Hangout Event:
{{CustomTabs |tab1 = Overview |tab2 = List |tab3 = Gallery }} {{Terminology Infobox |image = System Hangout Event.png |type = Quest Groups |group = Story Quests }} '''Hangout Events''', also known as '''Invitation Quests''', are special [[Story Quests]] that can be replayed and have multiple endings. ==Description== After unlocking Hangout Events, Travelers can go to the Hangout Events tab on the [[Story Quests]] screen to accept these choice-driven Story Quests. Each act in the Hangout Event requires 2 Story Keys in order to access. Further keys are not required for all of the content in that act. During the quests, the different choices Travelers make in dialogue will influence the direction of the story and lead to different endings. Every quest possesses a Heartbeat Value, but not all of them will utilize this feature. This value can increase or decrease depending on the Traveler's responses. If the meter fully empties, then the quest will fail. Decisions that branch into different scenarios will also serve as checkpoints to be returned to so the player can unlock different endings. These endings can be placed on [[Lingering Moment]]s in the [[Serenitea Pot]] mansion. Rewards can be obtained from these events depending on how many endings the player has accomplished. Rewards from these endings include [[Primogem]]s, [[Adventure EXP]], [[Hero's Wit]], [[Character Talent Material]]s, [[Character Ascension Material]]s, and the character's [[Special Dish]]. Hangout Events also award [[Memories of the Heart]] [[achievements]]. Generally, there is one {{Item|Primogem|x=20|notext=1}} achievement gained by unlocking all endings, with two {{Item|Primogem|x=5|notext=1}} hidden achievements that are gained by doing various tasks during the Hangout Event. ==List of Hangout Events== {{Story Quest Table|hangout = 1}} ==Descriptions== {{Description|'''Story Quests'''
Story Quests include not only the Story Quests of each character themselves, but also Hangout Events that let you spend more time with your favorite companions.

'''Unlocking Hangout Events'''
To gain access to Hangout Events, you must meet the following requirements:
·Complete the required preceding quests
·Reach the required Adventure Rank
·Use the required number of Story Keys

'''Obtaining Story Keys'''
To receive Story Keys, you must obtain a certain number of Daily Commission rewards.
Even the greatest heroes must first learn to excel at the small things in life before they can become worthy of undertaking legendary feats.
Receive a Story Key for every 8 Daily Commission rewards that you obtain.
The maximum number of Story Keys in your possession at any one time is subject to a limit.|Quests > Hangout Event > Unlocking Quests}} ==Gallery== Hangout Events.png|Main Promotional Poster Hangout Events Promo1.png|Promotional Material #1 Hangout Events Promo2.png|Promotional Material #2 Hangout Events Series I.png|Series I Overview Hangout Events Series II.png|Series II Overview Hangout Events Series III.png|Series III Overview Hangout Events Series IV.png|Series IV Overview Hangout Events Series V.png|Series V Overview Hangout Events Series VI.png|Series VI Overview Hangout Events Series VII.png|Series VII Overview Hangout Events Series VIII.png|Series VIII Overview Hangout Events Series IX.png|Series IX Overview Hangout Events Series X.png|Series X Overview Hangout Events Series XI.png|Series XI Overview Hangout Events Series XII.png|Series XII Overview ==Other Languages== {{Other Languages |en = Hangout Event |zhs = 邀约事件 |zhs_rm = Yāoyuē Shìjiàn |zht = 邀約事件 |zht_rm = Yāoyuē Shìjiàn |zh_tl = Invitation Event |ja = デートイベント |ja_rm = Deetoibento |ja_tl = Date Event |ko = 초대 이벤트 |ko_tl = Invitation Event |es = Encuentro |es_tl = Encounter |fr = Escapade |fr_tl = Getaway |ru = Встреча |ru_tl = Encounter |th = กิจกรรมแฮงเอ้าท์ |th_rm = Kitchakam Haeng-ao |th_tl = Hangout Event |vi = Sự Kiện Đồng Hành |vi_tl = Companion Event |de = Einladungsereignis |de_tl = Invitation Event |id = Event Undangan |id_tl = Invitation Event |pt = Eventos de Encontros |pt_tl = |tr = Arkadaşlık Etkinliği |tr_tl = Friendship Event |it = Evento incontro |it_tl = }} ==Change History== {{Change History|1.4}} ==Navigation== {{Genshin Navbox}} [[Category:Story Quests| ]] [[es:Encuentros]] [[fr:Escapade]] [[ja:デートイベント]] [[pt-br:Missões Lendárias/Eventos de Encontros]] [[ru:Встречи]] [[th:กิจกรรมแฮงเอ้าท์]] [[tr:Arkadaşlık etkinliği]] [[vi:Sự Kiện Đồng Hành]]
Story Quest:
{{CustomTabs |tab1 = Overview |tab2 = List |tab3 = Event List |tab4 = Gallery }} {{Terminology Infobox |image = System Story Quest.png|System Icon Story Quest.png|Marker |type = Quest Types }} {{Quote|Where will your journey take you, Traveler?|Blank Story Quest screen}} '''Story Quests''' are [[Quest]]s revolving around [[Playable Characters]] and their interactions with the [[Traveler]]. Character [[:Category:Story Quest Chapters|Story Quest Chapters]] are named after the character's [[Constellation/Gallery|constellation]], [[Hangout Event]]s are the character name, and [[Tribal Chronicles]] are the tribe name. Most Story Quests give the player the opportunity to trial the featured character for a brief period. This includes cases where said character may be in the player's active party, in which case they will be temporarily replaced with a trial version. A few character Story Quests are required in order to progress further into the [[Archon Quest]] series. Other character Story Quests are required to access some [[Weekly Boss|Weekly Bosses]]. Some Story Quests are part of [[Event]]s, and may require specific character Story Quests and/or Archon Quests in order to progress. Since [[Version 3.2]] however, these event Story Quests no longer require character Story Quests, however the game recommends players complete said quests first for the best experience and avoiding in-game spoilers. Story Quests for Natlan characters are presented in the form of [[Tribal Chronicles]], while the Story Quests for Nod-Krai characters released in between [[Version 6.0]] and [[Version 6.3]] are integrated into the [[Song of the Welkin Moon]] Archon Quest chapter. ==How to Unlock== All Story Quests have requirements that the player has to meet to unlock the quest. These requirements may differ between each act of the story chapter. Requirements include: * Reaching the required {{Icon|customfile=Item Adventure EXP.png}} [[Adventure Rank]]. * Completing prior quests in the chapter. * Completing Archon Quest acts. * Completing other Characters' Story Quests. * Using the required number of Story Keys. ==Story Keys== {{Main|Story Key}} [[File:Item Story Key.png|thumb|right|Story Key]] '''Story Keys''' are quest unlock items that players after Adventure Rank 26 can claim every 8 [[Commissions]] completed (i.e., 2 days of 4 Commissions). Story Keys will not be earned automatically and must be claimed from the Story Quests menu once eligible. A total of 3 Story Keys can be held at one time, but the counter will still continue to max out at 8, so one is able to immediately be claimed after one has been spent. * Hangout Event Acts require 2 Story Keys and repeating the same Hangout will not require more. * Story Quest Acts do not require Story Keys (Since [[Version 5.4]]). * Tribal Chronicles Acts do not require Story Keys. ==List of Story Quests== ===Character Story Chapters=== {{Story Quest Table}} ===Character Hangout Event Chapters=== {{Main|Hangout Event}} {{Transclude|Hangout Event|List of Hangout Events}} ===Tribal Chronicles=== {{Main|Tribal Chronicles}} {{Transclude|Tribal Chronicles|Available Tribal Chronicles}} ===Event Story Quest Chapters=== {{Main|Event Quest}} {| class="article-table sortable tdc1 tdc3" !style="text-align:center; width: 150px;"|Event !Acts and Requirements !style="text-align:center;"|Version |- |{{Chapter|Unreconciled Stars|event=1}} |data-sort-value="20"|'''Act I:''' [[Unknown Star]]

'''"Judgment Day"''' is the first part of {{Quest|Silent Night}}.

==Steps==
# Go to the Court of Fontaine: Quartier Lyonnais
# Talk to [[Clorinde]] and [[Navia]]
# Meet up with the others at [[Chioriya Boutique]]

==Dialogue==
{{Quest Description|On the streets of the Court of Fontaine, a pair of familiar faces seem to need your help...}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Approach Clorinde and Navia in Court of Fontaine{{colon}} Quartier Lyonnais)
:{{A|vo cllq001 1 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh? Do you also see Navia and Clorinde over there?
:{{A|vo cllq001 1 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' They look like they might have run into some kind of trouble... Let's go check out what's going on!

;(Talk to Clorinde and Navia)
:{{A|vo cllq001 2 clorinde 01.ogg}} '''Clorinde:''' ...Still no dice?
:{{A|vo cllq001 2 navia 01.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Not at all, and I've asked pretty much everyone in the Court of Fontaine already.
:{{A|vo cllq001 2 navia 02.ogg}} '''Navia:''' [[Lynette]]'s ears drooped as soon as she heard that we'd have to be out and about for days on end. And [[Freminet]]... he hid himself under his helmet as soon as he realized there'd be people around that he didn't know.
:{{A|vo cllq001 2 clorinde 02.ogg}} '''Clorinde:''' What about [[Chiori]] and [[Charlotte]]? I feel like both of them would be more than up to it.
:{{A|vo cllq001 2 navia 03.ogg}} '''Navia:''' I've asked them already, but they're both pretty busy right now. I just gave the members of the [[Spina di Rosula|Spina]] a few days off, too, so I don't want to bother them, either...
:{{A|vo cllq001 2 clorinde 03.ogg}} '''Clorinde:''' Hmm... This is getting pretty difficult.
:{{A|vo cllq001 2 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Navia! Clorinde! What's up?
:{{A|vo cllq001 2 navia 04.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Oh my! Well if it isn't my dear partners! How are you all doing?
:{{A|vo cllq001 2 clorinde 04.ogg}} '''Clorinde:''' Ha... Navia!
:{{A|vo cllq001 2 navia 05.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Huh? ...Ooh! You mean...
:{{A|vo cllq001 2 clorinde 05.ogg}} '''Clorinde:''' Yep, this is our chance...
:{{DIcon}} ...Wh—What are you going to do!?
:{{DIcon}} We were just passing through...
:{{A|vo cllq001 2 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Do you need our help with something...?
:{{A|vo cllq001 2 navia 06.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Precisely! My dear partners, we've got a huge problem right now that only you can solve!
:{{A|vo cllq001 2 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Woah! For real?
:{{A|vo cllq001 2 clorinde 06.ogg}} '''Clorinde:''' Absolutely. We've already exhausted all our other options.
:{{DIcon}} What kind of problem?
:{{DIcon}} Tell me about it...
:{{A|vo cllq001 2 navia 07.ogg}} '''Navia:''' {{Traveler}}, Paimon...
:{{A|vo cllq001 2 navia 08.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Would you join us, and play "Marechaussee Hunter: Judgment Day"!?
:{{A|vo cllq001 2 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Marechaussee what now?
:{{A|vo cllq001 2 clorinde 07.ogg}} '''Clorinde:''' It's a new game script by the Tabletop Troupe, a local roleplay adventure club.
:{{A|vo cllq001 2 navia 09.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Ever heard of the Tabletop Troupe? They put out games that allow you to participate in a story and roleplay characters with your friends. I've loved their stuff ever since I was a kid.
:{{A|vo cllq001 2 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' That sounds super interesting!
:{{A|vo cllq001 2 navia 10.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Clorinde and I are both veteran members of the club. Recently, someone came up with a new script and was looking for people to help playtest it for them.
:{{A|vo cllq001 2 navia 11.ogg}} '''Navia:''' And when they asked, of course I couldn't refuse. I mean, come on, a brand new script! Nobody has ever played it before!
:{{A|vo cllq001 2 clorinde 08.ogg}} '''Clorinde:''' Mm-hmm. Generally speaking, scripts at that level of development have a lot of issues, but I think this one is pretty solid. The author obviously put a lot of work into the story, and the worldbuilding is also quite credible.
:{{A|vo cllq001 2 navia 12.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Woah, woah, woah! I know I was the one that handed you the script, but some of us haven't read it yet! No spoilers, please!
:{{A|vo cllq001 2 clorinde 09.ogg}} '''Clorinde:''' ...Anyway, the script calls for a team of four. Ah, yes. We're missing one final player right now.
:{{DIcon}} You were right, that is a big problem!
:{{A|vo cllq001 2 navia 13.ogg}} '''Navia:''' So... you're saying you'll help us out? I knew I could count on you, partner!
:{{A|vo cllq001 2 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Paimon and {{Traveler}} are kind of a package deal. Is that okay?
:{{A|vo cllq001 2 clorinde 10.ogg}} '''Clorinde:''' That's not a problem. I'll adjust the pace based on the actual number of players and ensure that everyone has a good time.
:{{A|vo cllq001 2 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Well, {{Traveler}}, what do you think? Wanna play? Paimon will follow your lead.
:{{DIcon}} I always help a friend in need.
:{{DIcon}} Count me in for a great script!
:{{A|vo cllq001 2 clorinde 11.ogg}} '''Clorinde:''' Well, that solves our problem. You have our thanks.
:{{A|vo cllq001 2 navia 14.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Woo-hoo! I'll go grab the script manager from the club right away.
:{{A|vo cllq001 2 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' The script manager? Didn't you just say that you gave Clorinde the script?
:{{A|vo cllq001 2 clorinde 12.ogg}} '''Clorinde:''' The club introduced a completely new kind of gameplay for this script.
:{{A|vo cllq001 2 clorinde 13.ogg}} '''Clorinde:''' In this iteration, the Game Master's version of the script is incomplete. The script manager provides the next part of the script only after players have completed the current list of objectives.
:{{A|vo cllq001 2 clorinde 14.ogg}} '''Clorinde:''' On top of that, in order to increase player immersion, the club has created some of the story's sets and scenes in real life. We'll only know where we should go once the script manager reveals the starting location.
:{{A|vo cllq001 2 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wow, you're right, whoever wrote this script really did put in a lot of work!
:{{A|vo cllq001 2 navia 15.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Hehe, and it's got a real healthy amount of suspense, right? I mean, even the GM doesn't know how the story will end!
:{{A|vo cllq001 2 clorinde 15.ogg}} '''Clorinde:''' I look forward to experiencing it with you all.
:{{A|vo cllq001 2 navia 16.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Why don't you go meet up with the others first? They should all be waiting at Chioriya Boutique. I'll come over with the script manager as soon as I find them.
:{{A|vo cllq001 2 clorinde 16.ogg}} '''Clorinde:''' Sounds good. Remember to always watch where you're going, and don't rush.
:{{A|vo cllq001 2 navia 17.ogg}} '''Navia:''' You say that like I'm six years old or something!
:{{A|vo cllq001 2 navia 18.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Hmm... Let me think, what kind of character should I play this time?
:{{A|vo cllq001 2 clorinde 17.ogg}} '''Clorinde:''' ...I just hope you'll pick up some useful skills this time. Oh, and stop trying to "persuade" every animal you come across...
----
;(Approach Chioriya Boutique)
:{{A|vo cllq001 3 clorinde 01.ogg}} '''Clorinde:''' Sorry to keep you waiting.
:{{A|vo cllq001 3 furina 01.ogg}} '''Furina:''' Ah, you're back! Huh? And you've got {{Traveler}} and Paimon with you, too.
:{{A|vo cllq001 3 lyney 01.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' What a pleasant surprise. I assume you'll be joining us for the game, then?
:{{A|vo cllq001 3 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' [[Lyney]]! [[Furina]]! Paimon didn't know you were playing, too! Are you also members of the Tabletop Troupe?
:{{DIcon}} Hey, you two.
:{{A|vo cllq001 3 lyney 02.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Hmm, I'm more of a casual member, if anything. I haven't taken part in many formal club activities. Lynette, Freminet, and I play something similar at the [[Hotel Bouffes d'ete]] sometimes, but I'm usually the GM.
:{{A|vo cllq001 3 lyney 03.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Still, I'm sure it'll be fun being a player for the first time. I'm looking forward to it.
:{{A|vo cllq001 3 furina 02.ogg}} '''Furina:''' Well, I'm not a member of the club at all. Clorinde simply woke me up first thing this morning, said there was a good script worth experiencing, and asked if I wanted in.
:{{A|vo cllq001 3 clorinde 02.ogg}} '''Clorinde:''' If you're interested, I can give you a referral. That should give you a 40% discount on membership fees.
:{{A|vo cllq001 3 furina 03.ogg}} '''Furina:''' I think I'll wait to see how this experience plays out first, especially when it comes to the quality of the script. If it's sufficiently fun, then I'll join.
:{{A|vo cllq001 3 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Do you participate in a lot of Tabletop Troupe activities, Clorinde?
:{{A|vo cllq001 3 lyney 04.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' You could say that. She's actually one of the few "Senior Game Masters" of the Troupe.
:{{A|vo cllq001 3 furina 04.ogg}} '''Furina:''' Ah, right. I knew about that even when she was still my subordinate.
:{{A|vo cllq001 3 clorinde 03.ogg}} '''Clorinde:''' ...It's nothing, really. Just a small hobby of mine.
:{{A|vo cllq001 3 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wow, Paimon's so used to seeing you be all upstanding and intimidating as the [[Champion Duelist]]. It's kinda hard to imagine you roleplaying with a bunch of friends...
:{{DIcon}} So, if we have a problem with any of the rules...
:{{DIcon}} Do we have to submit a duel request to you...?
:{{A|vo cllq001 3 clorinde 04.ogg}} '''Clorinde:''' Surely you jest. I would never intentionally make things difficult for my players.
:{{A|vo cllq001 3 clorinde 05.ogg}} '''Clorinde:''' I maintain a clear boundary between my professional and personal lives. The me you see at court represents the law and order of Fontaine. I put all personal feelings to the side and grant a fair duel to all who seek to defend their honor.
:{{A|vo cllq001 3 clorinde 06.ogg}} '''Clorinde:''' But in my personal life, I'm just an ordinary person — someone who feels anger and sadness, just like everyone else.
:{{A|vo cllq001 3 furina 05.ogg}} '''Furina:''' Well, you say that, but for all the time I've known you, I don't think I've ever seen you cry... I've seen you get angry, sure, but... now I'm wondering whether you were actually mad or if it just looked that way from the outside?
:{{A|vo cllq001 3 clorinde 07.ogg}} '''Clorinde:''' I was probably in work mode during those times.
:{{A|vo cllq001 3 furina 06.ogg}} '''Furina:''' Is that so? Well, in any case, I just feel like even in your personal life, you don't get emotional very often.
:{{A|vo cllq001 3 clorinde 08.ogg}} '''Clorinde:''' So, you want to see me cry? That might be a little difficult. A show of anger, though... That might be something I could accomplish.
:{{A|vo cllq001 3 furina 07.ogg}} '''Furina:''' N—No, that's not what I meant...
:{{A|vo cllq001 3 navia 01.ogg}} '''Navia:''' I'm back! Here, allow me to introduce you to the script manager, Mr. [[Florian]]!
:{{A|vo cllq001 3 florian 01.ogg}} '''Florian:''' Pleasure to meet you all.
:{{A|vo cllq001 3 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hello! Wait, are you a Champion Duelist too, Mr. Florian?
:{{A|vo cllq001 3 florian 02.ogg}} '''Florian:''' Oh, no. This is just the costume provided by the club. I occasionally play a few roles in my scripts.
:{{A|vo cllq001 3 lyney 05.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' That sounds like a lot of work.
:{{A|vo cllq001 3 florian 03.ogg}} '''Florian:''' It's nothing. It's the least we can do to give the players a more immersive experience.
:{{A|vo cllq001 3 florian 04.ogg}} '''Florian:''' Anyway, allow me to give you a brief introduction of the script—
:{{A|vo cllq001 3 florian 05.ogg}} '''Florian:''' This script was adapted from the real history of the [[Marechaussee Phantom|Marechaussee Hunter]]s. You all will play the role of Hunters from a bygone era, and resolve a series of events unfolding in the capital.
:{{A|vo cllq001 3 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Erm... Paimon's not super familiar with the history of the Marechaussee Hunters. Is that a problem...?
:{{A|vo cllq001 3 florian 06.ogg}} '''Florian:''' Oh, no problem at all. I can give you a brief run down. So, basically, Marechaussee Hunters were people who dedicated themselves to hunting monsters and protecting the city by using a special swordsmanship technique passed down over generations.
:{{A|vo cllq001 3 florian 07.ogg}} '''Florian:''' Their story can be traced back to the ancient [[Remuria]]n dynasty, as well as the first hunter, [[Cassiodor]]...
:{{A|vo cllq001 3 florian 08.ogg}} '''Florian:''' But, I'll leave the finer details for you to seek out and discover later.
:{{A|vo cllq001 3 clorinde 09.ogg}} '''Clorinde:''' Mhm, and I'll provide additional commentary as the story progresses.
:{{A|vo cllq001 3 florian 09.ogg}} '''Florian:''' In that case... Ahem! Brave hunters, are you ready to set out on an unknown adventure?
:{{A|vo cllq001 3 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Whoa! Just one sentence, and it's like we're in the story already!
:{{A|vo cllq001 3 florian 10.ogg}} '''Florian:''' Aha, I see many a determined gaze before me. Very well. Head over to this location, and begin your heroic journey!
:{{Color|menu|Florian hands Clorinde an envelope before leaving.}}
:{{A|vo cllq001 3 furina 08.ogg}} '''Furina:''' So as we follow the story, it leads us to specific scenes? Sounds pretty innovative. What does the message in the envelope say?
:{{A|vo cllq001 3 clorinde 10.ogg}} '''Clorinde:''' It's the exact location of the scene, as well as the formal permission to use the venue. Seems like they have everything prepared.
:{{A|vo cllq001 3 clorinde 11.ogg}} '''Clorinde:''' Please check all your belongings, everyone, and make sure you haven't forgotten anything. Once you're ready, please follow me to the designated location.
:{{A|vo cllq001 3 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Sounds good! Hunter squad, move out!
{{Dialogue End}}

:{{A|vo yyeq002 7 dvorak 09.ogg}} '''Dvorak:''' Here's the music score and lyrics. I can't wait to see this!

:{{A|vo ymlq003 2 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' There's a really weird-looking stool as well. Wonder what it's for?
:{{A|vo ymlq003 2 yaemiko 03.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' Ah, I see. Heh, this setup is quite handy. Saves me a lot of work.
:{{A|vo ymlq003 2 yaemiko 04.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' Alright, go and take a look around. There should be a mechanism somewhere that makes the whole room move.

:{{A|vo ymlq003 3 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Whoa, it's that painting we just saw! It's turning this way, along with the whole wall!
:{{A|vo ymlq003 3 paimon 26.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' It's getting eerier and scarier! Wh—What is this place!?
:{{A|vo ymlq003 3 yaemiko 02.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' Okay. Next, I will show you a secret [[Kitsune (Species)|kitsune]] spell. This painting is a "swift summoning medium," which means I'll be able to skip many of the more tedious steps.
:{{A|vo ymlq003 3 yaemiko 03.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' The murky mirror reflects the view of Inazuma in a bygone age. Spirits stirred by the sight of the past will be easily drawn to it.
:{{A|vo ymlq003 3 yaemiko 04.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' You're up next, little one. Come on, sit yourself down here.
:{{DIcon}} Hold on, are we...
:{{DIcon}} Surely you're not planning to...
:{{A|vo ymlq003 3 yaemiko 05.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' Yes, the whole point of a summoning ritual is for a dead person's spirit to possess a living person's body.
:{{A|vo ymlq003 3 yaemiko 06.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' You saw what happened to that [[Arakawa Kouji|oni samurai]]'s spirit. After leaving the [[Katou Shingo|host]]'s body, he was only able to maintain his form for a very short time before disappearing.
:{{A|vo ymlq003 3 paimon 02a.ogg}} {{A|vo ymlq003 3 paimon 02b.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Are we positive that summoning a spirit to possess {{Traveler}} isn't gonna have any lasting negative consequences?
:{{A|vo ymlq003 3 yaemiko 07.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' Aw, you really care about the little one quite a lot, don't you? Hm, I'm a little jealous. I wish my friends were caring like that.
:{{A|vo ymlq003 3 yaemiko 08.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' Anyway, are you scared, little friend? Don't you worry, now, it'll be over soon. Just think of it like having a dream.
:{{DIcon}} What do I need to do?
:{{A|vo ymlq003 3 yaemiko 09.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' Sit on the chair, stare at the painting, and relax your body and mind. But try and be natural, there's really no need to be nervous.
:{{A|vo ymlq003 3 paimon 03a.ogg}} {{A|vo ymlq003 3 paimon 03b.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' It's like {{Traveler}}'s sitting inside the painting.
:{{A|vo ymlq003 3 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh!? Is Paimon seeing things? Did the painting just move!?
:{{A|vo ymlq003 3 yaemiko 10.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' Recite the incantation in your heart, little one. Also, you'll need to have some intense thoughts going through your head — a wish, for example.
:{{A|vo ymlq003 3 yaemiko 11.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' Now, what kind of wish do we think it would take to summon forth the author of "A Firsthand Guide to Summoning Spirits"? Anyone?
:{{A|vo ymlq003 3 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Umm... probably something to do with writing?
:{{A|vo ymlq003 3 yaemiko 12.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' Very good! The wish needs to be heartfelt, though, so let me help add a little realism to the equation:
:{{A|vo ymlq003 3 yaemiko 13.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' "The book is selling exceptionally well, Traveler, but we're going to need an outline for chapter four as soon as humanly possible. When is the earliest that you can turn it in by?"
:{{DIcon}} Aaaah, please, someone, anyone!
:{{DIcon}} Help me write chapter four!
:{{A|vo ymlq003 3 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' The painting is moving again! What the—

:{{color|menu|The strange aura travels from within the painting onto you, and the scene before your eyes changes...}}

:{{A|vo ymlq003 3 urakusai 01.ogg}} '''???:''' ...
:{{A|vo ymlq003 3 urakusai 02.ogg}} '''???:''' Haw-haw... I never thought the day would come when I'd be summoned using my own ritual! Getting a taste of my own medicine...
:{{A|vo ymlq003 3 urakusai 03.ogg}} '''???:''' What have we here? Another budding writer? What's come over you all, why is everyone wishing for help with their writing? Are novels so popular in this day and age?
:{{A|vo ymlq003 3 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' We got you! So, you were the one who wrote "A Firsthand Guide to Summoning Spirits"!
:{{A|vo ymlq003 3 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What are you trying to do, hmm? Why'd you put that summoning incantation in the book, huh? What's your game here?
:{{A|vo ymlq003 3 urakusai 04.ogg}} '''???:''' Huh? What's this?
:{{A|vo ymlq003 3 urakusai 05.ogg}} '''???:''' Oh, ho-ho, I see... No wonder this felt so familiar. I've walked right into your trap, haven't I.
:{{A|vo ymlq003 3 urakusai 06.ogg}} '''???:''' You ask me what my game is here? Well of course... it was to use this incantation as a means for all the souls of the departed [[youkai]] to make their glorious return to the world and plunge all of Inazuma into a brutal, bloody war!
:{{A|vo ymlq003 3 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What!? Paimon knew it! You had an evil plan all along!
:{{A|vo ymlq003 3 urakusai 07.ogg}} '''???:''' Oh, did you now? Then how naive of you to let me possess this body so easily!
:{{A|vo ymlq003 3 urakusai 08a.ogg}} {{A|vo ymlq003 3 urakusai 08b.ogg}} '''???:''' I sense... Yes, great power within {{MC|him|her|mc=1}}...
:{{A|vo ymlq003 3 urakusai 09.ogg}} '''???:''' Good... good! With this power, no one shall be able to stand in my way!
:{{A|vo ymlq003 3 urakusai 10.ogg}} '''???:''' Mwuhahahahahaha!
:{{A|vo ymlq003 3 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wake up, {{Traveler}}! Quick, wake up! We gotta stop him!
:{{A|vo ymlq003 3 urakusai 11a.ogg}} {{A|vo ymlq003 3 urakusai 11b.ogg}} '''???:''' It is futile... you shall never wake {{MC|him|her|mc=1}} again! This body now belongs to me!
:{{A|vo ymlq003 3 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hey! Come on, wake up! Don't let him take your mind!
:{{A|vo ymlq003 3 paimon 12.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Miko! Think of something! Miko! Miko!!!
:{{A|vo ymlq003 3 yaemiko 14.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' ...
:{{A|vo ymlq003 3 yaemiko 15.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' Pfff...
:{{A|vo ymlq003 3 yaemiko 16.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' Bahahahaha...
:{{A|vo ymlq003 3 urakusai 12.ogg}} '''???:''' Hahahaha...
:{{A|vo ymlq003 3 paimon 13.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' ...Um...
:{{A|vo ymlq003 3 paimon 14.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You're laughing!?
:{{A|vo ymlq003 3 yaemiko 17.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' Ahahahahahaha, oh, [[Urakusai]], you haven't changed a bit. You caught on so quickly. Too perfect.
:{{A|vo ymlq003 3 urakusai 13.ogg}} '''Urakusai:''' Haw-haw, well, you made the face enough times that I couldn't exactly miss the hint. This is what you were going for, yes? Never one to stand on the sidelines of a good spectacle, are you? Always got to dive in and fan the flames... Ah, you mischievous little kitsune, you...
:{{A|vo ymlq003 3 urakusai 14.ogg}} '''Urakusai:''' Look what you've done to this little flying one here. Aw, poor thing's scared witless.
:{{A|vo ymlq003 3 yaemiko 18.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' Pfft, you were having plenty of fun playing the bad guy a moment ago. Now you're trying blame it all on me?
:{{A|vo ymlq003 3 paimon 15.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Urakusai? Miko, you guys know each other?
:{{A|vo ymlq003 3 urakusai 15.ogg}} '''Urakusai:''' Yes, we do! Of course we do.
:{{A|vo ymlq003 3 yaemiko 19.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' Hehe, allow me to formally introduce the author of "A Firsthand Guide to Summoning Spirits," Urakusai.
:{{A|vo ymlq003 3 yaemiko 20.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' No, wait. To be more accurate, it's Urakusai's memory.
:{{A|vo ymlq003 3 paimon 16.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Memory? But... isn't he a spirit?
:{{A|vo ymlq003 3 urakusai 16.ogg}} '''Urakusai:''' Ah, spirits, memories... they're just different words to describe the same thing. Something that comes from the [[Ley Line]]s.
:{{A|vo ymlq003 3 yaemiko 21.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' Do you remember that [[Cleansing Light|recent incident]] when the [[rifthound]]s were gnawing at the [[Sacred Sakura]]'s roots?
:{{A|vo ymlq003 3 yaemiko 22.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' You witnessed human memories leaking from the Ley Lines, didn't you? Well, since there are human memories, of course there are going to be youkai memories, too.
:{{A|vo ymlq003 3 yaemiko 23.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' In life, youkai possess supernatural powers, and even when they are a shadow of their former selves from a bygone era, they still have the ability to control whether they are visible or not.
:{{A|vo ymlq003 3 yaemiko 24.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' Typically, youkai memories survive longer in the world than those of humans.
:{{A|vo ymlq003 3 urakusai 17.ogg}} '''Urakusai:''' Indeed, indeed. I was wandering around the Sacred Sakura's roots, when I suddenly heard someone yelling "Please, someone, anyone! Help me write a truly amazing novel!"
:{{A|vo ymlq003 3 urakusai 18.ogg}} '''Urakusai:''' It piqued my curiosity, so I popped inside his body and wrote a novel for him.
:{{A|vo ymlq003 3 paimon 17.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So that's how it happened... But why did you include a summoning incantation in the novel?
:{{A|vo ymlq003 3 urakusai 19.ogg}} '''Urakusai:''' Oh, little one... not to toot my own horn here, but when I was alive, I wasn't just another kitsune, no. I was a mighty and powerful Daiyouko. The memories of other youkai can't possess human bodies at will like I can.
:{{A|vo ymlq003 3 urakusai 08.ogg}} '''Urakusai:''' But with this incantation, they can go one last little joyride in the world for a couple of days. Anything they're still itching to do, they can go and get it done!
:{{A|vo ymlq003 3 paimon 18.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Uh, but... but...
:{{A|vo ymlq003 3 yaemiko 25.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' She's trying to say that all the commotion this causes is likely to be a great disturbance to the humans.
:{{A|vo ymlq003 3 urakusai 20.ogg}} '''Urakusai:''' Disturbance? Haw-haw, I guess you mean that we might leave them with some broken dreams after we leave, hmm? Oh, yes, and they might have a fever, or whatever.
:{{A|vo ymlq003 3 urakusai 21.ogg}} '''Urakusai:''' But you know, I actually think that the most admirable thing about human beings is the way that they go out and shape their fate with their own two hands, given that they're not born blessed with the same powers that we enjoy.
:{{A|vo ymlq003 3 urakusai 22.ogg}} '''Urakusai:''' As for those who would rather draw on external power than seek to improve themselves, it's quite right that they learn their lesson eventually.
:{{A|vo ymlq003 3 urakusai 23.ogg}} '''Urakusai:''' So when you think about it, we're actually doing the humans a big favor. Miko, you agree, don't you?
:{{A|vo ymlq003 3 yaemiko 26.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' Hehe, yes, that's what I thought, too.
:{{A|vo ymlq003 3 paimon 19.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Alright then... You've finally convinced Paimon, you guys were right.
:{{A|vo ymlq003 3 urakusai 24.ogg}} '''Urakusai:''' What are you scared of, little one? Don't be deceived by her day-to-day antics. Miko is actually one of the most powerful youkai out there.
:{{A|vo ymlq003 3 yaemiko 27.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' Not only that, Urakusai, but my latest work has beaten that book you wrote, "A Firsthand Guide to Summoning Spirits," to become the most popular in Inazuma.
:{{A|vo ymlq003 3 urakusai 25.ogg}} '''Urakusai:''' Hmph, of course. You were never one to make extra work for yourself where you can help it, and yet you went to all these lengths to find my painting room and even took the trouble to summon me... I knew you must have some ulterior motive!
:{{A|vo ymlq003 3 urakusai 26.ogg}} '''Urakusai:''' You were always the one to pick a quarrel with me when we all used to gather around and share stories.
:{{A|vo ymlq003 3 urakusai 27.ogg}} '''Urakusai:''' Alright, alright. You win, I lose. Happy now?
:{{A|vo ymlq003 3 yaemiko 28.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' Ha! I finally get to hear you say it, centuries later. Oh, I must say it feels good.
:{{A|vo ymlq003 3 urakusai 28.ogg}} '''Urakusai:''' Mmm... I remember when you were just a little girl, always hanging off my shoulders. A few hundred years later, and you're all grown up.
:{{A|vo ymlq003 3 yaemiko 29.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' Urakusai, how much time do you have left?
:{{A|vo ymlq003 3 urakusai 29.ogg}} '''Urakusai:''' Not much. That goes for all of us, actually. We've all got to go back where we came from in the end.
:{{A|vo ymlq003 3 urakusai 30.ogg}} '''Urakusai:''' Everyone's quite content in many ways, but they still can't help but ask: "Are we ever going to have another [[Hyakkiyakou]]?"
:{{A|vo ymlq003 3 yaemiko 30.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' Hehe, don't you worry about that, Urakusai. Arrangements are being made.
:{{A|vo ymlq003 3 yaemiko 31.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' When my bell rings, it means the moonless night is upon us.
:{{A|vo ymlq003 3 urakusai 31.ogg}} '''Urakusai:''' Haw-haw, great, wonderful! Fantastic!
:{{A|vo ymlq003 3 urakusai 32.ogg}} '''Urakusai:''' Miko, it's been nice catching up, but I'd better conserve my energy if I want to stick it out until then. So I'll be on my way now.
:{{A|vo ymlq003 3 yaemiko 32.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' Alright. Goodbye then, Urakusai.
:{{A|vo ymlq003 3 urakusai 33.ogg}} '''Urakusai:''' One last thing, Miko... I just want to know, have you been well all these years?
:{{A|vo ymlq003 3 yaemiko 33.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' I've been great, of course. Every day is a happy one.
:{{A|vo ymlq003 3 yaemiko 34.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' Especially these days. Not only do I have my light novels, but I've also met these two delightfully nosy outlanders.
:{{A|vo ymlq003 3 yaemiko 35.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' And even [[Ei]] is finally starting to come to her senses. Quite a miracle, given how pig-headed she can be.
:{{A|vo ymlq003 3 urakusai 34.ogg}} '''Urakusai:''' Oh, well great! That's fantastic!
:{{A|vo ymlq003 3 yaemiko 36.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' Urakusai, you'd be right at home in this era.
:{{A|vo ymlq003 3 yaemiko 37.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' A great storyteller and artist like yourself would be the [[Yae Publishing House]]'s ace in the hole. And I would personally be hounding you over your next installment.
:{{A|vo ymlq003 3 urakusai 35.ogg}} '''Urakusai:''' Hehe, hahahaha...
:{{A|vo ymlq003 3 paimon 20.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' He disappeared...
:{{A|vo ymlq003 3 paimon 21.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Are you awake, {{Traveler}}? How are you feeling?
:{{A|vo ymlq003 3 yaemiko 38.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' Are you all there? Here, like last time, repeat after me—
:{{DIcon}} "3, 2, 1"...
:{{DIcon}} "1, 2, 3"...
:{{A|vo ymlq003 3 yaemiko 39.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' Oh, you beat me to it. Looks like your brain is intact.
:{{A|vo ymlq003 3 yaemiko 40.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' So, your first possession, hmm? What was it like?
:{{DIcon}} I remember everything pretty clearly.
:{{DIcon}} I just couldn't get in on the conversation myself.
:{{A|vo ymlq003 3 yaemiko 41.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' Hehe, good. Saves me from having to explain everything again.
:{{A|vo ymlq003 3 yaemiko 42.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' Hearing Urakusai admit defeat has put me in the most wonderful mood. In return, it's only fair that we make sure to deliver on what they're all hoping for.
:{{DIcon}} You mean the "moonless night"?
:{{DIcon}} They want to do a "Hyakkiyakou"?
:{{A|vo ymlq003 3 yaemiko 43.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' Yes. Though they only represent a tiny proportion of the memories in the Ley Lines, it will still be quite a sight to behold when the time comes.
:{{A|vo ymlq003 3 yaemiko 44.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' Since you've come this far, why don't you do one last thing for me, hmm? I'll need your help with the ritual.
:{{A|vo ymlq003 3 paimon 22.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You cannot be serious, Miko! After all that, you still have more errands for us?
:{{A|vo ymlq003 3 paimon 23.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hmph, you guys teamed up to scare Paimon just now. If you think Paimon's gonna do anything you ask for, think again!
:{{A|vo ymlq003 3 yaemiko 45.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' Aw, come on, I'm really only asking you to finish what you started. Besides... your paychecks are still in my hands. Heh, heh, heh.
:{{A|vo ymlq003 3 paimon 24.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Paimon's paycheck!
:{{DIcon}} My paycheck!!!
:{{A|vo ymlq003 3 paimon 25.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ugh, well there's no way out now... We're in too deep.
{{Dialogue End}}

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
{{Quest Description|Instead of placing your bet on a sketchy legend, catching up on some rest seems like the better option for Layla right now.}}

===A Change of Pace===
;(Upon Arriving Puspa Café)
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915702 layla 01.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Let's sit down here and have some coffee and sweets. It'll help me put my thoughts together.
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915702 layla 02.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Ah no, we're here to rest... My problems will have to wait for now.
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915702 munirah 01.ogg}} '''Munirah:''' Oh, hey Layla!
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915702 layla 03.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Huh...
:{{DIcon}} Sorry, but who are you?
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915702 munirah 02.ogg}} '''Munirah:''' I'm one of Layla's classmates. I just came by to say hi.
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915702 munirah 03.ogg}} '''Munirah:''' We just submitted our theses, and we're totally beat. Everyone will be meeting here to celebrate.
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915702 munirah 04.ogg}} '''Munirah:''' Seeing how relaxed you look, you must've already had your thesis finished ages ago.
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915702 layla 04.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Oh, no I... I'm actually having a lot of trouble with it...
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915702 munirah 05.ogg}} '''Munirah:''' You say that every time we talk, but you've never missed a deadline. Not only that, your papers are always well-written and thorough. Your adviser is constantly praising your work.
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915702 munirah 06.ogg}} '''Munirah:''' Yet you're always going around saying stuff like, "I can't make it, I don't understand, I'm super worried..." That kind of talk doesn't reflect your work at all, you know.
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915702 layla 05.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Well, uh I...
:{{DIcon}} What are you getting at?
:{{DIcon}} Why are you so hostile towards Layla?
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915702 munirah 07.ogg}} '''Munirah:''' For starters, she doesn't even try to participate with the group at all. It's one thing that she's not willing to help us, but she doesn't even bother showing up for our discussion meetings.
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915702 munirah 08.ogg}} '''Munirah:''' Every time we come to see her, she looks out of sorts and on the verge of a breakdown.
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915702 munirah 09.ogg}} '''Munirah:''' It's not like we can't finish our own theses without her, but no one wants to always see her this way.
;(Stress Value +1)
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915702 layla 06.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Ugh, I know, I know... sorry.
:{{DIcon}} Everyone is entitled to their own choices. You should learn to respect that.
:{{DIcon}} Just because Layla breaks the mold doesn't mean it's a problem.
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915702 munirah 10.ogg}} '''Munirah:''' Whatever. There's no point in starting an argument here.
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915702 munirah 11.ogg}} '''Munirah:''' If you think she can justify her behavior, then that's your opinion. Hmph.
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915702 layla 07.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Thanks for standing up for me.
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915702 layla 08.ogg}} '''Layla:''' I really want to help the others, but most of the time I'm barely scraping by myself... There's very little I can help with...
:{{DIcon}} Is it because you don't want others to know about the "blessing from the stars"?
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915702 layla 09.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Yeah. I can't ever tell my classmates about that. I'd be a mess if they ever reported it to my adviser...
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915702 layla 10.ogg}} '''Layla:''' It's really just a big misunderstanding, and there's nothing I can do about it... Everyone just gives me weird looks and judges me... It's making it really difficult to find friends.
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915702 layla 11.ogg}} '''Layla:''' It's actually pretty rare for someone to actively engage in a conversation with me like you do.
:{{DIcon}} I think I understand your situation now.
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915702 layla 12.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Huh, what do you mean?
:{{DIcon}} You think that the blessing from the stars is some external power that's out of your control.
:{{DIcon}} Only by improving yourself and no longer relying on an external power can you break out of the vicious cycle.
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915702 layla 13.ogg}} '''Layla:''' *sigh* ...Yeah, that's exactly it. Seems you know just as well as I do.
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915702 layla 14.ogg}} '''Layla:''' The thing is, I'm terrible under pressure, that's just my nature. Even the thought of everyone's expectations back home is enough to make me feel nervous...
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915702 layla 15.ogg}} '''Layla:''' And the more nervous I get, the worse things become around me. Take what Munirah just said for example... I don't think I'll be able to get it out of my mind for the entire day... That means I won't be able to relax at all today...
:{{Hangout Branch|Why don't we try facing the problem head-on?|The Helper}}
::{{A|vo lylcop001 1915702 layla 16.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Face it head-on? Wh—What should I do? Do you really think I can...?

'''''A Cloud-Sea Appeal, a Brilliance Revealed''''' is an [[Event Quest]] and the only quest in {{Quest|A Cloud-Sea Appeal, a Brilliance Revealed}}.

==Steps==
# Wait until the appointed time (08:00 – 12:00 two days later)
# Go to Xinyue Kiosk and have dim sum with Gaming
# Go to Mt. Aocang
# Check on how construction is going (0/3)
# Make a kite
# Figure out where Xianyun's gone
# Follow Xianyun and check out the situation
# Return to Mt. Aocang
# Go to the abode entrance

:{{A|vo eqhdj302 19 ganyu 06.ogg}} '''Ganyu:''' Oh! It's been so long since I've had the chance to enjoy your cooking, Cloud Retainer!
:{{A|vo eqhdj302 19 shenhe 10.ogg}} '''Shenhe:''' ...Uh.
:{{A|vo eqhdj302 19 xianyun 04.ogg}} '''Xianyun:''' Worry not. One has prepared a variety of meat and vegetable dishes. One is more than familiar with everyone's culinary proclivities.
:{{DIcon}} We'll take you up on your offer then.
:{{DIcon}} I call dibs on Paimon's portion.
::{{A|vo eqhdj302 19 paimon 05b 1.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hey! Paimon's hungry too! It's not like the dim sum and grilled fish could keep her full the whole day, y'know!
:{{A|vo eqhdj302 19 xianyun 05.ogg}} '''Xianyun:''' Shenhe, Ganyu, come with me.
:{{A|vo eqhdj302 19 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Woah, what's with all the secrecy? You're not trying to play favorites, are you?
:{{A|vo eqhdj302 19 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' If you're ready to serve the food, we can help too!

;(Approach Cloud Retainer's abode)
:{{Black Screen|You wait outside Cloud Retainer's abode for a few moments...}}
:{{A|vo eqhdj302 20 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Th—This is...!
:;(Ganyu and Shenhe appear in their [[Twilight Blossom]] and [[Frostflower Dew]] outfits, repectively)
:{{A|vo eqhdj302 20 ganyu 01.ogg}} '''Ganyu:''' (Ohh... I can feel the wind brushing against my legs. This is a bit embarrassing...)
:{{A|vo eqhdj302 20 ganyu 02.ogg}} '''Ganyu:''' (Is the headpiece secure? I should have asked Cloud Retainer to check before I stepped outside...)
:{{A|vo eqhdj302 20 shenhe 01.ogg}} '''Shenhe:''' How do we look?
:{{A|vo eqhdj302 20 ganyu 03.ogg}} '''Ganyu:''' (Huh!? She asked them just like that...?)
:{{DIcon}} You look great.
:{{A|vo eqhdj302 20 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You look pretty too, Ganyu. How should Paimon put it? You both look so elegant and refined — those outfits really suit you both.
:{{A|vo eqhdj302 20 xianyun 01.ogg}} '''Xianyun:''' Given that one employed the services of the best tailor in all of Liyue, one would expect nothing less.
:;(A flashback begins)
:{{A|vo eqhdj302 20 xianyun 02.ogg}} '''Xianyun:''' What colors have you been partial to lately, Shenhe and Ganyu?
:{{A|vo eqhdj302 20 ganyu 04.ogg}} '''Ganyu:''' (Lately? Why is Cloud Retainer suddenly asking about what colors we like?)
:{{A|vo eqhdj302 20 shenhe 02.ogg}} '''Shenhe:''' I like black.
:{{A|vo eqhdj302 20 xianyun 03.ogg}} '''Xianyun:''' One is gratified to see that one's disciple has inherited one's own tastes.
:{{A|vo eqhdj302 20 shenhe 03.ogg}} '''Shenhe:''' (The color black doesn't get dirty easily — a virtue I've come to value recently.)
:{{A|vo eqhdj302 20 xianyun 04.ogg}} '''Xianyun:''' And you, Ganyu?
:{{A|vo eqhdj302 20 ganyu 05.ogg}} '''Ganyu:''' I favor blue and black.
:;(Flashback ends)
:{{A|vo eqhdj302 20 xianyun 05.ogg}} '''Xianyun:''' And the material is sufficiently comfortable, yes?
:{{A|vo eqhdj302 20 ganyu 06.ogg}} '''Ganyu:''' Yes, very. I simply cannot thank you enough, Cloud Retainer — for this gift, and the kite, too.
:{{A|vo eqhdj302 20 shenhe 04.ogg}} '''Shenhe:''' Thank you, Master.
:{{A|vo eqhdj302 20 xianyun 06.ogg}} '''Xianyun:''' One is content as long as you are pleased with the gift. One hopes these garments will see much use.
:{{Black Screen|You sit down and enjoy a tableful of delicious food and pleasant company...}}
:{{A|vo eqhdj302 20 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Seems like your [[Supreme Cuisine Machine]] is just getting better and better, Xianyun!
:{{A|vo eqhdj302 20 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' This Golden Crab's particularly good. The shell's deliciously crunchy, and the meat inside is so succulent and sweet. Hehe, Paimon can't stop eating!
:{{A|vo eqhdj302 20 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' It's a good thing Gaming isn't here or Paimon would have to have to duel him for the food — y'know, with chopsticks!
:{{DIcon}} It would be a close match.
:{{DIcon}} You'd trounce him.
:{{A|vo eqhdj302 20 xianyun 07.ogg}} '''Xianyun:''' He traveled all this way on account of the kite-making workshop, and he spent the whole afternoon looking after Shuyu... One was hoping to treat him to a meal.
:{{A|vo eqhdj302 20 xianyun 08.ogg}} '''Xianyun:''' Oh well... One will just have to extend one's thanks in person.
:{{A|vo eqhdj302 20 ganyu 07.ogg}} '''Ganyu:''' It's rare for someone to make such a good impression on you, Cloud Retainer.
:{{A|vo eqhdj302 20 xianyun 09.ogg}} '''Xianyun:''' Hah. One has high standards.
:{{A|vo eqhdj302 20 xianyun 10.ogg}} '''Xianyun:''' He appears to be a young man of much merit, and one is not the type who would see such potential squandered.
:{{A|vo eqhdj302 20 shenhe 05.ogg}} '''Shenhe:''' It appears that he wishes to break free from the kite string that tethers him.
:{{A|vo eqhdj302 20 xianyun 11.ogg}} '''Xianyun:''' Kite string? What strange metaphors you speak in, Shenhe. Ever since you returned from Wanmin Restaurant, your turns of phrase render one at quite the loss.
:{{A|vo eqhdj302 20 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Where do we even begin... Oh, do you know about the conflict between Gaming and his dad, Xianyun?
:{{A|vo eqhdj302 20 xianyun 12.ogg}} '''Xianyun:''' One has only heard that the two are not on good terms...
:{{A|vo eqhdj302 20 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' He ran away from home and hasn't been back since!
:{{A|vo eqhdj302 20 shenhe 06.ogg}} '''Shenhe:''' Oh?
:{{A|vo eqhdj302 20 xianyun 13.ogg}} '''Xianyun:''' Ran away, you say? One believes we would all benefit from a more thorough retelling. Start from the beginning.
:{{A|vo eqhdj302 20 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, okay. Paimon just hopes he won't mind...
:{{Black Screen|Paimon tells Cloud Retainer everything she knows about Gaming's family situation...}}
:{{A|vo eqhdj302 20 shenhe 07.ogg}} '''Shenhe:''' ...What?
:{{A|vo eqhdj302 20 xianyun 14.ogg}} '''Xianyun:''' This shall not do!
:{{A|vo eqhdj302 20 xianyun 15.ogg}} '''Xianyun:''' Lantern Rite fast approaches. We must make haste.
:{{A|vo eqhdj302 20 xianyun 16.ogg}} '''Xianyun:''' As one was contacting various tailors around Liyue, one could not help but be reminded of [[Menogias]].
:{{A|vo eqhdj302 20 xianyun 17.ogg}} '''Xianyun:''' He possessed a singular talent for clothing design. He had an exquisite eye not just for fabric selection and color pairing, but also for what accessories could best accentuate a garment's overall styling.
:{{A|vo eqhdj302 20 xianyun 18.ogg}} '''Xianyun:''' At a gathering of adepti, [[Bonanus]] once complained in secret to some of the ladies in attendance that the skirt Menogias made for her was too long and impractical, lamenting that it would only hinder her in battle.
:{{A|vo eqhdj302 20 xianyun 19.ogg}} '''Xianyun:''' However, when one asked Menogias his opinion, he remarked that the train of the skirt would serve to enhance her adeptal countenance by exemplifying a certain elegance. Menogias was that type of person. When it came to topics relating to garments and accessories, not even Rex Lapis could best his stubbornness.
:{{A|vo eqhdj302 20 xianyun 20.ogg}} '''Xianyun:''' And later...
:{{DIcon}} ...
:{{A|vo eqhdj302 20 xianyun 21.ogg}} '''Xianyun:''' Ah, one seems to have strayed off-topic.
:{{A|vo eqhdj302 20 xianyun 22.ogg}} '''Xianyun:''' One means to say that Lantern Rite should be a day of reunion.
:{{A|vo eqhdj302 20 xianyun 23.ogg}} '''Xianyun:''' It is a time to address problems before they turn into regrets.
:{{A|vo eqhdj302 20 xianyun 24.ogg}} '''Xianyun:''' Fate is fickle. The cruel reality of this world is that suffering and misfortune can befall any of us without design or reason. If there is a chance for young people to remain insulated from this reality, one should do one's utmost to make it so.
:{{A|vo eqhdj302 20 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' That's nice and all, but...
:{{A|vo eqhdj302 20 ganyu 08.ogg}} '''Ganyu:''' Do you have any ideas, Cloud Retainer?
:{{A|vo eqhdj302 20 xianyun 25.ogg}} '''Xianyun:''' Perhaps adeptal arts could be of use? No, no... mechanics, perhaps? Hmm, one fails to see its use in a situation such as this...
:{{A|vo eqhdj302 20 shenhe 08.ogg}} '''Shenhe:''' ...Is there anything I can do to help?
:{{A|vo eqhdj302 20 xianyun 26.ogg}} '''Xianyun:''' Hmm...
:{{A|vo eqhdj302 20 xianyun 27.ogg}} '''Xianyun:''' Combining our efforts... is a fine idea indeed.
:{{A|vo eqhdj302 20 xianyun 28.ogg}} '''Xianyun:''' Aha! One has an idea...
:{{A|vo eqhdj302 20 xianyun 29.ogg}} '''Xianyun:''' How about this...
:;(Xianyun discusses her plans with the others)
:{{A|vo eqhdj302 20 xianyun 30.ogg}} '''Xianyun:''' ...Does that make sense to everyone?
:{{A|vo eqhdj302 20 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yep! Paimon really hopes this works!
:{{A|vo eqhdj302 20 xianyun 31.ogg}} '''Xianyun:''' Hmph, one's designs never fail.
:{{A|vo eqhdj302 20 xianyun 32.ogg}} '''Xianyun:''' Now then, I counsel rest for all, and to make the necessary preparations. One shall see you in two days...
{{Dialogue End}}

'''''A Commission Catches You in Natlan''''' is the first quest in {{Quest|The Truth of the Battle of Seven Colors}}.

==Start Location==
The quest automatically starts upon approaching the three [[Fatui]] on the first platform of the "Masters of the Night-Wind". The quest will not trigger unless ''[[Incandescent Ode of Resurrection]]'' has been completed.

;(Approach the Fatui)
:{{A|vo xtlllq003 1 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh? What are the Fatui doing here?
:{{A|vo xtlllq003 1 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' That's a little concerning... Let's go over there and see what they're up to.

:{{A|vo xtlllq003 2 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ahem! What are you guys doing here?
:{{A|vo xtlllq003 2 grudoc 01.ogg}} '''???:''' Heh, following orders. If you have a problem, take it up with our employer.
:{{A|vo xtlllq003 2 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hey, what's with the attitude? Can the Fatui even work for a private employer?
:{{A|vo xtlllq003 2 montluson 01.ogg}} '''???:''' Ahem! This is [[Grudoc]] — I hired him to be my bodyguard in Natlan. As you can see, he's not the sociable type. I'm sorry for any offense.
:{{A|vo xtlllq003 2 montluson 02.ogg}} '''???:''' My original plan was to hire someone from the local tribes, but a priest recommended Grudoc and his squad.
:{{A|vo xtlllq003 2 montluson 03.ogg}} '''???:''' I was told they were capable fighters and had the time to spare, so they fit the bill... It seems like the Fatui's reputation in Natlan is quite positive.
:{{A|vo xtlllq003 2 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So, that's what happened... Then, you must be from Fontaine?
:{{A|vo xtlllq003 2 montluson 04a.ogg}} {{A|vo xtlllq003 2 montluson 04b.ogg}} '''Montluson:''' Precisely! [[Montluson]], at your service. I work in the publication business. And you two... Wait, you must be {{Traveler}} and {{MC|m=his|f=her}} fairy companion!
:{{A|vo xtlllq003 2 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, you know us?
:{{A|vo xtlllq003 2 montluson 05.ogg}} '''Montluson:''' A golden-haired Traveler with a floating companion... There's no mistake!
:{{A|vo xtlllq003 2 montluson 06.ogg}} '''Montluson:''' Your exploits in Fontaine have all the makings of a best-selling series! I'd be a failure of a book merchant if I couldn't recognize you.
:{{A|vo xtlllq003 2 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wow, we're really famous at this point, {{Traveler}}!
:{{A|vo xtlllq003 2 montluson 07.ogg}} '''Montluson:''' It's truly my lucky day! I know this is sudden, but I was actually looking for you two... You see, I have a favor to ask.
:{{A|vo xtlllq003 2 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So, you... chased us all the way to Natlan? That's a little creepy...
:{{A|vo xtlllq003 2 montluson 08.ogg}} '''Montluson:''' You'll be generously rewarded, I promise you!
:{{A|vo xtlllq003 2 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' ...Well, at least he got straight to the point. Should we hear what he has to say?
:{{DIcon}} Something tells me we can't escape this one.
:{{DIcon}} And if the pay is good...
:{{A|vo xtlllq003 2 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' *ahem*... Alright, we'll hear your request.
:{{A|vo xtlllq003 2 montluson 09.ogg}} '''Montluson:''' You know the great shaman, [[Citlali]], right? I need her help with something!
:{{A|vo xtlllq003 2 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Uh... Yeah, but the chances of her helping a random stranger just because we asked...
:{{DIcon}} With her personality? Pretty slim...
:{{A|vo xtlllq003 2 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yeah, Citlali really doesn't like dealing with strangers...
:{{A|vo xtlllq003 2 montluson 10.ogg}} '''Montluson:''' I heard about that from other members of her tribe. But, they told me if one person could convince her, it would be the golden-haired Traveler.
:{{A|vo xtlllq003 2 montluson 11.ogg}} '''Montluson:''' If you manage it, I'll even double your pay!
:{{A|vo xtlllq003 2 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' ...
:{{DIcon}} Why do you need her help?
:{{A|vo xtlllq003 2 paimon 12.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, yeah... We should definitely get to the bottom of that first.
:{{A|vo xtlllq003 2 montluson 12.ogg}} '''Montluson:''' It's kind of a long story, and there's tribal history involved, so you should hear it from an expert. [[Allier]], if you could...
:{{A|vo xtlllq003 2 allier 01.ogg}} '''Allier:''' Of course! I don't often have an eager audience for this kind of thing... Nice to meet you. The name's Allier — I'm a Researcher from the [[Fontaine Research Institute]].
:{{A|vo xtlllq003 2 allier 02.ogg}} '''Allier:''' Unlike most researchers, I have a keen interest in ancient ruins. That's why I was invited to join Monsieur Montluson's team.
:{{A|vo xtlllq003 2 allier 03.ogg}} '''Allier:''' Have you heard the legend of the great shaman, [[Huitzilin]]?
:{{DIcon}} It sounds familiar...
:{{DIcon}} She's the one that worked with colors, right?
:{{A|vo xtlllq003 2 allier 04.ogg}} '''Allier:''' Yes. According to local records, she was a color mystic who lived over two hundred years ago, the most adept in her tribe at using that particular technique.
:{{A|vo xtlllq003 2 allier 05.ogg}} '''Allier:''' Out of all her exploits, her most celebrated is "the Battle of Seven Colors."
:{{A|vo xtlllq003 2 allier 06.ogg}} '''Allier:''' According to legend, the battle was triggered by an [[Abyss]] invasion, one of the most brutal in Natlan's history, even from a greater historical perspective.
:{{A|vo xtlllq003 2 allier 07.ogg}} '''Allier:''' Amazingly, Natlan was able to turn the tide despite being at an extreme disadvantage. The key to victory was none other than a "color" Huitzilin created on the battlefield.
:{{A|vo xtlllq003 2 allier 08.ogg}} '''Allier:''' The "color" was extraordinary — illusory in appearance while also seeming to possess physical form. Legend has it that Huitzilin used the "color" to construct a magnificent maze on the battlefield...
:{{A|vo xtlllq003 2 allier 09.ogg}} '''Allier:''' ...And trap all the enemies inside. This allowed her allies to launch a counterattack and, ultimately, secure victory.
:{{A|vo xtlllq003 2 montluson 13.ogg}} '''Montluson:''' *ahem*... Anyway, that's the gist of it. We don't want to take up too much of your time.
:{{A|vo xtlllq003 2 montluson 14.ogg}} '''Montluson:''' That story is the reason I came to Natlan. I often publish books about the history of other nations. They always end up faring well on the market.
:{{A|vo xtlllq003 2 montluson 15.ogg}} '''Montluson:''' When I heard this story for the first time, I wanted to include it in my next collection, but...
:{{A|vo xtlllq003 2 montluson 16.ogg}} '''Montluson:''' Historical records about Natlan aren't very detailed. We haven't been able to determine where the battle took place, or find any definitive evidence that it occurred at all.
:{{A|vo xtlllq003 2 montluson 17.ogg}} '''Montluson:''' Even within the [[Masters of the Night-Wind]], people dispute the legitimacy of the story. Some believe it to be a myth.
:{{A|vo xtlllq003 2 montluson 18.ogg}} '''Montluson:''' If that were the case, the story would not be fit for publication...
:{{A|vo xtlllq003 2 paimon 13.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Uh, but, if you're just including it in a story collection, why does it matter if it never happened?
:{{A|vo xtlllq003 2 montluson 19.ogg}} '''Montluson:''' Well, you see, the slogan for the collection is "restoring the truth of history." Naturally, I need it to be factual.
:{{A|vo xtlllq003 2 montluson 20.ogg}} '''Montluson:''' That's why I'm here. The Masters of the Night-Wind are said to have a tradition of recording past events, so I wanted to consult their records.
:{{A|vo xtlllq003 2 montluson 21.ogg}} '''Montluson:''' But, I was refused access to the [[Obsidian Altar]]. Application after application, and all I received were a few ordinary woven scrolls with nothing to offer. Honestly, I'm just trying to promote their history, and they make such a fuss...
:{{A|vo xtlllq003 2 allier 10.ogg}} '''Allier:''' According to my research, their scrolls are considered sacred relics in addition to historical records. Naturally, outsiders are rarely granted access.
:{{A|vo xtlllq003 2 allier 11.ogg}} '''Allier:''' Not to mention, the scrolls we did get to review actually contain a huge amount of information. I just need more time, and I could—
:{{A|vo xtlllq003 2 montluson 22.ogg}} '''Montluson:''' We've been over this, Allier. There's no need to waste time on those scrolls when we have a better way.
:{{A|vo xtlllq003 2 paimon 14.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Citlali, you mean?
:{{A|vo xtlllq003 2 montluson 23.ogg}} '''Montluson:''' Exactly. You're well aware, I'm sure, that Citlali has been alive for more than two hundred years. That means she lived during the era of the Battle of Seven Colors!
:{{A|vo xtlllq003 2 montluson 24.ogg}} '''Montluson:''' If she agrees to be my consultant, then no other historical records are necessary.
:{{A|vo xtlllq003 2 paimon 15.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, that's what you want...
:{{A|vo xtlllq003 2 montluson 25.ogg}} '''Montluson:''' So, what do you say? I'll quadruple the pay if it helps sweeten the deal!
:{{A|vo xtlllq003 2 paimon 16.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Well, it's not that we don't want to help you...
:{{DIcon}} We actually should go ask her, Paimon.
:{{DIcon}} We still have a duty to fulfill, after all.
:{{A|vo xtlllq003 2 paimon 17.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, right! The duty the chief gave us has a lot to do with Huitzilin...
:{{A|vo xtlllq003 2 paimon 18.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Who knows? The "Battle of Seven Colors" might lead us in the right direction!
:{{A|vo xtlllq003 2 paimon 19.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Alright, we'll help you convince Citlali. Just let us do the talking, okay?
:{{A|vo xtlllq003 2 montluson 26.ogg}} '''Montluson:''' Of course!

:{{DIcon}} Sounds good.

:{{A|vo yqeq409 2 mualani 04.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' When it comes to helping people, a good guide always thinks one step ahead, right?
:{{A|vo yqeq409 2 mualani 05.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' Oh, and speaking of work, I guess our vacation's almost over, huh... Probably for the best. If I don't head back soon, I'm worried my little doggie won't even remember me.
:{{A|vo yqeq409 2 mualani 06.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' And after talking to the others, it seems like everyone is just about ready to get back.
:{{A|vo yqeq409 2 mualani 07.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' Some are missing their families, others are going through [[Dandelion Wine]] withdrawal, I guess...
:{{A|vo yqeq409 2 mualani 08.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' Even [[Chasca]] seems to be feeling it. Not that she'd ever admit it, but I have noticed her gazing back towards the [[Flower-Feather Clan]] at night.
:{{DIcon}} I completely understand...
:{{A|vo yqeq409 2 mualani 09.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' But summer's not over yet! So I say... we squeeze a few more unforgettable moments into the time we've got left!
:{{A|vo yqeq409 2 mualani 10.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' Like another group photo!
:{{A|vo yqeq409 2 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hey, how about taking one right here? After all this time, Paimon's grown kind of attached to this place.
:{{A|vo yqeq409 2 mualani 11.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' Great idea! Why don't you spruce up this wall, and I'll go gather the others. See you over at the plaza!

:{{A|vo yqeq409 5 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Whoa, you even look out for stuff like that?
:{{A|vo yqeq409 5 mualani 03.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' Well, what kind of guide would I be if I didn't pay attention to the details?
:{{A|vo yqeq409 5 venti 01.ogg}} '''Venti:''' Yeah, and what kind of bard would I be if I didn't appreciate a good drink?

:{{A|vo yqeq409 5 chasca 02.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' Don't want it all to end, huh?
:{{A|vo yqeq409 5 chasca 03.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' Are you worried, once you say those words, the vacation will officially be over?
:{{A|vo yqeq409 5 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' How the... Paimon thought Peacemakers couldn't read people's minds!

:{{A|vo yqeq409 5 bennett 07.ogg}} '''Bennett:''' Even though we'll all be going our separate ways, as long as we cherish each other's friendship, I just know that our paths will cross again.
:{{A|vo yqeq409 5 mualani 08.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' Bennett's becoming quite the talker, huh, Professor Venti?
:{{A|vo yqeq409 5 venti 02.ogg}} '''Venti:''' Ah, well, I wouldn't dare take credit for something like that...
:{{A|vo yqeq409 5 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Your tone would suggest otherwise... C'mon, Paimon was just starting to feel inspired...
:{{A|vo yqeq409 5 mualani 09.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' Why don't we just give it another try?
:{{A|vo yqeq409 5 bennett 08.ogg}} '''Bennett:''' Yeah, let's do it all together this time!
:{{A|vo yqeq409 5 chasca 04.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' Huh. What should we shout?
:{{DIcon}} Lucky star?
:{{A|vo yqeq409 5 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Sounds good!

:{{A|vo yqeq409 5 together 01.ogg}} '''Everyone:''' Lucky star!

:;(After a day of activities, the group returns to sit around one of the round tables at the plaza for food and drinks after sunset)
:{{A|vo yqeq409 5 chasca 05.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' ...So, what are your plans for the future, Bennett?
:{{A|vo yqeq409 5 mualani 11.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' If you're having trouble deciding, you can always park it in the [[People of the Springs]] for a bit, or however long you want, really.
:{{A|vo yqeq409 5 bennett 09.ogg}} '''Bennett:''' Thanks for the kind offer, Mualani.
:{{A|vo yqeq409 5 bennett 10.ogg}} '''Bennett:''' I actually went to see the Pyro Archon to tell her how grateful I am for everything she's done for me.
:{{A|vo yqeq409 5 bennett 11.ogg}} '''Bennett:''' She told me that the Domain we entered was an [[Abyss]]al simulation of the [[Mare Jivari]]. It was extremely unstable, and now it's completely gone.
:{{A|vo yqeq409 5 bennett 12.ogg}} '''Bennett:''' Later, when we got onto talking about my future, she said I was more than welcome to stay here in Natlan... but also that she would respect my decision, whatever it turned out to be.
:{{A|vo yqeq409 5 bennett 13.ogg}} '''Bennett:''' And after thinking it over, long and hard... I've decided to return to [[Mondstadt]].
:{{A|vo yqeq409 5 chasca 06.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' You miss your dads, don't you?
:{{A|vo yqeq409 5 bennett 14.ogg}} '''Bennett:''' That's definitely part of it. I promised to tell them everything that happened on this adventure, and I can't go back on my word.
:{{A|vo yqeq409 5 bennett 15.ogg}} '''Bennett:''' But also...
:{{A|vo yqeq409 5 bennett 16.ogg}} '''Bennett:''' When I said goodbye to my [[Aroni|mom]] and [[Macani|dad]], I promised them I'd become the most legendary adventurer in all of [[Teyvat]] someday.
:{{A|vo yqeq409 5 bennett 17.ogg}} '''Bennett:''' And no adventurer should stay in one place for too long.
:{{A|vo yqeq409 5 mualani 12.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' Bennett...
:{{A|vo yqeq409 5 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What if your luck starts going downhill again the moment you leave Natlan?
:{{A|vo yqeq409 5 bennett 18.ogg}} '''Bennett:''' Haha, it's fine.
:{{A|vo yqeq409 5 bennett 19.ogg}} '''Bennett:''' The warmth and kindness I've experienced on this adventure is enough to get me through all the challenges that lie ahead.
:{{A|vo yqeq409 5 bennett 20.ogg}} '''Bennett:''' As I attempt to shape my own fate, I want to take that same kindness and pass it forward. That's something I've always believed in.
:{{A|vo yqeq409 5 chasca 07.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' Hear, hear! To our leader!
:{{A|vo yqeq409 5 venti 03.ogg}} '''Venti:''' To our leader, Bennett!
:{{A|vo yqeq409 5 mualani 13.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' Cheers!
:;(After partying for some time, Paimon looks toward the night sky)
:{{A|vo yqeq409 5 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Uhh... This is gonna be another all-nighter, isn't it...
:{{A|vo yqeq409 5 mualani 14.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' Hehe, the fun never stops! Who's up to perform next?
:{{A|vo yqeq409 5 chasca 08.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' Bennett's almost fallen asleep several times now...
:{{A|vo yqeq409 5 bennett 21.ogg}} '''Bennett:''' No, no... I can still... keep going...
:{{A|vo yqeq409 5 chasca 09.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' Go get some rest now, guys. And seeing as you've still got the energy, I'll leave the clean-up to you, Mualani...
:{{A|vo yqeq409 5 mualani 15.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' Huh? Why me...?
:{{A|vo yqeq409 5 venti 04.ogg}} '''Venti:''' {{Traveler}}, perhaps you could join me for a walk?
:{{A|vo yqeq409 5 venti 05.ogg}} '''Venti:''' I know a great spot.
----
;(Approach the marked location)
:{{A|vo yqeq409 6 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You might be tone-deaf, but you sure know how to sniff out a good view...
:{{A|vo yqeq409 6 venti 01.ogg}} '''Venti:''' Haha, glad you like it. Some stories aren't meant for the birds — only for the stars high in the sky.
:{{DIcon}} Time for a bedtime story?
:{{A|vo yqeq409 6 venti 02.ogg}} '''Venti:''' Haha... More like a story that begins with "Time" itself.
:;(Venti turns back to look out over [[Wavey Bay]])
:{{A|vo yqeq409 6 venti 03.ogg}} '''Venti:''' Long, long ago, "{{Rubi|Time|[[Istaroth]]}}" began to write the story of this world.
:{{A|vo yqeq409 6 venti 04.ogg}} '''Venti:''' To her, all living beings were equal, both in their value and insignificance.
:;(The stars fade in the morning light as dawn begins to break)
:{{A|vo yqeq409 6 venti 05.ogg}} '''Venti:''' Like an ancient scroll, she engraved upon her memory all people, all events, all encounters, and all farewells.
:{{A|vo yqeq409 6 venti 06.ogg}} '''Venti:''' Back then, as an [[Anemo]] spirit, I had a chance encounter with "Time" at the [[Thousand Winds Temple]].
:{{A|vo yqeq409 6 venti 07.ogg}} '''Venti:''' Hearing my wishes, she entrusted me with fragments of her power and authority...
:{{DIcon}} Seeds, brought by the wind...
:{{DIcon}} ...and cultivated by time.
:{{A|vo yqeq409 6 venti 08.ogg}} '''Venti:''' Sounds like you've heard the story of "Time and the Wind" before.
:{{A|vo yqeq409 6 venti 09.ogg}} '''Venti:''' Charming, isn't it?
:{{A|vo yqeq409 6 venti 10.ogg}} '''Venti:''' Through the memories engraved in rituals, poems, ruins, and ancient texts, the same beings she considered so insignificant have met her... time and time again.
:{{A|vo yqeq409 6 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So this is the story you wanted to share?
:{{A|vo yqeq409 6 venti 11.ogg}} '''Venti:''' Mmm... More like the prologue.
:;(The Anemo Archon's expression becomes serious)
:{{A|vo yqeq409 6 venti 12.ogg}} '''Venti:''' The corruption of the Mare Jivari is tied to time itself. To put it another way, it is a calamity present in every moment that will ever be.
:{{A|vo yqeq409 6 venti 13.ogg}} '''Venti:''' Unlike "Time" herself, I have always cherished many wishes in my heart.
:{{A|vo yqeq409 6 venti 14.ogg}} '''Venti:''' Five hundred years ago, to prevent the corruption of the Mare Jivari from spreading beyond [[Tenochtzitoc]]...
:{{A|vo yqeq409 6 venti 15.ogg}} '''Venti:''' ...I blew it off the timeline, turning it into the "Windless Land."
:{{DIcon}} So that's the truth behind the Mare Jivari's disappearance?
:{{A|vo yqeq409 6 venti 16.ogg}} '''Venti:''' Oops, seems like I may have confused you...
:{{A|vo yqeq409 6 venti 17.ogg}} '''Venti:''' If you're asking about how the Mare Jivari disappeared from Tenochtzitoc two or three decades ago, there may be someone else better suited to tell that story.
:{{A|vo yqeq409 6 venti 18.ogg}} '''Venti:''' The Mare Jivari has been the bearer of too many stories that weren't meant to be its own... I merely played a part in one of its chapters.
:{{A|vo yqeq409 6 venti 19.ogg}} '''Venti:''' And the choice I made five hundred years ago came with a price.
:{{A|vo yqeq409 6 venti 20.ogg}} '''Venti:''' Some souls were unable to return to Mondstadt as a result... while others stayed to settle in this land, merging with the [[Monetoo]] to become the Asha we see today.
:{{A|vo yqeq409 6 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So the reason you're here in Tenochtzitoc is because...
:{{A|vo yqeq409 6 venti 21.ogg}} '''Venti:''' Correct. I'm here to collaborate with the current Pyro Archon, Mavuika.
:{{DIcon}} You mean when we lit up [[Miniature "Sun"|that candle]]...?
:{{A|vo yqeq409 6 venti 22.ogg}} '''Venti:''' Correct again. The flame was our signal.
:{{A|vo yqeq409 6 venti 23.ogg}} '''Venti:''' Only by having Mavuika open a rift between that space and the true Mare Jivari could I sneak in and bring back all the souls who wished to return.
:{{A|vo yqeq409 6 venti 24.ogg}} '''Venti:''' As for my little trick of bringing back memories as well... Heh, it's not the first time I've pulled that off.
:{{A|vo yqeq409 6 venti 25.ogg}} '''Venti:''' Mavuika also mentioned that you were planning to introduce us... Looks like I beat you to it, huh?
:{{A|vo yqeq409 6 venti 26.ogg}} '''Venti:''' I was glad to discover that she shares my love for fine wine and freedom. We got along great.
:{{DIcon}} Really outdid yourself this time...
:{{DIcon}} Pulling off something that big...
:{{A|vo yqeq409 6 venti 27.ogg}} '''Venti:''' Well, it really took it out of me for a few days... In fact, I still feel pretty dead on my feet even now.
:{{A|vo yqeq409 6 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, really?
:{{A|vo yqeq409 6 venti 28.ogg}} '''Venti:''' But, thinking of all the Aphimead and Dandelion Wine still left to drink... I suppose I can hang in there a little longer.
:{{A|vo yqeq409 6 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You don't look that tired to Paimon, so don't think you can just pull out that little excuse and we'll suddenly foot all your bills!
:{{A|vo yqeq409 6 venti 29.ogg}} '''Venti:''' Oh how you wound me, Paimon.
:{{DIcon}} Venti...
:{{A|vo yqeq409 6 venti 30.ogg}} '''Venti:''' You'll hook me up with some good liquor, won't you, {{Traveler}}?
:{{DIcon}} I'm curious...
:{{DIcon}} ...What do you wish for now?
:{{A|vo yqeq409 6 venti 31.ogg}} '''Venti:''' ...
:;(Venti looks back over the bay)
:{{A|vo yqeq409 6 venti 32.ogg}} '''Venti:''' I suppose... to protect Mondstadt, and that everyone who wishes to stay there has the freedom to choose their own path.
{{Dialogue End}}

===Bennett===
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Talk to Bennett at [[Huha Hill]])
:{{A|vo dialog yqeq409 bennett 04.ogg}} '''Bennett:''' Thanks for coming on this adventure with me, {{Traveler}}.
:{{DIcon}} About the Easybreeze Holiday Resort...
::{{A|vo dialog yqeq409 bennett 05a 1.ogg}} '''Bennett:''' Sunny islands, crackling bonfires, exciting attractions, carefree parties...
::{{A|vo dialog yqeq409 bennett 05a 2.ogg}} '''Bennett:''' If I didn't know better, I'd say it was all a dream.
::{{A|vo dialog yqeq409 bennett 05a 3.ogg}} '''Bennett:''' But knowing it was all real, I'm starting to feel emotional again.. Haha, this must be true happiness, huh?
::{{A|vo dialog yqeq409 bennett 05a 4.ogg}} '''Bennett:''' Not only did I finally meet the people dearest to me, but together with my closest friends, I spent a summer I wish could have lasted forever...
::{{A|vo dialog yqeq409 bennett 05a 5.ogg}} '''Bennett:''' I really am the luckiest person in the world.
:{{DIcon}} About your journey back...
::{{A|vo dialog yqeq409 bennett 05b 1.ogg}} '''Bennett:''' I picked out gifts for my dads and everyone back in Mondstadt. I was convinced my bag would be big enough, but I ended up having to buy another one just to squeeze everything in...
::{{A|vo dialog yqeq409 bennett 05b 2.ogg}} '''Bennett:''' I also picked up a bottle of concentrated honeydew. When I get back, I'm planning to ask [[Diona]] to create a Dandelion-flavored drink for Professor Venti with it.
::{{A|vo dialog yqeq409 bennett 05b 3.ogg}} '''Bennett:''' Wait a sec... Diona? Oh no, but what about [[Draff]]! How could I have forgotten Draff? Guess I'll be making another trip to the market, then...
:{{DIcon}} About [[Ororon]] and [[Ifa]]... <small>''(Only available after completing ''[[All Good Reunions Follow a Search]]'')''</small>
::{{A|vo dialog yqeq409 bennett 05c 1.ogg}} '''Bennett:''' Oh, those guys! To tell you the truth, I was really worried when Mr. Ifa first asked for my help. As I told him, I could never hope to pull off [[Mona]]'s whole hydromancy thing, and I'd no doubt cause trouble if I even tried...
::{{A|vo dialog yqeq409 bennett 05c 2.ogg}} '''Bennett:''' But then he said, "as long as you can wave a stick around, we're good, bro," and told me he'd handle the rest.
::{{A|vo dialog yqeq409 bennett 05c 3.ogg}} '''Bennett:''' I heard things got really lively afterwards. I'm happy for them, and for [[Cacucu]] too!
:{{DIcon}} Best of luck.
::{{A|vo dialog yqeq409 bennett 05d 1.ogg}} '''Bennett:''' Safe travels to you too! I'll be looking forward to the day we bump into each other again on another adventure.
{{Dialogue End}}

===Mavuika and Venti===
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Talk to Mavuika or Venti at [[Me & Dew]] on [[Tete Isle]])
:{{A|vo dialog yqeq409 mavuika 03.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' So, how about it? Now that you're all done, we can finally have a proper drink together, huh?
:{{A|vo dialog yqeq409 venti 04.ogg}} '''Venti:''' Haha, you make it sound like I was holding out on you...
:{{A|vo dialog yqeq409 venti 05.ogg}} '''Venti:''' But if you and I had a real drinking bout, I don't think these poor little aphids could handle it. They'd have to flit to and fro making mead till their wings gave way!
:{{A|vo dialog yqeq409 mavuika 04.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' Haha, spoken like a true bard! That impromptu toast you gave just now was spot on too.
:{{A|vo dialog yqeq409 mavuika 05.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' "For happiness and freedom"... Couldn't have said it better myself. That's exactly what we all need right now.
:{{A|vo dialog yqeq409 mavuika 06.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' You must have been to your fair share of banquets in Mondstadt, huh?
:{{A|vo dialog yqeq409 venti 06.ogg}} '''Venti:''' Of course — they don't call it "The City of Wine and Song" for nothing! Besides, without being able to come up with a decent toast, how else might a humble bard earn themselves a regular supply of free Dandelion Wine?
:{{A|vo dialog yqeq409 mavuika 07.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' Haha... Well, when you're free, you're always welcome at our tribal banquets. They'll be fighting over who gets to host you, I guarantee it!
:{{A|vo dialog yqeq409 mavuika 08.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' Just so you know, they can get pretty rowdy. Banging, stomping, belting out off-key drinking songs... stuff like that. You wouldn't mind, would you?
:{{A|vo dialog yqeq409 venti 07.ogg}} '''Venti:''' Of course not, that sounds like great fun! Ah, if only our two nations could throw a joint banquet someday...
:{{A|vo dialog yqeq409 mavuika 09.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' Great idea! I'll make sure to load up a few extra barrels of Aphimead for the occasion.
:{{A|vo dialog yqeq409 mavuika 10.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' As it happens, the [[Collective of Plenty]] recently launched a new drink called a "Quenepacano"... I'll make sure to bring some for you and your friends to try out too.
{{Dialogue End}}
