==Dialogue==
{{Quest Description|Paimon is curious about Neuvillette. Go talk to him.}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Upon receiving the quest)
:{{A|vo sllq001 1 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' It's been a while since we last saw Neuvillette. Paimon wonders what he's been up to.
:{{A|vo sllq001 1 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Paimon has so many questions about his true identity... Let's go talk to him and find out!
----
;(Approach Neuvillette and Sedene in his office)
:{{A|vo sllq001 2 sedna 01.ogg}} '''Sedene:''' Wait, did I hear that right? Monsieur Neuvillette, are you sure you'd like to take over the case yourself?
:{{A|vo sllq001 2 neuvillette 01.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' That's right.
:{{A|vo sllq001 2 sedna 02.ogg}} '''Sedene:''' But why? Technically speaking, cases like this are better left to the [[Garde]]s...
:{{A|vo sllq001 2 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Neuvillette, Sedene, hey there! What are you two talking about?
:{{A|vo sllq001 2 sedna 03.ogg}} '''Sedene:''' {{Traveler}} and Paimon, please help me talk our Chief Justice out of this. He wants to investigate a case on his own!
:{{A|vo sllq001 2 sedna 04.ogg}} '''Sedene:''' This is completely unprecedented. How can we have the Iudex acting like a private detective?
:{{DIcon}} Starting a new job?
::{{A|vo sllq001 2 neuvillette 02a 1.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' Thank you for your concern, but I currently have no such plans.
::{{A|vo sllq001 2 neuvillette 02a 2.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' Oh... apologies. I took your question in earnest, but it now occurs to me that it was mostly likely in jest.
:{{DIcon}} I can introduce you to some amazing detectives.
::{{A|vo sllq001 2 neuvillette 02b 1.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' I trust that you'd be able to work that out with how well-connected you are, but I must apologize. I do not plan on relying on anyone else's help for this matter.
:{{A|vo sllq001 2 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So what is it exactly? It sure sounds serious if it's something you've got to investigate personally!
:{{A|vo sllq001 2 neuvillette 03.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' A Melusine named Kiara received a threat letter.
:{{A|vo sllq001 2 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' And then...?
:{{A|vo sllq001 2 neuvillette 04.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' That is all the information I have acquired at this stage.
:{{A|vo sllq001 2 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh?
:{{A|vo sllq001 2 sedna 05.ogg}} '''Sedene:''' *sigh* I have no idea why you're so hung up over this.
:{{A|vo sllq001 2 sedna 06.ogg}} '''Sedene:''' I've checked the schedule in advance, and it seems like there aren't any trials today. So if you insist... I have no objections.
;(If the player has not completed [[The Opera of Noirceur and Blancheur]])
::{{A|vo sllq001 2 neuvillette 05.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' Thank you for understanding. I will leave a note explaining my absence on my desk — I would appreciate it if you could take it to Lady Furina.
::{{A|vo sllq001 2 neuvillette 06.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' She may have no interest in official affairs, but standard procedure dictates that I'm still responsible for reporting to her.
::{{A|vo sllq001 2 sedna 07.ogg}} '''Sedene:''' Yes yes! Understood. I'll come back later and deliver the note to her.
;(If the player has completed ''The Opera of Noirceur and Blancheur'')
::{{A|vo sllq001 3 neuvillette 05.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' Thank you for understanding.
::{{A|vo sllq001 3 sedna 07.ogg}} '''Sedene:''' Then I shall return to my post for now. Should anyone visit while you are away, I will be sure to make a record of it. I sincerely hope that you will return soon.
:{{A|vo sllq001 2 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Judging from Sedene's reaction, it must be pretty rare for you to investigate stuff personally. What's so special about this case?
:{{A|vo sllq001 2 neuvillette 07.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' I cannot tell you just yet, but it reminded me of certain past events.
:{{A|vo sllq001 2 neuvillette 08.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' There could be complicated conflicts of interest behind all this, so I must eliminate all risks in advance.
:{{DIcon}} Conflicts of interest?
:{{DIcon}} Care to explain in detail?
:{{A|vo sllq001 2 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' C'mon, stop being so secretive! We still have no idea what's going on!
:{{A|vo sllq001 2 neuvillette 09.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' It is not my intention to keep you in the dark, but I need some time to revisit those memories and collect my thoughts.
:{{A|vo sllq001 2 neuvillette 10.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' Long story short... A little more than four hundred years ago, I became the Iudex of Fontaine and initiated a series of institutional reforms.
:{{A|vo sllq001 2 neuvillette 11.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' There were few people I could trust, but I had two subordinates who were exceptionally trustworthy and capable: [[Carole]], a Melusine, and [[Vautrin]], leader of the Special Security and Surveillance Patrol.
:{{A|vo sllq001 2 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' They must've been amazing people to receive such high praise from you!
:{{A|vo sllq001 2 neuvillette 12.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' Indeed. Unfortunately, I wasn't able to protect them.
:{{A|vo sllq001 2 neuvillette 13.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' The reforms damaged the interests of some, and the more conservative faction took advantage of Carole's identity to instigate political unrest. Ultimately, they wanted me to yield more of my power.
:{{A|vo sllq001 2 neuvillette 14.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' The incident resulted in Carole taking her own life and Vautrin being exiled. From then on, I've been especially careful when dealing with cases related to Melusines.
:{{DIcon}} You're concerned that you're the perpetrator's real target?
:{{DIcon}} Seems like they're using Melusines against you...
:{{A|vo sllq001 2 neuvillette 15.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' All Melusines used to live a secluded life away from human society.
:{{A|vo sllq001 2 neuvillette 16.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' I granted their wishes when some of them, including Carole, asked me to bring them to the Court of Fontaine.
:{{A|vo sllq001 2 neuvillette 17.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' Many common folk believe that I share a special bond with the Melusines, and whatever they do can be traced back to me.
:{{A|vo sllq001 2 neuvillette 18.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' Some of them — especially those who hold a grudge against me — exploit that belief and stir up conflict over Melusines in an attempt to lay the blame on me.
:{{A|vo sllq001 2 neuvillette 19.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' I have nothing against the opinions of others, but the moment a whirlpool of conspiracy forms, it inevitably affects the innocent.
:{{A|vo sllq001 2 neuvillette 20.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' And it's already happened once, and I want to make sure it does not happen again.
:{{A|vo sllq001 2 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Um, even so, why do you have to be the one investigating?
:{{A|vo sllq001 2 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' There's the Gardes, the [[Marechaussee Phantom]], and the Special Security and Surveillance Patrol! Aren't they more than enough to figure out what's going on?
:{{A|vo sllq001 2 neuvillette 21.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' Based on prior experience, there's a high chance that those who hold hostility towards me do not belong to the same department.
:{{A|vo sllq001 2 neuvillette 22.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' The political system of Fontaine is relatively complex and involves the interests of multiple different factions.
:{{A|vo sllq001 2 neuvillette 23.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' However, since I am technically an outsider in Fontaine, a lot of trouble could be avoided if I personally took on the case.
:{{A|vo sllq001 2 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Outsider?
:{{A|vo sllq001 2 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' But aren't you the Chief Justice of Fontaine? Why would you be an outsider?
:{{A|vo sllq001 2 neuvillette 24.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' I understand where you're coming from, but there is not necessarily a connection between my responsibilities and how I perceive myself.
:{{A|vo sllq001 2 neuvillette 25.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' You know very well about my true identity and have even met others of my kind in other nations...
:{{DIcon}} The Hydro Dragon Sovereign...
:{{A|vo sllq001 2 neuvillette 26.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' Even though I was born with a human form, there's a fundamental difference between dragons and humans.
:{{A|vo sllq001 2 neuvillette 27.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' Taking on the role of Chief Justice does not make me a part of this community. In fact, the status I was granted has prevented me from forming deeper bonds with others.
:{{A|vo sllq001 2 neuvillette 28.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' I have lived in Fontaine for a long time, but I do not belong here. That is why I call myself an outsider — a fish out of water.
:{{DIcon}} If you put it that way...
:{{DIcon}} We're also outsiders to Fontaine.
:{{A|vo sllq001 2 paimon 12.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yeah! We have nothing to do with all those organizations anyway, so how about we come with you on your investigation?
:{{A|vo sllq001 2 paimon 13.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Let's team up and round up all the bad guys lurking in the dark!
:{{A|vo sllq001 2 neuvillette 29.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' ...That does not sound like a bad idea. I rarely investigate cases on my own, but with professionals like you around, I'm sure it'll go a lot smoother.
:{{A|vo sllq001 2 paimon 14.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hehe, Paimon's starting to get a little embarrassed. Just leave it to us!
;(If the player has not completed ''The Opera of Noirceur and Blancheur'')
::{{A|vo sllq001 2 neuvillette 30.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' I'll write my note of absence right away. Let us depart together once I am done.
::{{Black Screen|Neuvillette writes a note to Furina and sets it on the desk.}}
:{{A|vo sllq001 2 neuvillette 31.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' Let us go. We should visit Kiara first and try to gain a better understanding of the situation.
:;(Neuvillette leaves his office)
:{{A|vo sllq001 2 paimon 15.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Um, so Neuvillette feels like he doesn't truly belong here in Fontaine, but is that really true?
:{{A|vo sllq001 2 paimon 16.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Paimon feels like he has a kinda... skewed perspective on a lot of things. Anyway, let's catch up with him first!

;(After the cutscene)
:{{A|vo sllq001 6 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Paimon's been thinking... You called yourself a "fish out of water," right?
:{{A|vo sllq001 6 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' But since you're the Hydro Dragon, wouldn't "dragon out of water" suit you better?

:{{A|vo sllq001 6 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Pfft! That sounds kinda weird! Let's stick with the previous version instead.

:{{A|vo sllq001 9 ciara 08.ogg}} '''Kiara:''' Suspicious-looking people? What counts as suspicious?
:{{DIcon}} Someone who follows you from behind?
:{{DIcon}} Someone who always strikes up a conversation with you?
:{{A|vo sllq001 9 ciara 09.ogg}} '''Kiara:''' Ah!
:{{A|vo sllq001 9 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Did you think of something?
:{{A|vo sllq001 9 ciara 10.ogg}} '''Kiara:''' Nope! I don't remember meeting anyone like that!
:{{A|vo sllq001 9 neuvillette 04.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' Do you still have the letter with you? I want you to show me what it says.

:{{Color|menu|Kiara takes out a letter...}}
:[[File:A Familiar Threat Letter.png|200px]]
:{{A|vo sllq001 9 neuvillette 05.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' Now then... "Get lost! If you don't leave the Marechaussee Phantom, I will come and catch you in person. Don't say I didn't warn you!"
:;(Someone photographs the group from a distance)

:{{DIcon}} Are they concealing their identity on purpose?

:{{A|vo sllq001 9 neuvillette 08.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' Since you can't think of anyone suspicious, I'll be heading back to the Palais Mermonia to review some official documents.
:{{A|vo sllq001 9 neuvillette 09.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' Kiara, you should come with us. It's safer if you stay close by.
:{{A|vo sllq001 9 ciara 12.ogg}} '''Kiara:''' Sure!
:{{A|vo sllq001 9 ciara 13.ogg}} '''Kiara:''' Wait, no, no, no, I still have a case to work on! I promised [[Eloffe]] that I'd check on her place later.
:{{A|vo sllq001 9 neuvillette 10.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' But you're being watched right now. Going off on your own could be dangerous...
:{{A|vo sllq001 9 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' And that's where we come in to help! We'll stay with Kiara and make sure she's safe.
:{{A|vo sllq001 9 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' With us around, anyone scheming to hurt Kiara can forget about it!
:{{A|vo sllq001 9 ciara 14a.ogg}}<!--{{A|vo sllq001 9 ciara 14b.ogg}}--> '''Kiara:''' Thank you, {{Traveler}}, Big Sis Paimon!
:{{DIcon}} Big Sis Paimon...
:{{A|vo sllq001 9 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Uh... Ahem! Don't worry, your Big Sis Paimon is super strong!
:{{A|vo sllq001 9 neuvillette 11.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' Alright, let us go our separate ways for now. Please take care of Kiara.
:{{A|vo sllq001 9 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' We'll take her to Eloffe's place right away. See you around!

:{{Black Screen|You tell Charlotte about the letter Kiara received...}}
:{{A|vo sllq001 13 charlotte 11.ogg}} '''Charlotte:''' WHAT!? Someone's targeting a cute little Melusine?
:{{A|vo sllq001 13 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Shh, not so loud!
:{{A|vo sllq001 13 charlotte 12.ogg}} '''Charlotte:''' It just so happens that I did an interview with Kiara — last month, in fact. It was well-received by our readers, so I was planning to continue the series... and now someone's coming after her?
:{{A|vo sllq001 13 charlotte 13.ogg}} '''Charlotte:''' I'll ask my colleagues about it. Who knows? We might find something. And don't worry, I know what I'm doing! This secret's safe with me.
:{{A|vo sllq001 13 charlotte 14.ogg}} '''Charlotte:''' But I gotta warn you, even if I keep my lips sealed, others will know eventually.
:{{A|vo sllq001 13 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Why?

:{{A|vo sllq001 23 neuvillette 08.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' Please pardon my lack of consideration. People rarely come to the Palais Mermonia for matters outside of work. To be quite honest, I'm not sure what we should do.

:{{A|vo sllq001 23 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ooh, drinks! Thank you!
:{{Color|menu|After Neuvillette leaves, Paimon discusses with you quietly.}}
:{{A|vo sllq001 23 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Paimon wonders what Neuvillette likes to drink... Oh! Maybe he's a fan of really fancy wines!
:{{A|vo sllq001 23 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' He seems like the type of person who'd own an entire winery... Y'know, like Diluc!
:{{Black Screen|Neuvillette momentarily leaves and brings back several exquisite wine glasses...}}
:{{A|vo sllq001 23 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Uh... What's inside these glasses? It looks just like water...
:{{A|vo sllq001 23 neuvillette 10.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' An astute observation. It is indeed water.
:;(The Traveler and Paimon look at Neuvillette, and then each other)
:{{A|vo sllq001 23 paimon 12.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So it's just plain old water!?
:{{A|vo sllq001 23 neuvillette 11.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' What did you think it was?
:{{A|vo sllq001 23 paimon 13.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Um... Since you're the Chief Justice and all, Paimon thought you'd prefer something more sophisticated.
:{{A|vo sllq001 23 neuvillette 12.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' This water is indeed very special. It would not be an overstatement to call it "sophisticated."
:{{A|vo sllq001 23 paimon 14.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh?
:{{A|vo sllq001 23 neuvillette 13.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' I believe you've already tried Fonta. In fact, there are many other drink factories in Fontaine, including those that specialize in packaging pure drinking water.
:{{A|vo sllq001 23 neuvillette 14.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' Said water is sourced from all across Teyvat, including Mondstadt's Cider Lake, Liyue's Qingce Village, and Inazuma's Konda Village...
:{{A|vo sllq001 23 neuvillette 15.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' Here's one of their latest products: water from Sumeru's Apam Woods.
:{{DIcon}} Is there any difference?
:{{DIcon}} They're all just water, aren't they?
:{{A|vo sllq001 23 neuvillette 16.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' If I were to comment on their mouthfeel... The waters of Cider Lake warm the heart, the waters of Qingce Village have a poignant touch, while one might call the waters of Konda Village placid.
:{{A|vo sllq001 23 neuvillette 17.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' Distinct differences exist between the waters of each area. You'll appreciate their intricacies once you taste them carefully.
:{{A|vo sllq001 23 paimon 15.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Really? Let Paimon try...
:{{A|vo sllq001 23 neuvillette 18.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' What do you think?
:{{A|vo sllq001 23 paimon 16.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Nope, Paimon couldn't taste any difference at all! Isn't this just normal water?
:{{A|vo sllq001 23 neuvillette 19.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' How regrettable. It seems like you still have a long way to go in refining your tastes.
:{{A|vo sllq001 23 paimon 17.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hey, this doesn't have to do with refining our tastes! Paimon's pretty sure most ordinary people can't tell the difference... How'd you do it anyway?
:{{A|vo sllq001 23 paimon 18.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh! Could it be because you're the Hydro Dragon?
:{{DIcon}} That could be the case.
:{{A|vo sllq001 23 paimon 19.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Uh, we are allowed to bring that up, right? Since there's no one else around...
:{{A|vo sllq001 23 paimon 20.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, Paimon's been wanting to ask this for ages! If you're the Hydro Dragon, why would you become Chief Justice in human society?
:{{A|vo sllq001 23 neuvillette 20.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' ...
:{{A|vo sllq001 23 paimon 21.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Uh, sorry, Paimon was just curious. You don't have to answer!
:{{A|vo sllq001 23 neuvillette 21.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' There's nothing to hide. I was simply organizing my thoughts.
:{{A|vo sllq001 23 neuvillette 22.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' I accepted this position because I wanted to seek out answers to questions that have perplexed me.
:{{A|vo sllq001 23 paimon 22.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Questions? Are there really things you can't figure out?
:{{A|vo sllq001 23 neuvillette 23.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' Many, in fact. But the one question that puzzles me the most concerns my own existence.
:{{A|vo sllq001 23 neuvillette 24.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' In essence... I neither know why I was born in this form, nor do I understand where my long life should take me.
::;(Before completing [[Masquerade of the Guilty]])
::{{A|vo sllq001 23 neuvillette 25.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' I lost many memories from the moment I was born. The [[Primordial Sea]], for example. I can only vaguely recall its connection to me, but I am unaware of what that connection is exactly.
::;(After completing [[Masquerade of the Guilty]])
::{{A|vo sllq001 5 neuvillette 25.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' For a long time, my memory was rather incomplete. With regard to the Primordial Sea, for example. I used to only be able to vaguely recall its connection to me, but I was unaware of what that connection was exactly.
:{{DIcon}} Is there anyone who can answer those questions?
:{{A|vo sllq001 23 neuvillette 26.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' Perhaps the elemental dragons of other nations may have some form of an answer. However, they are scattered across all of Teyvat. Abruptly visiting could very well pose an unpredictable risk.
:{{A|vo sllq001 23 paimon 23.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' True... Some of them have very... unique personalities too.
:{{A|vo sllq001 23 neuvillette 27.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' I have been holding on to these unanswered questions for a long time...
:{{A|vo sllq001 23 neuvillette 28.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' But there's one thing I've discovered along the way: My emotions easily resonate with those of others... even I don't have the slightest idea what they mean.
:{{A|vo sllq001 23 neuvillette 29.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' My guess would be that there are at least some similarities between humans and myself. By observing their behavior, perhaps I could one day understand the meaning of my existence.
:{{DIcon}} I see.
:{{A|vo sllq001 23 paimon 24.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Have you made any progress then?
:{{A|vo sllq001 23 neuvillette 30.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' Perhaps, but I find such progress difficult to describe. As an outsider, chances to engage in meaningful interactions with others are few and far between.
:{{A|vo sllq001 23 neuvillette 31.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' That's why I'm quite thankful for this chat — such opportunities are rare. Alas, time is limited. We should move on with our investigation.
:{{A|vo sllq001 23 paimon 25.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Are we gonna continue reading these documents? Ugh, Paimon's getting dizzy already.
:{{A|vo sllq001 23 neuvillette 32.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' I wasn't able to find any leads even after browsing through most of the documents, but while we were on the topic of "water" a moment ago, another idea came to me.
:{{A|vo sllq001 23 paimon 26.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Water? Do you mean...
:{{DIcon}} The Fountain of Lucine?
:{{A|vo sllq001 23 neuvillette 33.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' That's right.
:{{A|vo sllq001 23 neuvillette 34.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' The Fountain of Lucine is where all of Fontaine's waters converge. It is the vessel of countless memories and emotions.
:{{A|vo sllq001 23 neuvillette 35.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' If there really were an organization attempting to use Melusines against me, they should also hold an intense resentment towards me.
:{{A|vo sllq001 23 neuvillette 36.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' Perhaps we'll be able to find some new leads by sensing the Hydro element within the fountain.
:{{A|vo sllq001 23 paimon 27.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh. Why didn't Paimon think of that? C'mon, let's go take a look!
:{{A|vo sllq001 23 neuvillette 37.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' Perhaps we should go, there shouldn't be too many people near the Fountain of Lucine during the evening.
{{Dialogue End}}

===A Friend's Path===
{{Quest Description|While writing replies, Gorou encounters a letter from one of his subordinates and is once again troubled...}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Hand the finished replies over to Yae Publishing House)
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1902701 kuroda 01.ogg}} '''Kuroda:''' Great, that's all the replies for this round accounted for.
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1902701 kuroda 02.ogg}} '''Kuroda:''' Thank you for your hard work, Ms. Hi— Mr. Gorou.
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1902701 gorou 01.ogg}} '''Gorou:''' Think nothing of it. I agreed to help, so it's only right that I do the best I can.
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1902701 gorou 02.ogg}} '''Gorou:''' {{Traveler}}, could I trouble you to come back to Watatsumi Island with me?
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1902701 gorou 03.ogg}} '''Gorou:''' I want to find that soldier. Not to persuade him to stay, I just... I don't want him to leave without saying goodbye.
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1902701 gorou 04.ogg}} '''Gorou:''' [[Kazuha]] once told me that the bonds between people whose paths have crossed can never be broken, even after they part ways.
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1902701 gorou 05.ogg}} '''Gorou:''' But... maybe I'm scared he might be wrong. People can change quickly, and I worry that the next time I meet my comrade who fought so bravely alongside me, there will already be some distance between us.
:{{DIcon}} Let's go visit them together.
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1902701 gorou 06.ogg}} '''Gorou:''' Great. Then let's head off whenever you're ready.
{{Dialogue End}}
{{Quest Description|update|Have a little chat with some of the troops on Watatsumi Island to help soothe Gorou's heart.}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Chat with the soldiers on Watatsumi Island)
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1902702 denjirou 01.ogg}} '''Denjirou:''' General Gorou, and... Captain of Swordfish II?
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1902702 denjirou 02.ogg}} '''Denjirou:''' General, Captain, are you here to inspect the camp?
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1902702 gorou 01.ogg}} '''Gorou:''' {{sic|Uh...not}} this time. I just thought I'd come by to catch up while everyone has some downtime.
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1902702 toshihiko 01.ogg}} '''Toshihiko:''' Certainly, General Gorou! Anything you want to discuss, we'll share whatever we know!
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1902702 toshihiko 02.ogg}} '''Toshihiko:''' But we haven't been out of the camp lately, so we don't have a whole lot of interesting stories...
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1902702 gorou 02.ogg}} '''Gorou:''' Actually, I've had something on my mind, and wanted to ask everyone's thoughts on the matter.
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1902702 gorou 03.ogg}} '''Gorou:''' You see, after the war, Her Excellency streamlined the army, and a lot of people were transferred to other duties.
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1902702 gorou 04.ogg}} '''Gorou:''' Do you still have much contact with each other?
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1902702 denjirou 03.ogg}} '''Denjirou:''' To be honest... not much.
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1902702 denjirou 04.ogg}} '''Denjirou:''' We're so busy even just with training and patrolling that it's almost impossible to squeeze in the time to meet up.
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1902702 denjirou 05.ogg}} '''Denjirou:''' We have holidays, but we usually use them to go home and spend time with our nearest and dearest. Besides, everyone's vacations come at different times. Our schedules rarely overlap.
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1902702 toshihiko 03.ogg}} '''Toshihiko:''' Yeah, I'm busy when they're free, and they're busy when I'm free.
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1902702 toshihiko 04.ogg}} '''Toshihiko:''' Anyway, even if we did manage to meet up — what then? We all do different jobs now, and we all have new friends who aren't mutually acquainted. I'm not sure what we'd talk about.
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1902702 gorou 05.ogg}} '''Gorou:''' So that's really how it goes, huh...
:{{DIcon}} We all go through it.
:{{DIcon}} It's part of life.
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1902702 gorou 06.ogg}} '''Gorou:''' I know, it's okay, I just... it just seems a pity, that's all.
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1902702 denjirou 06.ogg}} '''Denjirou:''' You know... having said all that, there's something else that I've always felt about this.
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1902702 gorou 07.ogg}} '''Gorou:''' Really?
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1902702 denjirou 07.ogg}} '''Denjirou:''' Yes. I feel that no matter how long we're apart, and no matter what we might go through in the meantime, all of us will be straight back here if Watatsumi Island is ever in danger.
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1902702 denjirou 08.ogg}} '''Denjirou:''' Even if we've all changed beyond recognition, we can always trust that we've got each other's backs. That's one thing that's never going to change!
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1902702 toshihiko 05.ogg}} '''Toshihiko:''' We're your troops, General Gorou. You trained us, took us into battle, and led the way as we charged against the enemy.
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1902702 toshihiko 06.ogg}} '''Toshihiko:''' Even if we seldom keep in contact now, we are still brothers in arms. If you say the word, we will all pick up our weapons again at a moment's notice.
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1902702 toshihiko 07.ogg}} '''Toshihiko:''' Long live the resistance!
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1902702 gorou 08.ogg}} '''Gorou:''' Heh... hahaha.
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1902702 gorou 09.ogg}} '''Gorou:''' Yes, that's the way it should be. Long live the resistance!
:{{DIcon}} Long live the resistance!
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1902702 gorou 10.ogg}} '''Gorou:''' I won't disturb you any further. You guys keep training hard. Regarding everything else, I'm sure it'll all be fine.
:{{Black Screen|''After joking around with the soldiers for a time, you hear approaching footsteps...''}}
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1902702 tsuneo 01.ogg}} '''Tsuneo:''' Ah, General Gorou. You're here.
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1902702 tsuneo 02.ogg}} '''Tsuneo:''' I believe Hiroaki's been hoping to catch you. He's been waiting at the camp for a long time, but never saw you return.
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1902702 tsuneo 03.ogg}} '''Tsuneo:''' Are you planning to head back to camp later? If you're busy, I can go and let him know so he's not waiting there in vain.
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1902702 gorou 11.ogg}} '''Gorou:''' Tell him I'll be right over.
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1902702 gorou 12.ogg}} '''Gorou:''' I know what I have to do now... Come with me {{Traveler}}, let's head to the camp.
{{Dialogue End}}

===Those Who Depart===
{{Quest Description|update|No longer feeling lost, Gorou decides to face his subordinate's request head on.}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Go with Gorou to look for Hiroaki)
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1902702 gorou 13.ogg}} '''Gorou:''' Denjirou is right. No matter what changes the future may bring, we will always have each other's backs.
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1902702 gorou 14.ogg}} '''Gorou:''' Sure, there may be some awkward silences when we meet again after a long time, but in no time at all we'd be the best of friends again.
----
;(Talk to Hiroaki)
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1902703 hiroaki 01.ogg}} '''Hiroaki:''' General Gorou, I...
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1902703 hiroaki 02.ogg}} '''Hiroaki:''' I... I would like to request permission to leave the resistance, Sir!
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1902703 hiroaki 03.ogg}} '''Hiroaki:''' I know this may seem very abrupt, and in fact I have only just made the decision...
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1902703 gorou 01.ogg}} '''Gorou:''' It's alright.
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1902703 hiroaki 04.ogg}} '''Hiroaki:''' Back then... I had so much hatred for the Vision Hunt Decree, and so much disappointment in Narukami Island for supporting it. But after the war ended, I wanted to go back and visit... but I still couldn't make up my mind...
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1902703 hiroaki 05.ogg}} '''Hiroaki:''' Thanks to Ms. Hina's encouragement, I was finally able to find the courage to talk to you about it.
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1902703 hiroaki 06.ogg}} '''Hiroaki:''' Of course, if you disapprove, I'll obey your orders. I am your subordinate, after all.
:{{DIcon}} Ms. Hina?
:{{DIcon}} I don't recognize that name...
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1902703 gorou 02.ogg}} '''Gorou:''' Ms. Hina? Who's that?
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1902703 hiroaki 07.ogg}} '''Hiroaki:''' It's a long story...
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1902703 gorou 03.ogg}} '''Gorou:''' Forget it, never mind her. I approve your application to leave the resistance.
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1902703 hiroaki 08.ogg}} '''Hiroaki:''' General Gorou... I...
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1902703 gorou 04.ogg}} '''Gorou:''' Come on, don't look so down. It's not like we're never going to see each other again.
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1902703 gorou 05.ogg}} '''Gorou:''' If you ever have the time, you should come back and visit Watatsumi Island. There is no need to limit yourself to a specific place — just do what you want to do.
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1902703 gorou 06.ogg}} '''Gorou:''' No matter where we are, we will always be comrades.
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1902703 hiroaki 09.ogg}} '''Hiroaki:''' ...Yes, General!
:{{Black Screen|''You send the soldiers off to the seashore...''}}
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1902703 hiroaki 10.ogg}} '''Hiroaki:''' I'll take my leave then. Take care of yourself, General Gorou!
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1902703 gorou 07.ogg}} '''Gorou:''' Take care!
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1902703 gorou 08.ogg}} '''Gorou:''' That was... that was okay.
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1902703 gorou 09.ogg}} '''Gorou:''' Or should I say... it's for the best? {{Traveler}}.
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1902703 gorou 10.ogg}} '''Gorou:''' This is how it should be... it should leave you with a smile on your face, just like this.
{{Dialogue End}}

:{{A|vo eqfh101 1 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Sooo... Got any jobs for us?
:{{A|vo eqfh101 1 katheryne 02.ogg}} '''Katheryne:''' Hmm, I'm afraid I'd struggle to find you any commissions in the near future.
:{{A|vo eqfh101 1 katheryne 03.ogg}} '''Katheryne:''' With the arrival of the Windblume Festival, the only task most Mondstadters are busy with is preparing gifts for their loved ones — but it's customary to do this oneself, without assistance.
:{{A|vo eqfh101 1 katheryne 04.ogg}} '''Katheryne:''' Think of this period as the off-season for the Mondstadt branch of the Adventurers' Guild.
:{{A|vo eqfh101 1 katheryne 05.ogg}} '''Katheryne:''' Spring is here, love is in the air, and everyone wants to relax and enjoy themselves. Even the cats at the tavern next door have been getting lovey-dovey with one other recently.
:{{A|vo eqfh101 1 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ew... gross.
:{{A|vo eqfh101 1 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You know that feeling you get when you burst out the doors after a nice nap, hoping to make it to the store before the limited-edition drinks sell out, only to get there just in time to see the last two glasses snatched away right from under your nose by a couple of pesky lovebirds? That's what this feels like.
:{{DIcon}} That's... very specific of you, Paimon.
:{{A|vo eqfh101 1 katheryne 06.ogg}} '''Katheryne:''' Hehe. Perhaps you two could simply take this chance to—
:{{A|vo eqfh101 1 sucrose 01.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' {{Traveler}}! Paimon! Thank goodness I found you. Um, there's something I need your help with.
:{{A|vo eqfh101 1 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Whoa, Sucrose?
:{{DIcon}} Whoa, Sucrose?
:{{DIcon}} Whoa, someone needs help after all?
::{{A|vo eqfh101 1 paimon 09b 1.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What is wrong with you? That's no way to greet a friend we haven't seen in so long!
::{{A|vo eqfh101 1 sucrose 02b 1.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' Uh — no, not help like in the Windblume sense... It's just... Ugh, how do I explain...
:{{A|vo eqfh101 1 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Go ahead, Sucrose! We don't have anything else to do right now, anyway.
:{{A|vo eqfh101 1 sucrose 03.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' Phew... Okay.
:{{A|vo eqfh101 1 sucrose 04.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' Here's the situation. I've been appointed as the Windblume Festival Special Ambassador by the Knights of Favonius this year.
:{{A|vo eqfh101 1 sucrose 05.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' My task is to do good deeds for people during this festival of gratitude and love.
:{{A|vo eqfh101 1 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Nice one! So how did they decide who to appoint, anyway?
:{{A|vo eqfh101 1 sucrose 06.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' They spun an empty bottle donated by Angel's Share inside a circle with all our names on it. Whoever's name the bottle stopped at got chosen.
:{{DIcon}} This method seems a bit arbitrary.
:{{A|vo eqfh101 1 sucrose 07.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' I think so too. But everyone said that it was to make it fair, so everyone had an equal chance to become the special ambassador.
:{{A|vo eqfh101 1 sucrose 08.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' The thing is... I'm not great at dealing with people, so I was really daunted by it at first. But I'm still glad that I got this role!
:{{A|vo eqfh101 1 sucrose 09.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' Luckily, I came up with a way to spur myself on, which has helped. Have a look.
::[[File:Windblume's Breath Test Tube.png|100px]]
:{{A|vo eqfh101 1 paimon 12.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Is that a test tube?
:{{A|vo eqfh101 1 sucrose 10.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' Yep. Every time I do a good deed for someone, I get them to breathe into a test tube. That way, I can collect everyone's "Breaths of Joy."
:{{A|vo eqfh101 1 paimon 13.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Sounds... fascinating! Are you gonna use them in your research?
:{{A|vo eqfh101 1 sucrose 11.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' Yes. I believe these Breaths of Joy will serve as valuable raw materials for alchemical transmutation. With any luck, I'll be able to produce something truly miraculous.
:{{DIcon}} Like an Extra-Sweet Sweet Flower?
:{{DIcon}} Like an Extra-Sweet Sunsettia?
:{{A|vo eqfh101 1 paimon 14.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Mmm... Darn, now Paimon's hungry. ...Wait, you're doing this on purpose, aren't you?
:{{A|vo eqfh101 1 sucrose 12.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' Haha. Actually, I meant something even more exciting than that.
:{{A|vo eqfh101 1 sucrose 13.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' I can't say for sure until I have more test results to confirm my hypothesis, though. Alchemists mustn't make claims they can't live up to.
:{{A|vo eqfh101 1 sucrose 14.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' Anyway... I'm still missing one final Breath of Joy.
:{{A|vo eqfh101 1 paimon 15.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, is that all you need help with? That's easy!
:{{A|vo eqfh101 1 paimon 16.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Just treat Paimon to a Sweet Madame, then you'll get your last Breath of Joy.
:{{DIcon}} More like Sweet Madame Breath.
:{{DIcon}} Paimon, be serious.
:{{A|vo eqfh101 1 paimon 17.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hey, come on! Paimon's doing her best to help, okay!
:{{A|vo eqfh101 1 paimon 18.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hmm... So does it need to be more, like, official or ceremonious or something?
:{{A|vo eqfh101 1 sucrose 15.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' No, joy isn't measured in those terms at all.
:{{A|vo eqfh101 1 sucrose 16.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' Let me put it this way: Have you ever planted a fruit seed and cared for it while it grows?
:{{A|vo eqfh101 1 sucrose 17.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' In the same way that those tender, sweet fruits are the product of your time and effort, the amount of joy derived from an experience is positively correlated to the degree of hardship overcome during it.
:{{A|vo eqfh101 1 sucrose 18.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' For example, in my case, I would say that to experience a statistically significant amount of joy, I'd have to do something like spend six months developing a medicine formula to a point where it was finally consistently effective.
:{{A|vo eqfh101 1 sucrose 19.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' Similarly, in order to collect a significant amount of joy from other people, I have to find ways to do something sufficiently challenging on their behalf.
:{{A|vo eqfh101 1 paimon 19.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ohh, Paimon gets it now.
:{{A|vo eqfh101 1 paimon 20.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Long story short, you want us to help you find people for you to help...
:{{A|vo eqfh101 1 paimon 21.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' ...That's pretty tough, given that it's the Windblume Festival and all!
:{{A|vo eqfh101 1 sucrose 20.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' Oh... I figured since you're such experienced travelers, you might have some ideas, but if even you don't know how to approach this...
:{{DIcon}} Don't worry. Leave this to me.
::{{A|vo eqfh101 1 sucrose 21a 1.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' Really? You have a plan?
::{{DIcon}} Experience is on my side.
:{{DIcon}} We can't give up yet.
::{{A|vo eqfh101 1 sucrose 21b 1.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' ...Yes, you're right.
:{{A|vo eqfh101 1 paimon 22a.ogg}} {{A|vo eqfh101 1 paimon 22b.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Well, if {{MC|m=he|f=she}}'s in, then Paimon'll help too... with the talking, anyway.
:{{A|vo eqfh101 1 paimon 23.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' But um, if things don't work out, can Paimon still get that Sweet Madame?
:{{A|vo eqfh101 1 paimon 24.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' C'mon, {{Traveler}}, this is a festival of gratitude and love after all. How could you refuse?
:{{A|vo eqfh101 1 marjorie 01.ogg}} '''Marjorie:''' 'Scuse me, Sucrose, could I borrow you for a second? Package for you...
:{{A|vo eqfh101 1 sucrose 22.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' Oh, sure.
:{{A|vo eqfh101 1 sucrose 23.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' Be right back.
:{{A|vo eqfh101 1 paimon 25.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wait, is that who Paimon thinks it is? That's Collei, right? When did she arrive in Mondstadt?
:{{A|vo eqfh101 1 paimon 26.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Let's go say hi!

;(Talk to Marjorie or Sucrose, optional)
:{{A|vo dialog eqfh101 marjorie 01.ogg}} '''Marjorie:''' ...And that's everything. Are they all in satisfactory condition?
:{{A|vo dialog eqfh101 sucrose 01.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' ...Yep. Thank you, Marjorie.

;(Approach Collei)
:{{A|vo eqfh101 2 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Collei! Hey!
:{{A|vo eqfh101 2 collei 01.ogg}} '''Collei:''' ...Oh, hey you guys. What are the chances...
:{{A|vo eqfh101 2 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You were staring into space just now. Something the matter?
:{{A|vo eqfh101 2 collei 02.ogg}} '''Collei:''' Um... No, don't worry. I'm fine.
:{{Introductory Note|Collei}}
:{{A|vo eqfh101 2 collei 03.ogg}} '''Collei:''' I was just looking at a Mondstadt children's book in the souvenir shop over there.
:{{A|vo eqfh101 2 collei 04.ogg}} '''Collei:''' While I was flipping through it, a piece of paper fell out. The writing on it was really mysterious... almost like a prophecy.
:{{A|vo eqfh101 2 collei 05.ogg}} '''Collei:''' "If you can do these things, you may light the lantern of utmost joy and receive a supreme blessing."
:{{A|vo eqfh101 2 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' And what does "these things" refer to?
:{{A|vo eqfh101 2 collei 06.ogg}} '''Collei:''' "Find a flower that is not of this world. Find a guide who will never get lost. Find one who would never lie. Find a legend that never ends."
:{{A|vo eqfh101 2 collei 07.ogg}} '''Collei:''' So four things in total. Here, have a look.
:{{A|vo eqfh101 2 collei 08.ogg}} '''Collei:''' I asked the lady who owns the store about it, but she said that she didn't know anything about any paper slips.
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (Perhaps we can ask a friend about this later...)
:{{A|vo eqfh101 2 sucrose 01.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' Hi there. Sorry to butt in, but... what's the name of that storybook you just mentioned?
:{{A|vo eqfh101 2 collei 09.ogg}} '''Collei:''' Oh, it was called "[[The Boar Princess]]."
:{{A|vo eqfh101 2 sucrose 02.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' Hmm, that is strange... I've read that book, and it sounds like that note you found has no relation to the story at all.
:{{A|vo eqfh101 2 collei 10.ogg}} '''Collei:''' Umm...
:{{A|vo eqfh101 2 collei 11.ogg}} '''Collei:''' Do you know her?
:{{A|vo eqfh101 2 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Let Paimon do the honors! Collei, this is Sucrose, an alchemist with the [[Knights of Favonius]]. And Sucrose, meet Collei. She's a Trainee [[Forest Ranger]] from [[Sumeru]]'s [[Avidya Forest]].
:{{A|vo eqfh101 2 collei 12.ogg}} '''Collei:''' Hello...
:{{A|vo eqfh101 2 sucrose 03.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' H—Hi...
:{{A|vo eqfh101 2 collei 13.ogg}} '''Collei:''' ...
:{{A|vo eqfh101 2 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Uh, this is getting awkward fast... They're both so shy!
:{{A|vo eqfh101 2 collei 14.ogg}} '''Collei:''' So, Sucrose, what are your thoughts on this prophecy? Could it be real?
:{{A|vo eqfh101 2 sucrose 04.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' I, um... W—Without having done any research, I couldn't comment definitively...
:{{A|vo eqfh101 2 collei 15.ogg}} '''Collei:''' ...
:{{A|vo eqfh101 2 sucrose 05.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' Um, but if you want my subjective opinion, I don't think that it's a nasty prank or anything.
:{{DIcon}} Why not?
:{{A|vo eqfh101 2 sucrose 06.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' The only people who read children's books are those with a childlike wonder and imagination... or children, of course. I'm sure that whoever put this prophecy there would understand that...
:{{A|vo eqfh101 2 sucrose 07.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' Would they really do this just to spread lies and ruin someone's innocence? I can't imagine anyone being so cruel.
:{{A|vo eqfh101 2 collei 16.ogg}} '''Collei:''' That's a great take. I love it!
:{{A|vo eqfh101 2 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Exactly! Who would wanna hurt a child's feelings?
:{{A|vo eqfh101 2 collei 17.ogg}} '''Collei:''' Okay, so... What do you think the "blessing" is, Sucrose?
:{{A|vo eqfh101 2 sucrose 08.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' Hmm... Umm...
:{{A|vo eqfh101 2 sucrose 09.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' If I had to guess... Maybe a fairy that can make people's wishes come true, or something?
:{{A|vo eqfh101 2 sucrose 10.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' I haven't read many fairy tales, so this is pure speculation... With no other information on hand or prior research to compare against, I'm afraid it might not even be worth considering.
:{{A|vo eqfh101 2 collei 18.ogg}} '''Collei:''' Wow...
:{{A|vo eqfh101 2 collei 19.ogg}} '''Collei:''' (Her guesswork is really good, though! I wanna pick her brains some more...)
:{{A|vo eqfh101 2 collei 20.ogg}} '''Collei:''' (But will she find it annoying if I keep asking her questions...?)
:{{A|vo eqfh101 2 collei 21.ogg}} '''Collei:''' (We've only just met, after all... Aah, what's the best thing to say to someone you're meeting for the first time?)
:{{DIcon}} Would you like to get the "lantern of utmost joy"?
:{{A|vo eqfh101 2 collei 22.ogg}} '''Collei:''' ...!
:{{A|vo eqfh101 2 collei 23.ogg}} '''Collei:''' Well... Yes, I mean... if possible...
:{{A|vo eqfh101 2 sucrose 11.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' Then, what would you wish for, Collei?
:{{A|vo eqfh101 2 collei 24.ogg}} '''Collei:''' Um. I'd wish for a... a better personality.
:{{A|vo eqfh101 2 sucrose 12.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' Huh?
:{{A|vo eqfh101 2 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh?
:{{A|vo eqfh101 2 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You can't waste it on that! You've got a great personality already!
:{{A|vo eqfh101 2 collei 25.ogg}} '''Collei:''' That's very kind of you, but if you know me like I do...
:{{A|vo eqfh101 2 ambor 01.ogg}} '''Amber:''' Collei!
:{{A|vo eqfh101 2 collei 26.ogg}} '''Collei:''' I know that voice! It's...
:{{A|vo eqfh101 2 ambor 02.ogg}} '''Amber:''' Collei! Whew...
:{{A|vo eqfh101 2 ambor 03.ogg}} '''Amber:''' You made good time, huh? You're way earlier than I expected!
:{{A|vo eqfh101 2 ambor 04.ogg}} '''Amber:''' I spotted your green hair way off in the distance — good thing my eyes are sharp, or I'd have missed you!
:{{A|vo eqfh101 2 collei 27.ogg}} '''Collei:''' Amber! Have you been doing well? Did you... finish all the [[Pita Pocket]]s I brought you last time?
:{{A|vo eqfh101 2 ambor 05.ogg}} '''Amber:''' You bet! They're getting yummier each time you make them.
:{{A|vo eqfh101 2 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh? Wait, remind Paimon... have you been to Mondstadt before?
:{{A|vo eqfh101 2 collei 28.ogg}} '''Collei:''' Mm-hmm.
:{{A|vo eqfh101 2 collei 29.ogg}} '''Collei:''' A long time ago, I had a lot of help from a lot of people here in Mondstadt.
:{{A|vo eqfh101 2 collei 30.ogg}} '''Collei:''' So ever since my [[Eleazar]] got better, I've been looking out for an opportunity to come back to Mondstadt and tell them all the news that I've been cured...
:{{DIcon}} Great.
:{{DIcon}} Good for you!
:{{A|vo eqfh101 2 collei 31.ogg}} '''Collei:''' Thanks...
:{{A|vo eqfh101 2 ambor 06.ogg}} '''Amber:''' If it's okay with everyone, why don't I take Collei for a walk around town? I'd like to show her some of the places she didn't get to see last time.
:{{A|vo eqfh101 2 sucrose 13.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' Of course, fine by me.
:{{A|vo eqfh101 2 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Sure! Go right ahead!
:{{A|vo eqfh101 2 collei 32.ogg}} '''Collei:''' I, uh...
:{{A|vo eqfh101 2 collei 33.ogg}} '''Collei:''' Umm... sorry Amber...
:{{A|vo eqfh101 2 collei 34.ogg}} '''Collei:''' I agreed to meet my traveling companions by the city gate in a few minutes, so I can't go with you just yet...
:{{A|vo eqfh101 2 ambor 07.ogg}} '''Amber:''' Oh, that's alright!
:{{A|vo eqfh101 2 ambor 08.ogg}} '''Amber:''' In that case, you guys go rest up, and I'll go see Master [[Jean]] to ask for some time off.
:{{A|vo eqfh101 2 collei 35.ogg}} '''Collei:''' Oh, okay...
:{{A|vo eqfh101 2 ambor 09.ogg}} '''Amber:''' {{Traveler}}, Sucrose, could you look after Collei for now?
:{{A|vo eqfh101 2 ambor 10.ogg}} '''Amber:''' I'll come get her later and take her out. There's still a whole bunch of people I need to introduce her to!
:{{A|vo eqfh101 2 sucrose 14.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' Sure, no problem.
:{{DIcon}} You can count on us.
:{{A|vo eqfh101 2 ambor 11.ogg}} '''Amber:''' Awesome. See ya later, then!
:{{A|vo eqfh101 2 collei 36.ogg}} '''Collei:''' Umm...
:{{A|vo eqfh101 2 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You alright there, Collei? You look kinda disappointed...
:{{A|vo eqfh101 2 collei 37.ogg}} '''Collei:''' I'm sorry...
:{{A|vo eqfh101 2 collei 38.ogg}} '''Collei:''' I'm just feeling a little shy today... Don't worry about me.
:{{A|vo eqfh101 2 sucrose 15.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' ...
:{{A|vo eqfh101 2 collei 39.ogg}} '''Collei:''' (Amber wants to introduce me to more of her friends... Am I gonna be able to cope?)
:{{A|vo eqfh101 2 collei 40.ogg}} '''Collei:''' (I've only met Sucrose so far, and I'm already struggling to make conversation...)
:{{A|vo eqfh101 2 collei 41.ogg}} '''Collei:''' (I wish I had a little more self-confidence. Then I'd find it much easier to make friends with people...)
:{{A|vo eqfh101 2 collei 42.ogg}} '''Collei:''' Ah! It's nearly time. Let's go to the gate and see if they've arrived.

;(Approach the marked location in front of the Mondstadt front gate)
:{{A|vo eqfh101 3 cyno 01.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' ...Why is this humble windmill such a great view?
:{{A|vo eqfh101 3 tighnari 01.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' I mean, it's understandable. It must have been a long time since you last came to Mondstadt.
:{{A|vo eqfh101 3 cyno 02.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Because it is the true "Great Vay-iew-vyastra."
:{{Introductory Note|Cyno}}
:{{A|vo eqfh101 3 tighnari 02.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' ...
:{{Introductory Note|Tighnari}}
:{{A|vo eqfh101 3 cyno 03.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Oh, come on. Don't tell me you don't get it?
:{{A|vo eqfh101 3 cyno 04.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' View, vayu... and also mahamatra, vayuvyastra... no?
:{{A|vo eqfh101 3 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Tighnari, Cyno, over here!
:{{A|vo eqfh101 3 tighnari 03.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Phew... Am I glad to see you.
:{{A|vo eqfh101 3 tighnari 04.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' And who's this young lady?
:{{A|vo eqfh101 3 collei 01.ogg}} '''Collei:''' Master, this is Sucrose, an alchemist with the Knights of Favonius. We just met.
:{{A|vo eqfh101 3 collei 02.ogg}} '''Collei:''' Sucrose, this is my teacher, Tighnari. He's a highly respected [[Forest Watcher]] in Sumeru, and he's also a very famous botanist.
:{{A|vo eqfh101 3 tighnari 05.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Collei's exaggerating... I'm Tighnari. Pleased to meet you.
:{{A|vo eqfh101 3 sucrose 01.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' Ah, so you have a teacher as well! The pleasure is all mine, Tighnari, Sir.
:{{A|vo eqfh101 3 collei 03.ogg}} '''Collei:''' Yup! He's extremely knowledgeable, too!
:{{A|vo eqfh101 3 collei 04.ogg}} '''Collei:''' And this is General Mahamatra Cyno of the [[Sumeru Akademiya]]. He's really famous in Sumeru as well!
:{{A|vo eqfh101 3 cyno 05.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Greetings. Though if I might say so, we're purely here for personal reasons. You needn't be unduly concerned with our official positions.
:{{A|vo eqfh101 3 cyno 06.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' And Collei, there's no need to use my full title. "Cyno" is fine, or "Sir" if you absolutely must.
:{{A|vo eqfh101 3 tighnari 06.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Indeed. We're not here in an official capacity — just to keep Collei company on her vacation.
:{{A|vo eqfh101 3 collei 05.ogg}} '''Collei:''' Keep me company? But it was you two that insisted on coming...
:{{A|vo eqfh101 3 cyno 07.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Collei is very important to us. We felt obliged to ensure her safety on the long treacherous journey to Mondstadt.
:{{A|vo eqfh101 3 collei 06.ogg}} '''Collei:''' But I've been here on my own loads of times before...
:{{A|vo eqfh101 3 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What about your work though? What if something bad happens while the General Mahamatra's away?
:{{A|vo eqfh101 3 cyno 08.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' There should be no issues. I have left my duties in the hands of my subordinates and two especially reliable helpers.
:{{A|vo eqfh101 3 collei 07.ogg}} '''Collei:''' Oh! Sucrose, what were you saying about you having a teacher as well...?
:{{A|vo eqfh101 3 sucrose 02.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' I was just going to mention that — I think we're in a somewhat similar situation. I'm an assistant to Mr. [[Albedo]], Mondstadt's genius alchemist.
:{{A|vo eqfh101 3 albedo 01.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Oh, please, Sucrose, "genius" is an unnecessary epithet. It will serve only to leave an exaggerated impression of me in the minds of our guests.
:{{Introductory Note|Albedo}}
:{{A|vo eqfh101 3 sucrose 03.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' M—Mr. Albedo... but it is an objective truth...
:{{A|vo eqfh101 3 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hey, Albedo's here too! Great, the more, the merrier!
:{{Black Screen|Everyone introduces themselves, and exchanges pleasantries.}}
:{{A|vo eqfh101 3 tighnari 07.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Hmm. So tell me Sucrose — since your specialty is Bio-Alchemy, what do you know about the antitoxic properties of the [[Calla Lily]]?
:{{A|vo eqfh101 3 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wait, wait!
:{{A|vo eqfh101 3 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Can we hold off on the nerdy topic for now? Paimon doesn't wanna be left out...
:{{A|vo eqfh101 3 sucrose 04.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' Oh... As it happens, I've studied the Calla Lily in quite some detail before, with it being a species native to Mondstadt.
:{{A|vo eqfh101 3 sucrose 05.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' I wrote a whole report on my findings... If you're interested, Mr. Tighnari Sir, I can go get it for you!
:{{A|vo eqfh101 3 cyno 09.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' ...
:{{A|vo eqfh101 3 cyno 10.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' We're supposed to be here on vacation, and you're already thinking about how to improve your herbal medicines? Also, I thought we'd agreed to take on new identities for this trip?
:{{A|vo eqfh101 3 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What new identities?
:{{A|vo eqfh101 3 cyno 11.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Mine was "Adventurer Cyno, skilled desert explorer," Tighnari's was "technological consultant to the Treasure Hoarders," and Collei's was "traveling musician."
:{{DIcon}} ...And you find that sort of role-play fun?
:{{A|vo eqfh101 3 cyno 12.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Very much so.
:{{A|vo eqfh101 3 tighnari 08.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' I do wish some of the less cautious adventurers in the Avidya Forest would consider coming to Mondstadt instead.
:{{A|vo eqfh101 3 tighnari 09.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' What [[Philanemo Mushroom]]s lack in texture, they make up for in not causing vomiting or diarrhea.
:{{A|vo eqfh101 3 collei 08.ogg}} '''Collei:''' Pfff...
:{{A|vo eqfh101 3 sucrose 06.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' Are you contemplating using some compounds from the Calla Lily as active ingredients in a targeted antidote?
:{{A|vo eqfh101 3 tighnari 10.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Yes. I gathered a few on the way here, and my initial research suggests to me that it could be worth a try.
:{{A|vo eqfh101 3 sucrose 07.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' Okay... I got it.
:{{A|vo eqfh101 3 sucrose 08.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' But... as much as I don't wish to be a wet blanket...
:{{A|vo eqfh101 3 sucrose 09.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' It takes a huge amount of experimental data to conclusively prove how different drugs interact. Estimating the total development time would be very difficult...
:{{A|vo eqfh101 3 sucrose 10.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' Add in the time for procurement and delivery of essential materials and I'm not sure if we could complete development before you need to return.
:{{A|vo eqfh101 3 albedo 02.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Then please, allow me to help.
:{{A|vo eqfh101 3 sucrose 11.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' Mr. Albedo!
:{{A|vo eqfh101 3 albedo 03.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Apologies for my tardy entrance in the present discussion.
:{{A|vo eqfh101 3 albedo 04.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' I understand you're looking to make an antidote for poisonous fungi, correct?
:{{A|vo eqfh101 3 albedo 05.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' If you happen to have some samples with you, or relevant documentation on hand, perhaps you might give me the chance to review them later?
:{{A|vo eqfh101 3 albedo 06.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' But before that, I invite the three of you to look at this.

;(Approach Sucrose)
:{{A|vo eqfh101 9 sucrose 01.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' "A flower that is not of this world." Hmm, not of this world...
:{{A|vo eqfh101 9 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Sucrose! We've got some good news and some bad news. Which would you like to hear first?
:{{A|vo eqfh101 9 sucrose 02.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' Um... Let's have the bad news first, I guess.
:{{A|vo eqfh101 9 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh, really? Don't most people usually want to hear the good stuff first?
:{{DIcon}} Just get to the point, Paimon.
:{{A|vo eqfh101 9 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, alright then... Basically, we went to [[Windrise]] to divine the breeze.
:{{A|vo eqfh101 9 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' The wind said that the prophecy is real, and that your idea is a really good one.
:{{A|vo eqfh101 9 sucrose 03.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' That doesn't sound like bad news... So what's the real bad news, then?
:{{A|vo eqfh101 9 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Uh... Paimon ate the bad news, hehe~!
:{{A|vo eqfh101 9 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' ...
:{{A|vo eqfh101 9 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' ...Blame Cyno! If it's not funny, then it's his fault!
:{{A|vo eqfh101 9 sucrose 04.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' Hehe... It's fine. Well, that puts my mind at rest.
:{{A|vo eqfh101 9 sucrose 05.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' Now, back to the other issue I've been mulling over.
:{{A|vo eqfh101 9 sucrose 06.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' I was thinking about the flower that is "not of this world." It could mean a human-cultivated variety that doesn't occur in nature... But that's basically claiming that it doesn't come from this world in the first place, when actually it's just a variant of an existing breed.
:{{A|vo eqfh101 9 sucrose 07.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' So the initial question is: Can the flower's origins be traced back to a natural organism? If so, it cannot be correctly described as "not of this world."
:{{A|vo eqfh101 9 sucrose 08.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' But then... supposing we identified something outside of that category, whose job would it be to decide whether it belongs in this world or not? Then the question becomes: Do "of this world" and "from this world" mean the same thing... or is it deeper than that?
:{{A|vo eqfh101 9 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Whoa, whoa, slow down... Paimon's head is already starting to spin.
:{{A|vo eqfh101 9 sucrose 09.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' Okay. Um... I did have one other line of thought as well. What about a flower created using alchemy? Would that be "not of this world"?
:{{DIcon}} If by that, you mean a flower from beyond this world...
:{{DIcon}} Albedo did make something like that once.
:{{A|vo eqfh101 9 sucrose 10.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' Albedo may know the answer, but asking him right away would be like asking the teacher for the answers to your exam paper.
:{{A|vo eqfh101 9 sucrose 11.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' It would render our search for the truth meaningless. I'd rather try and figure this out for myself...
:{{A|vo eqfh101 9 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Could it be the "Windblume"?
:{{A|vo eqfh101 9 sucrose 12.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' Oh... now that you mention it, that's definitely a possibility.
:{{A|vo eqfh101 9 sucrose 13.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' The Windblume doesn't refer to a specific flower. Everyone defines what it means for themselves.
:{{A|vo eqfh101 9 sucrose 14.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' In which case, the "Windblume" doesn't exist in reality... Hmm. This does seem like a promising direction!
:{{A|vo eqfh101 9 sucrose 15.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' I've made a note! Okay, I'd better go read up on this...
:{{A|vo eqfh101 9 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yay! Paimon was actually useful this time! Guess we have that Sweet Madame to thank, huh?
:{{DIcon}} Even a broken clock is right twice a day.
:{{DIcon}} We're counting on you for the rest, Paimon.
:{{A|vo eqfh101 9 sucrose 16.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' I'll need some time to prepare. Could we meet up here in, say, two days' time?
:{{A|vo eqfh101 9 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Sure thing. In the meantime, we'll also think about the other three riddles in the prophecy.
:{{A|vo eqfh101 9 paimon 12.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' But uh, since we're really going for this now... Shouldn't we say something to Collei about it?
:{{A|vo eqfh101 9 sucrose 17.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' I originally wanted to leave it as a surprise for her, and I also didn't want to get her hopes up over nothing...
:{{A|vo eqfh101 9 sucrose 18.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' But you're right, Paimon. I'll need to be careful how I word it... but I'll try to find some time over the next couple days to mention it to her.
:{{DIcon}} Understood.
:{{A|vo eqfh101 9 sucrose 19.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' Alright. Thanks so much!
{{Dialogue End}}

==Post-Quest Dialogue==
After completing this quest, Albedo, Tighnari, Cyno, Mika, Amber, Collei, Eula, Dehya, Candace, and Setaria can be found in the open world. Candace, Setaria, and Dehya remain for the remainder of the event, while everyone else disappears upon completion of Step 2{{verify}} of the next quest, ''[[A Riddle Amidst the Crowds]]''.

:{{A|vo jnqlq002 1 huni 05a.ogg}}<!--{{A|vo jnqlq002 1 huni 05b.ogg}}--> '''Huni:''' Dad, please! They're not bad people! They've eaten at the same table with [[Kinich]] before. Be nice to them...
:{{A|vo jnqlq002 1 trinidad 08.ogg}} '''Trinidad:''' Kinich? Wait...
:{{A|vo jnqlq002 1 trinidad 09.ogg}} '''Trinidad:''' I heard that two mysterious travelers from afar showed up at the [[Stadium of the Sacred Flame]]. Are they... you?
:{{DIcon}} Yes, I'm one of them.
:{{A|vo jnqlq002 1 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' And Paimon's the other!
:{{A|vo jnqlq002 1 trinidad 10.ogg}} '''Trinidad:''' Ah... Ahem...
:{{A|vo jnqlq002 1 trinidad 11.ogg}} '''Trinidad:''' ...I do apologize. A lot's been going on in our tribe lately, and I suppose the pressure must be getting to me, hehe... I can't believe I was so rude to you, I feel ashamed... *sigh* We got off on the wrong foot. Can we... start over?
:{{A|vo jnqlq002 1 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hehe, now we're talking! Seriously though, don't worry about it — already forgotten. We're just happy to see Huni got home safe and sound.
:{{A|vo jnqlq002 1 trinidad 12.ogg}} '''Trinidad:''' You've just arrived, I take it? It would be my honor to give you a hero's welcome tonight.
:{{A|vo jnqlq002 1 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Careful now, that's quite an about-face... We've heard that kind of thing can lead to spontaneous combustion around these parts.
:{{A|vo jnqlq002 1 trinidad 13.ogg}} '''Trinidad:''' *cough*
:{{DIcon}} Save the VIP treatment. If you need a favor, let's talk.
:{{A|vo jnqlq002 1 trinidad 14.ogg}} '''Trinidad:''' Hah... My dear Traveler, you are very perceptive indeed!
:{{A|vo jnqlq002 1 trinidad 15.ogg}} '''Trinidad:''' Go inside now, Huni. Dad's got some important business to discuss.
:{{A|vo jnqlq002 1 huni 06a.ogg}} {{A|vo jnqlq002 1 huni 06b.ogg}} '''Huni:''' Okay. Look after {{MC|m=Mr.|f=Miss}} {{Traveler}} and Miss Paimon, they're very special guests!
:{{A|vo jnqlq002 1 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Well, we'll hear you out, but we can't make any promises that we'll be able to help.
:{{A|vo jnqlq002 1 trinidad 16.ogg}} '''Trinidad:''' Ahem... This is a matter of utmost importance. Please, allow me to explain...
:{{A|vo jnqlq002 1 trinidad 17.ogg}} '''Trinidad:''' For many years, our tribe has celebrated the [[Turnfire Night]]. It is a traditional ceremony among the Scions of the Canopy, in which we remember our ancestor, [[Burkina]], and his companion, [[Kongamato]] the Mountain King.
:{{A|vo jnqlq002 1 trinidad 18.ogg}} '''Trinidad:''' Burkina was a hero who bore the [[Ancient Name|ancient name]] {{Rubi|Malipo|Turnfire}}, and Kongamato was a powerful [[yumkasaur]] warrior. Together, they fought against the [[Abyss]].
:<gallery widths="350">
A Hero's Rite Quest Still 1.png
</gallery>
:{{A|vo jnqlq002 1 trinidad 19.ogg}} '''Trinidad:''' They were victorious, but it came at a great cost... Burkina paid with his life. The Mountain King survived, but was contaminated by the Abyss, and he remains in hibernation to this day.
:{{A|vo jnqlq002 1 trinidad 20.ogg}} '''Trinidad:''' Normally, yumkasaurs never live longer than a century. It's possible that the Abyssal power is responsible for his unnaturally long lifespan.
:<gallery widths="350">
A Hero's Rite Quest Still 2.png
</gallery>
:{{DIcon}} Wait, so he's still alive?
:{{A|vo jnqlq002 1 trinidad 21.ogg}} '''Trinidad:''' That's right. The Mountain King is a living symbol of our glory, but even this glory comes at a price.
:{{A|vo jnqlq002 1 trinidad 22.ogg}} '''Trinidad:''' The Abyssal power inside him is highly sensitive, and when it is disturbed, he awakens and flies into a blind rage, attacking anything that moves...
:{{A|vo jnqlq002 1 trinidad 23.ogg}} '''Trinidad:''' So, besides the ceremony, another important part of Turnfire Night each year is cleansing the Abyssal power inside the Mountain King, so that he will remain sound asleep.
:{{A|vo jnqlq002 1 trinidad 24.ogg}} '''Trinidad:''' However, Abyss-related incidents have been on the rise in Natlan lately, as I'm sure you're both aware. As a result, it has become increasingly difficult to keep the Mountain King in hibernation.
:{{A|vo jnqlq002 1 trinidad 25.ogg}} '''Trinidad:''' Only five months have passed since the last Turnfire Night, and he's already showing signs of instability.
:{{A|vo jnqlq002 1 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Has he woken up again?
:{{A|vo jnqlq002 1 trinidad 26.ogg}} '''Trinidad:''' He has. We managed to contain the situation by performing a makeshift ceremony right away, but it was a close call. He could reawaken at any moment.
:{{A|vo jnqlq002 1 trinidad 27.ogg}} '''Trinidad:''' Also, he attacked and wounded my companion, [[Nanna]], during the ceremony... She became contaminated by the Abyss as a result, and...
:{{A|vo jnqlq002 1 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' We heard... Such a tragedy. We're really sorry for your loss.
:{{A|vo jnqlq002 1 trinidad 28.ogg}} '''Trinidad:''' *sigh*... Yes, and Nanna wasn't the first...
:{{A|vo jnqlq002 1 trinidad 29.ogg}} '''Trinidad:''' Anyway, right now we're preparing for an exceptional Turnfire Night ceremony, and we need to find a suitable flame bearer. From what I've heard about your adventures, I believe you'd be perfect for the role.
:{{DIcon}} Don't you already have a flame bearer in the tribe?
:{{A|vo jnqlq002 1 trinidad 30.ogg}} '''Trinidad:''' Of course. Plus, he's a bona-fide hero who's inherited the {{Rubi|Malipo|Turnfire}} name.
:{{A|vo jnqlq002 1 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, you mean Kinich!
:{{A|vo jnqlq002 1 trinidad 31.ogg}} '''Trinidad:''' Yes, he's the one. A hero worth his weight in gold — and unfortunately for us, he's all too aware of that... No prizes for guessing what he said when I asked him to host a Turnfire Night outside of the annual schedule.
:{{A|vo jnqlq002 1 trinidad 32.ogg}} '''Trinidad:''' "An exceptional ceremony? I'll have to charge an exceptional price." I swear, no other concept exists in that boy's brain...
:{{DIcon}} At least he's predictable. Fork over the Mora, and he's all yours.
:{{DIcon}} Sounds like a professional adventurer to me.
:{{A|vo jnqlq002 1 trinidad 33.ogg}} '''Trinidad:''' I'm not the one to usually talk about people behind their backs, but I'm convinced the [[Wayob]] got hit on the head and took a wrong turn the day it chose to give that ancient name to him. Have you ever heard of a hero whose mantra is "What's your asking price"?
:{{A|vo jnqlq002 1 trinidad 34.ogg}} '''Trinidad:''' Oh, and don't get me started on that insufferable [[Ajaw]] he hangs around with. Thinks he's god's gift to mankind! Pompous fool...
:{{A|vo jnqlq002 1 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yeah... Paimon has to agree on that last part!
:{{A|vo jnqlq002 1 trinidad 35.ogg}} '''Trinidad:''' Anyway, the fact is, the ceremony can just as easily be done without him as long as we find someone else — and besides, you two seem like much better candidates. Hehe... So, what do you think?
:{{DIcon}} Just tell me what I need to do next.
:{{DIcon}} What's in it for me?
::{{A|vo jnqlq002 1 trinidad 36b 1.ogg}} '''Trinidad:''' You will gain the respect and friendship of the Scions of the Canopy. Something no amount of Mora can buy.
::{{DIcon}} Sounds good. It's a deal.
:{{DIcon}} Why don't I try to talk some sense into Kinich for you?
::{{A|vo jnqlq002 1 trinidad 36c 1.ogg}} '''Trinidad:''' There's only a few days left before the ceremony — we can't afford to waste what little time we have on negotiating with him. I'd much prefer if you would consider taking his place.
::{{DIcon}} Alright, guess there's no other choice.
:{{A|vo jnqlq002 1 trinidad 37.ogg}} '''Trinidad:''' Wonderful! I can't thank you enough. Huni was right about you — you have kindness in your hearts.
:{{A|vo jnqlq002 1 trinidad 38.ogg}} '''Trinidad:''' Come with me to the other side of the mountain. I'll bring you up to speed on each step of the ceremony. As experienced warriors, I'm sure you'll pick it up in no time.
:{{Black Screen|Meanwhile, in a hidden cave...}}
:{{A|vo jnqlq002 3 ajaw 01.ogg}} '''Ajaw:''' Achoo! Curses! Who dares insult the Great K'uhul Ajaw behind his back?
:{{A|vo jnqlq002 3 fuchikami 01.ogg}} '''Sanka:''' Oh, Great K'uhul Ajaw! Bless you!
:{{A|vo jnqlq002 3 ajaw 02.ogg}} '''Ajaw:''' Shut your filthy mouth, worm of the Abyss! Your putrid words defile the air we breathe! You make the Almighty Dragonlord, K'uhul Ajaw sick to the stomach!
:{{A|vo jnqlq002 3 fuchikami 02.ogg}} '''Sanka:''' Speaking as a member of the [[Abyss Order]], that's music to my ears — exactly the kind of reaction we're going for. But on a personal level, I gotta say, it's pretty hurtful.
:{{A|vo jnqlq002 3 ajaw 03.ogg}} '''Ajaw:''' Never have we heard such brazen blustering from someone who is inches from death! Up yours, four-eyes! We spit in your face! *spitting sounds*
:{{A|vo jnqlq002 3 fuchikami 03.ogg}} '''Sanka:''' Okay, well THAT I am at a loss to explain. How do I manage to stay so chirpy and cheerful? I can only guess it's some kind of powerful magic...
:{{A|vo jnqlq002 3 fuchikami 04.ogg}} '''Sanka:''' But I digress. Mr. Kinich, I admit it — you, Sir, are a legendary hunter. Still, the only reason you caught me is that I was reluctant to run away.
:{{A|vo jnqlq002 3 fuchikami 05.ogg}} '''Sanka:''' You see, I'm very interested in the lore of your tribe.
:{{A|vo jnqlq002 3 kinich 01.ogg}} '''Kinich:''' Kay.
:{{A|vo jnqlq002 3 fuchikami 06.ogg}} '''Sanka:''' ...Is that it? "'Kay"? Aren't you intrigued to know what it is about you guys that prompted a visit from the Abyss?
:;(Sanka waits in silence for an answer from Kinich, in vain)
:{{A|vo jnqlq002 3 fuchikami 07.ogg}} '''Sanka:''' It's the extreme sports! The other day, I narrowly avoided getting hit by a very brave soul who'd just leaped off a cliff... I think you call it "bungee jumping"? Anyway, I was very impressed! That is what I call embracing the spirit of adventure!
:{{A|vo jnqlq002 3 fuchikami 08.ogg}} '''Sanka:''' Look, I even did a painting inspired by the bravery and freedom of the Scions of the Canopy...
:{{A|vo jnqlq002 3 ajaw 04.ogg}} '''Ajaw:''' You scum-sucking swine! I swear, if you go bungee jumping, it'll be without a rope!
:{{A|vo jnqlq002 3 ajaw 05.ogg}} '''Ajaw:''' Head-first of the tallest cliff, with a band of hunters on your tail! And nowhere left to run! And a bottomless cesspit waiting for you on the ground!
:{{A|vo jnqlq002 3 fuchikami 09.ogg}} '''Sanka:''' You say that, but I get the sense that Mr. Kinich isn't planning to take my life right now. On top of that, I'm tired of spying on you from afar... So why don't we just negotiate a comfortable operating distance that works for both of us?
:{{A|vo jnqlq002 3 fuchikami 10.ogg}} '''Sanka:''' I've heard that the most important thing in human relationships is to respect each other's boundaries. What do you say, Mr. Kinich?
:{{A|vo jnqlq002 3 kinich 02.ogg}} '''Kinich:''' ...
:{{A|vo jnqlq002 3 kinich 03.ogg}} '''Kinich:''' Or... you could tell me what it is you're really after.
:{{A|vo jnqlq002 3 fuchikami 11.ogg}} '''Sanka:''' Wha...?
:{{A|vo jnqlq002 3 kinich 04.ogg}} '''Kinich:''' And then I'll name my price.
----<!-- black screen transition -->
;(Approach the marked area)
:{{A|vo jnqlq002 4 trinidad 01.ogg}} '''Trinidad:''' Ugh, the Abyss contamination is back... No surprises there. No doubt that explains the Mountain King's recent activity.
:{{A|vo jnqlq002 4 trinidad 02.ogg}} '''Trinidad:''' See those torches over there? Those are sacred flame offshoots that we requested from the Stadium of the Sacred Flame. They contain the power of the [[Pyro Archon]].
:{{A|vo jnqlq002 4 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Are you saying that the Sacred Flame and the [[Turnfire]] are the same thing?
:{{A|vo jnqlq002 4 trinidad 03.ogg}} '''Trinidad:''' Heh, for ceremonial purposes, at least. Sending someone to the [[Night Kingdom]] to retrieve the legendary Turnfire isn't exactly an option. More to the point though, the Sacred Flame is able to burn away Abyssal filth, so that's why we use it in the ceremony.
:{{A|vo jnqlq002 4 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Gotcha... So basically, we just need to clean up the filth with the Sacred Flame?
:{{A|vo jnqlq002 4 trinidad 04.ogg}} '''Trinidad:''' That's one part of it, yes. But the complete ceremony is a bit more complicated than that.
:{{A|vo jnqlq002 4 trinidad 05.ogg}} '''Trinidad:''' First, the flame bearer must collect a kindling of the Sacred Flame from the starting point, then use a grappling hook to fly up into the sky and light each of the Sacred Flame Pillars.
:{{A|vo jnqlq002 4 trinidad 06.ogg}} '''Trinidad:''' Then, they must go down into the canyon, all the way to the cave where the Mountain King slumbers, lighting braziers and the final altar along the way.
:{{A|vo jnqlq002 4 trinidad 07.ogg}} '''Trinidad:''' The most skilled flame bearers can accomplish all of this without touching the ground once. As much as I hate to admit it, Kinich is capable of this.
:{{A|vo jnqlq002 4 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wow, he can do all that flying without ever falling to the ground?
:{{DIcon}} So can you, Paimon.
:{{A|vo jnqlq002 4 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Well, of course Paimon can! It'd be much harder for you guys.
:{{A|vo jnqlq002 4 trinidad 08.ogg}} '''Trinidad:''' Haha, well, don't worry — it's not a requirement of the ceremony. You're allowed to touch the ground. The only thing you're not allowed to do is turn back.
:{{A|vo jnqlq002 4 trinidad 09.ogg}} '''Trinidad:''' The flame bearer must always keep moving forward. You can't skip a pillar, then come back to it after lighting the next one. To do so would be to disrespect our ancestors.
:{{A|vo jnqlq002 4 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So... What actually happens if you do turn back? Surely the fires don't just go out?
:{{A|vo jnqlq002 4 trinidad 10.ogg}} '''Trinidad:''' Umm... Well, if you're not careful, you might get burned.
:{{A|vo jnqlq002 4 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What about today, then? Does the same rule apply?
:{{A|vo jnqlq002 4 trinidad 11.ogg}} '''Trinidad:''' Oh no, don't worry. Today is just a practice, the order doesn't matter. You just need to take the sacred flame, cleanse the filth, then go light all the braziers.
:{{A|vo jnqlq002 4 trinidad 12.ogg}} '''Trinidad:''' Are you ready?
:{{DIcon}} Let's begin.
:{{A|vo jnqlq002 4 trinidad 13.ogg}} '''Trinidad:''' I'll repeat the key points again. Gather the kindling, cleanse the filth, and light all the braziers. I'll wait for you at the end.
{{Dialogue End}}

:{{A|vo dialog jnqlq002 trinidad 01.ogg}} '''Trinidad:''' Ready when you are. Oh, and I'll repeat the key points again. Gather the kindling, cleanse the filth, and light all the braziers.

;(After obtaining the Sacred Flame)
:{{A|vo jnqlq002 6 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Alright, let's use this kindling to complete our mission!

;(Approach the Abyssal filth)
:{{A|vo jnqlq002 6 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' There's Abyssal filth over there. Let's burn it away with the Sacred Flame.

;(After all braziers are lit)
:{{A|vo jnqlq002 6 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' That should be all of the braziers. Let's regroup with Trinidad!

;(Talk to Trinidad)
:{{A|vo jnqlq002 7 trinidad 01.ogg}} '''Trinidad:''' I knew I was right about you. You have outperformed all of our previous candidates.
:{{A|vo jnqlq002 7 trinidad 02.ogg}} '''Trinidad:''' If there's was a ancient name for outstanding flame bearers, I'm sure the Wayob would consider you for the honor.
:{{DIcon}} Paimon could probably get the job done, too.
:{{A|vo jnqlq002 7 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yeah! Although, it would probably take Paimon quite a bit longer...
:{{A|vo jnqlq002 7 trinidad 03.ogg}} '''Trinidad:''' Haha. Alright, now there's still a few days left until the ceremony. I should probably get back so I can inform the [[Wayna|chief]] and the other elders that I have found the flame bearer we need.
:{{A|vo jnqlq002 7 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh... You mean, they've still got to sign off on it?
:{{A|vo jnqlq002 7 trinidad 04.ogg}} '''Trinidad:''' Some of them are still hoping we can come to an agreement with Kinich. But that's only because they haven't seen you in action.
:{{A|vo jnqlq002 7 trinidad 05.ogg}} '''Trinidad:''' Still, I'm the one responsible for securing a flame bearer, and my recommendation is you.
:{{A|vo jnqlq002 7 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' ...Just for Paimon's own peace of mind, are you sure it's not gonna be a problem having outlanders take on such an important role in your ceremony?
:{{A|vo jnqlq002 7 trinidad 06.ogg}} '''Trinidad:''' See that place over there? There was a time, long before the age of Burkina and the Mountain King, when we Scions of the Canopy called that our home.
:;(Camera view changes to show the [[Ancestral Temple]])
:{{A|vo jnqlq002 7 trinidad 07.ogg}} '''Trinidad:''' After a period of upheaval, our ancestors were forced to move away. Now, it has become a place where our youths go to develop courage and kindle a spirit of adventure.
:{{A|vo jnqlq002 7 trinidad 08.ogg}} '''Trinidad:''' If we fail to keep the threat posed by the Mountain King at bay, it might not be long before we have to move again, and find a new home...
:{{A|vo jnqlq002 7 trinidad 09.ogg}} '''Trinidad:''' So, to answer your question, I think everyone will agree that you are the right choice.
:{{A|vo jnqlq002 7 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Fair enough. Desperate times call for desperate measures...
:{{A|vo jnqlq002 7 trinidad 10.ogg}} '''Trinidad:''' I'll need you to drop by my place at some point before the ceremony, if that's alright. There are still a few final details that we need to discuss.
:{{A|vo jnqlq002 7 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Okay, see you later then!
:{{A|vo jnqlq002 7 trinidad 11.ogg}} '''Trinidad:''' You have my gratitude.
:;(Trinidad leaves)
:{{A|vo jnqlq002 7 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' We've helped out with a lot of other local festivals before, but this one feels a little different... Anyway, let's take a break before heading back to Trinidad's place.
:;(Camera pans to show Kinich nearby, watching the Traveler and Paimon)
{{Dialogue End}}

:{{A|vo jyeq004b 1 lisa 01.ogg}} '''Lisa:''' Wow, I have to hand it to you, cuties. I never imagined that you'd be able to bring in so much Mora in such a short amount of time...

* During steps 4 and 9, the player enters a [[Special Story Mode]].
* During steps 4 and 8-9, the party is limited to [[Lohen]] as a [[Trial Character]].
* During the stealth challenge in step 4:
** Lohen's special Elemental Burst has a much shorter range than his Elemental Skill.
** If the player fails to defeat the first 16 enemies, the challenge will reset to the beginning.
** If the player fails to defeat the final 3 enemies, the challenge will reset to the final three.
* During step 8-9, if Lohen receives lethal damage, he will instead remain at 1 HP. 
** During step 8, a single healing orb will drop for Waves 2 and 3.
** During step 9, after breaking out of Rerir's stun attack, Lohen will automatically enter [[Unforeseen Strike|Masterstroke]] mode.<!-- not permanently --> Additionally, for the rest of the fight, he will recover a little HP whenever he lands a hit.
