;(Approach [[Kaeya]] near the [[Anemo Archon Statue]] in Mondstadt)
:{{A|vo lelq001 1 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh? It's not a holiday or anything, is it? Why's it so lively in here?
:{{A|vo lelq001 1 kaeya 01.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' ...Prepare a few more strings of colored flags. As for the celebratory wine... I'll do the quality check in person.
:{{A|vo lelq001 1 kaeya 02.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' This is our first award ceremony since the expeditionary force's triumphant return. We're looking to put on a show, you hear?
:{{A|vo lelq001 1 raymond 01.ogg}} '''Raymond:''' Leave it to us, Captain Kaeya!
:{{DIcon}} An award ceremony?
:{{A|vo lelq001 1 kaeya 03.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' Oh? The Honorary Knight and Paimon? Well, this saves me the trouble of sending someone to invite you.
:{{A|vo lelq001 1 kaeya 04.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' I'm sure our colleagues from the expedition will be delighted to see such prestigious guests in attendance.
:{{A|vo lelq001 1 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' The Knights are giving out awards?
:{{A|vo lelq001 1 kaeya 05.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' Well, I'm sure you know how many Knights bear unique titles, yes?
:{{A|vo lelq001 1 kaeya 06.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' Take the [[Varka|Grand Master]]'s "Boreas" or Captain [[Eula]]'s "Spindrift," for example... Some they inherit. Others have unique origins...
:{{A|vo lelq001 1 kaeya 07.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' But in the vast majority of cases, they are titles conferred to honor said knight's conduct and achievements.
:{{DIcon}} Like how I'm the "Honorary" Knight?
:{{A|vo lelq001 1 kaeya 08.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' Hmm... You could say that! Shame we were so busy with the issue of [[Dvalin]]'s corruption back then, or we'd have held a ceremony for you, too... Let me think. Why don't we make it up to you this time?
:{{DIcon}} It's fine, it's been so long, anyway.
:{{A|vo lelq001 1 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Besides, isn't this ceremony meant for the knights who're back from the expedition in triumph? We wouldn't want to steal their thunder!
:{{A|vo lelq001 1 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Plus, being honored guests is way more impressive than actually receiving a title! Y'know, makes us sound like big shots!
:{{DIcon}} You might actually have a point there...
:{{A|vo lelq001 1 kaeya 09.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' Is that so? In that case, I'm looking forward to seeing you at the ceremony.
:{{A|vo lelq001 1 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' By the way, who's getting titles this time around?
:{{A|vo lelq001 1 kaeya 10.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' Mostly those who've made outstanding contributions during the expedition: [[Winfried]], [[Leifhelm]]...
:{{A|vo lelq001 1 kaeya 11.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' And [[Lohen]], Vice Captain of the 5th Company.
:{{A|vo lelq001 1 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wait. Him? You mean he doesn't have one yet?
:{{A|vo lelq001 1 kaeya 12.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' If it were just a question of personal ability, he'd have received a title before the expedition even started.
:{{A|vo lelq001 1 kaeya 13.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' But he hasn't been with us for very long, and... Well, let's just say there are personal reasons for the delay.
:{{A|vo lelq001 1 kaeya 14.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' Word is that he'll not only gain a title, but also official command over 5th Company.
:{{A|vo lelq001 1 kaeya 15.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' Why, by my count, he's even set to break a certain someone's record.
:{{DIcon}} Whose record?
:{{DIcon}} What record?
:{{A|vo lelq001 1 kaeya 16.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' "The youngest Captain of the Knights of Favonius," of course... The previous record holder was our former Cavalry Captain, [[Diluc]].
:{{A|vo lelq001 1 kaeya 17.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' Hehe. I wonder what face our "former Captain" will make when that happens.
:{{DIcon}} I'm guessing he won't make any face.
:{{A|vo lelq001 1 kaeya 18.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' Ah, ah, I wouldn't be so sure. He smiled oh-so-brilliantly the day he set that record...
:{{A|vo lelq001 1 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' A smiling champion of justice, huh...? Yeah, nah, Paimon can't see it...
:{{A|vo lelq001 1 kaeya 19.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' Well, let's not dwell on that. Care to guess what title our dear Vice-Captain Lohen will receive?
:{{DIcon}} Oh, we're playing name games, are we?
:{{DIcon}} You're up, Paimon!
:{{A|vo lelq001 1 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Gotcha, easy! So, Lohen... Lohen... "Dagger Knight"? "Smirking Knight"? Uh... Right! "Punching Bag Knight"!
:{{DIcon}} Your skills are fading, Paimon...
:{{A|vo lelq001 1 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Nuh-uh! This guy's just... hard to sum up! Anyway. What's his title gonna be?
:{{A|vo lelq001 1 kaeya 20.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' Hmm, I'd say most signs right now point to...
:{{A|vo lelq001 1 kaeya 21.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' —"The Benevolent Knight."
:{{A|vo lelq001 1 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' ...Benevolent?
:{{A|vo lelq001 1 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' How's that even slightly associated with him!?
:{{A|vo lelq001 1 kaeya 22.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' Haha... Long story. Alas, it seems someone has come looking for you.
:{{A|vo lelq001 1 porthos 01.ogg}} '''Porthos:''' Honorary Knight! Honorary Knight! Thank goodness, you're actually here.
:{{DIcon}} Is there something you need from me?
:{{A|vo lelq001 1 porthos 02.ogg}} '''Porthos:''' Uhm... The Grand Master would like you to come to the Knights of Favonius Headquarters. He says he has important matters to discuss!
:{{A|vo lelq001 1 paimon 12.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' [[Varka]]? What important business would he have with us?
:{{DIcon}} Looking for an excuse to slack off, maybe...
:{{DIcon}} Maybe he wants to sneak out for a drink...
:{{A|vo lelq001 1 paimon 13.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Paimon can't say she'd be surprised... But it's not like he's never serious, so maybe something really has come up...
:{{DIcon}} Let's go see him, just in case...
:{{DIcon}} Talk to you later, Kaeya.
:{{A|vo lelq001 1 kaeya 23.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' See you later — remember to attend the ceremony!

;(Talk to Kaeya, optional)
:{{A|vo dialog lelq001 kaeya 01.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' Yes, yes. Quality control for our drinks... That'll require a personal touch.

;(Enter the Knights of Favonius headquarters)
:{{A|vo lelq001 2 varka 01.ogg}} '''Varka:''' ...Any questions about the award ceremony arrangements? Perhaps... Are you even listening?
:{{A|vo lelq001 2 lohen 01.ogg}} '''Lohen:''' Mm-hmm, okay. No objections.
:{{A|vo lelq001 2 varka 02.ogg}} '''Varka:''' ...*cough* Lohen!
:{{A|vo lelq001 2 lohen 02.ogg}} '''Lohen:''' Huh... Yeah. Can I go now? Thanks a lot, Grand Master!
:{{A|vo lelq001 2 varka 03.ogg}} '''Varka:''' —Hey! Get back here!
:{{A|vo lelq001 2 varka 04.ogg}} '''Varka:''' *sigh*... What is it with you young people these days? When I first earned my title, I was so excited I couldn't sleep a wink all night...
:{{A|vo lelq001 2 lohen 03.ogg}} '''Lohen:''' Huh? Oh? And how many barrels of wine did you guzzle while counting sheep?
:{{A|vo lelq001 2 varka 05.ogg}} '''Varka:''' ...That's not the point!
:{{A|vo lelq001 2 varka 06.ogg}} '''Varka:''' *sigh*... Forget it. I know you're not interested in a knightly title — or the position of Captain.
:{{A|vo lelq001 2 varka 07.ogg}} '''Varka:''' But it's [[Adorno]]'s final wish to have you inherit the title of Benevolent Knight before he officially retires.
:{{A|vo lelq001 2 lohen 04.ogg}} '''Lohen:''' ...
:{{A|vo lelq001 2 varka 08.ogg}} '''Varka:''' You've been back in Mondstadt for a while now, and you're usually stationed at [[Dornman Port]]... Have you not thought about going to see him?
:{{A|vo lelq001 2 lohen 05.ogg}} '''Lohen:''' ...Hey, there have been too many reports to file since our return from the expedition. I haven't been able to find the time.
:{{A|vo lelq001 2 varka 09.ogg}} '''Varka:''' Oh? Odd that the handwriting on the reports you've submitted looks rather like [[Gunther]]'s, wouldn't you say?
:{{A|vo lelq001 2 lohen 06.ogg}} '''Lohen:''' Ugh... Can't even handle a little "paperwork"... He still needs more training.
:{{A|vo lelq001 2 varka 10.ogg}} '''Varka:''' Anyway — go have a good talk with Adorno. We'd like a smooth transition for both the title and the position of Captain.
:{{A|vo lelq001 2 varka 11.ogg}} '''Varka:''' Consider this a direct order from yours truly, the Grand Master, so don't go using work as an excuse, you hear?
:{{A|vo lelq001 2 lohen 07.ogg}} '''Lohen:''' *sigh*
:{{A|vo lelq001 2 varka 12.ogg}} '''Varka:''' Eh, don't look so worried. I've a rough idea of the agreement you two made before the expedition. If you need someone to cover for you...
:{{A|vo lelq001 2 varka 13.ogg}} '''Varka:''' ...I mean, considering Adorno's special circumstances, I can make an exception and go with you.
:{{A|vo lelq001 2 lohen 08.ogg}} '''Lohen:''' ...Uh, forget it. You two've worked together for so long, he'd see right through you with a glance.
:{{A|vo lelq001 2 varka 14.ogg}} '''Varka:''' *sigh* True... And besides, I've got other matters to attend to... Is there anyone else you can take?
:{{A|vo lelq001 2 varka 15.ogg}} '''Varka:''' Someone convincing, but not too close to Adorno... Do we have such a knight here in Mondstadt?
:{{A|vo lelq001 2 lohen 09.ogg}} '''Lohen:''' Hah, that "knight" you speak of... has just arrived.
:{{DIcon}} So, is that why you borrowed Varka's name...
:{{DIcon}} ...to summon us here?
:{{A|vo lelq001 2 lohen 10.ogg}} '''Lohen:''' I was troubled, troubled, I tell you, but then I just happened to see you two walking by from the window. This must be the [[Anemo Archon]]'s guidance, don't you think?
:{{A|vo lelq001 2 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Not at all! Paimon's not sure what's going on yet, but you just want us to help you scam someone, don't you?
:{{A|vo lelq001 2 lohen 11.ogg}} '''Lohen:''' Oh no, no, no, no, no, not at all! Honesty is a knight's badge of virtue. I'd just like you to "play the part" of my "friends."
:{{A|vo lelq001 2 lohen 12.ogg}} '''Lohen:''' ...And corroborate some of the expedition's events while you're at it. Relax. If I say a single lie... feel free to punch me, alright?
:{{A|vo lelq001 2 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wait. There's a ton of problems with that! We didn't even meet up with Varka until the very end of the expedition, and we didn't run into you in Nod-Krai, either...
:{{A|vo lelq001 2 lohen 13.ogg}} '''Lohen:''' Ah, right. Speaking of "friends," I've heard tell of a certain "friendly custom"...
:{{A|vo lelq001 2 lohen 14.ogg}} '''Lohen:''' —The "friendship fee." Here. I insist.
:{{DIcon}} What kind of custom is that!?
:{{DIcon}} What kind of friend are you talking about!?
:{{A|vo lelq001 2 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' ...Th—That's a lot of friendship!
:{{A|vo lelq001 2 lohen 15.ogg}} '''Lohen:''' I receive an allowance for special missions. Guess it all piled up before I knew it. I don't really have any use for so much money, so... why not give it to a friend?
:{{A|vo lelq001 2 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Y'know... We could always do with another friend... don't you think?
:{{DIcon}} What about those problems you mentioned!?
:{{A|vo lelq001 2 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' P—Problems are meant to be solved! F—For the sake of friends...!
:{{DIcon}} Setting aside whether we're doing this for a friend or a friendship fee...
:{{DIcon}} I'm starting to wonder who this Adorno is.
:{{A|vo lelq001 2 lohen 16.ogg}} '''Lohen:''' ...Adorno the Benevolent Knight. Captain of the 5th Company, and my direct superior.
:{{A|vo lelq001 2 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Benevolent Knight... Wasn't that...
:{{A|vo lelq001 2 lohen 17.ogg}} '''Lohen:''' The knightly title I'm about to inherit? It seems that's the rumor. But in truth, he and I made a pact...
:{{A|vo lelq001 2 lohen 18.ogg}} '''Lohen:''' In return for recommending me for the expedition, he hoped I, in turn, would reflect on what it truly means to be a virtuous knight while I was away.
:{{A|vo lelq001 2 lohen 19.ogg}} '''Lohen:''' Once it was all over, I'd then inherit the title Benevolent Knight from him... as well as the position of Captain.
:{{A|vo lelq001 2 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Uhm, wait, does that mean... You aren't confident you can get his approval, and that's why you want us to go along with your little show?
:{{A|vo lelq001 2 lohen 20.ogg}} '''Lohen:''' Don't get me wrong — I have no interest in titles or positions. I'd just... rather not listen to his nagging.
:{{DIcon}} ...Did he not join the expedition himself?
:{{A|vo lelq001 2 lohen 21.ogg}} '''Lohen:''' Oh, he'd have loved to. He's a real veteran of Varka's campaigns. Wouldn't have missed that show for the world...
:{{A|vo lelq001 2 lohen 22.ogg}} '''Lohen:''' ...If age and strength were still on his side. But I imagine it is now his final wish to find the "Benevolent" title a home.
:{{A|vo lelq001 2 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Is that so? Then we'll...
:{{DIcon}} ...Got it. I'll tag along for the ride.
:{{A|vo lelq001 2 lohen 23.ogg}} '''Lohen:''' Haha! I knew that would do the trick. Off we go, then — to Dornman Port.
:{{A|vo lelq001 2 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hey! How much of what you just said was true, huh? You sure you're not out to scam this Adorno guy?
:{{Color|menu|You and Lohen take your leave. After you've gone, Varka is left brooding over a letter...}}
:{{A|vo lelq001 2 varka 16.ogg}} '''Varka:''' "The [[Truth Amongst the Pages of Purana|situation in Sumeru]] is as described above... It is time to eliminate the remaining poison [[Dottore]] has left in Mondstadt."
:{{A|vo lelq001 2 varka 17.ogg}} '''Varka:''' *sigh*... [[Eroch]]... [[Ursa]]... It's been a while since I last heard those names. I can feel a headache coming on...
:;(Obtain {{Item|Lohen's "Friendship Fee"}})

;(Approach Adorno in Dornman Port)
:{{A|vo lelq001 3 lohen 01.ogg}} '''Lohen:''' Hey, old man! Still kicking, I see?
:{{A|vo lelq001 3 adorno 01.ogg}} '''Adorno:''' Heh. Didn't buy the farm during the expedition? Thought you might've fallen into some pit somewhere, what with how long it's taken you to come see me.
:{{A|vo lelq001 3 lohen 02.ogg}} '''Lohen:''' Ah, you worry too much. When it comes to pits, I've been the one doing all the digging and burying.
:{{DIcon}} ...That's a novel way to say hello...
:{{A|vo lelq001 3 adorno 02.ogg}} '''Adorno:''' Who are these two?
:{{A|vo lelq001 3 lohen 03a.ogg}} {{A|vo lelq001 3 lohen 03b.ogg}} '''Lohen:''' My friend — the "Honorary Knight" — and {{MC|m=his|f=her}} guide, Paimon.
:{{A|vo lelq001 3 adorno 03.ogg}} '''Adorno:''' "Honorary Knight"... The same one that resolved the [[Stormterror]] incident...
:{{DIcon}} In the flesh, sir.
:{{DIcon}} That's me!
:{{A|vo lelq001 3 lohen 04a.ogg}} {{A|vo lelq001 3 lohen 04b.ogg}} '''Lohen:''' Oh, {{MC|m=he|f=she}} didn't just resolve that incident — {{MC|m=he|f=she}} helped us complete the expedition. [[The Wild Hunt]], [[The Doctor]], [[To Those Who Embark on the Expedition|Andrius]]... {{MC|m=He|f=She}} played a part in dealing with all of them.
:{{A|vo lelq001 3 adorno 04.ogg}} '''Adorno:''' Oh? I've quizzed the knights at Dornman Port about what happened during the expedition.
:{{A|vo lelq001 3 adorno 05.ogg}} '''Adorno:''' Unfortunately, for some reason, none of them were willing to tell me the whole story... It's almost as if someone told them to avoid me.
:;(Lohen smiles to himself)
:{{A|vo lelq001 3 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' (Lohen... was that your doing?)
:{{A|vo lelq001 3 adorno 06.ogg}} '''Adorno:''' Since we've got a moment, let's have a proper chat. How did this magnificent knight here end up making friends with you?
:{{A|vo lelq001 3 lohen 05.ogg}} '''Lohen:''' Hmm, I suppose it's because we both possess a "chivalric spirit" that shines as bright as Mora. Isn't that right, Paimon?
:{{A|vo lelq001 3 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yeah... Just like Mora, haha...
:{{A|vo lelq001 3 lohen 06.ogg}} '''Lohen:''' I've been keeping my promise to you, you know. For instance...
:{{A|vo lelq001 3 lohen 07.ogg}} '''Lohen:''' I've been organizing group training sessions with my fellow knights every week to build ironclad trust between "friends"...
:{{A|vo lelq001 3 adorno 07.ogg}} '''Adorno:''' Oh, right, the team building I told you about! Great way to foster trust and chemistry.
:{{Color|menu|Lohen recounts the "group training" he conducted in detail, though with some delicacy...}}
:{{A|vo lelq001 3 lohen 08.ogg}} '''Lohen:''' Hmm... As for this week's "training plan"...
:{{DIcon}} (Drugging the wine one night in advance...)
:{{A|vo lelq001 3 edgar 01.ogg}} '''Leifhelm:''' Ugh... My stomach... My stomach!
:{{DIcon}} (Secretly swapping a teammate's ammo...)
:{{A|vo lelq001 3 winfried 01.ogg}} '''Winfried:''' What sorcery is this!? Huh? What do you mean, "there are no bullets in your gun"...
:{{DIcon}} (Digging traps at the training grounds...)
:{{A|vo lelq001 3 ekbert 01.ogg}} '''Ekbert:''' Surely the Vice-Captain can't take us all out if we swarm him at once? C'mon, let's get him— Aaah!
:{{A|vo lelq001 3 lohen 09.ogg}} '''Lohen:''' *scoff* Real combat's ten times harder than training, and the enemy's a hundred times more cunning than I am.
:{{A|vo lelq001 3 lohen 10.ogg}} '''Lohen:''' Remember this well. Once you're on the battlefield, the only one you can truly "trust" is yourself!
:{{A|vo lelq001 3 lohen 11.ogg}} '''Lohen:''' And so, to ensure the absolute safety of my "friends," I went out every night, eliminating potential threats around our stronghold...
:{{A|vo lelq001 3 adorno 08.ogg}} '''Adorno:''' Hmm... Vigilance and reconnaissance are indeed things a Company Captain needs to pay attention to...
:{{Color|menu|Lohen recounts his "patrol methods" in detail, though with some delicacy...}}

:{{A|vo lelq001 5 lohen 02.ogg}} '''Lohen:''' Of course, in order to gather intel for the expeditionary force, I also needed to maintain my "connections" at all times... and communicate earnestly with my friends...
:{{A|vo lelq001 5 adorno 01.ogg}} '''Adorno:''' Haha, I didn't expect you to have matured so much from one trip...
:{{Color|menu|Lohen recounts his methods of gathering intelligence in detail, though with some delicacy...}}

:{{DIcon}} (Sprinkle it all on!)

:{{DIcon}} (Salt.)
:{{DIcon}} (Pepper.)

:{{A|vo lelq001 5 lohen 10.ogg}} '''Lohen:''' See, you two? I didn't lie, did I?
:{{DIcon}} You, uh... didn't... somehow...
:{{A|vo lelq001 5 lohen 11.ogg}} '''Lohen:''' And that's the story, old man. Now pass on that Benevolent Knight title... thing, and get some well-deserved rest, alright?
:{{A|vo lelq001 5 adorno 02.ogg}} '''Adorno:''' Hey now, we aren't finished talking yet, are we? Word is that you faced a truly formidable foe while in Nod-Krai...
:{{A|vo lelq001 5 adorno 03.ogg}} '''Adorno:''' Someone called... the [[Rächer of Solnari]], I believe?
:'''Lohen:''' ...!
:{{A|vo lelq001 5 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Whoa, really!? Why haven't we heard you and Varka talk about that?
:{{A|vo lelq001 5 lohen 12.ogg}} '''Lohen:''' ...Ha, there's nothing to tell...
:{{A|vo lelq001 5 lohen 13.ogg}} '''Lohen:''' ...I was with the Grand Master when we ambushed Rerir. But not only was I useless, I even ended up acting as a punching bag.
:{{A|vo lelq001 5 lohen 14.ogg}} '''Lohen:''' That left me laid up in camp for several days. By the time I could finally get out of bed, I heard the news... that you had all joined forces to banish him.
:{{A|vo lelq001 5 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, so that's why Paimon didn't see you when we were duking it out with Rerir... It's not like you to miss a fight...
:{{DIcon}} Paimon...
:{{A|vo lelq001 5 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh! Sorry...
:{{A|vo lelq001 5 lohen 15.ogg}} '''Lohen:''' No need to apologize. You're right. I wasn't strong enough...
:{{Color|menu|Lohen recalls "the past"...}}
:{{A|vo lelq001 5 together 01.ogg}} '''Lohen:''' I was slow, weak, powerless... mortal.
:;(Lohen hears the word "mortal" in Rerir's voice)
:{{A|vo lelq001 5 varka 01.ogg}} '''Varka:''' Lohen! Lohen... Hey! You! Take him and fall back!
:{{DIcon}} He was a [[Sinner]] who once set his face against the world...
:{{DIcon}} He wields [[Abyss]]al powers far beyond our imagination.
:{{A|vo lelq001 5 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yeah! In the end, we had to use his power against him just to banish him... So don't worry about it too much!
:{{A|vo lelq001 5 lohen 16.ogg}} '''Lohen:''' ...But he was once a mere mortal too, wasn't he?
:{{DIcon}} ...
:{{A|vo lelq001 5 adorno 04.ogg}} '''Adorno:''' Ahem. Well, I haven't seen this Rächer of Solnari with my own eyes, but I believe that strength alone does not a "knight" make.
:{{A|vo lelq001 5 adorno 05.ogg}} '''Adorno:''' Anyway, I've got some important work to attend to. You and your friends can come along if you'd like, Lohen.
:{{A|vo lelq001 5 lohen 17.ogg}} '''Lohen:''' Important work? Aren't you already semi-retired?
:{{A|vo lelq001 5 adorno 06.ogg}} '''Adorno:''' Hah, just follow me and you'll see. Consider this required reading for any "Benevolent Knight."

:{{A|vo lelq001 6 moricztill 01.ogg}} '''Moricztill:''' Grandpa Adorno!

:'''Northland Cat:''' Meow~
:{{A|vo lelq001 6 hannelore 01.ogg}} '''Hannelore:''' Hey now — no rushing, and no snatching! Easy now. Line up properly!
:{{A|vo lelq001 6 adorno 01.ogg}} '''Adorno:''' Eh, it's alright, it's alright. They're just kids. A little excitement is a good thing. Here you go. Today's candy.
:{{A|vo lelq001 6 moricztill 02.ogg}} '''Moricztill:''' Thanks, Grandpa!
:{{A|vo lelq001 6 max 02.ogg}} '''Max:''' Ooh, this is great!
:{{A|vo lelq001 6 lohen 01.ogg}} '''Lohen:''' ...Is this the "important work" you spoke of?
:{{A|vo lelq001 6 adorno 02.ogg}} '''Adorno:''' Oh, we're just getting started, "recruit." Try to keep up!
:{{A|vo lelq001 6 lohen 02.ogg}} '''Lohen:''' ...Understood, Captain.
:;(Lohen's energy steadily drops as he sweeps up, feeds some dogs, retrieves a lost cat, and deals with a throng of children)
:{{Color|menu|Exhausted after attending to one task after another, Lohen slumps onto a bench...}}
:{{A|vo lelq001 6 lohen 03.ogg}} '''Lohen:''' Ugh...
:{{DIcon}} ...Are you alright?
:{{DIcon}} I've never seen you this exhausted, even after a fight.
:{{A|vo lelq001 6 lohen 04.ogg}} '''Lohen:''' I should be the one asking you — how are you so skilled at this?
:{{DIcon}} You get used to it.
:{{DIcon}} Such is the life of an adventurer.
:{{A|vo lelq001 6 lohen 05.ogg}} '''Lohen:''' I can barely imagine our Honorary Knight doing things like this all day long...
:{{A|vo lelq001 6 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' We don't spend every waking hour fighting bad guys who wanna destroy the world, y'know... Also, the world would be a way scarier place if that happened every day!
:{{DIcon}} You seem a bit disappointed...
:{{DIcon}} But this is our actual daily routine.
:{{A|vo lelq001 6 lohen 06.ogg}} '''Lohen:''' Daily routine, huh... I've been back in Mondstadt for a while now, but adapting... hasn't been easy.
:{{A|vo lelq001 6 lohen 07.ogg}} '''Lohen:''' Not long ago, camping in the wild and facing constant danger was our "daily routine."
:{{A|vo lelq001 6 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' But you were still on the expedition then, right? Now you can finally relax!
:{{A|vo lelq001 6 lohen 08.ogg}} '''Lohen:''' You think so? Personally, I find it hard to feel at ease with any sort of "daily routine."
:{{A|vo lelq001 6 lohen 09.ogg}} '''Lohen:''' It was the Anemo Archon who scattered the snowstorms that once swept Mondstadt, the Knights of Favonius who won the peace we now enjoy through conquest. A single unexpected incident could bring it all crashing down.
:{{A|vo lelq001 6 lohen 10.ogg}} '''Lohen:''' So... rather than waiting for someone to turn my "daily routine" on its head, I find it more reassuring to follow an "extraordinary routine."
:{{DIcon}} ...
:{{A|vo lelq001 6 adorno 03.ogg}} '''Adorno:''' We Knights are needed precisely because the world is so fragile.
:{{A|vo lelq001 6 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, are you done handing out the candy already?
:{{A|vo lelq001 6 adorno 04.ogg}} '''Adorno:''' Indeed. Looks like you're all wrapped up here as well. Thanks for exercising such patience.
:{{A|vo lelq001 6 adorno 05.ogg}} '''Adorno:''' This next task should give you a chance to stretch your legs. We're going to patrol the surrounding area for monsters.
:{{A|vo lelq001 6 lohen 11.ogg}} '''Lohen:''' Monsters? What, are the Knights shorthanded? You haven't held a sword in years.
:{{A|vo lelq001 6 adorno 06.ogg}} '''Adorno:''' Hey now, my retirement isn't official yet! It's just a patrol. I'm still more than capable of handling myself.
:{{A|vo lelq001 6 adorno 07.ogg}} '''Adorno:''' Things did get a bit tough a while back... but look at me now, eh? Might as well get going while I've still got pep in my step.
:{{A|vo lelq001 6 lohen 12.ogg}} '''Lohen:''' Never one to sit still, were you... Fine. Where are we headed?
:{{A|vo lelq001 6 adorno 08.ogg}} '''Adorno:''' We've had strange monsters show up around the outskirts. No one's gotten hurt yet, but you can never be too careful.
:{{A|vo lelq001 6 adorno 09.ogg}} '''Adorno:''' Usually, I just patrol the area for any approaching monsters, but this time, I've got you for backup.
:{{A|vo lelq001 6 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Heh! Forget about just patrolling — we can take them all on, no problem! Right?
:{{DIcon}} Piece of cake.
:{{A|vo lelq001 6 lohen 13.ogg}} '''Lohen:''' ...Sure. Let's go.
:{{A|vo lelq001 6 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh? That's weird... Paimon thought he'd be more excited...
:{{DIcon}} Were you expecting a "Let me try my blade with you," or something?
:{{DIcon}} Or perhaps "Another test subject"?
:{{A|vo lelq001 6 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Well, uh... Why not? *sigh* Paimon doesn't get him at all...

;(Approach the marked location)
:{{A|vo lelq001 7 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Weird, no signs of anything unusual here... Are there really monsters nearby?
:{{A|vo lelq001 7 diluc 01.ogg}} '''???:''' If you're looking for the ones that have been behaving strangely, I fear you're here too late.
:{{A|vo lelq001 7 diluc 02.ogg}} '''Diluc:''' It seems someone beat the Knights of Favonius to the punch and took care of them already.
:{{A|vo lelq001 7 adorno 01.ogg}} '''Adorno:''' [[Diluc]]? What are you doing here?
:{{A|vo lelq001 7 diluc 03.ogg}} '''Diluc:''' Long time no see, Mr. Adorno. You too, {{Traveler}}, Paimon... Lohen.
:{{A|vo lelq001 7 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Uhm... Were the monsters here wiped out by a certain [[Darknight Hero]] by any chance?
:{{A|vo lelq001 7 diluc 04.ogg}} '''Diluc:''' No.
:{{DIcon}} Are you sure?
:{{A|vo lelq001 7 diluc 05.ogg}} '''Diluc:''' ...I'm not personally familiar with this "Darknight Hero" you speak of, but based on the rumors I've heard, the traces left on this battlefield don't match his style.
:{{A|vo lelq001 7 diluc 06.ogg}} '''Diluc:''' This looks more like someone... obtained advance intel on the monsters and came to "clean up." Not even a single scrap remains.
:{{A|vo lelq001 7 lohen 01.ogg}} '''Lohen:''' Oh? So it would appear you're here to investigate, Master Diluc? That's odd. Why would the boss of the [[Dawn Winery]] be interested in monsters?
:{{A|vo lelq001 7 diluc 07.ogg}} '''Diluc:''' Dawn Winery's caravans pass through Dornman Port. The rumors left me ill at ease, so I decided to see for myself.
:{{A|vo lelq001 7 diluc 08.ogg}} '''Diluc:''' As for the Knights of Favonius... are they still understaffed even with the expedition's return?
:{{A|vo lelq001 7 adorno 02.ogg}} '''Adorno:''' Hah, strict as ever, I see. I took this patrol up myself — gotta keep moving while I still can.
:{{A|vo lelq001 7 adorno 03.ogg}} '''Adorno:''' I've been living this life for decades. Can't just sit idle, you know?
:{{A|vo lelq001 7 diluc 09.ogg}} '''Diluc:''' ...Thank you for your hard work, venerable Benevolent Knight.
:{{A|vo lelq001 7 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' ...Wait, what? Not even Varka gets that much respect from Diluc!
:{{A|vo lelq001 7 lohen 02.ogg}} '''Lohen:''' Heh. I'd say that's Varka's problem.
:{{A|vo lelq001 7 adorno 04.ogg}} '''Adorno:''' *sigh* Eroch only got away with causing that uproar by taking advantage of the Grand Master's absence.
:{{A|vo lelq001 7 adorno 05.ogg}} '''Adorno:''' If he and the [[Alder Knight]] had been here, they never would have allowed [[Crepus]]'s heroism in driving off the dragon to go unrecognized.
:{{A|vo lelq001 7 adorno 06.ogg}} '''Adorno:''' ...And we old codgers back in Mondstadt wouldn't have been the only ones left to stand up for your father.
:{{A|vo lelq001 7 diluc 10.ogg}} '''Diluc:''' ...But they weren't there, were they?
:{{A|vo lelq001 7 diluc 11.ogg}} '''Diluc:''' Let's cut the small talk. Since there are no clues here, I have no reason to stay. Goodbye, {{Traveler}}, Paimon.
:{{A|vo lelq001 7 diluc 12.ogg}} '''Diluc:''' And... take care, "Benevolent Knight."
:{{A|vo lelq001 7 adorno 07.ogg}} '''Adorno:''' *sigh* Ursa... Eroch... Even when gone, some foes leave wounds that won't easily heal.
:{{DIcon}} Ursa?
:{{DIcon}} Eroch?
:{{A|vo lelq001 7 adorno 08.ogg}} '''Adorno:''' ...
:{{A|vo lelq001 7 lohen 03.ogg}} '''Lohen:''' Hmm? Need me to explain? Sure. Ursa was a wicked dragon who could really take a beating, and Eroch was an Inspector who could've really used one...
:{{A|vo lelq001 7 adorno 09.ogg}} '''Adorno:''' *cough* ...Allow me instead. Ursa the Drake was a dragon who first appeared in Mondstadt a thousand years ago, bringing calamity with its immense might.
:{{A|vo lelq001 7 adorno 10.ogg}} '''Adorno:''' After the Knights of Favonius were founded, our first Grand Master, [[Vennessa]], sealed it away with the Anemo Archon's help. After that, the dragon sank into slumber...
:{{A|vo lelq001 7 adorno 11.ogg}} '''Adorno:''' However, just a decade ago, it appeared in Mondstadt once again!
:{{A|vo lelq001 7 adorno 12.ogg}} '''Adorno:''' With the Grand Master away, its timing could not have been worse. Not only that, it would lie low when the Knights of Favonius mobilized to attack, only to suddenly reemerge when they were resting...
:{{A|vo lelq001 7 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Such perfect timing!?
:{{A|vo lelq001 7 lohen 04.ogg}} '''Lohen:''' In the end, it was also "perfect timing" that the [[Fatui Harbinger]] who exterminated it just so happened to be "passing through."
:{{DIcon}} A Fatui... Harbinger?
:{{DIcon}} You don't mean...
:{{A|vo lelq001 7 lohen 05.ogg}} '''Lohen:''' That's right, your old friend — The Doctor. Or would it be more accurate to say one of his Segments?
:{{A|vo lelq001 7 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So, Ursa the Drake waking up... it was all part of some plot by that Segment?
:{{A|vo lelq001 7 adorno 13.ogg}} '''Adorno:''' Not entirely. Even a Fatui Harbinger would've struggled to stir up such a storm in Mondstadt all by themselves.
:{{DIcon}} So, there was someone else pulling the strings?
:{{A|vo lelq001 7 adorno 14.ogg}} '''Adorno:''' Indeed. There was one other person who, seduced by transcendent power, secretly colluded with The Doctor...
:{{A|vo lelq001 7 adorno 15.ogg}} '''Adorno:''' He was the then-Inspector of the Knights of Favonius, and the greatest traitor to the Knights in a hundred years — Eroch.
:{{DIcon}} The former Inspector of the Knights...
:{{DIcon}} So what's his relationship with Diluc?
:{{A|vo lelq001 7 adorno 16.ogg}} '''Adorno:''' ...When Diluc had just come of age, Ursa attacked a trade caravan from the Dawn Winery.
:{{A|vo lelq001 7 adorno 17.ogg}} '''Adorno:''' It should've been nothing more than a common raid, a tactic they commonly used to incite fear.
:{{A|vo lelq001 7 adorno 18.ogg}} '''Adorno:''' But the swaggering dragon was driven back by a mere merchant — Diluc's father, Crepus... who paid the ultimate price.
:{{A|vo lelq001 7 adorno 19.ogg}} '''Adorno:''' News of this defeat did not favor Eroch's plan to seize power through terror, so he suppressed the truth, claiming he was doing so to "maintain the honor of the Knights."
:{{A|vo lelq001 7 adorno 20.ogg}} '''Adorno:''' If only I had discovered a moment sooner that he and The Doctor were working hand in glove... perhaps I could have stopped everything that followed.
:{{A|vo lelq001 7 lohen 06.ogg}} '''Lohen:''' That's not your burden to shoulder alone. Eroch hid his true colors well — up until the incident with Ursa.
:{{A|vo lelq001 7 lohen 07.ogg}} '''Lohen:''' ...Even his victims had no idea who was responsible for their suffering.
:{{A|vo lelq001 7 adorno 21.ogg}} '''Adorno:''' *sigh*
:{{DIcon}} They may have got away with it for a time...
:{{DIcon}} But they've all paid the price for their sins now.
:{{A|vo lelq001 7 lohen 08.ogg}} '''Lohen:''' ...We needn't continue to live in the shadows of scum like that, old man.
:{{A|vo lelq001 7 adorno 22.ogg}} '''Adorno:''' ...Hmm, you've got a point. We've got long lives ahead of us, after all.
:{{A|vo lelq001 7 adorno 23.ogg}} '''Adorno:''' Let's get on with our next task, eh? This should lift your spirits a bit, I'm sure — we'll be assisting the [[Knights of Favonius#10th Company, Investigation|10th Company]] with their research.

:{{A|vo lelq001 13 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Is there... something up with Lohen?
:{{A|vo lelq001 13 sucrose 03.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' Could there be a problem with the magic? But if there were issues with the reproduced memories, the Honorary Knight should have noticed...

:{{DIcon}} I don't think the magic is the problem.
:{{A|vo lelq001 13 adorno 07.ogg}} '''Adorno:''' Are you saying the problem... lies with Lohen himself?

:{{DIcon}} ..."Again"?
:{{DIcon}} ..."Set him off"?
:{{A|vo lelq001 13 adorno 09.ogg}} '''Adorno:''' ...Lohen's pursuit of power began long ago.
:{{A|vo lelq001 13 adorno 10.ogg}} '''Adorno:''' The traitor, Eroch, collaborated with The Doctor on forbidden experiments in his quest for greater power...
:{{A|vo lelq001 13 adorno 11.ogg}} '''Adorno:''' Lohen nearly became one of their test subjects.
:{{A|vo lelq001 13 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Experiments by The Doctor!?
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (Could he be just like [[Collei]]...)
:{{A|vo lelq001 13 adorno 12.ogg}} '''Adorno:''' Fortunately, the Knights tracked Eroch's cronies down, uncovering their plots before they could act.
:{{A|vo lelq001 13 adorno 13.ogg}} '''Adorno:''' They cut their experiments short and tried to transport their victims away... But we intercepted them in transit and rescued everyone.
:{{Color|menu|Adorno recounts the day he rescued Lohen. Unlike the other children, who wept from fear, Lohen seemed... exceptional.}}
:{{A|vo lelq001 13 adorno 14.ogg}} '''Adorno:''' ...It's alright. It's over now.

A Knight's Merit Quest Still 3.png
</gallery>
:{{A|vo lelq001 13 theodor 02.ogg}} '''Crying Child:''' *sob*... *sob*...
:'''Lohen:''' ...
:{{A|vo lelq001 13 sucrose 04.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' I heard about that. That was the incident that saw you gain the title of "Benevolent Knight," right?
:{{A|vo lelq001 13 sucrose 05.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' I'd never have guessed that Vice Captain Lohen was involved...
:{{A|vo lelq001 13 adorno 15.ogg}} '''Adorno:''' *sigh* I never deserved that title. We saved the kidnapped children, yes, but I failed to root Eroch out.
:{{A|vo lelq001 13 adorno 16.ogg}} '''Adorno:''' I couldn't find their experiment site. Nor could I help Lohen fully shake off the trauma of that incident.
:{{A|vo lelq001 13 adorno 17.ogg}} '''Adorno:''' He's always believed he needs power to stay free from others' control. I'd hoped the expedition might change his perspective, but...
:{{DIcon}} The battle against Rerir...
:{{DIcon}} ...May have deepened his obsession instead?
:{{A|vo lelq001 13 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So that's what happened...
:{{A|vo lelq001 13 adorno 18.ogg}} '''Adorno:''' ...It's tough having to act the part of a "friend" with someone like him, huh?
:{{A|vo lelq001 13 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yeah... Wait!
:{{DIcon}} You saw right through us, didn't you?
:{{DIcon}} Nothing gets past you.
:{{A|vo lelq001 13 adorno 19.ogg}} '''Adorno:''' Haha, I may be getting old, but my eyes haven't failed me yet.
:{{A|vo lelq001 13 adorno 20.ogg}} '''Adorno:''' Ignoring his methods, the fact that he's found companions willing to play along with his little charade shows he's made at least some progress.
:{{A|vo lelq001 13 adorno 21.ogg}} '''Adorno:''' Even if you're just acting, maybe learning from you will finally help him figure it out.
:{{A|vo lelq001 13 sucrose 06.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' Hmm...
:{{DIcon}} Sucrose? What's wrong?
:{{A|vo lelq001 13 sucrose 07.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' There's something I'm concerned about... Honorary Knight, would you mind taking a look at this?
:;(Sucrose leads the Traveler back to the magic bubble)
:{{A|vo lelq001 13 sucrose 08.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' ...Strange. Mr. Adorno said that Lohen's obsession may have caused the projection to spiral out of control.
:{{A|vo lelq001 13 sucrose 09.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' However, the Simulation Training Bubble: Type 02's parameters were all normal... If anything, it was the power Vice Captain Lohen released at that moment that appeared unusual.
:{{A|vo lelq001 13 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So you haven't seen anything like this before?
:{{A|vo lelq001 13 sucrose 10.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' No... It's not the [[element]]al energy we usually encounter, and it isn't the "[[Void Realm]] energy" that Mr. [[Albedo]] talks about either... Do you have any ideas what it might be, Honorary Knight?
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (I thought I sensed... some familiar power back there... but I can't be certain.)
:{{A|vo lelq001 13 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So you think there's something up with Lohen? He's not... messing about with something dangerous, is he?
:{{A|vo lelq001 13 sucrose 11.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' That's not what I meant. I'm just reporting my findings. We shouldn't accuse our companions of anything untoward — not without evidence.
:{{A|vo lelq001 13 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You have a point! We've just run into this sorta thing way too many times... Can't be too careful...
:{{Color|menu|Under the shade of a nearby tree, Theodore is tending to Lohen's wounds...}}
:{{A|vo lelq001 13 theodor 03.ogg}} '''Theodore:''' Why did you come here today? We clearly agreed—
:{{A|vo lelq001 13 lohen 02.ogg}} '''Lohen:''' Varka's orders. Not my decision.
:{{A|vo lelq001 13 theodor 04.ogg}} '''Theodore:''' Even so, that was way too careless of you. Using so much power... *sigh*
:{{A|vo lelq001 13 theodor 05.ogg}} '''Theodore:''' ...What if we're exposed?
:{{A|vo lelq001 13 lohen 03.ogg}} '''Lohen:''' Hehe, then... We'll just have to accelerate our experiments before that happens.

:{{DIcon}} They attack... their own kind?
:{{A|vo lelq002 3 diluc 06.ogg}} '''Diluc:''' Yes. Eyewitness reports are scarce, so we can't be certain, but the monster remains here do show signs that they've been fighting each other.

:{{A|vo lelq002 3 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh? But if these monsters will attack each other, can't we just wait for them to wipe themselves out? Why be so vigilant?
:{{A|vo lelq002 3 varka 01.ogg}} '''Varka:''' Because such beasts, bearing [[Ursa]]'s Flesh, have appeared before, and not just once, either.
:{{A|vo lelq002 3 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' ...Varka!
:{{A|vo lelq002 3 varka 02.ogg}} '''Varka:''' Well, this is a coincidence. Honorary Knight, Paimon, and you too, Diluc.
:{{A|vo lelq002 3 diluc 08.ogg}} '''Diluc:''' ...So, the [[Knights of Favonius]] are not entirely ignorant of this anomaly.
:{{A|vo lelq002 3 varka 03.ogg}} '''Varka:''' Yes... The tragedy [[Eroch]] wrought cannot — and will not — be allowed to happen again.
:{{A|vo lelq002 3 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Did you just say... Ursa's Flesh? Is this somehow related to that Eroch guy?
:{{A|vo lelq002 3 varka 04.ogg}} '''Varka:''' In his pursuit of transcendent power, he once conspired with one of Dottore's Segments to extract a serum containing the power of Ursa the Drake from the dragon's flesh.
:{{A|vo lelq002 3 varka 05.ogg}} '''Varka:''' When the reckoning with the Knights came, he and his cohorts all injected themselves with that serum... causing us quite a bit of trouble.
:{{A|vo lelq002 3 varka 06.ogg}} '''Varka:''' Their strength and bloodthirst increased in equal measure, and consumed by madness, they even attacked each other.
:{{A|vo lelq002 3 varka 07.ogg}} '''Varka:''' Ironically, Eroch ultimately failed to control that power. Not only did he turn his sword against his followers, but he went to his own demise in the process.
:{{A|vo lelq002 3 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ursa the Drake... What exactly is it? How could it have such terrifying power?
:{{DIcon}} I heard it's existed for over a thousand years...
:{{DIcon}} And it even fought with the first Grand Master?
:{{A|vo lelq002 3 varka 08.ogg}} '''Varka:''' That's right.
:{{A|vo lelq002 3 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Then... then why did they only seal it away? Was even the founding Grand Master unable to kill it?
:{{A|vo lelq002 3 varka 09.ogg}} '''Varka:''' No. It was spared because... Ursa the Drake was once an [[angel]].
:{{A|vo lelq002 3 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What!?
:{{DIcon}} I'm sorry!?
:{{A|vo lelq002 3 varka 10.ogg}} '''Varka:''' I've heard that long ago, the angelic race was faced with a difficult choice... and Ursa chose to preserve its "power."
:{{A|vo lelq002 3 varka 11.ogg}} '''Varka:''' Having lost its mind and retaining only power, this angel remained drawn to human settlements, not realizing that its proximity alone would destroy many...
:{{A|vo lelq002 3 diluc 09.ogg}} '''Diluc:''' Is that why [[Vennessa]] decided to seal it away back then?
:{{A|vo lelq002 3 varka 12.ogg}} '''Varka:''' Yes, but it was awakened by [[The Doctor]]'s inducement... which was an oversight on the Knights' part. I won't deny that.
:{{A|vo lelq002 3 diluc 10.ogg}} '''Diluc:''' Rather than assigning blame for the past, we would be better served by rooting out the present threat.
:{{A|vo lelq002 3 diluc 11.ogg}} '''Diluc:''' But Ursa's flesh and blood... Why would it reappear within these monsters?
:{{A|vo lelq002 3 varka 13.ogg}} '''Varka:''' Eroch was, admittedly, once a knight in whom we placed much of our hopes. As such, he knows our methods well.
:{{A|vo lelq002 3 varka 14.ogg}} '''Varka:''' Before he met his end, he destroyed all records regarding his experiment site.
:{{A|vo lelq002 3 varka 15.ogg}} '''Varka:''' To this day, we've yet to find any information to locate it. I suspect we have the Segment to thank for that, too.
:{{A|vo lelq002 3 varka 16.ogg}} '''Varka:''' But Dottore's backup plans were dismantled by {{Traveler}} in [[Sumeru]], a fact you're no doubt aware of.
:{{A|vo lelq002 3 varka 17.ogg}} '''Varka:''' We believe this means that the covert measures he took in Mondstadt have also ceased to work.
:{{A|vo lelq002 3 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ahh... So those monsters... They all escaped from the experiment site!?
:{{A|vo lelq002 3 diluc 12.ogg}} '''Diluc:''' I'm afraid it goes deeper than that — someone has likely restarted the experiments.
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (Past experiments... Ursa's flesh and blood... Angelic power...)
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (Does this mean... that the power I sensed in Lohen yesterday is...)
:{{A|vo lelq002 3 varka 18.ogg}} '''Varka:''' You noticed it too, then? During the commotion yesterday.
:{{DIcon}} Yes. At the time, I...
:;(The Traveler explains their suspicions to Diluc and Varka)

:{{A|vo lelq002 3 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' He... He isn't bad enough to do something like that, is he?
:{{A|vo lelq002 3 diluc 14.ogg}} '''Diluc:''' Wealth, power, authority... Too many things can turn a good person into a villain.
:{{A|vo lelq002 3 diluc 15.ogg}} '''Diluc:''' Ursa, Eroch... Neither of them were the "bad guys" you might imagine before they made their fateful choices.
:{{A|vo lelq002 3 varka 19.ogg}} '''Varka:''' But no matter Lohen's intentions, it is my duty to pull him back from the edge before he goes too far.

:{{A|vo lelq002 3 varka 20.ogg}} '''Varka:''' No need for that. That's why I'm here at [[Dornman Port]] — I'm going to find him and ask him directly!

:{{A|vo lelq002 4 theodor 04.ogg}} '''Theodore:''' What do we do now, then? Find a place to lie low?
:{{A|vo lelq002 4 lohen 06.ogg}} '''Lohen:''' ...That would make reaching our objective even harder.

:{{A|vo lelq002 4 theodor 10.ogg}} '''Theodore:''' Lohen! We've got to hide! We can gather more monsters for experiments later...

:{{A|vo lelq002 4 theodor 11.ogg}} '''Theodore:''' Then... what should we do now?

:{{A|vo lelq002 6 adorno 10.ogg}} '''Adorno:''' The way I see it, you earn that title every day...

:{{A|vo lelq002 6 varka 12.ogg}} '''Varka:''' I know how much Adorno means to him, so I trust the weight of his vow.
:{{A|vo lelq002 6 diluc 02.ogg}} '''Diluc:''' There once was a man who made many promises to my father in the name of chivalry, yet in the end, he betrayed their friendship.
:{{A|vo lelq002 6 diluc 03.ogg}} '''Diluc:''' "Warped obsessions and the passage of time can turn friends into foes as easily as the wind changes its course."
:{{A|vo lelq002 6 varka 13.ogg}} '''Varka:''' ...Quoting [[Crepus]], are we? That really takes me back.
:{{A|vo lelq002 6 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Did you guys... all know each other back in the day?
:{{A|vo lelq002 6 varka 14.ogg}} '''Varka:''' Once, there were three spirited young men who imagined their futures together.
:{{A|vo lelq002 6 varka 15.ogg}} '''Varka:''' One was a rich {{Rubi|young master|Crepus}}. He dreamed of becoming a knight, but ended up inheriting the family winery.
:{{A|vo lelq002 6 varka 16.ogg}} '''Varka:''' Next came the hot-headed {{Rubi|rule-breaker|Varka}}, who ended up leading the Knights of Favonius.
:{{A|vo lelq002 6 varka 17.ogg}} '''Varka:''' And the {{Rubi|last one|Eroch}}... obtained neither the wealth he desired, nor the power he yearned for.
:;(Standing in front of Adorno's house, Lohen raises his hand at the closed door)
:{{A|vo lelq002 6 varka 18.ogg}} '''Varka:''' Obsession was all that was left, piling up day after day into a towering spire.
:{{DIcon}} Longing turned into obsession...
:{{DIcon}} Yearning turned into jealousy...
:{{A|vo lelq002 6 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Is that how Eroch... let The Doctor worm his way in?
:{{A|vo lelq002 6 varka 19.ogg}} '''Varka:''' Eroch made his own choices, no matter what was said to him.
:{{A|vo lelq002 6 varka 20.ogg}} '''Varka:''' I understand his reasoning, but that doesn't mean I pity him. And it certainly doesn't mean I'll make the same mistakes again.
:{{A|vo lelq002 6 varka 21.ogg}} '''Varka:''' I'm keeping a close eye on my subordinates this time...
:{{A|vo lelq002 6 lietzberg 01.ogg}} '''Lietzberg:''' B—Bad news!
:{{A|vo lelq002 6 varka 22.ogg}} '''Varka:''' —Hey, I haven't finished talking yet!
:{{A|vo lelq002 6 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' That voice... Did it come from where Adorno was just now?
:{{DIcon}} We can talk about trust later...
:{{DIcon}} Let's hurry over and take a look!
:{{A|vo lelq002 6 varka 23.ogg}} '''Varka:''' [[Lietzberg]]... What's going on here?
:{{A|vo lelq002 6 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Adorno's... gone? Lohen and Theodore, too?
:{{A|vo lelq002 6 lietzberg 02.ogg}} '''Lietzberg:''' I don't know. I was on patrol, and I saw the door was wide open. I looked inside... and everything was like this!
:{{A|vo lelq002 6 lietzberg 03.ogg}} '''Lietzberg:''' Captain Adorno couldn't have gotten out of bed in his condition. Could... someone have taken him away?
:{{A|vo lelq002 6 wernher 01.ogg}} '''Wernher:''' Grand Master — it's an emergency! Vice Captain Lohen barreled straight through our patrols and headed for the outskirts!
:{{A|vo lelq002 6 varka 24.ogg}} '''Varka:''' That kid... Seriously...
:{{A|vo lelq002 6 diluc 04.ogg}} '''Diluc:''' Did he leave any sort of message?
:{{A|vo lelq002 6 wernher 02.ogg}} '''Wernher:''' Message? ... He looked like he was in a hurry. All he said was "Out of the way!" before rushing off.
:{{DIcon}} Did you go after him?
:{{A|vo lelq002 6 wernher 03.ogg}} '''Wernher:''' Of course! But you know how fast he is. I'm afraid we...
:{{A|vo lelq002 6 varka 25.ogg}} '''Varka:''' Track him as far as you can. Leave the rest to us!
:{{A|vo lelq002 6 varka 26.ogg}} '''Varka:''' Diluc, Honorary Knight, I'm counting on you to help me with this one.

;(Interact with Notes on the Experimental Subjects, optional)
::'''Notes on the Experimental Subjects'''
::...
::The plan to incite panic through the use of the test subjects has progressed with remarkable success.
::Though even our most successful test subject at this stage can harbor less than one percent of the total power within Ursa's Flesh, the ensuing rumors and dread have proven far more readily disseminated and internalized among the masses than the drake in its true form.
::The legend of Ursa has haunted this land for a thousand years, after all. A plausible imitation of its form is quite enough to keep the populace in a state of perpetual dread.
::Moreover, the scrutiny and discontent directed at the Knights of Favonius will breed further chaos. It will pave the way for our [[Fatui|northern "allies"]] to step in with their timely assistance.
:: 
::...
::Regarding the mutual aggression among the test subjects, some researchers posited that the severed "flesh" is simply attempting to reconstitute itself into a single whole.
::Others, however, interpret this as Ursa's curse upon itself — that it would allow no vestige of its power to persist in any shape or manner.
::A foolishly sentimental notion. A brute that has abandoned its wisdom cannot then arrive at the refinement of desiring its own extinction.
::There are no unsolvable riddles in this world. The experiments shall continue. Our mastery of this power is inevitable; it is only a matter of time.
::Risks are one thing, and results are quite another. We should give necessary secrecy its due, and necessary sacrifice its place.
::Provided we keep a clean ledger, we keep our grip on the situation.

;(Interact with The Origins of the Experiment, optional)
::'''The Origins of the Experiment'''
::...
::Though a thousand years have passed since the [[Vennessa|first Grand Master]] laid her seal, the drake Ursa's power remains as formidable as ever. To regard it merely as a calamity or a scourge would be to squander its considerable potential.
::Should we succeed in deconstructing and taming Ursa's power into a controllable asset, the benefits — whether for strategic deterrence, tactical deployment, or targeted eradication — would be immeasurable.
::In light of these considerations, I hereby authorize the covert study of the relevant specimens.
::All pertinent records have been withdrawn from the general archives to preempt any unnecessary scrutiny from the [[Church of Favonius|Church]] or the Knights.
::Lasting peace should not depend on the momentary intervention of individual heroes, nor should it be entrusted to the whims of inscrutable gods.

:{{A|vo lelq003 12 lohen 01.ogg}} '''Lohen:''' Hehe. This epitaph suits you, old man...

:{{A|vo lelq003 12 lohen 05.ogg}} '''Lohen:''' I had nothing else to do during confinement, so I made candy to stave off the boredom.

:{{A|vo lelq003 12 lohen 08.ogg}} '''Lohen:''' The title of Benevolent Knight is to be buried with Adorno. The position of 5th Company Captain will also remain vacant — for the time being.

:{{A|vo lelq003 12 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Paimon suddenly felt like that title suited you for a second... Must have been her imagination, eh?
:{{A|vo lelq003 12 lohen 12.ogg}} '''Lohen:''' You think so? I prefer a different title, really. The "Ends Justify the Means Knight"? The "A Win Is a Win Knight"? The "Punching Bag Knight" sounds alright, too.
:{{A|vo lelq003 12 lohen 13.ogg}} '''Lohen:''' That said, it seems this sinner will have to win a few more battles first before getting his next commendation.
:{{DIcon}} Are you still pursuing victory?
:{{DIcon}} Are you still pursuing power?
:{{A|vo lelq003 12 lohen 14.ogg}} '''Lohen:''' Of course. After all, someone once told me.... acknowledging my limits is the first step towards transcending the mundane.
:{{A|vo lelq003 12 lohen 15.ogg}} '''Lohen:''' I'll keep winning, no matter what it takes.
:{{DIcon}} ...
:{{A|vo lelq003 12 lohen 16.ogg}} '''Lohen:''' Relax. Learning from our mistakes is part and parcel of getting stronger, no? Besides, I know why I pursue power.
:{{A|vo lelq003 12 lohen 17.ogg}} '''Lohen:''' Forgetting what you wanted in the first place... That would be true defeat. Do I look like that kind of idiot to you?
:{{DIcon}} I guess not...
:{{DIcon}} But how many people remember in the end?
:{{A|vo lelq003 12 lohen 18.ogg}} '''Lohen:''' Hmm... It's food for thought. Best to have someone on hand to help if something does go wrong.
:{{A|vo lelq003 12 lohen 19.ogg}} '''Lohen:''' In that case, until I'm strong enough to shoulder everything on my own...
:{{A|vo lelq003 12 lohen 20.ogg}} '''Lohen:''' ...Don't grow old on me, alright?
:;(The camera zooms in on Adorno's headstone)

{{Quest Description|While traveling, you receive a sudden invitation from Alice. She hopes you and Paimon can help Durin fulfill a wish — one connected to his late mother, "M"...}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(On obtaining quest)
:{{A|vo dllq001 1 alice 01.ogg}} '''???:''' O Traveler from beyond this world, will you witness this tale unfold?
:{{A|vo dllq001 1 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' ...[[Alice]]?
:{{A|vo dllq001 1 alice 02.ogg}} '''Alice:''' Ahem... You recognized me just like that? Hm, maybe I need to work on my impression...
:{{A|vo dllq001 1 alice 03.ogg}} '''Alice:''' Anywho, come to [[Starsand Shoal]]. There's a little something I'd like your help with.
:{{A|vo dllq001 1 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Well, it wouldn't be [[Klee]]'s mom without a hefty dose of mystery, huh? Let's go see what this is about.

;(Approach the marked location in Starsand Shoal)

::{{Recollections|Summertide Scales and Tales/Story}}

:;(The Traveler and Paimon approach Durin, who stands amidst several fallen [[Radiant Beast]]s, seething with dark red energy)
:{{A|vo dllq001 2 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, it's Durin!
:{{A|vo dllq001 2 durin 01.ogg}} '''Durin:''' Hmm?

:{{A|vo dllq001 2 durin 02.ogg}} '''Durin:''' {{Traveler}} and Paimon? Ah, I'm sorry, I hope I didn't scare you...
:{{A|vo dllq001 2 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh... No, you didn't scare us, just... gave us a little surprise, hehe... Looks like you've gotten even more powerful now.
:{{A|vo dllq001 2 durin 03.ogg}} '''Durin:''' Hmm... I don't know, it just feels like it's gotten harder to control. I didn't mean to strike so hard. I'm so relieved you didn't get hurt.
:{{A|vo dllq001 2 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' It's all good! We've had worse, hehe!
:{{DIcon}} Is the Abyssal power inside you acting up?
:{{A|vo dllq001 2 durin 04.ogg}} '''Durin:''' Ah, no, don't worry about that. It's been very stable ever since I got this body. [[Albedo]] made sure of that.
:{{A|vo dllq001 2 durin 05.ogg}} '''Durin:''' What you saw just now is something that only started happening recently. Maybe I'm still acclimating or something. I'm sure it'll clear up over time.

:{{A|vo dllq001 2 alice 01.ogg}} '''Alice:''' The day that the writer and the watcher crossed paths was the day that the magic known as storytelling was born.
:{{A|vo dllq001 2 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So, um... she asked us to come.
:{{A|vo dllq001 2 durin 07.ogg}} '''Durin:''' Ms. Alice?

:{{A|vo dllq001 2 alice 03.ogg}} '''Alice:''' I have brought you and {{Traveler}} together here for a very important purpose! It has to do with your mom.
:{{A|vo dllq001 2 durin 08.ogg}} '''Durin:''' My mom?
:{{DIcon}} You mean "M"?
:{{A|vo dllq001 2 alice 04.ogg}} '''Alice:''' Indeed! Fairytale author extraordinaire, [[Anya "Marie" Andersdotter]]. See, I knew this would be right up your alley.
:;(A book with Mini Durin on the cover appears before them)
:{{A|vo dllq001 2 alice 05.ogg}} '''Alice:''' Now then. If you'll open the book, I will begin narrating.
:{{DIcon}} (Open the book)
:{{Black Screen|The day that the writer and the watcher crossed paths...}}
:;(The Traveler, Paimon, and Durin are pulled into the world of the book)
:{{A|vo dllq001 3 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Whoa, what is this place? It reminds Paimon of [[Simulanka]]...
:{{A|vo dllq001 3 alice 01.ogg}} '''Alice:''' The two are indeed similar. Both worlds were built using the same magic, after all.
:{{Introductory Note|Alice}}
:{{A|vo dllq001 3 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Aha, so it IS Alice!
:{{A|vo dllq001 3 durin 01.ogg}} '''Durin:''' Hello, um... Aunt Alice.
:{{A|vo dllq001 3 alice 02.ogg}} '''Alice:''' Aw, no need to be shy. Just think of me as one of your mother's dearest friends.
:{{A|vo dllq001 3 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You keep talking about "stories" and "magic"... What's this all about? Simulanka 2.0 or something?
:{{A|vo dllq001 3 alice 03.ogg}} '''Alice:''' Certainly not! Simulanka was a peerless masterpiece. Without the original author, it would be impossible to create a sequel. Even for me!
:{{A|vo dllq001 3 alice 04.ogg}} '''Alice:''' But you are right about one thing. Just like last time, I want to show you a work of magic that has to do with storytelling.
:{{A|vo dllq001 3 durin 02.ogg}} '''Durin:''' What's this?
:{{DIcon}} It's the book we just saw...
:{{A|vo dllq001 3 alice 05.ogg}} '''Alice:''' This... is your mother's dying wish.
:{{A|vo dllq001 3 durin 03.ogg}} '''Durin:''' My mother's dying wish... was a book?
:{{A|vo dllq001 3 alice 06.ogg}} '''Alice:''' Let me answer that with a question. What do you suppose would be a writer's greatest regret?
:{{A|vo dllq001 3 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hmm...
:{{A|vo dllq001 3 alice 07.ogg}} '''Alice:''' Have you ever read a book called [[The Little Witch and the Undying Fire]]?
:;(A book flies off of a nearby shelf, right into Alice's hands)
:{{DIcon}} I have. But I'm not sure who wrote it.
::{{A|vo dllq001 3 alice 08a 1.ogg}} '''Alice:''' That's because it was the work of more than one person.
:{{DIcon}} Not yet.
::{{A|vo dllq001 3 alice 08b 1.ogg}} '''Alice:''' Ah, well, you're missing out. It's a wonderful book.
:{{A|vo dllq001 3 alice 09.ogg}} '''Alice:''' It began as a little game at our tea parties. Each of us took turns writing the next part of the story.
:{{A|vo dllq001 3 alice 10.ogg}} '''Alice:''' I wrote the first volume, then the other mages took their turns. M was tasked with writing the final volume and tying everything up.
:{{A|vo dllq001 3 alice 11.ogg}} '''Alice:''' But by the time everyone had finished writing their parts, M had passed away... Ah, it was a terrible shame. A true tragedy.
:{{A|vo dllq001 3 durin 04.ogg}} '''Durin:''' Mm...
:{{A|vo dllq001 3 alice 12.ogg}} '''Alice:''' And that is the answer to my question. A writer's greatest regret is to leave a story unfinished.
:{{DIcon}} That makes sense.
:{{A|vo dllq001 3 alice 13.ogg}} '''Alice:''' But all is not lost. I couldn't stand the doom and gloom of it all, so I went ahead and wrote an ending myself, on her behalf.
:{{A|vo dllq001 3 durin 05.ogg}} '''Durin:''' Then, what's this book?
:{{A|vo dllq001 3 alice 14.ogg}} '''Alice:''' This is the answer your mother gave to the same question. In her eyes, this was her greatest regret.
:{{A|vo dllq001 3 alice 15.ogg}} '''Alice:''' She made me promise that I would bring it to you, because she believed the only person who could resolve this regret... is you.

:'''Act I — "Birth"'''
:{{A|vo dllq001 8 m 01.ogg}} Long, long ago, an evil dragon descended upon the human world, bringing terrible calamity in its wake.
:{{A|vo dllq001 8 m 02.ogg}} Bravely did the people resist, until at last, the dragon lay slain.
:{{A|vo dllq001 8 m 03.ogg}} Later, a witch with a love for stories came upon the tale of the evil dragon, and for reasons she could not explain, felt a pang of sorrow on its behalf.
:{{A|vo dllq001 8 m 04.ogg}} For she knew, despite its body being born of [[Art of Khemia|wicked alchemy]], all along, the dragon's soul was that of an innocent child.
:{{A|vo dllq001 8 m 05.ogg}} Right up to the moment of its death, it had no choice in becoming a vessel of calamity, nor could it fathom the cruel fate that lay before it.
:{{A|vo dllq001 8 m 06.ogg}} Though the witch had a love of stories, she was not pleased with how this one ended.
:{{A|vo dllq001 8 m 07.ogg}} "No, that won't do," she thought. "I'll write you a better ending instead." And so she set off to do just that, borrowing a little magic from her friend.
:{{A|vo dllq001 8 m 08.ogg}} With it she wove a dragon's egg, resolving to rear a dragon-child of her own.
:{{A|vo dllq001 8 m 09.ogg}} Yet long in thought she lingered, wondering what kind of world her little dragon ought to behold upon waking.
:What should be used to adorn his cradle?
:{{DIcon}} Wisp of Woodland Air
::{{A|vo dllq001 8 m 10.ogg}} At last she made her mind up, adorning the cradle with a wisp of woodland air. Then, she quietly waited for the egg to hatch.
:{{DIcon}} Trace of Palatial Splendor
::{{A|vo dllq001 8 m 11.ogg}} At last she made her mind up, adorning the cradle with a trace of palatial splendor. Then, she quietly waited for the egg to hatch.

:{{A|vo dllq001 9 m 02.ogg}} '''Narrator:''' Yet those who never stray beyond the main plot often miss the fun little details along the way...

;(Observe the Dodoco, optional)
:{{A|vo dllq001 9 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' This Dodoco doll is meant to be the witch in the story, right? Wait a second...
:{{A|vo dllq001 9 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' All the people we've seen that looked like that turned out to be mages from the [[Hexenzirkel]]. D'you think the witch in this story is one of them too?
:{{A|vo dllq001 9 durin 01.ogg}} '''Durin:''' My mother had a hat just like this.
:{{A|vo dllq001 9 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Then, the witch must be Narrator! Looks like this story really is about Durin, huh...
:{{A|vo dllq001 9 m 03.ogg}} '''Narrator:''' Whether the sprite spoke true or not, it had little bearing on the story at hand.
:{{A|vo dllq001 9 m 04.ogg}} '''Narrator:''' For in that moment, what mattered most was not that she was a witch, but a mother waiting for her child to hatch.
:{{A|vo dllq001 9 durin 02.ogg}} '''Durin:''' Hmm... Let's keep looking.

;(Observe the stack of books, optional)
:{{A|vo dllq001 9 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Look at all these books. Guessing the witch did a lot of reading while she was waiting for the egg to hatch...
:{{A|vo dllq001 9 m 05.ogg}} '''Narrator:''' It just so happened, a dragon egg wasn't the only thing she was incubating here...
:{{A|vo dllq001 9 m 06.ogg}} '''Narrator:''' Where else might a story be born, if not among books?
:{{A|vo dllq001 9 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ohhh...

;(Observe the dragon egg)
:{{A|vo dllq001 9 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' This must be the dragon egg, right? Looks like it's gonna hatch any moment now...
:{{A|vo dllq001 9 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So we've got... a dragon egg about to hatch, a witch who loves stories, and that evil dragon we heard about at the beginning. Yep, it all adds up.
:{{A|vo dllq001 9 durin 03.ogg}} '''Durin:''' This... is my story, isn't it?
:{{DIcon}} Sure looks like it...
:{{A|vo dllq001 9 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Okay, so how are we supposed to help the story along? It feels like all we can do right now is wait.
:{{A|vo dllq001 9 m 07.ogg}} '''Narrator:''' Apparently, it hadn't dawned on the group to look for a way to help the egg hatch faster...
:{{A|vo dllq001 9 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ohhh, right. We're at the point in the story where we're waiting for the baby dragon to hatch, so that has to happen before the story can continue...
:{{DIcon}} And... how do we do that?
:{{A|vo dllq001 9 m 08.ogg}} '''Narrator:''' With the flames at his command, perhaps the dragon-youth might be able to provide the egg with sufficient warmth...
:{{A|vo dllq001 9 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What!? You want us to... roast the dragon egg?
:{{A|vo dllq001 9 m 09.ogg}} '''Narrator:''' The silvery sprite's surprise betrayed her lack of reading — for in countless tales, it is told that only by fire's embrace will a dragon's egg hatch swiftly.
:{{A|vo dllq001 9 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hmph, you... kinda have a point there.
:{{DIcon}} Wanna give it a try, Durin?
:{{A|vo dllq001 9 durin 04.ogg}} '''Durin:''' Okay, I'll... see what I can do.

|image2   = Tutorial A Mother's Last Wish 2.png
|text2    = Casting the special Normal Attack {{Color|help|Transmutation: Denial of Darkness}} will turn his next Elemental Burst into {{Color|help|Principle of Darkness: As the Stars Smolder}}, manifesting his power in the form of {{Color|help|Dragon of Dark Decay}}.

;(Floating letters appear above the egg)
:'''Use flames to help the little dragon break out of the shell...'''
<!-- "Drop of Miraculous Arcane Ink.png" -1 -->

;(Use Durin's Elemental Burst)
:;(If the Elemental Burst was Principle of Darkness{{colon}} As the Stars Smolder)
:::{{A|vo dllq001 10 m 01.ogg}} '''Narrator:''' Clearly, both the golden-haired Traveler and the dragon-youth were eagerly awaiting the little dragon's birth. Though perhaps their longing burned a little too brightly?
:::{{A|vo dllq001 10 m 02.ogg}} '''Narrator:''' Still, such fiery anticipation might itself become a blessing...
:;(If the Elemental Burst was Principle of Purity{{colon}} As the Light Shifts)
:::{{A|vo dllq001 10 m 03.ogg}} '''Narrator:''' Let every unborn life be welcomed with tender anticipation, and may that warmth stay with it for a lifetime.
;(The eggshell cracks, revealing a sleeping Mini Durin)
:{{A|vo dllq001 11 m 01.ogg}} '''Narrator:''' At last, under the witch's expectant gaze, the little dragon broke free from its shell.
:{{A|vo dllq001 11 m 02.ogg}} '''Story-Witch:''' No living being has ever decided the moment of its birth. You were no exception, my child.
:{{A|vo dllq001 11 m 03.ogg}} '''Story-Witch:''' I brought you into being because I willed it so — just like [[Rhinedottir|the witch]] who created that evil dragon.
:{{A|vo dllq001 11 m 04.ogg}} '''Story-Witch:''' But I promise you this: your birth was wanted, you are loved, and you will have a different fate than the dragon that came before you.
:{{A|vo dllq001 11 durin 01.ogg}} '''Durin:''' You've never told me those things before, but for some reason, I always knew.
:{{A|vo dllq001 11 durin 02.ogg}} '''Durin:''' Thank you for... for bringing me into this world.
:{{A|vo dllq001 11 m 05.ogg}} The waiting witch did not feel lonely, for she had three visitors by her side. Together, they beheld the hatchling's first breath of life.
:{{A|vo dllq001 11 m 06.ogg}} Holding her dragon-child close, the witch promised him a life unlike that of the evil dragon.
:{{A|vo dllq001 11 m 07.ogg}} And so, nestled in his mother's warm embrace, did the little dragon's story begin.
:{{Black Screen|There, a witch once spent a sleepless night — and all to bring forth a story yet untold.}}
:;(The Traveler, Paimon, and Durin are returned to Mondstadt City)
:{{A|vo dllq001 12 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wait... Isn't this Mondstadt? Looks like we're back in the real world!
:{{A|vo dllq001 12 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Looks like there's more written on the page now, and less ink left than before. So, does that mean we've completed this chapter?
:{{DIcon}} So it is Durin's story, after all.
:{{DIcon}} Or at least, a window into his past...
:{{A|vo dllq001 12 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yeah, but why does "M" seem to think that the story isn't finished yet?
:{{A|vo dllq001 12 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Durin broke free from the curse, came into this world with a new body, and even made a bunch of new friends. That already sounds like a happy ending to Paimon...
:{{DIcon}} Maybe there'll be some clues in the following chapters?
:{{A|vo dllq001 12 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' True... Everything's always so mysterious with these mages. Guess all we can do is wait for more clues.
:{{A|vo dllq001 12 durin 01.ogg}} '''Durin:''' ...Huh.
:;(The open book begins to emit a crackling noise)
:'''???:''' Dodoco— Dodoco—
:{{A|vo dllq001 12 alice 01.ogg}} '''???:''' Is this thing on? Alright, that should do it...
:{{A|vo dllq001 12 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hey, that's Alice's voice!
:{{A|vo dllq001 12 alice 02.ogg}} '''Alice:''' Hello there, children! If you're hearing this, you've stumbled upon the little recording I left for you. I thought you could use a few hints about how the book works.
:{{A|vo dllq001 12 alice 03.ogg}} '''Alice:''' By now, I'm guessing you've already begun to leave your mark on the story. You should know, however, that the book needs time to absorb the ink — so the next chapter's clues won't show up right away.
:{{A|vo dllq001 12 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wait, so... even magic ink needs time to dry!?
:{{A|vo dllq001 12 alice 04.ogg}} '''Alice:''' The good news is, you can return to any chapter you've already completed, and continue to explore the mystical, magical storybook world YOU helped create!
:{{A|vo dllq001 12 alice 05.ogg}} '''Alice:''' Have fun, dearies! Toodles!
:{{A|vo dllq001 12 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Aw, man. Paimon was so ready to knock this out in one go...
:{{A|vo dllq001 12 durin 02.ogg}} '''Durin:''' Maybe it's for the best. Sooner or later, we'll end up being whisked off to another world again — and if that happens, who knows when we'll be able to come back.
:{{A|vo dllq001 12 durin 03.ogg}} '''Durin:''' So it might be good to take a break while we can.
:{{A|vo dllq001 12 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' A break...
:;(Paimon's stomach growls)
:{{DIcon}} Guess now's as good a time as any...
:{{A|vo dllq001 12 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yeah, Paimon has a sudden craving for the [[Good Hunter]]'s [[Sticky Honey Roast]]... And we happen to be in Mondstadt, so...
:{{A|vo dllq001 12 durin 04.ogg}} '''Durin:''' So... let's meet up here later? I need to find Miss Lisa to return those books, anyway.
{{Dialogue End}}
