:{{A|vo jnqlq001 5 toba 01a.ogg}}<!--{{A|vo jnqlq001 5 toba 01b.ogg}}--> '''Toba:''' Wow, you're back already! That was sooo fast!
:{{A|vo jnqlq001 5 huni 01a.ogg}}<!--{{A|vo jnqlq001 5 huni 01b.ogg}}--> '''Huni:''' I'm so glad that the babies are all right. Thank you both so much! Now we can finally go home and stop worrying about them.
:{{A|vo jnqlq001 5 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You're welcome! Piece of cake.
:{{A|vo jnqlq001 5 huni 02a.ogg}}<!--{{A|vo jnqlq001 5 huni 02b.ogg}}--> '''Huni:''' You're not from Natlan, right? 'Cause your clothes look different than ours. Hey, you must be tired after all that climbing. You should come take a rest at my house!
:{{A|vo jnqlq001 5 toba 02.ogg}} '''Toba:''' Yeah, please come! I promise, you'll get a big Scions of the Canopy welcome! We love having guests, and you're really nice people — not like glasses guy.
:{{A|vo jnqlq001 5 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' By the sounds of it, "glasses guy" wasn't from Natlan either, right?
:{{A|vo jnqlq001 5 huni 03.ogg}} '''Huni:''' Uh-huh. Well, his clothes sure weren't... You know what, now that I think about it, there was something really fishy about him!
:{{A|vo jnqlq001 5 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Really? Maybe he was the suspicious outlander that Ajaw mentioned...
:{{DIcon}} Could you tell us a little bit more about him?
:{{A|vo jnqlq001 5 huni 04a.ogg}}<!--{{A|vo jnqlq001 5 huni 04b.ogg}}--> '''Huni:''' Sure, if you're interested. Lemme think, how did the conversation go again...
;(A flashback begins)
:{{A|vo jnqlq001 5 huni 05.ogg}} '''Huni:''' Please, Mister, I've told you so many stories already... When are you gonna help me find the baby Saurians?
:{{A|vo jnqlq001 5 fuchikami 01.ogg}} '''???:''' Just one more story. One more, I swear. Why don't you tell me more about that ball of fire?
:{{A|vo jnqlq001 5 fuchikami 02.ogg}} '''???:''' I heard that there was a huge, transparent ball of fire that used to burn... five hundred years ago? A thousand years ago? Maybe even further back than that.
:{{A|vo jnqlq001 5 toba 03.ogg}} '''Toba:''' Oh, you mean Turnfire! That's where the [[Ancient Name|ancient name]] "{{Rubi|Malipo|Turnfire}}" comes from!
:{{A|vo jnqlq001 5 fuchikami 03.ogg}} '''???:''' Oh, wow, so it was the origin of an ancient name? That's impressive!
:{{A|vo jnqlq001 5 huni 06.ogg}} '''Huni:''' Uh-huh! There's a story behind every ancient name. The legend goes that the Turnfire first appeared in the era of the Grand Alliance. It was used by the tyrant [[Och-Kan]] to rule over Natlan and oppress anyone who opposed him.
:{{A|vo jnqlq001 5 huni 07.ogg}} '''Huni:''' Turnfire is different from normal fire. If you get set on fire with it, you'll feel a horrible burning pain from behind you, but you won't die from it right away. And whatever you do, you mustn't turn back to look at it!
:{{A|vo jnqlq001 5 fuchikami 04.ogg}} '''???:''' Why? What happens if you turn back?
:{{A|vo jnqlq001 5 toba 04.ogg}} '''Toba:''' As soon as you turn around, poof! You get burned to a crisp!
:{{A|vo jnqlq001 5 fuchikami 05.ogg}} '''???:''' Well good golly gee... I mean, it's one thing to singe someone's clothes, but burning people alive? That is a big no-no in my book...
:{{A|vo jnqlq001 5 huni 08.ogg}} '''Huni:''' Right? How nasty is it to burn someone from behind and not even let them turn around to look? Och-Kan really was an evil tyrant.
:{{A|vo jnqlq001 5 fuchikami 06.ogg}} '''???:''' Yes, shocking behavior... Now let me guess — eventually, a valiant hero came to save the day? That's how these stories usually go.
:{{A|vo jnqlq001 5 toba 05.ogg}} '''Toba:''' Good guess, Uncle Glasses! Seems like you really know your stuff. The hero was called [[Yupanqui]]. He's the ancestor of our tribe.
:{{A|vo jnqlq001 5 huni 09.ogg}} '''Huni:''' Mm-hmm. Yupanqui was friends with Och-Kan the tyrant and also [[Xbalanque]], the first [[Pyro Archon]]. He was working as an ordnance officer for the Grand Alliance at the time.
:{{A|vo jnqlq001 5 huni 10.ogg}} '''Huni:''' He didn't like how Och-Kan was such a cruel tyrant. So he stole the Turnfire and threw it at the Och-Kan's army. The soldiers couldn't defend against it, and they all got turned to ash.
:{{A|vo jnqlq001 5 huni 11.ogg}} '''Huni:''' And that's how our ancestor set our people free. But, just as he was about to leave the city, he thought he heard Och-Kan calling out to him from behind. It caught him off guard, and he turned around to look...
:{{A|vo jnqlq001 5 toba 06.ogg}} '''Toba:''' But Och-Kan wasn't there. All he saw was a city burned black, an army in ruins, and giant flames reaching up into the sky...
:{{A|vo jnqlq001 5 huni 12.ogg}} '''Huni:''' A split-second later, the flames he saw burst out from inside his eyes, and swallowed him up.
:{{A|vo jnqlq001 5 toba 07.ogg}} '''Toba:''' All it took was a single glance! As soon as he looked back, he was burned to a crisp.
:{{A|vo jnqlq001 5 fuchikami 07.ogg}} '''???:''' The question is, was this the price he paid for stealing the Turnfire? Or the price of turning back?
:{{A|vo jnqlq001 5 toba 08.ogg}} '''Toba:''' Nobody knows the answer. But the fire that consumed Yupanqui burned more fiercely than any other. It burned for a hundred days, until it burned a hole right through the ley lines!
:{{A|vo jnqlq001 5 toba 09.ogg}} '''Toba:''' And then, kshhh! The flame dropped into the deathly dark Night Kingdom, where it still burns to this day.
:{{A|vo jnqlq001 5 huni 13.ogg}} '''Huni:''' The grown-ups say that it lights up the path that leads to the next life. But for the dead to be reborn, they have to accept the flames and be purified by the fire first.
:{{A|vo jnqlq001 5 huni 14.ogg}} '''Huni:''' It's like a final look back at your life, where you have to answer for everything you did... Anyway, that's the story of Yupanqui's Turnfire.
:{{A|vo jnqlq001 5 fuchikami 08.ogg}} '''???:''' Ahh... A fine parable indeed! So is it true? Is it really possible to find this fire in the Night Kingdom?
:{{A|vo jnqlq001 5 huni 15.ogg}} '''Huni:''' I dunno... I think it's just a story.
:{{A|vo jnqlq001 5 fuchikami 09.ogg}} '''???:''' Either way, I assume this name has been passed down in your tribe ever since?
:{{A|vo jnqlq001 5 toba 10.ogg}} '''Toba:''' Sure has! It went to [[Burkina]], the hero that we celebrate on Turnfire Night. But that was five hundred years ago.
:{{A|vo jnqlq001 5 huni 16.ogg}} '''Huni:''' Yeah, and now it belongs to Kinich... So we often call him "{{Rubi|Malipo|Turnfire}}" Kinich.
:{{A|vo jnqlq001 5 fuchikami 10.ogg}} '''???:''' Kinich, huh...
:{{A|vo jnqlq001 5 toba 11.ogg}} '''Toba:''' Alright, Uncle Glasses, that's enough stories! Now, can you please go find the baby Saurians for us, like you promised?
:{{A|vo jnqlq001 5 fuchikami 11.ogg}} '''???:''' Uhh... I would, but doesn't the legend of the Turnfire teach us not to look back? Let's not go dredging up the past.
:{{A|vo jnqlq001 5 fuchikami 12.ogg}} '''???:''' Tell me more about this Kinich guy. One more story, I swear. Starting... now.
:{{A|vo jnqlq001 5 fuchikami 13.ogg}} '''???:''' No? ...Careful Toba, you look dangerously close to cursing me out right now. Tut-tut, we can't have that. Cursing is for grown-ups only.
:{{A|vo jnqlq001 5 huni 17.ogg}} '''Huni:''' Uncle... You'd better not be trying to trick us... Or the Turnfire will get you when you die!
:{{A|vo jnqlq001 5 fuchikami 14.ogg}} '''???:''' How would it get me if I'm outside of Natlan? Uncle Glasses isn't from here, you know. Unlike you.
:{{A|vo jnqlq001 5 huni 18.ogg}} '''Huni:''' Huh...?
:;(Sanka sees the Traveler and Paimon walking over in the distance)
:{{A|vo jnqlq001 5 fuchikami 15.ogg}} '''???:''' Wait... Is that...?
:{{A|vo jnqlq001 5 fuchikami 16a.ogg}}<!--{{A|vo jnqlq001 5 fuchikami 16b.ogg}}--> '''???:''' ...Alright, kiddos — I'm a man of my word. Two of my friends are on their way here and, uh... yeah. They'll help you out on my behalf.
:{{A|vo jnqlq001 5 fuchikami 17a.ogg}}<!--{{A|vo jnqlq001 5 fuchikami 17b.ogg}}--> '''???:''' Work them like dogs, okay? That's what they're here for. Don't go easy on them just for my sake.
:{{A|vo jnqlq001 5 toba 12.ogg}} '''Toba:''' Really? ...Well, first can you tell us your name?
:{{A|vo jnqlq001 5 fuchikami 18.ogg}} '''Sanka:''' We met at the foot of this cliff, so... beneath the peaks... Let's go with "Sanka."
:{{A|vo jnqlq001 5 huni 19.ogg}} '''Huni:''' Seriously...?
:{{A|vo jnqlq001 5 fuchikami 19a.ogg}}<!--{{A|vo jnqlq001 5 fuchikami 19b.ogg}}--> '''Sanka:''' If you don't believe me, turn around and see for yourselves. They're right behind you.
:{{A|vo jnqlq001 5 huni 20.ogg}} '''Huni:''' Huh? Where...?
:{{A|vo jnqlq001 5 huni 21.ogg}} '''Huni:''' Wait... Uncle Sanka, where did you go!?
;(Flashback ends)
:{{A|vo jnqlq001 5 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yeah, definitely a fishy character... It sounds like he was digging for info about the ancient names.
:{{A|vo jnqlq001 5 toba 13.ogg}} '''Toba:''' Yeah! And not only that, but he betrayed us too! He'll pay for this!
:{{A|vo jnqlq001 5 huni 22.ogg}} '''Huni:''' All he got out of us were some stories, though. What's the worst that could happen?
:{{A|vo jnqlq001 5 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hmm... {{Traveler}}, maybe we should go tell Kinich about this? Ajaw says he's investigating it, but he's a bit of a loose cannon. We probably shouldn't take him at his word.
:{{A|vo jnqlq001 5 huni 23.ogg}} '''Huni:''' Huh? You know Kinich?
:{{A|vo jnqlq001 5 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Um... Not very well. But we have met him before, and one time we had a meal together.
:{{A|vo jnqlq001 5 toba 14.ogg}} '''Toba:''' Aw man, I'm so jealous! I've never even spoken to him. He's so cool! He's the Saurian-hunter, and he has a really awesome ancient name.
:{{A|vo jnqlq001 5 huni 24.ogg}} '''Huni:''' Me neither! I don't think my dad really likes him, though... He always tells me to stay away from him. Probably because of that little creep he always hangs out with. He's nasty. And he's so full of himself.
:{{A|vo jnqlq001 5 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, the creep who calls himself K'uhul Ajaw! Yeah, we've had the pleasure of meeting him too... He sure loves pushing people's buttons.
:{{A|vo jnqlq001 5 huni 25.ogg}} '''Huni:''' Exactly! I dunno why Kinich partnered up with him. Why didn't he pick me instead?
:{{A|vo jnqlq001 5 toba 15.ogg}} '''Toba:''' Uh-oh! Huni, look how late it is! We've been out way too long... We'd better get home now, or we'll get yelled at!
:{{A|vo jnqlq001 5 huni 26a.ogg}}<!--{{A|vo jnqlq001 5 huni 26b.ogg}}--> '''Huni:''' Yikes, you're right. Okay, well... this path here leads to our settlement. If you decide to visit, remember to come to my house!
:{{A|vo jnqlq001 5 huni 27.ogg}} '''Huni:''' If there's anything you need, my dad can help get it for you. Hope to see you soon!
:{{A|vo jnqlq001 5 toba 16a.ogg}}<!--{{A|vo jnqlq001 5 toba 16b.ogg}}--> '''Toba:''' We gotta run! Bye for now!
{{Dialogue End}}

:{{A|vo rcjeq004 2 kazuha 01.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' Greetings, {{Traveler}} and Paimon. I heard there would be guides for the [[Irodori Festival]], but I didn't expect it would be you two.
:{{A|vo rcjeq004 2 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hehe, we didn't expect to see you either! Returning as a guest for the Irodori Festival, no doubt!
:{{A|vo rcjeq004 2 kazuha 02.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' I was a little surprised myself when I received the invitation. But after wandering the outside world for so long, it is good to have an opportunity to return to my homeland and pay respects to my old friends.
:{{A|vo rcjeq004 2 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Kazuha, when we saw you in the distance just now, you seemed to be looking for something. What happened?
:{{A|vo rcjeq004 2 kazuha 03.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' Ah yes, you see, when I came off the boat with everyone just now, I suddenly heard light footsteps around me.
:{{A|vo rcjeq004 2 kazuha 04.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' I could tell they were not footsteps of a regular passenger, but by the time I turned around, the person had already disappeared. I only heard a splash come from below the pier.
:{{A|vo rcjeq004 2 kazuha 05.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' Even though I didn't manage to catch a glimpse of them, I found this strange piece of paper by my feet.
:{{A|vo rcjeq004 2 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, does the paper happen to have a poem written on it?
:{{A|vo rcjeq004 2 kazuha 06.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' Huh, how did you know?
:{{Black Screen|You tell Kazuha all that's happened over the last few days...}}
:{{A|vo rcjeq004 2 kazuha 07.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' Fascinating. It's almost hard to believe such things could happen.
:{{DIcon}} Kazuha, can you show us that piece of paper?
:{{A|vo rcjeq004 2 kazuha 08.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' Sure, here it is. Please, have a look.
;(Open [[The Five Kasen's Splendor: Akahito]])
:{{A|vo rcjeq004 2 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Last time, Aoi no Okina's poem ended with a reference to Akahito. And sure enough, this is a story about him.
:{{A|vo rcjeq004 2 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' The story this time basically says that Akahito got his name from his love of red seals. However, the Shogun discovered that he had committed plagiarism, and he was soon exiled...
:{{A|vo rcjeq004 2 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Well, if Paimon were to rate today's story, it sounds pretty unfortunate!
:{{DIcon}} Well, the other stories weren't much better either...
:{{A|vo rcjeq004 2 kazuha 09.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' I don't think there's anything particularly wrong with this story. I, too, was once wanted as a criminal by the Shogunate, so I'm not all that different from Akahito mentioned in this story.
:{{A|vo rcjeq004 2 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' But according to the story, Akahito was exiled by the shogun because of his wrongdoings. You did nothing wrong, Kazuha.
:{{A|vo rcjeq004 2 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh? Traveler, what are you thinking about?
:{{DIcon}} The seal mentioned in the story...
:{{DIcon}} Maybe it can help Xingqiu?
:{{A|vo rcjeq004 2 kazuha 10.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' Ah, by the way, you mentioned that your friend has been struggling because he's unable to sign his name quickly, right?
:{{A|vo rcjeq004 2 kazuha 11.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' In Liyue and Inazuma, there is a saying: "that which has been stamped has also been signed." Perhaps using a seal could be a feasible solution.
:{{A|vo rcjeq004 2 kazuha 12.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' While sailing at sea, I sometimes carve things to pass the time. If you wish to create a stamp for his seal, I might be able to help.
:{{A|vo rcjeq004 2 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wow, that's an idea! Quick, let's go tell Albedo.
;(Obtain {{Item|The Five Kasen's Splendor: Akahito}})
{{Dialogue End}}

:{{A|vo rcjeq004 3 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Albedo, we've figured out a way to help Xingqiu!
:{{Black Screen|You tell Albedo everything that happened with Kazuha...}}
:{{A|vo rcjeq004 3 albedo 01.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Interesting... A story of The Five Kasen appears again, and with a timely solution.
:{{A|vo rcjeq004 3 albedo 02.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' A stamped seal, huh? Hmm, let me think.
:{{A|vo rcjeq004 3 albedo 03.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Indeed, it is an efficient solution. If we use a stamp, then Xingqiu won't have to struggle with his handwriting anymore. However...
:{{DIcon}} However?
:{{DIcon}} Is there another problem?
:{{A|vo rcjeq004 3 albedo 04.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Since Xingqiu's signature has been previously revealed to the readers, it would seem insincere if he only used a stamped seal for his new books.
:{{A|vo rcjeq004 3 albedo 05.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' But, I have another idea. Using a seal is a part of it, of course. Let's go to Uyuu Restaurant now to discuss my idea with everyone.
{{Dialogue End}}
{{Quest Description|update|Albedo seems to have figured out a way to help Xingqiu. Go look for Xingqiu in Uyuu Restaurant together with him.}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Approach Xingqiu and the editors behind the desk on the second floor)
:{{A|vo rcjeq004 4 hirayama 01.ogg}} '''Hirayama:''' Yes, that's it, Zhenyu! Your writing has greatly improved today, which means yesterday's intensive training was effective!
:{{A|vo rcjeq004 4 xingqiu 01.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' My apologies, but I simply can't do it anymore. My hands are so sore that I can't even move them anymore... *sigh* I should've known better than to read novels during calligraphy class.
:{{A|vo rcjeq004 4 hirayama 02.ogg}} '''Hirayama:''' You just had a ten-minute break. C'mon, you can do this!
:{{A|vo rcjeq004 4 onodera 01.ogg}} '''Onodera:''' When it comes to pushing a deadline, there is no one more brutal than Mr. Hirayama.
:{{A|vo rcjeq004 4 murata 01.ogg}} '''Murata:''' No wonder Lady Yae would always send the editorial director to handle troublesome authors...
:{{A|vo rcjeq004 4 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Whoa, this is getting scary! It hasn't even been that long and Xingqiu's already zombified.
:{{A|vo rcjeq004 4 albedo 01.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Mr. Hirayama, we found a solution that might just solve our dilemma.
:{{A|vo rcjeq004 4 albedo 02.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' In both Liyue and Inazuma, seals are widely used as the equivalent of a signature. If we use a stamp to leave the author's seal on the books, then we could make the signature process a lot easier.
:{{A|vo rcjeq004 4 albedo 03.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Of course, a seal on its own is not enough. So, I propose that each signature consists of two parts.
:{{A|vo rcjeq004 4 albedo 04.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' First, we'll use a personalized seal. We can simply carve one using Zhenyu's signature as the design.
:{{A|vo rcjeq004 4 albedo 05.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' In addition, I'll also design a simple but elegant pattern that's easy for Zhenyu to write. That way, he will only need to draw a simple pattern on each book.
:{{A|vo rcjeq004 4 hirayama 03.ogg}} '''Hirayama:''' Hmm, let me think...
:{{A|vo rcjeq004 4 hirayama 04.ogg}} '''Hirayama:''' Alright, I think that would work! Not only does it still involve the author's own handwriting, but the result should be very beautiful as well.
:{{A|vo rcjeq004 4 xingqiu 02.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' So what you mean to say is, I've been saved from this predicament?
:{{A|vo rcjeq004 4 onodera 02.ogg}} '''Onodera:''' Mr. Hirayama, it suddenly occurred to me that the reason we gave up on live book signings previously was because it would take too long for the author to sign each book.
:{{A|vo rcjeq004 4 onodera 03.ogg}} '''Onodera:''' But if we adopt Calx's proposed method, we might have enough time to do signatures at the live event.
:{{A|vo rcjeq004 4 onodera 04.ogg}} '''Onodera:''' And if all the authors signed their books in the same fashion, then Zhenyu's signature wouldn't look out of place.
:{{A|vo rcjeq004 4 albedo 06.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' If you think it's feasible, I would certainly be happy to design signatures for the other authors as well.
:{{A|vo rcjeq004 4 kazuha 01.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' Yes, and you may leave carving the stamps to me.
:{{A|vo rcjeq004 4 hirayama 05.ogg}} '''Hirayama:''' In that case, I shall contact the other two authors participating in the new release event.
:{{Black Screen|Shortly after, the two other authors arrive...}}
:{{A|vo rcjeq004 4 satomi 01.ogg}} '''Satomi:''' It is a great honor to use a signature designed by Calx.
:{{A|vo rcjeq004 4 kadenokojikenzaburou 01.ogg}} '''Kadenokouji Kenzaburou:''' My pen name is quite complicated and isn't suitable for signing events. However, if we implement this new format, then it'll be a dream come true for me as well.
:{{A|vo rcjeq004 4 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Great! Looks like everyone's on board with the idea.
:{{A|vo rcjeq004 4 hirayama 06.ogg}} '''Hirayama:''' I'm sorry to have kept you busy for so long, Zhenyu. Please, take the next few days to have a good rest. We'll handle everything from here.
:{{A|vo rcjeq004 4 hirayama 07.ogg}} '''Hirayama:''' The books that Zhenyu already signed can be used as special prizes in future events held by the Yae Publishing House.
:{{A|vo rcjeq004 4 onodera 05.ogg}} '''Onodera:''' Phew... we did it, the event is saved!
:{{A|vo rcjeq004 4 xingqiu 03.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' Thanks to everyone's efforts, Onodera and I are finally free of that mess.
:{{A|vo rcjeq004 4 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hehe, that's right! You're finally free, Xingqiu. Maybe you should step outside for some fresh air.

;(Talk to Onodera, Murata, and Hirayama again)
:{{A|vo dialog rcjeq004 hirayama 01.ogg}} '''Hirayama:''' Onodera, please inform Lady Yae of the changes in the event planning when you have a moment. She will surely like to hear about our new idea.
:{{A|vo dialog rcjeq004 hirayama 02.ogg}} '''Hirayama:''' You're a quick thinker, Onodera. As long as you exercise a little prudence, you'll be able to achieve great things in the future.
:{{A|vo dialog rcjeq004 onodera 01.ogg}} '''Onodera:''' Uh, got it. Thank you very much, Mr. Hirayama.
:{{A|vo dialog rcjeq004 murata 01.ogg}} '''Murata:''' I suppose this is all a blessing in disguise, isn't it? I'm sure readers will be thrilled to hear that the release event will also have a book signing.{{Dialogue End}}
{{Quest Description|update|Albedo's method has successfully rescued Xingqiu and Onodera from a crisis. It's time to leave Uyuu Restaurant.}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Leave Uyuu Restaurant){{Dialogue End}}
{{Quest Description|update|Having resolved Xingqiu's autograph crisis, time to discuss further plans outside.}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Arrive at the entrance to Uyuu Restaurant)<!-- using "Arrive" because you can arrive naturally and instantly by leaving through the door or you can arrive by coming over from a Teleport Waypoint -->
:{{A|vo rcjeq004 5 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hmm, we still have some time to burn, where should we go next?
:{{A|vo rcjeq004 5 ayaka 01.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' Traveler, there you are.
:{{A|vo rcjeq004 5 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, it's Ayaka and Venti... That's an interesting combo.
:{{A|vo rcjeq004 5 ayaka 02.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' I was just going to the festival venue to prepare the ikebana lesson, when I found a strange piece of paper on a flower stand.
:{{A|vo rcjeq004 5 ayaka 03.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' This bard just happened to be close by at the time. He informed me that you've also found similar papers recently. As such, we came together to find you two.
:{{A|vo rcjeq004 5 venti 01.ogg}} '''Venti:''' But the paper she found isn't quite the same as the ones we found before.
:{{A|vo rcjeq004 5 ayaka 04.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' Here's the paper. Please, have a look.
;(Open [[The Five Kasen's Splendor: Sumizome]])
:{{A|vo rcjeq004 5 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh, all the poems we found before were roughly the same length, but this one is only two lines!
:{{A|vo rcjeq004 5 albedo 01.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' And even though there are only two short sentences, neither of them are next to the title or centered on the page.
:{{A|vo rcjeq004 5 albedo 02.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Hmm, the position of the writing seems to indicate that there is other content written on this paper besides these two lines.
:{{A|vo rcjeq004 5 xingqiu 01.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' If we take the poem literally, it reads, "Dip this paper in water, and see the truth naturally appear."
:{{A|vo rcjeq004 5 xingqiu 02.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' Speaking of which, I have an ancient text at home, specializing in ancient and exotic stories. It mentions a special ink that will show itself when wet, and disappear when it's dry.
:{{A|vo rcjeq004 5 venti 02.ogg}} '''Venti:''' So, shall we give it a whirl? It just so happens that there is a pond nearby.
;(Obtain {{Item|The Five Kasen's Splendor: Sumizome}})
{{Dialogue End}}
{{Quest Description|update|The new tale of The Five Kasen seems to hint at needing to submerge the paper underwater. Well, might as well give it a shot.}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Approach the pond)
:{{Black Screen|You carefully dip the paper into the water...}}
:{{A|vo rcjeq004 6 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wow, look! It's really working, more words have appeared on the paper!
:{{A|vo rcjeq004 6 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Let Paimon see what it says!
;(Open [[The Five Kasen's Splendor: Sumizome]])
:{{A|vo rcjeq004 6 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hmm, the story says that after Sumizome got the collection of poems from Akahito and put them into a stream of water...
:{{A|vo rcjeq004 6 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' The plagiarized words in the poem became blurry... Huh, why would that happen?
:{{A|vo rcjeq004 6 ayaka 01.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' You see, Paimon, in the past, when printing was not yet well-developed, handwritten text could easily become smudged in books when exposed to moisture.
:{{A|vo rcjeq004 6 ayaka 02.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' To ensure the text lasted longer, they'd either write using a special ink or coat the paper's surface with a waterproof coating once the writing was finished.
:{{A|vo rcjeq004 6 ayaka 03.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' Such special inks are time-consuming and laborious to produce, and the waterproof coating could also prove just as difficult.
:{{A|vo rcjeq004 6 ayaka 04.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' However, since Akahito's poetry collection was an important gift to be presented to the Shogun, surely one of those two methods was used to protect it.
:{{A|vo rcjeq004 6 ayaka 05.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' But as for the plagiarized poems, not only would they lack Akahito's seal, but the words would also react differently when exposed to liquid.
:{{DIcon}} So this poem wasn't written by Akahito.
:{{DIcon}} It was added later by someone else.
:{{A|vo rcjeq004 6 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' *gasp* Which means Akahito didn't plagiarize his work! He was set up!
:{{A|vo rcjeq004 6 albedo 01.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Yes, it appears that this is the truth that Sumizome's story is trying to convey.
:{{A|vo rcjeq004 6 albedo 02.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Although the story is saddening, I've decided on the subjects to use for Akahito and Sumizome's portraits.
:{{A|vo rcjeq004 6 albedo 03.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Kazuha, Ayaka, would you be willing to be the models for my paintings?
:{{A|vo rcjeq004 6 ayaka 06.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' I would be delighted.
:{{A|vo rcjeq004 6 kazuha 01.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' Yes, as would I.
:{{A|vo rcjeq004 6 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' There you go! The next two portraits should be ready in no time!
:{{A|vo rcjeq004 6 albedo 04.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Yes, and now that all four stories have all been collected, the story of The Five Kasen is now fully completed.

;(A [[#Cutscene|cutscene]] plays)

::'''Yae Miko:''' People bestowed upon them the title of The Five Kasen

::'''Venti:''' And presented the Kasen's work for the Shogun's perusal

::'''Venti:''' And vaguely recalled a mysterious figure approaching while he was intoxicated
::'''Xingqiu:''' That figure was none other than Aoi no Okina himself
::'''Xingqiu:''' This turn of events had begun with an unnamed individual
::'''Xingqiu:''' Under whose coercion Aoi no Okina was forced
::'''Xingqiu:''' To take drastic measures to retrieve a page of poetry
::'''Xingqiu:''' He knew nothing
::'''Xingqiu:''' Of this individual's true intentions
::'''Xingqiu:''' All he knew was that
::'''Xingqiu:''' The poem had to do with an old acquaintance, Akahito

::'''Kaedahara Kazuha:''' And yet one of the poems he had submitted the previous year

::'''Kaedahara Kazuha:''' Akahito was exiled for his crimes
::'''Kaedahara Kazuha:''' And only four of the Five Kasen remained

::'''Kamisato Ayaka:''' She immersed his poetry in a stream nearby
::'''Kamisato Ayaka:''' And only on the plagiarized poem
::'''Kamisato Ayaka:''' Did the ink run
::'''Kamisato Ayaka:''' Aoi no Okina passed by
::'''Kamisato Ayaka:''' And witnessed Sumizome's doing

;(Cutscene ends)
:{{Black Screen|Soon after, Albedo completes the two portraits...}}
:{{A|vo rcjeq004 7 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh... *sigh*
:{{DIcon}} Paimon, what's wrong?
:{{DIcon}} You seem upset, Paimon.
:{{A|vo rcjeq004 7 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yeah... Ever since we completed the story of The Five Kasen, there's still one thing Paimon hasn't been able to figure out.
:{{A|vo rcjeq004 7 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' One of The Five Kasen is called Kuronushi, right?
:{{A|vo rcjeq004 7 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' It's just that... How could the story of The Five Kasen finish without him appearing at all?
:{{A|vo rcjeq004 7 venti 01.ogg}} '''Venti:''' Oh, hahaha! Have you really not noticed?
:{{A|vo rcjeq004 7 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh? Not noticed what? Ugh, this is no time to be playing games, Tone-Deaf Bard!
:{{A|vo rcjeq004 7 albedo 01.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' What he means is that the story of Kuronushi was already embedded within the four poems.
:{{A|vo rcjeq004 7 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh, really?
:{{A|vo rcjeq004 7 venti 02.ogg}} '''Venti:''' That's right. The key lies in the poem that Aoi no Okina wrote after seeing Sumizome rinsing the poetry collection.
:{{A|vo rcjeq004 7 venti 03.ogg}} '''Venti:''' An average person could never understand the scene of a young girl washing Akahito's poetry collection in a stream.
:{{A|vo rcjeq004 7 venti 04.ogg}} '''Venti:''' Even Aoi no Okina couldn't figure out the meaning behind Sumizome's actions. He was simply reminiscing and thinking about his old acquaintances.
:{{A|vo rcjeq004 7 venti 05.ogg}} '''Venti:''' However, for the perpetrator who framed Akahito, it was completely obvious.
:{{A|vo rcjeq004 7 venti 06.ogg}} '''Venti:''' He was worried that if this poem was seen by the Shogun, then the Shogun could discover the truth behind the plagiarism incident. If that happened, then he'd be finished.
:{{A|vo rcjeq004 7 venti 07.ogg}} '''Venti:''' So in desperation, he threatened Aoi no Okina to make him tear out this poem.
:{{A|vo rcjeq004 7 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Which means... the one who threatened Aoi no Okina is the same person that framed Akahito!
:{{DIcon}} The culprit is none other than Kuronushi.
:{{A|vo rcjeq004 7 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What, Kuronushi!?
:{{A|vo rcjeq004 7 venti 08.ogg}} '''Venti:''' That's right. Though there are only four poems, they still manage to tell the complete story of all five kasen.
:{{A|vo rcjeq004 7 venti 09.ogg}} '''Venti:''' Since the Shogun mentioned in the poems is certainly not one of The Five Kasen, the only character left is the mysterious one with an unknown identity.
:{{A|vo rcjeq004 7 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ohh, okay... Paimon is finally starting to get it now.
:{{A|vo rcjeq004 7 albedo 02.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' However, this also brings something else to mind.
:{{A|vo rcjeq004 7 albedo 03.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' The story of The Five Kasen has more or less reflected everything that has been happening around us lately.
:{{A|vo rcjeq004 7 albedo 04.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Which begs the question... Is there a Kuronushi in our world as well?
:{{A|vo rcjeq004 7 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' A Kuronushi... In our world?
:{{A|vo rcjeq004 7 venti 10.ogg}} '''Venti:''' Speaking of which, I wonder if our dear Kazuha has come up with anything.
:{{A|vo rcjeq004 7 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh right, Kazuha! He's been pretty quiet this whole time. Let's ask him!
{{Dialogue End}}
{{Quest Description|update|Kazuha seems to have nothing this whole time. Has he been reminded of something?}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Talk to Kazuha)
:{{A|vo rcjeq004 8 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hey, Kazuha! Are you okay? You've been standing in front of this blank canvas for a while... and you don't look so good.
:{{A|vo rcjeq004 8 albedo 01.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Apologies for making a wild assumption, but has the story of The Five Kasen reminded you of anything?
:{{A|vo rcjeq004 8 kazuha 01.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' Yes, a few things did come to mind, actually. However, they were nothing more than some past incidents regarding my family.
:{{A|vo rcjeq004 8 kazuha 02.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' I don't mind sharing the stories, but I'd prefer not to bring you any more trouble.
:{{A|vo rcjeq004 8 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hey, we're all friends here, Kazuha. You can always tell us whatever's on your mind.
:{{A|vo rcjeq004 8 ayaka 01.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' Kaedehara, please forgive my assumption, but perhaps you are thinking of the [[Raiden Gokaden]]?
:{{A|vo rcjeq004 8 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' The "Raiden Gokaden"? What's that?
:{{A|vo rcjeq004 8 kazuha 03.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' It appears that Miss Kamisato and I were thinking of the same thing.
:{{A|vo rcjeq004 8 kazuha 04.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' But it also has much to do with the [[Yashiro Commission]]. It would be improper to speak of it here without the consent of Miss Kamisato.
:{{A|vo rcjeq004 8 ayaka 02.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' It's fine. Those of us here are all trustworthy, so there isn't any harm in it.
:{{A|vo rcjeq004 8 ayaka 03.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' However, this matter is somewhat complicated and may be difficult to explain. Let me start with the Raiden Gokaden.
:{{A|vo rcjeq004 8 ayaka 04.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' As you all know, the Yashiro Commission's primary purpose is managing ceremonial and cultural affairs, and Inazuma's art of forging swords is a very important part of our culture.
:{{A|vo rcjeq004 8 ayaka 05.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' The Raiden Gokaden were once the top five schools of the forging art in Inazuma. Although these families were swordsmiths by craft, they also held many important positions in the Yashiro Commission.
:{{A|vo rcjeq004 8 ayaka 06.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' Unfortunately, of the five, only the [[Amenoma Art]] still maintains its artisan lineage. The descendants of the [[Raiden Gokaden#Isshin Art|Isshin Art]] are also still alive, but the craft has been lost to time.
:{{A|vo rcjeq004 8 ayaka 07.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' The descendants of the Isshin Art are none other than the [[Kaedehara Clan|Kaedehara family]].
:{{A|vo rcjeq004 8 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Whoa! We knew Kazuha came from a noble family, but we had no idea about his connection to the Yashiro Commission and sword making.
:{{A|vo rcjeq004 8 kazuha 05.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' Yes, but that's all part of the past now. The Isshin Art was lost with my great grandfather's generation.
:{{A|vo rcjeq004 8 kazuha 06.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' My grandfather was dissatisfied with my great-grandfather's lack of effort. When he was young, my grandfather traveled all over Teyvat to find a way to revive the family business, but it was to no avail.
:{{A|vo rcjeq004 8 kazuha 07.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' And in my generation, our last remaining family property was lost as well.
:{{A|vo rcjeq004 8 ayaka 08.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' I heard my elder brother mention that the decline of the Raiden Gokaden happened very rapidly. In a span of a few decades, three of the families suffered various misfortunes and disappeared completely.
:{{A|vo rcjeq004 8 ayaka 09.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' Later, there was speculation that all of these misfortunes stemmed from some background machinations, meaning that someone wanted to wipe out the Raiden Gokaden.
:{{A|vo rcjeq004 8 ayaka 10.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' However, since not every family of the Raiden Gokaden came to ruin, such explanations were treated as nothing more than a conspiracy theory.
:{{A|vo rcjeq004 8 kazuha 08.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' Indeed, I've also believed such ideas were just theories and rumors.
:{{A|vo rcjeq004 8 kazuha 09.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' However, I know that a major incident happened to my great-grandfather when he was young.
:{{A|vo rcjeq004 8 kazuha 10.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' Not only did it affect the Kaedehara Clan, but it nearly jeopardized the Kamisato Clan's position in the Yashiro Commission as well.
:{{A|vo rcjeq004 8 kazuha 11.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' After reading the story of The Five Kasen, I can't help but feel like it's pointing me toward the truth behind that incident.
:{{A|vo rcjeq004 8 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What exactly happened to your great-grandfather, Kazuha?
:{{A|vo rcjeq004 8 kazuha 12.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' I still can't say, I need to speak with someone to verify the details. Let's meet here again at noon tomorrow.
:{{A|vo rcjeq004 8 kazuha 13.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' I will tell you everything I know then.
;(Quest ends)

;(Examine Akahito's Likeness)
:'''Akahito's Likeness:''' (This is Akahito's likeness, as done by Albedo.)
:'''Akahito's Likeness:''' (Kazuha was the model for this picture, and it shows Akahito, his garments red in his trademark style, kneeling before the throne as he is being punished by the Shogun.)
:'''Akahito's Likeness:''' ("Won't this image bring ill luck?" Someone asked, but neither the artist nor the model thought that this was a problem.)

;(Examine Sumizome's Likeness)
:'''Sumizome's Likeness:''' (This is Sumizome's likeness, as done by Albedo.)
:'''Sumizome's Likeness:''' (Ayaka was the model for this picture, and it depicts Sumizome rinsing the poetry collection in water, with a little extra flair, of course.)
:'''Sumizome's Likeness:''' ("You know, the Sumizome drawn here really looks like the Shirasagi Himegimi," so most of the guests have said. This portrait has also proved the most popular in terms of photos taken with it.)

;(Examine Portrait Canvas)
:'''Portrait Canvas:''' (A blank canvas which will soon be used to draw a lovely picture of one of the Five Kasen.)
{{Dialogue End}}

'''''A New Pilgrimage''''' is the second quest in {{Quest|As the Blazing Sun}}.

==Steps==
# Return to the [[Stadium of the Sacred Flame]]
# Test the competition process for [[Iansan]]<!--
-->{{Enemy List|Secret Source Automaton: Hunter-Seeker*1}}
# Try out the ball launcher with [[Mavuika]]
# Talk to [[Iansan]]
# Dine with Mavuika
# Return to your accommodation and rest
# Go to the Stadium with Mavuika
# Encourage the contestants
# Report the results to Mavuika
# Watch the match
# Leave the Stadium of the Sacred Flame

==Gameplay Notes==
* During steps 2 and 7, the active party will be limited to a trial [[Mavuika]].
* During steps 3 and 8–9, the active party will be limited to the [[Traveler]], automatically switched to the Pyro element.
* During step 6–11, the player will enter [[Special Story Mode]]. Upon leaving this mode, the player will have to restart from the beginning of step 6 again.

==Dialogue==
{{Quest Description|Accepting the commission of the Tianshu, [[Uncle Tian]], [[Ganyu]] very naturally slips into her work mode, coming to the aid of her junior colleague Huixin with ease in the latter's time of need. To express her thanks, Huixin invites you all to Xinyue Kiosk to have a meal...}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Approach Huixin)
:{{A|vo gylq003 2 huixin 01.ogg}} '''Huixin:''' Ms. Ganyu, thank you for accepting my invitation. And as for the two of you, your presence is also much appreciated.
:{{A|vo gylq003 2 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Sure!
:{{A|vo gylq003 2 ganyu 01.ogg}} '''Ganyu:''' That's so kind of you, Huixin. You went to great lengths to organize this.
:{{A|vo gylq003 2 huixin 02.ogg}} '''Huixin:''' Ha, truth be told... Apart from thanking you for all the help, there's something I'd like to tell you...
:{{A|vo gylq003 2 ganyu 02.ogg}} '''Ganyu:''' Oh? If there's anything I can help you with, just tell me straight away. No need to hesitate.
:{{A|vo gylq003 2 huixin 03.ogg}} '''Huixin:''' Ah... No, no, I don't really need help. Uh... Could you just listen for a bit?
:{{A|vo gylq003 2 ganyu 03.ogg}} '''Ganyu:''' With pleasure.
:{{A|vo gylq003 2 huixin 04.ogg}} '''Huixin:''' Ha... When I was a little girl, my father used to tell me many stories about you, Ms. Ganyu.
:{{A|vo gylq003 2 huixin 05.ogg}} '''Huixin:''' Even though I have the utmost respect for my father... I always admired how gentle and reliable you are.
:{{A|vo gylq003 2 huixin 06.ogg}} '''Huixin:''' I only decided to join the [[Yuehai Pavilion]] staff because I've always looked up to you.
:{{A|vo gylq003 2 ganyu 04.ogg}} '''Ganyu:''' I didn't know that you think so highly of me.
:{{A|vo gylq003 2 huixin 07.ogg}} '''Huixin:''' However, in reality, working at the Yuehai Pavilion turned out to be an arduous task.
:{{A|vo gylq003 2 huixin 08.ogg}} '''Huixin:''' I can't compare myself to such an outstanding secretary like you. I often doubt myself as a result...
:{{A|vo gylq003 2 ganyu 05.ogg}} '''Ganyu:''' I disagree. You're a great secretary in your own right.
:{{A|vo gylq003 2 huixin 09.ogg}} '''Huixin:''' Aha, thank you.
:{{A|vo gylq003 2 huixin 10.ogg}} '''Huixin:''' Over the years, I became a mother, too...
:{{A|vo gylq003 2 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh! So Uncle Tian is a grandpa!
:{{A|vo gylq003 2 huixin 11.ogg}} '''Huixin:''' Influenced by my youthful ideals, she followed my footsteps and came to be a secretary at the Yuehai Pavilion, too.
:{{A|vo gylq003 2 huixin 12.ogg}} '''Huixin:''' At first, I was worried about her. It's not an easy job, after all. To tell the truth, I'm still unsure if she's capable enough.
:{{A|vo gylq003 2 huixin 13.ogg}} '''Huixin:''' But after all that happened this time, I've... made up my mind to support her choice.
:{{A|vo gylq003 2 ganyu 06.ogg}} '''Ganyu:''' So, what made you change your mind?
:{{A|vo gylq003 2 huixin 14.ogg}} '''Huixin:''' The fact that she'll have you, Ms. Ganyu, as her senior colleague.
:{{A|vo gylq003 2 huixin 15.ogg}} '''Huixin:''' You'll help her, gentle as always, and tell her, "Your mom used to do it like that." Heh.
:{{A|vo gylq003 2 huixin 16.ogg}} '''Huixin:''' It'd be such a beautiful moment.
:{{A|vo gylq003 2 huixin 17.ogg}} '''Huixin:''' If it's not too much to ask for, she might still need your guidance in twenty plus years, too.
:{{A|vo gylq003 2 ganyu 07.ogg}} '''Ganyu:''' Huixin...
:{{A|vo gylq003 2 ganyu 08.ogg}} '''Ganyu:''' I... I never thought that I meant so much to you.
:{{A|vo gylq003 2 huixin 18.ogg}} '''Huixin:''' Heh, just like when you showed me my father's trick. Having you as their "witness" makes people feel at ease.
:{{A|vo gylq003 2 ganyu 09.ogg}} '''Ganyu:''' "Witness"...
:{{A|vo gylq003 2 ganyu 10.ogg}} '''Ganyu:''' ...It's true that I've witnessed thousands of years of [[Liyue Harbor]]'s history. All the changes it's gone through, the stories of its people...
:{{A|vo gylq003 2 ganyu 11.ogg}} '''Ganyu:''' But I've always regarded it as nothing more than the source of my loneliness.
:{{A|vo gylq003 2 ganyu 12.ogg}} '''Ganyu:''' Huixin, you don't know how important those words are to me...
:{{A|vo gylq003 2 ganyu 13.ogg}} '''Ganyu:''' You've made me realize that I share another connection with the people of Liyue Harbor, apart from my contract with [[Rex Lapis]].
:{{A|vo gylq003 2 ganyu 14.ogg}} '''Ganyu:''' They rely on me, accept me, and long for me to bear witness to their stories.
:{{A|vo gylq003 2 huixin 19.ogg}} '''Huixin:''' Of course! You're irreplaceable to us!
:{{A|vo gylq003 2 ganyu 15.ogg}} '''Ganyu:''' Ehehe... That's right. That's why I can't disappoint you.
:{{A|vo gylq003 2 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hooray! Ganyu's finally cheered up!
:{{A|vo gylq003 2 ganyu 16.ogg}} '''Ganyu:''' Even if I've really been supplanted, I wish to fight for my place...
:{{A|vo gylq003 2 ganyu 17.ogg}} '''Ganyu:''' I won't let you down. I'm going to fulfill my contract and keep working as the [[Qixing]]'s secretary.
:{{DIcon}} Uh... I told you, you haven't been...
:{{DIcon}} You haven't been fired. It's a misunderstanding.
:{{A|vo gylq003 2 ganyu 18.ogg}} '''Ganyu:''' Regardless, I'll go back and see for myself.
:{{A|vo gylq003 2 ganyu 19.ogg}} '''Ganyu:''' I'm afraid that it might've all become a mess during my absence.
:{{A|vo gylq003 2 ganyu 20.ogg}} '''Ganyu:''' No time to waste — let's get back to work!
:{{A|vo gylq003 2 huixin 20.ogg}} '''Huixin:''' Good luck, Ms. Ganyu!
:{{A|vo gylq003 2 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huuuuh!? We leaving already? Paimon's still hungry!

----
;(Approach the secretaries)
:{{A|vo gylq003 3 baishi 01.ogg}} '''[[Baishi]]:''' Ahhhh...
:{{A|vo gylq003 3 baiwen 01.ogg}} '''[[Baiwen]]:''' Baishi, are you okay? Did you fall asleep standing up?
:{{A|vo gylq003 3 baixiao 01.ogg}} '''[[Baixiao]]:''' Look... Look who's back!
:{{A|vo gylq003 3 ganyu 01.ogg}} '''Ganyu:''' You even have enough time for leisure? It seems you three are a suitable replacement for me after all.
:{{A|vo gylq003 3 baiwen 02.ogg}} '''Baiwen:''' Not at all! We just... We've been working for too long. If we didn't take a break...
:{{A|vo gylq003 3 baixiao 02.ogg}} '''Baixiao:''' We wouldn't have survived long enough to see you again, Ms. Ganyu.
:{{A|vo gylq003 3 baishi 02.ogg}} '''Baishi:''' Ms. Ganyu, we've missed you...
:{{A|vo gylq003 3 ganyu 02.ogg}} '''Ganyu:''' Ehehe. That's so kind of you all, given we've only met once.
:{{A|vo gylq003 3 baiwen 03.ogg}} '''Baiwen:''' We've been praying day and night for you to return and take over your duties again.
:{{A|vo gylq003 3 baishi 03.ogg}} '''Baishi:''' To us, you're like an [[adeptus]] coming down to the human world to save all life.
:{{A|vo gylq003 3 baixiao 03.ogg}} '''Baixiao:''' Forget all our envious complaints from before — just free us from this strenuous work, please...
:{{A|vo gylq003 3 ganyu 03.ogg}} '''Ganyu:''' Alright, alright, I see.
:{{A|vo gylq003 3 ganyu 04.ogg}} '''Ganyu:''' Please divide the matters at hand into government affairs, business affairs, and civil affairs. Mark out the tasks that haven't been started and those that are in progress...
:{{A|vo gylq003 3 ganyu 05.ogg}} '''Ganyu:''' I'll take care of the rest.
:{{A|vo gylq003 3 baiwen 04.ogg}} '''Baiwen:''' Of course! We'll do it right away!
:{{A|vo gylq003 3 baishi 04.ogg}} '''Baishi:''' Finally... We're saved...
:{{A|vo gylq003 3 ganyu 06.ogg}} '''Ganyu:''' Ah, yes, there's one more thing.
:{{A|vo gylq003 3 ganyu 07.ogg}} '''Ganyu:''' I'd like to earnestly thank you, Traveler. If it weren't for your companionship, I would still be embroiled in my inner conflict right now.
:{{DIcon}} It was a fun adventure for me, too.
:{{DIcon}} It's good that you've pulled yourself together.
:{{A|vo gylq003 3 ganyu 08.ogg}} '''Ganyu:''' Hehe, to think that I'd gain a human friend outside of work. It makes me happier than I could've imagined.
:{{A|vo gylq003 3 ganyu 09.ogg}} '''Ganyu:''' I'd like to repay you when I'm done with the work at hand. What would you say if I... accompanied you on one of your trips?
:{{A|vo gylq003 3 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Sure, but... are you ever done with work, Ganyu?
:{{A|vo gylq003 3 ganyu 10.ogg}} '''Ganyu:''' Hm...
:{{A|vo gylq003 3 ganyu 11.ogg}} '''Ganyu:''' Uh, let's cross that bridge when we come to it, shall we...
{{Dialogue End}}

{{Quest Description|Kamisato Ayaka seems to have something to discuss with you. Meet up for a chat with her at Komore Teahouse.}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Upon arriving at the outside of Komore Teahouse)
:{{A|vo aylq001 2 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hmm, where do we go from here...? What's the plan?
:{{A|vo aylq001 2 ayaka 01.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' Traveler, Paimon. Hold on.
:{{A|vo aylq001 2 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh? Ayaka?
:{{DIcon}} What's the matter?
:{{A|vo aylq001 2 ayaka 02.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' Something has come up, and I would like to request your assistance.
:{{A|vo aylq001 2 ayaka 03.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' But you ought not be nervous. This is not coming from the [[Yashiro Commission]] or the [[Kamisato Clan]]. It is my own individual request.
:{{A|vo aylq001 2 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Individual request? You mean... personal stuff?
:{{A|vo aylq001 2 ayaka 04.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' Correct. It concerns my mother.
:{{A|vo aylq001 2 ayaka 05.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' This may seem a little sudden... but in my view, you are the only person I can entrust this to.
:{{DIcon}} Can you give me any more details?
:{{A|vo aylq001 2 ayaka 06.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' A few days ago, I was sorting through some old family belongings when I found a notebook that belonged to my mother.
:{{A|vo aylq001 2 ayaka 07.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' She wrote about all kinds of things, mostly of little consequence. But what drew my attention was a name — it is one that I have never heard before, so the fact that she mentions it so frequently... it makes it difficult for me to ignore...

::{{A|vo dllq002 7 durin 07.ogg}} '''Durin:''' But despite the immense distances between them, there was always one topic that kept cropping up — your accomplishments.
::{{A|vo dllq002 7 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hehe... Well, we are world-renowned adventurers, after all!
::{{A|vo dllq002 7 durin 08.ogg}} '''Durin:''' Come to think of it... Isn't a wandering hero basically the same thing as an adventurer?
::{{A|vo dllq002 7 durin 09.ogg}} '''Durin:''' I've always thought of adventurers as people who chase after stories, and in doing so, they also leave behind many of their own.
::{{A|vo dllq002 7 durin 10.ogg}} '''Durin:''' I'd like to become someone like that too.
:{{DIcon}} Let's keep looking.

;(Observe the "scholar's tome")
:'''Observe:''' (A tome. The ideal gift for a budding scholar.)
:{{DIcon}} Let's go with this one.
::{{A|vo dllq002 7 m 03.ogg}} '''Narrator:''' In the end, the guests settled on... the scholar's tome.
::{{A|vo dllq002 7 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So you're the scholarly type, huh?
::{{A|vo dllq002 7 durin 11.ogg}} '''Durin:''' I just feel like... I should learn more about the way the world works.
::{{A|vo dllq002 7 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What makes you say that?
::{{A|vo dllq002 7 durin 12.ogg}} '''Durin:''' Um... I'll give you an example. Did you know that in Mondstadt, using fire to catch fish is a punishable offense?
::{{DIcon}} I'm guessing... [[Klee]] took you fish blasting?
::{{A|vo dllq002 7 durin 13.ogg}} '''Durin:''' I thought she was just teaching me regular hunting techniques. It was only after Master [[Jean]] caught me and sent me to solitary confinement that I realized I'd misread the situation...
::{{A|vo dllq002 7 durin 14.ogg}} '''Durin:''' So much of what's considered common knowledge in your world just wasn't in Simulanka. So, I have to learn, or I'll keep causing trouble for everyone else.
::{{A|vo dllq002 7 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Uh... Paimon's not sure that counts as "common" knowledge...
:{{DIcon}} Let's keep looking.

;(Observe all 3 objects but keep looking, optional)
:{{A|vo dllq002 6 m 05.ogg}} '''Narrator:''' The guests hesitated, and not without good reason. Given how much this gift would mean to the little dragon, a bit of careful thought could go a long way...

;(Approach the center table after choosing a gift)
:{{A|vo dllq002 8 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Alright, they should let us in now that we've got a gift, right?
:{{A|vo dllq002 8 durin 01.ogg}} '''Durin:''' Hello there. Brought a gift this time.
;(If the sword was chosen)
::{{A|vo dllq002 8 m 01.ogg}} '''Narrator:''' The newly arrived guest presented his gift, wishing the little dragon a future as an indomitable warrior.
;(If the slingshot was chosen)
::{{A|vo dllq002 8 m 02.ogg}} '''Narrator:''' The newly arrived guest presented his gift, wishing the little dragon a future as a wandering hero, free and unburdened.
;(If the tome was chosen)
::{{A|vo dllq002 8 m 03.ogg}} '''Narrator:''' The newly arrived guest presented his gift, wishing the little dragon a future as a wise and accomplished scholar.
:{{A|vo dllq002 8 m 04.ogg}} '''Narrator:''' Accepting the guest's blessing, the story-witch invited him and his friends to take their place around the table.
:{{A|vo dllq002 8 m 05.ogg}} '''Narrator:''' Finally, she could introduce them all to her dragon-child, telling all in attendance about the moment of his hatching, and of course, the name he'd been given...
:{{A|vo dllq002 8 m 06.ogg}} '''Narrator:''' It was then that the [[Barbeloth|seer-witch]], diviner of the stars, withdrew her gaze from the heavens and turned a sorrowful glance upon the little dragon.
:{{A|vo dllq002 8 b 01.ogg}} '''Seer-Witch:''' You gave him the same name as that evil dragon?
:{{A|vo dllq002 8 m 07.ogg}} '''Story-Witch:''' That's right. But the life I intend for him shall be very different.
:{{A|vo dllq002 8 b 02.ogg}} '''Seer-Witch:''' What folly, to love so blindly — for as you must know, a name is the mirror of destiny itself. He who bears an [[Durin (NPC)|evil dragon]]'s name must also inherit the fate of its previous owner.
:{{A|vo dllq002 8 b 03.ogg}} '''Seer-Witch:''' His fate... has been foretold.
:{{A|vo dllq002 8 m 08.ogg}} '''Story-Witch:''' ...Then I'll rewrite it.
:{{A|vo dllq002 8 m 09.ogg}} '''Narrator:''' The witches at the table fell silent, for they knew the seer-witch's words had never once proven wrong.
:{{A|vo dllq002 8 m 10.ogg}} '''Narrator:''' Yet just as clearly, they recognized the story-witch's resolve, for there is scarce a force in this world more fearsome than a mother's love.
:{{A|vo dllq002 8 m 11.ogg}} '''Narrator:''' At last, the [[Alice|merry-witch]] stepped forward, dispelling the uneasy silence.
:{{A|vo dllq002 8 alice 01.ogg}} '''Merry-Witch:''' So be it — then we'll all lend a hand. Together, we shall rewrite this child's fate!
:{{A|vo dllq002 8 b 04.ogg}} '''Seer-Witch:''' You mean to defy one of the fundamental rules of this world?
:{{A|vo dllq002 8 alice 02.ogg}} '''Merry-Witch:''' I refuse to be shackled by such "rules." Besides, this is a witches' gathering, is it not? What could be more fitting a subject for this occasion than to defy them?
:{{A|vo dllq002 8 rhinedottir 01.ogg}} '''Sage-Witch:''' Oh? Sounds like an interesting experiment...
:{{A|vo dllq002 8 b 05.ogg}} '''Seer-Witch:''' I suppose, were we to succeed in this endeavor, we might bring a touch of wonder to this otherwise dreary sky of stars...
:{{A|vo dllq002 8 m 12.ogg}} '''Narrator:''' The merry-witch finally talked them all round, just like she had done many times before.
:{{A|vo dllq002 8 m 13.ogg}} '''Narrator:''' Warm and strong as the sun she was — so much so, in fact, that those who her light shined down upon had no choice but to bask in it.
:{{A|vo dllq002 8 m 14.ogg}} '''Narrator:''' And so the witches readied their gifts, three marvels of the cosmos.
:{{A|vo dllq002 8 b 06.ogg}} '''Seer-Witch:''' For this child, I shall decipher the ravings of the heavens and lay bare before him the trickery of fate.
:{{A|vo dllq002 8 rhinedottir 02.ogg}} '''Sage-Witch:''' For this child, [[Rhinedottir|I]] shall leave a formula powerful enough to unravel the very origins of this world, that he may seek another solution for the conundrum of his life.
:{{A|vo dllq002 8 alice 03.ogg}} '''Merry-Witch:''' For this child, I shall call upon wondrous magic to make possible his impossible wish.
:{{A|vo dllq002 8 m 15.ogg}} '''Narrator:''' All the story-witch had was the pen in her hand, yet with the love that flowed from it, she resolved to bring forth a marvel of her own.
:{{A|vo dllq002 8 m 16.ogg}} '''Story-Witch:''' For this child, I shall leave behind the last story I will ever write, and with it, a path to an ending yet untold.
:{{A|vo dllq002 8 m 17.ogg}} '''Narrator:''' With the witches' blessings given and received, the little dragon's fate at last began to turn.
:{{A|vo dllq002 8 m 18.ogg}} In the midst of the dragon-child's birthday celebration, the seer-witch proclaimed her prophecy.
:{{A|vo dllq002 8 m 19.ogg}} The child had been given the evil dragon's name — and with it, the burden of its fate.
:{{A|vo dllq002 8 m 20.ogg}} But hearing this, the story-witch vowed to rewrite it all, for such was her love and resolve.
:{{A|vo dllq002 8 m 21.ogg}} And so the other witches offered their gifts in turn, marvels as rare as any in the cosmos.
:{{A|vo dllq002 8 m 22.ogg}} Together, they sought to test one of the fundamental laws of this world — in part to support a mother's love, and in part to sate their own curiosity.
:{{A|vo dllq002 8 m 23.ogg}} Oh, and I almost forgot! Our new guests came bearing blessings of their own.
;(If the sword was chosen)
::{{A|vo dllq002 8 m 24.ogg}} Who knows, perhaps this extra bit of courage might be all the little dragon needs to change his fate?
;(If the slingshot was chosen)
::{{A|vo dllq002 8 m 25.ogg}} Who knows, perhaps this extra spark of life might be all the little dragon needs to change his fate?
;(If the tome was chosen)
::{{A|vo dllq002 8 m 26.ogg}} Who knows, perhaps this extra dash of wisdom might be all the little dragon needs to change his fate?
:{{Black Screen|The witches readied their gifts, three marvels of the cosmos.}}
:;(The Traveler, Paimon, and Durin are released from the story world)
:{{A|vo dllq002 9 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yep... Looks like we've completed this chapter, too.
:{{A|vo dllq002 9 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Those witches in the story were the mages of the [[Hexenzirkel]], right? They sure seemed to care a lot about you, Durin!
:{{A|vo dllq002 9 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' But, uh... Paimon kinda had trouble following their conversation. Just a bunch of mystery, as usual...
:{{A|vo dllq002 9 durin 01.ogg}} '''Durin:''' The evil dragon's fate...
:{{A|vo dllq002 9 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ohhh, is that what you're worried about? But... didn't we already take care of that?
:{{DIcon}} Yeah, after what happened in Simulanka...
:{{DIcon}} With everyone's blessings...
:{{A|vo dllq002 9 durin 02.ogg}} '''Durin:''' Ahh... The mages must have had a hand in that too.
:{{A|vo dllq002 9 durin 03.ogg}} '''Durin:''' Also, I was just thinking... Which part of the story are we even meant to be "completing"?
:{{A|vo dllq002 9 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, um...
:{{DIcon}} That's a good question...
:{{A|vo dllq002 9 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' It feels less like we're filling in the gaps, and more like we're adding something new altogether...
:{{A|vo dllq002 9 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' But, we used the ink, right? And the book hasn't given us any more clues, so that must mean our task is complete — at least for now.
:{{A|vo dllq002 9 durin 04.ogg}} '''Durin:''' Yeah, I guess we're doing something right...
:{{DIcon}} Don't worry.
:{{DIcon}} Even if we run into trouble, we can always go ask [[Alice]].
:{{A|vo dllq002 9 durin 05.ogg}} '''Durin:''' Hm... Maybe I'm overthinking things. It's just, this is my mother's final wish, so I don't want to mess it up.
:{{A|vo dllq002 9 durin 06.ogg}} '''Durin:''' Anyway, thanks for all your help. I'll let you know as soon as the book reveals a hint about the next chapter.
:{{A|vo dllq002 9 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Okay then! See you in the next chapter!
{{Dialogue End}}

==Steps==

==Dialogue==
{{Quest Description|Within the ruins, [[Kliment]] and [[Wanyan]] each betray the contract in turn for personal reasons. As punishment, Kliment is cast out of the ruin and deprived of his reward. Wanyan is made to witness a truth that shatters her beliefs — the [[God of Salt]] was gentle but weak and was betrayed and slain as a result. Bearing witness to this incident and filled with conflicted feelings as a result, you follow Zhongli back to Guyun Stone Forest.}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Go to Guyun Stone Forest and talk to Zhongli)
:{{A|vo zllq005 1 zhongli 01.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Now, I mentioned before that many gods of old have been sealed beneath the Guyun Stone Forest.
:{{A|vo zllq005 1 zhongli 02.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' The [[adepti]] have presently handed Liyue over to mortals, and Havria's time was even further in the past. The salt chalice and salt ruler that she left behind should not return to Liyue.
:{{A|vo zllq005 1 zhongli 03.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' To leave them here is to let them slumber, and it is also a homecoming...
:{{DIcon}} So, what would you like us to do?
:{{A|vo zllq005 1 zhongli 04.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' I ended an era with my own two hands. I have always wondered how I should... remember that which I ended.
:{{A|vo zllq005 1 zhongli 05.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' History records, but history may be changed. This incident proved that. Time is a mighty force, and histories twist in its flow...
:{{A|vo zllq005 1 zhongli 06.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' I need to find a better way of recording history in order to engrave its truth.
:{{A|vo zllq005 1 zhongli 07.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Stone carvings were one such ancient method. But unchanging stone, immovable earth, even one such as myself... Someday, we may all disappear.
:{{A|vo zllq005 1 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Zhongli...
:{{A|vo zllq005 1 zhongli 08.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Therefore, I thought of you, Traveler.
:{{A|vo zllq005 1 zhongli 09.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' You are one who crosses the celestial atlas, and who passes through countless worlds. If our history is engraved in your memory, it will one day accompany you into another world.
:{{A|vo zllq005 1 zhongli 10.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' As long as a Traveler like you is able to record what happened, then a backup of sorts will exist for times and tides of [[Teyvat]].
:{{DIcon}} So that's why you wanted us to come with you.
::{{A|vo zllq005 1 paimon 02a.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Sounds like tough work.
:{{DIcon}} So you didn't just bring me along to find treasure?
::{{A|vo zllq005 1 zhongli 11b 1.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Hahaha... Well, may you find treasure among the stars even after you have left Teyvat.
::{{A|vo zllq005 1 zhongli 11b 2.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Now, I am the [[Rex Lapis|God of Wealth]], so I would think that my words have some weight here.
:{{A|vo zllq005 1 zhongli 12.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Now then, it is time that we consigned both the salt chalice and salt ruler to the sea.
:{{A|vo zllq005 1 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh? Why do we need to throw them into the sea?
:{{A|vo zllq005 1 zhongli 13.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' As I said before... This is the place to which the remnants of many bygone gods are consigned.
:{{A|vo zllq005 1 zhongli 14.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' This includes [[Osial]], Overlord of the Vortex, who the [[Jade Chamber]] most recently returned to this ocean prison...

{{Cutscene Description|In the sea breeze, Zhongli tells you tales from Liyue's long history. Gazing down at the blue ocean surface and the jagged backdrop of Guyun Stone Forest, Zhongli finally casts, the relics of the God of Salt into the part of the sea where the Overlord of the Vortex lies. Perhaps another spark of divinity has now parted from Liyue, but the question of what it all means will be left to the judgment of those who are yet to come.}}
:;(A cutscene plays)
::{{A|vo zllq004 cs zhongli 01.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Thousands of years ago, the adepti and I fought against the turmoil that plagued every corner of this land.
::{{A|vo zllq004 cs zhongli 03.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Guyun Stone Forest, where I sealed many gods with my spears...
::{{A|vo zllq004 cs zhongli 04.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' After so long, naught but folktales remain.
::{{A|vo zllq004 cs zhongli 05.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Osial... you and I were foes...
::{{A|vo zllq004 cs zhongli 06.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' But our ancient grudge is but a bygone memory now.
::{{A|vo zllq004 cs zhongli 07.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' May that which Havria has left behind be yours to subsume.
::{{A|vo zllq004 cs zhongli 08.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Thus another spark of divinity departs from Liyue.
::{{A|vo zllq004 cs zhongli 09.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' My legacy shall now be left for those who come after to debate.
:;(Cutscene ends)

;(Talk to Zhongli)
:{{A|vo dialog zllq005 zhongli 01.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' I will remain here for a while. I fear that moments of reminiscence like this can only grow fewer.
:{{DIcon}} I feel a bit bad for the God of Salt...
::{{A|vo dialog zllq005 zhongli 02a 1.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' We did not measure right and wrong during the days of the [[Archon War]] in the same manner as we do today.
::{{A|vo dialog zllq005 zhongli 02a 2.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Of course, as I am now... I only wish that she could have lived in a gentler time.
:{{DIcon}} Won't these relics cause Osial to grow in power?
::{{A|vo dialog zllq005 zhongli 02b 1.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Though the salt chalice and salt ruler do have power in their own right, they are nothing before Osial.
::{{A|vo dialog zllq005 zhongli 02b 2.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' If a day comes when he should recover his strength and return... Ha, I believe that even so, he will be defeated once more.
:{{DIcon}} What will you do now?
::{{A|vo dialog zllq005 zhongli 02c 1.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' That is a good question. In the past, I might have given you a most specific answer.
::{{A|vo dialog zllq005 zhongli 02c 2.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' But now... Yes, I suppose I will continue in my role as a consultant at [[Wangsheng Funeral Parlor]].
::{{A|vo dialog zllq005 zhongli 02c 3.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' But if this journey was to your liking, why don't you come along the next time I am seeking to preserve memories of Liyue's past?
{{Dialogue End}}
