==Dialogue==
{{Quest Description|You decide to help Kaveh convince the client to come to his side. However, it seems like the client's trying to hide something from you...}}
===Searching for the Commissioner===
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Use [[Nahida]]'s [[All Schemes to Know]] on Badawi, optional)
:{{A|vo kvcop001 19059 badawi 01.ogg}} '''Badawi:''' (I still need some more Mora...)

;(Approach Badawi)
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1905901 badawi 01.ogg}} '''Badawi:''' Kaveh? What are you doing here...?
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1905901 kaveh 01.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' I—I've changed my mind. Uh... I was overreacting earlier. Can we try discussing the project some more?
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1905901 badawi 02.ogg}} '''Badawi:''' My apologies as well. Now that I think about it, some of my requests were indeed a bit unreasonable.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1905901 badawi 03.ogg}} '''Badawi:''' If I chose you to create the design for my project, I should have a bit more faith in your vision.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1905901 kaveh 02.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Ah, thank you for understanding. Mutual trust is the basis for good communication. Now that we've got that out of the way, I think we can have a more productive conversation.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1905901 kaveh 03.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' To be perfectly honest... your commission request has been the most peculiar one I've ever received.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1905901 kaveh 04.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Even now, I still know nothing about the building's intended purpose. All I know is that you want to build something in the desert for public use.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1905901 kaveh 05.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' I am aware that overly specific requests will restrain the architect's artistic freedom. However, knowing nothing about the intended purpose of the building also means I have no idea if I'm on the right track.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1905901 kaveh 06.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' I've produced several draft proposals for you to choose from, and you've rejected every single one. If we don't get on the same page, it could be a decade before we can finally break ground on this project.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1905901 badawi 04.ogg}} '''Badawi:''' Yes, I've given this some thought already. I think we can go with the general direction of the latest proposal that you just showed me.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1905901 badawi 05.ogg}} '''Badawi:''' It's just...
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1905901 kaveh 07.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Hmm? Just what?
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1905901 badawi 06.ogg}} '''Badawi:''' Putting the building design aside, can we get some less expensive materials for the floor tiles? I know someone in the business, and the red bricks he sells can go for pretty cheap.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1905901 badawi 07.ogg}} '''Badawi:''' The timber here as well. We should be able to find some substitutes...
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1905901 kaveh 08.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Ahh... Please give me a moment, my head's starting to hurt again. Just please hold on for a second...
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1905901 kaveh 09.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' So, let me get this straight, you want to reduce the cost of the project, right? But if we implement your suggestions, then I'm afraid we have to scrap the entire design.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1905901 kaveh 10.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Architectural design cannot be neatly split into discrete parts — any change to one part of the design will affect the quality of the whole thing. I decided to utilize high-end timber for this section because the weight-bearing structure requires the supporting materials to be durable and strong.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1905901 kaveh 11.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Same with the tiles... Switch them out, and the entire mural will have to be redesigned. More importantly, if we make such a change, both its practical functionality and aesthetic value will take a great hit.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1905901 kaveh 12.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' If all you need is a building with a roof that can keep people dry in the rain, you shouldn't have commissioned me. Many architects would be able to build you one of those while charging far less in commission fees.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1905901 badawi 08.ogg}} '''Badawi:''' Actually, I... *sigh* Please tell me, are you absolutely sure that there's no room for any changes in this draft of the design?
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1905901 kaveh 13.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' I think the most important thing for me is to understand what you would actually like to get. If you could tell me more about your vision, I might be able to work with the design some more. You are the client, after all. You should have the final say on how the project turns out.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1905901 badawi 09.ogg}} '''Badawi:''' I... want to build something unique. Something quiet and warm inside, a refuge that can block out the world outside.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1905901 badawi 10.ogg}} '''Badawi:''' I want all who enter this building to be able to temporarily forget everything that's going on outside of the building, and just focus on their task at hand.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1905901 kaveh 14.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Hmm... that's a bit more information than last time, but it's still extremely vague. To put it another way, every rich person who wants to build a mansion for themselves would request something like this.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1905901 kaveh 15.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' We've gone through many proposals, and this draft is already the cheapest one. Cutting costs by substituting building materials will not only detract from the overall effect of the building, it also won't save you much Mora in the grand scheme of things.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1905901 badawi 11.ogg}} '''Badawi:''' Thank you for giving it so much thought. Please give me some more time to mull over the budget... I'll get back to you once I've figured out a solution.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1905901 badawi 12.ogg}} '''Badawi:''' I still have a few business meetings that I must attend, so I'm afraid I'll have to leave for now. You can just leave the proposal as-is. I'll get in touch once I've given it some more thought.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1905901 kaveh 16.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' ...
:{{DIcon}} Why do I feel like he's hiding something?
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1905901 kaveh 17.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' I also have a similar feeling.
:{{DIcon}} Should we follow him and see if anything unusual comes up?
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1905901 kaveh 18.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Uh... Is that really okay? I mean, what he does now is none of our business...
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1905901 kaveh 19.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' He does seem really suspicious, though. He dresses like a rich person, but when you talk to him, he hardly sounds the part.
:{{DIcon}} He sounds super frugal, too.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1905901 kaveh 20.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' That's actually pretty common. Not all rich people are spendthrifts. Many are just as if not more stingy than him.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1905901 kaveh 21.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' The more Mora some people have, the more they love interfering with people's lives — like constantly reminding you to pay back your debts, or hinting every other day that it's time for you to pay rent.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1905901 kaveh 22.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Actually, now that I think about it, I'm not even sure this person really wants to work on this project with me. Putting his vague requests aside, he's still finding excuses to procrastinate even when we've decided on a plan.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1905901 kaveh 23.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Who knows how long construction will take if he keeps delaying things like this... We should find him again and get some clearer answers. The sooner we can break ground on this, the better.

;(After following the client)
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1905902 kaveh 01.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Huh, where did he go? I could have sworn he went this way...
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1905902 kaveh 02.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Let's keep looking.

:{{Black Screen|You search the area with Kaveh, but find no trace of Badawi...}}
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1905903 kaveh 01.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Hey, look! Isn't that Badawi? It sure looks like him, but he's dressed completely different now. What is he up to?
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1905903 roya 01.ogg}} '''Roya:''' Didn't I tell you before? I'm not looking for more workers.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1905903 roya 02.ogg}} '''Roya:''' Plus, aren't you a bit old for physical labor? If something happens to you, I won't be able to pay for it.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1905903 badawi 01.ogg}} '''Badawi:''' Oh, you won't have to worry about that. I grew up as an Eremite mercenary, and worked in the desert my entire life. My body's still in great shape.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1905903 badawi 02.ogg}} '''Badawi:''' I don't have many talents, but I still have my muscle. If you need someone to unload goods or drive away sumpter beasts, I'm your man.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1905903 roya 03.ogg}} '''Roya:''' You used to be an Eremite mercenary?
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1905903 badawi 03.ogg}} '''Badawi:''' I know there are a lot of bad apples in our ranks, but most are just trying to make a living. We're not that greedy by nature, and will do our best when given a job.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1905903 roya 04.ogg}} '''Roya:''' Hmm, let me think...
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1905903 roya 05.ogg}} '''Roya:''' I'm sorry, but I still can't take you in. I don't have any open positions right now and don't have the Mora for anything more. How about this... why don't you try your luck somewhere else.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1905903 badawi 04.ogg}} '''Badawi:''' Okay, okay... *sigh*
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1905903 kaveh 02.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' He used to be a member of the Eremites? Huh, from the way he dressed, I would have thought he was a merchant from the rainforest... Let's ask him about it.
{{Dialogue End}}

===Concealed Circumstances===
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Talk to Badawi)
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1905904 kaveh 01.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' We meet again.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1905904 badawi 01.ogg}} '''Badawi:''' Huh? Why are you guys here?
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1905904 kaveh 02.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' That's what we wanted to ask you. Who are you? Why did you dress up like a merchant to talk to me about our project?
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1905904 badawi 02.ogg}} '''Badawi:''' ...
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1905904 kaveh 03.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' There's no need for us to continue this project if you still want to keep hiding things from us. I don't work with individuals I can't trust.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1905904 badawi 03.ogg}} '''Badawi:''' Believe me, I didn't have any bad intentions... It's just...
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1905904 badawi 04.ogg}} '''Badawi:''' Alright, there's no point hiding anything anymore. The building I'm trying to commission you for is not really a personal residence for me, but rather a library for children living in the desert.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1905904 kaveh 04.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' A library...? Funded entirely by yourself? Shouldn't this be the responsibility of the Akademiya?
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1905904 kaveh 05.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' I've heard that the Akademiya will be looking to prioritize the desert with the allocation of educational resources and materials. It sent over a large shipment of regular goods just last month.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1905904 badawi 05.ogg}} '''Badawi:''' You're right, and I was aware of these happenings as well. I just figured... what I want to do is a separate effort from what's already being done by the Akademiya.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1905904 badawi 06.ogg}} '''Badawi:''' The desert is too vast. Even if the Akademiya spends a lot of effort trying to disseminate knowledge in those parts, it might still take decades, if not centuries, to reduce the educational gap that already exists between the two regions.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1905904 badawi 07.ogg}} '''Badawi:''' And what's more... I don't know if the Akademiya would ever reverse its stance in the future.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1905904 badawi 08.ogg}} '''Badawi:''' All I know is that as a desert-dweller, we should not wait passively for good things to happen to us. If we only did that, we'd never be able to stand up and hold our heads high.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1905904 badawi 09.ogg}} '''Badawi:''' I don't have much longer left on this world, so I just want to use whatever time I have to contribute something to my homeland.
:{{DIcon}} Why didn't you just tell us that from the start?
:{{DIcon}} Why did you feel like you needed to lie?
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1905904 badawi 10.ogg}} '''Badawi:''' I didn't want you to know that I came from the desert. I've lived in the desert my entire life, and there wasn't anyone here that I could trust. I figured I needed as much safety as I could get.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1905904 kaveh 06.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' To the point that you even disguised your identity? That's certainly taking "playing it safe" to the next level... Hold on, don't tell me you've also been scammed before?
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1905904 badawi 11.ogg}} '''Badawi:''' When I first came to Sumeru City, I brought a lot of Mora hoping to find an architect that I could work with.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1905904 badawi 12.ogg}} '''Badawi:''' Someone agreed to take on the project, and even took a sum of Mora from me, but then disappeared without a trace.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1905904 badawi 13.ogg}} '''Badawi:''' After that, I heard that there are a lot of untrustworthy people in this business. Some would run as soon as they've been paid, while others would deliberately use expensive materials and take a cut of the construction funding.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1905904 badawi 14.ogg}} '''Badawi:''' I spent a while collecting information in the city, and eventually learned that you're the most famous architect in all of Sumeru. I figured that you wouldn't need to make Mora by scamming people, so I decided to reach out to you...
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1905904 badawi 15.ogg}} '''Badawi:''' By the way, how did you know I was scammed? I don't think I've ever mentioned that to anybody.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1905904 kaveh 07.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Just a hunch. A while ago, I accepted an offer to work on a project in the desert, and was also scammed out of a large sum of Mora.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1905904 kaveh 08.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' I ran into someone who was living in a pretty run-down house. I noticed a load-bearing wall on the verge of collapse and suggested that I build a new house for him.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1905904 kaveh 09.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' He said that he had no way to pay for it, so I loaned him some of my own Mora, and told him to get some stone and timber from the local vendors. Soon after that, I found out that he had gone gambling with all the money, and lost everything, down to the last coin.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1905904 kaveh 10.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' And after that, he even borrowed Mora from me twice more, using a different excuse each time. I didn't even suspect him of any wrongdoing until he hired a group of mercenaries and tried to ambush me in his own house.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1905904 kaveh 11.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' According to him, I looked like an easy target because I was an Akademiya scholar who didn't have any family or friends in the desert. Hmph, what kind of person would just look at someone else and think "this guy looks like an easy target"?
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1905904 badawi 16.ogg}} '''Badawi:''' ...Those kinds of things do happen every once in a while, yes. Folks like him are the exact reason why us desert-dwellers' reputation have gone down the drain! I must apologize to you on their behalf.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1905904 kaveh 12.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' It's alright. You were also scammed by someone from Kshahrewar, after all. I should apologize to you on their behalf.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1905904 kaveh 13.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Ultimately, neither of our experiences had anything to do with the desert or the rainforest. People who are new to an area are always easy targets for criminals.
:{{DIcon}} Bad people are everywhere.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1905904 kaveh 14.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Yeah, you'll find both good and bad people everywhere... I can't understand the logic of those who like to take advantage of others, but I have to accept their existence as a fact of life.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1905904 kaveh 15.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Anyway, I digress. Let's return to the topic at hand. Did you keep rejecting my designs because you thought I was deliberately using expensive materials to take a cut as a middleman?
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1905904 badawi 17.ogg}} '''Badawi:''' That's what I was afraid of initially, yes. I eventually understood that you weren't out to cheat me... but unfortunately, I still don't have nearly enough Mora to pay for the design you proposed.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1905904 badawi 18.ogg}} '''Badawi:''' I've done the math, and know that we should be able to make it if we cut some corners. However, after our conversations, I can see that you're passionate about your design, and I'm quite fond of the proposal as well.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1905904 badawi 19.ogg}} '''Badawi:''' So... I decided to try and see if I can afford your proposal as is. I've been looking for work every day, and in another month, I should be able to cobble together enough Mora together to meet the budget.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1905904 kaveh 16.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' By "cobble together," you mean you're going to spend your entire life's savings on this project? But then, what will you do if something unexpected comes up, and you find yourself stuck with no emergency fund?
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1905904 badawi 20.ogg}} '''Badawi:''' To be honest, I haven't really thought about that. I mean... when you've lived to be my age and something happens, you can't really call it "unexpected" anymore.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1905904 badawi 21.ogg}} '''Badawi:''' All I want is to build this library before I leave this world, so that the children of the future would have some books to read, and the desert-dwellers would be able to learn their letters and pick up some practical knowledge.
:{{DIcon}} You seem really passionate about this project.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1905904 badawi 22.ogg}} '''Badawi:''' A while ago, I heard that the Akademiya had decided to recruit a number of exceptional children from the desert. Of course, this is welcome news. But as someone who spent their entire life in the desert, I still have a few concerns.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1905904 badawi 23.ogg}} '''Badawi:''' I know the desert life and can predict what the problems will be. Many children from the desert have had neither the interest nor the proper environment to learn.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1905904 badawi 24.ogg}} '''Badawi:''' So even if the Akademiya would take them in, once they enter the halls, they might find themselves surrounded by other children who look and act very differently from them. And as a result, they might become socially isolated.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1905904 kaveh 17.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' ...Yes, I can imagine that.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1905904 kaveh 18.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' My father passed away at an early age. Even though I had a good number of friends during my years at the Akademiya, for some time, I still sensed many critical looks in my direction.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1905904 kaveh 19.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' I'm sure a child coming all the way from the desert will have an even harder time.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1905904 kaveh 20.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' But let's bring this back to the building itself. I think you said that you want this building to be quiet and warm, with its doors serving as a solid barrier to block out the sound and fury outside and allow one to focus on the book in their hands.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1905904 kaveh 21.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Building it according to the current plan will be quite costly. Even if I don't charge you any commission fees, I don't think we'd be able to keep it under your budget...
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1905904 kaveh 22.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Hmm... Any ideas on what we can do?

:{{Hangout Branch|Can we try a slightly different style?|Field Study}}
:;(+2 Hearts)
::{{A|vo kvcop001 1905904 kaveh 23.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' A slightly different style? Hmm, give me a minute...
::{{A|vo kvcop001 1905904 kaveh 24.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Most architects would probably prioritize cutting costs and removing extra features in this situation. Indeed, converting the building into a simple bungalow would solve most of our problems... However, I do not think this would be the best solution.
::{{A|vo kvcop001 1905904 kaveh 25.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' While it's true that the aesthetic value of a building is often viewed as an afterthought, neglecting it has some long-term negative consequences. It is especially undesirable in this situation as the library will serve a high number of children, many of whom would have never been exposed to structures that may be considered elegant or beautiful.
::{{A|vo kvcop001 1905904 kaveh 26.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' To completely give up on the more aesthetic design would mean stripping the children of an opportunity to appreciate the beauty of architecture. I share Badawi's sentiments in wanting to preserve a more complex design.
::{{A|vo kvcop001 1905904 kaveh 27.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' However, if we can reduce the ornate aspects of the design while maintaining its fundamental elegance... Which is to say, we won't touch the arches and stone pillars, but make changes elsewhere... Hmm, this is definitely a first...
::{{A|vo kvcop001 1905904 kaveh 28.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' To make up for the loss of regular details, we would need to put a lot of extra effort into the layout, lines, and color.
::{{A|vo kvcop001 1905904 badawi 25.ogg}} '''Badawi:''' I see... Would that really be okay?
::{{A|vo kvcop001 1905904 kaveh 29.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' It just increases the difficulty of the design. You should feel lucky that out of all the architects in the city, you chose to approach me. Most of the others would have given up on this project by now.
::{{A|vo kvcop001 1905904 kaveh 30.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' As for inspiration... I think I might have something in mind, but I'd need to visit the site to make sure. Where do you want this place to be built? Tell me the exact location.
::{{A|vo kvcop001 1905904 badawi 26.ogg}} '''Badawi:''' {{sic|Aaru village}}. Although it wasn't my childhood home, I think it'll be the best site for such a building.
::{{A|vo kvcop001 1905904 kaveh 31.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Okay, then we can pay a visit to Aaru Village.
::{{A|vo kvcop001 1905904 badawi 27.ogg}} '''Badawi:''' Is there something I can do for you? I've already caused you a lot of trouble before, and now, you're revising the design again because of me... Which draft are we even on now? It's making me feel terribly guilty.
::{{A|vo kvcop001 1905904 kaveh 32.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Let me think... You said you used to be an Eremite mercenary, right? In that case, you could help us clear out some monsters that are blocking the way to Aaru village.
::{{A|vo kvcop001 1905904 kaveh 33.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' We want to keep the roads clear, and reduce the loss of materials during transport to a minimum. If everything goes well, that'll help us save some Mora.
::{{A|vo kvcop001 1905904 badawi 28.ogg}} '''Badawi:''' Alright, just leave it to me! Haha, if there's anything I'm good at, it's clearing out monsters!
::{{A|vo kvcop001 1905904 kaveh 34.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' What are you waiting for, then? Let's pack up, and get ready to go.
:;(Go to [[A Whole New Style#Field Study|Field Study]])

:{{Hangout Branch|Would any other merchants be willing to sponsor the project?|Attempted Persuasion}}
::{{A|vo kvcop001 1905904 kaveh 35.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Sponsor the project? You mean... convince wealthy merchants to join our cause, and pool their money together to build the library?
::{{A|vo kvcop001 1905904 kaveh 36.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' That does make sense. A library is a big project, and it's going to be hard to fund it with just a single person's Mora.
::{{A|vo kvcop001 1905904 kaveh 37.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' What do you think? If we can find others to sponsor the project, we could potentially increase the size of the building two or threefold.
::{{A|vo kvcop001 1905904 badawi 29.ogg}} '''Badawi:''' It's all fine with me. But... where do you think we'll be able to find these sponsors?
::{{A|vo kvcop001 1905904 kaveh 38.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Well... You're right, if I really think about it, I'm not too familiar with many big name merchants...
::{{DIcon}} Can we ask [[Dori]]?
::{{A|vo kvcop001 1905904 kaveh 39.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Her? Hard pass. With her shrewd and greedy personality, she would never put Mora into something like this.
::{{DIcon}} Maybe she can connect us with some of her contacts?
::{{A|vo kvcop001 1905904 kaveh 40.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Hmm, now there's an idea. She probably won't say no if all she'll need to do is to make some introductions instead of spending Mora.
::{{A|vo kvcop001 1905904 kaveh 41.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Let's go and pay her a visit.
:;(Go to [[Wealthy Merchant#Attempted Persuasion|Attempted Persuasion]])
{{Dialogue End}}

==Dialogue==
{{Quest Description|Even though the clues are few and vague, you and Sucrose continue to work at uncovering the mystery behind the prophecy...}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Pass time)
:{{A|vo eqfh102 1 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Today's the day! Let's go meet up with Sucrose!

;(Talk to Sucrose)
:{{A|vo eqfh102 1 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Sucrose, we're here!
:{{A|vo eqfh102 1 sucrose 01.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' Oh, Traveler, Paimon! I only just arrived myself, so I'm still getting ready.
:{{A|vo eqfh102 1 sucrose 02.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' Ah, and Collei just passed by a moment ago. She said she had some things to sort out at the inn where she's staying, but she'll meet up with us when she's done.
:{{A|vo eqfh102 1 sucrose 03.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' Apparently, [[Tighnari]] and [[Cyno]] both went out, but she stayed behind because she wanted to help us.
:{{DIcon}} Understood. How has progress been on your end?
:{{A|vo eqfh102 1 sucrose 04.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' Not too bad. After reviewing it again with fresh eyes, I came up with a new theory which seems to hold some water. I'll attempt to explain it as simply as I can...
:{{A|vo eqfh102 1 sucrose 05.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' I believe that each of the four things in the prophecy refers to a different field of knowledge. So in a way, the prophecy is a test of the reader's intelligence...
:{{A|vo eqfh102 1 sucrose 06.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' But it's unlikely for any one person to have expertise in all these different areas, so I suggest that we seek out one expert from each and get their opinion.
:{{A|vo eqfh102 1 sucrose 07.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' Also, in two out of the four areas, the prophecy seems to want us to find specific people. It may even turn out that the people themselves are the answers.
:{{A|vo eqfh102 1 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hmm, so it sounds like we should put our heads together and list out the people who can help us!
:{{A|vo eqfh102 1 sucrose 08.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' Exactly. I think we can go through each riddle in turn and generate four groups of names to match the four questions.
:{{DIcon}} That makes sense.
:{{A|vo eqfh102 1 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Alright, then let's start from Group 1! The first riddle was... "a flower that is not of this world."
:{{A|vo eqfh102 1 sucrose 09.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' Personally, I would still go with [[Albedo]] for this one. Alchemy is the most likely to have to do with otherworldly things, and he is by far the leading expert in this regard.
:{{DIcon}} You'd count as an expert too, you know.
:{{A|vo eqfh102 1 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Exactly! You're the creator of the Tetratanic Sweet Flower. Who knows, maybe that's the flower we're looking for!
:{{A|vo eqfh102 1 sucrose 10.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' Huh? You really think so? Hehe...
:{{A|vo eqfh102 1 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, but what about Tighnari? He's a [[Forest Watcher]] and knows all about plants. If it's a flower we're looking for, maybe he's the man for the job!
:{{A|vo eqfh102 1 sucrose 11.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' Alright. I'll add him to the list as well.
:{{A|vo eqfh102 1 sucrose 12.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' On to Group 2. This subject is... "a guide who will never get lost."
:{{A|vo eqfh102 1 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hmm, that's kind of abstract... Does it just mean someone who never loses their way?
:{{A|vo eqfh102 1 sucrose 13.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' Wait, but they have to be able to guide others, too, so it's not quite as simple as that...
:{{DIcon}} Perhaps... an astrologer, then?
:{{A|vo eqfh102 1 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, you mean [[Mona]]? Yeah, she'd definitely count!
:{{A|vo eqfh102 1 sucrose 14.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' Mona... Yes, she certainly seems very confident, and she can use her astrology to guide people.
:{{A|vo eqfh102 1 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Would [[Bennett]] count?
:{{DIcon}} Huh? Why him?
:{{A|vo eqfh102 1 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Well, his luck's so bad that as long as you go in the opposite direction from him, you'll always be going the right way, right?
:{{A|vo eqfh102 1 sucrose 15.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' Hmm, I see... I—I suppose I can't argue with that logic...
:{{A|vo eqfh102 1 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Add him to the list! Finding everyone won't take long, so one extra person won't hurt.
:{{A|vo eqfh102 1 sucrose 16.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' Ah, I know! Would Outrider [[Amber]] be a valid candidate for this category as well?
:{{A|vo eqfh102 1 paimon 12.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yeah, she would! She's got a great sense of direction, after all. As a matter of fact, when the Traveler and Paimon first came to [[Mondstadt]], she was actually the one who gave us directions.
:{{A|vo eqfh102 1 sucrose 17.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' Yes, she's certainly a good guide.
:{{A|vo eqfh102 1 paimon 13.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Is there anyone else?
:{{A|vo eqfh102 1 sucrose 18.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' Let me think... Ah yes, I believe there may be one more.
:{{A|vo eqfh102 1 sucrose 19.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' Albedo once made a set of equipment for [[Mika]] from the [[Reconnaissance Company]]. He's their surveyor, and an exceptional pathfinder.
:{{A|vo eqfh102 1 sucrose 20.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' He's even instructed others in the discipline of surveying before. So in my view, he's highly unlikely to lose his way and would be very good at helping others find theirs.
:{{A|vo eqfh102 1 paimon 14.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Cool. Another one for our list.
:{{A|vo eqfh102 1 sucrose 21.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' ...Wait, Collei should've been here by now. Wonder what's taking her so long? ...Sorry, could we continue our chat somewhere else?
:{{A|vo eqfh102 1 paimon 15.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, you wanna go see how she's doing, right? Sure, let's all go!
----
;(Approach Collei)
:{{A|vo eqfh102 2 sucrose 01.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' Hi Collei, hope we're not intruding or anything... Is everything okay?
:{{A|vo eqfh102 2 collei 01.ogg}} '''Collei:''' Ah! Sucrose! I, uh... I was preparing some... stuff...
:{{A|vo eqfh102 2 collei 02.ogg}} '''Collei:''' Is it time already? Oh no, I—I'm sorry...
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (Collei seems to be wrapping gifts, and now she's frantically trying to hide it. I wonder who they're for?)
:{{A|vo eqfh102 2 sucrose 02.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' Don't worry, the Traveler and I only just met up. We were just worried that you might get lost along the way, so we thought that we'd come get you.
:{{A|vo eqfh102 2 collei 03.ogg}} '''Collei:''' Thank you. I'm ready to join you now! Um, how's that thing going?
:{{Black Screen|Sucrose tells Collei about the four riddles and the results of your discussion...}}
:{{A|vo eqfh102 2 sucrose 03.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' So let's pick up where we left off.
:{{A|vo eqfh102 2 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Next up is the third line: "one who would never lie"... Hmm, anyone spring to mind?
:{{DIcon}} Maybe... [[Diluc]]?
:{{A|vo eqfh102 2 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Uhh... you really think so? Seems like it would be pretty difficult for someone in his position to avoid having to lie.
;(If the player has sufficiently progressed through {{Quest|Darknight Hero's Alibi}})<!-- the reveal that diluc is the darknight hero is early on in the first quest; unknown if that's sufficient or if full completion of the act is required, and will likely forever remain unknown -->
::'''{{Traveler}}:''' (Ah yes, his secret alter ego: the Darknight Hero. He must have to deny it if anyone asks. In that sense, he has a complicated relationship with the truth.)
:{{A|vo eqfh102 2 collei 04.ogg}} '''Collei:''' Then what about [[Kaeya]]? He's the Cavalry Captain and a rather popular figure, but...
:{{A|vo eqfh102 2 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You think there's something fishy about him too, huh? Yeah... he's definitely a sneaky one! Bet he lies all the time.
:{{A|vo eqfh102 2 collei 05.ogg}} '''Collei:''' Hmm, I can't help but agree with you there...
:{{A|vo eqfh102 2 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' There's the [[Venti|Tone-Deaf Bard]]... Uh, but on second thought, he wouldn't qualify either. He talks way too much nonsense. Hmm... is there anyone else we're missing?
:{{A|vo eqfh102 2 sucrose 04.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' Acting Grand Master [[Jean]]? She has a good name in that regard... but from what I know, she sometimes covers up the truth out of concern for those around her...
:{{A|vo eqfh102 2 sucrose 05.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' For example, when Lisa loses track of time in the library and misses her patrol shift, Jean'll come up with some excuse, like "Lisa's ill today."
:{{A|vo eqfh102 2 sucrose 06.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' Also, she sometimes makes up stories to get [[Klee]] to behave. Like the one about the big monster that comes to catch naughty kids who don't go to bed on time... D'you think that rules her out?
:{{A|vo eqfh102 2 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hmm, white lies are still lies... But do we really have to reject her because of some harmless fibs? It's not like she had evil intentions.
:{{DIcon}} This prophecy seems very strict...
:{{A|vo eqfh102 2 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' No, we're the ones being strict!
:{{A|vo eqfh102 2 sucrose 07.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' [[Rosaria]] doesn't strike me as the type of person to lie.
:{{A|vo eqfh102 2 sucrose 08.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' Ah Collei, you probably haven't met her yet, have you? She's a sister from the [[Church of Favonius|church]] who looks, um... a little scary and not very sociable.
:{{DIcon}} What gives you that impression?
:{{A|vo eqfh102 2 sucrose 09.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' She stopped by the alchemy bench once, a long time ago, and asked me about Albedo.
:{{A|vo eqfh102 2 sucrose 10.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' I thought maybe she was trying to find him, for work or something. But when I asked, she just said that she was curious about him because he was so intelligent, and wanted to talk to his assistant to find out what he was like.
:{{A|vo eqfh102 2 sucrose 11.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' A lot of people might have given a more tactful justification, but I could see in her face that she wasn't trying to hide anything. She was just very direct and straightforward.
:{{A|vo eqfh102 2 sucrose 12.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' That's why I don't think of her as the lying type.
:{{A|vo eqfh102 2 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Rosaria doesn't look like the sort of person you'd want to get into a fight with... Maybe she just fights her way out of situations that some people might lie to get out of?
:{{A|vo eqfh102 2 sucrose 13.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' I can definitely see that! I've also heard the other sisters say that Rosaria doesn't even make excuses when she skips choir — she just doesn't show up.
:{{A|vo eqfh102 2 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' She's a tough cookie, huh. Let's put her name down.
:{{A|vo eqfh102 2 collei 06.ogg}} '''Collei:''' In that case, I think Cyno fits in this list, too!
:{{A|vo eqfh102 2 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ah, true. Lying's probably more trouble than it's worth for someone like him — kinda like with Rosaria.
:{{A|vo eqfh102 2 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, and Paimon also nominates [[Razor]]! Bet he couldn't lie to save his life.
:{{A|vo eqfh102 2 sucrose 14.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' I've also got someone else in mind, [[Noelle]], the trainee knight! She's a very honest person. I don't think she'd tell a lie.
:{{A|vo eqfh102 2 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Alrighty, write her name down too!
:{{A|vo eqfh102 2 sucrose 15.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' ...Wait, there's one more person... You know, our long-standing staffer at the alchemy bench...
:{{A|vo eqfh102 2 paimon 12.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh? You mean... [[Timaeus]]?
:{{A|vo eqfh102 2 sucrose 16.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' Yes, him. Um, truth be told, he's been lovestruck recently.
:{{A|vo eqfh102 2 sucrose 17.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' He swore that he wouldn't say a dishonest word or slack off until he succeeds in getting the woman he loves.
:{{A|vo eqfh102 2 paimon 13.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Timaeus has a crush!?
:{{A|vo eqfh102 2 sucrose 18.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' Yes, that's right.
:{{A|vo eqfh102 2 paimon 14.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Well, who is it? Do you know her?
:{{A|vo eqfh102 2 sucrose 19.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' I've never met her. All I know is that she's from Liyue... Timaeus says that she's fun, has a great personality, and is very, very good-looking.
:{{DIcon}} All great qualities, but that says nothing about her identity...
:{{A|vo eqfh102 2 sucrose 20.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' Since we're on the topic — helping Timaeus win the lady of his dreams was also one of my goals for this [[Windblume Festival]]!
:{{A|vo eqfh102 2 collei 07.ogg}} '''Collei:''' But how can we help with that?
:{{A|vo eqfh102 2 sucrose 21.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' I dunno, make sure he uses nice paper and a fancy envelope when he sends letters to her, help him pick a nice gift and wrap it properly... That sort of thing.
:{{A|vo eqfh102 2 collei 08.ogg}} '''Collei:''' Yeah, yeah, yeah! I had the same situation once in the [[Avidya Forest]]. I helped another Forest Ranger out by delivering a love letter to the coworker she likes...
:{{A|vo eqfh102 2 sucrose 22.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' Yep, that sort of thing, exactly! Oh, also, I helped him with some of the groundwork for one of his research projects. He must have appreciated it, because he gave me a refrigeration device that he's been developing as a thank-you gift.
:{{A|vo eqfh102 2 paimon 15.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Is it any good?
:{{A|vo eqfh102 2 sucrose 23.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' Uh... I mean, it looks nice...
:{{A|vo eqfh102 2 collei 09.ogg}} '''Collei:''' Sounds like a "no."
:{{A|vo eqfh102 2 paimon 16.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hmph, alright, guess we'll put lover boy down on the list then.
:{{A|vo eqfh102 2 sucrose 24.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' Okay, so last of all, we have "a legend that never ends." Anyone come to mind for this particular line?
:{{A|vo eqfh102 2 paimon 17.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Lisa, perhaps? A librarian understands books best... and aren't most legends written down somewhere?
:{{DIcon}} Not necessarily, but you have a point.
:{{A|vo eqfh102 2 sucrose 25.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' When I think about "legends," fairy tales and picture books come to mind.
:{{A|vo eqfh102 2 paimon 18.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Maybe Collei! She read a lot of fairy tales when Tighnari was teaching her to read.
:{{A|vo eqfh102 2 collei 10.ogg}} '''Collei:''' Oh... Do I count?
:{{A|vo eqfh102 2 sucrose 26.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' Of course you do. I'll put you on the list.
:{{DIcon}} Are you eligible for this one, Sucrose?
:{{A|vo eqfh102 2 sucrose 27.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' I prefer to read things like "An Illustrated Analysis of Alchemical Substances and Their Uses," "The Fascinating Principles of Crafting," and "Hypotheses of Life"...
:{{A|vo eqfh102 2 paimon 19.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Point taken... Paimon didn't quite understand any of those...
:{{A|vo eqfh102 2 sucrose 28.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' Hmmm. Klee might be a good choice. Her mother, [[Alice]], is a renowned traveling author, so I'll bet she's been exposed to all sorts of myths and legends.
:{{A|vo eqfh102 2 paimon 20.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Alright then, Klee makes the shortlist!
:{{A|vo eqfh102 2 sucrose 29.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' Well, that should just about do it. Next up, we should go and ask the people on the list about the prophecy.
:{{A|vo eqfh102 2 collei 11.ogg}} '''Collei:''' Do we have to ask absolutely everyone on the list? It seems like a lot of people...
:{{A|vo eqfh102 2 sucrose 30.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' It is, so I was thinking that perhaps we should split up? That might make our search more effective.
:{{A|vo eqfh102 2 paimon 21.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Okie-dokie!
:{{A|vo eqfh102 2 sucrose 31.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' Also, I've thought of a method of gathering feedback...
:{{Black Screen|Sucrose shares her idea with everyone...}}
:{{A|vo eqfh102 2 paimon 22.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' No problem, we can do that.
:{{A|vo eqfh102 2 sucrose 32.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' You and {{Traveler}} are practically joined at the hip, so you two can go together. I'll pair up with Collei.
:{{A|vo eqfh102 2 paimon 23.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Capable Collei and Sensible Sucrose... sounds like a winning combination!
:{{A|vo eqfh102 2 collei 12.ogg}} '''Collei:''' ...Okay, I promise I'll help! Capable Collei... yeah, I got this!
:{{A|vo eqfh102 2 paimon 24.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Rest assured that the unbeatable {{Traveler}} and Paimon will do our part too! Off we go!
:;(Sucrose and Collei reach the Knights of Favonius Headquarters)<!--screen transition; dialogue restarts here if they leave the area-->
:{{A|vo eqfh102 3 sucrose 01.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' I plan on starting from the person with the most defined stronghold, so let's go to the library. Lisa should be there.
:{{A|vo eqfh102 3 collei 01.ogg}} '''Collei:''' "Stronghold," That's an, uh... interesting word to use.
:{{A|vo eqfh102 3 sucrose 02.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' Umm... maybe "den"? No, that's even worse...
:{{A|vo eqfh102 3 collei 02.ogg}} '''Collei:''' How about... "lair"?

;(Enter the library)
:{{A|vo eqfh102 4 sucrose 01.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' Here we are! Lisa's lair!
:{{A|vo eqfh102 4 collei 01.ogg}} '''Collei:''' (Oh no, that was a bad word choice. Now Sucrose is using it and it's all my fault...)
:{{A|vo eqfh102 4 sucrose 02.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' Lisa, might I ask if... Huh?
:{{A|vo eqfh102 4 albedo 01.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Sucrose? Collei? What are you doing here?
:{{A|vo eqfh102 4 cyno 01.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' I can only "Sucrose" that they were "Collei"-ng in on someone. At "Lisa," that's as far as "Cyno."
:{{A|vo eqfh102 4 tighnari 01.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Please... Just stop it with these puns, I beg you. Are you trying to win worldwide fame for unfunny jokes?
:{{A|vo eqfh102 4 collei 02.ogg}} '''Collei:''' Um, is Lisa not here at the moment?
:{{A|vo eqfh102 4 albedo 02.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Surprising, isn't it? She went out. I'm afraid it's just us here looking for information.
:{{A|vo eqfh102 4 cyno 02.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Except me. I'm not here for information. Like you, I came here on an abortive search for the librarian, who is also my [[Akademiya]] senior.
:{{A|vo eqfh102 4 sucrose 03.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' Oh, so you studied in the same [[Darshan]] as Lisa?
:{{A|vo eqfh102 4 cyno 03.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' That's right. Her mentor in [[Sumeru]] was also my benefactor. We were both [[Spantamad]] students.
:{{A|vo eqfh102 4 sucrose 04.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' Wow, that's cool... But wait, we're getting sidetracked! We came here to look for some information — Collei and I are investigating a prophecy, and we were hoping you all might be able to help.
:{{A|vo eqfh102 4 albedo 03.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Oh? What sort of prophecy?
:{{Black Screen|Sucrose and Collei take turns explaining the prophecy and the information that they compiled with the Traveler...}}
:{{A|vo eqfh102 4 cyno 04.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' I see... You want to ask them about the "flower that is not of this world," and me about the "one who would never lie."
:{{A|vo eqfh102 4 collei 03.ogg}} '''Collei:''' But there's no rush! You don't need to answer right away! We're just here to tell you about the situation. You can take your time to think it over, and submit any thoughts you have in written form to the Sucrose Mailbox.
:{{A|vo eqfh102 4 cyno 05.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' The Sucrose Mailbox?
:{{A|vo eqfh102 4 sucrose 05.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' Yep. I was thinking about it on the way, and although these seem like trick questions, there's a lot to mull over once you get down to the details. A quick answer off the top of your head might not go into enough depth.
:{{A|vo eqfh102 4 sucrose 06.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' So, I decided to place a mailbox next to the alchemy crafting table. Everyone can submit their written answers there when they're ready.
:{{A|vo eqfh102 4 sucrose 07.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' We don't have to call it the Sucrose Mailbox, though. It could just as well be called the Sucrose and Collei Mailbox, or even the Sucrose, Collei, Traveler, and Paimon Mailbox...
:{{A|vo eqfh102 4 collei 04.ogg}} '''Collei:''' Haha, I think in this case, we CAN just go with your quick answer off the top of your head...

:{{A|vo eqfh102 9 mona 05.ogg}} '''Mona:''' *sigh* I hardly think giving flowers to your crush is worth throwing one's life away for...
:{{A|vo eqfh102 9 rosaria 04.ogg}} '''Rosaria:''' It's rare to run into someone with a death wish in this area.
:{{A|vo eqfh102 9 timaeus 06.ogg}} '''Timaeus:''' I don't have a death wish! I just... didn't think it would really come true... I mean, when Mona said "it would be dangerous," I thought I'd be fine as long as I watched my step cautiously. I'm sorry, okay? I was wrong.
:{{A|vo eqfh102 9 timaeus 07.ogg}} '''Timaeus:''' I'm telling you, I'm just here chasing the love of my life. Lovestruck Mondstadters is what the Windblume Festival's all about!
:{{A|vo eqfh102 9 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Okay... That explains you, but why is Rosaria here?
:{{A|vo eqfh102 9 rosaria 05.ogg}} '''Rosaria:''' I was looking for a quiet place to escape the crowds. I wasn't planning on having to save a life along the way.
:{{A|vo eqfh102 9 mona 06.ogg}} '''Mona:''' ...So that's why the scryglass just showed "danger" instead of "fatal danger."
:{{A|vo eqfh102 9 timaeus 08.ogg}} '''Timaeus:''' Ahaha, very funny... Anyway, {{Traveler}} and Paimon, what brings the two of you to Starsnatch Cliff?
:{{A|vo eqfh102 9 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Just trying our luck! We've got a lot of people we need to see today, so we've been all over the place. Actually, you're some of the people we were looking for!
:{{A|vo eqfh102 9 timaeus 09.ogg}} '''Timaeus:''' Huh?
:{{Black Screen|You tell them about the prophecy, the information gathered so far, and the mailbox...}}
:{{A|vo eqfh102 9 rosaria 06.ogg}} '''Rosaria:''' I see. So all we'll need to do is to find some clues, make a note, and drop it off at the mailbox?
:{{A|vo eqfh102 9 timaeus 10.ogg}} '''Timaeus:''' I can't believe there's a prophecy like this... Let alone that I have a part to play in it!
:{{A|vo eqfh102 9 timaeus 11.ogg}} '''Timaeus:''' I guess this means everyone will find out about my crush now... Hehe...
:{{A|vo eqfh102 9 timaeus 12.ogg}} '''Timaeus:''' I came here because I wanted to give some Cecilias to the girl I love. They'll really suit her. She's—
:{{A|vo eqfh102 9 mona 07.ogg}} '''Mona:''' No, no, no one asked. Please do not subject us to your gushing about your girlfriend.
:{{A|vo eqfh102 9 timaeus 13.ogg}} '''Timaeus:''' Oh... You saw right through me...
:{{A|vo eqfh102 9 mona 08.ogg}} '''Mona:''' You said you need clues, right? In that case, Mona Megistus the Astrologist will provide you with a personally handwritten letter. Just wait for it to show up in your mailbox!
:{{A|vo eqfh102 9 rosaria 07.ogg}} '''Rosaria:''' You can be on your way, now. We won't keep you any longer.
:{{A|vo eqfh102 9 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Alright, then let's head back for now and meet up with everyone else!
:{{DIcon}} Bye for now, everyone! Timaeus, please try to stay safe.

:{{A|vo eqfh102 11 scarlett 06.ogg}} '''Scarlett:''' I can. That's why I tried to strike up a conversation with you in the first place.
:{{A|vo eqfh102 11 scarlett 07.ogg}} '''Scarlett:''' I was on my way to go shopping earlier when I overheard your conversation next to the Crafting Bench. From what I could gather, you are trying to investigate a bizarre prophecy?

==Post-Quest Dialogue==
After completing this quest, Cyno and Lisa can be found in the open world. They disappear upon completion of Step 4 of the next quest, ''[[Joy Above the Clouds]]''.
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Talk to Cyno or Lisa in the [[Knights of Favonius Headquarters#Library|Knights of Favonius Library]])
:{{A|vo dialog eqfh102 lisa 01.ogg}} '''Lisa:''' Why, if it isn't my underclassman, Cyno. What a pleasant surprise it is to see you in Mondstadt during the Windblume Festival.
:{{A|vo dialog eqfh102 cyno 01.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Greetings, Lisa. Though I'm sure you've been aware of my presence in Mondstadt for some time already.
:{{A|vo dialog eqfh102 lisa 02.ogg}} '''Lisa:''' Oh dear, looks like you've seen right through me. But I was in no hurry. I knew we'd see each other sooner or later.
:{{A|vo dialog eqfh102 cyno 02.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Yes. It's just as [[Cyrus (Sumeru)|Professor Cyrus]] said — shared aspirations always have a way of bringing people into each other's orbit.
:{{A|vo dialog eqfh102 lisa 03.ogg}} '''Lisa:''' Hehe, he always has such a poetic way of wording things. I suppose that's the one respect in which I've taken after him, while in your case...
:{{A|vo dialog eqfh102 lisa 04.ogg}} '''Lisa:''' Yes, it's his wit and eccentricities that have left their mark on you.
:{{A|vo dialog eqfh102 cyno 03.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Hmm. I'm not sure that describes me very aptly these days, given that I'm now the General Mahamatra. Still, if we're going to talk about ways with words, I think my deadpan humor is far superior than our professor's.
:{{A|vo dialog eqfh102 lisa 05.ogg}} '''Lisa:''' Is that so? Strange, I heard that you're just Cyno the Adventurer when you're in Mondstadt.
:{{A|vo dialog eqfh102 cyno 04.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' ...You make a good point.
:{{A|vo dialog eqfh102 lisa 06.ogg}} '''Lisa:''' What do you think of Mondstadt during this time of year? It's quite nice, isn't it?
:{{A|vo dialog eqfh102 cyno 05.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Yes. It's very nice. I think I'm starting to understand your reasons for leaving the Akademiya.
:{{A|vo dialog eqfh102 lisa 07.ogg}} '''Lisa:''' Hehe. I've always prided myself on making wise decisions, and that was certainly one of them.
:{{A|vo dialog eqfh102 cyno 06.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' If our professor had been as sensible as you, he would have had a much easier time in his working life. Being stubborn doesn't help anybody.
:{{A|vo dialog eqfh102 lisa 08.ogg}} '''Lisa:''' Well, if even you feel comfortable criticizing him now that he's retired... it really goes to show how much he's changed.
:{{A|vo dialog eqfh102 lisa 09.ogg}} '''Lisa:''' Stubbornness is an all-too-common vice among scholars. I hope that never rubs off on you. I'm always happy to see you visit Mondstadt, and experience the feeling of freedom for yourself.
:{{A|vo dialog eqfh102 lisa 10.ogg}} '''Lisa:''' I heard the latest news about Collei, too. No doubt the traumas of her childhood will persist for a while to come, but I have to say, she appears to be doing quite better this time than on previous visits.
:{{A|vo dialog eqfh102 lisa 11.ogg}} '''Lisa:''' I suppose you're something of a mentor to her, aren't you? Now that I think about it, the two of you aren't so dissimilar. The power of [[Hermanubis]] once brought you great suffering.
:{{A|vo dialog eqfh102 cyno 07.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' That's all in the past now. Besides, Professor thankfully didn't treat me like a test subject for the priest's power like the higher-ups had hoped, even though I was a desert-dweller.
:{{A|vo dialog eqfh102 cyno 08.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Instead, he gave me the tools I needed to lead the life I have today. He adopted me, educated me, taught me how to fit into society... I am very grateful to him.
:{{A|vo dialog eqfh102 lisa 12.ogg}} '''Lisa:''' You are very gifted, and sometimes that can become its own curse. But he has reason to be grateful to you, too — without you as his son-slash-student, he may never have changed his stubborn ways.
:{{A|vo dialog eqfh102 lisa 13.ogg}} '''Lisa:''' As a fellow student of his, I couldn't be happier for the two of you. ...Ah, look at how quickly this developed from small talk to a deep and serious conversation. That's one thing I do miss about my Akademiya days.
:{{A|vo dialog eqfh102 cyno 09.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' By virtue of being another of his students, you are as much a part of professor's family as I. It's perfectly natural for a daughter to inherit her father's conversation style.
:{{A|vo dialog eqfh102 lisa 14.ogg}} '''Lisa:''' If you say so... I suppose that means I get to call you "baby brother" from now on.
:{{A|vo dialog eqfh102 cyno 10.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' ...Um... I—I'd rather you didn't...
:{{A|vo dialog eqfh102 lisa 15.ogg}} '''Lisa:''' Hahaha, yes, there's the baby brother I remember.
{{Dialogue End}}

Even Mr. Zhongli may not know all of its secrets... :{{A|vo zllq003 2 zhongli 03.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' I may know something about it. :{{A|vo zllq003 2 wanyan 10.ogg}} '''Wanyan:''' Wh—Whaaat!? :{{A|vo zllq003 2 zhongli 04.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Over the years, I've heard various rumors with bits of knowledge about seals. Although their references seem rather disorderly, they do in fact contain the secret to breaking seals. :{{A|vo zllq003 2 zhongli 05.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Let's go take a look at the mechanism Miss Wanyan just mentioned. :{{A|vo zllq003 2 wanyan 11.ogg}} '''Wanyan:''' Okay, since Mr. Zhongli says so... Follow me, then. ---- ;(Go to the first mechanism) :{{A|vo zllq003 3 wanyan 01.ogg}} '''Wanyan:''' Here it is. There's some debris scattered here that, when put together, look like they definitely had something to do with the God of Salt. :{{A|vo zllq003 3 wanyan 02.ogg}} '''Wanyan:''' According to the inscription on the side, if one looks from a certain angle, the secret to the mechanism will be revealed. ;(After activating the first mechanism) :{{A|vo zllq003 3 wanyan 03.ogg}} '''Wanyan:''' See that? Although we activated the mechanism, nothing happened to the seal... :{{A|vo zllq003 3 zhongli 01.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' That's because there's actually another mechanism that must be activated. :{{A|vo zllq003 3 wanyan 04.ogg}} '''Wanyan:''' A—Another? :{{A|vo zllq003 3 zhongli 02.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Let me lead the way from here. ---- ;(Go to the second mechanism) :{{A|vo zllq003 3 wanyan 05.ogg}} '''Wanyan:''' This place seems familiar... Ah, I remember! I think there's some elemental monuments here — so you're saying they're related to all this? :{{A|vo zllq003 3 wanyan 06.ogg}} '''Wanyan:''' When I investigated this seal last time, I had someone with a Vision accompany me. :{{A|vo zllq003 3 wanyan 07.ogg}} '''Wanyan:''' But when we lit up all the elemental monuments, nothing happened... :{{A|vo zllq003 3 zhongli 03.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' That's because you don't just need to activate them at the same time, but in a certain order as well. Otherwise, the seal will not be broken. :{{A|vo zllq003 3 zhongli 04.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' The secret to this puzzle is hidden in the legends about the [[Archon War]]. :{{A|vo zllq003 3 zhongli 05.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' "[[Mt. Tianheng|Tianheng]] in the {{Color|buzzword|south}}, [[Yaoguang Shoal|Yaoguang]] in the {{Color|buzzword|east}}, [[Jueyun Karst|Jueyun]] in the {{Color|buzzword|west}}, [[Qingce Village|Qingce]] in the {{Color|buzzword|north}} — All desolate and devoid of life. Liyue is vast, yet even one haven is hard to find." :{{A|vo zllq003 3 kliment 01.ogg}} '''Kliment:''' To the north... to the east... Do the people of Liyue always talk in riddles? :{{A|vo zllq003 3 wanyan 08.ogg}} '''Wanyan:''' I—I think I've heard this saying before! :{{A|vo zllq003 3 zhongli 06.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Certainly you have, and the contents of this saying are also related to the God of Salt. :{{A|vo zllq003 3 zhongli 07.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' To provide a haven for her people, whose lives had been ravaged by the Archon War, this benevolent god searched all across Liyue. :{{A|vo zllq003 3 zhongli 08.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' At that time, with the chaotic fires of war engulfing the land, even one sliver of peace was a luxury. :{{A|vo zllq003 3 zhongli 09.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' And that haven she eventually found is right here. Today, it is known as Sal Terrae. :{{A|vo zllq003 3 wanyan 09.ogg}} '''Wanyan:''' How sad then... In the end, this peaceful place was destroyed by Morax. :{{A|vo zllq003 3 kliment 02.ogg}} '''Kliment:''' Okay, enough with these ancient stories. Now that we have the clue, hurry up and break the seal! Whatever happened doesn't matter as long as we can get inside that ruin! :{{A|vo zllq003 3 zhongli 10.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Now think {{Traveler}}, {{Color|buzzword|"Tianheng in the south, Yaoguang in the east, Jueyun in the west, Qingce in the north."}} :{{A|vo zllq003 3 zhongli 11.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' With this clue, you should be able to solve the puzzle. ;(If failed to activate the elemental monuments correctly) :{{A|vo zllq003 3 zhongli 12.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Tianheng in the {{Color|buzzword|south}}, Yaoguang in the {{Color|buzzword|east}}, Jueyun in the {{Color|buzzword|west}}, Qingce in the {{Color|buzzword|north}}. :{{A|vo zllq003 3 zhongli 13.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' The directions are the clue. Give it another try. ;(Follow Zhongli's instructions and light the monuments up) :{{A|vo zllq003 3 wanyan 10.ogg}} '''Wanyan:''' Look! The seal really was broken! Mr. Zhongli is indeed quite remarkable! :{{A|vo zllq003 3 zhongli 14.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' It was nothing, really. :{{A|vo zllq003 3 zhongli 15.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Now, it's time that people learn the hidden truth lost in time. ---- ;(Go to the site of the broken seal) :{{A|vo zllq003 6 zhongli 01.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Before entering the ruin, I have a proposal that will help us prevent the kind of senseless arguing between you two that we saw at Guyun Stone Forest. :{{A|vo zllq003 6 wanyan 01.ogg}} '''Wanyan:''' Okay, what is it? :{{A|vo zllq003 6 zhongli 02.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' I propose you two agree upon a contract, stipulating that we alternate who gets claim to each treasure we encounter, with only one object permitted per claim. :{{A|vo zllq003 6 zhongli 03.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' To show my sincerity, I won't be taking any treasure — this will just be between you all. :{{DIcon}} I won't take any either. :{{A|vo zllq003 6 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Heyyy! Don't pass an opportunity like this up so easily! :{{A|vo zllq003 6 kliment 01.ogg}} '''Kliment:''' I don't agree! I mean... you want me to split the treasure with this amateur archaeologist? No, absolutely not! :{{A|vo zllq003 6 wanyan 02.ogg}} '''Wanyan:''' I don't agree either! Hmph, he will only defile the precious relics left behind by the God of Salt! I—I can't accept this. :{{A|vo zllq003 6 zhongli 04.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Well then... If the contract is not agreed upon, I will no longer serve as your consultant on this expedition. :{{A|vo zllq003 6 zhongli 05.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' You will have to rely on your own experience to find whatever treasures are hidden in this ruin, as well as traps. :{{A|vo zllq003 6 kliment 02.ogg}} '''Kliment:''' Y—You have the audacity to demand this... Okay then. Even half of the treasure in the long-sealed ruin of the God of Salt should be enough to make a fortune. :{{A|vo zllq003 6 wanyan 03.ogg}} '''Wanyan:''' If you want me to agree upon this contract, so be it... I just have one request, Mr. Zhongli. :{{A|vo zllq003 6 wanyan 04.ogg}} '''Wanyan:''' If we discover the truth behind the God of Salt, you must judge it fairly, even if the truth harms Morax's image. :{{A|vo zllq003 6 zhongli 06.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' I can accept this arrangement. :{{A|vo zllq003 6 zhongli 07.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Well then, let's go. {{Dialogue End}} ==Video Guides== {{EVT |video1 = https://youtu.be/xb0LzDZjWvo |caption1 = A Ruin Under Lock and Key Quest Guide 1 |video2 = https://youtu.be/zLYJrTPo_2M |caption2 = A Ruin Under Lock and Key Quest Guide 2 }} ==Other Languages== {{Other Languages |en = A Ruin Under Lock and Key |zhs = 深锁之迹 |zhs_rm = Shēnsuǒ zhī Jì |zht = 深鎖之蹟 |zht_rm = Shēnsuǒ zhī Jī |zh_tl = Deeply Locked Ruins |ja = 深鎖の跡 |ja_rm = Shinsa no Ato |ja_tl = Deeply Locked Ruins |ko = 굳게 닫힌 유적 |ko_tl = Tightly Closed Ruin |es = Unas ruinas bajo llave |es_tl = A Ruin Under Lock and Key |fr = Une ruine sous clé |fr_tl = A Ruin Under Lock and Key |ru = Руины под замком |ru_tl = Ruins Under a Lock |th = ผนึกแห่งห้วงลึก |th_rm = Phanuek haeng Huang-luek |th_tl = The Seal of the Depths |vi = Di Tích Khóa Chặt |vi_tl = Locked Ruin |de = Ruinen unter Verschluss |de_tl = Ruins Under Closure |id = Reruntuhan di Bawah Kunci |id_tl = A Ruin Under Key |pt = Uma Ruína Sob a Fechadura |pt_tl = A Ruin Under a Lock |tr = Kilitli Bir Harabe |tr_tl = |it = Delle rovine chiuse a chiave |it_tl = Some Ruins Under Lock and Key }} ==Change History== {{Change History|1.1}} [[es:Unas ruinas bajo llave]] [[ja:深鎖の跡]] [[vi:Di Tích Khóa Chặt]]
