'''''A Search for Secrets''''' is the second part of {{Quest|A Thousand Moonlit Miles}}.

==Steps==
# Ask [[Xingqiu]] about [[Yuandai]]
# Meet up with the others at where [[Madame Ping]] is
# Listen to [[Shuyu]] tell of a secret experience
# Go to [[Wangshu Inn]]
# Look for clues in northern [[Jueyun Karst]] (0/3)
#* This quest step will advance after finding the abandoned house in the south.
# Go to [[Qingyun Peak]]

==Dialogue==
{{Quest Description|While eating at Wanmin Restaurant, you encounter Yuandai and Shuyu. Yuandai, forgetful in her old age, cannot remember her past, but perhaps her having once been a chivalrous heroine is a good place to start...}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Approach Xingqiu)
:{{A|vo lylq002 1 xingqiu 01.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' Huh, it's you two... What brings you here?
:{{A|vo lylq002 1 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Xingqiu! Great, we found you. We wanted to ask you about something!
:{{Black Screen|You explain the situation to Xingqiu.}}
:{{A|vo lylq002 1 xingqiu 02.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' Hmm... That's not a whole lot of information to go off of. I don't know if I can say for sure.
:{{DIcon}} That's fine.
:{{DIcon}} Anything is helpful and appreciated.
:{{A|vo lylq002 1 xingqiu 03.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' I can't pinpoint her identity from your description alone. But considering her age, I am reminded of a "nameless heroine" who's been featured in various chivalric novels.
:{{A|vo lylq002 1 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Nameless heroine?
:{{A|vo lylq002 1 xingqiu 04.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' That's right. The novels often speak of a great drought from fifty years ago. As the people suffered, a nameless heroine appeared and began to clear away evil spirits and bandit camps. The people idolized her but never learned her name.
:{{A|vo lylq002 1 xingqiu 05.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' All they knew was that she always acted alone. Later, though, she supposedly fell in love with a similarly noble-minded exorcist from Mt. Tianheng. They were well-matched in more ways than one, often fighting together as a fearsome duo of otherworldly strength.
:{{A|vo lylq002 1 xingqiu 06.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' After the drought ended, the heroine and the exorcist left the public eye and began living a reclusive life in the mountains. All that remained were tales of her incredible accomplishments.
:{{A|vo lylq002 1 xingqiu 07.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' The way this nameless heroine faded from fame into obscurity later in life is not too dissimilar from Ms. Yuandai. I hope that's somewhat helpful.
:{{A|vo lylq002 1 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Thanks a lot Xingqiu! We knew it'd be worth talking to you.
:{{A|vo lylq002 1 xingqiu 08.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' It's nothing at all, just something I came across while reading. I did do a bit of extra research on her story, but it was just out of personal curiosity.
:{{A|vo lylq002 1 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Well, Paimon still thinks that's super cool! Wait, Xingqiu, if you've read up on her, do you know of any places often associated with her?
:{{A|vo lylq002 1 xingqiu 09.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' Let me think... In the novels, the nameless heroine always appeared near one of three places: Wangshu Inn, the area just north of Jueyun Karst, and Qingyun Peak.
:{{A|vo lylq002 1 xingqiu 10.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' Perhaps the real-life heroine who inspired the character was also often seen near those three places. That would explain why those locations appear in the various novels written about her.
:{{DIcon}} Thanks so much, Xingqiu!
:{{DIcon}} You were a huge help!
:{{A|vo lylq002 1 xingqiu 11.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' Haha, you're welcome. To be honest, I found some parts of the story confusing when I first came across it. If Ms. Yuandai was indeed the original inspiration for the character, she may just be able to help me put the pieces together.
:{{A|vo lylq002 1 xingqiu 12.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' It's rare for a chivalric hero to fade into obscurity during their lifetime, even after retiring from the public eye. But no one ever saw or heard from the nameless heroine again... There were even rumors that she became extremely ill.
:{{A|vo lylq002 1 xingqiu 13.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' I've never understood why someone would go to such lengths to erase themselves from public memory. It's almost as if she was trying to hide from something... There's probably far more to the story than what's been written.
:{{A|vo lylq002 1 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' We'll be sure to tell you if we manage to uncover the truth!
:{{A|vo lylq002 1 xingqiu 14.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' That's a deal. Perhaps, behind the truth of it all, there lies a story more fantastical than any work of fiction.
:{{A|vo lylq002 1 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Paimon feels like we just learned so much from Xingqiu! A drought, a nameless heroine, a life of seclusion... Wait, why does this story sound super familiar?
:{{A|vo lylq002 1 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, right! There's a drought in this story, too. Um, Xingqiu, are droughts super common in Liyue or something?
:{{A|vo lylq002 1 xingqiu 15.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' Well... They used to be. But people have long since developed methods to prevent them, like by cultivating the soil or digging canals.
:{{A|vo lylq002 1 xingqiu 16.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' So while droughts do happen from time to time, they are rarely regarded as true disasters. The drought fifty years ago is probably one of the worst we've had in the last several centuries.
:{{A|vo lylq002 1 xingqiu 17.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' The crops withered, the streams ran dry, and the monsters in the mountains became rabid and agitated. Countless caravans were attacked, and people who lost their homes came together to form bandit groups... What started as a natural disaster soon became a human tragedy as well.
:{{A|vo lylq002 1 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' That sounds awful...
:{{A|vo lylq002 1 xingqiu 18.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' Yeah, and that's exactly why the nameless heroine was so beloved. She must have been someone of true integrity, to do so much for the people while asking nothing in return.
:{{A|vo lylq002 1 xingqiu 19.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' Still, as terrible as that drought was, it was nothing compared to the truly calamitous disasters that befell this land in ancient times.
:{{A|vo lylq002 1 xingqiu 20.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' They say that back in those days, disasters were both more severe and more common. Only the strongest of adepti could hope to dispel the ruin and devastation.
:{{A|vo lylq002 1 xingqiu 21.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' Do you have any other questions?
:{{A|vo lylq002 1 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' We're good for now! We're just going to head back and meet up with Ms. Xianyun and the others again.
:{{A|vo lylq002 1 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Paimon hopes that Granny Yuandai will be able to remember more of her past! She used to be a great hero who saved many people. It's so sad that she can't recall any of it.
:{{A|vo lylq002 1 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Anyway, we'll be off now! See you some other time, Xingqiu. Thank you so much for your help!
:{{A|vo lylq002 1 xingqiu 22.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' It's no problem at all. Safe travels.

;(Talk to Xingqiu again, optional)
:{{A|vo dialog lylq002 xingqiu 01.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' Time erases everything. Even the greatest of heroes will have their legacy reduced to the small fraction of their deeds that were committed to paper.
:{{A|vo dialog lylq002 xingqiu 02.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' But I think the magic of chivalric novels lies in the way you can catch glimpses of a noble soul from a few mere paragraphs.
{{Dialogue End}}
{{Quest Description|update|You hear from Xingqiu about three places that Yuandai may have been to when she was young. Time to meet up with the others at where Madame Ping is.}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Approach Madame Ping and Xianyun)
:{{A|vo lylq002 3 madameping 01.ogg}} '''Madame Ping:''' I have recorded the tune that you requested. I hope it will be of help to you.
:{{A|vo lylq002 3 xianyun 01.ogg}} '''Xianyun:''' Thank you.
:{{A|vo lylq002 3 madameping 02.ogg}} '''Madame Ping:''' Hehe...
:{{A|vo lylq002 3 xianyun 02.ogg}} '''Xianyun:''' Streetward... Ping, what has amused you so?
:{{A|vo lylq002 3 madameping 03.ogg}} '''Madame Ping:''' Oh, it's no serious matter. I was just reminiscing about the last time I saw you in this form... Time has wrought such change in this world, and yet, you appear just the same as ever.
:{{A|vo lylq002 3 xianyun 03.ogg}} '''Xianyun:''' Time has little bearing on one's existence, nor has one keenly felt its effects whilst dwelling at Mt. Aocang. Nevertheless, Ping... One would like to seek your counsel on a personal matter.
:{{A|vo lylq002 3 madameping 04.ogg}} '''Madame Ping:''' Oh? Why so formal all of a sudden? I must say, you're making me a little nervous. What is it?
:{{A|vo lylq002 3 xianyun 04.ogg}} '''Xianyun:''' Well... The inquiry is as such...
:{{A|vo lylq002 3 xianyun 05.ogg}} '''Xianyun:''' ...Approximately how much Mora would one need to afford a comfortable life in the Harbor, not unlike the one that you yourself lead?
:{{A|vo lylq002 3 madameping 05.ogg}} '''Madame Ping:''' Hmm... it does not require as much as you may think. Still, do you mean that—
:{{A|vo lylq002 3 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Cloud Retainer, Madame Ping! What are you two talking about?
:{{A|vo lylq002 3 xianyun 06.ogg}} '''Xianyun:''' Ahem... Nothing, save for some trivial matters. Have you unearthed any useful details?
:{{A|vo lylq002 3 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Xingqiu has a theory... But let's save it for when Shuyu and Ms. Yuandai have joined up with us again.
:{{Black Screen|Shuyu and Yuandai soon arrive at the scene. Paimon relays Xingqiu's theory...}}
:{{A|vo lylq002 3 shuyu 01.ogg}} '''Shuyu:''' ...
:{{A|vo lylq002 3 madameping 06.ogg}} '''Madame Ping:''' Do not be troubled, young lady. Here, have some tea.
:{{A|vo lylq002 3 shuyu 02.ogg}} '''Shuyu:''' Ah... Thank you so much.
:{{A|vo lylq002 3 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What do you think, Shuyu? Does it match up with what you know of your Granny?
:{{A|vo lylq002 3 shuyu 03.ogg}} '''Shuyu:''' According to the story, the nameless heroine eventually fell in love with an exorcist from Mt. Tianheng. Maybe... that's my grandpa.
:{{A|vo lylq002 3 shuyu 04.ogg}} '''Shuyu:''' I don't have many memories of him. But, there was this one time, I found a box in our attic full of a bunch of weird sigils.
:{{DIcon}} Seems like the stories were on the right track.
:{{DIcon}} We should probably pay a visit to the three places mentioned in the books.
:{{A|vo lylq002 3 shuyu 05.ogg}} '''Shuyu:''' I think so too. Granny might remember something once she's returned to a familiar place.
:{{A|vo lylq002 3 yuandai 01.ogg}} '''Yuandai:''' What marvelous tea... I can taste the dew's sweetness in this cup.
:{{A|vo lylq002 3 yuandai 02.ogg}} '''Yuandai:''' It's as if I was taking a stroll in the mountains... thoroughly one with nature, and at peace...
:{{A|vo lylq002 3 madameping 07.ogg}} '''Madame Ping:''' Is that so? Then please drink as much as you like. There's no need to hurry. At our age, it's always nice to slow down and take the time to appreciate pleasant conversation among friends.
:{{A|vo lylq002 3 yuandai 03.ogg}} '''Yuandai:''' Thank you...
:{{DIcon}} Let's rest here for a little while, then.
:{{A|vo lylq002 3 shuyu 06.ogg}} '''Shuyu:''' Okay. Since we have the time... Could I ask you something?
:{{A|vo lylq002 3 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Sure thing! What would you like to know?
:{{A|vo lylq002 3 shuyu 07.ogg}} '''Shuyu:''' Um... I have a secret I wanna tell you. Let's go talk over there.

;(Talk to Madame Ping or Yuandai, optional)
:{{A|vo dialog lylq002 madameping 01.ogg}} '''Madame Ping:''' You can taste the sweetness of the dew?
:{{A|vo dialog lylq002 yuandai 01.ogg}} '''Yuandai:''' It's just a feeling — the sensation of stepping out into the mountains on a cool morning, gazing upon the small droplets of water hanging from the leaves, and feeling the sweet stream of water soothe a parched throat with every swallow...
:{{A|vo dialog lylq002 yuandai 02.ogg}} '''Yuandai:''' It's a sense of calm and serenity, one that stretches on and on, until days become weeks, weeks become years...

;(Approach the marked location)
:{{A|vo lylq002 5 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What's wrong, Shuyu?
:{{A|vo lylq002 5 shuyu 01.ogg}} '''Shuyu:''' Well, I've kinda been meaning to ask ever since we started talking in the restaurant, but are you guys all... adepti in disguise?
:{{A|vo lylq002 5 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh! Uhh... About that...
:{{DIcon}} Why do you say that?
:{{A|vo lylq002 5 shuyu 02.ogg}} '''Shuyu:''' Well, you guys just seem super special. Plus... I think I might've heard Ms. Xianyun call herself an adeptus.
:{{A|vo lylq002 5 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Eh... Must have been a slip of the tongue, hehe... Xianyun, since you were the one who, uh, "misspoke," maybe you can explain to Shuyu here what you really meant by that.
:{{A|vo lylq002 5 xianyun 01.ogg}} '''Xianyun:''' Ahem...
:{{A|vo lylq002 5 xianyun 02.ogg}} '''Xianyun:''' One is indeed an adeptus. Is that of some concern to you?
:{{A|vo lylq002 5 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Eh!?
:{{A|vo lylq002 5 shuyu 03.ogg}} '''Shuyu:''' I knew it...
:{{DIcon}} You don't sound surprised at all.
:{{A|vo lylq002 5 shuyu 04.ogg}} '''Shuyu:''' Well... One time when I was a little kid, I saw a pure white illuminated crane.
:{{A|vo lylq002 5 shuyu 05.ogg}} '''Shuyu:''' I had this super high fever, and Granny wasn't around. I was feeling all icky and gross. But then, this snowy-white crane flew down from the sky!
:<gallery widths="350">
A Search for Secrets Quest Still 1.png
</gallery>
:{{A|vo lylq002 5 shuyu 06.ogg}} '''Shuyu:''' She put me on her back, and flew me to her cool adeptus house, and fed me some sort of magic potion. When I woke up, I was already back in my bed, and my fever was gone.
:{{A|vo lylq002 5 shuyu 07.ogg}} '''Shuyu:''' I really wanted to thank her, but I was too sleepy to stay awake, so I never got the chance.
:{{A|vo lylq002 5 shuyu 08.ogg}} '''Shuyu:''' So, I just kinda wanted to ask if maybe... any of you have ever met an adeptus like that?
:{{A|vo lylq002 5 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' A... pure white illuminated crane? The only two we've ever met are blue-and-white, and black-and-brown...
:{{A|vo lylq002 5 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Have you ever met one that's pure white, Cloud Retainer?
:{{A|vo lylq002 5 xianyun 03.ogg}} '''Xianyun:''' Hmph. Never has one met an adeptus with such features. One surmises such a description is but a hyperbolic embellishment that oft results from narrative accounts.
:{{A|vo lylq002 5 shuyu 09.ogg}} '''Shuyu:''' That's weird... Was it really just a dream, then?
:{{A|vo lylq002 5 shuyu 10.ogg}} '''Shuyu:''' Well, even if it was just in my head, it doesn't matter that much anyway — all I really want is to help Granny recover her memories. I'm really grateful for all your help.
:{{A|vo lylq002 5 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Leave it to us! Now that we know the three locations, we just need to visit them one by one.
:{{A|vo lylq002 5 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Let's go to Wangshu Inn first!
:{{A|vo lylq002 5 shuyu 11.ogg}} '''Shuyu:''' Okay! I'll go get Granny.

;(Talk to Madame Ping, optional)
:{{A|vo dialog lylq002 madameping 02.ogg}} '''Madame Ping:''' Leaving already? Well, just remember that you can come over for a cup of tea at any time.
----
{{Quest Description|Having finished chatting, the time for the investigation of places Yuandai has been to has come...}}
;(Approach Wangshu Inn)
:{{A|vo lylq002 7 yuandai 01.ogg}} '''Yuandai:''' Wangshu Inn... Wangshu Inn...
:{{A|vo lylq002 7 shuyu 01.ogg}} '''Shuyu:''' Do you remember this place, Granny?
:{{A|vo lylq002 7 yuandai 02.ogg}} '''Yuandai:''' Yes! The fish here is very delicious. And if you look out into the distance... you can always spot a bird that's been left behind by its flock.
:{{A|vo lylq002 7 yuandai 03.ogg}} '''Yuandai:''' I believe I used to have a room here. It had a window... Yes, yes, I spent a lot of time looking out that window. Which room was it again? Let me look...
:{{A|vo lylq002 7 shuyu 02.ogg}} '''Shuyu:''' I'll come with.
:{{A|vo lylq002 7 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Paimon's still having some trouble understanding what she's talking about, but if she's so familiar with this place, that must mean she lived here, right? Wait... Huh!?
:{{A|vo lylq002 7 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Woah! Xiao! What are you doing here all of a sudden? You scared the living daylights out of Paimon!
:{{A|vo lylq002 7 xiao 01.ogg}} '''Xiao:''' I sensed a non-human presence and decided to come take a look.
:{{A|vo lylq002 7 xiao 02.ogg}} '''Xiao:''' If you're here, then there's likely no trouble afoot. I suppose there's no cause for concern.
:{{A|vo lylq002 7 xiao 03.ogg}} '''Xiao:''' ...It's been a while, Cloud Retainer. I see you have returned to your previous form.
:{{DIcon}} You've met her in this form before?
:{{A|vo lylq002 7 xiao 04.ogg}} '''Xiao:''' I have indeed. I fought alongside her in this form on many occasions during the [[Archon War]].
:{{A|vo lylq002 7 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh wow! What was she like during the War?
:{{A|vo lylq002 7 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wait, let Paimon take a guess... Was it anything like this?
:;(An imaginary weapon appears beside Paimon)
:{{A|vo lylq002 7 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Behold the glory of one's newest invention, the Bang-Bang Continuous Fire Mechanism! Hands up in surrender, or be prepared to face the full might of the adepti!
:{{A|vo lylq002 7 xiao 05.ogg}} '''Xiao:''' An impressive imitation.
:{{A|vo lylq002 7 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hehe, Paimon knows her all too well!
:{{A|vo lylq002 7 xiao 06.ogg}} '''Xiao:''' Even so, Cloud Retainer was not always as ostentatious as you describe. You may be unaware, but her talent with adepti sigils is just as formidable as her skill in mechanics.
:{{A|vo lylq002 7 xiao 07.ogg}} '''Xiao:''' The Archon War reached its peak after [[Guizhong]]'s death. The Cloud Retainer who fought beside me in those devastating battles was taciturn and solemn, only speaking when she had to activate her sigils.
:{{A|vo lylq002 7 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' A... Cloud Retainer who barely talks? Paimon can't picture it. But what happened after that? If you were so powerful in your human form, why did you decide to take up your bird form again?
:{{A|vo lylq002 7 xianyun 01.ogg}} '''Xianyun:''' Once one had bid farewell to the world of mortals, what use would one still have for such a shape?
:{{A|vo lylq002 7 xianyun 02.ogg}} '''Xianyun:''' When dwelling between mountain and forest, away from the struggles and troubles of the mortal world, a mortal form is hardly the most fitting of choices.
:{{A|vo lylq002 7 xiao 08.ogg}} '''Xiao:''' After the war, Cloud Retainer retired to Mt. Aocang, only revealing herself to the occasional visitor, and always in her avian form.
:{{A|vo lylq002 7 xiao 09.ogg}} '''Xiao:''' ...Although, I do believe there was an occasion some thirty odd years ago when she decided to don her human form. I believe it was for the purpose of—
:{{A|vo lylq002 7 xianyun 03.ogg}} '''Xianyun:''' Ahem. One believes there is little need to relive bygone matters.
:{{A|vo lylq002 7 shuyu 03.ogg}} '''Shuyu:''' Granny! Are you okay!?
:{{A|vo lylq002 7 yuandai 04.ogg}} '''Yuandai:''' Ahh... Back then, at this place, I...
:{{A|vo lylq002 7 xiao 10.ogg}} '''Xiao:''' Perhaps this conversation should end here. I shall take my leave now.
:{{A|vo lylq002 7 xiao 11.ogg}} '''Xiao:''' Should you encounter any trouble, you need only call my name. However, given that you are traveling with Cloud Retainer, I trust you are in good hands.
:{{A|vo lylq002 7 shuyu 04.ogg}} '''Shuyu:''' Everyone, I—I think Granny is finally beginning to remember her past!
:{{A|vo lylq002 7 xianyun 04.ogg}} '''Xianyun:''' Slowly now. Calm your mind, and recount what has been recalled.
:{{A|vo lylq002 7 yuandai 05.ogg}} '''Yuandai:''' A long time ago, I... stayed here to recuperate from my illness.
:{{A|vo lylq002 7 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh? So what Xingqiu said was true? You did fall ill? Was that why you went into hiding?
:{{A|vo lylq002 7 yuandai 06.ogg}} '''Yuandai:''' I... don't remember. I'm very sorry, but I can't even remember the name of my illness. The only thing I can remember is that it took a great toll on me, and there was no cure for it.
:{{A|vo lylq002 7 yuandai 07.ogg}} '''Yuandai:''' I was confined to my room in Wangshu Inn, where I spent many days unconscious. I'd come to every once in a while and stare at the migrating birds outside the window. It was a solemn sight. I remember crying... but I'm not even sure I knew why...
:<gallery widths="350">
A Search for Secrets Quest Still 2.png
</gallery>
:{{A|vo lylq002 7 yuandai 08.ogg}} '''Yuandai:''' One day, I met a traveling merchant. Upon hearing of my illness, he sold me a bottle of Soul-Revitalizing Teapills.
:{{A|vo lylq002 7 yuandai 09.ogg}} '''Yuandai:''' He told me that the pills were concocted using adepti blood and could be used to alleviate my symptoms. Sure enough, I made a full recovery. My illness remained dormant for several decades after that.
:{{DIcon}} So the "dementia" you're suffering from now is actually...
:{{A|vo lylq002 7 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wait, but if your illness "remained dormant" for several decades, are you saying that... what you're going through now is just a relapse of what happened all those years ago?
:{{A|vo lylq002 7 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' And it was all thanks to the pills that you managed to keep the symptoms in check? Ugh... Paimon's brain kinda hurts... Do you remember anything else?
:{{A|vo lylq002 7 yuandai 10.ogg}} '''Yuandai:''' I'm sorry, I don't. *sigh* Ahh... If only I wasn't so useless...
:{{A|vo lylq002 7 shuyu 05.ogg}} '''Shuyu:''' Hey, you're not useless! You've done so much for me, watched me grow up, raised me... How could you say that about yourself...
:{{A|vo lylq002 7 yuandai 11.ogg}} '''Yuandai:''' Fret not, dear child. Granny was just a bit frustrated. That's all...
:{{A|vo lylq002 7 xianyun 05.ogg}} '''Xianyun:''' The recovery of a person's memories is a gradual process. Finding pieces of one's past is always superior to not finding anything at all. Let us make haste to the next location.
:{{A|vo lylq002 7 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Next location... next location... Why don't we go to the area north of Jueyun Karst next?
:{{A|vo lylq002 7 paimon 12.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' There isn't really a landmark there, so where should we start? Oh, Paimon's got it! Let's check out the houses in the area first.
:{{A|vo lylq002 7 paimon 13.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' After all, if she was there for any length of time, then she would've stayed somewhere, right? Paimon's really got her thinking cap on today! At this rate, we'll recover all of Granny Yuandai's memories in no time.
----
;(Approach the northwestern marked area)
:{{A|vo lylq002 11 yuandai 01.ogg}} '''Yuandai:''' Hmm...
:{{DIcon}} What about this place? Any memories?
:{{A|vo lylq002 11 yuandai 02.ogg}} '''Yuandai:''' I don't remember this place at all... I don't think I've ever been here before.
:{{A|vo lylq002 11 yuandai 03.ogg}} '''Yuandai:''' Still, I was thinking... This place feels perfect for a game of hide-and-seek.
:{{A|vo lylq002 11 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh? Why a game of hide-and-seek?
:{{A|vo lylq002 11 yuandai 04.ogg}} '''Yuandai:''' I'm not sure. Maybe it's because... I used to play that game a lot with Shuyu when she was younger.
:{{A|vo lylq002 11 shuyu 01.ogg}} '''Shuyu:''' Hmm, I don't remember playing it that much. Are you sure about that, Granny? We only played a few times, and we stopped once we realized I was no good at the whole seeking part.
:{{A|vo lylq002 11 yuandai 05.ogg}} '''Yuandai:''' Ah, is that so? Then I must be mistaken.
:{{A|vo lylq002 11 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hmm, not here, then... Let's try somewhere else.

;(Approach the southeastern marked area)
:{{A|vo lylq002 8 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Whoa! Why are there so many Treasure Hoarders here?
:{{A|vo lylq002 8 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Guess it's time to round up some bad guys, {{Traveler}}!

;(Defeat the Treasure Hoarders)
:{{A|vo lylq002 9 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Do you remember anything about this place, Granny Yuandai?
:{{A|vo lylq002 9 yuandai 01.ogg}} '''Yuandai:''' Let me think... I feel like I've been here before.
:{{A|vo lylq002 9 yuandai 02.ogg}} '''Yuandai:''' But I don't think I stayed here too long. I might have just rested here briefly before continuing on my way.
:{{A|vo lylq002 9 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Got it... That's okay, there are still plenty of other places we can check!

;(After the cutscene)
:{{A|vo lylq002 10 yuandai 01.ogg}} '''Yuandai:''' Wait a second. If I remember correctly... I believe I brought... Ah yes, I brought some sweet snacks with me.
:{{A|vo lylq002 10 yuandai 02.ogg}} '''Yuandai:''' Go on, take some. You need to eat a lot if you want to grow big and strong...
:{{A|vo lylq002 10 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Whoa, thank you! Then Paimon will help herself!

;(Approach the southwestern marked area)
:{{A|vo lylq002 12 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Paimon sees an abandoned house! Why don't we take a break over there?
:{{A|vo lylq002 12 yuandai 01.ogg}} '''Yuandai:''' This place... It's...
:{{A|vo lylq002 12 shuyu 01.ogg}} '''Shuyu:''' Did you remember something, Granny?
:{{A|vo lylq002 12 yuandai 02.ogg}} '''Yuandai:''' I... I remember. Shuyu... This is where your father was born.
:{{A|vo lylq002 12 yuandai 03.ogg}} '''Yuandai:''' It was a moonless night. I had been injured, so your Grandpa was supporting me. We fled together, with some being in the fog behind us in hot pursuit...
:{{A|vo lylq002 12 yuandai 04.ogg}} '''Yuandai:''' I had exhausted my strength when the labor pains came on, so we took refuge in this house. Your Grandpa set up a barrier outside, but neither of us knew if it could hold the monsters back.
:<gallery widths="350">
A Search for Secrets Quest Still 3.png
</gallery>
:{{A|vo lylq002 12 yuandai 05.ogg}} '''Yuandai:''' I remember that night... I remember falling to my knees, reciting a prayer over and over.
:{{A|vo lylq002 12 yuandai 06.ogg}} '''Yuandai:''' I alone am the source of this sin. Punish me as you wish for forsaking my oath, but spare my innocent child.
:{{A|vo lylq002 12 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' ...Sin? Oath? Did you do something wrong?
:{{A|vo lylq002 12 yuandai 07.ogg}} '''Yuandai:''' I don't know... I don't remember. I only remember praying in the darkness with all my strength, until the sun finally rose again, and the fog cleared out.
:{{A|vo lylq002 12 yuandai 08.ogg}} '''Yuandai:''' Eventually, the house was filled with the sound of my baby's first cries. That baby was your father. I remember... I clutched him tight to my chest and wept tears of joy. It was the first time I'd ever felt such happiness in my life.
:{{A|vo lylq002 12 shuyu 02.ogg}} '''Shuyu:''' My dad...
:{{A|vo lylq002 12 yuandai 09.ogg}} '''Yuandai:''' He was my pride and joy, and so are you, Shuyu. You're so much like him, and I love you both so much...
:{{A|vo lylq002 12 yuandai 10.ogg}} '''Yuandai:''' But you're... always going to be different from me. I... Why... Just what did I do?
:{{A|vo lylq002 12 shuyu 03.ogg}} '''Shuyu:''' I don't care what you might have done, Granny. You'll always be the person I love more than anything.
:{{A|vo lylq002 12 yuandai 11.ogg}} '''Yuandai:''' You're too sweet, Shuyu. I'm lucky to have you with me... If not for you, I would not have had the courage to come here, to try to remember what I've forgotten.
:{{A|vo lylq002 12 yuandai 12.ogg}} '''Yuandai:''' Alright, let's not stand around any longer. There's one place left, yes? Let's go take a look.

;(After the cutscene)
:{{A|vo lylq002 13 xianyun 01.ogg}} '''Xianyun:''' If one recalls correctly, the next place should be Qingyun Peak. Yuandai, how fares your health?
:{{A|vo lylq002 13 yuandai 01.ogg}} '''Yuandai:''' I may be a bit slow, but I'll do my best to keep up. I'm sorry to keep everyone waiting...
:{{A|vo lylq002 13 xianyun 02.ogg}} '''Xianyun:''' Climb on. I shall carry you to the top.
:{{A|vo lylq002 13 xianyun 03.ogg}} '''Xianyun:''' ...Such lightness of weight.
:{{A|vo lylq002 13 yuandai 02.ogg}} '''Yuandai:''' All those who grow old grow frail in the end, do they not? First, you lose your memory, then your health. Eventually, you end up losing everything.
:{{A|vo lylq002 13 yuandai 03.ogg}} '''Yuandai:''' My only wish is to depart this world with a lucid mind, to free myself of this torment and the burden it places upon others...
:{{A|vo lylq002 13 xianyun 04.ogg}} '''Xianyun:''' Fret not. You have my aid in this endeavor.

;(Approach the marked location on Qingyun Peak)
:{{A|vo lylq002 14 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Phew, we're finally here!
:{{A|vo lylq002 14 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Does this place feel familiar to you, Granny Yuandai?
:{{A|vo lylq002 14 yuandai 01.ogg}} '''Yuandai:''' Let me see...
:{{A|vo lylq002 14 yuandai 02.ogg}} '''Yuandai:''' ...How strange. Have I... lived here before?
:{{DIcon}} Take it easy.
:{{DIcon}} Take your time.
:{{A|vo lylq002 14 yuandai 03.ogg}} '''Yuandai:''' When we were at Wangshu Inn and the abandoned house earlier, though I couldn't remember everything, I still... felt a sense of familiarity. I could easily picture myself in those places...
:{{A|vo lylq002 14 yuandai 04.ogg}} '''Yuandai:''' But here... I don't have that feeling. Perhaps I did come here in the past, but it just didn't leave a strong impression on me.
:{{A|vo lylq002 14 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' But... Did the stories get it wrong, then?
:{{DIcon}} We can't expect them to get everything right.
:{{A|vo lylq002 14 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yeah, that's true... But they're also the only thing we have to go off of.
:{{A|vo lylq002 14 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Paimon was hoping this place would jog Granny Yuandai's memory just like the others.
:{{A|vo lylq002 14 yuandai 05.ogg}} '''Yuandai:''' I'm sorry to disappoint you two.
:{{A|vo lylq002 14 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' It's alright! We're not going to give up yet! We'll figure something else out, just you wait!
:{{A|vo lylq002 14 yuandai 06.ogg}} '''Yuandai:''' Thank you. If only I could remember...
:{{A|vo lylq002 14 yuandai 07.ogg}} '''Yuandai:''' Huh? That way... What's that mountain?
:{{A|vo lylq002 14 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ooh, let Paimon look — huh!? Isn't that Mt. Aocang? Looks like we've come full circle!
:{{A|vo lylq002 14 yuandai 08.ogg}} '''Yuandai:''' Mt. Aocang... Mt. Aocang...
:{{A|vo lylq002 14 shuyu 01.ogg}} '''Shuyu:''' Granny? Are you okay?
:{{A|vo lylq002 14 shuyu 02.ogg}} '''Shuyu:''' Don't push yourself, Granny. It's okay if you can't remember... You shouldn't do something that makes you sad...
:{{A|vo lylq002 14 yuandai 09.ogg}} '''Yuandai:''' Mt. Aocang. I... What am I, really...
:{{A|vo lylq002 14 xianyun 01.ogg}} '''Xianyun:''' Mt. Aocang holds some familiarity to you?
:{{A|vo lylq002 14 yuandai 10.ogg}} '''Yuandai:''' It does. But I... I can't go back...
:{{A|vo lylq002 14 xianyun 02.ogg}} '''Xianyun:''' Are you feeling unwell?
:{{A|vo lylq002 14 yuandai 11.ogg}} '''Yuandai:''' My head... It feels all heavy and dizzy. Just what is wrong with me?
:{{A|vo lylq002 14 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Cloud... Ms. Xianyun. Is there anything you can do...?
:{{A|vo lylq002 14 xianyun 03.ogg}} '''Xianyun:''' Let us go to Mt. Aocang.
:{{A|vo lylq002 14 shuyu 03.ogg}} '''Shuyu:''' ...But—
:{{A|vo lylq002 14 xianyun 04.ogg}} '''Xianyun:''' Fret not, all will be well. Yuandai, you have already given more than enough to the pursuit of this endeavor.
:{{A|vo lylq002 14 xianyun 05.ogg}} '''Xianyun:''' You may leave the rest to me. I've prepared something that can aid you in suppressing the fear in your heart and restoring your lost memories. It currently resides at Mt. Aocang.
:{{A|vo lylq002 14 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wait, really!? When did you do that?
:{{A|vo lylq002 14 xianyun 06.ogg}} '''Xianyun:''' Hah, I never leave anything to chance. All will reveal itself when we arrive.

==Steps==
# Head for Albedo's campsite
# Return to the adventurer camp
# Talk to Cyrus
# Go to Mondstadt's alchemy store

==Dialogue==
{{Quest Description|You return to Dragonspine with your tale to meet Albedo at the encampment. The hitherto unknown secret may yet lie buried on this mysterious and perilous snowy mountain...}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(On login)
:{{A|vo eqxs105 1 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Guess what? Paimon's story is finished! Let's go see Albedo again!

;(Approach Albedo's camp)
:{{A|vo eqxs105 1 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Albedo!
:{{A|vo eqxs105 1 albedo 01.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Traveler, Paimon.
:{{A|vo eqxs105 1 albedo 02.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' I suppose your story is ready.
:{{A|vo eqxs105 1 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yup yup! How about you? Do you need some more time?
:{{A|vo eqxs105 1 albedo 03.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' No need. I am also ready to tell my story.
:{{A|vo eqxs105 1 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Paimon calls dibs! Paimon first!
:{{A|vo eqxs105 1 albedo 04.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Please, go ahead.
:{{A|vo eqxs105 1 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Okay, here goes!
:{{A|vo eqxs105 1 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Once upon a time, there was an evil researcher who went into the mountains and did a crazy experiment on whopperflowers to transform their appearance. After a lot of pain and suffering, the whopperflowers finally took on a human form. Then, they stood by the side of the mountain to wait for unsuspecting bypassers...
:{{A|vo eqxs105 1 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' To whoever spoke to them, they would ask some questions, such as: "Who am I?" "Who are you?"
:{{A|vo eqxs105 1 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' If the bypasser got the wrong answer... The last sound they'd make would be a "yelp" before the whopperflower ate them alive in one bite!
:{{A|vo eqxs105 1 albedo 05.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Oh, truly frightening.
:{{DIcon}} Yes, Paimon is truly frightening.
:{{A|vo eqxs105 1 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What the... You two aren't scared at all!
:{{DIcon}} Maybe I'm just really tough, I don't know.
:{{A|vo eqxs105 1 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Don't go nitpicking, okay! If you didn't like the story, go write your own.
:{{DIcon}} Ooh, in that case, I would add some horror elements in...
::{{DIcon}} After the whopperflowers eat someone...
::{{DIcon}} They would turn into that person!
:{{A|vo eqxs105 1 albedo 06.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' In other words, the whopperflowers would ambush and then completely replace their victims.
:{{DIcon}} And then adopt their newfound identity.
:{{A|vo eqxs105 1 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' And then what? Go back to where the person lives? Enter their home!? Eat their whole family!? Aaaah!!!
:{{A|vo eqxs105 1 paimon 12.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh, Paimon made up this story, but now Paimon's the one who's scared by it...
:{{A|vo eqxs105 1 albedo 07.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' It's a good story. May I write it down? I may bring it up in future conversations.
:{{A|vo eqxs105 1 paimon 13.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What for? Just to scare people with?
:{{A|vo eqxs105 1 albedo 08.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Yes.
:{{A|vo eqxs105 1 paimon 14.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You've got a real mean streak, Albedo!
:{{DIcon}} So what's your story?
:{{A|vo eqxs105 1 albedo 09.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Mine is a little longer than yours. It starts with an alchemist.
:{{A|vo eqxs105 1 albedo 10.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' A great alchemist once created Subject One. Subject One was her proudest achievement, and successfully blended into human society. No one ever would have thought that this friend of theirs was in fact a synthetic human.
:{{A|vo eqxs105 1 albedo 11.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' However, unbeknownst to Subject One, the alchemist had tried the same experiment many times before he had come into being. Some of the rejects from failed experiments had been discarded, but had not died.
:{{A|vo eqxs105 1 albedo 12.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Subject Two was one such failed experiment. He was swallowed by a great dragon that came to rest upon a snowswept mountain. Many years later, he was resurrected by the dragon's mysterious power.
:{{A|vo eqxs105 1 albedo 13.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' He saw all kinds of people on the mountain, including... Subject One, who had somehow, miraculously, blended in among them.
:{{A|vo eqxs105 1 albedo 14.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Never in Subject Two's wildest imagination had he thought it possible for experimental life forms such as they to deceive everyone so successfully. He saw the way humans accepted Subject One as a friend, witnessed their affection as they addressed him by name.
:{{A|vo eqxs105 1 albedo 15.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' This was what Subject Two wanted. Now, all that Subject Two desired was to replace Subject One and take the joy of his existence for himself.
:{{A|vo eqxs105 1 paimon 15.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Uhhh... Th—This is giving Paimon the chills. It's so scary...
:{{A|vo eqxs105 1 albedo 16.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Subject Two began to unfold his plan. He stole Subject One's books and notes and studied all that Subject One had learned from the alchemist. Subject Two was highly intelligent and he learned quickly.
:{{A|vo eqxs105 1 albedo 17.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' He changed his face into an exact replica of Subject One's face. Then, he found a plant with mimicry capabilities and transformed it using dragon blood and alchemy.
:{{DIcon}} ...
:{{A|vo eqxs105 1 albedo 18.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' And so, not only did Subject Two transform his own appearance to perfectly match that of Subject One, he also created a third entity: Subject Three.
:{{A|vo eqxs105 1 paimon 16.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What!? There's three of them now!?
:{{A|vo eqxs105 1 albedo 19.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' But Subject Two wanted to become a perfected human. So, he erased the mark on both his and Subject Three's necks, for these marks were symbols of imperfection.
:{{DIcon}} He purposely erased it?
:{{A|vo eqxs105 1 albedo 20.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' In my view, it was probably a subconscious act. An instinct.
:{{A|vo eqxs105 1 albedo 21.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' He so desperately craved to become a perfect human being that he forgot something: Human beings are defined by their flaws.
:{{A|vo eqxs105 1 albedo 22.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Subject Two's plan was meticulously crafted. Subject Three would draw Subject One's attention. After Subject One disposed of Subject Three, he would assume the threat had now disappeared, and would let his guard down.
:{{A|vo eqxs105 1 albedo 23.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' The next moment that Subject One was alone, Subject Two would make his move. He would eliminate Subject One and become the only one remaining.
:{{A|vo eqxs105 1 albedo 24.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' He would secretly replace the Subject One of everyone's memories, and inherit his identity, residence, clothing, sword, name, and friends.
:{{A|vo eqxs105 1 albedo 25.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' People would have no idea that the individual they knew had become somebody else from one day to the next.
:{{A|vo eqxs105 1 paimon 17.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Uhh, uhh, this is way too scary... Paimon's never gonna be able to trust anyone again...
:{{A|vo eqxs105 1 albedo 26.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' But just before Subject Two could carry out his plan, a unique stranger entered the mix. Subject Two tried to make contact with this person, but found that they could somehow sense he was different from Subject One.
:{{A|vo eqxs105 1 paimon 18.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' ...
:{{DIcon}} ...
:{{A|vo eqxs105 1 albedo 27.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' What's wrong? Are you scared?
:{{A|vo eqxs105 1 paimon 19.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What happened then? What happened to the stranger?
:{{A|vo eqxs105 1 albedo 28.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' He became a new stage in Subject Two's plan. One more person that Subject Two had to dispose of.
:{{A|vo eqxs105 1 albedo 29.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' It's as if there were three identical roses in a garden. Only one of the three was a fine specimen, while the other two were defective specimens that bore poisonous thorns.
:{{A|vo eqxs105 1 albedo 30.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' In all the world, only the gardener who tended to them could tell which was the good specimen.
:{{A|vo eqxs105 1 albedo 31.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' People do not like poisonous plants. Only a perfect rose can fetch a high price. If the inferior specimens wanted to conceal the fact of their worthlessness, they would have to take the gardener out of the picture using their poisonous thorns.
:{{A|vo eqxs105 1 albedo 32.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' This is exactly what Subject Two was thinking. So he hid in the shadows and waited patiently. Maybe soon, he would get his chance to become truly human.
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (This is not just a story...)
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (These are real events. Albedo is trying to tell me the cruel and unbelievable truth.)
:{{A|vo eqxs105 1 paimon 20.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Whew, that was intense. So what happened after that? Did Subject Two's plan succeed? Uhh, Paimon can't bear thinking about it...
:{{A|vo eqxs105 1 albedo 33.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Fortunately, it is just a story, and even in this story, Subject Two did not succeed. But you can never let your guard down on Dragonspine.
:{{A|vo eqxs105 1 albedo 34.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Monsters mutated with Durin's power and blood are also creatures of Rhinedottir, just like me. You must beware of all such creatures.
:{{DIcon}} Don't say that! You're not a monster, you're my friend.
:{{A|vo eqxs105 1 albedo 35.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' I'm glad to hear that. It's okay. I know what I am. You and I are both "different," so there is no need for me to hide the truth from you.
:{{A|vo eqxs105 1 albedo 36.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' The only thing is that sometimes, when I think about how mighty the power of alchemy is, I feel so small.
:{{A|vo eqxs105 1 albedo 37.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' As beings who set foot in this world, how arrogant are we in desiring to control our destiny, and in desiring to create?
:{{A|vo eqxs105 1 albedo 38.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Is creation an arrogant act, Traveler? If not, why do we call the ones that created us and control us, "gods"?
:{{A|vo eqxs105 1 albedo 39.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' If it is, then what qualifies us to call ourselves creators? How far must we take our reverence and respect, and what purpose does it serve?
:{{DIcon}} How did you feel when you took out the impostor?
:{{A|vo eqxs105 1 albedo 40.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Nothing special. But...
:{{A|vo eqxs105 1 albedo 41.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' ...Whenever I think about it, I feel a twinge of grief.
:{{A|vo eqxs105 1 paimon 21.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Poor Albedo...
:{{A|vo eqxs105 1 ambor 01.ogg}} '''???:''' Helloooo! Traveler! Are you here?
:{{A|vo eqxs105 1 paimon 22.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hey, is that Amber?
:{{A|vo eqxs105 1 eula 01.ogg}} '''Eula:''' Thought we might find you here.
:{{A|vo eqxs105 1 ambor 02.ogg}} '''Amber:''' We're here to deliver a message from Cyrus. There's gonna be a big event down at the base camp, and they want you there too, Traveler.
:{{A|vo eqxs105 1 eula 02.ogg}} '''Eula:''' Winter camp is nearing its end. Apparently, even provisional instructors are required to attend.
:{{A|vo eqxs105 1 paimon 23.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Looks like we need to go, Albedo. Bye for now.
:{{A|vo eqxs105 1 albedo 42.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Then I won't keep you. I have some things to attend to here, so forgive me for not seeing you down.
:{{A|vo eqxs105 1 ambor 03.ogg}} '''Amber:''' Don't worry about it! There've been no issues getting up and down the mountain recently.
:{{A|vo eqxs105 1 eula 03.ogg}} '''Eula:''' Is everyone ready? Let's not keep them waiting.

:{{A|vo eqxs105 3 recklesspallad 05.ogg}} '''Reckless Pallad:''' The place I fell to was somewhere I didn't recognize, and I'd sustained a few injuries. I remember thinking to myself: "This is the worst luck I've ever had in my whole life"...

:{{A|vo eqxs105 3 recklesspallad 06.ogg}} '''Reckless Pallad:''' ...Then I met Joserf. He'd heard the sound of me falling and came out to see what was going on!

Dad!" That's when Joserf suddenly started to remember.

:{{A|vo eqxs105 3 bennett 05.ogg}} '''Bennett:''' Ah... This is good... This is good...

:{{A|vo eqxs105 3 joel 04a.ogg}}<!-- {{A|vo eqxs105 3 joel 04b.ogg}} --> '''Joel:''' Oh, yeah — I wanna say thank-you to the Traveler, Uncle Cyrus, Aunty Eula, and Aunty Amber. Thanks everyone.

:{{A|vo eqxs105 3 joel 07.ogg}} '''Joel:''' Wow! Really? This is awesome! You're the best, Aunty Eula!

'''''A Secretary in a Sea of Humanity''''' is the second part of {{Quest|Sea of Clouds, Sea of People}}.

==Steps==
# Accompany Ganyu to return to [[Liyue Harbor]]
# Stroll around Liyue Harbor's wharf
# Head to [[Yuehai Pavilion]] and speak to [[Huixin]]
# Go to the [[Wanyou Boutique]] and talk to [[Bolai]]
# Go to [[Fanmu Carpenter]]'s and speak with [[Master Lu]]
# Defeat the suspicious [[Fatui]] underling{{Enemy List|Fatui Skirmisher - Cryogunner Legionnaire*0}}
# Clear the warehouse of its occupants
#* Wave 1:{{Enemy List|Blazing Axe Mitachurl;Hilichurl Grenadier*2;Hilichurl Berserker;Electro Hilichurl Shooter}}
#* Wave 2:{{Enemy List|Rock Shieldwall Mitachurl;Rock Shield Hilichurl Guard*2;Hilichurl Berserker*2}}
# Look for the {{Item|Invoice From Second Life|text=invoice}} from [[Second Life]]
# Return to Yuehai Pavilion and speak to Huixin
# Talk to [[Dongsheng]] at Second Life

::{{A|vo gylq002 3 huixin 11a.ogg}} '''Huixin:''' Ms. Ganyu plans to let them expose each other.

::{{A|vo gylq002 3 ganyu 10b.ogg}} '''Ganyu:''' Exactly.
:{{A|vo gylq002 3 ganyu 11.ogg}} '''Ganyu:''' Let's start with Wanyou Boutique. The owner's name is... Bolai, isn't it?

'''''A Series of Twists and Turns''''' is the second part of the [[Whirling Waltz]] Event.

==Steps==
# Wait until the morning of the day after tomorrow (08:00 – 10:00)
# Go to the [[Palais Mermonia]] to find out what's happening
# A few days ago, at [[Romaritime Harbor]]<!-- yes, it's written exactly like that -->
#* This occurs if the player leaves Romaritime Harbor during steps 4 or 5.<!-- barrier prevents walking away, but teleporting away is allowed; dying doesn't seem to be possible -->
# Approach quietly and find out what the suspicious folk are up to
# Find a way to create a diversion so you can investigate the cargo
# Approach quietly and find out what the suspicious folk are up to
# Discuss the case with everyone present
# Go find Ororon and Ifa
# Wait till 08:00 – 10:00 the next day
# Go to the Palais Mermonia
# Return to the entrance of the Palais Mermonia and carry out the plan
#* This occurs if the player leaves the area during step 10. Select "Move Out" to resume.
# Head to the plaza as planned

==Gameplay Notes==
* During steps 4–6, the party will be limited to a trial [[Kinich]] with [[Stealth]] gameplay.
** During step 5, pressing the [[Normal Attack]] input throws a distraction that will attract the smugglers. Holding the Normal Attack input allows Kinich to aim.
** If the player gets spotted by the smugglers during steps 4–6, the player will return to step 3.
* During step 12, the party will be limited to a trial [[Wriothesley]].

:{{A|Vo jyeq102 24 cacucu 04.ogg}} '''Cacucu:''' Feeling smug now, are we?

:{{A|Vo jyeq102 24 wriothesley 11.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' Go on.
:{{A|Vo jyeq102 24 argenteau 22.ogg}} '''Argenteau:''' Ah, where was I... Well anyway, I thought to myself, seeing as the item itself came from Natlan, it would make more sense if I could find someone from there to go retrieve it.
:{{A|Vo jyeq102 24 argenteau 23.ogg}} '''Argenteau:''' And by a stroke of complete and utter coincidence, I just so happened to see these two young folks wandering around, so I...

:{{A|Vo jyeq102 24 wriothesley 12.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' I need you to clear something up for me. You haven't paid the seller yet, correct? And yet, he told you to collect the item from the Palais Mermonia. Was he not worried that you'd just split afterwards?

:{{A|Vo jyeq102 24 wriothesley 14.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' So, Mr...

:{{A|Vo jyeq102 24 wriothesley 15.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' Alright, Mr. Argenteau, listen very carefully to what I'm about to say. It will determine how much of the rest of your life you'll be spending beneath the waves.

:{{A|Vo jyeq102 24 wriothesley 16.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' Owing to your suspected involvement in the illicit trade of Natlanese relics, you're now one of the suspects in an international smuggling case.
:{{A|Vo jyeq102 24 wriothesley 17.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' A trip to the [[Opera Epiclese]] seems unavoidable at this stage, but on the bright side, you still have one chance to make things right.

:{{A|Vo jyeq102 24 wriothesley 18.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' It's very simple. Just reach out to your seller in the same way as usual, arrange to meet, bring the money, and make the deal. Just be sure to let me know all the details — I'm talking time, place, the whole lot.

:{{A|Vo jyeq102 24 wriothesley 24.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' See, Mr. Cacucu knows exactly where I'm coming from.
:{{A|Vo jyeq102 24 wriothesley 25.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' So I was thinking, since you're all friends of {{Traveler}}...

I almost get the feeling that if he misses out on this opportunity, he won't have any other way of making money.

:{{A|Vo jyeq102 25 kinich 03.ogg}} '''Kinich:''' ...
:{{A|Vo jyeq102 25 wriothesley 07.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' ...Or, ugh, I dunno.
:{{A|Vo jyeq102 25 wriothesley 08.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' Maybe he'll cut his losses and vanish into thin air, and our efforts will have been in vain.
:{{A|Vo jyeq102 25 wriothesley 09.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' At least Natlan will get the stolen relic back, so it won't have been for nothing.

'''''A Single Harmony for an Irreplaceable Soul''''' is the second [[Event Quest]] during the [[The Exquisite Night Chimes]] Event.

==Steps==
# Wait until the appointed time (08:00 – 10:00 two days later)
# Head to [[Yujing Terrace]] and talk to [[Ganyu]]
# Go to [[Mt. Aocang]]
# Swim to the center of the pool
# Follow [[Shenhe]] to her cultivation place
# Head to the designated location
# Return to [[Liyue Harbor]] and talk to [[Madame Ping]]
# Talk to [[Dvorak]]
# Go to [[Wangsheng Funeral Parlor]]
# Go to [[Mt. Hulao]]
# Return to Liyue Harbor

==Gameplay Notes==
* In Step 4, approaching the center of the pool in a different way, such as through freezing the water or [[Hanega: Song of the Wind]], will still trigger Paimon's dialogue even though the character isn't swimming.

:{{A|vo eqhdj202 4 ganyu 09.ogg}} '''Ganyu:''' The way those melodies make me feel isn't all that different from other people after all. They're about mundane details of everyday existence, life's ups and downs, joys and sorrows...

:{{A|vo eqhdj202 4 ganyu 11.ogg}} '''Ganyu:''' ...In that sense, we're all the same.
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 4 paimon 14.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You go, Ganyu! You're really making progress! You have loads of friends in Liyue Harbor when you think about it, like ...Hmm, okay, maybe some of them are more like coworkers and bosses, but at the very least, Keqing and Shenhe are your friends now, right?
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 4 shenhe 10.ogg}} '''Shenhe:''' Yes. I am.
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 4 shenhe 11.ogg}} '''Shenhe:''' Technically speaking, we should refer to each other by the conventional forms of address used among fellow disciples. But now that I know what constitutes a friendship... I do believe we are more friends than co-disciples.
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 4 ganyu 12.ogg}} '''Ganyu:''' ...Thank you, everyone.
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 4 shenhe 12.ogg}} '''Shenhe:''' Once the days are warmer, I would like to host you at my home in the city. Please invite Keqing as well.
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 4 shenhe 13.ogg}} '''Shenhe:''' I've planted many types of flowers. I'm sure some of them will be to your taste.
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 4 ganyu 13.ogg}} '''Ganyu:''' Ah... you are too kind, I couldn't possibly...
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 4 shenhe 14.ogg}} '''Shenhe:''' Nonsense. You are my friend.
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 4 shenhe 15.ogg}} '''Shenhe:''' I have cultivated and cared for the flowers just as you taught me. Once you've seen them for yourself, I am sure you can advise me how to do an even better job next time.
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 4 shenhe 16.ogg}} '''Shenhe:''' I will save some for decoration. We can feast on the rest.
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 4 ganyu 14.ogg}} '''Ganyu:''' Then... thank you in advance. Wait, what is that saying again? "If you insist"?
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 4 shenhe 17.ogg}} '''Shenhe:''' ...Do people say that? I'm not completely sure, either.
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 4 paimon 15.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' It doesn't matter, okay! You got the point across, no need to split hairs. Paimon's more concerned about your idea of a girls' night out... Eating flowers? Really? ...Does this have anything to do with you both being the disciples of that illuminated bird?
:{{DIcon}} I doubt Keqing will be munching on any flowers...
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 4 cloudretainer 01.ogg}} '''Cloud Retainer:''' Hmph! Who dares refer to one not by one's adeptus title, but merely as "that illuminated bird"?
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 4 shenhe 18.ogg}} '''Shenhe:''' Master.
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 4 ganyu 15.ogg}} '''Ganyu:''' Our greetings, Cloud Retainer.
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 4 paimon 16.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Aaah, there it is! The illuminated bird has landed!
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 4 cloudretainer 02.ogg}} '''Cloud Retainer:''' Double hmph! Now she has the gall to use "it" rather than "she"! Even after being chastised once already! Huh, barely a moment has passed since we last met, and yet your impertinence has reached new heights. Very well, if you refuse to learn your lesson, one shall scold you no further.
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 4 cloudretainer 03.ogg}} '''Cloud Retainer:''' One has received your message from Ganyu. On the matter of the adeptus you seek, one suspects to know their identity.
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 4 cloudretainer 04.ogg}} '''Cloud Retainer:''' Well? Shall one lead the way?
:{{DIcon}} Yes please, Cloud Retainer.
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 4 shenhe 19.ogg}} '''Shenhe:''' I still have to complete my training for today, so I will bid farewell to everyone here.
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 4 cloudretainer 05.ogg}} '''Cloud Retainer:''' Very well. Await my arrival at one's abode later this night. On this special occasion, you should indulge yourself with some savory dishes.
:{{DIcon}} Happy Lantern Rite, Shenhe.
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 4 ganyu 16.ogg}} '''Ganyu:''' If you want to release a Xiao Lantern, come and find us anytime.
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 4 shenhe 20.ogg}} '''Shenhe:''' Thank you, everyone. Happy Lantern Rite to you too.
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 4 shenhe 21.ogg}} '''Shenhe:''' ♪♪♪♪♪♪♪... ♪♪♪♪♪♪♪...

;(Approach the marked location)
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 5 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Is this... [[Guili Plains]]?
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 5 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Cloud Retainer, why did you bring us here?
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 5 cloudretainer 01.ogg}} '''Cloud Retainer:''' Ganyu is of course familiar with the name "[[Guizhong]]," but have you ever heard of her?
:{{DIcon}} I've definitely heard it somewhere.
:{{DIcon}} I'm not sure.
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 5 cloudretainer 02.ogg}} '''Cloud Retainer:''' Guizhong is another name of Haagentus, the God of Dust. She was extroverted in nature, and adored social gatherings and inventions alike.
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 5 cloudretainer 03.ogg}} '''Cloud Retainer:''' Long ago, this region was yet a prosperous assembly. Guizhong often invited her friends to visit her home, reserving for us seats around the largest stone table.
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 5 cloudretainer 04.ogg}} '''Cloud Retainer:''' [[Sea Gazer]] would always bring out his latest treasure and place it upon the table. *sigh* He could be quite the braggart... Though usually a mild-mannered fellow, when it came to those collectibles he was so fond of, he always loved to show them off.
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 5 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Paimon remembers that name! So that's what Sea Gazer was like...
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 5 cloudretainer 05.ogg}} '''Cloud Retainer:''' He was an old friend and a former rival. One has many memories of him...
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 5 cloudretainer 06.ogg}} '''Cloud Retainer:''' Once he had brought out the treasure, it would predictably become the center of attention. Neither Guizhong nor one was content to let him just steal the spotlight, so we would then also present our proudest mechanical creations.
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 5 cloudretainer 07.ogg}} '''Cloud Retainer:''' As adepti, we were each gifted in our own ways, and naturally proud of our accomplishments in our respective fields of expertise. As a result, one often quarreled with Sea Gazer.
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 5 cloudretainer 08.ogg}} '''Cloud Retainer:''' His treasures were not even of his own making. He just used his exploration skills to dig them out of the ground! How, pray tell, could he compare to me, when every single one of one's accomplishments was crafted by one's own hand!?
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 5 ganyu 01.ogg}} '''Ganyu:''' Cloud Retainer, you are getting competitive again...
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 5 cloudretainer 09.ogg}} '''Cloud Retainer:''' ...Ahem, one digresses. Regardless, every time an argument occurred, Guizhong would come over to watch us during our mutual lambastings. On some occasions, she would join in, and on others, she'd take one of us by the limb, and start uttering the most ridiculous nonsense.
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 5 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What kind of nonsense?
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 5 cloudretainer 10.ogg}} '''Cloud Retainer:''' No kind of nonsense were we spared. Sometimes, she would brazenly opine "Ahh, why argue between yourselves when neither of you could ever hope to beat me?" Other times, she would make unsolicited suggestions such as "Once you two are done arguing, let's go to the foot of the mountain and grill some meat..."
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 5 cloudretainer 11.ogg}} '''Cloud Retainer:''' She always sought to make everyone happy, and one must say, she had quite the gift for it — no matter what nonsense she said, one never felt bothered or offended.
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 5 cloudretainer 12.ogg}} '''Cloud Retainer:''' ...It also helped that she never referred to one as "that illuminated bird" or "lady bird."
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 5 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You...! Come on, get over yourself!
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 5 cloudretainer 13.ogg}} '''Cloud Retainer:''' Hah. Anyway, just as our impassioned arguments would reach the apex of acrimony, [[Marchosius]] would bring his delectable dishes to the table.
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 5 cloudretainer 14.ogg}} '''Cloud Retainer:''' Who would dare snub the Stove God and his wondrous creations? At the sight of him, we would all immediately drop the argument, and prepare the table for a night of feasting and drinking...
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 5 cloudretainer 15.ogg}} '''Cloud Retainer:''' Heh, back then, one was always bothered by how the cups [[Rex Lapis]] brought were always too square for one's taste. Can you see yourselves ever enjoying a drink from a square cup?
:{{DIcon}} That does sound annoying.
::{{A|vo eqhdj202 5 cloudretainer 16a 1.ogg}} '''Cloud Retainer:''' Precisely! So as you can see, even one as great as Rex Lapis was not immune to making the occasional blunder.
:{{DIcon}} I don't think I'd really mind.
::{{A|vo eqhdj202 5 cloudretainer 16b 1.ogg}} '''Cloud Retainer:''' Then you are most tolerant. But that is its own virtue.
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 5 cloudretainer 17.ogg}} '''Cloud Retainer:''' Even one could never find fault with Marchosius' cooking. As we ate, Guizhong would continue to find topics for conversation, filling the table with humor and laughter.
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 5 cloudretainer 18.ogg}} '''Cloud Retainer:''' Each of those old fossils had their character flaws and points of obstinacy. So why was it that whenever we dined together, we always had a marvelous time?
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 5 cloudretainer 19.ogg}} '''Cloud Retainer:''' We would drink together from a spot high in the mountains, until the moon set and the sun rose, and only then would the banquet finally come to an end.
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 5 cloudretainer 20.ogg}} '''Cloud Retainer:''' [[Streetward Rambler]] would often remain to admire the flowers with Guizhong before returning to her own abode. The Glaze Lilies were far more abundant back then... entire fields of them would appear to the eye as a veritable sea of flowers...
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 5 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Streetward Rambler...?
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 5 ganyu 02.ogg}} '''Ganyu:''' That would be Ping. You probably know her as "Madame Ping."
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 5 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, okay... Wait, this is a lovely story and everything, but didn't we come here to find that adeptus from Mr. Dvorak's story?
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 5 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Or are you saying that... it was Guizhong? Didn't she, um... already, um...
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 5 cloudretainer 21.ogg}} '''Cloud Retainer:''' Alas... Long has one avoided this place for precisely that reason. The sights here are a reminder of a time long gone, and evoke much sorrow.
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 5 cloudretainer 22.ogg}} '''Cloud Retainer:''' One should have guessed that you would disrupt one's poignant moment of mourning with your incessant questioning!
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 5 cloudretainer 23.ogg}} '''Cloud Retainer:''' No matter... one will share the whole story with you now.

:{{A|vo eqhdj202 5 cloudretainer 25.ogg}} '''Cloud Retainer:''' One has always been austere and private by nature, and has never relished socializing. One's dealings with Guizhong were borne out of discussions on the discipline of mechanics.
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 5 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What? You have loads of friends! And you seem pretty chatty...
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 5 cloudretainer 26.ogg}} '''Cloud Retainer:''' Just because one is not ignorant of social graces does not mean one is fond of them! One is perfectly capable of partaking in conversation despite being introverted.
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 5 cloudretainer 27.ogg}} '''Cloud Retainer:''' But in the end, one is nothing like Streetward Rambler. She is dauntless but thoughtful, not to mention eloquent and wise. Moreover, her friendship with Guizhong was far greater than one's own...
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 5 cloudretainer 28.ogg}} '''Cloud Retainer:''' Back when they were rivals, they would often compete against one another in the realm of musical composition.
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 5 cloudretainer 29.ogg}} '''Cloud Retainer:''' That Cleansing Bell was one of Guizhong's proudest works, having the ability to both compose and perform...
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 5 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wait, that's weird. Didn't Madame Ping say she pestered an old friend for that bell?
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 5 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' And she also said something about being a vain beauty when she was young, or something.
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 5 cloudretainer 30.ogg}} '''Cloud Retainer:''' Streetward Rambler, a vain beauty? Hah... My foot.
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 5 cloudretainer 31.ogg}} '''Cloud Retainer:''' That bell has a sad history. Clearly, she refrained from sharing with you the truth of its origins, since the right time had not yet come.
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 5 cloudretainer 32.ogg}} '''Cloud Retainer:''' As for her "old friend"... who else could it be?
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 5 cloudretainer 33.ogg}} '''Cloud Retainer:''' As soon as Streetward Rambler heard that a certain "Zhongli" wished to borrow the Bell, she realized that the man was none other than Rex Lapis, and that he had made an enormous decision.
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 5 cloudretainer 34.ogg}} '''Cloud Retainer:''' After all, we all have known each other for several millennia. Some things between us are implicitly understood.
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 5 paimon 12.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Whoa, so they were talking in secret code? Paimon did not see that one coming...
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 5 cloudretainer 35.ogg}} '''Cloud Retainer:''' Hmph, enough of your intrusions... Where was one up to? ...Ah, yes. One remembers now.
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 5 cloudretainer 36.ogg}} '''Cloud Retainer:''' The Cleansing Bell is powered by a mechanical art, and can be used to great effect as an accompanying instrument. After the passing of its creator, it was used on numerous occasions during rites of parting.
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 5 cloudretainer 37.ogg}} '''Cloud Retainer:''' But Streetward Rambler did not acquire it from Rex Lapis for the purpose of producing further funerary tunes. No, each time she rang it, it was to play the tune that Guizhong composed on it.
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 5 cloudretainer 38.ogg}} '''Cloud Retainer:''' The two once clashed over their beliefs about the meaning of music. Who would have thought that with Guizhong's passing and Streetward Rambler's mourning, two tunes composed in discord would eventually become one harmonious composition...
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 5 ganyu 03.ogg}} '''Ganyu:''' ...
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 5 cloudretainer 39.ogg}} '''Cloud Retainer:''' Once upon a time, Streetward Rambler also loved gatherings, liquor, and music. But after Guizhong passed, she preferred her own company. She could often be found sitting alone at a mountain summit, contemplating and reminiscing with her zither.
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 5 cloudretainer 40.ogg}} '''Cloud Retainer:''' The music would go from mournful, to soothing, to impassioned...
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 5 cloudretainer 41.ogg}} '''Cloud Retainer:''' Many years passed before she finally composed a melody to her satisfaction. In celebration, she played the tune to the clouds. Regrettably, one has only ever heard her play that tune once.
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 5 cloudretainer 42.ogg}} '''Cloud Retainer:''' Which brings one back to the matter you've been investigating... Perhaps it was during that performance that the ancestor of your Fontaine friend fell into the water, and was saved by Streetward Rambler.
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 5 paimon 13.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' But... if she was so happy with the melody, why would she only play it once?
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 5 cloudretainer 43.ogg}} '''Cloud Retainer:''' One was also greatly perplexed by this. After suppressing one's curiosity for a long while, one finally approached her, and asked why she would retire the tune after having spent so long on it.
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 5 cloudretainer 44.ogg}} '''Cloud Retainer:''' In response, she said...
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 5 cloudretainer 45.ogg}} '''Cloud Retainer:''' "Though the strings that played that melody survive, the one who inspired it is gone. Tell me, Cloud Retainer... when the one attuned to my soul is no longer here, who else could hope to understand this tune?"
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 5 paimon 14.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Aw... Poor Madame Ping...
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 5 ganyu 04.ogg}} '''Ganyu:''' I just remember being taken care of by you when I was young. Once the Archon War came to an end, I stayed behind in Liyue Harbor to honor my contract.
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 5 ganyu 05.ogg}} '''Ganyu:''' Although I met Guizhong a few times, I never knew anything of this particular story...
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 5 cloudretainer 46.ogg}} '''Cloud Retainer:''' Guizhong was quite the visionary, but tragically passed before her time. Her manuscripts still lie unfinished in the Realm of Clouds... the blank pages give one cause for contemplation on what might have been.
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 5 cloudretainer 47.ogg}} '''Cloud Retainer:''' Had you not decided to search for that mystery adeptus, perhaps these stories, too, would have been lost to the sands of time.
:{{DIcon}} ...
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 5 cloudretainer 48.ogg}} '''Cloud Retainer:''' As of now, you know the truth: That the adeptus who rescued the drowning man was none other than Streetward Rambler.
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 5 cloudretainer 49.ogg}} '''Cloud Retainer:''' Do you intend to discuss this with her?
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 5 ganyu 06.ogg}} '''Ganyu:''' Do you mean... Ping might find the topic too distressing?
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 5 cloudretainer 50.ogg}} '''Cloud Retainer:''' Precisely. The passing of our old friend is a heavy topic that both of us are usually careful to avoid.
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 5 ganyu 07.ogg}} '''Ganyu:''' If I may be so bold... Cloud Retainer, could it be that this is just your own personal opinion?
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 5 cloudretainer 51.ogg}} '''Cloud Retainer:''' Oh? How so?
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 5 ganyu 08.ogg}} '''Ganyu:''' I've been in Liyue Harbor for quite a long time now, and I've witnessed many farewells along the way. So I, too, am well acquainted with the pain of the passing of a loved one.
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 5 ganyu 09.ogg}} '''Ganyu:''' But this doesn't bring the city or its people to a standstill. They have to keep moving forward.
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 5 ganyu 10.ogg}} '''Ganyu:''' Someone as perceptive and wise as Ping will surely have come to understand and embrace this.
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 5 ganyu 11.ogg}} '''Ganyu:''' Though these immortal mountains have lost an adeptus, the harbor of mortals has gained a wise elder.
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 5 ganyu 12.ogg}} '''Ganyu:''' No loss can ever be undone, but there is always much that can still be gained.
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 5 ganyu 13.ogg}} '''Ganyu:''' Ping has helped countless people, and will guide many others in the years to come. And all to whom she extends a helping hand become her friends. People she can admire flowers and discuss music with.
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 5 ganyu 14.ogg}} '''Ganyu:''' Though it is heartbreaking to lose a kindred spirit, life goes on... because there are new friends waiting for you further down the road.
:{{DIcon}} Ganyu is right.
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 5 paimon 15.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' We even asked Madame Ping what she thought about adding a music festival to this year's Lantern Rite!
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 5 paimon 16.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' When we get back, why don't we just ask her if she'd like to perform? Maybe we could even get her up on stage!
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 5 cloudretainer 52.ogg}} '''Cloud Retainer:''' ...Hah, you youngsters and your imaginations.
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 5 ganyu 15.ogg}} '''Ganyu:''' Why don't you come with us?
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 5 ganyu 16.ogg}} '''Ganyu:''' It's been a long time since you last spoke with Ping. And Liyue Harbor is always decorated so beautifully during the festival period...
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 5 cloudretainer 53.ogg}} '''Cloud Retainer:''' Is not every Lantern Rite the same in this regard? Were there ever anything new to discuss, one and Ping could meet any day of the year.
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 5 ganyu 17.ogg}} '''Ganyu:''' I disagree. Each new day and each new year is different from those that have come before. How long will you simply let them pass you by?
:{{DIcon}} If nothing else, do it for Ganyu.
::{{A|vo eqhdj202 5 cloudretainer 54a 1.ogg}} '''Cloud Retainer:''' ...Hmm, the edibles she brought this time were indeed quite delectable...
:{{DIcon}} Do it as a favor for me?
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 5 cloudretainer 55.ogg}} '''Cloud Retainer:''' ...Very well.
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 5 cloudretainer 56.ogg}} '''Cloud Retainer:''' Then one will be off. If the other old fossils have sneaked away into the city to amuse themselves, one shall soon find out...
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 5 ganyu 18.ogg}} '''Ganyu:''' Alright, we should be getting back to the harbor as well. We don't want to keep her waiting.
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 5 ganyu 19.ogg}} '''Ganyu:''' *sigh* Once the Guili Assembly, now the Guili Plains...
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 5 ganyu 20.ogg}} '''Ganyu:''' Say... if we planted flowers there and cared for them carefully enough, do you think that one day, we'd be able to recreate the sea of Glaze Lilies?
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 5 cloudretainer 57.ogg}} '''Cloud Retainer:''' Allow one to take back one's praise from a moment prior. You are still far too given to flights of fancy, child.
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 5 ganyu 21.ogg}} '''Ganyu:''' What...!? Cloud Retainer? Y—You were still listening?
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 5 cloudretainer 58.ogg}} '''Cloud Retainer:''' One observed that you were making no effort to leave and returned to chasten and hasten you! This time, one is departing in earnest.
