:{{A|vo eqhdj202 6 madameping 02.ogg}} '''Madame Ping:''' Ohoho... Cloud Retainer, you are uncommonly polite today.
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 6 cloudretainer 05.ogg}} '''Cloud Retainer:''' One... Uh... Hmm...
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 6 cloudretainer 06.ogg}} '''Cloud Retainer:''' Given that Lantern Rite is almost upon us, the weather in the city is most pleasant, and a sweet floral fragrance lingers in the air...
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 6 cloudretainer 07.ogg}} '''Cloud Retainer:''' Ahem... Ganyu, please continue from here!
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 6 ganyu 01.ogg}} '''Ganyu:''' Huh!?
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 6 ganyu 02.ogg}} '''Ganyu:''' A—Alright...
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 6 ganyu 03.ogg}} '''Ganyu:''' So, this all started because we were trying to help Mr. Dvorak find the adeptus who saved his ancestor's life...
:{{Black Screen|Ganyu recounts the story to Madame Ping...}}
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 6 ganyu 04.ogg}} '''Ganyu:''' Cloud Retainer informed us that the one who played that melody and rescued the drowning man was none other than yourself.
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 6 madameping 03.ogg}} '''Madame Ping:''' Ah... let me think... Yes, I do believe I recall that encounter...
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 6 cloudretainer 08.ogg}} '''Cloud Retainer:''' ...
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 6 madameping 04.ogg}} '''Madame Ping:''' What a long time ago that was... I'm surprised that you still remember it.
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 6 madameping 05.ogg}} '''Madame Ping:''' Even more astonishing, perhaps, is the fact that this story has survived this long at all, when mortal lives are so very brief...
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 6 madameping 06.ogg}} '''Madame Ping:''' Hehe... It appears that she has proven herself right once again.
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 6 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Who's "she"...?
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 6 madameping 07.ogg}} '''Madame Ping:''' We like to call her "Guizhong." From the look in Cloud Retainer's eyes, I sense that she has already told you all about her.
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 6 cloudretainer 09.ogg}} '''Cloud Retainer:''' *sigh*... Albeit reluctantly, one might add.
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 6 madameping 08.ogg}} '''Madame Ping:''' Hehe, there is no harm done.
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 6 madameping 09.ogg}} '''Madame Ping:''' After all, Lantern Rite's very purpose is to commemorate the heroes who gave their lives for Liyue.
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 6 madameping 10.ogg}} '''Madame Ping:''' Although Guizhong did not live to see the splendid sights of today, she was as much a hero as any other.
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 6 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Uh... so how has she proven herself right again, exactly?
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 6 madameping 11.ogg}} '''Madame Ping:''' Once upon a time, she said to me that humans were a weak form of life that she wished to protect with her wisdom.
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 6 madameping 12.ogg}} '''Madame Ping:''' But as she interacted more and more with them, her opinions on them began to change.
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 6 madameping 13.ogg}} '''Madame Ping:''' She marveled at the beautiful complexity of their spirits... the sheer splendor of all they could accomplish through their hard work and intelligence.
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 6 madameping 14.ogg}} '''Madame Ping:''' She told us that to underestimate human potential would be to make a grave mistake...
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 6 madameping 15.ogg}} '''Madame Ping:''' With the smallest amount of guidance, enormous power can be unleashed in them...
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 6 madameping 16.ogg}} '''Madame Ping:''' And a human who has reached their full potential may well be her equal. Someone who could have as much to teach an adeptus as to learn from them.
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 6 cloudretainer 10.ogg}} '''Cloud Retainer:''' Hmph, she always had a way with words.
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 6 cloudretainer 11.ogg}} '''Cloud Retainer:''' That her mechanical accomplishments were judged superior to one's own was, one suspects, in large part due to her sheer eloquence.
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 6 madameping 17.ogg}} '''Madame Ping:''' Speaking of mechanics, Cloud Retainer, do you still remember that potted plant mechanism? The one that the two of you gave me as a gift.
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 6 cloudretainer 12.ogg}} '''Cloud Retainer:''' Of course. Guizhong and one both put an immense amount of effort into that gift. It would be no overstatement to call it a testament to each of our individual technical genius...
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 6 madameping 18.ogg}} '''Madame Ping:''' As Guizhong once said: "It takes every blade of grass and every flower to make a homeland."
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 6 madameping 19.ogg}} '''Madame Ping:''' ...When I see the sight of Liyue Harbor before us today, I am reminded of this.
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 6 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Madame Ping looks very emotional right now...
:{{DIcon}} Well, she's been through a lot in her time...
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 6 madameping 20.ogg}} '''Madame Ping:''' *sigh*... Of all of us, it was Guizhong who was the fondest of these grand and exciting occasions.
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 6 madameping 21.ogg}} '''Madame Ping:''' If she were still with us, I'm quite sure she would still be trying to best Cloud Retainer's finest works at every opportunity...
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 6 cloudretainer 13.ogg}} '''Cloud Retainer:''' Liyue Harbor is always filled with the sound of music at this time of the year... If she were here, one is certain that she would seek you out to discuss and debate the virtues of various melodies.
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 6 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, yeah! Music!
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 6 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' We've been dying to ask: What was the melody that you played back then?
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 6 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, also, with you being such a music expert and all, why don't you join the concert as a performer?
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 6 ganyu 05.ogg}} '''Ganyu:''' I can make arrangements right away!
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 6 madameping 22.ogg}} '''Madame Ping:''' Oho... As much as I don't wish to dampen your enthusiasm...
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 6 madameping 23.ogg}} '''Madame Ping:''' It's been a long time since I played this zither. My fingers don't have the dexterity they once did...
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 6 madameping 24.ogg}} '''Madame Ping:''' And whenever I play that tune... it always reminds me of her. I start wondering what she would think of the changes I've made to her melody...
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 6 madameping 25.ogg}} '''Madame Ping:''' There was a period of time whenever I started strumming, it almost felt like she was back again, sitting right there on the stone stool next to me, chatting away. [[Skybracer]] and Sea Gazer, too... looking just like they did in the old days.
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 6 madameping 26.ogg}} '''Madame Ping:''' No matter how much time goes by, the moment that melody starts playing, it transports me right back to that time in my memory...
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 6 ganyu 06.ogg}} '''Ganyu:''' So the past still weighs heavily on your heart?
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 6 madameping 27.ogg}} '''Madame Ping:''' I would be lying to myself if I claimed to have completely moved on.
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 6 madameping 28.ogg}} '''Madame Ping:''' But that is not to say that grief doesn't get easier with time.
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 6 madameping 29.ogg}} '''Madame Ping:''' ...Despite the sadness, I have found many things that bring me joy in life. It is simply the nature of the world in which we live that even if one wished to mourn for an eternity, it would be a nigh-impossible feat.
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 6 madameping 30.ogg}} '''Madame Ping:''' Just look at this potted plant. Isn't it stunning?
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 6 cloudretainer 14.ogg}} '''Cloud Retainer:''' It takes an honest and open mind to confront and conquer grief. You have indeed made progress.
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 6 madameping 31.ogg}} '''Madame Ping:''' Hehe...
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 6 madameping 32.ogg}} '''Madame Ping:''' Be that as it may, I shall leave the Lantern Rite stage to the youth of today.
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 6 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Well, if you're sure...
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 6 yanfei 01.ogg}} '''Yanfei:''' Granny!
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 6 yanfei 02.ogg}} '''Yanfei:''' Whoa, what's everyone doing here? Did something bad happen?
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 6 madameping 33.ogg}} '''Madame Ping:''' Ah, and now we've spooked Yanfei. No, no, everyone's just here to give me their regards for the holiday...
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 6 yanfei 03.ogg}} '''Yanfei:''' Oh? That's wonderful! I'm glad.
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 6 yanfei 04.ogg}} '''Yanfei:''' Well, in that case: Happy Lantern Rite everyone.
:{{DIcon}} Happy Lantern Rite.
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 6 ganyu 07.ogg}} '''Ganyu:''' Happy Lantern Rite. Oh! I... I just remembered that I have some, uh... work to do at Yuehai Pavilion that I need to discuss with Yanfei. I haven't been able to find a chance until now...
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 6 ganyu 08.ogg}} '''Ganyu:''' I will leave Mr. Dvorak in your capable hands. Cloud Retainer, Ping, we will be off for now.
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 6 yanfei 05.ogg}} '''Yanfei:''' Huh? Does it have to be right now? Which case is this again? Hey, Ganyu...
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 6 madameping 34.ogg}} '''Madame Ping:''' Ahh... It seems Ganyu still has much to learn when it comes to the art of deception.
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 6 cloudretainer 15.ogg}} '''Cloud Retainer:''' What a pity... she has learned nothing of one's ability to carry a conversation.
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 6 madameping 35.ogg}} '''Madame Ping:''' Since it's been so long, Cloud Retainer, why don't you stay? I'll make a cup of tea, and we can chat a while.
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 6 cloudretainer 16.ogg}} '''Cloud Retainer:''' Gladly. This was one's intention as well.
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 6 madameping 36.ogg}} '''Madame Ping:''' When you next see the Fontaine musician, please give him my regards. I'd like to wish him the very best with the concert.
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 6 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You got it, Madame Ping!
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 6 madameping 37.ogg}} '''Madame Ping:''' Thank you all... I think you've listened to enough of my nattering for one day.
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 6 madameping 38.ogg}} '''Madame Ping:''' As for that melody, I will play it for you all another time. Goodness knows I need to practice it first.
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 6 paimon 12.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wow, that'd be great! We'll look forward to it!
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 6 madameping 39.ogg}} '''Madame Ping:''' Hehe...
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 6 madameping 40.ogg}} '''Madame Ping:''' When that time comes, wherever her spirit may be among the countless grains of sand and specks of dust between the harbor and the mountains... perhaps she will look at the Liyue of today, and steal a smile when she sees the prosperous land that it has become.

;(After the cutscene)
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 7 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Alright, let's go tell Mr. Dvorak the news!

;(Talk to Cloud Retainer or Madame Ping, optional)
:{{A|vo dialog eqhdj202 cloudretainer 01.ogg}} '''Cloud Retainer:''' Ping, what say you to convening more often in the future?
:{{A|vo dialog eqhdj202 madameping 01.ogg}} '''Madame Ping:''' That would be quite wonderful. But I must say, after all this time, I've grown quite accustomed to the harbor... When we are to meet, I shall have to trouble you to make the journey to the city.
:{{A|vo dialog eqhdj202 cloudretainer 02.ogg}} '''Cloud Retainer:''' You sound just like Shenhe. The child is constantly telling one all sorts of stories from the city, as if one was partial to them...
:{{A|vo dialog eqhdj202 madameping 02.ogg}} '''Madame Ping:''' Have you ever considered moving to the city, Cloud Retainer? There are plenty of people here to talk to. I think you would find it quite the antidote to the monotony of solitude.
:{{A|vo dialog eqhdj202 madameping 03.ogg}} '''Madame Ping:''' And if you looked around, I suspect you would find some young minds with an interest in the mechanical arts — some of them even worth training.
:{{A|vo dialog eqhdj202 cloudretainer 03.ogg}} '''Cloud Retainer:''' Haha. We shall see.

;(Approach Dvorak and Keqing)
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 7 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Mr. Dvorak!
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 7 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ah, and Keqing's here too... Thanks for helping set all of this up.
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 7 keqing 01.ogg}} '''Keqing:''' Welcome back. Did everything go well?
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 7 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Really, really well! We found the person Mr. Dvorak was looking for!
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 7 dvorak 01.ogg}} '''Dvorak:''' A—Are you serious!?
:{{Black Screen|You recount the true story of the "fairy lady" to Keqing and Dvorak...}}
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 7 dvorak 02.ogg}} '''Dvorak:''' I see... So, the melody my ancestor heard was an adeptus remembering her late friend...
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 7 dvorak 03.ogg}} '''Dvorak:''' That certainly explains why it was such a powerful and poignant tune...
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 7 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh. That's a really interesting first reaction. Guess that comes with having a musical mind.
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 7 dvorak 04.ogg}} '''Dvorak:''' ...I have to say, though, it's hard to believe that the fairy from the tale is now an elderly granny...
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 7 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, Paimon knows exactly what you mean! Normally, adepti don't age at all!
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 7 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' But Streetward Rambler, or "Madame Ping" as we know her, probably only became old because it's what she wanted for herself.
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 7 keqing 02.ogg}} '''Keqing:''' Madame Ping possesses vast knowledge and great wisdom. Whatever physical form she may decide to take, her mind and wits are as sharp as they come.
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 7 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yep, Keqing summed it up perfectly! That's exactly what Paimon was trying to say.
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 7 dvorak 05.ogg}} '''Dvorak:''' I think... Yes, I must thank her in person.
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 7 dvorak 06.ogg}} '''Dvorak:''' That can wait until after the concert though. For now, I need to devote all my emotional energy to the performance.
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 7 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ah, speaking of, Madame Ping wishes you all the best with the music festival!
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 7 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Paimon has a sneaking suspicion that she'll stay in her usual spot, but listen to the performances from afar!
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 7 dvorak 07.ogg}} '''Dvorak:''' ...Wait, are you serious?
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 7 dvorak 08.ogg}} '''Dvorak:''' Huh... Oh no, now I'm starting to get nervous...
:{{DIcon}} Relax.
:{{DIcon}} Just treat it like any other performance.
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 7 dvorak 09.ogg}} '''Dvorak:''' Okay, alright...
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 7 dvorak 10.ogg}} '''Dvorak:''' Nope! Another rehearsal is in order. Please excuse me, everyone...
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 7 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Mr. Dvorak! ...Ah, he's already gone. Paimon wasn't even finished telling him everything...
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 7 paimon 12.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Before we set off on our search with Ganyu, he asked us about what music means to people. After our recent adventure, Paimon thinks we have a lot more to say about that now.
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 7 keqing 03.ogg}} '''Keqing:''' Please, share your insights with me.
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 7 paimon 13.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Uh, well... we found out that music can be used for good, but also for bad.
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 7 paimon 14.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Um... It can make people happy and moved, but it can also be sad and bittersweet...
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 7 paimon 15.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' And music is like a kind of memory written in people's hearts. It can put you in touch with feelings from a totally different time and place.
:{{DIcon}} Pretty much. Though there was more to it than that.
:{{DIcon}} That was a broad summary, but not the most detailed.
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 7 keqing 04.ogg}} '''Keqing:''' It sounds like you had an eventful trip... Don't worry, I'm sure Ganyu will fill me in on all the details shortly.
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 7 paimon 16.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wait, does that mean you're gonna carry on working?
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 7 keqing 05.ogg}} '''Keqing:''' Mm-hmm. Just a few things to wrap up. All the groundwork is done.
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 7 keqing 06.ogg}} '''Keqing:''' As long as everyone enjoys the festival activities, all our efforts are worthwhile.
:{{DIcon}} Happy Lantern Rite.
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 7 keqing 07.ogg}} '''Keqing:''' Happy Lantern Rite to you as well.
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 7 paimon 17.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Whew... that should be everything taken care of, right? Oh no, wait...
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 7 paimon 18.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Paimon feels like she's forgetting something... Ugh, what was it? Ugh, it feels like it was a while ago!
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 7 paimon 19.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ah, shoot! Latent— Wait, no... anyway, uhh, fancy [[Bamboo Shoot]]s!
:{{DIcon}} Bamboozle soup!
:{{DIcon}} Made from "Nascent Bamboo Shoots"!
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 7 paimon 20.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Zhongli said he wasn't in a hurry, so if we went now, there's probably still time, right?
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 7 paimon 21.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Anyway, even if we don't make it, it's not our fault! He could've totally picked them by himself...
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 7 paimon 22.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ugh, anyway, let's go check with him at Wangsheng Funeral Parlor.

;(Approach Wangsheng Funeral Parlor)
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 8 hutao 01.ogg}} '''Hu Tao:''' Mm hmm! Da-da, da-da, da-da, da-da.
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 8 hutao 02.ogg}} '''Hu Tao:''' Dah-da-da-dah, dah-da-da-dah, oh!
:{{Introductory Note|Hu Tao}}
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 8 yunjin 01.ogg}} '''Yun Jin:''' Alright, let's take a break here.
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 8 hutao 03.ogg}} '''Hu Tao:''' Oh wow, look who it is! Are you here to hang out with everyone's favorite funeral director?
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 8 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So you're just... casually practicing your rapping skills at the entrance to your funeral parlor... in broad daylight... Uhh, okay...
:{{DIcon}} You're, uh... freaking me out a little.
:{{DIcon}} I... uh... wow.
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 8 hutao 04.ogg}} '''Hu Tao:''' Heheh, after everything we've been through... you don't see me for a hot minute, and you're back to being scared of your own shadow.
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 8 hutao 05.ogg}} '''Hu Tao:''' We have all this open space, a clear view of the mountains behind and the sea in front... not to mention we have several invisible audience members enthusiastically cheering us on! It's the perfect spot to rehearse!
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 8 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Invisible audience members...?
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 8 xinyan 01.ogg}} '''Xinyan:''' Gotta say, it took me a few days to get used to Director Hu's way of talking.
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 8 yunjin 02.ogg}} '''Yun Jin:''' Xinyan was pretty spooked too when she first got here! Just like when she sees a frog. But a giant frog. With sharp teeth!
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 8 xinyan 02.ogg}} '''Xinyan:''' C'mon, knock it off.
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 8 hutao 06.ogg}} '''Hu Tao:''' What's wrong? I've never seen someone look so confused before. Well, don't worry, because Director Hu's here to explain it all!
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 8 hutao 07.ogg}} '''Hu Tao:'''
::There once was a Fontaine musician<br>Who went around town on a mission<br>He came door to door<br>For his Iridescence Tour<br>Looking for acts to audition
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 8 hutao 08.ogg}} '''Hu Tao:''' With my words, Xinyan's chords, and Yun Jin as our mentor...
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 8 hutao 09.ogg}} '''Hu Tao:''' We'll take the stage by storm, with flames roaring, and the whole audience calling for more!
:{{DIcon}} Heck yeah!
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 8 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' For sure! The whole dance floor will be yelling "encore, encore"! ...Ugh, now Paimon's rhyming along... Um, but when you say "flames roaring"... are you sure this'll be safe?
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 8 xinyan 03.ogg}} '''Xinyan:''' Ah, don't you worry about that! I'm pretty experienced on the stage, and I've already informed the Yuheng of all the pyrotechnics we're planning on using.
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 8 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh... Guess we'll just have to trust Xinyan on this one.
:{{DIcon}} Have you seen Zhongli, Director Hu?
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 8 hutao 10.ogg}} '''Hu Tao:''' Oh, Zhongli? He took one of those fancy meal boxes and set off for the mountains. Said he wanted to pay a visit to some old friends.
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 8 yunjin 03.ogg}} '''Yun Jin:''' It's a real pity that he couldn't be around for this. As well as being a true connoisseur of traditional art forms, he's able to appreciate Xinyan's performances, too...
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 8 xinyan 04.ogg}} '''Xinyan:''' Yeah, that's right! Matter of fact, he was the one who first invited me to perform here.
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 8 xinyan 05.ogg}} '''Xinyan:''' To tell the truth, though, I never thought I'd really find myself rehearsing here one day...
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 8 hutao 11.ogg}} '''Hu Tao:''' Hehe, well, now you know: The Wangsheng Funeral Parlor is a great location! All of you are always welcome to come and hang out here, especially if you're in the mood to try something new!
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 8 yunjin 04.ogg}} '''Yun Jin:''' I can speak to that. Hu Tao is always full of fun surprises!
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 8 xinyan 06.ogg}} '''Xinyan:''' ...And jump scares.
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 8 yunjin 05.ogg}} '''Yun Jin:''' Actually, Xinyan, I have some lyric ideas for your part. Do you wanna go through them together?
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 8 xinyan 07.ogg}} '''Xinyan:''' Sure thing! I'm all ears.
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 8 hutao 12.ogg}} '''Hu Tao:''' Oh, {{Traveler}} and Paimon, I believe Zhongli was heading to Mt. Hulao. So, make sure you're hiking up the right hill!
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 8 hutao 13.ogg}} '''Hu Tao:''' When you see Zhongli, please pass on this message to him: It's up to him whether he wants to support us at the performance tonight... but I expect him to make time for the upcoming banquet we're planning. No excuses!
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 8 hutao 14.ogg}} '''Hu Tao:''' You should join us too! It'll be a riot. If there's one thing I've learned from being a funeral director, it's how to throw a party!

;(Talk to Hu Tao, Xinyan, or Yun Jin, optional)
:{{A|vo dialog eqhdj202 yunjin 01.ogg}} '''Yun Jin:''' Okay, everyone, I think that's a long-enough break. Let's take it from the top, shall we?
:{{A|vo dialog eqhdj202 hutao 01.ogg}} '''Hu Tao:''' Ms. Yun is such a strict mentor! These breaks aren't even long enough to have a sip of tea.

:{{A|vo dialog eqhdj202 hutao 02.ogg}} '''Hu Tao:''' Hmm... how about some [[Stir-Fried Filet]] with a side of [[Crab Roe Tofu]]?

;(Approach Moon Carver and Mountain Shaper)
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 9 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Paimon sees them! It's Illuminated Deer and Illuminated Bird number two.
:{{DIcon}} Greetings, everyone. Long time no see.
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 9 xueyue 01.ogg}} '''Moon Carver:''' Hmm... A familiar face. Have you come from Liyue Harbor? How is the city nowadays?
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 9 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Everything's great! But you know, if you're so curious, you can always go and check it out for yourself.
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 9 zhongli 01.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' In fact, Moon Carver has been taking many walks on [[Mt. Tianheng]] in recent times. I believe the sights of the city are quite familiar to him.
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 9 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Zhongli! Here you are. We've brought the Bamboo Shoots you wanted.
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 9 zhongli 02.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Impeccable timing.
:{{Black Screen|Zhongli puts the nascent Bamboo Shoots into the cooking mechanism next to him. Moon Carver and Mountain Shaper power it using their Adeptus Arts...}}
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 9 zhongli 03.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Traditionally, [[Bamboo Shoot Soup]] ought to be slow-cooked for many hours on low heat. Using Adeptus Arts to hasten the process is something of a shortcut.
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 9 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wait, that mechanism... Is that...
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 9 zhongli 04.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Indeed. Cloud Retainer kindly lent me her supreme cuisine machine.
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 9 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Can we not just call it a "cooking machine"? ..Ugh, actually never mind.
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 9 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' She seems to take a lot of pride in her mechanical gizmos, so it's probably best if Paimon doesn't go changing the name willy-nilly.
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 9 zhongli 05.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' I trust that you found the answers you were seeking during your recent journey?
:{{DIcon}} Yes.
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 9 zhongli 06.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Excellent.
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 9 zhongli 07.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' The past should be remembered, but not overly dwelt upon. Our journeys should be seen as a means to take on more from the world around us.
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 9 zhongli 08.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' When the Bamboo Shoot Soup is ready, I must insist that you try some for yourself.
:{{DIcon}} Of course!
:{{A|vo eqhdj202 9 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, Zhongli, Hu Tao told us to tell you something!

'''''A Sliver of Hope''''' is the third part of {{Quest|Dreamlike Timelessness}}.

==Steps==
# Visit the old couple to ask for their help
#* Speak to [[Imatani Saburou]] or [[Imatani Kaori]] in [[Konda Village]]
# Help the old couple clean up their courtyard
# Give the Pickled Radish to [[Satoru]] in the village
# Report back to the old couple
# Tell [[Sakujirou]] the news

==Gameplay Notes==
* It is possible to cut down the plants before talking to the Imatanis. This will result in some alternate dialogue from Paimon and Yoimiya.
* Talking to [[Matsuzaka]], [[Saika]] or [[Iwao]] before heading back to Sakujirou will result in special dialogue. They are located just outside [[Inazuma City]].

:{{A|vo xglq003 2 yoimiya 05.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' Oh yeah, um, this is some Pickled Radish from Mrs. Imatani.
:{{A|vo xglq003 2 satoru 04.ogg}} '''Satoru:''' Wow, thank you so much! I never used to be a fan of Pickled Radish, would you believe.
:{{A|vo xglq003 2 satoru 05.ogg}} '''Satoru:''' But then I tried some of Mrs. Imatani's homemade stuff, and I couldn't get enough of it. It's a family staple now.
:{{A|vo xglq003 2 yoimiya 06.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' Speaking of your family, how is everyone doing?
:{{A|vo xglq003 2 satoru 06.ogg}} '''Satoru:''' They're doing well. We have the occasional heated argument, but... I guess that's every family ever.
:{{A|vo xglq003 2 satoru 07.ogg}} '''Satoru:''' Being close to family is better than never getting to see them, even if it does mean putting up with some conflict.
:{{A|vo xglq003 2 satoru 08.ogg}} '''Satoru:''' Now, Mr. and Mrs. Imatani seem to have a great relationship — but still, they must get lonely with their child never visiting.
:{{A|vo xglq003 2 yoimiya 07.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' Huh, they didn't seem that way to me. I think they're just used to it.
:{{A|vo xglq003 2 yoimiya 08.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' You make a good point though. I should drop by more often in the future. That way, they won't get so bored.
:{{A|vo xglq003 2 satoru 09.ogg}} '''Satoru:''' I'm sure they'd love that — as would all of us in Konda Village. You're always welcome here.
:{{A|vo xglq003 2 yoimiya 09.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' Hee-hee, thank you.
----
;(After completing the chores)
:{{A|vo xglq003 2 yoimiya 10.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' Now that we've finished all the chores, it's time to talk to the Imatanis about Sakujirou.

;(Talk to Satoru again)
:{{A|vo dialog xglq003 satoru 01.ogg}} '''Satoru:''' The [[Naganohara Fireworks Show]] must be coming up soon, right? My daughter left quite a while ago.
:{{A|vo dialog xglq003 satoru 02.ogg}} '''Satoru:''' Heh, she couldn't get out the house quickly enough. She's clearly very taken with this boy in the city, it was written all over her face...
:{{A|vo dialog xglq003 satoru 03.ogg}} '''Satoru:''' *sigh* But, at least she's happy, I suppose.
----
;(Report back to the old couple)
:{{A|vo xglq003 3 imatanikaori 01.ogg}} '''Imatani Kaori:''' That was quick! Ah, young people are so handy.
:{{A|vo xglq003 3 yoimiya 01.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' Younger people have bundles of energy, and older people have a wealth of wisdom. Each have their strengths.
:{{A|vo xglq003 3 imatanisaburou 01.ogg}} '''Imatani Saburou:''' Speaking of youth... Do you know what? It's been 50 years this year.
:{{A|vo xglq003 3 imatanikaori 02.ogg}} '''Imatani Kaori:''' Oh, so it has! Goodness, how the time flies... You barely notice as the years go by, but then suddenly, 50 years have passed.
:{{A|vo xglq003 3 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' 50 years since what? Some important day?
:{{A|vo xglq003 3 imatanisaburou 02.ogg}} '''Imatani Saburou:''' Haha, well, if you must know, it was 50 years ago, back in the days when this young lady was still trying to win me over, that—
:{{A|vo xglq003 3 imatanikaori 03.ogg}} '''Imatani Kaori:''' Oh, stop trying to impress them. We both know you were the one who was hopelessly smitten and desperately trying to win my affection...
:{{A|vo xglq003 3 imatanisaburou 03.ogg}} '''Imatani Saburou:''' Well, maybe you're right. 50 years ago, I proposed to my wife at the Naganohara Fireworks Show. We've been together ever since.
:{{DIcon}} Congratulations to you both.
:{{DIcon}} You should be very proud of what you have.
:{{A|vo xglq003 3 imatanisaburou 04.ogg}} '''Imatani Saburou:''' To tell the truth, I was still a little uncertain. I wasn't sure what I was doing when I walked into the Naganoharas' shop and ordered my firework.
:{{A|vo xglq003 3 imatanisaburou 05.ogg}} '''Imatani Saburou:''' Even as it was rising up into the sky... I still had no clue what I was going to say.
:{{A|vo xglq003 3 imatanisaburou 06.ogg}} '''Imatani Saburou:''' But then it exploded... the sky lit up... I looked back at her and saw her eyes, twinkling in the light of the fireworks...
:{{A|vo xglq003 3 imatanisaburou 07.ogg}} '''Imatani Saburou:''' ...Before I knew what was happening, apparently, I'd already said it, and well, she'd said yes.
:{{A|vo xglq003 3 imatanikaori 04.ogg}} '''Imatani Kaori:''' 50 years... In some ways, it's a long time, in others, it's no time at all. Really, it's just a number.
:{{A|vo xglq003 3 imatanikaori 05.ogg}} '''Imatani Kaori:''' But 50 years of being together... now that is something worth commemorating.
:{{A|vo xglq003 3 yoimiya 02.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' I had no idea it was your 50th anniversary. If I'd known, I would've made some extra-fancy fireworks, just for you.
:{{A|vo xglq003 3 imatanikaori 06.ogg}} '''Imatani Kaori:''' Oh, no, it's quite alright. We always set off the same firework every year. It wouldn't be the same without it.
:{{A|vo xglq003 3 imatanikaori 07.ogg}} '''Imatani Kaori:''' Seeing that firework go off takes us right back to those days. Even at this age, we still look back with not a single regret.
:{{A|vo xglq003 3 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Aw, what a great relationship they have...
:{{A|vo xglq003 3 imatanisaburou 08.ogg}} '''Imatani Saburou:''' Enough about us, though. Yoimiya, aren't you busy with the fireworks show coming up? Was there something you needed to discuss?
:{{A|vo xglq003 3 yoimiya 03.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' Yeah, um... it's a difficult thing to talk about, but here goes...
:{{Black Screen|''Yoimiya tells the Imatanis about Sakujirou.''}}
:{{A|vo xglq003 3 imatanisaburou 09.ogg}} '''Imatani Saburou:''' Hmm... Sakujirou... so, he came back.
:{{A|vo xglq003 3 yoimiya 04.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' Huh? You know him?
:{{A|vo xglq003 3 imatanikaori 08.ogg}} '''Imatani Kaori:''' He was our boy's best friend when they were young.
:{{A|vo xglq003 3 imatanikaori 09.ogg}} '''Imatani Kaori:''' *sigh* They were inseparable. They grew up together, shared everything with each other, and went everywhere together.
:{{A|vo xglq003 3 imatanikaori 10.ogg}} '''Imatani Kaori:''' But one day, they had a terrible argument...
:{{A|vo xglq003 3 imatanisaburou 10.ogg}} '''Imatani Saburou:''' Sakujirou seemed to feel that Inazuma was too peaceful, and wanted to see what the outside world was like.
:{{A|vo xglq003 3 imatanisaburou 11.ogg}} '''Imatani Saburou:''' But our [[Keisuke]] took after his father and mother. He felt that there was nothing wrong at all with being peaceful.
:{{A|vo xglq003 3 imatanisaburou 12.ogg}} '''Imatani Saburou:''' You know what children are like, they get terribly worked up about these sorts of things. In the end, Sakujirou stormed off, and that was that.
:{{A|vo xglq003 3 yoimiya 05.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' I see...
:{{A|vo xglq003 3 imatanisaburou 13.ogg}} '''Imatani Saburou:''' Keisuke said nothing to me or my wife about the fight. We could sense that he was very hurt by it, but he didn't want to talk with us about how he was really feeling.
:{{A|vo xglq003 3 imatanisaburou 14.ogg}} '''Imatani Saburou:''' Eventually, whether out of pent-up anger or for some other reason, he joined the Tenryou Commission. He rarely comes home anymore.
:{{A|vo xglq003 3 imatanikaori 11.ogg}} '''Imatani Kaori:''' If it was anything else, I could talk to Keisuke, and I'm sure he'd be willing to help.
:{{A|vo xglq003 3 imatanikaori 12.ogg}} '''Imatani Kaori:''' But since it's Sakujirou... I don't feel there's any way we can get involved.
:{{A|vo xglq003 3 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What a strange coincidence. Who'd have thought...
:{{A|vo xglq003 3 yoimiya 06.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' I understand now. When I asked Sakujirou why he came back, he just said "because of past mistakes" and wasn't willing to elaborate.
:{{A|vo xglq003 3 yoimiya 07.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' Now, I finally understand why he can't decide what to do.
:{{A|vo xglq003 3 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Two best buddies in childhood... one grows up to join the Tenryou Commission, the other grows up to join the Tenryou Commission's most wanted list...
:{{DIcon}} I guess this is fate.
:{{DIcon}} I never would have imagined it either.
:{{A|vo xglq003 3 yoimiya 08.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' Well, no worries, if that's the case then never mind.
:{{A|vo xglq003 3 yoimiya 09.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' We can find some other way to help Sakujirou, there's no need to make things difficult for you. This sounds like something for Sakujirou and Keisuke to resolve between themselves.
:{{A|vo xglq003 3 imatanikaori 13.ogg}} '''Imatani Kaori:''' Yes, it'd be nice if they could go back to the way things were.
:{{A|vo xglq003 3 imatanisaburou 15.ogg}} '''Imatani Saburou:''' I think after all these years, they ought to let go of their grudges.

;(After the dialogue)
:{{A|vo xglq003 3 yoimiya 10.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' *sigh* Well, can't say we didn't try.
:{{A|vo xglq003 3 yoimiya 11.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' I'll let Sakujirou know after we get back.

;(Speak to Imatani Saburou or Imatani Kaori)
:{{A|vo dialog xglq003 imatanisaburou 02.ogg}} '''Imatani Saburou:''' I'm sorry that we weren't much help.
:{{A|vo dialog xglq003 imatanikaori 02.ogg}} '''Imatani Kaori:''' One day, though, that child is going to have to face up to his feelings.
:{{A|vo dialog xglq003 imatanikaori 03.ogg}} '''Imatani Kaori:''' This is one life lesson that he can't learn from his parents.
----
;(Talk to Matsuzaka, Saika, Iwao outside the city before meeting Sakujirou)
:{{A|vo dialog xglq003 matsuzaka 01.ogg}} '''Matsuzaka:''' That man who just came past looked really scary...
:{{A|vo dialog xglq003 saika 01.ogg}} '''Saika:''' Do you think... they're here to steal our weapons?
:{{A|vo dialog xglq003 iwao 01.ogg}} '''Iwao:''' Oh... So we won't be able to scare off the [[Great Mujina Youkai]] anymore?

;(Tell Sakujirou the news)
:{{A|vo xglq003 4 naganohararyuunosuke 01.ogg}} '''Naganohara Ryuunosuke:''' Yoimiya, something bad's happened! Some people from the Tenryou Commission came by.
:{{A|vo xglq003 4 yoimiya 01.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' Huh? Why? ... Do they know?
:{{A|vo xglq003 4 yoimiya 02.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' Pops, are you alright? They didn't do anything to you, did they?
:{{A|vo xglq003 4 naganohararyuunosuke 02.ogg}} '''Naganohara Ryuunosuke:''' I told them the show was starting soon and the place was filled with fireworks, so they shouldn't go in because it's a fire hazard.
:{{A|vo xglq003 4 naganohararyuunosuke 03.ogg}} '''Naganohara Ryuunosuke:''' But they didn't listen. It seemed like they knew Sakujirou was inside.
:{{A|vo xglq003 4 naganohararyuunosuke 04.ogg}} '''Naganohara Ryuunosuke:''' Luckily, Sakujirou heard them coming in time and managed to escape through the window. The Tenryou Commission wasn't able to capture him.
:{{A|vo xglq003 4 yoimiya 03.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' This is bad news. I don't think Sakujirou had enough time to make his mind up...
:{{A|vo xglq003 4 yoimiya 04.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' Pops, did you see where he went?
:{{A|vo xglq003 4 yoimiya 05.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' The Tenryou Commission will definitely be chasing after him.
:{{DIcon}} Did you catch any of their names?
:{{A|vo xglq003 4 yoimiya 06.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' Good point! Names, we need names! Suddenly showing up like this, surely it must be Keisuke's doing!
:{{A|vo xglq003 4 yoimiya 07.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' The Commission wouldn't normally cause this big of a fuss over a stowaway.
:{{A|vo xglq003 4 naganohararyuunosuke 05.ogg}} '''Naganohara Ryuunosuke:''' Sorry, my ears are no good, and I didn't get a good look at them either. If you're wondering which way they went, they left the city.
:{{A|vo xglq003 4 naganohararyuunosuke 06.ogg}} '''Naganohara Ryuunosuke:''' I wish I caught their names... *sigh* But I didn't hear a thing...
:{{A|vo xglq003 4 morihiko 01.ogg}} '''Morihiko:''' As it happens, I did.
:{{A|vo xglq003 4 morihiko 02.ogg}} '''Morihiko:''' I was getting some ore from my friend's place and happened to bump into them on the way over.
:{{A|vo xglq003 4 morihiko 03.ogg}} '''Morihiko:''' I think their leader's name was Keisuke, just like you said.
:{{A|vo xglq003 4 yoimiya 08.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' Just as I thought! Thanks!
:{{A|vo xglq003 4 yoimiya 09.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' If Sakujirou still hasn't made up his mind, those two running into each other won't solve anything — and even worse, there'll be no coming back from it for Sakujirou.
:{{A|vo xglq003 4 yoimiya 10.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' We can't let that happen. Come with me, {{Traveler}}, let's track them down!
{{Dialogue End}}

==Dialogue==
{{Quest Description|Diona would like to go to Dadaupa Gorge to secure a certain special "base drink."}}

===A Special Base Drink===
{{Dialogue Start}}
:{{A|vo dancop001 1910301 diona 01.ogg}} '''Diona:''' Dadaupa Gorge is just up ahead. We should be able to find a special drink base there.
:{{A|vo dancop001 1910301 diona 02.ogg}} '''Diona:''' An adventurer who visited the tavern told me that he once ventured deep into Dadaupa Gorge and discovered a type of drink inside the cooking pots of a hilichurl tribe who lived there.
:{{A|vo dancop001 1910301 diona 03.ogg}} '''Diona:''' The drink is actually a herbal soup made by samachurls  using a variety of ingredients. According to the adventurer, it seems like the samachurls made these drinks to grant the tribe more energy.
:{{A|vo dancop001 1910301 diona 04.ogg}} '''Diona:''' The adventurer also said that just by taking a single whiff of it, and I quote...
:{{A|vo dancop001 1910301 diona 05.ogg}} '''Diona:''' "I wasn't able to determine whether or not I took in the smell, because as soon as I tried to smell it, it felt like my nose was being trampled by a hundred forest boars. I couldn't feel my nose anymore, let alone smell anything..."
:{{A|vo dancop001 1910301 diona 06.ogg}} '''Diona:''' Hmph, even though he lost his sense of smell, he still remembered to come and drink. He even started telling me that my delicious cocktails would help his nose regain its sense of smell again...
:{{A|vo dancop001 1910301 diona 07.ogg}} '''Diona:''' What a hopeless drunk... He was probably just exaggerating and hoping for more drinks.
:{{A|vo dancop001 1910301 diona 08.ogg}} '''Diona:''' But whether or not he was exaggerating is not important. The idea of using a hilichurl drink as a base for my cocktails, haha, is one I'm definitely interested in.
:{{DIcon}} You want to make a drink... from that?
::{{A|vo dancop001 1910301 diona 09.ogg}} '''Diona:''' Of course, you wanted a specialty drink, right? Special drinks require special ingredients.
::{{A|vo dancop001 1910301 diona 10.ogg}} '''Diona:''' No need to worry. This will be one drink you'll remember... forever.
:{{DIcon}} Maybe we can use something else instead?
::{{A|vo dancop001 1910301 diona 11.ogg}} '''Diona:''' No way! Normal ingredients will never suffice for a special cocktail, we must use something special.
::{{A|vo dancop001 1910301 diona 12.ogg}} '''Diona:''' Besides, I've never used such ingredients before either. This will be my latest drink, just wait and you'll be the first one to try it.
:{{A|vo dancop001 1910301 diona 13.ogg}} '''Diona:''' Now listen up, I had that old adventurer mark the location for me, so all we have to do is get there and grab what we need.
:{{A|vo dancop001 1910301 diona 14.ogg}} '''Diona:''' Since we're only on the outskirts of Dadaupa Gorge, we'll have to walk further in. We still have quite a ways to go.

;(En route)
:{{A|vo dancop001 1910302 diona 01.ogg}} '''Diona:''' I also told my father about the samachurl herbal soup, he said that he would keep an eye out for it.
:{{A|vo dancop001 1910302 diona 02.ogg}} '''Diona:''' But he's probably just saying that. Once he's had enough drinks in him, he can't even remember his own name, let alone the herbal soup I mentioned.
:{{A|vo dancop001 1910302 diona 03.ogg}} '''Diona:''' Oh well, I never had high hopes for him anyway. Looks like I'm going to have to get the special drink base on my own.

;(Going into Dadaupa Gorge)
:{{A|vo dancop001 1910303 allan 01.ogg}} '''???:''' Hmm? Someone's approaching...
:{{A|vo dancop001 1910302 allan 01.ogg}} '''Allan:''' Diona? Is that you?
:{{A|vo dancop001 1910302 diona 04.ogg}} '''Diona:''' Huh? Oh, I know you... You're the one that usually goes hunting with my father.
:{{A|vo dancop001 1910302 allan 02.ogg}} '''Allan:''' Yeah, my name is Allan. I'm part of the hunting team that Draff leads.
:{{A|vo dancop001 1910302 diona 05.ogg}} '''Diona:''' Huh, so if you're here, that means my father is also somewhere nearby.
:{{A|vo dancop001 1910302 diona 06.ogg}} '''Diona:''' Well, where is he, huh? Oh, I bet he drank too much again after the hunt and fell asleep somewhere, waiting for someone to drag him back to Springvale.
:{{A|vo dancop001 1910302 allan 03.ogg}} '''Allan:''' I—I wish that were the case...
:{{A|vo dancop001 1910302 allan 04.ogg}} '''Allan:''' I'm afraid that Draff... Well h—he rushed into Dadaupa Gorge by himself!
:{{A|vo dancop001 1910302 diona 07.ogg}} '''Diona:''' Wait... What!?
:{{A|vo dancop001 1910302 allan 05.ogg}} '''Allan:''' You see, Draff brought us hunting in the area nearby...
:{{A|vo dancop001 1910302 allan 06.ogg}} '''Allan:''' Thanks to him, the hunt went really well and we managed to catch lots of game. After the hunt, we stopped to rest for a bit before we'd head back to Springvale.
:{{A|vo dancop001 1910302 allan 07.ogg}} '''Allan:''' So we started a bonfire, got some barbeque going, and well... had a little to drink. Honest! We only drank a little, you know, just to celebrate the hunt.
:{{A|vo dancop001 1910302 allan 08.ogg}} '''Allan:''' But after a few drinks, Draff started saying that he wanted to go get something from a hilichurl tribe in the depths of Dadaupa Gorge.
:{{A|vo dancop001 1910302 allan 09.ogg}} '''Allan:''' He refused to let any of us accompany him. Instead, he kept saying that he's a descendant of the Kätzlein bloodline and that he could come and go as he pleases in a place like this.
:{{A|vo dancop001 1910302 allan 10.ogg}} '''Allan:''' Before we could say anything, he rushed out by himself. There's no way we could stop him.
:{{A|vo dancop001 1910302 allan 11.ogg}} '''Allan:''' I had a hunter who's quick on his feet run back to Springvale to find help, and sent a few veteran hunters into the gorge to look for Draff, but...
:{{A|vo dancop001 1910302 diona 08.ogg}} '''Diona:''' Ugh! That stupid old man!
:{{A|vo dancop001 1910302 diona 09.ogg}} '''Diona:''' And it's all because he had something to drink, right!?
:{{A|vo dancop001 1910302 diona 10.ogg}} '''Diona:''' I don't know how many times I've told him not to drink! He just won't listen!
:{{A|vo dancop001 1910302 diona 11.ogg}} '''Diona:''' *sigh* I'll go look for him and see what kind of trouble he's got himself into this time!
:{{A|vo dancop001 1910302 allan 12.ogg}} '''Allan:''' No, wait! It's too dangerous for you to go alone, Diona. Let's wait for more help to arrive and go find him together.
:{{A|vo dancop001 1910302 diona 12.ogg}} '''Diona:''' I'm also of the Kätzlein bloodline, and I'm much better on my feet than he is.
:{{A|vo dancop001 1910302 diona 13.ogg}} '''Diona:''' And most importantly, I don't drink. So I won't be making any of the mistakes that he would.
:{{DIcon}} Don't worry, I'll go with her.
:{{A|vo dancop001 1910302 allan 13.ogg}} '''Allan:''' You're... Oh! You're the Honorary Knight!
:{{A|vo dancop001 1910302 allan 14.ogg}} '''Allan:''' There should be nothing to worry about with you by her side. I'll leave you to it.
:{{A|vo dancop001 1910302 diona 14.ogg}} '''Diona:''' You're coming with me to Dadaupa Gorge? There'll be a lot of monsters in there, I wouldn't want to stir them all up at once.
:{{A|vo dancop001 1910302 diona 15.ogg}} '''Diona:''' So I plan on sneaking by the monsters to find my stupid father... What's your plan?
:{{DIcon}} I'll avoid the monsters as well.
:;(Go to [[#Branch 1|Branch 1]])
:{{DIcon}} I'll defeat all the monsters head-on.
:;(Go to [[#Branch 2|Branch 2]])

;(Talk to Allan again)
:{{A|vo dancop001 1910305 allan 01.ogg}} '''Allan:''' What could Draff be looking for that made him just charge straight in like that? Maybe some kind of valuable treasure?
{{Dialogue End}}

===Branch 1===
{{Dialogue Start}}
:{{A|vo dancop001 1910302 diona 16.ogg}} '''Diona:''' Really? Alright then, but if you do startle them, be sure not to lure them to me.
:{{A|vo dancop001 1910302 diona 17.ogg}} '''Diona:''' Actually... it wouldn't really matter, because you won't be able to figure out where I'm headed anyway.
:{{A|vo dancop001 1910302 diona 18.ogg}} '''Diona:''' Let's pounce to it then. I'll mark the route on your map.
:{{A|vo dancop001 1910302 diona 19.ogg}} '''Diona:''' Oh — make sure to stick to the route. I'm not coming back for you if you get lost.
:;(Proceed to [[The Shadow Over Dadaupa#The Shadow Over Dadaupa|The Shadow Over Dadaupa]])
{{Dialogue End}}

===Branch 2===
{{Dialogue Start}}
:{{A|vo dancop001 1910302 diona 20.ogg}} '''Diona:''' Take them all head on, huh? Well, you are the Honorary Knight after all...
:{{A|vo dancop001 1910302 diona 21.ogg}} '''Diona:''' Hmmm...That would work too, I suppose. You can distract the monsters while I sneak around them.
:{{A|vo dancop001 1910302 diona 22.ogg}} '''Diona:''' Let's head deeper into Dadaupa Gorge. I don't know where my foolish father is, but we can start our search there.
:{{A|vo dancop001 1910302 diona 23.ogg}} '''Diona:''' And uh, if the monsters are too strong, then just run away if you can. There are lots of places to hide around here... trust me.
:{{A|vo dancop001 1910302 diona 24.ogg}} '''Diona:''' Alright, let's get to it! I've marked the approximate location on your map.
:;(Proceed to [[The Shadow Over Dadaupa#Dead-Drunk Draff|The Shadow Over Dadaupa]])
{{Dialogue End}}

==Dialogue==
===A Special Guest===
{{Dialogue Start}}
:{{A|vo bdcop001 1905001 seadrake 01.ogg}} '''[[Sea Drake]]:''' Well, would you look who's here! Looks like it's going to be a day to remember. Guys, look who the sea washed up!
:{{A|vo_bdcop001 1905001 furong 01.ogg}} '''[[Furong]]:''' Ahoy there, Traveler. Hah, so Captain really did invite you to join the homecoming celebration!
:{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905001_huixing_01.ogg}} '''[[Huixing]]:''' Hey! I heard that you took care of another crisis while you were in Inazuma. Are the rumors true?
:{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905001_furong_02.ogg}} '''Furong:''' That's what I heard, too. Thanks to you, Inazuma's Vision Hunt Decree was finally put to an end... Well done, Traveler!
:{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905001_seadrake_02.ogg}} '''Sea Drake:''' Captain's got quite the eye for people. She said she was sure that your trip to Inazuma would stir up some waves, and sure enough...
:{{DIcon}} All I wanted was to have a chat with the Electro Archon.
:{{DIcon}} It was a joint effort, I can't take all the credit.
:{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905001_furong_03.ogg}} '''Furong:''' Heh, look at you, being so modest. We all know what you did to protect Liyue Harbor...
:{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905001_seadrake_03.ogg}} '''Sea Drake:''' I've heard that they tell stories about you in Mondstadt too: the "Honorary Knight"... Pretty impressive!
:{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905001_huixing_02.ogg}} '''Huixing:''' I'd say someone of your caliber would be right at home in The Crux. Right, sailors?
:{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905001_furong_04.ogg}} '''Furong:''' Haha, that's right! Wow, I'm getting excited just thinking of being the Traveler's crewmate!
:{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905001_furong_05.ogg}} '''Furong:''' Hey, whaddya say we arm wrestle?
:{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905001_beidou_01.ogg}} '''[[Beidou]]:''' {{Traveler}}, I was worried you'd be too busy to show up.
:{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905001_seadrake_04.ogg}} '''Sea Drake:''' Oh, Captain on deck!
:{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905001_huixing_03.ogg}} '''Huixing:''' Captain! We were just trying to talk the Traveler into joining the crew.
:{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905001_furong_06.ogg}} '''Furong:''' Yeah c'mon, Captain Beidou! Surely you've got a way to get the Traveler onboard.
:{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905001_beidou_02a.ogg}} {{A|vo_bdcop001_1905001_beidou_02b.ogg}} '''Beidou:''' {{MC|m=He|f=She}}'s onboard right now for the celebration, isn't {{MC|m=he|f=she}}?
:{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905001_huixing_04.ogg}} '''Huixing:''' Yeah, but just one celebration together is not enough. You know what we mean, Captain!
:{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905001_beidou_03.ogg}} '''Beidou:''' Alright, alright, I get it now. There is something special about you, {{Traveler}}. You earned everyone's respect, myself included.
:{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905001_beidou_04.ogg}} '''Beidou:''' So it goes without saying that The Crux would be honored to have a crew member such as yourself.
:{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905001_furong_07.ogg}} '''Furong:''' No doubt about that!
:{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905001_beidou_05.ogg}} '''Beidou:''' But then again, a hero like yourself doesn't just set off on a journey without some bigger purpose in mind.
:{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905001_beidou_06.ogg}} '''Beidou:''' So should a hero really drop what they are doing just to spend day after day drifting at sea with us?
:{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905001_beidou_07.ogg}} '''Beidou:''' If that were the case, then The Crux, known for always moving forward to the next horizon, would instead be holding someone back.
:{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905001_huixing_05.ogg}} '''Huixing:''' Right... Uh, I guess we didn't think that part through.
:{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905001_beidou_08.ogg}} '''Beidou:''' Remember, rather than seeking out strong members to join us, you should be focusing on making yourselves the strongest that you can be! If we are powerful, they will come to us.
:{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905001_beidou_09.ogg}} '''Beidou:''' Isn't that why everyone here chose to come aboard in the first place?
:{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905001_seadrake_05.ogg}} '''Sea Drake:''' Yes... A strong sailor is always looking for a sturdy ship!
:{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905001_furong_08.ogg}} '''Furong:''' I guess I almost forgot the first lesson you ever taught me... Thanks for the reminder, Captain!
:{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905001_beidou_10.ogg}} '''Beidou:''' Just be sure you all keep that in mind! There's no more need to hound the Traveler. As you were! The Traveler and I have something to discuss.
{{Dialogue End}}

{{Dialogue Start}}
:{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905004_beidou_01.ogg}} '''Beidou:''' I'm glad you came, {{Traveler}}. Welcome back aboard.
:{{DIcon}} The crew seemed excited to see me. Thanks for helping me out back there.
::{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905004_beidou_02.ogg}} '''Beidou:''' Hey, don't mention it! As a host, it would be pretty embarrassing to continue letting my guest be put on the spot like that.
:{{DIcon}} You run a tight ship, Captain.
::{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905004_beidou_03.ogg}} '''Beidou:''' Do I? Haha! To be honest, I don't care for that kind of reputation. I don't want people to see me like some big-shot official from Yujing Terrace.
::{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905004_beidou_04.ogg}} '''Beidou:''' But I'll take it as a compliment. I'm glad you see me as well-respected.
:{{DIcon}} You are a wise leader.
::{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905004_beidou_05.ogg}} '''Beidou:''' Heh, thanks. I'll take that.
::{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905004_beidou_06.ogg}} '''Beidou:''' Some rumors have it that the leader of The Crux is so powerful that she could slay the mighty leviathan, Haishan, without breaking a sweat.
:{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905004_beidou_07.ogg}} '''Beidou:''' I can't go getting too caught up in my own reputation, though. That's certainly not how The Crux made it to where we are today.
:{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905004_beidou_08.ogg}} '''Beidou:''' As the head of the fleet, my task is to keep us on the right course, no matter how turbulent the seas may become.
:{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905004_beidou_09.ogg}} '''Beidou:''' But then again, the crew isn't usually this riled up. It's not that they're arrogant, they're just bubbling with ambition, that's all.
:{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905004_beidou_10.ogg}} '''Beidou:''' Their excitement today comes from their great respect for you — both your strength and your character... So please, don't take it the wrong way.
:{{Hangout Branch|Why would I? I'm actually quite interested in the life of a sailor.|A Special Guest#Sailor Training|Sailor Training}}
::{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905004_beidou_11.ogg}} '''Beidou:''' Oh, is that so? Well, it just so happens that we're doing some recruitment and training for new crew members while we're back. It'll be a first-rate chance to learn the life of a sailor.
::{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905004_beidou_12.ogg}} '''Beidou:''' Since you're interested, why don't you come along and experience a sailor's life firsthand?
::{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905004_beidou_13.ogg}} '''Beidou:''' I'm curious to see if you'll take the sea by storm in the same way you have on land.
::{{DIcon}} Alright, Captain. Show me the ropes.
:::{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905004_beidou_14.ogg}} '''Beidou:''' Good, come with me, I've got something interesting for you to see.
::{{DIcon}} Maybe not by storm, but I'll try and make a splash?
:::{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905004_beidou_15.ogg}} '''Beidou:''' Nice! Come with me. Let's see how big of a splash you can manage.
:;(Proceed to [[A Special Guest#Sailor Training|Sailor Training]])
:{{Hangout Branch|Why would I? I should be thanking them for taking me to Inazuma.|A Special Guest#Private Chat|Private Chat}}
::{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905004_beidou_16.ogg}} '''Beidou:''' All good then. Great. Actually, speaking of Inazuma, I think your good luck must have rubbed off on me on the way over. I made an interesting find on the beach shortly after we parted ways.
::{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905004_beidou_17.ogg}} '''Beidou:''' Let's talk about it over there, where it's a little quieter.
:;(Proceed to [[A Special Guest#Private Chat|Private Chat]])
{{Dialogue End}}

===Private Chat===
{{Quest Description|update|The Crux returns safely from Inazuma and is preparing to celebrate. The only difference is that today, you're the guest of honor...}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Go to a quiet spot to talk details with Beidou)
:{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905003_beidou_01.ogg}} '''Beidou:''' So after we dropped you off in Ritou, we found a shipwreck nearby. Probably belonged to Inazuman pirates.
:{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905003_beidou_02.ogg}} '''Beidou:''' We searched the wreckage and found a map.
:{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905003_beidou_03.ogg}} '''Beidou:''' At first, I thought it was a nautical chart. I was thinking we might discover a new sailing route if we were lucky.
:{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905003_beidou_04.ogg}} '''Beidou:''' But after a closer look, I realized that it wasn't a map of the sea at all. It was a Liyue treasure map, and no ordinary one at that.
:{{DIcon}} Is an evil chi active in the area?
:{{DIcon}} Is there a great demonic presence in the area?
:{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905003_beidou_05.ogg}} '''Beidou:''' Um... nothing like that. I just mean that the map was a mess. So it was the most I could do to figure out that the treasure was probably in Liyue.
:{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905003_beidou_06.ogg}} '''Beidou:''' As for its exact location, I have no idea.
:{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905003_beidou_07.ogg}} '''Beidou:''' I'd say I've explored Liyue pretty extensively, but still, this one managed to beat me.
:{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905003_beidou_08.ogg}} '''Beidou:''' So I thought of you. Nobody can beat you when it comes to treasure hunting on land, right?
:{{DIcon}} You know me too well.
:{{DIcon}} I wouldn't say I'm the best treasure hunter of all time... only the best to date.
:{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905003_beidou_09.ogg}} '''Beidou:''' Is that right? Well then, it looks like I'm in good hands.
:{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905003_beidou_10.ogg}} '''Beidou:''' Here's the map, see what you can make of it.
:{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905003_beidou_11.ogg}} '''Beidou:''' So? Where do you think it is?
:{{Hangout Branch|I think it's [[Guili Plains]], just very badly drawn.|Guili Plains Treasure Hunt}}
::{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905003_beidou_12.ogg}} '''Beidou:''' Guili Plains... Huh, I never would have gotten that. How can you tell?
::{{DIcon}} Call it a treasure hunter's intuition.
::{{DIcon}} Compared against a regular map, the topography of the area most closely resembles the Guili Plains.
::{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905003_beidou_13.ogg}} '''Beidou:''' Ohh... okay then.
::{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905003_beidou_14.ogg}} '''Beidou:''' So you do live up to the hype. I can't believe you noticed that — you sure have an eye for detail.
::{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905003_beidou_15.ogg}} '''Beidou:''' Let's head over there and take a look. I'll need you to help me zero in on the specific location once we're there.
:;(Continue to [[Guili Plains Treasure Hunt]])
:{{Hangout Branch|I think it's [[Qingce Village]], just very badly drawn.|Qingce Village Treasure Hunt}}
::{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905003_beidou_16.ogg}} '''Beidou:''' Qingce Village... I don't see the resemblance at all. How'd you come to that conclusion?
::{{DIcon}} Call it a treasure hunter's intuition.
::{{DIcon}} Qingce Village has a lot of terraced land, which seems to match the contour lines on this map.
::{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905003_beidou_17.ogg}} '''Beidou:''' Ohh... okay then.
::{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905003_beidou_18.ogg}} '''Beidou:''' I'm definitely a rookie at this, haha. But your word's good enough for me. Time for a trip to Qingce.
::{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905003_beidou_19.ogg}} '''Beidou:''' You're coming with me, of course. I'll need you to help me zero in on the specific location once we're there.
:;(Continue to [[Qingce Village Treasure Hunt]])
{{Dialogue End}}

===Sailor Training===
{{Dialogue Start}}
:{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905002_beidou_01.ogg}} '''Beidou:''' Chief Mate Juza is breaking in the newcomers. But, I think we can spare you the tedium of that.
:{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905002_beidou_02.ogg}} '''Beidou:''' After this, the new crew members will be arranged into two teams for more specialized training, according to their own aptitudes and the needs of the fleet.
:{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905002_beidou_03.ogg}} '''Beidou:''' One team will learn comprehensive survival skills, including maritime emergency rescue, marine meteorology, psychological counseling, and so on.
:{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905002_beidou_04.ogg}} '''Beidou:''' They will serve as the support team for the fleet, ensuring safe navigation. That's why we call them "The Shield of The Crux."
:{{DIcon}} What's the other team? "The Spear of The Crux"?
::{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905002_beidou_05.ogg}} '''Beidou:''' That's right. You catch on quick.
:{{DIcon}} What's the other team? "The Pen of The Crux"?
::{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905002_beidou_06.ogg}} '''Beidou:''' The Pen of The Crux? Hahahaha! That's a wild idea.
::{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905002_beidou_07.ogg}} '''Beidou:''' Unfortunately, this ain't the Wanwen Bookhouse, kid.
:{{DIcon}} What's the other team? "The Vision of The Crux"?
::{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905002_beidou_08.ogg}} '''Beidou:''' The Vision of The Crux? Hahahaha! We don't have that many Visions, kid.
:{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905002_beidou_09.ogg}} '''Beidou:''' As one might expect, we call the other team the "Spear of The Crux," because they will be learning about naval warfare. They will make up the armed portion of our crew.
:{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905002_beidou_10.ogg}} '''Beidou:''' Also, they are responsible for handling the fleet's cargo deals.
:{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905002_beidou_11.ogg}} '''Beidou:''' So, what do you think? Which team is for you?
:{{Hangout Branch|The Shield of The Crux.|Life on the High Seas|Training: The Shield of The Crux}}
::{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905002_beidou_12.ogg}} '''Beidou:''' Heh, as I expected. You have a will to protect others.
::{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905002_beidou_13.ogg}} '''Beidou:''' There are two main subjects that The Shield of The Crux focuses on, survival knowledge and entertainment.
::{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905002_beidou_14.ogg}} '''Beidou:''' As I was saying earlier, survival knowledge includes prevention of injuries and diseases at sea, navigation and cartography, basic meteorology, etc.
::{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905002_beidou_15.ogg}} '''Beidou:''' You can go learn about these skills from Yinxing, Huixing, and Liushi. They are all seasoned hands in their respective fields.
::{{DIcon}} I thought I would be learning from you, Captain.
::{{DIcon}} There are crewmates who know even more than you, Captain?
::{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905002_beidou_16.ogg}} '''Beidou:''' Each sailor has their own strengths and weaknesses. I'm no rookie, of course, but you shouldn't underestimate the knowledge of the crew.
::{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905002_beidou_17.ogg}} '''Beidou:''' If there's anything I'm most proud of in the fleet, it's my people!
::{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905002_beidou_18.ogg}} '''Beidou:''' Go and get to work. I'll have some questions to test you later. Heh, I look forward to seeing how you do.
:;(Continue to [[Life on the High Seas]])
:{{Hangout Branch|The Spear of The Crux.|Beneath the Surface|Training: The Spear of The Crux}}
::{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905002_beidou_19.ogg}} '''Beidou:''' Heh, you truly are an adventurer at heart.
::{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905002_beidou_20.ogg}} '''Beidou:''' Let's start with the fundamentals for any armed crew member: basic boat handling.
::{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905002_beidou_21.ogg}} '''Beidou:''' Follow me.
:;(Continue to [[Beneath the Surface]])
{{Dialogue End}}

==Dialogue==
{{Quest Description|Ilyas remembered two things that he had to do, one of which is to collect his pay at the Research Preparation Center.}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Use [[Nahida]]'s [[All Schemes to Know]] on Makesh, optional)
:{{A|vo dialog ahlq002 ramesh 05.ogg}} '''Makesh:''' (There's just too much to do...)

;(Approach Makesh)
:{{A|vo ahlq002 1 ramesh 01.ogg}} '''Makesh:''' Acting Grand Sage Alhaitham, I've sent this period's research expenses report to your office. Have you taken a look? Are there any issues with it?
:{{A|vo ahlq002 1 alhaitham 01.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' I did. Recent research expenses have decreased quite a bit compared to past figures.
:{{A|vo ahlq002 1 ramesh 02.ogg}} '''Makesh:''' Yes, though that is primarily because there are fewer scholars with research needs.
:{{A|vo ahlq002 1 ramesh 03.ogg}} '''Makesh:''' But that can be a rather... convoluted topic. Might I ask why you are here today?
:{{A|vo ahlq002 1 alhaitham 02.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' I believe you know this individual — his name is Ilyas. He worked part-time here, and he's here for his paycheck.
:{{A|vo ahlq002 1 ramesh 04.ogg}} '''Makesh:''' Oh, yes, of course, though... Ilyas, where have you been these past few days?
:{{A|vo ahlq002 1 ramesh 05.ogg}} '''Makesh:''' That was our busy period, but then you disappeared without a word. Everyone had to pick up the slack.
:{{A|vo ahlq002 1 ilyas 01.ogg}} '''Ilyas:''' I'm sorry, something unexpected came up...
:{{A|vo ahlq002 1 ilyas 02.ogg}} '''Ilyas:''' But I know I've caused trouble for everyone... Is there anything I can do to make up for it?
:{{A|vo ahlq002 1 ramesh 06.ogg}} '''Makesh:''' The other researchers have more or less finished your share of the work. However, there is one thing that has yet to be settled.
:{{A|vo ahlq002 1 ramesh 07.ogg}} '''Makesh:''' Do you remember Chandra? You were in charge of following up on his off-site research application.
:{{A|vo ahlq002 1 ramesh 08.ogg}} '''Makesh:''' He retracted his application a few days ago and canceled his off-site project.
:{{A|vo ahlq002 1 ramesh 09.ogg}} '''Makesh:''' He's the twelfth person to retract a research application this month. I'd like you to ask him why he did that. Chandra is probably having coffee at this hour, so you can find him at the cafe.
:{{A|vo ahlq002 1 ilyas 03.ogg}} '''Ilyas:''' Understood. Then, about my paycheck...

:{{A|vo ahlq002 2 ilyas 08.ogg}} '''Ilyas:''' I tried my best, but that's all I can remember. I still can't recall where the cave is. I'm really sorry...
:{{A|vo ahlq002 2 alhaitham 13.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' Take your time. You'll eventually remember it all. However, something doesn't seem right. Some details don't add up...

:{{A|vo ahlq002 4 izebel 08.ogg}} '''Izebel:''' Ilyas? What's wrong?
:{{A|vo ahlq002 4 ilyas 07.ogg}} '''Ilyas:''' Ah... I see. I remember now. Don't worry, I remember now.
:{{A|vo ahlq002 4 izebel 09.ogg}} '''Izebel:''' You're acting a little weird today, you know? Anyway, I understand your decision, but Mom, Dad, and I just want you to be happy.
:{{A|vo ahlq002 4 izebel 10.ogg}} '''Izebel:''' I don't care if you're a hero or not. I just want you to enjoy life and relax more.
:{{A|vo ahlq002 4 alhaitham 01.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' Your understanding is a great comfort to him.
:{{A|vo ahlq002 4 izebel 11.ogg}} '''Izebel:''' Is it? That's good. Are you a friend of his?
:'''Izebel:''' Huh... Wait a moment... you look familiar. Have you visited Gandharva Ville before?
:{{A|vo ahlq002 4 alhaitham 02a.ogg}}<!--{{A|vo ahlq002 4 alhaitham 02b.ogg}}--> '''Alhaitham:''' Moreso these two. My name is Alhaitham, and this is {{Traveler}} and Paimon.
:{{A|vo ahlq002 4 izebel 12.ogg}} '''Izebel:''' Oh, that rings a bell... At any rate, I feel more at ease knowing that my brother has friends.
:{{A|vo ahlq002 4 izebel 13.ogg}} '''Izebel:''' Would you like to join us for dinner? I just happened to buy some extra food.
:{{A|vo ahlq002 4 ilyas 08.ogg}} '''Ilyas:''' Sorry, but I still have things I need to take care of.
:{{A|vo ahlq002 4 izebel 14.ogg}} '''Izebel:''' Well, that's a shame... Okay, I'll get going then. Take care of yourself, Ilyas!
:{{A|vo ahlq002 4 ilyas 09.ogg}} '''Ilyas:''' Don't worry, I won't do anything to make you guys worry again.
:{{A|vo ahlq002 4 alhaitham 03.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' You remember now?
:{{A|vo ahlq002 4 ilyas 10.ogg}} '''Ilyas:''' Yes, I do.
:{{A|vo ahlq002 4 ilyas 11.ogg}} '''Ilyas:''' Thanks for that. You know, you don't seem like such a bad person.
:{{A|vo ahlq002 4 alhaitham 04.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' Is that your way of conveying gratitude?
:{{A|vo ahlq002 4 ilyas 12.ogg}} '''Ilyas:''' Oh, my apologies... but I meant every word. Remember when I asked at the tavern if we had ever met?
:{{A|vo ahlq002 4 ilyas 13.ogg}} '''Ilyas:''' I said there was a sense of familiarity, but what I really meant was a sense of loathing.
:{{A|vo ahlq002 4 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Loathing?
:{{A|vo ahlq002 4 ilyas 14.ogg}} '''Ilyas:''' Yeah, but having spent some time with you, I realized that you're not someone I'd dislike to that extent.
:{{A|vo ahlq002 4 ilyas 15.ogg}} '''Ilyas:''' Strange, isn't it? Why did I have those thoughts at that time?
:{{A|vo ahlq002 4 alhaitham 05.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' My strength is that I don't care about what others think. If you could also develop this quality, then you won't be as bothered by complicated social relationships.
:{{A|vo ahlq002 4 ilyas 16.ogg}} '''Ilyas:''' It'd be great if I could think like you. Ah, but first things first, I remember where Siraj's cave is now. I'll take you there.
:{{A|vo ahlq002 4 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Really? That's great!
:{{A|vo ahlq002 4 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Uhh, Paimon remembers that you said there were two things that you had to do. We've only checked off one, right?
:{{A|vo ahlq002 4 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What about the other one? Are we not gonna do that first?
:{{A|vo ahlq002 4 ilyas 17.ogg}} '''Ilyas:''' There are more important things at hand... We have to stop Siraj before he completes his collective consciousness, or it'll be too late.
:{{A|vo ahlq002 4 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You're right. Let's head out!
{{Dialogue End}}

* [[Co-Op Mode]] is disabled during the above steps.
