:{{A|vo eqhdj201 2 dvorak 04.ogg}} '''Dvorak:''' I'm Dvorak, a musician from Fontaine.
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 2 dvorak 05.ogg}} '''Dvorak:''' I came through [[Stone Gate]], intending to head towards Liyue Harbor, but then I became captivated by the beautiful scenery... and before long, I was completely lost.
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 2 dvorak 06.ogg}} '''Dvorak:''' Just now, I was so mesmerized by the waterfall that I slipped and fell into the water. If it weren't for Miss Yaoyao's help, I shudder to think what might have happened...
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 2 yaoyao 03.ogg}} '''Yaoyao:''' It's alright, Mr. Dvorak.
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 2 yaoyao 04.ogg}} '''Yaoyao:''' The splashing around the bottom of the waterfall means the stone path is always wet and slippy. You definitely have to be careful.
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 2 yaoyao 05.ogg}} '''Yaoyao:''' Next time you're exploring an unfamiliar environment, try to focus on what's right in front of you. Don't let your mind wander.
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 2 yaoyao 06.ogg}} '''Yaoyao:''' As long as you watch your step, accidents like this won't happen anymore!
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 2 dvorak 07.ogg}} '''Dvorak:''' Yes Ma'am, I understand... I'll remember to be more careful next time.
:<!--missing audio-->'''Dvorak:''' *grumble*
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 2 yaoyao 07.ogg}} '''Yaoyao:''' Oh... Are you hungry, Sir?
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 2 dvorak 09.ogg}} '''Dvorak:''' Oh, uh... I'll be fine, heh...
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 2 yaoyao 08.ogg}} '''Yaoyao:''' Please, Sir, it's quite alright! I was born and raised here in Liyue. It's only natural for me to extend my hospitality to any guests who are passing through.
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 2 yaoyao 09.ogg}} '''Yaoyao:''' I expect you still have quite a long journey ahead of you? It's very important to keep your energy levels up.
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 2 yaoyao 10a.ogg}}<!--{{A|vo eqhdj201 2 yaoyao 10b.ogg}}--> '''Yaoyao:''' I still have some [[Lotus Flower Crisp]]s left in my backpack. Why don't we split them between the four of us?
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 2 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Aww... what a thoughtful kid! She even has some for Paimon!
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 2 yaoyao 11.ogg}} '''Yaoyao:''' Hehe, you're welcome!
:{{Black Screen|Everyone savors some Delicious Lotus Flower Crisps as they enjoy the scenery...}}
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 2 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Mmm, so tasty... If only there were more...
:{{DIcon}} More!? You already had the Sumpter Beast's share...
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 2 yaoyao 12.ogg}} '''Yaoyao:''' Having a healthy appetite is a good thing! It means Paimon's still growing. If I'd known I was gonna run into you, I would have made a second batch.
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 2 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hope you're taking notes, Traveler. This is how you treat your Paimon!
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 2 yaoyao 13.ogg}} '''Yaoyao:''' What do you think, Sir? Are Liyue's snacks to your taste? I wonder if they're not sweet enough?
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 2 dvorak 10.ogg}} '''Dvorak:''' No no, they're perfect.
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 2 dvorak 11.ogg}} '''Dvorak:''' When I was traveling through Mondstadt, I had a chance to try one of their [[Moon Pie]]s. It had a meat filling, unlike these crisps. But apart from that, it seems like they follow a similar cooking process. Both are delicious in their own way.
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 2 dvorak 12.ogg}} '''Dvorak:''' As for [[Fontaine]]'s cooking, though... Ah, it's been a long time since I've had a taste of home.
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 2 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Sounds like you spend a lot of time on the road, huh?
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 2 dvorak 13.ogg}} '''Dvorak:''' I do. It's part of my job — I'm one of the main organizers of the [[Iridescence Tour]].
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 2 paimon 12.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Iridescence Tour?
:{{DIcon}} That sounds somewhat familiar.
:{{DIcon}} Doesn't ring a bell.
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 2 dvorak 14.ogg}} '''Dvorak:''' The Iridescence Tour is one of the biggest music festivals in Fontaine. We're looking to expand, though. Our aim is to hold a festival in every nation.
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 2 dvorak 15.ogg}} '''Dvorak:''' At least, all the main organizers share this goal. Unfortunately...
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 2 dvorak 16.ogg}} '''Dvorak:''' *sigh* It's a long story, so I'll spare you the details. But anyway, so the main reason I'm traveling all around Teyvat is to promote our music festivals. But I have some... personal reasons, too.
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 2 paimon 13.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Well, what are they? Just tell us already!
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 2 dvorak 17.ogg}} '''Dvorak:''' Let me see... well, to explain it in full, I'd have to start with a story from my ancestors... I don't want to take up too much of your time?
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 2 yaoyao 14.ogg}} '''Yaoyao:''' I love listening to stories!
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 2 paimon 14.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Mm-hmm, we want to hear it too!
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 2 dvorak 18.ogg}} '''Dvorak:''' Okay. Then I'll start from the beginning.
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 2 dvorak 19.ogg}} '''Dvorak:''' The story goes that my ancestor, who was also a traveler, once slipped and fell into a lake during his travels. As he was sinking and gasping for breath, he heard a wondrous tune in the air...
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 2 dvorak 20.ogg}} '''Dvorak:''' They say it was the most beautiful, moving melody he had ever heard.
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 2 dvorak 21.ogg}} '''Dvorak:''' Even in that life-and-death moment, the ethereal music seized his full attention, and almost made him forget the fact that he was drowning...
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 2 dvorak 22.ogg}} '''Dvorak:''' When he finally came to, he found that he had already been brought ashore. Not too far from him stood an unfamiliar woman with an almost divine aura.
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 2 dvorak 23.ogg}} '''Dvorak:''' Once she saw that he was no longer in danger, she left without a word.
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 2 dvorak 24.ogg}} '''Dvorak:''' My ancestor tried to run after her to give his thanks. But although a mere dozen paces separated them, no matter how quickly he gave chase, he drew no closer, and remained a dozen paces behind.
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 2 dvorak 25.ogg}} '''Dvorak:''' In the end, all he could do was to bow in thanks to the woman as he watched her walk away towards the rivers and mountains in the distance, before at last he turned around and made his way home.
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 2 dvorak 26.ogg}} '''Dvorak:''' Once he returned to Fontaine, he began to learn an instrument, so that he could spread his story far and wide, just like the bards.
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 2 dvorak 27.ogg}} '''Dvorak:''' After generations of retelling, embellishing, and dramatizing, people have come to think of that lady as something like a fairy.
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 2 dvorak 28.ogg}} '''Dvorak:''' The story's become something of a local legend in Fontaine. It's called, "The Lady Overlooking the Lake."
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 2 dvorak 29.ogg}} '''Dvorak:''' People now say that if you go down to the lakeside and play an instrument, so long as you play a pleasing melody, you will hear a fairy lady, who is hiding out of sight, playing along with you...
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 2 yaoyao 15.ogg}} '''Yaoyao:''' Wowwwww!
:{{DIcon}} It's a nice legend.
::{{A|vo eqhdj201 2 dvorak 30a 1.ogg}} '''Dvorak:''' Well, yes, as it stands now, it's become a touch too romantic and detached from reality... But I understand the original story and its historical grounding better than anyone else.
:{{DIcon}} At its heart is a true story.
::{{A|vo eqhdj201 2 dvorak 30b 1.ogg}} '''Dvorak:''' Exactly. It may just be a legend to others, but for me, it's a real part of my family history.
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 2 dvorak 31.ogg}} '''Dvorak:''' I wanted to find out the truth of this tale. So I decided to retrace my ancestor's steps, and search for that lady's modern-day descendants.
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 2 dvorak 32.ogg}} '''Dvorak:''' Of course, there's no way of knowing where my ancestor fell into the lake all those years ago. So I always knew that the search would be akin to looking for a needle in a haystack.
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 2 dvorak 33.ogg}} '''Dvorak:''' I've spent many years on the road now, and I'm nowhere near as fit as I was in my youth. The wish that I have spent half my life chasing after has now become something of an obsession...
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 2 yaoyao 16.ogg}} '''Yaoyao:''' I haven't lived half of my life yet, but still... I understand how you must feel.
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 2 paimon 15.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Paimon too...
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 2 paimon 16.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' It's like... imagine if you'd saved the center of a Lotus Flower Crisp — which is the best part, by the way — 'cause you wanted to eat it another day, but then suddenly, sploosh! It falls into the water, never to be seen again!
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 2 paimon 17.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Paimon would definitely remember that for the rest of her life!
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 2 dvorak 34.ogg}} '''Dvorak:''' Hahaha... There's no need to feel sorry for me. I have made some progress over the years. For example... I've concluded that the story must have taken place in Liyue.
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 2 paimon 18.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ooh! So you finally found a lead?
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 2 dvorak 35.ogg}} '''Dvorak:''' Yes. In fact, that's an intriguing story in and of itself.
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 2 dvorak 36.ogg}} '''Dvorak:''' I'd always known that Mondstadt is the City of Song and Freedom. But more recently, I heard that the Anemo Archon returned to Mondstadt for [[Weinlesefest|a festival in the Fall]], and learned that he himself is a patron deity of music.
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 2 dvorak 37.ogg}} '''Dvorak:''' So, I prayed for the Anemo Archon's guidance in the Mondstadt Cathedral... and as soon as I set foot back outside the front gate, I noticed a cluster of leaves being blown in the wind, further and further west, towards Stone Gate.
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 2 dvorak 38.ogg}} '''Dvorak:''' A friendly local told me that this meant the wind was guiding me in the direction of Liyue. So, I followed their advice, and made my way here.
:{{DIcon}} That settles it then. It was Liyue.
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 2 dvorak 39.ogg}} '''Dvorak:''' Right? You get it! I knew I'd find someone that agrees with me eventually.
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 2 yaoyao 17.ogg}} '''Yaoyao:''' Hmm... are you sure? It sounds a bit too much like one of those fake legends told by those treasure hoarder guys to scam gullible grannies from Qingce Village...
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 2 yaoyao 18.ogg}} '''Yaoyao:''' "Rex Lapis has returned to the world! Just give me some incense and a little Mora towards the travel fees, and I will pass your gift on to the Lord of Geo, and ask him to keep you and your family safe and well..." And so on, and so on.
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 2 paimon 19.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Don't worry, Yaoyao! We, uh... we have a lot of experience with deciphering omens and stuff.
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 2 paimon 20.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' And anyway, you only got scammed if you handed over Mora, right?
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 2 dvorak 40.ogg}} '''Dvorak:''' Actually, to express my gratitude, I did spend rather a lot of Mora on several bottles of fine wine, which I left at the {{sic|Statues of the Seven}} along the way...
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 2 paimon 21.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh dear...
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 2 yaoyao 19a.ogg}}<!--{{A|vo eqhdj201 2 yaoyao 19b.ogg}}--> '''Yaoyao:''' Well, how about this, ladies and gentlemen — why don't I bring you all to Yujing Terrace to see Miss Ganyu?
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 2 yaoyao 20.ogg}} '''Yaoyao:''' I don't know very many people, so I can't help you out much, but Miss Ganyu and the Qixing know just about everything.
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 2 yaoyao 21.ogg}} '''Yaoyao:''' If you've been scammed, they'll help you get your Mora back. And if the wind was telling the truth, and you wanna keep looking for that lady's family, they'll be the best people to ask.
:{{DIcon}} That does sound like a good idea.
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 2 dvorak 41.ogg}} '''Dvorak:''' But you've already helped me so much...
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 2 yaoyao 22.ogg}} '''Yaoyao:''' I was gonna take some new medicinal herbs and plants I picked to Miss Ganyu anyway, so it's no trouble at all!
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 2 paimon 22.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You know what, it's been a minute since we saw Ganyu, too. It'd sure be nice to pay her a visit before Lantern Rite.
:{{DIcon}} Then let's get moving.
:{{DIcon}} Let's head off.
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 2 dvorak 42.ogg}} '''Dvorak:''' Alright. Well, my sincere thanks to you all. I will never forget your kindness.
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 2 yaoyao 23.ogg}} '''Yaoyao:''' Okay, everyone, please follow me! I'll be your guide. Remember to watch where you're going, okay?
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 2 paimon 23.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Uh-oh, Paimon's out of a job... Eh, oh well! Paimon'll just be a cheerleader instead!
----
;(Approach the Liyue Harbor bridge)
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 3 dvorak 01.ogg}} '''Dvorak:''' Wow, Liyue Harbor looks very different from when I came last...
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 3 dvorak 02.ogg}} '''Dvorak:''' It's almost as if... I'm listening to the same melody, but with a richer timbre, and new variations added...
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 3 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Well, we are here during Lantern Rite, after all! It only comes once a year, so they always have a big celebration.
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 3 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' It's fair to say that this time of year is when Liyue Harbor looks the prettiest!
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 3 dvorak 03.ogg}} '''Dvorak:''' Great. Let's go and check it out.
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 3 dvorak 04.ogg}} '''Dvorak:''' I can't wait to get into the city and see it all up close for myself.

;(After the cutscene)
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 3 dvorak 05.ogg}} '''Dvorak:''' The streets are breathtaking...
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 3 dvorak 06.ogg}} '''Dvorak:''' Smiles and laughter everywhere I look... it's contagious.
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 3 dvorak 07.ogg}} '''Dvorak:''' I can almost feel the music in the air... I have the urge to start waving my conductor's baton...
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 3 yaoyao 01.ogg}} '''Yaoyao:''' Hee-hee... I'm glad that you're enjoying the city!

;(Approach the marked location)
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 3 xinyan 01.ogg}} '''Xinyan:''' Hey, everyone! Fancy meeting you all here! What a nice surprise.
:{{Introductory Note|Xinyan}}
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 3 yaoyao 02.ogg}} '''Yaoyao:''' Hello, Xinyan! Let me introduce some new friends. They are...
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 3 xinyan 02.ogg}} '''Xinyan:''' {{Traveler}}, Paimon, and Mr. Dvorak, right? Hehe, I've known them all for quite a while.
:{{DIcon}} So you already know each other...
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 3 dvorak 08.ogg}} '''Dvorak:''' Haha... When I was last here to advertise a Liyue stop for the Iridescence Tour, Xinyan was one of the few people willing to give me the time of day.
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 3 xinyan 03.ogg}} '''Xinyan:''' Feels like I've been chasing this Iridescence Tour bandwagon halfway around the world, but I keep getting stood up. What's going on, Mr. Dvorak?
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 3 dvorak 09.ogg}} '''Dvorak:''' *sigh* I am so sorry, Xinyan. We've had a string of terrible luck recently, and every time we've tried to put on a show, something or other has come up to stop our plans from materializing...
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 3 xinyan 04.ogg}} '''Xinyan:''' Is that right... Hmm, I guess it can't be helped.
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 3 xinyan 05.ogg}} '''Xinyan:''' So what brings you to Liyue Harbor at this time of the year, anyway? Thinking of putting on a music festival during the Lantern Rite celebrations?
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 3 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' A Lantern Rite music festival? Yes please!
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 3 dvorak 10.ogg}} '''Dvorak:''' No, uh... I'm actually here on personal business this time.
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 3 xinyan 06.ogg}} '''Xinyan:''' Aw, so no Lantern Rite music festival?
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 3 dvorak 11.ogg}} '''Dvorak:''' I mean... That's not just up to me.
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 3 dvorak 12.ogg}} '''Dvorak:''' Hosting a music festival takes a lot of funding and personnel. Moreover, I've never worked with the Liyue authorities before. Even if I were to start putting something together right now... I think it'd be too rushed.
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 3 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wait, but we're going to meet the Liyue Qixing, aren't we? And they're the ones in charge.
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 3 yaoyao 03.ogg}} '''Yaoyao:''' Uh-huh, that's right! Miss Keqing and Miss Ningguang can make anything happen.
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 3 dvorak 13.ogg}} '''Dvorak:''' You mean... What?
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 3 xinyan 07.ogg}} '''Xinyan:''' Hahaha, this is the perfect opportunity! Sure, it might not work out, but it can't hurt to bring it up as a suggestion.
:{{DIcon}} A Lantern Rite music festival would be something different.
:{{DIcon}} A Lantern Rite music festival would be a huge hit.
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 3 xinyan 08.ogg}} '''Xinyan:''' That's the spirit! See, even {{Traveler}} agrees with me. Mr. Dvorak, don't let yourself be put off by the fact that a few things haven't worked out recently.
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 3 xinyan 09.ogg}} '''Xinyan:''' As for the performers... I can put you in touch with some local artists.
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 3 xinyan 10.ogg}} '''Xinyan:''' My friend [[Yun Jin]] is a well-known opera singer in Liyue. With her support and a commissioned song from the [[Yun-Han Opera Troupe]], we should be able to get something going.
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 3 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' But what about you, Xinyan? Are you just going to sit this one out?
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 3 xinyan 11.ogg}} '''Xinyan:''' Haha, what do you take me for?
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 3 xinyan 12.ogg}} '''Xinyan:''' If we actually manage to make the Iridescence Tour: Lantern Rite Grand Concert a reality, you think I'd let anyone else perform the opening act!?
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 3 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wow, there's that rock 'n' roll spirit, hehe.
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 3 xinyan 13.ogg}} '''Xinyan:''' What do ya say, Mr. Dvorak?
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 3 dvorak 14.ogg}} '''Dvorak:''' Hmm...
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 3 dvorak 15.ogg}} '''Dvorak:''' Hmm... Okay. I'll give it a shot.
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 3 dvorak 16.ogg}} '''Dvorak:''' But the opening act is not something to be chosen lightly, Xinyan. I will judge your work by the strictest of standards, so please make sure you are fully prepared.
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 3 xinyan 14.ogg}} '''Xinyan:''' Are you kidding? I thought you'd never ask!
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 3 xinyan 15.ogg}} '''Xinyan:''' Whew, guess my shopping time's getting cut short! I'm gonna head back right away and start working on this!
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 3 xinyan 16.ogg}} '''Xinyan:''' Yaoyao, if you run into your senior on your way to the Qixing, please send her my regards!
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 3 yaoyao 04.ogg}} '''Yaoyao:''' Okay, I promise I will! Good luck with your music, Xinyan.
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 3 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You've got this, Xinyan!

;(After the cutscene)
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 4 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So, about this "senior" of yours Xinyan mentioned just now... is that anyone we know?
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 4 yaoyao 01.ogg}} '''Yaoyao:''' Yes, it's [[Xiangling]]. She's mentioned you two before.
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 4 yaoyao 02.ogg}} '''Yaoyao:''' Xiangling's always thinking about cooking... Whenever she gets scrapes or burns, she just leaves them to heal by themselves. She definitely needs someone around her to look after her.
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 4 yaoyao 03.ogg}} '''Yaoyao:''' I know you must have looked out for her a lot too in the time you've known her. So thank you for that.

;(Approach Madame Ping)
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 4 yaoyao 04.ogg}} '''Yaoyao:''' Oh! It's Master. Is it okay if I go and say hi to her?
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 4 madameping 01.ogg}} '''Madame Ping:''' Oh, calm down now, dear, I'm not about to run off anywhere. I'm not a bundle of energy like you...
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 4 yaoyao 05.ogg}} '''Yaoyao:''' I haven't seen you in days, Master! I've missed you.
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 4 madameping 02.ogg}} '''Madame Ping:''' Aww, bless you, Yaoyao... you do say the sweetest things.
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 4 madameping 03.ogg}} '''Madame Ping:''' Ah, look who it is. Visiting friends during the Lantern Rite, are we?
:{{DIcon}} Greetings, Madame Ping.
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 4 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You're half right, Madame Ping! We were also trying to help out Mr. Dvorak over here. We were on our way to take him to see the Qixing.
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 4 dvorak 01.ogg}} '''Dvorak:''' Hello, Ma'am. I am a musician from Fontaine, and an organizer of the Iridescence Tour... I don't suppose you've heard of it...
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 4 yaoyao 06.ogg}} '''Yaoyao:''' Master, Master, the Iridescence Tour is a super famous music festival!
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 4 madameping 04.ogg}} '''Madame Ping:''' Hehe... An old lady like me wouldn't know much about that sort of thing. A music festival, you say? It sounds terribly exciting.
:{{DIcon}} If we could add some musical elements to Lantern Rite...
:{{DIcon}} If we could organize a Lantern Rite music festival...
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 4 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh right! Madame Ping, how would you feel about that?
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 4 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You're an elder of Liyue, and you know all about Liyue's cultural traditions. Hearing your thoughts would definitely help us figure out how best to approach it!
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 4 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' For example... do you think it might be a bit too modern, or is there any other issue?
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 4 madameping 05.ogg}} '''Madame Ping:''' Why, not at all. Music pays homage to history and culture, and it can also be a bridge between different civilizations.
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 4 madameping 06.ogg}} '''Madame Ping:''' Times change, and the music enjoyed by the youngsters of today is, no doubt, very different from the tunes I was accustomed to in my youth. Nevertheless, all fine things in life can be appreciated.
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 4 madameping 07.ogg}} '''Madame Ping:''' And so... I look forward to it immensely.
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 4 dvorak 02.ogg}} '''Dvorak:''' Hear, hear! I do believe that, my own dear grandmother aside, you are the wisest old lady I've ever met.
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 4 madameping 08.ogg}} '''Madame Ping:''' Goodness gracious, you're all being suspiciously sweet today. Yaoyao, whatever have you been feeding them?
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 4 yaoyao 07.ogg}} '''Yaoyao:''' Master, you're in such a great mood today! You're even cracking jokes with the rest of us.
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 4 madameping 09.ogg}} '''Madame Ping:''' Hehe. Well, I'm sure you must have plenty to be getting on with, yes? Run along now, don't let me hold you up.
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 4 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Thanks, Madame Ping! We'll see you again soon!

;(Talk to Madame Ping again, optional)
:{{A|vo dialog eqhdj201 madameping 01.ogg}} '''Madame Ping:''' You mustn't be afraid to try new things. If you never try, you'll never know.
:{{A|vo dialog eqhdj201 madameping 02.ogg}} '''Madame Ping:''' With your contribution, I'm sure this year's Lantern Rite will be a most spectacular one.

;(Approach Ganyu and Baixiao)
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 5 ganyu 01.ogg}} '''Ganyu:''' ...and when you meet with the Ministry of Civil Affairs, please remind them that the festivities are not an excuse to procrastinate their work.
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 5 baixiao 01.ogg}} '''Baixiao:''' Understood, Miss Ganyu. I'll take my leave now.
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 5 yaoyao 01.ogg}} '''Yaoyao:''' Ganyuuu!
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 5 ganyu 02.ogg}} '''Ganyu:''' What brings you here, Yaoyao?
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 5 yaoyao 02.ogg}} '''Yaoyao:''' I've brought all the medicine you asked me to pick for you. Ah, and here's a pack of Sweet Flower seeds as well.
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 5 yaoyao 03.ogg}} '''Yaoyao:''' Also, also, these dried Qingxin leaves make a great pot of tea that's very good for you.
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 5 yaoyao 04.ogg}} '''Yaoyao:''' I know you've had a lot to deal with at work recently, but you shouldn't push yourself too hard. If you're not careful, you'll end up falling asleep in the grass again...
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 5 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Well this is weird. It's like a responsible younger sister talking to their disorganized older sister...
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 5 ganyu 03.ogg}} '''Ganyu:''' Ahem...
:{{DIcon}} Paimon, you're running your mouth again...
:{{DIcon}} Don't listen to Paimon...
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 5 ganyu 04.ogg}} '''Ganyu:''' Thank you, {{Traveler}}, but Paimon's criticism is quite valid. I do have a tendency to neglect matters outside of work, and that's something I should improve on.
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 5 ganyu 05.ogg}} '''Ganyu:''' Oh, my apologies, I don't believe we've been introduced?
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 5 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ah! Paimon will do the honors!
:{{Black Screen|Paimon tells Ganyu all about Mr. Dvorak, from how you met, to his family history, to your shared music festival aspirations.}}
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 5 ganyu 06.ogg}} '''Ganyu:''' Hmm...
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 5 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wh—What's wrong? Did Paimon go over everything a bit too fast?
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 5 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' It's definitely an ambitious plan... If there's anything you didn't quite catch, Paimon's more than happy to go over it again!
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 5 ganyu 07.ogg}} '''Ganyu:''' It may be... a little difficult to make this happen.
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 5 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh?
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 5 ganyu 08.ogg}} '''Ganyu:''' Well, the Lantern Rite is the most important festival of the year. Our celebrations must not only be visually spectacular, but also appeal to the tastes of Liyue citizens from all walks of life.
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 5 ganyu 09.ogg}} '''Ganyu:''' The Iridescence Tour is relatively unknown in Liyue. It's difficult to predict how a brand-new show will be received.
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 5 ganyu 10.ogg}} '''Ganyu:''' It would be quite risky for us to bet everything on this one music festival.
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 5 dvorak 01.ogg}} '''Dvorak:''' *sigh* All very valid points. I completely understand...
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 5 ganyu 11.ogg}} '''Ganyu:''' Therefore, we will not replace or cancel any of our preexisting program. However... I will submit a proposal requesting to put the Iridescence Tour special performance as the final act of this year's festivities.
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 5 ganyu 12.ogg}} '''Ganyu:''' Some live music will certainly add to the festive atmosphere on the night of the Lantern Rite. As for the venue... Hmm, let's reserve a space at the docks.
:{{DIcon}} So we're not stealing anyone's thunder...
:{{DIcon}} But we will end the night on a high note.
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 5 ganyu 13.ogg}} '''Ganyu:''' Yes. My thoughts precisely.
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 5 ganyu 14.ogg}} '''Ganyu:''' Now I just need to take some time to give this proposal some polish...
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 5 ganyu 15.ogg}} '''Ganyu:''' As long as I clearly lay out the pros and cons, and highlight the key points of the proposal... Given that Ping and {{Traveler}} have both given the idea their blessing, I'm confident the Qixing will be sure to give it serious consideration.
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 5 ganyu 16.ogg}} '''Ganyu:''' Mr. Dvorak, I will need to discuss with you the number of musicians who will be coming to Liyue, as well as their catering and accommodation requirements...
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 5 dvorak 02.ogg}} '''Dvorak:''' Oh, yes, certainly... Let's step to the side and discuss further.
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 5 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' As soon as there's work to do, Ganyu's as diligent as ever...
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 5 yaoyao 05.ogg}} '''Yaoyao:''' I couldn't agree more!
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 5 yaoyao 06.ogg}} '''Yaoyao:''' Master once said that everyone has things that they are good at, and things that they are less good at. So, with that in mind, Ganyu shouldn't feel compelled to become perfect at absolutely everything.
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 5 yaoyao 07.ogg}} '''Yaoyao:''' I'm good at taking care of people, so that can be left to me.
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 5 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wow... Hey, Yaoyao, can you take care of Paimon too? Paimon's getting hungry again!
:{{DIcon}} Paimon, you're trying to freeload again.
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 5 yaoyao 08.ogg}} '''Yaoyao:''' I'm afraid my backpack's empty now, but if you let me know what you like, I can bring you some of your favorite dishes next time we meet.
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 5 yaoyao 09.ogg}} '''Yaoyao:''' Apart from Lotus Flower Crisps, what else do you like?
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 5 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Anything sweet! And anything that's made from slimes...
:;(After a while)
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 5 ganyu 17.ogg}} '''Ganyu:''' ...Here's what I've drafted so far. Anything else you want to add?
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 5 dvorak 03.ogg}} '''Dvorak:''' No, this is excellent! I'm racking my brains, but I don't think you've missed a single thing.
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 5 ganyu 18.ogg}} '''Ganyu:''' Perfect, then we'll leave it as-is. I'll go make an official copy.
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 5 ganyu 19.ogg}} '''Ganyu:''' Oh, perfect timing. We were just wrapping up our discussion here.
:{{DIcon}} That was quick...
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 5 ganyu 20.ogg}} '''Ganyu:''' Not at all. Every second counts for a complex proposal such as this. I will inform the Qixing of this development immediately... please give me a moment to pass on the message.
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 5 ganyu 21.ogg}} '''Ganyu:''' Yaoyao, thank you for bringing my herbs. I will make sure to take them.
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 5 yaoyao 10.ogg}} '''Yaoyao:''' Remember to make tea from them first, Ganyu! You mustn't just chew them raw.
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 5 ganyu 22.ogg}} '''Ganyu:''' ...Uh, I—I will.
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 5 yaoyao 11.ogg}} '''Yaoyao:''' Okay, I should be getting back. If Yaoyao stays out for too long, Mom and Dad will be worried sick...
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 5 yaoyao 12a.ogg}}<!--{{A|vo eqhdj201 5 yaoyao 12b.ogg}}--> '''Yaoyao:''' Everyone, I'm sure that the music festival will go off without a hitch, so don't worry! And in case I don't see you before, I wish you all a very happy Lantern Rite.

:{{A|vo eqhdj201 5 ganyu 25.ogg}} '''Ganyu:''' Thanks. It was just that I had a few initial thoughts when I heard your story. For instance... I wonder if this lady your ancestor met might have been an adeptus. What do you think?

:{{A|vo eqhdj201 5 keqing 11.ogg}} '''Keqing:''' Wait, what do you mean, "as long as I don't sleep"?
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 5 keqing 12.ogg}} '''Keqing:''' Even for someone with illuminated beast blood in their veins, working for such an extended period without a break will take its toll on your health.

::{{A|vo eqhdj201 7 yelan 08a 2.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' To be honest, I was only able to put it all together because of some background knowledge about this area.

::{{A|vo eqhdj201 7 yelan 08b 3.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' Let me share a folk story with you.
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 7 yelan 09.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' A long time ago, there used to be a group of bandits in the Liyue countryside who would sound a horn every time they were about to raid a village.
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 7 yelan 10.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' But it wasn't a rallying cry to rouse their fellow men. It was a disconcerting tune, meant to intimidate the weak and warn them of their impending doom.
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 7 yelan 11.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' To escape with their lives, the villagers would abandon their homes and flee overnight, taking only their most valuable belongings with them. Everything else was left behind.
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 7 yelan 12.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' The bandits were eventually brought to justice. But the fear and trauma remained in the villagers' hearts.
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 7 yelan 13.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' Whenever they heard that melody, they would feel like their lives were in danger once again, and flee immediately.
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 7 yelan 14.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' The culprit of this crime exploited that very fear to get access to this house without having to force their way in.
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 7 paimon 12.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Whew, that's quite the story...
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 7 yelan 15.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' The victims obviously will have gotten quite a fright, but at least they won't be in any great danger.
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 7 yelan 16.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' The important thing now is to find this copycat criminal.
:{{DIcon}} If we use Elemental Sight...
:{{DIcon}} We could follow their tracks...
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 7 yelan 17.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' On any other day, that'd probably be a good idea. Unfortunately, it's not gonna work today.
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 7 yelan 18.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' Take a look around and you'll see what I mean. This criminal is clearly well-versed both in using music to commit crimes and in making a clean getaway.
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 7 yelan 19.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' Not only did they stay off the muddy road to avoid leaving footprints, it looks like they were also careful not to bring any gadgets with so much as a trace of elemental energy. Evidently, they were intent on keeping even the most experienced investigators off their trail.
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 7 yelan 20.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' Unfortunately for them, I'm one of the best trackers in the business. They're not about to get away with their little scheme on my watch.
:{{A|vo eqhdj201 7 paimon 13.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So basically... if we wanna find the culprit, we just need to follow Yelan!
:;(The Traveler and Paimon follow Yelan)

==Steps==
# Go to the [[Adventurers' Guild]] in [[Inazuma City]]
# Go to the [[Tenryou Commission Headquarters]]
# Negotiate with the officials at the Tenryou Commission Headquarters
# Enter the Tenryou Commission Headquarters
# Talk to [[Kujou Sara]]
# Go into the domain and investigate
# Check on the wounded soldier
# Go to the domain and guard the gate

:{{A|vo eqrg001 15 shikishogun 04.ogg}} '''Shiki Taishou:''' My name is Shiki Taishou, and I'm sorry you have to see me like this on our first meeting.
:{{A|vo eqrg001 15 shikishogun 05.ogg}} '''Shiki Taishou:''' This Domain is called the Mystic Onmyou Chamber. I'm the overseer in charge here.
:{{A|vo eqrg001 15 shikishogun 06 (re-upload).ogg}} '''Shiki Taishou:''' The Mystic Onmyou Chamber has been in an extended slumber, just as I have. However, a few days ago, under the influence of an unknown power, all the monsters in the Domain were suddenly awakened... and the door was opened...
:{{A|vo eqrg001 15 shikishogun 07.ogg}} '''Shiki Taishou:''' Actually... it seems like I may have suffered some memory loss in the process. All I remember is waking up to a living nightmare... I tried my best to stop them.
:{{A|vo eqrg001 15 shikishogun 08.ogg}} '''Shiki Taishou:''' I was surprised to see the monsters turn into paper charms when they were defeated. That's when I remembered that they must also be onmyoudou creations... and form part of this onmyou chamber, like me.
:{{A|vo eqrg001 15 xinyan 07.ogg}} '''Xinyan:''' Onmyoudou creations? I don't follow...

:{{DIcon}} But... what about yourself?

:{{A|vo eqrg001 15 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You mean, you don't even know if you're one of the good guys?

:{{A|vo eqrg001 15 shikishogun 12.ogg}} '''Shiki Taishou:''' I still have many unanswered questions, but one thing I'm certain of is that my powers originate from this Domain... We might even be one and the same.
:{{A|vo eqrg001 15 shikishogun 13.ogg}} '''Shiki Taishou:''' For some reason... I have a feeling that I should be able to completely control it!
:{{A|vo eqrg001 15 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' If shikigami are supposed to help with banishing evil and repelling monsters, you were probably stationed here to guard the entrance!
:{{A|vo eqrg001 15 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' As for your memory loss, did you ever hear those stories? Y'know, the ones where someone loses their memory and forgets about the incredible powers they had. Once they remember, they become invincible again!

:{{A|vo eqrg001 16 xinyan 11.ogg}} '''Xinyan:''' I don't care how strong they are, they'll be ashes when I'm finished with them!
:{{A|vo eqrg001 16 paimon 13.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' M—Make sure you guys protect us! Especially Paimon...
:{{DIcon}} What is it, Shiki Taishou?
:{{A|vo eqrg001 16 shikishogun 08.ogg}} '''Shiki Taishou:''' I hear something... an echo.
:{{A|vo eqrg001 16 shikishogun 09.ogg}} '''Shiki Taishou:''' This place... Yes, this used to be my dominion! I should be able to do more than just open doors and activate mechanisms here.
:{{A|vo eqrg001 16 shikishogun 10.ogg}} '''Shiki Taishou:''' Fight... I—I should know how to fight!
:{{A|vo eqrg001 16 shikishogun 11.ogg}} '''Shiki Taishou:''' Everyone! I've just remembered some combat techniques. Please, allow me to assist you in battle with shikifuda and onmyoudou.

;(Approach the charm emplacement)
:{{A|vo eqrg001 17 shikishogun 01.ogg}} '''Shiki Taishou:''' "There are four great spirits, and three spokes in the Mitsudomoe." This Domain is a magnificent work of onmyoudou. Over a thousand types of shikifuda were once placed here, nine of which are recognized as high magic.
:{{A|vo eqrg001 17 shikishogun 02.ogg}} '''Shiki Taishou:''' Onmyoudou can expel evil and repel monsters. When used wisely, it can be of great help to martial artists. The secrets therein, are all hidden within these shikifuda.

;(Enter the hallways between rooms) <!-- trigger after combat -->
:{{A|vo eqrg001 17 shikishogun 03.ogg}} '''Shiki Taishou:''' But why did people want to do battle in this Domain?
:{{A|vo eqrg001 17 shikishogun 04.ogg}} '''Shiki Taishou:''' On the way here, I noticed many damaged shikifuda and all kinds of weapons, as well as the scent of Grilled Fish. Who was it that left all this behind?

----
;(Reach the end of the dungeon)
:{{A|vo eqrg001 18 tartaglia 01.ogg}} '''Childe:''' Not bad, that was some perilous action... I've experienced close calls like that before.
:{{A|vo eqrg001 18 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' No surprise to see Childe enjoying himself. Do you really enjoy fighting that much?
:{{A|vo eqrg001 18 tartaglia 02.ogg}} '''Childe:''' Of course! I relish this kind of endless fighting. Putting your life on the line, giving your all, and leaving nothing on the battlefield...
:{{A|vo eqrg001 18 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hmm... I guess bringing Childe along does have its advantages. We're making quick work of these monsters!
:{{A|vo eqrg001 18 xinyan 01.ogg}} '''Xinyan:''' Hey! Watch your step! What is that?
:{{A|vo eqrg001 18 xinyan 02.ogg}} '''Xinyan:''' This paper cut-out looks just like Shiki Taishou!
:{{A|vo eqrg001 18 shikishogun 01.ogg}} '''Shiki Taishou:''' I know what this is. It's a replica of me — a mass-produced shikigami based on my design. It has my power... and possibly a portion of my memories...
:{{A|vo eqrg001 18 shikishogun 02.ogg}} '''Shiki Taishou:''' I should fuse with it.
:{{Black Screen|''Shiki Taishou retrieves the replica...''}}
:{{A|vo eqrg001 19 xinyan 01.ogg}} '''Xinyan:''' How was it? What did you see?
:{{A|vo eqrg001 19 shikishogun 01.ogg}} '''Shiki Taishou:''' Harunosuke...
:{{A|vo eqrg001 19 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Harunosuke?
:{{A|vo eqrg001 19 shikishogun 02.ogg}} '''Shiki Taishou:''' My master, [[Kamuna Harunosuke]].
:{{A|vo eqrg001 19 shikishogun 03.ogg}} '''Shiki Taishou:''' He was the first onmyouji of Inazuma and a master of charm magic. He created me and this Domain, and lived here in seclusion for a very long time.
:{{A|vo eqrg001 19 tartaglia 01.ogg}} '''Childe:''' Huh, so it was your master that created this place.
:{{A|vo eqrg001 19 xinyan 02.ogg}} '''Xinyan:''' But what was his reason behind creatin' you and the Domain?
:{{A|vo eqrg001 19 shikishogun 04.ogg}} '''Shiki Taishou:''' I'm sorry... I'm not sure of that myself just yet.
:{{A|vo eqrg001 19 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Perhaps he was passionate about onmyoudou? Maybe when he discovered how strong he was, he decided to create a place like this to hone his abilities, to become even stronger...
:{{A|vo eqrg001 19 tartaglia 02.ogg}} '''Childe:''' It's possible. Those obsessed with certain disciplines are often capable of incredible feats.
:{{A|vo eqrg001 19 tartaglia 03.ogg}} '''Childe:''' Perhaps that was the case with Kamuna Harunosuke. Onmyoudou may have been everything to him, so he created a Domain to train in.
:{{A|vo eqrg001 19 tartaglia 04.ogg}} '''Childe:''' But, he couldn't foresee that something would go wrong with the Domain, that he would lose control of the onmyoudou, and that his shikigami would turn into monsters.
:{{A|vo eqrg001 19 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wah! Shikigami can turn into monsters!?
:{{A|vo eqrg001 19 xinyan 03.ogg}} '''Xinyan:''' Th—That's not possible, right!? That could be bad news for us!
:{{A|vo eqrg001 19 tartaglia 05.ogg}} '''Childe:''' I'm just shooting in the dark here. If the monsters weren't originating from the shikigami or paper charms, where were they coming from? The Inazuman authorities must have caught wind of this place and sent people here to seal it off, sending Shiki Taishou into a deep sleep in the process...
:{{A|vo eqrg001 19 shikishogun 05.ogg}} '''Shiki Taishou:''' No. Even though I still can't recall what he looked like, or how it felt to be in his company, there is one thing I'm certain of...
:{{A|vo eqrg001 19 shikishogun 06.ogg}} '''Shiki Taishou:''' With his ability, there's no way Kamuna would have made an error like this with his onmyoudou. More importantly, I'm sure he wouldn't have been so irresponsible.
:{{A|vo eqrg001 19 tartaglia 06.ogg}} '''Childe:''' Oh really? Well then, that leaves us with the worst assumption of all.
:{{A|vo eqrg001 19 tartaglia 07.ogg}} '''Childe:''' What if Kamuna Harunosuke is evil, and created this Domain to enhance his onmyoudou? What if he succeeded in creating monsters that could become weapons...?
:{{A|vo eqrg001 19 tartaglia 08.ogg}} '''Childe:''' That would make him a problem, and you... you would be his accomplice.
:{{A|vo eqrg001 19 shikishogun 07.ogg}} '''Shiki Taishou:''' Evil? Accomplice? Using monsters... as weapons?
:{{A|vo eqrg001 19 xinyan 04.ogg}} '''Xinyan:''' Easy red, isn't it a little early to be jumping to conclusions?
:{{A|vo eqrg001 19 xinyan 05.ogg}} '''Xinyan:''' Shiki Taishou passed my test and earned my trust. I don't like the way you're talkin'.
:{{A|vo eqrg001 19 tartaglia 09.ogg}} '''Childe:''' Hey, I'm merely making inferences based on Shiki Taishou's memories. I'm not trying to cast doubt on him, and it's true that we don't have any decisive evidence. But we do need to understand the situation here.
:{{A|vo eqrg001 19 tartaglia 10.ogg}} '''Childe:''' Besides... is being used as a weapon really that bad?
:{{DIcon}} (Being used as a weapon...?)
::{{DIcon}} (He must know something.)
:::{{DIcon}} (Him being here is no coincidence.)
:::{{DIcon}} (He's looking for something too.)
:{{A|vo eqrg001 19 tartaglia 11.ogg}} '''Childe:''' Alright, the next room should be through that door.
:{{A|vo eqrg001 19 tartaglia 12.ogg}} '''Childe:''' Let's see if we can find more of Shiki Taishou's replicas and help him restore his memories.
:{{A|vo eqrg001 19 tartaglia 13.ogg}} '''Childe:''' Who knows? We may even find Kamuna Harunosuke himself somewhere further in. I wonder how strong of a fighter he is... I'd like to go a few rounds with him.
:{{A|vo eqrg001 19 shikishogun 08.ogg}} '''Shiki Taishou:''' ...Let's keep moving forward.

;(Exit the domain)
:{{A|vo eqrg001 20 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh? How did we get back out here?
:{{A|vo eqrg001 20 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wasn't that door meant to take us to the next room?
:{{A|vo eqrg001 20 xinyan 01.ogg}} '''Xinyan:''' Uh-oh, where's Shiki Taishou and Red? Are they still in the Domain?
:{{A|vo eqrg001 20 xinyan 02.ogg}} '''Xinyan:''' Oh no... we can't get back in. It's stoppin' outsiders from enterin'.
:{{DIcon}} The Domain is stopping us?
:{{A|vo eqrg001 20 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What's that rumbling... Can you feel it? Maybe some kind of mechanism has activated inside?
:{{A|vo eqrg001 20 xinyan 03.ogg}} '''Xinyan:''' ...Ugh, this ain't good.
:{{A|vo eqrg001 20 xinyan 04.ogg}} '''Xinyan:''' We can't make any hasty decisions... Traveler, Paimon, let's just wait it out for a minute.
:{{A|vo eqrg001 20 kujousara 01.ogg}} '''Kujou Sara:''' Hey!
:{{A|vo eqrg001 20 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh!? Kujou Sara? You're back so soon!
:{{DIcon}} (Good thing Tartaglia's not here...)
:{{DIcon}} (...or things might get out of hand real fast.)
:{{A|vo eqrg001 20 kujousara 02.ogg}} '''Kujou Sara:''' Not soon enough, we spent a long time chasing those monsters down. They were cunning, and surprisingly good at evading us.
:{{A|vo eqrg001 20 kujousara 03.ogg}} '''Kujou Sara:''' How are things looking here?
:{{A|vo eqrg001 20 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Uh, actually...
:{{A|vo eqrg001 20 xinyan 05.ogg}} '''Xinyan:''' No other monsters have emerged since we defeated the ones at the entrance.
:{{A|vo eqrg001 20 xinyan 06.ogg}} '''Xinyan:''' However, strange noises keep comin' from inside the Domain. Something big must be happenin', but we reckon it might be too dangerous to enter. We're waitin' for the noises to stop before goin' in to investigate.
:{{A|vo eqrg001 20 kujousara 04.ogg}} '''Kujou Sara:''' Hmm... I can sense a power is resisting us.
:{{A|vo eqrg001 20 kujousara 05.ogg}} '''Kujou Sara:''' We've already expended a lot of strength intercepting those monsters, investigating the truth of this Domain would be difficult... We need to be fully prepared.
:{{A|vo eqrg001 20 watabe 01.ogg}} '''Watanabe:''' Ma'am! It's not looking good for the wounded soldiers, but we came across a few scattered monsters on the way back...
:{{A|vo eqrg001 20 watabe 02.ogg}} '''Watanabe:''' If I may be so bold... we need you to bring up the rear and escort the wounded back to the city!
:{{A|vo eqrg001 20 kujousara 06.ogg}} '''Kujou Sara:''' ...
:{{DIcon}} Don't worry about us.
:{{DIcon}} Go and help those more in need.
:{{A|vo eqrg001 20 kujousara 07.ogg}} '''Kujou Sara:''' I suppose it can't be helped. I'll send the wounded back to Inazuma City and dispatch an elite force here. You've already been a great help, please return to the city with us.
:{{A|vo eqrg001 20 xinyan 07.ogg}} '''Xinyan:''' That's mighty kind Madam Kujou, but we're not outta strength yet. In fact, we've plenty to go around! We can keep taking care of things here, you do what you gotta do.
:{{A|vo eqrg001 20 xinyan 08.ogg}} '''Xinyan:''' We'll keep a close eye on the entrance for you.
:{{A|vo eqrg001 20 kujousara 08.ogg}} '''Kujou Sara:''' I... I'm very grateful.
:{{A|vo eqrg001 20 xinyan 09.ogg}} '''Xinyan:''' Hehe, if we're gonna help someone, we're gonna help them all the way through to the end.
:{{A|vo eqrg001 20 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yeah! We can get a fire going and eat some Grilled Fish while you're away! Mmmm...
:{{A|vo eqrg001 20 xinyan 10.ogg}} '''Xinyan:''' I just got a wave of new inspiration! I'm gonna write a song about this daredevil trip to Inazuma.
:{{A|vo eqrg001 20 kujousara 09.ogg}} '''Kujou Sara:''' We at the Tenryou Commission will forever remember your contributions to our cause. I will be sure to reward each and every one of you properly once this is all over.
:{{A|vo eqrg001 20 kujousara 10.ogg}} '''Kujou Sara:''' For now, I'll leave this Domain in your hands. Please keep a careful watch.
:{{A|vo eqrg001 20 kujousara 11.ogg}} '''Kujou Sara:''' Watanabe will be stationed in the area. Be sure to alert him if anything unexpected happens.
:{{Black Screen|''Kujou Sara leaves, while Watanabe heads to his station to continue awaiting orders.''}}
:{{A|vo eqrg001 20 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Xinyan, did you leave out the part about us entering the Domain on purpose? Hehe... Don't think Paimon didn't notice!
:{{A|vo eqrg001 20 xinyan 11.ogg}} '''Xinyan:''' Haha, you got me. Great minds think alike Paimon, you must've been fixin' to do the same.
:{{A|vo eqrg001 20 xinyan 12.ogg}} '''Xinyan:''' There's still a lot we don't know about the Domain. If we get the authorities involved... we might end up with more problems than we started with.
:{{A|vo eqrg001 20 xinyan 13.ogg}} '''Xinyan:''' Now let me be clear, I ain't biased in favor of Shiki Taishou! It's just, those memories are really important to him. Before we find out the truth about his origin... we shouldn't go makin' assumptions.
:{{DIcon}} Seemed like Tartaglia was making a few.
:{{DIcon}} There's certainly room for misunderstanding.
:{{A|vo eqrg001 20 xinyan 14.ogg}} '''Xinyan:''' Yeah, and it's a terrible feelin' to be misunderstood... I would know. Sometimes people are too ready to judge a book by its cover, and don't have the patience to read the pages...
:{{A|vo eqrg001 20 xinyan 15.ogg}} '''Xinyan:''' Sometimes a glance is all it takes. And once someone's misunderstood, they got a hell of a job tryin' to change people's minds.
:{{A|vo eqrg001 20 xinyan 16.ogg}} '''Xinyan:''' Rock 'n' roll is great music, but it's also easily misunderstood... I made a friend of Shiki Taishou as soon as he heard the language I was speakin'. I need to find my own way of helpin' him.
:{{DIcon}} It's a risky endeavor.
:{{DIcon}} Kujou Sara's given us some added time pressure.
:{{A|vo eqrg001 20 xinyan 17.ogg}} '''Xinyan:''' That's right, we're gonna have to prove Shiki Taishou's innocence before she returns.
:{{A|vo eqrg001 20 xinyan 18.ogg}} '''Xinyan:''' I need to ask a favor. Can you guys keep the Tenryou Commission's campaign against the Domain a secret from Shiki Taishou?
:{{A|vo eqrg001 20 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You're really considerate, Xinyan. You really care about Shiki Taishou's memory loss.
:{{A|vo eqrg001 20 xinyan 19.ogg}} '''Xinyan:''' Haha, could I call myself a friend if I didn't?
:{{DIcon}} (Xinyan can take care of the trust-building exercises...)
:{{DIcon}} (...I'll take care of the decision-making.)
:{{A|vo eqrg001 20 xinyan 20.ogg}} '''Xinyan:''' Huh? There's that noise again! Let me take a look...
:{{A|vo eqrg001 20 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wait, Paimon wants to take a look too—
:{{DIcon}} Paimon, come here a second!
:{{Black Screen|''To be on the safe side, you discuss some future moves with Paimon...''}}
:{{A|vo eqrg001 20 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So you really think we should tell him?
:{{A|vo eqrg001 20 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' ...Then again, if he turns on us when we lay it all out there, Paimon will have your back!
:{{A|vo eqrg001 20 paimon 12.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' There's no way we're losing to a tiny paper cut-out. Not on Paimon's watch!
:{{A|vo eqrg001 20 xinyan 21.ogg}} '''Xinyan:''' Traveler, come quick!
:{{A|vo eqrg001 20 shikishogun 01.ogg}} '''Shiki Taishou:''' *whimper* ...I failed again!
:{{A|vo eqrg001 20 xinyan 22.ogg}} '''Xinyan:''' Shiki Taishou! Are you okay?
:{{A|vo eqrg001 20 shikishogun 02.ogg}} '''Shiki Taishou:''' I'm fine, I had to use up some of my power just now to counter the resistance from within the Domain.
:{{A|vo eqrg001 20 shikishogun 03.ogg}} '''Shiki Taishou:''' The door just now must have actually been a disguised mechanism. As soon as anyone touches it, all the rooms inside the onmyou chamber are rearranged.
:{{A|vo eqrg001 20 shikishogun 04.ogg}} '''Shiki Taishou:''' It seems that no one can enter during the transition.
:{{A|vo eqrg001 20 shikishogun 05.ogg}} '''Shiki Taishou:''' *sigh* It's all my fault. If only I could exert real control over the Domain, we wouldn't be in this situation...
:{{A|vo eqrg001 20 paimon 13.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' There's no need to go blaming yourself. By the way, where's Childe? He's not still inside, is he?
:{{A|vo eqrg001 20 shikishogun 06.ogg}} '''Shiki Taishou:''' I couldn't say... but that man possesses an incredible aura.
:{{A|vo eqrg001 20 shikishogun 07.ogg}} '''Shiki Taishou:''' He's unlike any ordinary person... He enjoys fighting and knows no fear of it. Maybe someone like that really can succeed in conquering this Domain.
:{{A|vo eqrg001 20 paimon 14.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' He's a troublemaker, but he could be in serious danger right now. We can't let him perish in there! He's the strongest on the team!
:{{A|vo eqrg001 20 xinyan 23.ogg}} '''Xinyan:''' He was hardly breakin' a sweat in there. I think we should have faith in his abilities.
:{{A|vo eqrg001 20 xinyan 24.ogg}} '''Xinyan:''' As much as I hate sittin' around, if even Shiki Taishou can't get back in, there's not much we can do right now...
:{{A|vo eqrg001 20 xinyan 25.ogg}} '''Xinyan:''' *sigh* Well, while we're waitin', I'm gonna think about my song. Shiki Taishou, you wanna listen to some new music?
:{{A|vo eqrg001 20 shikishogun 08.ogg}} '''Shiki Taishou:''' I'd love {{sic|too}}, but my mind is restless...
:{{A|vo eqrg001 20 paimon 16.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' But you're a piece of paper, are you really more restless than we are?
:{{A|vo eqrg001 20 shikishogun 09.ogg}} '''Shiki Taishou:''' Trust me when I say that I'm well aware of the risks you're taking to help me. The experiences, battles, and injuries you've gone through in the Domain are all my responsibility.
:{{A|vo eqrg001 20 xinyan 26.ogg}} '''Xinyan:''' Us Liyue folk are all about maintainin' a tranquil mind. Things will only get worse if you let frustration take a hold of you.
:{{A|vo eqrg001 20 xinyan 27.ogg}} '''Xinyan:''' But there are some things in life that resist the more you try to repress them, that makes for freedom the more you try to tie 'em down. That's the kind of tenacity that gets me fired up!
:{{A|vo eqrg001 20 paimon 17.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You're talking about things like rock 'n' roll, right?
:{{A|vo eqrg001 20 xinyan 28.ogg}} '''Xinyan:''' Right on! It's powerful yet flexible, with a stubbornness that never surrenders to the challenges ahead. That's the existence I strive for.
:{{A|vo eqrg001 20 shikishogun 10.ogg}} '''Shiki Taishou:''' ...I see. Then let us wait for the opportune moment together, Miss Xinyan.
:{{A|vo eqrg001 20 xinyan 29.ogg}} '''Xinyan:''' Haha, now that's more like it!
:{{A|vo eqrg001 20 xinyan 30.ogg}} '''Xinyan:''' Well Traveler, if you got other matters to attend to, let's split up for the meantime.
:{{A|vo eqrg001 20 xinyan 31.ogg}} '''Xinyan:''' We can rendezvous somewhere close by when the Domain is open again!

:{{DIcon}} Yes, I have.
:{{DIcon}} Actually, the ones in Liyue are a little fancier...

:{{A|vo tmcop001 1911901 qiuyue 02.ogg}} '''Qiuyue:''' Since you're here, you should pick out a special something. We've got some fantastic pieces in at the moment.
:{{A|vo tmcop001 1911901 qiuyue 03.ogg}} '''Qiuyue:''' Like this [[Noctilucous Jade]] Necklace, or this [[Cor Lapis]] Bracelet. They may not be top tier in terms of ore quality, but the craftsmanship is simply exquisite.
:{{A|vo tmcop001 1911901 qiuyue 04.ogg}} '''Qiuyue:''' Do either of them pique your interest?
:{{DIcon}} I quite like the necklace, but...
:{{DIcon}} Maybe the bracelet would suit me better?
:{{A|vo tmcop001 1911901 thoma 10.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' I think both suit you very nicely.
:{{A|vo tmcop001 1911901 thoma 11.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' To heck with it — how often do we get to do this? We'll take them both.
:{{A|vo tmcop001 1911901 thoma 12.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' But you've gotta be fair to us with the price, Ma'am. My friend here is actually from Liyue.
:{{A|vo tmcop001 1911901 qiuyue 05.ogg}} '''Qiuyue:''' Oh, really? Well, say no more, Thoma, I wouldn't dream of overcharging. How does this figure look to you?
:{{A|vo tmcop001 1911901 thoma 13.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' It looks very reasonable. Deal! Now, {{Traveler}}, lemme take you somewhere else.

:{{A|vo tmcop001 1911903 thoma 02.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' As it turned out, one of the first things that greeted me here when I arrived wasn't my father, but wine from my hometown.
:{{A|vo tmcop001 1911903 thoma 03.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' It must be said though, the wines here aren't quite up to the [[Dawn Winery]] standard...
:{{A|vo tmcop001 1911903 thoma 04.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' Back when my father was still in Mondstadt, he used to talk fondly of the [[Angel's Share]].
:{{A|vo tmcop001 1911903 thoma 05.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' Of course, I was still a kid back then, so I never did get to join him for a drink.
:{{A|vo tmcop001 1911903 thoma 06.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' And now that I'm actually old enough, the opportunity is gone...
:{{DIcon}} You'll get the chance one day.
:{{DIcon}} You'll have that drink one day.
:{{A|vo tmcop001 1911903 thoma 07.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' I hope so.
:{{A|vo tmcop001 1911903 thoma 08.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' You've been to Mondstadt, right? I assume you've been to the Angel's Share?
:{{A|vo tmcop001 1911903 thoma 09.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' I hear the [[Diluc|owner]]'s quite a formidable businessman. Given the chance, I'd love to meet him.
:{{A|vo tmcop001 1911903 thoma 10.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' When that day comes, we should also grab a drink... ah, wait, what am I saying. Maybe when you're older.

:;(Roam the streets with Thoma)
::{{A|vo tmcop001 1911904 thoma 01.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' Ritou's been going downhill ever since the [[Sakoku Decree]] took effect.
::{{A|vo tmcop001 1911904 thoma 02.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' The winds of freedom disappeared and a dark gloom took their place.
::{{A|vo tmcop001 1911904 thoma 03.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' Ironically, though, it's that same gloom that really allows me to thrive here...
::{{A|vo tmcop001 1911904 kaede 01.ogg}} '''Kaede:''' Hi, Thoma. Out shopping with your friend? Can I get you anything today?
::{{A|vo tmcop001 1911904 thoma 04.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' Why not — I'll take that Toy Fox.
::{{A|vo tmcop001 1911904 thoma 05.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' The Sakoku Decree has not been good for business.
::{{A|vo tmcop001 1911904 thoma 06.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' Merchants have faced hostility at every turn. That's why the International Trade Association got together...

;(After "Transient Dreams")
:;(Roam the streets with Thoma)
::{{A|vo tmcop001 1911904 thoma 07.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' I heard the Shogun recently abolished the Sakoku Decree, and trade and commerce is already starting to recover.
::{{A|vo tmcop001 1911904 thoma 08.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' I'm sure it won't be long before Ritou retrieves the prosperity of its past.
::{{A|vo tmcop001 1911904 thoma 09.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' This is also thanks to your hard work. Thanks to you, our nation can finally prosper.
::{{A|vo tmcop001 1911904 kaede 01.ogg}} '''Kaede:''' Hi, Thoma. Out shopping with your friend? Can I get you anything today?
::{{A|vo tmcop001 1911904 thoma 04.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' Why not — I'll take that Toy Fox.
::{{A|vo tmcop001 1911904 thoma 10.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' The Sakoku Decree might have been abolished, but the International Trade Association is still going strong.
::{{A|vo tmcop001 1911904 thoma 11.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' After all, there are still plenty of situations where their help can be quite essential...
----
;(Go to the International Trade Association entrance)
:{{A|vo tmcop001 1911905 thoma 01.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' Here we are. Bet this takes you back, huh?
:{{DIcon}} I wonder how [[Kurisu]]'s doing?
::{{A|vo tmcop001 1911905 thoma 02.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' I'm sure he's getting by. He wrote me not long ago, actually, asking me to deal with a situation for one of the merchants.
:;(Before "Transient Dreams")
:::{{A|vo tmcop001 1911905 thoma 03.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' Kurisu works tirelessly to maintain some sort of order within the business world, despite the entire industry being less than ideal.
:;(After "Transient Dreams")
:::{{A|vo tmcop001 1911905 thoma 24.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' Now that the Sakoku Decree has ended, there's some disagreements within the International Trade Association. He's doing his best to mediate.
::{{A|vo tmcop001 1911905 thoma 04.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' Must be tough for the guy. I hope everything gets back to normal as soon as possible...
:{{DIcon}} We spent quite an eventful time here.
::{{A|vo tmcop001 1911905 thoma 05.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' We sure did. [[Katsuie]], from the [[Kanjou Commission]], was persecuting those poor merchants, until you stepped in, of course.
::{{A|vo tmcop001 1911905 thoma 06.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' A lot of people in Ritou are still very grateful to you for that. They ask me about you sometimes.
::{{A|vo tmcop001 1911905 thoma 07.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' If you're interested, I could set up a meal for all of us if you'd like.
:{{A|vo tmcop001 1911905 keiichi 01.ogg}} '''Keiichi:''' Excuse me — Thoma?
:{{A|vo tmcop001 1911905 keiichi 02.ogg}} '''Keiichi:''' It is you! What a coincidence. I was just about to send someone to deliver a gift to you.
:{{A|vo tmcop001 1911905 thoma 08.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' I don't believe we've met? And if there's a gift involved here, I'm not sure I've earned it! Is there something I can do for you?
:{{A|vo tmcop001 1911905 keiichi 03.ogg}} '''Keiichi:''' No, no, you don't know me, but I've heard of you before.
:{{A|vo tmcop001 1911905 keiichi 04.ogg}} '''Keiichi:''' I ran into some trouble a while back, asked Kurisu for some help, and he said you were the one that resolved the situation.
:{{A|vo tmcop001 1911905 keiichi 05.ogg}} '''Keiichi:''' Kurisu is always telling us that repaying favors is all the more important for us as merchants.
:{{A|vo tmcop001 1911905 keiichi 06.ogg}} '''Keiichi:''' If you're on the receiving end of someone's kindness, you can't let it go unacknowledged. So, I tried to pick out something that I thought you might like...
:{{A|vo tmcop001 1911905 thoma 09.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' Something... you thought I might like?
:{{A|vo tmcop001 1911905 keiichi 07.ogg}} '''Keiichi:''' That's right! So here it is — some confectionery from Yumeno Tennenan, a fine purveyor of Inazuman delicacies. Each one costs a small fortune.
:{{A|vo tmcop001 1911905 keiichi 08.ogg}} '''Keiichi:''' I thought this would be the only fitting way to repay someone of your stature!
:{{A|vo tmcop001 1911905 keiichi 09.ogg}} '''Keiichi:''' Not to mention that the value of your assistance far outweighs the value of my gift.
:{{A|vo tmcop001 1911905 keiichi 10.ogg}} '''Keiichi:''' Do you like it?
:{{A|vo tmcop001 1911905 thoma 10.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' ...
:{{A|vo tmcop001 1911905 thoma 11.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' Haha, I don't know how you did it, but you managed to cater to my tastes perfectly.
:{{A|vo tmcop001 1911905 thoma 12.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' I humbly accept your gift. Keep up the good work in your line of business, and if you have any further problems, feel free to come find me.
:{{A|vo tmcop001 1911905 keiichi 11.ogg}} '''Keiichi:''' I will! Thanks again, Thoma!
:{{A|vo tmcop001 1911905 keiichi 12.ogg}} '''Keiichi:''' I'll leave you in peace now. Have a good day!
:{{A|vo tmcop001 1911905 thoma 13.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' You too, goodbye.
:{{A|vo tmcop001 1911905 thoma 14.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' Pretty high-energy guy, huh.
:{{A|vo tmcop001 1911905 thoma 15.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' You wanna try, {{Traveler}}? This store is indeed renowned in Inazuma. In fact, demand is so high that it's very difficult to come by their products.
:{{A|vo tmcop001 1911905 thoma 16.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' They're all handmade by top chefs, and the flavor is as authentic as it gets.
:{{DIcon}} Tastes pretty good.
::{{A|vo tmcop001 1911905 thoma 17.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' Great, I'm glad you like it.
::{{A|vo tmcop001 1911905 thoma 18.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' I'll see about trying to make my own when I get the chance. They're made to a traditional family recipe though, so replicating them won't be easy.
:{{DIcon}} Your cooking is better.
::{{A|vo tmcop001 1911905 thoma 19.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' Haha... you flatter me.
::{{A|vo tmcop001 1911905 thoma 20.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' The store is at least a few decades old, and the chefs who make these have been at it their whole lives. Not sure my ability is on par with that...
::{{A|vo tmcop001 1911905 thoma 21.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' But if you're happy to be my taste-tester on a regular-enough basis, maybe one day I'll be able to reach their level.
:{{A|vo tmcop001 1911905 thoma 22.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' Okay, that about wraps up our nostalgia trip to the International Trade Association. I think we've just seen about everything there is to see in the city.
:{{A|vo tmcop001 1911905 thoma 23.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' Let's keep heading this way. We don't get to hang out all that often — it'd be a shame to head back so soon.
----
;(Roam the streets with Thoma)
:{{A|vo tmcop001 1911906 thoma 01.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' With the change of seasons, Ritou gives me a different feeling each time I come.
:{{A|vo tmcop001 1911906 thoma 02.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' Hmm... maybe it's not entirely to do with the seasons. Anyway, the main point is, I'm happy to be here with you this time.
----
;(Talk to Thoma)
:{{A|vo tmcop001 1911907 thoma 01.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' I come to this place every time I visit Ritou.
:{{A|vo tmcop001 1911907 thoma 02.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' The view here isn't as spectacular as on [[Narukami Island]], but if you're looking for a relaxing spot, you can't beat this one.
;(Before "Transient Dreams")
::{{A|vo tmcop001 1911907 thoma 03.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' I believe that the Sakoku Decree will be repealed one day, and this place will flourish again like it did in the old days.
::{{A|vo tmcop001 1911907 thoma 04.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' When the winds of freedom finally blow away the gloom... I think I'll have to ask milady for a long vacation, so I can take a trip back home.
;(After "Transient Dreams")
::{{A|vo tmcop001 1911907 thoma 27.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' And I'm sure it'll be bustling with life again soon enough now that the Sakoku Decree's been abolished.
::{{A|vo tmcop001 1911907 thoma 28.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' Once I'm on top of things, I think I'll have to ask milady for a long vacation, so I can take a trip back home. I don't see that happening anytime soon, though... I have a long list of things to get through.
:{{A|vo tmcop001 1911907 thoma 05.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' Alright, time to call it a day. Let's head back.
:{{DIcon}} Hold on.
:{{A|vo tmcop001 1911907 thoma 06.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' Hmm? Not ready to leave yet?
:{{A|vo tmcop001 1911907 thoma 07.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' Come to think of it, I do have a couple more places I could take you...
:{{DIcon}} I have a gift for you, too.
:{{DIcon}} I want to repay your kindness, too.
:{{A|vo tmcop001 1911907 thoma 08.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' Haha, there's no need for that.
:{{A|vo tmcop001 1911907 thoma 09.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' The whole reason I took you out was to thank you for all the help you gave us during the Vision Hunt Decree.
:{{A|vo tmcop001 1911907 thoma 10.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' As long as you enjoyed yourself, that's all I could ask for. You don't have to give me a gift.
:{{DIcon}} But I think you'll like it.
:{{DIcon}} It's nothing expensive.
:{{A|vo tmcop001 1911907 thoma 11.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' Really? Okay, well now I'm excited!
:{{A|vo tmcop001 1911907 thoma 12.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' Oh my... it's...
:{{DIcon}} A [[Windwheel Aster]].
:{{DIcon}} A little something from Mondstadt.
:{{A|vo tmcop001 1911907 thoma 13.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' ...
:{{A|vo tmcop001 1911907 thoma 14.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' This really... I wasn't expecting this.
:{{A|vo tmcop001 1911907 thoma 15.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' I'm a little lost for words... This gift is... invaluable.
:{{DIcon}} It didn't cost anything...
:{{A|vo tmcop001 1911907 thoma 16.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' I know, but I don't mean its material value. I'm talking about its value to me specifically.
:{{A|vo tmcop001 1911907 thoma 17.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' Let me put it this way. The confectionery I received from that merchant earlier — thoughtful gift, don't get me wrong, but at the end of the day, I know it's mostly transactional.
:{{A|vo tmcop001 1911907 thoma 18.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' I helped him out, so it's standard procedure for him to get a gift for me in return. Also, he picked a brand of fancy confectionery that he thought would meet me at my level, and make it easier for him to approach me with any future requests.
:{{A|vo tmcop001 1911907 thoma 19.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' If you lend Mora to someone, you can guarantee that any gift you receive in return will have been chosen according to its material value.
:{{A|vo tmcop001 1911907 thoma 20.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' But the gift you just gave me can't be weighed in the same terms.
:{{DIcon}} I'm just glad you like it.
:{{DIcon}} I don't want anything in return.
:{{A|vo tmcop001 1911907 thoma 21.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' Okay, well... at least take this in return.
:{{A|vo tmcop001 1911907 thoma 22.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' It's an omamori I always carry with me. Again, nothing expensive.
:{{A|vo tmcop001 1911907 thoma 23.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' But it can bring the bearer good luck... seriously, I'm not making that up. My father told me.
:{{A|vo tmcop001 1911907 thoma 24.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' He gave it to my mom, and she gave it to me just before I came to Inazuma.
:{{A|vo tmcop001 1911907 thoma 25.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' Who knows, maybe this omamori was the only reason I survived the storm and made it to Inazuma in the first place.
:{{A|vo tmcop001 1911907 thoma 26.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' Whatever the truth of it is, I'd like you to have it.
;(Obtain {{Item|Lucky Omamori}})
{{Dialogue End}}

:{{A|vo bblcop001 1900905 schulz 02.ogg}} '''Schulz:''' And [[Wagner|Mr. Wagner]]! ...Wait, he wouldn't want one, would he...? Uh — let me ask him, though...
:{{A|vo bblcop001 1900905 herman 02.ogg}} '''Herman:''' Oh! A friend of mine was asking about autographs, Barbara-sama — make that two!
:{{A|vo bblcop001 1900905 barbara 12.ogg}} '''Barbara:''' Ohh my...
:{{DIcon}} They're gonna keep asking for more and more...
:{{A|vo bblcop001 1900905 barbara 13.ogg}} '''Barbara:''' So sorry, please... H—Hold on a moment...
:{{Black Screen|''Barbara appeases her fans while the Traveler waits, and waits...''}}
:{{A|vo bblcop001 1900905 barbara 14.ogg}} '''Barbara:''' Whew... Sorry to keep you waiting so long.
:{{DIcon}} I've waited longer...
:{{A|vo bblcop001 1900905 barbara 15.ogg}} '''Barbara:''' You look like you're about to fall asleep! I feel terrible. It was me who invited you for a drink, and here I am wasting your time...
:{{A|vo bblcop001 1900905 barbara 16.ogg}} '''Barbara:''' Here, it's the Fantastic Summer-Serendipity Coral Sparkling Tea you wanted. I ordered this one especially for you.
:{{A|vo bblcop001 1900905 barbara 17.ogg}} '''Barbara:''' At least Miss Margaret didn't make our drinks in advance. The flavor would've changed completely by now...
:{{DIcon}} You don't look too good...
:{{DIcon}} You look exhausted...
:{{A|vo bblcop001 1900905 barbara 18.ogg}} '''Barbara:''' Hehe, how can I put this... Those relaxing moments of freedom in Wolvendom...? The rush just now kinda ruined that for me.
:{{A|vo bblcop001 1900905 barbara 19.ogg}} '''Barbara:''' But as long as I can bring everybody a smile...
:{{A|vo bblcop001 1900905 barbara 20.ogg}} '''Barbara:''' Although, perhaps you can stay with me a while longer? Let's take a stroll outside the city and finish our drinks.
:{{A|vo bblcop001 1900905 barbara 21.ogg}} '''Barbara:''' We have to seize every bit of free time we get, even if it only lasts a moment.
:;(Continue to [[#Deaconess's Time Off|Deaconess's Time Off]])

===Deaconess's Time Off===
;(While following Barbara)
:{{A|vo bblcop001 1900906 barbara 01.ogg}} '''Barbara:''' It's nice to finally relax for a while — thanks for accompanying me.
:{{A|vo bblcop001 1900906 barbara 02.ogg}} '''Barbara:''' Come to think of it, this is the first time we've gone for a walk together.
:{{A|vo bblcop001 1900906 barbara 03.ogg}} '''Barbara:''' When I heard you'd received the title of Honorary Knight, I thought you'd turn out to be more of a solemn character.
:{{A|vo bblcop001 1900906 barbara 04.ogg}} '''Barbara:''' But now that I've met you, I can't quite believe it. I never thought... O—Oh! I hope I'm not offending you!
:{{A|vo bblcop001 1900906 barbara 05.ogg}} '''Barbara:''' What I mean is, for someone as young as you to achieve the title of Honorary Knight... It's amazing!
:{{A|vo bblcop001 1900906 barbara 06.ogg}} '''Barbara:''' Jean... must really believe in you to grant you this title.
:{{A|vo bblcop001 1900906 barbara 07.ogg}} '''Barbara:''' I hope I can be as great as you one day, so I can help everybody around me too.
:{{A|vo bblcop001 1900906 barbara 08.ogg}} '''Barbara:''' But for now... all I can do is sing.
:{{A|vo bblcop001 1900906 barbara 09.ogg}} '''Barbara:''' ...
:{{A|vo bblcop001 1900906 barbara 10.ogg}} '''Barbara:''' Ah! So sorry, always thinking about myself...
:{{A|vo bblcop001 1900906 barbara 11.ogg}} '''Barbara:''' ...We've walked a long way — why don't we take a break up ahead?
----
:{{A|vo bblcop001 1900906 barbara 12.ogg}} '''Barbara:''' It looks so peaceful here, nobody's passing through except us. Let's rest for a while.
:{{DIcon}} Just now, in the city... why didn't you just tell them you were on leave and walk away?
::{{A|vo bblcop001 1900906 barbara 13.ogg}} '''Barbara:''' There's more than one answer to that question.
::{{A|vo bblcop001 1900906 barbara 14.ogg}} '''Barbara:''' A deaconess shouldn't ever be self-interested or let other people down...
::{{A|vo bblcop001 1900906 barbara 15.ogg}} '''Barbara:''' But at the end of the day, it's like my father said: I just don't know how to turn people away.
::{{A|vo bblcop001 1900906 barbara 16.ogg}} '''Barbara:''' My father and Sister Victoria always told me, if I wanted to become a proper deaconess, I would have to learn how to turn away others.
::{{A|vo bblcop001 1900906 barbara 17.ogg}} '''Barbara:''' But I've never been able to... When I see somebody in need, I lend a hand without a second thought.
::{{A|vo bblcop001 1900906 barbara 18.ogg}} '''Barbara:''' If I see somebody struggling, I want to help them solve the problem. If somebody comes to me with a request, I can't help but do my best.
::{{A|vo bblcop001 1900906 barbara 19.ogg}} '''Barbara:''' No matter how tiring, I'm happy as long as I can bring a smile to everybody.
::{{A|vo bblcop001 1900906 barbara 20.ogg}} '''Barbara:''' *sigh* Perhaps... I'm not a proper deaconess after all.
:{{DIcon}} That sudden crowd back there in the city... you must be exhausted.
::{{A|vo bblcop001 1900906 barbara 21.ogg}} '''Barbara:''' Hehe, I'm so used to it by now, but thanks for wanting to intervene.
::{{A|vo bblcop001 1900906 barbara 22.ogg}} '''Barbara:''' Usually, the Knights of Favonius end up arriving to restore order. Then someone from the Church comes to escort me away.
::{{A|vo bblcop001 1900906 barbara 23.ogg}} '''Barbara:''' It's happened so many times already, I don't really notice it anymore.
::{{DIcon}} Isn't it a little exhausting?
::{{A|vo bblcop001 1900906 barbara 24.ogg}} '''Barbara:''' Of course! More than a little, to say the least...
::{{A|vo bblcop001 1900906 barbara 25.ogg}} '''Barbara:''' But exhaustion for the sake of not letting everybody down is okay.
:{{DIcon}} What's the Barbara Fan Club?
:;(This dialogue option is locked behind the specific dialogue choices you made up to now, see the section below on how to unlock this)
::{{A|vo bblcop001 1900906 barbara 26.ogg}} '''Barbara:''' Heh, that thing? Uhh... It's a group of my Mondstadt... supporters.
::{{A|vo bblcop001 1900906 barbara 27.ogg}} '''Barbara:''' But I'm usually in the Cathedral. The knights and sisters stationed outside the Church won't let them in.
::{{A|vo bblcop001 1900906 barbara 28.ogg}} '''Barbara:''' So they support me in other ways — cleaning the Cathedral, helping their fellow citizens with difficult matters, stuff like that.
::{{A|vo bblcop001 1900906 barbara 29.ogg}} '''Barbara:''' It's... very considerate, though sometimes they get carried away.
::{{DIcon}} And how many members does the group have?
::{{A|vo bblcop001 1900906 barbara 30.ogg}} '''Barbara:''' Uh, I'm not really sure... but of the ones I know, there's Mr. Albert and Mr. Huffman.
::{{DIcon}} Ah yes, the knight...
::{{A|vo bblcop001 1900906 barbara 31.ogg}} '''Barbara:''' Oh, do you know Mr. Huffman? He's a very strict knight, not to mention disciplined.
::{{A|vo bblcop001 1900906 barbara 32.ogg}} '''Barbara:''' He's never asked for my autograph or tried to make conversation. Every time he comes to the Cathedral on official business, his face is a picture of seriousness.
::{{A|vo bblcop001 1900906 barbara 33.ogg}} '''Barbara:''' I'd never have known if I hadn't overheard Mr. Albert talking about it.
::{{A|vo bblcop001 1900906 barbara 34.ogg}} '''Barbara:''' When I found out, I had someone deliver my autograph to him. I hope he was happy with it.
:{{DIcon}} I get the feeling you're more popular than the average sister...
::{{A|vo bblcop001 1900906 barbara 35.ogg}} '''Barbara:''' Yeah, it's a little embarrassing... Do you know what an "idol" is?
::{{A|vo bblcop001 1900906 barbara 36.ogg}} '''Barbara:''' I guess you've heard that I... sometimes sing for the people in Mondstadt?
::{{A|vo bblcop001 1900906 barbara 37.ogg}} '''Barbara:''' I can use the power of my Vision to heal physical wounds, but it's no use on someone afflicted by sadness.
::{{A|vo bblcop001 1900906 barbara 38.ogg}} '''Barbara:''' I found out in a magazine that there was such a thing as an "idol."
::{{A|vo bblcop001 1900906 barbara 39.ogg}} '''Barbara:''' In the magazine, it said that an idol was... a person that spreads love and hope through song and dance.
::{{A|vo bblcop001 1900906 barbara 40.ogg}} '''Barbara:''' I don't know if it's really possible, but... at least the residents of Mondstadt seem to like my singing.
::{{DIcon}} There was once an idol who stopped a war with their singing.
::{{A|vo bblcop001 1900906 barbara 41.ogg}} '''Barbara:''' R—Really? That's so impressive...
::{{A|vo bblcop001 1900906 barbara 42.ogg}} '''Barbara:''' Do you know that idol? They sound like a mighty Vision bearer.
::{{A|vo bblcop001 1900906 barbara 43.ogg}} '''Barbara:''' Still, using song and dance to heal the sick of heart... It's easier said than done.
::{{A|vo bblcop001 1900906 barbara 44.ogg}} '''Barbara:''' I don't know if I'm up to it. I'm not even very good at being a deaconess...
::{{DIcon}} Why, sure you are.
::{{DIcon}} You're already a very gifted healer.
::{{A|vo bblcop001 1900906 barbara 45.ogg}} '''Barbara:''' Aw, if that really is true... then that's amazing.
:{{A|vo bblcop001 1900906 barbara 46.ogg}} '''Barbara:''' ...Thank you. It's been a long time since I've had such a long conversation, and it's all me complaining! Thanks for listening.
:{{A|vo bblcop001 1900906 barbara 47.ogg}} '''Barbara:''' The support of an Honorary Knight goes a long way!
:{{A|vo bblcop001 1900906 barbara 48.ogg}} '''Barbara:''' *sigh* So... we've still not finished our drinks! Let's finish them off while we're here.
:{{A|vo bblcop001 1900906 barbara 49.ogg}} '''Barbara:''' We can rest today, but it's back to the grindstone tomorrow.
