{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Approach Taj's house)
:{{A|vo cnlq003 16 nabil 01.ogg}} '''Nabil:''' So this is Taj's place... Hmm, there doesn't seem to be anyone here.
:{{A|vo cnlq003 16 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Well, what should we do then? Do we break in?
:{{A|vo cnlq003 16 nabil 02.ogg}} '''Nabil:''' No, no... Wait, the door is unlocked! Did Taj leave in a hurry?
:{{A|vo cnlq003 16 nabil 03.ogg}} '''Nabil:''' Well anyway, we're still not sure if he's the real culprit. Probably not a good idea to go in without permission...
:{{DIcon}} There's no other option, though.
:{{DIcon}} We have to do this in order to clear his name.
:{{A|vo cnlq003 16 nabil 04.ogg}} '''Nabil:''' *sigh* You're right. Even if we apply for a warrant now, we won't be able to do anything until tomorrow at the earliest. This is an emergency. I just hope Taj doesn't mind.
:{{Black Screen|You enter Taj's home and search around...}}
:{{A|vo cnlq003 16 nabil 05.ogg}} '''Nabil:''' What's this...?
:{{A|vo cnlq003 16 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' It's a paper full of names written on it. Oh, and a map... Nabil, can you make any sense of this?
:{{A|vo cnlq003 16 nabil 06.ogg}} '''Nabil:''' Hmm, yes, this is definitely Taj's handwriting. These papers look like records...
:{{A|vo cnlq003 16 nabil 07.ogg}} '''Nabil:''' These are transactions between Taj and some other people. From the look of the numbers, the scale of this smuggling case is absolutely massive.
:{{A|vo cnlq003 16 nabil 08.ogg}} '''Nabil:''' The whole operation involves more than 300 people, including dozens of celebrities! These are famous scholars, merchants, mercenaries...
:{{A|vo cnlq003 16 nabil 09.ogg}} '''Nabil:''' I have a feeling that Cyno might be unaware of what he's up against. There's no way anyone could face such a large organization on their own!
:{{DIcon}} Maybe he is aware of that.
:{{DIcon}} Even so, he won't back down.
:{{A|vo cnlq003 16 nabil 10.ogg}} '''Nabil:''' You're right, that's just who he is.
:{{A|vo cnlq003 16 nabil 11.ogg}} '''Nabil:''' As for the map, it appears to indicate the location of the Court of Desolation. Let's take it to Cyno and let him decide how to proceed.
:;(Opens [[Ancient Map]])
:{{A|vo cnlq003 16 nabil 12.ogg}} '''Nabil:''' If Taj really has turned on his honor and committed these terrible acts... then I suspect that he might already be at the Court of Desolation as we speak.
:{{A|vo cnlq003 16 nabil 13.ogg}} '''Nabil:''' I don't wanna suspect him, but I also don't know him very well. Maybe Cyno will know what to do.
:{{A|vo cnlq003 16 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Alright, we'll give these to Cyno and see! Let's go!
:;(Obtain {{Item|Ancient Map}})

;(Talk to Nabil again, optional)
:{{A|vo cnlq003 16 nabil 13.ogg}} '''Nabil:''' I don't wanna suspect him, but I also don't know him very well. Maybe Cyno will know what to do.
{{Dialogue End}}
{{Quest Description|update|Clues to the Court of Desolation and a suspicious list were found from Taj's home. Although you don't know why Taj keeps such important information at home, you decide to go back and meet Cyno first.}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Talk to Cyno)
:{{Black Screen|You tell Cyno everything that's happened.}}
:{{A|vo cnlq003 17 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Well, Cyno, what do you make of it?
:{{A|vo cnlq003 17 cyno 01.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Hmm, Taj... It's been a while since I last saw him.
:{{A|vo cnlq003 17 cyno 02.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' From what I remember, he is a straitlaced man. Although he would resort to extreme measures from time to time, he would never do anything against his beliefs.
:{{A|vo cnlq003 17 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So do you think he's the one behind all this?
:{{A|vo cnlq003 17 cyno 03.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' I'm still not sure.
:{{A|vo cnlq003 17 cyno 04.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' I cannot imagine how devastating the incident with Murtada was for him, nor can I deny the possibility that people can change.
:{{A|vo cnlq003 17 cyno 05.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Whether it's out of love for his son or for other reasons, we have to see for ourselves to judge him, or rather, the person he's become.
:{{DIcon}} The evidence is stacked against him now.
:{{A|vo cnlq003 17 cyno 06.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' That's right. It's clear that he had a hand in this case, yet he made no report of it. There's no doubting that.
:{{A|vo cnlq003 17 cyno 07.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' That's also why I need to see him. I must ask his reasoning and judge him myself.
:{{A|vo cnlq003 17 cyno 08.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Time is ticking. Let's go.
{{Dialogue End}}
{{Quest Description|update|Cyno decides to go to the Court of Desolation and ask Taj to get it straight.}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Enter the [[Court of Desolation|domain]])
:{{A|vo cnlq003 18 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So this is the Court of Desolation. Are there really any treasures buried here?
:{{A|vo cnlq003 18 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ooh, Paimon's kinda nervous... Could it be dangerous?
:{{A|vo cnlq003 18 cyno 01.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Don't worry, you'll be safe with me.

;(Pass through the door after defeating the Primal Construct)
:{{A|vo cnlq003 19 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Look, these walls have definitely seen better days... Was there some sort of battle here?
:{{A|vo cnlq003 19 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Let's keep going and see what we can find.

;(Activate the switch)
:{{A|vo cnlq003 20 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Whoa... Is it just Paimon, or did that passageway just rotate?
:{{A|vo cnlq003 20 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' It's not gonna start moving again, is it? Uh, either way, we should be careful!

;(Activate the floor mounted switch)
:{{A|vo cnlq003 21 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' A passage! Hopefully that's our way in!

;(Approach the next switch)
:{{A|vo cnlq003 22 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Uh, that eye seems to be staring right at us!
:{{A|vo cnlq003 22 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Waah, this place gives Paimon the creeps. You go first...

;(Approach Taj)
:{{A|vo cnlq003 23 cyno 01.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Taj...
:{{A|vo cnlq003 23 tajradkani 01.ogg}} '''Taj Radkani:''' Ah, Cyno, it's been some time since I've seen you last. I trust you are doing well?
:{{A|vo cnlq003 23 tajradkani 02.ogg}} '''Taj Radkani:''' Seeing that you've made it all the way here, you must be on the cusp of wrapping up your investigation, I presume? Hmm, even faster than I expected. Is it because you have some new partners now?
:{{A|vo cnlq003 23 cyno 02.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' That's right, this case is nearly closed, but the most important answer still eludes me.
:{{A|vo cnlq003 23 cyno 03.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Was it all your doing? Smuggling the Canned Knowledge, the research of the Court of Desolation...
:{{A|vo cnlq003 23 tajradkani 03.ogg}} '''Taj Radkani:''' Yes, it was me.
:{{A|vo cnlq003 23 cyno 04.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Then explain why.
:{{A|vo cnlq003 23 tajradkani 04.ogg}} '''Taj Radkani:''' That's the difficult part. Let's just say I've changed... I've become a selfish coward who only wants to pursue his own interests.
:{{A|vo cnlq003 23 cyno 05.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' I find that hard to believe.
:{{A|vo cnlq003 23 tajradkani 05.ogg}} '''Taj Radkani:''' Oh, really? The way I see it, every person will end up like me sooner or later.
:{{A|vo cnlq003 23 tajradkani 06.ogg}} '''Taj Radkani:''' When you're young, you press forward, unattached, living solely for the justice in your heart. But as you begin to age, you start to become more cautious. You know many things are wrong, but still turn a blind eye to them.
:{{A|vo cnlq003 23 tajradkani 07.ogg}} '''Taj Radkani:''' I was the same. I never questioned my actions until Murtada died. I could feel the justice that I once strived to uphold slowly crumbling in my heart.
:{{A|vo cnlq003 23 tajradkani 08.ogg}} '''Taj Radkani:''' I was completely dedicated to all that I did, but as I grew older, I found myself feeling alone... miserable. Can you imagine what it feels like to not have the will to live, but not be able to die?
:{{A|vo cnlq003 23 cyno 06.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' ...
:{{A|vo cnlq003 23 tajradkani 09.ogg}} '''Taj Radkani:''' Murtada was sent to prison by my own hands, I set myself on this painful path. My son hated me till the day he died, and now I must live with that pain and regret.
:{{A|vo cnlq003 23 tajradkani 10.ogg}} '''Taj Radkani:''' I failed him as a father, but now... Now, I have a chance to make it right, a chance to reunite with him...
:{{A|vo cnlq003 23 tajradkani 11.ogg}} '''Taj Radkani:''' The Court of Desolation! Here lies the key to overcoming life and death — the power to even bring the dead back to life!
:{{A|vo cnlq003 23 cyno 07.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' So, did you already find what you needed here?
:{{A|vo cnlq003 23 tajradkani 12.ogg}} '''Taj Radkani:''' Hehe... See this door behind me? Behind it lie the treasures that I seek.
:{{A|vo cnlq003 23 tajradkani 13.ogg}} '''Taj Radkani:''' I'm so close, Cyno. If only you hadn't arrived now, I could already have...
:{{A|vo cnlq003 23 cyno 08.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Enough conjecture. What has happened is already part of the past. You cannot bring the dead back to life.
:{{A|vo cnlq003 23 cyno 09.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' In the end, the treasures you seek are nothing but myths and legend.
:{{A|vo cnlq003 23 tajradkani 14.ogg}} '''Taj Radkani:''' Since you're so sure, why don't you just let me open the door and see then?
:{{A|vo cnlq003 23 cyno 10.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' No. I sense danger behind that door. There will be dire consequences the moment you open it.
:{{A|vo cnlq003 23 tajradkani 15.ogg}} '''Taj Radkani:''' I beg you: As an old partner, can you let me fulfill my last wish? Just this once?
:{{A|vo cnlq003 23 tajradkani 16.ogg}} '''Taj Radkani:''' Surely you get it by now. Doing your job without mercy will only drive people away from you. I'm the prime example.
:{{A|vo cnlq003 23 cyno 11.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' I don't overthink things. If there is only one way for me to defend my principles, then that is the path I will take.
:{{A|vo cnlq003 23 tajradkani 17.ogg}} '''Taj Radkani:''' Seems there's no convincing you... Alright then, let's see if your polearm skills have improved at all.

;(After defeating Taj)
:{{A|vo cnlq003 24 cyno 01.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Your strength...
:{{A|vo cnlq003 24 tajradkani 01.ogg}} '''Taj Radkani:''' You feel it, don't you? I'm stronger than you remember. I gained new power when I entered the Court of Desolation.
:{{A|vo cnlq003 24 tajradkani 02.ogg}} '''Taj Radkani:''' This is only a taste of it. Once I open the door behind me, this power will be complete. Even life and death will have no grip on me!
:{{A|vo cnlq003 24 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Uh oh, we have to stop this guy!
:{{A|vo cnlq003 24 cyno 02.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' I won't let you open that door.
:{{A|vo cnlq003 24 tajradkani 03.ogg}} '''Taj Radkani:''' I wouldn't be so sure. I'm afraid it won't be too easy to stop me now that you're injured. Or are you ready to sacrifice your life for this?
:{{A|vo cnlq003 24 cyno 03.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' I'll do what I have to.
:{{A|vo cnlq003 24 tajradkani 04.ogg}} '''Taj Radkani:''' ...
:{{A|vo cnlq003 24 tajradkani 05.ogg}} '''Taj Radkani:''' I still remember when we first became partners. You were always charging forward and putting your life on the line, just like now.
:{{A|vo cnlq003 24 tajradkani 06.ogg}} '''Taj Radkani:''' Even after all this time, you still haven't changed.
:{{A|vo cnlq003 24 cyno 04.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' You haven't changed either. You left that list of names and map in your house on purpose, didn't you? You wanted me to be able to find you here.
:{{A|vo cnlq003 24 cyno 05.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' All of this was just part of the act you were putting on. What happened just now was also part of your plan... You might have fooled those on the list, but you will not fool me.
:{{A|vo cnlq003 24 cyno 06.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' I had my suspicions from the beginning, but I couldn't be sure until we fought. If you really had changed, your fighting style wouldn't be as it was before.
:{{A|vo cnlq003 24 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh? What do you mean, Cyno?
:{{A|vo cnlq003 24 cyno 07.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' He never planned on opening the door. His true intention was...
:{{A|vo cnlq003 24 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ahh! What's happening?
:{{A|vo cnlq003 24 tajradkani 07.ogg}} '''Taj Radkani:''' Seems our time is running short. Let me make this quick then.
:{{A|vo cnlq003 24 tajradkani 08.ogg}} '''Taj Radkani:''' After Murtada died, my spirit was crushed. For a long time, I was hoping this reality was just some terrible nightmare. I hoped that I would just wake up and be able to see his smiling face again.
:{{A|vo cnlq003 24 tajradkani 09.ogg}} '''Taj Radkani:''' That is when I was approached by someone who wished to collaborate and find the Court of Desolation together. I did some investigation of my own and discovered that they were part of a massive organization.
:{{A|vo cnlq003 24 tajradkani 10.ogg}} '''Taj Radkani:''' People from every walk of life are involved. They are relentless in their search, pouring countless Mora into secret research, even sacrificing lives in hopes that the Court of Desolation would appear.
:{{A|vo cnlq003 24 cyno 08.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' No wonder banning the research wasn't enough. A full-scale operation was already in motion.
:{{A|vo cnlq003 24 tajradkani 11.ogg}} '''Taj Radkani:''' I'm a flesh-and-blood human like anyone else, so I obviously hesitated and considered it... The thought of bringing my son back tugged at my heart. But in the end, I came to my senses. I knew that I could not let myself go down that path.
:{{A|vo cnlq003 24 tajradkani 12.ogg}} '''Taj Radkani:''' I suddenly came to a realization amidst my suffering... The Court of Desolation, a place that once drove people to tragedy, was still doing so even centuries later.
:{{A|vo cnlq003 24 tajradkani 13.ogg}} '''Taj Radkani:''' As long as this place exists, people will recklessly seek it out just as Murtada did, generation after generation, regardless of the cost...
:{{A|vo cnlq003 24 tajradkani 14.ogg}} '''Taj Radkani:''' Let it be buried beneath the sand forever. Once the Court of Desolation is gone, there will no longer be anyone obsessed with seeking it out.
:{{DIcon}} The damage on the walls we saw on our way here...
:{{DIcon}} You're going to destroy the Court of Desolation.
:{{A|vo cnlq003 24 tajradkani 15.ogg}} '''Taj Radkani:''' That's right. I acted as if I had abandoned my convictions just so that they would cooperate without raising any suspicion. This was the only way I could find and destroy this place.
:{{A|vo cnlq003 24 tajradkani 16.ogg}} '''Taj Radkani:''' But that wasn't enough. I needed someone I could trust to bring the organization to justice. The Akademiya forbids the {{sic|researches<!--audio: "research"-->}} of the Court of Desolation, so they would never approve of my plan in the first place.
:{{A|vo cnlq003 24 tajradkani 17.ogg}} '''Taj Radkani:''' To add to the problem, the organization is so powerful that they even have members working within the Akademiya. If I wished to destroy the organization, I couldn't just count on the Akademiya alone.
:{{A|vo cnlq003 24 cyno 09.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' So you pretended to be the one behind all this as a test for me?
:{{A|vo cnlq003 24 tajradkani 18.ogg}} '''Taj Radkani:''' Yes, I'm sorry, but now I am assured. You haven't changed at all. You are still as you always were, fearless and making no compromise.
:{{A|vo cnlq003 24 tajradkani 19.ogg}} '''Taj Radkani:''' Anyway, this place is collapsing. You must leave now.
:{{A|vo cnlq003 24 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wait, aren't you leaving, too? There are still loads of bad guys to catch outside!
:{{A|vo cnlq003 24 cyno 10.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' His fate is already sealed. There is no life left inside him. He is like a candle with no more wick to burn.
:{{DIcon}} He means...
:{{DIcon}} "To open the Court of Desolation, one must sacrifice their life"...
:{{A|vo cnlq003 24 cyno 11.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' You planned it all from the very beginning, didn't you?
:{{A|vo cnlq003 24 cyno 12.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Risking being treated as a traitor to collaborate with them, sacrificing your own life to open and destroy the Court of Desolation...
:{{A|vo cnlq003 24 tajradkani 20.ogg}} '''Taj Radkani:''' Regardless, I made a grave mistake by allowing the smuggling and the research of this place. Let this be the final judgment on myself.
:{{A|vo cnlq003 24 tajradkani 21.ogg}} '''Taj Radkani:''' I was always so busy with work that I never made time to fulfill Murtada's wishes.
:{{A|vo cnlq003 24 tajradkani 22.ogg}} '''Taj Radkani:''' Finding this place was his biggest wish. Since I'll be reuniting with him here... I can only hope he won't have anything more to hold against me.
:{{A|vo cnlq003 24 tajradkani 23.ogg}} '''Taj Radkani:''' I'll leave all those people on the list to you. Sorry for all the trouble I've caused.
:{{A|vo cnlq003 24 cyno 13.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' There's nothing to be sorry for. We are partners.
:{{A|vo cnlq003 24 cyno 14.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' If you see Murtada... send him my greetings. Goodbye, old friend.
;(A cinematic plays)
{{Cutscene Description|Quicksand keeps pouring in. The Court of Desolation is about to be engulfed by the desert. In the last moments of his life, Taj is caught up in memories of his son... Because of him, Murtada had been carefully scrutinized ever since he was a child; When the boy was young, they had the worst relationship possible; And when he went to arrest Murtada, his son begged him to make an exception...<br>On the other end, you and Cyno are running desperately for "life," whereas behind you, the elderly Matra Taj Radkani, who is ready to face "death," utters his last words:<br>Because... We are Matra.}}
:;(The entire Court of Desolation begins to shake and fall apart)
:;(Taj moves to sit on the ground, while the Traveler, Paimon, and Cyno frantically looks around)

::'''Murtada Radkani (child, voice only):''' Dad
::'''Murtada Radkani (child, voice only):''' Why are they so strict with me?
::'''Murtada Radkani (child, voice only):''' I'm always the only one
::'''Murtada Radkani (child, voice only):''' Who gets in trouble...
:;(The Court of Desolation continues to collapse. Taj watches calmly as sand pours in from every opening to fill the halls)
::'''Murtada Radkani (young man, voice only):''' Just leave me alone!
::'''Murtada Radkani (young man, voice only):''' Don't worry
::'''Murtada Radkani (young man, voice only):''' I won't damage your precious reputation!
:;(Sand starts engulfing Taj as well, as he continues to reminisce)
::'''Murtada Radkani (adult, voice only):''' Alright, Dad
::'''Murtada Radkani (adult, voice only):''' Let's start over
:;(The Traveler, Paimon, and Cyno keep running for their lives, while sand rushes close behind them in an earthen wave)
::'''Murtada Radkani (adult, voice only):''' By the way, I've finally found an area of research I wish to pursue
:;(Seeing the Traveler falling a little behind him, Cyno grabs the Traveler's wrist while running and rushes forward, with Paimon flying close behind)
::'''Murtada Radkani (adult, voice only):''' Why can't you show even a little leniency?
:;(Cyno suddenly notices the outer entrance ahead with the light outside entering from above, then leaps over the growing mounds of sand with the Traveler, while Paimon maneuvers her flight in a zig-zag right behind them)
::'''Murtada Radkani (adult, voice only):''' Why...?
:;(Taj, now engulfed in sand up to his torso and still quickly being buried, looks at the ceiling and utters his last words as he bows his head and closes his eyes)
::'''Taj Radkani:''' Because...
::'''Taj Radkani:''' We are Matra
:;(Sand pours in, completely burying Taj and the rest of the Court of Desolation)
:;(Cinematic ends)
:{{A|vo cnlq003 25 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh? The Court of Desolation has...
:{{DIcon}} Disappeared.
:{{A|vo cnlq003 25 cyno 01.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Just as Taj said, that place had caused too many disasters and tragedies.
:{{A|vo cnlq003 25 cyno 02.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Being buried in quicksand is its rightful end.
:{{DIcon}} What about the organization...?
:{{A|vo cnlq003 25 cyno 03.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' To them, as long as there's Mora to be made, they will disregard the Akademiya's rules, whether it's the Court of Desolation or anything else.
:{{A|vo cnlq003 25 cyno 04.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Their only goal is to make massive profits off of dangerous research. Taj may have set them back with the Court of Desolation, but it won't be long before they continue searching for another target.
:{{A|vo cnlq003 25 cyno 05.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' That's an opportunity that I will not let them have.
:{{A|vo cnlq003 25 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' We'll help, too!
:{{A|vo cnlq003 25 cyno 06.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Thank you, but you've already done enough.
:{{A|vo cnlq003 25 cyno 07.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Just leave the rest to me. I will bring them to justice myself. Besides, I promised you that I would sweep away any potential danger.
:{{A|vo cnlq003 25 cyno 08.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' So that's what I'm going to do. Wait for me at Caravan Ribat four days from now.
{{Dialogue End}}
{{Quest Description|update|Taj was destroyed together with the Court of Desolation and fulfilled his final wish. Cyno took the list he left behind and decided to complete the arrest alone. You agreed to meet at Caravan Ribat in four days.}}
{{Quest Description|update|It's about time. Go to Caravan Ribat and have a look.}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Approach the marked location at Caravan Ribat)
;(If the player has not completed ''[[Where the Boat of Consciousness Lies]]'')
::{{A|vo cnlq003 26 nabil 01.ogg}} '''Nabil:''' We meet again! Thank you so much for all your help!
::{{A|vo cnlq003 26 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Nabil, what are you doing here?
::{{A|vo cnlq003 26 nabil 02.ogg}} '''Nabil:''' Convicts from the desert are being escorted through Caravan Ribat, so I'm here to keep an eye on things. This should be the last group of them, so I'll be heading back to the Akademiya once they're cleared.
::{{DIcon}} What's the situation?
::{{DIcon}} What's happened these last few days?
::{{A|vo cnlq003 26 nabil 03.ogg}} '''Nabil:''' The last few days have been quite the ride, but fortunately, I can say with confidence that this case is finally coming to an end.
::{{A|vo cnlq003 26 nabil 04.ogg}} '''Nabil:''' At first, the mercenary groups on the list were putting up quite a fight. They made several desperate attempts to cover up the truth. However, word is that someone crossed the desert and took out their main camp overnight.
::{{A|vo cnlq003 26 nabil 05.ogg}} '''Nabil:''' After that, people on the list started to put pressure on the higher ups within the Akademiya. Everyone was on edge and the case came to a standstill.
::{{A|vo cnlq003 26 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' And? Then what happened?
::{{A|vo cnlq003 26 nabil 06.ogg}} '''Nabil:''' Well, then we received word that Taj Radkani had sacrificed himself on the case. The news really stirred up the members of our ranks.
::{{A|vo cnlq003 26 nabil 07.ogg}} '''Nabil:''' The matra then moved together against the enemy. We cleared out the traitors from within the Akademiya and arrested all the researchers on the list.
::{{A|vo cnlq003 26 nabil 08.ogg}} '''Nabil:''' Some of them managed to get out of the Akademiya, but still failed to escape. The scattered criminals were captured all across Sumeru by the mysterious person who had defeated the mercenary groups.
::{{A|vo cnlq003 26 nabil 09.ogg}} '''Nabil:''' I even heard that someone was about to escape to Fontaine but was still apprehended just at the border. Having more than 300 prisoners apprehended for interrogation has definitely shaken things up recently.
::{{A|vo cnlq003 26 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So that's the end of it! Catching everyone on the list means no more smuggling Canned Knowledge and no more victims!
::{{A|vo cnlq003 26 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' It was a lot of work, but Paimon thinks we accomplished something big!
::{{A|vo cnlq003 26 nabil 10.ogg}} '''Nabil:''' That's right. Thanks again for your assistance.
::{{A|vo cnlq003 26 nabil 11.ogg}} '''Nabil:''' As for the mysterious person who hit the mercenary camp... that must be Cyno, right? He's the only one I can think of who could accomplish such a feat.
::{{A|vo cnlq003 26 nabil 12.ogg}} '''Nabil:''' Speaking of which, have you been in touch with Cyno these days? I think I just saw him when I was on watch nearby.
::{{A|vo cnlq003 26 nabil 13.ogg}} '''Nabil:''' He was walking with someone I didn't recognize, and then before I knew it, they were nowhere to be seen. If you happen to see him, please send my regards.
::{{A|vo cnlq003 26 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Sure thing, Nabil! You be careful too. Don't let any of those bad guys escape!
::{{A|vo cnlq003 26 nabil 14.ogg}} '''Nabil:''' Don't worry about me. If anything happens, you can find me at the Akademiya anytime! Farewell then.
;(If the player has completed ''Where the Boat of Consciousness Lies'')
::{{A|vo cnlq003 27 nabil 01.ogg}} '''Nabil:''' We meet again! Thank you so much for all your help!
::{{A|vo cnlq003 27 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Nabil, what are you doing here?
::{{A|vo cnlq003 27 nabil 02.ogg}} '''Nabil:''' Convicts from the desert are being escorted through Caravan Ribat, so I'm here to keep an eye on things. This should be the last group of them, so I'll be heading back to the Akademiya once they're cleared.
::{{DIcon}} What's the situation?
::{{DIcon}} What's happened these last few days?
::{{A|vo cnlq003 27 nabil 03.ogg}} '''Nabil:''' The last few days have been quite the ride, but fortunately, I can say with confidence that this case is finally coming to an end.
::{{A|vo cnlq003 27 nabil 04.ogg}} '''Nabil:''' At first, the mercenary groups on the list were putting up quite a fight. They made several desperate attempts to cover up the truth. However, Cyno crossed the desert and took out their main camp overnight.
::{{A|vo cnlq003 27 nabil 05.ogg}} '''Nabil:''' After that, people on the list started to put pressure on the higher ups within the Akademiya. Everyone was on edge and the case came to a standstill.
::{{A|vo cnlq003 27 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' And? Then what happened?
::{{A|vo cnlq003 27 nabil 06.ogg}} '''Nabil:''' Well, then we received word that Taj Radkani had sacrificed himself on the case. The news really stirred up the members of our ranks.
::{{A|vo cnlq003 27 nabil 07.ogg}} '''Nabil:''' The matra then moved together against the enemy. We cleared out the traitors from within the Akademiya and arrested all the researchers on the list.
::{{A|vo cnlq003 27 nabil 08.ogg}} '''Nabil:''' Some of them managed to get out of the Akademiya, but still failed to escape. The scattered criminals were captured by Cyno all across Sumeru.
::{{A|vo cnlq003 26 nabil 09.ogg}} '''Nabil:''' I even heard that someone was about to escape to Fontaine but was still apprehended just at the border. Having more than 300 prisoners apprehended for interrogation has definitely shaken things up recently.
::{{A|vo cnlq003 27 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Is Cyno alright? He didn't get injured, did he?
::{{A|vo cnlq003 27 nabil 10.ogg}} '''Nabil:''' He seems fine, but nobody knows the real situation.
::{{A|vo cnlq003 27 nabil 11.ogg}} '''Nabil:''' He brought over 300 suspects to judgment all on his own. Among them were even some of our former colleagues... Not just the criminals are afraid of him — even we start feeling a little nervous when he's around now.
::{{A|vo cnlq003 27 nabil 12.ogg}} '''Nabil:''' But even if we start feeling all self-conscious thinking if we've done anything wrong... We're still always honored to have Cyno around.
::{{A|vo cnlq003 27 nabil 13.ogg}} '''Nabil:''' By the way, are you guys here to see Cyno? I think I just saw him walking in that direction when I was on watch nearby.
::{{A|vo cnlq003 27 nabil 14.ogg}} '''Nabil:''' He was walking with someone I didn't recognize, and then before I knew it, they were nowhere to be seen. If you happen to see him, please send my regards.
::{{A|vo cnlq003 27 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Sure thing, Nabil! You be careful too. Don't let any of those bad guys escape!
::{{A|vo cnlq003 27 nabil 15.ogg}} '''Nabil:''' Don't worry about me. If anything happens, you can find me at the Akademiya anytime! Farewell then.
{{Dialogue End}}
{{Quest Description|update|You have learned from Nabil what happened in the last four days. Now go and see Cyno.}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Approach Cyno and Tighnari)
:{{A|vo cnlq003 28 tighnari 01.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Trying to single-handedly bring 300 people to justice must feel pretty exhilarating. But I can assure you this is certainly not the best solution.
:{{A|vo cnlq003 28 cyno 01.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' I'm aware.
:{{A|vo cnlq003 28 cyno 02.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' However, I learned something unexpected during interrogation... Apparently, someone had enticed Murtada Radkani into becoming interested in researching the Court of Desolation.
:{{A|vo cnlq003 28 cyno 03.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Murtada had lived in his father's shadow all his life. Naturally, he wanted to conduct research that would seem ground-breaking and significant.
:{{A|vo cnlq003 28 cyno 04.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' After Murtada died, the organization tried to use Taj's shame regarding his son to add him to their ranks.
:{{A|vo cnlq003 28 cyno 05.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Toying with others' minds, treating lives like dirt, and doing anything for their own interests... This makes me angry.
:{{A|vo cnlq003 28 tighnari 02.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Fine, I understand. This is a type of trap I've been working on which uses plants. Here, take some just in case you need them next time.
:{{A|vo cnlq003 28 tighnari 03.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' If thrown into the mud, the trap will grow rapidly and disperse a pollen that has a paralyzing effect. I don't have much use for the traps these days, but maybe you will, and can help me collect more testing data.
:{{A|vo cnlq003 28 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Cyno, Tighnari!
:{{A|vo cnlq003 28 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, so Tighnari must be who Nabil saw earlier! Are you also here to see Cyno?
:{{A|vo cnlq003 28 tighnari 04.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' That's right. Cyno asked me to collect some medicinal herbs to treat a girl named Simin.
:{{A|vo cnlq003 28 tighnari 05.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' I also dropped by just to check for any injuries. He seems to be fine physically, but he looks a little more lonely than I remember.
:{{A|vo cnlq003 28 tighnari 06.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' And Cyno, relax! You don't always have to look so serious, you know. Why don't you play more [[Genius Invokation TCG]], huh? Collei has always been a little wary of you, and your stern expression certainly isn't helping.
:{{A|vo cnlq003 28 cyno 06.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' How is Collei these days?
:{{A|vo cnlq003 28 tighnari 07.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' She has grown a bit taller, but her grades could use some improvement. She still made many mistakes on her last test, even after I had marked all the important content in the book for her.
;(If the player has not completed ''[[Where the Boat of Consciousness Lies]]'')
::{{A|vo cnlq003 28 tighnari 08.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Her condition seems to be improving lately, so I plan on having her go outside more. It just so happens that I have something she can help me with...
;(If the player has completed ''Where the Boat of Consciousness Lies'')
::{{A|vo cnlq003 28 tighnari 09.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' After some time, I plan on having her go outside more. It just so happens that I have something she can help me with...
:{{A|vo cnlq003 28 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh? You mean Collei is leaving Avidya Forest? What happened?
:{{A|vo cnlq003 28 tighnari 10.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' I've asked her to host some ad hoc lectures to teach the dangers of Canned Knowledge, as well as how to use it safely.
:{{A|vo cnlq003 28 tighnari 11.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Although we've apprehended all the criminals behind the recent smuggling case, there are many people who are still curious and seek Canned Knowledge.
:{{A|vo cnlq003 28 tighnari 12.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' So I decided to ask her to work on increasing knowledge and awareness on the topic. Please be sure to keep an eye on her.
:{{A|vo cnlq003 28 cyno 07.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' I will.
:{{A|vo cnlq003 28 tighnari 13.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' If anything else happens, the three of you can find me in the Avidya Forest. Take care.
:;(Tighnari leaves)
:{{A|vo cnlq003 28 cyno 08.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' I've already caught those who were preparing to attack you in secret.
:{{A|vo cnlq003 28 cyno 09.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Even if some criminals did slip through our fingers, they wouldn't know that you were involved in the case, so you can relax.
:{{A|vo cnlq003 28 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' But what about you, Cyno?
:{{A|vo cnlq003 28 cyno 10.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' It's still not time for me to rest yet. Those who died have fulfilled their wishes, but those who are alive must continue pressing forward.
:{{A|vo cnlq003 28 cyno 11.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' I've been thinking about what Taj said in the Court of Desolation these last few days. His words were not empty... People do change, and no belief can completely resist the erosion of time.
:{{A|vo cnlq003 28 cyno 12.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' I just hope my own change will come slowly, so that I can press on a little further...
:{{A|vo cnlq003 28 cyno 13.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' That way, those who see me as their superior and those who are following in my footsteps will learn courage from my example.
:{{A|vo cnlq003 28 cyno 14.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Just as I gained courage from my own superiors and my partner.
:{{DIcon}} Sounds like a lot of work.
:{{DIcon}} I hope it will make you happy, Cyno.
:{{A|vo cnlq003 28 cyno 15.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' I'll be fine. I'm also enjoying my chat with you right now, you know.
:{{A|vo cnlq003 28 cyno 16.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' There are many things I feel better about once I start to talk about them.
:{{A|vo cnlq003 28 cyno 17.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Many people want to go to the desert to offer condolences for Taj, but I didn't share details with anyone... I'd prefer to avoid revealing the location of the Court of Desolation.
:{{A|vo cnlq003 28 cyno 18.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' One day, I'll gather some flowers that grow in arid desert conditions, and then I was hoping you'd join me in planting them on the remains of the Court of Desolation.
:;(Quest ends)

;(Talk to Cyno again)
:{{A|vo dialog cnlq003 cyno 01.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' By the way, something strange happened a few days ago.
:{{A|vo dialog cnlq003 cyno 02.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' A merchant approached me and requested that I cover the cost of a "Desert Travel Kit." One million, two hundred and fifty thousand Mora.
:{{A|vo dialog cnlq003 cyno 03.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' I didn't remember owing anyone Mora, especially not that kind of amount. So I arrested the merchant on charges of provocation and disturbing the peace.
:{{A|vo dialog cnlq003 cyno 04.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Do you know anything about this?
:{{A|vo dialog cnlq003 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Uh, no—nope... Paimon has no idea what that could be!
{{Dialogue End}}

'''''All the World's a Stage''''' is a quest in {{Quest|Shenanigans and Sweet Wine}}.

==Steps==
# Watch the performance with Kaeya
# Order food from Nesmil
# Chat with Kaeya
# Watch Kaeya's performance
# Talk to Kaeya
# Leave quietly with Kaeya

==Gameplay Notes==
* The names of the characters change between when they are acting and out of character. The cast list is as follows:
** Zabi plays Gundafar;
** Darbil plays Qabus;
** Kaeya plays Qubad;
** The name of Frasiyav's actor is unknown.
* Dialogue and thoughts that were previously attributed to "Gundafar" and "Qabus" are changed after their real names are shown to use their real names.
* Completing this quest for the first time will award the quest item [[Prince Qubad's Intaglio]].

==Dialogue==
{{Quest Description|Drama is both the generalized form and essence of reality. Just what kind of light does the story onstage reflect in his eyes?}}
===The Stage===
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Talk to Nesmil, optional)
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909801 nesmil 02.ogg}} '''Nesmil:''' If you want to order any food, just holler.

;(Approach the stage)
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909801 gundafar 01.ogg}} '''Gundafar:''' ...Your Majesty, not only has God bestowed the throne upon you, but your beloved son, Prince Qubad, has led our brave warriors to victory against Frasiyav's army. His men have laid down their arms and fled.
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909801 gundafar 02.ogg}} '''Gundafar:''' Frasiyav's brazen ambition is no more. He has bowed his head and now presents to Your Majesty an offering of treasures and hostages, as well as a plea for peace.
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909801 gundafar 03.ogg}} '''Gundafar:''' My king, this battle has finally restored the dignity of our people. Moreover, with Frasiyav's offer of land comes the opportunity to expand our borders, as Your Majesty so greatly wishes.
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909801 gundafar 04.ogg}} '''Gundafar:''' His Highness the Prince and I believe this peace settlement will be a great boon to our nation. It is for this reason alone that I have removed my armor and made haste back to our halls from the front lines. My king, what say you to this proposal?
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909801 kaeya 01.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' Ah, it's the tale of Prince Qubad. Ever heard this one?
:{{DIcon}} Nope, never.
:{{DIcon}} Feels like we've missed a lot of the backstory.
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909801 kaeya 02.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' Don't worry, I still remember the general plot. Let me fill you in on the background while the king deliberates.
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909801 kaeya 03.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' The main characters are the brilliant prince Qubad and his war-hungry father, King Qabus. The one talking to the king right now is Gundafar, the prince's tutor.
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909801 kaeya 04.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' When the prince was young, the king was deceived by a malicious rumor that the prince had mistreated his stepmother. He demanded that the prince walk through a blazing fire to prove his innocence.
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909801 kaeya 05.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' Miraculously, the prince emerged unscathed, thus proving his innocence. But the seeds of doubt had already been sown in the king's mind.
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909801 kaeya 06.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' Now uneasy in the presence of his mistrustful father, the prince requested to be sent away to the battlefield, where he would fight against Frasiyav's army — that's the enemy general we heard them mention just now.
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909801 kaeya 07.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' This is the part where the prince has won the war and decided to forge a peace with the rival nation. He wrote a letter recommending peace to his father... Oh, it looks like the king's made up his mind. Let's keep watching.
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909801 qabus 01.ogg}} '''Qabus:''' Frasiyav lost because he did not have the blessing of God. Our God will always watch over us, and punish our enemies.
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909801 qabus 02.ogg}} '''Qabus:''' Once the bells of war have begun to toll, they shall not cease until the blood of our enemies fills the land. There can be no victory until the last enemy soldier has fallen.
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909801 qabus 03.ogg}} '''Qabus:''' If Qubad still wishes to be my son, and hold the intaglio I bestowed upon him as proof of his royal blood, then he must obey my command.
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909801 gundafar 05.ogg}} '''Gundafar:''' Your Majesty, I must caution that a nation destroyed is not a fallen city writ large. Now, the loss of one city strikes fear into the hearts of our enemies, compelling them to accept defeat and cede land in exchange for peace.
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909801 gundafar 06.ogg}} '''Gundafar:''' If, however, we insist on bringing a whole nation to its knees... Then so long as a single person is left standing, they will see us as their sworn enemy, and one day return to us tenfold the pain that we have inflicted on their nation and family.
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909801 gundafar 07.ogg}} '''Gundafar:''' My king, a people is to their nation as wild grass to the open prairie. Though we burn down the whole field and spare not one blade of grass, roots continue to grow unseen beneath the surface. Come the spring, it is all but inevitable that fresh green shoots will rise up from the ashes.
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909801 qabus 04.ogg}} '''Qabus:''' Cease, Gundafar. Your mind grows dull in your old age, filled with naive delusions. We shall have no more need of you on the battlefield.
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909801 qabus 05.ogg}} '''Qabus:''' As for my son Qubad... I will summon him back to the capital, so he may be tried by a court-martial.
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909801 gundafar 08.ogg}} '''Gundafar:''' What are you saying, my noble king? Why must you mistrust your own flesh and blood, and sink ever deeper into the blight of hatred?
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909801 gundafar 09.ogg}} '''Gundafar:''' When he was falsely accused, you once doubted his honor, and made him walk through a raging fire. Did he not prove himself worthy by emerging unharmed from the flames?
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909801 gundafar 10.ogg}} '''Gundafar:''' Now you would turn me away, when I seek only to provide the wisdom of counsel. What is the justification for this?
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909801 qabus 06.ogg}} '''Qabus:''' The justification is that my word, not yours, is the law of the land. Cease and begone, Gundafar, so you may spend the rest of your days with your wife.
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909801 gundafar 11.ogg}} '''Gundafar:''' What has become of the king that I served with my life? Fanaticism has robbed him of all reason and wisdom... Peace is surely the most favorable path for our nation, yet he refuses to accept it.
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909801 qabus 07.ogg}} '''Qabus:''' I must think of a way to seize control of the army back from the hands of my wayward son, that they might continue this fight to the end. Perhaps the first task should be this... I shall send a loyal contingent of warriors to eliminate Frasiyav and the hostages he has sent to our palace.

:{{A|vo kycop001 1909801 kaeya 08.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' Brilliant acting, Darbil.
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909801 qabus 08.ogg}} '''Darbil:''' Hahaha, I saw you approaching us in the middle of the scene. I was worried that my performance would be subpar, and you'd think I was just making a fool of myself.
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909801 kaeya 09.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' Not at all, far from it. Actually, let me introduce you — this is Darbil, the actor for King Qabus.
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909801 kaeya 10.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' When we first got to know each other, he was still a guard for one of the merchant caravans. Seems like he's now made the switch to full-time acting.
:{{DIcon}} Hello.
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909801 qabus 09.ogg}} '''Darbil:''' Nice to meet you. Any friend of Kaeya's is a friend of mine.
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909801 qabus 10.ogg}} '''Darbil:''' To be perfectly honest, I wasn't making all that much as a mercenary. It felt right to me to get away from the danger and live a more stable life.
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909801 qabus 11.ogg}} '''Darbil:''' I was already pretty good at telling stories, so I just recruited a few friends, and started performing shows all over the country.
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909801 qabus 12.ogg}} '''Darbil:''' Full disclosure, we had to put this little stage together using whatever wood and cloth we could borrow... It's really low-budget.
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909801 qabus 13.ogg}} '''Darbil:''' Anyway, we're all good enough at acting to get through the motions, but none of us are any good at coming up with a script. Everything we tried to write just sounded off somehow.
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909801 qabus 14.ogg}} '''Darbil:''' So I got a student from the Akademiya to adapt an old story I knew to make it more appealing to our audience. What do you think? Passable?
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909801 kaeya 11.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' I could tell that you've had someone tighten up the lines. They turned out very nicely.
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909801 qabus 15.ogg}} '''Darbil:''' Ah, that's good... Well, as you can see, even now, we still don't have much of an audience... Don't suppose you'd be interested to see the rest of the show?
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909801 kaeya 12.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' Sure, why not. I don't have anything pressing lined up, and I don't think {{Traveler}} does either.
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909801 kaeya 13.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' Tickets for two, please. How much would that be?
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909801 qabus 16.ogg}} '''Darbil:''' Hah, there's no need for tickets. You can just get some food from Djafar Tavern — we've worked out an arrangement with them.
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909801 qabus 17.ogg}} '''Darbil:''' We actually found a sponsor for this performance, too. He's not too happy about the poor turnout, though...
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909801 qabus 18.ogg}} '''Darbil:''' I doubt we'll be able to keep him for the next performance. A real pity... but what can ya do, huh?
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909801 gundafar 12.ogg}} '''Zabi:''' Darbil, Asgar still hasn't shown up for the next scene. We should get his costume and sword out, so they'll be ready to go the moment he gets here...
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909801 qabus 19.ogg}} '''Darbil:''' My apologies, I have to go get ready for the upcoming scene. I'll see you from the stage.

;(Talk to Darbil again, optional)
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909801 qabus 21.ogg}} '''Darbil:''' Where in the seven nations is that little twerp? The next scene is about to begin...

;(Talk to Zabi again, optional)
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909801 gundafar 14.ogg}} '''Zabi:''' God only knows. It's not the first time he's done this, either... *sigh*

;(Use [[Nahida]]'s [[All Schemes to Know]] on Nesmil, optional)
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909801 nesmil 01.ogg}} '''Nesmil:''' (That outlander sure is easy on the eyes...)

;(Talk to Nesmil)
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909802 nesmil 01.ogg}} '''Nesmil:''' Would you two like to order some food? What can I get you? If you're looking for recommendations, today's special is the Tandoori Roast Chicken.
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909802 kaeya 01.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' Bear with us a moment... We're just going to take a look at the menu.
:{{DIcon}} How did you become friends with Darbil?
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909802 kaeya 02.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' I was at Port Ormos discussing some business opportunities, and some crook was trying to pull a fast one on me. Darbil took pity on me, and politely asked him to make himself scarce.
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909802 kaeya 03.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' He's a good guy. A decent storyteller, too. Quite an interesting character.
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909802 kaeya 04.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' There's a lot of fun to be had if you hang around interesting people doing interesting things, especially if you're in the company of an interesting friend.
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909802 kaeya 05.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' That's my secret formula for staying in a good mood. Try it out sometime, you'll see what I mean.
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909802 kaeya 06.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' Thanks for waiting. We're ready to order now.
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909802 kaeya 07.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' We'll take you up on that Tandoori Roast Chicken... And let's throw in some desserts, too — one each of the Rose Custard, that Tulumba, and the Padisarah Pudding, please. That should see us through the show.

;(Talk to Nesmil again, optional)
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909802 nesmil 02.ogg}} '''Nesmil:''' Your food's on the way. It'll just be a few more minutes.

:{{A|vo kycop001 1909803 kaeya 01.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' (There are worse ways to pass the time than watching a little outdoor theater... Too bad I already know the story.)
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909803 kaeya 02.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' (Having {{Traveler}} here will help to keep things interesting, though. And being close to where the action's happening is always exciting.)

;(Talk to Kaeya)
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909803 kaeya 03.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' We've got good seats. Close to the stage, but also not too crowded.
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909803 kaeya 04.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' We can watch the show as we eat. If I remember correctly, the next scene should focus on the prince.

==Trivia==
* "{{w|All the world's a stage|All the world's a stage, and all the people merely players}}" is a quote from {{w|William Shakespeare}}'s play ''{{w|As You Like It}}''.
* The name of Kaeya's character, Prince Qubad, is likely a reference to {{Lang|{{w|Kay Kawad}}, also known as Kay Qobad|fa = کیقباد/کی‌قباد|ae = 𐬐𐬀𐬎𐬎𐬌 𐬐𐬀𐬎𐬎𐬁𐬙𐬀|ae_rm = Kauui Kauuāta}}, a mythological figure of Iranian folklore and oral tradition. In the tradition preserved in the {{w|Shahnameh}}, Kay Kawad was a descendant of {{w|Manuchehr}}, lived in the {{w|Alborz}} mountains, and was brought to {{w|Estaxr}} (the capital) by {{w|Rustam}}.

==Dialogue==
{{Quest Description|You and Paimon tell Yoimiya that meteor showers respond to people's wishes. In response, Yoimiya wants to spend some time getting herself ready for the occasion...}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Approach the marked area)
:;(The three reach Devantaka Mountain after dark.)
:{{A|vo xglq202 1 yoimiya 01.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' Wow, is that what you two were talking about? Amazing... It's huge!
:{{A|vo xglq202 1 yoimiya 02.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' W—Wait, it's not going to suddenly start moving, right?
:{{A|vo xglq202 1 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Relax, it's completely still, and it's been ages.
:{{A|vo xglq202 1 yoimiya 03.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' That's true. It's green from all the overgrowth on it.
:{{A|vo xglq202 1 yoimiya 04.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' Alright, let's go. Hehehe, now this'll make for quite the story!
----
;(While following the Four-Leaf Sigils)
:{{A|vo xglq202 2 yoimiya 01a.ogg}} {{A|vo xglq202 2 yoimiya 01b.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' I was wondering... have you seen your {{MC|m=sister|f=brother}} yet?
:{{A|vo xglq202 2 paimon 01a.ogg}} {{A|vo xglq202 2 paimon 01b.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yup, but {{MC|m=she|f=he}} said that {{MC|m=she|f=he}}'d meet us at the end of our journey — and then {{MC|m=she|f=he}} left.
:{{A|vo xglq202 2 yoimiya 02a.ogg}} {{A|vo xglq202 2 yoimiya 02b.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' I see. It seems {{MC|m=she|f=he}} has {{MC|m=her|f=his}} own things to worry about...
:{{A|vo xglq202 2 yoimiya 03a.ogg}} {{A|vo xglq202 2 yoimiya 03b.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' But it's alright. At least you were able to talk. How did {{MC|m=she|f=he}} look? Was {{MC|m=she|f=he}} doing well? Had {{MC|m=she|f=he}} changed in any way?
:{{A|vo xglq202 2 paimon 02a.ogg}} {{A|vo xglq202 2 paimon 02b.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Well, according to {{MC|m=him|f=her}}, nothing's really changed. {{MC|m=He|f=She}}'s hanging in there.
:{{A|vo xglq202 2 yoimiya 04.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' Hehe, that sure is reassuring!
:{{A|vo xglq202 2 yoimiya 05.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' I believe that you two will come to an understanding once your journey is over.
:{{A|vo xglq202 2 yoimiya 06.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' You are siblings, after all.
----
;(Approach the top of the Ruin Golem)
:{{A|vo xglq202 5 yoimiya 01.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' I didn't think we'd be able to climb all the way up here...
:{{A|vo xglq202 5 yoimiya 02.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' What a great view! I just wanna shout at the top of my lungs!
:{{A|vo xglq202 5 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yeah! And even though we might not be viewing the meteor shower from here, it's a good place to practice.
:{{A|vo xglq202 5 yoimiya 03.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' Oops, I was having too much fun and almost forgot about that.
:{{A|vo xglq202 5 yoimiya 04.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' Before I left Inazuma, many people heard that I was looking for a meteor shower, so they told me that they wanted to make wishes.
:{{A|vo xglq202 5 yoimiya 05.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' I told them that they could write their wishes down on paper, so I ended up collecting several dozens of wishes...
:{{A|vo xglq202 5 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Woah, that many!?
:{{DIcon}} So you want to help convey all those wishes?
:{{A|vo xglq202 5 yoimiya 06.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' That's part of it, but more importantly, I've been wondering why people link meteor showers and wishes in the first place.
:{{A|vo xglq202 5 yoimiya 07.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' After a lot of thought, I think I've figured it out.
:{{A|vo xglq202 5 yoimiya 08.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' People use fireworks to remember their most precious memories, and these memories sparkle and shine each time the fireworks fly.
:{{A|vo xglq202 5 yoimiya 09.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' In other words, fireworks symbolize the past.
:{{A|vo xglq202 5 yoimiya 10.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' And shooting stars make people think of wishes because wishes carry people's brilliant hopes and expectations for the future.
:{{A|vo xglq202 5 yoimiya 11.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' One represents the past, and the other the future. They both bloom in the sky, but have completely different meanings behind them.
:{{A|vo xglq202 5 yoimiya 12.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' It's really beautiful, isn't it?
:{{DIcon}} Very true...
:{{A|vo xglq202 5 yoimiya 13.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' It's clear to me that I'm not the only one holding this belief — I'm sure my ancestor had similar views.
:{{A|vo xglq202 5 yoimiya 14.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' I think that's how he drew inspiration from the meteor shower...
:{{A|vo xglq202 5 yoimiya 15.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' His method was a wish of sorts to begin with — to join the past and future together and combine their beauty.
:{{A|vo xglq202 5 yoimiya 16.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' At first, I wasn't completely serious about using the opportunity to travel abroad to see a meteor shower...
:{{A|vo xglq202 5 yoimiya 17.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' But it became something like a mission once everyone had handed their wishes over to me.
:{{A|vo xglq202 5 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yoimiya...
:{{A|vo xglq202 5 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Well said! And here Paimon thought you needed practice.
:{{A|vo xglq202 5 yoimiya 18.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' Huh, that was fine? You both understand what I'm trying to say? Honestly, I thought it was pretty messy...
:{{A|vo xglq202 5 yoimiya 19.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' I mean, these are all abstract topics that evoke a... sense of admiration that's hard to put into words.
:{{DIcon}} Then, have you ever considered that if you can't find it...
:{{DIcon}} Perhaps it doesn't exist?
:{{A|vo xglq202 5 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' ({{Traveler}}...)
:{{A|vo xglq202 5 yoimiya 20.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' I did consider that possibility, and I won't lie — it'd be a real bummer if that were the case.
:{{A|vo xglq202 5 yoimiya 21.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' I know that's the most realistic conclusion, and it's not like luck has to be on my side.
:{{A|vo xglq202 5 yoimiya 22.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' But there's a premise to every legend, and that's belief!
:{{A|vo xglq202 5 yoimiya 23.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' If I didn't take this step, it's not like a meteor shower would just rain upon me, either.
:{{A|vo xglq202 5 yoimiya 24.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' I wouldn't be where I am now. I wouldn't have known that they respond to wishes, and I wouldn't have seen all these beautiful sights in Sumeru.
:{{A|vo xglq202 5 yoimiya 25.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' So I'm looking forward to the rest of our journey — every single step of it.
:{{A|vo xglq202 5 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' ...You really are amazing, Yoimiya.
:{{A|vo xglq202 5 yoimiya 26.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' Eh, what?
:{{A|vo xglq202 5 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, nothing. Paimon just thinks you're doing a good job with the wishes. Now we just need one other thing.
:{{A|vo xglq202 5 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Like we said earlier, we're going to need to build a device.
:{{DIcon}} We'll need to look for the purest ore in Sumeru.
:{{A|vo xglq202 5 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yep, and once we use it to create an observation device, we can find where the meteor shower will be.
:{{A|vo xglq202 5 yoimiya 27.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' I see. The purest ore...
:{{DIcon}} We can go somewhere else to look for it.
:{{A|vo xglq202 5 yoimiya 28.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' Hmm... Then, why don't we go back to Sumeru City and ask the blacksmith?
:{{A|vo xglq202 5 yoimiya 29.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' I chatted with him a bit when Avin was showing me around. He seems really knowledgeable. I bet he'll know something.
:{{A|vo xglq202 5 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Uh... But wouldn't we be bothering him?
:{{A|vo xglq202 5 yoimiya 30.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' No one knows more about ore than a blacksmith!
:{{A|vo xglq202 5 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' That's true...
:{{A|vo xglq202 5 yoimiya 31.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' Let's go! Hehe, I wish we could fly over!
:{{A|vo xglq202 5 paimon 12.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What are we gonna do? If we really ask the blacksmith, he's gonna give us funny looks for sure!
:{{DIcon}} We'll just have to roll with the punches...
:{{A|vo xglq202 5 paimon 13.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' *sigh* You're right. Paimon will do her best to not say anything wrong!
:{{A|vo xglq202 5 paimon 14.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' At first, Paimon felt bad about keeping Yoimiya in the dark...
:{{A|vo xglq202 5 paimon 15.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' But now, it feels like we made the right decision.
:{{DIcon}} I want her to see that meteor shower.
:{{DIcon}} I want her to have her cake and eat it, too.
:{{A|vo xglq202 5 paimon 16.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yup, that's why we're doing all this!
{{Dialogue End}}
{{Quest Description|update|Though Yoimiya has brought many wishes with her, you still need an observation tool to find the exact location of the meteor shower. Yoimiya suggests that you speak to the blacksmith in the city.}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Talk to Ahangar)
:{{Black Screen|You briefly explain the purpose of your visit to the blacksmith.}}
:{{A|vo xglq202 6 ahangar 01.ogg}} '''Ahangar:''' You want to use the purest material to create a star observation device? Hmm... A pair of specially crafted lenses should do the job.
:{{A|vo xglq202 6 ahangar 02.ogg}} '''Ahangar:''' However, "purest material" is too vague. It'd be better if you were more specific...
:{{DIcon}} Do you have any alternatives for us?
:{{A|vo xglq202 6 ahangar 03.ogg}} '''Ahangar:''' Firstly, this all sounds rather strange. I've never heard that legend about meteor showers. You sure you're not just messing with me?
:{{A|vo xglq202 6 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' (Sorry for the trouble, but we are kind of messing with someone...)
:{{A|vo xglq202 6 yoimiya 01.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' Sorry... Inazuma's pretty far, so maybe some key information got lost across the ocean.
:{{A|vo xglq202 6 yoimiya 02.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' Still, I want to at least give it a shot. Even though the information's vague, can you help us at all?
:{{A|vo xglq202 6 ahangar 04.ogg}} '''Ahangar:''' Well, sure. Why don't I use some materials that might fit the bill, and create up a mock-up device for you?
:{{A|vo xglq202 6 yoimiya 03.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' That'd be great. Thanks so much for your help!
:{{A|vo xglq202 6 ahangar 05.ogg}} '''Ahangar:''' No need to be so polite — you're my customer. Also, this kind of project is a nice change of pace.
:{{Black Screen|Using his well-honed skills, the blacksmith constructs three lenses of different make.}}
:{{A|vo xglq202 6 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' (Maybe we can just pick a random one. It's not like we're really going to use it, anyway...)
:{{A|vo xglq202 6 ahangar 06.ogg}} '''Ahangar:''' No, that won't do. I don't think I can justify that to myself...
:{{A|vo xglq202 6 ahangar 07.ogg}} '''Ahangar:''' If these were for ordinary use, then it'd be acceptable... barely. But if you want a product that is top-notch, this is far from ideal.
:{{A|vo xglq202 6 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' (Gah, why are you so interested all of a sudden?)
:{{DIcon}} Then what do we do...?
:{{A|vo xglq202 6 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yeah, what now...?
:{{A|vo xglq202 6 yoimiya 04.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' Don't worry too much about the material. If you think it'll be difficult to obtain, we can get it for you.
:{{A|vo xglq202 6 yoimiya 05.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' I want to try all our options.
:{{A|vo xglq202 6 ahangar 08.ogg}} '''Ahangar:''' Hmm...
:{{A|vo xglq202 6 ahangar 09.ogg}} '''Ahangar:''' Since we're on the topic of legends, allow me to tell you one about blacksmiths.
:{{A|vo xglq202 6 ahangar 10.ogg}} '''Ahangar:''' All of us in Sumeru know about this legendary forging material. It possesses excellent properties that are matched by no other...
:{{A|vo xglq202 6 ahangar 11.ogg}} '''Ahangar:''' Using it to forge something is every blacksmith's dream.
:{{A|vo xglq202 6 ahangar 12.ogg}} '''Ahangar:''' Some spend their entire lives searching for this material in vain, while others have it in their possession, yet never use it in their forge.
:{{A|vo xglq202 6 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh? Why's that?
:{{A|vo xglq202 6 ahangar 13.ogg}} '''Ahangar:''' That's because the material is too precious. Many believe themselves unworthy to work with it due to a lack of skill.
:{{A|vo xglq202 6 ahangar 14.ogg}} '''Ahangar:''' In other words, not only does it represent the pinnacle of material quality, but also the culmination of a smith's skills.
:{{A|vo xglq202 6 ahangar 15.ogg}} '''Ahangar:''' I constantly practice and hone myself so when I do encounter this material, we won't pass each other by like two ships in the night.
:{{A|vo xglq202 6 yoimiya 06.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' So you mean that it symbolizes dreams?
:{{A|vo xglq202 6 ahangar 16.ogg}} '''Ahangar:''' Dreams, inspiration, obsession, focus... Call it what you want. But if you take it to symbolize "purity," then I believe it is your goal as well.
:{{A|vo xglq202 6 ahangar 17.ogg}} '''Ahangar:''' We call it Urstone, but in truth, neither I nor my colleagues have ever seen it.
:{{A|vo xglq202 6 ahangar 18.ogg}} '''Ahangar:''' It's more like a goal, and also a warning.
:{{A|vo xglq202 6 yoimiya 07.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' This fits perfectly with the tale of the meteor shower.
:{{A|vo xglq202 6 yoimiya 08.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' Then why don't we go looking for it?
:{{A|vo xglq202 6 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Is it even something we can find?
:{{DIcon}} We should at least try...
:{{DIcon}} Treat it as a fun excursion.
:{{A|vo xglq202 6 yoimiya 09.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' Exactly! We're chasing down a legend, after all. What's true or not doesn't matter as much.
:{{A|vo xglq202 6 yoimiya 10.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' If we do find it, that's a big win for us! And if we don't, maybe we can still find something that could be used as a substitute.
:{{A|vo xglq202 6 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' When you put it like that...
:{{A|vo xglq202 6 farid 01.ogg}} '''Farid:''' Excuse me. If I might intrude, have you seen a child in a wheelchair?
:{{A|vo xglq202 6 yoimiya 11.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' Yeah, she and I were hanging out not that long ago. What's the matter?
:{{A|vo xglq202 6 niousha 01.ogg}} '''Niousha:''' Do you know where she went? She hasn't returned home yet...
:{{A|vo xglq202 6 yoimiya 12.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' Huh? I wonder why? When we split up, she said she was heading home.
:{{A|vo xglq202 6 niousha 02.ogg}} '''Niousha:''' Oh dear... *sigh*
:{{A|vo xglq202 6 niousha 03.ogg}} '''Niousha:''' I'm sorry if I seemed worked up. I'm Avin's mother.
:{{A|vo xglq202 6 niousha 04.ogg}} '''Niousha:''' She's been depressed ever since she fell ill and was forced to use a wheelchair. I'm concerned about her mental health.
:{{A|vo xglq202 6 niousha 05.ogg}} '''Niousha:''' If she does something reckless because she's not in a good state of mind...
:{{A|vo xglq202 6 yoimiya 13.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' It's okay, don't worry. We'll help you find her.
:{{A|vo xglq202 6 yoimiya 14.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' I can't say that I know her very well, but I think she just has a lot on her mind, and is trying to come to terms with her feelings.
:{{A|vo xglq202 6 niousha 06.ogg}} '''Niousha:''' That's reassuring... *sigh* She doesn't want to tell me anything, probably because she thinks nothing she says would make either of us feel better.
:{{A|vo xglq202 6 niousha 07.ogg}} '''Niousha:''' But I can't tell what she's thinking if we don't communicate...
:{{A|vo xglq202 6 niousha 08.ogg}} '''Niousha:''' I'm worried that I'll panic and make things worse by saying the wrong thing.
:{{A|vo xglq202 6 yoimiya 15.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' Don't worry, I'm sure she has a reason for wanting some space to herself at the moment. We should just be open and understanding with her.
:{{A|vo xglq202 6 yoimiya 16.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' But that does bring me to a question I've been mulling over in my head... Do you think there's something else going on in her life?
:{{A|vo xglq202 6 niousha 09.ogg}} '''Niousha:''' Not that I'm aware of, I just know the illness was a big blow to her...
:{{A|vo xglq202 6 niousha 10.ogg}} '''Niousha:''' She's always been physically active. She absolutely loved to run and jump, and she told me that she wanted to become a great adventurer some day.
:{{A|vo xglq202 6 niousha 11.ogg}} '''Niousha:''' But after she became ill, she lost strength in both legs. She hasn't been able to stand since.
:{{A|vo xglq202 6 niousha 12.ogg}} '''Niousha:''' We've consulted with countless doctors, but they're all stumped. They said all she can do is slowly recuperate. No one can say for sure if she'll ever stand or walk again.
:{{A|vo xglq202 6 niousha 13.ogg}} '''Niousha:''' She believes that her legs will never recover, and her dreams of seeing the world would be forever shattered. *sigh* It's... This was all too sudden, too unfair.
:{{A|vo xglq202 6 yoimiya 17.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' Okay, I understand. I'll find a way to bring her around.
:{{A|vo xglq202 6 yoimiya 18.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' Sorry, but it looks like we'll have to put our meteor shower search on hold.
:{{DIcon}} Of course. Avin's safety is more important.
:{{A|vo xglq202 6 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' We're coming with you!
:{{A|vo xglq202 6 yoimiya 19.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' Mister Blacksmith, do you remember seeing a child in a wheelchair?
:{{A|vo xglq202 6 ahangar 19.ogg}} '''Ahangar:''' Sorry, afraid not. I've been keeping my eyes on my anvil.
:{{A|vo xglq202 6 ahangar 20.ogg}} '''Ahangar:''' But you're looking for someone... I suggest dropping in on Sadegh.
:{{A|vo xglq202 6 ahangar 21.ogg}} '''Ahangar:''' He's my supplier. If anyone's aware of the comings and goings in Treasures Street, it'd be him.
:{{A|vo xglq202 6 yoimiya 20.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' Do you know where we can find him?
:{{A|vo xglq202 6 ahangar 22.ogg}} '''Ahangar:''' He's probably resting just over there. It's not far.
:{{A|vo xglq202 6 yoimiya 21.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' Got it. Thanks for your help with everything!
:{{A|vo xglq202 6 yoimiya 22.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' We'll go over there and see what we can find out. Don't worry, I don't think she's gone too far.
:{{A|vo xglq202 6 niousha 14.ogg}} '''Niousha:''' Thank you so much. He and I will continue asking around in the city.
:{{A|vo xglq202 6 niousha 15.ogg}} '''Niousha:''' If you find her, please let me know... Thanks again for helping.

;(Use [[Nahida]]'s [[All Schemes to Know]] on Ahangar, optional)
:{{A|vo xglq202 6 ahangar 23.ogg}} '''Ahangar:''' (Kids these days... Her friends sure seem worried.)

;(Speak to Ahangar again, optional)
:{{A|vo dialog xglq202 ahangar 01.ogg}} '''Ahangar:''' I'll keep an eye out for you. If I see her, I'll try to keep her here with me.
{{Dialogue End}}

;(Talk to Jahan again, optional)

:{{A|vo xglq202 13 avin 06.ogg}} '''Avin:''' Yeah. My illness is really bad. It's not just my legs — I've forgotten a lot of stuff, too.
:{{A|vo xglq202 13 avin 07.ogg}} '''Avin:''' I used to love running. I loved the feeling it gave me, and the sound of wind rushing by my ears.
:{{A|vo xglq202 13 avin 08.ogg}} '''Avin:''' But the longer I sit, the cloudier those memories get. I'm starting to forget how it feels to "love" something.
:{{A|vo xglq202 13 avin 09.ogg}} '''Avin:''' But when I saw that wood carving, I remembered that I once had a best friend. He'd always run with me.
:{{A|vo xglq202 13 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wait, was he an Aranara!?
:{{A|vo xglq202 13 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Um, Paimon meant that it couldn't have been an Aranara, right? They're just fairy tale characters!
:{{A|vo xglq202 13 avin 10.ogg}} '''Avin:''' But they aren't! They're real! They couldn't be more real!
:{{A|vo xglq202 13 yoimiya 07.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' Hey, I understand. Okay, let's calm down. Tell us what happened so we can help you.
:{{A|vo xglq202 13 avin 11.ogg}} '''Avin:''' Sorry, I got carried away... and I don't have any evidence to show you...
:{{A|vo xglq202 13 avin 12.ogg}} '''Avin:''' Everyone says you can't see Aranara anymore once you become an adult. You have to say goodbye to your Aranara friends forever.
:{{A|vo xglq202 13 avin 13.ogg}} '''Avin:''' I can't remember his name or how he looked like... and soon, I'll even forget that he used to run with me...
:{{A|vo xglq202 13 avin 14.ogg}} '''Avin:''' I don't want to become an adult... Not like this.
:{{A|vo xglq202 13 yoimiya 08.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' I understand now... When you saw that carving, you were reminded of your friend.
:{{A|vo xglq202 13 yoimiya 09.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' You came out here to look for him and remember that friendship, no matter how difficult things got. Isn't that right?
:{{A|vo xglq202 13 avin 15.ogg}} '''Avin:''' Yes. I want to see him. I want to tell him that I'm not angry with him, and that I didn't want to break our promise. But then... this happened.
:{{A|vo xglq202 13 avin 16.ogg}} '''Avin:''' I'm not angry with him, not at all.
:{{A|vo xglq202 13 yoimiya 10.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' Cheer up — something beautiful has happened.
:{{A|vo xglq202 13 avin 17.ogg}} '''Avin:''' Beautiful?
:{{A|vo xglq202 13 yoimiya 11.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' That's right. You remembered something about the Aranara, haven't you?
:{{A|vo xglq202 13 yoimiya 12.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' Once you start remembering more things, you'll be able to find your friend again.
:{{A|vo xglq202 13 yoimiya 13.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' And I'll help you!

:{{A|vo xglq202 13 avin 19.ogg}} '''Avin:''' Does this mean that you can also see Aranara?
:{{A|vo xglq202 13 yoimiya 14.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' Sorry, I don't know if I can. I've only just arrived in Sumeru. Maybe I haven't seen one yet, or maybe I can't see them at all.
:{{A|vo xglq202 13 yoimiya 15.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' But that doesn't matter. Whether I can see them or not doesn't change my belief that you can.
:{{A|vo xglq202 13 avin 20.ogg}} '''Avin:''' ...!
:{{A|vo xglq202 13 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What do we do?
:{{A|vo xglq202 13 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Paimon really wants to help her. She didn't deserve any of this — not her illness, or being separated from her friend. But...
:{{DIcon}} We'll help, too.
::{{DIcon}} Yoimiya, can we talk?
:{{DIcon}} But before that...
::{{DIcon}} Yoimiya, can we talk?
:{{A|vo xglq202 13 yoimiya 16.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' Huh, me? Sure. Um, sorry, wait here for a moment. We'll be right back.
:{{A|vo xglq202 13 yoimiya 17.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' What's wrong? You look so serious all of a sudden.
:{{DIcon}} Do you really believe in the Aranara?
:{{DIcon}} How do you plan to help her?
:{{A|vo xglq202 13 yoimiya 18.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' Oh, did you think I was over-promising back there? Don't worry, I have experience with this kind of thing.
:{{A|vo xglq202 13 yoimiya 19.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' To her, reuniting with her Aranara friend is the "result." But recapturing her past joy and belief in herself is the "process," and that's where our help is needed.
:{{A|vo xglq202 13 yoimiya 20.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' I'm guessing that her sudden illness made her feel like she may not be able to realize her dreams anymore. It also made it difficult for her to hold onto the happy memories and dreams she had.
:{{A|vo xglq202 13 yoimiya 21.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' Everyone has their own imagination. After some chance coincidence, she met an "Aranara."
:{{A|vo xglq202 13 yoimiya 22.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' So as long as we help her rediscover that same feeling she once had, her "Aranara" will return naturally.
:{{A|vo xglq202 13 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, so that's what you're thinking...
:{{A|vo xglq202 13 yoimiya 23.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' Adults only want to believe in objective reality. In doing so, they may unintentionally do harm to the innocent fantasies of children.
:{{A|vo xglq202 13 yoimiya 24.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' But I think there are ways to get even subjective things back.
:{{A|vo xglq202 13 yoimiya 25.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' So how about it? Wanna help me out?
:{{A|vo xglq202 13 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hehe, looks like all this excitement made you forget your original goal again.
:{{A|vo xglq202 13 yoimiya 26.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' *sigh* If we didn't do anything to help, I wouldn't be able to watch a meteor shower, even if it appeared right now.
:{{A|vo xglq202 13 yoimiya 27.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' And would the stars really want their caller to have such a heartless soul?
:{{DIcon}} I understand.
:{{DIcon}} Don't worry, I don't doubt your reasoning, it's just...
:{{A|vo xglq202 13 yoimiya 28.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' What are you trying to say?
:{{A|vo xglq202 13 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Because we can actually summon the Aranara.
:{{DIcon}} You're a good Nara, Yoimiya.
:{{DIcon}} I'll apologize to them later.
:{{A|vo xglq202 13 yoimiya 29.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' R—Really?
:{{A|vo xglq202 13 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Just watch. We have some tricks up our sleeves!
:{{Black Screen|You blow the leaf to call forth the Aranara...}}
:{{A|vo xglq202 13 yoimiya 30.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' Whoa... So this is an Aranara...
:'''Arapurva:''' Very unexpected. The Lord of Dendro did not say that there would be strange Nara.
:'''Arapurva:''' Aranara trust Golden Nara. If that were not so... I would not have appeared.
:{{DIcon}} I'm sorry...
:{{DIcon}} There were circumstances, I'm afraid.
:{{A|vo xglq202 13 yoimiya 31.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' I'm the one who should be apologizing! Sorry, let me explain.
:{{A|vo xglq202 13 yoimiya 32.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' I know that you only want to be seen by people you trust. It's rash of me to butt in...
:{{A|vo xglq202 13 yoimiya 33.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' But this girl once had an Aranara as her best friend, and they haven't met in a very long time.
:{{A|vo xglq202 13 yoimiya 34.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' She's been quite ill, and her world has turned upside down. It's been so long since she's been able to see her friend that even her memory of him has become hazy...
:{{A|vo xglq202 13 yoimiya 35.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' Parting with a friend like that is too sad, and she never wanted that to happen.
:'''Arapurva:''' I remember Nara Avin and Arashani.
:'''Arapurva:''' All Nara grow up, and when they do, they will say goodbye to their young selves.
:'''Arapurva:''' All Nara want to prepare for that, but the truth is... very few succeed.
:{{A|vo xglq202 13 yoimiya 36.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' That's why I want to help her. Her world is still very small — too small for all the sadness she has to bear.
:{{A|vo xglq202 13 yoimiya 37.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' As things are, all she can do is sit alone and think about how happiness is leaving her little by little, about how life has been so unfair to her...
:'''Arapurva:''' I understand. Her world is very small, so disappointment is very large.
:{{A|vo xglq202 13 yoimiya 38.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' Yes. Maybe we're already used to bad luck, and we know how to deal with feelings of sorrow and disappointment.
:{{A|vo xglq202 13 yoimiya 39.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' But this is her first time dealing with any of this. Life can trip anyone up. What's most important in times like this...
:{{A|vo xglq202 13 yoimiya 40.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' Is for us to support one another.
:'''Arapurva:''' Hmm...
:'''Arapurva:''' It seems that Red Nara has not yet grown up.
:{{A|vo xglq202 13 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Eh? What do you mean by that?
:'''Arapurva:''' Time is very important to Nara. Nara walk with time. They remember much, and they forget much.
:'''Arapurva:''' But Red Nara is different. You know how young Nara think. The warmth in your heart is very pure, and it is fierce like the sun.
:'''Arapurva:''' I believe you are a trustworthy Nara.
:{{A|vo xglq202 13 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So, that means...
:'''Arapurva:''' I can bring you all to see Arashani.
:{{A|vo xglq202 13 avin 21.ogg}} '''Avin:''' Eh? T—Thank you...
:{{A|vo xglq202 13 yoimiya 41.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' Thanks for trusting us!
:'''Arapurva:''' Arashani is in Mawtiyima Forest. But Nara Avin might not be able to see Arashani unless she is prepared.
:'''Arapurva:''' It is not very complicated or difficult, though. Let me lead the way.
{{Dialogue End}}

:{{A|vo zllq104 6 kunjun 02.ogg}} '''???:''' Focus your efforts, Morax!
