----
;(After defeating Azhdaha)
:{{A|vo zllq104 7 jiu 01.ogg}} '''[[Jiu]]:''' Morax! A thousand years after you sealed me underground... you return for the second time...
:{{A|vo zllq104 7 zhongli 01.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' ...
:{{A|vo zllq104 7 zhongli 02.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' You should call it by its name, Azhdaha... fate.
:{{A|vo zllq104 7 jiu 02.ogg}} '''Jiu:''' Fate?
:{{A|vo zllq104 7 jiu 03.ogg}} '''Jiu:''' Fate!!! Hahahaha!
:{{A|vo zllq104 7 jiu 04.ogg}} '''Jiu:''' So here lies the wisdom of the [[god]]s? Destroy all deemed redundant, enlist tyrants to ravage the wilderness!
:{{A|vo zllq104 7 kunjun 01.ogg}} '''???:''' No. You have forgotten.
:{{A|vo zllq104 7 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' ...That... that voice...
:{{A|vo zllq104 7 zhongli 03.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Azhdaha...
:{{A|vo zllq104 7 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh? Kun Jun!?
:{{A|vo zllq104 7 kunjun 02.ogg}} '''Kun Jun:''' Morax. It's been a while.
:{{A|vo zllq104 7 jiu 05.ogg}} '''Jiu:''' Y—You're...
:{{A|vo zllq104 7 kunjun 03.ogg}} '''Kun Jun?:''' Azhdaha... the very same.
:{{A|vo zllq104 7 zhongli 04.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' During the battle... you embued us with your power...
:{{A|vo zllq104 7 kunjun 04.ogg}} '''Kun Jun?:''' Haha... yes. It was all I could manage.
:{{DIcon}} Then... which one is the real Azhdaha?
:{{DIcon}} You're not Kun Jun?
:{{A|vo zllq104 7 kunjun 05.ogg}} '''Kun Jun?:''' Forgive me for concealing the truth, Traveler. There were things that only became clear to me upon reaching this tree.
:{{A|vo zllq104 7 kunjun 06.ogg}} '''Kun Jun?:''' Allow me to elaborate. I am not Azhdaha the whole... but a fragment.
:{{A|vo zllq104 7 kunjun 07.ogg}} '''Kun Jun?:''' Heaven and earth, yin and yang, opposing forces... You can consider the existence of me and the Azhdaha you see there, to be a reflection of such polarities. "We" are a schism of the will... the will of Azhdaha.
:{{A|vo zllq104 7 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So... so there are two Azhdahas!?
:{{A|vo zllq104 7 jiu 06.ogg}} '''Jiu:''' No! It can't be! That's impossible...!
:;(Kun Jun gains the title of "Azhdaha")
:{{A|vo zllq104 7 kunjun 08.ogg}} '''Kun Jun:''' When the seal loosened, your power manifested in this world as a child. With this new identity, you were able to vent about the forces that suppressed you... but would anyone listen... would they even care?
:{{A|vo zllq104 7 kunjun 09.ogg}} '''Kun Jun:''' That's when it occurred to you. The loosening of the seal constituted an opportunity to strike back. Kidnapping the miners was all in aid of digging to the entrance to the seal itself. Your plan was to launch an attack on both ends. From outside... and within. Thereby fully destroying the seal.
:{{A|vo zllq104 7 jiu 07.ogg}} '''Jiu:''' The audacity! Are you insane!? If you truly are a part of me, how is it you find yourself standing on the side of the betrayer!?
:{{A|vo zllq104 7 kunjun 10.ogg}} '''Kun Jun:''' I was another power awakened with the loosening of the seal. Too weak to reincarnate, but strong enough to possess a human body.
:{{A|vo zllq104 7 kunjun 11.ogg}} '''Kun Jun:''' I was barely conscious... I couldn't remember who I was. Only the past would elicit a reaction from me... But my aim was clear: Find Morax... and aid him in stopping you.
:{{A|vo zllq104 7 zhongli 05.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' I had sensed that something was amiss when you mentioned [[Dragonfall]]. Had your power been but a little stronger, I would've recognized you.
:{{A|vo zllq104 7 kunjun 12.ogg}} '''Kun Jun:''' Don't blame yourself, I have changed beyond all recognition. Only when I touched the stone tablet... did I truly remember.
:{{A|vo zllq104 7 kunjun 13.ogg}} '''Kun Jun:''' It's been so long. A secret beyond all comprehension, of youthful humanity and ancient dragon-kind... Morax, do you want to tell the tale?
:{{A|vo zllq104 7 zhongli 06.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' There would be no harm in it. The decision is yours.
:{{A|vo zllq104 7 kunjun 14.ogg}} '''Kun Jun:''' Haha, you haven't changed. Then allow me.
:{{A|vo zllq104 7 kunjun 15.ogg}} '''Kun Jun:''' Azhdaha was once a friend and ally of the Geo Archon, Morax, with a lifespan far exceeding that of mankind. However, that which is derived of the earth is no more or less than the earth itself...
:{{A|vo zllq104 7 kunjun 16.ogg}} '''Kun Jun:''' The memories of rocks do not last long. Those memories that survive are rooted in powerful emotion. But as time passes, so these memories fade into obscurity. [[Erosion]] is the world's greatest destroyer of memories.
:{{DIcon}} Erosion...?
:{{A|vo zllq104 7 kunjun 17.ogg}} '''Kun Jun:''' Erosion ground Azhdaha's consciousness into oblivion. Slowly, he forgot the face of his old friend, and his memories of defending [[Liyue Harbor]] disintegrated.
:{{A|vo zllq104 7 kunjun 18.ogg}} '''Kun Jun:''' Azhdaha, now incomplete, became irascible... aggressive.
:{{A|vo zllq104 7 jiu 08.ogg}} '''Jiu:''' What would you expect!? It was humanity that attacked the [[Ley Line]]s that sustained me!
:{{A|vo zllq104 7 kunjun 19.ogg}} '''Kun Jun:''' This much is true. Which is why "you" attacked [[The Chasm (Subregion)|The Chasm]]... why "you" waged war against Morax.
:{{A|vo zllq104 7 kunjun 20.ogg}} '''Kun Jun:''' In the beginning, in order to open up new territory and increase production, the citizens of Liyue came to the mountains to mine. Overexploitation caused the Ley Lines to quake, which brought untold suffering to "us."
:{{A|vo zllq104 7 kunjun 21.ogg}} '''Kun Jun:''' Erosion made "us" even more savage. No matter how we struggled, we lost the ability to coexist with humanity... we lost all reason.
:{{A|vo zllq104 7 kunjun 22.ogg}} '''Kun Jun:''' Morax shared with us some of his power, to prevent further erosion. But... it was futile. Everything returns to dust. It is the natural order, an unstoppable force.
:{{A|vo zllq104 7 kunjun 23.ogg}} '''Kun Jun:''' And so, "we" became "you." And from your will... "I" emerged.
:{{A|vo zllq104 7 jiu 09.ogg}} '''Jiu:''' ...
:{{A|vo zllq104 7 kunjun 24.ogg}} '''Kun Jun:''' I am your final contract. Witness the promise between Azhdaha and Morax. You can hate me... but you cannot deny me.
:{{A|vo zllq104 7 jiu 10.ogg}} '''Jiu:''' No... no...
:{{A|vo zllq104 7 kunjun 25.ogg}} '''Kun Jun:''' I am the remnants of Azhdaha's benevolence, the echo of a contract set in stone. I harbor a willingness to go further, a willingness to coexist peacefully with mankind.
:{{A|vo zllq104 7 jiu 11.ogg}} '''Jiu:''' No, no! It is I, Azhdaha, forged of elemental crystal, bearer of the weight and memories of the earth, older than the mountains and the oceans that decides! I will not swear allegiance to this insect!
:{{A|vo zllq104 7 kunjun 26.ogg}} '''Kun Jun:''' Morax is not an insect.
:{{A|vo zllq104 7 jiu 12.ogg}} '''Jiu:''' A lord over insects is nothing but an insect in turn!
:{{A|vo zllq104 7 kunjun 27.ogg}} '''Kun Jun:''' You forgot yourself. Nobody held Morax in higher regard than you or I.
:{{A|vo zllq104 7 kunjun 28.ogg}} '''Kun Jun:''' That which you have forgotten, I hold here in my heart. If you are the memory of the earth... then I am the memory of coexistence... of coexistence with humanity.
:{{A|vo zllq104 7 kunjun 29.ogg}} '''Kun Jun:''' All powers under heaven,<ref group="Note">{{zh|天动万象|rm=tiān dòng wàn xiàng|tl=all powers under heaven}} is Zhongli's signature elemental burst voice-over in Chinese, being the voice-over used in his [https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1hD4y1X7Rm Character Demo]. The [https://youtu.be/4oBpaBEMBIM English version] uses "I will have order!" for Zhongli's elemental burst voice-over, which is not a direct translation of the CN version. The translation used by Kun Jun is a more accurate translation.</ref> rise and fall of land and sea...
:{{A|vo zllq104 7 jiu 13.ogg}} '''Jiu:''' ...A star appears within the wild... a sun ascends as bright as... jade...
:{{A|vo zllq104 7 zhongli 07.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' ...
:{{A|vo zllq104 7 jiu 14.ogg}} '''Jiu:''' Strange... What... what is this feeling? And all this...
:{{A|vo zllq104 7 kunjun 30.ogg}} '''Kun Jun:''' You are spent, and I will soon disappear. Before I do, heed these words.
:{{A|vo zllq104 7 kunjun 31.ogg}} '''Kun Jun:''' In the wilderness, snow falls on a spring day. In an instant it will melt. Even where it is fleeting and leaves no trace. Even where it will never fall again...
:{{A|vo zllq104 7 jiu 15.ogg}} '''Jiu:''' No, that isn't true! I don't accept this as fate!
:{{A|vo zllq104 7 kunjun 32.ogg}} '''Kun Jun:''' Perhaps it isn't. But it remains... an inevitable misfortune.
:{{A|vo zllq104 7 jiu 16.ogg}} '''Jiu:''' Mor... ax...
:{{A|vo zllq104 7 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' The little girl vanished...
:{{DIcon}} Sealed away?
:{{DIcon}} Eroded?
:{{A|vo zllq104 7 zhongli 08.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Are you satisfied, Azhdaha?
:{{A|vo zllq104 7 kunjun 33.ogg}} '''Kun Jun:''' I had to make amends. Satisfaction had no part in it.
:{{A|vo zllq104 7 kunjun 34.ogg}} '''Kun Jun:''' So, Morax... you call yourself Zhongli these days?
:{{A|vo zllq104 7 zhongli 09.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' I do.
:{{A|vo zllq104 7 kunjun 35.ogg}} '''Kun Jun:''' Well, I'm afraid old habits die hard. To me, you're Morax.
:{{A|vo zllq104 7 zhongli 10.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' As you please.
:{{A|vo zllq104 7 kunjun 36.ogg}} '''Kun Jun:''' I never did forget your gift of sight.
:{{A|vo zllq104 7 zhongli 11.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' I hardly lifted a finger. Think nothing of it.
:{{A|vo zllq104 7 kunjun 37.ogg}} '''Kun Jun:''' And yet you could see. You wouldn't know the yearning of a blind dragon, searching for the sun. A pair of eyes, from Morax to Azhdaha. This... I will remember this.
:{{A|vo zllq104 7 kunjun 38.ogg}} '''Kun Jun:''' ...
:{{A|vo zllq104 7 zhongli 12.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Your power is nearly spent.
:{{A|vo zllq104 7 kunjun 39.ogg}} '''Kun Jun:''' ...Perceptive as always, my friend.
:{{A|vo zllq104 7 zhongli 13.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Shall we get going, you and I?
:{{A|vo zllq104 7 kunjun 40.ogg}} '''Kun Jun:''' Surely the pressing matter is still that of the miners trapped outside the seal?
:{{A|vo zllq104 7 zhongli 14.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Indeed. Hence the need to get going, to fix the damage left in your wake.
:{{A|vo zllq104 7 kunjun 41.ogg}} '''Kun Jun:''' Ha... straight down to business, as always. Let's go.
{{Dialogue End}}

:{{A|vo zllq104 8 uncledai 01.ogg}} '''[[Uncle Dai]]:''' So there you are! My men and I found your clues and followed them straight here.
:{{A|vo zllq104 8 uncledai 02.ogg}} '''Uncle Dai:''' We found Mao in a tent at the campsite unconscious! It seems he'll be okay. Sadly, we found no trace of the other three...
:{{A|vo zllq104 8 uncledai 03.ogg}} '''Uncle Dai:''' Huh? Young Kun, wh—what is...?
:{{A|vo zllq104 8 kunjun 01.ogg}} '''Kun Jun:''' Nothing, pay it no mind. Those three miners are over in that cave there.
:{{A|vo zllq104 8 uncledai 04.ogg}} '''Uncle Dai:''' Cave? What happened!?
:{{A|vo zllq104 8 zhongli 01.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' They're exhausted, but not in danger. Don't worry.
:{{A|vo zllq104 8 uncledai 05.ogg}} '''Uncle Dai:''' R—Right, well... Thank you, all of you! I better go and see how they're doing.
:{{A|vo zllq104 8 kunjun 02.ogg}} '''Kun Jun:''' So you're taking them back to Liyue Harbor?
:{{A|vo zllq104 8 uncledai 06.ogg}} '''Uncle Dai:''' That's right!
:{{A|vo zllq104 8 kunjun 03.ogg}} '''Kun Jun:''' Can I come with you?
:{{A|vo zllq104 8 uncledai 07.ogg}} '''Uncle Dai:''' No problem! You rescued my men. I'll be happy to assist all of you in any way I can. I'll be back soon, I need to assess their condition.
:{{A|vo zllq104 8 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Kun Jun... Oh, uh... we should be calling you Azhdaha... You're coming back to Liyue Harbor too, right?
:{{A|vo zllq104 8 kunjun 04.ogg}} '''Kun Jun:''' Not I, merely this body.
:{{A|vo zllq104 8 kunjun 05.ogg}} '''Kun Jun:''' Once I'm gone, the true owner will accompany the miners back to Liyue. Kun Jun hails from a family of famous artisans — he too will be famous in time. It would be a shame for someone of his talent to go missing.
:{{A|vo zllq104 8 zhongli 02.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' You always did have a great admiration for blacksmiths.
:{{A|vo zllq104 8 kunjun 06.ogg}} '''Kun Jun:''' Curious how swords and daggers are blind, yet their creators see so much. Perhaps empathy is mankind's proudest achievement after all?
:{{A|vo zllq104 8 zhongli 03.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Azhdaha. I am no longer the Geo Archon.
:{{A|vo zllq104 8 kunjun 07.ogg}} '''Kun Jun:''' ...I can sense it.
:{{A|vo zllq104 8 zhongli 04.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Today I am just an ordinary citizen of Liyue.
:{{A|vo zllq104 8 kunjun 08.ogg}} '''Kun Jun:''' Even you met such a fate... Let's get the difficult part out of the way. I cannot guarantee that I won't be awoken a second time.
:{{A|vo zllq104 8 zhongli 05.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' No matter. If that day comes to pass, Liyue must prepare itself to face you.
:{{A|vo zllq104 8 kunjun 09.ogg}} '''Kun Jun:''' And how will Liyue fare without Rex Lapis?
:{{A|vo zllq104 8 zhongli 06.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Even without a god above, this remains a nation of men. I was once their god, I ought to be here to witness their rise and fall.
:{{A|vo zllq104 8 kunjun 10.ogg}} '''Kun Jun:''' All life is shaped and then ground away by the endless flow of time. You were always the strongest among us, yet it would seem that even you have been eroded...
:{{A|vo zllq104 8 kunjun 11.ogg}} '''Kun Jun:''' That's unimportant... fate is ordained by heaven. Even if our mission had already concluded, it would be cowardly not to strike out on the road of departure.
:{{A|vo zllq104 8 kunjun 12.ogg}} '''Kun Jun:''' You may live forever, doomed to a lonely existence... yet even this is temporary. When you reach the end of time, those people, those past and future relationships predetermined by fate... They will be waiting for you.
:{{A|vo zllq104 8 zhongli 07.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' I do not pretend to match your rhetoric when it comes to the subject of a life long-lived. I fear that the life of an elemental being is longer than any in this world.
:{{A|vo zllq104 8 kunjun 13.ogg}} '''Kun Jun:''' Were it not so, you would have killed me long ago, and would not be having to face me again now.
:{{A|vo zllq104 8 zhongli 08.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' You've brought a smile to my face. When all is said and done, a reunion between old friends is an auspicious occasion.
:{{A|vo zllq104 8 kunjun 14.ogg}} '''Kun Jun:''' That day in The Chasm? Did you hesitate?
:{{A|vo zllq104 8 zhongli 09.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' A heart of stone is a heart nonetheless. But I am the God of Contracts, and was, for a time, a god of the people of Liyue.
:{{A|vo zllq104 8 kunjun 15.ogg}} '''Kun Jun:''' You chose justice, but did not forsake your kindness. You came to me not as an assassin, and so I was willingly sealed away.
:{{A|vo zllq104 8 zhongli 10.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' The movements of the Earth Dragon can tremble the earth and shake the heavens. With your abilities, even at my full strength, I struggled to confront you, let alone seal you away.
:{{A|vo zllq104 8 kunjun 16.ogg}} '''Kun Jun:''' Hence "my" inception.
:{{A|vo zllq104 8 kunjun 17.ogg}} '''Kun Jun:''' Do not forget that I was there with Liyue's founder. The face may have changed, but the content of the contract remains intact.
:{{A|vo zllq104 8 kunjun 18.ogg}} '''Kun Jun:''' Old friend, God of Contracts. I hereby honor our agreement.
:{{A|vo zllq104 8 zhongli 11.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' ...
:{{A|vo zllq104 8 zhongli 12.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Thank you, Azhdaha.
:{{A|vo zllq104 8 kunjun 19.ogg}} '''Kun Jun:''' My life is nigh on eternal. I will go on with the infinite flow of time. And you, Morax... You too will live for many a day to come.
:{{A|vo zllq104 8 kunjun 20.ogg}} '''Kun Jun:''' ...
:{{A|vo zllq104 8 zhongli 13.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' You're leaving?
:{{A|vo zllq104 8 kunjun 21.ogg}} '''Kun Jun:''' If it is fated, Morax... we will meet again.

;{{Color|menu|A ray of light flies from Kun Jun's body, and just like that, Azhdaha is gone...}}

:{{A|vo zllq104 8 zhongli 14.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Yes. Don't be alarmed, he's only asleep.
:{{A|vo zllq104 8 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Whoa... that was so weird. It was like he... suddenly became another person.

::'''Iron Tongue Tian:''' The voice was sometimes sad and songlike, other times it was loud and thunderous. The Lord of Geo searched here and there before finally unearthing a strange stone from the bedrock.

::'''Iron Tongue Tian:''' The dragon accompanied the Lord of Geo, fighting campaigns alongside him in the four corners of the world. We have a saying to eulogize these events:
::'''Iron Tongue Tian:''' "The crash of a spear brought billowing dust"
::'''Iron Tongue Tian:''' "The mountains and waters made way at the sound"
::'''Iron Tongue Tian:''' "The sight of a dragon bestowed with a touch"
::'''Iron Tongue Tian:''' "The promise of rainwater blessing the ground"

;(Talk to Zhongli)
:{{A|vo zllq104 9 zhongli 01.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' A thousand years ago, Azhdaha attacked The Chasm. I tried to obstruct him, fighting him tooth and nail down the length and breadth of the mine. Finally, I brought him down, and sealed him underground.
:{{A|vo zllq104 9 zhongli 02.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' During that battle, Dragonfall was born. Azhdaha could sense the stone. Subconsciously, he wanted to use it to find me.
:{{A|vo zllq104 9 zhongli 03.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Despite being the victor, I could not claim to be stronger than he. And in his heart, he still retained an ounce of good will towards me... towards Liyue... towards life above ground.
:{{A|vo zllq104 9 zhongli 04.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' He was willing to be sealed away. But as the erosion set in... he forgot.
:{{DIcon}} The power of erosion is... scary.
:{{DIcon}} Have you also been affected by erosion?
:{{A|vo zllq104 9 zhongli 05.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Even I cannot avoid it. But there is something I understand better than most: When the door opens, it is time to leave.
:{{A|vo zllq104 9 zhongli 06.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' The greater the power, the greater the danger erosion may bring about. The millennia may come and go, but even a stone may tire.
:{{DIcon}} Is that why you chose to leave...?
:{{DIcon}} Is that why you chose to step down as the Geo Archon...?
:{{A|vo zllq104 9 zhongli 07.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Personally sealing away an old friend... this is just one form of erosion I have endured.
:{{A|vo zllq104 9 zhongli 08.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' People abandon and surrender the things they love to pursue the right path. Perhaps this is the erosion imposed on me by the [[Heavenly Principles]].
:{{A|vo zllq104 9 zhongli 09.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' But I was a god of mankind. My identity may change, but my eyes will bear witness to the history of humanity.
:{{A|vo zllq104 9 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You still care a lot about Liyue...
:{{A|vo zllq104 9 zhongli 10.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Call it... part of my duty.
:{{A|vo zllq104 9 zhongli 11.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' I must thank you both.
:{{A|vo zllq104 9 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' No worries!
:{{DIcon}} Hold on.
::{{DIcon}} I want to ask you something.<!--Two-liner, not two options-->
:{{A|vo zllq104 9 zhongli 12.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Oh? About what?
:{{DIcon}} About my {{MC|sister|brother|mc=1}}.
:{{A|vo zllq104 9 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh yeah! Paimon nearly forgot!
:{{A|vo zllq104 9 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So, not long ago we met a guy called [[Dainsleif|Dain]].
:{{A|vo zllq104 9 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' He told us about [[Khaenri'ah]] and the [[Cataclysm|punishment of the gods]]... That's when we realized that those events... were connected to the person we're searching for.
:{{DIcon}} [[Traveler's Sibling|My sibling]].
:{{DIcon}} This is crucial for me.
:{{A|vo zllq104 9 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Zhongli, you're a god. You've lived through thousands of years of history. Surely you experienced the incident.
:{{A|vo zllq104 9 zhongli 13.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' ...
:{{A|vo zllq104 9 zhongli 14.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' ......
:{{A|vo zllq104 9 zhongli 15.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' I cannot say.
:{{A|vo zllq104 9 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Why!?
:{{DIcon}} ...
:{{A|vo zllq104 9 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You can't even give us a thread of information? This is so important to us!
:{{A|vo zllq104 9 zhongli 16.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' I understand, but I must apologize. This is my contract.
:{{A|vo zllq104 9 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You mean, another past grievance? Like the incident with Azhdaha? Too painful to talk about?
:{{A|vo zllq104 9 zhongli 17.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' It was signed before it all began. I have always honored the contract... and kept my silence.
:{{A|vo zllq104 9 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' ...How can you be like that...!?

===An Exasperating Prank===
{{Quest Description|You know that it might not be fruitful even if you pursue it to the end, so you decide to forget about the Wisdom Seelie's prank and watch over Layla as she rests.}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915602 layla 01.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Let's stop here... I don't think I can walk any further...
:{{DIcon}} I'll prepare some food and juice.
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915602 layla 02.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Alright, I'm gonna give my legs a rest. I'll be waiting for you here.
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915602 layla 03.ogg}} '''Layla:''' I feel bad for making you go through so much trouble for me. If only I were more capable...
:{{DIcon}} No, you shouldn't say that.
:{{DIcon}} We're all skilled at different things.
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915602 layla 04.ogg}} '''Layla:''' I'm sorry... *sigh* I always find myself having to apologize.
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915602 layla 05.ogg}} '''Layla:''' But enough of that, I need to pull myself together. The memories I've been reminded of are all really taxing.
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915602 layla 06.ogg}} '''Layla:''' I cannot just give up this time, even if my head's not in a good place. Letting these heavy feelings get the best of me will only slow us down.
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915602 layla 07.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Ahh, watch out! Behind you!
:{{DIcon}} What's wrong?
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915602 layla 08.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Monsters! A lot of them, too... Why didn't we see them coming?
:{{DIcon}} Just leave it to me, it'll only take a moment.
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915602 layla 09.ogg}} '''Layla:''' No, I'll fight, too.
:{{DIcon}} You need to rest.
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915602 layla 10.ogg}} '''Layla:''' But I want to help, I can't just sit back and watch you while you fight. Don't worry, I can handle myself.
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915602 layla 11.ogg}} '''Layla:''' I mustn't keep repeating my past regrets. That's the most valuable lesson I've learned today.
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915602 layla 12.ogg}} '''Layla:''' I should take action when I'm needed and give it my all when the moment calls.
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915602 layla 13.ogg}} '''Layla:''' If you miss those opportunities in life, you may never get another chance to make up for them. I suppose that's fate.
:{{DIcon}} I see.
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915602 layla 14.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Alright, let's take them all down.

;(Defeat the attacking monsters)

;(Talk to Layla)
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915606 layla 01.ogg}} '''Layla:''' *panting* ...I really need to keep up with my training.
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915606 layla 02.ogg}} '''Layla:''' It's embarrassing to be out of breath so quickly like this...
:{{DIcon}} Are you alright?
:{{DIcon}} You look pale.
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915606 layla 03.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Well, the only appropriate response would be to say that I'm fine, right? I'm pale due to lack of sleep, not because of the fight...
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915606 layla 04.ogg}} '''Layla:''' But then again, I know you'd be able to see right through those words... I'm feeling weak, there's no hiding it.
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915606 layla 05.ogg}} '''Layla:''' I'm just happy I didn't get in your way during the fight...
:{{DIcon}} You did great.
;(Stress Value −1)
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915606 layla 06.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Oh, hehe... thanks for the compliment. I sure don't get to hear that often.
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915606 layla 07.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Although I may not be physically strong, my will is as resilient as they come. I'll be fine after I rest for a bit.
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915606 layla 08.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Can you stay with me while I recover my energy? It shouldn't take long.
{{Dialogue End}}

:{{A|vo dyzlq001 6 chamboduc 19.ogg}} '''Chamboduc:''' Are you sure you don't want more? These opportunities don't come by every day, you know.
:{{A|vo dyzlq001 6 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' It's alright! Two will do.
:{{DIcon}} I never thought you'd turn down a chance to freeload...
:{{A|vo dyzlq001 6 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Eh, it just doesn't feel the same if the owner's offering everything to you for free!
:{{A|vo dyzlq001 6 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' But anyway, we don't need to get into that right now. We can discuss Paimonology later — that poor guy must still be waiting for us.
:{{A|vo dyzlq001 6 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Thank you so much! We'll be off, then.
:{{A|vo dyzlq001 6 chamboduc 20.ogg}} '''Chamboduc:''' No problem, and thank you for your patronage! I'd appreciate it if you could put in a nice word for our establishment the next time you speak to His Grace.
:{{A|vo dyzlq001 6 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' That's a real sneaky way of getting good reviews...

;(Obtain [[Hat]])
:{{A|vo dyzlq001 6 paimon 12.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' We've been gone awhile... Paimon hopes that guy in the box hasn't passed out from lack of air.

;(Talk to Chamboduc again, optional)
:{{A|vo dialog dyzlq001 chamboduc 01.ogg}} '''Chamboduc:''' Please come again! And don't forget to mention us to Your Grace!

:{{DIcon|!}} Knock on the Chest
:{{A|vo dyzlq001 7 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You can come out now! We've found your hat.
:{{A|vo dyzlq001 7 faissolle 01.ogg}} '''Faissolle:''' You did? Oh, Archons, you've just saved my life! Just one sec...
:{{A|vo dyzlq001 7 faissolle 02.ogg}} '''Faissolle:''' Hmm... Uhh...
:{{A|vo dyzlq001 7 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wait, so you're not actually bald? You've got such a full head of hair, too!
:{{A|vo dyzlq001 7 faissolle 03.ogg}} '''Faissolle:''' *sigh* I mean, I told you that there had been a misunderstanding... This has nothing to do with my hair.
:{{A|vo dyzlq001 7 faissolle 04.ogg}} '''Faissolle:''' Wait, this isn't my hat...
:{{A|vo dyzlq001 7 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Well, we got you a new one! We tried really hard to look for your hat, but no dice.
:{{DIcon}} To be precise, someone else gave it to us...
:{{A|vo dyzlq001 7 faissolle 05.ogg}} '''Faissolle:''' Ah, I see... Thank you so much. I'm really grateful, but unfortunately, there's just something special about my hat...
:{{A|vo dyzlq001 7 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Does it have some kind of sentimental value?
:{{A|vo dyzlq001 7 faissolle 06.ogg}} '''Faissolle:''' Well, um...
:{{A|vo dyzlq001 7 faissolle 07.ogg}} '''Faissolle:''' Sorry, I can't... explain at the moment. Time's tight as well, so I suppose I'll keep looking for a while...
:{{A|vo dyzlq001 7 wriothesley 01.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' If you're looking for a hat, I just picked one up over here. Is it yours?
:{{A|vo dyzlq001 7 faissolle 08.ogg}} '''Faissolle:''' Your Grace!?
:{{A|vo dyzlq001 7 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, hey, Wriothesley! It's been a while.
:{{A|vo dyzlq001 7 wriothesley 02.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' It's a slow day today, so I decided to go for a little stroll. Even if your work space isn't cramped, it's still good to get some air.
:{{A|vo dyzlq001 7 wriothesley 03.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' I'll say, I'm not at all surprised to find the two of you here. You never could turn down someone's request for help.
:{{A|vo dyzlq001 7 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hehe, it's what good adventurers do, after all!
:{{A|vo dyzlq001 7 wriothesley 04.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' Is that so... Maybe I should consider asking the Adventurers' Guild to open a branch here.
:{{A|vo dyzlq001 7 wriothesley 05.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' As I recall, these hats are very important to members of the Beret Society. Best you avoid misplacing it again, hmm?
:{{A|vo dyzlq001 7 wriothesley 06.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' You might not have the same luck next time.
:{{A|vo dyzlq001 7 faissolle 09.ogg}} '''Faissolle:''' Understood. Th—Thank you so much, Your Grace.
:{{A|vo dyzlq001 7 faissolle 10.ogg}} '''Faissolle:''' Then... Then I'll be off. Umm... I—I'll get going now.
:{{A|vo dyzlq001 7 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What a strange guy... Why'd he care so much about his hat?
:{{A|vo dyzlq001 7 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, and has he done something wrong? When he saw you, it was as if he'd seen a ghost.
:{{A|vo dyzlq001 7 wriothesley 07.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' Oh, not at all. In fact, members of the Beret Society are model prisoners. They work hard and never get into trouble — they've saved me a lot of work, in fact.
:{{A|vo dyzlq001 7 wriothesley 08.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' As for him... I'd guess he's just more of an introvert. It's not unusual for the more shy prisoners to freak out when I show up unannounced.
:{{A|vo dyzlq001 7 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh? Shy? There are prisoners who are... afraid to talk to people?
:{{A|vo dyzlq001 7 wriothesley 09.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' Prisoners are still people, after all. There are as many crimes and motives as there are stars in the sky.
:{{A|vo dyzlq001 7 wriothesley 10.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' The idea of the criminal as a selfish, heartless brute is just a stereotype. Such labels could never capture the complexity of even a single individual person.
:{{A|vo dyzlq001 7 wriothesley 11.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' What kind of a person a prisoner may be, and why they have committed a crime — we'd never know these things if they don't share their story with us.
:{{A|vo dyzlq001 7 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh, you've got a point... Anyway, it's all good as long as it makes sense to you.
:{{DIcon}} What's this "Beret Society"?
:{{DIcon}} There are people here who enjoy working?
:{{A|vo dyzlq001 7 wriothesley 12.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' Although most of the societies here will just turn individual brawls into mass ones...
:{{A|vo dyzlq001 7 wriothesley 13.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' The Beret Society does appear to be an exception in that it's instead trying to experiment with some novel and interesting things.
:{{A|vo dyzlq001 7 wriothesley 14.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' If you have some time, why don't we grab something at the Coupon Cafeteria? It'll give us some time to catch up, too.
:{{A|vo dyzlq001 7 wriothesley 15.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' And if you're still interested in the Berets after that, I can take you to their usual gathering place as well.
:{{A|vo dyzlq001 7 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Paimon's not the biggest fan of that cafeteria, but if we're gonna catch up...
:{{DIcon}} Let's go, then.
:{{A|vo dyzlq001 7 wriothesley 16.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' Alright then, please follow me.
{{Dialogue End}}

:{{A|vo dyzlq001 8 wolsey 01.ogg}} '''Wolsey:''' Welcome, Your Grace, and the Traveler. Would you like three orders of today's Welfare Meal?

:{{A|vo dyzlq001 8 wriothesley 01.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' I'll pass on the food, then. What about you?
:{{DIcon}} I'm not hungry.
:{{DIcon}} Super Deluxe or bust.
:{{A|vo dyzlq001 8 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' ...Then, Paimon will also pass. Paimon will save her stomach for something better!
:{{A|vo dyzlq001 8 wriothesley 02.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' What a pity... It would seem that none of us can properly appreciate your skills, Wolsey.
:{{A|vo dyzlq001 8 wolsey 03.ogg}} '''Wolsey:''' Haha, then I must beg Your Grace to find me some more ingredients, so I can come up with some more Welfare Meal recipes.
:{{A|vo dyzlq001 8 wolsey 04.ogg}} '''Wolsey:''' If you're not in the mood to eat, I can get you some drinks. We just got some great shipments in from above.
:{{A|vo dyzlq001 8 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yes please! Huh, Paimon didn't know you could get non-Welfare stuff at this place.
:{{A|vo dyzlq001 8 wolsey 05.ogg}} '''Wolsey:''' Haha, it's not for everyone. Think of it as a special treat for VIPs.
:{{A|vo dyzlq001 8 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ooh, now that's what Paimon likes to hear! In that case, two bottles of the drink for Paimon, please!
:{{A|vo dyzlq001 8 wolsey 06.ogg}} '''Wolsey:''' Two bottles, coming right up!
:{{Black Screen|After a while, Wolsey brings out the drinks for everyone.}}
:{{A|vo dyzlq001 8 wriothesley 03.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' Our first meeting took place on short notice, and we were both swamped by everything that happened after, so there was no time for more casual chit-chat.
:{{A|vo dyzlq001 8 wriothesley 04.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' I'm actually quite fond of stories, you know. Of course, the others have already told me a lot about your deeds in Fontaine, but I'd love to hear it straight from the source.
:{{A|vo dyzlq001 8 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Whoa, that'd be quite the long story...
:{{DIcon}} We fought tooth and nail for the sake of justice.
::{{A|vo dyzlq001 8 wriothesley 05a 1.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' Impressive. Not all who possess the courage to risk their life for their ideals also have the strength to make it out unscathed.
::{{A|vo dyzlq001 8 wriothesley 05a 2.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' Had you not possessed these remarkable qualities, I probably wouldn't have had the chance to make your acquaintance in the first place.
:{{DIcon}} I'm still trying to learn more about Fontaine.
::{{A|vo dyzlq001 8 wriothesley 05b 1.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' I see. Certainly, that'd fit your title as the Traveler.
::{{A|vo dyzlq001 8 wriothesley 05b 2.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' Seeing everything for yourself, recording everything to the best of your ability, and making lots of friends along the way... I'm sure that by the end of your journey, you'll possess an unmatched amount of perspectives and opportunities.
:{{DIcon}} To be honest, I really wasn't that involved with a lot of it...
::{{A|vo dyzlq001 8 wriothesley 05c 1.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' Haha, that's a bit too humble for you.
::{{A|vo dyzlq001 8 wriothesley 05c 2.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' Even the most unintentional action can catalyze new developments, and force many fates onto brand new paths.
:{{A|vo dyzlq001 8 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Paimon gets the sense that you're trying to flatter us...
:{{A|vo dyzlq001 8 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' That guy we talked to earlier was obviously trying to get us to put in a good word for him, but you're the Duke, right? Why would you need to get on our good side?
:{{A|vo dyzlq001 8 wriothesley 06.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' Well, after all, you did help the Fortress and I maintain our autonomy.
:{{A|vo dyzlq001 8 wriothesley 07.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' Is it so strange that I would want to give a few words of praise out of genuine admiration?
:{{DIcon}} Just a little bit.
:{{DIcon}} It's because you don't ever talk about yourself.
:{{A|vo dyzlq001 8 wriothesley 08.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' Ah, so this is a matter of trust. Which is unfortunate, since I don't have nearly as interesting of a story to offer about myself.
:{{A|vo dyzlq001 8 wriothesley 09.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' I was convicted and sent here at an early age. I only became the top dog after spending a long time figuring out its inner workings.
:{{A|vo dyzlq001 8 wriothesley 10.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' Power and control come in many forms, some fair and ethical, others less so. And since we're all sinners here, the victor calls the shots, no matter how they managed to get to the top.
:{{A|vo dyzlq001 8 wriothesley 11.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' So, what do you think? Didn't put you much more at ease, now did it?
:{{A|vo dyzlq001 8 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Uh, kinda... You're really different from most of the people we've met so far...
:{{A|vo dyzlq001 8 wriothesley 12.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' Haha, I'm perfectly aware of that, too. But even so, that doesn't make me think any less of you.
:{{A|vo dyzlq001 8 wriothesley 13.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' I would very much like to maintain friendly relations with you two.
:{{DIcon}} That's how I feel as well.
:{{DIcon}} I must thank you for your generosity, but...
:{{A|vo dyzlq001 8 guelet 01.ogg}} '''Guelet:''' Your Grace, after following your instructions, we were able to find a box of undeclared contraband in the latest shipment of cargo.
:{{A|vo dyzlq001 8 guelet 02.ogg}} '''Guelet:''' They were extremely well-hidden, and we've confirmed that the senders have been using this method to smuggle goods for a while. We're trying to trace the goods to their source.
:{{A|vo dyzlq001 8 wriothesley 14.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' Got it. Leave the box here, and contact me immediately if you make any progress. You're dismissed.
:{{A|vo dyzlq001 8 guelet 03.ogg}} '''Guelet:''' Yes, Your Grace.
:{{A|vo dyzlq001 8 wriothesley 15.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' Sorry, I'd almost completely forgotten about this.
:{{A|vo dyzlq001 8 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' She mentioned something about "contraband." Are they like, dangerous goods?
:{{A|vo dyzlq001 8 wriothesley 16.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' Not necessarily. The term is just applied to things people want to bring in on the sly.
:{{A|vo dyzlq001 8 wriothesley 17.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' Many people here are experts at pulling rabbits out of the most ordinary hats, so we have to examine everything carefully.
:{{A|vo dyzlq001 8 wriothesley 18.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' Now, what do we have here... Hmm, it's more or less what I expected.
:{{A|vo dyzlq001 8 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Whoa, this is certainly a box of curiosities! Mora, snacks, yarn balls, ropes, mechanical parts, and even a gem!
:{{A|vo dyzlq001 8 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wait, if you've confiscated this entire box, then does that mean... all of this belongs to you now?
:{{A|vo dyzlq001 8 wriothesley 19.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' Yep. We can't just send them back up now, can we?
:{{A|vo dyzlq001 8 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Whaaaat? But that's just insane profit! {{Traveler}}, why don't you become a Duke as well?
:{{DIcon}} And what about you, Paimon?
::{{A|vo dyzlq001 8 paimon 12a 1.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Paimon will be your vault-keeper!
:{{DIcon}} Let's get that title, then.
::{{A|vo dyzlq001 8 wriothesley 20b 1.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' It's only been a couple minutes since we agreed to continue friendly relations with each other, and you're already planning to overthrow me?
:{{A|vo dyzlq001 8 wriothesley 21.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' Jokes aside, I didn't know you would be so interested in this box. How about this, then? You can pick anything you want from it. Consider it a gift from me.
:{{A|vo dyzlq001 8 paimon 13.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Really? You'll let Paimon pick anything?
:{{A|vo dyzlq001 8 paimon 14.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' No takebacks! Paimon will have you know that she's got a real good eye for treasure!
:{{A|vo dyzlq001 8 wriothesley 22.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' I never joke about things like this.
:{{A|vo dyzlq001 8 paimon 15.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Alright... Paimon's gonna have a look...
:{{A|vo dyzlq001 8 paimon 16.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Paimon wants... this one! This dark, sparkly gem — you just know it must be worth a ton of Mora!
:{{A|vo dyzlq001 8 paimon 17.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Umm... Uhh...
:{{A|vo dyzlq001 8 paimon 18.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Actually, never mind. Paimon doesn't want this gem anymore... Can Paimon pick something else instead?
:{{DIcon}} Paimon, what's wrong?

:{{A|vo dyzlq001 8 wriothesley 23.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' Is that so? Let me give it a try.

:{{DIcon}} My constitution is a bit different from everyone else's.

:{{Black Screen|You explain your chance encounter with Kaeya in Sumeru to Jean and Lisa.}}

:{{A|vo kycop001 1909502 kaeya 02.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' Just doing my duty — anything to reduce the Acting Grand Master's workload. Oh, I nearly forgot. I have some unused travel funds. I'll return the surplus now.

:{{A|vo kycop001 1909502 qin 04.ogg}} '''Jean:''' Given the suddenness of the situation, and the difficulty in resolving it, I authorized a greater than normal disbursement in case of unforeseen circumstances.
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909502 qin 05.ogg}} '''Jean:''' But I didn't think there would be this much left over. Thank you, Kaeya.
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909502 kaeya 03.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' Just doing the right thing. But I'm not actually here for a post-trip debrief. I brought some souvenirs back for everyone.
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909502 lisa 02.ogg}} '''Lisa:''' Souvenirs from Sumeru?
:[[File:Souvenirs from Sumeru.png|200px]]

:{{A|vo kycop001 1909502 qin 11.ogg}} '''Jean:''' You too, Honorary Knight. There isn't any work the Knights of Favonius require your assistance with at this time, so please take it easy.
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909502 kaeya 10.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' Thank you, then we'll be going now.
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909502 lisa 05.ogg}} '''Lisa:''' Enjoy your vacation. But don't forget to return [[The Fox in the Dandelion Sea]] series before it's due.
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909502 kaeya 11.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' Don't worry, I'm nearly done with those. I'll be able to return them in a few days.

:{{A|Vo jyeq101 2 lepinepauline 12.ogg}} '''Lepine-Pauline:''' Miss [[Navia]]!
:{{A|Vo jyeq101 2 lepinepauline 13.ogg}} '''Lepine-Pauline:''' Allow me to introduce the star behind all the work that's gone into this venue — Miss Navia, President of Fontaine's [[Spina di Rosula]]!
:{{A|Vo jyeq101 2 navia 02.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Hello, everyone! Partner, Paimon, how have you been lately?
:{{DIcon}} Ah, my trusty partner!
:{{DIcon}} Very well, thanks. Even better now that you're here.
:{{A|Vo jyeq101 2 kinich 05.ogg}} '''Kinich:''' Hello there, I'm Kinich.
:{{A|Vo jyeq101 2 ajaw 08.ogg}} '''Ajaw:''' ...What about me, what about ME? My useless servant can't even give me a proper introduction...
:{{A|Vo jyeq101 2 kinich 06.ogg}} '''Kinich:''' You think someone yelling their name out in the middle of a public street really needs an introduction?
:{{A|Vo jyeq101 2 navia 03.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Hahaha, he's not wrong! I caught yours just now, in fact.
:{{A|Vo jyeq101 2 navia 04.ogg}} '''Navia:''' So, you must be the Almighty Dragonlord, Mr. Ajaw. It's a pleasure to meet you.
:;(Navia extends her hand)
:;(Everyone awkwardly pauses as Ajaw does not react to the extended hand)
:;(Navia retracts her hand)
:{{A|Vo jyeq101 2 ajaw 09.ogg}} '''Ajaw:''' See that? That's what I call proper manners!
:{{A|Vo jyeq101 2 ajaw 10.ogg}} '''Ajaw:''' Well, well, it's not every day you meet a well-mannered human. Navia, was it? Excellent. You may address the Almighty Dragonlord by his name!
:{{A|Vo jyeq101 2 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Umm, Navia, don't you think the title "Almighty Dragonlord" is a bit... silly? Hehe...
:{{A|Vo jyeq101 2 navia 05.ogg}} '''Navia:''' It's no big deal! All little animals do that, don't they? I mean, try to puff themselves up to look more impressive?
:{{DIcon}} Ajaw's totally being treated like a little cuddly pet..
:{{A|Vo jyeq101 2 lepinepauline 14.ogg}} '''Lepine-Pauline:''' Anyway, it's all thanks to Miss Navia and the Spina di Rosula that Fantasyland's gotten up and running in the space of a single night.
:{{A|Vo jyeq101 2 lepinepauline 15.ogg}} '''Lepine-Pauline:''' Ah, honestly, thank heavens! After all that paperwork and endless waiting, the event and venue finally got the green light... *sobs*
:{{A|Vo jyeq101 2 lepinepauline 16.ogg}} '''Lepine-Pauline:''' I couldn't wait a moment longer! The second the approval came through, I reached out to President Navia, hoping she could lend a hand.
:{{A|Vo jyeq101 2 lepinepauline 17.ogg}} '''Lepine-Pauline:''' After all, who else but the Spina di Rosula would indulge such impulsive demands... *sobs*
:{{A|Vo jyeq101 2 navia 06.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Sorry, {{Traveler}}. Miss Lepine-Pauline sometimes gets a bit overwhelmed by her own excitement, as you can see...
:{{A|Vo jyeq101 2 navia 07.ogg}} '''Navia:''' I'm guessing she hasn't gone into much detail about the event yet, so let me fill you in.
:{{A|Vo jyeq101 2 navia 08.ogg}} '''Navia:''' In short, the Chevalmarin Film Fantasyland is a fan convention that's open to film enthusiasts from all over Teyvat. Miss Lepine-Pauline is hosting this event and also providing technical support.
:{{A|Vo jyeq101 2 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh? Chevalmarin?
:{{A|Vo jyeq101 2 lepinepauline 18.ogg}} '''Lepine-Pauline:''' That's right, the one and only [[Salon Solitaire|Surintendante Chevalmarin]]!
:{{A|Vo jyeq101 2 lepinepauline 19.ogg}} '''Lepine-Pauline:''' After much persistence and many solicitations, I finally obtained Lady [[Furina]]'s permission to use the image of her close friend.
:{{A|Vo jyeq101 2 lepinepauline 20.ogg}} '''Lepine-Pauline:''' Not only is our adorable mascot drawing in fans by the minute, but she's also boosting her own popularity — and that was always the goal, a win-win arrangement!
:{{A|Vo jyeq101 2 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' It's been a while since we last met, but still, it's a surprise to hear Lepine-Pauline coming out with such... sensible ideas...
:{{A|Vo jyeq101 2 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' By the way, Miss Lepine-Pauline, have you decided to switch careers and go into film tech?
:{{A|Vo jyeq101 2 lepinepauline 21.ogg}} '''Lepine-Pauline:''' Mm, not exactly. By chance, one of the prototype lenses I developed caught a photographer's eye, and it's now being used for the latest cinematic productions.
:{{A|Vo jyeq101 2 lepinepauline 22.ogg}} '''Lepine-Pauline:''' Thanks to this unexpected opportunity, I've had the chance to invent various film-related equipment and props.
:{{A|Vo jyeq101 2 navia 09.ogg}} '''Navia:''' That's right, so don't underestimate Miss Lepine-Pauline, our resident engineer! She's the technical powerhouse at the core of this entire event.
:{{A|Vo jyeq101 2 navia 10.ogg}} '''Navia:''' As for the Spina di Rosula, we're mainly here to take care of planning, operations, and management.
:{{A|Vo jyeq101 2 navia 11.ogg}} '''Navia:''' For anyone feeling inspired to set up a booth, Miss Lepine-Pauline and I will provide the necessary technical and operational support once their application has been approved.
:{{A|Vo jyeq101 2 navia 12.ogg}} '''Navia:''' By the way, {{Traveler}}, are you at all interested in taking part?
:{{A|Vo jyeq101 2 navia 13.ogg}} '''Navia:''' It would be a chance for you to earn some extra income. Plus, with your skills, I'm sure you could bring something special to the table!
:{{DIcon}} Sounds like a lot of fun.
:{{DIcon}} I'll think about it.
:{{A|Vo jyeq101 2 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Paimon would be even more tempted if you were to, say, throw in one of those fancy feasts she's seen in those gourmet food reels!
:{{A|Vo jyeq101 2 lepinepauline 23.ogg}} '''Lepine-Pauline:''' Well, as it happens, that'll be a piece of cake!
:{{A|Vo jyeq101 2 lepinepauline 24.ogg}} '''Lepine-Pauline:''' Everyone needs to eat, whether they be tourists or the stall owners themselves.
:{{A|Vo jyeq101 2 lepinepauline 25.ogg}} '''Lepine-Pauline:''' So, thanks to Miss Navia's help, we've managed to invite none other than the celebrity chef Miss [[Escoffier]] to run our theme restaurant!
:{{A|Vo jyeq101 2 lepinepauline 26.ogg}} '''Lepine-Pauline:''' Look, over th—
:{{A|Vo jyeq101 2 escoffier 01.ogg}} '''Escoffier:''' You, yes, YOU! For the last time, the ingredients have to be in the right ratio! Get it right next time, or you might as well just lie down on the chopping board yourself!
:{{Introductory Note|Escoffier}}
:{{A|Vo jyeq101 2 lepinepauline 27.ogg}} '''Lepine-Pauline:''' ...Haha, she seems a bit busy right now...
:{{A|Vo jyeq101 2 kinich 07.ogg}} '''Kinich:''' Well, I'm sold. I think I'll make Ajaw go be her assistant.
:{{A|Vo jyeq101 2 ajaw 11.ogg}} '''Ajaw:''' You little... What's your game here?
:{{A|Vo jyeq101 2 rosethronmember 01.ogg}} '''Spina di Rosula Member:''' Demoiselle, sorry to bother you, but there's an issue over here that requires your personal attention!
:{{A|Vo jyeq101 2 navia 14.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Ah, apologies, looks like it's back to work with me. Please feel free to take a gander at what we've got.
:{{A|Vo jyeq101 2 navia 15.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Anyway, {{Traveler}}, if you're interested in taking part, come find me later.
:{{DIcon}} Sure thing.

;(Talk to Escoffier, optional)
:{{A|Vo dialog jyeq101 escoffier 01.ogg}} '''Escoffier:''' The fresh vegetables from the new batch are of exceptional quality. I just wish I could say the same about the new staff...

;(Talk to Lepine-Pauline)
:{{A|Vo jyeq101 3 escoffier 01.ogg}} '''Escoffier:''' Greetings. Apologies if you overheard my harsh words just now, but I assure you it is entirely necessary.
:{{A|Vo jyeq101 3 escoffier 02.ogg}} '''Escoffier:''' The sheer lack of standards here will be the death of me... Do you have any idea of the kind of customers I'm gonna get with how lax things are at the moment?
:{{A|Vo jyeq101 3 escoffier 03.ogg}} '''Escoffier:''' ...The ones that leave their guns behind by accident! And then come back to collect them later, bringing ammunition with them!
:{{A|Vo jyeq101 3 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yeah, that's the kind of customer you wouldn't forget in a hurry...
:{{A|Vo jyeq101 3 lepinepauline 01.ogg}} '''Lepine-Pauline:''' Ah... haha...
:{{A|Vo jyeq101 3 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' ...Wait, has that happened before?
:{{A|Vo jyeq101 3 lepinepauline 02.ogg}} '''Lepine-Pauline:''' No, no, it's just the mention of guns reminded me... Someone did actually leave their gun nearby.
:{{A|Vo jyeq101 3 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh?
:{{A|Vo jyeq101 3 lepinepauline 03.ogg}} '''Lepine-Pauline:''' Just before we started setting up, as we were cleaning up the site, someone stumbled upon a mysterious locked box...
:{{A|Vo jyeq101 3 lepinepauline 04.ogg}} '''Lepine-Pauline:''' It didn't look like something from Fontaine, though. It had more of a... Natlanese vibe?
:{{A|Vo jyeq101 3 kinich 01.ogg}} '''Kinich:''' Oh?
:{{A|Vo jyeq101 3 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' D'you think a foreign tourist might have left it behind?
:{{A|Vo jyeq101 3 lepinepauline 05.ogg}} '''Lepine-Pauline:''' That's what I assumed at first. But the box was buried beneath a pile of wooden planks, rocks, and whatnot, so it seemed like someone deliberately hid it there.
:{{A|Vo jyeq101 3 lepinepauline 06.ogg}} '''Lepine-Pauline:''' But I didn't see much point in speculating, so the best thing I could think of was to hand it over to the authorities.
:{{A|Vo jyeq101 3 lepinepauline 07.ogg}} '''Lepine-Pauline:''' I trekked all the way over to the Palais Mermonia just to hand it in. Ugh, it was exhausting.
:{{A|Vo jyeq101 3 kinich 02.ogg}} '''Kinich:''' What did the authorities make of it?
:{{A|Vo jyeq101 3 lepinepauline 08.ogg}} '''Lepine-Pauline:''' Oh, they made a mountain out of a molehill. As usual.
:{{A|Vo jyeq101 3 lepinepauline 09.ogg}} '''Lepine-Pauline:''' Before even addressing the question of what was actually inside the box, they had several heated discussions about whose responsibility it was to write the lost-and-found notice...
:{{A|Vo jyeq101 3 lepinepauline 10.ogg}} '''Lepine-Pauline:''' Thankfully, the ever-reliable Officer [[Sedene]] stepped up and immediately called in the [[Marechaussee Phantom]] to crack the lock and check if there were any dangerous items inside.
:{{A|Vo jyeq101 3 lepinepauline 11.ogg}} '''Lepine-Pauline:''' And as it turned out, there was — a gun!
:{{A|Vo jyeq101 3 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wow, that's a dangerous item alright...
:{{A|Vo jyeq101 3 kinich 03.ogg}} '''Kinich:''' Mind if I ask what kind of gun it was?
:{{A|Vo jyeq101 3 lepinepauline 12.ogg}} '''Lepine-Pauline:''' Oh yeah, Mr. Kinich, you're from Natlan, aren't you? Do you know a lot about guns?
:{{A|Vo jyeq101 3 kinich 04.ogg}} '''Kinich:''' You could say it comes with the job. I have an interest in weaponry and the like.
:{{A|Vo jyeq101 3 ajaw 01.ogg}} '''Ajaw:''' Ugh, such a spoiled brat. What, are the toys I gave you not good enough for you anymore?
:{{A|Vo jyeq101 3 kinich 05.ogg}} '''Kinich:''' Yep, got sick of those long ago.
:{{A|Vo jyeq101 3 ajaw 02.ogg}} '''Ajaw:''' You little...! How dare you turn your nose up at my gifts! Why, I... Mmph!
:{{A|Vo jyeq101 3 kinich 06.ogg}} '''Kinich:''' Time for a time-out, old timer.
:{{A|Vo jyeq101 3 kinich 07.ogg}} '''Kinich:''' Sorry, where were we? Oh yeah, do you recall what the gun looked like?
:{{A|Vo jyeq101 3 lepinepauline 13.ogg}} '''Lepine-Pauline:''' Uh... It's a bit hard to describe. If you ask me, it didn't even really look like a gun...
:{{A|Vo jyeq101 3 lepinepauline 14.ogg}} '''Lepine-Pauline:''' Oh! Give me a second, I'll knock out a quick sketch...
:{{A|Vo jyeq101 3 lepinepauline 15.ogg}} '''Lepine-Pauline:''' Something like this.
:<gallery widths=370>
An Overnight Fantasyland Quest Still 1.png
</gallery>
:{{A|Vo jyeq101 3 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wow, it's so neat and precise!
:{{DIcon}} Sketched by a professional engineer, after all.
:{{A|Vo jyeq101 3 lepinepauline 16.ogg}} '''Lepine-Pauline:''' Hehe, it's nothing...
:{{A|Vo jyeq101 3 kinich 08.ogg}} '''Kinich:''' ...
:{{A|Vo jyeq101 3 lepinepauline 17.ogg}} '''Lepine-Pauline:''' Uh, sorry... Is something wrong with my drawing...?
:{{A|Vo jyeq101 3 lepinepauline 18.ogg}} '''Lepine-Pauline:''' I know it doesn't really look like a gun, but I assure you, this is exactly what it looked like!
:{{A|Vo jyeq101 3 lepinepauline 19.ogg}} '''Lepine-Pauline:''' And it certainly could shoot as well, too — I confirmed that with the officer from the Marechaussee Phantom.
:{{A|Vo jyeq101 3 kinich 09.ogg}} '''Kinich:''' No, no, quite the opposite. The features are very accurate — and it is definitely from Natlan.
:{{A|Vo jyeq101 3 kinich 10.ogg}} '''Kinich:''' Please, don't mind me, I'm just taking a moment to admire it.
:{{A|Vo jyeq101 3 kinich 11.ogg}} '''Kinich:''' ...
:;(Kinich and the Traveler exchange a look)
:{{DIcon}} Thanks a lot, Lepine-Pauline.
:{{DIcon}} Can't wait for the event to get started.
:{{A|Vo jyeq101 3 lepinepauline 20.ogg}} '''Lepine-Pauline:''' I should be the one thanking you! Thank you, and everyone else, for your support!
:{{A|Vo jyeq101 3 kinich 12.ogg}} '''Kinich:''' Don't mention it. Besides, we haven't really done anything.
:{{A|Vo jyeq101 3 lepinepauline 21.ogg}} '''Lepine-Pauline:''' Not at all! The buzz and excitement you guys bring is exactly what this event needs!
:{{A|Vo jyeq101 3 lepinepauline 22.ogg}} '''Lepine-Pauline:''' Oh dear... I'm starting to feel a bit guilty watching everyone else toil away. Guess it's about time I got back to work too...
:{{A|Vo jyeq101 3 lepinepauline 23.ogg}} '''Lepine-Pauline:''' But just before I go, one last thing! {{Traveler}}, it's wonderful to see you. Here's to a successful collaboration!

:{{A|Vo jyeq101 3 kinich 15.ogg}} '''Kinich:''' Based on my experience, it might be more accurate to refer to it as a "hand cannon." But in Fontaine terms, it's not wrong to call it a "gun."
:{{A|Vo jyeq101 3 kinich 16.ogg}} '''Kinich:''' Given why I came here, don't you think it's curious that an ancient dragon relic of unknown origin would turn up like this, out of the blue? I suspect this gun might have something to do with that smuggling case — it might've slipped through the cracks.
:{{A|Vo jyeq101 3 kinich 17.ogg}} '''Kinich:''' Time is of the essence, so I'd like to head over to the Palais Mermonia to verify my suspicions.
:{{DIcon}} I think I'll join you.
:{{A|Vo jyeq101 3 kinich 18.ogg}} '''Kinich:''' Perfect. Then we can head out right away.
:{{A|Vo jyeq101 3 kinich 19.ogg}} '''Kinich:''' Or, if you want to catch up with your friends first, I can wait.

:{{A|Vo jyeq101 9 olorun 10.ogg}} '''Ororon:''' You're a big boy. You can handle yourself now, even without Cacucu.
:{{A|Vo jyeq101 9 ifa 11.ogg}} '''Ifa:''' You think that's what I'm worried about!?
:{{A|Vo jyeq101 9 ifa 12.ogg}} '''Ifa:''' Anyway, my priority right now is Cacucu...
:{{A|Vo jyeq101 9 ifa 13.ogg}} '''Ifa:''' Suffice it to say, Cacucu's in big doo-doo.
:{{A|Vo jyeq101 9 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' How so? He's so small, and all he knows are a few harmless phrases... What kind of trouble could he even get himself into?

;(Use [[Nahida]]'s [[All Schemes to Know]] on Dunyarzad, optional)
:{{A|vo dhylq002 5 dunyarzad 01.ogg}} '''Dunyarzad:''' (Can there still possibly be a good ending to all of this? They are father and daughter, after all...)

;(Talk to Dunyarzad)
:{{A|vo dhylq002 5 dehya 01.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' We're back, my lady.
:{{A|vo dhylq002 5 dunyarzad 02.ogg}} '''Dunyarzad:''' Ah, you're back a lot sooner than I expected! You mustn't have run into any trouble, then. Well, how did it go? What did you come up with?
:{{A|vo dhylq002 5 dehya 02.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' Actually, we are still investigating. It's just that... we've discovered something strange.
:{{A|vo dhylq002 5 dunyarzad 03.ogg}} '''Dunyarzad:''' I see... the clues you found have led you back here in the city?
:{{A|vo dhylq002 5 dehya 03.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' Something like that, yeah.
:{{A|vo dhylq002 5 dunyarzad 04.ogg}} '''Dunyarzad:''' You all look a little dispirited. Whatever you found must not have been very encouraging after all.
:{{A|vo dhylq002 5 dunyarzad 05.ogg}} '''Dunyarzad:''' Why don't you discuss it with me? Maybe I'll be able to say something to cheer you up.
:{{A|vo dhylq002 5 dehya 04.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' It's okay, my lady, it's not so much about me being upset with my father or anything like that... Ugh, how should I put this...
:{{A|vo dhylq002 5 dunyarzad 06.ogg}} '''Dunyarzad:''' So something IS wrong. Even the Traveler and Paimon have been uncharacteristically quiet...
:{{A|vo dhylq002 5 dunyarzad 07.ogg}} '''Dunyarzad:''' On any other day, Paimon would have already waved to me with a smile and shouted "Dunyarzad, we're baaaack!"
:{{A|vo dhylq002 5 dunyarzad 08.ogg}} '''Dunyarzad:''' So tell me, what happened?
:{{A|vo dhylq002 5 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Uh, w—well...
:{{A|vo dhylq002 5 dehya 05.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' My lady, please prepare yourself for what we're going to tell you next. It concerns the master...
:{{A|vo dhylq002 5 dunyarzad 09.ogg}} '''Dunyarzad:''' The master... You mean my father?
:{{A|vo dhylq002 5 dunyarzad 10.ogg}} '''Dunyarzad:''' Okay, I understand. Don't worry about me, I'll listen as attentively as I can.
:{{Black Screen|Dehya manages to explain the results of the investigation to Dunyarzad.}}
:{{A|vo dhylq002 5 dunyarzad 11.ogg}} '''Dunyarzad:''' My father... has been supplying goods to Dakan Al-Ahmar?
:{{A|vo dhylq002 5 dehya 06.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' Yeah. It makes as little sense to us as it does to you.
:{{A|vo dhylq002 5 dehya 07.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' I've never doubted the master's integrity, so I'm having a real hard time rationalizing how he could ever support an infamous brigade like them.
:{{A|vo dhylq002 5 dehya 08.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' Maybe he's not actually aware of the full story, and just stumbled into the deal by accident...
:{{DIcon}} That feels unlikely, though.
:{{A|vo dhylq002 5 dunyarzad 12.ogg}} '''Dunyarzad:''' I can't help but agree with the Traveler.
:{{A|vo dhylq002 5 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh? You mean you feel the same way, Dunyarzad?
:{{A|vo dhylq002 5 dunyarzad 13.ogg}} '''Dunyarzad:''' Thank you for sharing all this information with me.
:{{A|vo dhylq002 5 dunyarzad 14.ogg}} '''Dunyarzad:''' Since you've told me everything you know... I should also tell you about some doubts that I've been harboring for quite a while.
:{{A|vo dhylq002 5 dunyarzad 15.ogg}} '''Dunyarzad:''' In the past, I thought that my father hired a bodyguard for me so that I wouldn't run away and get lost.
:{{A|vo dhylq002 5 dunyarzad 16.ogg}} '''Dunyarzad:''' However, there are plenty of capable mercenaries in the Corps of Thirty. Why did my father go out of his way to hire Dehya?
:{{A|vo dhylq002 5 dehya 09.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' Ah, about that... well, the Homayanis really needed bodyguards, so they reached out to the Blazing Beasts.
:{{A|vo dhylq002 5 dehya 10.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' Later, the master told me that I was one of the best mercenaries he'd ever seen, and that I should stick around to become one of his bodyguards.
:{{A|vo dhylq002 5 dehya 11.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' He offered me a pile of Mora, so I just signed on...
:{{A|vo dhylq002 5 dunyarzad 17.ogg}} '''Dunyarzad:''' Well, but that didn't really answer my question. Just think about it... why did my father specifically reach out to the Blazing Beasts?
:{{A|vo dhylq002 5 dehya 12.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' Err, maybe the Corps of Thirty just didn't have anyone available? Or maybe someone recommended us? I've never given it too much thought...
:{{A|vo dhylq002 5 dehya 13.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' ...I think I get what you're saying. You think none of this was a coincidence.
:{{A|vo dhylq002 5 dunyarzad 18.ogg}} '''Dunyarzad:''' Precisely. At first glance, nothing seems strange or out of place, but there are many parts of the story that don't actually make any sense.
:{{A|vo dhylq002 5 dunyarzad 19.ogg}} '''Dunyarzad:''' If my father had always been in contact with Dakan Al-Ahmar... then it would make sense for him to bring Dehya into our house.
:{{A|vo dhylq002 5 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You mean, the goal all along was to get Dehya to be your bodyguard?
:{{A|vo dhylq002 5 dehya 14.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' No no no, that's too much of a stretch. I cut all my ties with my father a long time ago. He has no control over my life anymore.
:{{A|vo dhylq002 5 dunyarzad 20.ogg}} '''Dunyarzad:''' But that still doesn't rule out the possibility that your father has still been trying to influence your life without you knowing.
:{{A|vo dhylq002 5 dehya 15.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' Hmm...
:{{A|vo dhylq002 5 dehya 16.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' So... the master was not likely an innocent victim in all of this?
:{{DIcon}} That's what things are looking like at this point.
:{{A|vo dhylq002 5 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Sorry we put all this on you so suddenly, Dunyarzad...
:{{A|vo dhylq002 5 dunyarzad 21.ogg}} '''Dunyarzad:''' It's okay, Paimon. I should actually be thanking you.
:{{A|vo dhylq002 5 dunyarzad 22.ogg}} '''Dunyarzad:''' Regardless of his reasons, if my father has truly been funding a violent group of mercenaries, then it's my duty to bring him back to reason.
:{{A|vo dhylq002 5 dehya 17.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' But is that... really the right thing to do?
:{{A|vo dhylq002 5 dehya 18.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' My father has committed many atrocities, and deserves all the punishment that he has coming to him. I have zero sympathy for him. You may call me an ungrateful child, but my feelings will remain the same.
:{{A|vo dhylq002 5 dehya 19.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' However... the Homayani family has treated me with nothing but generosity and kindness.
:{{A|vo dhylq002 5 dehya 20.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' If we decide to investigate this further, we could end up implicating the entire Homayani family. I would be biting the hand that's fed me over all these years...
:{{A|vo dhylq002 5 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Dehya...
:{{A|vo dhylq002 5 dunyarzad 23.ogg}} '''Dunyarzad:''' It's alright, Dehya. If anyone were to ask, you could always just say that I'm the one who instructed you to get to the bottom of this.
:{{A|vo dhylq002 5 dehya 21.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' You don't have to do that, my lady. I'm not conflicted because I'm afraid of taking responsibility... Besides, you're the one we should all be worried about right now.
:{{A|vo dhylq002 5 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hey, it's still too early to give up hope! What was that thing about friendship again...
:{{DIcon}} True friendship is built on trust.
:{{A|vo dhylq002 5 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Right, yeah, trust! You said that yourself, Dehya.
:{{A|vo dhylq002 5 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Besides, there's no point on getting all riled up before we've even confirmed all the facts!
:{{DIcon}} If your trust hasn't been misplaced...
:{{DIcon}} Then he probably has many conflicting feelings as well.
:{{A|vo dhylq002 5 dehya 22.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' Thank you, everyone. That makes a lot of sense. I guess I should always remember the trust that I've placed in people.
:{{A|vo dhylq002 5 dehya 23.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' In which case... my lady, could you ask the master to come out and have a chat with us?
:{{A|vo dhylq002 5 dunyarzad 24.ogg}} '''Dunyarzad:''' Sure thing. I also hope he'll be able to give us a logical explanation. Let's meet at the usual place, then.
:{{A|vo dhylq002 5 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' The... usual place? Ah, right!
----
;(Approach the marked area)
:{{A|vo dhylq002 6 dehya 01.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' Thank you for coming, sir.
:{{A|vo dhylq002 6 dehya 02a.ogg}} {{A|vo dhylq002 6 dehya 02b.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' Please allow me to introduce these two. This is {{Traveler}}, and next to {{MC|m=him|f=her}} is {{MC|m=his|f=her}} travel companion, Paimon.
:{{A|vo dhylq002 6 sahzaman 01a.ogg}}<!--{{A|vo dhylq002 6 sahzaman 01b.ogg}}--> '''Shahzaman:''' Ah yes, my daughter has mentioned them from time to time. It's a privilege to finally meet them in person.
:{{A|vo dhylq002 6 sahzaman 02.ogg}} '''Shahzaman:''' But we may skip all the pleasantries for now, what is the important matter you wished to discuss with me today?
:{{A|vo dhylq002 6 dehya 03.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' Well, we wanted to bring this transaction record to your attention. There's something on this record that we're all pretty curious about...
:{{Black Screen|Dehya explains the issue to Shahzaman, and admits her doubts to him.}}
:{{A|vo dhylq002 6 sahzaman 03.ogg}} '''Shahzaman:''' So that's what you've found, huh... Seems like I can't keep everything from you much longer.
:{{A|vo dhylq002 6 dehya 04.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' If you wouldn't mind, we'd like an explanation.
:{{A|vo dhylq002 6 sahzaman 04.ogg}} '''Shahzaman:''' Well, it's a long and difficult story, and to be perfectly honest, I'm not sure if I'm doing the right thing.
:{{A|vo dhylq002 6 sahzaman 05.ogg}} '''Shahzaman:''' What I do know though, Dehya, is that the truth will bring you no solace. If anything, it will likely cause you a great amount of anguish.
:{{A|vo dhylq002 6 dehya 05.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' Wait... me?
:{{A|vo dhylq002 6 sahzaman 06.ogg}} '''Shahzaman:''' Yes. I understand perfectly why you came to see me, and I am touched by your collective commitment to do the right thing.
:{{A|vo dhylq002 6 sahzaman 07.ogg}} '''Shahzaman:''' But knowledge always comes at a price, and sometimes, as they say, ignorance is bliss.
:{{A|vo dhylq002 6 sahzaman 08.ogg}} '''Shahzaman:''' Your father Kusayla and I both believed that.
:{{A|vo dhylq002 6 sahzaman 09.ogg}} '''Shahzaman:''' Of course, you have the right to seek and learn the truth, but I must warn you...
:{{A|vo dhylq002 6 sahzaman 10.ogg}} '''Shahzaman:''' That the facts of this matter may reduce everything you've built for yourself into sand blowing in the wind.
:{{A|vo dhylq002 6 sahzaman 11.ogg}} '''Shahzaman:''' If you must proceed, then Kusayla's heartfelt efforts will also fade into the wind like a fleeting mirage.
:{{A|vo dhylq002 6 dehya 06.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' His... heartfelt efforts? I'm sorry sir, but I'm not sure I follow.
:{{A|vo dhylq002 6 dehya 07.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' I've made it this far in life without a single drop of my father's support.
:{{A|vo dhylq002 6 dehya 08.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' I have my own ideals and ways of looking at the world, as well as people and causes that I've chosen to cherish and fight for... None of these things have anything to do with him.
:{{A|vo dhylq002 6 dehya 09.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' I came here today to support you as the head of the Homayani family. No warning will change my stance on that.
:{{A|vo dhylq002 6 sahzaman 12.ogg}} '''Shahzaman:''' *sigh* I understand. Then let me tell you a little story.
:{{A|vo dhylq002 6 sahzaman 13.ogg}} '''Shahzaman:''' Our family once needed to take a trip to the desert when Dunyarzad was just a baby. Along the way, we were attacked by bandits.
:{{A|vo dhylq002 6 sahzaman 14.ogg}} '''Shahzaman:''' They had superior numbers, and quickly overpowered our bodyguards. When all seemed lost, a group of passerby Eremites lent us their support.
:{{A|vo dhylq002 6 sahzaman 15.ogg}} '''Shahzaman:''' Those Eremites were Kusayla's brigade, Dakan Al-Ahmar.
:{{A|vo dhylq002 6 sahzaman 16.ogg}} '''Shahzaman:''' Kusayla's men told me that the attackers were Eremite mercenaries just like themselves. I was shocked. Why would Dakan Al-Ahmar go so far to save us, and not spare the fellow Eremites?
:{{A|vo dhylq002 6 sahzaman 17.ogg}} '''Shahzaman:''' Kusayla was grinning and walked over to play with baby Dunyarzad. She was startled by his unfamiliar face and nearly started crying.
:{{A|vo dhylq002 6 dunyarzad 01.ogg}} '''Dunyarzad:''' Really? I... never knew...
:{{A|vo dhylq002 6 sahzaman 18.ogg}} '''Shahzaman:''' He said that he had no particular reason to help us. He just took pity on us because he had a daughter about the same age.
:{{A|vo dhylq002 6 sahzaman 19.ogg}} '''Shahzaman:''' We started talking about our children, and I sensed that he was a devoted father.
:{{A|vo dhylq002 6 sahzaman 20.ogg}} '''Shahzaman:''' To repay his kindness, I hired his brigade to help out at our estate for a time, and offered everyone generous remuneration.
:{{A|vo dhylq002 6 dehya 10.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' So that's what happened...
:;(A flashback begins)
:{{A|vo dhylq002 6 sahzaman 21.ogg}} '''Shahzaman:''' It was many years before I saw him again. I almost didn't recognize him the next time he came knocking on my door.
:{{A|vo dhylq002 6 sahzaman 22.ogg}} '''Shahzaman:''' The man I knew to be strong and healthy had been reduced to a... shell of himself. He couldn't even walk anymore without his cane.
:;(Flashback ends)
:{{A|vo dhylq002 6 dehya 11.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' So what happened to him? He was perfectly fine when I left the brigade...
:{{A|vo dhylq002 6 sahzaman 23.ogg}} '''Shahzaman:''' I'm not too sure myself. The only thing that didn't change was his cheery disposition. He said there was absolutely nothing to worry about and that he had gotten into a fight, that was all.
:{{A|vo dhylq002 6 sahzaman 24.ogg}} '''Shahzaman:''' He then suddenly asked me if Dunyarzad, now that she had grown, would need a bodyguard of her own.
:{{A|vo dhylq002 6 sahzaman 25.ogg}} '''Shahzaman:''' At the time, Dunyarzad was going through a particularly severe bout of her [[Eleazar]]. There was no need for her to have a bodyguard when she could barely leave the house...
:{{A|vo dhylq002 6 sahzaman 26.ogg}} '''Shahzaman:''' But he kept coming back to the topic... "C'mon, it never hurts to be safe." "How do you know a bodyguard won't come in handy one day?"
:{{A|vo dhylq002 6 sahzaman 27.ogg}} '''Shahzaman:''' I was completely lost at first, until he recommended the "Blazing Beasts," and in particular, a mercenary named Dehya.
:{{A|vo dhylq002 6 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So he was the one who recommended Dehya to you!
:{{A|vo dhylq002 6 sahzaman 28.ogg}} '''Shahzaman:''' Indeed. He didn't say it out loud, but it was clear that he saw Deshret's Relics as an evil group who would eventually corrupt every member in their ranks.
:{{A|vo dhylq002 6 sahzaman 29.ogg}} '''Shahzaman:''' He was already beyond redemption, but he hoped that he would be able to detach his daughter from the vicious world of mercenary life.
:{{A|vo dhylq002 6 sahzaman 30.ogg}} '''Shahzaman:''' If Dehya could stay in my house and keep working as a bodyguard, then gradually her affinity for the desert would decrease, and she'd be able to leave her previous life behind.
:{{A|vo dhylq002 6 dunyarzad 02.ogg}} '''Dunyarzad:''' And that's why you offered her such generous compensation?
:{{A|vo dhylq002 6 sahzaman 31.ogg}} '''Shahzaman:''' Yes, but not just because of that. From the moment that he asked me for that favor, I also began to see Dehya as my own daughter.
:{{A|vo dhylq002 6 sahzaman 32.ogg}} '''Shahzaman:''' And that's also why I tried to persuade you to stay when you asked for permission to leave. I was willing to spend however much it took...
:{{A|vo dhylq002 6 sahzaman 33.ogg}} '''Shahzaman:''' Kusayla saved my daughter and me all those years ago in the desert. I could never refuse him entrusting his daughter to me.
:{{A|vo dhylq002 6 dehya 12.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' Ugh, he was always like that... Acting like he's oh-so-smart and self-righteous...
:{{A|vo dhylq002 6 sahzaman 34.ogg}} '''Shahzaman:''' Kusayla said that he'd reimburse me for a portion of Dehya's fees. I refused to take any Mora from him, but he'd always send me funds anyway.
:{{A|vo dhylq002 6 sahzaman 35.ogg}} '''Shahzaman:''' Eventually, I just accepted them as a token of his gratitude. That went on for a while, until I received another letter from him a few years ago.
:{{A|vo dhylq002 6 sahzaman 36.ogg}} '''Shahzaman:''' The letter contained a request to help him buy food, weapons, medicine, and even explosive materials.
:{{A|vo dhylq002 6 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wait, isn't that around the time that Dakan Al-Ahmar started becoming more aggressive?
:{{A|vo dhylq002 6 sahzaman 37.ogg}} '''Shahzaman:''' That's right. When I started to hear some nasty rumors, I became wary, and wanted to meet him face-to-face to discuss things.
:{{A|vo dhylq002 6 sahzaman 38.ogg}} '''Shahzaman:''' But by then, he was no longer receptive to my requests to talk. If I had to guess... it's probably because he doesn't want to put Dehya at risk.
:{{DIcon}} But by that same token, he should have also stopped asking you for materials.
:{{A|vo dhylq002 6 sahzaman 39.ogg}} '''Shahzaman:''' That thought occurred to me as well. I figured that he probably came to me for help because he had nobody else to turn to.
:{{A|vo dhylq002 6 sahzaman 40.ogg}} '''Shahzaman:''' After some deliberation, I decided to send him some food and medicine. I turned down all his requests for explosives and weaponry.
:{{A|vo dhylq002 6 sahzaman 41.ogg}} '''Shahzaman:''' I am aware that even such a reduced gesture of support could lead to others coming to harm, but I could not simply reject his plea for help.
:{{A|vo dhylq002 6 sahzaman 42.ogg}} '''Shahzaman:''' In the end, it probably was the wrong decision. I plugged my ears to the rumors and just chose the solution that made me feel least guilty about myself.
:{{A|vo dhylq002 6 dehya 13.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' ...If you can, please tell me where he is now.
:{{A|vo dhylq002 6 dehya 14.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' None of the things he's doing right now make any sense if he's just trying to keep me from getting tangled up in his world...
:{{A|vo dhylq002 6 dehya 15.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' If all he wants to do is steer clear of me, then maybe he shouldn't have brought me into this world in the first place.
:{{A|vo dhylq002 6 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh no, Dehya, please don't feel that way...
:{{A|vo dhylq002 6 dehya 16.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' I'm just angry because I can't wrap my head around any of his actions.
:{{DIcon}} Maybe there's another way of looking at all of this...
::{{A|vo dhylq002 6 dehya 17a 1.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' Another way? I dunno... I knew him, and he was nothing more than a childish brute. I can't understand what's going through his head.
:{{DIcon}} Can you try to believe in him... just one more time?
::{{A|vo dhylq002 6 dehya 17b 1.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' I don't know, I really don't know... I don't think I can do it.
:{{A|vo dhylq002 6 dehya 18.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' But I guess you do have a point... We haven't uncovered the whole truth yet. We still need to figure out his exact actions and reasoning for these last few years.
:{{A|vo dhylq002 6 sahzaman 43.ogg}} '''Shahzaman:''' I'll do my best to help. Of course, anything between the two of you would need to be resolved between you and him alone.
:{{A|vo dhylq002 6 sahzaman 44.ogg}} '''Shahzaman:''' I don't know Kusayla's exact whereabouts. Outside of supplying his brigade with some goods, I tried my best to avoid getting involved any further with him.
:{{A|vo dhylq002 6 sahzaman 45.ogg}} '''Shahzaman:''' However, there's a man on the list named {{color|buzzword|Jawad}}. He used to be a mercenary in the desert, and is now a member of the Corps of Thirty.
:{{A|vo dhylq002 6 sahzaman 46.ogg}} '''Shahzaman:''' He's responsible for supplying weapons and liaising with Dakan Al-Ahmar's merchant caravan. I think he should know Kusayla's whereabouts.
:{{A|vo dhylq002 6 sahzaman 47.ogg}} '''Shahzaman:''' I've heard that he likes to have a few drinks alone and enjoy the cool wind at {{color|buzzword|night}} outside of the {{color|buzzword|tavern}}. Maybe you'll be able to find him there.
:{{A|vo dhylq002 6 dehya 19.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' Understood, thank you sir. Then I guess this is bye for now, unless...
:{{A|vo dhylq002 6 dunyarzad 03.ogg}} '''Dunyarzad:''' I'll stay and be with my father here... To be honest, I'm still a little dazed, and haven't finished processing everything quite yet.
:{{A|vo dhylq002 6 dunyarzad 04.ogg}} '''Dunyarzad:''' My father has indeed done something wrong, but if I think about it, I'm also not sure if there was a right way to handle this problem.
:{{A|vo dhylq002 6 dunyarzad 05.ogg}} '''Dunyarzad:''' I feel like... our only course of action is to turn everything we know over to the Corps of Thirty, and let them render judgment...
:{{A|vo dhylq002 6 sahzaman 48.ogg}} '''Shahzaman:''' Yes. I am prepared to accept whatever verdict they choose.
:{{A|vo dhylq002 6 sahzaman 49.ogg}} '''Shahzaman:''' It's time to face my mistakes...
{{Dialogue End}}
