:{{A|vo dhylq002 7 jawad 05.ogg}} '''Jawad:''' This place should do... Alright, back to my question, how did you all know about me?
:{{A|vo dhylq002 7 dehya 02.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' Don't worry about that for now. You know what kind of punishment you'll face once we report you to the Corps, I assume?
:{{A|vo dhylq002 7 jawad 06.ogg}} '''Jawad:''' Wait wait wait, there's no need to jump the gun! Let's talk this out. What are your terms?
:{{A|vo dhylq002 7 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So what's in it for you anyway? Mora?
:{{A|vo dhylq002 7 jawad 07.ogg}} '''Jawad:''' Uhh... Well, I was a little tight on money at the time, and Kusayla took good care of me in the past...
:{{A|vo dhylq002 7 jawad 08.ogg}} '''Jawad:''' I weighed it in my mind, and I couldn't find a reason to turn the opportunity down. I wouldn't only be helping my benefactor, but I could also make some quick Mora...
:{{A|vo dhylq002 7 dehya 03.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' Let me tell you how it is. We're investigating Dakan Al-Ahmar, and we're gonna put an end to their operations.
:{{A|vo dhylq002 7 dehya 04.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' If you provide some help for us, then we might just put in a good word later to reduce the terms of your punishment.
:{{A|vo dhylq002 7 jawad 09.ogg}} '''Jawad:''' Hey, why don't we discuss this a little first? Listen, I made quite a bit of Mora from my last run. Just give me a number and I'm sure we can...
:{{A|vo dhylq002 7 dehya 05.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' Shut it.
:{{A|vo dhylq002 7 dehya 06.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' My patience is running out. You should know when a mercenary is after something other than money.
:{{A|vo dhylq002 7 jawad 10.ogg}} '''Jawad:''' Alright, alright, sheesh. But ya gotta promise you'll put in some nice words for me later.
:{{A|vo dhylq002 7 jawad 11.ogg}} '''Jawad:''' They're always on the move. Here's the spot they were at last time I made my delivery to the desert.
:{{A|vo dhylq002 7 jawad 12.ogg}} '''Jawad:''' Feel free to go have a look. I'm just telling you, though, it's not on me if they're not there anymore.
:{{A|vo dhylq002 7 dehya 07.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' Sure, and then you can forget about any nice words from us.
:{{A|vo dhylq002 7 jawad 13.ogg}} '''Jawad:''' Hey, c'mon! Now you're just being unreasonable!
:{{A|vo dhylq002 7 dehya 08.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' Really? And how do I know you're not leading us straight into a trap? Don't forget, you're the one with no bargaining chips.
:{{A|vo dhylq002 7 jawad 14.ogg}} '''Jawad:''' Alright, I get it, I get it... Why don't you go take a look, and if they're not there anymore, I'll try to figure out something else for you all.
:{{A|vo dhylq002 7 dehya 09.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' Now that's more like it. Let's move.
:{{A|vo dhylq002 7 dehya 10.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' And as for you... try to stick around the city until we get back. You don't want us to call the folks from the Corps and have them drag you back to the city.

;(Talk to Jawad again)
:{{A|vo dialog dhylq002 jawad 01.ogg}} '''Jawad:''' Oh, don't worry, I'm not goin' anywhere...

:{{A|vo dhylq002 8 dehya 02.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' Let's go. We'll finally get to the bottom of this ourselves.

;(After the cutscene)
:{{A|vo dhylq002 8 dehya 03.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' I'm here to see Kusayla. Tell him to get out here!
:{{A|vo dhylq002 8 tikriti 01.ogg}} '''Tikriti:''' Huh? Dehya? Why are you here?

;(After defeating the first wave of Eremites)
:{{A|vo dhylq002 8 dehya 04.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' Haven't you all done enough?
:{{A|vo dhylq002 8 idrisi 01.ogg}} '''Idrisi:''' Oh, so are you also here to stop us?
:{{A|vo dhylq002 8 bashar 01.ogg}} '''Bashar:''' Stay outta this! It's got nothing to do with you!

;(After defeating the second wave of Eremites)
:{{A|vo dhylq002 9 bashar 01.ogg}} '''Bashar:''' Sh—She's so strong...
:{{A|vo dhylq002 9 dehya 01.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' Enough fighting. We all know each other, and I don't want to take things too far.
:{{A|vo dhylq002 9 dehya 02.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' Just bring Kusayla to me! There's no use hiding him anymore!
:{{A|vo dhylq002 9 tikriti 01.ogg}} '''Tikriti:''' ...
:{{A|vo dhylq002 9 dehya 03.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' Did you understand a single word I just said? Or do I need to bash your skull in some more?
:{{A|vo dhylq002 9 idrisi 01.ogg}} '''Idrisi:''' Alright, everyone, let's all just calm down for a second.
:{{A|vo dhylq002 9 idrisi 02.ogg}} '''Idrisi:''' Um, Dehya, the boss can't come out and see you anymore.
:{{A|vo dhylq002 9 idrisi 03.ogg}} '''Idrisi:''' He died a long time ago.
:{{A|vo dhylq002 9 dehya 04.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' What...?
:{{A|vo dhylq002 9 bashar 02.ogg}} '''Bashar:''' Seems like you've been out of the loop for a while. Guess that's for the best, though... at least that's what the old man wanted.
:{{A|vo dhylq002 9 dehya 05.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' When did he die? What happened to him?
:{{A|vo dhylq002 9 tikriti 02.ogg}} '''Tikriti:''' A few years ago, Kusayla broke up Dakan Al-Ahmar, and went to the Deshret's Relics headquarters by himself.
:{{A|vo dhylq002 9 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So is that when you guys started acting up?
:{{A|vo dhylq002 9 bashar 03.ogg}} '''Bashar:''' We would prefer to call it "taking revenge." Every last person in Deshret's Relics must pay in blood for what they did!
:{{DIcon}} So that's why they turned on each other...
:{{DIcon}} It was all motivated by revenge...
:{{A|vo dhylq002 9 idrisi 04.ogg}} '''Idrisi:''' Let me start from the beginning. Dehya, do you know how the head of the Relics maintained order internally?
:{{A|vo dhylq002 9 dehya 06.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' Overwhelming strength, and unquestionable authority?
:{{A|vo dhylq002 9 idrisi 05.ogg}} '''Idrisi:''' Those were a part of it, yes. But just those on their own weren't enough. They had another tool at their disposal. They called it a person's "record."
:{{A|vo dhylq002 9 idrisi 06.ogg}} '''Idrisi:''' Regardless of whether they joined by their own will or were coerced, every person in Deshret's Relics were forced to leave a record of themselves at headquarters.
:{{A|vo dhylq002 9 idrisi 07.ogg}} '''Idrisi:''' Whether it be their deepest sin, some unforgivable act, or their most immoral exploit, the record served both as a symbol of loyalty and the perfect material for blackmail.
:{{DIcon}} So you mean...
:{{DIcon}} Kusayla thought there was no escaping the records.
:{{A|vo dhylq002 9 idrisi 08.ogg}} '''Idrisi:''' That's precisely it. Every one of us have a record... me, Bashar, Tikriti, and all the boys who grew up with Dehya and ended up joining our ranks.
:{{A|vo dhylq002 9 idrisi 09.ogg}} '''Idrisi:''' But you, Dehya... you were never asked to provide a record, were you?
:{{A|vo dhylq002 9 dehya 07.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' I... I never even knew this was a requirement...
:{{A|vo dhylq002 9 idrisi 10.ogg}} '''Idrisi:''' You were probably the only person in all of Deshret's Relics who didn't know about it.
:{{A|vo dhylq002 9 bashar 04.ogg}} '''Bashar:''' Ever since you were born, boss had been trying to shield you from this organization's sinister rules.
:{{A|vo dhylq002 9 bashar 05.ogg}} '''Bashar:''' Not only that, but he also banned all of us from committing any nefarious acts. He said he'd take care of the dues we had to pay regularly to headquarters...
:{{A|vo dhylq002 9 bashar 06.ogg}} '''Bashar:''' But in the end, he was just an ordinary person. What could he do?
:{{A|vo dhylq002 9 bashar 07.ogg}} '''Bashar:''' He was forced to go to headquarters again and again to account for missed dues and incomplete records. He'd come up with all kinds of excuses, and get beaten up as a result.
:{{A|vo dhylq002 9 tikriti 03.ogg}} '''Tikriti:''' We all knew he was doing that for you. He wanted to get you out of this world, no matter what it took.
:{{A|vo dhylq002 9 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' ...And that was why he became a shell of himself, and couldn't walk without a cane.
:{{A|vo dhylq002 9 dehya 08.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' Wait, but that doesn't make any sense. I didn't know about any of this, and I'd never seen him get injured or beaten...
:{{A|vo dhylq002 9 idrisi 11.ogg}} '''Idrisi:''' Because you were too young at the time. How would you ever tell between wounds from a beating and wounds from battle?
:{{A|vo dhylq002 9 idrisi 12.ogg}} '''Idrisi:''' When you left home after that final argument with him, he seemed to age by a decade overnight. Even his hair went gray.
:{{A|vo dhylq002 9 dehya 09.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' So, even the Blazing Beasts were...
:{{A|vo dhylq002 9 bashar 08.ogg}} '''Bashar:''' Yep, it was all his doing. Had he not arranged them to come to you, you probably would have been reduced to a pulp before you ever left the desert.
;(Illustrations of Idrisi's meeting with Kusayla and Kusayla's arson of the Dakan Al-Ahmar headquarters appear as Idrisi and Tikriti narrate)
::{|
| rowspan="2" |[[File:Annals of the Scarlet Sands Graphic 1.png|180px]]
|{{A|vo dhylq002 9 idrisi 13.ogg}} '''Idrisi:''' A few years ago, boss said he needed to make another trip to headquarters. He was already pretty weak then, and we all assumed he was going to get beaten again.
|-
|{{A|vo dhylq002 9 idrisi 14.ogg}} '''Idrisi:''' I suggested that he hand the role of leadership over to me, but he said there was no longer any need, since Dakan Al-Ahmar would soon be no more.
|-
| rowspan="2" |[[File:Annals of the Scarlet Sands Graphic 2.png|180px]]
|{{A|vo dhylq002 9 idrisi 15.ogg}} '''Idrisi:''' His words made no sense to me, but that night, we heard that a massive fire tore through headquarters, and razed everyone's "records" to ash.
|-
|{{A|vo dhylq002 9 tikriti 04.ogg}} '''Tikriti:''' Everyone gained their freedom that night. Many members fled... not just from our ranks, but from the other brigades as well.
|}
:;(End of illustrations)
:{{A|vo dhylq002 9 tikriti 05.ogg}} '''Tikriti:''' But how could we leave with a clear conscience? All of us, who knew exactly what had happened...
:{{A|vo dhylq002 9 bashar 09.ogg}} '''Bashar:''' The boss can't have just died for nothing! Those heartless jerks at headquarters took him from us!
:{{A|vo dhylq002 9 idrisi 16.ogg}} '''Idrisi:''' From that point on, the sole purpose of Dakan Al-Ahmar became revenge.
:{{A|vo dhylq002 9 idrisi 17.ogg}} '''Idrisi:''' The big fire that boss started was quite a blow to headquarters' strength. It's given us the opportunity to launch our attack.
:{{A|vo dhylq002 9 idrisi 18.ogg}} '''Idrisi:''' Even though we're outnumbered, we've vowed to see our revenge through to the very end.
:{{DIcon}} But Deshret's Relics haven't been the only victims of your revenge.
:{{A|vo dhylq002 9 idrisi 19.ogg}} '''Idrisi:''' There were people from headquarters who changed their names and went into hiding. Some fled to other brigades, and others escaped to the rainforest.
:{{A|vo dhylq002 9 idrisi 20.ogg}} '''Idrisi:''' But we won't let any of them escape our wrath. They'll all pay for what they've done.
:{{A|vo dhylq002 9 bashar 10.ogg}} '''Bashar:''' We've suffered plenty of losses as well. To keep going, we need an enormous amount of supplies... from food and medicine to weaponry and explosives.
:{{A|vo dhylq002 9 bashar 11.ogg}} '''Bashar:''' All we can do is exchange our loot for Mora, and then use that to get supplies.
:{{A|vo dhylq002 9 bashar 12.ogg}} '''Bashar:''' We forged boss's handwriting and sent out many letters to his former friends. Thankfully, many people were willing to come to our aid.
:{{A|vo dhylq002 9 bashar 13.ogg}} '''Bashar:''' We were also able to attract many mercenaries who shared our goal. We've endured unspeakable pain to win many impossible battles...
:{{A|vo dhylq002 9 bashar 14.ogg}} '''Bashar:''' Deshret's Relics have become weaker and weaker, and now... we finally have an opportunity to directly strike their headquarters.
:{{A|vo dhylq002 9 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Uh... Paimon doesn't know what to say anymore.
:{{DIcon}} Responding to violence with more violence will only cause more pain.
:{{DIcon}} Do you have any idea the amount of damage you've done?
:{{A|vo dhylq002 9 idrisi 21.ogg}} '''Idrisi:''' Hah, we do know right from wrong. But we were sinners from the very beginning... We do not deserve the freedom that the boss won for us with his life.
:{{A|vo dhylq002 9 idrisi 22.ogg}} '''Idrisi:''' Boss always loved his old-fashioned hero stories... those tales about sacrificing yourself to save the world.
:{{A|vo dhylq002 9 idrisi 23.ogg}} '''Idrisi:''' We used to always laugh at him for it, but in the end, he really went and lived those stories out himself...
:{{A|vo dhylq002 9 idrisi 24.ogg}} '''Idrisi:''' As for me, I never considered myself a hero. We're all the lowest of the low. We have no right to even imagine such an existence.
:{{A|vo dhylq002 9 idrisi 25.ogg}} '''Idrisi:''' But maybe those hero stories he liked foreshadowed everything that was to come. The spirit of the hero touched all those he had saved, and more and more people joined his cause...
:{{A|vo dhylq002 9 idrisi 26.ogg}} '''Idrisi:''' Maybe we were all just acting along with the play in the beginning, but as we acted the parts and recited the lines, we were drawn in, and now we want to see the story through to the end...
:{{A|vo dhylq002 9 idrisi 27.ogg}} '''Idrisi:''' I'm sorry, Dehya. I know you always found us insufferable ever since you were young. Just think of this as a madman ranting.
:{{A|vo dhylq002 9 dehya 10.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' ...
:{{A|vo dhylq002 9 dehya 11.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' I'll go with you.
:{{A|vo dhylq002 9 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh? Dehya, you want to go with them?
:{{A|vo dhylq002 9 dehya 12.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' I grew up with these guys, and I know they're not bad people. It's just that some situations get so bad that it's difficult to tell good from evil...
:{{A|vo dhylq002 9 dehya 13.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' All I know is that Deshret's Relics must be destroyed.
:{{A|vo dhylq002 9 dehya 14.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' Furthermore... I want to go see the place for myself. I want to know if my father is still there...
:{{A|vo dhylq002 9 dehya 15.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' I know you don't want to get involved in this, so there's no need for you to tag along. I can do this on my own.
:{{DIcon}} I'm on your side, Dehya.
:{{DIcon}} No, I made a promise to Dunyarzad to support you.
:{{A|vo dhylq002 9 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yeah, Paimon feels like we'd only regret it if we don't see this through to the end...
:{{A|vo dhylq002 9 dehya 16.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' Thank you. We'll be a lot stronger together with you.
:{{A|vo dhylq002 9 idrisi 28.ogg}} '''Idrisi:''' Haha, I bet boss would lose his mind if he ever knew you'd join us at the very last moment like this.
:{{A|vo dhylq002 9 tikriti 06.ogg}} '''Tikriti:''' Considering all the losses and injuries we've sustained... We can't afford to turn down someone as powerful as you.
:{{A|vo dhylq002 9 dehya 17.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' He can think whatever he wants...
:{{A|vo dhylq002 9 dehya 18.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' ...But the fact is, I owe him this much.
{{Dialogue End}}

==Dialogue==
{{Quest Description|The two of you receive a letter from Xiangling, inviting you to Yilong Wharf...}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Upon obtaining quest)
:{{A|vo zyjeq001 1 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Xiangling sent us a letter saying she wants us to head over to Yilong Wharf. Apparently, she's got a surprise for us!
:{{A|vo zyjeq001 1 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Could it be a new dish? Then we've gotta go try it right away, hehehe!
:;(Obtain {{Item|Letter From Xiangling}})

;(Read the letter)
::'''Letter from Xiangling'''
::It's been a while, {{Traveler}} and Paimon! I've really missed you two! I'm writing because whenever something good happens, I can't help thinking of my friends! If you're free, swing by Yilong Wharf — I've got a surprise waiting for you!
::{{Keys|Accept Invitation}}

;(Approach Xiangling)
:{{A|vo zyjeq001 1 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wow, Yilong Wharf sure is busy today! Is there an event going on or something?
:{{A|vo zyjeq001 1 xiangling 01.ogg}} '''Xiangling:''' {{Traveler}}, Paimon, over here!
:{{A|vo zyjeq001 1 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Xiangling!
:{{DIcon}} What's going on?
:{{A|vo zyjeq001 1 xiangling 02.ogg}} '''Xiangling:''' Hehe, look at the calendar! It's time for this year's [[Moonchase Festival]].
:{{A|vo zyjeq001 1 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ohh, right! Paimon almost forgot, haha! So, does that mean the [[Moonlight Merriment/Story|Masterful Chefs]] competition is back?
:{{A|vo zyjeq001 1 xiangling 03.ogg}} '''Xiangling:''' Not exactly, things are a little different this year...
:;([[Escoffier]] approaches the group)
:{{A|vo zyjeq001 1 escoffier 01.ogg}} '''Escoffier:''' Masterful Chefs, is it? Hmm... Intriguing. Liyue hosts culinary contests like that?
:{{A|vo zyjeq001 1 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Escoffier!
:{{DIcon}} What are you doing here?
:{{A|vo zyjeq001 1 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wait... Were you specially invited to join the Masterful Chefs competition as some super-powerful outside challenger, the ultimate boss for all of Liyue's chefs to take on?
:{{A|vo zyjeq001 1 escoffier 02.ogg}} '''Escoffier:''' Huh, that does sound rather appealing...
:{{A|vo zyjeq001 1 xiangling 04.ogg}} '''Xiangling:''' Nope, that's not it at all! We're not even holding another round of Masterful Chefs! Instead, there's an event called the "World Food Fair."
:{{A|vo zyjeq001 1 xiangling 05.ogg}} '''Xiangling:''' Representatives from [[Mondstadt]], [[Fontaine]], and [[Sumeru]] have all come to take part. Ms. Escoffier is here as the representative of Fontaine's culinary scene.
:{{A|vo zyjeq001 1 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' World Food Fair?
:{{A|vo zyjeq001 1 xiangling 06.ogg}} '''Xiangling:''' Yep! It's a chance to try amazing food from four different nations all in one place! I knew you wouldn't wanna miss out, so I wrote you a letter.
:{{A|vo zyjeq001 1 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You know it! This kind of event is Paimon's jam!
:{{A|vo zyjeq001 1 xiangling 07.ogg}} '''Xiangling:''' The event's already underway, and I still have a stall to run, so I won't be able to show you around. But if you ever start craving something good, drop by and try what I've been cooking up!
:{{A|vo zyjeq001 1 escoffier 03.ogg}} '''Escoffier:''' My own offerings for the fair this time aren't to be missed either. Do come by and sample them.
:{{A|vo zyjeq001 1 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Woohoo!
:;(Escoffier and Xiangling walk off together)
:{{A|vo zyjeq001 1 escoffier 04.ogg}} '''Escoffier:''' Miss Xiangling, I found the culinary insights you shared earlier most inspiring. Would you mind if I wrote everything down?
:{{A|vo zyjeq001 1 xiangling 08.ogg}} '''Xiangling:''' Oh, come on, you're making it sound so serious! I was just thinking out loud...
:{{A|vo zyjeq001 1 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wow, Xiangling and Escoffier in the same kitchen... Just imagine how good the food would be...
:{{DIcon}} Anyway...
:{{DIcon}} This year's Moonchase Festival does feel different.
:{{A|vo zyjeq001 1 paimon 12.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yeah, Paimon would never have guessed it'd be at Yilong Wharf before we came! Much less that they'd get rid of Masterful Chefs and add a food fair...
:;([[Lan Yan]] and [[Ningguang]] approach with some [[Millelith]] in tow)
:{{A|vo zyjeq001 1 lanyan 01.ogg}} '''Lan Yan:''' Well, the elders of the clan probably figured that between Yilong Wharf's connections to other nations and the timing of Moonchase, holding an international event rooted in the festival's culinary traditions was just the thing to do.
:{{Introductory Note|Lan Yan}}
:{{A|vo zyjeq001 1 lanyan 02.ogg}} '''Lan Yan:''' It's a great way to bring in visitors from all over the world, and hopefully give the locals a bit of an economic boost, too.
:{{A|vo zyjeq001 1 paimon 13.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Lan Yan — and Ningguang too! Long time no see!
:{{A|vo zyjeq001 1 ningguang 01.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' It has been a while, {{Traveler}}, Paimon.
:{{DIcon}} What were you saying just now, Lan Yan?
:{{A|vo zyjeq001 1 lanyan 03.ogg}} '''Lan Yan:''' I guess you haven't heard yet. [[Chenyu Vale]]'s associations are in charge of organizing this year's Moonchase Festival events.
:{{A|vo zyjeq001 1 lanyan 04.ogg}} '''Lan Yan:''' My clan carries a lot of weight there, so our elders worked out the format we're going with this year.
:{{A|vo zyjeq001 1 paimon 14.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, so that's what happened! Well, it was a really good call!
:{{A|vo zyjeq001 1 paimon 15.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' But is it really okay not to have Masterful Chefs? Paimon always thought that was a really important tradition...
:{{A|vo zyjeq001 1 ningguang 02.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' You needn't worry. Moonchase has always been shaped, first and foremost, by the people.
:{{A|vo zyjeq001 1 ningguang 03.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' Over the course of Liyue's history, many new customs have gradually been folded into the Moonchase Festival celebrations, only later to be regarded as "tradition." Masterful Chefs is but one example of such.
:{{A|vo zyjeq001 1 ningguang 04.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' There have never been any official rules dictating the Moonchase festivities. Most of them began with the people themselves.
:{{A|vo zyjeq001 1 ningguang 05.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' Perhaps in time, this "World Food Fair" will become a new tradition.
:{{DIcon}} I see.
:{{A|vo zyjeq001 1 paimon 16.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So you and Lan Yan came to enjoy the festival too, right? Hmm... Wait, then why'd you bring the Millelith?
:{{A|vo zyjeq001 1 ningguang 06.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' As a matter of fact, this visit to Yilong Wharf is official business.
:{{A|vo zyjeq001 1 ningguang 07.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' Around this time each year, malevolent forces tend to gather, stirring up trouble across Liyue. Their energy can possess monsters, making them far more dangerous than usual.
:{{A|vo zyjeq001 1 ningguang 08.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' The Millelith have already mobilized. My reason for coming is to coordinate their efforts with those of the [[Lan Clan|Lan clan]].
:{{A|vo zyjeq001 1 ningguang 09.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' Lan Yan was just taking me to meet with the clan elder when we happened to spot you.
:{{A|vo zyjeq001 1 paimon 17.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' The Millelith are working with Lan Yan's family?
:{{A|vo zyjeq001 1 ningguang 10.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' Precisely. Lan Yan belongs to a renowned old thaumaturge clan. I trust you've heard of the [[thaumaturge]]s of Liyue before?
:{{DIcon}} That I have.<!--Both options result in the same dialogue-->
:{{DIcon}} I might need a refresher.
:{{A|vo zyjeq001 1 ningguang 11.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' Liyue is home to many gifted individuals who study the mystical arts. Whether learned from [[adepti]] or born of their own insights, they preserve and pass them down from generation to generation.
:{{A|vo zyjeq001 1 ningguang 12.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' These practitioners are known as "thaumaturges." The founder of the [[Wangsheng Funeral Parlor]], the [[Wuwang Kid]], and the ancestor of the Lan clan, the [[Wind Reader]], are two notable examples.
:{{A|vo zyjeq001 1 ningguang 13.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' The arts practiced by these thaumaturges are quite formidable. Thus, when ill winds gather and evil spirits stir, they play an important role in safeguarding the land and its people.
:{{A|vo zyjeq001 1 paimon 18.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ohhh, Paimon gets it! Sounds like Lan Yan's family is the real deal! But, uh, about those evil spirits...
:{{A|vo zyjeq001 1 ningguang 14.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' Liyue enjoys the protection of the Adepti, certainly, but that is no reason for us mortals to sit idly by, dependent upon them.
:{{A|vo zyjeq001 1 ningguang 15.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' Moreover, with evil spirits being so much more active at this time of year, even they must grow weary... All the more reason for us to do our part.
:{{A|vo zyjeq001 1 ningguang 16.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' And so, it is customary for the Millelith to join forces with civilian thaumaturges during this season.
:{{DIcon}} As it should be.
:{{A|vo zyjeq001 1 ningguang 17.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' If there is nothing else, I'm afraid I must take my leave. When you have time, do come to the [[Jade Chamber]] so we can catch up properly. You will find I have prepared the finest tea and refreshments to receive you.
:{{DIcon}} Anything we can do to help?
:{{A|vo zyjeq001 1 paimon 19.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' That's right, we can help too!
:{{A|vo zyjeq001 1 ningguang 18.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' {{Traveler}}, Paimon, I thank you for your kind offer. But I would rather you enjoy the holiday, as any other ordinary festivalgoer might.
:{{A|vo zyjeq001 1 ningguang 19.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' Together, the Millelith and thaumaturges are more than capable of handling these troublesome spirits. They have done so for many years.
:{{A|vo zyjeq001 1 paimon 20.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Well, if you say so... okay.
:{{A|vo zyjeq001 1 lanyan 05.ogg}} '''Lan Yan:''' Then I should get going too. {{Traveler}}, Paimon, don't forget to have a wonderful Moonchase Festival!
:{{A|vo zyjeq001 1 lanyan 06.ogg}} '''Lan Yan:''' Lady Ningguang, this way, please.
<!--Silverwing in Pursuit of the Moon: Part I
As One Might Stride Betwixt the Clouds
Started-->
{{Dialogue End}}

==Dialogue==
{{Quest Description|On your last legs from being attacked by an enormous [[slime]], you were rescued by a young man named [[Razor]]. Razor, who calls a wolf pack family, mentioned a "red one, burny girl." You have your guesses as to who that is...}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Talk to Amber near the [[Mondstadt City]] gates)
:{{A|vo rzlq002 1 ambor 01.ogg}} '''Amber:''' Hi Paimon, hi {{Traveler}}! What can I do for you?
:{{A|vo rzlq002 1 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hi Amber~
:{{DIcon}} Amber, something has come up...
::{{A|vo rzlq002 1 paimon 02a.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Amber, do you know a wolf boy from Wolvendom?
::{{A|vo rzlq002 1 ambor 01a.ogg}} '''Amber:''' Who?
::{{A|vo rzlq002 1 paimon 02a 1.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' He said you guys hit it off like a mountain on fire...
::{{A|vo rzlq002 1 ambor 01a 1.ogg}} '''Amber:''' What on earth are you talking about?
::{{A|vo rzlq002 1 paimon 02a 2.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Strange... He said he would wait for you at your regular spot. Did you lose your memory or something?
::{{A|vo rzlq002 1 ambor 01a 2.ogg}} '''Amber:''' My memory is fine. But you've been eating magic [[matsutake]] again, haven't you Paimon?
::{{A|vo rzlq002 1 ambor 01a 3.ogg}} '''Amber:''' I have no idea what you're talking about.
::{{A|vo rzlq002 1 paimon 02a 3.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Magic matsutake... Remind me what color they are?
::{{A|vo rzlq002 1 ambor 01a 4.ogg}} '''Amber:''' Purple.
::{{A|vo rzlq002 1 paimon 02a 4.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' ...Paimon may have had a couple the other day.
::{{A|vo rzlq002 1 paimon 02a 5.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' But that's not the point! Paimon's not loopy!
::{{A|vo rzlq002 1 paimon 02a 6.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Do you really not know that boy that lives with the wolves?
::{{A|vo rzlq002 1 ambor 01a 5.ogg}} '''Amber:''' I. don't. know. what. you're. talking. about.
::{{A|vo rzlq002 1 ambor 01a 6.ogg}} '''Amber:''' But on the subjects of wolves, I've been investigating something recently.
::{{A|vo rzlq002 1 ambor 01a 7.ogg}} '''Amber:''' In the past, the wolves never dared venture outside of Wolvendom. But now they're getting braver.
::{{A|vo rzlq002 1 ambor 01a 8.ogg}} '''Amber:''' I heard they attacked a cart fleet near [[Drunkard Gorge]].
::{{A|vo rzlq002 1 ambor 01a 9.ogg}} '''Amber:''' If you have time, could you come and check out the situation with me?
::{{DIcon}} Sure.
::{{DIcon}} Let's get to it.
::{{A|vo rzlq002 1 ambor 01a 10.ogg}} '''Amber:''' Awesome! I knew I could count on you, let's go.
:{{DIcon}} Hey Amber, what's up?
::{{A|vo rzlq002 1 ambor 01b.ogg}} '''Amber:''' Hi... Looks like you've got a bit of time on your hands.
::{{A|vo rzlq002 1 paimon 02b.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Uh-oh, here it comes...
::{{A|vo rzlq002 1 ambor 01b 1.ogg}} '''Amber:''' I've been rushed off my feet recently. An Outrider's duties never end, so... Wanna help?
::{{A|vo rzlq002 1 paimon 02b 1.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Told you so!
::{{DIcon}} Sure.
::{{DIcon}} What's the issue?
::{{A|vo rzlq002 1 ambor 01b 2.ogg}} '''Amber:''' Recently, wolves have been attacking the carts at Drunkard Gorge.
::{{A|vo rzlq002 1 ambor 01b 3.ogg}} '''Amber:''' As you know, wolves are dangerous, but they do have their own rules.
::{{A|vo rzlq002 1 ambor 01b 4.ogg}} '''Amber:''' Mondstadt's wolves don't normally venture outside of the [[Brightcrown Mountains]] and Wolvendom.
::{{A|vo rzlq002 1 paimon 02b 2.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yes, Paimon heard someone say that those areas do have their own set of rules, even though they are wild and untouched by humans.
::{{A|vo rzlq002 1 ambor 01b 5.ogg}} '''Amber:''' That's right. So for wolves to be showing up around Drunkard Gorge is very unusual.
::{{A|vo rzlq002 1 paimon 02b 3.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Speaking of wolves, do you happen to know a wolf boy from Wolvendom?
::{{A|vo rzlq002 1 ambor 01b 6.ogg}} '''Amber:''' Who? I've never heard of anyone like that around Mondstadt.
::{{A|vo rzlq002 1 paimon 02b 4.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Um... What?
::{{A|vo rzlq002 1 paimon 02b 5.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' "The red one, burny girl"... That ain't you?
::{{A|vo rzlq002 1 ambor 01b 7.ogg}} '''Amber:''' Burny...? What are you talking about?
::{{A|vo rzlq002 1 ambor 01b 8.ogg}} '''Amber:''' Anyways, I'm off to Drunkard Gorge to investigate.
::{{A|vo rzlq002 1 ambor 01b 9.ogg}} '''Amber:''' Come with me!
----
;(Talk to Amber about the disturbances up ahead)
:{{A|vo rzlq002 3 ambor 01.ogg}} '''Amber:''' Look, up ahead! Something's happening.
:{{A|vo rzlq002 3 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' That ain't no wolf pack... looks like it's the hilichurls attacking the carts after all.
:{{A|vo rzlq002 3 ambor 02.ogg}} '''Amber:''' Huh. Not such a mystery after all.
:{{A|vo rzlq002 3 ambor 03.ogg}} '''Amber:''' Enough talk. Let's go help out!

;(Approach [[Siegfria]] after defeating the hilichurls)
:{{A|vo rzlq002 5 siegfria 01.ogg}} '''Siegfria:''' Bless you!
:{{A|vo rzlq002 5 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Piece of cake!
:{{A|vo rzlq002 5 ambor 01.ogg}} '''Amber:''' So, the hilichurls have been starting to flex their muscles on the back of the wolf scare.
:{{A|vo rzlq002 5 siegfria 02.ogg}} '''Siegfria:''' That's right. But I must say, if you think the hilichurls are a nasty lot, the wolves are even worse.
:{{A|vo rzlq002 5 siegfria 03.ogg}} '''Siegfria:''' They... they attacked [[Springvale]] this morning.
:{{A|vo rzlq002 5 ambor 02.ogg}} '''Amber:''' Springvale!? That's crazy!
:{{A|vo rzlq002 5 siegfria 04.ogg}} '''Siegfria:''' It's unheard of.
:{{A|vo rzlq002 5 siegfria 05.ogg}} '''Siegfria:''' I thought I would take my chances on the road after the wolves had their fun... I never thought the hilichurls would show up too.
:{{A|vo rzlq002 5 ambor 03.ogg}} '''Amber:''' We should head there soon and see how bad the situation is.
:{{A|vo rzlq002 5 ambor 04.ogg}} '''Amber:''' But first things first, you should assess the damage to your cart. Does it still work?
:{{A|vo rzlq002 5 siegfria 06.ogg}} '''Siegfria:''' I'll take a look.
{{Dialogue End}}

==Dialogue==
{{Quest Description|As [[Albedo]] expected, [[Festering Desire|this sword]] can absorb the power to display a facsimile of "growth." This rare ability has caused it to catch the eye of certain parties with ulterior motives.}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Talk to Albedo)
:{{A|vo eqxs002 2 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Albedo!
:{{A|vo eqxs002 2 albedo 01.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' You're back.
:{{A|vo eqxs002 2 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Haha! We've been working hard on the sword you know? Check it out!
:{{DIcon}} Have a look.
:{{A|vo eqxs002 2 albedo 02.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Hmm. Indeed.
:{{A|vo eqxs002 2 albedo 03.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' It is as I thought — this sword grows stronger as you use it in battle.
:{{A|vo eqxs002 2 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' I thought that only applied to people.
:{{A|vo eqxs002 2 albedo 04.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' And that's precisely what makes it special.
:{{A|vo eqxs002 2 albedo 05.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Ah yes, I should mention a more important matter first.
:{{A|vo eqxs002 2 albedo 06.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' I've investigated the area nearby, and I've discovered some unusual signs.
:{{A|vo eqxs002 2 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' It's not more thieves, is it?
:{{DIcon}} But aren't we the real thieves here?
:{{DIcon}} That's probably not how the [[Treasure Hoarders]] see things...
:{{A|vo eqxs002 2 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' That's true...
:{{A|vo eqxs002 2 albedo 07.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' I believe that these strange traces require investigation.
:{{A|vo eqxs002 2 albedo 08.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Whether it be thieves or something else, we shall investigate, and we shall find out.
----
;(Talk to Albedo at the investigation camp)
:{{A|vo eqxs002 2 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Lots of human activity here, that's for sure.
:{{A|vo eqxs002 2 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Looks like more than one person, too.
:{{DIcon}} Certainly seems like Treasure Hoarders.
:{{A|vo eqxs002 2 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So they have a camp here... Hmph! Here to steal, just as usual.
:{{A|vo eqxs002 2 albedo 09.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' It would be rather convenient to rob adventurers who come up here, yes.
:{{A|vo eqxs002 2 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' It's survival of the fittest here on this mountain, huh?
:{{A|vo eqxs002 2 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' All that stealing though, and still every last one of them's still poor as dirt...
:{{DIcon}} I wonder if we should feel sorry for them...
:{{DIcon}} Perhaps this is their fate?
:{{A|vo eqxs002 2 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hmph! Anyone who calls us thieves gets no pity from Paimon!
:;(Conversation with Albedo is interrupted by Treasure Hoarders)
:{{A|vo eqxs002 2 thoardera 01.ogg}} '''???:''' Who's that? Who're these sniveling sneaks snooping around our camp?
:{{A|vo eqxs002 2 paimon 12.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Argh, we're busted!
----
;(After defeating the Treasure Hoarders, Fatui Skirmishers appear)
:{{A|vo eqxs002 5 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh? What are the [[Fatui]] doing here!?
:{{A|vo eqxs002 5 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' And those Treasure Hoarders look just as confused as we do, too!
----
;(After defeating the Fatui Skirmishers)
:{{A|vo eqxs002 6 albedo 01.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' The Fatui? And they chose to attack us within the Treasure Hoarders' camp... Did they follow us here?
:{{A|vo eqxs002 6 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' But why would they do that?
:{{A|vo eqxs002 6 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Did you go rile them up while we weren't looking?
:{{A|vo eqxs002 6 albedo 02.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Did you?
:{{DIcon}} Why, I never!
:{{DIcon}} I wouldn't do something like that.
:{{A|vo eqxs002 6 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Um, maybe it's something we all did, then...
:{{A|vo eqxs002 6 albedo 03.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' I think the Fatui are looking for this sword.
:{{A|vo eqxs002 6 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Eh!? Weren't you keeping this sword super secret? How did they know it existed?
:{{A|vo eqxs002 6 albedo 04.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Perhaps they caught sight of you using it on the mountain.
:{{A|vo eqxs002 6 albedo 05.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' If their eyes are any good, they'll definitely have seen how this sword stands out from the rest.
:{{A|vo eqxs002 6 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' They really want everything, don't they?
:{{A|vo eqxs002 6 albedo 06.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Not quite, no.
:{{DIcon}} I remember hearing more about their activities recently too...
:{{A|vo eqxs002 6 albedo 07.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' The Fatui are collecting things related the [[archons]]. This, I believe, is known to you.
:{{A|vo eqxs002 6 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh. Now that you mention it, we did hear Master [[Diluc]] say that.
:{{A|vo eqxs002 6 albedo 08.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' [[Durin (Historical)|Durin]] is the sworn enemy of the [[Barbatos|Anemo Archon]], and had power comparable to his.
:{{A|vo eqxs002 6 albedo 09.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' To say that it could rival the archons, or was related to them... Neither is an overstatement.
:{{DIcon}} No wonder they've set their sights on this sword.
:{{A|vo eqxs002 6 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So that's how it is...
:{{A|vo eqxs002 6 albedo 10.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' I made a new discovery while sketching nearby.
:{{A|vo eqxs002 6 albedo 11.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' There's an area up ahead that's quite remarkable. Its ley lines flow differently from any other.
:{{A|vo eqxs002 6 albedo 12.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Nearby monsters have been attracted to it and have fallen under its influence. As a result, their constitutions have come to far surpass others of the same kind.
:{{A|vo eqxs002 6 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' That seems convenient.
:{{A|vo eqxs002 6 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Well, we're here to help this sword grow, aren't we? Might as well go try it out on those monsters!
:{{A|vo eqxs002 6 albedo 13.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Precisely my intention. Oh, and do remember to observe how various enemies affect this sword differently while you're at it, please.
----
;(After defeating the monsters at the ley line disorder)
:{{A|vo eqxs002 9 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So, how did it feel?
:{{DIcon}} The sword's power has increased.
:{{DIcon}} There are different responses... but there is an identical flow of energy.
:{{A|vo eqxs002 9 albedo 01.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' I have a hypothesis concerning this.
:{{A|vo eqxs002 9 albedo 02.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Each time this sword absorbs power from the bodies of fallen enemies, it will resonate with Durin's remains, hidden somewhere on this mountain.
:{{A|vo eqxs002 9 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Holy moly, that sounds amazing!
:{{A|vo eqxs002 9 albedo 03.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' If my theory proves correct, this could mean that all the monsters here may be resonating with Durin's body.
:{{DIcon}} But why would they do that?
:{{A|vo eqxs002 9 albedo 04.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' I fear this may have to do with the origin of these monsters' powers.
:{{A|vo eqxs002 9 albedo 05.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Durin is no ordinary beast. Even though it is long dead, the entire mountain is still held in thrall by its corpse.
:{{A|vo eqxs002 9 albedo 06.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' The dragon's mysterious power... may itself be a form of curse.
:{{A|vo eqxs002 9 albedo 07.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' We still don't have enough information. If we wish to understand more, more data is required. This is where you come in.
:{{A|vo eqxs002 9 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Guess story-time's become work—time...
:{{A|vo eqxs002 9 albedo 08.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' I have some research work that needs settling, so we will have to work separately for now. Let's meet up again near the broken bridge.
{{Dialogue End}}

:::{{A|vo vrslq001 2 varesa 06.ogg}} '''Varesa:''' I've been so excited to meet you ever since Coach Iansan told me you might be coming. Oh, my name's Varesa, by the way. Not sure if Coach mentioned me before...

:::{{A|vo vrslq001 2 varesa 09.ogg}} '''Varesa:''' But, that's in the past, the Collective of Plenty fared pretty well, all things considered. We finished our repairs, so now it's just a matter of helping out the other tribes.

;(Approach the marked location)
:{{A|vo vrslq001 8 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Um, about what you told us earlier... You're saying, a gigantic rock could crush us at any moment?

:{{A|vo vrslq001 14 varesa 01.ogg}} '''Varesa:''' Ah, home sweet home! We made it! Welcome to the Collective of Plenty!
:{{A|vo vrslq001 14 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Whoa, this place is so cool! That platform shaped like the head of a bull is awesome!
:{{A|vo vrslq001 14 varesa 02.ogg}} '''Varesa:''' Hehe, that's the [[Resonating Arena]]! It's where we hold all our competitions.
:{{DIcon}} Thanks for bringing us here.
:{{A|vo vrslq001 14 varesa 03.ogg}} '''Varesa:''' Don't mention it! It was no trouble at all.
:{{A|vo vrslq001 14 varesa 04.ogg}} '''Varesa:''' I wish I could show you around, but I need to get home.
:{{A|vo vrslq001 14 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, did you remember something important? You really hit the ground running when we ran into those hilichurls back there...

:{{A|vo vrslq001 14 varesa 05.ogg}} '''Varesa:''' Oh no, not at all! We made it in time! There's just something important I have to do... The most important thing after training — the post-workout meal!
:{{A|vo vrslq001 14 varesa 06.ogg}} '''Varesa:''' Otherwise, I'll be a lethargic, dizzy, hunger-addled mess. The perils of an empty stomach... It's terrible.
:{{A|vo vrslq001 14 varesa 07.ogg}} '''Varesa:''' Anyway, I'm sorry, but I've gotta get some food in me... like yesterday! You should grab something, too!
:{{A|vo vrslq001 14 varesa 08.ogg}} '''Varesa:''' We can meet back up at the arena! See you soon!
:{{A|vo vrslq001 14 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' And, she's off...
:{{A|vo vrslq001 14 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wow, talk about whiplash... One second she's chill and laid-back, and the next she's charging head-first into danger... literally!
:{{DIcon}} It's the spirit of youth.
:{{A|vo vrslq001 14 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' The spirit of youth? Sure, whatever you say, old-timer... Paimon thinks we're still young!
:{{A|vo vrslq001 14 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Anyway, why don't we take a look around in the meantime? We can head to the arena in a little bit.
:{{A|vo vrslq001 14 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' The view must be amazing from up there!

==Dialogue==
{{Quest Description|The Knights have provided Razor with the ingredients he needs, and preparations seem to almost be complete. Head over to the Knights of Favonius Headquarters to check in on them.}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(On passing time)
:{{A|vo jnjeq003 1 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Lisa said that the Knights of Favonius would help us get ingredients for Razor's wine, right? They should probably be ready by now.
:{{A|vo jnjeq003 1 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Let's go check.

;(Enter the Knights of Favonius headquarters)
:{{A|vo jnjeq003 2 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hmm... Paimon wonders how Razor's "class" has been going...
:{{A|vo jnjeq003 2 noelle 01.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' Sucrose! Wait!
:{{Introductory Note|character=Noelle}}
:{{A|vo jnjeq003 2 noelle 02.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' Honorary Knight {{Traveler}}, Paimon, please stop her!
:{{A|vo jnjeq003 2 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Whoa, you scared Paimon!
:{{A|vo jnjeq003 2 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What's gotten the two of you so worked up?
:{{A|vo jnjeq003 2 noelle 03.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' Sucrose and I agreed to present the wine ingredient to you together. But when she heard that Razor will be showing up, she insisted that she won't spend a moment longer here than she has to.
:{{A|vo jnjeq003 2 sucrose 01.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' I—I'm not good at dealing with strangers... Anyway, as long as the ingredient gets into the right hands, that's all that matters...
:{{Introductory Note|character=Sucrose}}
:{{A|vo jnjeq003 2 noelle 04.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' That won't do! We worked on this together and we should present it together. I can't take credit for what you did.
:{{A|vo jnjeq003 2 sucrose 02.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' It's not about... the credit...
:{{A|vo jnjeq003 2 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wait, so does this mean the Knights of Favonius' ingredient is a product of Bio-Alchemy?
:{{A|vo jnjeq003 2 noelle 05.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' Yes, it's a Quadruple-Sweetness [[Sunsettia]].
::{{Item|Sunsettia|notext=1|70}}
:{{A|vo jnjeq003 2 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Quadruple sweetness? But aren't regular ones sweet enough as it is?
:{{A|vo jnjeq003 2 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Also... why a Sunsettia?
:{{A|vo jnjeq003 2 noelle 06.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' Okay, um, let me give you the full story.
:{{A|vo jnjeq003 2 noelle 07.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' I love the scent of wine, and after reading up on the art of wine-making, I have grasped some of the key principles.
:{{A|vo jnjeq003 2 noelle 08.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' In short, whatever ingredients you use, it's essential to include something sweet.
:{{A|vo jnjeq003 2 noelle 09.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' In an attempt to select the most suitable ingredient, I gathered samples of all the sweet plants and fruits I could find in the Mondstadt area. Then, I tried them all in turn and took detailed notes.
:{{A|vo jnjeq003 2 noelle 10.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' I also factored in the differences between the same ingredient grown in different locations. For instance, [[Sweet Flower]]s from [[Springvale]] are a little sweeter than those at [[Cape Oath]].
:{{A|vo jnjeq003 2 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wow, that sounds like a lot of work...
:{{A|vo jnjeq003 2 noelle 11.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' It was no problem at all. Just my duty as a Maid of Favonius!
:{{A|vo jnjeq003 2 noelle 12.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' The chance to source the "defender's will" on behalf of the Knights of Favonius is a huge honor for me!
:{{A|vo jnjeq003 2 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Noelle, your eyes are sparkling...
:{{A|vo jnjeq003 2 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' But Paimon thinks it could be because of Lisa's brainwashing...
:{{DIcon}} Paimon, shush.
:{{A|vo jnjeq003 2 noelle 13.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' Um, anyway, I was worried that my evaluation would be too subjective if only I were involved. Thankfully, I ran into Sucrose the other day on her way out of the lab...
:{{A|vo jnjeq003 2 sucrose 03.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' Oh no!
:{{A|vo jnjeq003 2 noelle 14.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' What is it, Sucrose?
:{{A|vo jnjeq003 2 sucrose 04.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' I just remembered why I left the lab that day... I was supposed to go and fetch some lab equipment we imported recently...
:{{A|vo jnjeq003 2 noelle 15.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' ...
:{{A|vo jnjeq003 2 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Uh-oh... That look on your faces seems to say, you forgot all about it and have been in the lab this whole time...
:{{A|vo jnjeq003 2 noelle 16.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' Yeah, exactly... I'm so sorry...
:{{A|vo jnjeq003 2 sucrose 05.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' *sigh* Don't worry about it, it's my fault really. I'll go and see [[Marjorie]] about the equipment shortly. Carry on, Noelle.
:{{A|vo jnjeq003 2 noelle 17.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' Oh, okay!
:{{A|vo jnjeq003 2 noelle 18.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' Anyway, Sucrose is a true professional when it comes to this kind of research! I showed her my list, and she made some extremely valuable suggestions...
:{{A|vo jnjeq003 2 sucrose 06.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' Please, you don't need to go out of your way to compliment me...
:{{A|vo jnjeq003 2 sucrose 07.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' Noelle filled me in on the background of the whole situation.
:{{A|vo jnjeq003 2 sucrose 08.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' I was moved to see how seriously she took this task, even though she'd never even met Razor before. However, none of the potential ingredients she had identified were perfect candidates, in my opinion.
:{{A|vo jnjeq003 2 sucrose 09.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' What we needed was a fruit high in sugar and easily fermentable. After a final look at Noelle's list, I picked the Sunsettia sample from near [[Cider Lake]] as a basis, with a view to improving it.
:{{A|vo jnjeq003 2 sucrose 10.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' Using Bio-Alchemical techniques, we were able to amplify the sweetness, then conduct a few tests to compare the results against the benchmarks...
:{{A|vo jnjeq003 2 noelle 19.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' Watching Sucrose work on an experiment when she's in the zone blew me away! Such focus and determination...
:{{A|vo jnjeq003 2 sucrose 11.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' Ah, I already said don't compliment me...
:{{A|vo jnjeq003 2 sucrose 12.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' Anyway... The result of our research is the "Epsilon-Series Tetrasweet Sunsettia, Variation 63," and it's finally ready. The sweetness has been verified through rigorous testing, and the size and color are both optimal, too.
:{{A|vo jnjeq003 2 sucrose 13.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' Noelle shortened the name to "Quadruple-Sweetness Sunsettia."
:{{A|vo jnjeq003 2 sucrose 14.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' Unfortunately, it can't be produced on a very large scale under the current conditions... but as long as we have enough for Razor.
:{{DIcon}} This is more than sufficient.
:{{DIcon}} Can I have a little bite, just to taste?
::{{A|vo jnjeq003 2 paimon 11b 1.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hey! What's wrong with you?
:{{A|vo jnjeq003 2 sucrose 15.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' {{Traveler}}... there's something else I'd like to share with you.
:{{A|vo jnjeq003 2 sucrose 16.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' Growing up... I was lucky. I was never the best at dealing with other people, but my parents never placed any expectations on me.
:{{A|vo jnjeq003 2 sucrose 17.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' They never said to me, "you need to be more sociable," or anything like that. They just said I should "do what I enjoy."
:{{A|vo jnjeq003 2 sucrose 18.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' So, I'm well aware that... I'm one of the lucky ones.
:{{A|vo jnjeq003 2 sucrose 19.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' I haven't lived Razor's life, and I can't pretend to imagine what it must have been like. So, I don't know how much it will mean coming from me, but... I truly hope that he can find happiness and spend his life doing what he loves.
:{{A|vo jnjeq003 2 noelle 20.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' Aw, Sucrose...
:'''The door of the library:''' *click*
:(Sucrose leaves the scene hastily)
:{{A|vo jnjeq003 2 razor 01.ogg}} '''Razor:''' Sorry. I am late again.
:{{A|vo jnjeq003 2 razor 02.ogg}} '''Razor:''' Teacher, forgot about the time. Kept talking, and talking.

:{{A|vo jnjeq003 3 klee 02a.ogg}}<!--{{A|vo jnjeq003 3 klee 02b.ogg}}--> '''Klee:''' Ummmm... I told her that Razor's looking for his mommy with the Honorary Knight's help, and you both seemed really sad, and said you needed some wine, so maybe Diona could help...
:{{A|vo jnjeq003 3 klee 03.ogg}} '''Klee:''' But before I finished, Diona said, "Klee, say no more, I'm getting involved in this if it's the last thing I do." And... then we came here...
:{{DIcon}} ...
:{{A|vo jnjeq003 3 razor 02.ogg}} '''Razor:''' Uh...
:{{A|vo jnjeq003 3 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh... okay... Paimon doesn't even know where to start. Diona, it sounds like Klee left out a few important details in this story. Let us set the record straight...
:{{Black Screen|You explain the situation to Diona...}}
:{{A|vo jnjeq003 3 diona 05.ogg}} '''Diona:''' So you're saying... Razor wants to make the same wine that his mother and father once made, so he can learn more about them? ...Hmm, you'd better not be making this up to try and pull the wool over my eyes...

:{{DIcon}} Absolutely not.
:{{A|vo jnjeq003 3 klee 04.ogg}} '''Klee:''' Sorry, Diona, it was all Klee's fault for not explaining it properly.
:{{A|vo jnjeq003 3 klee 05.ogg}} '''Klee:''' So... are you still mad? Or can you help Razor make the wine?
:{{A|vo jnjeq003 3 klee 06.ogg}} '''Klee:''' I caught a bunch of fish for us to eat. Um... and you can pet Dodoco too if you want.
:{{A|vo jnjeq003 3 diona 06.ogg}} '''Diona:''' ...I—I wasn't THAT angry.
:{{A|vo jnjeq003 3 diona 07.ogg}} '''Diona:''' You were just trying to help. I understand.
:{{A|vo jnjeq003 3 diona 08.ogg}} '''Diona:''' I just don't want Razor being led astray, that's all. That's why I may have raised my voice a little bit just now... Hmm, well, since none of you plan on drinking it, then I suppose I can help you just this once, despite my reservations.
:{{A|vo jnjeq003 3 diona 09.ogg}} '''Diona:''' But I need you to know that I'm a mixer, not a brewer, so I'm used to working with the finished product. If you really want me to start with a bunch of raw ingredients, that's fine, but I can't make any promises about how it'll turn out...
:{{A|vo jnjeq003 3 klee 07.ogg}} '''Klee:''' Yay! Diona is the best!
:{{A|vo jnjeq003 3 razor 03.ogg}} '''Razor:''' Hehe.
:{{DIcon}} Don't worry, Diona, you got this!
:{{DIcon}} You can do it, Diona!
:{{A|vo jnjeq003 3 diona 10.ogg}} '''Diona:''' Hmph, bunch of flatterers. Now watch this.
:{{Black Screen|Diona puts her signature mixological magic to work...}}
:{{A|vo jnjeq003 3 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' All done! That was quick!
:{{A|vo jnjeq003 3 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Now we just need to find a place to store it.
:{{A|vo jnjeq003 3 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' "We wait, wait for a windier day." ...Hmm, does that mean we need to put it somewhere exposed to the wind?
:{{A|vo jnjeq003 3 razor 04.ogg}} '''Razor:''' Maybe... [[Windrise]]? Very windy.

:{{A|vo jnjeq003 3 diona 11.ogg}} '''Diona:''' I have to keep an eye on [[Draff|my foolish father]], so I won't be joining you.

;(Approach Venti at the [[Symbol of Mondstadt's Hero]])
:{{A|vo jnjeq003 4 venti 01.ogg}} '''Venti:''' Ah, what a curious coincidence meeting you here!
:{{A|vo jnjeq003 4 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Tone-Deaf Bard? What are you doing here?
:{{A|vo jnjeq003 4 venti 02.ogg}} '''Venti:''' Well, I awoke to the most magnificent aroma in the air. After following the sweet scent of fresh fruit to its source, this is where I ended up.
:{{A|vo jnjeq003 4 klee 01.ogg}} '''Klee:''' Yeah, the fruit are super fresh and super-duper sweet! I can smell it as well!

:{{A|vo jnjeq003 4 venti 03.ogg}} '''Venti:''' Yes. Oh ah, I remembered something important. Something that you have to do before sealing the barrel and burying it in the ground.
:{{A|vo jnjeq003 4 klee 02.ogg}} '''Klee:''' What? We missed something!?
:{{A|vo jnjeq003 4 venti 04.ogg}} '''Venti:''' Razor, do you still remember the scent of that half-bottle of [[Thousand-Wind Wine]]? I believe there was a hint of bitterness in there?
:{{A|vo jnjeq003 4 razor 01.ogg}} '''Razor:''' Yes, there was.
:{{A|vo jnjeq003 4 venti 05.ogg}} '''Venti:''' Hahaha, and with very good reason, too. The source? ...This.
:{{A|vo jnjeq003 4 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' [[Dandelion Seed]]s?
:{{A|vo jnjeq003 4 venti 06.ogg}} '''Venti:''' You're familiar with Dandelion Wine, right? Well, the people of Mondstadt believe that the wind can bring back the soul, and also preserve memories.
:{{A|vo jnjeq003 4 venti 07.ogg}} '''Venti:''' Dandelion Seeds are like living gemstones, formed from the first wisps of wind in the year. People add them to the mix at the last second as a way of capturing the wind in the very moment that the barrel is sealed.
:{{A|vo jnjeq003 4 venti 08.ogg}} '''Venti:''' The memory of that moment is then stored in the wine, for all time.
:{{A|vo jnjeq003 4 venti 09.ogg}} '''Venti:''' So, Thousand-Wind Wine is the original [[Dandelion Wine]].
:{{A|vo jnjeq003 4 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Whoa!
:{{A|vo jnjeq003 4 klee 03.ogg}} '''Klee:''' That's so cool! So now our story will be made into wine, too!
:{{A|vo jnjeq003 4 venti 10.ogg}} '''Venti:''' As for why it always has a different scent... Well, that's because people have the freedom to include whatever ingredients they want, hehe~
:{{A|vo jnjeq003 4 razor 02.ogg}} '''Razor:''' Hmm...
:{{A|vo jnjeq003 4 klee 04.ogg}} '''Klee:''' What is it, Razor? Whatcha thinkin' about?
:{{A|vo jnjeq003 4 razor 03.ogg}} '''Razor:''' In mother and father's wine, I can smell Dandelion Seeds, but I don't know what else.
:{{A|vo jnjeq003 4 razor 04.ogg}} '''Razor:''' In my wine, there is a lot of... friendship.
:{{A|vo jnjeq003 4 razor 05.ogg}} '''Razor:''' I still don't understand my mother and father, but... I still have you, and everyone else.
:{{A|vo jnjeq003 4 razor 06.ogg}} '''Razor:''' Everyone has done so much for me.
:{{A|vo jnjeq003 4 razor 07.ogg}} '''Razor:''' Varka, [[Lisa|Teacher]], Klee, Bennett, [[Draff|Uncle Brown Cat]], [[Rosaria|cold lady]], [[Kaeya|grown-up with fake smile]]...
:{{A|vo jnjeq003 4 razor 08.ogg}} '''Razor:''' {{sic|[[Noelle|Grey tough girl]]}}, [[Sucrose|person that smells like Anemo Crystalfly]], [[Diona|Uncle Browncat's daughter]]...
:{{A|vo jnjeq003 4 razor 09.ogg}} '''Razor:''' [[Venti|Green bard]], Paimon, and {{Traveler}}.
:{{A|vo jnjeq003 4 razor 10.ogg}} '''Razor:''' I remember everyone.
:{{A|vo jnjeq003 4 razor 11.ogg}} '''Razor:''' Making wine... is hard work.
:{{A|vo jnjeq003 4 razor 12.ogg}} '''Razor:''' Making this wine needed everyone, working together.
:{{A|vo jnjeq003 4 razor 13.ogg}} '''Razor:''' Hard work with friends... not so hard after all.
:{{A|vo jnjeq003 4 razor 14.ogg}} '''Razor:''' I'm... I'm so happy.
:{{DIcon}} We are all glad to help.
:{{DIcon}} It makes us happy to see you happy.
:{{A|vo jnjeq003 4 razor 15.ogg}} '''Razor:''' Thank you.
:{{A|vo jnjeq003 4 razor 16.ogg}} '''Razor:''' Friends... are also lupical.
:{{A|vo jnjeq003 4 razor 17.ogg}} '''Razor:''' Whether I'm human, or I'm wolf... it doesn't matter. From now on, all of us are together.
:{{A|vo jnjeq003 4 razor 18.ogg}} '''Razor:''' When I grow up, we will come back here. And we will open this wine... together.
:{{A|vo jnjeq003 4 venti 11.ogg}} '''Venti:''' What a magnificent monologue. Even as a bard, I don't feel like there's anything else to add.
:{{A|vo jnjeq003 4 venti 12.ogg}} '''Venti:''' All that remains now is to bury the barrel and wait, wait for the fruit to ferment.
:{{Black Screen|The group buries the barrel in the ground...}}
:{{A|vo jnjeq003 4 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' We're finally done. Paimon feels like a celebration is in order!
:{{A|vo jnjeq003 4 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' If Paimon remembers correctly, tomorrow should be Windcoming Day, right?
:{{A|vo jnjeq003 4 klee 05.ogg}} '''Klee:''' Wow! The Anemo God is coming home!
:{{A|vo jnjeq003 4 venti 13.ogg}} '''Venti:''' Hahaha, that reminds me — I haven't memorized the song for the toasting ceremony yet. I'd better get back. Friends, I shall see you all tomorrow.
:{{A|vo jnjeq003 4 venti 14.ogg}} '''Venti:''' Get a good night's sleep tonight. Wait for the whisper of the gentle breeze to rouse you tomorrow morning, then come and enjoy a performance by the greatest bard to ever grace the streets of Mondstadt.

:{{A|vo jnjeq003 6 venti 03.ogg}} '''Venti:'''

::"How does this fine wine taste to the tongue?<br>As 'Mondstadt' to the ear: like a sweet dream of freedom.<br>And what are the fruits that went into the brew?<br>An explorer's courage, a love tender and true."
:{{A|vo jnjeq003 6 venti 05.ogg}} '''Venti:'''
::"A defender's will, strong as yesteryear,<br>Joining the thousand winds in a song of good cheer,<br>Turning sour into sweet, bitter notes fade away,<br>As we wait, wait for a windier day."
:{{A|vo jnjeq003 6 venti 06.ogg}} '''Venti:'''
::"Pray tell, what treasure does this barrel hold?<br>'Tis wheat's greatest triumph, the true liquid gold.<br>As it flows from the keg, what sound drifts by?<br>Wind chimes in the boundless, immemorial sky."
:{{A|vo jnjeq003 6 venti 07.ogg}} '''Venti:'''
::"We raise up our glasses, and voices in song,<br>As we wait, wait for the wind to sing along.<br>Where do we turn once the thousand winds take flight?<br>To the tales of the lyre, to the sweet dream of tonight."

:{{A|vo jnjeq003 6 razor 02.ogg}} '''Razor:''' To the Anemo Archon...
:{{DIcon}} To the Anemo Archon.

:{{DIcon}} I don't think so...

:::{{A|vo jnjeq004 1 diluc 04a 1.ogg}} '''Diluc:''' *sigh* I can sympathize with the anguish of being away from family.
:::{{A|vo jnjeq004 1 diluc 04a 2.ogg}} '''Diluc:''' Certainly, a tragic situation. But tragedy can also drive personal growth, and perhaps learning how to face it head-on is part of growing up... part of becoming an adult.
:::{{A|vo jnjeq004 1 diluc 04a 3.ogg}} '''Diluc:''' Having the support of some good friends will certainly make that journey easier.
::{{DIcon}} About the voices...
:::{{A|vo jnjeq004 1 diluc 04b 1.ogg}} '''Diluc:''' ...When I unsealed the wine, it seemed that the words of my late father were sealed inside.
:::{{A|vo jnjeq004 1 diluc 04b 2.ogg}} '''Diluc:''' I wonder what he would think if he were to see me now.
:::{{A|vo jnjeq004 1 diluc 04b 3.ogg}} '''Diluc:''' Somehow, I doubt he'd share the same view as he did back then.
:::{{DIcon}} Of course he would.
:::{{A|vo jnjeq004 1 diluc 04b 4.ogg}} '''Diluc:''' Heh...
:::{{A|vo jnjeq004 1 diluc 04b 5.ogg}} '''Diluc:''' If you say so.
::{{DIcon}} About the Weinlesefest...
:::{{A|vo jnjeq004 1 diluc 04c 1.ogg}} '''Diluc:''' To the people of Mondstadt, wine-making is a way of working through emotions, and remembering our history.
:::{{A|vo jnjeq004 1 diluc 04c 2.ogg}} '''Diluc:''' We're only able to make such high-quality wines these days thanks to the peace we enjoy. War is a thing of the distant past.
:::{{A|vo jnjeq004 1 diluc 04c 3.ogg}} '''Diluc:''' Even though you might not see me reveling with the crowds, I am grateful for this as much as anyone.
:::{{A|vo jnjeq004 1 diluc 04c 4.ogg}} '''Diluc:''' Say, have you tried our latest product, "Fruits of the Festival"?
:::{{A|vo jnjeq004 1 diluc 04c 5.ogg}} '''Diluc:''' If you have any thoughts on how it could be improved, I'm all ears.
:{{DIcon}} I'll leave you in peace.
::{{A|vo jnjeq004 1 diluc 02b 1.ogg}} '''Diluc:''' Sure. We'll talk when you're free.
{{Dialogue End}}

===Lisa===
Lisa can be found on the porch of [[Good Hunter]].
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Talk to Lisa)
:{{A|vo jnjeq004 1 lisa 04.ogg}} '''Lisa:''' Ah, I'm much more suited to leisurely days like these...
:{{DIcon}} Do you want to chat?
::{{A|vo jnjeq004 1 lisa 06.ogg}} '''Lisa:''' I'd love to, cutie. Hmm, too bad I can't offer you some tea.
::{{DIcon}} About Varka...
:::{{A|vo jnjeq004 1 lisa 07a 1.ogg}} '''Lisa:''' I was quite surprised to learn that the Grand Master had written a private message just for me.
:::{{A|vo jnjeq004 1 lisa 07a 2.ogg}} '''Lisa:''' And I was equally surprised to find out that Razor's been on his mind this whole time.
:::{{A|vo jnjeq004 1 lisa 07a 3.ogg}} '''Lisa:''' Especially given how demanding he is of Jean... He left her to figure out the whole Weinlesefest on her own, and didn't give her a single word of acknowledgment.
:::{{A|vo jnjeq004 1 lisa 07a 4.ogg}} '''Lisa:''' I'll have to have to a stern word with him on Jean's behalf when he returns.
::{{DIcon}} About Razor...
:::{{A|vo jnjeq004 1 lisa 07b 1.ogg}} '''Lisa:''' It's funny — I always thought the Grand Master was the one who gave him the name "Razor"...
:::{{A|vo jnjeq004 1 lisa 07b 2.ogg}} '''Lisa:''' But it turns out his birth parents chose it all along.
:::{{A|vo jnjeq004 1 lisa 07b 3.ogg}} '''Lisa:''' ...
:::{{A|vo jnjeq004 1 lisa 07b 4.ogg}} '''Lisa:''' Anyway, Razor told me he heard the voices of his parents during the festival.
:::{{A|vo jnjeq004 1 lisa 07b 5.ogg}} '''Lisa:''' "Like stepping on a rock in the sun. Warm, but also heavy."
:::{{A|vo jnjeq004 1 lisa 07b 6.ogg}} '''Lisa:''' I'm sure he must think of them as both kind and dauntless people...
::{{DIcon}} About the Weinlesefest...
:::{{A|vo jnjeq004 1 lisa 07c 1.ogg}} '''Lisa:''' Originally, I only planned on having a glass or two. I thought I deserved a treat after being such a good teacher recently.
:::{{A|vo jnjeq004 1 lisa 07c 2.ogg}} '''Lisa:''' But that was before I came to appreciate how truly exceptional the festival-exclusive vintage was...
:::{{A|vo jnjeq004 1 lisa 07c 3.ogg}} '''Lisa:''' Before I knew it, I was already rather tipsy, hehe...
:::{{A|vo jnjeq004 1 lisa 07c 4.ogg}} '''Lisa:''' I'm a bad example. Don't be like me, cutie.
:{{DIcon}} I'll leave you in peace.
::{{A|vo jnjeq004 1 lisa 05b 1.ogg}} '''Lisa:''' Alright, but remember, it's important to rest when you're feeling tired. It makes my heart ache to see you so busy all the time.
{{Dialogue End}}

===Razor===
Razor can be found on a cliff east of Mondstadt across the Cider lake looking at the city.
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Talk to Razor)
:{{A|vo jnjeq004 1 razor 03.ogg}} '''Razor:''' The wind is gentle, comfortable.
:{{DIcon}} Do you want to chat?
::{{A|vo jnjeq004 1 razor 05.ogg}} '''Razor:''' Yes.
::{{DIcon}} About Varka...
:::{{A|vo jnjeq004 1 razor 06a 1.ogg}} '''Razor:''' The message in the letter... I want to thank him.
:::{{A|vo jnjeq004 1 razor 06a 2.ogg}} '''Razor:''' ...I miss him. Lupical miss him, too.
:::{{A|vo jnjeq004 1 razor 06a 3.ogg}} '''Razor:''' Now, I am grown up.
:::{{A|vo jnjeq004 1 razor 06a 4.ogg}} '''Razor:''' I want to hear him talk about human father and mother.
::{{DIcon}} About your parents...
:::{{A|vo jnjeq004 1 razor 06b 1.ogg}} '''Razor:''' Their voices. I heard them.
:::{{A|vo jnjeq004 1 razor 06b 2.ogg}} '''Razor:''' Human father and mother... were adventurers...
:::{{A|vo jnjeq004 1 razor 06b 3.ogg}} '''Razor:''' Teacher said, maybe they didn't survive...
:::{{DIcon}} Aw, Razor...
:::{{A|vo jnjeq004 1 razor 06b 4.ogg}} '''Razor:''' [[Razor/Lore#Razor's Crude Wooden Crate|I have a wooden box. Inside are treasures from my friends.]]
:::{{A|vo jnjeq004 1 razor 06b 5.ogg}} '''Razor:''' They are, most precious things I own.
:::{{A|vo jnjeq004 1 razor 06b 6.ogg}} '''Razor:''' ...
:::{{A|vo jnjeq004 1 razor 06b 7.ogg}} '''Razor:''' Inside box from human father and mother... is all about me...
::{{DIcon}} About friends...
:::{{A|vo jnjeq004 1 razor 06c 1.ogg}} '''Razor:''' A long time ago, I thought I was alone. Only have lupical.
:::{{A|vo jnjeq004 1 razor 06c 2.ogg}} '''Razor:''' Now, I know many people.
:::{{A|vo jnjeq004 1 razor 06c 3.ogg}} '''Razor:''' Everyone helps me. I will help everyone, too.
:::{{A|vo jnjeq004 1 razor 06c 4.ogg}} '''Razor:''' Humans, wolves, everyone.
:::{{A|vo jnjeq004 1 razor 07.ogg}} '''Razor:''' I am the bridge between city and outside.
:{{DIcon}} I'll leave you in peace.
::{{A|vo jnjeq004 1 razor 04b 1.ogg}} '''Razor:''' Okay. You go enjoy the wind.
{{Dialogue End}}

===Rosaria===
Rosaria can be found south of Mondstadt just outside the wall under a tree.
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Talk to Rosaria)
:{{A|vo jnjeq004 1 rosaria 01.ogg}} '''Rosaria:''' {{Traveler}}, hello again...
:{{DIcon}} Do you want to chat?
::{{A|vo jnjeq004 1 rosaria 03.ogg}} '''Rosaria:''' Sure. Did you have something you wanted to ask me about?
::{{DIcon}} About Varka...
:::{{A|vo jnjeq004 1 rosaria 04a 1.ogg}} '''Rosaria:''' Oh. Yes, I read his letter. Barbara showed it to me.
:::{{A|vo jnjeq004 1 rosaria 04a 2.ogg}} '''Rosaria:''' She'd been so worried about her father, Seamus. She almost burst into tears when she read that "the expedition is safe and all of its members are accounted for."
:::{{A|vo jnjeq004 1 rosaria 04a 3.ogg}} '''Rosaria:''' Hmm? ...My thoughts?
:::{{A|vo jnjeq004 1 rosaria 04a 4.ogg}} '''Rosaria:''' Hehe... You're curious what he means to me as a father figure, is that right? Well, I guess I'm not like other daughters. I can't bring myself to worry about him.
:::{{A|vo jnjeq004 1 rosaria 04a 5.ogg}} '''Rosaria:''' He wouldn't be leading that many people if he didn't have the necessary strength and courage for it. He's not the kind of person you need to worry about.
::{{DIcon}} About Razor...
:::{{A|vo jnjeq004 1 rosaria 04b 1.ogg}} '''Rosaria:''' So, he's finally come to terms with everything?
:::{{DIcon}} At the very least, he's no longer lost and confused.
:::{{DIcon}} He has a direction now.
:::{{A|vo jnjeq004 1 rosaria 04b 2.ogg}} '''Rosaria:''' Hmm, sounds like he still has some way to go before he can say he's fully independent. But everyone goes through their own life in their own way.
:::{{A|vo jnjeq004 1 rosaria 04b 3.ogg}} '''Rosaria:''' Well done. It sounds like your efforts were all worth it in the end.
::{{DIcon}} About the Weinlesefest...
:::{{A|vo jnjeq004 1 rosaria 04c 1.ogg}} '''Rosaria:''' I thought that if I made it to the Weinlesefest, I'd have the chance to spend a whole day in the tavern. Turns out, there's actually more work during a festival than usual.
:::{{A|vo jnjeq004 1 rosaria 04c 2.ogg}} '''Rosaria:''' I managed to escape to here, but I still can't completely let my guard down. Who knows when Victoria or Dahlia might show up and drag me off to the sung poetry event.
:::{{A|vo jnjeq004 1 rosaria 04c 3.ogg}} '''Rosaria:''' *sigh* The sooner this festival is over, the better.
:{{DIcon}} I'll leave you in peace.
::{{A|vo jnjeq004 1 rosaria 02b 1.ogg}} '''Rosaria:''' Alright. But don't tell anyone else that I'm here. I don't want to have to move anytime soon.
{{Dialogue End}}

===Sucrose===
Sucrose can be found at the Wine Festival venue.
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Talk to Sucrose)
:{{A|vo jnjeq004 1 sucrose 01.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' Hi there, are you here to take a look at my stall? I have a lot of newly developed research products.
:{{DIcon}} Do you want to chat?
::{{A|vo jnjeq004 1 sucrose 03.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' Um, okay, go ahead...
::{{DIcon}} About your stall...
:::{{A|vo jnjeq004 1 sucrose 04a 1.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' Oh, this?
:::{{A|vo jnjeq004 1 sucrose 04a 2.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' I actually wrote out all the nutritional information and prices for my Bio-Alchemy products in advance. But the customers still prefer to ask directly...
:::{{A|vo jnjeq004 1 sucrose 04a 3.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' So... I just read off the sheet for them...
:::{{A|vo jnjeq004 1 sucrose 04a 4.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' Running a stall is a huge challenge for me.
:::{{A|vo jnjeq004 1 sucrose 04a 5.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' Maybe I could get Noelle to interact with the customers, and I do the rest... Mmm, no, never mind... She's probably busy enough already.
::{{DIcon}} About your Bio-Alchemy products...
:::{{A|vo jnjeq004 1 sucrose 04b 1.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' I have here the Iota-Series Rapid-Acting Deep Freeze Mist Flower, the Theta-Series Fragrance-Enhanced Sweet Flower, Variation 21...
:::{{A|vo jnjeq004 1 sucrose 04b 2.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' And the Epsilon-Series Tetrasweet Sunsettia, Variation 63. I'm proud to put my name to all of these products!
:::{{A|vo jnjeq004 1 sucrose 04b 3.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' You won't need me to read out all the details, right?
::{{DIcon}} About Razor...
:::{{A|vo jnjeq004 1 sucrose 04c 1.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' I'm sorry for running off back then...
:::{{A|vo jnjeq004 1 sucrose 04c 2.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' I just thought that you and Noelle would do a better job of expressing things than I could...
:::{{A|vo jnjeq004 1 sucrose 04c 3.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' Did everything work out in the end? Mixing the Epsilon-Series Tetrasweet Sunsettia, Variation 63 with the other ingredients didn't cause any problems, did it?
:::{{A|vo jnjeq004 1 sucrose 04c 4.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' Oh, and uh... how did things go with Razor...
:::{{DIcon}} Don't worry. Everything turned out great.
:::{{A|vo jnjeq004 1 sucrose 04c 5.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' Phew... Thank goodness.
:::{{A|vo jnjeq004 1 sucrose 04c 6.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' Then... can I ask you for a favor? I want to make a note of the full recipe for the Thousand-Wind Wine we made.
:::{{A|vo jnjeq004 1 sucrose 04c 7.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' That way, we'll be able to recreate the exact same flavor we did today in the future, no matter how many years go by.
:{{DIcon}} I'll leave you in peace.
::{{A|vo jnjeq004 1 sucrose 02b 1.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' Oh, sure. No problem.
{{Dialogue End}}

===Venti===
Venti can be found at [[Starsnatch Cliff]].
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Talk to Venti)
:{{A|vo jnjeq004 1 venti 01.ogg}} '''Venti:''' I didn't expect you to come by here. Unless... oh, were you following the fragrance of wine on the wind?
:{{DIcon}} Do you want to chat?
::{{A|vo jnjeq004 1 venti 03.ogg}} '''Venti:''' Sure, the sound of your voice is always a pleasure to hear.
::{{DIcon}} About the blessings...
:::{{A|vo jnjeq004 1 venti 04a 1.ogg}} '''Venti:''' Blessings? Oh, that.
:::{{A|vo jnjeq004 1 venti 04a 2.ogg}} '''Venti:''' Between you and me... I breathed a sigh of relief when nobody said their wishes out loud during the toast. That would've really put me in a tough spot. Hahaha... The Anemo Archon, Barbatos, doesn't have unlimited power, you know.
:::{{A|vo jnjeq004 1 venti 04a 3.ogg}} '''Venti:''' I had to take a really deep breath to get the winds of the far-flung past blowing. I nearly went blue in the face.
::{{DIcon}} About Razor...
:::{{A|vo jnjeq004 1 venti 04b 1.ogg}} '''Venti:''' He's grown up so much recently... It's such a joy to see.
:::{{A|vo jnjeq004 1 venti 04b 2.ogg}} '''Venti:''' Huh... Suddenly I sound just like an old grandpa.
:::{{A|vo jnjeq004 1 venti 04b 3.ogg}} '''Venti:''' He was lucky to have friends like you ready to support him through all this.
:::{{A|vo jnjeq004 1 venti 04b 4.ogg}} '''Venti:''' I see a kind, gentle soul, with a healthy dose of romance and freedom, too... In other words, a true Mondstadter, who grew up drinking the water of Cider Lake.
:::{{A|vo jnjeq004 1 venti 04b 5.ogg}} '''Venti:''' You, on the other hand... Don't worry, you're the gentlest soul I've ever met.
::{{DIcon}} About drinking...
:::{{A|vo jnjeq004 1 venti 04c 1.ogg}} '''Venti:''' Oh, I've been very busy on that front. I'd long since drunk my fill by Windcoming Day.
:::{{A|vo jnjeq004 1 venti 04c 2.ogg}} '''Venti:''' But, uh, I wasn't counting on everyone bringing out their finest vintage to welcome me.
:::{{A|vo jnjeq004 1 venti 04c 3.ogg}} '''Venti:''' Ah, the fragrance alone was so intoxicating... I had no choice but to make room for a few more rounds...
:::{{A|vo jnjeq004 1 venti 05.ogg}} '''Venti:''' Full disclosure — I also secretly hid two bottles away for myself at the end.
:{{DIcon}} I'll leave you in peace.
::{{A|vo jnjeq004 1 venti 02b 1.ogg}} '''Venti:''' Then go, my friend. The stories that unfolded here shall be remembered by the wind in the form of verse.
{{Dialogue End}}
