==Dialogue==
{{Quest Description|You and [[Paimon]] begin to recall many a past happening at the very mention of the [[Moonchase Festival]]. But the most important thing right now is to enjoy the festival. While every festival is full of pleasant surprises, the two of you still have no idea what this one has in store for you...}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Continues from the previous quest)
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 1 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Where should we start? There's food to eat, fun games to try... Paimon wants to try everything...
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 1 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Anyway, no point standing here. Let's take a look around!

;(Approach the marked location)
:;(The Traveler and Paimon admire the moon-themed lantern on the platform)
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 1 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wow, look at the size of the moon! Seeing [[Yilong Wharf]] like this, it really has that festival feel...
:{{DIcon}} Something on your mind, Paimon?
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 1 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' It's nothing. Just that... Paimon suddenly remembered our first Moonchase Festival and how we went looking for recipes with [[Keqing]]. Feels like it was just yesterday, y'know?
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 1 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Since we started traveling together, holidays have always been a special time.
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 1 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' On one hand, whenever there's a festival, we'll find loads of good friends and tons of tasty treats to boot! And Paimon's lovin' all of it!
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 1 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' But on the other hand, though festivals come around every year, the people and things around them keep changing. It really gets Paimon thinking about the past...
:{{DIcon}} No matter the holiday...
:{{DIcon}} You and I won't change.
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 1 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hehe, Paimon knows! Right-o, let's do what we always do and enjoy the festival! Now, where to start...
:{{DIcon}} Isn't that Lan Yan?
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 1 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wasn't she taking [[Ningguang]] to see her clan elders? Let's go say hi, and while we're at it, ask her where we should start. She must know Yilong Wharf really well!

;(Approach Lan Yan)
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 2 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hiya, Lan Yan!
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 2 lanyan 01.ogg}} '''Lan Yan:''' Hello, {{Traveler}}, Paimon. Hmm... It hasn't been long enough for "long time no see," so... "short time no see," maybe?
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 2 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yeah, short time no see! Speaking of... weren't you supposed to take Ningguang to see the clan elders? How come you're back so soon?
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 2 lanyan 02.ogg}} '''Lan Yan:''' Oh, I was really only showing her the way.
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 2 lanyan 03.ogg}} '''Lan Yan:''' When someone like Lady Ningguang visits, lots and lots of clan elders always show up. A junior like me? I'd probably only get in the way if I stayed.
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 2 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Lots and lots, you say?
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 2 lanyan 04.ogg}} '''Lan Yan:''' Mm-hmm. Uncles, aunts, great-uncles, great-aunts...
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 2 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Stop, stop! Paimon can already picture the numbers just from hearing you rattle off that list...
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 2 lanyan 05.ogg}} '''Lan Yan:''' And every little thing matters in those meetings — who sits where, how the tea is served, and to whom... Every detail has to be right. Not exactly the kind of occasion I can handle.
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 2 lanyan 06.ogg}} '''Lan Yan:''' So, after seeing one of my uncles, I greeted him and excused myself.
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 2 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' To be honest, Paimon wouldn't know what to do at a gathering like that either... So this actually works out pretty nicely! So, where do you think we should start?
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 2 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Come to think of it, this is our first time celebrating a festival at Yilong Wharf.
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 2 lanyan 07.ogg}} '''Lan Yan:''' The associations of Chenyu Vale prepared so much good food and so many fun activities for this Moonchase Festival, I couldn't possibly explain it all in a few words. Hehe, why don't I show you around instead?
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 2 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yes please! But it might take a lot of time... Ningguang said the Lan clan's thaumaturges would be helping the Millelith. Aren't you going?
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 2 lanyan 08.ogg}} '''Lan Yan:''' The clan will handpick some real experts for that, so they don't need me tagging along and getting in the way.
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 2 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, Paimon understands now...
:{{DIcon}} Since you weren't chosen...
:{{DIcon}} Are you not disappointed?
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 2 lanyan 09.ogg}} '''Lan Yan:''' Huh. I wasn't expecting you to look at it like that... Hmm... How about this? Let me ask you a question.
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 2 lanyan 10.ogg}} '''Lan Yan:''' Should the mystic arts be treated as a "responsibility," to be studied with discipline, or as a "hobby," to be pursued however one likes?
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 2 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oof, that's a hard one. Paimon thinks both sides make sense...
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 2 lanyan 11.ogg}} '''Lan Yan:''' Apparently, back in the day, the Wind Reader asked his descendants that very question. When they could not decide, the Wind Reader said, "Why not both?"
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 2 lanyan 12.ogg}} '''Lan Yan:''' Since then, the Lan family has had a rule. Once children are old enough to understand, the elders give them a choice.
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 2 lanyan 13.ogg}} '''Lan Yan:''' If they want to study the mystic arts seriously, the clan will find them a master to study under. If they think of them as a hobby, nothing more is asked of them.
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 2 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So you chose the "hobby" option?
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 2 lanyan 14.ogg}} '''Lan Yan:''' Of course! Sitting in school getting scolded by a master is not my cup of tea. I probably would've snuck off to the hills near Qiaoying Village to fly kites, then completely forgotten about class.
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 2 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' When you put it like that, Paimon totally gets where you're coming from!
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 2 lanyan 15.ogg}} '''Lan Yan:''' So don't worry about me feeling down. This was my choice.
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 2 lanyan 16.ogg}} '''Lan Yan:''' My seniors have been taught lots of amazing arts that are super effective against evil spirits. I really look up to them.
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 2 lanyan 17.ogg}} '''Lan Yan:''' As for me, though, I mostly work things out on my own. Whenever I come across an art that catches my eye, I borrow whatever books I can find and start studying.
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 2 paimon 12.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oooh, Paimon's curious now. What kinds of mystic arts interest you?
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 2 lanyan 18.ogg}} '''Lan Yan:''' Hmm... Well, for example, I've been looking into one connected to swallows lately.
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 2 paimon 13.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Really? C'mon, tell us more!
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 2 lanyan 19.ogg}} '''Lan Yan:''' My elders say swallows are special birds. They carry mud and grass in their beaks, building nests under the eaves.
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 2 lanyan 20.ogg}} '''Lan Yan:''' But for as long as I can remember, I've never seen a swallow's nest under the eaves here in Chenyu Vale.
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 2 lanyan 21.ogg}} '''Lan Yan:''' Every year, the swallows rush through. Forget building nests — you can hardly even catch a glimpse of them. The elders' stories sound almost like some old legend.
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 2 paimon 14.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh, how come?
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 2 lanyan 22.ogg}} '''Lan Yan:''' I don't know either, but I did discover that swallows carry a kind of power that resonates well with the mystic arts our clan practices.
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 2 lanyan 23.ogg}} '''Lan Yan:''' That got me thinking... that maybe there's some technique that could fix whatever is keeping them away, so that they could come back and build their nests.
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 2 paimon 15.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Getting swallows to nest here again... Is that really possible?
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 2 lanyan 24.ogg}} '''Lan Yan:''' Unfortunately, I think I've hit a wall. No matter what I do, the formula is always missing a crucial piece...
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 2 paimon 16.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Still... That won't stop you though, right?
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 2 lanyan 25.ogg}} '''Lan Yan:''' Oh, it absolutely might! I've barely scratched the surface of my clan's arts, after all. If I get stuck, then I'm stuck, and that's fine.
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 2 lanyan 26.ogg}} '''Lan Yan:''' And then maybe one day, while I'm lying on a hill counting clouds, the answer will pop into my head.
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 2 paimon 17.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hehe. And here Paimon thought you might need some cheering up...
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 2 lanyan 27.ogg}} '''Lan Yan:''' Aww. You're always looking out for people, Paimon. I can see why you're such a great guide.
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 2 paimon 18.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Well, obviously! Hehe...
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 2 lanyan 28.ogg}} '''Lan Yan:''' Oh, right! I did say I'd show you around, didn't I? Follow me! Hehe, as it happens, I've been curious what being a guide feels like, too!
:{{DIcon}} Thanks, Lan Yan. We're in your hands.
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 2 lanjunming 01.ogg}} '''????:''' Moonchase ought not to be like this...
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 2 paimon 19.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh? Is someone causing trouble over there?
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 2 lanyan 29.ogg}} '''Lan Yan:''' Looks more like someone got lost... Let's go see what's going on. Since I'm a member of one of the associations, I should keep an eye on the festival.
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 2 paimon 20.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Sure, and we'll help too! Consider it a thank you.

;(Approach the unnamed man)
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 3 lanjunming 01.ogg}} '''???:''' Moonchase ought not to be like this...
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 3 lanyan 01.ogg}} '''Lan Yan:''' Excuse me, sir, is something the matter?
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 3 lanjunming 02.ogg}} '''???:''' Moonchase is not to be missed... But Moonchase was never meant to be like this... No, not only Moonchase. Liyue itself was never like this!
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 3 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What makes you say that?
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 3 lanjunming 03.ogg}} '''???:''' A food street featuring international cuisine? Since when does Moonchase have such things? The Moonchase Festival I recall has nothing whatsoever to do with matters of cookery!
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 3 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So... good food wasn't even in the picture? Who would celebrate Moonchase like that?
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 3 lanyan 02.ogg}} '''Lan Yan:''' My elders told me that long ago, customs from the Stove God Festival were folded into Moonchase. That's when it became linked to cooking events.
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 3 lanyan 03.ogg}} '''Lan Yan:''' It is possible that some places in Liyue still preserve the Moonchase customs from before the Stove God Festival became a part of it.
:{{DIcon}} Definitely possible.
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 3 lanyan 04.ogg}} '''Lan Yan:''' May I ask where you are from, sir?
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 3 lanjunming 04.ogg}} '''???:''' Where I'm from, you ask? Haha... The past is not to be chased. A free soul walks the world as he wills. It is enough to know the road ahead!
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 3 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Okay, so where are you going?
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 3 lanjunming 05.ogg}} '''???:''' Where I am going... Moonchase has come, and so this old man must drag himself there... Yet Moonchase ought not to be like this...
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 3 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' And we're right back to square one...
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 3 lanyan 05.ogg}} '''Lan Yan:''' Sir... Would you be willing to speak with us somewhere else? This is a busy road, and we'll be in everyone's way if we stand here.
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 3 lanyan 06.ogg}} '''Lan Yan:''' I can see that something is troubling you, sir. I may be able to help.
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 3 lanjunming 06.ogg}} '''???:''' Hmm... Sounds most reasonable. This old man shall accompany you.

:{{A|vo zyjeq002 4 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Okay, let's hear it! What's the problem? Paimon's always happy to help!
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 4 lanjunming 01.ogg}} '''???:''' Odd though you may appear, little friend, you have a kind heart. This old fellow is most grateful.
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 4 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hey, who're you calling "odd"!? You're the oddball here! You look young, but you're all, "this old guy this" and "this old man that"... You do have white hair, though...
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 4 lanjunming 02.ogg}} '''???:''' Think nothing of it. Nothing wrong with a touch of eccentricity, is there?
:{{DIcon}} Let's get back to the matter at hand.
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 4 lanjunming 03.ogg}} '''???:''' The matter at hand... These old eyes must not miss the Moonchase Festival, yet Moonchase ought not to be like this...
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 4 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' And we're back to where we started... again...
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 4 lanyan 01.ogg}} '''Lan Yan:''' Sir... you're not human, are you?
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 4 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Whaaa...!?
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 4 lanjunming 04.ogg}} '''???:''' Young lady, what gives you cause to say such things? This old... ngh!
:;(Lan Yan uses mystic arts to reveal a sigil over the man's chest)
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 4 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What is that?
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 4 lanyan 02.ogg}} '''Lan Yan:''' If I am not mistaken... this is one of the mystic arts passed down by our clan. It is called the "Soul-Binding Art."
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 4 lanyan 03.ogg}} '''Lan Yan:''' It traps a part of a person's soul within a rattan effigy, creating a puppet in their likeness for the caster to command.
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 4 lanyan 04.ogg}} '''Lan Yan:''' Later generations of the Lan clan felt it violated the natural order, even when used against our enemies. So, they forbade the clan from ever using it again.
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 4 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So, that means he's actually...
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 4 lanyan 05.ogg}} '''Lan Yan:''' He's essentially a wisp of a remnant soul bound to a rattan figure.
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 4 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' No way...
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 4 lanyan 06.ogg}} '''Lan Yan:''' Sir, do you know who used Soul-Binding on you?
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 4 lanjunming 05.ogg}} '''???:''' Young lady, what kind of nonsense is that? Who in all Liyue could possibly use Soul-Binding on me?
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 4 lanjunming 06.ogg}} '''???:''' Cease your tricks at once. This old man has a Moonchase appointment to keep. Wait, Moonchase ought not to be like this...
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 4 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ugh, we're getting nowhere with him...
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 4 lanyan 07.ogg}} '''Lan Yan:''' Since he's only a remnant soul, his memories must be incomplete. We should undo the technique first. If we could send this soul-wisp back to where it belongs, the consequences shouldn't be too serious.
:;(Lan Yan tries to undo the technique)
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 4 lanjunming 07.ogg}} '''???:''' ...Ngh...
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 4 lanyan 08.ogg}} '''Lan Yan:''' Ah...
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 4 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What's wrong?
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 4 lanyan 09.ogg}} '''Lan Yan:''' The bind is locked behind a powerful seal. I can't undo it. I'm afraid we may need the clan head to handle this.
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 4 lanyan 10.ogg}} '''Lan Yan:''' But he just left to help the Millelith deal with those evil spirits, so he won't be back anytime soon. And if we wait too long, this remnant soul...
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 4 lanjunming 08.ogg}} '''???:''' Steady yourself, young lady. No need to panic. Whatever art you used just now seems to have restored a few of this old codger's memories.
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 4 lanjunming 09.ogg}} '''???:''' But all I can recall is waking from a dream some days ago. Before that, there is little I can say for certain.
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 4 lanyan 11.ogg}} '''Lan Yan:''' Respectfully, sir, I'm not panicking. You really are in serious condition right now, and the severity of the consequences means I need to contact the clan head as soon as possible and ask him to return.
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 4 lanyan 12.ogg}} '''Lan Yan:''' This Soul-Binding Art is an ancestral technique of the Lan clan. Our clan head won't sit back and ignore this.
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 4 lanjunming 10.ogg}} '''???:''' The head of the Lan clan? And what would such a person amount to here, hmm? Nothing, that's what!
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 4 lanjunming 11.ogg}} '''???:''' My old eyes can recognize this Soul-Binding technique and the seal laid over it. Most exquisitely wrought it is. I daresay that even an Adeptus would have a headache over it, haha...
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 4 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' How are you laughing about this? If that's true, doesn't that make things even worse?
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 4 lanyan 13.ogg}} '''Lan Yan:''' In that case, I can't think of a good solution at the moment... *sigh* Looks like we should put on a pot of tea, sit down, and take our time talking this through.
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 4 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' ...Huh?
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 4 lanjunming 12.ogg}} '''???:''' Just so, just so! Tea first!
:;(They sit down with a pot of tea)
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 4 lanjunming 13.ogg}} '''???:''' Mm, fine tea.
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 4 lanyan 14.ogg}} '''Lan Yan:''' Sir, you seem to know quite a bit about the mystic arts. Do you perhaps come from a thaumaturge clan?
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 4 lanyan 15.ogg}} '''Lan Yan:''' If we can have someone ask around the various clans, I think we could find out who you really are, how you came to be affected by Soul-Binding, and then, how to undo it.
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 4 lanjunming 14.ogg}} '''???:''' A clan? My old bones most emphatically are no member of any clan.
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 4 lanjunming 15.ogg}} '''???:''' The mystical arts of Liyue are both subtle and profound. Master even a little, and one may wander the world at ease. Why tie oneself to some clan?
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 4 lanjunming 16.ogg}} '''???:''' You, though, young lady... In temperament, you rather resemble me, yet here you are, a daughter of a great clan.
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 4 lanjunming 17.ogg}} '''???:''' Instead of seeking help from others, why not let the matter rest with you? If you are willing to lend a hand, this mind, though antique, might have an idea worth trying.
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 4 lanyan 16.ogg}} '''Lan Yan:''' I'm listening, sir.
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 4 lanjunming 18.ogg}} '''???:''' Though this decrepit spirit of mine remembers little, there is one thing I recall with perfect clarity: I absolutely must not miss the Moonchase Festival. Yet...
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 4 paimon 12.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' "...Yet Moonchase ought not to be like this..."
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 4 lanjunming 19.ogg}} '''???:''' Precisely! Every thought in my head leads back to that one point, like an unshakable obsession. Yet so many memories end there, leaving me caught between advance and retreat.
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 4 lanjunming 20.ogg}} '''???:''' Were you to help me seek out the Moonchase I am meant to remember, perhaps this lingering fixation can yet be resolved, and the seal with it.
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 4 lanyan 17.ogg}} '''Lan Yan:''' What you say makes sense, but it sounds like it'll take some time to see through. I'm not sure your remnant soul can hold out that long, sir.
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 4 lanyan 18.ogg}} '''Lan Yan:''' Soul-binding like this doesn't last forever. Over time, the remnant soul slowly fades. I'm worried you might suddenly turn back into a rattan figure and stop moving for good before we finish.
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 4 lanjunming 21.ogg}} '''???:''' Haha! All the more reason this old man must ask for your help.
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 4 lanjunming 22.ogg}} '''???:''' When you used your arts on me but a moment ago, what remains of my soul actually grew a bit more stable. It seems the arts you practice hold some power that suits me well.
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 4 lanjunming 23.ogg}} '''???:''' With you helping to steady my spirit, I doubt I shall be rendered down to rattan quite so quickly.
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 4 lanyan 19.ogg}} '''Lan Yan:''' That does sound like it could work... But I just promised to show Paimon and {{Traveler}} around the festival. It doesn't feel right to go back on that right away...
:{{DIcon}} It's fine.
:{{DIcon}} Moonchase isn't ending that soon.
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 4 lanyan 20.ogg}} '''Lan Yan:''' Hmm... In that case, why don't you two join me?
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 4 lanyan 21.ogg}} '''Lan Yan:''' Think about it: A remnant soul bound to a rattan puppet, missing memories, a lingering obsession, and us helping him to unravel the mystery...
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 4 lanyan 22.ogg}} '''Lan Yan:''' Sounds like an adventure straight out of one of those "tales of the strange" novels, doesn't it? And we'd be helping this gentleman too... Don't you think that sounds positively fascinating?
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 4 paimon 13.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Okay, when you put it like that... consider Paimon's interest piqued! We're in! But where are we supposed to find the Moonchase he remembers?
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 4 lanyan 23.ogg}} '''Lan Yan:''' Right now, our only clue is that the Moonchase he remembers has nothing to do with cooking.
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 4 lanyan 24.ogg}} '''Lan Yan:''' In that case, the "Moonchase Festival" he remembers might go all the way back to before the people of ancient [[Guili Assembly|Guili]] migrated south to Liyue Harbor.
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 4 lanyan 25.ogg}} '''Lan Yan:''' From what I've heard, there were already some customs related to Moonchase back then, it was just that Guili's Stove God Festival had yet to be incorporated into them. So, naturally, they had nothing to do with cooking.
:{{DIcon}} In that case...
:{{DIcon}} I know just the person to ask.
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 4 paimon 14.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh yeah... If Paimon remembers right, she's staying at [[Baiju Guesthouse]].
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 4 lanyan 26.ogg}} '''Lan Yan:''' Sounds like you two already have an idea?
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 4 paimon 15.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yep, and this one's about as reliable as they come!

;(Approach Baiju Guesthouse)
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 5 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Here we are!
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 5 lanjunming 01.ogg}} '''???:''' Liyue Harbor...
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 5 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Well? Did it jog your memory?
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 5 lanjunming 02.ogg}} '''???:''' ...Where did these merchants in long coats come from? And when did [[Guyun Stone Forest|those islands]] across the water appear? Liyue was never thus!
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 5 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Annnd he's spouting nonsense again.
:{{DIcon}} Let's check if Zibai's here first.
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 5 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' There's [[Lu Weng|Boss Lu]]!
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 5 luweng 01.ogg}} '''Lu Weng:''' Well, if it isn't {{Traveler}} and Miss Lan Yan from Chenyu Vale. What can I do for you?
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 5 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Uh, sorry to bother you, but we're looking for someone. Is Ms. [[Zibai]] still staying here?
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 5 luweng 02.ogg}} '''Lu Weng:''' Ah, her? She went out earlier. Said she was going to find an old acquaintance, have a good long talk about the Moonchase Festival.
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 5 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' And do you know who that old acquaintance is?
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 5 luweng 03.ogg}} '''Lu Weng:''' Couldn't say. But I do recall she was headed in [[Iron Tongue Tian]]'s direction.
:{{DIcon}} I know who she's looking for...
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 5 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Paimon does too. Which means the next problem is figuring out what to say... Ah, we'll worry about that later. Lan Yan, follow us!
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 5 lanjunming 03.ogg}} '''???:''' Baiju Guesthouse...

;(Approach Zibai)
:;(The time changes to night)
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 6 irontonguetian 01.ogg}} '''Iron Tongue Tian:''' To speak of Moonchase's origins, one must begin with ancient Liyue, when the adepti host chased the moon in pursuit of the adeptal path...
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 6 zibai 01.ogg}} '''Zibai:''' The Moonchase Rite... So, a mortal festival sprang from an adeptal affair?
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 6 zhongli 01.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' What people know to be the adeptal path is all too distant from mortal life.
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 6 zhongli 02.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' The word "Moonchase," however, suits the season and stirs the imagination. Is it so strange, then, that later generations would adopt it as a festival motif?
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 6 zibai 02.ogg}} '''Zibai:''' Thinking back, the people of ancient [[Lang-Gan]] once celebrated a holiday much like this.
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 6 zibai 03.ogg}} '''Zibai:''' When the festival came, they would brew wine from grain, gaze up at the bright moon, and offer it to me in hopes of a bountiful harvest. In return, I taught them the art of tilling the land and the brilliance of mathematics.
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 6 zibai 04.ogg}} '''Zibai:''' And when Moonchase is celebrated now, do the people below still pray to the immortals above?
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 6 zhongli 03.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Such practices are no longer common. In present-day Liyue, when Moonchase comes, people are more likely to enjoy fine food and wine, admire the moon, and gather with friends and family.
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 6 zibai 05.ogg}} '''Zibai:''' Eating, drinking, and merrymaking? In that case, though this event still bears the word "moon," it seems to have little else to do with me now.
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 6 zhongli 04.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Not entirely. People labor in the fields and devote themselves to the arduous study of mathematics so that one day, they may live in abundance and peace. And then... they eat, drink, and make merry.
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 6 zhongli 05.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Broadly speaking, the birth of what we call "festivals" is often so. Seen in that light, many of Liyue's festivals may be said to have roots that trace back to you.
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 6 zibai 06.ogg}} '''Zibai:''' Haha... A delightful argument. Tell me, were you the one to teach mortals the art of eloquence? Little wonder Liyue has so many storytellers now.
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 6 zhongli 06.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' I have always been one who listens to tales. Could I have instructed their tellers in oratory?
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 6 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hi there Zhongli, and the Whi— it's Zibai!
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 6 lanyan 01.ogg}} '''Lan Yan:''' The White Horse Adeptus? If it's Moonchase we're talking about, she really is the right person to ask.
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 6 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Eh?
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 6 zibai 07.ogg}} '''Zibai:''' Well now, if it isn't Paimon and {{Traveler}}. And young Lan Yan as well?
:{{DIcon}} You know about her, Lan Yan?
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 6 lanyan 02.ogg}} '''Lan Yan:''' Not long ago, I made a new kite. While I was out flying it, I lost track of time and ended up on a hilltop. There, I happened to run into Ms. Zibai as she passed by in a chariot.
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 6 lanyan 03.ogg}} '''Lan Yan:''' I was curious about how her chariot could fly, so she just came out and told me, "One is the White Horse Adeptus. This is one's exalted chariot, and aboard it, one may soar through the skies."
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 6 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yeah... that tracks...
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 6 zibai 08.ogg}} '''Zibai:''' Why dance around the matter? I am the White Horse Adeptus, and he is...
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 6 zhongli 07.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Hm?
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 6 zibai 09.ogg}} '''Zibai:''' He is the Wangsheng Funeral Parlor's consultant. A rather learned man, though he prefers to spend his days mingling with the common folk — I needn't introduce him to you, I trust?
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 6 zibai 10.ogg}} '''Zibai:''' He and I could be considered... old acquaintances. As it happens, I found a fine tea in Chenyu Vale recently, and sought him out so he might sample it.
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 6 zhongli 08.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' ...Then I am much obliged to you, good adeptus, for thinking of me.
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 6 zibai 11.ogg}} '''Zibai:''' Now, young Lan Yan, you sought me out in person. What is it you wish to ask?
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 6 lanyan 04.ogg}} '''Lan Yan:''' We had a few questions, specifically, about this elder...
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 6 zibai 12.ogg}} '''Zibai:''' Mad Lan!
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 6 lanjunming 01.ogg}} '''???:''' White Foal?
:{{DIcon}} You two know each other?
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 6 zibai 13.ogg}} '''Zibai:''' Is this not Wind Reader?
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 6 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What!?
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 6 lanyan 05.ogg}} '''Lan Yan:''' Are you saying... he's the ancestor of the Lan clan?
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 6 lanjunming 02.ogg}} '''Lan Junming:''' Wind Reader... Indeed... I remember a little more now. Still, that was only a title others bestowed. My name is [[Lan Junming]].
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 6 lanjunming 03.ogg}} '''Lan Junming:''' I do not quite remember you, Adeptus, yet the nickname "White Foal" came to my lips without a thought... An old acquaintance of mine, perhaps?
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 6 zibai 14.ogg}} '''Zibai:''' Hmph, a vulgarian through and through! No, a buffoon to the very end... Though, on further reflection, perhaps a rare sort of man?
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 6 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Geez, what did this guy do to leave such a bad impression on Zibai?
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 6 zibai 15.ogg}} '''Zibai:''' Ahem... Still, as I recall, Mad Lan never sought any art of longevity. He should have long since passed from this world... It is as I thought. What remains here is but a remnant soul, held captive.
:;(Zibai notices the Soul-Binding Art)
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 6 zibai 16.ogg}} '''Zibai:''' If it remains here, then the part of him that returned to the Ley Lines must be incomplete as well. Until this wisp is released, he will never truly rest.
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 6 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, so that's what's going on... This really is serious, then.
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 6 lanyan 06.ogg}} '''Lan Yan:''' That's exactly why we came to you. We want to undo the Soul-Binding on him, but a seal has been placed over it, and breaking it is far beyond me.
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 6 zibai 17.ogg}} '''Zibai:''' Allow me to take a look... Hmm... Mm... I could break through this seal by force and undo the binding.
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 6 zibai 18.ogg}} '''Zibai:''' But this seal is highly unusual. Were it broken by force, I fear the remnant soul would disperse along with it. We must not take such a risk. Let us find another way.
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 6 lanjunming 04.ogg}} '''Lan Junming:''' See? This old man lied not at all! Enough to give an Adeptus a headache, yes?
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 6 lanyan 07.ogg}} '''Lan Yan:''' Then if we can find whoever cast it...
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 6 zibai 19.ogg}} '''Zibai:''' The caster? Is he not standing right before you?
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 6 zibai 20.ogg}} '''Zibai:''' To my knowledge, this Soul-Binding Art was invented by Mad Lan himself. And in its use, who could surpass its creator?
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 6 zibai 21.ogg}} '''Zibai:''' The technique used on him is exceedingly secure, and the additional seal is fashioned with considerable finesse. Plainly, it is his own handiwork.
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 6 zibai 22.ogg}} '''Zibai:''' Perhaps he meant to leave this fragment of his soul behind for some purpose, and so used the art on himself.
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 6 lanjunming 05.ogg}} '''Lan Junming:''' Hahaha! A great deal may have fled this doddering mind, but I still held on to the key. So in the end, my plan is one to follow, is it not?
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 6 zibai 23.ogg}} '''Zibai:''' What exactly are you scheming this time, Mad Lan?
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 6 lanyan 08.ogg}} '''Lan Yan:''' Miss Zibai, if I may explain?
:{{Black Screen|Lan Yan recounts the earlier conversation to Zibai.}}
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 6 zibai 24.ogg}} '''Zibai:''' I see... Going so far as to use Soul-Binding on himself, simply to leave this remnant behind for the festival? He even added a seal to make certain.
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 6 zibai 25.ogg}} '''Zibai:''' And yet... it is exactly the sort of thing he would do.
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 6 zhongli 09.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' When people look forward to a festival, what they long for is often not the event itself, but the people and moments bound up with it.
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 6 lanyan 09.ogg}} '''Lan Yan:''' That's why we thought that if we could help him find the Moonchase he remembers, it might spark something.
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 6 lanyan 10.ogg}} '''Lan Yan:''' If we could help him realize his desire, that could be enough to undo the seal.
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 6 zibai 26.ogg}} '''Zibai:''' Hm... The idea has merit... Earlier, you said the Moonchase he seeks must go back to before the people of ancient Guili migrated south?
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 6 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Right, right! You must know all about moon-related stuff from back then, right?
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 6 zibai 27.ogg}} '''Zibai:''' As it so happens, my old friend and I were just discussing that very matter. Have you heard of the "Moonchase Rite"?
:{{DIcon}} I have.
:{{DIcon}} Doesn't ring a bell...
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 6 zibai 28.ogg}} '''Zibai:''' Long before the word "Moonchase" became associated with a mortal festival, Rex Lapis once sought to awaken me. Thus, the "Moonchase Rite" came to be.
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 6 zibai 29.ogg}} '''Zibai:''' The people of ancient Liyue later imitated this rite, and from it were born some of the customs now associated with "Moonchase."
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 6 zibai 30.ogg}} '''Zibai:''' Mad Lan, is this the "Moonchase" you seek?
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 6 lanjunming 06.ogg}} '''Lan Junming:''' Imitating an Adeptal rite? That does not sound like something I would do.
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 6 lanjunming 07.ogg}} '''Lan Junming:''' The human world is home to fine wine and good food, and no end of natural beauty. Wandering among them, this old man often lost track of the passing days. I doubt I would have had a mind to keep my eye on the Adepti.
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 6 lanjunming 08.ogg}} '''Lan Junming:''' So no, that cannot be the "Moonchase" I'm searching for.
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 6 zibai 31.ogg}} '''Zibai:''' Hmph. At least now I can judge you with certainty: A worldly man through and through, unable to step beyond the mundane.
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 6 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What do we do now? Did our only lead... lead nowhere?
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 6 zhongli 10.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Hmm...
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 6 lanyan 11.ogg}} '''Lan Yan:''' Do you have any suggestions, Mr. Zhongli?
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 6 zhongli 11.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' There are indeed a few Moonchase Festival customs of which I have heard.
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 6 zhongli 12.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' In a later age, though still long ago, Dihua Marsh also had certain customs connected to the moon.
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 6 zhongli 13.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' There, the antiquarians of Liyue would gather in the golden autumn, ascend the heights to view the moon, drink wine, and write verse. This was known as a "Moon-Viewing Gathering."
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 6 zhongli 14.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' It is said that these gatherings were a predecessor of the Moonchase Festival. Perhaps they are connected to the "Moonchase" Mr. Lan seeks?
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 6 zibai 32.ogg}} '''Zibai:''' It sounds like there was fine wine and good food aplenty. That ought to be the one.
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 6 lanjunming 09.ogg}} '''Lan Junming:''' A Moon-Viewing Gathering... When? Where?
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 6 zhongli 15.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Wangshu Inn will be holding a similar event in two days' time.
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 6 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Then let's go check it out! It might jog his memory.
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 6 lanyan 12.ogg}} '''Lan Yan:''' Thank you, Mr. Zhongli.
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 6 lanyan 13.ogg}} '''Lan Yan:''' Forgive me, but how should a junior like myself address you? As the ancestor of the Lan clan, you are also the founder of our Qimen Arts traditions...
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 6 lanjunming 10.ogg}} '''Lan Junming:''' "Ancestor," you say...? To think this old man left an entire clan behind. I must admit, I never imagined such a thing... Still, I rather like the sound of "Grandmaster."
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 6 lanyan 14.ogg}} '''Lan Yan:''' Whatever you were planning, it must have been important, right? I still think we should inform the clan elders, so they can help us handle it.
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 6 lanjunming 11.ogg}} '''Lan Junming:''' Well. About that... Suppose you found yourself surrounded by all those clan elders, what would you do?
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 6 lanyan 15.ogg}} '''Lan Yan:''' In that case... I'd take the first chance I got to slip away and get some air on a hillside somewhere.
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 6 lanjunming 12.ogg}} '''Lan Junming:''' And so would I!
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 6 lanyan 16.ogg}} '''Lan Yan:''' Hehe... I understand.
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 6 lanjunming 13.ogg}} '''Lan Junming:''' This old man has seen what you can do, and your skills are more than enough. So, how about doing your old grandmaster a favor?
:{{DIcon}} Don't worry, Lan Yan.
:{{DIcon}} Paimon and I are here to help too.
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 6 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yeah! Paimon's only been getting curioser and curioser about what kind of Moonchase he wants to have!
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 6 lanyan 17.ogg}} '''Lan Yan:''' Leave it to me, then. {{Traveler}}, Paimon, we'll leave in two days.
:{{A|vo zyjeq002 6 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You got it!

'''''As the Courtyard in Spring Once Appeared''''' is an [[Event Quest]] during the [[Summertime Odyssey]] Event. It is the first quest of the second part.

==Steps==
# Rest until the following day (06:00–24:00)
# Talk to Paimon
# Board Miitoboru
#* Summoning another [[Waverider]] and boarding it will also fulfil this step
# Go to the island where the strange phenomena occurred
# Touch the bonsai
#* Enter [[Misty Hills, Foggy Vales]]'s Quest Domain: [[As the Courtyard in Spring Once Appeared: Part I]]
# Investigate the area
# Operate the device and investigate further
# Enter the corridor and explore further
# Investigate the area
# Investigate the surroundings and find a way to open the door
# Operate the device and investigate further
# Place the offerings (0/3)
# Look for Kazuha

==Dialogue==
{{Quest Description|The first day on the island was rather peaceful, yet things start to get strange the next morning... It seems to be just the beginning. You and the others trace the strange phenomena to an island and find a bonsai that is not supposed to be there.}}

:{{A|vo yqeq102 1 kazuha 01.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' Yes, we went for a little walk. The enchanting scenery and pleasant weather here soothes the body and mind.

:{{A|vo yqeq102 1 fischl 01.ogg}} '''Fischl:''' Hohoho! The servants of darkness have descended. Rejoice, for the return of the Immernachtreich is nigh!

:{{A|vo yqeq102 1 kazuha 03.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' There was also a peculiar floral scent on the wind. Though there are many flowers on this island, that scent did not resemble any of them.
:{{A|vo yqeq102 1 xinyan 02.ogg}} '''Xinyan:''' Seems to me like whatever these things are, they aren't visible to the naked eye...

:{{A|vo yqeq102 1 paimon 13.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, Paimon has a bad feeling about this... What have we gotten ourselves into...
:{{A|vo yqeq102 1 fischl 02.ogg}} '''Fischl:''' Hmm... I had resolved to summon the Immernachtreich in this land, but now we observe these puzzling phenomena... Could this be the spawn of the condemned, trying to thwart my sacred endeavor?
:{{A|vo yqeq102 1 paimon 14.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wait, {{Traveler}}... you don't think Alice could be behind all this, do you?

:{{A|vo yqeq102 1 squirrel 05.ogg}} '''Squirrel:''' Hahaha, look at them, old chap, seems we scared the pants off them!
:{{A|vo yqeq102 1 niceboat 04.ogg}} '''Fantastic Boat:''' Aye, well, they've never seen anything like this before.
:{{A|vo yqeq102 1 niceboat 05.ogg}} '''Fantastic Boat:''' This old boat's sailed all over the briney seas in its time, and tried talking to many a sailor, too. But in all that time, not a single person has ever spoken back.

:{{A|vo yqeq102 1 paimon 16.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' This environment? What do you mean by that?
:{{A|vo yqeq102 1 mona 04.ogg}} '''Mona:''' The environment... Could it be that... the environment is what's interfering with my divinations?
:{{DIcon}} Feels like...

:{{DIcon|space=1}}?
:{{DIcon}} What are you talking about?
:{{A|vo yqeq102 1 niceboat 06.ogg}} '''Fantastic Boat:''' Haha, I like yer senses o' humor, me hearties. An illusion? So, talking boats and squirrels are just an illusion to humans, huh.
:{{A|vo yqeq102 1 squirrel 07.ogg}} '''Squirrel:''' Now, now, it's understandable, old chap. Haven't you heard? As humans grow older, they forget many important things and lose many of their abilities.
:{{A|vo yqeq102 1 niceboat 07.ogg}} '''Fantastic Boat:''' Aye, so they do... A pity, to be sure. Thinking back, in all those years I spent sailing with the fleet, I would've never imagined that one day I'd be laughing over something like this.
:{{A|vo yqeq102 1 niceboat 08.ogg}} '''Fantastic Boat:''' Well then, me lads and lasses, don't you want to take a wee gander at all the places you're so curious about?

:{{A|vo yqeq102 1 niceboat 09.ogg}} '''Fantastic Boat:''' Look! Here!
:{{A|vo yqeq102 1 mona 07.ogg}} '''Mona:''' At what?
:{{A|vo yqeq102 1 niceboat 10.ogg}} '''Fantastic Boat:''' Blimey, at me, of course! Oh, that's right, I forgot to introduce myself. I'm the smartest ship you'll find in all these parts! The name's... argh, just call me whatever takes yer fancy.
:{{A|vo yqeq102 1 paimon 24.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Don't you have a name?
:{{A|vo yqeq102 1 niceboat 11.ogg}} '''Fantastic Boat:''' That I do, I just can't remember it. All I know is that I came here from Inazuma.
:{{A|vo yqeq102 1 paimon 25.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' In that case, Paimon shall name you... "Miitoboru"! How's that? All the other ships in Inazuma seem to have names ending in "ru," too.
:{{A|vo yqeq102 1 niceboat 12.ogg}} '''Fantastic Boat:''' Miitoboru? Haha, that'll do nicely.
:{{A|vo yqeq102 1 niceboat 13.ogg}} '''Miitoboru:''' You're lucky to have met me. I can sail through the choppiest seas with ease, there isn't a wave out there that can capsize me! So...
:{{A|vo yqeq102 1 niceboat 14.ogg}} '''Miitoboru:''' Come aboard, and I'll take you wherever you'd like to go!
:{{A|vo yqeq102 1 squirrel 08.ogg}} '''Squirrel:''' Ah, how very kind of you, old chap. Unlike that Anemo Archon who abandoned us here.
:{{DIcon}} The Anemo Archon?
:{{A|vo yqeq102 1 squirrel 09.ogg}} '''Squirrel:''' You know, the Anemo Archon of Mondstadt.
:{{A|vo yqeq102 1 squirrel 10.ogg}} '''Squirrel:''' Don't you know? Some of these islands used to be Mondstadt's mountaintops. Once upon a time, the Anemo Archon sliced them off to neaten the place up, and chucked them into the ocean.
:{{A|vo yqeq102 1 squirrel 11.ogg}} '''Squirrel:''' My great-great-great-great-great-great... great grandfather was on one of the mountaintops, and got sent flying here along with it. Wretched Anemo Archon!
:{{A|vo yqeq102 1 paimon 26.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' How could that happen!
:{{A|vo yqeq102 1 squirrel 12.ogg}} '''Squirrel:''' And we've been living here for generations since then, haha. Fortunately, there were a few other squirrel families that got stranded on these islands as well, so we built ourselves a kingdom here.
:{{A|vo yqeq102 1 squirrel 13.ogg}} '''Squirrel:''' The good thing is that there are no predators or competitors around. All the pinecones on this island are ours for the taking. The bad thing is... we're stuck here.
:{{A|vo yqeq102 1 paimon 27.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Didn't see that coming... Sounds like the Immernachtreich is a kingdom of squirrels!
:{{A|vo yqeq102 1 fischl 07.ogg}} '''Fischl:''' Hold thy tongue!
:{{A|vo yqeq102 1 oz 05.ogg}} '''Oz:''' Paimon, please do not make such slanderous statements. The Immernachtreich is, of course, a kingdom of night ravens.

;(Interact with the Elegantly-Written Note)
::{{Black Screen|Elegantly-Written Note}}
::When I was flipping through some old books today, I found my father's old notes.
::I read them, of course. He wouldn't mind. As I expected, most of the content concerned forging techniques as well as tricks on how to handle certain ores.
::The tail end featured a number of hand-drawn drafts, mostly bonsai designs. Well, I suppose this love for them does count as a clan tradition.
::My son turns six this year. His name is "Kazuha," just as my wife wished.
::...
::His coming and her going were not far apart. To think that it has been six years since then... If she were still here, she would surely be helping my father in the yard.
::My father lived well in his younger years, and that lifestyle has greatly deteriorated in his latter ones. It fills me with shame to admit that ::I am unable to improve these circumstances.
::He says that it is not important, however, and that it is instead we who are young who are the key.
:{{A|vo yqeq102 7 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' It looks like this letter was written by Kazuha's father.
:{{A|vo yqeq102 7 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So keeping bonsai plants really does run in the family.
:{{A|vo yqeq102 7 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hmm... But the fact that we're even here and could see his father's notes... It just seems so unbelievable.

;(Interact with A Letter)
::{{Black Screen|A Letter}}
::To My Dear Father, [[Kaedehara Kageharu]]:
::
::Ever since the official dissolution of our house, I have packed my bags and left our ancestral home, wandering the world, and I have learned much on this journey.
::Today, I was reminded of the many scenic artworks you drew in your notes as I passed some seaside cliffs by. The sight gave me much to think about.
::A wanderer's leisure is not the tradition of our clan, but the appreciation of scenery surely counts. I believe it was Great Grandfather who started that particular practice.
::You mentioned that he enjoyed planting small trees, loving their supple branches, while Grandfather was of a different temperament, enjoying fiddling with stones more.
::When I was young, our backyard was full of the many curious stones that Grandfather collected. Back then, I thought the ground was littered with treasure, but now that I know much more of the world, I can be quite certain that at least some of them were sword-testing stones that Grandfather brought back from the forging station.
::I knew precious little about stones then, believing them all to be of great value.
::But can there really be so much treasure in life?
::...I am writing this letter as I rest in a shady spot on a hilltop.
::I intend to burn this letter shortly, before using the water from a mountain stream to quench the remnant embers. This way, I believe that this message will reach you, though you can no longer receive letters.
::I dismissed the servants after your passing and settled our various assets. It isn't worth much, but it's enough to live on.
::I fear that our bonsais may not have fared as well as I hoped. I sold what I could get my hands on to pay our debts, save for Great Grandfather's old relic.
::It was confiscated by the Tenryou Commission... That said, I suspect that staying in their storehouse may have been a better fate for it than remaining in my hands.
::
::I have not been here in a long while. The wind whistling through the mountains is just as lovely as it was when you first brought me here, many years ago.
::I'm setting off again.
::Farewell.
::
::Kaedehara Kazuha
:{{A|vo yqeq102 8 xinyan 01.ogg}} '''Xinyan:''' Looks like a letter Kazuha wrote while he was traveling.
:{{A|vo yqeq102 8 mona 01.ogg}} '''Mona:''' What a sad letter...
:{{A|vo yqeq102 8 fischl 01.ogg}} '''Fischl:''' ...Lord Kazuha...

;(Interact with Old Yellowed Notes in Warehouse)
::{{Black Screen|Old Yellowed Notes}}
::Something quite amusing happened today that I just have to preserve in my diary: the young master got a little tipsy. Well, a lot tipsy, haha.
::It must be said that the young master is way underage to drink at all. Not knowing any better, he must've confused his father's drink with his own, mistaking that glass of wine for grape juice.
::From a distance, I noticed someone practicing martial arts in the courtyard. I expected it to be our young master, which I wasn't wrong in assuming, but I never expected to see him in such a state — that is to say utterly sloshed.
::He greeted me in high spirits, and if it wasn't for his lobster-red face, I wouldn't have suspected anything.
::Overdrinking on a summer night is hardly a crime. But considering his age, I simply felt that I had to keep an eye on him.
::At first, I wanted to pretend that I didn't see it. I even made a detour to take things out to the backyard so as to spare him the embarrassment.
::By the time I finished my work, the young master was already lying on the steps, asleep. Ah, what a rare sight it was to see this precocious young man revealing this side of him... A right sight indeed.
::Another servant and I quietly carried the young master back inside and prepared some tea and snacks to help him sober up and ease the discomfort later. He might have called his parents' names while sleeping. His eyes closed, he looked so contented. Perhaps he had dreams of some happy moments in his past.
::Dear young master, you still have a long life ahead of you. There shall be plenty of opportunities to drink — in the future, that is.

:{{A|vo yqeq102 10 kazuha 04.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' My father once mentioned that this pot was originally part of a collection belonging to my great-grandfather. He adored his bonsai and always took great care of them.
:{{A|vo yqeq102 10 kazuha 05.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' When our family fell upon hard times, my grandfather traveled far and wide, looking for a way to save the clan. However, during that time, my great-grandfather became gravely ill.
:{{A|vo yqeq102 10 kazuha 06.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' He knew my grandfather had no interest in bonsai, so before his death, he gave most of his carefully crafted bonsai away. This is the only one he retained.

::{{A|vo yqeq102 10 kazuha 09.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' Eventually, he started to make his own bonsai. Unlike his father, he preferred arranging rock gardens instead of plants.
::{{A|vo yqeq102 10 kazuha 10.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' Perhaps influenced by my grandfather, my father also took a liking to crafting bonsai. Back then, our courtyard was filled with all kinds of them.
:{{A|vo yqeq102 10 kazuha 11.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' And this flowerpot was passed down to me as a family treasure.
:{{A|vo yqeq102 10 kazuha 12.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' It's certainly no coincidence that it appeared here and became the entrance to the mirage. It's almost as if... it's giving me a chance to make up for past regrets.
:{{DIcon}} Regrets about what?
:{{A|vo yqeq102 10 kazuha 13.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' There was once a time when the Kaedeharas were an illustrious clan in Inazuma.
:{{A|vo yqeq102 10 kazuha 14.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' After the [[Raiden Gokaden]] incident, our clan's fortunes took a turn for the worse. By the time of my generation, our downfall was complete.
:{{A|vo yqeq102 10 kazuha 15.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' Later, I fled Inazuma as I didn't want be arrested. With no one left in the Kaedehara Clan, the authorities confiscated everything in our home, including this bonsai.
:{{A|vo yqeq102 10 kazuha 16.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' Like my ancestors before me, I think I'd like to try it out for myself... recreate a favorite scene from my travels and place it into this pot.

:{{A|vo yqeq102 10 kazuha 17.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' Since the contents of this bonsai affect the mirage, I'd at least like to try my hand at making something.
:{{A|vo yqeq102 10 kazuha 18.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' But what style? Should I use plants for the bonsai like my great-grandfather, or rocks like my father and grandfather...
:{{A|vo yqeq102 10 kazuha 19.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' ...Perhaps a rock garden would suit me better.

:{{A|vo yqeq102 10 kazuha 20.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' I think I'll need a set of tools and some rocks that can be carved and made into decorations.

:{{A|vo yqeq103 1 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wow, it's a new place!
:{{A|vo yqeq103 1 oz 01.ogg}} '''Oz:''' As was the case last time, only Lord Kazuha is missing.

:{{A|vo yqeq103 2 kageharu 01.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kageharu:''' ...This will do. Ah, Kazuha, you've come just at the right moment. What do you think of this rock carving?
:{{A|vo yqeq103 2 kazuha 01.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' It's very intricate.
:{{A|vo yqeq103 2 kageharu 02.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kageharu:''' I based it on a mountain scene I saw in a book. You know, there are nations in this world where the mountains reach all the way up into the clouds. If only I had the chance to see them with my own eyes...
:{{A|vo yqeq103 2 kazuha 02.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' Father, you can go anywhere whenever you want.
:{{A|vo yqeq103 2 kageharu 03.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kageharu:''' That's not true. Though the Kaedehara Clan is far from what it used to be, I still bear all the same responsibilities as the clan heads before me.
:{{A|vo yqeq103 2 kageharu 04.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kageharu:''' But then again... continuing in the way of our forefathers, sacrificing everything for our declining clan... is it really worth it?
:{{A|vo yqeq103 2 kazuha 03.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' But I... I don't understand.
:{{A|vo yqeq103 2 kageharu 05.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kageharu:''' ...Kazuha, there's one thing I want you to always remember.
:{{A|vo yqeq103 2 kageharu 06.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kageharu:''' Family ties are important, but you ought to not let them hold you back.
:{{A|vo yqeq103 2 kageharu 07.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kageharu:''' Family only exists because of the people in it. If we are unhappy, how can we hope to build a joyful one?
:{{A|vo yqeq103 2 kageharu 08.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kageharu:''' The events of the past have had a profound impact on our family, but they are not your burden to carry.
:{{A|vo yqeq103 2 kageharu 09.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kageharu:''' ...If you ever grow tired of this tedious life, just drop everything and go off on a journey, see the world. Remember, Kazuha, don't let yourself get tied down in life.
:{{A|vo yqeq103 2 kazuha 04.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' Yes, father.

;(Enter the dojo)
:{{A|vo yqeq103 2 soldier 01.ogg}} '''???:''' I've heard a lot about you, Mr. Kaedehara. It's my honor to meet you today.
:{{A|vo yqeq103 2 hisamichi 01.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Hisamichi:''' It is Kazuha's honor to duel with a military man like yourself. Kazuha, get ready.

;(Approach the marked area)
:{{A|vo yqeq103 3 kazuha 01.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' I'm sorry, but I just don't understand!
:{{A|vo yqeq103 3 kageharu 01.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kageharu:''' Kazuha, have you forgotten our promise?
:{{A|vo yqeq103 3 kazuha 02.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' You really want to give it all up? But... but even if we're having a rough time, you still have me by your side! Can't I be of any help?
:{{A|vo yqeq103 3 kazuha 03.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' When you were my age, you were already helping grandfather out! Am I so incompetent that I'm a disappointment to you? Or...
:{{A|vo yqeq103 3 kageharu 02.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kageharu:''' Kazuha!
:{{A|vo yqeq103 3 kageharu 03.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kageharu:''' *sigh* ...Now you're blaming yourself for all of this... That's why I have failed you as a father.
:{{A|vo yqeq103 3 kageharu 04.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kageharu:''' The Kaedehara Clan has been paying the price for our past mistakes ever since your great-grandfather's generation. To this day, we have never fully recovered from it.
:{{A|vo yqeq103 3 kageharu 05.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kageharu:''' Though we are a family of bladesmiths, you don't have to devote your life to the family craft.
:{{A|vo yqeq103 3 kageharu 06.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kageharu:''' If a wounded animal wants to escape from a trap, it has to sacrifice the hind leg that was caught. You might think of this as a loss, but staying in the trap has far more deadly consequences.
:{{A|vo yqeq103 3 kageharu 07.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kageharu:''' Enough now, Kazuha. As the head of the family, I failed to revitalize our clan. You never blamed me for not giving you the life promised to you by our heritage, and I'm grateful enough for that.
:{{A|vo yqeq103 3 kageharu 08.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kageharu:''' All these generations of suffering... let's end them today. From now on, live your life with no burdens.
:{{A|vo yqeq103 3 kageharu 09.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kageharu:''' Don't worry, I'll carry the blame for abandoning our family business.
:{{A|vo yqeq103 3 kazuha 04.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' Father, please don't... You should not be to blame for not upholding our family name.
:{{A|vo yqeq103 3 kazuha 05.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' Even if that day comes, let me share the burden with you.
:{{A|vo yqeq103 3 kazuha 06.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' Let's just wait and see. Sooner or later, I will have to lead the Kaedehara Clan. When the time comes, I'll deal with all our problems.

;(Enter the dojo)
:{{A|vo yqeq103 3 samurai 01.ogg}} '''???:''' Hey, think you're tough enough to go against me? Ha, no response! What's wrong — you scared?
:{{A|vo yqeq103 3 kazuha 07.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' Did you really think it would be wise to pick a fight with the Kaedehara Clan?

;(Approach the marked area)
:{{A|vo yqeq103 4 kazuha 01.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' The Kaedehara Clan is no longer what it used to be...
:{{A|vo yqeq103 4 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' That's Kazuha's voice!

;(Approach the image of Kazuha)
:{{A|vo yqeq103 4 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' But... why can't he hear us?
:{{A|vo yqeq103 4 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Looks like it's just an illusion. This isn't the Kazuha who came here with us.

;(While going through the unknown space)
:{{A|vo yqeq103 5 kazuha 01.ogg}} '''Kazuha:''' Maybe if I were more adept in the sword arts, I'd be able to share my father's burdens...*sigh*
:{{A|vo yqeq103 5 kazuha 02.ogg}} '''Kazuha:''' This won't do... I'm getting distracted by family matters, and making too many mistakes.
:{{A|vo yqeq103 5 kazuha 03.ogg}} '''Kazuha:''' "I yearn to hear the song of nightingale, my patient ears ready to attend. A veil of mist obscures the western skies, into its midst a silver moon descends."
:{{A|vo yqeq103 5 kazuha 04.ogg}} '''Kazuha:''' To know one is fighting a losing battle, and yet never once falter... This shall be my father's legacy.

;(After exiting the unknown space)
:{{A|vo yqeq103 6 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Thought we might find you trapped here again.
:{{A|vo yqeq103 6 kazuha 01.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' Haha, yeah, it seems those are the rules.
:{{A|vo yqeq103 6 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' We entered that maze in the mirage again, but the scene was different this time.
:{{Black Screen|You tell Kazuha what you saw...}}
:{{A|vo yqeq103 6 kazuha 02.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' The mood was more deflated, and the place more humbly furnished... yes, that makes sense.
:{{A|vo yqeq103 6 kazuha 03.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' What you saw was the Kaedehara Clan in decline.
:{{A|vo yqeq103 6 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' We saw you in the mirage too, but you looked a little different than now.
:{{A|vo yqeq103 6 fischl 01.ogg}} '''Fischl:''' Indeed, I most certainly agree.
:{{A|vo yqeq103 6 oz 01.ogg}} '''Oz:''' Compared to the Lord Kazuha before us now, the mirage we saw appeared lost, with the burden of fate weighing heavily upon him.
:{{A|vo yqeq103 6 mona 01.ogg}} '''Mona:''' I can confirm that. His fate was a heavy burden indeed.
:{{A|vo yqeq103 6 kazuha 04.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' That means I am older and wiser now. I am sorry you had to see my less mature former self.
:{{A|vo yqeq103 6 kazuha 05.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' For a long time after leaving Inazuma, I've lived the life of a drifter. But this is no bad thing, because I learned much from the experience.
:{{A|vo yqeq103 6 kazuha 06.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' I wish that I could've met my past self, too. If he saw me, I know that he would understand:
:{{A|vo yqeq103 6 kazuha 07.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' Life is a long journey, and that's why I must travel far and wide.
;(A domain transition occurs)
:{{A|vo yqeq103 7 kazuha 01.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' Just as I thought, the bonsai is the key to entering the mirage.
:{{A|vo yqeq103 7 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' C'mon, let's continue looking for the rock garden.
{{Dialogue End}}

:{{A|vo yqeq104 6 mona 01.ogg}} '''Mona:''' This mirage is quite fascinating. It presents life like a stage play, with each scene more captivating than the last.

:{{A|vo yqeq104 6 kazuha 06.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' When I first saw this bonsai, I thought of the possibility that... I needed to wait for you. Perhaps that was why I had to be here on my own.

:{{A|vo yqeq104 6 kazuha 08.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' ...While we were separated, I had a lot of time to reflect. I think I finally understand now.
:{{A|vo yqeq104 6 kazuha 09.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' The mirage is... me. The empty flowerpot represents the state of my heart.
:{{A|vo yqeq104 6 kazuha 10.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' When the heart is clear, the world is too. And when the heart is unladen, the same is true.
:{{A|vo yqeq104 6 kazuha 11.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' Clear and unladen... that describes how I feel right now.
:{{A|vo yqeq104 6 kazuha 12.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' Although, I would not say there are no regrets in this. To be unladen is also to be empty.
:{{A|vo yqeq104 6 kazuha 13.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' That's why this bonsai appeared as part of my mirage. It gave me a chance to fulfill my wishes.
:{{A|vo yqeq104 6 kazuha 14.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' I never realized that deep down in my heart, I also wanted to make my own bonsai... Perhaps this is what it really means to keep Kaedehara traditions alive.
:{{A|vo yqeq104 6 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Have you finished doing what you wanted to do, Kazuha?
:{{A|vo yqeq104 6 kazuha 15.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' Yes, you could say that.
:{{A|vo yqeq104 6 kazuha 16.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' You saw my past self and said goodbye to him. Only when you witness my whole story does it become truly consigned to history.
:{{A|vo yqeq104 6 kazuha 17.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' What really matters in life is not how strict we are with ourselves, but the connections we make along the way. There's no future for those who linger on the past.
:{{A|vo yqeq104 6 kazuha 18.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' So please believe me when I say that I've already come a long way, and I intend to go further still. I will always treasure your support.

'''''As Though Beholding Illusions''''' is the second part of the [[Enchanted Tales of the Mikawa Festival]] Event.

==Steps==
# Wait till the next morning (07:00 – 09:00)
# Go to the venue
# Go to the area outside the venue
# Go to [[Sayu]] and Investigate
# Go to [[Thoma]] and Investigate
# Go to [[Mizuki]] and Investigate
# Talk to [[Ei]]
# Wait until nighttime (21:00 – 24:00)
# Invite Ei to the [[Aisa Bathhouse]]
# Talk to Ei in the Aisa Bathhouse
# Go to the area outside the Aisa Bathhouse
# Return to the venue on [[Mt. Yougou]]
# Follow the [[bake-danuki]]
# Traverse the obstacles
# Break the bake-danuki's disguise
# Find the suspicious bake-danuki statue (0/3)
# Talk to [[Kinkaku]] and the others
# Pay another visit to [[Ioroi]]
# Talk to [[Miko]] and the others
# Talk to Ei

==Gameplay Notes==
* During steps 13 to 17, the player will be in a [[Special Story Mode]]. Several menus, including [[Party]] setup and the [[map]], cannot be accessed. Most gadgets cannot be used. Leaving the Special Story Mode will reset the quest to step 13, and the player can re-enter by interacting with the indicated entity<!-- is it a rift? it doesn't look like something that could be called a rift... --> in Chinju Forest.
<gallery>
As Though Beholding Illusions Begin Pursuit.png|Entity with the interaction prompt "Begin Pursuit"
</gallery>
* The [[Dusty Balloon]] "section" of the path can be completely bypassed by following the river instead of the path.
* Kinkaku, Ginkaku, and Tetsunosuke's torch disguises have leaves on them and are located together near the end of the torch "section" of the path. Their statue disguises also have leaves on them.
