:{{A|vo schjeq002 11 tetsunosuke 04.ogg}} '''Tetsunosuke:''' That's when we uncovered a horn filled with youkai power! It was the will of the great bake-danuki [[Giichiro]] made manifest!
:{{A|vo schjeq002 11 kinkaku 04.ogg}} '''Kinkaku:''' It restored our power! And we made the human go thump thump, clang clang, slash slash!
:{{A|vo schjeq002 11 ioroi 07.ogg}} '''Ioroi:''' Ooh! And by thump thump, clang clang, slash slash, you mean...
:{{A|vo schjeq002 11 kinkaku 05.ogg}} '''Kinkaku:''' ...We tricked him and ran!
:{{A|vo schjeq002 11 ioroi 08.ogg}} '''Ioroi:''' ...So, you didn't actually beat him up at all...
:{{A|vo schjeq002 11 ginkaku 04.ogg}} '''Ginkaku:''' We've been using the horn to hide ever since... But, there are too many humans... It's getting harder to hide...
:{{A|vo schjeq002 11 mizuki 02.ogg}} '''Yumemizuki Mizuki:''' A horn full of youkai power... Could that be the source of the nightmares? The reason the bake-danuki are so afraid of humans?
:{{A|vo schjeq002 11 mizuki 03.ogg}} '''Yumemizuki Mizuki:''' If the horn contained the fragment of a nightmare, using its power to hide would spread the nightmare to them. That means, the bake-danuki have been trapped in this state of anxiety... for five hundred years...
:{{A|vo schjeq002 11 ioroi 09.ogg}} '''Ioroi:''' Hah, I could have told you nothing good would come from that horn... Using external power is against the Tanuki path!
:{{A|vo schjeq002 11 kinkaku 06.ogg}} '''Kinkaku:''' Eek! We... strayed from the path?
:{{A|vo schjeq002 11 ginkaku 05.ogg}} '''Ginkaku:''' But... the horn helped us hide from the humans! The humans tried to take our land...
:{{A|vo schjeq002 11 raidenei 03.ogg}} '''Ei:''' ...On the contrary, the purpose of the investigation was to determine in advance if youkai were present on the land in question.
:{{A|vo schjeq002 11 raidenei 04.ogg}} '''Ei:''' Whether we avoid encroaching on youkai territory altogether or attempt to reach a mutually beneficial agreement, a peaceful resolution was always the goal.
:{{A|vo schjeq002 11 tetsunosuke 05.ogg}} '''Tetsunosuke:''' Oh... really?
:{{A|vo schjeq002 11 ginkaku 06.ogg}} '''Ginkaku:''' Wait... that IS what the human said back then, isn't it...
:;(A flashback begins, this time without the nightmare's influence)
:{{A|vo schjeq002 11 kiritani 01.ogg}} '''Kiritani:''' ...By order of the shogun, if youkai live here, we need to discuss the proposal...
:;(Flashback ends)
:{{A|vo schjeq002 11 ioroi 10.ogg}} '''Ioroi:''' Kinkaku, Ginkaku, Tetsunosuke... Not all humans are bad. Yellow Fur over there helped me a great deal, you know...
:{{A|vo schjeq002 11 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Besides, the bake-danuki were only sealed away back then because Ioroi stole that [[Ioroi's Ward|comb]]...
:{{A|vo schjeq002 11 tetsunosuke 06.ogg}} '''Tetsunosuke:''' Ioroi... is a thief? Ioroi... got what he deserved?
:{{A|vo schjeq002 11 ioroi 11.ogg}} '''Ioroi:''' ...H—H—How was I to know it was used to make Sacred Sakura Daifuku? I gave it back, didn't I!?
:{{A|vo schjeq002 11 kinkaku 07.ogg}} '''Kinkaku:''' So, the humans were mean for no reason?
:{{A|vo schjeq002 11 ioroi 12.ogg}} '''Ioroi:''' Well... if you must know, the young human and I fought... I was, perhaps, a tad careless, so I... conceded the match! Anyway, the point is... Neither side is bad!
:{{A|vo schjeq002 11 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' There he goes again, changing the subject when it makes him look bad...
:{{A|vo schjeq002 11 yaemiko 02.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' Now you know... No human is trying to harm you.
:{{A|vo schjeq002 11 tetsunosuke 07.ogg}} '''Tetsunosuke:''' So... it was all a nightmare...
:{{A|vo schjeq002 11 ginkaku 07.ogg}} '''Ginkaku:''' Five hundred years in hiding... for nothing...
:{{A|vo schjeq002 11 ioroi 13.ogg}} '''Ioroi:''' ...Eh, it was a five-hundred-year-long game of Hide-and-Seek. What's so bad about that? Besides, you won.
:{{A|vo schjeq002 11 kinkaku 08.ogg}} '''Kinkaku:''' Huh? We won? ...Go us! We're even better than Ioroi!
:{{A|vo schjeq002 11 ioroi 14.ogg}} '''Ioroi:''' Hey! My game of Hide-and-Seek isn't over yet!
:{{A|vo schjeq002 11 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wow, the mind of a bake-danuki is something else... Still so cheerful, even after all that...
:{{A|vo schjeq002 11 mizuki 04.ogg}} '''Yumemizuki Mizuki:''' That nature is what isolated them from the worst effects of the nightmare and prevented them from causing any real harm.
:{{A|vo schjeq002 11 mizuki 05.ogg}} '''Yumemizuki Mizuki:''' But, a nightmare that's still affecting people after all this time? Who could it belong to? Hm, a horn buried under Mt. Yougou...
:{{DIcon}} I feel like I've heard a legend about that...
:{{A|vo schjeq002 11 yaemiko 03.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' ...Tainted by darkness, the oni warrior raised her sword against the Almighty Shogun. Losing an arm and a horn to the Shogun's blade, she fled into the forest, never to be seen again.
:{{A|vo schjeq002 11 yaemiko 04.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' ...A trusted lieutenant fighting against the forces of darkness, she was once devoured whole by a beast from beyond this world, with the body of a tiger and the tail of a serpent, until she tore the creature apart from within...
:{{A|vo schjeq002 11 yaemiko 05.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' Thus, she earned the name, "Chiyo the Tiger-Bite"... Or, "Torachiyo."
:{{A|vo schjeq002 11 raidenei 05.ogg}} '''Ei:''' I don't think... [[Chiyo]] would like that name.
:{{A|vo schjeq002 11 raidenei 06.ogg}} '''Ei:''' Though she escaped the belly of the beast alive... That battle never left her.
:{{A|vo schjeq002 11 raidenei 07.ogg}} '''Ei:''' She saw the memories of her fallen comrades everywhere, slaughtered one after another, until she could no longer distinguish dream from reality...
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (A nightmare doesn't incapacitate someone with sufficient strength... It turns into something even worse...)
:{{A|vo schjeq002 11 raidenei 08.ogg}} '''Ei:''' ...The nightmare twisted every joy in her life — her subordinates, family, and friends — into enemies in need of destruction.
:{{A|vo schjeq002 11 raidenei 09.ogg}} '''Ei:''' It was in that state, trapped in the battlefield of her mind, that she raised her sword against me on Mt. Yougou.
:{{A|vo schjeq002 11 raidenei 10.ogg}} '''Ei:''' With the Musou no Hitotachi, I cut off her arm, one of her horns, and a portion of the mountain itself... I suspect that is when the horn in question was buried there.
:{{A|vo schjeq002 11 yaemiko 06.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' And, subsequently, uncovered by three bake-danuki... That means the fragment on the horn... comes from Chiyo's nightmare.
:{{A|vo schjeq002 11 mizuki 06.ogg}} '''Yumemizuki Mizuki:''' Nightmares feed on fear and anxiety. If what {{Traveler}} saw is true...
:{{A|vo schjeq002 11 mizuki 07.ogg}} '''Yumemizuki Mizuki:''' It's possible Kinkaku and the others' fear over the past five hundred years allowed the fragment to gain physical form and become something akin to a jibakurei.
:{{DIcon}} Jibakurei?
:{{A|vo schjeq002 11 mizuki 08.ogg}} '''Yumemizuki Mizuki:''' An earthbound spirit. They move through the [[Ley Line]]s, but are also bound by them. That's why the traces of this entity appeared intermittently, and never outside of Mt. Yougou.
:{{A|vo schjeq002 11 yaemiko 07.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' It would seem the fragment of this Nightmare is no different from the one back then... It hates all joy and every good thing in this world.
:{{A|vo schjeq002 11 yaemiko 08.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' The Investigation Team working for a better future? Attacked... Hitotsume Kozou and his friends, kind enough to lend a helping hand? Attacked...
:{{A|vo schjeq002 11 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yeah, and we were attacked, too! Right when we were having fun with the play-testing...
:{{DIcon}} So, why hasn't it appeared since?
:{{A|vo schjeq002 11 raidenei 11.ogg}} '''Ei:''' Perhaps it needs to regain strength after your defeat... Or, perhaps it is biding its time because it knows, with whatever rationality remains, that it cannot defeat you...
:{{A|vo schjeq002 11 raidenei 12.ogg}} '''Ei:''' ...But, sooner or later, its twisted hatred will force it out of hiding, and it will move to strike its "enemies."
:{{A|vo schjeq002 11 raidenei 13.ogg}} '''Ei:''' When Chiyo set her sights on a target... She never was one to waver.
:{{A|vo schjeq002 11 yaemiko 09.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' ...
:{{A|vo schjeq002 11 raidenei 14.ogg}} '''Ei:''' ...But, both possibilities prove something... Nightmare Fragments can be defeated.
:{{A|vo schjeq002 11 raidenei 15.ogg}} '''Ei:''' And an enemy that can be killed... is one that can be split in two by the power of Musou Isshin.
:{{A|vo schjeq002 11 mizuki 09.ogg}} '''Yumemizuki Mizuki:''' ...There's really no other way?
:{{A|vo schjeq002 11 raidenei 16.ogg}} '''Ei:''' Mikoshi Chiyo is gone. A fragment of a Nightmare tied to a severed horn... That is all that remains. The living must take precedent over the memory of the dead.
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (Even so, having to unleash Musou Isshin against her again? Would Ei really be okay?)
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (Mizuki said Archons suffer from the same turmoil as the rest of us... The dead may be gone, but that doesn't mean our emotions die with them...)
:{{A|vo schjeq002 11 yaemiko 10.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' ...Who cares about the dead, anyway?
:{{A|vo schjeq002 11 yaemiko 11.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' I'm just trying to look out for the living.
:{{A|vo schjeq002 11 raidenei 17.ogg}} '''Ei:''' ...! What is that supposed to mean, Miko?
:{{A|vo schjeq002 11 yaemiko 12.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' Oh, I'm just concerned about our poor bake-danuki friends...
:{{A|vo schjeq002 11 tetsunosuke 08.ogg}} '''Tetsunosuke:''' Huh? What does this have to do with us?
:{{A|vo schjeq002 11 yaemiko 13.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' The Nightmare Fragment has been tied to the bake-danuki for nearly five hundred years. Strike it down, and who's to say whether you take the lives of our poor friends along with it.
:{{A|vo schjeq002 11 ginkaku 08.ogg}} '''Ginkaku:''' EEEK!?
:{{A|vo schjeq002 11 ioroi 15.ogg}} '''Ioroi:''' I... I beseech you, Almighty Shogun! S—Spare the young ones! It was just a momentary... Or, uh, no... a five-hundred-year long lapse in judgement...
:{{A|vo schjeq002 11 raidenei 18.ogg}} '''Ei:''' Miko... You speak the truth?
:{{A|vo schjeq002 11 yaemiko 14a.ogg}}<!--{{A|vo schjeq002 11 yaemiko 14b.ogg}}--> '''Yae Miko:''' If you don't believe me, ask Mizuki and {{Traveler}}. I'm sure they've encountered similar cases during their extensive travels...
:{{A|vo schjeq002 11 mizuki 10.ogg}} '''Yumemizuki Mizuki:''' Well, I... Oh!
;(Miko, Mizuki, and the Traveler look at each other)
:{{A|vo schjeq002 11 mizuki 11.ogg}} '''Yumemizuki Mizuki:''' ...Yes! During my studies, both in [[Liyue]] and [[Natlan]]!
:{{DIcon}} Yeah! I've definitely seen that happen before!
:{{A|vo schjeq002 11 raidenei 19.ogg}} '''Ei:''' Then... What would you propose? This Nightmare Fragment is a constant threat to Inazuma. Should all other options fail... I will take action.
:{{A|vo schjeq002 11 mizuki 12.ogg}} '''Yumemizuki Mizuki:''' ...If the Fragment's hatred toward the world comes from a Nightmare, then the most logical option... is to get rid of the Nightmare itself...
:{{A|vo schjeq002 11 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Right! Can't you just eat the Nightmare, Mizuki?
:{{A|vo schjeq002 11 raidenei 20.ogg}} '''Ei:''' ...The Yumekui-Baku already tried that five hundred years ago. Even yesterday, when faced with the corruption of the Nightmare, Mizuki could only mitigate the effects.
:{{A|vo schjeq002 11 yaemiko 15.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' What was impossible back then... is not necessarily impossible now. I think Mizuki has the right idea. If we cannot eradicate the nightmares directly...
:{{A|vo schjeq002 11 yaemiko 16.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' Why not use this entity's tricks against it? Combat illusions with illusions. Combat nightmares... with dreams.
:{{A|vo schjeq002 11 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Is that even possible?
:{{A|vo schjeq002 11 yaemiko 17.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' Don't forget — there are youkai that specialize in shapeshifting and illusions, and they happen to be right in front of us.
:{{A|vo schjeq002 11 kinkaku 09.ogg}} '''Kinkaku:''' Wh—Where? Kinkaku doesn't see them anywhere!
:{{A|vo schjeq002 11 tetsunosuke 09.ogg}} '''Tetsunosuke:''' Maybe they're hiding as trees? Or the wind?
:{{A|vo schjeq002 11 ioroi 16.ogg}} '''Ioroi:''' Fools! The kitsune is clearly referring to the bake-danuki! Tetsunosuke, Kinkaku, must you be so dense!?
:{{A|vo schjeq002 11 yaemiko 18.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' Given their centuries-long connection to the Nightmare Fragment, they are perfectly positioned to create a dreamscape that the entity will be unable to distinguish from the real world.
:{{A|vo schjeq002 11 raidenei 21.ogg}} '''Ei:''' ...Back then, the Nightmare had little to no weaknesses... If we want to give the bake-danuki an opportunity to strike, I assume you have a plan, Miko?
:{{A|vo schjeq002 11 yaemiko 19.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' You said it yourself — Mikoshi Chiyo is gone. All that remains is a fragment of her nightmare, already broken and vulnerable.
:{{A|vo schjeq002 11 yaemiko 20.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' Besides... Mizuki is an old friend, one that is not to be underestimated. She has traveled the land studying dreams and is far more capable than those old fossils back then.
:{{A|vo schjeq002 11 mizuki 13.ogg}} '''Yumemizuki Mizuki:''' Oh... Um...
:{{DIcon}} ...Not gonna say anything?
:{{A|vo schjeq002 11 mizuki 14.ogg}} '''Yumemizuki Mizuki:''' She just... usually doesn't compliment me to my face... But, Miko's right. If we work together, I'm confident we can put together a ritual to subdue the Nightmare Fragment.
:{{A|vo schjeq002 11 yaemiko 21.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' Once we perform the ritual, it will take some time for the barrier to take effect. Luckily for us, we have two formidable warriors on our side...
:{{A|vo schjeq002 11 yaemiko 22.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' ...Our festival representative, who also happens to have extensive experience against dark forces, and the Almighty Shogun, unmatched in combat... I'm sure the two of you can buy us some time?
:{{A|vo schjeq002 11 mizuki 15.ogg}} '''Yumemizuki Mizuki:''' There's just one problem... Since this entity can pass through the Ley Lines, its movements are unpredictable. If we're going to create a barrier, how can we be sure it appears where we want?
:{{A|vo schjeq002 11 yaemiko 23.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' Ah, the solution to that... is obvious. If the Nightmare Fragment despises all sources of joy and happiness...
:{{A|vo schjeq002 11 yaemiko 24.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' Then, naturally, a joyous occasion would be an evil beyond measure — an enemy that must be annihilated at all costs...
:{{A|vo schjeq002 11 mizuki 16.ogg}} '''Yumemizuki Mizuki:''' So, if we want to lure it out...
:{{DIcon}} We need a source of joy.
:{{DIcon}} Then, the obvious target would be...
:{{A|vo schjeq002 11 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' ...The Mikawa Flower Festival!
:{{A|vo schjeq002 11 yaemiko 25.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' Hehe, what joy could possibly compare to finishing one's work right before the deadline?
:{{A|vo schjeq002 11 raidenei 22.ogg}} '''Ei:''' ...I would imagine we can all think of a few. But, I agree — the Mikawa Flower Festival is the most plausible target.
:{{A|vo schjeq002 11 raidenei 23.ogg}} '''Ei:''' Once the enemy appears, I will pull them into the Plane of Euthymia immediately... I will not put the people in danger.
:{{A|vo schjeq002 11 raidenei 24.ogg}} '''Ei:''' {{Traveler}}, I ask that you join me there so we can subdue the enemy together.
:{{DIcon}} Of course.
:{{A|vo schjeq002 11 yaemiko 26.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' Alright, I will update everyone back at the festival and start the preparations for the ritual... I'll need your help, Mizuki. It's going to be a busy night.
:{{A|vo schjeq002 11 mizuki 17.ogg}} '''Yumemizuki Mizuki:''' Looks like another all-nighter for me.
:{{A|vo schjeq002 11 yaemiko 27.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' ...Well, this was your idea. Oh, and don't forget — you need to finish "[[Enchanted Tales of the Mikawa Festival/A Little Fox's Daydream|A Little Fox's Daydream]]" as well.
:{{A|vo schjeq002 11 mizuki 18.ogg}} '''Yumemizuki Mizuki:''' ...And, in a surprising twist, you were my nightmare all along!

;(Talk to Ioroi or Yae Miko, optional)
:{{A|vo dialog schjeq002 yaemiko 01.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' Well, Ioroi, as I see it, you've been punished long enough. It's about time you were released...
:{{A|vo dialog schjeq002 ioroi 01.ogg}} '''Ioroi:''' R—R—Released!? I can do that myself any time I want! This statue keeps me warm in the winter and cool in the summer. Don't interfere!
:{{A|vo dialog schjeq002 together 01.ogg}} '''Kinkaku, Ginkaku, and Tetsunosuke:''' Ioroi is the best!
:{{A|vo dialog schjeq002 ioroi 02.ogg}} '''Ioroi:''' ...Besides, the seal's power is almost gone... What I really want is for you to help me give [[Kitsune Saiguu|that sneaky kitsune]] a piece of my mind!
:{{A|vo dialog schjeq002 yaemiko 02.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' ...Ioroi, she's already—
:{{A|vo dialog schjeq002 ioroi 03.ogg}} '''Ioroi:''' Not so fast! I won't be fooled by your tricks again! Whatever you were about to say, she can tell me herself, instead of sending some young kitsune to hoodwink me!

;(Talk to Yumemizuki Mizuki, optional)
:{{A|vo dialog schjeq002 tetsunosuke 01.ogg}} '''Tetsunosuke:''' Great youkai really wasn't forced to work all night?
:{{A|vo dialog schjeq002 mizuki 01.ogg}} '''Yumemizuki Mizuki:''' That's right. It was my choice.
:{{A|vo dialog schjeq002 kinkaku 01.ogg}} '''Kinkaku:''' Why does great youkai have to work?
:{{A|vo dialog schjeq002 mizuki 02.ogg}} '''Yumemizuki Mizuki:''' ...I suppose it's just the price of becoming a great youkai.
:{{A|vo dialog schjeq002 ginkaku 01.ogg}} '''Ginkaku:''' Great youkai, Ginkaku is sad for you...

;(Talk to Ei)
:{{A|vo schjeq002 12 raidenei 01.ogg}} '''Ei:''' {{Traveler}}... During the battle tomorrow, it is imperative you know your limits. If the enemy proves too much to handle... leave them to me.
:{{DIcon}} But—
:{{A|vo schjeq002 12 raidenei 02.ogg}} '''Ei:''' I know... I understand your concerns, just as you know mine. We need not say any more than that. Just get some rest and prepare yourself for the battle to come.
:{{DIcon}} Okay.
:{{DIcon}} Get some rest, Ei.
:{{A|vo schjeq002 12 raidenei 03.ogg}} '''Ei:''' ...
:{{A|vo schjeq002 12 raidenei 04.ogg}} '''Ei:''' Ah, one more thing... Thank you.
{{Dialogue End}}

==Steps==
# View the Invitation Letter
# Talk to [[Okuzumeshuu]]
# Pay a visit to [[Tenshukaku]]
# Pay a visit to [[Ioroi]]
# Make your way into [[Inazuma City]]
# Help the bake-danuki team up (0/3)
# Go to the [[Yashiro Commission]]
# Wait until the next day (13:00 – 16:00)
# Go to [[Mt. Yougou]]
# Share your play-test experience with [[Miko]]
#* Talk to contestants from various teams (optional)
# Talk to [[Paimon]]
# Defeat the opponents
#* {{Enemy|Kairagi: Dancing Thunder|link=Nightmare Fragments|text=??? — ???}}
# Talk to Paimon

==Gameplay Notes==
* During step 12, the active party will be limited to a trial [[Traveler]] aligned to [[Electro]] and using a special combat mode (see [[#Tutorials|Tutorials]]). There will also be a barrier around the area.

==Dialogue==
{{Quest Description|You receive a long-awaited letter from [[Yae Miko]]...}}
{{Dialogue Start}}<!-- Unvoiced in EN: Arataki Itto, Gorou, Kujou Sara, Kuki Shinobu, Sangonomiya Kokomi, Thoma, Yoimiya -->
;(Upon obtaining quest)
:{{A|vo schjeq001 1 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh? A letter from Miko? What is she plotting this time... Well, let's open it and take a look!
:;(Obtain {{Item|Invitation From Miko}})

;(Accept the Invitation Letter)
:{{A|vo schjeq001 1 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' ...Tenshukaku? Why does she want to meet us there? Paimon has a bad feeling about this...
----
;(Talk to [[Takeshi]])
:{{A|vo schjeq001 1 takeshi 01.ogg}} '''Takeshi:''' Ah, welcome, honored {{Traveler}}. Guuji Yae told me about your visit. Please, come in.
:{{DIcon}} Well, that was a lot easier than last time...
:{{A|vo schjeq001 1 takeshi 02.ogg}} '''Takeshi:''' Ahem... The Almighty Shogun is also inside. It's best not to keep her waiting.
:;(The player is teleported into Tenshukaku)
:{{A|vo schjeq001 2 yaemiko 01.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' ...Now, now, there's no need to be so stubborn about this. I'll adjust the budget here, and we'll definitely turn a profit.
:{{A|vo schjeq001 2 raidenshogun 01.ogg}} '''Raiden Shogun:''' No. We must confirm the official representative before discussing details. There is an order to this that must be followed.
:{{Introductory Note|Raiden Shogun}}
:{{A|vo schjeq001 2 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' From the way she's talking... This must be [[the Shogun]], right?
:{{DIcon}} Yeah, it's her alright.
:{{A|vo schjeq001 2 yaemiko 02.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' Ah, little one. It's about time. Come, I have a contract for you to sign.
:{{A|vo schjeq001 2 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Whoa! We're not just gonna sign a random contract out of the blue!
:{{DIcon}} Also, if it's one of your contracts...
:{{DIcon}} How can I be sure I'm not signing myself up for slave labor or something?
:{{A|vo schjeq001 2 yaemiko 03.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' Hardly, hardly... Well, "labor" is a part of it, but you will be compensated...
:{{Introductory Note|Yae Miko}}
:{{A|vo schjeq001 2 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hah, so it IS as bad as Paimon thought...
:{{A|vo schjeq001 2 raidenshogun 02a.ogg}} {{A|vo schjeq001 2 raidenshogun 02b.ogg}} '''Raiden Shogun:''' I see, so {{MC|m=he's|f=she's}} the representative you selected... {{MC|m=He|f=She}} would indeed be the perfect candidate for the [[Mikawa Flower Festival]].
:{{DIcon}} The Mikawa Flower Festival?
:{{A|vo schjeq001 2 raidenshogun 03.ogg}} '''Raiden Shogun:''' When the [[youkai]] still roamed the land, they celebrated an event known as the "Mikawa Flower Festival." It was an occasion for drink, laughter, and merriment.
:{{A|vo schjeq001 2 yaemiko 04.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' We hosted a version of it during the [[Test of Courage (Event Quest)|Test of Courage]]. Unfortunately, due to time constraints, we weren't able to put on a large celebration.
:{{A|vo schjeq001 2 yaemiko 05.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' So, I got to thinking, why not have another go? This time, with a Mikawa Flower Festival for youkai and humans alike.
:{{A|vo schjeq001 2 yaemiko 06.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' One that combines human ingenuity with youkai arts to offer the most innovative and thrilling entertainment of our time.... open to all humans and youkai throughout the land.
:{{A|vo schjeq001 2 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Entertainment, huh... Wait, kind of like [[Akitsu Yuugei]] and [[Akitsu Haneasobi]]? Those games were really fun!
:{{A|vo schjeq001 2 raidenshogun 04.ogg}} '''Raiden Shogun:''' For an important event like this, an official representative is required to preside over the festivities. In the past, the role was usually given to the Guuji, or an individual from the Yashiro Commission. But this time...
:{{A|vo schjeq001 2 yaemiko 07.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' Neither myself nor the [[Kamisato Clan|Kamisato family]] can assume the position, given we represent one side or the other — the youkai or the humans.
:{{DIcon}} But, aren't I human, too?
:{{A|vo schjeq001 2 raidenshogun 05.ogg}} '''Raiden Shogun:''' Human you may be, but you {{sic|posses}} a deep connection with the youkai, and you do not hail from this land. That makes you a more neutral option.
:{{A|vo schjeq001 2 raidenshogun 06.ogg}} '''Raiden Shogun:''' Moreover, you took part in the previous festival during the Test of Courage. In my estimation, there is no better candidate for the role.
:{{A|vo schjeq001 2 yaemiko 08.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' Plus, your name has the potential to attract an even greater showing... So, are you going to sign this thing, or what?
:{{A|vo schjeq001 2 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh, you've got a point... Then, let's go ahead and... Wait! Paimon almost fell into her trap!
:{{DIcon}} I don't work as a festival ambassador for free.
:{{DIcon}} How much are you willing to offer?
:{{A|vo schjeq001 2 yaemiko 09.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' Come now, this is for an important occasion, is it not? Even I've chosen to throw profit to the wind. Surely a... selfless hero like yourself wouldn't turn your back on a good cause?
:{{A|vo schjeq001 2 raidenshogun 07.ogg}} '''Raiden Shogun:''' According to the proposal, the proceeds will be distributed as follows — forty percent to [[Yae Publishing House]] and ten percent to the festival representative.
:{{A|vo schjeq001 2 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hey, no fair!
:{{DIcon}} I want thirty percent.
:{{A|vo schjeq001 2 yaemiko 10.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' Now, ten percent might not sound like much, but Yae Publishing House is going to great lengths for this occasion, both in time and personnel. All you need to do is show your face.
:{{DIcon}} ...You say that now, and then you're going to put me to work once I agree.
:{{A|vo schjeq001 2 yaemiko 11.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' Hah, getting smart, aren't you, little one? In that case, I'll throw in another ten percent from the other half of the proceeds.
:{{A|vo schjeq001 2 raidenshogun 08.ogg}} '''Raiden Shogun:''' No. The other half is going to the [[Shogunate]] — that is not up for negotiation. But, I am rather curious about the supposed "great lengths" you mentioned...
:{{A|vo schjeq001 2 raidenshogun 09.ogg}} '''Raiden Shogun:''' Unless I am mistaken, most of the personnel and supplies are to be provided by the Shogunate. In that sense, forty percent seems rather high for your establishment, does it not?
:{{A|vo schjeq001 2 yaemiko 12.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' That [[Ei]]... When did she reprogram you to argue back like this?
:{{A|vo schjeq001 2 raidenshogun 10.ogg}} '''Raiden Shogun:''' Proceeds should be distributed according to contribution. Besides, from the very beginning, you planned to allocate an additional ten percent of your share to {{Traveler}}, did you not?
:{{A|vo schjeq001 2 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wait, so earlier... you were just trying to shortchange us!
:{{A|vo schjeq001 2 yaemiko 13.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' *sigh* What's the fun in bargaining if you open up with your best offer right off the bat?
:{{A|vo schjeq001 2 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Uh... Paimon doesn't see the fun at all, but twenty percent is... acceptable.
:{{DIcon}} Alright, so what do I have to do as the representative?
:{{Black Screen|Once the representative is confirmed, the rest of the conversation goes quite smoothly.}}
:{{A|vo schjeq001 2 yaemiko 14.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' Games have always been a central part of the festival, and both Akitsu Haneasobi and Akitsu Yuugei were extremely popular.
:{{A|vo schjeq001 2 yaemiko 15.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' So, the plan is to host an event where the attendees have forty-eight hours to create a game of their own. We'll have new and exciting entertainment in no time!
:{{A|vo schjeq001 2 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ohh! Everyone loves fun games! You won't have to worry about attracting humans and youkai to the event!
:{{A|vo schjeq001 2 raidenshogun 11.ogg}} '''Raiden Shogun:''' That is the general plan. I'll leave you to iron out the finer details and contact the participants.
:{{A|vo schjeq001 2 raidenshogun 12.ogg}} '''Raiden Shogun:''' This is a critical time for the Shogunate's new development plans, and the survey team is returning momentarily, so I must turn my attention to them.
:{{A|vo schjeq001 2 yaemiko 16a.ogg}}<!--{{A|vo schjeq001 2 yaemiko 16b.ogg}}--> '''Yae Miko:''' Got it, got it. We'll see you later, then.
:{{DIcon}} Where to now?
:{{A|vo schjeq001 2 yaemiko 17.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' Hmm... [[Chinju Forest]]. Let's pay a visit to our old friend, Ioroi.
:;(The player is teleported to Chinju Forest)
----
;(Enter Chinju Forest)
:{{A|vo schjeq001 2 yaemiko 18.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' Oh, but before I forget, you should eat this Kitsune Meal first.
:{{A|vo schjeq001 2 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Whoa, it smells so good... Hmm... Oh, and also kind of like fried tofu, for some reason?

;(Approach Ioroi)
:{{A|vo schjeq001 3 ioroi 01.ogg}} '''Ioroi:''' Eek! The smell of humans... Nothing to see here, just a statue... Huh? Wait, why do I smell [[kitsune]]...
:{{Introductory Note|Ioroi}}
:{{A|vo schjeq001 3 yaemiko 01.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' Remember us, Ioroi?
:{{A|vo schjeq001 3 ioroi 02.ogg}} '''Ioroi:''' Ah! It's you youngsters... And... YOU! Hmph, the nasty kitsune who turned Chinju Forest into the playground for her Test of Courage!
:{{A|vo schjeq001 3 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, Chinju Forest is supposed to be Ioroi's territory, right? No wonder he's so mad...
:{{A|vo schjeq001 3 ioroi 03.ogg}} '''Ioroi:''' Exactly! How could you hold a Test of Courage without inviting me!?
:{{A|vo schjeq001 3 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ohhhhhh, so THAT's what he's angry about!
:{{DIcon}} But, um, sealed away like this...
:{{DIcon}} Could you even participate?
:{{A|vo schjeq001 3 ioroi 04.ogg}} '''Ioroi:''' ...*ahem* Anyway, what brings you all here? Something to discuss?
:{{DIcon}} (Okay, so he avoided the question completely...)
:{{A|vo schjeq001 3 yaemiko 02.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' Hehe, I actually came to apologize about the Test of Courage.
:{{A|vo schjeq001 3 yaemiko 03.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' It was my mistake not to invite more youkai to the ceremony. So, for this Mikawa Flower Festival, I knew I had to extend a personal invitation to the bake-danuki.
:{{A|vo schjeq001 3 kichiboushi 01.ogg}} '''"Kichiboushi":''' Huh? The Mikawa Flower Festival?
:{{A|vo schjeq001 3 together 01.ogg}} '''Shousei & Gyoubu Koban:''' Yes!!! The Mikawa Flower Festival!!!
:{{Introductory Note|Kichiboushi & Shousei & Gyoubu Koban}}
:{{A|vo schjeq001 3 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh!? [[Kichiboushi]], [[Shousei]], [[Gyoubu Koban]]... Where did you come from!?
:{{DIcon}} (And why can we understand them all of a sudden...)
:{{DIcon}} (Is it because of the Kitsune Meal? On second thought, better not to ask.)
:{{A|vo schjeq001 3 ioroi 05.ogg}} '''Ioroi:''' Hmph! Never trust an apology from a kitsune! Or an invitation, for that matter! It's just a silly festival... So what if there's delicious food!? Or fun games!?
:{{A|vo schjeq001 3 kichiboushi 02.ogg}} '''"Kichiboushi":''' Yum yum!
:{{A|vo schjeq001 3 shousei 02.ogg}} '''"Shousei":''' Fun fun!
:{{A|vo schjeq001 3 ioroi 06.ogg}} '''Ioroi:''' That's enough, you two! Don't fall for the kitsune's cheap tricks! Such hopeless innocent cubs...
:{{A|vo schjeq001 3 yaemiko 04.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' What a shame... I was hoping to take you all to the festival, but it would seem Ioroi disapproves.
:{{A|vo schjeq001 3 yaemiko 05.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' I suppose it makes sense... Poor Ioroi, stuck in this statue all alone while the rest of you got to have fun. How sad that would be...
:{{A|vo schjeq001 3 gyoubukoban 02.ogg}} '''"Gyoubu Koban":''' Poor Ioroi!
:{{A|vo schjeq001 3 ioroi 07.ogg}} '''Ioroi:''' E—Excuse you! I am Ioroi, the Kakushigami of the [[bake-danuki]]! I'm just... um... Ah, yes! Just worried the cubs will get distracted and stray from the tanuki path...
:{{A|vo schjeq001 3 yaemiko 06.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' Ah, I should also mention, I was hoping the bake-danuki could help the humans take their games to the next level, talented as you are in the art of transformation.
:{{A|vo schjeq001 3 yaemiko 07.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' In Inazuma, only the bake-danuki can hope to match the kitsune in that area.
:{{A|vo schjeq001 3 ioroi 08.ogg}} '''Ioroi:''' Match!? The kitsune could never rival the transformative gifts of the bake-danuki!
:{{A|vo schjeq001 3 yaemiko 08.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' ...Ah, well, I was thinking of using the bake-danuki as the symbol of the event in promotions and such. But, alas, it would seem you don't like that idea, Ioroi.
:;(Miko turns around as she speaks, as if about to walk away after Ioroi's rejection)
:{{A|vo schjeq001 3 yaemiko 09.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' No matter — I shall simply seek the help of the kitsune. When the time comes, all of Inazuma will know the kitsune stepped in to accomplish what the bake-danuki could not...
:{{A|vo schjeq001 3 ioroi 09.ogg}} '''Ioroi:''' W—Wait!
:{{A|vo schjeq001 3 yaemiko 10.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' Heh.
:{{DIcon}} What an obvious strategy...
:{{A|vo schjeq001 3 yaemiko 11.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' It worked, didn't it?
:{{A|vo schjeq001 3 ioroi 10.ogg}} '''Ioroi:''' Ahem... My dear cubs, transforming into things that already exist is only a small fraction of what it means to become a great bake-danuki...
:{{A|vo schjeq001 3 ioroi 11.ogg}} '''Ioroi:''' To even get a quarter of the way through your training, you must be able to turn into things of your own invention, just like when I turned into a gigantic ramen bowl that could fly...
:{{A|vo schjeq001 3 ioroi 12.ogg}} '''Ioroi:''' So, go forth and seize this opportunity, so you can advance the name of the... Ah, no, I mean, advance your training!
:{{A|vo schjeq001 3 ioroi 13a.ogg}}<!--{{A|vo schjeq001 3 ioroi 13b.ogg}}--> '''Ioroi:''' Not all humans are bad and scary — some are good, just like these youngsters. Go with them and transform into things you've never tried before.
:{{A|vo schjeq001 3 yaemiko 12.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' Don't worry, Ioroi. The little tanuki are safe with me.
:{{A|vo schjeq001 3 ioroi 14.ogg}} '''Ioroi:''' You're the one I'm worried about...
:{{A|vo schjeq001 3 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Well, we're here, too! We'll make sure they don't, uh... stray from the path!
:{{A|vo schjeq001 3 ioroi 15.ogg}} '''Ioroi:''' Hm... I'll hold you to that! Now, Kichiboushi, Shousei, Gyoubu Koban, while you're out there, always listen to—
:{{A|vo schjeq001 3 kichiboushi 03.ogg}} '''"Kichiboushi":''' Yep yep! Always listen to White Fur!
:{{A|vo schjeq001 3 shousei 03a.ogg}} {{A|vo schjeq001 3 shousei 03b.ogg}} '''"Shousei":''' And {{MC|m=Mr.|f=Miss}} Yellow Fur!
:{{A|vo schjeq001 3 gyoubukoban 03.ogg}} '''"Gyoubu Koban":''' And Auntie Pink—
:;(Miko gives the tanuki a scathing side-eye)
:{{A|vo schjeq001 3 gyoubukoban 04.ogg}} '''"Gyoubu Koban":''' ...*ahem* Miss Pink Fur!
:{{A|vo schjeq001 3 ioroi 16.ogg}} '''Ioroi:''' Ah, I almost forgot, given their level of training, speaking to humans will be a problem. Just a moment, I'll cook up a few Bake-Danuki Meals to keep on hand.
:{{A|vo schjeq001 3 yaemiko 13.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' No need. Here, Miss Pink Fur prepared a special Kitsune Meal for you all. It will give you the ability to speak to humans.
:{{A|vo schjeq001 3 ioroi 17.ogg}} '''Ioroi:''' Mm!? Y—You stole our tricks, too? A—And changed the name!?
:{{Black Screen|Seemingly oblivious to Ioroi's loud sounds of protest, Miko prepares a completely non-suspicious feast...}}
:{{A|vo schjeq001 3 kichiboushi 04.ogg}} '''"Kichiboushi":''' Mm! Yum yum!
:{{A|vo schjeq001 3 gyoubukoban 05.ogg}} '''"Gyoubu Koban":''' Nom nom! Mmm!
:{{A|vo schjeq001 3 ioroi 18.ogg}} '''Ioroi:''' *sigh*... Is it really that much better than mine...?
:{{A|vo schjeq001 3 yaemiko 14.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' Splendid! That should make our lives easier. Now, we can head into the city and start forming the teams.
:{{DIcon}} Teams?
:{{A|vo schjeq001 3 yaemiko 15.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' Well, we need more than bake-danuki power to design these games... Hmm, two humans per team should suffice, I'd say.
:{{A|vo schjeq001 3 yaemiko 16.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' Now, I need to discuss the layout of the venue with the Yashiro Commission. I'll leave the team recruitment to you.
:{{DIcon}} Put to work already...
:{{DIcon}} Guess I need to earn that extra ten percent...
:{{A|vo schjeq001 3 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hold on, you're not taking part, Miko? You're really gonna sit out on the fun? You, of all people...
:{{A|vo schjeq001 3 yaemiko 17.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' Hehe, making games is nowhere near as fun as playing them. Besides, working through the night certainly isn't my idea of a good time.
:{{A|vo schjeq001 3 kichiboushi 05.ogg}} '''"Kichiboushi":''' Making games?
:{{A|vo schjeq001 3 shousei 04.ogg}} '''"Shousei":''' Working?
:{{A|vo schjeq001 3 gyoubukoban 06.ogg}} '''"Gyoubu Koban":''' Through the night?
:{{A|vo schjeq001 3 yaemiko 18.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' ...Anyway, this time, I'm going to wait for the fun to come to me. See you later, little ones.

;(Talk to Ioroi, optional)
:{{A|vo dialog schjeq001 ioroi 01.ogg}} '''Ioroi:''' Kichiboushi and the others are young, so their speaking ability is limited... I miss the days when the bake-danuki could run circles around the humans.
:{{A|vo dialog schjeq001 ioroi 02.ogg}} '''Ioroi:''' Hold on, how were you able to understand them from the start? Does that mean the Bake-Danuki Meal from last time is still working...? Hah, take that, sneaky kitsune!
:{{A|vo dialog schjeq001 ioroi 03.ogg}} '''Ioroi:''' Speaking of... *sniff, sniff* That kitsune is gone, yes? Good. I have a request, young one. Come closer...
:{{A|vo dialog schjeq001 ioroi 04.ogg}} '''Ioroi:''' You must protect the cubs from that sneaky kitsune at all costs!!!
{{Dialogue End}}

{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Approach the Inazuma City teleport waypoint near [[Tsukumomono Groceries]])
:{{A|vo schjeq001 4 kichiboushi 01.ogg}} '''"Kichiboushi":''' Eek! A city!
:{{A|vo schjeq001 4 shousei 01.ogg}} '''"Shousei":''' So many houses! So many humans!
:{{A|vo schjeq001 4 gyoubukoban 01.ogg}} '''"Gyoubu Koban":''' Gotta farm beans! White Fur, Yellow Fur, how do we farm beans?
:{{A|vo schjeq001 4 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Form teams not "farm beans"! Uh... It's kind of hard to explain...

:{{A|vo schjeq001 4 kichiboushi 02.ogg}} '''"Kichiboushi":''' Taste the same... Got it!
:{{A|vo schjeq001 4 shousei 02.ogg}} '''"Shousei":''' Easy peasy! White Fur, dumb.
:{{A|vo schjeq001 4 gyoubukoban 02.ogg}} '''"Gyoubu Koban":''' Farm beans that taste the same!
:;(The three bake-danuki scurry off in different directions)

:'''Thoma:''' ...Wait, you're saying he's not one of [[Ushi]]'s friends?
:'''Arataki Itto:''' Whoa, pump the breaks... I thought he was your friend.
:{{Introductory Note|Arataki Itto}}
:{{A|vo schjeq001 6 shousei 01.ogg}} '''"Shousei":''' Hehe, long-horned [[oni]] and short-horned oni!
:'''Arataki Itto:''' He... He talks!
:{{A|vo schjeq001 6 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Shousei! There you are!
:{{A|vo schjeq001 6 shousei 02.ogg}} '''"Shousei":''' White Fur! Yellow Fur! Shousei found White Fur and Yellow Fur number two. Both great youkai! Both like to play!
:'''Thoma:''' Great youkai... So, he thinks I'm an oni, too?
:{{DIcon}} What's going on?
:'''Arataki Itto:''' Listen, I was just playin' some [[Genius Invokation]] with my good bro Thoma during his time off...
:'''Thoma:''' And then, out of the blue, this... Shousei appeared right in the middle of our match.
:{{A|vo schjeq001 6 shousei 03.ogg}} '''"Shousei":''' Shousei loves to play! Long-horned and short-horned Oni also love to play! We taste the same, hehe!
:'''Arataki Itto:''' We what now?
:{{DIcon}} I can explain...
:{{Black Screen|You briefly explain the situation to Itto and Thoma...}}
:'''Arataki Itto:''' Oho! The Mikawa Flower Festival! Shoulda opened with that, compadre!
:'''Arataki Itto:''' Man, the [[Arataki Gang]] really hard-carried the last one. We'll turn this one into somethin' special, too!
:{{A|vo schjeq001 6 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' [[Hitotsume Kozou]] and the others did all the work, Bull-chucker. You're really lumping them in with your gang?
:{{Introductory Note|Hitotsume Kozou & Youko & Kappa|guaranteed=yes}}<!-- yes this actually appeared, possibly a guaranteed intro note -->
:'''Arataki Itto:''' I—It's called doing them a favor... Besides, they look up to me. I'm like a cool older brother...
:{{A|vo schjeq001 6 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hmm... Hitotsume Kozou and his friends did come up with the Akitsu Yuugei game during the last festival. There's no reason not to invite them this time!
:'''Arataki Itto:''' Woo, the crew's gettin' back together! I'll round 'em up, hahaha!

:'''Arataki Itto:''' That's what I like to hear! Alright, let's round up those three little fellas and start workin' on the Almighty Arataki Great and Glorious Akitsu Yuugei Game...
:;(The camera pans to [[Kuki Shinobu]], who seemingly appeared out of nowhere)

:{{A|vo schjeq001 6 shousei 04.ogg}} '''"Shousei":''' ...Hornless oni?

* The "Tanuki Game Award" may be a reference to {{w|The Game Awards}}.

* The introductory note for Hitotsume Kozou, Youko, and Kappa will appear even if the player previously participated in and completed the [[Akitsu Kimodameshi]] Event Quests. '''''As Though Surrounded by Thunder''''' is the third part of the [[Enchanted Tales of the Mikawa Festival]] Event.

==Steps==
# Wait until the next day (13:00 – 15:00)
# Talk to [[Yae Miko|Miko]] and the others
# Talk to [[Ei]]
#* Talk to the contestants from various teams (optional)
# Prepare for battle with Ei
# Defeat the Nightmare Fragments
#* {{Enemy|Kairagi: Dancing Thunder|link=Nightmare Fragments|text=Nightmare Fragments — An All-Too-Distant Dream}}

==Gameplay Notes==
* During step 5:
** The active party will be limited to a trial [[Traveler]] aligned to [[Electro]] and using a special combat mode (see [[#Tutorials|Tutorials]]).
** The Traveler cannot die and will automatically recover 80% of their Max HP when they reach very low health.<!-- from HTML comment from dialogue trigger below: can't get below 259 at WL9, which is 1% - at which you stop getting damage, Miko says her line you get healed - for 20706 on WL9, which is 80%; same behavior confirmed for WL8; Miko's line triggers only first time, 2nd time onwards it heals without saying anything -->
** {{Enemy|Ei|link=Ei (Quest Boss)}} will fight alongside the player in her first phase, though she will not perform '''Lightning Blade''', '''Magatsu Electroculi''', and '''Vision Hunt Decree'''.
** "Everyone's Prayers" will assist three times during the battle. Each time, a fixed pink indicator circle will spawn at the location of the Nightmare Fragments, and after a short delay, several strikes will descend within the circle, dealing {{Color|Physical DMG}} to the Nightmare Fragments.

'''''Auction Games''''' is a quest in {{Quest|The Jade Chamber's Returning Guest}}.

==Steps==
# Go to the site where the auction is being held
# Talk to the secretary in charge of preparations
# Inspect the goods on auction (0/3)
# Wait for the auction to start (16:00–18:00)
# Attend the auction
# Figure out what the attendees are thinking (0/3)
# Talk to Ningguang again

:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913402 ningguang 17.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' I'm sure you must find it quite odd that all these everyday items could fetch such a huge price at auction.
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913402 ningguang 18.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' Since you're curious, why not go and talk to the buyers? I'm sure they'll give you the answers you're looking for.

===Those Whose Faith is Blind===
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Talk to Ningguang again)

:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913409 xiaofei 04.ogg}} '''Xiaofei:''' But I figured I'd buy it first, then go get it appraised by an expert. Then I'll be rich! Hehe...

;(Talk to Yingfeng)
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913410 yingfeng 01.ogg}} '''Yingfeng:''' I may have paid an arm and a leg for this, but in the end I got the result I wanted. Hahaha.

:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913410 yingfeng 02.ogg}} '''Yingfeng:''' Nothing of Ningguang's could ever be over-inflated.
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913410 yingfeng 03.ogg}} '''Yingfeng:''' I'm far from the only buyer who believes that "owned by Ningguang" is worth paying a premium for. So how much I can make just depends on how many people are even bigger fans of Ningguang than I am!

;(Talk to Ningguang again after talking to the buyers)
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913403 ningguang 03.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' Well? Did you find the answer yet?
:{{DIcon}} It's because everyone has faith in your judgment and aesthetics.
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913403 ningguang 04.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' That's certainly part of it. But every bidder will have noticed that none of these items have a particularly high going rate on the market in and of themselves.
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913403 ningguang 05.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' Despite this, they were all willing to pay very dearly for them. I wonder... is faith in me really the only factor in their appraisal of the items' value?
:{{DIcon}} If not, then what else could it be?
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913403 ningguang 06.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' You'll see shortly. The one who spent the most money will surely be the quickest to realize.
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913403 ningguang 07.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' If all I wanted to do was make some quick Mora by exploiting their blind faith in me, I have a million more effective ways of achieving that than hosting an auction.
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913403 ningguang 08.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' Every participant in this auction was hand-picked by me, based on certain intelligence.
:{{Black Screen|Sure enough, after some time has passed, one of the participants returns.}}
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913403 yingfeng 03.ogg}} '''Yingfeng:''' Lady Ningguang, uh... something doesn't seem quite right with the items from today's auction.
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913403 yingfeng 04.ogg}} '''Yingfeng:''' As unlikely as this sounds — and please forgive me for even bringing it up, but I had to ask... uhh... Y—You weren't selling counterfeits today, were you...?
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913403 ningguang 09.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' Counterfeits? Absolutely not. What motive would anyone have for making copies of things like these?
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913403 ningguang 10.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' They are simply ordinary items. And there was no coercion or enticement during the auction — every bid was voluntary.
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913403 yingfeng 05.ogg}} '''Yingfeng:''' Because we trusted you!
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913403 yingfeng 06.ogg}} '''Yingfeng:''' Everyone knows you love Mora, but we also know that you made your fortune through honest means... as opposed to, ahem, scamming people.
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913403 ningguang 11.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' You seem to have entered into dangerous linguistic territory there. You should know that unless you have evidence to support your outlandish claims, I am legally entitled to sue you for slander.
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913403 ningguang 12.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' Of course, if you have any genuine grievances about the auction, the lots, or the process, please enlighten me as to where exactly I went wrong.
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913403 yingfeng 07.ogg}} '''Yingfeng:''' You... You...!
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913403 yingfeng 08.ogg}} '''Yingfeng:''' Fine. Yes, technically, it was all legitimate. Guess all I can do is take the loss...
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913403 yingfeng 09.ogg}} '''Yingfeng:''' But if word gets out about today's auction, people are gonna start seeing you as a con artist. No one would dare do business with you after that.
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913403 yingfeng 10.ogg}} '''Yingfeng:''' I guess what I'm saying is... is this really in your best interests?
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913403 ningguang 13.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' Let me answer that with a question. You claim that you were willing to pay a high price because you trusted me. But is that really the full story?
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913403 yingfeng 11.ogg}} '''Yingfeng:''' Wh—What do you mean? What else could it be?
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913403 ningguang 14.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' Oh, I don't know... perhaps it could be something to do with a lost item from the original Jade Chamber collection that has quietly made its way into your hands?
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913403 yingfeng 12.ogg}} '''Yingfeng:''' ...!
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913403 ningguang 15.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' When the Jade Chamber fell, countless valuable items from my collection plunged into the sea. I organized a salvage operation, but still there were many items unaccounted for.
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913403 ningguang 16.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' A considerable number of these made their way back into Liyue Harbor through means unbeknownst to me, and passed through several pairs of hands before finally ending up in yours, and those of your fellow bidders today.
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913403 yingfeng 13.ogg}} '''Yingfeng:''' Wait, you mean...
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913403 ningguang 17.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' Yes, everyone attending the auction today is in possession of lost property belonging to me.
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913403 ningguang 18.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' Or to put it another way, they were all people who have had a taste of something that was mine and convinced themselves that I am someone to be taken advantage of.
:{{DIcon}} No wonder they had such blind faith.
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913403 ningguang 19.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' So I ask you again. Your high bidding price — was it motivated by trust? Or was it greed?
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913403 yingfeng 14.ogg}} '''Yingfeng:''' Tsk!
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913403 ningguang 20.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' The sole reason I held this auction is to reclaim my treasured possessions.
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913403 ningguang 21.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' If you are willing to return what is mine, I will refund all the money you spent in the auction today.
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913403 yingfeng 15.ogg}} '''Yingfeng:''' Alright, fine. I guess... I guess I'll return it.
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913403 yingfeng 16.ogg}} '''Yingfeng:''' You drive a hard bargain, like everyone says...
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913403 yingfeng 17.ogg}} '''Yingfeng:''' I'll go and get it right now. Please just wait here.
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913403 ningguang 22.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' Despite his bad attitude, he cooperated in the end. Good for him.
:{{DIcon}} It all makes sense now.
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913403 ningguang 23.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' The issue was that all items of mine that have been fished out of the sea have changed hands numerous times already. Determining who has legal ownership would be an extremely long-winded process, with each item being assessed on a case-by-case basis. Even Yanfei says she'd have a difficult time defending my claims.
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913403 ningguang 24.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' I could have bought them back, but it's not in my nature to pay twice for the same thing. Least of all when they'd be looking to make a handsome profit from my misfortune.
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913403 ningguang 25.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' After making some inquiries, I found them to be most uncooperative. So I had to resort to this auction to finally put a stop to all this nonsense.
:{{DIcon}} It definitely suits your modus operandi.
:{{DIcon}} I hope I never end up on the wrong side of you.
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913403 ningguang 26.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' Hehe. I just wanted my things back. Hardly an unusual sentiment.
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913403 ningguang 27.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' At most, a little childish, perhaps. Which is another reason why I didn't tell anybody about my plan.
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913403 ningguang 28.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' What do you think it was about the Jade Chamber that defeated Osial?
:{{DIcon}} The explosion?
:{{DIcon}} The size?
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913403 ningguang 29.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' I think it was a combination of the weight and the energy it contains.
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913403 ningguang 30.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' Its great weight meant it hit Osial with incredible force, while the energy within triggered that spectacular explosion.
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913403 ningguang 31.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' Every piece of the Jade Chamber, from the stone walls and wooden beams down to the smallest ornament, contributed to its total weight.
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913403 ningguang 32.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' But in the end, they became objects of merchants' greed.
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913403 ningguang 33.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' It's hard not to get a little irked thinking about it.
:{{DIcon}} That's not so childish.
:{{DIcon}} I hope you can get all your things back, too.
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913403 ningguang 34.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' Thank you for understanding.
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913403 ningguang 35.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' Now I've got one of my items back, let me show you what makes it so special.
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913403 ningguang 36.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' The secrets of history shine through in the relics that survive, and this one now has the story of another age to tell.
{{Dialogue End}}

'''Away With Obsessions and Falsehood''' is the third Event Quest of the [[Labyrinth Warriors]] event.

==Steps==
# Wait till 08:00 – 12:00 the next day
# Meet up with [[Xinyan]]
# Enter [[Labyrinth Warriors/The Vengeful Wood|The Vengeful Wood]]
# Retrieve a replica of [[Shiki Taishou]]
# Go deeper into The Vengeful Wood

==Dialogue==
{{Quest Description|The time for the critical battle has arrived. You return to the Mystic Onmyou Chamber and meet up with Childe and Shiki Taishou. Time to get to the bottom of all these mysteries...}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Wait until 08{{colon}}00 - 12{{colon}}00)

;(Talk to Watanabe)
:{{A|vo dialog eqrg003 watabe 01.ogg}} '''Watanabe:''' The situation seems to be stabilizing... Madam Kujou Sara won't feel pressured to take action.
:{{A|vo dialog eqrg003 watabe 02.ogg}} '''Watanabe:''' No need to rush. We'll launch a general offensive as soon as Madam Kujou Sara finishes her business in the city, and take down this Domain in one go!
:{{A|vo dialog eqrg003 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' We should hurry, they seem pretty amped up...

;(Talk to Xinyan)
:{{A|vo eqrg003 1 xinyan 01.ogg}} '''Xinyan:''' Traveler, I found out some good news from the garrisoned forces!
:{{A|vo eqrg003 1 xinyan 02.ogg}} '''Xinyan:''' Kujou Sara has been tied down with work in the city. Nothin' seems to be goin' on with her troops for now.
:{{A|vo eqrg003 1 xinyan 03.ogg}} '''Xinyan:''' Besides that, we haven't had any new monsters escape the Domain for quite some time, and the troops have complete control of the pass. I don't think they're in a hurry to attack the Domain right now.
:{{A|vo eqrg003 1 xinyan 04.ogg}} '''Xinyan:''' Seems we got more time than we bargained for!
:{{A|vo eqrg003 1 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Then let's get going! Those two must be getting impatient!
----
;(Enter the trial)
:{{A|vo eqrg003 3 shikishogun 01.ogg}} '''Shiki Taishou:''' Oh! You're back!
:{{A|vo eqrg003 3 tartaglia 01.ogg}} '''Childe:''' Okay, now that we're all here, whaddya say we get to the bottom of this?
:{{A|vo eqrg003 3 xinyan 01.ogg}} '''Xinyan:''' You two look like you've been through a war!
:{{A|vo eqrg003 3 tartaglia 02.ogg}} '''Childe:''' Just one war? Haha, I've lost count of how many battles we've had down here.
:{{A|vo eqrg003 3 tartaglia 03.ogg}} '''Childe:''' I did okay, right, Shiki Taishou?
:{{A|vo eqrg003 3 shikishogun 02.ogg}} '''Shiki Taishou:''' Mr. Tartaglia is no stranger to Domains. He was able to deal with even the most powerful monsters with ease.
:{{A|vo eqrg003 3 shikishogun 03.ogg}} '''Shiki Taishou:''' I am confident that we can make it to the innermost depths of the Domain.
:{{A|vo eqrg003 3 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh, you two seem to have gotten much closer over the last few days.
:{{A|vo eqrg003 3 tartaglia 04.ogg}} '''Childe:''' Well, we've fought shoulder to shoulder for quite a while now.
:{{A|vo eqrg003 3 tartaglia 05.ogg}} '''Childe:''' Alright, listen up. During the rearrangement, Shiki Taishou said he could sense the most important replica over there.
:{{A|vo eqrg003 3 shikishogun 04.ogg}} '''Shiki Taishou:''' Compared with the other replicas, it should contain a far greater power within. If I can fuse with it successfully, I should be able to remember the truth of this Domain.
:{{A|vo eqrg003 3 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' It's right there? Then how come you guys haven't gone over yet?
:{{A|vo eqrg003 3 xinyan 02.ogg}} '''Xinyan:''' Shiki Taishou... were you waitin' for us this whole time?
:{{A|vo eqrg003 3 shikishogun 05.ogg}} '''Shiki Taishou:''' Without your companionship, I never would have made it this far.
:{{A|vo eqrg003 3 shikishogun 06.ogg}} '''Shiki Taishou:''' My memories were only retrieved thanks to everyone's efforts. I feel it's only right that you're here with me to witness this final and most important juncture.

;(Retrieve the replica)
:{{A|vo eqrg003 4 shikishogun 01.ogg}} '''Shiki Taishou:''' My memories, fragmented for so long... are finally complete.
:{{A|vo eqrg003 4 shikishogun 02.ogg}} '''Shiki Taishou:''' I remember it all now... The origin of the Mystic Onmyou Chamber... Its essence.
:{{A|vo eqrg003 4 shikishogun 03.ogg}} '''Shiki Taishou:''' This realm is not for practicing onmyoudou, nor is it for harnessing evil. The reason Harunosuke created me and the Domain... Our sole purpose... was to protect.
:{{A|vo eqrg003 4 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Protect?
:{{A|vo eqrg003 4 shikishogun 04.ogg}} '''Shiki Taishou:''' Our nation was once attacked by a [[Abyss|great evil]], and a [[Kitsune Saiguu|person]] of importance to Harunosuke was taken from him...
:{{A|vo eqrg003 4 shikishogun 05.ogg}} '''Shiki Taishou:''' He was filled with hatred and regret, and began yearning for the strength to take on the evil himself.
:{{A|vo eqrg003 4 shikishogun 06.ogg}} '''Shiki Taishou:''' He made his way across the ocean to seek the [[adepti]] of Liyue, and went on to study the adepti arts. He combined those subtle techniques with the art of transcension that he himself had practiced over the years, and founded the earliest version of onmyoudou.
:{{A|vo eqrg003 4 shikishogun 07.ogg}} '''Shiki Taishou:''' Later, he rallied all samurai with the will to serve in protecting the nation, and created me and this onmyou chamber... With me as a template, he would create many replicas, assigning each to a samurai.
:{{A|vo eqrg003 4 shikishogun 08.ogg}} '''Shiki Taishou:''' The samurai and shikigami were partners, combining their martial prowess and charm magic to take on monsters with great efficiency.
:{{A|vo eqrg003 4 shikishogun 09.ogg}} '''Shiki Taishou:''' They worked in pairs, and set out to rid the land of monsters. Information on the defeated monsters would be recorded within the shikigami.
:{{A|vo eqrg003 4 shikishogun 10.ogg}} '''Shiki Taishou:''' Upon returning to the Domain, that information would be channeled into the creation of mirror monsters — training targets for the samurai.
:{{A|vo eqrg003 4 shikishogun 11.ogg}} '''Shiki Taishou:''' As the first shikigami, I was constantly absorbing the knowledge and experiences of the replicas. I was able to improve the structure of the Domain, and provide better training for the samurai.
:{{A|vo eqrg003 4 shikishogun 12.ogg}} '''Shiki Taishou:''' Over time, these dedicated samurai were able to achieve an enviable martial prowess. A new batch of recruits would arrive as the last group left the Domain. The cycle of new knowledge and new opponents seemed to be never ending...
:{{DIcon}} A Domain for training?
:{{A|vo eqrg003 4 tartaglia 01.ogg}} '''Childe:''' No wonder the fighting never stops here... This was a training ground to begin with.
:{{A|vo eqrg003 4 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' In another words, [[Kamuna Harunosuke]] built this onmyou chamber to train samurai to fight monsters?
:{{A|vo eqrg003 4 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Doesn't that make him a pretty great guy?
:{{A|vo eqrg003 4 xinyan 01.ogg}} '''Xinyan:''' If that's the case, why is he hiding away in the depths of the Domain?
:{{A|vo eqrg003 4 shikishogun 13.ogg}} '''Shiki Taishou:''' No... Harunosuke is no longer here.
:{{A|vo eqrg003 4 shikishogun 14.ogg}} '''Shiki Taishou:''' For reasons unknown, Harunosuke disbanded the samurai and abandoned the Domain.
:{{A|vo eqrg003 4 shikishogun 15.ogg}} '''Shiki Taishou:''' This part of my memory is still fragmented... I can't remember what Harunosuke said to me before he left.
:{{A|vo eqrg003 4 xinyan 02.ogg}} '''Xinyan:''' Left? Meanin'... he's still alive?
:{{A|vo eqrg003 4 shikishogun 16.ogg}} '''Shiki Taishou:''' It's possible... and I hope he is.
:{{A|vo eqrg003 4 shikishogun 17.ogg}} '''Shiki Taishou:''' I am a weapon created by Harunosuke. The purpose of the onmyou chamber, my purpose, is to facilitate combat, to train myself and others.
:{{A|vo eqrg003 4 shikishogun 18.ogg}} '''Shiki Taishou:''' But this Domain was abandoned. The only people to have come here since are yourselves. What use does a weapon discarded by its owner have to offer...
:{{A|vo eqrg003 4 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' This is really tough for Shiki Taishou...
:{{A|vo eqrg003 4 tartaglia 02.ogg}} '''Childe:''' A discarded weapon... Hah.
:{{A|vo eqrg003 4 tartaglia 03.ogg}} '''Childe:''' Discarded or not, what's so bad about being a weapon? All those who stalk the battlefield yearn for meaning and value.
:{{A|vo eqrg003 4 shikishogun 19.ogg}} '''Shiki Taishou:''' Do you think so...?
:{{A|vo eqrg003 4 tartaglia 04.ogg}} '''Childe:''' You were interested in my secret, right? Why is it that I'm able to withstand the resistance of the Domain? Why is it that I'm able to face down complex battles with ease?
:{{A|vo eqrg003 4 tartaglia 05.ogg}} '''Childe:''' I have fought in the fissures that lie between great tree roots. Boundless danger, fatal encounters... These are the ingredients I use to become stronger still.
:{{A|vo eqrg003 4 tartaglia 06.ogg}} '''Childe:''' It is not victory that I seek, but improvement. I want to become sharp as a blade, to the point where others fear me. You're not the only weapon here, Shiki Taishou.
:{{A|vo eqrg003 4 shikishogun 20.ogg}} '''Shiki Taishou:''' If that's true... then these battles you strive for... Where do they end?
:{{A|vo eqrg003 4 tartaglia 07.ogg}} '''Childe:''' Only those that wish for an end will find one. For me, it's nothing more than a mirage.
:{{A|vo eqrg003 4 tartaglia 08.ogg}} '''Childe:''' I was born to fight, and as long as I draw breath, there will be no end to my purpose. My limits vanish behind the horizon with every step that I take.
:{{A|vo eqrg003 4 tartaglia 09.ogg}} '''Childe:''' Let go of your confusion. Sorrow and hesitation are the enemy of an implacable weapon.
:{{A|vo eqrg003 4 shikishogun 21.ogg}} '''Shiki Taishou:''' What must I do... to let go...?
:{{A|vo eqrg003 4 xinyan 03.ogg}} '''Xinyan:''' Don't worry, you don't have to abandon somethin' to succeed in lettin' go.
:{{A|vo eqrg003 4 xinyan 04.ogg}} '''Xinyan:''' You don't have to abandon' anythin', Shiki Taishou.
:{{A|vo eqrg003 4 xinyan 05.ogg}} '''Xinyan:''' You've only just regained your memories — this is the perfect opportunity to pick up where you left off. All you gotta do is find the thing that was most important and righteous to you.
:{{A|vo eqrg003 4 shikishogun 22.ogg}} '''Shiki Taishou:''' Most important... and righteous?
:{{A|vo eqrg003 4 xinyan 06.ogg}} '''Xinyan:''' Yup! For me, it's rock 'n' roll.
:{{A|vo eqrg003 4 xinyan 07.ogg}} '''Xinyan:''' It's not everyone's cup of tea. In fact, I'd say it's kinda unpopular, really. But if it makes me happy, that's all that matters!
:{{A|vo eqrg003 4 xinyan 08.ogg}} '''Xinyan:''' What do I care if someone doesn't share my passion? All I need to worry about is doin' what I enjoy!
:{{A|vo eqrg003 4 xinyan 09.ogg}} '''Xinyan:''' So if people wanna roll their eyes or give me the cold shoulder, they can have at it! My music was never meant for those that couldn't understand it.
:{{A|vo eqrg003 4 shikishogun 23.ogg}} '''Shiki Taishou:''' ...I still remember your test... The song you played for me.
:{{A|vo eqrg003 4 xinyan 10.ogg}} '''Xinyan:''' You said that you were walkin' alone, that you spent time in the company of others eatin' Grilled Fish by a fire.
:{{A|vo eqrg003 4 xinyan 11.ogg}} '''Xinyan:''' Your answer was filled with an understandin' of human emotion.
:{{A|vo eqrg003 4 xinyan 12.ogg}} '''Xinyan:''' We've all journeyed down a path of solitude at some point in our lives. Your presence there puts you in good company. You found us and joined us by the fire, and we became friends.
:{{A|vo eqrg003 4 xinyan 13.ogg}} '''Xinyan:''' The road ahead is difficult, but we're never alone. Shiki Taishou, this is the language in my music, and my reward for stickin' to the path right for me. What about you?

:{{A|vo eqrg003 5 shikishogun 01.ogg}} '''Shiki Taishou:''' Harunosuke didn't abandon me... I enlightened him. I helped him to release a burden shouldered for too long.

:{{A|vo eqrg003 5 shikishogun 04.ogg}} '''Shiki Taishou:''' Even as we trained, the god with the power of the Musou no Hitotachi swept across the land with a force of diligent and mighty warriors. They removed all hidden evils from our territory.
:{{A|vo eqrg003 5 shikishogun 05.ogg}} '''Shiki Taishou:''' And just like that, a life's work was rendered unnecessary... No one in this world is prepared when such sorrow befalls them.

:{{A|vo eqrg003 5 shikishogun 07.ogg}} '''Shiki Taishou:''' Still... the fruits of our labor and valiant efforts cannot be denied, even if they were overshadowed.
:{{A|vo eqrg003 5 shikishogun 08.ogg}} '''Shiki Taishou:''' Regardless, the aim that Harunosuke and the samurai sought had been achieved. The samurai no longer needed to devote their life to training...

:{{A|vo eqrg003 5 shikishogun 10.ogg}} '''Shiki Taishou:''' To protect was our shared ambition. And if the world was the object of Harunosuke's protection... then he was the object of mine.
:{{A|vo eqrg003 5 shikishogun 11.ogg}} '''Shiki Taishou:''' As his most prized creation and only friend in the Mystic Onmyou Chamber, I tried to persuade him.
:{{A|vo eqrg003 5 shikishogun 12.ogg}} '''Shiki Taishou:''' He told me that he wanted to set out again in search of a new purpose... that it may take him months, years, or even centuries. It didn't matter to me. All I wanted was for him to achieve that aspiration, and to return to this place anew.
:{{A|vo eqrg003 5 shikishogun 13.ogg}} '''Shiki Taishou:''' And in the endless days of waiting... I fell into a deep slumber...
:{{A|vo eqrg003 5 shikishogun 14.ogg}} '''Shiki Taishou:''' Harunosuke... You're not coming back, are you?
:{{A|vo eqrg003 5 xinyan 01.ogg}} '''Xinyan:''' Don't be upset, Shiki Taishou...
:{{A|vo eqrg003 5 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' If Kamuna Harunosuke learned the power of the adepti arts and transcension, isn't it possible that he became immortal?
:{{A|vo eqrg003 5 shikishogun 15.ogg}} '''Shiki Taishou:''' ...What I've come to realize is that regardless of whether he remains in this world... he shouldn't be the sole purpose of my existence.
:{{A|vo eqrg003 5 shikishogun 16.ogg}} '''Shiki Taishou:''' Meeting all of you helped me understand belief. I believe that Harunosuke is walking his own path now... and I believe that I too can find a path of my own.
:{{A|vo eqrg003 5 shikishogun 17.ogg}} '''Shiki Taishou:''' From birth, we begin to walk in solitude toward an inevitable end. But there are embers in the mist that welcome us, and friendships to be made under the night sky...
:{{A|vo eqrg003 5 shikishogun 18.ogg}} '''Shiki Taishou:''' Our assignment does not end because the journey is long.
:{{A|vo eqrg003 5 shikishogun 19.ogg}} '''Shiki Taishou:''' There was value in everything Harunosuke did... and my purpose is my assignment. That's something that will never change, nor will it be taken away from me.
:{{A|vo eqrg003 5 shikishogun 20.ogg}} '''Shiki Taishou:''' I am Shiki Taishou, the first shikigami, ally of martial artists, and forevermore the overseer of the Mystic Onmyou Chamber.
:{{A|vo eqrg003 5 shikishogun 21.ogg}} '''Shiki Taishou:''' My duty is to assist fighters in reaching ultimate attainment.
:{{A|vo eqrg003 5 shikishogun 22.ogg}} '''Shiki Taishou:''' There will be others in this world attempting to scale the highest peak. I will gladly become a bridge between the mountains — a weapon that carries them through the clouds.
:{{A|vo eqrg003 5 xinyan 02.ogg}} '''Xinyan:''' Now that's what I'm talkin' about, haha!

:{{A|vo eqrg003 5 shikishogun 25.ogg}} '''Shiki Taishou:''' This place is an ever-changing yet reliable training ground. I will continue to stand guard here, and provide training for anyone seeking ultimate attainment.

==Trivia==
* Before [[Kamuna Harunosuke]]'s departure, he recites the following ''{{w|waka}}'': "Rosy-cheeked in the morning, bleached bones by dusk." {{Lang|ja=朝に紅顔ありて、夕べに白骨となる。}} The poem, from No. 794 of {{w|Wakan rōeishū|''Wakan Rōeishū''}} by Fujiwara no Kintō, refers to human aging and the transience of human life.
** [[Hanachirusato]] also recites this ''waka'' piece in the {{Quest|Sacrificial Offering}}.
* The domain's final room, where the cutscene with Kamuna takes place, is reused as the setting for Step 7 in the {{Quest|Silent Seeker of Knowledge}}. The courtyard was altered slightly to replace the target dummy with a patterned rock, which is the key to solving the puzzle and opening the left-hand door.
