:{{A|vo yqeq206 3 idyia 05.ogg}} '''Idyia:''' It's just... For people who stumble upon this place by accident, I think my current form is more approachable than my true one... I—I don't want people to get scared when they see me...
:{{DIcon}} Ah, I wondered!
:{{DIcon}} Aha, I figured...
:{{A|vo yqeq206 3 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What? What is it? And whatever it is, how the heck does everyone know about it?
:{{A|vo yqeq206 3 kokomi 03.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' Um... Well for one thing, I sensed elemental energy in the residents here, but none of them have Visions.
:{{A|vo yqeq206 3 kokomi 04.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' Then my mind started to wander as I was reading a story book, and suddenly I had a thought. Since Hydro Eidolons can change into any form... why not human form?
:{{A|vo yqeq206 3 idyia 06.ogg}} '''Idyia:''' You hit the nail on the head...
:{{A|vo yqeq206 3 idyia 07.ogg}} '''Idyia:''' Alright. In that case, please allow me to introduce myself once more:
:{{A|vo yqeq206 3 idyia 08.ogg}} '''Idyia:''' I am an Oceanid who was exiled here when the former Hydro Archon passed away. My name is Idyia.
:;(Idyia transforms into an Oceanid)
:{{DIcon}} An Oceanid...
:{{A|vo yqeq206 3 klee 02.ogg}} '''Klee:''' Wow, Idyia, you're so pretty!
:{{A|vo yqeq206 3 idyia 09.ogg}} '''Idyia:''' Heh... Now that I'm in my true form, I suddenly feel a little embarrassed talking to you all...
:{{A|vo yqeq206 3 eula 03.ogg}} '''Eula:''' You look stunning. You should be flaunting this look at every opportunity.
:{{A|vo yqeq206 3 idyia 10.ogg}} '''Idyia:''' Come on, I'm too shy!
:{{A|vo yqeq206 3 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wait... So does this mean that all the people we met in here are actually...
:{{A|vo yqeq206 3 kaeya 03.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' I'm guessing that the human counterparts to these Hydro alter egos are long gone.
:{{A|vo yqeq206 3 idyia 11.ogg}} '''Idyia:''' That's right. When they wanted to leave, I took them to the edge of the desert...
:{{A|vo yqeq206 3 idyia 12.ogg}} '''Idyia:''' The "components" are, in fact, gifts that they gave to me before they left.
:{{A|vo yqeq206 3 idyia 13.ogg}} '''Idyia:''' But I'm always curious about what brings people here... So I used the Streaming Projector to bring their wishes to life.
:{{A|vo yqeq206 3 kokomi 05.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' The power to grant wishes... but only within the confines of the bottle.
:{{A|vo yqeq206 3 idyia 14.ogg}} '''Idyia:''' Exactly.
:{{A|vo yqeq206 3 kaeya 04.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' It's a truly extraordinary light.
:{{A|vo yqeq206 3 kokomi 06.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' I've just realized something... When the components fell from the core, it appeared as if they had returned to their respective owners. But actually...
:{{A|vo yqeq206 3 kokomi 07.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' It was after the components landed where they did that their owners and the things associated with them arose around them to form the different zones.
:{{A|vo yqeq206 3 collei 03.ogg}} '''Collei:''' So now that the components have been retrieved, does that mean that all those things are gone...?
:{{A|vo yqeq206 3 idyia 15.ogg}} '''Idyia:''' Don't worry, they'll be quite safe. As long as I remember them... they'll never disappear.
:{{A|vo yqeq206 3 idyia 16.ogg}} '''Idyia:''' However much we might criticize each other, or get into scuffles... In this mirage, they will always be my friends.
:{{A|vo yqeq206 3 klee 03.ogg}} '''Klee:''' I had so much fun in the Choo-Choo Cart and hanging out with Mr. Director! I'll never forget them either!
:{{A|vo yqeq206 3 collei 04.ogg}} '''Collei:''' Me neither. I'll always remember my adventures in this fantasy land.
:{{A|vo yqeq206 3 idyia 17.ogg}} '''Idyia:''' Haha, very good. But it's probably time I set this wheel in motion.
:{{A|vo yqeq206 3 collei 05.ogg}} '''Collei:''' This one's all yours, Idyia! Our magical mascot.
:{{A|vo yqeq206 3 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Aaah... please work...
:{{A|vo yqeq206 3 idyia 18.ogg}} '''Idyia:''' ...
:{{A|vo yqeq206 3 idyia 19.ogg}} '''Idyia:''' ...
:{{DIcon}} ...
:{{A|vo yqeq206 3 idyia 20.ogg}} '''Idyia:''' Huh? That's strange, nothing happened... Has it lost some power because of the incident?
:{{A|vo yqeq206 3 idyia 21.ogg}} '''Idyia:''' Oh, crumbs... Not now, not right off the back of everyone putting me on a pedestal... And me acting like this was going to be my big moment...
:{{A|vo yqeq206 3 idyia 22.ogg}} '''Idyia:''' *sob* Someone get me a bottle, I'm hiding myself away! See you in a hundred years!
:{{A|vo yqeq206 3 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Uhh... You're already in a bottle...
:{{A|vo yqeq206 3 idyia 23.ogg}} '''Idyia:''' What now? This was the only way... Now I'll never be able to show you how the Veluriyam Mirage is supposed to look...
:{{A|vo yqeq206 3 kokomi 08.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' Hold on... I have an idea.
:{{A|vo yqeq206 3 idyia 24.ogg}} '''Idyia:''' Yes, General Sangonomiya? I'm all ears!
:{{A|vo yqeq206 3 kokomi 09.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' If it's okay with you, would you let me borrow the Shinrou Casket from the domain's core?
:{{A|vo yqeq206 3 idyia 25.ogg}} '''Idyia:''' Ah, the Shinrou Casket... That sounds familiar. One second...
:{{A|vo yqeq206 3 idyia 26.ogg}} '''Idyia:''' Here, is this it?
:{{A|vo yqeq206 3 klee 04.ogg}} '''Klee:''' Wow! A huge shell!
:{{A|vo yqeq206 3 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' It's the relic that Kokomi mentioned earlier! So this is where it's been hiding!
:{{A|vo yqeq206 3 kokomi 10.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' It was once a ritual vessel used for making offerings in the [[Mouun Shrine]]. It's made from the remains of a [[youkai]] called the shinkirou, and it can listen to the wishes of those who come to pray to build up "shinki," which gives it its power.
:{{A|vo yqeq206 3 kokomi 11.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' Several centuries ago, the relic was lost when the last Prefect of Yashiori died in battle. Its final resting place was unknown...
:{{A|vo yqeq206 3 kokomi 12.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' The pearl that goes with it should be able to sense the casket's location. But when, unbeknownst to anyone at the time, the casket disappeared inside the core of the Veluriyam Mirage, the pearl's light died out.
:{{A|vo yqeq206 3 klee 05.ogg}} '''Klee:''' Huh? How come?
:{{A|vo yqeq206 3 kaeya 05.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' Well, imagine it was a sound instead of light. If the room is too big, you can't hear anything from outside the door, can you?
:{{A|vo yqeq206 3 klee 06.ogg}} '''Klee:''' Ohhh! I get it now. The shell must've been having too much fun one day, and got locked in the solitary confinement room.
:{{A|vo yqeq206 3 idyia 27.ogg}} '''Idyia:''' I understand now, too! The core has been wearing out recently... That's why you were able to follow the pearl all the way here.
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (Sounds just like my Treasure Compasses...)
:{{A|vo yqeq206 3 kokomi 13.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' ...To get back to the story, without the offerings at the shrine, this vessel quickly loses its power...
:{{A|vo yqeq206 3 kokomi 14.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' Yet countless people who have visited this domain brought their wishes with them, and left a small piece of themselves behind along with their gifts. These have the same effect as the offerings at the shrine.
:{{A|vo yqeq206 3 idyia 28.ogg}} '''Idyia:''' Wow... I never knew this thing was so powerful...
:{{A|vo yqeq206 3 kokomi 15.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' It is. Powerful enough to help you repair the Veluriyam Mirage, with any luck.
:{{A|vo yqeq206 3 idyia 29.ogg}} '''Idyia:''' But... what do I do with it...?
:{{A|vo yqeq206 3 kokomi 16.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' It's simple. We just need to awaken it by telling it what we wish for.
:{{A|vo yqeq206 3 kokomi 17.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' For example... My name is Sangonomiya Kokomi, the Divine Priestess of Watatsumi Island...
:{{A|vo yqeq206 3 kokomi 18.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' And my wish is to use my critical thinking and strategic planning skills to bring a little more joy into the lives of my fellow Watatsumi Islanders, as well as the lives of everyone I cherish.
:{{A|vo yqeq206 3 kokomi 19.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' Idyia, what do you wish for?
:{{A|vo yqeq206 3 idyia 30.ogg}} '''Idyia:''' Me? I...
:{{A|vo yqeq206 3 idyia 31.ogg}} '''Idyia:''' My wish is that all those who have sojourned to the Veluriyam Mirage in the past will achieve what they truly wish for. Not just in this domain, but out there, too.
:{{A|vo yqeq206 3 idyia 32.ogg}} '''Idyia:''' Even though I know full well that trying to build a railway in the outside world is just a pipe dream... and that Maymunah will probably just go back to being a scholar...
:{{A|vo yqeq206 3 idyia 33.ogg}} '''Idyia:''' And I know that Zosimos has a lot of improving to do as a playwright... it's going to be tough for him back in Fontaine. Chasing your dreams is hard work!
:{{A|vo yqeq206 3 idyia 34.ogg}} '''Idyia:''' Despite all of that, I still hope...
:{{A|vo yqeq206 3 idyia 35.ogg}} '''Idyia:''' That somehow, someday, they will achieve their dreams.
;(A cinematic begins)
:;(The Shinrou Casket begins to glow and everyone looks on as she brings it to Idyia)
::'''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' Okay, the combined power of our hopes and dreams is at your disposal
:;(Idyia relives her memories of the human counterparts of the three brothers, Maymunah, and Zosimos leaving the Veluriyam Mirage)
:;(Streams of blue energy flow into the Central Hub and it begins to glow)
:;(The Hydro alter ego of Ferdinand notices while inspecting Choo-Choo Cart tracks and goes to tell his brothers)
::'''Ferdinand:''' Look, the wheel's been fixed!
:;(The Hydro alter egos of Zosimos and Maymunah also notice and stop to watch as the Central Hub begins to turn)
:;(Idyia leads the Traveler and others back to the Silver Bottle Courtyard)
::'''Klee:''' C'mon, hurry!
:;(Cinematic ends)
:{{A|vo yqeq206 4 klee 01.ogg}} '''Klee:''' Yay, Idyia, you're back to normal!
:{{A|vo yqeq206 4 idyia 01.ogg}} '''Idyia:''' ...
:{{DIcon}} Are you alright?
:{{A|vo yqeq206 4 idyia 02.ogg}} '''Idyia:''' Everyone's praise and curious questions went to my head... I said so many things I'm so ashamed of, and I... I lost the courage to live on.
:{{A|vo yqeq206 4 kokomi 01.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' Please don't say that. Yours was a noble wish.
:{{A|vo yqeq206 4 collei 01.ogg}} '''Collei:''' Yeah. And you weren't granting wishes for yourself. You did it for other people.
:{{A|vo yqeq206 4 collei 02.ogg}} '''Collei:''' I have friends like that, too! Other people's hopes and dreams are what motivate them. They'll work tirelessly just to see them smile.
:{{A|vo yqeq206 4 collei 03.ogg}} '''Collei:''' If you ask me... That's one of the most noble things a person can aspire to.
:{{A|vo yqeq206 4 idyia 03.ogg}} '''Idyia:''' Please, no more praise... I—I'm really not comfortable with it... It makes me feel so ashamed...
:{{A|vo yqeq206 4 idyia 04.ogg}} '''Idyia:''' Someone like me doesn't deserve so many people's praise... It's like I'm dreaming.
:{{A|vo yqeq206 4 eula 01.ogg}} '''Eula:''' Well, at least the domain is fixed now. And all the components are back in place.
:{{A|vo yqeq206 4 klee 02.ogg}} '''Klee:''' Mmm...
:{{A|vo yqeq206 4 kaeya 01.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' What's the matter, Klee?
:{{A|vo yqeq206 4 klee 03.ogg}} '''Klee:''' I suddenly have loads and loads of more wishes! I wanna ride the Choo-Choo Cart again, and look down from up on top of the big wheel!
:{{A|vo yqeq206 4 klee 04.ogg}} '''Klee:''' Is there a way to get up on top of the wheel, Idyia?
:{{A|vo yqeq206 4 idyia 05.ogg}} '''Idyia:''' There is a way, but there's only space for a very few people...
:{{A|vo yqeq206 4 klee 05a.ogg}} {{A|vo yqeq206 4 klee 05b.ogg}} '''Klee:''' That's okay, I can go up by myself! ...Um, but it'd be more fun with {{MC|m=Mr.|f=Miss}} Honorary Knight...
:{{DIcon}} I shall not leave your side, my lady.
:{{A|vo yqeq206 4 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Are we sure about this? It's so high...
:{{A|vo yqeq206 4 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What happens if we fall off?
:{{DIcon}} ...I thought you could fly?
:{{A|vo yqeq206 4 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Well yeah, but... Paimon's just worried for you!
:{{A|vo yqeq206 4 idyia 06.ogg}} '''Idyia:''' Don't worry, I'll be there to make sure no one falls off. I haven't been up there in a long time myself.

;(While riding to the top of the hub)
:{{A|vo yqeq206 5 klee 01.ogg}} '''Klee:''' Woooow, so high! I can see everything!
:{{A|vo yqeq206 5 klee 02.ogg}} '''Klee:''' Idyia, next time you need to bring Kaeya and the others up here!
:{{A|vo yqeq206 5 idyia 01.ogg}} '''Idyia:''' Haha, sure thing.

;(Reach the top of the hub)
:{{A|vo yqeq206 5 idyia 02.ogg}} '''Idyia:''' Whenever people have to leave this domain, I like to come up here and spend some time alone after I've seen them out.
:{{A|vo yqeq206 5 idyia 03.ogg}} '''Idyia:''' They're always overjoyed when they first arrive and start bringing their imaginations to life...
:{{A|vo yqeq206 5 idyia 04.ogg}} '''Idyia:''' But once they realize that they can't take anything home with them, they get upset. Some of them can't bear to leave, others regret ever setting foot in this place.
:{{A|vo yqeq206 5 klee 03.ogg}} '''Klee:''' Do you ever get sad, Idyia?
:{{A|vo yqeq206 5 idyia 05.ogg}} '''Idyia:''' ...I feel lonely, at times. But not sad.
:{{A|vo yqeq206 5 idyia 06.ogg}} '''Idyia:''' A lot of people destroy everything they created before leaving. But some don't, like the residents you met.
:{{A|vo yqeq206 5 idyia 07.ogg}} '''Idyia:''' Before they left, they asked me to make replicas of themselves using Hydro Eidolons. Then they tasked these replicas with maintaining everything they built here... as if this was their way of keeping their dreams alive.
:{{A|vo yqeq206 5 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' That's beautiful.
:{{A|vo yqeq206 5 idyia 08.ogg}} '''Idyia:''' Yeah. I don't know how they're faring in the outside world, but... just the thought that one day, they might achieve their dreams, and live on the outside just as their counterparts do in here... That's enough to make me happy.
:{{A|vo yqeq206 5 idyia 09.ogg}} '''Idyia:''' It feels like... I'm here waiting for them in the future, where they've achieved everything they wanted.
:{{DIcon}} You're so nice, Idyia.
:{{A|vo yqeq206 5 idyia 10.ogg}} '''Idyia:''' Uhh... really?
:{{A|vo yqeq206 5 idyia 11.ogg}} '''Idyia:''' ...I just think that every dream, every wish, is like a flame in a bottle.
:{{A|vo yqeq206 5 idyia 12.ogg}} '''Idyia:''' Whether someone is still working towards their dream, or living it already...
:{{A|vo yqeq206 5 idyia 13.ogg}} '''Idyia:''' As long as whenever they think back to that spark of light within them, it still makes them smile fondly... That's all it takes.
:{{A|vo yqeq206 5 klee 04.ogg}} '''Klee:''' Well, I feel super happy right now!
:{{A|vo yqeq206 5 idyia 14.ogg}} '''Idyia:''' Haha, then I guess I've finally paid Alice back after all these years. Funny to think I've been in the middle of a desert this whole time... it's just a giant muddy swamp to me...
:{{A|vo yqeq206 5 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Time for Paimon to give you a nickname! Mud Fairy! Watch out for Idyia the Mud Fairy.
:{{A|vo yqeq206 5 idyia 15.ogg}} '''Idyia:''' How dare you mock me! Roar, I'll gobble you up in one mouthful!
:{{A|vo yqeq206 5 idyia 16.ogg}} '''Idyia:''' ...I'm still embarrassed to have shown you my uglier side, but I'm glad the Veluriyam Mirage is up and running again. This place is going to be bustling with activity again soon enough. I hope you'll take some time to enjoy yourselves.
:{{DIcon}} Well, we still have some dreams to attend to...
:{{A|vo yqeq206 5 klee 05.ogg}} '''Klee:''' Yep, I wanna get everyone together...
:{{A|vo yqeq206 5 klee 06.ogg}} '''Klee:''' For one last ride on the Choo-Choo Cart!
{{Dialogue End}}

==Dialogue==
===Suspicious Trails===
{{Quest Description|The self-proclaimed Editor-in-Chief of The Steambird and a journalist come for an ad-hoc interview with Yun Jin, but they seem somewhat suspicious...}}
{{Dialogue Start}}

{{Quest Description|What can we do for these youkai? If you were to answer honestly, it could only be a grand farewell party.}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Go to the Grand Narukami Shrine and look for Yae Miko)
:{{A|vo ymlq004 1 yaemiko 01.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' Well hello there, my little helpers, so nice of you to join me. You're right on time, too.
:{{A|vo ymlq004 1 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hmph, as if we had a choice. We just want our paychecks.
:{{A|vo ymlq004 1 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So, Miko, what exactly do we have to do to make this [[Hyakkiyakou]] happen?
:{{A|vo ymlq004 1 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Also, to be clear, we actually have no idea what it even means.
:{{A|vo ymlq004 1 yaemiko 02.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' It might sound ominous, but to put it simply, the Hyakkiyakou is just a gathering of the youkai.
:{{A|vo ymlq004 1 yaemiko 03.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' Back in the day, at youkai gatherings, once everyone had had plenty to drink, one by one they'd start soaring into the sky with their youkai powers. There were so many of them that their silhouettes would block out the moon.
:{{A|vo ymlq004 1 yaemiko 04.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' But now, the youkai memories that leak from the Ley Lines are weak. They are no longer able to fly.
:{{A|vo ymlq004 1 yaemiko 05.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' So, I will be performing a convocation ritual for them, gathering all the wandering memories together in one place.
:{{A|vo ymlq004 1 yaemiko 06.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' When the time comes, they will gather in the sky above the Grand Narukami Shrine. Once their energy is spent, they will be satisfied, and return to where they belong.
:{{DIcon}} I see. I understand.
:{{A|vo ymlq004 1 yaemiko 07.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' All the preparations for the ritual have actually been made well in advance. Remember the incantation and the mention of "moonless night" that I added to our novel?
:{{A|vo ymlq004 1 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh yeah, something about reciting "The Secret Spells of Lady Kitsune" on a moonless night.
:{{A|vo ymlq004 1 yaemiko 08.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' That's the one. Actually, it's not a wish-granting incantation at all. It's a spell to help calm the Ley Line memories.
:{{A|vo ymlq004 1 yaemiko 09.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' When that time comes, let's all pitch in and help send them on their way!
:{{DIcon}} What do you need from me?
:{{A|vo ymlq004 1 yaemiko 10.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' I will start the ritual preparations shortly, and at that time, I need you to do two things:
:{{A|vo ymlq004 1 yaemiko 11.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' First, tell the shrine maidens to leave the mountain.
:{{A|vo ymlq004 1 yaemiko 12.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' During the Hyakkiyakou, a whole swarm of youkai memories will be hanging around in the air above the Grand Narukami Shrine. Having the shrine maidens leave avoids the bothersome issue of someone potentially getting possessed.
:{{A|vo ymlq004 1 yaemiko 13.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' After that, I will commence the ritual, and the memories will begin to congregate. This will take some time. I need you at the foot of Mt. Yougou during this part to keep an eye on nearby monster activity.
:{{A|vo ymlq004 1 yaemiko 14.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' The memories are normally dispersed, and don't pose a threat. But when their energy is concentrated, it is likely to disturb the monsters.
:{{A|vo ymlq004 1 yaemiko 15.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' They may see this as an opportunity to try and make it up the mountain. I need you to fend them off so that that doesn't happen.
:{{A|vo ymlq004 1 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Alright, got it. Then what?
:{{A|vo ymlq004 1 yaemiko 16.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' Hmm... Well, if at that point you felt like coming to the shrine and getting a close-up view of the youkai, I wouldn't say no.
:{{A|vo ymlq004 1 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Okay, {{Traveler}}, let's get going!
----
{{Dialogue End}}

:{{A|vo txslq003 10 inaam 01.ogg}} '''Innam:''' Ah! Oguz!
:{{A|vo txslq003 10 inaam 02.ogg}} '''Innam:''' Are you alright? W—Were you attacked?
:{{A|vo txslq003 10 oguz 01.ogg}} '''Oguz:''' Argh... No, no... I'm alright. I was just chasing after that figure, and then, all of a sudden, I didn't feel so hot...
:{{A|vo txslq003 10 emilie 01.ogg}} '''Emilie:''' Let me take a look.

:{{A|vo txslq003 10 collei 01.ogg}} '''Collei:''' This feeling... I've encountered it before...
:{{A|vo txslq003 10 emilie 02.ogg}} '''Emilie:''' Everything looks alright. It was probably just the stress of the chase combined with the impact of the environment. A bit of rest would do you some good.
:{{A|vo txslq003 10 oguz 02.ogg}} '''Oguz:''' I can't rest! Mr. Edgar is still in there! He taught my sister how to make perfume...
:{{A|vo txslq003 10 oguz 03.ogg}} '''Oguz:''' He's a good man... I can't just abandon him to die by Kirya's hand!
:{{A|vo txslq003 10 shyam 01.ogg}} '''Shyam:''' Oguz... You need to calm down and listen to me. Edgar is the one we're after. He and Kirya are the same person.
:{{A|vo txslq003 10 oguz 04.ogg}} '''Oguz:''' But... How is that possible!? I thought you said Kirya was in his thirties?
:{{A|vo txslq003 10 oguz 05.ogg}} '''Oguz:''' Mr. Edgar is seventy something... Changing your appearance to look decades older... That doesn't seem possible!
:{{A|vo txslq003 10 emilie 03.ogg}} '''Emilie:''' That's precisely why he had to resort to extraordinary measures to age himself.
:{{DIcon}} ...A Delusion.
:{{A|vo txslq003 10 emilie 04.ogg}} '''Emilie:''' Kirya used a Delusion to bring back the Auguste flower, corroding his body in the process... just like his older sister.
:{{A|vo txslq003 10 oguz 06.ogg}} '''Oguz:''' No... He couldn't have. Mr. Edgar has been in Port Ormos for years! If someone started impersonating him all of a sudden, we would have noticed!
:{{A|vo txslq003 10 emilie 05.ogg}} '''Emilie:''' And what if the impersonation started before he ever set foot in Sumeru?
:{{A|vo txslq003 10 oguz 07.ogg}} '''Oguz:''' I... Uh...
:{{A|vo txslq003 10 emilie 06.ogg}} '''Emilie:''' ...I've yet to confirm it, but I suspect Kirya killed the real Edgar in Fontaine not long after his release from prison.
:{{A|vo txslq003 10 emilie 07.ogg}} '''Emilie:''' While Edgar was incarcerated, Kirya started making preparations to replace him, including forcefully aging his body, studying perfumery... and planning the real Edgar's demise.
:{{A|vo txslq003 10 emilie 08.ogg}} '''Emilie:''' The new "Edgar" then decided to relocate to Sumeru, seemingly out of an innocuous desire to let go of the past. He even left perfume-making in favor of mentoring students... But, these decisions were all for a specific purpose... the need to distance himself from anyone who might see through the facade.
:{{A|vo txslq003 10 emilie 09.ogg}} '''Emilie:''' And Sumeru fit the bill to a tee. With no one around to question his identity, all he had to do was grow a beard, don a pair of glasses, make a few minor alterations to his appearance... and everyone would believe he was exactly who he claimed — Edgar, a perfumer from Fontaine.
:{{A|vo txslq003 10 emilie 10.ogg}} '''Emilie:''' As the years went by, he removed his disguise little by little and continued to refine his skills... It would have been a gradual process, one that ensured no one around him would notice anything unusual.
:{{A|vo txslq003 10 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' That explains why Sylvain said he barely recognized Edgar back at the hotel...
:{{A|vo txslq003 10 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' He aged himself decades beyond his years just so he could accomplish his revenge... Is that even worth it?
:{{A|vo txslq003 10 oguz 08.ogg}} '''Oguz:''' I... I need to find Mr. Edgar... He's not that kind of person, he can't be... *coughing*
:{{A|vo txslq003 10 shyam 02.ogg}} '''Shyam:''' What you really need is to get out of here and rest!
:{{A|vo txslq003 10 oguz 09.ogg}} '''Oguz:''' No, I... I can keep going!
:{{A|vo txslq003 10 collei 02.ogg}} '''Collei:''' Wait... This environment is likely being influenced by the Delusion. Any discomfort, no matter how slight, should not be treated lightly.
:{{A|vo txslq003 10 collei 03.ogg}} '''Collei:''' I know how to relieve your symptoms, Mr. Oguz... Please, come with me and rest.
:{{A|vo txslq003 10 collei 04.ogg}} '''Collei:''' I'm sure Kirya... No, Edgar wouldn't want any more innocent people implicated in all this.
:{{A|vo txslq003 10 emilie 11.ogg}} '''Emilie:''' Collei's right. {{Traveler}} and I will take things from here. From our brief exposure to "Auguste," it would seem the substance has little effect on us...
:{{A|vo txslq003 10 emilie 12.ogg}} '''Emilie:''' This leads me to believe those blessed with a Vision or capable of wielding elemental power are more resistant to the effects of abnormal elemental energy. In other words, this environment doesn't pose as much of a risk to us.
:{{A|vo txslq003 10 emilie 13.ogg}} '''Emilie:''' Actually, now that I think about it, this stronghold likely has multiple points of entry. If the target were to escape from a different point of entry, that might allow him to evade capture...
:{{A|vo txslq003 10 emilie 14.ogg}} '''Emilie:''' ...I hate to trouble you, but we need people to survey the perimeter...
:{{A|vo txslq003 10 oguz 10.ogg}} '''Oguz:''' I...
:{{A|vo txslq003 10 shyam 03.ogg}} '''Shyam:''' Heh... Thanks.
:{{A|vo txslq003 10 shyam 04.ogg}} '''Shyam:''' ...Hear that? We're heading out! There's work to be done! Oguz, head back to Port Ormos and start gathering reinforcements!
:{{A|vo txslq003 10 oguz 11.ogg}} '''Oguz:''' Got it...
:{{A|vo txslq003 10 collei 05.ogg}} '''Collei:''' {{Traveler}}, Emilie, Paimon... Please, be careful.
:{{A|vo txslq003 10 collei 06.ogg}} '''Collei:''' For someone whose only purpose in life is revenge, there's no telling what they'll do when there's no reason to move forward.
:{{A|vo txslq003 10 emilie 15.ogg}} '''Emilie:''' Don't worry. This isn't the end, not for us... or for Kirya.
:{{A|vo txslq003 10 emilie 16.ogg}} '''Emilie:''' ...We're not going to let "Auguste" kill anyone else. It's time for the mythos to fade into obscurity.

:{{A|vo txslq003 16 edgar 11.ogg}} '''Kirya:''' ...So, you switched the bottles of "Auguste" and then lied to me about Sylvain's death...
:{{A|vo txslq003 16 emilie 05.ogg}} '''Emilie:''' Convincing you that your revenge had been completed... was the easiest way to get you to let down your guard.
:{{A|vo txslq003 16 edgar 12.ogg}} '''Kirya:''' Impossible... even if you found a way to switch out the bottles, there's no way you could have made an accord!
:{{A|vo txslq003 16 edgar 13.ogg}} '''Kirya:''' If "Auguste" was so easy to replicate, Yelena wouldn't have...
:{{A|vo txslq003 16 emilie 06.ogg}} '''Emilie:''' It was a combination of Rainbow Roses, Glaze Lilies, and Cecilias... Those ingredients would have conflicted with each other if you tried to combine them in the past.
:{{A|vo txslq003 16 emilie 07.ogg}} '''Emilie:''' But recently, we found a way for them to work together.
:{{A|vo txslq003 16 edgar 14.ogg}} '''Kirya:''' ...Rainbow Roses... Glaze Lilies... and Cecilias?
:{{A|vo txslq003 16 emilie 08.ogg}} '''Emilie:''' ..."Auguste" was created over ten years ago. All this time, people never stopped analyzing it, never stopped trying to recreate it.
:{{A|vo txslq003 16 emilie 09.ogg}} '''Emilie:''' Perfumery techniques are advancing day by day. We've found better ways to extract essential oils, separate oils and fats... we even discovered new ways to combine fragrances together.
:{{A|vo txslq003 16 emilie 10.ogg}} '''Emilie:''' The mythos surrounding "Auguste" may have been untouchable almost twenty years ago... But, now, it's time for it to become a thing of the past.
:{{A|vo txslq003 16 edgar 15.ogg}} '''Kirya:''' The past...
:{{A|vo txslq003 16 emilie 11.ogg}} '''Emilie:''' You've been working as a perfumer for all these years... You should have always known that it is possible to make an accord, even if only in theory.
:{{A|vo txslq003 16 emilie 12.ogg}} '''Emilie:''' But, the meaning you assigned to "Auguste" became so inflated, you allowed yourself to get lost in it... just like the "Perfume Mania" that captivated the public all those years ago.
:{{A|vo txslq003 16 emilie 13.ogg}} '''Emilie:''' You believed in its "divinity" and "grandeur"... You believed it was entirely "one of a kind."
:{{DIcon}} And, in the process, you forgot...
:{{DIcon}} That it was a bottle of perfume, nothing more.
:{{A|vo txslq003 16 emilie 14.ogg}} '''Emilie:''' Your obsession with "Auguste" is also what allowed us to predict how you intended your plan to end... and to make preparations in advance.
:{{A|vo txslq003 16 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' We just didn't expect it to happen so fast...
:{{DIcon}} Or that you would activate the Delusion.
:{{A|vo txslq003 16 edgar 16.ogg}} '''Kirya:''' Ha... Haha...
:{{A|vo txslq003 16 edgar 17.ogg}} '''Kirya:''' Well... you hit the nail on the head, now didn't you?
:{{A|vo txslq003 16 edgar 18.ogg}} '''Kirya:''' So... Sylvain isn't dead...
:{{A|vo txslq003 16 edgar 19.ogg}} '''Kirya:''' Since you've been preparing your accord since last night... I assume you've also figured out my method, then?
:{{A|vo txslq003 16 edgar 20.ogg}} '''Kirya:''' That means the news of Sylvain's death, the crowd gathered outside the hotel this morning... It was all an act you put on with the Sheriff?
:{{A|vo txslq003 16 emilie 15.ogg}} '''Emilie:''' ...Yes. If we hadn't, you might have resorted to the Delusion out of desperation, or continued to use your "Spirit Borneol" and "Auguste" combination to wreak havoc...
:{{A|vo txslq003 16 edgar 21.ogg}} '''Kirya:''' Who knows... Maybe I would have just offed myself then and there.
:{{A|vo txslq003 16 emilie 16.ogg}} '''Emilie:''' I know if you had things your way, you would carry the truth of "Edgar's" demise and the secrets of this garden to the grave, but I'm sorry, Master... I don't want to see any more death.
:{{A|vo txslq003 16 emilie 17.ogg}} '''Emilie:''' Sylvain only inhaled a small amount of poison. He's being detained as we speak.
:{{A|vo txslq003 16 emilie 18.ogg}} '''Emilie:''' All the crimes he concealed back then will be exposed in a court of law for everyone to see, and all his secrets will be revealed... The same goes for you as well.
:{{A|vo txslq003 16 edgar 22.ogg}} '''Kirya:''' Is that so... Well, I suppose I'll be spending the rest of my days in a prison cell, then.
:{{A|vo txslq003 16 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Woah... He accepted that kinda fast...
:{{A|vo txslq003 16 edgar 23.ogg}} '''Kirya:''' ...I don't feel the need to justify my actions, nor do I intend to repent for them.
:{{A|vo txslq003 16 edgar 24.ogg}} '''Kirya:''' I did what I set out to do. I may have lost in the end, but it was my choice every step of the way. And if I could do it all over again...
:{{A|vo txslq003 16 edgar 25.ogg}} '''Kirya:''' Hah... But, there's no going back, is there?
:{{Color|menu|You hear the voices of Collei and the others in the distance...}}
:{{A|vo txslq003 16 collei 01.ogg}} '''Collei:''' Be careful, everyone. This environment is dangerous, I'll lead the way...
:{{A|vo txslq003 16 shyam 01.ogg}} '''Shyam:''' ...Stick close... We can't let Edgar die...
:{{A|vo txslq003 16 edgar 26.ogg}} '''Kirya:''' Looks like I'm almost out of time... Although, I do have one final question, Emilie.
:{{A|vo txslq003 16 emilie 19.ogg}} '''Emilie:''' ...Of course, Master.
:{{A|vo txslq003 16 edgar 27.ogg}} '''Kirya:''' The combination you used to make your accord... How did you figure it out?
:{{A|vo txslq003 16 emilie 20.ogg}} '''Emilie:''' ...The scent of "Auguste" is complex and varied, yet the main ingredient consists of a single variety of flower.
:{{A|vo txslq003 16 emilie 21.ogg}} '''Emilie:''' So, as I was analyzing the sample yesterday, I got to thinking... What if the scent of the Auguste flower was already imbued with that complexity during its cultivation?
:{{A|vo txslq003 16 edgar 28.ogg}} '''Kirya:''' You're saying... Yelena designed "Auguste" to have the scent of multiple flowers?
:{{A|vo txslq003 16 emilie 22.ogg}} '''Emilie:''' Rainbow Roses, Glaze Lilies, Cecilias... The perfumers of the past knew that if you combined their essential oils directly, they would just cancel each other out. It was a conundrum they could never solve.
:{{A|vo txslq003 16 emilie 23.ogg}} '''Emilie:''' But, if you cultivate a new flower species that intrinsically carries the unique features of those three scents, you can bypass that issue entirely... It goes without saying, that for the time, this idea was a stroke of genius.
:{{A|vo txslq003 16 edgar 29.ogg}} '''Kirya:''' Rainbow Roses, Glaze Lilies, and Cecilias... Hah, those really do seem like flowers you would choose...
:{{A|vo txslq003 16 edgar 30.ogg}} '''Kirya:''' ...Yelena.
:{{Color|menu|Kirya accepts his fate without saying a word.}}
:{{Black Screen|Not long after that, the Eremites rush over...}}
:{{Black Screen|Kirya accepts his fate without saying a word.}}

;(Leave the domain)
:{{Black Screen|And thus, all the turmoil caused by "Auguste" finally comes to an end...<br>A few weeks later, you receive a letter from Emilie inviting you to catch up in Fontaine...}}
----
;(Approach the upper floor)
:{{A|vo txslq003 18 citizenfemalec 01.ogg}} '''Crowd in Spirited Discussion:''' ...Did you know? Miss Emilie's releasing a new perfume!
:{{A|vo txslq003 18 citizenfemaled 01.ogg}} '''Crowd in Spirited Discussion:''' Ah, right! I heard about that! I think it's called... "Yelena"...
:{{A|vo txslq003 18 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' ...Seems like everyone in Fontaine is talking about the new perfume you're releasing!
:{{A|vo txslq003 18 emilie 01.ogg}} '''Emilie:''' I was hoping to release it without such a fuss, but... the news spread way faster than I expected.
:{{A|vo txslq003 18 emilie 02.ogg}} '''Emilie:''' I just hope it won't become the source of some new "myth"... especially after all the work we did to demystify "Auguste."
:{{DIcon}} About this perfume...
:{{DIcon}} Did you use the accord from back in Sumeru?
:{{A|vo txslq003 18 emilie 03.ogg}} '''Emilie:''' I did! Although, I made a few modifications to the formula to make the scent more pleasant and long-lasting... I actually brought a few samples with me today. I hope they're to your liking.
:{{A|vo txslq003 18 emilie 04.ogg}} '''Emilie:''' Also... I was hoping you could try out the fragrance before I officially release it, and tell me your thoughts.
:{{A|vo txslq003 18 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Of course! A good sense of taste and sense of smell go hand in hand, you know. Just leave it to Paimon!
:{{A|vo txslq003 18 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' ...*sniff* Ooh, it smells great!
:{{DIcon}} I'm not sure that's the kind of feedback she had in mind...
:{{A|vo txslq003 18 emilie 05.ogg}} '''Emilie:''' Haha, it's alright. All feedback is worth considering.
:{{A|vo txslq003 18 emilie 06.ogg}} '''Emilie:''' Besides, when it comes to perfume... commenting on whether it smells good is the most straightforward assessment you can ask for. There doesn't always have to be a deeper meaning.
:{{DIcon}} Speaking of deeper meanings... Kirya's final question...
:{{A|vo txslq003 18 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Right... Do those flowers have some special meaning? Hearing their names seemed to have an effect on him...
:{{A|vo txslq003 18 emilie 07.ogg}} '''Emilie:''' Hm, if I had to guess... I'd say it probably has something to do with the language of flowers.
:{{A|vo txslq003 18 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' The language of flowers? Oh, we've heard of that before. Paimon remembers hearing something like... the "Cecilia" represents "the true feelings of the prodigal son"...
:{{A|vo txslq003 18 emilie 08.ogg}} '''Emilie:''' What each flower is said to represent varies by person and across different moments in history... the same is true for the flowers that make up the scent of Auguste.
:{{A|vo txslq003 18 emilie 09.ogg}} '''Emilie:''' After returning to Fontaine, I did some research... and it turns out, the meanings of those three flowers can be reassembled to form a single phrase...
:{{A|vo txslq003 18 emilie 10.ogg}} '''Emilie:''' "...Forget the past, and keep on living."
:{{A|vo txslq003 18 emilie 11.ogg}} '''Emilie:''' Perhaps that's the legacy Yelena always intended, not the nobility and grandeur most people associate with Auguste.
:{{DIcon}} Or maybe... That's what she hoped for her brother...
:{{A|vo txslq003 18 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Do you think Kirya knew about that?
:{{A|vo txslq003 18 emilie 12.ogg}} '''Emilie:''' I paid him a visit before his trial and explained what I found... But, he didn't seem to care.
:{{A|vo txslq003 18 emilie 13.ogg}} '''Emilie:''' "Who knows? Maybe she didn't mean anything by it at all?" — that was his response.
:{{A|vo txslq003 18 emilie 14.ogg}} '''Emilie:''' "...Yelena is gone. We'll never know what she was thinking. We can look for meaning all we want, but it'll never be anything but conjecture."
:<gallery widths="350">
Base Note Auguste Quest Still 1.png
</gallery>
:{{A|vo txslq003 18 emilie 15.ogg}} '''Emilie:''' "Even if that is what she was trying to say, I would never be able to forget her."
:{{A|vo txslq003 18 emilie 16.ogg}} '''Emilie:''' "...Avenging her death... That was the meaning I chose for my life."
:{{A|vo txslq003 18 emilie 17.ogg}} '''Emilie:''' ...Kirya cultivated his revenge like a flower. He was commited to making it bloom, even if, in the end, it didn't bear the fruit he was hoping for...
:{{DIcon}} ...Kirya.
:{{A|vo txslq003 18 emilie 18.ogg}} '''Emilie:''' In any case, he did want me to pass along his thanks.
:{{A|vo txslq003 18 emilie 19.ogg}} '''Emilie:''' "...Thank you for saving my life, for giving me the chance to learn that Auguste... could have carried a very different meaning."
:{{DIcon}} ...
:{{A|vo txslq003 18 emilie 20.ogg}} '''Emilie:''' Love and hatred are a privilege of the living.
:{{A|vo txslq003 18 emilie 21.ogg}} '''Emilie:''' When someone dies, their thoughts, feelings, and intentions die with them. In that sense, what Auguste truly represents in the language of flowers will forever remain a mystery.
:{{A|vo txslq003 18 emilie 22.ogg}} '''Emilie:''' But... even if it's only a conjecture, I would like to believe my own interpretation.
:{{A|vo txslq003 18 emilie 23.ogg}} '''Emilie:''' The meaning we give to flowers, the symbolism we assign to our perfumes... They're constantly twisted and exploited in our imperfect world...
:{{A|vo txslq003 18 emilie 24.ogg}} '''Emilie:''' And yet, at the very outset, they're born from the simplest and most beautiful desires we hold in our heart.
{{Dialogue End}}

==Dialogue==
{{Quest Description|The Court of Fontaine seems to be holding quite a lively promotion event.}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Approach the group in Court of Fontaine: Vasari Passage)
:{{A|vo sgwlq001 1 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' This shop looks popular today... Wonder what the occasion is?
:{{A|vo sgwlq001 1 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hmm... "Butterfly Dew cosmetics, now on sale"... Huh, looks like it.
:{{A|vo sgwlq001 1 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh? Sigewinne's here too?
:{{A|vo sgwlq001 1 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hey there, Sigewinne!
:{{DIcon}} What are the chances.
:{{DIcon}} It's been a while.
:{{A|vo sgwlq001 1 sigewinne 01.ogg}} '''Sigewinne:''' Hello there, {{Traveler}} and Paimon. I hope you're keeping yourselves fit and healthy?
:{{A|vo sgwlq001 1 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You bet we are! So anyway, what are you doing here, Sigewinne?
:{{A|vo sgwlq001 1 sigewinne 02.ogg}} '''Sigewinne:''' The Duke insists I take regular vacations in the Court of Fontaine.
:{{A|vo sgwlq001 1 sigewinne 03.ogg}} '''Sigewinne:''' This one just so happened to coincide with a promotion for a new skincare product, so I came over to take a look. I like to keep up with the latest industry developments when I can, to help me with my magazine articles.
:{{A|vo sgwlq001 1 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wait, you write for a magazine? Which one?
:{{A|vo sgwlq001 1 sigewinne 04.ogg}} '''Sigewinne:''' It's called "[[Beautes en fleurs]]," and it's run by the [[Fontaine Beauty Association]]. I've done lots of articles about skincare for them, using the pen name "Romaritime Flower."
:{{A|vo sgwlq001 1 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, wow! You're "Romaritime Flower"!? If Paimon's not mistaken, you're one of the leading figures in the Fontaine Beauty Association...
:{{DIcon}} Since when did you start reading beauty mags?
:{{A|vo sgwlq001 1 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh? Wh—What's so weird about that? Everyone loves beauty.
:{{A|vo sgwlq001 1 sigewinne 05.ogg}} '''Sigewinne:''' I really like this role. The staff at cosmetics shops are always so polite, and as long as I wear a big smile on my face, I always get the best customer service.
:{{A|vo sgwlq001 1 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Well, they sure don't wanna make an enemy of THE Romaritime Flower...
:{{DIcon}} So what got you interested in beauty products, Sigewinne?
:{{DIcon}} How'd you become a leader in the Beauty Association?
:{{A|vo sgwlq001 1 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Obviously, it's because of Sigewinne's love for beauty. Still, a leader of the Beauty Association... that's incredible...
:{{A|vo sgwlq001 1 sigewinne 06.ogg}} '''Sigewinne:''' The truth is, I study this field because I cherish my own appearance. It has nothing to do with being beautiful or not.
:{{A|vo sgwlq001 1 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ooh... The words of a master beautician defy comprehension... Oh, wait! You're saying that natural beauty is the highest form of beauty, right?
:{{A|vo sgwlq001 1 sigewinne 07.ogg}} '''Sigewinne:''' Not really... Actually, Melusine aesthetics are very different from human ones. We don't view humans based on their appearance.
:{{A|vo sgwlq001 1 sigewinne 08.ogg}} '''Sigewinne:''' If I had to describe our approach, I'd say it's based on... "cuteness."
:{{A|vo sgwlq001 1 paimon 12.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh... Really?
:{{A|vo sgwlq001 1 sigewinne 09.ogg}} '''Sigewinne:''' Yep. Still, I really value my current appearance, and in the process of taking care of it, I've ended up learning quite a lot about skincare and stuff.
:{{A|vo sgwlq001 1 sigewinne 10.ogg}} '''Sigewinne:''' Turns out my knowledge and experience is pretty popular with beauty product lovers. It came as a big surprise to me though.
:{{A|vo sgwlq001 1 paimon 13.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Paimon gets it now. But speaking of your appearance... How come you look human, anyway? Are you, like, only half-Melusine?
:{{A|vo sgwlq001 1 paimon 14.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wait, sorry, sorry! That was probably really offensive, wasn't it...
:{{A|vo sgwlq001 1 sigewinne 11.ogg}} '''Sigewinne:''' No, I don't mind — I'm not mixed, though. I made a decision to turn myself into this form, a very long time ago...
:{{A|vo sgwlq001 1 sigewinne 12.ogg}} '''Sigewinne:''' If you're curious, I could tell you the story.
:{{A|vo sgwlq001 1 paimon 15.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' A shape-shifting story!? Heck yeah, Paimon's interested! You must be too, right, {{Traveler}}?
:{{A|vo sgwlq001 1 sigewinne 13.ogg}} '''Sigewinne:''' Once upon a time...
:{{Color|menu|Sigewinne tells you a tale of a time long past. In the story, a little Melusine doctor wants to cure her ill friend, but the humans who held Melusines in contempt refused to allow it. After drinking a magical potion she got from a witch, and becoming more human-like, she was finally able to help her friend. Nevertheless, after her friend's condition improved, the Melusine chose to leave in silence.}}
;(A cinematic plays)

::'''Sigewinne:''' There was one Melusine who became fascinated with human medicine
::'''Sigewinne:''' But no human wanted her help
::'''Sigewinne:''' And there was one girl who liked Melusines
::'''Sigewinne:''' So no humans would make friends with her
::'''Sigewinne:''' So, the Melusine became the girl's friend
::'''Sigewinne:''' And the girl became the Melusine's "patient"
::'''"The Melusine":''' Your checkup's all done. You're still in perfect health
::'''Girl:''' Thank you, Doctor Melusine!
::'''Sigewinne:''' In this game of doctor and patient, a friendship was born
::'''Sigewinne:''' Then one day, the girl fell ill
::'''Sigewinne:''' The Melusine was the only doctor to arrive on time
::'''Sigewinne:''' But the adults sent her away
::'''Father:''' Scram! Melusines can't be trusted!
::'''"The Melusine":''' So just because I'm not human... I can't save my best friend?
::'''Sigewinne:''' In desperation, the Melusine approached the frightening witch
::'''Sigewinne:''' She begged, and begged, until she got a reply
::'''Witch:''' If you take this potion, concocted of sin

::'''Sigewinne:''' Maybe to protect her from the rain... but maybe also to hide a secret

::'''Sigewinne:''' Just as she had so many times before
::'''Sigewinne:''' Dawn came, and the little girl's condition improved

::'''Sigewinne:''' For she knew her friend would never recognize her again
:;(Cinematic ends)
:{{A|vo sgwlq001 1 sigewinne 14.ogg}} '''Sigewinne:''' ...And so, since then, I've lived my life in human form. Most people who know me just think I was born this way.
:{{A|vo sgwlq001 1 paimon 16.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' ...
:{{A|vo sgwlq001 1 paimon 17.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' A witch... a potion... Why does this sound like a fairy tale?
:{{A|vo sgwlq001 1 sigewinne 15.ogg}} '''Sigewinne:''' Trust me, it's a true story.
:{{A|vo sgwlq001 1 paimon 18.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Must be the way you told it then... It just sounds so... huh.
:{{DIcon}} You're an incredibly kind person, Sigewinne.
:{{A|vo sgwlq001 1 paimon 19.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yeah... Not every Melusine would take human form to save their human friend... That must've been a huge decision.
:{{A|vo sgwlq001 1 sigewinne 16.ogg}} '''Sigewinne:''' Treating patients is a doctor's duty. We must always find a way, even when the going gets tough.
:{{A|vo sgwlq001 1 paimon 20.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ugh, it's so crazy that they turned you away just because you were a Melusine. Especially when their daughter was so sick...
:{{A|vo sgwlq001 1 sigewinne 17.ogg}} '''Sigewinne:''' Well... Sometimes, appearance can be a real barrier. But that was a long time ago. I like how I look now, anyway.
:{{A|vo sgwlq001 1 paimon 21.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Paimon too! You're super cute this way!
:{{A|vo sgwlq001 1 calcagni 01.ogg}} '''Calcagni:''' Attention customers! Thank you all for waiting. Now, on behalf of our skincare partner, I'm delighted to announce that our exciting new product is now officially on sale!
:{{A|vo sgwlq001 1 sigewinne 18.ogg}} '''Sigewinne:''' Well, there we go! Let's have a look, shall we? Paimon, if you wanna buy any skincare products, I'll be happy to give you some suggestions.
:{{A|vo sgwlq001 1 paimon 22.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Really? Personal advice, right from a leader of the Fontaine Beauty Association? What an honor!
:{{A|vo sgwlq001 1 calcagni 02.ogg}} '''Calcagni:''' Allow me to introduce our newest skin lotion, Butterfly Dew. I'm sure many of you have already read about this product's trials in the newspapers.
:{{A|vo sgwlq001 1 calcagni 03.ogg}} '''Calcagni:''' To say that it improves skin quality is an understatement. This product gets its name from the way it transforms your skin and makes it glow anew, like a butterfly emerging from its chrysalis and spreading its wings for the first time.
:{{A|vo sgwlq001 1 calcagni 04.ogg}} '''Calcagni:''' We are thrilled to have the inventor of this fantastic product with us here today — please welcome Mr. Rawat, a researcher from the Fontaine Research Institute. Now, without further ado, I'll hand over to Mr. Rawat to tell you all about what Butterfly Dew can do for you!
:{{A|vo sgwlq001 1 rawat 01.ogg}} '''Rawat:''' Thank you. Hello everyone, I'm Rawat, and I developed Butterfly Dew.
:{{A|vo sgwlq001 1 istress 01.ogg}} '''Istress:''' Wow, what a looker!
:{{A|vo sgwlq001 1 aurillac 01.ogg}} '''Aurillac:''' He's a researcher? Wow, he's really challenging the stereotype...
:{{A|vo sgwlq001 1 rawat 02.ogg}} '''Rawat:''' Haha, it seems that everyone is surprised by my entrance — or should I say, my appearance?
:{{A|vo sgwlq001 1 rawat 03.ogg}} '''Rawat:''' I'm well aware that researchers are generally better known for their brains than their dashing good looks... In that regard, I do believe I break the mold somewhat.
:{{A|vo sgwlq001 1 rawat 04.ogg}} '''Rawat:''' Of course, appearance is a skin-deep way of defining a person. And yet, one's appearance can be a very real set of shackles, holding a person back in their life.
:{{A|vo sgwlq001 1 rawat 05.ogg}} '''Rawat:''' It can rob a young person of their self-confidence when applying for a job, dissuade a young lady from approaching the one she loves... Our actions are at the mercy of our appearance, and we slowly become the very person that the outside world sees us as.
:{{A|vo sgwlq001 1 paimon 23.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hmm...
:{{A|vo sgwlq001 1 rawat 06.ogg}} '''Rawat:''' But what if I told you that those shackles can be broken?
:{{A|vo sgwlq001 1 rawat 07.ogg}} '''Rawat:''' If our appearance prevents us from changing, then let us first change our appearance itself!
:{{A|vo sgwlq001 1 rawat 08.ogg}} '''Rawat:''' Wash away moles, birthmarks, and wrinkles, and they can no longer rob us of our confidence. Replace them with luster and radiance, and we shall never again hang our heads in shame.
:{{A|vo sgwlq001 1 rawat 09.ogg}} '''Rawat:''' That is why Butterfly Dew exists. Its mission is to allow us to shed our pupae, undergo a complete metamorphosis, and embrace a new life!
:{{A|vo sgwlq001 1 paimon 24.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Well, whether it actually works or not — after that speech, Paimon's already sold!
:{{A|vo sgwlq001 1 istress 02.ogg}} '''Istress:''' Mr. Rawat, could I ask if you've used this product yourself?
:{{A|vo sgwlq001 1 rawat 10.ogg}} '''Rawat:''' Of course. I tried it many times while I was testing it — you can consider me a product ambassador.
:{{A|vo sgwlq001 1 paimon 25.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wow, then it's sure to work!
:{{A|vo sgwlq001 1 rawat 11.ogg}} '''Rawat:''' Still, I don't expect to convince you just by blowing my own trumpet. So could I get a volunteer from the audience to try it out?
:{{A|vo sgwlq001 1 paimon 26.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Paimon volunteers!
:{{A|vo sgwlq001 1 rawat 12.ogg}} '''Rawat:''' Hmm... Oh?
:{{A|vo sgwlq001 1 rawat 13.ogg}} '''Rawat:''' Ah, what an honor. It appears we have a giant of the Fontaine Beauty Association here with us... In that case, Miss Sigewinne, could we seek your most expert opinion on this product?
:{{A|vo sgwlq001 1 sigewinne 19.ogg}} '''Sigewinne:''' Ummm... Sure.
:{{A|vo sgwlq001 1 istress 03.ogg}} '''Istress:''' Is that "Romaritime Flower"? They say she's the pickiest user of skincare products in all of Fontaine...
:{{A|vo sgwlq001 1 rawat 14.ogg}} '''Rawat:''' Here you go.
:{{A|vo sgwlq001 1 sigewinne 20.ogg}} '''Sigewinne:''' Hmm... It's very kind to the skin, and the absorption rate is high... Even for Fontaine, this is a first-rate product.
:{{A|vo sgwlq001 1 paimon 27.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wow, now that's high praise!
:{{A|vo sgwlq001 1 crowd 01.ogg}} '''Customers:''' I'll take one! Me, too! Do we get discounts?
:{{A|vo sgwlq001 1 rawat 15.ogg}} '''Rawat:''' Alright, well all that remains for me to say is: Butterfly Dew is now on sale!
:{{Black Screen|The enthusiastic shopping spree rapidly decimates the stocks.}}
:{{A|vo sgwlq001 1 paimon 28.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Think we should buy a bottle too?
:{{DIcon}} Nah, you're cute enough already.
::{{A|vo sgwlq001 1 paimon 29a 1.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hehe, really? ...Well, it's still good to care for your skin though, right? Paimon definitely feels kinda rough from being exposed to the elements all the time...
:{{DIcon}} Are you paying for it yourself?
::{{A|vo sgwlq001 1 paimon 29b 1.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hmph, of course you'd bring up Mora... Fine, Paimon'll pay out of her own pocket, and even share it with you. There, does that sound fair?
:{{A|vo sgwlq001 1 paimon 30.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' And if you're worried about whether it's the right product for you — well, luckily for us, Sigewinne's here! So we can get an expert consultation.

;(Talk to Aurillac, optional)
:{{A|vo dialog sgwlq001 aurillac 01.ogg}} '''Aurillac:''' I'm buying for a friend, but just wanna check — this is designed for both women and men, right?

;(Talk to Istress, optional)

;(Talk to Rawat and Sigewinne)
:{{A|vo sgwlq001 2 rawat 01.ogg}} '''Rawat:''' It's an honor to receive such high praise from you. To be honest, I was also hoping you might be able to point out some flaws in the product so I can keep improving it.
:{{A|vo sgwlq001 2 sigewinne 01.ogg}} '''Sigewinne:''' With most skincare products, the pros and cons only become apparent with long-term use.
:{{A|vo sgwlq001 2 sigewinne 02.ogg}} '''Sigewinne:''' Yet this one has instant benefits, improving skin quality without any obvious side-effects. It's one of a kind.
:{{A|vo sgwlq001 2 sigewinne 03.ogg}} '''Sigewinne:''' Don't worry, though. I plan to keep using it, and I'll publish regular reviews in "Beautes en fleurs" — you can read my thoughts there. All you need to do is subscribe.
:{{A|vo sgwlq001 2 rawat 02.ogg}} '''Rawat:''' Oh... I was hoping for a more casual conversation, but you are a Beauty Association leader, after all. I understand if you want to keep this professional.
:{{A|vo sgwlq001 2 paimon 01a.ogg}} {{A|vo sgwlq001 2 paimon 01b.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Sigewinne! Ahem... Excuse us, Miss Beauty Expert, but do you think this product is a good choice for me and {{MC|m=him|f=her}}?
:{{A|vo sgwlq001 2 rawat 03.ogg}} '''Rawat:''' Hmm? Wait. Are you the renowned {{Traveler}}?
:{{A|vo sgwlq001 2 paimon 02a.ogg}} {{A|vo sgwlq001 2 paimon 02b.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' That's right — and by {{MC|m=his|f=her}} side, the equally famous Paimon!
:{{A|vo sgwlq001 2 rawat 04.ogg}} '''Rawat:''' Haha... Well, I don't normally handle customer questions personally, but since it's {{Traveler}} asking, allow me to make an exception.
:{{A|vo sgwlq001 2 rawat 05.ogg}} '''Rawat:''' Butterfly Dew is made for all skin types, so no matter who you are, you can rest assured that it will be kind to your skin. If anything, it might be marginally more effective on Fontainian skin, but other than that, it works the same on everyone.
:{{A|vo sgwlq001 2 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Why would it work better on Fontainians?
:{{A|vo sgwlq001 2 rawat 06.ogg}} '''Rawat:''' Um... In the interests of protecting my trade secrets, I'm afraid I can't answer that, Miss Paimon.
:{{A|vo sgwlq001 2 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Eh, alright then. How about a friend discount?
:{{A|vo sgwlq001 2 rawat 07a.ogg}}<!--{{A|vo sgwlq001 2 rawat 07b.ogg}}--> '''Rawat:''' Save yourself the trouble — I'd be greatly honored to have both of you use my product. Here, take two bottles, for free.
:{{A|vo sgwlq001 2 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yay! Paimon's private fund survives!
:{{DIcon}} What's the catch? Is this a publicity stunt?
:{{A|vo sgwlq001 2 rawat 08.ogg}} '''Rawat:''' Haha, I can see why you might think that. But please don't misunderstand — this gift is simply a token of my esteem. There's no business motivation behind it.
:{{A|vo sgwlq001 2 rawat 09.ogg}} '''Rawat:''' To me, finding new customers for Butterfly Dew is about meeting kindred spirits — fellow admirers of physical beauty. I consider it a labor of love.
:{{A|vo sgwlq001 2 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Admirers of physical beauty... Yeesh, that's embarrassing to say out loud. It sounds so shallow...
:{{A|vo sgwlq001 2 rawat 10.ogg}} '''Rawat:''' It's nothing to be ashamed of, Miss Paimon. Most people claim to desire inner virtue, but it is still physical appearance that turns their heads.
:{{A|vo sgwlq001 2 rawat 11.ogg}} '''Rawat:''' This is a fact of life. It's only natural for people to desire to become beautiful, and that's exactly what inspired me to choose this research direction in the first place.
:{{A|vo sgwlq001 2 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You're right! Everyone loves beauty, don't they?
:{{A|vo sgwlq001 2 rawat 12.ogg}} '''Rawat:''' Ah, look at the time... My apologies, but I have other things to attend to. I'll leave you with these two bottles of Butterfly Dew, and I look forward to seeing you again.
:{{A|vo sgwlq001 2 sigewinne 04.ogg}} '''Sigewinne:''' Paimon, I'd say there's no need for you and {{Traveler}} to use this product for now.
:{{A|vo sgwlq001 2 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh? Why, is there a problem with it?
:{{A|vo sgwlq001 2 sigewinne 05.ogg}} '''Sigewinne:''' The quality is fine, I just think there's room for improvement. I think I could add some ingredients to the mix to make it more effective.
:{{A|vo sgwlq001 2 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Really? Then... Why didn't you tell Rawat about that?
:{{A|vo sgwlq001 2 sigewinne 06.ogg}} '''Sigewinne:''' Researchers are a very special breed of human.
:{{A|vo sgwlq001 2 sigewinne 07.ogg}} '''Sigewinne:''' You can point out their flaws to their face, and they won't mind very much. But if you tell them that someone else could do a better job... Now that'll make them really upset.
:{{A|vo sgwlq001 2 sigewinne 08.ogg}} '''Sigewinne:''' If I'd mentioned it, he probably wouldn't have given you those two bottles for free.
:{{A|vo sgwlq001 2 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh, fair enough, that makes sense...
:{{A|vo sgwlq001 2 sigewinne 09.ogg}} '''Sigewinne:''' If you're interested in the more effective version, I can write up a list of ingredients for you. Just come get me once you've gathered them.
:{{A|vo sgwlq001 2 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' When you say more effective... You mean, it'll make Paimon even prettier? Ooh, {{Traveler}}, how could we say no!
:{{DIcon}} A prettier Paimon?
:{{DIcon}} Well, if you really want this...
:{{A|vo sgwlq001 2 sigewinne 10.ogg}} '''Sigewinne:''' As for me, it's probably time I got back to the Fortress of Meropide. I mustn't leave the infirmary unattended for too long.
:{{A|vo sgwlq001 2 paimon 12.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Alright, see you there, then!
{{Dialogue End}}

;(Approach the Fontemer Aberrants or the Hydro Phantasm)
:{{A|vo sgwlq001 2 paimon 13.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Just up ahead, {{Traveler}}! The ingredients for Sigewinne should be nearby!

:;(Obtain {{Item|Concentrated Transoceanic Pearl}})

;(Approach the infirmary in the Fortress of Meropide)
:{{A|vo sgwlq001 3 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Whoa, the infirmary's packed...
:{{A|vo sgwlq001 3 eric 01.ogg}} '''Erick:''' Please, you have to believe me! I saw it with my own eyes last night, another me! He looked EXACTLY like me!
:{{A|vo sgwlq001 3 sigewinne 01.ogg}} '''Sigewinne:''' Got it, okay. I've written down everything you told me. Now, I have a few tests to run. Take a deep breath, and don't worry — it's nothing to be nervous about.
:{{A|vo sgwlq001 3 sigewinne 02.ogg}} '''Sigewinne:''' First, which finger am I holding up?
:{{A|vo sgwlq001 3 eric 02.ogg}} '''Erick:''' Your index finger, but... I'm telling you, my mental state is fine! I'm not crazy!
:{{A|vo sgwlq001 3 sigewinne 03.ogg}} '''Sigewinne:''' Very good. Now, onto the next.
:{{A|vo sgwlq001 3 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hey there, Your Grace. It's been a while, huh?
:{{A|vo sgwlq001 3 wriothesley 01.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' Ah, it's you two. Indeed it has. I would offer you some tea, but I'm afraid the timing is unfortunate — duty calls.
:{{A|vo sgwlq001 3 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' No worries, actually, we were looking for Sigewinne. Do you, uh... know what all this is about?
:{{A|vo sgwlq001 3 wriothesley 02.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' This inmate came running to guards in a panic, claiming to have seen his exact doppelganger.
:{{A|vo sgwlq001 3 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' A doppelganger? Doesn't that just mean someone else kinda looks like him?
:{{A|vo sgwlq001 3 wriothesley 03.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' That's what I thought when the report first reached my desk. But we've inspected our records. No one even vaguely resembles him.
:{{A|vo sgwlq001 3 wriothesley 04.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' Considering how certain he is of what he saw, I can only surmise that he's having some mental issues. So I brought him for a medical evaluation.
:{{A|vo sgwlq001 3 sigewinne 04.ogg}} '''Sigewinne:''' Alright, very good. Take a sip of water and rest for a bit.
:{{A|vo sgwlq001 3 sigewinne 05.ogg}} '''Sigewinne:''' Evaluation complete. I couldn't find any symptoms pointing to a physical condition.
:{{A|vo sgwlq001 3 wriothesley 05.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' I see. So, do you still believe there's more likely to be an issue with his mind than his body?
:{{A|vo sgwlq001 3 sigewinne 06.ogg}} '''Sigewinne:''' I have to assume so for now. Psychological issues are more difficult to detect. At this stage, we can at least confirm that he is in command of his cognitive faculties.
:{{A|vo sgwlq001 3 wriothesley 06.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' The rumor mill will go crazy if word of this gets out... Guards, take him to the ward for a period of observation.
:{{A|vo sgwlq001 3 wriothesley 07.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' The Marechaussee Phantom has requested my cooperation on a case, otherwise I'd deal with this myself. Sorry for the trouble, Head Nurse, but I'll have to leave this to you.
:{{A|vo sgwlq001 3 sigewinne 07.ogg}} '''Sigewinne:''' No problem, Your Grace. I'll add him to my observation list.
:{{A|vo sgwlq001 3 wriothesley 08a.ogg}}<!--{{A|vo sgwlq001 3 wriothesley 08b.ogg}}--> '''Wriothesley:''' By the way, we have a couple of guests here who've made the trip just to see you. I imagine it must be important. You probably won't need to add them to your observation list, though.
:{{A|vo sgwlq001 3 sigewinne 08.ogg}} '''Sigewinne:''' Oh! {{Traveler}}, Paimon. It's you!
:{{A|vo sgwlq001 3 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hey there, Sigewinne! It's actually not THAT important, but...
:{{A|vo sgwlq001 3 wriothesley 09.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' I'll be in my office if you desperately need me. Goodbye for now.
:{{A|vo sgwlq001 3 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Okay, bye-bye!
:{{A|vo sgwlq001 3 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Uh, so, Sigewinne...
:{{A|vo sgwlq001 3 sigewinne 09.ogg}} '''Sigewinne:''' Would you mind waiting for just a moment? I have another patient to see. Just find an empty bed and take a seat, I won't be long.
:{{A|vo sgwlq001 3 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, sure.
:{{A|vo sgwlq001 3 odilon 01.ogg}} '''Odilon:''' Sigewinne, we've brought him — and he seems to have taken a turn for the worse again.
:{{A|vo sgwlq001 3 sigewinne 10.ogg}} '''Sigewinne:''' Okay, don't panic. Let's start by sitting him down here.
:{{A|vo sgwlq001 3 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Paimon had no idea how busy it can get for Sigewinne... Maybe now's not the time to ask for her help with skincare...
:{{DIcon}} Patience, Paimon. She'll help us, we just need to wait.
:{{DIcon}} In the meantime, we could offer to help Sigewinne.
:{{A|vo sgwlq001 3 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Good point... Besides, it might actually be interesting to observe her at work.
:{{A|vo sgwlq001 3 sigewinne 11.ogg}} '''Sigewinne:''' This could hurt, so I suggest you take a deep breath first.
:{{Color|menu|You see the face revealed by Potton, but are shocked by his appearance...}}
:{{A|vo sgwlq001 3 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Aah!
:{{A|vo sgwlq001 3 paimon 12.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Did his... face melt!? What happened to him?
:{{A|vo sgwlq001 3 odilon 02.ogg}} '''Odilon:''' It's anyone's guess... His face melted off shortly after arriving at the Fortress, but since he's a serious offender, he can't be allowed out for medical treatment. Best we can do for now is ask the head nurse to give him something to manage the symptoms.
:{{A|vo sgwlq001 3 odilon 03.ogg}} '''Odilon:''' This is gonna be awkward... We still need to bring him to the Marechaussee Phantom for questioning. What if he scares them half to death? Will that be our fault?
:{{A|vo sgwlq001 3 paimon 13.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' The Marechaussee Phantom? Does this have something to do with the case Wriothesley's dealing with?
:{{A|vo sgwlq001 3 odilon 04.ogg}} '''Odilon:''' Yep. It was a huge case. They bagged a few dozen crooks in one fell swoop — and this guy's the baddest apple of the bunch. He harmed countless people... And now it looks like it's all finally catching up with him.
:{{A|vo sgwlq001 3 potton 01.ogg}} '''Potton:''' You done gawking?
:{{A|vo sgwlq001 3 sigewinne 12.ogg}} '''Sigewinne:''' Not yet. I need to check the severity of your ulcers to decide the right dosage.
:{{A|vo sgwlq001 3 potton 02.ogg}} '''Potton:''' ...
:{{A|vo sgwlq001 3 sigewinne 13.ogg}} '''Sigewinne:''' Don't worry, we Melusines have a very different sense of aesthetics from humans. To me, you just look like a little kitty with slightly scruffy fur, but still just as cute.
:{{A|vo sgwlq001 3 potton 03.ogg}} '''Potton:''' Don't patronize me! Do I look like a kid to you? Just gimme the meds and lemme out of here, I already miss my cell.
:{{A|vo sgwlq001 3 odilon 05.ogg}} '''Odilon:''' Hey, lose the attitude! You dare talk back to our head nurse like that again, your days are numbered!
:{{A|vo sgwlq001 3 sigewinne 14.ogg}} '''Sigewinne:''' It's fine. Okay, I'm going to apply the medication now. Tell me if it hurts, alright?
:{{A|vo sgwlq001 3 paimon 14.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Look how nice Sigewinne's being! And still he talks to her like that. What a nasty piece of work.
:{{A|vo sgwlq001 3 potton 04.ogg}} '''Potton:''' Can I leave now?
:{{A|vo sgwlq001 3 sigewinne 15.ogg}} '''Sigewinne:''' Wow, not a peep. What a brave little guy.
:{{A|vo sgwlq001 3 odilon 06.ogg}} '''Odilon:''' Thank you, Sigewinne. And I apologize for the trouble.
:{{A|vo sgwlq001 3 sigewinne 16.ogg}} '''Sigewinne:''' So, {{Traveler}}, Paimon — did you bring the ingredients?
:{{A|vo sgwlq001 3 paimon 15.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Uhh... We did, but we don't wanna interfere or anything... You're busy saving lives here...
:{{A|vo sgwlq001 3 sigewinne 17.ogg}} '''Sigewinne:''' Oh, don't be silly. I agreed to it, didn't I? Just hand me the ingredients, and I'll make some time to whip it into the improved version for you.
:{{A|vo sgwlq001 3 sigewinne 18.ogg}} '''Sigewinne:''' Take a rest here if you want. Or, if you're not tired, I hear they're holding a new pankration tournament in the Administrative Area.
:{{A|vo sgwlq001 3 paimon 16.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Um... Or alternatively, is there anything we could we help you with, Sigewinne?
:{{DIcon}} Take it as a token of our gratitude.
:{{A|vo sgwlq001 3 paimon 17.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' That's right! Let us help you out. It's the least we can do!
:{{A|vo sgwlq001 3 sigewinne 19.ogg}} '''Sigewinne:''' Hmm, good point... Kind-hearted humans start to develop "guilt" if they accept free help from others...
:{{A|vo sgwlq001 3 sigewinne 20.ogg}} '''Sigewinne:''' Don't worry, I'll take a look at my schedule — I'm sure I can find something to treat this condition.
:{{A|vo sgwlq001 3 sigewinne 21.ogg}} '''Sigewinne:''' I gotta warn you though, it'll be tiring work. So I suggest that you take a break first, then come back and see me when you're ready.

;(Trying to enter the observation ward)
:{{A|vo dialog sgwlq001 odilon 01.ogg}} '''Odilon:''' This is the observation ward. If you want to visit a patient, you'll need authorization from the head nurse.
