==Dialogue==
{{Quest Description|Razor decides to make some [[Thousand-Wind Wine]] personally to better understand his human parents. However, which ingredients, specifically, was Venti's song referring to?}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(On passing time)
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 1 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' It's almost time. Let's go meet up with Razor!
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 1 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' The meeting spot is on the bank of Cider Lake. You know the way, right?

;(Approach the marked area)
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 2 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh? Where's the heck's Razor? Paimon thought he would've been here by now...
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 2 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hmm, he had a pretty big day when we last saw him... Do you think he fell asleep when he got back and is still snoozing away now?
:{{DIcon}} Sounds more like something you'd do than Razor.
:{{DIcon}} Let's wait and see.
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 2 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Fair enough, you're right. Let's keep waiting.
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 2 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Well, since we've got some time on our hands, let's put our heads together and try to figure out that poem! Tone-Deaf Bard mentioned some ingredients, but they all sounded super abstract:
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 2 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' An explorer's courage, a love tender and true, a defender's will, and... the thousand winds'... "song of good cheer"...
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 2 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Do you have any ideas?
:{{DIcon}} Maybe they aren't the "ingredients"...
:{{DIcon}} Maybe they describe the wine's "character"...
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 2 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yeesh, that's even more abstract! How do we go about looking for this wine's "character"? Where do we start?
:{{DIcon}} The Adventurers' Guild, the Church of Favonius...
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 2 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh? Are you saying that it has something to do with Mondstadt's institutions?
:{{DIcon}} Yes... And as for the word "defender"...
:{{DIcon}} It makes me think of the Knights of Favonius.
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 2 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wow, that... actually makes a surprising amount of sense. So the poem wasn't talking about any specific ingredients after all? More like... the general gist?
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 2 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Now that you mention it, it just so happens that all the institutions you mentioned are organizers of the Weinlesefest!
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 2 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' ...Wait, this is way too big of a coincidence! That Tone-Deaf Bard, did he just make this all up on the spot!?
:{{DIcon}} Perhaps he did... as a way of helping us to help Razor.
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 2 paimon 12.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' In that case, the last part about the thousand winds' song of cheer must be code for the toasting ceremony! Ohoho, now we're cookin'! We'll crack your riddle-recipe yet, Tone-Deaf Bard!
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 2 paimon 13.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' When Razor gets here, let's visit all the places you mentioned and talk to some people we know there. We definitely should be able to find some more clues that way.
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 2 klee 01a.ogg}} {{A|vo jnjeq002 2 klee 01b.ogg}} '''Klee:''' {{MC|m=Mr.|f=Miss}} Honorary Knight! Paimon!
:{{Introductory Note|character=Klee}}
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 2 razor 01.ogg}} '''Razor:''' I'm sorry! I'm late...
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 2 paimon 14.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' That's alright, we were just chatting.
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 2 paimon 15a.ogg}} {{A|vo jnjeq002 2 paimon 15b.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' {{Traveler}}'s pretty smart, so thanks to {{MC|m=him|f=her}}, we're finally onto something!
:{{DIcon}} Hello, Klee, and Razor.
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 2 razor 02.ogg}} '''Razor:''' Hi. I was on my way, then I saw Klee.
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 2 klee 02.ogg}} '''Klee:''' They let me out for Weinlesefest!
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 2 klee 03.ogg}} '''Klee:''' Albedo is super busy helping Timaeus fix his recipe for an Extra-Strong Sobriety Potion, so he doesn't have time to come play with me right now. I'm just playing by myself instead.
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 2 klee 04.ogg}} '''Klee:''' But it's so cool! All the grown-ups in Mondstadt are out to celebrate the festival. Everyone's smiling and having loads of fun!
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 2 klee 05.ogg}} '''Klee:''' I wanted to join in too. So I made a whole bunch of stuff so I can celebrate with everyone in my very own way!
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 2 paimon 16.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' "Very own way"... Uh oh, this does not bode well coming from Klee.
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 2 klee 06.ogg}} '''Klee:''' And that's when I bumped into Razor.
:{{DIcon}} Phew, so bomb crisis averted...
:{{DIcon}} Great job, Razor.
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 2 klee 07.ogg}} '''Klee:''' Razor was acting kinda different than usual, like he was thinking about something. So I asked him, "What happened?"
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 2 klee 08.ogg}} '''Klee:''' And then Razor said that he was looking for his mommy!
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 2 razor 03.ogg}} '''Razor:''' I did not say mommy.
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 2 klee 09.ogg}} '''Klee:''' It's okay, silly! Mommies are important people, so finding your mommy is a super important job. That's why Klee's gonna come help!
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 2 razor 04.ogg}} '''Razor:''' ...
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 2 bennett 01.ogg}} '''Bennett:''' *panting* Razor... Razor... finally, I found you.
:{{Introductory Note|character=Bennett}}
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 2 razor 05.ogg}} '''Razor:''' Bennett?
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 2 bennett 02.ogg}} '''Bennett:''' Oh, haha, look who's here! Hey, everyone.
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 2 bennett 03.ogg}} '''Bennett:''' Here, this is for you.
::{{Item|Small Lamp Grass|notext=1|80}}
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 2 paimon 17.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Uh... a Small Lamp Grass?
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 2 bennett 04.ogg}} '''Bennett:''' Yup, that's right. I tripped up on it this morning and took a little tumble.
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 2 bennett 05.ogg}} '''Bennett:''' I did a full faceplant, but somehow, this little thing came out completely unscathed. That's when I knew it was destined to go into your wine mix!
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 2 klee 10.ogg}} '''Klee:''' Bennett, how did you manage to trip up on a Small Lamp Grass?
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 2 paimon 18.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh, that's true. They do glow, after all...
:{{DIcon}} To be fair, they only glow at night...
:{{DIcon}} It doesn't help during the day.
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 2 klee 11.ogg}} '''Klee:''' No, no, I wasn't talking about the glowing. What I meant was, they're really big and easy to spot. So I don't get how you didn't see it.
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 2 bennett 06.ogg}} '''Bennett:''' Haha, ah, I was just running too fast and got careless, I guess.
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 2 bennett 07.ogg}} '''Bennett:''' (Okay, I guess maybe I won't tell them about the other faceplants that came after that...)
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 2 bennett 08.ogg}} '''Bennett:''' Anyway, I've been all over the place trying to find Razor this morning. Everyone I asked told me I'd just missed him.
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 2 bennett 09.ogg}} '''Bennett:''' Good thing I've caught up now, I can finally catch my breath...
:{{DIcon}} What a trooper...
:{{DIcon}} Definitely time to take a break...
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 2 bennett 10.ogg}} '''Bennett:''' Thanks, {{Traveler}}.
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 2 razor 06.ogg}} '''Razor:''' How did you know... I need ingredients?
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 2 bennett 11.ogg}} '''Bennett:''' Oh, that? Yeah, interesting story.
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 2 bennett 12.ogg}} '''Bennett:''' This lady came to see Master Cyrus, asking for the Adventurers' Guild's support with the Weinlesefest. Said she was the librarian. Anyway, she mentioned your situation too, and asked if we could help...
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 2 paimon 19.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Whoa, Lisa is doing some real work for once?
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 2 bennett 13.ogg}} '''Bennett:''' Ohhh! So that was Lisa? People say she's crazy intelligent but just doesn't go out much... First time I've ever seen her.
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 2 bennett 14.ogg}} '''Bennett:''' I thought long and hard about what ingredients to pick, and came up with a load of suggestions that I was gonna discuss with you...
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 2 bennett 15.ogg}} '''Bennett:''' But then I realized that Small Lamp Grass was clearly the best. It shines a light to guide the way for explorers in the dark. Doesn't that sound like a wonderful thing?
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 2 razor 07.ogg}} '''Razor:''' ...Apologies... for the trouble.
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 2 bennett 16.ogg}} '''Bennett:''' Ahh, don't gimme that! I get how you must be feeling about all of this. Besides, you gotta help out your friends, right?
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 2 bennett 17.ogg}} '''Bennett:''' If my family... uh, well, my dads ever needed help one day, I know you'd be there for me too.
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 2 razor 08.ogg}} '''Razor:''' Yes.
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 2 klee 12.ogg}} '''Klee:''' Can I help, too? Please, take me with you, pleeease! I wanna join in!
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 2 paimon 20.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Klee's in high spirits today. She seems more excited by this festival than anyone.
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 2 razor 09.ogg}} '''Razor:''' Bennett, before now... you never talk about your family.
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 2 bennett 18.ogg}} '''Bennett:''' Ahh, haha, well that's because I never met my parents. I was raised by some of the older adventurers in the guild. So we're not exactly a typical family.
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 2 bennett 19.ogg}} '''Bennett:''' But if you do want to hear about them, I can tell you some of my dads' stories. Hmm... okay, I'll start with the most awesome one.
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 2 klee 13.ogg}} '''Klee:''' Aw, Bennett...
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 2 klee 14.ogg}} '''Klee:''' You can be Mommy's kid, just like Klee! My mom is super nice — she'll take great care of you!
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 2 paimon 21.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh!?
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 2 bennett 20.ogg}} '''Bennett:''' ...
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 2 bennett 21.ogg}} '''Bennett:''' I really appreciate the thought, Klee. But I'm afraid I can't accept your offer...
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 2 bennett 22.ogg}} '''Bennett:''' I already have my dads and all my friends... And let's not forget that I'm the leader of Benny's Adventure Team. You don't need to worry about me.
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 2 klee 15.ogg}} '''Klee:''' Oh, okay. I got it. Um, then have this.
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 2 paimon 22.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' A Jumpy Dumpty?
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 2 klee 16.ogg}} '''Klee:''' Yeah! It's a lazy, dopey Jumpy Dumpty that always dozes and never explodes! I hope you guys can be best friends.
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 2 bennett 23.ogg}} '''Bennett:''' ...Are you sure?
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 2 klee 17.ogg}} '''Klee:''' Yep! Jumpy Dumpty will be happy to make a new friend, too.
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 2 razor 10.ogg}} '''Razor:''' I... also happy for you.
:{{DIcon}} I still have to look for ingredients with Razor...
:{{DIcon}} Why don't you two go adventuring together?
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 2 paimon 23.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Good idea. Maybe Klee will bring Bennett some good luck, and the adventure will go smoothly. And you might just find some treasures you've never noticed before!
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 2 paimon 24.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Of course... It's also highly possible that Klee will be the only one who gets lucky...
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 2 paimon 25.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Still, on the flip side, Klee won't be getting into any trouble with Bennett there. And this way, she'll still get to enjoy the Weinlesefest!
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 2 bennett 24.ogg}} '''Bennett:''' Cool, don't worry about a thing! We'll look after each other.
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 2 klee 18.ogg}} '''Klee:''' Yay! Adventure! Treasure! Weinlesefest! Let's go, let's go!
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 2 klee 19a.ogg}} {{A|vo jnjeq002 2 klee 19b.ogg}} '''Klee:''' Oh... wait, but what about Wolfie? Wolfie— uh, I mean Razor needs looking after. Honorary Knight, Paimon, you'd better take care of Razor, okay? Make sure he finds his mommy.
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 2 razor 11.ogg}} '''Razor:''' Mm...
:{{DIcon}} Leave it to us.
:{{DIcon}} Be careful.
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 2 razor 12.ogg}} '''Razor:''' ...Good luck.
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 2 bennett 25.ogg}} '''Bennett:''' See ya later, folks.
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 2 paimon 26.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ah, it's so nice to see everyone in such a good mood.
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 2 paimon 27.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh...! Paimon almost forgot the whole reason we came here!
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 2 paimon 28.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Razor, {{Traveler}} and Paimon were just chatting about the ingredients Venti mentioned in his poem. We think that they're actually a description of the wine's characteristics.
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 2 paimon 29.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Plus, it seems like each of them means something special to one of the three big institutions in Mondstadt. So, if we talk to some people we know at each place, maybe we'll find what you're looking for.
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 2 razor 13.ogg}} '''Razor:''' Hmm...
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 2 paimon 30.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What's wrong? Something on your mind? Do you want to talk about it?
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 2 razor 14.ogg}} '''Razor:''' Yes. These days, I think a lot.
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 2 razor 15.ogg}} '''Razor:''' I am not... smart. Not like teacher, not like {{Traveler}}. But... I still have to think.
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 2 razor 16.ogg}} '''Razor:''' Everyone is ready to help, but... some things, I must do myself.
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 2 razor 17.ogg}} '''Razor:''' I don't understand human father and mother... but I must find a way to understand.
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 2 razor 18.ogg}} '''Razor:''' Maybe I can learn about other people's father and mother first, then think about my own father and mother.
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 2 razor 19.ogg}} '''Razor:''' That's why I want to ask questions.
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 2 paimon 31.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' That's great! Keep at it, and you'll definitely find the answer eventually.
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 2 razor 20.ogg}} '''Razor:''' Never knew Bennett is... like me.
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 2 razor 21.ogg}} '''Razor:''' When he talks about "dads," his scent changes.
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 2 razor 22.ogg}} '''Razor:''' Warm, like a bed of straw in the sun.
:{{DIcon}} Let's find more people to speak to.
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 2 paimon 32.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yeah! We should head back into the city. Let's find a friendly face at the Church of Favonius!
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 2 paimon 33.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hmm, now who does Razor know best at the church...
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 2 marcel 01.ogg}} '''Marcel:''' Excuse me, I couldn't help but overhear that you're about to head back into the city. Is that right?
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 2 marcel 02.ogg}} '''Marcel:''' I'm waiting on a fruit cart from the city. It should be here now, but... I'm getting worried that something may have happened on the way, but I can't leave the festival to check up on it...
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 2 marcel 03.ogg}} '''Marcel:''' Would you be able to do me a huge favor, and keep an eye out for the cart on your way back?
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 2 paimon 34.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ummm... Well, if it's on the way...
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 2 razor 23.ogg}} '''Razor:''' Okay, we go. I go too.
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 2 razor 24.ogg}} '''Razor:''' Everyone helps me. Now I have chance, to help everyone.
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 2 marcel 04.ogg}} '''Marcel:''' That's wonderful, thank you so much!

;(Talk to Marcel again)
:{{A|vo dialog jnjeq002 marcel 01.ogg}} '''Marcel:''' We're going through a ton of fruit this Weinlesefest... I really need that cart to get here safely.
----
;(Approach the marked location)
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 3 razor 01.ogg}} '''Razor:''' *sniff*... This way.
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 3 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh! Paimon sees the cart, but what are these hilichurls doing here!? Do they want some fresh fruit now, too?
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 3 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' {{Traveler}}, to the rescue!

;(Defeat the hilichurls)
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 4 razor 01.ogg}} '''Razor:''' ...
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 4 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Whew, finally. These hilichurls are a little too obsessed with food for their own good... But never mind that, are you okay? Did they hurt you?
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 4 rolf 01.ogg}} '''Rolf:''' Phew... I'm fine, thanks to you. You were just in time. Any later, and all you'd have found here is a pile of pulp... and I don't think there'd be much left of the fruit, either.
:{{DIcon}} They're still waiting for you at the festival.
:{{DIcon}} Keep your eyes peeled on the road.
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 4 rolf 02.ogg}} '''Rolf:''' Got it. Well, thanks again! I'd better not delay this delivery any longer, so goodbye and Happy Weinlesefest!
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 4 rolf 03.ogg}} '''Rolf:''' Thanks to you, too, kiddo.
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 4 razor 02.ogg}} '''Razor:''' Mm.
:{{DIcon}} What is it, Razor?
:{{DIcon}} You seem a little...
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 4 razor 03.ogg}} '''Razor:''' Enemy following.
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 4 rosaria 01.ogg}} '''Rosaria:''' "Enemy"? Heh, I think we're a little closer than that.
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 4 rosaria 02.ogg}} '''Rosaria:''' On some level, you could even say that we're brother and sister.
:{{Introductory Note|character=Rosaria|v=3.1}}
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 4 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Rosaria! What the heck are you doing here?
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 4 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wait... Actually, turning up at random places is pretty normal for you...
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 4 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Okay, next question: What the heck do you mean "brother and sister"?
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 4 rosaria 03.ogg}} '''Rosaria:''' Varka taught you how to use that sword, I take it? Swift but powerful. Heh, I can spot that old-timer's style anywhere.
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 4 razor 04.ogg}} '''Razor:''' ...
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 4 rosaria 04.ogg}} '''Rosaria:''' I see you're not much of a talker. Well, there's something else you could learn from Varka. Never lost for words, even when he has nothing to say... It'd be good conversation practice for you. Just a shame we have no idea when he'll be back.
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 4 razor 05.ogg}} '''Razor:''' It's okay. I will wait.
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 4 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Brother and sister...? Varka...?
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 4 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh! Paimon gets it. Varka is a father figure to both of them, so that makes them family — just not by blood.
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 4 rosaria 05.ogg}} '''Rosaria:''' Well, blood relations are overrated anyway, don't you think?
:{{DIcon}} I think the bond of blood is a strong one.
::{{A|vo jnjeq002 4 rosaria 06a 1a.ogg}} {{A|vo jnjeq002 4 rosaria 06a 1b.ogg}} '''Rosaria:''' Ah, I almost forgot. You have a {{MC|m=sister|f=brother}}.
:{{DIcon}} ...Hard to say.
::{{A|vo jnjeq002 4 rosaria 06b 1.ogg}} '''Rosaria:''' I get it. In the final moments of your life, the people there with you won't necessarily be your blood relatives.
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 4 razor 06.ogg}} '''Razor:''' Cold, dark grown-up... You also don't remember what your real mother and real father look like?
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 4 rosaria 07.ogg}} '''Rosaria:''' Huh... So you're helping him dig up some info on his biological parents? And trying to help him build a concept of family along the way?
:{{DIcon}} You could say that.
:{{DIcon}} Just gathering some reference material.
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 4 rosaria 08.ogg}} '''Rosaria:''' Alright, you got me.
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 4 rosaria 09.ogg}} '''Rosaria:''' I barely have any memories of my birth parents... The last time I saw them was long before I had any understanding of the world around me.
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 4 rosaria 10.ogg}} '''Rosaria:''' But that seems pretty common. Even in this day and age, there are plenty of people in the world who can't stop thinking about their families, but will never get to see them.
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 4 rosaria 11.ogg}} '''Rosaria:''' Anyway, if you're never gonna meet someone, it's not worth spending mental energy on them. It's more important to focus on the kind of person you want to become.
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 4 razor 07.ogg}} '''Razor:''' No! You are wrong about this.
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 4 razor 08.ogg}} '''Razor:''' Lupical protect each other. Human family also important. Must care about them.
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 4 rosaria 12.ogg}} '''Rosaria:''' ...Fine. So let's say you do find out who your parents were, and they were saints. Or the opposite, they were complete monsters. What then?
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 4 rosaria 13.ogg}} '''Rosaria:''' How would that affect your life choices? What would you do about it?
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 4 razor 09.ogg}} '''Razor:''' Ummm...
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 4 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Whew, Rosaria's take is a little on the nose... That's a hard one for Razor to answer.
:{{DIcon}} But it's normal to be curious.
:{{DIcon}} The urge to know is understandable.
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 4 rosaria 14.ogg}} '''Rosaria:''' Don't get me wrong, I'm not trying to make this any more difficult than it already is. But Razor's feeling lost and confused right now, and all the other Mondstadters we know are too sunny and bright to tell it like it really is...
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 4 rosaria 15.ogg}} '''Rosaria:''' ...The sun nurtures many good things, but it can't do anything about the problems lurking in the shadows.
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 4 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wow, Rosaria...
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 4 rosaria 16.ogg}} '''Rosaria:''' Alright, I'll leave it there. Take this flower, it's icy cold — just like me.

:{{A|vo jnjeq002 4 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' But can we really use a Mist Flower? Won't it freeze the entire barrel?

:{{A|vo jnjeq002 4 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Aw, Rosaria, you're more thoughtful than Paimon realized...
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 4 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' ...Uh, wait, you heard the bard say that? Were you spying on us!?

:{{A|vo jnjeq002 4 rosaria 19.ogg}} '''Rosaria:''' Don't mention it. It's nothing. Varka's been a big help to me in the past, so just consider it returning a favor. Besides... if I'm your older sister, I might as well act like it.
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 4 rosaria 20.ogg}} '''Rosaria:''' Good luck finding your answers.
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 4 paimon 12.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Now you see her, now you don't... Paimon's slowly getting used to her style.
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 4 paimon 13.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh well, as "love tender and true" goes, that was pretty awkward, but... still counts, right? Now all that's left is the Knights of Favonius.
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 4 razor 11.ogg}} '''Razor:''' ...
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 4 paimon 14.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Razor, are you still thinking about what Rosaria said?
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 4 razor 12.ogg}} '''Razor:''' Her words, are like Mist Flower. They are cold, and they sting.
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 4 razor 13.ogg}} '''Razor:''' But cold also good for wounds. Like Wolfhook.
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 4 razor 14.ogg}} '''Razor:''' I need to, think about it. Maybe then, I will understand.
:{{DIcon}} It'll take some time, there's no need to rush it.
:{{DIcon}} We'll wait for you.
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 4 razor 15.ogg}} '''Razor:''' Okay.
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 4 razor 16.ogg}} '''Razor:''' I will come with you. I think while we walk.

:{{A|vo jnjeq002 5 lisa 05.ogg}} '''Lisa:''' After much deliberation, I realized this was a job for the most sociable and savviest member in our ranks, the Cavalry Captain. So I asked him to take a trip to the Dawn Winery, and somehow bring back a wine barrel.

:{{A|vo jnjeq002 5 kaeya 04.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' ...But I haven't been back there in a long time. This could be quite difficult to accomplish in just a single trip.

:{{A|vo jnjeq002 5 lisa 07.ogg}} '''Lisa:''' Weinlesefest is one of the most important festivals in Mondstadt, and you know how Diluc thinks better than anyone.
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 5 lisa 08.ogg}} '''Lisa:''' Just drop a few little hints, like how this is the first festival Mondstadt has had in a long time, we're short on much-needed supplies for a multitude of reasons... Oh, who can help us?

:{{A|vo jnjeq002 5 kaeya 05.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' Hmm... I suppose. Alright, I'll head out right away.
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 5 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wow, he didn't take much persuading!
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 5 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ugh, and Paimon was just about to thank Lisa for the things she's been doing for Razor behind the scenes...
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 5 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Paimon doesn't even know whose side to be on anymore...
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 5 razor 01.ogg}} '''Razor:''' ...
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 5 razor 02.ogg}} '''Razor:''' {{Traveler}} and teacher, did a lot for me. A lot of work.
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 5 razor 03.ogg}} '''Razor:''' But me... I still can't answer questions. So useless.
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 5 lisa 10.ogg}} '''Lisa:''' Dear me, what's gotten you so upset, my little wolf cub? We can't have you being so down in the dumps.
:{{DIcon}} Some questions, he can't stop thinking about.
:{{DIcon}} Maybe an information overload.
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 5 lisa 11.ogg}} '''Lisa:''' Ah, I see.
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 5 lisa 12.ogg}} '''Lisa:''' Hmm. Cutie, how about you keep Kaeya company while I stay here and help Razor process his feelings? As his teacher, I owe him some tutelage anyway.
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 5 lisa 13.ogg}} '''Lisa:''' Come and collect him in a few days' time. The last ingredient should be ready by then as well.
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 5 kaeya 06.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' Splendid. I was just thinking about how nice it would be to have some company on my trip.
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 5 razor 04.ogg}} '''Razor:''' I don't know what is right, but I trust Teacher. I accept.
:{{DIcon}} It's a plan then.
:{{DIcon}} Lisa, you're a godsend. Thank you.
::{{A|vo jnjeq002 5 lisa 14b 1.ogg}} '''Lisa:''' Well, aren't you a sweet one? But this is as much my business as yours. It's my pleasure, really.

:{{A|vo jnjeq002 7 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hi there, Master Diluc!
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 7 diluc 01.ogg}} '''Diluc:''' Oh? I was just wondering who'd be coming all the way out here during the Weinlesefest. So it's you two.
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 7 diluc 02.ogg}} '''Diluc:''' ...And you, too.

:{{A|vo jnjeq002 7 kaeya 02.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' Don't forget that this is my home, too. I'm fairly certain that taking a trip home during festival season is a universal custom, common to all the cultures of Teyvat.
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 7 diluc 03.ogg}} '''Diluc:''' Please get to the point.
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 7 kaeya 03.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' The point is one that you've already raised yourself: the Weinlesefest.
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 7 kaeya 04.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' To celebrate this long-awaited festival, the Acting Grand Master has been coordinating with both the church and the Adventurers' Guild to host a series of events.
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 7 kaeya 05.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' Unfortunately, given the financial situation of the Knights of Favonius... Well, I'm sure you can imagine...
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 7 diluc 04.ogg}} '''Diluc:''' And the Knights of Favonius's woes have what, exactly, to do with me?
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 7 kaeya 06.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' Hey, no need to be so cruel. Even I'm not going to take that. Everyone's just doing the best they can for Mondstadt.
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 7 kaeya 07.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' Now, I can't remember the last time I tasted Dawn Winery's Weinlesefest special... And I'm sure the Mondstadt populace would echo this sentiment.
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 7 kaeya 08.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' Are you going to deny others the opportunity to drink to their hearts' content just because you don't like to drink yourself?
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 7 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Check it out, Kaeya's not-so-subtly asking for freebies... He's actually doing it...
:{{DIcon}} What a guy.
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 7 kaeya 09.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' Anyway, speaking of the knights, everyone dearly hopes that you'll rejoin our ranks again one day. Then we'll be one big, happy family again.
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 7 kaeya 10.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' If we were able to enjoy the sterling reputation of Master Diluc, my... I'm sure people would be queuing for our charity booth all the way to Falcon Coast...
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 7 diluc 05.ogg}} '''Diluc:''' ...Hmph.
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 7 diluc 06.ogg}} '''Diluc:''' Give that silver tongue of yours a rest. You might need it to maintain public order at the festival.
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 7 diluc 07.ogg}} '''Diluc:''' Duly noted on the financial issues you raised. I'll have Elzer follow up with Hertha in more detail.
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 7 diluc 08.ogg}} '''Diluc:''' And I just so happen to have a batch of wine that I can offer as a token of appreciation to everyone that has been working so hard for the festival.
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 7 diluc 09.ogg}} '''Diluc:''' Shall I address it to you personally?
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 7 kaeya 11.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' That would be an absurd request, even for me. The words "with compliments from the Dawn Winery" ought never be preceded by "To the Cavalry Captain." Is that not the unwritten rule?
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 7 diluc 10.ogg}} '''Diluc:''' You're better informed than I thought. In that case, I will leave this with Adelinde and keep everything anonymous.
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 7 kaeya 12.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' I really can't thank you enough.
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 7 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Master Diluc is so generous! That's all Paimon needs to get that warm, fuzzy feeling... which is just as well, since she won't be allowed to drink a drop.
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 7 diluc 11.ogg}} '''Diluc:''' Are you two here regarding the Weinlesefest, too?
:{{DIcon}} Actually, we're here about Razor...
:{{DIcon}} We need a barrel...
:{{Black Screen|You tell Diluc that you're helping Razor to make Thousand-Wind Wine...}}
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 7 kaeya 13.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' Poor Razor. He grew up so fast, and he's still looking for his father. Master Diluc, we really ought to lend him a hand.
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 7 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' How come Klee said he's looking for his mom, but Kaeya says he's looking for his dad...? It might make more sense to them, but it's gonna get confusing for everyone else!
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 7 diluc 12.ogg}} '''Diluc:''' It's okay. I understand.
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 7 diluc 13.ogg}} '''Diluc:''' We have a spare barrel in the winery. It's a little old, but it's been specially treated for durability. You could leave it next to a Flaming Flower all day and there wouldn't be a scratch. I think that one should satisfy your needs.
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 7 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Sounds great, we'll take it! When can we come fetch it?
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 7 diluc 14.ogg}} '''Diluc:''' No need. I'll have someone deliver it to the festival market. Just collect it from the Angel's Share stand.
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 7 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ah, you always make things so nice and easy for us, Master Diluc! Hehe, thanks a lot. Razor will really appreciate it.
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 7 diluc 15.ogg}} '''Diluc:''' You're more than welcome. Helping each other is what friends do.

:{{A|vo jnjeq002 7 diluc 16.ogg}} '''Diluc:''' ...It's nearly dinner time. Would you care to stay for a meal?
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 7 kaeya 15.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' How time flies... I'll be on my way, then...

:{{A|vo jnjeq002 7 adelinde 02.ogg}} '''Adelinde:''' Oh, don't say that. How often do I get a chance to indulge my dear Master Kaeya, hmm? Tea for the Cavalry Captain when you visit in an official capacity doesn't count. I only get to spoil you if you'll let me cook for you.
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 7 kaeya 17.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' Oh, uh...
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 7 diluc 18.ogg}} '''Diluc:''' What happened to your swagger? Lost for words?
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 7 kaeya 18.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' ...Ahaha... Diluc, you—

:{{DIcon}} The more the merrier.

:{{A|vo jnjeq002 7 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ugh, Kaeya's back to his usual ways.
:{{A|vo jnjeq002 7 kaeya 21.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' Alright, now that our task is complete and our bellies are full, it's time for me to get back to work.

:{{A|vo cllq003 4 clorinde 15.ogg}} '''Prime Minister:''' Only that which is freely given by the king can be considered a reward. Taking the rightful wealth of a kingdom without said permission, on the other hand... is a crime.

:{{A|vo cllq003 4 clorinde 16.ogg}} '''Prime Minister:''' Maybe so, yet the fact remains... You tried to dispose of the treasure without reporting it to the court and without receiving permission, yes?
:{{A|vo cllq003 4 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Um...

Sensing the tense atmosphere in the room, they stand at the ready, each with a hand placed upon the hilt of their sword, as if prepared to draw their weapons and surround you at a moment's notice.

:{{A|vo cllq003 5 navia 08.ogg}} '''Navia:''' After the duel, though... There was a period of time where we simply didn't know how to face each other. She entrusted this sword to me, and never came back.

:{{A|vo cllq003 5 navia 09.ogg}} '''Navia:''' We were both sad, and conflicted, and totally overthinking everything as a result, haha.
:{{A|vo cllq003 5 navia 10.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Whenever I looked at this sword, I couldn't help but wonder... If Ms. [[Petronilla]] had never introduced us to each other at that picnic, maybe part of the sadness I was feeling could have been avoided.

:{{A|vo cllq003 14 clorinde 05.ogg}} '''Game Master:''' In an impressive display of courage, the four of you successfully defeat the uninvited guest.
:{{A|vo cllq003 14 clorinde 06.ogg}} '''Clorinde:''' (That look in his eyes... It's like he became an entirely different person as soon as I defeated him.)
:{{A|vo cllq003 14 furina 03.ogg}} '''Furina:''' Huh? Mr. [[Florian]]...?
:{{A|vo cllq003 14 furina 04.ogg}} '''Furina:''' (...Oh, wait! We're supposed to be roleplaying. I should stay in character.)
:{{A|vo cllq003 14 furina 05.ogg}} '''Furina:''' Ah, ahem...! Speak your name, guard. Why did you lead us here just to betray us?
:{{A|vo cllq003 14 furina 06.ogg}} '''Furina:''' ...Is this treasure really more important to you than bringing peace to the kingdom?
:{{A|vo cllq003 14 florian 02.ogg}} '''Florian:''' Tch... What kingdom? What peace? Those were nothing but lies!
:{{A|vo cllq003 14 florian 03.ogg}} '''Florian:''' I, Florian, am a true Marechaussee Hunter, descended from Hunters of ages past.
:{{A|vo cllq003 14 furina 07.ogg}} '''Furina:''' (So, he's also using his real name... Or wait, was that the name of his character from the very beginning...?)
:{{A|vo cllq003 14 lyney 02.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Then, I'm even more confused. If you truly are a Marechaussee Hunter, shouldn't you want to help us, just like you said before? Shouldn't we fight together for the sake of the people?
:{{A|vo cllq003 14 florian 04.ogg}} '''Florian:''' What do you know? In this day and age... There's no glory to be had as a Marechaussee Hunter.
:{{A|vo cllq003 14 navia 02.ogg}} '''Navia:''' What's that supposed to mean?
:{{A|vo cllq003 14 florian 05.ogg}} '''Florian:''' My skills were passed down to me by my father. We lived a life of obscurity in the remote wilderness. Still, he devoted everything he had to being a Marechaussee Hunter.
:{{A|vo cllq003 14 florian 06.ogg}} '''Florian:''' And what did he get in return? A life of poverty and pain... and a world that forgot all about him. When he died, not a single person came to mourn his passing!
:{{A|vo cllq003 14 florian 07.ogg}} '''Florian:''' The Marechaussee Hunters were the ones who saved this {{Rubi|city|Fontaine}}! We're heroes! We deserve more recognition and respect than this!
:{{A|vo cllq003 14 furina 08.ogg}} '''Furina:''' (Is he talking about how no one in the capital seems to remember the Hunters and their legacy? I didn't expect the script to contain this level of social criticism...)
:{{A|vo cllq003 14 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So, that's why you want to take the treasure for yourself? You feel like you're owed fame and wealth?
:{{A|vo cllq003 14 lyney 03.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' If you already knew where the treasure was located, why didn't you just come down here and take it?
:{{A|vo cllq003 14 florian 08.ogg}} '''Florian:''' Because... I still needed the final key...
:{{A|vo cllq003 14 clorinde 07.ogg}} '''Game Master:''' Ahem! Only a true Marechaussee Hunter is capable of passing through this final door.
:{{A|vo cllq003 14 clorinde 08.ogg}} '''Game Master:''' As someone who sought to hurt others for his own gain, Florian lost that right long ago.
:{{A|vo cllq003 14 navia 03.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Okay, but what is this treasure, anyway? We've got all the keys, right? So, can we just go in and take a look?
:{{A|vo cllq003 14 clorinde 09.ogg}} '''Game Master:''' You're sure you want to go in?
:{{A|vo cllq003 14 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' We've been talking about it for so long... Of course we want to see what's inside!
:{{A|vo cllq003 14 furina 09.ogg}} '''Furina:''' And we've already defeated Florian, right? So, he won't try to take it from us anymore.
:{{A|vo cllq003 14 florian 09.ogg}} '''Florian:''' Tch... Pesky brats...
:{{A|vo cllq003 14 clorinde 10.ogg}} '''Clorinde:''' (Watch yourself...)
:{{A|vo cllq003 14 lyney 04.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Then, let's open the door together.
:{{A|vo cllq003 14 clorinde 11.ogg}} '''Game Master:''' Alright. Your choice of action is confirmed.
:{{Black Screen|Clorinde takes out the keys from earlier and walks up to the heavy door.}}
:{{Black Screen|Without anyone noticing, she takes out her own key and joins it with the others to form the final, required shape.}}

:{{A|vo cllq003 14 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ah! It's open! C'mon, let's go in. Paimon wants to see what's inside!
:{{A|vo cllq003 14 furina 10.ogg}} '''Furina:''' Ooh, me too!

:{{A|vo cllq003 14 clorinde 14.ogg}} '''Clorinde:''' ...

:{{A|vo cllq003 14 lyney 06.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Maybe the Troupe ran out of budget at the end?

:{{A|vo cllq003 14 navia 05.ogg}} '''Navia:''' ...Wait, I get it now! Paimon, this is the real Marechaussee Hunter "treasure"!

:{{A|vo cllq003 14 florian 11.ogg}} '''Florian:''' Argh! Argh... Ahhhh!<!-- Devorator leaves Florian's body -->
:{{A|vo cllq003 14 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Woah! Are you okay?

:{{A|vo cllq003 16 clorinde 01.ogg}} '''Clorinde:''' ...So, how are you doing? Feeling any better?
:{{A|vo cllq003 16 florian 01.ogg}} '''Florian:''' I... What just happened...?
:{{A|vo cllq003 16 clorinde 02.ogg}} '''Clorinde:''' Do you remember how you got here? Or what happened to your body just now?
:{{A|vo cllq003 16 florian 02.ogg}} '''Florian:''' I... I remember now... I brought you here... Because I wanted to... Ah! The explosives in the cave...!
:{{A|vo cllq003 16 clorinde 03.ogg}} '''Clorinde:''' You mean these?
:{{A|vo cllq003 16 florian 03.ogg}} '''Florian:''' ...Huh? How did you...
:{{A|vo cllq003 16 clorinde 04.ogg}} '''Clorinde:''' I could tell something was off the moment I stepped into this cave, so I kept an eye out. I've already dismantled the whole thing.
:{{A|vo cllq003 16 florian 04.ogg}} '''Florian:''' Hah, so the strongest [[Champion Duelist]] in all of Fontaine saved the day once again... Guess I shouldn't be surprised. It would seem your skills as a Marechaussee Hunter are as sharp as ever...
:{{A|vo cllq003 16 clorinde 05.ogg}} '''Clorinde:''' I deserve some answers, don't you think? Tell me why you wanted to lure me here.
:{{A|vo cllq003 16 clorinde 06.ogg}} '''Clorinde:''' Everything you said earlier sounded like the truth. Luckily, your monologue was dramatic enough to convince my friends you were just roleplaying.
:{{A|vo cllq003 16 florian 05.ogg}} '''Florian:''' I... I don't know... I just always felt like there was something in my heart that didn't belong to me... something agitated and angry... Tch, who knows, maybe it was my own anger all along... I could never really tell.
:{{A|vo cllq003 16 florian 06.ogg}} '''Florian:''' The feelings about my father and the other Marechaussee Hunters are real. It just wasn't fair. I was angry... bitter that no one remembered them, or praised their accomplishments.
:{{A|vo cllq003 16 florian 07.ogg}} '''Florian:''' I don't know when it started, but at some point, my anger came to completely consume me. At that point, I remembered the legend my father used to tell me, the one about the treasure...
:{{A|vo cllq003 16 clorinde 07.ogg}} '''Clorinde:''' But if the treasure was all you cared about, why plant all those explosives? Wouldn't they just destroy the treasure, and bury you along with it?
:{{A|vo cllq003 16 florian 08.ogg}} '''Florian:''' Ah... I can't remember. My head is a mess... It felt like... there was this voice telling me to "eliminate the Hunters," but now, it's gone...
:{{A|vo cllq003 16 clorinde 08.ogg}} '''Clorinde:''' ...From your description, I suspect you were dealing with a "Devorator."
:{{A|vo cllq003 16 florian 09.ogg}} '''Florian:''' ...A "Devorator"?
:{{A|vo cllq003 16 clorinde 09.ogg}} '''Clorinde:''' Oh, your Master... Ahem, your father, I mean, never talked about it? It was a kind of monster that was active several centuries ago.
:{{A|vo cllq003 16 florian 10.ogg}} '''Florian:''' No, I've heard of it, I'm just not sure why you suddenly...
:{{A|vo cllq003 16 florian 11.ogg}} '''Florian:''' Wait, it can't be... The seal!
:{{A|vo cllq003 16 clorinde 10.ogg}} '''Clorinde:''' The seal?
:{{A|vo cllq003 16 florian 12.ogg}} '''Florian:''' My family... has served as Marechaussee Hunters for many generations. But the title and swordsmanship weren't the only things passed down over our line. There was a seal as well.
:{{A|vo cllq003 16 florian 13.ogg}} '''Florian:''' My father instructed me to always watch over that seal and maintain it regularly. He said it had been passed down from a truly ancient age, and protecting it was our clan's most important duty.
:{{A|vo cllq003 16 florian 14.ogg}} '''Florian:''' But, I neglected that duty after he died... I finally decided to come down and check on it one day, and that's where my memories become fuzzy...
:{{A|vo cllq003 16 clorinde 11.ogg}} '''Clorinde:''' The Devorator would be a formidable adversary for any mortal being, even ones as capable as the Hunters.
:{{A|vo cllq003 16 clorinde 12.ogg}} '''Clorinde:''' If you lacked the power to completely destroy it, you could easily fall prey to its influence and corruption. In light of this, some Marechaussee Hunters chose to seal the Devorator away in the hopes that a permanent solution would come with the passage of time.
:{{A|vo cllq003 16 florian 15.ogg}} '''Florian:''' I heard it has the power to amplify the obsessions and desires in people's hearts, to the point where they overtake you entirely... Hah, it would seem I'm not just lacking in skill with a blade, but in mental fortitude as well...
:{{A|vo cllq003 16 clorinde 13.ogg}} '''Clorinde:''' And yet, you were able to retrieve three of the four keys... If I remember correctly, each was entrusted to a respected and capable Hunter... How did you manage it?
:{{A|vo cllq003 16 florian 16.ogg}} '''Florian:''' ...One of them belonged to my father. The second I stole from a different Hunter... And the third, *sigh*... was one that I snatched while the person was on the way home from the tavern. I nearly died in that alley...
:{{A|vo cllq003 16 clorinde 14.ogg}} '''Clorinde:''' ...
:{{A|vo cllq003 16 florian 17.ogg}} '''Florian:''' I know just how strong you are — it's as clear as day to everyone in Fontaine. I observed you from dusk to dawn, but could never find any opportunity to sneak up on you... I never even saw you drink a single glass of liquor...
:{{A|vo cllq003 16 florian 18.ogg}} '''Florian:''' The only way I could think to obtain that last key... was to lure you here using your hobby, and then... Ah, I get it now... That monster... It wanted to bury you here alongside the treasure...
:{{A|vo cllq003 16 clorinde 15.ogg}} '''Clorinde:''' ...I won't comment on anything else, but the script was good.
:{{A|vo cllq003 16 florian 19.ogg}} '''Florian:''' Hah... Well, I did pour my heart and soul into it...
:{{A|vo cllq003 16 florian 20.ogg}} '''Florian:''' The stories my father used to tell me... about the glory of the heroic Marechaussee Hunters... and how they came to be forgotten...
:{{A|vo cllq003 16 clorinde 16.ogg}} '''Clorinde:''' It's more than just a story.
:{{A|vo cllq003 16 florian 21.ogg}} '''Florian:''' Huh?
:{{A|vo cllq003 16 clorinde 17.ogg}} '''Clorinde:''' You're proud to be a Hunter. You're still holding on to that part of yourself, no matter how small.
:{{A|vo cllq003 16 florian 22.ogg}} '''Florian:''' Hah, I've done so many despicable things... I have nothing to be proud of...
:{{A|vo cllq003 16 clorinde 18.ogg}} '''Clorinde:''' Then explain the purpose of the "evil sorcerer" in your story.
:{{A|vo cllq003 16 florian 23.ogg}} '''Florian:''' ...!
:{{A|vo cllq003 16 clorinde 19.ogg}} '''Clorinde:''' Isn't he the true antagonist? The one who sought nothing but his own gain and used the people as pawns to attain it... In your heart of hearts, he was the one you truly wanted to defeat.
:{{A|vo cllq003 16 florian 24.ogg}} '''Florian:''' B—But I've already tainted my sword. I no longer have any right to...
:{{A|vo cllq003 16 clorinde 20.ogg}} '''Clorinde:''' Wake up, Florian! Remember how you introduced yourself earlier.
:{{A|vo cllq003 16 clorinde 21.ogg}} '''Clorinde:''' Do you really think the Hunters acted out of a desire for honor and glory, or to be loved and acknowledged by the people? What did your Father teach you about our order?
:{{A|vo cllq003 16 florian 25.ogg}} '''Florian:''' ...
:{{A|vo cllq003 16 clorinde 22.ogg}} '''Clorinde:''' You do not wield your sword for yourself, but to protect those you serve. There's nothing special about a blade. It's the intentions of the wielder that matter above all else.
:{{A|vo cllq003 16 clorinde 23.ogg}} '''Clorinde:''' Do you still not understand? Even after seeing the "treasure" for yourself? The contents of that room... they represent the true legacy the Hunters left behind.
:{{A|vo cllq003 16 florian 26.ogg}} '''Florian:''' ...You're right. I... I am a Marechaussee Hunter. It's time for me to redeem — no, to finally serve the people I vowed to protect all along.
:{{A|vo cllq003 16 clorinde 24.ogg}} '''Clorinde:''' I wouldn't be so quick to push aside the need for redemption.
:{{A|vo cllq003 16 florian 27.ogg}} '''Florian:''' ...I know. That's a charge I won't bother to defend myself against.
:{{A|vo cllq003 16 clorinde 25.ogg}} '''Clorinde:''' Good. Then come with me, and help me see this script through to the end.
:{{A|vo cllq003 16 florian 28.ogg}} '''Florian:''' Huh? See the script through to the end? But... But there's no more script left.
:{{A|vo cllq003 16 clorinde 26.ogg}} '''Clorinde:''' Never finished it, huh?
:{{A|vo cllq003 16 florian 29.ogg}} '''Florian:''' No, I mean... I wrote the script with the sole purpose of luring you all here. There was no reason to write beyond this point...
:{{A|vo cllq003 16 clorinde 27.ogg}} '''Clorinde:''' Then we'll just have to keep writing it. The evil sorcerer still needs to be defeated.
:{{A|vo cllq003 16 florian 30.ogg}} '''Florian:''' You mean... the Devorator? Uh... Are you saying I have to make up the rest of the script as we go along?
:{{A|vo cllq003 16 clorinde 28.ogg}} '''Clorinde:''' Is that really so hard? You've already written most of it. Surely you can write an ending where the Hunters win and justice prevails? I'll be there to help you, too.
:{{A|vo cllq003 16 florian 31.ogg}} '''Florian:''' ...You aren't afraid your party will fall into danger?
:{{A|vo cllq003 16 clorinde 29.ogg}} '''Clorinde:''' I know what my friends are capable of, and they're all quite skilled. Besides, I need their help.
:{{A|vo cllq003 16 florian 32.ogg}} '''Florian:''' Then... are you going to tell them the truth about all this?
:{{A|vo cllq003 16 clorinde 30.ogg}} '''Clorinde:''' Ah, I don't intend to spoil the fun. Sometimes, protecting dreams and fantasies is more important than exposing the truth, don't you think?

'''''Business as Usual''''' is a quest in {{Quest|The Jade Chamber's Returning Guest}}.

==Steps==
# Wait until the following day (07:00–08:00)
# Wake Ningguang up
# Talk to Ningguang
# Have breakfast together with Ningguang
# Look for [[Lanyang]] to get the tailored clothes
# Give the tailored clothes to Ningguang
# Go to [[Liuli Pavilion]] for the banquet
#* Tell Ningguang not to worry about her capable secretaries. Proceed to [[Exchanging Intelligence]].
#* Offer to go and check up on her secretaries. Proceed to [[Auction Games]].

:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913204 luoqiao 06.ogg}} '''Luo Qiao:''' I'm Luo Qiao, a businesswoman. I work mostly in the textile business, but recently I've been considering branching out into some other markets.

:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913204 ningguang 11.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' You're comparing Apples and Sunsettias there. Whenever Beidou returns to Liyue Harbor, all she brings me is a headache.

:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913204 ningguang 15.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' I had my secretary do some analysis. The current price of Luminescent Spines far exceeds the profits that could be made on the end product.

:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913204 luoqiao 19.ogg}} '''Luo Qiao:''' Maybe it'd be a better choice to invest this money into an industry that I'm genuinely interested in getting involved with.
:{{Black Screen|''The business talk continues in this vein throughout lunchtime...''}}

:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913204 luoqiao 22.ogg}} '''Luo Qiao:''' You think clearly, you are very knowledgeable, and you keep yourself well-informed. It would take me a very long time to come anywhere close to your level.

==Steps==
# Go to the settlement of the [[Masters of the Night-Wind]]
# Enter the Hall
# Go to the Obsidian Altar
# Meet with the [[Biram|Chief of the Tribe]]
# Accept the test
# Look for Clues (0/3)
# Escape the sealed space
# Talk to Biram

:{{A|vo xtlllq001 6 biram 02.ogg}} '''Biram:''' Unusually so. Yes, I am aware. But I assure you, it's no cause for alarm.

:{{A|vo xtlllq001 6 biram 03.ogg}} '''Biram:''' Ah yes, Caholom told me about that. As outsiders to our tribe, this is probably the first you've heard of such appointments. I'm sure the whole thing seems very confusing.
:{{A|vo xtlllq001 6 biram 04.ogg}} '''Biram:''' Throughout our history, only members of the Masters of the Night-Wind have been appointed to undertake these tasks. This is the first time an outsider has ever been chosen.

:{{A|vo xtlllq001 6 biram 05.ogg}} '''Biram:''' Allow me to explain. Our tribe has an old tradition of recording history in the form of woven scrolls.
:{{A|vo xtlllq001 6 biram 06.ogg}} '''Biram:''' And not just our own history. We record the legends and heroic feats of all other tribes as well.
:{{A|vo xtlllq001 6 biram 07.ogg}} '''Biram:''' It is a tradition we have observed for many centuries. We treat it as a solemn duty.
:{{A|vo xtlllq001 6 biram 08.ogg}} '''Biram:''' However, when a major event occurs that affects all of Natlan, we record it on a different kind of scroll used for this exact purpose.
:{{A|vo xtlllq001 6 biram 09.ogg}} '''Biram:''' And these scrolls can only be woven by someone of the Iktomisaur Elder's choosing.
:{{A|vo xtlllq001 6 biram 10.ogg}} '''Biram:''' When the Iktomisaur Elder senses a major change in the Ley Lines, it will issue a formal declaration to appoint a creator for this scroll.
:{{A|vo xtlllq001 6 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Whoa, so you mean...
:{{A|vo xtlllq001 6 biram 11.ogg}} '''Biram:''' Elder Tlapo sensed a Ley Line change quite some time ago, but had not yet designated the scroll-weavers... until you arrived.
:{{A|vo xtlllq001 6 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Okay, but... Just so you're aware, we don't know the first thing about weaving scrolls.
:{{A|vo xtlllq001 6 biram 12.ogg}} '''Biram:''' As a matter of fact, that does not surprise me at all.
:{{A|vo xtlllq001 6 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' How come?
:{{A|vo xtlllq001 6 biram 13.ogg}} '''Biram:''' In the two hundred years that Elder Tlapo has held this position, none of the appointed ones have ever been experienced scroll-weavers.
:{{A|vo xtlllq001 6 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Does that mean two hundred years of major historical events have gone unrecorded?
:{{A|vo xtlllq001 6 biram 14.ogg}} '''Biram:''' No, they all submitted scrolls in time. Yet each of them claimed it was not their own work, but a "gift from the spirits."
:{{A|vo xtlllq001 6 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Man... this tribe gets more mysterious by the second.
:{{A|vo xtlllq001 6 biram 15.ogg}} '''Biram:''' Yes, well... that is the part that troubles me.
:{{A|vo xtlllq001 6 biram 16.ogg}} '''Biram:''' The notion that we have to rely on esoteric things like "gifts from the spirits" to record historical events of such great importance... it is unsettling.
:{{A|vo xtlllq001 6 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh... That's pretty surprising to hear, coming from the chief of this tribe.
:{{A|vo xtlllq001 6 biram 17.ogg}} '''Biram:''' I can imagine. You probably see the Masters of the Night-Wind as a people shrouded in mystery, who pride ourselves on our arcane practices.
:{{A|vo xtlllq001 6 biram 18.ogg}} '''Biram:''' But I am something of an exception. I may be the chief, but when it comes to our traditions, I am in fact a proponent of change and reform.
:{{A|vo xtlllq001 6 biram 19.ogg}} '''Biram:''' I have dedicated my energies to deciphering the many mysteries of our tribe. In doing so, I hope to establish clearer rules that will help sustain our traditions in the future.
:{{A|vo xtlllq001 6 paimon 12.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wow, that sounds great! So have you figured out the mystery of the "gift from the spirits"?
:{{A|vo xtlllq001 6 biram 20.ogg}} '''Biram:''' Sadly not... It is something I have been investigating for a long time, but I have yet to uncover what this "gift" truly refers to.
:{{A|vo xtlllq001 6 biram 21.ogg}} '''Biram:''' Only a small handful of events over the years have been recorded on these special scrolls, with decades between each one.
:{{A|vo xtlllq001 6 biram 22.ogg}} '''Biram:''' And by the time the next scroll-weaver is appointed, my time as chief will be long gone. I will not be in a position to investigate as thoroughly.
:{{A|vo xtlllq001 6 paimon 13.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So...
:{{A|vo xtlllq001 6 biram 23.ogg}} '''Biram:''' While I haven't yet gotten to the bottom of the matter, I have made some progress. But the only way I can develop my theories further is with the cooperation of the appointed ones.
:{{DIcon}} And that's why you want to put us through this test.
:{{A|vo xtlllq001 6 biram 24.ogg}} '''Biram:''' Precisely. It's nothing to be worried about — simply a means of validating my current hypothesis. It shouldn't take you long, nor will it put you in any danger.
:{{DIcon}} Alright. So what does it involve, exactly?
:{{A|vo xtlllq001 6 biram 25.ogg}} '''Biram:''' I can explain everything in detail when we get to the site of the test. But first, please wait a moment while I change out of the Soul-Shielding Cloak.
:{{A|vo xtlllq001 6 biram 26.ogg}} '''Biram:''' This garb is one of our important cultural relics, handed down by generations of chiefs. It is only to be worn when conducting certain ceremonies.
:{{A|vo xtlllq001 6 paimon 14.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh...
:{{Black Screen|Biram removes his cloak and carefully hands it to a priest for safekeeping.}}

:{{A|vo xtlllq001 6 biram 29.ogg}} '''Biram:''' Today's test is, quite simply, to find a way to escape that space.

==Steps==
# Deliver the [[letter]] to the servant at the [[Feiyun Commerce Guild]]
# Talk to [[Xu]] at the Feiyun Commerce Guild
#* You will receive [[A Huge Bag of Mora]]
# Go to the store and buy [[Cor Lapis]] (0/3)

#* Follow the quest marker and talk to [[Shizhuang the Strong]].
# Search for the carts loaded with Cor Lapis (0/5)

# Tell Shizhuang the Strong where to find Cor Lapis
# Purchase [[Chang the Ninth]]'s ore

:{{A|vo yllq002 8 yelan 03.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' We've heard about a certain Zhiyi who's been selling fresh fish at low prices in this area recently. Do you know anything about this?

:{{A|vo yllq002 8 unclegao 06.ogg}} '''Uncle Gao:''' Because he's so poor. His parents died when he was very young and his alcoholic father still owed a huge amount of debt. No one wanted to have anything to do with him.

:{{A|vo yllq002 8 unclegao 10.ogg}} '''Uncle Gao:''' It's not like he catches much anyway, so it's not going to affect my business. Oh... Don't tell him I said that.

:{{A|vo yllq002 8 unclegao 11.ogg}} '''Uncle Gao:''' Well... I spoke to him once, briefly, and I just had a feeling that he really cares what other people think of him.
:{{A|vo yllq002 8 unclegao 12.ogg}} '''Uncle Gao:''' I think he has pretty low self-esteem... But hey, it's hardly my place to say anything. What he's achieved already puts most people to shame.
:{{A|vo yllq002 8 unclegao 13.ogg}} '''Uncle Gao:''' Nobody's perfect. I just wouldn't want to upset him, that's all.
:{{A|vo yllq002 8 yelan 05.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' I see. Well, thank you for sharing that with us.
:{{A|vo yllq002 8 unclegao 14.ogg}} '''Uncle Gao:''' Not a problem. And just for the record, there's absolutely nothing wrong with the price of my fish!
:{{A|vo yllq002 8 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' The more times you say it, the less convincing it becomes...
:{{A|vo yllq002 8 yelan 06.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' "Doesn't have a lot of Mora to his name"... Okay, let's keep going.

:{{A|vo yllq002 9 yelan 05.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' Just as I thought...
:{{A|vo yllq002 9 dugushuo 11.ogg}} '''Dugu Shuo:''' Huh? What do you mean?
:{{A|vo yllq002 9 yelan 06.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' I mean, just as I thought, Master Dugu is indeed as kind and virtuous as the legends claim.
:{{A|vo yllq002 9 dugushuo 12.ogg}} '''Dugu Shuo:''' Heh... I'm not THAT great...
:{{A|vo yllq002 9 dugushuo 13.ogg}} '''Dugu Shuo:''' Oh yeah, one other thing. These days, there's a lot of people I've never seen before talking about Zhiyi's stories in the street. They seemed like nice people.
:{{A|vo yllq002 9 yelan 07.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' Oh, definitely.
:{{A|vo yllq002 9 dugushuo 14.ogg}} '''Dugu Shuo:''' Great! So next time I see them, I'll say hi! And... I guess I can share some of my candies with them, too.
:{{A|vo yllq002 9 yelan 08.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' Certainly! You can also tell my friend in Yanshang Teahouse about what they're up to. I'm sure my friend would also like to say hi to them.

:{{A|vo yllq002 9 yelan 10.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' Any of that sound strange to you?
:{{DIcon}} Yes, I heard it.
:{{DIcon}} I'm completely lost right now.
:{{A|vo yllq002 9 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Strange? What was strange about it?
:{{A|vo yllq002 9 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Zhiyi seems to have a great reputation. Uncle Sun and Uncle Gao spoke highly of him, and Dugu Shuo seems to like him, too...
:{{A|vo yllq002 9 yelan 11.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' True, but the issue is... where did his sudden celebrity come from? It almost seems too good to be true.
:{{A|vo yllq002 9 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Sudden? Too good to be true? What do you mean?
:{{A|vo yllq002 9 yelan 12.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' So he returns cruelty with kindness, and had to work to support his studies... These are the kinds of things that make someone well-known in their hometown. But Uncle Sun said even his friends who travel far and wide hear about him wherever they go. That's a little over the top, if you ask me.
:{{A|vo yllq002 9 yelan 13.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' Do you remember what Dugu Shuo said about Zhiyi's stories? Clearly they left him with a good impression of the guy, but beyond that he wasn't interested in the details. That's the reaction I would expect from any normal person.
:{{A|vo yllq002 9 yelan 14.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' Plus there's the fact that all this praise of Zhiyi has only been happening within the last two or three months.
:{{A|vo yllq002 9 yelan 15.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' His childhood, his studies, the thing with his neighbor... None of these are recent events. So why are these stories only going around now?
:{{A|vo yllq002 9 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' When you put it like that, it is kinda strange...
:{{A|vo yllq002 9 yelan 16.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' Of course, if that's all there was to it, I wouldn't look into it any further.
:{{A|vo yllq002 9 yelan 17.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' Zhiyi was born into a poor family. Paying people to get his stories out there is within the rules of the game, as far as I'm concerned.
:{{A|vo yllq002 9 yelan 18.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' The problem is... do you remember what Uncle Gao said about him? He's stayed poor his whole life. Everything he's earned, he's either spent on studying, traveling, or paying off debts. I don't think he has the Mora to pay for a publicity campaign.
:{{DIcon}} Someone's helping him.
:{{DIcon}} Maybe he's working with someone.
:{{A|vo yllq002 9 yelan 19.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' Right, and that changes everything... It could mean a powerful faction is trying to gain influence over the Liyue Qixing.
:{{A|vo yllq002 9 yelan 20.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' That's the worst-case scenario, but all too often, the most pessimistic speculation turns out to be the closest to the truth.
:{{A|vo yllq002 9 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Someone's trying to gain influence over the Qixing? That sounds serious. What should we do?
:{{A|vo yllq002 9 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Even if we asked Zhiyi about it, surely there's no way he'd admit it.
:{{A|vo yllq002 9 yelan 21.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' First we need to find out who's supporting him... Don't worry, I've got a plan.
:{{A|vo yllq002 9 yelan 22.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' Remember the Current Affairs and Planning stage of the assessment? Since the successful candidate is duty bound to implement their plan after taking office, their manifesto tells us their stance on key issues.
:{{A|vo yllq002 9 yelan 23.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' Whoever is secretly helping Zhiyi must be seeking to benefit from his actions after his appointment. So we should be able to find some hints in Zhiyi's manifesto on who we're dealing with.
:{{A|vo yllq002 9 yelan 24.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' Come on, let's get back to Yanshang Teahouse.

:{{A|vo yllq002 12 shanghua 01.ogg}} '''Shanghua:''' Aha, looks like I'm the first one back, as usual.
:{{A|vo yllq002 12 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, hey, it's one of Yelan's little helpers, Shanghua!
:{{A|vo yllq002 12 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' If you're back, that means... that means you've finished investigating Qianwei, right?
:{{A|vo yllq002 12 shanghua 02.ogg}} '''Shanghua:''' You betcha. I visited all the commerce guilds and gathered a wealth of information. Every time they asked me to leave, but I always had another trick up my sleeve...
:{{A|vo yllq002 12 yelan 01.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' Don't drag this out. Just tell us your findings.
:{{A|vo yllq002 12 shanghua 03.ogg}} '''Shanghua:''' Yes, Lady Yelan.
:{{A|vo yllq002 12 shanghua 04.ogg}} '''Shanghua:''' To summarize my findings, most people who've had interactions with Qianwei will start out complaining about how proud and arrogant he is, but then go on to give a generally positive appraisal of him.
:{{A|vo yllq002 12 shanghua 05.ogg}} '''Shanghua:''' The young master of the [[Feiyun Commerce Guild]] said that Qianwei appears arrogant, but he's very scrupulous in the way he works.
:{{A|vo yllq002 12 shanghua 06.ogg}} '''Shanghua:''' Once he signs a contract with somebody, he treats them fairly regardless of their background.
:{{A|vo yllq002 12 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Who'd have thought!
:{{A|vo yllq002 12 yelan 02.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' Is it possible that his reputation is fake? Is there any way you can check the accounts of the businesses under his name?
:{{A|vo yllq002 12 shanghua 07.ogg}} '''Shanghua:''' In theory, that should be very difficult. But here's the thing... I asked around and found out that almost all of Qianwei's accounts are open to the public.
:{{A|vo yllq002 12 shanghua 08.ogg}} '''Shanghua:''' Where he buys from and sells to should be confidential business information, but he doesn't seem interested in protecting it at all.
:{{A|vo yllq002 12 shanghua 09.ogg}} '''Shanghua:''' Qianwei often sees business opportunities that others don't. But once he's made enough Mora off of it, it's like he gets sick of it and releases all of his trade secrets.
:{{A|vo yllq002 12 shanghua 10.ogg}} '''Shanghua:''' It's like he wants people to know that they still can't beat him even if he shares all of his secrets. The fact that someone like that can still make Mora is pretty infuriating when you think about it!
:{{A|vo yllq002 12 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What a strange guy. It's like he's not doing business to make Mora, but instead...
:{{A|vo yllq002 12 yelan 03.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' To validate his theories. No wonder his manifesto contains so many insights — it's all the result of his firsthand experimentation.
:{{A|vo yllq002 12 wenyuan 01.ogg}} '''Wenyuan:''' I'm back... Huh? How come you're here?
:{{A|vo yllq002 12 shanghua 11.ogg}} '''Shanghua:''' Why do you think? Obviously, because I possess superior skills and am always one step ahead of the competition... Well, when you're the competition, at least.
:{{A|vo yllq002 12 wenyuan 02.ogg}} '''Wenyuan:''' You... Whatever, I'm not getting into an argument with you. If I hadn't had something else to take care of on the way, I would've been back long before you.
:{{A|vo yllq002 12 wenyuan 03.ogg}} '''Wenyuan:''' Lady Yelan, I have finished investigating Mingbo.
:{{A|vo yllq002 12 yelan 04.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' Well, we're all ears.
:{{A|vo yllq002 12 wenyuan 04.ogg}} '''Wenyuan:''' The Ministry of Civil Affairs says that Mingbo struggles to get his words out when he gets nervous, especially when he's chatting with strangers.
:{{A|vo yllq002 12 wenyuan 05.ogg}} '''Wenyuan:''' But after a few days of getting to know him, you can pretty much have a normal conversation with him. On the whole, the feedback from the Ministry of Civil Affairs was very positive. He always considers the things that everyone else overlooks.
:{{A|vo yllq002 12 yelan 05.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' In your opinion, was the Ministry of Civil Affairs' appraisal of Mingbo at all exaggerated?
:{{A|vo yllq002 12 wenyuan 06.ogg}} '''Wenyuan:''' I don't believe so. Mingbo is someone who has slowly but surely earned the reputation he has today.
:{{A|vo yllq002 12 wenyuan 07.ogg}} '''Wenyuan:''' According to [[Ms. Yu]], the Ministry often gets Mingbo to take a final look at projects before they're implemented. People feel much more confident in something if it has his stamp of approval.
:{{A|vo yllq002 12 wenyuan 08.ogg}} '''Wenyuan:''' Oh, and also, there was once someone in the Ministry who was lying and cheating to try to advance their career. Mingbo gave them the scolding of a lifetime. Apparently, he can be terrifying when he loses his temper... I haven't seen it for myself though.
:{{A|vo yllq002 12 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Whoa... That's hard to imagine...
:{{A|vo yllq002 12 yelan 06.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' Like I said before: Things are not always as they appear.
:{{A|vo yllq002 12 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ah, so that's what you meant by that. Paimon's starting to get it now...
:{{A|vo yllq002 12 yelan 07.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' Thank you both. You're free to go now.
:{{A|vo yllq002 12 yelan 08.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' So, have you finished reading the manifesto, {{Traveler}}?
:{{A|vo yllq002 12 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' We still have a bit left, hehe.
:{{Black Screen|You finish reading the manifesto with Yelan.}}
:{{A|vo yllq002 12 yelan 09.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' Hmm... I can't see any immediate problems looking at the individual entries.
:{{A|vo yllq002 12 yelan 10.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' The only one that strikes me as a little unusual is the [[Qingxu Pool]] Redevelopment Plan.
:{{DIcon}} What's that?
:{{A|vo yllq002 12 yelan 11.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' Qingxu Pool has always been home to many secrets. Plus, [[Azhdaha]] once wrought havoc there, so there are even more secrets buried deep underground.
:{{A|vo yllq002 12 yelan 12.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' At some point, a rumor began to go around that there is great treasure buried beneath Qingxu Pool.
:{{A|vo yllq002 12 yelan 13.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' A long time ago, with the approval of the Qixing, a mining team conducted an exploratory excavation there.
:{{A|vo yllq002 12 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So... did they find any treasure?
:{{A|vo yllq002 12 yelan 14.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' None. The ruin was completely impenetrable. The only way they could have gotten through the solid rock would've been by blowing it open with a special kind of explosive.
:{{A|vo yllq002 12 yelan 15.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' The technology wasn't mature enough at that time, so the excavation project was shut down, and the "treasure" became a mere legend.
:{{A|vo yllq002 12 yelan 16.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' Zhiyi's manifesto focuses on solving problems, and this treasure hunt seems extremely risky. It seems out of step with the rest of his plans.
:{{A|vo yllq002 12 yelan 17.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' Still, this one fact alone doesn't tell us much. Everyone wants to get their hands on this treasure — the Treasure Hoarders, the Fatui, even local Liyue factions...
:{{A|vo yllq002 12 yelan 18.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' Did you find anything?
:{{A|vo yllq002 12 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' "Excavation," "project," "treasure"... Did we read anything similar in our half of the manifesto, {{Traveler}}?
:{{DIcon}} The Blackcliff Forge...
:{{DIcon}} The "Rock" chapter.
:{{A|vo yllq002 12 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh yeah! Zhiyi said the Blackcliff Forge workers should get right of first refusal if any suitable projects come up!
:{{A|vo yllq002 12 yelan 19.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' Did he now? Well, that makes everything much clearer... So Zhiyi wants the Blackcliff Forge to excavate the treasure of Qingxu Pool.
:{{A|vo yllq002 12 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Does that mean the Blackcliff Forge is Zhiyi's secret supporter?
:{{A|vo yllq002 12 yelan 20.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' No, not likely. I've looked into the Blackcliff Forge before. They aren't involved with any powerful factions at present.
:{{A|vo yllq002 12 yelan 21.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' They do possess some specialized explosives, but it would seem more trouble than it's worth to put so many resources into a risky project like this.
:{{A|vo yllq002 12 yelan 22.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' Still, since the clues are pointing toward the Blackcliff Forge, we should see where they lead. We may well find something new.

:{{A|vo yllq002 12 paimon 12.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Qianwei and Mingbo both turned out to be completely different than what we thought...
:{{A|vo yllq002 12 paimon 13.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What about Zhiyi? ...Is there another side to him, too?
{{Dialogue End}}

:{{A|vo yllq002 14 yelan 05.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' At this rate, by the time the Qingxu Pool Redevelopment Plan is ready to roll, they'll be the technical backbone of the team.
:{{A|vo yllq002 14 yelan 06.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' That'll give them the chance to take a lot of liberties... They can copy any secret texts or steal any treasure they find underground.
:{{A|vo yllq002 14 yelan 07.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' Imagine if we didn't suspect anything. By the time Zhiyi recommends the Blackcliff Forge for the excavation project, at most we would maybe do a fresh background check on the place.
:{{A|vo yllq002 14 yelan 08.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' No red flags if all they did was change some key staff. And even if we decided to vet the staff individually, they'd have had more than enough time by then to come up with fake identities.
:{{A|vo yllq002 14 yelan 09.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' That's the advantage of planning this far in advance... It was a clever move.
:{{A|vo yllq002 14 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' When you put it like that, it all makes sense... If we hadn't found this out, someone else would've stolen the treasure!
:{{A|vo yllq002 14 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So who's really behind all this?
:{{A|vo yllq002 14 yelan 10.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' That's a question for the newcomers. But let's start with that worker over there for now.

:{{A|vo yllq002 15 ironshoulder 01.ogg}} '''Iron Shoulder:''' *sigh* You want them to teach you or something?
:{{A|vo yllq002 15 ironshoulder 02.ogg}} '''Iron Shoulder:''' I gotta say, these newcomers are in tip-top shape. Fast learners, too. They're picking up all the skills unbelievably fast.
:{{A|vo yllq002 15 ironshoulder 03.ogg}} '''Iron Shoulder:''' My only complaint is that they're always going out drinking at night, but they never let us join them.
:{{A|vo yllq002 15 ironshoulder 04.ogg}} '''Iron Shoulder:''' I guess they just need some time to adjust. I'm sure we'll get to know each other over time.
:{{A|vo yllq002 15 yelan 01.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' They go out drinking? This area isn't exactly renowned for the nightlife. I'm guessing it's a long trip to the nearest tavern?
:{{A|vo yllq002 15 ironshoulder 05.ogg}} '''Iron Shoulder:''' You got that right. They tell me they go all the way back to Liyue Harbor to drink at [[Wanmin Restaurant]].
:{{A|vo yllq002 15 ironshoulder 06.ogg}} '''Iron Shoulder:''' It rained after work today, so they actually stuck around at the site for a while. But as soon as the rain stopped, they went out drinking again right away.
:{{A|vo yllq002 15 ironshoulder 07.ogg}} '''Iron Shoulder:''' Hey, you're only young once, right? I say, if they can hack it, let 'em at it, haha.
:{{A|vo yllq002 15 yelan 02.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' Interesting. Let's go talk somewhere else, {{Traveler}}.

;(After investigating the four spots)
:{{A|vo yllq002 24 yelan 01.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' Looks like we were too late.
:{{A|vo yllq002 24 yelan 02.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' This has gotta be where the newcomers rendezvous with whoever they're working for. But all the evidence has been destroyed.
:{{A|vo yllq002 24 yelan 03.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' Look at these ashes. Someone was burning documents not long before we arrived.
:{{A|vo yllq002 24 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Could there be anything left? Maybe the wind could've blown the fire out before everything was finished burning?
:{{A|vo yllq002 24 yelan 04.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' The odds of that are very slim. It's practically impossible. I've checked — all the paper's been burned. There's only ash left now.
:{{A|vo yllq002 24 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Why don't we wait for them back at the Blackcliff Forge? They've gotta go back there sooner or later.
:{{A|vo yllq002 24 yelan 05.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' We can't count on that. Clearly, they were based here at one point, but it's mysteriously abandoned now.
:{{A|vo yllq002 24 yelan 06.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' To me, that says that whoever's behind this has moved them somewhere else to throw our investigation off course.
:{{A|vo yllq002 24 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Darn... Guess this is where our trail runs cold!
:{{A|vo yllq002 24 yelan 07.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' Make no mistake, the purpose of our trip wasn't to find any solid evidence. We just need to figure out who's behind Zhiyi.
:{{A|vo yllq002 24 yelan 08.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' I smelled something peculiar the moment I came in.
:{{A|vo yllq002 24 yelan 09.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' Those newcomers probably thought they'd be safe as long as they burned the letters. But what they failed to consider is that paper and ink from different regions produce different odors when they're burned.
:{{A|vo yllq002 24 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Really? *sniff* Paimon can't smell anything! Do you smell anything, {{Traveler}}?
:{{DIcon}} I smell a very gentle fragrance.
:{{A|vo yllq002 24 yelan 10.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' There is a certain place with a freezing-cold climate where there's nothing but ice as far as the eye can see.
:{{A|vo yllq002 24 yelan 11.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' Some wealthy people there put floral fragrance in their ink as a way of injecting a little romance into their writing.
:{{A|vo yllq002 24 yelan 12.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' When that fragrant ink is burned, this is the exact odor that it leaves behind...
:{{DIcon}} Snezhnaya...
:{{DIcon}} The Fatui!
:{{A|vo yllq002 24 yelan 13.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' Exactly. The evidence will soon be blown away by the wind, so it's nothing we can arrest anyone with.
:{{A|vo yllq002 24 yelan 14.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' But it's all I need. Now I know who we're dealing with, I can plan our next move.
:{{A|vo yllq002 24 wupei 01.ogg}} '''???:''' Lady Yelan! Oh, thank goodness I finally found you! *sob* ...I thought I'd never see you again!
:{{A|vo yllq002 24 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' ...Um, who are you?
:{{A|vo yllq002 24 yelan 15.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' Don't be alarmed, this is [[Wupei]]. He's Wenyuan and Shanghua's colleague.
:{{A|vo yllq002 24 yelan 16.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' I sent him to look into Zhiyi's regular contacts. Since Zhiyi likes fishing, Wupei thought he might know some of the fishermen and sailors, so he took a boat out to sea to ask around.
:{{A|vo yllq002 24 yelan 17.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' I left him a note at Yanshang Teahouse telling him to look for me at Blackcliff Forge when he got back. If there'd been an ambush waiting for us there, it means we'd have had some backup.
:{{A|vo yllq002 24 yelan 18.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' So, what did you find out at sea?
:{{A|vo yllq002 24 wupei 02.ogg}} '''Wupei:''' *sigh* Forgive my incompetence. I'm afraid I've come up empty-handed.
:{{A|vo yllq002 24 wupei 03.ogg}} '''Wupei:''' I asked all the fishermen multiple times, but none of them had had any interactions with Zhiyi before. Then the waves got so choppy I ended up falling overboard. Fortunately, someone managed to drag me out.
:{{A|vo yllq002 24 wupei 04.ogg}} '''Wupei:''' When I got back, I heard that you'd gone to Blackcliff Forge and might need backup, so I went straight there as fast as I could. Didn't even stop to change my clothes.
:{{A|vo yllq002 24 yelan 19.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' Oh? Well, Uncle Tian said that Zhiyi once bought a recipe from one of the fishermen. Did you hear anything about that at all?
:{{A|vo yllq002 24 wupei 05.ogg}} '''Wupei:''' What? That's news to me.
:{{A|vo yllq002 24 wupei 06.ogg}} '''Wupei:''' No, that's not possible... It's absolutely not possible! Lady Yelan, I'm telling you — I spoke to every single fisherman out there, and none of them mentioned anything about a recipe.
:{{A|vo yllq002 24 yelan 20.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' Interesting... Then I wonder how that "even more wonderful" fish soup came about?
:{{A|vo yllq002 24 wupei 07.ogg}} '''Wupei:''' Fish soup? What fish soup?
:{{A|vo yllq002 24 yelan 21.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' Nothing. Our priority right now is to find a way to get our hands on some solid evidence.
:{{A|vo yllq002 24 yelan 22.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' Well, any suggestions?
:{{DIcon}} Send someone to tail them?
:{{DIcon}} Catch them red-handed when they meet...
:{{A|vo yllq002 24 yelan 23.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' Not a bad idea. Wupei, what do you think?
:{{A|vo yllq002 24 wupei 08.ogg}} '''Wupei:''' Honestly, I've already tried following Zhiyi. But the guy's too cautious. Never meets with anyone suspicious.
:{{A|vo yllq002 24 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Okay, so tailing's out...
:{{A|vo yllq002 24 yelan 24.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' No, we'll still need to tail him. But first, we need to do some groundwork.
:{{A|vo yllq002 24 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Groundwork?
:{{A|vo yllq002 24 yelan 25.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' When you've worked in intelligence for a long time, you'll understand that no one can stay on high alert forever. Especially... when he thinks he's about to win.
:{{A|vo yllq002 24 yelan 26.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' Tomorrow morning, I'll announce his victory at Yuehai {{sic|Pavillion}}. Take a guess, what do you think he'll do next?
:{{A|vo yllq002 24 yelan 27.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' Be sure to arrive on time. You won't wanna miss the show.

'''''Cards Out! Grievances Begone''''' is an [[Event Quest]] during the [[Duel! The Summoners' Summit!]] event.

==Steps==
# Wait until the following day (08:00 – 10:00)
# Go to [[Ritou]] to investigate the Card Snatcher
# Look for clues in Ritou
# Go to the Ritou competition venue and look for [[Sangonomiya Kokomi|Kokomi]]
# Talk to [[Arataki Itto|Itto]]

;(Pass time)
:{{A|vo dpeq003 1 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Last night was so much fun! Paimon had a great time chatting with everyone. Hopefully we'll find someone in Inazuma to treat us to a meal, too!
