;(Approach the Ritou Docks)
:{{A|vo dpeq003 2 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Whoa, look! Promo posters everywhere, from the moment you arrive in the harbor!
:{{A|vo dpeq003 2 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hmm, Paimon gets more and more curious about the two inventors of this game every time we see the posters.
:{{A|vo dpeq003 2 charlotte 01.ogg}} '''Charlotte:''' You're not the only one. There's so little information to go off of that there's all sorts of wild speculations about them.
:{{A|vo dpeq003 2 charlotte 02.ogg}} '''Charlotte:''' Some people say that they invented the game after the God of Wisdom gave them an epiphany, while others say that they're not actually the inventors at all...
:{{A|vo dpeq003 2 charlotte 03.ogg}} '''Charlotte:''' By the way, have you two ever read a book called King of Invokations?
:{{DIcon}} Haven't read it, no...
:{{DIcon}} I've only heard of it...
:{{A|vo dpeq003 2 charlotte 04.ogg}} '''Charlotte:''' Well, it's a story about a young boy who gets possessed by the spirit of the Crocodile King and becomes a TCG player. It's quite fascinating. I made sure to read it before coming on this trip.
:{{A|vo dpeq003 2 charlotte 05.ogg}} '''Charlotte:''' Some people have even speculated that the author of King of Invokations is the boy who was possessed, while the true inventors of the game are the Crocodile King and Ibis King from the legends...
:{{A|vo dpeq003 2 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Each of these theories gets more ridiculous than the last...
:{{A|vo dpeq003 2 charlotte 06.ogg}} '''Charlotte:''' Exactly, which is why the original author came forward to deny these rumors.
:{{A|vo dpeq003 2 charlotte 07.ogg}} '''Charlotte:''' But that only fueled the debate further, and the book's sales skyrocketed.
:{{A|vo dpeq003 2 charlotte 08.ogg}} '''Charlotte:''' It can't be denied that the King of Invokations novels are a major part of why Genius Invokation TCG has become so popular.
:{{A|vo dpeq003 2 charlotte 09.ogg}} '''Charlotte:''' Just look at the venue, they're almost treating this like a national festival. I bet the book is going to sell more copies after this.
:{{A|vo dpeq003 2 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Heh, you can be sure that the fox lady is behind all this.
:{{A|vo dpeq003 2 charlotte 10.ogg}} '''Charlotte:''' Fox lady?
:{{A|vo dpeq003 2 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yeah, [[Yae Miko]]! She's chief editor of the [[Yae Publishing House]]. Paimon can just imagine her eating some Fried Tofu as she instructs her editors to use this event to boost light novel sales.
:{{A|vo dpeq003 2 charlotte 11.ogg}} '''Charlotte:''' Ah yes, I've been in that situation many times myself. Although in our case, the boss would be drinking coffee and talking about newspaper sales...
:{{A|vo dpeq003 2 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Sounds like bosses are the same everywhere...

;(Approach the marked area)
:{{A|vo dpeq003 3 charlotte 01.ogg}} '''Charlotte:''' The scenery in every nation is so different. This trip is really paying dividends!
:{{A|vo dpeq003 3 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Good thing that you're able to be so optimistic about it. It sounded like you were pretty much forced to come on this trip whether you wanted to or not...
:{{A|vo dpeq003 3 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh? Wait, is that who Paimon thinks it is? It's [[Ei]]!
:{{A|vo dpeq003 3 raidenei 01.ogg}} '''Ei:''' {{Traveler}}, Paimon, we meet again.
:{{A|vo dpeq003 3 charlotte 02.ogg}} '''Charlotte:''' Oh, who is this?

:{{A|vo dpeq003 3 charlotte 04.ogg}} '''Charlotte:''' Right, uh... I mean, okay...
:{{A|vo dpeq003 3 charlotte 05.ogg}} '''Charlotte:''' Whew, each of your acquaintances is more impressive than the last.
:{{A|vo dpeq003 3 raidenei 03.ogg}} '''Ei:''' Miko invited me here to experience the fun and festivities along with everybody else.
:{{A|vo dpeq003 3 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, Paimon gets it. The tournament venue is full of excitement and tasty food, and Miko didn't want you to miss out.
:{{A|vo dpeq003 3 charlotte 06.ogg}} '''Charlotte:''' I... guess I'll let you catch up for now. We can meet up later, just like last time.
:{{A|vo dpeq003 3 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Sure thing. See ya, Charlotte!
:{{A|vo dpeq003 3 raidenei 04.ogg}} '''Ei:''' Perhaps she felt a little intimidated by me?
:{{A|vo dpeq003 3 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' She's probably fine. Don't worry, she didn't leave because of you, we've split up like this in the previous places we've visited, too.
:{{A|vo dpeq003 3 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So, how do you like Genius Invokation TCG? Paimon bets you're enjoying watching the tournament matches.
:{{A|vo dpeq003 3 raidenei 05.ogg}} '''Ei:''' Well... In fact, I myself am competing in the tournament.
:{{A|vo dpeq003 3 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wait, really!?
:{{A|vo dpeq003 3 raidenei 06.ogg}} '''Ei:''' Why is that surprising? Playing cards is an ancient form of entertainment, and I was curious to see what card games are like in this day and age.
:{{DIcon}} How's the tournament been?
:{{A|vo dpeq003 3 raidenei 07.ogg}} '''Ei:''' I advanced all the way to the semifinals.
:{{A|vo dpeq003 3 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' The semifinals? That's amazing! So when's your next match?
:{{A|vo dpeq003 3 raidenei 08.ogg}} '''Ei:''' Unfortunately, the semifinals is where my journey ended. The reason being...
:{{A|vo dpeq003 3 yaemiko 01.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' The reason being that she lost to me. And when I say "lost," that doesn't begin to do it justice. It was quite a humiliating defeat.
:{{DIcon}} How unfortunate...
:{{DIcon}} Didn't see that coming...
:{{A|vo dpeq003 3 yaemiko 02.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' Hehe, I'll pretend I didn't hear that.
:{{A|vo dpeq003 3 raidenei 09.ogg}} '''Ei:''' I only lost because I was duped by her little tricks.
:{{A|vo dpeq003 3 yaemiko 03.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' What's wrong with my little tricks? Trickery within the scope of the rules is better known as ingenuity. It's not my fault that some people spend all their time cooped up in Tenshukaku and never have the chance to hone their skills.
:{{A|vo dpeq003 3 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What a unique friendship...
:{{A|vo dpeq003 3 raidenei 10.ogg}} '''Ei:''' Huh... You're right, though. I should make an effort to get out more.
:{{A|vo dpeq003 3 raidenei 11.ogg}} '''Ei:''' Many things have changed now that Inazuma is at peace. However... it seems that some people continue to fear the "divine light" just as before.
:{{A|vo dpeq003 3 raidenei 12.ogg}} '''Ei:''' In some of my tournament matches, I could see my opponent's hands shaking, hesitant to play their cards. Now that I think about it, perhaps they were scared of what would happen if they defeated me...
:{{DIcon}} Oh, Ei...
:{{DIcon}} You can't blame them.
:{{A|vo dpeq003 3 yaemiko 04.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' *yawn* Dear, dear. Other players lose their games and throw a tantrum... You win yours, and yet you still find a reason to mope about it.
:{{A|vo dpeq003 3 yaemiko 05.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' I invited you out for some simple fun and games... *sigh* I should have known you'd be like this.
:{{A|vo dpeq003 3 yaemiko 06.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' Anyway, you should watch and learn, because I plan on using some more of my "little tricks" to defeat that Divine Priestess from Watatsumi Island.
:{{A|vo dpeq003 3 paimon 12.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh? So Kokomi's your opponent in the finals?
:{{A|vo dpeq003 3 yaemiko 07.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' Mm-hmm. On one side will be your erstwhile comrade in arms, the leader of Watatsumi Island, and on the other will be head shrine maiden Yae Miko, the wise and beautiful. So, little one, who will you support?
:{{DIcon}} Sangonomiya Kokomi.
::{{A|vo dpeq003 3 yaemiko 08a 1.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' Hah, the nerve, saying that in the presence of me and Ei! Are you trying to find out whose lightning strikes faster?
:{{DIcon}} Yae Miko.
::{{A|vo dpeq003 3 yaemiko 08b 1.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' Good choice.
:{{DIcon}} Uhh...
:{{A|vo dpeq003 3 raidenei 13.ogg}} '''Ei:''' Miko, come on... no need to put them on the spot like that.
:{{A|vo dpeq003 3 yaemiko 09.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' Hehe, I know. I just wanted to see how they'd react.
:{{A|vo dpeq003 3 yaemiko 10.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' The venue is right over there. Why not go and take a walk around? Oh, and if you meet my fellow finalist, do pass on my regards.

==Steps==
# Go to the desert auction site
# Defeat the ambushing monsters
#* {{Enemy|Scorpion|x=4}}
# Talk to [[Cyno]]
# Continue heading to the desert auction
# Defeat the ambushing monsters

# Leave the auction with the tracker
# Meet up with Cyno
# Follow [[Bahari]] to [[Aaru Village]]

==Dialogue==
{{Quest Description|You repelled the chasing mercenaries and now it is time to leave for the desert.}}

;(Approach the auction site)
:{{A|vo cnlq002 7 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh! Looks like Cyno caught someone!
:{{A|vo cnlq002 7 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So you're the bad guy behind all this, aren't ya? Alright, tell Paimon everything you know!
:{{DIcon}} Does he know anything about the smuggling?
:{{DIcon}} Does he have an important role in the auction?
:{{A|vo cnlq002 7 cyno 01.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' I didn't act immediately when he showed up. Rather, I laid low and observed for a while instead.
:{{A|vo cnlq002 7 cyno 02.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' He is not the primary instigator, but he is most likely one of the more important dealers here. Am I right?
:{{A|vo cnlq002 7 bahari 01.ogg}} '''Bahari:''' Yes, impressive... You certainly live up to your reputation, Cyno. If I had any idea you were still around, I wouldn't have gotten so greedy.
:{{A|vo cnlq002 7 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh? Greedy? What do you mean by that?
:{{A|vo cnlq002 7 bahari 02.ogg}} '''Bahari:''' Once everyone knew you were coming, all the Canned Knowledge dealers abandoned their goods and fled at once. Obviously, there wasn't time to pack up everything.
:{{A|vo cnlq002 7 bahari 03.ogg}} '''Bahari:''' Since all the goods were just left here unsupervised, I thought I'd use the opportunity to come back and take what I could. You know, free merchandise is good business, but... *sigh* I suppose there's no use explaining it now.
:{{A|vo cnlq002 7 cyno 03.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' You must know who's manufacturing and selling the Canned Knowledge, correct? Will you tell us willingly, or do I need to make you talk?
:{{A|vo cnlq002 7 bahari 04.ogg}} '''Bahari:''' No, no, I'll talk. But before that, perhaps we can take the conversation elsewhere?
:{{A|vo cnlq002 7 bahari 05.ogg}} '''Bahari:''' If we stay here, chances are that someone will see me with you. That would put both me and my family in danger.
:{{A|vo cnlq002 7 cyno 04.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Alright. Where do you suggest we go?
:{{A|vo cnlq002 7 bahari 06.ogg}} '''Bahari:''' How about my home in Aaru Village? It should be safe there.
:{{A|vo cnlq002 7 cyno 05.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Fine, let's head out. You can throw away the tracker now, {{Traveler}}.

:{{A|vo cnlq002 8 bahari 01.ogg}} '''Bahari:''' C'mon now, do you really think I'd try to pull anything under Cyno's watch? Seriously, what can I even do?

{{Quest Description|update|You caught a man who returned to the auction, and he invited you to Aaru Village to have a talk.}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Approach Bahari's house)
:{{A|vo cnlq002 9 simin 01.ogg}} '''Simin:''' Dad, you're back!
:{{A|vo cnlq002 9 simin 02.ogg}} '''Simin:''' Oh, we have guests? Uh, hi there...
:{{A|vo cnlq002 9 bahari 01.ogg}} '''Bahari:''' This is my daughter, Simin. She can be a little shy of strangers.
:{{A|vo cnlq002 9 bahari 02.ogg}} '''Bahari:''' Why don't you run along now, dear? Dad needs to talk with our guests.
:{{A|vo cnlq002 9 simin 03.ogg}} '''Simin:''' Oh... okay.
:{{A|vo cnlq002 9 bahari 03.ogg}} '''Bahari:''' Everyone knows Cyno in our business, but let me ask, who are you two?
:{{A|vo cnlq002 9 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Paimon is Paimon, and this is {{Traveler}}!
:{{A|vo cnlq002 9 bahari 04.ogg}} '''Bahari:''' To be honest, I really didn't expect to see Cyno the lone operator working with any partners. When I saw the tracker start moving away, I assumed you had decided to just go back empty-handed.
:{{A|vo cnlq002 9 bahari 05.ogg}} '''Bahari:''' But even though you caught me, I'd still urge you to stop while you still can. You should abandon this investigation.
:{{A|vo cnlq002 9 cyno 01.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Why's that?
:{{A|vo cnlq002 9 bahari 06.ogg}} '''Bahari:''' Everything from the manufacturing of Canned Knowledge, to the sales and even splitting the profits... every step of the process involves dozens, if not hundreds of people. Massive profits have brought everyone together in this business.
:{{A|vo cnlq002 9 bahari 07.ogg}} '''Bahari:''' Everyone will try their best to defend this industry that we've worked to build. It will be a long and difficult fight, even for you, Cyno.
:{{A|vo cnlq002 9 bahari 08.ogg}} '''Bahari:''' And even if you manage to win in the end, no one will thank you. If anything, you yourself might even feel remorse... Why are you so bent on putting us out of business?
:{{A|vo cnlq002 9 cyno 02.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Everyone has their own reasons for what they do. I don't have to explain mine.
:{{A|vo cnlq002 9 bahari 09.ogg}} '''Bahari:''' *sigh*...
:{{A|vo cnlq002 9 simin 04.ogg}} '''Simin:''' Here's some tea, Dad... and for the guests, too.
:{{A|vo cnlq002 9 bahari 10.ogg}} '''Bahari:''' Ah, right. I forgot to offer tea to our guests. Thank you.
:{{A|vo cnlq002 9 simin 05.ogg}} '''Simin:''' Don't mention it... And, uh...
:{{A|vo cnlq002 9 simin 06.ogg}} '''Simin:''' I should tell you that our tea tastes kinda bitter, but I put some sugar in to make it a little tastier.
:{{A|vo cnlq002 9 bahari 11.ogg}} '''Bahari:''' That's my girl. Do we still have any sugar left? If not, I'll buy some more next time.
:{{A|vo cnlq002 9 simin 07.ogg}} '''Simin:''' Yes, we do... Okay, I'm gonna go have a rest now.
:{{A|vo cnlq002 9 cyno 03.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Didn't you say that everyone's in it for the massive profits? That sure doesn't seem to be the case for you.
:{{A|vo cnlq002 9 bahari 12.ogg}} '''Bahari:''' Ahem, actually that's what I wanted to talk to you about. I was hoping to ask you for a favor.
:{{A|vo cnlq002 9 bahari 13.ogg}} '''Bahari:''' My daughter was born with a chronic disease, so she has a relatively weak heart and lungs. Even slightly strenuous exercise can cause her to faint and prove to be a life-threatening risk.
:{{A|vo cnlq002 9 bahari 14.ogg}} '''Bahari:''' That's why she's never really had any friends to play with, and why she locks herself up in her room most of the time. She has to take lots of medicine, and it doesn't come cheap.
:{{A|vo cnlq002 9 bahari 15.ogg}} '''Bahari:''' As for me, I was just an average merchant. I would wake up early and travel all around to make a profit, but the Mora was still nowhere near enough. I could only watch my daughter's health deteriorate day by day.
:{{A|vo cnlq002 9 bahari 16.ogg}} '''Bahari:''' Until one day, someone reached out and showed me a way to really make a profit...
:{{A|vo cnlq002 9 cyno 04.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Selling Canned Knowledge?
:{{A|vo cnlq002 9 bahari 17.ogg}} '''Bahari:''' That's right. With all the Mora I made, I could finally afford medical treatment for my daughter. Nothing made me happier than seeing her get better.
:{{A|vo cnlq002 9 bahari 18.ogg}} '''Bahari:''' There are many others like me. Smuggling Canned Knowledge might seem like an unforgivable crime to you, but to us, it's a means of survival.
:{{A|vo cnlq002 9 bahari 19.ogg}} '''Bahari:''' I wanted to tell you all this so that maybe you could understand and change your mind. Please stay out of this, Cyno. Give us a way to survive.
:{{A|vo cnlq002 9 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh no... That means that if we prevent the sale of Canned Knowledge, his daughter will...
:{{DIcon}} ...
:{{A|vo cnlq002 9 cyno 05.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' ...
:{{A|vo cnlq002 9 cyno 06.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' I must get to the truth.
:{{A|vo cnlq002 9 cyno 07.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' I can find someone to help treat your child, but I cannot turn a blind eye to the smuggling. These are two completely different issues.
:{{A|vo cnlq002 9 bahari 20.ogg}} '''Bahari:''' *sigh* I somehow knew you would say that, but having your word to help my daughter is enough for me. Since you insist on continuing the investigation, you should have a look around the back of my home.
:{{A|vo cnlq002 9 bahari 21.ogg}} '''Bahari:''' You'll find some goods I received just recently. I think everything will become clear to you once you see them.
:{{Black Screen|You go to the back of the house with Cyno.}}
:{{A|vo cnlq002 9 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Whoa! Look at all of this!
:{{A|vo cnlq002 9 cyno 08.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Yes, all neatly packed away and organized in boxes. To think that this is only one dealer's worth...
:{{A|vo cnlq002 9 cyno 09.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Small producers couldn't possibly support such a large quantity of goods. Hmm, could the Akademiya have a hand in this? But such a volume of goods wouldn't be able to slip through inspection...
:{{A|vo cnlq002 9 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hey, look! These seem different from the other Knowledge Capsules we've seen. Maybe they contain knowledge about the Court of Desolation?
:{{A|vo cnlq002 9 cyno 10.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Yes, that would make sense. Wait, what's this...?
:{{DIcon}} Some sort of marking we've never seen before.
:{{DIcon}} Do you know what it is, Cyno?
:{{A|vo cnlq002 9 cyno 11.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Yes, it's a matra seal, indicating that the goods have passed matra inspection.
:{{A|vo cnlq002 9 cyno 12.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' I started to suspect that someone in the Akademiya might be involved when I found the tracker earlier, but how they could ship so much Canned Knowledge out of the Akademiya was still a mystery.
:{{A|vo cnlq002 9 cyno 13.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' The pieces have now all fallen into place. With this matra seal, goods can leave the Akademiya without undergoing a second inspection.
:{{A|vo cnlq002 9 cyno 14.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Hmph, no wonder they don't want me to investigate. It turns out that a matra is behind this. Even I find it hard to believe.
:{{DIcon}} It could be a misunderstanding.
:{{A|vo cnlq002 9 cyno 15.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Could I ask you for a favor, {{Traveler}}?
:{{A|vo cnlq002 9 cyno 16.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Since all this Canned Knowledge came from the Akademiya, then it's highly likely that the knowledge regarding the Court of Desolation originated from research files stored within the Akademiya.
:{{A|vo cnlq002 9 cyno 17.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' If we can enter the repository, we can find out who accessed these files.
:{{A|vo cnlq002 9 cyno 18.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' But considering my current status, if I suddenly show up at the Akademiya now, it will only draw unnecessary attention.
:{{A|vo cnlq002 9 cyno 19.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' You'll need to be the one who checks the records. I'll write a letter to [[Nabil]] and he'll take you there.
:{{A|vo cnlq002 9 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Sure thing, leave it to us!
:{{A|vo cnlq002 9 cyno 20.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' I'll also keep working here in the meantime. Although our leads all are currently pointing to someone within the Akademiya, it's obvious that they also have power outside of it.
:{{A|vo cnlq002 9 cyno 21.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' We can get more information on other dealers from Bahari. I'll stay here and make some preparations. You can come find me anytime if you uncover more info.

{{Quest Description|The Adventurers' Guild in Inazuma seems to have a commission concerning the Sacred Sakura...}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Talk to Katheryne at the Inazuma Adventurers' Guild)
:{{A|vo sglq101 1 katheryne 01.ogg}} '''Katheryne:''' Ad astra abyssosque, {{Traveler}}.
:{{A|vo sglq101 1 katheryne 02.ogg}} '''Katheryne:''' Recently, the Adventurers' Guild has received an unusual commission, and after careful consideration, we believe that—
:{{A|vo sglq101 1 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' "The traveler would be the most suitable candidate." Right?
:{{A|vo sglq101 1 katheryne 03.ogg}} '''Katheryne:''' Hehe, indeed. As ever.
:{{A|vo sglq101 1 katheryne 04.ogg}} '''Katheryne:''' I will spare the pleasantries, then. May I ask if you two are available to help?
:{{DIcon}} Of course, that's what we're here for.
:{{DIcon}} It'll depend on the task and the compensation.
:{{A|vo sglq101 1 katheryne 05.ogg}} '''Katheryne:''' Well, let me go over it briefly. Our client for this job is the [[Yashiro Commission]]. Apparently, [[rifthounds]] are attacking the roots of the Sacred Sakura nearby Mt. Yougou in great numbers.
:{{A|vo sglq101 1 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Rifthounds? ...On Narukami Island?
:{{A|vo sglq101 1 katheryne 06.ogg}} '''Katheryne:''' Yes. We are not sure where exactly these creatures come from. But this time, they are attacking in alarming numbers with great aggression and a clear target.
:{{A|vo sglq101 1 katheryne 07.ogg}} '''Katheryne:''' The [[Sacred Sakura]] is of tremendous importance to Inazuma. I trust you are aware of this already?
:{{DIcon}} I believe I understand.
::{{A|vo sglq101 1 katheryne 08a.ogg}} '''Katheryne:''' Good. Then you can see that this case is very urgent indeed.
:{{DIcon}} I'm hazy.
::{{A|vo sglq101 1 katheryne 08b.ogg}} '''Katheryne:''' For a long time, the Sacred Sakura has been absorbing filth from Inazuma's [[Ley Lines]] to maintain stability in the land.
::{{A|vo sglq101 1 katheryne 08b 1.ogg}} '''Katheryne:''' If it were ever damaged, the filth would once again invade Inazuma, causing great catastrophe. That's why this is a rather urgent case.
:{{A|vo sglq101 1 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Is the [[Tenryou Commission]] aware?
:{{A|vo sglq101 1 katheryne 09.ogg}} '''Katheryne:''' Yes, and they are already taking action of their own. However, given that the Sacred Sakura's root system is vast and complex, and faced with the unpredictability and scale of the rifthounds' attacks, they are finding it difficult to defend against them.
:{{A|vo sglq101 1 katheryne 10.ogg}} '''Katheryne:''' Their main priority is to protect the civilian population. So they are actively looking to cooperate with all other available forces to eliminate the monsters.
:{{A|vo sglq101 1 katheryne 11.ogg}} '''Katheryne:''' The Adventurers' Guild is one of the key parties assisting the Tenryou Commission with their work. But so far, the combined efforts to combat the rifthounds has failed to substantially ameliorate the situation.
:{{DIcon}} Time to make some whelps yelp.
:{{DIcon}} I'll send these pooches packing.
:{{A|vo sglq101 1 katheryne 12.ogg}} '''Katheryne:''' You have our deepest gratitude. Your confident response puts me far more at ease.
:{{A|vo sglq101 1 katheryne 13.ogg}} '''Katheryne:''' I will mark on your map the areas where rifthound appearances have been recently reported. I hope you won't encounter too much trouble overcoming them.
:{{A|vo sglq101 1 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Relax! We'll be back before you can say "ad astra abyssosque."

;(After talking to Katheryne if [[Sacred Sakura Cleansing Ritual]] is completed)
:{{A|vo sglq101 1 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' The Sacred Sakura's in danger again, huh. Who'd have thought.
:{{A|vo sglq101 1 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Keeping the Sacred Sakura safe was [[Hanachirusato]]'s greatest wish, and now these mangy mutts are trying to destroy it. Time to teach them a lesson!

;(Go to the area where the monsters have appeared)
:{{A|vo sglq101 2 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' They're attacking the Sacred Sakura! Stop them!

;(After defeating the second wave of Rifthounds)
:{{A|vo sglq101 2 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wow, there are so many of them! No wonder the Tenryou Commission needed help...
:{{A|vo sglq101 2 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Come on, {{Traveler}}! You can take 'em!

;(After defeating the third wave of Rifthounds, two more Thundercraven Rifthound Whelps approach the Traveler)
;(And just as they attack...)
:{{A|vo sglq101 2 raidenei 01.ogg}} '''Raiden Shogun?:''' Torn to oblivion!
;(The whelps are defeated by the "Raiden Shogun?" much to Paimon's surprise)

;(Talk to Raiden Ei)
:{{A|vo sglq101 2 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Sh—Shogun? Wait, no... could also be Ei...
:{{A|vo sglq101 2 raidenei 02.ogg}} '''Raiden Shogun?:''' ...It's you two.
:{{A|vo sglq101 2 raidenei 03.ogg}} '''Ei:''' It has been a long time. We have not seen each other since the resolution of the Tenryou Commission crisis.
:{{A|vo sglq101 2 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Okay, sounds more like Ei... it is you, right?
:{{A|vo sglq101 2 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You sure made short work of them. That was amazing!
:{{DIcon}} ...What are you doing here?
:{{DIcon}} What brings you out this time?
:{{A|vo sglq101 2 raidenei 04.ogg}} '''Ei:''' I'm making early preparations for what is to come.
:{{A|vo sglq101 2 raidenei 05.ogg}} '''Ei:''' Last time we took a walk around Inazuma together, I witnessed the way the world is today. I was finally able to comprehend some things that I had never understood in the past.
:{{A|vo sglq101 2 raidenei 06.ogg}} '''Ei:''' Since then, every time I encounter an obstacle in my thinking, I find myself having the urge to spend some time in the outside world.
:{{A|vo sglq101 2 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Makes sense. You must get super bored being stuck in there all the time.
:{{A|vo sglq101 2 raidenei 07.ogg}} '''Ei:''' ...Might I remind you that I am not here to amuse myself.
:{{A|vo sglq101 2 raidenei 08.ogg}} '''Ei:''' Recently, I have observed a number of changes in the external world from the [[Plane of Euthymia]]. The most serious of these being the attack on the Sacred Sakura by numerous rifthounds.
:{{A|vo sglq101 2 raidenei 09.ogg}} '''Ei:''' I considered this matter worthy of my attention. So I pursued them, and they led me here, where I happened to run into you.
:{{DIcon}} But the Commissions and adventurers can deal with monsters.
:{{DIcon}} It doesn't seem like a matter needing the archon's attention...
:{{A|vo sglq101 2 raidenei 10.ogg}} '''Ei:''' If the Shogun rather than I were to discover them... Yes, perhaps she would have left the situation alone.
:{{A|vo sglq101 2 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hmm? Why? Because she's just a puppet?
:{{A|vo sglq101 2 raidenei 11.ogg}} '''Ei:''' Precisely. According to the rules I designed for her, matters of this nature are to be delegated to the [[Tri-Commission]].
:{{A|vo sglq101 2 raidenei 12.ogg}} '''Ei:''' But rifthounds attacking the Sacred Sakura... it brings back bad memories of that terrible disaster...
:{{A|vo sglq101 2 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' A disaster?
:{{A|vo sglq101 2 raidenei 13.ogg}} '''Ei:''' Yes. Five hundred years ago, a [[Cataclysm|great catastrophe]] befell Inazuma.
:{{A|vo sglq101 2 raidenei 14.ogg}} '''Ei:''' Everything was engulfed in a pitch-black fog and monsters ravaged the land... Countless lives were lost, and this homeland that the people had worked so hard to build barely escaped being obliterated entirely.
:{{A|vo sglq101 2 raidenei 15.ogg}} '''Ei:''' The monsters committed many atrocities on Inazuman soil. And the rifthounds were always their advance guard.
:{{A|vo sglq101 2 raidenei 16.ogg}} '''Ei:''' Their duty was to tear open a passage through space with their claws and teeth, and then call in even more powerful beasts.
:{{DIcon}} Five hundred years ago... [[Khaenri'ah]].
:{{A|vo sglq101 2 raidenei 17.ogg}} '''Ei:''' Hmm. So you've heard of it, too.
:{{A|vo sglq101 2 raidenei 18.ogg}} '''Ei:''' That's an episode of history that I am loath to recall. Maybe to you, it seems like my response to these creatures was an excessive one.
:{{A|vo sglq101 2 raidenei 19.ogg}} '''Ei:''' But an excess of caution is not unwarranted in this case.
:{{A|vo sglq101 2 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Guess you can't argue with that...
:{{A|vo sglq101 2 raidenei 20.ogg}} '''Ei:''' Since we are both here for the same reason, let us work together.
:{{A|vo sglq101 2 raidenei 21.ogg}} '''Ei:''' From the traces they've left in the surrounding area, there should be many more monsters nearby. All of them must be eliminated.
:{{DIcon}} Let's go.
:{{A|vo sglq101 2 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Paimon feels so safe when we're in Ei's company! Having someone uber-powerful on your team kinda makes you feel invincible, doesn't it?
:{{A|vo sglq101 2 paimon 12.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, yeah — after we've dealt with the monsters, we should ask her to tell us more about Khaenri'ah.
{{Dialogue End}}

{{Quest Description|update|The Adventurers' Guild has noticed that the Rifthounds are attacking the Sacred Sakura. As you head to resolve this incident, you encounter Raiden Ei. After speaking with her, you decide to travel together.}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Look for the marks left behind)
:{{A|vo sglq101 3 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' This color... It's similar to the color when the Sacred Sakura takes damage!
:{{A|vo sglq101 3 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Let's follow it, it should be this way.

;(Try to figure out what happened)
:{{A|vo sglq101 4 raidenei 01.ogg}} '''Ei:''' We are lucky... the damage is not too serious. The [[Yashiro Commission]] will be able to nurse the root system back to health.
:{{A|vo sglq101 4 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' This stuff that's flowing out, is it sap or something? And how come it's glowing...

:{{color|menu|The light disperses in all directions before coalescing into human form...}}

:{{A|vo sglq101 4 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' ...Huh?
:{{A|vo sglq101 4 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wh—What's this?
:{{DIcon}} Is someone injured?
:{{DIcon}} How terrible.
:{{A|vo sglq101 4 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Could they be... dead people? It wouldn't be the first time we'd seen ghosts on our journey.
:{{A|vo sglq101 4 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' But... why would they appear here?
:{{A|vo sglq101 4 raidenei 02.ogg}} '''Ei:''' Let's search the area. Perhaps we will find out.
:{{A|vo sglq101 4 kitamura 01.ogg}} '''Kitamura:''' Ugh... ugh...
:{{A|vo sglq101 4 kitamura 02.ogg}} '''Kitamura:''' I can't go on like this... not when the other troops are counting on me...
:{{A|vo sglq101 4 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What happened here? Could you tell us?
:{{A|vo sglq101 4 kitamura 03.ogg}} '''Kitamura:''' Who are you? What are you doing here?
:{{A|vo sglq101 4 kitamura 04.ogg}} '''Kitamura:''' Run, quick, while you still can! The monsters will be back... And once you're in their sights, I'm telling you — there's no escaping them!

:{{DIcon}} What exactly happened?
:{{DIcon}} What monsters?
:{{A|vo sglq101 4 kitamura 06.ogg}} '''Kitamura:''' You... you don't know? Inazuma is engulfed in darkness.
:{{A|vo sglq101 4 kitamura 07.ogg}} '''Kitamura:''' Beasts and horrifying monsters are everywhere! They are merciless, ferocious... and they will devour everything in their path...
:{{A|vo sglq101 4 kitamura 08.ogg}} '''Kitamura:''' Every last trace of humanity's existence, I tell you... they'll devour it all...
:{{A|vo sglq101 4 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' But look... none of that seems to be going on around here.
:{{A|vo sglq101 4 kitamura 09.ogg}} '''Kitamura:''' Not right now, but they'll be back... Look — get out of here, now!!! There's no time left!
:{{A|vo sglq101 4 kitamura 10.ogg}} '''Kitamura:''' The Almighty Shogun is gone, so is [[Kitsune Saiguu]]. There's no one left to rely on but ourselves.
:{{A|vo sglq101 4 kitamura 11.ogg}} '''Kitamura:''' I don't know how long we can hold out for, but... if we abandon our hope, then we've got nothing left at all.
:{{A|vo sglq101 4 raidenei 03.ogg}} '''Ei:''' Don't worry. I am right here.
:{{A|vo sglq101 4 kitamura 12.ogg}} '''Kitamura:''' It's... the Shogun!?
:{{A|vo sglq101 4 kitamura 13.ogg}} '''Kitamura:''' You're back!
:{{A|vo sglq101 4 kitamura 14.ogg}} '''Kitamura:''' Please, we beg you... you have to help us... you have to save Inazuma!
:{{A|vo sglq101 4 kitamura 15.ogg}} '''Kitamura:''' Only the glow of your supreme lightning can dispel this terrible darkness... please, or the whole of Inazuma will be reduced to a hunting ground for the beasts!
:{{A|vo sglq101 4 raidenei 04.ogg}} '''Ei:''' Calm down. The war you speak of is over.
:{{A|vo sglq101 4 kitamura 16.ogg}} '''Kitamura:''' Over? But... what do you mean, Shogun...

:{{A|vo sglq101 4 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hey, calm down! Everything's fine now!

:{{A|vo sglq101 4 kitamura 21.ogg}} '''Kitamura:''' I think I understand... Almighty Shogun... you saved Inazuma!
:{{A|vo sglq101 4 kitamura 22.ogg}} '''Kitamura:''' Yes... we were right to place our trust in the Almighty Shogun. As long as the Shogun is with us, Inazuma will last for an eternity...
:{{A|vo sglq101 4 kitamura 23.ogg}} '''Kitamura:''' Thank you, Your Excellency, thank you, thank you...
;(The ghostly samurai dissipates)

:{{DIcon}} Is he disappearing?
:{{A|vo sglq101 4 raidenei 07.ogg}} '''Ei:''' ...He's gone.
:{{A|vo sglq101 4 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' ...Paimon can't even begin to understand what that was all about... but somehow, Paimon feels all sad and hopeless...
:{{A|vo sglq101 4 raidenei 08.ogg}} '''Ei:''' If I am not mistaken, what we just saw was a samurai's memory that was buried in the land.
:{{A|vo sglq101 4 raidenei 09.ogg}} '''Ei:''' The Sacred Sakura can absorb and purify the filth in the Ley Lines. After the rifthounds attacked, some of this filth leaked out through the cracks in the trunk and formed a physical entity.
:{{A|vo sglq101 4 raidenei 10.ogg}} '''Ei:''' An entity formed with strong filth would be highly aggressive. But when purified, it presents in the form of a memory.

:{{DIcon}} The same thing happened to [[Dusky Ming]].
:{{A|vo sglq101 4 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So the memories of the ones that died are all appearing at this moment?
:{{A|vo sglq101 4 raidenei 12.ogg}} '''Ei:''' Yes. That soldier was one of the many thousands who made the ultimate sacrifice. What he was describing just now was precisely the disaster that happened in Inazuma 500 years ago.
:{{DIcon}} He mentioned that the Shogun was absent...
:{{DIcon}} He mentioned that Kitsune Saiguu was absent...
:{{A|vo sglq101 4 raidenei 13.ogg}} '''Ei:''' Yes. Inazuma was facing many great crises at that time. Some were local in origin, while others... others came from the now-fallen kingdom of Khaenri'ah.
:{{A|vo sglq101 4 raidenei 14.ogg}} '''Ei:''' The disaster in Inazuma caused me great concern. I felt that I had to step in before it was too late, otherwise it would spread to all of Teyvat.
:{{A|vo sglq101 4 raidenei 15.ogg}} '''Ei:''' But my friend, Kitsune Saiguu, reassured me that I had nothing to worry about. She would shoulder the responsibility of protecting Inazuma, and mobilize all forces at her disposal to combat the threat.
:{{A|vo sglq101 4 raidenei 16.ogg}} '''Ei:''' ...I could tell that although neither of us acknowledged it, we both knew that the road ahead would likely end in tragedy.
:{{A|vo sglq101 4 paimon 12.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So... Inazuma was attacked at the same time as when the disaster happened in Khaenri'ah?
:{{A|vo sglq101 4 raidenei 17.ogg}} '''Ei:''' Indeed. Countless monsters suddenly appeared throughout all of Inazuma. In the end... Kitsune Saiguu sacrificed her life to protect the people.
:{{A|vo sglq101 4 raidenei 18.ogg}} '''Ei:''' I never had the chance to see her one last time. But I would like to believe that she kept her promise to me until the very last.
:{{A|vo sglq101 4 raidenei 19.ogg}} '''Ei:''' But even then, Inazuma was left more devastated than we could have ever imagined. Those terrible tragedies left great wounds that are still felt to this day, both on the land itself... and in my heart.
:{{A|vo sglq101 4 paimon 13.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ei...
:{{DIcon}} Is this the "loss" that Yae Miko mentioned?
:{{A|vo sglq101 4 raidenei 20.ogg}} '''Ei:''' Yes. For the longest time, I couldn't bring myself to face the pain of that loss.
:{{A|vo sglq101 4 raidenei 21.ogg}} '''Ei:''' All my martial might was in vain... Though I could conquer [[Tatarigami]] and vanquish monsters, I was helpless against the ravages of time, powerless to keep the ones I cherished alive.
:{{A|vo sglq101 4 raidenei 22.ogg}} '''Ei:''' ...
:{{A|vo sglq101 4 raidenei 23.ogg}} '''Ei:''' But after my clash with human ambition, I thought long and hard. Now I realize I cannot fixate on the past forever.
:{{DIcon}} So you're no longer stuck in the past?
:{{A|vo sglq101 4 raidenei 24.ogg}} '''Ei:''' ...When I traveled around Inazuma with you, I caught a glimpse of how the nation has progressed over the centuries. A glimpse of human potential. Everything far exceeded my expectations.
:{{A|vo sglq101 4 raidenei 25.ogg}} '''Ei:''' Moving forward inevitably invites further loss, but also new encounters.
:{{A|vo sglq101 4 raidenei 26.ogg}} '''Ei:''' Just think of that soldier. Despite all the losses he had experienced, he still chose to keep fighting, for the sake of moving forward.
:{{A|vo sglq101 4 raidenei 27.ogg}} '''Ei:''' All those who sacrificed themselves back then gave their lives fighting for a future... but perhaps the future they were hoping for is not the eternity that I once strove for.
:{{DIcon}} Absolutely.
:{{DIcon}} That's what being human is about.
:{{A|vo sglq101 4 raidenei 28.ogg}} '''Ei:''' As Inazuma's god, it is high time I honored their wishes.
:{{A|vo sglq101 4 raidenei 29.ogg}} '''Ei:''' Warriors of the past who spilled your blood on this land, your noble souls now rest in this earth.
:{{A|vo sglq101 4 raidenei 30.ogg}} '''Ei:''' I will never forget you, and all that you did for Inazuma.
:{{A|vo sglq101 4 paimon 14.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ei's taking all this pretty hard...
:{{DIcon}} ...
:{{A|vo sglq101 4 raidenei 31.ogg}} '''Ei:''' Come on. Let's keep investigating the damage to the Sacred Sakura.

:{{A|vo sglq101 5 raidenei 07.ogg}} '''Ei:''' Though blind, Furuyama is unparalleled in his ability to appraise tea. He brews some of the very finest tea in all of Inazuma.
:{{A|vo sglq101 5 furuyama 03.ogg}} '''Furuyama:''' Your Excellency, you shower me with praise undeserved. I have simply had the good fortune to be in Your Excellency's presence long enough to become acquainted with all the skills that are required of me.

:{{DIcon}} I want to learn more about the past.
:{{A|vo sglq101 5 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, um... yeah, sheesh, there's monsters everywhere out there, it's pitch-black, and loads of people have been injured...
:{{A|vo sglq101 5 furuyama 07.ogg}} '''Furuyama:''' I see. So they have fought their way this far already.
:{{A|vo sglq101 5 furuyama 08.ogg}} '''Furuyama:''' Most of the residents in this neighborhood have already escaped. They wanted to take me with them, but it seemed rather pointless to me. So I decided to stay.
:{{A|vo sglq101 5 furuyama 09.ogg}} '''Furuyama:''' And now the Almighty Shogun is here, I have even less reason to run away, hehe.
:{{A|vo sglq101 5 furuyama 10.ogg}} '''Furuyama:''' Imagine, if this was something that even the Almighty Shogun was powerless to resolve, where could I possibly run to then?
:{{DIcon}} How come you're not panicking?
:{{A|vo sglq101 5 furuyama 11.ogg}} '''Furuyama:''' People flee out of a desire to live on. And the desire to live on stems from a feeling of having unfinished business in life.
:{{A|vo sglq101 5 furuyama 12.ogg}} '''Furuyama:''' But me? I have no such thoughts, and I have no regrets.
:{{A|vo sglq101 5 furuyama 13.ogg}} '''Furuyama:''' The Almighty Shogun often speaks to me about her dreams over tea.
:{{A|vo sglq101 5 furuyama 14.ogg}} '''Furuyama:''' Just listening to her stories, ahh... I've been blind for many years, but her vivid descriptions took me on a splendid journey to all the most beautiful places in Inazuma... Over time, I've come to understand her mindset. Quite the romantic at heart. A true dreamer.
:{{A|vo sglq101 5 furuyama 15.ogg}} '''Furuyama:''' One thing she always says is... "Good things don't last forever. Everything changes, fades, disappears completely over the passage of time. And so, people must make the most of the life they have, seize the chance to enjoy it while it lasts, and have no regrets in the end..."
:{{A|vo sglq101 5 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Umm...
:{{DIcon}} (That doesn't sound like Ei at all...)
:{{DIcon}} (This doesn't fit the definition of eternity at all.)
:{{A|vo sglq101 5 furuyama 16.ogg}} '''Furuyama:''' So you see, as bleak as things may be now, I have experienced countless wonderful things in life, and have no reason not to be satisfied.
:{{A|vo sglq101 5 raidenei 08.ogg}} '''Ei:''' Perhaps... you are right.
:{{A|vo sglq101 5 furuyama 17.ogg}} '''Furuyama:''' It won't be long now before I have to say goodbye to the Almighty Shogun for the last time. Ah, what a pity... I'll never get to see what Inazuma looks like after the Almighty Shogun rebuilds it anew.
:{{A|vo sglq101 5 furuyama 18.ogg}} '''Furuyama:''' But I suppose it doesn't matter. Everyone says that Inazuma has turned dark now... but to me, it went dark a long time ago.
:{{A|vo sglq101 5 furuyama 19.ogg}} '''Furuyama:''' Once this catastrophe is over, life is sure to spring forth anew. But even if I survived until then, I'd probably be a hopelessly befuddled old so-and-so by then... Hahaha, so never mind, eh.
:{{A|vo sglq101 5 raidenei 09.ogg}} '''Ei:''' ...
:{{A|vo sglq101 5 furuyama 20.ogg}} '''Furuyama:''' Oh, goodness me. Speaking of befuddled, look at me rambling away to my heart's content and forgetting to serve the tea.
:{{A|vo sglq101 5 furuyama 21.ogg}} '''Furuyama:''' The Almighty Shogun comes to visit and I don't have the tea ready. A truly egregious loss of decorum.
:{{A|vo sglq101 5 furuyama 22.ogg}} '''Furuyama:''' One moment, I'll just... Hmm? Where in the world is the tea set?
:{{A|vo sglq101 5 furuyama 23.ogg}} '''Furuyama:''' I hope the others didn't smash it to smithereens in their hasty departure.
:{{A|vo sglq101 5 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Can't see a tea set anywhere around here...
:{{A|vo sglq101 5 furuyama 24.ogg}} '''Furuyama:''' Really? But it's always been right by my side... Goodness gracious... What a fool I'm making of myself.
:{{DIcon}} We know where to find a tea set.
:{{A|vo sglq101 5 furuyama 25.ogg}} '''Furuyama:''' I couldn't possibly have my guests fetch it themselves, that would be most discourteous indeed.
:{{A|vo sglq101 5 raidenei 10.ogg}} '''Ei:''' Don't worry about it. Take a rest, we'll be back right away.
:{{A|vo sglq101 5 furuyama 26.ogg}} '''Furuyama:''' Almighty Shogun, you're not going too, are you? No, no, no, your humble servant implores you... Not with the war raging outside...
:{{A|vo sglq101 5 raidenei 11.ogg}} '''Ei:''' This place is... complicated. It's quite unlike the tea house in your memories.
:{{A|vo sglq101 5 raidenei 12.ogg}} '''Ei:''' Leave it to us.
:{{A|vo sglq101 5 furuyama 27.ogg}} '''Furuyama:''' But... well, okay. I never thought I'd see the day that I need the Almighty Shogun to personally collect my tea set for me...

:{{A|vo sglq101 6 raidenei 02.ogg}} '''Ei:''' Be at ease, I'm not here to see Commissioner Kamisato. Actually, I'd prefer to spend this time chatting with the Traveler. Please, fetch the tea set at your convenience.
:{{A|vo sglq101 6 hirano 05.ogg}} '''Hirano:''' No, no, no. I am your humble servant, I daren't think of my own convenience when the Almighty Shogun graces me with her presence! I'll deal with it right away.
:{{A|vo sglq101 6 raidenei 03.ogg}} '''Ei:''' Well, it's not often we have the chance to chat. I'm sure you must have a lot of questions?
:{{DIcon}} Was it really you that that tea master used to serve?
:{{A|vo sglq101 6 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Right, Paimon wanted to ask that, too! The Almighty Shogun that he described didn't sound anything like you at all.
:{{A|vo sglq101 6 raidenei 04.ogg}} '''Ei:''' I seldom had the time to drink tea. Any free time I had was spent practicing martial arts.
:{{A|vo sglq101 6 raidenei 05.ogg}} '''Ei:''' So in the vast majority of cases, the one he made tea for was the former Electro Archon... who was also my sister. [[Raiden Makoto]].
:{{A|vo sglq101 6 raidenei 06.ogg}} '''Ei:''' He may well have had an inkling about there being two "Raiden Shoguns." But he always acted as if he was completely unaware of it.
:{{A|vo sglq101 6 raidenei 07.ogg}} '''Ei:''' The philosophy of life that he shared with us just now, that was Makoto's view on reality. She always saw things that way.
:{{A|vo sglq101 6 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You and Makoto had pretty different views, huh...
:{{A|vo sglq101 6 raidenei 08.ogg}} '''Ei:''' Indeed we did. It was the biggest difference between us.
:{{A|vo sglq101 6 raidenei 09.ogg}} '''Ei:''' In her eyes, the most precious things in this world were dreams — the yearning for a better future held by living beings.
:{{DIcon}} Dreams... or in other words, "ambitions"?
:{{A|vo sglq101 6 raidenei 10.ogg}} '''Ei:''' They are similar, but not identical.
:{{A|vo sglq101 6 raidenei 11.ogg}} '''Ei:''' When you came charging into the Plane of Euthymia, I saw human aspirations light up the sky far above in the form of countless stars. This... somewhat shook me.
:{{A|vo sglq101 6 raidenei 12.ogg}} '''Ei:''' Now, it seems like she was right, while I took the wayward path.
:{{A|vo sglq101 6 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wow. There sure was a lot going on beneath the surface...
:{{A|vo sglq101 6 raidenei 13.ogg}} '''Ei:''' Makoto saw a bigger picture than I did. In her view, a "dream" is more imaginary, more abstract than an "ambition."
:{{A|vo sglq101 6 raidenei 14.ogg}} '''Ei:''' An "ambition" is a yearning for something material, or a concrete outcome. It is finite in nature, and will be replaced by a new ambition in due course.
:{{A|vo sglq101 6 raidenei 15.ogg}} '''Ei:''' Makoto was more concerned with the force that drives humans to constantly generate new ambitions in the first place. It is something innate, rooted in instinct — in other words... it is something eternal.
:{{A|vo sglq101 6 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' That's, uh, quite a lot to take in...
:{{A|vo sglq101 6 raidenei 16.ogg}} '''Ei:''' To put it simply, Makoto wasn't concerned about outcomes.
:{{A|vo sglq101 6 raidenei 17.ogg}} '''Ei:''' I didn't understand at the time. How can we say that we are maintaining eternity when things are constantly moving forward and evolving?
:{{A|vo sglq101 6 raidenei 18.ogg}} '''Ei:''' I suppose what it comes down to is the definition of "eternity" she set out with.
:{{DIcon}} It seems more in line with how humans view the world.
:{{A|vo sglq101 6 raidenei 19.ogg}} '''Ei:''' Yes, it does. I always thought that she must have grasped some elusive, arcane wisdom to arrive at the conclusions she did.
:{{A|vo sglq101 6 raidenei 20.ogg}} '''Ei:''' But in the last analysis, Makoto's philosophy was — on the surface, at least — an elegantly simple one. Notwithstanding that it was also the more prudent choice, based on a more mature, far-sighted outlook.
:{{A|vo sglq101 6 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Do you feel you're starting to understand her better now?
:{{A|vo sglq101 6 raidenei 21.ogg}} '''Ei:''' You have already witnessed my previous views on eternity.
:{{A|vo sglq101 6 raidenei 22.ogg}} '''Ei:''' But now, I no longer cling to what was lost. I suppose that means our differences have been reconciled.
:{{A|vo sglq101 6 hirano 06.ogg}} '''Hirano:''' Almighty Shogun, I found a tea set! This one in particular should be fit for Your Excellency's use...
:{{A|vo sglq101 6 raidenei 23.ogg}} '''Ei:''' It's quite beautiful. Thank you.
:{{A|vo sglq101 6 hirano 07.ogg}} '''Hirano:''' You are too kind, a humble servant such as I does not deserve the gratitude of the Almighty Shogun...
:{{A|vo sglq101 6 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' It's all good, Sir! She's actually pretty chill.
:{{A|vo sglq101 6 raidenei 24.ogg}} '''Ei:''' Let us return. We ought not keep Furuyama waiting too long.

:{{A|vo sglq101 7 raidenei 06.ogg}} '''Ei:''' So many thoughts were racing through my head as I was brewing it, I... I'm not sure how to explain it...
:{{DIcon}} You don't need to. I understand.
:{{DIcon}} It's just the memories flooding back in...
:{{A|vo sglq101 7 raidenei 07.ogg}} '''Ei:''' You're right, but the things we've seen today have brought back many memories for me.
:{{A|vo sglq101 7 raidenei 08.ogg}} '''Ei:''' I've been reminded of many people, too. Kitsune Saiguu, Makoto, and all the other friends who I watched pass even further back.
:{{A|vo sglq101 7 raidenei 09.ogg}} '''Ei:''' Back at the Yashiro Commission, I kept the conversation reasonably light-hearted. But now... I'd like to broach a heavier topic, if I may.
:{{A|vo sglq101 7 raidenei 10.ogg}} '''Ei:''' The events of 500 years ago not only robbed me of my friend, Kitsune Saiguu... they also took Makoto away from me for good.
:{{A|vo sglq101 7 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' She died in that disaster too?
:{{A|vo sglq101 7 raidenei 11.ogg}} '''Ei:''' Yes. She went to Khaenri'ah alone, without telling me.
:{{A|vo sglq101 7 raidenei 12.ogg}} '''Ei:''' Unlike me, Makoto was no martial artist. Whenever similar crises had arisen in the past, I was always the one to face them in her stead.
:{{A|vo sglq101 7 raidenei 13.ogg}} '''Ei:''' But this time, the circumstances were so grave that Makoto had no choice but to leave me behind. Or... perhaps it was more that she went ahead of me, put herself in front of me so that I would remain hidden. In any case, by the time I realized what was happening...
:{{DIcon}} Makoto had already...
:{{A|vo sglq101 7 raidenei 14.ogg}} '''Ei:''' Yes. It was too late. I arrived only in time to hear her dying breath.
:{{A|vo sglq101 7 raidenei 15.ogg}} '''Ei:''' She had already lapsed into unconsciousness by that point, so all I could do was enter into her mind... As far as you're concerned, it would be somewhere similar to the Plane of Euthymia.
:{{A|vo sglq101 7 raidenei 16.ogg}} '''Ei:''' It was there that we bid each other a final farewell. I cried bitterly. Even in those final moments, I couldn't understand her actions.
:{{A|vo sglq101 7 raidenei 17.ogg}} '''Ei:''' Why did she go to Khaenri'ah first, and not I? Why did she keep me in the dark about it? Was it to shield me?
:{{A|vo sglq101 7 raidenei 18.ogg}} '''Ei:''' It was there and then that I resolved to pursue eternity. As a testament to that decision, I saved her [[Realm of Consciousness|realm of consciousness]] just before it collapsed completely, and brought it back to Inazuma.
:{{A|vo sglq101 7 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' That's quite a story...
:{{A|vo sglq101 7 raidenei 19.ogg}} '''Ei:''' When I returned to Inazuma, I was shocked to find that a great sakura tree had appeared on Mt. Yougou. The tree that you know as the Sacred Sakura.
:{{DIcon}} ..."Appeared"?
:{{DIcon}} The Sacred Sakura has always been there, hasn't it?
:{{A|vo sglq101 7 raidenei 20.ogg}} '''Ei:''' That's exactly what everyone back then told me as well. That it had existed since time immemorial. They were so matter-of-fact about it, and couldn't at all understand what I was so surprised about.
:{{A|vo sglq101 7 raidenei 21.ogg}} '''Ei:''' No one questioned it, and yet its presence contrasted so starkly with the area as I remembered it... it seemed as if I was the only one to have noticed it appear suddenly out of thin air.
:{{A|vo sglq101 7 raidenei 22.ogg}} '''Ei:''' In the end, I simply had to accept that it was a miraculous effect of Makoto's consciousness.
:{{A|vo sglq101 7 raidenei 23.ogg}} '''Ei:''' With the help of the Sacred Sakura's power, I was finally able to overcome the monsters and quell the disaster in Inazuma.
:{{A|vo sglq101 7 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' This is all really hard to understand... Kinda beyond Paimon's level.
:{{DIcon}} Simply put, Makoto's power somehow made that tree appear.
:{{A|vo sglq101 7 raidenei 24.ogg}} '''Ei:''' Yes... She had such a great love for this land, and for its people. In this respect, I still do not compare to her.
:{{A|vo sglq101 7 raidenei 25.ogg}} '''Ei:''' I once told myself that I would never speak of these events again. Facing the fact that she is gone is unbearably painful.
:{{A|vo sglq101 7 raidenei 26.ogg}} '''Ei:''' But even the tea that is most bitter to the tongue, once swallowed, leaves some sweetness in the throat.
:{{A|vo sglq101 7 raidenei 27.ogg}} '''Ei:''' ...And it's time I came to terms with it all.
:{{DIcon}} It seems like you've done a lot of thinking about this already.
:{{DIcon}} I know the pain of separation too.
:{{A|vo sglq101 7 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, um, while we're on the topic, since you experienced that battle in person...
:{{DIcon}} Have you seen my {{MC|sister|brother|mc=1}} before?
:{{A|vo sglq101 7 raidenei 28a.ogg}} {{A|vo sglq101 7 raidenei 28b.ogg}} '''Ei:''' {{MC|Sister|Brother|mc=1}}? Hmm... I had heard that you were looking for your family.
:{{A|vo sglq101 7 raidenei 29a.ogg}} {{A|vo sglq101 7 raidenei 29b.ogg}} '''Ei:''' You mean to say that {{MC|she|he|mc=1}} was somehow involved in the Khaenri'ah disaster?
:{{A|vo sglq101 7 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Based on what we've learned so far, it seems so, yeah.
:{{A|vo sglq101 7 raidenei 30.ogg}} '''Ei:''' I'm sorry. I wasn't there for the whole thing. By the time I arrived, the worst of the fighting was already over.
:{{A|vo sglq101 7 raidenei 31.ogg}} '''Ei:''' And also... my mind was consumed entirely with the plight of Inazuma and the fate of those closest to me.
:{{A|vo sglq101 7 raidenei 32.ogg}} '''Ei:''' So I am afraid I can't help you.
:{{A|vo sglq101 7 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh... well that's a shame. But it can't be helped I guess...
:{{A|vo sglq101 7 paimon 12a.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Boy, both of you have experienced great tragedy...
:{{A|vo sglq101 7 raidenei 33.ogg}} '''Ei:''' With this last cup of tea, let us honor the tea master's memory.
:{{A|vo sglq101 7 raidenei 34.ogg}} '''Ei:''' Thank you, destiny, for giving us the chance to meet again.

;(Observe the teacup after the quest ends)
:'''Observe Teacup:''' (A cup of tea has been left for Furuyama.)
:'''Observe Teacup:''' (How much did he actually perceive, and how much did he let on?)
{{Dialogue End}}

:{{A|vo xyjeq002 1 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hmm, that's true. It does look like his odds of winning are pretty high!

:{{A|vo xyjeq002 3 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' How are you feeling now, Tighnari? Do you want to rest some more?
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 3 cyno 01.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' There's some shade here, so we can stop for a while.

:{{A|vo xyjeq002 3 layla 02.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Yeah, the sun was too strong, so I decided to take cover here for a while.
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 3 layla 03.ogg}} '''Layla:''' What about you? Are you all done already?
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 3 tighnari 02.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Unfortunately not. I'm not quite as capable as I thought... I intend to withdraw from this round. Cyno and {{Traveler}} are escorting me back to Aaru Village.
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 3 layla 04.ogg}} '''Layla:''' W—Withdraw? Can you even do that?
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 3 tighnari 03.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' I believe the rules do provide for such a situation. Alhaitham did say that the act of leaving the competition grounds would result in disqualification from the round.
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 3 cyno 02.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Didn't I ask you if you were alright before this? If you had just decided to withdraw then, you wouldn't have had to suffer.
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 3 tighnari 04.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Well, I had to try, didn't I? So I tried, and it didn't work out — and now I'm backing out while I can.
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 3 tighnari 05.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' When I get back, I'm definitely going to make a batch of sun-resistant oil. Next time I venture into the desert, I'll be prepared.
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 3 tighnari 06.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' By the way, you're Layla, aren't you? You don't look very well yourself. Will you be alright?
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 3 layla 05.ogg}} '''Layla:''' I did feel a little faint when I first entered the desert, but I feel a lot better after resting here for a while.
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 3 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Be careful not to push yourself too hard!
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 3 layla 06.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Don't worry, I'm just...
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 3 cyno 03.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Feeling the pressure?
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 3 layla 07.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Huh? You can tell?
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 3 cyno 04.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Your expression is similar to the ones I see on criminals' faces when I interrogate them.
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 3 layla 08.ogg}} '''Layla:''' To tell you the truth, I'm still not sure whether I have what it takes to represent the Rtawahist Darshan in the Championship.
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 3 layla 09.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Most people voted for me because of all the rumors surrounding me, and to be honest, those rumors don't really mean anything. Now I don't know how to deal with all the expectations they've put on me.
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 3 layla 10.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Even the people who usually criticize me voted for me this time... So I feel like I have to live up to their expectations somehow...
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 3 tighnari 07.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' So their expectations are putting pressure on you?
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 3 layla 11.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Yes. Actually, I heard that you were voted in as well, Tighnari. How do you deal with it?

:{{A|vo xyjeq002 3 tighnari 09.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Firstly, those who expect things from you do not necessarily do so for benign reasons. On the other hand, those who do consider your feelings certainly wouldn't want you to push yourself.
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 3 tighnari 10.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Next, we are researchers. Our primary duty is to interact with knowledge, not to meet others' expectations.
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 3 tighnari 11.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' As for me, I took part in this competition to advertise for an academic lecture at Gandharva Ville next month. I'll obviously try my best during the competition, but I won't let any additional pressure get to me.
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 3 tighnari 12.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' I think you can also try to find a clearly defined goal. That may help you.
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 3 layla 12.ogg}} '''Layla:''' I understand. Thanks for your advice.
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 3 tighnari 13.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Phew... I'm absolutely parched after talking so much.
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 3 cyno 05.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' I've still got some water with me.
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 3 tighnari 14.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' No, I'll be alright. We aren't far from Aaru Village, so I can go the rest of the way myself. You should get back to the competition. Don't you want to win that limited-edition card?
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 3 cyno 06.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Yes. Alright then, your spirit will live on through me.
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 3 tighnari 15.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' ...Hey, don't talk like that. I'm not dead, Cyno.
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 3 tighnari 16.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Everyone, I'll be heading back now. See you after the round ends.
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 3 cyno 07.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' I'll continue searching for the Ley Line Disruptors.
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 3 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Are you feeling better now, Layla?
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 3 layla 13.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Yeah. I feel like some of the weight has been taken off my shoulders after chatting with Tighnari.
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 3 layla 14.ogg}} '''Layla:''' It's been a long time since I first left my hometown to come to the Akademiya, and every day here has been so precious... But of course, there have been some tough times.
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 3 layla 15.ogg}} '''Layla:''' All sorts of complex astrological models, countless quizzes, and essays that took all my brainpower to barely finish... Each of those things are like huge boulders barreling at me, forcing me to continue running forward.
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 3 layla 16.ogg}} '''Layla:''' When I was chosen as my Darshan's representative, it felt like another boulder was added to the ones already rolling behind me. Every time I close my eyes, I think of all the people I'd disappoint if I mess up.
:{{DIcon}} We would never be disappointed in you.
:{{DIcon}} We'd prefer you to be happy, Layla.
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 3 layla 17.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Yeah, I think that's what Tighnari was trying to tell me.
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 3 layla 18.ogg}} '''Layla:''' You're our good friends, which is why you didn't stop him from dropping out of this round, and why you don't feel disappointed in me.
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 3 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' That's right! No need to feel so down!
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 3 layla 19.ogg}} '''Layla:''' That said, he did also say that he hopes I could have more concrete goals for taking part in this competition. I don't have any now, but I'll give that some thought.
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 3 layla 20.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Anyway, I won't take up any more of your time. You still have to record the other contestants' progress, don't you? Perhaps they've had some breakthroughs while we've been chatting.
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 3 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' True, we should go look for the others. Hmm, now who's left? Tighnari's dropped out for the round, and we just saw Cyno...
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 3 layla 21.ogg}} '''Layla:''' You could go see how Madam Faruzan's doing. I've heard that she's quite knowledgeable about the desert, so she's probably made some progress by now...
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 3 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Okay! Let's go look for Faruzan!
{{Dialogue End}}

;(Talk to Faruzan)
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 4 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hey there, Faruzan. Have you made any progress?
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 4 faruzan 01.ogg}} '''Faruzan:''' Ah, you're just in time. I'm about to start digging right here.
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 4 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, you found the Ley Line Disruptor already?
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 4 faruzan 02.ogg}} '''Faruzan:''' Hmph, such a simple problem could never confound me.
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 4 faruzan 03.ogg}} '''Faruzan:''' Not long after entering the desert, I discovered a Primal Construct that was acting abnormally, so I followed it all the way here.
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 4 faruzan 04.ogg}} '''Faruzan:''' Once I got near here, it suddenly disappeared. Something unusual must be happening around this area.
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 4 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You're a true expert, Madam Faruzan! You knew what to do right away!
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 4 faruzan 05.ogg}} '''Faruzan:''' Well, I do happen to have more experience than most. But that aside, has anyone completed this challenge yet?
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 4 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Nope, not yet!
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 4 faruzan 06.ogg}} '''Faruzan:''' Well then, I suppose I'll be the first. What about that boy Tighnari?
:{{DIcon}} He withdrew from this round.
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 4 faruzan 07.ogg}} '''Faruzan:''' Oh, and why's that?
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 4 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' He's not used to being out and about in the desert...
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 4 faruzan 08.ogg}} '''Faruzan:''' Huh, I didn't think he would have such a weakness. I suppose he could use a bit more training.
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 4 faruzan 09.ogg}} '''Faruzan:''' What about the others? Is that Rtawahist girl still a bundle of nerves?
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 4 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Tighnari gave Layla some advice, and she seems to be doing a lot better now. Cyno just started his search for the Disruptors, and as for Hat Guy... Well, who knows what he's thinking.
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 4 faruzan 10.ogg}} '''Faruzan:''' And what about Kaveh? Has he found a Ley Line Disruptor yet?
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 4 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Paimon doesn't think so, or our locators would've already let us know.
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 4 faruzan 11.ogg}} '''Faruzan:''' Strange, what's he lollygagging for? With his skills, you should've heard something from him by now.
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 4 faruzan 12.ogg}} '''Faruzan:''' Well, I'm afraid the most thrilling moments are already done here. You should probably go find Kaveh and see how he's faring now.
{{Dialogue End}}

;(Talk to Kaveh)
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 5 kaveh 01.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Come on, stop following me! I already gave you all the food I had on me.
:'''Desert Fox:''' *whine*
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 5 kaveh 02.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' You can cry all you want. I don't have any more food! All I have left is half a bottle of water, and I can't possibly give you that.
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 5 kaveh 03.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Without water, traveling in the desert will be incredibly difficult, and I still need to find what I'm looking for.
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 5 kaveh 04.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Mehrak, can you help me out here? Keep them away!
:'''Mehrak:''' Beep-boop!
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 5 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Kaveh, there you are!
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 5 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Faruzan told us to come see how you're doing. What are you up to?
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 5 kaveh 05.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' *sigh* Just thinking about it makes me upset. Not long after I entered the desert, I was accosted by these fellows.
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 5 kaveh 06.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' I don't know why, but they didn't leave the competition grounds, and now the Ley Line disruptions have left them confused and circling around the area.
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 5 kaveh 07.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' The moment they saw me, they wouldn't leave me alone. They even cheated me out of my limited food supply.
:'''Mehrak:''' Beep-boop!
:'''Desert Fox:''' *whine*
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 5 kaveh 08.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Hey, didn't I ask you to keep them away?
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 5 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Kaveh, is this flying metal thingy yours?
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 5 kaveh 09.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' That's right. This is my toolbox, Mehrak.
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 5 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Your toolbox? It seems pretty fancy... Uh... Hey there, can you understand us?
:'''Mehrak:''' Beep-boop?
:{{DIcon}} Why's it here with you?
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 5 kaveh 10.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Sometimes I need to carry things when I go out, so it's handy to have a portable toolbox.
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 5 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Well, this definitely doesn't look like an ordinary toolbox, that's for sure.
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 5 kaveh 11.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' It's a long story. When I was working in the desert, I ran into a merchant group who had a machine core they excavated from some tomb.
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 5 kaveh 12.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' It was clearly from King Deshret's civilization. His technology still isn't fully understood, and Kshahrewar has many different opinions on this topic.
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 5 kaveh 13.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Our current theories cannot explain such mysteries. Upon seeing such a rare, complete specimen before me, I forked over all the Mora on my person to purchase it.
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 5 kaveh 14.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Some time back, I wanted to make an automated case that could store my offloaded items. With that core, I created Mehrak.
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 5 kaveh 15.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' It can't understand commands that are too complex, but it can serve as my assistant and help me with things like mapping and surveying.
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 5 kaveh 16.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Most importantly, it can't talk, so it can't give me any attitude.
:'''Mehrak:''' Beep-boop!
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 5 kaveh 17.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Oh, yes — thanks for helping hide the fact that I live at Alhaitham's place earlier.
:{{DIcon}} Well, Paimon was the one who gave it away in the first place.
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 5 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hehe, sorry...
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 5 kaveh 18.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' *sigh* I hope this season of my life ends soon, so I can get things back on track.
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 5 kaveh 19.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Things just... started going downhill at some point. Maybe it all started when my mom remarried and left for Fontaine. Or maybe it all started when I spoke to Alhaitham in the library...
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 5 kaveh 20.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Or maybe it's because constructing the Palace of Alcazarzaray burned through my funds. I'm still paying off the debt from that one... Argh, when's this going to end!?
:'''Desert Fox:''' *whine*
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 5 kaveh 21.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Now that I think about it, I guess we're all unlucky here.
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 5 kaveh 22.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' It's not like any of you asked to be trapped in a Ley Line disruption... Okay, let me get you all out.
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 5 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Kaveh, aren't you going to look for the Ley Line Disruptors?
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 5 kaveh 23.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Yes, but I can't just leave them here, can I?
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 5 kaveh 24.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Oh, forget it. The more I think about this, the more I feel a headache coming on. I'll get back to searching once I get them out of here.
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 5 kaveh 25.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Time's a-wasting — I'm off!
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 5 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Kaveh looks like he's conflicted... He really wants to win, but he can't ignore those he wants to help...
:{{DIcon}} He's a unique character.
:{{DIcon}} He can only do one or the other...
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 5 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Paimon's always felt like he's the type who easily gets himself into tough spots.
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 5 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Um, Paimon doesn't mean this in an insulting way, but... he seems like the kind of guy who'd be really easy to take advantage of.
:;(Locator chimes)
:{{DIcon}} You're certainly cruel with the truth...
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 5 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Woah, someone's done already!
:{{DIcon}} That was quick.
::{{A|vo xyjeq002 5 paimon 12a 1.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Right? Wonder who it is. Let's go back and ask Alhaitham!
:{{DIcon}} I wonder who it is.
::{{A|vo xyjeq002 5 paimon 12b 1.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Paimon also wants to know! Let's go back and ask Alhaitham!
{{Dialogue End}}

;(Approach Alhaitham, Nilou, and Cyno at the sub-venue)
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 6 nilou 01.ogg}} '''Nilou:''' Verification complete! Congratulations on being this round's first winner, Cyno!
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 6 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ooh, so Cyno was the quickest!
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 6 cyno 01.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' I am from Spantamad, after all. We know a lot about Ley Lines, so finding a disruptor was never going to be particularly difficult for me.
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 6 nilou 02.ogg}} '''Nilou:''' Since {{Traveler}} and Paimon also happen to be here... Do you have anything you want to say?
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 6 cyno 02.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Anything I want to say...? My friend couldn't continue on, so failure was never an option.
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 6 cyno 03.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' "The bonds of yesterday will forge the road to tomorrow. With the ties of friendship that bind us, I won't lose to anyone."
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 6 cyno 04.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' ...That's a line from "King of Invokations," one of my favorite works, and it sums up my thoughts right now.
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 6 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' It might be a good thing that Tighnari isn't here, or else he'd give Cyno a good smack right about now...
:{{DIcon}} That's so Cyno.
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 6 nilou 03.ogg}} '''Nilou:''' Oh wow, it's already so late. Everyone's probably running low on food and water — it'll only get harder from here on out.
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 6 cyno 05.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Something similar happened in "King of Invokations." What a classic.
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 6 nilou 04.ogg}} '''Nilou:''' Any thoughts on that, Alhaitham?
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 6 alhaitham 01.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' I have no thoughts regarding "King of Invokations."
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 6 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Nilou obviously wasn't asking about that!
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 6 alhaitham 02.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' Deserts are much more dangerous at night, so this competition should be nearing its end. At the moment, only Faruzan, Layla, and Kaveh remain.
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 6 nilou 05.ogg}} '''Nilou:''' I wonder who the next person to find a disruptor will be...
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 6 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wait, only three people are left? Tighnari forfeited, and Cyno's already done... What about Hat Guy?
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 6 alhaitham 03.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' He also forfeited not long ago.
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 6 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Paimon can't understand what he's thinking at all...
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 6 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' But like Alhaitham said — the round's almost over. Let's go see what the other contestants are doing!
{{Dialogue End}}
{{Quest Description|update|As it turns out, the one in the lead was Cyno, who, being of Spantamad, found little issue handling Ley Lines. How are the other participants doing?}}
