;(Talk to Layla)
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 7 layla 01.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Hello again... You know, it suddenly occurred to me that you guys have had to do a lot of running around this time. Don't you find it tiring?
:{{DIcon}} It's not bad.
::{{A|vo xyjeq002 7 layla 02a 1.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Really? Wow. I dunno where you get your strength from...
:{{DIcon}} Yeah, a little...
::{{A|vo xyjeq002 7 layla 02b 1.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Well, in that case, let's take a short breather here.
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 7 layla 03.ogg}} '''Layla:''' The desert's getting colder now that night's falling. And the wind can really sting your face because of all the sand in it.
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 7 layla 04.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Has anyone finished this round yet?
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 7 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Cyno's already shut one down. Have you made any progress yet?
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 7 layla 05.ogg}} '''Layla:''' I circled the whole area, but I didn't find anything.
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 7 layla 06.ogg}} '''Layla:''' But I did have the chance to think some more about that thing that was weighing on my mind, and I realized something.
:{{DIcon}} And what was that?
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 7 layla 07.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Well, my fellow Rtawahist members must have all put my name forward for different reasons. And maybe a lot of them only picked me because they wanted to watch me make a fool of myself.
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 7 layla 08.ogg}} '''Layla:''' But be that as it may, I believe that a lot of them genuinely do expect great things from me.
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 7 layla 09.ogg}} '''Layla:''' And I want to live up to their expectations. I don't want them to regret putting my name down.
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 7 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh? But doesn't thinking like that put a lot of pressure on you?
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 7 layla 10.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Of course, that comes with some amount of pressure, for sure. But now I've thought about it, I don't feel like this is something I have to do. Instead, it's something I want to do.
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 7 layla 11.ogg}} '''Layla:''' That may not sound like a huge difference to you. But it's helped me relax a lot... so don't worry about me.
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 7 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Well, that's great!
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 7 layla 12.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Also, now that I've relaxed... I'm suddenly really sleepy...
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 7 layla 13.ogg}} '''Layla:''' I think I'll just... take a quick nap... just a quick one...
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 7 layla 14.ogg}} '''Layla:''' ...
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 7 layla 15.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Hmm? But the competition isn't over yet... Oh, Layla, Layla... she's really a bundle of nerves, isn't she?
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 7 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wait, you're...!
:{{DIcon}} "Sleepwalking Layla"?
:{{DIcon}} "Other Layla"?
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 7 layla 16.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Good to see you too. Whew, it's nice to be out — feels like I've been cooped up inside for quite a while.
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 7 layla 17.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Well, since I'm here, I guess I should help her finish this. What are we supposed to be doing here again? Finding a Ley Line Disruptor, was it?
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 7 layla 18.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Let me see... Hmm, looks like she's basically gathered all the information she needs. It won't take long to wrap this up.
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 7 layla 19.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Come with me, you two.
{{Dialogue End}}
{{Quest Description|update|Upon encountering Layla again, she seems a bit more relaxed.}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(While following Layla)
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 8 layla 01.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Do you ever get the feeling that the Ley Lines have a regular flow, similar to the way that celestial bodies follow fixed orbits?
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 8 layla 02.ogg}} '''Layla:''' If we were looking down from on high, I wonder whether we'd find that the Ley Lines are just the reflections of the stars upon the earth?

:{{A|vo xyjeq002 8 layla 03.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Not all astrological phenomena can be directly observed. Some are deductions based on other details that we know.
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 8 layla 04.ogg}} '''Layla:''' It's the same situation with the Ley Lines. The parts of them that are hidden underground can be identified via elemental energy, sound, and other phenomena.

:{{A|vo xyjeq002 8 layla 05.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Plus, now that someone has shut one of the disruptors down, the contrast between before and after can provide me with further information still.
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 8 layla 06.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Let me see... It should be here, I think?
{{Dialogue End}}
{{Quest Description|update|The "Other Layla" has appeared. Can she locate the Ley Line Disruptor?}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Approach Layla)
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 8 layla 07.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Ah, this should be it, right? I'll turn it off — that should restore the Ley Lines in the area to normal.
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 8 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Nice work!
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 8 layla 08.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Again, I didn't do any of the real work. I'm just wrapping up.
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 8 layla 09.ogg}} '''Layla:''' She'll probably wake up soon... No doubt she'll be a little disoriented at first, but once she's got her bearings, she'll go and report that she shut down this disruptor.
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 8 layla 10.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Will you be staying here for a while? Or are you going to check on the other contestants?
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 8 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Time to check our locator... Whoa! It looks like Kaveh and Faruzan are heading toward the same place!
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 8 layla 11.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Perhaps they're about to find the last disruptor. ...Also, speaking of Kaveh, he's an interesting one.
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 8 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh? Why do you say that?
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 8 layla 12.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Before the second round, he had a chat with the other me. He said that worries can be like illnesses — they don't always have a magic cure. Sometimes, you just have to endure them as best you can until they run their course.
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 8 layla 13.ogg}} '''Layla:''' But the way I see it, his situation is much worse than my other self's... She just hadn't found what she wanted to do at that moment, which is why she felt lost.
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 8 layla 14.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Kaveh, meanwhile, knows what he wants to do — he's convinced that he has to win — and yet, he still seems conflicted...
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 8 layla 15.ogg}} '''Layla:''' He doesn't have a second personality, but... somehow, he still seems like he's at odds with himself in some way.
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 8 layla 16.ogg}} '''Layla:''' ...I don't know exactly how to describe it. It's like he's smiling on the outside, but there's no joy inside. Only sorrow.
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 8 layla 17.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Still, who knows. He must be more experienced than me — maybe he's just better at dealing with it all than I am.
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 8 layla 18.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Oh, but back to the topic of wrapping up... Shouldn't you be getting back to the action to record how everything plays out? Last one, then the round's over.
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 8 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, true. Okay then, guess we'll be going now! We'll keep everything you said in mind!

;(After the dialogue)
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 9 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Kaveh and Faruzan were super confident at the start, but it turns out they're the last ones to find a disruptor.
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 9 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' But between the two of them, who's going to get there first? Let's head over, quick!
{{Dialogue End}}
{{Quest Description|update|The "Other Layla" pointed out some contradictions regarding Kaveh. There is one last Ley Line Disruptor remaining. Will Kaveh or Faruzan find it first?}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Approach Faruzan and Kaveh)
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 9 faruzan 01.ogg}} '''Faruzan:''' It should be around here...
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 9 kaveh 01.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Finally found it...
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 9 faruzan 02.ogg}} '''Faruzan:''' Kaveh? Are you...
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 9 kaveh 02.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Madam Faruzan! And here I thought you would've finished this round by now...
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 9 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Faruzan, Kaveh!
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 9 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, looks like Layla's already done.
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 9 kaveh 03.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' I didn't expect that you and I would find a disruptor at the same time... How are the other contestants doing?
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 9 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Tighnari and Hat Guy forfeited, while Cyno and Layla are already done. You two are the only ones left.
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 9 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh, that's weird. Didn't you start digging really early on?
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 9 faruzan 03.ogg}} '''Faruzan:''' Yes. I kept digging, but instead of finding a disruptor, I found a ruin.
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 9 faruzan 04.ogg}} '''Faruzan:''' I fell down pretty deep, and it was completely dark in there. It took me quite some time to unlock the various mechanisms and return to the surface.
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 9 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' That's... actually really impressive...
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 9 kaveh 04.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Finishing a week's worth of trials in such a short time... That's pretty amazing, Madam Faruzan...
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 9 faruzan 05.ogg}} '''Faruzan:''' What about you? Why are you so late?
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 9 kaveh 05.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' I encountered a lot of lost Desert Foxes along the way, and I brought them to the outskirts of the competition zone. When I came back, I was absolutely parched... and then I blacked out. Probably from the heat, you know.
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 9 kaveh 06.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' When I woke up, it was already night. I used the last of my strength to come here.
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 9 faruzan 06.ogg}} '''Faruzan:''' A most curious reason indeed... Ah, but are you sure you're alright? It sounds like you were in an incredibly dangerous situation.
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 9 faruzan 07.ogg}} '''Faruzan:''' You said you were familiar with the desert, but the way you handle problems... It does feel rather at odds with your title as a genius.
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 9 kaveh 07.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Ahaha, it was problematic, but that had nothing to do with me being a genius. It was my decision.
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 9 kaveh 08.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' ...The way I did things wasn't optimal, but I wouldn't have been comfortable not doing it, either. My conscience would've weighed on me.
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 9 faruzan 08.ogg}} '''Faruzan:''' ...Hmph. Youths these days, each stranger than the next.
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 9 faruzan 09.ogg}} '''Faruzan:''' But back to the main issue at hand. Since we're both very certain that this is where the final Ley Line Disruptor is, let's dig it up then.
:{{Black Screen|Working together, the two unearth the final Ley Line Disruptor.}}
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 9 faruzan 10.ogg}} '''Faruzan:''' Well, this is indeed it, of that there is no doubt. But how should we count the score this time?
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 9 kaveh 09.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Phew...
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 9 faruzan 11.ogg}} '''Faruzan:''' What is it, youngster? You seem relieved.
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 9 kaveh 10.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Oh, nothing. I was just thinking that this round's finally over.
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 9 kaveh 11.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' ...There shouldn't be any more innocent creatures getting wrapped up in danger.
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 9 kaveh 12.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' As for the points... I guess we can draw lots again later. I can't think of anything better.
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 9 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Alright. In that case, let's all head back to Aaru Village. Paimon thinks you'll both need some water and rest.
{{Dialogue End}}

:{{A|vo xyjeq002 10 kaveh 03.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' ...

:{{A|vo xyjeq002 10 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Looks like Kaveh's luck's taken a turn for the better!
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 10 kaveh 05.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Finally, after all this time... *sniff*
:{{A|vo xyjeq002 10 faruzan 02.ogg}} '''Faruzan:''' It looks like you've been rewarded for your tribulations in the desert. This round's points are yours.

===Further Investigation===
{{Dialogue Start}}
{{Quest Description|You should be able to make progress with the information you have gathered so far...}}
;(Go over the clues with Layla)
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915302 layla 02.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Okay, everyone's given us a lot of useful information. Let's go through it and try to organize everything.
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915302 layla 03.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Some things we heard were pretty straightforward, but others were just ridiculous...
:{{DIcon}} We should be able to figure out more about its identity and whereabouts.
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915302 layla 04.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Yeah, let me think and see what I can make of it.
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915302 layla 05.ogg}} '''Layla:''' (Okay, calm down Layla. I know the info's all over the place, but you can definitely do it.)
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915302 layla 06.ogg}} '''Layla:''' (First, let's try to figure out the Seelie's identity based on the clues we currently have.)
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915302 layla 07.ogg}} '''Layla:''' (Then, we'll analyze where it's been sighted and its motives... Finally, we'll piece everything together...)
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915302 layla 08.ogg}} '''Layla:''' (From there, we should be able to predict its movement. Alright, let's give it a try.)
----
;(Layla enters {{color|menu|Contemplation}})

;(Interpret - Book Checkout Logs)
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915302 layla 09.ogg}} '''Layla:''' (Book circulation is strictly regulated and there is a log of anyone who checks out a book.)
;(Interpret - Shadow That Infiltrated the House of Daena)
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915302 layla 10.ogg}} '''Layla:''' (It once infiltrated the House of Daena while it was closed.)
;(Interpret - The Wisdom Seelie's Superpower)
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915302 layla 11.ogg}} '''Layla:''' (Hmm, I think I heard somewhere that it has a lot of ridiculous abilities...)
;(Interpret - Sighting Location)
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915302 layla 12.ogg}} '''Layla:''' (It's been to the Chatrakam Cave, the Avidya Forest, and the waterfall south of Sumeru City.)
;(Interpret - The Wisdom Seelie's True Identity)
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915302 layla 13.ogg}} '''Layla:''' (The stamp... Hmm, which probably means they're a Rtawahist student...)

;(Submit the wrong conclusion)
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915302 layla 14.ogg}} '''Layla:''' (I may be able to come up with a more concrete lead if I keep thinking...)
;(Submit the wrong association)
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915302 layla 15.ogg}} '''Layla:''' (Hmm, no, there doesn't seem to be any notable connection between these two pieces of information.)

;(Quit {{color|menu|Contemplation}} and use [[Nahida]]'s [[All Schemes to Know]] on [[Layla]], optional)
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915302 layla 01.ogg}} '''Layla:''' (Hmm... I think it's slowly starting to come together now...)

;(Submitting the correct association - The Wisdom Seelie's True Identity to Sighting Location)
;(Submit - The Wisdom Seelie's Behavioral Logic)
----
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915303 layla 01.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Okay, I think I've got it now...
:{{DIcon}} So, what've you come up with?
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915303 layla 02.ogg}} '''Layla:''' First, based on the information Katayoun provided, we can assume that the Seelie is a student from the Rtawahist Darshan.
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915303 layla 03.ogg}} '''Layla:''' The possibility of it being someone outside the Darshan can be ruled out because it'd be impossible to gain access to those two books without going through the librarian.
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915303 layla 04.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Next, leaving its crazy abilities aside, all the sightings took place in locations that are officially recommended for astrology observation by the Akademiya.
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915303 layla 05.ogg}} '''Layla:''' In other words, it's probably just conducting research, and the nature of its research is very similar to mine.
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915303 layla 06.ogg}} '''Layla:''' The question that I submitted was no simple query, but it was able to give me a reply in just a day. This implies that it's familiar with a similar field of knowledge.
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915303 layla 07.ogg}} '''Layla:''' So, based on this reasoning, all we have to do is wait for it at the next astrological observation site.
:{{DIcon}} Your reasoning is solid.
:{{DIcon}} Look at you, finishing your thesis should be no problem at all.
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915303 layla 08.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Ah, uh... It's nothing, really. There are actually some other factors that I've been speculating about...
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915303 layla 09.ogg}} '''Layla:''' But that's not important right now, let's get going. Even though we have a lead, it's still hard to say whether we'll be able to make any discoveries.
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915303 layla 10.ogg}} '''Layla:''' I'll tell you what I mean by that if the Seelie doesn't show up...
;(Continue to [[#The Truth Behind "It"|The Truth Behind "It"]])
{{Dialogue End}}

===The Truth Behind "It"===
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(If the watchtower is still locked)
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915303 layla 11.ogg}} '''Layla:''' We should be able to see more from up above, but how do we get up there?
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915303 layla 12.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Let's try using the Elemental Monuments in the area.

;(Upon Arriving to the watchtower, night has already fallen.)
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915306 layla 01.ogg}} '''Layla:''' The weather today is perfect for observation. Let's see if it shows up.
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915306 layla 02.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Honestly, spending an entire night waiting for something that we're not sure is gonna happen might not be the best use of our time...
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915306 layla 03.ogg}} '''Layla:''' But we don't really have any choice. This is all we've got.
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915306 layla 04.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Get some sleep if you're tired. I'll be up, it's not like I can sleep anyways.
:{{DIcon}} I'll stay up with you.
:{{DIcon}} I'm afraid you'll get bored.
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915306 layla 05.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Thanks. Hmm... Oh, how about I share some basics about astrology with you? If you're interested, that is.
;(The time passes as the two of you chat and before long, it's past sunrise.)
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915306 layla 06.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Sure enough, it didn't show up.
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915306 layla 07.ogg}} '''Layla:''' We hardly saw any animals, let alone people.
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915306 layla 08.ogg}} '''Layla:''' No matter how conclusive the evidence is or how perfect our reasoning may be, nothing will happen as long as I'm awake.
:{{DIcon}} Are you referring to the... "Wisdom Seelie" or the "blessing from the stars"?
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915306 layla 09.ogg}} '''Layla:''' They're probably one and the same.
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915306 layla 10.ogg}} '''Layla:''' It's like I told you — I have a severe sleeping disorder... and there have been a lot of rumors about me sleepwalking.
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915306 layla 11.ogg}} '''Layla:''' I tried to understand what I had been doing when I'm unconscious, but I've never been able to get any definitive evidence.
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915306 layla 12.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Something is actively attempting to cover up all the clues without my knowing.
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915306 layla 13.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Maybe that "something" is me... or maybe it isn't... I can't be sure...
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915306 layla 14.ogg}} '''Layla:''' For all I know, I could even BE the Seelie. But... what if I am?
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915306 layla 15.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Would "the Seelie" be willing to help me this time? What is it actually thinking? I really have no idea...
:{{DIcon}} What if I could help you?
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915306 layla 16.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Huh? You want to help me?
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915306 layla 17.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Of course, it would be nice to know what's really going on...
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915306 layla 18.ogg}} '''Layla:''' But that's impossible. It's always avoiding me and keeping me in the dark... And that won't change, even if you're around.
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (Seeing how badly she wants to know, maybe we should find a way to ask the "other Layla" about it...)
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915306 layla 19.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Huh? What's wrong?
:{{DIcon}} Oh, nothing. Maybe there really isn't anything we can do.
:{{DIcon}} Seems like we've come up empty-handed again this time.
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915306 layla 20.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Yeah...
;(Stress Value +1)
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915306 layla 21.ogg}} '''Layla:''' *sigh* And to think I could've been working on my thesis this whole time... Ahh, my stomach is churning just thinking about it...
:{{DIcon}} You're really not going to finish on time now.
:{{DIcon}} There's nothing else I can do. I'm sorry.
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915306 layla 22.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Please stop... the more you talk about it, the more silly I feel...
;(Stress Value +1)
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915306 layla 23.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Oh, c'mon Layla, what are you doing? Everyone's gonna start thinking you're crazy now...
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915306 layla 24.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Ahh... oh no. I'm losing it... So dizzy... ugh...
:{{DIcon}} (I'm sorry to have to make you feel so uncomfortable.)
;(Stress Value +1)
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915306 layla 25.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Hmm... oh, I'm sorry, I got distracted there. Where were we?
:{{DIcon}} (It seems like she's completely recovered. Huh, does that mean...)
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915306 layla 26.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Oh, what's wrong? You look like you've got something on your mind.
:{{DIcon}} Are you... the other Layla?
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915306 layla 27.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Hmm? What are you talking about? What do you mean the "other" Layla...? I am Layla.
:{{DIcon}} But you somehow seem a little different.
:{{DIcon}} Then why don't you repeat the conversation we just had?
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915306 layla 28.ogg}} '''Layla:''' *sigh*
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915306 layla 29.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Fine. It appears that you were waiting for me to show up. I suppose there's no use in me pretending.
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915306 layla 30.ogg}} '''Layla:''' I promise I don't mean any harm, and I'll answer all your questions. But before that, would you mind telling me who you are first?
:{{DIcon}} I'm a friend of Layla's. I'm trying to help her finish her thesis.
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915306 layla 31.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Let me think... Okay, I got it. You two found this place by following the hints that I left behind. You were planning to wait for me... Or, I should say, you were waiting for the Seelie to show up.
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915306 layla 32.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Was this your idea or hers?
:{{DIcon}} Mostly hers.
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915306 layla 33.ogg}} '''Layla:''' I see. Yes, she's always had great analytical skills. It'd be nice if she was more confident, though.
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915306 layla 34.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Alright, that's all the questions I have. Your turn, please ask away.
:{{DIcon}} Did you infiltrate the House of Daena? And what about those rumors of special powers?
::{{A|vo lylcop001 1915306 layla 41.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Infiltrating the House of Daena was a total accident. She'd forgotten an important book, and the House of Daena happened to be closed at the time. There were only days before the paper was due.
::{{A|vo lylcop001 1915306 layla 42.ogg}} '''Layla:''' I had no choice but to scale the walls with some simple climbing ropes and sneak in from above while the Corps of Thirty wasn't paying attention.
::{{A|vo lylcop001 1915306 layla 43.ogg}} '''Layla:''' I had no idea there was still a student inside. I had no choice but to put him to sleep.
::{{A|vo lylcop001 1915306 layla 44.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Any clear evidence of my existence would only hinder my ability to conceal my identity. It would also expose me to Layla as well.
::{{A|vo lylcop001 1915306 layla 45.ogg}} '''Layla:''' As for the special powers... Well, they're just things I did during the process of trying to finish the thesis. It's like I said — I don't have much time, so I need to be as efficient as possible.

::{{A|vo lylcop001 1915306 layla 39.ogg}} '''Layla:''' My time to move freely is quite limited, so it's only natural that I would punish the people attempting to waste my time.
::{{A|vo lylcop001 1915306 layla 40.ogg}} '''Layla:''' My intention is to help people. I'm not here to cause any harm.
:{{DIcon}} You're the Seelie, aren't you?

::{{A|vo lylcop001 1915306 layla 37.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Unfortunately, that didn't really work out. Instead, legends of "the Seelie" started going around. Hehe, but that's alright.

::{{DIcon}} Why don't you want her to know you exist?

:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915306 layla 48.ogg}} '''Layla:''' If she knew that there's another Layla who is capable of doing everything, she may think even less of herself.
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915306 layla 49.ogg}} '''Layla:''' She could think, "Maybe I should just leave it all to her. I'm always relying on her anyway. Why not let her live my life for me...?"
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915306 layla 50.ogg}} '''Layla:''' She might start thinking about giving up completely, and that's the exact opposite of what I'm trying to do for her.
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915306 layla 51.ogg}} '''Layla:''' After all, she and I are one and the same. We're two sides of the same coin.
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915306 layla 52.ogg}} '''Layla:''' No one knows her greatest strength more than I do — it's her resilience. If she's able to persevere in everything she does, then one day, she won't need my help anymore.

:{{A|vo sgeq001 13 venti 03.ogg}} '''Venti:''' Welcome, one and all, to this festival of poetry, jointly organized by Liyue and Mondstadt!
:{{A|vo sgeq001 13 hutao 03.ogg}} '''Hu Tao:''' Or, in full: the "Neighboring Nations Congenial Poetry Gala"!
:{{A|vo sgeq001 13 hutao 04.ogg}} '''Hu Tao:''' We are your hosts: Liyue's versemonger of the darkest alleys, Hu Tao...
:{{A|vo sgeq001 13 venti 04.ogg}} '''Venti:''' ...And Mondstadt's liquor-loving lyricist, Venti the bard!
:{{A|vo sgeq001 13 venti 05.ogg}} '''Venti:''' The purpose of this event is to promote friendly, poetic exchanges between our two nations! So please, have fun, talk to other people, and make some new friends.
:{{A|vo sgeq001 13 hutao 05.ogg}} '''Hu Tao:''' If you're here, you're our guest, so please enjoy this poetry fest!
:{{A|vo sgeq001 13 venti 06.ogg}} '''Venti:''' I'd also like to reassure everyone that this event welcomes people of all skill levels, from first-time rhymers to seasoned songwriters.
:{{A|vo sgeq001 13 venti 07.ogg}} '''Venti:''' If you ask me, the most important thing you can bring to writing poetry is authenticity. That means reaching deep down to all the thoughts and feelings you usually hide away or struggle to express, and putting them into words... Just write from the heart, in whatever form you like.
:{{A|vo sgeq001 13 hutao 06.ogg}} '''Hu Tao:''' To help everyone really cut loose and enjoy themselves to the fullest, Venti and I have carefully prepared three themes, to be revealed over the course of three days!
:{{A|vo sgeq001 13 hutao 07.ogg}} '''Hu Tao:''' Let's get right to it! The first theme is... "Riddle Me This"!
:{{A|vo sgeq001 13 xingqiu 01.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' (Solving riddles, huh? Interesting. It's actually a pretty good choice for a warm-up activity.)
:{{A|vo sgeq001 13 mika 01.ogg}} '''Mika:''' (Whew... I'm glad they're not making us write sonnets or something right at the start.)
:{{A|vo sgeq001 13 hutao 08.ogg}} '''Hu Tao:''' Does everyone see the lanterns hanging around the venue? These have been specially prepared for the riddle game.
:{{A|vo sgeq001 13 hutao 09.ogg}} '''Hu Tao:''' Simply write down your riddle and hang it on a lantern. Then, Venti and I will select a few to pose to the crowd, and you will try to solve them!
:{{A|vo sgeq001 13 hutao 10.ogg}} '''Hu Tao:''' We'll now give you some time to write down and hang up your riddles. Feel free to walk around and talk with the other contestants to get the creative juices flowing. And remember, whoever guesses the most riddles correctly will get a prize!
:{{A|vo sgeq001 13 venti 08.ogg}} '''Venti:''' And with that, the "Neighboring Nations Congenial Poetry Gala" has officially begun!

:{{A|vo sgeq001 20 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Seriously!? Wow, what is it?
:{{A|vo sgeq001 20 chongyun 01.ogg}} '''Chongyun:''' Ummm...
:{{A|vo sgeq001 20 hutao 01.ogg}} '''Hu Tao:''' A most generous donation by yours truly as Director of the [[Wangsheng Funeral Parlor]]. Namely, a buy one get one free coupon for our high-end customized service package! It's a pleasant surprise to learn you're so interested in it, Paimon.
:{{A|vo sgeq001 20 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hahahaha! Nope! Nuh-uh, no thank you! Hard pass — you can keep it!
:{{A|vo sgeq001 20 xingqiu 03.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' Are you sure? In that case, I'll gladly take it!
:{{A|vo sgeq001 20 hutao 02.ogg}} '''Hu Tao:''' Here you are! Now remember, this package comes with our "anytime, anywhere" on-demand collection service! Just give us a call and we'll be right there! ...With any luck, we'll still show up even if you're... unable to call.
:{{A|vo sgeq001 20 xingqiu 04.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' So, to what do we owe the honor, Paimon?
:{{A|vo sgeq001 20 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hmph! What do you mean, "we"? Chongyun's the one Paimon's looking for, not you. Wasn't he saying something about needing help?
:{{A|vo sgeq001 20 chongyun 02.ogg}} '''Chongyun:''' Oh yeah, that...
:{{A|vo sgeq001 20 xingqiu 05.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' How about I put it in riddle form?
:{{A|vo sgeq001 20 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh? Isn't the competition over?
:{{A|vo sgeq001 20 xingqiu 06.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' "'Twas like a demon not demonic, or devil devoid of the diabolic. Afar it floated free above the ground, but when approached, though sought, nought could be found."
:{{A|vo sgeq001 20 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Um...
:{{A|vo sgeq001 20 hutao 03.ogg}} '''Hu Tao:''' Sounds to me like you encountered a ghastly little ghostie in the wild?
:{{A|vo sgeq001 20 chongyun 03.ogg}} '''Chongyun:''' Perhaps I should just explain it...
:{{A|vo sgeq001 20 chongyun 04.ogg}} '''Chongyun:''' Basically, while I was training this morning, I suddenly caught sight of a [[Hydro Eidolon|nonhuman entity]].
:{{A|vo sgeq001 20 chongyun 05.ogg}} '''Chongyun:''' It was floating in the air without any kind of external aid, and its body was almost transparent. At first, I thought I'd finally encountered a demon that wasn't repelled by my pure-yang spirit, and immediately prepared to exorcise it.
:{{A|vo sgeq001 20 chongyun 06.ogg}} '''Chongyun:''' But none of my methods had any effect on it. And when I went to try and get a closer look at it and try to ascertain what I was dealing with, it disappeared into thin air.
:{{A|vo sgeq001 20 hutao 04.ogg}} '''Hu Tao:''' You're sure it's not a ghost or spirit of some kind?
:{{A|vo sgeq001 20 chongyun 07.ogg}} '''Chongyun:''' Quite sure. I could sense that it had a physical body. And if it were a spirit, I'm sure it would have been scared away long before I saw it.
:{{A|vo sgeq001 20 chongyun 08.ogg}} '''Chongyun:''' It's all my fault. I got overexcited, and in my haste I didn't ascertain its true nature before taking action. Thinking back on it... If it wasn't an evil spirit, maybe I offended some kind of adeptus, or illuminated beast...
:{{A|vo sgeq001 20 xingqiu 07.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' You shouldn't blame yourself. It was something you'd never seen before — anyone else would've reacted the same way.
:{{A|vo sgeq001 20 xingqiu 08.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' Besides, we're making up for it now by doing our best to find out the truth.
:{{A|vo sgeq001 20 hutao 05.ogg}} '''Hu Tao:''' Any thoughts, Venti? Have you managed to untangle Chongyun's twisted tale?
:{{A|vo sgeq001 20 venti 01.ogg}} '''Venti:''' Why don't you take a guess first, Hu Tao?
:{{A|vo sgeq001 20 hutao 06.ogg}} '''Hu Tao:''' Oho, that means you have!
:{{A|vo sgeq001 20 venti 02.ogg}} '''Venti:''' Hehe, I can't be absolutely certain, but I'm reasonably sure it's not what Liyue would call an "evil spirit" or "demon." So whatever it is, it's not dangerous.
:{{A|vo sgeq001 20 venti 03.ogg}} '''Venti:''' Hmm... How about this? We can incorporate a "search" element into tomorrow's poetry activity.
:{{A|vo sgeq001 20 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ooh, does that mean we get to play outside while we write poetry?
:{{A|vo sgeq001 20 venti 04.ogg}} '''Venti:''' Haha, close! ...But no.
:{{A|vo sgeq001 20 venti 05.ogg}} '''Venti:''' Good ideas could just pop into your head out of thin air. But if you ask me, everyone should relax tonight, and get a good rest before tomorrow!
:{{A|vo sgeq001 20 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You say that, but your gaze keeps drifting over towards the wine stand!
:;(Quest ends)

;(Talk to Venti next to Jochen's stall, optional)
:{{A|vo dialog sgeq001 venti 04.ogg}} '''Venti:''' Seeing my friends having such a lively discussion, I couldn't help but join in on the fun.
:{{A|vo dialog sgeq001 venti 05.ogg}} '''Venti:''' Of course, I promised Hu Tao I'd behave and do my job as a good host... but I really am parched from speaking so much. It would be negligent not to wet my whistle.
:{{A|vo dialog sgeq001 venti 06.ogg}} '''Venti:''' And you know what the best part is? Wine is to the poet's tongue as ink to his pen. So, two birds with one stone!
{{Dialogue End}}

==Steps==

# Apologize to [[Draff]]

==Dialogue==
{{Quest Description|While out on a stroll, you bumped into a strange girl. This girl, a chef from [[Liyue]] by the name of Xiangling, is on a journey to seek out exotic ingredients. She enlists your help in a hunt, but your private hunting expedition appears to have earned the ire of Draff, the leader of the hunters. You head off to apologize to him...}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Talk to Draff)
:{{A|vo xllq002 2 draff 01.ogg}} '''Draff:''' You must be Xiangling.
:{{A|vo xllq002 2 xiangling 01.ogg}} '''Xiangling:''' Sorry Mr. Draff, this was all my fault.
:{{A|vo xllq002 2 draff 02.ogg}} '''Draff:''' I heard the whole story. And now that you're here in person...
:{{A|vo xllq002 2 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ooh, he's gonna let her have it!
:{{DIcon}} Violence is not the answer!
:{{DIcon}} If you're looking for a fight, bring it on!
:{{A|vo xllq002 2 draff 03.ogg}} '''Draff:''' ...Please help me promote my meat!
:{{A|vo xllq002 2 xiangling 02.ogg}} '''Xiangling:''' ...Eh?
:{{A|vo xllq002 2 draff 04.ogg}} '''Draff:''' Sorry if I was a little brash. Let me explain.
:{{A|vo xllq002 2 draff 05.ogg}} '''Draff:''' Springvale has built its reputation on top-quality meat products, but this reputation is so far limited to Mondstadt.
:{{A|vo xllq002 2 draff 06.ogg}} '''Draff:''' When I heard that the great maestro Xiangling herself was in Mondstadt, I asked Allan to send you over.
:{{A|vo xllq002 2 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Maestro?
:{{A|vo xllq002 2 draff 07.ogg}} '''Draff:''' Haven't you heard? She's the one behind [[Wanmin Restaurant]], that one-of-a-kind folk cuisine restaurant in [[Liyue Harbor]].
:{{A|vo xllq002 2 draff 08.ogg}} '''Draff:''' Her unique take on cooking ingredients is behind some of the best-loved dishes in all of Liyue. They are very highly rated by travelers, too.
:{{A|vo xllq002 2 xiangling 03.ogg}} '''Xiangling:''' Hee-hee, you're too kind. I just try to cook things that are cheap and cheerful.
:{{A|vo xllq002 2 draff 09.ogg}} '''Draff:''' With a top-notch chef cooking top-notch cuisine with top-notch meat from Springvale... Our reputation would spread far and wide.
:{{A|vo xllq002 2 xiangling 04.ogg}} '''Xiangling:''' Hmm... I don't know...
:{{A|vo xllq002 2 xiangling 05.ogg}} '''Xiangling:''' I only ever think about how to make tasty dishes... I never limit myself to specific ingredients, and I don't know the first thing about promoting anything.
:{{A|vo xllq002 2 draff 10.ogg}} '''Draff:''' You use boar meat all the time anyway, surely? I can't see what the issue is.
:{{A|vo xllq002 2 xiangling 06.ogg}} '''Xiangling:''' The issue is... What would you think if I added a bit of [[Slime Condensate]]?
:{{A|vo xllq002 2 draff 11.ogg}} '''Draff:''' That's... I mean, couldn't you add something a bit more normal?
:{{A|vo xllq002 2 xiangling 07.ogg}} '''Xiangling:''' There's no such thing as "normal" ingredients to me! You can turn anything into a delicacy if you cook it in the right way.
:{{A|vo xllq002 2 xiangling 08.ogg}} '''Xiangling:''' I will not stand for having my creativity shackled by what ingredients I can and can't use! Food cooked like that is destined to be boring, period!
:{{DIcon}} That escalated quickly...
:{{DIcon}} Celebrity chefs are known to be somewhat strong-minded...
:{{A|vo xllq002 2 draff 12.ogg}} '''Draff:''' *sigh* Well, since you feel so strongly about it, forget it. But it really is a pity...

;(Catch up to Xiangling)
:{{A|vo xllq002 3 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You know, we did come to apologize... Couldn't you be a little more flexible?
:{{A|vo xllq002 3 xiangling 01.ogg}} '''Xiangling:''' It's one thing to apologize, but it's another thing entirely to change the way I approach cooking.
:{{A|vo xllq002 3 xiangling 02.ogg}} {{DIcon|Idle}} '''Xiangling:''' Mmm, what's that smell?
:{{A|vo xllq002 3 xiangling 03.ogg}} {{DIcon|Idle}} '''Xiangling:''' It's gorgeous!

;(Talk to Xiangling at the source of the aroma)
:{{A|vo xllq002 4 xiangling 01.ogg}} '''Xiangling:''' Hello, may I have a taste of your delicious cooking?
:{{A|vo xllq002 4 brook 01.ogg}} '''[[Brook]]:''' Sorry, I've taken all the orders I can for the next few days. The earliest I could put you down for is seven days from now, is that okay?
:{{A|vo xllq002 4 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wow, it must be delicious if it's that popular.
:{{DIcon}} Odd... This woman is clearly a very popular chef...
:{{A|vo xllq002 4 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yeah, good point. Why does Draff want Xiangling to help when Springvale already has this lady?
:{{A|vo xllq002 4 brook 02.ogg}} '''Brook:''' Hmm... Maybe he feels that Mondstadt cuisine can't compete with that of [[Teyvat]]'s biggest business hub, Liyue Harbor.
:{{A|vo xllq002 4 brook 03.ogg}} '''Brook:''' But I disagree! I don't think my cooking is at all inferior to anyone else's.
:{{A|vo xllq002 4 xiangling 02.ogg}} '''Xiangling:''' Well then... Show me what you got! Maybe I can give you some feedback.
:{{A|vo xllq002 4 brook 04.ogg}} '''Brook:''' Sorry, but customer feedback like "Oh, that tasted good" is no use to me. If I wanted feedback I would ask a professional chef— Hang on, are you... Xiangling!?
:{{A|vo xllq002 4 xiangling 03.ogg}} '''Xiangling:''' That's me!
:{{A|vo xllq002 4 brook 05.ogg}} '''Brook:''' It's really you! Well, I guess you do know what you're doing when it comes to cooking meat then.
:{{A|vo xllq002 4 brook 06.ogg}} '''Brook:''' As it happens, I have one of today's prime cuts remaining. So tell me, how would you cook this?
:{{A|vo xllq002 4 xiangling 04.ogg}} '''Xiangling:''' That depends on the ratio of fat to meat. With this cut, I would probably roast it over a hot stone with a little salt, some [[Jueyun Chili]], and [[Qingxin]] flower.
:{{A|vo xllq002 4 brook 07.ogg}} '''Brook:''' Qingxin flower!? But the melted fat would make the flavor of the flowers ten times stronger than when eaten raw... It would overpower everything!
:{{A|vo xllq002 4 xiangling 05.ogg}} '''Xiangling:''' I know, that's why it's a garnish — I would never marinate the meat in it!
:{{A|vo xllq002 4 xiangling 06.ogg}} '''Xiangling:''' I've tried it before. If you baste the petals in oil and then cook them with the right heat and duration, it gets rid of the bitterness completely and leaves you with a lovely crispy topping.
:{{A|vo xllq002 4 xiangling 07.ogg}} '''Xiangling:''' Then throw in some Jueyun Chilis grown at a high altitude, where the low humidity and varying temperature lends them a unique dry heat.
:{{A|vo xllq002 4 xiangling 08.ogg}} '''Xiangling:''' The petals absorb the saltiness from the sea salt, the chili spice, and the umami of the tender, freshly grilled steak, while also adding a floral aftertaste.
:{{A|vo xllq002 4 brook 08.ogg}} '''Brook:''' That's pure overkill! You're going all out on the trimmings and doing no justice to the meat whatsoever.
:{{A|vo xllq002 4 brook 09.ogg}} '''Brook:''' Who wants to eat a roast when you can taste everything except the roast?
:{{A|vo xllq002 4 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Whoa whoa whoa, stop arguing!
:{{DIcon}} I don't think they can hear anyone but themselves...
:{{DIcon}} I guess this is a sort of culinary clash of the titans.
:{{A|vo xllq002 4 xiangling 09.ogg}} '''Xiangling:''' Hmph. Well, there's only one sure-fire way out of a cooking dispute...
:{{A|vo xllq002 4 xiangling 10.ogg}} '''Xiangling:''' I declare a cook-off!
:{{A|vo xllq002 4 brook 10.ogg}} '''Brook:''' Suits me! If you can't beat my cooking, it'll show that Draff was clearly wrong about you.
:{{A|vo xllq002 4 xiangling 11.ogg}} '''Xiangling:''' Alright — but if I win, you have to use my winning dish to promote Springvale!
:{{A|vo xllq002 4 brook 11.ogg}} '''Brook:''' And if you lose, you have to add my winning dish to the Wanmin menu!
:{{A|vo xllq002 4 brook 12.ogg}} '''Brook:''' With a caption saying "This special addition to the Wanmin menu is generously provided by Chef Brook of Springvale, meat expert." Hmph!
:{{A|vo xllq002 4 xiangling 12.ogg}} '''Xiangling:''' You have a deal!
:{{A|vo xllq002 4 xiangling 13.ogg}} '''Xiangling:''' I'm off to get ingredients — I will see you all in Liyue!
:{{A|vo xllq002 4 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wait! Waaait!
:{{A|vo xllq002 4 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' {{Traveler}}, let's try and catch up.
{{Dialogue End}}

{{Quest Description|After obtaining the rare ingredients, Xiangling is finally ready for the cook-off. The showdown between the two head chefs is about to begin.}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Talk to [[Olaf]])
:{{A|vo xllq006 1 olaf 01.ogg}} '''Olaf:''' Uh... Are you sure this is Springvale?
:{{A|vo xllq006 1 draff 01.ogg}} '''Draff:''' Yes. For the millionth time, yes! But I don't know any of the people you're looking for.
:{{A|vo xllq006 1 olaf 02.ogg}} '''Olaf:''' That is not possible, they all live in Springvale. They are my neighbors and friends.
:{{A|vo xllq006 1 draff 02.ogg}} '''Draff:''' This is strange, what is going on?
:{{DIcon}} Surely, it couldn't be...
:{{DIcon}} I think I see what's going on here.
:{{A|vo xllq006 1 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What is it?
:{{DIcon}} This hunter is also a survivor from 300 years ago.
::{{A|vo xllq006 1 paimon 02a.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Whaaaat!? Can humans really live that long?
:{{DIcon}} He's talking about Springvale a long, long time in the past.
::{{A|vo xllq006 1 paimon 02b.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' How long? ...Surely not hundreds of years!?
:{{A|vo xllq006 1 xiangling 01.ogg}} '''Xiangling:''' Er... Does that really make sense?
:{{DIcon}} He and the boar were both frozen.
::{{A|vo xllq006 1 xiangling 02a.ogg}} '''Xiangling:''' Oh! Like the way that you keep food fresh!
:{{DIcon}} The ice kept him fresh all this time, like with your ingredients.
::{{A|vo xllq006 1 xiangling 02b.ogg}} '''Xiangling:''' Hee-hee, it all makes sense now that you're speaking my language!
:{{A|vo xllq006 1 draff 03.ogg}} '''Draff:''' Still, it's hard to believe...
:{{A|vo xllq006 1 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' But it doesn't seem like there's any other sensible explanation.
:{{A|vo xllq006 1 draff 04.ogg}} '''Draff:''' Okay so... What's your name?
:{{A|vo xllq006 1 olaf 03.ogg}} '''Olaf:''' Olaf.
:{{A|vo xllq006 1 draff 05.ogg}} '''Draff:''' Olaf? I'm sure I've seen that on my family tree!
:{{A|vo xllq006 1 draff 06.ogg}} '''Draff:''' I can't remember which generation it was from... but it was definitely on there.
:{{A|vo xllq006 1 xiangling 03.ogg}} '''Xiangling:''' So, a great-great-great-great grandfather, but with a whole load more greats?
:{{DIcon}} They don't look so distantly related.
:{{A|vo xllq006 1 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What an unusual turn of events!
:{{A|vo xllq006 1 xiangling 04.ogg}} '''Xiangling:''' Hee-hee, reunited at long last! Isn't that just amazing!?
:{{A|vo xllq006 1 xiangling 05.ogg}} '''Xiangling:''' Olaf, do you want to come and watch a cooking competition?
:{{A|vo xllq006 1 draff 07.ogg}} '''Draff:''' Ah yes, that reminds me — [[Brook]] told me about the competition, and I've set everything up at the venue.
:{{A|vo xllq006 1 draff 08.ogg}} '''Draff:''' You should come with me.

----

;(Talk to Xiangling at the Cooking Showdown)
:{{A|vo xllq006 2 xiangling 01.ogg}} '''Xiangling:''' We're ready to cook. Are you?
:{{A|vo xllq006 2 brook 01.ogg}} '''Brook:''' I was born ready. Oh, and [[Siegfria]] will be my assistant for the competition.
:{{A|vo xllq006 2 draff 01.ogg}} '''Draff:''' Then let the cooking commence! I will be your judge today.
:{{A|vo xllq006 2 draff 02.ogg}} '''Draff:''' And don't worry, I may have known Brook for longer, but I will remain entirely impartial.
:{{A|vo xllq006 2 xiangling 02.ogg}} '''Xiangling:''' Much appreciated. Well then, {{Traveler}}, Paimon — prepare!
:{{A|vo xllq006 2 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wait, we're taking part in this too?
:{{A|vo xllq006 2 xiangling 03.ogg}} '''Xiangling:''' Of course! If Brook has an assistant, you guys will have to be mine. I'll need you by my side when the going gets tough!
:{{A|vo xllq006 2 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' *sigh* Paimon doesn't remember applying for that job...
:{{DIcon}} Well, I'm going to see this through.
:{{DIcon}} Ugh, I guess there's no backing out now...
:{{A|vo xllq006 2 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Okay. Paimon'll do it for the sake of the food.

;(Talk to Brook, optional)
:{{A|vo dialog xllq006 brook 01.ogg}} '''Brook:''' What's this? Culinary espionage?
:{{A|vo dialog xllq006 brook 02.ogg}} '''Brook:''' Haha, well you don't stand a chance, anyway. I have the winning ingredients right here.

;(Talk to Draff, optional)

'''''Crisis at the Aisa Bathhouse''''' is the second quest in {{Quest|Dream Eater's Melancholia}}.

==Steps==
# Go to the [[Aisa Bathhouse]]
# Meet [[Yumemizuki Mizuki|Mizuki]]
# Follow Mizuki's instructions
# Undergo treatment
# Exit the nightmare
# Talk to Mizuki
# Experience the other services
# Go to the address [[Yae Miko|Miko]] mentioned
# Ask around for information on [[Emura Chuuya|Emura Ichigensai]]
# Look around
# Talk to Paimon
# Meet with Emura Ichigensai
# Return to the [[Aisa Bathhouse]]
# Go to where you first met Mizuki

:{{A|vo mzklq002 19 mizuki 01.ogg}} '''Yumemizuki Mizuki:''' So he gives spiritual guidance... And it takes all your troubles away and leaves only happy thoughts?
:{{A|vo mzklq002 19 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yup. At least, that's what his clients say.
:{{A|vo mzklq002 19 hyakujitsuhakushion 01.ogg}} '''Hyakujitsuhaku Shion:''' How is that possible? Not even Mizuki could do that, and she's an incredible psychologist.
:{{A|vo mzklq002 19 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Is that right? Paimon was gonna say, it all sounds too good to be true...
:{{A|vo mzklq002 19 shibamurasaki 01.ogg}} '''Shiba Murasaki:''' It certainly is. Humans are... how to put this... they're a moody race — always upset about something. Show me a human without a care in the world, and I'll show you what "messed up" really looks like.
:{{A|vo mzklq002 19 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You think? 'Cause honestly, they sounded pretty convincing. And they said they only left the Aisa Bathhouse because they found it didn't deal with the root cause of their issues.
:{{A|vo mzklq002 19 mizuki 02.ogg}} '''Yumemizuki Mizuki:''' But the idea he is spreading is categorically wrong...
:{{A|vo mzklq002 19 shibamurasaki 02.ogg}} '''Shiba Murasaki:''' That settles it, then. Emura Ichigensai is a quack, making false claims to steal all our customers.
:{{A|vo mzklq002 19 mizuki 03.ogg}} '''Yumemizuki Mizuki:''' Is that why he's doing this? To steal... steal our customers? Or is there more to it?
:{{A|vo mzklq002 19 mizuki 04.ogg}} '''Yumemizuki Mizuki:''' ...It's unfortunate that you didn't get to meet him in person. I need some idea of the kind of person he is. Otherwise, I have no hope of figuring out his motivations and goals.
:{{A|vo mzklq002 19 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yeah, it's too bad... Although if it's any help, we did hear a bit about his backstory from someone else. Apparently, he used to have a really rotten temper, but then one day he suddenly reached enlightenment and became a spiritual master, or something...
:{{A|vo mzklq002 19 shibamurasaki 03.ogg}} '''Shiba Murasaki:''' Emura Ichigensai... rotten temper... Now wait just a minute...
:{{A|vo mzklq002 19 shibamurasaki 04.ogg}} '''Shiba Murasaki:''' Filing patient records is normally the most tedious job in the world. But once in a while, something mildly amusing grabs my attention. Take a look at this.
:{{A|vo mzklq002 19 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Emura Chuuya?
:{{A|vo mzklq002 19 mizuki 05.ogg}} '''Yumemizuki Mizuki:''' ...It's him. I remember him.
:{{A|vo mzklq002 19 hyakujitsuhakushion 02.ogg}} '''Hyakujitsuhaku Shion:''' Wait... That guy? Oh no...
:{{A|vo mzklq002 19 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What is it? What about him?
:{{A|vo mzklq002 19 shibamurasaki 05.ogg}} '''Shiba Murasaki:''' Where to start? ...Imagine a big ball of negative emotion took on human form and started walking around. That's pretty much Emura Chuuya.
:{{A|vo mzklq002 19 shibamurasaki 06.ogg}} '''Shiba Murasaki:''' His patient record mentions that he loved nothing more than a heated argument. No matter how trivial it was, he could never agree to disagree — he always had to be right. The happiest part of his day would be winning an argument and proving the other person wrong.
:{{A|vo mzklq002 19 shibamurasaki 07.ogg}} '''Shiba Murasaki:''' If he lost, he'd sulk, and if anyone called him out, he'd throw a huge tantrum. Before long, he'd turned everyone against him.
:{{A|vo mzklq002 19 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Sounds like he had issues...
:{{A|vo mzklq002 19 shibamurasaki 08.ogg}} '''Shiba Murasaki:''' Oh yeah. Serious issues.
:{{A|vo mzklq002 19 shibamurasaki 09.ogg}} '''Shiba Murasaki:''' Anyway, since no one would talk to him in real life anymore, he turned to the readers' letters column of a magazine by the Yae Publishing House, where he would attack writers and trade insults with other contributors.
:{{A|vo mzklq002 19 shibamurasaki 10.ogg}} '''Shiba Murasaki:''' Naturally, this ruined the column for everyone, and the editor soon started rejecting his letters.
:{{A|vo mzklq002 19 shibamurasaki 11.ogg}} '''Shiba Murasaki:''' Next thing you know, he's written a complaint letter to the [[Tenryou Commission]], demanding that Inazuma pass a law to make it illegal for the Yae Publishing House to reject letters from readers...
:{{A|vo mzklq002 19 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Gee whizz... Where would you even start with a client like that?
:{{A|vo mzklq002 19 shibamurasaki 12.ogg}} '''Shiba Murasaki:''' In my case — by giving them a wide berth. Mizuki dealt with this guy.
:{{A|vo mzklq002 19 shibamurasaki 13.ogg}} '''Shiba Murasaki:''' I'm pretty sure he only came here to try and start something. But Mizuki managed to get him into a session, and after some treatment, his mood improved by a lot.
:{{DIcon}} Wow. Great work, Mizuki!
:{{A|vo mzklq002 19 mizuki 06.ogg}} '''Yumemizuki Mizuki:''' Murasaki makes him sound like a rabid animal... He wasn't THAT out of control. Sure, his personality was very abrasive, but it wasn't hard to see why.
:{{A|vo mzklq002 19 mizuki 07.ogg}} '''Yumemizuki Mizuki:''' Once I understood his situation, I was able to diagnose him very quickly...
:{{Color|menu|Mizuki recalls Emura Chuuya's reaction to the diagnosis...}}
;(Flashback begins)
:{{A|vo mzklq002 19 mizuki 08.ogg}} '''Yumemizuki Mizuki:''' You have very high expectations for yourself, but you've faced a lot of rejection in the past and haven't achieved much in your life.
:{{A|vo mzklq002 19 mizuki 09.ogg}} '''Yumemizuki Mizuki:''' You've never had any real close friends, so you don't know what healthy connections with other people look like. This puts you and your ego in the center of your world.
:{{A|vo mzklq002 19 mizuki 10.ogg}} '''Yumemizuki Mizuki:''' In short, you long to feel a sense of accomplishment and to receive attention from other people. But both of these are lacking in your life.
:{{A|vo mzklq002 19 mizuki 11.ogg}} '''Yumemizuki Mizuki:''' You have no idea how to properly deal with these emotions. So you've been taking it out on other people, partly to seek attention, and partly because you get a shallow sense of accomplishment whenever you win a war of words with another person.
:{{A|vo mzklq002 19 emurachuuya 01.ogg}} '''Emura Chuuya:''' Tsk... You promise the world with your adverts, and that's seriously the best you can come up with? I'm not even going to bother explaining all the reasons you're wrong...
:{{A|vo mzklq002 19 emurachuuya 02.ogg}} '''Emura Chuuya:''' I mean, you completely misunderstood why I even sent that complaint letter. The Yae Publishing House practically has a monopoly on Inazuma's publishing industry. How can they ignore what their readers have to say?
:{{A|vo mzklq002 19 mizuki 12.ogg}} '''Yumemizuki Mizuki:''' In the magazine column you wrote to, your strongly worded letter appeared alongside dozens of others which praised the writer for their work. You can't talk about what their readers have to say without including them, too.
:{{A|vo mzklq002 19 emurachuuya 03.ogg}} '''Emura Chuuya:''' No one with half a brain would praise a festering pile of garbage like that. Those are not opinions worth listening to.
:{{A|vo mzklq002 19 mizuki 13.ogg}} '''Yumemizuki Mizuki:''' So, when I touched on the idea of you having an egocentric worldview — this is the kind of thing I was talking about.
:{{A|vo mzklq002 19 emurachuuya 04.ogg}} '''Emura Chuuya:''' I... You...
;(Flashback ends)
:{{A|vo mzklq002 19 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wow... How the heck did you get him to stay for treatment after dropping all of that on him?
:{{A|vo mzklq002 19 mizuki 14.ogg}} '''Yumemizuki Mizuki:''' Simple. The more he realized the truth of my diagnosis, the more he compulsively searched for evidence to refute it with.
:{{A|vo mzklq002 19 mizuki 15.ogg}} '''Yumemizuki Mizuki:''' He'd lost the ability to communicate like a normal human being. So, I kept him here by using his preferred mode of interaction: argumentation.
:{{A|vo mzklq002 19 mizuki 16.ogg}} '''Yumemizuki Mizuki:''' The Tenryou Commission had ignored his complaint letter, so he had no outlets left for his emotional outbursts.
:{{A|vo mzklq002 19 mizuki 17.ogg}} '''Yumemizuki Mizuki:''' Eventually, with the help of some incendiary words, I got him to agree to try some basic therapy. Finally, I was able to tweak his mood and stabilize his condition.
:{{A|vo mzklq002 19 mizuki 18.ogg}} '''Yumemizuki Mizuki:''' It's a shame, really — if I'd only been able to see him a few more times, I know I could've helped him work through his personality issues. But unfortunately...
:{{A|vo mzklq002 19 hyakujitsuhakushion 03.ogg}} '''Hyakujitsuhaku Shion:''' It was all my fault...
:{{A|vo mzklq002 19 shibamurasaki 14.ogg}} '''Shiba Murasaki:''' For the last time, it was his fault for being a nutjob.
:{{A|vo mzklq002 19 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What? What happened?
:{{A|vo mzklq002 19 shibamurasaki 15.ogg}} '''Shiba Murasaki:''' Well, one day, he comes in as usual for therapy, but Mizuki isn't here. So, Shion sees him instead.
:{{A|vo mzklq002 19 shibamurasaki 16.ogg}} '''Shiba Murasaki:''' I don't know what got into him that day, but he suddenly announced that he wished to be free of his troubles for good — and demanded that Shion make that happen.
:{{A|vo mzklq002 19 shibamurasaki 17.ogg}} '''Shiba Murasaki:''' Obviously, she didn't manage it, and then he pulled out a complaint letter to try and intimidate her. That was the last straw for me. I kicked him out and blacklisted him.
:{{A|vo mzklq002 19 shibamurasaki 18.ogg}} '''Shiba Murasaki:''' He hasn't shown his face here since.
:{{A|vo mzklq002 19 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Whoa...
:{{A|vo mzklq002 19 shibamurasaki 19.ogg}} '''Shiba Murasaki:''' Anyway, now everyone's had a look at his record — do we think there's any chance that this guy and Emura Ichigensai are the same person?
:{{A|vo mzklq002 19 shibamurasaki 20.ogg}} '''Shiba Murasaki:''' Because it sounds to me like after he didn't get what he wanted, he decided to have his revenge by lying to our customers and getting them to leave.
:{{DIcon}} That makes sense!
:{{DIcon}} Is it really that simple?
:{{A|vo mzklq002 19 mizuki 19.ogg}} '''Yumemizuki Mizuki:''' Bad dreams are formed from a buildup of negative emotions in the subconscious. You can't simply trick people into not having them anymore. If Murasaki was right, then surely they'd have seen his lies for what they are by now...
:{{A|vo mzklq002 19 shibamurasaki 21.ogg}} '''Shiba Murasaki:''' There's no point hemming and hawing! Let's report this guy to the Tenryou Commission for fraudulent business practices. If he can complain, so can we!
:{{A|vo mzklq002 19 susukida 01.ogg}} '''Susukida:''' Is anyone there?
:{{A|vo mzklq002 19 umihiko 01.ogg}} '''Umihiko:''' We'd like to book a therapy session... Can we start now?
:{{A|vo mzklq002 19 hyakujitsuhakushion 04.ogg}} '''Hyakujitsuhaku Shion:''' Hello! Please come with me, I'll get you registered.
:{{A|vo mzklq002 19 paimon 12.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wait, those are the two guys Paimon mentioned earlier! Just this morning, they were calling the bathhouse a scam and a rip-off. How are they back here already?
:{{A|vo mzklq002 19 shibamurasaki 22.ogg}} '''Shiba Murasaki:''' Oh really? Well, that proves it doesn't it? I was right. Now that they've realized they were lied to, they've come back.
:{{A|vo mzklq002 19 shibamurasaki 23.ogg}} '''Shiba Murasaki:''' So chin up, Mizuki. I bet you business will start picking up again from tomorrow morning.
:{{A|vo mzklq002 19 paimon 13.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yeah! You yumekui-baku provide an unbeatable service, no scammer's gonna run you girls out of business!
:{{A|vo mzklq002 19 mizuki 20.ogg}} '''Yumemizuki Mizuki:''' Interesting... Well, good. Murasaki, go help Shion please.
:{{A|vo mzklq002 19 shibamurasaki 24.ogg}} '''Shiba Murasaki:''' Tch... Shoulda kept my mouth shut. I jinxed it, and now I have to work again.
:{{A|vo mzklq002 19 paimon 14.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Now we just need to report this guy as a fraud to the Tenryou Commission, like Murasaki suggested. Problem solved!
:{{A|vo mzklq002 19 paimon 15.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' It looks like the Aisa Bathhouse will be back in business in no time. No idea if our investigation actually helped, though...
:{{A|vo mzklq002 19 mizuki 21.ogg}} '''Yumemizuki Mizuki:''' Of course it did. You were a huge help, and I owe you big time for it.
:{{A|vo mzklq002 19 paimon 16.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hehe...
:{{A|vo mzklq002 19 mizuki 22.ogg}} '''Yumemizuki Mizuki:''' Now then. You only got part way through the VIP experience last time, didn't you? You still have to try the hot springs and snacks. Both are top tier.
:{{A|vo mzklq002 19 paimon 17.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, true! How could Paimon forget about that? Especially the snacks!
:{{Black Screen|After a dip in the hot springs and some delicious snacks, you and Paimon feel wonderfully relaxed.}}
:{{A|vo mzklq002 19 paimon 18.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wow, Paimon feels incredible now. Nothing beats the complete service package!
:{{DIcon}} We should go talk to Mizuki about booking our next appointment.
:{{DIcon}} Definitely coming back again.
:{{A|vo mzklq002 19 paimon 19.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Agreed! Although, Paimon didn't notice her inside just now. What could she be doing out at this hour? Hmm... Let's ask around.
:{{A|vo mzklq002 19 paimon 20.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hey there, Mr. Aikawa. Do you have any idea where Mizuki went?
:{{A|vo mzklq002 19 aikawasusumu 01.ogg}} '''Aikawa Susumu:''' Oh, you're looking for Mizuki? She actually tends to disappear for a while around this time every evening. It's the one part of the day where she gets to relax herself.
:{{A|vo mzklq002 19 aikawasusumu 02.ogg}} '''Aikawa Susumu:''' As for where she goes and what she does during that time, I'm afraid I have no idea.
:{{A|vo mzklq002 19 paimon 21.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' She takes the evenings to "relax," huh...
:{{DIcon}} Like the first time we met her...
:{{A|vo mzklq002 19 paimon 22.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' She probably tells people she's relaxing, but actually she's digesting the bad dreams, right? Hope she's not having any digestive trouble...
:{{A|vo mzklq002 19 paimon 23.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Remember the place from last time? Let's head there and check on her.

;(Approach the marked location)
:{{A|vo mzklq002 20 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' This should be the place...
:{{A|vo mzklq002 20 mizuki 01.ogg}} '''Yumemizuki Mizuki:''' *crying*... *sigh*...
:{{A|vo mzklq002 20 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What? Why's Mizuki crying? Unless... Oh, maybe we got pulled into one of her bizarre dreams again?
:{{A|vo mzklq002 20 mizuki 02.ogg}} '''Yumemizuki Mizuki:''' {{Traveler}}? Paimon? What are you doing here?
:{{A|vo mzklq002 20 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Well firstly, we were hoping to get our next appointment booked in...
:{{A|vo mzklq002 20 mizuki 03.ogg}} '''Yumemizuki Mizuki:''' ...Ah, I see. I was planning on making it back before you finished in the hot springs, but I ended up spending longer here than I intended.
:{{A|vo mzklq002 20 mizuki 04.ogg}} '''Yumemizuki Mizuki:''' Don't worry, this isn't a dream. I was just... feeling a little sad.
:{{A|vo mzklq002 20 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Aw, what's up? Indigestion getting you down again?
:{{A|vo mzklq002 20 mizuki 05.ogg}} '''Yumemizuki Mizuki:''' No, my digestion was fine this time. What you saw just now was the aftermath of the digestion process.
:{{A|vo mzklq002 20 mizuki 06.ogg}} '''Yumemizuki Mizuki:''' Like I said, bad dreams are basically bundles of all kinds of negative emotions. When I digest them, I feel them all for myself.
:{{A|vo mzklq002 20 mizuki 07.ogg}} '''Yumemizuki Mizuki:''' So when I'm processing these emotions, I tend to get quite... well, emotional.
:{{A|vo mzklq002 20 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Does that happen to all yumekui-baku?
:{{A|vo mzklq002 20 mizuki 08.ogg}} '''Yumemizuki Mizuki:''' Oh, don't worry about the others. To feel these emotions, you first have to understand them.
:{{A|vo mzklq002 20 mizuki 09.ogg}} '''Yumemizuki Mizuki:''' Most baku have a very poor understanding of humanity, so to them, a human bad dream just tastes like a slice of bland white bread. They can basically wolf it down and barely notice the flavor.
:{{A|vo mzklq002 20 mizuki 10.ogg}} '''Yumemizuki Mizuki:''' I'm the odd one out in that sense. When I was studying abroad, I made a serious effort to learn as much about human psychology as possible.
:{{A|vo mzklq002 20 mizuki 11.ogg}} '''Yumemizuki Mizuki:''' Now, I understand human emotions much better. I can empathize with them, and I can now discern many complex emotions when I turn my attention to digesting bad dreams.
:{{A|vo mzklq002 20 mizuki 12.ogg}} '''Yumemizuki Mizuki:''' But still, that's no reason for you to be concerned about me. I wouldn't be much of a psychologist if I didn't have the mental fortitude to handle this stuff.
:{{A|vo mzklq002 20 mizuki 13.ogg}} '''Yumemizuki Mizuki:''' Letting your emotions out is one of the most effective ways to process them. Now that I've done that, my mental state is back to normal.
:{{A|vo mzklq002 20 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Paimon thought maybe seeing those customers had upset you somehow.
:{{A|vo mzklq002 20 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' It even makes Paimon mad! You work so hard for them, and then they turn around and accuse the bathhouse of being a money-making scam.
:{{A|vo mzklq002 20 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yes, they were led astray by some swindler... but it's not like they took much persuading.
:{{A|vo mzklq002 20 mizuki 14.ogg}} '''Yumemizuki Mizuki:''' I can't blame them. The idea that you can forget all of your troubles and never have a bad dream again is a very alluring one. Who wouldn't want to believe that?
:{{A|vo mzklq002 20 mizuki 15.ogg}} '''Yumemizuki Mizuki:''' {{Traveler}}, if I really could make you forget all of your troubles for good, would you want me to try?
:{{DIcon}} ...
:{{Black Screen|As you imagine forgetting your pain and longing, the joy of reunion that you are looking forward to one day disappears along with it.}}
:{{Black Screen|As you imagine letting go of your hopelessness, you also feel your fighting spirit slip through your fingers.}}
:{{Black Screen|As you imagine being free from your painful regrets, the formative experiences of your journey lose their roots.}}
:'''Yumemizuki Mizuki:''' {{Traveler}}, if I really could make you forget all of your troubles for good, would you want me to try?
:{{DIcon}} But... if I forget all of that...
:{{DIcon}} Would I even still be me?
:{{A|vo mzklq002 20 mizuki 16.ogg}} '''Yumemizuki Mizuki:''' ...You really are different from other people.
:{{A|vo mzklq002 20 mizuki 17.ogg}} '''Yumemizuki Mizuki:''' Discovering what troubles people is easy for me — even in your case. But although I see your troubles clearly, I still don't completely understand you.
:{{A|vo mzklq002 20 mizuki 18.ogg}} '''Yumemizuki Mizuki:''' *sigh*... Thanks for checking in on me. As a psychologist, I know how to take care of myself, but you showing that you care is still appreciated.
:{{A|vo mzklq002 20 mizuki 19.ogg}} '''Yumemizuki Mizuki:''' Anyway, it's much too late to book another appointment now... You should head home, get some sleep, have a wonderful dream, and come see me again tomorrow.
:{{A|vo mzklq002 20 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Alright. Goodnight!
:{{DIcon}} Goodnight.
:{{A|vo mzklq002 20 mizuki 20.ogg}} '''Yumemizuki Mizuki:''' Bye for now. If you still want to book another appointment tomorrow, make sure to come see me early.

'''''Culminate! Chatter of Joyous Dreams''''' is an [[Event Quest]] during the [[Duel! The Summoners' Summit!]] event.

==Steps==
# Wait until the following day (08:00 – 10:00)
# Go to [[Caravan Ribat]] and find out the truth of the Card Snatcher
# Go to the delivery address with [[Kirara]]
# Find a hiding place
# Defeat all opponents {{Enemy List|1=Treasure Hoarders: Pugilist{ text = Dedebaba };Treasure Hoarders: Scout{ text = Pabag };Treasure Hoarders: Scout{ text = Papak } }}
# Go to [[Vimara Village]] to deliver the package
# Ask [[Zadith]] about the whereabouts of the scholar
# Ask [[Arezo]] about the whereabouts of the scholar
# Ask the village head about the whereabouts of the scholar
# Go to the house and talk to [[Garvipidam]]

==Gameplay Notes==
* During Step 5, Kirara joins the party as a trial character.

'''Currents Deep Beneath the Lanterns''' is the Story Quest for Part II of the [[Lantern Rite]] event.

==Steps==
# Talk to [[Wang'ya]]
# Obtain [[Azurite]] from [[Exploration#Bloatty Floatties|Bloatty Floatties]]
# Dig at the roots of the Bloatty Floatty
# Obtain [[Vermillionite]] from the [[Ruin Hunter]]
#*{{Enemy|Ruin Hunter|x=1}}
# Report back to Wang'ya
# Go to the construction site and collect the materials
# Talk to the [[Liuliu|suspicious person]]
# Investigate around the stockpile (0/3)
# Retrieve the [[Xiao Lantern]] materials
# Talk to Wang'ya
# Go to the [[Ministry of Civil Affairs]] and report to the [[Millelith]]
# Find the Millelith
# Clear the obstacles
# Eliminate the Hilichurls{{Enemy List|Hilichurl Grenadier *2; Rock Shield Hilichurl Guard *2; Rock Shieldwall Mitachurl *1}}
# Talk to the Millelith
# Go back to the crime scene
# Talk to [[Xiao]]
# Talk to [[Kaeya]]
# Talk to the informant
# Find the [[Treasure Hoarders|Treasure Hoarder]]'s camp
# Talk to the member of the Treasure Hoarders
#* [[Bei'er]] and [[Crafty]]

{{Quest Description|The highlight of Lantern Rite is the release of the giant Mingxiao Lantern into the sky, and this year's Mingxiao Lantern is supposed to be a sight well worth the wait. The Plaustrite that will lift the lantern into the air is the largest in twenty years! For this special occasion, the merchants of Liyue have set up the Xiao Market to help gather the materials needed to build the lantern. When you arrive at the Xiao Market, one of the event organizers, [[Wang'ya]] seems to have something to say to you...}}

==Steps==
# Go to [[Dawn Winery]]
# Furnish Diluc with the information
# Leave winery
# Collect [[Mist Flower Corolla]] from beside the water (0/4)

# Set the elemental bait
# Talk to Diluc

# Go to the tavern
# Wait until night (19:00 – 06:00)

# Pose as a customer and speak to Diluc
# Leave Tavern
# Place the elemental bait near the side gate
# Talk to Diluc
# Face the [[Abyss Order]] head-on at Mondstadt's front gate
# Defeat the Abyss Order attackers

:{{A|vo dlclq003 20 diluc 14.ogg}} '''Diluc:''' ...
:{{A|vo dlclq003 20 kaeya 12.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' I hope you all a wonderful night.

:{{A|vo dlclq003 20 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What was all that about?

:{{A|vo dlclq003 20 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Woooow! Thanks Master Diluc!
:{{A|vo dlclq003 20 diluc 17.ogg}} '''Diluc:''' I'm in the habit of working alone, but I did enjoy having your assistance this time.
:{{A|vo dlclq003 20 diluc 18.ogg}} '''Diluc:''' In the future, if there's anything you ever need, you can come to me for help.

'''''Descendant of Nightmares''''' is the fourth quest in {{Quest|Dream Eater's Melancholia}}.

==Steps==
# Go to the address [[Yae Miko|Miko]] provided
# Enter [[Emura Chuuya]]'s Hideout
#* Enter Quest Domain [[Bastion of Nightmares]]
# Go deeper into the Domain
#* Wave 1: {{Enemy List|Nobushi: Kikouban*1/nightmare variant [silent];Nobushi: Jintouban*2/nightmare variant [silent]}}
#* Wave 2: {{Enemy List|Nobushi: Kikouban*2/nightmare variant [silent];Nobushi: Hitsukeban*1/nightmare variant [silent]}}
# Follow Emura Chuuya, who is being controlled
# Touch Emura Chuuya's emotional fragments (0/4)
# Investigate the nightmare's hideout
# Find the resonance of sweet dreams (0/2)
#* Wave 1: {{Enemy List|Thundercraven Rifthound Whelp*3/nightmare variant [silent]}}
#* Wave 2: {{Enemy List|Thundercraven Rifthound Whelp*3/nightmare variant [silent]}}
# The final battle
# Face [[Kuroyume]] in battle
#* Wave 1: {{Enemy List|Nobushi: Hitsukeban*2/nightmare variant [silent];Nobushi: Jintouban*1/nightmare variant [silent]}}
#* Wave 2: {{Enemy List|1 = Kairagi: Dancing Thunder{ text = Nightmare Fragments: Bipolar };Kairagi: Fiery Might{ text = Nightmare Fragments: Violent }|x=1}}
# Defeat Kuroyume
#* Wave 1: {{Enemy List|Nobushi: Jintouban*8/nightmare variant [silent]}}
#* Wave 2: {{Enemy List|Thundercraven Rifthound Whelp*8/nightmare variant [silent]}}
# Under the bright moon's light, I feel no urge to return

==Gameplay Notes==
* During steps 3–9, a trial Yumemizuki Mizuki joins the party.
* During step 7, Kuroyume will open and close his eye at 7 second intervals. While in his line of sight, the active character will continuously lose HP.
* During step 10, the active party will be limited to a trial Traveler aligned to Electro.
** In this battle, using the Traveler's Elemental Burst will cause Mizuki to appear as an apparition and trigger [[Anraku Secret Spring Therapy|her Elemental Burst]]. Her Burst will last indefinitely and continuously generate Special Snacks.
* If the player leaves the [[Quest Domain]] at any point after entering it, the player will return to step 2.
* Step 11 automatically completes upon time passing until 06:00 the following morning; Yumemizuki Mizuki disappears and the tree branch can no longer be seated.
* Permanently missable chests inside the domain: {{Item|Exquisite Chest|x=2}}.

;(Approach the marked location)

:{{A|vo mzklq004 1 mizuki 02.ogg}} '''Yumemizuki Mizuki:''' All thanks to you two. With what I learned from those two guys, I managed to give [[Murasaki]] and [[Shion]] effective treatment as soon as I got back. That meant I was free to head out again as soon as I received your message.
