::{{DIcon}} They instructed the two men to communicate through letters and barrels specifically so that they'd never get to meet each other.
::{{DIcon}} Honestly, this third person probably planned to sell both of them out from the very beginning.
::{{A|vo lntcop001 1918520 benoit 03.ogg}} '''Bernard:''' What... You can't be serious... There was a third person involved!?
::{{A|vo lntcop001 1918520 lynette 16.ogg}} '''Lynette:''' ...If you focus only on Bernard's testimony, it's easy to believe that only Bernard and Pierre were working together. The case appeared extremely simple — Bernard did the trafficking, Pierre the Imitation Sinthe production, drugging, and stuffing.
::{{DIcon}} With everything accounted for, the third person would then be cleared of all suspicion.
::{{A|vo lntcop001 1918520 elodie 05.ogg}} '''Elodie:''' W—Wait, but that doesn't make any sense. If that's the actual truth, then as soon as Pierre is caught, he will explain his side of the story, and the third person will—
::{{A|vo lntcop001 1918520 lynette 17.ogg}} '''Lynette:''' Yep, which is why... the third person made sure that Pierre would never be found again.
::{{A|vo lntcop001 1918520 lynette 18.ogg}} '''Lynette:''' Once they had instructed Pierre to expose himself, the third person wrote to Pierre again, suggesting that everything had been taken care of, and he should take Bonnie and safely return to his base.
::{{DIcon}} They then ambushed Pierre...
::{{DIcon}} And made him "disappear."
::{{A|vo lntcop001 1918520 lynette 19.ogg}} '''Lynette:''' Of course, Pierre's disappearance at such a sensitive time immediately made him a prime suspect. Knowing that Bonnie had last been seen with him...
::{{A|vo lntcop001 1918520 lynette 20.ogg}} '''Lynette:''' All the third person would have to do from that point on would be to lead the Phantom to investigate the Humane Society, and get Bernard to confess the "truth."
::{{DIcon}} Bernard would then testify that Pierre was the one who came up with the whole plot.
::{{DIcon}} And Pierre would be seen as having gone into hiding in anticipation of getting caught.
::{{A|vo lntcop001 1918520 benoit 04.ogg}} '''Bernard:''' Wait... So you're saying... That the letter I received yesterday, the one that made me think Pierre was still alive... It was also sent by the third person?
::{{A|vo lntcop001 1918520 elodie 06.ogg}} '''Elodie:''' Is... Is that what happened!? I'll get back to headquarters right away, and re-investigate this case from the top!
::{{DIcon}} Not so fast.
::{{A|vo lntcop001 1918520 lynette 21.ogg}} '''Lynette:''' Chevreuse said that "assumptions can be detrimental to solving a case." Someone among us, however, has been feeding us all kinds of preconceived notions ever since our first meeting.
::{{A|vo lntcop001 1918520 lynette 22.ogg}} '''Lynette:''' They suggested that Pierre's disappearance was an attempt to escape the judgement of the law, and that Pierre was a scion of the {{sic|Levevere}} family...
::{{A|vo lntcop001 1918520 lynette 23.ogg}} '''Lynette:''' But if the "disappearance" is truly just a coverup for a murder, then couldn't the true scion have been an illegitimate daughter, rather than an illegitimate son?
::{{DIcon}} Miss Elodie Lefevere?
::{{A|vo lntcop001 1918520 benoit 05.ogg}} '''Bernard:''' ...Huh?
::{{A|vo lntcop001 1918520 elodie 07.ogg}} '''Elodie:''' Ha.. Haha... Hahahaha!
::{{A|vo lntcop001 1918520 elodie 08.ogg}} '''Elodie:''' Haven't you taken this joke a bit too far? You're right, I did let a lot of assumptions get to my head when I first started to talk to you about the case. I'll make sure to correct my behavior...
::{{A|vo lntcop001 1918520 lynette 24.ogg}} '''Lynette:''' You deliberately fed us lies, but even you could not control every last detail of your plan. There was a flaw in your scheme... and something didn't quite go as planned.
::{{A|vo lntcop001 1918520 lynette 25.ogg}} '''Lynette:''' Getting the Marechaussee Phantom to notice Pierre was only the first part of your plan. Had they failed to take notice of the Humane Society, they could have cast a wider net...
::{{A|vo lntcop001 1918520 lynette 26.ogg}} '''Lynette:''' And you couldn't predict what they might possibly find, if given enough time. This, of course, was the main weakness of your plan.
::{{DIcon}} And once the Special Patrol and Lyney got involved...
::{{DIcon}} It became even harder to control the outcome of the investigation.
::{{A|vo lntcop001 1918520 lynette 27.ogg}} '''Lynette:''' As someone accustomed to acting from behind the scenes, you didn't want to take the risk of personally proposing a raid on the Humane Society. So, you thought about pulling a few more strings, so all the suspicion would point towards Bernard and his Society...
::{{DIcon}} A great option, of course, would be to also dispose of Bonnie, and leave her body at Pierre's base in anticipation of a later discovery.
::{{A|vo lntcop001 1918520 lynette 28.ogg}} '''Lynette:''' Once the Phantom expanded their search, it would only be a matter of time before they found Pierre's base. If a cat last seen with the suspect turned up dead at the Imitation Sinthe base...
::{{A|vo lntcop001 1918520 lynette 29.ogg}} '''Lynette:''' It wouldn't be long until the Phantom would figure out exactly how she had been mistreated, and turn their eyes towards the one organization that has been sending boatloads of animals out of Fontaine.
::{{DIcon}} However, something unexpected happened at the base...
::{{DIcon}} Bonnie managed to escape in the chaos.
::{{A|vo lntcop001 1918520 lynette 30.ogg}} '''Lynette:''' It was probably during your ambush of Pierre... You didn't even have the time to check if she had already been stuffed full of Imitation Sinthe.
::'''Bonnie:''' Meow!
::{{A|vo lntcop001 1918520 elodie 09.ogg}} '''Elodie:''' ...!
::{{A|vo lntcop001 1918520 lynette 31.ogg}} '''Lynette:''' Still, you soon found another opportunity. Before long, Bonnie had made her way back into the city, and even popped up on the Steambird...
::{{A|vo lntcop001 1918520 lynette 32.ogg}} '''Lynette:''' Like Bernard, you desperately wanted to confirm the contents of her stomach, so you hurried to find us. Unlike Bernard, however, you were hoping that Pierre did have the time to make her swallow a load of Imitation Sinthe.
::{{A|vo lntcop001 1918520 lynette 33.ogg}} '''Lynette:''' While investigating the suspect's cat, we unexpectedly discovered that the suspect has been smuggling Imitation Sinthe using living animals as intermediaries. That was your plan, in any case. With that, you'd have been able to lead the investigation towards the Humane Society.
::{{DIcon}} But Bonnie was very lucky.
::{{DIcon}} But you were extremely unlucky.
::{{A|vo lntcop001 1918520 lynette 34.ogg}} '''Lynette:''' ...Bonnie had managed to escape before Pierre was able to stuff her full of Imitation Sinthe. That part of your plan could no longer be carried out. But as shrewd as you were, you came up with another plan right away...
::{{A|vo lntcop001 1918520 lynette 35.ogg}} '''Lynette:''' You manipulated the Traveler and I to help you identify Bernard as a key suspect.
::{{DIcon}} You knew Lyney was investigating the case with Chevreuse...
::{{DIcon}} And you also knew of Lynette's previous encounter with the Lefevere family.
::{{A|vo lntcop001 1918520 lynette 36.ogg}} '''Lynette:''' You used the Lefevere name as bait to get us to join your investigation. With two extra bodies around, the Special Patrol is sure to soon take note of the strange event of Bernard somehow having a reason to look for Pierre's cat.
::{{A|vo lntcop001 1918520 elodie 10.ogg}} '''Elodie:''' ...Ha, so what you're saying is... I went to all that trouble, just for the chance that you might put forth a suggestion that would lead you down the wrong path?
::{{A|vo lntcop001 1918520 lynette 37.ogg}} '''Lynette:''' Of course, you did far more than that. Just now, at Lumidouce Harbor... Were you not the person who highlighted the suspicious activities of the Society?
::{{DIcon}} By showing us the port's travel logs...
::{{A|vo lntcop001 1918520 elodie 11.ogg}} '''Elodie:''' ...Oh!
::{{A|vo lntcop001 1918520 lynette 38.ogg}} '''Lynette:''' You even highlighted the Society's activities during your compilation of the logs, so they'd be immediately visible to anyone examining the records.
::{{A|vo lntcop001 1918520 lynette 39.ogg}} '''Lynette:''' Moreover, the logs contained no records of the port authorities' activities. In other words, your activities.
::{{A|vo lntcop001 1918520 elodie 12.ogg}} '''Elodie:''' ...And what are you trying to suggest with that?
::{{A|vo lntcop001 1918520 lynette 40.ogg}} '''Lynette:''' I am insinuating that you had plenty of opportunities to transfer the raw materials for Imitation Sinthe from the harbor to a boat, and then sail over to the meeting place full of floating barrels.
::{{DIcon}} Once Bernard had placed the animals in the barrels...
:::{{DIcon}} As long as you did it before Pierre came for his pickup, there'd be no one the wiser.
::{{DIcon}} You'd open the lids and also dump in the raw materials.
:::{{DIcon}} As long as you did it before Pierre came for his pickup, there'd be no one the wiser.
::{{A|vo lntcop001 1918520 lynette 41.ogg}} '''Lynette:''' And that's how neither the trafficker nor the manufacturer knew there was a third person who supplied the raw materials, and surreptitiously operated between them.
::{{DIcon}} First, you got in touch with both parties, and secured the raw materials.
:::{{DIcon}} After that, you slipped the raw materials into the barrels next to the animals...
:::{{DIcon}} And requested that Pierre pick up the barrels and bring them back to his base.
::{{DIcon}} Then, you instructed Bernard to prepare the floating barrels and the animals.
:::{{DIcon}} After that, you slipped the raw materials into the barrels next to the animals...
:::{{DIcon}} And requested that Pierre pick up the barrels and bring them back to his base.
::{{A|vo lntcop001 1918520 lynette 42.ogg}} '''Lynette:''' Pierre manufactured Imitation Sinthe using the raw materials you provided, stuffed the animals, and placed the animals back into the barrels.
::{{A|vo lntcop001 1918520 lynette 43.ogg}} '''Lynette:''' Having received the green light from you as "Pierre," Bernard then retrieved his animals, and shipped them out of Fontaine once he had received enough for a full batch. This is the truth behind your smuggling ring.
::{{A|vo lntcop001 1918520 benoit 06.ogg}} '''Bernard:''' I can't believe it... I never put two and two together...
::{{A|vo lntcop001 1918520 elodie 13.ogg}} '''Elodie:''' Hahaha... You've sure got an extremely lively imagination.
::{{A|vo lntcop001 1918520 lynette 44.ogg}} '''Lynette:''' So, what do you think she's going to say next?
::{{DIcon}} Ever thought about a career in writing crime novels?
:::{{A|vo lntcop001 1918520 elodie 14.ogg}} '''Elodie:''' Ever thought about a career in writing crime novels, huh?
::{{DIcon}} But do you have any evidence?
:::{{A|vo lntcop001 1918520 elodie 15.ogg}} '''Elodie:''' But do you have any evidence, hm?
::{{A|vo lntcop001 1918520 lynette 45.ogg}} '''Lynette:''' Mhm, it appears that it's quite easy to predict what you'll think or say. Then, if we apply that to this case, we can also think of a few places to look for incriminating evidence.
::{{A|vo lntcop001 1918520 lynette 46.ogg}} '''Lynette:''' You know very well that this case will not end until Pierre is found, so you will have him "commit suicide" out of fear and shame to end the investigation for good.
::{{A|vo lntcop001 1918520 lynette 47.ogg}} '''Lynette:''' That way, you can also pin the blame for the overseas smuggling activities, the theft of the harbor's confiscated raw materials, and even the Lefevere name on him. After all, dead men tell no tales.
::{{A|vo lntcop001 1918520 lynette 48.ogg}} '''Lynette:''' But you still want it to appear as if he had sent that last letter to Bernard, so you have to make sure he cannot be found until after Bernard has confessed to the authorities.
::{{A|vo lntcop001 1918520 lynette 49.ogg}} '''Lynette:''' To do that, you either will hide his body until you've found an appropriate time to set up a fake suicide scene, or you'll dump it someplace where it'll be hard to determine the exact time of death. Submerged in water, for instance...
::{{A|vo lntcop001 1918520 lynette 50.ogg}} '''Lynette:''' The location would ideally allow you to keep the body hidden for some time while also letting you keep an eye on it.
::{{DIcon}} An example of such a place may be... somewhere in your own boat.
::{{DIcon}} Or underneath the waters near Lumidouce Harbor.
::{{DIcon}} You could also keep him in a very cool environment to be handled later.
::{{DIcon}} Or set fire to make it look like he had burned himself to a crisp.
::{{A|vo lntcop001 1918520 lynette 51.ogg}} '''Lynette:''' There are only so many options to hide a person's time of death, after all. As long as the Phantom investigates each of the possibilities in turn, they'll surely find Pierre's remains.
::{{A|vo lntcop001 1918520 lynette 52.ogg}} '''Lynette:''' Especially since... as the prime suspect who will now be taken into custody, you will no longer have the time to move him, or set up a fake suicide scene to cover up the murder.
::{{A|vo lntcop001 1918520 elodie 16.ogg}} '''Elodie:''' How absurd... And on what grounds will you order my arrest? Don't think for a second that your spouts of nonsense will amount to any kind of real argument. After all, I'm—
::{{A|vo lntcop001 1918520 chevreuse 01.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' Elodie Lefevere!
::{{A|vo lntcop001 1918520 chevreuse 02.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' As the captain of the Special Security and Surveillance Patrol, I hereby declare you as a suspect in the case. If you have any objections, you may raise them later during interrogation.
::{{DIcon}} Chevreuse! Lyney!
::{{DIcon}} You're here, too!
::{{A|vo lntcop001 1918520 lyney 01.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' That's right, we received a message from Lumidouce Harbor that you were going to investigate the Humane Society. We didn't expect to run into you at such a critical moment.
::{{A|vo lntcop001 1918520 chevreuse 03.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' While at the Harbor, we noticed something else extremely interesting... Apparently, you often used all kinds of excuses to swap your shifts.
::{{A|vo lntcop001 1918520 chevreuse 04.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' And if one were to match the times of your shifts to the activities of the Humane Society and those of certain foreign ships, they'd find them to be an exact match.
::{{A|vo lntcop001 1918520 elodie 17.ogg}} '''Elodie:''' Th—That's just a coincidence!
::{{A|vo lntcop001 1918520 lynette 53.ogg}} '''Lynette:''' Yes, I'm sure you have already thought of a dozen different ways to explain away the suspicious activities, but as far as evidence goes... that should be enough to warrant taking you into custody.
::{{A|vo lntcop001 1918520 lyney 02.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Don't worry. If it turns out that the Gardes are still unable to find any evidence after all of this, Lynette and I will do everything in our power to clear your name.
::{{A|vo lntcop001 1918520 elodie 18.ogg}} '''Elodie:''' Huff... huff...
::{{A|vo lntcop001 1918520 lynette 55.ogg}} '''Lynette:''' ...Although judging by her reaction, I assume no follow-up from us will be needed.
::{{A|vo lntcop001 1918520 elodie 19.ogg}} '''Elodie:''' Tch...!
::{{A|vo lntcop001 1918520 chevreuse 05.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' The Lefeveres were infamous for using disguise and infiltration to achieve their goals... Who would have thought that they would have planted someone within the Gardes.
::{{A|vo lntcop001 1918520 lynette 54.ogg}} '''Lynette:''' Judging from the timeline, they likely arranged for you to enter the Gardes before the fall of the clan... But they probably didn't expect you to turn it to your advantage, and use your job to save yourself during the purge.
::{{A|vo lntcop001 1918520 chevreuse 06.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' Not only that, but you actively participated in the interrogation, arrest, and judgement of the Lefeveres during their fall, thus clearing yourself of suspicion.
::{{A|vo lntcop001 1918520 chevreuse 07.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' You brutally and cruelly abandoned your allies as soon as they outlived their usefulness, just like a lizard cutting off its own tail in order to live... You've been doing this for years!
::{{A|vo lntcop001 1918520 benoit 07.ogg}} '''Bernard:''' So... So you played me like a fool after all! Ugh...!
::{{Black Screen|Bernard is suddenly knocked out by a sudden strike...}}
::;(Continues to ''[[Closure]]'')
{{Dialogue End}}

==Dialogue==
{{Quest Description|The troubled days have come to an end. You and Paimon decide to pay Aino another visit...}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Pass time)
:{{A|vo nkeq005 1 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hey, it's been a while. Why don't we check up on Aino!

;(Approach Ineffa and Jahoda)
:{{A|vo nkeq005 2 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hey, Ineffa! Oh, Jahoda! You're here, too?
:{{A|vo nkeq005 2 jahoda 01.ogg}} '''Jahoda:''' Well, after all that hard work, I at least deserve a slice of cake for my efforts, don't you think?
:{{A|vo nkeq005 2 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wait, there's cake!?
:{{A|vo nkeq005 2 ineffa 01.ogg}} '''Ineffa:''' Yes. You two are here just in time.
:{{A|vo nkeq005 2 ineffa 02.ogg}} '''Ineffa:''' Aino wanted to thank you for your help, so now that Krum-Clank is back safe and sound, she thought it would be nice for everyone to try out his baking.
:'''Krum-Clank 70% Sweet:''' Clank... clank...
:{{A|vo nkeq005 2 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wow, so this is what Krum-Clank was supposed to look like!
:{{A|vo nkeq005 2 ineffa 03.ogg}} '''Ineffa:''' Yes. Luckily, the core was still intact, so all Aino had to do was make a new body.
:'''Krum-Clank 70% Sweet:''' Clank... clank...
:{{A|vo nkeq005 2 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ooh, is it ready?
:'''Krum-Clank 70% Sweet:''' Gulp...
:{{A|vo nkeq005 2 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hey, he ate it!
:{{A|vo nkeq005 2 jahoda 02.ogg}} '''Jahoda:''' It's not unusual for a chef to take a few bites before serving a dish.
:{{A|vo nkeq005 2 ineffa 04.ogg}} '''Ineffa:''' No need to worry. Once he's had his fill, he can get started on the desserts for everyone else. It'll just be a moment.
:{{A|vo nkeq005 2 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Alright... Wait, speaking of desserts, where's Aino?
:{{A|vo nkeq005 2 ineffa 05.ogg}} '''Ineffa:''' Ah, she thought of a new idea for a robot and shut herself in the workshop to get started. When inspiration strikes, she jumps into action. That's just who she is.
:{{A|vo nkeq005 2 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Why does Aino like building robots so much?
:{{A|vo nkeq005 2 ineffa 06.ogg}} '''Ineffa:''' Hm... Retrieving historical records from data bank...
:<gallery widths="350">
Ding Ding Dinggg! A Great Feast! Quest Still 1.png
</gallery>
:{{A|vo nkeq005 2 ineffa 07.ogg}} '''Ineffa:''' At first, I believe Aino was just shocked to find something that fascinated her more than desserts.
:{{A|vo nkeq005 2 ineffa 08.ogg}} '''Ineffa:''' And fortunately, [[Conch Gang|her friends]] respected her passion — even if, aside from struggling to make ends meet, there was little time for much else.
:<gallery widths="350">
Ding Ding Dinggg! A Great Feast! Quest Still 2.png
</gallery>
:{{A|vo nkeq005 2 ineffa 09.ogg}} '''Ineffa:''' Then, one day, an [[Papa Wrench|acclaimed teacher]] discovered her and recognized her passion for what it truly was... genius.
:{{A|vo nkeq005 2 ineffa 10.ogg}} '''Ineffa:''' Just like her friends, she finally discovered what she wanted to do. And not only that, she excelled at it.
:<gallery widths="350">
Ding Ding Dinggg! A Great Feast! Quest Still 3.png
</gallery>
:{{A|vo nkeq005 2 ineffa 11.ogg}} '''Ineffa:''' And when genius and passion collide, there's not much that can get in the way.
:<gallery widths="350">
Ding Ding Dinggg! A Great Feast! Quest Still 4.png
</gallery>
:{{A|vo nkeq005 2 ineffa 12.ogg}} '''Ineffa:''' So, Aino left her childhood friends, established the Clink-Clank Krumkake Craftshop, and started making all kinds of robot companions.
:<gallery widths="350">
Ding Ding Dinggg! A Great Feast! Quest Still 5.png
</gallery>
:{{A|vo nkeq005 2 ineffa 13.ogg}} '''Ineffa:''' Perhaps it all comes down to the natural instinct of a genius... the drive to see their imagination come to life.
:<gallery widths="350">
Ding Ding Dinggg! A Great Feast! Quest Still 6.png
</gallery>
:{{A|vo nkeq005 2 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh... So that's what draws her to robotics?
:<gallery widths="350">
Ding Ding Dinggg! A Great Feast! Quest Still 7.png
</gallery>
:{{A|vo nkeq005 2 ineffa 14.ogg}} '''Ineffa:''' Based on my own experience with Aino, I think there's more to it than that.
:<gallery widths="350">
Ding Ding Dinggg! A Great Feast! Quest Still 8.png
</gallery>
:{{A|vo nkeq005 2 ineffa 15.ogg}} '''Ineffa:''' Long before she took me in, she was already pushing her skills to the limit in an effort to give each robot a distinct personality, and she already treated them like companions.
:{{A|vo nkeq005 2 ineffa 16.ogg}} '''Ineffa:''' What I mean is, it's not something that started with me, just because I have a unique background.
:{{A|vo nkeq005 2 ineffa 17.ogg}} '''Ineffa:''' I think, after walking the path of a genius for so long, she looked around and realized there was no one at her side, and it made her feel lonely.
:<gallery widths="350">
Ding Ding Dinggg! A Great Feast! Quest Still 9.png
</gallery>
:{{A|vo nkeq005 2 ineffa 18.ogg}} '''Ineffa:''' So, me, Krum-Clank, and all the other robots Aino has added to the workshop... We're not just proof of her genius.
:{{A|vo nkeq005 2 ineffa 19.ogg}} '''Ineffa:''' We're her family. We give her the companionship she longs for.
<!--quest still ends-->
:{{A|vo nkeq005 2 ineffa 20.ogg}} '''Ineffa:''' As I see it, that's the true relationship between Aino and her robots.
:{{A|vo nkeq005 2 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, wow. So, you really mean a lot to her...
:{{A|vo nkeq005 2 ineffa 21.ogg}} '''Ineffa:''' Yes. And for that reason, it did not matter to Aino how powerful Krum-Clank could become, nor how feared or coveted his technology might be among the factions.
:{{A|vo nkeq005 2 ineffa 22.ogg}} '''Ineffa:''' And she decided that he would join this family, and that meant she would spare no effort to save him.
:{{A|vo nkeq005 2 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yeah, that makes sense! But, it makes Paimon wonder why someone like Aino would choose to stay in Nod-Krai...
:{{A|vo nkeq005 2 ineffa 23.ogg}} '''Ineffa:''' ...I'm afraid my logic unit cannot make sense of that question.
:{{A|vo nkeq005 2 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Well, the way Paimon sees it, Nod-Krai is a dog-eat-dog place full of scheming and scamming. The people that thrive here seem to be built for that kind of thing.
:{{A|vo nkeq005 2 paimon 12.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Anyone else would use the kind of tech Aino has to make weapons and threaten people.
:{{A|vo nkeq005 2 paimon 13.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' But Aino... she takes something that could be a weapon and turns it into a robot that makes cakes. It just doesn't seem like she fits in...
:{{A|vo nkeq005 2 ineffa 24.ogg}} '''Ineffa:''' No, my view is the exact opposite.
:{{A|vo nkeq005 2 ineffa 25.ogg}} '''Ineffa:''' I've encountered the full spectrum of people that live here in Nod-Krai. But, in my experience, very few of them can be said to represent this place.

==Steps==
# Return to camp
# Rest until early morning the next day (06:00 -  08:00)
# Talk to [[Barbara]]
# Go to the location Barbara mentioned
# Talk to [[Diluc]] and [[Kaeya]]
# Look for [[Albedo]]
# Return to the central isle
# Look for [[Razor]]
#* Obtain {{Item|Mysterious Mechanical Part}}
# Insert the component to activate the [[Maguu Kenki|Inazuman device]]
# Defeat the awakened Inazuman device
#* {{Enemy|Maguu Kenki|x=1}}
# Listen to everyone's opinion
#* Obtain {{Item|Pale Blue Crystal}}, {{Item|Pale Red Crystal}} and {{Item|Pale Yellow Crystal}}
# Head to the island in the southwest
# Investigate the mysterious device
# Go to the gigantic conch
# Place the crystals and wait

:{{A|vo eqyq003 2 kaeya 21.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' Albedo is an alchemist and skilled at his craft. If I could use those beautiful artificial flowers of his, it would be a simple affair to traverse these islands.

:{{A|vo eqyq003 6 klee 02.ogg}} '''Klee:''' People?
:{{A|vo eqyq003 6 albedo 07.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' I'm sure the shrewdest among you have already come to the same conclusion. These deserted islands bear signs of human activity.
:{{A|vo eqyq003 6 albedo 08.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' I would go so far as to infer that this archipelago once held a human population. They were most likely visitors from elsewhere — not indigenous to the islands.

:{{A|vo eqyq003 6 albedo 10.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' As for the crystals... hmm. They've been manufactured from a particularly rare type of ore... transparent... I believe they must have a specific function.
:{{A|vo eqyq003 6 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' We found a pile of stones and small flowers nearby. Do you think there's any connection?

:{{A|vo eqyq003 6 albedo 13.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' What about the rest of you? Who do you think would want to commemorate a machine in this way?

:{{A|vo eqyq003 6 albedo 14.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' If the machine co-existed with that first group of humans, then the memorial isn't so hard to understand. Of course, this is only a hypothesis.

:{{A|vo eqyq003 6 kaeya 02.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' An unlikely coincidence, I would've thought. In any case, this is all speculation. If we want to get to the bottom of it, we'll need more evidence.
:{{A|vo eqyq003 6 qin 03.ogg}} '''Jean:''' Yes, though we don't have any clues to go on... We should sweep the area again soon. But first, let's focus our attention on the problem at hand.
:{{A|vo eqyq003 6 klee 03.ogg}} '''Klee:''' Look! Another letter! It must be Dodo-King!

:{{DIcon}} He's trying to tell us something.

:{{A|vo eqyq003 6 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' We've looked all over these islands, but there's nothing interesting here...

:{{A|vo eqyq003 9 qin 09.ogg}} '''Jean:''' I suppose we have to let our focus drift a little... but at the end of the day, you can't deny that this ocean view really is something.

:{{A|vo eqyq003 9 qin 17.ogg}} '''Jean:''' Anyway, I hope we can all find moments of peace and happiness on this beach.

===Post-quest===
After everyone goes their separate ways, the others can be encountered and spoken to in various locations in the archipelago. Lisa can also be found at the [[Knights of Favonius Headquarters]] in [[Mondstadt]].

* [[Razor]] stands on the eastern shore of the [[Golden Apple Archipelago/1.6#Central Platform|Central Platform]].
* [[Barbara]] stands on the north-eastern shore of the Central Platform.
* [[Albedo]] stands on the peak of the main island of [[Minacious Isle/1.6|Minacious Isle]], slightly south of the [[Teleport Waypoint]].
* [[Diluc]] stands on shallow reef, next to the Teleport Waypoint in the [[Broken Isle/1.6#North Island|northern island of Broken Isle]].
* [[Kaeya]], [[Jean]], and [[Klee]] stand on the north-western island of [[Minacious Isle/1.6|Minacious Isle]] (the island with an energy shield).
* [[Lisa]] stands in the Grand Master's office.

==Dialogue==
{{Quest Description|One day, you and Paimon notice that many people in Sumeru City are talking about dreams...}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Use [[Nahida]]'s [[All Schemes to Know]] on Pedrush, optional)
:{{A|Vo nhdlq001 1 pedrush 01.ogg}} '''Pedrush''' (I hope a lot of people will come to participate today.)

;(Approach Pedrush)
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 1 pedrush 02.ogg}} '''Pedrush:''' Hello, Traveler. Have you ever heard of "A Moment of Dreams"?
:{{DIcon}} "A Moment of Dreams"?
:{{DIcon}} What's that?
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 1 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, that sounds like some kind of sweet drink!
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 1 pedrush 03.ogg}} '''Pedrush:''' Haha, I'm afraid not. It's the name of an event we started to hold regularly.
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 1 pedrush 04.ogg}} '''Pedrush:''' Dreams have become quite the hot topic in Sumeru, and many people are excited to share the dreams they've seen at night.
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 1 pedrush 05.ogg}} '''Pedrush:''' The same goes for me! The last time I dreamed was when I was but a little child, so I can't help but feel excited and nostalgic about dreaming again.
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 1 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh right, everyone's able to dream again now!
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 1 pedrush 06.ogg}} '''Pedrush:''' Yes! We organized an event to give everyone with new dreams a platform to freely share their experiences.
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 1 pedrush 07.ogg}} '''Pedrush:''' And thus our event, "A Moment of Dreams," was born.
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 1 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So it's kinda like a fireside chat...
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 1 pedrush 08.ogg}} '''Pedrush:''' You could say that. We hear all sorts of wild and fabulous stories every day. Really, why not have a listen for yourselves?
:{{DIcon}} I can understand your curiosity...
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 1 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yeah, but to us, dreaming is as normal as breathing.
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 1 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wait, but if there are free drinks and snacks involved, then Paimon might consider it!
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 1 pedrush 09.ogg}} '''Pedrush:''' Oh really? So you mean... you've already seen many dreams?
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 1 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Mm-hmm, but no need to get so excited, it's really nothing special.
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 1 pedrush 10.ogg}} '''Pedrush:''' No no no, we need experienced participants like you to share your experiences with dreaming.
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 1 pedrush 11.ogg}} '''Pedrush:''' Please allow me to address you two as "dream experts"!
:{{DIcon}} ...Sounds kinda weird.
:{{DIcon}} There are some things that "expert" just doesn't seem to go with...
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 1 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, "expert." Hehe, Paimon kinda likes it!
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 1 pedrush 12.ogg}} '''Pedrush:''' Now you seem interested, hehe. Please, follow me to the meeting place. It won't take much of your time.
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 1 pedrush 13.ogg}} '''Pedrush:''' Rest assured, you'll find all the drinks and snacks you'd like there.
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 1 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wow, how accommodating!
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 1 paimon 09a.ogg}}<!--{{A|vo nhdlq001 1 paimon 09b.ogg}}--> '''Paimon:''' Sign us up! Ah, but wait... Paimon's getting ahead of herself again. We should see what the Traveler thinks first.
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 1 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Eh? Why aren't you saying anything?
:{{DIcon}} You're the boss...
:{{DIcon}} I don't think I really have a choice.
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 1 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hehe! Alright, hurry up and take us to be dream experts!
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 1 pedrush 14.ogg}} '''Pedrush:''' Haha, very good. Follow me, then.

;(After the cutscene)
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 1 paimon 12.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Do you know what's the most important part of being an "expert"?
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 1 pedrush 15.ogg}} '''Pedrush:''' Ahem... Well, I suppose it must be accumulating knowledge and sharing your experiences?
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 1 paimon 13.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Nope, it's all about the title. From now on, Paimon will be known as "Paimon, the Dream Expert"!
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 1 pedrush 16.ogg}} '''Pedrush:''' O—Okay...

;(Approach the gathered people)
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 2 pedrush 01.ogg}} '''Pedrush:''' Sorry to interrupt, everyone. We finally have some REAL dream experts joining us!
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 2 pedrush 02a.ogg}}<!--{{A|vo nhdlq001 2 pedrush 02b.ogg}}--> '''Pedrush:''' Esteemed experts, this way, please. Ahem, now, if anyone has any questions, please feel free to ask them.
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 2 ilman 01.ogg}} '''Ilman:''' They must be dream experts from another land... Great!
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 2 nasser 01.ogg}} '''Nasser:''' Oh, I have a question! Me first! Me first!
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 2 pedrush 03.ogg}} '''Pedrush:''' No rush. Everyone, please line up and ask in an orderly fashion!
:{{Black Screen|After some initial commotion, everyone finally forms a queue.}}
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 2 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Whoa, Paimon didn't expect them to be so enthusiastic...
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 2 ata 01.ogg}} '''Ata:''' My question is simple. My everyday life is very difficult, so I would like to become a Slime in my dreams. How can I do that?
:{{DIcon}} Oh, that's a tough one...
:{{DIcon}} Honestly, I don't have any good tips.
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 2 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, Paimon knows! Paimon's had this kind of dream before, so she knows a thing or two.
:;(Paimon gains the title "Expert")
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 2 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' The first time, Paimon became an Anemo Slime. Paimon was shot by an adventurer's arrow and flew in the sky all night long.
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 2 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' The second time, Paimon became a Dendro Slime. A group of kids thought Paimon was a Radish and pulled out all the grass on her head. It was super painful!
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 2 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' The third time, Paimon became a Cryo Slime. In the end, Paimon was captured by a chef and turned into a smoothie.
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 2 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' And the fourth time, Paimon became a powerful Geo Slime and went to take revenge on the Forest Boar that used to bully Paimon.
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 2 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' But then the boar showed up with all its relatives, and Paimon lost again.
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 2 ata 02.ogg}} '''Ata:''' Wait, why did all of your dreams end so tragically?
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 2 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Because Slimes are monsters, even though they look cute, they usually cause trouble and end up getting killed by adventurers.
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 2 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Things don't tend to end well for monsters. Believe Paimon.
:{{DIcon}} (I want to interrupt, but...)
:{{DIcon}} (At least she's grasped the standard tropes of adventurer stories.)
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 2 ata 03.ogg}} '''Ata:''' I suppose you're right... They are monsters, after all.
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 2 ata 04.ogg}} '''Ata:''' I just want to experience a different life, but it seems that becoming a monster would be even worse than my current life.
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 2 ata 05.ogg}} '''Ata:''' Hmm, maybe I'd be happier if I became just a regular Finch or fish...
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 2 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' It looks like being an expert is way easier than Paimon imagined.
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 2 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Next!
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 2 ilman 02.ogg}} '''Ilman:''' Oh, it's my turn. Esteemed expert, I want to know what posture I should sleep in so I can have the same dream as the one I had last night.
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 2 paimon 12.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Uh, well...
:;(Paimon's title becomes "Expert?")
:{{DIcon}} Yes, please enlighten us, esteemed expert.
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 2 paimon 13.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hey! You're supposed to be helping!
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 2 paimon 14.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Um, first, why don't you tell Paimon about the dream you want to have again?
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 2 ilman 03.ogg}} '''Ilman:''' Oh, it's quite ordinary. I sat and chatted with my wife on a sunny day, listening to the breeze blowing through the valley.
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 2 paimon 15.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Why don't you just find your wife and talk with her? There's no need to wait for a dream!
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 2 ilman 04.ogg}} '''Ilman:''' Well, uh... Unfortunately, she passed away.
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 2 paimon 16.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh!? Uh, sorry! Paimon shouldn't have assumed anything.
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 2 ilman 05.ogg}} '''Ilman:''' No, it's fine, I didn't make that clear. I just want a chance to see her again.
:{{DIcon}} Have you tried looking at her photos right before you fall asleep?
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 2 paimon 17.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yeah, it's not really about posture. What you think about right before falling asleep is probably way more important.
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 2 ilman 06.ogg}} '''Ilman:''' Oh, is that all I have to do?
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 2 paimon 18.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Think about it, if you're the one thinking about her, and you're the one that'll be dreaming about her, then it'll be easier to connect your thoughts and dreams.
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 2 ilman 07.ogg}} '''Ilman:''' You do have a point... I'll give it a try tonight! Thanks for your wise advice!
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 2 kathya 01.ogg}} '''Kathya:''' Oh, my turn, my turn! Ahem, I want to know the name of the plant in my dream!
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 2 debbi 01.ogg}} '''Debbi:''' I want to bring the souvenir box in my room into my dream!
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 2 paulin 01.ogg}} '''Pawlin:''' I dreamt of a raven flying over the wasteland last night. Does that have any kind of special meaning?
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 2 paimon 19.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hey, no rush. One at a time!
:{{Black Screen|After a long time, the "experts" finally conclude their work.}}
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 2 paimon 20.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ugh, their questions were way too difficult. We don't actually know anything more than they do. We're just more experienced dreamers, that's all.
:;(Paimon no longer has a title)
:{{DIcon}} They didn't really care about the answers.
:{{DIcon}} Vivid dreams are just really exciting to them.
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 2 paimon 21.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You do have a point. It's more rewarding to explore and contemplate the meaning of a question than to focus on the answer itself.
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 2 paimon 22.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Right now, these people are like wanderers who've starved for three days and three nights and are desperate to replenish their energy. Any explanation they get now is like pure sustenance to them, no matter how good the explanation really is!
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 2 paimon 23.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, and now that Paimon has said that, you know who comes to mind?
:{{DIcon}} Nahida.
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 2 paimon 24.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Bingo! If she was here, she'd probably be making some similar analogy.
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 2 paimon 25.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Unfortunately, she's super busy right now, and may not have time for gatherings like this.
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 2 pedrush 04.ogg}} '''Pedrush:''' Dear experts, we have another guest who would like to consult you.
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 2 paimon 26.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Eh? But you saw how we answered all the questions just now... We're not really all that knowledgeable.
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 2 pedrush 05.ogg}} '''Pedrush:''' Ah, but this guest is rather... special.
:;(Nahida walks up)
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 2 nahida 01.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' My question is, why didn't you immediately tell me about such an interesting place?
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 2 paimon 27.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh, Nahida!? How did you get here!?
:;(Pedrush bows towards Nahida and walks off)
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 2 nahida 02.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' Interesting events like "A Moment of Dreams" don't happen every day, after all. No matter how busy things are, I'd still set aside some time to check it out.
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 2 nahida 03.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' Anyway, I really didn't expect to meet you here.
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 2 paimon 28.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, right! If there's anyone that understands dreams, it's you! You should be able to help us answer all these questions!
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 2 nahida 04.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' You're not wrong. All right, they can ask me anything. The more interesting, the better.
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 2 ilman 08.ogg}} '''Ilman:''' ...
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 2 nahida 05.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' Huh? What's wrong? You were all so excited a minute ago... why the sudden hesitation?
:{{DIcon}} I think they need to build up some courage first.
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 2 nahida 06.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' Even so, it's not like I look super intimidating or anything, right?
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 2 nahida 07.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' And in terms of reputation and renown, you've also done many great things in Sumeru, yet they didn't even flinch at you.
:{{DIcon}} Still, not quite the same as approaching an archon.
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 2 nahida 08.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' Alas, the interesting questions have all vanished in an instant. It appears I'm the one spoiling the fun here. I'll see myself out.
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 2 paimon 29.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Aw, that's not true, Nahida!
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 2 nahida 09.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' I don't want to get in the way of the original purpose of "A Moment of Dreams," which is to let people gather here and freely share their marvelous dreams.
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 2 nahida 10.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' Now the atmosphere here is like water poured into a container... The water is more secure and settled, but it has lost its free-flowing nature from the river.
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 2 nahida 11.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' I just wanted to be another drop in the water, not the cold and restrictive container.
:{{DIcon}} Is she doing what I think she is...?
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 2 paimon 30.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' She's sulking...
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 2 paimon 31.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Um, hey, it's all right, everyone. No need to be shy! The Dendro Archon is really nice, so please, just go ahead and ask! Otherwise, she'll leave.
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 2 ata 06.ogg}} '''Ata:''' A—Alright... I'll give it a try.
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 2 paimon 32.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, it's the slime guy.
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 2 ata 07.ogg}} '''Ata:''' Hey, drop the nicknames, would ya? Besides... I don't want to become a Slime anymore. Maybe a Finch or fish is more suitable for me.
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 2 nahida 12.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' I see. So you want to become a small animal in your dreams, right? Why do you think that sounds good to you?
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 2 ata 08.ogg}} '''Ata:''' I guess I just want to experience something different. My everyday life is nothing but the same...
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 2 ata 09.ogg}} '''Ata:''' The sky is right above me, and the ocean just over the horizon, yet I remain caged in a life of monotony.
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 2 nahida 13.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' So you want to experience something new in your dreams... Sorry, I'm getting a little confused. Why don't you seek out some new experiences in real life?
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 2 ata 10.ogg}} '''Ata:''' Because if I don't work, I won't have any Mora. Sure, I don't want to be out hammering nails and cutting wood every day, but I have aging parents and young children to take care of.
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 2 ata 11.ogg}} '''Ata:''' By the time this all dawned on me, I realized that my life has already been filled to the brim by trifling matters, and I have no more freedom.
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 2 nahida 14.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' But if that's the case, then even if you became a flying bird or swimming fish, you will still be hammering nails and cutting wood in your dreams.
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 2 nahida 15.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' The reason is you've already been caged. It doesn't matter what your physical body turns into, your mind will still be stuck in the same predicament.
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 2 ata 12.ogg}} '''Ata:''' Really? That sounds pretty terrible! Then what should I do?
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 2 nahida 16.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' I don't know everything that you're going through, but how about replacing your hammer?
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 2 ata 13.ogg}} '''Ata:''' Huh? Replacing my hammer?
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 2 nahida 17.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' That's right. Having worked for such a long time, you of all people must know what makes a good hammer.
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 2 ata 14.ogg}} '''Ata:''' Well, of course. A good hammer needs to be heavy enough to drive the nail in with just a couple taps... and the handle has to have a good grip to it — not too smooth.
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 2 ata 15.ogg}} '''Ata:''' Come to think of it, I haven't replaced my current hammer in quite some time.
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 2 nahida 18.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' You should replace it. Then decorate the handle with something you like... maybe some ornaments, fur, or a hard leather wrapping. Then, write the names of your children on it.
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 2 ata 16.ogg}} '''Ata:''' That makes sense... I think it'd give me a good boost of energy at work!
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 2 nahida 19.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' A new sense of adventure often begins with the little things in life.
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 2 nahida 20.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' You don't need to become a bird in the air or fish in the sea. You only need to do your best in life, and all those things you cherish will become your source of happiness.
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 2 ata 17.ogg}} '''Ata:''' Yes, yes... I get it now. This is a real eye-opener for me!
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 2 ata 18.ogg}} '''Ata:''' I'll go and pick out a new hammer right away... No, I should make one of my own. Thank you, great Dendro Archon!
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 2 paimon 33.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' That's our Nahida! Only you would know how to get right to the heart of the problem.
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 2 nahida 21.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' Actually, I didn't really understand the problem.
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 2 paimon 34.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh?
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 2 nahida 22.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' I gave him that advice because I once saw a worker doing the same thing. Whenever he became tired, he would look at some names on the handle of his tool.
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 2 nahida 23.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' After a moment, he'd start to smile. It really surprised me at the time... My guess is that the names on the handle were of important people to him.
:{{DIcon}} I think I understand.
:{{DIcon}} You were just drawing from a similar example.
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 2 nahida 24.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' Mm-hmm. After observation, I know this kind of behavior motivates people... but why is that?
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 2 nahida 25.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' Is it because of excitement, anticipation, or helplessness? I really don't know... And even if I could know what's going through his mind, it's still difficult to fully grasp his feelings.
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 2 paimon 35.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, Paimon gets what you mean... Huh, Paimon had no idea it takes you so much effort to understand these kinds of things...
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 2 nahida 26.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' Hehe, that's why I was a bit nervous just now. But luckily, seeing his happy face in the end reassured me that I didn't say anything wrong.
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 2 nahida 27.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' Don't mind me, though. This is just my way of learning.
:{{DIcon}} I'm happy to help if you ever need it.
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 2 paimon 36.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hey, don't forget about Paimon! Everyone knows that Paimon's also super skilled at reading people's feelings!
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 2 nahida 28.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' Thanks, you two. That makes me feel a lot better. Let's move on to the next question, shall we?
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 2 ilman 09.ogg}} '''Ilman:''' I already asked the experts my question earlier, but I wanted to hear the Dendro Archon's response, too.
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 2 ilman 10.ogg}} '''Ilman:''' What should I do if I want to see my deceased wife in my dreams every night?
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 2 nahida 29.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' Hmm, longing for the deceased...
:{{DIcon}} (Is she remembering something about Greater Lord Rukkhadevata?)
:{{DIcon}} (No, she shouldn't be able to remember anymore.)
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 2 nahida 30.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' Even if you keep reliving those beautiful memories, it'll only highlight the emptiness in your real life.
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 2 nahida 31.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' If your wife were still alive, she certainly wouldn't want to see you like this, would she?
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 2 ilman 11.ogg}} '''Ilman:''' No, I suppose not... But our time together in my dreams is not just reliving our past together.
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 2 ilman 12.ogg}} '''Ilman:''' I don't know. Maybe it's because I miss her too much, but it's really as if she had come back to life in my dreams.
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 2 ilman 13.ogg}} '''Ilman:''' She even remembers each and every dream. After I wake up and then continue dreaming again later, we can pick up our conversation right where we last left off.
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 2 nahida 32.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' That's really amazing. Statistically speaking, continuous dreams are extremely rare.
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 2 ilman 14.ogg}} '''Ilman:''' It's almost as if my wife has obtained a second life in my dreams. But the more vivid she appears, the emptier I feel and the more painful it is when I wake up. I don't know whether to call it a blessing or a curse...
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 2 nahida 33.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' Maybe all of this is rooted in your deep longing for her.
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 2 nahida 34.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' Were there any unresolved matters or regrets between the two of you?
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 2 ilman 15.ogg}} '''Ilman:''' I don't know... I suppose my biggest regret is that I couldn't spend the rest of my life with her.
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 2 ilman 16.ogg}} '''Ilman:''' I really felt like I was ready to move on. I wouldn't be so hesitant now if it weren't for these hyper-realistic dreams I've been having.
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 2 paimon 37.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh. You know, they say that whatever's on your mind is what goes into your dreams.
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 2 nahida 35.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' But dreams are, and will forever be, just dreams. We are people living in the real world.
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 2 nahida 36.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' It's not good to be overly obsessed with dreams. All it'll do is fill up your mind and eat away at your thoughts.
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 2 ilman 17.ogg}} '''Ilman:''' Yes, I know... That's why I'm also a little disappointed in myself. I still need to take care of our child.
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 2 ilman 18.ogg}} '''Ilman:''' And it's probably not good to let her see me in such a state...
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 2 ilman 19.ogg}} '''Ilman:''' *sigh* Anyway, thanks for your advice, great Dendro Archon.
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 2 nahida 37.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' Hmm, I'm a little worried about him. I hope he can find a way to cheer up soon.
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 2 nahida 38.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' I think I can handle things from here. You don't need to stay here if you find it boring. You're here to have a good time, after all.
{{Dialogue End}}
{{Quest Description|update|You and Paimon meet Nahida at the venue of "A Moment of Dreams." Together, you hear many creative dream ideas shared by event participants. Among them, you are a little concerned about a man named Ilman...}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Use [[Nahida]]'s [[All Schemes to Know]] on Debbi, optional)
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 3 debbi 01.ogg}} '''Debbi:''' (If it IS a hint, well... I haven't seen them for a long time.)

;(Talk to Nahida or Debbi, optional)<!--no ASTK for Nahida of course-->
:{{A|vo dialog nhdlq001 nahida 01.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' ...Another recurring dream?
:{{A|vo dialog nhdlq001 debbi 01.ogg}} '''Debbi:''' Yeah, I'm starting to wonder if it's some kind of hint.

;(Use Nahida's All Schemes to Know on Nasser, optional)
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 3 nasser 01.ogg}} '''Nasser:''' (Wow, it's really the Dendro Archon.)

;(Talk to Nasser, optional)
:{{A|vo dialog nhdlq001 nasser 01.ogg}} '''Nasser:''' What a lucky day... Just wait till my friends hear about this!

;(Use Nahida's All Schemes to Know on Pawlin, optional)
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 3 paulin 01.ogg}} '''Pawlin:''' ...(Or maybe a more exciting love life... Nah, who am I kidding...)

;(Talk to Pawlin, optional)
:{{A|vo dialog nhdlq001 paulin 01.ogg}} '''Pawlin:''' I wish my dreams could be a little more practical, you know... Maybe something like becoming rich and famous overnight.

;(Use Nahida's All Schemes to Know on Pedrush, optional)
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 3 pedrush 01.ogg}} '''Pedrush:''' (Should I continue expanding the scale of this event...?)

;(Talk to Pedrush, optional)
:{{A|vo dialog nhdlq001 pedrush 01.ogg}} '''Pedrush:''' I didn't expect the Dendro Archon to attend this event in person... It's like a dream.

;(Use Nahida's All Schemes to Know on Ilman, optional)
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 3 ilman 01.ogg}} '''Ilman:''' (The Dendro Archon made a really good point...)

;(Talk to Ilman)
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 3 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Are you feeling any better now?
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 3 ilman 02.ogg}} '''Ilman:''' Yes. I think the Dendro Archon made a really good point. I need to stop dwelling on my wife like this and move on with my life.
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 3 ilman 03.ogg}} '''Ilman:''' Now that I think about it, my wife and I always meet at a familiar place in my dreams.
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 3 ilman 04.ogg}} '''Ilman:''' I know where that place exists in reality, but it's a bit far and dangerous. I don't dare to go there on my own.
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 3 ilman 05.ogg}} '''Ilman:''' But, at the same time, I feel as if I should go and have a look anyway. Perhaps I'll be able to move on once I see that there's nothing there.
:{{DIcon}} Sounds like a good plan.
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 3 ilman 06.ogg}} '''Ilman:''' Otherwise, I'll keep on feeling like everything is covered in a haze... like I'm only half-awake.
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 3 ilman 07.ogg}} '''Ilman:''' Once I can stop dreaming about that place, I'll probably be able to get my life back together.
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 3 ilman 08.ogg}} '''Ilman:''' Actually, you two are adventurers, right? If it's okay with you, could you escort me to that place?
:{{DIcon}} Sure, let's go have a look.
:{{DIcon}} Let's go get a breath of fresh air.
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 3 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yeah, it might also be a good chance for us to unwind.
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 3 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Even if you can't see your wife there, taking in some nice scenery will definitely help cheer you up.
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 3 ilman 09.ogg}} '''Ilman:''' Yeah, I hope so too.
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 3 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Alright, go ahead and get yourself ready then.
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (Speaking of longing for the deceased, I'd better tell Nahida about Greater Lord Rukkhadevata.)
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (Nahida should at least know that she once existed in this world.)
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 3 nahida 01.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' Ahem! Are you headed off to some interesting place without telling me again?
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 3 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh, wait, aren't you supposed to be answering questions?
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 3 nahida 02.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' I just finished. And I really got a lot out of it... so many interesting and novel thoughts.
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 3 nahida 03.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' Anyway, it looks like you're going somewhere. Why don't you take me with you?
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 3 ilman 10.ogg}} '''Ilman:''' Oh, there's no need to trouble you, great Dendro Archon. I imagine you must have many other important things to deal with.
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 3 nahida 04.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' No need to stand on ceremony. Besides, I wouldn't have asked to come along if I didn't have a good reason.
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 3 nahida 05.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' I wanted to use this opportunity to discuss with you some things that are puzzling me right now.
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 3 ilman 11.ogg}} '''Ilman:''' Hmm, I didn't know the great Dendro Archon could become puzzled, too...
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 3 nahida 06.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' I'm not all that different from you, you know. All right, let's go. We can talk on the way.
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (I'd better go with her. The whole Greater Lord Rukkhadevata thing will take some explaining...)

;(Use Nahida's All Schemes to Know on Debbi, optional)
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 3 debbi 02.ogg}} '''Debbi:''' (Maybe I should find a place to sleep, or go to the cafe...)

;(Talk to Debbi, optional)
:{{A|vo dialog nhdlq001 debbi 02.ogg}} '''Debbi:''' After talking so much about dreams, I'm feeling a little bit sleepy.
{{Dialogue End}}
{{Quest Description|update|You and Paimon meet Nahida at the venue of "A Moment of Dreams." Together, you hear many creative dream ideas shared by event participants. Among them, you are a little concerned about a man named Ilman, so you decide to escort him to the place he has been dreaming about.}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(On reaching the marked area, the group arrives just after sunset)
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 4 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ah, it's always nice to go for a leisurely stroll!
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 4 ilman 01.ogg}} '''Ilman:''' Do adventurers often go to places like this?
:{{DIcon}} Yes, of course.
:{{DIcon}} We usually journey through far more dangerous places than this.
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 4 ilman 02.ogg}} '''Ilman:''' Hmm, I guess so.
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 4 nahida 01.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' So this is where you always meet your wife in your dreams?
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 4 ilman 03.ogg}} '''Ilman:''' Yes, for the most part. Our place is on the summit just up ahead.
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 4 ilman 04.ogg}} '''Ilman:''' When I saw her in my dreams, we didn't do anything but talk about ordinary, mundane topics.
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 4 ilman 05.ogg}} '''Ilman:''' I'd tell her about our daughter, [[Haydar]], and she always listened intently.
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 4 ilman 06.ogg}} '''Ilman:''' She would also reminisce about the past with me, telling me interesting stories and cracking jokes.
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 4 ilman 07.ogg}} '''Ilman:''' It feels like no matter how long we may chat, it's never enough.
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 4 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Sometimes, it's the little things in life that matter the most.
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 4 nahida 02.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' This is the part I'm a little puzzled about...
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 4 nahida 03.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' I am very familiar with dreams, and normally, they lack logic and continuity.
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 4 nahida 04.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' But you said she could remember what you had told her before, right?
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 4 ilman 08.ogg}} '''Ilman:''' That's right. She always listened to me carefully in real life, and now, she's doing the same in my dreams.
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 4 ilman 09.ogg}} '''Ilman:''' She always surprises me with some details from our lives in the real world. The fact that she can remember such things makes me feel like she's alive.
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 4 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Whoa, that's pretty weird... Well, dreams are kinda weird to begin with.
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 4 nahida 05.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' However, the problem is that his dreams have too much structure and continuity. Most dreams are far more fragile than you could imagine.
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 4 nahida 06.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' For example, a loud noise outside your window in the real world could cause your dream self to get loaded into and fired out of a big cannon.
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 4 nahida 07.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' Another example... If you're thirsty in the real world, then you might find yourself trudging through a desert in your dream.
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 4 nahida 08.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' But the appearance of your wife seems unusually stable and unaffected by any outside interference. Statistically, this should be extremely rare.
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 4 ilman 10.ogg}} '''Ilman:''' I don't understand it either, but I have no reason to suspect or reject these dreams. They're too beautiful.
:{{DIcon}} Indeed.
:{{DIcon}} I agree, it doesn't really feel like a cause for concern.
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 4 nahida 09.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' But I still want to figure out the how and the why. These kinds of dreams are novel to me as well. That's why I want to have a look at the scene your dreams have been taking place at.
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 4 nahida 10.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' Let's go! Just think of it as a nice little hike to the top of the mountain.
----
;(Approach the summit)
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 4 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Well, he really wasn't kidding. This place definitely isn't safe.
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 4 nahida 11.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' No matter. We'll just finish them quickly.
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 4 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh? Are you going to fight too, Nahida?
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 4 nahida 12.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' Of course. This is all part of our little trip.

;(After defeating the enemies)
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 4 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' The scenery here is amazing... It also seems like a great spot for eating snacks and taking a nap.
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 4 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Paimon wouldn't mind spending some time here every day, either. *sigh*
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 4 nahida 13.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' I've yet to see anything strange about this place.
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 4 nahida 14.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' I do not plan to deny the power of longing. Such an intense but unquantifiable emotion could indeed have the power to organize dreams.

:{{A|vo nhdlq001 4 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh? Wait, where'd he go?
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 4 ilman 11.ogg}} '''Ilman:''' Oh, so you were waiting for me here? Well, guess what, I've brought someone amazing with me today.
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 4 ilman 12.ogg}} '''Ilman:''' When the Dendro Archon said she wanted to come with me, I could hardly believe it!
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 4 ilman 13.ogg}} '''Ilman:''' I'll bring Haydar once I'm more familiar with the way here. She's been telling me that she really misses you.

:{{A|vo nhdlq001 4 nahida 17.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' I find it a little strange as well, but we mustn't awaken someone while they're sleepwalking. All we can do is sit here and wait.

:{{A|vo nhdlq001 4 ilman 21.ogg}} '''Ilman:''' After I introduced her to you, she seemed a little flustered and started walking away. I told her to stop because of the cliff...
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 4 ilman 22.ogg}} '''Ilman:''' And then she seemed to suddenly disappear. A strong wind started to blow around me and the sky grew dark.

:{{A|vo nhdlq001 4 ilman 24.ogg}} '''Ilman:''' I don't think so... I slept a lot yesterday, and I don't feel very sleepy now.
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 4 nahida 18.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' Maybe we've affected the way his subconscious constructs dreams by following him here.
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 4 nahida 19.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' Anyway, all that matters is that you woke up safe and sound.
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 4 ilman 25.ogg}} '''Ilman:''' I think I know what happened now, I'm sorry... If it weren't for you, I would have fallen.
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 4 nahida 20.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' Let's head back now. Don't come back to this place again for the time being.

:{{A|vo nhdlq001 4 nahida 21.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' We still don't have enough evidence to work off of, so it's hard to draw any reliable conclusions yet... But I'm concerned that Ilman's case may not be unique to him...

:{{A|vo nhdlq001 4 paimon 18.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Then there's no time to lose. Let's head back!
:{{A|vo nhdlq001 4 paimon 19.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Stop standing there, Ilman! Let's go!

{{Quest Description|You realize that many people may be experiencing unusual dreams just like Ilman. To prevent the dreams from causing more harm, you must return to "A Moment of Dreams" to take measures.}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Approach the marked area)
:{{A|vo nhdlq002 1 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Look. She's sitting over there... and surrounded by monsters!
:{{A|vo nhdlq002 1 nahida 01.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' C'mon, let's rescue her!

;(After defeating the opponents)
:{{A|vo nhdlq002 2 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' She seems to be in the same condition as [[Ilman]] earlier.
:{{A|vo nhdlq002 2 nahida 01.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' Yes, but luckily, she hasn't been injured or jolted awake yet. Let's carefully move her somewhere safer.
:{{A|vo nhdlq002 2 kathya 01.ogg}} '''Kathya:''' See you tomorrow, Professor [[Aisha]]...
:{{A|vo nhdlq002 2 kathya 02.ogg}} '''Kathya:''' Hmm... Huh? W—Why am I back here again?
:{{DIcon}} Nobody else is here.
:{{DIcon}} You were dreaming just now.
:{{A|vo nhdlq002 2 kathya 03.ogg}} '''Kathya:''' Dreaming? But what about Professor Aisha...?
:{{A|vo nhdlq002 2 kathya 04.ogg}} '''Kathya:''' Oh, I see. It was all just a dream... Well, that makes sense. After all, it hasn't changed a single bit.
:{{A|vo nhdlq002 2 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh? What's "it"?
:{{A|vo nhdlq002 2 kathya 05.ogg}} '''Kathya:''' Nearly twenty years, and it still hasn't bloomed... *sigh*
:{{A|vo nhdlq002 2 nahida 02.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' Does it have something to do with your dream? Please, tell us what you mean.
:{{A|vo nhdlq002 2 kathya 06.ogg}} '''Kathya:''' Ah, sorry, I'm still feeling a little groggy. Please give me a moment here... Whew.
:{{A|vo nhdlq002 2 kathya 07.ogg}} '''Kathya:''' Ahem, alright, where to start... Right, this plant... So, Professor Aisha gave me this plant just before she left.
:{{A|vo nhdlq002 2 kathya 08.ogg}} '''Kathya:''' She was a good friend of my parents' and my first real tutor. She was also an outstanding [[Amurta]] researcher.
:{{A|vo nhdlq002 2 kathya 09.ogg}} '''Kathya:''' In addition to her extraordinary academic talents, she was also skilled in combat, and would accept lots of work from the Adventurers' Guild.
:{{A|vo nhdlq002 2 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, so you mean she's left on an adventure?
:{{A|vo nhdlq002 2 kathya 10.ogg}} '''Kathya:''' Yes. When I was about ten years old, she told me that she must go look for the secrets of "the Abyss," and that she would be gone for a long time.
:{{A|vo nhdlq002 2 kathya 11.ogg}} '''Kathya:''' I grabbed hold of her and wouldn't let go. I didn't know what "the Abyss" was... I just knew that she was like family to me.
:{{A|vo nhdlq002 2 kathya 12.ogg}} '''Kathya:''' She hugged me, and we cried for some time until I fell asleep. When I woke up, I was already back home.
:{{A|vo nhdlq002 2 kathya 13.ogg}} '''Kathya:''' She still decided to leave, but had left behind a letter for me saying that I was the person she cared for most in this world.
:{{A|vo nhdlq002 2 kathya 14.ogg}} '''Kathya:''' She claimed that investigating "the Abyss" could help more ordinary people protect the people and things they care about.
:{{A|vo nhdlq002 2 kathya 15.ogg}} '''Kathya:''' She had obtained some important evidence during her past adventures... If she didn't set off right away, she might miss the perfect opportunity.
:{{A|vo nhdlq002 2 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Guess "ad astra abyssosque" isn't just a slogan...
:{{A|vo nhdlq002 2 kathya 16.ogg}} '''Kathya:''' She left a seed in the letter, telling me that if it sprouted and bloomed, then she'd come back, no matter what sort of risky situation she was in.
:{{A|vo nhdlq002 2 kathya 17.ogg}} '''Kathya:''' She said she looked forward to seeing me all grown up...
:{{A|vo nhdlq002 2 kathya 18.ogg}} '''Kathya:''' But strangely, I've tried watering it, feeding it, everything I could think of... but I've never been able to get it to bloom.
:{{A|vo nhdlq002 2 kathya 19.ogg}} '''Kathya:''' I even went to ask the Amurta researchers, and they couldn't explain it, either.
:{{A|vo nhdlq002 2 nahida 03.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' May I have a look at the plant?
:{{A|vo nhdlq002 2 kathya 20.ogg}} '''Kathya:''' Of course. I was hoping the great Dendro Archon could help me solve this problem.
:{{A|vo nhdlq002 2 nahida 04.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' Let me see. Hmm, oh...
:{{A|vo nhdlq002 2 nahida 05.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' ...
:{{A|vo nhdlq002 2 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh, we've never seen that look on Nahida's face before.
:{{A|vo nhdlq002 2 nahida 06.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' ...
:{{DIcon}} (Wait, could it be...!?)
:{{DIcon}} (An expression pleading for help?)
:{{A|vo nhdlq002 2 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Sh—She looks a little unwell. Um, hold on, we'll be right back!
:;(The party separates from Kathya)
:{{A|vo nhdlq002 2 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What's wrong, Nahida? You can't tell what's wrong with the plant, either?
:{{A|vo nhdlq002 2 nahida 07.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' No, I immediately understood what's happening with that plant... I'm just not sure if I should say it.
:{{A|vo nhdlq002 2 nahida 08.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' This plant is not known to the academic world. It's a new species that her teacher managed to cultivate by some special means.
:{{A|vo nhdlq002 2 nahida 09.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' Judging by its features, I can tell from the moment it sprouted, it'll never be able to bloom.
:{{A|vo nhdlq002 2 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' I—It can't be...
:{{A|vo nhdlq002 2 nahida 10.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' It means that this "Professor Aisha" she keeps mentioning might have foreseen the danger, and was prepared to never return.
:{{A|vo nhdlq002 2 nahida 11.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' From my experience observing people, she would undoubtedly regard this as a "brutal" revelation.
:{{A|vo nhdlq002 2 nahida 12.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' When forced to confront such "brutal" truths, people may break down into tears, talk nonsense, or lose their tempers...
:{{A|vo nhdlq002 2 nahida 13.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' I know she has to face the truth, but at the same time, I don't want to hurt her... Tell me, {{Traveler}}, what should I do?
:{{A|vo nhdlq002 2 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yeah, that's a tricky one... Seems like you've already got a good idea of the feelings she might experience.
:{{DIcon}} I'll tell her.
:{{A|vo nhdlq002 2 nahida 14.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' But wouldn't that mean I'm just pushing it all on you? What if she just gets angry at you instead?
:{{A|vo nhdlq002 2 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' It's all right. There are all kinds of people, and the examples you observed are just the most extreme cases.
:{{DIcon}} I've seen many situations like this before.
:{{DIcon}} There's always a way to work through it.
:{{A|vo nhdlq002 2 nahida 15.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' O—Okay... Thank you.
:{{A|vo nhdlq002 2 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Let's go back and tell her.
:;(The party regroups with Kathya)
:{{A|vo nhdlq002 2 kathya 21.ogg}} '''Kathya:''' Huh! It'll never bloom!?
:{{A|vo nhdlq002 2 kathya 22.ogg}} '''Kathya:''' But how's that possible? If a plant is unable to bloom, doesn't that mean it can't reproduce, either? All that's left for it to do is slowly wither away!

:{{DIcon}} She meant to convey a message through the plant's true nature.

:{{A|vo nhdlq002 22 moseis 36.ogg}} '''Moseis:''' If you understood humans a little better or had also experienced firsthand the absolute devastation of loss, then perhaps you wouldn't be so cold towards us.

:{{A|vo nhdlq002 22 nahida 23.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' No, because unlike you, she can't enter this dream.
:{{A|vo nhdlq002 22 nahida 24.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' The moment you came into this dream, it created a "Haydar" to realize your wish of reuniting with your family.
:{{A|vo nhdlq002 22 nahida 25.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' So, tell me: Where's the real Haydar?
:{{A|vo nhdlq002 22 ilman 06.ogg}} '''Ilman:''' She's still out there on the mountainside...
:{{A|vo nhdlq002 22 nahida 26.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' That's right. And she must have been terrified to see her father not in his right mind.
:{{A|vo nhdlq002 22 nahida 27.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' Not to mention the monsters in that area... The situation is very dangerous.
:{{A|vo nhdlq002 22 ilman 07.ogg}} '''Ilman:''' If Haydar's still out there, then...
:{{A|vo nhdlq002 22 haydar 01.ogg}} '''Haydar:''' What're you talking about, Dad? I don't understand.
:{{A|vo nhdlq002 22 ilman 08.ogg}} '''Ilman:''' I must wake up right now! I can't leave her there alone.
:{{A|vo nhdlq002 22 kian 02.ogg}} '''Kian:''' ...
:{{A|vo nhdlq002 22 thana 01.ogg}} '''Thana:''' ...
:{{A|vo nhdlq002 22 nahida 28.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' It seems the others have also remembered something.
:{{A|vo nhdlq002 22 nahida 29.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' People try to avoid pain and stay in their perceived bubbles of safety out of an instinct to protect themselves. This is human nature, but it is also one of their weaknesses.
:{{A|vo nhdlq002 22 nahida 30.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' However, why are there still so many people striving to move forward even when they know the path ahead is dangerous and painful?
:{{A|vo nhdlq002 22 nahida 31.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' It's because people don't only live for themselves.
:{{A|vo nhdlq002 22 nahida 32.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' They have families, loved ones, friends, and communities. They have dreams that they are still trying to achieve.
:{{A|vo nhdlq002 22 nahida 33.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' But in this dream, you showed them only the most comfortable and soothing things. This entire world has been built on a foundation of buried and unseen pain.
:{{A|vo nhdlq002 22 nahida 34.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' It's all just a well-devised scam.
:{{A|vo nhdlq002 22 kian 03.ogg}} '''Kian:''' It seems like I've stayed in the dream for too long.
:{{A|vo nhdlq002 22 thana 02.ogg}} '''Thana:''' I still have so many things I haven't done...

:{{A|vo nhdlq002 22 moseis 40.ogg}} '''Moseis:''' If you wanted to spend a little time in the waking world, go right ahead. In any case, I wanted to spend some time alone with Emira.
:{{A|vo nhdlq002 22 moseis 41.ogg}} '''Moseis:''' As long as this dream continues to exist, you'll come back.
:{{A|vo nhdlq002 22 moseis 42.ogg}} '''Moseis:''' Humans aren't as strong as you think. Even if you're a god, they won't always listen to you.
:{{A|vo nhdlq002 22 moseis 43.ogg}} '''Moseis:''' It's time to purge all the extraneous data and noise.

==Steps==
# Inform A Moment of Dreams' participants of the situation
# Deliver the knowledge capsule containing Moseis' consciousness to the Akademiya
# Return to "A Moment of Dreams"
# Meet Nahida at the plaza

:{{A|vo nhdlq003 4 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Let's be quiet and just listen in.
:{{A|vo nhdlq003 4 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' I wonder what she's going to say.
:{{A|vo nhdlq003 4 nahida 01.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' Hello, all of you who have just woken up.
:{{A|vo nhdlq003 4 nahida 02.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' I'm sorry for interrupting your beautiful dreams. I may have acted a little cold when handling things in the dream. I sincerely apologize for that.
:{{A|vo nhdlq003 4 nahida 03.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' Dreams have amazing power. They inspire us to remain resolute in the face of adversity, and help those with aspirations achieve their desires.
:{{A|vo nhdlq003 4 nahida 04.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' But dreams also have the potential to exploit people, confuse the senses, and distort the truth. Unfortunately, you were all chosen as prey for an elaborate scheme.
:{{A|vo nhdlq003 4 nahida 05.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' As I've said before, I'm still learning, and cannot fully empathize with the pain of all the loss you've experienced.
:{{A|vo nhdlq003 4 nahida 06.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' But just take a good look around you, and you'll see many other people who have had similar experiences.
:{{A|vo nhdlq003 4 nahida 07.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' You should be proud that you've been able to gather here and look toward the future together.
:{{A|vo nhdlq003 4 nahida 08.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' The path of life is long, and it's hard for us to see the destination. This leads us to ask a lot of difficult questions...
:{{A|vo nhdlq003 4 nahida 09.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' What's the meaning of life? What's the purpose of my existence? Why do I keep experiencing pain and loss?
:{{A|vo nhdlq003 4 nahida 10.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' *sigh* Of course, the most comfortable choice is to stop progressing, give up thinking, and just keep repeating whatever you're already familiar with.
:{{A|vo nhdlq003 4 nahida 11.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' Whenever you have such thoughts, just look at the people and things around you.
:{{A|vo nhdlq003 4 nahida 12.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' Some people work hard all day so that their families can have a hot meal on the table at night.
:{{A|vo nhdlq003 4 nahida 13.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' Some people travel all over the world in order to create art that resonates with all of Teyvat.
:{{A|vo nhdlq003 4 nahida 14.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' Some venture in search of the world's secrets to prevent rapidly approaching, yet still unknown, world-shattering catastrophes.
:{{A|vo nhdlq003 4 nahida 15.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' Life is not just about yourself. Each and every one of your actions shapes you and the world around you.

:{{A|vo nhdlq003 4 nahida 18.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' Once you begin your journey on that same difficult yet rewarding path, you'll come to know the answers to those big, existential questions, yet they will no longer feel as life-defining as they did before.
