==Dialogue==
===Doing Paperwork Sure Is Tough!===
{{Quest Description|For Collei's future and that of all Sumeru, Faruzan decides to start a certain class...}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Go to the entrance to the Akademiya)
:{{A|vo frzcop001 1917102 collei 01.ogg}} '''Collei:''' I can't believe she rushed right in after we arrived. She's really headstrong... *sigh* How did things turn out like this?
:{{DIcon}} Did I end up giving her a bad idea?
:{{DIcon}} You seem quite scared of her.
:{{A|vo frzcop001 1917102 collei 02.ogg}} '''Collei:''' No, not really. Madam Faruzan is a brilliant scholar — even Master thinks so. If she's really going to teach me how to read, it'll definitely be much better than me bashing my head against the wall.
:{{A|vo frzcop001 1917102 collei 03.ogg}} '''Collei:''' It's just that she can get a bit TOO passionate sometimes. I don't know how to handle that.
:{{DIcon}} The way she treats you...
:{{DIcon}} ...Is completely different from how she treats researchers.
:{{A|vo frzcop001 1917102 collei 04.ogg}} '''Collei:''' Maybe it's because she wants to take me in as a student?
:{{A|vo frzcop001 1917102 collei 05.ogg}} '''Collei:''' It's just like that researcher said: the Akademiya has completely changed during the 100 years that Faruzan was gone.
:{{A|vo frzcop001 1917102 collei 06.ogg}} '''Collei:''' I don't really get it, but it does seem like Haravatat's students aren't optimistic about the prospects of doing research with her.
:{{A|vo frzcop001 1917102 collei 07.ogg}} '''Collei:''' Students who are interested in mechanisms and applications of the elements generally enroll in Kshahrewar and Spantamad.
:{{A|vo frzcop001 1917102 collei 08.ogg}} '''Collei:''' Madam Faruzan also refuses to accept random students just to make up numbers. She still hasn't found a student she likes, even after all this time back.
:{{DIcon}} So she's a teacher with no students...
:{{A|vo frzcop001 1917102 collei 09.ogg}} '''Collei:''' But she seems to like my attitude toward learning, so she often asks me if I'm willing to become her student.
:{{A|vo frzcop001 1917102 collei 10.ogg}} '''Collei:''' Agh, it's because I'm a slow learner that I have no choice but to stay up late and study! Whenever she compliments me, I feel really guilty...
:{{DIcon}} So you're scared of her because...
:{{DIcon}} ...She keeps asking you to become her student?
:{{A|vo frzcop001 1917102 collei 11.ogg}} '''Collei:''' It's not that... Madam Faruzan respects my choices. She hasn't been trying to persuade me, especially since she knows I need to rest and recuperate.
:{{A|vo frzcop001 1917102 collei 12.ogg}} '''Collei:''' She sometimes brings food to Gandharva Ville for me, and each time, she says that Master can't find out...
:{{DIcon}} That sounds like something a grandmother might do for her granddaughter...
:{{A|vo frzcop001 1917102 collei 13.ogg}} '''Collei:''' Now that you mention it, it does feel a bit like that. ...Do I really look that young?
:{{A|vo frzcop001 1917102 faruzan 01.ogg}} '''Faruzan:''' Collei, {{Traveler}}, thank you for waiting. The issue has been resolved.
:{{DIcon}} That was fast!
:{{A|vo frzcop001 1917102 faruzan 02.ogg}} '''Faruzan:''' I argued with the higher-ups and convinced them of the practicality and necessity of educating the general public.
:{{A|vo frzcop001 1917102 faruzan 03.ogg}} '''Faruzan:''' If I'm not mistaken, they're the students of my classmates' students. They're a lot less forceful than their predecessors, though. I'd say they caved rather quickly.
:{{A|vo frzcop001 1917102 collei 14.ogg}} '''Collei:''' A—Amazing...
:{{DIcon}} (Were they convinced...)
:{{DIcon}} (...Or were they coerced?)
:{{A|vo frzcop001 1917102 faruzan 04.ogg}} '''Faruzan:''' It's just that we need to fill in every single page of the application. Tch, it's been a century, but the Akademiya is as picky as ever.
:{{A|vo frzcop001 1917102 faruzan 05.ogg}} '''Faruzan:''' Let's see now, what do we need to fill in... Course name, learning objectives, teaching methods, course materials... Hmm, I suppose we can fill in the course name last.
:{{DIcon}} Our learning objective is to teach people to read, right?
:{{A|vo frzcop001 1917102 faruzan 06.ogg}} '''Faruzan:''' That's a bit too general, I'd say. After all, this class's target audience isn't toddlers or children, but rather people who already know the basics of reading.
:{{A|vo frzcop001 1917102 faruzan 07.ogg}} '''Faruzan:''' As such, we'll need a more specific learning objective. How about... proficiency in reading and writing?
:{{A|vo frzcop001 1917102 collei 15.ogg}} '''Collei:''' That's true! If we use children's teaching materials, we'll only end up wasting a lot of time on things that students would already know...
:{{A|vo frzcop001 1917102 faruzan 08.ogg}} '''Faruzan:''' And you have your job as a Forest Ranger, Collei. People who attend this course in the future are also likely to have life commitments. We need more effective teaching methods.
:{{DIcon}} So, other than teaching materials for children...
:{{DIcon}} ...What other learning methods does Collei use?
:{{A|vo frzcop001 1917102 collei 16.ogg}} '''Collei:''' Hmm... Master always tells me that practice is the best way to learn. That's why I often ask him to help me find simple books to read.
:{{A|vo frzcop001 1917102 faruzan 09.ogg}} '''Faruzan:''' It must have been difficult to get books in Sumeru in recent years, no? Tighnari really went the extra mile for you.
:{{A|vo frzcop001 1917102 faruzan 10.ogg}} '''Faruzan:''' Expanding literacy is a capital notion. Now that the Akademiya is easing restrictions on the circulation of books, there should be more people who have become interested in reading. It's a great time to conduct this course.
:{{DIcon}} So we've got teaching methods sorted out.
:{{DIcon}} How do we choose our course materials, then?
:{{A|vo frzcop001 1917102 faruzan 11.ogg}} '''Faruzan:''' Hmm, so that's next on the list... I fear that I'm at a loss as to which books youngsters like nowadays. Would "The Legend of Antara" be too old of a story?
:{{DIcon}} If even a centenarian like you finds that tale old...
:{{DIcon}} How old is that story, exactly...?
:{{A|vo frzcop001 1917102 faruzan 12.ogg}} '''Faruzan:''' Hm, fair... Collei, what have you been reading lately?
:{{A|vo frzcop001 1917102 collei 17.ogg}} '''Collei:''' Me...? I've been reading light novels from Inazuma. I heard that ever since we were allowed to sell books in Sumeru again, some people set up stalls at Treasures Street to sell light novels. I've been meaning to go there and check it out!
:{{A|vo frzcop001 1917102 faruzan 13.ogg}} '''Faruzan:''' Light novels? This is my first time hearing about such a thing, but I doubt I will procure suitable teaching materials from the House of Daena... Treasures Street it is!
:{{A|vo frzcop001 1917102 collei 18.ogg}} '''Collei:''' W—Wait for us, Madam Faruzan!

:{{A|vo frzcop001 1917102 collei 19.ogg}} '''Collei:''' Gah, you wouldn't think someone as fast as her is over 100...! Let's pick up the pace and catch up to her!

;(Continue to [[#Finding Teaching Material Sure Is Tough!|Finding Teaching Material Sure Is Tough!]])
{{Dialogue End}}

===Finding Teaching Material Sure Is Tough!===
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Use [[Nahida]]'s [[All Schemes to Know]] on Faruzan, optional)
:{{A|vo frzcop001 1917301 faruzan 02.ogg}} '''Faruzan:''' (Got to pick a true classic...)

;(Use [[Nahida]]'s [[All Schemes to Know]] on Farruq, optional)
:{{A|vo frzcop001 1917301 farrokh 01.ogg}} '''Farruq:''' (These folks had better be buying...)

;(Go to the book vendors at Treasures Street)
:{{A|vo frzcop001 1917103 faruzan 01.ogg}} '''Faruzan:''' What a long and mildly ungrammatical title. And why is the cover so colorful?
:{{A|vo frzcop001 1917103 farrokh 01.ogg}} '''Farruq:''' Is this your first time seeing a light novel, ma'am? They're the most popular of books nowadays. Would you like me to recommend something?
:{{A|vo frzcop001 1917103 faruzan 02.ogg}} '''Faruzan:''' Fine. One shouldn't judge a book by its cover, after all. May we browse through the books here?
:{{A|vo frzcop001 1917103 farrokh 02.ogg}} '''Farruq:''' Of course. Why don't you try this one? It's "Outlander Brigade: When the Wind of Death Blew Towards the Blond Samurai"!
:{{A|vo frzcop001 1917103 collei 01.ogg}} '''Collei:''' Ah, I heard that this book's author describes action in vivid detail.
:{{A|vo frzcop001 1917103 faruzan 03.ogg}} '''Faruzan:''' Hmm... Now, I've only skimmed through a few pages, but it feels like it's all fight scenes. There are only subjects and predicates, and the syntax is a tad simple.
:{{A|vo frzcop001 1917103 collei 02.ogg}} '''Collei:''' S—Subjects? Predicates?
:{{A|vo frzcop001 1917103 faruzan 04.ogg}} '''Faruzan:''' The protagonist just ends up fighting in every scene with no proper build-up. Will anyone even enjoy a story that's only comprised of fights?
:{{DIcon}} There might be people out there who will.
:{{DIcon}} It's for readers who don't care about plot.
:{{A|vo frzcop001 1917103 farrokh 03.ogg}} '''Farruq:''' Uh, how about "The Good Thing About Being Reincarnated as a Hilichurl Is That I Only Need to Eat Sunsettias to Become Stronger"?
:{{A|vo frzcop001 1917103 collei 03.ogg}} '''Collei:''' A reincarnation {{w|isekai}} story? Those are pretty popular right now.
:{{A|vo frzcop001 1917103 faruzan 05.ogg}} '''Faruzan:''' "Isekai"? What in the world is that? Also, why does it become stronger by eating Sunsettias?
:{{DIcon}} Those are what we call "tropes."
:{{A|vo frzcop001 1917103 faruzan 06.ogg}} '''Faruzan:''' "Tropes"? Ah, those fictional rules used to push the plot forward, yes? They're definitely effective in achieving a distancing effect.
:{{A|vo frzcop001 1917103 collei 04.ogg}} '''Collei:''' Uh, sorry, what is this distancing effect?
:{{A|vo frzcop001 1917103 faruzan 07.ogg}} '''Faruzan:''' However, this book doesn't explain how reincarnation correlates to becoming stronger. Such an illogical rule will affect the coherence of the story. Will readers really accept this?
:{{DIcon}} There might be people out there who will.
:{{DIcon}} It's for readers who don't care much for logic.
:{{A|vo frzcop001 1917103 farrokh 04.ogg}} '''Farruq:''' H—How about this? I had to fight tooth and nail to get this in stock!
:{{A|vo frzcop001 1917103 collei 05.ogg}} '''Collei:''' Oh! That's the latest volume of "Onibudou"!
:{{A|vo frzcop001 1917103 faruzan 08.ogg}} '''Faruzan:''' Hmm? Now that's a rather normal title length. ...Oh, Collei, do you like this series?
:{{A|vo frzcop001 1917103 collei 06.ogg}} '''Collei:''' Y—Yes, but I—I don't like it THAT much! Ha ha...
:{{DIcon}} (She clearly recognized it as the latest volume with a single glance...)
:{{DIcon}} (Is she embarrassed to admit that she likes books like that?)
:{{A|vo frzcop001 1917103 collei 07.ogg}} '''Collei:''' Uh... Madam, are you going to use this series as teaching material?
:{{A|vo frzcop001 1917103 faruzan 09.ogg}} '''Faruzan:''' Let me see... The dialogue flows quite well, but there are too many phrases here that I don't recognize.
:{{A|vo frzcop001 1917103 faruzan 10.ogg}} '''Faruzan:''' "Third Eye of Perception," "Illusory Mirror," and so on. Are these terms that are tied to tropes?
:{{A|vo frzcop001 1917103 collei 08.ogg}} '''Collei:''' Haha, I also thought those names were strange when I was reading them...
:{{DIcon}} She was able to say those phrases in such a serious tone...
:{{DIcon}} I guess that's a language researcher from Haravatat for you...
:{{A|vo frzcop001 1917103 faruzan 11.ogg}} '''Faruzan:''' It's impossible to derive the meaning of these phrases in isolation. Also, their morphological properties are quite pedestrian, really.
:{{A|vo frzcop001 1917103 faruzan 12.ogg}} '''Faruzan:''' Or did the protagonist purposely create these strange names to disorient their foes?
:{{DIcon}} I think it's because such names are "cool"...
:{{DIcon}} I think it's because such names are "fancy"...
:{{A|vo frzcop001 1917103 faruzan 13.ogg}} '''Faruzan:''' So there's no deeper purpose? My, it's quite hard to understand stories written these days.
:{{A|vo frzcop001 1917103 collei 09.ogg}} '''Collei:''' Y—You're right... It's such a weird book, haha... but you keep wanting to read the next page...
:{{A|vo frzcop001 1917103 faruzan 14.ogg}} '''Faruzan:''' *sigh* Even the most popular book in Sumeru back then had greater depth than anything written today.
:{{DIcon}} The most popular book back then?
:{{A|vo frzcop001 1917103 faruzan 15.ogg}} '''Faruzan:''' Yes — a Vahumana researcher wrote it while researching folk legends.
:{{A|vo frzcop001 1917103 faruzan 16.ogg}} '''Faruzan:''' The plot had many twists, the world-building was fantastic, and even the writing could withstand scrutiny. When it was still being published, many people in the Akademiya were reading it.
:{{A|vo frzcop001 1917103 faruzan 17.ogg}} '''Faruzan:''' Even the sages back then all described the story as a timeless classic. The series must have concluded after so many years, right? Perhaps it's even more popular now.
:{{A|vo frzcop001 1917103 farrokh 05.ogg}} '''Farruq:''' Is there a book like that in Sumeru? I've never heard of such a thing before. What's the title?
:{{A|vo frzcop001 1917103 faruzan 18.ogg}} '''Faruzan:''' It's called "Tales of Shahryar." Do you sell it here?
:{{A|vo frzcop001 1917103 farrokh 06.ogg}} '''Farruq:''' Tales of Shahryar? I don't think I've heard of that before. When was it published?
:{{A|vo frzcop001 1917103 faruzan 19.ogg}} '''Faruzan:''' About 100 years ago...
:{{A|vo frzcop001 1917103 farrokh 07.ogg}} '''Farruq:''' 100 years ago? Are you pulling my leg? What sort of book can remain popular for 100 years?
:{{A|vo frzcop001 1917103 faruzan 20.ogg}} '''Faruzan:''' "The Legend of Antara" is popular to this very day, isn't it? I just heard someone telling it a few days ago in a cafe.
:{{A|vo frzcop001 1917103 faruzan 21.ogg}} '''Faruzan:''' If an old story like that is still being shared, then "Tales of Shahryar" must be even more popular.
:{{A|vo frzcop001 1917103 farrokh 08.ogg}} '''Farruq:''' Even if that is the case, I really don't carry that book here in my store...
:{{A|vo frzcop001 1917103 faruzan 22.ogg}} '''Faruzan:''' What? Hmm, is that because of the Akademiya's strict control over books in recent years?
:{{A|vo frzcop001 1917103 faruzan 23.ogg}} '''Faruzan:''' I can't believe they've allowed the people of Sumeru to become so uncivilized. How can they not know about the Tales of Shahryar?
:{{A|vo frzcop001 1917103 farrokh 09.ogg}} '''Farruq:''' Tales of Shahryar... Oh wait, I think I heard an antique seller on the other end of Treasures Street mention that name before.
:{{A|vo frzcop001 1917103 farrokh 10.ogg}} '''Farruq:''' I mean, it is a book from 100 years ago... Why don't you try asking for it there?
:{{A|vo frzcop001 1917103 faruzan 24.ogg}} '''Faruzan:''' Tales of Shahryar is considered an antique now? How could the Akademiya have let such an excellent work of literature be forgotten like this?
:{{A|vo frzcop001 1917103 faruzan 25.ogg}} '''Faruzan:''' {{Traveler}}, Collei, I'm going to get to the bottom of this. Let's meet at the antique seller's.
:{{A|vo frzcop001 1917103 collei 10.ogg}} '''Collei:''' Madam, wait! Oh no, this is bad...
:{{DIcon}} What's wrong?
:{{A|vo frzcop001 1917103 collei 11.ogg}} '''Collei:''' You asked me why I'm scared of Madam Faruzan, right? It's not because I don't know how to respond to her kindness...
:{{A|vo frzcop001 1917103 collei 12.ogg}} '''Collei:''' It's because I'm afraid of that ancient language she researches, because I can barely understand any of it. What if she uses ancient texts as teaching material!?
:{{DIcon}} That book's only 100 years old, Collei...
:{{DIcon}} I doubt this counts as a book written in an ancient language...
:{{A|vo frzcop001 1917103 collei 13.ogg}} '''Collei:''' Even so, what if researchers from 100 years ago liked to use ancient languages in their books? We've got to catch up to her!

;(Talk to Farruq again, optional)
:{{A|vo frzcop001 1917104 farrokh 01.ogg}} '''Farruq:''' A book that was popular 100 years ago? It doesn't sound like something that'd be popular now, to be frank.

;(Use [[Nahida]]'s [[All Schemes to Know]] on Derafsh, optional)
:{{A|vo frzcop001 1917301 derafsh 01.ogg}} '''Derafsh:''' (Who in their right mind would have any interest in this?)

;(Go to the antique shop at Treasures Street)
:{{A|vo frzcop001 1917104 faruzan 01.ogg}} '''Faruzan:''' Found it! The fifth volume of "Tales of Shahryar"!
:{{A|vo frzcop001 1917104 collei 01.ogg}} '''Collei:''' Wow, you actually found it!
:{{A|vo frzcop001 1917104 derafsh 01.ogg}} '''Derafsh:''' I never thought that this book would ever get sold...
:{{A|vo frzcop001 1917104 faruzan 02.ogg}} '''Faruzan:''' All right, that's our teaching material secured. We also now know what to call this course: "Analysis of Classical Texts." After all, this book is definitely worthy of being called a classic!
:{{A|vo frzcop001 1917104 collei 02.ogg}} '''Collei:''' C—Can I take a look...?
:{{A|vo frzcop001 1917104 collei 03.ogg}} '''Collei:''' Phew... Luckily, the language being used here isn't ancient at all. I can recognize a few words here and there... Huh? But why aren't there pictures in this book?
:{{A|vo frzcop001 1917104 faruzan 03.ogg}} '''Faruzan:''' As long as the writing is good, readers won't need any illustrations to imagine the scenes.
:{{A|vo frzcop001 1917104 faruzan 04.ogg}} '''Faruzan:''' Worry not, I shall thoroughly explain the difficult sections. You'll like this book, I know it!
:{{A|vo frzcop001 1917104 faruzan 05.ogg}} '''Faruzan:''' Ah, after all this time. I wonder if Aliyah and Aziz ended up together. And who obtained the Desert Gem in the end...?
:{{A|vo frzcop001 1917104 faruzan 06.ogg}} '''Faruzan:''' Sir, do you have the subsequent volumes of this series?
:{{A|vo frzcop001 1917104 derafsh 02.ogg}} '''Derafsh:''' Uh, I don't think so.
:{{A|vo frzcop001 1917104 faruzan 07.ogg}} '''Faruzan:''' Is that so? And here I thought I could finally read the ending... Never mind, I'll keep searching for the later volumes myself.
:{{A|vo frzcop001 1917104 faruzan 08.ogg}} '''Faruzan:''' If I'm to use it as a teaching material, it's better to start earlier in the series. Where are the first four volumes? Why aren't they all together?
:{{A|vo frzcop001 1917104 derafsh 03.ogg}} '''Derafsh:''' Uh, I don't have those either. Actually, this is the only volume I have.
:{{A|vo frzcop001 1917104 faruzan 09.ogg}} '''Faruzan:''' Is this series really that popular?
:{{A|vo frzcop001 1917104 derafsh 04.ogg}} '''Derafsh:''' No, no, no. It's not popular at all. Rather, there's absolutely no demand for it.
:{{A|vo frzcop001 1917104 faruzan 10.ogg}} '''Faruzan:''' No demand? Impossible! Back then, I'd come across at least three groups of people talking about it during a single stroll at the Akademiya!
:{{A|vo frzcop001 1917104 derafsh 05.ogg}} '''Derafsh:''' Seriously? No one told me that this book was anything special when I first got it.
:{{A|vo frzcop001 1917104 faruzan 11.ogg}} '''Faruzan:''' Where did you get this from? Can you still contact the seller?
:{{A|vo frzcop001 1917104 derafsh 06.ogg}} '''Derafsh:''' I'm afraid not. This book was sold together with a whole bunch of antique furniture. I didn't even notice it initially.
:{{A|vo frzcop001 1917104 derafsh 07.ogg}} '''Derafsh:''' Otherwise, the matra would've come knocking... Wait, is this book actually worth a lot? It can't be, right?
:{{DIcon}} I'm afraid not.
:{{DIcon}} It doesn't look valuable.
:{{A|vo frzcop001 1917104 faruzan 12.ogg}} '''Faruzan:''' That's impossible! No matter how strict the Akademiya was, there's no way "Tales of Shahryar" could have fallen into such a state...
:{{A|vo frzcop001 1917104 derafsh 08.ogg}} '''Derafsh:''' Ah, I do remember a passerby skimming through the book a few days ago. However, he simply sighed and left.
:{{A|vo frzcop001 1917104 faruzan 13.ogg}} '''Faruzan:''' He sighed? Why would he react like that? Given the quality of "Tales of Shahryar," he should've been entranced after a single glance.
:{{A|vo frzcop001 1917104 faruzan 14.ogg}} '''Faruzan:''' ...I'm sorry, Traveler, Collei. Please give me a moment. I'd like to look through this book first.
:{{Black Screen|Faruzan quickly flips through the pages...}}
:{{A|vo frzcop001 1917104 faruzan 15.ogg}} '''Faruzan:''' ...Why is there another misunderstanding between Aliyah and Aziz? Also, why is there no mention of the Desert Gem at all?
:{{A|vo frzcop001 1917104 faruzan 16.ogg}} '''Faruzan:''' ...And a new character is introduced with no foreshadowing at all? Also, what are all these new names and terms?
:{{A|vo frzcop001 1917104 faruzan 17.ogg}} '''Faruzan:''' Is this really the "Tales of Shahryar" I know...?
:{{A|vo frzcop001 1917104 faruzan 18.ogg}} '''Faruzan:''' *sigh*
:{{A|vo frzcop001 1917104 derafsh 09.ogg}} '''Derafsh:''' Well, that passerby reacted in much the same way.
:{{DIcon}} Who was the passerby, in any case?
:{{A|vo frzcop001 1917104 derafsh 10.ogg}} '''Derafsh:''' It's Maddah from the cafe over there. You know, the fellow who spends all day telling "The Legend of Antara."
:{{A|vo frzcop001 1917104 derafsh 11.ogg}} '''Derafsh:''' Since that's also a very old story, maybe he knows a thing or two about that, uh... Tales of... uh, whatever it's called.
:{{A|vo frzcop001 1917104 collei 04.ogg}} '''Collei:''' Then let's go ask around at the cafe... Um, Madam Faruzan?
:{{A|vo frzcop001 1917104 faruzan 19.ogg}} '''Faruzan:''' ...Oh, yes... Let's go.

;(Talk to Derafsh again, optional)
:{{A|vo frzcop001 1917105 derafsh 01.ogg}} '''Derafsh:''' Anyway, is there anything else here that has caught your eye? As long as the price is reasonable, I can give you this book as a bonus!

;(Continue to [[#Being a Classic Sure is Tough!|Being a Classic Sure is Tough!]])
{{Dialogue End}}

===Being a Classic Sure is Tough!===
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Use [[Nahida]]'s [[All Schemes to Know]] on Maddah, optional)
:{{A|vo frzcop001 1917301 maddah 01.ogg}} '''Maddah:''' (That book I saw earlier... Ah, what a shame.)

;(Go to Puspa Café and talk to Maddah)
:{{A|vo frzcop001 1917105 maddah 01.ogg}} '''Maddah:''' *sigh* Another day, another empty room...
:{{A|vo frzcop001 1917105 collei 01.ogg}} '''Collei:''' Excuse me, but are you Maddah?
:{{A|vo frzcop001 1917105 maddah 02.ogg}} '''Maddah:''' Yes. Are you here to listen to my story?
:{{A|vo frzcop001 1917105 collei 02.ogg}} '''Collei:''' Uh, well, we actually came to ask about something else.
:{{A|vo frzcop001 1917105 maddah 03.ogg}} '''Maddah:''' *sigh* I see...
:{{A|vo frzcop001 1917105 collei 03.ogg}} '''Collei:''' S—Sorry...
:{{A|vo frzcop001 1917105 maddah 04.ogg}} '''Maddah:''' It's fine. I'm used to it, more or less. So, how can this terribly unpopular storyteller help you?
:{{A|vo frzcop001 1917105 faruzan 01.ogg}} '''Faruzan:''' Do you know about "Tales of Shahryar"?
:{{A|vo frzcop001 1917105 maddah 05.ogg}} '''Maddah:''' Huh? "Tales of Shahryar"? Why, I can barely remember the last time anyone talked about it.
:{{A|vo frzcop001 1917105 maddah 06.ogg}} '''Maddah:''' My master always talked about how incredibly popular that book used to be. However, I tried reciting a few chapters of it at the cafe, and I found that it's even less popular than "The Legend of Antara"...
:{{A|vo frzcop001 1917105 faruzan 02.ogg}} '''Faruzan:''' Your master?
:{{A|vo frzcop001 1917105 maddah 07.ogg}} '''Maddah:''' Yes, the one who taught me how to be a storyteller. He said that "Tales of Shahryar" was written by his master's master's master.
:{{A|vo frzcop001 1917105 maddah 08.ogg}} '''Maddah:''' He also said that this great-great-grandmaster was an Akademiya researcher, and that even the sages liked the series!
:{{A|vo frzcop001 1917105 maddah 09.ogg}} '''Maddah:''' He wrote four volumes back then, and the reviews just got better and better! You couldn't find a single person in Sumeru who hadn't read his books.
:{{A|vo frzcop001 1917105 faruzan 03.ogg}} '''Faruzan:''' And then? What happened next? Why doesn't anyone know about "Tales of Shahryar" now?
:{{A|vo frzcop001 1917105 maddah 10.ogg}} '''Maddah:''' Oh, it's hard to tell when it comes to trends. One day, everyone likes stories like that, and the next day, their tastes change completely.

:{{A|vo frzcop001 1917105 maddah 12.ogg}} '''Maddah:''' To tap into popular trends, he added a lot of tropes. Then, starting from the fifth volume, the reviews started to go downhill.

:{{A|vo frzcop001 1917105 maddah 13.ogg}} '''Maddah:''' In the end? There's no ending. The great-great-grandmaster tried to write a few more volumes, following whatever trends were popular at the time, but the trends kept changing right as he published his books.

:{{A|vo frzcop001 1917105 maddah 16.ogg}} '''Maddah:''' Anyway, my master probably exaggerated. How could a work possibly have been that popular?
:{{A|vo frzcop001 1917105 maddah 17.ogg}} '''Maddah:''' The only tangible thing my great-great-grandmaster left is the original draft of "Legend of Antara."
:{{A|vo frzcop001 1917105 maddah 18.ogg}} '''Maddah:''' He also left behind many theses from his research phase. When my master talked about "Legend of Antara," he'd even quote from those theses.
:{{A|vo frzcop001 1917105 maddah 19.ogg}} '''Maddah:''' My master is a much better storyteller than me. Even when we're telling the same story about Antara, he's always able to draw in a huge crowd!
:{{A|vo frzcop001 1917105 maddah 20.ogg}} '''Maddah:''' But even he won't recite "Tales of Shahryar" due to its ever-changing writing style and its lack of an ending.
:{{A|vo frzcop001 1917105 faruzan 06.ogg}} '''Faruzan:''' So Antara's story is the one that lasted through the years...
:{{A|vo frzcop001 1917105 maddah 21.ogg}} '''Maddah:''' Well, not even sages can definitively ascertain the quality of something like a story. In the end, only time can separate the classics from the fads.
:{{A|vo frzcop001 1917105 faruzan 07.ogg}} '''Faruzan:''' Only time...?
:{{A|vo frzcop001 1917105 collei 04.ogg}} '''Collei:''' Madam Faruzan...?
:{{A|vo frzcop001 1917105 faruzan 08.ogg}} '''Faruzan:''' It's been a hundred years... Perhaps some things I once believed to be great aren't so after all.
:{{DIcon}} You know, I think...
::{{DIcon}} The story's decline might not have been due to changing trends...
::{{DIcon}} It doesn't matter if it's a classic or a fad. What matters is that you like it.
:{{DIcon}} You don't have to worry about that.
::{{DIcon}} The story's decline might not have been due to changing trends...
::{{DIcon}} It doesn't matter if it's a classic or a fad. What matters is that you like it.
:{{A|vo frzcop001 1917105 collei 05.ogg}} '''Collei:''' Y—Yeah! Master helped me find a lot of famous books at first, but in the end, I realized that I couldn't get into them...
:{{A|vo frzcop001 1917105 collei 06.ogg}} '''Collei:''' No matter how good those stories are, I can't improve my skills if I can't bring myself to read them in the first place. I think the best books for me are the ones I like!
:{{DIcon}} The problem here is not actually about improving your reading skills...
:{{DIcon}} ...But I suppose the principle is the same.
:{{A|vo frzcop001 1917105 faruzan 09.ogg}} '''Faruzan:''' ...Indeed.
:{{A|vo frzcop001 1917105 faruzan 10.ogg}} '''Faruzan:''' That is true. Readers' interests and trends of a time are not things that are so easily predicted.
:{{A|vo frzcop001 1917105 faruzan 11.ogg}} '''Faruzan:''' What was popular a hundred years ago could be completely forgotten in modern times. And yet a hundred years, as far as history is concerned, is but a blink of an eye.
:{{A|vo frzcop001 1917105 faruzan 12.ogg}} '''Faruzan:''' If "Tales of Shahryar" hadn't chased after trends and instead stuck to its original style from start to finish...

:{{DIcon}} You should think about your income first.
:{{A|vo frzcop001 1917105 faruzan 14.ogg}} '''Faruzan:''' Hah, how unseemly. I almost got carried away because of a single book. Well then, we should get back to the matter of our teaching material... It looks like we can't use "Tales of Shahryar" now.

:{{A|vo frzcop001 1917105 collei 08.ogg}} '''Collei:''' Um... Yes, but I don't really—
:{{A|vo frzcop001 1917105 faruzan 17.ogg}} '''Faruzan:''' Then we'll use that book as our teaching material. Now that I think about it, using a book that you like is the most suitable choice for teaching you how to read.

:{{A|vo frzcop001 1917105 faruzan 19.ogg}} '''Faruzan:''' My, it sounds like you've dealt with the Akademiya before! Let's go with that.
:{{A|vo frzcop001 1917105 faruzan 20.ogg}} '''Faruzan:''' Now then, let's return to the book vendor in a bit and buy the latest volume of this "Onibudou" for Collei.
:{{A|vo frzcop001 1917105 faruzan 21.ogg}} '''Faruzan:''' Ah, but if I wish to use it as teaching material, I have to read it first.

:{{A|vo frzcop001 1917105 faruzan 23.ogg}} '''Faruzan:''' Such things as "Even if it reminds me of my dark history, I still can't help but be drawn in by the story," and "The author has written all the things that I only dare whisper into a tree hollow!"...
:{{A|vo frzcop001 1917105 faruzan 24.ogg}} '''Faruzan:''' Why do people use "dark history" to refer to awkward or embarrassing memories? Is this some slang that was invented in the last century?
:{{A|vo frzcop001 1917105 faruzan 25.ogg}} '''Faruzan:''' If one of our learning objectives was researching linguistic changes over the past hundred years, it might make it easier to get these books approved as teaching material.
:{{A|vo frzcop001 1917105 maddah 24.ogg}} '''Maddah:''' Oh, I can tell you what that's all about! Apparently, in their youth, some people used to imagine themselves as someone "burdened by fate," "fighting against the world," et cetera.
:{{A|vo frzcop001 1917105 maddah 25.ogg}} '''Maddah:''' But as they grew older, they started to become embarrassed by such memories. Some would write those fantasies into novels, while others would entrust such tales to tree hollows...
:{{A|vo frzcop001 1917105 collei 10.ogg}} '''Collei:''' M—Maddah! You know, I suddenly have the urge to hear a story about Antara!
:{{A|vo frzcop001 1917105 faruzan 26.ogg}} '''Faruzan:''' Huh? Why so suddenly?
:{{DIcon}} I think we can ignore the whole dark history thing, just for now...
:{{DIcon}} It's good to reminisce on an old tale in a while.
:{{A|vo frzcop001 1917105 maddah 26.ogg}} '''Maddah:''' Heh, I knew it — there will always be people who love the golden oldies! Ahem. Now, let me tell you all about the ancient hero, Antara...

:{{A|vo sllq002 9 chimne 04.ogg}} '''Simone:''' How can two completely different species possibly coexist?
:;(The passersby leave)
:{{A|vo sllq002 9 calore 09.ogg}} '''Carole:''' ...
:{{A|vo sllq002 9 vautrin 04.ogg}} '''Vautrin:''' You heard that?
:{{A|vo sllq002 9 calore 10.ogg}} '''Carole:''' Yeah.
:{{A|vo sllq002 9 calore 11.ogg}} '''Carole:''' I don't understand... Why won't anyone believe us?
:{{A|vo sllq002 9 vautrin 05.ogg}} '''Vautrin:''' There have been rumors saying that you were born from calamity... and that you inherently bring danger to those around you.
:{{A|vo sllq002 9 vautrin 06.ogg}} '''Vautrin:''' There are countless negative rumors about you floating around in Fontaine. It's near impossible for you to become a part of this society... best if you give up before it's too late.
:{{A|vo sllq002 9 calore 12.ogg}} '''Carole:''' Monsieur Neuvillette said that we needed to put both time and effort in. I don't know how long it'll take, but I can at least try making my best effort.
:{{A|vo sllq002 9 calore 13.ogg}} '''Carole:''' I still want to try a little harder. Thank you for bailing me out earlier.
:{{A|vo sllq002 9 vautrin 07.ogg}} '''Vautrin:''' *sigh*
:{{A|vo sllq002 9 calore 14.ogg}} '''Carole:''' Okay, I won't be taking any more of your time. I painted a lot of flyers last night, so I have to stay and hand them out to everyone...
:{{A|vo sllq002 9 vautrin 08.ogg}} '''Vautrin:''' Give them to me.
:{{A|vo sllq002 9 calore 15.ogg}} '''Carole:''' Y—You're not gonna take them away... right?
:{{A|vo sllq002 9 vautrin 09.ogg}} '''Vautrin:''' We'll hand them out together. The faster we get this done, the sooner we can head back.
:;(They fade away)

;(Approach Neuvillette, Carole, and Vautrin)
:{{A|vo sllq002 10 calore 01.ogg}} '''Carole:''' Monsieur Neuvillette, what's this?
:{{A|vo sllq002 10 neuvillette 01.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' Medals of Peace, awarded to you and Vautrin.
:{{A|vo sllq002 10 neuvillette 02.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' Thank you for your continuous dedication in the past five years. You've taken one small step forward in helping Melusines gain the trust of humans.
:{{A|vo sllq002 10 vautrin 01.ogg}} '''Vautrin:''' I think I'll pass...
:{{A|vo sllq002 10 calore 02.ogg}} '''Carole:''' Hey, don't say that. We wouldn't have made it this far without you!
:{{A|vo sllq002 10 calore 03.ogg}} '''Carole:''' It won't be long before Melusines begin living peacefully with the humans... Just the thought of it makes me happy.
:{{A|vo sllq002 10 vautrin 02.ogg}} '''Vautrin:''' Don't keep your hopes up. We've barely scratched the surface. There's still a long way to go before that dream of yours comes true.
:{{A|vo sllq002 10 calore 04.ogg}} '''Carole:''' Ugh, you blockhead! Don't ruin the mood!
:{{A|vo sllq002 10 neuvillette 03.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' Vautrin brings up a good point. The trust humans have placed in you is still very fragile. Any small incident could undermine the hard work you've put in.
:{{A|vo sllq002 10 neuvillette 04.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' Please be on your guard for the next few days.
:{{A|vo sllq002 10 vautrin 03.ogg}} '''Vautrin:''' Yes, Sir.
:{{A|vo sllq002 10 calore 05.ogg}} '''Carole:''' ...Okay, got it.
:;(They fade away)
:{{Color|menu|Two people are conspiring not far away.}}
:{{A|vo sllq002 10 thibert 01.ogg}} '''Thibert:''' Medal of Peace? Ha, "peace" isn't going to give us back what's rightfully ours.
:{{A|vo sllq002 10 suavegothe 01.ogg}} '''Suavegothe:''' Are you sure we should do this? We're no match for Neuvillette, even with all our powers combined. What if...
:{{A|vo sllq002 10 thibert 02.ogg}} '''Thibert:''' Nah, not gonna happen. As long as he remains in his position, there's no chance he'd take us out personally.
:{{A|vo sllq002 10 thibert 03.ogg}} '''Thibert:''' There are rules even he must comply with in the political sphere... unless he wants to become an enemy of Fontaine.
:{{A|vo sllq002 10 thibert 04.ogg}} '''Thibert:''' So quit worrying and just go ahead with it. I've already planned out the murder. Once we lay the blame on the Melusines, as the person who brought them to the Court of Fontaine, Neuvillette will be left with no excuse.
:{{A|vo sllq002 10 suavegothe 02.ogg}} '''Suavegothe:''' I guess you're right. Ugh, if he'd just left things the way they were, it never would've had to come to this... But he's forced our hand. Time to teach him a lesson.
:;(They fade away)

:{{Color|menu|The conspirators successfully incite the people...}}
;(Approach Thibert and the crowd around him)
:{{A|vo sllq002 11 thibert 01.ogg}} '''Thibert:''' Turn the murderer in!
:;(They fade away)

;(Approach Suavegothe, the two people behind her, and the Melusine)
:{{A|vo sllq002 11 suavegothe 01.ogg}} '''Suavegothe:''' Melusines can't be trusted! That goes for Neuvillette too!
:;(They fade away)

;(Approach Clotaire, the two people beside her, and the Melusine)
:{{A|vo sllq002 11 clotaire 01.ogg}} '''Clotaire:''' Peaceful coexistence? What a joke. Get out of the Court of Fontaine and don't ever come back!
:;(They fade away)

;(Approach Vautrin and Rastignac)
:{{A|vo sllq002 12 rastignac 01.ogg}} '''Rastignac:''' The results of the investigation are in, Captain Vautrin.
:{{A|vo sllq002 12 vautrin 01.ogg}} '''Vautrin:''' Go on.
:{{A|vo sllq002 12 rastignac 02.ogg}} '''Rastignac:''' There is no direct evidence, but reasonable inference indicates that the ones controlling the situation are supporters of the old regime whose interests have been undermined by the reform.
:{{A|vo sllq002 12 rastignac 03.ogg}} '''Rastignac:''' They tricked Miss Carole into going to the crime scene and pressed charges against her. After that, they incited panic among the people in order to make Monsieur Neuvillette confess to his mistakes and yield up power.
:{{A|vo sllq002 12 rastignac 04.ogg}} '''Rastignac:''' The Gardes were stopped by the enraged mob and couldn't intervene in time. Miss Carole... chose to sacrifice herself to pacify the situation.
:{{A|vo sllq002 12 vautrin 02.ogg}} '''Vautrin:''' ...
:{{A|vo sllq002 12 vautrin 03.ogg}} '''Vautrin:''' And she called ME a blockhead...!
:{{A|vo sllq002 12 vautrin 04.ogg}} '''Vautrin:''' A little investigation would've cleared things up! Why didn't she wait until we'd established the truth? She didn't have to prove her innocence like that...
:{{A|vo sllq002 12 rastignac 05.ogg}} '''Rastignac:''' The situation had rapidly escalated to a physical altercation between infuriated citizens and the Gardes. Miss Carole might've thought there was no better plan...
:{{A|vo sllq002 12 vautrin 05.ogg}} '''Vautrin:''' *sigh* That is indeed something she'd do.
:{{A|vo sllq002 12 rastignac 06.ogg}} '''Rastignac:''' Captain Vautrin, should I present these results to Monsieur Neuvillette right away?
:{{A|vo sllq002 12 vautrin 06.ogg}} '''Vautrin:''' There's no need. Notify the Gardes to restrict public access to all information.
:{{A|vo sllq002 12 rastignac 07.ogg}} '''Rastignac:''' Restrict access to... Wait, are you planning to—
:{{A|vo sllq002 12 vautrin 07.ogg}} '''Vautrin:''' There's something I've never told Carole — I had a little sister named Illaria who passed away when I was very young.
:{{A|vo sllq002 12 vautrin 08.ogg}} '''Vautrin:''' She's just like Carole in every possible way. Innocent, kind... always believing the best of people. People like her are the most vulnerable to deception and betrayal.
:{{A|vo sllq002 12 vautrin 09.ogg}} '''Vautrin:''' From the moment I met Carole, I knew that she'd be easily manipulated by others. I kept a cold demeanor and tried lecturing her into giving up...
:{{A|vo sllq002 12 rastignac 08.ogg}} '''Rastignac:''' ...Looks like she was unfazed by that.
:{{A|vo sllq002 12 vautrin 10.ogg}} '''Vautrin:''' Yes. In fact, some of her spirit must've rubbed off on me instead... because I too began working towards that pie-in-the-sky dream of hers.
:{{A|vo sllq002 12 vautrin 11.ogg}} '''Vautrin:''' I should've known. Those cowards don't have the guts to confront Neuvillette — they even avoided causing trouble for me... They were after Carole all along.
:{{A|vo sllq002 12 vautrin 12.ogg}} '''Vautrin:''' Can you understand how I feel? Right now, there's only one thought on my mind: Only through bloodshed can their debt be repaid.
:{{A|vo sllq002 12 rastignac 09.ogg}} '''Rastignac:''' I understand, but I'm certain Monsieur Neuvillette wouldn't accept that as a solution.
:{{A|vo sllq002 12 vautrin 13.ogg}} '''Vautrin:''' That's exactly why we need to keep this a secret. Give me the list of suspects. What happens after this has nothing to do with any of you.
:{{A|vo sllq002 12 vautrin 14.ogg}} '''Vautrin:''' I will take responsibility for everything.

;(Enter the Opera House)
:{{A|vo sllq002 13 baderico 01.ogg}} '''Baderico:''' Did you know? They're hearing a major case today, and the criminal is Captain Vautrin of the Special Security and Surveillance Patrol!
:{{A|vo sllq002 13 baderico 02.ogg}} '''Baderico:''' Apparently, he resorted to personal measures to seek revenge for Carole and settled the score with the group that framed his friend... Hey, why aren't you saying anything?
:{{A|vo sllq002 13 lothaire 01.ogg}} '''Lothaire:''' I'm thinking... We should try our best to bail him out when the trial commences.
:{{A|vo sllq002 13 baderico 03.ogg}} '''Baderico:''' Bail him out? Why?
:{{A|vo sllq002 13 lothaire 02.ogg}} '''Lothaire:''' Shh, keep it down. Haven't you realized? Both Vautrin and Carole are Neuvillette's most trusted subordinates. After everything that happened to Carole, Neuvillette's guaranteed to do everything he can to keep Vautrin around.
:{{A|vo sllq002 13 lothaire 03.ogg}} '''Lothaire:''' Besides, now that the old regime has been uprooted, Neuvillette's status is secure as can be. As long as we redirect public opinion, Neuvillette will be able to give Vautrin a reprieve. The benefits are endless...
:{{Black Screen|A raucous commotion gradually began to rise in the opera house...}}
:{{A|vo sllq002 13 baderico 04.ogg}} '''Baderico:''' Vautrin sought vengeance for his friend for a valid cause. This represents the justice he upholds!
:{{A|vo sllq002 13 baderico 05.ogg}} '''Baderico:''' Please think about it. If the same thing had happened to you, wouldn't you feel the same way as he did?
:{{A|vo sllq002 13 prume 01.ogg}} '''Prume:''' Yeah, that's right!
:{{A|vo sllq002 13 lothaire 04.ogg}} '''Lothaire:''' This whole thing started because of those despicable cowards who levied false accusations against Carole! How could Vautrin be declared guilty for seeking revenge?
:{{A|vo sllq002 13 vautrin 01.ogg}} '''Vautrin:''' Monsieur Neuvillette...
:{{A|vo sllq002 13 baderico 06.ogg}} '''Baderico:''' Mr. Vautrin is innocent!
:{{A|vo sllq002 13 together 01.ogg}} '''Audience:''' He's innocent!
:;(The scales of the Oratrice tip to the right)
:{{A|vo sllq002 13 neuvillette 01.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' Order.
:{{A|vo sllq002 13 neuvillette 02.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' ...
:{{A|vo sllq002 13 neuvillette 03.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' I acknowlege your arguments. Vautrin, your revenge could be seen as a form of justice.
:{{A|vo sllq002 13 neuvillette 04.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' I understand your decision. Which is why I cannot help but feel regret... and even grief about the judgment I must now impose.
:{{A|vo sllq002 13 neuvillette 05.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' However, personal justice does not equate to justice as defined by the law. To execute your plan for revenge, you abused your authority and conducted informal executions. Your actions have thus violated the law.
:{{A|vo sllq002 13 neuvillette 06.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' Therefore, you will be declared... guilty.
:{{A|vo sllq002 13 baderico 07.ogg}} '''Baderico:''' What!?
:{{A|vo sllq002 13 lothaire 05.ogg}} '''Lothaire:''' That can't be... Monsieur Neuvillette, please give this a little more thought. He has done so much for Fontaine!
:{{A|vo sllq002 13 neuvillette 07.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' Vautrin... my friend. Is there anything else you want to say?
:{{A|vo sllq002 13 vautrin 02.ogg}} '''Vautrin:''' Neuvillette...
:{{A|vo sllq002 13 vautrin 03.ogg}} '''Vautrin:''' What have I done to deserve this? I've closely followed every one of your orders! Can't you see? Everyone in this room believes that I'm innocent... why can't you just let me off!?
:{{A|vo sllq002 13 vautrin 04.ogg}} '''Vautrin:''' Is this what justice means to you? Answer me, Neuvillette!!
:{{A|vo sllq002 13 neuvillette 08.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' ...Order.
:{{A|vo sllq002 13 neuvillette 09.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' Since there have been no further objections, the Oratrice will now deliver the final verdict regarding the charges against Mr. Vautrin.
:;(The lights on the Oratrice light up and the scales tip to the left)
:{{A|vo sllq002 13 neuvillette 10.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' According to the judgment of the Oratrice Mecanique d'Analyse Cardinale, Mr. Vautrin will be declared... guilty.
:{{Black Screen|{{A|vo sllq002 13 vautrin 05.ogg}} "Goodbye, Monsieur Neuvillette."}}
:{{Black Screen|{{A|vo sllq002 13 baderico 08.ogg}} "This all happened because of Carole's naive ideas..."}}
:{{Black Screen|{{A|vo sllq002 13 lothaire 06.ogg}} "How can different species peacefully coexist anyway?"}}
:;(In the present)<!--screen transition-->
:{{A|vo sllq002 14 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hey, stop spacing out!
:{{A|vo sllq002 14 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' {{Traveler}}, what's wrong? Are you not feeling well?
:{{DIcon}} What was that...
:{{A|vo sllq002 14 neuvillette 01.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' Apologies, it seems like my memories got the better of me.
:{{A|vo sllq002 14 neuvillette 02.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' I tried my best to suppress the power of Hydro within myself, but it seems like it still caused the emotions within the Fountain of Lucine to boil over.
:{{A|vo sllq002 14 neuvillette 03.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' Due to my negligence, the overflow of emotions and memories must have affected you as well. Are you alright?
:{{DIcon}} I'm fine.
:{{A|vo sllq002 14 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wow! The Hydro Dragon is more powerful than Paimon thought...
:{{A|vo sllq002 14 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Anyway, the last time we came here, {{Traveler}} only heard voices from the Fountain of Lucine... No "emotions boiling over" or anything.
:{{A|vo sllq002 14 neuvillette 04.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' It is as you said. This might be because I'm different.
:{{A|vo sllq002 14 neuvillette 05.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' It is not only the Fountain. I can sense emotions from all waters in Fontaine. Rivers, lakes... and even the rain.
:{{A|vo sllq002 14 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' That sounds awesome!
:{{A|vo sllq002 14 neuvillette 06.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' But I rarely ever do anything like this. Emotions carried by water are always chaotic and disconnected. As an outsider, having my mind occupied with irrelevant memories isn't exactly a pleasant experience.
:{{DIcon}} The memories I saw were related to you.
:{{A|vo sllq002 14 neuvillette 07.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' Which ones?
:{{DIcon}} From when you brought Carole to the Court of Fontaine...
:{{DIcon}} To when you declared Vautrin guilty.
:{{A|vo sllq002 14 neuvillette 08.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' ...
:{{A|vo sllq002 14 neuvillette 09.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' It's fine. I prefer not to speak of those memories, but that does not mean I am deliberately hiding them.
:{{A|vo sllq002 14 neuvillette 10.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' It was a coincidence, but perhaps it is a good thing that you saw everything in that form.
:{{A|vo sllq002 14 neuvillette 11.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' You should now understand why I believe there to be a conspiracy behind all this... These two cases are much too similar. I felt like I needed to do something.
:{{A|vo sllq002 14 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Uhh, Paimon's starting to lose track of what you're saying...
:{{A|vo sllq002 14 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Don't leave Paimon out of the conversation! Paimon wants to help too!
:{{A|vo sllq002 14 neuvillette 12.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' Then let us get back to the point. While I was investigating the Fountain, I discovered something strange.
:{{A|vo sllq002 14 neuvillette 13.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' I did not sense too much hatred towards me within its accumulated emotions.
:{{A|vo sllq002 14 neuvillette 14.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' However, I did find some resentment directed towards [[Kiara]]. If I remember correctly, it seemed to be related to a smuggling case.
:{{A|vo sllq002 14 neuvillette 15.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' I don't know what caused this to happen, but it seems like there won't be a shortcut to finding the organization that may be pulling the strings here.
:{{A|vo sllq002 14 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh! Didn't we read about that in one of those documents?
:{{A|vo sllq002 14 neuvillette 16.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' You've read about it? In that case, the resentment should've come from that incident—
:{{Color|menu|Navia walks over from close by.}}
:{{A|vo sllq002 14 navia 01.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Huh, what are you doing here? I was just about to look for you at the Palais Mermonia.
:{{A|vo sllq002 14 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Navia! Nice to see you again! Is there something we can help with?
:{{A|vo sllq002 14 navia 02.ogg}} '''Navia:''' I've heard some things... But I'm not purposely asking around or anything, don't worry!
:{{A|vo sllq002 14 navia 03.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Rumors are abroad that someone's scheming against Melusines, and that you're investigating the case.
:{{A|vo sllq002 14 navia 04.ogg}} '''Navia:''' So I told the Spina di Rosula to keep an eye out for leads. We've had unfamiliar faces showing themselves at the Fleuve Cendre lately. Maybe you'll find the suspects among them.
:{{A|vo sllq002 14 neuvillette 17.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' Thank you.
:{{A|vo sllq002 14 neuvillette 18.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' ...Where did you hear about all this?
:{{A|vo sllq002 14 navia 05.ogg}} '''Navia:''' The Chief Justice out on investigation, accompanied by {{Traveler}} from afar... No matter how you conceal your whereabouts, there will be countless eyes watching you.
:{{A|vo sllq002 14 navia 06.ogg}} '''Navia:''' You talked to Kiara, but didn't ask her to keep things secret. People curious to know asked around for information. Then, it was only a matter of time before word of the threatening letter spread all across Fontaine.
:{{A|vo sllq002 14 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So that's what Charlotte meant...
:{{A|vo sllq002 14 neuvillette 19.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' Indeed. I did not expect that this could be kept hidden for too long, but the rumors still spread faster than I imagined.
:{{A|vo sllq002 14 navia 07.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Hmm... You know, it could be because... you attract more attention than you think.
:{{A|vo sllq002 14 navia 08.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Anyway, any progress with the investigation?
:{{A|vo sllq002 14 neuvillette 20.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' The suspects who threatened Kiara might have to do with a certain smuggling case, but it is still uncertain if there is, in fact, another party behind all this.
:{{A|vo sllq002 14 neuvillette 21.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' We are planning to return to the Palais Mermonia to revisit some details and identify the senders of that threatening letter.
:{{A|vo sllq002 14 navia 09.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Alright, then I'll round up the Spina di Rosula and follow up on their progress.
:{{A|vo sllq002 14 navia 10.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Wait for my word. Ta-ta!
:{{A|vo sllq002 14 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Neuvillette, do you think there will be any problems now that the word is out?
:{{A|vo sllq002 14 neuvillette 22.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' I have already considered that possibility, and I do not think there will be any. As a matter of fact, once the word gets out, no one would dare to harm Kiara in broad daylight.
:{{A|vo sllq002 14 neuvillette 23.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' What is more important is how the case is perceived by the public. Four hundred years ago, they chose to side with the old regime and direct their resentment towards the Melusines.
:{{A|vo sllq002 14 neuvillette 24.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' ...I hope the same won't happen again. Let us head back to the Palais.
:{{Color|menu|You are walking along the street.}}
:{{A|vo sllq002 14 paimon 12.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Strange... What are these people doing out on the streets so late at night?
:{{A|vo sllq002 14 paimon 13.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Did something happen? Let's take a look around!
:{{Color|menu|Someone is speaking loudly nearby. You take a closer look.}}
:{{A|vo sllq002 14 corneille 01.ogg}} '''Corneille:''' Have you heard? Someone's plotting against a Melusine! This is one hundred percent the truth — even the Chief Justice is investigating in person!
:{{A|vo sllq002 14 serurier 01.ogg}} '''Serrurier:''' WHAT? That's it! Who's been threatening Melusines? Show yourself!
:{{A|vo sllq002 14 herbier 01.ogg}} '''Herbier:''' Our enemies are lurking in the shadows and won't easily reveal themselves, but no amount of hiding will keep us from finding them!
:{{A|vo sllq002 14 corneille 02.ogg}} '''Corneille:''' That's exactly what I wanted to say! The Gardes have already begun to take action... We can't just stand by and watch.
:{{A|vo sllq002 14 corneille 03.ogg}} '''Corneille:''' Think about how much we owe them! Now that they're in danger, how can we sit back and do nothing?
:{{A|vo sllq002 14 herbier 02.ogg}} '''Herbier:''' Everyone, please stay alert to your surroundings from now on. If you see any suspicious persons, report them to the Gardes immediately.
:{{Color|menu|You continue forward, and there are two Gardes behind a Melusine.}}
:{{A|vo sllq002 14 veleda 01.ogg}} '''Veleda:''' It feels like you've been following me this whole time. Did something happen?
:{{A|vo sllq002 14 deliphine 01.ogg}} '''Delphine:''' We were informed that...
:{{A|vo sllq002 14 lowrey 01.ogg}} '''Lori:''' Ahem! Nope, we just finished our shifts and happened to be strolling by.
:{{A|vo sllq002 14 veleda 02.ogg}} '''Veleda:''' Have you had dinner yet? Why don't we check out the new items at the dessert shop together?
:{{A|vo sllq002 14 deliphine 02.ogg}} '''Delphine:''' This isn't a good time to be out and about.
:{{Color|menu|At this time, you hear the loud grumble of a hungry stomach.}}
:{{A|vo sllq002 14 lowrey 02.ogg}} '''Lori:''' C'mon, don't act tough. I bet you're hungry too.
:{{A|vo sllq002 14 deliphine 03.ogg}} '''Delphine:''' *sigh* Alright, let's go buy a cake or something.
:{{A|vo sllq002 14 veleda 03.ogg}} '''Veleda:''' You shouldn't ever skip meals, especially if you have another shift scheduled for later.
:{{Color|menu|You continue forward. Two Gardes are speaking by the wall.}}
:{{A|vo sllq002 14 cooper 01.ogg}} '''Cooper:''' I heard even Neuvillette's keeping an eye on the situation. Haha, this is the perfect chance to get promoted. We gotta make sure we give it all we've got!
:{{A|vo sllq002 14 burnett 01.ogg}} '''Bruno:''' Seriously? Were you planning to shirk your duties if Neuvillette wasn't involved?
:{{A|vo sllq002 14 cooper 02.ogg}} '''Cooper:''' Relax, I was just playing. We've worked together for years now. If something happened to them, I'd be haunted by regret for the rest of my life.
:{{A|vo sllq002 14 burnett 02.ogg}} '''Bruno:''' That's more like it. We should stand guard until the criminal has been caught.
:{{Color|menu|The people on the streets are still carrying on a spirited discussion.}}
:{{A|vo sllq002 14 serurier 02.ogg}} '''Serrurier:''' Come and fight me instead, you cowards!
:{{A|vo sllq002 14 corneille 04.ogg}} '''Corneille:''' Have you heard? Even the Special Patrol came to help...

:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913301 ningguang 14.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' Thank you for the repair, Xingxi. This is a great help.
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913301 xingxi 04.ogg}} '''Xingxi:''' Oh, don't mention it. It's always a pleasure, Lady Ningguang.
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913301 ningguang 15.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' Let's go and meet them.

:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913302 zhizhi 01.ogg}} '''Zhizhi:''' Aunty Ningguang!
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913302 littlelong 01.ogg}} '''Little Long:''' Hi, Aunty Ningguang!

:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913302 ningguang 04.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' It turned out that they delivered the goods and thoroughly enjoyed themselves while they were at it. So, it was a win-win.

:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913302 zhizhi 02.ogg}} '''Zhizhi:''' But... you didn't do your homework, did you...

:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913302 zhizhi 03.ogg}} '''Zhizhi:''' You still gotta try. Like teacher says, Liyue Harbor is in a new age now, and we've got a really important part to play.

:{{DIcon}} I didn't know it would have such a profound impact.
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913302 ningguang 07.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' Well, this is a dramatic change, unique in all of the millennia of Liyue's history. Everyone is eager to do their part and make their mark in the age of humanity.
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913302 ningguang 08.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' What about you, Nannan? You haven't said anything yet, and you're looking a little unhappy.

:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913302 littlelong 04.ogg}} '''Little Long:''' Oh yeah, I just remembered! A load of really big boats came into the harbor the day before yesterday!
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913302 zhizhi 04.ogg}} '''Zhizhi:''' Yeah, that's right! All the merchants were there and it was really noisy, and then the people on the boat started unloading all these crates. There was a salty, kinda fishy smell in the air.
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913302 ningguang 09.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' Oh, I see. That'll be the fishing boats coming back from the open ocean. How much cargo were they carrying? Remember, I taught you how you can tell.

:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913302 ningguang 10.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' My goodness! Well, it sounds like they made quite a big catch.

:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913302 ningguang 11.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' The heavier the boat, the lower the hull sits in the water. So you can tell how heavily loaded a vessel is from the height of the waterline.
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913302 ningguang 12.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' How deep a fully loaded vessel will sit in the water varies from ship to ship. But it's something you can tell from experience, at least for the kinds of vessels you see regularly.
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913302 littlelong 06.ogg}} '''Little Long:''' Hee-hee, since Aunty Ningguang taught me how to do it, I can tell with just one look!
:{{DIcon}} Very clever!
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913302 nannan 02.ogg}} '''Nannan:''' Um, a few days ago, I heard some people saying that a big merchant from Fontaine is coming soon to buy Luminescent Spines.
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913302 nannan 03.ogg}} '''Nannan:''' They said that when they get here... the price will go up a lot.
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913302 ningguang 13.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' Oh, really?

:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913302 nannan 05.ogg}} '''Nannan:''' Um... um, I don't remember that either. Sorry...

:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913302 ningguang 16.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' It's okay, don't be upset. Actually, I brought you a little something to cheer you up. How about that, hmm?

:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913302 ningguang 17.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' Of course I did. If I make you a promise, I will always keep it.
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913302 nannan 07.ogg}} '''Nannan:''' Thank you, Aunty Ningguang. Thank you so much...
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913302 ningguang 18.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' It was just a small favor, really. Nothing to get overexcited about.
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913302 nannan 08.ogg}} '''Nannan:''' But... but they said you'd be too busy to remember about a boring old comb.
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913302 ningguang 19.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' "They"?
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913302 nannan 09.ogg}} '''Nannan:''' Uh oh...
:{{DIcon}} (It looks like there's a story here.)
:{{DIcon}} (No wonder she was fumbling her words.)

:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913302 nannan 13.ogg}} '''Nannan:''' Then they bought me a new comb, and, and I...
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913302 nannan 14.ogg}} '''Nannan:''' I'm sorry! I'll give them the comb back right away! No comb is better than the one you helped get fixed for me!
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913302 ningguang 21.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' I know how much it means to you. It was a gift from your mom before she left Liyue Harbor, wasn't it?
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913302 nannan 15.ogg}} '''Nannan:''' Yep, it was! I'll be extra careful with it from now on. When mom gets back, she'll be so sad if she finds out I broke it...
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913302 ningguang 22.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' I must say, this is most intriguing...
:{{DIcon}} It looks like someone is trying to scam you.
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913302 ningguang 23.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' How about this: You tell me where those two people are, and I'll take the comb back to them for you. Sound good?
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913302 nannan 16.ogg}} '''Nannan:''' Okay... um, they're over at the docks. They said I should go and meet them when I've finished the mission...
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913302 ningguang 24.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' Alright then. Don't worry, it'll all be fine. I'll be right back.

:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913302 ningguang 25.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' Now now, this is a grown-up situation, okay? It's not fun and games anymore. And don't try and follow me.

:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913303 ningguang 02.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' You knew how important that comb was to Nannan, and you exploited that fact to emotionally manipulate her.
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913303 ningguang 03.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' You coached a child to lie, made her betray her own innocence and confuse her conscience. Do you not realize how contemptible that is?
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913303 oldke 04.ogg}} '''Lao Ke:''' I... Uh...
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913303 xu 02.ogg}} '''Big Xu:''' Sorry, Lady Ningguang! We... we never should have crossed you like this!
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913303 ningguang 04.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' That's not the point. Business is business, and at some point we're all trying to get the better of one another. So if all you'd done is fool me by feeding me false information, I'd make a loss and that would be the end of it.
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913303 ningguang 05.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' But you cannot put Mora above all else. You cannot go exploiting children for profit. Do you have any idea just how much damage that will cause?
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913303 oldke 05.ogg}} '''Lao Ke:''' It was hardly our first choice either... We were only acting out of necessity.
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913303 oldke 06.ogg}} '''Lao Ke:''' We've been business partners for years now. We've gotten by, I guess, but never had any opportunities to expand.
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913303 oldke 07.ogg}} '''Lao Ke:''' When we heard about the movement in the Luminescent Spine market, we thought to heck with it. Let's go all in on this one, see if we don't get lucky for once.
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913303 oldke 08.ogg}} '''Lao Ke:''' So we stocked up a huge stash of Luminescent Spines and watched as the price went up and up. We thought, this was gonna be it. We were gonna make our fortune.
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913303 xu 03.ogg}} '''Big Xu:''' But we waited and waited and this mystery merchant from Fontaine never came. More and more people started to suspect it was all a huge scam.
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913303 xu 04.ogg}} '''Big Xu:''' Suddenly, everyone with Luminescent Spines was running for the exit, selling as fast as they could. But we had so much inventory that no one was willing to buy it...
:{{DIcon}} And that's when you thought of Ningguang?
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913303 oldke 09.ogg}} '''Lao Ke:''' Well, yeah. As soon as Lady Ningguang makes a move, everyone follows her lead, and the price takes a steep hike...
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913303 oldke 10.ogg}} '''Lao Ke:''' If we don't sell the goods, we're both bankrupt. We're in debt up to our eyeballs! We just didn't have any other choices...
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913303 ningguang 06.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' To be brutally honest, "We took out a loan and made a speculative investment" is not a sob story.
:{{DIcon}} Your business analysis was correct.
:{{DIcon}} This supports your conclusion about the Luminescent Spine hype.
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913303 ningguang 07.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' But not everyone has the capability to make rational decisions.
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913303 ningguang 08.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' Greed, a lust for wealth, and impatience can all cloud your judgment.
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913303 ningguang 09.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' Do you now realize how dire the consequences of wild speculation can be?
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913303 oldke 11.ogg}} '''Lao Ke:''' A hundred percent. We've both barely slept in days.
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913303 oldke 12.ogg}} '''Lao Ke:''' We begged people to take our stock off our hands... They laughed at us, called us idiots, thought it was all hilarious...
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913303 xu 05.ogg}} '''Big Xu:''' We messed up. Completely and catastrophically messed up...
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913303 xu 06.ogg}} '''Big Xu:''' The savings we worked so hard our whole lives to build up, decimated just like that. All we want now is a chance to start over.
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913303 ningguang 10.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' Hmm... Well, I can take your Luminescent Spines off your hands. But we will need a detailed contract.
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913303 ningguang 11.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' The portion of what I pay that exceeds the average price of Luminescent Spines in the past, you will need to pay back to me by some means in our future business dealings.
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913303 oldke 13.ogg}} '''Lao Ke:''' Huh? But... but that means our profit is zero...
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913303 ningguang 12.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' Then you're free to find another willing buyer.
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913303 ningguang 13.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' But if you're seriously still insisting on turning a profit under these circumstances, I'm afraid you're beyond redemption.
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913303 xu 07.ogg}} '''Big Xu:''' Lady Ningguang is right. Let's swap the goods for cash and use it to pay off our debts, and be done with it. This is a lifeline, and we should be grateful for it. Forget about making money.
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913303 oldke 14.ogg}} '''Lao Ke:''' Yes, yes, you're right...
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913303 ningguang 14.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' I have no particular need for Luminescent Spines, but I'm quite sure I can uncover a market for it with a little research.
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913303 oldke 15.ogg}} '''Lao Ke:''' Okay, so, uh... shall we get this deal done now, or...?
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913303 ningguang 15.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' No need to hurry. Our deal is hardly the urgent matter here. Atoning for your transgressions is the main order of business.
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913303 ningguang 16.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' You took advantage of a child, and you are coming with me to make a full and unreserved apology.
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913303 ningguang 17.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' This is an opportunity for you to show remorse.
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913303 oldke 16.ogg}} '''Lao Ke:''' O—Okay...
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913303 ningguang 18.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' Come on, let's go back and see the children.
{{Dialogue End}}

:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913305 ningguang 06.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' For my part, I did my utmost to fulfill the duties of a responsible adult.
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913305 ningguang 07.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' I played games with them, but I also taught them observation skills, analytical skills, how to think critically. I never taught business, though.
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913305 ningguang 08.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' Now, they're much further ahead in their studies and far more mature than their peers. This has given them confidence in themselves.
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913305 ningguang 09.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' I think that this is beneficial to them.
:{{DIcon}} You are a lot like a teacher to them.

:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913305 ningguang 11.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' I never had the chance to receive a good education as a child. That's why I hope to teach these children myself. Hopefully I can pass on some of what I have learned.
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913305 ningguang 12.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' Someday, they may realize that not everything is a win-win deal, that deception and one-upmanship are facts of life. But there's nothing wrong with that.
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913305 ningguang 13.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' When that happens, they will be ready to face the world head-on and become exceptional businessmen and women. But until then, I am here to protect them.

:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913305 ningguang 15.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' I hope the name, Ningguang, will live on, but not as a person. As more of a symbol.
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913305 ningguang 16.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' If I can pass on everything I have learned, I can create a legacy that will live on long after I am gone.

:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913305 nannan 01.ogg}} '''Nannan:''' We're not gonna wait forever~!
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913305 ningguang 17.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' Coming!
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913305 ningguang 18.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' Come on, let's enjoy this while we can.

==Dialogue==
{{Quest Description|In order to learn the tricks of a professional mixologist, [[Diona]] decides to exchange pointers with Connor}}
===Exchanging Pointers===
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Talk to Diona in Dawn Winery)
:{{A|vo dancop001 1910701 connor 01.ogg}} '''Connor:''' Oh, you're here. Look, I've already prepared all the tools we need.
:{{A|vo dancop001 1910701 connor 02.ogg}} '''Connor:''' Sure, they're a little... basic, but they should do just fine. I've also prepared a top-shelf bottle of Dandelion Wine to use as a drink base.
:{{A|vo dancop001 1910701 connor 03.ogg}} '''Connor:''' Oh, I've also heard that you don't like to see people drink too much, am I right?
:{{A|vo dancop001 1910701 connor 04.ogg}} '''Connor:''' So today, we'll strictly just exchange techniques. There will be no talk of drinking, and even if we try the drinks, we'll just only have a little taste. How's that sound?
:{{A|vo dancop001 1910701 diona 01.ogg}} '''Diona:''' Fine, I suppose. These tools will suffice.
:{{DIcon}} How did you prepare so many things in advance?
:{{A|vo dancop001 1910701 connor 05.ogg}} '''Connor:''' Ah, heh... Well, we've always been hoping to invite Diona to our winery to instruct us on her techniques of mixing drinks.
:{{A|vo dancop001 1910701 connor 06.ogg}} '''Connor:''' Though the preparations have been made, we've just never had the chance...
:{{A|vo dancop001 1910701 connor 07.ogg}} '''Connor:''' So how could I not be fully prepared now that she's willing to come today!
:{{A|vo dancop001 1910701 connor 08.ogg}} '''Connor:''' Oh, and to keep things fair, we'll need an impartial judge...
:{{A|vo dancop001 1910701 diona 02a.ogg}}<!--{{A|vo dancop001 1910701 diona 02b.ogg}}--> '''Diona:''' Well, we have the Honorary Knight...
:{{A|vo dancop001 1910701 connor 09a.ogg}} {{A|vo dancop001 1910701 connor 09b.ogg}} '''Connor:''' Yes, but {{MC|m=he|f=she}} doesn't look...
:{{DIcon}} I don't look to be of drinking age yet. Yes, I know...
:{{A|vo dancop001 1910701 connor 10.ogg}} '''Connor:''' Haha, so honest and forthcoming, you are after all the Honorary Knight of the Knights of Favonius. What impressive discipline!
:{{A|vo dancop001 1910701 connor 11.ogg}} '''Connor:''' Hmm... then who could we find to be the judge?
:{{A|vo dancop001 1910701 elzer 01.ogg}} '''Elzer:''' Connor, there you are. I've been looking for you, what are you doing here?
:{{A|vo dancop001 1910701 connor 12.ogg}} '''Connor:''' Elzer, your timing couldn't be any more perfect. I'm about to have a little mixing competition with Diona here...
:{{A|vo dancop001 1910701 elzer 02.ogg}} '''Elzer:''' What! Really!? That's great! Would it be alright if I stayed to observe?
:{{A|vo dancop001 1910701 connor 13.ogg}} '''Connor:''' Actually, we're looking for a judge. Would you be free to help us out?
:{{A|vo dancop001 1910701 elzer 03.ogg}} '''Elzer:''' Haha, why I'd be delighted! It'd be an honor to have an opportunity to have a taste of Diona's craft.
:{{DIcon}} (What a... coincidence.)
:{{DIcon}} (These two have been planning this all along.)
:{{A|vo dancop001 1910701 diona 03.ogg}} '''Diona:''' What's that old booze sponge Elzer doing here? He doesn't think that I'm here to collaborate with them, does he?
:{{DIcon}} Collaborate with them?
:{{A|vo dancop001 1910701 diona 04.ogg}} '''Diona:''' Don't you know? Elzer used to always show up at the Cat's Tail.
:{{A|vo dancop001 1910701 diona 05.ogg}} '''Diona:''' Every time he came, he would always be sweet-talking me, trying to get me to work with the Dawn Winery to come up with some sort of new drink.
:{{A|vo dancop001 1910701 diona 06.ogg}} '''Diona:''' He needs to know that that'll never happen, not until I figure out how to make the most terrible drink in the world.
:{{A|vo dancop001 1910701 connor 14.ogg}} '''Connor:''' Uh, so then... Shall we begin Diona?
:{{A|vo dancop001 1910701 diona 07.ogg}} '''Diona:''' Sure, but like I said before, this is an exchange of techniques as bartenders. Anyone not involved should stay away.
:{{A|vo dancop001 1910701 elzer 04.ogg}} '''Elzer:''' What is that supposed to mean?
:{{A|vo dancop001 1910701 connor 15.ogg}} '''Connor:''' Um, Elzer... why don't you just take a break over there? We'll bring over the drinks once they're finished.
:{{A|vo dancop001 1910701 elzer 05.ogg}} '''Elzer:''' Wait, but I...
:{{A|vo dancop001 1910701 connor 16.ogg}} '''Connor:''' Elzer, just...
:{{DIcon}} (Their faces are gonna cramp up with all the facial cues they're giving each other...)
:{{A|vo dancop001 1910701 elzer 06.ogg}} '''Elzer:''' Ah... right! I shouldn't disturb the mixing process. I'll uh... be over there, just let me know if you need me.
:{{A|vo dancop001 1910701 connor 17.ogg}} '''Connor:''' Alright, since I invited you here, I'll begin.
:{{A|vo dancop001 1910701 connor 18.ogg}} '''Connor:''' Lizard Tail's bitter nature will ruin the alcohol's texture and taste. We should soak it in distilled spirits first to remove the bitterness, then add it to the Dandelion Wine later as flavoring...
:{{A|vo dancop001 1910701 connor 19.ogg}} '''Connor:''' Hmm... Slime Condensate in small amounts could improve the texture, but not too much, otherwise the alcohol might start to coagulate.
:{{A|vo dancop001 1910701 connor 20.ogg}} '''Connor:''' The smell of these Fish Scales is way too strong, there's no way it could go in a drink. And is Butterfly Dust even edible?
:{{A|vo dancop001 1910701 connor 21.ogg}} '''Connor:''' Oh well, let's start mixing and see what we end up with...
:{{Black Screen|''Connor speeds up his mixing process...''}}
:{{A|vo dancop001 1910701 connor 22.ogg}} '''Connor:''' And voilá, it's done. Elzer, if you could please do the honors.
:{{A|vo dancop001 1910701 elzer 07.ogg}} '''Elzer:''' Ahem... the color and presentation... Hmm, it looks very interesting. Let me have a try...
:{{A|vo dancop001 1910701 elzer 08.ogg}} '''Elzer:''' Mmm, upon an initial taste, the impact of the distilled spirits mixed with the refreshing Dandelion Wine along with a hint of bitterness all work to accentuate the distinct flavor of the drink.
:{{A|vo dancop001 1910701 elzer 09.ogg}} '''Elzer:''' And this slightly thicker texture... Hmm, it really is a memorable drink.
:{{A|vo dancop001 1910701 elzer 10.ogg}} '''Elzer:''' Yes, not bad Connor. Looks like you've finally found the right inspiration to guide your mixing techniques.
:{{A|vo dancop001 1910701 connor 23.ogg}} '''Connor:''' It's all thanks to Diona. If she hadn't asked for this little exchange of skills and provided all the ingredients, then I'd probably still be confined to my old techniques and usual ingredients.
:{{A|vo dancop001 1910701 connor 24.ogg}} '''Connor:''' However, I wasn't able to find a way to use the Butterfly Dust and Fish Scales. Seems that my creativity is still quite limited...
:{{A|vo dancop001 1910701 elzer 11.ogg}} '''Elzer:''' Hahaha, no worries. Not everyone possesses Diona's genius intuition and techniques. No need to be so hard on yourself.
:{{A|vo dancop001 1910701 diona 08.ogg}} '''Diona:''' So he actually made something good out of these ingredients... Do you remember all the techniques he used?
:{{DIcon}} I tried to remember as much as I could.
:{{A|vo dancop001 1910701 diona 09.ogg}} '''Diona:''' The process wasn't too complicated. Next, all we have to do is follow the same steps, but mess them all up.
:{{A|vo dancop001 1910701 diona 10.ogg}} '''Diona:''' Alright, first you can try making a drink using the same techniques.
:{{DIcon}} Why don't you just make it?
:{{A|vo dancop001 1910701 diona 11.ogg}} '''Diona:''' Because observation and experimentation come first when a professional bartender is faced with a new mixing technique.
:{{A|vo dancop001 1910701 diona 12.ogg}} '''Diona:''' As my assistant, you must try your best to make a horrible, terrible tasting drink. Meanwhile, I'll watch closely and see if there's any room for improvement.
:{{A|vo dancop001 1910701 elzer 12.ogg}} '''Elzer:''' So, Diona's going to be making the next drink for us, right?
:{{A|vo dancop001 1910701 connor 25.ogg}} '''Connor:''' I just can't wait to see what she'll be making!
:{{DIcon}} (It's like they're finishing each other's sentences...)
:{{A|vo dancop001 1910701 diona 13a.ogg}} {{A|vo dancop001 1910701 diona 13b.ogg}} '''Diona:''' Sure, but before I do, let's allow my assistant to have a try. {{MC|m=He|f=She}}'s also very interested in mixing drinks.
:{{A|vo dancop001 1910701 elzer 13a.ogg}} {{A|vo dancop001 1910701 elzer 13b.ogg}} '''Elzer:''' Is {{MC|m=he|f=she}} a bartender as well? Ooh, aren't we lucky! We're in for a treat.
:{{A|vo dancop001 1910701 elzer 14.ogg}} '''Elzer:''' Please, this way. All the materials and tools are already prepared, you may start when you're ready.

;(Talk to Connor and Elzer)
:{{A|vo dancop001 1910702 elzer 01.ogg}} '''Elzer:''' Great job, keep it up. We'll definitely be able to hire Diona as resident bartender here!
:{{A|vo dancop001 1910702 connor 01.ogg}} '''Connor:''' I hope it works. I was out there for weeks waiting for this chance... We musn't let this opportunity go to waste.
:{{A|vo dancop001 1910702 elzer 02.ogg}} '''Elzer:''' You really outdid yourself this time, Connor. As long as we can get Diona to come work here, all our hard work will have paid off. This is just the first step.
:{{A|vo dancop001 1910702 elzer 03.ogg}} '''Elzer:''' Now don't forget, Diona must feel our sincerity and our passion! Oh, and remember, try not to overdo it...
:{{A|vo dancop001 1910702 connor 02.ogg}} '''Connor:''' No problem. We've already gone over this many times before.
:{{DIcon}} What are you guys talking about?

:{{A|vo dancop001 1910702 connor 03.ogg}} '''Connor:''' Y—Yeah, we're talking about business. Let's go over the recent upkeep costs of the winery again, shall we, Elzer?

;(Talk to Diona)

:{{DIcon}} (Add all of the Slime Condensate into the drink.)
::{{A|vo dancop001 1910702 diona 05.ogg}} '''Diona:''' That's it, that's it! Ooooh, this will definitely be the worst drink ever.

'''''Expectations Not to Be Betrayed''''' is the second part of {{Quest|Dreamlike Timelessness}}.

==Steps==
#Prepare a boat for [[Sakujirou]] alongside Yoimiya
#Look for firework materials in the city
#*Talk to [[Morihiko]]
#Go to [[Amenoma Smithy]]

#Tell Sakujirou the ship's location

:{{A|vo xglq002 3 yoimiya 08.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' Wow, Mr. Amenoma! Just look at the shape and size of these grains... It's beautiful. I'm at a loss for words.
:{{A|vo xglq002 3 yoimiya 09.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' It's been a while since I've seen you take up your tools, but it looks like your craft hasn't degraded one bit.
:{{A|vo xglq002 3 amenomatoogo 10.ogg}} '''Amenoma Tougo:''' Of course. I have studied these techniques my whole life... they are impossible for me to forget.
:{{A|vo xglq002 3 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So have Amenoma Art and Naganohara Fireworks been working together for a really long time already?
:{{A|vo xglq002 3 amenomatoogo 11.ogg}} '''Amenoma Tougo:''' Back in the day, it was my master and Ryuunosuke's father. The people may have changed from one generation to another, but the ingredients required to make fireworks have remained the same.
:{{A|vo xglq002 3 amenomatoogo 12.ogg}} '''Amenoma Tougo:''' Hajime, in the future, this will be up to you.
:{{A|vo xglq002 3 hajime 06.ogg}} '''Hajime:''' I know, I know...
:{{A|vo xglq002 3 yoimiya 10.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' Hahaha, alright, I won't bother you guys any longer. Remember to come and watch the fireworks!
:{{A|vo xglq002 3 yoimiya 11.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' Okay, {{Traveler}}, time to head off.
:{{A|vo xglq002 3 yoimiya 12.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' Kouichi probably isn't back just yet, but let's go wait for him.
