;(Head to the location to meet Kouichi)
:{{A|vo xglq002 4 yoimiya 01.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' Ah, just as I thought, he isn't back yet. But not to worry, because actually, I've been hoping for a chance to have a nice long chat with you all day.
:{{A|vo xglq002 4 yoimiya 02.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' Sorry for dragging you with me everywhere... Everyone's been so good to me though. It's all gone really smoothly, hee-hee.
:{{A|vo xglq002 4 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' *sigh* Feels like Paimon has barely spoken a word this whole trip.
:{{DIcon}} You seem to get along well with everyone.
:{{DIcon}} It was nice just listening quietly.
:{{A|vo xglq002 4 yoimiya 03.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' I felt like I was neglecting you guys, so I wanted to find an opportunity to catch up.
:{{A|vo xglq002 4 yoimiya 04.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' When we first met, I was in a hurry. We didn't have a chance to sit down and have a proper chat.
:{{A|vo xglq002 4 yoimiya 05.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' You guys are travelers, right? So, where else did you go before coming to Inazuma?
:{{DIcon}} [[Mondstadt]], the City of Freedom.
::{{A|vo xglq002 4 yoimiya 06a.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' Sounds great! I heard that they pretty much have no rules over there, right? So people are free to live their life however they want, doing whatever makes them happy.
::{{A|vo xglq002 4 yoimiya 06a 1.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' My pops actually received a gift from one of his old customers over there. It was from the winery or something...
::{{A|vo xglq002 4 paimon 02a.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' [[Dawn Winery]]! Their [[Dandelion Wine]] is super famous.
::{{A|vo xglq002 4 yoimiya 06a 2.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' Oh, yes! That's the one. I remember when he drank it — hee-hee, I've never seen him enjoy a bottle of wine so much in his life! He was telling me all night about how good it tasted.
:{{DIcon}} [[Liyue]], the nation of contracts.
::{{A|vo xglq002 4 yoimiya 06b.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' I haven't been to Liyue before, but from what I've heard from Miss [[Beidou]], it sounds like a really interesting place.
::{{A|vo xglq002 4 yoimiya 06b 1.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' But something big happened there recently, right? Didn't their archon leave all of sudden?
::{{A|vo xglq002 4 paimon 02b.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yeah, a lot of crazy things went down as a result.
::{{A|vo xglq002 4 paimon 02b 1.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' *sigh* Luckily, everyone worked together to stave off a [[Osial|huge disaster]] that could have wiped out the whole city.
::{{A|vo xglq002 4 yoimiya 06b 2.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' Oh, well that's good to hear. I gotta say, it's pretty remarkable that the citizens managed to step up and keep things going even after their archon left.
::{{A|vo xglq002 4 yoimiya 06b 3.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' I mean, I sure can't imagine Inazuma without the [[Ei|Shogun]].
:{{A|vo xglq002 4 yoimiya 07.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' My friend once said to me that only people with a strong will and a clear purpose decide to go traveling. Maybe it's to see a certain view or to fulfill a certain wish...
:{{A|vo xglq002 4 yoimiya 08.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' So. What made you guys embark on your treacherous journey to Inazuma?
:{{DIcon}} To track down an enemy god.
::{{A|vo xglq002 4 paimon 03a.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' And to find a lost family member, too.
:{{DIcon}} I'm looking for my lost {{MC|m=sister|f=brother|mc=1}}.
::{{A|vo xglq002 4 paimon 03b.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' And we're looking for answers from the [[gods]], too.
:{{A|vo xglq002 4 yoimiya 09.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' You were separated from your family because of a god?
:{{A|vo xglq002 4 yoimiya 10.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' Oh...
:{{A|vo xglq002 4 yoimiya 11.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' That must be really tough.
:{{DIcon}} Sometimes it is.
:{{DIcon}} I'm slowly learning to cope.
:{{A|vo xglq002 4 yoimiya 12.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' I get it. Well, if that's how it is, then that's how it is. Eh-he, y'know, I was going to ask you guys if you wanted to stay here in Inazuma.
:{{A|vo xglq002 4 yoimiya 13.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' Unlike the outside world, what Inazuma seeks is eternity. In other words, a state of tranquility, where very little ever changes.
:{{A|vo xglq002 4 yoimiya 14.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' The advantage of that is that if you're tired from your journey, Inazuma's a great place to come and rest.
:{{A|vo xglq002 4 yoimiya 15.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' Umm... let me put it this way. I was just worried that you might be getting weary, and if you keep pressing on in that state, you might start to lose sight of the things that made you want to start your journey in the first place.
:{{A|vo xglq002 4 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' *sigh* Sometimes, that's also just how it is.
:{{A|vo xglq002 4 yoimiya 16.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' When you're exhausted, everything becomes an uphill struggle. Even trying to have fun — you won't be able to enjoy yourself if you're too tired.
:{{A|vo xglq002 4 yoimiya 17.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' An adventurer friend of mine once told me that if you're too focused on reaching the end of the race, you'll miss a lot of opportunities and precious moments to be had along the way.
:{{DIcon}} ...
:{{DIcon}} I'll bear that in mind.
:{{A|vo xglq002 4 yoimiya 18.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' Don't worry though, I'm sure I can think of some way to get you feeling relaxed and happy!
:{{A|vo xglq002 4 yoimiya 19.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' And you're here now, so even if you're gonna leave eventually, I wanna make sure you at least leave with fond memories.
:{{A|vo xglq002 4 yoimiya 20.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' Who knows — once you're reunited with your family, maybe you'll find Inazuma the right kind of place to call home.
:{{DIcon}} I'll add it to my list of candidates.
:{{DIcon}} It also depends what my {{MC|m=sister|f=brother|mc=1}} thinks.
:{{A|vo xglq002 4 yoimiya 21.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' Hehe, I already have an idea of the color and type of fireworks I wanna give you guys. I'll keep it a secret for now, though.
:{{A|vo xglq002 4 kouichi 01.ogg}} '''Kouichi:''' Yoimiya, I'm back! Sorry to keep you waiting! Let's head over to the boat... or, uh, did you want to keep chatting a little longer?
:{{DIcon}} We just finished, as it happens.
:{{A|vo xglq002 4 kouichi 02.ogg}} '''Kouichi:''' Okay, good. Let's go, then. Just act naturally, though, we don't want to raise any suspicion.
:{{A|vo xglq002 4 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' If it can withstand the storms out on the ocean, it must be super sturdy, right?
:{{A|vo xglq002 4 kouichi 03.ogg}} '''Kouichi:''' Absolutely. Rest assured that the quality is guaranteed.

:{{DIcon}} Makes me think of [[Atsuko]].
:{{A|vo xglq002 5 kouichi 01.ogg}} '''Kouichi:''' Can't be helped, I'm afraid, this is the biggest and sturdiest boat that I can provide. It's built from the finest Inazuman timber.

:{{A|vo xglq002 5 yoimiya 01.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' I'm also hoping Sakujirou won't have to use it. It's just there as a last resort.
:{{A|vo xglq002 5 yoimiya 02.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' I gotta say, though, Kouichi, it feels like your craft has improved once again.
:{{A|vo xglq002 5 kouichi 03.ogg}} '''Kouichi:''' Haha, I'm not the one you should be praising. It's all thanks to the guys who kindly pitched in.
:{{A|vo xglq002 5 kouichi 04.ogg}} '''Kouichi:''' To avoid detection, we each worked on our own materials separately, then assembled them secretly in the night.
:{{A|vo xglq002 5 kouichi 05.ogg}} '''Kouichi:''' This is the largest we could afford to build it. Any bigger and there's no way it would pass the Tenryou Commission's inspection.
:{{A|vo xglq002 5 yoimiya 03.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' Let's store the boat here for now, then. I'll fill Sakujirou in when I get back, he'll need to make some preparations before setting sail.
:{{A|vo xglq002 5 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Uh-oh, Paimon feels really worried all of a sudden... Uh... Doesn't helping Sakujirou make you a collaborator in the eyes of the Tenryou Commission?
:{{A|vo xglq002 5 yoimiya 04.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' Haha, maybe it does, but I knew what I was getting into from the moment I agreed to help him.
:{{A|vo xglq002 5 yoimiya 05.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' My family has pretty good connections with the Yashiro Commission. We work very closely with them. And whenever there's a national event of any sort, the other two Commissions come to us, too.
:{{A|vo xglq002 5 yoimiya 06.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' As long as I'm polite and respectful and don't cause a fuss, they won't look to cause trouble for me, either.
:{{A|vo xglq002 5 yoimiya 07.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' And anyway, to your point about collaboration... you've been helping out too, right?
:{{A|vo xglq002 5 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' That's true, this was all a collaborative effort... wait, huh? *gasp* Oh no!
:{{DIcon}} We were chased by the [[Millelith]] in Liyue, too.
:{{DIcon}} Do we have to be the bad guys in Inazuma as well?
:{{A|vo xglq002 5 yoimiya 08.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' Ah, so you're seasoned crooks already, eh? Don't know what I was worried about then! Hehe.
:{{A|vo xglq002 5 yoimiya 09.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' Anyway, thanks for everything, Kouichi.
:{{A|vo xglq002 5 yoimiya 10.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' Oh, and your fireworks are ready, so just go and pick them up from my house whenever you want. While you're there, you can get my pops to settle the boat construction fees.
:{{A|vo xglq002 5 kouichi 06.ogg}} '''Kouichi:''' Oh, don't worry about paying anything. [[Third Sis]] would be sure to scold me if she found out I'd taken Mora from the Naganoharas.
:{{A|vo xglq002 5 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Who's Third Sis?
:{{A|vo xglq002 5 yoimiya 11.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' Oh! Uh, let me explain this one, it's a story my pops told me. There used to be a thriving merchants' guild in Inazuma, it got really prosperous.
:{{A|vo xglq002 5 yoimiya 12.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' At one point, there were a dozen or so kids born around the same time to the families of the guild. They all grew up together, each of them learning their respective family's business.
:{{A|vo xglq002 5 yoimiya 13.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' They were a tightly knit group of friends, but eventually, they all grew up and decided they each wanted to go into business themselves.
:{{A|vo xglq002 5 yoimiya 14.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' It was inevitable that their business would send them all to different corners of the world, and that they'd have far less opportunity to see each other in the future.
:{{A|vo xglq002 5 kouichi 07.ogg}} '''Kouichi:''' That's right. Just before we went our separate ways, the eldest of the group suggested that we should all go watch some fireworks together one last time.
:{{A|vo xglq002 5 yoimiya 15.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' Hehe, they were all very ambitious types, and each had their own knack for doing business. One by one, they left, until Kouichi was the only one of them remaining in Inazuma.
:{{A|vo xglq002 5 yoimiya 16.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' After that, he hardly saw them. But whenever one of them did come back to visit, fireworks would always be involved.
:{{A|vo xglq002 5 kouichi 08.ogg}} '''Kouichi:''' Yeah, no matter how close you and your friends are, there's always going to be some distance after being separated for a long time. But as soon as the fireworks lit up the sky, it'd instantly take us right back to our childhood, and we'd be chatting away like in the old days.
:{{A|vo xglq002 5 kouichi 09.ogg}} '''Kouichi:''' To us, those memories are eternal.
:{{A|vo xglq002 5 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ohh, so this is what you meant when you were talking about commemorating things.
:{{A|vo xglq002 5 yoimiya 17.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' Yep, that's exactly right. That's why I can't let people down when they're counting on me for their fireworks.
:{{A|vo xglq002 5 yoimiya 18.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' Anyway, I need to go update Sakujirou. See you, Kouichi! Thanks again for your help!
:{{A|vo xglq002 5 kouichi 10.ogg}} '''Kouichi:''' Yeah, I should get out of here, too. I don't want to get caught red-handed.

:{{A|vo xglq002 5 yoimiya 19.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' Okay, story time. So, whenever Kouichi brings one of his friends from the trade association to see me, they always mention how they used to play with me when I was a kid, or held me once as a baby, or something.
:{{A|vo xglq002 5 yoimiya 20.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' But there are so many of them in that friendship group, and I don't remember anything from that age anyway. So I never have a clue who they are.
:{{A|vo xglq002 5 yoimiya 21.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' One time, he shows up with another one of his friends, and the friend asks me if I remember him.
:{{A|vo xglq002 5 yoimiya 22.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' So I'm like, "Yes, I do! You held me once when I was just a baby!"
:{{A|vo xglq002 5 yoimiya 23.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' Kouichi just bursts out laughing and says actually, this is one of his carpenter friends. Turns out he's a lot younger than he looks — just a few years older than me.

;(Tell Sakujirou the ship's location)
:{{A|vo xglq002 6 yoimiya 01.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' The boat is a-ready and waiting. I'll mark the location for you on the map. Before you leave, I recommend that you pack some food and water. You can never be too prepared.
:{{A|vo xglq002 6 sakujirou 01.ogg}} '''Sakujirou:''' Ah...
:{{A|vo xglq002 6 sakujirou 02.ogg}} '''Sakujirou:''' *sigh* After how much effort it took to get back in, it's hard to convince myself to leave again... especially when I'll be going up against the stormy ocean on a tiny little boat... My prospects don't look great.
:{{A|vo xglq002 6 yoimiya 02.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' Well, they won't look much better if you get caught by the Tenryou Commission...
:{{A|vo xglq002 6 yoimiya 03.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' I'm afraid that sooner or later, they are going to find you here. Time is starting to run out.
:{{A|vo xglq002 6 sakujirou 03.ogg}} '''Sakujirou:''' I'm sorry, I'll make sure to get out of here before they come. I promise I won't cause you and your family any more trouble.
:{{A|vo xglq002 6 yoimiya 04.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' I didn't mean it like that. If we ran into any problems, I'm sure I'd figure something out.
:{{A|vo xglq002 6 yoimiya 05.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' But if the Tenryou Commission does catch up to you, then make a run for the boat.
:{{A|vo xglq002 6 sakujirou 04.ogg}} '''Sakujirou:''' Okay. I won't let them catch me...
:{{A|vo xglq002 6 sakujirou 05.ogg}} '''Sakujirou:''' But... *sigh* Ah, I guess this whole trip was a waste in the end.
:{{A|vo xglq002 6 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Why did you wanna come back to Inazuma anyway? Is there something you wanted to do?
:{{A|vo xglq002 6 sakujirou 06.ogg}} '''Sakujirou:''' I didn't use to like this place at all, that's why I left. But looking back on things now, I was really just running away from my responsibilities.
:{{A|vo xglq002 6 sakujirou 07.ogg}} '''Sakujirou:''' Once I started to realize that, I got restless. I couldn't stop thinking about the people and the things I'd left behind...
:{{A|vo xglq002 6 sakujirou 08.ogg}} '''Sakujirou:''' So, I... Ah, forget it, what does it matter now. It's too late, anyway. I originally wanted to make up for all my regrets, but instead, I found myself in the situation I'm in now.
:{{A|vo xglq002 6 yoimiya 06.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' *sigh* What a pity...
:{{A|vo xglq002 6 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Talk to us about it, maybe we could—
:{{A|vo xglq002 6 yoimiya 07.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' If only there was no Sakoku Decree, huh.
:{{A|vo xglq002 6 yoimiya 08.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' Anyway, don't worry, we're not going to bother you about it. We'll keep trying to buy you as much time as possible until you reach your final decision.
:{{A|vo xglq002 6 yoimiya 09.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' The Tenryou Commission... If only they weren't so overzealous, there might be a way...
:{{A|vo xglq002 6 yoimiya 10.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' Oh, that's right! That elderly couple, old customers of ours — their son's in the Tenryou Commission, isn't he? Yeah, quite high up, as well.
:{{A|vo xglq002 6 yoimiya 11.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' That's it! I'll go talk to them. Maybe they can do something!
:{{A|vo xglq002 6 sakujirou 09.ogg}} '''Sakujirou:''' Um... Are you sure they won't just report me instead?
:{{A|vo xglq002 6 yoimiya 12.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' Oh, don't worry about that. They're really nice people, I know them well. They won't cause us any issues.
:{{A|vo xglq002 6 yoimiya 13a.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' Alright, you should get back indoors, Sakujirou. We'll be back in no time time at all.
:{{A|vo xglq002 6 yoimiya 14.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' Okay, let's go. Time waits for no one.
:{{A|vo xglq002 6 yoimiya 15.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' Wait, hang on... What about the fireworks? All those materials... there's so many orders to finish...
:{{A|vo xglq002 6 yoimiya 16.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' ...Pops! Pops!
:{{A|vo xglq002 6 yoimiya 17.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' Oh, never mind. I know, I'll write him a note telling him to sort out the fireworks!
:{{Black Screen|''Yoimiya swiftly finishes writing the paper slip. You are finally ready to set off.''}}

:{{A|vo yqeq204 2 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Look at that huge tent...
:{{A|vo yqeq204 2 idyia 01.ogg}} '''Idyia:''' Amazing, isn't it? I helped make it. What fun would a fairground be without a tent, right?

:{{DIcon}} Yet another victim...

:{{A|vo yqeq204 2 eula 05.ogg}} '''Eula:''' ...
:{{A|vo yqeq204 2 eula 06.ogg}} '''Eula:''' Just talking about it is a waste of time. Since we're already here, let's go and scout out the situation ourselves.
:{{A|vo yqeq204 2 maymom 10.ogg}} '''Maymunah:''' *sigh* Alright. This way, please.

;(Enter the big tent)
:{{A|vo yqeq204 2 maymom 11.ogg}} '''Maymunah:''' There used to be a large stage inside, but after everything got shaken up, it seems the very nature of the entire place was altered.

:{{A|vo yqeq204 2 collei 07.ogg}} '''Collei:''' Wait, so you mean it's difficult to move around in there?
:{{A|vo yqeq204 2 maymom 13.ogg}} '''Maymunah:''' Yes, mainly because of the lights.

:{{A|vo yqeq204 2 collei 08.ogg}} '''Collei:''' Uh...
:{{A|vo yqeq204 2 collei 09.ogg}} '''Collei:''' I can't stand that feeling. Having everyone's attention focused solely on me would just make me feel terrible.
:{{A|vo yqeq204 2 idyia 03.ogg}} '''Idyia:''' Me too! I'm no good at speaking in front of people, and then to have everyone staring at you... Ugh, just the thought of it makes me shudder.
:{{A|vo yqeq204 2 eula 07.ogg}} '''Eula:''' Sounds like you have some things you haven't been able to let go of yet.
:{{A|vo yqeq204 2 collei 10.ogg}} '''Collei:''' *sigh* Please don't laugh. I'm trying my best to change that, but there are still some things I can't overcome. Like when there's a lot of people around, or when people are staring at me...
:{{A|vo yqeq204 2 eula 08.ogg}} '''Eula:''' No, there's nothing funny about that... and you know what? It's not a bad thing to care when other people are looking.
:{{A|vo yqeq204 2 eula 09.ogg}} '''Eula:''' That's my opinion, anyway. Think about it, only people who have high standards for themselves would worry about failing to meet others' expectations.
:{{A|vo yqeq204 2 eula 10.ogg}} '''Eula:''' You have many good qualities, Collei. I bet if you had to learn dance since childhood like myself, then you'd be an even better dancer than me.

:{{A|vo yqeq204 2 idyia 04.ogg}} '''Idyia:''' (I can relate. I know exactly how she feels.)
:{{A|vo yqeq204 2 eula 11.ogg}} '''Eula:''' Maybe we should find a time for you to learn with me, and one day you will become an outstanding dancer, too. By that time, you'll be so focused on performing your beautiful moves that you'll no longer worry about an audience watching you.
:{{A|vo yqeq204 2 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wow, Eula's so passionate about this that she's practically glowing now.
:{{A|vo yqeq204 2 collei 12.ogg}} '''Collei:''' Really, you'd do that? You wouldn't think I look stupid and secretly laugh at me, would you?
:{{A|vo yqeq204 2 eula 12.ogg}} '''Eula:''' Hmph, you really think I'm that kind of person? Fine, vengeance will be mine.
:{{A|vo yqeq204 2 collei 13.ogg}} '''Collei:''' Oh, no! Of course not! Alright, please teach me.
:{{A|vo yqeq204 2 maymom 15.ogg}} '''Maymunah:''' Seems there's no need for me to warn you again. Anyway, you just need to open the curtain and you'll be able to see the stage.

:{{A|vo yqeq204 3 eula 06.ogg}} '''Eula:''' Hmph. He's been trapped for so long that it seems he's forgotten how to hold a decent conversation. How ridiculous. Let's go. We'll leave the stage to this person who'd rather save face than save his own life.

:{{A|vo yqeq204 5 collei 02.ogg}} '''Collei:''' The place is bustling with all kinds of vendors! And if you're lucky, you can see [[Nilou]] perform her dance.
:{{A|vo yqeq204 5 eula 02.ogg}} '''Eula:''' Oh, a dance from Sumeru? I'd like to see that myself. Hmm, if only it were on the way back, then we could stop there.
:{{A|vo yqeq204 5 collei 03.ogg}} '''Collei:''' It doesn't matter if it's on the way or not. I would be happy to take you whenever you have time, Eula!
:{{A|vo yqeq204 5 eula 03.ogg}} '''Eula:''' Great, I'll take you up on that offer.
:{{DIcon}} We've been to the Grand Bazaar.
:{{A|vo yqeq204 5 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yeah, now that Paimon thinks about it, we've already been there more times than Paimon can remember!
:{{A|vo yqeq204 5 maymom 04.ogg}} '''Maymunah:''' Really? My father used to help with festivities at the Grand Bazaar and would always give me candy during the events.
:{{A|vo yqeq204 5 maymom 05.ogg}} '''Maymunah:''' I was just a kid and didn't understand anything... I was happy as long as he gave me some candy. To me, fairs and festivals were the best things ever.
:{{A|vo yqeq204 5 maymom 06.ogg}} '''Maymunah:''' I always thought my father was amazing, and wanted to be just like him when I grew up.
:{{A|vo yqeq204 5 collei 04.ogg}} '''Collei:''' But aren't you a scholar in the Akademiya, Maymunah? As far as I know, scholars seldom can spend time doing anything but research.
:{{A|vo yqeq204 5 collei 05.ogg}} '''Collei:''' I doubt you could have time to assist your father in preparing festivities.
:{{A|vo yqeq204 5 maymom 07.ogg}} '''Maymunah:''' Yeah, seems you read me like a book.
:{{A|vo yqeq204 5 maymom 08.ogg}} '''Maymunah:''' When I had the choice between becoming who I wanted to be and who my parents wanted me to be, I ended up choosing the latter... But I was never happy about it.
:{{A|vo yqeq204 5 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh, that's almost the exact opposite of Eula's situation.
:{{A|vo yqeq204 5 eula 04.ogg}} '''Eula:''' You must have already realized that. Why else would you set up all the booths here and make this place like a fairgrounds?
:{{A|vo yqeq204 5 maymom 09.ogg}} '''Maymunah:''' Yes, but... I'm still not as happy as I imagined I would be.
:{{A|vo yqeq204 5 maymom 10.ogg}} '''Maymunah:''' I realized that attending a fair and running a fair are two completely different things.
:{{A|vo yqeq204 5 maymom 11.ogg}} '''Maymunah:''' The main reason my childhood was so fun and carefree is because my family worked hard.
:{{A|vo yqeq204 5 maymom 12.ogg}} '''Maymunah:''' But my father knew how difficult and tiring running a fair could be, so he wanted to push me towards academics.
:{{A|vo yqeq204 5 maymom 13.ogg}} '''Maymunah:''' *sigh* But in the end, I didn't do well in either.
:{{A|vo yqeq204 5 maymom 14.ogg}} '''Maymunah:''' I gave up on myself and resorted to investigating Ley Lines in the desert. Some things happened and then I accidentally ended up here.
:{{A|vo yqeq204 5 maymom 15.ogg}} '''Maymunah:''' I finally had a chance to make my wish of running a fair come true, but after seeing everything come crashing down, I feel like I've lost the strength to go on.
:{{A|vo yqeq204 5 collei 06.ogg}} '''Collei:''' It's not as bad as you make it out to be, Maymunah. No need to feel so down.
:{{A|vo yqeq204 5 collei 07.ogg}} '''Collei:''' You have the courage to change, and you've been actively guiding us on this journey.
:{{A|vo yqeq204 5 collei 08.ogg}} '''Collei:''' Someone who's given up on themself could never do these things.
:{{A|vo yqeq204 5 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, Collei...
:{{A|vo yqeq204 5 maymom 16.ogg}} '''Maymunah:''' I understand my situation better than anyone, you don't need to try to comfort me.
:{{A|vo yqeq204 5 collei 09.ogg}} '''Collei:''' It's not that I'm trying to comfort you, it's just that people sometimes don't realize that their own actions speak louder than words.
:{{A|vo yqeq204 5 collei 10.ogg}} '''Collei:''' Believe me, this is something that I learned from my time together with Eula.
:{{A|vo yqeq204 5 eula 05.ogg}} '''Eula:''' Oh? What are you trying to say?
:{{A|vo yqeq204 5 collei 11.ogg}} '''Collei:''' Oh, uh nothing! Ahem, now let's get that Crystal Light fixed.
:{{A|vo yqeq204 5 maymom 17.ogg}} '''Maymunah:''' ...Alright.

;(Release the Crystal Light without activating the Lamp Gem)
:{{A|vo yqeq204 5 maymom 19.ogg}} '''Maymunah:''' If we're going to raise the Crystal Light, then we need to open the top of the tent.
;(Release the Crystal Light and activating the Lamp Gem at the same time)
:{{A|vo yqeq204 5 maymom 20.ogg}} '''Maymunah:''' Good, that should do it.

:{{A|vo yqeq204 6 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hey Idyia, we're back!
:{{A|vo yqeq204 6 idyia 01.ogg}} '''Idyia:''' Oh! I was starting to wonder what was taking you so long! But don't worry, Lessig is recovering well.
:{{A|vo yqeq204 6 idyia 02.ogg}} '''Idyia:''' Hehe, I'm pretty good at taking care of people. Seems I've found another good thing about myself...
:{{A|vo yqeq204 6 collei 01.ogg}} '''Collei:''' I don't know if I should be worried for him or happy for her...
:{{A|vo yqeq204 6 lessig 01.ogg}} '''Lessig:''' The shadow... it's massive!!! Ah, wait! The shadow just now, it's... Ah!
:{{A|vo yqeq204 6 idyia 03.ogg}} '''Idyia:''' Uh, ahem... Seems he still might need a little more time to recover. Tell me, did everything go well for you all?
:{{A|vo yqeq204 6 maymom 01.ogg}} '''Maymunah:''' Of course. With a team like {{Traveler}}, Paimon, Collei and Eula, they're at least 40 times more reliable than you ever were.
:{{A|vo yqeq204 6 idyia 04.ogg}} '''Idyia:''' Only 40 times more reliable? That means I'm still pretty good, then.
:{{A|vo yqeq204 6 maymom 02.ogg}} '''Maymunah:''' Ugh... I guess it's impossible to feel like you've lost once you've already given up... I'm a little concerned about how comfortable you are with that...
:{{A|vo yqeq204 6 lessig 02.ogg}} '''Lessig:''' Huh!? What has happened? How did I get outside of the tent!?
:{{A|vo yqeq204 6 lessig 03.ogg}} '''Lessig:''' Ah, that's right... I remember meeting Eula, and then... and then, ugh... my head...
:{{A|vo yqeq204 6 idyia 05.ogg}} '''Idyia:''' Ah, you're awake now. Don't worry, that's just a side effect of your treatment, Lessig.
:{{A|vo yqeq204 6 lessig 04.ogg}} '''Lessig:''' I'm afraid I still feel a little disoriented...
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (I'm scared to ask what kind of treatment he's receiving...)
:{{A|vo yqeq204 6 eula 01.ogg}} '''Eula:''' Lessig Lawrence.
:{{A|vo yqeq204 6 lessig 05.ogg}} '''Lessig:''' Oh, it's you, Eula! Alright, alright, I'll do it... I'll come back to Mondstadt with you and abandon my wild efforts to restore the Lawrence Clan.
:{{A|vo yqeq204 6 eula 02.ogg}} '''Eula:''' Interesting, now you want to talk. Seems you've had a change of heart.
:{{A|vo yqeq204 6 eula 03.ogg}} '''Eula:''' In that case, maybe you'll be able to explain everything in detail for us now?
:{{A|vo yqeq204 6 lessig 06.ogg}} '''Lessig:''' I, uh... I admit it. Yes, I came here in hopes of finding a way to restore the Lawrence Clan to its former glory.
:{{A|vo yqeq204 6 lessig 07.ogg}} '''Lessig:''' But it was a long journey, and I didn't always know the way. I passed through Liyue and Sumeru... and there was even a time when I lost my wallet and had to live in the wild.
:{{A|vo yqeq204 6 lessig 08.ogg}} '''Lessig:''' But the peculiar thing is... I realized that nobody knew me out there, and not a single person even cared about the Lawrence Clan.
:{{A|vo yqeq204 6 lessig 09.ogg}} '''Lessig:''' You and I are like glass pawns that were raised in shackles. We were taught to act like nobles, but outside the walls of our home, the people of Mondstadt despised us.
:{{A|vo yqeq204 6 lessig 10.ogg}} '''Lessig:''' Such pompous, hateful, and stubborn teaching... It all culminated to making us cling to the old aristocratic dogma in an attempt to maintain our pride.
:{{A|vo yqeq204 6 lessig 11.ogg}} '''Lessig:''' It's like a never-ending game of tug-of-war. But it is meaningless... You understand. Or I should say, you have already long understood, but I'm afraid that I have only just realized this.
:{{A|vo yqeq204 6 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hmm, Paimon sorta understands what Lessig is saying.
:{{A|vo yqeq204 6 eula 04.ogg}} '''Eula:''' Everything he said is true. Your family is probably unaware that you've already changed how you see things.
:{{A|vo yqeq204 6 lessig 12.ogg}} '''Lessig:''' Yes, this has all happened recently. After coming to this domain, I realized the Mondstadt that I want is one where not everyone fears me.
:{{A|vo yqeq204 6 lessig 13.ogg}} '''Lessig:''' All that I and many other members of the Lawrence Clan long for is a place where we can live peacefully with others.
:{{A|vo yqeq204 6 eula 05.ogg}} '''Eula:''' Lessig, both you and I never had anything to do with the glory of the Lawrence Clan. That is all in the past, we are just ordinary people.
:{{A|vo yqeq204 6 lessig 14.ogg}} '''Lessig:''' ...
:{{A|vo yqeq204 6 lessig 15.ogg}} '''Lessig:''' I originally planned on returning to Mondstadt after taking care of things here. I never thought you would come here. I was completely shocked, which is why I reacted like I did. I'm sorry.
:{{A|vo yqeq204 6 maymom 03.ogg}} '''Maymunah:''' See, people can always make different choices, and it seems that Lessig has also chosen to become someone he truly wants to be.
:{{A|vo yqeq204 6 lessig 16.ogg}} '''Lessig:''' Ah yes, about that... I'm afraid I haven't quite found my own purpose in life yet...
:{{A|vo yqeq204 6 maymom 04.ogg}} '''Maymunah:''' That's alright. Being able to clearly choose between becoming who you want to be and who your parents wanted you to be is already a step in the right direction.
:{{A|vo yqeq204 6 maymom 05.ogg}} '''Maymunah:''' How to find true happiness is probably one of the most difficult research topics of all.
:{{A|vo yqeq204 6 eula 06.ogg}} '''Eula:''' I have a suggestion for you, Lessig.
:{{A|vo yqeq204 6 eula 07.ogg}} '''Eula:''' Why don't you return to Mondstadt and tell your parents what you just told us?
:{{A|vo yqeq204 6 lessig 17.ogg}} '''Lessig:''' Hah, they'll probably try to tear me limb from limb. But what about you? Did you ever tell your family about what you think?
:{{A|vo yqeq204 6 eula 08.ogg}} '''Eula:''' This is something that I've been thinking about, too. Perhaps the two of us can sit down with the rest of the clan and discuss it with them.
:{{A|vo yqeq204 6 eula 09.ogg}} '''Eula:''' The Lawrence Clan is just like this stage. It was once home to glorious performances, but those days are now long gone, and it is time for the stage to be updated.
:{{A|vo yqeq204 6 collei 02.ogg}} '''Collei:''' (She's so solid and tough, but also clear and open... like an ice cube. Is that why she's able to dance anytime and anywhere she wishes?)
:{{A|vo yqeq204 6 idyia 06.ogg}} '''Idyia:''' Uh, are you all done talking now?
:{{A|vo yqeq204 6 maymom 06.ogg}} '''Maymunah:''' Yes, I think so. By the way, that is for you, please take it. I found it on Lessig earlier.
:[[File:Fairground Gathering, Summer Lights Illuminated Candy Box.png|200px]]
:{{A|vo yqeq204 6 idyia 07.ogg}} '''Idyia:''' Oh! It's one of the missing components! Wait, so you had it all this time? Why didn't you give it to me earlier?
:{{A|vo yqeq204 6 maymom 07.ogg}} '''Maymunah:''' Well, you didn't ask! Alright, I admit it... I forgot about it.
:{{A|vo yqeq204 6 idyia 08.ogg}} '''Idyia:''' Hehe... Okay, we'll let {{Traveler}} hold on to it for now.
:{{A|vo yqeq204 6 collei 03.ogg}} '''Collei:''' Hmm? Wait, this looks like...
:{{A|vo yqeq204 6 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' It looks pretty familiar... Have we seen one of these before?
:{{DIcon}} Many times... Some might say too many...
::{{A|vo yqeq204 6 paimon 04a 1.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Shh! Now's not the time to brag about being a hero!
:{{DIcon}} It's a candy box!
:{{A|vo yqeq204 6 collei 04.ogg}} '''Collei:''' Ah right, I also bought a similar box at the last festival.
:{{A|vo yqeq204 6 maymom 08.ogg}} '''Maymunah:''' Yes, people often use this kind of box for candy at festivals. This was one of the "materials" originally used to create the tent.
:{{A|vo yqeq204 6 maymom 09.ogg}} '''Maymunah:''' But now that the tent has been repaired, we no longer need it.
:{{A|vo yqeq204 6 maymom 10.ogg}} '''Maymunah:''' Eating the candy from the box as an adult will never be as delicious as it was when you were a kid. But if you really think about it, there are way more things you can eat as an adult.
:{{A|vo yqeq204 6 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ah! So when it comes down to it, eating candy is sorta like life, it's just another choice!
:{{A|vo yqeq204 6 lessig 18.ogg}} '''Lessig:''' ...
:{{A|vo yqeq204 6 idyia 09.ogg}} '''Idyia:''' So as of now, we've already collected three of the missing components. Only one more to go!
:{{A|vo yqeq204 6 idyia 10.ogg}} '''Idyia:''' I'm sorry that repairing the tent took so much of everyone's time. You should all head back and have a rest, I'll lead the way...

:{{DIcon}} So you came here looking for something...

:{{A|vo yqeq204 7 kokomi 06.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' As I made my way from Watatsumi Island to Sumeru, I enjoyed a variety of breathtaking sights. It really is a beautiful nation. I even stayed in the rainforest for several days.

:{{A|vo yqeq204 7 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Now that you mention it, a lot did happen today.
:{{Black Screen|You tell Kokomi everything that happened at the fairgrounds...}}

:{{A|vo yqeq204 7 collei 01.ogg}} '''Collei:''' Hey everyone! Oh, I hope we're not interrupting your conversation...
:{{A|vo yqeq204 7 kokomi 11.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' It's alright, you two did a lot today. Care to join me for a cup of tea?
:{{A|vo yqeq204 7 collei 02.ogg}} '''Collei:''' Sure, that would be perfect! Eula and I just made some snacks...
:{{A|vo yqeq204 7 eula 01.ogg}} '''Eula:''' Turns out that Idyia has a cooking stove and oven. Seriously, why didn't she mention it earlier...
:{{A|vo yqeq204 7 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh! So did you make us some [[Moon Pie]]s?

:{{A|vo yqeq204 7 collei 03.ogg}} '''Collei:''' And I made some [[Pita Pocket]]s! You can try some, Kokomi. It should taste great with tea.

:{{A|vo yqeq204 7 kokomi 12.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' Oh, I would be happy to try some.

==Dialogue==
{{Quest Description|Many people's memories have escaped from the damaged roots of the Sacred Sakura. Raiden Ei takes the opportunity to tell you many stories about her cherished friends and the Inazuma she wants to protect.}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
:{{A|vo sglq102 1 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' We should go. Let's keep following the traces.
:{{A|vo sglq102 1 raidenei 01.ogg}} '''Ei:''' Very well. Based on my investigation so far, I believe this next pack of monsters should be the last.

;(Continue the pursuit and defeat the Rifthounds)
:{{A|vo sglq102 1 raidenei 02.ogg}} '''Ei:''' Once again, please leave them to me.
:{{A|vo sglq102 1 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hey, hey! A—Are you sure you're alright? You're scaring us!
:{{A|vo sglq102 1 raidenei 03.ogg}} '''Ei:''' Fear not. Fighting is what I do best.

;(Partway through the first wave, the Raiden Shogun is immobilized for a moment)
:{{A|vo sglq102 1 raidenei 04.ogg}} '''Ei:''' Ugh...
:{{A|vo sglq102 1 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Are you alright?
:{{A|vo sglq102 1 raidenei 05.ogg}} '''Ei:''' I'm fine, I...

;(After defeating the Rifthounds, or if Ei's HP falls below 25%)
:{{A|vo sglq102 2 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ei, maybe you should leave this one to us.
:{{DIcon}} You don't look too good.
:{{DIcon}} Don't force it.
:{{A|vo sglq102 2 raidenei 01.ogg}} '''Ei:''' I...
:{{A|vo sglq102 2 raidenei 02.ogg}} '''Ei:''' My apologies.
:{{A|vo sglq102 2 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Don't worry about it! Just take a breather and get your strength back.
:{{A|vo sglq102 2 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' We'll deal with the monsters!
:{{A|vo sglq102 2 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Look... that's the same light again.

:{{color|menu|Three samurai emerge from the light at the critical moment.}}

:{{DIcon}} Time for another trip down memory lane.
:{{DIcon}} Who have we got this time...
:{{A|vo sglq102 2 fujiki 01.ogg}} '''Fujiki:''' Wh—Where am I?
:{{A|vo sglq102 2 fujiki 02.ogg}} '''Fujiki:''' Who are you... *gasp* Almighty Shogun, you're here too!
:{{A|vo sglq102 2 fujiki 03.ogg}} '''Fujiki:''' Are you injured, Your Excellency?
:{{A|vo sglq102 2 raidenei 03.ogg}} '''Ei:''' Ahem... I'm quite alright. Just feeling a little stiff.
:{{A|vo sglq102 2 fujiki 04.ogg}} '''Fujiki:''' We, the Shogunate samurai, will defend the Shogun until the very end!
:{{A|vo sglq102 2 fukami 01.ogg}} '''Fukami:''' Come on, men! They're coming back for more, let's get them!
:{{A|vo sglq102 2 raidenei 04.ogg}} '''Ei:''' Don't. It's too dangerous.
:{{A|vo sglq102 2 fujiki 05.ogg}} '''Fujiki:''' Danger is our duty, Ma'am! If we were the kind to shy away from danger, we never would've taken up arms to begin with.
:{{A|vo sglq102 2 fukami 02.ogg}} '''Fukami:''' No need to worry, Almighty Shogun. When the situation looks bleak, we will draw on the power granted to us by the gods.
:{{A|vo sglq102 2 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Is that a Vision?
:{{A|vo sglq102 2 fujiki 06.ogg}} '''Fujiki:''' It certainly is. I know the gods are omnipotent, and their willingness to grant their power to humans means that they have high expectations for us.
:{{A|vo sglq102 2 fujiki 07.ogg}} '''Fujiki:''' If the Almighty Shogun is in trouble, now of all times is the moment for us to honor that.
:{{A|vo sglq102 2 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So that's how samurai of that era understood Visions, huh...
:{{DIcon}} So full of hope.
:{{DIcon}} An unwavering commitment to resistance.
:{{A|vo sglq102 2 fukami 03.ogg}} '''Fukami:''' Nobody knew where Your Excellency had gone, and we were starting to despair. But now we've found you. You are right here with us.
:{{A|vo sglq102 2 fukami 04.ogg}} '''Fukami:''' Just the sight of you appearing before us once more has reignited the hope in our hearts.
:{{A|vo sglq102 2 fukami 05.ogg}} '''Fukami:''' This hope is the light that will guide us out from the darkness.
:{{A|vo sglq102 2 fujiki 08.ogg}} '''Fujiki:''' Everyone, on me!
:{{A|vo sglq102 2 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' We'll help too!
:{{A|vo sglq102 2 fujiki 09.ogg}} '''Fujiki:''' Huh...?
:{{A|vo sglq102 2 fujiki 10.ogg}} '''Fujiki:''' Affirmative. But watch your backs!

;(Defeat the Rifthounds)
:{{A|vo sglq102 3 fukami 01.ogg}} '''Fukami:''' Protect the Almighty Shogun!

;(After defeating the Rifthounds)
:{{A|vo sglq102 3 fujiki 02.ogg}} '''Fujiki:''' It seems like their attacks are finally over.
:{{A|vo sglq102 3 fukami 03.ogg}} '''Fukami:''' Huh, I've never fought so fiercely before!
:{{A|vo sglq102 3 raidenei 01.ogg}} '''Ei:''' Thank you all...
:{{A|vo sglq102 3 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Umm... Are you okay? Maybe you should keep resting...
:{{A|vo sglq102 3 raidenei 02.ogg}} '''Ei:''' I'm fine. I feel much better already.
:{{A|vo sglq102 3 fujiki 03.ogg}} '''Fujiki:''' You fought phenomenally. It was truly awe-inspiring.
:{{A|vo sglq102 3 fujiki 04.ogg}} '''Fujiki:''' The monsters will definitely come back. And when they do, it'll be more than a few rifthounds this time.
:{{A|vo sglq102 3 fujiki 05.ogg}} '''Fujiki:''' Quickly, escort Her Excellency back to Inazuma City, and regroup with the general's forces as soon as possible.
:{{A|vo sglq102 3 fukami 04.ogg}} '''Fukami:''' When everyone sees the Almighty Shogun safely returning, their spirits will be lifted.
:{{A|vo sglq102 3 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Well... what're you guys gonna do?
:{{A|vo sglq102 3 fujiki 06.ogg}} '''Fujiki:''' We will stay here and guard against the monsters' advance. We cannot afford to let them get any further.
:{{A|vo sglq102 3 fujiki 07.ogg}} '''Fujiki:''' We are brothers in arms. As long as we stick together, we can face any number of monsters that come our way.
:{{A|vo sglq102 3 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' *gulp*...
:{{DIcon}} (We have no business disrupting the reality they are experiencing.)
:{{DIcon}} Great, thanks. I appreciate it.
:{{A|vo sglq102 3 fukami 05.ogg}} '''Fukami:''' Just leave it to us! Fighting is what we do best!
:{{A|vo sglq102 3 fukami 06.ogg}} '''Fukami:''' But the Almighty Shogun is the only one of us with the power to change the present state of affairs. Only Her Excellency can turn back the tide of despair and lead us onward into the future.
:{{A|vo sglq102 3 fukami 07.ogg}} '''Fukami:''' No matter what kind of threat faces Inazuma, we will always place our faith in the Almighty Shogun!
:{{A|vo sglq102 3 raidenei 03.ogg}} '''Ei:''' ...
:{{A|vo sglq102 3 raidenei 04.ogg}} '''Ei:''' Thank you all very much. I promise you that I will create a bright future for Inazuma.
:{{A|vo sglq102 3 raidenei 05.ogg}} '''Ei:''' I should not have left it this late to make this promise. But from this moment forth, know that I shall be true to my word.
:{{A|vo sglq102 3 fukami 08.ogg}} '''Fukami:''' Don't worry, Your Excellency. We will never doubt your word as long as we live!
:{{A|vo sglq102 3 fukami 09.ogg}} '''Fukami:''' With you leading us, we will claim back everything that Inazuma has lost!
:{{A|vo sglq102 3 fujiki 08.ogg}} '''Fujiki:''' Glory to the Shogun!
:{{A|vo sglq102 3 together 01.ogg}} '''Samurai:''' Glory to the Shogun!
:{{A|vo sglq102 3 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' ...They're gone.
:{{DIcon}} Was that a promise to them...?
:{{DIcon}} Or a promise to yourself?
:{{A|vo sglq102 3 raidenei 06.ogg}} '''Ei:''' It was both.
:{{A|vo sglq102 3 raidenei 07.ogg}} '''Ei:''' The people's sacrifice has always caused me immense pain, but in dwelling on the tragedy, I overlooked their splendor... The grief blinded me to how brightly they shone in their final moments.
:{{A|vo sglq102 3 raidenei 08.ogg}} '''Ei:''' The result being that in the centuries since their sacrifice, I have dishonored their will.
:{{A|vo sglq102 3 raidenei 09.ogg}} '''Ei:''' You could take the view that whatever I say to them is meaningless, because they are but disembodied memories held in the Ley Lines.
:{{A|vo sglq102 3 raidenei 10.ogg}} '''Ei:''' But even so, they are due a resolution... I owe it to them and to all the people who have placed their faith in me to date.
:{{A|vo sglq102 3 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Well... Paimon thinks that even if it's a few hundred years later, you're doing right by them now. And that's what counts.
:{{A|vo sglq102 3 raidenei 11.ogg}} '''Ei:''' Thank you for your comforting words. But this is my basic duty as Inazuma's archon, and I have neglected it for far too long.
:{{A|vo sglq102 3 raidenei 12.ogg}} '''Ei:''' I used to think just like that samurai... that I was first and foremost a warrior, and my only duty was to face whatever challenge came my way.
:{{A|vo sglq102 3 raidenei 13.ogg}} '''Ei:''' But what Inazuma needs more than a warrior is someone like Makoto.
:{{A|vo sglq102 3 raidenei 14.ogg}} '''Ei:''' Even though I am utterly unlike Makoto, and can never become the person she was, I still need to do the things that she would have done.
:{{DIcon}} Humans are worthy of your trust.
:{{A|vo sglq102 3 raidenei 15.ogg}} '''Ei:''' Yes, they are. They are strong and resilient, and have much to be proud of.
:{{A|vo sglq102 3 raidenei 16.ogg}} '''Ei:''' As the Raiden Shogun they revere, I should not be the one to hold them back.
:{{A|vo sglq102 3 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Well said! Sounds to Paimon like you've figured things out.
:{{A|vo sglq102 3 raidenei 17.ogg}} '''Ei:''' Change will come to Inazuma, and with it, new possibilities. This will take time, but eventually, the future will bring healing to the scars of the past.
:{{A|vo sglq102 3 raidenei 18.ogg}} '''Ei:''' No matter how long it takes, I am committed to bringing this to fruition. This is my promise.
:{{A|vo sglq102 3 raidenei 19.ogg}} '''Ei:''' Now that we've dealt with the rifthounds, this matter is halfway resolved. It does not appear that the threat will escalate for the time being.
:{{A|vo sglq102 3 raidenei 20.ogg}} '''Ei:''' I will leave the Tenryou and Yashiro Commissions to handle the follow-up work, such as investigating the origins of this incident and tending to the root system.
:{{A|vo sglq102 3 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Alrighty then! Let's move on.

:{{A|vo sglq102 3 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ei looks calm on the outside, but Paimon bets her emotions must be all over the place right now, huh?
:{{A|vo sglq102 3 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' She seems to have changed a lot since we last met her.
:{{A|vo sglq102 3 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' ...Hmm?
:{{A|vo sglq102 3 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What's wrong, Ei? C'mon, keep up.
:{{A|vo sglq102 3 raidenei 21.ogg}} '''Ei:''' Ugh...
:{{DIcon}} Ei!
:{{A|vo sglq102 3 paimon 12.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What's going on? Are you feeling unwell again?
:{{A|vo sglq102 3 raidenei 22.ogg}} '''Ei:''' My body... I can't move it.
:{{A|vo sglq102 3 raidenei 23.ogg}} '''Ei:''' It looks like the situation is more serious than I thought.
:{{DIcon}} Do you need to take a rest?
:{{DIcon}} We should get you back to the city.
:{{A|vo sglq102 3 raidenei 24.ogg}} '''Ei:''' No need. "She" is calling me. The time has come.
:{{A|vo sglq102 3 raidenei 25.ogg}} '''Ei:''' Can you help me walk, {{Traveler}}?
:{{A|vo sglq102 3 raidenei 26.ogg}} '''Ei:''' I need to go to the cave below the Grand Narukami Shrine.
:{{A|vo sglq102 3 paimon 13.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Why? What's in there?
:{{A|vo sglq102 3 raidenei 27.ogg}} '''Ei:''' A battleground... One where I shall sever ties with the past and take the first steps into the future.
{{Dialogue End}}

{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Go to the cave beneath the Grand Narukami Shrine)
:{{A|vo sglq102 4 raidenei 01.ogg}} '''Ei:''' We're finally here. The entrance should be nearby...
:{{A|vo sglq102 4 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Whoa, where'd that torii gate come from?
:{{DIcon}} Are you alright?
:{{A|vo sglq102 4 raidenei 02.ogg}} '''Ei:''' It's getting worse again... But it's fine, I'm about to put an end to it all.
:{{A|vo sglq102 4 raidenei 03.ogg}} '''Ei:''' This is a place I once sealed off with my own hands... The entrance to Raiden Makoto's [[Realm of Consciousness|realm of consciousness]].
:{{A|vo sglq102 4 raidenei 04.ogg}} '''Ei:''' It looks like "she" will no longer allow me to do with this body as I please.
:{{A|vo sglq102 4 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh? What are you talking about? And who is "she" — Makoto?
:{{A|vo sglq102 4 raidenei 05.ogg}} '''Ei:''' Follow me.
:{{A|vo sglq102 4 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Where are we g— aah, aaah aaaah!!!

:{{color|menu|You are dragged into a mysterious space by some unknown energy.}}

;(Enter the realm of consciousness)
:{{A|vo sglq102 5 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ugh... Paimon's dizzy, where did we get sucked into this time...
:{{A|vo sglq102 5 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Whoa! This place...
:{{DIcon}} It does look a lot like the Plane of Euthymia.
:{{A|vo sglq102 5 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Look! Look, over there!
:{{A|vo sglq102 5 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' It's another Ei!
:{{A|vo sglq102 5 raidenshogun 01.ogg}} '''Raiden Shogun:''' We meet again, Traveler.
:{{A|vo sglq102 5 raidenshogun 02.ogg}} '''Raiden Shogun:''' This body is an assistant to the one within. But it is also the guardian of the rules.
:{{A|vo sglq102 5 raidenshogun 03.ogg}} '''Raiden Shogun:''' Should the one within wish to stray from the rules, this body shall stand in her way.
:{{A|vo sglq102 5 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wait, Paimon knows that voice... is that... the puppet!?
:{{A|vo sglq102 5 raidenshogun 04.ogg}} '''Raiden Shogun:''' You have wandered the realm in my body, and you appear to have grasped the true essence of eternity.
:{{A|vo sglq102 5 raidenshogun 05.ogg}} '''Raiden Shogun:''' You believe your present self has greater certainty than your former self. Thus, you believe your present self is correct. Don't you?
:{{A|vo sglq102 5 raidenshogun 06.ogg}} '''Raiden Shogun:''' But have you really been enlightened with new ideas? Or have you been degraded by irreversible erosion?
:{{A|vo sglq102 5 raidenei 01.ogg}} '''Ei:''' I'm here to show you my answer.
:{{A|vo sglq102 5 raidenei 02.ogg}} '''Ei:''' We are both warriors, and the dialogue we must now have shall be conducted by the blade alone.
:{{A|vo sglq102 5 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Uhhh, wait, wait, wait, the atmosphere in here just took a turn for the worse!
:{{A|vo sglq102 5 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' A—Are you, uh, are you alright now?
:{{A|vo sglq102 5 raidenei 03.ogg}} '''Ei:''' The discomfort I was experiencing earlier was caused by the Shogun rejecting my continued use of her body.
:{{A|vo sglq102 5 raidenei 04.ogg}} '''Ei:''' As she indicates, once I started entertaining the idea of change, I became hostile in her eyes.
:{{A|vo sglq102 5 raidenei 05.ogg}} '''Ei:''' But inside a realm of consciousness, I exist independently of her. She cannot affect me in this way.
:{{A|vo sglq102 5 raidenei 06.ogg}} '''Ei:''' Though she is a puppet, the Shogun has her own consciousness, too. When necessary, she appears here to confront me.
:{{DIcon}} I think you've mentioned this before...
:{{DIcon}} This is her system to safeguard against modifications to eternity?
:{{A|vo sglq102 5 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Uh... Paimon gets that everyone has their internal battles and stuff, but... not like this! It's a bit extreme!
:{{A|vo sglq102 5 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ei's showdown with the Shogun... Never thought we'd see that day.
:{{A|vo sglq102 5 raidenei 07.ogg}} '''Ei:''' The rules I set for the Shogun are... no, the Shogun herself is the manifestation of my past ideals, the very foundation stone of eternity. It shall not be easily swayed.
:{{A|vo sglq102 5 raidenei 08.ogg}} '''Ei:''' I would not try to change her if it wasn't necessary.
:{{A|vo sglq102 5 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Isn't there any other way? Can't you... talk it through? ...Or something?
:{{DIcon}} Ei isn't someone who leaves herself an escape route.
:{{A|vo sglq102 5 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' But they both just want the best for Inazuma...
:{{A|vo sglq102 5 raidenshogun 07.ogg}} '''Raiden Shogun:''' My form is a symbol of supreme majesty, in which has been vested power over all the realm. It is the cohesive embodiment of all that constitutes the "Raiden Shogun."
:{{A|vo sglq102 5 raidenshogun 08.ogg}} '''Raiden Shogun:''' It inherits Ei's pain — the pain of inevitable loss that comes as she moves forward. So too does it inherit her determination to reach eternity.
:{{A|vo sglq102 5 raidenshogun 09.ogg}} '''Raiden Shogun:''' Every action undertaken is for the sake of resisting erosion.
:{{A|vo sglq102 5 raidenshogun 10.ogg}} '''Raiden Shogun:''' Determination, courage, love, hatred... All of these will be degraded and distorted by the incessant flow of time.
:{{A|vo sglq102 5 raidenshogun 11.ogg}} '''Raiden Shogun:''' Only rules shall remain constant for eternity.
:{{A|vo sglq102 5 raidenei 09.ogg}} '''Ei:''' Those were my thoughts when I created you.
:{{A|vo sglq102 5 raidenei 10.ogg}} '''Ei:''' Now they are towering obstacles that I have no choice but to overcome.
:{{A|vo sglq102 5 raidenshogun 12.ogg}} '''Raiden Shogun:''' You wish to make yourself my enemy?
:{{A|vo sglq102 5 raidenshogun 13.ogg}} '''Raiden Shogun:''' I am your past, the everlasting law, the guardian of eternity.
:{{A|vo sglq102 5 raidenei 11.ogg}} '''Ei:''' And I am she who promised a dream to her subjects... Raiden Ei.

;(Fight the Raiden Shogun)
:{{A|vo sglq102 5 raidenshogun 14.ogg}} '''Raiden Shogun:''' In the end, even the proud and mighty oni maiden was cut down and disgraced...
:{{A|vo sglq102 5 raidenshogun 15.ogg}} '''Raiden Shogun:''' Though your blade has been cleansed of her blood and filth, never shall it shine as brightly as it once did.

;(If the player's Raiden Shogun reaches low health for the first time)
:{{A|vo sglq102 6 raidenei 01.ogg}} '''Ei:''' I shall not fall here.

;(When the enemy Raiden Shogun reaches low health, she completely recovers)
:{{A|vo sglq102 6 raidenshogun 01.ogg}} '''Raiden Shogun:''' The Kitsune's Sakura blossoms that once filled the skies fell to the ground as pitch-black rain...
:{{A|vo sglq102 6 raidenshogun 02.ogg}} '''Raiden Shogun:''' As long as the Ley Lines flow, the relentless erosion of time will never stop.
:{{A|vo sglq102 6 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Sh—She's completely recovered!?

;(When the enemy Raiden Shogun reaches low health a second time, she completely recovers again)
:{{A|vo sglq102 6 raidenshogun 03.ogg}} '''Raiden Shogun:''' The divine lightning that envelops all of Inazuma will fade silently into the clouds...
:{{A|vo sglq102 6 raidenshogun 04.ogg}} '''Raiden Shogun:''' There shall never be another. Never, for the rest of time...

;(Upon defeating the enemy Raiden Shogun for the third time)
:{{A|vo sglq102 7 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Have you finally defeated her?
:{{A|vo sglq102 7 raidenshogun 01.ogg}} '''Raiden Shogun:''' It appears your martial prowess has not dulled.
:{{A|vo sglq102 7 raidenshogun 02.ogg}} '''Raiden Shogun:''' But how long can your will remain strong?
:{{A|vo sglq102 7 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' How the heck...
:{{DIcon}} Surely the Shogun puppet isn't invincible...?
:{{A|vo sglq102 7 raidenei 01.ogg}} '''Ei:''' In this realm of consciousness, her existence is tenacious indeed.
:{{A|vo sglq102 7 raidenei 02.ogg}} '''Ei:''' She was built to resist erosion. Her will is stronger than any other living being's, including you and me.
:{{A|vo sglq102 7 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Then... does that mean this is gonna be a never-ending battle?
:{{A|vo sglq102 7 raidenei 03.ogg}} '''Ei:''' Maybe. But I have to prove to her that my present will is no product of erosion. The future I shall forge will be a grand undertaking, one that will be resistant to erosion.
:{{A|vo sglq102 7 raidenei 04.ogg}} '''Ei:''' If I don't do this, the Shogun's rules can never change, and Inazuma can never move forward.
:{{A|vo sglq102 7 raidenei 05.ogg}} '''Ei:''' This is my duty. No matter how long this battle may last, months, years, centuries... And no matter how many times we must fight, I will defeat her.
:{{DIcon}} What will happen to Inazuma in the meantime?
:{{A|vo sglq102 7 raidenei 06.ogg}} '''Ei:''' Five hundred years ago, humanity proved their strength in battle.
:{{A|vo sglq102 7 raidenei 07.ogg}} '''Ei:''' Here in the present, they rely on their ambition to challenge wayward practices, tear them out like the diseased wood of an old sakura tree, so that new, healthy branches might spring to life in their place.
:{{A|vo sglq102 7 raidenei 08.ogg}} '''Ei:''' It is about time that I learned to trust them.
:{{DIcon}} But can you bear to leave humanity to go alone?
:{{DIcon}} Everyone looks to the Shogun for hope.
:{{A|vo sglq102 7 raidenei 09.ogg}} '''Ei:''' I understand that. But if the dreams of which Makoto spoke are true eternity, a short moment for which the Shogun does not exist is nothing to fear.
:{{A|vo sglq102 7 raidenei 10.ogg}} '''Ei:''' I fight for the everlasting future of Inazuma. However long the battle may last, it is but a drop in the ocean of eternity.
:{{A|vo sglq102 7 raidenei 11.ogg}} '''Ei:''' I vow to the subjects of Inazuma that I shall one day return. This is my oath. Please be my witness.
:{{A|vo sglq102 7 raidenei 12.ogg}} '''Ei:''' During my absence, I place everything in Miko's hands.
:{{A|vo sglq102 7 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' But, but this means that—
:{{A|vo sglq102 7 raidenei 13.ogg}} '''Ei:''' Pass on my words.

:{{color|menu|You were chased out of that dimension by Ei.}}

:{{DIcon}} Ei!

----

:{{A|vo sglq102 8 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' ...Oh, but we also can't get in there anymore.
:{{A|vo sglq102 8 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Okay, well first things first, we gotta find a way back in! C'mon brain juice, don't fail Paimon now! Um, okay, maybe if we both ram into it at the same time, really really hard—

:{{A|vo sglq102 8 paimon 12.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Who knows if she really understands these consciousness realm-plane thingies more than we do... But there's no one else we can turn to. Alright, up the mountain we go!

==Dialogue==
{{Quest Description|It's about time to say goodbye to your shroom buddies...}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Pass time)
:{{A|vo eqpm006 1 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' {{Traveler}}, Bongo-Head! It's time for us to meet up with everyone in Port Ormos!
:{{A|vo eqpm006 1 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Let's go see Layla first, then Miko, and finally... go give our Fungi over to Haniyyah.

;(Approach [[Berbere]]'s stall)
:{{A|vo eqpm006 2 layla 01.ogg}} '''Layla:''' {{Traveler}}, Paimon, Bongo-Head! Over here!
:{{A|vo eqpm006 2 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hey, Layla! Have you and Twirly-Whirly been having fun these past few days?
:{{A|vo eqpm006 2 layla 02.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Definitely! With Twirly-Whirly helping me carry my luggage, we could go camping really far away, and I got to see the stars from a different perspective. I even managed to make some progress with my paper!
:{{A|vo eqpm006 2 layla 03.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Although... I've tried making almost everything on my food list now. Every time I used flour or something, it got in the air and gave me a coughing fit... But after all that, I still haven't figured out what Twirly-Whirly likes.
:{{A|vo eqpm006 2 layla 04.ogg}} '''Layla:''' It would be great if the improved Wisdom Orb allowed us to communicate directly with the Fungi... Oh! I should mention that in my letter and get someone to ask a senior Amurta scholar!
:{{A|vo eqpm006 2 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Paimon's never seen you in such good spirits, Layla! You spoke a lot more than usual just now, and you're still full of life... You really go the extra mile for your shroom buddies.
:{{A|vo eqpm006 2 layla 05.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Whew, I think I might've overexerted myself though... I'm flagging hard. Let's go see Miss Yae before I crash ...

;(Approach the marked location on the docks)
:{{A|vo eqpm006 3 yaemiko 01.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' Oh? You're earlier than I expected...
:{{A|vo eqpm006 3 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Miko, you're not leaving, are you? It feels like you never got to properly enjoy your vacation here...
:{{A|vo eqpm006 3 yaemiko 02.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' Oh, my needs for amusement have been more than met. Thanks to your help, our little inspiration hunt went perfectly. Not only did we gain invaluable experience in the tournament, we also had all the excitement of exposing a criminal conspiracy...
:{{A|vo eqpm006 3 yaemiko 03.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' Yes, I think I might ask Souka to ditch her original characters and just make you the protagonists in her next novel.
:{{DIcon}} You were helping behind the scenes.
:{{DIcon}} You knew there was something up with Elchingen.
:{{A|vo eqpm006 3 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' True! It all makes sense now. You dropped so many hints, but it went over Paimon's head at the time!
:{{A|vo eqpm006 3 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Why didn't you expose Elchingen right away, though? Why wait for things to escalate like they did?
:{{A|vo eqpm006 3 yaemiko 04.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' Going for the big reveal right at the beginning would have been an anti-climax of the most literal kind. I wanted to see how you'd react in a situation like this, and you did not disappoint...
:{{A|vo eqpm006 3 yaemiko 05.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' I thought that the story between you and the Fungi would follow a master-servant paradigm, but you offered something even better: companionship, based on mutual understanding.
:{{A|vo eqpm006 3 yaemiko 06.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' From a certain point of view, it seems fitting that Elchingen, the one person who could barely keep the word "Master" from his lips, met his downfall at your hand. Of course, considering what he's capable of, I'm sure he'll have his ways of continuing to put up a fight...
:{{A|vo eqpm006 3 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Paimon's getting confused again... In the future, we should take notes when Miko's talking and carefully look over them later...
:{{A|vo eqpm006 3 yaemiko 07.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' That's enough chatting for now. I'll leave Blitzara in your hands. Remember to take good care of it.
:{{A|vo eqpm006 3 yaemiko 08.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' I hope you really give this a good shot, you and Haniyyah. The future of this highly entertaining tournament depends on the decisions you make from now on... I'm excited to see what you've got in store for us.

;(Approach the marked location west of Port Ormos)
:{{A|vo eqpm006 4 haniyyah 01.ogg}} '''Haniyyah:''' Hello, all. Right on time.
:{{A|vo eqpm006 4 haniyyah 02.ogg}} '''Haniyyah:''' I've collected all the other contestants' Wisdom Orbs and found a suitable place for our Fungi friends to live. I'll make absolutely sure the surrounding environment is not affected.
:{{A|vo eqpm006 4 haniyyah 03.ogg}} '''Haniyyah:''' Say hello to everyone, Kindlejoy.
:{{DIcon}} "Kindlejoy"?
:{{A|vo eqpm006 4 haniyyah 04.ogg}} '''Haniyyah:''' That's Pyro-1's new name. When I saw how well-behaved it was when we first met, a sense of joy welled up inside me.
:{{A|vo eqpm006 4 haniyyah 05.ogg}} '''Haniyyah:''' If I'd just let go of my preconceived notions about Fungi and allowed myself to truly feel that moment... Maybe I could have felt like that all this time.
:{{A|vo eqpm006 4 layla 01.ogg}} '''Layla:''' I'm so glad Haniyyah has finally worked things out...
:{{A|vo eqpm006 4 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yeah! Even though Paimon has gotten used to the name "Pyro-1" at this point, the new name holds so much more significance!
:{{DIcon}} Congratulations, Haniyyah.
:{{DIcon}} Congratulations to you too, Kindlejoy.
:{{A|vo eqpm006 4 haniyyah 06.ogg}} '''Haniyyah:''' I will commit to giving these gentle creatures the highest standard of care I can provide. Please rest assured that your Fungi friends will be safe with me.
:{{A|vo eqpm006 4 layla 02.ogg}} '''Layla:''' I guess it's... time for us to say goodbye...
:{{A|vo eqpm006 4 layla 03.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Go on, Twirly-Whirly. Be a good Fungus now, and do everything that Haniyyah says...
:{{A|vo eqpm006 4 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Blitzara, Miko will be back to visit when the next beast tamers tournament comes around.
:{{A|vo eqpm006 4 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' High five, Bongo-Head! It was really fun having you around. Paimon hopes you have a good time at Haniyyah's, and is really looking forward to seeing you again next time!
:{{DIcon}} We'll meet again... that's a promise!
:{{A|vo eqpm006 4 haniyyah 07.ogg}} '''Haniyyah:''' I hope that the day when humans and Fungi can live in harmony will come quickly...
:{{A|vo eqpm006 4 haniyyah 08.ogg}} '''Haniyyah:''' I believe in you all, you'll make it happen! I look forward to the good news!
{{Dialogue End}}

==Dialogue==
{{Quest Description|With the aid of Zhongli's knowledge, you are able to undo the seals, but before entering the ruin, he lays a condition before Wanyan and Kliment: to alternate who gets claim to each treasure encountered, with only one object permitted per claim.}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Examine the statues)
:'''Examine Statue:''' (A bizarre-looking statue that appears to be made of salt)

;(You encounter towering white figures in the ruin...)
:{{A|vo zllq004 1 wanyan 01.ogg}} '''Wanyan:''' A—Are these... statues?
:{{A|vo zllq004 1 zhongli 01.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' No. These are people.
:{{A|vo zllq004 1 kliment 01.ogg}} '''Kliment:''' Urgh...
:{{A|vo zllq004 1 zhongli 02.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' They were probably followers of the [[God of Salt]].
:{{A|vo zllq004 1 kliment 02.ogg}} '''Kliment:''' How did they become this way...?
:{{A|vo zllq004 1 wanyan 02.ogg}} '''Wanyan:''' What in the world is hidden deep in this ruin...?

----

;(Explore further and look for divine relics)
:'''Examine Salinized Adherent:''' (He is transfixed in an earnest posture... No, perhaps he was also... afraid?)

;(You find a strange chalice on an altar...)
:{{A|vo zllq004 2 wanyan 01.ogg}} '''Wanyan:''' Look at this. It's filled halfway with salt.
:{{A|vo zllq004 2 kliment 01.ogg}} '''Kliment:''' Just looks like a fancy salt holder. Seems like the God of Salt was a god lacking in treasures.
:{{A|vo zllq004 2 zhongli 01.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' According to my knowledge, it's no ordinary vessel. Although it is only half-full, it is also forever half-full — that is to say, it is bottomless.
:{{A|vo zllq004 2 kliment 02.ogg}} '''Kliment:''' What!? You're saying that even if I pour the salt out, the amount inside won't change!?
:{{A|vo zllq004 2 zhongli 02.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Exactly.
:{{A|vo zllq004 2 wanyan 02.ogg}} '''Wanyan:''' Able to produce endless salt... The God of Salt is powerful indeed!
:{{A|vo zllq004 2 kliment 03.ogg}} '''Kliment:''' Finally, after all that effort, I've found precious treasure! I claim this as mine!
:{{A|vo zllq004 2 kliment 04.ogg}} '''Kliment:''' I just need to pour the endless salt into a thousand, or ten-thousand bags... I can sell it and make a fortune!
:{{A|vo zllq004 2 wanyan 03.ogg}} '''Wanyan:''' Hey! How can you use a relic of the God of Salt for such a shallow pursuit!?
:{{A|vo zllq004 2 zhongli 03.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' If Mr. Kliment wants this salt chalice, then the next object we find will belong to Miss Wanyan, according to the contract agreed upon.
:{{A|vo zllq004 2 kliment 05.ogg}} '''Kliment:''' Of course, as we agreed. Hehe, but how can anything be worth more than this rare find?
:{{A|vo zllq004 2 wanyan 04.ogg}} '''Wanyan:''' Since we have a contract, it's no use for me to fight with him...
:{{A|vo zllq004 2 zhongli 04.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Then let's move on, shall we?

----

;(You discover a strange ruler on a separate altar...)
:{{A|vo zllq004 3 kliment 01.ogg}} '''Kliment:''' Ha, just a simple ruler. Doesn't look to be worth anything.
:{{A|vo zllq004 3 wanyan 01.ogg}} '''Wanyan:''' This... If I remember correctly, this is some kind of measuring tool.
:{{A|vo zllq004 3 zhongli 01.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Indeed. But the God of Salt imbued it with another power.
:{{A|vo zllq004 3 zhongli 02.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' When you stick this ruler in the ground, the surrounding area will become covered in salt, much like a rising tide covers the earth.
:{{A|vo zllq004 3 zhongli 03.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' The deeper it is stuck in the ground, the more salt will appear. It is essentially a "bumper harvest" of salt.
:{{A|vo zllq004 3 kliment 02.ogg}} '''Kliment:''' Th—That's even better than the salt chalice!
:{{A|vo zllq004 3 zhongli 04.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Well then, according to our contract, the salt ruler goes to Miss Wanyan.
:{{A|vo zllq004 3 kliment 03.ogg}} '''Kliment:''' No! Unacceptable! I paid for and organized this entire expedition. Why should I get the short end of the stick!
:{{A|vo zllq004 3 kliment 04.ogg}} '''Kliment:''' And this girl has been useless. Why should she get anything!?
:{{A|vo zllq004 3 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh boy, here we go again...
:{{DIcon}} *sigh*
:{{DIcon}} While we're on the topic of "useless" people...
:{{A|vo zllq004 3 zhongli 05.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' So you are saying, you want to break the contract?
:{{A|vo zllq004 3 kliment 05.ogg}} '''Kliment:''' So what if I break it? Now that I've seen how the mechanisms in this ruin work, I no longer need you.
:{{A|vo zllq004 3 kliment 06.ogg}} '''Kliment:''' Let's not forget who hired who here. Why should I let you make the rules?
:{{A|vo zllq004 3 zhongli 06.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Because you agreed to a contract.
:{{A|vo zllq004 3 zhongli 07.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' [[Rex Lapis]] once said: "Ones who break their contracts shall suffer the Wrath of the Rock."
:{{A|vo zllq004 3 kliment 07.ogg}} '''Kliment:''' That is one of your Liyue gods. I am from [[Snezhnaya]], I—
:{{A|vo zllq004 3 zhongli 08.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' —Will "suffer the Wrath of the Rock" — you may find it rather unpleasant.

----

;(After defeating Kliment)
:{{A|vo zllq004 4 zhongli 01.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' I shall confiscate your treasure as well.
:{{A|vo zllq004 4 zhongli 02.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' You are not worthy to continue any further into the ruin. Leave this place.
:{{A|vo zllq004 4 kliment 01.ogg}} '''Kliment:''' Darn you... Just you wait!

;(Talk to Zhongli and Wanyan)
:{{A|vo zllq004 4 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Some "archaeological survey..." He could only pretend for so long.
:{{DIcon}} At least we had our guard up.
::{{A|vo zllq004 4 paimon 02a.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yeah, good thing Paimon can smell a liar from a mile away.
:{{DIcon}} I hope you never become as greedy as him, Paimon.
::{{A|vo zllq004 4 paimon 02b.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hey! Paimon likes [[Mora]], but Paimon doesn't do bad things!
:{{A|vo zllq004 4 zhongli 03.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Kliment's wrongdoing stemmed from greed, yes. But besides greed, there are many other things that may tempt us to break contracts.
:{{A|vo zllq004 4 zhongli 04.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' When people see the object of their dreams, how many are really able to control their desire and follow the contract...?
:{{A|vo zllq004 4 zhongli 05.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' I think we should be honest with each other now.
:{{A|vo zllq004 4 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh? Be honest about what?
:{{A|vo zllq004 4 zhongli 06.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' That in truth, not a single member of this "archaeological expedition" came here for archaeology.
:{{A|vo zllq004 4 wanyan 01.ogg}} '''Wanyan:''' Wh—Why do you say that?
:{{A|vo zllq004 4 zhongli 07.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Miss, you lack even the most basic archaeological knowledge and can recognize naught but a few simple relics. However, you are an expert when it comes to anything regarding the God of Salt.
:{{A|vo zllq004 4 zhongli 08.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' You aren't interested in archaeology or relics — what you're really interested in is the God of Salt.
:{{A|vo zllq004 4 zhongli 09.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' I believe those legends about the God of Salt that you mentioned on the [[Pearl Galley]] are passed down between generations at [[Yinyuan Hall]]...
:{{A|vo zllq004 4 wanyan 02.ogg}} '''Wanyan:''' Okay, that's enough!
:{{A|vo zllq004 4 wanyan 03.ogg}} '''Wanyan:''' ...Sir, you are indeed a man of great knowledge and talents. I seem to have been right to seek you out, once I plucked up my courage.
:{{A|vo zllq004 4 wanyan 04.ogg}} '''Wanyan:''' You're right. I'm not a scholar of archaeology. I come from one of the [[Eight Trades]] under the jurisdiction of the [[Qixing]] — [[Yinyuan Hall]] of the salt industry.
:{{A|vo zllq004 4 wanyan 05.ogg}} '''Wanyan:''' Our ancestors were those protected by the God of Salt all those years, when the [[Archon War]] engulfed the land in chaos.
:{{DIcon}} Come to think of it, I've never heard you say "Rex Lapis"...
:{{DIcon}} Hmm, I've never heard you say "Lord of Geo"...
:{{A|vo zllq004 4 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh right. Now that you mention it, the people of Liyue very seldom use the name "Morax"...
:{{A|vo zllq004 4 wanyan 06.ogg}} '''Wanyan:''' During the war, Morax assassinated our god out of envy for her power! He left us alone and lost in the world.
:{{A|vo zllq004 4 wanyan 07.ogg}} '''Wanyan:''' We... We hate him! But this is Morax's Liyue, after all, and its history is written as he wishes...
:{{A|vo zllq004 4 wanyan 08.ogg}} '''Wanyan:''' So, I seek proof of Morax's guilt! He has blood on his hands, and cruelty in his heart!
:{{A|vo zllq004 4 zhongli 10.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' ...
:{{A|vo zllq004 4 wanyan 09.ogg}} '''Wanyan:''' We agreed to a contract that we will face the truth head-on, didn't we Mr. Zhongli!? You must judge this history fairly!
:{{A|vo zllq004 4 zhongli 11.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Naturally, of course. But I must add, Liyue is no longer Morax's Liyue.
:{{A|vo zllq004 4 zhongli 12.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Come with me. All the answers you seek lie ahead.

----

;(Examine the broken sword)
:{{A|vo zllq004 5 wanyan 01.ogg}} '''Wanyan:''' This is... a sword?

:{{A|vo zllq004 5 zhongli 03.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' When there's a contract, nothing can be allowed to "slide." If the contract is not followed, then it is broken.
:{{A|vo zllq004 5 wanyan 07.ogg}} '''Wanyan:''' No! If I only take one half, then it can't be repaired, and the power of the God of Salt cannot be restored...
:{{A|vo zllq004 5 wanyan 08.ogg}} '''Wanyan:''' No matter what, I must be faithful to her...
:{{A|vo zllq004 5 wanyan 09.ogg}} '''Wanyan:''' Even if it breaks the contract, I don't care.
:{{A|vo zllq004 5 zhongli 04.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' So you are already decided? Hmm... Then, there is a price to pay for breaking the contract.
:{{A|vo zllq004 5 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Zhongli!
:{{A|vo zllq004 5 zhongli 05.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' That is to say, you consign yourself to "suffer the Wrath of the Rock."
:{{A|vo zllq004 5 wanyan 10.ogg}} '''Wanyan:''' That... That's okay. The God of Salt gave up her life to protect her people. My sacrifice is nothing compared to that.
:{{A|vo zllq004 5 wanyan 11.ogg}} '''Wanyan:''' Punish me however you want. Just let me take this proof of my faith!
:{{A|vo zllq004 5 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' No, you can't hit her!
:{{A|vo zllq004 5 zhongli 06.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Perhaps that punishment would be easier for her, but...
:{{A|vo zllq004 5 zhongli 07.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' As punishment, I will tell you the truth.
:{{A|vo zllq004 5 wanyan 12.ogg}} '''Wanyan:''' Huh?
:{{A|vo zllq004 5 wanyan 13.ogg}} '''Wanyan:''' The truth? You mean the truth is my punishment?
:{{A|vo zllq004 5 zhongli 08.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Yes. The truth that I am about to tell you shall be your price to pay for breaking the contract.
:{{A|vo zllq004 5 zhongli 09.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' I'm afraid to say that the God of Salt, Havria, was not the powerful god you imagine her to be.
:{{A|vo zllq004 5 zhongli 10.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Rather, she was a small and weak god who yielded to all other gods. When it came to war, she lost... never able to win a seat among [[The Seven]].
:{{A|vo zllq004 5 wanyan 14.ogg}} '''Wanyan:''' Wh—What...!?
:{{A|vo zllq004 5 zhongli 11.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' During the Archon War, the gods of this world used all their strength and cunning to vie for control of [[Teyvat]].
:{{A|vo zllq004 5 zhongli 12.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' But Havria instead chose to flee. She thought that by giving up before a fight could start, she could save herself and her people from the war.
:{{A|vo zllq004 5 zhongli 13.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' However, during such a long war, there is no end to the advances of aggressors.
:{{A|vo zllq004 5 zhongli 14.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' After making countless concessions, Havria had lost all of her lands until only one small haven remained.
:{{A|vo zllq004 5 wanyan 15.ogg}} '''Wanyan:''' No... no... it can't be so...
:{{A|vo zllq004 5 zhongli 15.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' In her last days, she had not even a single blade to defend her people with.
:{{A|vo zllq004 5 wanyan 16.ogg}} '''Wanyan:''' "Not even a single blade?" Then, this sword...
:{{A|vo zllq004 5 zhongli 16.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' This sword is not a relic belonging to the God of Salt... but is instead the murder weapon used to kill her.
:{{A|vo zllq004 5 wanyan 17.ogg}} '''Wanyan:''' Murder weapon?
:{{A|vo zllq004 5 wanyan 18.ogg}} '''Wanyan:''' No! That's not true, that can't be true! You are trying to test my faith in the God of Salt!
:{{A|vo zllq004 5 zhongli 17.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' As I said before, I only state the facts.
:{{A|vo zllq004 5 wanyan 19.ogg}} '''Wanyan:''' Preposterous! Y—You are a follower of Morax, don't try to trick me!

;(Wanyan cannot accept Zhongli's words. She storms off further into the ruin...)
:{{A|vo zllq004 5 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hey! Heyyy! Come back!
:{{DIcon}} That was too much for her to take.
::{{A|vo zllq004 5 zhongli 18a.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' It is a punishment, after all. I did not want to tell her such cruel facts, but the contract was broken...
:{{DIcon}} What you said really is true, right?
::{{A|vo zllq004 5 zhongli 18b.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Indeed. Otherwise, why would I use the truth as punishment? I did not want to tell her such cruel facts, but the contract was broken...
:{{A|vo zllq004 5 zhongli 19.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Let's follow her deeper into the ruin. There, I fear, we will find something that will leave her no choice but to face the truth.

----
