:{{A|vo yjcop001 1904703 yunjin 06.ogg}} '''Yun Jin:''' It's okay if you can't recall the events clearly. You can just replace them with the movements you are most familiar with...
:{{A|vo yjcop001 1904703 yunjin 07.ogg}} '''Yun Jin:''' And... attack, {{Traveler}}! "The three adepti are manning the Guizhong Ballistas. Do not let the Fatui disturb their work!"

;(Talk to Yun Jin, optional)
:{{A|vo yjcop001 1904752 yunjin 01.ogg}} '''Yun Jin:''' "The three adepti are manning the Guizhong Ballistas. Do not let the Fatui disturb their work!"
----
;(After the training)
:{{A|vo yjcop001 1904704 yunjin 01.ogg}} '''Yun Jin:''' Hmm...
:{{DIcon}} H-how did it go?
:{{A|vo yjcop001 1904704 yunjin 02.ogg}} '''Yun Jin:''' I can't fault your movements in terms of technique...
:{{A|vo yjcop001 1904704 yunjin 03.ogg}} '''Yun Jin:''' But Fatui are larger than most monsters.
:{{A|vo yjcop001 1904704 yunjin 04.ogg}} '''Yun Jin:''' I don't think it was a conscious decision, but you were aiming a little too low, and you also didn't strike with enough force. Overall, it was just lacking that sense of being in the heat of the battle.
:{{A|vo yjcop001 1904704 yunjin 05.ogg}} '''Yun Jin:''' Veteran practitioners of this acting method are able to adjust and embellish their real life experience enough so that it makes an adequate substitute for the scene they are trying to portray.
:{{A|vo yjcop001 1904704 yunjin 06.ogg}} '''Yun Jin:''' But adjusting deep-rooted habits to adapt them for the stage... that's no easy task.
:{{DIcon}} Yeah, it doesn't sound easy...
:{{A|vo yjcop001 1904704 yunjin 07.ogg}} '''Yun Jin:''' Still, this was only your first time trying this method and all things considered, I think you've done quite well.
:{{A|vo yjcop001 1904704 yunjin 08.ogg}} '''Yun Jin:''' But judging from your movements, I think this next method might suit you a little better.
:{{DIcon}} What is it?
:{{A|vo yjcop001 1904704 yunjin 09.ogg}} '''Yun Jin:''' Choreograph every aspect of your onstage performance in advance — every movement, every facial expression, even your emotions — and rehearse it thoroughly.
:{{A|vo yjcop001 1904704 yunjin 10.ogg}} '''Yun Jin:''' You can reference existing characters from opera or imitate similar people from your own life...
:{{A|vo yjcop001 1904704 yunjin 11.ogg}} '''Yun Jin:''' In short, you want to pin down every detail of the character you want to portray in your mind, and then work through them methodically and find ways to bring them out.
:{{DIcon}} I don't fully understand...
:{{A|vo yjcop001 1904704 yunjin 12.ogg}} '''Yun Jin:''' Well... In your case, what you need to do is imitate your past self.
:{{A|vo yjcop001 1904704 yunjin 13.ogg}} '''Yun Jin:''' Think of yourself not as you, but as somebody outside this world controlling your every move...
:{{DIcon}} That's even harder to understand!
:{{A|vo yjcop001 1904704 yunjin 14.ogg}} '''Yun Jin:''' Heh. It's complicated to explain, but once you give it a try, I think you'll get the hang of it.
:{{A|vo yjcop001 1904704 yunjin 15.ogg}} '''Yun Jin:''' Okay, how about we start by setting a simple scenario.
:{{A|vo yjcop001 1904704 yunjin 16.ogg}} '''Yun Jin:''' The Fatui in red want to attack the Guizhong Ballista and the heavyweight guards in blue want to try and stop you.
:{{A|vo yjcop001 1904704 yunjin 17.ogg}} '''Yun Jin:''' What you want to do is {{Color|buzzword|evade all the blues}} and {{Color|buzzword|go straight for the reds}}...
:{{Black Screen|''Yun Jin tells you the various details...''}}
:{{A|vo yjcop001 1904704 yunjin 18.ogg}} '''Yun Jin:''' ...Yes, I think that sums it up.
:{{A|vo yjcop001 1904704 yunjin 19.ogg}} '''Yun Jin:''' There's an open area {{Color|buzzword|to the north}}. I'll set up a stage for you.
:{{A|vo yjcop001 1904704 yunjin 20.ogg}} '''Yun Jin:''' When you've finished rehearsing everything in your mind, come and find me.

:{{A|vo yjcop001 1904706 yunjin 01.ogg}} '''Yun Jin:''' Now that was a little better! You managed to bring out more of that "fearless hero" quality that time.
:{{A|vo yjcop001 1904706 yunjin 02.ogg}} '''Yun Jin:''' Hmm-hmm. My hard work coaching you has finally paid off.
:{{A|vo yjcop001 1904706 yunjin 03.ogg}} '''Yun Jin:''' This method might not sound as sophisticated and exciting as the first two, but it's the most popular choice for teaching beginners.
:{{A|vo yjcop001 1904706 yunjin 04.ogg}} '''Yun Jin:''' Rigorous rehearsal and vocal training is at the core of this school of thought. It even works on those whose performance lacks emotional depth at first.
:{{A|vo yjcop001 1904706 yunjin 05.ogg}} '''Yun Jin:''' As long as you practice diligently, with time, you will achieve mastery one way or another. Either your finely honed skills become a good substitute for innate talent, or the process of honing your skills cultivates genuine talent within you.
:{{A|vo yjcop001 1904706 yunjin 06.ogg}} '''Yun Jin:''' People say that when you truly master the art of singing, even the birds and beasts will be drawn to your song.
:{{DIcon}} That's amazing!
:{{A|vo yjcop001 1904706 yunjin 07.ogg}} '''Yun Jin:''' I know. Looks like I still have a long road ahead of me when it comes to developing as a performer...
:{{DIcon}} Couldn't you have gone with the beginner's method first?
:{{DIcon}} Why on earth didn't you start with this one?
:{{A|vo yjcop001 1904706 yunjin 08.ogg}} '''Yun Jin:''' Well, because... even if I had, you wouldn't have put your heart into it.
:{{A|vo yjcop001 1904706 yunjin 09.ogg}} '''Yun Jin:''' It's been written on your face this whole time: "Just try and keep her occupied until the next show."
:{{DIcon}} Was it that obvious...?
:{{DIcon}} I thought I was doing a good job of hiding it...
:{{A|vo yjcop001 1904706 yunjin 10.ogg}} '''Yun Jin:''' Hmm-hmm, don't forget that acting is my bread and butter. Did you really think I wouldn't be able to see through it?
:{{A|vo yjcop001 1904706 yunjin 11.ogg}} '''Yun Jin:''' Still, this is a rare opportunity and I hope you have at least learned something from it about the beauty of the performing arts.
:{{A|vo yjcop001 1904706 yunjin 12.ogg}} '''Yun Jin:''' The operatic tradition carries countless historical memories within it. As long as the art is kept alive, the voices and faces of bygone heroes can be recreated on the stage for generation after generation.
:{{A|vo yjcop001 1904706 yunjin 13.ogg}} '''Yun Jin:''' {{Traveler}}, I hope that your voice and your face will make their mark on Liyue opera, too.
:{{DIcon}} My voice and face...?
:{{DIcon}} Make a mark on Liyue opera?
:{{A|vo yjcop001 1904706 yunjin 14.ogg}} '''Yun Jin:''' Yes. As well as coaching you today, I have also been closely observing every movement you make.
:{{A|vo yjcop001 1904706 yunjin 15.ogg}} '''Yun Jin:''' Do you remember the basics of the final method?
:{{DIcon}} Reference existing characters from opera...
:{{DIcon}} Imitate similar people from your own life...
:{{A|vo yjcop001 1904706 yunjin 16.ogg}} '''Yun Jin:''' Don't you think there's a striking similarity between you, who stood up for Liyue and fought off a god of old, and the divine damsel in the play?
:{{A|vo yjcop001 1904706 yunjin 17.ogg}} '''Yun Jin:''' With you as a reference in mind, I'm sure I can finally make a breakthrough in creating my own adaptation of this character.
:{{DIcon}} Studying me can help you achieve a breakthrough?
:{{DIcon}} So why was your first method to go and put yourself in danger?
:{{A|vo yjcop001 1904706 yunjin 18.ogg}} '''Yun Jin:''' Because as far as I'm concerned, the immersion method, drawing on life experiences, and imitating others are all valuable acting methods.
:{{A|vo yjcop001 1904706 yunjin 19.ogg}} '''Yun Jin:''' Even if my every movement is rehearsed to perfection, I can't move the audience without conveying emotion.
:{{A|vo yjcop001 1904706 yunjin 20.ogg}} '''Yun Jin:''' And even if I fully master the character's emotions, a little choreography will help make the performance more polished and appealing.
:{{A|vo yjcop001 1904706 yunjin 21.ogg}} '''Yun Jin:''' Whatever the method is, as long as it offers something that can improve my performance, I will always give it a try.
:{{A|vo yjcop001 1904706 yunjin 22.ogg}} '''Yun Jin:''' Thank you for trying them out as well, {{Traveler}}. It means a lot to me.
:{{A|vo yjcop001 1904706 yunjin 23.ogg}} '''Yun Jin:''' And congratulations on making it to the end of your first acting class!
:{{DIcon}} When's my graduation ceremony?

:{{A|vo yjcop001 1904706 yunjin 25.ogg}} '''Yun Jin:''' For now, I hope to incorporate part of you into my performance of the divine damsel. But one day... I hope to write an opera all about you...
:{{A|vo yjcop001 1904706 yunjin 26.ogg}} '''Yun Jin:''' When that day comes, I hope you will be able to join me on stage, and give me some constructive criticism.
:{{A|vo yjcop001 1904706 yunjin 27.ogg}} '''Yun Jin:''' It'll take a lot of hard work to reach the point where you're ready to go on stage... but I'll be here to keep you on track every step of the way.

:{{A|vo aylq003 1 kiminamianna 06.ogg}} '''Kiminami Anna:''' Haha, well, we serve all the classics. Sure, there are fancier-looking places out there, but the food here speaks for itself! Hope you enjoy it.
:{{A|vo aylq003 1 kiminamianna 07.ogg}} '''Kiminami Anna:''' Over the years we've been in business, we've gotten to know the Kamisato Clan quite well.
:{{A|vo aylq003 1 kiminamianna 08.ogg}} '''Kiminami Anna:''' Miss Kamisato and her brother are both fond of our food. They're always sending staff down here to order something and take it back to them.
:{{A|vo aylq003 1 kiminamianna 09.ogg}} '''Kiminami Anna:''' Her table booking surprised me — not least because it was a group reservation! This is the first time I've ever heard of Miss Kamisato going out for dinner with friends!
:{{A|vo aylq003 1 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' The first time ever!? Whoa... Guess that makes us pretty important people, huh!
:{{A|vo aylq003 1 kiminamianna 10.ogg}} '''Kiminami Anna:''' Sure does, and I'm probably crossing the line here, but... I'm just telling you what others have told me. Apparently, Miss Kamisato doesn't have a lot of friends.
:{{DIcon}} ...That really surprises me.
:{{A|vo aylq003 1 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' How is that possible? She's so kind and polite to everyone, Paimon would've thought that would make her really popular.
:{{A|vo aylq003 1 kiminamianna 11.ogg}} '''Kiminami Anna:''' That's what I used to think, too. But it turns out the rules of social interaction are a bit more complicated than that.
:{{A|vo aylq003 1 kiminamianna 12.ogg}} '''Kiminami Anna:''' Nobody in the neighborhood has a bad word to say about her. They all say she's beautiful, elegant, graceful, not to mention that she belongs to one of the most illustrious clans in the land. In short, they see her as a model young lady.
:{{A|vo aylq003 1 kiminamianna 13.ogg}} '''Kiminami Anna:''' But that's just it — people look at her and see a model of perfection, and they don't feel like that's something they can relate to. So the majority of kids from ordinary families don't dare even try to talk to her.
:{{A|vo aylq003 1 kiminamianna 14.ogg}} '''Kiminami Anna:''' So you see? On paper, she sounds like a girl everyone would want to get to know, but in practice, she finds it difficult to make friends...
:{{A|vo aylq003 1 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh, Paimon never would have guessed...
:{{A|vo aylq003 1 kiminamianna 15.ogg}} '''Kiminami Anna:''' We don't speak all that much, but we do go quite a way back. I've always admired her for taking on so many responsibilities at such a young age.
:{{A|vo aylq003 1 kiminamianna 16.ogg}} '''Kiminami Anna:''' So it makes me really happy to see her here with friends today!
:{{A|vo aylq003 1 kiminamianna 17.ogg}} '''Kiminami Anna:''' Anyway — relax, enjoy your meal, and... please talk to her as much as possible. I know she'll appreciate it.
:{{A|vo aylq003 1 kiminamianna 18.ogg}} '''Kiminami Anna:''' Consider it a favor for the whole neighborhood... Look after her for us!
:{{A|vo aylq003 1 ayaka 07.ogg}} '''???:''' Ah...!
:{{A|vo aylq003 1 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh? That sounded like Ayaka...!
:{{A|vo aylq003 1 ayaka 08.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' *sigh* I'm so sorry, Traveler...
:{{DIcon}} Was that an explosion?
:{{DIcon}} What's going on?
:{{A|vo aylq003 1 ayaka 09.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' Could you join me over there for a minute? Um... I need your help with something.
:{{Black Screen|''You head towards the great noise...''}}

:{{A|vo aylq003 1 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ohh, so that loud noise we heard came from the cooking pot...
:{{A|vo aylq003 1 ayaka 11.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' As you can see, this house is right next to the restaurant. It's where the owner lives.
:{{A|vo aylq003 1 ayaka 12.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' Actually, this whole compound is the family's private property. I asked Miss Kiminami to prepare some ingredients and utensils for me so that I could cook a special dish here.
:{{DIcon}} Why would you be cooking?

:{{A|vo aylq003 1 ayaka 14.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' My mother mentioned in her notebook that Tsubaki enjoys food from all over the world.

:{{DIcon}} Actually... I'm a bit of a pro in the kitchen.
::{{A|vo aylq003 1 ayaka 16a.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' That's what I was thinking! You must have picked up a lot of knowledge about different cultures on your travels, hopefully including regional cuisines...

:{{DIcon}} My time to shine.

:{{A|vo aylq003 3 paimon 12.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Long may our reputations and our recipes precede us, wherever we go in Inazuma!
:{{A|vo aylq003 3 ayaka 13.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' I have no doubt that they will. This dish is exquisite.
:{{A|vo aylq003 3 paimon 13.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Cool, then let's get this recipe to Miss Kiminami, pronto!
----
:{{A|vo aylq003 4 kiminamianna 01.ogg}} '''Kiminami Anna:''' Hey! Have you written out the recipe?
:{{A|vo aylq003 5 ayaka 01.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' Here it is!
:{{A|vo aylq003 5 kiminamianna 01.ogg}} '''Kiminami Anna:''' Thank you!
:{{A|vo aylq003 5 kiminamianna 02.ogg}} '''Kiminami Anna:''' Wowee, this is so exciting! I want to make it right away.
:{{A|vo aylq003 5 ayaka 02.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' Traveler, Paimon, please accept my sincerest apologies for delaying your meal.
:{{A|vo aylq003 5 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hehe, no problem! Food always tastes better when you've worked up an appetite.
:{{A|vo aylq003 5 ayaka 03.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' Alright, let's dig in before it gets cold.
:{{A|vo aylq003 5 ayaka 04.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' Well, what do you think? Is Inazuman cuisine to your liking?
:{{A|vo aylq003 5 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' It's amazing! Paimon loved this one... Oh! A—And especially that one over there...
:{{DIcon}} It was all very tasty.
:{{DIcon}} It was nice to try something new.
:{{A|vo aylq003 5 ayaka 05.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' Haha, good. I'm relieved.
:{{A|vo aylq003 5 ayaka 06.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' Um... When I was attempting to cook earlier on, did you... chat with the owner at all?
:{{A|vo aylq003 5 ayaka 07.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' And did she, uh... say anything about me?
:{{A|vo aylq003 5 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' She did, but don't worry, she's just happy for you is all.
:{{A|vo aylq003 5 ayaka 08.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' She's... happy for me?
:{{A|vo aylq003 5 ayaka 09.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' Oh... then... she must have told you. D—Did she, um...
:{{A|vo aylq003 5 ayaka 10.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' *sigh* What does it matter... I know just as well as anybody else that I've got no friends...
:{{A|vo aylq003 5 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hey, it's not you, most people just haven't had the chance to talk to you one-on-one before.
:{{A|vo aylq003 5 ayaka 11.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' Thank you for your comforting words, Paimon.
:{{A|vo aylq003 5 ayaka 12.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' It's all true, though. I just... don't have very many friends.
:{{A|vo aylq003 5 ayaka 13.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' Most of the time I'm either accompanied by family or staff. So everyone must have found it quite a surprise to see me taking you out for a meal...
:{{DIcon}} Don't be silly!
:{{DIcon}} You've got a friend in me.
:{{A|vo aylq003 5 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Exactly! You've got at least two friends right here!
:{{A|vo aylq003 5 ayaka 14.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' Aw...
:{{A|vo aylq003 5 ayaka 15.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' Thank you... that makes me so happy!
:{{A|vo aylq003 5 ayaka 16.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' Ahem, excuse me... I—I'm forgetting myself.
:{{A|vo aylq003 5 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hey now, expressing your feelings is the right thing to do. Keeping them locked away inside isn't gonna do you any good, now is it?
:{{A|vo aylq003 5 ayaka 17.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' I agree! So...
:{{A|vo aylq003 5 ayaka 18.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' I just want to say how happy I feel... that you both see me as a true friend.
:{{A|vo aylq003 5 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Of course we do. That's always been our style — if someone's nice to us, we're nice to them, too!
:{{A|vo aylq003 5 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Friendship can go a long way! Take your mom for example — she wrote about Tsubaki in her notebook, and now it's made you want to find them, too.
:{{A|vo aylq003 5 ayaka 19.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' Yes! I think friendship is an extremely precious thing, and ours is one that I will always treasure.
:{{A|vo aylq003 5 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Um, while we're on the topic though — who is this Tsubaki person, anyway?
:{{A|vo aylq003 5 ayaka 20.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' Well, I think I have an idea, but it's just speculative at this point.
:{{DIcon}} I'm all ears.
:{{A|vo aylq003 5 ayaka 21.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' I think that Tsubaki... might be a fox envoy!
:{{DIcon}} ...?
:{{A|vo aylq003 5 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' A fox envoy?
:{{A|vo aylq003 5 ayaka 22.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' Yes. That's what I think.
:{{A|vo aylq003 5 ayaka 23.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' Even I, my mother's own daughter, had never even heard of this friend before. It just seems so mysterious. So I think it must be someone with transcendent abilities who doesn't show themselves very often.
:{{A|vo aylq003 5 ayaka 24.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' And fox envoys are nothing new. Stories have been told about them in Inazuma since ancient times.
:{{A|vo aylq003 5 ayaka 25.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' You must have met Guuji Yae before? Well, she's a fox envoy!
:{{A|vo aylq003 5 ayaka 26.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' That got me thinking, maybe there are fox envoys out there in Inazuma that people just don't know about... and maybe Tsubaki is one of them.
:{{A|vo aylq003 5 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Whoa, so Inazuma also has supernatural beings?
:{{A|vo aylq003 5 ayaka 27.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' Uh, when you say "also"...
:{{A|vo aylq003 5 paimon 12.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Well, before Inazuma we spent some time in Liyue. They have lots of supernatural beings there, like the adepti.
:{{A|vo aylq003 5 paimon 13.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' All kinds of them, too... Up in the sky, down below the ground, in the water...
:{{A|vo aylq003 5 ayaka 28.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' Really... I have come across such things being asserted in books, but to hear someone talk about it from firsthand experience is extremely surprising.
:{{A|vo aylq003 5 ayaka 29.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' So, Liyue lives up to its reputation... Its culture has a long history and gives rise to the most beautiful legends. Quite captivating.
:{{A|vo aylq003 5 paimon 14.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You should come visit Liyue with us some time. The best part is... they have loads and loads of delicious delicacies!
:{{A|vo aylq003 5 ayaka 30.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' Really? I would love that!
:{{A|vo aylq003 5 ayaka 31.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' Speaking of delicacies — Traveler, Paimon, have you eaten your fill?
:{{A|vo aylq003 5 paimon 15.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, Paimon has!
:{{A|vo aylq003 5 ayaka 32.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' Excellent, then let's collect the kimono. Then we can pay a visit to my mother's mysterious and transcendent friend...
----
;(Talk to Ogura Mio)
:{{A|vo aylq003 6 oguramio 01.ogg}} '''Ogura Mio:''' Your garment is ready, Miss Kamisato. I've folded and packaged it for you.
:{{A|vo aylq003 6 oguramio 02.ogg}} '''Ogura Mio:''' Oh, and the other item we discussed — that's ready too!
:{{A|vo aylq003 6 ayaka 01.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' Thank you very much.
:{{A|vo aylq003 6 oguramio 03.ogg}} '''Ogura Mio:''' No, thank you! It is a beautiful piece of clothing, and it was a pleasure to work on. See you again next time!
:{{A|vo aylq003 6 ayaka 02.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' Traveler, I have a gift for you.
:{{DIcon}} Hmm? Really?
:{{A|vo aylq003 6 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Whoa... Looks super fancy! Is that for wearing in your hair?
:{{A|vo aylq003 6 ayaka 03.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' It's a hairpin in the style of a white heron. As well as a hair accessory, you can also use it as an ornament.
:{{A|vo aylq003 6 ayaka 04.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' I couldn't ask for your help and offer nothing at all in return, so this is my gift to you.
:{{DIcon}} It's a beautiful gift, thank you very much.
:{{DIcon}} I will take very good care of it.
:{{A|vo aylq003 6 ayaka 05.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' I'm glad you like it!
:{{A|vo aylq003 6 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Speaking of white herons, that's what your title means, doesn't it? Shirasagi Himegimi. So this gift is like a little piece of yourself. It's just as elegant and beautiful as you are.
:{{A|vo aylq003 6 ayaka 06.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' Hehe, you flatter me, Paimon. If this gift reminds you of me, that is all I could ask for.
:{{A|vo aylq003 6 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hee-hee, it definitely will.
:{{A|vo aylq003 6 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Alright, well, now we've got what we came for, we can set off.
:{{A|vo aylq003 6 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Time to go meet Tsubaki!
{{Dialogue End}}

# Go to [[Aaru Village]]

# Follow the mysterious person
# Talk to the mysterious person

==Dialogue==
{{Quest Description|[[Cyrus (Sumeru)|Cyrus]]'s strange situation puts everyone on alert, and [[Cyno]] went after him alone. As his friends, you, Paimon, and [[Tighnari]] could never turn a blind eye to his predicament.}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Approach [[Caravan Ribat]])
:{{A|vo cnlq103 1 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Okay, we've made it to Caravan Ribat. Where should we go next?
:{{A|vo cnlq103 1 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hmm... Maybe we should ask the nearby guards if they've seen anything?
:{{A|vo cnlq103 1 tighnari 01.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Hold on. Look over there.
:{{A|vo cnlq103 1 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Is that... [[Dehya]]?
:{{A|vo cnlq103 1 dehya 01.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' You sure you wanna brave the desert alone? I mean, it's your choice at the end of the day, but still...
:{{A|vo cnlq103 1 cyno 01.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' It's not my first time. I'll be fine.
:{{A|vo cnlq103 1 tighnari 02.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Cyno...
:{{A|vo cnlq103 1 candace 01.ogg}} '''Candace:''' If you're really going to go through with this, then at least take our advice: When you're packing for your trip, budget for five days more than you plan to spend out there.
:{{A|vo cnlq103 1 cyno 02.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Makes sense. Okay, I'll go get ready.
:{{A|vo cnlq103 1 tighnari 03.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Thought we might find you here. You're trying to retrace Cyrus's steps, aren't you?
:{{A|vo cnlq103 1 cyno 03.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Didn't I tell you not to come after me? ...I thought I had a good lead on you.
:{{A|vo cnlq103 1 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Well sorry, but we never agreed to that. Why would you go off on your own like this?
:{{A|vo cnlq103 1 cyno 04.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Nothing personal. It's just a complex situation, and I'd rather not involve anyone else if I can help it.
:{{A|vo cnlq103 1 dehya 02.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' Hah, takes a special kind of person to get Cyno chasing them all the way to Caravan Ribat.
:{{A|vo cnlq103 1 dehya 03.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' But why so coy today, huh? You only gave us his age and description, why can't you reveal his name? ...Is he Sumeru's Most Wanted, or something?
:{{A|vo cnlq103 1 dehya 04.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' Oh, also — hey guys! It's been a while!
:{{A|vo cnlq103 1 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Dehya and [[Candace]]! So nice to see you! Actually, seeing all of our friends is the whole reason we're here!
:{{A|vo cnlq103 1 dehya 05.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' You're looking well. Glad to see it.
:{{DIcon}} Thanks.
:{{A|vo cnlq103 1 dehya 06.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' Candace and I came to Caravan Ribat on business. We ran into Cyno as he was asking about some elderly gentleman's whereabouts.
:{{A|vo cnlq103 1 dehya 07.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' Some people here say they saw him. Guess he stood out as an older guy heading into the desert alone, with just a [[Sumpter Beast|sumpter beast]] in tow, and very few supplies...
:{{A|vo cnlq103 1 dehya 08.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' That's gotta be one heck of a story there.
:{{A|vo cnlq103 1 candace 02.ogg}} '''Candace:''' Cyno, it's okay if you can't tell us anything about the case. But let us know how we can support you.
:{{A|vo cnlq103 1 candace 03.ogg}} '''Candace:''' We're here to help however you need. The more people we have working on this, the quicker we'll be able to find the person you seek.
:{{A|vo cnlq103 1 cyno 05.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' ...No, it's not that simple. If I'm right, he'll be doing everything he can to avoid us.
:{{A|vo cnlq103 1 tighnari 04.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' We spoke with [[Zaha Hadi]]. From what she said, it's pretty clear that he wants to try and solve this on his own. It won't be easy trying find him in the desert when he's deliberately trying to cover his tracks.
:{{A|vo cnlq103 1 candace 04.ogg}} '''Candace:''' Sounds like this is far more complex than we imagined.
:{{A|vo cnlq103 1 dehya 09.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' Still, if he started from Caravan Ribat, the chances are that his route took him via [[Aaru Village]]. You may as well ask if anyone there has seen him.
:{{A|vo cnlq103 1 cyno 06.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' My thanks to you both. Once this is resolved, I will find a way to repay you.
:{{A|vo cnlq103 1 dehya 10.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' Ah c'mon, no need to get all serious. Just buy a round of drinks next time we're all in the city, or something.
:{{A|vo cnlq103 1 cyno 07.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' That's a deal.
:{{A|vo cnlq103 1 dehya 11.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' Alright. So... you all set?
:{{A|vo cnlq103 1 cyno 08.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Yes, we'll handle it from here. Thank you again for your help — I don't take it for granted.
:{{A|vo cnlq103 1 dehya 12.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' Alright, then we'll leave you to it. Just remember, if you change your mind and need some reinforcements, we'll be here.
:{{A|vo cnlq103 1 candace 05.ogg}} '''Candace:''' And don't think you'd be imposing. You can depend on us.
:{{A|vo cnlq103 1 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Don't worry, we'll keep him outta trouble!

;(Use [[Nahida]]'s [[All Schemes to Know]] on Candace, optional)
:{{A|vo dialog cnlq103 candace 02.ogg}} '''Candace:''' (Gods above, I pray that you will see the goodness in their hearts, and give them your protection.)

;(Use Nahida's All Schemes to Know on Dehya, optional)
:{{A|vo dialog cnlq103 dehya 02.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' (Whatever they're getting themselves into, I just hope it isn't too dangerous. Get home safe, everyone.)

;(Talk to Candace or Dehya, optional)
:{{A|vo dialog cnlq103 dehya 01.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' Cyno should count himself lucky that {{Traveler}} and Tighnari got here when they did. What was he thinking, trying to play the lone hero?
:{{A|vo dialog cnlq103 candace 01.ogg}} '''Candace:''' The desert tests the character of all who enter it, and only those with wisdom and courage shall prevail. But take heart. With his companions by his side, no harm will come to Cyno.
----
;(Approach Aaru Village)
:{{A|vo cnlq103 2 tighnari 01.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Hold on... There's a few things I'd like to clear up.
:{{A|vo cnlq103 2 cyno 01.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Go on.
:{{A|vo cnlq103 2 tighnari 02.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' So, after you left the campsite, we had a longer talk...
:;(Tighnari relays the new information to Cyno)
:{{A|vo cnlq103 2 cyno 02.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' ...Hmm. Clearly, we've only scratched the surface of the [[Temple of Silence]] question. It doesn't surprise me at all that the one in the [[Akademiya]] is a fake.
:{{A|vo cnlq103 2 tighnari 03.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Do you have any connecti on with the Temple of Silence?
:{{A|vo cnlq103 2 cyno 03.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' I do. I trust you're all aware of the spirit that gives me my power? [[Hermanubis]], the original founder of the Temple of Silence.
:{{A|vo cnlq103 2 cyno 04.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Due to my unique constitution, I was put through a number of trials in the desert when I was younger. Later, I met the professor, and he brought me to [[Sumeru City]].
:{{A|vo cnlq103 2 cyno 05.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' But my memory of that time is hazy. I can't recall much.
:{{A|vo cnlq103 2 cyno 06.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' It's a good thing that Kaveh noticed the emblem on the letter. Without that, I don't know if we would have connected the dots, and realized there was more to this case than mere extortion.
:{{A|vo cnlq103 2 cyno 07.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' I did not recognize that symbol at all. Whether that's because I've never seen it, or because my memory fails me... it's hard to say.
:{{A|vo cnlq103 2 tighnari 04.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Yeah, you're right. Thank goodness for Kaveh, and for Alhaitham's diligence during his time as Acting Grand Sage.
:{{A|vo cnlq103 2 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' But Cyrus must have recognized it right away, right? Otherwise, he wouldn't have had any qualms about you reporting it. Maybe his connection to the Temple of Silence goes even deeper than yours!
:{{A|vo cnlq103 2 cyno 08.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' I suspect so too. Professor has never once mentioned the Temple of Silence in conversation. And whenever the conversation turns to Hermanubis and the concept of spirit indwelling, he avoids going into any depth.
:{{A|vo cnlq103 2 tighnari 05.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Well, speaking of avoiding things — you do realize, don't you, now that we've caught up with you, you're stuck with us for the rest of the way?
:{{A|vo cnlq103 2 cyno 09.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' I am aware. And I have accepted it.
:{{A|vo cnlq103 2 cyno 10.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' ...Or rather, I don't see how I could manage to ditch you en route. So I might as well accept that you're coming with me.
:{{A|vo cnlq103 2 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' That's right! Fact is, we're coming with you whether you like it or not. So the best option now is to try to look out for each other. Ha!
:{{DIcon}} You can't get rid of us!
:{{A|vo cnlq103 2 cyno 11.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Fair enough. Then at least let me buy you a drink once we're back in the city.
:{{A|vo cnlq103 2 tighnari 06.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Works for me. Alright, off we go. Let's start by seeing what the guards here can tell us.
:{{A|vo cnlq103 2 cyno 12.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Hello.
:{{A|vo cnlq103 2 fodil 01.ogg}} '''Fodil:''' Mahamatra Cyno?
:{{A|vo cnlq103 2 cyno 13.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' I'm looking for someone, so I'd like to confirm any recent foot traffic in and out of Aaru Village.
:{{Black Screen|Cyno describes Cyrus's appearance and provisions.}}
:{{A|vo cnlq103 2 fodil 02.ogg}} '''Fodil:''' A man matching that description passed by Aaru Village not too long ago. He stopped by to load up on food and water, and feed his sumpter beast, then he was on his way.
:{{A|vo cnlq103 2 cyno 14.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Where was he going?
:{{A|vo cnlq103 2 fodil 03.ogg}} '''Fodil:''' Let me think... He took a seat by the entrance of the village for a while, and had a brief chat with the person who came to deliver the water. He said he was headed... somewhere near an oasis. But he didn't mention which one.
:{{A|vo cnlq103 2 fodil 04.ogg}} '''Fodil:''' Do you have a map? I can mark out the direction he was heading and the best routes to any nearby oases.
:{{A|vo cnlq103 2 tighnari 07.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' I have one. Mark away.
:{{A|vo cnlq103 2 fodil 05.ogg}} '''Fodil:''' Great.
:{{A|vo cnlq103 2 fodil 06.ogg}} '''Fodil:''' ...There you go.
:{{A|vo cnlq103 2 cyno 15.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Thank you so much. You were a great help.
:{{A|vo cnlq103 2 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You've got a really good memory!
:{{A|vo cnlq103 2 fodil 07.ogg}} '''Fodil:''' Ah, you're quite welcome. Just doing my job.
:{{A|vo cnlq103 2 fodil 08.ogg}} '''Fodil:''' Best of luck. I hope you find him soon!
----
;(Approach the marked location near the oasis)
:{{A|vo cnlq103 3 cyno 01.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Hold on. I see some people over there.
:{{A|vo cnlq103 3 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Do you think it's safe to ask them what they know?
:{{A|vo cnlq103 3 cyno 02.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Should be. I'll g—
:{{A|vo cnlq103 3 tighnari 01.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' No. I'll do it.
:{{A|vo cnlq103 3 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh? Why can't Cyno go talk to them? What difference does it make?
:{{A|vo cnlq103 3 cyno 03.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Given my background, appearance, and the way I dress, I might not be the most welcome visitor here. Just in case, it's probably better to let a more neutral party handle things.
:;(As Tighnari approaches the group of people, some of them subtly side-eye him)
:{{A|vo cnlq103 3 tighnari 02.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Hello there. Hope I'm not interrupting. My friend and I are looking for an elderly man who's gone missing around these parts. Any chance I could ask you a couple of questions?
:{{A|vo cnlq103 3 sethos 01.ogg}} '''???:''' Oh, a missing person, huh? Sure, sure, sure, what do you wanna know?
:{{A|vo cnlq103 3 tighnari 03.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' I'm just wondering if you've seen him. Let me give you the details...
:{{Color|menu|Tighnari describes Cyrus' appearance and clothing.}}
:{{A|vo cnlq103 3 sethos 02.ogg}} '''???:''' ...So, a silver-haired guy in a long robe, cultured type with thoughtful eyes... And he's traveling alone.
:{{A|vo cnlq103 3 stranger01 01.ogg}} '''Carefree Desert-Dweller:''' He'd stand out like a sore thumb around here.
:{{A|vo cnlq103 3 sethos 03.ogg}} '''???:''' Yeah. Sounds like the kind of guy we'd remember if we saw him.
:{{A|vo cnlq103 3 tighnari 04.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' (He's looking behind me?)
:;(The mysterious person makes direct eye contact with Cyno)
:{{A|vo cnlq103 3 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Uh oh, that guy's looking our way...
:{{A|vo cnlq103 3 sethos 04.ogg}} '''???:''' Your friend over there stands out a lot, too.
:{{A|vo cnlq103 3 sethos 05.ogg}} '''???:''' Hey! Aren't you Cyno, the General Mahamatra?
:{{A|vo cnlq103 3 cyno 04.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Yes, that's me.
:{{A|vo cnlq103 3 sethos 06.ogg}} '''???:''' You don't seem surprised that I recognized you.
:{{A|vo cnlq103 3 cyno 05.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' It wouldn't be the first time.
:{{A|vo cnlq103 3 sethos 07.ogg}} '''???:''' You're the one looking for the old man who's gone missing, aren't you?
:{{A|vo cnlq103 3 tighnari 05.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' (I have a bad feeling about this guy...)
:{{A|vo cnlq103 3 cyno 06.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' ...
:{{A|vo cnlq103 3 sethos 08.ogg}} '''???:''' Someone's on edge. You don't trust me much, do you?
:{{A|vo cnlq103 3 sethos 09.ogg}} '''???:''' No need to hide it, I understand why you're wary of us. Still, you came to us asking for help — do you want it or not?
:{{A|vo cnlq103 3 tighnari 06.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' I thought you were a group of merchants. Seems I was mistaken.
:{{A|vo cnlq103 3 cyno 07.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Your henchmen don't look like much. But something tells me they'd put up a better fight than most mercenaries.
:{{A|vo cnlq103 3 sethos 10.ogg}} '''???:''' Hey! Hear that, guys? You're my henchmen now.
:{{A|vo cnlq103 3 stranger01 02.ogg}} '''Carefree Desert-Dweller:''' Suits me. As long as I get paid for it.
:{{A|vo cnlq103 3 stranger02 01.ogg}} '''Irritable Desert-Dweller:''' Just cut to the chase already. I'm running out of patience.
:{{A|vo cnlq103 3 sethos 11.ogg}} '''???:''' Alright, alright, alright.
:{{A|vo cnlq103 3 sethos 12.ogg}} '''???:''' ...Come with me, all of you.
:{{DIcon}} Where are you taking us?
:{{A|vo cnlq103 3 sethos 13.ogg}} '''???:''' Don't you want to find your friend?
:{{A|vo cnlq103 3 sethos 14.ogg}} '''???:''' Silver-haired, long robe, cultured type with thoughtful eyes... Hahaha, sounds like there's a whole other side to Cyrus I didn't know about.
:{{A|vo cnlq103 3 cyno 08.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' So you know where he is?
:{{A|vo cnlq103 3 sethos 15.ogg}} '''???:''' Just follow me. I'll take you to him.

;(Use [[Nahida]]'s [[All Schemes to Know]] on Irritable Desert-Dweller, optional)

;(Use [[Nahida]]'s [[All Schemes to Know]] on Carefree Desert-Dweller, optional)
:{{A|vo cnlq103 3 stranger01 03.ogg}} '''Carefree Desert-Dweller:''' (Huh. Those guys are pretty cautious. They just sent one person to try to talk to us.)

;(Follow the mysterious person)
:{{A|vo cnlq103 4 sethos 01.ogg}} '''???:''' In here.

:{{Color|menu|The mystery person does a series of motions that resemble a ritual...}}
:{{A|vo cnlq103 4 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Whoa! Something's coming out of the ground!
:{{A|vo cnlq103 4 tighnari 01.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' ...What is this enormous building doing here?
:{{A|vo cnlq103 4 cyno 01.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' And how was it so well hidden? ...King Deshret's technology?
:{{A|vo cnlq103 4 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' W—Wait, so... Hold on, who are you guys, really...
:{{A|vo cnlq103 4 cyno 02.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Is this... the Temple of Silence? So you're a member?
:{{A|vo cnlq103 4 sethos 03.ogg}} '''???:''' All good questions. There'll be plenty of time to address them later.

:{{A|vo cnlq103 5 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' This is not what Paimon was expecting to find in the desert... Especially not hidden right next to an oasis...
:{{A|vo cnlq103 5 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Uhhh... Paimon's scared...
:{{A|vo cnlq103 5 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' They must have kidnapped Cyrus. D—Do you think this is the guy [[Urraca]] met in the tavern?
:{{A|vo cnlq103 5 cyno 01.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' ...
:{{A|vo cnlq103 5 sethos 01.ogg}} '''???:''' What's wrong? Thinking about your professor?
:{{A|vo cnlq103 5 cyno 02.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' I just hope for your sake you haven't done anything you might regret.
:{{A|vo cnlq103 5 sethos 02.ogg}} '''???:''' Me too. I hope I haven't done anything to incur your wrath.

;(Approach the marked area)
:{{A|vo cnlq103 6 sethos 01.ogg}} '''???:''' Alright. You can wait here for now.
:{{A|vo cnlq103 6 sethos 02.ogg}} '''???:''' I'll inform our leader that you've arrived at the Temple of Silence. Sit tight until he comes to greet you.
:{{A|vo cnlq103 6 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Uh, so he's just gonna leave us here unattended? Maybe we're not being kidnapped after all.
:{{A|vo cnlq103 6 tighnari 01.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' They can't have been at the oasis by chance. They were waiting for us... Whoever the leader is here, they were obviously counting on us showing up.
:{{A|vo cnlq103 6 cyno 01.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' ...
:{{A|vo cnlq103 6 cyno 02.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' So this is the Temple of Silence?
:{{A|vo cnlq103 6 cyno 03.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' After leaving the rainforest... They hid themselves here?
:{{A|vo cnlq103 6 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hey, look. That guy's coming back.
:{{A|vo cnlq103 6 sethos 03.ogg}} '''???:''' Don't worry. Someone will come and call for you soon.
:{{A|vo cnlq103 6 cyno 04.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' What's your name?
:{{DIcon}} Please. At least tell us what to call you.
:{{A|vo cnlq103 6 sethos 04.ogg}} '''???:''' Ah. Sorry, guess I was so delighted to see you, I forgot to introduce myself.
:{{A|vo cnlq103 6 sethos 05.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' My name is [[Sethos]]. I'll be here if you need me, but I'm not planning on answering all of your questions. Other than that, you can occupy yourselves however you see fit.
:{{A|vo cnlq103 6 tighnari 02.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' So we're free to explore by ourselves?
:{{A|vo cnlq103 6 sethos 06.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' Yep. I mean, I'm not worried about you running off.
:{{A|vo cnlq103 6 sethos 07.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' Cyrus is here, and unless I've misunderstood — you're all quite anxious to see him again.
:{{A|vo cnlq103 6 cyno 05.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' ...He's right. Well, if we've got some time, we might as well take a look around.

;(Use Nahida's All Schemes to Know on Sethos, optional)
:{{A|vo cnlq103 7 sethos 01.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' (These guys clearly care a lot about each other. This is a long way for them all to come.)

;(Talk to Sethos)
:{{A|vo dialog cnlq103 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hey, Sethos, have you got some time to chat?
:{{A|vo dialog cnlq103 sethos 01.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' Sure.
:{{A|vo dialog cnlq103 sethos 02.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' Although I'm assuming by "chat," you mean you have questions for me? Hahaha, I don't blame you. Anyone else would.
:{{DIcon}} So you get a lot of people asking you questions?
:{{A|vo dialog cnlq103 sethos 03.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' Not often. The Temple of Silence is a place of quiet and solitude. We don't get too many visitors.
:{{DIcon}} You were the one who tricked Urraca, right?
::{{A|vo dialog cnlq103 sethos 04a 1.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' Yes, that was me. Although, "tricked" is a stretch. He was asking everyone in the tavern about ways to make some easy money.
::{{A|vo dialog cnlq103 sethos 04a 2.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' He insisted that nothing was off the table, even if it broke the law. So I told him that Cyrus had embezzled a large sum of Mora from the desert.
::{{A|vo dialog cnlq103 paimon 02a 1.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So you framed Cyrus for a crime that he did not commit!
::{{A|vo dialog cnlq103 sethos 04a 3.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' No no no, that's not entirely true. Let me jog your memory — the letter just said that he had uncovered Cyrus's secret. It didn't say what secret that was.
::{{DIcon}} Did you tell him to use that wording?
::{{A|vo dialog cnlq103 sethos 04a 4.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' Of course. Urraca was a great accomplice, really. Very cooperative with a little bit of wine in him — did exactly what he was told... And not much of an original thinker though. It doesn't surprise me that he struggles academically.
::{{A|vo dialog cnlq103 paimon 02a 2.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Why did Cyrus leave for the desert as soon as he received the letter?
::{{A|vo dialog cnlq103 sethos 04a 5.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' You'll have to ask him that one yourself. Certain things I can't answer for him. I'm neither judging nor defending him.
::{{A|vo dialog cnlq103 sethos 04a 6.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' All you need to know is that he recognized our emblem, and it was his own choice to take the bait.
::;(Dialogue returns to option selection)
:{{DIcon}} Do you know Cyno?
::{{A|vo dialog cnlq103 sethos 04b 1.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' Ahaha, what kind of a question is that? He's the General Mahamatra, everyone in Sumeru knows who he is.
::{{A|vo dialog cnlq103 paimon 02b 1.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Right, but back at the oasis, you can't have known who he was for sure, or you wouldn't have asked him. So what we're really asking is... Have you never seen him in person before?
::{{A|vo dialog cnlq103 sethos 04b 2.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' I've lived in the desert my whole life. Guess you could say... I've never had the pleasure.
::{{A|vo dialog cnlq103 paimon 02b 2.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ugh... Why does Paimon feel like this guy's not being straight with us...
::{{A|vo dialog cnlq103 sethos 04b 3.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' C'mon, we've only just met. If I give you all the answers up front, you'll have nothing left to look forward to.
::;(Dialogue returns to option selection)
:{{DIcon}} Have you ever been to the Akademiya?
::{{A|vo dialog cnlq103 sethos 04c 1.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' No. Not once.
::{{A|vo dialog cnlq103 paimon 02c 1.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Really?
::{{A|vo dialog cnlq103 sethos 04c 2.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' I have no need to go there — not when the taverns are full of the Urracas of this world. Besides, we're well aware of what goes on at that place.
::{{DIcon}} Are you saying you have spies inside the city?
::{{A|vo dialog cnlq103 sethos 04c 3.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' Spies? Heh, it's not as clandestine as that. The city gates are wide open, anyone's free to walk in. You can find out all you need to know just by walking around town and hearing the word on the street.
::;(Dialogue returns to option selection)
:{{DIcon}} That's all I wanted to ask.
::{{A|vo dialog cnlq103 sethos 04d 1.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' Mhm.

;(Talk to Cyno or Tighnari)
:{{A|vo dialog cnlq103 cyno 01.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' I never imagined that the true Temple of Silence would be hidden somewhere like this... We've passed through these parts before, but never noticed anything.
:{{A|vo dialog cnlq103 tighnari 01.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' That's King Deshret's technology for you, I guess. It borders on the miraculous. Amazing to think that's it's been preserved intact all this time...
:{{A|vo dialog cnlq103 cyno 02.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' We should be wary of our hosts. Still, at this point we can be confident that the professor is safe and sound. So that's something.

;(After talking to Cyno, Tighnari, and Sethos)
:{{A|vo cnlq103 8 sethos 01.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' Ah, here he is.
:;(A woman approaches Sethos and nods, then leads the group into a ceremonial hall)
:{{A|vo cnlq103 8 sethos 02.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' Grandfather, the person you wish to see is here.
:{{A|vo cnlq103 8 bamoun 01.ogg}} '''Bamoun:''' Well done, Sethos.
:{{A|vo cnlq103 8 bamoun 02.ogg}} '''Bamoun:''' Greetings, one and all. I am [[Bamoun]], the current leader of the Temple of Silence. I know why you are here, and I thank you for your patience... Bring him out.
:{{A|vo cnlq103 8 cyno 01.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Professor!
:{{A|vo cnlq103 8 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Cyrus, are you okay?
:;(The guard escorting Cyrus knocks him to his knees)
:{{A|vo cnlq103 8 spantamadcyrus 01.ogg}} '''Cyrus:''' Argh!
:{{A|vo cnlq103 8 cyno 02.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Watch what you're doing!
:{{A|vo cnlq103 8 bamoun 03.ogg}} '''Bamoun:''' Ah, my apologies, we have no intention of causing you distress. But you must understand, Cyrus is of great importance to us. We had to find a way to bring him back to us.
:{{A|vo cnlq103 8 bamoun 04.ogg}} '''Bamoun:''' Cyrus owes me his life, and to the Temple of Silence he owes a debt of gratitude. I let him go a long time ago, but now, the time has come to demand payment.
:{{A|vo cnlq103 8 spantamadcyrus 02.ogg}} '''Cyrus:''' *sigh* I wanted to end my feud with this old bag of bones before you caught up with me... But you got here so quickly.
:{{A|vo cnlq103 8 spantamadcyrus 03.ogg}} '''Cyrus:''' ...Just leave, Cyno. This is a matter between us two old men. You're all too young to get involved.
:{{A|vo cnlq103 8 cyno 03.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' So that's why you didn't want to report the letter. You'd made up your mind to come here from the beginning... You only left in such a hurry to try and throw us off your trail.
:{{A|vo cnlq103 8 spantamadcyrus 04.ogg}} '''Cyrus:''' Some things in life catch up with you no matter what you do. You shouldn't have come... let alone brought the others.
:{{A|vo cnlq103 8 tighnari 01.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Cyno didn't make us do anything. We came here for the same reason he did — to rescue you. We'd appreciate you telling us the truth, otherwise it seems a little unfair on everyone who had to stay behind.
:{{A|vo cnlq103 8 spantamadcyrus 05.ogg}} '''Cyrus:''' My secrets are secret for good reason... Bringing them to light can only lead to misfortune.
:{{A|vo cnlq103 8 bamoun 05.ogg}} '''Bamoun:''' You're afraid, aren't you? You can't bring yourself to speak of your past deeds to the students you nurtured as if they were your own children.
:{{A|vo cnlq103 8 bamoun 06.ogg}} '''Bamoun:''' You recognized our emblem because for many years, you lived among us. Indeed, you all but became one of us.
:{{A|vo cnlq103 8 bamoun 07.ogg}} '''Bamoun:''' You knew as soon as you saw the letter that we, not Urraca, were the ones speaking to you. It threatened you only because you know what you did. Your own guilt convicted you.
:{{A|vo cnlq103 8 bamoun 08.ogg}} '''Bamoun:''' For you, Cyrus, are a traitor! You once shared your learning with us, and joined us in our mission to revive the might of Hermanubis, to bring new hope, new opportunity...
:{{A|vo cnlq103 8 bamoun 09.ogg}} '''Bamoun:''' But then, you betrayed us. You bargained for your independence with your past contributions. And then you left, taking with you Hermanubis's might and the wielder of his power.
:{{A|vo cnlq103 8 bamoun 10.ogg}} '''Bamoun:''' We both know what I said to you that day. That as the leader, I grant you permission to leave, but that one day, the sands of time will catch up with you. And when that day comes, you must pay the price you owe.
:{{A|vo cnlq103 8 spantamadcyrus 06.ogg}} '''Cyrus:''' ...Ha, you really know how to hold a grudge.
:{{A|vo cnlq103 8 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hermanubis' might... and the wielder of his power?
:{{A|vo cnlq103 8 tighnari 02.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Does he mean you?
:{{A|vo cnlq103 8 cyno 04.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Professor? Anything to say?
:{{A|vo cnlq103 8 spantamadcyrus 07.ogg}} '''Cyrus:''' ...Bamoun is right. I came here once before.
;(Flashback begins)
:{{A|vo cnlq103 8 spantamadcyrus 08.ogg}} '''Cyrus:''' He rescued me from the brink of death once, many years ago in the desert. When he learned that I was a scholar, he invited me to come here, and revive the might of Hermanubis together.
:{{A|vo cnlq103 8 spantamadcyrus 09.ogg}} '''Cyrus:''' It was a... great, daring plan, and one shrouded in secrecy. The Temple of Silence had been bereft of Hermanubis for too long. The strength of its faith and its warriors were waning...
:{{A|vo cnlq103 8 spantamadcyrus 10.ogg}} '''Cyrus:''' Bamoun proposed that we implant Ba Fragments, shards of Hermanubis, into the bodies of suitable vessels. If the experiment was successful, the spirit of Hermanubis would then dwell within the vessel.
:{{A|vo cnlq103 8 spantamadcyrus 11.ogg}} '''Cyrus:''' Many believers volunteered themselves for the experiment, but we soon discovered that the bodies of grown adults could not withstand Hermanubis's power. In the end, Bamoun offered his own adoptive grandson.
;(Flashback ends)
:{{A|vo cnlq103 8 spantamadcyrus 12.ogg}} '''Cyrus:''' One other child was identified as a suitable vessel... and his parents agreed to release him into our custody, in exchange for a small fortune. These two children were our only hope for hosting Hermanubis's power.
:{{A|vo cnlq103 8 cyno 05.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' ...
:{{A|vo cnlq103 8 bamoun 11.ogg}} '''Bamoun:''' For many years, the Temple of Silence had been in possession of two Ba Fragments from Hermanubis. As remnants of his raw power, they were exceedingly rare treasures.
:{{A|vo cnlq103 8 bamoun 12.ogg}} '''Bamoun:''' The test subjects were sent into a room that had been prepared for the ceremony, and instructed to approach the Ba Fragments, whose power had been amplified. If, after some time, this power did not repel them, this would mean that they were suitable vessels.
:{{A|vo cnlq103 8 bamoun 13.ogg}} '''Bamoun:''' The original plan was for a three-stage experiment: resonance, implantation, and recovery and observation. The resonance stage went quite smoothly for both candidates.
:{{A|vo cnlq103 8 bamoun 14.ogg}} '''Bamoun:''' As the second stage began, I realized a decision had to be made. Should we implant the fragments one at a time? This would allow us to monitor the results after the first round, and adjust our plan accordingly. Or alternatively, we could implant each fragment in a different vessel at the same time, and compare their effects.
:{{A|vo cnlq103 8 bamoun 15.ogg}} '''Bamoun:''' But as I was deliberating, both Ba Fragments suddenly became active. They glowed with a light we had never seen before... I knew that if they were not implanted right away, they would disintegrate, and be gone from the world for good.
:{{A|vo cnlq103 8 bamoun 16.ogg}} '''Bamoun:''' Our two vessels had both displayed great promise by successfully resonating with the fragments. Under the circumstances, the thought of implanting both fragments into the same vessel seemed out of the question.
:{{A|vo cnlq103 8 bamoun 17.ogg}} '''Bamoun:''' To preserve our faith and our power... We implanted each of them with a single fragment.
:{{A|vo cnlq103 8 spantamadcyrus 13.ogg}} '''Cyrus:''' Ultimately, I ended the experiment and left, taking one of the children with me.
:{{A|vo cnlq103 8 bamoun 18.ogg}} '''Bamoun:''' In recognition of your past contributions, I chose not to send someone to hunt down and kill you both. Your lives were spared, but I have paid a great price for your betrayal ever since.
:{{A|vo cnlq103 8 bamoun 19.ogg}} '''Bamoun:''' I have always wanted to see you, Cyno. Losing you and your Ba Fragment dealt us a devastating blow. We've been in decline ever since you left.
:{{A|vo cnlq103 8 cyno 06.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' I see... So that's how I gained my power.
:{{A|vo cnlq103 8 spantamadcyrus 14.ogg}} '''Cyrus:''' Look... In essence, I borrowed your Ba Fragment for a decade or so, and now you are seeking justice. If you want to take my life, then so be it. I'm an old man now, anyway.
:{{A|vo cnlq103 8 spantamadcyrus 15.ogg}} '''Cyrus:''' But you cannot lift a finger against Cyno. He is the General Mahamatra. Your actions would be seen as a declaration of war against the Akademiya.
:{{A|vo cnlq103 8 bamoun 20.ogg}} '''Bamoun:''' I'm sure you don't remember anymore, dear Cyno, but you've met us all before. You were so young then, when we all gathered around and celebrated the revival of our lord.
:{{A|vo cnlq103 8 bamoun 21.ogg}} '''Bamoun:''' You and he, Sethos — you were our final hope.
:{{A|vo cnlq103 8 cyno 07.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' You'd like me to return my power?
:{{A|vo cnlq103 8 bamoun 22.ogg}} '''Bamoun:''' As a follower of Hermanubis, I have allowed this power to remain in the rainforest for far too long. Now, it is time to reclaim it.
:{{A|vo cnlq103 8 spantamadcyrus 16.ogg}} '''Cyrus:''' That power is not yours to reclaim! Cyno was chosen by the gods, you cannot take what they have bestowed!
:{{A|vo cnlq103 8 bamoun 23.ogg}} '''Bamoun:''' You are wrong. Cyno was chosen, but he was not the only one. My child, Sethos, has the same gift as he.
:{{A|vo cnlq103 8 cyno 08.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' So those are your terms for freeing the professor?
:{{A|vo cnlq103 8 bamoun 24.ogg}} '''Bamoun:''' Despise me all you want. My sins are my own — the Temple of Silence is an innocent party. It is because of my foolishness all those years ago that the temple's glory has waned, and now I must take responsibility for the decision I made back then.
:{{A|vo cnlq103 8 cyno 09.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' So what you're saying is, the power of one Ba Fragment is not enough. You're asking me to return the one in my possession, so it can be implanted in him instead?
:{{A|vo cnlq103 8 spantamadcyrus 17.ogg}} '''Cyrus:''' Divine power causes great suffering to those who wield it. How do you know that Sethos would be able to withstand it?
:{{A|vo cnlq103 8 bamoun 25.ogg}} '''Bamoun:''' He is no longer a small child. But regardless, this burden is ours to bear, and your objections mean little given that you turned your back on us long ago.
:{{A|vo cnlq103 8 cyno 10.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' ...
:{{A|vo cnlq103 8 cyno 11.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Both my heart and my mind are telling me that what you are proposing is a terrible idea. However...
:{{A|vo cnlq103 8 spantamadcyrus 18.ogg}} '''Cyrus:''' Don't listen to him, Cyno! That power is no more yours to give than it is his to take! You have to understand!
:{{A|vo cnlq103 8 cyno 12.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' I know. But if this is a question of your freedom versus a fragment of power, then... There is nothing to debate.
:{{A|vo cnlq103 8 tighnari 03.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Sorry to interrupt, but in my view, there are a number of contentions here that still need addressing.
:{{A|vo cnlq103 8 tighnari 04.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Say that Cyno refuses to return his power, and you also refuse to release Cyrus. Then we are at an impasse. I find it hard to believe that you went to all this effort without planning for that possibility.
:{{A|vo cnlq103 8 tighnari 05.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' You're trying to gauge where we stand while keeping your remaining cards close to your chest. Well, my stance is — put the rest of your cards on the table. Then we can have a discussion.
:{{A|vo cnlq103 8 bamoun 26.ogg}} '''Bamoun:''' Wait, those ears... So, we have a descendant of the [[Tighnarian|Valuka Shuna]] in our midst? Splendid... Hahaha, fate smiles upon us after all!
:{{A|vo cnlq103 8 bamoun 27.ogg}} '''Bamoun:''' Everything we have longed for, Hermanubis will provide. Perhaps, this very day... *cough* *cough*
:;(Bamoun falls to the ground, and his guards rush to attend to him)
:{{A|vo cnlq103 8 bamoun 28.ogg}} '''Bamoun:''' *cough*...
:{{A|vo cnlq103 8 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Why is he coughing so much? He looks like he's in really bad shape...
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (Bamoun's condition is critical. He must have been forcing himself to act strong...)
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (His eyesight must be failing him, too. Otherwise, he would have noticed Tighnari's ears right away.)
:{{A|vo cnlq103 8 spantamadcyrus 19.ogg}} '''Cyrus:''' Bamoun! You...
:{{A|vo cnlq103 8 sethos 03.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' Take our leader back to his room.
:{{A|vo cnlq103 8 bamoun 29.ogg}} '''Bamoun:''' Sethos!... *cough* You...
:{{A|vo cnlq103 8 sethos 04.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' Grandfather, I know what you wish to say. Leave this in my hands.
:{{A|vo cnlq103 8 sethos 05.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' I don't like to drag out conversations, so I'll just cut to the chase.
:{{A|vo cnlq103 8 sethos 06.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' Had Cyrus not stopped the experiment all those years ago, the plan would most likely have been a success. The wisdom of Hermanubis would have been ours.
:{{A|vo cnlq103 8 sethos 07.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' Still, it's no use talking about what-ifs. We cannot change the past.
:{{A|vo cnlq103 8 sethos 08.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' I'm not like my grandfather. The Temple of Silence has a grand legacy and a sacred duty to fulfill, so it's somewhat inevitable for the leader to have an inflated sense of self.
:{{A|vo cnlq103 8 sethos 09.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' But I see things a little differently. I don't believe the Temple has the same stature that it once did. Time has worn away at its prestige, and changed things almost beyond recognition.
:{{A|vo cnlq103 8 sethos 10.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' So I'm not going to force your hand. You're all free to leave — except for Cyrus. My grandfather gave him his chance once, and now I'm giving the rest of you yours.
:{{A|vo cnlq103 8 spantamadcyrus 20.ogg}} '''Cyrus:''' Haha... You have courage and wise judgment, kid. Reminds me a lot of Bamoun in his younger years.
:{{A|vo cnlq103 8 spantamadcyrus 21.ogg}} '''Cyrus:''' I just... I truly wish that the Temple would take an objective look at the Akademiya of today. You've been to the city yourself. I'm sure you've seen that much has changed for the better.
:{{A|vo cnlq103 8 spantamadcyrus 22.ogg}} '''Cyrus:''' And things will only continue to improve. Why not consider cooperating with the Akademiya once more?
:{{A|vo cnlq103 8 sethos 11.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' If you hadn't betrayed my grandfather, I might well be open to persuasion. But it's a bit too late for that now, Cyrus.
:{{A|vo cnlq103 8 cyno 13.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Tighnari made a good point earlier. He said there has to be more to your plan than this, and I agree.
:{{A|vo cnlq103 8 cyno 14.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' All you and Bamoun are after is the Ba Fragment. The professor will accept whatever fate you deem fit for him out of a sense of guilt — I am the one who has a choice to make, and that's how it was always going to be.
:{{A|vo cnlq103 8 cyno 15.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Ultimately, you want to trade the Ba Fragment for the professor, correct?
:{{A|vo cnlq103 8 sethos 12.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' I'm glad to see you're giving it some serious consideration.
:{{A|vo cnlq103 8 cyno 16.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' I won't forsake my professor, nor do I intend to run from a problem that I must face sooner or later. Give me one night to make my decision.
:{{A|vo cnlq103 8 sethos 13.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' That works. Then I'll be waiting to hear your verdict, Cyno.
:{{A|vo cnlq103 8 sethos 14.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' Oh, my grandfather still has a fair few things he wants to say to Cyrus, so I'll be escorting him back now.
:{{A|vo cnlq103 8 tighnari 06.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Are you sure about negotiating with him?
:{{A|vo cnlq103 8 cyno 17.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' I need to think this through. Everyone, let's meet again later tonight. Until then, take some time for yourself.
:{{A|vo cnlq103 8 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Alright... Well, don't put too much pressure on yourself, Cyno! If you need any help working things out, just come and find us!
{{Dialogue End}}

'''''For a Reunion Without Tears''''' is the second part of the [[Homeward, He Who Caught the Wind]] Event.

==Steps==
# Wait until the following day (08:00 – 10:00)
# Go to the [[Knights of Favonius Headquarters]] and participate in the test
# Enter the bubble
# Enter the basement
# Approach the [[Holy Lyre der Himmel]]
# Chase after the escaped [[Fatuus]]
# Track the target to the Fatui hideout
#* This step appears if the Special Story Mode is exited.
# Enter the hideout
# Explore the area and find the crest (0/3)
#* Defeat {{Enemy|Fatui Skirmisher - Anemoboxer Vanguard|text=Fatui Skirmisher - Anemoboxer Vanguard — Played by Cyrus}}
#* Defeat {{Enemy|Oprichniki Fireblade Shock Trooper|text=Oprichniki Fireblade Shock Trooper — Played by Durin}} ''(if not approached last)''
#* Defeat {{Enemy|Mirror Maiden|text=Mirror Maiden — Played by Mona}} ''(if negotiation fails)''
# Return to [[Mika]] to proceed further
# Retrieve the Holy Lyre der Himmel
# Defeat the Electro Cicin Mage
#* Defeat {{Enemy|Oz|link=Electro Cicin (Event Enemy)|text=Electro Cicin — Played by Ozvaldo Hrafnavins}}
# Talk to [[Varka]]

==Gameplay Notes==
* During steps 4<!-- Enter the basement -->-12<!-- Defeat the Electro Cicin Mage  -->, the player enters a [[Special Story Mode]].
** If the Special Story Mode is exited early, the quest is reset to the first step after the last bubble transition screen the player saw.<!--Exiting while in the basement brings you straight back to the basement and not the upper level-->
** During step 4<!-- Enter the basement -->, the active party is limited to a trial [[Traveler (Pyro)]].
** During steps 5<!-- Approach the Holy Lyre der Himmel -->-6<!-- Chase after the escaped Fatuus -->, the active party is limited to the Traveler.<!-- non-trial -->
** Step 6<!-- Chase after the escaped Fatuus --> will complete when the player approaches Amber southeast of the Springvale lake. If the player reaches the location first, Amber will catch up:
*** Amber will glide even if the player cannot see her.
*** However, after Amber lands, she may not run until the player's device has rendered her. This may require turning the camera and backtracking until the player can see Amber at her landing location.
** During steps 7<!-- Track the target to the Fatui hideout -->-12<!-- Defeat the Electro Cicin Mage -->, the active party is limited to a trial Traveler (Pyro), [[Venti]], [[Diluc]], [[Jean]], and [[Varka]].
** During the second part of step 8<!-- Enter the hideout -->, tiles to cross the chasm follow the pattern of the star map above the chasm and are invisible until the player steps on them. Tiles that have been revealed are indicated by a circular glow around the corresponding star. The quest will proceed when the player reaches the other side, regardless of how many tiles have been revealed.
*** The player can travel directly to the invisible tiles at the end by holding Varka's [[Elemental Skill]], [[Windbound Execution]], on the first tile and opening the glider before Varka begins descending.
** During step 9<!-- Explore the area and find the crest (0/3) -->:
*** Obtaining [[Cyrus (Mondstadt)|Cyrus]] and [[Mona]]'s crests before approaching [[Durin]] will cause him to give up his crest without a fight.
*** With the exception of Mona's highest tier response, which is always triggered by an offer of at least 487,501 Mora, Mona's negotiation thresholds are randomly determined per playthrough and are also not solely tied to the amount of hearts Mona begins with. Thresholds may vary by a few thousand Mora per playthrough.
*** All fights occur within barriers.

:{{A|vo mdeq002 1 nicole 07.ogg}} '''Nicole:''' The parts you're testing today are more stable, so there shouldn't be too many bugs.
:{{A|vo mdeq002 1 nicole 08.ogg}} '''Nicole:''' Of course, when you access the dicier sections, be sure to keep our vision in mind.

:{{A|vo mdeq002 1 varka 05.ogg}} '''Varka:''' Hahaha, well let's get this show on the road. I'm ready to witness our Honorary Knight's story first-hand!

:{{DIcon}} This is where I began my search for {{MC|m=her|f=him}}.
::{{DIcon}} Still, {{MC|m=she|f=he}} is more important to me than any specific place.
:{{A|vo mdeq002 22 varka 07.ogg}} '''Varka:''' I get that. The people are what make Mondstadt what it is, too... all the carefree kids running around, livening up the place.
:{{A|vo mdeq002 22 varka 08.ogg}} '''Varka:''' Which reminds me, I never thanked you for helping Mondstadt out back then.
:{{A|vo mdeq002 22 varka 09.ogg}} '''Varka:''' It takes a special person to do what you did. Most people are helpless in the face of Abyssal corruption. Considering their target was Dvalin... things could have been bad.

:{{A|vo mdeq002 22 varka 10.ogg}} '''Varka:''' I suppose Barbatos could have handled it, even though he hadn't been awake for long. But, still... I doubt the ending would have turned out quite so perfect.
:{{A|vo mdeq002 22 varka 11.ogg}} '''Varka:''' Dvalin is family to him, y'know. Having to choose between the dragon's life and Mondstadt's safety... That would've been cruel.
:{{A|vo mdeq002 22 varka 12.ogg}} '''Varka:''' Not to mention, the Wild Hunt would have reached our borders sooner or later. We'd have been stretched thin without your help.

:{{DIcon}} Huh, I guess you're right.
:{{A|vo mdeq002 22 varka 15.ogg}} '''Varka:''' Hah, look at us, taking down the Abyss in two separate nations! Doin' the Knights of Favonius proud, aren't we?
:{{DIcon}} I feel like Paimon might have a few things to say about that...

:{{A|vo mdeq002 22 varka 16.ogg}} '''Varka:''' Hah, I guess not. In any case, for a knight, honor is something you get to define for yourself, no matter what the outside world thinks.
:{{A|vo mdeq002 22 varka 17.ogg}} '''Varka:''' And that's the question, isn't it? Why do we do what we do? But, I think it's safe to say... You already know the answer.
:{{DIcon}} ...I do.

:{{A|vo mdeq002 22 venti 04.ogg}} '''Venti:''' *sigh* Disappointing, but... understandable.
:{{A|vo mdeq002 22 venti 05.ogg}} '''Venti:''' Oh, I almost forgot. Since this banquet is also for the actors, I invited [[Dvalin]].
:{{A|vo mdeq002 22 varka 20.ogg}} '''Varka:''' Hahaha, alright! Might hike up the bill a bit, but who cares? I haven't seen him in too long.
:{{A|vo mdeq002 22 venti 06.ogg}} '''Venti:''' Yeah, well... He turned me down. He never did like being the center of attention...
:{{A|vo mdeq002 22 venti 07.ogg}} '''Venti:''' The city is a little too small for him to spread his wings. Even if no one is afraid of him, he could still take out a windmill or two... Guess it's better not to risk it.
:{{A|vo mdeq002 22 varka 21.ogg}} '''Varka:''' Huh, maybe it's time to draft a proposal to build him a landing pad?

:{{A|vo mdeq002 22 varka 22.ogg}} '''Varka:''' To our Honorary Knight!
:{{A|vo mdeq002 22 venti 09.ogg}} '''Venti:''' I often think about [[Ending Note|our parting]] at [[Windrise]], you know. And now, almost in the blink of an eye, the final stop on your journey is just around the corner... [[Snezhnaya]].
:{{A|vo mdeq002 22 venti 10.ogg}} '''Venti:''' The [[Tsaritsa]]'s plans have continued to advance. Now, only the [[Pyro]] [[Gnosis]] remains free from her grasp.
:{{A|vo mdeq002 22 varka 23.ogg}} '''Varka:''' But if even [[The Captain]] couldn't take [[Mavuika]]'s Gnosis by force, I guess we don't need to be concerned about its safety for now. So that's good news, at least.
:{{A|vo mdeq002 22 venti 11.ogg}} '''Venti:''' Heh, you wouldn't be taking a dig at someone else's ability to hold onto their Gnosis, now would you, Grand Master?
:{{A|vo mdeq002 22 varka 24.ogg}} '''Varka:''' Haha, of course not. I'm not one to rub salt in old wounds.
:{{A|vo mdeq002 22 venti 12.ogg}} '''Venti:''' Heh, her Harbingers do often tend to take a rather extreme approach. Just look at [[Childe]] or [[Signora]].
:{{A|vo mdeq002 22 venti 13.ogg}} '''Venti:''' But we would be mistaken to ignore the fact that Signora did not win the [[Geo]] Gnosis using force.
:{{A|vo mdeq002 22 varka 25.ogg}} '''Varka:''' Right, you told me about the contract [[Morax]] signed with her before his death... You're saying she didn't need to resort to violence in Mondstadt either?
:{{A|vo mdeq002 22 venti 14.ogg}} '''Venti:''' That's right. If she was able to provide a reason convincing enough to persuade Morax, she could have persuaded me no problem.
:{{A|vo mdeq002 22 venti 15.ogg}} '''Venti:''' I suppose she just... didn't think there was a reason to negotiate. I had just woken up, so I must not have seemed like much of a threat.
:{{A|vo mdeq002 22 venti 16.ogg}} '''Venti:''' Honestly, the Gnosis was of no use to me. I didn't care who it belonged to, or what means were used to take it...
:{{A|vo mdeq002 22 venti 17.ogg}} '''Venti:''' I just knew if I fought her in that moment, the Cathedral... Perhaps even the entire city might have become collateral damage.
:{{A|vo mdeq002 22 varka 26.ogg}} '''Varka:''' True. I wouldn't put it past Signora to take civilians as hostages, either.
:{{DIcon}} So that's the full story...
:{{A|vo mdeq002 22 venti 18.ogg}} '''Venti:''' In the end, though, it was those same methods that led to her end. After all, her third target — the [[The Shogun|Raiden Shogun]] — wasn't a big negotiator back then.
:{{A|vo mdeq002 22 venti 19.ogg}} '''Venti:''' Perhaps Signora's success in Mondstadt and [[Liyue]] convinced her that she was a match for the [[Archon]] of any nation.
:{{DIcon}} I had to stop her.
:{{A|vo mdeq002 22 venti 20.ogg}} '''Venti:''' You did the right thing. It pained me to see [[Inazuma]] as it was back then. I'm glad things have changed since.
:{{A|vo mdeq002 22 venti 21.ogg}} '''Venti:''' Of course, now the elite force of Harbingers has quite a few missing from its ranks, so I suspect the Tsaritsa no longer has the means to meddle in other nations like she used to.
:{{A|vo mdeq002 22 venti 22.ogg}} '''Venti:''' Who knows? Perhaps a chance to formally meet her in Snezhnaya might come sooner than we think.
:{{A|vo mdeq002 22 varka 27.ogg}} '''Varka:''' Some of our knights remain stationed in Nod-Krai. If you need help, just say the word, and we'll be there.
:{{DIcon}} Thank you both...
:{{DIcon}} I'm getting closer to the truth. I can feel it.
:{{A|vo mdeq002 22 venti 23.ogg}} '''Venti:''' Heh, the look in your eyes... It's changed a lot since you first set off from Mondstadt.
:{{A|vo mdeq002 22 venti 24.ogg}} '''Venti:''' But, my advice remains unchanged. Never forget that the journey itself has meaning, {{Traveler}}.
:{{A|vo mdeq002 22 venti 25.ogg}} '''Venti:''' The birds of Teyvat, the songs and the cities, the Tsaritsa, her Fatui and the monsters... they are all part of that journey.
:{{A|vo mdeq002 22 venti 26.ogg}} '''Venti:''' Perhaps earth-shaking truths and indescribable trials await you at the end... Just remember, there is more to life than that.
:{{DIcon}} I will. Thank you.
:{{A|vo mdeq002 22 venti 27.ogg}} '''Venti:''' Alright, that's more than enough acting like a real Archon for one night...
:{{A|vo mdeq002 22 venti 28.ogg}} '''Venti:''' And still, not a sip of drink for dear old Venti at a time like this...? You're no fun, Varka!

==Steps==
# Go to the [[Children of Echoes]]
# Chat with Ifa
# Ask the tribal chiefs about the situation

# Defeat the base guards and switch the flag

==Gameplay Notes==
* During steps 8–12, the player will be in a [[Special Story Mode]], and the active party will be limited to a trial Traveler (Pyro), Kachina, Mualani, and Kinich.
** Leaving the Special Story Mode will reset the quest to Step 7, and all progress will be lost.
* All characters' [[energy]] will be restored to full when the fight at the Masters of the Night-Wind's base begins, as well as after the flag is switched.
* All characters' [[HP]] will be restored once when the Collective of Plenty flag is switched, and again when the Masters of the Night-Wind flag is switched.
