==Dialogue==
{{Quest Description|Since you've got a free moment, why not take a walk around the Children of Echoes?}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Approach the marked location at the Children of Echoes)
:{{A|vo nteq001 1 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh? Why are all these people gathered around? Did something happen?
:{{A|vo nteq001 1 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Let's go take a look!
:{{A|vo nteq001 1 pacal 01.ogg}} '''Pacal:''' How's it looking, doc? Is there... any hope for him?
:{{A|vo nteq001 1 ifa 01.ogg}} '''???:''' Chill, bro. I'm thinking.
:{{A|vo nteq001 1 ifa 02.ogg}} '''???:''' This dude's... [[Milray]], right? What a lil' champ... Barely made a noise, despite all the pain he must be in. Did he fight in the war?
:{{A|vo nteq001 1 pacal 02.ogg}} '''Pacal:''' That's right. We'd never normally send such a young Tepetlisaur into battle, but we couldn't stop him. Developed a real knack for sneaking past us and running off to the frontline to fight the [[Abyss]].
:{{A|vo nteq001 1 pacal 03.ogg}} '''Pacal:''' He's a smart one, that's for sure. Might not be the strongest, but he ran rings around those Abyssal monsters.
:{{A|vo nteq001 1 pacal 04.ogg}} '''Pacal:''' We even awarded him a Warrior's Medal after the war ended. But then he took a turn for the worse a few days ago. He's been having fainting spells ever since...
:{{A|vo nteq001 1 ifa 03.ogg}} '''???:''' Poor little guy... Already a battle-worn veteran, yet still so young.
:'''Milray:''' *whimper*
:{{A|vo nteq001 1 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hey, [[Kachina]], what's going on here?
:{{A|vo nteq001 1 kachina 01.ogg}} '''Kachina:''' {{Traveler}}, Paimon, long time no see.
:{{Introductory Note|Kachina}}
:{{A|vo nteq001 1 kachina 02.ogg}} '''Kachina:''' So basically, there's this young Tepetlisaur in our tribe called Milray. We're not sure what's wrong with him, but he's been getting weaker and weaker by the day. [[Ifa]]'s taking a look at him.
:{{A|vo nteq001 1 kachina 03.ogg}} '''Kachina:''' [[Naiyan]], who he grew up with, is here too. We're all really worried about him.
:{{A|vo nteq001 1 tiyaca 01.ogg}} '''Tiyaca:''' When my daughter got lost in the mountains, it was Milray who helped bring her back.
:{{A|vo nteq001 1 yolehua 01.ogg}} '''Yolehua:''' To think that he made it through the war, but now that peace has finally come... *sigh*
:{{A|vo nteq001 1 cacucu 01.ogg}} '''Cacucu:''' Steady there, bro. We'll find a way.
:{{DIcon}} And you are...
:{{A|vo nteq001 1 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ah, you're that... Qucu-Thesaurus from the vet clinic!
:{{A|vo nteq001 1 cacucu 02.ogg}} '''Cacucu:''' Huh? What are you on about?
:{{A|vo nteq001 1 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So this "Ifa" you just mentioned is actually—
:{{A|vo nteq001 1 ifa 04.ogg}} '''Ifa:''' Hey, yo, everyone, please chill! I think I've got this figured out.
:{{A|vo nteq001 1 ifa 05.ogg}} '''Ifa:''' For a juvenile [[saurian]], he showed remarkable courage in the war, but he's too young to be using that much [[phlogiston]].
:{{A|vo nteq001 1 ifa 06.ogg}} '''Ifa:''' As a result, he developed a rare pathological change. The initial symptoms might not have been obvious, but he's gone untreated for so long that his condition is now very serious.
:{{A|vo nteq001 1 pacal 05.ogg}} '''Pacal:''' You mean he originally got sick during the war, but the symptoms only just started to show up now?
:{{A|vo nteq001 1 ifa 07.ogg}} '''Ifa:''' That's right. He may have just been acting tough this whole time... Didn't want his friends stressing out over him.
:{{A|vo nteq001 1 naiyan 01.ogg}} '''Naiyan:''' Wooo... Rrrooo!
:{{A|vo nteq001 1 milray 01.ogg}} '''Milray:''' Rroooh...
:{{A|vo nteq001 1 kachina 04.ogg}} '''Kachina:''' Ifa, there must be something you can do, right? Please, help him!
:{{A|vo nteq001 1 ifa 08.ogg}} '''Ifa:''' Something this rare? I don't have anything on hand that can treat it.
:{{A|vo nteq001 1 ifa 09.ogg}} '''Ifa:''' Good news is that I read about a similar case back when I was still studying. The scroll mentioned two essential ingredients.
:{{A|vo nteq001 1 ifa 10.ogg}} '''Ifa:''' First up, an herbaceous perennial known as an "Ocean Zephyr"... Though they can grow practically anywhere, they're exceedingly rare.
:{{A|vo nteq001 1 ifa 11.ogg}} '''Ifa:''' The second... Honestly, I couldn't figure it out back then either. The name recorded was "Sacred Flame Crystal," but there wasn't much else to go on beyond that.
:{{A|vo nteq001 1 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' [[Sacred Flame]]... Like the one burning in the [[Stadium of the Sacred Flame|Stadium]]?
:{{A|vo nteq001 1 kachina 05.ogg}} '''Kachina:''' When Mualani and I took part in the [[Pilgrimage of the Return of the Sacred Flame]], we collected loads of [[Contending Spark]]s during the team stage.
:{{A|vo nteq001 1 kachina 06.ogg}} '''Kachina:''' Apparently they're sparks from the Sacred Flame itself. They even make you feel all warm and fuzzy while you carry them! Do you think these Crystals might be something similar?
:{{A|vo nteq001 1 ifa 12.ogg}} '''Ifa:''' From the name, I'd say we're lookin' for a rarer, purer form of Sacred Flame.
:{{A|vo nteq001 1 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You sure there's even such a thing? We've been in Natlan for ages now, but we've never come across anything like that.
:{{A|vo nteq001 1 pacal 06.ogg}} '''Pacal:''' ...So it would seem, as it happens.
:{{A|vo nteq001 1 together 01.ogg}} '''Kachina & Paimon:''' Huh!?
:{{A|vo nteq001 1 kachina 07.ogg}} '''Kachina:''' For real, Uncle [[Pacal]]?
:{{A|vo nteq001 1 pacal 07.ogg}} '''Pacal:''' It's a coincidence that I've even heard of it. Apparently, the people of Natlan knew how to make a special kind of "Sacred Flame Crystal" way back when.
:{{A|vo nteq001 1 pacal 08.ogg}} '''Pacal:''' I'm not sure exactly how they did it, but the other chiefs might know something... I'll go ask them.
:{{A|vo nteq001 1 pacal 09.ogg}} '''Pacal:''' Thank you, Ifa, your diagnosis was a huge help. Mind if I keep you a little longer?
:{{A|vo nteq001 1 ifa 13.ogg}} '''Ifa:''' Sure thing, dude. I'll stick around until we've got some results.
:{{A|vo nteq001 1 pacal 10.ogg}} '''Pacal:''' Great. In that case, let's go our separate ways for now. Milray needs some proper rest, and he's not gonna get that with so many people gathered around.
:{{A|vo nteq001 1 pacal 11.ogg}} '''Pacal:''' I'll let you all know as soon as there's any news. Fingers crossed, he'll soon be on the mend.
{{Dialogue End}}
{{Quest Description|update|The Children of Echoes' tribespeople are working hard to save a little Tepetlisaur, and the famous sauro-vet Ifa is also present. You've heard so much about him — might as well make your way over to say hello.}}<!-- quest interrupted. Acatl is busy completing the quest [[Sage Supreme]]-->
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Approach the marked location)
:{{A|vo nteq001 2 ifa 01.ogg}} '''Ifa:''' What up, my dudes?
:{{DIcon}} Umm... Hello?
::{{A|vo nteq001 2 ifa 02a 1.ogg}} '''Ifa:''' Haha, hey, come on, chill.
:{{DIcon}} Your rep precedes you, bro. Respect.
::{{A|vo nteq001 2 ifa 02b 1.ogg}} '''Ifa:''' Man, I can tell we're totally on the same wavelength.
:{{A|vo nteq001 2 ifa 03.ogg}} '''Ifa:''' The name's Ifa, a vet from the Flower-Feather Clan. This here's my assistant, [[Cacucu]]. Dude's all about copying what others say.
:{{A|vo nteq001 2 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' We're...
:{{A|vo nteq001 2 ifa 04.ogg}} '''Ifa:''' {{Traveler}} and Paimon, yeah? Everyone's heard all about you two — you're absolute legends!
:{{A|vo nteq001 2 ifa 05.ogg}} '''Ifa:''' The total package: Brave, wise, and strong... Best hero duo I've ever seen, no contest!
:{{A|vo nteq001 2 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Aw, hehe, you're making Paimon blush!
:{{A|vo nteq001 2 ifa 06.ogg}} '''Ifa:''' Truth is, I spent the war treating wounded saurians. Never got a chance to fight alongside you.
:{{DIcon}} You saved so many saurian lives. That was an amazing contribution too!
:{{DIcon}} A legend among vets.
:{{A|vo nteq001 2 ifa 07.ogg}} '''Ifa:''' Yo, thanks bro! I appreciate that!
:{{A|vo nteq001 2 kachina 01.ogg}} '''Kachina:''' There was always a long line outside Ifa's clinic back then. Even Cacucu was so busy he was running around like a headless chicken.
:{{A|vo nteq001 2 cacucu 01.ogg}} '''Cacucu:''' Seriously! Seriously!
:{{A|vo nteq001 2 ifa 08.ogg}} '''Ifa:''' True that... more wounded were pilin' up by the day.
:{{A|vo nteq001 2 ifa 09.ogg}} '''Ifa:''' Dude, the Abyss is no joke, sneaky enough to hit us right where it hurts. Lots of docs have dropped at their posts over the last few years...
:{{A|vo nteq001 2 ifa 10.ogg}} '''Ifa:''' There's some fresh talent rolling in recently, I'm hoping they can step up quick. But vet med's no joke. There's a ton of challenges to overcome before you can be a qualified vet.
:{{DIcon}} That's rough...
:{{A|vo nteq001 2 ifa 11.ogg}} '''Ifa:''' No matter how hard you hit the books, you're still gonna run into all kinds of weird diseases that are hard to treat. Like Milray's — so rare it doesn't even have a name.
:{{A|vo nteq001 2 ifa 12.ogg}} '''Ifa:''' If my old man hadn't forced me to read all kinds of different stuff when I was a kid, I'd probably only be able to suggest a more conservative treatment. It's true what they say, bro — there's always more to learn.
:{{A|vo nteq001 2 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, so your dad was a vet too?
:{{A|vo nteq001 2 ifa 13.ogg}} '''Ifa:''' Yeah, totally. Our family's medical knowledge has been passed down over generations. My old man started steering me toward being a vet when I was a kid, schooling me on all kinds of herbs. And man, if I forgot anything, out came the broom.
:{{A|vo nteq001 2 ifa 14.ogg}} '''Ifa:''' My family's been vets for generations now. No clue who it was that kicked off the tradition though, you know?
:{{A|vo nteq001 2 ifa 15.ogg}} '''Ifa:''' Back when I was a kid, my dad said something about our skills being "medicine born of guilt"... But the reason we got into it doesn't really matter — what matters is that it's useful.
:{{A|vo nteq001 2 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Guilt? Sounds pretty strange to Paimon. Usually, you only feel guilty when you've done something wrong...
:{{A|vo nteq001 2 ifa 16.ogg}} '''Ifa:''' Who knows? After he passed, there wasn't anybody else I could ask. I figure it's because guilt gnaws at anyone practicing medicine. When you fail to fix someone up... I've been there.
:{{A|vo nteq001 2 ifa 17.ogg}} '''Ifa:''' So I'm gonna do my best to make sure that doesn't happen this time. I don't recall ever seeing a record of any patient with his malady who was successfully cured, so maybe Milray will be the first.
:{{DIcon}} You've got this, bro.
:{{A|vo nteq001 2 ifa 18.ogg}} '''Ifa:''' Heck yeah, I do.
:{{Black Screen|You talk for a while longer...}}
:{{A|vo nteq001 2 ifa 19.ogg}} '''Ifa:''' Oh? Looks like the chiefs are back. Let's go see what they have to say.
{{Dialogue End}}
{{Quest Description|update|While you were chatting, the tribal chiefs came back. Would they know anything about the Sacred Flame Crystals? Now's a good time to ask and see.}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Approach the chiefs)
:{{A|vo nteq001 3 wayna 01.ogg}} '''Wayna:''' The last time I was here, I remember seeing him happily rolling around with [[Ayo]]. This is so sudden..
:{{A|vo nteq001 3 biram 01.ogg}} '''Biram:''' Well, as the saying goes, "illness strikes like a landslide." It's not uncommon for people and saurians to just collapse overnight.
:{{A|vo nteq001 3 mutota 01.ogg}} '''Mutota:''' Given that he first fell sick during the war, he's done well to make it this far.
:{{A|vo nteq001 3 amina 01.ogg}} '''Amina:''' Hey, little guy, are you okay? Does it hurt?
:{{A|vo nteq001 3 acatl 01.ogg}} '''Acatl:''' For one so young to risk life and limb on the field of battle... This, too, is a responsibility we adults must bear.
:{{A|vo nteq001 3 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Whoa, all six tribal chiefs in one place! Not something you see every day...
:{{A|vo nteq001 3 wayna 02.ogg}} '''Wayna:''' Haha, it's true that we used to hardly ever meet up like this. The affairs of our own tribes were usually enough to keep us all swamped.
:{{A|vo nteq001 3 wayna 03.ogg}} '''Wayna:''' These days, though, group dinners on our days off have practically become the routine, so don't look too surprised.
:{{A|vo nteq001 3 acatl 02.ogg}} '''Acatl:''' Group dinners? More like group mooching! You guys always seem to end up at my place... So shameless.
:{{A|vo nteq001 3 wayna 04.ogg}} '''Wayna:''' Well, your cooking is too good to resist. You've seen how hopeless the rest of us are in that regard... *ahem* Anyway, let's get down to business.
:{{A|vo nteq001 3 mutota 02.ogg}} '''Mutota:''' Ifa, we've been informed about the situation. Once again, it's a good thing you were here to help out.
:{{A|vo nteq001 3 mutota 03.ogg}} '''Mutota:''' Milray and the other Tepetlisaurs have helped transport goods for the Flower-Feather Clan in the past. We won't just stand by and watch while he suffers.
:{{A|vo nteq001 3 ifa 01.ogg}} '''Ifa:''' I just happened to come across a record of a case like his back home, but I don't know anything about this "Sacred Flame Crystal."
:{{A|vo nteq001 3 amina 02.ogg}} '''Amina:''' I haven't heard of it either. Can the Sacred Flame even take other forms?
:{{A|vo nteq001 3 biram 02.ogg}} '''Biram:''' It can indeed. While I've never seen this happen in the flesh, I have read references to it in woven scrolls.
:{{A|vo nteq001 3 biram 03.ogg}} '''Biram:''' In ancient Natlan, besides the Pilgrimage of the Return of the Sacred Flame, there is said to have been another way to produce Sacred Flame, known as the "[[Bloomflower Trials]]."
:;(A [[Yumkasaurus Whelp]] is shown walking nearby)
:{{A|vo nteq001 3 biram 04.ogg}} '''Biram:''' It was a combat exercise held jointly by the six tribes that was even more intense than the Pilgrimage, so they occasionally yielded an even purer form of Sacred Flame.
:{{A|vo nteq001 3 together 01.ogg}} '''Kachina & Paimon:''' Sacred Flame Crystals!?
:{{A|vo nteq001 3 ifa 02.ogg}} '''Ifa:''' For real? How have I never heard of that...?
:{{A|vo nteq001 3 biram 05.ogg}} '''Biram:''' Simple. The Bloomflower Trials haven't been held for centuries.
:{{DIcon}} Is there some hidden story behind this?
:{{A|vo nteq001 3 biram 06.ogg}} '''Biram:''' Something seems to have happened the last time they were held, but it was so long ago that I don't know the specifics.
:;(A [[Koholasaurus Whelp]] is secretly watching from a distance)
:{{A|vo nteq001 3 biram 07.ogg}} '''Biram:''' The more reasonable explanation is this — that people once believed these Sacred Flame Crystals to be vessels of extraordinary power, and that warriors could use them to enhance their own strength.
:{{A|vo nteq001 3 biram 08.ogg}} '''Biram:''' In reality, they turned out to be far less miraculous than hoped for. In some rare, very specific circumstances, they proved irreplaceable, but they were not so different from the regular Sacred Flame in essence.
:{{A|vo nteq001 3 biram 09.ogg}} '''Biram:''' The Pilgrimage produced enough Sacred Flame, making the Bloomflower Trials obsolete. And thus, they were forgotten.
:{{A|vo nteq001 3 ifa 03.ogg}} '''Ifa:''' Ah, I get it. So to save Milray, we have to revive the Bloomflower Trials and get all six tribes to take part. That sounds rough...
:{{A|vo nteq001 3 wayna 05.ogg}} '''Wayna:''' I'd say we'd be better off not treating it like some kind of hassle.
:{{A|vo nteq001 3 wayna 06.ogg}} '''Wayna:''' All six tribes need to take part, sure, but not everyone has to show up. We can keep it voluntary, so warriors who happen to have time can sign up and fight it out of their own accord.
:;(A [[Tatankasaurus Whelp]] is shown watching from a distance, which Ifa notices)
:{{A|vo nteq001 3 wayna 07.ogg}} '''Wayna:''' Since the war ended, the Pilgrimage has become more like a tournament for our warriors to compete in and keep themselves in shape, so why not let them hone their skills on a fresh new stage?
:{{A|vo nteq001 3 mutota 04.ogg}} '''Mutota:''' We should never drop our guard completely, even in times of peace. Put like that, it seems high time we restarted the Bloomflower Trials.
:{{A|vo nteq001 3 acatl 03.ogg}} '''Acatl:''' I'm with you on that. Nothing gets the blood pumping like a contest to see which tribe's the strongest, huh?
:{{A|vo nteq001 3 biram 10.ogg}} '''Biram:''' No objections on my part.
:{{A|vo nteq001 3 amina 03.ogg}} '''Amina:''' I'll go discuss this with the others. I'm sure there'll be plenty of warriors who'll be itching to take part.
:{{A|vo nteq001 3 amina 04.ogg}} '''Amina:''' I can't speak for everyone else, but I can guarantee that [[Mualani]] will be there — there's nothing she loves more than a lively occasion.
:{{A|vo nteq001 3 wayna 08.ogg}} '''Wayna:''' And I guess your vote was a foregone conclusion, eh, Pacal? Great, we're all in agreement, then.
:{{A|vo nteq001 3 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Nice!
:{{A|vo nteq001 3 pacal 01.ogg}} '''Pacal:''' ...Thanks, everyone, it really means a lot.
:{{A|vo nteq001 3 wayna 09.ogg}} '''Wayna:''' Let's head back to our tribes and see how many people are willing to sign up. If interest is high, we'll hold a big event, but if not, we'll keep it small.
:{{A|vo nteq001 3 mutota 05.ogg}} '''Mutota:''' Agreed. Rules will be crucial too. A competition without rules is just mindless violence, and that's not what we want.
:{{A|vo nteq001 3 biram 11.ogg}} '''Biram:''' I'll draw up an outline. Let's meet up at the Speaker's Chamber later — after all, we'll still need the Pyro Archon's final approval.
:{{A|vo nteq001 3 amina 05.ogg}} '''Amina:''' Oh yeah, and we'll also need some Ocean Zephyrs to cure Milray. Who'll go gather them while we're organizing the Trials?
:{{A|vo nteq001 3 ifa 04.ogg}} '''Ifa:''' I've got that covered... I just noticed that some of Milray's friends have shown up.
:;(All the saurians hiding nearby revealed themselves)
:{{A|vo nteq001 3 mutota 06.ogg}} '''Mutota:''' You mean these saurians? You're right, there's all sorts. Seems like he's quite the popular little fella, huh...
:{{A|vo nteq001 3 ifa 05.ogg}} '''Ifa:''' Cacucu, can you hit them up and ask if they'd be down to lend a claw?
:{{A|vo nteq001 3 cacucu 01.ogg}} '''Cacucu:''' Sure thing, bro. I've got you, bro.
:{{A|vo nteq001 3 wayna 10.ogg}} '''Wayna:''' Hah, must be nice having a saurian companion who can talk...
:{{A|vo nteq001 3 acatl 04.ogg}} '''Acatl:''' Well, if that's everything, how about we call it a day?
:{{A|vo nteq001 3 mutota 07.ogg}} '''Mutota:''' Alright. See you later.
:{{A|vo nteq001 3 mutota 08.ogg}} '''Mutota:''' Ifa, let's head back — and bring these saurians along too. We've gotta teach them how to identify Ocean Zephyrs.
:{{A|vo nteq001 3 amina 06.ogg}} '''Amina:''' Seeya, little guy. We'll come visit you again soon.
:{{A|vo nteq001 3 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Whoa, they sure are quick on their feet!
:{{A|vo nteq001 3 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Guess they're chiefs for a reason — when they decide on something, it gets done right away...
:{{DIcon}} More the "Let's sleep on it" type, are we, Paimon?
:{{A|vo nteq001 3 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hehe, but that's what you're here for, right? Whenever Paimon puts things off, even for just a while, you'll handle them straight away!
:{{A|vo nteq001 3 cacucu 02.ogg}} '''Cacucu:''' Oh wow... No way, bro!
:{{A|vo nteq001 3 kachina 01.ogg}} '''Kachina:''' Even Cacucu's done with this conversation...
:{{A|vo nteq001 3 pacal 02.ogg}} '''Pacal:''' I'll go spread the word. Kachina, you gonna sign up?
:{{A|vo nteq001 3 kachina 02.ogg}} '''Kachina:''' O—Of course!
:{{A|vo nteq001 3 pacal 03.ogg}} '''Pacal:''' In that case, let's head over together. {{Traveler}}, Paimon, see you at the Speaker's Chamber in a bit.
:{{A|vo nteq001 3 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' See ya!
:{{A|vo nteq001 3 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So far, so good! At this rate, Milray will be better in no time.
:'''Milray:''' *whimper*...
:{{A|vo nteq001 3 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh, you're awake? Wanna try getting a bit more sleep?
:{{A|vo nteq001 3 milray 02.ogg}} '''Milray:''' Rrrrawrrr...
:{{DIcon}} I feel like...
:{{DIcon}} ...He has something to say?
:{{A|vo nteq001 3 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You think so? Is he feeling hungry, then?
:{{A|vo nteq001 3 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hey, Cacucu! Can you help us transl—
:{{A|vo nteq001 3 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ugh, long gone! Oh no, he does seem pretty anxious... What are you trying to say, little guy?
{{Dialogue End}}
{{Quest Description|update|Plans have been made to hold the Bloomflower Trials, and the chiefs have returned to their tribes to make arrangements. As you prepare to leave, the little Tepetlisaur Milray suddenly looks very anxious. Does it have something it wants to say?}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(After competing the previous step)
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (It seems like the Bloomflower Trials are all set to take place, which means we've got the Sacred Flame Crystals covered, and Milray's saurian buddies are out collecting Ocean Zephyrs too. So, on paper at least, everything should be fine...)
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (But why does Milray look so anxious? Has his condition gotten worse? We'd better ask him, just in case.)

;(Talk to Milray or Naiyan, optional)
:'''Milray:''' ...
:'''Naiyan:''' ...

;(Talk to Milray or Naiyan while indwelling a Tepetlisaurus<!-- Yumkasaurus does not give any interaction options -->)
:'''Milray:''' *Rrraw* *cough* *cough*
:'''Naiyan:''' Everything okay, Milray? Do you wanna eat something?
:'''Naiyan:''' Wh—Why don't I go pick you some fruit?
:'''Milray:''' Thanks for looking after me, Naiyan. I'll be fine...
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' Hello, Milray and Naiyan.
:'''Naiyan:''' Oh? Who are you...?
:'''Naiyan:''' Haven't seen you around here before, hmm... Have you come to visit Milray, too?
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' Yeah! I just wanted to tell you that you have nothing to worry about, okay? Those nice humans have found a way to cure you.
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' It won't be long before they've gathered enough Ocean Zephyrs and Sacred Flame Crystals, so hang in there — you'll be on the mend soon.
:'''Milray:''' Sacred Flame Crystals... *cough* *cough*
:'''Naiyan:''' Milray...
:'''Milray:''' That's exactly what I'm worried about. Those nice humans have no idea how dangerous Sacred Flame Crystals are...
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' ...Dangerous?
:'''Milray:''' Yes, very dangerous. They can beguile human hearts, turn friends into enemies... The humans must be very careful...
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (Milray struggles to say something else, but he soon falls unconscious once more.)
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' ("Beguile human hearts"? The chiefs didn't mention anything about that before... Could there be unknown risks associated with using Sacred Flame Crystals?)
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (But, more importantly... If even the chiefs know nothing about this, despite all the knowledge they possess, then where did Milray and Naiyan come to hear of it?)
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' Naiyan, who told you guys that Sacred Flame Crystals were dangerous?
:'''Naiyan:''' A mysterious [[Qucusaur]] we met while fighting those big monsters... He was the one who told us.
:;(Flashback begins)
:'''Naiyan:''' I still remember how our friends were all running around in a panic the first time Milray passed out...
:'''???:''' Not this disease, not again... We'll need to find Ocean Zephyrs and Sacred Flame Crystals...
:'''???:''' But Sacred Flame Crystals can beguile human hearts, turn friends into enemies... What should I do?
:;(Flashback ends)
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' Where did this Qucusaur find out, then?
:'''Naiyan:''' I don't know... He often said things we couldn't understand. Apart from us, no other little saurians wanted to play with him, and as far as I could tell, he didn't have any human companions either.
:'''Naiyan:''' But I'm sure he wouldn't have lied to us. He's saved us many times, and we're very close friends.
:'''Naiyan:''' I really, really hope that Milray recovers soon. But if Sacred Flame Crystals genuinely are that dangerous... I don't think that's the way he would want to be saved.
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' Don't worry, I'm here to help.
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' I'll remind the humans to be careful. In the meantime, you take good care of Milray, alright? Just make sure he doesn't worry too much and gets lots of rest.
:'''Naiyan:''' You'd do that for him? Thank you so much!
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (This is becoming more mysterious by the minute. With Mavuika and the six chiefs present, I'm sure everything will be alright — but still, I'd better find a chance to talk to Mavuika about it.)

;(Talk to Milray or Naiyan again while indwelling a saurian<!-- both Tepetlisaurus and Yumkasaurus confirmed -->, optional)
:'''Milray:''' ...
:'''Naiyan:''' You'd better get well soon, Milray. There are still so many things I want to say to you.
{{Dialogue End}}
{{Quest Description|update|Who knew there would be such unfavorable rumors about Sacred Flame Crystals... It'd be good to also bring this up with Mavuika.}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Enter the Speaker's Chamber)
:{{A|vo nteq001 5 mavuika 01.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' I've read through your proposal, and it sounds like a great idea.
:{{A|vo nteq001 5 mavuika 02.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' Even if it wasn't for Milray's situation, there'd be many reasons to start holding the Bloomflower Trials again. How many warriors have been signing up?
:{{Introductory Note|Mavuika}}
: {{A|vo nteq001 5 wayna 01.ogg}} '''Wayna:''' Far more than we anticipated.
:{{A|vo nteq001 5 mutota 01.ogg}} '''Mutota:''' Our warriors sure are fired up! The ones who came late even held a protest outside the signup booth, so we had to make an exception by adding a few more spots.
:{{A|vo nteq001 5 biram 01.ogg}} '''Biram:''' So many people have signed up that we've had to divide the competition up into main matches and exhibition matches. Each main match will pit two different tribes against one another, while the exhibition matches will see three tribes going up against another three.
:{{A|vo nteq001 5 biram 02.ogg}} '''Biram:''' I'm planning to limit the number of spots for the exhibition matches. Accidents are more likely in tangled melees, so with fewer contestants, we can ensure that any injuries will be attended to promptly.
:{{A|vo nteq001 5 mavuika 03.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' Well, you've clearly thought this through with care. You have my approval — and don't worry, I'll find a way to fund it.
:{{A|vo nteq001 5 together 01.ogg}} '''Chiefs:''' Thank you, Archon!
:{{A|vo nteq001 5 mavuika 04.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' Where will the Trials be held? I'll stop by later to see how things are going, but I won't be taking part. Wouldn't want to spoil everyone else's fun.
:{{A|vo nteq001 5 pacal 01.ogg}} '''Pacal:''' The main venue will be near the Stadium of the Sacred Flame, with additional arenas set up around the various tribes.
:{{A|vo nteq001 5 mavuika 05.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' Alright, I'm all out of questions. Keep at it, everyone, and thanks for your hard work.
:{{A|vo nteq001 5 amina 01.ogg}} '''Amina:''' In that case, we'll be off. It's time we started organizing crews to set up the venues.
:{{A|vo nteq001 5 acatl 01.ogg}} '''Acatl:''' {{Traveler}}, Paimon... Good luck.
:{{A|vo nteq001 5 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh? Good luck with... what, exactly?
:{{A|vo nteq001 5 mavuika 06.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' Hey! It's been a while, you two. Are you here about the Bloomflower Trials too?
:{{A|vo nteq001 5 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yup, we sure are. Sounds like everything's going to plan!
:{{A|vo nteq001 5 mavuika 07.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' "Bloomflower Trials"... The name alone fills me with nostalgia. I first heard about it from my dad, who first heard about it from his dad, my old grandpa.
:{{A|vo nteq001 5 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Guess that means they were last held at least 500 years ago...? Wait a sec, no, it must have been much earlier than that, then...
:{{A|vo nteq001 5 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Whoa, when you put it like that, it does feel kinda surreal that we're doing something that hasn't been done in such a long time!
:{{A|vo nteq001 5 mavuika 08.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' True, but I've got a good feeling about this. We'll pull it off, rest assured.
:{{DIcon}} Do you know anything about Sacred Flame Crystals?
:{{DIcon}} Is there anything dangerous about them?
:{{A|vo nteq001 5 mavuika 09.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' Hmm? What makes you ask?
:{{DIcon}} We've heard rumors that Sacred Flame Crystals can "beguile human hearts"...
:{{A|vo nteq001 5 mavuika 10.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' Hmm... I've never heard such a rumor before. And rationally speaking, it just doesn't even seem possible.
:{{A|vo nteq001 5 mavuika 11.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' The rules governing the [[Ode of Resurrection]] have protected Natlan for many long years, and these rules are themselves fueled by the Sacred Flame's power. We've been working with the Sacred Flame all this time, and we've never noticed anything unusual about it.
:{{A|vo nteq001 5 mavuika 12.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' In essence, Sacred Flame Crystals are just another form of the Sacred Flame. I can't imagine how they could possibly "beguile human hearts."
:{{DIcon}} That's very true.
:{{DIcon}} I find it hard to imagine too.
:{{A|vo nteq001 5 mavuika 13.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' So please, be at ease. And besides, even if they did harbor some kind of evil power, it will not cause any real trouble in the Natlan we now live in — not if I have anything to say about it.
:{{A|vo nteq001 5 mavuika 14.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' Our main priority right now is to hold the Bloomflower Trials so we can collect enough Sacred Flame Crystals to heal that little Tepetlisaurus.
:{{A|vo nteq001 5 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hehe, it's so reassuring to have you on our side, Mavuika.
:{{A|vo nteq001 5 mavuika 15.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' Well, there are some things even I can't handle.
:{{A|vo nteq001 5 mavuika 16.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' For example... It just came to my attention that you've got some people waiting for you outside.
:{{A|vo nteq001 5 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh? Who could they be?
:{{A|vo nteq001 5 mavuika 17.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' You'll find out soon enough... Go on, now. Don't keep them waiting.

;(Talk to Mavuika again, optional)
:{{A|vo dialog nteq001 mavuika 01.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' A new competition brings a new challenge... And who knows? Maybe even a whole new story.
{{Dialogue End}}
{{Quest Description|update|Looks like nobody really understands what's going on... You should probably leave the Speaker's Chamber for now.}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Leave the Speaker's Chamber)
:{{A|vo nteq001 6 mualani 01.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' Finally, you're here!
:{{Introductory Note|Mualani}}
:{{A|vo nteq001 6 iansan 01.ogg}} '''Iansan:''' {{Traveler}}, Paimon. So basically...
:{{Introductory Note|Iansan}}
:{{A|vo nteq001 6 mualani 02.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' Hold up, what happened to "first come, first served"? What I'm saying is, I get to go first!
:{{A|vo nteq001 6 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh, what's going on? Why has everyone turned up all of a sudden?
:{{A|vo nteq001 6 kachina 01.ogg}} '''Kachina:''' Umm, so...
:{{A|vo nteq001 6 mualani 03.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' *ahem* So, you know about the Bloomflower Trials, right? I— I mean we, were wondering... Have you decided which tribe you'll join? If not, how about the [[People of the Springs]]?
:{{A|vo nteq001 6 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Uhhh, what—!?
:{{A|vo nteq001 6 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' We're allowed to take part too!?
:{{A|vo nteq001 6 kinich 01.ogg}} '''Kinich:''' Given that the Trials haven't been held in so long, we're creating a new set of rules for them, separate from the ones for the Pilgrimage.
:{{Introductory Note|Kinich}}
:{{A|vo nteq001 6 olorun 01.ogg}} '''Ororon:''' All of the chiefs have agreed. But whether or not you compete, or which tribe you support... Well, that's completely up to you.
:{{Introductory Note|Ororon|v=5.5}}
:{{A|vo nteq001 6 chasca 01.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' As the hero who saved Natlan, your participation would be a huge morale boost for whoever you choose to join. In other words, recruiting you is every tribe's top priority right now.
:{{Introductory Note|Chasca}}
:{{A|vo nteq001 6 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, so that's what's going on! No wonder Chief [[Acatl]] wished us good luck just now... He must have known this was coming!
:{{A|vo nteq001 6 mualani 04.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' Hehe — and that's all for the chit-chat. I hope you're ready for some serious incentives.
:{{A|vo nteq001 6 mualani 05.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' How do you like the sound of luxury hot spring vouchers? I'll even throw in a selection of fine gifts from the shop!
:{{A|vo nteq001 6 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Luxury hot springs... Sounds like Paimon's perfect vacation!
:{{A|vo nteq001 6 kinich 02.ogg}} '''Kinich:''' If you join the [[Scions of the Canopy]], we'll hold a great barbecue in your honor. The finest quality meat, all you can eat.
:{{A|vo nteq001 6 ajaw 01.ogg}} '''Ajaw:''' And if you join right away, you'll even stand a chance of being taken on as a sidekick of the Almighty Dragonlord, [[K'uhul Ajaw]]!
:{{A|vo nteq001 6 kinich 03.ogg}} '''Kinich:''' Yeah, no one wants that.
:{{A|vo nteq001 6 ajaw 02.ogg}} '''Ajaw:''' Kinich, you little—
:{{A|vo nteq001 6 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' All you can eat barbecue... *salivating*...
:{{A|vo nteq001 6 iansan 02.ogg}} '''Iansan:''' Join up with the Collective of Plenty, and I'll provide a year's worth of training sessions and a personalized nutrition plan to help you become stronger than you already are.
:{{A|vo nteq001 6 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Umm... Paimon's not too keen on training, but getting stronger does sound tempting...
:{{A|vo nteq001 6 olorun 02.ogg}} '''Ororon:''' All I've got to offer are freshly picked vegetables. But I can guarantee they are really tasty.
:{{A|vo nteq001 6 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ooohh, could Paimon get some samples?
:{{A|vo nteq001 6 chasca 02.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' Fancy some flying lessons? Or you could just hitch a ride. I'll take you soaring through the skies myself.
:{{A|vo nteq001 6 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Flying's kinda what Paimon does for a living, but flying around with {{Traveler}} sounds like it could be a lot of fun too!
:{{A|vo nteq001 6 kachina 02.ogg}} '''Kachina:''' I—I can bake [[Saurus Crackers]] and [[Grainfruit Chips]]!
:{{A|vo nteq001 6 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ohh, Paimon loves those too... This is such a tough choice.
:{{A|vo nteq001 6 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Not just 'cause the freebies are tempting, but also because picking one tribe feels like we're betraying all the others...
:{{A|vo nteq001 6 paimon 12.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Y'know what? Paimon's decided... to leave this one to you.
:{{DIcon}} How about I join you all, then?
:{{DIcon}} "Tumaini" belongs to all of Natlan, after all.
:{{A|vo nteq001 6 paimon 13.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Uhh, Paimon's pretty sure that isn't an option...
:{{A|vo nteq001 6 kinich 04.ogg}} '''Kinich:''' Actually, it's not a bad idea... It could work for the exhibition matches, at least.
:{{A|vo nteq001 6 kinich 05a.ogg}}<!--{{A|vo nteq001 6 kinich 05b.ogg}}--> '''Kinich:''' There'd be three tribes on each side. So, for the first half, you're on our side. Second half, theirs. Sound fair?<ref group="Note">Actual voice-over: "There'd be three tribes on one side, versus three on the other for those. So, first half, you're on our side. Second half, on theirs. Sounds fair enough, right?"</ref>
:{{A|vo nteq001 6 olorun 03.ogg}} '''Ororon:''' Huh, I hadn't thought of that... Pretty clever.
:{{A|vo nteq001 6 paimon 14.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What, really? Then as for those perks you mentioned earlier... Hehe...
:{{A|vo nteq001 6 mualani 06.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' Don't worry, my offer still stands. Enjoying ourselves is the number one priority here!
:{{A|vo nteq001 6 kinich 06.ogg}} '''Kinich:''' So it's settled, then? For the first half of the exhibition match, you'll join the Scions of the Canopy, the People of the Springs, and the Children of Echoes, fighting against the other three tribes.<ref group="Note">Actual voice-over: "So it's settled, then? For the first half of the exhibition match, you'll fight alongside us Scions of the Canopy, People of the Springs, and the Children of Echoes against the other three tribes."</ref>
:{{A|vo nteq001 6 mualani 07.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' Haha, feels just like the old days when we used to fight side by side. We're gonna be unstoppable!
:{{A|vo nteq001 6 kinich 07.ogg}} '''Kinich:''' Alright, it's nearly time. Let's get ready and head over there together.
:;(Opens event menu)
{{Dialogue End}}
{{Quest Description|update|You decided to participate in the exhibition match of the Bloomflower Trials. Once again, your comrades-in-arms are Kinich, Mualani, and Kachina. It would only be fitting to give it your all!}}

;(Approach Yuehai Pavilion)
:{{A|vo yllq003 2 yelan 01.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' It looks like we're all here. Well then, time for me to announce the results of the assessment process.
:{{A|vo yllq003 2 yelan 02.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' I won't drone on about the importance of the Tianshu role. Suffice to say that Uncle Tian entrusted me with the monumentally important task of assessing the candidates, and now it falls to me to give him a satisfactory answer.
:{{A|vo yllq003 2 qianwei 01.ogg}} '''Qianwei:''' All of us here know the score. Don't beat around the bush, just get on with it.
:{{A|vo yllq003 2 yelan 03.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' Qianwei has many pioneering ideas, but some of his plans are lacking in detail, and he easily gets into testy exchanges with other people.
:{{A|vo yllq003 2 yelan 04.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' Mingbo is reliable, but not quite ambitious enough, and because of his personality, he struggles to win people over.
:{{A|vo yllq003 2 yelan 05.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' In contrast, Zhiyi is evenly balanced across the board, and enjoys an excellent reputation in Liyue.
:{{A|vo yllq003 2 yelan 06.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' After much consideration, I have decided to recommend Zhiyi to the [[Liyue Qixing]].
:{{A|vo yllq003 2 qianwei 02.ogg}} '''Qianwei:''' What!?
:{{A|vo yllq003 2 mingbo 01.ogg}} '''Mingbo:''' Oh, uh... Congratulations...
:{{A|vo yllq003 2 zhiyi 01.ogg}} '''Zhiyi:''' Thank you. Honestly, I'm a little surprised to hear my name being announced.
:{{A|vo yllq003 2 zhiyi 02.ogg}} '''Zhiyi:''' In my estimation, all three of us are worthy candidates for the Tianshu position. As your competitor, I've become keenly aware of your great talents.
:{{A|vo yllq003 2 zhiyi 03.ogg}} '''Zhiyi:''' Would either of you entertain the possibility of working with me in the future, and taking on some of my workload?
:{{A|vo yllq003 2 qianwei 03.ogg}} '''Qianwei:''' I'll have to see. I'm in a bad mood. This is the last thing I want to be thinking about right now.
:{{A|vo yllq003 2 mingbo 02.ogg}} '''Mingbo:''' I don't mind... As long as I can help...
:{{A|vo yllq003 2 yelan 07.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' Okay, well that's all from me. Zhiyi, you'll have some preparation to do. It won't be long before you're informed of your official appointment. I hope you will work hard and make Uncle Tian proud.
:{{A|vo yllq003 2 zhiyi 04.ogg}} '''Zhiyi:''' I will live up to the Tianshu name. On this, you have my word.
:{{A|vo yllq003 2 zhiyi 05.ogg}} '''Zhiyi:''' I should go. I need to pack my things and then I think a celebratory meal is in order... Would anyone like to join me?
:{{A|vo yllq003 2 qianwei 04.ogg}} '''Qianwei:''' Count me out. I am not in the mood for a celebration.
:{{A|vo yllq003 2 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Zhiyi seems pretty relaxed now. This would be a good time to follow him...
:{{A|vo yllq003 2 qianwei 05.ogg}} '''Qianwei:''' Hey, Traveler! Tell me something — what exactly does that guy have that I don't?
:{{A|vo yllq003 2 qianwei 06.ogg}} '''Qianwei:''' If you can't answer that, I'm not accepting this result!
:{{A|vo yllq003 2 mingbo 03.ogg}} '''Mingbo:''' I, uh... also wouldn't mind knowing...
:{{A|vo yllq003 2 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh no! If we get stuck here, we won't be able to leave...
:{{A|vo yllq003 2 yelan 08.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' Follow him.
:{{A|vo yllq003 2 wenyuan 01.ogg}} '''Wenyuan:''' Yes, Ma'am.
:{{Black Screen|After finally persuading Qianwei and Mingbo to leave...}}
:{{A|vo yllq003 2 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Phew... We finally got rid of them...
:{{A|vo yllq003 2 wenyuan 02.ogg}} '''Wenyuan:''' Lady Yelan, Zhiyi has gone towards Feiyun Slope.
:{{A|vo yllq003 2 yelan 09.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' Follow him. Quickly.

:{{A|vo yllq003 3 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So Zhiyi really sided with the Fatui?
:{{A|vo yllq003 3 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' But [[Uncle Tian]] thought so highly of him. Why would he do this?
:{{A|vo yllq003 3 yelan 01.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' Difficult to say. But everything should become a lot clearer when we find him.

;(Approach Feiyun Slope)
:{{A|vo yllq003 4 shanghua 01.ogg}} '''Shanghua:''' I'm sorry, Lady Yelan. We lost him.
:{{A|vo yllq003 4 shanghua 02.ogg}} '''Shanghua:''' He's too good at this... We weren't able to keep following him without being seen.
:{{A|vo yllq003 4 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' How the heck did he manage to shake Yelan's subordinates...
:{{A|vo yllq003 4 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' I guess Zhiyi didn't let his guard down. Still as vigilant as ever?
:{{A|vo yllq003 4 shanghua 03.ogg}} '''Shanghua:''' No, Wupei says he's much more relaxed than usual... Maybe it's just how he's wired. Perceptive enough to sense when he's being watched.
:{{A|vo yllq003 4 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' But how...
:{{A|vo yllq003 4 yelan 01.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' Don't blame yourselves. Let's not forget he was trained by Uncle Tian himself. Evading detection is not an unusual skill for him to have.
:{{A|vo yllq003 4 yelan 02.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' If I'd asked you to tail Uncle Tian, you'd have ended up at a dead end, too. It's fine. So, where did you lose him?
:{{A|vo yllq003 4 shanghua 04.ogg}} '''Shanghua:''' Xinyue Kiosk. He only went in briefly. Wupei and I were watching outside the whole time.
:{{A|vo yllq003 4 shanghua 05.ogg}} '''Shanghua:''' A few moments later, a man dressed in a completely different outfit came out. Wupei had a feeling that it was him, but we couldn't get close enough to check without blowing our cover.
:{{A|vo yllq003 4 shanghua 06.ogg}} '''Shanghua:''' I figured that if we spooked him, it would undo what we've accomplished today so far. Another option would've been to arrest him there and then... But without any evidence, that would've been meaningless.
:{{A|vo yllq003 4 shanghua 07.ogg}} '''Shanghua:''' So I stopped Wupei, and I stayed here to wait for you while that meathead went to ask around in Xinyue Kiosk.
:{{A|vo yllq003 4 yelan 03.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' Good work.
:{{A|vo yllq003 4 yelan 04.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' The fish didn't take the bait, but that's okay. As long as he's still swimming around, we'll find a way to catch him eventually... The key is figuring out what he's trying to achieve.
:{{A|vo yllq003 4 yelan 05.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' Let's go to Xinyue Kiosk.
----
{{Dialogue End}}
{{Quest Description|update|The plan to follow Zhiyi didn't go as planned, but Yelan still seems confident.}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Enter Xinyue Kiosk)
:{{A|vo yllq003 5 wupei 01.ogg}} '''Wupei:''' Could you explain to me how that works? A guy like him comes in, changes his whole outfit right under your nose, and you don't even ask him about it?
:{{A|vo yllq003 5 heli 01.ogg}} '''Heli:''' Our customers are free to dress however they please. What grounds would I have to question him?
:{{A|vo yllq003 5 wupei 02.ogg}} '''Wupei:''' *sigh* Okay, fair enough, but didn't you think it was just a little bit strange?
:{{A|vo yllq003 5 heli 02.ogg}} '''Heli:''' Maybe I did, but it still doesn't give me the right to stop him...
:{{A|vo yllq003 5 yelan 01.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' Enough, let's tone this down a little.
:{{A|vo yllq003 5 yelan 02.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' I'll make this quick. Just one question: What did he buy while he was here?
:{{A|vo yllq003 5 heli 03.ogg}} '''Heli:''' Oh, he didn't buy anything. He just picked up a bottle of liquor that he ordered ages ago.
:{{A|vo yllq003 5 yelan 03.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' A bottle of liquor?
:{{A|vo yllq003 5 heli 04.ogg}} '''Heli:''' Yes, a very strong kind. Fiery with a rich flavor. Not something the average customer would order.
:{{A|vo yllq003 5 heli 05.ogg}} '''Heli:''' This gentleman ordered it in person from us a long time ago. He was only here today to pick it up.
:{{A|vo yllq003 5 yelan 04.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' Liquor... and wineware... I see. Let's go.
:{{A|vo yllq003 5 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Where to?
:{{A|vo yllq003 5 yelan 05.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' Xigu Antiques.

;(Talk to Linlang)
:{{A|vo yllq003 6 yelan 01.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' Hey, Ms. Linlang, sorry to bother you — Zhiyi ordered a wineware set from you not long ago, right?
:{{A|vo yllq003 6 yelan 02.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' We're friends of his. He's been telling us how impressed he is with the quality considering how affordable it was, so we just had to come and take a look for ourselves.
:{{A|vo yllq003 6 linglang 01.ogg}} '''Linlang:''' Sure. Which model are you looking for?
:{{A|vo yllq003 6 yelan 03.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' Um... We don't really know a whole lot about wineware... Let's just go with Zhiyi's choice. Would you be able to show us the one he bought?
:{{A|vo yllq003 6 linglang 02.ogg}} '''Linlang:''' Zhiyi picked up his set not long ago. As a quality imitation of an antique wineware set, it has the look and feel of a luxury item.
:{{A|vo yllq003 6 linglang 03.ogg}} '''Linlang:''' Just so you're aware, we don't have many of this model left in stock. And now that Mr. Zhiyi has taken one, I'm afraid... it may encourage the price to go up a little.
:{{A|vo yllq003 6 yelan 04.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' Don't worry. Price shouldn't be an issue. I'm sure we can work something out. But I'm just a little hazy on one thing — did Zhiyi's wineware set include wine glasses, or...?
:{{A|vo yllq003 6 linglang 04.ogg}} '''Linlang:''' For this set, the wine glasses are sold separately. Minimum purchase is one glass, maximum is four. Mr. Zhiyi bought two.
:{{A|vo yllq003 6 yelan 05.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' Okay... Thanks, Linlang. Seems there's a little more to buying wineware than I first thought. We'll have to mull it over.
:{{A|vo yllq003 6 linglang 05.ogg}} '''Linlang:''' Well, don't take too long. We could sell out any day now... Alright, see you next time.
:{{Black Screen|You find a quiet place nearby...}}
:{{A|vo yllq003 6 wenyuan 01.ogg}} '''Wenyuan:''' This is turning into a real headache...
:{{A|vo yllq003 6 shanghua 01.ogg}} '''Shanghua:''' I'd just like to point out that we have the self-professed "Grandmaster of Fieldwork" here to thank for being wholly incapable of tailing an ordinary civilian without being seen.
:{{A|vo yllq003 6 wupei 01.ogg}} '''Wupei:''' It's not like you did any better!
:{{A|vo yllq003 6 shanghua 02.ogg}} '''Shanghua:''' My specialty is information trading, okay? I don't have the physical agility. What's your excuse?
:{{A|vo yllq003 6 wupei 02.ogg}} '''Wupei:''' I... ugh... fair point.
:{{A|vo yllq003 6 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yelan, so has the plan failed?
:{{A|vo yllq003 6 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' If we can't figure out where Zhiyi went, there's not much we can do... But why was he buying liquor at Xinyue Kiosk anyway? To celebrate?
:{{A|vo yllq003 6 yelan 06.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' If so, it's no ordinary celebration.
:{{A|vo yllq003 6 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What do you mean?
:{{A|vo yllq003 6 yelan 07.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' First of all, Zhiyi isn't much of a drinker. On some level, he hates alcohol because of what it did to his father.
:{{A|vo yllq003 6 yelan 08.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' If he was just looking to celebrate by himself, he wouldn't spend his meager savings on an expensive bottle of alcohol, let alone buy a pair of special wine glasses.
:{{A|vo yllq003 6 yelan 09.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' No, this is a victory feast... held in honor of Zhiyi's private sponsor.
:{{A|vo yllq003 6 yelan 10.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' Whoever this person is clearly enjoys hard liquor and has a very high status — hence the need for expensive-looking wineware.
:{{A|vo yllq003 6 yelan 11.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' Now, where might we find Fatui who match that description, I wonder?
:{{A|vo yllq003 6 wenyuan 02.ogg}} '''Wenyuan:''' Fatui officials? Should be either the [[Snezhnayan Embassy]] or the [[Northland Bank]].
:{{A|vo yllq003 6 yelan 12.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' Have both locations surrounded. Take as many people as you need.
:{{A|vo yllq003 6 wupei 03.ogg}} '''Wupei:''' Lady Yelan, is it time for us to make our move? If so, you can count me in.
:{{A|vo yllq003 6 yelan 13.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' Get with the program, would you? This is a covert surveillance operation. Zhiyi may be vigilant, but that doesn't mean the same is true for his drinking buddy.
:{{A|vo yllq003 6 yelan 14.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' In which case, we don't need to change tactics, just change who we're following.
:{{A|vo yllq003 6 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Great idea! So we just need to find out who Zhiyi bought that liquor for and follow them instead!
:{{A|vo yllq003 6 wenyuan 03.ogg}} '''Wenyuan:''' But Lady Yelan, if we get caught, this could become a major diplomatic incident...
:{{A|vo yllq003 6 yelan 15.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' I'm well aware. But don't you see? Zhiyi is gambling everything on this. If we really want to catch him, we're going to have to accept a little risk ourselves.
:{{A|vo yllq003 6 yelan 16.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' Stick to your orders. And make sure we're covering all other bases, too — anywhere else Zhiyi might be going, I want eyes on those locations.
:{{A|vo yllq003 6 wenyuan 04.ogg}} '''Wenyuan:''' ...Yes, Ma'am.
:{{A|vo yllq003 6 shanghua 03.ogg}} '''Shanghua:''' Don't worry, Lady Yelan. Zhiyi may be a slippery character, but we'll keep a close watch on the movements of all Fatui officials.
:{{A|vo yllq003 6 yelan 17.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' I'll be waiting for you at the teahouse.
:{{A|vo yllq003 6 yelan 18.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' If I'm guessing correctly, Fatui officials are likely to take action at night. {{Traveler}}, you should go and get ready, then meet me at [[Yanshang Teahouse]].
----

;(Approach Yanshang Teahouse)
:{{A|vo yllq003 8 yelan 01.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' Perfect timing. Wenyuan just sent word that the Fatui Ambassador, [[Yusupov]], just left the embassy alone. He's heading in the direction of [[Qingxu Pool]].
:{{A|vo yllq003 8 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Qingxu Pool? That's the place Zhiyi mentioned in his manifesto...
:{{A|vo yllq003 8 yelan 02.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' It looks like that's where they've arranged to meet. Sensible choice, I'll give them that.
:{{A|vo yllq003 8 yelan 03.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' Qingxu Pool is always crawling with monsters. Most people wouldn't dream of going there. It's one place they won't need to worry about being seen.
:{{A|vo yllq003 8 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh no! We gotta go get them!
:{{A|vo yllq003 8 yelan 04.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' Let's go. If my hunch is correct, we just might hit the jackpot this time.

{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Approach Qingxu Pool)
:{{A|vo yllq003 9 yelan 01.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' This is Qingxu Pool. Full of ruins, crawling with monsters... Anyone with any sense steers well clear of this place.
:{{A|vo yllq003 9 yelan 02.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' I've looked into the place before. There's a workers' entrance somewhere around here — follow me.

;(Approach the marked area)
:{{A|vo yllq003 10 yelan 01.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' There's been some work done on this place in the past, but it's a bit of a labyrinth inside. I can't guarantee we'll be safe once we're underground.
:{{A|vo yllq003 10 yelan 02.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' The workers left an emergency access route. If we can find it, this will be a much easier journey.
:{{A|vo yllq003 10 yelan 03.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' Still... Be ready to fight at any moment. Any resistance needs to be taken out quickly and quietly. We don't want to attract too much attention.
:{{A|vo yllq003 10 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Don't worry, we're all professionals here!
:{{A|vo yllq003 10 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' By the way, Yelan, where are your three little helpers at?
:{{A|vo yllq003 10 yelan 04.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' They have other things to take care of first. We couldn't afford to wait for them, but they'll join us later.

;(Enter the domain)
;(Defeat the first set of enemies)
:{{A|vo yllq003 13 yelan 01.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' As I expected. But this shouldn't be too much trouble.

;(Enter the second room)
:{{A|vo yllq003 12 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You guys see that? That's gotta be the Fatui Ambassador, here to meet Zhiyi... Looks like he went through that door!
:{{A|vo yllq003 12 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' That must be the emergency access route, right? Come on, let's hurry!

;(Interact with the gate)
:{{A|vo yllq003 13 yelan 02.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' This is the construction workers' emergency access route... but it's closed tight.
:{{A|vo yllq003 15 yelan 01.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' Trying to break through would be risky. Let's see if we can find another way.

;(After activating both lamps)
:{{A|vo yllq003 14 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' The water's gone down... Hey, look, is that another way through?

;(After activating the next set of lamps)
:{{A|vo yllq003 17 yelan 01.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' The water's flowed into the groove and now the statues have lit up. Okay, now we should be able to move the statues.

;(After placing the statues in the correct spots)
:{{A|vo yllq003 16 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' The door is open, let's go!

;(Go through the door)
:{{A|vo yllq003 18 yelan 01.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' We should be nearly at the bottom now... Let's wrap this up.

;(Listen to the conversation)
:{{A|vo yllq003 19 yusupov 01.ogg}} '''Yusupov:''' Mmm... I can tell from the aroma that this is very fine liquor indeed. I'm impressed.
:{{A|vo yllq003 19 yusupov 02.ogg}} '''Yusupov:''' Come on, bottoms up. After you, of course!
:{{A|vo yllq003 19 zhiyi 01.ogg}} '''Zhiyi:''' *coughing* ...Sorry, that went down the wrong way. I've never drunk anything this strong before. It'll take me some getting used to.
:{{A|vo yllq003 19 yusupov 03.ogg}} '''Yusupov:''' You'll get there. If you want to stay friends with us, you have to drink with us.
:{{A|vo yllq003 19 zhiyi 02.ogg}} '''Zhiyi:''' *cough* ...I'll do my best.
:{{A|vo yllq003 19 yusupov 04.ogg}} '''Yusupov:''' You're more of a lightweight than I thought... Already struggling after one glass?
:{{A|vo yllq003 19 yusupov 05.ogg}} '''Yusupov:''' I thought you were made of sterner stuff. You certainly kept it together when you were poisoning your teacher's soup!
:{{A|vo yllq003 19 yusupov 06.ogg}} '''Yusupov:''' Come on, another round. Less talking, more drinking, haha!
:{{A|vo yllq003 19 zhiyi 03.ogg}} '''Zhiyi:''' Sure. You didn't leave me much of a choice, though, did you? Just the mention of poisoning sends shivers down my spine.
:{{A|vo yllq003 19 zhiyi 04.ogg}} '''Zhiyi:''' I'm more timid than you realize. Every time I poisoned him, I had to hide away at home for a few days because I was so scared of getting caught.
:{{A|vo yllq003 19 yusupov 07.ogg}} '''Yusupov:''' Look, I know it has not been easy for you, my friend. We appreciate all your hard work.
:{{A|vo yllq003 19 yusupov 08.ogg}} '''Yusupov:''' But I have to say: You really are quite a genius at poisoning people.
:{{A|vo yllq003 19 yusupov 09.ogg}} '''Yusupov:''' I mean, the poison we brought from Snezhnaya is as strong as this wine, but you found a way to turn it into an imperceptible, slow-acting poison and came up with the idea of delivering it through fish soup.
:{{A|vo yllq003 19 yusupov 10.ogg}} '''Yusupov:''' What was it you said... Oh yeah. You said "the soup's fishy flavor neutralizes the pungency of the poison, and this process even makes the soup tastier as a result"... Tsk tsk, how did you think of that?
:{{A|vo yllq003 19 zhiyi 05.ogg}} '''Zhiyi:''' It struck me one day when I was fishing. I'm lucky it did, otherwise, I'm not sure I would have been able to fool Uncle Tian.
:{{A|vo yllq003 19 yusupov 11.ogg}} '''Yusupov:''' You have performed excellently! The Fatui will continue to provide the support you need to consolidate your position as Tianshu. Of course, this is as long as you continue to do as we instruct.
:{{A|vo yllq003 19 yusupov 12.ogg}} '''Yusupov:''' Aside from Qingxu Pool, we also have some other requests for you, which we will inform you of in due course.
:{{A|vo yllq003 19 zhiyi 06.ogg}} '''Zhiyi:''' Don't worry. Whatever tasks you have for me, I will perform them diligently.
:{{A|vo yllq003 19 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Did you hear that? It was poison... That's why Uncle Tian hasn't been feeling well recently. It's all Zhiyi's doing!
:{{A|vo yllq003 19 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What a nasty guy! Seize him!
:{{A|vo yllq003 19 yelan 01.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' Hold on. Did you bring a Kamera, {{Traveler}}?
:{{A|vo yllq003 19 yelan 02.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' If not, you can use mine. This is quite a scene. We have to capture it for posterity.
:{{Black Screen|You take a picture of Zhiyi drinking with Yusupov...}}
:{{A|vo yllq003 19 yusupov 13.ogg}} '''Yusupov:''' Ahhh... Excellent liquor!
:{{A|vo yllq003 19 yusupov 14.ogg}} '''Yusupov:''' We've seen no progress on the diplomatic front, and everyone has been eyeing up the treasure of Qingxu Pool. It's been a real headache for me.
:{{A|vo yllq003 19 yusupov 15.ogg}} '''Yusupov:''' But soon, everything will be taken care of, and I can report back on a successful mission. Thank you, Zhiyi!
:{{A|vo yllq003 19 yusupov 16.ogg}} '''Yusupov:''' I remember when I first saw you... I knew right away that you would make a good partner for us. Hey, do you still remember what I said to you?
:{{A|vo yllq003 19 zhiyi 07.ogg}} '''Zhiyi:''' How could I forget. You said a lowly commoner like me could never be seen as a serious candidate for the Tianshu, no matter how hard I work.
:{{A|vo yllq003 19 zhiyi 08.ogg}} '''Zhiyi:''' "The only way is for you to shine bright in the Tianshu's darkest moment"... I think you were absolutely right.
:{{A|vo yllq003 19 yusupov 17.ogg}} '''Yusupov:''' Yes. Under normal circumstances, the gap between you and other people could only ever grow wider over time.
:{{A|vo yllq003 19 yusupov 18.ogg}} '''Yusupov:''' Just look at your two competitors. Qianwei had wealth, Mingbo had reputation, but you? You had nothing. You were just another nobody!
:{{A|vo yllq003 19 yusupov 19.ogg}} '''Yusupov:''' ...And that's why I decided to help you. Yeah, there is an old saying in the Fatui: Give a starving dog a bone, and it'll guard your home for the rest of its life.
:{{A|vo yllq003 19 zhiyi 09.ogg}} '''Zhiyi:''' Yes, I cannot thank you enough for your generous support.
:{{A|vo yllq003 19 yusupov 20.ogg}} '''Yusupov:''' Hahaha... You know, the best thing about you is that you do as you're told, without complaining. Keep up the good work, and I can assure you, you'll never have to worry about Mora again.
:{{A|vo yllq003 19 yusupov 21.ogg}} '''Yusupov:''' Heck, when you're not in the company of the Fatui, you'll be able to throw your weight around as much as you want. How about that?
:{{A|vo yllq003 19 yelan 03.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' Uncle Gao said that Zhiyi has low self-esteem... Seems he was right.
:{{A|vo yllq003 19 yelan 04.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' He was worried that whatever advantage he might have now will diminish over time... so the Fatui persuaded him that he should act while he can.
:{{A|vo yllq003 19 yelan 05.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' Do you have any more film in the Kamera?
:{{DIcon}} Plenty.
:{{A|vo yllq003 19 yelan 06.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' Then get ready to use it. Tonight's grand finale should be coming up any minute now.
:{{A|vo yllq003 19 yelan 07.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' How well this goes for us depends on how Zhiyi plays his hand.
:{{A|vo yllq003 19 yusupov 22.ogg}} '''Yusupov:''' Is there any more alcohol? Go on, fill me up. I'm in a good mood today, and I'm gonna drink my fill. Make sure to get me home safely afterward.
:{{A|vo yllq003 19 zhiyi 10.ogg}} '''Zhiyi:''' There's only a little left. Here, I'll fill your glass. If you like it, I can bring you some more next time.
:{{A|vo yllq003 19 yusupov 23.ogg}} '''Yusupov:''' *gulp* ...Phwoar, this is the good stuff, it is great...
:{{A|vo yllq003 19 yusupov 24.ogg}} '''Yusupov:''' Huh? Ugh... *cough* ... *cough* ...What the...
:{{Black Screen|Suddenly, the Fatui official seems to be in pain and slowly drops to the ground.}}
:{{A|vo yllq003 19 yusupov 25.ogg}} '''Yusupov:''' Zhiyi... You... You poisoned my wine? But when...
:{{A|vo yllq003 19 zhiyi 11.ogg}} '''Zhiyi:''' You seem surprised, Mr. Yusupov?
:{{A|vo yllq003 19 yusupov 26.ogg}} '''Yusupov:''' You... How could you...
:{{A|vo yllq003 19 zhiyi 12.ogg}} '''Zhiyi:''' How could I not? I've sacrificed years of my life studying and reflecting to prepare myself for this position, and in the end I even had to poison my own teacher.
:{{A|vo yllq003 19 zhiyi 13.ogg}} '''Zhiyi:''' You really think I'd put myself through all that just to become your little puppet? I don't want to bow down to anyone ever again, and that includes you.
:{{A|vo yllq003 19 yusupov 27.ogg}} '''Yusupov:''' You imbecile! It's the Fatui who got you to where you are, do you understand? ...If I disappear with no explanation, the embassy will come after you... They'll get to the bottom of this, mark my words!
:{{A|vo yllq003 19 zhiyi 14.ogg}} '''Zhiyi:''' Do you see the haystack in the corner? Underneath it is a pile of explosives. And next door in the darkroom are the three undercover agents you sent to infiltrate the Blackcliff Forge.
:{{A|vo yllq003 19 zhiyi 15.ogg}} '''Zhiyi:''' I'm gonna stay here till I see you slip into unconsciousness, then I'm gonna set this on fire. Once the flames burn through the hay, they'll ignite the explosives, the ruins will collapse, and everything will be buried.
:{{A|vo yllq003 19 yusupov 28.ogg}} '''Yusupov:''' Wh—What do you hope to...
:{{A|vo yllq003 19 zhiyi 16.ogg}} '''Zhiyi:''' I took the liberty of leaving some evidence of your contact with the undercover agents at the Blackcliff Forge. It won't take long for people to join the dots... Two missing-person cases will become one as the "truth" gradually reveals itself.
:{{A|vo yllq003 19 zhiyi 17.ogg}} '''Zhiyi:''' The Fatui planted undercover agents in the Blackcliff Forge to steal their signature ruin-grade explosives. Their plan was to blow through the solid floor tiles in the dead of night and seize the treasure of Qingxu Pool.
:{{A|vo yllq003 19 zhiyi 18.ogg}} '''Zhiyi:''' *sigh*...But things didn't quite go to plan. Mistakes were made that led to the accidental deaths of the entire crew.
:{{A|vo yllq003 19 zhiyi 19.ogg}} '''Zhiyi:''' Faced with the overwhelming evidence, the embassy won't investigate this any further. In fact, they'll be only too happy to blame it all on a rogue operation by you.
:{{A|vo yllq003 19 zhiyi 20.ogg}} '''Zhiyi:''' It explains why you acted alone, while exonerating the rest of the embassy of any liability.
:{{A|vo yllq003 19 zhiyi 21.ogg}} '''Zhiyi:''' Of course, none of that will have anything to do with me. When all of this comes to my attention, I'm afraid I'll have no choice but to cancel the Qingxu Pool Redevelopment Plan immediately. I guess then, I'll be Tianshu in my own right, with a clean record and well out of the Fatui's reach.
:{{A|vo yllq003 19 yusupov 29.ogg}} '''Yusupov:''' Haha... Hah.
:{{A|vo yllq003 19 yusupov 30.ogg}} '''Yusupov:''' Zhiyi, do you really think you're gonna get away with this? The Fatui has a record of everything! That includes the poison, all interactions between us, even my trip here tonight!
:{{A|vo yllq003 19 yusupov 31.ogg}} '''Yusupov:''' After I die... they'll come looking... and they'll get to the bottom of this...
:{{A|vo yllq003 19 zhiyi 22.ogg}} '''Zhiyi:''' A record? Oh, you must mean the one in the hands of your second-in-command, [[Theofan]]?
:{{A|vo yllq003 19 yusupov 32.ogg}} '''Yusupov:''' H—How do you know about that?
:{{A|vo yllq003 19 zhiyi 23.ogg}} '''Zhiyi:''' Because when you contacted me, I also made contact with your associates. I have Theofan to thank for providing me with the poison I used on you today.
:{{A|vo yllq003 19 zhiyi 24.ogg}} '''Zhiyi:''' He'll help me tie up all the loose ends. After all, your untimely demise comes with a few perks for him.
:{{A|vo yllq003 19 zhiyi 25.ogg}} '''Zhiyi:''' He has been eyeing your position for a long time now.
:{{A|vo yllq003 19 yusupov 33.ogg}} '''Yusupov:''' That traitor! *cough* ... *cough* ...Zhiyi, you—
:{{A|vo yllq003 19 zhiyi 26.ogg}} '''Zhiyi:''' Shhh. Relax... It's over. After tonight, everyone gets what they want. And anyone else in the know is either my accomplice, or about to be taken out of the picture.
:{{A|vo yllq003 19 zhiyi 27.ogg}} '''Zhiyi:''' Sweet dreams, Mr. Yusupov.
{{Cutscene Description|Just as Zhiyi is about to light the haystack and consign the evidence to the flames, you and Yelan appear to interrupt him.}}
:;(A cutscene plays)
:;(Zhiyi attempts to light the haystack, but Yelan fires an arrow knocking away his torch. Yelan's assistants and the Millelith enter the area and surround Zhiyi.)
:;(Cutscene ends)

;(If the player tries to burn the haystack)
:;(Yelan extinguishes the haystack...)
::{{A|vo yllq003 20 yelan 01.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' There are explosives under the haystack, are you trying to get us all buried?

;(Talk to Yelan)
:{{A|vo yllq003 21 yelan 01.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' I did a little surveying on the way here, and found that you'd left yourself three escape routes in case things went south.
:{{A|vo yllq003 21 yelan 02.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' I have them all surrounded. If you're thinking of trying anything, save yourself the effort. The game's up.
:{{A|vo yllq003 21 yelan 03.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' We were here the whole time and have pictures of everything. They came out pretty nicely, wanna see them?
:{{A|vo yllq003 21 zhiyi 01.ogg}} '''Zhiyi:''' "The game's up"? ...Forgive me, I'm not quite sure what you're referring to, Ms. Yelan?
:{{A|vo yllq003 21 zhiyi 02.ogg}} '''Zhiyi:''' I happened to discover a Fatui operation here, so I approached them on the pretext of joining forces and eventually brought them down from within. If it pleases you, Ms. Yelan, I'd be only too happy to have you join me in investigating this matter.
:{{A|vo yllq003 21 yelan 04.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' This is how you want to play it, huh?
:{{A|vo yllq003 21 yelan 05.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' Fine, you do you. All we need to do to convict you is establish that the poison in his system is the same as in Uncle Tian's.
:{{A|vo yllq003 21 zhiyi 03.ogg}} '''Zhiyi:''' ...
:{{A|vo yllq003 21 yelan 06.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' Nothing else you wanted to add? Let's leave it there then. Time to go.
:{{A|vo yllq003 21 zhiyi 04.ogg}} '''Zhiyi:''' One wrong move and it all comes crashing down... I should have been more careful.
:{{A|vo yllq003 21 zhiyi 05.ogg}} '''Zhiyi:''' You followed him here, didn't you? I was so focused on keeping myself out of sight, I forgot he was a potential liability.
:{{A|vo yllq003 21 zhiyi 06.ogg}} '''Zhiyi:''' Let's talk about this, Yelan. I gave you my word that I would live up to the Tianshu name, and that much I can still guarantee.
:{{A|vo yllq003 21 yelan 07.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' Your point being?
:{{A|vo yllq003 21 zhiyi 07.ogg}} '''Zhiyi:''' When I take office, I can guarantee that I will act in your best interests. In fact, all of you here tonight can expect very generous treatment in the future.
:{{A|vo yllq003 21 zhiyi 08.ogg}} '''Zhiyi:''' I don't deny that I used underhanded methods to get here. But given my lowly origins, what other choice did I have?
:{{A|vo yllq003 21 yelan 08.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' Hmph, you still don't get it, do you? Even now.
:{{A|vo yllq003 21 yelan 09.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' What do you think, {{Traveler}}?
:{{DIcon}} What will Uncle Tian think?
:{{DIcon}} Uncle Tian has always trusted you.
:{{A|vo yllq003 21 yelan 10.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' Exactly. Zhiyi, clever people can always come up with a good excuse. But while you might be able to get other people to believe you, you'll never be able to deceive yourself.
:{{A|vo yllq003 21 yelan 11.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' There's nothing wrong with wanting to win other people's respect. But when has Uncle Tian ever looked down on you?
:{{A|vo yllq003 21 yelan 12.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' He was like a teacher and a father to you, but you chose to repay that by poisoning him... Whatever positive goal you may have started out with, you threw it away in that moment.
:{{A|vo yllq003 21 zhiyi 09.ogg}} '''Zhiyi:''' That's enough... I...
:{{A|vo yllq003 21 yelan 13.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' Of course, what makes this even crueler is that you managed to convince yourself there was "no other way." Uncle Tian was always going to give you this opportunity... even if you'd done nothing at all.
:{{A|vo yllq003 21 yelan 14.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' Out of everyone in the world, he is the one who trusts you the most. So much that he drank your fish soup without doubting you, not for one second.
:{{A|vo yllq003 21 zhiyi 10.ogg}} '''Zhiyi:''' That's enough! ...That's enough.
{{Cutscene Description|Zhiyi remembers the lessons that Uncle Tian taught him once while they were fishing together, and the hesitation he felt when poisoning the latter, and is wracked with internal turmoil... which Yelan interrupts. Since he has broken the law, he must be punished, but there is a way he can avoid the worst-case scenario. He just needs to accept her offer...}}
:;(A cinematic plays)
::'''Uncle Tian:''' Life is like fishing
::'''Uncle Tian:''' It cannot be rushed
::'''Uncle Tian:''' Whatever you do, impatience will accomplish nothing
::'''Uncle Tian:''' I was just like you once
::'''Uncle Tian:''' Desperate to prove myself
::'''Uncle Tian:''' Only later did I realize
::'''Uncle Tian:''' Things do not turn out the way you plan
::'''Uncle Tian:''' But you have to keep calm to carry on
::'''Uncle Tian:''' You're still young. Be patient
::'''Uncle Tian:''' Believe in yourself
::'''Uncle Tian:''' And don't look outside yourself to prove your value
::'''Uncle Tian:''' Where's Zhiyi these days?
::'''Uncle Tian:''' It's been a long time since he last paid me a visit
::'''Huixin:''' Maybe he's just busy...
::'''Uncle Tian:''' Hmph, well next time
::'''Uncle Tian:''' If he doesn't bring a pot of piping hot fish soup, don't let him in!
::'''Yelan:''' Whatever you were thinking about, you'll have plenty of time to mull it over in prison
::'''Yelan:''' Oh, I almost forgot
::'''Yelan:''' If the Fatui find out what happened today
::'''Yelan:''' Prison might not turn out to be the safest place for you
::'''Yelan:''' Trying to have friends on both sides... it has a way of turning everyone against you
::'''Yelan:''' But right now
::'''Yelan:''' I have an opportunity for you
:;(Cinematic ends)
:{{Black Screen|Yelan's subordinates take Zhiyi and Yusupov away.}}
:{{A|vo yllq003 21 yelan 15.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' Sorry, things are about to get extremely busy for me. Let's meet at Yanshang Teahouse tomorrow morning, {{Traveler}}.
:{{A|vo yllq003 21 yelan 16.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' I'll have someone remove the explosives. Then, there's someone I have to go and see.
:{{A|vo yllq003 21 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Need our help with that?
:{{A|vo yllq003 21 yelan 17.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' No. It could be dangerous... You should leave this one to the professionals.
:{{DIcon}} Be careful.
:{{A|vo yllq003 21 yelan 18.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' Don't worry. As long as they're willing to cooperate, this'll be a straightforward deal.
:{{A|vo yllq003 21 yelan 19.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' Get some rest. See you tomorrow.
