==Dialogue==
{{Quest Description|It turns out that [[Katou Youhei|Youhei]] and [[Katou Shingo|Shingo]] had summoned a spirit with the method recorded in "[[A Firsthand Guide to Summoning Spirits]]." [[Yae Miko]] suggests going to the Yae Publishing House to discuss how to respond...}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Go to Yae Publishing House)
:{{A|vo ymlq002 1 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Alright, Miko, we're here. So, what's your plan of action to deal with this rival book?
:{{A|vo ymlq002 1 yaemiko 01.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' Hmm... Why don't you take a guess?
:{{A|vo ymlq002 1 yaemiko 02.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' I'll give you a hint. It's to do with the Yae Publishing House.
:{{A|vo ymlq002 1 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hmmmm... Oh, Paimon knows! Combine the reputation of the Yae Publishing House with the status of Guuji Yae and tell everyone that the incantations in that book are dangerous!
:{{A|vo ymlq002 1 yaemiko 03.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' Ooh, wow! Your first guess, and you got it absolutely...
:{{A|vo ymlq002 1 yaemiko 04.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' ...wrong.
:{{A|vo ymlq002 1 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yeah— Aww! ...Wait, seriously? That wasn't it?
:{{A|vo ymlq002 1 yaemiko 05.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' "A Firsthand Guide to Summoning Spirits" is the hottest light novel right now. If we did as you suggested, we would effectively be advertising to everyone that the incantations are real.
:{{A|vo ymlq002 1 yaemiko 06.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' In bending over backwards trying to warn everyone about the dangers, all we would accomplish is to create more curious readers ready to try them out. Also, sales for the book would only increase further.
:{{A|vo ymlq002 1 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Okay, yeah, that would be pretty catastrophic... Oh! How about we confiscate all the copies?
:{{A|vo ymlq002 1 yaemiko 07.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' *sigh* Leaving aside the issue of the enormous manpower and resources such an operation would require, going to such lengths over a light novel would be extremely disruptive to the lives of Inazumans.
:{{A|vo ymlq002 1 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' But that means there's nothing we can do...
:{{A|vo ymlq002 1 yaemiko 08.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' Well I've been thinking...
:{{A|vo ymlq002 1 yaemiko 09.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' I've read "A Firsthand Guide to Summoning Spirits." It has many other good qualities besides the incantations alone.
:{{A|vo ymlq002 1 yaemiko 10.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' The book contains many ancient "kaidan" — or tales of the supernatural — and is written in a very engaging way. That is why the book has become so popular.
:{{A|vo ymlq002 1 yaemiko 11.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' I think we're going to have a difficult time trying to rein in its popularity while it's the only work in its league on the market.
:{{DIcon}} Wait, so you mean...
:{{A|vo ymlq002 1 yaemiko 12.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' That's right. How do you get rid of the next big thing? You replace it with the next next big thing.
:{{A|vo ymlq002 1 yaemiko 13.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' So what we're going to do is create Inazuma's newest hit novel.
:{{A|vo ymlq002 1 yaemiko 14.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' Smash our rival's sales numbers and win our readers back. That is how Yae Miko wages war!
:{{A|vo ymlq002 1 yaemiko 15.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' Incidentally, this will also be the best way to combat the influence of "A Firsthand Guide to Summoning Spirits."
:{{A|vo ymlq002 1 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wait, Miko, so you want us to write a novel?
:{{DIcon}} Can I really do that?
:{{DIcon}} I've never written a novel before.
:{{A|vo ymlq002 1 yaemiko 16.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' Heh, well, becoming an accomplished novelist certainly isn't an overnight process. But let's not forget that I am the chief editor of the Yae Publishing House. I have my ways.
:{{A|vo ymlq002 1 yaemiko 17.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' I did say this is what "we're" going to do. I trust that the word "teamwork" is in your vocabulary.
:{{A|vo ymlq002 1 yaemiko 18.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' Anyway. There's a writers' submission event going on at the moment. Start by talking to readers and finding out what they're into. When you have an idea of what the current trends are, come back and see me.
:{{A|vo ymlq002 1 yaemiko 19.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' I'll be at Uyuu Restaurant — find me there when you're done. I will assemble a team, and we can work while we eat.
----
{{Dialogue End}}
{{Quest Description|update|Unexpectedly, Yae Miko intends to publish a new light novel to blow the competition out of the water. It might be best to start figuring out what the readers would like...}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Go to the submission event to listen to what the readers like)

;(Read the Submission Event Notice)
:'''Submission Event Notice:''' Yae Publishing House's submission event is in full swing!
:'''Submission Event Notice:''' Unleash your talent! Become the one light novelist to rule them all!

;(Talk to [[Nakano Shino]])
:{{A|vo dialog ymlq002 nakanoshino 01.ogg}} '''Nakano Shino:''' The Yae Publishing House has held many writers' submission events to date.
:{{A|vo dialog ymlq002 nakanoshino 02.ogg}} '''Nakano Shino:''' The winner gets a huge amount of publicity. It's been the ticket to fame for a lot of authors! If you've got a good idea for a story, you definitely don't want to miss out!

;(Talk to [[Kyouta]])
:{{color|menu|You ask a reader named Kyouta some questions...}}
:{{A|vo ymlq002 2 kyouta 01.ogg}} '''Kyouta:''' I've been reading light novels for long time now. I'm mainly into big, ambitious fantasy works with an original core concept and good storytelling.
:{{A|vo ymlq002 2 kyouta 02.ogg}} '''Kyouta:''' These days, though, everyone seems to be imitating each other. Most of the time I can guess what the story is about just from the title.
:{{A|vo ymlq002 2 kyouta 03.ogg}} '''Kyouta:''' The only recent book worth mentioning is "A Firsthand Guide to Summoning Spirits."
:{{A|vo ymlq002 2 kyouta 04.ogg}} '''Kyouta:''' Not only is it a good story, but the descriptions are really true to life. So much so that I'm almost wondering if maybe the author really has met all those [[youkai]] before.

;(Talk to [[Oosuke]])
:{{color|menu|You ask a reader named Oosuke some questions...}}
:{{A|vo ymlq002 2 oosuke 01.ogg}} '''Oosuke:''' The key to a successful light novel is having good illustrations.
:{{A|vo ymlq002 2 oosuke 02.ogg}} '''Oosuke:''' When to use illustrations, what they should contain, and which artist you should commission for them... These are all key things to bear in mind.
:{{A|vo ymlq002 2 oosuke 03.ogg}} '''Oosuke:''' Good illustrations can make up for bad writing. But on the flip side, a bad illustration can ruin your novel, even if you have the best story in the world.
:{{A|vo ymlq002 2 oosuke 04.ogg}} '''Oosuke:''' There's a saying that light novels are essentially a case of "buy art, get words free." I'd agree with that. Too bad most of the top artists have jam-packed schedules, so it's extremely difficult to commission them...
:{{A|vo ymlq002 2 oosuke 05.ogg}} '''Oosuke:''' The illustrations in "A Firsthand Guide to Summoning Spirits" are incredible, but it's unlike any art style I've ever seen before.

;(Talk to [[Tetsuo]])
:{{color|menu|You ask a reader named Tetsuo some questions...}}
:{{A|vo ymlq002 2 tetsuo 01.ogg}} '''Tetsuo:''' I'll be honest. I read light novels for the cheap thrills.
:{{A|vo ymlq002 2 tetsuo 02.ogg}} '''Tetsuo:''' In most traditional stories, the protagonist usually has this long and drawn out character arc, usually involving a process of separation, loss, and ultimately growth and renewed strength. It reads well, and everything, it's just a little slow-paced for me.
:{{A|vo ymlq002 2 tetsuo 03.ogg}} '''Tetsuo:''' By contrast, there's this popular light novel at the moment called "A Firsthand Guide to Summoning Spirits," where the protagonist is super strong right from the get-go! That's what I mean by cheap thrills: action-packed right from page one.
:{{A|vo ymlq002 2 tetsuo 04.ogg}} '''Tetsuo:''' The protagonist is a [[Kitsune (Species)|kitsune]] who has not only mastered the secret art of incantations, but also tea ceremony, painting, and calligraphy!

;(After talking to all three readers)
:{{A|vo ymlq002 2 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' There's much more to light novels than Paimon realized... Let's go tell our findings to Yae Miko, {{Traveler}}!
----
{{Dialogue End}}
{{Quest Description|update|With the readers' preferences in hand, it's time to head to Uyuu Restaurant to finish that light novel.}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Go to Uyuu Restaurant to finish the light novel)
:{{A|vo ymlq002 3 yaemiko 01.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' Ah, there you are. Let me introduce the team:
:{{A|vo ymlq002 3 yaemiko 02.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' You've already met [[Junkichi]] and [[Shigeru]].
:{{A|vo ymlq002 3 yaemiko 03.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' Shigeru is an experienced editor and Junkichi is the author he's partnered with. Junkichi's working through a creative lull at the moment, but all his past works have been very popular with young people. He has developed a distinct and enduringly popular style.
:{{A|vo ymlq002 3 yaemiko 04.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' [[Satomi]] is Yae Publishing House's ace in the hole. Her specialty is that she can write all kinds of completely different stories, and all under different pen names. As for what those names are, well, that's a trade secret.
:{{A|vo ymlq002 3 yaemiko 05.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' They will be teaming up with us to collectively create the novel that knocks "A Firsthand Guide to Summoning Spirits" off its perch. So? Feeling better about my plan now?
:{{A|vo ymlq002 3 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Uh-huh, it definitely makes sense! Hehe.
:{{A|vo ymlq002 3 yaemiko 06.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' Now then, tell me what you found out about readers' preferences.
:{{Black Screen|You tell Yae Miko the readers' thoughts.}}
:{{A|vo ymlq002 3 yaemiko 07.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' All very true. An original core concept, a fast pace, quality illustrations, and lots of action. This is the formula that will guarantee good sales numbers.
:{{A|vo ymlq002 3 yaemiko 08.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' More importantly than that, even though it's a work of fiction, we have to deliver a sense of realism.
:{{A|vo ymlq002 3 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Paimon followed pretty much all of that, but there's still one question... what are we actually gonna write about?
:{{A|vo ymlq002 3 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' For example, we know we need an original core concept... but how do we come up with one?
:{{A|vo ymlq002 3 yaemiko 09.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' Hehe... Before you can answer that question, you have to understand your target audience.
:{{A|vo ymlq002 3 yaemiko 10.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' Take "A Firsthand Guide to Summoning Spirits," for example. When I read it, all I find is common knowledge to the kitsune. But to the general public, it's bursting with new and interesting ideas. It all comes down to the size of the information gap between author and reader.
:{{A|vo ymlq002 3 yaemiko 11.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' As a Traveler, there must be a great many things you know about that are complete unknowns to the people of Inazuma. What is commonplace to you may be fresh and original to them.
:{{A|vo ymlq002 3 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ohh, right! So maybe we can take inspiration from our time in [[Mondstadt]] and [[Liyue]]!
:{{A|vo ymlq002 3 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hmm, but that would make it a completely different genre than "A Firsthand Guide to Summoning Spirits"... Uh, is that gonna be a problem?
:{{A|vo ymlq002 3 yaemiko 12.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' Not at all. You don't have to worry so much about how to compete with that book. All you have to do is provide some interesting ideas based on your travel experiences.
:{{A|vo ymlq002 3 yaemiko 13.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' As long as the core content is interesting, my expert team here will be able to flesh out the details.
:{{A|vo ymlq002 3 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Alright! Let's start with chapter one, then. Uh... what are you thinking, {{Traveler}}?
:{{DIcon}} "Reincarnated in Another World: Encounters with Airborne Emergency Rations"
::{{A|vo ymlq002 3 paimon 07a.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' No! No one would ever go for that, no matter how you tried to play it!
::{{A|vo ymlq002 3 yaemiko 14a.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' Hmm... Out of a maximum of 10 points, I'd give that a 9!
::{{A|vo ymlq002 3 yaemiko 14a 1.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' Is there really flying emergency food in other worlds? How does it taste? And how do you cook it?
::{{A|vo ymlq002 3 yaemiko 14a 2.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' It's a strong opening — an easy way to grab the readers' attention. Never underestimate the appeal of culinary-oriented subject matter. Food, after all, is a topic that everyone is interested in.
::{{A|vo ymlq002 3 paimon 07a 1.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hey!
:{{DIcon}} "The Work-Shy Bard"
::{{A|vo ymlq002 3 paimon 07b.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Let's see what you've got... "After enrolling in the Mondstadt Academy, I found out that the [[Venti|young man]] sitting next to me in class was a total slacker."
::{{A|vo ymlq002 3 paimon 07b 1.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' "He said he was a bard, had a habit of playing his lyre in class, and always had a bottle of liquor on his person. But his true identity was actually the principal of the academy..."
::{{A|vo ymlq002 3 paimon 07b 2.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What kind of plot is that!?
::{{A|vo ymlq002 3 yaemiko 14b.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' Hmm... Out of a maximum of 10 points, I'd give that a 9.5!
::{{A|vo ymlq002 3 yaemiko 14b 1.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' It just goes to show, you have to have an interesting character sitting in the back row by the window.
::{{A|vo ymlq002 3 yaemiko 14b 2.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' The protagonist is a transfer student, new to the school, whose ordinary life is about to take a wild turn when they meet the ballad-and-alcohol-loving principal. Sounds interesting. Approved!
::{{A|vo ymlq002 3 paimon 07b 3.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Paimon just does not see the appeal...
:{{DIcon}} "The Dragon and the Grand Adventure"
::{{A|vo ymlq002 3 paimon 07c.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' This sounds like a great one!
::{{A|vo ymlq002 3 paimon 07c 1.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Let's see here... "The protagonist arrives in Mondstadt for the first time to the sight of a [[Dvalin|dragon]] flying around and wreaking havoc on the city."
::{{A|vo ymlq002 3 paimon 07c 2.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' "With the help of some trusty companions, the protagonist successfully defeats the dragon. But then... the dragon suddenly turns into a beautiful young woman..." ...Huh?
::{{A|vo ymlq002 3 paimon 07c 3.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' "Human, let us work together to build a better future! The love story between human and dragon begins today..."
::{{A|vo ymlq002 3 paimon 07c 4.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Well that was an unexpected development. What happened to the grand adventure!?
::{{DIcon}} "The Grand Adventure" is just the protagonist's name.
::{{A|vo ymlq002 3 paimon 07c 5.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What!? But that's so misleading!
::{{A|vo ymlq002 3 yaemiko 14c.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' Hmm... Out of a maximum of 10 points, I'd give that a 9!
::{{A|vo ymlq002 3 yaemiko 14c 1.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' The story certainly goes in an unorthodox direction. And the dragon-girl sounds destined to be a hit character. Approved!
::{{A|vo ymlq002 3 paimon 07c 6.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What the heck!
:{{A|vo ymlq002 3 yaemiko 15.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' Good job, little one. You're not only drawing on your own experiences, but it seems you're filtering them through the lens of the kinds of light novels you've read in the past. I think you really understand what we're trying to do here.
:{{A|vo ymlq002 3 yaemiko 16.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' Thoughts from the experts? Are we able to work with this general framework to make an interesting story?
:{{A|vo ymlq002 3 junkichi 01.ogg}} '''Junkichi:''' Yeah, we think it works. I tend to overcomplicate the core concept if I'm not careful, so this deals with that problem.
:{{A|vo ymlq002 3 yaemiko 17.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' Hehe. That's good.
:{{A|vo ymlq002 3 yaemiko 18.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' Okay, we're done with chapter one. Let's move on to chapter two.
:{{A|vo ymlq002 3 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh? Won't that do for now?
:{{A|vo ymlq002 3 yaemiko 19.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' Readers will devour your content a lot more quickly than you'd think. If we don't keep delivering the goods now we've caught their attention, all our hard work so far is in vain.
:{{A|vo ymlq002 3 yaemiko 20.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' Hurry, chapter two, let's go. Can't you see that Satomi is waiting?
:{{A|vo ymlq002 3 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hmm? What's wrong with you, {{Traveler}}? You don't look so good...
:{{DIcon}} I can't think of any more stories...
:{{DIcon}} My mind's gone blank...
:{{A|vo ymlq002 3 yaemiko 21.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' What a pity... I thought your "beginner's luck" would carry you a little further before it came to this. But alas. The time has come prematurely.
:{{A|vo ymlq002 3 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Before it came to what? What's happened?
:{{A|vo ymlq002 3 yaemiko 22.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' The bane of our existence: "writer's block." It's your arch-nemesis for life, appearing without warning and inflicting a pain worse than death upon the writer. They sell their souls just to get their muse back.
:{{A|vo ymlq002 3 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Sounds awful.
:{{A|vo ymlq002 3 yaemiko 23.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' When this happens, the best thing you can do is have a bite to eat and take a proper break.
:{{A|vo ymlq002 3 yaemiko 24.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' Boss, get me a plate of Fried Tofu! And get some Kushikatsu for these two. Just the basic kind will do.
:{{A|vo ymlq002 3 yaemiko 25.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' Don't worry, this is my treat.
:{{A|vo ymlq002 3 paimon 12.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Your treat? Oh, wait a minute. Miko, we'll be getting paid for all the hard work we're doing, right?
:{{A|vo ymlq002 3 yaemiko 26.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' Of course, everyone that takes part in the creative process will be paid.
:{{A|vo ymlq002 3 paimon 13.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Alright, cool! Then let's press on, shall we, {{Traveler}}? Don't give up now! For the sake of our paycheck, get your brain going!
:{{DIcon}} Paycheck... hmm, speaking of "Mora"...
:{{A|vo ymlq002 3 paimon 14.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ooh, ooh! Does this mean your inspiration's come back?
:{{DIcon}} "Took a Trip to Liyue, Tour Guide Turned Out to Be Rex Lapis"
::{{A|vo ymlq002 3 paimon 15a 1.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Let's see now... "The protagonist arrives in Liyue and befriends a young man who doesn't have the money to pay for anything. Only later do we find out that this young man is none other than [[Rex Lapis]] himself."
::{{A|vo ymlq002 3 paimon 15a 2.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' "With the help of the [[Qixing]] and the protection of the [[Adeptus|adepti]], I am free to roam this vast realm..."
::{{A|vo ymlq002 3 paimon 15a 3.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hmm, is this the kind of "cheap thrill" that that guy was talking about?
::{{A|vo ymlq002 3 yaemiko 27a 1.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' Hmm... I give it a 9.8!
::{{A|vo ymlq002 3 yaemiko 27a 2.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' The story is fun and action-packed, with no dark undertones. Also, there are a great many legends about Rex Lapis. I'm sure it will spark the people's curiosity.
::{{A|vo ymlq002 3 yaemiko 27a 3.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' I, for one, think there's a sizable market for this. Approved.
::{{A|vo ymlq002 3 paimon 15a 4.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Alright, well... let's just hope Zhongli doesn't mind.
:{{DIcon}} "Rock 'N' Roll Girl!!!"
::{{A|vo ymlq002 3 paimon 15b 1.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' "The Liyue Academy has more student clubs than you can shake a stick at, and as the new kid on the block, the protagonist is the one they're all fighting over..."
::{{A|vo ymlq002 3 paimon 15b 2.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' "There's the Culinary Club, the Architecture Club, the Funerary Club, even the Coconut Milk Research Club... But in the end, the protagonist chose to join the Rock 'N' Roll Club."
::{{A|vo ymlq002 3 paimon 15b 3.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' "Taking a chance on their youthful dreams, four newcomers to the academy form a rock 'n' roll band that really begins to take off!"
::{{A|vo ymlq002 3 paimon 15b 4.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Paimon loves it!
::{{A|vo ymlq002 3 yaemiko 27b 1.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' Hmm... I give it a 9.5!
::{{A|vo ymlq002 3 yaemiko 27b 2.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' A classic tale of youth and friendship. It never gets old.
::{{A|vo ymlq002 3 yaemiko 27b 3.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' I especially like the head of the club. Great character design. She really has rock 'n' roll coursing through her veins. I can almost feel the heat from that fire in her soul. Approved!
::{{A|vo ymlq002 3 paimon 15b 5.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Aw, yeah!
:{{DIcon}} "I Turned Into a Geovishap Hatchling!"
::{{A|vo ymlq002 3 paimon 15c 1.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' "The protagonist awakes to find themselves turned into a [[Geovishap Hatchling]] surrounded by countless adventurers."
::{{A|vo ymlq002 3 paimon 15c 2.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' "But then, the protagonist suddenly discovers that they have a special ability: keep rolling to keep evolving..."
::{{A|vo ymlq002 3 paimon 15c 3.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' "So the protagonist rolled and rolled and rolled, hoping to evolve into the strongest [[Geo]] creature ever!"
::{{A|vo ymlq002 3 paimon 15c 4.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So the protagonist is no longer a human, huh? Good luck retconning that after chapter one!
::{{A|vo ymlq002 3 yaemiko 27c 1.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' Hmm... I give it a 9.5!
::{{A|vo ymlq002 3 yaemiko 27c 2.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' "Monster evolution" is an increasingly common theme these days. What started out as a rather niche genre has gradually worked its way into the mainstream.
::{{A|vo ymlq002 3 yaemiko 27c 3.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' And I wouldn't worry about the continuity issue. All we have to do is explain at the beginning of the work that the protagonist can travel between different worlds. Or just explain it away as a dream.
::{{A|vo ymlq002 3 paimon 15c 5.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ugh, no integrity whatsoever!
::{{A|vo ymlq002 3 yaemiko 27c 4.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' Hehe... The most important thing is that it's fun. In light novels, as in life, having fun is the most important thing. Wouldn't you agree?
::{{A|vo ymlq002 3 paimon 15c 6.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hmm. You do kinda have a point...
:{{A|vo ymlq002 3 yaemiko 28.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' Great, well, now Satomi can get started on that.
:{{A|vo ymlq002 3 satomi 01.ogg}} '''Satomi:''' Leave it to me, Lady Yae.
:{{A|vo ymlq002 3 yaemiko 29.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' Let's write about Inazuma in the third chapter, shall we? I can help with this one. We can use the [[Vision Hunt Decree]] or your experience in [[Watatsumi Army|the resistance]], any ideas?
:{{DIcon}} "Stuff This! C'mon, Let's Get Rid of This Vision Hunt Decree!"
::{{A|vo ymlq002 3 yaemiko 30a 1.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' Mm, clearly very closely based on your own personal experience, with no major changes at all.
::{{DIcon}} Well, I'm running low on inspiration...
::{{A|vo ymlq002 3 yaemiko 30a 2.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' That's fine. Since it's something that took place in Inazuma, it might actually be more interesting to readers if it's grounded in the truth.
:{{DIcon}} "Farewell, Literature Hunt Decree!"
::{{A|vo ymlq002 3 paimon 16b 1.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' "The strict Principal [[The Shogun|Raiden]] of the Inazuma Academy decided to confiscate all light novels."
::{{A|vo ymlq002 3 paimon 16b 2.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' "With the help of Lady Kitsune, the protagonist defeats Principal Raiden in an exam before the throne, forcing the principal to abolish the Literature Hunt Decree..."
::{{A|vo ymlq002 3 paimon 16b 3.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Are we absolutely sure we can publish this...?
::{{A|vo ymlq002 3 yaemiko 30b.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' We can and we will! I think it's great!
:{{DIcon}} "Starting as a Resistance Soldier"
::{{A|vo ymlq002 3 paimon 16c 1.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' "When the Vision Hunt Decree comes out of nowhere, the protagonist joins the [[Watatsumi Army|resistance]], starting out as an ordinary rank-and-file soldier."
::{{A|vo ymlq002 3 paimon 16c 2.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' "Find out how the protagonist goes on to make great contributions to the war effort, become best friends with the resistance [[Gorou|general]], and get to know the Guuji of the [[Grand Narukami Shrine (Faction)|Grand Narukami Shrine]], working together with everyone to finally secure a grand victory for the resistance..."
::{{A|vo ymlq002 3 paimon 16c 3.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh, it's... surprisingly normal...
::{{A|vo ymlq002 3 yaemiko 30c.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' I think it's rather good. A lot of people still like the classic hero's journey. From ordinary soldier to great leader — a fresh take on a timeless classic.
:{{A|vo ymlq002 3 yaemiko 31.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' One thing though — we'll need to rewrite the part about me giving you the [[Grand Narukami Shrine Omamori|omamori]].
:{{A|vo ymlq002 3 yaemiko 32.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' Let's change it to: "The mysterious Lady Kitsune teaches the protagonist a spell that can make their wishes come true. The protagonist uses this spell to defeat the Raiden Shogun in battle." That should do the trick.
:{{A|vo ymlq002 3 paimon 17.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Whoa, so we're really going head-to-head with our rival on this one, huh?
:{{A|vo ymlq002 3 yaemiko 33.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' Hehe, I suppose so. Once they're done writing the manuscript, I'll write the passage where the protagonist recites the incantation myself.
:{{A|vo ymlq002 3 paimon 18.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Are we done, then? Do you really think this will be able to beat "A Firsthand Guide to Summoning Spirits"?
:{{A|vo ymlq002 3 yaemiko 34.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' The content is fine. Now we just need to promote it.
:{{A|vo ymlq002 3 yaemiko 35.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' I will contact an artist to make some illustrations — I'm positive they will be at least as good as those in "A Firsthand Guide to Summoning Spirits." We'll also need an endorsement on a paper band around the book. I can get the wonderful [[Ms. Hina]] to write that.
:{{A|vo ymlq002 3 yaemiko 36.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' She runs a regular Q&A column in "That's Life" magazine. The people of Inazuma absolutely adore her.
:{{A|vo ymlq002 3 yaemiko 37.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' You're free to take a break while the creative team is doing their work, but please go by the Yae Publishing House at some point to commission Ms. Hina for that recommendation. Once our light novel is complete, let's meet at the writers' submission event.

:{{A|vo ymlq002 5 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Uh-oh, Paimon's getting a little nervous now. D'you really think this is gonna work, {{Traveler}}?
:{{DIcon}} We had a top-notch team.
:{{DIcon}} We're all professionals.
:{{A|vo ymlq002 5 yaemiko 02.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' That's right, be confident in your work. That's exactly how a light novelist should be.

:{{A|vo dialog ymlq002 nakanoshino 04.ogg}} '''Nakano Shino:''' It just goes to show that you should write to your own interests. If you just try and imitate someone else, you'll lose your way.

:{{A|vo ymlq002 7 nakanoshino 01.ogg}} '''Nakano Shino:''' Ah, you've all finally made it.

:{{A|vo ymlq002 7 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Woohoo, that's great!
:{{A|vo ymlq002 7 nakanoshino 03.ogg}} '''Nakano Shino:''' This level of success is an amazing accomplishment for a new work. Most new books don't sell 30% of what you've sold.
:{{A|vo ymlq002 7 nakanoshino 04.ogg}} '''Nakano Shino:''' I have free copies for each of you here, please take them. The payment will follow shortly, and I'll notify you to come and collect it when the time comes.
:{{DIcon}} This is all great, but...
:{{A|vo ymlq002 7 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, yeah! The whole reason why we made this light novel was to combat the influence of "A Firsthand Guide to Summoning Spirits."
:{{A|vo ymlq002 7 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hmm, we sold a lot of copies, but it doesn't feel like we accomplished our goal. How do we know whether it worked?
:{{A|vo ymlq002 7 yaemiko 01.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' Hehe... Oh, don't worry. The change is already underway.
:{{A|vo ymlq002 7 yaemiko 02.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' Shh... listen to what the people around us are talking about. The conversation has already moved on, hasn't it?
:{{A|vo ymlq002 7 kazumichi 01.ogg}} '''[[Kazumichi]]:''' Hey guys... have you heard about this latest kaidan thing doing the rounds? You just need to recite the incantation from "A Firsthand Guide to Summoning Spirits" at midnight, and your wish will come true...
:{{A|vo ymlq002 7 kyouta 01.ogg}} '''Kyouta:''' Oh, that? Heh, that's a throwback. That's old news, man.
:{{A|vo ymlq002 7 kyouta 02.ogg}} '''Kyouta:''' No one's talking about that anymore. "The Secret Spells of Lady Kitsune" is the new hit thing. I've already memorized all the incantations.
:{{A|vo ymlq002 7 kazumichi 02.ogg}} '''Kazumichi:''' "The Secret Spells of Lady Kitsune"? What's that?
:{{A|vo ymlq002 7 tetsuo 01.ogg}} '''Tetsuo:''' You haven't read it yet? Okay, so, supposedly, if you recite the spell in there on a moonless night, you'll receive the protection of the kitsune and all the other powerful youkai. They can make any of your wishes come true!

:{{A|vo ymlq002 7 yaemiko 04.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' Hehe, this is something that will become very important to us further down the line. Alright, it's time to move on to the next phase of the plan.

:{{A|vo ymlq002 7 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' ...Also, we still need to figure out what his motive for writing it was!
:{{A|vo ymlq002 7 yaemiko 06.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' Exactly, that's what we need to take care of next. Fortunately, I've already managed to identify the author — he's a failed light novelist named Tomoyuki.
:{{A|vo ymlq002 7 yaemiko 07.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' But when we went to ask him about it, he had no recollection whatsoever of having written the book.
:{{DIcon}} Wait, so does this mean...
:{{A|vo ymlq002 7 yaemiko 08.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' Yes, this is another case of possession — only this time, whoever possessed him actively sought him out.

:{{A|vo ymlq002 7 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' But the spirit that wrote the book has already left him now, right? So what are we supposed to do?
:{{A|vo ymlq002 7 yaemiko 10.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' Simple. It wrote a summoning incantation in the book, didn't it? So we can just use its own method to make it manifest itself.
:{{A|vo ymlq002 7 yaemiko 11.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' And you, my little friend, are the perfect candidate for this role. Hehehe...
:{{DIcon}} This sounds very dubious.
:{{DIcon}} Is it too late for me to back out?
:{{A|vo ymlq002 7 yaemiko 12.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' Aww, what are you talking about? The fun's just about to begin.

[[Luocheng]], another superstitious person who believes ghost stories just like Meng, visits the Wangsheng Funeral Parlor seeking an exorcism. However, [[Hu Tao]] knows that the source of the worries is imaginary, so she comes up with an equally make-believe solution and organizes a fake exorcism. Surprisingly, the spirit of Big G appears before your eyes after the ritual.}}

==Dialogue==
===Further Investigation===
{{Dialogue Start}}
{{Quest Description|The Wisdom Seelie left a few hints in its letter. Perhaps you could first figure out what it's up to.}}
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915402 layla 01.ogg}} '''Layla:''' We should be close. This is the way I came when I first traveled to Sumeru City.
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915402 layla 02.ogg}} '''Layla:''' *sigh* It's been way too long since I last visited home...
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915402 layla 03.ogg}} '''Layla:''' No, no, this isn't the time for that kind of talk. We have to hurry and find the clues that the Seelie left behind.
:{{DIcon}} It's a pretty big area...
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915402 layla 04.ogg}} '''Layla:''' It is... Relying solely on what the Seelie said might not be viable.
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915402 layla 05.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Hmm, assuming the Seelie is intentionally linking the clues to my past, ah, I think I have an idea.
:{{DIcon}} Let's hear it.
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915402 layla 06.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Um, so this is a little embarrassing. At that time, the sight of Sumeru City was absolutely mesmerizing. I was anxious, but also excited about all the things to come.
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915402 layla 07.ogg}} '''Layla:''' I was distracted and... accidentally stepped on an Avidya Leopard's tail.
:{{DIcon}} The price of being distracted...
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915402 layla 08.ogg}} '''Layla:''' I didn't notice it at all... The poor thing was sound asleep, and after I stepped on its tail, it bolted straight up. I freaked out and ran as fast as I could.
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915402 layla 09.ogg}} '''Layla:''' There were actually more Avidya Leopards sleeping nearby, and they were all faster than me... I almost got bitten a couple of times.
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915402 layla 10.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Good thing someone from the Eremites heard me shouting for help. They managed to scare off the leopards.
:{{DIcon}} Good thing you weren't hurt.
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915402 layla 11.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Yeah, but when I finally managed to calm myself down, I noticed that the talisman my mother had made for me was missing.
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915402 layla 12.ogg}} '''Layla:''' It's extremely precious to me. Ever since I was little, I would always carry it with me whenever I'm doing something important.
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915402 layla 13.ogg}} '''Layla:''' I also had it with me when the Akademiya conducted its selection exam at my village. I checked my bag at least a dozen times to make sure the talisman was in there.
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915402 layla 14.ogg}} '''Layla:''' I feel much more at ease knowing that I have it with me. I had thought that it would also help me calm my nerves in Sumeru City.
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915402 layla 15.ogg}} '''Layla:''' But I ended up losing it before I even finished registration at the Akademiya...
:{{DIcon}} I can sympathize with your feeling of loss.
:{{DIcon}} The peace of mind it gave you must be irreplaceable.
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915402 layla 16.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Yeah, and that's when I started having sleeping problems... I just began to sleep less and less each day.
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915402 layla 17.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Losing a talisman like that is definitely a bad omen...
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915402 layla 18.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Oh, sorry, I'm starting to ramble again. What were we talking about before...? Oh right, why the Seelie led us here.
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915402 layla 19.ogg}} '''Layla:''' I think we should look around where the Avidya Leopards attacked me.
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915402 layla 20.ogg}} '''Layla:''' If the Seelie is trying to make me remember things that happened in the past, it would make the most sense for it to hide clues in memorable locations.
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915402 layla 21.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Hope the Seelie's clue wasn't also torn to shreds by Avidya Leopards...
:{{DIcon}} Let's look around first.
::{{A|vo lylcop001 1915402 layla 22.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Yeah... That's the only way we'll know for sure...
:{{DIcon}} Relax. No need to be so pessimistic all the time.
::{{A|vo lylcop001 1915402 layla 23.ogg}} '''Layla:''' I'm sorry, you're right. It's a bad habit of mine.
::{{A|vo lylcop001 1915402 layla 24.ogg}} '''Layla:''' I suppose any progress is a step in the right direction. Let's go.

;(Go to the place mentioned in the letter)
;(Near the rock formation)
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915403 layla 01.ogg}} '''Layla:''' We should be close...
;(After destroying the rock formation)
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915403 layla 02.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Sure enough, it's here, and in a really obvious place. That pretty much confirms my hunch about the Seelie's intentions.
:{{DIcon}} It seems like the Seelie knows you really well.
:{{DIcon}} It feels like the Seelie is trying to provoke you.
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915403 layla 03.ogg}} '''Layla:''' I dunno... but how did it know about all these details? I've hardly told anyone about this stuff...
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915403 layla 04.ogg}} '''Layla:''' It's not hiding somewhere and spying on me, is it? Oh, that's a scary thought...
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915403 layla 05.ogg}} '''Layla:''' *sigh* Anyway, let's look at the clue we've found.
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915403 layla 06.ogg}} '''Layla:''' "Seems like you haven't forgotten about your very first failure."
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915403 layla 07.ogg}} '''Layla:''' See? It knows everything.
:{{DIcon}} This might be too much, even for the Wisdom Seelie.
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915403 layla 08.ogg}} '''Layla:''' I have no idea what's going on... No wonder this Seelie is becoming legendary. Let's keep reading the clue.
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915403 layla 09.ogg}} '''Layla:''' "I've placed the second clue where heaven meets water. The answer, seemingly amongst the stars, was ultimately washed to some unremarkable place downstream."
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915403 layla 10.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Just as I thought, it's something to do with me again.
:{{DIcon}} You already got the meaning?
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915403 layla 11.ogg}} '''Layla:''' If the first clue was any indication, then the location described in this clue should also be related to my life experiences.
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915403 layla 12.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Most Rtawahist research is related to studying the stars. My own thesis work often requires me to go in the field and collect astrological data.
;(Stress Value +1)
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915403 layla 13.ogg}} '''Layla:''' And... *sigh* Let's just say there's another devastating and unforgettable failure I had.
:{{DIcon}} Should we still keep following these clues...?
:{{DIcon}} Thinking about these things will only make things worse for you.
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915403 layla 14.ogg}} '''Layla:''' But that can't be helped, right? We do many things not because we want to, but because we have to.
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915403 layla 15.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Let's keep moving. It might be hard to believe, but being out and about is making me feel a lot better than usual.
;(Continue to [[#Underlying Meaning|Underlying Meaning]])
{{Dialogue End}}

===Underlying Meaning===
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Go to the place mentioned in the letter)
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915404 layla 01.ogg}} '''Layla:''' We're here. Th—That's the spot.
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915404 layla 02.ogg}} '''Layla:''' That's where I performed my first field observation after enrolling at the Akademiya. I borrowed some equipment from the school and came here on a perfectly clear day.
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915404 layla 03.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Everything was ready to go, and I was positive that I'd be able to get some great data.
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915404 layla 04.ogg}} '''Layla:''' But the equipment was a little heavy, and I didn't notice that the ground was muddy and some spots were unstable.
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915404 layla 05.ogg}} '''Layla:''' After I finished setting up everything, part of the ground suddenly shifted, and my equipment started teetering over. I rushed over to grab hold of it, but I ended up tripping over another piece of equipment...
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915404 layla 06.ogg}} '''Layla:''' The next thing I knew, everything was covered with muddy water... me, and all my equipment.
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915404 layla 07.ogg}} '''Layla:''' You must be wondering how someone can be so clumsy...
:{{DIcon}} Oh, not really...
::{{A|vo lylcop001 1915404 layla 08.ogg}} '''Layla:''' You wouldn't be wrong for thinking that... I don't sleep much, so I get light-headed pretty often.
:{{DIcon}} We're all prone to mistakes when we aren't well-rested.
::{{A|vo lylcop001 1915404 layla 09.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Thank you for understanding. If I were the one complaining about not being well-rested, it would just sound like an excuse.
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915404 layla 10.ogg}} '''Layla:''' It's a vicious cycle... the less I sleep, the more mistakes I make. The more mistakes I make, the harder it is for me to sleep...
:{{DIcon}} So what happened afterwards? Were you injured?
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915404 layla 11.ogg}} '''Layla:''' I just got a minor fracture, so I had to rest at Bimarstan for a while.
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915404 layla 12.ogg}} '''Layla:''' To pay off the damages to the equipment, I took some part-time jobs. I just went to work whenever I couldn't sleep. It took me forever to pay off what I owed.
:{{DIcon}} Don't tell me, your insomnia got worse after that?
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915404 layla 13.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Bingo... *sigh* The pressure from my studies and debt was crushing me, and I didn't want to tell my family about any of it.
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915404 layla 14.ogg}} '''Layla:''' After all, I am the legendary Layla who made it into the Akademiya at a young age and had never failed an assignment in her life...
:{{DIcon}} Ever consider taking a break?
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915404 layla 15.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Of course. I've even considered giving up on my studies completely and returning home to help care for the Sumpter Beasts, but that would be kind of embarrassing...
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915404 layla 16.ogg}} '''Layla:''' I don't mean that I'd be embarrassed in front of others... I mean that I'd be ashamed of myself. After all, everything I've done up till now is only a result of my own decisions.
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915404 layla 17.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Although it hasn't always been smooth sailing and sometimes things don't go my way, I made it this far on my own. There haven't been any major incidents with my studies, and I even managed to pay off the equipment damages...
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915404 layla 18.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Ahh, but I guess I'm exaggerating a bit... Most of it is still due to the help of some unknown person, rather than my own work... hehe...
:{{DIcon}} Your parents would feel bad if they knew what you were going through.
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915404 layla 19.ogg}} '''Layla:''' And that's exactly why they mustn't ever find out. Once I've finally managed to acclimate to life in Sumeru City, I'll show them my success... I hope that day will come, eventually.
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915404 layla 20.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Anyways, let's continue looking for the next clue. It should be around here somewhere... an "unremarkable place downstream" was the description.

;(Go to the place mentioned in the letter)
;(Near the rock formation)
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915404 layla 21.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Hmm, that "place downstream" could be somewhere close by.
;(After destroying the rock formation)
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915405 layla 01.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Here, it's over here! Whew, good thing it's dry. I was worried the message might be wet.
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915405 layla 02.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Let's see... "Have you found it? The unremarkable place downstream?"
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915405 layla 03.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Well... of course. How else could I be reading this message...? Seriously.
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915405 layla 04.ogg}} '''Layla:''' "I've placed the third hint at a crossroad without a cross. You can turn left or right, but turning back shouldn't be an option."
:{{DIcon}} It feels like the clues are getting more and more vague...
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915405 layla 05.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Hmm... they're actually getting clearer for me. I was sorta expecting this, even before I read the message.
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915405 layla 06.ogg}} '''Layla:''' I dunno if the clues are following a timeline or if they're based on the amount of regret I have... Either way, this incident was bound to come up sooner or later.
:{{DIcon}} Sounds like this is getting personal.
::{{A|vo lylcop001 1915405 layla 07.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Hmm... would someone really go to all this trouble just to pull off some prank? I can't make heads or tails of it.
:{{DIcon}} Is the Seelie stalking you?
::{{A|vo lylcop001 1915405 layla 08.ogg}} '''Layla:''' A—Ahh... Don't say that... That sounds horrible.
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915405 layla 09.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Anyway, just follow me. I'll save the story for when we get there.
;(Continue to [[#The Road to Failure|The Road to Failure]])
{{Dialogue End}}

===The Road to Failure===
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Look for the clues the Wisdom Seelie left behind)
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915406 layla 01.ogg}} '''Layla:''' This is the place that immediately came to mind when the hint mentioned a crossroad.
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915406 layla 02.ogg}} '''Layla:''' I came here to conduct some astrological observation once. Everything went smoothly on the way, and I thought I was starting to get used to life at the Akademiya.
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915406 layla 03.ogg}} '''Layla:''' But just as I was about to set up the observation equipment, I heard a strange sound coming from nearby. I made my way here and discovered a bunch of bandits robbing someone.
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915406 layla 04.ogg}} '''Layla:''' They were a group of Treasure Hoarders, and the family that was being mugged looked completely helpless. They definitely wouldn't have been able to escape, and simply handing over their Mora might not have been enough to make the bandits go away.
:{{DIcon}} So you wanted to help, but couldn't?
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915406 layla 05.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Not exactly. I already had a Vision by that time.
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915406 layla 06.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Someone with a Vision should technically be really powerful, right? Handling a group of Treasure Hoarders should be well within my abilities.
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915406 layla 07.ogg}} '''Layla:''' However, I didn't know how to channel the power of the elements to fight at that time, and I was super scared. *sigh* I wielded immense power, but I didn't feel any stronger than just an ordinary person.
:{{DIcon}} Then what happened?
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915406 layla 08.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Then... I ran away. I scrambled towards Sumeru City looking for help.
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915406 layla 09.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Eventually, I managed to return with a few adventurers I ran into along the way.
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915406 layla 10.ogg}} '''Layla:''' It took longer than I had hoped, and by the time we made it back here, the Treasure Hoarders and the family were gone...
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915406 layla 11.ogg}} '''Layla:''' I don't know if the family only lost their belongings in the end, or if something worse happened to them.
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915406 layla 12.ogg}} '''Layla:''' I've faced a lot of problems after coming to Sumeru City, but this incident is one that I regret the most. I sat on the ground and began to cry.
;(Stress Value +1)
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915406 layla 13.ogg}} '''Layla:''' I could've stepped in to help that family... "Would it have ended differently... if I were just a little braver?"
:{{DIcon}} You did the right thing.
:{{DIcon}} You can't solve every problem with just courage alone. Being rational is just as important.
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915406 layla 14.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Thank you for trying to comfort me, but I can't stop myself from thinking that way.
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915406 layla 15.ogg}} '''Layla:''' It's just as the Seelie said, "Turning back shouldn't be an option." However, I can't help but think about running away whenever I'm faced with a challenge.
:{{Hangout Branch|The Seelie probably wants to do more than just criticize you for the past. Why don't you try facing your challenge head-on?|One Final Step}}
::{{A|vo lylcop001 1915406 layla 16.ogg}} '''Layla:''' You're right. The more challenging it gets, the harder I should try.
::{{A|vo lylcop001 1915406 layla 17.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Hmm... I'm feeling calmer now... Okay, let's go look for more leads nearby.
:;(Proceed to [[One Final Step]])

:{{Hangout Branch|Let's take a break from searching and rest for a bit.|An Exasperating Prank}}
::{{DIcon}} Let's take a break from searching and rest for a bit.
::{{A|vo lylcop001 1915406 layla 18.ogg}} '''Layla:''' B—But what about my thesis? We still haven't found the Seelie's answer yet...
::{{DIcon}} Forget about the thesis, you need to get some rest first.
::{{DIcon}} Your health is more important than your thesis.
::{{A|vo lylcop001 1915406 layla 19.ogg}} '''Layla:''' *sigh* Sorry for causing you so much trouble...
::{{DIcon}} Let's find someplace to rest.
::{{A|vo lylcop001 1915406 layla 20.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Alright. I... actually don't have much stamina. I've been stressed this whole time, and I feel exhausted...
::{{A|vo lylcop001 1915406 layla 21.ogg}} '''Layla:''' I'm really sorry.
:;(Proceed to [[An Exasperating Prank]])
{{Dialogue End}}

:{{A|vo jqrcop001 1914301 aikawasusumu 03.ogg}} '''Aikawa Susumu:''' I got to the door just in time to see {{color|buzz|a shadowy figure disappear up that tree}}!

:{{A|vo tnllq004 3 tighnari 09.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' We then buried Abattouy together. After organizing the research materials, I kept some as a souvenir, most of it was burned to hide the evidence.
:{{A|vo tnllq004 3 tighnari 10.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' I'm not with the Akademiya, so what do their policies have to do with me? On the other hand, I am the Forest Watcher of the Avidya Forest. I have a duty to protect all life in the forest.
:{{A|vo tnllq004 3 tighnari 11.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' All life brought forth in this world has meaning, and Karkata is no exception. If it exists, then it shouldn't be carelessly abandoned or destroyed.

:{{A|vo tnllq004 3 tighnari 12.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' The possibility exists is all. It's hard to explain Karkata's efforts to "repair" Abattouy.
:{{A|vo tnllq004 3 tighnari 13.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Abattouy only left behind a small portion of his research. Who knows how many commands he installed.
:{{A|vo tnllq004 3 tighnari 14.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Maybe a conflict between all those commands resulted in this sort of behavior.
:{{A|vo tnllq004 3 tighnari 15.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' From a more rigorous perspective, it is impossible to conclude that Karkata is a real life form, but the possibility exists — I am willing to believe in that.
:{{A|vo tnllq001 karkata happy 01.ogg}} '''Karkata:''' Kolu!
:{{A|vo tnllq004 3 tighnari 16.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' By the way, I'm not interested in continuing research on this subject. I'm just letting it hang out here because this place is relatively secluded.
:{{A|vo tnllq004 3 tighnari 17.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' But as things stand now, it wouldn't be a bad idea to make it my research assistant. At the very least, it can record my experiments.
:{{A|vo tnllq004 3 tighnari 18.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' What do you think?
:{{A|vo tnllq001 karkata excite 01.ogg}} '''Karkata:''' Kalu! Kalu!

'''''Give Her Memories''''' is the third part of the [[Chromatic Ode of Candies and Roses]] Event.

==Steps==
# Wait until the following morning (08:00 – 10:00)
# Go to [[Pardis Dhyai]]
# Go to [[Zubayr Theater]]
# Ask about [[Nilou]]'s whereabouts along the way
# Follow the clues to find Nilou
# Talk to the [[Aranara]]
# Talk to [[Cyno]] and [[Candace]]
# Go to the places the clues point to
# Catch up to Nilou
# Stop the caravan
# Wreck the caravan's cart
# Talk to [[Sethos]]
# Return to Pardis Dhyai
# Go to the [[Sanctuary of Surasthana]] and decorate the Flower Carriage
# Wait for the parade to begin
# Return to Pardis Dhyai

'''''Give Her Surprises''''' is the first part of the [[Chromatic Ode of Candies and Roses]] Event.

==Steps==
# Go to Port Ormos
# Go shopping with [[Candace]]
# Keep shopping
# Look for [[Dori]]

==Optional Quest Dialogue==
The following optional dialogues become available in the open-world as soon as this quest appears in the quest log, and will remain available until the end of this quest, with these additional conditions:
* Arachitta and Arasati disappear when talked to, so their dialogue is only available once.
* Layla's dialogue below gets replaced by her new open-world dialogue from the next quest, ''[[Give Her Sweetness]]'', once this quest ends and that quest becomes available in the quest log.
* Nilou, Najia, and the Wanderer disappear after the time changes to trigger Paimon's voice-lines of the next quest.

'''''Give Her Sweetness''''' is the second part of the [[Chromatic Ode of Candies and Roses]] Event.

==Steps==
# Wait until the following morning (08:00 – 10:00)
# Look for [[Dori]]
# Go to the scene of the crime
# Follow [[Candace]]
# Ask the caravan about the situation
# Return to [[Caravan Ribat]]
# Meet up in [[Port Ormos]]
# Go to the gathering spot

:{{Black Screen|Not long ago...}}
:<!-- {{A|vo hseq002 7 kaveh 07.ogg}}  -->'''Kaveh:''' Like I said, that's not it! We have more than just a heartless, transactional relationship... You're overthinking the whole thing!
:<!-- {{A|vo hseq002 7 alhaitham 04.ogg}}  -->'''Alhaitham:''' It was your theory in the first place... that [[Mehrak]] disappeared after working for you all this time without anything in return.

:<!-- {{A|vo hseq002 7 kaveh 09.ogg}}  -->'''Kaveh:''' You're saying I treat Mehrak like my inferior? I would never! I'm just worried Mehrak had some sort of awful experience and decided to run away.

:<!-- {{A|vo hseq002 7 kaveh 11.ogg}}  -->'''Kaveh:''' No, that's impossible... I created Mehrak myself, and I perform regular maintenance every week. There's no way Mehrak would be that heartless...

:<!-- {{A|vo hseq002 7 kaveh 12.ogg}}  -->'''Kaveh:''' It's good I ran in to you, actually. I was hoping you could take a look at my proposal.
:<!-- {{A|vo hseq002 7 alhaitham 08.ogg}}  -->'''Alhaitham:''' Huh, I thought you were confident in your abilities.
:<!-- {{A|vo hseq002 7 kaveh 13.ogg}}  -->'''Kaveh:''' It's not like that! I just wanted to confirm the route for the Flower Carriage.
:<!-- {{A|vo hseq002 7 alhaitham 09.ogg}}  -->'''Alhaitham:''' Unfortunately, I know nothing about the route for the Flower Carriage.
:<!-- {{A|vo hseq002 7 kaveh 14.ogg}}  -->'''Kaveh:''' What? You're not involved in the Festival at all? The Akademiya couldn't convince you to help out?

:<!-- {{A|vo hseq002 7 kaveh 16.ogg}}  -->'''Kaveh:''' Yep. The candy tower I designed is going to hit the Flower Carriage at a designated time and explode into pieces, shooting candy in all directions.

:<!-- {{A|vo hseq002 7 alhaitham 20.ogg}}  -->'''Alhaitham:''' As for the falling crates... During a busy time like the Sabzeruz Festival, people often stack their crates on both sides of the street, likely leading to similar accidents.

:'''Mehrak:''' Beep-beep.
:<!-- {{A|vo hseq002 7 kaveh 27.ogg}}  -->'''Kaveh:''' You went to look for more coffee beans because the shop was out of stock? Hey, if they're out, they're out. You don't have to go that far...

'''''Give It Up!''''' is a quest in {{Quest|Yoohoo Art: Seichou no Jutsu}}.

==Steps==
# Go to Chinju Forest
#* Ask [[Sayu]] if growing taller is all she cares about, and...
#** Tell her that sleep alone won't make her grow taller. Proceed to [[Bottleneck Breaking]].
#** Tell her that it's the quality of sleep that's keeping her from growing. Proceed to [[Sleep Alone Can't Wait]].
#* Tell Sayu not to neglect her work. Proceed to [[Operation Substitution]].

==Dialogue==
{{Quest Description|Sayu has been discovered by [[Kano Nana]], and has no choice but to return to Chinju Forest to practice ninjutsu. She begs you to come along, and so you do...}}
===Give It Up!===
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Go to Chinju Forest)
:{{A|vo zycop001 1901001 kanonana 01.ogg}} '''Kano Nana:''' We've arrived. Alright, I will go to the Yashiro Commission now to inquire about Sayu's mission orders. In the meantime, please keep an eye on her.
:{{A|vo zycop001 1901001 kanonana 02a.ogg}}<!--{{A|vo zycop001 1901001 kanonana 02b.ogg}}--> '''Kano Nana:''' Sayu, you can start by warming up. Though you may often be difficult for me, I certainly will not abide any trouble for the Traveler. Understand?
:{{A|vo zycop001 1901001 sayu 01.ogg}} '''Sayu:''' Yes, ma'am.
:{{Black Screen|''Kano Nana leaves.''}}
:{{A|vo zycop001 1901001 sayu 02.ogg}} '''Sayu:''' Good, she's gone. Phew, no more work for today, hehe!
:{{DIcon}} So that's why you wanted me to come along? To help you slack off?
:{{A|vo zycop001 1901001 sayu 03.ogg}} '''Sayu:''' Actually... I invited you to come as a helper. No need to go into too much detail.
:{{A|vo zycop001 1901001 sayu 04.ogg}} '''Sayu:''' The shrine maiden is terrifying. As soon as she picks up on my tracks, it's nearly impossible for me to shake her.
:{{A|vo zycop001 1901001 sayu 05.ogg}} '''Sayu:''' But you are also super skilled, so maybe you can help me.
:{{DIcon}} I don't think I should be doing this kind of thing.
:{{A|vo zycop001 1901001 sayu 06.ogg}} '''Sayu:''' Huh? You mean you won't rescue someone in a moment of dire need?
:{{A|vo zycop001 1901001 sayu 07.ogg}} '''Sayu:''' All that goes on here is cruel and involuntary labor.
:{{A|vo zycop001 1901001 sayu 08.ogg}} '''Sayu:''' Is it wrong to wish for ample rest? How else can I ever reach my growth spurt!? I'm not being unreasonable.
:{{DIcon}} I've been meaning to ask you... Why are you so obsessed with sleeping all the time?
:{{A|vo zycop001 1901001 sayu 09.ogg}} '''Sayu:''' Don't you know, there are tons of benefits to sleeping! You can regain energy, clear your mind, pass the time, and escape from all your troubles.
:{{A|vo zycop001 1901001 sayu 10.ogg}} '''Sayu:''' But most importantly, sleep helps you grow, and I've got plenty of growing to do.
:{{DIcon}} Growing?
:{{A|vo zycop001 1901001 sayu 11.ogg}} '''Sayu:''' That's right. The other ninja can leap up tall trees in a single bound and pick the tasty fruit way up high. Being tall is the key to everything.
:{{A|vo zycop001 1901001 sayu 12.ogg}} '''Sayu:''' All the other ninja my age are already way taller than me. Sensei told me that kids only have one chance to grow up, and that I'll miss my chance if I keep slacking off.
:{{DIcon}} But is growing taller really related to how long you sleep?
:{{A|vo zycop001 1901001 sayu 13.ogg}} '''Sayu:''' Of course it is! Haven't you seen someone suddenly grow taller while they're sleeping?
:{{DIcon}} I've never seen anyone grow in their sleep.
:{{DIcon}} I don't think anyone could "suddenly" grow taller.
:{{A|vo zycop001 1901001 sayu 14.ogg}} '''Sayu:''' It happens all the time! Though, I guess it does sound silly when you think about it...
:{{A|vo zycop001 1901001 sayu 15.ogg}} '''Sayu:''' Ugh, never mind. The longer I talk to you, the more you'll convince me otherwise...
:{{A|vo zycop001 1901001 sayu 16.ogg}} '''Sayu:''' Besides, what's wrong with wanting a little more sleep? *yawn* See... I'm already crazy tired.
:{{DIcon}} Growing taller is what you really care about, isn't it?
:;(Proceed to [[#Branch 1|Branch 1]])
:{{DIcon}} I can see that you're tired, but it's not good to neglect your work either.
:;(Proceed to [[#Branch 2|Branch 2]])
{{Dialogue End}}

===Branch 1===
{{Dialogue Start}}
:{{DIcon}} Growing taller is what you really care about, isn't it?
:{{A|vo zycop001 1901001 sayu 17.ogg}} '''Sayu:''' Exactly. At first, I only wanted to grow as fast as possible. But as I started sleeping more every day, the sleepier I became. The sleepier I became, the more I slept.
:{{A|vo zycop001 1901001 sayu 18.ogg}} '''Sayu:''' Even right now, I'm awake and talking with you, but my brain still feels half asleep... Trust me, work is the last thing on my mind.
:{{A|vo zycop001 1901001 sayu 19.ogg}} '''Sayu:''' Maybe you can help me! Even though I've been getting more sleep recently, I haven't gained any height at all. Any ideas?
:{{DIcon}} Sleep alone isn't enough to make you grow taller.
:;(Proceed to [[#Branch 1.A|Branch 1.A]])
:{{DIcon}} It's not the amount of sleep but the quality of sleep that's keeping you from growing.
:;(Proceed to [[#Branch 1.B|Branch 1.B]])
{{Dialogue End}}

====Branch 1.A====
{{Dialogue Start}}
:{{DIcon}} Sleep alone isn't enough to make you grow taller.
:{{A|vo zycop001 1901001 sayu 31.ogg}} '''Sayu:''' Huh? You're saying there's a way to grow taller while I'm awake, too?
:{{DIcon}} Plants grow best when the environmental conditions are right for them to generate energy and get proper nutrition. The same is probably true for people.
:{{A|vo zycop001 1901001 sayu 32.ogg}} '''Sayu:''' Yes... You do have a point. Hmm.
:{{DIcon}} How is your appetite these days?
:{{A|vo zycop001 1901001 sayu 33.ogg}} '''Sayu:''' It's nothing compared to the adults. Just a little food is enough to make me full. I usually prefer eating fruit rather than those big, filling dishes.
:{{A|vo zycop001 1901001 sayu 34.ogg}} '''Sayu:''' But I think I get it now... With more nutrients, people can grow bigger and taller. If anybody can eat a lot, it's the samurai. I should follow their example.
:{{DIcon}} You don't need to grow as big as a samurai though...
:{{A|vo zycop001 1901001 sayu 35.ogg}} '''Sayu:''' Hehe, I guess. Let's head into town and find something to eat.
:{{DIcon}} But Kano Nana hasn't returned yet.
:{{A|vo zycop001 1901001 sayu 36.ogg}} '''Sayu:''' We won't be able to go anywhere once she's around. Now's our only chance!
:;(Proceed to [[Bottleneck Breaking]])
{{Dialogue End}}

====Branch 1.B====
{{Dialogue Start}}
:{{DIcon}} It's not the amount of sleep but the quality of sleep that's keeping you from growing.
:{{A|vo zycop001 1901001 sayu 37.ogg}} '''Sayu:''' Quality sleep is hard to come by, especially with the shrine maiden always after me... Not much I can do about that.
:{{A|vo zycop001 1901001 sayu 38.ogg}} '''Sayu:''' Somehow, she knows all my favorite napping spots. Sometimes I wonder if she knows everything. *sigh* It's tough to throw her off my trail.
:{{A|vo zycop001 1901001 sayu 39.ogg}} '''Sayu:''' Anyway, let's go have a look around. *yawn* Maybe we can find a nice place to curl up for a nap.
:;(Proceed to [[Sleep Alone Can't Wait]])
{{Dialogue End}}

===Branch 2===
{{Dialogue Start}}
:{{DIcon}} I can see that you're tired, but it's not good to neglect your work either.
:{{A|vo zycop001 1901001 sayu 20.ogg}} '''Sayu:''' Yeah, I suppose I haven't kept up with my duties... I'm sorry, but...
:{{A|vo zycop001 1901001 sayu 21.ogg}} '''Sayu:''' *yawn* I really am getting sleepy...
:{{DIcon}} It seems you aren't taking the matter to heart at all.
:{{A|vo zycop001 1901001 sayu 22.ogg}} '''Sayu:''' It's because my work is just too boring. Transporting documents, organizing the ninja tools... As long as I don't do the work, no one will come asking me to do it again.
:{{A|vo zycop001 1901001 sayu 23.ogg}} '''Sayu:''' The higher ups always give all the important tasks to more suitable operatives. They never even give me a second thought.
:{{DIcon}} It's still your responsibility to fulfil your duties.
:{{DIcon}} You should try to at least keep your sensei and Kano Nana from worrying.
:{{A|vo zycop001 1901001 sayu 24.ogg}} '''Sayu:''' Hmm. Now that you say that, I just had an idea.
:{{A|vo zycop001 1901001 sayu 25.ogg}} '''Sayu:''' If you learn ninjutsu and help me with my tasks, then I can sleep peacefully and focus more on growing.
:{{DIcon}} You still haven't taken anything I've said to heart.
:{{A|vo zycop001 1901001 sayu 26.ogg}} '''Sayu:''' Ninjutsu will come in super handy during your adventures. Don't worry, I'll personally teach you everything.
:{{A|vo zycop001 1901001 sayu 27.ogg}} '''Sayu:''' If you work hard, then I'll work hard to teach you. See? This way, nobody is wasting time being lazy, hehe!
:{{DIcon}} Now you're the one trying to convince me to work.
:{{DIcon}} Fine, if that's what we have to do.
:{{A|vo zycop001 1901001 sayu 28.ogg}} '''Sayu:''' Thank you so much! See, you're the hero that protects Sayu's nap time!
:{{A|vo zycop001 1901001 sayu 29.ogg}} '''Sayu:''' We can start training as soon as the shrine maiden gets back.
:{{Black Screen|''After a while, Kano Nana returns.''}}
:{{A|vo zycop001 1901001 kanonana 03.ogg}} '''Kano Nana:''' Oh, I'm honestly surprised to see you still here, Sayu. Unless... Is this some sort of trick?
:{{A|vo zycop001 1901001 sayu 30a.ogg}}<!--{{A|vo zycop001 1901001 sayu 30b.ogg}}--> '''Sayu:''' The Traveler is interested in ninjutsu and wants to learn together.
:{{A|vo zycop001 1901001 kanonana 04.ogg}} '''Kano Nana:''' Is that so? Though it is strictly forbidden for some techniques to be taught to outsiders...
:{{A|vo zycop001 1901001 kanonana 05.ogg}} '''Kano Nana:''' But I suppose you are an exception in this case.
:{{DIcon}} Did you find out more about the ambush thing?
:{{A|vo zycop001 1901001 kanonana 06.ogg}} '''Kano Nana:''' Indeed, I did. I was able to determine that the Yashiro Commission had no intent of carrying out such a mission. They are now investigating the origins of these orders.
:{{A|vo zycop001 1901001 kanonana 07.ogg}} '''Kano Nana:''' Rest assured, the related personnel are all aware of the situation and there should be no further threats to your safety.
:{{DIcon}} Good to hear.
:{{A|vo zycop001 1901001 kanonana 08.ogg}} '''Kano Nana:''' Well then, let us begin your ninjutsu training.
:{{A|vo zycop001 1901001 kanonana 09.ogg}} '''Kano Nana:''' Please, {{Traveler}}, follow us.
:;(Proceed to [[Operation Substitution]])
{{Dialogue End}}

'''''Glaze Domain, Multum in Parvo''''' is an [[Event Quest]] during [[Secret Summer Paradise]]: Part I - [[An Invitation From Afar!]].

==Steps==
# Explore the Domain ahead
# Follow the Water Droplet
# Enter the stone wall and save the Water Droplet's friend
# Follow the Water Droplet
# Talk to everyone (0/3)
# Go to the first component's location
# Keep heading towards the first component's location
# Enter the preprint and get the component
# Return to the Silver Bottle Courtyard
