:{{A|vo yqeq202 3 kaeya 04.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' We keep getting sidetracked... but I believe you were saying something about being in a difficult predicament. Is something wrong with the Veluriyam Mirage?
:{{A|vo yqeq202 3 idyia 24.ogg}} '''Idyia:''' Ah yes, about that... I'm afraid the entire domain has recently sustained some significant damage...
:{{A|vo yqeq202 3 idyia 25.ogg}} '''Idyia:''' It was as if... the whole world was suddenly flipped upside down. A few components went missing from the core, which sustains the domain, and the impact cascaded out from there.
:{{A|vo yqeq202 3 idyia 26.ogg}} '''Idyia:''' Needless to say, many things in the Veluriyam Mirage have now stopped working...
:{{A|vo yqeq202 3 idyia 27.ogg}} '''Idyia:''' Just days after I agreed to let my friend's daughter come and visit, too. When she gets here, and sees the state this place is in—
:{{A|vo yqeq202 3 klee 17.ogg}} '''Klee:''' Oh, so you're Mom's friend? Hi, Aunty Desert, I'm Klee! Here, I brought the Magic Invite — see?
:{{A|vo yqeq202 3 idyia 28.ogg}} '''Idyia:''' Huh? Wait, so you're... you're...!
:{{A|vo yqeq202 3 eula 05.ogg}} '''Eula:''' Look how dilated her pupils are... She must be very surprised.
:{{A|vo yqeq202 3 collei 12.ogg}} '''Collei:''' Yeah, and not in a good way...
:{{A|vo yqeq202 3 klee 18.ogg}} '''Klee:''' Mom's the one who sent me here! She's the strongest mage ever. She said that her friend lives in the desert — you live in the desert, so that must be you! Right, Aunty Desert?
:{{A|vo yqeq202 3 kokomi 20.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' Ah, I see. So being a mage runs in the family.
:{{A|vo yqeq202 3 idyia 29.ogg}} '''Idyia:''' Aaaah!!!
:{{A|vo yqeq202 3 idyia 30.ogg}} '''Idyia:''' You're... you're Alice's daughter!? Oh, I just want the ground to swallow me up right now... Wait, that's it! I'll hide myself away in the core of the domain! Hide there until this all blows over. See you all in a hundred years!
:{{A|vo yqeq202 3 collei 13.ogg}} '''Collei:''' Idyia's really going through it! She's like a shriveled little forest fungus, hanging its head in shame!
:{{A|vo yqeq202 3 eula 06.ogg}} '''Eula:''' ...Collei? That's a harsh analogy, where'd all that come from?
:{{A|vo yqeq202 3 klee 19.ogg}} '''Klee:''' Don't worry, Aunty Desert, Klee's here to help you! And all my friends will help, too! Just take a deep breath, then another deep breath, and all your worries will fly away!
:{{DIcon}} Klee's right. Many hands make light work...
:{{DIcon}} As a Knight, it shall be my honor to render my assistance...
:{{A|vo yqeq202 3 paimon 04a.ogg}} {{A|vo yqeq202 3 paimon 04b.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yeah, don't you worry — {{MC|m=Sir|f=Lady}} Fixalot over here has a good track record with this kind of thing!
:{{A|vo yqeq202 3 idyia 31.ogg}} '''Idyia:''' Well, I'm useless... but it looks like that won't matter with all you capable people around. Fantastic!
:{{A|vo yqeq202 3 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Don't put yourself down, Idyia, you're great too!
:{{A|vo yqeq202 3 idyia 32.ogg}} '''Idyia:''' Thanks for your encouragement... Anyway, for the time being, please talk amongst yourselves.
:{{A|vo yqeq202 3 idyia 33.ogg}} '''Idyia:''' That'll give me some time to think things through, and maybe make a start on... um, delegating...

;(Talk to Klee or Kokomi)
:{{A|vo dialog yqeq202 klee 01a.ogg}} {{A|vo dialog yqeq202 klee 01b.ogg}} '''Klee:''' Hi Miss General! {{MC|m=Mr.|f=Miss}} Honorary Knight says that you're from Watatsumi Island...
:{{A|vo dialog yqeq202 klee 02.ogg}} '''Klee:''' What's it like there? There must be loooads of fish, right?
:{{A|vo dialog yqeq202 klee 03.ogg}} '''Klee:''' Wait! You look kinda like a mermaid. Are there fish in your family?
:{{A|vo dialog yqeq202 kokomi 01.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' Oh, uh... Sorry to disappoint you, Miss Mage, but I'm just an ordinary human.
:{{A|vo dialog yqeq202 kokomi 02.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' I have lots of great stories about Watatsumi Island, though. C'mon, let's enjoy the scenery while I tell you all about it.

;(Talk to Kaeya or Collei)
:{{A|vo dialog yqeq202 kaeya 01.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' Feeling nervous, Collei? It's your first time as a guide, after all.
:{{A|vo dialog yqeq202 collei 01.ogg}} '''Collei:''' Hmm? Oh no, not at all. I'm just... still settling into the role, so I was thinking about how to talk more like Master Tighnari...
:{{A|vo dialog yqeq202 kaeya 02.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' Well, the easiest way to imitate someone is to start with their most common turns of phrase.
:{{A|vo dialog yqeq202 collei 02.ogg}} '''Collei:''' Oh, okay. In that case... Ahem! "Put that mushroom down! Now! It's highly poisonous."
:{{A|vo dialog yqeq202 kaeya 03.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' There you go. With just a few simple words, you've captured your master's personality perfectly.
:{{A|vo dialog yqeq202 collei 03.ogg}} '''Collei:''' Anyway, what about your role? Don't you mind being the "Master Thief"? It doesn't sound like you're one of the good guys...
:{{A|vo dialog yqeq202 kaeya 04.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' Maybe not — until you factor in that I only steal from the enemy. I think that's enough to make me one of the good guys... don't you?
:{{A|vo dialog yqeq202 collei 04.ogg}} '''Collei:''' Oh, uh... fair point, fair point...

;(Talk to Eula or Idyia)
:{{A|vo dialog yqeq202 idyia 01.ogg}} '''Idyia:''' Hmm? Who else has visited the Veluriyam Mirage recently? There was [[Kaveh|someone]] from the Akademiya who came not long ago... a Kshahrewar scholar. Blond hair, architect, I think?
:{{A|vo dialog yqeq202 idyia 02.ogg}} '''Idyia:''' He was a huge help, and redesigned many of the buildings here. Although he was always grumbling to himself, he was extremely diligent in his work. Ah... What a kind person...
:{{A|vo dialog yqeq202 idyia 03.ogg}} '''Idyia:''' I could tell that was a sensitive soul, a lot like me... Ah! Sorry, please pretend you didn't hear that... Ahem! I'm of course a very strong and resilient person.
:{{A|vo dialog yqeq202 idyia 04.ogg}} '''Idyia:''' After him, an [[Lessig|aristocrat from Mondstadt]] showed up, then the Gen— I mean, Miss Sangonomiya.
:{{A|vo dialog yqeq202 idyia 05.ogg}} '''Idyia:''' Unfortunately, everything here suddenly started changing before I'd had the chance to be a good host and show them around.
:{{A|vo dialog yqeq202 eula 01.ogg}} '''Eula:''' Do you know where the Mondstadt aristocrat is now?
:{{A|vo dialog yqeq202 idyia 06.ogg}} '''Idyia:''' ...If I remember correctly, he headed north after the incident.
:{{A|vo dialog yqeq202 idyia 07.ogg}} '''Idyia:''' It's a pity we're having all these issues... *sigh* If we could get everything working normally again, I could probably locate him in an instant.
:{{A|vo dialog yqeq202 idyia 08.ogg}} '''Idyia:''' Still, not to worry. There's nothing dangerous here.
:{{A|vo dialog yqeq202 eula 02.ogg}} '''Eula:''' Mm...

;(After talking to everyone)
:{{A|vo yqeq202 5 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hey Idyia, you got an update for us? We've all caught up with each other.
:{{A|vo yqeq202 5 idyia 01.ogg}} '''Idyia:''' Very well. Then please allow me, Idyia, your Mascot, to explain exactly what's happened here...
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (She's pretty happy with this Mascot role, huh...)
:{{A|vo yqeq202 5 idyia 02.ogg}} '''Idyia:''' Basically, this entire domain is powered by a device called the Central Hub, which you all saw earlier.
:{{A|vo yqeq202 5 idyia 03.ogg}} '''Idyia:''' But following a major incident, several key components from the Central Hub came loose and went flying.
:{{A|vo yqeq202 5 idyia 04.ogg}} '''Idyia:''' ...Four components, I believe, which has caused the Central Hub to stop turning.
:{{A|vo yqeq202 5 klee 01.ogg}} '''Klee:''' Ohhh, so that thing's supposed to spin?
:{{A|vo yqeq202 5 idyia 05.ogg}} '''Idyia:''' Yes! It definitely shouldn't be frozen still like it is now! ...At least, that's not how it was when I first got here? Ugh, I've done such a terrible job of taking care of it, it's so embarrassing...
:{{A|vo yqeq202 5 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hey, everything's gonna be okay. So, we need to fix the big wheel up there, and to do that we need to find the missing parts.
:{{A|vo yqeq202 5 idyia 06.ogg}} '''Idyia:''' Right... I do know where one of the parts is. It landed not too far away.
:{{A|vo yqeq202 5 idyia 07.ogg}} '''Idyia:''' But the rest all landed in different areas. I'm afraid you'll have to go and look for those...
:{{A|vo yqeq202 5 idyia 08.ogg}} '''Idyia:''' Ahem! Now, as the caretaker and your mascot, I shall announce your respective adventure duties!
:{{A|vo yqeq202 5 collei 01.ogg}} '''Collei:''' Umm... You can just be yourself if you want, no need to force the whole roleplaying thing...
:{{A|vo yqeq202 5 idyia 09.ogg}} '''Idyia:''' ...Oh, I see... Um, okay, so I was thinking that maybe Swordmaster Eula and Healer Collei could investigate the northern zone, if that's okay?
:{{A|vo yqeq202 5 eula 01.ogg}} '''Eula:''' Fine by me. I was going to be looking for my cousin there anyway.
:{{A|vo yqeq202 5 collei 02.ogg}} '''Collei:''' I'll be your backup, Eula. I know you usually team up with Amber, so I'll try my best to fill her shoes.
:{{A|vo yqeq202 5 eula 02.ogg}} '''Eula:''' Oh? Well this'll be fun. Let's see if a forest ranger can outperform an outrider.
:{{A|vo yqeq202 5 idyia 10.ogg}} '''Idyia:''' Master Thief Kaeya and Mage Klee, if you could earmark some time in your busy schedules to search the west zone...
:{{A|vo yqeq202 5 klee 02.ogg}} '''Klee:''' Earmark? What does that mean?
:{{A|vo yqeq202 5 kaeya 01.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' It just means we mustn't forget to do it. Don't worry, we can handle that.
:{{A|vo yqeq202 5 idyia 11.ogg}} '''Idyia:''' Finally, we have our General, Miss Sangonomiya, and our Knight, {{Traveler}}. If there's no objections, please come with me to retrieve the first component.
:{{DIcon}} Understood.
:{{DIcon}} You have my sword!
::{{A|vo yqeq202 5 idyia 12b 1.ogg}} '''Idyia:''' Wow... Spoken like a true knight.
::{{A|vo yqeq202 5 kokomi 01b 1.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' Hehe... Then for my part, my strategic mind is at your service.
:{{A|vo yqeq202 5 idyia 13.ogg}} '''Idyia:''' Alright. Well, if anyone finds anything, come back here and we'll regroup.
:{{A|vo yqeq202 5 idyia 14.ogg}} '''Idyia:''' Please take care while you're out on the road, and look after each other... especially our little mage here.
:{{A|vo yqeq202 5 klee 03.ogg}} '''Klee:''' You got it! I'll take extra-special care of Kaeya.
:{{A|vo yqeq202 5 kaeya 02.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' I'll be on my best behavior.
:{{A|vo yqeq202 5 idyia 15.ogg}} '''Idyia:''' ...
:{{A|vo yqeq202 5 idyia 16.ogg}} '''Idyia:''' Okay, we'll leave it there for now. You two, please follow me.

;(After the cutscene)
:{{A|vo yqeq202 5 idyia 17.ogg}} '''Idyia:''' I remember seeing it just behind the Central Hub...
:{{A|vo yqeq202 5 kokomi 02.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' ...So how come you didn't bring it back when you first saw it?
:{{A|vo yqeq202 5 idyia 18.ogg}} '''Idyia:''' I'd have been more than happy to, if this one component was enough to fix the whole domain.
:{{A|vo yqeq202 5 idyia 19.ogg}} '''Idyia:''' But with three other components to find... I suddenly felt overwhelmed by how much work needed doing...
:{{A|vo yqeq202 5 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Paimon kinda gets that... Taking the first step is always the hardest part.

;(Approach the bridge on the floating rock)
:{{A|vo yqeq202 5 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hey, so Paimon's been meaning to ask, what brought you here, Kokomi?
:{{A|vo yqeq202 5 kokomi 03.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' Oh, um... Well, things have quieted down in Watatsumi Island for now, so I thought I'd take the chance to get out and see more of the world.
:{{A|vo yqeq202 5 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You've traveled a pretty long way... Why Sumeru?
:{{A|vo yqeq202 5 kokomi 04.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' ...I figured that I needed to venture farther than usual to really broaden my horizons.
:{{A|vo yqeq202 5 kokomi 05.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' Well, that's one reason, anyway... I can explain in more detail another time.

;(Approach the [[Streaming Projector]])
:{{A|vo yqeq202 6 idyia 01.ogg}} '''Idyia:''' Okay, this is the spot.
:{{A|vo yqeq202 6 idyia 02.ogg}} '''Idyia:''' Now, I'm sure you're both wondering: "But where's the component?"
:{{A|vo yqeq202 6 idyia 03.ogg}} '''Idyia:''' "There's nothing here! Oh, where could it be..."
:{{A|vo yqeq202 6 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, it's that lamp thingy, right? Water Droplet showed us how that works already.
:{{A|vo yqeq202 6 idyia 04.ogg}} '''Idyia:''' Uh... yes, that's the one... There goes my big introduction.
:{{A|vo yqeq202 6 idyia 05.ogg}} '''Idyia:''' Showing people the ropes is supposed to be my job... I can't believe I'm being shown up by a Hydro Eidolon...
:{{A|vo yqeq202 6 kokomi 01.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' Cheer up, Idyia. The Hydro Eidolon can give a basic demonstration of how to use things, but beyond that, it can't communicate...
:{{A|vo yqeq202 6 kokomi 02.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' That's where you come in. Your descriptions can explain everything in full, vivid detail.
:{{A|vo yqeq202 6 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Paimon forgot how persuasive Kokomi can be when she really wants to... Sometimes having a genius strategist around really comes in handy.
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (Now I see how an eloquent speaker can persuade others to not only agree with them, but do things for them...)
:{{A|vo yqeq202 6 idyia 06.ogg}} '''Idyia:''' Oh, if you put it that way... Well then, just pretend like you've never seen it before, and I'll tell you all about it!
:{{A|vo yqeq202 6 idyia 07.ogg}} '''Idyia:''' This is called the Streaming Projector. Everything here in the Veluriyam Mirage was made using this device...
:{{A|vo yqeq202 6 idyia 08.ogg}} '''Idyia:''' All you need to do is place an item in the Projector, and you can construct a corresponding item based on the shape of the original and your imagination.
:{{A|vo yqeq202 6 idyia 09.ogg}} '''Idyia:''' ...At least, I think that's what it used to do. With the domain in its current state, only its most basic functions are still operable.
:{{DIcon}} Basic functions... like shining light?
:{{A|vo yqeq202 6 idyia 10.ogg}} '''Idyia:''' Okay, not quite that basic... At the moment, it's only able to show two-dimensional objects. I call them "preprints."
:{{A|vo yqeq202 6 idyia 11.ogg}} '''Idyia:''' Think of it like a sort of draft or blueprint, or something.
:{{A|vo yqeq202 6 kokomi 03.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' So you're saying, the component fell into the preprints?
:{{A|vo yqeq202 6 idyia 12.ogg}} '''Idyia:''' Yes, exactly. I'll leave you to go in and physically retrieve it, while I... Uh, I'll be out here rooting for you by... by doing a motivational dance!
:{{A|vo yqeq202 6 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Really?
:{{A|vo yqeq202 6 idyia 13.ogg}} '''Idyia:''' ...No. Sorry. I feel like I have two left feet when I try to dance. I guess I'll just... find a place nearby to sit and wait patiently for you...
:{{A|vo yqeq202 6 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hey, come on, cheer up. We'll handle everything from here!

;(Talk to Idyia again, optional)
:{{A|vo dialog yqeq202 idyia 09.ogg}} '''Idyia:''' All you need to do is touch the Streaming Projector and you'll enter the world of preprints...
:{{A|vo dialog yqeq202 idyia 10.ogg}} '''Idyia:''' Don't worry. It's not dangerous.

;(Open the first chest in the Prerint)
:{{A|vo yqeq202 6 idyia 14.ogg}} '''Idyia:''' Doesn't look like the component is in here...

;(Open the rightmost chest in the Prerint)
:{{A|vo yqeq202 6 idyia 15.ogg}} '''Idyia:''' Yes, that's the one! Now you just need to bring it back out.

;(Leave the preprint after collecting the gear)
:{{A|vo yqeq202 7 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What is this thing, anyway? Some kind of gear?
:[[File:Secret Summer Paradise Gear.png|200px]]
:{{A|vo yqeq202 7 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' And why's it so small? It doesn't look like it belongs in that huge wheel...
:{{A|vo yqeq202 7 idyia 01.ogg}} '''Idyia:''' It's hard to explain, but I assure you that it's definitely one of the components.
:{{A|vo yqeq202 7 idyia 02.ogg}} '''Idyia:''' So that leaves three more components missing...
:{{A|vo yqeq202 7 kokomi 01.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' Every journey begins with a first step. I think we're off to a good start, and things should keep going smoothly from here.
:{{A|vo yqeq202 7 idyia 03.ogg}} '''Idyia:''' Y—You really think so?
:{{DIcon}} Of course, trust the General!
:{{A|vo yqeq202 7 idyia 04.ogg}} '''Idyia:''' I suppose you're right... she did manage to defeat class A at the Onmyou chamber, after all...
:{{A|vo yqeq202 7 kokomi 02.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' Um... You, uh, don't need to keep bringing that up!
:{{A|vo yqeq202 7 idyia 05.ogg}} '''Idyia:''' Anyway, thank you for all your help.
:{{A|vo yqeq202 7 idyia 06.ogg}} '''Idyia:''' I'll take this and start trying to repair the Central Hub. You two may as well head back to town.
:{{A|vo yqeq202 7 idyia 07.ogg}} '''Idyia:''' *sigh* Why am I so clumsy? Once again, I was no help at all... The least I can do is try and handle the actual repairs.
----
;(Approach the marked location in the Silver Bottle Courtyard)
:{{A|vo yqeq202 8 kokomi 01.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' Hmm...
:{{A|vo yqeq202 8 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What's wrong, Kokomi?
:{{A|vo yqeq202 8 kokomi 02.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' I'm just a little confused... You mentioned that the Water Droplet showed you how to use the projector?
:{{A|vo yqeq202 8 kokomi 03.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' Can you tell me a little bit more about that? I'm so curious to know what happened.
:{{A|vo yqeq202 8 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, sure!
:{{Black Screen|You tell Kokomi everything that happened earlier with Water Droplet.}}
:{{A|vo yqeq202 8 kokomi 04.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' I see...
:;(The ground shakes)
:{{A|vo yqeq202 8 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hey, look! The wheel is spinning now.
:{{A|vo yqeq202 8 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Aww, and now it's stopped again. Well, that didn't last long...
:{{A|vo yqeq202 8 kokomi 05.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' It also wasn't spinning at the right speed. Before the incident, it spun much faster than that.
:{{A|vo yqeq202 8 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, so you saw it back when it was still working?
:{{A|vo yqeq202 8 kokomi 06.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' Yes. I arrived here a little earlier than the rest of you. But the incident took place not long after I entered.
:{{A|vo yqeq202 8 kokomi 07.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' Like Idyia said, it felt like the world was "flipped upside down"... I don't know how else to describe it... and I certainly don't want to experience it again.
:{{A|vo yqeq202 8 idyia 01.ogg}} '''Idyia:''' *sigh* It's no use... Seems it won't run until all the missing components are returned.
:{{A|vo yqeq202 8 idyia 02.ogg}} '''Idyia:''' For a moment there, when it started turning, I got excited... I thought that maybe the hub can work just fine without the other three...
:{{A|vo yqeq202 8 kokomi 08.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' Wishful thinking is only going to lead to disappointment, Idyia. Let's stick to the plan, we'll get there.
:{{A|vo yqeq202 8 klee 01a.ogg}} {{A|vo yqeq202 8 klee 01b.ogg}} '''Klee:''' Hey, {{MC|m=Mr.|f=Miss}} Honorary Knight and Miss General are here! Oh, and our mascot!
:{{A|vo yqeq202 8 klee 02.ogg}} '''Klee:''' You beat us! I was sure we were gonna be the first ones back!
:{{A|vo yqeq202 8 kaeya 01.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' Hey. How'd it go?
:{{DIcon}} Mission complete!
:{{DIcon}} Where a knight's sword goes, victory soon follows!
:{{A|vo yqeq202 8 kaeya 02.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' Haha. Impressive. I doubt you'd find many other knights of such caliber even among the Knights of Favonius.
:{{A|vo yqeq202 8 idyia 03.ogg}} '''Idyia:''' How about our Master Thief and Mage? Did you find anything?
:{{A|vo yqeq202 8 klee 03.ogg}} '''Klee:''' You bet! We made a huuuge discovery!
:{{A|vo yqeq202 8 klee 04.ogg}} '''Klee:''' The place we were trying to get to was blocked off. We couldn't see anything past it, and there was no way around.
:{{A|vo yqeq202 8 klee 05.ogg}} '''Klee:''' But then, just now, a huge canyon appeared outta nowhere... so we hurried back here!
:{{A|vo yqeq202 8 kokomi 09.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' It appeared just now?
:{{A|vo yqeq202 8 kokomi 10.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' ...
:{{A|vo yqeq202 8 klee 06a.ogg}} {{A|vo yqeq202 8 klee 06b.ogg}} '''Klee:''' Come and see, {{MC|m=Mr.|f=Miss}} Honorary Knight! Let's go on a canyon adventure!
:{{DIcon}} To the canyon!
:{{A|vo yqeq202 8 idyia 04.ogg}} '''Idyia:''' I'll sit this one out. I'm beat after trying to make those repairs... I need to take a break.
:{{A|vo yqeq202 8 klee 07.ogg}} '''Klee:''' Miss General, you should come, too! You can hide behind me and give me smart advice while I protect you!
:{{A|vo yqeq202 8 kokomi 11.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' Wonderful. It would be an honor to serve as adviser for our young mage.
:{{A|vo yqeq202 8 klee 08.ogg}} '''Klee:''' Hee-hee, let's go!!!
{{Dialogue End}}

::When the first wisp of wind brushed across the land

:{{A|vo eqxs204 1 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' The cross country contest is about to begin. So many people have shown up... How's everyone doing? Feeling ready?

:{{A|vo eqxs204 1 minnie 01.ogg}} '''Minnie:''' I got here a little late 'cause I was coming from home. Are they still warming up? The race is gonna start any minute...
:{{A|vo eqxs204 1 alrani 04.ogg}} '''Alrani:''' Yeah, I wonder what's taking them so long...
:{{A|vo eqxs204 1 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, it's not like Varesa and Xilonen to be behind schedule... Okay, we'll go check on them.

:{{A|vo eqxs204 2 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hey, they've finally emerged from the tent.

:{{A|vo eqxs204 2 xilonen 01.ogg}} '''Xilonen:''' It's Yigang. He's come down with a fever.
:{{A|vo eqxs204 2 varesa 01.ogg}} '''Varesa:''' *sigh*... I wish I'd acted sooner... I've been checking in with him constantly since he started sneezing, and he said he was fine, but still. I should've known better.
:{{A|vo eqxs204 2 xilonen 02.ogg}} '''Xilonen:''' He probably hoped he could tough it out until the end of the competition. But now it's broken into a full-blown fever. He doesn't even have the energy to get out of bed.
:{{A|vo eqxs204 2 varesa 02.ogg}} '''Varesa:''' We've been in touch with the organizing committee, and they're making sure he stays warm and takes his medication. They actually sent a medic to look after him, so he's in good hands.
:{{A|vo eqxs204 2 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Well, that's good... But what about the race? You're one team member short, and it's about to kick off any minute...
:{{A|vo eqxs204 2 varesa 03.ogg}} '''Varesa:''' Yeah... What're we gonna do?
:{{A|vo eqxs204 2 varesa 04.ogg}} '''Varesa:''' This race is a huge deal for all of us. Minnie's parents are already waiting at the finish line... Our only hope now is...
:{{DIcon}} I'll do it.
:{{DIcon}} Me? I can try.
:{{A|vo eqxs204 2 xilonen 03.ogg}} '''Xilonen:''' That was our first thought too. You've trained with us, so you know the course. Plus, you have a good level of fitness and plenty of outdoor experience.
:{{A|vo eqxs204 2 xilonen 04.ogg}} '''Xilonen:''' I don't feel great about roping you in at the last minute, though. There's nothing worse than someone dumping an urgent job on you when you least expect it, and making you feel like you can't turn it down.
:{{A|vo eqxs204 2 varesa 05.ogg}} '''Varesa:''' We'd love to have you on the team — but only if you're willing.
:{{DIcon}} I won't let Minnie down.
:{{DIcon}} I won't let your trip to Mondstadt be in vain.
:{{DIcon}} "Soulblazers don't give up without a fight."
:{{A|vo eqxs204 2 varesa 06.ogg}} '''Varesa:''' Hehe... Tumaini to the rescue once again! You'll always be Natlan's hero, {{Traveler}}. Wherever you go, we place our pride and our hope in you!
:{{A|vo eqxs204 2 xilonen 05.ogg}} '''Xilonen:''' Alright, let's save the fawning for later. We don't have much time.
:{{A|vo eqxs204 2 xilonen 06.ogg}} '''Xilonen:''' The order for the relay will be as follows: First, me. Second, {{Traveler}}. Third, Varesa — and finally, Minnie.
:{{A|vo eqxs204 2 xilonen 07.ogg}} '''Xilonen:''' Your section of the course is the first uphill stretch. Remember to pace yourself and conserve your energy. Don't try to sprint the whole way.
:{{A|vo eqxs204 2 xilonen 08.ogg}} '''Xilonen:''' Once I hand you the baton, follow the signs until you reach the statue, where you'll hand it off to Varesa.
:{{A|vo eqxs204 2 varesa 07.ogg}} '''Varesa:''' We can do this, guys!
:{{DIcon}} Got it.
:{{A|vo eqxs204 2 xilonen 09.ogg}} '''Xilonen:''' Alright, time to make a move. Everyone, get to your starting positions.

'''''Half a Day's Leisure''''' is a quest in {{Quest|A Song That Knows Grace}}.

==Steps==
# Go to [[Chihu Rock]]
# Talk to [[Yun Jin]]
# Go to [[Chen the Sharp]]'s snack stand
# Talk to Yun Jin
# Talk to Yun Jin
#* Tell Yun Jin that her offstage personality is the cuter one. Continue with the quest to '''Ending: Brought Together by Common Interests'''.
#* Tell Yun Jin that her onstage persona is more striking. This completes the quest with '''Ending: A Souvenir Without Sentiment is of Little Worth'''.
# Take a photo of Yun Jin
# Talk to Yun Jin
# Go to [[Feiyun Slope]] to look for a suitable spot
# Wait for Yun Jin to arrive

==Gameplay Notes==
*Completing this quest by taking photos with Yun Jin grants the {{Achievement|May This Moment Be Made to Last}}.

===Meeting by the Wharf===
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Talk to Chongyun)
:{{A|vo cycop001 1902101 chongyun 01.ogg}} '''???:''' Excuse me, have you perchance seen any "evil spirits"?
:{{DIcon}} "Evil spirits"?
:{{A|vo cycop001 1902101 chongyun 02.ogg}} '''???:''' Oh, my apologies. You're not from around here, are you? This question must sound a little confusing to you.
:{{A|vo cycop001 1902101 chongyun 03.ogg}} '''Chongyun:''' I'm Chongyun, a local exorcist from Liyue. Those versed in the arts of exorcism refer to all forms of demons and monsters as "evil spirits."
:{{A|vo cycop001 1902101 chongyun 04.ogg}} '''Chongyun:''' Evil spirits have existed since ancient times. They lurk among the shadows in the lands of Liyue, stirring up all sorts of trouble and mischief.
:{{A|vo cycop001 1902101 chongyun 05.ogg}} '''Chongyun:''' It is my duty to exorcise or destroy them and protect the citizens here from their evil doings.
:{{DIcon}} That is an admirable job.
::{{A|vo cycop001 1902101 chongyun 06.ogg}} '''Chongyun:''' It's work that must be done, just like any other job. That's all.
:{{DIcon}} That sounds similar to the work of adventurers.
::{{A|vo cycop001 1902101 chongyun 07.ogg}} '''Chongyun:''' Really... Please, enlighten me.
::{{DIcon}} I have also been traveling across Liyue, rescuing people from monsters, and collecting treasures along the way.
::{{A|vo cycop001 1902101 chongyun 08.ogg}} '''Chongyun:''' Oh, I see! There are some similarities.
:{{DIcon}} I get it, that's what the [[Xiao|Vigilant Yaksha]] fights against, right?
::{{A|vo cycop001 1902101 chongyun 09.ogg}} '''Chongyun:''' How did you come to know of the Vigilant Yaksha?
::{{A|vo cycop001 1902101 chongyun 10.ogg}} '''Chongyun:''' I have great respect for the [[yaksha]]s. For generations, yakshas and exorcists have been protecting Liyue together, one in plain sight and the other in secret.
:{{A|vo cycop001 1902101 chongyun 11.ogg}} '''Chongyun:''' Sorry, I digress.
:{{A|vo cycop001 1902101 chongyun 12.ogg}} '''Chongyun:''' Judging from your response, it seems you aren't well-versed in the realm of evil spirits... But that's understandable. If I may ask, have you happened to come across anything strange recently?
:{{A|vo cycop001 1902101 chongyun 13.ogg}} '''Chongyun:''' Sometimes even the most trivial matters prove helpful in my hunt for evil spirits.
:{{DIcon}} Hmm, nothing in particular.
:{{A|vo cycop001 1902101 chongyun 14.ogg}} '''Chongyun:''' Oh, I see. Well, fair enough...
:{{A|vo cycop001 1902101 chongyun 15.ogg}} '''Chongyun:''' In that case, I guess I'll just have to try my luck with the clues I already have.
:{{DIcon}} What clues do you have now?
:{{A|vo cycop001 1902101 chongyun 16.ogg}} '''Chongyun:''' *sigh* Only some scattered reports, really. Nothing too significant yet...
:{{A|vo cycop001 1902101 chongyun 17.ogg}} '''Chongyun:''' But if you're really interested, I can tell you about some of the more useful ones I've gathered so far.
:{{A|vo cycop001 1902101 chongyun 18.ogg}} '''Chongyun:''' I read a flyer that said: "The Test of Courage is now being held on [[Wuwang Hill]]. Bring your best friend and test your courage together!"
:{{A|vo cycop001 1902101 chongyun 19.ogg}} '''Chongyun:''' Then: "Recently, the sounds of footsteps and shouting have been heard outside people's windows at night. The noises have frightened the children and they are unable to sleep."
:{{A|vo cycop001 1902101 chongyun 20.ogg}} '''Chongyun:''' And: "A huge shadow has appeared in [[Guili Plains]]. It flies and swirls, summons down fireballs, and makes all sorts of strange noises."
:{{A|vo cycop001 1902101 chongyun 21.ogg}} '''Chongyun:''' Cases such as these might actually be worth our attention.
:{{DIcon}} Test of Courage... Doesn't that sound like an advertisement?
::{{A|vo cycop001 1902101 chongyun 22.ogg}} '''Chongyun:''' I think something strange must have happened at the Test of Courage...
::{{A|vo cycop001 1902101 chongyun 23.ogg}} '''Chongyun:''' I guess this so-called "test" is supposed to be like a "test of mettle." Its purpose must be to try the will and power of exorcists.
:{{DIcon}} Sometimes drunkards pass by people's windows at night, that's nothing unusual.
::{{A|vo cycop001 1902101 chongyun 24.ogg}} '''Chongyun:''' Hmm, unless there was a problem with the drinks, I don't think drunkards would scare the children that much.
:{{DIcon}} The shadow in Guili Plains sounds like it may be a Ruin Hunter.
::{{A|vo cycop001 1902101 chongyun 25.ogg}} '''Chongyun:''' Ruin Hunter? Hmm, that would fit the description, but why has no one recognized it?
:{{A|vo cycop001 1902101 chongyun 26.ogg}} '''Chongyun:''' Do you think I'm not deciphering these clues correctly?
:{{Hangout Branch|They all sound pretty farfetched, perhaps I should just tell him that.|Distant Gaze}}
::{{A|vo cycop001 1902101 chongyun 27.ogg}} '''Chongyun:''' So you don't think any of these clues are related to evil spirits?
::{{A|vo cycop001 1902101 chongyun 28.ogg}} '''Chongyun:''' Sorry... Please give me a moment to calm myself.
::{{DIcon}} I'm sorry, I didn't realize it would be so devastating to you.
::{{A|vo cycop001 1902101 chongyun 29.ogg}} '''Chongyun:''' ...No, it's fine. I've been this way since I was young.
::{{DIcon}} Oh, is it... health-related?
::{{A|vo cycop001 1902101 chongyun 30.ogg}} '''Chongyun:''' No, not at all. I guess you could say I just tend to be... unstable... you know, emotionally. It causes me to become very uncomfortable at times.
::{{A|vo cycop001 1902101 chongyun 31.ogg}} '''Chongyun:''' This tendency of getting stirred up easily is what people call a "pure-yang spirit."
::{{DIcon}} "Stirred up easily"? I couldn't tell that from your appearance...
::{{A|vo cycop001 1902101 chongyun 32.ogg}} '''Chongyun:''' Yes, well, such a constitution is very rare, but it's a potent weapon for an exorcist. My constitution alone is capable of scaring off evil spirits.
::{{A|vo cycop001 1902101 chongyun 33.ogg}} '''Chongyun:''' But I must constantly focus on my emotions... Otherwise, I may easily do something out of control.
::{{A|vo cycop001 1902101 chongyun 34.ogg}} '''Chongyun:''' ...Anyway... I carefully selected these clues from an ocean of information. I can't believe they're all completely irrelevant.
::{{A|vo cycop001 1902101 chongyun 35.ogg}} '''Chongyun:''' Oh no... I'm still feeling quite uncomfortable. There's heat growing in my chest... I—I can't breathe.
::{{DIcon}} Shall I take you to Bubu Pharmacy?
::{{DIcon}} How about some water?
::{{DIcon}} Shall I try rubbing your Vision on your forehead?
::{{A|vo cycop001 1902101 chongyun 36.ogg}} '''Chongyun:''' No, I'll be alright. I—I brought some popsicles with me for just such occasions.
::{{Black Screen|''Chongyun eats the popsicle.''}}
::{{A|vo cycop001 1902101 chongyun 37.ogg}} '''Chongyun:''' ...I—I feel much better now.
::{{DIcon}} That's an unexpected solution.
:::{{A|vo cycop001 1902101 chongyun 38.ogg}} '''Chongyun:''' ...It's quite effective. I'm always sure to bring out some popsicles with me whenever I go out.
::{{DIcon}} It looked tasty.
:::{{A|vo cycop001 1902101 chongyun 39.ogg}} '''Chongyun:''' Actually, they're quite tasteless. Otherwise, I wouldn't be able to stomach them.
::{{A|vo cycop001 1902101 chongyun 40.ogg}} '''Chongyun:''' *sigh* Thank you for your concern. I'm fine now.
::{{A|vo cycop001 1902101 chongyun 41.ogg}} '''Chongyun:''' But what should I do next if all these clues are irrelevant?
::{{DIcon}} Actually, it seems someone's been watching us this whole time...
::;(Camera pans to a boy watching Chongyun and the Traveler eagerly)
::{{A|vo cycop001 1902101 chongyun 42.ogg}} '''Chongyun:''' Yes, I've noticed him too.
::{{A|vo cycop001 1902101 chongyun 43.ogg}} '''Chongyun:''' It's no coincidence that we both noticed it. I'm sure he's watching us.
::{{A|vo cycop001 1902101 chongyun 44.ogg}} '''Chongyun:''' But it doesn't seem he has any intentions other than looking at us... Perhaps there's something he wishes to tell us?
::{{DIcon}} Let's go and ask him.
:::{{A|vo cycop001 1902101 chongyun 45.ogg}} '''Chongyun:''' Right, he might need our help.
::{{DIcon}} Maybe he's just shy.
:::{{A|vo cycop001 1902101 chongyun 46.ogg}} '''Chongyun:''' Hmm, possible... Let's go and ask him.
:;(Continues to [[Distant Gaze]])
:{{Hangout Branch|Although they all seem farfetched, I'd better not tell him that. He seems like quite the persistent character.|Test of Courage}}
::{{A|vo cycop001 1902101 chongyun 47.ogg}} '''Chongyun:''' Hmm... I think the clue about the Test of Courage is the most relevant one I have so far.
::{{A|vo cycop001 1902101 chongyun 48.ogg}} '''Chongyun:''' If strange things have been happening at the event, then evil spirits may well be the cause.
::{{A|vo cycop001 1902101 chongyun 49.ogg}} '''Chongyun:''' *sigh* But there's an unusual requirement for this event. You must be a team of two people in order to participate.
::{{DIcon}} Actually, that's quite normal.
:::{{A|vo cycop001 1902101 chongyun 50.ogg}} '''Chongyun:''' Is it? Huh... perhaps you're right. If evil spirits do show up, then the two can take care of each other, I suppose.
::{{DIcon}} The aim is to strengthen the relationship between the two participants.
:::{{A|vo cycop001 1902101 chongyun 51.ogg}} '''Chongyun:''' Uh...? Strengthen the relationship...? Sorry, I don't really get it.
::{{A|vo cycop001 1902101 chongyun 52.ogg}} '''Chongyun:''' Anyway, if you have the time, would you join me for this event?
::{{A|vo cycop001 1902101 chongyun 53.ogg}} '''Chongyun:''' You seem to have a good eye for discerning these clues. With your adventuring experience, I'm sure we'll track down those evil spirits in no time.
::{{DIcon}} Okay, I'm free now anyway.
:::{{A|vo cycop001 1902101 chongyun 54.ogg}} '''Chongyun:''' Thank you! I was starting to worry that I wouldn't be able to find a partner.
::{{DIcon}} Sorry, I'm not interested...
:::{{A|vo cycop001 1902101 chongyun 55.ogg}} '''Chongyun:''' Please, you must go with me! I don't know if I'll be able to find anyone else suitable to join me.
:::{{A|vo cycop001 1902101 chongyun 56.ogg}} '''Chongyun:''' My [[Xingqiu|best friend]] is busy with other matters, and I worry that anyone else won't even be able to protect themselves.
:::{{DIcon}} Fine, If you say so.
:::{{A|vo cycop001 1902101 chongyun 57.ogg}} '''Chongyun:''' Ah, you have my thanks!
::{{A|vo cycop001 1902101 chongyun 58.ogg}} '''Chongyun:''' We should make haste! If there are evil spirits at the event, then things could get dangerous.
:;(Continues to [[Test of Courage]])
{{Dialogue End}}

'''''Headlong Into the Sands''''' is the second part of the [[Ruins Exploration: Fieldwise Center]] event.

==Steps==
# Wait until two days later (06:00 – 08:00)
# Go to the agreed location
# Proceed deeper into the [[Unknown Ruins|unknown ruins]]
# Explore the ruins
# Continue investigating the ruins
# Clear out the monsters{{Enemy List|Primal Construct: Prospector; Primal Construct: Repulsor; Primal Construct: Reshaper}}
# Continue investigating the ruins
# Follow [[Mehrak]]
# Explore the ruins
# Use the key to continue forward
# Proceed deeper into the ruins
# Explore the ruins
# Open the door
# Explore the ruins
# Look for other stone slabs (0/3)
# Observe the stone slab
# Follow the cat's guidance to obtain one more stone slab
# Discuss with your companions
# Activate the Great Vayuvyastra by attacking it
# Observe the stone slab
# Continue investigating the ruins
# Explore the ruins
# Follow Mehrak
# Split up and search for the stone slabs
# Reunite with your companions
# Attack the mechanism to clear away the dust
# Observe the stone slab
# Catch up with Mehrak
# Explore the ruins
# Explore the ruins together
# Investigate the upper level
# Discuss with your companions
# Sort through the Ragged Notes in your Inventory
# Read the notes together
# Reunite with your companions
# Explore the ruins
# Follow [[Thoth]]
# Talk to Thoth
# Leave the ruins
# Talk to [[Cyrus (Sumeru)|Cyrus]]

==Gameplay Notes==
* During steps 14–22, the active party will be limited to a trial [[Tighnari]], [[Cyno]], and [[Sethos]].
* During steps 23–25, the active party will be limited to a trial [[Alhaitham]].
* During steps 26–27, the active party will be limited to a trial [[Kaveh]].
* During steps 28–29, the active party will be limited to a trial Alhaitham and Kaveh.
* During steps 30–35, the active party will be limited to a trial [[Layla]] and [[Traveler (Dendro)]].

==Dialogue==
{{Quest Description|The appointed time has come. Seek out the truth in the sea of sand.}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Talk to [[Cyrus (Sumeru)|Cyrus]] at the Fieldwise Center, optional)
:{{A|Vo dialog hzweq002 spantamadcyrus 01.ogg}} '''Cyrus:''' The desert is ever unchanging... I hope it isn't too harsh on the young ones...

;(Use [[Nahida]]'s [[All Schemes to Know]] on Cyrus, optional)
:{{A|Vo hzweq002 41 spantamadcyrus 01.ogg}} '''Cyrus:''' (*sigh* I know they're far more capable than an old man like me... but I worry all the same.)

;(Approach the marked location)
:{{A|vo hzweq002 1 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Looking at the map... We should be getting close...
:{{A|vo hzweq002 1 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Speaking of which, the closer we get, the more Paimon's heart feels like it's beating out of her chest...
:{{DIcon}} Must just be jitters of excitement.
:{{A|vo hzweq002 1 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Excitement... Yeah, sure. That's it...
:{{A|vo hzweq002 1 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, look! It's [[Tighnari]] and the others! Everyone's here bright and early.
:{{DIcon}} They must have set out last night.
:{{A|vo hzweq002 1 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yeah, the desert's a pretty harsh environment. Better to travel at night and beat the heat.
:{{A|vo hzweq002 1 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hey, everyone! We're here!
:{{A|vo hzweq002 1 tighnari 01.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Ah, right on time.
:{{DIcon}} Looks like the desert's treating you okay so far.
:{{A|vo hzweq002 1 tighnari 02.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' You don't need to worry about me. It's not too hot yet, and I'm properly hydrated.
:{{A|vo hzweq002 1 sethos 01.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' Alright, we're just waiting on the two people Miss [[Layla]] mentioned, and then we'll be set.
:{{DIcon}} What about [[Djer]]?
:{{A|vo hzweq002 1 sethos 02.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' He's staying behind. If we don't make it back after a certain time, he'll be in charge of rescue operations.
:{{A|vo hzweq002 1 djer 01.ogg}} '''Djer:''' You can count on me.
:{{A|vo hzweq002 1 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Nice. You've thought of everything!
:{{A|vo hzweq002 1 tighnari 03.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Oh, and Cyrus said he'll be in [[Aaru Village]], so he's also available if we need help.
:{{A|vo hzweq002 1 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Haha, amazing. Having people to watch our back is making Paimon a lot less nervous!
:{{DIcon}} Did you get a good night's sleep, Layla?
:{{A|vo hzweq002 1 layla 01.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Yeah, I did.
:{{A|vo hzweq002 1 layla 02.ogg}} '''Layla:''' After hearing about what happened, my advisor gave me some time off to rest, so my studies are on hold for now.
:{{A|vo hzweq002 1 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Then, does your advisor know you're back in the desert to investigate?
:{{A|vo hzweq002 1 layla 03.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Yes. But, I was only allowed to come after I mentioned the General Mahamatra would be there too.
:{{A|vo hzweq002 1 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hehe, quite the reputation you've got there, [[Cyno]]!
:{{A|vo hzweq002 1 cyno 01.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Hmm?
:{{A|vo hzweq002 1 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Uh, something wrong? You haven't said a word this whole time. Are you in a bad mood or something?
:{{A|vo hzweq002 1 cyno 02.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' No.
:{{A|vo hzweq002 1 cyno 03.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Being skilled with words also means being a good listener. I'm just reflecting on what you're sayi—
:{{A|vo hzweq002 1 tighnari 04.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Ah! [[Alhaitham]]! [[Kaveh]]! Ha, over here!
:{{A|vo hzweq002 1 cyno 04.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Darn it. I was just setting up a brilliant—
:{{A|vo hzweq002 1 sethos 03.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' Yeah, yeah, yeah. I'm sure you'll find another chance.
:{{A|vo hzweq002 1 sethos 04.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' The important thing is, our Scribe and our renowned architect are here at last.
:{{A|vo hzweq002 1 kaveh 01.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Haha, high praise...
:{{A|vo hzweq002 1 kaveh 02.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' But, wait, why am I renowned and not him? He's just as famous as Cyno, [[Dehya]], or [[Nilou]]...
:{{A|vo hzweq002 1 alhaitham 01.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' That just means your level of fame is even greater. How could a lowly Scribe hold a candle to you...?
:{{A|vo hzweq002 1 kaveh 03.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Lowly scribe? Please. All those strings you pulled to get those new books from the [[House of Daena]]... What do you call that?
:{{A|vo hzweq002 1 alhaitham 02.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' Borrowing. Anyone with an employee ID can do it.
:{{A|vo hzweq002 1 kaveh 04.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Uh huh, yeah. The House of Daena bends over backwards for just anyone, does it?
:{{A|vo hzweq002 1 alhaitham 03.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' Send a report to Lesser Lord Kusanali, then. Let her know someone at the [[Akademiya]] is abusing their position.
:{{A|vo hzweq002 1 kaveh 05.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Hey! I never said abusing—
:{{A|vo hzweq002 1 sethos 05.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' Haha, impressive verbal sparring, as always...
:'''Mehrak:''' Beep-boop! Beep-boop!
:{{A|vo hzweq002 1 sethos 06.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' Oh, hello to you too, Mehrak! Well, looks like your assistant is raring to go, Kaveh.
:{{A|vo hzweq002 1 sethos 07.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' So, I say we get this show on the road. No sense delaying the inevitable.
:{{DIcon}} True.
:{{DIcon}} Let me scout ahead.
:{{A|vo hzweq002 1 sethos 08.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' No need. We're in this together, remember?
:{{A|vo hzweq002 1 sethos 09.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' Djer! This is the entrance, yeah?
:{{A|vo hzweq002 1 djer 02.ogg}} '''Djer:''' Yes!
:{{A|vo hzweq002 1 sethos 10.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' Perfect! Then, if we're all set, let's get moving.
<!--act start banner-->

;(Talk to Djer, optional)
:{{A|Vo dialog hzweq002 djer 01.ogg}} '''Djer:''' I hope everything goes well in there. I've got your back from out here.

;(Use Nahida's All Schemes to Know on Djer, optional)
:{{A|vo hzweq002 3 djer 01.ogg}} '''Djer:''' (Guess this is where we waltz right in. No need to knock... knock... Ajile-knock... Hehehe...)

;(Interact with the signpost, optional)<!--{{DIcon}} Check-->
:'''Warning!:''' Danger: Quicksand — Keep Away!

;(Enter the [[Unknown Ruins]])
:{{A|vo hzweq002 4 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Pffft! Ugh, Paimon's mouth is full of sand... Ugh! So that's what falling into quicksand feels like...
:{{A|vo hzweq002 4 tighnari 01.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' If this was quicksand, we would have struggled to breathe. No... I think this was regular sand. And we didn't sink into it, we fell through it... into this place.
:{{A|vo hzweq002 4 cyno 01.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Agreed.
:{{A|vo hzweq002 4 sethos 01.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' Hehe, in other words, sounds like a "you" problem, Paimon.
:{{A|vo hzweq002 4 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Haha, very funny. No way Paimon's the only one...
:{{A|vo hzweq002 4 kaveh 01.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Pffft! Blech!
:{{A|vo hzweq002 4 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hah! See?
:{{A|vo hzweq002 4 alhaitham 01.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' Heh.
:{{A|vo hzweq002 4 kaveh 02.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' What? I'm the only one with sand in my shoes? Yeah, right...
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (This place... looks kind of familiar...)
:;(Traveler remembers the scene with [[Ashru]] during {{Quest|Dance of Death: Serpent and Scorpion}})
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (Well, looks like everyone made it here unscathed. Let's keep going.)

:{{A|vo hzweq002 31 thoth 06.ogg}} '''"Cat":''' I have forgotten what it was called... It must have had an official name, albeit in the old tongue. Even if I did remember, I would need to translate it into modern language.
:{{A|vo hzweq002 31 thoth 07.ogg}} '''"Cat":''' Ah, it's not important. Mehrak's a fine name — even better than the original, if you ask me. Who thought of it?
:{{A|vo hzweq002 31 thoth 08.ogg}} '''"Cat":''' And the remodeling... Quite well done, indeed! This "Mehrak" looks much happier in its current form.
:{{A|vo hzweq002 31 thoth 09.ogg}} '''"Cat":''' Oh, and the components should have model numbers written on them. You can look them up, if you're curious.
:{{A|vo hzweq002 31 layla 03.ogg}} '''Layla:''' (This cat talks... a lot.)
:{{A|vo hzweq002 31 tighnari 04.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' (Quite the one-sided conversation.)
:{{A|vo hzweq002 31 sethos 05.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' (Is this what the Ibis King was like?)
:{{A|vo hzweq002 31 cyno 09.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' (He seems quite eloquent. I wonder if he plays cards...)
:{{A|vo hzweq002 31 kaveh 09.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' (Hah! I knew Mehrak was a great name. Go me!)
:{{A|vo hzweq002 31 alhaitham 03.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' (Let's see... What page was I on again? Hm, should've brought a bookmark.)
:{{A|vo hzweq002 31 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' (That all went over Paimon's head...)
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (So, when the notes mentioned something being "off" with the Ibis King... It was because he's in the form of a cat.)
:{{DIcon}} Hello, Thoth.
:{{A|vo hzweq002 31 thoth 10.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' Hello indeed.
:{{A|vo hzweq002 31 thoth 11.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' For you to know my name... Yes, I was not mistaken. You are special among your companions.
:{{A|vo hzweq002 31 thoth 12.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' But, you are all guests. It is only proper to invite you in.
:{{A|vo hzweq002 31 thoth 13.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' Come then! This way.

;(Ride the elevator down)<!--{{DIcon|Gear}} Start Up-->
:{{A|vo hzweq002 32 thoth 01.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' Welcome to my humble abode.
:{{A|vo hzweq002 32 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, uh... Your house sure is... spacious, Lord Ibis King.
:{{A|vo hzweq002 32 thoth 02.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' Haha, I fear it's not quite what it used to be.
:{{A|vo hzweq002 32 thoth 03.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' In fact, it has long ceased to be my home at all. It belongs to the descendants of the cats I once raised.
:{{A|vo hzweq002 32 thoth 04.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' Such adorable creatures, aren't they? Take the one I'm "borrowing" here, for instance. A chubby fellow, with such lovely fur...
:{{A|vo hzweq002 32 thoth 05.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' Ahem! Anyway... Tradition dictates that a special guest such as yourself be presented with a gift.
:{{A|vo hzweq002 32 thoth 06.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' Alas, it's a first come, first served basis, you see. I fear, with the passage of time, none are left.
:{{A|vo hzweq002 32 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What!? So the treasure's gone already?
:{{A|vo hzweq002 32 thoth 07.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' Hah! "Treasure," you say? Hm, not an inaccurate description.
:{{DIcon}} Gifts and "treasure"...
:{{DIcon}} Are you talking in a literal sense?
:{{A|vo hzweq002 32 thoth 08.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' Yes... and no.
:{{A|vo hzweq002 32 thoth 09.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' I have the power to grant gifts inaccessible to the masses. The only requirement is answering a question... Not a bad deal, yes?
:{{A|vo hzweq002 32 thoth 10.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' Of course, my questions were given unto me by King Deshret, who in turn received them from the [[Nabu Malikata|Mistress of Flowers]]. There are three, and no more.
:{{A|vo hzweq002 32 thoth 11.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' What causes our rise and fall?
:{{A|vo hzweq002 32 thoth 12.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' What obliterates love and hate?
:{{A|vo hzweq002 32 thoth 13.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' What determines truth and falsehood?
:{{A|vo hzweq002 32 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' The more he talks, the less Paimon understands...
:{{A|vo hzweq002 32 alhaitham 01.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' I see... That must mean Goudarz and Makhaira managed to answer two of the three.
:{{A|vo hzweq002 32 thoth 14.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' Haha! Another who understands!
:{{A|vo hzweq002 32 kaveh 01.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Oh! So that's the event those two slabs are depicting!
:{{A|vo hzweq002 32 thoth 15.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' Ah, priests and their records... A singular obsession, and quite boring too...
:{{A|vo hzweq002 32 thoth 16.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' After being imprisoned within Aaru, I could, on occasion, take the form of a cat to converse with those around me, but I despised speaking to them.
:{{A|vo hzweq002 32 thoth 17.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' No conversational skills whatsoever!
:{{A|vo hzweq002 32 thoth 18.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' Now, humans like you, who stumble in here from time to time... You are much more interesting.
:{{A|vo hzweq002 32 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hold on, we're getting off-topic again...
:{{A|vo hzweq002 32 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' The three questions you just mentioned — what are they for, exactly?
:{{A|vo hzweq002 32 thoth 19.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' Ah, that is a story that begins with King Deshret...
:{{A|vo hzweq002 32 sethos 01.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' And we're in for another long one...
:{{A|vo hzweq002 32 thoth 20.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' Nostalgia for the past is common to us all, is it not?
:<gallery widths="350">
Headlong Into the Sands Quest Still 1.png
</gallery>
:{{A|vo hzweq002 32 thoth 21.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' And our king... He was such a proud, solemn man in those days...
:{{A|vo hzweq002 32 thoth 22.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' He watched us speak of the present and the future, of the wisdom we possessed or were about to obtain.
:{{A|vo hzweq002 32 thoth 23.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' We were his proud retainers, confident in our belief that, so long as each one of us used our abilities to the fullest, progress was inevitable.
:{{A|vo hzweq002 32 thoth 24.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' Yet, King Deshret's ambition was not destined to be allowed in a closed-off world such as this, so nothing went as planned.
:{{A|vo hzweq002 32 thoth 25.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' In fact, from the beginning, there were signs an outcome of this nature was inevitable. Because, although there were Seven Pillars, one was forever absent.
:{{A|vo hzweq002 32 thoth 26.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' Al-Ahmar would insist the [[Apep|Dendro Dragon Sovereign]] was one of us, but the dragon herself rejected that idea.
<!--quest still ends-->
:{{A|vo hzweq002 32 cyno 01.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Huh, like a card you can never seem to draw from your deck.
:{{A|vo hzweq002 32 kaveh 02.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' More like a card that was never in the deck to begin with.
:{{A|vo hzweq002 32 thoth 27.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' Alas, that's just who Al-Ahmar was. There was nothing we could do about that.
:{{A|vo hzweq002 32 thoth 28.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' And I always preferred chess to cards.
:{{A|vo hzweq002 32 thoth 29.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' In the end, life grew unbearable for our king. But, of course, those who remain must continue to live on.
:{{A|vo hzweq002 32 thoth 30.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' But, subjects like us were less fortunate. After all, the fate of a retainer is decided by the king, including the chance to walk away.
:{{A|vo hzweq002 32 thoth 31.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' So it was, then, that King Deshret had Croco, Goatie, and I locked up within Aaru, where we remain to this day.
:{{A|vo hzweq002 32 sethos 02.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' Croco...
:{{A|vo hzweq002 32 tighnari 01.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Uhhh... Goatie...?
:{{A|vo hzweq002 32 thoth 32.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' Ah, of course. You're more familiar with their full names — Sobek, the Crocodile King and Heryshaf, the Goat King.
:<gallery widths="350">
Headlong Into the Sands Quest Still 2.png
</gallery>
:{{A|vo hzweq002 32 thoth 33.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' Hehehe, and let me tell you... When it comes to chess, Heryshaf was a habitual back-seat strategist, always spewing nonsense from the sidelines. While Sobek was all too quick to take his terrible advice, to the point where I was the one who got accused of cheating.
:{{A|vo hzweq002 32 thoth 34.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' Chess is an exercise in patience, and that man couldn't sit still to save his life. He could never excel at that game.
:{{A|vo hzweq002 32 thoth 35.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' In fact, neither of them were good at chess. Even so, we played together often. And, since I was always the winner, we got along quite well.
<!--quest still ends-->
:{{A|vo hzweq002 32 thoth 36.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' ...Hm? What are you laughing at? Were we not good friends?
:{{A|vo hzweq002 32 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Uh... No one's laughing... Paimon would never!
:{{A|vo hzweq002 32 thoth 37.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' No, not you. It's Goatie. He's laughing for no reason again. Can you not hear him?
:{{A|vo hzweq002 32 thoth 38.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' Ah, right. Of course you can't. The two of them are inside Aaru, as am I, so only I can hear them...
:{{A|vo hzweq002 32 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What is even going on here...
:{{A|vo hzweq002 32 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Has he, like, started to lose it after being trapped for so long?
:{{A|vo hzweq002 32 cyno 02.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' That does happen to prisoners serving life sentences.
:{{A|vo hzweq002 32 sethos 03.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' Speaking of which, how's [[Azar]] doing these days?
:{{A|vo hzweq002 32 tighnari 02.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' I doubt he's "doing" much of anything.
:{{A|vo hzweq002 32 sethos 04.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' Just what I wanted to hear.
:{{A|vo hzweq002 32 thoth 39.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' What is the meaning of this? You doubt my words? Hmph, I have half a mind to not talk at all!
:{{A|vo hzweq002 32 kaveh 03.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Oh, no. They're not questioning you, Lord Ibis King, just discussing other things. Please, continue.
:{{A|vo hzweq002 32 thoth 40.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' Hmm. In that case... Where were we?
:{{A|vo hzweq002 32 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Uh, getting to the part about the three questions, hopefully...?
:{{A|vo hzweq002 32 thoth 41.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' Ah, yes! We're almost there.
:<gallery widths="350">
Headlong Into the Sands Quest Still 3a.png
</gallery>
:{{A|vo hzweq002 32 thoth 42.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' Before I entered Aaru, King Deshret said I could be released from my eternal seal, if I chose humans who could provide the correct answers to those three questions.
:{{A|vo hzweq002 32 thoth 43.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' The first person who caught my eye was Goudarz.
:<gallery widths="350">
Headlong Into the Sands Quest Still 3b.png
</gallery>
:{{A|vo hzweq002 32 thoth 44.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' I asked him, "what causes our rise and fall?" He answered, "conspiracy and betrayal, for it renders the righteous and wise unable to succeed, and thus nations fall."
:<gallery widths="350">
Headlong Into the Sands Quest Still 3c.png
</gallery>
:{{A|vo hzweq002 32 thoth 45.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' I found his answer quite interesting, so I bestowed upon him the power to "deceive."
:{{A|vo hzweq002 32 thoth 46.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' The second human I chose was Makhaira.
:<gallery widths="350">
Headlong Into the Sands Quest Still 3d.png
</gallery>
:{{A|vo hzweq002 32 thoth 47.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' I asked her, "what obliterates love and hate?" She said unto me, "I have nothing left to lose. Vengeance alone can quench both love and hate."
:<gallery widths="350">
Headlong Into the Sands Quest Still 3e.png
</gallery>
:{{A|vo hzweq002 32 thoth 48.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' I found this to be another fascinating response, so I granted her the power to "be loved."
<!--quest still ends-->
:{{A|vo hzweq002 32 kaveh 04.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' But both of them ended up...
:{{A|vo hzweq002 32 thoth 49.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' Hehe... Now then, young one, riddle me this. Did their answers point to this fate, or was it the power I bestowed upon them that determined their end?
:{{A|vo hzweq002 32 kaveh 05.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' I'm just an observer who doesn't understand their circumstances, so I can't answer.
:{{A|vo hzweq002 32 thoth 50.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' A clever reply.
:{{A|vo hzweq002 32 thoth 51.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' I do not wish to comment, either. It is all in the past at this point.
:<gallery widths="350">
Headlong Into the Sands Quest Still 3e.png
</gallery>
:{{A|vo hzweq002 32 thoth 52.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' My only wish was for their answers to be acknowledged by King Deshret's rules, and bring me one step closer to freedom.
:<gallery widths="350">
Headlong Into the Sands Quest Still 3f.png
</gallery>
:{{A|vo hzweq002 32 thoth 53.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' As for the final person... Her fate remains to be seen. So, I will not reveal her name.
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (That must've been Nefer, then...)
:{{A|vo hzweq002 32 thoth 54.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' I asked her, "what determines truth and falsehood?" and found her answer quite compelling, so I bestowed upon her a gift to match.
:{{A|vo hzweq002 32 thoth 55.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' As you can see, however, I have not been freed, so it's clear... the answer she gave at that time was wrong.
:{{A|vo hzweq002 32 thoth 56.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' But, alas. Three people were chosen, and three questions were asked, so now all I can do is wait.
:{{A|vo hzweq002 32 thoth 57.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' Wait until her wisdom is in line with the rules set forth by my King... until she has found the true answer to that question.
<!--quest still ends-->
:{{A|vo hzweq002 32 alhaitham 02.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' No wonder there was no third stone slab, then.
:{{A|vo hzweq002 32 alhaitham 03.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' Or perhaps, you're just not ready to include her in the story, though that might be a generous interpretation.
:{{A|vo hzweq002 32 thoth 58.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' Well, it's not merely because her story remains unfinished.
:{{A|vo hzweq002 32 thoth 59.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' As the remaining priests of this place left or passed on, there were none left to record the events that followed.
:{{A|vo hzweq002 32 thoth 60.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' Besides, stone slabs are few and far between in the [[Great Red Sand]]s. In the sprawling desert, very few things, or people, even manage to leave a trace.
:{{A|vo hzweq002 32 thoth 61.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' But, sometimes, I can't help but wonder...
:{{A|vo hzweq002 32 thoth 62.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' If that young man from several centuries ago had been willing to answer my question, would I have left Aaru by now?
:{{A|vo hzweq002 32 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wait, so there was someone else?
:{{A|vo hzweq002 32 thoth 63.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' Of course. It has been thousands of years, after all. All sorts of people have stumbled upon this place, but I only chose the "special" ones.
:{{A|vo hzweq002 32 thoth 64.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' That young man had such a singular intelligence, though his companion, by contrast, was rather average.
:{{DIcon}} Wait. Could that have been...
:{{A|vo hzweq002 32 layla 01.ogg}} '''Layla:''' The author of those notes we found? The student named Zandik?
:{{A|vo hzweq002 32 thoth 65.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' Ah... Yes, I think that was his name.
:<gallery widths="350">
Headlong Into the Sands Quest Still 4.png
</gallery>
:{{A|vo hzweq002 32 thoth 66.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' In truth, I was unsure whether I should grant him my third remaining gift.
:{{A|vo hzweq002 32 thoth 67.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' He was, of course, exceedingly clever, but he was also mistrustful and narcissistic in equal measure, and there did not seem to be a line he was unwilling to cross.
:{{A|vo hzweq002 32 thoth 68.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' Too much power could be dangerous in the hands of someone like him, so I found myself rather relieved when he declined my gift.
<!--quest still ends-->
:{{A|vo hzweq002 32 layla 02.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Oh, he turned you down? Did he give a reason?
:{{A|vo hzweq002 32 thoth 69.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' Yes.
:{{A|vo hzweq002 32 thoth 70.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' He said he "didn't need it."
:<gallery widths="350">
Headlong Into the Sands Quest Still 5.png
</gallery>
:{{A|vo hzweq002 32 thoth 71.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' I still remember the look in his eyes... Nothing stood out, per se, and still... I could sense contempt and disdain radiating from his gaze.
:{{A|vo hzweq002 32 thoth 72.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' I could not give an exact reason, but on instinct, I just knew... It would not end well to get close to a man like that.
:{{A|vo hzweq002 32 thoth 73.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' So, I tricked him.
:{{A|vo hzweq002 32 thoth 74.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' Stick close to your companion, I said. "Only the descendants of [[Tulaytullah]] can come and go as they please. Leave him behind, and there is no escape for you."
<!--quest still ends-->
:{{A|vo hzweq002 32 layla 03.ogg}} '''Layla:''' So, does that mean his companion wasn't a descendant of Tulaytullah?
:{{A|vo hzweq002 32 thoth 75.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' Oh no, that part was true. The lie was in the other half. Anyone can enter or exit this place — there are no restrictions.
:{{A|vo hzweq002 32 thoth 76.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' I saw that his companion was exhausted, and was concerned Zandik might leave him behind.. Or worse, that some other "accident" might befall him... So I made up an excuse to prevent Zandik from going a step too far.
:{{A|vo hzweq002 32 thoth 77.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' Oh, and speaking of, Zandik's companion had the same blue hair and pointed ears as you.
:{{A|vo hzweq002 32 layla 04.ogg}} '''Layla:''' !
:{{A|vo hzweq002 32 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wait, does that mean... Layla's also a descendant of Tulaytullah?
:{{A|vo hzweq002 32 thoth 78.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' Indeed.
:{{A|vo hzweq002 32 thoth 79.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' When Hermanubis founded that city, he took in many who had nowhere else to go. Today, their progeny are scattered to the four winds, and indeed, are far more numerous than I could have imagined.
:{{A|vo hzweq002 32 layla 05.ogg}} '''Layla:''' So, the person you protected could have been my ancestor...
:{{A|vo hzweq002 32 thoth 80.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' Yes, yes. You're very welcome for that.
:{{A|vo hzweq002 32 layla 06.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Could I... ask another question, Lord Ibis King?
:{{A|vo hzweq002 32 thoth 81.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' Of course. I have nothing but time, I'm afraid.
:{{A|vo hzweq002 32 layla 07.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Did you also save me and a man named Djer?
:{{A|vo hzweq002 32 thoth 82.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' I did.
:{{A|vo hzweq002 32 thoth 83.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' You two were quite unlucky, bumping into a device King Deshret once used to measure human brain power. That contact caused more knowledge than you could handle to flood into your minds.
:{{A|vo hzweq002 32 thoth 84.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' So, I replaced that knowledge with simpler, repetitive information.
:{{A|vo hzweq002 32 thoth 85.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' Of course, the side-effect being the same thought repeating over and over again in your mind. But, that should resolve itself in time.
:{{A|vo hzweq002 32 layla 08.ogg}} '''Layla:''' How many moons are there in the sky?
:{{A|vo hzweq002 32 thoth 86.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' Yes, that was the phrase I used in your head. I forgot the other one, though I believe it had something to do with food...
:{{A|vo hzweq002 32 thoth 87.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' Both were spur of the moment decisions, so no need to dwell on the meaning too much, hehe...
:{{A|vo hzweq002 32 layla 09.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Oh, I see... Thank you, Lord Ibis King.
:{{A|vo hzweq002 32 thoth 88.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' As I said, young one. You are most welcome.
:{{A|vo hzweq002 32 thoth 89.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' If you're inclined to return the favor, perhaps you could turn off that device so no one else can trigger it.
:{{A|vo hzweq002 32 thoth 90.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' There's only so much a cat's paw can do, so I'm afraid this is something I must leave to you... or Mehrak, I suppose.
:{{DIcon}} Don't worry. That device can no longer be activated.
:{{A|vo hzweq002 32 thoth 91.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' Oh, splendid! Another one bites the dust!
:{{A|vo hzweq002 32 thoth 92.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' Such is the fate of things here. Day by day, little by little, the remnants of ages past fade into obscurity.
:{{A|vo hzweq002 32 thoth 93.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' For that reason, the gifts of bygone eras, be they tied to your blood or technological in nature... are not to be revered. They are tools, nothing more.
:{{A|vo hzweq002 32 thoth 94.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' ...Disrespectful? Hmph, I simply make the most of what I have. Besides, our King has been gone all these years. What good does it do to revere him now?
:{{A|vo hzweq002 32 paimon 12.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, are you talking to the Goat King again?
:{{A|vo hzweq002 32 thoth 95.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' No, no. Croco this time.
:{{A|vo hzweq002 32 thoth 96.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' He's pestering me for another game of chess. Says he wants to even the score.
:{{A|vo hzweq002 32 thoth 97.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' Wishful thinking, if you ask me. If we counted one push-up for every loss, he'd owe me three hundred thousand by now.
:{{A|vo hzweq002 32 thoth 98.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' Of course, that's just a rough estimate. I've never kept count.
:{{A|vo hzweq002 32 alhaitham 04.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' It appears that's something you like... being someone unable to be defeated.
:{{A|vo hzweq002 32 thoth 99.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' Hm, I suppose so...
:{{A|vo hzweq002 32 thoth 100.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' Alright, then! Time for me to extend my winning streak, and for you all to head home.
:{{DIcon}} Best of luck to you.
:{{A|vo hzweq002 32 thoth 101.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' Hehe...
:{{A|vo hzweq002 32 thoth 102.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' In truth, deep down, I know even the answers to those three questions will not change my fate.
:{{A|vo hzweq002 32 thoth 103.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' But that is for me to reckon with. Go on now!

;(Leave the domain)
:{{A|vo hzweq002 33 spantamadcyrus 01.ogg}} '''Cyrus:''' Excuse me, do you even know what time it is? I've harvested three crops of tomatoes while you've been gone!
:{{A|vo hzweq002 33 cyno 01.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' You're exaggerating, Professor.
:{{A|vo hzweq002 33 spantamadcyrus 02.ogg}} '''Cyrus:''' I'm making a point! There's a difference!
:{{A|vo hzweq002 33 tighnari 01.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Sincerest apologies for keeping you waiting, Professor Cyrus.
:{{DIcon}} Our mistake. Please accept our apology.
:{{A|vo hzweq002 33 spantamadcyrus 03.ogg}} '''Cyrus:''' See? That's what I call manners. Now, are any of you hurt?
:{{A|vo hzweq002 33 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Nope! It went way smoother than we expected, actually.
:{{A|vo hzweq002 33 spantamadcyrus 04.ogg}} '''Cyrus:''' I presume the investigation is complete, then? Come, come, tell me all about it.
:{{Black Screen|You tell Cyrus what happened...}}
:{{A|vo hzweq002 33 spantamadcyrus 05.ogg}} '''Cyrus:''' Oh my, did you luck out.
:{{A|vo hzweq002 33 spantamadcyrus 06.ogg}} '''Cyrus:''' If you've read the work from the [[Vahumana]] Darshan, you would know that the Ibis King has... Well, let's call it a mixed record.
:{{A|vo hzweq002 33 spantamadcyrus 07.ogg}} '''Cyrus:''' Perhaps he's softened up a bit in his old age, and that's why he chose to help you.
:{{A|vo hzweq002 33 alhaitham 01.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' Or... Perhaps he just didn't have a good enough reason not to help us.
:'''Mehrak:''' Beep-boop!
:{{A|vo hzweq002 33 alhaitham 02.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' See? Mehrak agrees.
:{{A|vo hzweq002 33 kaveh 01.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' How do you even know that's what Mehrak meant? That could have just been a happy noise.
:{{A|vo hzweq002 33 sethos 01.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' In any case, there's a lot to be happy about! We figured out what happened to Layla and Djer, and there were some unexpected takeaways, too!
:{{A|vo hzweq002 33 layla 01.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Yeah, I never expected to learn about my ancestry...
:{{A|vo hzweq002 33 layla 02.ogg}} '''Layla:''' I've always thought of myself as just an ordinary student. I never would have even considered something like that could be true...
:{{A|vo hzweq002 33 tighnari 02.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Come to think of it, our ancestors might even have been friends at some point.
:{{A|vo hzweq002 33 layla 03.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Huh, you're right!
:{{A|vo hzweq002 33 layla 04.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Maybe I should take a trip back home to see if I can find any records about that...
:{{A|vo hzweq002 33 tighnari 03.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Oh, I was just throwing that out there, haha. I wouldn't want you to go to the trouble...
:{{A|vo hzweq002 33 layla 05.ogg}} '''Layla:''' It's fine. My advisor gave me a break, and I still have a few days left, so...
:{{A|vo hzweq002 33 layla 06.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Oh, wait! My study topic! I haven't made any progress at all! No, no. I need to focus on that instead...
:{{DIcon}} One thing at a time, Layla.
:{{A|vo hzweq002 33 layla 07.ogg}} '''Layla:''' R—Right...
:{{A|vo hzweq002 33 cyno 02.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Couldn't you help her, Professor?
:{{A|vo hzweq002 33 layla 08.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Eh? N—No, no. I could never—
:{{A|vo hzweq002 33 spantamadcyrus 08.ogg}} '''Cyrus:''' Me, you say? I'm from the [[Spantamad]] Darshan, and I don't think that [[Naphis]] or [[Zaha Hadi]] research the stars.
:{{A|vo hzweq002 33 spantamadcyrus 09.ogg}} '''Cyrus:''' All I have to offer are my home-grown tomatoes...
:{{A|vo hzweq002 33 spantamadcyrus 10.ogg}} '''Cyrus:''' Although, I suppose it's not impossible. I can ask a few old friends to recommend some interesting topics.
:{{A|vo hzweq002 33 layla 09.ogg}} '''Layla:''' You really don't have to! It sounds like a lot of work...
:{{A|vo hzweq002 33 spantamadcyrus 11.ogg}} '''Cyrus:''' Hardly! A few passing questions while we water the plants... It's no trouble at all!
:{{A|vo hzweq002 33 layla 10.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Thank you so much!
:{{A|vo hzweq002 33 spantamadcyrus 12.ogg}} '''Cyrus:''' Of course! Now, it's getting late, and you all must be tired. Let's wrap things up here.
:{{A|vo hzweq002 33 spantamadcyrus 13.ogg}} '''Cyrus:''' Some say desert nights are the sun taking mercy on us after the heat of the day, so let's leave while she still feels merciful.
{{Dialogue End}}

==Steps==

# Accompany [[Barbara]] while she heals [[Uwe]]

==Dialogue==
{{Quest Description|To heal Uwe, you accompany Barbara to search the [[Whispering Woods]] for [[Small Lamp Grass]].}}
===Healing Is My Job===
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Talk to Uwe again)
:{{A|vo bblcop001 1900801 uwe 20.ogg}} '''Uwe:''' Y—You got a problem? Stop looking at me like that...

;(While looking for Small Lamp Grass)
:{{A|vo bblcop001 1900801 barbara 01.ogg}} '''Barbara:''' Don't look so serious, I know what you're thinking.
:{{A|vo bblcop001 1900801 barbara 02.ogg}} '''Barbara:''' I've heard a lot about the criminal methods of the Treasure Hoarders around Mondstadt.
:{{A|vo bblcop001 1900801 barbara 03.ogg}} '''Barbara:''' Usually, if I come across a person like this, I'd simply ask them to seek help from somebody at the Church.
:{{A|vo bblcop001 1900801 barbara 04.ogg}} '''Barbara:''' But this fellow is in serious condition, he needs urgent healing...
:{{A|vo bblcop001 1900801 barbara 05.ogg}} '''Barbara:''' After all, I've got an Honorary Knight at my side to protect me, right?
:{{A|vo bblcop001 1900801 barbara 06.ogg}} '''Barbara:''' Hmm, let's gather the Small Lamp Grass and head back so we can heal him.

;(Talk to Uwe after picking up 3 Fresh Small Lamp Grass)
:{{A|vo bblcop001 1900801 uwe 01.ogg}} '''Uwe:''' Sister Deaconess... you're back!
:{{A|vo bblcop001 1900801 barbara 07.ogg}} '''Barbara:''' This should do the trick, hold on a moment...
:{{DIcon}} No sudden moves.
:{{DIcon}} I'm watching you.
:{{A|vo bblcop001 1900801 uwe 02.ogg}} '''Uwe:''' You adventurers... really are jumpy these days.
:{{Black Screen|''Barbara starts to heal Uwe...''}}
:{{A|vo bblcop001 1900801 barbara 08.ogg}} '''Barbara:''' Alright, that should do it. But just to be safe, you should probably pay a visit to the Church.
:{{A|vo bblcop001 1900801 uwe 03.ogg}} '''Uwe:''' Haha... no need. I should be able to recover by myself.
:{{A|vo bblcop001 1900801 uwe 04.ogg}} '''Uwe:''' Uh... S—Sister Deaconess...
:{{A|vo bblcop001 1900801 uwe 05.ogg}} '''Uwe:''' Why... weren't you suspicious of me? Like the adventurer here?
:{{A|vo bblcop001 1900801 uwe 06.ogg}} '''Uwe:''' Surely you've heard about the Treasure Hoarders and their methods... haha...
:{{A|vo bblcop001 1900801 uwe 07.ogg}} '''Uwe:''' Feigning injury by the roadside, begging for healing to get close to travelers, then striking at the opportune moment... Y'know, stuff like that...
:{{A|vo bblcop001 1900801 uwe 08.ogg}} '''Uwe:''' And... that's just one of their methods. Weren't you... worried that I might've been looking to harm you?
:{{A|vo bblcop001 1900801 barbara 09.ogg}} '''Barbara:''' Um... It crossed my mind.
:{{A|vo bblcop001 1900801 uwe 09.ogg}} '''Uwe:''' And yet... Why did you still help me?
:{{A|vo bblcop001 1900801 barbara 10.ogg}} '''Barbara:''' The fact was, you needed healing, right?
:{{A|vo bblcop001 1900801 barbara 11.ogg}} '''Barbara:''' And you hadn't done anything wrong. You just asked me for help.
:{{A|vo bblcop001 1900801 barbara 12.ogg}} '''Barbara:''' Whatever your true identity, in my eyes, you were merely a person in need of healing.
:{{A|vo bblcop001 1900801 uwe 10.ogg}} '''Uwe:''' Sister Deaconess...
:{{A|vo bblcop001 1900801 uwe 11.ogg}} '''Uwe:''' The truth is... I am a Treasure Hoarder. My plan was to feign injury in order to take advantage of the situation...
:{{A|vo bblcop001 1900801 uwe 12.ogg}} '''Uwe:''' But I ran into a group of monsters — I barely made it out. Then I realized I actually had to seek help from someone, anyone...
:{{A|vo bblcop001 1900801 uwe 13.ogg}} '''Uwe:''' But travelers all kept their distance, none of them believed me... Until you showed up.
:{{A|vo bblcop001 1900801 uwe 14.ogg}} '''Uwe:''' I—I can't thank you enough for healing me. I feel strong enough to carry on now... I won't trouble you anymore.
:{{A|vo bblcop001 1900801 barbara 13.ogg}} '''Barbara:''' Oh... Well, the best thing would be for you to come back to Mondstadt with us. The Church can help with your treatment, you're not fully healed yet...
:{{A|vo bblcop001 1900801 uwe 15.ogg}} '''Uwe:''' Please! I've taken up enough of your time.
:{{A|vo bblcop001 1900801 uwe 16.ogg}} '''Uwe:''' Oh, these are for you. I'm afraid I have nothing of value to give, but... I picked these Sweet Flowers from nearby.
:{{A|vo bblcop001 1900801 uwe 17.ogg}} '''Uwe:''' Take them, as thanks for healing me. I will remember your kindness.
:{{A|vo bblcop001 1900801 uwe 18.ogg}} '''Uwe:''' In the future, if you have any trouble with... Treasure Hoarders... just mention my name, Uwe. I guarantee, they won't dare touch the hem of your jacket!
:{{A|vo bblcop001 1900801 uwe 19.ogg}} '''Uwe:''' I must go. Farewell.
:{{A|vo bblcop001 1900801 barbara 14.ogg}} '''Barbara:''' Hehe, what a strange character... but I hope his wounds will be okay.
:{{A|vo bblcop001 1900801 barbara 15.ogg}} '''Barbara:''' At least we got a hold of some Sweet Flowers! We were running out of time for me to whip you up some Chilibrew.
:{{A|vo bblcop001 1900801 barbara 16.ogg}} '''Barbara:''' Wow... this is a great batch! That's everything we need. It's getting late, let's get back to Mondstadt.

;(Arriving at Mondstadt)
:{{A|vo bblcop001 1900802 barbara 01.ogg}} '''Barbara:''' Well, we're back. Whew... that was pretty tiring.
:{{DIcon}} Why did you choose to heal that guy even though you knew he was suspicious?
:{{A|vo bblcop001 1900802 barbara 02.ogg}} '''Barbara:''' I'm a deaconess, healing the wounded is something I must do.
:{{A|vo bblcop001 1900802 barbara 03.ogg}} '''Barbara:''' Besides... I have a [[Vision]]. Even if he did try anything, I'd have been able to handle it.
:{{A|vo bblcop001 1900802 barbara 04.ogg}} '''Barbara:''' Not to mention, I had the Honorary Knight with me. If there'd been any danger... you would definitely have protected me, right?
:{{DIcon}} And if I hadn't been there...?
:{{DIcon}} What if you'd been on your own?
:{{A|vo bblcop001 1900802 barbara 05.ogg}} '''Barbara:''' If I was alone... Mm...
:{{A|vo bblcop001 1900802 barbara 06.ogg}} '''Barbara:''' Well, for a Vision-bearer, I'm more adept at healing. If there were too many enemies, I guess I would've been defeated after a while...
:{{A|vo bblcop001 1900802 barbara 07.ogg}} '''Barbara:''' However, because I would've been alone... I wouldn't have risked an ambush by stopping to heal him myself. I would've just left some herbs with him instead.
:{{A|vo bblcop001 1900802 barbara 08.ogg}} '''Barbara:''' I'm good at remembering self-defense tactics like that.
:{{A|vo bblcop001 1900802 barbara 09.ogg}} '''Barbara:''' After all, as Sister [[Victoria]] always says... don't go around healing people in the wild...
:{{A|vo bblcop001 1900802 barbara 10.ogg}} '''Barbara:''' Then again... What's the point of having a Vision if I can't stretch the rules once in a while? Hehe...
:{{A|vo bblcop001 1900802 barbara 11.ogg}} '''Barbara:''' Oh — the Chilibrew! It shouldn't take long to make... Why don't you wait for me in the garden next to the Adventurers' Guild?
:{{A|vo bblcop001 1900802 barbara 12.ogg}} '''Barbara:''' I'll bring it straight over when it's ready.
:;(Continue to [[Knight and Deaconess, Ready for Battle!#Home-Made Chilibrew|Home-Made Chilibrew]])
{{Dialogue End}}
