==Dialogue==
{{Quest Description|You visit Cheven at the agreed-upon time. At her invitation, you decide to see the former master artisan Tlazolli.}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Talk to Cheven)
:{{A|vo xnnlq002 1 cheven 01.ogg}} '''Cheven:''' Oh, you're early! Looking forward to your gift?
:{{DIcon}} We're just happy to visit Tlazolli and Nechca.
::{{A|vo xnnlq002 1 paimon 01a 1.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' That's right! [[Nechca]]'s been so sick, and [[Tlazolli]] had to give up what she loves...
::{{A|vo xnnlq002 1 paimon 01a 2.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Things might be getting better,<ref group="Note">[Actual voice-over: "Things might get better"]</ref> but they could probably still use some cheering up.
:{{DIcon}} Well, I am curious...
::{{A|vo xnnlq002 1 paimon 01b 1.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Paimon too... But we're also here to see how Nechca's doing.
::{{A|vo xnnlq002 1 paimon 01b 2.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' It can't be easy to recover from such a serious illness. And then there's Tlazolli...
::{{A|vo xnnlq002 1 paimon 01b 3.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' She had to give up what she loves... We just want to cheer them up!
:{{A|vo xnnlq002 1 cheven 02.ogg}} '''Cheven:''' Haha, I've already asked someone to swing by and let Tlazolli know we're coming. She's probably made all the necessary preparations.
:{{A|vo xnnlq002 1 cheven 03.ogg}} '''Cheven:''' Let's go, then. Do you mind watching the store, Imix? I'll be right back.

;(Talk to Imix, optional)
:{{A|vo dialog xnnlq002 imix 01.ogg}} '''Imix:''' Again? *sigh* Alright. You two take care of Master Cheven, okay? Don't let her go anywhere dangerous.
{{Dialogue End}}
{{Quest Description|update|You visit Cheven at the agreed-upon time. At her invitation, you decide to see the former master artisan Tlazolli. However, when you arrive at her dwelling, nobody answers the door...}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Talk to Iengu at the top of the mountain while indwelling a Saurian, optional) 
:{{A|vo dialog xnnlq002 iengu 01.ogg}} '''Iengu:''' Hungry... Digging... Tired...

;(Approach the house)
:{{A|vo xnnlq002 2 cheven 01.ogg}} '''Cheven:''' Here we are. Nice house, right? Gimme a sec, I'll go knock.
:{{A|vo xnnlq002 2 cheven 02.ogg}} '''Cheven:''' Tlazolli, open up! They're here!
:{{A|vo xnnlq002 2 cheven 03.ogg}} '''Cheven:''' ...Tlazolli? Are you home? Open the door!
:{{A|vo xnnlq002 2 cheven 04.ogg}} '''Cheven:''' That's strange... Huh, the door's locked, but she shouldn't be out at this time of day.
:{{A|vo xnnlq002 2 cheven 05.ogg}} '''Cheven:''' Hey, Nechca? Nechca? It's me, Cheven. Open up, please.
:{{DIcon}} (No response...)
:{{DIcon}} Need me to break down the door?
::{{A|vo xnnlq002 2 paimon 01b 1.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What if something happened to the two of them? What if Nechca got worse again...
::{{A|vo xnnlq002 2 cheven 06b 1.ogg}} '''Cheven:''' Let's not overthink things. They were doing just fine the last time I was here. Nechca was sleeping soundly in her room.
:{{A|vo xnnlq002 2 cheven 07.ogg}} '''Cheven:''' Still, I told Tlazolli we were coming... Maybe she had to take Nechca out to get some medicine?
:{{A|vo xnnlq002 2 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hey, what's that over there? Looks like a Tepetlisaur nest.
:{{A|vo xnnlq002 2 cheven 08.ogg}} '''Cheven:''' That's right. Tlazolli has a Tepetlisaur companion. If I remember right, its name is... Iengu?
:{{A|vo xnnlq002 2 cheven 09.ogg}} '''Cheven:''' When she was still in the forging business, she'd often have Iengu help with some digging work.
:{{A|vo xnnlq002 2 cheven 10.ogg}} '''Cheven:''' But since Nechca fell ill, she hasn't let it dig much recently...
:{{A|vo xnnlq002 2 cheven 11.ogg}} '''Cheven:''' Wait a minute. What the...? This place is a mess! Iengu's nowhere to be seen, either.
:{{A|vo xnnlq002 2 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Whoa, look at all these broken boxes! Something terrible must have happened...
:{{DIcon}} Let's take a closer look.
:{{DIcon}} You stay here, Cheven.
::{{A|vo xnnlq002 2 cheven 12b 1.ogg}} '''Cheven:''' Oh... Alright! I'll just... find a place to hide for now!
::{{A|vo xnnlq002 2 cheven 12b 2.ogg}} '''Cheven:''' How is it that every single time Imix tells me not to go someplace dangerous, I end up running into danger? It's like her words have some sort of power over me... Maybe it's the Wayob's doing.

;(Talk to Cheven, optional)
:{{A|vo dialog xnnlq002 cheven 01.ogg}} '''Cheven:''' How is it that every single time Imix tells me not to go someplace dangerous, I end up running into danger? It's like her words have some sort of power over me... Maybe it's the Wayob's doing.

;(Approach the cliff)
:{{A|vo xnnlq002 3 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' The tracks end at this cliff... Could the Tepetlisaur have climbed up the mountain?
:{{A|vo xnnlq002 3 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Let's head up there and see.

;(Reach the top of the mountain)
:{{A|vo xnnlq002 4 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh, there really is a Tepetlisaur up here. Might not be Tlazolli's companion, though...
:{{DIcon}} At least it doesn't seem to be in any danger.
:{{DIcon}} Seems like it got up there on its own...?
:{{A|vo xnnlq002 4 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh... Paimon still doesn't see any sign of Tlazolli...
:{{Color|menu|You hear Cheven's shouts from the foot of the mountain...}}
:{{A|vo xnnlq002 4 cheven 01.ogg}} '''Cheven:''' Hey, {{Traveler}}! Paimon!
:{{A|vo xnnlq002 4 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' That's Cheven's voice!
:{{DIcon}} Looks like there's someone next to her.
:{{A|vo xnnlq002 4 cheven 02.ogg}} '''Cheven:''' Come down, quick! Tlazolli's here!
:{{A|vo xnnlq002 4 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh? We just got up here, and Tlazolli's back already? What a coincidence...
:{{DIcon}} Either way, let's get down there.
:{{DIcon}} Yeah, quite a coincidence...
::{{A|vo xnnlq002 4 paimon 05b 1.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Well, guess this means we should head back down.
:{{A|vo xnnlq002 4 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh? Why's the Tepetlisaur coming along — Whoa, hey, hey, don't run, you'll hit us!
:{{Black Screen|You descend the mountain with the Tepetlisaur...}}
:{{A|vo xnnlq002 4 tlazolli 01.ogg}} '''Tlazolli:''' Iengu, come here... Are you being naughty again?
:{{A|vo xnnlq002 4 iengu 01.ogg}} '''Iengu:''' Roar...
:{{A|vo xnnlq002 4 tlazolli 02.ogg}} '''Tlazolli:''' That's a good Saurian. You must be hungry. Sorry... I'll whip up something for you later.
:{{A|vo xnnlq002 4 tlazolli 03.ogg}} '''Tlazolli:''' Alright, run along and play now. I'll come along in a sec.
:{{A|vo xnnlq002 4 iengu 02.ogg}} '''Iengu:''' Roar!
:{{A|vo xnnlq002 4 tlazolli 04.ogg}} '''Tlazolli:''' Sorry, you two. I was waiting for you at home when Nechca... Well, she snuck out and ran off by herself.
:{{A|vo xnnlq002 4 tlazolli 05.ogg}} '''Tlazolli:''' She said she just wanted to pick some flowers for our guests.
:{{A|vo xnnlq002 4 tlazolli 06.ogg}} '''Tlazolli:''' But, she ended up getting lost along the way... Luckily, I managed to find her before long.
:{{DIcon}} Is she alright?
:{{A|vo xnnlq002 4 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yeah, Cheven told us she was just starting to get better...
:{{A|vo xnnlq002 4 tlazolli 07.ogg}} '''Tlazolli:''' She's still very weak. The shock and the cold wind certainly didn't help, so she ended up with a slight fever. I gave her some medicine, and now she's in bed.
:{{A|vo xnnlq002 4 tlazolli 08.ogg}} '''Tlazolli:''' But, it's nothing a good night's rest can't fix.
:{{A|vo xnnlq002 4 tlazolli 09.ogg}} '''Tlazolli:''' That said, she won't be able to meet you today. I'm sorry you came all this way for nothing.
:{{A|vo xnnlq002 4 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Don't worry about it! We know she's still recovering. Cheven told us how serious her illness was.
:{{A|vo xnnlq002 4 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Her health definitely comes first! We were just dropping by to check on her.
:{{DIcon}} Is she all better now?
::{{A|vo xnnlq002 4 tlazolli 10a 1.ogg}} '''Tlazolli:''' ...Well, she can at least speak to me and go about her day normally.
::{{A|vo xnnlq002 4 tlazolli 10a 2.ogg}} '''Tlazolli:''' That's already more than I could ask for...
:{{DIcon}} Sounds like she's doing well enough to run off on her own, too.
::{{A|vo xnnlq002 4 tlazolli 10b 1.ogg}} '''Tlazolli:''' Yes, and to run away from eating her vegetables. She's a fast one, that's for sure.
::{{A|vo xnnlq002 4 tlazolli 10b 2.ogg}} '''Tlazolli:''' She jumps over the chairs, hides under the table... then runs all around the house. I can hardly catch her.
::{{A|vo xnnlq002 4 tlazolli 10b 3.ogg}} '''Tlazolli:''' Seeing how she is now... That's already enough. I really couldn't ask for more...
:{{A|vo xnnlq002 4 cheven 03.ogg}} '''Cheven:''' Hey, cheer up! This is supposed to be a happy occasion!
:{{A|vo xnnlq002 4 cheven 04.ogg}} '''Cheven:''' It was very nice of little Nechca to try and bring us flowers.<ref group="Note">Actual voice-over: "We do appreciate that she tried to welcome us with flowers."</ref> Anyway, Tlazolli, about the thing I was telling you before...
:{{DIcon}} The gift!
:{{DIcon}} Alright! Let's hear it!
:{{A|vo xnnlq002 4 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yeah! What did you get us?
:{{A|vo xnnlq002 4 tlazolli 11.ogg}} '''Tlazolli:''' Well, it's a Blazegem Inscription. I made it from the purest ore, so it's almost completely resistant to erosion.
:{{A|vo xnnlq002 4 tlazolli 12.ogg}} '''Tlazolli:''' The techniques used to make it are all rooted in Ancient Name forging.
:{{DIcon}} So, it's like a simplified version of an Ancient Name?
:{{A|vo xnnlq002 4 tlazolli 13.ogg}} '''Tlazolli:''' Heh, don't say that, or the Wayob might smite me. The process just uses a few of the same techniques and materials.
:{{A|vo xnnlq002 4 tlazolli 14.ogg}} '''Tlazolli:''' When I first made one, I didn't think it could serve any practical purpose, apart from the erosion resistance and the general aesthetic.
:{{A|vo xnnlq002 4 tlazolli 15.ogg}} '''Tlazolli:''' But, then Cheven suggested using these crystals to make a special kind of "ornament"...
:{{A|vo xnnlq002 4 cheven 05.ogg}} '''Cheven:''' "Blazegem Inscriptions made by an Ancient Name artisan, engraved with words that never fade."
:{{A|vo xnnlq002 4 cheven 06.ogg}} '''Cheven:''' Quite the sales pitch, don't you think?
:{{A|vo xnnlq002 4 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wow, that description really does make it seem special...
:{{DIcon}} You've got a good eye for business...
:{{DIcon}} No wonder you run your own store...
:{{A|vo xnnlq002 4 cheven 07.ogg}} '''Cheven:''' Haha, Tlazolli's Blazegem Inscriptions really are special, though.
:{{A|vo xnnlq002 4 cheven 08.ogg}} '''Cheven:''' Word of mouth isn't always reliable. As information gets passed along, it becomes incomplete, forgotten, and, sometimes... even distorted.
:{{A|vo xnnlq002 4 cheven 09.ogg}} '''Cheven:''' But the words inscribed on these crystals will stand the test of time. The inscription will never deteriorate, and the meaning will never get twisted.
:{{A|vo xnnlq002 4 cheven 10.ogg}} '''Cheven:''' It's the perfect gift for a dear friend or significant other. You could even pass it down to younger generations!
:{{DIcon}} You're really pushing the sales pitch.
::{{A|vo xnnlq002 4 paimon 12a 1.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Paimon's interested! Let's buy one, {{Traveler}}! We can engrave our names onto it!
::{{A|vo xnnlq002 4 paimon 12a 2a.ogg}} {{A|vo xnnlq002 4 paimon 12a 2b.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Then, once we find your {{MC|m=sister|f=brother}}, we can get {{MC|m=her|f=him}} to add {{MC|m=her|f=his}} name, as well.
:{{DIcon}} You're very persuasive...
::{{A|vo xnnlq002 4 paimon 12b 1a.ogg}} {{A|vo xnnlq002 4 paimon 12b 1b.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yeah, let's get one! We can engrave our names onto it. Then, once we find your {{MC|m=sister|f=brother}}, {{MC|m=she|f=he}} can add {{MC|m=her|f=his}} name, as well!
:{{A|vo xnnlq002 4 paimon 13.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' That way, our names will be together forever, hehe.
:{{DIcon}} Looks like Paimon's already been hooked...
:{{DIcon}} That sounds a little too precious...
:{{A|vo xnnlq002 4 cheven 11.ogg}} '''Cheven:''' You deserve it! You saved me and Nechca's birthday present. It's the least I can do to repay you.
:{{A|vo xnnlq002 4 tlazolli 16.ogg}} '''Tlazolli:''' Cheven, I thought I told you—
:{{A|vo xnnlq002 4 cheven 12.ogg}} '''Cheven:''' Don't you start acting shy too, Tlazolli! It's a great gift! I know how much work goes into one of your Blazegem Inscriptions.
:{{A|vo xnnlq002 4 tlazolli 17.ogg}} '''Tlazolli:''' Well, then... Thank you both. I'll have it ready as soon as possible. Then, I'll have you do the inscription yourself.
:{{A|vo xnnlq002 4 tlazolli 18.ogg}} '''Tlazolli:''' Nechca should be well by then. She'll be very excited to meet you.
:{{DIcon}} Good things are better with company...
:{{DIcon}} Might as well buy a few more as gifts...
:{{A|vo xnnlq002 4 paimon 14b 2.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Whoa, let's not get ahead of ourselves. We don't even know how expensive that would be. You sure we have enough travel funds?
:{{A|vo xnnlq002 4 paimon 15.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hold on... this isn't part of some scheme to make us spend all our Mora, right Cheven?
:{{A|vo xnnlq002 4 cheven 13.ogg}} '''Cheven:''' You never know... You do look like you have some savings to spare...
:{{A|vo xnnlq002 4 paimon 16.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' No! Don't listen to that, {{Traveler}}! You'll end up losing all your Mora!
:{{A|vo xnnlq002 4 cheven 14.ogg}} '''Cheven:''' Haha! In any case, it's up to you.
:{{Color|menu|As you are in the midst of a conversation, Iengu sidles up a bit closer once more...}}
:{{A|vo xnnlq002 4 iengu 03.ogg}} '''Iengu:''' Roar!
:{{A|vo xnnlq002 4 paimon 17.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh no, it's the Tepetlisaur again! Quick, someone stop it! Paimon doesn't wanna get run over again!
:{{DIcon}} Whoa! There, there!
:{{A|vo xnnlq002 4 iengu 04.ogg}} '''Iengu:''' Roar...
:{{A|vo xnnlq002 4 cheven 15.ogg}} '''Cheven:''' Also, if you don't mind, Tlazolli, I'd like you to help me repair my Blazegem Inscription.
:{{A|vo xnnlq002 4 cheven 16.ogg}} '''Cheven:''' I dropped it when I was attacked earlier. The rope and clasp both snapped, so I haven't been wearing it.
:{{A|vo xnnlq002 4 cheven 17.ogg}} '''Cheven:''' I tried to fix it myself,<ref group="Note">Actual voice-over: "I tried fixing it myself"</ref> but I just couldn't get it to stay. Could you help?
:{{A|vo xnnlq002 4 tlazolli 19.ogg}} '''Tlazolli:''' Just leave it to me. I'll make it as good as new.
:{{A|vo xnnlq002 4 tlazolli 20.ogg}} '''Tlazolli:''' ...Thank you, Cheven... for going all that way, and—
:{{A|vo xnnlq002 4 cheven 18.ogg}} '''Cheven:''' It was nothing. We all just want Nechca to get better.
:{{A|vo xnnlq002 4 tlazolli 21.ogg}} '''Tlazolli:''' ...You're right.
:{{A|vo xnnlq002 4 tlazolli 22.ogg}} '''Tlazolli:''' Iengu! Behave yourself! I'll feed you in just a second!
:{{A|vo xnnlq002 4 tlazolli 23.ogg}} '''Tlazolli:''' I'll have Cheven contact you once everything's ready, {{Traveler}}.
:{{A|vo xnnlq002 4 tlazolli 24.ogg}} '''Tlazolli:''' Maybe we'll even line it up with Nechca's birthday. We could even have a little party.
:{{A|vo xnnlq002 4 paimon 18.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' That sounds great! We'll look forward to all the good food, and we'll make sure we're ready to eat!
:{{A|vo xnnlq002 4 paimon 19.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Anyway, see you around, Tlazolli!
:{{DIcon}} See you.
:{{DIcon}} I hope Nechca gets better soon.
:{{A|vo xnnlq002 4 tlazolli 25.ogg}} '''Tlazolli:''' Look after yourselves!
:{{A|vo xnnlq002 4 tlazolli 26.ogg}} '''Tlazolli:''' Nechca... is going to be so happy to meet you.
{{Dialogue End}}

:{{A|vo cllq002 11 clorinde 10.ogg}} '''Anxious Man:''' When I was child, though, my grandfather would tell me stories about how the Marechaussee Hunters drove back the monsters. So, on the off-chance that something might come of it, I decided to reach out to you.
:{{A|vo cllq002 11 clorinde 11.ogg}} '''Anxious Man:''' To be perfectly honest, I was starting to think all those stories were just tall tales, but now that I've seen you in person, I finally know that it was true!
:{{A|vo cllq002 11 navia 02.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Well, you can rest easy, friend! The righteous and formidable Marechaussee Hunters are on the case!
:{{A|vo cllq002 11 clorinde 12.ogg}} '''Game Master:''' The man is touched by your determination and resolve. His eyes begin to well with tears of relief.
:{{A|vo cllq002 11 furina 05.ogg}} '''Furina:''' Still, if we're going to hunt the monsters, we need to know where to find them. Can you give us any leads?
:{{A|vo cllq002 11 clorinde 13.ogg}} '''Anxious Man:''' All I know is that the area outside the city is dangerous. I'm afraid I can't point you toward a specific location.
:{{A|vo cllq002 11 clorinde 14.ogg}} '''Anxious Man:''' Although, if you leave the capital through the main gate and follow the road, you should run into a group of guards. They might know more about where to find the monsters.
:{{A|vo cllq002 11 navia 03.ogg}} '''Navia:''' I see... We'll go look for them, then.
:{{A|vo cllq002 11 clorinde 15.ogg}} '''Anxious Man:''' Alright, be careful. Oh and... one last thing. The monsters outside the city are just part of the problem. There are evil sorcerers inside the city as well, so be on your guard.
:{{A|vo cllq002 11 clorinde 16.ogg}} '''Anxious Man:''' They're actively working with the monsters, and have corrupted the court ministers with malicious magic. They're the reason why, even inside the city, everything has been a giant mess.
:{{A|vo cllq002 11 clorinde 17.ogg}} '''Anxious Man:''' Even one of our kindest ministers has turned into a boorish and unreasonable figure, interested in nothing but enacting laws that exploit the people. Who knows how much longer we'll be able to go on like this...

:{{A|vo cllq002 12 clorinde 11.ogg}} '''Clorinde:''' Responding to Egeria's call, a number of warriors followed Cassiodor into battle against the monsters. This group of warriors, under Cassiodor's leadership, became known as the Marechaussee Hunters.
:{{A|vo cllq002 12 clorinde 12.ogg}} '''Clorinde:''' Yet, as Fontaine entered an era of peace, their work gradually became obsolete. The Marechaussee Phantom, originally an association made up of Hunters, eventually came to be predominantly comprised of [[Melusine]]s.

:{{DIcon}} We're counting on you, Navia!
::{{A|vo cllq002 14 navia 01.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Sir, we were indeed in the city earlier, but our purpose was only to gather information on the monsters. We're here to help this city and all the people within it.
::{{A|vo cllq002 14 navia 02.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Your guards are still fighting the monsters as we speak. They could be seriously wounded and in grave need of support. You need all the help you can get!
::{{A|vo cllq002 14 clorinde 01.ogg}} '''Game Master:''' The man regards you with doubt and concern. After a period of inner struggle, he lets out a long sigh, and informs you of the locations where the monsters have appeared.
::{{A|vo cllq002 14 clorinde 02.ogg}} '''Guard Captain:''' Those monsters aren't easy to deal with. But... if you insist on going, I won't stop you, either.
::{{A|vo cllq002 14 clorinde 03.ogg}} '''Guard Captain:''' I just hope all the guards will be able to come back to their families alive. I wish you the best of luck...
;(If insight was chosen as a skill)
:{{DIcon}} I'd like to do an insight check to tell what he's thinking...
::{{A|vo cllq002 13 clorinde 46.ogg}} '''Game Master:''' While everyone is talking, you begin to carefully observe the captain's mannerisms.
::{{A|vo cllq002 13 clorinde 47.ogg}} '''Game Master:''' Every so often, you see him glance toward a particular direction with a pained expression on his face, as if an invisible thread is tying him to an unknown place.
::{{A|vo cllq002 13 clorinde 48.ogg}} '''Game Master:''' As you follow his gaze, you vaguely recall that the location he seems fixated on is known for its difficult terrain. Any battle that breaks out in a place like that is likely to be prolonged and devastating.
::{{A|vo cllq002 13 hero 05.ogg}} {{A|vo cllq002 13 heroine 05.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' Is that where the monsters are? Outside the forest, in the area with the difficult terrain?
::{{A|vo cllq002 13 clorinde 49.ogg}} '''Game Master:''' The captain is taken aback by your sudden question. Still, his shock only lends credence to your theory.
::{{A|vo cllq002 13 clorinde 50.ogg}} '''Guard Captain:''' You're... looking to fight the monsters?
::{{A|vo cllq002 13 navia 08.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Well, we're Marechaussee Hunters, after all. You could say that's basically our job!
::{{A|vo cllq002 13 clorinde 51.ogg}} '''Game Master:''' He shakes his head and continues to regard you with skepticism. In the end, he decides to inform you of the locations where the monsters have appeared.
::{{A|vo cllq002 13 clorinde 52.ogg}} '''Guard Captain:''' Those monsters aren't easy to deal with. But... if you insist on going, I won't stop you, either.
::{{A|vo cllq002 13 clorinde 53.ogg}} '''Guard Captain:''' I just hope all the guards will be able to come back to their families alive. I wish you the best of luck...
:{{A|vo cllq002 15 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Based on what the captain said, the monsters should be right up ahead!
:{{A|vo cllq002 15 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Let's go. Hopefully we're not too late.

;(Approach the injured guards)
:{{A|vo cllq002 16 clorinde 01.ogg}} '''Game Master:''' As you approach the battlefield, you see numerous people lying by the side of the road. They appear to be dressed like guards.
:{{A|vo cllq002 16 clorinde 02.ogg}} '''Game Master:''' Their faces are filled with desperation and terror. Some are screaming and cursing in vain, as if still trying to banish the monstrosities they saw from their minds.
:{{A|vo cllq002 17 clorinde 01.ogg}} '''Game Master:''' A few of the wounded look up at you in shock and disbelief.
:{{A|vo cllq002 17 clorinde 02.ogg}} '''Game Master:''' "Quick! Leave this place. Turn around and don't look back!" They yell.

;(Approach the marked location)
:{{A|vo cllq002 18 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' This is the place he mentioned... right?
:{{A|vo cllq002 18 clorinde 01.ogg}} '''Game Master:''' You see broken iron swords scattered all around you and downed trees riddled with terrifying claw marks.
:{{A|vo cllq002 18 clorinde 02.ogg}} '''Game Master:''' All the signs point to one thing — a truly devastating battle just took place here.
:{{A|vo cllq002 18 navia 01.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Be on your guard, everyone. The monsters might still be around...
:{{A|vo cllq002 18 clorinde 03.ogg}} '''Game Master:''' Before you can finish your sentence, you hear rustling sounds from the surrounding bushes. The monsters have emerged.
:{{A|vo cllq002 18 clorinde 04.ogg}} '''Game Master:''' They close in on you without fear. You get the impression that, in their bloodthirsty eyes, you're just another meal for them to devour.
:{{A|vo cllq002 18 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Argh! L—Little help here! This thing wants to eat Paimon!
:{{A|vo cllq002 18 clorinde 05.ogg}} '''Game Master:''' Your battle round begins... now.

:{{A|vo cllq002 19 clorinde 01.ogg}} '''Game Master:''' The next battle round begins... now.

:{{A|vo cllq002 20 clorinde 01.ogg}} '''Game Master:''' The monsters lets out a terrifying roar of anger and resentment, before dissipating into thin air.
:{{A|vo cllq002 20 navia 01.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Phew... Thank goodness it's over!
:{{A|vo cllq002 20 lyney 01.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' We're lucky the Marechaussee Hunter class came with all those preset skill points. Otherwise, we would've been in some real trouble.
:{{A|vo cllq002 20 furina 01.ogg}} '''Furina:''' I never knew the Fateometer even determines the amount of damage you inflict... If you get unlucky, isn't it just game over right then and there?
:{{A|vo cllq002 20 navia 02.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Hehe, that's part of the fun! The uncertainty of fate is what gives these games their appeal.
:{{A|vo cllq002 20 clorinde 02.ogg}} '''Game Master:''' Just as you begin to celebrate your victory, a suspicious lump on the ground catches your attention.
:{{A|vo cllq002 20 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' A suspicious... lump? Wait, could it be... the thing that appears after every battle...!?
:{{A|vo cllq002 20 navia 03.ogg}} '''Navia:''' I walk up to it, crouch down, and begin to carefully examine it. I've still got my right glove on, so it should be fine for me to touch it, right?
:{{A|vo cllq002 20 clorinde 03.ogg}} '''Game Master:''' As you investigate the mound, you discover that the exposed portion appears to be made of wood. It was previously obscured by the large form of the monsters.
:{{A|vo cllq002 20 clorinde 04.ogg}} '''Game Master:''' With the monsters gone, the small protrusion now awaits your discovery, poking out of the ground like a shy flower bud.
:{{A|vo cllq002 20 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Woah! It's a treasure chest!
:{{DIcon}} Let's dig it up!
<!-- special screen transition -->
----
:{{A|vo cllq002 21 clorinde 01.ogg}} '''Game Master:''' With everyone's help, you successfully excavate the wooden chest from the ground.
:{{A|vo cllq002 21 clorinde 02.ogg}} '''Game Master:''' Even without opening it, you can tell from the mora and jewels scattered around the chest that it must contain quite the fortune.
:{{A|vo cllq002 21 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Makes sense! We worked hard for this! Let's open it, and we can share what's inside!
:{{A|vo cllq002 21 lyney 01.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Haha, I can understand your excitement, Paimon, but think about it... Doesn't it seem like there are people out there who need this treasure more than us?
:{{A|vo cllq002 21 navia 01.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Yeah! Think about all the people suffering in the capital or all those guards who got hurt fighting the monsters... Wouldn't it be better if we gave the treasure to them?
:{{A|vo cllq002 21 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wait, is that how it works? Paimon thought, since we were the ones to dig it up, we could just take it for ourselves...
:{{A|vo cllq002 21 navia 02.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Well, let's put it this way... Any decision you make during a roleplaying game can impact the future course of the story.
:{{A|vo cllq002 21 furina 01.ogg}} '''Furina:''' But, would the people really believe us? It's hard enough for us to prove we're Marechaussee Hunters. What if they think we procured the treasure illegally? They might get even more suspicious of us...
:{{A|vo cllq002 21 lyney 02.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' That's definitely something we should consider. Maybe we can come up with an explanation in advance...
:{{A|vo cllq002 21 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Well, if donating it could cause that much trouble, why don't we use it to buy some gear and fill up on good food? Then, we'll be ready to fight even more bad guys!
:{{A|vo cllq002 21 clorinde 03.ogg}} '''Clorinde:''' Looks like you're facing a difficult choice once again.
:{{A|vo cllq002 21 clorinde 04.ogg}} '''Clorinde:''' Well, it's getting late. Why don't we call it a day for now.
:{{A|vo cllq002 21 furina 02.ogg}} '''Furina:''' Wow, where did the time go...
:{{A|vo cllq002 21 lyney 03.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Haha, I'm not sure if it's because I'm having so much fun with you all, or because the story is particularly enticing... But, I feel like I could almost keep going.
:{{A|vo cllq002 21 navia 03.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Hear, hear! Ooh, how about we play through the night!
:{{A|vo cllq002 21 furina 03.ogg}} '''Furina:''' Huh!? Oh, um... I'm not sure I'll have enough energy for that...
:{{A|vo cllq002 21 lyney 04.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Yeah, that won't work for me, either. [[Lynette]] will give me an earful if I get home too late.
:{{A|vo cllq002 21 clorinde 05.ogg}} '''Clorinde:''' I understand how you feel, Navia, but we have to change venues for the next part of the story, anyway.
:{{A|vo cllq002 21 navia 04.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Huh? Another location?
:{{A|vo cllq002 21 clorinde 06.ogg}} '''Clorinde:''' Mhm. There's a special note for the GM at the end of this section that says to proceed to an indoor set for the next part of the script.
:{{A|vo cllq002 21 navia 05.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Woah, they really pulled out all the stops for this new script!
:{{A|vo cllq002 21 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Well, even if we end the game for the day, we can still stay a little longer and hear Clorinde finish her story, right? Paimon wants to hear more about the history of the Hunters...
:{{A|vo cllq002 21 furina 04.ogg}} '''Furina:''' Hmm, something tells me you just want to finish the free desserts before we break for the day...
:{{A|vo cllq002 21 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Th—That's just a coincidence, okay? Besides, to Paimon, not finishing free food feels even worse than having to buy her own!
:{{A|vo cllq002 21 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' And anyway, Paimon really does want to hear more about Clorinde's master!
:{{A|vo cllq002 21 navia 06.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Well...
:{{DIcon}} If the story doesn't have a happy ending...
:{{DIcon}} It's okay not to finish it...
:{{A|vo cllq002 21 clorinde 07.ogg}} '''Clorinde:''' It's nothing. I appreciate the concern, but it's all in the past. It won't do any harm to share these things now.
<!-- time passes -->
:{{A|vo cllq002 21 clorinde 08.ogg}} '''Clorinde:''' My earliest memories are of living with Master. According to her, she saved me from certain people of ill repute. My birth parents had left me behind some time before that.
:{{A|vo cllq002 21 furina 05.ogg}} '''Furina:''' (What a heavy beginning for a life story...)
:{{A|vo cllq002 21 clorinde 09.ogg}} '''Clorinde:''' Master was a fascinating individual, if... inexperienced in the ways of raising children.
:{{A|vo cllq002 21 clorinde 10.ogg}} '''Clorinde:''' My first ever toy was a short sword. Although, I suppose it wasn't so much a toy as something Master removed from her waist and handed to a noisy child in need of distraction.
:{{A|vo cllq002 21 furina 06.ogg}} '''Furina:''' Wait, so she... handed an actual sword to a child? Isn't that dangerous!? Did you hurt yourself?
:{{A|vo cllq002 21 clorinde 11.ogg}} '''Clorinde:''' Of course I did. I cut my palm, and bled quite a lot. But Master was not concerned. She just stood there and casually lectured me about it—
:{{A|vo cllq002 21 clorinde 12.ogg}} '''Clorinde:''' "See? That's what you get for not holding the sword properly," she told me. She then crouched down next to me and said, "Give me your hand. I'll teach you to bandage this wound. After that, it's time to learn how to truly hold a blade."
:{{A|vo cllq002 21 lyney 05.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Excuse me for asking this, Clorinde, but... how old were you, exactly, when all of this happened?
:{{A|vo cllq002 21 clorinde 13.ogg}} '''Clorinde:''' Probably around... three? Give or take.
:{{A|vo cllq002 21 furina 07.ogg}} '''Furina:''' Three!? Isn't that when most kids are still struggling to hold a fork?
:{{A|vo cllq002 21 clorinde 14.ogg}} '''Clorinde:''' As I said, Master was... rather inexperienced in the ways of raising children. She believed trial and error was the best way to teach a child what they're capable of.
:{{A|vo cllq002 21 lyney 06.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' (I'm not so sure this is a question of "experience"...)
:{{A|vo cllq002 21 clorinde 15.ogg}} '''Clorinde:''' I didn't see anything wrong with her ways at the time, and, anyway, children don't get to choose how they're raised... Oh, she did bring me back a pet from [[Liyue]] once. It was a [[Geovishap Hatchling]].
:{{A|vo cllq002 21 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' A Geovishap Hatchling!? For a pet!? That seems even more dangerous!
:{{A|vo cllq002 21 clorinde 16.ogg}} '''Clorinde:''' What she said was this — "Make sure to get along, you two. If you really can't agree on something, just settle it with a fight. Whoever loses is the real pet."
:{{A|vo cllq002 21 lyney 07.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Uh... And how old were you when this happened?
:{{A|vo cllq002 21 clorinde 17.ogg}} '''Clorinde:''' Five.
:{{A|vo cllq002 21 furina 08.ogg}} '''Furina:''' Well... Did you win?
:{{A|vo cllq002 21 clorinde 18.ogg}} '''Clorinde:''' No, I lost.
:{{A|vo cllq002 21 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So you're saying... You actually became... the Geovishap's pet?
:{{A|vo cllq002 21 clorinde 19.ogg}} '''Clorinde:''' Yes, but only for a week. By the end of that week, I defeated it in combat, and we've shared a cordial relationship ever since.
:{{A|vo cllq002 21 furina 09.ogg}} '''Furina:''' (That really doesn't sound like the kind of childhood someone should have...)
:{{A|vo cllq002 21 clorinde 20.ogg}} '''Clorinde:''' Later on, I gradually understood that Master most likely didn't know any other way to raise a child. She was a Marechaussee Hunter, but I never heard her bring up her own parents.
:{{A|vo cllq002 21 clorinde 21.ogg}} '''Clorinde:''' Thanks to her, I learned how to navigate the forest by the age of six, and could hunt monsters in the wild by myself the year after that.
:{{A|vo cllq002 21 clorinde 22.ogg}} '''Clorinde:''' Even though the training she subjected me to was strict, she always made sure to take me traveling when she had the time. We met many of her friends during those days... That was also how I met Mr. [[Callas]] and his family.
:{{A|vo cllq002 21 navia 07.ogg}} '''Navia:''' I still remember the first time we met. You were too scared to join our picnic and hid behind Ms. Petronilla the whole time.
:{{A|vo cllq002 21 clorinde 23.ogg}} '''Clorinde:''' I still... hadn't really met many children my age at that time, so I didn't know how to interact with others.
:{{A|vo cllq002 21 navia 08.ogg}} '''Navia:''' After that, though, you started coming over a lot. You loved challenging people to shooting competitions, remember? I don't think many members of the Spina ever beat you in one of those.
:{{A|vo cllq002 21 clorinde 24.ogg}} '''Clorinde:''' I had a lot of fun during those days.
:{{A|vo cllq002 21 navia 09.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Hehe, I enjoyed them too! Oh, do you remember that one time we went exploring around the [[Spina di Rosula|Spina]] together? We overheard Papa call your Master Fontaine's "Protector of Justice."
:{{A|vo cllq002 21 navia 10.ogg}} '''Navia:''' We tried to pretend like we never heard anything, but you nearly let it slip that one time, hahaha...
:{{A|vo cllq002 21 furina 10.ogg}} '''Furina:''' "Protector of Justice"? Wait, you mean... that vigilante hero from twenty years ago? The one who was always active at night?
:{{A|vo cllq002 21 clorinde 25.ogg}} '''Clorinde:''' Yep, that would be her. She would often put on a black cloak and go out at night. I never knew where she went or what she was doing... until, like Navia said, we overheard the truth from Mr. Callas that night.
:{{A|vo cllq002 21 furina 11.ogg}} '''Furina:''' Twenty years ago, huh... I still remember the [[Garde]]s leaving all kinds of witness reports about her on [[Neuvillette]]'s desk.
:{{A|vo cllq002 21 clorinde 26.ogg}} '''Clorinde:''' My apologies.
:{{A|vo cllq002 21 furina 12.ogg}} '''Furina:''' Oh... There's no need to apologize! You had nothing to do with it. And, anyway, everything she did was for a good cause.
:{{A|vo cllq002 21 furina 13.ogg}} '''Furina:''' Although, calling herself the "Protector of Order" was a bit much, especially when she deliberately operated outside the law...
:{{A|vo cllq002 21 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh? When did the "Protector of Justice" become the "Protector of Order"?
:{{A|vo cllq002 21 furina 14.ogg}} '''Furina:''' Oh, she had a bunch of codenames. I heard she would just come up with a name on the spot whenever she was asked...
:{{A|vo cllq002 21 furina 15.ogg}} '''Furina:''' Later on, she probably got sick of answering those questions and decided to stick to just two — the "Protector of Justice" and the "Protector of Order."
:{{A|vo cllq002 21 clorinde 27.ogg}} '''Clorinde:''' That sounds like her, all right. I bet she forgot which of the two she'd used by the time she got back each night.
:{{A|vo cllq002 21 lyney 08.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Well, she certainly sounds like a fascinating individual. With her strong sense of justice, it's no surprise her student followed in her footsteps.
:{{A|vo cllq002 21 clorinde 28.ogg}} '''Clorinde:''' It's true. I always wanted to become like her. Someone powerful, independent, and with a strong sense of conviction... But...
:{{A|vo cllq002 21 lyney 09.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' But...?
:{{A|vo cllq002 21 navia 11.ogg}} '''Navia:''' ...
:{{A|vo cllq002 21 clorinde 29.ogg}} '''Clorinde:''' ...She suddenly disappeared the night I turned ten years old.
:{{A|vo cllq002 21 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Disappeared!? What happened?
:{{A|vo cllq002 21 clorinde 30.ogg}} '''Clorinde:''' I have no idea. She didn't even leave a note. I was never able to find out where she went.
:{{A|vo cllq002 21 clorinde 31.ogg}} '''Clorinde:''' That night, I was celebrating my birthday at Navia's house, but Master never came to pick me up. When I returned home on my own, it was to an empty house.
:{{A|vo cllq002 21 clorinde 32.ogg}} '''Clorinde:''' When she still didn't appear after a few days, I went to Mr. Callas' house to ask about her whereabouts, but he only shook his head.
:{{A|vo cllq002 21 navia 12.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Papa probably didn't know, either. I know he sent a few people to investigate the matter in secret, but... they never found any credible leads.
:{{A|vo cllq002 21 clorinde 33.ogg}} '''Clorinde:''' Don't worry, I understand. To be perfectly honest, given Master's personality and way of doing things, it all made a lot of sense. If I had to guess, I'd say she probably used it as an opportunity to force me to become independent.
:{{A|vo cllq002 21 clorinde 34.ogg}} '''Clorinde:''' Just like how... when a litter of kittens reaches a certain age, the mother willingly leaves them behind.
:{{A|vo cllq002 21 furina 16.ogg}} '''Furina:''' Were... Were you upset, Clorinde?
:{{A|vo cllq002 21 clorinde 35.ogg}} '''Clorinde:''' I was at first, but not anymore. I don't believe Master would suddenly disappear for no reason. There must have been something she just had to do.
:{{A|vo cllq002 21 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Well, despite everything, you still managed to follow in her footsteps and become the greatest [[Champion Duelist]] in all of Fontaine! You're practically a living symbol of law and justice!
:{{A|vo cllq002 21 clorinde 36.ogg}} '''Clorinde:''' Hmm, I suspect my position would be far too "by-the-books" for her. Master always did whatever she pleased. But... you're right. I suppose I do take after her in some ways.
:{{A|vo cllq002 21 furina 17.ogg}} '''Furina:''' (Who knew Clorinde had such an interesting past... I never had the chance to ask her about it before.)
:{{A|vo cllq002 21 furina 18.ogg}} '''Furina:''' (I wonder.. If Clorinde's master were the Champion Duelist back then... Would that duel against Mr. Callas have gone differently?)
:{{A|vo cllq002 21 furina 19.ogg}} '''Furina:''' (Oh no... Judging by the atmosphere, Clorinde and Navia are probably thinking something similar. The mood just got super awkward all of a sudden...)
:{{A|vo cllq002 21 navia 13.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Well, anyway! Would you look at the time? It's getting dark, so we should probably call it a day for real this time. If we keep talking like this, we really will be here all night!
:{{A|vo cllq002 21 lyney 10.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' I had a great time today, Miss Clorinde. Thank you for being our GM.
:{{A|vo cllq002 21 clorinde 37.ogg}} '''Clorinde:''' Anytime.
:{{A|vo cllq002 21 navia 14.ogg}} '''Navia:''' The script was good, but I've got to say, your childhood stories were even better!
:{{A|vo cllq002 21 navia 15.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Hey, you should tell us more about that fight against the Geovishap some time! Maybe your master was onto something, hehe!
:{{A|vo cllq002 21 clorinde 38.ogg}} '''Clorinde:''' Hm, you could be right.
:{{A|vo cllq002 21 furina 20.ogg}} '''Furina:''' (What does she mean, "onto something"? I certainly don't know any five-year-olds who want to fight a vishap in their spare time!)
:{{A|vo cllq002 21 furina 21.ogg}} '''Furina:''' Guess I'll head back as well. I need to save my energy if I want to continue enjoying the story tomorrow.
:{{A|vo cllq002 21 clorinde 39.ogg}} '''Clorinde:''' You're that excited to hear about my fight with the vishap?
:{{A|vo cllq002 21 furina 22.ogg}} '''Furina:''' I was talking about the script!
;(Quest completes)

;(Talk to Clorinde or Navia, optional)
:{{A|vo dialog cllq002 navia 01.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Um... Just between the two of us, could you tell me what it was like to be the Geovishap's pet?
:{{A|vo dialog cllq002 clorinde 01.ogg}} '''Clorinde:''' It was nothing special, really. Geovishaps don't understand the concept of a "pet." So, basically, it just headbutted me whenever I entered its territory.
:{{A|vo dialog cllq002 navia 02.ogg}} '''Navia:''' And that... hurt?
:{{A|vo dialog cllq002 clorinde 02.ogg}} '''Clorinde:''' Yeah, it hurt. What, something you want to experience for yourself?
:{{A|vo dialog cllq002 navia 03.ogg}} '''Navia:''' I'm good, thanks!
{{Dialogue End}}

:{{A|vo dqeq001 11 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, wait a second...
:{{A|vo dqeq001 11 prune 14.ogg}} '''Prune:''' (Oh no... Is the cat out of the bag?)
:{{A|vo dqeq001 11 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' That just means you're super good friends, huh!
:;(The Traveler is flabbergasted to a humorous level, and Prune is astonished as well)
:{{A|vo dqeq001 11 prune 15.ogg}} '''Prune:''' Huh?
:{{A|vo dqeq001 11 paimon 08a.ogg}}<!--{{A|vo dqeq001 11 paimon 08b.ogg}}--> '''Paimon:''' We have [[Childe|a friend]] like that, too! Always challenging {{Traveler}} to a sparring match whenever there's a chance.
:{{A|vo dqeq001 11 paimon 09a.ogg}} {{A|vo dqeq001 11 paimon 09b.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' {{Traveler}}'s got a pretty impressive reputation, after all! Y'know, Prune, if you're looking to improve your combat skills, you could always just ask {{MC|m=him|f=her}}.

:{{A|vo dqeq001 11 prune 17.ogg}} '''Prune:''' Would you join my practice session, {{Traveler}}? Seeing you in action would be an invaluable resource!
:{{DIcon|Fantasy Realm Performance}} Alright, I'll show you what I've got!

==Dialogue==
{{Quest Description|Following your deal with Kinich, you prepare to walk around the tribe, making room for him to maneuver...}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Pass time)
:{{A|vo jnqlq004 1 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Okay, task for the day — meet the tribespeople and take some heat off of Kinich's back!

;(Approach Huni and Toba)
:{{A|vo jnqlq004 1 toba 01.ogg}} '''Toba:''' Huni! How can you call the [[Kongamato|Mountain King]] a monster?
:{{A|vo jnqlq004 1 huni 01.ogg}} '''Huni:''' Because he hurt a lot of people! And look what happened to [[Nanna]]...
:{{A|vo jnqlq004 1 toba 02.ogg}} '''Toba:''' But it wasn't on purpose! The Mountain King is sick, that's all. He's been hurt by the [[Abyss]].
:{{A|vo jnqlq004 1 huni 02.ogg}} '''Huni:''' That's true, but the fact remains that he's now a threat to all of us!
:{{A|vo jnqlq004 1 toba 03.ogg}} '''Toba:''' How can you be so harsh to someone who's sick? If you don't take back what you just said, I don't know if we can carry on being friends!
:{{A|vo jnqlq004 1 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Toba... Huni... What's wrong?
:{{A|vo jnqlq004 1 toba 04.ogg}} '''Toba:''' Huni's saying nasty things about the Mountain King! It's not right, he's our hero!
:{{A|vo jnqlq004 1 huni 03.ogg}} '''Huni:''' Hmph, once upon a time, maybe. But not anymore.
:{{DIcon}} Hey now, let's not fight. Aren't you best friends?
:{{A|vo jnqlq004 1 toba 05.ogg}} '''Toba:''' Hmph, yesterday, maybe. But not anymore!
:{{A|vo jnqlq004 1 huni 04.ogg}} '''Huni:''' Toba! Fine... I guess [[Trinidad|my dad]] is right. Things change, and you just have to accept it and move forward.
:{{A|vo jnqlq004 1 huni 05.ogg}} '''Huni:''' As of today, our friendship is over! There's no going back!
:{{A|vo jnqlq004 1 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh come on, cut it out you two! We have some great news to tell you!
:{{A|vo jnqlq004 1 paimon 04a.ogg}} {{A|vo jnqlq004 1 paimon 04b.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' {{Traveler}} is gonna be the flame bearer for the next [[Turnfire Night]]! {{MC|m=He|f=She}}'s gonna do a beautiful ceremony and cure the Mountain King's illness for good.
:{{A|vo jnqlq004 1 toba 06.ogg}} '''Toba:''' What? Really?
:{{DIcon}} Of course. I'm an expert at this stuff.
:{{A|vo jnqlq004 1 huni 06.ogg}} '''Huni:''' So that's what my dad wanted to talk to you about?
:{{A|vo jnqlq004 1 huni 07a.ogg}}<!--{{A|vo jnqlq004 1 huni 07b.ogg}}--> '''Huni:''' To be fair, from what we saw the other day, you are pretty good at climbing cliffs. Probably just as good as Kinich.
:{{A|vo jnqlq004 1 toba 07.ogg}} '''Toba:''' Wait, speaking of Kinich... Where even is that guy?
:{{A|vo jnqlq004 1 huni 08.ogg}} '''Huni:''' Oh yeah, good question... Is he not coming to the ceremony anymore?
:{{A|vo jnqlq004 1 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' We can get him to come. But if he catches you two fighting again, he won't be happy! He'll be sure to give you both a piece of his mind!
:{{A|vo jnqlq004 1 toba 08.ogg}} '''Toba:''' No, we can't let that happen! I've never even spoken to him before! I can't afford to make such a bad first impression.
:{{A|vo jnqlq004 1 huni 09.ogg}} '''Huni:''' I didn't mean to argue with Toba... All I said was that the Mountain King has done some pretty bad things. He was the one who turned it into a fight.
:{{DIcon}} You two clearly care about each other. The Mountain King can't change that.
:{{A|vo jnqlq004 1 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yeah! If you weren't friends, there's no way Toba would've come to look for the baby [[Saurian]]s with you.
:{{A|vo jnqlq004 1 huni 10a.ogg}}<!--{{A|vo jnqlq004 1 huni 10b.ogg}}--> '''Huni:''' ...Alright, well... Because it's {{Traveler}} and Paimon, and Kinich... I'm sorry, Toba. I'm sorry for all the mean things I said about the Mountain King.
:{{A|vo jnqlq004 1 huni 11.ogg}} '''Huni:''' Dad just really misses Nanna. And I was really upset that she's gone, too...
:{{A|vo jnqlq004 1 toba 09.ogg}} '''Toba:''' Huh? Oh... Uhh...
:{{A|vo jnqlq004 1 toba 10a.ogg}}<!--{{A|vo jnqlq004 1 toba 10b.ogg}}--> '''Toba:''' I shouldn't have spoken to you the way I did either. It wasn't very nice of me. For {{Traveler}} and Paimon, Kinich, and for Nanna... I'm sorry too, Huni.
:{{A|vo jnqlq004 1 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' That's more like it... Now you're best friends again!
:{{A|vo jnqlq004 1 huni 12.ogg}} '''Huni:''' Guess so... Toba, if I ever say something mean about the Mountain King in the future, I'll make sure I say it to someone else and not you.
:{{A|vo jnqlq004 1 huni 13.ogg}} '''Huni:''' I'd better go buy some colored cloth for my Dad now. He needs it for Turnfire Night. Let's play again some other time.
:{{A|vo jnqlq004 1 huni 14a.ogg}}<!--{{A|vo jnqlq004 1 huni 14b.ogg}}--> '''Huni:''' See you, Toba. See you, {{Traveler}} and Paimon.
:{{A|vo jnqlq004 1 toba 11.ogg}} '''Toba:''' Kay, I'll head home as well then... See you next time...
:{{A|vo jnqlq004 1 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Okay, take care you two...
:{{A|vo jnqlq004 1 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Aww... Even though they said they're sorry, it looks like their friendship isn't as strong as it was before.
:{{DIcon}} Times really are changing.
:{{A|vo jnqlq004 1 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' *sigh* ...Let's just hope we can solve this once and for all.
:{{A|vo jnqlq004 1 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Come on, let's move on.

;(Approach the marked location)
:{{A|vo jnqlq004 2 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh? What's going on over there? Let's take a look.

;(Approach Thiago)
:{{A|vo jnqlq004 3 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hey there, what's happening here?
:{{A|vo jnqlq004 3 thiago 01.ogg}} '''Thiago:''' A rehearsal, for the Turnfire Night dance.
:{{A|vo jnqlq004 3 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oooh! There's a dance involved? Paimon wants to learn, too...
:{{A|vo jnqlq004 3 thiago 02.ogg}} '''Thiago:''' You don't know it? Ah, I guess you're not from these parts, huh? It's rare to see a new face around the tribe these days — I thought everyone would be keeping away.
:{{A|vo jnqlq004 3 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh? Why do you say that?
:{{A|vo jnqlq004 3 thiago 03.ogg}} '''Thiago:''' Because of the Turnfire Night, of course. The Mountain King could wake up at any time — that's why we're holding an emergency ceremony.
:{{A|vo jnqlq004 3 thiago 04.ogg}} '''Thiago:''' This isn't one of those fun-and-games festivals. For outsiders, it might even be a little dangerous.
:{{A|vo jnqlq004 3 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Well, did you know that the flame bearer this time is actually gonna be an outsider?
:{{A|vo jnqlq004 3 thiago 05.ogg}} '''Thiago:''' Oh, I did hear about that! It's a first for sure. I would've loved to meet them in person.
:{{DIcon}} Heh... Now you have.
:{{A|vo jnqlq004 3 thiago 06.ogg}} '''Thiago:''' What? Oh...! It's you!? Man, oh man... Well, this is a nice surprise.
:{{A|vo jnqlq004 3 thiago 07.ogg}} '''Thiago:''' It's funny, I was just thinking that I'll probably miss out on meeting the new flame bearer, since I'm not taking part this time around... Then suddenly, there you are! Must be my lucky day, haha.
:{{A|vo jnqlq004 3 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You're not taking part in Turnfire Night? How come? You're not an outsider too, are you?
:{{A|vo jnqlq004 3 thiago 08.ogg}} '''Thiago:''' Haha, you must be joking! Watch this...
:{{Color|menu|Thiago sways and twists, and begins to perform a ritual dance...}}
:{{A|vo jnqlq004 3 thiago 09.ogg}} '''Thiago:''' Not bad, right? Yeah, I'm considered one of the better-looking guys who dances beneath the Pillars of the Sacred Flame. Been doing it a few years. Always gets the ladies out to watch, haha.
:{{A|vo jnqlq004 3 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ooh, very impressive! So why did you quit?
:{{A|vo jnqlq004 3 thiago 10.ogg}} '''Thiago:''' Well, I feel like the whole Mountain King situation is getting more and more precarious. It's just not safe here anymore. One of our elders' Saurian companions even lost her life not long ago.
:{{A|vo jnqlq004 3 thiago 11.ogg}} '''Thiago:''' The question is, what are we going to do about this in the long term? But our leaders don't have any answers for us. They're probably too busy fighting about it amongst themselves.
:{{A|vo jnqlq004 3 thiago 12.ogg}} '''Thiago:''' The way things are going, it's only a matter of time before it gets violent. So I figured, y'know what? Now's as good a time as any to get away for little while, go do some exploring.
:{{A|vo jnqlq004 3 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You look a little disappointed...
:{{A|vo jnqlq004 3 thiago 13.ogg}} '''Thiago:''' Disappointed? Nah. It's a great opportunity to go see the world. As every male Scion of the Canopy knows: Wherever you are and wherever you go, the only way is forwards. We take pride in that. I won't forget my roots.
:{{DIcon}} Fair enough. So what's your plan for the next step?
:{{A|vo jnqlq004 3 thiago 14.ogg}} '''Thiago:''' Hehe, I managed to get in touch with the [[Saurian Relics Association]]. They gave me a simple test: Find a decent quality relic, and they'll make me a member.
:{{A|vo jnqlq004 3 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What's the Saurian Relics Association?
:{{A|vo jnqlq004 3 thiago 15.ogg}} '''Thiago:''' You've never heard of it? It's a group of amateur history enthusiasts who do research on the ancient Saurian era. They're all about collecting relics and remnants from that age.
:{{A|vo jnqlq004 3 thiago 16.ogg}} '''Thiago:''' Speaking of which, the guy who was flame bearer before you — I've heard that his Saurian buddy comes from that time.
:{{A|vo jnqlq004 3 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' [[Ajaw]]? Ajaw's a relic from an ancient Saurian civilization!?
:{{A|vo jnqlq004 3 thiago 17.ogg}} '''Thiago:''' Oh! Yeah, him. So you know those two already, huh?
:{{A|vo jnqlq004 3 thiago 18.ogg}} '''Thiago:''' Then do you know how they met? It was deep inside some mysterious ruin, and they signed a contract there. The association folks say that kind of contract usually comes with a huge, hidden cost.
:{{A|vo jnqlq004 3 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Really? That sounds ominous...
:{{A|vo jnqlq004 3 thiago 19.ogg}} '''Thiago:''' Who knows? But if it's true, Kinich can probably handle it. He knows what he's doing with weighing up contracts and costs and stuff. I doubt he'd make a contract that doesn't benefit him.
:{{A|vo jnqlq004 3 thiago 20.ogg}} '''Thiago:''' Strangely enough, I actually happened upon a strange mural a while back, and it looked to me like it was depicting a Saurian and a human involved in some kind of Saurian-era contract ritual.
:{{A|vo jnqlq004 3 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ooh, does that count as a relic then?
:{{A|vo jnqlq004 3 thiago 21.ogg}} '''Thiago:''' You bet it does. I was all ready to go take a picture of it and use that as my entry ticket to the association.
:{{A|vo jnqlq004 3 thiago 22.ogg}} '''Thiago:''' But after all the Abyssal activity recently, I heard that area's been overrun by monsters. The best laid plans, huh? I'll just have to wait and see if things improve.
:{{A|vo jnqlq004 3 thiago 23.ogg}} '''Thiago:''' ...Or... You look like you know your way around a fight... I don't suppose there's any chance you'd be able to help...?
:{{A|vo jnqlq004 3 paimon 12.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' If all you need is to get a picture, that should be pretty achievable, right...? {{Traveler}} deals with monsters all the time, it's a piece of cake.
:{{A|vo jnqlq004 3 thiago 24.ogg}} '''Thiago:''' Wait, you're seriously gonna help me out?
:{{A|vo jnqlq004 3 paimon 13.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' C'mon, it's no big deal! Compared to some of the things we've been roped into before, this is nothing.

:{{A|vo jnqlq004 16 fuchikami 13.ogg}} '''The Thing Calling Itself "Sanka":''' But now I've run into you, which is just my luck... Or maybe I've incited the wrath of the Turnfire, and this is the price I have to pay. But I don't understand, what did I do wrong?

:{{A|vo jnqlq004 16 kinich 06.ogg}} '''Kinich:''' Don't worry, I told him to act as bait.
:{{A|vo jnqlq004 16 ajaw 02.ogg}} '''Ajaw:''' Yes, and you should have picked a bigger fish! The Abyss Order? What a joke! Not even a match for our lowly servant. I put up with this toad's croaking for days, and it was all for nothing!

:{{A|vo jnqlq004 16 fuchikami 15.ogg}} '''The Thing Calling Itself "Sanka":''' Eh, what did you expect? Behavioral rehab isn't really our thing. Otherwise, we might as well change our name from the Abyss Order to the Abyss Boarding School.

::{{A|vo jnqlq004 16 fuchikami 16b 1.ogg}} '''The Thing Calling Itself "Sanka":''' You see, this is why I like you. Still, you shouldn't underestimate me just because I'm a lowly clerk.

:{{A|vo jnqlq004 16 kinich 17.ogg}} '''Kinich:''' You should go back and get some rest. Big day ahead — tomorrow's Turnfire Night. Time to light the sacred flame and burn away the filth for a legendary five-hundred-year-old warrior.

:{{A|vo jnqlq004 16 kinich 18.ogg}} '''Kinich:''' Then it can't hurt to say this one more time: Good luck to us both.
:{{DIcon}} Good luck to us both.
:{{A|vo jnqlq004 16 kinich 19.ogg}} '''Kinich:''' See you tomorrow.

::{{A|vo dialog jnqlq004 kinich 02b 2.ogg}} '''Kinich:''' I know he can be awful, but don't worry. As long as I'm still around, he can't do that much damage.

::{{A|vo dialog jnqlq004 kinich 05.ogg}} '''Kinich:''' Crazy, isn't it? That was probably the first time I really appreciated what it meant to pay a "price." Then, once I signed the contract, I received the ancient name "{{Rubi|Malipo|Turnfire}}."
::{{A|vo dialog jnqlq004 kinich 06.ogg}} '''Kinich:''' But that's a whole other story. We can get into it another time, if you're interested.

'''''If You Should Forget the Entrance to Dreams''''' is the second part of the [[Phantasmal Pals]] Event.

==Steps==
# Wait until the next day (08:00 – 10:00)
# Head to the secret base
# Make ready and then set out
# Find the nightmare fragment in the small forested area (0/4)<!-- quest progress saves after this step -->
# Talk to [[Prune]] and check on the situation
# Investigate the suspicious area (0/2)
# Defeat the monsters
#* Wave 1: {{Enemy List|1 = Hydro Slime*3; Electro Slime*4; Large Hydro Slime{ text = Glug Glug King — Lord Who Lifts Water Droplets to Wet Socks and Shoes }|x=1}}
#* Wave 2: {{Enemy List|1 = Electro Slime*3; Hydro Slime*3; Large Electro Slime{ text = Crackle Snap King — Incarnation of the Micro-Fury }; Mutant Electro Slime{ text = Crackle Snap King — Incarnation of the Micro-Fury }|x=1}}<!-- defeating either "Crackle Snap King" doesn't make the title disappear for the other -->
# Achieve victory and reclaim the nightmare fragment
# Return to the secret base

==Gameplay Notes==
* During steps 4-8, the player will enter a [[Special Story Mode]].
** Exiting Special Story Mode will take the player back to the base. A rift with the quest marker "Find the nightmare fragment" will appear.
* During step 7, the active party will be limited to a trial [[Klee]], [[Yaoyao]], [[Qiqi]], [[Sayu]], and [[Prune]].
* During the battle in step 7, there are three healing orbs in the area. These each restore 20% of the active character's Max HP when picked up and respawn after 10 seconds.

==Dialogue==
{{Quest Description|The [[Dough King]] and its kin have come to the little witches' secret base, and they even bring new clues with them...}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Approach the event venue)
:{{A|vo dqeq002 1 klee 01.ogg}} '''Klee:''' The Dough King is here! Oh, and someone new!
:{{A|vo dqeq002 1 hyakujitsuhakushion 01.ogg}} '''Hyakujitsuhaku Shion:''' Hello. I'm [[Hyakujitsuhaku Shion]]. I'm a [[Yumekui-Baku]] like Kohaku here — or the Dough King, as most people know her. She told us about what happened.
:{{A|vo dqeq002 1 hyakujitsuhakushion 02.ogg}} '''Hyakujitsuhaku Shion:''' Oh, {{Traveler}} and Paimon? I didn't know you'd be here too. I hope you've been well.
:{{A|vo dqeq002 1 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Shion! What a coincidence! We were gonna head to [[Aisa Bathhouse]], but something came up and we had to change our plans.
:{{A|vo dqeq002 1 hyakujitsuhakushion 03.ogg}} '''Hyakujitsuhaku Shion:''' Ah, well, you're welcome any time. [[Mizuki]] is away on business, so I'm in charge in the meantime. It's, uh... quite the task, but I'm trying my best.
:{{A|vo dqeq002 1 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Sounds like you're here for the same incident as us, then, hehe! Wow, small world!
:{{A|vo dqeq002 1 prune 01.ogg}} '''Prune:''' So the Dough King is a Yumekui-Baku...
:{{A|vo dqeq002 1 prune 02.ogg}} '''Prune:''' I read about them in "Little-Known Creatures of Teyvat: Inazuma Edition." Cute in appearance, with soft, dough-like bodies. Some can even take human form...
:{{A|vo dqeq002 1 prune 03.ogg}} '''Prune:''' A friendly and approachable type of [[youkai]], Yumekui-Baku help humans regulate their emotions by devouring nightmares.
:{{A|vo dqeq002 1 prune 04.ogg}} '''Prune:''' That's all on page 136, if you were wondering.
:{{A|vo dqeq002 1 hyakujitsuhakushion 04.ogg}} '''Hyakujitsuhaku Shion:''' That was quite the knowledgeable introduction. We appreciate all the help so far, little ones.
:{{A|vo dqeq002 1 klee 02.ogg}} '''Klee:''' Little witches! We're the [[Little Hexenzirkel]]!
:{{A|vo dqeq002 1 hyakujitsuhakushion 05.ogg}} '''Hyakujitsuhaku Shion:''' Oh, um... noted. Thank you, Little Hexenzirkel.
:{{A|vo dqeq002 1 hyakujitsuhakushion 06.ogg}} '''Hyakujitsuhaku Shion:''' As for our friend [[Popcorn]]... We discussed the situation with the baku that patrol the wilderness last night, and well... The situation is a bit complicated...
:{{A|vo dqeq002 1 prune 05.ogg}} '''Prune:''' Klee, why don't you and the other little witches go play with Popcorn for a bit?
:{{A|vo dqeq002 1 klee 03.ogg}} '''Klee:''' Okay! Follow me, everyone!
:;(Klee, Qiqi, Sayu, and Yaoyao leave)
:{{A|vo dqeq002 1 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh? Did you send them away on purpose?
:{{A|vo dqeq002 1 prune 06.ogg}} '''Prune:''' Well, our baku friend here did make it sound kind of serious...
:{{A|vo dqeq002 1 prune 07.ogg}} '''Prune:''' It's not good for kids to be exposed to the dark side of the world too early, so I thought it was better to be safe.
:{{A|vo dqeq002 1 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You could stand to take your own advice...
:{{A|vo dqeq002 1 prune 08.ogg}} '''Prune:''' I heard that! You just have to blurt out whatever pops into your head...?
:{{DIcon}} It's because you care about them, huh, Prune?
:{{A|vo dqeq002 1 prune 09.ogg}} '''Prune:''' Ahem, well, they would've got impatient and run off to play sooner or later. I just... hurried things along.
:{{A|vo dqeq002 1 hyakujitsuhakushion 07.ogg}} '''Hyakujitsuhaku Shion:''' Haha, I'm not sure it's quite as serious as that, but allow me to explain.
:{{A|vo dqeq002 1 hyakujitsuhakushion 08.ogg}} '''Hyakujitsuhaku Shion:''' After Kohaku sent Popcorn off with the ki— Ahem... Or, um, the little witches, she found this in the area.
:;(Shion shows them a sphere of purple energy)
:{{A|vo dqeq002 1 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Okay, this is giving Paimon the creeps... What is it?
:{{A|vo dqeq002 1 hyakujitsuhakushion 09.ogg}} '''Hyakujitsuhaku Shion:''' It's a nightmare fragment, formed from an accumulation of negative emotions.
:{{A|vo dqeq002 1 hyakujitsuhakushion 10.ogg}} '''Hyakujitsuhaku Shion:''' You can think of it as... emotions materialized in physical form. Popcorn happens to bear an identical signature to this fragment.
:{{A|vo dqeq002 1 hyakujitsuhakushion 11.ogg}} '''Hyakujitsuhaku Shion:''' We think he must have come into contact with it and undergone a similar process of materialization.
:{{A|vo dqeq002 1 prune 10.ogg}} '''Prune:''' Wait, so that must be why we can see him in the real world!
:{{A|vo dqeq002 1 hyakujitsuhakushion 12.ogg}} '''Hyakujitsuhaku Shion:''' Exactly. Imaginary friends are, at their essence, a harmless collection of positive emotions originating from the subconscious. But under the influence of the nightmare fragment, Popcorn is much less stable...
:{{A|vo dqeq002 1 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yeah, he's definitely been pretty hot and cold, and his memories are all messed up!
:{{DIcon}} There's another problem, though...
:{{DIcon}} What about the human Popcorn belongs to?
:{{A|vo dqeq002 1 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yeah! We tried to ask him about his human during the little witch's tea party. He said [[Homura]] is hurt and needs help!
:{{A|vo dqeq002 1 hyakujitsuhakushion 13.ogg}} '''Hyakujitsuhaku Shion:''' Based on what we know so far, it's possible Homura had a nightmare, which in turn affected Popcorn, and... that's how things turned out like this.
:{{A|vo dqeq002 1 prune 11.ogg}} '''Prune:''' The Yumekui-Baku have a way to fix this, though, right? You deal with dreams all the time!
:{{A|vo dqeq002 1 prune 12.ogg}} '''Prune:''' We have to help Popcorn! His human must be worried sick!
:{{A|vo dqeq002 1 hyakujitsuhakushion 14.ogg}} '''Hyakujitsuhaku Shion:''' Of course. In our experience, once a baku consumes these negative emotions, the affected parties should return to normal. That includes Popcorn and the human suffering from the nightmares.
:{{A|vo dqeq002 1 hyakujitsuhakushion 15.ogg}} '''Hyakujitsuhaku Shion:''' We were going to do just that. But then we received word that there are three other locations with a similar signature. Here, take a look.
:[[File:If You Should Forget the Entrance to Dreams Map.png|200px]]
:{{A|vo dqeq002 1 prune 13.ogg}} '''Prune:''' That means there are three more of these nightmare fragments?
:{{A|vo dqeq002 1 hyakujitsuhakushion 16.ogg}} '''Hyakujitsuhaku Shion:''' Yes. The emotions contained within are highly volatile. Devouring this one right now could make the others even more unstable...
:{{A|vo dqeq002 1 hyakujitsuhakushion 17.ogg}} '''Hyakujitsuhaku Shion:''' It would be safer to retrieve them and devour all of them at once.
:{{A|vo dqeq002 1 hyakujitsuhakushion 18.ogg}} '''Hyakujitsuhaku Shion:''' That's not quite where our talents as baku lie though. With our round bodies, short legs, and stubby hands, we can't run fast or hold tools...
:{{DIcon}} Just leave it to us!
:{{A|vo dqeq002 1 hyakujitsuhakushion 19.ogg}} '''Hyakujitsuhaku Shion:''' Really? I can't thank you enough! Here, take this map with you.
:{{A|vo dqeq002 1 hyakujitsuhakushion 20.ogg}} '''Hyakujitsuhaku Shion:''' Oh, be warned, though, the negative energy within the nightmare fragments might affect the surrounding environment.
:{{A|vo dqeq002 1 hyakujitsuhakushion 21.ogg}} '''Hyakujitsuhaku Shion:''' So pay close attention, and if you notice anything unusual, a nightmare fragment could be close.
:{{A|vo dqeq002 1 hyakujitsuhakushion 22.ogg}} '''Hyakujitsuhaku Shion:''' I'll gather a few other baku, and we'll be back tomorrow with empty stomachs and the materials needed to prep the nightmare for consumption.
:{{A|vo dqeq002 1 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, you need to prep it? You can't just... dig in?
:{{A|vo dqeq002 1 hyakujitsuhakushion 23.ogg}} '''Hyakujitsuhaku Shion:''' Uhh, it's nothing special, just a bit of... seasoning. Nightmares don't taste that great, so the seasoning helps them go down easier...
:{{A|vo dqeq002 1 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ohhh. Yeah... That sounds rough.
:{{A|vo dqeq002 1 hyakujitsuhakushion 24.ogg}} '''Hyakujitsuhaku Shion:''' It's what we do. Alright, I better get back to work. Kohaku will look after Popcorn in the meantime. See you tomorrow, and best of luck!
:;(Sayu is revealed to be standing by a crate behind them)
:{{A|vo dqeq002 1 sayu 01.ogg}} '''Sayu:''' So, when are we doing this thing?
:{{A|vo dqeq002 1 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Whoa!? When did you get here? Paimon didn't hear a thing!
:{{A|vo dqeq002 1 sayu 02.ogg}} '''Sayu:''' Hehe, I wouldn't be a very good ninja if I didn't know how to move around without making noise. How else would I sneak off to go take a nap?
:{{A|vo dqeq002 1 sayu 03.ogg}} '''Sayu:''' I even learned a new ninjutsu to help! Hidden mujina no jutsu!
:;(Sayu transforms into a Muji-Muji Daruma, then reappears with Klee and Yaoyao)
:{{A|vo dqeq002 1 together 01.ogg}} '''Klee & Yaoyao:''' Tada!<!-- automatically proceeds after a few seconds -->
:;(Qiqi appears a few seconds later)
:{{A|vo dqeq002 1 qiqi 01.ogg}} '''Qiqi:''' ...Tada.<!-- automatically proceeds after a few seconds to show a surprised Paimon -->
:{{A|vo dqeq002 1 klee 04.ogg}} '''Klee:''' So, um... we heard all of that! So what's the plan? When are we heading out?
:{{A|vo dqeq002 1 yaoyao 01.ogg}} '''Yaoyao:''' Yeah, Popcorn is our friend. We want to do our part to help him.
:{{A|vo dqeq002 1 prune 14.ogg}} '''Prune:''' C'mon, we can't be bringing this many kids along. There's just too much to worry about.
:{{DIcon}} It's okay. I've got this.
:{{DIcon}} Plus, we have a reliable kid like you to help out.
:{{A|vo dqeq002 1 prune 15.ogg}} '''Prune:''' I'm... not a kid!

==Steps==
# Rest until the following day (06:00–24:00)
# Talk to everyone
#* Enter [[Immernachtreich Keep]]'s Quest Domain: [[Immernachtreich Apokalypse: Part I]]

# Enter the castle as the story unfolds
# Repair the bridge
# Enter the castle as the story unfolds
# Find the source of the voice
# Help Leon leave the cellar
# Talk to Leon
# Repair the path to the tower
# Head to the top of the tower
# Close "Hymn of the Holy Land"
# Listen to the voices inside the room
# Leave the room
