:{{A|vo htlq002 1 meng 01.ogg}} '''Meng:''' I see. Well, I'm just sorry for the trouble. We've already searched in all the likely places...
:{{A|vo htlq002 1 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Who is this Big G anyway?
:{{A|vo htlq002 1 meng 02.ogg}} '''Meng:''' I guess I should start at the beginning. My home was in the vicinity of [[Wuwang Hill]]. In my youth, I had a good many friends there.
:{{A|vo htlq002 1 meng 03.ogg}} '''Meng:''' Big G was one of them. We were the best of friends, inseparable really. But one day there was an accident, and that was the end of him.
:{{A|vo htlq002 1 meng 04.ogg}} '''Meng:''' I've never forgotten... Too many memories, I suppose. I often return to Wuwang Hill.
:{{A|vo htlq002 1 meng 05.ogg}} '''Meng:''' But recently, after one such visit, I started to feel strange. Now, every night, Big G appears in my dreams.
:{{A|vo htlq002 1 meng 06.ogg}} '''Meng:''' I can't help but wonder, did I disturb him somehow?
:{{DIcon}} Sounds like a tall story.
:{{DIcon}} That kind of thing doesn't happen.
:{{A|vo htlq002 1 meng 07.ogg}} '''Meng:''' Perhaps. I don't have proof, but I can't stop worrying. I get more anxious every day.
:{{A|vo htlq002 1 meng 08.ogg}} '''Meng:''' How would I ever come to terms with my childhood friend becoming an evil spirit?
:{{A|vo htlq002 1 hutao 02.ogg}} '''Hu Tao:''' That's why he joined Wangsheng Funeral Parlor. In place of a salary, I'm helping him deal with this matter.
:{{A|vo htlq002 1 hutao 03.ogg}} '''Hu Tao:''' And in fact, what Meng has said is entirely plausible. Spirits, on occasion, do find a way into our world.
:{{A|vo htlq002 1 hutao 04.ogg}} '''Hu Tao:''' But as for evil spirits, I think you're scaring yourself. Even I have only encountered malevolent forces a handful of times.
:{{A|vo htlq002 1 meng 09.ogg}} '''Meng:''' But are you sure there's no danger? I couldn't bear for him to go around harming people.
:{{A|vo htlq002 1 hutao 05.ogg}} '''Hu Tao:''' You see what I mean? Look at the state of him. If we can't find Big G, it'll eat away at Meng forever.
:{{A|vo htlq002 1 hutao 06.ogg}} '''Hu Tao:''' Those people we found today were also Meng's childhood friends. I thought there was a good chance Big G might have hidden among them. But here we are, empty-handed.
:{{A|vo htlq002 1 meng 10.ogg}} '''Meng:''' Wuwang Hill, childhood friends... Seems like we're out of leads...
:{{A|vo htlq002 1 luocheng 01.ogg}} '''???:''' Sorry, excuse me, is this Wangsheng Funeral Parlor?
:{{A|vo htlq002 1 luocheng 02.ogg}} '''[[Luocheng]]:''' My name's Luocheng. I've had this awful feeling recently, like something's staring at me.
:{{A|vo htlq002 1 luocheng 03.ogg}} '''Luocheng:''' Some of my friends and I went to Wuwang Hill the other day on a dare. After I returned home, I fell ill... I've been having recurring nightmares, but the doctors can't find anything wrong with me.
:{{A|vo htlq002 1 luocheng 04.ogg}} '''Luocheng:''' I think that... it's a curse, right? I've been cursed by a demon!
:{{A|vo htlq002 1 hutao 07.ogg}} '''Hu Tao:''' Say no more. There's no doubt, it's a demonic curse alright — and a serious one at that.
:{{A|vo htlq002 1 luocheng 05.ogg}} '''Luocheng:''' You believe so too!? Then it's just like they say in the tales of old... The vengeful spirits of the [[god]]s who fell in the [[Archon War]] return to cast their evil curses upon mortals...
:{{A|vo htlq002 1 luocheng 06.ogg}} '''Luocheng:''' And if the curse isn't lifted, it will burn through the body, laying waste to flesh and bone! Oh, what a wretched end!
:{{A|vo htlq002 1 luocheng 07.ogg}} '''Luocheng:''' The symptoms I'm having are just like those described in the tales!
:{{A|vo htlq002 1 meng 11.ogg}} '''Meng:''' Wuwang Hill? Hmm... No, I don't think it was a curse, it was probably just Big G—
:{{A|vo htlq002 1 hutao 08.ogg}} '''Hu Tao:''' Hold your horses, both of you. There's no need to creep each other out.
:{{A|vo htlq002 1 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Isn't that exactly what you like to do, though?
:{{A|vo htlq002 1 luocheng 08.ogg}} '''Luocheng:''' Wangsheng Funeral Parlor specializes in demonic stuff like this, right? Help me, I beg you! I'm too young to die!
:{{A|vo htlq002 1 hutao 09.ogg}} '''Hu Tao:''' Alright alright, don't panic. Leave it to me, you've come to the right person.
:{{A|vo htlq002 1 hutao 10.ogg}} '''Hu Tao:''' However, in order to lift the curse, we need a suitable location... and we need to make some preparations.
:{{A|vo htlq002 1 hutao 11.ogg}} '''Hu Tao:''' Come with me, my trusty assistants. I'm going to need your help.
:{{A|vo htlq002 1 meng 12.ogg}} '''Meng:''' I—I guess I'll come too...
:{{A|vo htlq002 1 hutao 12.ogg}} '''Hu Tao:''' Help him make the preparations first. The incense exorcism, the one I taught you.
:{{A|vo htlq002 1 hutao 13.ogg}} '''Hu Tao:''' When you're ready, come and find me. Once we've finished with this, we'll get back to the Big G matter.
:{{A|vo htlq002 1 meng 13.ogg}} '''Meng:''' Okay, I guess.
:{{A|vo htlq002 1 hutao 14.ogg}} '''Hu Tao:''' Right, let's go.

;(Talk to Luocheng or Meng again, optional)
:{{A|vo dialog htlq002 luocheng 01.ogg}} '''Luocheng:''' Please help me, I don't want to die...
:{{A|vo dialog htlq002 meng 01.ogg}} '''Meng:''' Don't worry, the director is highly skilled, she'll help you find a way.
----
;(Interact with the Ley Line Monolith before meeting with Hu Tao, optional)
:'''Observe Device:''' (No matter how you look at it, this is just an ordinary Ley Line Monolith.)

;(Upon arriving at the exorcism site)
:{{A|vo htlq002 2 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So... what mysterious rituals are you gonna perform here?
:{{A|vo htlq002 2 hutao 01.ogg}} '''Hu Tao:''' No ritual at all. We just need to kill some time.
:{{A|vo htlq002 2 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Eh!?
:{{A|vo htlq002 2 hutao 02.ogg}} '''Hu Tao:''' Wait, you didn't take all that vengeful god's curse stuff seriously, did you? They were eradicated ages ago!
:{{DIcon}} So why are we here?
:{{A|vo htlq002 2 hutao 03.ogg}} '''Hu Tao:''' You saw those two. One thinks he's been cursed, the other one believes his friend's turned into an evil spirit. It's hard to reason with them.
:{{A|vo htlq002 2 hutao 04.ogg}} '''Hu Tao:''' *sigh* Now you see why I believe that ordinary folks should be kept in the dark...
:{{A|vo htlq002 2 hutao 05.ogg}} '''Hu Tao:''' I've seen too many people lose their senses on account of things like this. If you want to calm them down, you need to convince them with something tangible.
:{{A|vo htlq002 2 hutao 06.ogg}} '''Hu Tao:''' And the best way to do that is to make a great show of destroying the bogeyman they believe in before their very eyes.
:{{A|vo htlq002 2 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Uh... Sounds like that might work if you were trying to cheer up a three-year-old...
:{{DIcon}} Isn't it better to tell people the truth?
::{{A|vo htlq002 2 paimon 04a.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You're onto something. After all, we're only afraid of what we don't know.
:{{DIcon}} How old are you, Paimon?
::{{A|vo htlq002 2 paimon 04b 1.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Why would you ask that!?
::{{A|vo htlq002 2 paimon 04b 2.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Paimon just wants to know why we can't tell everyone the truth!
:{{A|vo htlq002 2 hutao 07.ogg}} '''Hu Tao:''' Because you can't guarantee that telling an ignorant person the truth will improve the situation instead of exacerbating it.
:{{A|vo htlq002 2 hutao 08.ogg}} '''Hu Tao:''' What I can do is pretend to pull back anyone who believes their time is nigh. But, since the curse is imaginary, our fix will also be make-believe.
:{{A|vo htlq002 2 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Makes sense, but... why would anyone believe that it's a curse?
:{{A|vo htlq002 2 hutao 09.ogg}} '''Hu Tao:''' Do you know the history of the [[Yaksha]]?
:{{DIcon}} Haven't heard about it.
:{{DIcon}} I know just some bits and pieces.
:{{A|vo htlq002 2 hutao 10.ogg}} '''Hu Tao:''' They once fought against the ancient gods. They fought brilliantly in a battle that engulfed the whole world in darkness. Although the gods were defeated in the end, their resentment persevered.
:{{A|vo htlq002 2 hutao 11.ogg}} '''Hu Tao:''' That resentment turned into a pestilence spreading amongst the ordinary folk. Hysteric people mistook it for "the curse of the gods."
:{{A|vo htlq002 2 hutao 12.ogg}} '''Hu Tao:''' The plague took the lives of many, which only furthered its spread, as the dead were a breeding ground for the disease.
:{{A|vo htlq002 2 hutao 13.ogg}} '''Hu Tao:''' Then, someone discovered how to prevent it from spreading: purify the air and burn the bodies of the deceased. The pioneers of these practices were, you guessed it, the founders of the Wangsheng Funeral Parlor.
:{{A|vo htlq002 2 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' ...Paimon didn't see that coming. Really?
:{{A|vo htlq002 2 hutao 14.ogg}} '''Hu Tao:''' Yes. Anyway, it took many years, but eventually the plague was completely eradicated.
:{{A|vo htlq002 2 hutao 15.ogg}} '''Hu Tao:''' We've dealt with similar phenomena multiple times throughout the ages. Each time, we successfully restore the balance between life and death.
:{{A|vo htlq002 2 hutao 16.ogg}} '''Hu Tao:''' To sum it up, we are "gatekeepers," guarding the border for the sake of both the living and the dead, hehe.
:{{DIcon}} That's what you meant by "guarding the border"?
:{{DIcon}} Never knew Wangsheng had such a long history.
:{{A|vo htlq002 2 hutao 17.ogg}} '''Hu Tao:''' So when I say this "curse" is just a figment of the imagination, I say it with more certainty than most. But I also can't really go telling people that the ancient plagues were real, or it would incite panic.
:{{A|vo htlq002 2 hutao 18.ogg}} '''Hu Tao:''' Anyway, let's wait a bit more and get ready for the show. This Ley Line Monolith will make for a really great prop.
:{{Black Screen|''A while later...''}}
:{{A|vo htlq002 2 hutao 19.ogg}} '''Hu Tao:''' Ah, you're finally here! We just finished our preparations.
:{{A|vo htlq002 2 hutao 20.ogg}} '''Hu Tao:''' Now, look here. This device is used to drive away evil spirits. It'll absorb the curse inside you and cause it to take a physical form.
:{{A|vo htlq002 2 hutao 21.ogg}} '''Hu Tao:''' But don't worry, the Traveler here is a seasoned warrior and will assure our safety.
:{{DIcon}} Doing the dirty work again...
:{{DIcon}} You failed to mention we'd need to fight.
:{{A|vo htlq002 2 hutao 22.ogg}} '''Hu Tao:''' Oh, right. I forgot to tell you, haha! It'll be fine.
:{{A|vo htlq002 2 luocheng 01.ogg}} '''Luocheng:''' Will that really solve my problem?
:{{A|vo htlq002 2 meng 01.ogg}} '''Meng:''' Trust the director. She might look like a weirdo, but she's serious about everything she does.
:{{A|vo htlq002 2 hutao 23.ogg}} '''Hu Tao:''' Ugh, how can you call me a weirdo? I mean, wouldn't you say it's more... charmingly naive? Or... disarmingly different?
:{{A|vo htlq002 2 hutao 24.ogg}} '''Hu Tao:''' Alright, let's get down to business! My glamorous assistant, please activate the device!

;(After activating the Monolith)
:{{A|vo htlq002 2 luocheng 02.ogg}} '''Luocheng:''' Is it really possible to materialize the curse!?

;(After defeating the first wave of enemies)
:{{A|vo htlq002 2 luocheng 03.ogg}} '''Luocheng:''' I'm counting on you.
----
;(After the fight)
:{{A|vo htlq002 4 hutao 01.ogg}} '''Hu Tao:''' How are you feeling? Did the curse leave your body?
:{{A|vo htlq002 4 luocheng 01.ogg}} '''Luocheng:''' Yes, I feel more invigorated than ever before! I'm cured!
:{{A|vo htlq002 4 luocheng 02.ogg}} '''Luocheng:''' I can't express how grateful I am for your and the Traveler's help! If it hadn't been for you, the curse would've taken my life.
:{{A|vo htlq002 4 hutao 02.ogg}} '''Hu Tao:''' Ah, great! In which case, I guess now I can tell you...
:{{A|vo htlq002 4 hutao 03.ogg}} '''Hu Tao:''' *fanfare* You've been pranked!
:{{A|vo htlq002 4 luocheng 03.ogg}} '''Luocheng:''' Eh? Wh—What?
:{{A|vo htlq002 4 hutao 04.ogg}} '''Hu Tao:''' This exorcism device? People like you wouldn't recognize it, but it's just an old Ley Line Monolith, deceptively effective at attracting monsters.
:{{A|vo htlq002 4 hutao 05.ogg}} '''Hu Tao:''' And those were real monsters, not a manifestation of your curse.
:{{A|vo htlq002 4 hutao 06.ogg}} '''Hu Tao:''' So riddle me this: If I didn't do anything to lift the curse, then what's the cause of your sudden recovery?
:{{A|vo htlq002 4 luocheng 04.ogg}} '''Luocheng:''' The curse... wasn't real?
:{{A|vo htlq002 4 luocheng 05.ogg}} '''Luocheng:''' ...Then why was I sick?
:{{A|vo htlq002 4 hutao 07.ogg}} '''Hu Tao:''' You caught a cold, ate something bad, or just scared yourself sick, it's anyone's guess... but I'm leaning towards the last option. It wouldn't be the first time in my career.
:{{A|vo htlq002 4 meng 01.ogg}} '''Meng:''' How unexpected...
:{{A|vo htlq002 4 luocheng 06.ogg}} '''Luocheng:''' I also didn't expect that, but still... I'd like to thank you.
:{{A|vo htlq002 4 hutao 08.ogg}} '''Hu Tao:''' Don't mention it. I found a way to deal with your fears this time, but I can't do it over and over again, so I'd appreciate it if you try not to give in to superstitions in the future.
:{{A|vo htlq002 4 hutao 09.ogg}} '''Hu Tao:''' Human life is short. Enjoy it while it lasts.
:{{A|vo htlq002 4 luocheng 07.ogg}} '''Luocheng:''' Wow, I... What a weird thing to say.
:{{A|vo htlq002 4 luocheng 08.ogg}} '''Luocheng:''' I—I shall head  back. I'm sorry for troubling you.
:{{A|vo htlq002 4 meng 02.ogg}} '''Meng:''' I feel relieved to see that it wasn't Big G's doing. However, unless he crosses the border, there will be no end to his antics.
:{{A|vo htlq002 4 meng 03.ogg}} '''Meng:''' Since we are done with the matter at hand, can we resume our search for Big G?
:{{A|vo htlq002 4 hutao 10.ogg}} '''Hu Tao:''' I believe that won't be needed.
:{{A|vo htlq002 4 hutao 11.ogg}} '''Hu Tao:''' He found us first.
:{{A|vo htlq002 4 meng 04.ogg}} '''Meng:''' Big G!?
:{{A|vo htlq002 4 bigg 01.ogg}} '''Big G:''' U—Um... I didn't mean to bother you... Any of you...
:{{A|vo htlq002 4 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' This is Big G? He's just a child!
:{{A|vo htlq002 4 hutao 12.ogg}} '''Hu Tao:''' Well, he is a spirit. It's quite normal that he looks just like he did when he left this world.
:{{A|vo htlq002 4 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Umm, that's not what Paimon imagined when Paimon first heard the name "Big G."
:{{A|vo htlq002 4 hutao 13.ogg}} '''Hu Tao:''' Let's bring him back to Wangsheng Funeral Parlor. We have much to do.
{{Dialogue End}}

;(Condition 3 — If ''Sakura Arborism'' has been completed)
::{{A|vo jqrcop001 1914601 miyuki 11.ogg}} '''Miyuki:''' Oh, it's you, Traveler. Long time no see.
::{{A|vo jqrcop001 1914601 miyuki 12.ogg}} '''Miyuki:''' Lady Yae has instructed me to clean up all the flyers on the mountain. As for why someone would put these up at a shrine in the first place...
:{{A|vo jqrcop001 1914601 miyuki 13.ogg}} '''Miyuki:''' Unbelievable. Who was behind it, I wonder?
:{{A|vo jqrcop001 1914601 miyuki 14.ogg}} '''Miyuki:''' Huh? Who's that standing behind you...?
:{{A|vo jqrcop001 1914601 shinobu 01.ogg}} '''Kuki Shinobu:''' Ahem... Miyuki. It's been a while.
:{{A|vo jqrcop001 1914601 miyuki 15.ogg}} '''Miyuki:''' Shinobu! You... you...
:{{A|vo jqrcop001 1914601 miyuki 16.ogg}} '''Miyuki:''' ...You finally decided to come back!
:{{A|vo jqrcop001 1914601 shinobu 02.ogg}} '''Kuki Shinobu:''' Sorry, no... I'm here for other reasons.
:{{A|vo jqrcop001 1914601 miyuki 17.ogg}} '''Miyuki:''' Aw, really... The whole family's worried about you. They might not always say the right thing, but deep down—
:{{A|vo jqrcop001 1914601 shinobu 03.ogg}} '''Kuki Shinobu:''' I'm doing fine, and there's no need to worry about me. There. Just tell them that.
:{{A|vo jqrcop001 1914601 miyuki 18.ogg}} '''Miyuki:''' I'm gonna need more to go on than that! What's this I've been hearing from visitors that you've joined some sort of gang since returning from Liyue? That's not the worst of the rumors, either...
:{{A|vo jqrcop001 1914601 miyuki 19.ogg}} '''Miyuki:''' As unlikely as it sounds, I have to ask... Shinobu, did you get tricked into this, or something?
:{{A|vo jqrcop001 1914601 shinobu 04.ogg}} '''Kuki Shinobu:''' I was just about to fill you in on that side of things. As it happens, the "gang" I work for...
:{{A|vo jqrcop001 1914601 shinobu 05.ogg}} '''Kuki Shinobu:''' It's actually a legitimate international organization.
:{{A|vo jqrcop001 1914601 miyuki 20.ogg}} '''Miyuki:''' Really!?
:{{DIcon}} Really!?
:{{A|vo jqrcop001 1914601 shinobu 06.ogg}} '''Kuki Shinobu:''' Shush! Ahem, our organization brings together the brightest talents from all over the world, including {{Traveler}}, for instance...
:{{A|vo jqrcop001 1914601 shinobu 07.ogg}} '''Kuki Shinobu:''' A prominent figure in both Mondstadt and Liyue who has recently joined us as our "chief advisor."
:{{DIcon}} Greetings.
:{{DIcon}} Nice to re-meet you.
:{{A|vo jqrcop001 1914601 miyuki 21.ogg}} '''Miyuki:''' Wait... Lady Yae did mention something about a world-renowned Traveler. So... that's you?
:{{DIcon}} The pleasure is all mine.
:{{DIcon}} Yes indeed.
:{{A|vo jqrcop001 1914601 shinobu 08.ogg}} '''Kuki Shinobu:''' That's right. A large part of the reason I traveled all the way to Liyue was for the opportunity to build contacts with these prominent individuals.
:{{A|vo jqrcop001 1914601 miyuki 22.ogg}} '''Miyuki:''' I see... Well, that makes sense. So, what is the name of this organization?
:{{A|vo jqrcop001 1914601 shinobu 09.ogg}} '''Kuki Shinobu:''' ..."The Arataki Gang."
:{{A|vo jqrcop001 1914601 miyuki 23.ogg}} '''Miyuki:''' Huh? "The Arataki Gang"? I feel like I've heard that name somewhere before...
:{{A|vo jqrcop001 1914601 miyuki 24.ogg}} '''Miyuki:''' Wait... That's the name on these flyers!
:{{A|vo jqrcop001 1914601 shinobu 10.ogg}} '''Kuki Shinobu:''' Ahem! I can explain, that was all due to a marketing campaign gone wrong. We came to the shrine today to clear up the misunderstanding.
:{{A|vo jqrcop001 1914601 shinobu 11.ogg}} '''Kuki Shinobu:''' Heh... Our organization is relatively new to Inazuma, and one recurring issue we've had is people misinterpreting what we're about.
:{{A|vo jqrcop001 1914601 shinobu 12.ogg}} '''Kuki Shinobu:''' So we engaged a local marketing agency to help us communicate our ethos and philosophy more effectively.
:{{A|vo jqrcop001 1914601 shinobu 13.ogg}} '''Kuki Shinobu:''' Unfortunately... something must have gotten misunderstood along the way, because the results were quite a disaster.
:{{A|vo jqrcop001 1914601 shinobu 14.ogg}} '''Kuki Shinobu:''' Although the fault lies overwhelmingly with our partner agency in this case, as a responsible organization, we think we should be the ones to apologize and deal with the fallout.
:{{A|vo jqrcop001 1914601 shinobu 15.ogg}} '''Kuki Shinobu:''' So yeah, we can deal with this and you can go ahead and get back to the shrine...
:{{A|vo jqrcop001 1914601 miyuki 25.ogg}} '''Miyuki:''' No way! This task was assigned to me by Lady Yae herself!
:{{A|vo jqrcop001 1914601 miyuki 26.ogg}} '''Miyuki:''' Look... we can clean up together, can't we? Besides, I also want to hear all about this Arataki Gang...
:{{A|vo jqrcop001 1914601 shinobu 16.ogg}} '''Kuki Shinobu:''' (Ugh... it's like she's predicted my every move.)
:{{A|vo jqrcop001 1914601 shinobu 17.ogg}} '''Kuki Shinobu:''' *sigh* Alright, fine. The flyers aren't particularly sticky. If we soften them up with water or loosen them up with wind, they'll probably peel right off.

:{{A|vo tnllq002 1 tighnari 02.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' You honored our agreement and waited here until we returned.
:{{A|vo tnllq002 1 tighnari 03.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' As such, I'll hold up my end and give you another mechanical part. Keep it safe. I'm not giving you another one if you lose it.
:{{A|vo tnllq001 karkata happy 01.ogg}} '''Mechanical Crab:''' Kolu!
:{{A|vo tnllq002 1 tighnari 04.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Glad you're satisfied. If you want more mechanical parts, take us deeper into the contaminated region.
:{{A|vo tnllq002 1 tighnari 05.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' I want to see what happened there — what caused the Avidya Forest to become like this.

;(Approach the marked area)
:{{A|vo tnllq002 2 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So this is the contaminated region that everyone's been talking about... It definitely looks different from normal!
:{{A|vo tnllq002 2 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' It's like... really creepy and suffocating...
:{{A|vo tnllq002 2 tighnari 01.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Do you feel unwell at all?
:{{DIcon}} Doing fine so far.
:{{A|vo tnllq002 2 tighnari 02.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Good. It's as I predicted: Elemental power confers a degree of resistance against the contaminated region's influence.
:{{A|vo tnllq002 2 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' How do you know that?
:{{A|vo tnllq002 2 tighnari 03.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' I haven't entered the contaminated region for a proper investigation, but I've conducted quite a few controlled experiments.
:{{A|vo tnllq002 2 tighnari 04.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' My observations during our time here have all but confirmed my hypothesis. Look at these flowers. How are they different from normal?
:{{DIcon}} They're more colorful?
:{{DIcon}} They're brighter?
:{{A|vo tnllq002 2 tighnari 05.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' This flower species is formally known as the "Sumeru Rose," but it is also known as the "Ley Line Lodestar."
:{{A|vo tnllq002 2 tighnari 06.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' They're sensitive to Ley Lines and emit varying amounts of light in response. Excessive brightness indicates a dangerous level of Ley Line activity in the surrounding area.
:{{A|vo tnllq002 2 tighnari 07.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' From the looks of things, the Ley Lines around here are already out of control.
:{{A|vo tnllq002 2 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You're saying that the contamination here is coming from Ley Lines?
:{{A|vo tnllq002 2 tighnari 08.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' I can't confirm that right now, but I think that is the case.
:{{A|vo tnllq002 2 tighnari 09.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Let's take another look around and see if we can discover more clues.
{{Dialogue End}}
{{Quest Description|update|Tighnari theorizes that the contaminated region was formed on account of a Ley Line effluence. Continue searching for clues nearby.}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Approach the marked area)
:{{A|vo tnllq002 3 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You know, we haven't seen any animals this entire time!
:{{A|vo tnllq002 3 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' The birds used to chirp really loudly, and there were a lot of foxes...
:{{A|vo tnllq002 3 tighnari 01.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' The contaminated region currently appears to have a critical efflux of Ley Line energy, which is probably the root cause of the patients' cognitive disturbances.
:{{A|vo tnllq002 3 tighnari 02.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Some animals have keen awareness. They sensed something abnormal in this area and fled.
:{{A|vo tnllq002 3 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Leaky Ley Lines sure can cause a lot of damage, huh?
:{{A|vo tnllq002 3 tighnari 03.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Like how plants have preferred growth conditions, we also gradually habituate to our surrounding environment.
:{{A|vo tnllq002 3 tighnari 04.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Climate, temperature, humidity, intensity of Ley Line energies. When people live under fixed conditions, they reach a sort of "homeostasis" with their environment.
:{{A|vo tnllq002 3 tighnari 05.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' This equilibrium is broken when the surrounding environment abruptly changes, causing people's bodies to react in abnormal ways.
:{{A|vo tnllq002 3 tighnari 06.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' If normal fluctuations in temperature occur, then our bodies automatically adjust. However, the average person cannot adapt to changes in Ley Line energy, and so they fall ill.
:{{DIcon}} Ah, I see.
:{{A|vo tnllq002 3 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Then why are we okay?
:{{A|vo tnllq002 3 tighnari 07a.ogg}} {{A|vo tnllq002 3 tighnari 07b.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' I'm not sure why you are, but {{Traveler}} and I are fine because our elemental capabilities allow us to adapt to this kind of change.
:{{A|vo tnllq002 3 tighnari 08.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Of course, it's not a good idea to spend too much time in areas with concentrated Ley Line energy. The only one who can freely traverse this place is probably the mechanical crab.
:{{A|vo tnllq001 karkata doubt 01.ogg}} '''Mechanical Crab:''' Kulilu?
:{{A|vo tnllq002 3 tighnari 09.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' That's about it for the investigation. Help me find an open space. I want to test something.

;(Approach the marked area)
:{{A|vo tnllq002 4 tighnari 01.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Environment... No wind... Target parameters... Normal...
:{{A|vo tnllq002 4 tighnari 02.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Setup complete. Excellent — looks like it's working.
:{{A|vo tnllq002 4 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What's this?
:{{A|vo tnllq002 4 tighnari 03.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' A Purification Device I made. It can absorb excess Ley Line energy and temporarily stabilize an area.
:{{A|vo tnllq002 4 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What a neat thing! Let's set up more and cover the entire region!
:{{A|vo tnllq002 4 tighnari 04.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' I wouldn't mind if that would actually work. Unfortunately, once this "contamination" is present, it isn't something that a few Purification Devices can fix.
:{{A|vo tnllq002 4 tighnari 05.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' The Purification Devices have their limits. At best, they can only prevent the contaminated region from expanding temporarily.
:{{A|vo tnllq002 4 tighnari 06.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' If we want to permanently eradicate the contamination from the Ley Line effluence, we'll need to tackle the source.
:{{DIcon}} At the heart of the contaminated region?
:{{A|vo tnllq002 4 tighnari 07.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' That's right.
:{{A|vo tnllq001 karkata doubt 01.ogg}} '''Mechanical Crab:''' Kulilu?
:{{A|vo tnllq001 karkata happy 01.ogg}} '''Mechanical Crab:''' Kolu!
:{{A|vo tnllq002 4 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh? The mechanical crab is acting a little strange.
:{{A|vo tnllq002 4 tighnari 08.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Something's approaching...
:{{A|vo tnllq002 4 tighnari 09.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' So that's it. Now that the Ley Line energy has stabilized, the monsters that had left are starting to return.
:{{A|vo tnllq002 4 tighnari 10.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Get rid of them quickly! Don't let them get close to the Purification Device!

;(After defeating the opponents)
:{{A|vo tnllq002 6 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Whew... That's all of them.
:{{A|vo tnllq001 karkata happy 01.ogg}} '''Mechanical Crab:''' Kolu!
:{{A|vo tnllq001 karkata happy 01.ogg}} '''Mechanical Crab:''' Kolu!
:{{A|vo tnllq002 6 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hey, where are you— Wait for us!
:{{A|vo tnllq002 6 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Let's hurry and keep up, {{Traveler}}!

;(After the cutscene)
:{{A|vo tnllq002 1 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' The mechanical crab went that way. Let's keep up!
{{Dialogue End}}
{{Quest Description|update|After you defeat the gathered monsters, the mechanical crab suddenly starts to run wild.}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Approach the location)
:{{A|vo tnllq002 7 jasar 01.ogg}} '''Jasar:''' Help! Heeelp!
{{Dialogue End}}
{{Quest Description|update|As it turns out, the mechanical crab had heard someone's cries for help and wanted to help. It seems to be quite different from the "ferocious" machine creatures as the people see them...}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Talk to Jasar)
:{{A|vo tnllq002 7 jasar 02.ogg}} '''Jasar:''' Aaah... Spare me, please spare me!
:{{A|vo tnllq002 7 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hey, are you okay?
:{{A|vo tnllq002 7 tighnari 01.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' These injuries are superficial. Don't move. I'll patch you up.

:{{A|vo tnllq002 7 jasar 03.ogg}} '''Jasar:''' Who are you all? What happened to those mechanical monsters?
:{{A|vo tnllq002 7 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Don't worry, we took care of them!
:{{A|vo tnllq002 7 jasar 04.ogg}} '''Jasar:''' Good. Haha... That's good...
:{{A|vo tnllq001 karkata happy 01.ogg}} '''Mechanical Crab:''' Kolu!
:{{A|vo tnllq002 7 jasar 05.ogg}} '''Jasar:''' Aaah, it's a monster! Hurry, attack it!
:{{A|vo tnllq001 karkata doubt 01.ogg}} '''Mechanical Crab:''' Kulilu?
:{{A|vo tnllq002 7 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' How do we explain this? Crabby here isn't a bad guy.
:{{A|vo tnllq002 7 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' It heard you shouting for help and brought us here to rescue you.
:{{A|vo tnllq002 7 jasar 06.ogg}} '''Jasar:''' It's faking it — it has to be! Maybe it's gonna partner up with the other mechanical monsters and kill me!
:{{A|vo tnllq002 7 jasar 07.ogg}} '''Jasar:''' Do you know what's inside the forest? It's all... It's all crawling with mechanical freaks!
:{{A|vo tnllq002 7 jasar 08.ogg}} '''Jasar:''' I just came here to pick herbs, but I accidentally went into the contaminated region and almost died.
:{{A|vo tnllq002 7 tighnari 02.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' ...
:{{A|vo tnllq002 7 jasar 09.ogg}} '''Jasar:''' I gotta get out of here. Yes... Yes, I have to escape...
:{{A|vo tnllq002 7 jasar 10.ogg}} '''Jasar:''' Be careful. These mechanical life forms are up to no good. It'd be best if you stayed far, far away from them!
:{{A|vo tnllq002 7 jasar 11.ogg}} '''Jasar:''' No wonder the Akademiya wanted to completely ban the existence of mechanical life forms. Those things should be annihilated...
:{{A|vo tnllq002 7 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Are you okay?
:{{A|vo tnllq002 7 tighnari 03.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' His inarticulate speech and bodily tremors indicate psyche disruption. He's been inside the contaminated region for too long.
:{{A|vo tnllq002 7 tighnari 04.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' We've purified the Ley Line energy over there. Follow this path out and you'll soon see the village.
:;(Jasar runs off)
:{{A|vo tnllq002 7 tighnari 05.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' When he gets to the village, someone will bring him to Collei for help. I already prepared medication that will return him to normal.
:{{A|vo tnllq001 karkata happy 01.ogg}} '''Mechanical Crab:''' Kolu!
:{{DIcon}} It looks like it's...
:{{DIcon}} Expecting something?
:{{A|vo tnllq002 7 tighnari 06.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Hmm... So you think you did a "good job" and want a part as your reward?
:{{A|vo tnllq001 karkata happy 01.ogg}} '''Mechanical Crab:''' Kolu!
:{{A|vo tnllq002 7 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' It's so hard to understand...
:{{A|vo tnllq002 7 tighnari 07.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Alright, regardless of what you're thinking, you did some real good this time.
:{{A|vo tnllq002 7 tighnari 08.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' That's why I'll give you another mechanical part. Need any help with it?
:{{A|vo tnllq001 karkata refuse 01.ogg}} '''Mechanical Crab:''' Kelukulo.
:{{A|vo tnllq002 7 tighnari 09.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Guess not. Well, make sure to hang on to it. What was going through your owner's mind when he made you, I wonder? You're like a giant mechanical crab on the outside and a fluffy little hamster on the inside.
:{{A|vo tnllq002 7 tighnari 10.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' And also, how do you feel about that person saying that you're as evil as the other mechanical life forms?
:{{A|vo tnllq001 karkata doubt 01.ogg}} '''Mechanical Crab:''' Kulilu?
:{{A|vo tnllq002 7 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Okay, it definitely doesn't understand you.
:{{A|vo tnllq002 7 tighnari 11.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' It seems like it possesses limited understanding only towards matters related to mechanical components.
:{{A|vo tnllq002 7 tighnari 12.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' "Help others to get parts." That's probably its thought process. As for why it — rather, its owner — is collecting so many components, I'm not sure.
:{{A|vo tnllq002 7 tighnari 13.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' It's getting late. Let's set up camp for the night. We'll explore further tomorrow after a night's rest.

;(Approach the marked location)
:{{A|vo tnllq002 7 tighnari 14.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Hey! Over here!
:{{A|vo tnllq002 7 tighnari 15.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Come on you big lummox, raise your head and look up!

;(Approach Tighnari)
:{{A|vo tnllq002 10 tighnari 01.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Let's set up camp here.
:{{A|vo tnllq002 10 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Alright! Paimon also thinks it's a good spot!
:{{A|vo tnllq002 10 tighnari 02.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Oh? Any particular reason?
:{{A|vo tnllq002 10 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' This place is perfect to put up a big tent!
:{{A|vo tnllq002 10 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' We can also set up a cooking pot and cook tons of delicious food!
:{{DIcon}} A very Paimon reason.
:{{A|vo tnllq002 10 tighnari 03.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' You're not wrong, but the primary reason for choosing this place is because its higher elevation keeps us away from the water vapor below.
:{{A|vo tnllq002 10 tighnari 04.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Rainforests are very wet. You should always be careful when spending the night in damp places.
:{{A|vo tnllq002 10 tighnari 05.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' For the next tasks at hand, let's divide and conquer. I'll set up the tent, you'll be in charge of making the fire, and Paimon will forage for edibles nearby.
:{{A|vo tnllq002 10 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Leave it to Paimon! Paimon's a pro!
:{{A|vo tnllq002 10 tighnari 06.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' I'm not expecting that much. Just do what you can.
:{{Black Screen|Thanks to Tighnari's guidance, you safely start a fire...}}
:{{A|vo tnllq002 10 tighnari 07.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' That's right. You can use rushes to start a fire in the wilderness.
:{{A|vo tnllq002 10 tighnari 08.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Their piths are relatively dry and can be readily set aflame. The downside is that they produce a lot of smoke.
:{{A|vo tnllq002 10 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' *sob* {{Traveler}}, Tighnari... Paimon couldn't find any food.
:{{A|vo tnllq002 10 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Paimon didn't know that rainforests had so many interesting plants until we came here! There were all sorts of weird-looking mushrooms, but Paimon didn't know which ones were edible.
:{{A|vo tnllq002 10 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Paimon also saw wild berries on the ground, and Paimon was gonna fly over and pick them up, but the dead leaves on top suddenly started moving! It freaked Paimon out!
:{{A|vo tnllq002 10 tighnari 09.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Those were probably Deadleaf Butterflies. They camouflage as dead leaves to evade predators.
:{{A|vo tnllq002 10 tighnari 10.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' My guess is that they mistook you for a bird when you flew over, so they fled. Little did they know that you were more scared than they were.
:{{A|vo tnllq002 10 tighnari 11.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Never mind. The tent's up, so you two go rest. I'll forage for food.
:{{A|vo tnllq001 karkata happy 01.ogg}} '''Mechanical Crab:''' Kolu!
:{{A|vo tnllq002 10 tighnari 12.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Oh? You found some already.
:{{DIcon}} You have my gratitude.
:{{DIcon}} It's more useful than Paimon.
::{{A|vo tnllq002 10 paimon 08b.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hey!
:{{A|vo tnllq001 karkata happy 01.ogg}} '''Mechanical Crab:''' Kolu!
:{{A|vo tnllq002 10 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Paimon understands it this time! It wants mechanical parts again!
:{{A|vo tnllq002 10 tighnari 13.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Sorry, no part this time.
:{{A|vo tnllq001 karkata doubt 01.ogg}} '''Mechanical Crab:''' Kulilu?
:{{A|vo tnllq002 10 tighnari 14.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' That task wasn't important enough. If every little thing resulted in a reward, then it might start to take advantage of the system.
:{{A|vo tnllq002 10 tighnari 15.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' I'll note little things like this and give a cumulative reward at a later time.
:{{DIcon}} Are you running low on parts...?
:{{A|vo tnllq002 10 tighnari 16.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Ahem, that is one reason.
:{{A|vo tnllq001 karkata upset 01.ogg}} '''Mechanical Crab:''' Kuli...
:{{A|vo tnllq002 10 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' It looks really sad...
:{{A|vo tnllq002 10 tighnari 17.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' ...After some further thought, it might come up with some weird misunderstanding if I don't give it something. Alright, here's another for you.
:{{A|vo tnllq001 karkata happy 01.ogg}} '''Mechanical Crab:''' Kolu!
:{{A|vo tnllq002 10 tighnari 18.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' I'm off to prepare dinner. We'll take shifts on lookout duty tonight. You two can sleep first. I'll wake you up later.
:{{A|vo tnllq002 10 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' We need lookouts?
:{{A|vo tnllq002 10 tighnari 19.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Yes.
:{{A|vo tnllq002 10 tighnari 20.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Even though most animals fled because of the Ley Lines, we can't completely let down our guard.
:{{A|vo tnllq002 10 tighnari 21.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' It's settled, then. I'll set up some pest-repelling devices so poisonous insects don't come crawling into the tent.
:{{A|vo tnllq002 10 tighnari 22.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Have a good night. Not too good, though.

;(Talk to Tighnari again)
:{{A|vo dialog tnllq002 tighnari 06.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Hm? You're still awake?
{{Dialogue End}}
{{Quest Description|update|You and Tighnari agree to trade guard shifts. It is your turn to rest first...}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Rest at the tent)
:{{A|vo tnllq002 11 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Paimon's getting sleepy... Ah! Is this because of the Ley Lines?
:{{A|vo tnllq002 11 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' It's been a while since we camped outside like this!
:{{A|vo tnllq002 11 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hehe... This feels like when we just started adventuring together! Nighty night! {{Traveler}}!
:{{Black Screen|Paimon gradually falls asleep while reminiscing...}}
:{{A|vo tnllq002 11 tighnari 01.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Hm? You're awake earlier than I expected. Did you sleep well?
:{{DIcon}} Very well.
::{{A|vo tnllq002 11 tighnari 02a.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' That's good. I was worried that you two wouldn't be able to sleep, so I used two of my homemade incenses.
::{{A|vo tnllq002 11 tighnari 02a 1.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Don't worry, they're made from all-natural ingredients. They have a light fragrance and aren't harmful to the body.
:{{DIcon}} I'm still a little sleepy.
::{{A|vo tnllq002 11 tighnari 02b.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' You have to maintain constant vigilance in dangerous places like this. Yawning all the time like that is no good.
::{{A|vo tnllq002 11 tighnari 02b 1.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' If you can't stay awake, it's okay. Go sleep some more. I'm not tired yet.
::{{DIcon}} I can manage.
::{{A|vo tnllq002 11 tighnari 02b 2.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Really? You don't need to push yourself. I'm used to staying up all night because many plant and animal species can only be observed during nighttime.
:{{A|vo tnllq002 11 tighnari 03.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Speaking of which, have you seen the crab?
:{{A|vo tnllq002 11 tighnari 04.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' It was scampering around over there just now, but I don't know where it went.
:{{DIcon}} Are you wary of it?
:{{A|vo tnllq002 11 tighnari 05.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' So you can tell. My suspicion is less towards the crab, and more directed to its unrevealed owner.
:{{A|vo tnllq002 11 tighnari 06.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' A Ley Line effluence of this magnitude occurred without any warning. Someone probably disrupted the natural flow of the Ley Lines.
:{{A|vo tnllq002 11 tighnari 07.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Until we fully understand the situation, take extra caution. The Akademiya has banned mechanical life form research for years, so the origin of these creatures is very suspect.
:{{DIcon}} Banned research?
:{{DIcon}} The Akademiya previously conducted research on mechanical life forms?
:{{A|vo tnllq002 11 tighnari 08.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Topics related to mechanical life forms were popular in the Spantamad for a time. Some of my juniors had also thrown themselves into such research.
:{{A|vo tnllq002 11 tighnari 09.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' They proposed an intriguing idea: Use our knowledge to create a "new and practical" life form that could help humanity "conquer nature."
:{{A|vo tnllq002 11 tighnari 10.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' However, no matter which modules or parts are installed, a machine is innately a construct that receives and executes commands. They can never possess self-awareness like us or other living organisms.
:{{A|vo tnllq002 11 tighnari 11.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' In their pursuit to discover the differences between mechanical and biological life forms, zealous researchers performed unregulated vivisections and other absurdly cruel experiments on animals. Research on mechanical life forms was thus banned.
:{{A|vo tnllq002 11 tighnari 12.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' The irony is that the researchers became even more impetuous afterward. Who knows, maybe the subject will be unbanned in a few years.
:{{DIcon}} Do you not like this area of research?
:{{A|vo tnllq002 11 tighnari 13.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Hmm... That's a difficult question to answer.
:{{A|vo tnllq002 11 tighnari 14.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' I'm interested in the topic of mechanical life, but I don't like the researchers' attitudes.
:{{DIcon}} Anything in particular, or...?
:{{DIcon}} Because the "conquest of nature" is bad?
:{{A|vo tnllq002 11 tighnari 15.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' It's just my personal opinion.
:{{A|vo tnllq002 11 tighnari 16.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' My ancestors and the Valuka Shuna of the desert coexisted together and supported one another. The bloodline of my people was born from this symbiotic relationship.
:{{A|vo tnllq002 11 tighnari 17.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' So to me, all life is important. To understand life, you must first respect it.
:{{A|vo tnllq002 11 tighnari 18.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Life is not an expendable commodity, and knowledge should not be wielded like a scepter. These are the points of contention I have with some researchers, and why I left the Akademiya.
:{{A|vo tnllq002 11 tighnari 19.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Once you start placing yourself above other life forms, I mean... What kind of results do you expect to get from researching pure life with impure intentions?
:{{DIcon}} I understand what you mean.
:{{A|vo tnllq002 11 tighnari 20.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Really? Well, I'm glad to hear it.
:{{A|vo tnllq001 karkata upset 01.ogg}} '''Mechanical Crab:''' Kuli...
:{{A|vo tnllq001 karkata happy 01.ogg}} '''Mechanical Crab:''' Kolu!
:{{A|vo tnllq002 11 tighnari 21.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Coffee? Did you prepare this for us?
:{{A|vo tnllq001 karkata happy 01.ogg}} '''Mechanical Crab:''' Kolu!
:{{DIcon}} It looks like it wants a reward again...
:{{A|vo tnllq002 11 tighnari 22.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Alright, seeing that you're working so hard to help out, I'll give you another part.
:{{A|vo tnllq002 11 tighnari 23.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' You're not planning on using it? Many of your own parts are critically degraded, and you're running low on power.
:{{A|vo tnllq001 karkata refuse 01.ogg}} '''Mechanical Crab:''' Kelukulo.
:{{A|vo tnllq002 11 tighnari 24a.ogg}} {{A|vo tnllq002 11 tighnari 24b.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Alright, suit yourself. Oh and thanks for the coffee, but I'm about to go to sleep. Leave it with {{Traveler}}.
:{{A|vo tnllq002 11 tighnari 25.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' The night watch is yours. Stay safe.
:;(Time skips ahead to daylight)
:{{A|vo tnllq002 11 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' S—Sorry, {{Traveler}}, Paimon slept through the entire night...
:{{DIcon}} It's okay.
::{{A|vo tnllq002 11 paimon 05a.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Really? You're not mad?
:{{DIcon}} Your punishment is solo watch duty.
::{{A|vo tnllq002 11 paimon 05b.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hehe. Don't worry, Paimon will be sure to stay awake next time!
:{{A|vo tnllq002 11 tighnari 26.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Good morning, {{Traveler}} and Paimon. Quick question, do you feel off at all?
:{{DIcon}} I'm a little dizzy.
:{{A|vo tnllq002 11 tighnari 27.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Me too. The farther in we go, the closer we get to the source of the Ley Line effluence. We'll be heading out earlier today. I'll take down the tent.
:{{A|vo tnllq002 11 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Is there something we can do?
:{{A|vo tnllq002 11 tighnari 28.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Extinguish our fire so we don't set the entire forest aflame.
:{{A|vo tnllq002 11 tighnari 29.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Also, retrieve the pest-repelling devices from last night. We don't want to affect the ecosystem here.
:{{A|vo tnllq002 11 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Got it! Paimon will take care of the fire!
:{{DIcon}} I'll retrieve the pest-repelling devices.
:{{A|vo tnllq002 11 tighnari 30.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Alright. Let's meet back here later.

:{{A|vo dialog tnllq002 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Alright! Now that the fire's out, we just need to pack up the cooking pot...

;(Talk to Tighnari before collecting the pest-repelling devices)

:{{A|vo dialog tnllq002 tighnari 03.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' I also just remembered that I forgot to apply essential oil to my tail. You probably noticed that it isn't as glossy as usual.

:{{A|vo dialog tnllq002 tighnari 04.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Hmm... Perhaps one night doesn't make too much of a difference.
:{{A|vo dialog tnllq002 tighnari 05.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' I'll make a new blend when we get back. It should make up for last night. I should have some leftover herbs from last month...

==Steps==

# Go and appraise the situation
# Engage in the duel with all your might

==Dialogue==
{{Quest Description|The Knave is well aware of the plans Lyney and the others have hatched. She proposes a deal that seems to be a good chance to get to the bottom of all this...}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Approach the ruins)
:{{A|vo arlq004 1 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What is this place?
:{{A|vo arlq004 1 arlecchino 01.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' Somewhere long forgotten by everyone. It used to be a grand building. Now, it's nothing more than a pile of rubble.
:{{A|vo arlq004 1 arlecchino 02.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' No one comes here anymore, nor does anyone care about what once happened here. Although, this place does have something to do with the story I'm about to tell you.
:{{A|vo arlq004 1 arlecchino 03.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' It was before I became a [[Harbinger]], and before Lyney and the others joined the House of the Hearth. Due to certain events, I first killed Clervie, and then her mother... and this is where it all happened.
:{{A|vo arlq004 1 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You were the one that killed Clervie!?
:{{DIcon}} Why?
:{{A|vo arlq004 1 arlecchino 04.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' Patience, now. Allow me to explain Clervie's side of the story first. I'll start from the beginning.
:<gallery widths="350">
Into the Sunlight Quest Still 1.png
</gallery>
:{{A|vo arlq004 1 arlecchino 05.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' Clervie was six years old when she was brought by her mother, [[Crucabena]], to live in the House of the Hearth. From the outside, it seemed like a fairytale — a thriving family made up of kind adults and friendly children.
:{{A|vo arlq004 1 arlecchino 06.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' Crucabena was The Knave at that time, and the House of the Hearth was under her control. She was Clervie's mother by blood, but she was also the "Mother" to all the children in the House.
:{{A|vo arlq004 1 arlecchino 07.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' Clervie was happy here... for a time. But, she quickly realized that being part of this "family"... wasn't a fairytale at all. It was a kind of purgatory.
:{{A|vo arlq004 1 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Purgatory?
:<gallery widths="350">
Into the Sunlight Quest Still 2.png
</gallery>
:{{A|vo arlq004 1 arlecchino 08.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' Exactly. The House of the Hearth takes in war orphans from all over Teyvat, but as for how to raise them... That depends entirely on the person in charge.
:{{A|vo arlq004 1 arlecchino 09.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' Crucabena came up with a novel idea. She would teach the children to fight, force them to duel each other, and then crown, as the "king" of the House, the child who proved themselves most worthy of inheriting her title.
:{{A|vo arlq004 1 arlecchino 10.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' It's difficult to estimate the number of children who died or were maimed in the process. There's little I can say about the ones who died. The ones that emerged with permanent injuries, on the other hand... Well, they still served a purpose.
:{{A|vo arlq004 1 arlecchino 11.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' They would be handed over to The Doctor to be experimented on, or sent away on dangerous missions... nothing more than tools to be used and then discarded.
:{{A|vo arlq004 1 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So those were the experiments Clervie was talking about... But what actually happened to her?
:{{A|vo arlq004 1 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You said that Clervie was Crucabena's daughter, so if Clervie tried to convince her to stop what she was doing, Crucabena probably would've listened... right?
:{{A|vo arlq004 1 arlecchino 12.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' Despite being Clervie's mother, Crucabena cared little for her daughter. She forced Clervie to join the House of the Hearth only as a means to demonstrate her own impartiality as a "Mother" — to prove that she treated all her children equally.
:{{A|vo arlq004 1 arlecchino 13.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' Clervie did try to convince her mother to change her ways, but it was to no avail. After her efforts failed, the only other option was to rise up and try to fight back. Unfortunately, the other children had already been thoroughly indoctrinated into the illusion of happiness Crucabena had created.
:{{A|vo arlq004 1 arlecchino 14.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' Of course, there was one exception... someone Clervie's age who knew the truth about the House of the Hearth. Her name was Peruere.
:{{DIcon}} "Perrie"?
:{{A|vo arlq004 1 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wait, the friend that Clervie mentioned?
:{{A|vo arlq004 1 arlecchino 15.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' "Friend," huh... I suppose we can call her that for now.
:<gallery widths="350">
Into the Sunlight Quest Still 3.png
</gallery>
:{{A|vo arlq004 1 arlecchino 16.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' Clervie was a cheerful and passionate person with a tenacious spirit. Peruere, on the other hand, was rather cold-blooded.
:{{A|vo arlq004 1 arlecchino 17.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' Her cold-blooded nature allowed her to see through Crucabena's facade. Yet, it was also this cold-bloodedness that prevented her from acting against it... at least at first. While Clervie longed for freedom, Peruere was convinced that, amid all the fighting and violence, she would make it until the end.
:{{A|vo arlq004 1 arlecchino 18.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' Despite their differences, the two became fast friends — united by their knowledge of the truth. Clervie told Peruere that she hoped to create a real family where no one would be killed or sacrificed.
:{{A|vo arlq004 1 arlecchino 19.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' There may have been a certain naivete to her ideas, but Clervie proved her determination many times over. She tried countless times to run away, ask for help, or expose the truth, but her efforts only earned her beating after beating. The only thing that kept her going was her strength of will.
:{{A|vo arlq004 1 arlecchino 20.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' Even with her body wracked with pain, she would still stand on her tip-toes and open the window at night. She and Peruere would look out at the moon together, a fierce longing for freedom shining in her eyes... But, one day, that light... simply vanished.
:{{A|vo arlq004 1 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh no... What happened?
:<gallery widths="350">
Into the Sunlight Quest Still 4.png
</gallery>
:{{A|vo arlq004 1 arlecchino 21.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' Her hopelessness resulted from a culmination of things. Ten years had passed — ten years' worth of failure after failure. She and Peruere weren't children anymore, but finding any chance to escape still seemed as hopeless as ever.
:{{A|vo arlq004 1 arlecchino 22.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' It was during this time that Peruere suggested a new plan... If escaping was out of the question, why not take down the very person sitting on top of this throne of lies — "Mother" herself.
:{{A|vo arlq004 1 arlecchino 23.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' Clervie rejected that proposal. She claimed that, as a famous Harbinger, Crucabena possessed an unimaginable amount of power. Trying to kill her would have an incredibly low chance of success.
:{{A|vo arlq004 1 arlecchino 24.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' Clervie never gave another reason, but Peruere could see it written all over her face. Clervie still thought of Crucabena as her mother. Killing her own flesh and blood was a line she couldn't bring herself to cross.
:{{A|vo arlq004 1 arlecchino 25.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' If she couldn't escape and fight back... Then only one option remained.
:{{DIcon}} Death...
:{{A|vo arlq004 1 arlecchino 26.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' Precisely. Death was the only way that she felt she could be free.
:<gallery widths="350">
Into the Sunlight Quest Still 5.png
</gallery>
:{{A|vo arlq004 1 arlecchino 27.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' It happened during a duel. When she arrived at the dueling ring that day, her partner turned out to be none other than Peruere, the very person that had stood by her side all those years. It was a fierce battle, but, ultimately, Clervie decided to let Peruere end her life.
:{{A|vo arlq004 1 arlecchino 28.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' From that moment on, Peruere's journey was one written in flames. When the rain finally came and washed it all away, there she stood — the sole victor in "Mother's" endless game of slaughter, a trail of corpses strewn across her path to success.
:{{A|vo arlq004 1 arlecchino 29.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' It was the very result she had predicted ten years prior. Even then, she believed she would make it until the end. She wasn't surprised by the fact that she emerged as "Mother's" undisputed heir. Rather, her success left her with an inexplicable sense of restlessness.
:{{A|vo arlq004 1 arlecchino 30.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' She was unsettled, and there was only one thing that could quell that sensation... Perhaps you two would like to take a guess as to what it was?
:{{DIcon}} Killing the person at the very top?
:{{A|vo arlq004 1 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Crucabena, you mean? But, but...
:{{A|vo arlq004 1 arlecchino 31.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' Correct. This is the place where Peruere killed her best friend. A mere year later, this is also the place where she fought tooth and nail to kill the "Mother" they shared.
:{{A|vo arlq004 1 arlecchino 32.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' The moment she acted, any conception of what was right or wrong ceased to matter. It's one of the principles of the House — only those who survive get to write the rules.
:{{A|vo arlq004 1 arlecchino 33.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' Peruere won the battle and became a Harbinger herself, after which Her Majesty the Tsaritsa bestowed upon her a new name... Arlecchino.
:{{A|vo arlq004 1 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So, the "Perrie" Clervie was talking about... It was you all along. You're Peruere! Arlecchino is just a name you got later!
:{{DIcon}} This was your story just as much as Clervie's...
:{{A|vo arlq004 1 arlecchino 34.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' I left that name behind long ago. I must say, hearing it now... does bring back memories.
:{{A|vo arlq004 1 arlecchino 35.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' After I defeated Crucabena, the moniker of "Mother" died with her. I chose to forgo the title she called herself and even chose to give up my own name. I rebuilt the House of the Hearth under a new identity... not only as Arlecchino, but as "Father."
:{{A|vo arlq004 1 arlecchino 36.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' And that is where the story ends. Any more questions?
:{{DIcon}} The Clervie we met, though... Who is she exactly?
:{{A|vo arlq004 1 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yeah, based on what you just told us, Clervie wasn't a little kid when she was killed. So the Clervie we met... Was she really a spirit at all?
:{{A|vo arlq004 1 arlecchino 37.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' I suppose you could call her an illusion born of flame... Her existence is like ashes to a fire — something leftover in the wake of blaze and ruin.
:{{A|vo arlq004 1 arlecchino 38.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' You see, a certain power runs through my veins. It's not unlike a curse. My flames leave behind shadows of anything they consume.
:{{A|vo arlq004 1 arlecchino 39.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' Of course, the chances of those shadows morphing into a sentient entity are exceedingly slim. Clervie is a very special case.
:{{A|vo arlq004 1 arlecchino 40.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' Clervie died when she was sixteen years old, but what emerged from the flames was her six-year-old self. Her appearance wasn't the only thing affected. Most of her memories were lost to the blaze as well.
:{{A|vo arlq004 1 arlecchino 41.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' Memory is a mysterious thing indeed. Losing a portion of your memories will alter your sense of self. Lose ten years' worth, however, and it would be like living in the past, like returning to a version of yourself that never grew up.
:{{A|vo arlq004 1 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' No wonder Paimon got such a weird feeling when we were talking to her...
:{{A|vo arlq004 1 arlecchino 42.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' Perhaps I should put it this way... Clervie is someone trapped in time. It may seem like she exists with us in the present, but she truly lives in the confines of her own past.
:{{A|vo arlq004 1 paimon 12.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So, if all of that is true, then you must've known about Clervie for a long time!
:{{A|vo arlq004 1 arlecchino 43.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' Indeed. She's a rather volatile and unstable entity. Sometimes, she would look after the children. She's even saved some of their lives.
:{{A|vo arlq004 1 arlecchino 44.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' But, other times, she would hide from me and become obsessed with revealing the "truth" about the House to anyone who will listen.
:{{A|vo arlq004 1 arlecchino 45.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' Shadows don't have the capacity to learn or grow. Any new information they encounter is quickly forgotten over time.
:{{A|vo arlq004 1 arlecchino 46.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' Your attempts to expose Clervie to sunlight... They failed, yes? The reason is actually quite simple. In Clervie's mind, the House is impossible to escape, and it is this very perception that traps her there.
:{{A|vo arlq004 1 arlecchino 47.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' But, no matter. All I have to do is kill her again and all will be resolved. I don't anticipate so much as a single speck of ash will be left behind this time.
:{{A|vo arlq004 1 paimon 13.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wait!
:{{A|vo arlq004 1 paimon 14.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Paimon can understand why you might want her gone... But isn't there any other way?
:{{A|vo arlq004 1 paimon 15.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So what if she's trapped in her six-year-old self! She's still your friend! At least talk to her first!
:{{A|vo arlq004 1 arlecchino 48.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' It's too late for that. She broke the rules, and now she must be punished. That goes for [[Filliol]] and [[Nanteuil]] as well. She's had quite the effect on them...
:{{A|vo arlq004 1 arlecchino 49.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' I hope you understand, the difference between Crucabena and myself lies in our formulation of the rules, not our policy for enforcing them. Upholding the rules without question is a trait we both share, because that is how a household should be run.
:{{A|vo arlq004 1 hero 01.ogg}} {{A|vo arlq004 1 heroine 01.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' ...
:{{A|vo arlq004 1 hero 02.ogg}} {{A|vo arlq004 1 heroine 02.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' Is this really what you want to do?
:{{A|vo arlq004 1 arlecchino 50.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' Whatever could you mean?
:{{A|vo arlq004 1 hero 03.ogg}} {{A|vo arlq004 1 heroine 03.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' Don't you... want to say a proper goodbye at least?
:{{A|vo arlq004 1 arlecchino 51.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' Whether as a "killer" or as a "Father," there are two things that must be avoided at all costs — anger and sorrow.
:{{A|vo arlq004 1 arlecchino 52.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' Anger makes you impulsive. Sorrow causes you to waver.
:{{A|vo arlq004 1 arlecchino 53.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' Well, it appears it's about time to proceed. Before we arrived, I told some of my well-behaved children to bring our troublemakers here by nightfall.
:{{A|vo arlq004 1 arlecchino 54.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' I do believe I've kept my end of the deal. I gave your friends quite a bit more time. As for what happens now, we'll just have to wait and see.
:{{A|vo arlq004 1 chapleau 01.ogg}} '''Chapleau:''' Here they are, "Father."
:{{A|vo arlq004 1 foltz 01.ogg}} '''Foltz:''' You gonna execute 'em? Seeing something like that would actually be a first for me.
:{{A|vo arlq004 1 paimon 16.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Lyney!
:{{DIcon}} Clervie...
:{{A|vo arlq004 1 lyney 01.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' I'm sorry. I heard about how you helped buy us more time...
:{{A|vo arlq004 1 lyney 02.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' But, I still failed. I couldn't find a way to fulfill her wish.
:{{A|vo arlq004 1 creirve 01.ogg}} '''Clervie:''' Huh...
:{{A|vo arlq004 1 creirve 02.ogg}} '''Clervie:''' Are you... Perrie?
:{{A|vo arlq004 1 arlecchino 55.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' Indeed. It's been a while, Clervie.
:{{A|vo arlq004 1 creirve 03.ogg}} '''Clervie:''' Perrie!
:{{A|vo arlq004 1 arlecchino 56.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' Shh... Stay right there. I'm sorry to postpone our reunion, but first, I believe certain scores need settling.
{{Quest Description|update|Once The Knave has spoken of the past, the other children of the Hearth are summoned. How will she judge them?}}
:{{A|vo arlq004 2 lyney 01.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' "Father," let me explain...
:{{A|vo arlq004 2 arlecchino 01.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' Out of my way.
:{{A|vo arlq004 2 lyney 02.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' "Father"...
:{{A|vo arlq004 2 arlecchino 02.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' You chose to conceal a threat to the House, and for that, you must be punished.
:{{A|vo arlq004 2 arlecchino 03.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' Overall, however, I suppose your wrongdoing is hardly the most egregious of the bunch, so I'll deal with your punishments later. As for right now, the more pressing concerns are the traitors among us.
:{{A|vo arlq004 2 filliol 01.ogg}} '''Filliol:''' By traitors... do you mean us?
:{{A|vo arlq004 2 nanteuil 01.ogg}} '''Nanteuil:''' "Father," let me explain. We didn't mean to—
:{{A|vo arlq004 2 arlecchino 04.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' Foltz, why don't you share what you heard.
:{{A|vo arlq004 2 foltz 01.ogg}} '''Foltz:''' Yes, "Father."
:{{A|vo arlq004 2 foltz 02.ogg}} '''Foltz:''' Secret midnight meeting number 3. Participants: Filliol, Nanteuil, [[Sotto]], [[Tadie]]...
:{{A|vo arlq004 2 foltz 03.ogg}} '''Foltz:''' Nanteuil clearly said, "If only 'Father' wasn't the one who took us in."
:{{A|vo arlq004 2 foltz 04.ogg}} '''Foltz:''' Sotto added, "I'm sick of this life. I just want to live as a normal person."
:{{A|vo arlq004 2 foltz 05.ogg}} '''Foltz:''' Filliol was the worst of them all. She called us crazies and said a bunch of mean things about "Father"...
:{{A|vo arlq004 2 filliol 02.ogg}} '''Filliol:''' I did not!
:{{A|vo arlq004 2 filliol 03.ogg}} '''Filliol:''' You're... You're lying! Foltz is trying to frame us!
:{{A|vo arlq004 2 foltz 06.ogg}} '''Foltz:''' It's not like I'm the only one who heard those things. After that, you and Tadie and a bunch of other people started talking about Clervie. You were using all those things Clervie brought up as an excuse to question "Father."
:{{A|vo arlq004 2 foltz 07.ogg}} '''Foltz:''' "We're birds locked in a cage. The only way out is to destroy it." That's what you said, wasn't it?
:{{A|vo arlq004 2 filliol 04.ogg}} '''Filliol:''' You little... You just want me gone, don't you! What did I ever do to you, huh!?
:{{A|vo arlq004 2 filliol 05.ogg}} '''Filliol:''' And you, Chapleau... Have you forgotten who stood by your sickbed, watched over you, and changed your dressings? C'mon, let's hear it, then — what's your reason for all this?
:{{A|vo arlq004 2 chapleau 01.ogg}} '''Chapleau:''' ...
:{{A|vo arlq004 2 foltz 08.ogg}} '''Foltz:''' You're wrong, Filliol.
:{{A|vo arlq004 2 foltz 09.ogg}} '''Foltz:''' We don't want you to die. You're our family.
:{{A|vo arlq004 2 filliol 06.ogg}} '''Filliol:''' Liar. You wouldn't be doing this if that were the case. So, why? Why have you backed us into a corner?

:{{A|vo arlq004 2 foltz 12.ogg}} '''Foltz:''' That's why the House of the Hearth cannot tolerate any form of betrayal. Ever since we came to Poisson, you've had seven secret meetings. A lot of the things you talked about really crossed the line.
:{{A|vo arlq004 2 filliol 07.ogg}} '''Filliol:''' You've been spying on us for half a month? Wait a second, now that I think about it... The move to Poisson was just a way to make it easier to spy on us, wasn't it? 'Cause we were all in one place! You've had this planned all along...
:{{A|vo arlq004 2 chapleau 02.ogg}} '''Chapleau:''' Filliol, Nanteuil, I'm sorry...
:{{A|vo arlq004 2 chapleau 03.ogg}} '''Chapleau:''' I owe you both my life. I owe Clervie too. If it weren't for all your help after I got poisoned, I wouldn't be standing here today.
:{{A|vo arlq004 2 chapleau 04.ogg}} '''Chapleau:''' If this were any other situation, I would do anything to repay that kindness, even if it cost me my life. But, rules are rules. I'm sorry, my hands are tied.
:{{A|vo arlq004 2 filliol 08.ogg}} '''Filliol:''' Why... *sobbing*... Why...
:{{A|vo arlq004 2 nanteuil 02.ogg}} '''Nanteuil:''' That's enough, Filliol. We made a mistake, and we should own up to it. We broke the rules — plain and simple, and now we have to face the consequences.

:{{A|vo arlq004 2 arlecchino 05.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' Chapleau, according to the rules of the House of the Hearth, how should these traitors be punished?

:{{A|vo arlq004 2 arlecchino 06.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' And so it shall be.
:{{A|vo arlq004 2 filliol 09.ogg}} '''Filliol:''' *sobbing*...
:{{A|vo arlq004 2 lyney 03.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' "Father"! Please wait!
:{{A|vo arlq004 2 arlecchino 07.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' Something you want to say, Lyney?
:{{A|vo arlq004 2 lyney 04.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' ...Please reconsider, "Father." What Filliol and the others did... Does it really count as betrayal?
:{{A|vo arlq004 2 lyney 05.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' We all come from broken families. From the very first day we joined the House of the Hearth, we wanted nothing more than to make it a real home.
:{{A|vo arlq004 2 lyney 06.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' But the truth is... none of us know what a real home should look like.
:{{A|vo arlq004 2 lyney 07.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' I'm not saying I have all the answers. All I know is this — killing Filliol and the others may uphold the rules, but doing so will only bring us further away from being a real family than we've ever been.
:{{A|vo arlq004 2 lyney 08.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' So, please, "Father"... Please reconsider!
:{{A|vo arlq004 2 lynette 01.ogg}} '''Lynette:''' I agree with Lyney.
:{{A|vo arlq004 2 freminet 01.ogg}} '''Freminet:''' "Father," please...
:{{A|vo arlq004 2 nanteuil 05.ogg}} '''Nanteuil:''' Lyney, you...
:{{A|vo arlq004 2 chapleau 06.ogg}} '''Chapleau:''' I also agree with Lyney.
:{{A|vo arlq004 2 arlecchino 08.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' ...
:{{A|vo arlq004 2 arlecchino 09.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' An order, once given, cannot be rescinded.
:{{A|vo arlq004 2 arlecchino 10.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' However, given the extent of your determination, I suppose we shall have to go about this a different way... Draw your weapons, and face me.
:{{A|vo arlq004 2 lyney 09.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Our weapons...?
:{{A|vo arlq004 2 lynette 02.ogg}} '''Lynette:''' "Father," are you referring to a duel?
:{{A|vo arlq004 2 arlecchino 11.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' Precisely. The rules of the House will not be altered. Traitors must be punished.
:{{A|vo arlq004 2 arlecchino 12.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' However, resolving disputes with a duel is also one of our rules, one that also applies to me. Demonstrate a sufficient showing of strength, and I shall offer a concession.
:{{A|vo arlq004 2 freminet 02.ogg}} '''Freminet:''' Wait... Beat... "Father" in a duel...?
:{{A|vo arlq004 2 foltz 13.ogg}} '''Foltz:''' Impossible. "Father" is way too strong, even for Lyney.
:{{A|vo arlq004 2 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Did you hear that, {{Traveler}}?
:{{A|vo arlq004 2 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Lyney and the others have to duel The Knave! What should we do? Can they really win something like that?
:{{A|vo arlq004 2 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' If they lose, those people from the House are really gonna be executed... Hey, are you listening?

:{{A|vo arlq004 2 arlecchino 13.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' Anger makes you impulsive. Sorrow causes you to waver.

:{{A|vo arlq004 2 lyney 10.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' When guests are around, families are often on their best behavior... and any disputes are less likely to escalate...
:{{A|vo arlq004 2 arlecchino 14.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' When the time comes, make the choice that you deem most appropriate in the situation, and lend your help to the House of the Hearth.

:{{A|vo arlq004 3 arlecchino 06.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' Indeed. They're the product of a secret experiment. Under certain special circumstances, flames can be extracted from my person and preserved.
:{{A|vo arlq004 3 arlecchino 07.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' Once ingested, searing pain will spread across every inch of your body. No harm will come to you physically, but your memories will be burned away.
:{{A|vo arlq004 3 arlecchino 08.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' If you can withstand the pain... When you awake, you'll have forgotten everything you know about the House of the Hearth, and will be expelled from the organization.

:{{A|vo arlq004 3 filliol 03.ogg}} '''Filliol:''' Even so... Even so... *sobbing*... I won't have to live in fear anymore...
:{{A|vo arlq004 3 filliol 04.ogg}} '''Filliol:''' I'm sorry, "Father." I'm sorry I let you down. But I... I really...
:{{A|vo arlq004 3 arlecchino 12.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' Don't cry, Filliol.
:{{A|vo arlq004 3 arlecchino 13.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' You haven't left the House yet, so there are still rules to be followed, yes? Remember what I taught you — anger makes you impulsive, sorrow causes you to waver. Don't let yourself be controlled by your emotions.

:{{A|vo arlq004 3 arlecchino 17.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' Goodbye, children. The next time we meet, I will no longer be your "Father."
:{{A|vo arlq004 3 arlecchino 18.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' Thank you for all you've done for the House. I hope you have bright futures ahead of you.

:{{A|vo arlq004 3 creirve 01.ogg}} '''Clervie:''' Can we talk now? I've been waiting for a super long time.

:{{A|vo arlq004 3 creirve 04.ogg}} '''Clervie:''' Oh... Okay then.
:{{A|vo arlq004 3 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh? That's it? You accepted it just like that?
:{{A|vo arlq004 3 creirve 05.ogg}} '''Clervie:''' Yep. If that's what Perrie says happened, then I believe her. Perrie wouldn't lie to me.
:{{A|vo arlq004 3 creirve 06.ogg}} '''Clervie:''' Plus, I don't really need to know why I'm like this. I'm more curious about what happens in the future. If you're a Harbinger now, Perrie, that means Mother is gone, isn't she?
:{{A|vo arlq004 3 creirve 07.ogg}} '''Clervie:''' Can you tell me about it? I wanna know what happened to her... and to me.
:{{A|vo arlq004 3 arlecchino 21.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' You never stopped trying to defy fate.
:{{A|vo arlq004 3 arlecchino 22.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' At first, no one believed you. You could only vent your frustrations to the moon. In fact, you often sought comfort in the night sky. You wanted to see the aurora, so one night, we promised each other we would go to [[Snezhnaya]] to see it together.
:{{A|vo arlq004 3 arlecchino 23.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' Later on, you tried to run away, but you were brought back each time. "Mother" spared your life, but it wasn't out of kindness. Instead, she decided to make an example of you by slowly torturing you over time. That way, the other children would know what happens to traitors.
:{{A|vo arlq004 3 arlecchino 24.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' Still, you never gave up. "Mother" hoped that, through ruthless duel after ruthless duel, she would be able to crown an ultimate victor among the children she raised.
:{{A|vo arlq004 3 arlecchino 25.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' But you called on everyone to unite, to fight to a draw in order to reduce casualties. Your efforts may have only delayed the inevitable, but still... you gave them hope.
:{{A|vo arlq004 3 arlecchino 26.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' You tried everything you could think of, but every attempt ended in failure. Still, you never turned your sword on Crucabena, and you never turned it on me. On that gloomy day, you told me—
:{{A|vo arlq004 3 arlecchino 27.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' "For the last sixteen years of my life, I've done everything I can to fight for freedom. But now, I realize that the only freedom I truly possess is the freedom to choose to die."
:{{A|vo arlq004 3 creirve 08.ogg}} '''Clervie:''' I never imagined I would say something like that. I must've been feeling really worn down.
:{{A|vo arlq004 3 creirve 09.ogg}} '''Clervie:''' But, somehow, I still think I understand. According to Mother's plan, only one of us was going to make it until the end... And I always hoped that person would be you.
:{{A|vo arlq004 3 creirve 10.ogg}} '''Clervie:''' If I could do it all over again, I still don't think I would make a different choice. Even when I first met you, I knew you'd be able to do what I couldn't.
:{{A|vo arlq004 3 arlecchino 28.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' Is that so? Even now, I'm not sure I truly understand what kind of freedom you were trying to pursue.
:{{A|vo arlq004 3 arlecchino 29.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' But, as the head of the House of the Hearth and as the children's "Father," I've tried to give them the most basic of freedoms — the freedom to choose their own fate.

:{{A|vo arlq004 3 arlecchino 31.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' Of course, I won't simply hand freedom to them on a silver platter. They have to fight for it and prove themselves worthy of it. Only freedom that is earned has true value.
:{{A|vo arlq004 3 creirve 11.ogg}} '''Clervie:''' That's more than enough. That's exactly the kind of life I was fighting for.
:{{A|vo arlq004 3 creirve 12.ogg}} '''Clervie:''' Y'know, Perrie... I think you're a pretty amazing "king" and a really great "Father" too.
:{{A|vo arlq004 3 creirve 13.ogg}} '''Clervie:''' I'm really happy that you're the one who took over the House. I guess I do have one regret, though. I still haven't seen the outside world!
:{{A|vo arlq004 3 arlecchino 32a.ogg}}<!--{{A|vo arlq004 3 arlecchino 32b.ogg}}--> '''The Knave:''' ...Well, it just so happens that our dear guests over here have been to many nations and traveled to countless places. Perhaps they would be willing to tell you what the outside world is like.

::{{A|vo arlq004 3 cs2 arlecchino 06.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' You are no longer tied to this place, nor are you bound by its rules
::{{A|vo arlq004 3 cs2 creirve 01.ogg}} '''Clervie:''' You're saying that I can finally leave?
::{{A|vo arlq004 3 cs2 creirve 02.ogg}} '''Clervie:''' I... get to experience the outside world as well?
::{{A|vo arlq004 3 cs2 creirve 03.ogg}} '''Clervie:''' Oh... I almost forgot...
::{{A|vo arlq004 3 cs2 creirve 04.ogg}} '''Clervie:''' There's no getting older for me...
::{{A|vo arlq004 3 cs2 creirve 05.ogg}} '''Clervie:''' Still, seeing who you grew up to be...
::{{A|vo arlq004 3 cs2 creirve 06.ogg}} '''Clervie:''' Makes me really happy, Peruere
::{{A|vo arlq004 3 cs2 creirve 07.ogg}} '''Clervie:''' Take care of yourself
::{{A|vo arlq004 3 cs2 creirve 08.ogg}} '''Clervie:''' Goodbye!
