:{{A|vo arlq004 4 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Clervie...
:{{A|vo arlq004 4 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' She left so soon... Paimon didn't even get to finish her story...
:{{A|vo arlq004 4 arlecchino 01.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' I also have certain sentiments left unsaid.
:{{A|vo arlq004 4 arlecchino 02.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' I wanted to tell her that the aurora I saw in Snezhnaya was just as beautiful as the ones in the pictures.
:{{A|vo arlq004 4 arlecchino 03.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' But, a shadow's memories reset at dawn. Had we delayed any longer, we wouldn't have had the time to say goodbye.
:{{A|vo arlq004 4 arlecchino 04.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' Whatever regrets may linger... let them be lost to the coming of a new day.
:{{A|vo arlq004 4 lyney 01.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' "Father"... *cough*
:{{A|vo arlq004 4 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' It's Lyney and the others! Hey, Lyney—
:{{A|vo arlq004 4 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What is he doing back here? Let's go check it out!
:{{A|vo arlq004 4 lyney 02.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' "Father"... The bottled flames have been administered. Filliol and the others have left the House.
:{{A|vo arlq004 4 arlecchino 05.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' And you? What have you decided?
:{{A|vo arlq004 4 lyney 03.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' *ahem*... Thank you for giving us that choice, "Father." But we never wanted to leave the House. It's the only home we've ever known.
:{{A|vo arlq004 4 lyney 04.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Lynette and Freminet feel the same way. They're recuperating back at the Hotel Bouffes d'ete. But, I decided to come back and tell you where we stood.
:{{A|vo arlq004 4 arlecchino 06.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' I'm sure you're well aware of the expectations I have for you. I want you to follow in my footsteps and become the next "king" of the House. Yet, you seem to have different ideas.
:{{A|vo arlq004 4 arlecchino 07.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' I must admit, I'm rather surprised by your decision to stay. There's nothing wrong with choosing to live a quiet life. Leading this organization is a heavy responsibility, one not so easily carried by someone forced onto the throne.
:{{A|vo arlq004 4 lyney 05.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' I just... never understood what you saw in me... what made you believe I was deserving of that throne.
:{{A|vo arlq004 4 arlecchino 08.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' You're brave, talented... And, most importantly, you cherish your family.
:{{A|vo arlq004 4 arlecchino 09.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' You would do anything to protect them — even if it costs you your life.
:{{A|vo arlq004 4 lyney 06.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' ...
<!-- flashback begins -->
:{{A|vo arlq004 4 chapleau 01.ogg}} '''Chapleau:''' Speaking up back there was so brave of you, Lyney! It's all thanks to you that we were able to convince "Father" to back down.
:{{A|vo arlq004 4 foltz 01.ogg}} '''Foltz:''' You're a hero, Lyney!
:{{A|vo arlq004 4 lyney 07.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' (Hero... "Father" is the real hero.)
<!-- flashback ends -->
:{{A|vo arlq004 4 lyney 08.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' (Had "Father" gone all out during the duel, there's no way I would've walked away with my life. She must have had it all planned from the beginning, from the very moment she suggested a duel...)
:{{A|vo arlq004 4 lyney 09.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' I'm not deserving of that title. I'm not strong enough or smart enough...
:{{A|vo arlq004 4 arlecchino 10.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' You're wrong.
:{{A|vo arlq004 4 arlecchino 11.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' In my opinion, all you need to be deserving of the throne is conviction, and the necessary strength to act on it.
:{{A|vo arlq004 4 arlecchino 12.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' We may have different ideas of what it means to be a family, but you can hardly be said to lack conviction. What you truly lack is strength. For someone of your talent, though, that's something that will come with time.
:{{A|vo arlq004 4 arlecchino 13.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' Even without that strength, you still chose to face me in a duel even though the odds were stacked against you. That capacity to honor your convictions is what I truly see in you.
:{{A|vo arlq004 4 lyney 10.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' "Father"...
:{{A|vo arlq004 4 arlecchino 14.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' No one knows what the future holds, what tragedy or triumph may be in store. Being at the head of this organization requires the strength of will to face whatever comes. Caution will only hold you back.
:{{A|vo arlq004 4 arlecchino 15.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' If reaching a certain standard were required to go after what you want, I would never have succeeded in killing my predecessor. Back then, there was still a considerable gap between our abilities.
:{{A|vo arlq004 4 arlecchino 16.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' Strength may decide the ultimate victor, but those who let a lack of strength dictate their decisions or undermine their convictions will never be worthy of the throne.
:{{A|vo arlq004 4 lyney 11.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' I understand, "Father." Thank you.
:{{A|vo arlq004 4 arlecchino 17.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' Children must grow up to surpass their parents... Only then can a family continue to flourish.
:{{A|vo arlq004 4 arlecchino 18.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' The road ahead is not an easy one, so I'll ask you one last time. Are you certain you want to stay?
:{{A|vo arlq004 4 lyney 12.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' You've done so much for me, "Father," and that kindness must be repaid. Plus, with [[Project Stuzha]] at hand, there are many dangers ahead, and I, for one, don't intend to back down.
:{{A|vo arlq004 4 lyney 13.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' ...Protecting my family at all costs — that's my conviction.
:{{A|vo arlq004 4 arlecchino 19.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' Then you're welcome to stay. As for Project Stuzha, you need not be too concerned. If those cowardly businessmen and heartless dignitaries try to take us down, I'm prepared to teach them a lesson.
:{{A|vo arlq004 4 arlecchino 20.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' Having members who longed for the light was our organization's last weakness. With those members no longer among our ranks, the House of the Hearth is like a spider hiding in the shadows — we need only wait for our prey to come to us.
:{{A|vo arlq004 4 arlecchino 21.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' At present, our imperative is to use their plan to our advantage. In doing so, a crimson moon shall rise amid the frigid blizzards of winter. No demonstration of loyalty shall go unrewarded, and no sacrifice shall be in vain.
:{{A|vo arlq004 4 arlecchino 22.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' As for the two of you, whether we meet again as friend or foe, I'll remember the camaraderie we shared in this moment.
:{{A|vo arlq004 4 arlecchino 23.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' No matter how arduous the journey ahead, I hope we both reach our desired destination.
----

;(Approach Freminet and Lynette)
:{{A|vo arlq004 5 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Lynette, Freminet, how are you feeling?
:{{A|vo arlq004 5 lynette 01.ogg}} '''Lynette:''' Much better.
:{{A|vo arlq004 5 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Phew, what a relief!
:{{A|vo arlq004 5 lynette 02.ogg}} '''Lynette:''' What about you? Are you feeling alright?
:{{DIcon}} There's no need to worry.
:{{DIcon}} I'm right as rain!
:{{A|vo arlq004 5 freminet 01.ogg}} '''Freminet:''' I knew you'd come out unscathed... Us, on the other hand, well... We've been bedridden for two days. I couldn't even turn over.
:{{A|vo arlq004 5 freminet 02.ogg}} '''Freminet:''' Oh, and I wanted to ask... Is Clervie... gone?
:{{A|vo arlq004 5 freminet 03.ogg}} '''Freminet:''' Lyney and the other members have left Poisson and returned to the House of the Hearth. According to him, there haven't been any more sightings of a spirit roaming the House.
:{{DIcon}} We bid her farewell under a blanket of sunlight.
:{{DIcon}} Her wish has been fulfilled.
:{{A|vo arlq004 5 lynette 03.ogg}} '''Lynette:''' I see...
:{{A|vo arlq004 5 freminet 04.ogg}} '''Freminet:''' I'm glad...
:{{A|vo arlq004 5 freminet 05.ogg}} '''Freminet:''' "Father" came to check up on us two days ago and told us about what happened with Crucabena and Clervie. Actually, I... I've met Crucabena before.
:{{A|vo arlq004 5 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wait, what? You've met the former Knave?
:{{A|vo arlq004 5 freminet 06.ogg}} '''Freminet:''' Crucabena died a year after Clervie. It was during the year between their deaths that I joined the House of the Hearth.
:{{A|vo arlq004 5 freminet 07.ogg}} '''Freminet:''' Crucabena had an extremely cruel and radical way of doing things. While she was alive, the atmosphere in the House was suffocating.
:{{A|vo arlq004 5 freminet 08.ogg}} '''Freminet:''' When I joined, though, the experiments she valued so much had already come to an end, and all the people involved — dead and injured alike — were gone. Crucabena never talked about the past with us newcomers.
:{{A|vo arlq004 5 freminet 09.ogg}} '''Freminet:''' A couple months after I joined, "Father" killed Crucabena and burned all her files. With that, the names of all the people subjected to her experiments — Clervie included — were lost to the flames, along with the painful memories they represented.
:{{A|vo arlq004 5 lynette 04.ogg}} '''Lynette:''' "Father" took in Lyney and me a couple months after that, but she never mentioned anything about Crucabena or Clervie.
:{{A|vo arlq004 5 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hmm, it really seems like something she was planning to keep to herself.
:{{A|vo arlq004 5 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' The last time you talked to her, did she mention why she kept it a secret for so long?
:{{A|vo arlq004 5 lynette 05.ogg}} '''Lynette:''' She said she didn't want us to be affected by the darkness of the past. She was worried we'd develop a false sense of gratitude towards her if we knew about it.
:{{A|vo arlq004 5 lynette 06.ogg}} '''Lynette:''' "The foundation of a family should be free of any corrupting influence. Whatever happened in the past, it has nothing to do with who we are now."
:{{A|vo arlq004 5 lynette 07.ogg}} '''Lynette:''' ...That's what "Father" told us in the end.
:{{A|vo arlq004 5 freminet 10.ogg}} '''Freminet:''' But, I still thanked her for everything. It was only after hearing about what Crucabena did that I finally realized how insignificant our lives could have been... The members of the House meant nothing to her. To say that she valued them in any way, even just as a tool, would probably be giving her too much credit.
:{{A|vo arlq004 5 freminet 11.ogg}} '''Freminet:''' If "Father" hadn't taken over the House of the Hearth, I probably would've already...
:{{DIcon}} Don't think about that.
:{{DIcon}} She saved you in the end.
:{{A|vo arlq004 5 lynette 08.ogg}} '''Lynette:''' "Father" rarely brings up the fact that she saved us. She doesn't believe that being indebted to her should be what ties us together.
:{{A|vo arlq004 5 lynette 09.ogg}} '''Lynette:''' But, even if we didn't owe her anything, we would still choose to stay. Because this is our home.
:{{A|vo arlq004 5 lynette 10.ogg}} '''Lynette:''' We may have arguments or times when we feel wronged. Some people may even choose to leave. But, as long as "Father" is here, we will always have a home.
:{{A|vo arlq004 5 freminet 12.ogg}} '''Freminet:''' Whether the path before us is bathed in sunlight or shrouded in shadow, we'll follow "Father" wherever she chooses to go.
:{{A|vo arlq004 5 freminet 13.ogg}} '''Freminet:''' So, I wanted to say thank you for helping us make it through this crisis. Without your help, we could've lost a lot more along the way.
:{{A|vo arlq004 5 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, we didn't do anything, really.
:{{DIcon}} Just invite us back as guests and we'll call it even!
:{{A|vo arlq004 5 freminet 14.ogg}} '''Freminet:''' Of course! You're welcome any time.
:{{A|vo arlq004 5 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Are... Filliol and Nanteuil okay?
:{{A|vo arlq004 5 lynette 11.ogg}} '''Lynette:''' I actually saw them at a cafe this morning.
:{{A|vo arlq004 5 lynette 12.ogg}} '''Lynette:''' They didn't recognize me. From what I could tell, they were drinking coffee and talking about one of the operas that started running recently.
:{{A|vo arlq004 5 lynette 13.ogg}} '''Lynette:''' They seemed happy. If I had to take a guess, I would say they finally found the kind of life they always wished for.
{{Dialogue End}}

::Dear Lauren, my sweetest daughter, I have no choice but to say goodbye to you in this way. Since our separation, not a moment goes by when I do not wish that I could leave for Fortress of Meropide as soon as possible and come back to you — to go back to being the father you looked up to the most.
::<br>
::Perhaps I'm the only one who naively believes that sinners are forgiven. The moment one is handed a sentence, they are already dead, leaving only a husk of flesh that must atone. Nobody shows compassion for the flesh — it is utterly filthy, and utterly worthless.

::<br>

::<br>
::No matter how you feel inside about a father like me, I still want you to know that I wish I could see you, and that I love you very much.

:{{A|vo dyzlq003 17 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' No, not at all. Paimon didn't know you were so considerate.
:{{A|vo dyzlq003 17 wriothesley 02.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' Heh, if you ask me, I'd say I actually feel very helpless. There's no way that I could truly empathize with the fear that the members felt every day.
:{{A|vo dyzlq003 17 wriothesley 03.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' I could comfort and compensate them all I want, but it might still not be enough to repair the damage that has been done.
:{{A|vo dyzlq003 17 wriothesley 04.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' I have to take responsibility for it, as does the Fortress.
:{{DIcon}} At least we were able to stop it before it got any worse, right?
::{{A|vo dyzlq003 17 wriothesley 05a 1.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' Yeah, it's the least that we could do.
:{{DIcon}} Maybe you should give a more formal apology.
::{{A|vo dyzlq003 17 wriothesley 05b 1.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' You're right. Besides formal apologies and reprimands, I also probably need to head upstairs to have a talk about how best to manage the guards.
:{{DIcon}} You sound more serious than usual.
::{{A|vo dyzlq003 17 wriothesley 05c 1.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' Even I wouldn't be able to find humor in a situation like this.
:{{A|vo dyzlq003 17 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So, do you have a plan for how you're gonna deal with him yet?
:{{A|vo dyzlq003 17 wriothesley 06.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' Oh, Dougier? I've already got an idea.
:{{A|vo dyzlq003 17 wriothesley 07.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' For now, I think I'll do nothing.
:{{A|vo dyzlq003 17 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh? Why?
:{{A|vo dyzlq003 17 wriothesley 08.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' I think it's a very fitting punishment for him to have to imagine the sorts of punishments that will soon be coming his way.
:{{A|vo dyzlq003 17 wriothesley 09.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' He'll be left in the dark with regards to both the dates and the details of his punishment.
:{{A|vo dyzlq003 17 wriothesley 10.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' Of course, that's not to say that I'll be letting him off scot-free. It's not often that I actually get the chance to be creative with my punishments.
:{{A|vo dyzlq003 17 wriothesley 11.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' I'm going to talk to the members of the Society. He'll get a chance to experience everything that he's ever inflicted on them.
:{{DIcon}} Good idea.
:{{DIcon}} I suppose this is a kind of punishment that only the Fortress can mete out.
:{{A|vo dyzlq003 17 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Paimon didn't know you could also be so harsh... Looks like she should watch her tongue when she's around you in the future.
:{{A|vo dyzlq003 17 wriothesley 12.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' Why do you think I'd do that kind of thing to you? You offend me, Paimon.
:{{A|vo dyzlq003 17 wriothesley 13.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' Anyway, jokes aside, thank you so much for all of your help. There's still a lot for me to take care of, so...
:{{A|vo dyzlq003 17 wriothesley 14.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' How about this? I'll treat you to a meal in two days at the Coupon Cafeteria. We should have a better handle on things by then.
:{{A|vo dyzlq003 17 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Uh... No, Paimon's had enough of that place...
:{{A|vo dyzlq003 17 wriothesley 15.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' Don't worry, it won't be the same old Welfare Meal. I'll make the necessary arrangements.
:{{A|vo dyzlq003 17 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, then you've got yourself a deal!
----
{{Quest Description|Now that Dougier's questionable ambitions have been completely shattered, it seems like things are settling down. But will the victims fully recover from this incident? You agree to meet up with Wriothesley two days later for an update on his progress.}}
;(Approach the Coupon Cafeteria, where several Super Deluxe Welfare Meals sit prepared on a table)
:{{A|vo dyzlq003 18 wriothesley 01.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' Ah, you're here.
:{{A|vo dyzlq003 18 paimon 01a.ogg}} {{A|vo dyzlq003 18 paimon 01b.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Paimon never forgets about meals! Even if {{Traveler}} forgets, Paimon will remind {{MC|m=him|f=her}} for sure!
:{{DIcon}} You say that as if I haven't been feeding you or something...
:{{A|vo dyzlq003 18 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ah, that's not what Paimon meant at all! Wriothesley, you got what Paimon meant, right...?
:{{A|vo dyzlq003 18 wriothesley 02.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' Mm? I'm a little confused, actually.
:{{A|vo dyzlq003 18 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hey, not you, too!
:{{A|vo dyzlq003 18 wriothesley 03.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' Jokes aside, I've got some good news. After taking a look, the doctors have let me know that it shouldn't be too difficult to extract the thorns.
:{{A|vo dyzlq003 18 wriothesley 04.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' Which means that everyone should be able to recover after a period of rest.
:{{A|vo dyzlq003 18 wriothesley 05.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' As for their mental recoveries, most are making good progress as well. We've added a few who were more severely affected to a special observation list.
:{{A|vo dyzlq003 18 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You've sure got everything taken care of, Wriothesley!
:{{A|vo dyzlq003 18 wriothesley 06.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' I try my best. After all, it's my duty to take care of everything that happens within my territory.
:{{DIcon}} I have a question for you, actually.
:{{A|vo dyzlq003 18 wriothesley 07.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' Please go ahead.
:{{DIcon}} Your flashbacks when you picked up the gem...
:{{DIcon}} Your anger when you confronted Dougier...
:{{A|vo dyzlq003 18 wriothesley 08.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' Ah, that's a bit of a long story...
:{{A|vo dyzlq003 18 wriothesley 09.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' I once had a similar experience. It had to do with the host family I lived with as a child...
:{{Color|menu|Wriothesley tells you about his adoptive family...}}
:;(A flashback begins)
:{{A|vo dyzlq003 18 wriothesley 10.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' I was an orphan adopted by a couple with a great deal of love in their hearts. I had many siblings, and we all adored each other.
:{{A|vo dyzlq003 18 wriothesley 11.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' Once we were older, Mom and Dad would turn us over to be individually adopted by families of greater means, and go on to adopt more young children...
:{{A|vo dyzlq003 18 wriothesley 12.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' They were perfect parents — or so I thought.
:;(Flashback ends)
:{{A|vo dyzlq003 18 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' And then...?
:{{A|vo dyzlq003 18 wriothesley 13.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' And then I found out we were merely raised as livestock. Once we had reached a certain age, our "parents" would bring us to the market for sale.
:{{A|vo dyzlq003 18 wriothesley 14.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' All children that were sold would leave the house, and nobody would know what became of them. As for those who didn't sell... they were merely "disposed of."
:{{A|vo dyzlq003 18 wriothesley 15.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' Did you know? I once considered myself an extremely lucky child. And all of my friends — all of my siblings — they all felt this way as well...
:{{Color|menu|Wriothesley recounts the loss of his siblings...}}
:;(A flashback begins)
:{{A|vo dyzlq003 18 wriothesley 16.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' I was also not the first to find out about the truth. All those who found out before me were simply added to the disposal pile.
:{{A|vo dyzlq003 18 wriothesley 17.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' I could never shake the feeling of irony every time I juxtaposed their tragic ends against our parents' adoring smiles.
:{{DIcon}} That explains a lot...
:{{A|vo dyzlq003 18 wriothesley 18.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' Yes, like the Society, my parents created a facade of joy, lied to satiate their desires, and even employed incredibly cruel methods to keep their grasp on power.
:{{A|vo dyzlq003 18 wriothesley 19.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' They did all of that, but never considered how their actions would utterly ruin all the children they took under their wing. Worse, perhaps they never cared about that at all.
:{{A|vo dyzlq003 18 wriothesley 20.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' —But I did.
:;(Flashback ends)
:{{A|vo dyzlq003 18 wriothesley 21.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' So, in the end, I killed them, and set all of the remaining children free. I was convicted for my crimes, and exiled to the Fortress of Meropide.
:{{A|vo dyzlq003 18 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh...
:{{A|vo dyzlq003 18 wriothesley 22.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' My methods were extreme, yes...
:{{A|vo dyzlq003 18 wriothesley 23.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' But I was still a teenager at the time. I'd been betrayed by those I trusted most, and I didn't think that more "moderate" ways would solve the problem.
:{{A|vo dyzlq003 18 wriothesley 24.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' My doubt and helpless anger pushed me forward until I got what I deserved.
:{{DIcon}} I have to... take some time to process that.
:{{DIcon}} I don't really know what to say.
:{{A|vo dyzlq003 18 wriothesley 25.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' It's alright, you don't have to tell me what you think. I've already committed to this path, regardless of what anyone may say about it.
:{{A|vo dyzlq003 18 wriothesley 26.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' The least I can do is to make sure that the same tragedy will not happen again in my new home.
:{{A|vo dyzlq003 18 avice 01.ogg}} '''Avice:''' Sorry to disturb you, everyone...
:{{A|vo dyzlq003 18 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, it's Avice and Faissolle! Are you two feeling better yet?
:{{A|vo dyzlq003 18 faissolle 01.ogg}} '''Faissolle:''' It was all because you arrived in time. I managed to escape unscathed.
:{{DIcon}} Glad to hear it.
:{{A|vo dyzlq003 18 avice 02.ogg}} '''Avice:''' We came here on impulse today, because we were hoping that you'd be able to lend us a hand, Your Grace...
:{{A|vo dyzlq003 18 wriothesley 27.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' Please go on right ahead. I'll do my best to help — within reason, of course.
:{{A|vo dyzlq003 18 faissolle 02.ogg}} '''Faissolle:''' It's... Erm... I'd like to be wedded to Avice here at the Fortress...
:{{A|vo dyzlq003 18 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You're getting married!?
:{{A|vo dyzlq003 18 faissolle 03.ogg}} '''Faissolle:''' Yeah, we met each other through the Society, and both fell into Dougier's trap.
:{{A|vo dyzlq003 18 faissolle 04.ogg}} '''Faissolle:''' But even during our time there, we never doubted each other. We always believed that Dougier was manipulating us, trying to make us mistrust each other.
:{{A|vo dyzlq003 18 faissolle 05.ogg}} '''Faissolle:''' And after this incident... We've come to believe that we've found "the one" for the rest of our lives.
:{{A|vo dyzlq003 18 avice 03.ogg}} '''Avice:''' Hehe, you could say we managed to make the best out of a bad situation. He didn't abandon me, and I didn't forsake him either.
:{{A|vo dyzlq003 18 avice 04.ogg}} '''Avice:''' But we're still both prisoners, and we also aren't sure if the Fortress is the best place to host something so celebratory...
:{{A|vo dyzlq003 18 avice 05.ogg}} '''Avice:''' So we are just wondering... Is our request a bit too out of line?
:{{A|vo dyzlq003 18 wriothesley 28.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' Hmm, you're right in that the Fortress has never hosted a wedding before...
:{{A|vo dyzlq003 18 wriothesley 29.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' But that's no reason to say no, is it? I'll help you make the arrangements. If you need anything special shipped in from the surface, just say the word.
:{{A|vo dyzlq003 18 faissolle 06.ogg}} '''Faissolle:''' We can't thank you enough, Your Grace!
:{{A|vo dyzlq003 18 faissolle 07.ogg}} '''Faissolle:''' We are actually also planning to stay here after the conclusion of our sentences.
:{{A|vo dyzlq003 18 avice 06.ogg}} '''Avice:''' Yeah, we've already made tons of special memories here, so now, it'd be too hard to leave.
:{{A|vo dyzlq003 18 avice 07.ogg}} '''Avice:''' And we have full confidence in the Fortress' future with you at the helm, Your Grace.
:{{A|vo dyzlq003 18 wriothesley 30.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' Your trust is the highest form of praise.
:{{A|vo dyzlq003 18 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hey, loosen up a bit. Shouldn't you be the happiest man in Teyvat to hear that people would like to stay of their own free will?
:{{A|vo dyzlq003 18 wriothesley 31.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' Yeah...
:{{A|vo dyzlq003 18 wriothesley 32.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' I'll always take a genuine expression of faith over any obligation to obey.
{{Dialogue End}}

==Dialogue==
{{Quest Description|Noelle reveals to you that she is very anxious about the Knights of Favonius selection exam. At your suggestion, she decides to join you on a trip to Liyue to relieve her stress...}}

===Levity in Liyue===
{{Dialogue Start}}
:{{A|vo noecop002 1908201 noelle 01.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' I can't believe I have really come all the way to Liyue...
:{{A|vo noecop002 1908201 noelle 02.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' Wow... The architecture here is so unique, and there are so many people around... But somehow, I feel like I'm constantly being watched...
:{{DIcon}} Well, you do look especially good today.
:;(+1 Heart)
::{{A|vo noecop002 1908201 noelle 03.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' No~ Please don't make fun of me.
:{{DIcon}} Well, Knights of Favonius are a rare sight around here.
:;(−1 Heart)
::{{A|vo noecop002 1908201 noelle 04.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' Oh, I am not a Knight of Favonius yet...
:{{A|vo noecop002 1908201 noelle 05.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' Tsk, you shouldn't make jokes like that in public, people may hear you and get the wrong idea.
:{{A|vo noecop002 1908201 noelle 06.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' Huh, how strange... Back in Mondstadt, I never feel shy around strangers, but over here I feel so tense...
:{{A|vo noecop002 1908201 noelle 07.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' I—It's probably because I'm in a completely different environment. I don't know how I should act to make sure I don't make a fool of myself...
:{{A|vo noecop002 1908201 noelle 08.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' And speaking of... I heard that it's customary to eat with chopsticks in Liyue...
:{{A|vo noecop002 1908201 noelle 09.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' Back in Mondstadt, I have previously provided chopsticks to visitors from Liyue, but I have never used them myself... Ohh, I hope I won't become a laughing stock...
:{{DIcon}} Some foods here can be eaten without chopsticks. Want to have a look?
:{{DIcon}} I can teach you how to use chopsticks. Want to try?
:{{A|vo noecop002 1908201 noelle 10.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' Huh? Oh, I... I was just thinking aloud. Don't worry about it.
:{{A|vo noecop002 1908201 noelle 11.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' My time here in Liyue is precious. I should make good use of it to study...
:{{DIcon}} You never know, the exam may test your ability to work with partners from Liyue.
:;(−1 Heart)
::{{A|vo noecop002 1908201 noelle 12.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' Wh—What? Could that really come up in the exam? Wait, you're right... maybe it will!
:{{DIcon}} Understanding the local culture will help you connect with people and learn more.
:;(+1 Heart)
::{{A|vo noecop002 1908201 noelle 13.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' Hmm, true... If I offended the locals by not knowing their customs, I wouldn't have the chance to learn from them...
:{{A|vo noecop002 1908201 noelle 14.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' Huh, then... okay... Let's start by learning about the local cuisine. {{Traveler}}, do you have any suggestions?
:{{DIcon}} You can trust me with this.
:{{DIcon}} Let's go to Wanmin Restaurant.
:{{A|vo noecop002 1908201 noelle 15.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' Okay! {{Traveler}}, if it comes recommended by you, I'm excited to find out what kind of food it is...

;(Go to Wanmin Restaurant)
:{{A|vo noecop002 1908202 chefmao 01.ogg}} '''Chef Mao:''' If it isn't the Traveler! What would you like to order today? Wanmin Restuarant will cook it just how you like it!
:{{A|vo noecop002 1908202 chefmao 02.ogg}} '''Chef Mao:''' Oh, is this a new customer you've brought with you? Based on Madam's attire... it would appear that...
:{{A|vo noecop002 1908202 chefmao 03.ogg}} '''Chef Mao:''' ...Even a Knight of Favonius will travel all the way to Liyue just to try Wanmin Restaurant's cooking!
:{{A|vo noecop002 1908202 noelle 01.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' Knight of Favonius? Oh... I—I'm not...
:{{A|vo noecop002 1908202 chefmao 04.ogg}} '''Chef Mao:''' Haha, I'm just joking, of course. You must be in Liyue on official business?
:{{A|vo noecop002 1908202 chefmao 05.ogg}} '''Chef Mao:''' But anyway, while you're here in Liyue, I can confidently say that you won't regret stopping by Wanmin Restaurant to try our tasty dishes!
:{{A|vo noecop002 1908202 noelle 02.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' That... that's not what I meant...
:{{A|vo noecop002 1908202 chefmao 06.ogg}} '''Chef Mao:''' Not what you meant... Oh, I see... I suppose you must be looking for Liuli Pavilion or Xinyue Kiosk?
:{{A|vo noecop002 1908202 chefmao 07.ogg}} '''Chef Mao:''' *sigh* Most first-time visitors have only heard of these two places. I just didn't expect the Knights of Favonius to be the same way...
:{{DIcon}} Chef Mao... that's not what she meant...
:{{A|vo noecop002 1908202 noelle 03.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' Wh—What I meant was... I am not an official Knight of Favonius. I'm just a knight-in-training currently serving as a maid...
:{{A|vo noecop002 1908202 chefmao 08.ogg}} '''Chef Mao:''' Goodness... They really distinguish between knights to that degree? Well, anyway, as long as you dine at Wanmin Restaurant, rest assured you will leave here a satisfied customer!
:{{A|vo noecop002 1908202 chefmao 09.ogg}} '''Chef Mao:''' Since this is your first time in Liyue, perhaps you are not used to chopsticks yet? If so, might I recommend the Grilled Tiger Fish — fresh, fragrant, and easy to eat...
:{{A|vo noecop002 1908202 chefmao 10.ogg}} '''Chef Mao:''' If I tone down the spice a little, it should be perfect for the Mondstadt palate. Want to try it?
:{{DIcon}} Noelle, what do you think?
:{{A|vo noecop002 1908202 noelle 04.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' Um... I want to learn about the Liyue diet. Adjusting the dish to accommodate what I'm used to seems to defeat the purpose of coming here...
:{{A|vo noecop002 1908202 chefmao 11.ogg}} '''Chef Mao:'''  Oh? You want to try something with more of a local flavor? Well, in that case, you've got to try our signature dish: Black-Back Perch Stew!
:{{A|vo noecop002 1908202 chefmao 12.ogg}} '''Chef Mao:''' The only thing is, you can't really eat it without using chopsticks, and the level of spice is not for everyone.
:{{A|vo noecop002 1908202 chefmao 13.ogg}} '''Chef Mao:''' I pour oil into a hot pan, throw in a big handful of Jueyun Chilis, and stir-fry them to release the flavor. Then, I sprinkle in some powdered Violetgrass to enhance the spiciness...
:{{A|vo noecop002 1908202 noelle 05.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' Phew! I can already feel the spiciness just by listening to your description! ...Will I be able to handle it?
:{{DIcon}} Come on, you can do it!
:;(+1 Heart)
::{{A|vo noecop002 1908202 noelle 06.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' ...Right! I can't give up so soon!
:{{DIcon}} Don't force it if you're not going to enjoy it.
:;(−1 Heart)
::{{A|vo noecop002 1908202 noelle 07.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' But if I give up so soon... how can I learn to overcome future obstacles?
:{{A|vo noecop002 1908202 noelle 08.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' Hmm... It's just a harmless bit of chili pepper... I—I can take it!
:{{A|vo noecop002 1908202 noelle 09.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' Chef Mao, I will go with your recommendation!
:{{A|vo noecop002 1908202 chefmao 14.ogg}} '''Chef Mao:''' Haha, great! Please have a seat. One Black-Back Perch Stew, coming right up!
:{{Black Screen|You and Noelle dine on Black-Back Perch Stew together...}}
:{{A|vo noecop002 1908202 noelle 10.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' *cough* *cough* *cough* So spicy... I can't even hold... my chopsticks steadily... *cough* *cough*
:{{DIcon}} Are you okay...?
:{{A|vo noecop002 1908202 noelle 11.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' I'm fine... I'm fine... It's certainly very spicy, but once you get over that, it' quite delicious...
:{{A|vo noecop002 1908202 noelle 12.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' What surprised me is how the freshness of the fish still shines through, despite how heavily seasoned the dish is...
:{{A|vo noecop002 1908202 noelle 13.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' Hmm... the next time I entertain guests from Liyue... I wonder if I'll be able to prepare such delicious food for them...
:{{DIcon}} Your cooking is delicious, too.
:;(+1 Heart)
::{{A|vo noecop002 1908202 noelle 14.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' R—Really? Then, let me bake some muffins for you when we get back...
:{{DIcon}} Liyue cuisine is in a league of its own.
:;(−1 Heart)
::{{A|vo noecop002 1908202 noelle 15.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' So... So this is the kind of food you like? After I get back, I will have to study it properly...
:{{A|vo noecop002 1908202 chefmao 15.ogg}} '''Chef Mao:''' Wow, you've already finished? How do you feel? Even locals rarely finish the dish so quickly...
:{{A|vo noecop002 1908202 noelle 16.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' Oh, it was very good! Thank you, Chef Mao.
:{{A|vo noecop002 1908202 chefmao 16.ogg}} '''Chef Mao:''' Ah, you're very welcome! Seeing customers satisfied is my greatest pleasure.
:{{A|vo noecop002 1908202 chefmao 17.ogg}} '''Chef Mao:''' But... I must say, I really didn't expect you to drink the soup! It's so spicy that most people here in Liyue can't even handle it.
:{{A|vo noecop002 1908202 noelle 17.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' Wha— The soup...? W—We weren't supposed to drink it!?
:{{DIcon}} Ahem... Time to move on.
:{{A|vo noecop002 1908202 noelle 18.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' Oh, um... Yes. Let's.
:{{A|vo noecop002 1908202 noelle 19.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' *sigh*... Next time I eat in Liyue, I'll be sure to check how each dish is meant to be consumed first...
:{{A|vo noecop002 1908202 noelle 20.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' Oh... That sounds like ironwork going on over there. Is it a blacksmith?
:{{A|vo noecop002 1908202 noelle 21.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' ...From the kind of weapons made here, I should be able to learn something about the local combat style. Will you come with me to the blacksmith, so I can take a look?
:{{DIcon}} You mean Hanfeng's Ironmongers? Sure, follow me.
:{{A|vo noecop002 1908202 noelle 22.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' Oh, great!

'''Justice Is Its Own Reward''' is the fourth and final part of {{Quest|Bookworm Swordsman}}.

==Steps==
# Go to the [[Feiyun Commerce Guild]] warehouse
# Help [[Gentry Maocai]] and defeat the attacking [[Fatui (Enemies)|Fatui]]{{Enemy List|Treasure Hoarders: Scout*3;Treasure Hoarders: Marksman*2}}
#* [[Xingqiu]] is added to the party as a trial character
# Fend off the [[Javert|Agent]]
#* {{Enemy|Fatui Pyro Agent|text=Fatui Javert — Agent - Incinerating Blades}}
# Return the [[Legend of the Shattered Halberd (VI)|Legend of the Shattered Halberd]] to its rightful owner

==Gameplay Notes==

==Dialogue==
{{Quest Description|As per the plan written in the letter, the Feiyun Commerce Guild has bought up all the [[Cor Lapis]] there is to be bought in [[Liyue Harbor]]. Now all that remains is for Gentry Maocai to discover this, and for the real show to begin.}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Talk to Xingqiu at the Feiyun Commerce Guild warehouse)
:{{A|vo xqlq004 2 xingqiu 01.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' Welcome. The final act in this drama would not be complete without you two here as audience.
:{{A|vo xqlq004 2 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You'd better believe it! We're the ones who've been doing all the work! What exactly have you been doing all this time?
:{{A|vo xqlq004 2 xingqiu 02.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' Ah, well... Naturally, I used the time to immerse myself completely in Legend of the Shattered Halberd. I managed to finish the book off, and I enjoyed every minute of it.
:{{A|vo xqlq004 2 xingqiu 03.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' Divine Halberd and Ominous Sword, Mir and Weiyang...
:{{A|vo xqlq004 2 xingqiu 04.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' The way the story develops across the first five volumes — nothing short of exemplary. But the sixth volume... words fail me.
:{{A|vo xqlq004 2 xingqiu 05.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' How blessed we are to have such an author grace our world with such works.
:{{A|vo xqlq004 2 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' And this is related to Gentry Maocai... how?
:{{A|vo xqlq004 2 xingqiu 06.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' It's not, but when something surpasses expectation to such a degree, one must show one's appreciation.
:{{DIcon}} You saw how everything would play out.
::{{A|vo xqlq004 2 xingqiu 07a.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' And it is thanks to your help that everything will play out just as I had foreseen.
:{{DIcon}} Is the ending of the book good?
::{{A|vo xqlq004 2 xingqiu 07b.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' It was rather good, thanks... I only hope that as our plan reaches its denouement, it too will live up to its expectations.
:{{A|vo xqlq004 2 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' ...Why does Paimon have to be the only one who doesn't get what's going on? No fair!
:{{A|vo xqlq004 2 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ahh... So go on then, tell me. What are we doing here? And what's this big dramatic showdown thing that's supposed to happen?
:{{A|vo xqlq004 2 xingqiu 08.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' Think about it. Gentry Maocai goes searching for Cor Lapis all over Liyue Harbor, and he doesn't find a single piece.
:{{A|vo xqlq004 2 xingqiu 09.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' He panics — without the goods, he can't fulfill his contract. And if he can't fulfill his contract, he can't stay in good standing with the [[Fatui]].
:{{A|vo xqlq004 2 xingqiu 10.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' He hears a rumor that the Feiyun Commerce Guild is the culprit. Panic turns to disbelief.
:{{A|vo xqlq004 2 xingqiu 11.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' Gentry Maocai is a hugely powerful figure in the business world. Never has anyone dared to target him like this.
:{{A|vo xqlq004 2 xingqiu 12.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' So regardless of whether it is revenge or a swift resolution that he seeks, he is certain to—
:{{A|vo xqlq004 2 gentrymaocai 01.ogg}} '''Gentry Maocai:''' So it was you! You were the ones sticking your necks out for [[Chang the Ninth]]!
:{{A|vo xqlq004 2 xingqiu 13.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' Speak of the devil.
:{{A|vo xqlq004 2 gentrymaocai 02.ogg}} '''Gentry Maocai:''' I went everywhere trying to find someone selling Cor Lapis before I realized the Feiyun Commerce Guild had been on an acquisition spree!
:{{A|vo xqlq004 2 gentrymaocai 03.ogg}} '''Gentry Maocai:''' Cor Lapis is hardly a rare mineral, and yet suddenly the stocks dry up, just like that! Explain yourselves! What is the meaning of this persecution?
:{{A|vo xqlq004 2 xingqiu 14.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' We are not persecuting you, but protecting another, one to whom I am indebted. Upon witnessing an injustice, it is a perfectly normal response to rush to the aid of he who has been wronged.
:{{A|vo xqlq004 2 xingqiu 15.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' Was it not one of your own men who said... this isn't over?
:{{A|vo xqlq004 2 gentrymaocai 04.ogg}} '''Gentry Maocai:''' Hmph. You clearly don't know what's good for you. I won't beat around the bush.
:{{A|vo xqlq004 2 gentrymaocai 05.ogg}} '''Gentry Maocai:''' Master, if you please. Seize their Cor Lapis!

----

:{{A|vo xqlq004 4 agent 01.ogg}} '''Agent:''' Don't get too carried away now.
:{{A|vo xqlq004 4 paimon 01.ogg }} '''Paimon:''' Yikes! This guy looks all kinds of dangerous!

;(Fend off the Agent)
:{{A|vo xqlq004 6 agent 01.ogg}} '''Agent:''' Impressive. You are no commoners... To continue this fight would be to incur greater losses than I can accept.
:{{A|vo xqlq004 6 gentrymaocai 01.ogg}} '''Gentry Maocai:''' Their strength is almost spent! Finish them off! The Cor Lapis is almost within our grasp...
:{{A|vo xqlq004 6 agent 02.ogg}} '''Agent:''' Might I remind you that the Fatui's relationship with you extends to business matters only! I did not lend you my men to have them stir up trouble at your beck and call!
:{{A|vo xqlq004 6 gentrymaocai 02.ogg}} '''Gentry Maocai:''' W—What are you saying? Master, everything I did, I did with only one thing in mind — to complete the order!
:{{A|vo xqlq004 6 agent 03.ogg}} '''Agent:''' Then figure it out by yourself!
:{{A|vo xqlq004 6 gentrymaocai 03.ogg}} '''Gentry Maocai:''' D—Don't go! Wait! Master! Waaaait...
:{{A|vo xqlq004 6 xu 01.ogg}} '''[[Xu]]:''' My lord! What are you doing here? Are you hurt?
:{{A|vo xqlq004 6 xingqiu 01a.ogg}} {{A|vo xqlq004 6 xingqiu 01b.ogg}}  '''Xingqiu:''' Thanks to this valiant young {{MC|man|woman|mc=1}}, I am unscathed.
:{{A|vo xqlq004 6 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' "My lord"!?
:{{DIcon}} "My lord"!?
:{{DIcon}} ...I did NOT see that coming!
:{{A|vo xqlq004 6 gentrymaocai 04.ogg}} '''Gentry Maocai:''' You... You are the heir of the Feiyun Commerce Guild?
:{{A|vo xqlq004 6 xingqiu 02.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' Indeed, my liege. I am Xingqiu, disciple of the [[Guhua Clan]] and second son of the Feiyun Commerce Guild manager, and I make no secret of it.
:{{A|vo xqlq004 6 gentrymaocai 05.ogg}} '''Gentry Maocai:''' Drats! I've been played like a fiddle!
:{{A|vo xqlq004 6 xingqiu 03.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' Gentry Maocai, coercion and intimidation are hardly the attributes of a respectable businessman. The problems that your business practices have created, I have sought to resolve through mine.
:{{A|vo xqlq004 6 xingqiu 04.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' I shudder to think what the Fatui will do with you if you fail to provide their Cor Lapis.
:{{A|vo xqlq004 6 gentrymaocai 06.ogg}} '''Gentry Maocai:''' You meddling swine! Well, go on! Tell me, what will you sell it for?
:{{A|vo xqlq004 6 xingqiu 05.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' Since you asked Chang the Ninth for a discount of seventy percent, let's fight fire with fire, shall we?
:{{A|vo xqlq004 6 xingqiu 06.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' Three times the market rate sounds fair, no?
:{{A|vo xqlq004 6 gentrymaocai 07.ogg}} '''Gentry Maocai:''' How dare you subject me to such viciousness! This is a malicious and calculated attempt to run me into the ground—
:{{A|vo xqlq004 6 xingqiu 07.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' ...Deep breaths now. This is a simple decision. Will you buy, or not?
:{{A|vo xqlq004 6 gentrymaocai 08.ogg}} '''Gentry Maocai:''' I... Hmph, fine, have it your way! I'll find the money somehow. Happy now!?
:{{A|vo xqlq004 6 xingqiu 08.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' On behalf of the Feiyun Commerce Guild, I thank you for your business and hope you will continue to do business with us in the future.
:{{A|vo xqlq004 6 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You? Funny-speaking, book-reading, Guhua-geeking, Xingqiu... Are the heir of the Feiyun Commerce Guild!?
:{{A|vo xqlq004 6 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So that massive stash of [[Mora]] you let us burn through in a day — that was from your private vault!?
:{{A|vo xqlq004 6 xingqiu 09.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' 'Twas but a paltry sum. I got to make a very sound investment while putting Gentry Maocai in his place. A classic two birds, one stone situation.
:{{DIcon}} Appearances really can be deceiving.
::{{A|vo xqlq004 6 xingqiu 10a.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' You're too kind. You have valor in your heart, and that is worthy of admiration.
:{{DIcon}} Don't you rich kids take calligraphy classes from a young age?
::{{A|vo xqlq004 6 xingqiu 10b.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' Hahahaha, very droll... My family can always tell me from my handwriting, it's certainly one of my distinguishing features.
:{{A|vo xqlq004 6 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yikes! Paimon's been calling you Guhua Geek this whole time...
:{{A|vo xqlq004 6 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Paimon read in one of these martial artist novels that when rich heirs like you get angry at someone, you have their arms and legs chopped off!
:{{A|vo xqlq004 6 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Arghhh, Paimon's toast! And sorry! Very sorry! Please don't hurt Paimon~!
:{{A|vo xqlq004 6 xingqiu 11.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' Calm down — since you can fly, you hardly need your legs anyway.
:{{A|vo xqlq004 6 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' ARGH! Save me {{Traveler}}, save me! This is not a drill. Repeat, this is not a drill!
:{{DIcon}} He's so obviously joking.
:{{DIcon}} What kind of book did you say you read this in!?
:{{A|vo xqlq004 6 xingqiu 12.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' Jokes aside, I have the two of you two thank for this successful resolution. Really, you were a huge help.
:{{A|vo xqlq004 6 xingqiu 13.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' Meanwhile, Legend of the Shattered Halberd was positively riveting. Much obliged if you could return it to Chang the Ninth for me.
:{{DIcon}} You're making us run yet another errand!?
:{{A|vo xqlq004 6 xingqiu 14.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' I did nothing, and hence deserve none of his gratitude. The two of you, meanwhile, though strangers to the circumstances, stepped in and saved the day.
:{{A|vo xqlq004 6 xingqiu 15.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' To have made such valiant and chivalrous friends is more than enough for me, my liege.
:{{A|vo xqlq004 6 xu 02.ogg}} '''Xu:''' My lord, forgive the intrusion... It's about your father...
:{{A|vo xqlq004 6 xingqiu 16.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' Please inform my father thusly: I have averted a disaster and earned a sizable sum of money in the process.
:{{A|vo xqlq004 6 xingqiu 17.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' Might this meritorious act compensate for my prior transgressions and earn me a few more days of freedom, perchance? Legend of the Shattered Halberd speaks of a domain that I should very much like to investigate...
:{{A|vo xqlq004 6 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' For all your clever long words, the fact is you're just a lazybones who doesn't wanna work!
:{{A|vo xqlq004 6 xingqiu 18.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' Hahaha... What if I told you that a reward awaits you at Chang the Ninth's palace, and not just his gratitude?
:{{A|vo xqlq004 6 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' A reward! Hmm... Well, that sweetens the deal somewhat.
:{{A|vo xqlq004 6 xu 03.ogg}} '''Xu:''' *sigh* It seems whatever I say, there's no persuading you to stay...
:{{DIcon}} Why didn't you tell us Xingqiu was the Feiyun heir?
:{{A|vo xqlq004 6 xu 04.ogg}} '''Xu:''' Oh, I didn't realize you weren't aware...
:{{A|vo xqlq004 6 xingqiu 19.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' Thank you in advance for returning the book for me, I will take my leave now. May we meet again, fellow merchants!

----

;(Talk to Chang the Ninth)
:{{A|vo xqlq004 7 changtheninth 01.ogg}} '''Chang the Ninth:''' Finally, you're back! This morning the pawnbroker showed up and gave me back my entire collection!
:{{A|vo xqlq004 7 changtheninth 02.ogg}} '''Chang the Ninth:''' I'm positive that you must have been behind this once again. Thank you, thank you from the bottom of my heart!
:{{DIcon}} No big deal, happy to help.
:{{DIcon}} Actually, that wasn't us.
:{{A|vo xqlq004 7 changtheninth 03.ogg}} '''Chang the Ninth:''' Please don't say that. You have no idea how much this means to me!
:{{A|vo xqlq004 7 changtheninth 04.ogg}} '''Chang the Ninth:''' The Chang family was a prestigious household in Liyue back in the day. Unfortunately, after I took over the family's affairs as heir, a series of business setbacks devoured our fortune...
:{{A|vo xqlq004 7 changtheninth 05.ogg}} '''Chang the Ninth:''' Since then, I've saved for years, hoping to restore the house to its former glory... In the end, everything was riding on this Cor Lapis deal.
:{{A|vo xqlq004 7 changtheninth 06.ogg}} '''Chang the Ninth:''' Were it not for you, this barren wasteland in the mountains would have become my final resting place.
:{{A|vo xqlq004 7 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wow, that's the second heir we've met in this town!
:{{A|vo xqlq004 7 changtheninth 07.ogg}} '''Chang the Ninth:''' I'm sorry, what?
:{{A|vo xqlq004 7 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' ...Uh, nothing! Oh — here's your book back.
:{{A|vo xqlq004 7 changtheninth 08.ogg}} '''Chang the Ninth:''' Wonderful, Legend of the Shattered Halberd! I was beginning to think that Guhua rascal had swindled me!
:{{A|vo xqlq004 7 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Do people really look down on the Guhua Clan so much?
:{{A|vo xqlq004 7 changtheninth 09.ogg}} '''Chang the Ninth:''' Actually, the art is centuries old, and was once held in high esteem. But now it has faded beyond recognition.
:{{A|vo xqlq004 7 changtheninth 10.ogg}} '''Chang the Ninth:''' To instigate a revival, you need to inject some fresh blood, but it's hard to attract budding young talent to a dying art... And so it becomes a vicious cycle.
:{{A|vo xqlq004 7 changtheninth 11.ogg}} '''Chang the Ninth:''' In any case, Guhua kids these days... Take that young rascal Xingqiu for instance, for all his talk about repaying kindness with kindness and whatnot, what has he done to show for it? You're the ones who've displayed a genuine sense of responsibility.
:{{DIcon}} He's better than you give him credit for.
:{{DIcon}} Maybe a Guhua renaissance is just around the corner.
:{{A|vo xqlq004 7 changtheninth 12.ogg}} '''Chang the Ninth:''' Ah, what does it matter? Anyway, you wanted the Liyue volume of the Teyvat Travel Guide, didn't you? I'll fetch it for you.
:{{A|vo xqlq004 7 changtheninth 13.ogg}} '''Chang the Ninth:''' It's yours to keep. In addition, here is but a small token of appreciation for your huge generosity.
:{{DIcon}} Finally. Our trip was worth it after all.
:{{DIcon}} I'd almost forgotten about that.
:{{A|vo xqlq004 7 changtheninth 14.ogg}} '''Chang the Ninth:''' My ore is sold and my treasured books have returned, I can't believe it...
:{{A|vo xqlq004 7 changtheninth 15.ogg}} '''Chang the Ninth:''' What?

[[File:Bookmark.png|alt=The strange bookmark that fell from Chang's book.|thumb|160x160px|Strange Bookmark]]
;(A bookmark bearing the Feiyun symbol falls out of the book...)
:{{A|vo xqlq004 7 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What was that? Paimon saw something fall out...
:{{A|vo xqlq004 7 changtheninth 16.ogg}} '''Chang the Ninth:''' Huh. Nothing, nothing...
:{{A|vo xqlq004 7 changtheninth 17.ogg}} '''Chang the Ninth:''' (That little rascal... surely isn't...)
{{Dialogue End}}

==Steps==

# Ask [[Jifang]] about the travel guide
# Go to [[Qingce Village]] and visit [[Chang the Ninth]]
# Talk to Chang the Ninth

==Dialogue==
{{Quest Description|You and [[Paimon]] are looking to purchase a copy of the Liyue volume of the [[Teyvat Travel Guide]] in Liyue Harbor, intending to use it to visit various places of note throughout the region.}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Go to the Wanwen Bookhouse in Liyue Harbor)
:{{A|vo xqlq001 1 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wanwen Bookhouse... Guess this is where we go to buy books in Liyue.
:{{A|vo xqlq001 1 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Should we ask here if they have a copy of the Liyue volume of the Teyvat Travel Guide? It's super-duper interesting!

;(Talk to Jifang)
:{{A|vo xqlq001 2 jifang 01.ogg}} '''Jifang:''' Feel free to take a look around, there's no obligation to buy.
:{{A|vo xqlq001 2 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' We're looking for the Liyue volume of the Teyvat Travel Guide. Do you have it in stock?
:{{A|vo xqlq001 2 jifang 02.ogg}} '''Jifang:''' Sorry dear, we stopped stocking that a very long time ago. It just wasn't selling.
:{{A|vo xqlq001 2 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh!? But the [[Mondstadt]] volume was so interesting! Bummer...
:{{A|vo xqlq001 2 jifang 03.ogg}} '''Jifang:''' The thing is, the [[Alice|author]] made it too personal, and the result wasn't really much of a guide.
:{{A|vo xqlq001 2 jifang 04.ogg}} '''Jifang:''' It barely sold any copies, and the few travelers that did buy it made complaints afterward.
:{{DIcon}} Too much passion, not enough clarity?
:{{DIcon}} Content was a little too wild, huh?
:{{A|vo xqlq001 2 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Well, that's a shame. The Mondstadt volume was a good read, even just as an adventurer's diary.
:{{A|vo xqlq001 2 jifang 05.ogg}} '''Jifang:''' The fact remains that I don't have it in stock. If you must read it, try your luck at Chang the Ninth's place.
:{{A|vo xqlq001 2 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Who's Chang the Ninth?
:{{A|vo xqlq001 2 jifang 06.ogg}} '''Jifang:''' A book collector who lives in Qingce Village. He's a complete grouch — but he will behave himself if the conversation is about books.
:{{A|vo xqlq001 2 jifang 07.ogg}} '''Jifang:''' He was a regular customer here back when he lived in Liyue Harbor, and I still send him the odd out-of-print books or two every now and then.
:{{A|vo xqlq001 2 jifang 08.ogg}} '''Jifang:''' The place where he lives is difficult to get to. You need to head to the mountain just behind Qingce Village, then follow the wooden walkway all the way up...
:{{A|vo xqlq001 2 xingqiu 01.ogg}} '''???:''' Did someone say "out-of-print books"?
:{{A|vo xqlq001 2 xingqiu 02.ogg}} '''???:''' Is there a chance that volume six of "[[Legend of the Shattered Halberd]]" is also in his collection?
:{{DIcon}} Who are you?
:{{DIcon}} You shouldn't sneak up on people like that!
:{{A|vo xqlq001 2 xingqiu 03.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' Apologies my liege, where are my manners? My name is Xingqiu, a humble literature enthusiast who happened to be passing by.
:{{A|vo xqlq001 2 xingqiu 04.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' Since you and I are both in search of lost books, what say we travel together to Mt. Qingce and pay a visit to Chang the Ninth?
:{{DIcon}} Makes sense. Please lead the way.
::{{A|vo xqlq001 2 xingqiu 05a.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' My pleasure, fellow book lover!
:{{DIcon}} I don't know, it sounds like quite a trek...
::{{A|vo xqlq001 2 xingqiu 05b.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' Just take it as a chance to get some respite from the hustle and bustle of Liyue Harbor. We all need that once in a while.

;(Talk to Xingqiu again, optional)
:{{A|vo dialog xqlq001 xingqiu 01.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' I've had my heart set on getting hold of a copy of Legend of the Shattered Halberd volume six for the longest time now.
:{{A|vo dialog xqlq001 xingqiu 02.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' Frankly, I'd be willing to do whatever it takes to get my hands on that book.

----

;(Talk to Chang the Ninth)
:{{A|vo xqlq001 4 changtheninth 01.ogg}} '''Chang the Ninth:''' *sigh* The heavens are smiting me... Smiting me to smithereens...
:{{DIcon}} Excuse me, are you Chang the Ninth?
:{{A|vo xqlq001 4 changtheninth 02.ogg}} '''Chang the Ninth:''' Uh-huh. And what do you want? Come on, spit it out!
:{{A|vo xqlq001 4 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' We've heard you've got tons of old books lying around, and we wanna borrow the Liyue volume of the Teyvat Travel Guide.
:{{A|vo xqlq001 4 changtheninth 03.ogg}} '''Chang the Ninth:''' Hmph. Don't get me started on the topic of my books...
:{{A|vo xqlq001 4 changtheninth 04.ogg}} '''Chang the Ninth:''' After [[The Chasm (Subregion)|the Chasm]] was sealed off, the family mining business started going south. Then, the [[Fatui]] started working to sabotage me...
:{{A|vo xqlq001 4 changtheninth 05.ogg}} '''Chang the Ninth:''' To pay off my debts, I had no choice but to pawn off my beloved book collection. Every last book! Do you have any idea what that means!?
:{{DIcon}} You're sad you've got nothing to read now?
:{{DIcon}} You're bored now that you've got nothing to read?
:{{A|vo xqlq001 4 changtheninth 06.ogg}} '''Chang the Ninth:''' Wrong! That was my life's work! I devoted my entire life to curating, collecting, caring for them... And now they're gone! Gone, I tell you!
:{{A|vo xqlq001 4 changtheninth 07.ogg}} '''Chang the Ninth:''' *sigh* It's useless ranting and raving at you like this. All I can do is try to save enough Mora to buy them back.
:{{A|vo xqlq001 4 changtheninth 08.ogg}} '''Chang the Ninth:''' Unless you have other business here, I'm done talking to you. Goodbye! Off you go! Go on, go!
:{{A|vo xqlq001 4 xingqiu 01.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' Please tell me that you didn't pawn volume six of Legend of the Shattered Halberd?
:{{A|vo xqlq001 4 changtheninth 09.ogg}} '''Chang the Ninth:''' Legend of the Shattered Halberd... There's a title I haven't heard in a long time. You have good taste, my boy!
:{{A|vo xqlq001 4 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What, but we don't?
:{{A|vo xqlq001 4 changtheninth 10.ogg}}  '''Chang the Ninth:''' That work was an epoch-defining masterpiece. Granted, it was almost unknown at the time it was published...
:{{A|vo xqlq001 4 changtheninth 11.ogg}} '''Chang the Ninth:''' But over time it was the work that came to define the genre of martial arts novels — and sparked a plethora of imitation works.
:{{A|vo xqlq001 4 changtheninth 12.ogg}} '''Chang the Ninth:''' Barely any copies of the first edition were ever printed.
:{{A|vo xqlq001 4 xingqiu 02.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' The later edition inexplicably went out of print almost as soon as it was released — a shame given what it allegedly added to the original story. ''(Note: This line of dialogue is completely different in Chinese. Xingqiu instead mentions that the 6th volume was an epilogue to the main story and that later reprintings of the novel neglected to include the 6th volume.)''
:{{A|vo xqlq001 4 changtheninth 13.ogg}} '''Chang the Ninth:''' Yes! That's right, how did I forget? The original-edition sixth volume of that work is so rare, I could never bring myself to pawn it no matter how much I needed the money.
:{{A|vo xqlq001 4 xingqiu 03.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' You mean— You mean you still have it!?
:{{A|vo xqlq001 4 changtheninth 14.ogg}} '''Chang the Ninth:''' Yes. It is my one and only remaining treasure—

;(Someone marches up and interrupts your conversation...)
:{{A|vo xqlq001 4 changhu 01.ogg}} '''[[Changhu]]:''' Ay! Chang!
:{{A|vo xqlq001 4 changhu 02.ogg}} '''Changhu:''' You've got some nerve keeping me and my boss waiting like this. I need an answer! Will you sell the [[Cor Lapis]] or not?
:{{A|vo xqlq001 4 changhu 03.ogg}} '''Changhu:''' I'm sure you don't need me to remind you that if you mess with [[Gentry Maocai]], you're messing with the Fatui!
:{{A|vo xqlq001 4 changtheninth 15.ogg}} '''Chang the Ninth:''' *sigh* You again...
:{{A|vo xqlq001 4 changtheninth 16.ogg}} '''Chang the Ninth:''' But you know I can't afford to give a seventy percent discount on the price... I'd never be able to buy my collection back—
:{{A|vo xqlq001 4 changhu 04.ogg}} '''Changhu:''' That's your business. The question is, do you want your books or do you want food on your plate? Perhaps you'd like to take your books with you to an early grave?
:{{A|vo xqlq001 4 changtheninth 17.ogg}} '''Chang the Ninth:''' *Grr* You...*sigh*
:{{A|vo xqlq001 4 xingqiu 04.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' Whoa there, friend. Come on. This gentleman is either willing to make a deal or he's not. You can't force him to sell against his will.
:{{A|vo xqlq001 4 changhu 05.ogg}} '''Changhu:''' Just who do you think you are? Keep your nose out of other people's business!
:{{A|vo xqlq001 4 xingqiu 05.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' My liege, I am but one who comes to the aid of this gentleman in his moment of need. I am Xingqiu, disciple of the [[Guhua Clan]].
:{{A|vo xqlq001 4 changhu 06.ogg}} '''Changhu:''' A-hahahahahahaha...
:{{A|vo xqlq001 4 changhu 07.ogg}} '''Changhu:''' "Guhua Clan"! Did you hear this clown? He thinks he's a Guhua master! In this day and age! Hahahahaha...
:{{A|vo xqlq001 4 changhu 08.ogg}} '''Changhu:''' There was me thinking that the last granddads of Guhua had keeled over and died by now. Who are you supposed to be then, some sort of Guhua messiah!?
:{{A|vo xqlq001 4 xingqiu 06.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' Justice is blind to our backgrounds, my friend. That just makes me someone trying to do the right thing. But you? The weasel who does the tiger's bidding may be less powerful than his master, but he is no less guilty.
:{{A|vo xqlq001 4 changhu 09.ogg}} '''Changhu:''' Get a load of this guy! Just you wait, you'll be sorry you crossed me!
:{{A|vo xqlq001 4 changhu 10.ogg}} '''Changhu:''' And you, Chang... you're selling that Cor Lapis whether you like it or not!

;(After he finishes speaking, Changhu dismisses your reaction and struts off...)
:{{A|vo xqlq001 4 changtheninth 18.ogg}} '''Chang the Ninth:''' *sigh* Oh, how the wolves prey upon the fallen tiger! My days are numbered.
:{{A|vo xqlq001 4 xingqiu 07.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' ...So just to come back to what we were talking about earlier, could I get a yea or nay about borrowing that book...?
:{{DIcon}} Geez Louise, give the man a minute!
:{{DIcon}} Two words: situational awareness...
:{{A|vo xqlq001 4 changtheninth 19.ogg}} '''Chang the Ninth:''' Oh, what does it matter now? I can't expect anybody to care about me anymore. But since you did stick up for me, please just take this book and leave me in peace.
:{{A|vo xqlq001 4 xingqiu 08.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' Three long years I have waited for this day! Words cannot express my gratitude... I, Xingqiu, vow to repay this great act of generosity!
:{{A|vo xqlq001 4 changtheninth 20.ogg}} '''Chang the Ninth:''' Alright, give it a rest! Just bring it back when you're finished. Sorry, but I'm not about to put my hopes in some self-professed Guhua disciple.
:{{A|vo xqlq001 4 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hey! Where are you going!? We've still got a job to do over here!

----

;(Talk to Xingqiu)
:{{A|vo xqlq001 5 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So you like reading, huh? Mr. Five-Second Hero?
:{{A|vo xqlq001 5 xingqiu 01.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' Ho-ho, amazing... I NEVER saw that coming...
:{{A|vo xqlq001 5 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hello! Xingqiu! Anybody in there?
:{{A|vo xqlq001 5 xingqiu 02.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' No wonder this book is so highly sought after...
:{{A|vo xqlq001 5 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' UGH!
:{{DIcon}} That guy back at Chang the Ninth's was pretty bossy...
:{{DIcon}} That bossy guy back at Chang's — sounds like he's working for a "Gentry Maocai."
:{{A|vo xqlq001 5 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' How can they bully poor Chang the Ninth like this, forcing him to sell his ore for dirt cheap? It's daylight robbery, pure and simple!
:{{DIcon}} You and I have got to find a way to help Chang the Ninth!
::{{A|vo xqlq001 5 xingqiu 03a.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' Don't forget me. I'm in, too.
:{{DIcon}} So I guess we're scrapping Operation Liyue Travel Guide?
::{{A|vo xqlq001 5 xingqiu 03b.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' Why do you give up on your book search so lightly?
:{{A|vo xqlq001 5 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, so NOW you can hear what we're saying!
:{{A|vo xqlq001 5 xingqiu 04.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' The reason I borrowed this book is that it would be a real pity if Chang the Ninth ended up having to pawn it.
:{{A|vo xqlq001 5 xingqiu 05.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' And I meant every word I said to Chang the Ninth. I will return his act of kindness. It is the just thing to do.
:{{A|vo xqlq001 5 xingqiu 06.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' I will be custodian of this book, and I will also help find a way to buy back the rest of his collection.
:{{DIcon}} You already have a plan, don't you?
:{{DIcon}} You don't have a plan at all, do you?
:{{A|vo xqlq001 5 xingqiu 07.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' Of course I do. An initial plan, anyway. I still need to work out the details.
:{{A|vo xqlq001 5 xingqiu 08.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' Give me a second to reflect. It shan't take but a moment...

;(While Xingqiu is deep in thought, Changhu returns — this time, with his gang...)
:{{A|vo xqlq001 5 changhu 01.ogg}} '''Changhu:''' You're still here!? What is this, a game to you? You think no one's really gonna get hurt?
:{{A|vo xqlq001 5 changhu 02.ogg}} '''Changhu:''' Huh. I gotta hand it to the Goofball Clan... What you lack in numbers and talent, you make up for in guts!
:{{A|vo xqlq001 5 changhu 03.ogg}} '''Changhu:''' Oh, I'm sorry — did I say Goofball Clan? I meant Guhua Clan... That's what you goofballs call it, right? Hahahahaha...
:{{A|vo xqlq001 5 xingqiu 09.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' There's a saying that goes: "The insect that shakes the oak tree ludicrously overestimates its ability."
:{{A|vo xqlq001 5 changhu 04.ogg}} '''Changhu:''' Quit quoting proverbs at me, you buffoon!
:{{A|vo xqlq001 5 xingqiu 10.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' Please leave this place. I will not tolerate an attempt to coerce an honest trader — especially when the one you seek to threaten is one to whom I owe a debt of gratitude.
:{{A|vo xqlq001 5 changhu 05.ogg}} '''Changhu:''' It's cute that you wanna stick your neck out for Chang, and all...
:{{A|vo xqlq001 5 changhu 06.ogg}} '''Changhu:''' But you picked the wrong time, you little punk! I brought the Fatui to back me up. A whole army of your little Guhua buddies wouldn't be able to help you now!
:{{A|vo xqlq001 5 xingqiu 11.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' I may be young, my liege, but the path I have chosen makes me no stranger to conflict. Why should I cower in the face of evil?
:{{A|vo xqlq001 5 changhu 07.ogg}} '''Changhu:''' Great speech. But now it's time for your to learn your lesson!

;(Defeat the attacking Fatui)
:{{A|vo xqlq001 9 changhu 01.ogg}} '''Changhu:''' I thought that was just a regular pendant you were wearing, not a [[Vision]]!
:{{A|vo xqlq001 9 changhu 02.ogg}} '''Changhu:''' You won this round, but you'd better watch your back! This isn't over!
:{{A|vo xqlq001 9 xingqiu 01.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' Would it be too much to hope they've learned their lesson?
:{{DIcon}} So, you're a Vision bearer!
::{{A|vo xqlq001 9 xingqiu 02a.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' Yes, though I try to avoid using it. I dislike the unfair advantage it gives me against my opponents.
:{{DIcon}} More to Guhua than meets the eye, huh!
::{{A|vo xqlq001 9 xingqiu 02b 1.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' N—No, no you misunderstand. That fellow has a foul mouth to be sure, but his assessment of the state of the Guhua Clan is, well... not exactly incorrect, I suppose. *sigh*
:{{A|vo xqlq001 9 xingqiu 02b 2.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' Though I long to restore Guhua to its former glory, it is no easy task.
:{{A|vo xqlq001 9 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' They've gone for now, but they'll be back looking to cause more trouble before long.
:{{A|vo xqlq001 9 xingqiu 03.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' I'll see to it that no harm comes to those who show me kindness. There is a just and an unjust way to do business, and I will ensure the matter is resolved satisfactorily.
:{{A|vo xqlq001 9 xingqiu 04.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' It's not like the Fatui to pick sides in a business dispute. But the confident demeanor of their errand boy suggests there is substance to his words.
:{{A|vo xqlq001 9 xingqiu 05.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' There must be a deeper level of collusion at work here.
:{{A|vo xqlq001 9 xingqiu 06.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' He mentioned Gentry Maocai. I know this name... he has a stately residence in Liyue Harbor. Maybe the two of you could go and investigate.
:{{A|vo xqlq001 9 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' That idea works... But what are you gonna do?
:{{A|vo xqlq001 9 xingqiu 07.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' Me? I have other things to look into. Let me see... Let us meet at Yujing Terrace in Liyue Harbor in a bit.
:{{A|vo xqlq001 9 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You really have stuff to do? Are you sure you're not just using us as your errand runners?
:{{A|vo xqlq001 9 xingqiu 08.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' Wow... So that's how that turned out! This whole passage is just... extraordinary!
:{{A|vo xqlq001 9 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' ARGH! This guy is SO ANNOYING! Paimon just wants to slap him right in his stupid face!
:{{DIcon}} First let's help Chang the Ninth.
:{{DIcon}} Xingqiu's vengeance may not be swift, but it will surely come.
:{{A|vo xqlq001 9 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hmph. FINE! But as per tradition, Paimon gets to pick an ugly nickname for him!
:{{A|vo xqlq001 9 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' From now on he shall be known as... Guhua Geek!
;(Quest ends)

;(Talk to Xingqiu again, optional)
:{{A|vo dialog xqlq001 xingqiu 03.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' You go first. No need to wait for me.
:{{A|vo dialog xqlq001 xingqiu 04.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' One more page and I'll go and stretch my legs. Just one last page.
{{Dialogue End}}

:{{A|vo kylq001 2 kaeya 03.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' It's a secret of my past, and I confide in you to keep it.
:{{A|vo kylq001 2 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Don't worry, Paimon's lips are sealed.
:{{A|vo kylq001 2 kaeya 04.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' As a matter of fact, my grandfather was a pirate!
:{{A|vo kylq001 2 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh.
:{{A|vo kylq001 2 kaeya 05.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' ...Wait, why do you sound so blithe? Do you think I'm making it up?
:{{A|vo kylq001 2 kaeya 06.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' Look at my eye patch! I inherited it from my grandfather and this is solid proof that we are related by blood!
:{{DIcon}} I never knew you could inherit eye patches.
::{{A|vo kylq001 2 kaeya 07.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' My! {{Traveler}}, how could you not know such common knowledge!
::{{A|vo kylq001 2 kaeya 08.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' This is no different from children inheriting their hairstyle from their parents!
:{{DIcon}} How surprising.
:{{A|vo kylq001 2 kaeya 09.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' Yesterday I was glancing through the notes my grandfather left and stumbled upon records that spoke of a {{Color|buzzword|treasure}}...
:{{A|vo kylq001 2 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' ...Treasure!?
:{{A|vo kylq001 2 kaeya 10.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' According to his notes, the treasure is buried in the "Lost Arcadian Ruins."
:{{A|vo kylq001 2 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Treasure...
:{{A|vo kylq001 2 kaeya 11.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' But the location of the ruins is currently unknown. I've tried searching for clues...
:{{A|vo kylq001 2 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Treasure!
:{{A|vo kylq001 2 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Kaeya! What kind of treasure is it? Gold? Or better yet, gems!?
:{{A|vo kylq001 2 kaeya 12.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' Hmph! Treasures that consist of nothing but gold and gems are third-rate treasures...
:{{A|vo kylq001 2 kaeya 13.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' My grandfather's treasure is a sword!
:{{A|vo kylq001 2 kaeya 14.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' A magic sword that grants the wielder unrivaled power!
:{{A|vo kylq001 2 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh wowwwww!
:{{A|vo kylq001 2 kaeya 15.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' The sword was dropped from [[Celestia]] into the sea by a god. It was later salvaged by my grandfather's crew by pure coincidence.
:{{A|vo kylq001 2 kaeya 16.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' The moment he gripped the sword, thunder roared, billows hollowed, and the clear skies were suddenly swallowed by raging winds...
:{{A|vo kylq001 2 kaeya 17.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' With the might of the magic sword, my grandfather went on to defeat a hydra, a silver-haired banshee, a wicked abyss dragon...
:{{A|vo kylq001 2 kaeya 18.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' But the immense power of the sword enticed many more greedy pirates.
:{{A|vo kylq001 2 kaeya 19.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' To avoid meaningless conflicts, my grandfather hid the magic sword.
:{{DIcon}} Eight-headed hydras, silver-haired banshees... Do they really exist?
::{{A|vo kylq001 2 kaeya 20.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' The world we live in is fascinating, full of unknown and inexplicable wonders.
:{{DIcon}} ...
::{{A|vo kylq001 2 kaeya 21.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' These incredibly thrilling adventures are romances that could only be told by pirates.
:{{A|vo kylq001 2 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Holy moley! That's just insane!
:{{A|vo kylq001 2 kaeya 22.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' A gang of {{Color|buzzword|Treasure Hoarders|link=1}} has been very active lately and many ruins have had their relics stolen by them.
:{{A|vo kylq001 2 kaeya 23.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' I'm afraid that they will soon discover the [[Arcadia]]n Ruins and the magic sword will be lost...
:{{A|vo kylq001 2 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' We won't let it fall into the wrong hands! We must get the sword before them.
:{{A|vo kylq001 2 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You just rest assured that Paimon and {{Traveler}} are here to help!
:{{A|vo kylq001 2 kaeya 24.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' Wow~
:{{A|vo kylq001 2 kaeya 25.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' Great! Please keep it a secret. I'll wait for your good news!
:{{Color|menu|Talk to Paimon}}
:{{A|vo kylq001 3 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hey! So whatcha think, {{Traveler}}? Isn't it exciting? We're talking about a super-duper powerful sword!
:{{DIcon}} Is it true?
:{{DIcon}} Is it really, really true?
:{{A|vo kylq001 3 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Well... let's go to the {{Color|buzzword|Adventurers' Guild}} and see if we can find out more.
:{{A|vo kylq001 3 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' The adventurers should know more about the ruins, right?

;(Talk to Kaeya again inside the Knights of Favonius Headquarters, optional)

'''''Key Decision''''' is a quest in {{Quest|The Gang's Daily Deeds}}.

==Steps==
# Talk to Mamoru and the others
# Go to the second floor of Uyuu Restaurant
# Talk to Arataki Itto
# Return to Uyuu Restaurant
# Talk to the merchants near the street
# Talk to Aoi, owner of Tsukomomono Groceries
# Go to the next person you need to apologize to
# Talk to the Arataki Gang Members

:{{A|vo jqrcop001 1914408 shinobu 03.ogg}} '''Kuki Shinobu:''' I know how preposterous it sounds, but they have, in fact, been cleaning up the flyers. Numerous witnesses in this area can attest to that.

:{{A|vo jqrcop001 1914408 shinobu 04.ogg}} '''Kuki Shinobu:''' Wait, please! I can explain...
:{{A|vo jqrcop001 1914408 norika 01.ogg}} '''Norika:''' What's going on?
:{{A|vo jqrcop001 1914408 amano 05.ogg}} '''Amano:''' So sorry, Madam Norika. I'm just stopping some hooligans from posting flyers...
:{{A|vo jqrcop001 1914408 itto 04.ogg}} '''Arataki Itto:''' We already told you, we are innocent! Are you even listening?
:{{A|vo jqrcop001 1914408 amano 06.ogg}} '''Amano:''' You've been detained at the Police Station for graffiti countless times. You're really trying to tell me you're an innocent man?
:{{A|vo jqrcop001 1914408 itto 05.ogg}} '''Arataki Itto:''' Well, oni... but that's beside the point. It's different this time, I swear!
:{{A|vo jqrcop001 1914408 norika 02.ogg}} '''Norika:''' Doushin, this is Miss Kuki, a business partner of mine. I can vouch for her honest and forthright character.
:{{A|vo jqrcop001 1914408 norika 03.ogg}} '''Norika:''' If her friends have done anything wrong, she will not hide it. Perhaps we could hear her out first?
:{{A|vo jqrcop001 1914408 norika 04.ogg}} '''Norika:''' After all, since we're gonna be working together in a few days... it would be a shame to let something like this come between us, don't you think?
:{{A|vo jqrcop001 1914408 amano 07.ogg}} '''Amano:''' Working together... Oh, you mean, the thing Madam Kujou Sara briefed us on?
:{{A|vo jqrcop001 1914408 amano 08.ogg}} '''Amano:''' Understood. We will hear your explanation.
:{{A|vo jqrcop001 1914408 shinobu 05.ogg}} '''Kuki Shinobu:''' *sigh* Alright...
:{{Black Screen|''Kuki Shinobu explains the situation to Doushin Amano...''}}
:{{A|vo jqrcop001 1914408 amano 09.ogg}} '''Amano:''' I see. So you did post the flyers, but then you did the responsible thing and came back to clear them up...

:{{A|vo jqrcop001 1914408 shinobu 06.ogg}} '''Kuki Shinobu:''' No apology needed. We know how much trouble we've created for you in the past.
:{{A|vo jqrcop001 1914408 norika 05.ogg}} '''Norika:''' *sigh* Well, I'm glad to see that the misunderstanding is resolved. Well, I will see you soon — I hope we can work together effectively.
:{{A|vo jqrcop001 1914408 amano 11.ogg}} '''Amano:''' Most certainly, Ma'am.
:{{A|vo jqrcop001 1914408 genta 01.ogg}} '''Genta:''' Boss... did you hear what they said...
:{{A|vo jqrcop001 1914408 mamoru 02.ogg}} '''Mamoru:''' This means... Shinobu has already made her decision?
:{{A|vo jqrcop001 1914408 itto 06.ogg}} '''Arataki Itto:''' Yep, looks like it's time for us to make a decision, too...
:{{A|vo jqrcop001 1914408 itto 07.ogg}} '''Arataki Itto:''' Move to the backup plan!
:{{A|vo jqrcop001 1914408 shinobu 07.ogg}} '''Kuki Shinobu:''' Guys, chill... What are you up to now?
:{{A|vo jqrcop001 1914408 together 01.ogg}} '''Arataki Gang Members:''' Shinobu... Thank you for everything!
:{{A|vo jqrcop001 1914408 shinobu 08.ogg}} '''Kuki Shinobu:''' Hey, what's this all about?
:{{A|vo jqrcop001 1914408 itto 08.ogg}} '''Arataki Itto:''' Shinobu, this is a parting gift from all of us in the Arataki Gang. We all pitched in and bought you this from Tsukumomono Groceries.
:{{A|vo jqrcop001 1914408 itto 09.ogg}} '''Arataki Itto:''' We know it's nothing compared to your salary in the Shogunate, but...
:{{A|vo jqrcop001 1914408 shinobu 09.ogg}} '''Kuki Shinobu:''' A Naku Weed bracelet...? What am I supposed to do with this?
:{{A|vo jqrcop001 1914408 genta 02.ogg}} '''Genta:''' Shinobu! Don't forget about us when you're in the Tenryou Commission!
:{{A|vo jqrcop001 1914408 mamoru 04.ogg}} '''Mamoru:''' We'll all try and be better people... and better oni. We promise to stay out of trouble and not make your job difficult!
:{{A|vo jqrcop001 1914408 shinobu 10.ogg}} '''Kuki Shinobu:''' Wait... who said I'm leaving?
:{{A|vo jqrcop001 1914408 akira 02.ogg}} '''Akira:''' Also, Shinobu, when you couldn't find your snacks last week, the truth is... I ate them...
:{{A|vo jqrcop001 1914408 genta 03.ogg}} '''Genta:''' And last month, I stole that toy we won, and when you came and asked me for it, I... I lied and I told you it was broken... *sobs*
:{{A|vo jqrcop001 1914408 shinobu 11.ogg}} '''Kuki Shinobu:''' ...
:{{A|vo jqrcop001 1914408 itto 10.ogg}} '''Arataki Itto:''' Hey, no crying! We talked about this, send her off with a smile, alright? Who are we? We're... t—the Arataki Gang!
:{{A|vo jqrcop001 1914408 itto 11.ogg}} '''Arataki Itto:''' Shinobu is moving on to better things. We should be happy for her!
:{{A|vo jqrcop001 1914408 mamoru 05.ogg}} '''Mamoru:''' *sobs* ...You're right... You're right, Boss... *sobs*
:{{A|vo jqrcop001 1914408 genta 04.ogg}} '''Genta:''' The Arataki Gang... rules... *sobs*
:{{DIcon}} Ugh...
:{{DIcon}} Sh—Shinobu...
:{{A|vo jqrcop001 1914408 shinobu 12.ogg}} '''Kuki Shinobu:''' Hey, don't you start, too.

:{{A|vo jqrcop001 1914408 shinobu 13.ogg}} '''Kuki Shinobu:''' ...Yes. Sorry for making a scene.
:{{A|vo jqrcop001 1914408 norika 07.ogg}} '''Norika:''' Hmm, I forgot to introduce myself. My name is Norika, a merchant who does business between Inazuma and Liyue. Recently, I've been negotiating a business deal with the Tenryou Commission regarding medical supplies.

:{{A|vo jqrcop001 1914408 norika 11.ogg}} '''Norika:''' That's right. Thanks to Miss Kuki, our negotiations went very smoothly.

:{{DIcon}} I knew it...
:{{DIcon}} I thought so.
:{{A|vo jqrcop001 1914408 shinobu 14.ogg}} '''Kuki Shinobu:''' I can definitely spare the time — so long as these guys stay out of trouble.
:{{A|vo jqrcop001 1914408 norika 13.ogg}} '''Norika:''' Ah, yes, I have a little compensation for you all: here, some trial packs of our new supplies.
:{{A|vo jqrcop001 1914408 norika 14.ogg}} '''Norika:''' Miss Kuki tells me that you often find yourselves in injury-prone situations... I heartily recommend our product!
:{{A|vo jqrcop001 1914408 mamoru 07.ogg}} '''Mamoru:''' This is unexpected...
:{{A|vo jqrcop001 1914408 akira 03.ogg}} '''Akira:''' So she's really a merchant...
:{{A|vo jqrcop001 1914408 itto 12.ogg}} '''Arataki Itto:''' Uh... hehe... Hahaha! Oh, you guys, I knew you must have gotten the wrong idea! Shinobu would never quit!
:{{A|vo jqrcop001 1914408 itto 13.ogg}} '''Arataki Itto:''' Look at all this fuss you made over nothing! Pfft, planning a whole leaving ceremony...
