:{{A|vo jqrcop001 1914408 itto 14.ogg}} '''Arataki Itto:''' Ahem! Alright, well, if we're done here, I'm gonna head to Tsukumomono Groceries and see if they'll let me return the bracelet...
:{{A|vo jqrcop001 1914408 akira 04.ogg}} '''Akira:''' Wait up, Boss, we'll come with you!
:{{A|vo jqrcop001 1914408 shinobu 15.ogg}} '''Kuki Shinobu:''' Hold it right there.
:{{A|vo jqrcop001 1914408 mamoru 08.ogg}} '''Mamoru:''' Eek!
:{{A|vo jqrcop001 1914408 shinobu 16.ogg}} '''Kuki Shinobu:''' Last week's snacks, last month's toy... What else aren't you telling me?
:{{A|vo jqrcop001 1914408 genta 07.ogg}} '''Genta:''' Oh, uh... the thing is... you see...
:{{DIcon}} Shinobu, let it slide!
:{{DIcon}} Calm down, Shinobu!
:{{A|vo jqrcop001 1914408 shinobu 17.ogg}} '''Kuki Shinobu:''' You've all got your new first aid supplies — don't you want to test them out?

:{{A|vo jnqlq003 1 kinich 01.ogg}} '''Kinich:''' {{Traveler}}, Paimon.
:{{A|vo jnqlq003 1 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Kinich! Fancy meeting you here! We've actually been looking for you.
:{{DIcon}} Hey there. Nice to see you again.
:{{A|vo jnqlq003 1 kinich 02.ogg}} '''Kinich:''' I'll get straight to the point. I hear you accepted a proposal from elder Trinidad?
:{{A|vo jnqlq003 1 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh! The, uh, [[Turnfire Night]], you mean? Uhh... You were still his first choice, it's just... Oh geez... It's not what it looks like, promise!
:{{A|vo jnqlq003 1 kinich 03.ogg}} '''Kinich:''' Chill, it's cool. I only mention it because there's something you should know, and I suspect Elder Trinidad hasn't been completely forthcoming with you. His true intention is to resolve the [[Kongamato|Mountain King]] problem once and for all.
:{{A|vo jnqlq003 1 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Once and for all? You mean, this'll be the last Turnfire Night ever?
:{{A|vo jnqlq003 1 kinich 04.ogg}} '''Kinich:''' That's right. He wants to use you to send the Mountain King to the [[Night Kingdom]].
:{{A|vo jnqlq003 1 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' To the Night Kingdom? You mean—
:{{A|vo jnqlq003 1 kinich 05.ogg}} '''Kinich:''' To his death.
:{{A|vo jnqlq003 1 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Whoa, whoa, whoa! Are you serious right now? You shouldn't go around blurting out accusations like that, it can get you in trouble!
:{{A|vo jnqlq003 1 kinich 06.ogg}} '''Kinich:''' Too blunt? Okay. I'll phrase it more gently...
:{{A|vo jnqlq003 1 kinich 07.ogg}} '''Kinich:''' There is potentially a possibility that Elder Trinidad may be hoping that, during the course of the ceremony... you kill the Mountain King dead.
:{{A|vo jnqlq003 1 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' But... That's ridiculous! He told us the Mountain King is a living symbol of your tribe's glory!
:{{A|vo jnqlq003 1 kinich 08.ogg}} '''Kinich:''' And that glory comes at a price.
:{{Color|menu|You remember the words Elder Trinidad spoke...}}
;(A flashback begins)
:{{A|vo jnqlq003 1 trinidad 01.ogg}} '''Trinidad:''' That's right. The Mountain King is a living symbol of our glory, but even this glory comes at a price.
:{{A|vo jnqlq003 1 trinidad 02.ogg}} '''Trinidad:''' *sigh*... Yes, and [[Nanna]] wasn't the first...
;(Flashback ends)
:{{DIcon}} Is it because of his companion, Nanna?
:{{A|vo jnqlq003 1 kinich 09.ogg}} '''Kinich:''' Mhm. She likely won't be the last to lose her life, either.
:{{A|vo jnqlq003 1 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Still... Is killing the Mountain King really the only way? It seems so extreme...
:{{DIcon}} How does he plan to kill him?
:{{A|vo jnqlq003 1 kinich 10.ogg}} '''Kinich:''' The Mountain King is a unique case when it comes to [[Abyss]]al contamination. It's eaten away at him for so long that it has consumed him entirely, and the damage is irreversible.
:{{A|vo jnqlq003 1 kinich 11.ogg}} '''Kinich:''' That evil power has both driven him insane and kept him alive over the centuries. So to look at it one way, once it's completely purged from his body, the Mountain King will finally be able to rest in peace.
:{{A|vo jnqlq003 1 kinich 12.ogg}} '''Kinich:''' In past ceremonies, we've only purged around half of the Abyssal power. This was to strike a balance — to keep him alive, but also keep him asleep.
:{{A|vo jnqlq003 1 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Trinidad didn't say anything about how much power he wanted us to purge... But he did say there were some more details to go over before the ceremony.
:{{A|vo jnqlq003 1 kinich 13.ogg}} '''Kinich:''' Then it sounds like you'll know for sure soon enough.
:{{A|vo jnqlq003 1 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' ...If he really asks us to kill the Mountain King, what should we do?
:{{DIcon}} I think we're a little out of our depth here.
:{{DIcon}} Is it too late for us to back out?
:{{A|vo jnqlq003 1 kinich 14.ogg}} '''Kinich:''' I know this must come as quite a shock, so I suggest you act like you didn't hear anything for now. But would you have time to visit the chief after your meeting with Elder Trinidad?
:{{A|vo jnqlq003 1 kinich 15.ogg}} '''Kinich:''' I'd like to make a deal with you.
:{{A|vo jnqlq003 1 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What kind of deal?
:{{A|vo jnqlq003 1 kinich 16.ogg}} '''Kinich:''' One that comes at a very reasonable price. I'm sure you have plenty of other questions, but we can talk more later.
:{{DIcon}} Okay. We'll be there.
:{{A|vo jnqlq003 1 kinich 17.ogg}} '''Kinich:''' Good. See you soon.

;(Talk to Trinidad)
:{{A|vo jnqlq003 2 trinidad 01.ogg}} '''Trinidad:''' Ah, mighty outlanders, you have returned. Did you have a good rest?
:{{A|vo jnqlq003 2 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' It was, uh... pretty good, yeah!
:{{A|vo jnqlq003 2 trinidad 02.ogg}} '''Trinidad:''' Glad to hear it. Things are progressing very smoothly on my end. Many of the elders have heard of your heroic deeds, including the chief. They all speak very favorably of you.
:{{A|vo jnqlq003 2 trinidad 03.ogg}} '''Trinidad:''' There are still those who insist that the ceremony should be performed by the bearer of the {{Rubi|Malipo|Turnfire}} name, but they're just stuck in the past. We need to move with the times.
:{{A|vo jnqlq003 2 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Plus, Kinich doesn't wanna do it anyway...
:{{A|vo jnqlq003 2 trinidad 04.ogg}} '''Trinidad:''' Exactly. So now, it's time for us to discuss the finer details of the ceremony.
:{{A|vo jnqlq003 2 trinidad 05.ogg}} '''Trinidad:''' We covered the fire-lighting part of the proceedings yesterday. The next part is the purification of the Mountain King.
:{{DIcon}} How does that work?
:{{A|vo jnqlq003 2 trinidad 06.ogg}} '''Trinidad:''' It's quite simple — you just need to use the sacred flame. We've done it plenty of times before and it's always very routine. I'm sure you won't have any problems.
:{{A|vo jnqlq003 2 trinidad 07.ogg}} '''Trinidad:''' One point I'd like to stress, though, is that you need to burn away as much of the Abyssal energy as you possibly can. The more we dispel, the longer the Mountain King will remain asleep.
:{{A|vo jnqlq003 2 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' "Asleep," huh...
:{{A|vo jnqlq003 2 trinidad 08.ogg}} '''Trinidad:''' Precisely. In previous years, the flame bearer has often been unable to dispel a sufficient amount of Abyssal energy. That's the only reason why we have to perform the ceremony on a regular basis.
:{{A|vo jnqlq003 2 trinidad 09.ogg}} '''Trinidad:''' But I understand that you have a lot of experience fighting against the Abyss. And you seemed to wield the sacred flame quite effortlessly yesterday.
:{{A|vo jnqlq003 2 trinidad 10.ogg}} '''Trinidad:''' With your help, I'm optimistic that this time we can dispel all the remaining Abyssal energy from the Mountain King's body, freeing us from this ever-looming threat for many years to come.
:{{A|vo jnqlq003 2 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' {{Traveler}}...
:{{DIcon}} Got it. Anything else we need to know?
:{{A|vo jnqlq003 2 trinidad 11.ogg}} '''Trinidad:''' So this doesn't faze you at all, huh? You clearly have a lot of confidence in yourself, haha.
:{{A|vo jnqlq003 2 trinidad 12.ogg}} '''Trinidad:''' That's all you really need to know. The ceremony is in three days. I'll come and fetch you when we're ready.
:{{A|vo jnqlq003 2 trinidad 13.ogg}} '''Trinidad:''' In the meantime, feel free to take a look around our settlement. It would mean a lot to the elders if you got to know some of our people.
:{{A|vo jnqlq003 2 trinidad 14.ogg}} '''Trinidad:''' And if you wouldn't mind helping them out with a few errands here and there, that would be even better.
:{{A|vo jnqlq003 2 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So now we have extra errands to run? Maybe we should add a little extra to the price...
:{{A|vo jnqlq003 2 trinidad 15.ogg}} '''Trinidad:''' Haha, just a humble suggestion, that's all. It will help you gain the respect of our people, and as a mighty hero, I truly believe that's what you deserve.
:{{A|vo jnqlq003 2 trinidad 16.ogg}} '''Trinidad:''' I'll be sticking around over the next few days, so if you have any questions, you know where to find me.

;(After the cutscene)
:{{A|vo jnqlq003 3 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Seems like Kinich was right... We should go meet up with him right away.

;(Talk to Kinich or [[Wayna]])
:{{A|vo jnqlq003 4 kinich 01.ogg}} '''Kinich:''' Ah, you're here.
:{{A|vo jnqlq003 4 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Kinich! Elder Trinidad said that—
:{{A|vo jnqlq003 4 kinich 02.ogg}} '''Kinich:''' I can tell. It's written on your faces.
:{{A|vo jnqlq003 4 wayna 01.ogg}} '''Wayna:''' Is that {{Traveler}} and Paimon? Forgive me for not being there to welcome you on your arrival. That should have been my duty as chief.
:{{A|vo jnqlq003 4 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hello, Chief Wayna.
:{{A|vo jnqlq003 4 wayna 02.ogg}} '''Wayna:''' I only heard the news from Trinidad yesterday, so I asked Kinich to invite you over for a quick chat.
:{{DIcon}} It's our pleasure.
:{{A|vo jnqlq003 4 wayna 03.ogg}} '''Wayna:''' Hehe... I believe Kinich has already filled you in, so I'll get straight to the point. Firstly, I fully endorse your appointment as flame bearers for the upcoming Turnfire Night.
:{{A|vo jnqlq003 4 wayna 04.ogg}} '''Wayna:''' However, I would like to request that you take steps to ensure the Mountain King's safety.
:{{A|vo jnqlq003 4 wayna 05.ogg}} '''Wayna:''' Every child of our tribe grows up hearing the tales of our heroes, from [[Yupanqui]] the Fire-Bringer, to [[Burkina]] and the Mountain King who fought against the Abyss...
:{{A|vo jnqlq003 4 wayna 06.ogg}} '''Wayna:''' This is our history and our heritage, the source of our pride and the center of our faith.
:{{A|vo jnqlq003 4 wayna 07.ogg}} '''Wayna:''' To kill the Mountain King would be to destroy our spirit... I would never be able to face our ancestors in the Night Kingdom.
:{{A|vo jnqlq003 4 wayna 08.ogg}} '''Wayna:''' Nanna's death was a great tragedy, and I do not blame Trinidad for the actions he has taken. Nevertheless, I cannot allow any harm to come to the Mountain King. The very roots of our identity are at stake.
:{{A|vo jnqlq003 4 wayna 09.ogg}} '''Wayna:''' My honored guests, please give this matter your serious consideration.
:{{DIcon}} Is there no solution that would satisfy both sides?
:{{A|vo jnqlq003 4 wayna 10.ogg}} '''Wayna:''' Perhaps there is. But despite all our attempts to contain the situation over the years, we have not found it. Right now, I should like to hear where you stand on this matter.
:{{DIcon}} I'm inclined to honor your request.
::{{A|vo jnqlq003 4 wayna 11a 1.ogg}} '''Wayna:''' Though I sense that your mind is not yet made up, I am still comforted by your words. There are three days left before the ceremony. I hope they will bring you clarity.
:{{DIcon}} I'm inclined to honor my agreement with Trinidad.
::{{A|vo jnqlq003 4 wayna 11b 1.ogg}} '''Wayna:''' I must say, I find this troubling, though I'm sure you need more time to consider it fully. No matter, there are still three days left before the ceremony. I hope they will bring you clarity.
:{{DIcon}} I need some time to mull this over.
::{{A|vo jnqlq003 4 wayna 11c 1.ogg}} '''Wayna:''' I understand. There are still three days left before the ceremony. I hope they will bring you clarity.
:{{DIcon}} Paimon, let's sneak off to some other tribe tonight...
::{{A|vo jnqlq003 4 paimon 03d 1.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Running away won't solve anything... You just need some time to think this through, that's all. Don't worry, we'll come up with something if we put our heads together!
::{{A|vo jnqlq003 4 wayna 11d 1.ogg}} '''Chief:''' Thank you both. There are still three days left before the ceremony. I hope they will bring you clarity.
:{{A|vo jnqlq003 4 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So Kinich, earlier, you were saying that—
:{{A|vo jnqlq003 4 kinich 03.ogg}} '''Kinich:''' Let's walk and talk. I'll show you around the tribe.
:{{A|vo jnqlq003 4 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' That works too. Paimon needs to get some air after this...

;(Approach the marker)
:{{A|vo jnqlq003 5 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Kinich, Paimon finally understands why you turned Trinidad down.
:{{A|vo jnqlq003 5 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You knew what he was planning, didn't you? That's why you didn't wanna be the flame bearer this time, 'cause it's a double-edged sword. The whole [[Mora]] thing was just a sneaky excuse!
:{{A|vo jnqlq003 5 kinich 01.ogg}} '''Kinich:''' Double-edged sword is right. But my response wasn't merely an excuse: To solve this exceptional problem, an exceptional price must be paid.
:{{DIcon}} Are you saying you have a plan?
:{{A|vo jnqlq003 5 kinich 02.ogg}} '''Kinich:''' I'm working on it.
:{{A|vo jnqlq003 5 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Really? Well c'mon then, let's hear it!
:{{A|vo jnqlq003 5 kinich 03.ogg}} '''Kinich:''' In a moment. Didn't you have a question you were about to ask me?
:{{A|vo jnqlq003 5 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, yeah... What was it again? ...Oh! Right! We need to talk about [[Ajaw]], he's completely unhinged!
:{{DIcon}} That's a point... where is he today?
:{{A|vo jnqlq003 5 kinich 04.ogg}} '''Kinich:''' I agree that he has a problem. He needs disciplining, so I hired him a teacher.
:{{A|vo jnqlq003 5 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You got him a teacher? Oh, Paimon would love to see him get scolded for bad behavior!
:{{A|vo jnqlq003 5 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Anyway, moving on — when we ran into Ajaw, he said you two were investigating some Abyss thing together... Is that related to the whole Mountain King situation?
:{{A|vo jnqlq003 5 kinich 05.ogg}} '''Kinich:''' Yes. That's the angle I've been working on.
:{{A|vo jnqlq003 5 kinich 06.ogg}} '''Kinich:''' I'm a [[Saurian]] hunter, but I occasionally hunt the Abyss, too. One time, I was pursuing some [[Riftwolf|purple demonic dogs]] when I accidentally entered a hidden space.
:{{A|vo jnqlq003 5 kinich 07.ogg}} '''Kinich:''' I did some research after the fact. Apparently, they're known as "beastly rifts," and there are many of them of all different sizes. That's where those purple dogs were coming from.
:{{A|vo jnqlq003 5 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So...?
:{{A|vo jnqlq003 5 kinich 08.ogg}} '''Kinich:''' So, if we can locate one of these beastly rifts, clear the monsters out, and move the Mountain King inside... he'd be able to continue living, but without posing a threat to the tribe.
:{{A|vo jnqlq003 5 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Whoa! That sounds kind of crazy... Would it really work?
:{{A|vo jnqlq003 5 kinich 09.ogg}} '''Kinich:''' It's not without its risks, of course. There's a lot of unknowns in the equation. For instance, for all we know, a prolonged period inside the rift could make the Mountain King's condition worse.
:{{A|vo jnqlq003 5 kinich 10.ogg}} '''Kinich:''' Still, we desperately need something like this — even just as a temporary measure. You've seen the conflict the issue is causing in our tribe for yourselves, and believe me, it's been a long time coming.
:{{A|vo jnqlq003 5 kinich 11.ogg}} '''Kinich:''' The chief is adamant about keeping the Mountain King alive, whatever happens.
:{{A|vo jnqlq003 5 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Paimon can understand... It's less about the Mountain King, and more about preserving your culture and heritage.
:{{A|vo jnqlq003 5 kinich 12.ogg}} '''Kinich:''' Yes, but on the flip side, you've got people like Elder Trinidad, who is more concerned about protecting the people he cares about, now and into the future.
:{{A|vo jnqlq003 5 kinich 13.ogg}} '''Kinich:''' And he has every right to take that view. It's one thing to try and preserve the last remnants of a glorious past, but making your kin pay the price for it?
:{{A|vo jnqlq003 5 kinich 14.ogg}} '''Kinich:''' No one can seriously tell them that's a fair trade.
:{{A|vo jnqlq003 5 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You're right, there's no easy answers here... Let's leave that to one side for a moment and assume we go with your plan. How do you actually intend to find one of these beastly rifts?
:{{A|vo jnqlq003 5 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Cause at least in our experience, the dogs open the rifts when they wanna attack us, not the other way around.
:{{A|vo jnqlq003 5 kinich 15.ogg}} '''Kinich:''' I think I know a way.
:{{DIcon}} Are you really gonna do this?
:{{A|vo jnqlq003 5 kinich 16.ogg}} '''Kinich:''' You have any better ideas?
:{{A|vo jnqlq003 5 paimon 12.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Not at the moment, but... It just feels like using the power of the Abyss for our own ends isn't gonna end well...
:{{A|vo jnqlq003 5 paimon 13.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' After all, the Abyss is what turned the Mountain King into a monster in the first place. People are gonna think you've lost your marbles...
:{{A|vo jnqlq003 5 kinich 17.ogg}} '''Kinich:''' If it doesn't end well, then that's the price we pay. Everything in the world comes at a price... Even when Yupanqui the Fire-Bringer stole the [[Turnfire]], it cost him dearly.
:{{A|vo jnqlq003 5 kinich 18.ogg}} '''Kinich:''' The Mountain King's erratic outbursts have brought tensions within the tribe to a boiling point. Unless this gets resolved quickly, everyone will be stuck in a stalemate.
:{{A|vo jnqlq003 5 paimon 14.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Alright... So what's this "deal" you wanted to make with us? We're hardly experts on exploiting Abyssal power...
:{{A|vo jnqlq003 5 kinich 19.ogg}} '''Kinich:''' All I need you to do is keep people away from me.
:{{A|vo jnqlq003 5 kinich 20.ogg}} '''Kinich:''' I'm getting harassed on a daily basis by people trying to convince me to be the flame bearer. I can't afford to waste all my energy dealing with them.
:{{A|vo jnqlq003 5 kinich 21.ogg}} '''Kinich:''' If you help me out, there'll be a gift for you in return.
:{{A|vo jnqlq003 5 paimon 15.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ooh, what kind of gift?
:{{A|vo jnqlq003 5 kinich 22.ogg}} '''Kinich:''' Something well worth your while, I'd say.
:{{DIcon}} Okay, but how do we keep people away?
:{{A|vo jnqlq003 5 kinich 23.ogg}} '''Kinich:''' Just keep doing what you've been doing — ingratiate yourself with the tribespeople, so everyone comes to terms with the fact that we have a new flame bearer.
:{{A|vo jnqlq003 5 kinich 24.ogg}} '''Kinich:''' That way, I won't have an endless stream of people coming to beg me to join the ceremony, and I can focus on finding a way to summon the beastly rift.
:{{A|vo jnqlq003 5 kinich 25.ogg}} '''Kinich:''' Then, when the day of the ceremony comes, we'll move the Mountain King into his new home.
:{{A|vo jnqlq003 5 paimon 16.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Still sounds pretty crazy... Even for a daredevil like you, that's dangerous...
:{{A|vo jnqlq003 5 paimon 17.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' And even if it works — what if neither Chief Wayna nor Elder Trinidad are happy with it? Have you thought about what you'd do then?
:{{A|vo jnqlq003 5 kinich 26.ogg}} '''Kinich:''' At least the two of them would finally be on the same side of the issue, leaving only me on the opposing side.
:{{A|vo jnqlq003 5 kinich 27.ogg}} '''Kinich:''' The tribe needs leaders like them far more than a Saurian hunter for hire like me.
:{{DIcon}} Either way, sounds like there's no mora in this for you.
:{{A|vo jnqlq003 5 kinich 28.ogg}} '''Kinich:''' Hah. Can I take that to mean that we have a deal?
:{{DIcon}} We can give it a try.
:{{A|vo jnqlq003 5 paimon 18.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' For sure. And who knows, maybe we'll come up with an even better solution to all of this in the next couple of days.
:{{A|vo jnqlq003 5 kinich 29.ogg}} '''Kinich:''' Great. Well, for the next couple of days, please spend some time among the tribe and lend a hand wherever you can. I'm sure everyone will be swept off their feet when they meet our new flame bearer.
:{{A|vo jnqlq003 5 kinich 30.ogg}} '''Kinich:''' Good luck to us both.
{{Dialogue End}}

==Dialogue==
{{Quest Description|Repel the Treasure Hoarders and rescue the merchant being threatened by them.}}
===Knight and Deaconess, Ready for Battle!===
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Defeat the Treasure Hoarders)
:{{A|vo bblcop001 1900501 thboss 01.ogg}} '''Treasure Hoarder Boss:''' Who dares enter our territory?
:{{A|vo bblcop001 1900501 barbara 01.ogg}} '''Barbara:''' Release your hostage immediately!
:{{A|vo bblcop001 1900501 thboss 02.ogg}} '''Treasure Hoarder Boss:''' Hah, so you wanna play the hero.... Hoarders, seize the girl! Let's see if this idiot with her dares make a move.
:{{A|vo bblcop001 1900501 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh no! They're going after Barbara! We've gotta—
:{{A|vo bblcop001 1900501 barbara 02.ogg}} '''Barbara:''' Don't worry about me! I'm a Vision bearer, after all. I'll handle these guys, you go rescue the merchant.
:{{A|vo bblcop001 1900501 thsidekick 01.ogg}} '''Treasure Hoarder Sidekick:''' Sh—She's got a Vision! Boss, what should we do?
:{{A|vo bblcop001 1900501 thboss 03.ogg}} '''Treasure Hoarder Boss:''' What are you scared of? She's just a girl, so what if she's got a Vision? There are more of us — quit stalling and get her!

;(Talk to Caishan)
:{{A|vo bblcop001 1900501 caishan 01.ogg}} '''Caishan:''' Thank you, I can't express my gratitude...
:{{A|vo bblcop001 1900501 caishan 02.ogg}} '''Caishan:''' I'm a merchant from Liyue. I was on my way to Mondstadt...
:{{A|vo bblcop001 1900501 caishan 03.ogg}} '''Caishan:''' I had no idea there were Treasure Hoarders on the road. They seized me and brought me here...
:{{A|vo bblcop001 1900501 caishan 04.ogg}} '''Caishan:''' If it weren't for you, gods know what would have happened to me.
:{{A|vo bblcop001 1900501 caishan 05.ogg}} '''Caishan:''' Oh! Please allow me to repay your kindness. The Treasure Hoarders already made off with most of my things, but let me see here...
:{{A|vo bblcop001 1900501 caishan 06.ogg}} '''Caishan:''' So, there are still a few bottles of Chilibrew... a few Sweet Flowers, and... here's some Mora!
:{{A|vo bblcop001 1900501 barbara 03.ogg}} '''Barbara:''' No, no, no, we don't need a reward! Rescuing those in need is only natural...
:{{A|vo bblcop001 1900501 barbara 04.ogg}} '''Barbara:''' Besides, I'm the Deaconess of the Church of Favonius, and this is the Knights of Favonius' Honorary Knight.
:{{A|vo bblcop001 1900501 barbara 05.ogg}} '''Barbara:''' As a visitor from Liyue, we have a duty to guard your safety.
:{{A|vo bblcop001 1900501 caishan 07.ogg}} '''Caishan:''' I won't hear of it! You rescued me, it's only right that your kindness is repaid.
:{{A|vo bblcop001 1900501 caishan 08.ogg}} '''Caishan:''' I'm afraid I have nothing of great value to offer, but please choose what you'd like.
:{{A|vo bblcop001 1900501 barbara 06.ogg}} '''Barbara:''' Umm, okay... I just don't know what to choose...
:{{A|vo bblcop001 1900501 barbara 07.ogg}} '''Barbara:''' Liyue Chilibrew might be delicious, but with those Sweet Flowers, I'd have enough ingredients to make my own...
:{{A|vo bblcop001 1900501 barbara 08.ogg}} '''Barbara:''' I know! You have way more adventuring experience than me, you'll be better at this...
:{{A|vo bblcop001 1900501 barbara 09.ogg}} '''Barbara:''' You choose! What do you think is the most fitting reward?
:{{A|vo bblcop001 1900501 caishan 09.ogg}} '''Caishan:''' Yes, adventurers are savvy when it comes to rewards... What'll it be? Liyue's famous Chilibrew, sweet Flowers, or Mora?
:{{DIcon}} Well, we were looking for Sweet Flowers...
::{{A|vo bblcop001 1900501 caishan 15.ogg}} '''Caishan:''' Really? Sweet Flowers in a Chilibrew...? I guess it's all Chilibrew at the end of the day, but the Mondstadt version sure sounds... interesting.
::{{A|vo bblcop001 1900501 caishan 16.ogg}} '''Caishan:''' Sweet Flowers it is, these are an excellent batch. Thanks again for your help, I better get moving.

===Home-Made Chilibrew===
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Head to the garden near the Adventurers' Guild and wait for Barbara)
;(Talk to Barbara)
:{{A|vo bblcop001 1900504 barbara 01.ogg}} '''Barbara:''' Sorry for the delay, the Chilibrew's ready! Why don't we drink these here?
:{{A|vo bblcop001 1900504 barbara 02.ogg}} '''Barbara:''' Here, this one is for you. Let me know what you think!
:{{DIcon}} This is... pretty good.
:{{A|vo bblcop001 1900504 barbara 03.ogg}} '''Barbara:''' Really? Is the flavor okay for you?
:{{A|vo bblcop001 1900504 barbara 04.ogg}} '''Barbara:''' I was worried you might not like it.
:{{DIcon}} So what got you into Chilibrew?
:{{DIcon}} You've got an... interesting taste in drinks...
::{{A|vo bblcop001 1900504 barbara 05.ogg}} '''Barbara:''' Um... Now that you mention it, I guess I'm the only one in the whole of Mondstadt that likes Chilibrew.
:{{A|vo bblcop001 1900504 barbara 06.ogg}} '''Barbara:''' Well... I like Chilibrew because... actually, it's a little embarrassing...
:{{A|vo bblcop001 1900504 barbara 07.ogg}} '''Barbara:''' At first, I drank Chilibrew just to keep me awake...
:{{A|vo bblcop001 1900504 barbara 08.ogg}} '''Barbara:''' When I first began singing practice, I had to get up early every day.
:{{A|vo bblcop001 1900504 barbara 09.ogg}} '''Barbara:''' After practice, I would go work at the Church to take care of official matters.
:{{A|vo bblcop001 1900504 barbara 10.ogg}} '''Barbara:''' But because I was getting up so early... my singing wasn't getting any better. Sometimes I'd be half asleep, singing the wrong lyrics, it was a disaster...
:{{A|vo bblcop001 1900504 barbara 11.ogg}} '''Barbara:''' I went to people for advice on how to stay awake. They had all kinds of methods: running, chewing mint... one adventurer even told me they'd fight slimes to stave off sleep...
:{{A|vo bblcop001 1900504 barbara 12.ogg}} '''Barbara:''' None of these ideas worked for me, they were too time-consuming. By the time I started to feel awake, there was hardly any time left for practice.
:{{A|vo bblcop001 1900504 barbara 13.ogg}} '''Barbara:''' Hehe, that was until I started chewing Jueyun Chilis...
:{{DIcon}} And that didn't... affect your voice?
:{{DIcon}} Sounds bad for singing...
:{{A|vo bblcop001 1900504 barbara 14.ogg}} '''Barbara:''' Hehe, that's what Sara said... She told me not to chew them, but to use the Jueyun Chilis to make some kind of drink, something milder in flavor...
:{{A|vo bblcop001 1900504 barbara 15.ogg}} '''Barbara:''' Using Sweet Flowers to temper the flavor was also her idea.
:{{A|vo bblcop001 1900504 barbara 16.ogg}} '''Barbara:''' That's when I started using this new and improved Chilibrew method. After a while... I actually started to enjoy the flavor.
:{{A|vo bblcop001 1900504 barbara 17.ogg}} '''Barbara:''' Whenever I drank it, the spiciness would always push me to work harder...
:{{DIcon}} I guess that's what "hard work" tastes like...
:{{DIcon}} Sounds like this bottle of Chilibrew is a reflection of your determination.
:{{A|vo bblcop001 1900504 barbara 18.ogg}} '''Barbara:''' I don't know what to say...
:{{A|vo bblcop001 1900504 barbara 19.ogg}} '''Barbara:''' My determination is nothing compared to yours. I heard Amber say that you're traveling far and wide, looking for your sibling. Is that true?
:{{A|vo bblcop001 1900504 barbara 20.ogg}} '''Barbara:''' Oh, the things you've faced, and those yet to come... are more difficult than a few bad songs.
:{{A|vo bblcop001 1900504 barbara 21.ogg}} '''Barbara:''' Even if I can't assist you in other ways, when it comes to healing, you can count on me. No matter the wound, I will help you recover.
:{{A|vo bblcop001 1900504 barbara 22.ogg}} '''Barbara:''' Uh- have I said too much? Sorry, I'm not used to taking a break, I keep boring you to death...
:{{A|vo bblcop001 1900504 barbara 23.ogg}} '''Barbara:''' It's not often I get so much freedom. Let's just... take our time and drink our drinks.
:{{A|vo bblcop001 1900504 barbara 24.ogg}} '''Barbara:''' Tomorrow, it's back to chasing our dreams with hard work.
:{{A|vo bblcop001 1900504 barbara 25.ogg}} '''Barbara:''' I hope our dreams can come true, in the end.
{{Dialogue End}}

:{{DIcon}} A [[Mondstadt]] merchant here for a meeting with Gentry Maocai.
::{{A|vo xqlq002 2 sturdywu 02a.ogg}} '''Sturdy Wu:''' Really? He didn't mention anything about a meeting...
:{{DIcon}} I'm {{Traveler}}, a VIP client of your boss'!
::{{A|vo xqlq002 2 sturdywu 02b.ogg}} '''Sturdy Wu:''' How strange, you're not on the guestlist...
:{{A|vo xqlq002 2 sturdywu 03.ogg}} '''Sturdy Wu:''' The Master is dealing with some urgent business today. All prior appointments have been canceled.
:{{A|vo xqlq002 2 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Urgent business? ...What is it?
:{{A|vo xqlq002 2 sturdywu 04.ogg}} '''Sturdy Wu:''' The Master has been working on a major business deal recently. He left early this morning to meet with a VIP client.
:{{A|vo xqlq002 2 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So where is he now?
:{{A|vo xqlq002 2 sturdywu 05.ogg}} '''Sturdy Wu:''' I'm sorry, the Master has stressed that we must not disclose the information to just anyone...
:{{DIcon}} "Just anyone"? Are you saying we are not his VIP clients?
:{{A|vo xqlq002 2 sturdywu 06.ogg}} '''Sturdy Wu:''' N—No! I mean yes, yes you are! Ah... I—I meant no offense, please believe me...
:{{DIcon}} Take me to Gentry Maocai or suffer the consequences!
:{{DIcon}} Would you like to explain these extra fees you are incurring to your boss, or shall I?
:{{A|vo xqlq002 2 sturdywu 07.ogg}} '''Sturdy Wu:''' I'm sorry, I'm sorry! Master is currently in business negotiations at Xinyue Kiosk!
:{{A|vo xqlq002 2 sturdywu 08.ogg}} '''Sturdy Wu:''' I beg for your mercy! Please, my master will show me no leniency if he finds out...
:{{A|vo xqlq002 2 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Well, MY master has much more important things to do than talking to rude guards like you.
:{{A|vo xqlq002 2 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Luckily for you, your bad attitude will be the last thing on our minds when my master's busy negotiating a big business deal with your boss!

::{{A|vo xqlq002 2 paimon 06a.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Is that so? Well then. Now Paimon knows not to let your wily ways get the better of her in the future!
:{{DIcon}} You did great too.
::{{A|vo xqlq002 2 paimon 06b.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Tee-hee! Paimon loves compliments and all... but treating Paimon to some tasty snacks would show that you really mean it!
:{{A|vo xqlq002 2 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Anyway, seems like the VIP client in question must be one of the [[Fatui]].
:{{DIcon}} I think you're right.
:{{DIcon}} This could work in our favor.
:{{A|vo xqlq002 2 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' In that case, let's get ourselves over to the Xinyue Kiosk!

;(After earlier dialogue)
:{{A|vo xqlq002 2 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Seems business is booming at the Xinyue Kiosk. No one should notice if we blend in there.
:{{A|vo xqlq002 2 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' But either way, if we wanna know what kinda shady business they're up to, we better be careful!

;(Talk to Sturdy Wu again, optional)
:{{A|vo dialog xqlq002 sturdywu 01.ogg}} '''Sturdy Wu:''' I—I'm sorry if my mistake earlier caused any offence.
----

;(Go to Xinyue Kiosk and eavesdrop on Gentry Maocai)
:{{A|vo xqlq002 7 gentrymaocai 01.ogg}} '''Gentry Maocai:''' I understand. I do. Please do not worry, you have my word that the order will be completed as promised.
:{{A|vo xqlq002 7 agent 01.ogg}} '''Agent:''' Hmm... The subordinate I sent was not quite so optimistic in his appraisal. Is somebody being uncooperative?
:{{A|vo xqlq002 7 gentrymaocai 02.ogg}} '''Gentry Maocai:''' Ah... We just ran into a minor procurement problem is all. We haven't managed to purchase the Cor Lapis yet.
:{{A|vo xqlq002 7 gentrymaocai 03.ogg}} '''Gentry Maocai:''' But it's nothing for you to worry about. If Chang the Ninth won't sell, I can buy from someone else.
:{{A|vo xqlq002 7 agent 02.ogg}} '''Agent:''' That would be most ideal. I remind you again that the Fatui care only about the result.
:{{A|vo xqlq002 7 agent 03.ogg}} '''Agent:''' We are willing to lend a certain degree of support to this transaction. But if it is not completed in time...
:{{A|vo xqlq002 7 agent 04.ogg}} '''Agent:''' You may suddenly find our good will comes at a price you cannot afford.
:{{A|vo xqlq002 7 gentrymaocai 04.ogg}} '''Gentry Maocai:''' I understand... I am indebted to you for your protection. You know I would not dream of disappointing you, don't you?
:{{A|vo xqlq002 7 agent 05.ogg}} '''Agent:''' We shall see when the time comes.
:{{A|vo xqlq002 7 gentrymaocai 05.ogg}} '''Gentry Maocai:''' *sigh* Darn that old man Chang!

;(You hear the voices of Gentry Maocai and the Agent through the divider screen, and you can't help but grow infuriated by what they are saying...)

:{{A|vo xqlq002 7 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Who knows if Guhua Geek has made any progress. Should we go tell him?

:{{A|vo xqlq002 8 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' When actually all you meant was you wanted somewhere new to park your backside while you read your book!
:{{DIcon}} We know what Gentry Maocai's up to now.
:{{Black Screen|You and Paimon tell Xingqiu about Gentry Maocai's deal.}}
;(You share with Xingqiu what you have learned about Gentry Maocai...)
:{{A|vo xqlq002 8 xingqiu 01.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' I see. I guessed as much.
:{{A|vo xqlq002 8 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Did you really guess, or are you just saying that to sound clever?
:{{A|vo xqlq002 8 xingqiu 02.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' The course of action we must take is now clear. To start with, please deliver this letter to the [[Feiyun Commerce Guild]]. They will know what to do.
:{{A|vo xqlq002 8 xingqiu 03.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' My liege, for reasons that I cannot explain, I will be unable to join you.
:{{A|vo xqlq002 8 xingqiu 04.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' There is no need for you to read the contents of the letter, when the time comes—
:{{A|vo xqlq002 8 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Whew, this writing is super hard to read! Paimon can't make heads or tails of it...
:{{DIcon}} It's in an ancient script, perhaps?
:{{DIcon}} A secret text that needs a cipher, perhaps?
:{{A|vo xqlq002 8 xingqiu 05.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' Ugh...
:{{A|vo xqlq002 8 xingqiu 06.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' Hence why I said there's no need for you to read it...
:{{A|vo xqlq002 8 xingqiu 07.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' The Feiyun Commerce Guild will have someone who can understand it.
:{{A|vo xqlq002 8 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' But why do you wanna get them involved? They're one of the bigwig commerce guilds in Liyue — why would they wanna help us?
:{{DIcon}} What is the Feiyun Commerce Guild?
:{{A|vo xqlq002 8 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Since we got to Liyue, Paimon keeps hearing people mention it. Seems they oversee a lot of business that goes on around here.
:{{A|vo xqlq002 8 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Having such big backing would be great and all... But are you sure they'd wanna help?
:{{A|vo xqlq002 8 xingqiu 08.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' No need to worry about that. From what I know, they share my sense of chivalry.
:{{A|vo xqlq002 8 xingqiu 09.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' Once they have read the carefully reasoned and passionately argued case I put forth in this letter, they will certainly be moved to action.
:{{DIcon}} How can you be sure?
:{{DIcon}} Why get them involved anyway?
:{{A|vo xqlq002 8 xingqiu 10.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' Gentry Maocai must be taught a lesson he will never forget. This is something we cannot do on our own.
:{{A|vo xqlq002 8 xingqiu 11.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' Also, I do not wish for anyone else to know of my involvement in this.
:{{A|vo xqlq002 8 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Why not? You're only doing this to try and help Chang the Ninth, right?
:{{A|vo xqlq002 8 xingqiu 12.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' "To silently disappear at the matter's conclusion, concealing one's name and contribution," this is the chivalrous thing to do. To savor the memory is ample reward.
:{{A|vo xqlq002 8 xingqiu 13.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' Each droplet of kindness I receive I am duty-bound to repay with a welling spring of gratitude. I seek neither praise nor reward.
:{{A|vo xqlq002 8 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' That sounds very lovely. But be honest — you just want them to do it so you can carry on reading your book, don't you?
:{{A|vo xqlq002 8 xingqiu 14.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' Thank you in advance for delivering this letter to the Feiyun Commerce Guild. Someone from the guild should be able to receive you near the [[Liuli Pavilion]].
:{{A|vo xqlq002 8 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hey! Stop ignoring Paimon!
;(Quest ends)

:{{A|vo dialog xqlq002 xingqiu 02.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' So long as this letter makes it to the Feiyun Commerce Guild, they will be sure to take action.

==Gameplay Notes==
* After the first step, the description changes as follows:"'A crane brings 1 fresh flower in its beak to decorate my hair, while a white rabbit sews a hemline from 4 rays of moonlight. Dressed appropriately, I face eastward and call out Tsubaki's name 7 times. In the blink of an eye, I am standing on the path that leads to her house.'"
* There are Conspicuous Stone Walls to the north, east, and south of the area. Approaching any of them will trigger Paimon's dialogue and the "Investigate the shrubbery on the wall" step. If an incorrect wall is removed, the step will not change. Paimon's dialogue will not play more than once.

'''''Legendary "Color"''''' is the second act of {{Quest|Memories Flowing With Color}}.

==Start Location==
Start the quest by talking to [[Toltec]] near the entrance of the [[Sacrificial Altar of Enigmatic Land]] (i.e. the cave that leads to the [[Obsidian Totem Pole]] of the [["Masters of the Night-Wind"]]).
<gallery>
World Quest Legendary Color Start Location.png|Legendary "Color"'s start location
World Quest Legendary Color Start Location Context.png|Additional context
</gallery>

==Steps==
# Rendezvous with the guide
# Go into the fog's depths
# Try to break the barrier
# Try using the [[Iktomisaur]]'s special Elemental Sight
# Obtain dye (0/3)
# Meet up with Toltec
# Return to the Masters of the Night-Wind
# Enter the [["Chamber of Weaving"|Chamber of Weaving]]
# Accept [[Biram]]'s invitation

==Gameplay Notes==
* Step 3 is replaced with "''Go into the cave's depths''" if the player has completed [[Kuntur's Pursuit]] beforehand.

:{{A|vo xtlllq002 2 toltec 11.ogg}}<!--{{A|vo xtlllq002 2 toltec 19.ogg}}--> '''Toltec:''' I guess it's supposed to be a test left there by our ancestors. If you don't pass the test, you're not worthy of viewing their works of art.

:{{A|vo xtlllq002 2 toltec 12.ogg}}<!--{{A|vo xtlllq002 2 toltec 20.ogg}}--> '''Toltec:''' Don't worry about me though. I wouldn't be joining you this time, even if I was able to get in.
:{{A|vo xtlllq002 2 toltec 13.ogg}}<!--{{A|vo xtlllq002 2 toltec 21.ogg}}--> '''Toltec:''' Unlike our chief, I don't have the guts to challenge our traditions. This task is specifically appointed to someone by the [[Tlapo|Iktomisaur Elder]]. Who knows what bad things might happen if I got involved?
:{{A|vo xtlllq002 2 paimon 07.ogg}}<!--{{A|vo xtlllq002 2 paimon 10.ogg}}--> '''Paimon:''' Fair enough. Alright, we'll try not to take too long!

;(Talk to Toltec again, optional)
:{{A|vo dialog xtlllq002 toltec 01.ogg}} '''Toltec:''' You two head on in. I'll wait right here.

;(Hint shown if quest navigation is used)
::Try using the Iktomisaur's {{Color|tutorial|special Elemental Sight}} to eliminate obstacles.

;(Approach the barrier, if the barrier wasn't removed beforehand)
:{{A|vo xtlllq002 3 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Looks like there's no way past... Maybe try the same thing as before?

;(After dispelling the barrier, if the barrier wasn't removed beforehand)
:{{A|vo xtlllq002 3 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hey, it worked! Let's head in and take a look!

;(Enter the cavern)
:{{A|vo xtlllq002 4 paimon 01.ogg}}<!--{{A|vo xtlllq002 4 paimon 05.ogg}}--> '''Paimon:''' This should be the place! That fruit Toltec mentioned should be the one on the wall, right?
;(If the mural was completed beforehand)
::{{A|vo xtlllq002 4 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Paimon didn't notice it last time we were here.
:{{A|vo xtlllq002 4 paimon 03.ogg}}<!--{{A|vo xtlllq002 4 paimon 06.ogg}}--> '''Paimon:''' Now the only question is, which ones do we pick?
:{{DIcon}} This is probably where my special ability the chief mentioned comes in.
:{{A|vo xtlllq002 4 paimon 04.ogg}}<!--{{A|vo xtlllq002 4 paimon 07.ogg}}--> '''Paimon:''' Well, go ahead, try it out!

;(Hint shown if quest navigation is used)
::Try using the Iktomisaur's {{Color|tutorial|special Elemental Sight}} to search for the target object.

;(Look at the fruits on the ground using an Iktomisaur's elemental sight)
:{{A|vo xtlllq002 4 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You saw something, right? Whatever it was, grab it!

;(Interact with the three glowing fruits)
:;(Obtain {{Item|Dye Samples|x=3}})

;(After collecting the dye samples)
:;(If [[Kuntur's Pursuit]] was not completed)
:::{{A|vo xtlllq002 5 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' These guys' ancestors made some real works of art here. But based on what we've seen so far, it seems like there should be more to the story.
:::{{A|vo xtlllq002 5 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Do you think maybe there's more artwork further inside? Seems kinda strange...
:::{{DIcon}} We can go take look if you want?
::::{{A|vo xtlllq002 5 paimon 03a 1.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, no need — Paimon was just thinking aloud. Toltec's waiting for us, and we have a job to do, so maybe it's best if we head out now?
:::{{DIcon}} Maybe — but we have a job to do. We should focus on that.
::::{{A|vo xtlllq002 5 paimon 03b 1.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yeah, you're right. There's always next time.
:::{{A|vo xtlllq002 5 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Let's head back and meet up with Toltec!
:;(If [[Kuntur's Pursuit]] was completed)
:::{{A|vo xtlllq002 5 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Remember the last time we came here? We found all of the artwork throughout the cave. These guys' ancestors created a real masterpiece!
:::{{A|vo xtlllq002 5 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' They probably used the same stuff for their paint as we're using for the dye, right? Maybe we'll create a masterpiece of our own!
:::{{DIcon}} Then we'd better get started.
:::{{A|vo xtlllq002 5 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yup, let's head back and meet up with Toltec!

;(Talk to Toltec)
:{{A|vo xtlllq002 6 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' We're back! And we found the ingredients for the dye.
:{{A|vo xtlllq002 6 toltec 01.ogg}} '''Toltec:''' Sounds like you made it through the seal then! Our Iktomisaur Elder was right about you.
:{{A|vo xtlllq002 6 toltec 02.ogg}} '''Toltec:''' It's getting late. Follow me, I'll take us back.
----
;(Talk to Biram)
:{{A|vo xtlllq002 7 biram 01.ogg}} '''Biram:''' Toltec has updated me on your progress. Well done, I appreciate your efforts.
:{{A|vo xtlllq002 7 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Sure thing! Here's the stuff for the dye.
:;(Submit {{Item|Dye Samples|x=3}})
:{{A|vo xtlllq002 7 biram 02.ogg}} '''Biram:''' I see... yes, this is certainly a very different substance from typical dyes... Okay, now let's try our hand at making some samples. The fabric is ready for testing.
:{{A|vo xtlllq002 7 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Got it!
:{{A|vo xtlllq002 7 biram 03.ogg}} '''Biram:''' Please, follow me.<ref group="Note">Actual voice-over: "Please come with me."</ref>

;(Enter the [["Chamber of Weaving"]])
:{{A|vo xtlllq002 8 biram 01.ogg}} '''Biram:''' Take a look at this — it's a woven scroll made by one of our ancestors. This is the kind of thing we're trying to make.
:{{A|vo xtlllq002 8 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh...<ref group="Note">Actual voice-over: "Ooh!"</ref>
:{{A|vo xtlllq002 8 biram 02.ogg}} '''Biram:''' The person depicted is the legendary shaman, Huitzilin. She lived two hundred years ago, and was once appointed by the Iktomisaur Elder like yourselves.
:{{A|vo xtlllq002 8 biram 03.ogg}} '''Biram:''' She was especially skilled in the art of color manipulation, and of course completed her task with flying colors.
:{{A|vo xtlllq002 8 biram 04.ogg}} '''Biram:''' This scroll is a record of her deeds, and was most likely the work of her own hand. The quality is simply breathtaking, even compared to other scrolls of this variety.
:{{A|vo xtlllq002 8 biram 05.ogg}} '''Biram:''' Sadly, since she passed away, all of our Iktomisaur Elder's subsequent appointees have had to rely on the "gift from the spirits" to complete their work.
:{{DIcon}} But now, you're about to revive an older tradition.
:{{A|vo xtlllq002 8 biram 06.ogg}} '''Biram:''' That's a good way of putting it. My only quibble with your phrasing would be, it's not just me, but "us."
:{{A|vo xtlllq002 8 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ooh! Now Paimon's getting excited.
:{{A|vo xtlllq002 8 biram 07.ogg}} '''Biram:''' Bring out the samples.
:{{Black Screen|An assistant presents the samples for test-dyeing.}}
:{{A|vo xtlllq002 8 biram 08.ogg}} '''Biram:''' Now, as I mentioned, the dyeing process is a little complicated, but I am confident you will manage. Just make sure to follow my instructions carefully.
:{{DIcon}} Will do. Let's get started.
:{{A|vo xtlllq002 8 biram 09.ogg}} '''Biram:''' The pattern has already been sketched out on the sample, so you just need to dye each block with the correct color. But you'll need to wait for the dye to fully soak in between each step to make sure the colors don't run.
:{{DIcon}} (Dye the fabric as instructed.)
:{{A|vo xtlllq002 8 biram 10.ogg}} '''Biram:''' Good.<ref group="Note">Actual voice-over: "Hahaha! Good!"</ref> The dye has taken to the fabric, and the pattern is crisp and clear. Next, apply all the remaining dye and we should see that elusive signature color emerge.
:{{A|vo xtlllq002 8 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Okay, final step!
:{{DIcon}} (Apply the remaining dye.)
:{{A|vo xtlllq002 8 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Um... Did it work? Paimon doesn't see it...
:{{A|vo xtlllq002 8 biram 11.ogg}} '''Biram:''' That color isn't showing up... The dyeing has failed.
:{{DIcon}} Did I mess up somehow?
:{{A|vo xtlllq002 8 biram 12.ogg}} '''Biram:''' No, your technique was flawless. You did everything exactly as instructed. It would have made no difference if I'd done it myself.
:{{A|vo xtlllq002 8 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Then what went wrong?
:{{A|vo xtlllq002 8 biram 13.ogg}} '''Biram:''' It could be the weaving technique, or maybe the dye has to be applied in a different way... Whatever the case, it looks like I have failed to get to the bottom of this mystery.
:{{A|vo xtlllq002 8 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Sorry... Paimon wishes we could do more to help.
:{{A|vo xtlllq002 8 biram 14.ogg}} '''Biram:''' I am the one who should be apologizing. I made you do so much work, and it was for nothing.
:{{A|vo xtlllq002 8 biram 15.ogg}} '''Biram:''' I will of course honor my commitment to compensate you for your trouble, but I do hope you won't give up on this task. I plan to keep investigating, and will be sure to keep you updated with any progress.
:{{A|vo xtlllq002 8 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Don't worry, we're not quitters!
:{{A|vo xtlllq002 8 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Paimon does have a question though... Um, this whole process of recording history on woven scrolls seems so complicated. Why don't you just write it down instead?
:{{A|vo xtlllq002 8 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You said yourself, you're all about change and reform. Well, this seems like a pretty good place to start, don't you think? Writing things down would be easier for everyone, and your records would be more detailed.
:{{A|vo xtlllq002 8 biram 16.ogg}} '''Biram:''' ...I think you've perhaps misunderstood my philosophy, but that's okay. I can answer your question, but there's somewhere I need to show you first.
:{{A|vo xtlllq002 8 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh... sure.

;(Approach Biram near the teleport waypoint on top of [["Masters of the Night-Wind"]])
:{{A|vo xtlllq002 9 biram 01.ogg}} '''Biram:''' Look at this view. What do you think?
:{{A|vo xtlllq002 9 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' It's gorgeous!
:{{A|vo xtlllq002 9 biram 02.ogg}} '''Biram:''' Now, try looking a little further.
:{{A|vo xtlllq002 9 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Whoa... That graffiti...
:{{A|vo xtlllq002 9 biram 03.ogg}} '''Biram:''' In all the years since the founding of our tribe, those colors have been with us every step of the way.
:{{A|vo xtlllq002 9 biram 04.ogg}} '''Biram:''' It is true that I seek to bring new life to this ancient tribe through change and reform. But I also understand there are certain foundational things that we cannot afford to throw away.
:{{A|vo xtlllq002 9 biram 05.ogg}} '''Biram:''' The foremost of these is the way we record our history.
:{{A|vo xtlllq002 9 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' That makes sense.
:{{A|vo xtlllq002 9 biram 06.ogg}} '''Biram:''' Since the very beginnings, our tribe has always sought to bring color to history, and I have a deep sense that this is one part of our heritage that we should not give up.
:{{A|vo xtlllq002 9 biram 07.ogg}} '''Biram:''' So whatever it takes, I must find a way for us to continue producing our traditional woven scrolls.
:{{A|vo xtlllq002 9 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You're completely right. Paimon's sorry for what she said earlier. It was out of line...
:{{A|vo xtlllq002 9 biram 08.ogg}} '''Biram:''' It's quite alright. I'm just grateful you're able to understand where I'm coming from.
:{{DIcon}} We're committed to helping you solve this.
:{{A|vo xtlllq002 9 biram 09.ogg}} '''Biram:''' Then let us hope that when we next meet, we succeed in reviving this tradition.
{{Dialogue End}}

==Dialogue==
{{Quest Description|Paimon has a sudden yearning for the quirky stories told by Cloud Retainer. Go to Mt. Aocang to see this adeptus, with whom you are quite familiar.}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Upon obtaining quest)
:{{A|vo lylq001 1 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' We've been to so many places lately! What do you say we take a day off from adventuring and just find somewhere nice to relax?
:{{A|vo lylq001 1 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Let Paimon think, where are some nice places we could go... Oh, why don't we pay Cloud Retainer a visit at Mt. Aocang?
:{{A|vo lylq001 1 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' It's been a while since we last saw that illuminated bird! She's always the one popping up out of nowhere and scaring us half to death, so let's surprise her this time!
:{{Color|menu|You and Paimon arrive at Mt. Aocang...}}

;(Approach the pond at Mt. Aocang)
:{{A|vo lylq001 2 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Here we are! Right outside her place.
:{{A|vo lylq001 2 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Do you still remember the first time we came here? We even brought offerings and everything.
:{{A|vo lylq001 2 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' And when we told her that Rex Lapis had been assassinated, she immediately threatened to "squash Liyue Harbor"! Paimon thought she'd be impossible to get along with, but now that we've spent some more time together, she's really not like that at all.
:{{A|vo lylq001 2 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' We probably don't need to bring any offerings now that we've gotten to know her pretty well, right? Still, Paimon's got some snacks around here somewhere, so if she really wants something, we can just use that!
:{{A|vo lylq001 2 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh? {{Traveler}}? Did something catch your eye?
:{{DIcon}} Wow, it's...
:{{DIcon}} Don't think we've ever seen her before...
:{{Color|menu|Paimon follows your gaze and there, in the middle of the lake, stands an unfamiliar woman.}}
:{{A|vo lylq001 2 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Whoa, what a pretty lady! Is she also here to visit Cloud Retainer?
:{{DIcon}} It seems like she could also be a powerful adeptus.
:{{A|vo lylq001 2 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yeah, you're right... All it takes is one look and you can tell she's someone special! As expected of that bird lady, really. She must have a whole bunch of adepti friends from all over the country!
:{{A|vo lylq001 2 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Okay, but... If we're both friends of Cloud Retainer, then we're basically friends by association, right? Want to go up to her and say hello?
:{{DIcon}} Who knew you were such a social butterfly, Paimon.
:{{DIcon}} I'll leave the introductions to you!
:{{A|vo lylq001 2 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Helping you make more connections is a part of Paimon's job as your reliable guide. Paimon's got this!
:{{A|vo lylq001 2 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' H—Hello!
:{{A|vo lylq001 2 xianyun 01.ogg}} '''???:''' ...
:{{A|vo lylq001 2 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Um... Paimon is Paimon, and this is {{Traveler}}.
:{{DIcon}} (Paimon...!)
:{{DIcon}} (Just say everything in a nice, even tone!)
:{{A|vo lylq001 2 paimon 12.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' A—Ahem... Paimon doesn't think we've met, but we're also friends of Cloud Retainer. May we have the pleasure of learning your name, Madame Adeptus?
:{{A|vo lylq001 2 xianyun 02.ogg}} '''???:''' You two...
:{{A|vo lylq001 2 xianyun 03.ogg}} '''???:''' What is this tomfoolery? Has this shift in form so clouded your eyes that you no longer recognize one anymore?
:{{A|vo lylq001 2 paimon 13.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wait, you're...
:{{DIcon}} ...Cloud Retainer?
:{{A|vo lylq001 2 paimon 14.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh!? You're the illuminated bird? But you look human! How did that happen?
:{{A|vo lylq001 2 xianyun 04.ogg}} '''Cloud Retainer:''' Donning human form is scarcely any test of one's abilities. As for your confusion, one merely had no reason to indulge such inclinations before.
:{{A|vo lylq001 2 paimon 15.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So uh... you're indulging now because...?
:{{A|vo lylq001 2 xianyun 05.ogg}} '''Cloud Retainer:''' Well... One has made plans to pay a visit to some disciples at Liyue Harbor. Taking on a human form for such a trip is simply a way to make matters less conspicuous.
:{{A|vo lylq001 2 paimon 16.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You, worrying about keeping a low profile? You're the one who likes to pop up out of nowhere all over the place. In fact, Paimon can think of several examples. Like last year, when you suddenly appeared on the top of a roof without any warning, or—<ref group="Note">Actual voice-over: "[...]can think of several examples. Like that time, when[...]"</ref>
:{{A|vo lylq001 2 xianyun 06.ogg}} '''Cloud Retainer:''' Ahem...
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (It feels like Cloud Retainer has her reasons, but doesn't want to discuss them too openly...)
:{{DIcon}} I almost forgot. Paimon brought you some gifts!
:{{A|vo lylq001 2 paimon 17.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hey! Didn't we agree to not bring that up unless she asked?
:{{A|vo lylq001 2 xianyun 07.ogg}} '''Cloud Retainer:''' Oh? So you have taken care to follow the proper rules of etiquette after all. Most commendable.
:{{Black Screen|Cloud Retainer tries, but fails, to look indifferent as Paimon begrudgingly takes out her snacks...}}
:{{A|vo lylq001 2 paimon 18.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Um... Well, this is all Paimon's got. You don't mind, right...?
:{{A|vo lylq001 2 xianyun 08.ogg}} '''Cloud Retainer:''' One has never found oneself lacking in basic comforts. On the contrary, it is the gesture that one values above all else. So long as you've shown proper respect and consideration, the quantity or quality of the gift is but a trivial matter.
:{{A|vo lylq001 2 paimon 19.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ahh... That kinda makes Paimon feel a little guilty for trying to keep them for herself. Anyway, where were we before you reminded Paimon about the gifts?
:{{DIcon}} Cloud Retainer said that she's going to visit some of her disciples.
:{{A|vo lylq001 2 paimon 20.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ah, right! So by disciples, you must mean Ganyu and Shenhe! It's also been a while since we last saw them. Maybe we can come too!
:{{A|vo lylq001 2 xianyun 09.ogg}} '''Cloud Retainer:''' One planned to extend the invitation even if you had not raised the matter yourself. Shenhe and Ganyu should be quite pleased to see you again.
:{{A|vo lylq001 2 xianyun 10.ogg}} '''Cloud Retainer:''' However... One would first inquire as to the reason behind your visit here. You have cause to seek one's company?
:{{DIcon}} No reason in particular.
:{{A|vo lylq001 2 paimon 21.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yeah, we just found ourselves missing you and wanted to see how you were doing! We were hoping you'd tell us one of your stories. Who knew we'd run into your human form while we were at it...
:{{A|vo lylq001 2 xianyun 11.ogg}} '''Cloud Retainer:''' Is that so...
:{{A|vo lylq001 2 xianyun 12.ogg}} '''Cloud Retainer:''' If there are no urgent matters at hand, then let us make haste for Liyue Harbor. Ganyu is likely still working at Yuehai Pavilion, so that shall be our first stop.
:{{A|vo lylq001 2 paimon 22.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Sounds great! Then let's all go to Liyue Harbor!

{{Quest Description|You didn't expect to see Cloud Retainer in a human form. She says that she wishes to visit her disciples in Liyue Harbor. Accompnay her on her trip.}}
;(After the cutscene)
:{{A|vo lylq001 3 xianyun 01.ogg}} '''Cloud Retainer:''' *sigh* Ganyu has been quite busy with work as of late. One can count on one talon the number of times she returns to Mt. Aocang each year.
:{{A|vo lylq001 3 xianyun 02.ogg}} '''Cloud Retainer:''' Shenhe has also secured employment recently. In her correspondence with me, she wrote that she shall have "no need to return for the foreseeable future."
:{{A|vo lylq001 3 xianyun 03.ogg}} '''Cloud Retainer:''' Hmph! Did they think one was so easily mollified? One shall investigate everything with one's own eyes, and decide for oneself if their living conditions are satisfactory!

;(Investigate the mechanism on the table, optional)
:'''Mechanism on the table:''' (An elegantly assembled mysterious mechanism. For some reason, it is hard to keep your eyes off of it.)
:'''Mechanism on the table:''' (It appears to be one of Cloud Retainer's new inventions, but it's hard to tell what it could be used for.)

;(Approach Yuehai Pavilion)
:{{A|vo lylq001 5 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' We're almost at Yuehai Pavilion! Hey, do you think Ganyu will be shocked to see Cloud Retainer like this?
:{{A|vo lylq001 5 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Guess we have no idea if Shenhe and Ganyu have ever seen her in this form before... Wait, where did she go?
:{{DIcon}} She's back there.
:{{DIcon}} She didn't come with us!
:{{A|vo lylq001 5 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Why are you just standing there, Cloud Retainer?
:{{A|vo lylq001 5 xianyun 01.ogg}} '''Cloud Retainer:''' Quietly, now. One shall stay here. You two can go and meet with her.
:{{A|vo lylq001 5 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh? But why? Isn't it better if we all go together?
:{{A|vo lylq001 5 xianyun 02.ogg}} '''Cloud Retainer:''' Hmph. If one were to proudly proclaim one's presence, Ganyu would surely profess herself otherwise unoccupied and drop everything to attend to one's visit. One fears that would only result in her staying up all night to make up for lost time.
:{{A|vo lylq001 5 xianyun 03.ogg}} '''Cloud Retainer:''' One does not wish to trouble her. Conversing vicariously via you two shall suffice. Do remember to inquire as to her recent well-being. Again! Do not mention one's presence here.
:{{A|vo lylq001 5 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Fair enough, makes sense. Alright, then we'll just pass on your regards and—
:;(Ganyu notices from afar)
:{{A|vo lylq001 5 ganyu 01.ogg}} '''Ganyu:''' Cloud Retainer?
:;(Cloud Retainer turns away)
:{{A|vo lylq001 5 xianyun 04.ogg}} '''Cloud Retainer:''' !!!
:{{A|vo lylq001 5 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, busted!
:{{A|vo lylq001 5 huixin 01.ogg}} '''Huixin:''' Is that lady someone you know, Ms. Ganyu?
:{{A|vo lylq001 5 ganyu 02.ogg}} '''Ganyu:''' She is indeed. I'm sorry, Huixin, but could we delay the upcoming meeting for a little bit? I believe my schedule today is quite full. Although, perhaps I could move some work to later in the evening...
:{{A|vo lylq001 5 huixin 02.ogg}} '''Huixin:''' Not to worry, Ms. Ganyu. I'll make the necessary arrangements right away.
:{{A|vo lylq001 5 ganyu 03.ogg}} '''Ganyu:''' Thank you, Huixin.
:;(Ganyu walks over)

:{{A|vo lylq001 5 xianyun 06.ogg}} '''Cloud Retainer:''' Ahem, that was... but a simple test. One did not expect you to be able to recognize one so easily, especially after so many years of only seeing one's other form.

:{{A|vo lylq001 5 xianyun 11.ogg}} '''Cloud Retainer:''' Ah, it still makes one nostalgic to see you as you are now, respected and independent. When you were young, you oft begged one to cuddle you to sleep when you suffered from nightmares—

:{{A|vo lylq001 5 ganyu 13.ogg}} '''Ganyu:''' An adeptus of years past would rise with the clouds and rest with the moon. They were enlightened and wise, free and unfettered. The writer referenced master's name to describe her carefree and spontaneous nature.
:{{A|vo lylq001 5 paimon 13.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Whoa, that sounds super cool! Paimon feels like only the most powerful of adepti could rise with the clouds and rest with the moon!

:{{DIcon}} (Paimon looked away in embarrassment...)

:{{A|vo lylq001 5 ganyu 15.ogg}} '''Ganyu:''' To be fair, Cloud Retainer rarely speaks of her past accomplishments. The tales of her past can only be found in ancient texts.
:{{A|vo lylq001 5 ganyu 16.ogg}} '''Ganyu:''' It is said that once, a long, long time ago, there was a severe drought in Liyue. Left with no choice, many people left their homes, while others spent day and night praying to the adepti.
:{{A|vo lylq001 5 ganyu 17.ogg}} '''Ganyu:''' Although I did not live through such tragedy, simply reading about it is enough to gain a visceral understanding of all the pain and desperation during that time.
:{{A|vo lylq001 5 ganyu 18.ogg}} '''Ganyu:''' On top of the drought, a noxious gas also began to spread through the land. If not for Cloud Retainer's efforts, much of Liyue would be nothing more than a barren wasteland today.
:{{A|vo lylq001 5 ganyu 19.ogg}} '''Ganyu:''' The books had this to say about what happened:
:{{A|vo lylq001 5 ganyu 20.ogg}} '''Ganyu:''' Upon arrival, the adeptus borrowed the wind to retain the clouds. Immediately, the clouds gathered together, and abundant rain burst forth from the heavens. Drought and plague were both driven away, and the people were saved.
:{{A|vo lylq001 5 paimon 16.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Woah! That's incredible!
:{{A|vo lylq001 5 xianyun 16.ogg}} '''Xianyun:''' Mortal records add embellishments to dramatize past events. One did merely what one ought. And even if one had not interceded, the other adepti would surely have stepped in to help.
:{{A|vo lylq001 5 paimon 17.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Even so... you stopped an entire drought! Can you really control the weather like the book said?
:{{A|vo lylq001 5 paimon 18.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Paimon suddenly has a lot more respect for you! Eh, so it was Paimon's bad for calling you "illuminated bird" before. You're not too mad, are you?
:{{A|vo lylq001 5 xianyun 17.ogg}} '''Xianyun:''' How laughable. A name is but a simple label we carry with us on our journey through the world. Why would one be offended by such a trivial matter?
:{{A|vo lylq001 5 paimon 19.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Whew... That's a relief... In that case, Paimon will continue to call you whatever feels right in the moment, hehe.
:{{A|vo lylq001 5 xianyun 18.ogg}} '''Xianyun:''' Well, that is quite enough ancient history for now. Ganyu, have you had word from Shenhe?
:{{A|vo lylq001 5 xianyun 19.ogg}} '''Xianyun:''' One has heard that she procured a job recently. Have you any thoughts on her workplace? And what, pray tell, of her monthly remuneration?
:{{A|vo lylq001 5 xianyun 20.ogg}} '''Xianyun:''' Moreover, does she find herself overly inundated with work? Is she allowed time off during Lantern Rite?
:{{A|vo lylq001 5 paimon 20.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' That is a lot of questions!
:{{A|vo lylq001 5 ganyu 21.ogg}} '''Ganyu:''' There is no cause for concern, Cloud Retainer. I introduced Shenhe to her employer personally.
:{{A|vo lylq001 5 ganyu 22.ogg}} '''Ganyu:''' Wanmin Restaurant's business has been booming recently, so with Chef Mao being swamped with customers, and Xiangling still often out in search of new recipes, I introduced Shenhe to staff the restaurant.
:{{A|vo lylq001 5 xianyun 21.ogg}} '''Xianyun:''' I see. Most excellent indeed. One has had the pleasure of being introduced to that family. Xiangling is kind and astute, while her father is loyal and reliable. One has no cause to believe that they will make Shenhe's work difficult.
:{{A|vo lylq001 5 xianyun 22.ogg}} '''Xianyun:''' ...Now, it is almost time to partake in the victuals of noon. One shall visit Wanmin Restaurant in person, and see how Shenhe is doing.
:{{A|vo lylq001 5 ganyu 23.ogg}} '''Ganyu:''' Huh? But didn't you just say that you had something important to do...?
:{{A|vo lylq001 5 paimon 21.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Can that wait until after we've eaten?
:{{A|vo lylq001 5 xianyun 23.ogg}} '''Xianyun:''' You may return to your work, Ganyu. One shall see to this matter on one's own. There will be many an occasion to dine together in the future. One is certain the opportunity shall present itself most readily.
:{{A|vo lylq001 5 ganyu 24.ogg}} '''Ganyu:''' Of course, Cloud Retainer. Please take care. {{Traveler}}, Paimon — I'll see you some other time.

:{{A|vo lylq001 9 shenhe 06.ogg}} '''Shenhe:''' By the way... Master, since you are in Liyue Harbor, have you had the chance to visit Ganyu?

:{{A|vo lylq001 9 shenhe 09.ogg}} '''Shenhe:''' Master once participated in a race against [[Moon Carver]]. After Moon Carver lost, he insisted that Master's ability to fly gave her a natural edge in such a contest.
:{{A|vo lylq001 9 shenhe 10.ogg}} '''Shenhe:''' In response, Master agreed to forgo flying in return for being able to use one of her devices in the race. Moon Carver accepted, only to find Master with a brand-new device on the day of the contest.

:{{A|vo lylq001 9 shenhe 11.ogg}} '''Shenhe:''' It was a mechanical vehicle made out of iron. What was it called again... An "Electro-Powered Bicycle"?
:{{A|vo lylq001 9 xianyun 10.ogg}} '''Xianyun:''' You refer to the "Bi-Cyclical Thunderflash-Mobile." One spent forty-nine days conceptualizing and crafting it. It need only be infused with adeptal energy, and it can cover thousands of miles in one day.
:{{A|vo lylq001 9 xianyun 11.ogg}} '''Xianyun:''' It boggles the mind why Moon Carver ever supposed he might best me in a contest of locomotion. Though he sprinted with all his might, he could barely keep up.
:{{A|vo lylq001 9 xianyun 12.ogg}} '''Xianyun:''' Alas, the one flaw of my mechanism lay in its weakness against mountainous terrain. :{{A|vo lylq001 9 xianyun 13.ogg}} '''Xianyun:''' Is that so? *sigh* With you gone, one has seldom felt the desire to call upon those old fossils for another contest. What is a race without spectators, after all.

:{{A|vo lylq001 9 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' ...

:{{A|vo lylq001 10 xianyun 04.ogg}} '''Xianyun:''' Tis a fated meeting then. Please, take a seat.
:{{A|vo lylq001 10 shuyu 08.ogg}} '''Shuyu:''' What would you like to eat, Granny? I can order for you.
:{{A|vo lylq001 10 yuandai 04.ogg}} '''Yuandai:''' I want... braised earthworms. They always pop up out of the ground after a rainstorm...
:{{A|vo lylq001 10 shuyu 09.ogg}} '''Shuyu:''' No, no, not this again! Granny, there's no braised earthworms on the menu.
:{{A|vo lylq001 10 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Braised earthworms? Well, that sounds weird... Do people actually eat that?
:{{DIcon}} Can't hurt to ask...?
:{{A|vo lylq001 10 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Right, that's what Paimon was thinking, too!
:{{A|vo lylq001 10 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Uh... Need any help?
:{{A|vo lylq001 10 shuyu 10.ogg}} '''Shuyu:''' Help? ... Oh, do you mean with Granny?
:{{A|vo lylq001 10 shuyu 11.ogg}} '''Shuyu:''' Thanks, it's nice of you to offer. Granny has pretty bad dementia, so her memory's getting worse all the time. She's always saying things that sound kinda confusing.
:{{A|vo lylq001 10 shuyu 12.ogg}} '''Shuyu:''' Actually, her memory's been bad ever since I was little. But it's gotten so bad lately that I even have to remind her who I am every morning.
:{{DIcon}} What about your parents?
:{{A|vo lylq001 10 shuyu 13.ogg}} '''Shuyu:''' They died young. It's just me and Granny now.
:{{A|vo lylq001 10 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, um...
:{{A|vo lylq001 10 shuyu 14.ogg}} '''Shuyu:''' Ah, but it's okay, don't feel bad. Granny loves me a lot, and I love her a lot too. Sure, it's hard at times, but you just gotta make the best of the life you've got.
:{{A|vo lylq001 10 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wow. You're really tough for your age, kid!
:{{A|vo lylq001 10 shuyu 15.ogg}} '''Shuyu:''' You're too kind.
:{{A|vo lylq001 10 yuandai 05.ogg}} '''Yuandai:''' And me? What about me?
:{{A|vo lylq001 10 shuyu 16.ogg}} '''Shuyu:''' You're tough too, Granny. Plus, you're really gentle and you're always there for me.
:{{A|vo lylq001 10 yuandai 06.ogg}} '''Yuandai:''' Yes, and it's hardly as if I forget everything! I still remember the important things. Uhh... Wait, what was that really important thing again?
:{{A|vo lylq001 10 yuandai 07.ogg}} '''Yuandai:''' Ah, I remember now. It was a dream. I had a dream, where everything was dark. Someone was standing in front of me... She told me to come and find her — and that once I'd found her, I would be free.
:{{A|vo lylq001 10 shuyu 17.ogg}} '''Shuyu:''' Huh? That sounds super important... but how come you've never told me about it before?
:{{A|vo lylq001 10 yuandai 08.ogg}} '''Yuandai:''' It was just a dream, so I forgot about it. But I'm in a good mood now, and somehow I remembered it again.
:{{A|vo lylq001 10 yuandai 09.ogg}} '''Yuandai:''' Ah... You know, I believe I've had this dream a great many times. But just how many times have I had it? Now that, I do not remember...
:{{A|vo lylq001 10 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wait, so you have a recurring dream where someone's talking to you? That sounds spooky! Does that mean... You're possessed?
:{{A|vo lylq001 10 xianyun 05.ogg}} '''Xianyun:''' Unlikely. Her eyes are clear, and her breathing remains calm and level. One sees no signs of possession.
:{{A|vo lylq001 10 paimon 12.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Are you sure?
:{{A|vo lylq001 10 xianyun 06.ogg}} '''Xianyun:''' Who do you take me for? Is one not an adept— Ahem, am I not an expert?
:{{A|vo lylq001 10 paimon 13.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ah, you're right, Paimon almost forgot, you're the expert... In that case... Do you still remember what the person in your dreams looked like, Granny?
:{{A|vo lylq001 10 yuandai 10.ogg}} '''Yuandai:''' Not anymore. Although, I have a sense that she looked rather like... me, but not as I am now. My younger self.
:{{A|vo lylq001 10 shuyu 18.ogg}} '''Shuyu:''' A younger version of Granny?
:{{A|vo lylq001 10 paimon 14.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' This is just getting weirder and weirder! What is going on here?
:{{A|vo lylq001 10 xianyun 07.ogg}} '''Xianyun:''' As one said, fate must have brought us together. You may leave this situation to me.
:{{A|vo lylq001 10 shuyu 19.ogg}} '''Shuyu:''' Are you sure? Umm... So, what are your names?
:{{A|vo lylq001 10 paimon 15.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Paimon's Paimon!
:{{DIcon}} I'm {{Traveler}}.
:{{A|vo lylq001 10 xianyun 08.ogg}} '''Xianyun:''' Just Xianyun is fine.
:{{A|vo lylq001 10 shuyu 20.ogg}} '''Shuyu:''' Thank you all so much for offering to help! But first... I'm sorry for asking, but, um... How do you want us to pay you back?
:{{A|vo lylq001 10 paimon 16.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, we don't need any payment for this.
:{{DIcon}} We're just curious about your situation, and want to help if we can.
:{{A|vo lylq001 10 shuyu 21.ogg}} '''Shuyu:''' Th—Thank you so much!
:{{A|vo lylq001 10 paimon 17.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You're welcome! But Ms. Xianyun, what exactly can we do to help out this Granny?
:{{A|vo lylq001 10 paimon 18.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' All we have to go off of is that dream. Where do we start?
:{{A|vo lylq001 10 xianyun 09.ogg}} '''Xianyun:''' That is elementary. Since her dreams portray her younger self, then we shall retrace the steps of her youth. Once we have revisited those places, her memories will likely return.
:{{A|vo lylq001 10 paimon 19.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hmm, sounds like a plan. So Granny, do you remember which places you went to when you were young?
:{{A|vo lylq001 10 yuandai 11.ogg}} '''Yuandai:''' Why, of course I do! The heavens above, the earth below, the wispy clouds, and the emerald mountain streams...
:{{A|vo lylq001 10 paimon 20.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Okay... Taking that as a no.
:{{A|vo lylq001 10 shuyu 22.ogg}} '''Shuyu:''' I... might have an idea.
:{{A|vo lylq001 10 shuyu 23.ogg}} '''Shuyu:''' Once, when I was really little, my dad told me that Granny used to be a martial artist heroine who saved loads of people from a disaster.
:{{A|vo lylq001 10 shuyu 24.ogg}} '''Shuyu:''' If it's true, then maybe they wrote about it in the history books, or something...
:{{A|vo lylq001 10 paimon 21.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' A martial arts heroine? Hmm... Oh! Xingqiu knows tons about Liyue's chivalric traditions. If anyone knows about the heroes of the past, it's him. Let's go find him at the Feiyun Commerce Guild!
:{{A|vo lylq001 10 yuandai 12.ogg}} '''Yuandai:''' Are you leaving already? But I'm still hungry...
:{{A|vo lylq001 10 shuyu 25.ogg}} '''Shuyu:''' I'll go order some food, Granny. If there's nothing on the menu that you especially want, I'll just get a few different things.
:{{A|vo lylq001 10 xianyun 10.ogg}} '''Xianyun:''' It seems we must part ways for now. {{Traveler}} and Paimon are bound for the Feiyun Commerce Guild, while Yuandai and Shuyu shall remain here and partake of their lunch. As for myself... I have matters to discuss with Streetward Rambler.
:{{A|vo lylq001 10 paimon 22.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Streetward Rambler... Oh! You mean Madame Ping?
:{{A|vo lylq001 10 xianyun 11.ogg}} '''Xianyun:''' Precisely. Let us meet at Yujing Terrace once you are ready.

;(At the other tables, idle quotes)
:{{A|vo lylq001 14 baotai 01.ogg}} '''Baotai:''' I've always wanted to try this place...
:{{A|vo lylq001 15 dixin 01.ogg}} '''Dixin:''' For this price, the food is unbelievable!
:{{A|vo lylq001 16 juan 01.ogg}} '''Wenliu:''' Everyone, please eat to your hearts' content! Today is my treat.

;(Talk to Shuyu or Yuandai, optional)
:;(Yuandai gets up from the table)
:{{A|vo dialog lylq001 shuyu 01.ogg}} '''Shuyu:''' Where are you going, Granny? Don't you like the food?
:{{A|vo dialog lylq001 yuandai 01.ogg}} '''Yuandai:''' Fresh milk... I need to buy you some fresh milk.
:{{A|vo dialog lylq001 shuyu 02.ogg}} '''Shuyu:''' Milk? Why?
:{{A|vo dialog lylq001 yuandai 02.ogg}} '''Yuandai:''' You need to drink milk before eating, or the spicy food will make you cry. Hush, little one, don't cry...
:{{A|vo dialog lylq001 shuyu 03.ogg}} '''Shuyu:''' Granny, you're forgetting things again! I'm not a little baby anymore — I can eat spicy food now. Even the super spicy dishes like their fish stew. I can eat two whole bowls, no problem...
:{{A|vo dialog lylq001 yuandai 03.ogg}} '''Yuandai:''' Wonderful, how wonderful... my darling granddaughter is all grown up...

;(Talk to Shenhe, optional)
:{{A|vo dialog lylq001 shenhe 01.ogg}} '''Shenhe:''' Ah...
:{{A|vo dialog lylq001 shenhe 02.ogg}} '''Shenhe:''' I should get paid in another few days. Shall we take the opportunity to go out and have some fun?

;(Talk to Chef Mao, optional)
:{{A|vo dialog lylq001 chefmao 03.ogg}} '''Chef Mao:''' This is one of our busiest periods in the year... Things should calm down a little in another few days.
:{{A|vo dialog lylq001 chefmao 04.ogg}} '''Chef Mao:''' I sure am glad to have Shenhe now. There's no way I'd have been able to cope this year all by myself.

:{{A|vo ablq002 2 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Really? Hmm... Paimon thought there were some pretty cool stories in the gliding manual.

:{{A|vo ablq002 2 ambor 08.ogg}} '''Amber:''' Lemme take a look... Shoot, this is the storybook I used to read as a kid!
:{{A|vo ablq002 2 ambor 09.ogg}} '''Amber:''' Oops, sorry! I put both books in the same pile and must have grabbed the wrong one when I was leaving.
:{{A|vo ablq002 2 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' How in the heck do you confuse a bedtime story with an instruction manual?
