;(Meet Hiiragi Chisato)
:{{A|vo lrlq001 24 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hi! Nice to see you again, Chisato!
:{{A|vo lrlq001 24 hiiragichisato 01.ogg}} '''Hiiragi Chisato:''' I heard that Sir Kamisato had brought some guests, but I didn't know it was you two.
:{{A|vo lrlq001 24 ayato 01.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' It's been a while, Lady Hiiragi. How have you been faring?
:{{A|vo lrlq001 24 hiiragichisato 02.ogg}} '''Hiiragi Chisato:''' This is a rare privilege, Sir Kamisato. It is not often that I have the chance to meet you, let alone here in the comfort of my own home. I'm doing very well indeed, thank you.
:{{A|vo lrlq001 24 hiiragichisato 03.ogg}} '''Hiiragi Chisato:''' You must be so busy. Thank you so much for taking the time to come and congratulate Kamaji and I, it really means a lot.
:{{A|vo lrlq001 24 ayato 02.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' But of course. The Tri-Commission are the servants of the Shogun, and we should look out for one another. In fact, we visited Sir Kujou just now. It's clear that he's very much looking forward to the wedding.
:{{A|vo lrlq001 24 ayato 03.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' Perhaps his joy is infectious, for I am now feeling rather elated myself. I sincerely wish you a joyful wedding and a blissful marriage.
:{{A|vo lrlq001 24 hiiragichisato 04.ogg}} '''Hiiragi Chisato:''' Thank you for your kind words.
:{{A|vo lrlq001 24 hiiragichisato 05.ogg}} '''Hiiragi Chisato:''' This was not an easy decision to make. We will both have to work harder from now on.
:{{A|vo lrlq001 24 hiiragichisato 06.ogg}} '''Hiiragi Chisato:''' I'm sure the news will cause something of a stir. But come what may, we will stand as one and face whatever the future throws at us together.
:{{A|vo lrlq001 24 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Sounds like things are pretty tough for you, Chisato.
:{{A|vo lrlq001 24 hiiragichisato 07.ogg}} '''Hiiragi Chisato:''' Yes... To be honest, I'm still a little nervous about it all...
:{{A|vo lrlq001 24 hiiragichisato 08.ogg}} '''Hiiragi Chisato:''' But Kamaji has been so supportive. His promises have comforted me a lot.
:{{A|vo lrlq001 24 ayato 04.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' It sounds like you have some considerable reservations, Lady Hiiragi.
:{{A|vo lrlq001 24 hiiragichisato 09.ogg}} '''Hiiragi Chisato:''' ...Yes, well... There are so many things I need to consider.
:{{A|vo lrlq001 24 hiiragichisato 10.ogg}} '''Hiiragi Chisato:''' In case you were wondering, I was not actually entertaining VIPs just now. I was in fact meeting with one of the Kanjou Commission's officers, Shinnojou.
:{{A|vo lrlq001 24 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh... really? Him?
:{{A|vo lrlq001 24 hiiragichisato 11.ogg}} '''Hiiragi Chisato:''' Mm-hmm. He charged in all of a sudden and said that he had something very important to tell me.
:{{A|vo lrlq001 24 hiiragichisato 12.ogg}} '''Hiiragi Chisato:''' He didn't mince his words. Basically... he doesn't want me to marry Kamaji.
:{{DIcon}} ...He finally went there.
:{{A|vo lrlq001 24 hiiragichisato 13.ogg}} '''Hiiragi Chisato:''' He has always been a calm and contained person who never acts out of line. I was quite shocked to see him so agitated.
:{{A|vo lrlq001 24 hiiragichisato 14.ogg}} '''Hiiragi Chisato:''' But despite all that, what he was saying made a lot of sense. He thinks that now is a bad time for this wedding to happen.
:{{A|vo lrlq001 24 hiiragichisato 15.ogg}} '''Hiiragi Chisato:''' He pointed out that I am like the final pillar propping up my clan. If I marry into the Kujou Clan, that pillar is taken away. There will no longer be a voice of authority in the Hiiragi Clan, and it could be a disastrous move for my personal image, too...
:{{A|vo lrlq001 24 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' It's just two families becoming one big family though, right? What's the big deal?
:{{A|vo lrlq001 24 ayato 05.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' Traditionally, in Inazuma, clan affiliation influences every facet of life.
:{{A|vo lrlq001 24 ayato 06.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' After the wedding, Lady Hiiragi will belong to the Kujou Clan. The Kanjou Commission's attitude toward you may undergo some significant changes thereafter.
:{{A|vo lrlq001 24 hiiragichisato 16.ogg}} '''Hiiragi Chisato:''' Precisely. This is a terrible thing to be saying, but... I'm starting to have second thoughts. Maybe I went along with it all too easily. Maybe I allowed myself to be pushed into this...
:{{A|vo lrlq001 24 hiiragichisato 17.ogg}} '''Hiiragi Chisato:''' Ah! I'm so sorry, I can't believe I'm making my guests listen to me complaining...
:{{A|vo lrlq001 24 ayato 07.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' No problem at all. The Yashiro Commission has a duty to listen to you. Now that I've heard your concerns, I should offer to help you as best I can, for instance, by helping you gather your thoughts on the matter.
:{{A|vo lrlq001 24 ayato 08.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' Now. We heard from Sir Kujou that his decision to tie the knot was prompted by a letter he received from you.
:{{A|vo lrlq001 24 ayato 09.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' But we've also heard that you did not write that letter. Sir Kujou thought that perhaps you were just being coy... Oh dear, perhaps I should have kept that part to myself?
:{{A|vo lrlq001 24 hiiragichisato 18.ogg}} '''Hiiragi Chisato:''' ...What? But that was... It was just a prop in his playful proposal, wasn't it? It was clearly purpose-designed, what with all the fancy lettering, and so on...
:{{A|vo lrlq001 24 ayato 10.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' ...Fancy lettering, you say?
:{{A|vo lrlq001 24 ayato 11.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' So I am to understand that had it not been for this letter, you two may not have chosen this moment to be wed?
:{{A|vo lrlq001 24 hiiragichisato 19.ogg}} '''Hiiragi Chisato:''' When it comes down to it... Yes, I think so... Oh, do you mean to say that this letter is not what I thought it to be?
:{{A|vo lrlq001 24 ayato 12.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' Sir Kujou maintains that the letter was penned by your hand.
:{{A|vo lrlq001 24 hiiragichisato 20.ogg}} '''Hiiragi Chisato:''' Huh? But then... how did...
:{{A|vo lrlq001 24 ayato 13.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' Either way, it's wonderful to see how much you both trust one another. In that sense, you could say that the origin of the letter is ultimately not of great importance.
:{{A|vo lrlq001 24 ayato 14.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' Who knows, perhaps Sir Kujou was the one being coy. After all, he had no particular reason to be forthcoming with us about the details of his playful proposal.
:{{A|vo lrlq001 24 hiiragichisato 21.ogg}} '''Hiiragi Chisato:''' ...
:{{A|vo lrlq001 24 hiiragichisato 22.ogg}} '''Hiiragi Chisato:''' I understand. As you say, ultimately, the origin of the letter doesn't matter.
:{{A|vo lrlq001 24 hiiragichisato 23.ogg}} '''Hiiragi Chisato:''' But my position does matter. Kamaji and I thought that we needn't worry about anything that lies ahead, because we can face it all together.
:{{A|vo lrlq001 24 hiiragichisato 24.ogg}} '''Hiiragi Chisato:''' But now, I... I think I should give it some more thought.
:{{A|vo lrlq001 24 ayato 15.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' Marriage is the most important decision of your life. Don't let yourself regret it.
:{{A|vo lrlq001 24 ayato 16.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' It is also part of the Yashiro Commission's job to help people through difficult times.
:{{A|vo lrlq001 24 ayato 17.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' I say this as an advocate for you personally and for the Hiiragi Clan. Please do not be compelled by circumstances to make any decision that goes against your will.
:{{A|vo lrlq001 24 ayato 18.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' To be together with the one you love is a sacred thing. It is my earnest wish that both of you may enjoy a bright and beautiful future, not a bittersweet one.
:{{A|vo lrlq001 24 hiiragichisato 25.ogg}} '''Hiiragi Chisato:''' I'll take to heart every word you have said to me... I can't thank you enough, Sir Kamisato. I'll think very carefully about your advice.
:{{A|vo lrlq001 24 ayato 19.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' All that matters is that you follow your heart. Since you'll be needing some time to think things over, we will excuse ourselves now.
:{{A|vo lrlq001 24 hiiragichisato 26.ogg}} '''Hiiragi Chisato:''' Ah, wait! Let me see you out...
:{{A|vo lrlq001 24 ayato 20.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' Thank you, Lady Hiiragi, but there will be no need.
:{{A|vo lrlq001 24 ayato 21.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' Traveler, let's find somewhere to talk.

;(Talk to Hiiragi Chisato again)
:{{A|vo dialog lrlq001 hiiragichisato 01.ogg}} '''Hiiragi Chisato:''' What should I do...
:{{A|vo dialog lrlq001 hiiragichisato 02.ogg}} '''Hiiragi Chisato:''' Oh, Kamaji...

----
;(Leave the Hiiragi Estate and go over what you know)
:{{A|vo lrlq001 26 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hiiragi Chisato is on a totally different page than Kujou Kamaji...
:{{A|vo lrlq001 26 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ayato, why did you give her such vague suggestions? Couldn't you just have told her what you'd do in her position? 'Cause Paimon's pretty sure you have an idea.
:{{A|vo lrlq001 26 ayato 01.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' I've said everything I can, given the Yashiro Commission's stance. Interfering too much with other Commissions' domestic issues will only create trouble.
:{{A|vo lrlq001 26 ayato 02.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' The more I think about it, the stranger this all seems, but Hiiragi Chisato has yet to see it. We must be vigilant.
:{{A|vo lrlq001 26 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Strange? In what way?
:{{A|vo lrlq001 26 ayato 03.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' Someone wants Hiiragi Chisato to be married as soon as possible, and if my guess is right... it is someone from within the Kanjou Commission. This person is presumably also responsible for the mysterious and misleading letter.
:{{A|vo lrlq001 26 ayato 04.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' Think about this: A lowly officer is greatly worried about Hiiragi Chisato's future, while the heads of the supporting clans ostensibly have no concerns at all. It doesn't add up.
:{{A|vo lrlq001 26 ayato 05.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' When someone's words and actions do not match, you need to infer their intentions from their behavior.
:{{DIcon}} So... is someone trying to get Hiiragi Chisato into trouble?
:{{DIcon}} So... is someone coveting Hiiragi Chisato's position?
:{{A|vo lrlq001 26 ayato 06.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' Yes. It's a smart strategy. Far superior to the one adopted by the Tenryou Commission's Takatsukasa Clan.
:{{A|vo lrlq001 26 ayato 07.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' Even had the forged letter failed and been seen for what it was, there would have been no repercussions. They could simply have explained it away as a misguided but well-meaning matchmaking attempt by a member of the family.
:{{A|vo lrlq001 26 ayato 08.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' But if the letter were to achieve its goal, as it has so far... the perpetrator would successfully weaken the Hiiragi Clan without ever having to lift a finger against them, all under the guise of simply encouraging a wedding.
:{{A|vo lrlq001 26 ayato 09.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' With Hiiragi Chisato having married into the Kujou Clan and the head of the Hiiragi Clan in prison, challenges to the Hiiragi Clan's leadership would begin to emerge throughout the ranks of the Kanjou Commission... Eventually, another clan would take the Hiiragi Clan's place.
:{{DIcon}} A reasonable theory. But it's just a theory.
:{{DIcon}} Unfortunately, there's no evidence.
:{{A|vo lrlq001 26 ayato 10.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' Actually, we have evidence. His name is Shinnojou.
:{{A|vo lrlq001 26 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Shinnojou?
:{{A|vo lrlq001 26 ayato 11.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' He should be back by now.
:{{A|vo lrlq001 26 hisashi 01.ogg}} '''Hisashi:''' Yes, Sir.
:{{A|vo lrlq001 26 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Aah! That's the second time you've done that! Paimon cannot deal with this...
:{{A|vo lrlq001 26 ayato 12.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' Did they take one of the Kanjou Commission officers away?
:{{A|vo lrlq001 26 hisashi 02.ogg}} '''Hisashi:''' Yes. His name is Shinnojou.
:{{A|vo lrlq001 26 ayato 13.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' As I expected.
:{{A|vo lrlq001 26 ayato 14.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' They cannot afford to let this opportunity pass them by. They have to act now, while the Hiiragi Clan is at its weakest.
:{{A|vo lrlq001 26 ayato 15.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' Hiiragi Chisato had been persuaded by Kujou Kamaji, and the wedding was sure to go ahead.
:{{A|vo lrlq001 26 ayato 16.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' But after Chisato's meeting with Shinnojou, she began to have second thoughts. In their eyes, Officer Shinnojou has interfered with their plan.
:{{A|vo lrlq001 26 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' But why did they suspect him, and not us?
:{{A|vo lrlq001 26 ayato 17.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' Someone was eavesdropping on our conversation with Chisato the entire time. That's why I was a little reserved.
:{{A|vo lrlq001 26 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' *gasp* No way! Whew... lucky Paimon didn't say anything stupid.
:{{A|vo lrlq001 26 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ah! But Chisato got what you meant about the letter though, right?
:{{A|vo lrlq001 26 ayato 18.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' I think so. But whoever is behind this will not allow their plan to fail now. They will not be inclined to respect Hiiragi Chisato's own wishes.
:{{A|vo lrlq001 26 ayato 19.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' Her stance was so passive that she was easily manipulated... Treated like a pawn, with even her marriage becoming a battleground for political power play.
:{{A|vo lrlq001 26 ayato 20.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' Despite all of this, she still believed that a happy future was awaiting her...
:{{A|vo lrlq001 26 ayato 21.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' When she formally marries into the Kujou Clan, she will lose her title as daughter of the Hiiragi Clan, her position in the Kanjou Commission... and above all, her independence.
:{{A|vo lrlq001 26 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Whew, marriage is such a trap...
:{{DIcon}} We've got to stop her.
:{{DIcon}} We can't let this evil plan come to fruition.
:{{A|vo lrlq001 26 ayato 22.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' Easier said than done... The perpetrators are manipulating everything from the shadows, letting unsuspecting pawns do their work. This is what makes their approach so smart.
:{{A|vo lrlq001 26 ayato 23.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' We, meanwhile, are out in the open. If we attempt to stop this wedding from happening, we will become the villains of the story and face immense public backlash.
:{{A|vo lrlq001 26 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Um... so what're we gonna do?
:{{A|vo lrlq001 26 ayato 24.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' At this stage, if the perpetrators wish to maintain control over the situation, their only option is to come out from the shadows and bare their fangs. I will wait for that moment to arrive.
:{{A|vo lrlq001 26 ayato 25.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' But first things first, we must go and rescue Shinnojou. He has done nothing wrong, and does not deserve to be punished.
:{{A|vo lrlq001 26 ayato 26.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' Tell me where Shinnojou is. We'll head off right now.
{{Dialogue End}}

==Dialogue==
{{Quest Description|The festival is not yet over, and Lan Yan has finally found some time to take the two of you around...}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Pass time)
:{{A|vo zyjeq005 1 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' It's already been two whole days! Paimon wonders if Lan Yan's still busy... Let's go check on her!

;(Approach Lan Yan)
:{{A|vo zyjeq005 1 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Whoa! Look, Lan Yan's surrounded by her elders!
:{{A|vo zyjeq005 1 ningguang 01.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' I received a battle report just yesterday. The evil spirits causing turmoil across Liyue were suddenly suppressed by an unseen force. Because of this, purging them proved far simpler than before.
:{{A|vo zyjeq005 1 ningguang 02.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' With this support, the Millelith dispatched throughout Liyue completed their missions ahead of schedule, giving them time to return home and enjoy the festival.
:{{A|vo zyjeq005 1 ningguang 03.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' Upon asking around, I learned that this was all thanks to an art cast by Lan Yan. And so, I came to offer my thanks in person.
:{{A|vo zyjeq005 1 ningguang 04.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' Your clan truly does honor to its reputation as a house of thaumaturges. Brilliant minds emerge here in every generation.
:{{A|vo zyjeq005 1 lanyu 01.ogg}} '''Lan Yu:''' You flatter us, Lady Ningguang. This was simply our clan's duty.
:{{A|vo zyjeq005 1 auntlan 01.ogg}} '''Aunt Lan:''' Speaking of which, this child used to do nothing but play. Has she finally decided to take things seriously?
:{{A|vo zyjeq005 1 unclelan 01.ogg}} '''Uncle Lan:''' Perhaps it's about time she learned the true techniques from our elders.
:{{A|vo zyjeq005 1 lanyan 01.ogg}} '''Lan Yan:''' Actually, if it weren't for Director Hu and Chongyun...
:{{A|vo zyjeq005 1 ningguang 05.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' I am well aware. I have already conveyed my thanks to them. In fact, they insisted this art could never have succeeded without your ingenuity.
:{{A|vo zyjeq005 1 ningguang 06.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' You are more than worthy of this praise.
:{{A|vo zyjeq005 1 lanyan 02.ogg}} '''Lan Yan:''' This praise is going to drag me straight to the training grounds...
:{{A|vo zyjeq005 1 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Um... sorry to interrupt! We're Lan Yan's friends, and we needed to talk to her about something. Is now a good time?
:{{A|vo zyjeq005 1 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Well... it's pretty important, actually!
:{{A|vo zyjeq005 1 lanyu 02.ogg}} '''Lan Yu:''' If it is an important matter... Lady Ningguang, may Lan Yan be excused for a moment?
:{{A|vo zyjeq005 1 auntlan 02.ogg}} '''Aunt Lan:''' That would hardly be proper... Lady Ningguang made a special trip to visit us. How could she just walk away in the middle of it?
:{{A|vo zyjeq005 1 ningguang 07.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' No matter. I have already conveyed my gratitude to Lan Yan.
:{{A|vo zyjeq005 1 ningguang 08a.ogg}}<!--{{A|vo zyjeq005 1 ningguang 08b.ogg}}--> '''Ningguang:''' Besides, it is {{Traveler}} who comes seeking her. Whatever they need to discuss is surely of great importance. I see no reason for us to hold them up.
:{{A|vo zyjeq005 1 unclelan 02.ogg}} '''Uncle Lan:''' Then please forgive her haste, Lady Ningguang.
:{{A|vo zyjeq005 1 lanyan 03.ogg}} '''Lan Yan:''' Thank you... And thank you, Lady Ningguang!
:{{A|vo zyjeq005 1 lanyan 04.ogg}} '''Lan Yan:''' Phew, hehe... You saved me at the perfect moment! Thanks a million.
:{{A|vo zyjeq005 1 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Paimon was so nervous back there...
:{{A|vo zyjeq005 1 lanyan 05.ogg}} '''Lan Yan:''' I was nervous too! Most of our clan elders are so stern... I've never been good at dealing with them.
:{{A|vo zyjeq005 1 zhongli 01.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' The members of the Lan clan place great weight upon duty, so it is only natural that they conduct themselves with austerity... Who could have foreseen that their Grandmaster was such an unbound, free-spirited soul?
:{{A|vo zyjeq005 1 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Zhongli?
:{{DIcon}} What brings you here?
:{{A|vo zyjeq005 1 zhongli 02.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' I was merely passing by. I trust I am not disturbing you?
:{{A|vo zyjeq005 1 lanyan 06.ogg}} '''Lan Yan:''' Not at all, Mr. Zhongli! Though from the sound of it... you seem quite familiar with our Grandmaster?
:{{A|vo zyjeq005 1 zhongli 03.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Only rumors and passing mentions. As it happens, I bring glad tidings for Miss Lan Yan.
:{{A|vo zyjeq005 1 zhongli 04.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' After you cast your art last night, swallows across Liyue seemed to be affected by it. They no longer fly about in such a frantic rush.
:{{A|vo zyjeq005 1 zhongli 05.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' They remain difficult to spot at present, but more swallows will surely return to Chenyu Vale to build their nests once again.
:{{A|vo zyjeq005 1 lanyan 07.ogg}} '''Lan Yan:''' Really? That truly is wonderful news! At first, all I wanted was to watch swallows build their nests... I never imagined so much would come of it.
:{{A|vo zyjeq005 1 zhongli 06.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' I suspect the same was true for Wind Reader. At first, he simply took a liking to Silverwing's eyes.
:{{A|vo zyjeq005 1 zhongli 07.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Yet as he spent much time gazing into those eyes, even the mountains and rivers of Liyue reflected within them became all but impossible to forget.
:{{A|vo zyjeq005 1 lanyan 08.ogg}} '''Lan Yan:''' Mr. Zhongli... how do you know so much about the swallows?
:{{A|vo zyjeq005 1 zhongli 08.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' {{Traveler}} mentioned your story to me. As one familiar with Liyue's avian life, I took a moment to observe.
:{{A|vo zyjeq005 1 lanyan 09.ogg}} '''Lan Yan:''' Well... that's very thoughtful of you!
:{{A|vo zyjeq005 1 zhongli 09.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' I shall take my leave then. I must visit the nearby market to purchase some tea leaves. The Director has been in good spirits lately and has expanded my budget accordingly.
:{{A|vo zyjeq005 1 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Then you'd better make the most of it!
:{{A|vo zyjeq005 1 lanyan 10.ogg}} '''Lan Yan:''' I forgot to ask earlier, what did you two need to talk to me about?
:{{A|vo zyjeq005 1 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Well, now that we finally have a chance to enjoy the festival, we wanted to ask if you'd show us around again!
:{{A|vo zyjeq005 1 lanyan 11.ogg}} '''Lan Yan:''' That's right! Last time I tried to show you around, we ran right into our Grandmaster... Why don't we head to the food street first? That's your favorite, right Paimon?
:{{A|vo zyjeq005 1 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You bet! Oh, by the way, will they run this event again for the next Moonchase Festival?
:{{A|vo zyjeq005 1 lanyan 12.ogg}} '''Lan Yan:''' That's hard to say. After everything these past few days, I'm sure you know Moonchase events are always changing. Who knows? One of these years, it might have nothing to do with food at all.
:{{A|vo zyjeq005 1 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What!? How could they do that? Would it even be Moonchase without food?
:{{A|vo zyjeq005 1 lanyan 13.ogg}} '''Lan Yan:''' Hmm... then what makes it Moonchase to you?
:{{A|vo zyjeq005 1 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Well... at the very least, you've gotta have good food and good friends!
:{{A|vo zyjeq005 1 lanyan 14.ogg}} '''Lan Yan:''' Haha. In that case, as long as you remember to come to Yilong Wharf, you'll be set! Xiangling and Escoffier have agreed to hold a culinary duel here every year.
:{{A|vo zyjeq005 1 lanyan 15.ogg}} '''Lan Yan:''' When the time comes, festival or not, you'll never be short on good food or good friends.
:{{A|vo zyjeq005 1 paimon 12.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Now that's more like it!
:{{A|vo zyjeq005 1 lanyan 16.ogg}} '''Lan Yan:''' Come on, the festival's not over yet, hehe!
{{Dialogue End}}

'''''Nilotpala Cup: Debut Match''''' is the second [[Event Quest]] during the [[Fabulous Fungus Frenzy]] Event.

==Steps==
# Wait till the next morning (8:00 – 10:00)
# Go to the Nilotpala Cup Arena
# Participate in the competition
# Defeat your [[Ajilenakh Dash|opponents]]
# Leave the arena
# Talk to [[Yae Miko]]
# Look for the source of the cry for help
# Talk to [[Haniyyah]]
# Return to the Nilotpala Cup Arena

* Completing this quest grants the ''[[Memories of the Heart]]'' achievement ''[[From the Sea Never Returning]].''

==Dialogue==
{{Quest Description|You find the masterless ninken that [[Thoma]] mentioned, but its attitude is a bit...}}
===Warning! Dangerous Dog Outside Premises!===
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Look for the ninken that has wandered off into the wild)
:{{A|vo tmcop001 1911701 thoma 01.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' Oh... see it? It's that one, just up ahead.
:{{A|vo tmcop001 1911701 thoma 02.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' Judging by the breed and apparel, it definitely is a ninja dog from the [[Shuumatsuban]].
:{{A|vo tmcop001 1911701 thoma 03.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' It's looking a little more docile today. Shall we try and get closer?
:{{A|vo tmcop001 1911701 thoma 04.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' Oh, uh, you should stay a few paces behind me. I know it looks calm, but if it gets riled up, it could pounce and bite in an instant.
:{{A|vo tmcop001 1911701 thoma 05.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' Here doggy, good doggy... you hungry my friend? I brought you a nice little snack...
:{{A|vo tmcop001 1911701 inushoushou 01.ogg}} '''Ninken:''' Woof! Woof! *growl*
:{{A|vo tmcop001 1911701 thoma 06.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' You're a vicious little thing, aren't you? You almost bit me again!
:{{A|vo tmcop001 1911701 thoma 07.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' Look at you, wasting away... you must wanna eat a little something?
:{{A|vo tmcop001 1911701 thoma 08.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' You don't have to come back with us, but c'mon — a dog's gotta eat, right?
:{{A|vo tmcop001 1911701 thoma 09.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' You're not worried it's poisoned, are you? Here, I'll take the first bite.
:{{A|vo tmcop001 1911701 thoma 10.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' See? Delicious and poison-free.
:{{DIcon}} Thoma...
:{{DIcon}} You're really putting yourself out there...
:{{A|vo tmcop001 1911701 thoma 11.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' Come on, just have a bite. A little tiny bite, and then I'll leave you alone, how's that sound?
:{{A|vo tmcop001 1911701 inushoushou 02.ogg}} '''Ninken:''' Woof! Woof, woof!
:{{A|vo tmcop001 1911701 thoma 12.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' Looks like it has zero intention of eating the food we brought... Is it just me, or does it look kind of on edge?
:{{A|vo tmcop001 1911701 thoma 13.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' Maybe it's something in the sea... Or something nearby that's got him on alert.
:{{DIcon}} Those monsters, perhaps?
:{{A|vo tmcop001 1911701 thoma 14.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' You think he was attacked by monsters... Hmm, it's possible.
:{{A|vo tmcop001 1911701 thoma 15.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' People do tend to lose their appetite in dangerous situations. Maybe it's the same for dogs, too. Let's clear out the area on behalf of our canine companion here.
:{{A|vo tmcop001 1911701 thoma 16.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' Thanks for helping out. This place should be a little more tranquil now, {{Traveler}}.
----
;(Observe the ninken's responses)
:{{A|vo tmcop001 1911702 thoma 01.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' Here doggy, look — no more danger.
:{{A|vo tmcop001 1911702 thoma 02.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' You've gotta wanna eat a little something now? Come on, eat up, then let's get you back to Komore Teahouse.
:{{A|vo tmcop001 1911702 thoma 03.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' Whatever's on your mind, you can tell me and [[Taroumaru]] all about it.
:{{A|vo tmcop001 1911702 inushoushou 01.ogg}} '''Ninken:''' Woof! Woof! *growl*
:{{DIcon}} It still doesn't want to cooperate.
:{{DIcon}} Looks like we failed...
:{{A|vo tmcop001 1911702 thoma 04.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' *sigh* Rejected again.
:{{A|vo tmcop001 1911702 thoma 05.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' And there I was thinking that I was the one it didn't like. I didn't expect it to be so on edge around you, too.
:{{A|vo tmcop001 1911702 thoma 06.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' Well, to me, this proves that it simply doesn't want to leave this place. For now, let's not force it.
:{{A|vo tmcop001 1911702 thoma 07.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' Time to head back to the Yashiro Commission headquarters. I'll see if I can find its owner, so they can come and collect it.
:{{DIcon}} But it's from the Shuumatsuban...
:{{A|vo tmcop001 1911702 thoma 08.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' That's right — the Shuumatsuban only answer to the Yashiro Commissioner, [[Kamisato Ayato]]. Under most circumstances, no one else has the authority to inquire into their business.
:{{A|vo tmcop001 1911702 thoma 09.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' However, I was talking to Commissioner Ayato a while back, and he agreed to let me bend the rules in exceptional circumstances.
:{{A|vo tmcop001 1911702 thoma 10.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' That doesn't mean I can mobilize the Shuumatsuban to do my bidding, of course. But I'll be able to get the intel we need, no problem. It's sort of a prerogative I have.
:{{A|vo tmcop001 1911702 inushoushou 02.ogg}} '''Ninken:''' Woof! Woof, woof, woof!
:{{A|vo tmcop001 1911702 thoma 11.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' Alright, there's a good dog, calm down. We're not gonna take you away.
:{{A|vo tmcop001 1911702 thoma 12.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' It's much safer here now, see? We're gonna leave now, make sure to give yourself a good rest.
:{{A|vo tmcop001 1911702 thoma 13.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' Alright, let's go, {{Traveler}}.

;(Talk to Ninken again)
:'''Ninken:''' Woof! Woof! *growl*
{{Dialogue End}}

===Those Who Can Never Return===
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Ask Kazuaki)
:{{A|vo tmcop001 1911703 kazuaki 01.ogg}} '''Kazuaki:''' This ninja dog you speak of... it rings a bell.
:{{A|vo tmcop001 1911703 kazuaki 02.ogg}} '''Kazuaki:''' Could I trouble you to describe it again for me?
:{{A|vo tmcop001 1911703 thoma 01.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' A red Shiba, with a scar on its eye, dressed in black stealth wear...
:{{A|vo tmcop001 1911703 kazuaki 03.ogg}} '''Kazuaki:''' Ah, I think I know. You must be talking about Inu Shoushou.
:{{DIcon}} "Inu Shoushou"?
:{{DIcon}} Is that its name?
:{{A|vo tmcop001 1911703 kazuaki 04.ogg}} '''Kazuaki:''' That's right. I'm really surprised that's where you found him...
:{{A|vo tmcop001 1911703 thoma 02.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' Perfect! Now that we've figured out his identity, we can get its owner to go and collect it.
:{{A|vo tmcop001 1911703 thoma 03.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' I should add, it's never good to have dogs run away like this. The poor thing's out there all on his own with no real food or shelter, day and night.
:{{A|vo tmcop001 1911703 thoma 04.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' So, shall we go find the owner and see if they have time to fetch him?
:{{A|vo tmcop001 1911703 kazuaki 05.ogg}} '''Kazuaki:''' I'm sorry. That won't be possible.
:{{A|vo tmcop001 1911703 thoma 05.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' Why?
:{{A|vo tmcop001 1911703 kazuaki 06.ogg}} '''Kazuaki:''' I'm afraid I can't disclose the owner's identity.
:{{A|vo tmcop001 1911703 kazuaki 07.ogg}} '''Kazuaki:''' What I can tell you is they went out to sea on a dangerous mission, and... he won't be coming back.
:{{A|vo tmcop001 1911703 kazuaki 08.ogg}} '''Kazuaki:''' I had no idea that he hadn't taken Inu Shoushou along with him. Seems he decided to face this one alone.
:{{A|vo tmcop001 1911703 kazuaki 09.ogg}} '''Kazuaki:''' I can only assume that Inu Shoushou is waiting for his owner to come back, which is why he refuses to move from the beach...
:{{DIcon}} But that means...
:{{DIcon}} Inu Shoushou will be waiting forever...
:{{A|vo tmcop001 1911703 thoma 06.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' Did Inu Shoushou's owner leave anything behind?
:{{A|vo tmcop001 1911703 thoma 07.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' You know, any personal items, or a Shuumatsuban uniform perhaps?
:{{A|vo tmcop001 1911703 kazuaki 10.ogg}} '''Kazuaki:''' Most of his possessions disappeared along with the man himself. The only thing I can think of is the Kunai he used to train with.
:{{A|vo tmcop001 1911703 kazuaki 11.ogg}} '''Kazuaki:''' Come with me. I'll see if I can find it for you.
:{{Black Screen|''You search the warehouse with Kazuaki:''}}
:{{A|vo tmcop001 1911703 kazuaki 12.ogg}} '''Kazuaki:''' Ah, yes, this looks like the one.
:{{A|vo tmcop001 1911703 kazuaki 13.ogg}} '''Kazuaki:''' The reason this Kunai stands out in my memory is because when he first joined the Shuumatsuban, he trained at it harder than anyone else, to the point where the tip became blunt from erosion.
:{{A|vo tmcop001 1911703 kazuaki 14.ogg}} '''Kazuaki:''' Take it. The Shuumatsuban will make sure to cover Inu Shoushou's daily expenses.
:{{A|vo tmcop001 1911703 thoma 08.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' Thank you kindly. Let's just hope Inu Shoushou remembers the scent of this Kunai... Then again, I'm certain he will.
:{{A|vo tmcop001 1911703 thoma 09.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' Let's go pay Inu Shoushou another visit, {{Traveler}}.
----
;(Keep the ninken company with Thoma)
:{{A|vo tmcop001 1911704 thoma 01.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' Hey, Inu Shoushou...
:{{A|vo tmcop001 1911704 inushoushou 01.ogg}} '''Inu Shoushou:''' Woof! ...Woof?
:{{A|vo tmcop001 1911704 thoma 02.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' I know, I know, how come this strange man suddenly knows your name?
:{{A|vo tmcop001 1911704 thoma 03.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' You're waiting for your master to come home, aren't you? Mind if we wait with you?
:{{A|vo tmcop001 1911704 thoma 04.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' Don't worry, we're not looking to suddenly whisk you away. Look at this, do you know what it is?
:[[File:Ino Shoushous owners Kunai.png|200px]]
::A kunai that has lost its edge. You've heard that its user once used it while being put through a tough regimen.
:{{A|vo tmcop001 1911704 inushoushou 02.ogg}} '''Inu Shoushou:''' Woof, woof! Woof!
:{{A|vo tmcop001 1911704 thoma 05.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' As I thought. You remember.
:{{DIcon}} Inu Shoushou...
:{{DIcon}} He seems to be more affectionate this time.
:{{A|vo tmcop001 1911704 thoma 06.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' Excellent. It looks like what he needed wasn't for us to take him away, but for us to accompany him.
:{{A|vo tmcop001 1911704 thoma 07.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' You know, I sometimes did this too, when I first arrived in [[Inazuma]]. I just stood on the beach, looking out at the horizon.
:{{A|vo tmcop001 1911704 thoma 08.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' Everyone has people and events from their past that they look back on fondly. I guess we only grow when we realize that those things aren't coming back.
:{{A|vo tmcop001 1911704 thoma 09.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' The Shuumatsuban is not a peaceful organization, and being a ninja is an extremely dangerous profession.
:{{A|vo tmcop001 1911704 thoma 10.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' Many of the Shuumatsuban's ninjas have paid the ultimate price in the course of carrying out top-secret missions. The Shuumatsuban never discloses their identities, and doesn't publicly commemorate them.
:{{A|vo tmcop001 1911704 thoma 11.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' But at least now, Inu Shoushou, you're not the only one in the world who remembers him.
:{{A|vo tmcop001 1911704 thoma 12.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' From today onward, we will join you in honoring his memory.
:{{A|vo tmcop001 1911704 inushoushou 03.ogg}} '''Inu Shoushou:''' Woof...
:{{A|vo tmcop001 1911704 thoma 13.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' I think that means "deal," right, {{Traveler}}?
:{{DIcon}} It's a deal alright.
:{{A|vo tmcop001 1911704 thoma 14.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' Hey, in the future, let's try and come back here from time to time, when we get the chance.
:{{A|vo tmcop001 1911704 thoma 15.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' Maybe we could build a little kennel for him. In the long-term, being out in the cold and wet like this could start to cause joint problems.
:{{A|vo tmcop001 1911704 thoma 16.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' I could make some winter clothes for him, too. In fact, I'd better get started...
{{Dialogue End}}

==Dialogue==
{{Quest Description|Noelle reveals to you that she is very anxious about the Knights of Favonius selection exam. At your suggestion, she decides to emulate the knights she knows in an attempt to overcome her sense of unease.}}
===Outrider 101===
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Obtain {{Item|Fresh Valberry}})
:{{A|vo noecop002 1909001 noelle 01.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' Yes, this should be plenty of Valberries...
:;(Pyro slimes appear)
:{{A|vo noecop002 1909001 noelle 02.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' Oh? Pyro Slimes? Perfect, they can provide us with another ingredient we need.

;(After obtaining all materials)
:{{A|vo noecop002 1909001 noelle 03.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' [[Pyro Slime Condensate]]... Crushed Valberries...
:{{A|vo noecop002 1909001 noelle 04.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' Good! Now I can start to make a Baron Bunny!
:{{A|vo noecop002 1909001 noelle 05.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' Mm-hmm... Through here... Conceal the stitch... Done!
:{{DIcon}} It looks just like the ones Amber makes! Noelle, you are very handy!
:{{A|vo noecop002 1909001 noelle 06.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' ...Far from it... I know it looks the part on the outside, but I still don't know if it will really work...
:{{A|vo noecop002 1909001 noelle 07.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' There should be a hilichurl camp nearby. Let's place the Baron Bunny there and try it out.

;(Head to the hilichurl camp and place the Baron Bunny)
:{{A|vo noecop002 1909001 noelle 08.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' Ah! The hilichurls are coming back. Let's see if the Baron Bunny gets their attention.
:{{A|vo noecop002 1909001 noelle 09.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' What's going on... They're completely ignoring the Baron Bunny...
:{{A|vo noecop002 1909001 noelle 10.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' They're coming this way! {{Traveler}}, watch out!

;(After defeating opponents)
:{{A|vo noecop002 1909002 noelle 01.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' Ohhhh...
:{{A|vo noecop002 1909002 noelle 02.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' ...It neither attracted their attention nor exploded... In the end, all I managed to recreate was the outward appearance...
:{{DIcon}} Perhaps Amber controls it using her Pyro abilities...
:{{A|vo noecop002 1909002 noelle 03.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' I suppose the conclusion is: I can't become an Outrider like Amber.
:{{A|vo noecop002 1909002 noelle 04.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' Hmm... Maybe I am not yet ready to carry out the work of a fully qualified knight...
:{{DIcon}} Or maybe you're just not suited to becoming an Outrider...
:{{A|vo noecop002 1909002 noelle 05.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' But... I just can't think of what else I could do...
:{{A|vo noecop002 1909002 noelle 06.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' Every time I've looked forward to passing the exam, I always ended up disappointed in the end...
:{{A|vo noecop002 1909002 noelle 07.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' Whenever I remember that feeling of disappointment, I stop being able to think about what kind of knight I could become...
:{{Hangout Branch|You could become an Acting Grand Master, like Jean.|Substitute Acting Grand Master Noelle}}
::{{A|vo noecop002 1909002 noelle 16.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' M—Master Jean!? How could I ever become someone great like her?
::{{A|vo noecop002 1909002 noelle 17.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' Master Jean is a pillar of the Knights of Favonius and a great source of inspiration to me... If I could gain even one or two of her qualities, I would be very happy.
::{{A|vo noecop002 1909002 noelle 18.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' But the thought of becoming a knight just like her in every way... I could never achieve that.
::{{DIcon}} Just set a goal first. We can start from the smaller details.
::{{A|vo noecop002 1909002 noelle 19.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' Y—You think so? ...I suppose if the goal is set so high that I couldn't hope to achieve it right away, I won't be too disappointed day to day...
::{{A|vo noecop002 1909002 noelle 20.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' But... where to start? I can't imagine what I would need to do to become more like Master Jean...
::{{DIcon}} Jean doesn't always sit in her office.
::{{DIcon}} Jean often helps out the locals around town.
::{{A|vo noecop002 1909002 noelle 21.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' Oh... That's true, Master Jean is always lending a hand to citizens in need... So strong, but so gentle, too...
::{{A|vo noecop002 1909002 noelle 22.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' I still don't think I can do what Master Jean does... But at least I could start by trying to be gentle like her.
::{{A|vo noecop002 1909002 noelle 23.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' Okay, then let's head back to Mondstadt and see if anyone needs help.
:;(Proceed to [[Substitute Acting Grand Master Noelle]])
:{{Hangout Branch|You could become a Cavalry Captain, like Kaeya.|Noelle the Intelligence Operative}}
::{{A|vo noecop002 1909002 noelle 08.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' C—Captain Kaeya? No, I could never manage that...
::{{A|vo noecop002 1909002 noelle 09.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' Captain Kaeya has his own way of thinking and planning... Sometimes, I can barely understand it, and as for imitating it...
::{{A|vo noecop002 1909002 noelle 10.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' I simply wouldn't know where to begin.
::{{DIcon}} Kaeya doesn't spend every second of every day on making big plans.
::{{DIcon}} You can start with some smaller details.
::{{A|vo noecop002 1909002 noelle 11.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' Oh, so you mean I should focus on smaller steps in order to achieve a larger goal?
::{{A|vo noecop002 1909002 noelle 12.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' I suppose with smaller goals, I won't be disappointed day-to-day... Since the larger goal is so light, I couldn't hope to achieve it immediately.
::{{A|vo noecop002 1909002 noelle 13.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' In which case... Hmmm... Captain Kaeya seems to be in the habit of fishing for information at the Angel's Share.
::{{A|vo noecop002 1909002 noelle 14.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' That's pretty small... and yet... I heard that the reason we were able to arrest those Treasure Hoarders last time was thanks to Captain Kaeya's intel.
::{{DIcon}} Then let's start with the Angel's Share.
::{{A|vo noecop002 1909002 noelle 15.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' Alright... I hope I can find some intel that proves useful to Mondstadt...
:;(Proceed to [[Noelle the Intelligence Operative]])
{{Dialogue End}}

:{{DIcon}} Is there something wrong with that...?
:{{A|vo eqxs203 2 tangyigang  02.ogg}} '''Tang Yigang:''' Everything is wrong with that. Would you put The Soulblazer Saga on the same shelf as [[The Boar Princess]]?
:{{A|vo eqxs203 2 alrani 01.ogg}} '''Alrani:''' Hey, watch it... What have you got against The Boar Princess, hmm?
:{{A|vo eqxs203 2 tangyigang  03.ogg}} '''Tang Yigang:''' Oh, sorry — I didn't mean it like that. To be fair, The Boar Princess is a pretty good read. I bought the whole set from the [[Wanwen Bookhouse]].
:{{DIcon}} What are you reading, [[Tang Yigang|Yigang]]?
:{{A|vo eqxs203 2 alrani 02.ogg}} '''Alrani:''' The Soulblazer Saga: Armored Assault, volume 1... Ah. The Soulblazer spinoff.
:{{A|vo eqxs203 2 tangyigang  04.ogg}} '''Tang Yigang:''' Yup. This book was my first introduction to the Soulblazer universe.
:{{A|vo eqxs203 2 tangyigang  05.ogg}} '''Tang Yigang:''' It abandons traditional modes of human combat, instead housing the heroes within giant armored mecha, each the size of the [[Jade Chamber]].
:{{A|vo eqxs203 2 tangyigang  06.ogg}} '''Tang Yigang:''' And since it isn't canon, it's free to delve into territory that the original series can't explore — like aerial combat. It goes pretty hard.
:{{A|vo eqxs203 2 tangyigang  07.ogg}} '''Tang Yigang:''' When I discovered this as a boy, ahh... I thought it was the coolest thing ever. As soon as I saw mecha and mid-air dogfights, I was hooked.
:{{A|vo eqxs203 2 alrani 03.ogg}} '''Alrani:''' So you're big into the mecha genre, huh?
:{{A|vo eqxs203 2 tangyigang  08.ogg}} '''Tang Yigang:''' Hehe, I sure am. After that, I was hunting down books in the Soulblazer series wherever I could find them. I even bought the mecha warrior action figures released by the Yae Publishing House.
:{{A|vo eqxs203 2 tangyigang  09.ogg}} '''Tang Yigang:''' *sigh* I gotta say though, it really did a number on my savings. Those action figures are so expensive, and there are so many to collect.
:{{A|vo eqxs203 2 alrani 04.ogg}} '''Alrani:''' Yup, that's how it goes. Seems like every other day there's a Soulblazer reprint, collector's edition, spinoff series, sequel... So much to keep track of.
:{{A|vo eqxs203 2 tangyigang  10.ogg}} '''Tang Yigang:''' Yeah... The thing is, the publisher knows exactly what they're doing. They keep milking their cash cow for all it's worth, because chumps like me fall for it every single time...
:{{A|vo eqxs203 2 alrani 05.ogg}} '''Alrani:''' ...Me too...

;(Talk to Varesa)<!--can't interact with Minnie-->
:{{A|vo eqxs203 6 minnie 01.ogg}} '''Minnie:''' I'm surprised [[Ella Musk|Miss Musk]] isn't here today. I always see her by the linguistics section.
:{{DIcon}} Yeah, it's not like her to slack off...

:{{A|vo eqxs203 6 varesa 01.ogg}} '''Varesa:''' You guys know this place inside out, huh? Even down to the regulars. That's impressive!
:{{A|vo eqxs203 6 minnie 02.ogg}} '''Minnie:''' Of course. The library is my secret base.
:{{A|vo eqxs203 6 minnie 03.ogg}} '''Minnie:''' I know which books are on what shelves, who the regular customers are, even what brand of tea Lisa uses for her afternoon drink.
:{{A|vo eqxs203 6 minnie 04.ogg}} '''Minnie:''' This chair is the same one I was sitting in when I first read through The Soulblazer Saga.
:{{A|vo eqxs203 6 minnie 05.ogg}} '''Minnie:''' And any time I want to write letters to my friends in the Legion, this is where I come.
:{{A|vo eqxs203 6 minnie 06.ogg}} '''Minnie:''' I just feel so comfortable here. Miss Lisa is really friendly — she's shared some of her snacks with me before.
:{{A|vo eqxs203 6 varesa 02.ogg}} '''Varesa:''' Wow, amazing... Mmm, snacks... Hehe...
:{{A|vo eqxs203 6 varesa 03.ogg}} '''Varesa:''' Ahem... What I meant to say was, this library is totally different from the one back home.
:{{A|vo eqxs203 6 varesa 04.ogg}} '''Varesa:''' Instead of books, we have woven scrolls. They're usually hung up high on the walls, which means the shorter kids can't always see them.
:{{A|vo eqxs203 6 varesa 05.ogg}} '''Varesa:''' Heh, but I was always tall for my age. Whenever my friends wanted to read a woven scroll, they'd come get me to read it out for them.
:{{A|vo eqxs203 6 varesa 06.ogg}} '''Varesa:''' I got so used to reading woven scrolls in a group that when I eventually got into comics, I carried on the habit. It's more fun reading them together with friends.
:{{A|vo eqxs203 6 minnie 07.ogg}} '''Minnie:''' You think so? How does that work, though? 'Cause everyone reads at a different pace, right?
:{{A|vo eqxs203 6 varesa 07.ogg}} '''Varesa:''' It works fine. The faster readers just wait for the others to catch up before turning the page. Plus, with other people around, you can read for a bit, then chat for a bit, then read some more... Beats reading in silence!
:{{A|vo eqxs203 6 varesa 08.ogg}} '''Varesa:''' Funnily enough, that's actually how I got to know Xilonen.
:{{A|vo eqxs203 6 varesa 09.ogg}} '''Varesa:''' This one time, I came to her workshop, planning to commission her for a job. When I arrived, I found [[Nepecha]] reading a comic book — and it turned out it was The Soulblazer Saga!
:{{A|vo eqxs203 6 varesa 10.ogg}} '''Varesa:''' We were both pretty stoked to meet a fellow Soulblazer fan, and I guess we were chatting so loudly that we woke Xilonen up from her nap.
:{{A|vo eqxs203 6 varesa 11.ogg}} '''Varesa:''' She came over, intending to quiet us down... but that turned into us roping Xilonen into reading comics with us.
:{{A|vo eqxs203 6 varesa 12.ogg}} '''Varesa:''' Next thing you know, it was the middle of the night and we'd been at it for hours... Xilonen was so tired, she just lay down in between me and Nepecha and went to sleep. Hehe, ever since then, we've been the best of friends!
:{{A|vo eqxs203 6 minnie 08.ogg}} '''Minnie:''' That sounds so nice... I really wanna meet Nepecha, too. I hope I can visit [[Natlan]] one day...
:{{A|vo eqxs203 6 varesa 13.ogg}} '''Varesa:''' We can make that happen! I'm sure Xilonen would be more than happy to introduce you. And don't forget to invite me too!
:{{A|vo eqxs203 6 minnie 09.ogg}} '''Minnie:''' It's just...
:{{A|vo eqxs203 6 varesa 14.ogg}} '''Varesa:''' Hey, don't feel down! A deal's a deal. As long as we get ranked in the contest, your parents will have to respect your wishes.
:{{A|vo eqxs203 6 varesa 15.ogg}} '''Varesa:''' So let's put all our energy into doing the best we can. We're gonna get that ranking, and you're gonna go on that trip!
:{{A|vo eqxs203 6 minnie 10.ogg}} '''Minnie:''' Mm... I'll do my best!

;(Approach the marked location at Good Hunter)
:{{A|vo eqxs203 9 minnie 01.ogg}} '''Minnie:''' Everyone loves Good Hunter. My family eats here all the time.
:{{A|vo eqxs203 9 minnie 02.ogg}} '''Minnie:''' It's a little small, though. We'll probably have to split the group across two tables.
:{{A|vo eqxs203 9 xilonen 01.ogg}} '''Xilonen:''' Ah, bummer... Well, never mind. We've done plenty of group activities recently, it won't kill us to split up just this once.
:{{A|vo eqxs203 9 alrani 01.ogg}} '''Alrani:''' Haha, Captain's already been hypnotized by the menu.
:{{A|vo eqxs203 9 varesa 01.ogg}} '''Varesa:''' It smells so good... Meat stew... seafood... Ahhh!
:{{A|vo eqxs203 9 sara 01.ogg}} '''Sara:''' Are you ready to order?
:{{A|vo eqxs203 9 varesa 02.ogg}} '''Varesa:''' Let's see... Um, I guess I'll get the ball rolling.
:{{A|vo eqxs203 9 varesa 03.ogg}} '''Varesa:''' Let's start with thirty plates each of [[Tea Break Pancake]]s and [[Flaming Red Bolognese]], seven bowls of [[Calla Lily Seafood Soup]]...
:{{A|vo eqxs203 9 varesa 04.ogg}} '''Varesa:''' And um... yeah, thirty [[Meatnado]]s. As for appetizers... twelve [[Apple Roly Poly|Apple Roly Polies]] and twelve [[Sautéed Matsutake]]. Don't wanna overdo it.
:{{A|vo eqxs203 9 varesa 05.ogg}} '''Varesa:''' Anyone else wanna add something? Or we could just start there and add stuff later...

:{{DIcon}} We can always order more if we need.
:{{A|vo eqxs203 9 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Looks like Varesa's appetite is as crazy as ever... Thanks, [[Sara]], that'll do for now.
:{{A|vo eqxs203 9 sara 02.ogg}} '''Sara:''' A—Are you sure it's not too much...?
:{{A|vo eqxs203 9 xilonen 02.ogg}} '''Xilonen:''' Oh, I promise you, none of it will go to waste.
:{{A|vo eqxs203 9 sara 03.ogg}} '''Sara:''' Uh, if you say so... Well then. I guess I'd better get cooking...
:{{A|vo eqxs203 9 varesa 06.ogg}} '''Varesa:''' Hehe, nothing beats eating a nice big meal when you're hungry for it.
:{{Black Screen|After a short wait, Sara expertly maneuvers the enormous platter of dishes to your tables.}}
:{{Black Screen|"Thanks!" says Varesa, before digging in like there's no tomorrow.}}
:{{A|vo eqxs203 9 xilonen 03.ogg}} '''Xilonen:''' No matter how many times I witness it, the Varesa VS Food show never ceases to amaze me. You gotta hand it to the Collective of Plenty: They can pack it away, and they can pack a punch.
:{{A|vo eqxs203 9 varesa 07.ogg}} '''Varesa:''' Well, you gotta eat so you have enough energy for training... And as [[Fietena]] once said, "Even a beast of the [[Abyss]] knows that being a picky eater... is an unpardonable sin!" So, all the more reason for us to eat our fill.
:{{A|vo eqxs203 9 alrani 02.ogg}} '''Alrani:''' Ooh, I know that line. It's from that standalone special, Fietena VS [[Abyss Lector]]: Battle of the Meat Feasters. Right?
:{{DIcon}} Wow. Really plumbing the depths of obscurity here...
:{{A|vo eqxs203 9 alrani 03.ogg}} '''Alrani:''' Don't underestimate a hardcore fan. I know every line in The Soulblazer Saga, no matter where in the Soulblazer universe it comes from.
:{{A|vo eqxs203 9 tangyigang  01.ogg}} '''Tang Yigang:''' Haha, nice one, Alrani. The writers had fun with that one, didn't they? Pure comedy.
:{{A|vo eqxs203 9 tangyigang  02.ogg}} '''Tang Yigang:''' Can you imagine if that was based on a true story? Haha... an eating competition with an Abyssal monster — such a hilarious proposition.
:{{A|vo eqxs203 9 xilonen 04.ogg}} '''Xilonen:''' Yeah, it's really stretching the boundaries of possibilities. I guess it takes a certain kind of talent to come up with ideas like that.
:{{A|vo eqxs203 9 varesa 08.ogg}} '''Varesa:''' Wacky ideas are one thing, but what really blows my mind is the characterization process.
:{{A|vo eqxs203 9 varesa 09.ogg}} '''Varesa:''' The way they take historical figures like Fietena and breathe new life into them as comic-book heroes is just so impressive.
:{{A|vo eqxs203 9 varesa 10.ogg}} '''Varesa:''' "Some people think I'm not enough. I have two words for those people: Think again."
:{{A|vo eqxs203 9 varesa 11.ogg}} '''Varesa:''' That's one of my favorite Fietena quotes of all time.
:{{A|vo eqxs203 9 alrani 04.ogg}} '''Alrani:''' That's from the Soulblazer Saga, volume 3. Just FYI.
:{{A|vo eqxs203 9 varesa 12.ogg}} '''Varesa:''' Thanks, Alrani.
:{{A|vo eqxs203 9 varesa 13.ogg}} '''Varesa:''' Minnie, do you have a favorite Soulblazer quote? Or a favorite plot point in general?
:{{A|vo eqxs203 9 minnie 03.ogg}} '''Minnie:''' I think for me... it's the way they portray Fietena's dream.
:{{A|vo eqxs203 9 minnie 04.ogg}} '''Minnie:''' Despite the endless numbers of monsters, and even when the Abyss seems like a never-ending threat, Fietena never gives up fighting for her dream homeland.
:{{A|vo eqxs203 9 minnie 05.ogg}} '''Minnie:''' Ahem... "Maybe it is impossible. But if we don't try, we'll never know."
:{{A|vo eqxs203 9 varesa 14.ogg}} '''Varesa:''' Ah, yeah, I love that line too!
:{{A|vo eqxs203 9 alrani 05.ogg}} '''Alrani:''' Volume 3 strikes again. FYI.
:{{A|vo eqxs203 9 varesa 15.ogg}} '''Varesa:''' No matter what, Fietena always stays true to her dreams. That's why she'll always be my favorite hero.
:{{A|vo eqxs203 9 minnie 06.ogg}} '''Minnie:''' Same... But when I look at my own life, I wonder... Will I ever have that same kind of tireless dedication? Following your dreams is so hard sometimes.
:{{A|vo eqxs203 9 minnie 07.ogg}} '''Minnie:''' I feel like I'm giving everything I have to give, but everyone around me is telling me "give up, it's not realistic"... Ugh, I don't know. Honestly, I'm not even that good of an artist. I'm never quite happy with my work.
:{{A|vo eqxs203 9 minnie 08.ogg}} '''Minnie:''' Sometimes, I get to thinking that I should just pack my pens and paper away and be done with it. Maybe life would be easier that way.
:{{A|vo eqxs203 9 minnie 09.ogg}} '''Minnie:''' But I've tried that before too... and it's never long before I start to miss it. I'll be at the grocery store buying some cured meat, or at home doing some chores, and I'll suddenly find myself thinking... "I miss my art."
:{{A|vo eqxs203 9 xilonen 05.ogg}} '''Xilonen:''' Lemme guess, it always ends up with you digging out your art supplies and giving it another try?
:{{A|vo eqxs203 9 minnie 10.ogg}} '''Minnie:''' Yeah. It's turning into a bit of a cycle, honestly. I keep flip-flopping between "that's it, I'm never painting again!" and "no, I gotta keep trying!"
:{{A|vo eqxs203 9 minnie 11.ogg}} '''Minnie:''' Who am I kidding. I'll never have Fietena's perseverance.
:{{A|vo eqxs203 9 varesa 16.ogg}} '''Varesa:''' You're thinking about it all wrong, Minnie. Even Fietena had days when she didn't feel like training or eating right!
:{{A|vo eqxs203 9 varesa 17.ogg}} '''Varesa:''' Having tireless dedication doesn't mean doing the same thing on repeat every day.
:{{A|vo eqxs203 9 varesa 18.ogg}} '''Varesa:''' To me, dedication just means being passionate about something. Wherever you go, whatever you do, you always carry it in your heart.
:{{A|vo eqxs203 9 varesa 19.ogg}} '''Varesa:''' Sometimes you let yourself go, but it's okay. You can always get back on the wagon. If you lose muscle or stamina, you just build it back up again.
:{{A|vo eqxs203 9 varesa 20.ogg}} '''Varesa:''' The important thing is to keep that passion alive through all the ups and downs! As Fietena said...
:{{A|vo eqxs203 9 minnie 12.ogg}} '''Minnie:''' "There is only one eternal power in this world... the power of love."
:{{A|vo eqxs203 9 varesa 21.ogg}} '''Varesa:''' Exactly! From volume 6, when Fietena delivers the crushing blow to her enemies. You see? The important lessons stay with you.
:{{A|vo eqxs203 9 minnie 13.ogg}} '''Minnie:''' Yeah... And they always will.
:{{DIcon}} Here's to your dreams.
:{{DIcon}} Here's to your passion.
:{{A|vo eqxs203 9 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' ...Wait a sec! Varesa, when did you clear all those plates!?
:{{A|vo eqxs203 9 varesa 22.ogg}} '''Varesa:''' While everyone was talking. I guess Fietena put me in the mood for a meat feast.
:{{A|vo eqxs203 9 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' No fair! C'mon everyone, eat! We need to catch up!

:{{A|vo eqxs203 9 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So full... Uhhh...
:{{A|vo eqxs203 9 tangyigang  03.ogg}} '''Tang Yigang:''' I can't eat another bite... I'm absolutely stuffed.
:{{A|vo eqxs203 9 xilonen 06.ogg}} '''Xilonen:''' Should we head back to camp? We can walk off some of that food.

:{{A|vo eqxs203 10 patton 08.ogg}} '''Patton:''' Good, glad to hear it. Okay, well... Mom and dad said to tell you they miss you, and they hope you come home soon.
:{{A|vo eqxs203 10 patton 09.ogg}} '''Patton:''' It's great that you've got a hobby you're so passionate about, but don't let it take up all your time, okay? You gotta come home and check in once in a while.
:{{A|vo eqxs203 10 patton 10.ogg}} '''Patton:''' Come home as soon as you can, okay? You can go back to training tomorrow. We don't want mom and dad blowing a gasket...

:{{A|vo eqxs203 10 patton 12.ogg}} '''Patton:''' Sorry to intrude, everyone. Have a great day — I'd better get back to the tavern now.

:{{A|vo eqxs203 11 tangyigang  01.ogg}} '''Tang Yigang:''' Achoo... Man, I almost forgot how cold the mountain was. The difference between here and the city is mind-boggling. I'm gonna go warm up in the tent.
:{{A|vo eqxs203 11 alrani 01.ogg}} '''Alrani:''' I'll join you. Right now, I just wanna wrap myself in blankets and let the food coma run its course.
:{{A|vo eqxs203 11 minnie 01.ogg}} '''Minnie:''' I'd better come too, so I can grab my luggage...
:{{A|vo eqxs203 11 moritz 01.ogg}} '''Moritz:''' Minnie!
:{{A|vo eqxs203 11 sherilyn 01.ogg}} '''Sherilyn:''' There you are, young lady...
:{{A|vo eqxs203 11 minnie 02.ogg}} '''Minnie:''' [[Sherilyn|Mom]], [[Moritz|Dad]]... You actually came...
:{{A|vo eqxs203 11 sherilyn 02.ogg}} '''Sherilyn:''' What choice did we have? When were you planning on coming home? I thought this was supposed to only last a couple of days, but you've been gone for most of the week!
:{{A|vo eqxs203 11 minnie 03.ogg}} '''Minnie:''' I never said a couple of days... I said several days.
:{{A|vo eqxs203 11 moritz 02.ogg}} '''Moritz:''' You did, I remember that. But we also agreed that you'd be out during the days and come back home every night. Come on, it's time to go.
:{{A|vo eqxs203 11 minnie 04.ogg}} '''Minnie:''' ...Okay. I'll just let my friends know.
:{{A|vo eqxs203 11 minnie 05.ogg}} '''Minnie:''' Hey guys, I won't be staying in the camp tonight. See you tomorrow for training.
:{{A|vo eqxs203 11 moritz 03.ogg}} '''Moritz:''' I'm sorry? Tomorrow as well? This is all getting to be a bit too much, Minnie...
:{{A|vo eqxs203 11 moritz 04.ogg}} '''Moritz:''' You've been out here for days on end. Don't you think you've had your fun? Besides, you're not built for this cold weather.
:{{A|vo eqxs203 11 moritz 05.ogg}} '''Moritz:''' Remember that dreadful fever you had as a child? It took the better part of a week to clear up. Your mother and I worried ourselves half to death about you.
:{{A|vo eqxs203 11 minnie 06.ogg}} '''Minnie:''' But...
:{{A|vo eqxs203 11 varesa 01.ogg}} '''Varesa:''' Hello, Sir. I'm Minnie's friend, Varesa.
:{{A|vo eqxs203 11 moritz 06.ogg}} '''Moritz:''' Ah, Varesa, how do you do... I believe Minnie's mentioned you before. Thank you for keeping her company out here. *sigh* Sorry, I would have brought a welcome gift if I'd known...
:{{A|vo eqxs203 11 varesa 02.ogg}} '''Varesa:''' Welcome gift? Nooo, there's no need for that! I just wanted to say, this contest... it really means a lot to Minnie. We've been training together in preparation for it.
:{{A|vo eqxs203 11 varesa 03.ogg}} '''Varesa:''' Minnie's taking the training really seriously. Every day, she starts earlier and finishes later than anyone else.
:{{A|vo eqxs203 11 varesa 04.ogg}} '''Varesa:''' Whether it's strength training or practicing out on the race course, she's been working the hardest out of everyone in our group.
:{{A|vo eqxs203 11 varesa 05.ogg}} '''Varesa:''' Didn't you make a deal with her? I heard that as long as Minnie gets ranked in the contest, you'll consider letting her do what she wants with her life.
:{{A|vo eqxs203 11 varesa 06.ogg}} '''Varesa:''' Her greatest wish is to work in the comic book industry, and she's putting so much work into it. Surely you don't want to see all her efforts go to waste?
:{{A|vo eqxs203 11 sherilyn 03.ogg}} '''Sherilyn:''' Of course not, but the thing is...
:{{A|vo eqxs203 11 minnie 07.ogg}} '''Minnie:''' Mom, I...
:{{A|vo eqxs203 11 moritz 07.ogg}} '''Moritz:''' That's enough! What's more important, your comics or your health?
:{{A|vo eqxs203 11 moritz 08.ogg}} '''Moritz:''' I don't know how many times we've told you: It's great that you have a hobby, but you need to learn the difference between work and play.
:{{A|vo eqxs203 11 moritz 09.ogg}} '''Moritz:''' When's it going to stop, Minnie? When you ruin your health in the name of fun?
:{{A|vo eqxs203 11 sherilyn 04.ogg}} '''Sherilyn:''' Don't take your father's words too hard, Minnie. Both of us just want what's best for you.
:{{A|vo eqxs203 11 sherilyn 05.ogg}} '''Sherilyn:''' You're still young, and it's great that you have something you're passionate about. But at some point, you need to think about your future.
:{{A|vo eqxs203 11 sherilyn 06.ogg}} '''Sherilyn:''' I've seen your artwork, and I do think you have a wonderful talent. But being a comic book artist just isn't a stable career.
:{{A|vo eqxs203 11 moritz 10.ogg}} '''Moritz:''' ...*sigh* I'm sorry, Minnie, I didn't mean to be so harsh.
:{{A|vo eqxs203 11 moritz 11.ogg}} '''Moritz:''' I know how much effort you're putting into this — we both do. We really admire your determination... You're our daughter, and we love you so much.
:{{A|vo eqxs203 11 moritz 12.ogg}} '''Moritz:''' But surely, you can appreciate where we're coming from.
:{{A|vo eqxs203 11 moritz 13.ogg}} '''Moritz:''' Dreams are great. But at the end of the day, they don't put food on the table.
:{{A|vo eqxs203 11 minnie 08.ogg}} '''Minnie:''' Mom, Dad, can we please continue this in private?
:{{A|vo eqxs203 11 sherilyn 07.ogg}} '''Sherilyn:''' Yes, of course. Let's move over there.

;(Try to approach Minnie, Moritz, and Sherilyn)
:'''Minnie and Family:''' (Minnie is talking with her parents. The atmosphere seems very stern.)

;(Talk to Varesa or Xilonen)
:{{A|vo eqxs203 12 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Things got pretty intense with Minnie's parents there. Even Paimon didn't dare to interrupt...
:{{A|vo eqxs203 12 varesa 01.ogg}} '''Varesa:''' Yeah. I kinda wanted to speak up on Minnie's behalf again, but I didn't even know how to butt in...
:{{A|vo eqxs203 12 varesa 02.ogg}} '''Varesa:''' I mean, it sounded like their hearts are in the right place. They said they have her best interests in mind, expressed concern for her health, tried to comfort her...
:{{A|vo eqxs203 12 varesa 03.ogg}} '''Varesa:''' But the whole thing still just felt kinda off to me. I can't quite pinpoint what it was, though...
:{{DIcon}} What about your parents, Varesa?
:{{DIcon}} Have they always supported you?
:{{A|vo eqxs203 12 varesa 05.ogg}} '''Varesa:''' I mean... Whether I'm training, eating, or heading to bed for a nap, they're all smiles.
:{{A|vo eqxs203 12 varesa 06.ogg}} '''Varesa:''' But Minnie's parents... neither of them were smiling when they spoke to her just now.
:{{A|vo eqxs203 12 varesa 07.ogg}} '''Varesa:''' Their words were caring, but their tone was so angry... I don't understand it.
:{{A|vo eqxs203 12 varesa 08.ogg}} '''Varesa:''' It sounds like they don't wanna let Minnie take part in the contest... But then all her hard work will have been for nothing! What are we gonna do?
:{{A|vo eqxs203 12 varesa 09.ogg}} '''Varesa:''' *sigh*... I'm supposed to be Minnie's captain, but I feel powerless to help her...
:{{A|vo eqxs203 12 xilonen 01.ogg}} '''Xilonen:''' ...Heh, I wasn't expecting Nepecha's gift for Minnie to come in handy so soon.
:{{A|vo eqxs203 12 xilonen 02.ogg}} '''Xilonen:''' I was planning to save it as a final surprise before we leave, but under the circumstances, it would be silly not to use it now...
:{{DIcon}} You've got a plan, Xilonen?
:{{DIcon}} How do we fix this?
:{{A|vo eqxs203 12 xilonen 03.ogg}} '''Xilonen:''' I can't put smiles on her parents' faces. But I think I can make sure Minnie gets to participate in the contest.

;(Approach Minnie, Moritz, and Sherilyn)
:{{A|vo eqxs203 13 minnie 01.ogg}} '''Minnie:''' That's not true... I promise, I would never...
:{{A|vo eqxs203 13 sherilyn 01.ogg}} '''Sherilyn:''' Well, in that case, we can discuss this more back home.
:{{A|vo eqxs203 13 xilonen 01.ogg}} '''Xilonen:''' Sorry to interrupt, but there's something I'd like to discuss with the two of you.
:{{A|vo eqxs203 13 moritz 01.ogg}} '''Moritz:''' You must be... Vice Captain Xilonen? Minnie's mentioned you before.... Is something the matter?
:{{A|vo eqxs203 13 moritz 02.ogg}} '''Moritz:''' If it's about the competition, don't worry — we'll let Minnie take part. But as we've just informed her, this will be her last time. We don't want her wasting any more time on worthless pursuits.
:{{A|vo eqxs203 13 xilonen 02.ogg}} '''Xilonen:''' Gotcha... Look, I don't mean to interfere with your family business, but Minnie's a part of our team. I have to make sure everyone's in the right frame of mind to compete.
:{{A|vo eqxs203 13 xilonen 03.ogg}} '''Xilonen:''' And I can't help but feel that her conversation with you was a little demotivating. I'm concerned it's gonna impact her performance on race day.
:{{A|vo eqxs203 13 xilonen 04.ogg}} '''Xilonen:''' I also don't think you're really validating her efforts when you brand something your daughter is passionate about as "wasting time."
:{{A|vo eqxs203 13 xilonen 05.ogg}} '''Xilonen:''' Like I said, not trying to intrude on your family business or anything. But I thought you should know that a student of mine back home simply adores Minnie's artwork.
:{{A|vo eqxs203 13 xilonen 06.ogg}} '''Xilonen:''' She's not here to speak for herself, but as her teacher, I felt like I should pass along the message.
:{{A|vo eqxs203 13 moritz 03.ogg}} '''Moritz:''' I agree that Minnie has artistic talent, but I stand by what I said earlier. Hobbies are hobbies, work is work. A couple of fans isn't going to get you anywhere in life...
:{{A|vo eqxs203 13 xilonen 07.ogg}} '''Xilonen:''' Yeah, about that... Take a look at this letter.
:{{A|vo eqxs203 13 moritz 04.ogg}} '''Moritz:''' ...What's this?
:{{A|vo eqxs203 13 xilonen 08.ogg}} '''Xilonen:''' Let's call it a token of appreciation from Minnie's fanbase.
:{{A|vo eqxs203 13 xilonen 09.ogg}} '''Xilonen:''' They wanted to write one letter each, but I told them I couldn't take a whole sack of mail on a long-distance trip.
:{{A|vo eqxs203 13 xilonen 10.ogg}} '''Xilonen:''' So instead, my student Nepecha arranged for them all to make a group painting for Minnie.
:{{A|vo eqxs203 13 xilonen 11.ogg}} '''Xilonen:''' In the end, so many people participated that it was pretty much one brush-stroke per person.
:{{A|vo eqxs203 13 minnie 02.ogg}} '''Minnie:''' Nepecha's so thoughtful...
:{{A|vo eqxs203 13 xilonen 12.ogg}} '''Xilonen:''' Sorry, Minnie, Nepecha wanted me to give this to you as a surprise after the competition.
:{{A|vo eqxs203 13 xilonen 13.ogg}} '''Xilonen:''' But given the situation, I made the executive decision to give it to you now.
:{{A|vo eqxs203 13 moritz 05.ogg}} '''Moritz:''' So... So how many people is this?
:{{A|vo eqxs203 13 xilonen 14.ogg}} '''Xilonen:''' You think Minnie's wasting her time because in your eyes, making art isn't a worthwhile job.
:{{A|vo eqxs203 13 xilonen 15.ogg}} '''Xilonen:''' And when you use words like "worthless," what you're really saying is, it's not a stable source of income. Am I right?
:{{A|vo eqxs203 13 moritz 06.ogg}} '''Moritz:''' ...Yes. You're right.
:{{A|vo eqxs203 13 xilonen 16.ogg}} '''Xilonen:''' Well, now you have another way to measure "worth." Your daughter's artwork has attracted a whole lot of fans, and very enthusiastic ones at that.
:{{A|vo eqxs203 13 xilonen 17.ogg}} '''Xilonen:''' Since arriving in Mondstadt, I've learned that being a bard is seen as a very respectable profession here.
:{{A|vo eqxs203 13 xilonen 18.ogg}} '''Xilonen:''' Let's imagine Minnie was a bard for a second. Instead of drawings and paintings, she'd produce poetry and songs. Instead of fans, she'd have an audience.
:{{A|vo eqxs203 13 xilonen 19.ogg}} '''Xilonen:''' Would you still be inclined to stop her from being creative? Would lyrics and music be just as much of a "waste of time"?
:{{A|vo eqxs203 13 sherilyn 02.ogg}} '''Sherilyn:''' I take your point, but there's still the issue of her health...
:{{A|vo eqxs203 13 varesa 01.ogg}} '''Varesa:''' Sorry... lemme butt in real quick! You know, Minnie's not nearly as fragile as you think.
:{{A|vo eqxs203 13 varesa 02.ogg}} '''Varesa:''' I'm not just saying that, either. I've been doing competitive sports in my tribe since I was a little kid, so I know what I'm talking about.
:{{A|vo eqxs203 13 varesa 03.ogg}} '''Varesa:''' Sure, Minnie's not built like a pro bodybuilder, but she's got great potential.
:{{A|vo eqxs203 13 varesa 04.ogg}} '''Varesa:''' A sensible amount of exercise is good for her health. Far better than staying cooped up at home all the time.
:{{A|vo eqxs203 13 minnie 03.ogg}} '''Minnie:''' Mom, Dad... My health is a lot better these days. Really. I feel great.
:{{A|vo eqxs203 13 minnie 04.ogg}} '''Minnie:''' Now that I'm training every day, my appetite's improved and I'm sleeping better.
:{{A|vo eqxs203 13 moritz 07.ogg}} '''Moritz:''' Minnie... Sometimes I forget how grown up you are now. You're your own person with your own ideas.
:{{A|vo eqxs203 13 moritz 08.ogg}} '''Moritz:''' To tell you the truth, your mother and I don't really understand this whole world of comics and Yae Publishing House.
:{{A|vo eqxs203 13 moritz 09.ogg}} '''Moritz:''' *sigh* When all's said and done... We just want you to have a safe and stable life. The last thing we want is to see you suffer.
:{{A|vo eqxs203 13 moritz 10.ogg}} '''Moritz:''' But a deal is a deal... This competition clearly means a lot to you. So, give it your best shot. See it through to the end.
:{{A|vo eqxs203 13 minnie 05.ogg}} '''Minnie:''' Mm-hmm! I will!
:{{DIcon}} Don't worry.
:{{DIcon}} I'll make sure Minnie gets through this safe and sound.
:{{A|vo eqxs203 13 moritz 11.ogg}} '''Moritz:''' Thank you, Honorary Knight. It really does ease my mind knowing that you're on the team.
:{{A|vo eqxs203 13 moritz 12.ogg}} '''Moritz:''' Heh, I think I've said enough for one day. Minnie, you're free to attend training and attend the competition, but you're not to stay out at night. Come home and sleep in your own bed. Understand?
:{{A|vo eqxs203 13 minnie 06.ogg}} '''Minnie:''' Yes, Dad!
:{{Black Screen|Minnie collects her luggage and leaves with her parents. They promise to bring her to tomorrow's training session.}}
:{{A|vo eqxs203 13 xilonen 20.ogg}} '''Xilonen:''' ...Phew, at least we got there in the end.
:{{DIcon}} Your powers of persuasion worked like a charm!
:{{A|vo eqxs203 13 xilonen 21.ogg}} '''Xilonen:''' Heh. It was a shot in the dark, honestly... I'm not good at dealing with family drama. Sure as heck didn't have a Plan B, so it's a good thing the letter worked.
:{{A|vo eqxs203 13 xilonen 22.ogg}} '''Xilonen:''' This is way more than I signed up for. I only came here to buy that... merch stuff or whatever.
:{{DIcon}} Even though it wasn't what you signed up for...
:{{DIcon}} You really rose to the occasion.
:{{A|vo eqxs203 13 xilonen 23.ogg}} '''Xilonen:''' Oh, you think? I dunno, seeing how Minnie's parents were acting, it just reminded me of [[Melodious Chant|a similar situation from a while back]].
:{{A|vo eqxs203 13 xilonen 24.ogg}} '''Xilonen:''' Sometimes, someone can love their idea of another person so much that they'll try to mold them to fit that mental image.
:{{A|vo eqxs203 13 xilonen 25.ogg}} '''Xilonen:''' But if "love" is starting to restrict your freedom, it's time to get out.
:{{A|vo eqxs203 13 xilonen 26.ogg}} '''Xilonen:''' Anyway, Minnie's parents aren't nearly that extreme.
:{{A|vo eqxs203 13 xilonen 27.ogg}} '''Xilonen:''' Let's go get ready. Tomorrow is race day, and we have to deliver results.
{{Dialogue End}}

{{Dialogue Start}}

:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915502 layla 01.ogg}} '''Layla:''' We're probably getting close now. Let's search this area.

:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915502 layla 04.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Huh? It's a... picture?

:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915502 layla 07.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Whatever the case, the only way we'll know is if we go there.
