==Dialogue==
{{Quest Description|A shared hobby brings you all together...}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Approach the camp)
:{{A|vo eqxs202 1 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hey Varesa, we finished reading that comic book you gave us. It was pretty cool!
:{{A|vo eqxs202 1 varesa 01.ogg}} '''Varesa:''' Morning... Wait, you finished it? Wow, that was so quick!
:{{DIcon}} I want to know more.
:{{DIcon}} I want to understand the whole story.
:{{A|vo eqxs202 1 alrani 01.ogg}} '''Alrani:''' Hehe, so you, too, have been won over by [[Fietena]]'s infectious charisma... It was but a matter of time.
:{{A|vo eqxs202 1 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' From what we read, it seemed like the Soulblazers were a group of [[Natlan]]ese heroes who fought against monsters.
:{{A|vo eqxs202 1 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Also, [[Mavuika]] had a cameo in there. Does that mean The Soulblazer Saga is based on historical events?
:{{A|vo eqxs202 1 varesa 02.ogg}} '''Varesa:''' That's right. It's an adaptation of Natlan's history. All the characters are based on real people.
:{{A|vo eqxs202 1 varesa 03.ogg}} '''Varesa:''' But of course, it's mostly for entertainment. You can't treat it as a history textbook.
:{{A|vo eqxs202 1 alrani 02.ogg}} '''Alrani:''' The Soulblazers were warriors who fought against the monsters of the [[Abyss]]. Their mission? To protect their nation.
:{{A|vo eqxs202 1 alrani 03.ogg}} '''Alrani:''' The finest warrior of all the Soulblazers was Fietena. She is our hero, our role model.
:{{A|vo eqxs202 1 varesa 04.ogg}} '''Varesa:''' The [[Pyro]] [[Archon]] has some real cool fight scenes too though! She fights with real passion!
:{{A|vo eqxs202 1 varesa 05.ogg}} '''Varesa:''' But there's a whole bunch of other comic series that deal with her story specifically. This one is more focused on Fietena's story arc — her motivations, her rise to greatness, and so on.
:{{A|vo eqxs202 1 varesa 06.ogg}} '''Varesa:''' No matter how desperate things got, she never lost hope.
:{{A|vo eqxs202 1 varesa 07.ogg}} '''Varesa:''' Thanks to her dogged determination, she went from rookie warrior with no understanding of strategy to a formidable commander... Along the way, she became friends with a group of fellow warriors who stuck with each other through thick and thin...
:{{A|vo eqxs202 1 varesa 08.ogg}} '''Varesa:''' Ah, Fietena! She's my hero!
:{{A|vo eqxs202 1 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' This story really means a lot to her...
:{{DIcon}} She seems truly inspired.
:{{A|vo eqxs202 1 alrani 04.ogg}} '''Alrani:''' Oh, every time my thesis gets rejected, I just think about all the challenges that she faced... and suddenly, my own problems don't seem so insurmountable after all.
:{{A|vo eqxs202 1 varesa 09.ogg}} '''Varesa:''' Don't worry, [[Alrani]], I have faith in you! You'll get your thesis approved one day!
:{{A|vo eqxs202 1 alrani 05.ogg}} '''Alrani:''' Aw, Varesa...
:{{A|vo eqxs202 1 alrani 06.ogg}} '''Alrani:''' Hm, you bet I will! Trifling thesis, you are no match for me! When I get back to the Akademiya, prepare to be whipped into shape.
:{{A|vo eqxs202 1 varesa 10.ogg}} '''Varesa:''' Sooo... Now that you guys are into the series, you wanna join the Legion?
:{{A|vo eqxs202 1 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Um... What does it involve? It's a comic book fan club, right?
:{{A|vo eqxs202 1 varesa 11.ogg}} '''Varesa:''' Don't stress over it. Yes, we were initially brought together by a shared interest in comics.
:{{A|vo eqxs202 1 varesa 12.ogg}} '''Varesa:''' But ultimately, our main purpose is to share life's joys and get rid of life's woes.
:{{A|vo eqxs202 1 varesa 13.ogg}} '''Varesa:''' Whatever comes our way, we have each other, and we can face it together.
:{{A|vo eqxs202 1 varesa 14.ogg}} '''Varesa:''' We discuss comics together, eat together, and chill together.
:{{A|vo eqxs202 1 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' In that case, Paimon's in!
:{{DIcon}} Count me in too.
:{{A|vo eqxs202 1 varesa 15.ogg}} '''Varesa:''' YES! Welcome, welcome!
:{{A|vo eqxs202 1 alrani 07.ogg}} '''Alrani:''' Captain, what about the welcome ceremony? Or have you forgotten our traditions?
:{{A|vo eqxs202 1 varesa 16.ogg}} '''Varesa:''' Haha, of course I haven't forgotten! Find a nice open space and wait for me there — I'll just go grab something from the camp.<!--Varesa is at the camp but can't be talked to-->
----
;(Approach the marked location)
:{{A|vo eqxs202 2 alrani 01.ogg}} '''Alrani:''' Here, this is a good spot.
:{{A|vo eqxs202 2 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Alrani, do you have any idea what Varesa's fetching from the camp?
:{{A|vo eqxs202 2 alrani 02.ogg}} '''Alrani:''' Probably the relic we use to swear in new members.
:{{DIcon}} Relic?
:;(Varesa rapidly approaches the area in her [[Riding the Night-Rainbow|Sudden Onrush]] state)
:{{A|vo eqxs202 2 varesa 01.ogg}} '''Varesa:''' I'm here! Hope I didn't keep you waiting too long? I sprinted the whole way!
:{{A|vo eqxs202 2 varesa 02.ogg}} '''Varesa:''' Here, take this. It's a Fietena mask, I made it myself.
:{{A|vo eqxs202 2 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Thanks! ...Huh? Isn't this the mask you wear in combat?
:{{A|vo eqxs202 2 varesa 03.ogg}} '''Varesa:''' That's right. Fietena used to wear a mask in combat too, so the one I made for myself is modeled after hers.
:{{A|vo eqxs202 2 varesa 04.ogg}} '''Varesa:''' Um... Mind if I keep going for a bit?
:{{A|vo eqxs202 2 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Not at all! The floor is yours.
:{{A|vo eqxs202 2 varesa 05.ogg}} '''Varesa:''' ...Phew.
:{{A|vo eqxs202 2 varesa 06.ogg}} '''Varesa:''' The tale of The Soulblazer Saga is a long one, told over 12 volumes. The characters go through so many changes along the way, growing and developing as the story progresses.
:{{A|vo eqxs202 2 varesa 07.ogg}} '''Varesa:''' This mask, for instance, is just one of the five different versions Fietena wears during the story. This one is my favorite of them all.
:{{A|vo eqxs202 2 varesa 08.ogg}} '''Varesa:''' At one point, Fietena goes through a tough phase where she's disillusioned after fighting so many battles. But her friends are always there for her even through her darkest time.
:{{A|vo eqxs202 2 varesa 09.ogg}} '''Varesa:''' With their encouragement, she was able to rally and get back on her feet... And this is the mask she wore when she made her comeback.
:{{A|vo eqxs202 2 varesa 10.ogg}} '''Varesa:''' In my view, that makes it the perfect relic to use for inducting new members into the Legion.
:{{A|vo eqxs202 2 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ooh, this ceremony just got super ceremonious!
:{{A|vo eqxs202 2 varesa 11.ogg}} '''Varesa:''' Hehe! Hold onto it, you're gonna need it during the ceremony!
:{{A|vo eqxs202 2 alrani 03.ogg}} '''Alrani:''' Oh! Captain, is it time?
:{{A|vo eqxs202 2 varesa 12.ogg}} '''Varesa:''' Now, {{Traveler}} and Paimon, join me in reciting the Legion of Soulblazers' creed, which we will cry out at the top of our lungs...
:{{DIcon}} Wait... We have to shout it out?
:{{A|vo eqxs202 2 varesa 13.ogg}} '''Varesa:''' Yeah! Just imagine you're bursting with praise for the chef after a sensational meal.
:{{A|vo eqxs202 2 varesa 14.ogg}} '''Varesa:''' Or... for me, sometimes, I get so happy hanging out with my friends that I just wanna shout "thank you" as loud as I can.
:{{A|vo eqxs202 2 varesa 15.ogg}} '''Varesa:''' When you believe in something, you shout it for the whole world to hear!
:{{A|vo eqxs202 2 alrani 04.ogg}} '''Alrani:''' Exactly. I couldn't have put it better myself. Now, repeat after me!
:{{A|vo eqxs202 2 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' O—Okay...
:{{A|vo eqxs202 2 alrani 05.ogg}} '''Alrani:''' Through pain and defeat, we shall never fear!
:{{A|vo eqxs202 2 hero 01.ogg}} {{A|vo eqxs202 2 heroine 01.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' Through pain and defeat, we shall never fear!
:{{A|vo eqxs202 2 alrani 06.ogg}} '''Alrani:''' I will always champion love and imagination!
:{{A|vo eqxs202 2 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' I will always champion love and imagination!
:{{A|vo eqxs202 2 varesa 16.ogg}} '''Varesa:''' Great! Soulblazers, as of this moment, you are now members of the Legion.
:{{A|vo eqxs202 2 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Nice!
:{{A|vo eqxs202 2 varesa 17.ogg}} '''Varesa:''' Haha, I can't wait to tell [[Xilonen]] the good news!
:{{A|vo eqxs202 2 alrani 07.ogg}} '''Alrani:''' If I'm not mistaken, she's out training with Minnie and [[Tang Yigang|Yigang]] today.
:{{A|vo eqxs202 2 varesa 18.ogg}} '''Varesa:''' Got it. Alright, let's go!

:{{A|vo eqxs202 7 varesa 11.ogg}} '''Varesa:''' Your mask and artwork are already famous in the [[Collective of Plenty]]! People are constantly asking, "Who painted this? It's incredible work!"
:{{A|vo eqxs202 7 varesa 12.ogg}} '''Varesa:''' If you ever visit our tribe, you can bet there'd be crowds of people swarming you and begging for your autograph!
:{{A|vo eqxs202 7 minnie 16.ogg}} '''Minnie:''' I'll definitely visit one day! I... I had no idea I had fans already...
:{{A|vo eqxs202 7 xilonen 13.ogg}} '''Xilonen:''' All in good time. We can talk more about that later — for now... I think you need to stay here and get some rest.
:{{A|vo eqxs202 7 minnie 17.ogg}} '''Minnie:''' Thanks, both of you. I'll make sure to rest properly.

==Dialogue==
{{Quest Description|After some waiting, the Mystic Onmyou Chamber has finished rearranging itself. You prepare to meet up with Xinyan and enter the Chamber once more to help Shiki Taishou regain its memories...}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Wait until 08{{colon}}00 - 12{{colon}}00)
:{{A|vo eqrg002 1 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' It's been a while now, do you think the Mystic Onmyou Chamber has finished rearranging yet?
:{{A|vo eqrg002 1 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hmm, let's go meet up with Xinyan!

;(Talk to Xinyan)
:{{A|vo eqrg002 2 xinyan 01.ogg}} '''Xinyan:''' Traveler, Paimon!
:{{A|vo eqrg002 2 xinyan 02.ogg}} '''Xinyan:''' Kujou Sara has arrived. She's right over there.
:{{A|vo eqrg002 2 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What's with all the rushing back and forth? Guess she doesn't trust us after all... She sure does seem on high alert.
:{{DIcon}} She's just trying to take responsibility.
:{{A|vo eqrg002 2 xinyan 03.ogg}} '''Xinyan:''' The situation's getting complicated. Let's have a word with her first.

;(Talk to Kujou Sara)
:{{A|vo eqrg002 3 kujousara 01.ogg}} '''Kujou Sara:''' Thank you again for your help this entire time.
:{{A|vo eqrg002 3 kujousara 02.ogg}} '''Kujou Sara:''' I've brought reinforcements. It would seem that the most critical moments are behind us, so from here on out, if we can hold this path, we should be able to repel the monsters. If any do escape, we can corner them in the Araumi region.
:{{A|vo eqrg002 3 kujousara 03.ogg}} '''Kujou Sara:''' The loud noises we heard earlier were probably the result of large numbers of mechanisms... We're ready and waiting for an opportunity to storm the Domain.
:{{A|vo eqrg002 3 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Why don't you station troops closer to the Domain?
:{{A|vo eqrg002 3 kujousara 04.ogg}} '''Kujou Sara:''' In our last operation, our samurai didn't think to maintain a certain distance. When the monsters suddenly attacked, they had no choice but to beat a hasty retreat.
:{{A|vo eqrg002 3 kujousara 05.ogg}} '''Kujou Sara:''' Once is an oversight, twice would be a grave error. I won't allow such things to happen again.
:{{A|vo eqrg002 3 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, Paimon gets it now...
:{{DIcon}} (Good, that means we have an opportunity.)
:{{A|vo eqrg002 3 kujousara 06.ogg}} '''Kujou Sara:''' I will return to the Kujou Encampment and plan our defenses for the other regions.
:{{A|vo eqrg002 3 kujousara 07.ogg}} '''Kujou Sara:''' It took some time, but the Tenryou Commission has assumed full control of this area. With all my heart, I thank the three of you for your assistance. Your promised rewards are not forgotten.
:{{A|vo eqrg002 3 kujousara 08.ogg}} '''Kujou Sara:''' Miss Xinyan, please take this letter. Enclosed is a travel permit that I processed personally for you.
:{{A|vo eqrg002 3 kujousara 09.ogg}} '''Kujou Sara:''' I applied for the longest duration available. I hope you can use this time to really get to know Inazuma.
:{{A|vo eqrg002 3 kujousara 10.ogg}} '''Kujou Sara:''' I've also arranged your accommodation. Simply follow the instructions in the letter when you're back in the city.
:{{A|vo eqrg002 3 xinyan 01.ogg}} '''Xinyan:''' Oh, wow! Free boardin' and unlimited travels across Inazuma!? I don't know what to say!
:{{A|vo eqrg002 3 kujousara 11.ogg}} '''Kujou Sara:''' It's the least I can do.
:{{A|vo eqrg002 3 xinyan 02.ogg}} '''Xinyan:''' Thank you Ma'am! I know you're real busy, but if you do get a day off and I'm still here in Inazuma, please come and see one of my street performances!
:{{A|vo eqrg002 3 kujousara 12.ogg}} '''Kujou Sara:''' Haha, I must tell you that I never did develop much of a taste for songs and music... But given everything you've done for the Tenryou Commission, I will certainly attend your performance if the opportunity arises.
:{{Black Screen|Kujou Sara leaves...}}
:{{A|vo eqrg002 3 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Well, that's Xinyan's biggest worry taken care of!
:{{A|vo eqrg002 3 xinyan 03.ogg}} '''Xinyan:''' Not quite, my biggest worry is still Shiki Taishou! What comes next has nothing to do with me. As a friend, I must go back and help.
:{{A|vo eqrg002 3 xinyan 04.ogg}} '''Xinyan:''' Not to mention Red. Traveler, we gotta go back and save him, right?
:{{DIcon}} He'll probably be fine...
:{{DIcon}} ...but we can't just leave him like this.
:{{A|vo eqrg002 3 xinyan 05.ogg}} '''Xinyan:''' Then let's go! We'll need to meet up with Shiki Taishou in secret first.
----
;(Talk to Shiki Taishou)
:{{A|vo eqrg002 5 shikishogun 01.ogg}} '''Shiki Taishou:''' Xinyan, Traveler, Paimon!
:{{A|vo eqrg002 5 shikishogun 02.ogg}} '''Shiki Taishou:''' A general just passed through here, she was leading a team to investigate the area.
:{{A|vo eqrg002 5 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Her name is Kujou Sara, she's from the Tenryou Commission.
:{{A|vo eqrg002 5 shikishogun 03.ogg}} '''Shiki Taishou:''' Kujou Sara... Why haven't I heard of her?
:{{A|vo eqrg002 5 shikishogun 04.ogg}} '''Shiki Taishou:''' I think I remember hearing the name of the Supreme Commander of the Tenryou Commission once. It was a man called Kujou... something. What was it again?
:{{A|vo eqrg002 5 shikishogun 05.ogg}} '''Shiki Taishou:''' I can't remember his name, but I do remember that Harunosuke played chess with him.
:{{A|vo eqrg002 5 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Harunosuke sounds like someone important.
:{{A|vo eqrg002 5 xinyan 01.ogg}} '''Xinyan:''' Let's save the chit-chat for later, we need to sneak back into the onmyou chamber before anyone sees us.
:{{A|vo eqrg002 5 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, right! We still gotta find Childe! Let's go!
:{{A|vo eqrg002 5 shikishogun 06.ogg}} '''Shiki Taishou:''' Alright. Everyone, follow me.

;(Enter the trial)
:{{A|vo eqrg002 6 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh! Here you are!
:{{A|vo eqrg002 6 tartaglia 01.ogg}} '''Childe:''' So, is this everyone? You guys had me waiting for quite some time.
:{{A|vo eqrg002 6 tartaglia 02.ogg}} '''Childe:''' Let me tell you, you missed out on some incredible action. Quite the pity.
:{{A|vo eqrg002 6 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Tsk, look at this guy, not a scratch on him.
:{{A|vo eqrg002 6 tartaglia 03.ogg}} '''Childe:''' Hmm? Were you guys worried about me?
:{{DIcon}} No.
::{{A|vo eqrg002 6 tartaglia 04a.ogg}} '''Childe:''' Hah, you must have a lot of faith in my abilities.
:{{DIcon}} A little.
::{{A|vo eqrg002 6 tartaglia 04b.ogg}} '''Childe:''' Just a little, huh? Haha, well, if you were worried about me, I'm flattered.
:{{A|vo eqrg002 6 tartaglia 05.ogg}} '''Childe:''' As a comrade and old rival, you should know that unexpected combat situations are my bread and butter.
:{{A|vo eqrg002 6 tartaglia 06.ogg}} '''Childe:''' Anyway, when the Domain was rearranging itself, the rooms were moving up and down. The monsters were scattered all over the place! *sigh* I had so much fun fighting them these last few days.
:{{A|vo eqrg002 6 tartaglia 07.ogg}} '''Childe:''' I even came across a few replicas. They should contain more power and memories.
:{{A|vo eqrg002 6 xinyan 01.ogg}} '''Xinyan:''' Better late than never! Hurry up and fuse with them, Shiki Taishou!

;(Interact with the replicas)
:{{A|vo eqrg002 7 shikishogun 01.ogg}} '''Shiki Taishou:''' The residual power in these replicas is limited, I can only regain a fraction of my memories.
:{{A|vo eqrg002 7 tartaglia 01.ogg}} '''Childe:''' Not enough? Then I guess it's on with the plan. We need to venture deeper into the Domain.
:{{A|vo eqrg002 7 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wait... the Domain already rearranged itself. The route we discovered is useless now!
:{{A|vo eqrg002 7 shikishogun 02.ogg}} '''Shiki Taishou:''' Don't worry too much, there's a pattern to the rearrangement. I should be able to find the way.
:{{A|vo eqrg002 7 shikishogun 03.ogg}} '''Shiki Taishou:''' If I'm not mistaken, we should head in that direction.
:{{A|vo eqrg002 7 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wait a second, Paimon has a question! Shiki Taishou, didn't you just say that the power left in the replicas wasn't enough? You still don't have all your memories.
:{{A|vo eqrg002 7 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So how would you know if you were heading in the right direction?
:{{A|vo eqrg002 7 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Last time, when we followed you through that door, we were sent out of the Domain... which means not all the doors in this place are real!
:{{A|vo eqrg002 7 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What if you still can't tell the difference? We might end up somewhere super dangerous.
:{{A|vo eqrg002 7 shikishogun 04.ogg}} '''Shiki Taishou:''' I can completely understand your reservations. Unfortunately, I'm still unable to give you a compelling answer...
:{{A|vo eqrg002 7 shikishogun 05.ogg}} '''Shiki Taishou:''' Would you believe it if I said that it's an intuition I have as the overseer here?
:{{A|vo eqrg002 7 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Not... really...
:{{A|vo eqrg002 7 xinyan 01.ogg}} '''Xinyan:''' I can see why you're worried Paimon, but our only option is to trust Shiki Taishou as our guide. Otherwise, all we can do is stand here and wait.
:{{A|vo eqrg002 7 xinyan 02.ogg}} '''Xinyan:''' Besides, we'll be even more lost if the Domain rearranges itself again!
:{{A|vo eqrg002 7 tartaglia 02.ogg}} '''Childe:''' Hmm, you seem to be more anxious this time around.
:{{A|vo eqrg002 7 tartaglia 03.ogg}} '''Childe:''' Let me guess... trouble on the outside?
:{{A|vo eqrg002 7 tartaglia 04.ogg}} '''Childe:''' As far as I understand it, Inazuma's situation is still far from stable. A Domain like this would likely fall under the Tenryou Commission's jurisdiction, but they're spread too thinly at present. There's a lot that still falls outside of their control.
:{{A|vo eqrg002 7 tartaglia 05.ogg}} '''Childe:''' Which means that you guys are here as support, and it's very likely that the Tenryou Commission made the request. So, you're receiving their orders.
:{{A|vo eqrg002 7 tartaglia 06.ogg}} '''Childe:''' In that case, knowing their style, they're probably planning a lethal assault on the Domain to crush everything in their path. If we don't find Shiki Taishou's memories before that happens, then it's possible we never will.
:{{A|vo eqrg002 7 tartaglia 07.ogg}} '''Childe:''' Hence the increased anxiety... right?
:{{DIcon}} As expected, you are here to investigate Inazuma.
:{{A|vo eqrg002 7 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Is this all part of your scheme!?
:{{A|vo eqrg002 7 tartaglia 08.ogg}} '''Childe:''' It's true, there are indeed matters that I'm investigating, but it's not what you might think. We can talk about that later, let's make sure we deal with our own problems first.
:{{A|vo eqrg002 7 tartaglia 09.ogg}} '''Childe:''' Now then, Traveler, you and I are hardly strangers, and I see no reason for me to lie to you. After arriving in Inazuma, I discovered monster tracks in the surrounding areas, and so I followed them into the Domain.
:{{A|vo eqrg002 7 tartaglia 10.ogg}} '''Childe:''' It would appear that this place is some sort of combat training ground — there's nothing but fighting and slaughter to be had here. Needless to say, it's been an enjoyable experience for me! I feel quite at home.
:{{A|vo eqrg002 7 tartaglia 11.ogg}} '''Childe:''' This may come as an unpleasant surprise to Miss Xinyan and Shiki Taishou, but I'm not someone who cares for allegiance and affiliation.
:{{A|vo eqrg002 7 tartaglia 12.ogg}} '''Childe:''' Good and evil, right and wrong, duty and destiny... are these things really so important? Are they really more appealing than the euphoria of battle and close combat?
:{{A|vo eqrg002 7 xinyan 03.ogg}} '''Xinyan:''' You got fightin' in your veins, that's for sure. Well brother, what is it you're tryin' to say...?
:{{A|vo eqrg002 7 tartaglia 13.ogg}} '''Childe:''' Nothing in particular. But I am telling you that we should venture forward bravely. Don't fear the monsters that lie ahead.
:{{A|vo eqrg002 7 tartaglia 14.ogg}} '''Childe:''' If you're not up to the task, I will happily take your place in crushing all that come before us... then the burden of the slaughter will be mine and mine alone.
:{{A|vo eqrg002 7 tartaglia 15.ogg}} '''Childe:''' Because fighting... is what I'm best at.
:{{A|vo eqrg002 7 xinyan 04.ogg}} '''Xinyan:''' ...
:{{A|vo eqrg002 7 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' D—Don't look at Paimon! We're going, okay? We're going!

;(Enter the second final room on Level 1)
:{{A|vo eqrg002 8 shikishogun 01.ogg}} '''Shiki Taishou:''' "The mind of our master is righteous and broad, our enemies flee at the sound of our sword..."
:{{A|vo eqrg002 8 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Is that a song?
:{{A|vo eqrg002 8 shikishogun 02.ogg}} '''Shiki Taishou:''' It's a ballad that was once passed down by samurai through the ages. They fought alongside my replicas, and through the power of charm magic, that song is now a part of me... The emotion of that time is with me too.
:{{A|vo eqrg002 9 shikishogun 01.ogg}} '''Shiki Taishou:''' Something's coming back to me... echoes circulating. It's the emotions and voices that they left in my memory.
:{{A|vo eqrg002 9 shikishogun 02.ogg}} '''Shiki Taishou:''' Some of them were scared, some were discontent, others were eager to join the fray — yearning for battle through day and night...
:{{A|vo eqrg002 9 shikishogun 03.ogg}} '''Shiki Taishou:''' The lead samurai addressed [[Kamuna Harunosuke|Harunosuke]] as Master Kamuna. He had unyielding respect for him, and always acted on his advice.
:{{A|vo eqrg002 9 shikishogun 04.ogg}} '''Shiki Taishou:''' Strange... What was their purpose in continuing to fight here?

;(Enter the final room on Level 2)
:{{A|vo eqrg002 10 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Whew, finally, the last room. It hasn't been easy.
:{{A|vo eqrg002 10 xinyan 01.ogg}} '''Xinyan:''' Is that... Another replica!
:{{A|vo eqrg002 10 shikishogun 01.ogg}} '''Shiki Taishou:''' Traveler, quickly!

;(Interact with the replica)
:{{A|vo eqrg002 11 shikishogun 01.ogg}} '''Shiki Taishou:''' This room is very close to the deepest part of the onmyou chamber. Harunosuke and I... I remember we spent a long time here.
:{{A|vo eqrg002 11 shikishogun 02.ogg}} '''Shiki Taishou:''' We would watch martial artists from all over Inazuma. They would drink here and celebrate, shouting: "Now we too have the power to defeat the strongest monsters!"
:{{A|vo eqrg002 11 xinyan 01.ogg}} '''Xinyan:''' So, you and Kamuna Harunosuke brought samurai here to eradicate monsters?
:{{A|vo eqrg002 11 shikishogun 03.ogg}} '''Shiki Taishou:''' That is one possibility... among many.
:{{A|vo eqrg002 11 shikishogun 04.ogg}} '''Shiki Taishou:''' Perhaps it was all just a ploy by Harunosuke. Maybe recruiting those samurai and ordering them to eradicate the monsters was all in aid of regaining control of the onmyou chamber.
:{{A|vo eqrg002 11 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh, sounds a lot like something Tartaglia would say...
:{{A|vo eqrg002 11 tartaglia 01.ogg}} '''Childe:''' Hey—? I can have positive assumptions too you know!
:{{A|vo eqrg002 11 shikishogun 05.ogg}} '''Shiki Taishou:''' I'm just trying to make a logical guess. I don't mean to offend anyone.
:{{A|vo eqrg002 11 shikishogun 06.ogg}} '''Shiki Taishou:''' My memory is still incomplete, but there's less and less gaps to fill. Soon it should be fully restored.
:{{A|vo eqrg002 11 shikishogun 07.ogg}} '''Shiki Taishou:''' What's more, I sense that if we continue forward... we might just come face to face with Harunosuke himself.
:{{A|vo eqrg002 11 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' But... this onmyou chamber was built ages ago, wasn't it? Could he have been here all that time!? Whoa...
:{{DIcon}} Shiki Taishou.
:{{DIcon}} There's something I need to ask you.
:{{A|vo eqrg002 11 xinyan 02.ogg}} '''Xinyan:''' Wait — Traveler... You're not about to—
:{{DIcon}} There are things I need to say myself.
:{{A|vo eqrg002 11 shikishogun 08.ogg}} '''Shiki Taishou:''' Looking at your expressions... This must be something serious.
:{{A|vo eqrg002 11 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Uh, we don't need to get too serious though, right? It's eerie enough down here without adding more tension into the mix! Ugh, let Paimon say it.
:{{A|vo eqrg002 11 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Alright, here goes. In the very beginning, all we heard was that monsters had escaped from a Domain. We came straight here along with samurai from the Tenryou Commission.
:{{A|vo eqrg002 11 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' When we met you, you didn't know anything about the Domain or where you came from, and we believed you.
:{{A|vo eqrg002 11 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' We had our reservations, but we trusted Xinyan. She took you at your word, and we decided to work together.
:{{DIcon}} That's right.
:{{A|vo eqrg002 11 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' As we ventured deeper and deeper into the Domain, it seemed like the truth was just around the corner...
:{{A|vo eqrg002 11 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' But even now, we still can't be sure whether this Domain was created for... evil ends.
:{{A|vo eqrg002 11 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You never know what you'll find in a chest until you open it, and now we've arrived at that moment, we need to be ready for whatever it contains!
:{{DIcon}} If Kamuna has evil intentions...
:{{DIcon}} ...if he seeks to endanger Inazuma...
:{{DIcon}} ...will you still be on our side?
:{{A|vo eqrg002 11 xinyan 03.ogg}} '''Xinyan:''' ...
:{{A|vo eqrg002 11 xinyan 04.ogg}} '''Xinyan:''' I don't like seein' folks forced into a corner like this... but it's like the Traveler says. We gotta be ready to take responsibility for each other.
:{{A|vo eqrg002 11 shikishogun 09.ogg}} '''Shiki Taishou:''' I see... So the time has come for me to make a choice.
:{{A|vo eqrg002 11 shikishogun 10.ogg}} '''Shiki Taishou:''' Until now, I had my doubts about why you had decided to help me throughout all this. Even if we've only spent a few days fighting in each other's company, we should have no reason to hide anything.
:{{A|vo eqrg002 11 shikishogun 11.ogg}} '''Shiki Taishou:''' I'm afraid that barring new information, it's impossible for me to make any guarantees. I want to believe in Harunosuke, but after all these years, perhaps he's changed... Maybe my memories were never real to begin with.
:{{A|vo eqrg002 11 shikishogun 12.ogg}} '''Shiki Taishou:''' I am just a shikigami, created by an onmyouji, with nothing more than a few fragmented memories to my name. The four of you are all I have.
:{{A|vo eqrg002 11 shikishogun 13.ogg}} '''Shiki Taishou:''' Our bond is one of trust. My bond with Harunosuke... is one of responsibility.

'''''Qimen Arts and the Rite of Homa, the Spirits are Calmed and Life Restored''''' is the third part of the [[Springtime Charms]] Event.

==Steps==
# Wait until two days later
# Go to [[Yujing Terrace]]
# Go with [[Hu Tao]] to meet your friends
# Head to the next stop
# Celebrate the [[Lantern Rite Festival|Lantern Rite]]...
# Follow the rattan figure to search for Hu Tao
# Find Hu Tao as soon as possible
# Cross over to the other side, towards the next life...
# Talk to [[Paimon]]
# Take a look outside

==Gameplay Notes==
* During steps 5 and 6, the active character will be limited to the [[Traveler]].<!-- in step 5, UI will also be hidden, and Paimon will show up in the overworld -->
* During step 5, if the player leaves the area, the quest step will become "Wait for the Lantern Rite to begin..." A quest marker will appear at the Wangsheng Funeral Parlor and approaching it will resume the quest at the previous black screen text.
* During step 6:
** If the player exits the domain, they will have to complete step 5 again.<!--{{DIcon}} Wait for Lantern Rite to Begin...-->
** If the small Fetor Nodes are dispelled before the rattan figure reaches them, it will fly past without getting stuck.
* During step 8, the active character will be limited to [[Hu Tao]], and {{w|Lycoris radiata|red spider lilies}} will grow where she walks.

::{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905401_grannyruoxin_06.ogg}} '''Granny Ruoxin:''' Why yes, there is plenty left over. The Crux brings such a generous sum each time, there's no way our small village could ever use up all of it.
::{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905401_wenjing_07.ogg}} '''Wenjing:''' Oh, thank you, Captain Beidou! You can bet I never would have managed to get Ji to pay up, even if I spent my whole life trying to persuade him!
::{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905401_ji_09.ogg}} '''Ji:''' Thank you, Captain! You can bet I never would have been able to afford the compensation out of my own pocket...
::{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905401_ji_10.ogg}} '''Ji:''' I'll drive those finches away the moment I get back. I can't let them carry on ruining the neighbors' crops!
::{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905401_grannyruoxin_07.ogg}} '''Granny Ruoxin:''' Beidou, you do so much for our village, and we could never hope to repay you.
:{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905401_beidou_14.ogg}} '''Beidou:''' Granny Ruoxin, as you know, many of the boys from your fine village do sterling work for The Crux.
:{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905401_beidou_15.ogg}} '''Beidou:''' The fleet wouldn't be what it is today without them. So please, think nothing of it.
:{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905401_beidou_16.ogg}} '''Beidou:''' Ji, Wenjing, I guess you're free to go.
:{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905401_popsxing_01.ogg}} '''[[Pops Xing]]:''' Captain Beidou! Captain Beidou, you're here.
:{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905401_beidou_17.ogg}} '''Beidou:''' Pops Xing! It's been a long time. How have you been?
:{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905401_popsxing_02.ogg}} '''Pops Xing:''' *sigh* Don't get me started... I've been having some real trouble with that neighbor of mine, Ren. We keep having the same argument, and it just goes nowhere.
:{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905401_popsxing_03.ogg}} '''Pops Xing:''' I heard you were in the village, so I rushed over to seek your help.
:{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905401_beidou_18.ogg}} '''Beidou:''' What's the issue?
:{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905401_popsxing_04.ogg}} '''Pops Xing:''' Come with me, you'll see. Let's go find Ren and clear this whole thing up face to face.
{{Dialogue End}}
{{Quest Description|update|Hearing that Beidou has come to their village, Pops Xing asks her to help mediate in a disagreement. It seems that everyone here thinks very highly of her. Go see what's going on...}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Go to [[Ren]] for a little conversation)
:{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905402_ren_01.ogg}} '''[[Ren]]:''' C—Captain Beidou? You're here.
:{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905402_beidou_01.ogg}} '''Beidou:''' Heh. I heard that you and Pops Xing had a little misunderstanding. So what's up? Tell me about it.
:{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905402_popsxing_01.ogg}} '''Pops Xing:''' Ren planted a tree on his property a few years back.
:{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905402_popsxing_02.ogg}} '''Pops Xing:''' I had no issue with it at the time. It's just a tree. But a few years on, it's grown taller than the roof of my house!
:{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905402_popsxing_03.ogg}} '''Pops Xing:''' Every morning when I get up and open the window, I just want to feel the sun on my face, but I'm greeted instead by the looming shadow of my neighbor's tree. It really affects my mood.
:{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905402_popsxing_04.ogg}} '''Pops Xing:''' I asked Ren to cut it down, so I could get some sunlight back on my property.
:{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905402_popsxing_05.ogg}} '''Pops Xing:''' But he said no! Ugh! It's like he's done this on purpose just to drive me crazy...
:{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905402_ren_02.ogg}} '''Ren:''' Captain Beidou, you gotta believe me, I didn't intend to block the sunlight, but there's nothing I can do about it now.
:{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905402_ren_03.ogg}} '''Ren:''' It's not just any old tree, you see... that tree was planted there by my late father!
:{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905402_ren_04.ogg}} '''Ren:''' Not long after he planted it, he passed away, and just before he passed, he left me with some parting words.
:{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905402_ren_05.ogg}} '''Ren:''' He said our family's fortune was inauspicious, and we needed something to suppress the bad luck. That's what he planted the tree for... how can I just chop it down?
:{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905402_ren_06.ogg}} '''Ren:''' I'll be honest, I spent a few years studying in Liyue Harbor, so I don't actually share his superstitious beliefs...
:{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905402_ren_07.ogg}} '''Ren:''' But still... that doesn't change the fact that this was my father's dying wish.
:{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905402_beidou_02.ogg}} '''Beidou:''' Ok. I think I'm all clear on the situation.
:{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905402_beidou_03.ogg}} '''Beidou:''' {{Traveler}}, what are you thinking?
:{{DIcon}} I don't think it's fair for Pops Xing to suffer over this.
::{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905402_beidou_04.ogg}} '''Beidou:''' Yeah, you have a point.
::{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905402_beidou_05.ogg}} '''Beidou:''' Ren, I'm truly sorry to hear that your father passed away. But look... you can't use that as an excuse for harming other people.
::{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905402_beidou_06.ogg}} '''Beidou:''' You really should have thought about the impact that planting that tree would have on your neighbors before you went ahead with it.
::{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905402_beidou_07.ogg}} '''Beidou:''' However, this tree is special to you... I understand that, and it would be cruel to make you chop it down.
::{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905402_beidou_08.ogg}} '''Beidou:''' So how about you move the tree to somewhere where it won't block the sunlight? Somewhere else in your courtyard, or even outside it if you have to. Just as long as it stops posing a problem for Pops Xing.
::{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905402_beidou_09.ogg}} '''Beidou:''' Ren, Pops Xing — thoughts?
::{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905402_popsxing_06.ogg}} '''Pops Xing:''' Your idea works for me, Captain Beidou! Forcing Ren to cut it down was never my real goal, I just want some sunlight back. That's all I ask.
::{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905402_ren_08.ogg}} '''Ren:''' *sigh* Honestly, I already considered that. It's a nice idea, but the tree's way too big. We haven't got the manpower in the village to take on a task like that...
::{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905402_beidou_10.ogg}} '''Beidou:''' Oh, you don't need to worry about that. I'll just have my crew head down to the harbor and find you a few pairs of strong arms. Problem solved.
::{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905402_beidou_11.ogg}} '''Beidou:''' While they're at it, I'll have them find you a gardener, too. This tree is a little overdue for a manicure...
::{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905402_ren_09.ogg}} '''Ren:''' Wow, thank you so much, Captain Beidou. Now that this is resolved, it'll be such a relief to be able to put it all behind me.
::{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905402_ren_10.ogg}} '''Ren:''' On a separate note... I remember The Crux last visited the village not very long ago.
::{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905402_ren_11.ogg}} '''Ren:''' Is there some special reason why you're back in person so soon?
:{{DIcon}} I think Ren deserves some leniency.
::{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905402_beidou_12.ogg}} '''Beidou:''' Mmm, I was thinking along the same lines as you.
::{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905402_beidou_13.ogg}} '''Beidou:''' Look Pops, I'm not trying to make excuses for Ren, but just try putting yourself in his shoes for a moment.
::{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905402_beidou_14.ogg}} '''Beidou:''' Ren's desire to protect his tree isn't for money, or because he wants to hurt anyone, or for the sake of any superstition.
::{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905402_beidou_15.ogg}} '''Beidou:''' He just wants to honor his father's dying wish. Pops... you have kids, too, right?
::{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905402_popsxing_07.ogg}} '''Pops Xing:''' Yeah... when you put it like that...
::{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905402_beidou_16.ogg}} '''Beidou:''' Pops, if you can agree to it, I'll have a word with Granny Ruoxin and see about getting you some money from the relief fund, as compensation for having your sunlight blocked...
::{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905402_beidou_17.ogg}} '''Beidou:''' As for the tree...
::{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905402_popsxing_08.ogg}} '''Pops Xing:''' Uh... that sounds good to me! Whatever you think, Captain Beidou...
::{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905402_popsxing_09.ogg}} '''Pops Xing:''' The tree can stay!
::{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905402_popsxing_10.ogg}} '''Pops Xing:''' Some compensation would make me feel much better about the whole thing.
::{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905402_ren_12.ogg}} '''Ren:''' Thank you, Captain Beidou! And thank you for understanding, Pops Xing! I'll make sure to trim it back when I get home to let some more light through...
::{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905402_ren_13.ogg}} '''Ren:''' It'll be such a relief not to have to worry about this anymore.
::{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905402_ren_14.ogg}} '''Ren:''' On a separate note... I remember The Crux last visited the village not very long ago.
::{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905402_ren_15.ogg}} '''Ren:''' Is there some special reason why you're back in person so soon?
:{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905402_beidou_18.ogg}} '''Beidou:''' Haha, nothing all that special, just personal reasons. I'm looking for some treasure.
:{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905402_ren_16.ogg}} '''Ren:''' Huh? Treasure? Wait a second... that reminds me, I saw Changping and Defu arguing in the fields earlier. It sounded like they were both trying to lay claim to some treasure...
:{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905402_ren_17.ogg}} '''Ren:''' I don't know if it's related to the one you were looking for. But anyway, they're probably still there now.
:{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905402_beidou_19.ogg}} '''Beidou:''' Really? Okay, well, you and Pops Xing can go about your business now. I'll go see what the situation is.
{{Dialogue End}}
{{Quest Description|update|You hear from Ren that Changping and Defu are currently arguing over some treasure. Time to see what's happening...}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Look for Changping and Defu)
:{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905404_changping_01.ogg}} '''[[Changping]]:''' Huh? Beidou!? You're just in time. Defu is being completely unreasonable!
:{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905404_beidou_01.ogg}} '''Beidou:''' What happened?
:{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905404_defu_01.ogg}} '''[[Defu]]:''' I'm not being unreasonable, Captain. I got Changping to help me plow my land, because it's the busy season.
:{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905404_defu_02.ogg}} '''Defu:''' And then, what do you know — he plows up a treasure chest!
:{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905404_defu_03.ogg}} '''Defu:''' Way I see it, it's my land, so the treasure belongs to me. Right? I think it's a pretty clear-cut case.
:{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905404_changping_02.ogg}} '''Changping:''' You say that, Defu, but what you're forgetting is that I came to help you plow your fields out of the goodness of my heart, and you haven't paid me a single Mora.
:{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905404_changping_03.ogg}} '''Changping:''' It was also my plowing that turned up this chest. However you cut it, surely I'm entitled to at least some of the treasure?
:{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905404_beidou_02.ogg}} '''Beidou:''' Haha, the domestic drama just keeps coming today. What are your thoughts, {{Traveler}}?
:{{DIcon}} I know a legal expert. I think she is better suited to handling this kind of stuff.
:{{DIcon}} I don't have your clout. You should be the one making the call.
:{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905404_beidou_03.ogg}} '''Beidou:''' Okay. I think I'm up to speed here. If you two really want to take this further, I can get a legal expert from Liyue Harbor to adjudicate.
:{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905404_beidou_04.ogg}} '''Beidou:''' As for the costs, I'll cover them. What do you think?
:{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905404_changping_04.ogg}} '''Changping:''' Umm...
:{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905404_defu_04.ogg}} '''Defu:''' Uhh...
:{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905404_beidou_05.ogg}} '''Beidou:''' Neither of you seems thrilled about this course of action. Okay, so plan B.
:{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905404_beidou_06.ogg}} '''Beidou:''' I'll be straight with you — the reason I came here today was to look for some treasure. Chances are it's hiding right there in the chest you're both fighting over.
:{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905404_beidou_07.ogg}} '''Beidou:''' So how about you two stop fighting over it, and do me a favor by handing it to me?
:{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905404_beidou_08.ogg}} '''Beidou:''' Of course, I'll be indebted to both of you. If either of you ever needs anything in the future, The Crux will not hesitate to lend you our support.
:{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905404_defu_05.ogg}} '''Defu:''' Captain, you're far too kind, really. Indebted? That won't be necessary. If you want this chest, you go ahead and take it.
:{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905404_changping_05.ogg}} '''Changping:''' Yep, totally agree! If only I'd known you were looking for this chest...
:{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905404_changping_06.ogg}} '''Changping:''' You should've said something! I would have delivered it to you personally to save you the trip.
:{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905404_defu_06.ogg}} '''Defu:''' It seems like it's been quite a busy day for you. Helping us settle all our little quarrels...
:{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905404_defu_07.ogg}} '''Defu:''' Come on! Let's go to the village. I'll rally the masses, we'll get some good food and good drink, and have a good old get-together!
:{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905404_changping_07.ogg}} '''Changping:''' Don't worry about the chest. I'll carry it over!
{{Dialogue End}}

===Honorary Villager===
{{Quest Description|update|At your suggestion, the two of you decide to seek the treasure in Qingce Village. What will you encounter on the way?}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Wait until nighttime <nowiki>(21:00–24:00)</nowiki>)
;(Take part in the village banquet)
:{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905405_grannyruoxin_01.ogg}} '''Granny Ruoxin:''' What a fine day today has been... Beidou has solved an awful lot of problems in our village.
:{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905405_ji_01.ogg}} '''Ji:''' She sure has! Without Captain Beidou, that compensation payment would've bankrupted me.
:{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905405_ren_01.ogg}} '''Ren:''' Yeah, and if it weren't for Captain Beidou, I'd still be arguing with Pops Xing!
:{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905405_defu_01.ogg}} '''Defu:''' Hear, hear! We all have plenty to thank Captain Beidou for, I'm sure. I propose a toast in her honor!
:{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905405_changping_01.ogg}} '''Changping:''' To Captain Beidou! Cheers!
:{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905405_beidou_01.ogg}} '''Beidou:''' I couldn't ask for more than the chance to get everyone together and drink to our hearts' content. Cheers!
:{{Black Screen|After the lively celebration...}}
:{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905405_beidou_02.ogg}} '''Beidou:''' Whew! That really hit the spot. {{Traveler}}, wanna get some air? The view in this place is pretty good.
:{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905405_beidou_03.ogg}} '''Beidou:''' We can take a look through the contents of that chest while we're at it. Changping placed it by the waterwheel.
:{{DIcon}} Are you sure you haven't had too much to drink?
:{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905405_beidou_04.ogg}} '''Beidou:''' Pff! Are you kidding? Beidou can handle her liquor!
:{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905405_beidou_05.ogg}} '''Beidou:''' Come on, come on, let's go.
{{Dialogue End}}
{{Quest Description|update|After three rounds of drinks, Beidou invites you to go out to shoot the breeze — and maybe find out what's in that chest...}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Talk to Granny Ruoxin again)
:{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905406_grannyruoxin_01.ogg}} '''Granny Ruoxin:''' It's not often this village gets so lively. Make yourself at home, Traveler, help yourself to some food and drink.

;(Talk to Ji again)
:{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905406_ji_01.ogg}} '''Ji:''' It's not just me saying this, honestly — those finches are the cutest little things! So plump and fluffy... Traveler, do you want to swing by my place and see them?

;(Talk to Wenjing again)
:{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905406_wenjing_01.ogg}} '''Wenjing:''' Ji may not be the sharpest tool in the shed, but even I can't deny he's just a big softie at heart.

;(Talk to Ren again)
:{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905406_ren_01.ogg}} '''Ren:''' Why isn't Pops Xing here tonight?

;(Talk to Defu again)
:{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905406_defu_01.ogg}} '''Defu:''' Changping, come on, let me top you off!

;(Talk to Changping again)
:{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905406_changping_01.ogg}} '''Changping:''' Thanks, but no thanks... I'm getting a little light-headed...

;(Observe Cup, located on the table in front of Ren)
:'''Observe Cup:''' The crystal-clear fluid that fills this cup is a fruit juice that Beidou specially ordered for you.

;(Go to the waterwheel where the chest is)
:{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905406_beidou_01.ogg}} '''Beidou:''' So I've been thinking, everyone seems to trust me enough to let me have the final word on their disputes...
:{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905406_beidou_02.ogg}} '''Beidou:''' But don't you think some of my solutions can be a little stupid?
:{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905406_beidou_03.ogg}} '''Beidou:''' You can laugh, I don't mind. Take Changping and Defu's wrangling over that chest, for instance...
:{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905406_beidou_04.ogg}} '''Beidou:''' I had no clue who it should belong to. So I just came up with this stupid idea of taking it for myself. At least that way, neither of them would feel like it was unfair.
:{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905406_beidou_05.ogg}} '''Beidou:''' But I mean, I'm no [[Ningguang]]. I can't make a perfect deal every time.
:{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905406_beidou_06.ogg}} '''Beidou:''' And I'm no [[Yanfei]], either. Not all my judgment calls are gonna be 100% fair and square.
:{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905406_beidou_07.ogg}} '''Beidou:''' I am Beidou, and my strength is in trading favors.
:{{DIcon}} So the captain of The Crux just hands out favors to everyone all the time?
:{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905406_beidou_08.ogg}} '''Beidou:''' Haha, you think I should be more selective?
:{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905406_beidou_09.ogg}} '''Beidou:''' Some people think their favors are so valuable that they need to plan out how and when to use them to maximize the return on their investment. They view the favor as a bargaining chip.
:{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905406_beidou_10.ogg}} '''Beidou:''' Others see doing favors as a burden. Not worth anything in monetary terms, and prone to getting you locked in a cycle of constantly returning the favor back and forth.
:{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905406_beidou_11.ogg}} '''Beidou:''' But the way I see it, favors are what keep people connected to one another.
:{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905406_beidou_12.ogg}} '''Beidou:''' Over thousands of years, the people of Liyue have created bonds between each other by doing someone a favor here, and asking for a favor there.
:{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905406_beidou_13.ogg}} '''Beidou:''' This means that no individual is truly on their own out there. When someone falls down, there's an invisible net made of human connections, waiting to catch them and get them back on their feet.
:{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905406_beidou_14.ogg}} '''Beidou:''' Over the years, I have come to owe favors to a great many people, and many other people have come to owe me one.
:{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905406_beidou_15.ogg}} '''Beidou:''' These are the countless bonds between us, like so many fish in the sea. And they are the reason that The Crux and I have survived the countless hardships we've faced.
:{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905406_beidou_16.ogg}} '''Beidou:''' I believe that if there ever comes a day when the world is overrun by monsters, Liyue's legal system collapses, and the land is thrust back into an age of war...
:{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905406_beidou_17.ogg}} '''Beidou:''' It is these bonds that will see us all through the dark days ahead, until we come out on the other side.
:{{DIcon}} So the reason you asked for my help with finding the treasure today was so that you can owe me a favor?
:{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905406_beidou_18.ogg}} '''Beidou:''' I'm not saying that. But either way, we have a pretty firm bond between us already, don't you think?
:{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905406_beidou_19.ogg}} '''Beidou:''' Haha! Was this wind brewed in a winery? It's making me light-headed...
:{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905406_beidou_20.ogg}} '''Beidou:''' I feel like I'm forgetting something... something we were literally just talking about...
:{{DIcon}} If you forgot, that means it's not important.
:{{DIcon}} You did mention that treasure chest...
:{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905406_beidou_21.ogg}} '''Beidou:''' Oh, yeah! The chest! Haha... I got so immersed in our conversation that I forgot all about the main event...
:{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905406_beidou_22.ogg}} '''Beidou:''' Come on. Let's open it up and see what's inside.
:{{Black Screen|You all open the Chest and are overwhelmed by the putrid smell of years old rotten cabbage.}}
:{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905406_beidou_23.ogg}} '''Beidou:''' Hahahaha. That's it? A whole lot of nothing?
:{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905406_beidou_24.ogg}} '''Beidou:''' It's not exactly what I was looking for... but you know what, I don't care. The fun part was going on a treasure hunt with you!
:{{A|vo_bdcop001_1905406_beidou_25.ogg}} '''Beidou:''' Come on, let's get back to the party! Tonight, we go big before we go home!
{{Dialogue End}}

'''Radiant Sakura''' is the third part and final part of {{Quest|Transient Dreams}}.

==Steps==
# Go to the Grand Narukami Shrine and meet [[Yae Miko]]
# Talk to Yae Miko
# Return to the entrance to the secret realm
# Talk to Yae Miko
# Force your way into the realm
#* Enter the Quest Domain: [[End of the Oneiric Euthymia (Quest Domain)|End of the Oneiric Euthymia]]
# Speak to [[Ei]] and get up to speed with the situation
# Defeat the Raiden Shogun
#* {{Enemy|Magatsu Mitake Narukami no Mikoto|text=Magatsu Mitake Narukami no Mikoto — Raiden no Inazuma Tono}}
#* The player's party will be locked to only the Raiden Shogun permanently in her Musou Isshin state during this battle.
#* The player's Raiden Shogun cannot die<!-- at least 8 revives --> and will automatically recover to full HP whenever she reaches very low health.
# Witness the end of the long battle
# Witness the beginning of the dream
# Talk to Ei and Yae Miko

==Gameplay Notes==
* Completing this quest unlocks the trounce domain, [[End of the Oneiric Euthymia]].
* The [[Sakoku Decree]] is lifted upon completing this quest. The [[Climate]] effect [[A Nation Closed by Thunder]] is removed, allowing free access to [[Inazuma]] by water.
* During "Defeat the Raiden Shogun", Raiden Shogun (playable character) is the only character that the players can play. In the duration of the fight, the Raiden Shogun will permanently remain in her Mussou Isshin state.

:{{A|vo sglq103 5 raidenei 08.ogg}} '''Ei:''' My first thought was, "Has a great disaster befallen Inazuma?"
:{{A|vo sglq103 5 raidenei 09.ogg}} '''Ei:''' But it turned out you had come to rescue me... You came for my sake, to help me reach the best possible outcome.
:{{A|vo sglq103 5 raidenei 10.ogg}} '''Ei:''' You two have my thanks. You have done much for me, and I will never forget it.
:{{A|vo sglq103 5 yaemiko 18.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' Ei, how are you feeling now?
:{{A|vo sglq103 5 raidenei 11.ogg}} '''Ei:''' My body has fully recovered, and the Shogun's will no longer fights against me.
:{{A|vo sglq103 5 yaemiko 19.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' Always thrilled to hear you're in good health. But I was really asking about your emotions. Have you managed to calm down?
:{{A|vo sglq103 5 yaemiko 20.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' After all, you saw Makoto in there, didn't you?
:{{A|vo sglq103 5 raidenei 12.ogg}} '''Ei:''' I only heard her voice. I wouldn't say I saw her...
:{{A|vo sglq103 5 raidenei 13.ogg}} '''Ei:''' I'll be fine. It brought a few things back, of course. But I've made my decision to move forward.
:{{A|vo sglq103 5 raidenei 14.ogg}} '''Ei:''' I have to say, this has reminded me once again just how brilliant Makoto was. She predicted all the ways in which Inazuma's future could unfold all the way back then.
:{{A|vo sglq103 5 raidenei 15.ogg}} '''Ei:''' She even factored my immaturity into her plan.
:{{A|vo sglq103 5 raidenei 16.ogg}} '''Ei:''' It's all thanks to her that Inazuma lived to see this day.
:{{DIcon}} Makoto was brilliant.
:{{DIcon}} But Ei, you made a crucial contribution, too.
:{{A|vo sglq103 5 raidenei 17.ogg}} '''Ei:''' I just planted a seed.
:{{DIcon}} Your will and hers were both indispensable.
:{{A|vo sglq103 5 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yeah! It was thanks to everything you did that you got to see her again. That's amazing!
:{{DIcon}} The final act might be a simple one.
::{{DIcon}} Just because the cause and effect ended up a bit back-to-front...
::{{DIcon}} ...doesn't mean you should undervalue the part you played.
:{{DIcon}} But getting there was the result of countless efforts coming together.
::{{DIcon}} Just because the cause and effect ended up a bit back-to-front...
::{{DIcon}} ...doesn't mean you should undervalue the part you played.
:{{A|vo sglq103 5 raidenei 18.ogg}} '''Ei:''' ...Thank you, {{Traveler}}.
:{{A|vo sglq103 5 yaemiko 21.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' Today, at long last, you and Inazuma finally emerge from the shadows cast by the events of centuries past.
:{{A|vo sglq103 5 yaemiko 22.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' Makoto and you are Inazuma's past and future, and both are indispensable.
:{{A|vo sglq103 5 raidenei 19.ogg}} '''Ei:''' It's rare to hear such comforting words from you. I graciously accept them.
:{{A|vo sglq103 5 yaemiko 23.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' Oh, come on, you only think it's rare because you never used to listen to a word I say.
:{{A|vo sglq103 5 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Makoto said the exact same thing.
:{{A|vo sglq103 5 yaemiko 24.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' Great minds think alike, hmm? I wonder, does that qualify me to, maybe, take the position of Shogun for a couple of days?
:{{A|vo sglq103 5 yaemiko 25.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' Actually, no — forget that. Far more trouble than it's worth.
:{{A|vo sglq103 5 raidenei 20.ogg}} '''Ei:''' We will have to end the frivolities there. There is much work to be done.
:{{A|vo sglq103 5 raidenei 21.ogg}} '''Ei:''' The Shogun and I will closely review the Inazuma of today to find out where things currently stand. Then, we will give careful consideration to the future.
:{{A|vo sglq103 5 raidenei 22.ogg}} '''Ei:''' After that... I will abolish the [[Sakoku Decree]].
:{{A|vo sglq103 5 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Really? That's huge news!
:{{A|vo sglq103 5 raidenei 23.ogg}} '''Ei:''' I am no longer pursuing an eternity defined by stasis. In which case, there is no further need to keep the nation under lock and key.
:{{A|vo sglq103 5 raidenei 24.ogg}} '''Ei:''' I don't doubt that many challenges lie ahead for Inazuma...
:{{DIcon}} But out of those challenges will be born new opportunities.
:{{A|vo sglq103 5 raidenei 25.ogg}} '''Ei:''' I'm looking forward to it.
;(Obtain {{Item|Dream Sakura}})

----
;(Talk to Ei or Yae Miko again)
:{{A|vo sglq103 6 raidenei 01.ogg}} '''Ei:''' Many challenges still lie ahead for Inazuma, but I am prepared for them.
:{{DIcon}} About the "challenges"...
::{{A|vo sglq103 6 raidenei 02a.ogg}} '''Ei:''' Abolishing the Sakoku Decree has a myriad of implications. It would be folly to say that it will be all positive, and there will be no negative repercussions.
::{{A|vo sglq103 6 raidenei 02a 1.ogg}} '''Ei:''' For example, I can foresee the outside world posing a threat to Inazuma's businesses. These are the issues that I must work to solve.
::{{A|vo sglq103 6 yaemiko 01a.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' Ei, you're thinking about this all so conscientiously. I've only got as far as wondering whether I'll be able to sell entrance tickets to the Grand Narukami Shrine in the future.
::{{A|vo sglq103 6 raidenei 02a 2.ogg}} '''Ei:''' Honestly, Miko...
:;(Dialogue returns to option selection)
:{{DIcon}} About the gaze of the gods...
::{{A|vo sglq103 6 raidenei 02b.ogg}} '''Ei:''' Makoto's gaze was always fixed on the people of Inazuma. I always assumed it was because... that was her duty.
::{{A|vo sglq103 6 raidenei 02b 1.ogg}} '''Ei:''' But now I see that hers was a gaze full of delight and hope. It was not just a duty, but a joy, too. She loved humanity very dearly.
::{{A|vo sglq103 6 yaemiko 01b.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' If people of the past deserved the gods' attention, then so do the people of the future.
::{{A|vo sglq103 6 raidenei 02b 2.ogg}} '''Ei:''' Indeed. No longer will I ignore their passions and dreams.
:;(Dialogue returns to option selection)
:{{DIcon}} About the centuries of dueling...
::{{A|vo sglq103 6 raidenei 02c.ogg}} '''Ei:''' To put it bluntly, it was constant torture with no end in sight.
::{{A|vo sglq103 6 raidenei 02c 1.ogg}} '''Ei:''' Faced with an endless battle, I had to remain focused at all times. Had my concentration lapsed for but a moment, the Shogun's blade would have taken my life.
::{{A|vo sglq103 6 raidenei 02c 2.ogg}} '''Ei:''' Safe to say, were it not for my previous experiences in combat, my skills would not have been up to the challenge. I would most certainly have been defeated.
::{{A|vo sglq103 6 raidenei 02c 3.ogg}} '''Ei:''' And through it all, you also had your part to play.
:;(Dialogue returns to option selection)
:{{DIcon}} About the damage to the Sacred Sakura...
::{{A|vo sglq103 6 raidenei 02d.ogg}} '''Ei:''' Don't worry, I haven't forgotten. I will be sure to remind the Tenryou and Yashiro Commissions of their duties in this regard.
::{{A|vo sglq103 6 raidenei 02d 1.ogg}} '''Ei:''' It's not only the monsters that I am worried about. I'm concerned about what else might escape from the Sacred Sakura.
::{{A|vo sglq103 6 yaemiko 01d.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' That's a tough one, alright... There's plenty more besides memories held in the Ley Lines.
::{{A|vo sglq103 6 raidenei 02d 2.ogg}} '''Ei:''' Since you clearly understand, perhaps you could think about making an effort, too.
:;(Dialogue returns to option selection)
:{{DIcon}} Yae Miko said she was placing her god—
::{{A|vo sglq103 6 yaemiko 01e.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' Ahem! Yae Miko said nothing of the sort, and the Traveler has some nerve making up spurious claims about her while she is still present.
::{{A|vo sglq103 6 yaemiko 01e 1.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' Some words are not to be passed on.
::{{A|vo sglq103 6 yaemiko 01e 2.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' Trust me, you don't want to know the cost of betraying me. Just think of the things I said to you as our little secret. Understood?
::{{A|vo sglq103 6 raidenei 02e.ogg}} '''Ei:''' What are you talking about?
::{{A|vo sglq103 6 yaemiko 01e 3.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' Nothing. I suddenly want some fried tofu.
:;(Dialogue returns to option selection)
:{{DIcon}} I have no other questions.
:;(Dialogue ends)

::{{A|vo hzweq001 1 spantamadcyrus 02b 1.ogg}} '''Cyrus:''' Hah, you must be mistaken!
::{{A|vo hzweq001 1 spantamadcyrus 02b 2.ogg}} '''Cyrus:''' Unless, of course, you mean his "project collaborator." Because that is far more accurate.
::{{A|vo hzweq001 1 spantamadcyrus 02b 3.ogg}} '''Cyrus:''' Naphis, that old coot, should thank his lucky stars he has me on his team!
::{{A|vo hzweq001 1 collei 02b 1.ogg}} '''Collei:''' Which is something he'd never have the courage to say to his face...
:{{A|vo hzweq001 1 paimon 14.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Pfft...!
:{{A|vo hzweq001 1 paimon 15.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Well, Paimon's glad to see you in such good spirits, Cyrus. Must mean things are all good here in Sumeru.
:{{DIcon}} Apologies, Sir Cyrus.
:{{DIcon}} I couldn't help making a joke at your expense.
:{{A|vo hzweq001 1 spantamadcyrus 03.ogg}} '''Cyrus:''' Ah, well, it's quite alright. I'm not the type to take offense at that kind of thing, haha!

:'''Paimon:''' (You definitely are...!)
:{{DIcon}} (You definitely are...!)

:{{A|vo hzweq001 1 together 01.ogg}} '''Collei & Paimon & {{Traveler}}:''' (You definitely are...!)
:{{A|vo hzweq001 1 paimon 16.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Anyway, what were you and Collei chatting about just now?
:{{A|vo hzweq001 1 spantamadcyrus 04.ogg}} '''Cyrus:''' Ah, that... Well, it was quite a spontaneous meeting!
:{{A|vo hzweq001 1 spantamadcyrus 05.ogg}} '''Cyrus:''' I was leaving the Sage's office when I spotted Collei in conversation with a Mahamata, and it looked serious.
:{{A|vo hzweq001 1 spantamadcyrus 06.ogg}} '''Cyrus:''' I thought something bad might have happened, so I hurried over as soon as the conversation ended.
:{{A|vo hzweq001 1 spantamadcyrus 07.ogg}} '''Cyrus:''' But, as it turns out, our Collei is moving up in the world. The Akademiya even hired her as a consultant!
:{{A|vo hzweq001 1 paimon 17.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wow! That's incredible!
:{{A|vo hzweq001 1 collei 03.ogg}} '''Collei:''' Oh... It's nothing, really...
:{{A|vo hzweq001 1 spantamadcyrus 08.ogg}} '''Cyrus:''' Look at that! So humble. Takes after me, she does!
:{{A|vo hzweq001 1 collei 04.ogg}} '''Collei:''' Not at all, not at all... No, wait! I didn't mean that to sound like I don't think you're humble, Mr. Cyrus, because of course you are, I just... uh...
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (Uh oh, Collei's so nervous she's sweating. I should help her out...)
:{{DIcon}} Anyway, what are you a consultant for, exactly?
:{{A|vo hzweq001 1 collei 05.ogg}} '''Collei:''' Oh, well, I wouldn't even call myself a consultant. I'm just helping out...
:{{A|vo hzweq001 1 collei 06.ogg}} '''Collei:''' Now that the new semester has started, a lot of students and scholars are doing field work for their research.
:{{A|vo hzweq001 1 collei 07.ogg}} '''Collei:''' But, it can be dangerous for those who don't have a lot of experience in the wilds.
:{{A|vo hzweq001 1 collei 08.ogg}} '''Collei:''' So, the Akademiya is planning to establish an agency that provides guidance on outdoor survival and rescue for people who need it.
:{{A|vo hzweq001 1 paimon 18.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ooh, Paimon gets it!
:{{A|vo hzweq001 1 paimon 19.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So, you're here to explain rainforest survival as a representative of the Forest Rangers!
:{{A|vo hzweq001 1 collei 09.ogg}} '''Collei:''' Yeah, pretty much.
:{{A|vo hzweq001 1 collei 10.ogg}} '''Collei:''' Of course, when it comes to tips on deciphering mechanisms or defeating monsters, that's for people who are far more senior than me to handle.
:{{A|vo hzweq001 1 collei 11.ogg}} '''Collei:''' Ah, and speaking of which... Since we're short on manpower, the person in charge at the Akademiya said we're still accepting newcomers.
:{{A|vo hzweq001 1 collei 12.ogg}} '''Collei:''' If you're interested, you're welcome to join and share your insights.
:{{A|vo hzweq001 1 spantamadcyrus 09.ogg}} '''Cyrus:''' Ah, seizing the moment. Well done, Collei! Recruiting someone as capable as {{Traveler}} is a great idea!
:{{A|vo hzweq001 1 spantamadcyrus 10.ogg}} '''Cyrus:''' Oh, and just between the four of us... The Akademiya has set aside a generous amount of funding for this project.
:{{A|vo hzweq001 1 paimon 20.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' *gasp*
:{{A|vo hzweq001 1 paimon 21.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ahem! Well, since Collei's thrown her hat in the ring, we should help out too! Whaddaya say, {{Traveler}}?
:{{DIcon}} Well, as we all know, I'm nothing if not helpful.
:{{A|vo hzweq001 1 collei 13.ogg}} '''Collei:''' Great!
:{{A|vo hzweq001 1 collei 14.ogg}} '''Collei:''' We're all supposed to meet up in Aaru Village later, so I guess we'll regroup there!
:{{A|vo hzweq001 1 collei 15.ogg}} '''Collei:''' Phew... I was kinda worried, since Master Tighnari isn't around to help this time. But, now I feel much better...
:{{DIcon}} Have faith. You don't need anyone's help to do a great job.
:{{A|vo hzweq001 1 paimon 22.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yeah! Even if you don't trust the Akademiya's eye for talent, you can trust ours for sure!
:{{A|vo hzweq001 1 spantamadcyrus 11.ogg}} '''Cyrus:''' And mine, of course! I have as good an eye for people as I do for tomatoes!
:{{A|vo hzweq001 1 paimon 23.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Well, there you have it!
:{{A|vo hzweq001 1 collei 16.ogg}} '''Collei:''' Hehe... Thanks, everyone...
:{{A|vo hzweq001 1 paimon 24.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, speaking of Tighnari, how are things with him and the others?
:{{A|vo hzweq001 1 collei 17.ogg}} '''Collei:''' Good, thanks! All the Forest Rangers are doing great.
:{{A|vo hzweq001 1 collei 18.ogg}} '''Collei:''' Oh, but Master Tighnari did mention that Cyno and Sethos were heading to Gandharva Ville... I'm not sure if it's for work or something else...
:{{A|vo hzweq001 1 paimon 25.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh, knowing them... Could just be to play some [[Genius Invokation TCG|cards]]...
:{{A|vo hzweq001 1 collei 19.ogg}} '''Collei:''' Hmm... I'm not sure. Apparently, Sethos is bringing someone else with him too.
:{{A|vo hzweq001 1 collei 20.ogg}} '''Collei:''' But, with my Akademiya commitment, I didn't have time to ask for more details...
:{{A|vo hzweq001 1 paimon 26.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh, well now Paimon's curious. Should we go check things out, {{Traveler}}?
:{{DIcon}} Why not? It's been a while since we've dropped in to say hi.
:{{A|vo hzweq001 1 collei 21.ogg}} '''Collei:''' That's true, and I'm sure they've missed you.
:{{A|vo hzweq001 1 spantamadcyrus 12.ogg}} '''Cyrus:''' Now, that is how it should be between friends, getting together to play cards or enjoy a meal. Yet, here I am, stuck with Naphis who only ever calls to talk about research...
:{{A|vo hzweq001 1 spantamadcyrus 13.ogg}} '''Cyrus:''' Well, I won't delay your reunion any longer. Until next time!
:{{A|vo hzweq001 1 collei 22.ogg}} '''Collei:''' Goodbye, Mr. Cyrus. Take care!
:{{A|vo hzweq001 1 collei 23.ogg}} '''Collei:''' Alright, I should probably get going too.
:{{A|vo hzweq001 1 collei 24.ogg}} '''Collei:''' See you later, guys! Come find me in Aaru Village when you're ready!
:{{DIcon}} Sure thing.
:{{A|vo hzweq001 1 paimon 27.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hehe. Looking forward to seeing you shine, Collei!
:;(Event menu opens)
