;(Use [[Nahida]]'s [[All Schemes to Know]] on Sethos, optional)<!--seems to be only available via co-op-->{{Verify|Is this line first available here?}}
:{{A|vo hzweq001 4 sethos 01.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' (It's been a while since I've been in the rainforest. The humidity is a nice change of pace.)

;(Approach Tighnari's hut in Gandharva Ville)
:{{A|vo hzweq001 2 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Tighnari's place... Tighnari's place... Ah, here it is!
:{{A|vo hzweq001 2 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Cyno, Sethos! Looks like the whole gang's here! ...Oh, and Layla's here too!
:{{A|vo hzweq001 2 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' But, oh... She doesn't look too good. Did something happen?
:{{DIcon}} Hi everyone, it's been a while.
:{{DIcon}} Is everything okay here...?
:{{A|vo hzweq001 2 tighnari 01.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Ah, Paimon, {{Traveler}}. It's good to see you.
:{{Introductory Note|Tighnari}}
:{{A|vo hzweq001 2 tighnari 02.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' I'd welcome you like a proper host, but I'm a bit busy at the moment. Apologies.
:{{DIcon}} No worries. This seems serious.
:{{A|vo hzweq001 2 tighnari 03.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Ah, no need to look that worried.
:{{A|vo hzweq001 2 tighnari 04.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' My observations indicate Miss Layla's condition has improved quite a bit.
:{{A|vo hzweq001 2 tighnari 05.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' There's no danger to her mind. She's just fatigued and needs some rest.
:{{A|vo hzweq001 2 tighnari 06.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Excuse me for a moment while I blend some calming incense. I'll let you two explain the situation.
:{{A|vo hzweq001 2 cyno 01.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Alright.
:{{Introductory Note|Cyno}}
:{{A|vo hzweq001 2 cyno 02.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' What happened was, Sethos and a few members of the Temple of Silence rescued Layla, who was out in the desert trapped in a state of delirium.
:{{A|vo hzweq001 2 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' She had to be "rescued"? That sounds bad...
:{{A|vo hzweq001 2 sethos 01.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' That's all you're gonna say about it, Cyno? I mean, we don't want people jumping to conclusions.
:{{Introductory Note|Sethos}}
:{{A|vo hzweq001 2 cyno 03.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' That's all I can say about it. The person involved is unable to explain what happened to her, so we're limited in what we know.
:{{A|vo hzweq001 2 layla 01.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Ugh... Sorry. My head... still dizzy...
:{{A|vo hzweq001 2 layla 02.ogg}} '''Layla:''' The moons... The moons... Exactly how many are there...
:{{Introductory Note|Layla}}
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (The moons!?)
:{{A|vo hzweq001 2 cyno 04.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' She's been repeating that phrase over and over again, but she can't seem to remember what happened to her.
:{{A|vo hzweq001 2 sethos 02.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' We tried a few things back at the Temple of Silence, but we couldn't recover her memories.
:{{A|vo hzweq001 2 sethos 03.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' Her symptoms are kind of similar to researchers in the [[Satyavada Life]] state, so we brought her to Tighnari to see if our veteran Forest Watcher had any other ideas.
:{{A|vo hzweq001 2 cyno 05.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Tighnari is pretty much our last option, so let's hope he can help.
:{{A|vo hzweq001 2 sethos 04.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' The good news is, even if restoring her memory is a no go, we can help with the headache at least. Djer was in a similar state when we found him, delirious and mumbling to himself, but he's more or less back to normal now.
:{{A|vo hzweq001 2 sethos 05.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' Ah, sorry. I should give you some context first, huh...
:{{A|vo hzweq001 2 sethos 06.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' We should let Miss Layla get some rest. Come with me, you two, and I'll introduce you to the other "victim" of this incident.
:{{A|vo hzweq001 2 cyno 06.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Good idea. I'll wait for Tighnari here and keep an eye on our patient.
:{{A|vo hzweq001 2 sethos 07.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' Alright, then! This way.

;(Talk to Cyno, optional)
:{{A|vo dialog hzweq001 cyno 01.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Something strange is going on...

;(Use Nahida's All Schemes to Know on Cyno, optional)
:{{A|vo hzweq001 4 cyno 01.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' (I'll have to tell Master about this when I get back.)

;(Talk to Layla, optional)
:{{A|vo dialog hzweq001 layla 01.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Ugh...

;(Use Nahida's All Schemes to Know on Layla, optional)
:{{A|vo hzweq001 6 layla 01.ogg}} '''Layla:''' (How many moons are there in the sky?)

;(Use Nahida's All Schemes to Know on Djer, optional)
:{{A|vo hzweq001 7 djer 01.ogg}} '''Djer:''' (Who did the Ajilenakh Nut offend...)

;(Approach Djer)
:{{A|vo hzweq001 8 djer 01.ogg}} '''Djer:''' *sigh* Who did the Ajilenakh Nut offend... I just don't get it...
:{{A|vo hzweq001 8 sethos 01.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' Hey, Djer! Still musing about Ajilenakh Nuts, huh? Want me to have Cyno come over and tell some jokes? Might help distract you!
:{{A|vo hzweq001 8 djer 02.ogg}} '''Djer:''' NO! No need. I'm done.
:{{DIcon}} I like jokes.
::{{A|vo hzweq001 8 djer 03a 1.ogg}} '''Djer:''' Don't encourage him!
::{{A|vo hzweq001 8 sethos 02a 1.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' Well, sorry for interrupting the Ajilenakh talk, buddy. Next time, just say... "Ah, gee. Hey! Knock!"
::{{A|vo hzweq001 8 djer 03a 2.ogg}} '''Djer:''' Agh!
:{{DIcon}} Yeah, that's one nutty idea that's not all it's... cracked up to be.
::{{A|vo hzweq001 8 djer 03b 1.ogg}} '''Djer:''' Oh, dear... another master of puns?
::{{A|vo hzweq001 8 sethos 02b 1.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' One of Cyno's card buddies, actually.
::{{A|vo hzweq001 8 djer 03b 2.ogg}} '''Djer:''' Ah, I think I might just take that as my cue to head back to the desert...
:{{A|vo hzweq001 8 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hold on, hold on. So, what's the deal with the Ajilenakh Nuts? Other than the bad Cyno jokes...
:{{A|vo hzweq001 8 sethos 03.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' Hahaha, we'll get to that. But first, introductions are in order! This is Djer — a member of the Temple of Silence.
:{{A|vo hzweq001 8 sethos 04.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' And you remember {{Traveler}}, right, Djer?
:{{A|vo hzweq001 8 djer 04.ogg}} '''Djer:''' Of course. I'd never forget a participant in the Rite of Duels or the hero who saved Sumeru.
:{{A|vo hzweq001 8 sethos 05.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' Awesome. Could you go over what happened to you one more time, Djer? Our valiant hero is gonna help us get to the bottom of this.
:{{DIcon}} Huh? I am?
:{{A|vo hzweq001 8 sethos 06.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' Might as well join since you're here, am I right?
:{{A|vo hzweq001 8 sethos 07.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' Just hear him out. You're gonna want to uncover this mystery once you do — I'd bet on it.
:{{A|vo hzweq001 8 djer 05.ogg}} '''Djer:''' Well, I was on an expedition in the desert not too long ago when I got caught in some quicksand.
:{{A|vo hzweq001 8 djer 06.ogg}} '''Djer:''' Later, it became obvious it wasn't normal quicksand, because instead of sinking to my death, I fell into an undiscovered ruin.
:{{A|vo hzweq001 8 djer 07.ogg}} '''Djer:''' In my panic, arms and legs flailing about, I suspect I touched some things I shouldn't have...
:{{A|vo hzweq001 8 djer 08.ogg}} '''Djer:''' ...Because in that brief moment, an enormous amount of information came surging into my mind.
:{{A|vo hzweq001 8 djer 09.ogg}} '''Djer:''' I would hesitate to even call it knowledge because my brain had no capacity to process the information.
:{{A|vo hzweq001 8 djer 10.ogg}} '''Djer:''' To use an analogy, it would be like... Trying to stuff thousands of Ajilenakh Nuts into a small water skin without it bursting.
:{{A|vo hzweq001 8 djer 11.ogg}} '''Djer:''' Sorry, sorry. Again with the Ajilenakh Nuts, I know..
:{{A|vo hzweq001 8 sethos 08.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' It's fine. We're getting to that part of the story, anyway.
:{{A|vo hzweq001 8 djer 12.ogg}} '''Djer:''' *sigh* True.
:{{A|vo hzweq001 8 djer 13.ogg}} '''Djer:''' Well, just as I was on the verge of madness, a single phrase broke through the storm of thoughts in my head...
:{{A|vo hzweq001 8 djer 14.ogg}} '''Djer:''' It was a man's voice saying, "don't eat Ajilenakh Nuts."
:{{A|vo hzweq001 8 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What?
:{{DIcon}} Uh...
:{{A|vo hzweq001 8 djer 15.ogg}} '''Djer:''' I know it's hard to believe, but that's what happened. I was saved by the phrase "don't eat Ajilenakh Nuts."
:{{DIcon}} You mentioned a man's voice...
:{{DIcon}} Do you know who it was?
:{{A|vo hzweq001 8 djer 16.ogg}} '''Djer:''' I'm not sure.
:{{A|vo hzweq001 8 djer 17.ogg}} '''Djer:''' I'm not even certain it was a man's voice... It's hard to remember now that I've been repeating it so much myself.
:{{A|vo hzweq001 8 djer 18.ogg}} '''Djer:''' Anyway, the good news is, I no longer feel like my head is going to explode.
:{{A|vo hzweq001 8 djer 19.ogg}} '''Djer:''' Of course, the bad news is, that phrase has been stuck in my head for the past few days.
:{{A|vo hzweq001 8 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wow, but doesn't that have the opposite effect? Like, the more you say "don't eat it," the more you want to eat it...
:{{A|vo hzweq001 8 djer 20.ogg}} '''Djer:''' Yes, that's exactly right!
:{{A|vo hzweq001 8 djer 21.ogg}} '''Djer:''' Whoever the voice belongs to, I don't know what his deal is with those nuts...
:{{A|vo hzweq001 8 sethos 09.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' Well, the world's a big place. There's bound to be people who don't like sweet stuff.
:{{A|vo hzweq001 8 djer 22.ogg}} '''Djer:''' I suppose. Strangely enough... I'm starting to think the voice belonged not to a man, but a cat.
:{{A|vo hzweq001 8 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' A cat? How?
:{{A|vo hzweq001 8 djer 23.ogg}} '''Djer:''' That's the question, isn't it. What would a cat be doing in an abandoned ruin like that?
:{{A|vo hzweq001 8 djer 24.ogg}} '''Djer:''' Just as my mind was reaching its breaking point, I could've sworn I heard the sound of a cat guiding me to exit.
:{{A|vo hzweq001 8 djer 25.ogg}} '''Djer:''' But when I came to, all I saw was endless desert, and Sethos shaking me in a desperate attempt to wake me up.
:{{A|vo hzweq001 8 sethos 10.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' I'll admit, it was pretty terrifying, seeing you like that — staring off into space and mumbling about Ajilenakh Nuts... Heh.
:{{A|vo hzweq001 8 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You sure don't sound terrified!
:{{A|vo hzweq001 8 sethos 11.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' Sorry, sorry, sorry. It's not that I don't care. It's just... kind of hard for rambling about Ajilenakh Nuts to sound menacing.
:{{A|vo hzweq001 8 sethos 12.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' Now, what Layla was saying, on the other hand... That is much creepier.
:{{DIcon}} You mean about the number of moons?
:{{A|vo hzweq001 8 sethos 13.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' Exactly. The unknown is what breeds fear. Ajilenakh Nuts are familiar, but the moon suspended above us at night... That's about as foreign as it gets.
:{{A|vo hzweq001 8 djer 26.ogg}} '''Djer:''' W—We don't know that for sure! There could be a whole other world inside an Ajilenakh Nut, with a moon of its own!
:{{A|vo hzweq001 8 sethos 14.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' Huh... I guess.
:{{A|vo hzweq001 8 djer 27.ogg}} '''Djer:''' Ajilenakh Nuts are not to be underestimated...
:{{A|vo hzweq001 8 sethos 15.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' Right, yeah! Of course! Won't catch me disparaging the mighty Ajilenakh Nut. No sir...
:{{A|vo hzweq001 8 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh, so a similar thing happened to Layla, then?
:{{A|vo hzweq001 8 sethos 16.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' Yeah, I think so.
:{{A|vo hzweq001 8 sethos 17.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' I was in a hurry to rescue Djer, so I put a marker on the incident site so we could go back and investigate.
:{{A|vo hzweq001 8 sethos 18.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' When his condition stabilized, we doubled back around to check, and—
:{{DIcon}} You discovered Layla in a similar condition.
:{{A|vo hzweq001 8 sethos 19.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' Exactly.
:{{A|vo hzweq001 8 sethos 20.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' Multiple victims with the same symptoms at the same location... It wasn't hard to conclude that something is seriously wrong with that place.
:{{A|vo hzweq001 8 sethos 21.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' So, after we got Layla out of there, I had the Temple of Silence put up a warning sign at the scene and send patrols to watch the area.
:{{A|vo hzweq001 8 sethos 22.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' Speaking of, Cyno, Tighnari, and I are going to head back there and investigate once Layla is stable... So, as per usual, you're here just in time!
:{{DIcon}} Yeah, it sounds like you need all the help you can get.
:{{A|vo hzweq001 8 sethos 23.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' That's for sure. But, there's another reason I want Cyno and Tighnari involved in this.
:{{A|vo hzweq001 8 sethos 24.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' Because the story doesn't end there. Right, Djer?
:{{A|vo hzweq001 8 djer 28.ogg}} '''Djer:''' Hm... Oh, yes. Where was I? The Ajilenakh Nuts butted in and I... Right. Yes. The cat.
:{{A|vo hzweq001 8 djer 29.ogg}} '''Djer:''' As I followed the cat noises, the voice said something else: "So, there are those from Tulaytullah who still endure..."
:{{A|vo hzweq001 8 djer 30.ogg}} '''Djer:''' I thought that was strange, of course, because well... Was the voice referring to me?
:{{A|vo hzweq001 8 djer 31.ogg}} '''Djer:''' Haha, records of my ancestry are rather sparse, so I'm not sure if my bloodline even traces back to that place.
:{{DIcon}} Tulaytullah...
:{{A|vo hzweq001 8 sethos 25.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' That's right. The Temple of Silence's place of origin.
:{{A|vo hzweq001 8 sethos 26.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' And the home of Tighnari's people. Plus, Hermanubis, who Cyno and I both share a connection to, was one of the city's founders.
:{{A|vo hzweq001 8 sethos 27.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' As the Temple's current leader, if something strange happens in the desert, it's my job to get to the bottom of it.
:{{A|vo hzweq001 8 sethos 28.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' But, it turns out, a lot of people have a horse in this race, and I'm not leaving any of them out.
:{{DIcon}} Good idea.
:{{DIcon}} Count me in, too.
:{{A|vo hzweq001 8 sethos 29.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' See? Knew you'd join.
:{{A|vo hzweq001 8 sethos 30.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' But yeah, that's all we know about Djer's situation.
:{{A|vo hzweq001 8 sethos 31.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' Tighnari should be done on his end. Let's head back and check on Miss Layla.

;(Talk to Djer, optional)
:{{A|vo dialog hzweq001 djer 01.ogg}} '''Djer:''' There are records in the Temple of Silence that speak of the ancient desert peoples' love of raising cats. Perhaps I encountered some ancestral cat spirit, long since passed on?

:{{A|vo hzweq001 10 djer 01.ogg}} '''Djer:''' (The more I mention Ajilenakh Nuts, the more I want some...)

;(Use Nahida's All Schemes to Know on Tighnari, optional)
:{{A|vo hzweq001 11 tighnari 01.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' (Huh, I've never seen these symptoms before...)

:{{A|vo hzweq001 12 layla 01.ogg}} '''Layla:''' (*sigh* I've caused so much trouble for everyone...)

;(Use Nahida's All Schemes to Know on Cyno, optional)
:{{A|vo hzweq001 4 cyno 01.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' (I'll have to tell Master about this when I get back.)

;(Talk to Layla, Cyno, or Tighnari)
:{{A|vo hzweq001 13 tighnari 01.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' How are you feeling? Ah, but don't speak if it's too taxing.

:{{A|vo hzweq001 25 layla 15.ogg}} '''Layla:''' No, I don't... have anything to hide. It's just... complicated, so explaining might take time...
:{{A|vo hzweq001 25 kaveh 13.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Ah, well, lucky for us... I've got that in spades.
:{{A|vo hzweq001 25 alhaitham 05.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' Yes. You have been quite... sedentary recently.
:{{A|vo hzweq001 25 kaveh 14.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Excuse me? I've been going about work as normal, thank you. And — might I add — you do way less work than me!
:{{A|vo hzweq001 25 alhaitham 06.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' I do the amount of work that is required of me.
:{{A|vo hzweq001 25 kaveh 15.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Ah, yes. You and your stellar work ethic. The stuff of legends...
:'''Mehrak:''' Beep-boop?
:{{A|vo hzweq001 25 kaveh 16.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Ugh, now look what you've done — I've lost my train of thought. Where were we...
:{{A|vo hzweq001 25 alhaitham 07.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' The problem in the desert.
:{{A|vo hzweq001 25 kaveh 17.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Wait, you were listening earlier?
:{{A|vo hzweq001 25 alhaitham 08.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' ...
:{{A|vo hzweq001 25 kaveh 18.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Oh, we're giving the silent treatment, now? Mature! Very mature!
:{{A|vo hzweq001 25 alhaitham 09.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' Continue, Miss Layla. I'm curious as to how this incident unfolded.
:{{A|vo hzweq001 25 kaveh 19.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' What did I tell you? This one doesn't have enough to do.
:{{A|vo hzweq001 25 layla 16.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Alright, well...
:{{Black Screen|You explain what happened. Of course, you leave out the part about the other Layla.<br><!--appends to previous
-->Hearing the word "quicksand," Kaveh begins to look troubled...}}
:{{A|vo hzweq001 25 kaveh 20.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Could you still use some extra hands on this investigation team of yours?
:{{A|vo hzweq001 25 layla 17.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Huh? You want to join, Mr. Kaveh?
:{{A|vo hzweq001 25 kaveh 21.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' That's right. I think my experience studying desert mausoleums could be of some use here. Alhaitham's expertise in ancient languages could be helpful, too.
:{{A|vo hzweq001 25 kaveh 22.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Besides, I consider you all to be my friends... and friends are supposed to help each other out!
:{{A|vo hzweq001 25 alhaitham 10.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' Wait, I'm involved in this now?
:{{A|vo hzweq001 25 kaveh 23.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Oh please, I know you. Half the battle was over the minute you said you were "curious." We couldn't stop you from joining if we tried.
:{{A|vo hzweq001 25 alhaitham 11.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' Well, you've got me there. Besides...
:'''Mehrak:''' Beep-boop! Beep-boop!
:{{A|vo hzweq001 25 alhaitham 12.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' This suitcase of yours has been jumping at the chance to volunteer for a while now.
:{{A|vo hzweq001 25 alhaitham 13.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' Hm, I imagine...
:{{A|vo hzweq001 25 kaveh 24.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' You imagine...?
:{{A|vo hzweq001 25 alhaitham 14.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' ...Mechanical life forms might also feel homesick from time to time.
:{{A|vo hzweq001 25 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh...
:{{A|vo hzweq001 25 kaveh 25.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Huh, now that you mention it, Mehrak's core was a component sourced from the desert...
:{{A|vo hzweq001 25 alhaitham 15.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' That could prove useful.
:{{A|vo hzweq001 25 layla 18.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Y—You're sure you want to come with us? It could be dangerous...
:{{A|vo hzweq001 25 kaveh 26.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Oh, I'm sure. All the more reason to recruit as much help as possible. It's important to count on friends at times like these.
:{{DIcon}} We appreciate the help.
:{{A|vo hzweq001 25 kaveh 27.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Our pleasure.
:{{A|vo hzweq001 25 kaveh 28.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' It's a plan, then!
:{{Black Screen|You give Kaveh and Alhaitham the directions Sethos provided.<br><!--appends to previous
-->You all chat for a while longer, and Layla's spirits are lifted.}}
:{{A|vo hzweq001 25 kaveh 29.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Alright, we'll head back to our place to get ready.
:{{A|vo hzweq001 25 kaveh 30.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' This one hasn't been on a trip in a while. Chances are, he doesn't even remember how to pack a suitcase.
:{{A|vo hzweq001 25 alhaitham 16.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' I'm not worried. It'll get done... somehow.
:{{A|vo hzweq001 25 kaveh 31.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Would it kill you to help every once in a while?
:{{A|vo hzweq001 25 alhaitham 17.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' I do help. It's called moral support.
:{{A|vo hzweq001 25 kaveh 32.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Oh, of course! And I am ever so grateful...
:{{A|vo hzweq001 25 alhaitham 18.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' Goodbye, you three.
:{{A|vo hzweq001 25 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' We'll see you soon!
:{{A|vo hzweq001 25 paimon 12.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, and Kaveh, your coffee beans... You were too busy glaring at Alhaitham, you almost forgot them.
:'''Mehrak:''' Beep-boop~! Beep-boop~!
:{{A|vo hzweq001 25 layla 19.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Well, we're pretty close to the Akademiya now. I should be fine from here.
:{{A|vo hzweq001 25 layla 20.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Thanks for the coffee, Paimon. I feel much better now!

==Gameplay Notes==
* During steps 2–6, the player will be transported to a domain version of Hotel Debord and enter [[Special Story Mode]]. Leaving this mode will reset the quest progress to step 2.
* During steps 4–5, the active party will be limited to a trial Escoffier.
* During step 4:
** Fruity Flavoring is obtained by cutting fruit, while Floral Flavoring is obtained from the food processor.
** The timer will continuously increase, but there are no consequences.
** There is no limit to the number of flavoring servings that the player can obtain, but only the last 6 will be accessible while adding flavorings.

:{{A|vo akflq002 6 monica 16.ogg}} '''Monica:''' So many times, I've seen her make the cake base over and over again, late into the night, determined to match Escoffier's version. But something's always slightly off every time...

:{{A|vo akflq002 6 escoffier 21.ogg}} '''Escoffier:''' ...Every year, they migrate long distances in search of a suitable home. There's always one goose at the front, whose job is to lead the flock...
:{{A|vo akflq002 6 escoffier 22.ogg}} '''Escoffier:''' Fontaine poets often use the image of that goose to explore the ideas about leadership and genius. They usually imagine someone who's a cut above the rest, a model of perfection...
:{{A|vo akflq002 6 escoffier 23.ogg}} '''Escoffier:''' But what those poets don't know is that during a migration, the lead goose is always changing.
:{{A|vo akflq002 6 escoffier 24.ogg}} '''Escoffier:''' Once the lead goose shows signs of fatigue, it retreats to the back of the flock, and allows another goose to take its place.
:{{A|vo akflq002 6 escoffier 25.ogg}} '''Escoffier:''' So the truth is that leadership, with all the responsibilities and pressures that come with it — it's something that everyone takes turns at. But we humans completely miss that fact when we project our own ideas about social hierarchies onto them.
:{{DIcon}} Is this about... you and Savanna?
:{{A|vo akflq002 6 escoffier 26.ogg}} '''Escoffier:''' Heh... I guess what I'm saying is, I don't buy into this notion that there's some sort of gulf between "normal" and "genius."

:{{A|vo akflq002 6 escoffier 28.ogg}} '''Escoffier:''' Of course, some people have a more sensitive palate than others, and some people are just born bolder or more conscientious... But these are all variables that can be accounted for with time and practice.
:{{A|vo akflq002 6 escoffier 29.ogg}} '''Escoffier:''' I'd have no reason to expect so much from others if I believed that perfection can only come from the hands of a genius. The only reason I hold people to high standards is because... well, I believe they're capable of greatness.
:{{DIcon}} I don't know if you're right...
:{{DIcon}} But I think that's a great thing to believe in.
:{{A|vo akflq002 6 escoffier 30.ogg}} '''Escoffier:''' Hmm... Okay, I've made up my mind. {{Traveler}}, I'm gonna get to the bottom of why Savanna failed.
:{{A|vo akflq002 6 escoffier 31.ogg}} '''Escoffier:''' And come tomorrow, I'll give her the scolding of her life, pointing out all the mistakes she's made along the way. Then she'll finally see the error of her ways!

==Steps==

:{{A|vo dpeq002 10 kazuha 03.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' Did he happen to say anything after he got the card back?
:{{A|vo dpeq002 10 chongyun 06.ogg}} '''Chongyun:''' Not a lot. He seemed to be in a hurry — he just packed up his things and then left for the docks. Hmm... but I did hear him grumbling about how far away Inazuma is, and how he wasn't looking forward to the boat journey.

==Gameplay Notes==
* The performance during the battle has no impact on the story, but in order to get the "good performance" dialogue branch, a certain objective must be completed depending on the option selected. A dialogue line from Kokomi will be heard during the battle if the objective was fulfilled. Kokomi will say nothing during the battle and the player will receive the "poor performance" branch otherwise.
** If '''Surprise air raid''' was selected, then kill the Fatui Pyro Agent first.
** If '''Gunpowder plot''' was selected, then detonate the [[Exploding Barrel]]s before alerting or killing any enemies.
** If '''Let's spark things up a little''' was selected, then inflict enemies with [[Electro-Charged]] reaction.
* The player's party cannot be changed after selecting an option.
* If the player leaves a certain radius from the Fatui camp, Kokomi will be removed from the party. She will automatically rejoin once the player returns to the quest area.

==Dialogue==
{{Quest Description|Peace talks between [[Watatsumi Island]] and the [[Tenryou Commission]] are due to commence, but a rumor that the Tenryou Commission remains in cahoots with the [[Fatui]] is still circulating around the island. To uncover the truth, Kokomi decides to assault the Fatui's temporary encampment...}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Go to the temporary Fatui camp)
:{{A|vo xhlq002 1 kokomi 01.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' This must be the Fatui camp that the merchant was talking about.
:{{A|vo xhlq002 1 kokomi 02.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' From the looks of it, it used to be a hilichurl camp. Who knows why the Fatui occupied it.
:{{A|vo xhlq002 1 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Uhh... looks pretty heavily guarded, how are we supposed to get in?
:{{A|vo xhlq002 1 kokomi 03.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' Not by brute force, that's for sure. But that's not a problem. The terrain here gives us an advantage, and we haven't given away our position so far.
:{{A|vo xhlq002 1 kokomi 04.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' Our enemy is in the light, while we are in the shadows. Strategically, we have the upper hand.
:{{DIcon}} And what does the grand strategist have in mind?
:{{A|vo xhlq002 1 kokomi 05.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' Hmm... I think we have three options available.
:{{A|vo xhlq002 1 kokomi 06.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' Option 1: Take the king and it's checkmate. The Fatui's presence in Inazuma is weak at present. Nothing more than a few scattered remnants.
:{{A|vo xhlq002 1 kokomi 07.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' If we strike from above and take down their leader first, the rest of them will be hard-pressed to put up a serious fight.
:{{A|vo xhlq002 1 kokomi 08.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' Option 2: Hit them where it hurts. Over there, {{Traveler}}, for example — a store of gunpowder kegs.
:{{A|vo xhlq002 1 kokomi 09.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' If we managed to discreetly set the gunpowder alight without alerting them, it would deal them a devastating blow.
:{{A|vo xhlq002 1 kokomi 10.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' They'd be caught completely off guard. Both their morale and fighting capacity would be severely impaired.
:{{A|vo xhlq002 1 kokomi 11.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' Option 3: Use the environment against them. We're close to the sea here, so the air is very humid. I can gather the water vapor, you add a touch of lightning, and together we can shock them into submission.
:{{A|vo xhlq002 1 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wow, that's our grand strategist! It's a lot to think about though... which option should we choose?
:{{A|vo xhlq002 1 kokomi 12.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' That will depend on our assessment of our own abilities.
:{{A|vo xhlq002 1 kokomi 13.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' A surprise attack from the air is the quickest solution, but requires superior combat skills.
:{{A|vo xhlq002 1 kokomi 14.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' With an explosion, we could rapidly reduce their numbers without a protracted battle. But absolute stealth would be required during the operation, or we'd risk exposing ourselves.
:{{A|vo xhlq002 1 kokomi 15.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' If we decide to take advantage of the environment, we should be prepared for a lengthy siege. So, {{Traveler}}, which is your preferred option?
:{{DIcon}} Surprise air raid.
::{{A|vo xhlq002 1 kokomi 16a.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' Haha... There's the Swordfish captain I know. Every confidence in your abilities.
::{{A|vo xhlq002 1 kokomi 16a 1.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' It's decided then — let's fight this one together. I'm no warrior myself, but I can still provide some support. I certainly won't be dropping you into battle all by yourself.
::{{A|vo xhlq002 1 kokomi 16a 2.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' We should take them down as quickly as possible and retrieve the merchant's goods.
:{{DIcon}} Gunpowder plot.
::{{A|vo xhlq002 1 kokomi 16b.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' Haha, it seems that you share my strategic sensibilities.
::{{A|vo xhlq002 1 kokomi 16b 1.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' This is my preferred tactic. It places us in the least amount of danger.
::{{A|vo xhlq002 1 kokomi 16b 2.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' Let's work together to give them the surprise of their lives.
:{{DIcon}} Let's spark things up a little.
::{{A|vo xhlq002 1 kokomi 16c.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' Alright. We'll draw them out first to minimize damage to the camp itself.
::{{A|vo xhlq002 1 kokomi 16c 1.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' I haven't had much chance to fight alongside you in the past, I'm not sure I'll be able to keep up with your pace...
::{{A|vo xhlq002 1 kokomi 16c 2.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' Still, not to worry. Even if I can't claim to be a warrior myself, I'm no stranger to the battlefield. This fight should be well within my capabilities.
::{{A|vo xhlq002 1 kokomi 16c 3.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' Okay. Let's clear out the camp and find out what they've been up to.

:{{A|vo xhlq002 4 kokomi 04.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' Food, medicine, farming tools... All essential for post-war recovery. He was probably stockpiling them until he could make a handsome profit.

:{{A|vo xhlq002 4 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Uhh... he's hardly a saint, though, right? How could he stockpile things that people are desperate for?
:{{A|vo xhlq002 4 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' We're not gonna just give them back to him and let him go, are we? It doesn't feel right...

:{{A|vo xhlq002 4 kokomi 08.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' In my recently issued Post-War Temporary Decree, I included restrictions on the prices of essential everyday goods. These items will ultimately reach the people at a reasonable price.
:{{A|vo xhlq002 4 kokomi 09.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' If he had taken the time to read the decree, it's unlikely he ever would have ended up in this predicament.
:{{A|vo xhlq002 4 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Kokomi, you think of everything!
:{{A|vo xhlq002 4 kokomi 10.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' I wish that were true. Take this alleged collusion between the Tenryou Commission and the Fatui, for example. I'm still completely stumped.
:{{A|vo xhlq002 4 kokomi 11.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' The low energy doesn't exactly help...
:{{A|vo xhlq002 4 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Uh... Huh? What do you mean by that?
:{{A|vo xhlq002 4 kokomi 12.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' Nothing. Come on, let's take the goods back.
:{{A|vo xhlq002 4 kokomi 13.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' It's not long now until the Victory Feast. It'll be a race against the clock to get all of this resolved before it starts.
:{{A|vo xhlq002 4 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Got it! First we mend the peace, then we attend the feast!

:{{A|vo xhlq002 4 naruse 03.ogg}} '''Naruse:''' You see? I told you I was innocent!
:{{A|vo xhlq002 4 matsuda 01.ogg}} '''Matsuda:''' Hmph... I'm not so sure. You could have easily planned the whole thing with the Fatui in advance...
:{{A|vo xhlq002 4 kokomi 14.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' Based on the information we gathered from the Fatui camp, there's nothing to suggest he had any correspondence with them.
:{{A|vo xhlq002 4 kokomi 15.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' Had it been the case, then knowing how the Fatui operates, they would have left some evidence of it.
:{{A|vo xhlq002 4 uchimura 01.ogg}} '''Uchimura:''' But... what if—
:{{A|vo xhlq002 4 kokomi 16.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' No ifs, no buts. We've recovered the goods. As agreed, this is sufficient to establish his innocence.
:{{A|vo xhlq002 4 matsuda 02.ogg}} '''Matsuda:''' Sorry this happened.
:{{A|vo xhlq002 4 uchimura 02.ogg}} '''Uchimura:''' Guess we got carried away.
:{{A|vo xhlq002 4 naruse 04.ogg}} '''Naruse:''' Hah! What did I tell you? You army numskulls don't have a clue — all brawn and no brains! Coming to me with your crazy conspiracies... Lay off me next time, got it?
:{{A|vo xhlq002 4 kokomi 17.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' Sir, I'm afraid you're getting ahead of yourself. You may be innocent of the accusations originally leveled at you, but hoarding essential goods is a crime under the Temporary Decree. You must bear the consequences.
:{{A|vo xhlq002 4 kokomi 18.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' You have already admitted to being the owner of these goods, so we are obliged to respond with appropriate measures. In addition to enforcing the sale of these goods at the accepted rates, there will also be a fine, the amount of which—
:{{A|vo xhlq002 4 naruse 05.ogg}} '''Naruse:''' Wait, wait, wait! Your Excellency... Whose side are you on here?
:{{A|vo xhlq002 4 kokomi 19.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' I have no business taking sides. As the Divine Priestess of Watatsumi Island, I abide by the principle of clear and consistent rewards and punishments.
:{{A|vo xhlq002 4 kokomi 20.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' Just as merit must be recognized, mistakes must be penalized. You may have been proven innocent of the more serious allegations leveled at you, but this does not exempt you from bearing the consequences of your mistakes.
:{{A|vo xhlq002 4 naruse 06.ogg}} '''Naruse:''' Wait a minute! I... But...
:{{A|vo xhlq002 4 matsuda 03.ogg}} '''Matsuda:''' Well, don't just stand there — take him away! Time to pay up!
:{{A|vo xhlq002 4 uchimura 03.ogg}} '''Uchimura:''' Your Excellency, he says all the goods belong to him, but it doesn't add up.
:{{A|vo xhlq002 4 uchimura 04.ogg}} '''Uchimura:''' Those with a Tenryou Commission emblem are probably his, but not the rest. Especially these ones — they're clearly for shrine use.
:{{A|vo xhlq002 4 kokomi 21.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' Mm... It seems the Fatui simply dumped all their stolen goods in one place. Leave the shrine paraphernalia to me. As for the rest, I'll leave you to sift through and try to track down the owners.
:{{A|vo xhlq002 4 kokomi 22.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' I know that's a lot to ask.
:{{A|vo xhlq002 4 uchimura 05.ogg}} '''Uchimura:''' Not at all, Your Excellency, we're on it.
:{{A|vo xhlq002 4 uchimura 06.ogg}} '''Uchimura:''' But if I may, Your Excellency... Maybe there were no signs of collusion in this case, but our people know what they saw. Something is going on between the Tenryou Commission and the Fatui.
:{{A|vo xhlq002 4 uchimura 07.ogg}} '''Uchimura:''' I know the peace talks are coming up, so... please keep an open mind.
:{{A|vo xhlq002 4 kokomi 23.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' I understand your concern. I'll be sure to give it further consideration.
:{{A|vo xhlq002 4 kokomi 24.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' {{Traveler}}, I'm going to take these items back to the Sangonomiya Shrine. Why don't you come along for the walk?

{{Quest Description|update|While on your walk around Watatsumi Island, many residents come to chat with Kokomi. You sense there's something... odd about her response.}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Take a walk with Kokomi)
:{{A|vo xhlq002 4 kokomi 25.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' Watatsumi Island observes different customs than the rest of Inazuma. I imagine it must all seem a little alien to you?
:{{A|vo xhlq002 4 kokomi 26.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' It's been a long time since I last came to this village. There's been a lot to deal with recently...
:{{A|vo xhlq002 4 kokomi 27.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' Next time you visit, I'll take you to visit Watatsumi Island's old shrine.

;(Talk to Kokomi)
:{{A|vo xhlq002 5 kokomi 01.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' You know, the earliest shrine on Watatsumi Island was not located in Sangonomiya.
:{{A|vo xhlq002 5 kokomi 02.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' It was close to the [[Statue of The Seven]]. Back then, the people of this island recognized the [[Shogun]]'s existence, despite not venerating her as the [[Inazuma Shogunate|Shogunate]] do.
:{{A|vo xhlq002 5 kokomi 03.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' But after she struck down our [[Orobashi|protector deity]], the shrine was abandoned.
:{{A|vo xhlq002 5 kokomi 04.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' Relations between Watatsumi Island and the Shogunate have soured ever since. Mistrust has become deep-rooted over time.
:{{A|vo xhlq002 5 kokomi 05.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' I've been hoping to raise all this at the peace talks and discuss it properly. Grievances have to be let go eventually...

:{{A|vo xhlq002 5 youkou 01.ogg}} '''[[Youkou]]:''' Your Excellency, what brings you out this way on your busy schedule?
:{{A|vo xhlq002 5 youkou 02.ogg}} '''Youkou:''' Oh my, you're looking a little worse for wear... You need to take better care of yourself, okay? All of our fates depend on you...
:{{A|vo xhlq002 5 kokomi 06.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' Mm, thanks for your concern, but I'm fine.
:{{A|vo xhlq002 5 yuna 01.ogg}} '''[[Yuna]]:''' Your Excellency, I beg you, heed a word of advice. After all this time fighting the Shogun's Army, peace is not something that can simply be declared.
:{{A|vo xhlq002 5 yuna 02.ogg}} '''Yuna:''' If we reconcile with them, the god who once protected us will have died in vain...
:{{A|vo xhlq002 5 youkou 03.ogg}} '''Youkou:''' Come on, that's ancient history. Besides, the fighting is barely over. We should be grateful to be at peace once more.
:{{A|vo xhlq002 5 yuna 03.ogg}} '''Yuna:''' I know, I know, it's just... *sigh* We should remain strong in these negotiations. We mustn't be too ready to compromise.
:{{A|vo xhlq002 5 kokomi 07.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' I appreciate your concerns. I will consider the options carefully and be sure to proceed appropriately.
:{{A|vo xhlq002 5 yuna 04.ogg}} '''Yuna:''' Wonderful... We're all counting on you, Your Excellency.

:{{A|vo xhlq002 5 shiori 01.ogg}} '''[[Shiori]]:''' Your Excellency? Well, I'll be! Fancy meeting you at a place like this.
:{{A|vo xhlq002 5 shiori 02.ogg}} '''Shiori:''' Do you know — my daughter's enrolled herself in the shrine maiden selection process this year. If she makes it into [[Sangonomiya Shrine|Sangonomiya]], I'll be one very happy mother! You're a kind and gracious leader. She'd be in very good hands.
:{{A|vo xhlq002 5 shiori 03.ogg}} '''Shiori:''' *sigh* I'm always telling my daughter that if she gets the chance to learn from Her Excellency directly, she must make the most of it.
:{{A|vo xhlq002 5 shiori 04.ogg}} '''Shiori:''' I mean, just look at Her Excellency. Still so young, but so mature and intelligent. My daughter has always looked to you as a role model.
:{{A|vo xhlq002 5 kokomi 08.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' Well, if she comes to Sangonomiya, I'll look out for her...

:{{A|vo xhlq002 5 iwata 01.ogg}} '''[[Iwata]]:''' Ah, Your Excellency! Boy, am I glad you're here. As you know, agricultural output has taken a pretty big hit this year, let me bring you up to speed on the latest situation...
:{{A|vo xhlq002 5 ryouko 01a.ogg}} {{A|vo xhlq002 5 ryouko 01b.ogg}} '''[[Ryouko (Rumors Abound)|Ryouko]]:''' Oh, Your Excellency, isn't this the captain of Swordfish II? Will {{MC|he|she}} be based on Watatsumi Island from now on?
:{{A|vo xhlq002 5 yukiya 01.ogg}} '''[[Yukiya]]:''' Your Excellency...
:{{A|vo xhlq002 5 kokomi 09.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' Uh... Please remain calm, everyone, I'll get around to all your queries.
:{{A|vo xhlq002 5 kokomi 10.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' Though for the longer ones, I'd prefer it if you could write a report and submit it to the shrine. Then I can respond to each one as and when I have the time.
:{{Black Screen|''You chat with the friendly people alongside Kokomi...''}}
:{{A|vo xhlq002 5 kokomi 11.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' ...
:{{A|vo xhlq002 5 kokomi 12.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' {{Traveler}}, are you alright?
:{{DIcon}} I'm fine.
::{{A|vo xhlq002 5 kokomi 13a.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' Heh... This kind of thing is water off a duck's back for you, huh?
:{{DIcon}} This is testing my patience.
::{{A|vo xhlq002 5 kokomi 13b.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' *sigh* Me too. It does get pretty annoying...
:{{A|vo xhlq002 5 izuminaki 01.ogg}} '''Izumi Naki:''' Your Excellency, here you are.
:{{A|vo xhlq002 5 izuminaki 02.ogg}} '''Izumi Naki:''' There's been a situation. We're still waiting on the delivery of a whole batch of ceremonial items. I'm beginning to worry that they've been stolen...
:{{A|vo xhlq002 5 kokomi 14.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' Oh, we retrieved those already — no need to worry.
:{{A|vo xhlq002 5 izuminaki 03.ogg}} '''Izumi Naki:''' Really? That's fantastic! You never cease to amaze us, Your Excellency!
:{{A|vo xhlq002 5 izuminaki 04.ogg}} '''Izumi Naki:''' I sorted through all the petitions received recently and placed them on your desk.
:{{A|vo xhlq002 5 izuminaki 05.ogg}} '''Izumi Naki:''' Also, according to the schedule, you're just in time for your meeting today on the development of the textiles industry...
:{{A|vo xhlq002 5 kokomi 15.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' That's today? ...Right now?
:{{A|vo xhlq002 5 izuminaki 06.ogg}} '''Izumi Naki:''' Yes. The two young ladies have arrived safely, we're just waiting for you.
:{{A|vo xhlq002 5 kokomi 16.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' Mm, I see... *sigh* {{Traveler}}, I was hoping to take a walk around the island with you, but it looks like we'll have to save that for some other time.
:{{A|vo xhlq002 5 kokomi 17.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' Let's rendezvous tomorrow at the entrance to Sangonomiya Shrine. Then we'll go and make preparations for the Victory Feast.
:{{A|vo xhlq002 5 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yay, the Victory Feast! Just to be clear, we're talking lots of delicious food, right?
:{{A|vo xhlq002 5 kokomi 18.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' Haha... That's the name of the game. There'll be some Watatsumi Island specialties which I'm sure you'll enjoy.
:{{A|vo xhlq002 5 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Great! See you tomorrow then!
:{{A|vo xhlq002 5 kokomi 19.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' Mm...
{{Dialogue End}}

==Dialogue==
{{Quest Description|[[Sethos]] leads you into the ancient [[Temple of Silence]]. There, you learn why [[Cyrus (Sumeru)|Cyrus]] went into the desert alone, and the origin of Cyno's power. Next, it's time to face the requirements of the Temple of Silence.}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Approach the marked location after passing time)
:{{Black Screen|The group gathers again at the agreed time...}}
:{{A|vo cnlq104 1 cyno 01.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' I've taken some time to reflect on this... If I had to guess, Professor Cyrus came to the desert knowing that he would almost certainly never return.
:{{A|vo cnlq104 1 cyno 02.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' He's a stubborn man who tends to double down when he feels strongly about something. We won't get anywhere trying to convince him to escape.
:{{A|vo cnlq104 1 tighnari 01.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' I agree. My master, [[Naphis]], says the same thing — once Cyrus makes up his mind about something, he won't listen to reason.
:{{A|vo cnlq104 1 cyno 03.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Mhm. So that's one thing. A few other things came to mind, too.
:{{A|vo cnlq104 1 cyno 04.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' You've heard all you need to hear about the Temple of Silence, so on that, I don't have anything to add.
:{{A|vo cnlq104 1 cyno 05.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' My own memories of this place are hazy, though. Probably something to do with the overpowering presence of the Ba Fragments. That might explain why I suffered from constant headaches and fevers as a child.
:{{A|vo cnlq104 1 cyno 06.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' I do remember having some fleeting moments of profound emotion, when vague images would appear in my mind. But I don't recall much, only bits and pieces.
:{{A|vo cnlq104 1 cyno 07.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' I was still young, then, and all I could understand was that there was this strong will inside my mind. Thinking back on it now, I suppose it was [[Hermanubis]]'s way of trying to encourage me, even if we couldn't communicate.
:{{A|vo cnlq104 1 cyno 08.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' The power that came to inhabit my spirit was probably one of the cornerstones of their whole faith. So if the will and might of Hermanubis is a real and tangible thing, and they are its rightful worshipers, then...
:{{A|vo cnlq104 1 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You're not gonna give in to their demands, are you? Surely there has to be another way?
:{{DIcon}} Don't make any rash decisions, Cyno.
:{{DIcon}} There must be another way!
:{{A|vo cnlq104 1 cyno 09.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' No, I have no intention of returning it. I need this power to protect Sumeru. But the Temple has the right to make the final decision over its fate, since it belongs to one of the [[Seven Pillars]] of [[King Deshret]]...
:{{A|vo cnlq104 1 cyno 10.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' So I will challenge them head-on, and win the right to wield this power for myself, fair and square.
:{{A|vo cnlq104 1 tighnari 02.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Hmm, this reminds me of something [[Alhaitham]] mentioned to me just before we left. He said that the Temple of Silence was originally founded by the ruling elite of the day. Traditionally, such organizations are bound by a strict and ancient code of nobility.
:{{A|vo cnlq104 1 tighnari 03.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' [[Kaveh]] has made similar observations about the desert tribes from his work trips there. He says many of them have their own internal rules. They talk about the importance of never dishonoring their tribal bonds, or the rules laid down by their ancestors.
:{{A|vo cnlq104 1 tighnari 04.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' I think we could turn that to our advantage. Go back to them with a proposal of our own.
:{{A|vo cnlq104 1 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wow... And just like that, we've turned the tables on them!
:{{A|vo cnlq104 1 cyno 11.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Looks like we have the same idea.
:{{A|vo cnlq104 1 cyno 12.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Turn it back on them now, while we still can, in terms that they cannot refuse. That's how we win this.
:{{DIcon}} That sounds good to me.
:{{A|vo cnlq104 1 tighnari 05.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Great. And I know just how to start the conversation. Let's go find Sethos. We'll tell him that I know a thing or two about medicine, and would like to take a look at [[Bamoun|his grandfather]]'s condition.
----
;(Approach the marked location)
:{{A|vo cnlq104 2 cyno 01.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Sethos. Let's talk.
:{{A|vo cnlq104 2 sethos 01.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' Have you made up your mind?
:{{A|vo cnlq104 2 tighnari 01.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' We'll get to that. But first — I have some degree of medical training, so I was wondering if you might let me take a look at your grandfather?
:{{A|vo cnlq104 2 sethos 02.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' I have no objections, although we do have our own doctors here. I doubt you'll be able to tell us anything we don't already know.
:{{A|vo cnlq104 2 tighnari 02.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Only one way to find out.
:{{A|vo cnlq104 2 sethos 03.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' Follow me.
:{{A|vo cnlq104 2 sethos 04.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' Keep your voices down. We don't want to disturb him.
:{{Black Screen|Tighnari takes out his medical kit and performs a basic medical exam for Bamoun.}}
:{{A|vo cnlq104 2 tighnari 03.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' ...
:{{A|vo cnlq104 2 tighnari 04.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Let's talk outside.
:{{A|vo cnlq104 2 tighnari 05.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Bamoun has fallen into a deep coma, and his prognosis is quite grave. I am sure that your physicians have come to the same conclusion.
:{{A|vo cnlq104 2 tighnari 06.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' He appears to have sustained a serious injury in his youth, which has been exacerbated over the years by the heavy burden of work, and now by the effects of old age...
:{{A|vo cnlq104 2 tighnari 07.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Regretfully, I must inform you that... based on what I've seen with patients in a similar condition, he doesn't have long left. A few days at most.
:{{A|vo cnlq104 2 sethos 05.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' ...Yeah, I've known for a long time.
:{{A|vo cnlq104 2 cyno 02.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' You're his heir, aren't you? You clearly have a lot of respect for the man. But you also see things differently. You have a broader range of concerns, and a more pragmatic approach.
:{{A|vo cnlq104 2 cyno 03.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' So tell me how we can end this on your terms. Let's find a way to bring all this to a resolution while Bamoun is still alive to see it — that's what really matters to you, I know it.
:{{A|vo cnlq104 2 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yeah. There's no time to waste here. You know that better than anyone.
:{{A|vo cnlq104 2 sethos 06.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' ...
:{{A|vo cnlq104 2 tighnari 08.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' You know, the two of you are actually in a very similar predicament right now. Both of you have a very different perspective from the men who raised you.
:{{A|vo cnlq104 2 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Right. And you didn't create this situation — they did, but somehow, you've ended up having to make the tough decisions...
:{{A|vo cnlq104 2 sethos 07.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' ...You're right. We both look at this problem very differently than the people we inherited it from.
:{{A|vo cnlq104 2 sethos 08.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' I accept, Cyno. This all began because of Hermanubis, so let's end it with a rite he himself created.
:{{A|vo cnlq104 2 sethos 09.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' Legend has it that when Hermanubis first arrived in [[Tulaytullah]], he sparred with the city's residents. He and his two companions proved their mettle by fighting over several days, winning the support of many fine people.
:{{A|vo cnlq104 2 sethos 10.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' That group of supporters were some of the first members of the Temple of Silence, and the sparring matches were enshrined as one of our founding rites... The Rite of Duels. It's where it all began.
:{{A|vo cnlq104 2 cyno 04.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Sounds very fitting. I'm in.
:{{A|vo cnlq104 2 sethos 11.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' As a fellow vessel of Hermanubis, your ties to the Temple of Silence run deep. So I will permit you to participate in this rite, along with your chosen companions.
:{{A|vo cnlq104 2 tighnari 09.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Three against three. Sounds good.
:{{A|vo cnlq104 2 sethos 12.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' However, I have some additional terms. As the challengers, you must win all three of your fights to win. And Cyno... both of us must put our Ba Fragment on the line. The winner takes them both.
:{{A|vo cnlq104 2 sethos 13.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' Letting Cyrus leave with one of the Ba Fragments was a mistake, made by my grandfather out of pity. It is a longstanding issue that must be addressed for the Temple of Silence to move forward. I can make no concessions on that front.
:{{A|vo cnlq104 2 cyno 05.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' None needed. We're on the same page.
:{{A|vo cnlq104 2 cyno 06.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' If I win, the Temple of Silence must release Cyrus, and consider this past dispute resolved.
:{{A|vo cnlq104 2 cyno 07.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' If you win, I'll return my power to you.
:{{A|vo cnlq104 2 sethos 14.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' It's a deal. Then let's meet at the ceremonial hall tomorrow evening, eight o'clock.

;(Talk to Sethos, optional)
:{{A|vo dialog cnlq104 sethos 01.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' I'm really looking forward to this Rite of Duels. It'll be one for the ages. 
:{{A|vo dialog cnlq104 sethos 02.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' Not just for the sake of the Ba Fragments, but for many other people as well. 
:{{A|vo dialog cnlq104 sethos 03.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' Grandfather...

;(Use [[Nahida]]'s [[All Schemes to Know]] on Sethos, optional)
:{{A|vo dialog cnlq104 sethos 04.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' (...Grandfather, you have to hold on.)

;(Approach the marked location)
:{{A|vo cnlq104 3 tighnari 01.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Well, after how that went, there's definitely no turning back now.
:{{A|vo cnlq104 3 cyno 01.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' There never was. Turning back hasn't been an option for me since the moment the professor slipped away to return to the desert.
:{{A|vo cnlq104 3 tighnari 02.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' You have to win. You need this power — both as [[General Mahamatra]] and for yourself.
:{{A|vo cnlq104 3 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yeah, that's right! Besides, it's stayed with you ever since you were a small child. Surely that's a sign it thinks of you as its rightful owner.
:{{A|vo cnlq104 3 cyno 02.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' ...Both as General Mahamatra, and for myself...
:{{A|vo cnlq104 3 cyno 03.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Yeah, when you put it that way... I've had to overcome a lot to tame this power and claim it for myself. Not everyone could have done that.
:{{A|vo cnlq104 3 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Exactly!
:{{DIcon}} Let's not get sidetracked. We gotta focus on winning!
:{{DIcon}} We'll help you see this through.
:{{A|vo cnlq104 3 tighnari 03.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' {{Traveler}} and I will never lose.
:{{A|vo cnlq104 3 cyno 04.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' And neither shall I.
:{{A|vo cnlq104 3 cyno 05.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' The desert was home to an ancient and great civilization that for a variety of reasons, fell out with the civilization of the rainforest. It's just as [[Dehya]] said — prejudices pushed people apart.
:{{A|vo cnlq104 3 cyno 06.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' But there must be personal factors at work here, too. I can't shake the feeling that Bamoun cares for many more things than he lets on, and I don't think that Sethos is any kind of villain. He's just doing what he thinks is best.
:{{A|vo cnlq104 3 cyno 07.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' ...Tomorrow, everything will be resolved.

;(Enter the ceremonial hall after passing time)
:{{A|vo cnlq104 4 duaenre 01.ogg}} '''Duaenre:''' We gather on this day to perform once more the Rite of Duels, with the greatest of all sages, Lord Hermanubis as our witness, for his power and authority is present in our midst.
:{{A|vo cnlq104 4 duaenre 02.ogg}} '''Duaenre:''' This is our most sacred of ceremonies, and no disruption from the audience shall be tolerated. It is incumbent upon all to observe the duel with the utmost respect and reverence throughout the proceedings.
:{{A|vo cnlq104 4 duaenre 03.ogg}} '''Duaenre:''' Representing the Temple of Silence: The defenders.
:{{A|vo cnlq104 4 sethos 01.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' Grandfather, you're here.
:{{A|vo cnlq104 4 bamoun 01.ogg}} '''Bamoun:''' *cough* ...A Rite of Duels, after all these years... I am surprised by your decision, Sethos.
:{{A|vo cnlq104 4 sethos 02.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' I know what I'm doing, Grandfather. Just leave it to me.
:{{A|vo cnlq104 4 duaenre 04.ogg}} '''Duaenre:''' Representing the [[Akademiya]]: The challengers.
:{{A|vo cnlq104 4 cyno 01.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Ready. We will fight to have our voices heard.
:{{A|vo cnlq104 4 duaenre 05.ogg}} '''Duaenre:''' Warriors, take your positions and decide on the order of battle.
:{{A|vo cnlq104 4 duaenre 06.ogg}} '''Duaenre:''' We come not to debate what brings our challengers here, nor what will become of the defeated duelists. Duelists, the might of Hermanubis himself is at stake here. Now, fight, fight until the rightful victor is proclaimed!
:{{DIcon}} I'll go first.
:{{A|vo cnlq104 4 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh? Are you sure?
:{{DIcon}} I'm sure. We want to keep our morale up.
:{{A|vo cnlq104 4 tighnari 01a.ogg}} {{A|vo cnlq104 4 tighnari 01b.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' I agree. {{Traveler}} is very strong.<ref group="Note">Actual voice-over: "{{MC|m=He|f=She}} is very strong."</ref> Sending {{MC|m=him|f=her}} out first will definitely intimidate the opposing side.
:{{A|vo cnlq104 4 cyno 02.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Okay, then you're second.
:{{A|vo cnlq104 4 tighnari 02.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Sure.
:{{A|vo cnlq104 4 cyno 03.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' We have decided.
:{{A|vo cnlq104 4 sethos 03.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' So have we. Let's begin.

:{{A|vo cnlq104 5 duaenre 01.ogg}} '''Duaenre:''' Duelists of the first bout, please step forward.
:;(The Traveler draws their [[Silver Sword]])
:{{DIcon}} Leave it to me.

;(While fighting the enemies)
:{{A|vo cnlq104 5 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Don't forget, safety first!
:{{A|vo cnlq104 5 paimon 02a.ogg}} {{A|vo cnlq104 5 paimon 02b.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hey, you there! You better play nice with {{MC|m=him|f=her}}, or Paimon will make you regret it!
:{{A|vo cnlq104 5 sethos 01.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' Little bit too much chatter from the audience over there.
:{{A|vo cnlq104 5 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Heyyy!

;(After completing the first bout)
:{{A|vo cnlq104 6 duaenre 01.ogg}} '''Duaenre:''' A swift end to the first bout. I now invite the duelists of the second bout to please step forward.
:{{A|vo cnlq104 6 duaenre 02.ogg}} '''Duaenre:''' When you're both ready, you may begin.
:{{A|vo cnlq104 6 tighnari 01.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Let's begin.

;(While fighting the enemies)
:{{A|vo cnlq104 6 cyno 01.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Watch out!
:{{A|vo cnlq104 6 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Go, Tighnari, go!
:{{A|vo cnlq104 6 cyno 02.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' He drank plenty of water before the bout, so he should be fine...

;(After completing the second bout)
:{{A|vo cnlq104 6 duaenre 03.ogg}} '''Duaenre:''' Thus ends the second bout. We will now move to the third bout. Duelists, please step forward.
:{{A|vo cnlq104 6 cyno 03.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' I'm ready.
:{{A|vo cnlq104 6 sethos 01.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' So am I.
:{{A|vo cnlq104 6 duaenre 04.ogg}} '''Duaenre:''' This is the final stage of the rite. I remind you both that the terms you agreed upon in advance are binding.
:{{A|vo cnlq104 6 duaenre 05.ogg}} '''Duaenre:''' When you're both ready, you may begin.
:{{A|vo cnlq104 6 sethos 02.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' ...
:{{A|vo cnlq104 6 sethos 03.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' I am Sethos, vessel of Hermanubis, grandson of Bamoun, the leader of the Temple of Silence.
:{{A|vo cnlq104 6 sethos 04.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' For many years, we have kept our covenant with Lord Hermanubis by guarding the secrets of King Deshret. And even in our darkest hour, when we could not see a way forward, we chose not to abandon hope, but to embark on a brave new experiment so that we might prevail.
:{{A|vo cnlq104 6 sethos 05.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' We earnestly sought Lord Hermanubis's wisdom and power, longing to see his spirit and his light descend upon us.
:{{A|vo cnlq104 6 sethos 06.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' Now, I will fight to become the rightful wielder of that power!
:{{A|vo cnlq104 6 cyno 04.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' I am Cyno, General Mahamatra of the Akademiya, student and successor of Cyrus, the sage of [[Spantamad]]. I fight in defense of my power, my professor, and my nation.
:{{A|vo cnlq104 6 cyno 05.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' And you? I think you left some things unsaid. This is a sacred duel, and Hermanubis is watching. So bare your soul.
:{{A|vo cnlq104 6 sethos 07.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' ...
:{{A|vo cnlq104 6 sethos 08.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' (Everyone... old and young, fit and frail, they're all waiting to see how this duel will end.)
:{{A|vo cnlq104 6 sethos 09.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' My grandfather is a wise leader. He is also known to be a ruler who is not afraid to get blood on his hands. I understand his beliefs well, and I know what he expects of me.
:{{A|vo cnlq104 6 sethos 10.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' But our faith has held us back for too long. After I grew up, I went to the rainforest once, and I saw for myself the people of the city.
:{{A|vo cnlq104 6 sethos 11.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' Times have changed. The people of Sumeru are happier and more free now than in the past. I thought about this as I stood at one of the tallest points in the city, gazing down at the streets below.
:{{A|vo cnlq104 6 sethos 12.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' Then I thought of you, Cyno. You and I both wield the same power, yet the lives we lead could not be more different.
:{{A|vo cnlq104 6 sethos 13.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' Each Ba Fragment of Hermanubis stands for something different — might, glory... or one of many other secrets that have yet to be revealed.
:{{A|vo cnlq104 6 sethos 14.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' I once thought that the nature of our fragments must be what makes us so different from one other. But... maybe, it's that you've found your answer, and I am still searching for mine.
:{{A|vo cnlq104 6 cyno 06.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' I am more than just a warrior. I am my own person.
:{{A|vo cnlq104 6 tighnari 02.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' ...Exactly.
:{{A|vo cnlq104 6 sethos 15.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' ...
:{{A|vo cnlq104 6 sethos 16.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' The name "Hermanubis" has left its mark on both of us, shaped the course of our lives. We are his vessels, and yet we are more besides.
:{{A|vo cnlq104 6 sethos 17.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' So show me your answer, Cyno. Show me I can be more than my faith, more than the power I wield... Show me the person I can become!
:{{A|vo cnlq104 6 sethos 18.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' Bring it on!

;(A cinematic plays)
::{{Color|menu|Cyno and Sethos engage in a fair and fierce duel witnessed by Hermanubis. Cyno emerges victorious.}}
::{{Color|menu|As agreed, Sethos hands his Ba Fragment over to Cyno. When the latter receives it, his body begins to give off a startling radiance.}}
::{{Color|menu|Bamoun, whose life gutters like a moribund candle, is greatly moved at this sight, as one who has witnessed a miracle. Ancient memories come to his mind, of Hermanubis, of the desert of bygone eras, and many things involving the Temple of Silence...}}
::'''Cyno:''' That's all you've got?
::'''Cyno:''' What happened to searching for your answer?
:;(Cyno and Sethos have an intense fight; first using the power of Hermanubis, then switching to their respective staffs)
::'''Cyno:''' Fight's over
::'''Cyno:''' Do you yield?
::'''Sethos:''' You won
::'''Cyno:''' Well then, looks like you found your answer
:;(Sethos extracts his Ba Fragment and sends it to Cyno)
::'''Sethos:''' I give his glory to you
:;(Cyno accepts it and begins to emanate a blinding light that fills the room)
::'''Bamoun:''' I've seen that light...
::'''Bamoun:''' That is the light of our Lord... The great Hermanubis, priest over all other priests
::'''Bamoun:''' His spirit dwells within that lightning, and his will lives on
::'''Bamoun:''' Once a warrior of Tighnar, he emerged from the barren desert sands
::'''Bamoun:''' To serve the God King, Al-Ahmar
::'''Bamoun:''' After the death of the God King, Hermanubis gathered his followers
::'''Bamoun:''' And the [[Tighnarian]] priests
::'''Bamoun:''' And led them to the city of Tulaytullah
::'''Bamoun:''' There, they founded the Temple of Silence. And from that day forth
::'''Bamoun:''' We became stewards of all knowledge
::'''Bamoun:''' That survived from King Deshret's civilization
::'''Bamoun:''' Barely a century passed before war ravaged the desert
::'''Bamoun:''' One by one, Eremite leaders took up arms against each other in battles
::'''Bamoun:''' That would devour what little remained of their civilization
::'''Bamoun:''' Only the wise city of Tulaytullah
::'''Bamoun:''' Was spared under the guiding hand of the Tighnarians
::'''Bamoun:''' But peace did not last
::'''Bamoun:''' Coveting the knowledge of King Deshret, the beasts set their eyes on Tulaytullah
::'''Bamoun:''' The king of [[Gurabad]] laid siege to the city
::'''Bamoun:''' And ordered the sages to surrender to him the Temple of Silence, as proof of his victory

::'''Bamoun:''' Betraying the Temple so as to hold onto their rule over the city

::'''Bamoun:''' These were dark days, and we faced enemies on all sides

::'''Bamoun:''' Keeping the forbidden knowledge introduced by King Deshret at bay
::'''Bamoun:''' To ensure the Temple's continued survival
::'''Bamoun:''' He broke his being into many pieces
::'''Bamoun:''' And began the ceremony of Hermanubis's legacy

::'''Bamoun:''' Strange and unfamiliar as this power was

::'''Bamoun:''' And we wandered from place to place, always in hiding
::'''Bamoun:''' All the while keeping close watch over our secrets
::'''Bamoun:''' And staying true to our mission
::'''Bamoun:''' Betrayal forced us out of the desert and into the forest
::'''Bamoun:''' Then mistrust drove us from the forest, into the desert once more
::'''Bamoun:''' We have lived in exile for far, far too long...
::'''Bamoun:''' Yet today, the Temple of Silence has borne witness to the glory of Hermanubis once more
::'''Bamoun:''' ...Thank you

:{{A|vo vrslq003 4 varesa 16.ogg}} '''Varesa:''' Just like you, she was full of courage, and never stopped challenging and exploring the unknown... She's my idol!
:{{A|vo vrslq003 4 varesa 17.ogg}} '''Varesa:''' Actually, could you give me a moment? All I need is three seconds... Lady Fietena, lend my your courage.
:{{A|vo vrslq003 4 varesa 18.ogg}} '''Varesa:''' Three, two, one...
:{{A|vo vrslq003 4 varesa 19.ogg}} '''Varesa:''' You're right! I can't keep running from the truth. I... want to command it, just like you said.

:{{A|vo vrslq003 4 bifrons 02.ogg}} '''???:''' No need for alarm. There is only one among you who piqued my interest, and that is the one with the golden hair. Seeing as you all appear to be acquainted, I allowed the rest of you to hear my voice as well.

:{{A|vo vrslq003 4 bifrons 04.ogg}} '''???:''' Now, now... YOU were the ones who wanted to learn more about my origins. I merely granted your wish.

:{{A|vo vrslq003 4 bifrons 05.ogg}} '''???:''' Ah, so you do know how to use your brain, young one. You'll excuse me if I have no interest in you — craven and dull-witted as you usually seem.

:{{A|vo vrslq003 4 bifrons 06.ogg}} '''???:''' Heh, let me remind you, it was your own curiosity that started all of this. I see no reason for me to stand down.

:{{A|vo vrslq003 4 bifrons 10.ogg}} '''Sage-Lord of Fungi:''' Ahem... Of course, the Sage-Lord of Fungi is too dignified for petty arguments with lesser organisms.

:{{A|vo vrslq003 4 varesa 30.ogg}} '''Varesa:''' ...No response. Guess he's not gonna admit it.

==Dialogue==
{{Quest Description|According to Diona, the herbal soup made by samachurls can possibly be used to make an antidote to alcohol.}}
===A Sobering Affair===

==Dialogue==
{{Quest Description|After discussing the plan with [[Lyney]] and the others, you go to the seaside to meet The Knave in an attempt to distract her...}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Approach Arlecchino and Tartaglia)
:{{A|vo arlq002 1 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' It's The Knave! And... [[Tartaglia|Childe]]!?
:{{A|vo arlq002 1 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hey, aren't you supposed to be in [[Snezhnaya]] recuperating? What are you still doing in [[Fontaine]]?
:{{A|vo arlq002 1 tartaglia 01.ogg}} '''Childe:''' Oh, it's you two. I didn't expect to run into you here... *coughing*
:{{A|vo arlq002 1 tartaglia 02.ogg}} '''Childe:''' I was unconscious for quite a while after the fight in the [[Primordial Sea]]. After I woke up, I realized I was being taken back to Snezhnaya, and well...
:{{A|vo arlq002 1 tartaglia 03.ogg}} '''Childe:''' I couldn't have that, now could I? Not when I've still got unfinished business here in Fontaine. So, I mustered up all my strength and made the journey back on my own.
:{{A|vo arlq002 1 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What sort of unfinished business are we talking here?
:{{A|vo arlq002 1 tartaglia 04.ogg}} '''Childe:''' It has to do with [[Skirk]]... My master. I really wanted to meet up with her... But, by the time I got back, she had already left.
:{{A|vo arlq002 1 tartaglia 05.ogg}} '''Childe:''' I still have so many questions for her. Without any other leads... all I could do was ask The Knave to help me track her down. She must have left behind some traces from her time in Fontaine.
:{{A|vo arlq002 1 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, okay... So, have you found any clues?
:{{A|vo arlq002 1 arlecchino 01.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' Unfortunately, no. While the [[House of the Hearth]] is adept at collecting all manner of intelligence, certain existences... can still manage to escape our purview.
:{{A|vo arlq002 1 tartaglia 06.ogg}} '''Childe:''' Basically, unless Master feels there's a need to meet with me, she's not going to be found.
:{{A|vo arlq002 1 tartaglia 07.ogg}} '''Childe:''' But, that problem has an easy fix. I just need to become stronger, and then... *coughing*
:{{A|vo arlq002 1 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Uh... Paimon thinks you should focus on getting better first.
:{{A|vo arlq002 1 tartaglia 08.ogg}} '''Childe:''' Haha, the worst of it is over.
:{{A|vo arlq002 1 tartaglia 09.ogg}} '''Childe:''' It's all thanks to that one kid from the House of the Hearth... [[Heloir]] I think her name was. She gave me a bunch of random potions to drink. They didn't go down easy, let me tell you — pain and chills all over. But, they really did help speed up my recovery.
:{{A|vo arlq002 1 tartaglia 10.ogg}} '''Childe:''' And that's good, because it looks like I really do have to head back this time. The [[Pulcinella|old man]]'s been putting the pressure on me. He sent someone to tell me I'm needed for some sort of project...
:{{A|vo arlq002 1 arlecchino 02.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' "[[Project Stuzha]]"?
:{{A|vo arlq002 1 tartaglia 11.ogg}} '''Childe:''' Yeah, that's the one. *sigh* I heard [[Regrator]]'s involved too. I'm not looking forward to having to listen to all his monologuing, that's for sure. Hey, maybe you could think of a way for me to stay in Fontaine for a little longer?
:{{A|vo arlq002 1 tartaglia 12.ogg}} '''Childe:''' Helping Lyney and the others brush up on their fighting skills would be far more interesting. If you and I could spar — that would be even better. I've been waiting for the chance to see you go all out.
:{{A|vo arlq002 1 arlecchino 03.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' And what a sweet, little daydream that is. But, I also have a role to play in all this. I'll be leaving Fontaine shortly as well.
:{{A|vo arlq002 1 arlecchino 04.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' Besides, considering how little they see fit to step outside the homeland, being called on to return to Snezhnaya by such illustrious dignitaries... What a great "honor," wouldn't you agree?
:{{A|vo arlq002 1 tartaglia 13.ogg}} '''Childe:''' Haha... One I could do without, I'd say.
:{{A|vo arlq002 1 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Is it just Paimon? Or, does it kinda seem like they're...
:{{DIcon}} Just casually trash-talking their colleagues behind their backs...?
:{{A|vo arlq002 1 arlecchino 05.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' So, dear guests of the House of the Hearth, to what do I owe the visit?
:{{A|vo arlq002 1 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Um... Well, we just, uh...
:{{DIcon}} Wanted to learn more about you.
:{{A|vo arlq002 1 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Right! We're super close to Lyney and the others, but we still don't know much about you!
:{{A|vo arlq002 1 arlecchino 06.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' Is that so? Introductions have already been made, have they not?
:{{A|vo arlq002 1 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, well, you see... There's only so much you can learn about someone from a short introduction! At least tell us something a little extra, like... Why do you call yourself "Father"?
:{{A|vo arlq002 1 tartaglia 14.ogg}} '''Childe:''' Ooh, good question! I'd also like to know.
:{{A|vo arlq002 1 arlecchino 07.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' The fact that you have to ask tells me our intelligence work has been quite successful. Telling you the answer to that question would only serve to undermine that success, and we can't have that, now can we?
:{{A|vo arlq002 1 tartaglia 15.ogg}} '''Childe:''' Spoken like a true diplomat. That was some expert sidestepping right there.
:{{A|vo arlq002 1 arlecchino 08.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' Well, if there's nothing else, I think I'll take my leave. I still have a small matter to resolve at home.
:{{A|vo arlq002 1 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Uh... Wait! Don't go!
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (If The Knave leaves right now, she's sure to run into Lyney and Clervie...!)
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (Should I release the bird Lyney gave us? No, we should try to get her talking about something else first.)
:{{DIcon}} About the House of the Hearth...
:{{DIcon}} What does the organization mean to you?
:{{A|vo arlq002 1 tartaglia 16.ogg}} '''Childe:''' Oho, I'd also like to hear the answer to this.
:{{A|vo arlq002 1 tartaglia 17.ogg}} '''Childe:''' I've met some of the members of your organization, and they all seemed like really good kids. They actually reminded me of [[Tonia]] and [[Teucer]].
:{{A|vo arlq002 1 tartaglia 18.ogg}} '''Childe:''' Which, by the way, if you ever betray them, I'm just letting you know — I won't let you off easy.
:{{A|vo arlq002 1 arlecchino 09.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' And why would I betray them?
:{{A|vo arlq002 1 tartaglia 19.ogg}} '''Childe:''' Well, you've already betrayed the House of the Hearth once, haven't you? At least... that's what I heard.
:{{A|vo arlq002 1 arlecchino 10.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' ...
:{{A|vo arlq002 1 tartaglia 20.ogg}} '''Childe:''' Okay, okay. I admit, that's just what the old man told me... The Rooster, I mean.
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (The Knave betrayed the House of the Hearth... So, does that mean what Clervie said was true? Does The Knave really treat her children like test subjects?)
:{{A|vo arlq002 1 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' W—Wait... did you really do something bad to those kids?
:{{A|vo arlq002 1 arlecchino 11.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' Never mind what I've done, I'm more curious as to what the mighty Rooster had to say. Care to enlighten me?
:{{A|vo arlq002 1 tartaglia 21.ogg}} '''Childe:''' Ah, well, nothing much... Just some stuff about you taking out many other members of the House of the Hearth, and even going so far to attack your own "family."
:{{A|vo arlq002 1 arlecchino 12.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' Hmm... I see.
:{{A|vo arlq002 1 tartaglia 22.ogg}} '''Childe:''' Based on your reaction, I'm guessing it's all a bunch of lies?
:{{A|vo arlq002 1 arlecchino 13.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' Hardly. I don't appreciate his particular turns of phrase, but I suppose he didn't say anything untrue.
:{{A|vo arlq002 1 arlecchino 14.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' Although, it would be more accurate to say that there is a certain level of prejudice involved... But, I don't intend to clear that up just yet. Prejudice has a funny way of concealing the real truth behind certain things — an attribute that I find to be quite advantageous.
:{{A|vo arlq002 1 arlecchino 15.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' Call yourself a Fontainian, for example, and people will assume all sorts of things, when the real truth... is that this is simply the land where I was raised.
:{{A|vo arlq002 1 paimon 12.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh!? You're not actually from Fontaine!? But then, why did you try to help out with the prophecy and everything?
:{{A|vo arlq002 1 arlecchino 16.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' I was trying to protect the children born in Fontaine. Claiming that I, myself, was a Fontainian simply made it easier to operate. People would hardly suspect a fellow Fontainian of having any ulterior motives. Who wouldn't want to save their homeland, after all?
:{{A|vo arlq002 1 arlecchino 17.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' The Primordial Sea wouldn't have any effect on me, but it would have caused great harm to the House of the Hearth... Well, you wanted "extra information," didn't you? There you go. I hope that satisfied your curiosity.
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (So much for learning anything else about her "betrayal." She probably only revealed that other secret in order to change the subject. It seems like she's trying to avoid talking about her past...)
:{{A|vo arlq002 1 tartaglia 23.ogg}} '''Childe:''' So, you stayed in Fontaine for the kids... I guess I was wrong to believe you'd betray them. Apologies. Looks like I was holding on to some prejudices myself.
:{{A|vo arlq002 1 arlecchino 18.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' Good. Like I said — I like it when others have misconceptions of me.
:{{A|vo arlq002 1 tartaglia 24.ogg}} '''Childe:''' Actually, while I was recuperating at the House of the Hearth, there was something else that really caught my attention.
:{{A|vo arlq002 1 tartaglia 25.ogg}} '''Childe:''' I heard that members always resolve disputes and arguments with a friendly spar, and the loser has to back down. Seems pretty cool, if you ask me. Would also give them plenty of opportunities to hone their skills.
:{{A|vo arlq002 1 arlecchino 19.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' Well, that's only a recent development. In the past, such spars weren't nearly so... friendly. The losing party would lose everything, including their life.
:{{A|vo arlq002 1 paimon 13.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' They were that high stakes!? Phew, at least that's not a thing anymore!
:{{A|vo arlq002 1 tartaglia 26.ogg}} '''Childe:''' Well, the current atmosphere's not half bad. I'm a bit jealous, actually. You've got so many family members around you, and you even get to live with them.
:{{A|vo arlq002 1 arlecchino 20.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' Having a lot of family around means dealing with a considerable amount of bickering and scheming. Once Tonia and Teucer enter their rebellious phase, I'm sure you'll understand.
:{{A|vo arlq002 1 arlecchino 21.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' Just imagine... Teucer becomes obsessed with plucking out strands from the Rooster's mustache, or Tonia decides to dye her hair 42 different colors...
:{{A|vo arlq002 1 tartaglia 27.ogg}} '''Childe:''' Okay, okay! I get the picture.
:{{Black Screen|As the conversation shifts to the topic of Tonia and Teucer, Childe begins to share story after story about his siblings.}}
:{{Black Screen|It's the type of conversation that would usually leave you falling asleep, but you find yourself grateful to Childe for buying you more time.}}
:{{A|vo arlq002 1 tartaglia 28.ogg}} '''Childe:''' Ah, well, would you look at the time. I should probably get going.
:{{A|vo arlq002 1 tartaglia 29.ogg}} '''Childe:''' {{Traveler}}, Paimon, I'm not sure where our paths will cross next, but the next time we run into each other, we should definitely try and find some time to spar... *coughing*
:{{A|vo arlq002 1 paimon 14.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Again, maybe this is a conversation we can have when you look less like you're gonna keel over...
:{{A|vo arlq002 1 tartaglia 30.ogg}} '''Childe:''' Alright, alright... Well, thanks for everything, Arlecchino.
:{{A|vo arlq002 1 arlecchino 22.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' No thanks necessary. You also played a part in obtaining the Gnosis. I would say we can call ourselves even.
:{{A|vo arlq002 1 tartaglia 31.ogg}} '''Childe:''' Hah, I like the sound of that... Well, I'm off. See you all some other time.
:{{A|vo arlq002 1 paimon 15.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' We should probably get going too... Do you wanna head back with us?
:{{A|vo arlq002 1 arlecchino 23.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' Oh? You want me to leave so soon?
:{{A|vo arlq002 1 paimon 16.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, uh... Well, you see, um...
:{{A|vo arlq002 1 arlecchino 24.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' I'm rather enjoying the evening breeze. If you don't mind, I think I'll stick around for a bit. I have some things to think about.
:{{A|vo arlq002 1 arlecchino 25.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' Apologies for not attending to you like a proper host. Please, forgive the slight. I do hope you'll have a pleasant stay.
:{{A|vo arlq002 1 paimon 17.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Phew... We managed to keep her distracted until nightfall. Good thing Childe was there to keep the conversation going. You don't think she suspected anything, do you?
:{{A|vo arlq002 1 paimon 18.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wonder if Lyney ran into any issues... Let's hurry back and see how everything went.
