:{{A|vo arlq002 2 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Lyney! How'd everything go?
:{{A|vo arlq002 2 lyney 01.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Well, long story short, we ran into a small issue — Clervie can't go into the sunlight.
:{{DIcon}} What do you mean?
:{{A|vo arlq002 2 lyney 02.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Everything was fine at first. She followed me up to the surface, just like I told her.
:{{A|vo arlq002 2 lyney 03.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' But as I led her out of the shadows and into the sunlight, she vanished.
:{{A|vo arlq002 2 lyney 04.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' I turned around, and there she was — standing at the edge of the shadows, silently watching me.
:{{A|vo arlq002 2 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Maybe she's afraid of sunlight, or... No, it wouldn't be her wish if that were the case.
:{{A|vo arlq002 2 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Well, we could always try... pushing her into it?
:{{DIcon}} Not sure "pushing" works on a non-corporeal being...
:{{A|vo arlq002 2 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, true...
:{{A|vo arlq002 2 lyney 05.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' I've pretty much tried it all already. Nothing worked. Eventually, the sun went down, so all I could do was bring her back here.
:{{A|vo arlq002 2 lyney 06.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' How did it go with you, Lynette?
:{{A|vo arlq002 2 lynette 01.ogg}} '''Lynette:''' Good. I've got the list. It's right here.
:{{A|vo arlq002 2 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Really? Well, what are we waiting for? Let's take a look!

:{{A|vo arlq002 2 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yikes, that Horrer guy has a huge scar on his face. He's kinda giving Paimon the creeps.
:{{A|vo arlq002 2 lyney 08.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Ah, I've met him before. The scar is from an injury he received during a mission. I still remember him joking with me about it. He said any future lover would take one look at him and then lose all interest.
:{{A|vo arlq002 2 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Did he say anything else?
:{{A|vo arlq002 2 lyney 09.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Well, I asked if there was someone he was interested in. He said no, and that's where our conversation ended.
:{{A|vo arlq002 2 lyney 10.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' It was only later that I learned he really did have someone he liked. He risked everything to escape so he could be with her, but it didn't work. One day, "Father" asked to see him, and well... I never saw him again after that.
:{{A|vo arlq002 2 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wait, so that means, The Knave, she...
:{{A|vo arlq002 2 lyney 11.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' It may seem cruel, but it's just one of the rules of the House.
:{{A|vo arlq002 2 lyney 12.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Betrayal is not to be taken lightly. We know too many secrets to come and go as we please. So, if you do try to leave, you pay with your life.
:{{Black Screen|A solemn atmosphere descends over the group as you look through the list of names. However, Clervie's name does not seem to be among them.}}
:{{A|vo arlq002 2 lyney 13.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Her name's not here, huh... Well, that's not too surprising. It doesn't seem like this list is complete. It only contains records dating back around five years.
:{{A|vo arlq002 2 lyney 14.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Let's shift our attention, then. Freminet, were you able to find anything out?
:{{A|vo arlq002 2 freminet 01.ogg}} '''Freminet:''' ...
:{{A|vo arlq002 2 lyney 15.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Freminet?
:{{A|vo arlq002 2 freminet 02.ogg}} '''Freminet:''' Ah sorry, I was thinking about something.
:{{A|vo arlq002 2 freminet 03.ogg}} '''Freminet:''' I managed to talk to quite a few people, but I couldn't help but notice that the atmosphere in the House was a little... strange.
:{{A|vo arlq002 2 lynette 02.ogg}} '''Lynette:''' Strange?
:{{A|vo arlq002 2 freminet 04.ogg}} '''Freminet:''' Yeah. I mean, I know there have been arguments in the past, times when people haven't gotten along. [[Chapleau]] and [[Filliol]] are a good example of that...
:{{A|vo arlq002 2 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, those are two of the people we met while delivering supplies! Paimon can see how they might not get along. They had very different vibes, and their, um... "interests" seemed to be pretty different as well...
:{{A|vo arlq002 2 lyney 16.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' That's to be expected, actually. "Father" brought us all here, shared her knowledge with us, taught us how to fight — that's one thing we all share. But, that's also where the similarities end. Not all of us feel the same desire to stay here.
:{{A|vo arlq002 2 lyney 17.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' As members of the House of the Hearth, we're also considered part of the Fatui. And to a lot of people, that's an identity they never asked for.
:{{A|vo arlq002 2 lyney 18.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Certain members get older and realize they want something else for themselves. But, considering the rules of the House... most people would never say that out loud.
:{{A|vo arlq002 2 lyney 19.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' People like Chapleau and [[Foltz]] are loyal to "Father" and her vision. They're proud to be part of the Fatui. Filliol and [[Nanteuil]] on the other hand... Well, they aren't quite as enthusiastic.
:{{A|vo arlq002 2 lynette 03.ogg}} '''Lynette:''' These kinds of conflicts have always been there. It's not like "Father" is in the dark about any of this.
:{{A|vo arlq002 2 freminet 05.ogg}} '''Freminet:''' Well, that's true, but it just feels like things have gotten worse lately. Filliol and the others... It seemed like they were meeting in secret to talk about something.
:{{A|vo arlq002 2 freminet 06.ogg}} '''Freminet:''' I can't say for sure, but I think they've met Clervie.
:{{A|vo arlq002 2 lyney 20.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' You think she's been inciting them to act out?
:{{A|vo arlq002 2 freminet 07.ogg}} '''Freminet:''' No, not exactly... But, I wouldn't be surprised if she said something to them about "the darkness in the House" and how deep it runs.
:{{A|vo arlq002 2 freminet 08.ogg}} '''Freminet:''' She's told me about it before... experiments being run on children, people being used as pawns on the battlefield without so much as the strength to survive...
:{{A|vo arlq002 2 lyney 21.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' And they just believed all that? Without any evidence?
:{{A|vo arlq002 2 lynette 04.ogg}} '''Lynette:''' Clervie's words probably gave them the excuse they were looking for. Whether they actually believe them to be true is secondary.
:{{A|vo arlq002 2 lyney 22.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' *sigh*... This is all because of "Project Stuzha," isn't it?
:{{A|vo arlq002 2 paimon 12.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Woah, woah, woah. Hold on a second!
:{{A|vo arlq002 2 paimon 13.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What's this "Project Stuzha" all about, huh? This is the second time it's come up now!
:{{A|vo arlq002 2 lyney 23.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Sorry, but I'm not sure of the details either.
:{{A|vo arlq002 2 lyney 24.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' I only know what "Father" has told us, which is that it's something The Rooster and Regrator have been working on together. Apparently, it has to do with the Fatui's strategic plan for the future.
:{{A|vo arlq002 2 lyney 25.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Because the House of the Hearth was so successful in obtaining the Gnosis, we now have the honor of playing a key role in Project Stuzha.
:{{A|vo arlq002 2 paimon 14.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wait... but isn't that a good thing?
:{{A|vo arlq002 2 lyney 26.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' "Key" role is just another way of saying "dangerous" role. To us, the whole thing is an inconvenience.
:{{A|vo arlq002 2 lyney 27.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' "Father" thinks so too, but she's in no position to refuse. Their plan isn't exactly unreasonable, and they've been funneling the House a lot of funding.
:{{A|vo arlq002 2 lyney 28.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' It's just that... We'll lose a lot of members in the process. Participating in the plan... It's an honor in name only. What they're really trying to do is subdue us. The existence of an intelligence organization outside their control makes them feel uneasy.
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (Looks like the Fatui are plotting something big, but given how little Lyney and the others seem to know about it, I probably won't be able to learn much.)
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (I should keep a sharp eye out during any future dealings with the Fatui to see what I can learn.)
:{{A|vo arlq002 2 paimon 15.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Okay, super complicated, top-secret Fatui business aside... What does all this have to do with the conflicts you were talking about earlier? Paimon doesn't get the connection...
:{{A|vo arlq002 2 lyney 29.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' External pressure has a way of exacerbating internal strife. You can't overlook the power of fear, either. People are afraid of dying, and that fear is often the impetus for a lot of stupid decisions.
:{{A|vo arlq002 2 lyney 30.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' I thought resolving the Clervie situation would make everything go back to normal.
:{{A|vo arlq002 2 lyney 31.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' But it looks like things are more complicated than I thought. If we leave Filliol and the others to their own devices, sooner or later, "Father" will be forced to take action.
:{{A|vo arlq002 2 lynette 05.ogg}} '''Lynette:''' We can only focus on one situation at a time, Brother.
:{{A|vo arlq002 2 lyney 32.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' You're right. Even if we confront Filliol and the others, it won't do any good. It might even make matters worse. We should focus on Clervie for now.
:{{A|vo arlq002 2 lyney 33.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Well, it's getting late. We should head back and get some rest. We'll try again first thing tomorrow.
:{{A|vo arlq002 2 lyney 34.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Lynette, you stick with me this time. Freminet, keep a close eye on Filliol and the others. Make sure they don't do anything they'll regret.
:{{A|vo arlq002 2 lyney 35.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Good work today, everyone. Have a good night, and I'll see you tomorrow.

;(Talk to Clervie)
:{{A|vo arlq002 4 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Clervie!
:{{A|vo arlq002 4 creirve 01.ogg}} '''Clervie:''' Shh!
:{{A|vo arlq002 4 creirve 02.ogg}} '''Clervie:''' I opened the window while no one was looking.
:{{A|vo arlq002 4 creirve 03.ogg}} '''Clervie:''' Look how pretty the outside is...
:{{DIcon}} Window?
:{{DIcon}} There's nothing here...
:{{A|vo arlq002 4 creirve 04.ogg}} '''Clervie:''' If only I could have more than this.
:{{A|vo arlq002 4 creirve 05.ogg}} '''Clervie:''' You probably think I'm being silly, huh? All this hopeless resisting... It's better to dream of what I could have than try to make it a reality, right?
:{{A|vo arlq002 4 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Please help us get on the same page here, Clervie. We need you to tell us what you know. Can you do that?
:{{A|vo arlq002 4 creirve 06.ogg}} '''Clervie:''' Sure! Although... after you hear all this, I think you might regret that decision.
:{{A|vo arlq002 4 creirve 07.ogg}} '''Clervie:''' Everyone in this family is nothing more than a tool, something to be used and exploited. We're all expendable... including me.
:{{A|vo arlq002 4 creirve 08.ogg}} '''Clervie:''' As long as you're useful, you get to stick around. Lose your value... and you're handed over to [[Dottore|The Doctor]], experimented on, and given a fate worse than death. I've seen it happen again and again, and I've had enough.
:{{A|vo arlq002 4 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You're saying The Knave did all that?
:{{A|vo arlq002 4 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' It's just... That doesn't seem like something she would do. She's scary and all, but it seems like even she has lines she wouldn't cross.
:{{A|vo arlq002 4 creirve 09.ogg}} '''Clervie:''' Heh, I knew you wouldn't believe me.
:{{A|vo arlq002 4 creirve 10.ogg}} '''Clervie:''' Everyone thinks she's a good person. They all think of her like a real "Mother"...
:{{A|vo arlq002 4 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' "Mother"?
:{{A|vo arlq002 4 creirve 11.ogg}} '''Clervie:''' But she doesn't deserve that title. She's disgraced it and tarnished it... and if I had things my way, I'd never see her again.
:{{A|vo arlq002 4 creirve 12.ogg}} '''Clervie:''' If only [[Perrie]] were here. She'd understand...
:{{A|vo arlq002 4 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Perrie... There's that name again.
:{{A|vo arlq002 4 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Also, Paimon's getting a strange feeling...
:{{A|vo arlq002 4 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' It almost feels like she's not really "here" with us. Paimon can't tell if she's actually talking to us, or if she's mistaken us for someone else...
:{{DIcon}} I'm not sure either.
:{{DIcon}} She's a spirit. It could be anything.
:{{A|vo arlq002 4 paimon 12.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hmm... Well, in any case, it seems like she really needs someone to talk to. We should keep her company for a little longer.
:{{A|vo arlq002 4 paimon 13.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' She looks so young, but it seems like she's been through a lot.
:{{A|vo arlq002 4 creirve 13.ogg}} '''Clervie:''' It's getting windy. I should close the window...
:{{A|vo arlq002 4 creirve 14.ogg}} '''Clervie:''' Ooh, look at the moon! Isn't it pretty? ...Hey, wanna hear a secret? I heard that if you look up at the night sky in Snezhnaya, you can see the aurora. It's supposed to be super pretty... even prettier than the moon tonight.
:{{DIcon}} I'd love to see it.
:{{A|vo arlq002 4 creirve 15.ogg}} '''Clervie:''' Perrie and I promised each other, that once we're older, we're gonna go see it together.
:{{A|vo arlq002 4 creirve 16.ogg}} '''Clervie:''' But I can't find her. I'm worried she's also been... No, that wouldn't happen to her. She's special. Mother likes her a lot.
:{{A|vo arlq002 4 creirve 17.ogg}} '''Clervie:''' I should really go talk to Mother, but we just fought. She doesn't want to see me, and I'm too scared to face her.
:{{A|vo arlq002 4 creirve 18.ogg}} '''Clervie:''' What should I do...
:{{Color|menu|Clervie appears lost in thought. She stands there silently and doesn't say another word.}}
:{{Black Screen|After some time, Clervie seems to come back to herself. She gives a weak smile and leaves on her own.}}
:{{A|vo arlq002 4 paimon 14.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' *sigh*... Paimon really doesn't understand what's going on with her.
:{{A|vo arlq002 4 paimon 15.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Well, let's head back. We've got an early morning tomorrow!
{{Dialogue End}}

;(Talk to Gorou, optional)
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1901802 gorou 55.ogg}} '''Gorou:''' Hmm? I thought you were going to survey the scene at Yae Publishing House?
----
;(Go to Yae Publishing House and keep watch)
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1902601 nobuhiro 01.ogg}} '''Nobuhiro:''' Alright, everyone, settle down!
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1902601 nobuhiro 02.ogg}} '''Nobuhiro:''' We are gathered here today united by a common purpose! Now, who can tell me what they think that might be?
:{{DIcon}} (Let's see what this is all about...)
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1902601 hiroshi 01.ogg}} '''Hiroshi:''' Well of course, it's... to tell the whole world about how wonderful Ms. Hina is!
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1902601 nobuhiro 03.ogg}} '''Nobuhiro:''' An excellent answer!
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1902601 nobuhiro 04.ogg}} '''Nobuhiro:''' How gentle she is... how understanding she is... how delightfully mischievous she can be, on occasion...
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1902601 nobuhiro 05.ogg}} '''Nobuhiro:''' We can all testify to the great joy that Ms. Hina has brought to our lives. But my friends, there are so many people out there in this world who still need Ms. Hina's salvation.
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1902601 nobuhiro 06.ogg}} '''Nobuhiro:''' We can help by spreading the good news about Ms. Hina to every soul in the world!
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1902601 yuka 01.ogg}} '''Yuka:''' My friend... do you have a moment to talk about Ms. Hina?
:{{DIcon}} I've never heard of her.
:{{DIcon}} Who?
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1902601 yuka 02.ogg}} '''Yuka:''' Friends, I found one! Someone needs our help!
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1902601 nobuhiro 07a.ogg}} {{A|vo wlcop001 1902601 nobuhiro 07b.ogg}} '''Nobuhiro:''' Shhh! Calm your voice down, we don't want to scare {{MC|him|her}} off!
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1902601 nobuhiro 08.ogg}} '''Nobuhiro:''' Hello, my friend. On this joyous day, we would like to open our hearts to you and tell you about the existence of a perfect being.
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1902601 nobuhiro 09.ogg}} '''Nobuhiro:''' She is gentle, kind, understanding... she is the brightest star in our sky. Here, have this pamphlet.
:[[File:Item Mysterious Flyer.png|thumb|Mysterious Flyer]]
:;Mysterious Flyer
::Teyvat's Big Sister
::Gentle and kind, she answers all your questions
::She'll help you be rid of all your troubles!
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1902601 hiroshi 02.ogg}} '''Hiroshi:''' So what do you think?
:{{DIcon}} Looks kind of familiar...
:{{DIcon}} What's this...?
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1902601 nobuhiro 10.ogg}} '''Nobuhiro:''' Oh, my apologies. In my excitement, I forgot to give you all the details.
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1902601 nobuhiro 11.ogg}} '''Nobuhiro:''' Have you ever come across a magazine called "That's Life," published by the Yae Publishing House?
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1902601 nobuhiro 12.ogg}} '''Nobuhiro:''' It's a monthly magazine featuring, amongst other things, an advice column. We were among the first readers to send in letters seeking advice, and we've received kind and gentle replies to each one.
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1902601 nobuhiro 13.ogg}} '''Nobuhiro:''' Although the editor chose to conceal her name, gender, and other details, we all see her as an empathetic older sister figure, and feel convinced that she must be the same sort of person in real life.
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1902601 hiroshi 03.ogg}} '''Hiroshi:''' There is no mistaking it. Just from her letters, I can feel that she respects me, trusts me... she has a natural ability to connect with people.
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1902601 hiroshi 04.ogg}} '''Hiroshi:''' She's so considerate. She can always sense our true emotions from our letters and never fails to deliver the advice and the encouragement we need.
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1902601 hiroshi 05.ogg}} '''Hiroshi:''' Except when it comes to the topic of romantic love — she's clearly not an expert there. But even then, that just makes her all the more endearing to us!
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1902601 yuka 03.ogg}} '''Yuka:''' Recently, the column went through a low period where it just wasn't popular at all. In fact, they almost axed it.
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1902601 yuka 04.ogg}} '''Yuka:''' Fortunately, Yae Publishing House made the decision to publicize her image, and then the column finally started to grow in popularity.
:{{DIcon}} So Ms. Hina is...
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1902601 nobuhiro 14.ogg}} '''Nobuhiro:''' That's right! Ms. Hina is the person in charge of "That's Life" magazine's advice column. She is the one we all admire and adore so greatly.
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1902601 nobuhiro 15.ogg}} '''Nobuhiro:''' And so, when we heard that Yae Publishing House would be revealing the official likeness of Ms. Hina today, we immediately came here from wherever we were, all over the nation, to gather together...
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1902601 nobuhiro 16.ogg}} '''Nobuhiro:''' ...and to witness this grand moment in history!
:{{DIcon}} (I wonder how Gorou would react to this...)
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1902601 nobuhiro 17.ogg}} '''Nobuhiro:''' Please, gaze upon the radiant beauty of Ms. Hina, see how truly lovely she is...
{{Dialogue End}}
{{Quest Description|update|You've learned the truth behind Ms. Hina. Do you want to break this news to Gorou?}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Talk to Hiroshi, optional)
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1902601 hiroshi 06.ogg}} '''Hiroshi:''' Welcome to the Ms. Hina Fan Club!

;(Talk to Nobuhiro, optional)
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1902601 nobuhiro 18.ogg}} '''Nobuhiro:''' I've been following Ms. Hina's column since the very first issue of "That's Life."

;(Talk to Yuka, optional)
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1902601 yuka 05.ogg}} '''Yuka:''' I don't know if you know the word "fan"? [[Alice|A friendly adventurer lady]] taught it to us a few years ago. She seemed to know everything.
----
;(Go back and look for Gorou)
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1902602 gorou 01.ogg}} '''Gorou:''' Oh? Hey, there you are.
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1902602 gorou 02.ogg}} '''Gorou:''' Is you-know-who at Yae Publishing House?
:{{DIcon}} No, she isn't.
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1902602 gorou 03.ogg}} '''Gorou:''' Phew... That's good.
:{{DIcon}} What's up, Gorou?
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1902602 gorou 04.ogg}} '''Gorou:''' I just finished writing my replies, so I was about to head to Yae Publishing House and hand them in.
:{{DIcon}} Why are you helping to write for them?
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1902602 gorou 05.ogg}} '''Gorou:''' Why...? Hmm.
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1902602 gorou 06.ogg}} '''Gorou:''' I guess it's because I can help people this way. Also, the editor said to me, "This is something that only you are capable of."
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1902602 gorou 07.ogg}} '''Gorou:''' They made quite a solemn request when they first approached me, so I felt like I couldn't refuse it. But once I'd settled into it, I found myself really enjoying it.
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1902602 gorou 08.ogg}} '''Gorou:''' Before I knew it, I had written hundreds of replies, and sometimes they'd respond again just to thank me. It made me so happy whenever they'd compliment me.
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1902602 gorou 09.ogg}} '''Gorou:''' Every time I think about that terrifying woman, I feel like I want nothing to do with Yae Publishing House. But then, whenever I think about how my replies can help so many people, I feel a sense of responsibility.
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1902602 gorou 10.ogg}} '''Gorou:''' By this point, I'm so used to it that I'd probably find it hard to adjust if I ever gave it up.
:{{DIcon}} (I can't let Gorou know the full story...)
:{{DIcon}} (I'll just have to hide it from him for now...)
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1902602 gorou 11.ogg}} '''Gorou:''' Well... I don't know quite what's going on, but I'd like to get these letters delivered quickly while you-know-who isn't around.
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1902602 gorou 12.ogg}} '''Gorou:''' I'm really looking forward to the readers' reactions when they receive my letters. In the army, people are always a little reserved when talking to me, because I'm a general.
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1902602 gorou 13.ogg}} '''Gorou:''' But those obstacles are removed when you're communicating via letters. Everyone who writes seems to treat me like that one friend who they can share anything and everything with.
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1902602 gorou 14.ogg}} '''Gorou:''' So I'm not about to let them down. Let's head over!
:{{DIcon}} Why don't I deliver them for you...
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1902602 gorou 15.ogg}} '''Gorou:''' Hmm? But Yae Publishing House isn't far from here, if I remember correctly. Let's just head there together.
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1902602 gorou 16.ogg}} '''Gorou:''' Besides, this way, if you-know-who does show up, we can look out for each other. Let's go!
{{Dialogue End}}

{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Go to Yae Publishing House with Gorou to deliver the replies)
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1902603 gorou 01.ogg}} '''Gorou:''' Strange, it seems unusually lively here today.
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1902603 gorou 02.ogg}} '''Gorou:''' I don't come here often. {{Traveler}}, is it like this most of the time?
:{{DIcon}} Not really...
:{{DIcon}} It's a special case today...
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1902603 gorou 03.ogg}} '''Gorou:''' Hey, there seems to be some commotion over there. Let's check it out.
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1902603 nobuhiro 01.ogg}} '''Nobuhiro:''' Allow me to reiterate, my friends! We in the Ms. Hina Fan Club must abide by the club rules!
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1902603 nobuhiro 02.ogg}} '''Nobuhiro:''' Firstly, we mustn't try and probe into Ms. Hina's true identity. We of all people cannot cause her any trouble!
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1902603 nobuhiro 03.ogg}} '''Nobuhiro:''' Secondly, fans of Ms. Hina are not to make any controversial statements when representing the fan club. We must exercise self-discipline and present a good image in front of other people!
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1902603 nobuhiro 04.ogg}} '''Nobuhiro:''' Thirdly, while our mission is to promote Ms. Hina in every way possible, if someone we're talking to says they're not interested, we are to respect that, and not go forcing it down their throats!
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1902603 nobuhiro 05.ogg}} '''Nobuhiro:''' And finally! We are here today because Ms. Hina has brought us together. But we are also here to change ourselves for the better, for her sake! Can we do that, people? Can we do that?
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1902603 hiroshi 01.ogg}} '''Hiroshi:''' Yes, we can!
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1902603 yuka 01.ogg}} '''Yuka:''' Always make her proud, and never bring her down!
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1902603 gorou 04.ogg}} '''Gorou:''' Oh! So this is what they call a "Fan Club."
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1902603 gorou 05.ogg}} '''Gorou:''' I don't know whose fan club it is, but they are raring to go! Reminds me of the rallying speeches we used to give before going into battle.
:{{DIcon}} Hehe...
:{{DIcon}} Heh, yeah...
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1902603 gorou 06.ogg}} '''Gorou:''' Hmm, something's up, isn't it... I can tell, you're avoiding my gaze.
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1902603 gorou 07.ogg}} '''Gorou:''' Did something happen? It's not "her," is it?
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1902603 hiroshi 02.ogg}} '''Hiroshi:''' Excuse me, friend...
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1902603 hiroshi 03.ogg}} '''Hiroshi:''' Something about you looks awfully similar to Ms. Hina...
:{{DIcon}} You're imagining things!
:{{DIcon}} No resemblance whatsoever!
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1902603 hiroshi 04.ogg}} '''Hiroshi:''' I see, well, one way or another, fate has brought you here. Have you ever heard of Ms. Hina?
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1902603 gorou 08.ogg}} '''Gorou:''' Sorry, I'm not sure...
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1902603 hiroshi 05.ogg}} '''Hiroshi:''' Well, now's as good a time as any for you to find out more!
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1902603 hiroshi 06.ogg}} '''Hiroshi:''' Ms. Hina is gentle, kind, and considerate. You can tell her anything that is bothering you, and she will patiently advise you on how to deal with it.
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1902603 gorou 09.ogg}} '''Gorou:''' Oh! Well, she sounds like a very pleasant person to be around!
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1902603 gorou 10.ogg}} '''Gorou:''' She must be the polar opposite of Yae Miko... right, {{Traveler}}?
:{{DIcon}} Haha...
:{{DIcon}} I couldn't say...
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1902603 yuka 02.ogg}} '''Yuka:''' But he's the spitting image of Ms. Hina... I wonder if they're blood relatives...
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1902603 hiroshi 07.ogg}} '''Hiroshi:''' Shh! Have you forgotten? We may not pry into Ms. Hina's identity!
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1902603 yuka 03.ogg}} '''Yuka:''' At least let's take a photo with him...
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1902603 hiroshi 08.ogg}} '''Hiroshi:''' Ahem. Friend, may we... take a photo with you?
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1902603 hiroshi 09.ogg}} '''Hiroshi:''' We borrowed a Kamera specifically to witness the official unveiling of Ms. Hina's image today...
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1902603 gorou 11.ogg}} '''Gorou:''' Sure, that's fine.
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1902603 gorou 12.ogg}} '''Gorou:''' {{Traveler}}, why do they want to take a picture with me?
:{{DIcon}} It's a Narukami Island custom!
:{{DIcon}} It's a quirky practice of the Yae Publishing House!
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1902603 gorou 13.ogg}} '''Gorou:''' Alright, sure...
:{{Black Screen|''People cluster around Gorou, and he takes a great many photos with them.''}}
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1902603 gorou 14.ogg}} '''Gorou:''' That should do it... Right, I should really be heading to the Yae Publishing House to hand in those letters now.
:{{DIcon}} (Phew, managed to keep him in the dark...)
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1902603 kuroda 01.ogg}} '''Kuroda:''' Make way, everyone! Make way!
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1902603 kuroda 02.ogg}} '''Kuroda:''' The Ms. Hina billboard is here... Please, make some space, coming through!
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1902603 nobuhiro 06.ogg}} '''Nobuhiro:''' Hey, everybody! It's the real Ms. Hina!
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1902603 hiroshi 10.ogg}} '''Hiroshi:''' Ms. Hina! Ms. Hina!
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1902603 gorou 15.ogg}} '''Gorou:''' Now I'm curious too... Let's go over and take a look, {{Traveler}}.
:{{DIcon}} No...
:{{DIcon}} You can't...
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1902603 gorou 16.ogg}} '''Gorou:''' Hmm? Why, what's the problem?
:{{DIcon}} I heard Yae Miko is about to come back!
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1902603 gorou 17.ogg}} '''Gorou:''' Really!? Then we can't stay, let's get out of here!
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1902603 gorou 18.ogg}} '''Gorou:''' As curious as I am to see what all the fuss is about... it'll have to wait until next time. So, {{Traveler}}, please join me again the next time I'm delivering letters.
{{Dialogue End}}

==Steps==
# Intercept [[Xiangling]] on her way to [[Liyue]]
# Talk to Xiangling
# Continue looking for the right ingredients
# Collect three [[Lotus Head]]s (0/3)
# Continue looking for the right ingredients

==Gameplay Notes==

==Dialogue==
{{Quest Description|To your surprise, [[Draff]] did not intend to reprimand Xiangling, but instead wanted her to help promote [[Springvale]]'s meat products instead. Sticking to her principles, Xiangling refused to cook for advertising, and would have left if she was not attracted to the smell of [[Brook]]'s cooking. What began as a chat devolved into disagreement about how to prepare food, and ended in the declaration of a cook-off between the head chef of Springvale and the chef from Liyue.}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Talk to Xiangling)
:{{A|vo xllq003 2 xiangling 01.ogg}} '''Xiangling:''' I think we're getting close...
:{{A|vo xllq003 2 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Have you decided what you're looking for yet?
:{{A|vo xllq003 2 xiangling 02.ogg}} '''Xiangling:''' Of course not!
:{{A|vo xllq003 2 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Then how are you so sure of yourself?
:{{A|vo xllq003 2 xiangling 03.ogg}} '''Xiangling:''' That's just my style. If I decided in advance exactly how I was going to cook something, there'd be no element of surprise to the dish.
:{{A|vo xllq003 2 xiangling 04.ogg}} '''Xiangling:''' In the same way, if I knew what I was looking for before I found it, it wouldn't be a surprise.
:{{A|vo xllq003 2 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' But that's so risky...
:{{A|vo xllq003 2 xiangling 05.ogg}} '''Xiangling:''' Relax, this is how I came up with all the signature dishes at [[Wanmin Restaurant]].
:{{A|vo xllq003 2 xiangling 06.ogg}} '''Xiangling:''' Let's look around here, I'll let you know when I find something I like.

;(Approach the pool of Lotuses)
:{{A|vo xllq003 3 xiangling 01.ogg}} '''Xiangling:''' Check out those Lotus Heads — look how fresh they are!
:{{A|vo xllq003 3 xiangling 02.ogg}} '''Xiangling:''' Boar steak with lotus seeds... This could work!
:{{A|vo xllq003 3 xiangling 03.ogg}} '''Xiangling:''' Okay, let's gather them.

;(After obtaining three Lotus Heads)
:{{A|vo xllq003 4 xiangling 01.ogg}} '''Xiangling:''' Hee-hee, this should be enough.
:{{A|vo xllq003 4 xiangling 02.ogg}} '''Xiangling:''' It's not every day you come to Liyue. Let's keep looking and see what else we can find.

;(Approach Xiangling near the Jueyun Chilis)
:{{A|vo xllq003 5 xiangling 01.ogg}} '''Xiangling:''' Wow, Jueyun Chilis!
:{{A|vo xllq003 5 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Aw, that's such a cute name.
:{{A|vo xllq003 5 xiangling 02.ogg}} '''Xiangling:''' Maybe so, but those little fellas pack quite a punch.
:{{A|vo xllq003 5 xiangling 03.ogg}} '''Xiangling:''' From what I've observed spicy food is a rarity in Mondstadt. So this will be perfect.
:{{A|vo xllq003 5 xiangling 04.ogg}} '''Xiangling:''' Go and pick some! Get a good handful.

;(Talk to Xiangling)
:{{A|vo xllq003 7 xiangling 01.ogg}} '''Xiangling:''' I still feel like we're lacking something...
:{{DIcon}} What do you mean?
:{{DIcon}} Do you mean it's not impressive enough?
:{{A|vo xllq003 7 xiangling 02.ogg}} '''Xiangling:''' It's missing a little boom shaka-laka!
:{{A|vo xllq003 7 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yeah, now that you mention it, it is a little boom shaka-laka-lacking.
:{{DIcon}} A shaka-laka-loada what now?
:{{DIcon}} Paimon, you understand this?
:{{A|vo xllq003 7 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hehehe...
:{{A|vo xllq003 7 xiangling 03.ogg}} '''Xiangling:''' Brook may be a stickler for convention, but she is a talented chef nonetheless.
:{{A|vo xllq003 7 xiangling 04.ogg}} '''Xiangling:''' There's no doubt she will source the fanciest-quality ingredients. To win this will take a truly mind-blowing dish...
:{{A|vo xllq003 7 xiangling 05.ogg}} '''Xiangling:''' Something like sea-serpent salad, stir-fried [[Qingxin]] flower, or wild mushrooms in a rich slime jus.
:{{A|vo xllq003 7 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Urgh... a slime jus!?
:{{A|vo xllq003 7 xiangling 06.ogg}} '''Xiangling:''' Haha, I know how weird it sounds but I guarantee you it tastes incredible.
:{{A|vo xllq003 7 xiangling 07.ogg}} '''Xiangling:''' I'll make some for you next time!
:{{DIcon}} Can't wait to try it.
::{{A|vo xllq003 7 xiangling 08a.ogg}} '''Xiangling:''' Hee-hee, you won't be disappointed when you taste it, although it looks a teensy bit gross.
:{{DIcon}} Eh... No need.
::{{A|vo xllq003 7 xiangling 08b.ogg}} '''Xiangling:''' I don't get it, what's not to love...?
:{{A|vo xllq003 7 xiangling 09.ogg}} '''Xiangling:''' Never mind that, I've just remembered there's somewhere I never checked out last time.
:{{A|vo xllq003 7 xiangling 10.ogg}} '''Xiangling:''' My gut tells me that's where we'll hit the jackpot. Let's take a look!
{{Dialogue End}}

:{{A|vo xtlllq005 16 montluson 01.ogg}} '''Montluson:''' {{Traveler}}, Great Shaman, sorry to keep you waiting. Shall we head out?

:{{A|vo xtlllq005 22 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wait, what was that? What is this place?

:{{A|vo xtlllq005 22 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh?
:{{DIcon}} Is this the [[Night Kingdom]]?
:{{A|vo xtlllq005 22 citlali 02.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' No, this is a space constructed using memories as a medium. The principle is similar, but the two are not the same.
:{{A|vo xtlllq005 22 huizilin 01.ogg}} '''???:''' Correct!
:{{A|vo xtlllq005 22 citlali 03.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' Huitzilin!?
:{{A|vo xtlllq005 22 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What?
:{{A|vo xtlllq005 22 citlali 04.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' ...No, it's just a trace of her consciousness left behind after creating this space.
:{{A|vo xtlllq005 22 huizilin 02.ogg}} '''Huitzilin:''' Friends, this is my question to you — what is our strongest weapon against the Abyss? In my opinion, it's "memory."
:{{A|vo xtlllq005 22 huizilin 03.ogg}} '''Huitzilin:''' After all, is it not after losing the capacity for memory, love, and compassion that our enemies fell to the Abyss?
:{{A|vo xtlllq005 22 huizilin 04.ogg}} '''Huitzilin:''' That is why, with our memories, we possess a power the Abyss cannot hope to match.
:{{A|vo xtlllq005 22 huizilin 05.ogg}} '''Huitzilin:''' I have discovered the perfect medium for us to wield that weapon. You know it as "color."
:{{A|vo xtlllq005 22 huizilin 06.ogg}} '''Huitzilin:''' The more cherished the memory, the more vivid its color. As memories disappear, their color fades first. That is why color is the best vehicle to wield the power of memory.
:{{A|vo xtlllq005 22 huizilin 07.ogg}} '''Huitzilin:''' Guided by vibrant colors, your capacity for memory is what will allow you to navigate this maze.
:{{A|vo xtlllq005 22 huizilin 08.ogg}} '''Huitzilin:''' Without that capacity, enemies will fail to cross the barrier in front of them and be trapped here for eternity.
:{{A|vo xtlllq005 22 huizilin 09.ogg}} '''Huitzilin:''' So, be brave, my friends, and march forward!
:{{A|vo xtlllq005 22 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Any ideas, Citlali?
:{{A|vo xtlllq005 22 citlali 05.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' Hmph, sounds like she left a tutorial. Not surprising, she always did have to hand-hold her talentless students... Follow me.

;(Approach the platform)
;(Enemies appear)

:{{A|vo xtlllq005 22 citlali 07.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' Looks like a few monsters made it out of the battle all those years ago.

:{{A|vo xtlllq005 22 citlali 08.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' Must be one of the mechanics of the maze.
:{{A|vo xtlllq005 22 citlali 09.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' I'm guessing the purpose is to help allies navigate this place...

;(Walk on the bridge made of floating platforms)

;(Leave the maze)

:{{A|vo xtlllq005 23 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Whoa, so pretty! The thing inside the sphere looks exactly like the maze!

:{{A|vo xtlllq005 23 montluson 01.ogg}} '''Montluson:''' That color...
:{{A|vo xtlllq005 23 citlali 03.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' The dye was modified using a secret technique to harness the power of memories and create mazes like the one we just witnessed.
:{{A|vo xtlllq005 23 citlali 04.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' Without that power, it's just a normal dye. But, the color it produces is still quite rare.
:{{A|vo xtlllq005 23 citlali 05.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' I would say this is the most direct evidence that the Battle of Seven Colors actually took place.
:{{A|vo xtlllq005 23 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' The expert has spoken!

:{{A|vo xtlllq005 23 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What are you doing!?
:{{A|vo xtlllq005 23 citlali 07.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' You noticed my signal... Not bad, {{Traveler}}. We make a good team.
:{{A|vo xtlllq005 23 montluson 03.ogg}} '''Montluson:''' *scoff*... So, you've been watching me?
:{{A|vo xtlllq005 23 citlali 08.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' A self-proclaimed book merchant who's never heard of "[[Shogun Almighty: Reborn as Raiden With Unlimited Power]]"? Please, that work was a commercial success across [[Teyvat]].
:{{A|vo xtlllq005 23 citlali 09.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' I knew you were fishy, but I didn't expect you to pull something like this.
:{{A|vo xtlllq005 23 allier 01.ogg}} '''Allier:''' Monsieur Montluson, we just need a few pictures for our research, not the artifact itself! What if it gets damaged or destroyed!?

:{{A|vo xtlllq005 23 montluson 05.ogg}} '''Montluson:''' What if that was my goal all along?
:{{A|vo xtlllq005 23 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What!?
:{{A|vo xtlllq005 23 montluson 06.ogg}} '''Montluson:''' Hmph, pretending to be a book merchant, pretending to promote the history of Natlan and its heroes... was the only way to get information out of the people in this tribe.
:{{A|vo xtlllq005 23 montluson 07.ogg}} '''Montluson:''' But, make no mistake — I'm no lowly merchant. I am the future owner of the largest printing company in all of Teyvat!
:{{A|vo xtlllq005 23 montluson 08.ogg}} '''Montluson:''' But, the dye in that sphere ruined all my plans before they could even get off the ground...
;(Flashback begins)
:{{A|vo xtlllq005 23 otila 01.ogg}} '''Otila:''' We've received a report that your advertisement in the paper makes false claims. [[Fontaine]] law demands it be taken down immediately.
:{{A|vo xtlllq005 23 montluson 09.ogg}} '''Montluson:''' False claims? The dye I advertised is an unprecedented innovation! It produces colors of unmatched radiance!
:{{A|vo xtlllq005 23 otila 02.ogg}} '''Otila:''' Unfortunately, its qualities are neither "unprecedented" nor "unmatched." According to the lady who made the report, she saw a woven scroll in Natlan made with a similar dye.
:{{A|vo xtlllq005 23 otila 03.ogg}} '''Otila:''' Even more miraculous, that substance dates back hundreds of years.
:{{A|vo xtlllq005 23 montluson 10.ogg}} '''Montluson:''' How!? Creating this dye is the culmination of my entire life's work! You're telling me I'm hundreds of years too late!?
:{{A|vo xtlllq005 23 otila 04.ogg}} '''Otila:''' Calm down, sir...
:{{A|vo xtlllq005 23 montluson 11.ogg}} '''Montluson:''' Sorry, it's just... I know this product will be a hit. The economic boost to Fontaine will be huge! We just need to advertise it as written.
:{{A|vo xtlllq005 23 montluson 12.ogg}} '''Montluson:''' Fontaine's publishing industry is one of the best in the world. All we need to do is publish something in the paper, and all of Teyvat will think it was our invention first!
:{{A|vo xtlllq005 23 montluson 13.ogg}} '''Montluson:''' We don't need to worry about more reports. Fontaine is far more advanced than Natlan — no one will believe such an innovative product could come from a place like that.
:{{A|vo xtlllq005 23 otila 05.ogg}} '''Otila:''' That... That goes against all of Fontaine's advertisement regulations! We can't do that!
:{{A|vo xtlllq005 23 montluson 14.ogg}} '''Montluson:''' What if... I give you a portion of the profits? All you have to do is let the advertisement stay.
:{{A|vo xtlllq005 23 otila 06.ogg}} '''Otila:''' You're trying to bribe me? Careful, I'm dangerously close to reporting this to Monsieur [[Neuvillette]].
:{{A|vo xtlllq005 23 montluson 15.ogg}} '''Montluson:''' *frustrated grumble*...
;(Flashback ends)
:{{A|vo xtlllq005 23 montluson 16.ogg}} '''Montluson:''' I knew, if I was just allowed to market my product, it would be a hit — a bestseller, even! I would be a giant in the printing industry!
:{{A|vo xtlllq005 23 montluson 17.ogg}} '''Montluson:''' But now, no one will see it as anything more than a... poor imitation marketed centuries too late. No matter how good the product actually is, not a single one will sell.
:{{A|vo xtlllq005 23 montluson 18.ogg}} '''Montluson:''' *scoff* I will never accept that someone from this backwards, ignorant nation could come up with that dye. Not two hundred years before me!
:{{A|vo xtlllq005 23 citlali 10.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' Even when the truth is right in front of you?
:{{A|vo xtlllq005 23 montluson 19.ogg}} '''Montluson:''' *scoff* "Truth" is in the eye of the beholder. I'm already in the printing industry — I can go into publishing no problem.
:{{A|vo xtlllq005 23 montluson 20.ogg}} '''Montluson:''' All I have to do is destroy this sphere, write a detailed report about my findings, and publish it around the world. Then, the so-called "truth" becomes your word against mine.
:{{A|vo xtlllq005 23 montluson 21.ogg}} '''Montluson:''' Once my report is accepted as "fact," no one can accuse me of making "false claims."
:{{A|vo xtlllq005 23 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' That's awful! What happened to "restoring the truth of history"!?
:{{A|vo xtlllq005 23 montluson 22.ogg}} '''Montluson:''' Haha, that plan hasn't changed! I will continue to spread MY truth for all of Teyvat to see!
:{{DIcon}} You talk a big game.
:{{DIcon}} But, did you forget who you're talking to?
:{{A|vo xtlllq005 23 montluson 23.ogg}} '''Montluson:''' Ah, you mean a hero of Natlan who's not actually from Natlan? And a great shaman who, according to rumor, abandoned her tribe long ago?
:{{A|vo xtlllq005 23 montluson 24.ogg}} '''Montluson:''' From a practical perspective, there's no reason for either of you to stand against me.
:{{A|vo xtlllq005 23 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Shows what you know!
:{{A|vo xtlllq005 23 citlali 11.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' Since you like rumors so much, have you heard the one about what happens to people who get on my bad side?
:{{A|vo xtlllq005 23 montluson 25.ogg}} '''Montluson:''' Ah, the wrath of Granny Itztli... Like I said, our interests aren't at odds.
:{{A|vo xtlllq005 23 montluson 26.ogg}} '''Montluson:''' I knew from the beginning that you would accept my invitation, considering Huitzilin was your rival.
:{{A|vo xtlllq005 23 montluson 27.ogg}} '''Montluson:''' You've lived longer than her, you're far stronger than her... And yet, she has always been more revered than you. Now, that can change.
:{{A|vo xtlllq005 23 montluson 28.ogg}} '''Montluson:''' With the backing of the printing industry, I can take any book and send it to all four corners of Teyvat. This part of Natlan's history will be mine to tell.
:{{A|vo xtlllq005 23 montluson 29.ogg}} '''Montluson:''' And in my version, I can erase the Battle of Seven Colors. You can be the one to have all the glory!
:{{A|vo xtlllq005 23 citlali 12.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' That's not real history.
:{{A|vo xtlllq005 23 montluson 30.ogg}} '''Montluson:''' That's a no, then? *scoff* Your history means nothing to me. But, it's not allowed to stand in the way of my Mora!
:{{A|vo xtlllq005 23 citlali 13.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' Done running your mouth? Good... Before handing you over to the tribe, I think I'll have my way with you first.
:{{DIcon}} Teach him a lesson.
:{{DIcon}} And make it stick.
:{{A|vo xtlllq005 23 grudoc 01.ogg}} '''Grudoc:''' If this comes to a fight, per my contract, you're gonna have to go through me.
:{{A|vo xtlllq005 23 montluson 31.ogg}} '''Montluson:''' That's right! I didn't pay all that Mora for nothing!
:{{A|vo xtlllq005 23 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wait, aren't you subordinates of [[The Captain]]? Why are you helping someone who wants to erase Natlan's history!?
:{{A|vo xtlllq005 23 grudoc 02.ogg}} '''Grudoc:''' The Captain? You actually bought that?
:{{A|vo xtlllq005 23 grudoc 03.ogg}} '''Grudoc:''' United in the pursuit of Mora, we travel the land to collect debts. Our loyalty is to [[Regrator]], his interests, and his wealth.
:{{A|vo xtlllq005 23 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Regrator!?
:{{A|vo xtlllq005 23 montluson 32.ogg}} '''Montluson:''' Haha, The Captain means nothing to them. They serve a different [[Harbinger]] altogether, Regrator!
:{{A|vo xtlllq005 23 grudoc 04.ogg}} '''Grudoc:''' This man has the potential to become a giant in the printing industry and disrupt Fontaine's economic system. This aligns with Regrator's interests.
:{{A|vo xtlllq005 23 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' It's all been a lie, from the very beginning!
:{{DIcon}} This doesn't change anything, Paimon.
:{{DIcon}} Just one more guy to beat up.
:{{A|vo xtlllq005 23 citlali 14.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' I don't care who you serve. When it comes to punishment, I don't discriminate.
{{Dialogue End}}
{{Quest Description|update|Montluson and his group finally reveal their true colors. They try to make a deal with you...}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(After defeating the Fatui)
:{{A|vo xtlllq005 24 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hmph, that's what you get for messing with the Hero of Natlan and Granny Itztli! They could give Regrator a run for his Mora!
:{{A|vo xtlllq005 24 grudoc 01.ogg}} '''Grudoc:''' *cough*... When did this person get so strong? Looks like the men following The Captain failed to update us on the latest intelligence...
:{{A|vo xtlllq005 24 grudoc 02.ogg}} '''Grudoc:''' Not good... This is becoming more trouble than it's worth. You're on your own.
:{{A|vo xtlllq005 24 montluson 01.ogg}} '''Montluson:''' Hey! What about our contract? Your boss signed it himself!
:{{A|vo xtlllq005 24 grudoc 03.ogg}} '''Grudoc:''' Our boss never signs a contract without loopholes. Even a veteran businessman like yourself fell into his trap... That's what makes him the best.
:{{A|vo xtlllq005 24 grudoc 04.ogg}} '''Grudoc:''' Go home and read the fine print... All I did was trigger the exculpatory clause.
:{{A|vo xtlllq005 24 montluson 02.ogg}} '''Montluson:''' You...
:{{A|vo xtlllq005 24 grudoc 05.ogg}} '''Grudoc:''' The other stipulations have been fulfilled. I set up explosives around the cave, strong enough to destroy this place — as instructed.
:{{A|vo xtlllq005 24 grudoc 06.ogg}} '''Grudoc:''' Oh, and for security purposes, all explosives have been rigged to blow at a specific time. Shouldn't be too long now...
:{{A|vo xtlllq005 24 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What? This whole place is gonna collapse?
:{{A|vo xtlllq005 24 montluson 03.ogg}} '''Montluson:''' You were supposed to wait until I made it out! Are you trying to kill me?
:{{A|vo xtlllq005 24 grudoc 07.ogg}} '''Grudoc:''' That depends on how fast you can run! I'm off... Ugh!
:{{A|vo xtlllq005 24 citlali 01.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' You think you can just waltz out of here? {{Traveler}}, stop them, and then we'll make a break for it!
:{{DIcon}} Can do!
:{{A|vo xtlllq005 24 grudoc 08.ogg}} '''Grudoc:''' Hmph, if I'm caught, I implicate my boss. Time for the backup plan...
:{{A|vo xtlllq005 24 citlali 02.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' Wait... Don't!
:{{Color|menu|Grudoc plays his last card, withdrawing a polearm from the ruins and hurling it at the sphere...}}

;(Scene transitions back to the maze of color)
:{{A|vo xtlllq005 25 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Where are we? Back in the maze? Our surroundings look different, though... What did that Fatui guy do?
:{{DIcon}} We need to find Citlali.
:{{DIcon}} She's probably somewhere around here, too.
:{{A|vo xtlllq005 25 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Good point... She'll know how to get out of here. Let's hurry — if we don't make it out before the cave collapses, we might never be able to leave!
:{{DIcon}} Where could she be?
:{{A|vo xtlllq005 25 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Let's see... Citlali!
:{{A|vo xtlllq005 25 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Looks like it's not gonna be that easy... What should we do?
:{{DIcon}} I saw the special color.
:{{DIcon}} It seems to be guiding me.
:{{A|vo xtlllq005 25 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' The special color? The one you saw on that woven scroll? Why would it appear around here...
:{{DIcon}} There's no time to think about that.
:{{A|vo xtlllq005 25 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You're right... Lead the way, {{Traveler}}!

;(Elsewhere, on a different floating platform of the maze)
:{{A|vo xtlllq005 26 citlali 01.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' He triggered it just like that!? If the technique isn't activated correctly...
:{{A|vo xtlllq005 26 huizilin 01.ogg}} '''???:''' Instead of a realm of memory, the subjects in question will be trapped in a temporary space like this.
:{{A|vo xtlllq005 26 huizilin 02.ogg}} '''???:''' If you cannot escape in time, it's mutually assured destruction. But, I can't fault someone for using it as a last resort.
:{{A|vo xtlllq005 26 citlali 02.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' ...Hmph, I knew it. Someone of your skill wouldn't leave behind memory fragments just to parrot instructions. You must have the capacity for conscious thought...
:{{A|vo xtlllq005 26 huizilin 03.ogg}} '''Huitzilin:''' I appreciate the compliment. It's been a long time, my friend.
:{{A|vo xtlllq005 26 citlali 03.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' This is no time for a reunion. The cave outside is about to collapse. I know time flows differently in this place, but that still doesn't leave us much time.
:{{A|vo xtlllq005 26 citlali 04.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' Can you help me get out?
:{{A|vo xtlllq005 26 huizilin 04.ogg}} '''Huitzilin:''' You misunderstand, Citlali... I'm nothing more than a fragment of memory. There's not much I can do.
:{{A|vo xtlllq005 26 citlali 05.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' What do you mean? This space can be manipulated, right? The exit of your maze... I remember its structure. If I create an exit here, I can leave.
:{{A|vo xtlllq005 26 citlali 06.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' ...You just need to tell me how to manipulate this space.
:{{A|vo xtlllq005 26 huizilin 05.ogg}} '''Huitzilin:''' The maze you saw earlier was constructed using the memories of many warriors of Natlan.
:{{A|vo xtlllq005 26 huizilin 06.ogg}} '''Huitzilin:''' When people leave deep impressions on each other, their memories form connections.
:{{A|vo xtlllq005 26 huizilin 07.ogg}} '''Huitzilin:''' These connections are particularly strong between comrades-in-arms.
:{{A|vo xtlllq005 26 huizilin 08.ogg}} '''Huitzilin:''' That is how I created my maze — the connections between the memories were my needle and thread, and the special color was my fabric.
:{{A|vo xtlllq005 26 huizilin 09.ogg}} '''Huitzilin:''' But, if that color is crudely combined with an isolated memory, one without connections, you get a place like this.
:{{A|vo xtlllq005 26 huizilin 10.ogg}} '''Huitzilin:''' This space is a combination of my color and your memories. There is no way to alter or construct anything within it.
:{{A|vo xtlllq005 26 huizilin 11.ogg}} '''Huitzilin:''' Because there are no "connections" at your disposal.
:{{A|vo xtlllq005 26 citlali 07.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' ...Hmph, over two hundred years, and not a single lasting connection. This is my punishment, huh...
:{{A|vo xtlllq005 26 huizilin 12.ogg}} '''Huitzilin:''' Well, at the very least, you have a connection to me. Otherwise, I wouldn't be able to appear in this space.
:{{A|vo xtlllq005 26 citlali 08.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' That's only because you never gave me a moment's peace... Still, it's a shame you're not around. You said it yourself — a memory fragment can't be used to create the "connections" I need...
:{{A|vo xtlllq005 26 huizilin 13.ogg}} '''Huitzilin:''' Citlali...
:{{A|vo xtlllq005 26 citlali 09.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' But, now that I have the chance to talk to you again, I need you to give me an answer.
:{{A|vo xtlllq005 26 citlali 10.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' Your special technique... You didn't pass it on to your students. You passed it onto the rival you could never beat — me. What I want to know is... Why?
:{{A|vo xtlllq005 26 huizilin 14.ogg}} '''Huitzilin:''' ...So, you figured it out.
:{{A|vo xtlllq005 26 citlali 11.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' After what I saw in the maze and everything you just told me, I'm certain the technique at the center of all this... is the same one you taught me all those years ago.
:{{A|vo xtlllq005 26 citlali 12.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' But, you never brought up the fact that you used it to win a battle. From your description, it might as well have been a simple color trick.
:{{A|vo xtlllq005 26 citlali 13.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' I'm getting the feeling you always meant for me to come here... But, if this is a foreshadowed event, I'm not happy with the narrative setup.
:{{A|vo xtlllq005 26 huizilin 15.ogg}} '''Huitzilin:''' Citlali, ever since you learned that technique, you've been able to see a special color, haven't you?
:{{A|vo xtlllq005 26 citlali 14.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' You mean...
:{{A|vo xtlllq005 26 huizilin 16.ogg}} '''Huitzilin:''' That color is the core of the technique, but it isn't my invention. It's something I discovered in the work of our ancestors.
:{{A|vo xtlllq005 26 huizilin 17.ogg}} '''Huitzilin:''' More specifically, you could call it... the color of memories.
:{{A|vo xtlllq005 26 huizilin 18.ogg}} '''Huitzilin:''' In truth, passing on the technique is a process of using that color to "tint" another person's memories.
:{{A|vo xtlllq005 26 huizilin 19.ogg}} '''Huitzilin:''' Yes, the technique has the power to decide victory. But, in my opinion, the capacity to add color to someone's memories is where the true value lies.
:{{A|vo xtlllq005 26 huizilin 20.ogg}} '''Huitzilin:''' You are fated to live a far longer life than me, Citlali. I couldn't bear the thought of all those years existing as a blank canvas in your memory...
:{{A|vo xtlllq005 26 huizilin 21.ogg}} '''Huitzilin:''' So, I wanted to leave a little color behind...
:{{A|vo xtlllq005 26 citlali 15.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' ...Your color, you mean.
:{{A|vo xtlllq005 26 huizilin 22.ogg}} '''Huitzilin:''' One day, you, too, will want to leave behind your color in someone else's memory. When that day comes, you will understand my decision.
:{{A|vo xtlllq005 26 citlali 16.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' I...
:{{Color|menu|Citlali recalls the words that you said before...}}
:{{Black Screen|{{A|vo xtlllq005 26 hero 01.ogg}} {{A|vo xtlllq005 26 heroine 01.ogg}} (So, if you still need time, let me choose to remember you first.)}}
:{{A|vo xtlllq005 26 citlali 17a.ogg}}<!--{{A|vo xtlllq005 26 citlali 17b.ogg}}--> '''Citlali:''' ...I have to get out of here. That's the only way to rescue them.
:{{A|vo xtlllq005 26 huizilin 23.ogg}} '''Huitzilin:''' Citlali, what are you—
:{{A|vo xtlllq005 26 citlali 18.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' I understand the true principle of this technique now. If I can't construct an exit, then I will separate this color from my memories by force!
:{{A|vo xtlllq005 26 huizilin 24.ogg}} '''Huitzilin:''' But, you could lose a portion of your memories that way!
:{{A|vo xtlllq005 26 citlali 19a.ogg}}<!--{{A|vo xtlllq005 26 citlali 19b.ogg}}--> '''Citlali:''' I know, but my memory is just a blank canvas I've neglected for two hundred years. My friends are worth the risk...
:{{A|vo xtlllq005 26 hero 02.ogg}} {{A|vo xtlllq005 26 heroine 02.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' (I have to find her...)
:{{A|vo xtlllq005 26 citlali 20.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' {{Traveler}}?
:{{A|vo xtlllq005 26 huizilin 25.ogg}} '''Huitzilin:''' When you entered the realm of memory I constructed, I used your memories to learn about your recent experiences. I have a feeling... you're the one who will be saved this time.
:{{A|vo xtlllq005 26 huizilin 26.ogg}} '''Huitzilin:''' After two hundred years, someone has appeared by your side — the kind of person I could have never anticipated.
:{{A|vo xtlllq005 26 huizilin 27a.ogg}}<!--{{A|vo xtlllq005 26 huizilin 27b.ogg}}--> '''Huitzilin:''' The Night Kingdom harbors Natlan's memories, and the Traveler's connection to that realm is incredibly strong, surpassing even the shamans who worship the Lord of the Night.
:{{A|vo xtlllq005 26 huizilin 28a.ogg}} {{A|vo xtlllq005 26 huizilin 28b.ogg}} '''Huitzilin:''' This means that, even without your tutelage, {{MC|f=s}}he can see the "color of memories."
:{{A|vo xtlllq005 26 citlali 21.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' What did you say?
:{{A|vo xtlllq005 26 huizilin 29a.ogg}} {{A|vo xtlllq005 26 huizilin 29b.ogg}} '''Huitzilin:''' Although {{MC|f=s}}he doesn't know how to wield it, {{MC|f=s}}he unknowingly left behind a trace of color in your memories.
:{{A|vo xtlllq005 26 huizilin 30a.ogg}} {{A|vo xtlllq005 26 huizilin 30b.ogg}} '''Huitzilin:''' That was enough to guide {{MC|m=him|f=her}} to this space. You now have a "connection" at your disposal.
:{{A|vo xtlllq005 26 huizilin 31.ogg}} '''Huitzilin:''' Well, Citlali, it looks like part of this was foreshadowed, but the rest is a surprise.
:{{A|vo xtlllq005 26 citlali 22.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' {{Traveler}}... {{Traveler}}!
:{{A|vo xtlllq005 26 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' That's... Citlali's voice! She's just up ahead!
:{{A|vo xtlllq005 26 huizilin 32.ogg}} '''Huitzilin:''' This is goodbye, my friend. Your memories over the past two hundred years are much more than a "blank canvas"... Cherish them.
:{{A|vo xtlllq005 26 citlali 23.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' Huitzilin...
:{{Color|menu|Huitzilin's memory fragment dissipates, and you and Paimon discover Citlali's whereabouts.}}
:{{A|vo xtlllq005 26 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Citlali!
:{{A|vo xtlllq005 26 citlali 24.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' Paimon, {{Traveler}}...
:{{DIcon}} We finally found you.
:{{DIcon}} Let's find a way to get out of here.
:{{A|vo xtlllq005 26 citlali 25.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' ...Hold my hand!

;(Scene transitions to outside the domain)
:{{A|vo xtlllq005 27 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Did we teleport out? Man, that place was so—
:{{Color|menu|Explosions and the sounds of a collapse echo from the ruins.}}
:{{A|vo xtlllq005 27 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Whoa! We made it out just in time!
:{{Color|menu|Citlali reseals the entrance to the ruins.}}
:{{A|vo xtlllq005 27 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wonder what happened to the Fatui guy and the others...
:{{A|vo xtlllq005 27 citlali 01.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' He was most likely trapped inside that space, just like us.
:{{A|vo xtlllq005 27 citlali 02.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' The external structures supporting that space would have collapsed with the ruin. Unless he managed to escape, he would have been crushed.
:{{A|vo xtlllq005 27 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' He still preferred that to being caught, huh...
:{{DIcon}} What about the Fontainians?
:{{A|vo xtlllq005 27 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' They were standing a bit further away, right? They probably weren't pulled into the space. Maybe they already made a run for it...
:{{A|vo xtlllq005 27 allier 01.ogg}} '''Allier:''' Um... Hello...
:{{A|vo xtlllq005 27 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' It's one of that guy's employees!<ref group="Note">Actual voice-over: "It's one of Montluson's employees!"</ref> Quick, restrain him!
:{{A|vo xtlllq005 27 allier 02.ogg}} '''Allier:''' I—I can explain! I had no idea Montluson was such a terrible person. I couldn't stop him from running, so I stayed behind and tried to find people to help rescue you.
:{{A|vo xtlllq005 27 allier 03.ogg}} '''Allier:''' I'm so glad you managed to get out of there!
:{{A|vo xtlllq005 27 citlali 03.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' Either way, the guards will take you back to the tribe. You'll be their problem.
:{{A|vo xtlllq005 27 allier 04.ogg}} '''Allier:''' I understand...
:{{A|vo xtlllq005 27 citlali 04.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' Anyway, I'm not here to harp on you. I just need to know one thing — which way did he run?
:{{A|vo xtlllq005 27 allier 05.ogg}} '''Allier:''' He went that way! But, I'm not sure if you can catch up...
:{{A|vo xtlllq005 27 citlali 05.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' That way... Hmph, unless he suddenly grows a pair of wings, I think we're okay.
:{{A|vo xtlllq005 27 citlali 06.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' {{Traveler}}, Paimon, come with me.
{{Dialogue End}}
{{Quest Description|update|Having foiled Montluson's conspiracy and successfully escaped, you must now capture him and bring him to justice...}}

;(Talk to Allier, optional)
:{{A|vo dialog xtlllq005 allier 01.ogg}} '''Allier:''' I'll wait here for the tribal guards. I'm so sorry the ruin was destroyed...

;(Approach the [[Iktomisaur]]s)
:{{A|vo xtlllq005 28 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hey, it's Elder [[Tlapo]] and a group of iktomisaurs! They caught Montluson!
:{{A|vo xtlllq005 28 citlali 01.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' Something felt off about him yesterday, so I set a few things in motion... Looks like it's time for that foreshadowing to pay off.
:{{A|vo xtlllq005 28 montluson 01.ogg}} '''Montluson:''' My bank balance... No! NO!
:{{A|vo xtlllq005 28 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What's wrong with him?
:{{A|vo xtlllq005 28 citlali 02.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' Ah, that's one of the tricks Claw uses to scare people... He makes people hallucinate the thing that scares them the most.
:{{A|vo xtlllq005 28 citlali 03.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' It's particularly effective on weak-minded people like him.
:{{A|vo xtlllq005 28 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Serves him right!
:{{A|vo xtlllq005 28 claw 01.ogg}} '''Tlapo:''' ...
:{{A|vo xtlllq005 28 citlali 04.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' I know, it was a lot to ask, making you come all the way out here during the day...
:{{A|vo xtlllq005 28 claw 02.ogg}} '''Tlapo:''' !
:{{A|vo xtlllq005 28 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Was that a declaration? Elder Tlapo didn't appoint us to a whole other task, did he?
:{{A|vo xtlllq005 28 citlali 05.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' Forget about him for now... The iktomisaurs will make sure Montluson doesn't escape before the guards arrive. In the meantime, we have unfinished business, remember?
:{{A|vo xtlllq005 28 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Right! The special scroll! But, the dye is buried underneath a bunch of rubble now...
:{{A|vo xtlllq005 28 citlali 06.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' Don't worry, Huitzilin's technique hasn't been lost at all. Come with me, I'll explain everything at my house.
:{{A|vo xtlllq005 28 citlali 07.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' Oh, and {{Traveler}}, everything you said about memory... I've finally figured out my answer.
:{{A|vo xtlllq005 28 claw 03.ogg}} '''Tlapo:''' !
:{{A|vo xtlllq005 28 citlali 08.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' I knew you'd want to tag along. Let's go.

:{{A|vo yllq001 1 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, hey, [[Huixin]]! Long time no see!

:{{A|vo yllq001 1 huixin 08.ogg}} '''Huixin:''' He seems very fond of you two. I'm sure chatting with you will make him very happy.
:{{A|vo yllq001 1 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Sure! Let's go!
{{Dialogue End}}
{{Quest Description|update|After talking to Huixin, you decide to go to the second floor of Yanshang Teahouse to visit Uncle Tian.}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Approach Uncle Tian)
:{{A|vo yllq001 3 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Uncle Tian! We're here to chat with you!
:{{A|vo yllq001 3 uncletian 01.ogg}} '''Uncle Tian:''' Oh? Hah, what a lovely surprise. Welcome. Huixin, why don't you go downstairs and get the shopkeeper to make us a fresh pot of tea?
:{{A|vo yllq001 3 uncletian 02.ogg}} '''Uncle Tian:''' I heard that you've been traveling all over the place recently. I would very much like to hear your adventure stories.
:{{DIcon}} We're more concerned about your health, Uncle Tian.
:{{DIcon}} Is everything okay?
:{{A|vo yllq001 3 uncletian 03.ogg}} '''Uncle Tian:''' Huixin told you, didn't she... Don't worry, I'm quite alright. It's just the years gradually catching up with me.
:{{A|vo yllq001 3 uncletian 04.ogg}} '''Uncle Tian:''' As I grow older, I'm starting to find that with many things, though the mind is willing, the flesh is weak. Especially recently, I've noticed a rather drastic drop in my energy levels.
:{{A|vo yllq001 3 uncletian 05.ogg}} '''Uncle Tian:''' I am still very much in good standing as the Tianshu today. Nevertheless, I wish to pass on the position before my mental acuity begins to decline beyond redemption.
:{{A|vo yllq001 3 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' How difficult is it to transfer the Tianshu position?
:{{A|vo yllq001 3 uncletian 06.ogg}} '''Uncle Tian:''' Oh, well, you see, the Tianshu is a rather unique position among the Liyue Qixing.
:{{A|vo yllq001 3 uncletian 07.ogg}} '''Uncle Tian:''' Historically speaking, the Tianshu rarely appears in public. We stay behind the scenes, planning and giving advice. So a public selection process would not be suitable.
:{{A|vo yllq001 3 uncletian 08.ogg}} '''Uncle Tian:''' We also want to keep any prospective Tianshu candidates free from influence by outside forces, so we tend to be as discreet as possible in their assessment and appointment.
:{{A|vo yllq001 3 uncletian 09.ogg}} '''Uncle Tian:''' For these reasons, the incumbent Tianshu typically recommends their candidate of choice, and this is then approved by the other Qixing members.
:{{A|vo yllq001 3 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So in other words, you pick someone, and then Lady [[Keqing]], Lady [[Ningguang]], and the other Qixing appoint them?
:{{A|vo yllq001 3 uncletian 10.ogg}} '''Uncle Tian:''' Correct. Unfortunately, due to my health, I won't be able to assess every candidate myself.
:{{A|vo yllq001 3 uncletian 11.ogg}} '''Uncle Tian:''' Not to despair, however, because I've found someone exceptionally capable to act on my behalf as assessment officer. In fact, I believe you recently became acquainted with her yourself.
:{{A|vo yllq001 3 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh? Who is it?
:{{A|vo yllq001 3 yelan 01.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' I'm heartbroken... I thought it might take you a little longer than this to forget all about me?
:{{A|vo yllq001 3 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' It's [[Yelan]]!
:{{A|vo yllq001 3 yelan 02.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' Jackpot. Uncle Tian here asked me to assess three candidates for him.
:{{A|vo yllq001 3 yelan 03.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' Fancy joining me, {{Traveler}}? You'll be among the first to get to know the next Tianshu. Might be a good opportunity for you.
:{{A|vo yllq001 3 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hmm... What do you think, {{Traveler}}?
:{{DIcon}} It's a good opportunity.
::{{A|vo yllq001 3 paimon 07a.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Paimon thinks so too! It can't be a bad thing to be on good terms with a new Qixing, right?
:{{DIcon}} I'm not really interested.
::{{A|vo yllq001 3 paimon 07b.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Makes sense. After all, whoever the next Tianshu is, it doesn't really make any difference to us.
::{{A|vo yllq001 3 paimon 07b 1.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Still, Paimon's really curious to see which candidates Uncle Tian picked! So let's go take a look!
:{{A|vo yllq001 3 yelan 04.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' Alright then.
:{{A|vo yllq001 3 yelan 05.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' Though I gotta say, Uncle Tian, you say you're into behind-the-scenes planning? My work's of the covert variety, too... Don't you think I might make a good Tianshu?
:{{A|vo yllq001 3 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh!? Yelan, you want to be the next Tianshu?
:{{A|vo yllq001 3 uncletian 12.ogg}} '''Uncle Tian:''' I'm not opposed to the idea, but I suspect Ningguang wouldn't let you go very easily after how long you've been working together.
:{{A|vo yllq001 3 uncletian 13.ogg}} '''Uncle Tian:''' So how about this... If your investigation reveals that none of the other candidates are qualified for the position, I'll recommend you for the job.
:{{A|vo yllq001 3 yelan 06.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' Deal. Well, you guys take your time. Everything's all set for the assessments to go ahead.
:{{A|vo yllq001 3 yelan 07.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' Meet me on the first floor when you're ready. Until then... have a pleasant conversation.
:{{A|vo yllq001 3 yelan 08.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' Oh — and no need to pay for your tea. As the new owner of this fine establishment, this round's on the house.
:{{Black Screen|After telling Uncle Tian about your recent adventures, you return to the entrance of the teahouse...}}
:{{A|vo yllq001 3 yelan 09.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' You're all set?
:{{A|vo yllq001 3 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Uncle Tian seems really worn down. It's like all his energy's gone...
:{{A|vo yllq001 3 yelan 10.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' Yeah. It may sound harsh, but Uncle Tian is past his prime. He's not cut out for this anymore.
:{{A|vo yllq001 3 yelan 11.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' So, he's recommended three candidates. Their names are: [[Qianwei]], [[Mingbo]], and [[Zhiyi]].
:{{A|vo yllq001 3 yelan 12.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' Qianwei is a wealthy entrepreneur, Mingbo works at the Liyue [[Ministry of Civil Affairs]], and Zhiyi is focused on study and travel.
:{{A|vo yllq001 3 yelan 13.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' Try to keep all that in mind... Of course, it doesn't really matter if you forget, since we'll be assessing them at Yuehai Pavilion in a short while.
:{{A|vo yllq001 3 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Qianwei, Mingbo, Zhiyi... Paimon should be able to remember their names, but what does the assessment involve, exactly?
:{{A|vo yllq001 3 yelan 14.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' Let's leave that until we get to [[Yuehai Pavilion]].
:{{A|vo yllq001 3 yelan 15.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' Alright. Heads in the game, people. The stakes don't get much higher than a change in the Qixing. We can't afford to miss anything, no matter how small.
:{{A|vo yllq001 3 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Got it! {{Traveler}}, we'll keep our eyes wide open!

:{{A|vo dialog yllq001 uncletian 01.ogg}} '''Uncle Tian:''' Oh, are the assessments complete?
:{{A|vo dialog yllq001 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Umm... Not just yet...

:{{A|vo yllq001 4 yelan 07.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' Failing the occurrence of some cataclysmic event, they will not be permitted to change their plan. Therefore, these three piles of documents in front of us represent where each candidate stands on key policy issues.

;(Talk to Yelan again)

:{{A|vo yllq001 9 yelan 01.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' Finished, huh? What did you think?
:{{A|vo yllq001 9 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Everyone took it very seriously...

:{{A|vo yllq001 9 yelan 07.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' You know what, let's leave the self-introduction there and move onto some questions.

:{{A|vo yllq001 9 zhiyi 01.ogg}} '''Zhiyi:''' Hello. Hehe... Not gonna lie, I'm feeling a little nervous.
:{{A|vo yllq001 9 zhiyi 02.ogg}} '''Zhiyi:''' What would you like to know? You're here to assess me, so ask away and I'll answer your questions to the best of my ability.
:{{A|vo yllq001 9 yelan 08.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' Your manifesto is very wide in its scope, but you don't seem to be personally involved in many of the specific fields. How can you be sure that you have the ability to put your plan into action?

What I've tried to do is strike a balance. In other words, present an optimal solution to all the problems as a whole.

:{{A|vo yllq001 9 zhiyi 06.ogg}} '''Zhiyi:''' A great question! Well, I'd start by having my colleagues and the secretaries of the Yuehai Pavilion evaluate any proposals before implementation. Post-implementation, it would all come down to the results.
:{{A|vo yllq001 9 zhiyi 07.ogg}} '''Zhiyi:''' If it turned out that my judgment was to blame for poor results, I would take responsibility.

:{{DIcon}} Meh...

:{{A|vo yllq001 9 yelan 12.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' As you saw, Qianwei is highly knowledgeable. He proposes many excellent ideas in his manifesto which effectively target the big issues.

:{{A|vo yllq001 9 yelan 15.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' But he and Qianwei are otherwise polar opposites. Mingbo is not very articulate and comes across as very timid in conversation.

:{{A|vo yllq001 9 yelan 16.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' Last but not least, Zhiyi. His manifesto is full of pertinent details, his methodology is sound, and his proposals cover a broad range of fields, which is quite a rare feat.
:{{A|vo yllq001 9 yelan 17.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' The depth he goes into in each and every area means it can only be a product of painstaking work. Plus, he is modest and good at dealing with people.
:{{A|vo yllq001 9 yelan 18.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' But what really interests me is that many of his views happen to coincide with Uncle Tian's. Having someone like Zhiyi take the position would certainly put Uncle Tian's mind at rest.
:{{A|vo yllq001 9 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Great!
:{{A|vo yllq001 9 yelan 19.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' We'll see. Let's go back and report to Uncle Tian.
