:{{A|vo nvlq001 3 navia 02.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Hahaha, that's alright! I've heard many stories about her from the rest of the Spina. They've always said that they were sure we would have gotten along famously.
:{{A|vo nvlq001 3 navia 03.ogg}} '''Navia:''' While my papa was stiff like a board, my mother was supposedly super cheerful and funny. Their complementary personalities allowed them to make up for each other's flaws.
:{{A|vo nvlq001 3 navia 04.ogg}} '''Navia:''' My father would run the businesses and expand our reach, while my mother would keep the peace and make sure that everyone was happy. Their work made sure that the Spina could grow and thrive.
:{{A|vo nvlq001 3 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Sounds like they were not just a well-matched couple, but fantastic business partners as well!
:{{A|vo nvlq001 3 navia 05.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Yeah, but those are just stories and anecdotes after all. It's hard for me to piece together a more complete or intimate picture of her.
:{{A|vo nvlq001 3 navia 06.ogg}} '''Navia:''' But sometimes, I'd still look at the Clementine Line and wonder... Would the Spina and Poisson still be what they are today, had my mother survived?
:{{A|vo nvlq001 3 navia 07.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Silver once said that a name is a kind of inscription — a way to etch a memory into the world. When given a name, a cold, inanimate object can gain a completely new meaning.
:{{A|vo nvlq001 3 navia 08.ogg}} '''Navia:''' So, I will always associate the Line with her in my heart.
:{{A|vo nvlq001 3 navia 09.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Over the past few weeks, I've also begun to appreciate how water can take in and hold our most intense feelings and memories, as well as how one may reflect on their past by watching the sea.
:{{A|vo nvlq001 3 navia 10.ogg}} '''Navia:''' I've lost many beloved people and memories to the sea. Even though I cannot stop for them, and must continue to keep moving...
:{{A|vo nvlq001 3 navia 11.ogg}} '''Navia:''' The fact won't change that they existed in my life, and gave me the reason and motivation to move forward.
:{{DIcon}} Do you miss them?
::{{A|vo nvlq001 3 navia 12a 1.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Always, but no matter what, we can't change the past.
:{{DIcon}} Missing Melus and [[Silver]]?
::{{A|vo nvlq001 3 navia 12b 1.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Of course. I still haven't really gotten used to a life without them...
;(Ignoring both options)
::{{A|vo nvlq001 3 navia 12a 1.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Always, but no matter what, we can't change the past.
:{{A|vo nvlq001 3 navia 13.ogg}} '''Navia:''' But I tell myself that I need to keep looking towards the future. Everyone, even my parents, have all already overcome so many obstacles.
:{{A|vo nvlq001 3 navia 14.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Besides, I'm the President of Spina di Rosula. I've got to keep my chin up.
----
;(Arriving at Poisson)
:{{A|vo nvlq001 3 navia 15.ogg}} '''Navia:''' We've reached the shore. Let's go — I'll show you the new Poisson.
:{{Color|menu|Navia leaves the boat first. Watching her, Paimon whispers to you...}}
:{{A|vo nvlq001 3 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Navia... Do you think she's doing alright?
:{{DIcon}} She seems to be managing.
:{{DIcon}} She's always been having to cope with one thing or another.
:{{A|vo nvlq001 3 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Okay, Paimon supposes you're right... She's really been through a lot. It couldn't have been easy, shouldering so much by herself...

;(Talk to Florent in Poisson)
:{{A|vo nvlq001 4 florent 01.ogg}} '''Florent:''' Boss, you're back! {{Traveler}} and Paimon, welcome back to Poisson.
:{{A|vo nvlq001 4 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh hey! Fancy seeing you again, Florent! Is it your turn to take care of Navia now?
:{{A|vo nvlq001 4 navia 01.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Hey, I can totally take care of myself! For the time being, I'll go around without any attendants.
:{{A|vo nvlq001 4 navia 02.ogg}} '''Navia:''' We did hand over some of Melus' old responsibilities to Florent, though. It's been really nice to have him around to help out.
:{{A|vo nvlq001 4 florent 02.ogg}} '''Florent:''' Thank you for the compliment, Boss.
:{{A|vo nvlq001 4 florent 03.ogg}} '''Florent:''' As you see, I've been working closely with the Boss on rebuilding Poisson.
:{{A|vo nvlq001 4 florent 04.ogg}} '''Florent:''' Mr. Melus was an extremely capable and respected member of the Spina. I've got some really big shoes to fill.
:{{A|vo nvlq001 4 navia 03.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Alright, alright, there's no need to be so formal. Everyone's practically old friends by now.
:{{A|vo nvlq001 4 navia 04.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Were you waiting here for me? Did we manage to make any progress on the statue?
:{{A|vo nvlq001 4 florent 05.ogg}} '''Florent:''' Yeah, we contacted a sculptor about the job, but they can't get started on sourcing a correctly sized block without knowing the design that we want to use first.
:{{A|vo nvlq001 4 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You're commissioning a statue?
:{{A|vo nvlq001 4 navia 05.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Ah, so basically, we've been meaning to commission a statue of my parents in commemoration of everything they've done for the Spina and the town of Poisson.
:{{A|vo nvlq001 4 navia 06.ogg}} '''Navia:''' But since my father was known as "Callas the Unfaithful" for the longest time, it would have been too controversial to commission a statue of him.
:{{A|vo nvlq001 4 navia 07.ogg}} '''Navia:''' But now that his name has been cleared, and the town is also being rebuilt, I thought this would be the perfect chance to actually realize this dream.
:{{A|vo nvlq001 4 florent 06.ogg}} '''Florent:''' The funds to build the statue were freely donated by the people of Poisson, to show their appreciation for Ms. Clementine and Mr. Callas and everything they did.
:{{DIcon}} Shouldn't Navia be featured with them, too?
:{{A|vo nvlq001 4 navia 08.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Me? I'm just the newbie President that's running around and causing everyone trouble.
:{{A|vo nvlq001 4 navia 09.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Maybe we can have this conversation again in a few decades, once I've done more for the town and the people.
:{{A|vo nvlq001 4 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hey, there's no need to be so humble! Didn't you just help save the entire country?
:{{A|vo nvlq001 4 florent 07.ogg}} '''Florent:''' I agree wholeheartedly. I also believe that Boss should have a place on the statue.
:{{A|vo nvlq001 4 navia 10.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Hey, if you keep inflating my ego like this, I might just float off into the sky with my parasol.
:{{A|vo nvlq001 4 navia 11.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Haha, just kidding! There's no way that I'd accept that kind of compliment at face value. At a minimum, I'd have to match what my father did for the people.
:{{DIcon}} Well, if that's what you think...
:{{DIcon}} I think it'll just be a matter of time.
:{{A|vo nvlq001 4 navia 12.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Haha, thanks for the vote of confidence! I just don't think I'm ready yet.
:{{A|vo nvlq001 4 navia 13.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Anyway, Florent, now it's up to us to confirm the final design, right?
:{{A|vo nvlq001 4 florent 08.ogg}} '''Florent:''' Mhm. We can ask the sculptor to start looking for a good block once we've decided on the poses for Ms. Clementine and Mr. Callas.
:{{A|vo nvlq001 4 florent 09.ogg}} '''Florent:''' But we haven't had any real discussions yet on the possible designs. I feel like I should get a few promising designs first, and then send them over to you to review...
:{{A|vo nvlq001 4 navia 14.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Eh, there's no need for all that. Let's decide on a design right now!
:{{A|vo nvlq001 4 navia 15.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Hey, {{Traveler}}, come over here with me.
:{{DIcon}} Me?
:{{DIcon}} What are you doing?
:{{A|vo nvlq001 4 navia 16.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Modeling a few poses, of course! Here, just pretend to be Callas, and I'll be Clementine.
:{{A|vo nvlq001 4 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' That's, um...
:{{A|vo nvlq001 4 navia 17a.ogg}}<!--{{A|vo nvlq001 4 navia 17b.ogg}}--> '''Navia:''' Didn't you say on the boat that Callas and Clementine sounded like great partners? Well, then there's no one better to fill this role than my most valuable partner!
:{{A|vo nvlq001 4 navia 18.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Florent, let's grab some reference shots!
:{{A|vo nvlq001 4 florent 10.ogg}} '''Florent:''' You've got it, Boss. I'll go get the Kamera.
:{{A|vo nvlq001 4 navia 19.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Well, what do you think? Got any ideas?
:{{DIcon}} Uhh, shouldn't you be running this show?
:{{A|vo nvlq001 4 navia 20.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Well, I've actually discussed it a bit with Florent before, but I could never come up with any fresh or original ideas... It's probably because my idea of them is already kind of set in stone.
:{{A|vo nvlq001 4 navia 21.ogg}} '''Navia:''' So I want to pick your brain for a bit, and see if you can come up with some new and interesting ideas.
:{{A|vo nvlq001 4 florent 11.ogg}} '''Florent:''' I'm all good here, Boss. Feel free to start posing whenever.
:{{DIcon}} Okay, then let's try for something... imposing.
::{{A|vo nvlq001 4 navia 22a 1.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Imposing, huh... Oh, I've got it! Let's try this!
::{{A|vo nvlq001 4 florent 12a 1.ogg}} '''Florent:''' This pose... It makes me recall Spina di Rosula's glorious golden age.
::{{A|vo nvlq001 4 paimon 05a 1.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' But isn't Clementine's pose a bit too... bold and heroic? Was she really that kind of person?
::{{A|vo nvlq001 4 paimon 05a 2.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' If we were to stick with this pose, maybe people would wonder if she was actually the real boss behind the scenes.
::{{A|vo nvlq001 4 florent 12a 2.ogg}} '''Florent:''' Well, tabloids did indeed speculate as much back in the day. But the Spina pulled a few strings, and made both the report and the journalist disappear...
::{{A|vo nvlq001 4 paimon 05a 3.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, Paimon was just kidding! Please don't make Paimon disappear!
::{{A|vo nvlq001 4 navia 22a 2.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Haha, what Florent meant was that we asked the journalist to choose a new alias.
::{{A|vo nvlq001 4 navia 22a 3.ogg}} '''Navia:''' You're right, though, that this may not accurately represent the image of her in our hearts. Let's try to come up with something else.
:;(Dialogue returns to option selection with this option removed)
:{{DIcon}} Okay, then let's try... looking out into the distance.
::{{A|vo nvlq001 4 navia 22b 1.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Ah, by that... do you mean as if we were standing on a boat and looking out at the sea? Sure, let's give that a try!
::{{A|vo nvlq001 4 paimon 05b 1.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Whoa, you really remind Paimon of a captain and their first mate!
::{{A|vo nvlq001 4 paimon 05b 2.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' "Look over there, my dear Clementine. As you can see, every tree on that island is dripping with Mora fruit."
::{{A|vo nvlq001 4 florent 12b 1.ogg}} '''Florent:''' Hmm... But there's something off with the composition. This pose makes Mr. Callas look too tall next to the lady.
::{{A|vo nvlq001 4 navia 22b 2.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Oh, I see what you mean. Then let's swap.
::{{A|vo nvlq001 4 paimon 05b 3.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Well, Paimon is a fan! A statue like this would look fantastic on a boat.
::{{A|vo nvlq001 4 navia 22b 3.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Wait, but we can't do that. Very few people would see the statue if we were to put it on a boat. This statue is meant to be placed in the town.
::{{A|vo nvlq001 4 florent 12b 2.ogg}} '''Florent:''' But then, since we're putting it in the town, the whole point of the pose would be lost.
::{{A|vo nvlq001 4 paimon 05b 4.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, okay... We'll try to think of something else...
:;(Dialogue returns to option selection with this option removed)
:{{DIcon}} Okay, then why don't we just strike a happy pose?
::{{A|vo nvlq001 4 navia 22c 1.ogg}} '''Navia:''' A... happy pose? You mean, something like... we were laughing together at a funny joke?
::{{A|vo nvlq001 4 florent 12c 1.ogg}} '''Florent:''' Huh, would all that be able to come through with just a picture?
::{{A|vo nvlq001 4 paimon 05c 1.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Would we even be able to tell what they're supposed to be laughing about?
::{{A|vo nvlq001 4 florent 12c 2.ogg}} '''Florent:''' Yeah, and that'd probably be a massive pain to sculpt as well...
::{{A|vo nvlq001 4 paimon 05c 2.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hm, could one of you try striking a pose like you're talking, while the other one laughs?
::{{A|vo nvlq001 4 paimon 05c 3.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Er, that actually sounds pretty hard to pull off. Forget it, let's try something else.
:;(Dialogue returns to option selection with this option removed)

;(After choosing every option)
:{{A|vo nvlq001 4 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ugh, we tried a bunch of different ideas, but none of them felt right. Paimon's all out of brain juice, now, too...
:{{A|vo nvlq001 4 navia 23.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Oh, don't worry, we still got a lot of reference shots out of the session, and each of them can be considered to be a souvenir in their own right. Let's just keep the ideas we tried as backups.
:{{A|vo nvlq001 4 navia 24.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Man, if I knew I was going to do a photoshoot with {{Traveler}}, I would have prepared a lot of outfits and props ahead of time...
:{{A|vo nvlq001 4 navia 25.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Oh, outfits... Ah! That's the errand I forgot back in the city! Do either of you still remember that girl? The girl I went to see with you two. Her name is [[Adele]].
:{{A|vo nvlq001 4 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh! Paimon remembers her! She was the one that we met while investigating Mr. Callas' case, right?
:{{DIcon}} She always believed that her father, [[Jacques]], was a good person.
:{{A|vo nvlq001 4 navia 26.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Yes, that's exactly who I'm talking about! So, after the case, she was finally willing to talk to me, and she told me that she wanted to join the Spina too.
:{{A|vo nvlq001 4 navia 27.ogg}} '''Navia:''' I said that it's fine, but young children are not allowed to join the Spina. She will just have to wait a few years, and then we'll welcome her with open arms. Since she's still a child, though, she thought I was just trying to let her down gently...
:{{A|vo nvlq001 4 navia 28.ogg}} '''Navia:''' But how could I get her to believe that I meant what I said? In the end, I came up with an idea. I'd have a Spina uniform made, and give it to her as a gift.
:{{A|vo nvlq001 4 navia 29.ogg}} '''Navia:''' But I got so busy and distracted in the city that I forgot to pick the uniform up... Ugh, so I did forget something important after all.
:{{A|vo nvlq001 4 florent 13.ogg}} '''Florent:''' Don't worry, Boss. I can send someone to pick it up right away.
:{{A|vo nvlq001 4 navia 30.ogg}} '''Navia:''' On the matter of the statue, we should still come up with a few more ideas for the design. I'll have to trouble you to source some for me.
:{{A|vo nvlq001 4 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' We could have just done that from the start...
:{{DIcon}} Hey, at least this way, we got some cool pictures.
:{{A|vo nvlq001 4 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yeah, you're right... They'll have some value as souvenirs, at least.

;(Colter approaches as the Traveler, Paimon, Navia, and Florent are conversing)
:{{A|vo nvlq001 4 colter 01.ogg}} '''Colter:''' Navia, Florent! Guess who's back!
:{{A|vo nvlq001 4 florent 14.ogg}} '''Florent:''' Huh!? But aren't you supposed to...
:{{A|vo nvlq001 4 navia 31.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Oh, well if it isn't Colter! Back already from the Fortress of Meropide?
:{{A|vo nvlq001 4 colter 02.ogg}} '''Colter:''' Hahaha, that's right! I've finally finished serving my time. Gotta say, turns out I was a lot tougher than I thought!
:{{A|vo nvlq001 4 colter 03.ogg}} '''Colter:''' After I got out, I immediately made a beeline back to Poisson. You could say that familiar briny smell became a primal call, urging me to forget everything else and just come back home.
:{{A|vo nvlq001 4 colter 04.ogg}} '''Colter:''' You wouldn't believe how much I've missed Melissa's Grilled Fish — I dreamed about it every time I had to get a Welfare Meal down there underneath the sea!
:{{A|vo nvlq001 4 florent 15.ogg}} '''Florent:''' It's good to have you back, Colter. You look as well as ever.
:{{A|vo nvlq001 4 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' And this guy is...
:{{A|vo nvlq001 4 navia 32.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Ah, let me introduce you. This is Colter, another of Spina di Rosula's members. He was found guilty and sentenced to the Fortress of Meropide some time ago.
:{{A|vo nvlq001 4 navia 33.ogg}} '''Navia:''' But looking at it now, it was probably another one of [[Marcel (Fontaine)|Marcel]]'s plots while he worked at the [[Confrerie of Cabriere]].
:{{A|vo nvlq001 4 colter 05.ogg}} '''Colter:''' Wait, wait, Mr. Marcel? What do you mean, he was involved in some sort of plot?
:{{A|vo nvlq001 4 florent 16.ogg}} '''Florent:''' Have you not heard anything at all about the "Water from the Primordial Sea" case?
:{{A|vo nvlq001 4 colter 06.ogg}} '''Colter:''' Well, I know that Fontaine got flooded, but then the water levels miraculously receded. I thought that was all there was to it, and didn't care to ask for any more details. Do you mean... Mr. Marcel was somehow involved with all of that?
:{{A|vo nvlq001 4 navia 34.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Looks like we'll have to explain everything from the top. That case... A lot of things have happened in Poisson since then.
:{{A|vo nvlq001 4 navia 35a.ogg}}<!--{{A|vo nvlq001 4 navia 35b.ogg}}--> '''Navia:''' First things first, let me introduce you to these two. They're my most trusted partners, and they've been with me through thick and thin. Now, you could call them Spina di Rosula's VIP helpers.
:{{A|vo nvlq001 4 colter 07.ogg}} '''Colter:''' Oh, nice to meet you! I don't recall Navia ever generously complimenting anyone like that before, so you must be pretty amazing to get that from her!
:{{A|vo nvlq001 4 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hehe, yeah, we are indeed pretty amazing, but we've been cool since before we even met her!
:{{DIcon}} We just followed Navia's lead.
::{{A|vo nvlq001 4 navia 36a 1.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Humble again as always, I see, even when I was totally sincere with my praise.
:{{DIcon}} All credit to Paimon.
::{{A|vo nvlq001 4 paimon 12b 1.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wait, now you suddenly resist taking a dig at Paimon?
:{{A|vo nvlq001 4 colter 08.ogg}} '''Colter:''' Nice, nice. Spina di Rosula always seems to attract great people.
:{{A|vo nvlq001 4 colter 09.ogg}} '''Colter:''' Oh, that reminds me — where are Melus and Silver? Aren't they always by your side?
:{{A|vo nvlq001 4 navia 37.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Um... About that...
:{{A|vo nvlq001 4 florent 17.ogg}} '''Florent:''' Colter, a lot of things happened while you were gone. As you can see, even Poisson isn't quite the same as... how it was before you left.
:{{A|vo nvlq001 4 navia 38.ogg}} '''Navia:''' They lost their lives keeping me safe during the flood.
:{{A|vo nvlq001 4 colter 10.ogg}} '''Colter:''' ...What did you say?
:{{A|vo nvlq001 4 colter 11.ogg}} '''Colter:''' This isn't some kind of morbid welcome-home prank, right? You're just scaring me on purpose, because I don't know anything about what's happened...
:{{A|vo nvlq001 4 navia 39.ogg}} '''Navia:''' I'm sorry, but it's the truth. They weren't the only people we lost, either. Many others, including [[Melissa]], also lost their lives in the disaster.
:{{A|vo nvlq001 4 colter 12.ogg}} '''Colter:''' Melus, and Melissa... Dead? They're just... gone?
:{{A|vo nvlq001 4 colter 13.ogg}} '''Colter:''' Melus... I was planning to give him a surprise gift once I ran into him again in town. Ah, I can't believe it...
:{{A|vo nvlq001 4 paimon 13.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' H—Hey, keep it together...
:{{A|vo nvlq001 4 florent 18.ogg}} '''Florent:''' Melus and Colter were friends for many years, and even served on many missions together during the early days of the Spina. I can understand how he feels.
:{{A|vo nvlq001 4 navia 40.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Let's sit down somewhere, so I can tell you everything that has happened while you were gone. Fair warning, there was... a lot.
:{{A|vo nvlq001 4 colter 14.ogg}} '''Colter:''' I... Okay.

;(Speak to Colter at the large ship in Poisson)
:{{Black Screen|Navia explains everything that has happened recently to Colter.}}
:{{A|vo nvlq001 5 colter 01.ogg}} '''Colter:''' All of this... It's unbelievable... I can't believe that those stories were real, it all really happened. Has the world gone mad?
:{{DIcon}} Had I not personally experienced all those events...
:{{DIcon}} I would also have found them very difficult to accept.
:{{A|vo nvlq001 5 navia 01.ogg}} '''Navia:''' I think you and I both feel the same way about the profound tragedy of Melus's loss, and... the sheer depravity of Marcel's actions.
:{{A|vo nvlq001 5 colter 02.ogg}} '''Colter:''' I thought Mr. Marcel would always stand by the Spina... Everything he had, the Spina gave to him.
:{{A|vo nvlq001 5 colter 03.ogg}} '''Colter:''' It's unconscionable to have received all that, and yet still plot to kidnap and dissolve you for his insane research.
:{{A|vo nvlq001 5 florent 01.ogg}} '''Florent:''' The good news is that the Confrerie of Cabriere is no more. Gone with them, too, is the entire Sinthe manufacturing and distribution network.
:{{A|vo nvlq001 5 florent 02.ogg}} '''Florent:''' We've finally closed the curtain on that long struggle.
:{{A|vo nvlq001 5 colter 04.ogg}} '''Colter:''' Are you sure? But if Marcel wanted to rebel against us, he probably sent word in secret to [[Romeuf]].
:{{A|vo nvlq001 5 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Romewho?
:{{A|vo nvlq001 5 navia 02.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Not a name I've heard before, either.
:{{A|vo nvlq001 5 colter 05.ogg}} '''Colter:''' Florent should remember him. You see, there was once a major internal dispute regarding funding the construction of the aquabus lines.
:{{A|vo nvlq001 5 colter 06.ogg}} '''Colter:''' Romeuf was the leader of the faction that thought such a vast sum of Mora would be better spent improving the town of Poisson.
:{{A|vo nvlq001 5 colter 07.ogg}} '''Colter:''' But Mr. Callas believed that an opportunity to collaborate with the Court of Fontaine and the Fontaine Research Institute was hard to come by, and would allow us to build many valuable relationships.
:{{A|vo nvlq001 5 colter 08.ogg}} '''Colter:''' Not only would the aquabus be a good business investment, it would also boost our reputation among the general populace, eventually paying us massive dividends down the line.
:{{A|vo nvlq001 5 colter 09.ogg}} '''Colter:''' But the two couldn't come to an agreement. Romeuf ended up taking a lot of people with him when he left Spina di Rosula altogether, and the split was on extremely bad terms.
:{{A|vo nvlq001 5 navia 03.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Ugh, and with Papa's stubbornness, I can definitely imagine how it must have gone down...
:{{A|vo nvlq001 5 florent 03.ogg}} '''Florent:''' And, of course, when he was suffering the slings and arrows of outrageous injustice...Those "relationships" that he spent a fortune to build didn't help in the least.
:{{A|vo nvlq001 5 colter 10.ogg}} '''Colter:''' Yeah... You could say it was the price he paid for sticking to his beliefs.
:{{DIcon}} That couldn't have been the first time a dispute like that happened, right?
:{{A|vo nvlq001 5 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, that's a good point! If Callas was really as stubborn as you say, then wouldn't he have argued with the rank and file all the time?
:{{A|vo nvlq001 5 colter 11.ogg}} '''Colter:''' Oh yeah, it eventually became a thing that just happened on every day that ended with "y." But, Navia... I mean, Boss, you might not know this, but he wasn't always like that.
:{{A|vo nvlq001 5 colter 12.ogg}} '''Colter:''' He used to be a lot better with taking counsel. With him listening to our advice, and Ms. Clementine also frequently on our side, it was pretty smooth sailing for a good many years.
:{{A|vo nvlq001 5 colter 13.ogg}} '''Colter:''' But on the matter of the aquabus, even Ms. Clementine completely stood by Mr. Callas' side.
:{{A|vo nvlq001 5 navia 04.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Huh, I never knew... But from my perspective, Romeuf's position had a lot going for it. Couldn't they have sat down and talked it out?
:{{A|vo nvlq001 5 florent 04.ogg}} '''Florent:''' I think the aquabus was just the straw that broke the camel's back. On that topic, they eventually came to a rather... radical conclusion.
:{{A|vo nvlq001 5 florent 05.ogg}} '''Florent:''' They believed that... Ms. Clementine lost her ability to serve as an impartial mediator when she became pregnant with Callas' child.
:{{A|vo nvlq001 5 navia 05.ogg}} '''Navia:''' So... they thought she had betrayed them?
:{{A|vo nvlq001 5 navia 06.ogg}} '''Navia:''' But that doesn't make any sense. Before she was their mediator, my mother was also her own person and a member of the Spina. She should have the right to take any side she wished.
:{{A|vo nvlq001 5 colter 14.ogg}} '''Colter:''' Yeah, but to them, even taking a side was betrayal enough. They felt like their voices could no longer be heard once their sole mediator had gone over to the other side.
:{{A|vo nvlq001 5 colter 15.ogg}} '''Colter:''' Of course, Ms. Clementine then passed away, and Mr. Callas began to regard the completion of the aquabus project as her final wish. With that, the last hope of reconciliation was gone.
:{{A|vo nvlq001 5 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So that's what happened...
:{{A|vo nvlq001 5 florent 06.ogg}} '''Florent:''' From that point on, Romeuf and his people cut ties with the Spina, and never gave us any kind of professional or personal courtesy ever again.
:{{A|vo nvlq001 5 florent 07.ogg}} '''Florent:''' Perhaps they've regarded us as enemies ever since they left. But even so, there is still no proof that they ever acted in concert with Marcel.
:{{A|vo nvlq001 5 colter 16.ogg}} '''Colter:''' I've also heard that they aren't in a good financial position, so they've been lying low for a while. But as long as they exist, they'll continue to be a threat.
:{{A|vo nvlq001 5 navia 07.ogg}} '''Navia:''' I think Colter's got a point. Both Marcel and Romeuf had my father in their sights for a very long time.
:{{A|vo nvlq001 5 navia 08.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Even though Marcel's faction has been dissolved, we still don't know anything about Romeuf's whereabouts. If they're still trying to get revenge on us...
:{{A|vo nvlq001 5 navia 09.ogg}} '''Navia:''' ...With how distracted and vulnerable we are, now would be the best time.
:{{A|vo nvlq001 5 florent 08.ogg}} '''Florent:''' Good thinking, Boss. We should keep an eye on them at all times. I'll let my men know right away.
:{{A|vo nvlq001 5 navia 10.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Mhm, thank you for that, Florent. And Colter, thank you for telling me about this as well.
:{{A|vo nvlq001 5 colter 17.ogg}} '''Colter:''' Don't worry, it's nothing. Do you have a moment right now? How about we go out for a walk?
:{{A|vo nvlq001 5 colter 18.ogg}} '''Colter:''' I've heard so many incredulous things today... I'm finding it a bit hard to calm down, even now. I mean, to think that I'll just... never see them again...
:{{A|vo nvlq001 5 navia 11.ogg}} '''Navia:''' In that case, why don't we go back to the Court? I can pick up Adele's uniform while we're there as well. It'll save Florent's guys a trip.
:{{A|vo nvlq001 5 navia 12.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Want to come with me again, you two? You don't mind, do you, Colter?
:{{A|vo nvlq001 5 colter 19.ogg}} '''Colter:''' O—Oh, of course, that's fine by me.
:{{A|vo nvlq001 5 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Then let's go! Paimon feels like a lot's hinging on this visit.
:{{DIcon}} We want to see Adele cheer up.
:{{DIcon}} We want to see the future star of the Spina.
:{{A|vo nvlq001 5 navia 13.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Hehe, we really are the best of partners. Come on, let's go.
----
{{Quest Description|update|Melus's dear friend Colter grieves over the disaster that has befallen Poisson. As it happens, Navia also wishes to return to the Court of Fontaine, and so you all set off for a short, relaxing trip.}}
;(Leaving Poisson)
:{{A|vo nvlq001 5 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Are we not taking the boat this time?
:{{A|vo nvlq001 5 navia 14.ogg}} '''Navia:''' It's nice to walk from time to time, isn't it? Think of it as something like a hiking trip.
:{{A|vo nvlq001 5 navia 15.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Once we're there, we can stay a few days before we return.
:{{A|vo nvlq001 5 colter 20.ogg}} '''Colter:''' Sounds good... I haven't walked this road in a long time.

;(After walking for some time)
:{{A|vo nvlq001 6 navia 01.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Well, we've walked far enough for now. Let's take a break!
:{{A|vo nvlq001 6 navia 02.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Since we're out for a walk, we shouldn't stress too much about the destination.
:{{A|vo nvlq001 6 colter 01.ogg}} '''Colter:''' Hehe, I've grown old, so I'm not as fit as before. It's a good thing that at least my work down in the Fortress was quite the workout.
:{{A|vo nvlq001 6 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Well, Paimon thinks you're doing great! We didn't have to slow down for you at all.
:{{A|vo nvlq001 6 colter 02.ogg}} '''Colter:''' Back in the days before the aquabus lines were built, we often had to hike north with our goods, then catch a boat to the Court.
:{{A|vo nvlq001 6 colter 03.ogg}} '''Colter:''' Melus and I must have traveled this way hundreds of times. When we were tired, we would lay down for a while on the grass, and when we were hungry, we'd catch a fish or two.
:{{A|vo nvlq001 6 colter 04.ogg}} '''Colter:''' The Spina was still on the rise back then. Mr. Callas was generous, and everyone had the chance to strike it rich. So of course, we all worked really hard.
:{{A|vo nvlq001 6 colter 05.ogg}} '''Colter:''' And now, in the blink of an eye, the aquabus lines have been built, and this road has fallen into disuse.
:{{DIcon}} I don't really think that's a bad thing, though.
:{{A|vo nvlq001 6 colter 06.ogg}} '''Colter:''' Oh, I know. I was just being a little nostalgic.
:{{A|vo nvlq001 6 navia 03.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Then let's stay here a bit longer. Anyone want snacks?
:{{A|vo nvlq001 6 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh! Is this another chance to try some of Navia's macarons? Paimon's been dreaming of them!
:{{A|vo nvlq001 6 navia 04.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Hahaha, yep! I figured you wouldn't say no to a few more.
:{{A|vo nvlq001 6 navia 05.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Oh, wait, let me check if I have all the ingredients... *sigh* Melus and Silver used to take care of tasks like this.
:{{A|vo nvlq001 6 navia 06.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Okay, the stove's looking good, and as for the ingredients...
:{{A|vo nvlq001 6 navia 07.ogg}} '''Navia:''' ...Seems like we're all out of flour and sugar. The two most important ingredients of all.
:{{DIcon}} Should I go get some?
:{{A|vo nvlq001 6 navia 08.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Oh, would you? But it would be too much to ask you to go on a trip just for those...
:{{A|vo nvlq001 6 paimon 03a.ogg}} {{A|vo nvlq001 6 paimon 03b.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' We should contribute to making the macarons, too! Don't worry, we cook out in the wild all the time, so {{MC|m=he|f=she}} should have some stuff on hand.
:{{A|vo nvlq001 6 navia 09.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Oh, that's great! Then I'll leave the ingredient gathering to you. As long as we have some sweet flowers and wheat, I can start the baking.
:{{A|vo nvlq001 6 colter 07.ogg}} '''Colter:''' Then I'll go look for some boxes nearby, for a makeshift table and chairs.
:{{A|vo nvlq001 6 navia 10.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Great, then I'll prep the stove. Let's get to work, everyone!

;(Talk to Navia)
:{{A|vo nvlq001 7 navia 01.ogg}} '''Navia:''' How did it go? Did you find the ingredients?
:;(Opens item submit menu)

;(After submitting one [[Sweet Flower]] and one [[Wheat]])
:{{A|vo nvlq001 8 navia 01.ogg}} '''Navia:''' You've all done your part! Just leave the rest to me.
:{{Color|menu|Navia bakes a batch of macarons with her usual gusto.}}
:{{A|vo nvlq001 8 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Whoa, these macarons look and taste macanificent! Your cooking is as good as ever, Navia!
:{{A|vo nvlq001 8 colter 01.ogg}} '''Colter:''' Boss's baking skills have always been famous. Everyone in the Spina knows how exceptionally talented she is.
:{{A|vo nvlq001 8 navia 02.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Hehe, it's just a hobby. There's no need to praise me for it like that.
:{{A|vo nvlq001 8 colter 02.ogg}} '''Colter:''' Have you two seriously never considered joining us? You're so close to the Boss, and she obviously trusts you with all her heart, so...
:{{DIcon}} There are still some important things we must do.
::{{A|vo nvlq001 8 colter 03a 1.ogg}} '''Colter:''' I see... Is that why you have to always stay on the road?
:{{DIcon}} You really wanna poach me from the Adventurers' Guild, huh?
::{{A|vo nvlq001 8 colter 03b 1.ogg}} '''Colter:''' Hahaha, was it that obvious? I just thought you would be a great fit, that's all.
:{{A|vo nvlq001 8 navia 03a.ogg}}<!--{{A|vo nvlq001 8 navia 03b.ogg}}--> '''Navia:''' Haha, you just happened to walk in on our little reunion. It's actually been quite a while since we last spent time together.
:{{A|vo nvlq001 8 navia 04a.ogg}}<!--{{A|vo nvlq001 8 navia 04b.ogg}}--> '''Navia:''' Adventurers never stay in one place for long. The name of Spina di Rosula would just tie them down.
:{{A|vo nvlq001 8 navia 05.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Besides, after everything we've been through together, I'm sure our hearts would remain intertwined even if we found ourselves on opposite sides of the world!
:{{DIcon}} Navia's right.
:{{DIcon}} That's certainly one way of putting it...
:{{A|vo nvlq001 8 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Even if Paimon was far beyond the horizon, she'd still remember the delicious taste of Navia's macarons!
:{{A|vo nvlq001 8 colter 04.ogg}} '''Colter:''' I understand now. Then I am very lucky indeed to have been graced with the chance to meet the two of you.
:{{A|vo nvlq001 8 colter 05.ogg}} '''Colter:''' I will endeavor to make the most of this short yet fortuitous encounter, and enjoy every moment we spend together.
:{{A|vo nvlq001 8 navia 06.ogg}} '''Navia:''' We've got no wine with us, but let's still toast with water! In celebration of this moment!
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (...Huh?)
:{{Color|menu|You notice something strange and have a look around...}}
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (I thought I heard something just now. Was it just some small critter?)
:{{A|vo nvlq001 8 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Cheers! Hey, what are you doing? Quick, join in on the toast!
:{{DIcon}} Cheers!
:{{A|vo nvlq001 8 navia 07.ogg}} '''Navia:''' May your travels go smoothly, may the Spina continue to grow, and may our friendship last until the end of time!
{{Dialogue End}}

==Dialogue==
{{Stub Dialogue|sort=1}}
{{Quest Description|The [[Fontinalia Film Festival]] is coming up. Why not head back to Fontaine? You might just run into some old friends there.}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(After the quest is obtained and diving is unlocked)
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 1 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hey, the Fontinalia Film Festival should be happening over in Fontaine right now! Wonder if our friends at Musketeer Pictures are taking part...
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 1 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Let's head over and check it out! Maybe there's even something we can help with!

;(Approach [[Chiori]], [[Furina]], and [[Xavier]])
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 2 chiori 01a.ogg}}<!--{{A|vo sdnlq001 2 chiori 01b.ogg}}--> '''Chiori:''' Hah, see? Told you they'd be here.
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 2 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Xavier! Oh, and Chiori and Furina too!
:{{DIcon}} Happy Fontinalia Festival!
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 2 xavier 01.ogg}} '''Xavier:''' Ah! [[Hydro Archon]] above! If it isn't my darling [[Kamera]] operator and clapper loader! A very happy Fontinalia Festival to you as well!
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 2 furina 01.ogg}} '''Furina:''' I'm guessing you came back to celebrate with us?
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 2 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yep! And help out, too. Even though the [[Roses and Muskets|last festival]] had some... unexpected hiccups, making the film was still super fun!
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 2 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Since you're all here together like this, you must be planning on entering the competition, right?
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 2 furina 02.ogg}} '''Furina:''' Of course! A celebration of the entertainment industry? Hehe, no one who's anyone would choose to sit this one out. It only happens once a year, after all.
:{{Introductory Note|Furina}}
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 2 chiori 02.ogg}} '''Chiori:''' [[Fontaine Fashion Week]] might be more my speed, but the Film Festival brings in a lot of orders and boosts brand recognition. So, I wasn't going to miss out either.
:{{Introductory Note|Chiori}}
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 2 furina 03.ogg}} '''Furina:''' A few new awards have been added this year, too! "Best Director," "Best Costume Design"... Oh, and "Best Kamera Operation."
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 2 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ooh! Sounds like we've got work to do! C'mon, tell us! What's Musketeer Pictures' film gonna be about?
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 2 xavier 02.ogg}} '''Xavier:''' Oh, um... About that...
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 2 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wh—What's wrong, Xavier? What's with that look? Oh, man, you weren't scammed by some shady investor again, were you!?
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 2 xavier 03.ogg}} '''Xavier:''' No, no! Even I'm not naive enough to fall for something like that again.
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 2 xavier 04.ogg}} '''Xavier:''' Besides, thanks to the fine people here, Musketeer Pictures has more than enough funds to shoot without investors.
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 2 chiori 03.ogg}} '''Chiori:''' And yet problems persist...
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 2 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh? What do you mean?
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 2 xavier 05.ogg}} '''Xavier:''' Ahaha... Well, we were planning to replicate our past success and shoot a film based on a popular novel.
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 2 xavier 06.ogg}} '''Xavier:''' But, as we were holding auditions for the female lead earlier today, a striking young mademoiselle wandered in by accident.
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 2 xavier 07.ogg}} '''Xavier:''' Her disposition was simply ethereal, the look in her eyes somewhat melancholic... Oh, I wish you could have been there! The awe I felt can scarcely be put to words!
:{{DIcon}} Uh, sounds like she made quite the impression...
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 2 xavier 08.ogg}} '''Xavier:''' You had to be there, friend. No matter where she stood, it was as if her surroundings, even the air itself, turned into the perfect shot!
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 2 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Guess you found your lead actress, then...
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 2 xavier 09.ogg}} '''Xavier:''' No, quite the opposite. My script is entirely unworthy of her.
:{{DIcon}} I'm sure it's not that bad.
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 2 xavier 10.ogg}} '''Xavier:''' I fear it is. Nevertheless, I couldn't help but approach the mademoiselle to ask about her background, and what brought her to Fontaine.
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 2 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What did she say?
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 2 xavier 11.ogg}} '''Xavier:''' Sadly, she said her best friend was gone. After returning to her own homeland not too long ago, she decided to visit where her friend was from, to remember them better.
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 2 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' No wonder she looked sad.
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 2 xavier 12.ogg}} '''Xavier:''' Yes, but that's when it struck me — why not cast her as the lead in a film centered around her search for this old friend?
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 2 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh!? You're gonna rewrite the whole script? But, is there even enough time? Isn't the prep work super complicated? We might not finish!
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 2 xavier 13.ogg}} '''Xavier:''' Think about the difficulties we faced with "The Two Musketeers." We had to start from scratch back then, too. I'd say we're ahead of the game this time.
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 2 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Guess so, but...
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 2 furina 04.ogg}} '''Furina:''' Don't worry, Paimon. Chiori and I have evaluated the proposal, and we support Xavier's decision.
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 2 chiori 04.ogg}} '''Chiori:''' I won't really need to start on the costumes until the cast is finalized, so it's not too much extra work for me.
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 2 xavier 14.ogg}} '''Xavier:''' Oh, fair mademoiselles, how can I ever thank you?
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 2 together 01.ogg}} '''Chiori & Furina:''' Finishing the script would be a start.
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 2 furina 05.ogg}} '''Furina:''' Y'know, compared to a commercial popcorn flick, I do prefer the idea of shooting a more artistic film — one that leaves a profound and lingering impact in the hearts of the audience!
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 2 chiori 05.ogg}} '''Chiori:''' Mm-hmm, I agree. True trendsetters are the people who dare to go against the grain.
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 2 paimon 12.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wow, leave it to Director Furina to have a vision! Honestly though, the artistic passion of everyone at Musketeer Pictures is inspiring!
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 2 paimon 13.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Anyway, now that we've heard so much about this lead actress, Paimon's gotta know who it is!
:;(Chiori and Furina look past the Traveler)
:;([[Columbina]] appears behind the Traveler)
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 2 columbina 01.ogg}} '''???:''' ...Hehe!
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 2 paimon 14.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Waah...! Columbina!? What are you doing here?
:{{Introductory Note|Columbina}}
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 2 columbina 02.ogg}} '''Columbina:''' Hello. I was just walking past when I heard you talking about me, so I came over.
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 2 xavier 15.ogg}} '''Xavier:''' Huh? You know Miss Columbina?
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 2 paimon 15.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Of course! Wait a second, does this mean... Columbina is the actress who inspired the whole rewrite!?
:{{DIcon}} Xavier's reaction seems a lot more reasonable now...
:{{DIcon}} Quite a few things are starting to make sense...
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 2 paimon 16.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yeah...
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 2 columbina 03.ogg}} '''Columbina:''' Hm...?
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 2 paimon 17.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wait so, did you make the trip by yourself, Columbina?
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 2 columbina 04.ogg}} '''Columbina:''' Yes. I mentioned how I wanted to visit other nations once things settled down in [[Nod-Krai]], remember?
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 2 columbina 05.ogg}} '''Columbina:''' So I went to the [[Curatorium of Secrets (Point of Interest)|Curatorium]] to ask [[Nefer]] for advice. She told me about the film festival in Fontaine and said it might be fun to visit.
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 2 columbina 06.ogg}} '''Columbina:''' I spoke to [[Lauma]] before I left too, and she thought it was a great idea to get out for a bit. It's just... I received quite different travel advice from the two of them.
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 2 paimon 18.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, how so?
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 2 columbina 07.ogg}} '''Columbina:''' Well, Lauma told me to go out and experience new things and make new friends.
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 2 furina 06.ogg}} '''Furina:''' What a wonderful suggestion! That's how a trip should be!
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 2 paimon 19.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What about Nefer?
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 2 columbina 08.ogg}} '''Columbina:''' She said... "Don't trust anyone" and "don't talk to strangers."
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 2 paimon 20.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yep... That sounds like her...
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 2 chiori 06.ogg}} '''Chiori:''' I can understand that too. It shows this Nefer cares about you a great deal, Miss Columbina.
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 2 columbina 09.ogg}} '''Columbina:''' Yes. So I plan on combining their advice. All I need to do is turn strangers into friends, and then I can talk to them.
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 2 paimon 21.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh, that kinda makes sense, but also... not...
:;([[Chevreuse]] arrives)
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 2 chevreuse 01.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' Hey, Chiori. Oh, look who's back! Happy Fontinalia Festival, you two!
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 2 chiori 07.ogg}} '''Chiori:''' Ah, looks like we have a superstar in our midst. How about an autograph, big shot?
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 2 chevreuse 02.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' Haha, very funny.
:;(Chevreuse lightly punches Chiori's arm)
:{{Introductory Note|Chevreuse}}
:;(Observing this, Columbina tilts her head in curiosity)
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 2 columbina 10.ogg}} '''Columbina:''' (Huh...)
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 2 chiori 08.ogg}} '''Chiori:''' All settled, then?

:{{A|vo sdnlq001 2 paimon 25.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Th—That's not... What Paimon's trying to say is, maybe keep the punches to a minimum until AFTER you're friends with someone...

:{{A|vo sdnlq001 2 wriothesley 08.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' Of course. Any friend of {{Traveler}} is a friend of mine.
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 2 columbina 18.ogg}} '''Columbina:''' Hya...!

:{{A|vo sdnlq001 2 wriothesley 09.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' Oof...

:{{A|vo sdnlq001 2 wriothesley 10.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' When it comes to friends, you sure know how to pick 'em.

:{{A|vo sdnlq001 2 chevreuse 05.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' So Miss Columbina is the lead actress I've been hearing so much about. The whole thing about her... aura is starting to make more sense.
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 2 paimon 27.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You gonna be part of the film this time too, Chevreuse?
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 2 chevreuse 06.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' That was the plan. But now that Mr. Xavier has changed the direction, I don't think I'm in quite as many scenes.
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 2 chevreuse 07.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' It's all for the best, though. A different crew asked me to help consult on some of their musket work.

:{{A|vo sdnlq001 2 chevreuse 08.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' I'm just going where I'm needed. I'm more than willing to help with whatever this production needs as well.
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 2 xavier 16.ogg}} '''Xavier:''' Ah, well, speaking of... Would you happen to know if there are scenic locations around the Court of Fontaine that other crews haven't booked?
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 2 chevreuse 09.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' Hm... The festival's pretty popular this year, so there's not a lot left. You might just have to talk it over with the other productions, and see if they'll let you squeeze in here and there.
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 2 xavier 17.ogg}} '''Xavier:''' I see...
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 2 wriothesley 11.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' Having trouble finding a filming location?

:{{A|vo sdnlq001 2 wriothesley 13.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' You want me to reveal it just like that? C'mon, let it be a surprise.
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 2 chiori 12.ogg}} '''Chiori:''' As much as that sounds... riveting, I think we should divide and conquer.
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 2 chiori 13.ogg}} '''Chiori:''' You go do that, and Director Furina and I will take Miss Columbina around the city to discuss lighting and styling. Is that alright with you, Miss Columbina?
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 2 columbina 19.ogg}} '''Columbina:''' {{Traveler}}?
:{{DIcon}} Go ahead.
:{{DIcon}} You can trust these people.
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 2 paimon 29.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yeah, everyone here is our friend. So, don't worry about a thing and just focus on enjoying your trip!
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 2 columbina 20.ogg}} '''Columbina:''' Hehe, okay.
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 2 xavier 18.ogg}} '''Xavier:''' Alright, then {{Traveler}} and I will go check out this potential filming location. It might even give me some inspiration for the new script!
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 2 chevreuse 10.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' I'll leave this to the Duke then. Until later, everyone. Maybe we'll run into each other on set!
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 2 paimon 30.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hehe, okay then. Lead the way, Wriothesley! Paimon's not built for suspense. Let's get this show on the road!

:{{A|vo sdnlq001 3 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' No way! You brought the Wingalet up to the surface!?
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 3 wriothesley 01.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' It'd make quite the grand backdrop for a film, don't you think?
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 3 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Paimon's more focused on the fact that this thing is supposed to be underwater... inside the [[Fortress of Meropide]].
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 3 wriothesley 02.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' True, and keeping up with the maintenance on a vessel this big is a lot of work. It takes a crazy amount of manpower just to keep it up and running.
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 3 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh... Paimon kinda thought it just sat there until you needed it...
:;(Xavier walks around the deck)
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 3 wriothesley 03.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' I wish it were that simple. The truth is, the maintenance costs on this thing are substantial, so we decided to rent it out during the festival to earn some extra mora.
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 3 wriothesley 04.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' Besides, the inmates are the ones who keep it in good shape. Seeing the fruits of their labor put to use is a good form of social rehabilitation for them.
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 3 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh, you've really thought this through.
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 3 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Whatcha think, Xavier? Is this a good place to shoot?
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 3 xavier 01.ogg}} '''Xavier:''' Ah, I've got it! Good messieurs and mesdemoiselles, I've got it!
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 3 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Uh... Gonna take that as a "yes."
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 3 xavier 02.ogg}} '''Xavier:''' The beginning is the hardest part, and the opening of this film has been eluding me, but now... I know just how it should start!
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 3 wriothesley 05.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' Glad to hear it.
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 3 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Thanks for bringing us here, Wriothesley.
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 3 wriothesley 06.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' Don't thank me just yet. This isn't quite a done deal.
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 3 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' ...Huh? Not a done deal as in... someone already rented it out? You said no other production teams had snatched it up!
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 3 wriothesley 07.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' This person isn't affiliated with a production team. The rental fee was high enough to scare off plenty of other film crews, but she didn't blink. Made quite the generous offer, and didn't even attempt to haggle.
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 3 xavier 03.ogg}} '''Xavier:''' Do you know what she plans to use it for? I'd like to at least have a rough idea before going in to negotiate.
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 3 wriothesley 08.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' I didn't ask for the details. But I did see what looked like a "Fishing Permit" and a "Business License" on her desk.
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 3 wriothesley 09.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' My guess is she's planning on using it for some kind of restaurant or aquarium.
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 3 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' A floating restaurant is sure to attract people! But an aquarium sounds cool too! The views from the ship make it a great spot for a date!
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 3 wriothesley 10.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' The Wingalet might not be under my command right now, but it's always nice to see her admired.
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 3 xavier 04.ogg}} '''Xavier:''' A film is sure to drum up some good publicity as well. I do hope we can work something out with the current captain.
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 3 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Well, guess we should head over and talk things out, then.
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 3 wriothesley 11.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' Best of luck.

:{{A|vo sdnlq001 4 citlali 06a.ogg}}<!--{{A|vo sdnlq001 4 citlali 06b.ogg}}--> '''Citlali:''' The wash! I put them in the wash after I drank too much and fell into the fountain... This can't be happening. Am I seriously gonna go out like this!?

:{{A|vo sdnlq001 4 citlali 14a.ogg}}<!--{{A|vo sdnlq001 4 citlali 14b.ogg}}--> '''Citlali:''' (This is so embarrassing! I seemed a little too pleased to get that compliment, didn't I...)

:{{A|vo sdnlq001 4 citlali 18.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' You're not here alone, I see...
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 4 xavier 02.ogg}} '''Xavier:''' Ahaha... Hello. I'm Xavier, a film director and producer from Fontaine. I meant to introduce myself sooner. I just didn't want to, um... interrupt, hehehe.
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 4 citlali 19.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' Ah, no wonder we ran into each other in Fontaine of all places. You must also be in town for the festival then...
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 4 paimon 12.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' That's right! We're helping Xavier with his film. In fact, we were hoping to shoot some scenes on this boat...
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 4 paimon 13.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You're the one who rented it out, right, Citlali?
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 4 citlali 20.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' Me? Rent a boat? I wish I had that kinda spare cash floating around, not to mention the spare time...
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 4 citlali 21.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' Don't get the wrong idea, though! I'm not here to sail off into the sunset and live out some cushy, retirement life, okay? I'm not that old!
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 4 paimon 14.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Then why are you dressed like... Um, how did you end up staying aboard the Wingalet?
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 4 citlali 22.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' Well, I heard one of my favorite light novels was getting turned into a film, so I came to Fontaine to catch the premiere.
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 4 citlali 23.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' Originally, I booked a room near the Opera Epiclese, but I'm quite particular about where I sleep these days. I think it's an age thing, and that bed... I just couldn't sleep in it.
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 4 citlali 24.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' I tried to find a different hotel, but with the festival, everything was completely booked!
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 4 citlali 25.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' Just as I was worried I'd have to sleep under a bridge or something, I happened to spot a "Help Wanted" sign on the side of the road...
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 4 paimon 15.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh! So, you're here to take care of the boat?
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 4 citlali 26.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' No, I was hired to man the front desk. The pay is a bit low, but food and drinks are covered, and it includes room and board during the festival. Plus, the job is simple, so I thought I'd give it a shot.
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 4 paimon 16.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wow, they actually thought you'd be a good fit, huh...
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 4 citlali 27.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' What, you don't think I'm cut out for it?
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 4 citlali 28.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' All I have to do is tell people the aquarium isn't open yet. Other than that, I'm free to do whatever I want. It's a pretty sweet gig.
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 4 paimon 17.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' That's all?
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 4 citlali 29.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' Yeah, I was also kind of shocked, but it's not a lie. Head downstairs and see for yourselves. There's nothing but empty tanks. Not a marine animal in sight.
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 4 xavier 03.ogg}} '''Xavier:''' Did your boss mention anything about being open to film crews using this space? Our production was hoping to film on the deck for a few scenes.
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 4 citlali 30.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' Uh, no... That never came up... You could just ask her.
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 4 paimon 18.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, she's around? What kind of person is she? We should know what we're heading into...
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 4 citlali 31.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' She's... nice enough, I suppose. Pretty reasonable, too. Even offered for me to move to a bigger cabin if I was too cramped.
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 4 citlali 32.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' Back at the [["Masters of the Night-Wind"|Masters of the Night-Wind]], I'm used to being the one giving orders. But working under her doesn't feel like being bossed around. She seems to respect what I think.
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 4 paimon 19.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wow, she sounds like a great boss!
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 4 citlali 33.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' She did tell me she'd rather not be disturbed, though. She's been working on an important project, so I'd keep it brief.
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 4 paimon 20.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Got it! Thanks for the heads-up!
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 4 citlali 34.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' Alright, the captain's quarters are this way. I can take—

:{{A|vo sdnlq001 6 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' A "Stellar Linchpin"? What's that?
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 6 marionette 01.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' You can think of it as a rare kind of Vision. As for what causes one to manifest, well... That's still unknown.
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 6 marionette 02.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' But in [[Snezhnaya]] — or in the [[Fatui]]'s research at least — it's believed to have some connection to the [[Third Descender]].
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 6 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' "The Third Descender"? We knew his remains were used to create the [[Gnoses]], but this is the first we're hearing about a Stellar Linchpin.
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 6 marionette 03.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' You knew about the remains? Right, of course. Look who I'm talking to.
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 6 marionette 04.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' Yes, the [[Heavenly Principles]] used the remains of the Third Descender to create the seven Gnoses as a means to consolidate the [[archon]] system.
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 6 marionette 05.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' Visions result from that same system, so extrapolating from there... It's clear that the manifestation of a Vision is also, to some extent, related to the Third Descender. Still following?
:{{DIcon}} Sort of...
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 6 marionette 06.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' For those that wield them, Visions serve as a means to channel [[element]]al power. The same is true of Stellar Linchpins.
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 6 marionette 07.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' The difference is that, when wielding elemental energy, Stellar Linchpin-users often exhibit a unique kind of power that seems to come from beyond [[Teyvat]].
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 6 marionette 08.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' It's believed that, when a Stellar Linchpin manifests, impurities from the remains of the Third Descender get fixed in place. Hence, the name. That's also believed to be the source of the strange power I just mentioned.
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 6 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' We've heard that Visions can appear when someone has a really strong wish or desire. Stellar Linchpins sound kinda similar, so does that mean...
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 6 marionette 09.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' Huh? Oh, don't look at me like that. I've never had any grand wishes or aspirations. Just a list of things that drive me up the wall... So, if you're asking why this thing appeared, I have no clue...
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 6 marionette 10.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' All I know is that, without it, the "Gift" Alain left me — this built-in second chance — never would have triggered. The damage to my core was too severe...
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 6 marionette 11.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' But thanks to the Stellar Linchpin's manifestation, it did trigger, and after my core rebooted, I was able to repair the damage to my body. I also managed to import the numerological array, along with some of Pulonia's surviving algorithms into this form.
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 6 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wait, does that mean Pulonia is...
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 6 marionette 12.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' ...Yes. Unfortunately, Pulonia is... beyond repair.
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 6 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, we're... so sorry to hear that... But, you also mentioned something about a "Final Gift"...?
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 6 marionette 13.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' Yes. Alain often spoke to me about wishes and desires when he was alive.
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 6 marionette 14.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' I suppose he thought there might come a day when I wished for something, and was willing to sacrifice my own life to fulfill it, so he left me a chance to start over.
:{{DIcon}} This "Gift"...
:{{DIcon}} You never knew about it?
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 6 marionette 15.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' No, never.
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 6 marionette 16.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' Alain once said I was his proudest masterpiece. That might sound boastful coming from me, but it's also an undeniable fact.
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 6 marionette 17.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' After Alain died, I started studying how Pulonia and I worked. Pulonia is essentially a computational machine, so it wasn't difficult to figure out the mechanical principles there.
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 6 marionette 18.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' But, when it came to my own structure, that's when Alain, the Lord-Artificer's true greatness struck me once again.
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 6 marionette 19.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' I attempted to imitate it when I created [[Katheryne]], but in the end, she turned out to be nothing more than a superficial replica.
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 6 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What!? B—But... As creations go, Katheryne is super impressive! We were shocked [[Dawn (Quest)|when we first found out she was a puppet]]!
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 6 marionette 20.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' No, she's nothing compared to what Alain was able to create. Some of the mechanical principles of my own core are still a complete mystery to me.
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 6 marionette 21.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' Keeping that "Gift" hidden wasn't even a challenge for him.
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 6 marionette 22.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' Just a shame I had to waste it on fighting Dottore. I just couldn't stand the thought of him coming out on top.
:{{DIcon}} You gave the world a second chance.
:{{DIcon}} It wasn't a waste.
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 6 marionette 23.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' Hah, if you put it that way, the world owes me a whole lot then, doesn't it?
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 6 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wait, but all this still doesn't explain what you're doing here.
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 6 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wriothesley said you rented this ship, and even had some kind of... fishing permit?
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 6 marionette 24.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' Ah, that's because I'm trying to go back to the place Alain and I lived when he was alive. My former home, I suppose you could say.
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 6 marionette 25.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' The second chance wasn't the only part of the "Gift." According to the message, Alain left me a few other things that are stored in the house we shared together.
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 6 marionette 26.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' I'm hoping that whatever he left me can help fix certain "anomalies" in my rebooted core... and help me understand why I received a Stellar Linchpin in the first place.
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 6 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Okay, so go back then. What does that have to do with fishing?
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 6 marionette 27.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' Heh, and to think I'm talking to the saviors of Fontaine. Did you forget that [[Prophecy of Fontaine|the water levels have been rising for centuries]]? I can't just go back to the place I used to live, because now, it's underwater.
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 6 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh... Right...
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 6 marionette 28.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' With the rising water levels and changes in terrain... It's not just a matter of finding where it is, but also clearing away any sediment or debris.
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 6 marionette 29.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' But Fontaine law prohibits unauthorized individuals and organizations from excavating underwater ruins. A [[Melusine]] caught me the minute I even made an attempt.
:;([[Siora]] is shown blowing a whistle)
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 6 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Why not apply for authorization, then?
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 6 marionette 30.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' And face the endless slog of Fontainian bureaucracy? No thanks.
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 6 marionette 31.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' Besides, I'm a [[Fatui Harbinger]]. The diplomatic implications alone would be enough to give the [[Gestionnaire]]s at the [[Palais Mermonia]] a headache.
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 6 marionette 32.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' A fishing permit, on the other hand, isn't difficult to obtain at all. Minimal paperwork required, and under the name "Guillotin," the application was a cinch.
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 6 paimon 12.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So, you're... exploiting a legal loophole?
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 6 marionette 33.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' Am I? That underwater home belongs to me. If I happen to chance upon it while doing some "fishing," what's the issue with that?
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 6 marionette 34.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' Of course, I do have to catch some fish to put in the aquarium, just in case the Gestionnaires come to check up on things. That's also the reason I hired someone to man the front desk.
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 6 paimon 13.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh... But, isn't that kind of a waste? You went to all the trouble of getting a business license, and rented out this giant ship... just for show?
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 6 marionette 35.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' If you want to run an aquarium that bad, be my guest. Use the facilities however you want. I'm certainly not going to stop you.
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 6 marionette 36.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' All I want is to go back home and see what other gifts Alain wanted me to inherit.
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 6 marionette 37.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' Hold on, enough about me... What are you two even doing here?

:{{A|vo sdnlq001 10 charlotte 02.ogg}} '''{{Not a typo|????}}:''' You think it was someone they knew?
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 10 chevreuse 02.ogg}} '''"Detective":''' Yes. It's possible the suspect arranged for them to meet at this very spot.
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 10 charlotte 03.ogg}} '''"Hurlock"<!-- "Played by Charlotte" -->:''' Hmm, a reasonable deduction. But... You're overlooking a crucial clue!
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 10 chevreuse 03.ogg}} '''"Detective":''' ...What?
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 10 charlotte 04.ogg}} '''"Hurlock":''' ...The victim's pocket watch is missing.
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 10 lepinepauline 01.ogg}} '''Lepine-Pauline:''' And... cut!
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 10 lepinepauline 02.ogg}} '''Lepine-Pauline:''' I think we got it! Good work, everyone!
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 10 charlotte 05.ogg}} '''Charlotte:''' Phew... Finally!
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 10 chevreuse 04.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' Acting was nerve-wracking for me when I first tried it too. Just loosen up, and you'll get used to it in no time.
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 10 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Chevreuse! Charlotte!
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 10 charlotte 06.ogg}} '''Charlotte:''' Oh! Hello there, you two!
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 10 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You're filming here too? Oh, so Charlotte's crew must've been the one that asked you to help out, huh, Chevreuse!
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 10 chevreuse 05.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' Yup, they heard about a potential filming location and wanted to come check it out.
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 10 charlotte 07.ogg}} '''Charlotte:''' But, when we got here, your crew had already beaten us to it! Hehe, luckily, Xavier and our director, [[Lepine-Pauline]], go way back. In the end, we agreed to just share each other's filming locations.
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 10 chevreuse 06.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' Considering all the last-minute changes, that's just what Musketeer Pictures needed.
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 10 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' For sure. Based off the scene just now, you must be the star of the film, Charlotte!
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 10 charlotte 08.ogg}} '''Charlotte:''' Hehe, you bet! This [[Hurlock Variations|detective costume]] really suits me, don't you think?
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 10 chiori 01.ogg}} '''Chiori:''' Oh, for sure. You're already right at home lurking in the shadows taking pictures of this and that. Add a notepad, and you're practically {{w|method acting|method}}.
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 10 charlotte 09.ogg}} '''Charlotte:''' Thanks, Miss Chiori! I appreciate the compliment!
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 10 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' That didn't sound much like a compliment to Paimon...
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 10 columbina 01.ogg}} '''Columbina:''' So this is a film set? It looks like a very happy place.
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 10 furina 02.ogg}} '''Furina:''' This must all be quite new to you, Miss Columbina.
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 10 columbina 02.ogg}} '''Columbina:''' Yes. I watched a few films with a friend once, but she thought there was no point if I wouldn't open my eyes, so she stopped inviting me.
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 10 columbina 03.ogg}} '''Columbina:''' Looks like I missed out on a lot.
:{{DIcon}} Well, now you get to make up for it.
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 10 columbina 04.ogg}} '''Columbina:''' True. But being an actor seems like a tough job...
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 10 furina 03.ogg}} '''Furina:''' Huh? Most people would swap lives with an actor in a heartbeat. The lifestyle is so glamorous, and the pay is more than generous...
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 10 columbina 05.ogg}} '''Columbina:''' But they have to act out lives that aren't their own, with the whole world watching on in judgment. If they don't do it justice, it must feel like... they're letting people down.
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 10 furina 04.ogg}} '''Furina:''' (That's... exactly how it feels! This young lady has quite the unique perspective...)
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 10 furina 05.ogg}} '''Furina:''' Well, that's true. But, these actors are here because they want to be, and they think it's fun. Ahem, most of them at least...
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 10 chiori 02.ogg}} '''Chiori:''' Not to mention, the film we're shooting is based entirely on you, Miss Columbina. You just need to be true to yourself.
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 10 columbina 06.ogg}} '''Columbina:''' I don't have to pretend to be someone I'm not?
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 10 furina 06.ogg}} '''Furina:''' Not at all! Authenticity is what we're after. For example, this first scene opens with you on the boat, sailing to your friend's homeland.
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 10 furina 07.ogg}} '''Furina:''' You just need to think about that moment in the story, and picture how you would feel.
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 10 columbina 07.ogg}} '''Columbina:''' Oh, okay.
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 10 xavier 01.ogg}} '''Xavier:''' We're all here? Wonderful. Let's head to the deck and get shooting.
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 10 xavier 02.ogg}} '''Xavier:''' Oh, and this is for you, dear Paimon. Your clapperboard.
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 10 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Whoa! Is this the same one Paimon used for "The Two Musketeers"?
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 10 xavier 03.ogg}} '''Xavier:''' The very same. I saved it just for you.
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 10 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Thanks, Xavier! Feels like being reunited with an old friend!
:{{DIcon}} Did you keep my Kamera too?
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 10 xavier 04a.ogg}}<!--{{A|vo sdnlq001 10 xavier 04b.ogg}}--> '''Xavier:''' Haha, of course. That said, I have a different job in mind for you this time, {{Traveler}}.
:{{DIcon}} What is it?
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 10 xavier 05.ogg}} '''Xavier:''' Our film is focusing on a single protagonist, so conveying the subtle changes in her state of mind is of the utmost importance.
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 10 xavier 06.ogg}} '''Xavier:''' In addition to the actor's own performance, another way we can convey that is through "lighting."
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 10 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh? But there's already a lighting specialist, isn't there?
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 10 xavier 07.ogg}} '''Xavier:''' Yes, but it's clear {{Traveler}} and Miss Columbina share a deep bond. You might have a better chance of understanding her frame of mind in certain scenes.
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 10 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, that makes sense.
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 10 xavier 08.ogg}} '''Xavier:''' So, what do you say? Willing to take on the role of "lighting specialist"?
:{{DIcon}} Gladly.
:{{DIcon}} Not sure I want to give up the coveted title of "Kamera operator," though...
::{{A|vo sdnlq001 10 xavier 09b 1.ogg}} '''Xavier:''' Then, we'll combine them! You can be the "chief lighting and Kamera specialist," haha!
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 10 xavier 10.ogg}} '''Xavier:''' It's settled! I leave the job of translating our leading lady's inner thoughts in your capable hands!

;(Talk to Lepine-Pauline, optional)
:{{A|vo dialog sdnlq001 lepinepauline 01.ogg}} '''Lepine-Pauline:''' Hmm... Seeing all the sets in place, things are looking even better than I expected. The actors are doing great too. Editing it all together's gonna be a piece of cake! Bet I can finish it in one night!
:{{A|vo dialog sdnlq001 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hi, Lepine-Pauline!
:{{A|vo dialog sdnlq001 lepinepauline 02.ogg}} '''Lepine-Pauline:''' Hey, you're back! The timing couldn't be more perfect! If there's one thing you absolutely can't miss, it's the Fontinalia Film Festival!
:{{A|vo dialog sdnlq001 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' And you're a director this time! That's so cool!
:{{A|vo dialog sdnlq001 lepinepauline 03.ogg}} '''Lepine-Pauline:''' Haha, it's all thanks to my apprentice, [[Ninette]]. She's the one who told me to read "Great Detective Hurlock" in the first place, and then it struck me — this would make a great film!
:{{A|vo dialog sdnlq001 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What about your savings, though? You didn't...
:{{A|vo dialog sdnlq001 lepinepauline 04.ogg}} '''Lepine-Pauline:''' Haha! Yep! I went all in!
:{{A|vo dialog sdnlq001 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ah... Paimon was worried you'd say that.
:{{A|vo dialog sdnlq001 lepinepauline 05.ogg}} '''Lepine-Pauline:''' Relax, it's different this time. I met Director Xavier back during my Kamera outsourcing days, so I got to know the industry a bit.
:{{A|vo dialog sdnlq001 lepinepauline 06.ogg}} '''Lepine-Pauline:''' I know exactly what our film needs, and what the fans want to see.
:{{A|vo dialog sdnlq001 lepinepauline 07.ogg}} '''Lepine-Pauline:''' So, be sure to check it out! I'm confident we've got a winner on our hands!
:{{A|vo dialog sdnlq001 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Sounds like it! But we've got some filming chops ourselves! It's definitely still anyone's game!
:{{A|vo dialog sdnlq001 lepinepauline 08.ogg}} '''Lepine-Pauline:''' Then, may the best film win!

;(Talk to Charlotte, optional)
:{{A|vo dialog sdnlq001 charlotte 01.ogg}} '''Charlotte:''' Oh, I didn't expect to run into you two on set! Happy Fontinalia Festival!
:{{A|vo dialog sdnlq001 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Nice acting back there, Charlotte!
:{{A|vo dialog sdnlq001 charlotte 02.ogg}} '''Charlotte:''' Thanks! I'm, uh... usually the one behind the Kamera, so it's actually pretty nerve-wracking being the center of all that attention.
:{{A|vo dialog sdnlq001 charlotte 03.ogg}} '''Charlotte:''' But, I've known Miss Lepine-Pauline for quite some time, so we work really well together.
:{{A|vo dialog sdnlq001 charlotte 04.ogg}} '''Charlotte:''' Miss Lepine-Pauline prefers to assign roles based on our own personalities. She'll even adjust the script to make it a better fit.
:{{A|vo dialog sdnlq001 charlotte 05.ogg}} '''Charlotte:''' The scene from earlier was just me and Chevreuse, but [[Navia]] and [[Emilie]] are also going to be taking part!
:{{A|vo dialog sdnlq001 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ooh! That's quite the lineup!
:{{A|vo dialog sdnlq001 charlotte 06.ogg}} '''Charlotte:''' Your film's leading lady also seems like quite the score. Just on first impressions alone, it's clear she's someone special!
:{{A|vo dialog sdnlq001 charlotte 07.ogg}} '''Charlotte:''' Hehe, guess we'll just have to wait and see who wins Best Picture and gets to go home with the Furina Award!

;(Talk to Citlali behind the nearby pillar, optional)
:{{A|vo dialog sdnlq001 citlali 02.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' Ugh, I wanna ask for an autograph so bad, but I can't do it dressed like this!
:{{DIcon}} An autograph? From who?
:{{A|vo dialog sdnlq001 citlali 03.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' The cast of "Great Detective Hurlock," duh! I came all the way here just for the premiere!
:{{A|vo dialog sdnlq001 citlali 04.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' But I didn't expect to end up on their film set! Ah, my laundry just won't dry! The weather here is too wet!
----

:;(Xavier gathers the film crew on the deck)
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 12 xavier 01.ogg}} '''Xavier:''' Alright, without any further ado, it's time for production on our film, "A Homecoming," to officially begin!
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 12 xavier 02.ogg}} '''Xavier:''' Turning it over to you once again, Director Furina.
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 12 furina 01.ogg}} '''Furina:''' Alright! Positions, everyone. Kamera Operator, Clapper Loader, get set up! Let me know when lighting is good to go!
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 12 furina 02.ogg}} '''Furina:''' All you need to worry about, Miss Columbina, is hitting your mark. Other than that, just focus on immersing yourself in the emotions of the moment.
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 12 columbina 01.ogg}} '''Columbina:''' Okay.
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 12 furina 03.ogg}} '''Furina:''' Good. Lighting, are we ready?

:{{A|vo sdnlq001 12 hero 01.ogg}} {{A|vo sdnlq001 12 heroine 01.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' Ready!
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 12 furina 04.ogg}} '''Furina:''' Alright, quiet on set! Three, two, one, action!
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 12 columbina 02.ogg}} '''Columbina:''' ...
:{{A|vo sdnlq001 12 columbina 03.ogg}} '''Columbina:''' This is... her homeland...
:;(Sandrone watches from a high balcony at the Wingalet's stern)

:{{A|vo sdnlq001 12 furina 06.ogg}} '''Furina:''' Hm, the emotions I'm looking for were definitely there. Let's just try to keep it a bit more natural.

:{{A|vo sdnlq001 12 columbina 05.ogg}} '''Columbina:''' ...

:{{A|vo dialog sdnlq001 furina 01.ogg}} '''Furina:''' Terrific performance, Miss Columbina. Truly excellent work.
