;(Talk to [[Randall]])
:{{A|vo ellq002 4 eula 01.ogg}} '''Eula:''' You there, lowly worker, I—
:{{A|vo ellq002 4 randall 01.ogg}} '''Randall:''' Yeah, I've already heard it all before. Look, just spare me the time, our answer is always the same. We've got nothing to say to the likes of you.
:{{A|vo ellq002 4 randall 02.ogg}} '''Randall:''' I mean, seriously, can't you just take a hint?
:{{A|vo ellq002 4 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Please calm down, we don't want to cause any trouble.
:{{A|vo ellq002 4 randall 03.ogg}} '''Randall:''' *sigh* I know she's a [[Knight of Favonius]], and that the Knights wouldn't misplace their trust, but the name Lawrence carries too much weight with it.
:{{A|vo ellq002 4 randall 04.ogg}} '''Randall:''' Even to this very day, the descendants of the Lawrence Clan are still scheming to reclaim Mondstadt and reinstate their aristocratic rule.
:{{A|vo ellq002 4 randall 05.ogg}} '''Randall:''' And if that wasn't enough, here you are purposefully using their awkward way of speaking just to put on an act? Don't you care for the feelings of us ordinary folk?
:{{A|vo ellq002 4 eula 02.ogg}} '''Eula:''' You have a point.
:{{A|vo ellq002 4 eula 03.ogg}} '''Eula:''' But mark my words, this transgression will not go unnoticed!
:{{A|vo ellq002 4 randall 06.ogg}} '''Randall:''' H—Huh? You wanna fight? Listen here, I might be no match for you, but I'll be sure to lodge a complaint with the Knights of Favonius!
:{{DIcon}} Maybe we should just call it a day now.
:{{DIcon}} Maybe everyone should just take a step back.
:{{A|vo ellq002 4 randall 07.ogg}} '''Randall:''' I'm sorry but... I want her to understand that I'm serious!
:{{A|vo ellq002 4 randall 08.ogg}} '''Randall:''' Listen here, if you don't want things to get more unpleasant, then you'd better just stop.
:{{A|vo ellq002 4 eula 04.ogg}} '''Eula:''' Forget it, there's no point in quarreling any further. Let's go.
:{{A|vo ellq002 4 randall 09.ogg}} '''Randall:''' *sigh*...
:{{A|vo ellq002 4 eula 05.ogg}} '''Eula:''' It's alright, this happens quite often. Let's find someone else to talk to.
:{{A|vo ellq002 4 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Uh, Paimon thinks we've seen enough now. Let's just stop.
:{{A|vo ellq002 4 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Actually, Paimon thinks we should apologize for asking you to demonstrate for us. We had no idea the feelings between the Lawrence Clan and the people of Mondstadt were so bitter.
:{{A|vo ellq002 4 eula 06.ogg}} '''Eula:''' Haha, what can we do? The Lawrence name is already a dirty word among every household in Mondstadt. Even three-year-olds know the story. I see this kind of attitude all the time.
:{{DIcon}} And somehow you still manage to brush it off with a laugh?
:{{DIcon}} I'm starting to sympathize with you.
:{{A|vo ellq002 4 eula 07.ogg}} '''Eula:''' Don't worry, what with me being a Knight of Favonius, they're usually willing to speak a few words with me.
:{{A|vo ellq002 4 eula 08.ogg}} '''Eula:''' Perhaps my aristocratic manner of speech provoked them today. Believe me, it's not a big issue.
:{{A|vo ellq002 4 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So this is the way things are normally for you? There's no need for them to direct their anger at you personally.
:{{A|vo ellq002 4 eula 09.ogg}} '''Eula:''' That's the way things are. Perhaps it's just fate for those who've made mistakes. Accepting punishment is only fair, right? But when your family has committed atrocities, I'm afraid there's no easy path to reconciliation.
:{{A|vo ellq002 4 eula 10.ogg}} '''Eula:''' As memories are carried in the city breeze, the faults of such grievances are passed on from one generation to the next. It is now my turn to bear this burden.
:{{A|vo ellq002 4 eula 11.ogg}} '''Eula:''' At least I have a means of living a relatively normal life compared to the elders of my family. I have nothing to be discontented about.
:{{DIcon}} So you knew all along that we'd encounter these kinds of problems?
:{{A|vo ellq002 4 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yeah, why were you so willing to try and demonstrate for us?
:{{A|vo ellq002 4 eula 12.ogg}} '''Eula:''' Oh, that reminds me... that last person will not escape my vengeance either...
:{{A|vo ellq002 4 eula 13.ogg}} '''Eula:''' *sigh* Let's leave it at that. Just think of it as something I like to do.
:{{A|vo ellq002 4 eula 14.ogg}} '''Eula:''' But unfortunately, you probably didn't learn much from those conversations. It seems we have no other choice but to find more people to talk to.
:{{A|vo ellq002 4 paimon 06a.ogg}} {{A|vo ellq002 4 paimon 06b.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Uh, n—no need! Besides, the Traveler's pretty sharp, and nothing gets in our way on an adventure. Paimon thinks we've got the gist of it now.
:{{A|vo ellq002 4 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Right? RIGHT!?
:{{DIcon}} Uh... Yeah, I think I've got it.
:{{DIcon}} I'm still not too sure I can do this.
:{{A|vo ellq002 4 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' We'll just have to roll with it for now.
:{{A|vo ellq002 4 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Let's just keep Eula from getting anyone else riled up.
:{{A|vo ellq002 4 eula 15.ogg}} '''Eula:''' Well then, I'm glad you learned something. You're already halfway toward mastering aristocratic conduct.
:{{A|vo ellq002 4 eula 16.ogg}} '''Eula:''' A proper manner of speech is more aesthetic than anything else — it stems from their taste for refinement.
:{{A|vo ellq002 4 eula 17.ogg}} '''Eula:''' But we must also practice your bearing.
:{{A|vo ellq002 4 eula 18.ogg}} '''Eula:''' I have a very effective way of training for this. Come with me to Dragonspine.

;(Talk to Randall again, optional)
:{{A|vo dialog ellq002 randall 01.ogg}} '''Randall:''' So it seems you've finally given up on the idea of finding more people to talk to.
:{{A|vo dialog ellq002 randall 02.ogg}} '''Randall:''' Believe me, that's in everyone's best interest.

;(Approach Eula in Dragonspine)
:{{A|vo ellq002 5 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' It's s—so c—cold... Does aristocrat training really need to be done here?
:{{A|vo ellq002 5 eula 01.ogg}} '''Eula:''' If you wish to truly achieve the dignified conduct of an aristocrat, you must learn to remain composed and elegant even amidst harsh conditions.
:{{A|vo ellq002 5 eula 02.ogg}} '''Eula:''' For example, you can see that part of the path up ahead is quite difficult to traverse.
:{{A|vo ellq002 5 eula 03.ogg}} '''Eula:''' But a well-trained aristocrat would not only effortlessly proceed forward, but do so without a stain on their garment and their elegance fully intact.
:{{A|vo ellq002 5 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Paimon thinks we've let the realm of aristocrats and entered the realm of adventuring.
:{{A|vo ellq002 5 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Compared to what we've already seen, {{Traveler}}, this should be a piece of cake.
:{{DIcon}} Yeah, I'm used to this kind of challenge.
::{{A|vo ellq002 5 paimon 04a.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Uh-huh, this is where you can finally apply some of your adventuring knowledge.
:{{DIcon}} Should be way easier than making conversation, at least.
::{{A|vo ellq002 5 paimon 04b.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Paimon thinks so too... But you've got this in the bag!
:{{A|vo ellq002 5 eula 04.ogg}} '''Eula:''' Haha, you look pretty confident this time.
:{{A|vo ellq002 5 eula 05.ogg}} '''Eula:''' Alright, let's get started. Remember, you must be graceful and elegant. Don't get knocked or launched into the air, that would be most unsightly.

;(Talk to Eula again, optional)
:{{A|vo dialog ellq002 eula 01.ogg}} '''Eula:''' Good luck! Just remember, don't get knocked or launched into the air. That would be most inelegant.

;(Upon taking damage)
:{{A|vo ellq002 5 eula 06.ogg}} '''Eula:''' That won't do! You've exposed your shortcomings.
:{{A|vo ellq002 5 eula 07.ogg}} '''Eula:''' No need to worry. Head back to the starting point and try again.

:{{A|vo ellq002 6 eula 01.ogg}} '''Eula:''' It'll be difficult at first, but the key is to remain patient. Let's try again.
:{{A|vo ellq002 6 eula 02.ogg}} '''Eula:''' Remember, you must be elegant... Don't get knocked or launched into the air.

;(After completing the challenge)
:{{A|vo ellq002 7 eula 01.ogg}} '''Eula:''' Not bad. A lot better than I had anticipated, at least.
:{{A|vo ellq002 7 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' *panting* Paimon almost didn't make it through! Whew, good thing we didn't get stuck.
:{{A|vo ellq002 7 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Um... so... are we "aristocrats" now?
:{{A|vo ellq002 7 eula 02.ogg}} '''Eula:''' Don't flatter yourselves. We've only just begun.
:{{A|vo ellq002 7 eula 03.ogg}} '''Eula:''' This scenario was relatively simple. In the face of a real battle, one would seldom have a chance to stop and evaluate the situation.
:{{A|vo ellq002 7 eula 04.ogg}} '''Eula:''' There's a [[Ley Line Monolith]] just up ahead that will attract nearby monsters.
:{{A|vo ellq002 7 eula 05.ogg}} '''Eula:''' True elegance is the ability to calmly yet swiftly make decisions in the heat of the battle.
:{{DIcon}} Is this how you normally train?
:{{DIcon}} No wonder you are so skilled...
:{{A|vo ellq002 7 eula 06.ogg}} '''Eula:''' My family set only the highest expectations for me, even as a child.
:{{A|vo ellq002 7 eula 07.ogg}} '''Eula:''' Let's proceed, shall we?

;(Approach the Ley Line Monolith)
:{{A|vo ellq002 7 eula 08.ogg}} '''Eula:''' This is the Ley Line Monolith. Go ahead, activate it.
:{{A|vo ellq002 7 eula 09.ogg}} '''Eula:''' But be careful not to get launched into the air or frozen while fighting. That would be most unsightly.

;(Upon getting frozen)
:{{A|vo ellq002 7 eula 10.ogg}} '''Eula:''' You failed this time, what a shame.
:{{A|vo ellq002 7 eula 11.ogg}} '''Eula:''' But not to worry, it's just training after all. Let's try again.

;(After completing the challenge)
:{{A|vo ellq002 8 eula 01.ogg}} '''Eula:''' Well done. Your performance was most impressive.
:{{A|vo ellq002 8 eula 02.ogg}} '''Eula:''' And you managed to remain calm even in these grueling Dragonspine surroundings, haha. I'm starting to wonder if even I could have done the same.
:{{A|vo ellq002 8 eula 03.ogg}} '''Eula:''' Given such an outstanding performance, it seems there is little left for me to teach you.
:{{A|vo ellq002 8 paimon 01a.ogg}} {{A|vo ellq002 8 paimon 01b.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Like Paimon said, adventuring is our specialty!
:{{A|vo ellq002 8 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hehe... So that's it for our training, right? Then let's get out of Dragonspine before Paimon turns into a popsicle! *shivers*
:{{A|vo ellq002 8 eula 04a.ogg}} {{A|vo ellq002 8 eula 04b.ogg}} '''Eula:''' Hold on. I was commending {{Traveler}}'s performance just now. You, on the other hand, seem to have made no progress at all!
:{{A|vo ellq002 8 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What? You mean, Paimon was also part of the training!?
:{{A|vo ellq002 8 eula 05.ogg}} '''Eula:''' Yes, of course. You were frantically flying and dashing about throughout the entire thing. Not an elegant sight at all.
:{{A|vo ellq002 8 eula 06.ogg}} '''Eula:''' Did you even listen to anything I was trying to teach you?
:{{DIcon}} Maybe the weather is just too cold here.
::{{A|vo ellq002 8 paimon 04a a.ogg}} {{A|vo ellq002 8 paimon 04a b.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yeah, that's it, it's too cold here. B—Besides, Paimon was paying attention to the Traveler.
:{{DIcon}} Maybe that's just Paimon's style?
::{{A|vo ellq002 8 paimon 04b.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hey, that's not true! Paimon was just focusing on you the whole time!
:{{A|vo ellq002 8 eula 07.ogg}} '''Eula:''' Whatever the reason, not heeding my instructions... a cause for vengeance, perhaps...
:{{A|vo ellq002 8 eula 08.ogg}} '''Eula:''' *sigh* Now, drink this.
:{{A|vo ellq002 8 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh? What is it? *gasp* Are you trying to poison Paimon!?
:{{A|vo ellq002 8 eula 09.ogg}} '''Eula:''' Certainly not. It's warm milk.
:{{A|vo ellq002 8 eula 10.ogg}} '''Eula:''' Didn't you say you were freezing? Drink it and it'll help warm you up.
:{{A|vo ellq002 8 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh... uh... thank you! Um, are you... still planning on the whole vengeance thing?
:{{A|vo ellq002 8 eula 11.ogg}} '''Eula:''' If I wasn't, then why would I care about you being cold? If you turned into a Paimon popsicle, that would ruin my plans for vengeance now, wouldn't it...
:{{A|vo ellq002 8 eula 12.ogg}} '''Eula:''' So, "dear friend"... don't die on me out here.
:{{A|vo ellq002 8 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ahh! Paimon knew something was off!
:{{DIcon}} Thank you for looking after Paimon.
::{{A|vo ellq002 8 eula 13a.ogg}} '''Eula:''' All in the name of vengeance, no need to thank me.
:{{DIcon}} You're... strange.
::{{A|vo ellq002 8 eula 13b.ogg}} '''Eula:''' Hehe, vengeance should know no bounds, you know...
:{{A|vo ellq002 8 eula 14.ogg}} '''Eula:''' Now then, given that your training is complete, it's time we return to Mondstadt. Our last step will be preparing a cordial gift to present to my uncle when you meet him.
:{{A|vo ellq002 8 eula 15.ogg}} '''Eula:''' I already have something in mind. Let's pay Sara a visit at Good Hunter.

;(Approach Good Hunter)
:{{A|vo ellq002 9 ambor 01.ogg}} '''[[Amber]]:''' Oh, hey Eula! I see you've met the Honorary Knight!
:{{A|vo ellq002 9 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' We meet again, Amber! Seems we're just bound to run into you these days.
:{{A|vo ellq002 9 ambor 02.ogg}} '''Amber:''' Well, I just got back and was thinking about grabbing a bite at Good Hunter. But now that you're here, why don't we all eat together?
:{{A|vo ellq002 9 eula 01.ogg}} '''Eula:''' Very well. It's been some time since we've last shared a meal together.
:{{A|vo ellq002 9 eula 02.ogg}} '''Eula:''' Come, take a seat. We can discuss my uncle's gift while we eat.
:{{Black Screen|''Accepting Amber's invitation, you and Eula sit at the table.''}}
:{{A|vo ellq002 9 sara 01.ogg}} '''[[Sara]]:''' Yes, is there something else you'd like to order?
:{{A|vo ellq002 9 eula 03.ogg}} '''Eula:''' Could you please prepare a serving of my uncle's favorite, Gebratenes Fleisch mit Sauerkraut? We'll take it as a gift to him later.
:{{A|vo ellq002 9 sara 02.ogg}} '''Sara:''' Coming right up! It'll take some time to prepare, I'll have it here at the counter once it's ready.
:{{A|vo ellq002 9 eula 04.ogg}} '''Eula:''' Hold on a moment. Is this [[Satisfying Salad]] also something that Amber ordered?
:{{A|vo ellq002 9 sara 03.ogg}} '''Sara:''' No, she didn't order it. But because she didn't order any vegetables, I thought I'd throw in a salad on the house. You know, to contrast all the meat dishes.
:{{A|vo ellq002 9 eula 05.ogg}} '''Eula:''' So... we clearly didn't order this, yet you prepared it without authorization... Hmph! Mark my words, this transgression will not go unnoticed!
:{{A|vo ellq002 9 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Uh... you're gonna take revenge on her giving us a free salad!?
:{{A|vo ellq002 9 sara 04.ogg}} '''Sara:''' Hmph, you should know me by now, that's the kind of villainous character I am!
:{{A|vo ellq002 9 sara 05.ogg}} '''Sara:''' Well then... please wait a moment while I get the dish for your uncle started.
:{{A|vo ellq002 9 eula 06.ogg}} '''Eula:''' Hmph, delicious unauthorized delicacies... Sara will pay for this.
:{{A|vo ellq002 9 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Why would you choose Gebratenes Fleisch mit Sauerkraut as a gift for your uncle? Paimon's never even heard of that dish before...
:{{A|vo ellq002 9 eula 07.ogg}} '''Eula:''' This dish isn't actually on Good Hunter's menu. Only longstanding patrons such as my uncle would know about the dish. The old aristocrats seem to take a liking to it.
:{{A|vo ellq002 9 ambor 03.ogg}} '''Amber:''' Because of the sour flavor of the sauerkraut, not too many people are fond of it these days. I guess it's become less popular over time.
:{{A|vo ellq002 9 ambor 04.ogg}} '''Amber:''' Eula treated me to the dish once, and I couldn't even finish a bite. I've nicknamed it "Gebratenes Fleisch mit Vengeance" ever since. Yuck!
:{{A|vo ellq002 9 eula 08.ogg}} '''Eula:''' I never expected us to have such completely different tastes in food... If I weren't in such a good mood, I'd say that constitutes grounds for transgression...
:{{DIcon}} Huh, so even Amber doesn't escape your vengeance?
:{{A|vo ellq002 9 eula 09.ogg}} '''Eula:''' Of course not! It's hard to find someone in Mondstadt that attracts contempt as much as she does.
:{{A|vo ellq002 9 ambor 05.ogg}} '''Amber:''' Haha, it's fine when you're just joking between us, but I'm afraid our Honorary Knight might misunderstand you.
:{{A|vo ellq002 9 ambor 06.ogg}} '''Amber:''' Eula's always talking about vengeance, but that's just how she is. It's nothing you should take too seriously.
:{{A|vo ellq002 9 eula 10.ogg}} '''Eula:''' But I am serious! And I'll remember every transgression committed against me! Ugh, it's no wonder so many people dislike you!
:{{A|vo ellq002 9 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Paimon's starting to realize that Eula is actually a very good person.
:{{A|vo ellq002 9 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' There's no need to be so awkward when you want to say something nice.
:{{A|vo ellq002 9 eula 11.ogg}} '''Eula:''' *sigh* Listen, you've never been labeled as a social pariah, have you?
:{{A|vo ellq002 9 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What... well... no...?
:{{A|vo ellq002 9 eula 12.ogg}} '''Eula:''' So that's why you wouldn't understand how hard it is for a bad person to try to be good. It's impossible for me, and I have no intention of acting like a good person.
:{{A|vo ellq002 9 eula 13.ogg}} '''Eula:''' Alright, no need to look so sullen... I'm just kidding. Come on, let's eat. The food is getting cold.
:{{Black Screen|''After an awkward pause, everyone resumes cheerfully chatting and enjoys the meal.''}}
:{{A|vo ellq002 9 ambor 07.ogg}} '''Amber:''' Ooh, I'm stuffed. I'll see Sara about the bill.
:{{A|vo ellq002 9 eula 14.ogg}} '''Eula:''' No need, I've left the [[Mora]] under the plate. If you try to settle it with her in person, she won't accept payment for the salad.
:{{A|vo ellq002 9 eula 15.ogg}} '''Eula:''' Don't underestimate my ability to exact revenge. Hah! Sara won't get the upper hand this time!
:{{A|vo ellq002 9 eula 16.ogg}} '''Eula:''' Alright, next you should pay my uncle a visit. He has a small camp at the top of the mountain near [[Springvale]]. He usually whiles his time away there when there's nothing else to do.
:{{A|vo ellq002 9 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Uh... Aren't you coming with us, Eula?
:{{A|vo ellq002 9 eula 17.ogg}} '''Eula:''' I'm afraid that wouldn't be very convenient for me. It'd be better if you two went alone.
:{{A|vo ellq002 9 eula 18.ogg}} '''Eula:''' Ah yes, please do remember to pick up the dish from Sara.
:{{A|vo ellq002 9 ambor 08.ogg}} '''Amber:''' I still have more recon to do in the wilderness. Well, until next time!
:{{A|vo ellq002 9 eula 19.ogg}} '''Eula:''' Let's meet again. What an interesting bunch you are.

;(Talk to Sara)
:{{A|vo ellq002 10 sara 01.ogg}} '''Sara:''' Here, the Gebratenes Fleisch mit Sauerkraut is ready to go! Be sure to eat it while it's hot, otherwise the flavor will be spoiled.
:{{A|vo ellq002 10 sara 02.ogg}} '''Sara:''' And by the way, don't worry too much when Eula says strange things. She's actually a very good person.
:{{A|vo ellq002 10 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Paimon's been meaning to ask... No one could stand the sight of Eula when she was trying to speak with the others in Mondstadt earlier.
:{{A|vo ellq002 10 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' But she seemed to get alone fine with you and Amber just now... what's up with that?
:{{A|vo ellq002 10 sara 03.ogg}} '''Sara:''' The people of Mondstadt don't take kindly to anyone bearing the Lawrence name.
:{{A|vo ellq002 10 sara 04.ogg}} '''Sara:''' They are unable to see past her family, therefore they don't really see Eula for herself.
:{{A|vo ellq002 10 sara 05.ogg}} '''Sara:''' So no matter what Eula tries to do, it's seen as a wrongdoing. It essentially strips the meaning of anything she tries to accomplish.
:{{DIcon}} I think I understand now.
:{{DIcon}} So that's what she meant when she said it was hard for "a bad person to try to be good."
:{{A|vo ellq002 10 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' How come you're able to see Eula differently then?
:{{A|vo ellq002 10 sara 06.ogg}} '''Sara:''' Well, when she joined the Knights of Favonius, it caused quite an uproar.
:{{A|vo ellq002 10 sara 07.ogg}} '''Sara:''' Many people signed a petition, demanding that the Knights reverse their decision.
:{{A|vo ellq002 10 sara 08.ogg}} '''Sara:''' At the same time, numerous members of the Lawrence Clan crowded the entrance of the Knights of Favonius Headquarters, clamoring for Eula to give an explanation.
:{{A|vo ellq002 10 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Whoa... so both sides were unhappy.
:{{A|vo ellq002 10 sara 09.ogg}} '''Sara:''' That's right. So, you can imagine how determined Eula must have been under such circumstances.
:{{A|vo ellq002 10 sara 10.ogg}} '''Sara:''' But thanks to Grand Master [[Varka]] and the unwavering attitudes of others in the Knights of Favonius, they were able to quell the unrest. Tensions still remain beneath the surface, I'm afraid.
:{{A|vo ellq002 10 sara 11.ogg}} '''Sara:''' In the eyes of the people, she's a stain on the Knights of Favonius... and in the eyes of the Lawrence Clan, she's a disgrace to her family.
:{{A|vo ellq002 10 sara 12.ogg}} '''Sara:''' But she simply fulfills her duty as a Knight, silently helping one person after another, myself included.
:{{A|vo ellq002 10 sara 13.ogg}} '''Sara:''' People like Eula should be approached with care and understanding. She could stand to be treated a little more fairly.
:{{DIcon}} It's good that you're able to understand her.
:{{DIcon}} If only there were more people like you.
:{{A|vo ellq002 10 sara 14.ogg}} '''Sara:''' I believe a day will come when things will get better.
:{{A|vo ellq002 10 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Once everything's settled, we should go talk to Eula again. Paimon thinks we know how to communicate with her now.
:{{A|vo ellq002 10 sara 15.ogg}} '''Sara:''' I'm glad. I think that would make her very happy, though she might not ever admit it.
:{{A|vo ellq002 10 sara 16.ogg}} '''Sara:''' Take care. Please come again!
:;(Obtain [[Well-Packaged Gebratenes Fleisch mit Sauerkraut]] ×1)

;(Talk to Sara again, optional)
:{{A|vo dialog ellq002 sara 01.ogg}} '''Sara:''' Please don't tell Eula a word of what I've said.
:{{A|vo dialog ellq002 sara 02.ogg}} '''Sara:''' She might think I'm being too nosy.

==Gameplay Notes==
* During steps 3–8, the player will be in a [[Special Story Mode]], and the active party will be limited to a trial Traveler (Pyro), Iansan, Ororon, and Chasca.
** Additionally, during steps 5–6, a trial Citlali joins the active party.<!-- Is this the first time there have ever been 5 trial characters in one party? -->
** Leaving the Special Story Mode will reset the quest to Step 3, and all progress will be lost.
* All characters' [[energy]] and [[HP]] will be restored to full when the fight at the Children of Echoes base begins, after its flag is switched, after the flag at the People of the Springs base is switched, and when the fight at the Scions of the Canopy base begins.

==Dialogue==
{{Stub Dialogue|Check for missing lines.}}
{{Quest Description|Everyone decided to do something after hearing about how badly the last Bloomflower Trials went, and what happened to the little Qucusaur Antu. However, you'll need help from your other friends...}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Enter the Speaker's Chamber)
:{{A|vo nteq003 1 mualani 01.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' *yawn*... So sleepy!
:{{A|vo nteq003 1 kinich 01.ogg}} '''Kinich:''' Didn't sleep well?
:{{A|vo nteq003 1 mualani 02.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' Yeah... I blame Kachina, being all mysterious about some gathering to discuss "something important." I was so curious, I couldn't stop tossing and turning the whole night!
:{{A|vo nteq003 1 mualani 03.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' Also, how come it's so quiet today? You didn't lock Ajaw up, did you?
:{{A|vo nteq003 1 kinich 02.ogg}} '''Kinich:''' When I tried to wake him up this morning, his response was: "Leave me be, minion! Dar'st thou disturb the Almighty Dragonlord in our slumber?" I figured it would be for the best that he's not here anyway, so I didn't bother calling him again.
:{{A|vo nteq003 1 mualani 04.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' Haha, good thing you didn't tell him about our gathering. We could do without his gate-crashing, for sure...
:{{A|vo nteq003 1 iansan 01.ogg}} '''Iansan:''' Not late, am I?
:{{A|vo nteq003 1 citlali 01.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' Nope, you're right on time. So, Ifa, now that everyone's here, shall we begin?
:{{A|vo nteq003 1 ifa 01.ogg}} '''Ifa:''' *ahem*... Actually, today we have a big favor we'd like to ask of all of you.
:{{A|vo nteq003 1 xilonen 01.ogg}} '''Xilonen:''' What's up? Why so serious all of a sudden?
:{{A|vo nteq003 1 ifa 02.ogg}} '''Ifa:''' It's... a long story. One that begins with a "mysterious friend" of Milray's...
:{{Black Screen|Ifa relates what happened in the Bloomflower Trials centuries ago, and the tale of the little Qucusaur, Antu.}}
:{{Black Screen|After hearing such a tragic tale, everyone seems a bit gloomy.}}
:{{A|vo nteq003 1 iansan 02.ogg}} '''Iansan:''' Bloodshed between the tribes... That seems almost unthinkable today, but it was an everyday occurrence in that era.
:{{A|vo nteq003 1 varesa 01.ogg}} '''Varesa:''' Even working together on something was impossible... That's just too awful!
:{{Introductory Note|Varesa}}
:{{A|vo nteq003 1 chasca 01.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' There have always been disputes, but once they escalated into fully-fledged clashes between tribes... Even a peacemaker would have been powerless to mediate.
:{{A|vo nteq003 1 olorun 01.ogg}} '''Ororon:''' And that little Qucusaur, Antu, believed that the Sacred Flame Crystals harbored some kind of evil power that lay at the root of these inter-tribal conflicts.
:{{A|vo nteq003 1 olorun 02.ogg}} '''Ororon:''' And that led to all the later misunderstandings. At this point, it would be nigh impossible to explain the truth to him... Granny's right, it would only make him suffer all over again.
:{{A|vo nteq003 1 mavuika 01.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' That said, Antu will naturally sense that something's off once we've collected enough Sacred Flame Crystals and cure Milray, won't he?
:{{A|vo nteq003 1 mavuika 02.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' He'll see that no one has been "corrupted" and that all is as it should be. At that point, he would realize the truth of what happened in the past, even as young as he is.
:{{A|vo nteq003 1 ifa 03.ogg}} '''Ifa:''' Exactly. That's why we came up with a plan.
:{{A|vo nteq003 1 ifa 04.ogg}} '''Ifa:''' When the second half of the tournament wraps up, we'll have enough Sacred Flame Crystals. That's when I want everyone to act like the Crystals have messed with us and start arguing.
:{{A|vo nteq003 1 mualani 05.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' Ooh, acting! That sounds fun. Then what?
:{{A|vo nteq003 1 ifa 05.ogg}} '''Ifa:''' Then, we'll bring Antu over and cast a "Spell of Unity" to cleanse all the bad vibes within the Sacred Flame Crystals and bring everyone back to their senses.
:{{A|vo nteq003 1 ifa 06.ogg}} '''Ifa:''' Of course, neither the evil power or the magic are real, but we've gotta make the lil' dude think he's done "something awesome."
:{{A|vo nteq003 1 xilonen 02.ogg}} '''Xilonen:''' Aha, yeah. I get where you're going with this.
:{{A|vo nteq003 1 xilonen 03.ogg}} '''Xilonen:''' The best way to make up for regrets is to do what you failed to do before. We'll recreate that scene from his past, only this time, he'll get the chance to rewrite the future.
:{{A|vo nteq003 1 xilonen 04.ogg}} '''Xilonen:''' So, how exactly are we going to do this? Is there anything we can look to?
:{{A|vo nteq003 1 citlali 02.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' Once, when I was reading a foreign book, I came across something called an "interactive play," designed specifically for kids.
:{{A|vo nteq003 1 citlali 03.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' The story usually features a showdown between a hero and a villain, with twists and turns throughout. Just as things reach a climax, the hero will pretend to be losing and ask for the children's help.
:{{A|vo nteq003 1 citlali 04.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' Then, the children all raise their hands, lending their power to the hero and helping them defeat the villain.
:{{A|vo nteq003 1 citlali 05.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' For the adults watching, it's just a performance, but the children will walk away feeling happy for days to come.
:{{A|vo nteq003 1 citlali 06.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' At that age, happiness doesn't come from material rewards, but from "a heart that believes."
:{{A|vo nteq003 1 mualani 06.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' True! I can totally relate.
:{{A|vo nteq003 1 mualani 07.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' When I helped out at my parents' shop as a kid, they would always intentionally leave me some simple tasks, like dusting down the shelves or making sure the merchandise was arranged neatly.
:{{A|vo nteq003 1 mualani 08.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' Then they'd shower me with praise when I was finished, saying stuff like, "Good job, Mualani, you're a genius!"... And the funny thing is, it always made me super happy!
:{{A|vo nteq003 1 ifa 07.ogg}} '''Ifa:''' Spot on, that's exactly it. We wanna make Antu feel the same way a kid who just helped a hero would, lessen his regret and pain... before he moves on.
:{{A|vo nteq003 1 ifa 08.ogg}} '''Ifa:''' Besides, Milray already heard the rumors about the Sacred Flame Crystals from him. If we don't dispel the "curse" right in front of him, he might refuse to take the medicine.
:{{A|vo nteq003 1 ifa 09.ogg}} '''Ifa:''' But we can't pull off a show like that with just us. That's why I'm asking for your help.
:{{A|vo nteq003 1 citlali 07.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' We'll probably need about five more people... *ahem* I mean, there are five more spots up for grabs. First come, first served!
:{{A|vo nteq003 1 mualani 09.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' You have my board! Hehe, I'm probably the best at arguing here, don'cha think?
:{{A|vo nteq003 1 mualani 10.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' We get some pretty rude customers in our shop, and I've had to develop quite a few communication skills to deal with them.
:{{A|vo nteq003 1 olorun 03.ogg}} '''Ororon:''' You have my... cabbages? I can help prepare some props and special effects, like smoke to mimic the "evil power" and bright lights for the "Spell of Unity."
:{{A|vo nteq003 1 mavuika 03.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' And my Flamestrider.
:{{A|vo nteq003 1 mualani 11.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' Oh, you're joining too, Archon?
:{{A|vo nteq003 1 mavuika 04.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' It really resonated with me when Citlali mentioned a clash between heroes and villains.
:{{A|vo nteq003 1 mavuika 05.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' And unlike the heroes in those plays, I've borrowed strength from all of you in the real world — and we've overcome powerful foes together as a result. I think I'll do justice to the role.
:{{A|vo nteq003 1 xilonen 05.ogg}} '''Xilonen:''' If Mavuika's on board, then you have my hammer. I'm really interested in the part where we "pretend to argue."
:{{A|vo nteq003 1 ifa 10.ogg}} '''Ifa:''' Let's see. We've got our actors, and the stage is set. Now, we need a... director. A dude to run the show.
:{{A|vo nteq003 1 kinich 03.ogg}} '''Kinich:''' Wh—What's wrong? Why are you all looking at me?
:{{A|vo nteq003 1 mualani 12.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' Consider it our vote of confidence, Kinich!
:{{A|vo nteq003 1 kinich 04.ogg}} '''Kinich:''' Fine. Then you have my grappling hook. I happen to have some time.

'''''Stained Spots''''' is the second quest of {{Quest|When They Talk About Tonight}}.

==Steps==
# Wait till the next morning (06:00 – 10:00)
# Go to [[Chioriya Boutique]]
# Set up Chioriya Boutique
# Talk to Chiori
# Go to the supplier
# Catch up with Chiori
# Return to Chioriya Boutique
# Look for Chiori at the designated location
# Dive into the sea
# Collect materials for the accessories (X/3)
# Meet up with Chiori
# Return to Chioriya Boutique
# Dismantle the clothes
# Talk to Chiori
# Search for Lyney and Lynette

==Gameplay Notes==
* During step 13, the active party will be limited to the [[Traveler]].
* Step 4 of this quest will be blocked if the player has started {{Quest|When the Hearth-Flame Goes Out}} and has not yet completed step 4 of ''[[Into the Sunlight]]''.

:{{A|vo qzlq002 1 chiori 07.ogg}} '''Chiori:''' My thoughts exactly. She even lamented the fact that she didn't have time to prepare something even fancier. I'm pretty sure she can't wait for another escort opportunity to come her way.
:{{A|vo qzlq002 1 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Y'know, now that you mention Navia, Paimon thinks the two of you are actually pretty similar... You say what you mean, and when you have an idea, you really hit the ground running...
:{{A|vo qzlq002 1 chiori 08.ogg}} '''Chiori:''' I suppose that's why we're such good friends.
:{{A|vo qzlq002 1 chiori 09.ogg}} '''Chiori:''' Navia has a certain resilience about her — it's part of who she is. No matter what comes her way, she never bows down in the face of adversity. That sort of determination and courage is something I really admire.
:{{A|vo qzlq002 1 chiori 10.ogg}} '''Chiori:''' That same spirit is the true vision of my brand. When she first mentioned commissioning an outfit from my boutique... Well, I'm sure you can imagine my excitement.
:{{A|vo qzlq002 1 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' It's like finding the perfect brand ambassador, huh?
:{{A|vo qzlq002 1 chiori 11.ogg}} '''Chiori:''' Indeed. Customers pay attention not just to the clothes, but also to the figures in society who wear said clothes. People like to copy the styles of those they look up to.
:{{A|vo qzlq002 1 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh, and here Paimon thought all that mattered was for the clothes to look cute...
:{{A|vo qzlq002 1 chiori 12.ogg}} '''Chiori:''' Fashion is about more than just looks, my dear — especially if you've got your sights set on a market the size of Teyvat.
:{{A|vo qzlq002 1 chiori 13.ogg}} '''Chiori:''' ...Hmm? Well, would you look at the time...
:{{A|vo qzlq002 1 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh yeah! Come on, let's get down to business. We're here to model!
:{{A|vo qzlq002 1 chiori 14.ogg}} '''Chiori:''' Indeed. Give me a moment while I go retrieve some fabrics and sample outfits. Why don't you help me set up the shop displays in the meantime?
:{{A|vo qzlq002 1 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Set them up... Uh, how exactly?
:{{A|vo qzlq002 1 chiori 15.ogg}} '''Chiori:''' Just carefully organize the ready-to-wear clothes with an eye toward their types and styles. This way, we can guarantee that the customers will see something different every day.
:{{A|vo qzlq002 1 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Whoa... There sure is a lot that goes into running a store!
:{{A|vo qzlq002 1 chiori 16.ogg}} '''Chiori:''' Well then, I'll leave the displays to you.

:{{A|vo qzlq002 2 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So uh... We just need to put all the clothes with similar styles together, right?

;(Talk to Chiori, optional)
:{{A|vo dialog qzlq002 chiori 01.ogg}} '''Chiori:''' Please organize the clothes with an eye towards their types and styles. I'm counting on you.

;(Talk to Chiori)
;(If the clothes were placed in the correct configuration)
::{{A|vo qzlq002 2 chiori 01.ogg}} '''Chiori:''' Hmm, not bad. You might just have an eye for design.
;(If the clothes were not placed in the correct configuration)
::{{A|vo qzlq002 2 chiori 02.ogg}} '''Chiori:''' ...You didn't get bought out by my competitors, did you? This arrangement... It's...
::{{A|vo qzlq002 2 chiori 03.ogg}} '''Chiori:''' ...Never mind. It might look like a chaotic mess, but I suppose it works as a change of pace — and who knows? This style arrangement might come into vogue someday.
:{{A|vo qzlq002 2 chiori 04.ogg}} '''Chiori:''' Anyway, let's move on to the real task at hand.
:{{A|vo qzlq002 2 chiori 05.ogg}} '''Chiori:''' Over here, stand still. I'll take your measurements first...
:{{Color|menu|At that moment, a woman suddenly arrives...}}
:{{A|vo qzlq002 2 leeann 01.ogg}} '''Leeann:''' ...Excuse me, Miss Chiori.
:{{A|vo qzlq002 2 chiori 06.ogg}} '''Chiori:''' Oh, good morning, Leeann. How have you been recently?
:{{A|vo qzlq002 2 leeann 02.ogg}} '''Leeann:''' Umm... Not too bad.
:{{A|vo qzlq002 2 chiori 07.ogg}} '''Chiori:''' Your gown will be ready next week, so there's no need to worry about missing the ball. Or did you come here today because you'd like to make a new request, perhaps?
:{{A|vo qzlq002 2 leeann 03.ogg}} '''Leeann:''' Oh... No... Nothing like that, Miss Chiori. To be honest... I came here today to cancel my order for that gown.
:{{A|vo qzlq002 2 chiori 08.ogg}} '''Chiori:''' ...Cancel your order?
:{{A|vo qzlq002 2 leeann 04.ogg}} '''Leeann:''' Uh, but you can keep the deposit, of course! I know you can't return any materials you've already used.
:{{A|vo qzlq002 2 chiori 09.ogg}} '''Chiori:''' Don't worry about the materials. I'm more concerned about you. Did something happen, Leeann? Have your plans changed?
:{{A|vo qzlq002 2 leeann 05.ogg}} '''Leeann:''' Umm...
:{{A|vo qzlq002 2 chiori 10.ogg}} '''Chiori:''' It's alright, I'm not trying to make things difficult for you. I'll take note of the cancellation.
:{{A|vo qzlq002 2 leeann 06.ogg}} '''Leeann:''' Thank you... I'm really sorry.
:{{A|vo qzlq002 2 chiori 11.ogg}} '''Chiori:''' Don't worry about it. Just let me know if there's anything I can do to help.
:{{Color|menu|Leeann nods, then turns and leaves...}}
:{{A|vo qzlq002 2 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Is it just Paimon, or was she acting a bit strange just now... Wonder why she wouldn't tell us why she was cancelling her order...
:{{A|vo qzlq002 2 chiori 12.ogg}} '''Chiori:''' It's not a big deal. These things happen every once in a while.
:{{A|vo qzlq002 2 chiori 13.ogg}} '''Chiori:''' A family emergency, an important payday falling through, a lovers' quarrel, no one to take you to the ball... I've pretty much heard it all.
:{{A|vo qzlq002 2 chiori 14.ogg}} '''Chiori:''' Judging from the look on her face, something's keeping her from revealing the truth to us. It's best not to pry.
:{{A|vo qzlq002 2 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Well, guess this means you'll have more time to work on Fashion Week, right?
:{{A|vo qzlq002 2 chiori 15.ogg}} '''Chiori:''' That's true. Come, let's pick up where we left off...
:{{Color|menu|A man also walks into the shop...}}
:{{A|vo qzlq002 2 with 01.ogg}} '''Weis:''' ...Is Miss Chiori in?
:{{A|vo qzlq002 2 chiori 16.ogg}} '''Chiori:''' I am. How can I help you?
:{{A|vo qzlq002 2 with 02.ogg}} '''Weis:''' Um... I'd like to return this item.
:{{A|vo qzlq002 2 chiori 17.ogg}} '''Chiori:''' Oh? Could I ask why?
:{{A|vo qzlq002 2 with 03.ogg}} '''Weis:''' It's just, um... not to my liking. You said I could get a refund if I wasn't satisfied, so... that's why I'm here.
:{{A|vo qzlq002 2 chiori 18.ogg}} '''Chiori:''' Is there something about it that didn't meet your expectations? Are the sleeves too short, or is the color too dark? I can always make those adjustments for you.
:{{A|vo qzlq002 2 with 04.ogg}} '''Weis:''' Uh, no need... You don't have to concern yourself with that. I'd just like that refund please.
:{{A|vo qzlq002 2 chiori 19.ogg}} '''Chiori:''' And I'd be happy to process that for you... If you could just tell me the cause of your dissatisfaction...
:{{A|vo qzlq002 2 guestoutdoor 01.ogg}} '''Guest Outside the Shop:''' Is Chiori here? I'd like to return my outfit!
:{{A|vo qzlq002 2 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Another one!?
:{{A|vo qzlq002 2 chiori 20.ogg}} '''Chiori:''' Is there some sort of new calamity coming that I haven't heard about? Another flood? Or an apocalypse maybe? What does the prophecy say this time — you'll be spared if you get rid of all your clothes?
:{{A|vo qzlq002 2 chiori 21.ogg}} '''Chiori:''' Surely, the entire population of Fontaine didn't convene and pick this one day to come and return my clothes. What is going on?
:{{A|vo qzlq002 2 with 05.ogg}} '''Weis:''' ...
:{{A|vo qzlq002 2 guestoutdoor 02.ogg}} '''Guest Outside the Shop:''' What kind of rags are you trying to sell us, huh? The way I see it, this shop is nothing more than a black market front run by a bunch of dirty criminals!
:{{A|vo qzlq002 2 eloffe 01.ogg}} '''Eloffe:''' Please calm down, sir...
:{{A|vo qzlq002 2 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What is he talking about?
:{{A|vo qzlq002 2 with 06.ogg}} '''Weis:''' Haven't you heard? Chioriya Boutique has been exposed for having close ties with criminals. It's all over the papers!
:{{A|vo qzlq002 2 chiori 22.ogg}} '''Chiori:''' And just who is it that dares to throw that accusation around?
:{{A|vo qzlq002 2 with 07.ogg}} '''Weis:''' Well, you tell us! The fabrics you've got here — they're all sourced from underground factories, aren't they?
:{{A|vo qzlq002 2 chiori 23.ogg}} '''Chiori:''' ...I've been transparent about my materials from the very beginning. I've already proved there's nothing wrong with them.
:{{A|vo qzlq002 2 chiori 24.ogg}} '''Chiori:''' If a little hearsay and baseless slander are enough to convince you, then by all means, go ahead and hand over your garments right now — spare yourself from that flood of yours. Or have you not been convinced of that one just yet...
:{{A|vo qzlq002 2 with 08.ogg}} '''Weis:''' You...!
:{{A|vo qzlq002 2 chiori 25.ogg}} '''Chiori:''' Eloffe!
:{{A|vo qzlq002 2 eloffe 02.ogg}} '''Eloffe:''' Miss Chiori...
:{{A|vo qzlq002 2 chiori 26.ogg}} '''Chiori:''' Go outside and help these customers with their return requests. There's no need to ask them why. We'll refund them at the purchase price.
:{{A|vo qzlq002 2 eloffe 03.ogg}} '''Eloffe:''' A—Alright...
:{{A|vo qzlq002 2 chiori 27.ogg}} '''Chiori:''' And once you're done, put up the sign that says we're closed for the day.
:{{A|vo qzlq002 2 eloffe 04.ogg}} '''Eloffe:''' ...Got it.
:{{A|vo qzlq002 2 with 09.ogg}} '''Weis:''' Hmph...
:{{Color|menu|Weis and Eloffe leave together...}}
:{{A|vo qzlq002 2 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Chiori...
:{{DIcon}} These rumors...
:{{A|vo qzlq002 2 chiori 28.ogg}} '''Chiori:''' They couldn't be more fabricated if you tried. No need to worry about them. I'm sure they'll go away on their own in a few days.
:{{A|vo qzlq002 2 chiori 29.ogg}} '''Chiori:''' The real goal here is to divert my attention away from Fashion Week. The best response right now is to tune it out and focus on finalizing my designs.
:{{A|vo qzlq002 2 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' If you say so... but Paimon still can't help but worry...
:{{A|vo qzlq002 2 chiori 30.ogg}} '''Chiori:''' The best way to respond to public skepticism is to let your work speak for itself. There will be no doubt about the quality of my work once my new designs are released — the public just has to see it for themselves.
:{{A|vo qzlq002 2 eloffe 05.ogg}} '''Eloffe:''' ...Miss Chiori! Bad news!
:{{A|vo qzlq002 2 chiori 31.ogg}} '''Chiori:''' Oh, for the love of... Can a woman not get a moment of peace to do her work? Go on. What's the matter now?
:{{A|vo qzlq002 2 eloffe 06.ogg}} '''Eloffe:''' It's our accessories supplier. They just sent word that they'll no longer be able to supply us during Fashion Week!
:{{A|vo qzlq002 2 chiori 32.ogg}} '''Chiori:''' What? No accessories? Not even the ones we pre-ordered?
:{{A|vo qzlq002 2 eloffe 07.ogg}} '''Eloffe:''' Yes, that's what their messenger said...
:{{A|vo qzlq002 2 chiori 33.ogg}} '''Chiori:''' And what about the models we asked them to book for us?
:{{A|vo qzlq002 2 eloffe 08.ogg}} '''Eloffe:''' I think... They'll probably pull out as well...
:{{A|vo qzlq002 2 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Even the suppliers believe those nasty rumors!?
:{{A|vo qzlq002 2 chiori 34.ogg}} '''Chiori:''' ...
:{{A|vo qzlq002 2 chiori 35.ogg}} '''Chiori:''' Is the messenger still here?
:{{A|vo qzlq002 2 eloffe 09.ogg}} '''Eloffe:''' No, they've already left.
:{{A|vo qzlq002 2 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So no accessories means... no brooches, no bow ties, things like that?
:{{A|vo qzlq002 2 chiori 36.ogg}} '''Chiori:''' Not just that. It means no gems, ribbons, gold thread — all the elements that lend life and soul to my designs.
:{{A|vo qzlq002 2 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' But... if you take those away... Does that mean you won't be able to make your designs at all?
:{{A|vo qzlq002 2 chiori 37.ogg}} '''Chiori:''' ...Eloffe, you stay and watch the shop. I'll go talk to the supplier myself.
:{{DIcon}} We'll go with you.
:{{DIcon}} Maybe we'll be able to find out what happened.
:{{A|vo qzlq002 2 paimon 12.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yeah! And we can vouch for you too! We'll make sure your supplier knows there's nothing wrong with your clothes!
:{{A|vo qzlq002 2 chiori 38.ogg}} '''Chiori:''' Thank you. In that case, please come with me.

;(Talk to Eloffe, optional)
:{{A|vo dialog qzlq002 eloffe 01.ogg}} '''Eloffe:''' I know Miss Chiori has put a lot of work into making Fashion Week a success...
:{{A|vo dialog qzlq002 eloffe 02.ogg}} '''Eloffe:''' I hope you can talk things through with the supplier.
----
;(Approach the marked location)
:{{A|vo qzlq002 3 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' By the way, we really are just going to "talk," right?
:{{A|vo qzlq002 3 chiori 01.ogg}} '''Chiori:''' Of course. I wouldn't do anything to one of my business partners, especially when a reasonable conversation should suffice.

;(Approach the marked location)
:'''Chiori:''' ...
:{{A|vo qzlq002 3 wenger 01.ogg}} '''Wenger:''' Who is it?
:{{A|vo qzlq002 3 chiori 02.ogg}} '''Chiori:''' Wenger. It's Chiori.
:{{A|vo qzlq002 3 wenger 02.ogg}} '''Wenger:''' ...
:{{A|vo qzlq002 3 chiori 03.ogg}} '''Chiori:''' We've worked together all these years — the least you could do is allow me a face-to-face conversation.
:{{A|vo qzlq002 3 wenger 03.ogg}} '''Wenger:''' Haha... Straightforward as always, I see. You know, there are certain conventions people usually follow if they want to seek someone's company — sending a messenger for example.
:{{A|vo qzlq002 3 chiori 04.ogg}} '''Chiori:''' And when has following convention ever gotten me anywhere? Why hire a messenger when I can just explain things in person?
:{{A|vo qzlq002 3 wenger 04.ogg}} '''Wenger:''' Hmm... Have you read the papers today?
:{{A|vo qzlq002 3 chiori 05.ogg}} '''Chiori:''' I don't like to waste my time on baseless lies and speculation. Maybe that's something you should consider as well...
:{{A|vo qzlq002 3 wenger 05.ogg}} '''Wenger:''' You're right. I only subscribe to [[The Steambird]], and most days, I never even read the others.
:{{A|vo qzlq002 3 chiori 06.ogg}} '''Chiori:''' So these rumors... The Steambird was the one that published them?
:{{A|vo qzlq002 3 wenger 06.ogg}} '''Wenger:''' No, not at all. They were in some second-rate fashion tabloids.
:{{A|vo qzlq002 3 chiori 07.ogg}} '''Chiori:''' Well then, there you go! Those sort of headlines become old news faster than you can read them. Surely a bit of tabloid drama isn't worth cutting off my supply?
:{{A|vo qzlq002 3 wenger 07.ogg}} '''Wenger:''' *sigh* You would think that... But this time is different...
:{{A|vo qzlq002 3 wenger 08.ogg}} '''Wenger:''' Someone paid off the tabloids to publish the same article at once. They even went so far as to leave a copy in front of every house. That's how I first learned of the rumors.
:{{A|vo qzlq002 3 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Every house? That means... someone must have been planning this for a very long time...
:{{A|vo qzlq002 3 wenger 09.ogg}} '''Wenger:''' It seems your rival has really pulled out all the stops this time, Chiori. The article was even published alongside a photo of you...
:{{A|vo qzlq002 3 chiori 08.ogg}} '''Chiori:''' What sort of photo?
:{{A|vo qzlq002 3 wenger 10.ogg}} '''Wenger:''' A photo of you... beating up someone on the street yesterday.
:{{A|vo qzlq002 3 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yesterday!? Wait. That means...
:{{A|vo qzlq002 3 chiori 09.ogg}} '''Chiori:''' Tsk... Uther again...
:{{A|vo qzlq002 3 wenger 11.ogg}} '''Wenger:''' Here, I've got a copy. See for yourselves.
:{{Color|menu|Wenger hands you a newspaper...}}
::'''Chioriya Boutique - Darkness Disguised Behind a Facade of Fashion'''
::...Chioriya Boutique, located within our good Court of Fontaine, claims to be a clothing store with a unique style. But there is another side to this tale for those few who look beneath that facade—
::Sources in the [[Fortress of Meropide]] say that not a few criminals have boasted of wearing Chioriya Boutique's clothes. "I just felt that the atmosphere in there suited me..." convicted felon Lyle said. These words met with wide approval from many of his fellow inmates. Our sources also stated that a prisoner who was recently convicted of violent conduct and battery also openly supported Chiori's designs a year ago.
::...
::Upon close investigation of Chioriya's many suppliers, we discovered that there is something more to the discovery that criminals favor its wares. The Boutique is in truth comparable to an invisible hand, like a spider's web that connects these evil-doers. Our investigations show that the Wenger family supplies the ornaments that adorn her designs, and a certain member of this household is a frequent guest at the Fortress... But do birds of a feather not flock together? ...
::...
::Not only that, but many customers have also been subject to rough treatment at Chioriya. Mr. Valerian had this to say: "A real brute, that one. Never mind refusing to tailor my clothes! Why, she seized her scissors and began wrecking them, and threw me out the window! A clothing store? More like a thieves's lair if you ask me!"
::Doubtless, many of you may have wondered why the glass at Chioriya Boutique often shatters with a loud crash, leaving behind a terrifying mess... Mr. Valerian's unfortunate encounter unveils the truth.
::Just the day before this report was going to print, another such act of brutal battery occurred on the streets. Just imagine, if you would, the scene playing out as depicted in the photo above — Chiori, her countenance terrifying as she grabs her competitor Mr. Uther by the scruff, making threatening gestures toward him. This incident was ultimately broken up by Gardes who reached the scene...
::...
::When we asked criminals why they appreciated this brand, the answer we received was that Chioriya employs illegal competitive tactics to come out on top, giving hope to evil-doers among us that wrongdoing can still prevail, provided you conceal it under the guise of fashion and beauty...
::...
::Perhaps those who purchase clothes from this establishment may, following this establishment's philosophy, prefer to "liquidate" those with whom they have disagreements...
::...
::...Is Chioriya Boutique, indeed, a place blindly flattered by fashionistas that keeps an exclusive clientele of crooks?
:{{A|vo qzlq002 3 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Behind the scenes, the true Chioriya Boutique takes shape — not a fashion house, but a house of lies...
:{{A|vo qzlq002 3 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Relying on its close ties to the criminal underworld, the Chioriya brand employs illegal competitive tactics to come out on top, giving hope to the evil-doers among us that wrongdoing can still prevail, provided you conceal it under the guise of fashion and beauty.
:{{A|vo qzlq002 3 chiori 10.ogg}} '''Chiori:''' ...
:{{A|vo qzlq002 3 wenger 12.ogg}} '''Wenger:''' I don't know what happened, and I don't want to comment on things that I didn't see with my own eyes. Still, that photo shows you to be the clear aggressor.
:{{DIcon}} But Uther harassed Chiori first...
:{{DIcon}} He even hired some goons to attack her courier...
:{{A|vo qzlq002 3 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yeah! He was the one who started it, that little...
:{{A|vo qzlq002 3 chiori 11.ogg}} '''Chiori:''' I appreciate you standing up for me, Paimon, but it can't be helped now...
:{{A|vo qzlq002 3 wenger 13.ogg}} '''Wenger:''' That's right. The court of public opinion has already made up its mind... Still, I've got to give your rival high marks for effort. They even dug up the fact that my father once served time in the Fortress of Meropide...
:{{A|vo qzlq002 3 chiori 12.ogg}} '''Chiori:''' But that was so long ago...
:{{A|vo qzlq002 3 wenger 14.ogg}} '''Wenger:''' In the world of fashion, your past is like a piece of clothing stained with mud — once tainted, it can never be washed clean.
:{{A|vo qzlq002 3 wenger 15.ogg}} '''Wenger:''' They claim that most of your clientele are criminals and that those who buy your clothes are just like you — people who silence all dissent with violence.
:{{A|vo qzlq002 3 chiori 13.ogg}} '''Chiori:''' The absurdity... I don't even know which part to laugh at the most.
:{{A|vo qzlq002 3 wenger 16.ogg}} '''Wenger:''' Well, it's no laughing matter.
:{{A|vo qzlq002 3 wenger 17.ogg}} '''Wenger:''' Maybe your clientele are criminals, maybe they're not. There's even the possibility that they're just people who happened to commit crimes after buying your clothes...
:{{A|vo qzlq002 3 wenger 18.ogg}} '''Wenger:''' But, with the way this article combines fact with rumor, trying to determine the truth is practically an exercise in futility. It's not something people are just going to forget about in a day or two, especially when they've found several people to back up their claims.
:{{A|vo qzlq002 3 chiori 14.ogg}} '''Chiori:''' ...Wenger, are you sure you won't reconsider? If we go through with the show together, we can defeat them fair and square.
:{{A|vo qzlq002 3 wenger 19.ogg}} '''Wenger:''' Hahaha... If I were younger, I might have said yes.
:{{A|vo qzlq002 3 wenger 20.ogg}} '''Wenger:''' But I'm no longer that brave young man with nothing to lose. I've got the family business to consider now.
:{{A|vo qzlq002 3 wenger 21.ogg}} '''Wenger:''' I'd be perfectly happy to work with you again after this, but my daughter is manning the store during Fashion Week, and I don't want her implicated in all this. She doesn't deserve to be swarmed by all that negative publicity.
:{{A|vo qzlq002 3 chiori 15.ogg}} '''Chiori:''' ...I understand.
:{{A|vo qzlq002 3 wenger 22.ogg}} '''Wenger:''' Let me offer you a piece of advice, Chiori, for old time's sake — let this Fashion Week go. There's always next year. You just need to wait for all of this to blow over.
:{{A|vo qzlq002 3 chiori 16.ogg}} '''Chiori:''' You're free to wait things out, Wenger. I'll make my own choices.
:{{A|vo qzlq002 3 wenger 23.ogg}} '''Wenger:''' Heh... have you ever thought maybe that attitude of yours is what's gotten you into all this trouble?
:{{A|vo qzlq002 3 chiori 17.ogg}} '''Chiori:''' Have you ever thought maybe this attitude of mine is precisely what paved the way for my success?
:{{A|vo qzlq002 3 wenger 24.ogg}} '''Wenger:''' Fair enough... Then I suppose all there's left to say is... Best of luck. As for the models... *sigh* None of them wanted to be implicated in all this either...
:{{A|vo qzlq002 3 chiori 18.ogg}} '''Chiori:''' Understood. Take care.
:{{A|vo qzlq002 3 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' ...
:{{A|vo qzlq002 3 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So, um... What should we do now?
:{{A|vo qzlq002 3 chiori 19.ogg}} '''Chiori:''' Without the accessories, I can no longer use my old designs.
:{{A|vo qzlq002 3 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ugh, how could they do this! They're making things up! The Boutique doesn't have anything to do with violent criminals! Can't people tell this is just a bunch of lies!
:{{A|vo qzlq002 3 chiori 20.ogg}} '''Chiori:''' Public opinion has never been about what's true and what's not. It's about echoing the loudest voice in the room.
:{{A|vo qzlq002 3 chiori 21.ogg}} '''Chiori:''' Tch... I should have seen it from the beginning. Uther knows me too well. Everything that happened yesterday... was just a trap.
:{{A|vo qzlq002 3 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Well, guess all we can do is just head back for now...
:{{A|vo qzlq002 3 charlotte 01.ogg}} '''Charlotte:''' {{Traveler}}, Paimon!
:{{A|vo qzlq002 3 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Charlotte!? What are you doing here?
:{{A|vo qzlq002 3 charlotte 02.ogg}} '''Charlotte:''' Looking for you, of course! Did you see those fashion tabloids this morning?
:{{A|vo qzlq002 3 paimon 12.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You mean that sorry excuse for an article? Ugh, just thinking about it makes Paimon's blood boil!
:{{A|vo qzlq002 3 charlotte 03.ogg}} '''Charlotte:''' You too, huh?
:{{A|vo qzlq002 3 charlotte 04.ogg}} '''Charlotte:''' Whoever wrote that article must have known The Steambird would never print something so defamatory. Unfortunately, not all the papers in Fontaine share our same sense of journalistic integrity...
:{{A|vo qzlq002 3 charlotte 05.ogg}} '''Charlotte:''' Miss Chiori doesn't deserve to suffer all this baseless slander! I was just about to find some people to interview so that I can write an article to refute all those claims! If there's one thing I can't stand... it's people who misrepresent and distort the facts!
:{{A|vo qzlq002 3 paimon 13.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' That's great! With your help, we might be able to get some people back on our side!
:{{A|vo qzlq002 3 charlotte 06.ogg}} '''Charlotte:''' It's my pleasure! I've met Miss Chiori several times. I know she's not the kind of person that article makes her out to be.
:{{A|vo qzlq002 3 charlotte 07.ogg}} '''Charlotte:''' She was the one who made the hat and tie for my Kamera, "Monsieur Verite."

:{{A|vo qzlq002 4 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Eloffe! We're back.
:{{A|vo qzlq002 4 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh? Who's this?
:{{A|vo qzlq002 4 eloffe 01.ogg}} '''Eloffe:''' Ah, this is Miss Laetitia. She's also here to see Miss Chiori.
:{{A|vo qzlq002 4 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh! You're the one who came to collect the wedding dress yesterday, right? Wait, please don't say you're returning that dress, too...
:{{A|vo qzlq002 4 laetitia 01.ogg}} '''Laetitia:''' Oh, no, no, not at all! I'm just here to thank her! In fact, if there's anything I can do to help her out, I'd be more than willing...
:{{A|vo qzlq002 4 charlotte 01.ogg}} '''Charlotte:''' Ah, so you've come across that article as well.
:{{A|vo qzlq002 4 laetitia 02.ogg}} '''Laetitia:''' Yeah... You probably don't know this... But after I got engaged, I didn't think I'd be able to wear a Chioriya dress on my wedding day.
:{{A|vo qzlq002 4 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh. Why?
:{{A|vo qzlq002 4 laetitia 03.ogg}} '''Laetitia:''' My fiance owns a small business. It doesn't bring in a lot of Mora, but we get by. After he proposed, he took me to Chioriya Boutique, and we put down a custom order for a dress.
:{{A|vo qzlq002 4 laetitia 04.ogg}} '''Laetitia:''' He probably noticed how often I talked about Miss Chiori's clothes and how pretty they were... Being able to wear one of her dresses to my wedding has always been my dream.
:{{A|vo qzlq002 4 charlotte 02.ogg}} '''Charlotte:''' And then?
:{{A|vo qzlq002 4 laetitia 05.ogg}} '''Laetitia:''' And then... Something happened to the business, and we ran into major Mora problems. We were able to scrounge up enough to pay off our debts, but... it left us without the funds to pay for the dress.
:{{A|vo qzlq002 4 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' But didn't Chiori say she was able to make the dress from what was left of the original deposit?
:{{A|vo qzlq002 4 laetitia 06.ogg}} '''Laetitia:''' Yes... When I came to cancel the order, she asked if something happened, and I told her everything...
:{{A|vo qzlq002 4 laetitia 07.ogg}} '''Laetitia:''' She heard me out, and then told me not to worry. She assured me that the deposit I paid would be enough for the dress, and that she'd be able to finish making it in time as well... She promised that I'd be able to wear a Chioriya dress on my wedding day.
:{{A|vo qzlq002 4 charlotte 03.ogg}} '''Charlotte:''' Well, that's a good thing isn't it? I've always known Miss Chiori to be a woman of her word.
:{{A|vo qzlq002 4 laetitia 08.ogg}} '''Laetitia:''' It is good... It's just... After I went home yesterday, I couldn't help but take out the dress and try it on. My fiance happened to walk into the room... and when he saw me, he froze on the spot.
:{{A|vo qzlq002 4 charlotte 04.ogg}} '''Charlotte:''' Ah... What a shame... He's not supposed to see it until the wedding day...
:{{A|vo qzlq002 4 laetitia 09.ogg}} '''Laetitia:''' Well, see, that wasn't actually the issue...
:{{A|vo qzlq002 4 laetitia 10.ogg}} '''Laetitia:''' He's seen a lot of wedding dresses in his time doing business, so as soon as he saw it, he knew for sure that it must've cost far more than what we paid.
:{{A|vo qzlq002 4 charlotte 05.ogg}} '''Charlotte:''' Huh? So wait, that means...
:{{A|vo qzlq002 4 laetitia 11.ogg}} '''Laetitia:''' Yeah... Miss Chiori covered all the costs and held nothing back. The fabric, accessories, beading, construction... It was all of the highest quality.
:{{A|vo qzlq002 4 charlotte 06.ogg}} '''Charlotte:''' ...
:{{A|vo qzlq002 4 charlotte 07.ogg}} '''Charlotte:''' Miss Laetitia... I'd really like to use your story for a piece I'm writing about the boutique. Would you mind going on the record?
:{{A|vo qzlq002 4 laetitia 12.ogg}} '''Laetitia:''' Huh? Well, if it would help Miss Chiori out, I wouldn't mind at all...
:{{A|vo qzlq002 4 charlotte 08.ogg}} '''Charlotte:''' I think it'd go a long way! Your real experience is more powerful than all of those lies combined!
:{{A|vo qzlq002 4 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hey, Eloffe... Has Chiori come back here since we left?
:{{A|vo qzlq002 4 eloffe 02.ogg}} '''Eloffe:''' Huh? I thought you all were together...
:{{A|vo qzlq002 4 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Well, we were... Hmm, if she didn't come back here, then do you know of any other places she could've gone?
:{{A|vo qzlq002 4 eloffe 03.ogg}} '''Eloffe:''' Umm...
:{{A|vo qzlq002 4 eloffe 04.ogg}} '''Eloffe:''' Oh, I remember now! There's this one cliff by the sea! Miss Chiori would always go there whenever she was upset.
:{{A|vo qzlq002 4 charlotte 09.ogg}} '''Charlotte:''' In that case, why don't we split up? I'll continue interviewing Miss Laetitia, and you two can go look for Miss Chiori.
:{{A|vo qzlq002 4 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Alright, sounds good! Let's go!

:{{A|vo dialog qzlq002 laetitia 01.ogg}} '''Laetitia:''' Let's see... Well, she's certainly not afraid to say what she means, but she always looks out for her customers however she can...

:{{A|vo qzlq002 5 chiori 02.ogg}} '''Chiori:''' Ah, I'm not upset. I just wanted to get some fresh air.

:{{A|vo qzlq002 5 chiori 05.ogg}} '''Chiori:''' Well, how does it feel?
:{{A|vo qzlq002 5 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' This place is pretty great!
:{{A|vo qzlq002 5 chiori 06.ogg}} '''Chiori:''' Right? It's quiet and open, and far from the relentless critique from fashion commentators and the media. It's just you and the beautiful scenery.
:{{A|vo qzlq002 5 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yeah! It's important to take yourself out of that kind of stressful environment every once in a while.
:{{A|vo qzlq002 5 chiori 07.ogg}} '''Chiori:''' ...
:{{A|vo qzlq002 5 chiori 08.ogg}} '''Chiori:''' I didn't grow up in a very strict family. My parents would joke that I grew up to be so assertive because they spoiled me as a child.
:{{A|vo qzlq002 5 chiori 09.ogg}} '''Chiori:''' I would get together with the other children to climb trees and explore caves... One time, I even climbed over the walls of the [[Kamisato Estate]]. One of the servants had to physically remove me...
:{{A|vo qzlq002 5 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Whoa... Paimon would have never imagined that...
:<gallery widths="350">
Stained Spots Quest Still 3.png
</gallery>
:{{A|vo qzlq002 5 chiori 10.ogg}} '''Chiori:''' But even as rambunctious as I was, when it came to needlework, I was as quiet and focused as could be.
:{{A|vo qzlq002 5 chiori 11.ogg}} '''Chiori:''' It was as if I'd discovered a whole new world within those vibrant, dazzling fabrics... You know the feeling?
:{{A|vo qzlq002 5 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Err, sorta...
:{{A|vo qzlq002 5 chiori 12.ogg}} '''Chiori:''' My parents noticed, and they sent me to study under a famous Inazuman tailor. It wasn't long before I had driven away pretty much every master tailor on the archipelago. You could say I really tried their patience.
:{{A|vo qzlq002 5 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You were that misbehaved?
:<gallery widths="350">
Stained Spots Quest Still 4.png
</gallery>
:{{A|vo qzlq002 5 chiori 13.ogg}} '''Chiori:''' I wasn't misbehaved, exactly. I just... often had strange ideas when it came to fashion, ones that weren't in line with traditional ways of doing things.
:{{A|vo qzlq002 5 chiori 14.ogg}} '''Chiori:''' On top of that, I hated the idea of groveling and making outfits for every arrogant big shot expecting me to be at their beck and call.
:{{A|vo qzlq002 5 chiori 15.ogg}} '''Chiori:''' Anyway, a few incidents later, I soon found myself without a master. Worse, not one shop was willing to hire me, not even to do grunt work.
:{{A|vo qzlq002 5 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' No wonder you left Inazuma...
:{{A|vo qzlq002 5 chiori 16.ogg}} '''Chiori:''' I was angry and frustrated, so before I left, I swore to all those "masters" that my brand would one day become renowned all over Teyvat.
:{{A|vo qzlq002 5 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Well, that's a great dream to strive towards!
:{{A|vo qzlq002 5 chiori 17.ogg}} '''Chiori:''' After that, I came all the way to the Court of Fontaine — a city often referred to as the capital of arts and fashion.
:{{A|vo qzlq002 5 chiori 18.ogg}} '''Chiori:''' I had a lot of fun starting out. Sure, I was living in a small, cramped room... but I was finally free to make whatever I wanted.
:{{A|vo qzlq002 5 chiori 19.ogg}} '''Chiori:''' I had a far more naive view of "fashion" back then. As long as something was pretty, it would become popular, right? A simple concept, surely.
:{{A|vo qzlq002 5 chiori 20.ogg}} '''Chiori:''' Of course, as I spent more and more time in the industry, I learned nothing was ever that simple, least of all "fashion."
:{{DIcon}} Well, I know someone who absolutely adored your designs...
:{{DIcon}} And dreamed of wearing one at her wedding...
:{{A|vo qzlq002 5 chiori 21.ogg}} '''Chiori:''' Oh, you mean Laetitia?
:{{A|vo qzlq002 5 chiori 22.ogg}} '''Chiori:''' Yeah, she did mention that dream... I'll be honest with you. That's the first time I ever heard something like that from one of my customers.
:{{A|vo qzlq002 5 chiori 23.ogg}} '''Chiori:''' Who would have thought... Even as I continue to pursue my dream, my work has also become someone else's...
:{{A|vo qzlq002 5 chiori 24.ogg}} '''Chiori:''' ...
:{{A|vo qzlq002 5 chiori 25.ogg}} '''Chiori:''' Alright, that's enough sight-seeing for one day. Time to come up with a way out of this mess.
:{{A|vo qzlq002 5 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ooh! Looks like you've got your game face back!
:{{A|vo qzlq002 5 chiori 26.ogg}} '''Chiori:''' Back? It was never gone to begin with. I did say I wasn't upset, didn't I?
:{{A|vo qzlq002 5 paimon 12.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Paimon thinks we should look for evidence that Uther wrote that article, and that he hired those Treasure Hoarders to attack Kirara!
:{{A|vo qzlq002 5 paimon 13.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Charlotte's already working on an article to address all those nasty rumors, so we can publish all our findings in The Steambird once we're done!
:{{A|vo qzlq002 5 chiori 27.ogg}} '''Chiori:''' I don't like duking it out in the press... But if Charlotte's thrown her hat in the ring, I won't stop her, either.
:{{A|vo qzlq002 5 chiori 28.ogg}} '''Chiori:''' I know where Uther's clothing factory is located. It might be a good place to start looking for some evidence.
:{{A|vo qzlq002 5 paimon 14.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Sounds good! We'll come with!
:{{A|vo qzlq002 5 paimon 15.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' As for Fashion Week... Well, there's always next year, right? So there's no need to be too upset!
:{{A|vo qzlq002 5 chiori 29.ogg}} '''Chiori:''' Hmm? When did this become an either-or situation? Find incriminating evidence, or participate in Fashion Week? Hah, I'm doing both.
:{{A|vo qzlq002 5 paimon 16.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh? But your accessories... Didn't you say your designs were unusable without them?
:{{A|vo qzlq002 5 chiori 30.ogg}} '''Chiori:''' Well, it's true that I haven't quite figured out what to do about that, but...
:{{A|vo qzlq002 5 chiori 31.ogg}} '''Chiori:''' To tell you the truth... Even here in Fontaine, every time I see the sea, I can't help but remember Inazuma... and the vow I made in front of those "masters"...
:{{A|vo qzlq002 5 chiori 32.ogg}} '''Chiori:''' Thinking about all that, I just... can't bear to take even one step back.
:{{A|vo qzlq002 5 paimon 17.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' ...
:{{A|vo qzlq002 5 chiori 33.ogg}} '''Chiori:''' ...The sea...
:{{A|vo qzlq002 5 paimon 18.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hmm? What did you just say, Chiori?
:{{A|vo qzlq002 5 chiori 34.ogg}} '''Chiori:''' ...The sea. Seashells... Coral...
:{{A|vo qzlq002 5 chiori 35.ogg}} '''Chiori:''' ...I've got it!
:{{A|vo qzlq002 5 paimon 19.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh? Got what?
:{{A|vo qzlq002 5 chiori 36.ogg}} '''Chiori:''' Come! Let's take a dip, shall we?
:{{A|vo qzlq002 5 paimon 20.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh!? Chiori, wait, hold up!

:{{A|vo qzlq002 8 chiori 04.ogg}} '''Chiori:''' Haha, well I can't argue with you there. One thing's for sure, though — I'm going to do whatever it takes to make it work.
:{{A|vo qzlq002 8 chiori 05.ogg}} '''Chiori:''' Hah... All this grit and determination... It reminds me of the first Fashion Week I ever participated in...
:{{A|vo qzlq002 8 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What else can we help with?
:{{A|vo qzlq002 8 chiori 06.ogg}} '''Chiori:''' Hmm... Let me see...
:{{A|vo qzlq002 8 chiori 07.ogg}} '''Chiori:''' I suppose all there's left to do is... tear up all the outfits currently on display.
:{{A|vo qzlq002 8 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You got it! Uh... Wait, what did you just say!?

:{{A|vo qzlq002 8 chiori 09.ogg}} '''Chiori:''' When I went to that first Fashion Week, I had no savings to speak of, just a few dozen yards of fabric and a dream.
:{{A|vo qzlq002 8 chiori 10.ogg}} '''Chiori:''' I had to make something work, so I tore up all the clothes that I brought with me from Inazuma, and I used the scraps to make my entries for the show. I used the larger pieces for the base fabric and the smaller pieces for accessories...
:{{A|vo qzlq002 8 chiori 11.ogg}} '''Chiori:''' If it worked back then, why not now? We can also repurpose some of the ready-to-use accessories in the shop as well.
:{{A|vo qzlq002 8 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' But... You worked so hard on all these outfits...
:{{A|vo qzlq002 8 chiori 12.ogg}} '''Chiori:''' I know. That's why I refuse to let it all go to waste. I'm not going to let them win, even if it takes everything I've ever made and more.
:{{A|vo qzlq002 8 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Um, okay... Then, here's goes nothing...
:{{A|vo qzlq002 8 chiori 13.ogg}} '''Chiori:''' No need to be nervous. I won't hold it against you.
:{{A|vo qzlq002 8 chiori 14.ogg}} '''Chiori:''' Of course, if anyone dared to tear up one of my dresses in front of me on a normal day, I'd probably toss them into the sewer.

:{{A|vo qzlq002 8 chiori 15.ogg}} '''Chiori:''' Just this once, though, I think I can make an exception. Go ahead and tear them up. Think of it as a good way to vent your emotions.

:{{A|vo qzlq002 9 navia 05.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Oh, so that's... what happened... Ahaha... Guess I got a bit ahead of myself just now. Back to what you were doing, everyone. You can all just pretend like I didn't say anything...

:{{A|vo qzlq002 9 navia 06.ogg}} '''Navia:''' If there's one thing I can't stand, it's a false accusation. No one's gonna orchestrate some conspiracy to take down one of my friends and get away with it.
:{{A|vo qzlq002 9 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You and Chiori are really close!
:{{A|vo qzlq002 9 navia 07.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Of course! Everyone knows that Chiori makes the most gorgeous outfits in town. All of the Spina di Rosula's formal wear is custom-tailored here!
:{{A|vo qzlq002 9 chiori 03.ogg}} '''Chiori:''' Now, if only you'd give me the contract for your uniforms as well...

:{{A|vo qzlq002 9 navia 09.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Plus, with how much your intel has helped us out in the past, to the Spina, you're more of an intelligence agency than a fashion boutique.
:{{A|vo qzlq002 9 chiori 04.ogg}} '''Chiori:''' If I had it my way, it would be the other way around...
:{{A|vo qzlq002 9 navia 10.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Anyway, we both know why I'm here. Tell me, how can the Spina be of service to you?
:{{A|vo qzlq002 9 chiori 05.ogg}} '''Chiori:''' ...If it's not too much trouble, can I borrow some skilled hands to help with some simple sewing work? I'll need all the help I can get if I'm going to finish these outfits over the next few days.
:{{A|vo qzlq002 9 navia 11.ogg}} '''Navia:''' No problem. I've got a few of those guys all ready to go! I just knew you wouldn't be intimidated into withdrawing from this year's show.
:{{A|vo qzlq002 9 navia 12.ogg}} '''Navia:''' When are you going to get started? I can help with the sewing, too.
:{{A|vo qzlq002 9 chiori 06.ogg}} '''Chiori:''' Actually, there's something else I'd like to ask of you.
:{{A|vo qzlq002 9 navia 13.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Ask away. I'm all ears!
:{{A|vo qzlq002 9 chiori 07.ogg}} '''Chiori:''' Oh and, {{Traveler}} and Paimon — could you help me pass word to Lyney and Lynette? I'll need their help as well.
:{{DIcon}} Gladly.
:{{A|vo qzlq002 9 charlotte 01.ogg}} '''Charlotte:''' I'm done with my interview! Has Miss Chiori made it back yet— Aahhhh!! What happened to the boutique!?
:{{A|vo qzlq002 9 charlotte 02.ogg}} '''Charlotte:''' Who did this!? Give me names! I'll make sure every last one lands a full feature on the front page of the Steambird tomorrow!
:{{A|vo qzlq002 9 chiori 08.ogg}} '''Chiori:''' Not this again...

;(Talk to Chiori, Charlotte, or Navia, optional)
:{{A|vo dialog qzlq002 navia 01.ogg}} '''Navia:''' What should we do about these clothes everywhere? Need any help?
:{{A|vo dialog qzlq002 chiori 02.ogg}} '''Chiori:''' Sort them by the type of fabric first, and then by color. Oh and, don't forget to remove any accessories and put them to the side.
:{{A|vo dialog qzlq002 charlotte 02.ogg}} '''Charlotte:''' That sounds pretty straightforward. I'll help, too!
----
;(Talk to Lyney and Lynette)
:{{A|vo qzlq002 10 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Lyney, Lynette! Great, you're both here!
:{{A|vo qzlq002 10 lynette 01.ogg}} '''Lynette:''' A moment later and you'd have missed us.
:{{A|vo qzlq002 10 lyney 01.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' We read the article in the papers — we were just about to go find Miss Chiori.
:{{A|vo qzlq002 10 lyney 02.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' She helped design a number of our costumes in the past and even sponsored one of our performances. The time has come, it seems, for us to return the favor.
:{{A|vo qzlq002 10 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ooh, perfect! She was the one who sent us!
:{{A|vo qzlq002 10 lyney 03.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' In that case, I assume that there's something we can do to help? Just say the word, and we'll take care of it.
:{{A|vo qzlq002 10 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Okay, so it's like this...
:{{A|vo qzlq002 10 lyney 04.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' ...Is that all we'll need to do?
:{{A|vo qzlq002 10 lynette 02.ogg}} '''Lynette:''' Should be a piece of cake for the two of us.
:{{A|vo qzlq002 10 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hehe, Paimon's glad to hear it!
:{{A|vo qzlq002 10 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Well then... Guess it's about time we go and find some evidence for all the bad stuff Uther has been doing, right?
:{{A|vo qzlq002 10 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Chiori said we shouldn't disturb her over the next couple of days. We can check in with her again once she's done with all the new designs.
:{{A|vo qzlq002 10 lyney 05.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' But the show's in another two days, isn't it? Will she be able to make the deadline?
:{{A|vo qzlq002 10 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Well, according to her, she wants to first beat Uther fair and square at the show, and then defeat him in the court of public opinion. She said that it'd be like, uh...
:{{A|vo qzlq002 10 lyney 06.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' A two-pronged approach?
:{{A|vo qzlq002 10 lynette 03.ogg}} '''Lynette:''' Courtesy first, confrontation second?
:{{A|vo qzlq002 10 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Uhh... Yeah, something like that.
:{{A|vo qzlq002 10 lyney 07.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Understood. Then we'll have faith in her decision. We'll go make some preparations — see you at the venue in two days.
:{{A|vo qzlq002 10 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Alright! We're counting on you!
:{{A|vo qzlq002 10 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Okay, then let's also do as Chiori said and meet up with her at Uther's factory in two days. We'll gather the evidence then.
:{{A|vo qzlq002 10 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Paimon sure hopes she won't have a hard time making all of those new outfits for the show...
