==Dialogue==
{{Quest Description|Ningguang would like to relive the experiences she had when she was just starting out. She thus invites you to play a game of starting from the very bottom. You head to the wharf together...}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Go to the wharf to search for abandoned goods)
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913601 gousaner 01.ogg}} '''Gou San'er:''' L—Lady Ningguang, to what do I owe the honor?
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913601 gousaner 02.ogg}} '''Gou San'er:''' Are you here to inspect the goods in the warehouse? You may have to wait a moment, I, uh, must have not gotten the message...
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913601 gousaner 03.ogg}} '''Gou San'er:''' Sorry, I won't be long. I'll grab all the paperwork right away!
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913601 ningguang 01.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' Calm down, no need to panic. That's not why we're here.
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913601 gousaner 04.ogg}} '''Gou San'er:''' Uh... Oh, you're just looking for... for me?
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913601 gousaner 05.ogg}} '''Gou San'er:''' I haven't done anything! Have I? I mean, I don't think so...? Uhhh...
:{{DIcon}} We want to know about the unclaimed and abandoned goods.
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913601 gousaner 06.ogg}} '''Gou San'er:''' Oh right. The periodic clearances, yeah. I've been handling those, strictly per the protocol.
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913601 gousaner 07.ogg}} '''Gou San'er:''' I make sure I post all the necessary notices and notify every individual that I'm required to.
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913601 gousaner 08.ogg}} '''Gou San'er:''' It used to be a huge problem. But with a bit of hard work, I've managed to reduce the amount of goods we need to clear out by at least half.
:{{DIcon}} Why do so many goods get abandoned in the first place?
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913601 gousaner 09.ogg}} '''Gou San'er:''' It's hard to say. It really depends, everyone has their own reasons.
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913601 gousaner 10.ogg}} '''Gou San'er:''' But as far as the warehouse is concerned, they all fall into these categories: unclaimed goods, damaged goods, or unpaid storage fees.
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913601 gousaner 11.ogg}} '''Gou San'er:''' As for the damaged ones, I guarantee you it's nothing to do with how they're stored. It's because some things go bad more easily than others.
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913601 gousaner 12.ogg}} '''Gou San'er:''' If it sits there in the warehouse for too long, it goes without saying that it could start to affect the other goods. But that aside, even the smell is just unbearable...
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913601 ningguang 02.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' So, have you cleared out any of these goods recently?
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913601 gousaner 13.ogg}} '''Gou San'er:''' Um... I'm afraid we just finished clearing out all the big ones.
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913601 gousaner 14.ogg}} '''Gou San'er:''' But don't worry, Lady Ningguang! If you're here for an inspection, then I'm here to make it happen. Hang tight, I'll grab some of the smaller items for you right away!
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913601 ningguang 03.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' Hold on...
:{{DIcon}} Off he goes.
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913601 ningguang 04.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' I don't think he has quite grasped the nature of this situation.
:{{DIcon}} It's like he was reporting on his work.
:{{DIcon}} Can't really blame him.
:{{Black Screen|After waiting for a while, Gou San'er comes back, panting for breath.}}
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913601 gousaner 15.ogg}} '''Gou San'er:''' Lady Ningguang... I... I had a quick run through the list, and... cleared out some more... items. Please... inspect them... at your leisure...
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913601 ningguang 05.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' Let me see here... soggy food, an odd shoe, a broken mirror, small wooden toy...
:{{DIcon}} They're in terrible shape. No wonder no one wants them.
:{{DIcon}} Not a whole lot of use.
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913601 ningguang 06.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' It's a shame we missed the last clearance. We're down to the slim pickings now.
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913601 ningguang 07.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' Hmm... some of these are true junk, but there are a few items of value here.
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913601 ningguang 08.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' Take this wooden toy, for example. The wood is good quality. If you took it apart, there is quite a number of useful everyday objects that you could turn it into with a little work...
:{{DIcon}} Can we have this stuff?
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913601 gousaner 16.ogg}} '''Gou San'er:''' Huh? ...You want it?
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913601 gousaner 17.ogg}} '''Gou San'er:''' Well sure, take whatever you want. It's all getting thrown away anyway.
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913601 ningguang 09.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' Great. This is going well.
:{{DIcon}} Let's take some time to sift through what we have acquired.
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913601 ningguang 10.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' Yes, and once we're done, we will find a merchant to give us an appraisal of their value.
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913601 gousaner 18.ogg}} '''Gou San'er:''' (I have no idea what's going on here, and I'm not about to ask, either...)
;(Obtain [[Bag of Retrieved Items]] ×1)

;(Talk to Gou San'er again)
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913602 gousaner 01.ogg}} '''Gou San'er:''' Take care. If there's anything else you need, just give me a shout.

;(Sell the material to the merchant)

:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913602 ningguang 01.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' Actually, today's a little different. I'm not here to buy anything. I wanted to ask if you could take a look at some goods for me.
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913602 bolai 02.ogg}} '''Bolai:''' Just... take a look? What for?
:{{DIcon}} To give me an estimate on their value.
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913602 bolai 03.ogg}} '''Bolai:''' Oh, I see. Let me take a look then.
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913602 bolai 04.ogg}} '''Bolai:''' Hmm...

:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913602 bolai 06.ogg}} '''Bolai:''' But, uh...
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913602 ningguang 02.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' What's wrong? If it's too much trouble, please, there's no need to force it.

:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913602 bolai 08.ogg}} '''Bolai:''' Uh... Well, anyway, let's talk prices.
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913602 bolai 09.ogg}} '''Bolai:''' So all these together, heh...
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913602 bolai 10.ogg}} '''Bolai:''' I'll give you 150,000 Mora. How does that sound?
:{{DIcon}} (That's so much!)
:{{DIcon}} (I think he added a couple of zeros by accident...)
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913602 ningguang 03.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' Oh, well...
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913602 bolai 11.ogg}} '''Bolai:''' Uh, no worries, no worries. The price is negotiable, of course, so we can discuss it further.
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913602 bolai 12.ogg}} '''Bolai:''' If that figure's not what you had in mind, I can, uh... bump it up a little. It'll be fine. I'm sure we can reach an agreement here.
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913602 ningguang 04.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' What are your thoughts?
:{{DIcon}} Honestly, that's way too much...
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913602 ningguang 05.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' Yes. At most, these items are only worth a couple of thousand Mora.
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913602 bolai 13.ogg}} '''Bolai:''' Huh? Wait a minute, so you're really here just to sell a few things?
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913602 bolai 14.ogg}} '''Bolai:''' And, uh, specifically... these things?
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913602 bolai 15.ogg}} '''Bolai:''' I thought that was all code for some kind of inspection, or something...
:{{DIcon}} So we were misunderstood again.
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913602 ningguang 06.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' It appears so. We can't go on like this.
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913602 ningguang 07.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' Let's try something else. As long as we're in Liyue Harbor, this kind of misunderstanding is inevitable.
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913602 ningguang 08.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' If I wasn't Ningguang, Gou San'er probably wouldn't have handed all of these over to us.
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913602 ningguang 09.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' And you likely wouldn't be willing to buy them, either.
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913602 bolai 16.ogg}} '''Bolai:''' To be completely honest... You're not wrong.
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913602 ningguang 10.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' This goes against the rules we set for ourselves at the start.
:{{DIcon}} Then we'll just have to leave Liyue Harbor and live an adventurer's life.
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913602 ningguang 11.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' Are there any other ways for adventurers to make Mora besides their remuneration from the Guild?
:{{DIcon}} We can go treasure hunting in Guili Plains. But the work is hard and the payout is low.
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913602 ningguang 12.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' Great! I don't mind, let's give it a try. Lead the way.
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913602 bolai 17.ogg}} '''Bolai:''' You two have a good one...

;(Talk to Bolai again)
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913603 bolai 01.ogg}} '''Bolai:''' What in the heck has gotten into Lady Ningguang today...
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913603 bolai 02.ogg}} '''Bolai:''' Did I say that aloud? Never mind.
{{Dialogue End}}

:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913603 ningguang 02.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' Goodness. This reminds me of fishing... not an easy catch.

:{{DIcon}} Do you need to take a break?

:{{DIcon}} Based on our current financial position, we can rule that out.
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913603 ningguang 08.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' Same thoughts here. After how hard we worked to get our hands on this Mora, it would be a shame to eat it all in a single sitting.

:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913604 ningguang 06.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' Back in the day, I had to hurry home after work to do my household chores. Then in the evening, it was out to the night market with the family to support our stall.
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913604 ningguang 07.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' I was always meticulous with the most menial of tasks. My mother always loved that about me.
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913604 ningguang 08.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' But by the same token, she didn't love the idea of me leaving home and starting my own business. She thought it was just an unnecessary risk when I could just carry on helping out at home instead.
:{{DIcon}} If you'd followed her advice, people wouldn't be calling you "Lady Ningguang" today.
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913604 ningguang 09.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' You'd be more likely to see me pulling up outside Wanmin Restaurant and selling Grilled Tiger Fish from a food cart.
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913604 ningguang 10.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' My childhood memories run deep. I'll always have a special affection for fish.
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913604 ningguang 11.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' They are confined to the water, and yet they live free, swimming around wherever the mood takes them.

:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913604 ningguang 13.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' When I think back on all my hard work in the past, it motivates me to face the challenges that lie ahead in the future.

:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913604 ningguang 15.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' But a word of warning, I am very picky about my grilled fish... I can be a tough lady to impress.

:{{A|vo zllq101 4 uncledai 09.ogg}} '''Uncle Dai:''' I asked him a few questions out of curiosity. To my surprise, he knew more than me, an old mining foreman! In any case, he didn't have any pressing matters, and agreed to help me.

:{{A|vo zllq101 4 zhongli 05.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Hmm...
:{{A|vo zllq101 4 zhongli 06.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' A glossy exterior, with a fissure that could only have been left in the wake of a volcanic eruption. If I'm not mistaken, this is a rough gem from another nation.
:{{A|vo zllq101 4 kunjun 11.ogg}} '''Kun Jun:''' Ah... a keen eye!
:{{A|vo zllq101 4 zhongli 07.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' It's no ordinary rough gem. Fragile surface layer, black veining... My intuition tells me that there's high-quality crystal ore inside.
:{{A|vo zllq101 4 kunjun 12.ogg}} '''Kun Jun:''' Remarkable. This rock does indeed hail from the vicinity of a volcano. I came across it in a market and snapped it straight up. The seller thought it was some leftover industrial remnant. They had no inkling of the treasure that lay within.
:{{DIcon}} Isn't [[Crystal Ore]] found everywhere?
:{{DIcon}} What makes this one so special?
:{{A|vo zllq101 4 kunjun 13.ogg}} '''Kun Jun:''' Purity and geological rarity alone aren't enough to make a treasure. Some of the most precious crystals contain deposits of water or sand.
:{{A|vo zllq101 4 kunjun 14.ogg}} '''Kun Jun:''' In the moment of its formation, the crystal hidden within this stone shell captured a pocket of water. For water to be hidden in its depths, like a moon concealed within a mountain, reflecting shafts of daylight that make it through... Now that's a rare treasure.
:{{A|vo zllq101 4 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Such a detailed description, almost like he saw it with his own two eyes...
:{{A|vo zllq101 4 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Say... you're not trying to hoodwink us are you? After all, we haven't even seen what's inside yet!
:{{A|vo zllq101 4 zhongli 08.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Everything he said is true.
:{{A|vo zllq101 4 zhongli 09.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Most crystals are born in high-temperature environments. Heat and water aren't natural bedfellows of course, which is why crystals with water deposits are so sought-after. Moreover, this particular crystal contains mountain lake water. A rare find indeed.
:{{A|vo zllq101 4 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Well if Zhongli says so, it must be true...
:{{A|vo zllq101 4 kunjun 15.ogg}} '''Kun Jun:''' I've yet to encounter anyone with a judgment as shrewd as yours, Mr. Zhongli. How did you know exactly what lay within?
:{{A|vo zllq101 4 zhongli 10.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' I've seen many such stones in my time, I recognized it immediately. I hope you didn't mind me flaunting my experience, Mr. Kun Jun?
:{{A|vo zllq101 4 kunjun 16.ogg}} '''Kun Jun:''' Of course not! I feel I've met a kindred spirit here today. I hope you will accept my friendship.
:{{A|vo zllq101 4 kunjun 17.ogg}} '''Kun Jun:''' Uncle Dai, it would be a mistake for Mr. Zhongli not to join us! Trust me when I say that his level of expertise is unrivaled in the trade. You won't come across another of his caliber in your lifetime.
:{{A|vo zllq101 4 uncledai 10.ogg}} '''Uncle Dai:''' Very well, there is strength in numbers after all! Everyone, follow me to [[The Chasm (Area)|The Chasm]]. There are men counting on you to find them.
{{Dialogue End}}

:;(−1 Heart)
::{{A|vo noecop002 1908101 noelle 05.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' I don't? ...I'm sorry to make you worry on my account...
:{{A|vo noecop002 1908101 noelle 06.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' I've been busy preparing for my exam. Other than for work and training, I've barely left the library.
:{{A|vo noecop002 1908101 noelle 07.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' The exam is drawing nearer and nearer, but there just seems to be an endless amount of material to review... *sigh*
:{{DIcon}} Surely, the only exam that could make Noelle so nervous is...
:{{A|vo noecop002 1908101 noelle 08.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' Right, The Knights of Favonius selection exam... *sigh*
:{{A|vo noecop002 1908101 noelle 09.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' Even though I've already worked for the Knights as a maid for some time, I still need to pass this exam to officially become a Knight.
:{{A|vo noecop002 1908101 noelle 10.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' It's just that I've failed several times in the past... I still don't know if I can make it this time...
:{{DIcon}} Can I help?
::{{A|vo noecop002 1908101 noelle 11.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' N—no, thank you! I can take care of myself... I hope...
:{{DIcon}} I can be your study buddy!
::{{A|vo noecop002 1908101 noelle 12.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' Study buddy? N—no, I... That won't be necessary.
:{{A|vo noecop002 1908101 noelle 13.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' This is my exam, and I'm taking it to fulfill my dream. Any obstacles I face are mine to overcome.
:{{A|vo noecop002 1908101 noelle 14.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' Plus, there is still some time to go before the exam arrives. You're the Honorary Knight of Mondstadt, it won't do for me to take up so much of your time.
:{{A|vo noecop002 1908101 noelle 15.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' But on the day of the exam, if... if you happen to be free...
:{{DIcon}} Which day is the exam? I'll be there.
:{{A|vo noecop002 1908101 noelle 16.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' Um, based on the Knights' schedule, I think it should be... half a year from now.
:{{DIcon}} ...Half a year away?
:{{DIcon}} I thought it was more imminent...
:{{A|vo noecop002 1908101 noelle 17.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' But, it's just half a year... don't you think that's quite soon?
:{{A|vo noecop002 1908101 noelle 18.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' Even though there is still some time, if I don't make good use of it, it will disappear!
:{{A|vo noecop002 1908101 noelle 19.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' I've planned my schedule carefully. If I sleep two hours less each day and finish my work one hour earlier, then as long as I spend all the time I save studying, I should be able to finish these books...
:{{A|vo noecop002 1908101 noelle 20.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' There's always coffee if I feel sleepy, and I have some candy on hand just in case I ever feel low on energy...
:{{DIcon}} Pushing yourself too hard will only affect your exam performance.
:{{A|vo noecop002 1908101 noelle 21.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' No, it won't. I've made sure to allocate time for training too — after all, combat is also assessed as part of the examination... Ohh...
:{{A|vo noecop002 1908101 noelle 22.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' Did I get too worked up all of a sudden? My vision... seems a bit blurry...
:{{A|vo noecop002 1908101 noelle 23.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' No... I still have training tomorrow, I must freshen up...
:{{A|vo noecop002 1908101 noelle 24.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' I apologize for letting you see me in such bad shape... I'm okay now.
:{{DIcon}} Pushing yourself too hard will only make things worse.
:{{DIcon}} Maybe try to relieve your anxiety first?
:{{A|vo noecop002 1908101 noelle 25.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' Ohh... Every time I think of the exam, I get so nervous. Only studying or training helps to relieve it a little...
:{{A|vo noecop002 1908101 noelle 26.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' But in the end, I keep finding new ways in which I'm not prepared, and that makes me even more nervous.
:{{Hangout Branch|A change of scenery might do you good.|Journey to Liyue}}
::{{A|vo noecop002 1908101 noelle 27.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' You mean, a change of location? Hmm... Yes, staying in the Knights Headquarters and in the library all the time does tend to make me feel as if I always have to be studying...
::{{A|vo noecop002 1908101 noelle 28.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' But where else could I go? The Cat's Tail? Or the Angel's Share?
::{{A|vo noecop002 1908101 noelle 29.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' Or perhaps somewhere away from the city... Starsnatch Cliff, or Windrise?
::{{A|vo noecop002 1908101 noelle 30.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' I could even make some muffins, grab some napkins, and make a picnic out of it... Ohh, but would that just waste too much time?
::{{DIcon}} How about farther away? Make it a trip to Liyue.
::{{A|vo noecop002 1908101 noelle 31.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' A trip? To Liyue!? Oh, I couldn't possibly justify that. In the time it would take to get to Liyue and back, I could have just finished several of my books!
::{{DIcon}} Liyue has an old saying: "Better to travel ten thousand miles than to read ten thousand books."
::{{A|vo noecop002 1908101 noelle 32.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' Hmm... You really think I shouldn't limit myself to Mondstadt?
::{{A|vo noecop002 1908101 noelle 33.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' Maybe you're right. Mondstadt is symbolized by the wind... But my Vision is a Geo one.
::{{A|vo noecop002 1908101 noelle 34.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' Maybe visiting the nation built by the Geo Archon could help me learn something new...
::{{A|vo noecop002 1908101 noelle 35.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' Hmm... very well, then... if it's just a quick visit...
:;(Proceed to [[Journey to Liyue]])
:{{Hangout Branch|Don't hide from it. Confront the stress of the exam directly.|customlinks=[[Adventurer's Entrance Exam]] and [[Noelle Rides Out]]}}
::{{A|vo noecop002 1908101 noelle 36.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' Oh... You mean, studying isn't the only preparation I should be doing?
::{{A|vo noecop002 1908101 noelle 37.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' If I don't overcome my fear of the exam, I will just repeat the same mistakes over and over again...
::{{A|vo noecop002 1908101 noelle 38.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' Whenever I encounter something unexpected, I can't think straight... And whenever I start worrying that I might fail again, my mind goes completely blank...
::{{Hangout Branch|You could take some more exams to get used to the atmosphere.|Adventurer's Entrance Exam}}
:::{{A|vo noecop002 1908101 noelle 39.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' Take some more exams? ...Would that really help me?
:::{{A|vo noecop002 1908101 noelle 40.ogg}} '''Noelle:'''  It's true that the more I study, the more unprepared I feel. It's inevitable that I'll run into something unexpected...
:::{{A|vo noecop002 1908101 noelle 41.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' But if I can simulate the atmosphere of an exam, then I can learn  how to cope with it.
:::{{A|vo noecop002 1908101 noelle 42.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' But... where would I even go to take one?
:::{{DIcon}} I often take part in the ranking exams of the Adventurers' Guild.
::::{{A|vo noecop002 1908101 noelle 43.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' The Adventurers' Guild? Now that you mention it, someone once invited me to join them...
:::{{DIcon}} The ranking exams of the Adventurers' Guild can make you stronger.
::::{{A|vo noecop002 1908101 noelle 44.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' The Adventurers' Guild? You can get stronger just by... passing their exam? ...Ohh, that sounds a little difficult to believe.
:::{{A|vo noecop002 1908101 noelle 45.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' ...Well, since it's recommended by the Honorary Knight, then... I have to give it a try.
::;(Proceed to [[Adventurer's Entrance Exam]])
::{{Hangout Branch|You could try to imagine yourself passing the exam.|Noelle Rides Out}}
:::{{A|vo noecop002 1908101 noelle 46.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' Imagine myself passing the exam...? Hmm...
:::{{DIcon}} If you passed the selection exam, what kind of knight would you want to become?
:::{{A|vo noecop002 1908101 noelle 47.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' What... kind of knight? I—I always thought that just qualifying to be a knight was challenging enough to begin with...
:::{{A|vo noecop002 1908101 noelle 48.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' The knight that I want to be someday... Ohh... that feels so far away that it's a little difficult to imagine...
:::{{DIcon}} Then let's start with knights closer to home. How about an Outrider, like Amber?
:::{{A|vo noecop002 1908101 noelle 49.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' ...An Outrider?
:::{{A|vo noecop002 1908101 noelle 50.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' I'm sure Amber would be happy to see the Outriders grow as a team.
:::{{A|vo noecop002 1908101 noelle 51.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' But my strengths are not in scouting and luring the enemy, and I'm not as agile as Amber. Hmm... I don't know if I would be of any assistance to her...
:::{{A|vo noecop002 1908101 noelle 52.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' However, I did once get Amber to teach me how to make Baron Bunnies!
:::{{A|vo noecop002 1908101 noelle 53.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' If I were to use Baron Bunny to lure the enemy away and protect my fellow knights... I suppose I could do it?
:::{{DIcon}} If you can perform the duty of a qualified knight, then you might feel more confident about the exam.
:::{{DIcon}} Think of it as practicing for when you have to make Baron Bunnies with Amber in the future.
:::{{A|vo noecop002 1908101 noelle 54.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' Hmm... I still have some of the materials we used when she taught me. There's just a few extra things I'd need...
:::{{A|vo noecop002 1908101 noelle 55.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' Making the stuffing requires Pyro Slime Condensate, and the red dye used to grab the enemies' attention can be made from crushed Valberries.
:::{{A|vo noecop002 1908101 noelle 56.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' It's just that dried Valberries are not very suitable for making dye. I'll need to get some fresh ones from the Stormbearer Mountains.
:::{{A|vo noecop002 1908101 noelle 57.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' So... let's start by going to the Stormbearer Mountains.
::;(Proceed to [[Noelle Rides Out]])
{{Dialogue End}}

==Steps==
If [[Cryo Slime]] [[Slime Condensate|Condensate]] was chosen:
# Look for Cryo Slime Condensate
#* {{Enemy|Cryo Slime|x=3}}
# Talk to the staff

If [[Cryo Whopperflower]] [[Whopperflower Nectar|Nectar]] was chosen:
# Look for Cryo Whopperflower Nectar

==Dialogue==
{{Quest Description|You and [[Chongyun]] successfully enter the [[Test of Courage]], but as you track the evil spirits, Chongyun suddenly experiences a rush of unstable yang energy and must rest. {{Dialogue Start}}
;(Report back to Barbara)
:{{A|vo bblcop001 1900203 barbara 01.ogg}} '''Barbara:''' So... is he gone now?

:{{A|vo bblcop001 1900203 barbara 02.ogg}} '''Barbara:''' Whew, thank you! Although... I guess I'm not being very polite towards him...
:{{DIcon}} Why are you trying to avoid being seen?
:{{A|vo bblcop001 1900203 barbara 03.ogg}} '''Barbara:''' Well... it's a little embarrassing to say, but...
:{{A|vo bblcop001 1900203 barbara 04.ogg}} '''Barbara:''' In Mondstadt, I often perform songs for people. Because it's been so well received, the other sisters have started encouraging me to perform across Teyvat. Now, more and more people are showing up to hear me perform.
:{{A|vo bblcop001 1900203 barbara 05.ogg}} '''Barbara:''' I'm happy to see such turnouts, don't get me wrong... but... Now, people always stop me on the street when I go shopping, or when I go out for personal matters...
:{{A|vo bblcop001 1900203 barbara 06.ogg}} '''Barbara:''' I know that all they want is to get my autograph, or to ask me how I'm doing, which isn't a bad thing.
:{{A|vo bblcop001 1900203 barbara 07.ogg}} '''Barbara:''' And... I'm very thankful for all my fans, but... there are simply too many of them.
:{{A|vo bblcop001 1900203 barbara 08.ogg}} '''Barbara:''' I always do my best to fulfill their requests and not let them down.
:{{A|vo bblcop001 1900203 barbara 09.ogg}} '''Barbara:''' But... sometimes... I feel that I just don't have the strength to do so.
:{{A|vo bblcop001 1900203 barbara 10.ogg}} '''Barbara:''' Even when I'm in the church, people will still come hoping to greet me. I'm constantly in a state of tension, no matter where I go.
:{{A|vo bblcop001 1900203 barbara 11.ogg}} '''Barbara:''' The reason I came here was not only to find Wolfhooks for making Tunner's cough medicine, but also to have some quiet time alone...
:{{A|vo bblcop001 1900203 barbara 12.ogg}} '''Barbara:''' Do you understand that feeling? To sit peacefully and not think about anything... just by yourself. It's simply the feeling of relaxation.
:{{A|vo bblcop001 1900203 barbara 13.ogg}} '''Barbara:''' It's been far too long since I've had that feeling. Before I knew it, I was out here all day and forgot to return to the city.
:{{DIcon}} If you're looking for Wolfhooks, there should be plenty nearby.
:{{A|vo bblcop001 1900203 barbara 14.ogg}} '''Barbara:''' No, I couldn't find any... The kind I'm looking for are red.
:{{A|vo bblcop001 1900203 barbara 15.ogg}} '''Barbara:''' I remember seeing them here before, but I've already searched the area and there aren't any. I wonder if someone had already picked them? No, people seldom come out here...
:{{DIcon}} Are these the kind of Wolfhook you're looking for?
:{{A|vo bblcop001 1900203 barbara 16.ogg}} '''Barbara:''' Huh? Yes, those are the ones! And you've found so many, these will be more than enough! But where did you...
:{{Black Screen|''The Traveler tells Barbara what happened with Albert...''}}
:{{A|vo bblcop001 1900203 barbara 17.ogg}} '''Barbara:''' Oh my... Oh, I've been far too impolite.
:{{A|vo bblcop001 1900203 barbara 18.ogg}} '''Barbara:''' Albert came all this way just to help me, and I...
:{{A|vo bblcop001 1900203 barbara 19.ogg}} '''Barbara:''' But if I were to go and apologize to him, it would probably only make him feel even worse.
:{{A|vo bblcop001 1900203 barbara 20.ogg}} '''Barbara:''' *sigh* I guess I'm still just too immature...
:{{A|vo bblcop001 1900203 barbara 21.ogg}} '''Barbara:''' Let's just head back to the city for now. I'll think of a way to make it up to Albert later.
:{{DIcon}} But no one even knows about this matter...
:{{A|vo bblcop001 1900203 barbara 22.ogg}} '''Barbara:''' Well, I know, and you also know. And we mustn't forget that Barbatos also knows. We certainly can't say that "no one knows about this matter," don't you think?
:{{A|vo bblcop001 1900203 barbara 23.ogg}} '''Barbara:''' Besides, as a deaconess, I could never simply ignore such a matter. I must take the appropriate actions and make things right.
:{{A|vo bblcop001 1900203 barbara 24.ogg}} '''Barbara:''' I'll see to that matter on my own. Anyway, the berries you have here will be just enough. We should get going.
:;(Continue to [[The Church's Affairs]])
{{Dialogue End}}

==Steps==
# Return to camp
# Rest until the next morning (08:00 - 10:00)

:{{A|vo xyjeq003 1 dehya 06.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' In their words, one gig sets you up for half a year. Just one job like this nets them enough Mora to take it easy for a while.
:{{A|vo xyjeq003 1 candace 03.ogg}} '''Candace:''' The Extravaganza has brought many tourists to Sumeru City all at once, so it's likely that they took advantage of the bustle to sneak in.
:{{A|vo xyjeq003 1 candace 04.ogg}} '''Candace:''' Dehya and I wanted to directly capture them, but they were on guard and made some excuse to slip away.
:{{A|vo xyjeq003 1 dehya 07.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' I would've tied them up if it wouldn't have caused a scene.
:{{A|vo xyjeq003 1 dehya 08.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' Who's legally supposed to take care of this kind of thing? The matra? Or the Corps of Thirty?
:{{A|vo xyjeq003 1 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hmm... If Cyno were here, he'd definitely get involved. Why don't we head over to the Akademiya and tell a matra?
:{{A|vo xyjeq003 1 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Thanks a million, you two!
:{{A|vo xyjeq003 1 candace 05.ogg}} '''Candace:''' Not at all. It was coincidence on our part as well.
:{{A|vo xyjeq003 1 dehya 09.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' Yeah, don't sweat it. The Eremites' reputation is gonna get even worse if these scumbags succeed.
:{{A|vo xyjeq003 1 dehya 10.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' But this is Sumeru City. Candace and I don't have as much freedom to act here, so we're leaving this in your hands.
:{{A|vo xyjeq003 1 candace 06.ogg}} '''Candace:''' Should you require our aid, come find us at the café.
:{{A|vo xyjeq003 1 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Paimon's noticed that something's bugging you. Is it the Extravaganza? 'Cause Paimon's starting to think that there's more than meets the eye here, too...
:{{A|vo xyjeq003 1 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ugh, but thinking like this isn't doing anything. Let's just go find a matra!
{{Dialogue End}}
{{Quest Description|update|Dehya and Candace heard about someone plotting to kidnap Sachin. You should report this to the matra.}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Talk to Candace and Dehya in Puspa Cafe, optional)
:{{A|vo dialog xyjeq003 dehya 01.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' I'm surprised anyone has the guts to try and pull off something like this during the Extravaganza. Just goes to show how tempting a fortune like Sachin's is.
:{{A|vo dialog xyjeq003 dehya 02.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' What would you do if a sum of Mora like that suddenly landed in your lap?
:{{A|vo dialog xyjeq003 candace 01.ogg}} '''Candace:''' I don't know. I've never thought about it.
:{{A|vo dialog xyjeq003 dehya 03.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' Come on, first thing off the top of your head. How would you spend it?
:{{A|vo dialog xyjeq003 candace 02.ogg}} '''Candace:''' Hmm... Buying food, finding water sources... That kind of thing, I guess?

:{{A|vo xyjeq003 8 candace 01.ogg}} '''Candace:''' (Mmm, this is good coffee.)

;(Use Nahida's All Schemes to Know on Dehya, optional)
:{{A|vo xyjeq003 8 dehya 01.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' (There's not much harm that a bunch of small-time crooks can do. But this whole Sachin affair... something about it strikes me as strange.)

;(Approach Aarav)<!-- NOT conditional, I did not do Alhaitham's Story Quest, still got these lines -->
:{{A|vo xyjeq003 2 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hey... Isn't that the matra [[The Illusions of the Mob|we investigated Siraj with]]?
:{{A|vo xyjeq003 2 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' "Aarav," wasn't it? Let's go talk to him!

;(Talk to Aarav)<!--no ASTK-->
:{{A|vo xyjeq003 2 aarav 01.ogg}} '''Aarav:''' Hello both. It's been a while. Do you have any issues to report?
:{{Black Screen|You tell Aarav about the situation with Dehya and Candace.}}
:{{A|vo xyjeq003 2 aarav 02.ogg}} '''Aarav:''' Someone's planning to kidnap Sachin? Goodness... Though I suppose it's not all that surprising.
:{{A|vo xyjeq003 2 aarav 03.ogg}} '''Aarav:''' The growing popularity of the Extravaganza has given him quite the reputation boost as its sponsor. He's seen as one of these "super-rich" types.
:{{A|vo xyjeq003 2 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Well, since he's got a target on his back now, shouldn't you send some people to protect him?
:{{A|vo xyjeq003 2 aarav 04.ogg}} '''Aarav:''' To tell you the truth, we've thought about doing just that. However, Sachin apparently prefers to spend most of his time out doing field work, and hardly ever comes back to Sumeru City. No one has been able to contact him.
:{{A|vo xyjeq003 2 aarav 05.ogg}} '''Aarav:''' Our only lead is something he once said... "Each time the Interdarshan Championship is held, I will be watching from close by to choose a suitable person to inherit my estate."
:{{A|vo xyjeq003 2 aarav 06.ogg}} '''Aarav:''' Assuming he remains committed to that promise, then he must be right here in the city somewhere. I suspect that the Eremites in question must've heard about that as well, and decided to come here and try their luck.
:{{A|vo xyjeq003 2 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So they shouldn't know where Sachin is either, right?
:{{A|vo xyjeq003 2 aarav 07.ogg}} '''Aarav:''' I would assume not. Anyway, Mahamatra Cyno is still on vacation, so I'll handle this.
:{{A|vo xyjeq003 2 aarav 08.ogg}} '''Aarav:''' Don't you worry. A couple of kidnappers aren't gonna get very far in Sumeru City these days. I have my ways of forcing them out into the open.
:{{A|vo xyjeq003 2 aarav 09.ogg}} '''Aarav:''' All of that said — if you're interested in Sachin's story, why don't you try tracking him down as well?
:{{A|vo xyjeq003 2 aarav 10.ogg}} '''Aarav:''' The sooner we ascertain his whereabouts, the quicker we can act to ensure his safety. I mean, you could task all the matra and the whole Corps of Thirty with someone's protection, but if the client doesn't show themselves, there's nothing we can do to help them.
:{{A|vo xyjeq003 2 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Fair point. Guess we should start searching for him too. But where should we start?
:{{DIcon}} Do the matra have any information at all on Sachin?
:{{A|vo xyjeq003 2 aarav 11.ogg}} '''Aarav:''' None, I'm afraid. He's never committed any crimes or broken academic protocol, so we don't have a very detailed file on him.
:{{A|vo xyjeq003 2 aarav 12.ogg}} '''Aarav:''' I've heard that Alhaitham has now stepped down from his post as Acting Grand Sage and is back to being the Scribe again. Maybe it's worth checking to see if he knows anything?
:{{A|vo xyjeq003 2 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Good idea. Okay, we'll head back to the Extravaganza venue and see if we can find him!

;(Talk to Aarav again, optional)
:{{A|vo dialog xyjeq003 aarav 01.ogg}} '''Aarav:''' Rest assured that I will bring these criminals to justice.
{{Dialogue End}}
{{Quest Description|update|Matra Aarav has indicated that he will resolve the matter of the kidnappers himself, but it appears that only Scribe Alhaitham can aid in the Sachin investigation.}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Approach Nilou)<!-- No ASTK -->
:{{A|vo xyjeq003 3 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Phew... Hey, Nilou, have you seen Alhaitham anywhere?
:{{A|vo xyjeq003 3 nilou 01.ogg}} '''Nilou:''' Alhaitham? Why, what is it?
:{{A|vo xyjeq003 3 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' We're trying to track down someone, and we need him to pull up some records for us.
:{{A|vo xyjeq003 3 nilou 02.ogg}} '''Nilou:''' Oh, I see... Sorry, I don't know where he went.
:{{A|vo xyjeq003 3 nilou 03.ogg}} '''Nilou:''' He's always the first to leave after the competition ends, and he never tells anyone where he'll be going...
:{{A|vo xyjeq003 3 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh. Yeah, actually, that sounds about right for him.
:{{A|vo xyjeq003 3 nilou 04.ogg}} '''Nilou:''' Lemme think... To be honest, he doesn't seem very interested in the Extravaganza, so he probably doesn't stick around longer than he has to.
:{{A|vo xyjeq003 3 nilou 05.ogg}} '''Nilou:''' To him, being a commentator is just extra work he was roped into. Do you guys know of any places he'd go after work?
:{{DIcon}} A tavern?
::{{A|vo xyjeq003 3 nilou 06a 1.ogg}} '''Nilou:''' Uhh... There's still one more round to go. Would he really go to a tavern in the middle of the competition?
::{{A|vo xyjeq003 3 paimon 04a 1.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh! Here's a thought. Maybe he just went straight home?
:{{DIcon}} ...Maybe he went home?
::{{A|vo xyjeq003 3 paimon 04b 1.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ooh, maybe!
:{{A|vo xyjeq003 3 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Paimon remembers that his house isn't that far from here, so we might as well check it out!

:{{A|vo dialog xyjeq003 nilou 01.ogg}} '''Nilou:''' I wonder where Alhaitham would go?

{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Approach Alhaitham's home)
:{{A|vo xyjeq003 4 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Let's try knocking...
:{{DIcon}} (Knock.)
:{{A|vo xyjeq003 4 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' No answer... Maybe no one's home?
:{{DIcon}} (Knock.)
:{{A|vo xyjeq003 4 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hellooo...? Alhaitham? Are you in? We need your help with something!
:{{A|vo xyjeq003 4 kaveh 01.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Oh, it's you two?
:{{A|vo xyjeq003 4 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, Kaveh! You're home!
:{{A|vo xyjeq003 4 kaveh 02.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' ...Come on in. I'll get the door for you.
:;(The Traveler and Paimon enter Alhaitham's home)
:{{A|vo xyjeq003 9 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' We didn't hear a peep when we first knocked — we thought no one was home!
:{{A|vo xyjeq003 9 kaveh 01.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Well, I can't be too careful. If someone from the Akademiya came here looking for Alhaitham and I opened the door for them without thinking, before long the whole city would know that I'm living here...
:{{A|vo xyjeq003 9 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You're pretty conscientious about this, huh...
:{{A|vo xyjeq003 9 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So... what happens if someone comes inside looking for him while you're at home?
:{{A|vo xyjeq003 9 kaveh 02.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' It's fine, as long as I stay in my own room. Anyway, why would someone just barge in here looking for him? Most people have better things to do.
:{{A|vo xyjeq003 9 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Fair enough. So do you know where he is at the moment?
:{{A|vo xyjeq003 9 kaveh 03.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' What do you think? Who knows what he does in his free time. All that matters to me is that he's out of the house!
:{{DIcon}} Did you have a quarrel or something?
:{{A|vo xyjeq003 9 kaveh 04.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' I wouldn't call it that, he's just incapable of saying anything pleasant at all!
:{{A|vo xyjeq003 9 kaveh 05.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' I told him how the second round went. I won the lot draw, remember? Because of good karma, of course. My luck's on the rise.
:{{A|vo xyjeq003 9 kaveh 06.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' But him, being him... You wouldn't believe what he said after I was done talking!
:{{A|vo xyjeq003 9 kaveh 26.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' "You're always quick to remind me that you're my upperclassman, and yet you do not problem-solve in the manner becoming of an upperclassman. This begs the question of why we attach prestige to seniority at all." What does he mean, "manner becoming of an upperclassman"? What, am I supposed to earn the title of upperclassman now!?
:{{A|vo xyjeq003 9 kaveh 27.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' And he didn't stop there! He said:
:{{A|vo xyjeq003 9 kaveh 07.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' "I'd encourage you to reflect on why you've ended up having to rely on luck every round. Frankly, it's incomprehensible to me how you've managed to make it to this age without acknowledging the proverbial elephant in the room of your life."
:{{A|vo xyjeq003 9 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hahaha... Yeah, that does sound like something Alhaitham would say...
:{{A|vo xyjeq003 9 kaveh 08.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' I've had it with him! Every time I talk to him it's the same way! He finds a way to infuriate me, every single time!
:{{A|vo xyjeq003 9 kaveh 09.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Anyway, the disdain is very much mutual between us, so I'll be moving out as soon as possible. I'm actually packing my things right now. He'll have to get used to doing his own cleaning and tidying from now on!
:{{A|vo xyjeq003 9 kaveh 10.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' See those perfectly hung paintings on the walls? They're coming with me, too! Heh, if his life wasn't utterly devoid of artistic sensibility already, it certainly will be after today.
:{{A|vo xyjeq003 9 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wait, you're moving out already? But the competition isn't even over yet. How can you afford it?
:{{A|vo xyjeq003 9 kaveh 11.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Well, obviously I can't just yet. I'm just packing early, to get ahead of the game.
:{{A|vo xyjeq003 9 kaveh 12.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' I've got my new place picked out already. The moment I have my hands on the prize money, I'm going to buy it and move my things right in. It'll take me three days tops to move out of here for good.
:{{A|vo xyjeq003 9 kaveh 13.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' I now know what I have to do to achieve this goal. No matter what happens in the third round, I will win. I will emerge triumphant! You'll see!
:{{A|vo xyjeq003 9 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Well, we'll be rootin' for ya. But... are you sure you'll be alright?
:{{A|vo xyjeq003 9 kaveh 14.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Hmm? In what way?
:{{A|vo xyjeq003 9 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Layla said that she thinks you'll get caught up in internal conflict.
:{{A|vo xyjeq003 9 kaveh 15.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' ...Meaning what, exactly? Don't tell me you think I have serious personality flaws, too...?
:{{A|vo xyjeq003 9 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' We didn't say that! But think about it. You say you wanna win, but you also turned Faruzan down when she offered to give you her points. Plus, you took it upon yourself to help those Desert Foxes...
:{{A|vo xyjeq003 9 kaveh 16.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Wait, what's so unusual about all that? I gave you my reasons — I would have felt guilty otherwise... Where's the conflict in that?
:{{DIcon}} Why would you feel guilty?
:{{A|vo xyjeq003 9 kaveh 17.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' ...
:{{A|vo xyjeq003 9 kaveh 18.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Well, when you put it like that... Yes, why, indeed? It's a good question. I guess it's just in my nature. Plus, if I just did nothing, then there'd be no escaping the blame if something bad came of it later down the line.
:{{A|vo xyjeq003 9 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' But thinking like that all the time must make your life so exhausting. Not to mention that by helping out, you put yourself at risk... Fainting in the middle of the desert, for example. Was that really worth it?
:{{A|vo xyjeq003 9 kaveh 19.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' It's complicated, I... Look, let's maybe leave this conversation for another time. What was it you needed Alhaitham's help with, anyway?
:{{DIcon}} We'd like him to help us look into Sachin.
:{{A|vo xyjeq003 9 kaveh 20.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Sachin? Huh, he did actually mention a Sachin recently.
:{{A|vo xyjeq003 9 kaveh 21.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' I remember he brought a few documents home that day. He was thinking out loud as he looked through them, making some notes and doodling as he went. He even suggested that I should take a look, but I didn't. Gimme a moment, let me go find them...
:{{A|vo xyjeq003 9 kaveh 22.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Ah, this is the one. Here, take it.
:{{A|vo xyjeq003 9 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Uh... You sure he'd be okay with this?
:{{A|vo xyjeq003 9 kaveh 23.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' With taking liberties? He's certainly okay with helping himself to my beer whenever he pleases.
:{{A|vo xyjeq003 9 kaveh 24.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' And anyway, he did ask me if I wanted to read his notes. I didn't see the point at the time, so he just left them on the side.
:{{A|vo xyjeq003 9 kaveh 25.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' He doesn't leave documents lying around unless he's okay with other people reading them. It's fine, I promise.
:{{A|vo xyjeq003 9 paimon 12.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Cool, if you say so. Okay, let's see what he's got on Sachin...

;(Talk to Kaveh, optional)
:{{A|vo dialog xyjeq003 kaveh 01.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' I fetched the documents for you. Feel free to look through them at your leisure.

;(Use Nahida's All Schemes to Know on Kaveh, optional)
:{{A|vo xyjeq003 8 kaveh 01.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' (Did he leave these notes there on purpose, or was this sheer coincidence? No... But if it wasn't a coincidence, then...)
{{Dialogue End}}
{{Quest Description|update|Alhaitham isn't home, and the one who opened the door for you is a fuming Kaveh. After ranting about Alhaitham, Kaveh remembers that Alhaitham left some files relating to Sachin behind...}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Investigate the document)
::'''Tabletop Documents'''
::Sachin was born to a wealthy family, and his father Rajput was a renowned merchant in Sumeru, with many properties to his name.
::At the age of nine, Sachin enrolled into Vahumana and achieved excellent grades. At the age of fifteen, he completed all of his courses and graduated first in class, his accomplishments greatly lauded by the sages.
::At the age of sixteen, Sachin ventured out and began to research the local environment and customs. His travels took him throughout Sumeru's rainforests and deserts.
::When Sachin was 23 years old, his father Rajput passed away. Sachin returned to Sumeru City to take over his father's business and spent two years here.
::At the age of 25, Sachin once again ventured into the desert to conduct field research. Records show that he traveled with a caravan and lived in Aaru Village for a period of time.
::At the age of 32, Sachin returned to Sumeru City. He looked withered and weary, his mental state in shambles. Much speculation arose amongst outsiders, but Sachin locked himself in his room and did not respond.
::At the age of 33, Sachin entrusted all of his properties to the Akademiya and pledged to donate all proceeds to the Akademiya. He then wrote a contract regarding the use of the proceeds and property ownership.
::The following is an excerpt quoted from Sachin when the contract was signed:
::"A minimum of 30% of all revenue generated from the business will be used to fund prizes for the Interdarshan Championship, which will encourage young prodigies to actively participate in the competition..."
::"I will also be donating my entire collection, the most prominent item of which, the 'Diadem of Knowledge,' will serve as a symbol of great honor in the Interdarshan Championship. Only the winner of the competition may wear it..."
::"In addition, the Akademiya is only given the right to maintain and manage my properties. Ownership of them does not belong to the Akademiya, nor does it belong to me."
::"Each year, when the Interdarshan Championship is held, I will keep a close eye on each candidate... If I particularly identify with a participant, I will reveal myself."
::"I will then bequeath all of my wealth to this individual whom I judge worthy of my acknowledgment. They will have the usage rights to all assets and proceeds under my name. I hope the Akademiya will respect any and all decisions made by that person."
::After the contract came into effect, Sachin returned to the desert to continue his investigations. But there has been no word from him since then.
::Many claimed to have seen him in the desert, but none of such claims have been verified. Twenty years have passed since then.
:{{A|vo xyjeq003 5 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' That was a lot of information... Paimon's getting a headache.
:{{A|vo xyjeq003 5 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So to sum up, Sachin put the Akademiya in charge of managing his estate and went off to do research, right?
:{{A|vo xyjeq003 5 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' He even said that if he really liked one of the contestants, he wouldn't just give them a reward, but his entire estate as well... That must be worth heaps and heaps of Mora!
:{{A|vo xyjeq003 5 kaveh 01.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' What!? Are you serious?
:{{A|vo xyjeq003 5 kaveh 02.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' All of Sachin's wealth, that's... more than I could spend in a lifetime, surely. Heck, if I got chosen, I'd be able to pay off all my debts, then buy a new place, and still have cash to burn...
:{{A|vo xyjeq003 5 kaveh 03.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' I could build another Palace of Alcazarzaray... Except this time, I'd make it ten times bigger...
:{{A|vo xyjeq003 5 kaveh 04.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Then there's that new project in Port Ormos, of course — the bridge renovation. To do it properly would take upwards of—
:{{A|vo xyjeq003 5 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hey, hey, snap out of it! You're getting way ahead of yourself there, mister!
:{{A|vo xyjeq003 5 kaveh 05.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' You're right. First, I need to focus on winning and moving out of this place...
:{{A|vo xyjeq003 5 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh? Wait a moment, there's a loose slip of paper tucked in between these pages.
:{{A|vo xyjeq003 5 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Did Alhaitham write this? It looks like he was jotting ideas down as he was thinking things over. Hmm, let's see... Um, two phrases have been circled:
:{{A|vo xyjeq003 5 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' "Sachin, dead or alive? Unknown"... and "Diadem of Knowledge"?
:{{A|vo xyjeq003 5 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Some of this stuff is just plain incomprehensible. Is this written in some other language?
:{{A|vo xyjeq003 5 kaveh 06.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Let me see... Huh? I recognize this script. Hmm, give me a second...
:{{A|vo xyjeq003 5 kaveh 07.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' "Lofty ideals may provide no defense at all against nihilism, but perhaps little decisions can"... That's a rough translation, anyway. I can't guarantee it's one hundred percent accurate.
:{{A|vo xyjeq003 5 kaveh 08.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' ...Hmm? There's another, smaller line of text underneath... Huh... Why would he bring that up?
:{{A|vo xyjeq003 5 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wow, it's so cool that you can actually read this script!
:{{A|vo xyjeq003 5 kaveh 09.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' We worked together on a project once when we were students — the title was "Decoding the Runes and Architectural Philosophy of the Ruins of King Deshret's Civilization." I had to familiarize myself a little with this script at the time.
:{{A|vo xyjeq003 5 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, interesting! So... Any idea what Alhaitham meant by all of this?
:{{A|vo xyjeq003 5 kaveh 10.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Heh. Who knows? The way his mind works is one of the great mysteries of the world.
:{{A|vo xyjeq003 5 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Fair enough. Well, guess we've learned all we can here.
:{{DIcon}} Let's hope Aarav's made some progress.
:{{A|vo xyjeq003 5 paimon 12.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yeah, he'd better catch those crooks. But until then, uh... let's just head out for a stroll.
:;(Quest ends)

;(Talk to Kaveh again, optional)
:{{A|vo dialog xyjeq003 kaveh 02.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' "Little decisions"? What could've been going through his mind when he wrote that...
{{Dialogue End}}

'''''Suspicious Smuggling Case''''' is the first part of {{Quest|Sands of Solitude}}.

==Steps==
# Take a look around the [[Akademiya]]
# Look for clues around the Akademiya
# Look for clues outside the city
# Work with [[Cyno]] to arrest the suspects
# Ask [[Dori]] for information
# Inform Cyno of the intel
# Leave [[Caravan Ribat]]
# Defeat the mercenaries that followed you

#* Wave 2: {{Enemy List|Eremite Daythunder*1;Eremite Sword-Dancer*1}}
# Talk to Cyno

==Gameplay Notes==

{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Approach the marked area in the Akademiya)

::{{A|vo cnlq001 1 nabil 01.ogg}} '''???:''' What should I do now? *sigh* If only Cyno was still around...
::{{A|vo cnlq001 1 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Uh, excuse us, has something happened?
::{{A|vo cnlq001 1 nabil 02.ogg}} '''???:''' Oh, I appreciate the concern, but who are you?
::{{DIcon}} We also happen to know Cyno.
::{{A|vo cnlq001 1 nabil 03.ogg}} '''???:''' Ah, friends of Cyno! Well, I suppose it's not a secret or anything... Since you two are interested, I'll just lay it out for ya.
::{{A|vo cnlq001 1 nabil 04.ogg}} '''Nabil:''' My name is [[Nabil]], I'm a [[matra]] in the Akademiya. A case involving the smuggling of [[Canned Knowledge]] has come to our attention recently, but unfortunately, we don't have the people to handle it at the moment.
::{{A|vo cnlq001 1 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh? You mean the Akademiya is short on matra right now?
::{{A|vo cnlq001 1 nabil 05.ogg}} '''Nabil:''' Well, not exactly, I suppose the main problem is that the case suddenly came up after General Mahamatra Cyno left to go somewhere. It would be a real headache for us to tackle the case ourselves.
::{{A|vo cnlq001 1 nabil 06.ogg}} '''Nabil:''' Given the large scope of the issue, we talked things over internally and decided that we should find further assistance from outside the matra.
::{{A|vo cnlq001 1 nabil 07.ogg}} '''Nabil:''' If you two have some time, would you lend us your strength?
::{{A|vo cnlq001 1 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hmm, alright. Since you asked so nicely, we'll help!
::{{DIcon}} Do you have any further intel regarding this case?
::{{A|vo cnlq001 1 nabil 08.ogg}} '''Nabil:''' Yes, large amounts of Canned Knowledge from unknown origins have been appearing on the market recently. We suspect there's a secret route being used to move the capsules.
::{{A|vo cnlq001 1 nabil 09.ogg}} '''Nabil:''' According to some research, using large amounts of Canned Knowledge could lead to some serious consequences, and unfortunately, most people have yet to realize that.
::{{A|vo cnlq001 1 nabil 10.ogg}} '''Nabil:''' Rumors also have it that some particularly dangerous Canned Knowledge has made its way into the market. Regardless of whether the rumors are true or not, this case calls for urgent action.
::{{A|vo cnlq001 1 nabil 11.ogg}} '''Nabil:''' According to our current leads, it's highly likely that there are dealers selling Canned Knowledge outside the city even as we speak. If you two could, please help us investigate the area.
::{{A|vo cnlq001 1 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You can count on us, let's go!
;(If the player has completed ''Where the Boat of Consciousness Lies'')
::{{A|vo cnlq001 3 nabil 01.ogg}} '''???:''' Wait, you two! Just a moment, please!
::{{A|vo cnlq001 3 nabil 02.ogg}} '''???:''' You're {{Traveler}} and Paimon, right? I thought you two looked familiar. People have been talking all about you.
::{{A|vo cnlq001 3 nabil 03.ogg}} '''???:''' It's a pleasure to meet you. Do you have a moment? There's something I'd like to discuss with you.
::{{DIcon}} Umm, who are you?
::{{DIcon}} Have we met before?
::{{A|vo cnlq001 3 nabil 04.ogg}} '''Nabil:''' My name is Nabil. I'm a matra in the Akademiya. You're friends with Cyno, right? I've heard him mention you before.
::{{A|vo cnlq001 3 nabil 05.ogg}} '''Nabil:''' Currently, Cyno is out investigating a case involving smuggled Canned Knowledge. It's been days since we've last heard from him.
::{{A|vo cnlq001 3 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh no, do you think he's in trouble?
::{{A|vo cnlq001 3 nabil 06.ogg}} '''Nabil:''' Uh, well... To be completely honest, it's pretty hard to imagine anything that could pose a threat to Cyno. But since we haven't heard from him, we're starting to suspect that the case might be more complicated than we had originally thought.
::{{A|vo cnlq001 3 nabil 07.ogg}} '''Nabil:''' Word has it that you two are brave, smart, and extremely capable adventurers. Do you think you could lend us a hand and help investigate the smuggling?
::{{A|vo cnlq001 3 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Alright, since you put it that way, we'll help!
::{{DIcon}} Do you have any further intel regarding this case?
::{{A|vo cnlq001 3 nabil 08.ogg}} '''Nabil:''' Large amounts of Canned Knowledge from unknown origins have been appearing on the market recently. Cyno suspected that there's a secret route being used to move the capsules.
::{{A|vo cnlq001 3 nabil 09.ogg}} '''Nabil:''' According to some research, using large amounts of Canned Knowledge could lead to some serious consequences, and unfortunately, most people have yet to realize that.
::{{A|vo cnlq001 3 nabil 10.ogg}} '''Nabil:''' Rumors also have it that some particularly dangerous Canned Knowledge has made its way into the market. Regardless of whether the rumors are true or not, this case calls for urgent action.
::{{A|vo cnlq001 3 nabil 11.ogg}} '''Nabil:''' Last we heard from Cyno, he was investigating somewhere outside Sumeru City. It seems that he had found some leads at the time, but we haven't heard from him since.
::{{A|vo cnlq001 3 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Sounds like we'd better go look for him. C'mon!

;(Talk to Nabil again)
:{{A|vo dialog cnlq001 nabil 01.ogg}} '''Nabil:''' How's the case coming? Any progress?
{{Dialogue End}}
{{Quest Description|update|After listening to Nabil's account of the recent case of Canned Knowledge smuggling, you decide to go outside the city to investigate.}}

;(Approach the marked area)
;(If the player has not completed ''[[Where the Boat of Consciousness Lies]])
::{{A|vo cnlq001 2 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh? It's Cyno! Uh, what are you doing here?
::{{A|vo cnlq001 2 cyno 01.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Ah, it's you two. I knew I sensed a familiar presence.

::{{DIcon}} Does that mean...

::{{A|vo cnlq001 2 cyno 05.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Long story short, I was able to learn of the secret location where the Canned Knowledge is being sold. You're welcome to accompany me if you're interested.
::{{A|vo cnlq001 2 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Whoa, sounds pretty complicated... but having Cyno around will definitely make things easier.
::{{A|vo cnlq001 2 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Alright, let's go round up those bad guys!

;(If the player has completed ''Where the Boat of Consciousness Lies'')
::{{A|vo cnlq001 4 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Cyno, there you are! We finally found you!
::{{A|vo cnlq001 4 cyno 01.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Ah, it's you two. I knew I sensed a familiar presence.
::{{A|vo cnlq001 4 cyno 02.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' But I'm very busy at the moment. We'll have to chat some other time.
::{{DIcon}} We heard about the case of smuggled Canned Knowledge.
::{{A|vo cnlq001 4 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' That's right! Nabil asked us to come check on the situation.
::{{A|vo cnlq001 4 cyno 03.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' So Nabil told you about this? Hmm, divulging my location without authorization... I'll let it slide for now — this isn't the time for that.
::{{A|vo cnlq001 4 cyno 04.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' I see, well the situation might be more problematic than you anticipated. I've already questioned several people, but gained very little information.
::{{A|vo cnlq001 4 cyno 05.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Long story short, I was able to learn of the secret location where the Canned Knowledge is being sold. You're welcome to accompany me if you're interested.
::{{A|vo cnlq001 4 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Whoa, sounds pretty complicated. But having a chance to catch bad guys with Cyno, it's like we're a part of the matra!
::{{A|vo cnlq001 4 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Alright, sign us up!
