==Dialogue==
===Taking the Opposite Route===
{{Dialogue Start}}
{{Quest Description|After weighing the pros and cons, you decide to seek out Wisdom Seelie's true identity.}}
;(Gather more information about the Wisdom Seelie)
;(Use [[Nahida]]'s [[All Schemes to Know]] on Katayoun, optional)
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915201 katayoun 11.ogg}} '''Katayoun:''' (*sigh* Did someone put the books back in the wrong place again?)

;(Talk to Katayoun)
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915201 katayoun 01.ogg}} '''Katayoun:''' Oh, hello there. Can I help you?
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915201 layla 01.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Uh, hello, I'm a Rtawahist student and would like to see the checkout logs for "Theoretical Astrology" and "A Quick Reference Guide to Astrology Cases."
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915201 katayoun 02.ogg}} '''Katayoun:''' Oh, are you also here to investigate the Rtawahist Wisdom Seelie legend?
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915201 layla 02.ogg}} '''Layla:''' "Also?" Hmm... I suppose it makes sense that we're not the only ones investigating such a popular legend.
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915201 katayoun 03.ogg}} '''Katayoun:''' Yes, I myself am also quite curious about it. But unfortunately, I haven't found anything out of the ordinary.
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915201 katayoun 04.ogg}} '''Katayoun:''' Given you're a Rtawahist student, I'm sure you know that a lot of research references these two books. All our copies of these particular titles are frequently checked out.
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915201 katayoun 05.ogg}} '''Katayoun:''' I have looked into it, but found no irregularities in the checkout logs.
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915201 layla 03.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Is there any chance the Seelie could have taken the books out and returned them without being noticed...?
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915201 katayoun 06.ogg}} '''Katayoun:''' Not likely, that would be almost impossible. The House of Daena is extremely strict about the circulation of its books. There will always be a record if a book is checked out.
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915201 katayoun 07.ogg}} '''Katayoun:''' And even if it managed to figure out a way to take the books without leaving any record, it's possible that someone would come looking to borrow the books before the Seelie returned them.
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915201 katayoun 08.ogg}} '''Katayoun:''' If someone discovers that a book is missing or that it doesn't match my inventory records, it would come to my attention immediately.
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915201 katayoun 09.ogg}} '''Katayoun:''' However, it might be possible to pull off in the case of a less popular book...
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915201 layla 04.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Okay. I understand now, thank you.
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915201 layla 05.ogg}} '''Layla:''' This is useful to know. With any luck, it'll help us work out the Seelie's identity.

;(Use [[Nahida]]'s [[All Schemes to Know]] on Katayoun, optional)
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915201 katayoun 12.ogg}} '''Katayoun:''' (Speaking of checkouts, it's time to do a routine inventory check. I hope everything's in order.)

;(Talk to Katayoun again)
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915201 katayoun 10.ogg}} '''Katayoun:''' I assure you that you won't find anything strange here.

;(Use [[Nahida]]'s [[All Schemes to Know]] on Hunayn, optional)
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915202 hunayn 15.ogg}} '''Hunayn:''' (The House of Daena doesn't feel as quiet as it used to be.)

;(Talk to Hunayn)
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915202 layla 01.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Hi there, have you heard of the legend of the Wisdom Seelie?
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915202 hunayn 01.ogg}} '''Hunayn:''' Do I really look like the kind of student that would be interested in such a pointless legend...?
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915202 layla 02.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Oh uh, I'm sorry, we were just curious.
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915202 hunayn 02.ogg}} '''Hunayn:''' Well, I do happen to have some information on it.
:{{DIcon}} Then why didn't you just say so?
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915202 hunayn 03.ogg}} '''Hunayn:''' Huh? Logically, that has nothing to do with the question I asked.
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915202 hunayn 04.ogg}} '''Hunayn:''' I just don't want others to see me as some poor excuse for a student, whiling away my time in the House of Daena.
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915202 layla 03.ogg}} '''Layla:''' I don't really think bad students would come to the House of Daena to pass the time... But anyways, you were saying?
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915202 hunayn 05.ogg}} '''Hunayn:''' Well, I spend most of my time here, and I have noticed something odd before.
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915202 hunayn 06.ogg}} '''Hunayn:''' One time, late at night, a black shadow fell from above and landed in the central area of the House of Daena.
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915202 hunayn 07.ogg}} '''Hunayn:''' Of course, I was a little sleepy at the time, but it startled me and I got up to see what was going on.
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915202 layla 04.ogg}} '''Layla:''' An—And then what happened??
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915202 hunayn 08.ogg}} '''Hunayn:''' Then, the shadow quickly circled behind me with incredible speed. Just as I tried to turn around to get a look at it, I fainted.
:{{DIcon}} This shadow sounds pretty powerful.
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915202 hunayn 09.ogg}} '''Hunayn:''' Yes, it was unbelievably fast. I had never seen anything like it. It was so unusual that I wasn't sure if it was real or if I was half-dreaming.
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915202 hunayn 10.ogg}} '''Hunayn:''' But given how popular the legend of the Seelie has become lately, maybe this has something to do with it.
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915202 layla 05.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Don't take this the wrong way, but... doesn't the House of Daena have a door?
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915202 hunayn 11.ogg}} '''Hunayn:''' It was closed that night. I suppose even the House of Daena needs to be closed for maintenance from time to time.
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915202 layla 06.ogg}} '''Layla:''' I see, that makes sense...
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915202 layla 07.ogg}} '''Layla:''' But what were you doing here if the House of Daena was closed?
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915202 hunayn 12.ogg}} '''Hunayn:''' Don't look so surprised. It's a common practice to find a place to hide before they lock the doors so you can continue reading books here... Everyone knows that.
:{{DIcon}} Good thing I'm not studying alongside you. I can tell that you'd really stress me out.
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915202 layla 08.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Anyway, thank you for the info. I'll be sure to take note of everything you mentioned.
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915202 hunayn 13.ogg}} '''Hunayn:''' You're welcome.

;(Use [[Nahida]]'s [[All Schemes to Know]] on Hunayn, optional)
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915202 hunayn 16.ogg}} '''Hunayn:''' (No wonder the House of Daena has been getting more noisy recently...)

;(Talk to Hunayn again)
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915202 hunayn 14.ogg}} '''Hunayn:''' If you don't have any more questions, I'm gonna go back to my books now.

;(Use [[Nahida]]'s [[All Schemes to Know]] on Latifah, optional)
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915203 latifah 15.ogg}} '''Latifah:''' (I wonder if there will be any new sightings today...)

;(Talk to Latifah)
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915203 layla 01.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Hi there, do you know anything about the Wisdom Seelie?
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915203 latifah 01.ogg}} '''Latifah:''' Yes, of course. I've been looking into it for quite a while now.
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915203 latifah 02.ogg}} '''Latifah:''' However, I feel like I'm still missing some key pieces of information. Hey, maybe if we put our heads together, we can figure something out.
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915203 layla 02.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Sure, I'll try my best.
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915203 latifah 03.ogg}} '''Latifah:''' There are a few known traits of the Wisdom Seelie. First, it's extremely strong. It can easily carry a few dozen books, along with four or five pieces of astrology equipment all at once.
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915203 latifah 04.ogg}} '''Latifah:''' It's extremely athletic as well. It only moves in a straight line and doesn't stop for anything, not even walls or rivers.
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915203 latifah 05.ogg}} '''Latifah:''' Lastly, it has a number of "special abilities." It has a hardened metal body that's impervious to injury, it can freeze water into ice, and it can also summon meteors.
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915203 layla 03.ogg}} '''Layla:''' That... doesn't even sound human.
:{{DIcon}} It sounds like some hero out of a fairy tale.
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915203 latifah 06.ogg}} '''Latifah:''' Well, it is a legend after all. It's no surprise that some details seem a little exaggerated.
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915203 latifah 07.ogg}} '''Latifah:''' But these aren't just made up, you know. Each of its abilities has been confirmed by eyewitnesses.
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915203 latifah 08.ogg}} '''Latifah:''' There have been many sightings too, including at Chatrakam Cave, the Avidya Forest, and around the waterfall south of Sumeru City.
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915203 layla 04.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Has anyone seen what it actually looks like? Or what kind of a person it is?
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915203 latifah 09.ogg}} '''Latifah:''' Hmm, not that I know of. No one's been able to get close to it. It seems like it tries to stay out of sight.
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915203 latifah 10.ogg}} '''Latifah:''' I would probably want to remain a mystery too, if I were someone as legendary as the Wisdom Seelie.
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915203 latifah 11.ogg}} '''Latifah:''' So, what do you make of it? Have you seen it somewhere as well?
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915203 layla 05.ogg}} '''Layla:''' No... We're probably gonna need some time to digest all the... incredible information you've provided us.
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915203 latifah 12.ogg}} '''Latifah:''' Haha, not a problem. But if you manage to find anything, be sure to come and tell me about it.
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915203 latifah 13.ogg}} '''Latifah:''' I trust that you'll quickly discover the excitement of slowly unraveling the truth.

;(Use [[Nahida]]'s [[All Schemes to Know]] on Latifah, optional)
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915203 latifah 16.ogg}} '''Latifah:''' (It's so exciting to search and dig for the truth.)

;(Talk to Latifah again)
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915203 latifah 14.ogg}} '''Latifah:''' Please remember to share any new information you come across.

;(After Talking to Katayoun, Hunayn, and Latifah)
;(Proceed to [[Compiling the Clues]])
{{Dialogue End}}

===Taste of Home===
{{Dialogue Start}}
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909701 kaeya 01.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' You're more punctual than I expected.
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909701 kaeya 02.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' Let's head inside.

;(Talk to Elzer)
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909702 elzer 01.ogg}} '''Elzer:''' Master Kaeya? And {{Traveler}}! Welcome, welcome. Please come in, I'll fetch you both something to drink.
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909702 kaeya 01.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' Long time no see, Elzer.
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909702 elzer 02.ogg}} '''Elzer:''' Haha, yes, it's been a while, hasn't it? So, what brings you back to the winery this... *cough* Sorry... Is there anything I can do for you?
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909702 kaeya 02.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' No need to be so formal. I just returned from Sumeru, and dropped by to see you all.
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909702 elzer 03.ogg}} '''Elzer:''' Ah... What a pity, Master Diluc went out to handle business last night, and hasn't returned yet...
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909702 kaeya 03.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' Never mind, the main thing is that you and Adelinde are here. Oh, speaking of Adelinde, where is she?
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909702 elzer 04.ogg}} '''Elzer:''' She's taking some time off. She was busy cleaning yesterday, and finally has a bit of time to herself.
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909702 kaeya 04.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' Perfect. I brought some gifts for you both. Here, this belt buckle is for you.
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909702 elzer 05.ogg}} '''Elzer:''' My goodness, it's exquisite... Thank you, Master Kaeya, I... *cough* I'll treasure it.
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909702 elzer 06.ogg}} '''Elzer:''' Would you like anything to drink? We recently finished making a new batch of [[Dandelion Wine]].
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909702 kaeya 05.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' Well, what perfect timing. I was just wondering how this year's batch was coming along.
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909702 elzer 07.ogg}} '''Elzer:''' Let me fetch a barrel and have someone deliver it to the Knights of Favonius headquarters for you.
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909702 kaeya 06.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' Oh, I won't be needing an entire barrel. A couple of bottles will be more than sufficient... else Diluc might say I came here to beg.
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909702 elzer 08.ogg}} '''Elzer:''' Oh, Master Diluc might grumble, but he doesn't mean it. Anyway, let me fix you both a drink.
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909702 kaeya 07a.ogg}} {{A|vo kycop001 1909702 kaeya 07b.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' Much obliged. Then I'll have a glass of Dandelion Wine, and a glass of Cider Lake for {{MC|m=him|f=her}}, if you please.
:{{DIcon}} "Cider Lake"?
:{{DIcon}} Am I drinking lakewater?
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909702 elzer 09.ogg}} '''Elzer:''' The name is not that literal. It is a drink with virtually no alcoholic content, as Master Kaeya will be aware. I'll prepare them now, please wait a moment.
:{{DIcon}} Of course, my drink is non-alcoholic...
:{{DIcon}} Dunno what I was expecting. Never mind, I'm used to it already.
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909702 kaeya 08.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' Strictly speaking, that's not entirely true. "Cider Lake" does have a tiny amount of alcohol in it...
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909702 elzer 10.ogg}} '''Elzer:''' Please, enjoy.
:{{DIcon}} (Try the "Cider Lake" that Elzer mixed)
::{{DIcon}} It's quite sweet, and very tasty.
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909702 elzer 11.ogg}} '''Elzer:''' Pleased you like it. Looks like my bartending skills haven't faded with age.
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909702 kaeya 09.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' How have you been recently? Is the winery's business doing well?
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909702 elzer 12.ogg}} '''Elzer:''' To tell you the truth, we've had our work cut out for us recently trying to fulfill some major orders. Things have only just started to quiet down over the last couple of days.
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909702 kaeya 10.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' So you've had no time off lately?
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909702 elzer 13.ogg}} '''Elzer:''' Haha... *cough* Master Diluc was concerned about the same thing.
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909702 elzer 14.ogg}} '''Elzer:''' But with him being out on business for a few days, who would take care of business and the guests if I were to take time off? Maybe some other time.
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909702 kaeya 11.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' At least take half a day to see a doctor and make sure you're okay. If your condition worsens, Diluc will never forgive himself.
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909702 elzer 15.ogg}} '''Elzer:''' *cough cough* You make a fair point...
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909702 kaeya 12.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' If you're worried about having someone to handle the winery, why not leave it to me? I'm familiar enough with your responsibilities to cover for you for a while.
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909702 elzer 16.ogg}} '''Elzer:''' Master Kaeya, I...
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909702 elzer 17.ogg}} '''Elzer:''' *sigh* ...Please come back to the winery more often. We all miss you very much.
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909702 kaeya 13.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' Alright, alright, no need for that kind of talk. Come on, I'll see you out.

;(Outside the manor)
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909703 elzer 01.ogg}} '''Elzer:''' While I'm resting, I shall leave Dawn Winery in your hands.
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909703 kaeya 01.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' Don't worry, I'm not going anywhere. Rest easy. And go see the doctor.
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909703 kaeya 02.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' Such great weather today... A calm breeze and delicious wine, this is quite the treat.
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909703 kaeya 03.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' Though it's a pity this batch seems a bit bland. How about I go to the wine locker and fetch one from the reserve collection? I remember it's on the second floor...
:{{DIcon}} Huh? Is that allowed?
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909703 kaeya 04.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' Of course it's fine. I promised Elzer I'd help, I said nothing about leaving the wine alone.

:{{A|vo kycop001 1909703 adelinde 01.ogg}} '''Adelinde:''' Sorry I'm a little late to the welcome party, but I believe I just heard the words "wine locker" and "reserve collection"... Planning on pilfering a bottle of reserve, Master Kaeya?
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909703 adelinde 02.ogg}} '''Adelinde:''' The reserve collection is reserved for a reason, you know... You should at least run it past Master Diluc first.
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909703 kaeya 05.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' Adelinde, surely you misheard? We were simply taking a walk around the house.
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909703 adelinde 03.ogg}} '''Adelinde:''' I see. Anyway, what brings you and {{Traveler}} to the winery today?
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909703 kaeya 06.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' We just returned from Sumeru. It's been a while, so I thought we might drop by and say hello.
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909703 kaeya 07.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' And perhaps enjoy a complimentary drink while we're here. Surely you wouldn't object, Adelinde?
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909703 adelinde 04.ogg}} '''Adelinde:''' How could I object? We're simply happy that you've come back to see us.
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909703 kaeya 08.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' Oh, Adelinde — I also brought some gifts for you all. This bottle of essential oil is for you. If you rub it on your hands when it gets cold, your skin won't crack.
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909703 adelinde 05.ogg}} '''Adelinde:''' Oh my, I can't believe you remembered something like that...
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909703 kaeya 09.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' Of course I remember. You always took such good care of me when I fell sick as a child. In comparison, this is nothing.
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909703 adelinde 06.ogg}} '''Adelinde:''' ...You're all grown up now, and you don't get sick nearly as easily. You don't need me to look after you anymore.
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909703 kaeya 10.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' True, I don't get sick as much, but speaking of being looked after... When I was in Sumeru, I did find myself and my stomach missing your cooking so terribly...
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909703 adelinde 07.ogg}} '''Adelinde:''' Oh, are you hungry? Would you like to eat something? You too, {{Traveler}}, please tell me if there's anything you'd like to eat.
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909703 kaeya 11.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' Well, now that you mention it... I do actually feel a bit peckish.
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909703 adelinde 08.ogg}} '''Adelinde:''' [[Steak]]?
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909703 kaeya 12.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' Ooh, yes. A nice steak would really hit the spot.
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909703 adelinde 09.ogg}} '''Adelinde:''' [[Fragrant Cedar Wood]] grilled, medium, stewed vegetables on the side?
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909703 kaeya 13.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' Yes, just like you always used to make. Thank you kindly, Adelinde.
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909703 adelinde 10.ogg}} '''Adelinde:''' My pleasure. {{Traveler}}, I'm sorry I'm not familiar with your preferences. Would you like to come with me and select a few dishes?

;(Talk to Kaeya again, optional)
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909703 kaeya 14.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' The taste of home... truly irreplaceable.

===Guests===
;(Talk to Adelinde)
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909705 adelinde 01.ogg}} '''Adelinde:''' Grilling the steak over Fragrant Cedar Wood infuses it with more flavor than pan-frying it. It's a favorite of Master Kaeya's.
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909705 adelinde 02.ogg}} '''Adelinde:''' Since using an open flame to grill indoors is somewhat inconvenient, we usually set up a grill outdoors. It's perfect for grilling meat, but you can also use it to make stews.
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909705 adelinde 03.ogg}} '''Adelinde:''' I can offer you a Satisfying Salad, Cold Cut Platter, and anything stewed. What would you prefer, {{Traveler}}?
:{{DIcon}} Satisfying Salad.
:{{DIcon}} Cold Cut Platter.
:{{DIcon}} Sticky Honey Roast.
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909705 adelinde 04.ogg}} '''Adelinde:''' Okay, right away.
:{{Black Screen|Adelinde easily gets a fire roaring and prepares to boil the vegetables...}}
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909705 adelinde 05.ogg}} '''Adelinde:''' Master Kaeya really likes stewed vegetables, but it takes the most time. So I'll start making that first, and then prepare your meal once that's underway.
:{{DIcon}} You seem to know Kaeya's preferences inside-out.
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909705 adelinde 06.ogg}} '''Adelinde:''' Of course. I looked after him and Master Diluc when they were growing up.
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909705 adelinde 07.ogg}} '''Adelinde:''' He wasn't always such a complicated character... He was a gentle child. Polite and very sweet.
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909705 adelinde 08.ogg}} '''Adelinde:''' Boys, huh? The gentle ones grow up to be wild, and the rambunctious ones become quiet and reserved.
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909705 adelinde 09.ogg}} '''Adelinde:''' At least, that's my experience. If there's anything you don't understand about Master Kaeya and his antics, please feel free to talk to me about it.
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909705 adelinde 10.ogg}} '''Adelinde:''' His temperament has changed quite a lot over the years, but he still has a lot of the endearing qualities I remember.
:{{DIcon}} I can't always tell if he's being truthful.
:{{DIcon}} I can't always tell what he's up to.
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909705 adelinde 11.ogg}} '''Adelinde:''' Kaeya is much savvier and more mature than he used to be. Goodness knows he can be tricky to deal with... But let me share a few little tips.
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909705 adelinde 12.ogg}} '''Adelinde:''' When he answers your question with a question, stop and think carefully about what he wants you to believe, and don't be led on by him.
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909705 adelinde 13.ogg}} '''Adelinde:''' As for not knowing what he's up to, hehe, that's because he loves making up a good cover story.
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909705 adelinde 14.ogg}} '''Adelinde:''' But don't let him get to you too much. You can take it from me... You were drinking a "Cider Lake" just now, right?
:{{DIcon}} That's right.
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909705 adelinde 15.ogg}} '''Adelinde:''' Do you know why it's called that? The name was coined by none other than Master [[Crepus]] when he mixed the drink for Master Kaeya himself.
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909705 adelinde 16.ogg}} '''Adelinde:''' They were adorable when they were young. One time, the winery was hosting a banquet, and Master Crepus strictly forbade Master Diluc from drinking.
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909705 adelinde 17.ogg}} '''Adelinde:''' Master Diluc wasn't happy about that, and he convinced Master Kaeya to team up with him and sneak into the wine cellar to steal some Dandelion Wine.
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909705 adelinde 18.ogg}} '''Adelinde:''' And how did I find this out? Because when Master Kaeya attempted to distract me, I could clearly see Diluc hiding around the corner of the corridor, gesturing to Master Kaeya to direct him through the whole thing.
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909705 adelinde 19.ogg}} '''Adelinde:''' The Captain Kaeya of today never bats an eye when he lies, but he wasn't like that at all when he was young... Ah, goodness, how did I get into this...
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909705 adelinde 20.ogg}} '''Adelinde:''' Anyway, they were discovered by Master Crepus in the end, and he was furious. He punished Master Kaeya by making him write lines, and Master Diluc was forced to clean the wine barrels in the cellar.
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909705 adelinde 21.ogg}} '''Adelinde:''' The wine cellar had over a dozen large wine barrels to scrub, and Master Diluc was just a child. There was no way he could finish it all by himself. Master Crepus really meant to teach him a lesson!
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909705 adelinde 22.ogg}} '''Adelinde:''' I'd originally planned to secretly finish off the work for him, but when I peeked inside the cellar, I found that Master Kaeya was already there.
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909705 adelinde 23.ogg}} '''Adelinde:''' He and I finished scrubbing the remaining barrels. When Master Crepus saw that the bruises on Master Kaeya's hands were even darker than those on Master Diluc's hands, he instantly understood the situation.
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909705 adelinde 24.ogg}} '''Adelinde:''' Master Crepus wasn't stern by nature, so to comfort Master Kaeya, he mixed him a drink and added a few drops of alcohol just so he could have a little taste.
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909705 adelinde 25.ogg}} '''Adelinde:''' So, you see? Kaeya was a gentle child, and never one to boast about the things he did for other people. Sometimes, he'd even deny it if asked.
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909705 adelinde 26.ogg}} '''Adelinde:''' His friends have a special place in his heart, even if he keeps this to himself.
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909705 adelinde 27.ogg}} '''Adelinde:''' Kaeya's quite a smooth talker these days... But I can tell that his habit of quietly helping others hasn't changed.
:{{DIcon}} I understand what you mean.
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909705 adelinde 28.ogg}} '''Adelinde:''' Ah, good. Okay, the stew is nearly ready, but the meat and other dishes will need a moment. Please wait at the table, I'll be over shortly.

;(Talk to Adelinde again, optional)
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909705 adelinde 29.ogg}} '''Adelinde:''' You're not worried that I can't handle it by myself, are you? Relax. Serving meals is all part of my job as a maid, I can manage.

;(Talk to Kaeya)
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909706 kaeya 01.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' Drinking fine wine, eating Adelinde's Steak... Ah, now this is what I call a vacation.
:{{DIcon}} And I got to hear some stories about your childhood.
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909706 kaeya 02.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' Oh? What has Adelinde been telling you?
:{{DIcon}} She said you were a very smart kid.
:{{DIcon}} She said you had a strong sense of justice.
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909706 kaeya 03.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' Haha, so she told you the good stories... Well, shucks, now I'm embarrassed.
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909706 adelinde 01.ogg}} '''Adelinde:''' Food's ready. I hope you're hungry — I made a little extra, given how long it's been since you were last here.
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909706 kaeya 04.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' We never imagined there would be such a magnificent feast! You've really outdone yourself. Why don't you sit and eat with us this time?
:{{DIcon}} Yeah. Let's eat together.
:{{DIcon}} The more the merrier!
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909706 adelinde 02.ogg}} '''Adelinde:''' Hehe, if you keep chatting away, the food will get cold. I'll wait here, please call me if you need anything.
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909706 kaeya 05.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' I'm afraid that just won't do, Adelinde. I'm serious, we get together so rarely, can't you bend the house rules just this once?
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909706 kaeya 06.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' After all, I don't live here anymore, so I'm just a regular guest. You aren't going to refuse your honored guest this small request, are you?
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909706 adelinde 03.ogg}} '''Adelinde:''' Since it's you, Master Kaeya, I see no choice but to honor your request.
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909706 adelinde 04.ogg}} '''Adelinde:''' I know that us sharing a meal is a sign of our close relationship, but this is technically against the rules for a maid... So please forgive me for rebuffing you at first. I didn't mean to sound rude.
:{{DIcon}} It's all Kaeya's fault.
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909706 adelinde 05.ogg}} '''Adelinde:''' {{Traveler}}, given how petty Master Kaeya can be, it must be hard for him to make friends. Does he have any friends in the Knights of Favonius?
:{{DIcon}} Yes, me.
::{{A|vo kycop001 1909706 kaeya 07.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' Haha, looks like my efforts have paid off! See, Adelinde?
:{{DIcon}} Yes, everyone is Kaeya's friend.
::{{A|vo kycop001 1909706 kaeya 08a.ogg}} {{A|vo kycop001 1909706 kaeya 08b.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' See? I do have a way with people. And now I have {{MC|m=him|f=her}} here to back me up.
:{{Black Screen|You enjoy a home-cooked meal with Kaeya and Adelinde under a gentle breeze.}}
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909706 guangzhi 01.ogg}} '''???:''' Hello, everyone. Pardon me, but is this Dawn Winery?
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909706 guangzhi 02.ogg}} '''Guangzhi:''' I am Guangzhi, a guard with the Secure Transport Agency under the Liyue Communications Office. Here is my card.
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909706 kaeya 09.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' No wonder Elzer felt so strongly about staying, he certainly wasn't kidding about how busy it is... Mr. Guangzhi, a pleasure to make your acquaintance.
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909706 guangzhi 03.ogg}} '''Guangzhi:''' The pleasure is all mine. The Secure Transport Agency has worked with your fine establishment in the past, though we have only corresponded through letters. I always found it a great pity that I, the overseer of our cooperation, have never had the occasion to visit in person.
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909706 kaeya 10.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' Why don't we go inside to discuss the details? No doubt the conversation will flow better with some of our wines to taste. Adelinde, we'll continue our discussion later. Could you fetch some [[Apple Cider]] for the three of us?
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909706 adelinde 06.ogg}} '''Adelinde:''' Certainly, Master Kaeya. Please wait a moment.

;(Inside the manor)
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909707 guangzhi 01.ogg}} '''Guangzhi:''' And how might I address you, Sir, as well as your...
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909707 kaeya 01.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' Just "Kaeya" is fine. I'm standing in today for Elzer, who usually manages the winery's business, and this is my good friend.
:{{DIcon}} Hi, I'm {{Traveler}}.
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909707 guangzhi 02.ogg}} '''Guangzhi:''' A pleasure to meet you as well. I am not just here today to pay a visit, I actually have an invitation for Master Diluc to cut the ribbon at a ceremony to celebrate our agency's business.
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909707 guangzhi 03.ogg}} '''Guangzhi:''' Our collaboration with Dawn Winery last year was quite successful, and I was curious about your product shipment plans for the next quarter.
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909707 guangzhi 04.ogg}} '''Guangzhi:''' If it's no trouble, please also mention to Master Diluc that our agency has expanded this year, so if the winery has any additional needs, please consider us.
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909707 adelinde 01.ogg}} '''Adelinde:''' Master Kaeya, the Apple Cider you requested.
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909707 guangzhi 05.ogg}} '''Guangzhi:''' ...Master... wait... Pardon my foolishness, but might I inquire as to your relation to Dawn Winery...?
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909707 kaeya 02.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' I am Master Crepus's adopted son, and Master Diluc's brother. However, as a serving Captain with the Knights of Favonius, I am rarely at the winery.
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909707 guangzhi 06.ogg}} '''Guangzhi:''' ...My mistake, I apologize for not realizing earlier. I do hope I have not done you a discourtesy.
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909707 kaeya 03.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' You may have misunderstood, Mr. Guangzhi. Though I am Master Diluc's brother, I don't actually live at Dawn Winery.
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909707 kaeya 04.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' I am also a guest here today. I'm merely here receiving guests due to Elzer being temporarily indisposed.
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909707 kaeya 05.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' But please don't worry, I will be sure to extend your invitation to Master Diluc.
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909707 guangzhi 07.ogg}} '''Guangzhi:''' ...Thank you for your graciousness. I knew that Dawn Winery's wines were delicious, but I am only now discovering how wonderful the Apple Cider is. It has a clear and inviting fragrance.
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909707 kaeya 06.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' In addition to the Apple Cider, the winery has an extensive collection of reserve wines and liquors. I see you are also a connoisseur of fine wines, so it would be a shame not to sample some.
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909707 kaeya 07.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' Adelinde, please fetch a bottle from the reserve collection in the second floor wine locker.
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909707 adelinde 02.ogg}} '''Adelinde:''' ...As you wish, Master.
:{{Black Screen|The three of you enjoy Apple Cider and an exquisite bottle of reserve.}}
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909707 guangzhi 08.ogg}} '''Guangzhi:''' Thank you again for your most gracious hospitality, today's trip was very fruitful. Now, allow your humble servant to take his leave.
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909707 kaeya 08.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' Please, it was a pleasure. Here's hoping we'll have a chance to share some more fine wines together in the future.
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909707 adelinde 03.ogg}} '''Adelinde:''' The guest has left, Master Kaeya...
:{{DIcon}} In the end, you couldn't protect the reserve.
:{{DIcon}} Kaeya's plan succeeded again...
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909707 adelinde 04.ogg}} '''Adelinde:''' It's no skin off my nose. Master Diluc may have a few choice words when he learns of the situation, but that's all.
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909707 adelinde 05.ogg}} '''Adelinde:''' All I really wanted to say is... You will always be a part of the Dawn Winery family, Master Kaeya.
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909707 adelinde 06.ogg}} '''Adelinde:''' I have never considered you an outsider. No matter when, if you ever feel tired, you'll always be welcome here...
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909707 kaeya 09.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' I understand, Adelinde.
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909707 kaeya 10.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' Now this is a busy day... Who's at the door this time?
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909707 elzer 01.ogg}} '''Elzer:''' Hello, everyone. I'm back.
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909707 kaeya 11.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' Now that was fast, how are you feeling?
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909707 elzer 02.ogg}} '''Elzer:''' The doctor said there was nothing to worry about, I just need some rest. But on the way back, I met someone who was looking for Master Kaeya...
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909707 klee 01.ogg}} '''Klee:''' Kaeya! Shhh...! Klee's here to rescue you, c'mon, let's escape!
:{{DIcon}} Kaeya's not in danger.
:{{DIcon}} What are you rescuing Kaeya from...?
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909707 klee 02a.ogg}} {{A|vo kycop001 1909707 klee 02b.ogg}} '''Klee:''' Ah! {{MC|m=Mr.|f=Miss}} Honorary Knight!? Are you grounded with Kaeya, too?
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909707 kaeya 12.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' Grounded? Ah yes, Albedo was saying something about that...
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909707 kaeya 13.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' Mmm... Sumeru was fun, but it can't compare with Mondstadt. So, here we are.
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909707 klee 03.ogg}} '''Klee:''' You two must have done something to make Jean mad! But that's okay!
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909707 klee 04.ogg}} '''Klee:''' Kaeya has rescued Klee loads of times before, so when Albedo told me you came back, I went and said sorry to Jean.
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909707 klee 05.ogg}} '''Klee:''' Kaeya, you're free now! We can go play together again!
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909707 adelinde 07.ogg}} '''Adelinde:''' Ah, if my memory serves me correctly, this child is...
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909707 kaeya 14.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' This is a fully qualified Knight of Favonius, Klee.
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909707 klee 06.ogg}} '''Klee:''' Hello, Miss! I'm Klee! We're sorry, please don't ground Kaeya!
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909707 adelinde 08.ogg}} '''Adelinde:''' ...What?
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909707 klee 07a.ogg}} {{A|vo kycop001 1909707 klee 07b.ogg}} '''Klee:''' I really need to take Kaeya and {{MC|m=Mr.|f=Miss}} Honorary Knight away, so we can go find Albedo, Sucrose, Amber, and everyone else and play together!
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909707 adelinde 09.ogg}} '''Adelinde:''' ...I see. Hello, Miss Klee. You needn't worry, Master Kaeya's grounding is long over.
:{{A|vo kycop001 1909707 kaeya 15.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' See, Adelinde? You don't need to worry about me. I have lots of people to care for me now.

==Steps==
# Wait until the following day (08:00 – 10:00)
# Go to the [[Stone Gate|event venue]]
# Follow [[Chongyun]] to the location of the incident
# Collect [[Fresh Jueyun Chili (Tears Among the Leaves)|fresh Jueyun Chilis]] (0/3)
# Defeat the [[Hydro Slime]]s (0/4) {{Enemy List|Large Hydro Slime*1;Hydro Slime*3}}
# Talk to [[Diona]]
# Pick up the leaf in the water
# Place the poem upstream
# Go on a walk to get some inspiration
# Collect [[Dry Firewood (Tears Among the Leaves)|wood]] nearby (0/1)
# Look for cooking ingredients nearby
# Collect [[fresh Berries]] (0/3)
# Sort through the supplies
# Go back to camp and talk to [[Noelle]]
# Talk to the [[Callirhoe|woman]] on the bridge
# Return to the event venue
# Talk to everyone

==Gameplay Notes==
* For steps 4 to 7, the party will be limited to the Traveler, Xiao, Chongyun, and Diona. [[Co-Op Mode]] will be disabled.
* For steps 10 to 14, the party will be limited to Xingqiu and Mika. Co-Op Mode will be disabled.
* For step 15, Noelle will join the current party.
* Depending on the current attributes of the player's characters, either a trial character or the player's version of the character is used.
** The criteria for the trial character to be replaced with the player's character is unclear. Characters with lower levels, lower artifact levels, and lower weapon levels than the trial can replace the trial, so having higher stats than the trial character in all aspects is not necessary.

==Dialogue==
{{Quest Description|You take a stroll while taking in the scenery for poetic inspiration. As you share your verses with each other, there seems to be a faint sense of sorrow admist the joyful laughter...}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
:{{A|vo sgeq002 1 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Looks like it's about time to head over to the venue again.
:{{A|vo sgeq002 1 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Paimon's still curious what Chongyun saw the other day.

;(Approach the stage at the event venue)
:{{A|vo sgeq002 2 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wow, everyone got here so early.
:{{A|vo sgeq002 2 venti 01.ogg}} '''Venti:''' The sun is shining bright today! As soon as that leaf floats past Stone Gate, we shall reveal today's poetry theme!
:{{A|vo sgeq002 2 hutao 01.ogg}} '''Hu Tao:''' The theme of the second day of the "Neighboring Nations Congenial Poetry Gala" is... Pairing couplets!
:{{A|vo sgeq002 2 noelle 01.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' (Pairing couplets? I've heard of that — it's a Liyue art form where you have to create new lines of poetry based on fixed rules. Kind of like... a fill-in-the-blanks game, but for poetry?)
:{{A|vo sgeq002 2 hutao 02.ogg}} '''Hu Tao:''' Heaven and earth, rain and wind, the endless sky and the boundless land. [[Forest Boar|Forest boars]] and ocean shrimp, [[Lavender Melon]]s and [[Matsutake]] 'shrooms!
:{{A|vo sgeq002 2 hutao 03.ogg}} '''Hu Tao:''' Based on a given line of poetry, you must create the second line to form a pair, or "couplet"! As long as you take inspiration from the wide world around you, you'll find it's not so difficult after all.
:{{A|vo sgeq002 2 hutao 04.ogg}} '''Hu Tao:''' The two lines should be neatly matched, complementing each other both semantically and rhythmically. In essence, it's just like most other forms of poetry.
:{{A|vo sgeq002 2 venti 02.ogg}} '''Venti:''' To buoy your imaginations and allow the winds of inspiration to fill your sails, we've added an additional component: a nature tour!<ref group="Note">Instead of "a nature tour," the voice line says "an inspiration walk!"</ref>
:{{A|vo sgeq002 2 mika 01.ogg}} '''Mika:''' (...An "inspiration walk"?)
:{{A|vo sgeq002 2 hutao 05.ogg}} '''Hu Tao:''' By inspiration walk, we simply mean wandering around in the wild, taking in the scenery, and pocketing any poetic thoughts.
:{{A|vo sgeq002 2 hutao 06.ogg}} '''Hu Tao:''' Of course, to all our friends, old and new, please be careful while out and about. [[Wangsheng Funeral Parlor]] is already fully booked for the month ahead, and if there's any more demand, I'll be the only one with a smile on my face.
:{{A|vo sgeq002 2 venti 03.ogg}} '''Venti:''' In short, please roam freely as the mood takes you, enjoy the spectacular scenery of our two beautiful nations, and fill your imaginations with the most pleasing of poetry! We will all reconvene here tonight.

;(Approach the marked location after collecting the [[Fresh Berries]])
:{{A|vo sgeq002 12 mika 01.ogg}} '''Mika:''' With this wood and the food I brought along, we can definitely put together a decent lunch.
:{{A|vo sgeq002 12 xingqiu 01.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' You've got quite a knack for wilderness survival, I'll give you that.
:{{A|vo sgeq002 12 mika 02.ogg}} '''Mika:''' Thanks! I... I was on an expedition with the Grand Master of the Knights of Favonius for a while not too long ago. I was in charge of surveying and mapping.
:{{A|vo sgeq002 12 xingqiu 02.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' Oh? You sound like a character from an adventure novel, charging across the world, sword in hand!
:{{A|vo sgeq002 12 mika 03.ogg}} '''Mika:''' Wha...? No, I'm nowhere near as amazing as all that...
:{{A|vo sgeq002 12 mika 04.ogg}} '''Mika:''' If I really run into a powerful enemy, I always leave it for someone stronger to deal with...
:{{A|vo sgeq002 12 xingqiu 03.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' You're too modest, Mika. A hero is measured not by the blood on his sword, but by what's in his heart.
:{{A|vo sgeq002 12 xingqiu 04.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' As long as a righteous heart that yearns to aid others beats within your chest, no matter where you go, or what you have achieved, you may be called a "hero."
:{{A|vo sgeq002 12 mika 05.ogg}} '''Mika:''' (That all sounded pretty profound... I've never even thought about any of that before.)
:{{A|vo sgeq002 12 xingqiu 05.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' Hello? Are you okay? Maybe we should return, lest Noelle be forced to wait on us.
:{{A|vo sgeq002 12 mika 07.ogg}} '''Mika:''' Oh, sure.

;(Approach Noelle at the camp)
:{{A|vo sgeq002 13 noelle 01.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' You're back! Did everything go smoothly? Do you need a cloth to wipe the sweat from your brow?
:{{A|vo sgeq002 13 mika 01.ogg}} '''Mika:''' No need, thanks. All clear. There's no danger in the vicinity.
:{{Black Screen|The team lights a fire and starts preparing lunch.}}
:{{Black Screen|Before long, a delicious meal is ready.}}
:{{A|vo sgeq002 13 mika 02.ogg}} '''Mika:''' Noelle, your cooking is amazing! Every single dish is so tasty.
:{{A|vo sgeq002 13 xingqiu 01.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' Truly astounding, I never imagined it was possible to enjoy such a satisfying meal in the great outdoors.
:{{A|vo sgeq002 13 noelle 02.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' Really? Then what do you usually eat when you're out on an inspiration walk?
:{{A|vo sgeq002 13 xingqiu 02.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' Oh, well, since I usually sneak out from home, I just grab some dried snacks to take with me. Add in whatever fruit I pick along the way, and that's my lunch.
:{{A|vo sgeq002 13 mika 03.ogg}} '''Mika:''' By sneaking out, you mean... running away from home?
:{{A|vo sgeq002 13 xingqiu 03.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' That's right! Or sometimes, I'll tell a cover story, like... I'm going out to take care of business.
:{{A|vo sgeq002 13 noelle 03.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' But... if you get caught, won't you get disciplined?
:{{A|vo sgeq002 13 xingqiu 04.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' So just don't get caught!
:{{A|vo sgeq002 13 noelle 04.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' ...
:{{A|vo sgeq002 13 noelle 05.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' Anyway, did anything interesting come up while you were out scouting?
:{{A|vo sgeq002 13 mika 05.ogg}} '''Mika:''' Well, Xingqiu and I talked about what it means to be a "hero."
:{{A|vo sgeq002 13 mika 06.ogg}} '''Mika:''' Now that I think about it, by Xingqiu's definition, you should be considered a hero too, Noelle!
:{{A|vo sgeq002 13 noelle 06.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' Huh? Me?
:{{A|vo sgeq002 13 mika 07.ogg}} '''Mika:''' You're always happy to help everyone in the Knights of Favonius. Not only that, but whenever we're out training, you help out the citizens of Mondstadt.
:{{A|vo sgeq002 13 mika 08.ogg}} '''Mika:''' Remember that time when a giant boulder was blocking the road? You cut it in two with a single blow!
:{{A|vo sgeq002 13 xingqiu 05.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' Oh? It appears that not only does she have a heroic spirit, but also incredible martial prowess.
:{{A|vo sgeq002 13 noelle 07.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' Don't... Please don't praise me like that! ...We should talk about what we came here to do: finding inspiration.
:{{A|vo sgeq002 13 mika 09.ogg}} '''Mika:''' Miss Hu Tao said something about pocketing our... poetic thoughts. But so far all we've done is gather some firewood and cook lunch. I have no idea what to write...
:{{A|vo sgeq002 13 xingqiu 06.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' You can write about anything.
:{{A|vo sgeq002 13 xingqiu 07.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' Looking at [[Cor Lapis]], one can't help but wonder if one's own heart is as bright and clear as jade. Observing silk, so bright and beautiful, one pauses to consider whether it ever feels the sadness and sorrow that humans do.
:{{A|vo sgeq002 13 noelle 08.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' So, we have to connect our internal world with the external one?
:{{A|vo sgeq002 13 xingqiu 08.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' Exactly! But that's just one of many possible methods.
:{{A|vo sgeq002 13 xingqiu 09.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' Perhaps you might gaze out at the bridge in the distance, and see a [[Callirhoe|woman]] leaning on the railing, looking as if her heart is laden by sorrows that even the rushing waters below cannot wash away...
:{{A|vo sgeq002 13 noelle 09.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' Huh? Wait, I saw her at the gala yesterday. She wrote one of the riddles we answered.
:{{A|vo sgeq002 13 noelle 10.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' Why don't we go say hi?

;(Approach the woman on the bridge)
:{{A|vo sgeq002 14 xingqiu 01.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' Hello, Ma'am. How fortuitous it is that we meet again.
:{{A|vo sgeq002 14 kallirhoe 01.ogg}} '''???:''' Hello. Are you here on your inspiration walk too?
:{{A|vo sgeq002 14 xingqiu 02.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' Yes. Allow me to introduce ourselves: I am Xingqiu, and this is Noelle and Mika.
:{{A|vo sgeq002 14 noelle 01.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' Thank you for accepting our answer to your riddle yesterday.
:{{A|vo sgeq002 14 kallirhoe 02.ogg}} '''Callirhoe:''' Oh, don't mention it. It's all in good fun. I'm Callirhoe.
:{{A|vo sgeq002 14 mika 01.ogg}} '''Mika:''' ...So, Miss Callirhoe, are you from [[Fontaine]]?
:{{A|vo sgeq002 14 kallirhoe 03.ogg}} '''Callirhoe:''' That's right! I was traveling in the area, and just happened to see there was a poetry event being held at Stone Gate. It looked fun, so I thought I'd drop in.
:{{A|vo sgeq002 14 xingqiu 03.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' Your riddle yesterday made quite an impression on me. It was uniquely evocative. Have you studied Liyue poetry before?
:{{A|vo sgeq002 14 kallirhoe 04.ogg}} '''Callirhoe:''' I haven't, actually. I've just picked up a few things here and there from chatting with people throughout my travels.
:{{A|vo sgeq002 14 noelle 02.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' Amazing! So you're a natural poet!
:{{A|vo sgeq002 14 xingqiu 04.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' We noticed you standing on the bridge from quite some distance away. Are you drawing poetic inspiration from the flowing current beneath your feet?
:{{A|vo sgeq002 14 kallirhoe 05.ogg}} '''Callirhoe:''' Haha, I haven't finished my poem yet. The water here was just so peaceful and calming, I stopped for a moment and lost myself in admiring it...
:{{A|vo sgeq002 14 xingqiu 05.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' Well, since we're all here, why not head back with us to the venue for tonight's festivities? It's getting late, after all.
:{{A|vo sgeq002 14 kallirhoe 06.ogg}} '''Callirhoe:''' ...Huh? Are... Are you sure?
:{{A|vo sgeq002 14 xingqiu 06.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' We can walk and talk. Perhaps the mingling of ideas will give rise to new inspiration.
:{{A|vo sgeq002 14 noelle 03.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' I'd personally like to hear Miss Callirhoe's couplet. I'm sure I can learn something.
:{{A|vo sgeq002 14 kallirhoe 07.ogg}} '''Callirhoe:''' Haha, well if you're all in agreement, I've got no reason not to join you.

:{{Black Screen|The group walk back to the venue, laughing and joking as they go.}}
:{{A|vo sgeq002 15 venti 01.ogg}} '''Venti:''' Woohoo, the first team is back, right on schedule!
:{{A|vo sgeq002 15 xingqiu 01.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' Huh? The others have yet to return?
:{{A|vo sgeq002 15 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' ...C'mon, let's hurry!
:{{A|vo sgeq002 15 chongyun 01.ogg}} '''Chongyun:''' *wheezing* We... *panting* ...We're not too late, are we?
:{{A|vo sgeq002 15 xingqiu 02.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' Just how far did you all go?
:{{A|vo sgeq002 15 venti 02.ogg}} '''Venti:''' Haha, everyone catch your breath... Come on, deep breaths, one... two. Now don't panic, the party hasn't started yet!
:{{A|vo sgeq002 15 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Phew... We made it... Paimon's exhausted...
:{{DIcon}} Since when do you get tired from flying...
:{{A|vo sgeq002 15 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Paimon gets tired if she has to fly too fast!
:{{A|vo sgeq002 15 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Not to mention dropping all those leaves. Paimon's hands are cramping up...
:{{A|vo sgeq002 15 diona 01.ogg}} '''Diona:''' Hmph! Sounds like someone needs to exercise more.
:{{A|vo sgeq002 15 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh? You guys picked up a new teammate while you were out?
:{{A|vo sgeq002 15 xingqiu 03.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' Indeed. This is Callirhoe — I believe you'll remember her from yesterday, though you weren't introduced.
:{{A|vo sgeq002 15 kallirhoe 01.ogg}} '''Callirhoe:''' Hi everyone.
:{{A|vo sgeq002 15 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hello! But you're not the only ones who called in reinforcements! Hee-hee, look who we got...
:{{A|vo sgeq002 15 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wait... Xiao? Where'd he go?
:{{A|vo sgeq002 15 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' XIAOOOOOO! Come on oooout~!
:{{A|vo sgeq002 15 xiao 01.ogg}} '''Xiao:''' ...
:{{A|vo sgeq002 15 venti 03.ogg}} '''Venti:''' Ahem, now that we've all regrouped, let's... Huh. Scratch that, looks like we're still waiting on my co-host.
:{{A|vo sgeq002 15 hutao 01.ogg}} '''Hu Tao:''' Hohoho, they say roosters crow at first light, and finches go to bed at night, but Director Hu Tao's always on the ball — anytime, anywhere, she'll answer your call!
:{{A|vo sgeq002 15 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Um... Are the theatrics really necessary? We're already on day two of the festival. The opening ceremony is over...
:{{A|vo sgeq002 15 hutao 02.ogg}} '''Hu Tao:''' Oh ho, but my dear dear Paimon, it seems you are not yet aware. That was not for my own sake, but for a special guest who is joining us today—
:{{A|vo sgeq002 15 zhongli 01.ogg}} '''[[Zhongli]]:''' Director Hu's manner is as exuberant as ever. It always makes quite an impression.
:{{A|vo sgeq002 15 venti 04.ogg}} '''Venti:''' Oh boy, now this is a surprise!
:{{A|vo sgeq002 15 xingqiu 04.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' Mr. Zhongli, I hope you are well.
:{{A|vo sgeq002 15 noelle 01.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' Xingqiu... What can you tell me about Mister Zhongli? He seems like somebody very important.
:{{A|vo sgeq002 15 xingqiu 05.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' Yes — he's held in very high regard in Liyue Harbor. He's extremely erudite in many different domains of knowledge.
:{{A|vo sgeq002 15 hutao 03.ogg}} '''Hu Tao:''' Allow me to introduce you all to Zhongli, a consultant at the Wangsheng Funeral Parlor.
:{{A|vo sgeq002 15 hutao 04.ogg}} '''Hu Tao:''' His expertise is limitless, stretching from the celestial orbs to the terrestrial ores, spanning modern and ancient culture, delving into literature both prosaic and poetic.
:{{A|vo sgeq002 15 hutao 05.ogg}} '''Hu Tao:''' He may be my subordinate, but he is certainly a qualified poetry expert. And so, we have invited him here tonight to judge the compositions.
:{{A|vo sgeq002 15 zhongli 02.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' The director exaggerates. I am but vaguely acquainted with a few lines of classical poetry. Should you consider me to be remiss in my appraisal of your own compositions, please correct me.
:{{A|vo sgeq002 15 hutao 06.ogg}} '''Hu Tao:''' Aiya, enough with the modesty already! If I didn't know better, I'd say you seemed nervous. Just focus on judging.
:{{A|vo sgeq002 15 zhongli 03.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Please rest assured that I shall rise to the occasion, Director.
:{{A|vo sgeq002 15 hutao 07.ogg}} '''Hu Tao:''' Let me do a quick count... one, two, three, four... Great, equal numbers on both sides.
:{{A|vo sgeq002 15 diona 02.ogg}} '''Diona:''' Huh? Are you counting me, too?
:{{DIcon}} Join us.
:{{DIcon}} It'll be fun.
:{{A|vo sgeq002 15 diona 03.ogg}} '''Diona:''' Okay, fine... But consider this a favor!
:{{A|vo sgeq002 15 hutao 08.ogg}} '''Hu Tao:''' Hmm, with our Fontaine friend present, perhaps we should rename this event to the "Three Nations Congenial Poetry Gala"...
:{{A|vo sgeq002 15 hutao 09.ogg}} '''Hu Tao:''' Also, I'm just noticing that Paimon should only count as a half-teammate at most...? Hmm, that kinda puts Team {{Traveler}} at a bit of a disadvantage...
:{{A|vo sgeq002 15 hutao 10.ogg}} '''Hu Tao:''' Well, how about this: I'll join in as well! Director Hu Tao, here to help out in your hour of greatest need! What does everyone think?
:{{A|vo sgeq002 15 xingqiu 06.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' Naturally, the more the merrier. Being the host of the festival shouldn't stop you from having the chance to enjoy it like the rest of us.
:{{A|vo sgeq002 15 hutao 11.ogg}} '''Hu Tao:''' Then it's settled! Everyone else in the audience, feel free to join in too, and support your favorite team!
:{{A|vo sgeq002 15 venti 05.ogg}} '''Venti:''' What about me? Shall I keep track of the score?
:{{A|vo sgeq002 15 hutao 12.ogg}} '''Hu Tao:''' No need for that! The teams are just a formality. We're all friends here, and this isn't intended to be competitive. But what do you think, Judge Zhongli?
:{{A|vo sgeq002 15 zhongli 04.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' I concur, Director. Moreover, it would be disingenuous to impose upon our friends from Mondstadt and Fontaine a competition in which they are judged on how rigorously they can adhere to Liyue poetic conventions.
:{{A|vo sgeq002 15 zhongli 05.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Since this is a "Congenial Poetry Gala," should we not begin with inspiration and finish with friendly conversation? The aim being for all participants to enjoy themselves.
:{{A|vo sgeq002 15 mika 01.ogg}} '''Mika:''' Phew, that's a relief... I was so nervous about this, but it sounds like it's gonna be pretty relaxed...
:{{A|vo sgeq002 15 hutao 13.ogg}} '''Hu Tao:''' Couldn't have asked for a better judge — Zhongli said everything I was supposed to say, only far more eloquently. So without further ado... I shall pass the baton to Venti.
:{{A|vo sgeq002 15 venti 06.ogg}} '''Venti:''' No problem.
----
:{{A|vo sgeq002 15 venti 07.ogg}} '''Venti:''' Friends old and new, put on your thinking caps and take a deep breath of fresh air! The second stage of our poetry gala will now commence: matching couplets!
:{{A|vo sgeq002 15 xingqiu 07.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' Perhaps I could break the ice with a humble contribution to inspire others to share their brilliance.
:{{A|vo sgeq002 15 xingqiu 08.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' Please listen to the first line in the couplet: "Lounging in luxury inside a [[Xinyue Kiosk]] booth, delighting in countless contemporary tastes."
:{{A|vo sgeq002 15 mika 02.ogg}} '''Mika:''' (What? He managed to think of one already? He seems like a real expert at this...)
:{{A|vo sgeq002 15 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hmm, Xinyue Kiosk... Should that be paired with [[Liuli Pavilion]]? Or are they too similar for a couplet? Ugh, this is pretty difficult!
:{{A|vo sgeq002 15 chongyun 02.ogg}} '''Chongyun:''' (Xinyue Kiosk... contemporary tastes... Hmm, I guess I should pair the modernity of their VIP dining experience with an emblem of the past... Ah! Maybe where I was training that one time? That was quite ancient. The weather was terrible that day...)
:{{A|vo sgeq002 15 chongyun 03.ogg}} '''Chongyun:''' ...Okay! I got something!
:{{A|vo sgeq002 15 chongyun 04.ogg}} '''Chongyun:''' ..."Surrounded by history outside a Tianheng Pass pavilion, as lightning sets the boundless tenebrous skies ablaze."
:{{A|vo sgeq002 15 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wow! Chongyun completed the couplet!
:{{A|vo sgeq002 15 zhongli 06.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Hmm... Xinyue Kiosk is a renowned modern restaurant, while the mountain pass of Tianheng is a prominent historical landmark. These two iconic locations form a complementary pair.
:{{A|vo sgeq002 15 zhongli 07.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' The imagery also contrasts rather well between the two halves of the couplet, one half describing a leisurely and comfortable indoor scene, the other portraying a hazardous outdoor scenario where there is no protection from the elements.
:{{A|vo sgeq002 15 chongyun 05.ogg}} '''Chongyun:''' (Huh? I was just describing what I experienced that day... I guess I just got lucky?)
:{{A|vo sgeq002 15 chongyun 06.ogg}} '''Chongyun:''' Alright then, I guess I'll start the next couplet:
:{{A|vo sgeq002 15 chongyun 07.ogg}} '''Chongyun:''' "Mind pines for [[Mingyun Village|Mingyun]], flesh confined to [[Qingce Village|Qingce]], spirit striding high on [[Jueyun Karst|Jueyun]]'s clouds."
:{{A|vo sgeq002 15 xingqiu 09.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' (Oh, Chongyun, you dark horse... Looks like you came to play today...)
:{{A|vo sgeq002 15 zhongli 08.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' This conjures the image of one with lofty aspirations, whose life is limited to a small town, but who awaits the opportunity to one day ascend above the clouds. The use of various locations for their symbolism is quite novel indeed.
:{{A|vo sgeq002 15 noelle 02.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' ...Oh!
:{{A|vo sgeq002 15 noelle 03.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' "Soul shines like jadestone, dressed in finest silkwear, lucent heart still beats within me now."
:{{A|vo sgeq002 15 paimon 12.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wow, how did Noelle do that!?
:{{A|vo sgeq002 15 zhongli 09.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' A superb line. It employs the metaphor of precious stone to describe one of noble and moral character, with a pure and clear heart. The symbolism in this case is centered around objects. Truly, the work of a skilled poet.
:{{A|vo sgeq002 15 xingqiu 10.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' That was a commendable couplet.
:{{A|vo sgeq002 15 noelle 04.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' All thanks to your guidance while we were out on our inspiration walk.
:{{A|vo sgeq002 15 kallirhoe 02.ogg}} '''Callirhoe:''' I'd like to start the next couplet:
:{{A|vo sgeq002 15 kallirhoe 03.ogg}} '''Callirhoe:''' "Up into the misty karst, down among the grassy marsh, all for [[Lotus Seed and Bird Egg Soup]]."
:{{A|vo sgeq002 15 diona 04.ogg}} '''Diona:''' ...Lotus Seed and Bird Egg Soup?
:{{A|vo sgeq002 15 paimon 13.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What is it, Diona? Did you think of a second line for the couplet?
:{{A|vo sgeq002 15 diona 05.ogg}} '''Diona:''' No, everyone's poems are so complicated. I need more time just to understand them...
:{{A|vo sgeq002 15 diona 06.ogg}} '''Diona:''' But when I heard "Lotus Seed and Bird Egg Soup," it made me think of [[Berry & Mint Burst|Berry and Mint Burst]]... maybe because I mixed a similar drink recently.
:{{DIcon}} ...
:{{DIcon}} ...Got it!
:{{A|vo sgeq002 15 hero 01.ogg}} {{A|vo sgeq002 15 heroine 01.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' "North beyond the [[Starfell Lake]], south across the windswept plains, just for berries squeezed and mint infused."
:{{A|vo sgeq002 15 kallirhoe 04.ogg}} '''Callirhoe:''' No wonder everyone praises {{Traveler}} so highly! You answered so quickly.
:{{A|vo sgeq002 15 zhongli 10.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Both halves of this couplet require intimate knowledge of the terrain in question and the local plants that may be found there. The two of you are clearly both seasoned travelers.
:{{A|vo sgeq002 15 diona 07.ogg}} '''Diona:''' Does this mean I helped? Meowza!
:{{DIcon}} You saved the day.
:{{DIcon}} Thanks, Diona.
:{{A|vo sgeq002 15 hutao 14.ogg}} '''Hu Tao:''' Hey now, Zhongli, don't just praise everything you hear! You should question and press them a bit, don't worry about upsetting anyone! After all, I'm here to take the heat!
:{{A|vo sgeq002 15 kallirhoe 05.ogg}} '''Callirhoe:''' Then allow me to try another:
:{{A|vo sgeq002 15 kallirhoe 06.ogg}} '''Callirhoe:''' "[[Qingxin|'Qingxin']] has no heart, still it soothes the human heart."
:{{A|vo sgeq002 15 chongyun 08.ogg}} '''Chongyun:''' Is she talking about the medicinal effects of Qingxin? Hmm... this is a hard one to match.
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (...The "xin" part of Qingxin means heart, but the flower itself has no heart...)
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' ...
:;(The Traveler gazes at Xiao on an overlooking mountain)
:{{DIcon}} ...!
:{{DIcon}} I've got it!
:{{A|vo sgeq002 15 hero 02.ogg}} {{A|vo sgeq002 15 heroine 02.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' "[["Sweet Dream"|'Sweet Dream']] is no dream, yet it nurtures people's dreams."
:{{A|vo sgeq002 15 huanxi 01.ogg}} '''Huanxi:''' Sweet dream? Does that really match?
:{{A|vo sgeq002 15 zhongli 11.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Hmm. Since the suitability of the match has been queried, I shall act according to the Director's wishes, and ask you: What is the link between "Sweet Dream" and "Qingxin"?
:{{DIcon}} "Sweet Dream" is a type of [[Almond Tofu|dessert]].
:{{A|vo sgeq002 15 xiao 02.ogg}} '''Xiao:''' ...
:{{A|vo sgeq002 15 paimon 14.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ohhh! You mean eating a delicious dessert before bed will make you sleep well, right? You're amazing!
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (Actually, we sleep peacefully at night because Xiao is there to protect everyone.)
:;(Xiao smiles then disappears)
:{{A|vo sgeq002 15 zhongli 12.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Haha, then I agree, the two halves of the couplet match. This point is well deserved.
:{{A|vo sgeq002 15 hutao 15.ogg}} '''Hu Tao:''' Points for me, points for thee, this judge gives out points for free...
:{{A|vo sgeq002 15 hutao 16.ogg}} '''Hu Tao:''' But if you ask me, everyone's being a little too conventional so far. Let's push the envelope a little! Go nuts!
:{{A|vo sgeq002 15 xingqiu 11.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' Oh? In that case, why don't you finish this one for me, Hu Tao?
:{{A|vo sgeq002 15 xingqiu 12.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' "Round moon in the heavens: full moon at night, celebrate with circle of friends."
:{{A|vo sgeq002 15 hutao 17.ogg}} '''Hu Tao:''' "Square meals in the basement: big bowls of rice, decorate with cuboids of meat."
:{{A|vo sgeq002 15 xingqiu 13.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' Huh? Wh—What the...?
:{{A|vo sgeq002 15 zhongli 13.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Ah, we have ourselves a "pedants' couplet."
:{{A|vo sgeq002 15 zhongli 14.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' The two halves have no thematic connection... Yet each word has its perfect parallel, meaning the two halves do form a cohesive whole. The strict pairings make this no easier to achieve than a thematically coherent couplet.
:{{A|vo sgeq002 15 hutao 18.ogg}} '''Hu Tao:''' Blah blah blah! So verbose. Zhongli, just tell me if I got a point or not.
:{{A|vo sgeq002 15 zhongli 15.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Of course, you did. I presumed it went without saying.
:{{A|vo sgeq002 15 xingqiu 14.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' Ahem... "Through [[Qiongji Estuary|Qiongji]] I walked a hundred miles, at [[Guili Plains|Guili]] I ended my march. In [[Dihua Marsh|Dihua]] the silvergrass grows in two styles, but [[horsetail]]s don't trot out the marsh."
:{{A|vo sgeq002 15 hutao 19.ogg}} '''Hu Tao:''' "From vendors I bought some fifteen steaks, at dinner I sizzled the lot. At pressure the tenderloin cooks in two ticks, but fifteen won't fit in the pot."
:{{A|vo sgeq002 15 xingqiu 15.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' Huh?
:{{A|vo sgeq002 15 paimon 15.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So that's a "pedants' couplet"? Paimon thinks she can do that too!
:{{A|vo sgeq002 15 diona 08.ogg}} '''Diona:''' I thought of one!
:{{A|vo sgeq002 15 diona 09.ogg}} '''Diona:''' "[[Wolfhook]]s can't hook [[Baron Bunny]]."
:{{A|vo sgeq002 15 paimon 16.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Aww, that's a cute couplet!
:{{A|vo sgeq002 15 levin 01.ogg}} '''Levin:''' "[[Sweet Flower]]s can't outsweet Sister [[Barbara]]!"
:{{A|vo sgeq002 15 paimon 17.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh?
:{{A|vo sgeq002 15 venti 08.ogg}} '''Venti:''' Haha, now that's the passion we like to see, although... unfortunately, your response was technically one word too long.
:{{A|vo sgeq002 15 mika 03.ogg}} '''Mika:''' ...
:{{A|vo sgeq002 15 mika 04.ogg}} '''Mika:''' In that case... "[[Whopperflower]]s can't whop [[Jumpy Dumpty]]."
:{{A|vo sgeq002 15 hutao 20.ogg}} '''Hu Tao:''' Oho! This Mondstadter's got talent!
:{{A|vo sgeq002 15 mika 05.ogg}} '''Mika:''' (Phew... I'm so relieved I at least managed to get one...)
:{{A|vo sgeq002 15 noelle 05.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' ...
:{{A|vo sgeq002 15 noelle 06.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' "Nestling by a roaring fire, scent of tea wafts from the stove, reading through the [[Heart of Clear Springs]]."
:{{A|vo sgeq002 15 kallirhoe 07.ogg}} '''Callirhoe:''' ...
:{{A|vo sgeq002 15 paimon 18.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wow! Noelle came up with another one!

:{{A|vo sgeq002 15 paimon 21.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Fine, Paimon'll give it a whirl...
:{{A|vo sgeq002 15 paimon 22.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' "Nestling by a roaring fire, scent of tea wafts from the stove, reading through the Heart of Clear Springs."
:{{A|vo sgeq002 15 paimon 23.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hmm... "Seething in the pouring rain, sword of pain swipes at my foe, beating up the [[Eye of the Storm]]!"
:{{DIcon}} Great job!
:{{A|vo sgeq002 15 paimon 24.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What? Really?
:{{A|vo sgeq002 15 hutao 21.ogg}} '''Hu Tao:''' Yes, very good!!! The image of challenging powerful foes in the harshest of conditions seemed to manifest before my eyes, and it was perfectly juxtaposed against the atmosphere of leisurely reading with a cup of freshly brewed tea.
:{{A|vo sgeq002 15 paimon 25.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' R—Really? Hehe... Maybe Paimon has a knack for this after all!
:{{A|vo sgeq002 15 zhongli 16.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' ...It appears that my services as a judge are no longer needed.
:{{Black Screen|In high spirits, the laughter and couplets continue late into the night...}}
:{{Black Screen|As the host declares the day's events over, the crowd reluctantly disperses...}}
:{{A|vo sgeq002 16 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Woohoo, Paimon's so happy! Paimon managed to match a bunch of couplets at the end! You did hear them all, right?
:{{A|vo sgeq002 16 noelle 01.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' I really enjoyed myself too! I never knew Liyue's couplet poetry was so much fun.
:{{A|vo sgeq002 16 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You were amazing today, Noelle! You did so many couplets.
:{{A|vo sgeq002 16 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Paimon especially liked your one about reading "Heart of Clear Springs." Paimon never could've thought of that!
:{{A|vo sgeq002 16 kallirhoe 01.ogg}} '''Callirhoe:''' ...
:{{DIcon}} Callirhoe?
:{{A|vo sgeq002 16 xingqiu 01.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' Miss Callirhoe, are you okay? You look like you're getting tired.
:{{A|vo sgeq002 16 kallirhoe 02.ogg}} '''Callirhoe:''' Don't worry, I'm fine. Thanks for asking.
:{{A|vo sgeq002 16 kallirhoe 03.ogg}} '''Callirhoe:''' Although... I do have a question I'd like to ask.
:{{A|vo sgeq002 16 kallirhoe 04.ogg}} '''Callirhoe:''' Have all of you read "Heart of Clear Springs"?
:{{DIcon}} I've read it before.
:{{DIcon}} I haven't read it yet.
:{{A|vo sgeq002 16 chongyun 01.ogg}} '''Chongyun:''' I haven't actually read it.
:{{A|vo sgeq002 16 diona 01.ogg}} '''Diona:''' My dad told me the story once. It's about a spring fairy and a young boy.
:{{A|vo sgeq002 16 noelle 02.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' Oh yes, the story of a spring fairy who left her homeland, and met a boy under the moonlight in a faraway land.
:{{A|vo sgeq002 16 noelle 03.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' The boy poured out his heart to her, and she listened to his stories.
:{{A|vo sgeq002 16 noelle 04.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' Over time, the boy grew up, and began to develop feelings for the spring fairy. But the spring fairy didn't understand human love, and was afraid that making a promise to him would ultimately end in tragedy... and so... um...
:{{A|vo sgeq002 16 noelle 05.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' (I don't know if [[Draff|Diona's father]] mentioned the part about the kiss to her...)
:{{A|vo sgeq002 16 diona 02.ogg}} '''Diona:''' In the end, the spring fairy left the boy, and was never heard from again.
:{{A|vo sgeq002 16 noelle 06.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' Ah, yes, that's it! Many years went by, and the boy became an old man, but he never stopped believing that the fairy was real, and not just a dream.
:{{A|vo sgeq002 16 chongyun 02.ogg}} '''Chongyun:''' Sounds like a tragic tale...
:{{A|vo sgeq002 16 kallirhoe 05.ogg}} '''Callirhoe:''' So, what do you guys think of the spring fairy in the story?
:{{A|vo sgeq002 16 xingqiu 02.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' I'm sure she made her decision with the best of intentions, but the boy couldn't hope to understand why she left... It's a shame that the misunderstanding never got cleared up.
:{{A|vo sgeq002 16 kallirhoe 06.ogg}} '''Callirhoe:''' Well... Do you think she should go back and see that boy again, if she ever had another chance?
:{{A|vo sgeq002 16 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Now? But... isn't he an old man by the end of the story?
:{{A|vo sgeq002 16 mika 01.ogg}} '''Mika:''' Hmm... isn't it a bit late? What if it just led to more regrets?
:{{A|vo sgeq002 16 mika 02.ogg}} '''Mika:''' Ah! Sorry, maybe I'm being too pessimistic...
:{{A|vo sgeq002 16 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' If Paimon was that boy... Hmm, actually, Paimon would definitely want to see the spring fairy again. No matter how old Paimon got. After all, she's the love of his life, right?
:{{A|vo sgeq002 16 kallirhoe 07.ogg}} '''Callirhoe:''' I see...
:{{A|vo sgeq002 16 venti 01.ogg}} '''Venti:''' Oh? Looks like the party's still going strong over here. Are you coming up with more couplets? Need my help?
:{{A|vo sgeq002 16 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Stick to hosting, Tone-Deaf Bard! If you get involved, you'll only match every couplet yourself and not leave any for the rest of us!
:{{A|vo sgeq002 16 venti 02.ogg}} '''Venti:''' Haha, I never knew you had such a high opinion of my abilities, Paimon.
:{{A|vo sgeq002 16 venti 03.ogg}} '''Venti:''' But the couplet games are all over now! Tomorrow's theme is "Freestyle Poetry"!
:{{A|vo sgeq002 16 mika 03.ogg}} '''Mika:''' Do we have to share our own poems with everyone?
:{{A|vo sgeq002 16 venti 04.ogg}} '''Venti:''' That's right! If you're not feeling confident, don't worry — it's never too late to register for Venti's Poetry Cram Class.
:{{A|vo sgeq002 16 noelle 07.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' I'll sign up!
:{{A|vo sgeq002 16 mika 04.ogg}} '''Mika:''' Me too!
:{{A|vo sgeq002 16 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hold on, buster... Before you start peddling your classes, just how much freedom is there with this freestyle poetry, exactly? Aren't there any requirements at all?
:{{A|vo sgeq002 16 venti 05.ogg}} '''Venti:''' It's as free as the winds that blow, and there's nothing freer! There are no limits to genre, form, content, or anything else. So long as it comes from the heart, you're welcome to put it into poetry.
:{{A|vo sgeq002 16 venti 06.ogg}} '''Venti:''' Give it a try, there's no better chance to express your innermost thoughts!
:{{A|vo sgeq002 16 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Whoa... That's almost too much freedom! Paimon can't decide which way to go... Our travels? Or maybe all the food that {{Traveler}} has cooked for Paimon...
:{{A|vo sgeq002 16 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Will you come too, Callirhoe? Paimon wants to see what you write!
:{{A|vo sgeq002 16 kallirhoe 08.ogg}} '''Callirhoe:''' Oh, um... Yes. I'll be there.
:{{A|vo sgeq002 16 venti 07.ogg}} '''Venti:''' Oof, my nose is starting to itch again... Alright, I shall leave you to privately ponder your poems and bid you all goodnight! See you tomorrow!
{{Dialogue End}}

:{{A|vo xnnlq001 2 cheven 01.ogg}} '''Cheven:''' ...Get away from me!
:{{A|vo xnnlq001 2 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Look over there! Is that Master Cheven?

;(Defeat the Treasure Hoarders)
:{{A|vo xnnlq001 3 impatientthieves 01.ogg}} '''Coztic:''' Where did you come from!? S—So strong...
:{{A|vo xnnlq001 3 impatientthieves 02.ogg}} '''Coztic:''' Let's get out of here, boys! Run! Leave the stuff if you wanna live! Drop all of it!

:{{Color|menu|You beat back the perfidious bandits that surrounded Cheven...}}

;(After defeating the Treasure Hoarders)
:{{A|vo xnnlq001 4 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Well, they didn't put up much of a fight...
:{{DIcon}} Guess they knew what they were up against.
:{{DIcon}} Our reputation has its perks...
:{{A|vo xnnlq001 4 cheven 01.ogg}} '''Cheven:''' Phew... Thank you so much... I thought I wasn't gonna make it down this mountain alive.
:{{A|vo xnnlq001 4 cheven 02.ogg}} '''Cheven:''' Saved by {{Traveler}}... Guess my luck's not too bad today.
:{{A|vo xnnlq001 4 cheven 03.ogg}} '''Cheven:''' Ah, sorry, let me introduce myself. I'm Cheven, a gem artisan. I'm not usually this lucky, but maybe things are looking up.
:{{DIcon}} Imix sent us to help.
:{{A|vo xnnlq001 4 cheven 04.ogg}} '''Cheven:''' She did, huh... *sigh* I didn't mean to make her worry. I wasn't planning to be gone longer than two days tops.
:{{A|vo xnnlq001 4 cheven 05.ogg}} '''Cheven:''' But, then, I discovered a new seam of Volcanic Crystal near the Shadow Pin... It's a large deposit, and the purity is exceptional.
:{{A|vo xnnlq001 4 cheven 06.ogg}} '''Cheven:''' I dug up a whole bunch of it and was getting ready to head back, but the phlogiston within the crystals attracted monsters...
;(If the player has completed [[Beneath the Crystal Rock]])
::{{A|vo xnnlq001 4 cheven 07.ogg}} '''Cheven:''' Anyway... I'm sure you've seen the state this place is in. It's all because the Shadow Pin suddenly came crashing to the ground and left behind a massive crater.
::{{A|vo xnnlq001 4 cheven 08.ogg}} '''Cheven:''' The seam I found was closer to the outside, so it survived the disaster. Still, the crash riled up the monsters in the area, and now they're everywhere.
:{{A|vo xnnlq001 4 cheven 09.ogg}} '''Cheven:''' I panicked, and ran up a narrow path to avoid them... But, by the time I was in the clear, I ended up running into those bandits... You showed up in the nick of time.
:{{A|vo xnnlq001 4 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' If the situation was so dangerous, why didn't you just drop the crystals and run?
:{{A|vo xnnlq001 4 cheven 10.ogg}} '''Cheven:''' I left most of them behind, believe me. I only kept the purest chunk — I have to bring it back, no matter what.
:{{A|vo xnnlq001 4 cheven 11.ogg}} '''Cheven:''' ...For [[Tlazolli]], and poor little [[Nechca]].
:{{DIcon}} Who are they?
:{{A|vo xnnlq001 4 cheven 12.ogg}} '''Cheven:''' Ah, right, you wouldn't know. Tlazolli is a former Ancient Name artisan, and Nechca is her daughter.
:{{DIcon}} So... She crafts Ancient Names?
::{{A|vo xnnlq001 4 cheven 13a 1.ogg}} '''Cheven:''' That's right... Or, well, she used to. Now, she just handles regular forging commissions.
::{{DIcon}} Why did she stop?
:{{DIcon}} [[Xilonen]]'s in that line of business too. <small>''(If the player has completed ''[[Past and Future]]'')''</small>
::{{A|vo xnnlq001 4 cheven 13b 1.ogg}} '''Cheven:''' Oh, you know Xilonen? Haha, try mentioning that name in front of Tlazolli. She could sing Xilonen's praises forever.
::{{A|vo xnnlq001 4 cheven 13b 2.ogg}} '''Cheven:''' "The foremost expert in Ancient Names" "the future of our tribe," "the finest artisan in Natlan"... You'll never hear the end of it.
::{{A|vo xnnlq001 4 cheven 13b 3.ogg}} '''Cheven:''' I know Tlazolli misses the days when she used to forge Ancient Names. She'd never say as much... but I can tell.
::{{DIcon}} Why did she stop?
:{{A|vo xnnlq001 4 cheven 14.ogg}} '''Cheven:''' ...Because of her daughter. Poor Nechca contracted an awful illness and Tlazolli put everything aside to take care of her.
:{{A|vo xnnlq001 4 cheven 15.ogg}} '''Cheven:''' Even as Nechca's illness grew worse, Tlazolli never gave up. Like a torch in the night, she was determined to burn bright, even as darkness encroached from all directions...
:{{A|vo xnnlq001 4 cheven 16.ogg}} '''Cheven:''' Still, all's well that ends well! Thanks to the doctor's medicine and the Great Spirit's<ref group="Note">Actual voice-over: "Wayob's"</ref> protection, Nechca's flame was rekindled!
:{{A|vo xnnlq001 4 cheven 17.ogg}} '''Cheven:''' Her condition has been slowly improving ever since. She's still weak, of course, and has to recuperate at home... but she's well enough to write letters already.
:{{A|vo xnnlq001 4 cheven 18.ogg}} '''Cheven:''' She often writes to Xilonen, apparently. Her dream is to become an Ancient Names forger, just like her mother.
:{{A|vo xnnlq001 4 cheven 19.ogg}} '''Cheven:''' Her birthday's in a few days, so Tlazolli asked me to find a pure Volcanic Crystal to give her as a present.
:{{DIcon}} So that's why you were out here.
:{{DIcon}} No wonder you wouldn't leave the crystal behind.
:{{A|vo xnnlq001 4 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yeah, talk about an important chunk of ore! What a nice gift! Paimon hopes it helps her feel better!
:{{A|vo xnnlq001 4 cheven 20.ogg}} '''Cheven:''' I'm sure she and her mother appreciate your well wishes.
:{{A|vo xnnlq001 4 cheven 21.ogg}} '''Cheven:''' Alright, let's head back. I'm sure Imix is worried sick.
:{{A|vo xnnlq001 4 cheven 22.ogg}} '''Cheven:''' Actually, why don't you come with me to visit Tlazolli tomorrow?
:{{A|vo xnnlq001 4 cheven 23.ogg}} '''Cheven:''' It's all thanks to you that I managed to bring back the crystal.
:{{A|vo xnnlq001 4 cheven 24.ogg}} '''Cheven:''' You deserve a reward for helping us protect something so significant.
:{{DIcon}} I just hope it makes Nechca happy.
::{{A|vo xnnlq001 4 paimon 04a 1.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' That's right. A good mood makes for a quick recovery!
::{{A|vo xnnlq001 4 paimon 04a 2.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' And of course, we, uh... wouldn't say no to a little gift...
:{{DIcon}} Is it an Ancient Name? <small>''(If the player has completed ''[[Past and Future]]'')''</small>
:;(If the player has not completed [[When All Becomes a Monument]])
::{{A|vo xnnlq001 4 paimon 04b 1.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hey, the Pyro Archon said she contacted Xilonen about that already. Let's not complicate things!
::{{A|vo xnnlq001 4 paimon 04b 3.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' We don't need anything fancy like that. A normal gift is more than enough.
:;(If the player has completed When All Becomes a Monument)
::'''Paimon:''' You basically have an Ancient Name, and it's useless to have more than one.
::{{A|vo xnnlq001 4 paimon 04b 3.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' We don't need anything fancy like that. A {{Sic|normal}} <!-- missing "gift" --> is more than enough, hehe.
:{{A|vo xnnlq001 4 cheven 25.ogg}} '''Cheven:''' Haha, don't worry. Something tells me you'll like this one.
:{{A|vo xnnlq001 4 cheven 26.ogg}} '''Cheven:''' But, I'll let Tlazolli tell you what it is herself.
{{Dialogue End}}

'''''Test of Courage''''' is a quest in the second branch of {{Quest|Signs of Evil}}.

==Steps==
# Go to [[Wuwang Hill]] and take part in the Test of Courage
#Go to the Site of the Test of Courage
#Look around for any sign of evil spirits (0/3)
#*Interact with Strange Smoke
#*Talk to [[Junjun]] to start the conversation
#*Talk to [[Lu Zheng]] to start the conversation
# Proceed onward and look for information

==Gameplay Notes==
* Branches
** Branch 1: Chongyun's Determination (''Let's both drink it. If you lose control, I'll be sure to take care of you'')
*** This branch also branches into 3.

***** Follows up with [[The Bottom of Things]]
**** Branch 2: [[Whopperflowers|Cryo Whopperflower]] Recipe
