****

==Dialogue==
{{Quest Description|The young thaumaturge [[Chongyun]] has obtained a great amount of (rather unreliable-sounding) information concerning evil spirits, but you decide not to expose this fact out of courtesy. The way Chongyun sees it, the most likely spot for evil spirits to show up is [[Wuwang Hill]], where a Test of Courage is currently taking place. The test requires two people to go in together, so you accept his invitation and accompany him there...}}

===To Take a Test of Courage===
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Talk to [[Uncle Jia]])
:{{A|vo cycop001 1903001 unclejia 01.ogg}} '''Uncle Jia:''' Please be careful, everyone. Pay close attention to your surroundings and stay vigilant once you enter.
:{{A|vo cycop001 1903001 unclejia 02.ogg}} '''Uncle Jia:''' And most importantly, don't get separated from your partner and wander off on your own. You'll most certainly be in for a scare if you go alone.
:{{A|vo cycop001 1903001 chongyun 01.ogg}} '''Chongyun:''' Did you hear that? He's warning the event participants. Maybe something strange really did happen here...
:{{A|vo cycop001 1903001 chongyun 02.ogg}} '''Chongyun:''' Let's investigate.
:{{DIcon}} (I think you misunderstood that...)
:{{A|vo cycop001 1903001 unclejia 03.ogg}} '''Uncle Jia:''' Hehe, welcome to the Test of Courage! You two must be very close friends.
:{{A|vo cycop001 1903001 chongyun 03.ogg}} '''Chongyun:''' Actually, we just met...
:{{A|vo cycop001 1903001 unclejia 04.ogg}} '''Uncle Jia:''' Hah, no problem at all. Don't be shy, just enjoy yourselves!
:{{A|vo cycop001 1903001 unclejia 05.ogg}} '''Uncle Jia:''' But please drink this before you enter the Test of Courage.
:{{A|vo cycop001 1903001 unclejia 06.ogg}} '''Uncle Jia:''' This drink will boost the yang energy inside your body and lift your courage.
:{{A|vo cycop001 1903001 unclejia 07.ogg}} '''Uncle Jia:''' Not only that, but this drink will also allow you to see things which are usually hidden from the naked eye... Pretty exciting, huh?
:{{A|vo cycop001 1903001 chongyun 04.ogg}} '''Chongyun:''' Y—Yang energy?
:{{A|vo cycop001 1903001 unclejia 08.ogg}} '''Uncle Jia:''' That's right. Ghosts are said to be full of "yin energy," so more "yang energy" will surely deter them.
:{{A|vo cycop001 1903001 chongyun 05.ogg}} '''Chongyun:''' Whoa, I've never heard of such a drink. Is it a secret recipe, or maybe some kind of potion?
:{{DIcon}} Perhaps it's all just psychological.
::{{A|vo cycop001 1903001 chongyun 06.ogg}} '''Chongyun:''' Hmm, possibly... But why bother exaggerating it so much then?
:{{DIcon}} I think you've misunderstood the whole "Test of Courage" thing.
::{{A|vo cycop001 1903001 chongyun 07.ogg}} '''Chongyun:''' Surely not, he keeps emphasizing that there are frightening things inside. I'm almost certain it's some powerful evil spirit.
:{{A|vo cycop001 1903001 chongyun 08.ogg}} '''Chongyun:''' But if this drink really does boost yang energy, then it's potentially dangerous for me.
:{{DIcon}} Dangerous?
:{{A|vo cycop001 1903001 chongyun 09.ogg}} '''Chongyun:''' *sigh* You see, I have a very rare constitution called a "pure-yang spirit."
:{{A|vo cycop001 1903001 chongyun 10.ogg}} '''Chongyun:''' Such a constitution allows me to scare away evil spirits, but also makes me prone to emotional impulses.
:{{DIcon}} You seem like a very calm person to me.
:{{A|vo cycop001 1903001 chongyun 11.ogg}} '''Chongyun:''' I am constantly focusing to keep my mind and body in a normal state, which usually works until I suffer from some external stress...
:{{A|vo cycop001 1903001 unclejia 09.ogg}} '''Uncle Jia:''' Come now, what's with that serious expression on your face, lad? You aren't worried about the drink, are you?
:{{A|vo cycop001 1903001 unclejia 10.ogg}} '''Uncle Jia:''' It's delicious and quite effective if I do say so myself! There's nothing to worry about.
:{{A|vo cycop001 1903001 unclejia 11.ogg}} '''Uncle Jia:''' Or if you're still unsure, perhaps only one of you could take the drink. The person who takes the drink can protect the one who doesn't. It'll be exciting either way!
:{{A|vo cycop001 1903001 chongyun 12.ogg}} '''Chongyun:''' Hmm, it's hard to refuse when you put it that way...
:{{DIcon}} Let's both drink it. If you lose control, I'll be sure to take care of you. ''(Unlocks [[Sudden Discomfort]] and [[The Bottom of Things]])''
:{{DIcon}} Just let me drink it alone. ''(Unlocks [[Ever Deeper]])''
:{{A|vo cycop001 1903001 unclejia 12.ogg}} '''Uncle Jia:''' Alright, here it is! Please drink it slowly.
:{{Black Screen|''After finishing the drink...''}}
:{{A|vo cycop001 1903001 unclejia 13.ogg}} '''Uncle Jia:''' Haha! Yes, that's it, you did great! You two may enter now.
{{Dialogue End}}

====Lu Zheng and Dandan====
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Talk to Lu Zheng)
:{{A|vo cycop001 1903003 dandan 01.ogg}} '''[[Dandan]]:''' This is all your fault! This place nearly scared me to death!
:{{A|vo cycop001 1903003 luzheng 01.ogg}} '''Lu Zheng:''' Alright, alright, don't lose your temper. We're leaving now, okay?

:{{A|vo cycop001 1903003 chongyun 05.ogg}} '''Chongyun:''' N—No, we're not taking you anywhere. I am just asking you to show us—
:{{A|vo cycop001 1903003 dandan 07.ogg}} '''Dandan:''' Ugh, no, forget it!
:{{A|vo cycop001 1903003 luzheng 03.ogg}} '''Lu Zheng:''' Alright, that's enough. Listen, if you keep talking like that, she might actually end up believing in that nonsense.
:{{A|vo cycop001 1903003 luzheng 04.ogg}} '''Lu Zheng:''' Can't you see she's terrified enough already? You can go find whatever strange things you're looking for on your own.
:{{A|vo cycop001 1903003 chongyun 06.ogg}} '''Chongyun:''' My apologies, I didn't mean to frighten her.
:{{DIcon}} He's quite the serious exorcist.
:{{A|vo cycop001 1903003 chongyun 07.ogg}} '''Chongyun:''' Yes, I'm just trying to hunt the evil spirit you mentioned to prevent it from hurting anyone.
:{{A|vo cycop001 1903003 luzheng 05.ogg}} '''Lu Zheng:''' Isn't it a bit strange for an exorcist to come to the Test of Courage looking for evil spirits?
:{{A|vo cycop001 1903003 luzheng 06.ogg}} '''Lu Zheng:''' Oh... I think I get it now. But we didn't say anything about a ghost or spirit. I think you misunderstood us.
:{{A|vo cycop001 1903003 luzheng 07.ogg}} '''Lu Zheng:''' I brought my girlfriend here to have some fun, but instead, she got frightened by all this spooky atmosphere. Now we'll just have to go home.
:{{A|vo cycop001 1903003 luzheng 08.ogg}} '''Lu Zheng:''' *sigh* I'm not too sure what you're looking for, but we did see some dark shadows making strange noises.
:{{A|vo cycop001 1903003 chongyun 08.ogg}} '''Chongyun:''' Thank you very much. That's very helpful.
:{{Black Screen|''The couple leaves.''}}
:{{A|vo cycop001 1903003 chongyun 09.ogg}} '''Chongyun:''' Well, you heard it. It seems something unusual is going on here.
:{{A|vo cycop001 1903003 chongyun 10.ogg}} '''Chongyun:''' But why would they ever want to come here if they get scared so easily?
:{{DIcon}} The point isn't getting scared, it's relying on each other in the face of fear.
:{{A|vo cycop001 1903003 chongyun 11.ogg}} '''Chongyun:''' Interesting... I have never had any fear of evil spirits, so perhaps I'm unable to understand their feelings.
:{{A|vo cycop001 1903003 chongyun 12.ogg}} '''Chongyun:''' It's amazing that you're able to pick up on that. Good thing I brought you as my partner!
:{{A|vo cycop001 1903003 chongyun 13.ogg}} '''Chongyun:''' Anyway, let's keep searching the area.

:{{A|vo cycop001 1903005 chaner 02.ogg}} '''Chan'er:''' Seriously, just leave me alone!
:{{A|vo cycop001 1903005 junjun 01.ogg}} '''Junjun:''' Why must you be so obstinate?

:{{A|vo cycop001 1903005 chongyun 01.ogg}} '''Chongyun:''' Stop! Not a step closer!
:{{A|vo cycop001 1903005 chongyun 02.ogg}} '''Chongyun:''' Don't be afraid! I'll exorcise it right now!

:{{A|vo cycop001 1903005 chaner 06.ogg}} '''Chan'er:''' And now that we're finally here, you don't wanna go anywhere, and you just wanna hang around the entrance. What's the point in that?
:{{A|vo cycop001 1903005 junjun 05.ogg}} '''Junjun:''' Alright, fine! I was just about to walk in with you...

'''''Test of Courage''''' is an [[Event Quest]] during the [[Akitsu Kimodameshi]] Event.

==Steps==
# Go to the [[Yashiro Commission]] to ask about the Test of Courage
# Talk to [[Kamisato Ayato|Ayato]]
# Leave the Yashiro Commission
# Go to the site of the Test of Courage
# Ask the member of staff
# Pick a partner out of the three contestants
# Begin the first round of the Test of Courage
# Complete the first round of the Test of Courage
# Return to the site of the Test of Courage
# Help [[Itto]] scare people
# Follow the people that ran away

==Gameplay Notes==
* During the ''Test of Courage'' step, the party will be limited to only the Traveler, and the chosen partner will follow behind the player. Some functions, such as [[Normal Attack]], [[Jump]], and [[Co-Op Mode]] will be disabled.
** The player can get separated from their partner during this quest. When this happens, '''"You get separated from your partner during the Test of Courage"''' text will appear on screen and the player will be brought back near the [[Hitomi (Inazuma)|Shrine Maiden]], restarting the quest with their chosen partner.

:{{A|vo sdeq001 47 heizou 05.ogg}} '''Shikanoin Heizou:''' Okay, I see...
:{{A|vo sdeq001 47 heizou 06.ogg}} '''Shikanoin Heizou:''' I only found the two of you passed out here when I arrived. There was no one else around.
:{{A|vo sdeq001 47 heizou 07.ogg}} '''Shikanoin Heizou:''' What happened? Tell me all the details.
:{{Black Screen|You tell Heizou everything that just happened...}}
:{{A|vo sdeq001 47 heizou 08.ogg}} '''Shikanoin Heizou:''' As I suspected, there appears to be something more behind this Test of Courage event.
:{{A|vo sdeq001 47 heizou 09.ogg}} '''Shikanoin Heizou:''' But let's get back to your original question, I haven't told you the reason I'm here.
:{{A|vo sdeq001 47 heizou 10.ogg}} '''Shikanoin Heizou:''' The truth is, I was commissioned to come here for an investigation.
:{{A|vo sdeq001 47 paimon 12.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You were... commissioned?
:{{A|vo sdeq001 47 heizou 11.ogg}} '''Shikanoin Heizou:''' That's right. Some time ago, a peculiar game was discovered on the beach.
:{{A|vo sdeq001 47 paimon 13.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' A peculiar game on the beach... Ohh, could it be the Akitsu Yuugei game that Ei mentioned?
:{{A|vo sdeq001 47 heizou 12.ogg}} '''Shikanoin Heizou:''' Ah, so you've heard of it...
:{{A|vo sdeq001 47 heizou 13.ogg}} '''Shikanoin Heizou:''' The game quietly appeared some time ago and has since attracted some players. Apparently, it's very interesting.
:{{A|vo sdeq001 47 heizou 14.ogg}} '''Shikanoin Heizou:''' There was no one on the beach other than visitors and tourists when the game appeared. Imagine it like this: a stall suddenly appears on the street with no owner...
:{{A|vo sdeq001 47 heizou 15.ogg}} '''Shikanoin Heizou:''' And stranger yet, it could operate normally without anyone supervising it. People at the beach can start the game simply by talking to the Bulletin Board...
:{{A|vo sdeq001 47 paimon 14.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Could it be run by... ghosts?
:{{A|vo sdeq001 47 heizou 16.ogg}} '''Shikanoin Heizou:''' Some tourists started to say that, and the rumor began to spread, until it became a full-blown ghost story. The further that story spread, the more plausible it seemed, causing people to be unwilling to go anywhere near the beach.
:{{A|vo sdeq001 47 heizou 17.ogg}} '''Shikanoin Heizou:''' The [[Tenryou Commission]] wanted to close the beach in order to investigate the situation and dispel the rumors, but before they could do anything, the Yashiro Commission organized the Test of Courage event here.
:{{A|vo sdeq001 47 heizou 18.ogg}} '''Shikanoin Heizou:''' People that were initially scared by the rumors began to believe that the "beach game" was actually a preview event planned by the Yashiro Commission for the Test of Courage, so visitors have gradually returned again.
:{{A|vo sdeq001 47 heizou 19.ogg}} '''Shikanoin Heizou:''' But I'm quite positive that the game never had anything to do with the Yashiro Commission...
:{{A|vo sdeq001 47 paimon 15.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wait, so the Yashiro Commission were fully aware of all the spooky stuff going on, but they still decided to hold their event here?
:{{A|vo sdeq001 47 paimon 16.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' But... Ayato must be one of the smartest guys we know. What the heck was he thinking!?
:{{A|vo sdeq001 47 heizou 20.ogg}} '''Shikanoin Heizou:''' Who knows? But I'd rather trust tangible evidence than speculate on his thoughts.
:{{A|vo sdeq001 47 heizou 21.ogg}} '''Shikanoin Heizou:''' As for my commission, apparently someone reported that they found themselves trapped for hours on the beach while playing the game.
:{{A|vo sdeq001 47 heizou 22.ogg}} '''Shikanoin Heizou:''' According to his own account, he kept returning to the same location no matter which way he went, and even though his friends were nearby, they couldn't see him.
:{{A|vo sdeq001 47 paimon 17.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ah, that sounds so scary!
:{{A|vo sdeq001 47 heizou 23.ogg}} '''Shikanoin Heizou:''' Even though it was obvious that he wasn't telling me the whole story, the testimonies of his friends did validate that what he said actually occurred.
:{{A|vo sdeq001 47 heizou 24.ogg}} '''Shikanoin Heizou:''' On top of that, it was also this very incident that led to all the ghost rumors. No one dared to go near the beach until the Yashiro Commission announced the Test of Courage...
:{{A|vo sdeq001 47 heizou 25.ogg}} '''Shikanoin Heizou:''' Who set up the game on the beach? And why did the Yashiro Commission help them cover it up?
:{{A|vo sdeq001 47 heizou 26.ogg}} '''Shikanoin Heizou:''' I need to uncover the truth, so I'm here to investigate.
:{{A|vo sdeq001 47 heizou 27.ogg}} '''Shikanoin Heizou:''' Anyway, don't mind me. Working together will only raise suspicion, so I'll undertake my own investigation for the time being.
:{{A|vo sdeq001 47 heizou 28.ogg}} '''Shikanoin Heizou:''' However, please proceed with caution. Based on my observations, most people are still unaware of anything happening here. Telling people that something's amiss might cause quite a stir.
{{Dialogue End}}

==Steps==
# Take [[Teucer]] out to the toy store
# Talk to Teucer
# Bring Teucer to [[Wanmin Restaurant]]
# Talk to Teucer
# Bring Teucer to the wharf
#* [[Co-Op Mode]] is disabled from this step onwards
# Talk to Teucer<!--anchor-->
# Talk to Teucer<!--fish stall-->
# Talk to Teucer<!--boat-->
# Bring Teucer to where [[Tartaglia|Childe]] is
# Complete the [[Treasure Hoarder]]'s test by obtaining the treasure
#* Claim the treasure within 80 seconds
#* If the player fails the challenge, talk to [[Slippery Wu]] and restart the challenge
# Talk to the member of the Treasure Hoarders
# Go to Childe's location to look for Teucer
# Defeat all the [[Fatui]] recruits
#* Wave 1: {{Enemy List|Fatui Skirmisher - Electrohammer Vanguard; Fatui Skirmisher - Pyroslinger Bracer; Fatui Skirmisher - Cryogunner Legionnaire}}
#* Wave 2: {{Enemy List|Fatui Skirmisher - Anemoboxer Vanguard; Fatui Skirmisher - Pyroslinger Bracer; Fatui Skirmisher - Hydrogunner Legionnaire}}

==Gameplay Notes==
* If the {{Quest|Home Lies Over the Ocean}} is active, complete the delivery of the letter to be able to bring Teucer to the wharf.
* There is some randomness involved with the negotiation. Acceptable values may vary.
** The lowest amount that can be negotiated for is roughly:
*** '''[[Granny Shan]]:''' ~7,500 Mora
*** '''[[Chef Mao]]:''' ~7,000 Mora
** After haggling, the player may keep the remaining Mora given by Childe. This bag of Mora can be exchanged for regular Mora with [[Ekaterina]].

:{{A|vo gzlq002 18 tartaglia 17.ogg}} '''Childe:''' Now, come at me, you lot.

:{{A|vo gzlq002 19 tartaglia 01.ogg}} '''Childe:''' Well then. Do you all understand what I said earlier?
:{{A|vo gzlq002 19 fatuuisoldier 01.ogg}} '''Fatui Recruits:''' Yes, sir!
:{{A|vo gzlq002 19 tartaglia 02.ogg}} '''Childe:''' Excellent. And, you all almost managed to get me limbered up.
:{{A|vo gzlq002 19 tartaglia 03.ogg}} '''Childe:''' In other words...
:{{A|vo gzlq002 19 tartaglia 04.ogg}} '''Childe:''' You have done well — for new recruits.
:{{A|vo gzlq002 19 fatuuisoldier 02.ogg}} '''Fatui Recruits:''' Thank you, Lord Harbinger!
:{{A|vo gzlq002 19 tartaglia 05.ogg}} '''Childe:''' Alright, hush now.
:{{A|vo gzlq002 19 tartaglia 06.ogg}} '''Childe:''' Now, then. I wish you all glorious victory — for Snezhnaya, for Her Majesty the Tsaritsa, and for yourselves.
:{{A|vo gzlq002 19 tartaglia 07.ogg}} '''Childe:''' Dismissed!
:;(The Fatui leave)
:{{A|vo gzlq002 19 teucer 01.ogg}} '''Teucer:''' Brother! You were amazing!
:{{A|vo gzlq002 19 tartaglia 08.ogg}} '''Childe:''' Oh, Teucer! What in the world are you doing here?
:{{A|vo gzlq002 19 tartaglia 09.ogg}} '''Childe:''' There I was thinking that the Traveler had taken you to play at [[Wangshu Inn]], haha!
:{{A|vo gzlq002 19 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yikes, that's some terrible acting.
:{{DIcon}} You really did get stronger.
:{{DIcon}} That was a good showing.
:{{A|vo gzlq002 19 tartaglia 10.ogg}} '''Childe:''' Haha. I told you, didn't I? I never pass on an opportunity to improve my strength.
:{{A|vo gzlq002 19 tartaglia 11.ogg}} '''Childe:''' I'm not the man I was when we first met.
:{{DIcon}} You didn't go all out, though.
::{{A|vo gzlq002 19 tartaglia 12a.ogg}} '''Childe:''' By that, I assume you mean that I didn't use the [[Foul Legacy Transformation]], yes?
:{{DIcon}} Didn't see your black armor anywhere.
::{{A|vo gzlq002 19 tartaglia 12b.ogg}} '''Childe:''' Haha. You must mean my Foul Legacy Transformation.
:{{A|vo gzlq002 19 tartaglia 13.ogg}} '''Childe:''' It puts a great strain on my body, so it's best saved for crucial moments.
:{{A|vo gzlq002 19 tartaglia 14.ogg}} '''Childe:''' I still haven't fully recovered from the injuries I suffered when I used it at the [[Golden House]].
:{{A|vo gzlq002 19 tartaglia 15.ogg}} '''Childe:''' Anyway, I'm no [[Signora]] — I don't use lethal force against recruits, come on now...
:{{A|vo gzlq002 19 teucer 02.ogg}} '''Teucer:''' The Foul Legacy Transformation? Does it make you stronger than Mr. Cyclops?
:{{A|vo gzlq002 19 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You could say that.
:{{A|vo gzlq002 19 teucer 03.ogg}} '''Teucer:''' I wanna learn to fight too. I wanna be cool like you!
:{{A|vo gzlq002 19 tartaglia 16.ogg}} '''Childe:''' Now, Teucer. Fighting isn't about looking cool. You can only continue to get stronger if you know the reason why you're fighting.
:{{A|vo gzlq002 19 tartaglia 17.ogg}} '''Childe:''' I can teach you. But think carefully, first. Why do you want to fight?
:{{A|vo gzlq002 19 teucer 04.ogg}} '''Teucer:''' I...
:{{A|vo gzlq002 19 tartaglia 18.ogg}} '''Childe:''' Hmm?
:{{A|vo gzlq002 19 teucer 05.ogg}} '''Teucer:''' I... I want to protect sister Tonia.
:{{A|vo gzlq002 19 tartaglia 19.ogg}} '''Childe:''' That's a good answer, Teucer.
:{{A|vo gzlq002 19 tartaglia 20.ogg}} '''Childe:''' When I return to Snezhnaya, I will start teaching you fighting techniques. Then, you'll have to protect Tonia for me. How does that sound?
:{{A|vo gzlq002 19 teucer 06.ogg}} '''Teucer:''' Hehe... Leave it to me!
:{{A|vo gzlq002 19 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You know, Teucer's a good kid when he's not being so stubborn.
:{{DIcon}} Agreed.
:{{DIcon}} Protecting family is an admirable motivation.
:{{A|vo gzlq002 19 tartaglia 21.ogg}} '''Childe:''' You've had a nice long time here in Liyue, haven't you, Teucer? Isn't it about time that you took the boat back home?
:{{A|vo gzlq002 19 teucer 07.ogg}} '''Teucer:''' But, but... but you've been so busy, and we didn't get any time to play together yet...
:{{A|vo gzlq002 19 tartaglia 22a.ogg}} {{A|vo gzlq002 19 tartaglia 22b.ogg}} '''Childe:''' Teucer, you know I'm very busy at work... And hasn't it been fun traveling all over the place with {{MC|him|her|mc=1}}, a proper traveler?
:{{A|vo gzlq002 19 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' (He's just worried he won't be able to keep up the toy seller act forever...)
:{{A|vo gzlq002 19 teucer 08.ogg}} '''Teucer:''' W—Well, how about this? If you just do one little thing for me, I'll be a good boy and go back home!
:{{A|vo gzlq002 19 tartaglia 23.ogg}} '''Childe:''' Oh dear, who taught this little devil to bargain... *chuckle* Alright. What'll it be?
:{{A|vo gzlq002 19 teucer 09.ogg}} '''Teucer:''' Take me to visit the Institute of Toy Research!
:{{A|vo gzlq002 19 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' ...Do you think he means that ruin that the Millelith was telling us about? The one where all those Ruin Guards were coming from?
:{{DIcon}} A reasonable wish.
:{{DIcon}} A risky wish.
:{{A|vo gzlq002 19 tartaglia 24.ogg}} '''Childe:''' Done deal. After all, you've come all this way for me, Teucer...
:{{A|vo gzlq002 19 tartaglia 25.ogg}} '''Childe:''' As your brother, it's only right for me to grant you one last wish before you leave.
:{{A|vo gzlq002 19 teucer 10.ogg}} '''Teucer:''' Exactly! Hee-hee.
:{{A|vo gzlq002 19 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Um, are you sure this is a good idea? It doesn't seem like the best place for kids...
:{{A|vo gzlq002 19 teucer 11a.ogg}}<!--{{A|vo gzlq002 19 teucer 11b.ogg}}--> '''Teucer:''' You should come along too, Traveler! This time, it's Teucer's turn to take you sightseeing!
:{{A|vo gzlq002 19 tartaglia 26.ogg}} '''Childe:''' Let me think... Yes, the Institute of Toy Research is not far at all from {{Color|buzzword|Lingju Pass}}. Now, Traveler... you're not the sort of person who would disappoint a kid now, are you?
:{{A|vo gzlq002 19 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ugh, the brothers are ganging up on us again... Fine! {{Traveler}} and Paimon will go.
{{Dialogue End}}

==Dialogue==
{{Quest Description|[[Thoma]] heads to [[Komore Teahouse]] first. He seems to be preparing something...}}
===Thanks for Your Hospitality!===
{{Dialogue Start}}
:{{A|vo tmcop001 1911301 thoma 01.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' Oh, welcome! It must've been a while since you were last here.
:{{A|vo tmcop001 1911301 thoma 02.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' Since it's about time to eat, I couldn't resist whipping up a little something for us.
:{{A|vo tmcop001 1911301 thoma 03.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' So please, help yourself. Hope you enjoy it.
:{{A|vo tmcop001 1911301 thoma 04.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' And... I can't claim to compete with the likes of [[Uyuu Restaurant]]'s chef, but I think I did alright.
:{{A|vo tmcop001 1911301 thoma 05.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' What's wrong? You look shocked!
:{{DIcon}} After that hot pot game, I figured self-sabotage was your cooking style...
:{{A|vo tmcop001 1911301 thoma 06.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' Whoa, whoa, there's been a misunderstanding!
:{{A|vo tmcop001 1911301 thoma 07.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' I admit, I may have added a few weird things to that hot pot. But it was just a game!
:{{A|vo tmcop001 1911301 thoma 08.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' For normal meals, I cook normal dishes. I am a housekeeper, after all — wouldn't have gotten very far without a few culinary skills!
:{{A|vo tmcop001 1911301 thoma 09.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' Anyway, please dig in. I won't get the chance to cook for you like this every day.
:{{Black Screen|''You promptly polish off everything on the table.''}}
:{{A|vo tmcop001 1911301 thoma 10.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' Well, seems like my cooking has your seal of approval.
:{{DIcon}} Thanks for your hospitality.
:{{DIcon}} It was delicious!
:{{A|vo tmcop001 1911301 thoma 11.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' You're welcome. When you're out adventuring on your own, you've got to maintain your quality of life.
:{{A|vo tmcop001 1911301 thoma 12.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' Take your cape, for example. I definitely see one or two loose threads there.
:{{A|vo tmcop001 1911301 thoma 13.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' If you ignore them, sooner or later the whole seam is going to come undone, and then you'll have a really tough time mending it.
:{{A|vo tmcop001 1911301 thoma 14.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' Let me sew it up for you later — I'm pretty handy with a needle and thread.
:{{A|vo tmcop001 1911301 thoma 15.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' Speaking of housekeeping — I can say with confidence that you won't find anyone as handy around the home as I am.
:{{A|vo tmcop001 1911301 thoma 16.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' Cleaning, cooking, and mending are among my greatest strengths. You can always feel free to hand me jobs like this.
:{{DIcon}} Housekeeping, huh...
:{{DIcon}} If this is your strength...
:{{A|vo tmcop001 1911301 thoma 17.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' Hmm? What is it?
:{{DIcon}} You could run a housekeeping class for the Yashiro Commission!
:{{DIcon}} This is how you can start winning more respect!
:{{A|vo tmcop001 1911301 thoma 18.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' Wait... you're suggesting I teach housekeeping to the Yashiro Commission staff?
:{{A|vo tmcop001 1911301 thoma 19.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' I'm not sure it would work... I doubt anyone would sign up for that class.
:{{A|vo tmcop001 1911301 thoma 20.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' I just don't think it's realistic to change people's perception of me by showcasing my housekeeping skills... I'm surprised that whole matter is still troubling you, actually.
:{{A|vo tmcop001 1911301 thoma 21.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' With that being said, finding an opportunity to share some housekeeping wisdom with the Yashiro Commission would certainly be in people's best interests.
:{{A|vo tmcop001 1911301 thoma 22.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' Life maintenance is important. You have to look after yourself if you're going to bring your best self to your work.
:{{A|vo tmcop001 1911301 thoma 23.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' You know what? Let's give it a try! But first, how do you think I should promote it?
:{{DIcon}} We need to get out there and spread the word.
:;(Proceed to [[#Branch 1|Branch 1]])
:{{DIcon}} Let's keep it within the Yashiro Commission.
:;(Proceed to [[#Branch 2|Branch 2]])
{{Dialogue End}}

===Branch 1===
{{Dialogue Start}}
:{{DIcon}} We need to get out there and spread the word.
:{{A|vo tmcop001 1911301 thoma 24.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' You think so? In that case, I need to prepare.
:{{A|vo tmcop001 1911301 thoma 25.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' If I'm going to end up with a lot of students, I should make sure I have all the supplies I need for the class.
:{{A|vo tmcop001 1911301 thoma 26.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' Tables and chairs I can sort out easily enough, but I'll need to stock up on materials and ingredients for the textiles and cookery segments...
:{{DIcon}} I can handle that.
:{{A|vo tmcop001 1911301 thoma 27.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' Are you sure? That'd be greatly appreciated. Umm, let's see... to start with, I'll be needing {{Color|buzzword|Lavender Melon|link=Lavender Melon}}, {{Color|buzzword|Fowl|link=Fowl}}, and {{Color|buzzword|Flour|link=Flour}}.
:{{A|vo tmcop001 1911301 thoma 28.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' Once we have all our essentials, we can figure out the next steps.
:{{A|vo tmcop001 1911301 thoma 29.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' I really hope everything goes smoothly...
:;(Proceed to [[Start Spreadin' the News]])
{{Dialogue End}}

===Branch 2===
{{Dialogue Start}}
:{{DIcon}} Let's keep it within the Yashiro Commission.
:{{A|vo tmcop001 1911301 thoma 30.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' Alright then. If we're only opening this up to Yashiro Commission staff, it shouldn't take too much preparation.
:{{A|vo tmcop001 1911301 thoma 31.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' Tables and chairs I can sort out easily enough, but we'll need to think some more about how exactly to promote this.
:{{A|vo tmcop001 1911301 thoma 32.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' Let's start by asking around at the Yashiro Commission headquarters.
:;(Proceed to [[Small-Scale Changes]])
{{Dialogue End}}

:{{A|vo yqeq113 3 fischl 04.ogg}} '''Fischl:''' Hmph, then I shall extend to you the honor of meeting the Kaiser and Kaiserin with me on a future occasion.
:{{A|vo yqeq113 3 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Really? Hey {{Traveler}}, we should go too!
:{{A|vo yqeq113 3 kazuha 03.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' Now that you mention it, it has been a while since I visited a friend's house. I shall gladly oblige.
:{{A|vo yqeq113 3 kazuha 04.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' Oh, but shouldn't we bring some sort of gift?
:{{A|vo yqeq113 3 oz 04.ogg}} '''Oz:''' Those two are very kind and understanding, so please don't worry about that. Just bring yourselves.
:{{A|vo yqeq113 3 mona 05.ogg}} '''Mona:''' You seriously have to try her mom's cold cut platter. It's her specialty, or something — anyway, it's simply delightful!
:{{A|vo yqeq113 3 oz 05.ogg}} '''Oz:''' Not to interrupt, but perhaps we should start working on the puzzle at hand? Ever since I entered this place, I have found myself most preoccupied with that ornament...
:{{A|vo yqeq113 3 mona 06.ogg}} '''Mona:''' Oh, right.

;(Touch the strange ornament)
:{{A|vo yqeq113 3 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Whoa!

;(Enter the domain)
:{{A|vo yqeq113 4 mona 01.ogg}} '''Mona:''' Astrologists are able to understand the most complex signs among the stars. And because of this, we are not allowed to show any arrogance.
:{{A|vo yqeq113 4 mona 02.ogg}} '''Mona:''' If one believes that astrology grants them unlimited power, they will face banishment by the stars.
:{{A|vo yqeq113 4 mona 03.ogg}} '''Mona:''' In the past, I was ignorant enough to think that I understood all fates in the universe.
:{{A|vo yqeq113 4 mona 04.ogg}} '''Mona:''' Maybe it was some form of punishment... but I became lost. I couldn't see the stars any longer.

:{{A|vo yqeq113 4 mona 05.ogg}} '''Mona:''' "You should not get confused. If you should become confused one day, not even astrology will be able to help you then."
:{{A|vo yqeq113 4 mona 06.ogg}} '''Mona:''' That's what the [[Barbeloth|old hag]] said. We astrologists can't predict our own fate.
:{{A|vo yqeq113 4 mona 07.ogg}} '''Mona:''' But today, those words seem to carry a different meaning.

:{{A|vo yqeq113 4 mona 08.ogg}} '''Mona:''' I understand now that people won't always follow a beacon's guiding light. Even though the way forward may be dark and dangerous, they will still resolutely forge ahead.

:{{A|vo yqeq113 4 mona 09.ogg}} '''Mona:''' Fate is called such precisely because it cannot be altered or reversed.

:{{A|vo yqeq113 4 mona 10.ogg}} '''Mona:''' I understand the governing laws of the universe, and have glimpsed secrets between heaven and earth. Observing it is enough for me, there's no need to force it to change.

:{{A|vo yqeq113 4 mona 11.ogg}} '''Mona:''' There are no perfect legends, and no heroes that can save everyone. Instead of dwelling on my helplessness, what I should do...

:{{A|vo yqeq113 4 mona 12.ogg}} '''Mona:''' ...is seize my own destiny.

:{{A|vo yqeq113 4 mona 13.ogg}} '''Mona:''' ...Looks like it's coming to an end again.

;(Fall through the floor)
:{{A|vo yqeq113 5 fischl 01.ogg}} '''Fischl:''' What a magnificent view...
:{{A|vo yqeq113 5 oz 01.ogg}} '''Oz:''' Lady Megistus, I believe this is the firmest evidence yet of your immense genius. You truly are the greatest archmage in the history of the Immernachtreich.
:{{A|vo yqeq113 5 mona 01.ogg}} '''Mona:''' Thank you, although the Immernachtreich really doesn't have that much of a history...
:{{A|vo yqeq113 5 kazuha 01.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' ...Stars like diamonds, and the moon like a pearl. This is the most brilliant night sky I have ever beheld.
:{{A|vo yqeq113 5 xinyan 01.ogg}} '''Xinyan:''' It's beautiful...
:{{A|vo yqeq113 5 xinyan 02.ogg}} '''Xinyan:''' To call up such a mirage, Mona must have a vast and boundless sea of stars in her heart.
:{{A|vo yqeq113 5 mona 02.ogg}} '''Mona:''' ...
:{{DIcon}} Mona, what's the matter?
:{{A|vo yqeq113 5 mona 03.ogg}} '''Mona:''' ...I'm just thinking, these must be the things that we aspire to.
:{{A|vo yqeq113 5 mona 04.ogg}} '''Mona:''' This night sky is incredibly beautiful. In fact, I might go so far as to say it's even more beautiful than what I usually see in divinations.
:{{A|vo yqeq113 5 mona 05.ogg}} '''Mona:''' All the stars are in their rightful place.
:{{A|vo yqeq113 5 mona 06.ogg}} '''Mona:''' ...This is definitely my mirage. Only here can I see extraordinary sights like these.
:{{A|vo yqeq113 5 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Extraordinary? Why do you say that?
:{{A|vo yqeq113 5 mona 07.ogg}} '''Mona:''' You know, the night sky of Teyvat is truly marvelous. All the answers in the world seem to have been hidden within.
:{{A|vo yqeq113 5 mona 08.ogg}} '''Mona:''' "When is my missing son going to be found?"
:{{A|vo yqeq113 5 mona 09.ogg}} '''Mona:''' "Do they love me or not?"
:{{A|vo yqeq113 5 mona 10.ogg}} '''Mona:''' "Will I ever recover?"
:{{A|vo yqeq113 5 mona 11.ogg}} '''Mona:''' As your stars move across the sky, they record all your life events in their path. And among all the people in the world, a considerable number will see their stars deviate from their path.
:{{A|vo yqeq113 5 mona 12.ogg}} '''Mona:''' When your stars are on track, it means you will be healthy, happy, and at peace.
:{{A|vo yqeq113 5 mona 13.ogg}} '''Mona:''' Conversely, if your stars go off track, everything will get worse.
:{{A|vo yqeq113 5 mona 14.ogg}} '''Mona:''' The starry sky in my divinations would never look as perfect as this. Some stars would lose their way, and others would fall...
:{{A|vo yqeq113 5 mona 15.ogg}} '''Mona:''' ...I wish everyone could be happy, and stay on track.
:{{A|vo yqeq113 5 mona 16.ogg}} '''Mona:''' To this end, I offer advice and tell the truth.
:{{A|vo yqeq113 5 mona 17.ogg}} '''Mona:''' I know it's useless. All fates are already revealed in the night sky, with mine, too, just another among them. I can't change anything.
:{{A|vo yqeq113 5 mona 18.ogg}} '''Mona:''' Even so... outside of astrology, outside of the words of truth, I still cling to the wisp of an irrational fantasy.
:{{A|vo yqeq113 5 mona 19.ogg}} '''Mona:''' We must all live within the confines of reality, but... call me presumptuous, but I still believe in miracles.
:{{A|vo yqeq113 5 mona 20.ogg}} '''Mona:''' In this vast sea of stars, there are stars for you, for me, for everybody.
:{{A|vo yqeq113 5 mona 21.ogg}} '''Mona:''' What are the chances of one star encountering another? Are these encounters not the most wonderful miracles in all of destiny? ...I don't know.
:{{A|vo yqeq113 5 mona 22.ogg}} '''Mona:''' But within Teyvat, the stars in the sky will always have a place for us. Even if astrology is resolutely rational, fate remains arbitrary, cruel, but romantic.
:{{A|vo yqeq113 5 mona 23.ogg}} '''Mona:''' ...
:{{DIcon}} Mona, you seem to have been deep in thought...
::{{DIcon}} Have you found the answer?
:{{A|vo yqeq113 5 mona 24.ogg}} '''Mona:''' ...I think I have figured out what those stars are hiding.
:{{A|vo yqeq113 5 mona 25.ogg}} '''Mona:''' "Now, I will seize my own destiny."

;(Capture the star)
;(A cutscene plays)
::'''Mona:''' There was a transparent bird made of crystal
::'''Mona:''' It was beautiful and fragile, and could sing the most beautiful songs
::'''Mona:''' But since mortals couldn't even see it, they believed it to be a trick
::'''Mona:''' How could a transparent bird possibly exist, let alone sing?
::'''Mona:''' When the bird heard that, it flapped its wings
::'''Mona:''' And flew across mountains and seas
::'''Mona:''' All the way to the night sky, where it turned into a star
::'''Mona:''' Its brilliance was so dazzling that it illuminated everyone
::'''Mona:''' It allowed all those that could see it to follow its light through the dark night
::'''Mona:''' To sail through the seas under the guidance of the stars
::'''Mona:''' It was born in wisdom, but trapped in ignorance
::'''Mona:''' It has never voiced a complaint, for this is its destiny
::'''Mona:''' Guiding people to see their destinies is the very meaning of its existence
:;(Cutscene ends)
:{{A|vo yqeq113 6 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' We're back here again. So... Are we completely out of the mirage?
:{{A|vo yqeq113 6 mona 01.ogg}} '''Mona:''' How strange...
:{{A|vo yqeq113 6 mona 02.ogg}} '''Mona:''' My mirage didn't contain any hints on the [[Fatui]] or the machine... Does that mean they had nothing to do with these mirages after all?
:{{A|vo yqeq113 6 mona 03.ogg}} '''Mona:''' Or perhaps these mirages are a mere consequence, and not part of a process at all?
:{{A|vo yqeq113 6 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Umm, Paimon's lost...
:{{A|vo yqeq113 6 mona 04.ogg}} '''Mona:''' I mean, these mirages were not steps towards solving the mystery, but rather a direct effect of whatever is going on.
:{{A|vo yqeq113 6 mona 05.ogg}} '''Mona:''' Someone did something to bring the mirages into being. As they were just passive side products, it was natural that they couldn't provide us with any useful information.
:{{A|vo yqeq113 6 xinyan 01.ogg}} '''Xinyan:''' In other words, those mirages were only about ourselves.
:{{A|vo yqeq113 6 fischl 01.ogg}} '''Fischl:''' Hmm, pure materializations of ourselves... Interesting.
:{{A|vo yqeq113 6 kazuha 01.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' ...
:{{A|vo yqeq113 6 kazuha 02.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' Everyone, maybe we should go back to where this whole thing began.
:{{A|vo yqeq113 6 kazuha 03.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' During our first day on the island, {{Traveler}} and I checked out the Fatui camp together. We found a strange machine there, as well as some disoriented Fatui.
:{{DIcon}} This is correct.
:{{A|vo yqeq113 6 kazuha 04.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' The researcher who spoke to us claimed that the machine was just a Fatui industrial invention. He even promised to not disturb us.
:{{A|vo yqeq113 6 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Right right, and the cappy-cap guy looked half asleep the entire time. He kept talking nonsense!
:{{A|vo yqeq113 6 kazuha 05.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' I wonder, is it possible that "madness" and "mirages" are two different outcomes of the machine's influence?
:{{A|vo yqeq113 6 kazuha 06.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' If so, everything can be traced back to that damaged machine — except for the difference in how it affects people. This, I believe, is caused by differences between the affected people themselves.
:{{A|vo yqeq113 6 mona 06.ogg}} '''Mona:''' ...!
:{{A|vo yqeq113 6 mona 07.ogg}} '''Mona:''' When you put it that way... it is indeed difficult to distinguish dreams and hallucinations.
:{{A|vo yqeq113 6 mona 08.ogg}} '''Mona:''' So what you're saying is, the device affected us differently because we are different from the Fatui?
:{{A|vo yqeq113 6 kazuha 07.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' Yes, and according to our observations over these past few days, I think... the difference is that we all have stronger willpower.
:{{A|vo yqeq113 6 xinyan 02.ogg}} '''Xinyan:''' ...Yeah, I can get behind that.
:{{A|vo yqeq113 6 xinyan 03.ogg}} '''Xinyan:''' People with strong willpower will hallucinate instead of falling into madness, but those who break too easily can't maintain a stable mirage.
:{{A|vo yqeq113 6 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' In other words, we should go back to the Fatui camp and destroy that machine right away.
:{{A|vo yqeq113 6 fischl 02.ogg}} '''Fischl:''' No, it should be repaired, rather than destroyed.
:{{A|vo yqeq113 6 oz 01.ogg}} '''Oz:''' What mein Fräulein means is that rashly destroying a machine we do not understand may lead to more serious consequences. It would be better to find a way to repair it first.
:{{A|vo yqeq113 6 kazuha 08.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' Right, it pays to be cautious.
:{{A|vo yqeq113 6 mona 09.ogg}} '''Mona:''' If my guess is correct, that machine is capable of influencing the human brain. So we'd better tread carefully.
:{{A|vo yqeq113 6 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So let's go now! There's no time to waste!
{{Dialogue End}}

:{{A|vo xyjeq005 1 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Looks like the ceremony will be held at the main venue. Let's head over and check it out!

:{{A|vo xyjeq005 1 kareena 01.ogg}} '''Kareena:''' ...Thank you all for your excellent performance. And that brings this year's Interdarshan Championship to a close!
:{{A|vo xyjeq005 1 kareena 02.ogg}} '''Kareena:''' Finally, it gives me great pleasure to invite our champion, Kaveh, to the stage to receive his award.
:{{A|vo xyjeq005 1 kareena 03.ogg}} '''Kareena:''' Typically, at this point, we would crown our champion with the diadem as well as presenting them with their award.
:{{A|vo xyjeq005 1 kareena 04.ogg}} '''Kareena:''' However, we have just received word that Kaveh has inherited Sachin's estate, and made the decision to donate it all to charitable causes.

:{{A|vo xyjeq005 1 alae 01.ogg}} '''Alae:''' So much Mora... and he gave it all up?
:{{A|vo xyjeq005 1 kareena 05.ogg}} '''Kareena:''' Kaveh's generosity will give many struggling families the chance to change their lives for the better.
:{{A|vo xyjeq005 1 kareena 06.ogg}} '''Kareena:''' Of course, without the diadem and prize money to present, this makes the award ceremony a little more concise than expected. Would you like to say a few words, Kaveh? I'm sure many of our audience, like myself, are curious to learn why you decided to give all this wealth away.
:{{A|vo xyjeq005 1 kaveh 01.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' I'm... not entirely sure what I should say under these circumstances. I'm glad to have won, even though I'd say luck played a big part in that.

:{{A|vo xyjeq005 1 kaveh 03.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Anyway, this isn't really the time and place for such weighty and complicated topics. So umm... I guess that's all. I'll leave it there, thanks very much.

:{{A|vo xyjeq005 1 kaveh 04.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Alright, I'll take the card. But as for project proposals... Eh, forget it.
:{{A|vo xyjeq005 1 kareena 10.ogg}} '''Kareena:''' In that case, I declare the award ceremony over. Let's give our champion, Kaveh one last big round of applause!
:{{A|vo xyjeq005 1 aissa 01.ogg}} '''Aissa:''' I still don't really get it. That sum of Mora would've been enough for me to live in luxury for my entire life.

:{{A|vo xyjeq005 1 kaveh 05.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' *sigh* Glad that's over. I think I'm quite good at giving speeches, but this one was just so tiring...
:{{A|vo xyjeq005 1 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Do you mean that you're still exhausted from the competition? Honestly, you don't look happy at all... But whatever else happened, you're the champion, you know? Don't you think you should be proud of that?
:{{A|vo xyjeq005 1 kaveh 06.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' I suppose... *sigh* Oh, wait. Cyno said that he wanted the card, didn't he? And now I have it, right here!
:{{A|vo xyjeq005 1 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So you're gonna give it to him? But, if it's a rare one, you should be able to make a tidy sum of Mora off it!

:{{A|vo xyjeq005 1 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Whoa, whoa, this is a super big deal. You should do it yourself! Come on, let's go find Cyno!
:{{A|vo xyjeq005 1 kaveh 08.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Huh? But I was gonna rest for a while longer— hey, hey, stop pulling my hair!

:{{A|vo xyjeq005 3 dehya 03.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' Madam Faruzan here's pretty friendly — when she heard that we were buying clothes, she decided to give us some help.

:{{A|vo xyjeq005 3 faruzan 03.ogg}} '''Faruzan:''' Let's go with a plain fabric as our base, and embroider red and pink flowers on. Oh, and some green leaves...
:{{A|vo xyjeq005 3 dehya 04.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' Wait a sec... You sure that's the latest style? That sounds a lot like what the older folks back home would wear...
:{{A|vo xyjeq005 3 faruzan 04.ogg}} '''Faruzan:''' Don't worry, this style is a timeless classic...
:{{A|vo xyjeq005 3 dehya 05.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' Uhhh, no thanks. This is actually sounding pretty weird.
:{{A|vo xyjeq005 3 nilou 01.ogg}} '''Nilou:''' Wait, wait, wait... Madam Faruzan's right, that style is a classic, and used to be mainstream fashion. But these days, there are some other options, too.
:{{A|vo xyjeq005 3 nilou 02.ogg}} '''Nilou:''' If you don't mind, how about I pick some clothes out for everyone? It's not often that we get to meet up, especially since Candace rarely makes it to Sumeru City. Also, I know a few places where I can get a great bargain!
:{{A|vo xyjeq005 3 candace 01.ogg}} '''Candace:''' Sure, I'm happy to leave it to you.
:{{A|vo xyjeq005 3 faruzan 05.ogg}} '''Faruzan:''' I'll come with you to have a look. One always has to keep on top of what the youth of today are into...
:{{A|vo xyjeq005 3 marwa 01.ogg}} '''Marwa:''' Madam Faruzan? ...Come quick, she's over here!
:{{A|vo xyjeq005 3 faruzan 06.ogg}} '''Faruzan:''' Hmm? Who are you...?
:{{A|vo xyjeq005 3 fawra 01.ogg}} '''Fawara:''' We're new in the Akademiya. We saw all the amazing things you did during the competition... Do you have any classes we could sign up for?
:{{A|vo xyjeq005 3 faruzan 07.ogg}} '''Faruzan:''' Ahem! Of course I do — and you're both very welcome to join.
:{{A|vo xyjeq005 3 marwa 02.ogg}} '''Marwa:''' That's great! We can't wait... Um, what's your area of research? Precision mechanics?
:{{A|vo xyjeq005 3 faruzan 08.ogg}} '''Faruzan:''' ...I'm from Haravatat.
:{{A|vo xyjeq005 3 marwa 03.ogg}} '''Marwa:''' Huh? But you seem like an expert in machines... Wait, sorry, I remember now. You were representing the Haravatat Darshan in the Championship...
:{{A|vo xyjeq005 3 marwa 04.ogg}} '''Marwa:''' Their classes are so boring, though! I'm sorry, Ma'am... let me know if you run any other classes in the future, I'll be there!
:{{A|vo xyjeq005 3 faruzan 09.ogg}} '''Faruzan:''' Hmph! I knew it... What about you? Aren't you going to leave with your friend?
:{{A|vo xyjeq005 3 fawra 02.ogg}} '''Fawara:''' I think you're amazing, Madam Faruzan, and I'd like to learn from you for a while if possible.
:{{A|vo xyjeq005 3 fawra 03.ogg}} '''Fawara:''' I can take the class you're teaching as an option, even though cross-Darshan lessons might be a little tough to arrange... But I look forward to learning from you!
:{{A|vo xyjeq005 3 faruzan 10.ogg}} '''Faruzan:''' I see... you're a good egg, child! Don't worry, study under me, and I promise you you will get the best teaching available!
:{{A|vo xyjeq005 3 fawra 04.ogg}} '''Fawara:''' Thank you so much, Ma'am. Well, I won't disturb you any further. See you in class!
:{{A|vo xyjeq005 3 dehya 06.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' I don't quite understand what happened there, but... congratulations, I think?
:{{A|vo xyjeq005 3 candace 02.ogg}} '''Candace:''' {{Traveler}}, Paimon, would you two like to come and pick out some clothes?
:{{A|vo xyjeq005 3 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Sorry, we can't. We've got a meal with Kaveh later, and we have to check in with all the other contestants before then!
:{{A|vo xyjeq005 3 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh! By the way, have any of you seen Hat Guy or Layla?
:{{A|vo xyjeq005 3 nilou 03.ogg}} '''Nilou:''' I don't know where Hat Guy went... We just saw Layla not too long ago, though.
:{{A|vo xyjeq005 3 nilou 04.ogg}} '''Nilou:''' But she was hanging out with some other Rtawahist students, so we didn't get a chance with speak with her. Are you gonna go and see where she's up to?
:{{A|vo xyjeq005 3 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Rtawahist students... They must be the ones who voted for her to enter the competition, right?

:{{A|vo xyjeq005 5 tighnari 01.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Are you sure you have enough to cover this? Don't blow it all at once.
:{{A|vo xyjeq005 5 kaveh 01.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Don't worry. I budgeted very carefully, and this is well within my means. Anyway, I've lost count of how many times you've treated me. It's high time I returned the favor.
:{{A|vo xyjeq005 5 kaveh 02.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' {{Traveler}}, Paimon, over here!
:{{A|vo xyjeq005 5 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ooh, look at all this! Good food, here we come!
:{{A|vo xyjeq005 5 tighnari 02.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' I heard that you went to see the other contestants. How's everyone doing?
:{{A|vo xyjeq005 5 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Faruzan found herself a student, and Layla's classmates are bowled over by how well she did. We couldn't find Hat Guy, though. Who knows where he's gone.
:{{A|vo xyjeq005 5 kaveh 03.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Alhaitham's gone missing in action, too. Huh. The one time I'm actually in a good enough mood to treat him to a nice meal, he disappears without a trace.
:{{A|vo xyjeq005 5 kaveh 04.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' ...That guy... where the heck could he have gone? I still have questions about that note he left...
:{{A|vo xyjeq005 5 kaveh 05.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Well, whatever. He can do what he wants. Now, let's eat!
:{{Black Screen|You all share a delicious meal...}}
:{{A|vo xyjeq005 5 tighnari 03.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' You shocked me a little when you hurled the diadem to the ground. On further reflection, of course, it made sense, but at the time I was expecting at least some amount of deliberation.
:{{A|vo xyjeq005 5 kaveh 06.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' ...Sachin's voice started talking to me inside my head from the moment I picked it up. I could feel his emotions, too... It was a mix of despair and horror swirling around inside my mind.
:{{A|vo xyjeq005 5 kaveh 07.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' He bombarded me with his ideas relentlessly, like he was trying to brainwash me... It gave me a splitting headache that only got worse as he went on.
:{{A|vo xyjeq005 5 kaveh 08.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Like I was saying at the time, his views are not necessarily completely without value, but if all his research does is lead to misfortune, then we're probably better off without it.
:{{A|vo xyjeq005 5 cyno 01.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' If his forbidden research were to spread in a harmful form, and cause people to suffer, the matra would step in and ban it.
:{{A|vo xyjeq005 5 tighnari 04.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' I think you did the right thing. I suppose another way to approach it would have been to claim that you agreed to inherit his research, but give up the research as soon as you've inherited the wealth. But that wouldn't have been your style.
:{{A|vo xyjeq005 5 tighnari 05.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' I won't comment on his theories or experiments, but I don't believe that he was careless in his choice of candidate... He chose you. That means he knew what he was doing.
:{{A|vo xyjeq005 5 kaveh 09.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Perhaps. I just think that if you accept someone else's things, you should honor their wishes.
:{{A|vo xyjeq005 5 collei 01.ogg}} '''Collei:''' That's a good thing... It means that you have integrity.
:{{A|vo xyjeq005 5 kaveh 10.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Thank you, oh my god, thank you... See, you get me, Collei!
:{{A|vo xyjeq005 5 kaveh 11.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' It's a good thing Alhaitham isn't here right now... He'd be quick to explain why you're wrong.
:{{A|vo xyjeq005 5 collei 02.ogg}} '''Collei:''' Seems like you always include him in the conversation, even when he isn't here...
:{{A|vo xyjeq005 5 tighnari 06.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Yep. No dinner with Kaveh is complete without a few words about Alhaitham.
:{{A|vo xyjeq005 5 cyno 02.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' I sense that Alhaitham has in fact been here with us all along...
:{{A|vo xyjeq005 5 kaveh 12.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' He's here? Where!? Why didn't you tell me?
:{{A|vo xyjeq005 5 cyno 03.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' ...He lives rent-free in each of our hearts.
:{{A|vo xyjeq005 5 tighnari 07.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' ...
:{{A|vo xyjeq005 5 collei 03.ogg}} '''Collei:''' ...
:{{A|vo xyjeq005 5 kaveh 13.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' That was horrifying. It literally sent chills down my spine...
:{{A|vo xyjeq005 5 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Good thing he didn't say that before we started eating. That would've killed the mood in a heartbeat...
:{{A|vo xyjeq005 5 kaveh 14.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Alright, enough about Alhaitham. Tighnari, did you achieve what you wanted out of the Championship?
:{{A|vo xyjeq005 5 tighnari 08.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' I did — in the first round, in fact. Word of mouth proved very effective. I spoke to a handful of people, they told their friends, and so on. Now, a record number of people have signed up to attend the next lecture.
:{{A|vo xyjeq005 5 tighnari 09.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Oh, are you free next month? You should come along. Maybe even say a few words.
:{{A|vo xyjeq005 5 kaveh 15.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' About what? I don't know the first thing about anything Amurta-related.
:{{A|vo xyjeq005 5 tighnari 10.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Just play to your strengths. For instance, you could talk about the distinguishing features of rainforest architecture. Or ask everyone not to chop down too many trees the next time they're building a house...
:{{A|vo xyjeq005 5 kaveh 16.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Oh, well that's no problem. Sure, I'll make time.
:{{A|vo xyjeq005 5 kaveh 17.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Has everyone had enough to eat? I can order more if anyone's still hungry.
:{{A|vo xyjeq005 5 collei 04.ogg}} '''Collei:''' I'm full, thanks!
:{{A|vo xyjeq005 5 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Paimon's super full too! If only we could eat like this every day, hehe!
:{{A|vo xyjeq005 5 kaveh 18.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Yeah, we should do this more often. Work will always be there, but seeing friends is important, too. This is a good restaurant. Let's definitely come here again.
:{{A|vo xyjeq005 5 cyno 04.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Sounds good. We should pick a few other places as backup options, though.
:{{A|vo xyjeq005 5 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' There are other good places around here, too? Don't forget to invite us if you go! There's nothing we love more than good food!

;(Approach Alhaitham in Aaru Village)
:{{A|vo xyjeq005 7 alhaitham 01.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' Didn't expect to run into you here.
:{{A|vo xyjeq005 7 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Alhaitham!? What're you doing here?
:{{A|vo xyjeq005 7 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' And what are you reading? Are those—
:{{A|vo xyjeq005 7 alhaitham 02.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' Sachin's notes. Yes.
:{{A|vo xyjeq005 7 alhaitham 03.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' I came across his profile while I was organizing some documents, and became interested in his research.
:{{A|vo xyjeq005 7 alhaitham 04.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' If it wasn't for that, I never would have agreed to being a commentator. I had a hunch after seeing the fragment of his mind, and sure enough, I came here and found his research.
:{{A|vo xyjeq005 7 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' W—Wait, so you've read it already?
:{{A|vo xyjeq005 7 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Are you alright? How do you feel?
:{{A|vo xyjeq005 7 alhaitham 05.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' I think you may have misunderstood something. The reason Sachin chose that architect to inherit his research was that only he could really empathize with both the calamity and the humanity that these notes seek to convey.
:{{A|vo xyjeq005 7 alhaitham 06.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' Only one who resonates with these sentiments would suffer, and begin to think of history as bleak, the present as perplexing, and the future as pessimistic.
:{{A|vo xyjeq005 7 alhaitham 07.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' Empathy is a double-edged sword. Clearly, I am not the same sort of person as Sachin was.
:{{A|vo xyjeq005 7 alhaitham 08.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' Empaths have many friends, and their wide social circle comes with certain societal advantages. But this also makes it hard for them to achieve their goals.
:{{A|vo xyjeq005 7 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Why's that?
:{{A|vo xyjeq005 7 alhaitham 09.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' All important things in life involve other people. As such, it's extremely difficult to live a life that causes no harm whatsoever to others.
:{{A|vo xyjeq005 7 alhaitham 10.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' If you really want to achieve your goals, you have to be prepared to make enemies along the way. Not everyone can deal with that reality.
:{{A|vo xyjeq005 7 alhaitham 11.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' And that reality is like the material here... objective, heavy, negative... But at the end of the day, for all these experiment results and conclusions, it's just one person's perspective — Sachin's.
:{{A|vo xyjeq005 7 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So, what are your thoughts now that you've read it?
:{{A|vo xyjeq005 7 alhaitham 12.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' As a scholar, Sachin was, without a doubt, a genius.
:{{A|vo xyjeq005 7 alhaitham 13.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' He laid the blame for the darkness in the world squarely on humanity, experimented extensively with reliable results, and drew logical conclusions... In that sense, one might say his views were "correct."
:{{A|vo xyjeq005 7 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So... people are bad, and things can only ever get worse? All of that's true?
:{{A|vo xyjeq005 7 alhaitham 14.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' That is not a question for me to answer. Someone else will arrive shortly — you can ask them instead.
:{{A|vo xyjeq005 7 alhaitham 15.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' All I will say is that the world is not built on "correctness" alone. Sometimes, being correct means nothing at all.
:{{DIcon}} Those words you wrote among your notes...
:{{DIcon}} What did that line written in ancient script mean?
:{{A|vo xyjeq005 7 alhaitham 16.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' "Lofty ideals may provide no defense at all against nihilism, but perhaps little decisions can."
:{{A|vo xyjeq005 7 alhaitham 17.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' "By their own choice, the idealist seeks to bring happiness to all, while denying themselves the same. Thus they shall never reach even the borders of truth until they wipe away the ignorance that blinds them."
:{{A|vo xyjeq005 7 alhaitham 18.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' I have never been able to agree with certain philosophies. Even Sachin himself struggled to comprehend the notion of sacrificing oneself for the greater good.
:{{A|vo xyjeq005 7 alhaitham 19.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' But sadly, all viewpoints will find their supporters, and the way we see the world largely decides our fates.
:{{A|vo xyjeq005 7 alhaitham 20.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' Alright, then. I got what I came for — these research materials are yours to look after. I'll be off.
:{{A|vo xyjeq005 7 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wait. So you came here just to read this stuff? You missed out on a big get-together, you know!
:{{A|vo xyjeq005 7 alhaitham 21.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' A get-together? ...Ah. Yes, that makes sense. This is a good opportunity for that sort of thing.
:{{A|vo xyjeq005 7 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Guess what? Kaveh treated everyone this time.
:{{A|vo xyjeq005 7 alhaitham 22.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' Then I'm sure he packed up the leftovers for me. See ya.
:{{A|vo xyjeq005 7 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' And there he goes... Well, it seems like he really wasn't affected by this research.
:{{A|vo xyjeq005 7 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' He said that someone else would answer our questions. Who do you think that'll be?
:{{Black Screen|You wait around near the research materials...}}
:{{A|vo xyjeq005 7 nahida 01.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' {{Traveler}}, Paimon, you're already here.
:{{A|vo xyjeq005 7 paimon 12.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Nahida... oh, and Hat Guy.
:{{A|vo xyjeq005 7 paimon 13.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wait, so you asked him to take part in the Championship?
:{{A|vo xyjeq005 7 nahida 02.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' Yes, it was me. Are you surprised?
:{{DIcon}} A little...
:{{DIcon}} Actually, not really...
:{{Introductory Note|Nahida}}
:{{A|vo xyjeq005 7 paimon 14.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Did you know that there was something wrong with the diadem from the start? And if so, why didn't you switch it out for another one?
:{{A|vo xyjeq005 7 nahida 03.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' Because Sachin's research is not mistaken. He spent his entire life researching this topic, and these materials are a result of that.
:{{A|vo xyjeq005 7 nahida 04.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' These are the crystallization of his wisdom. Yes, I was worried that the material might cause some disruption, but I didn't want to wipe away all his hard work searching for the truth.
:{{A|vo xyjeq005 7 nahida 05.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' So instead, I had Hat Guy here help me keep an eye on things.
:{{A|vo xyjeq005 7 wanderer 01.ogg}} '''{{Wanderer}}:''' Seriously? I think you can stop calling me that now.
:{{A|vo xyjeq005 7 nahida 06.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' Why? Don't you like it?
:{{A|vo xyjeq005 7 wanderer 02.ogg}} '''{{Wanderer}}:''' ...*sigh*
:{{A|vo xyjeq005 7 nahida 07.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' ...Well, anyway — if Sachin's chosen successor hadn't been able to handle his research, or if it had brought pain to more people, he would have intervened at a suitable moment.
:{{A|vo xyjeq005 7 wanderer 03.ogg}} '''{{Wanderer}}:''' And after all that, the person Sachin chose, turned his nose up at his life's work. Pretty hilarious.
:{{A|vo xyjeq005 7 nahida 08.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' I was also hoping that this could be an opportunity for you to learn how to interact with people normally... But it looks like that didn't work out.
:{{A|vo xyjeq005 7 wanderer 04.ogg}} '''{{Wanderer}}:''' That wasn't necessary. I'm still paying you back for your help, and the last thing I need is more reasons to be indebted to you.
:{{A|vo xyjeq005 7 paimon 15.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Nahida, what did you mean by "Sachin's research is not mistaken"? Does that mean that you approve of his research?
:{{A|vo xyjeq005 7 nahida 09.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' Hmmm. Put it this way instead. Truth, to me, is like a Shroomboar.
:{{A|vo xyjeq005 7 nahida 10.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' Some people only see the mushroom on the Shroomboar's back, and they conclude that a Shroomboar is a mushroom.
:{{A|vo xyjeq005 7 nahida 11.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' Others see only the Shroomboar's body, and they declare that a Shroomboar is a boar.
:{{A|vo xyjeq005 7 nahida 12.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' Still others look deeper inside, and determine that a Shroomboar is... meat.
:{{A|vo xyjeq005 7 nahida 13.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' These conclusions are all correct in their own way, but none of them objectively describe the Shroomboar.
:{{A|vo xyjeq005 7 paimon 16.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Paimon kinda gets it... but also not really...
:{{A|vo xyjeq005 7 nahida 14.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' The world is the same way. No one, not even I included, can understand it in its entirety. All of us are somewhere on the path toward truth.
:{{A|vo xyjeq005 7 nahida 15.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' Within the confines of our limited knowledge, some may blindly believe in the beauty of this world, and others may focus only on its evils.
:{{A|vo xyjeq005 7 nahida 16.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' In truth, the most important thing isn't what state the world is in now, but what people hope it will become. But of course, I don't mean that as a criticism or a call to action.
:{{A|vo xyjeq005 7 nahida 17.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' Ultimately, my duty as the God of Wisdom is to guide every form of wisdom to a place where it can find its purpose.
:{{A|vo xyjeq005 7 wanderer 05.ogg}} '''{{Wanderer}}:''' That was a long speech. So what are you actually going to do with these research materials?
:{{A|vo xyjeq005 7 nahida 18.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' Because Kaveh, as the successor of this research, does not wish to see these ideas disseminated, I will seal it up.
:{{A|vo xyjeq005 7 nahida 19.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' But even though Sachin's research could be considered "negative" wisdom, it is still a building block of the truth. If someone wishes to follow in his footsteps in the future, I will not stop them.
:{{A|vo xyjeq005 7 nahida 20.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' I also look forward to the day that a member of the Vahumana Darshan can not only comprehend his theories, but also find a way out from the despair as well.
:{{A|vo xyjeq005 7 wanderer 06.ogg}} '''{{Wanderer}}:''' Hmph, Vahumana doesn't have that kind of talent... Wait, you're not intending to keep me in Vahumana long-term, are you?
:{{A|vo xyjeq005 7 wanderer 07.ogg}} '''{{Wanderer}}:''' Hah, I don't remember signing up to become a scholar. Don't you think I'm useful enough to you as a prisoner?
:{{A|vo xyjeq005 7 paimon 17.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh boy, here we go again...
:{{A|vo xyjeq005 7 nahida 21.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' You think so? Well, to that, I would say that in Sumeru, even prisoners have the right to an education.
:{{A|vo xyjeq005 7 nahida 22.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' I hope that your studies in Vahumana will help you deal with your own fate, and learn how best to settle old debts from your past.
:{{A|vo xyjeq005 7 nahida 23.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' I will review your final thesis myself. I am expecting great things from you, Mr. Hat Guy.
:{{A|vo xyjeq005 7 wanderer 08.ogg}} '''{{Wanderer}}:''' ...Tsk.
:;(Quest ends)

===Guest From Afar===
{{Quest Description|You and Noelle met a strange guest near Mondstadt named Alois. Alois claims to be a merchant who has lost his cargo due to a monster attack. Noelle decides to bring Alois to Mondstadt to help him find his lost goods...}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Approach the gate)
:{{A|vo noecop001 1906201 swan 01.ogg}} '''[[Swan]]:''' Aha, Honorary Knight and Noelle. Were you two out on a mission?
:{{A|vo noecop001 1906201 swan 02.ogg}} '''Swan:''' Wait, who is this person behind you?
:{{A|vo noecop001 1906201 alois 01.ogg}} '''Alois:''' I... My name is Alois. I'm a humble merchant.
:{{A|vo noecop001 1906201 swan 03.ogg}} '''Swan:''' Ah, Mondstadt welcomes you, strange yet respectable traveler.
:{{A|vo noecop001 1906201 swan 04.ogg}} '''Swan:''' Please state your identity and purpose. The Knights of Favonius are here to ensure your safety.
:{{A|vo noecop001 1906201 alois 02.ogg}} '''Alois:''' Uh... ahem... I came to Mondstadt to import wines back to Liyue...
:{{A|vo noecop001 1906201 swan 05.ogg}} '''Swan:''' I see, but are you not carrying any luggage or goods?
:{{A|vo noecop001 1906201 swan 06.ogg}} '''Swan:''' I also don't see your name among the wine merchants that Mondstadt regularly deals with...
:{{A|vo noecop001 1906201 alois 03.ogg}} '''Alois:''' I... It's my first time visiting Mondstadt, but I expect to come back often...
:{{A|vo noecop001 1906201 swan 07.ogg}} '''Swan:''' Hmm... In that case, please show me the relevant documents issued by Liyue's [[Ministry of Civil Affairs]]. I need to verify your identity.
:{{A|vo noecop001 1906201 alois 04.ogg}} '''Alois:''' Huh? What on earth is the Min— ...Oh! Right, right, I... put them in my luggage!
:{{A|vo noecop001 1906201 swan 08.ogg}} '''Swan:''' ...Luggage?
:{{A|vo noecop001 1906201 noelle 01.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' Oh, our apologies... This gentleman was just attacked by a monster and lost both his luggage and his goods.
:{{A|vo noecop001 1906201 noelle 02.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' Could you allow him to calm down a bit before we register him with the Knights?
:{{A|vo noecop001 1906201 swan 09.ogg}} '''Swan:''' Hmm, according to Article 10 of the [[Knights of Favonius Handbook - 5th Edition|Knights of Favonius Handbook]], caution should be exercised with regard to unfamiliar visitors.
:{{A|vo noecop001 1906201 noelle 03.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' But Article 2 of the Knights of Favonius Handbook also says that one must not offend our visitors, right?
:{{A|vo noecop001 1906201 swan 10.ogg}} '''Swan:''' Mmm, well... In this situation... umm...
:{{A|vo noecop001 1906201 swan 11.ogg}} '''Swan:''' ...I—It seems the Knights of Favonius Handbook has a bit of an overlap...
:{{DIcon}} I'll keep an eye on him. Nothing bad will happen.
::{{A|vo noecop001 1906201 swan 12.ogg}} '''Swan:''' Well... if you are keeping watch, there shouldn't be a problem...
::{{A|vo noecop001 1906201 noelle 04.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' After all, this is our Honorary Knight, the one who defended Mondstadt from the claws of the frenzied [[Stormterror]].
::{{A|vo noecop001 1906201 alois 05.ogg}} '''Alois:''' Storm... terror?
::{{DIcon}} Many times your height, without jumping.
::{{DIcon}} He's a little fellow, not worth worrying about.
::{{A|vo noecop001 1906201 alois 06.ogg}} '''Alois:''' Haha... indeed... good one...
:{{DIcon}} Leave it to Noelle. She can take care of the situation.
::{{A|vo noecop001 1906201 swan 13.ogg}} '''Swan:''' Hmm... if Noelle is willing to vouch for him, then I can rest easy.
::{{DIcon}} After all, she is the most reliable maid in all Mondstadt.
::{{A|vo noecop001 1906201 noelle 05.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' I'm... just doing my job...
::{{A|vo noecop001 1906201 noelle 06.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' "Most reliable"? I've got a way to go, but I will try to live up to that!
::{{DIcon}} I'll be there too.
:{{A|vo noecop001 1906201 swan 14.ogg}} '''Swan:''' Well then, I'm counting on you two to take care of this gentleman while he's in Mondstadt.
----
{{Dialogue End}}
{{Quest Description|To display Mondstadt's hospitality to guests, Noelle is working hard and making preparations.}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(After the cutscene)
:{{A|vo noecop001 1906203 noelle 01.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' So you're a wine merchant? You must have excellent wine knowledge.
:{{A|vo noecop001 1906203 noelle 02.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' Would you like to rest awhile at Angel's Share? It's our signature tavern.
:{{A|vo noecop001 1906203 alois 01.ogg}} '''Alois:''' Such a... warm welcome... how could I refuse?

;(Approach Angel's Share)
:{{A|vo noecop001 1906203 alois 02.ogg}} '''Alois:''' Ah... Angel's Share. So this barrel must be full with Mondstadt's celebrated wine, right? If only it could be imitated...
:{{DIcon}} "Imitated"?
:{{A|vo noecop001 1906203 alois 03.ogg}} '''Alois:''' Oh, uh... imported! That's the word.
:{{A|vo noecop001 1906203 noelle 03.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' Sorry to keep you waiting. Drink up!
:{{A|vo noecop001 1906203 noelle 04.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' This is a Dandelion Wine-based cocktail — I asked the bartender to add [[Calla Lily]] because it has a calming effect.
:{{A|vo noecop001 1906203 noelle 05.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' I know you've been on the road for a long time and cold drinks would be bad for your stomach.
:{{A|vo noecop001 1906203 noelle 06.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' So I requested less ice. Hope it's to your liking.
:{{A|vo noecop001 1906203 alois 04.ogg}} '''Alois:''' Calming?
:{{A|vo noecop001 1906203 alois 05.ogg}} '''Alois:''' Is this what they give to all visitors in Mondstadt?
:{{DIcon}} ...Made especially for you.
::{{A|vo noecop001 1906203 alois 06.ogg}} '''Alois:''' Hehe... because you know I'm interested in Mondstadt wines?
::{{DIcon}} You're very interested, no?
::{{A|vo noecop001 1906203 alois 07.ogg}} '''Alois:''' Y—Yes! Just interested, mind you.
:{{DIcon}} ...Noelle's way of showing hospitality.
::{{A|vo noecop001 1906203 alois 08.ogg}} '''Alois:''' Aha... o—okay then...
:{{A|vo noecop001 1906203 alois 09.ogg}} '''Alois:''' On another note, that drink's made me realize just how empty my stomach is...
:{{A|vo noecop001 1906203 noelle 07.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' Oh, so you're hungry too!
:{{A|vo noecop001 1906203 noelle 08.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' ...How terrible of me. If I'd realized, I would've saved some [[Lighter-Than-Air Pancake|pancakes]] for you.
:{{DIcon}} Not to worry. Let's go to the [[Good Hunter]] restaurant.
:{{A|vo noecop001 1906203 alois 10.ogg}} '''Alois:''' Oh, good idea! That sounds like a good place!

;(Approach Good Hunter)
:{{A|vo noecop001 1906204 alois 01.ogg}} '''Alois:''' Mmmm... smells incredible! So it's true... If you really want to sell Mondstadt wines, you can't do without Mondstadt dishes...
:{{A|vo noecop001 1906204 alois 02.ogg}} '''Alois:''' Maybe recipes will be easier to obtain than the brewing process...
:{{DIcon}} Brewing process?
:{{DIcon}} Easier to obtain?
:{{A|vo noecop001 1906204 alois 03.ogg}} '''Alois:''' Oh! Uhh, what I mean is... the Dandelion Wine brewing process is unique — difficult to imitate! That's why we merchants can buy with confidence!
:{{A|vo noecop001 1906204 alois 04.ogg}} '''Alois:''' Haha, where was I... Let's see, what's on the menu... Hmm, so many dishes... hard to decide...
:{{A|vo noecop001 1906204 noelle 01.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' Can I help?
:{{A|vo noecop001 1906204 alois 05.ogg}} '''Alois:''' Uh, sure... What do you suggest?
:{{A|vo noecop001 1906204 noelle 02.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' Hm... Well, do you prefer red meat or white?
:{{A|vo noecop001 1906204 alois 06.ogg}} '''Alois:''' I like 'em both.
:{{A|vo noecop001 1906204 noelle 03.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' The [[Steak]]s here are cuts of freshly shipped [[Springvale]] [[Forest Boar|Boar]]. I'd recommend having it served medium to really bring out the natural sweetness of the meat.
:{{A|vo noecop001 1906204 noelle 04.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' Mm... oh! [[Sweet Madame]] is another specialty. Crispy skin and tender meat — goes perfectly with wine!
:{{A|vo noecop001 1906204 noelle 05.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' However, those dishes alone aren't very healthy from a nutritional standpoint.
:{{A|vo noecop001 1906204 noelle 06.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' I recommend a [[Mushroom Pizza]] and a [[Satisfying Salad]] too on the side.
:{{A|vo noecop001 1906204 noelle 07.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' If that sounds okay, I'll place the order for you. This meal is on me, to make up for my inattentiveness.
:{{A|vo noecop001 1906204 alois 07.ogg}} '''Alois:''' That's too generous of you...
:{{A|vo noecop001 1906204 noelle 08.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' Please, enjoy. After all, it's your first meal here as a new visitor, and your last. I wouldn't want to give you the cold shoulder.
:{{A|vo noecop001 1906204 alois 08.ogg}} '''Alois:''' Huh? *coughing* M—My last!? *choking*
:{{A|vo noecop001 1906204 alois 09.ogg}} '''Alois:''' ...You give this meal to... all new visitors, right?
:{{DIcon}} This one was made especially for you.
::{{A|vo noecop001 1906204 alois 10.ogg}} '''Alois:''' Wait... Is it really my last meal?
::{{DIcon}} Your last meal as a new visitor, of course. So enjoy!
::{{A|vo noecop001 1906204 alois 11.ogg}} '''Alois:''' Ah, haha... so that's what it means... Well, then I better make the most of it...
:{{DIcon}} It's just Noelle's way of showing hospitality.
::{{A|vo noecop001 1906204 alois 12.ogg}} '''Alois:''' Aha... o—okay then...
:{{DIcon}} Where are we going after the meal?
:{{DIcon}} Noelle, do we have anything else on the itinerary?
:{{A|vo noecop001 1906204 noelle 09.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' How about With Wind Comes Glory?
:{{A|vo noecop001 1906204 noelle 10.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' For our final stop, I want to leave Mr. Alois with something to commemorate his time here.
:{{A|vo noecop001 1906204 alois 13.ogg}} '''Alois:''' So... that's the final stop, yes?
:{{A|vo noecop001 1906204 alois 14.ogg}} '''Alois:''' Wait... what are we commemorating?

;(Approach Marjorie)
:{{A|vo noecop001 1906205 marjorie 01.ogg}} '''Marjorie:''' Oh, here's your order, Noelle.
:{{A|vo noecop001 1906205 noelle 01.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' Thanks, Marjorie.
:{{A|vo noecop001 1906205 noelle 02.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' Mr. Alois, please accept this souvenir.
:{{A|vo noecop001 1906205 alois 01.ogg}} '''Alois:''' Eh-he, thanks. I will treasure this wood carving forev— ...Eh?
:{{A|vo noecop001 1906205 alois 02.ogg}} '''Alois:''' Wait, what's on the... Is that... the insignia of the Knights of Favonius?
:{{A|vo noecop001 1906205 noelle 03.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' I, maid Noelle, on behalf of Mondstadt and the Knights of Favonius, officially welcome you!
:{{A|vo noecop001 1906205 alois 03.ogg}} '''Alois:''' Wait... Knights of Favonius? How can you be both a maid and a part of the Knights of Favonius?
:{{DIcon}} She's a maid of the Knights of Favonius.
:{{DIcon}} She's a future knight of Favonius.
:{{A|vo noecop001 1906205 alois 04.ogg}} '''Alois:''' So, so this gift is also a...
:{{DIcon}} This one was made especially for you.
::{{A|vo noecop001 1906205 alois 05.ogg}} '''Alois:''' So it's... a warning!
:{{DIcon}} It's just Noelle's way of showing hospitality.
::{{A|vo noecop001 1906205 alois 06.ogg}} '''Alois:''' ...So, just a regular souvenir?

;(If the "Noelle's way of showing hospitality" dialogue option was chosen two or more times, go to [[#Branch 2|Branch 2]])

{{Dialogue Start}}
:{{A|vo noecop001 1906205 noelle 04.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' Oh, I'm afraid this is all I had time for...
:{{A|vo noecop001 1906205 noelle 05.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' However, I hope it leaves you with a lasting impression of your trip to Mondstadt.
:{{A|vo noecop001 1906205 noelle 06.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' Now then, if you wouldn't mind accompanying me to the Knights of Favonius, the registration process only requires—
:{{A|vo noecop001 1906205 alois 07.ogg}} '''Alois:''' Ah—! N—no need! I uhh... suddenly I remember where I lost my luggage!

:{{A|vo noecop001 1906205 noelle 10.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' Or... perhaps it's a little too soon but...

====After Hospitality Comes...====
{{Quest Description|Noelle's passionate reception is putting an immense amount of pressure on Alois, who just wants to leave...}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Approach the end of the bridge)
:{{A|vo noecop001 1906206 alois 01.ogg}} '''Alois:''' *whimpers*
:{{DIcon}} Okay, no further.
:{{A|vo noecop001 1906206 alois 02.ogg}} '''Alois:''' ...So this is the end?
:{{DIcon}} I can't see anyone around.
:{{A|vo noecop001 1906206 alois 03.ogg}} '''Alois:''' Meaning this is a good spot!?
:{{DIcon}} If you understand, then nothing needs to be said.
:{{DIcon}} If you don't understand, it's pointless to explain.
:{{A|vo noecop001 1906206 alois 04.ogg}} '''Alois:''' Archons above! Oh, honorable knight, please have mercy! Forgive me! I'll confess! I'll confess to everything!
:{{A|vo noecop001 1906206 alois 05.ogg}} '''Alois:''' I was planning to investigate Mondstadt's Dandelion Wine — to see if I could find a way to imitate it!

:{{A|vo noecop001 1906205 noelle 16.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' I'm afraid this is all I had time for...
