:{{A|vo noecop001 1906205 alois 13.ogg}} '''Alois:''' ...And yet you still went to all this effort... to prepare all this for me...
:{{A|vo noecop001 1906205 alois 14.ogg}} '''Alois:''' Didn't you wonder whether the savage monsters — the missing cargo... What if it were all lies?
:{{A|vo noecop001 1906205 noelle 18.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' Why would I think that? I'm just doing what a maid of Favonius should do.
:{{A|vo noecop001 1906205 noelle 19.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' Knights of Favonius Handbook Article 2: "Do not exhibit suspicion or hostility towards visitors, no matter how suspicious they may seem."
:{{A|vo noecop001 1906205 noelle 20.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' You are a visitor from far away. You should be welcomed by me and by Mondstadt.
:{{A|vo noecop001 1906205 noelle 21.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' Even if there really is only a slight possibility that everything you say is true...
:{{A|vo noecop001 1906205 noelle 22.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' Being attacked by savage monsters, losing goods and documents... Isn't it times like these that people need help the most?
:{{A|vo noecop001 1906205 noelle 23.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' And if I failed to offer our hospitality on such an occasion, despite there being no evidence to back up your claims...
:{{A|vo noecop001 1906205 noelle 24.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' ...That's not the way a maid of Favonius should behave!
:{{A|vo noecop001 1906205 alois 15.ogg}} '''Alois:''' I see... Well, thank you...
:{{A|vo noecop001 1906205 alois 16.ogg}} '''Alois:''' It's... time for me to leave Mondstadt.
:{{A|vo noecop001 1906205 noelle 25.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' Huh? Why the hurry...?
:{{A|vo noecop001 1906205 noelle 26.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' We haven't recovered your lost property yet...
:{{A|vo noecop001 1906205 alois 17.ogg}} '''Alois:''' No need. I've just remembered where I left them.
:{{A|vo noecop001 1906205 alois 18.ogg}} '''Alois:''' Somewhere far, far away...
:{{A|vo noecop001 1906205 alois 19.ogg}} '''Alois:''' I'll be sure to keep a better eye on them next time.
:{{A|vo noecop001 1906205 alois 20.ogg}} '''Alois:''' Perhaps when I'm a visitor worthy of your hospitality, I can return to Mondstadt.
:{{A|vo noecop001 1906205 noelle 27.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' Umm... I'm not sure I fully understand what you mean...
:{{A|vo noecop001 1906205 noelle 28.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' But if you think you can retrieve your lost property, that's great.
:{{DIcon}} You two clearly aren't talking about the same thing...
:{{DIcon}} But at least the problem seems to be solved.
:{{A|vo noecop001 1906205 alois 21.ogg}} '''Alois:''' What a short trip...
:{{A|vo noecop001 1906205 alois 22.ogg}} '''Alois:''' But... thank you for your care and hospitality, I've learned a lot...
:{{A|vo noecop001 1906205 alois 23.ogg}} '''Alois:''' Goodbye, Mondstadt. Goodbye, maid of the Knights of Favonius!
:{{A|vo noecop001 1906205 noelle 29.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' Ah, okay then... goodbye!
:{{A|vo noecop001 1906205 noelle 30.ogg}} '''Noelle:''' Mondstadt and I, maid Noelle of the Knights of Favonius, will always welcome you when you return!

==Dialogue==
{{Quest Description|Lantern Rite has come around again. You and Paimon go and ask the people of Liyue about this year's festival preparations.}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Enter Liyue Harbor)
:{{A|vo eqhdj101 1 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Who would've guessed that rebuilding the [[Jade Chamber]] would draw out such a massive monster!
:{{A|vo eqhdj101 1 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' For a second there, Paimon really thought the Jade Chamber was gonna be ruined again...
:{{A|vo eqhdj101 1 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Whew, but it's all over now... who knows if the Lantern Rite can still go on after an incident like that, though.
:{{A|vo eqhdj101 1 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Let's ask Lady Ningguang how things are shaping up for the festival this year, {{Traveler}}.

----

;(Approach Ningguang at the Yujing Terrace)
:{{A|vo eqhdj101 2 ningguang 01.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' ...Send this report to the [[Ministry of Civil Affairs]] and have them delegate each of the tasks on the list to the appropriate departments.
:{{A|vo eqhdj101 2 ningguang 02.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' Also, be sure to tell them that though the [[Lantern Rite Festival|Lantern Rite]] may be complicated, everything must be done properly.
:{{A|vo eqhdj101 2 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hello, Lady Ningguang! It's us again!
:{{DIcon}} We're not disturbing you, are we?
:{{A|vo eqhdj101 2 ningguang 03.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' No, of course not. You are my honored guests.
:{{A|vo eqhdj101 2 ningguang 04.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' And given the looks of you two, I presume that you are here to celebrate the Lantern Rite?
:{{A|vo eqhdj101 2 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' That's right! So what's on the agenda for the festival this year?
:{{A|vo eqhdj101 2 ningguang 05.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' As always, there will be a variety of activities taking place. Oh, but there is one of particular interest... The Ministry of Civil Affairs is planning a fireworks show this year. It should certainly be worth your time.
:{{A|vo eqhdj101 2 ningguang 14.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' Releasing Mingxiao Lanterns has always been at the heart of the Lantern Rite, but with all that has occurred in Liyue as of late, I think the people of the city need something to warm their hearts, a feeling of everyone coming together in solidarity.
:{{A|vo eqhdj101 2 ningguang 15.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' So, I believe that this year calls for a celebration of particular magnificence, something that would be closer to the hearts of every citizen.
:{{A|vo eqhdj101 2 ningguang 16.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' We are currently in the process of placing fireworks at various locations all throughout Liyue. We shall choose a timely moment during the festival to set off all the fireworks in unison, allowing the sparkling lights and excitement to resonate with the hearts of the people.
:{{A|vo eqhdj101 2 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Fireworks? But we've already seen fireworks in other places before.
:{{A|vo eqhdj101 2 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Is there something special about the fireworks in Liyue?
:{{A|vo eqhdj101 2 ningguang 06.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' Fireworks were originally developed alongside many other inventions here in Liyue.
:{{A|vo eqhdj101 2 ningguang 07.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' When our ancestors first created fireworks, they were originally known as "firecrackers." Their bright flashes and loud sounds were often used for warding off beasts or as warning signals to other people.
:{{A|vo eqhdj101 2 ningguang 08.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' In those days, it was difficult for people to contact one another while out farming the land, so they would carry firecrackers with them to give signals when necessary.
:{{A|vo eqhdj101 2 ningguang 09.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' But people's lifestyles began to change after [[Liyue Harbor]] was founded. They no longer had to travel out of town to tend the fields anymore, so the use of firecrackers for emergencies also began to dwindle.
:{{A|vo eqhdj101 2 ningguang 10.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' But through our local customs, the pioneering spirit of the firecrackers has been passed down to this very day.
:{{A|vo eqhdj101 2 ningguang 11.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' We made improvements to firecrackers and began setting them off during the Lantern Rite to commemorate the tenacious spirit of our ancestors.
:{{DIcon}} Classic Liyue...
:{{A|vo eqhdj101 2 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wow, everything has so much history in Liyue.
:{{A|vo eqhdj101 2 ningguang 12.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' As I am sure you already know, everything on this land accumulates history and value as time passes. That is the nature of Liyue.
:{{A|vo eqhdj101 2 ningguang 13.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' I've left [[Keqing]] in charge of the fireworks show. If you're interested, why don't we pay her a visit together?

----
;(Approach the fireworks stall)
:{{A|vo eqhdj101 3 keqing 01.ogg}} '''Keqing:''' Hmm, we need to add a few more locations for launching fireworks. The show has to be visible all across Liyue, not just in the city. They celebrate Lantern Rite in [[Qingce Village]] too, you know.
:{{A|vo eqhdj101 3 pengyi 01.ogg}} '''Pengyi:''' B—But Lady Keqing, what about our budget...
:{{A|vo eqhdj101 3 keqing 02.ogg}} '''Keqing:''' The budget is exactly what it's meant to be. It's the necessary amount of funds to properly carry out a task.
:{{A|vo eqhdj101 3 keqing 03.ogg}} '''Keqing:''' If you think the current budget will not suffice, then we'll simply have to apply for more funding from the Ministry of Civil Affairs and wait for their approval.
:{{A|vo eqhdj101 3 keqing 04.ogg}} '''Keqing:''' Our aim is to organize a memorable Lantern Rite. The budget is there just to facilitate planning, we mustn't lose sight of our goal.
:{{A|vo eqhdj101 3 pengyi 02.ogg}} '''Pengyi:''' Yes, Lady Keqing. I understand.
:{{A|vo eqhdj101 3 keqing 05.ogg}} '''Keqing:''' Good, and please remember, safety first.
:{{A|vo eqhdj101 3 keqing 06.ogg}} '''Keqing:''' Oh, it's Ningguang and the Traveler! Good to see you.
:{{A|vo eqhdj101 3 keqing 07.ogg}} '''Keqing:''' Are you here for the Lantern Rite? Your timing couldn't be any better, the preparations are almost complete.
:{{DIcon}} What are you working on, Keqing?
:{{A|vo eqhdj101 3 keqing 08.ogg}} '''Keqing:''' I'm reviewing the positioning of the fireworks and double-checking the relevant facilities... It's all in a day's work.
:{{A|vo eqhdj101 3 ningguang 01.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' Forgive my directness, but if I'm not mistaken, you could just as easily leave these tasks to your subordinates. You've already been working around the clock these past few days, I'm sure a break would not be amiss.
:{{A|vo eqhdj101 3 keqing 09.ogg}} '''Keqing:''' No, it's fine. Really, I can handle it.
:{{A|vo eqhdj101 3 keqing 10.ogg}} '''Keqing:''' [[Pengyi]], please redraft our plans, make a summary report, and send it to the Ministry of Civil Affairs.
:{{A|vo eqhdj101 3 keqing 11.ogg}} '''Keqing:''' I'm going into town to check the progress of the fireworks setup. I'll return shortly.
:{{A|vo eqhdj101 3 keqing 12.ogg}} '''Keqing:''' As for you, Traveler, you're our esteemed guest. Please take the opportunity to stay in Liyue Harbor and enjoy the festivities.
:{{A|vo eqhdj101 3 keqing 13.ogg}} '''Keqing:''' Pengyi, is everything clear? Please remember the tasks I've given you.
:{{A|vo eqhdj101 3 pengyi 03.ogg}} '''Pengyi:''' Yes, Lady Keqing! Don't worry.
:{{A|vo eqhdj101 3 keqing 14.ogg}} '''Keqing:''' Good. Ningguang, Traveler, goodbye for now.
;(Keqing leaves)
:{{A|vo eqhdj101 3 pengyi 04.ogg}} '''Pengyi:''' Please excuse me, Lady Ningguang, and uh... Traveler, I must get going.
:{{A|vo eqhdj101 3 pengyi 05.ogg}} '''Pengyi:''' Lady Keqing told me a great deal of information, and I have to write up the plans from scratch again, so time is of the essence.

'''''The Bottom of Things''''' is a quest in the second branch of {{Quest|Signs of Evil}}.

==Steps==
# Look for signs of evil spirits alone
# Tell Chongyun the truth

==Gameplay Notes==
* This is the final quest of this route.
** Gives the Memory "Nothing Gained"

==Dialogue==
{{Quest Description|You and [[Chongyun]] successfully enter the [[Test of Courage]], but as you track the evil spirits, Chongyun suddenly experiences a rush of unstable yang energy and must rest. But it would be a shame to leave without having found any evil spirits. And so you forge on alone, leaving Chongyun behind to rest.}}

===No Wasted Effort===
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Approach Zhouliang)
:{{A|vo cycop001 1903101 zhouliang 01.ogg}} '''[[Zhouliang]]:''' Ugh... I'm beat. Finally, I can take a break.
:{{A|vo cycop001 1903101 zhouliang 02.ogg}} '''Zhouliang:''' *sigh* I wonder if I took things a little too far... A few people seemed scared out of their minds.
:{{DIcon}} Who are you?
:{{A|vo cycop001 1903101 zhouliang 03.ogg}} '''Zhouliang:''' Huh? Hey, you shouldn't be here!
:{{A|vo cycop001 1903101 zhouliang 04.ogg}} '''Zhouliang:''' *sigh* Never mind. I assume you overheard me anyway.
:{{A|vo cycop001 1903101 zhouliang 05.ogg}} '''Zhouliang:''' I work here pretending to be a ghost, but now's my break time, so I took off my costume. I get all hot and stuffy wearing that thing...
:{{DIcon}} So there are no real ghosts here?
:{{DIcon}} It's all planned to scare people. right?
:{{A|vo cycop001 1903101 zhouliang 06.ogg}} '''Zhouliang:''' Of course, how could there be real ghosts here?
:{{A|vo cycop001 1903101 zhouliang 07.ogg}} '''Zhouliang:''' No one wants to see a real ghost, neither us nor the participants.
:{{A|vo cycop001 1903101 zhouliang 08.ogg}} '''Zhouliang:''' They just come here for the atmosphere, or should I say, the chance... Everyone wants the chance to feel the thrill of excitement.
:{{A|vo cycop001 1903101 zhouliang 09.ogg}} '''Zhouliang:''' When people find themselves in a scary situation, they'll say things that they'd never dare to otherwise. That's what the Test of Courage is all about.
:{{DIcon}} I think I understand.
:{{DIcon}} (Chongyun will be very disappointed.)
:{{A|vo cycop001 1903101 zhouliang 10.ogg}} '''Zhouliang:''' *sigh* Okay... I should get back to work now. Hope you and... whoever you're here with have a fun time.
{{Dialogue End}}

===Nothing Going Bump After All...===
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Talk to Chongyun)
:{{A|vo cycop001 1903109 chongyun 01.ogg}} '''Chongyun:''' You're back! So how did it go? Did you see an evil spirit...?
:{{DIcon}} No, I only saw an [[Zhouliang|event staff member]] pretending to be a ghost.
:{{A|vo cycop001 1903109 chongyun 02.ogg}} '''Chongyun:''' Huh...? So that's what's going on here!?
:{{A|vo cycop001 1903109 chongyun 03.ogg}} '''Chongyun:''' No evil spirits...? No danger...? It's all just a setup...?
:{{DIcon}} I'm sorry, but that seems to be the truth.
:{{DIcon}} That's all there is to the [[Test of Courage]].
:{{DIcon}} It's just for entertainment, you took it way too seriously.
:{{A|vo cycop001 1903109 chongyun 04.ogg}} '''Chongyun:''' I—I see... it seems I've been tricked again.
:{{A|vo cycop001 1903109 chongyun 05.ogg}} '''Chongyun:''' Uh oh, I'm starting to feel more and more... uncomfortable.
:{{A|vo cycop001 1903109 chongyun 06.ogg}} '''Chongyun:''' Now that everything's settled here... let's head back to Liyue Harbor.
:{{A|vo cycop001 1903109 chongyun 07.ogg}} '''Chongyun:''' But could you... help me walk back?
:{{DIcon}} You don't look so good.
:{{A|vo cycop001 1903109 chongyun 08.ogg}} '''Chongyun:''' It's fine... I'll be okay...
:{{A|vo cycop001 1903109 chongyun 09.ogg}} '''Chongyun:''' No, really... I'm fine...
{{Dialogue End}}

==Dialogue==
{{Quest Description|They say that there's a popular bartender at The Cat's Tail.}}
===The Cat's Tail's Bartender===
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Talk to Nimrod)
:{{A|vo dancop001 1910101 nimrod 01.ogg}} '''Nimrod:''' Mmm... drinks at The Cat's Tail. Not bad... not bad at all...
:{{DIcon}} The Cat's Tail?
:{{A|vo dancop001 1910101 nimrod 02.ogg}} '''Nimrod:''' Oh hey, it's you, Traveler. ...Huh? Y—You've never heard of The Cat's Tail?
:{{A|vo dancop001 1910101 nimrod 03.ogg}} '''Nimrod:''' Judging from your expression, seems like you really don't know the place. Boy, have you been missing out...
:{{A|vo dancop001 1910101 nimrod 04.ogg}} '''Nimrod:''' The Cat's Tail is renowned for its incredible specialty drinks. I'm talking drinks you've definitely never tasted before.
:{{A|vo dancop001 1910101 nimrod 05.ogg}} '''Nimrod:''' And just as its name suggests, there are loads of cute kitties at The Cat's Tail.
:{{A|vo dancop001 1910101 nimrod 06.ogg}} '''Nimrod:''' Time simply starts slipping away when you're enjoying a delicious specialty cocktail and surrounded by a bunch of cute kitties...
:{{DIcon}} Is The Cat's Tail still open right now?
:{{DIcon}} I'd like to go check it out...
:{{A|vo dancop001 1910101 nimrod 07.ogg}} '''Nimrod:''' Uh, but you don't seem of age to drink yet.
:{{A|vo dancop001 1910101 nimrod 08.ogg}} '''Nimrod:''' Well, that shouldn't be a problem, Diona will be there. She's the best bartender in all of Mondstadt!
:{{A|vo dancop001 1910101 nimrod 09.ogg}} '''Nimrod:''' It should be a piece of cake for her to whip you up a drink with no alcohol in it.
:{{A|vo dancop001 1910101 nimrod 10.ogg}} '''Nimrod:''' Oh, and not to mention, Diona is also pretty cute... just like a little kitty.
:{{A|vo dancop001 1910101 nimrod 11.ogg}} '''Nimrod:''' *hic* Oh no... did I say that out loud? Uh, please don't tell her I said that!
:{{A|vo dancop001 1910101 nimrod 12.ogg}} '''Nimrod:''' Anyway, if you want to check out The Cat's Tail for yourself, the entrance is just around the back.
:{{A|vo dancop001 1910101 nimrod 13.ogg}} '''Nimrod:''' I'm gonna... *hic* go over there and sober up a bit, I don't think I can handle a fifth round quite yet... I drank way too much already.

;(Talk to Diona)
:{{A|vo dancop001 1910101 diona 01.ogg}} '''Diona:''' All out of ingredients... again. Ugh, I really don't understand why these adults love to drink so much.
:{{A|vo dancop001 1910101 margaret 01.ogg}} '''Margaret:''' Because all the drinks you make are so delicious! All it takes is just one sip and they're hooked.
:{{A|vo dancop001 1910101 diona 02.ogg}} '''Diona:''' Hmph, and I thought self-control was the most important quality of being an adult.
:{{A|vo dancop001 1910101 margaret 02.ogg}} '''Margaret:''' Well, it just so happens that self-control often falls by the wayside when someone's enjoying one of your delicious specialty drinks!
:{{A|vo dancop001 1910101 diona 03.ogg}} '''Diona:''' All that means is that they're nothin' but a bunch of drunkards that don't know when to stop...
:{{DIcon}} Aww look, it's a kitty.
:{{A|vo dancop001 1910101 diona 04.ogg}} '''Diona:''' Hey! Who you calling "kitty"!? Haven't you seen anyone of the Kätzlein bloodline before?
:{{A|vo dancop001 1910101 margaret 03a.ogg}}<!--{{A|vo dancop001 1910101 margaret 03b.ogg}}--> '''Margaret:''' Oh, hello there. Are you here to visit the Cat's Tail?
:{{Hangout Branch|I'm here for the kitties...|To Catch a Kitten}}
::{{A|vo dancop001 1910101 margaret 04.ogg}} '''Margaret:''' Here for the kitties, huh? Hehe, I suppose we do have a lot of cute cats here.
::{{A|vo dancop001 1910101 margaret 05.ogg}} '''Margaret:''' They're all quite friendly. In fact, many other customers are here for the same reason.
::{{A|vo dancop001 1910101 margaret 06.ogg}} '''Margaret:''' After all, there aren't many places in Mondstadt where you can just relax and interact with friendly cats.
::{{A|vo dancop001 1910101 diona 05.ogg}} '''Diona:''' Hmph, I've never seen such a bunch of arrogant and stubborn cats. I don't understand why people like them so much. Besides, shouldn't the main purpose for going to a tavern to be drinking, without getting cat hair in your beverage?
::{{DIcon}} Maybe everyone just thinks the cats are cute?
::{{A|vo dancop001 1910101 diona 06.ogg}} '''Diona:''' What kind of reason is that!? So as long as they're cute, nothing else matters?
::{{A|vo dancop001 1910101 margaret 07.ogg}} '''Margaret:''' Well, judging from the customers, that seems to be the case, hehe.
::{{A|vo dancop001 1910101 margaret 08a.ogg}}<!--{{A|vo dancop001 1910101 margaret 08b.ogg}}--> '''Margaret:''' See? This traveler is here for the cats as well.
::{{A|vo dancop001 1910101 margaret 09.ogg}} '''Margaret:''' However, you've come at a most unfortunate time. Our cats seem to have snuck out to play somewhere.
::{{A|vo dancop001 1910101 margaret 10.ogg}} '''Margaret:''' If you're willing to wait, Diona here should be able to bring them back shortly...
::{{A|vo dancop001 1910101 diona 07.ogg}} '''Diona:''' Huh? When did I agree to fetch those little troublemakers!?
::{{A|vo dancop001 1910101 margaret 11.ogg}} '''Margaret:''' Consider it a task straight from tavern management. Besides, the cats are quite fond of you, so you're the natural pick for the job.
::{{A|vo dancop001 1910101 diona 08.ogg}} '''Diona:''' *sigh* They're probably just bored and wandering off to get people's attention.
::{{A|vo dancop001 1910101 margaret 12.ogg}} '''Margaret:''' Is that so? Hehe... Well anyway, it'll be up to you to bring them back here.
::{{A|vo dancop001 1910101 margaret 13.ogg}} '''Margaret:''' Oh, and didn't you say that you're here to see the kitties? If you're up for it, perhaps you could accompany Diona to retrieve them.
::{{A|vo dancop001 1910101 margaret 14.ogg}} '''Margaret:''' Maybe after interacting with them for a bit, the cats will get to know you and seek more of your attention.
::{{DIcon}} I understand.
::{{A|vo dancop001 1910101 margaret 15.ogg}} '''Margaret:''' The three cats that snuck out are Roger, Nelson, and Paisley. Diona, you usually take care of them, so you should be quite familiar with these three, right?
::{{A|vo dancop001 1910101 diona 09.ogg}} '''Diona:''' Ugh, them again! And they even dared to sneak out during working hours... Don't they have any sense of duty as tavern cats?
::{{A|vo dancop001 1910101 margaret 16.ogg}} '''Margaret:''' Come on, not every kitty can be as reliable and caring as you, Diona.
::{{A|vo dancop001 1910101 diona 10.ogg}} '''Diona:''' I am not a cat!
::{{A|vo dancop001 1910101 diona 11.ogg}} '''Diona:''' ...Whatever. So all we have to do is to bring them back to the tavern, right? This shouldn't be a problem, let's scurry out of here. They love wandering around the center of town, so let's check there first.
::{{A|vo dancop001 1910101 margaret 17.ogg}} '''Margaret:''' I'll leave you to it. In the meantime, I'll keep an eye on things here at the tavern. Once you've found the little rascals, please bring them right back.
:;(Proceed to [[To Catch a Kitten]])
:{{Hangout Branch|I want to try some new specialty drinks...|customlinks=[[A Special Base Drink]] and [[Special Cocktailing Condiments]]}}
::{{A|vo dancop001 1910101 margaret 18.ogg}} '''Margaret:''' Oh, you're here for the drinks? Unfortunately, we're pretty much out of ingredients, besides...
::{{A|vo dancop001 1910101 diona 12.ogg}} '''Diona:''' Besides, you don't look like you're even old enough to drink yet!
::{{DIcon}} I'm a lot older than I look...
:::{{A|vo dancop001 1910101 diona 13.ogg}} '''Diona:''' Hah! That's what every underage person says when they come here trying to sneak a drink.
::{{DIcon}} A non-alcoholic beverage would be fine as well.
:::{{A|vo dancop001 1910101 diona 14.ogg}} '''Diona:''' A non-alcoholic beverage? There are tons of other places in Mondstadt that serve that.
:::{{A|vo dancop001 1910101 diona 15.ogg}} '''Diona:''' But seeing as you came all the way to a tavern for a non-alcoholic drink, that must mean you have your own views about alcohol, right?
::{{A|vo dancop001 1910101 diona 16.ogg}} '''Diona:''' Unless you just want to try a drink because you think it's the romantic thing that adults do. Hmph, those sleazy old men over there once thought the same thing, you know!
::{{A|vo dancop001 1910101 diona 17.ogg}} '''Diona:''' *sigh* I just don't get why everyone is so obsessed with alcohol. What's so good about it anyway?
::{{A|vo dancop001 1910101 margaret 19.ogg}} '''Margaret:''' That's enough, Diona. This traveler obviously made a trip here to have a drink. We should always do our best to satisfy the customers' needs.
::{{A|vo dancop001 1910101 margaret 20.ogg}} '''Margaret:''' Consider this the tavern management's request.
::{{A|vo dancop001 1910101 diona 18.ogg}} '''Diona:''' Ugh, oh alright! So one special cocktail is all I need to make, right?
::{{A|vo dancop001 1910101 diona 19.ogg}} '''Diona:''' Fine, since you seem to fantasize about alcohol so much, I'll make you something that'll crush whatever dreams you've had about the stuff.
::{{A|vo dancop001 1910101 diona 20.ogg}} '''Diona:''' That way, maybe you won't become another one of those annoying and smelly old drunks...
::{{A|vo dancop001 1910101 diona 21.ogg}} '''Diona:''' Though we do have some drink base and flavoring ingredients left, since you're looking for a special drink, I'm willing to put in the effort and search for some special ingredients.
::{{A|vo dancop001 1910101 diona 22.ogg}} '''Diona:''' But considering the time, I can only make either the drink's base or flavoring more special.
::{{A|vo dancop001 1910101 diona 23.ogg}} '''Diona:''' So... what'll it be? The drink's base or flavoring to be more unique? Hmm?
::{{Hangout Branch|I'd like the base to be more unique...|A Special Base Drink}}
:::{{A|vo dancop001 1910101 diona 24.ogg}} '''Diona:''' A drink with a special base, huh? Hm, looks like you already possess plenty of potential to become a roaring drunkard. I'm gonna have to really knock some sense into you with this one.
:::{{A|vo dancop001 1910101 diona 25.ogg}} '''Diona:''' Ahem... Anyway, let's head to Dadaupa Gorge, I know just the place to find a unique drink base.
::;(Proceed to [[A Special Base Drink]])
::{{Hangout Branch|I'd like the flavoring to be more unique...|Special Cocktailing Condiments}}
:::{{A|vo dancop001 1910101 diona 26.ogg}} '''Diona:''' A drink with special flavoring huh? Well, that'll be easy enough, I was planning on looking for some more flavorings anyway. Hm, I've got a list of things we can search for.
:::{{A|vo dancop001 1910105 diona 01.ogg}} '''Diona:''' Hmm... let's go visit Blanche first. I placed an order for some flavoring ingredients that should be ready by now.
::;(Proceed to [[Special Cocktailing Condiments]])
{{Dialogue End}}

'''''The Championship Begins''''' is the first part of {{Quest|Up! Toward Homecoming Wings}}.

==Steps==
# Talk to [[Katheryne]]
# Go to [[Speranza]] and find the mysterious Advisor
# Talk to Advisor Linnea
# Go to the arena at the [[Frostmoon Enclave]]
# Sign up for the Spirit Envoy Championship

==Dialogue==
{{Quest Description|Following a tranquil stay in Nod-Krai, you check in with Katheryne to see if anything noteworthy has happened lately.}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Approach Katheryne at the [[Adventurers' Guild]] in Nasha Town)
:{{A|vo lnylq001 1 katheryne 01.ogg}} '''Katheryne:''' Ad astra abyssosque! How can the Adventurers' Guild help you today?
:{{A|vo lnylq001 1 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' It's been a while since we last came to see you! Got any exciting commissions for us?
:{{A|vo lnylq001 1 katheryne 02.ogg}} '''Katheryne:''' Things have been rather quiet in Nod-Krai lately. The commissions currently on our books are all very routine.
:{{A|vo lnylq001 1 katheryne 03.ogg}} '''Katheryne:''' That being said, the [[Frostmoon Scions]] are preparing to host some sort of event. They have approached us with quite a number of requests for supplies. Apparently, it's going to be quite a large gathering.
:{{A|vo lnylq001 1 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' The Frostmoon Scions? Well, it can't be another [[Moon-Prayer Night]]... Do they have some other big festival that Paimon doesn't know about?
:{{A|vo lnylq001 1 katheryne 04.ogg}} '''Katheryne:''' I heard it's a friendly sparring competition for animal friends. Something called the "Spirit Envoy Championship."
:{{DIcon}} "Animal friends"?
:{{DIcon}} ..."Sparring"?
:{{A|vo lnylq001 1 katheryne 05.ogg}} '''Katheryne:''' That's right. The Frostmoon Scions have always advocated coexistence with nature, encouraging their followers to build positive relationships with the beasts of the wild.
:{{A|vo lnylq001 1 katheryne 06.ogg}} '''Katheryne:''' At the same time, to ensure their animal friends build the strength to withstand hardship and disasters, they put select animals with whom they share a special bond through a unique sort of training.
:{{A|vo lnylq001 1 katheryne 07.ogg}} '''Katheryne:''' The "Spirit Envoy Championship" is designed to find the strongest human-animal pair by means of friendly sparring.
:{{A|vo lnylq001 1 katheryne 08.ogg}} '''Katheryne:''' In previous years, the competition was restricted to the Frostmoon Scions only, but this year, participants from all over Teyvat are invited to join. I understand that the Frostmoon Scions have even prepared a generous prize for the winner.
:{{A|vo lnylq001 1 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ooh... Does that mean we can join, too?
:{{DIcon}} Can I sign Paimon up?
:{{DIcon}} Time to put you through your paces, Paimon!
:{{A|vo lnylq001 1 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What? You want Paimon to fight!?
:{{A|vo lnylq001 1 katheryne 09.ogg}} '''Katheryne:''' While you two certainly share a remarkably deep bond, I believe that would be against the rules...
:{{A|vo lnylq001 1 katheryne 10.ogg}} '''Katheryne:''' Apparently, in a previous competition, someone entered an extremely rare and powerful partner... After this, the rules were clarified to state that only common animal species and their variants can compete.
:{{DIcon}} I guess that rules out Paimon.
:{{A|vo lnylq001 1 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ah... Wh—What a shame, huh! Paimon was totally looking forward to making a super cool entrance and then *cute fighting noises* "Paimon is the winner"! Sucks that the rules got in the way... Looks like Paimon won't get a chance to show off her skills. Unlike, uh, all those other times...
:{{A|vo lnylq001 1 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Anyway... Who else do we know who might wanna take part?
:{{A|vo lnylq001 1 katheryne 11.ogg}} '''Katheryne:''' If you're unsure of what to do, why not ask one of our advisors for help?
:{{A|vo lnylq001 1 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Advisors? Since when does the Adventurers' Guild have advisors?
:{{A|vo lnylq001 1 katheryne 12.ogg}} '''Katheryne:''' Hehe... The Guild has always had a team of advisors on hand to assist our fledgling adventurers.
:{{A|vo lnylq001 1 katheryne 13.ogg}} '''Katheryne:''' Of course, few of them would be qualified to assist such world-renowned adventurers as yourselves. But as luck would have it, one of our top advisors has recently returned to Nod-Krai from a trip away.
:{{A|vo lnylq001 1 katheryne 14.ogg}} '''Katheryne:''' Her expertise is varied and broad, and she often gives lectures at Speranza. If you have any questions, you could try asking her for help.
:{{A|vo lnylq001 1 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' She sounds impressive... Heh, but you're right Katheryne, it would take a lot to teach us something new.
:{{A|vo lnylq001 1 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Let's go put this mystery adventure advisor to the test!

;(Approach the marked location at Speranza)
:{{A|vo lnylq001 2 linnea 01.ogg}} '''???:''' Alright then! Next, let's go over some more tips for adventuring in Nod-Krai.
:{{A|vo lnylq001 2 linnea 02.ogg}} '''???:''' If you found yourself getting hungry in the wild, what are some things you could eat?
:{{A|vo lnylq001 2 zelibrat 01.ogg}} '''Zelibrat:''' That's easy — [[Lakkaberry|Lakkaberries]], [[Midsommar Berry|Midsommar Berries]]... There's loads of options.
:{{A|vo lnylq001 2 linnea 03.ogg}} '''???:''' Correct! 10 points to you!
:{{A|vo lnylq001 2 lumi 01.ogg}} '''???:''' Ya-ho!
:{{A|vo lnylq001 2 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' That must be who Katheryne was talking about... She looks pretty young for an advisor, though. How knowledgeable can she really be?
:{{A|vo lnylq001 2 orvokki 01.ogg}} '''Orvokki:''' But there are plenty of places where berries don't grow, right? What should we be looking for in those places, Miss Linnea?
:{{A|vo lnylq001 2 linnea 04.ogg}} '''Linnea:''' Good question — I'm glad you asked. That's exactly what I wanted to talk about next. Does everyone recognize this mushroom?
:{{A|vo lnylq001 2 zelibrat 02.ogg}} '''Zelibrat:''' Hmm... Based on the color... this is an edible one, right? Doesn't look poisonous to me...
:{{A|vo lnylq001 2 linnea 05.ogg}} '''Linnea:''' Eh-ehhh... Wrong answer!
:{{A|vo lnylq001 2 linnea 06.ogg}} '''Linnea:''' This here is a Browncap Mushroom. It looks harmless enough, but eating it will give you hallucinations.
:{{A|vo lnylq001 2 linnea 07.ogg}} '''Linnea:''' An unsuspecting adventurer once used a handful of these to make a pot of mushroom soup. Next thing you know, he was trying to foxtrot with [[the Wild Hunt]]... Luckily, he was spotted by a fisherman passing by who managed to save his life, but it was a close call.
:{{A|vo lnylq001 2 zelibrat 03.ogg}} '''Zelibrat:''' That sounds so dangerous!
:{{A|vo lnylq001 2 linnea 08.ogg}} '''Linnea:''' You bet! Adventuring in the wild is no joke. Alright, onto the next — does anyone recognize this plant? Can you tell me if it's edible?
:{{A|vo lnylq001 2 zelibrat 04.ogg}} '''Zelibrat:''' Isn't that a [[Winter Icelea]] leaf?
:{{A|vo lnylq001 2 orvokki 02.ogg}} '''Orvokki:''' They say that the King of Winter Icelea and the King of Midsommar Oak are sworn enemies. If Midsommar Berries are sweet and delicious, I guess Winter Icelea leaves must be horribly bitter...
:{{A|vo lnylq001 2 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hmph, Paimon knows the answer to this one! Winter Icelea leaves might not taste good in food, but you can brew a nice tea with them!
:{{A|vo lnylq001 2 zelibrat 05.ogg}} '''Zelibrat:''' Huh...
:{{DIcon}} Wow, impressive knowledge, Paimon!
:{{DIcon}} Where did you learn that?
:{{A|vo lnylq001 2 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' At [[the Flagship]]. Once when Paimon was eating some yummy food there, [[Demyan]] mentioned that one of the drinks in their [[Roulette Special]] has Winter Icelea in it.
:{{A|vo lnylq001 2 linnea 09.ogg}} '''Linnea:''' Hmm? Who are...
:{{A|vo lnylq001 2 linnea 10.ogg}} '''Linnea:''' ...Looks like we have an expert attending our Q&A session today! Well, I hope you're ready for the next question?
:{{A|vo lnylq001 2 lumi 02.ogg}} '''???:''' Ya-hoho...
:{{A|vo lnylq001 2 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Bring it on!
:{{A|vo lnylq001 2 linnea 11.ogg}} '''Linnea:''' Every adventurer knows to pack a compass and a map before heading into the wilderness, but where would you go to buy these things?
:{{A|vo lnylq001 2 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ahem! Listen up, everyone! The answer is... the Adventurers' Guild!
:{{A|vo lnylq001 2 linnea 12.ogg}} '''Linnea:''' Oh, really? But I hear [[Mimisbrunnr Books]] sells them too. And at a very low price!
:{{A|vo lnylq001 2 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hah! Paimon's done her research. The boss of that place tries to pass off cheap knockoffs as the real deal — don't be fooled!
:{{A|vo lnylq001 2 linnea 13.ogg}} '''Linnea:''' Well said. But even with a high-quality map and compass, the wild can still be a dangerous place. What should you do if you're being chased by a monster you can't fight off?
:{{DIcon}} Seek help from the [[Lightkeepers|ratniki]] on patrol.
:{{A|vo lnylq001 2 linnea 14.ogg}} '''Linnea:''' Correct! Although the ratniki's main duty is to deal with the Wild Hunt, you can always ask them for help if you run into serious trouble.
:{{A|vo lnylq001 2 linnea 15.ogg}} '''Linnea:''' While we're on the subject, some adventurers have found they can use the territorial nature of [[Radiant Beast]]s to their advantage. Lure a monster into their territory, and they will fight each other instead of you. I wouldn't recommend doing this, though, as you may instead find yourself fighting two enemies instead of one.
:{{A|vo lnylq001 2 linnea 16.ogg}} '''Linnea:''' Final question! This is an important one. Which place in Nod-Krai is an absolute must-visit for travelers from abroad?
:{{DIcon}} ...Just one?
:{{A|vo lnylq001 2 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oof, that's a tough choice! There's the Frostmoon Enclave, [[Starsand Shoal]], [[Blue Amber Lake]]... They're all so pretty! Then there's the [[Voynich Guild]], The Flagship... And so many other shops worth visiting!
:{{A|vo lnylq001 2 linnea 17.ogg}} '''Linnea:''' In truth, there's no right answer to this question. But if you ask me, the place most worth visiting is right here — Speranza.
:{{A|vo lnylq001 2 linnea 18.ogg}} '''Linnea:''' Why? Simple — this was once my home. So, this final question was more like a little bit of shameless self-promotion, hehe.
:{{A|vo lnylq001 2 linnea 19.ogg}} '''Linnea:''' You can get delicious [[Nod-Krai Hot Dog]]s and [[Lakkaberry Madame]]s. And if you're not too hungry, just order a slice of [[Midsommar Torte]] and listen to the entertaining rumors the children like to tell.
:{{A|vo lnylq001 2 linnea 20.ogg}} '''Linnea:''' That's it for today's lecture. Tomorrow, I'll be heading to the Frostmoon Enclave to take part in a competition. If you have any questions, you can ask at the Adventurers' Guild, where the other advisors will be happy to help.

;(Talk to Linnea)
:{{A|vo lnylq001 3 linnea 01.ogg}} '''Linnea:''' I haven't met many adventurers who can keep up with me. Consider me impressed!
:{{A|vo lnylq001 3 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Likewise! You really know your stuff! You're everything Paimon would expect from an Adventurers' Guild advisor... Huh!?
:{{A|vo lnylq001 3 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What's the deal!? Don't get so close! {{Traveler}}, there's something wrong with her!
:;(Paimon hides behind the Traveler)
:{{A|vo lnylq001 3 linnea 02.ogg}} '''Linnea:''' Hehehe... Actually, I was going to ask...
:{{A|vo lnylq001 3 linnea 03.ogg}} '''Linnea:''' Your little friend is so clever and cute. I love how she flies around, too. Can I pet her?
:{{A|vo lnylq001 3 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Whoa! Stay back!
:{{A|vo lnylq001 3 linnea 04.ogg}} '''Linnea:''' Don't be afraid. Hehe, I'm not gonna hurt you. Come on, come here...
:;(Linnea starts chasing Paimon around the restaurant while [[Lumi|Linnea's companion]] cheers on and the Traveler watches in bewilderment)
:;(After a few rounds, Paimon hides behind the Traveler who crosses their arms and they both give Linnea an unamused glare)
:{{DIcon}} I'll protect you, Paimon!
:{{DIcon}} Please go back to acting like a teacher.
:{{A|vo lnylq001 3 linnea 05.ogg}} '''Linnea:''' Hehe... Ahem. I'm sorry, I got a little bit carried away again.
:{{A|vo lnylq001 3 linnea 06.ogg}} '''Linnea:''' My name's Linnea. I'm an advisor working for the Adventurers' Guild. Uh... And I promise you, I'm not some sort of weirdo!
:{{A|vo lnylq001 3 linnea 07.ogg}} '''Linnea:''' ...Lemme make it up to you. You want something to eat? Here, try some Midsommar Torte, it's delicious.
:{{A|vo lnylq001 3 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Phew, you gave Paimon a fright... Paimon's never met someone so, uh... how to put this... "enthusiastic" as you.
:{{A|vo lnylq001 3 linnea 08.ogg}} '''Linnea:''' I was fighting to keep a lid on my curiosity during class, but then I just lost control...
:{{A|vo lnylq001 3 linnea 09.ogg}} '''Linnea:''' Anyway, let's get this back on track. Could you tell me your story? How did you two meet?
:<gallery>
Wanderer's Trail Quest Still Aether.png
Wanderer's Trail Quest Still Lumine.png
</gallery>
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (You tell Linnea how you and Paimon met...)
:{{A|vo lnylq001 3 linnea 10.ogg}} '''Linnea:''' What? You fished this little cutie out of the sea?
:{{A|vo lnylq001 3 linnea 11.ogg}} '''Linnea:''' Can you tell me where? A visit to that beach is going right to the top of my bucket list.
:{{A|vo lnylq001 3 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You'd be wasting your time — Paimon is one of a kind! You could sit on that beach for a hundred years, but you'd still come away empty-handed!
:{{A|vo lnylq001 3 linnea 12.ogg}} '''Linnea:''' Ah... Is that right? What a pity.
:{{DIcon}} Anyway...
:{{DIcon}} You said you're going to the Frostmoon Enclave for a competition?
:{{A|vo lnylq001 3 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, right! Paimon almost forgot why we came here. We were thinking of taking part in the Spirit Envoy Championship ourselves. Katheryne said you could give us some pointers?
:{{A|vo lnylq001 3 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Let Paimon guess... Is that your partner there?
:{{A|vo lnylq001 3 lumi 01.ogg}} '''???:''' Ya-ho?
:{{A|vo lnylq001 3 linnea 13.ogg}} '''Linnea:''' Yep! Her name is Lumi. She's my trusty assistant.
:{{DIcon}} I've never seen a creature like this...
:{{A|vo lnylq001 3 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Uh... Hey there.
:{{A|vo lnylq001 3 lumi 02.ogg}} '''Lumi:''' Ya-ho!
:{{A|vo lnylq001 3 linnea 14.ogg}} '''Linnea:''' Have you two ever ventured north of Nod-Krai?
:{{A|vo lnylq001 3 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Not yet... Wait, so you're saying Lumi comes from the northern tundra?
:{{A|vo lnylq001 3 linnea 15.ogg}} '''Linnea:''' Pretty much. There are six types of [[Snowland Fae|fae]] commonly found in the tundra. Lumi here is a "Jack Frost" — that's one of them.
:{{A|vo lnylq001 3 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' "Jack Frost"? Hmm, interesting name choice... She doesn't exactly look very frosty.
:;(The background behind Paimon fades to black and she looks to the side as she envisions a [[Cryo Slime]])
:{{A|vo lnylq001 3 linnea 16.ogg}} '''Linnea:''' An excellent observation. In fact, Lumi is no ordinary Jack Frost — she's a special one.
:;(A flashback begins)
:{{A|vo lnylq001 3 linnea 17.ogg}} '''Linnea:''' The first time I met her, she was wearing this weird cardboard outfit with ugly splotches of paint on it, as if she was trying to disguise herself as a regular Jack Frost.
:{{A|vo lnylq001 3 linnea 18.ogg}} '''Linnea:''' I stayed and watched her for a while, and I discovered that some other mean Jack Frosts were ganging up and bullying her because she looked different. They stole all the food she'd gathered and kicked her out of her sleeping spot...
:{{A|vo lnylq001 3 linnea 19.ogg}} '''Linnea:''' Lumi couldn't fight them. She had nowhere else to go, so she found an old cardboard box, painted it blue, and put it over her head, hoping to blend in with the group.
:;(Flashback ends)
:{{A|vo lnylq001 3 linnea 20.ogg}} '''Linnea:''' Whenever she was discovered, she'd get beaten up, and the rest of the time she lived in constant fear... Until one day, seeking shelter from the rain, she clung to me and wouldn't let go. We've been partners ever since.
:{{A|vo lnylq001 3 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What a story... Oh, poor Lumi. Sounds like she's had a tough time.
:{{A|vo lnylq001 3 lumi 03.ogg}} '''Lumi:''' Ya-ho!
:{{A|vo lnylq001 3 linnea 21.ogg}} '''Linnea:''' As for why Lumi is so different from other Jack Frosts... I'm still looking into that. I'm thinking it's either a mutation or an atavism — or maybe some sort of curse?
:{{A|vo lnylq001 3 linnea 22.ogg}} '''Linnea:''' Hopefully, I'll find the answer one day. But either way, we're best friends for life. Nothing can change the special bond between us.
:{{A|vo lnylq001 3 linnea 23.ogg}} '''Linnea:''' Speaking of which — given how long it can take to build a strong bond with another creature, if you're serious about entering the competition, my advice is to pick an animal friend that you're already pretty close with. Otherwise, the odds are gonna be stacked against you.
:{{A|vo lnylq001 3 paimon 12.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' An animal friend I'm close with, huh...
:{{A|vo lnylq001 3 paimon 13.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Actually, we're kinda spoiled for choice on this one! Who do you think would be the best fit?
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (I need to consider this carefully...)
:{{A|vo lnylq001 3 aguara 01.ogg}} '''???:''' Rawr!
:{{Introductory Note|Aguara|img=Item Aguara.png}}
:{{A|vo lnylq001 3 paimon 14.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh...? [[Aguara]]! What are you doing here?
:{{A|vo lnylq001 3 aguara 02.ogg}} '''Aguara:''' Rawr!
:{{DIcon}} Are you saying...
:{{DIcon}} You want to join the competition?
:{{A|vo lnylq001 3 aguara 03.ogg}} '''Aguara:''' Rawr!
:{{A|vo lnylq001 3 linnea 24.ogg}} '''Linnea:''' Oh, neat! A Natlanese [[Tepetlisaurus|tepetlisaur]]! Aw, it's so small and cute!
:{{A|vo lnylq001 3 linnea 25.ogg}} '''Linnea:''' He seems to really like you guys. I'm sure he'll make a great partner.
:{{DIcon}} Alright!
:{{DIcon}} Let's do our best, Aguara!
:{{A|vo lnylq001 3 lumi 04.ogg}} '''Lumi:''' Ya-ho!
:'''Aguara:''' Rawr!
:{{A|vo lnylq001 3 paimon 15.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Aw, look at them, fast friends, hehe! Play nice, you two!
:{{A|vo lnylq001 3 linnea 26.ogg}} '''Linnea:''' They both seem pretty sociable. No wonder they get along so well.
:{{A|vo lnylq001 3 linnea 27.ogg}} '''Linnea:''' Well then, there's no time to lose — let's go get you signed up!
{{Dialogue End}}

{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Approach [[Mualani]] at the arena)
:{{A|vo lnylq001 4 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Whoa, Paimon wasn't expecting this many people...
:{{A|vo lnylq001 4 mualani 01.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' {{Traveler}}, Paimon! What a nice surprise! I didn't think I'd run into you here!
:{{A|vo lnylq001 4 mualani 02.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' Oh, and Professor Linnea's here too! Are you guys here for the competition as well?
:{{A|vo lnylq001 4 linnea 01.ogg}} '''Linnea:''' Um, yep, hehe...
:{{A|vo lnylq001 4 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Feels like we haven't seen you in ages, Mualani! So how do you know Linnea, anyway?
:{{A|vo lnylq001 4 mualani 03.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' Through her work with the Adventurers' Guild. She was in [[Natlan]] not long ago. She knows so much that we took to calling her "Professor."
:{{A|vo lnylq001 4 mualani 04.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' Speaking of which, you never answered my question... If a [[koholasaurus]] and a [[qucusaurus]] got together, would their babies be able to fly in the sky and dive underwater? 'Cause that would make a pretty awesome [[saurian]] companion!
:{{A|vo lnylq001 4 linnea 02.ogg}} '''Linnea:''' That's almost certainly impossible... They're completely different species...
:{{A|vo lnylq001 4 mualani 05.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' Ah, well, that's too bad. Hear that, [[Mamala]]? Guess I can't do any match-making for you in the [[Flower-Feather Clan]] after all...
:'''Mamala:''' Awoo...
:{{A|vo lnylq001 4 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So you have a thing for qucusaurs!?
:{{A|vo lnylq001 4 itto 01.ogg}} '''Arataki Itto:''' Hahahaha! I was wonderin' what all the commotion was. Looks like this is where it's at!
:{{A|vo lnylq001 4 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' [[Arataki Itto|Itto]]!? What the heck? Either Paimon's seeing things, or... You're not here for the competition too, are you?
:{{A|vo lnylq001 4 itto 02.ogg}} '''Arataki Itto:''' Why else would I be here? Cost me an arm and a leg to get a boat all the way to this "Krod-Nai" place.
:{{A|vo lnylq001 4 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' It's "Nod-Krai."
:{{A|vo lnylq001 4 mualani 06.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' Hey there! I'm Mualani. Are you a friend of {{Traveler}} and Paimon's, too?
:{{A|vo lnylq001 4 itto 03.ogg}} '''Arataki Itto:''' I sure am. Nice to meet ya! The name's Arataki "Beetle Gladiator" Itto, head honcho of the world-famous [[Arataki Gang]] of [[Inazuma]]!
:{{A|vo lnylq001 4 mualani 07.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' That's quite a mouthful!
:{{A|vo lnylq001 4 mualani 08.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' (Wait, did he say "Arataki Gang"? Why does that sound so familiar...?)
:{{A|vo lnylq001 4 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Just call him Arataki Itto. This guy's a bona-fide buffoon.
:{{A|vo lnylq001 4 itto 04.ogg}} '''Arataki Itto:''' Hey! Who are you callin' a buffoon, ya [[Lavender Melon#Trivia|flying Lavender Melon]]!
:{{A|vo lnylq001 4 linnea 03.ogg}} '''Linnea:''' ...Flying Lavender Melon? Wait, so you're some sort of... mutated lavender melon? You don't look like a melon...
:{{A|vo lnylq001 4 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Paimon's not a mutated melon! Or any kind of melon! How could a melon be this cute?
:{{DIcon}} So, Itto — are you here on your own?
:{{DIcon}} Where's the rest of your gang?
:{{A|vo lnylq001 4 itto 05.ogg}} '''Arataki Itto:''' Yeah, about that... Unfortunately, the gang only had the funds to send their main man this time. But don't sweat it! Once I snag that championship title, I'll use the prize money to bring [[Kuki Shinobu|Shinobu]] and the boys over to join the party!
:{{A|vo lnylq001 4 mualani 09.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' Shinobu...? Ah! I remember now! Kuki Shinobu, right? She's mentioned the Arataki Gang before.
:{{A|vo lnylq001 4 itto 06.ogg}} '''Arataki Itto:''' Huh? No way, you've met my deputy?
:{{A|vo lnylq001 4 mualani 10.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' She stopped by the Flower-Feather Clan recently to take the flying trial. [[Chasca]] said she was a natural!
:{{A|vo lnylq001 4 mualani 11.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' ...Hold on, if she's that good and she's only the deputy... you must be way stronger than I imagined. Look sharp, Mamala — we're in for a tough competition!
:;(An image of Itto and Shinobu against a black background is shown)
:{{A|vo lnylq001 4 itto 07.ogg}} '''Arataki Itto:''' Hahahaha! That's right! Bring it on — I'm looking forward to seeing who I'll be facing in the finals.
:{{A|vo lnylq001 4 itto 08.ogg}} '''Arataki Itto:''' Word is that the early birds get the best draws. You snooze you lose! Laters, compadres!
:{{A|vo lnylq001 4 mualani 12.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' Wait, is he serious? ...Mamala, we'd better hurry!
:{{A|vo lnylq001 4 linnea 04.ogg}} '''Linnea:''' N—No, that's complete nonsense...
:{{A|vo lnylq001 4 linnea 05.ogg}} '''Linnea:''' *sigh* ...Shall we?

;(After the cutscene)
:{{A|vo lnylq001 4 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hey, {{Traveler}}, have you noticed? There's loads of other people we know here, too!
:{{A|vo lnylq001 4 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Why don't we go say hi before we register?

;(Talk to Arataki Itto or Mualani, optional)
:{{A|vo dialog lnylq001 itto 01.ogg}} '''Arataki Itto:''' I got here first!
:{{A|vo dialog lnylq001 mualani 01.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' No way, my Sharky Surfboard clearly beat you to it!
:{{A|vo dialog lnylq001 itto 02.ogg}} '''Arataki Itto:''' Hahahaha! Well, I'll see you in the arena! Just don't go crying like a baby when you lose.
:{{A|vo dialog lnylq001 mualani 02.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' Did you hear that, Mamala? Argh, show them no mercy!

:{{A|vo dialog lnylq001 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Jahoda?

{{Quest Description|It's a fine day. Yes, a fine day for a stroll around Poisson!}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Upon obtaining quest)
:{{A|vo arlq001 1 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' It's been a while since we visited Poisson. Maybe we should head over and have a look around?

;(Approach Poisson)
:{{A|vo arlq001 1 lyney 01.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Hey, {{Traveler}}! Paimon!
:{{A|vo arlq001 1 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, Paimon knows that voice...
:{{A|vo arlq001 1 lyney 02.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Over here!
:{{DIcon}} Lyney!
:{{DIcon}} It's been too long.
:{{A|vo arlq001 1 lyney 03.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' To borrow one of the more popular turns of phrase at the moment, this appears to be quite the "fated reunion." Running into you two out of the blue like this has really made my day. I certainly wasn't expecting it.
:{{A|vo arlq001 1 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You can say that again! What brings you to Poisson?
:{{A|vo arlq001 1 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wait! Paimon's got it! You must be here for one of your magic shows, right?
:{{A|vo arlq001 1 lyney 04.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Um... Actually, we've run into a bit of trouble on the home front, so "Father" arranged for us to stay in Poisson for the time being.
:{{A|vo arlq001 1 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, are Lynette and Freminet here too?
:{{A|vo arlq001 1 lyney 05.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Yep, along with most of the other members of the [[House of the Hearth]]. You may have noticed Poisson seems a bit more... crowded than usual.
:{{A|vo arlq001 1 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So you're saying nearly the entire organization has moved to Poisson? Sounds like you've run into way more than just "a bit of trouble." What's really going on?
:{{A|vo arlq001 1 lyney 06.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Umm... Well...
:{{A|vo arlq001 1 arlecchino 01.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' Since the two of you are so curious, perhaps I can fill in the gaps.
:{{A|vo arlq001 1 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ack! You scared Paimon half to death!
:{{A|vo arlq001 1 lyney 07.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' "Father," you're here.
:{{A|vo arlq001 1 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Um... Y'know? On second thought, maybe we don't need to know. It's all probably super confidential House of the Hearth stuff, right? We totally weren't trying to pry or anything...
:{{A|vo arlq001 1 arlecchino 02.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' No need to be nervous. I could sense your genuine concern from your conversation just now.
:{{A|vo arlq001 1 arlecchino 03.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' Of course, I can also understand your confusion. Sending so many Fatui here to Poisson, it's only natural that some might suspect an "ulterior motive" to be involved.
:{{DIcon}} Well, we are a little curious...
:{{DIcon}} We still have our reservations about your organization.
:{{A|vo arlq001 1 arlecchino 04.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' I understand. I'm well aware you've had your fair share of confrontations with the Fatui in the past. And I can't exactly guarantee that we'll remain on good terms in the future.
:{{A|vo arlq001 1 arlecchino 05.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' As for right now, however, I would say we have little reason to be at odds, wouldn't you agree? The House of the Hearth could stand to be more open with those who have worked so closely with us in the past.
:{{A|vo arlq001 1 arlecchino 06.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' As for the issue at hand... Well, it hardly relates to any ulterior motive. To be frank, it all stems from a certain rumor circulating around the House of the Hearth. It's an internal matter.
:{{A|vo arlq001 1 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What sort of rumor?
:{{A|vo arlq001 1 arlecchino 07.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' A rumor that a certain "phantom child" is hiding away in the House of the Hearth.
:{{DIcon}} Some sort of ghost story, maybe?
:{{DIcon}} I feel like I'm getting chills already.
:{{A|vo arlq001 1 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' A phantom child? Just hearing the name is giving Paimon the creeps...
:{{A|vo arlq001 1 arlecchino 08.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' A spirit that should have long ceased to exist is lurking in the shadows of the House of the Hearth.
:{{A|vo arlq001 1 arlecchino 09.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' So, I decided to bring the children to Poisson before continuing to investigate the situation. I expect I should be able to track down the spirit fairly quickly. After that, it's just a matter of "resolving" the situation, if you will. It shouldn't be much trouble at all.
:{{A|vo arlq001 1 arlecchino 10.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' If you're curious, or if you still have some concerns, it might be advisable to stick around for a few days. I'm sure the children would be exceedingly pleased to welcome some visitors.
:{{A|vo arlq001 1 arlecchino 11.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' Lyney, I'll leave you to entertain our guests. I have some matters to attend to.
:{{A|vo arlq001 1 lyney 08.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Of course, "Father."

:{{A|vo arlq001 3 chapleau 05.ogg}} '''Chapleau:''' I was poisoned not too long ago, and I'm still dealing with the aftereffects, so I'm not quite as good as I was before... but I can still give you some pointers.

:{{A|vo arlq001 3 lyney 05.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' You don't need a physical gift to make our guests happy. In fact, pestering them with suggestion after suggestion might make them more annoyed than anything. I would say your enthusiasm has certainly gotten across.

:{{A|vo arlq001 3 lyney 08.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' When Foltz was really young, he strangled all of his family pets — just out of curiosity. He was labeled a dangerous "problem child" and was abandoned by his family.
:{{A|vo arlq001 3 lyney 09.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Heloir has an unnatural obsession with potions. "Father" has forbidden her from trying all the different concoctions she comes up with, but she still tries to test them in secret. You really have to keep an eye on that one.

:{{A|vo arlq001 3 lyney 11.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' I know you two probably aren't used to that kind of talk, but I can promise you they only had the best of intentions. Things like stealth tactics and developing different poisons... they really mean a lot to them. They were just trying to share the best of what they could offer — that's all.

:{{A|vo arlq001 6 lyney 06.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' So, ever since we got to Poisson, then? Do you have any idea what you're doing!?
:{{A|vo arlq001 6 freminet 03.ogg}} '''Freminet:''' I know what I'm doing.
:{{A|vo arlq001 6 lyney 07.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Really? 'Cause from where I'm standing, it looks like you're hiding the very person "Father" has been trying to find! If "Father" finds out about this, everyone involved is going to be punished.
:{{A|vo arlq001 6 lyney 08.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' You know the rules of the House, Freminet. I know you do — "Father" doesn't tolerate any form of betrayal. So, why are you doing this?
:{{A|vo arlq001 6 freminet 04.ogg}} '''Freminet:''' I've thought it through... And I just can't hand her over like that.
:{{A|vo arlq001 6 freminet 05.ogg}} '''Freminet:''' Lyney, don't you remember last year? Chapleau nearly died after getting poisoned during that one mission. He wasn't able to get back before the poison started taking effect, and not a single person was there to help him.
:{{A|vo arlq001 6 freminet 06.ogg}} '''Freminet:''' That night, while I was sleeping, I heard a voice telling me to go save him. I opened my eyes, but I couldn't find the source of the voice. I thought maybe I was just hearing things, but I went to look for him anyway. Luckily, I got there with enough time to save his life.
:{{A|vo arlq001 6 freminet 07.ogg}} '''Freminet:''' That feeling of being "haunted," of hearing voices... It's happened many times in the House of the Hearth. I'm sure you've noticed.
:{{A|vo arlq001 6 lyney 09.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' So what you're saying is... That was her? She was the one who spoke to you that night?
:{{A|vo arlq001 6 freminet 08.ogg}} '''Freminet:''' Unless there are other spirits roaming around the House of the Hearth, I don't think there's any other possibility.
:{{A|vo arlq001 6 freminet 09.ogg}} '''Freminet:''' If Clervie were our enemy, it wouldn't matter whether she was a spirit or an actual child — I would have acted without a second thought, because that's what "Father" ordered us to do.
:{{A|vo arlq001 6 freminet 10.ogg}} '''Freminet:''' But, she's been living with us, helping us from the shadows all this time. I think that makes her family.
:{{A|vo arlq001 6 freminet 11.ogg}} '''Freminet:''' I couldn't just hand her over to be dealt with — not when there's so much we still don't know.
:{{A|vo arlq001 6 lyney 10.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' So what's your plan then? You can't keep her here forever. Someone is bound to find out eventually.
:{{A|vo arlq001 6 freminet 12.ogg}} '''Freminet:''' I haven't thought that far yet. I don't want to disobey an order from "Father," but I also don't want to put Clervie in danger.
:{{A|vo arlq001 6 lyney 11.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Come with me. There are a couple things I'd like to say to you in private.
:{{Color|menu|Lyney leads Freminet somewhere further away to speak.}}
:{{A|vo arlq001 6 creirve 05.ogg}} '''Clervie:''' Those two sure care a lot about each other.
:{{A|vo arlq001 6 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Well, they got a funny way of showing it. From where Paimon was floating, it sure seemed like they were about to bite each other's heads off...
:{{A|vo arlq001 6 creirve 06.ogg}} '''Clervie:''' No way! They have a really deep bond. I could tell right away, 'cause I also have a friend like that.
:{{A|vo arlq001 6 creirve 07.ogg}} '''Clervie:''' I just... don't know how long that kind of bond can last.
:{{DIcon}} What do you mean?
:{{A|vo arlq001 6 creirve 08.ogg}} '''Clervie:''' The darkness in the House runs deeper than you can imagine. No one can get out alive.
:{{A|vo arlq001 6 freminet 13.ogg}} '''Freminet:''' I'm sorry, Lyney. I really didn't mean to drag anyone else into this...
:{{A|vo arlq001 6 lyney 12.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Oh, really? You didn't mean to? 'Cause I, for one, wish you did.
:{{A|vo arlq001 6 freminet 14.ogg}} '''Freminet:''' Huh? What do you mean?
:{{A|vo arlq001 6 lyney 13.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Y'know, when we were younger, you didn't call me "Lyney." You called me "Brother," just like Lynette.
:{{A|vo arlq001 6 lyney 14.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' We grew up together, the three of us. We were all orphans, all rescued by "Father." Of all the siblings in the House of the Hearth, I think our bond was the closest.
:{{A|vo arlq001 6 lyney 15.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Later on, when you started calling me "Lyney," I wasn't actually surprised. After all, Lynette and I are related by blood. We've had to depend on each other to survive long before we joined the House.
:{{A|vo arlq001 6 freminet 15.ogg}} '''Freminet:''' Lyney, I...
:{{A|vo arlq001 6 lyney 16.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' The darkest and most difficult moments of my life happened before you and I had ever met — I'm sure that's true for you as well. Even so, Freminet, we've stood by each other for all these years now, and, to me, that means more than blood.
:{{A|vo arlq001 6 lyney 17.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' You and Lynette are the most important people in my life. No one can replace you. So, I won't let you face anything alone — not if I can help it.
:{{A|vo arlq001 6 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh no, looks like things are getting kinda heated between Lyney and Freminet... Maybe we should go check on them.

:{{A|vo arlq001 6 creirve 10.ogg}} '''Clervie:''' [[Perrie]]? Huh... Looks like she's not here either...
:{{A|vo arlq001 6 creirve 11.ogg}} '''Clervie:''' Ah, it's time to eat.

:{{A|vo arlq001 7 lyney 04.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Well, back to the matter at hand, then. If we don't plan on handing Clervie over to "Father," then our only other option is to solve the mystery of her identity before "Father" is able to track her down.
:{{A|vo arlq001 7 lyney 05.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' That means finding out where she came from and what she's doing here. Then, we can send her on her merry way and pretend like none of this ever happened.

:{{A|vo arlq001 7 freminet 05.ogg}} '''Freminet:''' She even came with us all the way to Poisson. It seems like wherever the House is, she follows.
:{{A|vo arlq001 7 lyney 07.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Hmm, I don't know much about spirits... Do you two have any ideas?
:{{A|vo arlq001 7 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Let's see here... Ooh! Paimon remembers hearing something like... If you fulfill a spirit's last wish before they died, they'll let go of whatever's keeping them here and return to the Ley Lines.
:{{A|vo arlq001 7 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' It's just that... Paimon doesn't really remember where she heard that... so it's not guaranteed to work or anything.
:{{A|vo arlq001 7 lyney 08.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Well, sounds like it's worth a shot. Guess that means we should go ask her about her wish. But first... Freminet, I need you to promise me something.
:{{A|vo arlq001 7 freminet 06.ogg}} '''Freminet:''' What is it?
:{{A|vo arlq001 7 lyney 09.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' I need you to promise me that this will stay between the two of us. We're the masterminds behind this whole thing — no one else gets involved. Can you do that for me?
:{{A|vo arlq001 7 freminet 07.ogg}} '''Freminet:''' Of course. I promise.
:{{A|vo arlq001 7 lyney 10.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Alright, then let's seal the promise just like when we were kids... Fist bump on three. Ready? One, two, three...
:{{A|vo arlq001 7 together 01.ogg}} '''Lyney & Freminet & Lynette:''' I swear.

:{{A|vo arlq001 8 lyney 01.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Clervie, if you've got some time, I'd like to ask you a few questions.
:{{A|vo arlq001 8 creirve 02.ogg}} '''Clervie:''' Sure.
:{{A|vo arlq001 8 creirve 03.ogg}} '''Clervie:''' Oh! Another new friend! Hi, I'm Clervie.
:{{A|vo arlq001 8 lynette 02.ogg}} '''Lynette:''' Hello.

:{{A|vo arlq001 8 creirve 05.ogg}} '''Clervie:''' The Knave brings you here, and then you can't leave.
:{{A|vo arlq001 8 lyney 03.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' It's just that... your name, it's not on the roster. And I've never seen you before.
:{{A|vo arlq001 8 creirve 06.ogg}} '''Clervie:''' The roster? Ah, I get it now. I think there might be some things you don't know about this place.
:{{A|vo arlq001 8 creirve 07.ogg}} '''Clervie:''' The people in charge... They're not as nice as they look. They say they keep a roster... but it's not complete. There are a lot of people who aren't on it... and never will be.
:{{A|vo arlq001 8 creirve 08.ogg}} '''Clervie:''' In this House, some people are "family" and other people... are just "test subjects." Those kinds of people aren't ever going to get a place on the roster... unless it's the roster of people who've been executed.
:{{A|vo arlq001 8 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wait, does that mean The Knave, she...
:{{A|vo arlq001 8 lyney 04.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Is there anyone that can vouch for you?
:{{A|vo arlq001 8 creirve 09.ogg}} '''Clervie:''' ...
:{{A|vo arlq001 8 creirve 10.ogg}} '''Clervie:''' Perrie. She's my best friend. She's the only one I trust in this place.
:{{A|vo arlq001 8 lyney 05.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Have either of you heard of that name before?
:{{A|vo arlq001 8 lynette 03.ogg}} '''Lynette:''' No.
:{{A|vo arlq001 8 freminet 04.ogg}} '''Freminet:''' Me neither...
:{{A|vo arlq001 8 lyney 06.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Clervie... Perrie... Neither of those names are on the roster.
:{{A|vo arlq001 8 lyney 07.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' But... it seems like she's telling the truth. Either that, or this kid's already got a bag of tricks bigger than mine.
:{{A|vo arlq001 8 lyney 08.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Hmm, maybe we should try a different approach. Clervie, do you have a wish?
:{{A|vo arlq001 8 creirve 11.ogg}} '''Clervie:''' A wish?
:{{A|vo arlq001 8 lyney 09.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' It can be anything you want. Just imagine — it's your birthday, you're blowing out the candles, and your wish is...
:{{A|vo arlq001 8 creirve 12.ogg}} '''Clervie:''' To... To go outside.
:{{A|vo arlq001 8 creirve 13.ogg}} '''Clervie:''' Where the sun can find me.
:{{A|vo arlq001 8 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' That's it? Well, that sounds easy enough.
:{{Color|menu|You recall what Clervie said...}}
:{{A|vo arlq001 8 creirve 14.ogg}} '''Clervie:''' The darkness in the House runs deeper than you can imagine. No one can get out alive.
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (What did she mean by that...? Things can't be this simple.)
:{{A|vo arlq001 8 lyney 10.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Okay, time to divide and conquer. Listen up. I've got a plan.
:{{A|vo arlq001 8 lyney 11.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' I'll try and find a way to use basic illusory magic to take Clervie outside and bring her somewhere with sunlight.
:{{A|vo arlq001 8 lyney 12.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Lynette, try and find the list of executions that Clervie was talking about, and see if her name is on it.
:{{A|vo arlq001 8 lyney 13.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Freminet, you stay in Poisson. We can't be the only ones who've had run ins with Clervie. I need you to collect intel on everything she's said and done.
:{{A|vo arlq001 8 lynette 04.ogg}} '''Lynette:''' Understood.
:{{A|vo arlq001 8 freminet 05.ogg}} '''Freminet:''' I'll try my best.
:{{A|vo arlq001 8 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What about us? What should we do?
:{{A|vo arlq001 8 lyney 14.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' I really appreciate your willingness to help, but this is a family matter. I don't want to drag you in too deep. It's too risky.
:{{A|vo arlq001 8 lyney 15.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Let me think... Since "Father" considers you to be guests, maybe you could stick by her side for a little while? You don't need to do anything except keep up some nice, casual conversation.
:{{A|vo arlq001 8 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ah, Paimon gets it! You want us to distract her!
:{{DIcon}} How should we contact you?
:{{A|vo arlq001 8 lyney 16.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' I'll give you a magic bird. If "Father" suspects something, all you need to do is release it when she's not looking, and it'll alert me that something's wrong.
:{{A|vo arlq001 8 lyney 17.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Of course, that's only as a last resort. If "Father" doesn't seem to notice us, there's no need to make contact. We'll reconvene here tonight after all's said and done.
:{{A|vo arlq001 8 lyney 18.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' If the worst-case scenario happens, and we're discovered, just tell "Father" everything. We're not going to let our guests get punished for our own actions — that's where we draw the line.
:{{DIcon}} Be careful.
:{{A|vo arlq001 8 lyney 19.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' You too... Okay, this is where we part. "Father" should be at the beach nearby.
:{{A|vo arlq001 8 lyney 20.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' I really hope this goes well. No... It has to go well. That's the only way this can get resolved.

==Steps==
# Leave [[Wolvendom]] with [[Barbara]]
# Report back to Sister Victoria
# Clean the Cathedral grounds
# Talk to Sister Victoria

==Dialogue==
{{Quest Description|At Barbara's request, you head back to [[Mondstadt]] to report to Sister Victoria.}}
===The Church's Affairs===

;(Heading back to Sister Victoria)
:{{A|vo bblcop001 1900303 barbara 01.ogg}} '''Barbara:''' Sister Victoria told me you already helped tidy up the Cathedral! Thank you so much!
:{{DIcon}} When did you get back?
:{{A|vo bblcop001 1900303 barbara 02.ogg}} '''Barbara:''' I just returned a short while ago. I can't thank you enough for how much you've helped me today, both here in the Cathedral and back in Wolvendom...
:{{A|vo bblcop001 1900303 barbara 03.ogg}} '''Barbara:''' You must be thirsty after so much work, no? How about I treat you to a drink?
:{{A|vo bblcop001 1900303 barbara 04.ogg}} '''Barbara:''' Oh, I've just remembered that the Cat's Tail is promoting a special drink recently.
:{{A|vo bblcop001 1900303 barbara 05.ogg}} '''Barbara:''' Miss Margaret said that the name of the drink is "Fantastic Summer-Serendipity Coral Sparkling Tea," haha!
:{{A|vo bblcop001 1900303 barbara 06.ogg}} '''Barbara:''' She also mentioned that it's her secret weapon to beating Angel's Share in drink sales.
:{{A|vo bblcop001 1900303 barbara 06.ogg}} '''Barbara:''' Word is that the drink's pretty good, but there's always a line to get it. We'll probably have to wait if we want some...
:{{A|vo bblcop001 1900303 barbara 07.ogg}} '''Barbara:''' If you'd rather not stand in line, I could make you a glass of my very own Chilibrew.
:{{A|vo bblcop001 1900303 barbara 08.ogg}}<!--{{A|vo bblcop001 1900303 barbara 09.ogg}}--> '''Barbara:''' Which would you like to drink?
:{{Hangout Branch|Fantastic Summer-Serendipity Coral Sparkling Tea does sound pretty amazing.|A Very Special Beverage#The Cat's Tail's Specialty|The Cat's Tail's Specialty}}

::{{A|vo bblcop001 1900303 barbara 23.ogg}} '''Barbara:''' But I have heard that the drink is quite popular now. There's even a line of people waiting to purchase it every day.
::{{A|vo bblcop001 1900303 barbara 24.ogg}} '''Barbara:''' If you'd like to get one, we should head over to the Cat's Tail as quickly as we can.
::{{A|vo bblcop001 1900303 barbara 25.ogg}} '''Barbara:''' However... even though I've already requested a half day of leave from Sister Victoria, she still insists that I let her know where I'm going...
::{{A|vo bblcop001 1900303 barbara 26.ogg}} '''Barbara:''' With so many people trying to get in on the newest Cat's Tail offering, I'm worried we'll have to wait for ages if we get there too late.
::{{A|vo bblcop001 1900303 barbara 27.ogg}} '''Barbara:''' Ah, I've got it! Why don't you help me check in with Sister Victoria while I get in line at the Cat's Tail? That would save us some time!
::{{A|vo bblcop001 1900303 barbara 28.ogg}} '''Barbara:''' What do you think?
::{{DIcon}} Sounds good to me.
::{{A|vo bblcop001 1900303 barbara 29.ogg}} '''Barbara:''' It's settled then! Let's meet up at the entrance to the Cat's Tail.
::{{DIcon}} But what if you run into people asking for an autograph?
::{{A|vo bblcop001 1900303 barbara 30.ogg}} '''Barbara:''' I—It'll be fine... I'll just tell them that today is my day off. I'm sure they'll understand.
::{{A|vo bblcop001 1900303 barbara 31.ogg}} '''Barbara:''' Let's get going then. See you at the Cat's Tail!
::
:;(Talk to Sister Victoria)
::{{A|vo bblcop001 1900306 victoria 01.ogg}} '''Victoria:''' Yes, my child?
::{{DIcon}} About Barbara's time off...
::{{A|vo bblcop001 1900306 victoria 02.ogg}} '''Victoria:''' Oh yes, Sister Barbara just submitted her request for half a day's leave. She said she had plans with a friend.
::{{A|vo bblcop001 1900306 victoria 03.ogg}} '''Victoria:''' I must say though, it is quite unusual for Barbara to request time off just to see a friend...
::{{A|vo bblcop001 1900306 victoria 04.ogg}} '''Victoria:''' But that's beside the point. What is it you'd like to ask me?
::{{DIcon}} About "Fantastic Summer-Serendipity Coral Sparkling Tea"...
::{{A|vo bblcop001 1900306 victoria 05.ogg}} '''Victoria:''' Oh? You mean to tell me that Barbara intends to accompany you to buy this... special drink?
::{{A|vo bblcop001 1900306 victoria 06.ogg}} '''Victoria:''' Then you must be the friend that she mentioned, I presume?
::{{A|vo bblcop001 1900306 victoria 07.ogg}} '''Victoria:''' Hmm, seeing as you're the Honorary Knight, I guess that's fine...
::{{A|vo bblcop001 1900306 victoria 08.ogg}} '''Victoria:''' Well, then please take good care of Sister Barbara.
::{{DIcon}} Why does Barbara always have to report her plans?
::{{A|vo bblcop001 1900306 victoria 09.ogg}} '''Victoria:''' Well, as you may already know, Sister Barbara is quite popular in [[Mondstadt]] for several reasons...
::{{A|vo bblcop001 1900306 victoria 10.ogg}} '''Victoria:''' Although the citizens here may only be acting out of good intention, there are too many of them, and Sister Barbara can't handle it all
::{{A|vo bblcop001 1900306 victoria 11.ogg}} '''Victoria:''' If they appear while she is working here at the Church, we can come and intervene.
::{{A|vo bblcop001 1900306 victoria 12.ogg}} '''Victoria:''' But if she's approached by fans during her time off, then she can only fend for herself.
::{{A|vo bblcop001 1900306 victoria 13.ogg}} '''Victoria:''' And no to mention, she's too... kind. She'll always try to fulfill the requests of the citizens of Mondstadt, even when it takes a heavy toll and leaves her more exhausted than actual working hours.
