:{{A|vo dialog sdeq003 yaemiko 01.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' ...Yes, every celebration must come to an end.

;(Talk to Kaedehara Kazuha, optional)
:{{A|vo dialog sdeq003 kazuha 01.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' Are you enjoying yourself? How about we go eat together?

;(Talk to Sayu or Kamisato Ayaka, optional)
:{{A|vo dialog sdeq003 sayu 01.ogg}} '''Sayu:''' Zzz...
:{{A|vo dialog sdeq003 ayaka 01.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' One bowl of ramen shouldn't hurt, right?...

;(Talk to Arataki Itto or Gorou, optional)
:{{A|vo dialog sdeq003 itto 01.ogg}} '''Arataki Itto:''' Weird... Where did all the fish go?
:{{A|vo dialog sdeq003 gorou 01.ogg}} '''Gorou:''' Don't worry. Let's go try another spot.

{{Dialogue End}}
{{Quest Description|update|Chizuru has something to say to you.}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Approach the marked area)
:{{A|vo sdeq003 27 chizuru 01.ogg}} '''Hanyuuda Chizuru:''' Alright, here will do. Thank you for agreeing to come with me.
:{{DIcon}} Don't mention it.
:{{A|vo sdeq003 27 chizuru 02.ogg}} '''Hanyuuda Chizuru:''' Actually, I was delighted when I first discovered that I could take on a human form.
:{{A|vo sdeq003 27 chizuru 03.ogg}} '''Hanyuuda Chizuru:''' I was a youkai derived from a pair of hagoita who came into being in the middle of a festival, so naturally I enjoyed the lively festival atmosphere.
:{{A|vo sdeq003 27 chizuru 04.ogg}} '''Hanyuuda Chizuru:''' I wanted to go to more festivals, become friends with humans, and play Akitsu Yuugei with them.
:{{A|vo sdeq003 27 chizuru 05.ogg}} '''Hanyuuda Chizuru:''' But every evening as night began to set in, I'd recall the bitter smile of the old samurai as he set down the hagoita, and the lonely Kamai sighing as he drank his sake.
:{{A|vo sdeq003 27 chizuru 06.ogg}} '''Hanyuuda Chizuru:''' Then I would wonder... if I became friends with a human, would that person experience the same melancholy in the future?
:{{A|vo sdeq003 27 chizuru 07.ogg}} '''Hanyuuda Chizuru:''' As a result, I was convinced that I couldn't do it. I told myself that I would not repeat that same mistake.
:{{DIcon}} I understand what you mean.
:{{A|vo sdeq003 27 chizuru 08.ogg}} '''Hanyuuda Chizuru:''' I'm sorry that I spoke so strangely when we first met... I'm sure it must have scared you.
:{{A|vo sdeq003 27 chizuru 09.ogg}} '''Hanyuuda Chizuru:''' I expected you to flee in terror, but when we met again, you acted like you had no trouble being around me.
:{{A|vo sdeq003 27 chizuru 10.ogg}} '''Hanyuuda Chizuru:''' I knew you mistook me as one of the youkai, but instead of telling you the truth, I went and played Akitsu Yuugei with you...
:{{DIcon}} Why?
:{{A|vo sdeq003 27 chizuru 11.ogg}} '''Hanyuuda Chizuru:''' Hmm... I'm not completely sure myself.
:{{A|vo sdeq003 27 chizuru 12.ogg}} '''Hanyuuda Chizuru:''' Perhaps it's because I've always wanted to be like Kamai and play Akitsu Yuugei with humans.
:{{A|vo sdeq003 27 chizuru 13.ogg}} '''Hanyuuda Chizuru:''' Or perhaps it was because I knew I didn't have much time left and I didn't want to be alone...
:{{A|vo sdeq003 27 chizuru 14.ogg}} '''Hanyuuda Chizuru:''' Anyway, thank you for taking the time to play with me.
:{{DIcon}} ...
:{{A|vo sdeq003 27 chizuru 15.ogg}} '''Hanyuuda Chizuru:''' When we played Akitsu Yuugei, Paimon said the loser would have to grant the winner a wish.
:{{A|vo sdeq003 27 chizuru 16.ogg}} '''Hanyuuda Chizuru:''' At the time, I wished for us to never cross paths again.
:{{A|vo sdeq003 27 chizuru 17.ogg}} '''Hanyuuda Chizuru:''' However, you still came and found me, meaning you never granted my wish. So... can I make another wish?
:{{DIcon}} Of course.
:{{DIcon}} As long as I can fulfill it.
:{{A|vo sdeq003 27 chizuru 18.ogg}} '''Hanyuuda Chizuru:''' Let me think... I wish for you to remember me... Ah no, I only have one wish, so I'd better make it count.
:{{A|vo sdeq003 27 chizuru 19.ogg}} '''Hanyuuda Chizuru:''' Okay, listen carefully. My wish is...
:;(Fireworks start to go off)
:{{A|vo sdeq003 27 chizuru 20.ogg}} '''Hanyuuda Chizuru:''' "I wish that every day of your journey ahead will be filled with joy like a festival."
:;(Chizuru disappears, leaving the Traveler standing alone by the shore)
:;(Quest ends)
{{Dialogue End}}
----
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Talk to Sayu, optional)
:{{A|vo sdeq003 36 sayu 01.ogg}} '''Sayu:''' Zzz... I've grown taller... hehe...
:{{A|vo sdeq003 36 sayu 02.ogg}} '''Sayu:''' I'm so tall... Everyone else looks so tiny now... Zzz...

;(Talk to Yoimiya, optional)
:{{A|vo dialog sdeq004 yoimiya 01.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' Every year, when the fireworks go off, I say to myself, "Another year has already passed."
:{{A|vo dialog sdeq004 yoimiya 02.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' As each year passes by, your life gradually approaches its end.
:{{A|vo dialog sdeq004 yoimiya 03.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' But I don't think that's a bad thing. Like I always say, fireworks are for now, but friends are forever.

;(Talk to Yae Miko, optional)
:{{A|vo dialog sdeq004 yaemiko 01.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' When Ayato approached me about holding the Test of Courage event, it dawned on me that this would be the perfect opportunity to help Chizuru face her problem.
:{{A|vo dialog sdeq004 yaemiko 02.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' Kamai and the samurai's parting was one of the first things she experienced when she was partially sentient and didn't have her human form yet.
:{{A|vo dialog sdeq004 yaemiko 03.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' This was a very traumatic experience for her, and she could never come to grips with it by reasoning alone.
:{{A|vo dialog sdeq004 yaemiko 04.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' The best option was for her to directly interact with humans. There's no need to feel sad, I believe she was content when she left us.

;(Talk to Kamisato Ayato, optional)
:{{A|vo dialog sdeq004 ayato 01.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' So, did you enjoy the Test of Courage?
:{{A|vo dialog sdeq004 ayato 02.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' Once I learned of the youkai's intentions to hold a festival, I wanted to spread the word and attract people to their event.
:{{A|vo dialog sdeq004 ayato 03.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' However, it occurred to me that doing so might be overly ambitious. If we marketed the Mikawa Flower Festival from the get-go, people would have arrived with insatiably high expectations.
:{{A|vo dialog sdeq004 ayato 04.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' So I decided on using the Test of Courage's notoriety to attract visitors and left the rest to the youkai.
:{{A|vo dialog sdeq004 ayato 05.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' I had an inkling that their presence would spice up the event, hehe...

;(Talk to Youko, optional)
:'''Youko:''' Will you be here for the next Mikawa Flower Festival?

;(Talk to Kamisato Ayaka, optional)
:{{A|vo dialog sdeq004 ayaka 01.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' Ah, after hearing Chizuru describe the original Mikawa Flower Festival, I wanted to arrange another chance to talk with her about it.
:{{A|vo dialog sdeq004 ayaka 02.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' I didn't expect that would be our last conversation...

;(Talk to [[Yoshiharu]], optional)
:'''Yoshiharu:''' I'd be great if festivals like this are held everyday!

;(Talk to [[Hitomi (Inazuma)|Hitomi]], optional)
:'''Hitomi:''' I've been practicing for a really long time so that I'll actually scare people. I can finally take a break from that now...

;(Talk to Kaedehara Kazuha or Shikanoin Heizou, optional)
:{{A|vo dialog sdeq004 heizou 01.ogg}} '''Shikanoin Heizou:''' Will you have some time in the next few days, Kazuha?
:{{A|vo dialog sdeq004 heizou 02.ogg}} '''Shikanoin Heizou:''' I'd like you to work on a case with me.
:{{A|vo dialog sdeq004 kazuha 01.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' Oh? Did you run into some trouble?
:{{A|vo dialog sdeq004 heizou 03.ogg}} '''Shikanoin Heizou:''' Not exactly. It's just an old case with almost no tangible leads.
:{{A|vo dialog sdeq004 heizou 04.ogg}} '''Shikanoin Heizou:''' But I believe your attuned sense of nature might allow us to discover some new clues.
:{{A|vo dialog sdeq004 kazuha 02.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' Sure. I can stay after the festival and we can go investigate together.
:{{A|vo dialog sdeq004 heizou 05.ogg}} '''Shikanoin Heizou:''' Great, thank you!
:{{A|vo dialog sdeq004 kazuha 03.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' My pleasure. It's no trouble at all.

;(Talk to Kappa, optional)<!--no audio-->
:'''Kappa:''' I love playing with humans...

;(Talk to Arataki Itto, optional)
:{{A|vo dialog sdeq004 itto 01.ogg}} '''Arataki Itto:''' Lifespans, partings... It really gets you thinking, doesn't it? ...But uh, I got nothing.
:{{A|vo dialog sdeq004 itto 02.ogg}} '''Arataki Itto:''' Alls I know is that I'll never regret meeting you! Hahaha!

;(Talk to Gorou, optional)
:{{A|vo dialog sdeq004 gorou 01.ogg}} '''Gorou:''' It was heartbreaking to learn of Chizuru's story.
:{{A|vo dialog sdeq004 gorou 02.ogg}} '''Gorou:''' To be honest, I experience that same kind of sorrow when I'm on the battlefield. I don't know when I'll lose my comrades, so I try to appreciate every moment.

;(Talk to Thoma, optional)
:{{A|vo sdeq003 35 thoma 01.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' Even though I knew my lord had most likely planned everything before the Test of Courage even began, I was still caught off guard.
:{{A|vo sdeq003 35 thoma 02.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' But, in retrospect, it was a lot of fun.

;(Talk to [[Tomohiro]], optional)<!--no audio-->
:'''Tomohiro:''' The sales are rapidly increasing today. We're almost running out of stock, haha!

;(Talk to Hitotsume Kozou, optional)<!--no audio-->
:'''Hitotsume Kozou:''' I'll always treasure this water balloon...
{{Dialogue End}}

==Dialogue==
{{Quest Description|After the sands have settled, you and the others bid farewell to the ancient grounds and return to the Akademiya...}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
:{{A|vo cnlq105 1 sethos 01.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' Grandfather...
:{{Black Screen|You, [[Sethos]], and the other members of [[Temple of Silence|the Temple]] bid farewell to [[Bamoun]].}}
:{{Black Screen|In the great hall, people gather around the coffin to pay their respects. The atmosphere is solemn.}}
:{{A|vo cnlq105 1 sethos 02.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' ...
:{{A|vo cnlq105 1 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hey, Sethos... You'll get through this.
:{{A|vo cnlq105 1 sethos 03.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' I know, I just... I'll miss him.
:{{DIcon}} I am so sorry for your loss.
:{{A|vo cnlq105 1 tighnari 01.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' I guess you were prepared for this. It's been a long time coming, huh?
:{{A|vo cnlq105 1 sethos 04.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' Yeah. He's been on death's door for a very long time now. I think it was only through sheer willpower that he managed to hold on to this point.
:{{A|vo cnlq105 1 sethos 05.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' ...At least he was able to see this chapter come to a close before he passed.
:{{A|vo cnlq105 1 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What's next for you?
:{{A|vo cnlq105 1 sethos 06.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' Per my grandfather's last wishes, the Temple of Silence should submit to whoever possesses the largest number of [[Hermanubis]] fragments. That entitles you to be our new leader, Cyno.
:{{A|vo cnlq105 1 cyno 01.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' But that's never going to work, as I'm sure you realize. I'm the [[General Mahamatra]]. I am needed back at [[the Akademiya]].
:{{A|vo cnlq105 1 cyno 02.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' I did foresee this possibility, and I gave it some thought. The fact is, I know next to nothing about the staff, records, and environment here. As such, I am ill-suited to be your leader.
:{{A|vo cnlq105 1 cyno 03.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Sethos, I believe the honor should go to you.
:{{A|vo cnlq105 1 cyno 04.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Were it not for this duel, or indeed if you had other intentions... The Ba Fragments would most likely be in your hands by now. I'm sure Bamoun never meant for anyone but you to be his successor.
:{{A|vo cnlq105 1 sethos 07.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' You really think so?
:{{A|vo cnlq105 1 cyno 05.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' I do.
:{{A|vo cnlq105 1 tighnari 02.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Still, I didn't think Bamoun looked very surprised by the final result. Perhaps he had an inkling that this would be the way things end.
:{{A|vo cnlq105 1 cyno 06.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Well, in any case, since the Ba Fragments are with me now, I guess I can call the shots.
:{{A|vo cnlq105 1 cyno 07.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Sethos, I would like you to succeed Bamoun as the new leader of the Temple of Silence. You are more suited to the role than I, and I have complete faith that you will be an excellent leader. Just think of it as doing me a favor.
:{{A|vo cnlq105 1 sethos 08.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' But doesn't that render everything that we've been through up to now meaningless?
:{{A|vo cnlq105 1 cyno 08.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' No, it doesn't. This experience has allowed us to become friends, which means that the Akademiya and the Temple of Silence will become partners once more.
:{{A|vo cnlq105 1 cyno 09.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' That's a much bigger deal than you might think, Sethos. You said yourself, times have changed. You have to believe that things can change for the better here at the Temple, too.
:{{A|vo cnlq105 1 sethos 09.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' ...I will try. To be honest, I couldn't have asked for a better outcome.
:{{A|vo cnlq105 1 cyno 10.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Actually, part of me wonders whether Bamoun's intention from the very beginning was just to create enough pressure to force us towards a duel.
:{{A|vo cnlq105 1 cyno 11.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' That way, no matter who won, one of us would have to surrender our Ba Fragment, and the power of Hermanubis would be concentrated in one single person.
:{{A|vo cnlq105 1 cyno 12.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Had you won, the Temple of Silence would have doubled its strength.
:{{A|vo cnlq105 1 cyno 13.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' And were I to win, he correctly anticipated that I wouldn't suddenly drop everything to become the leader of the Temple, much less integrate the Temple into the Akademiya by force.
:{{A|vo cnlq105 1 cyno 14.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' He knew that the Temple's future would depend not just on the guidance of Hermanubis, but the support of the Akademiya too. So he made it his responsibility to ensure his successor would be free from the burdens of the past.
:{{A|vo cnlq105 1 cyno 15.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' His plan meant that whoever ended up succeeding him, they would have an easier time interacting with the Akademiya. With one single letter, he lured out the Professor... No matter what happened after that, it would result in a net benefit to the Temple.
:{{A|vo cnlq105 1 sethos 10.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' ...And here I thought the General Mahamatra wouldn't care for all these trivial details.
:{{A|vo cnlq105 1 sethos 11.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' You're absolutely right. Grandfather and I considered this from every angle. We had to find a way to mend our relationship with the Akademiya... In that sense, the Rite of Duels was just a means to an end.
:{{A|vo cnlq105 1 sethos 12.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' Thank you for everything, Cyno. As a gesture of our gratitude, to those that you and [[Lesser Lord Kusanali]] deem worthy, I will grant the honor of access to the Temple of Silence for their pursuit of knowledge.
:{{A|vo cnlq105 1 sethos 13.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' The Temple of Silence has a wealth of information on [[King Deshret]]'s civilization, more than any other organization in existence today. In times when you need information that only we can provide, we will be here to support you.
:{{A|vo cnlq105 1 sethos 14.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' But you must be exceedingly careful with your selection of candidates, lest you lead humanity to repeat the same mistakes.
:{{A|vo cnlq105 1 sethos 15.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' By the way, [[Tighnari]], my grandfather was so happy to see you. You are a descendant of the Valuka Shuna, and we are the heirs to the will of Hermanubis.
:{{A|vo cnlq105 1 sethos 16.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' The story goes that King Deshret chose the sage Hermanubis from among the [[Tighnarians]], and appointed him as his familiar.
:{{A|vo cnlq105 1 sethos 17.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' He went on to fight many valiant battles with his Tighnarian companions. They always stood by each other, from the founding of the Temple of Silence to the fall of [[Tulaytullah]].
:{{A|vo cnlq105 1 sethos 18.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' The Tighnarians who left Tulaytullah joined their human counterparts in the rainforest. A few centuries later, when some of the group returned to the desert, many of the Tighnarians chose to stay, and put down roots in the rainforest.
:{{A|vo cnlq105 1 sethos 19.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' In all likelihood, those were your ancestors.
:{{A|vo cnlq105 1 tighnari 03.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' How fascinating... My father once mentioned that I was named after the Tighnarians, but I never knew that my forbearers had such a history with the Temple of Silence.
:{{A|vo cnlq105 1 cyno 16.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' I like this story.
:{{A|vo cnlq105 1 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' By the way, has anyone seen Cyrus?
:{{A|vo cnlq105 1 sethos 20.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' Ah yes, Cyrus... You'll probably find him in my grandfather's room. He wouldn't show it in front of me, but I think he still has many fond memories of my grandfather.
:{{A|vo cnlq105 1 tighnari 04.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' If it's true that you and your grandfather really planned for everything to turn out this way, then I guess he didn't really resent Cyrus as much as he appeared to.
:{{A|vo cnlq105 1 sethos 21.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' Heh, who knows? Perhaps all of us — you, me, and Cyrus — were all just pawns in my grandfather's plan to set things straight. He was awful like that.
:{{A|vo cnlq105 1 cyno 17.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Someone's got to make the decisions when history is at a crossroads.
:{{A|vo cnlq105 1 cyno 18.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' I will make a detailed report on all of this to Lesser Lord Kusanali, and arrange for an official delegation from the Akademiya to come and meet you in the desert.
:{{A|vo cnlq105 1 cyno 19.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' I'm sure you'll have lots to attend to in the days ahead. But once things return to normal, please come and visit the rainforest again. You should stay for a few days this time, and start to build some relationships.
:{{A|vo cnlq105 1 cyno 20.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' If we're going to work together, both sides have to get to know one another better.
:{{A|vo cnlq105 1 sethos 22.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' I will.
:{{A|vo cnlq105 1 sethos 23.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' Alright, well... Bye for now, everyone. I'll be seeing you.
:{{A|vo cnlq105 1 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' See you soon! Come hang out with us anytime!
:{{DIcon}} Best of luck to you, Sethos.

;(Use [[Nahida]]'s [[All Schemes to Know]] on Sethos, optional)
:{{A|vo cnlq105 2 sethos 01.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' (Did you see, Grandfather? Cyno chose me to succeed you as leader of the Temple of Silence. I will now serve in his stead.)
:{{A|vo cnlq105 2 sethos 02.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' (It's still early days, and I can't say that I know him that well yet. But after that battle, I now understand why he came here with a whole group of friends.)
:{{A|vo cnlq105 2 sethos 03.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' (Companionship means to trust and be trusted. Just like Cyno and his friends, we too will fight side by side and support each other in times of trouble.)

;(Talk to Sethos, optional)
:{{A|vo dialog cnlq105 sethos 01.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' ...Grandfather, we did it. We achieved what we set out to do.
:{{A|vo dialog cnlq105 sethos 02.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' From this day on, the Temple of Silence has the chance to work with the Akademiya once more. Real change, real opportunities... They are now within our grasp.

;(Use Nahida's All Schemes to Know on Cyrus, optional)
:{{A|vo cnlq105 2 spantamadcyrus 01.ogg}} '''Cyrus:''' (All these years, I've felt like I'm still young, I still have lots to look forward to in life.)
:{{A|vo cnlq105 2 spantamadcyrus 02.ogg}} '''Cyrus:''' (But now... I suddenly feel...)
:{{A|vo cnlq105 2 spantamadcyrus 03.ogg}} '''Cyrus:''' (I too have grown old, Bamoun, just like you.)

:{{A|vo sglq003 2 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' That's what makes it so special.
:{{A|vo sglq003 2 raidenei 05.ogg}} '''Ei:''' Hang on, I'm still struggling to understand this. I need you to explain it again...
:{{A|vo sglq003 2 raidenei 06.ogg}} '''Ei:''' So the one in this photo... are you sure it isn't me?
:{{A|vo sglq003 2 raidenei 07.ogg}} '''Ei:''' If it's not me, then why does she look exactly like me? And if she is me, then... who am I?
:{{A|vo sglq003 2 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Uh... okay, way above Paimon's head— over to you, {{Traveler}}!
:{{DIcon}} It's a little bit like you and the Shogun.
:{{A|vo sglq003 2 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hey, that's right. Do you think the Shogun counts as you?
:{{A|vo sglq003 2 raidenei 08.ogg}} '''Ei:''' Of course I do. It was never my intention to place control of Inazuma into anybody else's hands.
:{{A|vo sglq003 2 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So then, who does that make you, here and now?
:{{A|vo sglq003 2 raidenei 09.ogg}} '''Ei:''' Well I'm still me. There is no doubt about that.
:{{DIcon}} So your existence isn't singular.
:{{A|vo sglq003 2 raidenei 10.ogg}} '''Ei:''' My existence, hmm...
:{{A|vo sglq003 2 raidenei 11.ogg}} '''Ei:''' I think I understand.
:{{A|vo sglq003 2 raidenei 12.ogg}} '''Ei:''' I am me. There is only one of me, but I can exist in many different forms. It's not important what form I exist in.
:{{A|vo sglq003 2 raidenei 13.ogg}} '''Ei:''' The Shogun, for example, is one of my forms of existence. The question of whether or not she is me is not determined by any of her components.
:{{A|vo sglq003 2 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' In that case, this picture is one of your forms of existence, too.
:{{A|vo sglq003 2 raidenei 14.ogg}} '''Ei:''' Hmm. So even I, who seeks Eternity, am constantly changing my form of existence...
:{{A|vo sglq003 2 raidenei 15.ogg}} '''Ei:''' Then, how can I ask Inazuma and everyone who lives here to remain unchanging?
:{{DIcon}} Inazuma will always be Inazuma.
:{{DIcon}} Human beings will always be human.
:{{A|vo sglq003 2 raidenei 16.ogg}} '''Ei:''' Everything I have encountered on this journey with you has been from beyond my existing sphere of knowledge.
:{{A|vo sglq003 2 raidenei 17.ogg}} '''Ei:''' *sigh* You've seen a lot of my ignorant side today. Maybe you can't tell, but all this has challenged my understanding of things.
:{{A|vo sglq003 2 raidenei 18.ogg}} '''Ei:''' Based on what I have seen today, I am forced to accept that Inazuma is a completely different place from the one I remember.
:{{A|vo sglq003 2 raidenei 19.ogg}} '''Ei:''' But it would be incorrect to conclude from this that the Inazuma of today is no longer Inazuma.
:{{DIcon}} Right.
:{{A|vo sglq003 2 raidenei 20.ogg}} '''Ei:''' Both the Vision Hunt Decree and the Statue of the Omnipresent God were conceived as a means of bringing about Eternity. But if I were really getting closer to Eternity, none of this ever would have happened.
:{{A|vo sglq003 2 raidenei 21.ogg}} '''Ei:''' Hmm...
:{{A|vo sglq003 2 raidenei 22.ogg}} '''Ei:''' Perhaps... perhaps I've been holding on to everything too tightly.
:{{A|vo sglq003 2 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Sounds to Paimon like Ei's figured things out!
:{{A|vo sglq003 2 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' And that means that we've done a really great job as her guides!
:{{A|vo sglq003 2 ippei 01.ogg}} '''Ippei:''' Master Kamaji! Master Kamaji!
:{{A|vo sglq003 2 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hmm? Why's it getting so noisy down there?
:{{A|vo sglq003 2 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' That sounded like Ippei. What could be the matter?
:{{A|vo sglq003 2 raidenei 23.ogg}} '''Ei:''' Ippei? Is that someone from the Tenryou Commission?
:{{A|vo sglq003 2 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yep. Let's find out what's going on.
----
{{Quest Description|update|Ei seems especially concerned as to whether "the person in the picture is her or not." After some discussion, she receives an answer that satisfies her... but that is when you head the voice of Ippei, Kujou Kamaji's servant.}}
;(Approach Ippei)
:{{A|vo sglq003 3 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hey, Ippei, what's the matter?
:{{A|vo sglq003 3 ippei 01.ogg}} '''Ippei:''' Ah, it's you. I...
:{{A|vo sglq003 3 ippei 02.ogg}} '''Ippei:''' Huh? Th—The Almighty Shogun!?
:{{A|vo sglq003 3 ippei 03.ogg}} '''Ippei:''' You must be looking for my master, Kujou Kamaji? I'm very sorry, he's not here at the moment. But if it pleases you, I will gladly deliver a message on your behalf?
:{{A|vo sglq003 3 raidenei 01.ogg}} '''Ei:''' It's okay, I'm not here to see him. We just heard you calling out, so we came to see what was going on.
:{{DIcon}} Are you looking for your master?
:{{A|vo sglq003 3 ippei 04.ogg}} '''Ippei:''' Yes. Master Kamaji still hasn't returned from the negotiations, and I'm starting to get worried.
:{{A|vo sglq003 3 ippei 05.ogg}} '''Ippei:''' In fairness, he does have a habit of taking long walks and coming back late. It's perfectly possible that he just found somewhere he likes and lost track of time.
:{{A|vo sglq003 3 ippei 06.ogg}} '''Ippei:''' But for some reason, today I'm particularly nervous.
:{{A|vo sglq003 3 raidenei 02.ogg}} '''Ei:''' Kujou Kamaji... A descendant of the Kujou Clan, I presume.
:{{A|vo sglq003 3 ippei 07.ogg}} '''Ippei:''' That's right. Apologies, since the head of the clan is in poor health at the moment, and Master Masahito is rarely home, Master Kamaji is currently serving as representative of the Kujou Clan.
:{{A|vo sglq003 3 raidenei 03.ogg}} '''Ei:''' I have heard that things are quite tumultuous within the Tenryou Commission at present. Does this have anything to do with Kujou Kamaji?
:{{A|vo sglq003 3 ippei 08.ogg}} '''Ippei:''' Forgive us, Almighty Shogun. The Kujou Clan has failed in its duty.
:{{A|vo sglq003 3 ippei 09.ogg}} '''Ippei:''' The Kujou Clan's reputation is damaged and its power over the Tenryou Commission is in decline. Plus you, um... ahem, you have yet to issue a verdict on the Commission's future...
:{{A|vo sglq003 3 ippei 10.ogg}} '''Ippei:''' So, Master Kamaji decided to enter negotiations with the Takatsukasa Clan with a view of having them take over...
:{{A|vo sglq003 3 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Surely they would be discussing something like that at their headquarters, right? Why are you looking for them here?
:{{A|vo sglq003 3 ippei 11.ogg}} '''Ippei:''' Actually, they decided to hold this one elsewhere. I'm a little confused as to why, to be honest, but I didn't feel it was my place to question the higher-ups.
:{{A|vo sglq003 3 ippei 12.ogg}} '''Ippei:''' The meeting place is in the mountains near the Grand Narukami Shrine. I believe the Takatsukasa Clan have some kind of base there.
:{{A|vo sglq003 3 raidenei 04.ogg}} '''Ei:''' Takatsukasa... another familiar name. They have been faithfully serving the Kujou Clan all these years?
:{{A|vo sglq003 3 ippei 13.ogg}} '''Ippei:''' Yes, yes. That's why Master Kamaji decided to discuss things with them. I understand they must have had a lot of ground to cover, but still, there's no way it should have gone on this long.
:{{A|vo sglq003 3 ippei 14.ogg}} '''Ippei:''' I've searched all over the city. If he really hasn't returned yet, then...
:{{DIcon}} Maybe they haven't finished.
:{{DIcon}} Maybe something's happened.
:{{A|vo sglq003 3 ippei 15.ogg}} '''Ippei:''' Yeah, I thought of that possibility too... but someone of my rank can't just go venturing into Takatsukasa Clan territory like that.
:{{DIcon}} We can go check things out for you.
:{{A|vo sglq003 3 ippei 16.ogg}} '''Ippei:''' No, no need. I'm probably just overthinking things. Besides, if they're still at it, they'll only blame me for interrupting the negotiations.
:{{A|vo sglq003 3 ippei 17.ogg}} '''Ippei:''' I'm only a lowly servant, but Master Kamaji and I grew up together... It'd be terrible if anything ever happened to him.
:{{A|vo sglq003 3 ippei 18.ogg}} '''Ippei:''' I'm not as smart as Master, so I can't really share his burdens. But the last thing I'd want would be for him to come to harm when I could've done something about it.
:{{A|vo sglq003 3 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hmm... what do you think, Almighty Shogun?
:{{A|vo sglq003 3 raidenei 05.ogg}} '''Ei:''' Let's go see what's happening.
:{{A|vo sglq003 3 raidenei 06.ogg}} '''Ei:''' With me present, they are unlikely to blame you even if we do happen to interrupt the negotiations.
:{{A|vo sglq003 3 raidenei 07.ogg}} '''Ei:''' Besides, this has only come about because I failed to make a timely decision. This issue started with me, and I shall be the one to finish it.
:{{DIcon}} That's commitment, right there.
:{{DIcon}} Awesome stuff.
:{{A|vo sglq003 3 ippei 19.ogg}} '''Ippei:''' Thank you so much, Shogun! I'll keep looking around in the meantime, too!
:{{A|vo sglq003 3 ippei 20.ogg}} '''Ippei:''' Let me mark out the location of the base for you. I hope everything goes smoothly!
{{Dialogue End}}

{{Quest Description|As the final experiments proceed, Albedo obtains more and more data related to you, and the alchemy he envisages begins to take shape. Finally, after a simple test of your physical capabilities, the experiments draw to a close...}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Upon reaching the location of the intelligence test)
:{{A|vo abdlq006 1 albedo 01.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' I imagine you must have encountered more than a few conundrums during your travels.
:{{A|vo abdlq006 1 albedo 02.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' I'd like to observe your intelligence by means of a practical test of your capabilities — much as we did for the physical test.
:{{DIcon}} No problem.
:{{DIcon}} Wouldn't a written test suffice...?
:{{A|vo abdlq006 1 albedo 03.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' I'd like you to explore these ruins and return with your findings.
:{{A|vo abdlq006 1 albedo 04.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' There are two puzzles located at the far ends of the ruins. After completion, you should be able to activate the mechanism in the center.
:{{A|vo abdlq006 1 albedo 05.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' As with the physical test, there are no restrictions. Everything you do is an action I wish to observe.
:{{DIcon}} I'm getting good at these.
::{{A|vo abdlq006 1 albedo 06a.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' A tried and tested adventurer I see.
:{{DIcon}} Where there's a will, there's a way.
::{{A|vo abdlq006 1 albedo 06b.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Remember that this is a test of intellect. So should you get lucky in any way, that won't be factored in as part of the test.
:{{A|vo abdlq006 1 albedo 07.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' So, let's see you in action. Start wherever you like.

;(Approach the two Seelie Gardens)

:{{A|vo abdlq006 2 albedo 03.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Returning them to their rightful places is up to you, {{Traveler}}.

:{{DIcon}} I feel like I've seen these before...
:{{A|vo abdlq006 3 albedo 02.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' To the best of my knowledge, these belong to a script of some kind. They can be found all over [[Teyvat]], but they've never given up their secrets.
:{{A|vo abdlq006 3 albedo 03.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' There's still a lot to learn about them, and as for why they should ever have come to rest here... A true mystery.
:{{A|vo abdlq006 3 albedo 04.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Let me make a copy first. I'll make time to go over them in greater detail after our research.

:{{A|vo abdlq006 3 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Seems like if you want the reward, you gotta pay the price.
:{{A|vo abdlq006 3 albedo 05.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' I've truly gained a lot from all this. Comparatively, the little reward I can offer is too small to mention.

:{{A|vo abdlq006 3 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Paimon's kinda looking forward to seeing the result of all this brain ache...
:{{A|vo abdlq006 3 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Unless you can think of anything better to do, let's head back to the campsite.
:{{A|vo abdlq006 3 rosaria 01.ogg}} '''[[Rosaria]]:''' Not so fast. You're not leaving until I'm convinced that nothing dangerous is going on here.
:{{A|vo abdlq006 3 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wah! You! You didn't leave the mountain!?
:{{A|vo abdlq006 3 rosaria 02.ogg}} '''Rosaria:''' I most certainly did not. And I've witnessed everything that you and Albedo have been up to.
:{{A|vo abdlq006 3 rosaria 03.ogg}} '''Rosaria:''' I must say, you let your guards down. Or maybe you were drawn in by his compelling-sounding hypothesis and friendly demeanor?
:{{DIcon}} What do you mean?
:{{DIcon}} He has ulterior motives?
:{{A|vo abdlq006 3 rosaria 04.ogg}} '''Rosaria:''' Taking orders from a complete stranger, drinking anonymous potions, participating in all kinds of strange experiments?
:{{A|vo abdlq006 3 rosaria 05.ogg}} '''Rosaria:''' I'd sooner believe you were tricked than that you would be so naive. Or perhaps... you were colluding from the beginning?
:{{A|vo abdlq006 3 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Sister Rosaria's guard's so high, she can't even see over the top of it!
:{{DIcon}} I was just helping him with his research.
:{{DIcon}} I don't think he's a bad person.
:{{A|vo abdlq006 3 rosaria 06.ogg}} '''Rosaria:''' It doesn't matter what you think, he could be a saint for all you know. But I understand him a little better than you, Outlander.
:{{A|vo abdlq006 3 rosaria 07.ogg}} '''Rosaria:''' I'm only concerned with one thing: whether his alchemy has transformed you into something more sinister.
:{{A|vo abdlq006 3 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' No way! Paimon would've sensed it. And anyway, he didn't even use any alchemy...
:{{A|vo abdlq006 3 rosaria 08.ogg}} '''Rosaria:''' With an alchemist of his level, you wouldn't sense a thing.
:{{A|vo abdlq006 3 rosaria 09.ogg}} '''Rosaria:''' In any case, I'm not about to let a potential threat back into Mondstadt.
:{{A|vo abdlq006 3 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So, what're you gonna do?
:{{DIcon}} You came here to be sure, so you must have your ways of assuring yourself.
:{{A|vo abdlq006 3 rosaria 10.ogg}} '''Rosaria:''' I've gotta hand it to you, you have your moments. If I can be sure that nothing you came into contact with is dangerous, that's good enough for me.
:{{A|vo abdlq006 3 rosaria 11.ogg}} '''Rosaria:''' I've investigated everything else. The only items left on the agenda are these symbols.
:{{A|vo abdlq006 3 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' But we don't even know what they mean!
:{{A|vo abdlq006 3 rosaria 12.ogg}} '''Rosaria:''' Hmm... That much is true, not to mention... Seems like there's nothing more to them.
:{{A|vo abdlq006 3 rosaria 13.ogg}} '''Rosaria:''' But for insurance purposes, I'd better make a copy... Hmm. This is now a location of interest — regular patrols should be set up here.
:{{A|vo abdlq006 3 rosaria 14.ogg}} '''Rosaria:''' Now then. All things considered, I deem that you pose no immediate threat.
:{{A|vo abdlq006 3 rosaria 15.ogg}} '''Rosaria:''' Which is what I was hoping. I would have been one very unhappy Sister if you'd made me work overtime on your account.
:{{A|vo abdlq006 3 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' ...Overtime?
:{{A|vo abdlq006 3 rosaria 16.ogg}} '''Rosaria:''' Before we go our separate ways, Outlander, a word of advice. Don't be so quick to trust Albedo, and don't repeat the same mistakes that you did this time. You made a lot of rash decisions today.
:{{A|vo abdlq006 3 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' She's gone. So stubborn!
:{{A|vo abdlq006 3 paimon 12.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Mondstadt doesn't have many people like that.
:{{DIcon}} Maybe she just lacks security.
:{{DIcon}} Maybe she's just sensitive.
:{{A|vo abdlq006 3 paimon 13.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh, never mind her. Let's go see Albedo!

:'''Observe Picture:''' (Like Albedo's various experiments, the symbols here make no sense.)

:{{A|vo dialog abdlq006 timaeus 02.ogg}} '''Timaeus:''' On the other hand, some of the conclusions that Albedo derived from his own intuition have been borne out by the facts.
:{{A|vo dialog abdlq006 timaeus 03.ogg}} '''Timaeus:''' I'm just glad that we've seen some progress, so uh... No reason to be dejected! Albedo said I did a good job!
:{{A|vo dialog abdlq006 timaeus 04.ogg}} '''Timaeus:''' If you want to hear the results in detail, you'd be better talking to him. I've got work to do.

;(Talking to Albedo)
:{{A|vo abdlq006 4 albedo 01.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' You're back! Good timing, I've just about reached a conclusion.
:{{A|vo abdlq006 4 albedo 02.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' You took quite a while. Did you get held up on the way back?
:{{DIcon}} Not really.
:{{DIcon}} Quite literally, by a sister no less.
::{{A|vo abdlq006 4 albedo 03.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Aha, I wouldn't worry, she's just doing her job.
:{{A|vo abdlq006 4 albedo 04.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Time for the results. We got a myriad of data today, and it was very difficult to finish all the research in one go.
:{{A|vo abdlq006 4 albedo 05.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' But the integral preliminary conclusion that I can offer you is... You're very much like a human from this world.
:{{DIcon}} ...
:{{DIcon}} That's it?
:{{A|vo abdlq006 4 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You couldn't tell that just by looking?
:{{A|vo abdlq006 4 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' We spent all day working our butts off for that!?
:{{A|vo abdlq006 4 albedo 06.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Please, I understand that this may have seemed self-evident to you, but in fact nothing in this world should be taken for granted.
:{{A|vo abdlq006 4 albedo 07.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Have you ever considered that the world of Teyvat may have a natural hostility to outlanders?
:{{DIcon}} Only the [[god]]s would know.
:{{DIcon}} Perhaps.
:{{A|vo abdlq006 4 albedo 08.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' I mentioned the natural laws of this world. You're able to converse with me here without consequence, and nothing seems amiss. But it's arguably a small miracle.
:{{A|vo abdlq006 4 albedo 09.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' The only other life form that, like you, has come here from afar, is the seed that I mentioned. Under the effects of Teyvat's natural laws, it isn't even able to sprout, let alone bloom.
:{{A|vo abdlq006 4 albedo 10.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' But after I observed you, I had another idea.
:{{A|vo abdlq006 4 albedo 11.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Imitating you helped to inspire my alchemy, and so...
:{{A|vo abdlq006 4 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Whoa! It looks like — something's appearing!
:{{Color|menu|A flower blooms at Albedo's fingertips...}}
:{{A|vo abdlq006 4 albedo 12.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' The transition from nothing into something, from shoot to stem... And now to fruition.
:{{A|vo abdlq006 4 albedo 13.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Is not nurturing otherworldly life also nurturing the world itself?
:{{A|vo abdlq006 4 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Aww...
:{{Color|menu|The flower quickly withers, barely moments after being in full bloom...}}
:{{DIcon}} It was beautiful.
:{{DIcon}} It was so short-lived.
:{{A|vo abdlq006 4 albedo 14.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' *sigh* It would seem that that's as far as we go. A transient bloom of incomparable beauty... Life's proudest achievement.
:{{A|vo abdlq006 4 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Paimon thought, with all our efforts, it might have bloomed forever. And it didn't even have any fruit...
:{{A|vo abdlq006 4 albedo 15.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Life is a manifold tapestry of free entities, its value shouldn't derive from how long it stays with us. Even a momentary burst is precious.

'''The Final Riddle: A Secret Uncovered''' is the fourth part of the [[Midsummer Island Adventure]] event. Finishing this quest unlocks [[Harpastum Bombs Loaded... Blow 'Em Away!]].

==Steps==
# Rest until early morning the next day (06:00–08:00)
#* The player does not need to perform this step in the [[Golden Apple Archipelago/1.6|Golden Apple Archipelago]].
#* If the time goes past 08:00, the time can be adjusted again to trigger the quest.
# Return to the gigantic conch
# Catch [[fish]] to obtain scales (0/3)
# Return to the device and talk to [[Klee]]
# Place scales
# Talk to Klee

==Gameplay Notes==
* If the time goes past 08:00 before the player arrives at the conch to speak with Klee, Barbara, and Jean, the player can catch the fish to receive the scales early. However, the scales will disappear from the player's inventory when the time reaches 06:00 again.
* The fish can be picked up or killed to obtain the scales.

** The children came to ask for information about the [[Great Mujina Youkai]]. However, the monster doesn't actually exist. :{{A|vo xglq001 3 naganohararyuunosuke 06.ogg}} '''Naganohara Ryuunosuke:''' Eh? What is it?
:{{A|vo xglq001 3 yoimiya 07.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' Did they deliver those firework materials that we ordered yet?
:{{A|vo xglq001 3 naganohararyuunosuke 07.ogg}} '''Naganohara Ryuunosuke:''' Oh, yesterday's fireworks have all been delivered. So have the ones from the day before yesterday, and the ones from the day before that.
:{{A|vo xglq001 3 yoimiya 08.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' No, Pops. I meant the materials. The materials that we ordered. They should have arrived today.
:{{A|vo xglq001 3 naganohararyuunosuke 08.ogg}} '''Naganohara Ryuunosuke:''' Today's fireworks are almost ready, too, don't you worry! Hehe, your old man's skills are still as sharp as ever.
:{{A|vo xglq001 3 yoimiya 09.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' No— Pops, the materials! The raw materials for making fireworks.
:{{A|vo xglq001 3 naganohararyuunosuke 09.ogg}} '''Naganohara Ryuunosuke:''' Sorry?
:{{A|vo xglq001 3 yoimiya 10.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' Ma-te-ri-als!
:{{A|vo xglq001 3 naganohararyuunosuke 10.ogg}} '''Naganohara Ryuunosuke:''' Oh... Ohh, the materials?
:{{A|vo xglq001 3 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yes, yes! The materials!
:{{A|vo xglq001 3 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Sorry, sorry... Paimon got all excited because you finally got the message across, hehe...
:{{A|vo xglq001 3 naganohararyuunosuke 11.ogg}} '''Naganohara Ryuunosuke:''' The materials aren't here yet. The couriers did come over to explain why, but... Well, I think they did, but I couldn't quite hear what they were saying...
:{{A|vo xglq001 3 yoimiya 11.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' No worries, as long as we know, that's fine. We can just make them later. Oh, uh — don't forget to take the goods in when they deliver them, okay, Pops?
:{{A|vo xglq001 3 naganohararyuunosuke 12.ogg}} '''Naganohara Ryuunosuke:''' Of course, leave it to me.
:{{A|vo xglq001 3 yoimiya 12.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' Oh, sorry if we were a little loud. it's always the way, though — it's like that every time I need to ask pops something.
:{{DIcon}} Still, he seems like a warm and friendly person.
::{{A|vo xglq001 3 yoimiya 13a.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' Uh-huh, that's my pops! He's a good person, alright. Everyone around here respects him.
:{{DIcon}} I think the two of you are quite similar.
::{{A|vo xglq001 3 yoimiya 13b.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' Hehe, I get told that a lot.
:{{A|vo xglq001 3 yoimiya 14.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' Because my pops is deaf, he never argues with anyone, and never contradicts them. He just listens cheerfully.
:{{A|vo xglq001 3 yoimiya 15.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' When I was little, I thought it was because he really understood me, and agreed with whatever I had to say. So, I'd tell my pops everything.
:{{A|vo xglq001 3 yoimiya 16.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' Eventually, I realized that the reason he was like that was that he's deaf. But I still tell him stories every day.
:{{A|vo xglq001 3 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh? Why would you do that?
:{{A|vo xglq001 3 yoimiya 17.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' It just makes me happy to see him smile. And it keeps him from being lonely, right?
:{{A|vo xglq001 3 yoimiya 18.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' Anyway. More importantly right now, the fireworks show is right around the corner and the materials still haven't arrived. We need to think of an alternative...
:{{A|vo xglq001 3 sakujirou 01.ogg}} '''???:''' Um, Yoimiya, is that you?
:{{A|vo xglq001 3 yoimiya 19.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' Wah! Oh, you scared me there! I thought I told you to be more careful before you speak?
:{{A|vo xglq001 3 sakujirou 02.ogg}} '''???:''' S—Sorry...
:{{A|vo xglq001 3 yoimiya 20.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' Hold on, I'm coming over.

;(Talk to Naganohara Ryuunosuke)
:{{A|vo dialog xglq001 naganohararyuunosuke 01.ogg}} '''Naganohara Ryuunosuke:''' Oh, don't worry about me, go take care of business first. There'll always be time for my stories later.
:{{A|vo dialog xglq001 naganohararyuunosuke 02.ogg}} '''Naganohara Ryuunosuke:''' I have a lot of time, and a lot of stories to tell, too.
----
;(Confirm the source of the sound)
:{{A|vo xglq001 4 yoimiya 01.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' No one's looking. Okay, you can come out now. Uh, come around the side.
:{{Black Screen|''The person hiding inside the house carefully crawls out the window.''}}
:{{A|vo xglq001 4 yoimiya 02.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' *sigh* We're lucky that no one from the Tenryou Commission was around, otherwise, we'd all be in big trouble.
:{{A|vo xglq001 4 sakujirou 01.ogg}} '''???:''' Sorry, I guess I was a little rash. But when I heard you come back, I just...
:{{A|vo xglq001 4 yoimiya 03.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' Don't worry [[Sakujirou]]. So far, at least, everything is going according to plan.
:{{A|vo xglq001 4 yoimiya 04.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' We're going to look for firework materials shortly. While we're out, we'll sort out the boat situation for you, as promised.
:{{A|vo xglq001 4 sakujirou 02.ogg}} '''Sakujirou:''' Thank you for all your help.
:{{DIcon}} Who is this?
:{{DIcon}} And why is he hiding in your house?
:{{A|vo xglq001 4 yoimiya 05.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' He's one of our old customers. He came back to Inazuma from the outside world not long ago. While he was smuggling himself in, the Tenryou Commission found him and put out a warrant for his arrest...
:{{A|vo xglq001 4 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' An arrest warrant!?
:{{A|vo xglq001 4 yoimiya 06.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' Shhhh, keep it down! We don't want to draw any unwanted attention.
:{{A|vo xglq001 4 yoimiya 07.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' If Sakujirou is caught, there's no knowing what crimes they could charge him with. All we can do is find him a boat and send him out of Inazuma again.
:{{DIcon}} But isn't there a thunderstorm out in the ocean?
:{{A|vo xglq001 4 yoimiya 08.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' Yeah, we know it's going to be dangerous, but there aren't many other options left.
:{{A|vo xglq001 4 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What if the boat capsizes? Uhh! Drowning is really scary!
:{{A|vo xglq001 4 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' If things are this bad, couldn't you have just not come back in the first place?
:{{A|vo xglq001 4 sakujirou 03.ogg}} '''Sakujirou:''' Well... There is something I felt I had to do...
:{{A|vo xglq001 4 sakujirou 04.ogg}} '''Sakujirou:''' But as soon as I got back, I started hearing about all these unbelievable changes. I had my mind up, originally, but now I'm not sure anymore...
:{{A|vo xglq001 4 sakujirou 05.ogg}} '''Sakujirou:''' I didn't want to cause any trouble for Yoimiya or Mr. Ryuunosuke, but I'm very grateful to them for taking me in.
:{{A|vo xglq001 4 yoimiya 09.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' Hey, no worries, you're more than welcome. Remember what I said? As long as you've got that little piece of paper, you'll always be a valued customer of the Naganoharas.
:{{A|vo xglq001 4 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Little piece of paper...?
:{{DIcon}} I remember something about that.
:{{DIcon}} Like the paper slips you gave to the kids?
:{{A|vo xglq001 4 yoimiya 10.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' Yep, the same paper slips as the ones I gave to the kids earlier. Whenever a customer orders fireworks for a commemorative event, we always include a little paper slip with the goods.
:{{A|vo xglq001 4 yoimiya 11.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' Only people from my inside my family can understand what's written on it. It's the recipe for the fireworks they ordered.
:{{A|vo xglq001 4 yoimiya 12.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' If someone shows a Naganohara that paper slip, we guarantee we can make the exact same firework as the original one they purchased, whether it's ten or even a hundred years later.
:{{A|vo xglq001 4 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wow, that is so awesome!
:{{A|vo xglq001 4 yoimiya 13.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' It's a family tradition. All our regular customers know about this.
:{{A|vo xglq001 4 sakujirou 06.ogg}} '''Sakujirou:''' The slip I have is from back when my parents ordered fireworks from Mr. Ryuunosuke. Now I think about it, it must be nearly 20 years ago.
:{{A|vo xglq001 4 sakujirou 07.ogg}} '''Sakujirou:''' *sigh* Who would have thought that things would turn out the way they have...
:{{A|vo xglq001 4 yoimiya 14.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' It'll be fine. Escaping in a boat is just a last resort for if there's no other way. I'll still try and come up with a different solution, because it'd be much better if you could stay in Inazuma.
:{{A|vo xglq001 4 yoimiya 15.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' Whatever their reasons might be, if our customers come to us looking for help, we're not about to leave them high and dry.
:{{A|vo xglq001 4 sakujirou 08.ogg}} '''Sakujirou:''' Thank you... This way, I'll still have some time to consider my options...
:{{A|vo xglq001 4 yoimiya 16.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' Alright, well, let's not stay out here in the open for too long. Hurry up and get back inside. I'll let you know as soon as I have an update for you.
:{{A|vo xglq001 4 sakujirou 09.ogg}} '''Sakujirou:''' Thank you, I—I'll leave it to you, then, I guess.
:{{Black Screen|''Sakujirou goes back into hiding.''}}
:{{A|vo xglq001 4 yoimiya 17.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' *sigh* It's a shame, they still wouldn't give him a permit, even though he was born and raised in Inazuma.
:{{A|vo xglq001 4 yoimiya 18.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' Speaking of, you guys only got here recently, how did you manage to get a permit?
:{{DIcon}} We went through a long bureaucratic process on Ritou.
:{{A|vo xglq001 4 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Even then, we only got through thanks to some help from Miss Hiiragi Chisato of the Kanjou Commission.
:{{A|vo xglq001 4 yoimiya 19.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' I see, so you had big shots helping you. I guess that won't be of much help to Sakujirou.
:{{A|vo xglq001 4 yoimiya 20.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' *sigh* I just wish the commissions could be a little more flexible.
:{{A|vo xglq001 4 yoimiya 21.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' I bet nowhere else you've been is quite like Inazuma, huh?
:{{DIcon}} It's true.
:{{DIcon}} Each archon has their own idea on how to run things.
:{{A|vo xglq001 4 yoimiya 22.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' *sigh* Well, no matter what, I have to find a way to help him.
:{{A|vo xglq001 4 yoimiya 23.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' I'm sorry, I invited you to come and watch the fireworks, but now I have to run a few errands.
:{{A|vo xglq001 4 yoimiya 24.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' You don't have to join me if you don't want to. I can go sort out the firework materials and the boat by myself, and then you can come and meet me back at the house later.
:{{DIcon}} I don't mind coming along.
:{{DIcon}} I'm interested to learn how fireworks are made.
:{{A|vo xglq001 4 yoimiya 25.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' Oh, cool! Then let's start with Sakujirou's boat. We can chat along the way!
:;(Dialogue continues in next quest [[Expectations Not to Be Betrayed]])

{{Dialogue Start}}
:{{Black Screen|The Traveler and Paimon begin to wait}}
:{{A|vo bblcop001 1900401 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ugh, it's been ages, where in Teyvat did she go...?
:{{DIcon}} I'm a little worried...
::{{A|vo bblcop001 1900401 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Paimon's worried too, Barbara should have been back by now.

:{{A|vo bblcop001 1900402 barbara 06.ogg}} '''Barbara:''' I guess they were too caught up with the merchant to notice me.
:{{A|vo bblcop001 1900402 barbara 07.ogg}} '''Barbara:''' I followed them this far, but it seemed like they knew somebody was following them, so I didn't go any further.

:{{A|vo bblcop001 1900402 barbara 10.ogg}}<!--{{A|vo bblcop001 1900402 barbara 11.ogg}}--> '''Barbara:''' I thought of getting the Knights involved, but I was worried it would take too long... What if the Treasure Hoarders did something terrible while I was gone...
:{{A|vo bblcop001 1900402 barbara 12.ogg}} '''Barbara:''' I was trying to think of some way of rescuing the merchant when you showed up.
:{{A|vo bblcop001 1900402 barbara 13.ogg}} '''Barbara:''' So... Honorary Knight, maybe you could, uh...

::{{A|vo bblcop001 1900402 barbara 15.ogg}} '''Barbara:''' Oh.. B—But sometimes — I mean — for some people, it's hard to persuade them without, you know... "direct intervention."
::{{A|vo bblcop001 1900402 barbara 16.ogg}} '''Barbara:''' Please, Honorary Knight, it's up to you. I'll handle the aftercare.
;(Continue to [[Knight and Deaconess, Ready for Battle!]])

==Gameplay Notes==

==Dialogue==
{{Quest Description|After finding Albedo, [[Rosaria]] leaves on her own. You chat with Albedo and discover the objective of his research: to use alchemy to cause a seed from another world to sprout and flourish. To better understand otherworldly lifeforms, Albedo states his desire to observe you and to perform some experiments in the process.}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Head to the test site)
:{{A|vo abdlq003 1 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Paimon has a question. After the seed sprouts, will it grow into anything?
:{{A|vo abdlq003 1 albedo 01.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' I don't know, but I feel the importance will lie in the method, not the end point.
:{{A|vo abdlq003 1 albedo 02.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Using alchemy to awaken otherworldy life in [[Teyvat]] would constitute a big leap in my understanding of the essence of life.
:{{A|vo abdlq003 1 albedo 03.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' After awakening, even creation may be possible.
:{{A|vo abdlq003 1 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Uhh...
:{{A|vo abdlq003 1 albedo 04.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Aha... Still a little difficult to understand?
:{{A|vo abdlq003 1 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' N—No! Paimon's got a brain! But what's the seed gonna become? Isn't that more interesting than whatever it was you were saying?
:{{DIcon}} Doesn't seem like you understood.
:{{DIcon}} That's what I want to know.
:{{A|vo abdlq003 1 albedo 05.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Well, if it turns out to be a delicious fruit, dinner's on me.
:{{A|vo abdlq003 1 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yay! Paimon's holding you to it!
:{{DIcon}} You sure know how to keep Paimon on board.
:{{DIcon}} You've seen through Paimon's ulterior motives.

'''''The First Ideal''''' is a quest in {{Quest|The Pendulum of Weal and Woe}}.

==Steps==
# Go to the House of Daena
# Take a walk nearby
# Talk to Kaveh and Alhaitham
# Follow Kaveh to Port Ormos
# Follow Kaveh to the desert
# Clear out the nearby Primal Constructs {{Enemy List|Primal Construct: Reshaper*2;Primal Construct: Prospector*1}}
# Listen to Kaveh's thoughts

==Gameplay Notes==
* During Step 6, Kaveh will join the team as a trial character.
* Reading all three books nearby in the Akademiya after Step 3 will grant the {{Achievement|School Days}}.
* Completing this branch grants the {{Achievement|An Architect's Romanticism}}.

:{{DIcon}} He was put through the wringer recently by a particularly difficult client.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907603 alhaitham 15.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' "Put through the wringer" — what an interesting phrase. I assume he used those exact words himself.
:{{DIcon}} It doesn't seem far from the truth, though.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907603 alhaitham 16.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' He probably did suffer quite a bit, that's true. He always spends a lot of time editing his proposals, with the goal of satisfying as many of the client's preferences as possible.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907603 alhaitham 17.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' But the satisfaction of one client will not translate to general satisfaction with his work. Many problems in life can only be solved by a fundamental change of attitude. As the leading genius of Kshahrewar, Kaveh should have both the right and the confidence to reject any unreasonable demands.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907603 alhaitham 18.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' There are plenty of architects in Sumeru who are inferior to him in skill, yet far more irascible in temperament. What's more, there are plenty of people who look up to such individuals as paragons of "staying true to one's principles."
:{{DIcon}} So, the problem is with Kaveh...?
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907603 alhaitham 19.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' Clearly, his predicament is inevitable, since he holds other people's feelings as more important than his own.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907603 alhaitham 20.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' Of course, each person is different, and we should respect the paths that they have chosen for themselves.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907603 alhaitham 21.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' Admonitions will serve no purpose. People tend to succumb to familiar pitfalls, and this is especially true for those who believe it's their duty to carry more burdens on their shoulders.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907603 kaveh 09.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Looks like you were having an enjoyable chat while I was gone. Were you talking about me by any chance?
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907603 alhaitham 22.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' What do you think?
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907603 kaveh 10.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Hmph, what else is there to talk about? Surely, no one would be interested in talking about the files that you were browsing through earlier.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907603 kaveh 11.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Anyway, you should take a look at this! Look at this comment on page eighty-two: "Dear Kaveh, thank you so much for annotating this book in such detail. It was a great help to me!"
;(+1 Heart)
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907603 kaveh 12.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' See that? Now that's how a student should treat their seniors!
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907603 alhaitham 23.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' And it looks like you're already in a much better mood now. It really doesn't take much to make you happy, huh.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907603 kaveh 13.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Me? Happy? I'm mocking that retired blockhead for being so full of himself! He understands nothing about the true beauty of architecture! When I can find some time, I'll have a serious talk with him about making sure these books are put where they belong.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907603 alhaitham 24.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' Why don't you just move all the books yourself? It's not like he hasn't cursed you out before. What was that nickname he gave you while you were in the Akademiya? "The Urchin of Kshahrewar"?
:{{DIcon}} Wait, what?
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907603 alhaitham 25.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' Kaveh had a habit of scribbling and writing in all kinds of books.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907603 kaveh 14.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Hey...! You didn't need to bring that up! At least not when I'm still standing here!
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907603 kaveh 15.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Oh, actually, I also found a really old sketch in one of the books over there. See? Doesn't it remind you of something?
:{{DIcon}} An arch bridge?
:{{DIcon}} I don't really get it...
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907603 alhaitham 26.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' ...
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907603 kaveh 16.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Huh? Don't tell me even you don't get it.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907603 alhaitham 27.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' Hmm? Don't ask me. This is the time you specifically put aside to brag about yourself. Feel free to hoard all the spotlight you want.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907603 kaveh 17.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' You... Ahem, in that case, allow me to explain. Although this sketch is a little abstract, you can plainly see from the road plans that this was an original concept for the expansion of Port Ormos.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907603 alhaitham 28.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' We can also plainly see that the designer was a huge fan of this project. It's the project he loves to talk about the most, second to the Palace of Alcazarzaray.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907603 kaveh 18.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' If I don't keep bringing up the neat projects that I've done, how would anyone know that I was the one who did them in the first place?
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907603 kaveh 19.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' There shouldn't be any complaints about Port Ormos... If I remember correctly, the construction process was very smooth, everything was made ready ahead of time, and there were very few safety concerns.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907603 alhaitham 29.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' There are indeed no records of any complaints about this project. A most impressive achievement.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907603 kaveh 20.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' See? What did I tell you?
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907603 kaveh 21.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' C'mon, let's take a stroll through Port Ormos next! I'll tell you all about the designs I made for the place!
:{{DIcon}} Are you going to come too, Alhaitham?
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907603 alhaitham 30.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' No need. It's almost time to clock out for the day, and I don't intend on bringing any unfinished work home.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907603 kaveh 22.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Hmph, suit yourself, it's not like you know how to appreciate artistry anyway. Let's go, {{Traveler}}. I'll take you to Port Ormos.

;(Read Almanac of Avidya Forest's Avians, optional)
:'''Almanac of Avidya Forest's Avians:''' (The almanac contains information on all kinds of avian species in the Avidya Forest, with notes on their natural behavior and conservation status.)
:'''Almanac of Avidya Forest's Avians:''' (A number of corrections have been made to the listed figures. Judging from the handwriting, they must have been pretty recent.)

;(Read Evolution of Ancient Literature, optional)
:'''Evolution of Ancient Literature:''' (A brand-new volume. Seems like very few people have been interested in reading it.)
:'''Evolution of Ancient Literature:''' (There are almost no annotations in the book, but the daring speculation made by the original author has been unceremoniously crossed out by a reader.)

;(Read "Graphical Illustrations of Ancient Architecture," optional)
:'''"Graphical Illustrations of Ancient Architecture":''' (Upon opening the book, you are greeted by a series of beautiful illustrations.)
:'''"Graphical Illustrations of Ancient Architecture":''' (Next to the lovely images are some notes in equally gorgeous handwriting. The commentary is extremely thorough, and appears to be even more professional than the book's original contents.)
{{Dialogue End}}

===Successes and Regrets===
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Approach the marked area in Port Ormos)
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907604 kaveh 01.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Port Ormos...
:{{DIcon}} Did you design one of the buildings here?
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907604 kaveh 02.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' No, I didn't design any one specific building. Most of my work here concerned structural renovation.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907604 kaveh 03.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Port Ormos had already existed since I was still a young child. It wasn't as large as it is now, though — it only came to its current size after a sizable expansion. I was part of that project.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907604 kaveh 04.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' The arch bridge over there, for example... That was one of my designs.
:{{DIcon}} How did you come up with the idea for it?
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907604 kaveh 05.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' When I was first tasked with the project, I decided to reference the growth patterns of nearby trees to split Port Ormos into two levels. My goal was to improve the overall utilization of space.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907604 kaveh 06.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' We ran into a lot of issues during construction, but thankfully, we were still able to achieve the original vision.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907604 kaveh 07.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Residents can now behold all the ships entering and leaving the harbor from the vantage point of the bridge, while visitors can recognize the sight of Port Ormos from a long ways away.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907604 kaveh 08.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' I was still young and new to the trade back then... I could hardly believe that an idea in my head had become reality, and remain in the world for many years to come.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907604 kaveh 09.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' The true cornerstone of the creative process... The point about the design that will be ultimately used to judge its true worth. It was the first time that it became crystal clear in my mind.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907604 kaveh 10.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Once built, a building will continue to stand. Countless people will see it, and countless more will step inside it. Its final worth — whether it's "good" or "bad" — will be assessed by the countless generations of people that interact with the building during their lives.
:{{DIcon}} I'm sure the residents of Port Ormos really enjoy it.
:{{DIcon}} I think it's pretty cool.
;(+2 Hearts)
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907604 kaveh 11.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' You think so? I'm glad to hear that. But even with this project, I still had one small regret.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907604 kaveh 12.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' My budget was tight, and I was unable to use the higher-quality timber I had originally intended for the design. I knew that some concessions on aesthetics would be needed because I agreed to a proposal that prioritized the practical functions of the project.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907604 kaveh 13.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Us creative types know better than anyone that most projects cannot be completed without a few regrets. Even the Palace of Alcazarzaray is not perfect.
:{{DIcon}} But having no regrets would also mean you had no higher hopes for the future.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907604 kaveh 14.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Yeah, you're right... I should learn to look toward future opportunities, and believe that any regrets I have can be overcome in time.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907604 kaveh 15.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' We've spent long enough here. There's still one last place I want to go, but it's a little far... Would you be interested in a quick trip to the desert?
:{{DIcon}} I wouldn't mind.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907604 kaveh 16.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Great. Most of my projects over the last few years have had something to do with the desert, partially because there's a special place there that I often visit.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907604 kaveh 17.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' This is a rare opportunity, so why don't you come along and see it for yourself?
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907604 kaveh 18.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' If you ever feel down, maybe you'll be able to go there and feel better, too.
{{Dialogue End}}

===Desert Sanctum===
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(At [[The Dune of Magma]])
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907605 kaveh 01.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Who would have thought that so many Primal Constructs could have congregated here while I was gone...
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907605 kaveh 02.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' We won't be able to sit and talk peacefully with these guys around. Let's clear the area.

;(After clearing out the enemies)
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907607 kaveh 01.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Isn't this place great? I often come here to clear my mind when I'm dealing with a difficult situation.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907607 kaveh 02.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' You know what I mean... everyone finds themselves in frustrating situations once in a while.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907607 kaveh 03.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Just take me as an example. My family life got shaken up quite a bit when I was young, I struggled in school, and I got into a huge pile of debt building the Palace of Alcazarzaray...
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907607 kaveh 04.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Although Alhaitham thinks that it's because of my personality that I continue to live in the shadow of the past, I think it's also just a part of life... Plus, if I look back, I've honestly had my fair share of good luck as well.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907607 kaveh 05.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' You could probably say I've followed in the path of my mother. Like her, I've gained a name for myself as an architect, built something that's seen as my magnum opus, and found many projects that others have entrusted to me to finish.
:{{DIcon}} You also haven't completely lost your passion for life.
;(+1 Heart)
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907607 kaveh 06.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Life is too boring when you live with no enthusiasm and passion. Only those who believe in the inherent meaning of it can capture the small nuances of everyday life, and turn them into inspiration for beautiful designs.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907607 kaveh 07.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Of course, I will concede that loving something also means taking it to heart, so to an extent, caring is also a source of pain. If I didn't love my work, I wouldn't be so torn up about it all the time.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907607 kaveh 08.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' ...But still, isn't this place beautiful? Despite the erosion from the winds and changing seasons, you can still perceive its past beauty and glory.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907607 kaveh 09.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' With different landforms come different architectural styles. The desert's history has left it with few records regarding its buildings, so I often visit the desert to investigate things in person.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907607 kaveh 10.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' The sight here has moved me ever since the first time I laid my eyes on it. I told myself that one day, I would also be able to create buildings that move others.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907607 kaveh 11.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' My pain will one day fade into nothing just as I reach the end of my life, but buildings are different.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907607 kaveh 12.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' They are far more valuable than most materialistic things, and far more durable than human flesh. As long as there remain souls in the world who can decipher the meaning behind them, they will also have acknowledged me across the vast stream of time.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907607 kaveh 13.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' If you were to ask me what art is, that would be my answer.
:{{DIcon}} Now that's more like the Kaveh I know.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907607 kaveh 14.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' You think so? But I feel I've always been like this.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907607 kaveh 15.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Remember that question I brought up before? The one about whether I should see art as a divine gift of inspiration from the gods, or as a product of my own existential struggle?
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907607 kaveh 16.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' I still haven't found an answer to that yet, but if art wasn't inherently paradoxical and enigmatic, then people probably wouldn't be drawn to it.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907607 kaveh 17.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Those who pursue art will be unable to avoid the pain that it naturally brings. We'll often be floating on cloud nine one second, and sinking in a mire the next.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907607 kaveh 18.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' I'll try gathering my thoughts again once I've found a way to define art in the first place.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907607 kaveh 19.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' In any case, thank you so much for listening to everything I had to say.
{{Dialogue End}}

:{{Black Screen|The Irodori festival goes into full festive swing and your work is going well. Finally, the day of the release event arrives...}}
:{{A|vo rcjeq006 1 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Today's the final stage of the Irodori Festival. Not only will there be Xingqiu's signing event, but Albedo's painting of Kuronushi will also be unveiled.

{{Quest Description|The much-awaited final phase of the Irodori Festival has begun. Not only will the new volume release event occur today, but Albedo will also unveil his portrait of Kuronushi to everyone. Go speak to Albedo first.}}

;(Examine Kuronushi's likeness)
:'''Kuronushi's Likeness:''' (Albedo's portrait of Kuronushi. The portrait has been covered up by a piece of cloth.)

:{{A|vo rcjeq006 2 albedo 01.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Hello {{Traveler}}, Paimon.
:{{A|vo rcjeq006 2 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Albedo, why is the portrait of Kuronushi all covered up? Paimon wants to see what your Kuronushi portrait looks like.
:{{A|vo rcjeq006 2 albedo 02.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Don't worry, the unveiling ceremony will be starting shortly. You'll see what it looks like then.
:{{A|vo rcjeq006 2 albedo 03.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' I will say that I'm most satisfied with this particular work. I even made a special trip to see someone in order to complete it. They gave me some very valuable suggestions.

:{{DIcon}} Sounds pretty suspicious if you ask me.
