{{Quest Description|update|Other than Xingqiu, who is at the signing event, Venti, Kazuha, and Ayaka should all be around here somewhere. Go see what they're doing at the moment.}}
----
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Talk to Venti or Yae Miko)
:{{A|vo dialog rcjeq006 yaemiko 01.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' Well, hello everyone.
:{{A|vo dialog rcjeq006 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hey, what are you two doing together!? Don't think we didn't see you two chatting up a storm just now. The moment we came over, you stopped talking.
:{{A|vo dialog rcjeq006 yaemiko 02.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' Is that so? I'm afraid you're just overthinking things.
:{{A|vo dialog rcjeq006 venti 01.ogg}} '''Venti:''' We were merely discussing wine and food, I'm sure you two wouldn't be interested.
:{{A|vo dialog rcjeq006 yaemiko 03.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' Ahem, speaking of good sides with sake, I personally prefer fried tofu...
:{{A|vo dialog rcjeq006 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ugh, forget it. Even if those two are plotting something, they'd still never let us know.

;(Talk to Venti or Yae Miko again)
:'''Miko and Venti:''' (Miko and Venti are drinking and chatting in a corner. The empty bottles are starting to pile up at an alarming rate... But it seems that they've really been discussing the best sides to go with sake this whole time.)

;(Talk to Kaedehara Kazuha)
:{{A|vo rcjeq006 3 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Kazuha, what are you doing here? Why aren't you at the festival?
:{{A|vo rcjeq006 3 kazuha 01.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' I came here to take in the sea breeze. Such a bustling atmosphere is never really to my liking.
:{{DIcon}} Are you really alright, Kazuha?
:{{A|vo rcjeq006 3 kazuha 02.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' Heh, I knew you were still worried about me.
:{{A|vo rcjeq006 3 kazuha 03.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' Thank you, but please don't worry. The things I said in front of everyone weren't just pretty-sounding excuses.
:{{A|vo rcjeq006 3 kazuha 04.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' Look, see this familiar harbor in front of us? Before, you could sit here all day without seeing a single ship pass through. Instead, all you would see were soldiers from the Kanjou Commission guarding against possible intruders.
:{{A|vo rcjeq006 3 kazuha 05.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' But now, it's become a bustling place.
:{{A|vo rcjeq006 3 kazuha 06.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' Not only are foreigners coming to Inazuma again, but traffic between here and Watatsumi Island has also been picking up.
:{{A|vo rcjeq006 3 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yeah, Inazuma's already started to change, huh.
:{{A|vo rcjeq006 3 kazuha 07.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' I was thinking... In some ways, each and every one of us are similar to this country.
:{{A|vo rcjeq006 3 kazuha 08.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' It might take a different amount of time for different people, but there will inevitably come a day when each person can let go of their burdens.
:{{A|vo rcjeq006 3 kazuha 09.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' And when they finally let go, they are free to follow the wind as they please.

;(Talk to Kaedehara Kazuha again)
:{{A|vo dialog rcjeq006 kazuha 01.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' Don't worry about me. You should go enjoy the festival.

;(Talk to Kamisato Ayaka or Kamisato Ayato)
:{{A|vo dialog rcjeq006 ayato 01.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' Greetings Traveler, Paimon.
:{{A|vo dialog rcjeq006 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, Ayato! We finally get to see the busiest person of all.
:{{A|vo dialog rcjeq006 ayato 02.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' Yes, there were many things which required my attention these past few days.
:{{A|vo dialog rcjeq006 ayato 03.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' Fortunately, the Irodori Festival is proceeding smoothly. The Tri-Commission cooperated closely to prepare this festival, so at long last, I can take a break today.
:{{A|vo dialog rcjeq006 ayaka 01.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' Brother and I are very grateful for your help.
:{{A|vo dialog rcjeq006 ayato 04.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' Hmm, Thoma sure is taking his sweet time...
:{{DIcon}} Oh, you're waiting for Thoma?
:{{A|vo dialog rcjeq006 ayaka 02.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' Yes, today is one of the rare occasions when brother isn't busy. I was going to buy some books but he said he wanted to come along, "his treat." However, he forgot his wallet at home, so he asked Thoma to go back and fetch it for him.
:{{A|vo dialog rcjeq006 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Paimon didn't think Ayato could ever be forgetful like that.
:{{A|vo dialog rcjeq006 ayaka 03.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' Hehe, brother always works diligently, and it's rare for him to ever put his duties to the side and relax.
:{{A|vo dialog rcjeq006 ayaka 04.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' So, Thoma and I really cherish such moments when he's forgetful.

;(Talk to Kamisato Ayaka or Kamisato Ayato again)
:'''The Kamisato Siblings:''' (The two people talk about various things regarding the Irodori Festival while they wait for Thoma. You can hear snatches of their conversation: "Brother, even if Thoma is here, you cannot simply forget to bring your purse"...)

;(Approach Xingqiu)
:{{A|vo dialog rcjeq006 xingqiu 01.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' {{Traveler}}, Paimon, it's a pleasure to see you!
:{{DIcon}} Did {{sic|today’s}} signing go as planned?
:{{A|vo dialog rcjeq006 xingqiu 02.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' Indeed, it did. Thanks to you, the signing event went off without a hitch! And I must say, the readers seemed most satisfied.
:{{A|vo dialog rcjeq006 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Uh, Xingqiu... Is it just Paimon, or are you on the lookout for something?
:{{A|vo dialog rcjeq006 xingqiu 03.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' You aren't mistaken. Though I'm ashamed to admit it, but in fact, I have been on the watch for tourists from Liyue.
:{{A|vo dialog rcjeq006 xingqiu 04.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' After all, I came to Inazuma under the pretext of evaluating a potential investment. If an acquaintance were to see me sitting here, then there would be no way to hide the truth from my father.
:{{A|vo dialog rcjeq006 xingqiu 05.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' Fortunately, the crowds of readers that came flocking over have kept the usual tourists at bay.
:{{A|vo dialog rcjeq006 xingqiu 06.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' Oh, I should mention, Xu is also unaware of the real purpose of my trip. If you happen to meet him, please, remember to keep it secret.
:{{DIcon}} Don't worry, we've got you covered.
:{{A|vo dialog rcjeq006 xingqiu 07.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' Then please accept my thanks in advance. I'm sorry that I can't chat long, there are still readers waiting in line.
:{{A|vo dialog rcjeq006 xingqiu 08.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' I'll see you later at the unveiling ceremony for Kuronushi's portrait.

;(Talk to Xingqiu again)
:'''Xingqiu:''' (Xingqiu currently seems to be carefully signing books for his readers. His penmanship is quite smooth. Even though the stamp designed by Albedo is not very complicated, he must have practiced for quite a long time just to make his readers happy...)

;(Talk to [[Onodera]])
:{{A|vo dialog rcjeq006 onodera 02.ogg}} '''Onodera:''' The release event has been a huge success. It's all thanks to you, Traveler.

;(Talk to [[Kadenokouji Kenzaburou]])
:{{A|vo dialog rcjeq006 kadenokojikenzaburou 01.ogg}} '''Kadenokouji Kenzaburou:''' Lots of people came to buy books today. Though the signing process wasn't difficult, after so many copies, I can barely lift my hand.

;(Talk to [[Satomi]])
:{{A|vo dialog rcjeq006 satomi 01.ogg}} '''Satomi:''' I heard that not only is Zhenyu heir to a Liyue merchant family, but he also created the entire novel without ever telling his family. Come to think of it, that's quite similar to the plot in the novel.
:{{A|vo dialog rcjeq006 satomi 02.ogg}} '''Satomi:''' Hmm... Perhaps next time we should try to write a story about a novelist based on Zhenyu.

;(After talking to Ayaka, Kazuha, Venti, and Xingqiu)
:{{A|vo rcjeq006 6 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' It's time for the portrait's unveiling ceremony, let's head over to The Five Kasen Plaza.
{{Dialogue End}}
{{Quest Description|update|The unveiling of Kuronushi's portrait is about to begin. Return to The Five Kasen Plaza and admire this masterpiece together with everyone else.}}
----
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Approach the Plaza)
:{{A|vo rcjeq006 7 hirayama 01.ogg}} '''Hirayama:''' Everyone, welcome to the Magnificent Irodori Festival!
:{{A|vo rcjeq006 7 hirayama 02.ogg}} '''Hirayama:''' Today, we have ushered in the final stage of our festival.
:{{A|vo rcjeq006 7 hirayama 03.ogg}} '''Hirayama:''' And now, we will reveal the final portrait of The Five Kasen — Kuronushi, which was done by none other than our guest artist from Mondstadt, Calx.
;(Everyone claps)
:{{A|vo rcjeq006 7 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Paimon has no idea what Albedo's portrait looks like... Ugh, this is so nerve-racking!
:{{A|vo rcjeq006 7 hirayama 04.ogg}} '''Hirayama:''' Let's all count down together! Three, two, one!
:{{A|vo rcjeq006 7 hirayama 05.ogg}} '''{{Sic|Guest|hide=1}}:''' Huh? What's this? This piece depicts nothing but a background!
:{{A|vo rcjeq006 7 hirayama 06.ogg}} '''{{Sic|Guest|hide=1}}:''' I suppose Calx must have forgotten to include the character.
:{{A|vo rcjeq006 7 hirayama 07.ogg}} '''Hirayama:''' Ahem. Uh, let's hear some words from Calx himself regarding the creative process behind this piece.
:{{A|vo rcjeq006 7 albedo 01.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Hello everyone. First, I would like to say that it was an honor to be invited to create the portraits of The Five Kasen.
:{{A|vo rcjeq006 7 albedo 02.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' The Five Kasen are legendary figures from ancient Inazuma, famous for their works of poetry. As time passed, poems were composed about them, and they became the subjects of many stories.
:{{A|vo rcjeq006 7 albedo 03.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' I learned from existing sources about those stories that the character of Kuronushi is the deepest and most differing of The Five Kasen.
:{{A|vo rcjeq006 7 albedo 04.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Moreover, Kuronushi lacks a dedicated chapter among the stories. It's as if he is a "behind-the-scenes role" of The Five Kasen.
:{{A|vo rcjeq006 7 albedo 05.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Perhaps we can assume that every creator had a different understanding of Kuronushi. So, in the same way, I also wanted to leave this character to everyone's own imagination.
:{{A|vo rcjeq006 7 albedo 06.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' After all, the Irodori Festival is a place for everyone to express their minds through creative works.
:{{A|vo rcjeq006 7 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yep, that's Albedo for ya! His super logical explanation is sure to win everyone's approval.
:{{A|vo rcjeq006 7 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Well, it seems that our adventures at the Irodori Festival have come to a close, hehe.
:{{DIcon}} Are you sure?
:{{DIcon}} Aren't you forgetting something, Paimon?
:{{A|vo rcjeq006 7 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh? Wh—What are you talking about?
:{{A|vo rcjeq006 7 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh... Ohhh! Right, we still haven't figured out who left those stories of The Five Kasen for us to find.
:{{DIcon}} But, I have an inkling of who it might be.
:{{A|vo rcjeq006 7 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Really? C'mon then, who is it? Tell Paimon!
:{{DIcon}} First, it's someone that knows every one of us.
:{{A|vo rcjeq006 7 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Well, that makes sense... Otherwise, there'd be no way to give the right paper to the right person every time.
:{{DIcon}} Also, they are connected with the Kaedehara Clan.
:{{A|vo rcjeq006 7 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Right, even though they were using stories to hint us toward Xingqiu's troubles, the real goal was to lead us to solve the secrets of the Kaedehara Clan...
:{{A|vo rcjeq006 7 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' *gasp* Paimon gets it now! Well, at least Paimon thinks she knows...
:{{A|vo rcjeq006 7 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Let's go! We'll get to the bottom of this!
{{Dialogue End}}
{{Quest Description|update|The person who left the various tales behind should be near The Five Kasen Plaza. Look for "this person" and solve the final mystery behind the Irodori Festival.}}
----
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Examine Kuronushi's Likeness)
:'''Kuronushi's Likeness:''' (Albedo's portrait of Kuronushi. There is no sign of any personage here. Only a backdrop adorns this image.)
:'''Kuronushi's Likeness:''' (Albedo said that he wanted to leave this to everyone's imagination. Perhaps you too, already have some clear idea of what this person might have looked like...)

;(Talk to Venti)
:{{A|vo rcjeq006 8 venti 01.ogg}} '''Venti:''' Oh, are you asking about the one who left the stories of The Five Kasen? Hehe, I do happen to know their true identity.
:{{A|vo rcjeq006 8 venti 02.ogg}} '''Venti:''' But things may be little more complicated than you think.

;(Talk to Xingqiu)
:{{A|vo rcjeq006 8 xingqiu 01.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' Are you discussing the person who left The Five Kasen stories? They are indeed a meticulous person who's good at reading the situation.

;(Talk to Albedo)
:{{A|vo rcjeq006 8 albedo 01.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Yes, in fact, before doing the portrait of Kuronushi, I visited the person who left those stories and confirmed a few things.
:{{A|vo rcjeq006 8 albedo 02.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' I think my current approach to this portrait is the most correct one. after all, there are something things that are better left obscure and out of the public eye.

;(Talk to Kamisato Ayaka)
:{{A|vo rcjeq006 8 ayaka 01.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' The person who left behind the stories of The Five Kasen probably chose to do so for Kaedehara's sake.
:{{A|vo rcjeq006 8 ayaka 02.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' After all, if they wanted to simply tell me what happened, there'd be far easier ways of doing it.

;(Talk to Kaedehara Kazuha)
:{{A|vo rcjeq006 8 kazuha 01.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' To be honest, I am very grateful to the one who left those stories for us to find. This journey allowed me to uncover the truth behind my family.
:{{A|vo rcjeq006 8 kazuha 02.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' And, I am also very fortunate to have you to accompany me and find the answers.

;(Talk to Yae Miko)
:{{A|vo rcjeq006 8 yaemiko 01.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' The one who left the stories of The Five Kasen? Haha, I'm afraid you guessed wrong, Paimon. It wasn't me~
:{{A|vo rcjeq006 8 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh? Really!? Paimon thought for sure you'd be the sneaky and tricky one!
:{{A|vo rcjeq006 8 yaemiko 02.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' Hah, but seeing as you stumbled upon me, you aren't far from finding that person now.
:{{A|vo rcjeq006 8 yaemiko 03.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' Because other that me, there's only one person left.<!--This line occurs even if there are more than one person not spoken to.-->

;(Talk to Ayato)
:{{A|vo rcjeq006 9 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ayato! you're the one behind the stories of The Five Kasen!
:{{A|vo rcjeq006 9 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' But, don't you think you overdid it a little, leading all your friends on a wild hunt like that!
:{{A|vo rcjeq006 9 ayato 01.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' Haha. As it just so happens, one of the reasons I'm here today is to explain the details behind this "wild hunt."
:{{A|vo rcjeq006 9 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hmph, Paimon wants to see how you'll explain yourself out of this one.
:{{A|vo rcjeq006 9 ayato 02.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' First of all, the start of this whole incident was due to mere happenstance. You see, Lady Yae happened to catch sight of Xingqiu and the editor carrying the books away one night. She thought it was interesting, so she asked me to tease them a bit.
:{{A|vo rcjeq006 9 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh!? So it was Miko after all!
:{{A|vo rcjeq006 9 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Paimon knew it! This thing had Miko written all over it...
:{{A|vo rcjeq006 9 ayato 03.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' That's right, but using the story of The Five Kasen to guide you to the Kaedehara family's secrets was my personal touch.
:{{A|vo rcjeq006 9 ayato 04.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' As for my roundabout approach... Well, that was something which I had no choice but to do.
:{{DIcon}} You had no choice?
:{{A|vo rcjeq006 9 ayato 05.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' Yes. Due to a certain incident that occurred earlier, I happened to notice the bonsai plants left behind by Kaedehara Yoshinori, as well as the blank papers hidden inside.
:{{A|vo rcjeq006 9 ayato 06.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' I knew there was more than meets the eye regarding those papers, but it took me some time to figure out the secret behind the ink, the kind that would only appear when exposed to water.
:{{A|vo rcjeq006 9 ayato 07.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' What Kaedehara Yoshinori said in the letter is very important for both the Kamisato Clan and the descendants of the Kaedehara Clan, especially Kazuha.
:{{A|vo rcjeq006 9 ayato 08.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' The Kaedehara Clan used to be subordinates of the Kamisato Clan. It was my ancestors who were unable to protect them all those years ago. So now, this obligation fell on my shoulders.
:{{A|vo rcjeq006 9 ayato 09.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' Although he has the right to know the truth, the closer he draws to things hidden out of sight, the closer he also draws to danger. I had to confirm whether Kazuha has both the will and ability to be privy to the truth.
:{{A|vo rcjeq006 9 ayato 10.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' Of course, I could outright tell him the truth that I had discovered, but maybe he doesn't have the will that's required. In that case, the truth would only become a burden to him.
:{{A|vo rcjeq006 9 ayato 11.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' If he lacks the ability, then he wouldn't be able to find the truth in the first place. In which case, it would be better to keep him away from danger altogether.
:{{A|vo rcjeq006 9 ayato 12.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' Kaedehara Yoshinori left his message in a roundabout way precisely for this reason.
:{{A|vo rcjeq006 9 ayato 13.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' For a long time, I yearned for a suitable opportunity to convey this matter, right up until the night when "A Legend of Sword" was smuggled away.
:{{A|vo rcjeq006 9 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, Paimon gets it now...
:{{DIcon}} But why was everyone else involved, too?
:{{A|vo rcjeq006 9 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yeah, it wasn't only Kazuha. You brought all the rest of us into this plan of yours!
:{{A|vo rcjeq006 9 ayato 14.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' Hahaha, I figured you would ask this question eventually.
:{{A|vo rcjeq006 9 ayato 15.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' I merely saw that this matter would be of value to you.
:{{A|vo rcjeq006 9 ayato 16.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' And more importantly, I hoped that while Kazuha and Ayaka were looking for the answers together, they would have some reliable friends by their side.
:{{A|vo rcjeq006 9 ayato 17.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' Reliable friends who would be willing to protect them and make measured decisions. Friends who would spare no effort to lend a helping hand in times of trouble.
:{{A|vo rcjeq006 9 ayato 18.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' Because it is also very likely that you will face the same enemy together in the future.
:{{DIcon}} So who is Kunikuzushi?
:{{A|vo rcjeq006 9 ayato 19.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' You already know the answer deep down inside, don't you?
:{{A|vo rcjeq006 9 ayato 20.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' The answer is actually hidden in the portrait of Kuronushi.
:{{A|vo rcjeq006 9 ayato 21.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' When there is no one else near the portrait, you can confirm with your own eyes.
:{{A|vo rcjeq006 9 ayato 22.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' As for the means of revealing that answer... well, you have used it many times before.
{{Dialogue End}}
{{Quest Description|update|According to Ayato, the truth is buried within the portrait of Kuronushi. The method of revealing the truth is one you've used several times before already. The Five Kasen Plaza is a little crowded at the moment. It might be best to return to this place later at night.}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(When the time arrives)
:{{A|vo rcjeq006 10 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' It's getting pretty late, so nobody else is around now.
:{{A|vo rcjeq006 10 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So Ayato must have been telling us to splash water on the portrait, right?
;(The Traveler walks up to the painting and makes a splash. After the pair waits several moments, their expressions change to troubled concern. A figure painted with special ink appears, revealing...)
:{{A|vo rcjeq006 10 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' *gasp* It's... It's [[Scaramouche|the Balladeer]]!
:{{A|vo rcjeq006 10 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So he was the one behind the trouble all those years ago!

;(Flashback begins of the Traveler and Paimon's continuing conversation with Ayato)
:{{A|vo rcjeq006 10 ayato 15.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' When there is no one else near the portrait, you can confirm with your own eyes.
:{{A|vo rcjeq006 10 ayato 16.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' As for the means of revealing that answer... well, you have used it many times before.
:{{A|vo rcjeq006 10 ayato 01.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' Also, there's one last thing that we must discuss.
:{{A|vo rcjeq006 10 ayato 02.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' I mentioned earlier that the occurrence of "a certain incident" made me notice the bonsai plants. I wish to tell you of that incident now.
:{{A|vo rcjeq006 10 ayato 03.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' It was just after the Shogun announced the abolition of the Sakoku Decree. I heard that something had happened at the Tenryou Commission.
:{{A|vo rcjeq006 10 ayato 04.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' They had discovered signs that someone had entered the warehouse storing the commission's articles of evidence and confiscated items. But, nothing was stolen.
:{{A|vo rcjeq006 10 ayato 05.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' I felt something unusual about that incident, so I told Kujou Sara of the Tenryou Commission to treat it as if nothing happened. She was not to increase the guard or relocate the warehouse contents.
:{{A|vo rcjeq006 10 ayato 06.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' In the meantime, I sent a member of the [[Shuumatsuban]] to keep watch over the warehouse. And sure enough, someone was sneaking in and rummaging through the belongings of the Kaedehara Clan.
:{{A|vo rcjeq006 10 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You mean, he was also looking for...
:{{A|vo rcjeq006 10 ayato 07.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' Heh, I let him search for a while, but in the end, he found nothing. Soon after, he had to leave Inazuma by boat.
:{{A|vo rcjeq006 10 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Why didn't you send someone to catch him?
:{{A|vo rcjeq006 10 ayato 08.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' Hehe. The best way to protect a secret is to treat it as if it doesn't exist, is it not? Besides, the identity of this person is not hard to guess.
:{{A|vo rcjeq006 10 ayato 09.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' After he left Inazuma, I carefully checked the Kaedehara Clan's belongings one by one, and eventually discovered the papers in the hidden compartment of the flower pot.
:{{A|vo rcjeq006 10 ayato 10.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' I am certain that the papers are the secret which the infiltrator sought to find, though he couldn't confirm whether this secret existed at all.
:{{A|vo rcjeq006 10 ayato 11.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' So, now on to my final question...
:{{A|vo rcjeq006 10 ayato 12.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' Which part of Kaedehara Yoshinori's experiences was the secret that needed to be protected?
:{{DIcon}} That Kaedehara Yoshinori knew that the family was framed?
:{{DIcon}} That Kaedehara Yoshinori knew that the culprit was named Kunikuzushi?
:{{DIcon}} That Kaedehara Yoshinori was spared by his opponent?
:{{A|vo rcjeq006 10 ayato 13.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' Hahaha, I don't have an answer to this question at present, so I'll leave it to your future self.
:{{A|vo rcjeq006 10 ayato 14.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' As for now, please enjoy yourselves at the Irodori Festival.
;(Quest ends)

;(Examine Kuronushi's Likeness)
:'''Kuronushi's Likeness:''' (This is Albedo's portrait of Kuronushi.)
:'''Kuronushi's Likeness:''' (He used a special ink here to depict "Kunikuzushi," a secret that was only revealed when the canvas' surface touched water.)
:'''Kuronushi's Likeness:''' (The way Ayato puts it, it seems that the person who tried to furtively search for the secret was a Fatui spy. But "who" would want to hide Kunikuzushi's past?)
:'''Kuronushi's Likeness:''' (And what effect might this secret have on your own destiny?)
{{Dialogue End}}

'''''The Formula for a Miracle''''' is the third and final part of {{Quest|The Heart of Healing}}.

==Steps==
# Return to the west of [[Qingce Village]]
# Follow [[Jialiang]]
# Talk to Jialiang and the others
# Head to the underground space
#* Enter the Quest Domain: [[Entanglement of Past Dreams]]
# Talk to [[Baizhu]] and the others
# Proceed deeper
#* Wave 1: {{Enemy List|Hilichurl*2;Hilichurl Fighter}}
#* Wave 2: {{Enemy List|Hilichurl*2;Hilichurl Fighter*2}}
# Talk to Baizhu and the others
# Proceed deeper

# Follow [[Jiangli]]
# Talk to Jiangli

==Gameplay Notes==
* From step 1 until completing step 3, going too far away from the quest area will reset the quest progress to the beginning of step 1.
* During steps 4–9, a [[Character Trial|trial]] Baizhu will join the party.
* From step 10 until completing step 11, going too far away from the quest area will reset the quest progress to the beginning of step 10.
* During step 11, the active party will be limited to a trial Baizhu.
** Before leaving the back room of Bubu Pharmacy, all menus (except for the Quest, Character, and Map menus) and actions (except for Quest Navigation) are inaccessible.
* Permanently missable chests inside the domain: {{Item|Common Chest|x=2}}, {{Item|Exquisite Chest|x=1}}.

:{{A|vo bzlq003 5 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh no! Are you saying...
:{{A|vo bzlq003 5 baizhu 04.ogg}} '''Baizhu:''' Indeed. If the god remains here are purged... then your life will come to an end.
:{{A|vo bzlq003 5 jialiang 02.ogg}} '''Jialiang:''' ...*sigh* I wondered when this day might come...

:{{A|vo bzlq003 5 changsheng 04.ogg}} '''Changsheng:''' It appears to me that she was striving to concoct your medicine for you, right up until the moment when she lost consciousness... Maybe it's her greatest wish that you will continue to take it, and live...

:{{A|vo bzlq003 5 baizhu 06.ogg}} '''Baizhu:''' The god remains have reached her internal organs. Under ordinary circumstances, I would give her less than three days. But if I were to treat her using a secret art...

:{{A|vo bzlq003 5 jialiang 05.ogg}} '''Jialiang:''' Dr. Baizhu... I'm all too aware of the dangers of god remains. You are not the first to mention it to me.
:{{A|vo bzlq003 5 jialiang 06.ogg}} '''Jialiang:''' If I continue to sustain my own life using this wretched substance, not only would Jiangli have to keep risking her life to make my medicine for me, but I would have to live with the looming threat of these remains breaking out and wreaking havoc not just upon me, but my entire family...
:{{A|vo bzlq003 5 jialiang 07.ogg}} '''Jialiang:''' ...I know for a fact that I should have died over a decade ago. The fact that I've been around to see [[Ayu]] grow up is already a great blessing from [[Rex Lapis]].
:{{A|vo bzlq003 5 jialiang 08.ogg}} '''Jialiang:''' If my choice can bring Jiangli back... then even if I... even if I... die...
:{{A|vo bzlq003 5 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Jialiang...
:{{A|vo bzlq003 5 jialiang 09.ogg}} '''Jialiang:''' ...Hah, after cheating death for so long, it seems I've grown somewhat addicted to life.
:{{A|vo bzlq003 5 jialiang 10.ogg}} '''Jialiang:''' {{Traveler}}, Dr. Baizhu... Could I have another minute with my wife? I just want to have... one final moment together. Just a moment, that's all.
:{{A|vo bzlq003 5 baizhu 07.ogg}} '''Baizhu:''' ...Of course.
:{{A|vo bzlq003 5 jialiang 11.ogg}} '''Jialiang:''' Thank you, everyone. And I'm sorry that... I won't be able to repay your kindness in this life.
:{{A|vo bzlq003 5 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' *sniff* Jialiang... Baizhu, [[Changsheng]], is there really nothing else you can do?
:{{A|vo bzlq003 5 baizhu 08.ogg}} '''Baizhu:''' I am sure that over the years, Jiangli will have tried all the conventional methods known to humankind. As for less-conventional methods, I have little expertise besides Changsheng's secret art...
:{{A|vo bzlq003 5 changsheng 05.ogg}} '''Changsheng:''' Mortals are fated to grow old and pass on when their natural lifespan runs out. If it were so easy to combat the natural processes of aging and death, Jiangli would not have had to resort to unnatural methods.
:{{A|vo bzlq003 5 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What a crazy situation... Jiangli risked it all to save Jialiang's life, and now, Jialiang has to sacrifice himself to save Jiangli... Wh—What's the point of it all?
:{{DIcon}} All we can do right now...
:{{DIcon}} Is honor Jialiang's decision and bear witness.
:{{A|vo bzlq003 5 baizhu 09.ogg}} '''Baizhu:''' I've seen many final farewells in my time... but I can never get used to it.
:{{A|vo bzlq003 5 changsheng 06.ogg}} '''Changsheng:''' In the human realm, all things must come to an end... Is it not a fitting end to die for a worthy cause?
:{{A|vo bzlq003 5 changsheng 07.ogg}} '''Changsheng:''' ...At least, that's what generations of masters before you have always believed.
:{{A|vo bzlq003 5 baizhu 10.ogg}} '''Baizhu:''' The path they chose was indeed a heroic one. But when I think of those who would willingly sacrifice themselves for others...
:{{A|vo bzlq003 5 baizhu 11.ogg}} '''Baizhu:''' ...I cannot help but think that theirs are the lives least deserving of death.
:{{A|vo bzlq003 5 jialiang 12.ogg}} '''Jialiang:''' ...When all this began, we agreed that once Ayu was old enough to help you gather herbs, it would be time for me to go...
:{{A|vo bzlq003 5 jialiang 13.ogg}} '''Jialiang:''' If you could only see him now... He took me all the way to [[Liyue Harbor]] to see the doctor, and he even got the [[Adventurers' Guild]] to search for you...
:{{A|vo bzlq003 5 jialiang 14.ogg}} '''Jialiang:''' ...So I know that you'll both be okay without me.
:{{A|vo bzlq003 5 jialiang 15.ogg}} '''Jialiang:''' ...!

:{{A|vo bzlq003 5 changsheng 08.ogg}} '''Changsheng:''' ...
:{{A|vo bzlq003 5 jialiang 16.ogg}} '''Jialiang:''' I've said my goodbyes. My time has come... Do what you must.

:{{A|vo bzlq003 5 jialiang 17.ogg}} '''Jialiang:''' ...Ugh...Arghhh...
:{{Black Screen|{{A|vo bzlq003 5 jiangli 01.ogg}} ...It will eat away at both your cognition and your memories... In the end, you'll become little more than a shadow of your true self...}}

:{{A|vo bzlq003 6 baizhu 08.ogg}} '''Baizhu:''' In the end, I am merely a doctor. I understand very little of the great principles governing life and death, and the perpetual cycle of yin and yang.

:{{A|vo bzlq003 6 baizhu 11.ogg}} '''Baizhu:''' Without Director Hu nudging things in the right direction, we may not have found Jiangli in time.

:{{DIcon}} So it was Hu Tao!

:{{A|vo bzlq003 6 hutao 04.ogg}} '''Hu Tao:''' ...All I wanted was to help Jialiang find his missing wife as soon as possible, so that he could be on his way to the afterlife without any unfulfilled wishes making the journey more difficult than it needs to be...
:{{A|vo bzlq003 6 hutao 05.ogg}} '''Hu Tao:''' Leave it to Bubu Pharmacy to snatch the perfect opportunity right outta my hands at the last hurdle! Never mind, I'll just have to put it down in the books as a deferred consideration.

:{{A|vo bzlq003 6 hutao 07.ogg}} '''Hu Tao:''' Ooh, is that right? Well, you wouldn't be the first person who's tried to put Wangsheng Funeral Parlor out of business. If you're serious about it, you'll have your work cut out for you.

:{{A|vo bzlq003 7 baizhu 04.ogg}} '''Baizhu:''' When I treated Jialiang for the second time, I transferred some of the poison from his body into my own. Not only did this allow me to alleviate the burden on him, but it also gave me an opportunity to study its properties...

:{{A|vo bzlq003 7 jiangli 08.ogg}} '''Jiangli:''' ...Hah. What am I saying? I'm in no position to criticize you for this.
:{{A|vo bzlq003 7 jiangli 09.ogg}} '''Jiangli:''' The reason I left our [[Baizhu's Master|Master]] and went into hiding all those years ago was that he was getting old, and I didn't want him using up any more of his own life force to treat my husband.
:{{A|vo bzlq003 7 jiangli 10.ogg}} '''Jiangli:''' But in the end, how were my methods any different? I risked one life to save another. And then you tried the poison on yourself, too... It looks like both of us have ended up going the same way as our master before us.

:{{A|vo bzlq003 7 jiangli 13.ogg}} '''Jiangli:''' Can you... still stop before it's too late?
:{{A|vo bzlq003 7 baizhu 07.ogg}} '''Baizhu:''' I think you know the answer, Jiangli. Every one of us from Chenyu Vale believes in the same thing...

:{{A|vo bzlq003 7 ayu 02a.ogg}}<!--{{A|vo bzlq003 7 ayu 02b.ogg}}--> '''Ayu:''' {{Traveler}} taught me a load of new recipes, and said even dad'll be able to taste them! Come and try them out!

{{Cutscene Description|A pharmacist once made a symbiotic pact with Changsheng to reverse death and cure harsh diseases with inhuman powers. However, this caused the pharmacist to pass away at a young age after burning up the pharmacist's own life...<br>The pharmacist's pursuit and the pact with Changsheng were inherited by the pharmacist's disciple. They continued healing the sick and saving lives with the mysterious power, generation after generation.<br>It is a doctor's job to heal the sick and save lives. However, are the healers bound by the pact and forced down a path to premature death not worthy of being saved? To them, is the pact a life-saving medicine, or a life-ending poison?<br>—In the last days of Baizhu's master, he left such a question to Baizhu. And now, standing in front of the master's tomb, Baizhu has given his answer...}}

::'''Changsheng:''' Time and again... No matter how much I try to warn them
::'''Changsheng:''' Or balance their qi, I can never save them...
::'''Changsheng:''' And you? What's your answer?
::'''Baizhu:''' ...If I abandoned the contract and left you without a host, what would happen?
::'''Changsheng:''' Hmm... I suppose I'd spend my final moments taking a nice nap on Mt. Yaojun
::'''Changsheng:''' Then, I'd be reunited with my old friends, and your predecessors
::'''Baizhu:''' Then it's decided
::'''Baizhu:''' If there's a life in front of me that deserves to be saved
::'''Baizhu:''' Why shouldn't I do everything within my power to save it?
::'''Changsheng:''' ...*sigh* Once again, it's the same answer
::'''Changsheng:''' So be it. Close your eyes
::'''Changsheng:''' ...Who knows how many more people will take on this contract
::'''Baizhu:''' None
::'''Baizhu:''' This contract... will end with me
:;(Baizhu opens his eyes to reveal that his irises have changed from red to yellow with vertical pupils)
:;(Cinematic ends)
:{{A|vo bzlq003 7 changsheng 03.ogg}} '''Changsheng:''' ...My contract has strict requirements on the host's natural temperament. All my hosts have been most pure of heart.
:{{A|vo bzlq003 7 baizhu 11.ogg}} '''Baizhu:''' But when one with an altruistic nature gains access to this art, they are more seduced than the average person by the miracle of overturning the laws of life and death.
:{{A|vo bzlq003 7 baizhu 12.ogg}} '''Baizhu:''' Though they know better than anyone else the fate that awaits them, when faced with the sorrows of humanity and the pain of losing their nearest and dearest, they cannot help but reach beyond human means.
:{{A|vo bzlq003 7 baizhu 13.ogg}} '''Baizhu:''' ...They are like moths that throw themselves into the flame, seeking a glimmer of hope in a dark world filled with pain and suffering.
:{{A|vo bzlq003 7 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So... Baizhu, does that mean...
:{{A|vo bzlq003 7 baizhu 14.ogg}} '''Baizhu:''' Heh... I suppose that would make me a moth that yearns for the light, but doesn't want to be burned to a crisp.
:{{A|vo bzlq003 7 baizhu 15.ogg}} '''Baizhu:''' Changsheng's art can transfer pain and suffering between people, but it cannot reduce the total amount of pain in the world. It's just like we witnessed: either Jialiang feared for Jiangli's life, or Jiangli grieved over Jialiang's sacrifice.
:{{A|vo bzlq003 7 baizhu 16.ogg}} '''Baizhu:''' I have nothing but the utmost respect for my predecessors who sacrificed their lives for their principles, but I do not wish to join their ranks... nor do I wish to pass on this contract to anyone else in the future.
:{{A|vo bzlq003 7 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh? But, didn't you already transfer a ton of diseases onto yourself?
:{{A|vo bzlq003 7 baizhu 17.ogg}} '''Baizhu:''' What makes a poison, "poison"? And what makes a disease, a "disease"? When it comes down to it, are not both mechanisms that affect the operations of the human body?
:{{A|vo bzlq003 7 baizhu 18.ogg}} '''Baizhu:''' If disease is defined as deviation from normal functioning, then who knows... perhaps the true Elixir of Immortality could in fact be a kind of poison?
:{{A|vo bzlq003 7 baizhu 19.ogg}} '''Baizhu:''' Many may view the notion of searching for immortality in poisons and illnesses as a flagrant violation of the natural order. But to me, it is no different from the way our ancestors tested the medicinal qualities of herbs by sampling each and every one.
:{{A|vo bzlq003 7 baizhu 20.ogg}} '''Baizhu:''' I don't want those who come after me to lose their lives to this contract, nor do I wish for Changsheng to perish from losing her host... This leaves only one solution, doesn't it?
:{{DIcon}} The Elixir of Immortality...
:{{DIcon}} You have to become immortal yourself...
:{{A|vo bzlq003 7 baizhu 21.ogg}} '''Baizhu:''' Precisely. I will be Changsheng's final host, and the tradition of passing down the contract will end with me.
:{{A|vo bzlq003 7 changsheng 04.ogg}} '''Changsheng:''' ...Even the gods of old struggled to achieve true immortality. First you want to save others, then you want to save yourself. Now you even want to save me... You're getting greedy, Baizhu.
:{{A|vo bzlq003 7 baizhu 22.ogg}} '''Baizhu:''' Mmm... but isn't wanting to have it all what makes us human?
:{{A|vo bzlq003 7 baizhu 23.ogg}} '''Baizhu:''' ...For a selfish moth like me, who's afraid of the flame, yet yearns for the light, the only path forward is up towards the moon.
:{{A|vo bzlq003 7 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' *sigh*... For once, Paimon just does not know what to say.
:{{A|vo bzlq003 7 ayu 03a.ogg}}<!--{{A|vo bzlq003 7 ayu 03b.ogg}}--> '''Ayu:''' Dr. Baizhu! {{Traveler}}! What are you still chatting about? The food's about to get cold!
:{{A|vo bzlq003 7 qiqi 01.ogg}} '''Qiqi:''' We also have coconut milk, for Changsheng and Paimon...
:{{A|vo bzlq003 7 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ummm... Okay fine, let's go grab some food! Paimon has a bunch of burning questions, but they can wait till after we've eaten.
:{{DIcon}} Oh, Paimon...
:{{DIcon}} Leave some grub for me.
:{{A|vo bzlq003 7 changsheng 05.ogg}} '''Changsheng:''' Ah, I do envy Paimon sometimes. Eating her fill is enough to satisfy her body and mind...
:{{A|vo bzlq003 7 baizhu 24.ogg}} '''Baizhu:''' Hehe, true. And yet... although we call them simple pleasures...
:{{A|vo bzlq003 7 baizhu 25.ogg}} '''Baizhu:''' Are such things as these not precisely why we mortals cling desperately to the life we have?

;(Interact with the message on the door of Jiangli's residence, optional)
:'''Message:''' "We're going to [[Natlan]]! Mom told me that there could be herbs there that aren't in any medicine books."
:'''Message:''' "I've heard that [[Toyac Springs|the hot springs]] in Natlan help with muscle relaxation and blood circulation. Perhaps they will be beneficial for Jialiang..."
:'''Message:''' "Let's not think too much about that for now, and just focus on the journey! We are going to enjoy every moment we can spend as a family."
:'''Message:''' (At the end of the message, you see three crudely drawn stick figures. It shows a man, a woman and their son, holding hands as they set off on a new journey.)
{{Dialogue End}}

==Steps==
# Wait until two days later
# Go to [[Wangsheng Funeral Parlor]]
# Go to [[Wuwang Hill]] and search for [[Qiqi]]
# Search for Qiqi
# Fend off the monsters
#* Wave 1: {{Enemy List|Hilichurl Fighter*3}}
#* Wave 2: {{Enemy List|Blazing Axe Mitachurl;Hilichurl Shooter*2/Multishot variant}}
# Examine the rattan figures near the monsters
# Go meet [[Ningguang]]
# Seek assistance from the [[Conqueror of Demons]] at [[Wangshu Inn]]
# Find the source of the fetor
#* Defeat enemies: {{Enemy List|Hilichurl*3}}
# Go to Wuwang Hill
#* This step only appears if the player leaves the quest area or dies during the previous step
# Enter the border between life and death
#* The player will be teleported into the Quest Domain [[Enter the "border" (The Funeral Parlor Has No Master, Yujing Terrace Calls the Troops)|Enter the "border"]]
# Find the three people who are trapped
# Fend off the monsters
# Talk to Xiao
# Return to [[Yujing Terrace]]
# Meet [[Lan Yan]] at the [[Adventurers' Guild]]
# Visit [[Hu Tao]] at the Wangsheng Funeral Parlor

==Gameplay Notes==
* During Step 9, the active party will be limited to a trial [[Xiao]]. Additionally, the effect of Yaksha's Mask from [[Bane of All Evil]] will be active throughout. Receiving an [[energy particle]] from an enemy, including any nearby enemy that is unrelated to the quest, will restore 10% of Xiao's HP.
* During Step 13 the active party will be limited to a trial [[Hu Tao]], [[Lan Yan]], and [[Qiqi]], as well as the [[Traveler]].

==Dialogue==
{{Quest Description|The [[Lantern Rite Festival|Lantern Rite]] has come around once more. What stories will be written in [[Liyue Harbor]] this year...}}
{{Dialogue Start}}<!-- Silent in EN VO: Beidou, Changsheng, Gaming, Hu Tao, Ningguang, Qiqi, Xiao, Yelan -->
;(Pass time)
:{{A|vo eqhdj402 1 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Whew, it's been two whole days. Surely Hu Tao must have finished her work by now? Let's go to the funeral parlor and check.
{{Dialogue End}}
{{Quest Description|update|After two days have passed, you decide to visit the Wangsheng Funeral Parlor to see if Hu Tao has returned...}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Approach Wangsheng Funeral Parlor)
:{{A|vo eqhdj402 2 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hey there! It's us again, hehe.
:{{A|vo eqhdj402 2 ferrylady 01.ogg}} '''Ferrylady:''' Hello, you two. I'm so sorry, but if you're looking for the director, I'm afraid she still hasn't returned.
:{{A|vo eqhdj402 2 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What? She still isn't back after two whole days?
:{{DIcon}} Is that normal?
:{{A|vo eqhdj402 2 ferrylady 02.ogg}} '''Ferrylady:''' Hmm... Not exactly, but it's not unheard of. The director is unpredictable sometimes. She's been known to disappear for up to two weeks.
:{{A|vo eqhdj402 2 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Okay, well in that case, a couple of days isn't a huge deal. Hu Tao will be Hu Tao...
:'''Gaming:''' Hey hey! I spy {{Traveler}} and a Paimon! Man, how long's it been? Happy Lantern Rite!
:{{Introductory Note|Gaming}}
:{{A|vo eqhdj402 2 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, hey, Gaming!
:{{DIcon}} Happy Lantern Rite, Gaming.
:{{A|vo eqhdj402 2 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So, what brings you here?
:'''Gaming:''' I gotta make a delivery to [[Chenyu Vale]]. It works out nicely, 'cause my [[Yip Tak|dad]]'s eager for me to get home for the holidays anyway. So, two birds with one stone.
:{{A|vo eqhdj402 2 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hold on! A delivery from the Wangsheng Funeral Parlor to Chenyu Vale? ...Is this for the [[Feiyun Commerce Guild]], by any chance?
:'''Gaming:''' ...Wait, what? Have you been learning fortune-telling, or something? How could you know that?
:{{A|vo eqhdj402 2 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' No, no. We just ran into [[Xingqiu]] a couple days ago, so he told us the news...
:'''Gaming:''' Whew, you scared me there for a second! I thought we'd sprung a leak, and on the one job that we were specifically told has to be extremely hush-hush... But it sounds like you found out from another source, so we're all good.
:'''Gaming:''' Miss Undertaker, is everything ready to be loaded up? If so, I'll do a quick inventory count and then we'll be on our way.
:{{A|vo eqhdj402 2 ferrylady 03.ogg}} '''Ferrylady:''' The goods are ready for inspection. This way, please.
:{{A|vo eqhdj402 2 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wait, Gaming... the last we heard, [[Baizhu]] was still trying to figure out a way to help Xingqiu's great-grandfather. So... did it not work, then?
:'''Gaming:''' Oh. The Baizhu part is news to me... but anyway, the master from the Feiyun Commerce Guild said they just wanna ship some items back home to get ahead of the situation.
:'''Gaming:''' I guess they're hoping for the best and planning for the worst. So don't worry, there's still hope.
:{{A|vo eqhdj402 2 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ah, gotcha. Hey, {{Traveler}}, do you think we should go see Xingqiu?

:{{DIcon}} What is this Seven-and-Eight-Gates Method?

:{{A|vo eqhdj402 13 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' And the seven?

:{{A|vo eqhdj402 13 lanyan 03.ogg}} '''Lan Yan:''' As in, disappear from the Ley Lines completely, never to be seen again — taking the banished evil along with them.
:{{A|vo eqhdj402 13 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So... so someone has to die for this to work? But... you can't seriously be considering this?

:'''Ningguang:''' Director Hu...
:'''Hu Tao:''' Hmm? Something to add, Lady Tianquan?

:{{A|vo eqhdj402 13 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh? There was a disaster at Wuwang Hill? What happened?
:{{A|vo eqhdj402 13 lanyan 04.ogg}} '''Lan Yan:''' Some sort of natural disaster, wasn't it? There used to be a village there, but then there was a flood or something. It took a lot of lives, and all the survivors moved away.
:{{A|vo eqhdj402 13 lanyan 05.ogg}} '''Lan Yan:''' Hmm... But that doesn't explain how Wuwang Hill became the dark and gloomy place it is today. Maybe there was... more to it?
:'''Hu Tao:''' Phew...
:'''Hu Tao:''' No, Lady Tianquan. I don't think these two events are related.
:'''Ningguang:''' Excellent, well that puts my mind at ease. Everyone, let's meet here again in two days. We should know the locations of all the gates by then.
:'''Hu Tao:''' Alright. Well, I've still got a lot of preparations to make, so I'll be heading back to the funeral parlor now.
:{{A|vo eqhdj402 13 lanyan 06.ogg}} '''Lan Yan:''' Sounds good. If we're all done here, I'd better get going too.

;(Approach the Adventurer's Guild)
:{{A|vo eqhdj402 15 lanyan 01.ogg}} '''Lan Yan:''' {{Traveler}}, Paimon! Over here! Perfect timing — I literally just posted my letter.
:{{A|vo eqhdj402 15 lanyan 02.ogg}} '''Lan Yan:''' Anyway, back to your question... Let me guess, you're probably thinking I predicted the border crisis with some kind of mysterious magic?
:{{A|vo eqhdj402 15 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Well, yeah. Aren't the Lans of Chenyu Vale all experts at Qimen Divination, or something?
:{{A|vo eqhdj402 15 lanyan 03.ogg}} '''Lan Yan:''' *sigh* No, that's simply not true. Yes, the Qimen arts have been practiced in my clan for many generations, and yes, Wind Reader is listed as one of our ancestors in the genealogy...
:{{A|vo eqhdj402 15 lanyan 04.ogg}} '''Lan Yan:''' But my family are only distant relatives — we branched off from the main family line long ago. By my grandpa's generation, the only Qimen he knew was a few parlor tricks.
:{{A|vo eqhdj402 15 lanyan 05.ogg}} '''Lan Yan:''' Put it like this — my grandpa makes a living telling fortunes in [[Yilong Wharf]], but I'm making more than him just selling my handmade arts and crafts.
:{{A|vo eqhdj402 15 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh... So why exactly did you come to look for Hu Tao?
:{{A|vo eqhdj402 15 lanyan 06.ogg}} '''Lan Yan:''' Because Grandpa's readings have gone sideways recently. The romance and career fortunes are doing okay, but when it comes to longevity, everyone's reading is suddenly saying they only have a few years left to live. It gave grandpa quite a fright.
:{{A|vo eqhdj402 15 lanyan 07.ogg}} '''Lan Yan:''' Fearing backlash from his clients, he closed shop and shut himself away at home, trying to divine an answer to the strange readings. But after days and nights of divination, the only clue he got was: "Wangsheng Funeral Parlor."
:{{A|vo eqhdj402 15 lanyan 08.ogg}} '''Lan Yan:''' Right around that time, I happened to receive an invitation from the Ministry of Civil Affairs to organize a street fair. So, I figured I might as well drop by the funeral parlor to see what Director Hu might know about all this.
:{{A|vo eqhdj402 15 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh... Wait, so... Your grandpa's divinations were correct all along, weren't they? The longevity readings were affected by the border crisis, and "Wangsheng Funeral Parlor" was the answer, because they can fix it!
:{{A|vo eqhdj402 15 lanyan 09.ogg}} '''Lan Yan:''' It's certainly looking that way. Apparently, every soul in Liyue is now living under the creeping shadow of death, but so far, we are the only ones in the know.
:{{DIcon}} I have another question. What's the deal with this rattan figure?
:{{A|vo eqhdj402 15 lanyan 10.ogg}} '''Lan Yan:''' Wait, that's the one I left at Miss Ying'er's shop... It's actually a product of genuine Qimen art. It's engraved with an exorcism sigil to absorb inauspicious energy in their owner's place, so they won't come to harm.
:{{A|vo eqhdj402 15 lanyan 11.ogg}} '''Lan Yan:''' I had no idea you'd been holding onto it all this time... Haha, I guess it was meant to be. You're more than welcome to keep it if you like.
:{{A|vo eqhdj402 15 lanyan 12.ogg}} '''Lan Yan:''' When I first arrived in Liyue Harbor, I passed by a large house, and felt a chill go down my spine. So I made a rattan figure, and gave it to the young master there.
:{{A|vo eqhdj402 15 lanyan 13.ogg}} '''Lan Yan:''' Later on, I also sensed something similar around Timaeus, so I made another one, and left it at Scent of Spring.
:{{A|vo eqhdj402 15 lanyan 14.ogg}} '''Lan Yan:''' Then, I followed Director Hu to Wuwang Hill, only to find she'd disappeared without a trace. While I was searching the area, I found Miss Qiqi. She was stuck in some kind of crevice, and she seemed to be blocking something from coming through.
:{{A|vo eqhdj402 15 lanyan 15.ogg}} '''Lan Yan:''' When I tried to pull her out, we both got pulled in to a cold, dark place... which, I soon discovered, was the border.
:{{A|vo eqhdj402 15 lanyan 16.ogg}} '''Lan Yan:''' We wandered around aimlessly for a while until we ran into Director Hu. She'd lit some incense and was burning fetor left and right with a flaming staff.
:{{A|vo eqhdj402 15 lanyan 17.ogg}} '''Lan Yan:''' But there was just too much... There was no way she could hope to get rid of it all. Worse still, the fetor blocked off the way we'd come in, trapping us inside. Thank goodness you came to our rescue!
:{{A|vo eqhdj402 15 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Whew, what an ordeal... Still, your family sounds more impressive than you let on — didn't you use some kind of illusion magic in the border?
:{{A|vo eqhdj402 15 lanyan 18.ogg}} '''Lan Yan:''' Ah, yes. Actually, that and the rattan figures are things I learned from one of my cousins in the main branch of my family. She's been practicing the Qimen arts since she was little. She's also the one I posed some questions to in my letter back home.
:{{DIcon}} Questions about the Seven-and-Eight-Gates Method?
:{{A|vo eqhdj402 15 lanyan 19.ogg}} '''Lan Yan:''' Wow. Good guess... Yes, I want to know for sure whether sacrificing one of the participants is a necessary part of the method or not. I figured she might know.
:{{A|vo eqhdj402 15 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh? But Hu Tao already told us it won't come to that... She said we just need to make sure the person can withstand a strong blast of fetor.
:{{A|vo eqhdj402 15 lanyan 20.ogg}} '''Lan Yan:''' Mm... I certainly hope that's true, but I can't help but feel uneasy about it. I haven't known Director Hu for long, but... I get the sense that she prefers to keep the truth bottled up sometimes.
:{{A|vo eqhdj402 15 lanyan 21.ogg}} '''Lan Yan:''' Sure, she talks a lot, and isn't afraid to broach dark and uncomfortable topics. But she really hasn't said much in the way of her own, private thoughts. It's like she's already got a plan, and is keeping it to herself.
:{{A|vo eqhdj402 15 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You mean... You think she lied to us...?
:{{A|vo eqhdj402 15 lanyan 22.ogg}} '''Lan Yan:''' I wouldn't call it "lying," per se, but... remember when the Tianquan asked about the incident at Wuwang Hill from a decade ago?
:{{A|vo eqhdj402 15 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yep! Hu Tao said that it doesn't have anything to do with what's happening now. Are you saying they actually are related?
:{{DIcon}} Do you know anything about what happened back then, Lan Yan?
:{{A|vo eqhdj402 15 lanyan 23.ogg}} '''Lan Yan:''' I just heard that there was a flood. But given everything that's going on, I think it likely had to do with the border as well. That would at least explain the strange weather going on at Wuwang Hill.
:{{A|vo eqhdj402 15 lanyan 24.ogg}} '''Lan Yan:''' I remember my cousin saying that around that time, the Wangsheng Funeral Parlor set up an altar on top of the hill. I just assumed it was for a funeral, but now, I can't help but wonder if it was some sort of ritual to try and fix the border.
:{{A|vo eqhdj402 15 lanyan 25.ogg}} '''Lan Yan:''' Anyway, the ceremony was hosted jointly by two former directors of the Wangsheng Funeral Parlor. Namely, Hu Tao's [[Hu Tao's Father|father]] and [[Old Hu|grandfather]].

:{{A|vo eqhdj402 15 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Whoa, really? Hu Tao's never mentioned her dad to us before... How strange. So you think there's more to this story, huh?
:{{A|vo eqhdj402 15 lanyan 26.ogg}} '''Lan Yan:''' Yeah... But since she brushed it aside when the Tianquan asked her about it, I don't see how I can broach the topic. I've only known her for a few days...
:{{DIcon}} I guess we should go talk to Hu Tao ourselves.
:{{A|vo eqhdj402 15 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh? You think we should ask her about it? But she's never opened up to us about family stuff before... What if she shuts us out?

;(Approach Hu Tao at the Wangsheng Funeral Parlor)
:'''Hu Tao:''' ...
:{{A|vo eqhdj402 17 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hu Tao!
:'''Hu Tao:''' {{Traveler}}, Paimon! What's up? We haven't spoken in five minutes and you're missing me already?
:{{A|vo eqhdj402 17 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yep! So we thought we'd come hang out with you. What were you looking at just now?
:'''Hu Tao:''' Something so amazing, you wouldn't believe it. But I'm not showing you.
:{{DIcon}} Why? ...Is it a secret photo of me?
:'''Hu Tao:''' Hahaha! Seriously though, you probably shouldn't joke about that. You don't wanna jinx it...
:{{DIcon}} Jinx it how?
:'''Hu Tao:''' Well, the people in this picture keep appearing in my dreams lately, and none of them are around anymore... So keeping you out of the picture is probably for the best.
:'''Hu Tao:''' Haha, alright, I'll quit joking around. Here, take a look.
:{{A|vo eqhdj402 17 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh? Wait, are they...?
:<gallery widths="350">
The Funeral Parlor Has No Master, Yujing Terrace Calls the Troops Quest Still 2.png
</gallery>
:'''Hu Tao:''' Yeah, my dad and my grandpa. Without this picture, I'd probably have forgotten what my dad looked like by now. When he passed, I was still too young to understand what was going on.
:'''Hu Tao:''' Everything I know about my dad, I learned from my grandpa.
:{{DIcon}} So... what happened to him?
:'''Hu Tao:''' There was a border incident on Wuwang Hill about a dozen years ago. My dad tried using the Art of Homa to burn away the fetor, but he slipped up and suffered a lethal exposure to it. He died on the spot.
:{{A|vo eqhdj402 17 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' That's awful... So, is that what made Wuwang Hill the way it is today?
:'''Hu Tao:''' Yep. His mistake didn't just cost him his own life — it took most of the village out, and left lasting changes on Wuwang Hill itself.
:'''Hu Tao:''' Thankfully, my grandpa managed to deal with the fallout — but that's not to say he escaped unscathed... He didn't even make it to sixty before he passed.
:{{DIcon}} So your grandpa was affected by the incident with your dad?
:'''Hu Tao:''' Well, he never admitted it, of course. But given how fit and healthy he was before that, I would've expected him to have a few more years in him...
:{{A|vo eqhdj402 17 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Sounds like... You blame your dad for all of this...
:'''Hu Tao:''' How could I not? It would be one thing if he was just a spoiled brat who never amounted to anything. But he was a genius. He was, and still is, the best spellcaster in [[Hu Family|our family]] for generations.
:'''Hu Tao:''' Grandpa always called me gifted for mastering the Wangsheng arts by the age of eight, but by the time my dad was eight, he was already hosting rituals and incinerating fetor all by himself.
:'''Hu Tao:''' Fixing the border crisis should have been a piece of cake for him, and he messed up. Who else is there to blame, if not him?
:{{A|vo eqhdj402 17 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' But... Maybe the question is, why did he mess up?
:'''Hu Tao:''' Because he was an unworthy director. Every past director has burned away all of their belongings when they pass on, leaving at most one or two items behind.
:'''Hu Tao:''' My grandpa, for example, left only his hat behind. But my dad? He left a whole pile of stuff, including this meaningless picture...
:{{A|vo eqhdj402 17 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' But doesn't that just show how much he cared...?
:'''Hu Tao:''' No — all it shows is that he was unable to let go. And the fact that he couldn't let go is precisely why he failed during that ritual.
:'''Hu Tao:''' He was too attached to his aging father, his young daughter, and the world where we were all together.
:'''Hu Tao:''' That's why he hesitated in that final moment. Because he was afraid to die, he lost focus, and death won, taking his life and many others.
:'''Hu Tao:''' In this line of work, we know better than anyone how hard letting go can be. We see it all the time. But as funeral directors, it's the one thing we cannot allow ourselves to fall victim to.
:'''Hu Tao:''' Like Grandpa always said, we should live in life, and die in death... That's the whole basis of the Wangsheng Funeral Parlor's existence.
:'''Hu Tao:''' Unfortunately, with my dad, these teachings went in one ear and out the other. He really let everyone down.
:{{A|vo eqhdj402 17 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You don't need to be so hard on him... Sure, he made a mistake, but he can't have meant for things to turn out this way.
:'''Hu Tao:''' You're missing the point, my little Paimon. It's precisely because he's my dad that I choose not to hold back.
:'''Hu Tao:''' There isn't a father in the world who would disapprove of their daughter being outspoken. Because a father's biggest fear is that once he's not around anymore, his daughter will never get to be that carefree, sassy little kid ever again.
:'''Hu Tao:''' So, I'm gonna keep talking trash about him all I want. And on the off chance he ever overhears me, I know he'll take some comfort from knowing that I never stopped just being myself and living my life my way.
:'''Hu Tao:''' Anyway, so that's a brief history of Wuwang Hill for you. Anything else on the agenda?
:{{DIcon}} Thank you for being so open with us.
:'''Hu Tao:''' Hehe, did you think I'd hide it from you? Nah, we're better buds than that.
:'''Hu Tao:''' Plus, you did just rescue me from the border, so I owe you bigtime. Answering your questions seems like the least I can do.
:{{A|vo eqhdj402 17 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' ...Alright, in that case, Paimon has one last question! Earlier, you said that no one will have to die when the array is activated... Is that the truth?
:'''Hu Tao:''' Yes. In my highly professional opinion, yes!
:{{A|vo eqhdj402 17 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Okay, phew. That's all Paimon wanted to hear.
:'''Hu Tao:''' Try not to dwell too much on all this stuff, okay? There are still two days to go, so check out the street fair and enjoy yourself. You said it yourself, remember? Gotta keep a reasonable work-life balance.
:'''Hu Tao:''' I'll see you at Yujing Terrace in two days. This time, we're gonna turn death to ashes!
:;(Quest completes)

==Dialogue==
{{Quest Description|While searching for Albedo, you encounter an odd-looking nun named [[Rosaria]]. She claims to know where Albedo is and expresses her willingness to show you the way.}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(While following Albedo's tracks)
:{{A|vo abdlq002 1 rosaria 01.ogg}} '''Rosaria:''' You know, little pixie, your ability to appear and disappear at will is very interesting...
:{{A|vo abdlq002 1 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Uh... Yeah?
:{{A|vo abdlq002 1 rosaria 02.ogg}} '''Rosaria:''' After committing a crime, you'd be able to the leave the scene without a trace.
:{{A|vo abdlq002 1 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You're so suspicious! Why is Paimon a criminal in your example?

;(Advance further on the [[Snow-Covered Path]])
:{{A|vo abdlq002 1 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Brrrr, It's getting colder and colder. Rosaria, aren't you freezing?
:{{A|vo abdlq002 1 rosaria 03.ogg}} '''Rosaria:''' Me? I'm alright. I got used to operating in adverse conditions a long time ago.
:{{A|vo abdlq002 1 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ah? ...Seems like there's more to being a sister in the [[Church of Favonius|Favonius Church]] than Paimon realized...

;(Approach Albedo)
:{{A|vo abdlq002 2 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Is that Albedo? Why would he hang around a place like this?
:{{A|vo abdlq002 2 rosaria 01.ogg}} '''Rosaria:''' The word on the street is he loves painting. He'll hang around anywhere for a good landscape.
:{{A|vo abdlq002 2 rosaria 02.ogg}} '''Rosaria:''' The views and scenery here are pretty good, potential paintings everywhere you look.
:{{A|vo abdlq002 2 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' But... can't he see those hilichurls? Isn't he in danger?
:{{A|vo abdlq002 2 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Eek!

;(Defeat the startled hilichurls)
:{{A|vo abdlq002 3 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Uh-oh, looks like we startled them.
:{{A|vo abdlq002 3 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Enough talk, let's take them out of the picture first!

;(Speak with Albedo)
:{{A|vo abdlq002 4 albedo 01.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Who are you? Why did you alarm them?
:{{A|vo abdlq002 4 albedo 02.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Thank the [[god]]s I'd already completed my painting. Would've been a shame to leave these particular hilichurls unfinished.
:{{DIcon}} You were painting hilichurls?
:{{DIcon}} I thought you were painting a landscape.
:{{A|vo abdlq002 4 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What's up with painting hilichurls? What makes them so interesting?
:{{A|vo abdlq002 4 albedo 03.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Hmm, I'm afraid the answer isn't easy to explain. If you'd like to have a look at my painting, it may give you a clue.
:{{DIcon}} Uh...
:{{DIcon}} Very... avant-garde.
:{{A|vo abdlq002 4 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wow, look at the detail! But some of it seems to have been done in a hurry.
:{{A|vo abdlq002 4 albedo 04.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' You can find these hilichurls anywhere, quite boring in fact, not worth closer inspection.
:{{A|vo abdlq002 4 albedo 05.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' But take a look at this specimen. The build, the coat... And there's a distinct force at work here.
:{{A|vo abdlq002 4 albedo 06.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' In the cyclical lives of such primitive communities, such unique attributes are an indication of evolution at work. Evolution, the transition from nothing into existence, from the known to the un—
:{{A|vo abdlq002 4 rosaria 01.ogg}} '''Rosaria:''' Hold your horses. Ugh, something tells me we're in for a thesis, and I haven't got the stamina.
:{{A|vo abdlq002 4 rosaria 02.ogg}} '''Rosaria:''' We've found your man, I'm headed back.
:{{A|vo abdlq002 4 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What!? Don't you have any questions for him? Hey!
:{{A|vo abdlq002 4 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ugh, what a weirdo.
:{{A|vo abdlq002 4 albedo 07.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' So Sister Rosaria brought you? Surprising. And I didn't have time to thank her.
:{{A|vo abdlq002 4 albedo 08.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' But back to the point. From her words, it seems that you were looking for me?
:{{A|vo abdlq002 4 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Mm-hmm, we met a girl in Mondstadt, [[Sucrose]]! She said you were stuck with your research.
:{{A|vo abdlq002 4 albedo 09.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' I see, so Sucrose sent you here.
:{{A|vo abdlq002 4 albedo 10.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Then, if I'm not mistaken, you must be the Honorary Knight. You've got the whole of Mondstadt talking.
:{{A|vo abdlq002 4 albedo 11.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' I've heard a bit of everything: your actions during [[Stormterror]]'s attack, your elemental control, and quite a few other mysterious things...
:{{A|vo abdlq002 4 albedo 12.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' I'll skip to the conclusion, there's only one possibility after all. You came from afar — from another world. Correct?
:{{DIcon}} Correct.
:{{DIcon}} You are worthy of your scholarly reputation.
:{{A|vo abdlq002 4 albedo 13.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Excellent. If I could procure your assistance, I think my research would benefit enormously.
:{{DIcon}} Your research?
:{{DIcon}} I'm not sure I understand.
:{{A|vo abdlq002 4 albedo 14.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Ah — forgive me, this must be confusing. Where should I begin? Hmm... The essence of life?
:{{A|vo abdlq002 4 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Whoa whoa, you want to start with that!?
:{{A|vo abdlq002 4 albedo 15.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Hmm... You're right. Giving a demonstration would be better than trying to explain.
:{{A|vo abdlq002 4 albedo 16.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' For example, awakening life. Breathing new life into fallen leaves.
:{{A|vo abdlq002 4 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You can do that!?
:{{DIcon}} Alchemy really is miraculous.
:{{DIcon}} Alchemy really is useful.
:{{A|vo abdlq002 4 albedo 17.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' However, I have a particular seed in my possession. The method I'm talking about has produced no results.
:{{A|vo abdlq002 4 albedo 18.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' It's like you, in that it hails from another world. Helping it to grow — to bloom... That's the problem my research is up against. That's where I'd need your assistance.
:{{A|vo abdlq002 4 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Well, if you're struggling to figure it out, Paimon's not sure we're gonna be much assistance.
:{{A|vo abdlq002 4 albedo 19.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' I beg to differ. I'm unable to comprehend the intricacies of life outside of the known world.
:{{A|vo abdlq002 4 albedo 20.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' But you're not from the known world. By observing and researching you, I may just be able to find a way to get the seed to sprout.
:{{DIcon}} So I'm an... object of research?
:{{A|vo abdlq002 4 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Uh... Shall we just get outta here, {{Traveler}}? This sounds a little freaky.
:{{DIcon}} Is there any danger?
::{{A|vo abdlq002 4 albedo 21a.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' It's possible. But I will do everything in my control to ensure your safety.
:{{DIcon}} What's in it for me?
::{{A|vo abdlq002 4 albedo 21b.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' [[Mora]], knowledge. And the answer to the question you are seeking. It happens to be an answer that I can provide. How does that sound?
:{{A|vo abdlq002 4 albedo 22.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Time for a change of surroundings, we should be going. There's research to do!
:{{Color|menu|Meanwhile, Rosaria is spying on you from somewhere nearby...}}
:{{A|vo abdlq002 4 rosaria 03.ogg}} '''Rosaria:''' Albedo and that Traveler seem to have hit it off.
:{{A|vo abdlq002 4 rosaria 04.ogg}} '''Rosaria:''' Takes a weirdo to know one I guess. I wonder... Does this constitute a risk to Mondstadt?
{{Dialogue End}}
