:{{Introductory Note|Zhongli}}
:{{A|vo eqhdj303 6 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ahem! *cough* *cough*
:{{A|vo eqhdj303 6 zhongli 02.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Oh?
:{{A|vo eqhdj303 6 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' *cough*
:{{A|vo eqhdj303 6 zhongli 03.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Ah, I see.
:{{A|vo eqhdj303 6 zhongli 04.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' It appears many people are catching a chill as of late. If your throat is bothering you, Paimon, perhaps some tea and rest are in order.
:{{A|vo eqhdj303 6 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Uh... Nope! No need. No need. Paimon's fine. She just... had some cake stuck in her throat...
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (He must have figured it all out by now. Is he just playing dumb on purpose...)
:{{A|vo eqhdj303 6 zhongli 05.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' If there are indeed bandits in the area, then we should inform the Millelith at once.
:{{DIcon}} The guard that was escorting us is already on their tail.
:{{A|vo eqhdj303 6 zhongli 06.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Oh? Well, if that's the case...
:{{A|vo eqhdj303 6 zhongli 07.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Such matters are best left to those with the necessary expertise, wouldn't you agree?
:{{A|vo eqhdj303 6 yede 09.ogg}} '''Yip Tak:''' *sigh* I suppose you're right... If ordinary people like us got involved, we would only cause more trouble.
:{{A|vo eqhdj303 6 zhongli 08.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Since we find ourselves otherwise unoccupied in this beautiful area, why don't we find a quiet place to relax while we wait for good news?
:{{A|vo eqhdj303 6 yede 10.ogg}} '''Yip Tak:''' Hmm... That would be lovely.

;(Approach the tea stall)
:{{A|vo eqhdj303 7 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So, uh, Uncle Yip does have reason to be worried. After all, Gaming, the guard we mentioned, is his son.
:{{A|vo eqhdj303 7 zhongli 01.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Gaming... The name sounds somewhat familiar. Ah yes, that is the name of the Wushou dancer who has been performing around Liyue Harbor recently, is it not?
:{{A|vo eqhdj303 7 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh? Have you seen him perform?
:{{A|vo eqhdj303 7 zhongli 02.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Indeed. I cannot help but admire his skill. He truly encapsulates the spirit of the suanni.
:{{A|vo eqhdj303 7 zhongli 03.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Wushou dancing has become more well-known in Liyue Harbor recently. However... Although performers are seeing budding success, they have, no doubt, had to face many hurdles along the way — ones not so easily understood by spectators such as ourselves.
:{{A|vo eqhdj303 7 zhongli 04.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' If you ask me, what truly deserves admiration is perseverance in the face of adversity. That is a rare attribute indeed.
:{{A|vo eqhdj303 7 zhongli 05.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' I have heard many of my acquaintances praise Gaming for his kind, selfless, and courageous disposition... To have a child so accomplished and upright... You must be a very proud parent indeed, Uncle Yip.
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (Uncle Yip...)
:{{A|vo eqhdj303 7 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' (Seems like Zhongli has decided to skip the formalities...)
:{{A|vo eqhdj303 7 yede 01.ogg}} '''Yip Tak:''' Ah, well...
:{{A|vo eqhdj303 7 yede 02.ogg}} '''Yip Tak:''' He... He's a hard worker, yes.
:{{A|vo eqhdj303 7 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You should be sure to tell him you think that when he gets back!
:{{A|vo eqhdj303 7 yede 03.ogg}} '''Yip Tak:''' I...
:{{A|vo eqhdj303 7 zhongli 06.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Your son is young yet. It's normal for someone his age to be a bit... hotheaded.
:{{A|vo eqhdj303 7 zhongli 07.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' It's understandable to find talking about such things in person difficult. If there's a particular sentiment you wish to convey, perhaps we could pass it along for you.
:{{A|vo eqhdj303 7 yede 04.ogg}} '''Yip Tak:''' No, no! It wouldn't be right to ask that of you...
:{{A|vo eqhdj303 7 yede 05.ogg}} '''Yip Tak:''' *sigh* This thing between us has festered for many years now. In truth... there are some things that simply aren't easy for us to talk through.
:{{A|vo eqhdj303 7 yede 06.ogg}} '''Yip Tak:''' I've been in the tea business for most of my life, and I always hoped my child would do the same. Otherwise, how would he support himself?
:{{A|vo eqhdj303 7 yede 07.ogg}} '''Yip Tak:''' Over the past few years, I heard how well he was doing for himself as a guard, how his work was taking him to farther and farther off places... I also heard that he never gave up on Wushou dancing. It made me happy... but I was also worried.
:{{A|vo eqhdj303 7 yede 08.ogg}} '''Yip Tak:''' When you're young, you can handle all that physically taxing work and manual labor. What young person isn't capable of making a living that way? My concern is what happens when you get old.
:{{A|vo eqhdj303 7 yede 09.ogg}} '''Yip Tak:''' Every time I get to thinking like that, I cannot help but be reinforced in the belief that I was right... that I was right not to give in.
:{{A|vo eqhdj303 7 yede 10.ogg}} '''Yip Tak:''' I often regret introducing him to Wushou dancing as a kid. If I had known how things would turn out, I would have never taken him to see those performances in the first place.
:{{A|vo eqhdj303 7 zhongli 08.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' It is only natural for a parent to strive to send their child down the right path. No one would begrudge you that sentiment, Uncle Yip. You need not worry.
:{{A|vo eqhdj303 7 yede 11.ogg}} '''Yip Tak:''' You seem quite young, Mr. Zhongli, yet you speak with such wisdom... Perhaps I have misjudged your age?
:{{A|vo eqhdj303 7 zhongli 09.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Hahaha, your words are too kind. Truth be told, one of my old friends has several grown daughters.
:{{A|vo eqhdj303 7 zhongli 10.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Rather than fretting about their future, however, she prefers to let them find their own way.
:{{A|vo eqhdj303 7 yede 12.ogg}} '''Yip Tak:''' Then she is more easygoing than I could ever be. I fear... I lack such an open mind.
:{{A|vo eqhdj303 7 yede 13.ogg}} '''Yip Tak:''' Oh, I meant to say earlier, there is no need to be so polite. Feel free to call me by my name, Yip Tak.
:{{A|vo eqhdj303 7 zhongli 11.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Sure.
:{{A|vo eqhdj303 7 yede 14.ogg}} '''Yip Tak:''' So, do you also think I fret too much, Mr. Zhongli?
:{{A|vo eqhdj303 7 zhongli 12.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' *sigh* That's not exactly what I was hoping to convey. Only a fool would ask a parent not to worry about their child. But think of it this way — raising a child is not unlike flying a kite. Hold the string too tight, and it can no longer soar.
:{{A|vo eqhdj303 7 zhongli 13.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' As my friend once said, if your children are aiming for the stars... clipping their wings will only cause them to come crashing down. You need to let out the line for a kite to soar.
:{{A|vo eqhdj303 7 yede 15.ogg}} '''Yip Tak:''' ...*sigh* It seems I was too stuck in my ways.
:{{A|vo eqhdj303 7 zhongli 14.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' You need not reproach your heart for caring. You simply need to loosen your hold a little.
:{{A|vo eqhdj303 7 zhongli 15.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Indeed with such a big heart, why not allocate the time you usually spend worrying about Gaming to the pursuit of other things, like going for a stroll, drinking tea, or taking in the scenery? You never know what surprises could be in store — things can change in the blink of an eye.
:{{A|vo eqhdj303 7 yede 16.ogg}} '''Yip Tak:''' Haha, the blink of an eye, you say? Do things change so quickly?
:{{A|vo eqhdj303 7 zhongli 16.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Children grow up in quite the same way, do they not? Day after day, year after year, sometimes in the blink of an eye, but always when you least expect it. As a father, I'm sure you know that best.
:{{A|vo eqhdj303 7 yede 17.ogg}} '''Yip Tak:''' Haha... Yes, you can say that again... One second, Gaming was a kid, the next thing I knew he was ready to fly the nest.
:{{A|vo eqhdj303 7 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Zhongli certainly has a way with words...
:{{A|vo eqhdj303 7 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh! Gaming is back!
:{{A|vo eqhdj303 7 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hey, Gaming, we're over here!
:{{A|vo eqhdj303 7 gaming 01.ogg}} '''Gaming:''' Dad, {{Traveler}}, Paimon. Good, you're all here. Oh! And Mr. Zhongli from the Wangsheng Funeral Parlor? You're here too?
:{{A|vo eqhdj303 7 zhongli 17.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Haha, a fated meeting indeed! We were just enjoying some pleasant conversation.
:{{A|vo eqhdj303 7 yede 18.ogg}} '''Yip Tak:''' ...
:{{A|vo eqhdj303 7 yede 19.ogg}} '''Yip Tak:''' Is everything resolved?
:{{A|vo eqhdj303 7 gaming 02.ogg}} '''Gaming:''' Well, you could say that...
:{{A|vo eqhdj303 7 yede 20.ogg}} '''Yip Tak:''' What does that mean?
:{{A|vo eqhdj303 7 gaming 03.ogg}} '''Gaming:''' {{Traveler}}, Paimon, come with me. I need to talk to you.
:{{A|vo eqhdj303 7 yede 21.ogg}} '''Yip Tak:''' ...
:{{A|vo eqhdj303 7 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh? Oh... Okay...
:;(The Traveler and Paimon step aside with Gaming)
:{{A|vo eqhdj303 7 gaming 04.ogg}} '''Gaming:''' I'll come right out and say it. Those two bandits... You sent them, didn't you?
:{{A|vo eqhdj303 7 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh!? So, that's how we're starting off?
:{{A|vo eqhdj303 7 gaming 05.ogg}} '''Gaming:''' Can't look me in the eye, huh? Guess I'm right, then.
:{{A|vo eqhdj303 7 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Okay... But how did you know?
:{{A|vo eqhdj303 7 gaming 06.ogg}} '''Gaming:''' At first, their mannerisms seemed a bit stilted. But once I got close, it was obvious that they possessed great skills.
:{{A|vo eqhdj303 7 gaming 07.ogg}} '''Gaming:''' I was right on their tail, and it should have taken only a few steps to catch up to them, yet somehow, I was never able to close that distance...
:{{A|vo eqhdj303 7 gaming 08.ogg}} '''Gaming:''' People with that level of skill would have gone about things differently from the start, like sneaking up on us while we were distracted.
:{{A|vo eqhdj303 7 gaming 09.ogg}} '''Gaming:''' Unless, or course, their real motive was to lure me away from the group all along.
:{{A|vo eqhdj303 7 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wow, you're pretty quick on the uptake!
:{{A|vo eqhdj303 7 gaming 10.ogg}} '''Gaming:''' I just have a lot of experience. I've dealt with many a ruthless bandit in my time, but I've never seen ones like them.
:{{A|vo eqhdj303 7 gaming 11.ogg}} '''Gaming:''' In the end, I told them they would make good guards if they ever wanted to get back on the straight and narrow, and that they could come hang out with me in Liyue Harbor any time.
:{{A|vo eqhdj303 7 paimon 12.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Eh... You ever consider that you might be a little too good at making friends?
:{{A|vo eqhdj303 7 gaming 12.ogg}} '''Gaming:''' I'm guessing you guys were trying to help resolve things between my dad and me?
:{{DIcon}} Yeah.
:{{A|vo eqhdj303 7 gaming 13.ogg}} '''Gaming:''' *sigh*
:{{A|vo eqhdj303 7 gaming 14.ogg}} '''Gaming:''' I appreciate it. I really do.
:{{A|vo eqhdj303 7 gaming 15.ogg}} '''Gaming:''' But this conflict between us has been going on for a long time.
:{{A|vo eqhdj303 7 gaming 16.ogg}} '''Gaming:''' Even if those two were real bandits, and I was able to subdue them and show him what I was capable of, it wouldn't change anything...
:{{A|vo eqhdj303 7 gaming 17.ogg}} '''Gaming:''' You've seen the way he talks to me...
:{{A|vo eqhdj303 7 paimon 13.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' It's not like that at all! Your dad really cares about you. You should see the way he talks about you when you're not around!
:{{A|vo eqhdj303 7 paimon 14.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Zhongli was talking things through with him, and he nearly agreed to let it go...
:{{A|vo eqhdj303 7 gaming 18.ogg}} '''Gaming:''' *sigh*
:{{A|vo eqhdj303 7 paimon 15.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You don't believe us?
:{{A|vo eqhdj303 7 gaming 19.ogg}} '''Gaming:''' He won't let it go. He can say as much as he wants to other people, but he won't talk to me. I'm certain of it.
:{{DIcon}} And you? Will you talk to him?
:{{A|vo eqhdj303 7 gaming 20.ogg}} '''Gaming:''' ...
:{{A|vo eqhdj303 7 paimon 16.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You told us you wanted to prove yourself to your dad. Why don't you tell him about all the hard work you've done these past few years?
:{{A|vo eqhdj303 7 gaming 21.ogg}} '''Gaming:''' Will that even do anything? I'm not sure "talking" is enough...
:{{A|vo eqhdj303 7 paimon 17.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You won't know unless you try! Just like how you won't know if something is delicious unless you taste it.
:{{A|vo eqhdj303 7 paimon 18.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Listen to us. It's time to put these people skills to good use! You can make friends with anyone! So why not your dad?
:{{DIcon}} Good luck! We'll be rooting for you.
:{{DIcon}} It won't hurt to try.
:{{A|vo eqhdj303 7 gaming 22.ogg}} '''Gaming:''' Ha...
:{{A|vo eqhdj303 7 gaming 23.ogg}} '''Gaming:''' I'll do my best.
:{{A|vo eqhdj303 7 yede 22.ogg}} '''Yip Tak:''' ...You are very knowledgeable, Mr. Zhongli. I'm impressed!
:{{A|vo eqhdj303 7 yede 23.ogg}} '''Yip Tak:''' Despite my being in the tea industry for several decades, it seems I still have much to learn about the art of tea tasting.
:{{A|vo eqhdj303 7 zhongli 18.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' You flatter me. It was nothing but a few humble musings.
:{{A|vo eqhdj303 7 paimon 19.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' How much tea have you drank since we've been gone?
:{{DIcon}} It's not like it was alcohol...
:{{A|vo eqhdj303 7 zhongli 19.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Haha, Yip Tak and I have found many a common interest. Our friendship, much like a cup of tea, seems to grow stronger the longer it has to steep.
:{{A|vo eqhdj303 7 yede 24.ogg}} '''Yip Tak:''' Well said, Mr. Zhongli.
:{{A|vo eqhdj303 7 yede 25.ogg}} '''Yip Tak:''' Gaming, Mr. Zhongli is very knowledgeable. You should take the opportunity to learn from people like him when you're in the city.
:{{A|vo eqhdj303 7 gaming 24.ogg}} '''Gaming:''' Huh? Oh... Of course.
:{{A|vo eqhdj303 7 paimon 20.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ahem... Zhongli...
:{{A|vo eqhdj303 7 zhongli 20.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' I have very much enjoyed our conversation, Yip Tak, but I, unfortunately, have some unfinished Funeral Parlor business to attend to.
:{{A|vo eqhdj303 7 yede 26.ogg}} '''Yip Tak:''' Oh! I hope I didn't keep you.
:{{A|vo eqhdj303 7 yede 27.ogg}} '''Yip Tak:''' My apologies for taking up so much of your time, Mr. Zhongli. No need to stay on my account. When you're less busy, let's find a time to meet. I'll treat you to dim sum.
:{{A|vo eqhdj303 7 zhongli 21.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' It would be an honor.
:{{A|vo eqhdj303 7 paimon 21.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' We'll see you off, Zhongli!
:{{A|vo eqhdj303 7 paimon 22.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You two have a nice chat, alright?

:{{A|vo dialog eqhdj303 gaming 01.ogg}} '''Gaming:''' ...Sure.

;(Approach the marked location)
:{{A|vo eqhdj303 9 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Thanks for helping us talk things through with Uncle Yip. Good thing you were able to pick up on what we were putting down.

:{{A|vo eqhdj303 9 zhongli 02.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' As for my role in the conversation, think nothing of it. I hardly did anything noteworthy.
:{{A|vo eqhdj303 9 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hehe, you never change, do you?
:{{A|vo eqhdj303 9 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Uh, why did you have us walk all this way? Paimon thought we just had to go far enough to be out of earshot.
:{{A|vo eqhdj303 9 zhongli 03.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' A friend approaches.

:{{A|vo eqhdj303 9 xiao 01.ogg}} '''Xiao:''' Hello.
:{{Introductory Note|Xiao}}
:{{A|vo eqhdj303 9 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Xiao! You're here too!?
:{{A|vo eqhdj303 9 xiao 02.ogg}} '''Xiao:''' I've been here the whole time.
:;(A flashback begins)
:{{A|vo eqhdj303 9 xiao 03.ogg}} '''Xiao:''' (A ghostly kite? Could that elusive Director Hu be coming to Wangshu Inn once again?)
:{{A|vo eqhdj303 9 xiao 04.ogg}} '''Xiao:''' (What is she doing here? I suppose it matters not. Given her relationship with Rex... well, Zhongli, I might as well go pay my respects.)
:;(Xiao appears behind the kite-flier)
:{{A|vo eqhdj303 9 xiao 05.ogg}} '''Xiao:''' (!)
:{{A|vo eqhdj303 9 xiao 06.ogg}} '''Xiao:''' It's you? I thought you were Director Hu.
:{{A|vo eqhdj303 9 zhongli 04.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Ah. Your arrival is most fortuitous. Do you want to try out this new gadget?
:{{A|vo eqhdj303 9 zhongli 05.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' The addition of the power source makes the takeoff more stable. It's just that...
:{{A|vo eqhdj303 9 xiao 07.ogg}} '''Xiao:''' (He seems quite immersed in the study of this device...)
:{{A|vo eqhdj303 9 zhongli 06.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' I fear it's almost too stable. It completely negates the pleasure of seeing one's kite sway with the wind. It's a bit of a shame.
:{{A|vo eqhdj303 9 zhongli 07.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' In truth, I'm here because Director Hu dispatched me to purchase some items in preparation for Lantern Rite.
:{{A|vo eqhdj303 9 xiao 08.ogg}} '''Xiao:''' I see. Much like she does every year. Much like she'll do next year, I would imagine.
:{{A|vo eqhdj303 9 zhongli 08.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' ...
:{{A|vo eqhdj303 9 xiao 09.ogg}} '''Xiao:''' ...
:{{A|vo eqhdj303 9 xiao 10.ogg}} '''Xiao:''' Am I wrong? Or has she once again sent you out to buy... what is it, sesame oil or something?
:{{A|vo eqhdj303 9 zhongli 09.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' While we're on the subject, I do wonder why she is so obsessed with using sesame oil in the preparation of mixed vegetable dishes for Lantern Rite... A recommendation from Xiangling, perhaps? What do you think, Xiao?
:{{A|vo eqhdj303 9 xiao 11.ogg}} '''Xiao:''' I've only met Director Hu a few times. I'm hardly the best person to ask...
:{{A|vo eqhdj303 9 zhongli 10.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Ah, and is that not a sign that you should visit Wangsheng Funeral Parlor more often? It wouldn't hurt to grace the Parlor with your presence now and again when you are otherwise unoccupied.
:{{A|vo eqhdj303 9 zhongli 11.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' This one here is a traditional kite, one without any equipped mechanical device. Director Hu tasked me with studying the differences between the two to determine which one is of greater merit.
:{{A|vo eqhdj303 9 zhongli 12.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Many hands make light work. Perhaps you could test out the other kite for me.
:{{A|vo eqhdj303 9 xiao 12.ogg}} '''Xiao:''' ...Alright.
:;(Flashback ends)
:{{A|vo eqhdj303 9 xiao 13.ogg}} '''Xiao:''' I have made my comparisons.
:{{A|vo eqhdj303 9 xiao 14.ogg}} '''Xiao:''' If speed is what you're after, the mechanical kite is the better choice.
:{{A|vo eqhdj303 9 zhongli 13.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Wonderful. I shall pass that information along to Director Hu.
:{{A|vo eqhdj303 9 zhongli 14.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' I'll leave these two kites with you. Perhaps you can find a few friends with which to partake in the activity. You might find it to be an enjoyable use of your time.
:{{A|vo eqhdj303 9 xiao 15.ogg}} '''Xiao:''' Oh, uh... Wait, who enjoys kite-flying?
:{{A|vo eqhdj303 9 zhongli 15.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Well, I would imagine someone of your talent and wisdom is more than capable of finding out.
:{{A|vo eqhdj303 9 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So you were testing out the kites for Hu Tao, and even roped Xiao into doing it for you... Paimon didn't ask earlier because the situation was awkward.
:{{A|vo eqhdj303 9 zhongli 16.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' I would hardly say I "roped" Xiao into anything. I simply sought the help of a friend. Besides, we did the testing together.
:{{A|vo eqhdj303 9 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' *sigh* Seems like our pool of competitors is growing...
:{{DIcon}} The competition's not the important thing right now.
:{{DIcon}} Doesn't matter. We're going to win either way.
:{{A|vo eqhdj303 9 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Do you like kite-flying, Xiao?
:{{A|vo eqhdj303 9 xiao 16.ogg}} '''Xiao:''' I suppose I neither like nor dislike it.
:{{A|vo eqhdj303 9 xiao 17.ogg}} '''Xiao:''' Although, watching a kite gradually ascend into the sky does bring me a certain peace of mind.
:{{A|vo eqhdj303 9 xiao 18.ogg}} '''Xiao:''' ...Perhaps they're a bit like [[Xiao Lantern]]s in that way.
:{{A|vo eqhdj303 9 zhongli 17.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Kite-flying is also a pleasant form of relaxation.
:{{A|vo eqhdj303 9 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Have you ever thought about making a kite, Xiao?
:{{A|vo eqhdj303 9 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Cloud Retainer taught us how. We can teach you if you want.
:{{A|vo eqhdj303 9 xiao 19.ogg}} '''Xiao:''' There's no need.
:{{A|vo eqhdj303 9 xiao 20.ogg}} '''Xiao:''' [[Menogias]] was the only yaksha among us who had an interest in matters of ornamentation and design.
:{{A|vo eqhdj303 9 xiao 21.ogg}} '''Xiao:''' {{Traveler}}, when Lantern Rite is over, come find me near Pervases' temple if you have the time.
:{{DIcon}} Sure.
:{{DIcon}} Absolutely.
:{{A|vo eqhdj303 9 xiao 22.ogg}} '''Xiao:''' Mmm.
:{{A|vo eqhdj303 9 zhongli 18.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' It's getting late. I should go inform Director Hu of our findings.
:{{A|vo eqhdj303 9 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' How has she been by the way? Be sure to say hi to her for us!
:{{A|vo eqhdj303 9 zhongli 19.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' The last time I spoke to her, she mentioned that she would be visiting Qiaoying Village in a few days.
:{{A|vo eqhdj303 9 zhongli 20.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' If you have the time, perhaps you could also make the trip. If you happen to run into her, you can pass along your regards in person.
:{{A|vo eqhdj303 9 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' We'll keep that in mind!
:{{A|vo eqhdj303 9 paimon 12.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Take care, Zhongli. See you later!
:{{A|vo eqhdj303 9 zhongli 21.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' See you next time.

'''''The Golden Apple Vacation Returns!''''' is an [[Event Quest]] that unlocks the [[Summertime Odyssey]] Event.

==Steps==
# Go to the Adventurers' Guild in Mondstadt
# Meet [[Fischl]] at the plaza
# Head to the [[Angel's Share]]
#*If the quest cannot be progressed further, make sure you've completed [[Should You Be Trapped in a Windless Land (Quest)|Should You Be Trapped in a Windless Land]], as [[Nelson]], [[Quinn]] and [[Jack]] are busy.
# Talk to everyone
# Talk to [[Venti]] on the second floor of the tavern
# Wait till the next morning (08:00–10:00)
# Go to the city gate
# Go to the location Paimon mentioned
# Talk to everyone
# Go to the island that [[Kazuha]] mentioned
# Use Elemental Sight to follow the traces
# Defeat the Fatui soldier
#* {{Enemy|Fatui Skirmisher - Cryogunner Legionnaire|x=1}}
# Talk to the Fatui soldier
# Return to camp
# Contact Venti in a less conspicuous place

==Gameplay Notes==
* If the player attempts to go activate any of the other Waypoints outside of the island mentioned in Step 10, there is a chance that they will be forced to teleport further away. This behavior is inconsistent and not guaranteed, as players may be able to activate most or all Teleport Waypoints during this step without ever being teleported away.

'''''The Helper''''' is a quest in {{Quest|Ever Silent Stars}}.

==Steps==
# Ask Katheryne for help
# Chat with the astrology enthusiast
#*If [[Layla]] gets nervous to answer [[Azzam]]'s questions, ... 
#**Encourage her, and proceed to [[Thesis Defense Practice]]

==Dialogue==
{{Quest Description|Layla will have to face the problems with her thesis, and perhaps a little push is all that she needs.}}

===The Helper===
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Talk to Katheryne)
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915801 katheryne 01.ogg}} '''Katheryne:''' Ad astra abyssosque! Welcome to the Adventurers' Guild. How can I help you today?
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915801 layla 01.ogg}} '''Layla:''' I'd like to... Uh, I have a commission... Hmm, it's kinda strange. How should I put this...
:{{DIcon}} We would like to borrow a high-precision celestial globe.
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915801 layla 02.ogg}} '''Layla:''' R—Right! Equipment at the Akademiya is in very high demand, and we aren't able to borrow one now. We were hoping someone else might have something similar that we could use...
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915801 katheryne 02.ogg}} '''Katheryne:''' I don't know anything about astrology, so I'm afraid I'm unfamiliar with the device you are looking for.
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915801 katheryne 03.ogg}} '''Katheryne:''' However, one of our requesters happens to be an astrology enthusiast. I hear that he's a collector of all sorts of specialized astrology equipment.
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915801 katheryne 04.ogg}} '''Katheryne:''' After the Adventurers' Guild helped him out, he indicated that he'd be happy to return the favor if the adventurers ever need it.
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915801 katheryne 05.ogg}} '''Katheryne:''' Perhaps we could arrange a meeting between you two, that should help solve your problem.
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915801 layla 03.ogg}} '''Layla:''' R—Really!?
:{{DIcon}} Thank you so much.
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915801 katheryne 06.ogg}} '''Katheryne:''' You're welcome. It's my job to provide adventurers with the necessary support.
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915801 katheryne 07.ogg}} '''Katheryne:''' The man's name is Azzam. Here is his address. You can go ahead and pay him a visit.
;(Continue to [[#Remedial Measures|Remedial Measures]])
{{Dialogue End}}

===Remedial Measures===
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Use [[Nahida]]'s [[All Schemes to Know]] on Azzam, optional)
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915802 azzam 28.ogg}} '''Azzam:''' (I wonder if I'll be able to go out and look at the stars tonight...)

:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915802 layla 01.ogg}} '''Layla:''' H—Hello, are you Azzam?
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915802 azzam 01.ogg}} '''Azzam:''' Yes, I am. How may I help you?
:{{Black Screen|You explain to Azzam the purpose of your visit.}}
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915802 azzam 02.ogg}} '''Azzam:''' Ah, I see. Well, if it's a request from an adventurer, then I'll be happy to help you. I just so happen to have the device that you're looking for. Let me fetch it and show you, just to be sure.
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915802 layla 02.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Yes, this is it! Thank you so much!
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915802 layla 03.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Ah sorry, I didn't mean to interrupt you... I just got a little excited. Uh, please, go ahead.
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915802 azzam 03.ogg}} '''Azzam:''' To be honest, judging by what stands before me, I find it very hard to believe that you're an astute Rtawahist student.
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915802 layla 04.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Uh, w—well...
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915802 azzam 04.ogg}} '''Azzam:''' Astrology is a hobby of mine and these devices have cost me both time and Mora to collect. I cherish them as if they were members of my own family.
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915802 azzam 05.ogg}} '''Azzam:''' Which is why I don't let just anyone borrow them on a whim. These devices are delicate and can easily be damaged if used inappropriately.
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915802 layla 05.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Oh, th—that's completely understandable. What can I do to better gain your trust?
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915802 azzam 06.ogg}} '''Azzam:''' How about this — I don't need a deposit or anything, but I'd like you to share the contents of your research with me. I'll ask you some questions.
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915802 azzam 07.ogg}} '''Azzam:''' If your explanation proves satisfactory, then I'll lend you the device.
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915802 layla 06.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Sh—Share the contents of my research... and answer questions? Uh oh...

:{{Hangout Branch|This should be a piece of cake for you.|Thesis Defense Practice}}
::;(Stress Value +1)
:{{Hangout Branch|Don't be nervous. Just explain what you've learned.|Thesis Defense Practice}}
::{{A|vo lylcop001 1915802 layla 07.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Alright, I'll try. But I can't disclose the actual details to you... How about a general overview of the research, would that suffice?
::{{A|vo lylcop001 1915802 azzam 08.ogg}} '''Azzam:''' Yes, that would be fine.
::{{A|vo lylcop001 1915802 layla 08.ogg}} '''Layla:''' You're probably aware that astrologists rely on the movements of celestial bodies to calculate the past and the future, as well as attempt to summarize the correlating principles, correct?
::{{A|vo lylcop001 1915802 azzam 09.ogg}} '''Azzam:''' Mhm, of course. This is the basic principle of astrology.
::{{A|vo lylcop001 1915802 layla 09.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Ahem... My current research is about a certain phenomenon called "Astral Shift."
::{{A|vo lylcop001 1915802 azzam 10.ogg}} '''Azzam:''' Interesting. That's not a topic any ordinary person would be familiar with. I have a basic understanding of the concept, but I'd like to hear you explain it.
::{{A|vo lylcop001 1915802 layla 10.ogg}} '''Layla:''' O—Okay. Well, in short, it means that the results derived from astrology are prone to change...
::{{A|vo lylcop001 1915802 layla 11.ogg}} '''Layla:''' As time continues to flow, the stars change and everything else becomes affected by this change. However, what's actually driving the change is what's worth investigating.
::{{A|vo lylcop001 1915802 azzam 11.ogg}} '''Azzam:''' I think that it might just be another law of nature.
::{{A|vo lylcop001 1915802 layla 12.ogg}} '''Layla:''' If the changes follow a certain pattern or routine, then it could be explained as some law. But, the changes are manifold, even when considering just a single star.
::{{A|vo lylcop001 1915802 layla 13.ogg}} '''Layla:''' The changes could be resulting from a simple single-orbit shift, or it could be a more complex double-orbit or even a triple or quadruple-orbit shift. These phenomena have a dramatic effect on astrological conclusions.
::{{A|vo lylcop001 1915802 layla 14.ogg}} '''Layla:''' What I'm working on now is the research and prediction of the triple-orbit shift phenomenon.
::{{A|vo lylcop001 1915802 azzam 12.ogg}} '''Azzam:''' Triple-orbit? By yourself?
::{{A|vo lylcop001 1915802 layla 15.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Uh, yes. That's right...
::{{A|vo lylcop001 1915802 azzam 13.ogg}} '''Azzam:''' You do know that adding an extra star to the equation increases the computational workload by more than tenfold, right...?
::{{A|vo lylcop001 1915802 layla 16.ogg}} '''Layla:''' It does get a little complicated... But it's still manageable with the use of a few self-invented techniques and a large number of starlogs and star charts...
::{{A|vo lylcop001 1915802 layla 17.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Which leads us to why I'm in need of a high-precision celestial globe.
::{{A|vo lylcop001 1915802 azzam 14.ogg}} '''Azzam:''' Hmm...
::{{A|vo lylcop001 1915802 azzam 15.ogg}} '''Azzam:''' Amazing. I suppose I should never have judged a book by its cover. I thought you were just trying to halfheartedly deal with some school assignment.
::{{A|vo lylcop001 1915802 layla 18.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Do I really look like that sort of person...?
::{{A|vo lylcop001 1915802 azzam 16.ogg}} '''Azzam:''' Haha, don't worry, I'm just joking. I was a little cautious at first, but now I trust you completely.
::{{A|vo lylcop001 1915802 azzam 17.ogg}} '''Azzam:''' It would make me extremely happy if my collection could assist a researcher in achieving tangible results.
::{{A|vo lylcop001 1915802 azzam 18.ogg}} '''Azzam:''' Just make sure you return it to me once you're done.
::{{A|vo lylcop001 1915802 layla 19.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Oh, thank you so much. I really needed this.
::{{A|vo lylcop001 1915802 layla 20.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Whew, good thing Azzam was willing to hear me out...
::{{DIcon}} I didn't really understand what you were talking about, but I thought you did great.
::{{A|vo lylcop001 1915802 layla 21.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Really? I was just explaining what it is I'm trying to do.
::{{DIcon}} You're starting to show signs of becoming a great researcher.
::{{A|vo lylcop001 1915802 layla 22.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Really? Hehe, I don't know if you really mean it, but I'm happy to hear that.
::{{A|vo lylcop001 1915802 layla 23.ogg}} '''Layla:''' I guess even the hardest problems can be solved as long as I'm willing to try...
::{{A|vo lylcop001 1915802 layla 24.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Recording and comparing data will be much easier now that we have this device. I can do it all on my own, too.
::{{A|vo lylcop001 1915802 layla 25.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Let's continue with the plan. Can you help me with a rehearsal of my thesis defense? We can do that at the House of Daena.

:;(Use Nahida's All Schemes to Know on Azzam, optional)
::{{A|vo lylcop001 1915802 azzam 29.ogg}} '''Azzam:''' (There's nothing to worry about... right?)

:;(Talk to Azzam again)
::{{A|vo lylcop001 1915802 azzam 27.ogg}} '''Azzam:''' You're quite welcome. It makes me happy to see my equipment being used to its potential.

:;(Proceed to [[Thesis Defense Practice]])

:{{Hangout Branch|If you mess this up, you won't be able to gain his trust.|The Remaining Problem}}
:;(Stress Value +1)
::{{A|vo lylcop001 1915802 layla 26.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Uh... Y—You're starting to make me feel nervous...
::{{A|vo lylcop001 1915802 layla 27.ogg}} '''Layla:''' I'm sorry... I feel a little dizzy. Ugh... I...
::{{DIcon}} Are you okay!?
:;(Stress Value +1)
::{{A|vo lylcop001 1915802 layla 28.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Ugh... Hm?
::{{A|vo lylcop001 1915802 layla 29.ogg}} '''Layla:''' I'm okay, my mind just decided to stray elsewhere for a moment. Give me a second to gather myself... Oh, is this the celestial globe that I needed to borrow?
::{{DIcon}} (Why is she asking?)
::{{A|vo lylcop001 1915802 azzam 19.ogg}} '''Azzam:''' Correct. I was about to test you with a few questions, but you suddenly started looking very uncomfortable.
::{{A|vo lylcop001 1915802 layla 30.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Oh, don't worry about it. I don't sleep very well, so I tend to get a little dizzy from time to time. I'm fine now.
::{{A|vo lylcop001 1915802 azzam 20.ogg}} '''Azzam:''' (Hmm? She seems a little different all of a sudden...)
::{{A|vo lylcop001 1915802 azzam 21.ogg}} '''Azzam:''' Oh, *ahem* I see. Well then, can you briefly summarize your area of research for me?
::{{A|vo lylcop001 1915802 layla 31.ogg}} '''Layla:''' With pleasure. I'll give you a general overview. *ahem* You're probably aware that astrologists rely on the movements of the celestial bodies to calculate the past and the future.
::{{A|vo lylcop001 1915802 layla 32.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Due to the difficulty of designing an experiment and the challenges of validating theories about the past, astrological research is usually based on an immense foundation of experience.
::{{A|vo lylcop001 1915802 layla 33.ogg}} '''Layla:''' And therein lies the largest complexity. Derived and validated conclusions may vary due to subtle changes caused by the flow of time and shifts in the stars.
::{{A|vo lylcop001 1915802 azzam 22.ogg}} '''Azzam:''' I've heard about this before. I believe it's known as Astral Shift.
::{{A|vo lylcop001 1915802 layla 34.ogg}} '''Layla:''' One of the most classic challenges is to use three stars with shifting orbits to predict the overall changes that may have occurred.
::{{A|vo lylcop001 1915802 azzam 23.ogg}} '''Azzam:''' Ah, are you referring to the triple-orbit problem? Yes, that really is a classic problem, and a very difficult one to tackle...
::{{A|vo lylcop001 1915802 layla 35.ogg}} '''Layla:''' I came up with a set of prediction methods that encompass more than half of the triple-orbit problems. However, there are quite a few limitations and requirements.
::{{A|vo lylcop001 1915802 layla 36.ogg}} '''Layla:''' This set of methods is already being put into practice at the Rtawahist Darshan by my adviser, drastically simplifying the difficulty of calculations involved in the triple-orbit problem.
::{{A|vo lylcop001 1915802 azzam 24.ogg}} '''Azzam:''' Yes, I've heard about that! The announcement made big waves in the astrology enthusiast community. So, you were the one who came up with that...?
::{{A|vo lylcop001 1915802 layla 37.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Hehe, you mustn't judge a book by its cover, you know.
::{{A|vo lylcop001 1915802 layla 38.ogg}} '''Layla:''' The thesis I'm working on this time aims to address the remaining triple-orbit problems, as well as eliminate a portion of the methodology's limitations, which will make it easier to use.
::{{A|vo lylcop001 1915802 azzam 25.ogg}} '''Azzam:''' I see... In that case, perhaps there is no one more fitting to operate this device than you.
::{{A|vo lylcop001 1915802 azzam 26.ogg}} '''Azzam:''' I just keep it as part of a collection. I can't use it to its full potential like you can.
::{{A|vo lylcop001 1915802 layla 39.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Thank you for understanding. I'll return it in perfect working order once I'm finished with it.
::{{A|vo lylcop001 1915802 layla 40.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Okay, we should be going now.
::{{A|vo lylcop001 1915802 layla 41.ogg}} '''Layla:''' What did we plan to do after this...? I kinda forgot.
::{{DIcon}} You aren't Layla, are you?
::{{A|vo lylcop001 1915802 layla 42.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Huh? What makes you say that? Is there something off about me?
::{{DIcon}} Your personality changed.
::{{DIcon}} The real Layla wouldn't forget what to do next.
::{{A|vo lylcop001 1915802 layla 43.ogg}} '''Layla:''' *sigh* Fine, looks like I can't keep the act up any longer. I even tried to look a little panicky to emulate her behavior.
::{{DIcon}} You're the "blessing from the stars," aren't you?
::{{A|vo lylcop001 1915802 layla 44.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Hehe, I suppose that is what she's been calling me.
::{{A|vo lylcop001 1915802 layla 45.ogg}} '''Layla:''' With her long-term sleep deprivation, whenever her anxiety peaks, she loses consciousness and I take over.
::{{A|vo lylcop001 1915802 layla 46.ogg}} '''Layla:''' However, her unpredictable and variable sleep patterns are completely out of my control, so I have to make every second count.
::{{A|vo lylcop001 1915802 layla 47.ogg}} '''Layla:''' There's no one willing to help her here, so I have to step in.
::{{A|vo lylcop001 1915802 layla 48.ogg}} '''Layla:''' I am rather curious about you, though. Why are you trying to help her?
::{{DIcon}} Well, she's finally decided to face the problems with her thesis head-on, and she's working very hard on it.
::{{A|vo lylcop001 1915802 layla 49.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Really? That's great. You're helping with all the things that I used to do for her.
::{{A|vo lylcop001 1915802 layla 50.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Seems like you've given her a boost of confidence with your encouragement.
::{{A|vo lylcop001 1915802 layla 51.ogg}} '''Layla:''' She's only steps away from the finish line... She's already made a lot of progress, so there's no need to push too hard now.
::{{A|vo lylcop001 1915802 layla 52.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Anyway, what's the plan from here?
::{{DIcon}} She said that she wanted to practice for her thesis defense...
::{{A|vo lylcop001 1915802 layla 53.ogg}} '''Layla:''' I see. Well, it wouldn't be of any help if I practiced for her, but I'll leave some notes that should come in handy.
::{{A|vo lylcop001 1915802 layla 54.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Come on, let's go back to the House of Daena to make preparations. You'll have to tell her later when she wakes up.

:;(Use Nahida's All Schemes to Know on Azzam, optional)
::{{A|vo lylcop001 1915802 azzam 30.ogg}} '''Azzam:''' (There's probably nothing to worry about.)

:;(Talk to Azzam again)
::{{A|vo lylcop001 1915802 azzam 27.ogg}} '''Azzam:''' You're quite welcome. It makes me happy to see my equipment being used to its potential.

:;(Proceed to [[The Remaining Problem]])
{{Dialogue End}}

==Steps==
# Head to the giant ship on the sea
# Take [[Beidou]] to the event venue

==Dialogue==
{{Quest Description|[[Jahoda]] reminds you that the person you're about to meet on the giant ship is an infamous merc captain who sails the high seas. You had best act with caution...}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Approach the Alcor-class No. 2)
:{{A|vo nkeq101 3 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wait, is this...?
:{{DIcon}} [[The Alcor]]?
:{{A|vo nkeq101 3 beidou 01.ogg}} '''Beidou:''' Actually, this is the second ship in our fleet. The Alcor's back home, patrolling [[Guyun Stone Forest]].
:{{A|vo nkeq101 3 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' [[Beidou]]! The infamous merc captain who sails the high seas!
:{{A|vo nkeq101 3 beidou 02.ogg}} '''Beidou:''' Uh, yeah, haha. We've met, remember? What's with all the pomp and circumstance?
:{{Introductory Note|Beidou}}
:{{A|vo nkeq101 3 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' It's a long story...
:{{A|vo nkeq101 3 beidou 03.ogg}} '''Beidou:''' Well, no sense standin' around. Take a seat. Tell me all about it. I'll have my men roll out the welcome mat.
:;(The scene changes, with the group seated at a nearby table)
:{{A|vo nkeq101 3 beidou 04.ogg}} '''Beidou:''' Ah, I see. So, you know [[Nefer|the head honcho]] of [[Curatorium of Secrets (Faction)|the Curatorium]], huh... Your network of connections is somethin' else, that's for sure.
:{{A|vo nkeq101 3 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hehe...
:{{DIcon}} About the registration...
:{{A|vo nkeq101 3 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Right! We need a record of who's participating in the expo and what you're planning to trade.
:{{A|vo nkeq101 3 beidou 05.ogg}} '''Beidou:''' Well, mark down me and a few crew members as participants — the rest will stay on the ship. As for what we're trading... Take a look.
:;(Beidou turns to face a nearby ballista, with the Traveler and Paimon following suit)
:{{A|vo nkeq101 3 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What is it?
:{{A|vo nkeq101 3 beidou 06.ogg}} '''Beidou:''' A while ago, [[Ningguang]] revamped the [[Guizhong Ballista]]. The beauty you see here is one of her new and improved models.
:{{A|vo nkeq101 3 beidou 07.ogg}} '''Beidou:''' It has insane firepower and comes complete with remote guidance for accurate striking even at long distances. I just know people are gonna be fighting to get their hands on it.
:{{A|vo nkeq101 3 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Are you sure you're allowed to sell stuff like this!?
:{{A|vo nkeq101 3 beidou 08.ogg}} '''Beidou:''' Haha, don't worry. Compared to the model the [[Millelith]]'s using, this one might as well be an antique.
:{{A|vo nkeq101 3 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' ...Nefer wasn't kidding when she said "no restrictions," huh...
:{{DIcon}} But, who's gonna buy something like this?
:{{A|vo nkeq101 3 yelan 01.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' Oh, I'm sure someone will bite. Buyers from all over [[Teyvat]] will be in attendance, after all.
:{{Introductory Note|Yelan}}
:{{A|vo nkeq101 3 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' ...[[Yelan]]?
:{{A|vo nkeq101 3 beidou 09.ogg}} '''Beidou:''' Ah, sorry. I was so busy with the cargo, I forgot to mention that Yelan was aboard.
:{{A|vo nkeq101 3 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' No worries. You here for the expo too, Yelan?
:{{A|vo nkeq101 3 yelan 02.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' No, I'm just here for work. Captain Beidou was kind enough to lend me a ride. So, no need to register me with [[Nod-Krai Trade Expo|the expo]].
:{{A|vo nkeq101 3 yelan 03.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' Anyway, it's been a while, {{Traveler}}. If you get the chance, be sure to pass along my regards to the head of the Curatorium.
:{{DIcon}} What kind of work?
:{{A|vo nkeq101 3 yelan 04.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' The... sensitive kind.
:{{A|vo nkeq101 3 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Sounds like our cue to stop asking questions, doesn't it...?
:{{DIcon}} One hundred percent.
:{{A|vo nkeq101 3 yelan 05.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' Well, I'll be off, then. Once I'm done with this, drinks are on me.
:;(Yelan leaves)
:{{A|vo nkeq101 3 beidou 10.ogg}} '''Beidou:''' About time! I've been itching to see [[Nod-Krai]] from the bottom of a bottle, haha.
:{{A|vo nkeq101 3 paimon 12.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Alright, that's it for registration. Follow us, and we'll take you to the venue.
:{{Black Screen|Beidou directs her crew to unload the cargo and follows you to the venue.}}
:{{A|vo nkeq101 4 beidou 01.ogg}} '''Beidou:''' So, this is the place, huh? Not a bad spot!
:{{A|vo nkeq101 4 beidou 02.ogg}} '''Beidou:''' When you've got some time, come help me test the remote guidance on this thing. It's a real thrill — you'll love it.
{{Dialogue End}}

==Steps==

# Go to [[The Steambird]]'s offices

==Dialogue==
{{Quest Description|What's made headlines today? Go to The Steambird and check it out!}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Approach The Steambird)
:{{A|vo lnlq004 1 lyney 01.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' I'm very sorry, Charlotte, but my sister and I are quite busy today. I'm afraid we will have to decline this interview...
:{{A|vo lnlq004 1 charlotte 01.ogg}} '''Charlotte:''' Oh, please, Lyney? I'll only take a moment of your time! If you would be so kind!
:{{A|vo lnlq004 1 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh. What's happening here?
:{{A|vo lnlq004 1 charlotte 02.ogg}} '''Charlotte:''' I spent all night writing my piece about The Phantom Weasel, and it was going to go to print this morning...
:{{A|vo lnlq004 1 charlotte 03.ogg}} '''Charlotte:''' But just as dawn broke, I suddenly received news that [[Cesar]]'s fiancée, [[Jemma]], had contacted the [[Garde]]s and confessed to having been the real Phantom Weasel all along!
:{{A|vo lnlq004 1 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' That was quick!
:{{A|vo lnlq004 1 lyney 02.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Ahem.
:{{A|vo lnlq004 1 charlotte 04.ogg}} '''Charlotte:''' Hmm?
:{{A|vo lnlq004 1 lynette 01.ogg}} '''Lynette:''' Too late, bro.
:{{A|vo lnlq004 1 charlotte 05.ogg}} '''Charlotte:''' Hohoho! "That was quick," you say? It sounds like I've got some catching up to do! Please, fill me in.
:{{A|vo lnlq004 1 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hehe, whoops!
:{{A|vo lnlq004 1 charlotte 06.ogg}} '''Charlotte:''' Aha! My instincts did not lead me astray — you DO have something to hide! Jemma turning herself in must have something to do with Lyney's performance last night!
:{{A|vo lnlq004 1 lyney 03.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Maybe watching my high-altitude escape trick reminded her of a better time with Cesar, and she could no longer ignore the voice of her conscience.
:{{A|vo lnlq004 1 charlotte 07.ogg}} '''Charlotte:''' Huh, okay then... Wait, no no no, there must be more to it! If that's all it took for her to have a change of heart, how did it take her ten whole years?
:{{A|vo lnlq004 1 lyney 04.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Umm... Well...
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (Charlotte's journalistic spirit is burning red — we're going to have to distract her somehow...)
:{{A|vo lnlq004 1 charlotte 08.ogg}} '''Charlotte:''' Ah, I remember now! You and Jemma were nowhere to be found after the show... What happened between you?
:{{A|vo lnlq004 1 charlotte 09.ogg}} '''Charlotte:''' Quickfire question! Where did you all go after the show?
:{{A|vo lnlq004 1 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, we went to the cemetery, and Lyney did a private magic trick, just for us!
:{{A|vo lnlq004 1 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Actually, glad you mentioned it, 'cause that reminds Paimon. Guess what? Lyney's started using [[Rainbow Rose]]s in his tricks!
:{{A|vo lnlq004 1 lyney 05.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' *cough*
:{{A|vo lnlq004 1 lynette 02.ogg}} '''Lynette:''' ...What?
:{{A|vo lnlq004 1 lynette 03a.ogg}}<!--{{A|vo lnlq004 1 lynette 03b.ogg}}--> '''Lynette:''' I don't recall ever having received a Rainbow Rose from you myself. Is this supposed to mean that they're more important to you than your own sister?
:{{A|vo lnlq004 1 lyney 06.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' No! I, I just, uh...
:{{A|vo lnlq004 1 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What the... What now? Oh, did Paimon say something wrong again, {{Traveler}}?
:{{A|vo lnlq004 1 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' This is getting pretty awkward... What do we do, {{Traveler}}?
:{{A|vo lnlq004 1 charlotte 10.ogg}} '''Charlotte:''' *sigh* Seems like this interview wasn't meant to be. Well, never mind — there's always next time.
:{{A|vo lnlq004 1 charlotte 11.ogg}} '''Charlotte:''' Forgive my persistence, but when there's explosive news waiting to be found, I can't turn away! The news about Jemma has already made waves, and I'll stop at nothing to get to the bottom of it all!
:{{A|vo lnlq004 1 charlotte 12.ogg}} '''Charlotte:''' Apparently, one of the things she said to the Gardes was that her "final wish is to see [[Lorenzo]] one last time." *sigh*, there's clearly a web of complicated relationships there... Can't blame me for being curious.
:{{A|vo lnlq004 1 charlotte 13.ogg}} '''Charlotte:''' Alright, I guess I'll leave you to continue the rest of your conversation in peace. Bye for now!
:{{A|vo lnlq004 1 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Um, Lynette, Paimon didn't mean to—
:{{A|vo lnlq004 1 lynette 04.ogg}} '''Lynette:''' Don't worry, I wasn't angry. I was just trying to distract her.
:{{A|vo lnlq004 1 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, really? Thank goodness. You scared Paimon there!
:{{A|vo lnlq004 1 lyney 07.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Phew, you and me both, Paimon, you and me both... At least it did the job, right?
:{{A|vo lnlq004 1 lynette 05.ogg}} '''Lynette:''' ...Please take good care of that Rainbow Rose.
:{{A|vo lnlq004 1 lynette 06.ogg}} '''Lynette:''' I'd be really upset if you lost it.
{{Dialogue End}}

==Dialogue==
===The Jade Chamber Once More===
{{Quest Description|You receive an invitation from Ningguang, she seems to have something to discuss with you.}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Approach Ningguang)
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913101 ningguang 01.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' Huh?
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913101 ningguang 02.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' Ah, it looks like all our problems are solved. Welcome to the Jade Chamber, {{Traveler}}.
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913101 baishi 01.ogg}} '''Baishi:''' Oh, great! I have no idea what we would have done otherwise...
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913101 baiwen 01.ogg}} '''Baiwen:''' I didn't think we'd really manage to get you here.
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913101 baixiao 01.ogg}} '''Baixiao:''' This was a last-minute situation, and you're the one we trust the most.
:{{DIcon}} What's happened?
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913101 ningguang 03.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' To put it simply, we are just looking for the right person to help. We had a very long discussion about it, but to no avail.
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913101 ningguang 04.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' I have tasked my three most trusted secretaries with overseeing an important auction tomorrow. This, however, leaves their regular duties unattended to, and the work cannot afford to go undone.
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913101 ningguang 05.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' The nature of their day-to-day work is highly sensitive and confidential, so whomever I ask to fill in needs to be someone I can trust, and who doesn't have a conflict of interest.
:{{DIcon}} So you thought of me?
::{{A|vo ngcop001 1913101 ningguang 06.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' Yes. You were the person who came to mind. We may not have spent a great deal of time together... but I do place a great deal of trust in you.
:{{DIcon}} I don't think I'm up to this task...
::{{A|vo ngcop001 1913101 ningguang 07.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' There's no need to be quite so modest. Actually, you were the first person I thought of. I place a great deal of trust in you. Besides, we haven't thought of any other suitable candidates.
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913101 ningguang 08.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' To me, this work is highly sensitive and of utmost importance, though I'm sure you will find it to be mundane at best. It would not surprise me if you can't bear the tedium or can't make the time...
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913101 ningguang 09.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' And yet, despite this, I thought it could do no harm to ask the question, on the off chance that you are interested.
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913101 ningguang 10.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' As it happens, I was just having a discussion on backup plans with my secretaries before you arrived.
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913101 baixiao 02.ogg}} '''Baixiao:''' But... the outcome of that discussion was that we couldn't think of a suitable alternative...
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913101 baiwen 02.ogg}} '''Baiwen:''' This is a good reminder that we should always have a contingency plan for everything.
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913101 ningguang 11.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' Anyway. This may add to the debt of gratitude I owe you, but the fact is, your arrival here has rescued what was fast becoming a rather dire situation indeed.
:{{DIcon}} If I have what it takes, I'll do it.
:{{DIcon}} How tedious are we talking?
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913101 ningguang 12.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' I wouldn't worry. It's all work you'll be quite familiar with — planning trips, gathering pertinent information, that sort of thing.
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913101 ningguang 13.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' All basic skills required by competent adventurers, if I'm not mistaken.
:{{DIcon}} Okay. I'll give it a try...
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913101 baishi 02.ogg}} '''Baishi:''' If you have any questions about your work, I will answer them shortly.
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913101 baishi 03.ogg}} '''Baishi:''' The administrative work Lady Ningguang touched upon just now is only one aspect. You'll also be required to cater for Lady Ningguang's basic daily needs, such as clothing and meals, and be on call for any other requests she may have.
:{{DIcon}} That's, um... Wow.
::{{A|vo ngcop001 1913101 ningguang 14.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' Don't be mistaken, I won't put you in a difficult position. And I will fully respect your judgment.
:{{DIcon}} ...Why can't you do it yourself?
::{{A|vo ngcop001 1913101 ningguang 15.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' None of this is hard work, but there is a lot to do and it's highly repetitive. Having a dedicated staff member deal with it exclusively means that everyone has clearly delineated duties and can focus on their own work.
::{{A|vo ngcop001 1913101 ningguang 16.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' Simply put, this is about maximizing overall efficiency.
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913101 ningguang 17.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' Alright. Please proceed to the office. Baishi will go over the work with you in more detail.
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913101 baishi 04.ogg}} '''Baishi:''' Yes, Lady Ningguang. Okay, let's go.
{{Dialogue End}}

===Scheduling the Day===
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Talk to Baishi)
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913102 baishi 01.ogg}} '''Baishi:''' Before I get into specifics, I want to start by giving you the big picture.
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913102 baishi 02.ogg}} '''Baishi:''' As a member of the Liyue Qixing, Lady Ningguang's every move is in the spotlight. Maintaining her perfect image at all times is absolutely essential.
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913102 baishi 03.ogg}} '''Baishi:''' My usual job is to be her right hand, to maintain her image, and take care of all her worries.
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913102 baishi 04.ogg}} '''Baishi:''' For example, arranging her daily schedule, picking out clothes for her... dressing her, applying her perfume...
:{{DIcon}} Your eyes are really sparkling right now...
:{{DIcon}} Are you in a trance, or?
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913102 baishi 05.ogg}} '''Baishi:''' Ahem. You misunderstand me. I am simply trying to impress upon you the sheer importance of the work you will be undertaking!
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913102 ningguang 01.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' Baishi has always been very passionate about her work. I can leave any task in her capable hands and rest assured that her performance will be nothing short of exemplary.
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913102 ningguang 02.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' I'm sure she was simply trying to share some of her enthusiasm, in the hopes that you may find it infectious.
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913102 baishi 06.ogg}} '''Baishi:''' Th—Thank you, Lady Ningguang!
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913102 baishi 07.ogg}} '''Baishi:''' Back to the topic at hand. Let's get into the details.
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913102 baishi 08.ogg}} '''Baishi:''' Baixiao and Baiwen handle tasks that require enormous experience, while I'm mainly responsible for organizing her daily scheduled and making sure she is well-fed, dressed for any occasion, and that all her needs are met.
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913102 baishi 09.ogg}} '''Baishi:''' I can go through the methods I use and give you some pointers based on my experience to ensure that you are fully equipped to perform your duties.
:{{DIcon}} It's just basic daily routine stuff. It'll be fine.
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913102 baishi 10.ogg}} '''Baishi:''' All in a day's work for the Traveler, hmm? Great, then I'll skip that and just get to the handover of duties.
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913102 baishi 11.ogg}} '''Baishi:''' Currently, there are 133 items that have yet to be scheduled, 17 of which are high-importance and...
:{{DIcon}} ...133!?
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913102 baishi 12.ogg}} '''Baishi:''' Yes. I did try to make a start in advance, but only got as far as roughly prioritizing the tasks before I ran out of time.
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913102 baishi 13.ogg}} '''Baishi:''' I'll go through the most important items with you in more detail. If there's anything you don't understand, feel free to stop me with questions at any point.
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913102 baishi 14.ogg}} '''Baishi:''' First is the periodic meeting with the representatives of the Eight Trades, after that, fielding opinions on revisions to the current tax legislation.
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913102 baishi 15.ogg}} '''Baishi:''' Then, a discussion with Lady Keqing on issues relating to time restrictions on land conveyance deals. Following that, there's a Q&A session with all the major commerce guilds.
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913102 baishi 16.ogg}} '''Baishi:''' Right after that, there's—
:{{DIcon}} Hold up! Do I really have to understand Ningguang's work in all this detail just to organize her schedule?
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913102 baishi 17.ogg}} '''Baishi:''' Yes, you do. To the uninitiated, scheduling may sound like a simple process of matching tasks to time slots, but there is actually far more to it than that.
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913102 baishi 18.ogg}} '''Baishi:''' You need to take travel time into account, along with a whole spectrum of potential issues that can arise...
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913102 baishi 19.ogg}} '''Baishi:''' Ample knowledge of all outside factors that may weigh upon your plan A is essential to devise a workable contingency plan.
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913102 baishi 20.ogg}} '''Baishi:''' I assume this is all making sense... unless you had any other questions at this point?
:{{DIcon}} (She's not going to keep going on like this... is she?)
:{{DIcon}} No, I think I'm good...
:{{DIcon}} (Actually, I didn't understand any of it...)
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913102 baishi 21.ogg}} '''Baishi:''' Good, then let's press on — we're tight on time here, and there's a lot to get through. And we still need to leave enough time for you to prepare Lady Ningguang's schedule.
:{{DIcon}} Uh, n—no need.
:{{DIcon}} I think I know how to approach it now.
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913102 baishi 22.ogg}} '''Baishi:''' Already? Wow... you're a fast learner. Very good, this will be much more efficient.
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913102 ningguang 03.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' Wonderful. Then I'll be counting on you to provide my schedule for tomorrow.
:{{DIcon}} I'll do my best.
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913102 ningguang 04.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' I'm grateful for your assistance. Now, I will leave you here in peace to proceed with your work. I still have a few items from today's schedule that need addressing.
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913102 ningguang 05.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' If anything else is unclear, you can ask Baishi.
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913102 baishi 23.ogg}} '''Baishi:''' Take care, Lady Ningguang!
:{{Hangout Branch|(Alright. Time to make a serious effort.)|Business as Usual}}
::{{Black Screen|You hand over the schedule you made to Baishi.}}

'''''The Last Turnfire Night''''' is the third part of {{Quest|Kinich's Deal}}.

==Steps==
# Wait till the next day (18:00 – 20:00)
# Go to Elder [[Trinidad]]'s home
# Head to the [[Turnfire Night]] venue
# Prepare to begin the ceremony
# Obtain the kindling
# Light the Pillars of the Sacred Flame (x/9)
# Complete the Lighting ceremony
# Go to the cave where the [[Kongamato|Mountain King]] slumbers
# Go deeper inside...
# Cleanse the [[Abyss]]al power all around and light the brazier (X/6)
# Go further in
# Light up the last torches and altar (X/6)
# Implement the final step of the plan
# Defeat the Mountain King
#* {{Enemy|Kongamato|text=Kongamato — Corrupted Mountain King}}
# Talk to the Mountain King
# Consult Chief [[Wayna]]
# Find [[Kinich]] and talk to him
# Standing before a familiar mural...<!-- doesn't show during playthrough, but shows in the Travel Log as the section with the final Sanka dialogue block -->

==Gameplay Notes==
* During steps 3–15, the player will enter [[Special Story Mode]]. Upon leaving this mode, the player will reappear in front of Trinidad's home, with Kinich standing nearby. Depending on quest progress, talking to him will resume the quest from either steps 4, 5, 8, 11, or 13.
* While lighting the nine pillars, it is possible to miss lighting a pillar if the player advances too quickly, as it is possible to cancel movement toward a [[Coilgrass Sigil]] by triggering another grapple<!-- with both Kinich and an indwelled Yumkasaurus -->. This will cause the process to be restarted.
* During step 14, a trial [[Kinich]] joins the party.

:{{A|vo jnqlq005 14 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Phew... Pretty eventful day yesterday, huh? Paimon wonders how things are doing now. Let's go ask the chief.

;(Talk to Wayna)
:{{A|vo jnqlq005 15 wayna 01.ogg}} '''Wayna:''' {{Traveler}}, you've come at just the right time. I have some good news for you...
:{{A|vo jnqlq005 15 wayna 02.ogg}} '''Wayna:''' Trinidad's condition has stabilized. He suffered burns on much of his body, but we believe he'll survive.
:{{A|vo jnqlq005 15 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Guess that's the best news we could hope for...
:{{A|vo jnqlq005 15 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Paimon has to ask, is everyone in your tribe such a risk-taker? First Kinich, then Elder Trinidad... Is this the Scions of the Canopy's adventurous spirit in action?
:{{A|vo jnqlq005 15 wayna 03.ogg}} '''Wayna:''' We're simply not afraid to charge ahead into the unknown.
:{{DIcon}} Is Kinich okay?
:{{A|vo jnqlq005 15 wayna 04.ogg}} '''Wayna:''' He's fine, don't worry. He's gone to check on the Mountain King — something most mysterious has happened.
:{{A|vo jnqlq005 15 wayna 05.ogg}} '''Wayna:''' After the incident yesterday, a transparent shell has formed around the Mountain King's body. We don't understand the mechanism behind it, but this shell appears to insulate him against the influence of Abyssal power.
:{{A|vo jnqlq005 15 wayna 06.ogg}} '''Wayna:''' It is somewhat akin to a scab, in that it stops the Abyssal energy within him from bleeding out, while also preventing further Abyssal energy from seeping in and infecting him.
:{{A|vo jnqlq005 15 wayna 07.ogg}} '''Wayna:''' We've never seen anything like it. The tribe's most senior elders believe it was caused when he was burned by the sacred flame, similar to the way burned wood becomes charcoal.
:{{A|vo jnqlq005 15 wayna 08.ogg}} '''Wayna:''' I think their theory makes sense. After all, we've never thrown the Mountain King directly into the sacred flame before.
:{{A|vo jnqlq005 15 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wow, so it's made a barrier against Abyssal energy? That's... a good thing, right?
:{{A|vo jnqlq005 15 wayna 09.ogg}} '''Wayna:''' It's practically a miracle, from what we've seen of it so far. It means that the Mountain King's level of Abyssal energy is now stable. No longer will we need to perform an annual cleansing ceremony.
:{{A|vo jnqlq005 15 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wow! That's amazing!
:{{DIcon}} Was it really just the power of the sacred flame?
:{{A|vo jnqlq005 15 wayna 11.ogg}} '''Wayna:''' I know what you're thinking. The young people in the tribe are already speculating that yesterday's ceremony was a Turnfire Night like none other in our history.
:{{A|vo jnqlq005 15 wayna 12.ogg}} '''Wayna:''' Because you and Kinich... You summoned the very flame that appears in our ancient legends. A great, transparent ball of fire.
:{{A|vo jnqlq005 15 wayna 13.ogg}} '''Wayna:''' And that fire is what saved the Mountain King.
:{{A|vo jnqlq005 15 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Whoa! So that was the real Turnfire?
:{{A|vo jnqlq005 15 wayna 14.ogg}} '''Wayna:''' Haha, I may be the chief of this tribe, but I've only ever known the Turnfire as a concept in our legends. I cannot answer that question.
:{{A|vo jnqlq005 15 wayna 15.ogg}} '''Wayna:''' If anyone can answer it, I suspect it would be the bearer of the {{Rubi|Malipo|Turnfire}} name. He is in the Mountain King's cave as we speak.
:{{A|vo jnqlq005 15 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ah... So, Kinich then. Why don't we go see how he's doing?

;(Approach Kinich)
:{{A|vo jnqlq005 16 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hey, Kinich!
:{{A|vo jnqlq005 16 kinich 01.ogg}} '''Kinich:''' Hey yourselves. You two doing okay after yesterday?
:{{A|vo jnqlq005 16 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' We were gonna ask you the same question... You scared Paimon half to death when you rushed into the fire.
:{{A|vo jnqlq005 16 kinich 02.ogg}} '''Kinich:''' Sorry, I couldn't just stand and watch the Mountain King get burned alive.
:{{A|vo jnqlq005 16 ajaw 01.ogg}} '''Ajaw:''' So you thought you'd try and extinguish the sacred flame with [[Dendro]]? Or was that an attempt to make the Almighty Dragonlord, K'uhul Ajaw die of laughter?
:{{A|vo jnqlq005 16 kinich 03.ogg}} '''Kinich:''' The sacred flame only possesses a fraction of the [[Pyro Archon]]'s power. It's not as if I was fighting the Pyro Archon herself.
:{{A|vo jnqlq005 16 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Kinich... When you went into the flames, were you intending to... uh...
:{{A|vo jnqlq005 16 kinich 04.ogg}} '''Kinich:''' Intending to what?
:{{A|vo jnqlq005 16 paimon 14.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' To, um... do the same thing as Burkina...
:{{A|vo jnqlq005 16 kinich 06.ogg}} '''Kinich:''' Sacrifice myself? Of course not. My focus was on keeping the Mountain King alive, not on what it would cost.
:{{A|vo jnqlq005 16 kinich 07.ogg}} '''Kinich:''' But now I'm curious. What made you think I was going to sacrifice myself?
:{{A|vo jnqlq005 16 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Well... Because everyone's saying the Turnfire is what saved the King last night...
:{{A|vo jnqlq005 16 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' And Ponche's theory was that summoning the Turnfire is a tit-for-tat exchange, right? So Paimon thought you'd decided to pay for it with your life...
:{{A|vo jnqlq005 16 kinich 08.ogg}} '''Kinich:''' So you've heard that rumor too.
:{{A|vo jnqlq005 16 kinich 09.ogg}} '''Kinich:''' I'm afraid I can't say for sure. What happened yesterday was a first for me too.
:{{A|vo jnqlq005 16 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Well, if even you don't know,<ref group="Note">Paimon says "even if you don't know" in the voiceover, but the text displays what the line should have been.</ref> there's probably no one in the world who does. 
:{{A|vo jnqlq005 16 kinich 10.ogg}} '''Kinich:''' What I would say is, if that really was the power of the Turnfire, I'd sooner believe that the Mountain King summoned it himself.
:{{A|vo jnqlq005 16 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' The Mountain King? Then... what price did he pay?
:{{A|vo jnqlq005 16 kinich 11.ogg}} '''Kinich:''' The core meaning of "price" is not atonement or compensation, but what you're willing to give up in order to obtain what you want.
:{{A|vo jnqlq005 16 kinich 12.ogg}} '''Kinich:''' It's easy to die for your sins, much harder to live with the guilt and keep on going. In the end, the Mountain King chose the latter option — for Burkina, and for the tribe. That's the price he paid.
:{{A|vo jnqlq005 16 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Alright... So how is the Mountain King doing now?
:{{A|vo jnqlq005 16 kinich 13.ogg}} '''Kinich:''' Health-wise, there's nothing to worry about. He'll enter a fighting stance whenever we set foot in his territory.
:{{A|vo jnqlq005 16 kinich 14.ogg}} '''Kinich:''' But his attacks are gentler now, and not as crazed as before. Like he said yesterday, he just intends to be a sparring partner for people to practice with.
:{{DIcon}} You said "health-wise." Is something else bothering you?<ref group="Note">The [[Travel Log]] incorrectly attributes this line to Paimon.</ref>
:{{A|vo jnqlq005 16 kinich 15.ogg}} '''Kinich:''' Yeah. I tried communicating with him again, but he didn't respond.
:{{A|vo jnqlq005 16 ajaw 02.ogg}} '''Ajaw:''' Hmph, we daresay that Locust King has well and truly lost its mind. The lights are on, but nobody is home.
:{{A|vo jnqlq005 16 ajaw 03.ogg}} '''Ajaw:''' Its body remains fighting fit thanks to the perverse power of the Abyss, but time has been less kind to its soul... It was ground to a pulp long ago!
:{{A|vo jnqlq005 16 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' But we saw him come back to his senses yesterday...
:{{A|vo jnqlq005 16 ajaw 04.ogg}} '''Ajaw:''' That was merely one last burst of brain activity before it croaked. As you humans would say, it went out with a bang.
:{{A|vo jnqlq005 16 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, come on! Stop being such a doomer. Paimon bets the Mountain King has finally let go of the tragedies of the past now, and is focusing on moving forward!
:{{A|vo jnqlq005 16 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' That's why he doesn't have time to chat with us. He's too busy thinking about the future!
:{{A|vo jnqlq005 16 kinich 16.ogg}} '''Kinich:''' Heh, well, at least it means my fellow tribespeople can move forward now, too. Thank you for your help, {{Traveler}}. I owe you one.
:{{DIcon}} Nah, you already gave me that "gift."
:{{A|vo jnqlq005 16 paimon 12.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yeah, that's right. You caught Enjou for us, remember?
:{{A|vo jnqlq005 16 kinich 17.ogg}} '''Kinich:''' But he ended up being completely useless. It's not a fair trade if you lost out.
:{{A|vo jnqlq005 16 paimon 13.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Eh, that's on him. It's not your fault he's useless! Besides, we're friends now. You don't owe us anything.
:{{A|vo jnqlq005 16 kinich 18.ogg}} '''Kinich:''' Friends? But your friendship is an even more valuable gift. I can't in good conscience accept it for free...
:{{A|vo jnqlq005 16 kinich 19.ogg}} '''Kinich:''' So promise me, if you need anything in the future, you'll come to me.
:{{A|vo jnqlq005 16 kinich 20.ogg}} '''Kinich:''' For you, I'll do anything.

;(Meanwhile, at the mural Thiago found)
:{{A|vo jnqlq005 17 fuchikami 01.ogg}} '''Sanka:''' ACHOO! Ahem... So in the end, only poor little Huni got the sad ending?
:{{A|vo jnqlq005 17 huni 01.ogg}} '''Huni:''' Yeah! Everyone's happy, except me. First [[Nanna]], then my Dad... Why does everyone in my family have to suffer?
:{{A|vo jnqlq005 17 toba 01.ogg}} '''Toba:''' Huni... It'll be okay. Your dad will get better soon.
:{{A|vo jnqlq005 17 huni 02.ogg}} '''Huni:''' Toba, you're my friend, so I shouldn't say this to your face. But it was all the Mountain King's fault.
:{{A|vo jnqlq005 17 toba 02.ogg}} '''Toba:''' Ehh!?
:{{A|vo jnqlq005 17 fuchikami 02.ogg}} '''Sanka:''' Now hold your horses, kiddo. If you promise not to fight, Uncle [[Sanka]] will tell you a story.
:;(Huni and Toba both immediately glare at Sanka)
:{{A|vo jnqlq005 17 fuchikami 03.ogg}} '''Sanka:''' ...Okay, before you roll your eyes out of your skull, I promise you can trust me. I almost got my eyebrows burned off by the Turnfire after last time. That's why I came back, to make it up to you!
;(Sanka briefly waits for a response from Huni and Toba, who continue to glare at him)
:{{A|vo jnqlq005 17 fuchikami 04.ogg}} '''Sanka:''' ...Alright, I'll just get to the point. Do you know what Uncle Sanka loves the most about your people?
:{{A|vo jnqlq005 17 huni 03.ogg}} '''Huni:''' ...What?
:{{A|vo jnqlq005 17 fuchikami 05.ogg}} '''Sanka:''' Your extreme sports.
:{{A|vo jnqlq005 17 toba 03.ogg}} '''Toba:''' Huh?
:{{A|vo jnqlq005 17 fuchikami 06.ogg}} '''Sanka:''' On my first day here, I got hit by someone falling out of the sky. I believe you call it "bungee jumping"?
:{{A|vo jnqlq005 17 fuchikami 07.ogg}} '''Sanka:''' It's a dangerous sport, to be sure, but the courage it took to make the jump impressed the heck out of me. So I introduced myself to the jumper, we made friends, and I even helped treat her wounds.
:{{A|vo jnqlq005 17 huni 04.ogg}} '''Huni:''' Aw. Such a nice friend.
:{{A|vo jnqlq005 17 fuchikami 08.ogg}} '''Sanka:''' Of course. Anyway, the good times didn't last, 'cause I got captured by a powerful foe, so we had to part ways for a while.
:{{A|vo jnqlq005 17 fuchikami 09.ogg}} '''Sanka:''' In the hands of the enemy, I was scorned, scolded, and nearly given away as a gift. Oh, it was so humiliating! A horrible experience to look back on.
:{{A|vo jnqlq005 17 fuchikami 10.ogg}} '''Sanka:''' "Why does Uncle Sanka always have to suffer?" I thought. So I feel your pain, Huni. I was in the same position.
:{{A|vo jnqlq005 17 fuchikami 11.ogg}} '''Sanka:''' But in the end, I made it through, and I left all of those painful memories in the past. I even managed to reunite with my friend!
:{{A|vo jnqlq005 17 toba 04.ogg}} '''Toba:''' Uh... Is that it?
:{{A|vo jnqlq005 17 huni 05.ogg}} '''Huni:''' The moral of the story is to look forward in life, right? Yeah, we've heard that one millions of times. Sorry, Uncle Sanka, but you're not cut out to be a teacher.
:{{A|vo jnqlq005 17 fuchikami 12.ogg}} '''Sanka:''' Very smart, Huni. But not quite smart enough.
:{{A|vo jnqlq005 17 fuchikami 13.ogg}} '''Sanka:''' What I'm trying to tell you is that after I reunited with my friend, I found her injuries were all healed, but she really missed her family. So, I thought you might like to see her too.
:{{A|vo jnqlq005 17 fuchikami 14.ogg}} '''Sanka:''' She's right behind you. Turn around and see.
:{{A|vo jnqlq005 17 huni 06.ogg}} '''Huni:''' Another trick about not turning back? I'm not falling for that one again!
:{{A|vo jnqlq005 17 huni 07.ogg}} '''Huni:''' ...Huh!?
:{{Color|menu|Huni feels a warmth from behind. Turning around, she sees her friend Nanna. Before she can recover from her shock, Nanna has pressed her face against Huni's.}}

:{{A|vo mlnlq002 1 amina 03.ogg}} '''Amina:''' So what brings you here? Do you need help with anything?

:{{A|vo mlnlq002 1 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yeah, but now that you mention it, we don't know anything about the actual legend yet.
:{{A|vo mlnlq002 1 amina 06.ogg}} '''Amina:''' Then allow me to explain it to you two.
:{{A|vo mlnlq002 1 amina 07.ogg}} '''Amina:''' It is said that the first chief of the [[People of the Springs]] was the most outstanding guide in all of Natlan. He discovered many deserted domains and found countless treasures.
:{{A|vo mlnlq002 1 amina 08.ogg}} '''Amina:''' But to prove himself once more, he embarked on yet another journey, in search of a legendary mysterious island. He endured many hardships along the way, but he persevered and managed to reach the destination.
:{{A|vo mlnlq002 1 amina 09.ogg}} '''Amina:''' The island emits a golden light, where countless treasures are buried. But instead of claiming the treasures for himself, he left behind a trail of clues that lead to the island.
:{{A|vo mlnlq002 1 amina 10.ogg}} '''Amina:''' Since then, many people from later generations have undertaken the challenge of finding the island. After all, to find the island is to find riches and glory.
:{{A|vo mlnlq002 1 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, that makes sense! So could you tell us how to get to that island?
:{{A|vo mlnlq002 1 amina 11.ogg}} '''Amina:''' ...
:{{A|vo mlnlq002 1 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, Paimon gets it. This is a big secret for the People of the Springs, so you can't just tell anyone, right?
:{{A|vo mlnlq002 1 amina 12.ogg}} '''Amina:''' On the contrary, it's quite the opposite. The legend and the clues needed to find the island are all already known to the public.
:{{A|vo mlnlq002 1 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh! Then what's the problem?
:{{A|vo mlnlq002 1 amina 13.ogg}} '''Amina:''' Well, I'm willing to answer your question in exchange for a favor. What do you think?
:{{A|vo mlnlq002 1 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Sure thing, but what do you need us to do?
:{{A|vo mlnlq002 1 amina 14.ogg}} '''Amina:''' Then you have my thanks. Allow me to tell you some details.
:{{A|vo mlnlq002 1 amina 15.ogg}} '''Amina:''' I'll be honest, there are some among the tribe who are of rather base character. Not long ago, I received a report that a few of them were working together to scam visitors.
:{{A|vo mlnlq002 1 amina 16.ogg}} '''Amina:''' As the chief of the tribe, I was very ashamed to hear of this...
:{{A|vo mlnlq002 1 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' It's really hard to believe that could happen!
:{{A|vo mlnlq002 1 amina 17.ogg}} '''Amina:''' They are targeting tourists who wish to visit that island.
:{{A|vo mlnlq002 1 amina 18.ogg}} '''Amina:''' According to my sources, they would trick tourists into believing they are trustworthy guides, before luring the tourists into spending a fortune for the sake of reaching the island.
:{{A|vo mlnlq002 1 amina 19.ogg}} '''Amina:''' They run a pretty sophisticated operation. They would always claim the scammed money as some kind of legal travel expenditure, so it's hard to use that to directly convict them.
:{{A|vo mlnlq002 1 amina 20.ogg}} '''Amina:''' So, I was hoping to find someone who could approach them and pretend to get scammed. Doing so would allow us to gather the evidence required to bring them to justice.
:{{A|vo mlnlq002 1 amina 21.ogg}} '''Amina:''' The problem is... They would certainly recognize anyone associated with me, which is why I haven't been able to carry out the plan yet.
:{{A|vo mlnlq002 1 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, Paimon understands now. We're the perfect bait because we're both tourists!
:{{A|vo mlnlq002 1 amina 22.ogg}} '''Amina:''' Exactly. And as far as I know, you two are no pushovers. No matter what nefarious schemes they may come up with, you'll be perfectly capable of protecting yourselves, right?
:{{A|vo mlnlq002 1 paimon 12a.ogg}} {{A|vo mlnlq002 1 paimon 12b.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You betcha! If it's just a few scammers we're talking about, {{MC|m=he|f=she}} will take 'em all down!
:{{A|vo mlnlq002 1 amina 23.ogg}} '''Amina:''' Wonderful. Then here, please take this.

</gallery>
:{{A|vo mlnlq002 1 paimon 13.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Whoa, that's a lot of [[Mora]]! Did we already earn a bonus?
:{{A|vo mlnlq002 1 amina 24.ogg}} '''Amina:''' There will be plenty of rewards if you manage to catch those scoundrels. This Mora, however, is for other purposes.
:{{A|vo mlnlq002 1 amina 25.ogg}} '''Amina:''' I'm sure some spending will be required on your part before they lower their guard. I certainly wouldn't expect you to pay out of your own pockets.
:{{A|vo mlnlq002 1 amina 26.ogg}} '''Amina:''' So please use the Mora as needed, and collect as much evidence as possible.
:{{A|vo mlnlq002 1 paimon 14.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' No wonder you're the chief! Seems like you've already thought of everything. Okay, we'll take it from here!
:{{A|vo mlnlq002 1 amina 27.ogg}} '''Amina:''' I've marked the location of the scammers on your map. I'll leave the rest to you two.

:{{A|vo mlnlq002 2 kaulu 01.ogg}} '''Kaulu:''' Ah, are you two visitors from afar looking to visit the mysterious island?
