:{{A|vo mlnlq002 2 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ahem... Oh, pardon, is something the matter?
:{{A|vo mlnlq002 2 kaulu 02.ogg}} '''Kaulu:''' I just happened to overhear you two talking about the mysterious island. I assume you two must be tourists brought here by the legend and looking for the island, am I right?
:{{A|vo mlnlq002 2 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hello, Paimon is Paimon, and this is {{Traveler}}. That's right, we were just getting ready to look for that island from the legend!
:{{A|vo mlnlq002 2 kaulu 03.ogg}} '''Kaulu:''' In that case, as a qualified guide, I certainly cannot allow you to embark on such a dangerous journey.
:{{A|vo mlnlq002 2 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh?
:{{A|vo mlnlq002 2 kaulu 04.ogg}} '''Kaulu:''' As the legend says, if you can manage to reach the mysterious island, riches and glory will be yours for the taking.
:{{A|vo mlnlq002 2 kaulu 05.ogg}} '''Kaulu:''' Be that as it may, the journey to the island is full of untold perils and dangers. It would be nigh impossible for any average person to reach the island.
:{{A|vo mlnlq002 2 kaulu 06.ogg}} '''Kaulu:''' But you are in luck! Allow me to tell you the purpose of our services. It just so happens that our mission as guides is to help visitors avoid danger, find shortcuts, and successfully reach their destination.
:{{A|vo mlnlq002 2 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' ...
:{{DIcon}} So, this was all a pitch for your services?
:{{A|vo mlnlq002 2 kaulu 07.ogg}} '''Kaulu:''' Please, there's no need to worry. This was just one point I had to make perfectly clear.
:{{A|vo mlnlq002 2 kaulu 08.ogg}} '''Kaulu:''' Although the legend and the clues to finding the island are known to everyone, the leads left behind by our ancestors are as enigmatic as riddles found on a lost treasure map.
:{{A|vo mlnlq002 2 kaulu 09.ogg}} '''Kaulu:''' Only guides bestowed with the legacy of our ancestors can correctly decipher the clues. Tourists who rashly embark on their own often wind up lost and encounter unnecessary dangers.
:{{A|vo mlnlq002 2 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh, he actually sounds pretty convincing...
:{{A|vo mlnlq002 2 kaulu 10.ogg}} '''Kaulu:''' But it seems like fate has brought us together, so what say you to having me as your guide?
:{{A|vo mlnlq002 2 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Uh, so how much will you charge us?
:{{A|vo mlnlq002 2 kaulu 11.ogg}} '''Kaulu:''' Not to worry, I don't intend to charge any fees.
:{{A|vo mlnlq002 2 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So you'd be working for... free?
:{{A|vo mlnlq002 2 kaulu 12.ogg}} '''Kaulu:''' For us People of the Springs, guiding guests to the mysterious island is a great honor in of itself, worth more than any amount of Mora.
:{{A|vo mlnlq002 2 paimon 12.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Smooth, Paimon almost wants to believe him...
:{{DIcon}} This is all still a part of his sales pitch.
:{{DIcon}} We need to see what he actually wants to do.
:{{A|vo mlnlq002 2 paimon 13.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Alright, thank you. Then please, guide us onward!
:{{A|vo mlnlq002 2 kaulu 13.ogg}} '''Kaulu:''' Of course. Please follow me.

:{{A|vo mlnlq002 6 kaulu 01.ogg}} '''Kaulu:''' According to Ata's insights, this is the place. We're here!

:{{A|vo mlnlq002 6 kaulu 02.ogg}} '''Kaulu:''' Yes, I've led you to the island just as I promised, which means it's time for me to say goodbye.
:{{A|vo mlnlq002 6 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hold on, are you serious!? This is supposed to be the island!? Then what about the treasure? And look at these wooden signs and artificial lights. Even we can tell it's fake!

:{{A|vo mlnlq002 6 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hmph, since you seem to have dropped the act, then there's no need for us to continue, either.
:{{A|vo mlnlq002 6 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' We were commissioned by the chief of the People of the Springs to gather evidence of your scamming activities! With these receipts, your scamming days are over.

:{{A|vo mlnlq002 6 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Let's see... Huh? Wait, all the writing has disappeared!?
:{{A|vo mlnlq002 6 kaulu 05.ogg}} '''Kaulu:''' I took you all this way just to buy enough time for the handwriting to disappear. Even if you were to go back to the people you paid, you'd only find that they were using fake names, making them impossible to track down.
:{{A|vo mlnlq002 6 kaulu 06.ogg}} '''Kaulu:''' You wanna report me for scamming tourists, then be my guest. I'll just say that I'm being falsely accused. With that settled, I'll be going now.

:{{A|vo mlnlq002 6 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' It's the chief!

:{{A|vo mlnlq002 6 amina 01.ogg}} '''Amina:''' I had dispatched others to secretly trail you. Thanks to you, we can finally convict him of scamming people.
:{{A|vo mlnlq002 6 kaulu 08a.ogg}}<!--{{A|vo mlnlq002 6 kaulu 08b.ogg}}--> '''Kaulu:''' Convict me? How? They don't have any evidence against me. Even as the chief, you can't just level accusations without any evidence, right?
:{{A|vo mlnlq002 6 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Sorry to say it, but he got us. We lost all the evidence we had...
:{{A|vo mlnlq002 6 amina 02.ogg}} '''Amina:''' Not to worry, let's search him first.
:{{A|vo mlnlq002 6 kaulu 09.ogg}} '''Kaulu:''' Hey, what are you doing? Keep your hands off me, that's my Mora!
:{{A|vo mlnlq002 6 amina 03.ogg}} '''Amina:''' Yes, I see the mark... Looks like you already split the Mora before you led them here.
:{{A|vo mlnlq002 6 kaulu 10.ogg}} '''Kaulu:''' What do you mean?
:{{A|vo mlnlq002 6 amina 04.ogg}} '''Amina:''' The Mora that {{Traveler}} and Paimon were using today were all provided by me. They all have a special mark on them.
:{{A|vo mlnlq002 6 kaulu 11.ogg}} '''Kaulu:''' You...
:{{A|vo mlnlq002 6 amina 05a.ogg}}<!--{{A|vo mlnlq002 6 amina 05b.ogg}}--> '''Amina:''' So, there must be an explanation why the Mora that should have been theirs ended up in your hands, right?
:{{A|vo mlnlq002 6 amina 06.ogg}} '''Amina:''' There are no receipts to prove that any transactions took place, and you yourself just denied that there was a scam... So did you, then, take the Mora from them by force?
:{{A|vo mlnlq002 6 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Take Mora from others by force!? Oh, that's an even more serious crime than scamming!
:{{A|vo mlnlq002 6 kaulu 12.ogg}} '''Kaulu:''' Ah, y—you... Ugh, alright. Sure, I admit that I coaxed them into spending a few times... But I wouldn't go as far as calling it "scamming"...
:{{A|vo mlnlq002 6 amina 07.ogg}} '''Amina:''' We have witnesses standing right here, you know.
:{{A|vo mlnlq002 6 kaulu 13.ogg}} '''Kaulu:''' Fine... Yes, it was all a scam.
:{{A|vo mlnlq002 6 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Woohoo! No wonder you're the chief of the tribe!
:{{A|vo mlnlq002 6 amina 08.ogg}} '''Amina:''' I still don't understand how so many people have been getting duped by them. You need only stop and think for a moment to see through the whole thing.
:{{A|vo mlnlq002 6 amina 09.ogg}} '''Amina:''' If he claims to be able to find a shortcut to the mysterious island, then why hasn't he just gone there and claimed the treasure for himself? Why even bother guiding others there?
:{{A|vo mlnlq002 6 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' That's a good point. Speaking of, have any guides from the People of the Springs ever found the treasure of the mysterious island?
:{{A|vo mlnlq002 6 amina 10.ogg}} '''Amina:''' I can answer this question along with your previous one about how to get there. The answer is actually very simple—
:{{A|vo mlnlq002 6 amina 11.ogg}} '''Amina:''' There is no shortcut to the island, and most people don't even meet the requirement to ever reach it.
:{{A|vo mlnlq002 6 amina 12.ogg}} '''Amina:''' If you don't meet this single condition, then even guides from the People of the Springs, despite all of their abilities, will find it difficult to overcome the obstacles along the way...
:{{A|vo mlnlq002 6 amina 13.ogg}} '''Amina:''' Which is exactly why even though the clues to the mysterious island are open to the public, few have ever made it there.
:{{A|vo mlnlq002 6 paimon 12.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' There's a requirement? What is it?
:{{A|vo mlnlq002 6 amina 14.ogg}} '''Amina:''' Let me ask you something first. What do you think a real journey to the mysterious island should be like?
:{{A|vo mlnlq002 6 paimon 13.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Uh, it should probably involve... overcoming a lot of hardships with your companions, before witnessing some breathtaking sights, uncovering a really touching story.. Oh! And scoring some super cool treasure at the end!
:{{A|vo mlnlq002 6 amina 15.ogg}} '''Amina:''' And therein lies the key point... overcoming hardships with your companions.
:{{A|vo mlnlq002 6 amina 16.ogg}} '''Amina:''' It's said that when the first chief set out to search for the island, the ones who accompanied him were not clients, nor tourists, but his closest friends.
:{{A|vo mlnlq002 6 amina 17.ogg}} '''Amina:''' The legend also mentioned that only those willing to entrust their lives to one another will be able to reach the island together.
:{{A|vo mlnlq002 6 amina 18.ogg}} '''Amina:''' Therefore, the requirement to reach the island is journeying with your closest friends... The kind of friends you would trust with your life.
:{{A|vo mlnlq002 6 paimon 14.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So that's the key...
:{{A|vo mlnlq002 6 amina 19.ogg}} '''Amina:''' From what I can see, you and Paimon are exactly those kinds of friends, the kind that would trust each other with anything.
:{{A|vo mlnlq002 6 amina 20.ogg}} '''Amina:''' But unfortunately, neither of you are experienced guides. And if you were to hire someone else, then I'm afraid you could probably never place your lives in the hands of someone you met on a pure monetary basis.
:{{A|vo mlnlq002 6 paimon 15.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' That's true...
:{{A|vo mlnlq002 6 amina 21.ogg}} '''Amina:''' But don't feel discouraged! I believe that this beautiful land that I call my home will not disappoint you.
:{{A|vo mlnlq002 6 amina 22.ogg}} '''Amina:''' Whether it's remote islands or ancient ruins, I'm sure they can also provide you with plenty of exciting adventures.
:{{A|vo mlnlq002 6 amina 23.ogg}} '''Amina:''' And let me tell you a secret. The elders once told me that beneath these very ruins lies a way to reach the sky!

:{{A|vo dyjeq003 8 chevreuse 10.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' ...
:{{A|vo dyjeq003 8 baptiste 10.ogg}} '''Baptiste:''' I know you haven't figured out the link between the two of us. Had you done so, I'd have been taken away to the headquarters a long time ago.
:{{A|vo dyjeq003 8 baptiste 11.ogg}} '''Baptiste:''' But that won't stop me from always remembering his grotesque face. After all, he was the one who killed my mother.
:{{A|vo dyjeq003 8 chevreuse 11.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' ...Your mother is still healthy and well.
:{{A|vo dyjeq003 8 baptiste 12.ogg}} '''Baptiste:''' You know I was adopted as a child. I was referring to my birth mother.
:{{A|vo dyjeq003 8 chevreuse 12.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' That was never recorded in the orphanage's records...
:{{A|vo dyjeq003 8 baptiste 13.ogg}} '''Baptiste:''' Please forgive a six-year-old child for concocting some lies to protect himself after watching his mother die right in front of him.
:{{A|vo dyjeq003 8 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So... your novel... it was like a record of your life?
:{{A|vo dyjeq003 8 baptiste 14.ogg}} '''Baptiste:''' No, of course not. It was a work of fiction with many embellished parts.
:{{A|vo dyjeq003 8 baptiste 15.ogg}} '''Baptiste:''' But... I am indeed the illegitimate son of a wealthy and influential man, who abused his power to murder my mother. That part was a hundred percent real.
:{{A|vo dyjeq003 8 chevreuse 13.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' But the man you killed didn't have a Mora to his name.
:{{A|vo dyjeq003 8 baptiste 16.ogg}} '''Baptiste:''' He was a hired assassin, an irredeemable beast who sank his fangs into a defenseless woman just for a few bags of Mora.
:{{A|vo dyjeq003 8 chevreuse 14.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' But if that's really the truth... You wouldn't be telling us any of this now. You still haven't managed to take revenge against your father, the true mastermind behind it all.
:{{A|vo dyjeq003 8 baptiste 17.ogg}} '''Baptiste:''' ...Haha, I never thought I'd hear that kind of thing from the Captain of the Special Security and Surveillance Patrol.
:{{A|vo dyjeq003 8 chevreuse 15.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' I'm simply skeptical about your motives.
:{{A|vo dyjeq003 8 baptiste 18.ogg}} '''Baptiste:''' It's simple, really. I've grown tired of everything, and don't want to shoulder this burden anymore.
:{{A|vo dyjeq003 8 baptiste 19.ogg}} '''Baptiste:''' You may have considered me too soft to pull the trigger. Well, as it turns out, you are exactly right. I've become overwhelmed by the aftermath of the murder.
:{{A|vo dyjeq003 8 chevreuse 16.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' So you're going to call a stop to your revenge, just like that?
:{{A|vo dyjeq003 8 baptiste 20.ogg}} '''Baptiste:''' The true mastermind is too rich and too powerful for me. I've accepted that I will never be able to avenge my mother alone.
:{{A|vo dyjeq003 8 chevreuse 17.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' And so what? The characters in your book never gave up.
:{{A|vo dyjeq003 8 baptiste 21.ogg}} '''Baptiste:''' Now, Officer Chevreuse, I'm the one who has killed a man, aren't I? Are you trying to convince me to commit another crime?
:{{A|vo dyjeq003 8 chevreuse 18.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' What's your father's name? How do you plan to prove the veracity of all of your claims?
:{{A|vo dyjeq003 8 baptiste 22.ogg}} '''Baptiste:''' Well, ahem... I'd like to speak with you privately.
:{{A|vo dyjeq003 8 chevreuse 19.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' Sure. Why don't we speak privately at the Gardes headquarters?
:{{A|vo dyjeq003 8 baptiste 23.ogg}} '''Baptiste:''' No, it has to be here. I must ensure that we won't be overheard.
:{{A|vo dyjeq003 8 chevreuse 20.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' ...Fine. Let's talk here.
:{{A|vo dyjeq003 8 baptiste 24.ogg}} '''Baptiste:''' When I said "won't be overheard," I meant by anyone...
:{{A|vo dyjeq003 8 baptiste 25.ogg}} '''Baptiste:''' I would like to speak with you and you alone.
:{{DIcon}} ...
:{{DIcon}} We can go somewhere else for now.
:{{A|vo dyjeq003 8 chevreuse 21.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' Thanks, I appreciate it.
:{{A|vo dyjeq003 8 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Please stay safe, Chevreuse!
:;(Traveler and Paimon leave)
:{{A|vo dyjeq003 8 chevreuse 22.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' Alright. Let's hear it.
:{{A|vo dyjeq003 8 baptiste 26.ogg}} '''Baptiste:''' ...Will you really believe what I'm about to say?
:{{A|vo dyjeq003 8 chevreuse 23.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' Well, that depends on what you're going to tell me.
:{{A|vo dyjeq003 8 baptiste 27.ogg}} '''Baptiste:''' Heh... Fair enough, fair enough. Then listen closely...
:;(Baptiste privately tells Chevreuse about his father)
:{{A|vo dyjeq003 8 chevreuse 24.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' ...
:{{A|vo dyjeq003 8 chevreuse 25.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' So that's how it's connected.
:{{A|vo dyjeq003 8 baptiste 28.ogg}} '''Baptiste:''' So, it seems you believe me after all.
:{{A|vo dyjeq003 8 chevreuse 26.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' Do you want me to go public with this?
:{{A|vo dyjeq003 8 baptiste 29.ogg}} '''Baptiste:''' No, of course not. At least, not right now.
:{{A|vo dyjeq003 8 chevreuse 27.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' Then, why did you bother telling me?
:{{A|vo dyjeq003 8 baptiste 30.ogg}} '''Baptiste:''' You've read my work. What do you think?
:{{A|vo dyjeq003 8 chevreuse 28.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' ...
:{{A|vo dyjeq003 8 baptiste 31.ogg}} '''Baptiste:''' Even if you were to go public with all of this right now, he'd simply deny everything.
:{{A|vo dyjeq003 8 baptiste 32.ogg}} '''Baptiste:''' It's been too long... almost twenty years. Anything that could be used as evidence has long faded away. Even if there might have been a solitary island of truth once upon a time, it has long sunk beneath the waves by now.
:{{A|vo dyjeq003 8 baptiste 33.ogg}} '''Baptiste:''' Justice will never find him.
:{{A|vo dyjeq003 8 chevreuse 29.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' Not if you don't try.
:{{A|vo dyjeq003 8 baptiste 34.ogg}} '''Baptiste:''' I know that as the Captain of the Special Security and Surveillance Patrol, you will always stand on the side of justice.
:{{A|vo dyjeq003 8 baptiste 35.ogg}} '''Baptiste:''' But... do you really think a cushy life in prison really constitutes "justice" for him? I bet he could lead an extremely comfortable life in the Fortress of Meropide.
:{{A|vo dyjeq003 8 chevreuse 30.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' What are you trying to say?
:{{A|vo dyjeq003 8 baptiste 36.ogg}} '''Baptiste:''' I've been observing you from a distance. Your portrayal of the musketeer was exquisite.
:{{A|vo dyjeq003 8 baptiste 37.ogg}} '''Baptiste:''' Pull the trigger of justice against him. Let the villain get what he deserves.
:{{A|vo dyjeq003 8 chevreuse 31.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' ...You want me to let you go, so you may complete your revenge?
:{{A|vo dyjeq003 8 baptiste 38.ogg}} '''Baptiste:''' No, Officer Chevreuse. I know that would be impossible.
:{{A|vo dyjeq003 8 baptiste 39.ogg}} '''Baptiste:''' No, what I'd like is for you to perform the deed on my behalf.
:{{Black Screen|Meanwhile, not far away...}}
:{{A|vo dyjeq003 8 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ooh... Chevreuse sure is taking her time! What could they be talking about, anyway?
:{{A|vo dyjeq003 8 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Paimon's worried... What if he decided to attack her?
:{{DIcon}} I have full confidence in Chevreuse's fighting skills.
:{{DIcon}} If anything, he's the one I'd be worried about.
:{{A|vo dyjeq003 8 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, uh... You do have a point.
:{{A|vo dyjeq003 8 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Still, do you have any idea who the rich person might be? And why the novelist doesn't want us to hear what he's saying to Chevreuse?
:{{A|vo dyjeq003 8 chevreuse 32.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' Sorry to keep you waiting, you two.
:{{A|vo dyjeq003 8 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hey! How did your talk go?
:{{DIcon}} Did you figure out who the rich person he mentioned was?
:{{DIcon}} What should we do next?
:{{A|vo dyjeq003 8 chevreuse 33.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' I've already sent someone to escort Baptiste back to the headquarters for questioning. He wasn't lying about the musket — it was indeed buried in his backyard.
:{{A|vo dyjeq003 8 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' But what about the name? Did he tell you the name of the rich guy?
:{{A|vo dyjeq003 8 chevreuse 34.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' Yes, he did. But for now, I have to return to the Special Patrol. There are still a few loose ends I need to tie up.
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (What's going on? It feels like she's keeping something from us.)
:{{A|vo dyjeq003 8 chevreuse 35.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' I'll probably be quite busy over the next few days, so apologies if you don't see me on set.
:{{A|vo dyjeq003 8 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Alright, Paimon understands if you can't tell us everything you know! We'll just keep an eye on [[The Steambird]], then.
:{{A|vo dyjeq003 8 chevreuse 36.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' ...Actually, there's still something else I need your help with.
:;(Quest ends)
{{Dialogue End}}

==Dialogue==
{{Quest Description|Your adventure has come to an end for now. You and Paimon decide to pay the Statue of the Omnipresent God a visit...}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Approach Thoma, Kujou Kamaji, and Ippei at the Statue of the Omnipresent God)
:{{A|vo sglq001 1 thoma 01.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' If the [[Tenryou Commission]] won't assist in dealing with the thunderstorm, the consequences could be catastrophic.
:{{A|vo sglq001 1 kujoukamaji 01.ogg}} '''Kujou Kamaji:''' It's not that we're unwilling to do our part. We just don't have any spare hands right now. I hope you can understand.
:{{A|vo sglq001 1 ippei 01.ogg}} '''[[Ippei]]:''' Exactly. So let's keep the discussion going, and see if we can find a solution.
:{{A|vo sglq001 1 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hey, Thoma! What's going on?
:{{A|vo sglq001 1 thoma 02.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' Ah, hello you two. We were just talking about what an impact you've made in Inazuma.
:{{DIcon}} What a coincidence.
:{{DIcon}} Are you mocking me?
:{{A|vo sglq001 1 kujoukamaji 02.ogg}} '''Kujou Kamaji:''' Greetings. Thank you both again for delivering Miss [[Hiiragi Chisato|Hiiragi]]'s letter that time.
:{{A|vo sglq001 1 ippei 02.ogg}} '''Ippei:''' Ah, so they're friends of yours. I'm Master Kamaji's servant. Call me Ippei!
:{{DIcon}} Sounds like you're having some trouble?
:{{A|vo sglq001 1 thoma 03.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' Well, the [[Tri-Commission]]'s work used to consist of gathering information for the [[Ei|Shogun]] and carrying out any duties she assigned.
:{{A|vo sglq001 1 thoma 04.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' But recently, she announced that she wishes to spend some time in solitude and self-reflection. Since she is refusing to receive any visitors, there is no one to tell us what to do.
:{{A|vo sglq001 1 thoma 05.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' We all understand if the Shogun needs some quiet time to gather her thoughts. The only problem is, in the meantime, the thunderstorm out at sea has been getting wilder.
:{{DIcon}} I hear that storm represents the Shogun's will.
:{{A|vo sglq001 1 thoma 06.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' Yup, that's the one, and in all the time it's been there, the storm has never changed in shape or size. But now, it seems to be drawing closer to Inazuma.
:{{A|vo sglq001 1 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What!? So her will's changed and she wants to destroy Inazuma now? Or is this her way of trying to get revenge on us?
:{{DIcon}} That would be a little childish.
::{{A|vo sglq001 1 paimon 03a.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, yeah, you're right. If she really wanted to get revenge on us, she could just strike us with lightning right here...
::{{A|vo sglq001 1 paimon 03a 1.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' ...Which would also be pretty scary!
:{{DIcon}} Are you really scared of her?
::{{A|vo sglq001 1 paimon 03b.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Nuh-uh, she lost to us. Paimon's not scared, why would Paimon be scared!
::{{A|vo sglq001 1 paimon 03b 1.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Paimon's just, y'know, a little... concerned that she might be angry. Yeah, that's all, just a little concerned.
:{{A|vo sglq001 1 thoma 07.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' Haha, I don't think you need worry about that. The reason we're concerned is that we've never known the Almighty Shogun's will to falter before.
:{{A|vo sglq001 1 kujoukamaji 03.ogg}} '''Kujou Kamaji:''' Considering [[Morax|Liyue's god]] left not too long ago, it's hard not to take it as a bad sign.
:{{A|vo sglq001 1 kujoukamaji 04.ogg}} '''Kujou Kamaji:''' A lot of people now believe that the thunderstorm is getting wilder because the Almighty Shogun is having health problems. The fact that she won't see anyone right now makes us concerned that things are only going to get worse.
:{{DIcon}} That seems like a valid concern.
:{{DIcon}} There must be a reason for the change in the storm.
:{{A|vo sglq001 1 thoma 08.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' Right. So, before rumors start spreading, Miss [[Kamisato Ayaka|Kamisato]] got me to come here and discuss countermeasures with the Tenryou Commission. We need to make sure we're prepared to deal with the chaos if and when it arrives.
:{{A|vo sglq001 1 kujoukamaji 05.ogg}} '''Kujou Kamaji:''' Unfortunately, the reality is that the Tenryou Commission is facing huge internal instability at the moment. The [[Kujou Clan]] has lost control over the other clans.
:{{A|vo sglq001 1 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh? Why is that?
:{{A|vo sglq001 1 kujoukamaji 06.ogg}} '''Kujou Kamaji:''' The Kujou Clan is still awaiting the Shogun's trial for colluding with the [[Fatui]] and nearly destroying the whole of Inazuma.
:{{A|vo sglq001 1 kujoukamaji 07.ogg}} '''Kujou Kamaji:''' Everyone knows that a change of Commissioner is inevitable. It's just a matter of time before the Almighty Shogun hands down her decree.
:{{A|vo sglq001 1 thoma 09.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' To put it simply, no one will take orders from the Kujou Clan anymore, but there's still work that has to be done.
:{{A|vo sglq001 1 ippei 03.ogg}} '''Ippei:''' If Mr. Takayuki was in better health, there might be a way through. But now...
:{{A|vo sglq001 1 kujoukamaji 08.ogg}} '''Kujou Kamaji:''' My lack of ability is to blame. I failed to uncover the truth in time, and I failed to stop my father. And now, as acting head of the clan, I'm failing to quell the unrest.
:{{A|vo sglq001 1 ippei 04.ogg}} '''Ippei:''' Don't blame yourself, Master. You have to at least keep your chin up until your older brother returns. The Kujou Clan can't cope with any more instability in its current state.
:{{A|vo sglq001 1 kujoukamaji 09.ogg}} '''Kujou Kamaji:''' Yes, you're right. Masahito has enough on his plate at the moment. I mustn't cause any more issues for him.
:{{A|vo sglq001 1 kujoukamaji 10.ogg}} '''Kujou Kamaji:''' Okay. Thoma, let's revisit this discussion in a few days. Right now, I need to go visit [[Takatsukasa Susumu]], head of the [[Takatsukasa Clan]]. He is the only one capable of taking charge of the situation now.
:{{A|vo sglq001 1 thoma 10.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' Hmmm...I suppose. Okay, no problem. A speedy resolution to the Tenryou Commission's internal issues is in our best interests as well.
:{{A|vo sglq001 1 ippei 05.ogg}} '''Ippei:''' I'll come with you, Master!
:{{A|vo sglq001 1 kujoukamaji 11.ogg}} '''Kujou Kamaji:''' No need. I'll handle this by myself.
:{{A|vo sglq001 1 ippei 06.ogg}} '''Ippei:''' Oh okay... take care, then. Come back soon!
:{{A|vo sglq001 1 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' If you think about it, both the thunderstorm situation and the issue with the Tenryou Commission have been caused by the Shogun's decision to take some time off, right?
:{{A|vo sglq001 1 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' If things carry on like this, people will start to panic...
:{{DIcon}} Maybe we could invite her out for a while?
:{{A|vo sglq001 1 ippei 07.ogg}} '''Ippei:''' Huh? You can actually do that!?
:{{A|vo sglq001 1 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Don't know for sure, but we may as well try. Whether she takes us up on the offer or not will depend on what mood she's in...
:{{A|vo sglq001 1 thoma 11.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' Sounds like you guys know what to do. Shall I leave it up to you, then?
:{{A|vo sglq001 1 thoma 12.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' Everyone's worrying about the Shogun's condition, but if people got to see her in person, it would put their fears to rest.
:{{DIcon}} I'll try.
:{{A|vo sglq001 1 thoma 13.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' Thank you very much, {{Traveler}}. I owe you one, again.
:{{A|vo sglq001 1 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' The way Paimon sees it, there's only one person who might have the chance to see the Shogun while she's isolating. Right?
:{{A|vo sglq001 1 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Let's take a trip to the Grand Narukami Shrine!

;(Talk to Thoma or Ippei again)
:{{A|vo dialog sglq001 thoma 01.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' Your master shouldn't blame himself so much. Anyone else in his position would find it just as difficult to deal with.
:{{A|vo dialog sglq001 ippei 01.ogg}} '''Ippei:''' Exactly. He puts far too much pressure on himself...
:{{A|vo dialog sglq001 ippei 02.ogg}} '''Ippei:''' *sigh*... The Kujou Clan's future isn't looking bright.

----
{{Quest Description|update|You hear about the internal and external threats Inazuma faces from Thoma and Kujou Kamaji, and about how these threats are being caused by the Raiden Shogun's refusal to leave her quarters. Looks like the best way to solve this problem is to ask her to come out.}}
;(Talk to [[Inagi Hotomi]] while looking for Yae Miko at the Grand Narukami Shrine)
:{{A|vo dialog sglq001 inagihotomi 01.ogg}} '''Inagi Hotomi:''' Are you here to see Lady Yae?
:{{A|vo dialog sglq001 inagihotomi 02.ogg}} '''Inagi Hotomi:''' She was inside a moment ago, but her movements are always a source of mystery — you never know when she might disappear...
:{{A|vo dialog sglq001 inagihotomi 03.ogg}} '''Inagi Hotomi:''' Anyway, you may head in and see if she's there.

;(Talk to Yae Miko)
:{{A|vo sglq001 2 yaemiko 01.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' I wasn't expecting to receive VIP shrine visitors during down time. Hehe, so I suppose you're here just to visit me?
:{{DIcon}} Yes, I was.
::{{A|vo sglq001 2 yaemiko 02a.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' What a smooth talker... though, your eyes do not lie as convincingly as your tongue. You came because you need my help, didn't you?
::{{A|vo sglq001 2 yaemiko 02a 1.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' Still, your answer has put me in a good mood.
:{{DIcon}} Actually, I wanted to ask you about something.
::{{A|vo sglq001 2 yaemiko 02b.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' Oh, how cold. I saved your skin, didn't I? Surely you could at least humor me by engaging in some small talk first?
::{{A|vo sglq001 2 yaemiko 02b 1.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' Then again, I suppose your frankness is part of your charm.
:{{A|vo sglq001 2 yaemiko 03.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' So, tell me. What is the matter?
:{{A|vo sglq001 2 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' We heard that the Shogun decided to take a break, and since then the thunderstorm around Inazuma has gotten wilder.
:{{A|vo sglq001 2 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Rumor has it that the thunderstorm is affected by the Shogun's will. So people are worrying that something might be wrong with her.
:{{DIcon}} The Tenryou Commission also needs her attention.
:{{A|vo sglq001 2 yaemiko 04.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' *sigh*...
:{{A|vo sglq001 2 yaemiko 05.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' Alright. There's little purpose in keeping anything hidden from you, anyway.
:{{A|vo sglq001 2 yaemiko 06.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' Since the battle, the Shogun has been greatly troubled and her temperament has changed drastically.
:{{A|vo sglq001 2 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What!?
:{{DIcon}} Her temperament has changed?
:{{DIcon}} That's hard to believe...
:{{A|vo sglq001 2 yaemiko 07.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' Her power was already on the decline. Then you dealt her that fateful strike.
:{{A|vo sglq001 2 yaemiko 08.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' The defeat was a heavy blow to her. It also didn't help that I forgot to bring her some [[Tricolor Dango]] and light novels when I went to see her...
:{{A|vo sglq001 2 yaemiko 09.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' Oh, the poor thing. Without desserts and books to console herself with, she was so angry she quite simply lost it. Crying and ranting and raving... Oh, I could hardly bear to see her that way...
:{{A|vo sglq001 2 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You expect us to believe that a god would throw a temper tantrum over something like that!?
:{{DIcon}} I don't believe you.
:{{DIcon}} It's not beyond the realm of possibility.
:{{A|vo sglq001 2 yaemiko 10.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' Hehe. Before you get too indignant, consider the fact that your concerns sound every bit as nonsensical to me as that blatant lie did to you.
:{{A|vo sglq001 2 yaemiko 11.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' Ei seeks eternity. To her, mortal lives come and go in the blink of an eye. Of what consequence to her are mortal concerns for her wellbeing?
:{{A|vo sglq001 2 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You're saying she's fine, right?
:{{A|vo sglq001 2 yaemiko 12.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' I don't know the details. She said she wanted to rest, and I have nothing pressing that requires her attention. So there is no reason to disturb her.
:{{A|vo sglq001 2 yaemiko 13.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' I have heard about the thunderstorm, though. As to the cause, it is not inconceivable that, as you suggest, her will has wavered somewhat.
:{{DIcon}} All the more reason to check on her.
:{{DIcon}} Maybe she's gone stir-crazy.
:{{A|vo sglq001 2 yaemiko 14.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' I am the only one in all of Inazuma who can visit her while she is resting.
:{{A|vo sglq001 2 yaemiko 15.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' But tell me, why should this concern me? Why should I do this for you, when I already have everything one could ever want, and have seen everything one could ever wish to see?
:{{DIcon}} Do it for the people of Inazuma.
:{{DIcon}} Do it for Ei.
:{{A|vo sglq001 2 yaemiko 16.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' Haha. I like that answer.
:{{A|vo sglq001 2 yaemiko 17.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' Here is the [[Pass Permit]]. Show it to the [[Okuzumeshuu]] at the gate, and he will let you in.
:{{A|vo sglq001 2 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Thanks, Miko!
:{{A|vo sglq001 2 yaemiko 18.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' My question was in jest, but since you answered it in earnest, please stay true to your word.
:{{A|vo sglq001 2 yaemiko 19.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' Oh, and don't forget to return the Pass Permit to me after you have finished with it.
:;(Obtain [[Pass Permit]])

:{{DIcon}} About the Wishlists...
::{{A|vo lnlq002 24 cesar 01a 1.ogg}} '''Cesar's Diary:''' At one of my shows a few days ago, a child asked me how I pulled candy out of my hat.
::{{A|vo lnlq002 24 cesar 01a 2.ogg}} '''Cesar's Diary:''' As a joke, I told the kid that the hat has a built-in wish-granting machine... Next thing I know, today a whole bunch of kids were pestering me to pull all sorts of things out of the hat...
::{{A|vo lnlq002 24 cesar 01a 3.ogg}} '''Cesar's Diary:''' So I told them another white lie: "The machine needs time to power up, but in the meantime, you can write your wishes down." Well, they took me up on that offer enthusiastically... As I write this, I've only just got back from running around all over town, buying the things they wanted. Boy, are my legs sore...
::{{A|vo lnlq002 24 cesar 01a 4.ogg}} '''Cesar's Diary:''' I wound up saving very little this month, but that's not a major issue. I now have a bigger problem: How am I going to hide all these things inside my hat...?
:;(Return to selection)
:{{DIcon}} About the Children Studying Magic...
::{{A|vo lnlq002 24 cesar 01b 1.ogg}} '''Cesar's Diary:''' Two children came to talk to me after today's show. I don't know why they were out on their own — they looked much too young to be unsupervised. I do hope they got home safely.
::{{A|vo lnlq002 24 cesar 01b 2.ogg}} '''Cesar's Diary:''' Anyway, they said that they wanted me to teach them how to do magic. It's not uncommon for children to ask this, of course, but I've never seen any of them as serious about it as these two.
::{{A|vo lnlq002 24 cesar 01b 3.ogg}} '''Cesar's Diary:''' I told them that learning magic is very hard work, but that didn't faze them at all — it's like they already knew. They seemed so committed... I couldn't turn them down.
:;(Return to selection)
:{{DIcon}} About Lorenzo's Issues...
::{{A|vo lnlq002 24 cesar 01c 1.ogg}} '''Cesar's Diary:''' It seems like something's bothering Lorenzo lately, but he won't open up to me about it.
::{{A|vo lnlq002 24 cesar 01c 2.ogg}} '''Cesar's Diary:''' Surely, he's not upset that I agreed to teach those two children? I'll have to talk him around...
::{{A|vo lnlq002 24 cesar 01c 3.ogg}} '''Cesar's Diary:''' I have a good feeling about those kids. They're naturally talented, and it seems like they're not new to the world of magic.
::{{A|vo lnlq002 24 cesar 01c 4.ogg}} '''Cesar's Diary:''' They have all sorts of fantastic ideas. All I'm really doing is helping them develop a more professional-standard training plan.
::{{A|vo lnlq002 24 cesar 01c 5.ogg}} '''Cesar's Diary:''' They wanted to call me "Master," but I told them they absolutely mustn't. Any magician worth their salt could've taught them what I have... They're the geniuses here. Compared to them, I don't deserve to be called any sort of "master."
::{{A|vo lnlq002 24 cesar 01c 6.ogg}} '''Cesar's Diary:''' With time, I have no doubt that they could become far greater magicians than I. My only concern is why they're so mature for their age... I fear they've had to grow up too fast. I don't dare to imagine what they must have been through.
::{{A|vo lnlq002 24 cesar 01c 7.ogg}} '''Cesar's Diary:''' Jemma thinks so too. She doesn't like being around them — says that their eyes are "too piercing." They don't bother me, but then again, I've never been the sharpest tool in the shed.
:;(Return to selection)
:{{DIcon}} About the Farewell...
::{{A|vo lnlq002 24 cesar 01d 1.ogg}} '''Cesar's Diary:''' It's nearly time for me to go on tour. I asked the two kids if they'd like to come with me, but they shook their heads.
::{{A|vo lnlq002 24 cesar 01d 2.ogg}} '''Cesar's Diary:''' I once overheard them talking about their "Father" and their "mission"... Sounds like their parents have other plans for them. I guess we'll be parting ways soon.
::{{A|vo lnlq002 24 cesar 01d 3.ogg}} '''Cesar's Diary:''' It's only been ten days since I first met them, but I think that I've gotten a feel for their personalities now.
::{{A|vo lnlq002 24 cesar 01d 4.ogg}} '''Cesar's Diary:''' They're very tough, but also very cautious — and they trust no one but each other. This, I fear, is not a good habit to have.
::{{A|vo lnlq002 24 cesar 01d 5.ogg}} '''Cesar's Diary:''' They hide things from me, too. For example, when I asked them where they live and why they wanted to learn magic, they lied.
::{{A|vo lnlq002 24 cesar 01d 6.ogg}} '''Cesar's Diary:''' That's the thing about children — whenever they're trying to cover something up, it always shows somehow...
::{{A|vo lnlq002 24 cesar 01d 7.ogg}} '''Cesar's Diary:''' I can sense that their lives have been hard — possibly even dangerous, too. They're not like other children... It's a shame that I can't do more to help them.
::{{A|vo lnlq002 24 cesar 01d 8.ogg}} '''Cesar's Diary:''' After thinking things over, I decided to tell them a bit about how I see the world: It's full of lies and falsehoods, and that is why we must find our own truth.
::{{A|vo lnlq002 24 cesar 01d 9.ogg}} '''Cesar's Diary:''' P.S. I hope they won't find my nagging annoying. Children are so opinionated nowadays. Will it do them more harm than good for someone they've only known ten days to lecture them like that?
::{{A|vo lnlq002 24 cesar 01d 10.ogg}} '''Cesar's Diary:''' P.P.S. Maybe I'm overthinking this. Children aren't interested in grand philosophies — it probably just went in one ear and out the other. I bet they've already forgotten every word I said.
::{{A|vo lnlq002 24 cesar 01d 11.ogg}} '''Cesar's Diary:''' Oh, Cesar, Cesar... Just mind your own business next time.
:;(Return to selection)

;(After selecting all the options)
:{{DIcon}} Stop Reading
::{{A|vo lnlq002 24 paimon 02e 1.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Two magic geniuses with a "Father" and a mission, huh...
::{{A|vo lnlq002 24 paimon 02e 2.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Sounds a lot like he was writing about Lyney and Lynette, don't you think?

;(Approach Lyney)
:{{A|vo lnlq002 25 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Lyney—
:{{A|vo lnlq002 25 lyney 01.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Shh, hold that thought... As I expected, there's a lot of fishy things going on in this place.
:{{A|vo lnlq002 25 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Fishy? Uh-oh, what have you found?
:{{A|vo lnlq002 25 lyney 02.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' All in good time. Before we go over our new leads, I wanna tell you how a "high-altitude escape" is performed.
:{{A|vo lnlq002 25 lyney 03.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' First, the magician slots themselves into a magic box in full view of the audience. The box is then suspended high in the air, and a short while later, the base automatically opens.
:{{A|vo lnlq002 25 lyney 04.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' At this point, a dummy will fall out of the box, but it looks real enough to grab the audience's attention, and they start wailing and screaming...
:{{A|vo lnlq002 25 lyney 05.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Meanwhile, the real magician — who has by now blended into the crowd — waits for a good moment to make their appearance and put on a hysterical performance:
:{{A|vo lnlq002 25 lyney 06.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' "Oh no! Is that me!? Did I just fall to my death!?"
:{{A|vo lnlq002 25 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Very vivid description, Paimon can really picture it... and then what?
:{{A|vo lnlq002 25 lyney 07.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' The audience's gaze then turns to the magician, and by the time they realize what's happened, the dummy has vanished — as if everything that just happened was some sort of shared illusion.
:{{A|vo lnlq002 25 lyney 08.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Of course, that's just how I think the process should work, theoretically speaking.
:{{DIcon}} Theoretically speaking? What do you mean?
:{{A|vo lnlq002 25 lyney 09.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' The inventor of this trick never performed it successfully. When the box opened... Cesar was the one who fell out, and not the dummy.
:{{A|vo lnlq002 25 lyney 10.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' He fell right to the ground from the highest point of the opera house... No one could hope to survive that fall — not without a Vision, at least.
:{{A|vo lnlq002 25 lyney 11.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' And no one else has ever attempted this trick since. My understanding of how it works is just based on what I could gather from his notes and the relevant gadgets here in his workshop.
:{{A|vo lnlq002 25 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So Cesar's famous high-altitude escape has never been done, huh?
:{{A|vo lnlq002 25 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Paimon was about to say how cool it would be to see it in person. But if it's that dangerous, it's probably for the best that no one else tries to do it.
:{{A|vo lnlq002 25 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wait a second, so if a dummy's supposed to drop out of the box, then where does the real magician go? How does he get out?
:{{A|vo lnlq002 25 lyney 12.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Glad you asked — that brings us to the secret of said box.
:{{A|vo lnlq002 25 lyney 13.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' This box right here is the one that Cesar constructed himself to use in the performance, and it's not as simple as it looks. Inside, there's a device that only the magician himself would know about.
:{{A|vo lnlq002 25 lyney 14.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Once the magician's inside, and the box is lifted up into the air, the audience's view of the box is fixed at a certain angle.
:{{A|vo lnlq002 25 lyney 15.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' From where they're standing, they have a clear view of the front, sides, and bottom, but the back and the top are now no longer visible.
:{{A|vo lnlq002 25 lyney 16.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' At this point, the magician presses a button inside the box, opening a secret door out of view.
:{{A|vo lnlq002 25 lyney 17.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' He then escapes through this trap door onto the opera house roof, waits for the dummy to fall and distract the audience, and quietly returns to ground level.
:{{A|vo lnlq002 25 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' That's way simpler than Paimon imagined. Even Paimon could probably do it!
:{{A|vo lnlq002 25 lyney 18.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Haha, well, there's a little more to it than that, of course. The hardest part of this trick is controlling the audience's mood and reactions. That takes an exceptional degree of showmanship.
:{{A|vo lnlq002 25 lyney 19.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' There's the falling dummy, the miraculous reappearance, the pompous performing... Maybe the magician would even have themselves tied up before it begins to strengthen the impression that there's no escape.
:{{A|vo lnlq002 25 lyney 20.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Many days and nights of careful research and painstaking practice would have gone into this, all culminating in a performance just a few minutes long — but one that still manages to transform the shock and grief of a tragic accident to the joy and laughter of a mesmerizing magic trick.
:{{A|vo lnlq002 25 lyney 21.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Cesar was a highly accomplished magician... But unfortunately, even he didn't manage to pull it off.
:{{A|vo lnlq002 25 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So... How did it go so wrong? You said you found some fishy stuff here — have you figured out what really happened?
:{{A|vo lnlq002 25 lyney 22.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' ...I can make a pretty good guess.
:{{A|vo lnlq002 25 lyney 23.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' I looked into the case files. The magic box Cesar was using at the time of his death had the secret button I mentioned positioned on the right-hand side. And sure enough, he always used his right hand as his dominant hand in public.
:{{A|vo lnlq002 25 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Okay... Nothing suspicious there...
:{{A|vo lnlq002 25 lyney 24.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' But here's the strange thing: Most of the devices in this workshop have the mechanism on the left-hand side, including this box right here. Which leads me to believe that Cesar was, in fact, left-handed.
:{{DIcon}} I'm not sure where you're going with this.
:{{DIcon}} Why would Cesar pretend to be right-handed?
:{{A|vo lnlq002 25 lyney 25.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Because a magician can't afford to have their most basic habits stand out too much. People naturally focus their attention on the most important details of the task or situation at hand.
:{{A|vo lnlq002 25 lyney 26.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' But a magician needs to be able to redirect an audience's attention at will, so as to avoid arousing their suspicion.
:{{A|vo lnlq002 25 lyney 27.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' The essence of magic is getting people to believe a lie. If even the truth raises eyebrows, the falsehoods become all the more difficult to mask.
:{{A|vo lnlq002 25 lyney 28.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' And so, Cesar trained himself to use his right hand to align with his audience's expectations... Great magic always requires sacrifices.
:{{A|vo lnlq002 25 lyney 29.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' But in his most stressful and nerve-wracking moments, and when no one was watching, reflex would kick in and he'd use his left hand. That's why he set his gadgets with the mechanism on his left.
:{{DIcon}} Maybe someone exploited that fact against him?
:{{A|vo lnlq002 25 lyney 30.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Exactly. I think that's likely what happened.
:{{A|vo lnlq002 25 lyney 31.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Cesar would have been under a lot of time pressure during the escape. He'd have had mere seconds to open the hidden compartment, retrieve the dummy, then open the secret door and make a swift escape.
:{{A|vo lnlq002 25 lyney 32.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' But I'm sure he was confident. He would have rehearsed countless times, to the point where it was second nature. He'd barely need to think about what he was doing, because muscle memory would guide him through.
:{{A|vo lnlq002 25 lyney 33.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' So he opened the compartment, took out the dummy, checked everything was in order, and then went to leave. With his left hand, he reached for the button, and suddenly his heart skipped a beat — it wasn't there.
:{{A|vo lnlq002 25 lyney 34.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Much like when you reach for your keys but find your pocket empty, his mind needed a moment to process what was going on.
:{{A|vo lnlq002 25 lyney 35.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Instinctively, his left hand would keep feeling around for the missing button, maybe for another second or two... until the bottom of the box gave way.
:{{A|vo lnlq002 25 lyney 36.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' With the stakes being as high as they were, just a two-second delay cost him everything. The authorities would find nothing suspicious, and conclude that his death was due to his own error.
:{{A|vo lnlq002 25 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' When in reality, someone switched the boxes... and they did it to murder him.
:{{A|vo lnlq002 25 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' But how would they be able to make the switch without being noticed? That would be difficult to pull off, no?
:{{A|vo lnlq002 25 lyney 37.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' It would have to have been someone who knew that he was left-handed, and who could move his props around without arousing suspicion. Someone who was always by his side.
:{{A|vo lnlq002 25 lyney 38.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Isn't that right... Lorenzo?
:{{A|vo lnlq002 25 lorenzo 01.ogg}} '''Lorenzo:''' You just couldn't let sleeping dogs lie, could you?
:{{A|vo lnlq002 25 lorenzo 02.ogg}} '''Lorenzo:''' There's not a lot of people who'd go to all this trouble for some magician who died ten years ago. I didn't want to have to do this, you know... Silencing you the hard way just creates more problems for me to deal with.
:{{A|vo lnlq002 25 lorenzo 03.ogg}} '''Lorenzo:''' But I gave you your chance. I hoped you'd do what's good for you and back off, like the lady, but... you disappoint me.
:{{A|vo lnlq002 25 paimon 12.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You mean Jemma? So YOU are the one who's been threatening her!
:{{A|vo lnlq002 25 lorenzo 04.ogg}} '''Lorenzo:''' Yes, although however stubborn she might be, she was never much of a liability. But you people... You never even knew him, but for some reason you just wouldn't drop it...
:{{A|vo lnlq002 25 lorenzo 05.ogg}} '''Lorenzo:''' Which is why you can't leave this place alive. Take them out. And make it quick.
:{{A|vo lnlq002 25 paimon 13.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hmph, do your worst!!!

;(After defeating enemies)
:;(Lyney throws a card at the fleeing Lorenzo)
:{{A|vo lnlq002 26 lorenzo 01.ogg}} '''Lorenzo:''' *cough* ...Ugh, you kids are tougher than you look...
:{{A|vo lnlq002 26 lyney 01.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Had enough yet, Lorenzo? Your cronies can't help you now.
:{{A|vo lnlq002 26 lyney 02.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' I think it's high time you started talking, and what I'd really like to know is... Why did you murder Cesar?
:{{A|vo lnlq002 26 lorenzo 02.ogg}} '''Lorenzo:''' Ugh, if I had a Mora for every time you've said that man's name... Of course you idolize Cesar, everyone else did. But I was the real genius magician! Me!
:{{A|vo lnlq002 26 lorenzo 03.ogg}} '''Lorenzo:''' He was just an amateur who did cheap tricks for gullible children. I was the one who made magic into the fine art it is today! The aristocrats doffed their hats to ME!
:{{A|vo lnlq002 26 lyney 03.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' So it was jealousy...
:{{A|vo lnlq002 26 lorenzo 04.ogg}} '''Lorenzo:''' ...
:{{A|vo lnlq002 26 lorenzo 05.ogg}} '''Lorenzo:''' Jealousy? Hatred, more like. I hated Cesar. All he cared about was his magic — he lived and breathed it.
:{{A|vo lnlq002 26 lorenzo 06.ogg}} '''Lorenzo:''' He poured everything into his street performances and his stupid tours like it was just a hobby to him, never bothering to think about Mora. What sort of fool devotes their life to the art of deception and never has a Mora to show for it?
:{{A|vo lnlq002 26 lorenzo 07.ogg}} '''Lorenzo:''' But the people loved him, didn't they? Oh, how they looked up to him! No one gave me a second look. All I ever heard was "Oh, your master's amazing, isn't he!"
:{{A|vo lnlq002 26 lorenzo 08.ogg}} '''Lorenzo:''' Amazing? Yeah, so amazing that he was completely broke. Every other apprentice was living it up at their master's expense, but no, not me! I put in all the work, mastered all the skills, and it brought me nothing more than the life I already had.
:{{DIcon}} So you killed him?
:{{DIcon}} Why didn't you just leave?
:{{A|vo lnlq002 26 lorenzo 09.ogg}} '''Lorenzo:''' He forbade me from using magic to trick people out of their Mora. There was nothing he hated more than that.
:{{A|vo lnlq002 26 lorenzo 10.ogg}} '''Lorenzo:''' And with his reputation in Fontaine, it was too risky for me to go it alone. As long as he was alive, if I dabbled in my own brand of money-making magic, he would expose me, and it would destroy me.
:{{A|vo lnlq002 26 lorenzo 11.ogg}} '''Lorenzo:''' I had to kill him... There was no other way. He had to go.
:{{A|vo lnlq002 26 lyney 04.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' ...
:{{A|vo lnlq002 26 lyney 05.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' And this was your only motive?
:{{A|vo lnlq002 26 lorenzo 12.ogg}} '''Lorenzo:''' It was reason enough. What other motive would I need?
:{{A|vo lnlq002 26 lyney 06.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Well, I was under the impression that there might have been other factors at play. For instance... Maybe you were in love with Jemma, but she was engaged to Cesar.
:{{A|vo lnlq002 26 lorenzo 13.ogg}} '''Lorenzo:''' In love with Jemma? D—Don't be ridiculous...
:{{A|vo lnlq002 26 lyney 07.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Guess I was wrong about that, then. Next question: Are you The Phantom Weasel?
:{{A|vo lnlq002 26 lorenzo 14.ogg}} '''Lorenzo:''' ...I am.
:{{A|vo lnlq002 26 lorenzo 15.ogg}} '''Lorenzo:''' Cesar was so strict with me. He insisted that his way was the right way. That the sole purpose of magic was to bring joy to the world.
:{{A|vo lnlq002 26 lorenzo 16.ogg}} '''Lorenzo:''' I never bought into any of that. I was more interested in the practical value of magic... Sure enough, it helped me fill my pockets with all kinds of valuable treasures.
:{{DIcon}} But I heard that The Phantom Weasel stole from the rich and poor alike.
:{{A|vo lnlq002 26 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, yeah. Charlotte told us that The Weasel would steal whatever people valued, no matter how much it was worth.
:{{A|vo lnlq002 26 lorenzo 17.ogg}} '''Lorenzo:''' That's just how it looked from the outside. What would any thief want with second-rate loot? I've only ever targeted high-value items.
:{{A|vo lnlq002 26 lorenzo 18.ogg}} '''Lorenzo:''' I stole cheap things as a way of practicing my craft. It was other people's overactive imaginations that conjured up the preposterous image they then dubbed the "Phantom Weasel."
:{{A|vo lnlq002 26 lyney 08.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' So that's the story, huh? Well, I hope you're ready to tell it all over again during your trial?
:{{A|vo lnlq002 26 lorenzo 19.ogg}} '''Lorenzo:''' What choice do I have? You're a pack of wolves and you've got me between your jaws. You've seen what's here, and my last-ditch effort to stop it getting out has failed. What else can I do?
:{{A|vo lnlq002 26 lorenzo 20.ogg}} '''Lorenzo:''' So be it. I've enjoyed power and wealth for the last ten years, the likes of which Cesar could never give me. I wouldn't choose for things to end this way, but I regret nothing.
:{{A|vo lnlq002 26 lyney 09.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Very well. In that case, I'll contact the Gardes.
:{{A|vo lnlq002 26 lyney 10.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' {{Traveler}}, Paimon, keep an eye on Lorenzo for me. I'll meet you just outside the workshop when I'm back.

;(Talk to Lorenzo, optional)
:{{A|vo dialog lnlq002 lorenzo 01.ogg}} '''Lorenzo:''' ...At least I can finally stop looking over my shoulder now.

;(After exiting Magic Workshop)
:{{A|vo lnlq002 27 burnett 01.ogg}} '''Bruno:''' Lyney has told me the whole story.
:{{A|vo lnlq002 27 burnett 02.ogg}} '''Bruno:''' Lorenzo, do you confess to the murder of Cesar, and to framing him for the Phantom Weasel's crimes?
:{{A|vo lnlq002 27 lorenzo 01.ogg}} '''Lorenzo:''' ...
:;(Lorenzo nods)
:{{A|vo lnlq002 27 lowrey 01.ogg}} '''Lori:''' Hmph. Look who's finally developed a conscience.
:{{A|vo lnlq002 27 lowrey 02.ogg}} '''Lori:''' What kind of disciple murders their own master? I hope it was worth it, because there'll be hell to pay!
:{{A|vo lnlq002 27 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Phew. Looks like it's all over. What should we do next, Lyney? Should we start preparing for your show?
:{{A|vo lnlq002 27 lyney 01.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Let me think...
:{{A|vo lnlq002 27 lyney 02.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Let's rendezvous with Lynette and Jemma first. With Lorenzo in custody, Jemma will no longer have to fear for her safety.
:{{A|vo lnlq002 27 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Good point! We should go tell Jemma the good news right away. It'll give her some peace of mind for sure!
{{Dialogue End}}
{{Quest Description|update|Lorenzo has confessed to the murder of Cesar and has been arrested as the Phantom Weasel. Due punishment awaits him. Bring this wonderful news to Lynette and Jemma!}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Approach Lynette)
:{{A|vo lnlq002 28 lynette 01.ogg}} '''Lynette:''' ...Ah. You're back.
:{{A|vo lnlq002 28 lynette 02.ogg}} '''Lynette:''' You were so quick. I've only just finished my third dessert.
:{{A|vo lnlq002 28 lyney 01.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Your third!? Lynette, come on, we've talked about this, everything in moderation... You're not gonna have any room left for dinner now.
:{{A|vo lnlq002 28 lynette 03.ogg}} '''Lynette:''' That's fine. I'll shift to Exercise Mode and jog off the excess sugar.
:{{A|vo lnlq002 28 lyney 02.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' That's besides the point... *sigh* Well, it's done now. But try to eat a more balanced diet in the future.
:{{A|vo lnlq002 28 lynette 04.ogg}} '''Lynette:''' Point taken.
:{{A|vo lnlq002 28 gemma 01.ogg}} '''Jemma:''' Did... everything go okay?
:{{A|vo lnlq002 28 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Of course. Lorenzo was no match for us! The Gardes are taking him into custody as we speak.
:{{A|vo lnlq002 28 gemma 02.ogg}} '''Jemma:''' Gosh. That's amazing... I'm sorry, I still didn't know if I could trust you, but now it seems I can.
:{{A|vo lnlq002 28 gemma 03.ogg}} '''Jemma:''' I had my suspicions about Lorenzo, but I... *sob*
:{{A|vo lnlq002 28 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' It's okay, we understand. He did threaten you. Paimon would find it hard to trust strangers in your position too.
:{{A|vo lnlq002 28 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' But you don't need to be scared anymore. Everything's gonna be okay!
:{{A|vo lnlq002 28 gemma 04.ogg}} '''Jemma:''' Sorry... Sorry, my emotions are all over the place right now. I've been waiting for this day to come for so long.
:{{A|vo lnlq002 28 gemma 05.ogg}} '''Jemma:''' I always wanted to report Lorenzo. He took all of Cesar's property, which I found suspicious, but I had people watching me all the time, so I couldn't risk looking into it...
:{{A|vo lnlq002 28 gemma 06.ogg}} '''Jemma:''' I was so afraid... I was scared he'd do something terrible to me, and then no one would be left to visit Cesar's grave... so I never had the courage to speak out.
:{{A|vo lnlq002 28 gemma 07.ogg}} '''Jemma:''' Thank you all, truly. Thank you so much...
:{{Black Screen|At Lyney's suggestion, everyone goes to the cemetery to announce Lorenzo's arrest and hold a memorial for Cesar}}
:{{A|vo lnlq002 29 baltasar 01.ogg}} '''Baltasar:''' Thank you all for clearing Cesar's name.
:{{A|vo lnlq002 29 baltasar 02.ogg}} '''Baltasar:''' I never would have guessed that Lorenzo was the real Phantom Weasel... He never showed any signs that there were problems between him and Cesar in public. From the outside, it looked like they got along great.
:{{A|vo lnlq002 29 baltasar 03.ogg}} '''Baltasar:''' Ugh, to think that lowlife's been living life to the fullest all this time while Cesar's name was getting dragged through the mud. It's a travesty...
:{{A|vo lnlq002 29 baltasar 04.ogg}} '''Baltasar:''' At least his soul can finally rest in peace now, thanks to your efforts.
:{{A|vo lnlq002 29 gemma 01.ogg}} '''Jemma:''' ...
:{{A|vo lnlq002 29 gemma 02.ogg}} '''Jemma:''' If... If only I'd realized before it was too late...
:{{A|vo lnlq002 29 gracia 01.ogg}} '''Gracia:''' Don't blame yourself, Jemma. This isn't your fault.
:{{A|vo lnlq002 29 dolora 01.ogg}} '''Dolora:''' Yeah. You still have the rest of your life to live. Cesar wouldn't want to see you spend it feeling guilty.
:{{A|vo lnlq002 29 lyney 01.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' ...
:{{A|vo lnlq002 29 lynette 01.ogg}} '''Lynette:''' Cheer up, Jemma.
:{{A|vo lnlq002 29 lynette 02.ogg}} '''Lynette:''' My brother's doing a magic show at the opera house tomorrow evening. Would you like to come along? It might raise your spirits.
:{{A|vo lnlq002 29 lynette 03.ogg}} '''Lynette:''' This show will be a special one. We're holding it in Cesar's honor.
:{{A|vo lnlq002 29 gemma 03.ogg}} '''Jemma:''' In Cesar's honor? Really?
:{{A|vo lnlq002 29 gemma 04.ogg}} '''Jemma:''' Thank you. I'll be there.
:{{A|vo lnlq002 29 lyney 02.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Great! We'll see you tomorrow evening. {{Traveler}}, Paimon, don't be late~
:{{A|vo lnlq002 29 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Don't worry, we'll be there. No way are we gonna miss out on a free magic show!

;(Talk to [[Gracia]], optional) 
:{{A|vo dialog lnlq002 gracia 01.ogg}} '''Gracia:''' ...I've spoken many choice words about Cesar over the years.
:{{A|vo dialog lnlq002 gracia 02.ogg}} '''Gracia:''' I'm so ashamed of myself now. He was such a good man...

;(Talk to [[Dolora]], optional) 
:{{A|vo dialog lnlq002 dolora 01.ogg}} '''Dolora:''' I can't believe Lorenzo was intimidating Jemma all this time...
:{{DIcon}} Have you met Lorenzo before?
:{{A|vo dialog lnlq002 dolora 02.ogg}} '''Dolora:''' He comes around here sometimes. Not to clean Cesar's grave, though. He just stands off to the side and watches Jemma from a distance.
:{{A|vo dialog lnlq002 dolora 03.ogg}} '''Dolora:''' She must've known, but she never asked him to leave. I wonder why that is.

;(Talk to [[Baltasar]], optional) 
:{{A|vo dialog lnlq002 baltasar 01.ogg}} '''Baltasar:''' It may take some time, but Cesar's reputation will be restored now that the real culprit has been captured.
:{{A|vo dialog lnlq002 baltasar 02.ogg}} '''Baltasar:''' Looks like Jemma chose a good man after all...

:{{DIcon}} They do give off a sinister energy.

:{{A|vo xlq001 1 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Uh-oh, this is right by the Wangshu Inn, too. The guests are in great danger!

:{{A|vo xlq001 2 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:'''  But the magic he was using seemed even more adeptus-y than Xiao's. Shall we go say hi?

:'''Mercantile Believer:''' ...Adepti arts in action!
:'''Female Believer:''' ...As powerful as ever.

:{{A|vo xlq001 3 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ahem. Hello! Allow us to introduce ourselves, this—
:{{A|vo xlq001 3 starsnatcher 01.ogg}} '''???:''' Please, if you're here to thank me, there's no need. Cleansing the world of evil is the duty of the adepti. Think nothing of it — I certainly don't.

::{{A|vo xlq001 3 starsnatcher 03a.ogg}} '''???:''' One sees. One, too, shall introduce oneself, for it is good manners to comply.
:{{DIcon}} We are following the trail of the adepti.
::{{A|vo xlq001 3 paimon 02b.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' My name's Paimon! And this is my sidekick, {{Traveler}}.
::{{A|vo xlq001 3 starsnatcher 03b.ogg}} '''???:''' Then it is right that our paths coincide. I, too, shall introduce myself, for with good manners to comply.
:{{A|vo xlq001 3 starsnatcher 04.ogg}} '''???:''' Ahem... The one before you is the adeptus, Master of Stars, though one is better known to one's followers as "Starsnatcher."
:{{A|vo xlq001 3 starsnatcher 05.ogg}} '''Starsnatcher:''' One descended from one's mountain abode to cleanse the world of evil, whereupon fate saw fit that our paths should cross. Now... tell me that which you wish for.
:{{A|vo xlq001 3 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Our wishes? Paimon thought that the adepti in Liyue were just really good in battle... You mean you can grant people's wishes, too?
:{{A|vo xlq001 3 starsnatcher 06.ogg}} '''Starsnatcher:''' Hah... There are different levels of adepti... Are not the stars loftier than the mountains, clouds, and moon?
:{{A|vo xlq001 3 starsnatcher 07.ogg}} '''Starsnatcher:''' Yet, it is unbecoming of an adepti to boast of one's powers. One would have you first speak to one's followers, and only then make your verdict.

;(Talk to Starsnatcher again, optional)
:{{A|vo xlq001 3 starsnatcher 08.ogg}} '''Starsnatcher:''' Chat with them as you please. One will not beat one's own drum — the words of others shall ring truer.

;(Talk to the Male Believer, on the left)
:{{A|vo xlq001 4 malefollower 01.ogg}} '''Male Believer:''' Have you seen the Master of Stars in action? His power truly hails from the divine!
:{{A|vo xlq001 4 malefollower 02.ogg}} '''Male Believer:''' I believe that now, there is finally some hope for my ailing father...
:{{DIcon}} Tell me about the Master of Stars.

:{{A|vo xlq001 4 malefollower 05.ogg}} '''Male Believer:''' Once it was boiled and ready, it gave off this really ethereal mist — seemed pretty adeptal to me! Hm... Could have also been because there was [[Mist Flower]] in it though...
:{{A|vo xlq001 4 malefollower 06.ogg}} '''Male Believer:''' Adepti medicine is surely the most potent. My father will recover soon, I just know it...
:{{A|vo xlq001 4 malefollower 07.ogg}} '''Male Believer:''' Sure, you have to make some sacrifices if you seek help from an adeptus like the Master of Stars — I had to give a few antiques as offerings. But my father's life is worth much more than a few old relics, right?

;(Talk to the Mercantile Believer, in the middle)
:{{A|vo xlq001 5 merchantfollower 01.ogg}} '''Mercantile Believer:''' The [[Millelith]] don't really need to do shifts when the Master of Stars is around, do they?

:{{A|vo xlq001 5 merchantfollower 03.ogg}} '''Mercantile Believer:''' Reason being, monsters run a mile as soon as he so much as holds up his talisman. We didn't have the slightest bit of trouble the whole journey.
:{{A|vo xlq001 5 merchantfollower 04.ogg}} '''Mercantile Believer:''' It didn't come cheap, of course... but then, soliciting the services of an adeptus is a monumental affair — just look at the Rite of Descension! So I can accept it, but I doubt that most from outside of Liyue would be willing to...

;(Talk to the Female Believer, on the right)
:{{A|vo xlq001 6 femalefollower 01.ogg}} '''Female Believer:''' Finally, a life full of hope and purpose...
:{{DIcon}} What are your thoughts on the Master of Stars?
:{{A|vo xlq001 6 femalefollower 02.ogg}} '''Female Believer:''' Oh! Are you believers, too?
:{{A|vo xlq001 6 femalefollower 03.ogg}} '''Female Believer:''' After my fiancé upped and left, I cried every day...
:{{A|vo xlq001 6 femalefollower 04.ogg}} '''Female Believer:''' But then I turned to the Master of Stars for help. At his suggestion, I started burning paintings of my fiancé and casting the ashes into the ocean at sunrise...
:{{A|vo xlq001 6 femalefollower 05.ogg}} '''Female Believer:''' I can't explain it... but it really worked! I know in my heart that he will return. This is not some sort of positive thinking trick... I am certain of it.
:{{A|vo xlq001 6 femalefollower 06.ogg}} '''Female Believer:'''  I'm so overjoyed that I gave a portion of my wedding budget to the Master of Stars as an offering. After all, if not for him, I wouldn't be getting my fiancé back, in which case I wouldn't need it anyway...
----
;(Talk to Starsnatcher)
:{{A|vo xlq001 7 starsnatcher 01.ogg}} '''Starsnatcher:''' What do you think? One's adherents may exaggerate a little, but they speak from the heart.
:{{DIcon}} From their imaginations, I'd say...
:{{A|vo xlq001 7 starsnatcher 02.ogg}} '''Starsnatcher:''' Haha, surely you must jest. There was once a senior adeptus, Xue Wuliang, known to the people as "Liangzi." He said this:
:{{A|vo xlq001 7 starsnatcher 03.ogg}} '''Starsnatcher:'''  "All things are connected. That which mortals call 'imagination' is merely the bridge betwixt the spiritual and the material."
:{{A|vo xlq001 7 starsnatcher 04.ogg}} '''Starsnatcher:''' In other words, their wishes are already on the path of transitioning into reality. Does this make things clearer?
:{{A|vo xlq001 7 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ahh... Nope, it makes them way more complicated... But basically, what you're saying is that their wishes can come true, right?
:{{A|vo xlq001 7 starsnatcher 05.ogg}} '''Starsnatcher:''' Indeed. You are perceptive, my diminutive friend.
:{{A|vo xlq001 7 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Okay. Um, so we also have one other question.
:{{A|vo xlq001 7 starsnatcher 06.ogg}} '''Starsnatcher:''' Oh? You need but ask.
:{{DIcon}} Why do you wear a mask?
:{{DIcon}} Go on, take it off, lemme see...
::{{A|vo xlq001 7 paimon 03b.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hey! Isn't that a bit inappropriate?
::{{A|vo xlq001 7 starsnatcher 07b.ogg}} '''Starsnatcher:''' Hm. Indeed, it would be inappropriate for one to remove one's mask.
:{{A|vo xlq001 7 starsnatcher 08.ogg}} '''Starsnatcher:''' One... wanders among mortals, doing good and cleansing evil. One reveals not one's visage to avoid further disturbance to this realm than is necessary.
:{{A|vo xlq001 7 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ah, got it.
:{{A|vo xlq001 7 starsnatcher 09.ogg}} '''Starsnatcher:''' Now then — what are your wishes?
:{{DIcon}} I want to know where my sibling is.
::{{A|vo xlq001 7 starsnatcher 10a.ogg}} '''Starsnatcher:''' Hmm... One senses that a tragic tale lies behind this wish...
:{{DIcon}} I want power rivaling that of the gods.
::{{A|vo xlq001 7 starsnatcher 10b.ogg}} '''Starsnatcher:''' Indeed, a great many obstacles may be overcome given commensurate power. But one cannot but wonder — what grudge have you against the gods?
:{{DIcon}} I'd like to get rich quick!
::{{A|vo xlq001 7 paimon 05c a.ogg}} {{A|vo xlq001 7 paimon 05c b.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Now hold on a second! What about your {{MC|m=sister|f=brother}}!?
::{{A|vo xlq001 7 starsnatcher 10c.ogg}} '''Starsnatcher:''' This is a common mortal sentiment. That you hail not from Liyue is manifest in your appearance, but one senses their materialistic influence upon you.
:{{A|vo xlq001 7 starsnatcher 11.ogg}} '''Starsnatcher:''' So be it. This wish is not beyond one's power to grant...
:{{A|vo xlq001 7 starsnatcher 12.ogg}} '''Starsnatcher:''' But first, one must see some proof of your... faith.
:{{A|vo xlq001 7 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' ...What's that supposed to mean?
:{{A|vo xlq001 7 starsnatcher 13.ogg}} '''Starsnatcher:''' The way of the adepti cannot be grasped from words alone. One must seek... the profound truths that lie beyond them... Should you fail to perceive one's hidden meaning, then regrettably, one may lend you no aid.
:{{A|vo xlq001 7 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What do we do? Paimon doesn't understand  him at all!
:{{DIcon}} I think he wants us to sweeten the deal...
:{{DIcon}} I think he wants some [[Mora]]...
:{{A|vo xlq001 7 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, that's right! Some of those believers mentioned that they had to pay a pretty sum for the adeptus' help, didn't they?
:{{A|vo xlq001 7 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Well Paimon's not forking over any Mora, and we don't have anything valuable enough on us...
:{{A|vo xlq001 7 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You don't even have a [[Vision]]...
:{{DIcon}} I don't think people put Visions up for sale.
:{{DIcon}} No need to rub it in...
:{{A|vo xlq001 7 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hey! Why don't we make him a tasty snack? No one can resist the temptation of good food, can they?
:{{DIcon}} No one who share your values, for sure...
:{{DIcon}} Nom! Sounds good.
:{{A|vo xlq001 7 paimon 12.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yep, a tasty snack is sure to work! Hehehe...
:{{A|vo xlq001 7 paimon 13.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Why don't we head over to [[Wanwen Bookhouse]] and see if they've got any new recipes in?
----

:{{A|vo dialog xlq001 malefollower 01.ogg}} '''Male Believer:''' I still have some valuables at home, Starsnatcher. I can bring them tomorrow, to see if they're to your liking.

;(Talk to the Mercantile Believer again, optional)
:{{A|vo dialog xlq001 merchantfollower 01.ogg}} '''Mercantile Believer:''' Please Starsnatcher, watch over me...

;(Talk to the Female Believer again, optional)
:{{A|vo dialog xlq001 femalefollower 01.ogg}} '''Female Believer:'''  I'm only at ease with the Master of Stars present...

:{{A|vo vrslq004 6 varesa 16.ogg}} '''Varesa:''' C'mon, let's head back to the tribe. We'll earn that mushroom's recognition this time, for sure!

'''''The Missing Thing''''' is a quest in {{Quest|Trap 'Em by Storm}}.

==Steps==
# Investigate the goods at the camp (0/2)
# Talk to [[Heizou]]
# Go to [[Sangonomiya Shrine]]
# Talk to [[Shibata]]
# Go to a nearby location and talk to Heizou
# Wait until night (20:00–24:00)
# Head to [[Bourou Village]]
# Follow [[Todoroki]] and [[Tokuda]]
# Listen in on Todoroki and Tokuda's conversation
# Investigate the goods (0/3)
# Talk to Heizou
# Go with Heizou to where the inmates are imprisoned
# Talk to the inmates
# Wait until the following day (08:00–12:00)
# Question Todoroki
# Go to a nearby location and talk to Heizou

==Gameplay Notes==
* The {{Achievement|Sangonomiya Supplications}} is granted upon talking to Gorou after questioning Todoroki. Talking to Gorou is optional so the quest can be completed without earning this achievement.

:{{A|vo lyycop001 1903907 gorou 04.ogg}} '''Gorou:''' I see, so you've come to ask if we know of any relevant cases, well...

:{{A|vo lyycop001 1903907 gorou 08.ogg}} '''Gorou:''' Actually, I've only heard of Detective Heizou from the soldiers' reports. We've never met in person.
:{{A|vo lyycop001 1903907 heizou 06.ogg}} '''Shikanoin Heizou:''' Ah, darn it, you're right! Now that you mention it, I've been on Watatsumi Island all this time and still haven't properly introduced myself! Man alive, please forgive me!
:{{A|vo lyycop001 1903907 heizou 07.ogg}} '''Shikanoin Heizou:''' It's a pleasure to meet you, General Gorou. I'm Shikanoin Heizou of the [[Tenryou Commission]].
:{{A|vo lyycop001 1903907 gorou 09.ogg}} '''Gorou:''' Yes, it's a pleasure to meet you, too. I'd like to express my gratitude to you for stepping in and helping recover those goods.
:{{A|vo lyycop001 1903907 heizou 08.ogg}} '''Shikanoin Heizou:''' Don't mention it. You never know what you'll find when you're out for a stroll.
:{{A|vo lyycop001 1903907 heizou 09.ogg}} '''Shikanoin Heizou:''' But, if the source of the problem is not addressed, I'm afraid this sort of situation will continue cropping up for you.
:{{A|vo lyycop001 1903907 gorou 10.ogg}} '''Gorou:''' Yes, of course. Not only have we reassured the affected caravans, but we also dispatched personnel to investigate the culprits.
:{{A|vo lyycop001 1903907 gorou 11.ogg}} '''Gorou:''' Their reports indicated that the stolen goods were being delivered to a merchant of the [[International Trade Association]] named Godot.
:{{A|vo lyycop001 1903907 gorou 12.ogg}} '''Gorou:''' It all seems pretty unusual. We suspect that there are bigger players behind Godot, and that their target is none other than Watatsumi Island's valuable resources.
:{{A|vo lyycop001 1903907 gorou 13.ogg}} '''Gorou:''' But unfortunately, it would be difficult for us to investigate further, given that...
:{{A|vo lyycop001 1903907 heizou 10.ogg}} '''Shikanoin Heizou:''' Given that [[Ritou]], the island where the International Trade Association is located, is not part of your territory. Yes, they have cleverly picked their base of operations.
:{{A|vo lyycop001 1903907 gorou 14.ogg}} '''Gorou:''' I can see you catch on quickly, Detective Heizou.
:{{A|vo lyycop001 1903907 heizou 11.ogg}} '''Shikanoin Heizou:''' Hehe. It's my guess that you're telling us this because you're going to ask us to assist you in finding who's behind all this, right?
:{{A|vo lyycop001 1903907 gorou 15.ogg}} '''Gorou:''' Haha, you're always thinking one step ahead. Yes, those were exactly my intentions... and of course, we will prepare a generous reward for you.
:{{A|vo lyycop001 1903907 gorou 16.ogg}} '''Gorou:''' With the recent end of the war, trade and commerce have now become an important component of Watatsumi Island's development. Ensuring safety of the trade routes is critical, and we can't afford any further incidents.
:{{A|vo lyycop001 1903907 gorou 17.ogg}} '''Gorou:''' So will you please help Watatsumi Island, Detective Heizou, {{Traveler}}?
:{{A|vo lyycop001 1903907 heizou 12a.ogg}} {{A|vo lyycop001 1903907 heizou 12b.ogg}} '''Shikanoin Heizou:''' I'm willing to assist, but it all depends on what {{Traveler}} wishes.
:{{DIcon}} As the captain of Swordfish II, it's my duty to help Watatsumi.
:{{DIcon}} Gorou is a good friend, we should do this for him regardless of the rewards.
:{{A|vo lyycop001 1903907 gorou 18.ogg}} '''Gorou:''' Great! With both Detective Heizou and the Traveler on the case, I'm sure it'll be solved in no time.
:{{A|vo lyycop001 1903907 gorou 19.ogg}} '''Gorou:''' The situation is now in your capable hands. I look forward to hearing your report when you get back.
:{{A|vo lyycop001 1903907 heizou 13.ogg}} '''Shikanoin Heizou:''' Alright, we'll take care of it. {{Traveler}}, let's go discuss where to head from here.

;(Go with Heizou to where the inmates are imprisoned)
:{{A|vo lyycop001 1905510 heizou 01.ogg}} '''Shikanoin Heizou:''' Are you still a little confused? Haha, let me help connect the dots, this whole thing was actually quite similar to a case I once worked on previously.
:{{A|vo lyycop001 1905510 heizou 02.ogg}} '''Shikanoin Heizou:''' It was a case involving the trade of prohibited items, and they employed an old trick to execute the deal.
:{{A|vo lyycop001 1905510 heizou 03.ogg}} '''Shikanoin Heizou:''' The culprit would first go strolling down the street, until they knocked over a pedestrian on purpose, using the opportunity to slip the prohibited goods into the unknowing pedestrian's pocket.
:{{A|vo lyycop001 1905510 heizou 04.ogg}} '''Shikanoin Heizou:''' Once the intended recipient got word of it, they would find an excuse to harass the same pedestrian before stealing the goods from the pocket.
:{{A|vo lyycop001 1905510 heizou 05.ogg}} '''Shikanoin Heizou:''' The pedestrian had no idea what happened from start to finish, and unknowingly functioned as a "middleman"... So, can you guess who the middleman was in this case?
