# Go to the [[Kamisato Estate]]
# Talk to [[Ayaka]]
# Go to the [[Tenryou Commission Headquarters]]
# Talk to [[Kujou Sara]]
# Go to the Police Station warehouse
# Talk to everyone (0/4)
# Go to where Kazuha is
# Follow Kazuha to the seaside
# Talk to Kazuha

==Dialogue==
{{Quest Description|Kazuha mentions that there is something he must investigate and that he will meet with everyone else the following afternoon. Time to wait patiently for that time (12:00 – 14:00) to come.}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Wait until the next day)
{{Dialogue End}}
{{Quest Description|update|The agreed time has arrived. Go to The Five Kasen Plaza to meet Kazuha.}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
:{{A|vo rcjeq005 1 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Kazuha said he would wait for us at The Five Kasen Plaza today. Let's go find him there.

;(Approach the Plaza and talk to Kazuha)
:{{A|vo rcjeq005 2 kazuha 01.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' Ah, you're here. It appears everyone has arrived.
:{{DIcon}} How did your investigation go, Kazuha?
:{{A|vo rcjeq005 2 kazuha 02.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' Last night I visited a former servant who once worked for my family. I was able to learn the entirety of what happened all those years ago.
:{{A|vo rcjeq005 2 kazuha 03.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' In my great-grandfather's generation, the Isshin Art was tasked with forging an important Goshintou according to an ancient forging diagram.
:{{A|vo rcjeq005 2 kazuha 04.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' Though all the craftsmen involved were very experienced, the process was still unsuccessful. Every blade that was forged was defective.
:{{A|vo rcjeq005 2 kazuha 05.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' When the deadline came, the blade still wasn't finished, so the craftsmen all fled and hid for fear of punishment.
:{{A|vo rcjeq005 2 kazuha 06.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' The Kaedehara Clan and Yashiro Commission then conducted an investigation. My great-grandfather and the head of the Kamisato Clan eventually tracked down the craftsmen near the seaside.
:{{A|vo rcjeq005 2 kazuha 07.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' However, they met fierce resistance from the craftsmen, and in the end, they were unable to prevent them from escaping by sea.
:{{A|vo rcjeq005 2 kazuha 08.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' The Kaedehara Clan was severely punished for the swordsmiths that had escaped, and the family gradually fell into decline.
:{{A|vo rcjeq005 2 kazuha 09.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' Moreover, I heard that the head of the Kamisato Clan was injured by the fleeing swordsmiths, which, combined with his advanced age, caused him to pass away shortly thereafter.
:{{A|vo rcjeq005 2 ayaka 01.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' Yes... The sudden passing of the family head left the Kamisato Clan leaderless. Treacherous people took advantage of the situation and put the family's status in the Yashiro Commission at jeopardy.
:{{A|vo rcjeq005 2 ayaka 02.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' This single incident had profound effects. Even after the position as head of the clan was passed to my father, the Kamisato Clan still wasn't able to regain its prior reputation.
:{{DIcon}} I see...
:{{A|vo rcjeq005 2 ayaka 03.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' But, thanks to my brother, everything is getting better now.
:{{A|vo rcjeq005 2 kazuha 10.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' The failure to forge the blade was ultimately attributed to a lack of required skill and finesse. The Kaedehara Clan and the Yashiro Commission always believed that was the case.
:{{A|vo rcjeq005 2 kazuha 11.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' However, the story of The Five Kasen seems to imply that the failure didn't stem from a lack of skill, but rather, the diagram had been tampered with by someone.
:{{A|vo rcjeq005 2 kazuha 12.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' Miss Kamisato, I heard yesterday that the Yashiro Commission has still kept the diagram ever since the failed forging all those years ago.
:{{A|vo rcjeq005 2 kazuha 13.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' Might I ask you to do me a favor?
:{{A|vo rcjeq005 2 ayaka 04.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' Yes, I understand. I will go back and search for the diagram. Please come meet me at the Kamisato Estate later.
{{Dialogue End}}
{{Quest Description|update|Ayaka has gone back to her family estate to get the old forging blueprint. Meet up with her there.}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Enter the Yashiro Commission headquarters)
{{Dialogue End}}
{{Quest Description|update|Ask Ayaka what she has discovered.}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Talk to Kamisato Ayaka)
:{{A|vo rcjeq005 3 ayaka 01.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' Everyone, I've managed to find the old diagram.
:{{A|vo rcjeq005 3 venti 01.ogg}} '''Venti:''' Hmm. Though the diagram is well-preserved, you can still tell that it's seen at least three or four centuries of history.
:{{A|vo rcjeq005 3 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Whoa, that's pretty old! Is it still possible to find any evidence of tampering?
:{{A|vo rcjeq005 3 venti 02.ogg}} '''Venti:''' At this point, we can only try our luck and see how we fare.
:{{Black Screen|They immerse the diagram into a basin of water, and after a short while...}}
:{{A|vo rcjeq005 3 albedo 01.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Although the effect is not too obvious, you can still see that some words have now started to smudge.
:{{A|vo rcjeq005 3 albedo 02.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Kazuha, this is clear evidence that this chart was indeed tampered with. Someone framed the Kaedehara Clan all those years ago.
:{{A|vo rcjeq005 3 kazuha 01.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' *sigh* I see, but I fear that I've discovered this secret too late...
:{{A|vo rcjeq005 3 kazuha 02.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' When my grandfather was young, he proposed reviving the Isshin Art many times to my great-grandfather. But my grandfather was only scolded for being too foolhardy.
:{{A|vo rcjeq005 3 kazuha 03.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' Yesterday, the former family servant said that my great-grandfather even went to the Yashiro Commission to request that diagram from the head of the Kamisato Clan. He then showed that diagram to my grandfather and asked him and his subordinates to try to forge the sword.
:{{A|vo rcjeq005 3 kazuha 04.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' Sure enough, my grandfather also failed. My great-grandfather then told him, "If you can't find the secret within, then the Isshin Art deserves to fade from the world."
:{{A|vo rcjeq005 3 kazuha 05.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' My grandfather left Inazuma in a rage after hearing those words. He didn't ever see my great-grandfather again, even till the day of his passing.
:{{A|vo rcjeq005 3 kazuha 06.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' Looking back at it now, the argument between the two of them was simply... meaningless.
:{{A|vo rcjeq005 3 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, Kazuha...
:{{A|vo rcjeq005 3 ayaka 02.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' I heard that your great-grandfather was very industrious when he was young. But later in life, he no longer bothered with the forging arts. It appears that his failure took quite a toll on him.
:{{A|vo rcjeq005 3 albedo 03.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Kazuha, did your great-grandfather really say "if you can't find the secret within"? Did he use those exact words?
:{{A|vo rcjeq005 3 kazuha 07.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' Yes, the servant said that he personally heard those words and still remembers them very clearly.
:{{A|vo rcjeq005 3 kazuha 08.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' My grandfather was so angry at the time that he smashed my great-grandfather's cherished bonsai tree...
:{{DIcon}} Wait, Albedo. Are you trying to say...
:{{A|vo rcjeq005 3 albedo 04.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Yes, it appears that you understand my meaning, {{Traveler}}.
:{{A|vo rcjeq005 3 albedo 05.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Kazuha, if your great-grandfather thought that the Isshin Art lacked finesse, then after witnessing his son's failure, wouldn't he have said something more along the lines of "your skills aren't sufficient"?
:{{A|vo rcjeq005 3 albedo 06.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' But instead he said, "If you can't find the secret within." Don't you find that a little strange?
:{{A|vo rcjeq005 3 kazuha 09.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' Huh? Oh!
:;(Kazuha's eyes widen with realization)
:{{A|vo rcjeq005 3 kazuha 10.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' So, you're saying... my great-grandfather may have very well known that the failure was due to someone's tampering?
:{{A|vo rcjeq005 3 albedo 07.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Yes, the current evidence suggests that it is highly likely.
:{{A|vo rcjeq005 3 kazuha 11.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' I apologize, but would you all please accompany me to the Tenryou Commission?
:{{A|vo rcjeq005 3 kazuha 12.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' After I became a wanted criminal, the Tenryou Commission seized my family's last remaining estate, which contained all of my family's old belongings.
:{{A|vo rcjeq005 3 kazuha 13.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' I want to inquire about the whereabouts of those belongings. If I can find them, we might be able to get some clues.
:{{A|vo rcjeq005 3 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Alright, let's get moving!
;(Obtain [[Ancient Forging Blueprint]] ×1)
{{Dialogue End}}
{{Quest Description|update|Go to the Tenryou Commission Headquarters, find Kujou Sara, and ask her about the items confiscated from the Kaedehara Clan.}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Talk to Kujou Sara)
:{{A|vo rcjeq005 4 kujousara 01.ogg}} '''Kujou Sara:''' Hmm? What are you all doing here? Did something happen on Ritou?
:{{DIcon}} Nothing's happened, Sara.
:{{DIcon}} We're just here to ask about something.
:{{A|vo rcjeq005 4 kazuha 01.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' Kujou Sara, perhaps you still remember me?
:{{A|vo rcjeq005 4 kujousara 02.ogg}} '''Kujou Sara:''' Yes, I do. You're Kaedehara Kazuha, a wanted criminal during the Vision Hunt Decree. However, your arrest warrant has since been repealed.
:{{A|vo rcjeq005 4 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Sara, we'd like to ask about the Kaedehara Clan's property that was seized by the Tenryou Commission. Do you know where all their belongings are now?
:{{A|vo rcjeq005 4 kujousara 03.ogg}} '''Kujou Sara:''' Yes, the items seized at that time are currently stored in the warehouse next to the Police Station. Since Kaedehara has come back to Inazuma, those items should be returned to their rightful owner.
:{{A|vo rcjeq005 4 kazuha 02.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' No, I'm afraid you misunderstand. I'm not here to reclaim those belongings. I just want to investigate them for a personal matter.
:{{A|vo rcjeq005 4 kujousara 04.ogg}} '''Kujou Sara:''' I see. Alright, I'll inform the Police Station. They'll take you into the warehouse.
:{{A|vo rcjeq005 4 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Thank you, Sara!
:{{A|vo rcjeq005 4 kujousara 05.ogg}} '''Kujou Sara:''' Ahem... Kaedehara, about the Vision Hunt Decree...
:{{A|vo rcjeq005 4 kazuha 03.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' That's all in the past now, Kujou Sara. There's no need to mention it again. I know you've also had your own convictions and struggles.
:{{A|vo rcjeq005 4 kujousara 06.ogg}} '''Kujou Sara:''' ...
:{{A|vo rcjeq005 4 kazuha 04.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' However, may I ask something of you?
:{{A|vo rcjeq005 4 kujousara 07.ogg}} '''Kujou Sara:''' Yes, what is it?
:{{A|vo rcjeq005 4 kazuha 05.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' Currently I have no plans to stay in Inazuma. As the result, those items from my family's estate are of no use to me.
:{{A|vo rcjeq005 4 kazuha 06.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' Madam Kujou, I believe you're a person of integrity. After our investigation is over, I'd like to ask if you can handle those belongings for me. Please, sell them and use the money to help the poor.
:{{A|vo rcjeq005 4 kujousara 08.ogg}} '''Kujou Sara:''' Alright, I understand. I'll be sure to take care of it.

;(Talk to Kujou Sara again)
:{{A|vo dialog rcjeq005 kujousara 01.ogg}} '''Kujou Sara:''' I've already informed the Police Station. There'll be someone to take you into the warehouse, so you may head there directly.
:{{A|vo dialog rcjeq005 kujousara 02.ogg}} '''Kujou Sara:''' As for the belongings left by the Kaedehara Clan, I will deal with them promptly.
{{Dialogue End}}
{{Quest Description|update|The Kaedehara Clan's items have been stored in a warehouse near the Police Station. Sara has already informed the Doushin on duty of your investigation.}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Talk to Asakawa)
:{{A|vo rcjeq005 5 asakawa 01.ogg}} '''Asakawa:''' You must be here to investigate the Kaedehara Clan's belongings. Madam Kujou has already informed me of the situation. Please, come this way.

:{{A|vo rcjeq005 6 asakawa 01.ogg}} '''Asakawa:''' The Kaedehara Clan's belongings are stored in this warehouse. Unfortunately, the items are scattered throughout in order to save space. My deepest apologies.
:{{A|vo rcjeq005 6 asakawa 02.ogg}} '''Asakawa:''' However, I have clearly marked the corresponding items, so they shouldn't be too difficult to find.
:{{A|vo rcjeq005 6 asakawa 03.ogg}} '''Asakawa:''' I'll be waiting for you at the door, please come see me if you require any assistance.
:{{A|vo rcjeq005 6 xingqiu 01.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' Kazuha, since the items are scattered throughout the building, I propose we split up and look for clues.
:{{A|vo rcjeq005 6 kazuha 01.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' Yes, sounds like a plan. Thanks for your help, everyone.

;(Talk to Asakawa again)
:{{A|vo dialog rcjeq005 asakawa 01.ogg}} '''Asakawa:''' Sorry, many of the items were moved here recently, so things are still a bit unorganized.
:{{A|vo dialog rcjeq005 asakawa 02.ogg}} '''Asakawa:''' Although the previous warehouse was large, the locks were dated, and something was nearly stolen. So, Madam Kujou Sara ordered the contents to be moved here.
{{Dialogue End}}
{{Quest Description|update|Everyone has split up to look for clues. Talk to them about what they've found.}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Talk to Kaedehara Kazuha)
:{{A|vo dialog rcjeq005 kazuha 01.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' I'll be checking around here. You and the others can start looking elsewhere.

;(Talk to Kamisato Ayaka)
:{{A|vo dialog rcjeq005 ayaka 01.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' Hmm...
:{{DIcon}} Ayaka, how's it going for you?
:{{A|vo dialog rcjeq005 ayaka 02.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' Oh, it's you, {{Traveler}}. I'm currently investigating this sword rack.
:{{A|vo dialog rcjeq005 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, since the Kaedehara Clan was a family of renowned swordsmiths, then this blade should be super valuable, right? *gasp* Maybe it's a treasure of the Isshin Art!?
:{{A|vo dialog rcjeq005 ayaka 03.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' I'm afraid not. Although the sword rack is made of fine wood, the swords placed here appear to be quite ordinary. Due to the dire financial situation of the late Kaedehara Clan, everything of value has probably been sold off already.
:{{A|vo dialog rcjeq005 ayaka 04.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' The blade on this sword hasn't been sharpened, but there are many signs of use on the hilt. Perhaps Kaedehara used it for training as a child.
:{{A|vo dialog rcjeq005 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Let Paimon see... Oh, there seems to be a couple uneven characters etched into the scabbard! "Kazu"... "ha." Wow, so it really was Kazuha's!
:{{A|vo dialog rcjeq005 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Paimon can imagine what Kazuha was like as a kid, hehe.
:{{A|vo dialog rcjeq005 ayaka 05.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' I will continue investigating here and call you if I find anything interesting.

;(Talk to Xingqiu)
:{{A|vo dialog rcjeq005 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What did you find, Xingqiu?
:{{A|vo dialog rcjeq005 xingqiu 01.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' I've found quite the pile of old books.
:{{A|vo dialog rcjeq005 xingqiu 02.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' These books here are all related to smelting steel, and these are about the process of forging blades. This pile over here is all about plants and flowers.
:{{A|vo dialog rcjeq005 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hmm, the books about plants and flowers must have belonged to Kazuha's great-grandfather.
:{{DIcon}} Could there be any clues in the books?
:{{A|vo dialog rcjeq005 xingqiu 03.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' I skimmed through them just now, but I didn't find anything particularly worth noting. I shall take a closer look and let you know if I find anything.

;(Talk to Albedo)
:{{A|vo dialog rcjeq005 albedo 01.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Oh, it's you. Unfortunately, I have yet to find anything of value here.
:{{A|vo dialog rcjeq005 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Whoa, this folding screen looks pretty old, though.
:{{A|vo dialog rcjeq005 albedo 02.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Yes. Perhaps if it were better maintained, then it could fetch a decent price. However, I doubt it could be sold in its current condition.
:{{A|vo dialog rcjeq005 albedo 03.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' I was taking a closer look just now and noticed a large piece of dirt caught in the fabric fibers on the backside.
:{{A|vo dialog rcjeq005 albedo 04.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' The soil is deeply embedded into the cloth. That means a great deal of force was used when the dirt was lodged into the cloth. It's likely that this patch of dirt is from the very flower pot thrown by Kazuha's grandfather.
:{{DIcon}} Isn't that an important discovery?
:{{DIcon}} Why don't you think this is of any value?
:{{A|vo dialog rcjeq005 albedo 05.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Because this is not what we are looking for now.
:{{A|vo dialog rcjeq005 albedo 06.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Let me think... If I wanted to leave a message behind, I would probably choose to leave it on something a little more special. Hmm...
:{{A|vo dialog rcjeq005 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Albedo seems to be thinking pretty hard, we'd better not bother him.

;(Talk to Venti)
:{{A|vo dialog rcjeq005 venti 01.ogg}} '''Venti:''' Hmm, there must be some around here somewhere...
:{{DIcon}} What are you looking for, Venti?
:{{A|vo dialog rcjeq005 venti 02.ogg}} '''Venti:''' Do you see all these pots here? Some of them are bound to have liquor inside, right?
:{{A|vo dialog rcjeq005 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hey! Everyone else is trying hard to help and you're over here looking for a drink!?
:{{A|vo dialog rcjeq005 venti 03.ogg}} '''Venti:''' Haha, I merely jest, of course. C'mon, we're close to uncovering the truth now, why do you look so worried?
:{{A|vo dialog rcjeq005 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Well, Paimon doesn't really get why Kazuha told Sara to sell all these belongings...
:{{A|vo dialog rcjeq005 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What if we don't end up finding anything today? Then wouldn't Kazuha lose the chance of finding out what really happened all those years ago? ...Y'know, just saying.
:{{A|vo dialog rcjeq005 venti 04.ogg}} '''Venti:''' I know you are worried about Kazuha, but if you ask me, he is stronger than you think.
:{{A|vo dialog rcjeq005 venti 05.ogg}} '''Venti:''' Since Kazuha made such a request to Sara, that indicates he's already made his choice. Whether we find out the truth or not today, or whatever it turns out to be, he's ready to accept it.
:{{DIcon}} Is this your archon's intuition speaking?
:{{A|vo dialog rcjeq005 venti 06.ogg}} '''Venti:''' No, not intuition. Rather, I've lived for a long time now, so you could say I have some experience in reading people.
:{{A|vo dialog rcjeq005 venti 07.ogg}} '''Venti:''' Leave the things here to me, you two can look around elsewhere.
{{Dialogue End}}
{{Quest Description|update|Kazuha seems to have found a clue. Go and see what he's found.}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(After talking to everyone)
:{{A|vo rcjeq005 8 kazuha 01.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' Everyone, I've found something that you should all have a look at.
:{{A|vo rcjeq005 8 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh! Seems Kazuha discovered something, let's go see what he's got!

;(Talk to Kaedehara Kazuha)
:{{A|vo rcjeq005 8 kazuha 02.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' This flowerpot was in my house for a long time. I heard that it was left behind by my great-grandfather.
:{{A|vo rcjeq005 8 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yeah, the plants seem to have been dead for a while now.
:{{A|vo rcjeq005 8 kazuha 03.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' Well, after my great-grandfather stopped studying the forging arts, he picked up the hobby of keeping bonsai plants. Most of his prized plants were given to others once he became seriously ill.
:{{A|vo rcjeq005 8 kazuha 04.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' But he specifically left behind this dead plant at the time, and even instructed my grandfather not to throw it away in his will.
:{{A|vo rcjeq005 8 kazuha 05.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' My grandfather deeply regretted that he never managed to reconcile with my great-grandfather, so he left the plant exactly as it was.
:{{A|vo rcjeq005 8 kazuha 06.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' But now that I think about it, my great-grandfather could very well have left it behind for other reasons.
:{{A|vo rcjeq005 8 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hmm, now that you mention it, this flower pot is kinda suspicious.
:{{A|vo rcjeq005 8 kazuha 07.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' Yes. Let's take a closer look, shall we?
:{{Black Screen|They find a hidden compartment at the bottom of the flowerpot...}}
:{{A|vo rcjeq005 8 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' We finally found something! Huh, it's only a bunch of blank paper.
:{{A|vo rcjeq005 8 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Do you think someone already discovered the compartment and swapped the contents?
:{{A|vo rcjeq005 8 albedo 01.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' No, I do not think that is the case here. See the paper? It's quite yellowed, which means it's very old.
:{{DIcon}} Maybe we need to try using water again.
:{{A|vo rcjeq005 8 kazuha 08.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' Hmm. You mean to say that these sheets have been written with special ink, like that which Miss Kamisato found before?
:{{A|vo rcjeq005 8 albedo 02a.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Yes, I agree with this hypothesis.
:{{A|vo rcjeq005 8 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Okay, let's give it a dunk then!
:{{A|vo rcjeq005 8 kazuha 09.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' There is a pond outside the Police Station. I'll use the water there.
:{{Black Screen|You go with Kazuha to the pond outside the police station...}}
:{{A|vo rcjeq005 9 kazuha 01.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' ...
:{{A|vo rcjeq005 9 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Well? How did it go? Those weren't just plain old sheets of paper, were they?
:{{A|vo rcjeq005 9 kazuha 02.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' Just as everyone guessed, after I sprinkled some water onto the paper, writing did indeed begin to appear on it. It is a letter written by my great-grandfather.
:{{A|vo rcjeq005 9 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, what does the letter say?
:{{DIcon}} Is it something you can share with us, too?
:{{A|vo rcjeq005 9 kazuha 03.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' It is. I'll tell you what my great-grandfather knew at the time. But before that, I wish to take you somewhere.
:{{A|vo rcjeq005 9 kazuha 04.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' Everyone, please follow me.
{{Dialogue End}}
{{Quest Description|update|Kazuha says that he'd like everyone to go somewhere, and that he'll reveal the truth there.}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Approach the beach)
:{{A|vo rcjeq005 10 ayaka 01.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' Kaedehara, why did you lead us to this beach?
:{{DIcon}} Is this place related to the contents of the letter?
:{{A|vo rcjeq005 10 kazuha 01.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' It is... In fact, my great-grandfather and the head of the Kamisato Clan tracked the fleeing swordsmiths to this very location.
:{{A|vo rcjeq005 10 kazuha 02.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' Our hypothesis was correct. My great-grandfather was well aware of the truth behind the defective blades. And it was right here where they encountered the culprit who framed the Kaedehara Clan and the [[Raiden Gokaden]].
:{{A|vo rcjeq005 10 kazuha 03.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' It reads:
:{{A|vo rcjeq005 10 kazuha 04.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' "To whoever reads this letter: I, Kaedehara Yoshinori, have been held to a certain secret throughout my entire life. I don't have much longer in this world, and after much consideration, I've finally decided to disclose the matter."
:{{A|vo rcjeq005 10 kazuha 05.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' "All those years ago, when I was pursuing the swordsmiths alongside Commissioner Kamisato of the Yashiro Commission, I was not injured by one of the fleeing smiths. Rather..."
;(Flashback begins)
:{{A|vo rcjeq005 11 kaedeharayoshinori 01.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Yoshinori:''' ...It was night, and after the clues led us down to shore, I waited for the culprits to show themselves. However, there were no swordsmiths in sight, only a single eccentric stranger.
:{{A|vo rcjeq005 11 kaedeharayoshinori 02.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Yoshinori:''' This stranger claimed to be the one behind the failed forgings and said that he had been patiently waiting for us. He then threatened to destroy the Raiden Gokaden.
:{{A|vo rcjeq005 11 kaedeharayoshinori 03.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Yoshinori:''' That person was of able body, and in a blink of an eye, myself and the accompanying samurai had been defeated.
:{{A|vo rcjeq005 11 kaedeharayoshinori 04.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Yoshinori:''' Commissioner Kamisato was severely wounded, and I barely escaped death myself. My hat had fortunately blunted a blow to my head.
:{{A|vo rcjeq005 11 kaedeharayoshinori 05.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Yoshinori:''' The unusual stranger could've easily claimed my life at that moment. But, after noticing my appearance, he stopped his attacks, and sternly asked if I had any connection with the name "[[Niwa Hisahide|Niwa]]."
:{{A|vo rcjeq005 11 kaedeharayoshinori 06.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Yoshinori:''' I answered that it was my father's surname and after my father disappeared, I was adopted by the Kaedehara family.
:{{A|vo rcjeq005 11 kaedeharayoshinori 07.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Yoshinori:''' Upon hearing my answer, the stranger paused. After a long silence, he suddenly said: "Tell her this. My name is [[Scaramouche|Kunikuzushi]]." He then turned and left...
;(Flashback ends)
:{{A|vo rcjeq005 12 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wow, so that's what really happened!
:{{A|vo rcjeq005 12 kazuha 01.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' Yes. My great-grandfather and the head of the Kamisato Clan escaped from death and learned that the forging diagram had been tampered with by Kunikuzushi.
:{{A|vo rcjeq005 12 kazuha 02.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' However, due to the encounter, the head of the Kamisato Clan was worried that my great-grandfather would be falsely accused of being involved with the perpetrator. So even on his deathbed, the master of the Kamisato Clan cautioned my great-grandfather to never speak of what happened.
:{{A|vo rcjeq005 12 kazuha 03.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' Because the perpetrator said he would destroy the Raiden Gokaden, my great-grandfather worried that the perpetrator would still return for vengeance. So, to protect his loved ones, he closed the family business.
:{{A|vo rcjeq005 12 kazuha 04.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' He said: "As the leader of the Kaedehara Clan, I am deeply ashamed to witness the decline of the Isshin Art. But, as a father, it is my priority to ensure the safety of my children and grandchildren."
:{{DIcon}} So all those harsh words he said...
:{{DIcon}} Were because he was worried about his son's well-being.
:{{A|vo rcjeq005 12 kazuha 05.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' Yes, that's right. If my grandpa had somehow discovered the secret behind the tampered diagram all those years ago, perhaps my great-grandfather would've told him the truth.
:{{A|vo rcjeq005 12 kazuha 06.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' Unfortunately, he failed to catch any of the hints in my great-grandfather's words.
:{{A|vo rcjeq005 12 kazuha 07.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' Miss Kamisato, it appears you were unaware of the happenings that my great-grandfather described here. What are your thoughts?
:{{A|vo rcjeq005 12 ayaka 01.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' Hmm, I suppose the reason the head of the Kamisato House never spoke of this to the family was due to similar safety concerns.
:{{A|vo rcjeq005 12 ayaka 02.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' If the perpetrator was capable of tampering with even the Shogun's diagrams, and could single-handedly defeat many men, then he is not an ordinary enemy.
:{{A|vo rcjeq005 12 ayaka 03.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' I will discuss this matter with brother shortly and investigate the identity behind the one called "Kunikuzushi." Rest assured, we will act cautiously.
:{{DIcon}} How are you feeling, Kazuha?
:{{A|vo rcjeq005 12 kazuha 08.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' To be honest, as I read the letter, I felt much turbulence in my heart. But now, I've managed to calm myself.
:{{A|vo rcjeq005 12 kazuha 09.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' My great-grandfather said in the letter that he did not wish his descendants to blindly seek revenge and be deceived by things of the past.
:{{A|vo rcjeq005 12 kazuha 10.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' Though he was in a tight situation when he wrote these words, I feel like they are still valid nonetheless.
:{{A|vo rcjeq005 12 kazuha 11.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' I think what's most important for each person is not the past, but the present. Even though we must carry the burdens from the past, there are also things we wish to strive for.
:{{A|vo rcjeq005 12 kazuha 12.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' Therefore, knowing the truth behind what happened is enough for me. I will live on just as my great-grandfather had hoped.
:{{A|vo rcjeq005 12 kazuha 13.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' That being said, if the enemy from all those years ago is still lurking and plotting to stir up more trouble, then I definitely won't turn a blind eye.
:{{DIcon}} That's Kazuha, always sensible.
:{{DIcon}} Classic Kazuha, optimistic as always.
:{{A|vo rcjeq005 12 kazuha 14.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' These are simply insights I've gathered from all that I've experienced.
:{{A|vo rcjeq005 12 kazuha 15.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' Thank you all for accompanying me in my search for the truth behind that incident.
:{{A|vo rcjeq005 12 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Great! Now that we're done here, let's head back to Ritou.
;(Obtain [[Kaedehara Yoshinori's Letter]] ×1)
{{Dialogue End}}

==Dialogue==
{{Quest Description|The bustling streets of the Court of Fontaine seem more lively than usual. Why not take a walk around?}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Approach Louis' Snack Shop)
:{{A|vo lnlq001 1 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hey, isn't that Charlotte?
:{{A|vo lnlq001 1 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hehe, we're always running into her! What's she doing this time... Oh, looks like street interviews?
:{{A|vo lnlq001 1 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Paimon has a funny feeling that we might be in for an interesting time if we go check it out. Shall we?

;(Approach Charlotte)
:{{A|vo lnlq001 2 charlotte 01.ogg}} '''Charlotte:''' I see! So you believe that this warning letter was sent by The Phantom Weasel?
:{{A|vo lnlq001 2 abagnale 01.ogg}} '''Abagnale:''' Absolutely! I've said it before, and I'll say it again: The Phantom Weasel never acts as you expect. He must have faked his own death ten years ago using a body double!
:{{A|vo lnlq001 2 abagnale 02.ogg}} '''Abagnale:''' Now that he's back, I'm sure the Gardes who worked on his case back in the day are in for a headache. But however this turns out in the end, the one thing it won't be is boring!
:{{A|vo lnlq001 2 charlotte 02.ogg}} '''Charlotte:''' Couldn't agree more! As a journalist, I'm gonna get a lot of mileage out of this one!
:{{A|vo lnlq001 2 charlotte 03.ogg}} '''Charlotte:''' Thank you, Sir, for your time. Now, whom should I interview next... Huh!? Hey, what a coincidence. Fancy meeting you here!
:{{A|vo lnlq001 2 charlotte 04.ogg}} '''Charlotte:''' Perfect timing. So, The Phantom Weasel's latest warning letter — what are your thoughts?
:{{DIcon}} "Phantom Weasel"?
:{{DIcon}} "Warning letter"?
:{{A|vo lnlq001 2 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yeah, this is the first time we're hearing of this one. Could you clue us in?
:{{A|vo lnlq001 2 charlotte 05.ogg}} '''Charlotte:''' Huh? Oh... Ah, sorry! Yes, this case is from a decade ago. I guess you wouldn't know about it...
:{{A|vo lnlq001 2 charlotte 06.ogg}} '''Charlotte:''' Well, not to worry — you're in good hands, because I'm a professional! The story goes like this...
:{{A|vo lnlq001 2 charlotte 07.ogg}} '''Charlotte:''' Ten or so years ago, a phantom thief became active in the Court of Fontaine. Known only as "The Weasel," nobody knew his true identity, and the authorities never managed to catch him.
:{{A|vo lnlq001 2 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wow, cool! He sounds like one of those... mysterious night burglars that you read about in novels!
:{{A|vo lnlq001 2 charlotte 08.ogg}} '''Charlotte:''' Precisely — well, except the part where they actually have a good reputation. Our Weasel targeted whatever people held dear, and no one was safe from his predations!
:{{A|vo lnlq001 2 charlotte 09.ogg}} '''Charlotte:''' He would just as soon steal a necklace from a rich merchant's safe as he would a toy doll given to a commoner child for their birthday.
:{{DIcon}} Sounds like an absolute weirdo.
:{{A|vo lnlq001 2 charlotte 10.ogg}} '''Charlotte:''' I know! The phantom thieves you read about in novels rob the rich to pay the poor, but this guy did not discriminate. Unsurprisingly, this didn't work wonders for his public reputation. Every man and his dog wanted to see him behind bars.
:{{A|vo lnlq001 2 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yeesh. So, uh... Did they catch him?
:{{A|vo lnlq001 2 charlotte 11.ogg}} '''Charlotte:''' Umm... Not exactly. There's a good chance that the Weasel would still be at large to this day if it hadn't been for an accident ten years ago.
:{{A|vo lnlq001 2 charlotte 12.ogg}} '''Charlotte:''' A magician named [[Cesar]] fell to his death in a botched high-altitude escape performance.
:{{A|vo lnlq001 2 charlotte 13.ogg}} '''Charlotte:''' When the police went through his personal effects, they found a hoard of stolen loot and gadgets used for criminal activities... and that was how The Phantom Weasel's identity was revealed to all.
:{{A|vo lnlq001 2 charlotte 14.ogg}} '''Charlotte:''' Sure enough, thefts in Fontaine went down after Cesar's death... But today, ten years on, the notorious thief has once again issued one of his warning letters — and pasted it on the gate of the Opera Epiclese for all to see!
:{{A|vo lnlq001 2 charlotte 15.ogg}} '''Charlotte:''' I had to squeeze through the crowd this morning to get a photo as soon as I heard... Here, it's this one.
::[[File:The Phantom Thief's Reappearance 1.png|500px]]
:{{A|vo lnlq001 2 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So this is the warning letter, huh? Let's see what he wrote...
:{{A|vo lnlq001 2 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' "Three days from now, when evening falls, I shall take from you that which you hold most dear at the opera house, just as you did to me ten years ago."
:{{A|vo lnlq001 2 charlotte 16.ogg}} '''Charlotte:''' This is, without a doubt, a clear declaration of criminal intent. After years of laying low, The Phantom Weasel is back with a vengeance!
:{{A|vo lnlq001 2 charlotte 17.ogg}} '''Charlotte:''' What once seemed like an open-and-shut case has been blown wide open again. But why has he re-emerged now, and what does he want? I sense an epic scoop — and I'm going for it!
:{{A|vo lnlq001 2 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Uh-oh... If this thief will steal anything that other people value, does that mean even we might be targeted?
:{{DIcon}} He might steal all your favorite snacks.
::{{A|vo lnlq001 2 paimon 07a 1.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Really? Hmph, let him try! In fact... Paimon's gonna eat all her snacks right now — let's see what he can do about that!
:{{DIcon}} He might try to nab you, little Paimon.
::{{A|vo lnlq001 2 paimon 07b 1.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Aww... But Paimon doesn't wanna get kidnapped... Well, he'd have to go through you first. ...You would stop him, right?
:{{A|vo lnlq001 2 charlotte 18.ogg}} '''Charlotte:''' Okay, the people have spoken. It's clear that the public are very concerned about The Phantom Weasel's reappearance...
:{{A|vo lnlq001 2 charlotte 19.ogg}} '''Charlotte:''' Let's see, I've got a photo of the letter, my interview notes... Yup, that should be enough to form the skeleton of my article. It does feel like something is missing, though...
:{{A|vo lnlq001 2 charlotte 20.ogg}} '''Charlotte:''' Something... exclusive.
:{{A|vo lnlq001 2 charlotte 21.ogg}} '''Charlotte:''' Who should I interview next? I need someone with a more concrete connection to the Weasel... Hmm? Is that who I think it is...?
:{{A|vo lnlq001 2 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Lyney?
:{{DIcon}} Looks like he's performing some magic.
:{{A|vo lnlq001 2 charlotte 22.ogg}} '''Charlotte:''' Magic... Magician... Cesar... The Phantom Weasel! That's it! Let's go interview Lyney!
:{{A|vo lnlq001 2 charlotte 23.ogg}} '''Charlotte:''' You see? The original phantom thief, Cesar, was a magician too. And what do phantom thieves and magicians have in common? They both have an air of mystery about them! Perhaps there's a connection there?
:{{A|vo lnlq001 2 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Are you serious? What sort of a deduction is that!?
:{{A|vo lnlq001 2 charlotte 24.ogg}} '''Charlotte:''' Oh, relax... My journalistic instinct tells me that an exclusive news story is beckoning. Let's go — no time for delay!
----
{{Dialogue End}}
{{Quest Description|update|Is there a connection between phantom thieves and magicians? Interview Lyney about the Phantom Weasel's reappearance.}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Approach Lyney)
:{{A|vo lnlq001 3 david 01.ogg}} '''David:''' Wow, Mr. Magician! How did you know which card I'd picked?
:{{A|vo lnlq001 3 lyney 01.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Oh, it's simple! Come closer, and I'll let you in on my secret... Magicians have a special skill called "telepathy," which means we can read other people's minds.
:{{A|vo lnlq001 3 david 02.ogg}} '''David:''' Really? Then... What am I thinking now?
:{{A|vo lnlq001 3 lyney 02.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Well, first you need to relax... Because I can see that you're clenching your fist in your mind, as if to say "No, I mustn't let him guess it..."
:{{A|vo lnlq001 3 david 03.ogg}} '''David:''' Aww...!
:{{A|vo lnlq001 3 lyney 03.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' And now you're getting a little flustered. You're trying to find a way to empty your mind, to think of nothing at all. But the more you try to hide a secret, the easier it'll come out~
:{{A|vo lnlq001 3 lyney 04.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' You snuck out from home today, didn't you? You told your family a little lie so you could come out and play. Now, now, that's not a good habit.
:{{A|vo lnlq001 3 david 04.ogg}} '''David:''' Y—You can tell? Oh boy... you really CAN read my mind!
:{{A|vo lnlq001 3 lyney 05.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Of course. And that's the end of my performance — you should really be heading home. Remember to apologize to your family, alright? They must be worried about you.
:{{A|vo lnlq001 3 david 05.ogg}} '''David:''' A—Alright, got it. Bye, Mr. Magician!
:{{A|vo lnlq001 3 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Uh... Hey, Lyney...
:{{A|vo lnlq001 3 lyney 06.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Why, hello, we meet again. Are you looking for me? What's the situation?
:{{A|vo lnlq001 3 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Well, why don't you guess, Mr. Telepathic?
:{{A|vo lnlq001 3 lyney 07.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Oh, please! You didn't believe that spiel, did you? The power of telepathy is quite beyond me.
:{{A|vo lnlq001 3 charlotte 01.ogg}} '''Charlotte:''' I'm sure that child would beg to differ... Seemed like you were right on the money.
:{{A|vo lnlq001 3 lyney 08.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' That was nothing more than a little trickery. I made an educated guess based on his microexpressions...
:{{A|vo lnlq001 3 lyney 09.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' That, plus the fact that he was the only kid here without his parents, and he looked as guilty as sin. He made it easy for me.
:{{A|vo lnlq001 3 lyney 10.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' You guys, on the other hand... Let me guess... Don't tell me you're here for the Phantom Weasel, are you?
:{{A|vo lnlq001 3 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wow! Got it in one! Is this more of your trickery at work?
:{{A|vo lnlq001 3 lyney 11.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Wait, really? Haha... No, no trickery this time. It was pure luck.
:{{A|vo lnlq001 3 lyney 12.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' His warning letter's been the talk of the town, so I figured that maybe you were asking around about that.
:{{A|vo lnlq001 3 charlotte 02.ogg}} '''Charlotte:''' Bingo! I plan on writing a column reporting on the latest news about The Phantom Weasel!
:{{A|vo lnlq001 3 charlotte 03.ogg}} '''Charlotte:''' So Lyney, what are your thoughts on this infamous thief's reappearance?
:{{A|vo lnlq001 3 lyney 13.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Hmm... To be honest, it makes me angry.
:{{A|vo lnlq001 3 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Angry? Why?
:{{A|vo lnlq001 3 lyney 14.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' You read his letter, right? The Phantom Weasel claims he's planning something in three nights' time at the opera house. That's the night I'll be performing there.
:{{A|vo lnlq001 3 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh, what are the chances...
:{{A|vo lnlq001 3 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' ...Wait a minute. You don't think he's after you... do you?
:{{A|vo lnlq001 3 lyney 15.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Well, if he is, then his warning is clearly a direct challenge to me personally.
:{{A|vo lnlq001 3 lyney 16.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' And if he's not... then it's still going to be a huge headache for me.
:{{A|vo lnlq001 3 lyney 17.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' The mere mention of the Weasel's name is enough to scare people off. So once the contents of that letter get out, barely anyone will be showing up to watch my show.
:{{A|vo lnlq001 3 lyney 18.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' But I've been preparing for this for a long time. I'm not about to let him ruin my big day. This leaves me with only one choice... I have to expose The Phantom Weasel's identity before the show begins.
:{{A|vo lnlq001 3 charlotte 04.ogg}} '''Charlotte:''' Really? So what you're saying is... We might get to see a live duel between a famous magician and an infamous thief? Wow... This has "exclusive" written all over it!
:{{A|vo lnlq001 3 lyney 19.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' To be honest, I'm not sure if I'll emerge the victor. The Phantom Weasel is a notorious crook, infamous for his inscrutable methods.
:{{A|vo lnlq001 3 charlotte 05.ogg}} '''Charlotte:''' You're being far too modest, Lyney. I think your magic tricks are even more inscrutable than those of a thief!
:{{A|vo lnlq001 3 lyney 20.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Thanks for the compliment, though I have to say, I don't care much for the comparison.
:{{A|vo lnlq001 3 lyney 21.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' A lot of people liken magicians to thieves because we both have the ability to make things disappear without the person noticing. But there's an important difference that these people overlook.
:{{A|vo lnlq001 3 lyney 22.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Allow me to demonstrate with a quick magic trick. Here I have a flower, just an ordinary flower that was picked not long ago. Watch it carefully now... Three, two, one...
:{{A|vo lnlq001 3 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' It's gone!
:{{DIcon}} Where'd it go?
:{{A|vo lnlq001 3 lyney 23.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' That's the question. Where did it go?
:{{A|vo lnlq001 3 lyney 24.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Therein lies the difference between us. Thieves make precious things disappear, but only magicians make them reappear.
:{{A|vo lnlq001 3 lyney 25.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' If I could now invite you all to check your clothes... There might be a surprise in there somewhere.
:{{A|vo lnlq001 3 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' A surprise? Lemme see...
:{{DIcon}} Huh!!!
:{{A|vo lnlq001 3 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' It's right there! But how? You haven't moved this whole time!
:{{A|vo lnlq001 3 charlotte 06.ogg}} '''Charlotte:''' What an outstanding trick! Sorry, Lyney, it seems that my previous praise was woefully inadequate. Clearly, magic is the superior art form to theft.
:{{A|vo lnlq001 3 lyney 26.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Don't worry, I didn't take offense. I just wanted to take the opportunity to perhaps change some of the preconceived notions you might have about magicians.
:{{A|vo lnlq001 3 lyney 27.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Since Cesar's death, a lot of people associate magicians with criminality. It can be quite frustrating.
:{{A|vo lnlq001 3 charlotte 07.ogg}} '''Charlotte:''' I can imagine. Um, coming back to your trick just now — might I presume that you are well-versed in floral symbolism?
:{{A|vo lnlq001 3 charlotte 08.ogg}} '''Charlotte:''' For example, magicians often use "Rainbow Roses" in their flower-related performances to represent "passion" and "romantic encounters."
:{{A|vo lnlq001 3 charlotte 09.ogg}} '''Charlotte:''' But you used a Lumidouce Bell, which, if I'm not mistaken, allude to "separations." I'm curious to know if there was any deeper meaning behind this choice?
:{{A|vo lnlq001 3 lyney 28.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Impressive knowledge — it's no wonder you're such a successful journalist. But I'm afraid I don't know the first thing about floral symbolism. I'm just in the habit of using Lumidouce Bells in my magic.
:{{A|vo lnlq001 3 lyney 29.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' It sounds like something I should look into though. I'll buy myself a copy of "Fontaine's Floral Language Facts" when I have some time — but it'll have to wait until this Phantom Weasel business is behind us.
:{{A|vo lnlq001 3 charlotte 10.ogg}} '''Charlotte:''' Well-noted... In that case, this brings us to the end of our interview. I, for one, am looking forward to the final showdown between you and the thief.
:{{A|vo lnlq001 3 charlotte 11.ogg}} '''Charlotte:''' Please feel free to get in touch to update me on any further developments. Otherwise, I will of course see you at your show in three days' time. But let's hope The Phantom Weasel is caught by then.
:{{A|vo lnlq001 3 charlotte 12.ogg}} '''Charlotte:''' If there's nothing else, I'll be off. You've given me lots to work with here, and I've got no time to lose if I wanna write that exclusive piece! I'll see you all later!
:{{A|vo lnlq001 3 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So, Lyney... Are you gonna tell us how you did that flower trick now?
:{{A|vo lnlq001 3 lyney 30.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Hehe... I'm afraid that's my little secret.
:{{A|vo lnlq001 3 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Aww... Well, magicians are entitled to their secrets... But Paimon's reeeally itching to know how it's done...
:{{A|vo lnlq001 3 paimon 12.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You feel it too, right? So itchy!
:{{DIcon}} The Phantom Weasel...
:{{DIcon}} You sure you'll be able to handle him?
:{{A|vo lnlq001 3 lyney 31.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Hehe, not so itchy then, huh?
:{{A|vo lnlq001 3 lyney 32.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Well, since you're so concerned, how you would like to serve as my temporary magician's assistants, and help me investigate?
:{{A|vo lnlq001 3 paimon 13.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Magician's assistants? That sounds fun! Assistants are technically magicians too!
:{{A|vo lnlq001 3 paimon 14.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Also, it'll bring us one step closer to figuring out how that darn trick is done! Shall we go for it?
:{{DIcon}} We'll help you with your investigation.
::{{A|vo lnlq001 3 lyney 33a 1.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Excellent. Thank you for putting your trust in moi.
:{{DIcon}} What's your plan?
:{{A|vo lnlq001 3 lyney 34.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' The first thing we need to look into is who Cesar really was. If he truly was The Phantom Weasel, that means that the weasel is dead, and whoever wrote this warning letter is just a copycat criminal.
:{{A|vo lnlq001 3 lyney 35.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' But if he wasn't The Weasel... Well, that'll make things more interesting. It would mean that The Weasel lives, and he's been laying low all this time in some corner of Fontaine.
:{{A|vo lnlq001 3 lyney 36.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' And if we're investigating Cesar, his fiancée, Jemma, is a good place to start. Word is that she visits the cemetery often, so I asked [[Lynette]] to wait for her there.
:{{A|vo lnlq001 3 lyney 37.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' We should make a move. Let's go and rendezvous with Lynette.
:;(Obtain {{Item|Gift of "Parting"}})
----
{{Dialogue End}}
{{Quest Description|update|You decide to investigate the truth behind the Phantom Weasel. Cesar's fiancée, Jemma, is a good place to start.}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Approach the marked area)
:{{A|vo lnlq001 4 lynette 01.ogg}} '''Lynette:''' ...You took your time.
:{{A|vo lnlq001 4 lyney 01.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Sorry. I bumped into {{Traveler}} and Charlotte en route, and we ended up chatting for a while.
:{{A|vo lnlq001 4 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' It's been a while, Lynette!
:{{A|vo lnlq001 4 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' We're working as Lyney's temporary assistants in the investigation of The Phantom Weasel!
:{{A|vo lnlq001 4 lynette 02.ogg}} '''Lynette:''' Thank you. It's good to have you helping.
:{{A|vo lnlq001 4 lyney 02.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' So, what's the situation? Have you seen Jemma?
:{{A|vo lnlq001 4 lynette 03.ogg}} '''Lynette:''' Nope. I've been here a while, and she still hasn't shown up.
:{{A|vo lnlq001 4 lyney 03.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' How bizarre. Maybe it was bad intel?
:{{A|vo lnlq001 4 lyney 04.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Well, we won't get anywhere by standing around waiting. {{Traveler}}, Paimon, let's go ask around.

;(Talk to Lynette, optional) 
:{{A|vo dialog lnlq001 lynette 01.ogg}} '''Lynette:''' I'll wait for you here and see if Jemma shows up.

;(Talk to [[Gracia]] or [[Juliano]], optional) 
:{{A|vo dialog lnlq001 gracia 01.ogg}} '''Gracia:''' A lot of people here today, huh. When did this cemetery get so popular?
:{{A|vo dialog lnlq001 juliano 01.ogg}} '''Juliano:''' Same thoughts here. What's going on...

;(Talk to [[Baltasar]]) 
:{{A|vo lnlq001 5 lyney 01.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Excuse me good sir, do you by any chance know a Jemma?
:{{A|vo lnlq001 5 baltasar 01.ogg}} '''Baltasar:''' Jemma? You mean Cesar's fiancée? Sure I do... What's this about?
:{{A|vo lnlq001 5 lyney 02.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' I'm just trying to get ahold of her, because I need her help with something. I heard she comes here a lot?
:{{A|vo lnlq001 5 baltasar 02.ogg}} '''Baltasar:''' Yeah, she does. *sigh* Poor thing... It's no secret why, either. She's heartsick.
:{{A|vo lnlq001 5 baltasar 03.ogg}} '''Baltasar:''' Ever since Cesar passed away, she's been coming here once every week to clean his grave. Often, she just sits there in front of his headstone, lost in thought. Sometimes she talks to herself.
:{{A|vo lnlq001 5 baltasar 04.ogg}} '''Baltasar:''' I asked her what she was doing once. She said... she wanted to speak to him again.
:{{A|vo lnlq001 5 baltasar 05.ogg}} '''Baltasar:''' She knows he's gone, and can't hear her from the grave, but... She just likes to spend time there, telling her fiancé all about how her life is going.
:{{A|vo lnlq001 5 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' And she's been doing this ever since Cesar passed away? So, ten years? Wow. Their love must've been really strong.
:{{A|vo lnlq001 5 baltasar 06.ogg}} '''Baltasar:''' I'll bet. Cesar's reputation fell apart after his identity was revealed, so no one else visits his grave... Jemma's the only one who still thinks about him after all these years.
:{{A|vo lnlq001 5 baltasar 07.ogg}} '''Baltasar:''' I don't know if the mind lives on in the waters after death, but if it does... I'm sure Cesar must be grateful to have someone who remembers him fondly.
:{{A|vo lnlq001 5 baltasar 08.ogg}} '''Baltasar:''' If I'm honest, I think this is all so unfair to poor Jemma. Her fiancé was a lowlife crook — he doesn't deserve someone like her.
:{{A|vo lnlq001 5 baltasar 09.ogg}} '''Baltasar:''' Anyway, all of that said — she's running later than usual today. Normally, she'd be sitting in front of his grave by now. I wonder if she's okay?
:{{A|vo lnlq001 5 baltasar 10.ogg}} '''Baltasar:''' Well, that's everything I know, I'm afraid. You might have more luck asking some other people.
:{{A|vo lnlq001 5 lyney 03.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Alright, well thanks for sharing all of this with us. We'll keep asking around.
:{{A|vo lnlq001 5 baltasar 11.ogg}} '''Baltasar:''' You're welcome. *sigh* ...I just hope she'll be able to move on one day.

;(Talk to Baltasar again, optional) 
:{{A|vo dialog lnlq001 baltasar 01.ogg}} '''Baltasar:''' A lot of people find cemeteries bleak and oppressive, but not me.
:{{A|vo dialog lnlq001 baltasar 02.ogg}} '''Baltasar:''' I find the silence gives me a sense of peace. And something about being in the presence of the dead and buried... It sorta puts all of life's woes in perspective.

;(Talk to Gracia or Juliano) 
:{{A|vo lnlq001 7 gracia 01.ogg}} '''Gracia:''' Did you hear the news? They're saying The Phantom Weasel's back.
:{{A|vo lnlq001 7 juliano 01.ogg}} '''Juliano:''' You're kidding... Wait, isn't he dead?
:{{A|vo lnlq001 7 gracia 02.ogg}} '''Gracia:''' I dunno anymore. All sorts of news flying around nowadays. I can never tell what's true and what isn't.
:{{A|vo lnlq001 7 gracia 03.ogg}} '''Gracia:''' But what if... Just hypothetically, I mean... What if this Weasel's the real deal, and Cesar was framed?
:{{A|vo lnlq001 7 juliano 02.ogg}} '''Juliano:''' Called it. Seriously, ten years ago, on the day it all went down, I said to myself "You know what? This guy's been set up." The Cesar I knew was a good guy. He gave balloons to children on the street, for Pete's sake. What, are we supposed to believe that he was a balloon thief, or something? Gimme a break.
:{{A|vo lnlq001 7 gracia 04.ogg}} '''Gracia:''' Oh please. Weren't you the one cursing his name to high heaven when the police announced the news!? You were all, "That gosh-darn lousy son of a... You think you know a guy..." Or words to that effect.
:{{A|vo lnlq001 7 juliano 03.ogg}} '''Juliano:''' Wait, did I say that? Hmm. I don't seem to recall...
:{{DIcon}} Sorry to interrupt...
:{{A|vo lnlq001 7 lyney 01.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Hello there. Sorry for disturbing you, but I couldn't help but notice you were discussing The Phantom Weasel?
:{{A|vo lnlq001 7 lyney 02.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' We're actually quite interested in this topic as well, but we're struggling to get to the bottom of it. Do you think you could spare a moment to tell us a little bit about Cesar?
:{{A|vo lnlq001 7 juliano 04.ogg}} '''Juliano:''' You've come to the right people. Yep... I was there. Back when Cesar used to perform magic tricks on the street.
:{{A|vo lnlq001 7 juliano 05.ogg}} '''Juliano:''' He was a great magician. The best trick I ever saw him do was pop a transparent balloon, only for a whole bunch of doves to fly out from the inside.
:{{A|vo lnlq001 7 juliano 06.ogg}} '''Juliano:''' I was right up close and didn't blink or look away once. But for the life of me, I still don't have the faintest clue how he pulled it off. Really incredible stuff.
:{{A|vo lnlq001 7 gracia 05.ogg}} '''Gracia:''' I saw him perform too. He always used to bring some gifts along for the kids who came to watch his show, and he'd hand them out after he was done.
:{{A|vo lnlq001 7 gracia 06.ogg}} '''Gracia:''' Sometimes, he even got the kids to write their wishes down, and then he'd make the items on the "wishlist" appear in his next show.
:{{A|vo lnlq001 7 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh, he doesn't sound like such a bad guy...
:{{A|vo lnlq001 7 gracia 07.ogg}} '''Gracia:''' But after he died, there were also rumors that he used the wishlist to find out what was precious to people, with the intent to steal it later.
:{{A|vo lnlq001 7 gracia 08.ogg}} '''Gracia:''' ...As I'm sure you know, The Phantom Weasel would steal just about anything from anyone.
:{{A|vo lnlq001 7 juliano 07.ogg}} '''Juliano:''' Whatever the case, now that The Weasel is back, Cesar's become a hot topic once more.
:{{A|vo lnlq001 7 juliano 08.ogg}} '''Juliano:''' I bet Jemma must be pleased. If Cesar's name gets cleared, maybe it'll finally give her some solace after all this time.
:{{A|vo lnlq001 7 juliano 09.ogg}} '''Juliano:''' Oh, speak of the devil — that's her over there. If you've got any more questions about Cesar, she's definitely the one to ask.
:{{A|vo lnlq001 7 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So that's Jemma... Is it just Paimon, or does it look like something's wrong?
:{{A|vo lnlq001 7 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wait... It looks like she's injured! C'mon, let's see if she's okay!
:;(The group walks up to Jemma, who is standing in front of a tombstone)
:{{A|vo lnlq001 8 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Uh... Hi there. You're Jemma, right?
:{{A|vo lnlq001 8 gemma 01.ogg}} '''Jemma:''' ...Who's asking?
:{{A|vo lnlq001 8 lyney 01.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Don't be afraid, we mean no harm.
:{{A|vo lnlq001 8 lyney 02.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' It looks like you're injured. How bad is it?
:{{A|vo lnlq001 8 gemma 02.ogg}} '''Jemma:''' Thanks for your concern, but you didn't answer my question. Who are you? And what do you want with me?
:{{A|vo lnlq001 8 lyney 03.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' My name is Lyney, and this is my sister Lynette.
:{{A|vo lnlq001 8 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' My name's Paimon, and this here's {{Traveler}}. We're investigating The Phantom Weasel.
:{{A|vo lnlq001 8 lyney 04.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' The Weasel posted a warning letter this morning. If he still lives, that means that Cesar was falsely accused.
:{{A|vo lnlq001 8 lyney 05.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' You knew Cesar better than anyone else. So if you're willing, we'd love to hear what you think about all this.
:{{A|vo lnlq001 8 gemma 03.ogg}} '''Jemma:''' ...
:{{A|vo lnlq001 8 lyney 06.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' I promise you can trust us. We won't hurt you — in fact, we'll do all we can to keep you safe.
:{{A|vo lnlq001 8 gemma 04.ogg}} '''Jemma:''' I... I never believed that he was The Weasel.
:{{A|vo lnlq001 8 lyney 07.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Huh, I suspected as much. Okay, so going back ten years, do you remember anything strange in the weeks leading up to the accident? Did Cesar have a falling out with anyone, for instance?
:{{A|vo lnlq001 8 gemma 05.ogg}} '''Jemma:''' ...No. Not that I know of.
:{{A|vo lnlq001 8 lynette 01.ogg}} '''Lynette:''' ...
:{{A|vo lnlq001 8 lyney 08.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Got it. Alright, sorry for disturbing you.
:{{A|vo lnlq001 8 gemma 06.ogg}} '''Jemma:''' If you don't have any more questions, please leave. I want to be alone with him.
:{{A|vo lnlq001 8 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Judging by the look on her face, there's definitely something fishy about her...
:{{A|vo lnlq001 8 lynette 02.ogg}} '''Lynette:''' She's lying. She definitely knows something.
:{{DIcon}} Perhaps she simply doesn't trust us.
:{{A|vo lnlq001 8 lyney 09.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' That's fair. We're just a bunch of strangers who showed up and started questioning her about things that happened a whole decade ago... It makes sense that she'd be wary around us.
:{{A|vo lnlq001 8 lyney 10.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' In any case, I doubt we'll get any further here, so let's call it a day. Meet me outside Hotel Debord tomorrow, and then we'll start the next step of our plan.

:{{A|vo dialog lnlq001 juliano 02.ogg}} '''Juliano:''' Jemma's hurt, you say?

:{{A|Vo jyeq103 3 angoulvant 13.ogg}} '''Angoulvant:''' I still have a chance to help my son straighten himself out — but only if I get back. If I go to prison now, he'll be doomed, I tell you, doomed!
:{{A|Vo jyeq103 3 angoulvant 14.ogg}} '''Angoulvant:''' And isn't standing together and fighting for a better future what families do?
:{{A|Vo jyeq103 3 angoulvant 15.ogg}} '''Angoulvant:''' Our fate is in your hands, young man. Please, have a heart!
:{{A|Vo jyeq103 3 kinich 05.ogg}} '''Kinich:''' ...
:{{A|Vo jyeq103 3 ajaw 01.ogg}} '''Ajaw:''' Haha, something wrong, Kinich? Gone soft, have we?
:{{A|Vo jyeq103 3 kinich 06.ogg}} '''Kinich:''' Hmph.
:{{A|Vo jyeq103 3 kinich 07.ogg}} '''Kinich:''' I don't believe a word you say.
:{{A|Vo jyeq103 3 kinich 08.ogg}} '''Kinich:''' Wriothesley had you just about figured out — you're a gambler, pure and simple.
:{{A|Vo jyeq103 3 angoulvant 16.ogg}} '''Angoulvant:''' A gambler? Me? Nonsense! I told you, it's... it's my son—
:{{A|Vo jyeq103 3 kinich 09.ogg}} '''Kinich:''' First of all, are you really from Natlan?
:{{A|Vo jyeq103 3 kinich 10.ogg}} '''Kinich:''' You've been keeping tabs on the gun's whereabouts this whole time — you should have recognized [[Heroes of Natlan|at least one familiar face]] by now.
:{{A|Vo jyeq103 3 kinich 11.ogg}} '''Kinich:''' On top of that, the way you threatened to sue me? Spoken like a true Fontainian, if you ask me.
:{{A|Vo jyeq103 3 angoulvant 17.ogg}} '''Angoulvant:''' Huh? What kind of logic is that...
:{{A|Vo jyeq103 3 angoulvant 18.ogg}} '''Angoulvant:''' I—I can explain! I... I actually grew up in, in—
:{{A|Vo jyeq103 3 kinich 12.ogg}} '''Kinich:''' Tsk. I don't wanna hear another word.
:{{A|Vo jyeq103 3 kinich 13.ogg}} '''Kinich:''' Ajaw, here's your chance. Shut someone else up for once.
:{{A|Vo jyeq103 3 ajaw 02.ogg}} '''Ajaw:''' Hahahahaha, the moment I've been waiting for!
:{{A|Vo jyeq103 3 ajaw 03.ogg}} '''Ajaw:''' Eat this, scumbag!
:{{A|Vo jyeq103 3 kinich 14.ogg}} '''Kinich:''' Being a compulsive liar is one of the hallmarks of a diehard gambler.
:{{A|Vo jyeq103 3 kinich 15.ogg}} '''Kinich:''' I bet you're just a Fontainian pretending to be from Natlan. Even if you have any friends or family to speak of, I'm guessing they've long since cut all ties with you — and you have your depraved ways to thank for that.
:;(Ajaw beats up Angoulvant during the next four lines)
:{{A|Vo jyeq103 3 kinich 16.ogg}} '''Kinich:''' Of course, I might be wrong.
:{{A|Vo jyeq103 3 kinich 17.ogg}} '''Kinich:''' But does that matter?
:{{A|Vo jyeq103 3 kinich 18.ogg}} '''Kinich:''' I'm just here to arrest you. If you're looking for an advocate or a shoulder to cry on, you're out of luck.
:{{A|Vo jyeq103 3 kinich 19.ogg}} '''Kinich:''' Besides, prying the truth out of you is exactly what your beloved courts are for. Isn't that right?
:;(The Traveler and Chevreuse walk up.)
:'''Chevreuse:''' That's right.
:{{Introductory Note|Chevreuse}}
:'''Chevreuse:''' It's been a while, Mr. Kinich. The Special Patrol will take this criminal off your hands now.
:{{A|Vo jyeq103 3 kinich 20.ogg}} '''Kinich:''' Many thanks.
:'''Chevreuse:''' Please. I should be the one thanking you for all the help you've given us.
:{{A|Vo jyeq103 3 ajaw 04.ogg}} '''Ajaw:''' And me? Hmm, hmm? What about me? Hmph, so rude! You should be bowing down in gratitude to the Almighty Dragonlord!
:'''Chevreuse:''' As you wish. My thanks to you, and also to Mr. Cacucu, for your show-stopping performances.
:{{A|Vo jyeq103 3 ajaw 05.ogg}} '''Ajaw:''' Hey, what do you mean!? Hold it right there!
:{{DIcon}} Are you okay, Kinich?
:{{A|Vo jyeq103 3 kinich 21.ogg}} '''Kinich:''' Don't worry, I'm fine. I wasn't the one who just got dragged all the way here.
:{{DIcon}} You seemed a little upset just now.
:{{A|Vo jyeq103 3 ajaw 06.ogg}} '''Ajaw:''' Pfft... Little Kinich, thinking back to when you were just an itty bitty boy Kinich, aren't ya?
:{{A|Vo jyeq103 3 ajaw 07.ogg}} '''Ajaw:''' Aw, don't start crying like a little baby! I am the Almighty Dragonlord! No servant of mine will be seen acting so weak and pathetic in public!
:{{A|Vo jyeq103 3 kinich 22.ogg}} '''Kinich:''' What are you on about...
:{{DIcon}} Bad Ajaw, bad.
:{{A|Vo jyeq103 3 kinich 23.ogg}} '''Kinich:''' Still, I suppose there's no point hiding it from you. To put it plainly, I can't stand gamblers.
:{{A|Vo jyeq103 3 kinich 24.ogg}} '''Kinich:''' They're the most irresponsible people in the entire world... No respect for the principle that you have to give in order to get.
:{{A|Vo jyeq103 3 kinich 25.ogg}} '''Kinich:''' They'll tell a thousand lies for a single coin, deluding themselves into thinking they can use it to gamble their way to a vast fortune.
:{{A|Vo jyeq103 3 kinich 26.ogg}} '''Kinich:''' But we all know that even when it looks like you're getting something for free, there's always an unseen cost.
:{{A|Vo jyeq103 3 kinich 27.ogg}} '''Kinich:''' In the past, I also ended up paying a price for my father's gambling losses. I don't want anyone else to end up in a similar situation if I can help it.
:{{DIcon}} Kinich...
:{{A|Vo jyeq103 3 kinich 28.ogg}} '''Kinich:''' Don't feel sorry for me. I certainly don't feel sorry for myself.
:{{A|Vo jyeq103 3 kinich 29.ogg}} '''Kinich:''' They say that people are shaped by their past. And since I've made it this far... I must have done a lot of things right.
:{{A|Vo jyeq103 3 kinich 30.ogg}} '''Kinich:''' We should never punish ourselves for the mistakes of others.
:{{A|Vo jyeq103 3 kinich 31.ogg}} '''Kinich:''' Instead, I choose to remember the moments that helped me grow.
:<gallery>
The Price of Every Price Quest Still 1.png
</gallery>
:{{A|Vo jyeq103 3 kinich 32.ogg}} '''Kinich:''' Like when I first learned to use a grappling hook...
:<gallery>
The Price of Every Price Quest Still 2.png
</gallery>
:{{A|Vo jyeq103 3 kinich 33.ogg}} '''Kinich:''' Or the very first time I yearned for knowledge.
:{{DIcon}} I get it.
:{{A|Vo jyeq103 3 kinich 34.ogg}} '''Kinich:''' Yeah, I believe in you.
:{{A|Vo jyeq103 3 kinich 35.ogg}} '''Kinich:''' Let's get going. If we don't head back soon, we'll cause more unnecessary worry.

;(Talk to Charlotte or Paimon)
:{{A|Vo jyeq103 4 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yay, {{Traveler}}, Kinich, you're back!
:{{A|Vo jyeq103 4 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' We just saw Chevreuse taking the criminal away. She looked pretty pleased with herself!
:{{DIcon}} Well, it did go smoother than expected.
:{{DIcon}} Our opponent was pretty weak.
:{{A|Vo jyeq103 4 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hehe, so after so much running in circles, turns out he had no fight in him, huh? Guess running away was the only trick up his sleeve!
:{{A|Vo jyeq103 4 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, also, Wriothesley said to let you know that he's already left. He went to report back to the Palais Mermonia.
:{{A|Vo jyeq103 4 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Apparently, the Marechaussee Phantom's preparing to carry out an in-depth investigation into illegal gambling activities. Sounds like they'll have their hands full...
:{{A|Vo jyeq103 4 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Anyway, that's for the Palais to worry about. Not really our concern.
:'''Charlotte:''' Judging by how fast the Duke took off, I'd say he was avoiding my Kamera!
:'''Charlotte:''' *sigh* But I guess I'm used to that by now...
:{{A|Vo jyeq103 4 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hey, it's not like you to give up so easily, Charlotte!
:'''Charlotte:''' Hehe, it's fine — I got plenty of other great shots back there. More than enough for a front-page spread!
:'''Charlotte:''' And on that note, this busy reporter needs to scoot. Those photos won't develop themselves!
:{{A|Vo jyeq103 4 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Make sure you pick the best shots of Paimon!
:{{A|Vo jyeq103 4 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, already gone... Hope she heard that...
:{{DIcon}} You can trust her judgment, Paimon. She's a professional photographer.
:{{A|Vo jyeq103 4 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yeah, you're right!
:{{A|Vo jyeq103 4 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' But what took you all so long to get here? Did something happen?
:{{DIcon}} Ajaw bonked his head and started crying.
::{{A|Vo jyeq103 4 ajaw 01a 1.ogg}} '''Ajaw:''' What!?
::{{A|Vo jyeq103 4 ajaw 01a 2.ogg}} '''Ajaw:''' Rumors and slander!
::{{A|Vo jyeq103 4 ajaw 01a 3.ogg}} '''Ajaw:''' When have I, the Almighty Dragonlord, K'uhul Ajaw, ever sunk to such sniveling?
::{{A|Vo jyeq103 4 kinich 01a 1.ogg}} '''Kinich:''' Often, actually.
::{{DIcon}} Anyway... What's next?
:{{DIcon}} Kinich hit his head and started crying.
::{{A|Vo jyeq103 4 kinich 01b 1.ogg}} '''Kinich:''' If you say so.
::{{A|Vo jyeq103 4 ajaw 01b 1.ogg}} '''Ajaw:''' Hahaha! Poor little Kinich! No one was there to pat him on the head, so he went off to cry all on his own...
::{{A|Vo jyeq103 4 paimon 12b 1.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' For real, now? Seems more likely that Ajaw was the one crying...
::{{A|Vo jyeq103 4 ajaw 01b 2.ogg}} '''Ajaw:''' Hey, you little—!
::{{DIcon}} Anyway... What's next?
:{{A|Vo jyeq103 4 kinich 02.ogg}} '''Kinich:''' Hmm... To be honest, I haven't decided yet.
:{{A|Vo jyeq103 4 kinich 03.ogg}} '''Kinich:''' At the moment, I've got nothing urgent to get back for. And in any case, the court might need me to testify again.
:{{A|Vo jyeq103 4 kinich 04.ogg}} '''Kinich:''' Plus, that gun's still a key piece of evidence. I'll probably have to wait until the case is closed before I can return it to Natlan.
:{{A|Vo jyeq103 4 kinich 05.ogg}} '''Kinich:''' So I guess I'll be sticking around to enjoy the beach a little longer.
{{Dialogue End}}

==Steps==
# Go to the [[Beret Society]]'s gathering place
# Chat with the members of the Beret Society (0/3)
# Return to the Beret Society's gathering place
