:{{A|vo eqhdj501 2 qiqi 09.ogg}} '''Qiqi:''' [[Changsheng]] told me about it, but now... I forgot...
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 2 yaoyao 09.ogg}} '''Yaoyao:''' It's an old myth from [[Chenyu Vale]] about a giant toad in the sky that eats the moon.
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 2 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What!? The moon gets eaten!?
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 2 yaoyao 10.ogg}} '''Yaoyao:''' It's just a story! It's not like there's actually a giant toad in the sky.
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 2 yaoyao 11.ogg}} '''Yaoyao:''' I asked Master about it, and she said myths are just... insights into how the people of the past understood the world.
:{{DIcon}} So did the moon really disappear?
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 2 yaoyao 12.ogg}} '''Yaoyao:''' Well, I didn't see it that night... But I've checked several nights since, and it's been there same as ever.
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 2 yaoyao 13.ogg}} '''Yaoyao:''' According to Qiqi, though, the [[Ministry of Civil Affairs]] sent someone to do some kind of serious investigation. So, I don't know... Maybe something did happen.
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 2 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' The Ministry of Civil Affairs? This is starting to sound bad...
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 2 qiqi 10.ogg}} '''Qiqi:''' It's okay, you can fly. Even if it's too dark, you won't fall and get hurt.
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 2 yaoyao 14.ogg}} '''Yaoyao:''' Yeah, exactly! So turn that frown upside down, Paimon, or someday you'll get a whole bunch of wrinkles and wake up looking like an old granny!
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 2 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What? Okay, okay... No more frowning!
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 2 paimon 08a.ogg}} {{A|vo eqhdj501 2 paimon 08b.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' But {{Traveler}} can't fly... {{MC|m=He|f=She}} could still fall and hurt {{MC|m=himself|f=herself}}, right?
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 2 yaoyao 15.ogg}} '''Yaoyao:''' Don't worry. That's what the Xiao Lanterns are for. As long as we make enough, Liyue Harbor will never go dark.
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 2 qiqi 11.ogg}} '''Qiqi:''' Yeah, and there's the giant lantern too.
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 2 yaoyao 16.ogg}} '''Yaoyao:''' Oh right, I almost forgot! Look, this year's grand lantern commemorates the [[adeptus]] who guards the moon! With her watching over it, the moon will be safe for sure!
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 2 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' A white horse? Wait, so that's... the [[White Horse Adeptus]]?
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 2 yaoyao 17.ogg}} '''Yaoyao:''' Yeah! Legend has it, she used to live on the moon, so if it were ever in danger, I'm sure she wouldn't just stand by and watch.
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 2 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh, we've heard of the White Horse Adeptus before. But we never heard the part about her living on the moon...
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 2 yaoyao 18.ogg}} '''Yaoyao:''' Probably because it's a folk legend from Chenyu Vale, so not a lot of people know about it.
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 2 yaoyao 19.ogg}} '''Yaoyao:''' But recently, some ancient artifacts were unearthed in Liyue, and the archaeological team even found evidence of ancient people worshiping an adeptus who lived in a palace on the moon!
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 2 yaoyao 20.ogg}} '''Yaoyao:''' It's kinda like how we write wishes on Xiao Lanterns and release them during Lantern Rite.
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 2 yaoyao 21.ogg}} '''Yaoyao:''' The White Horse Adeptus would descend from the moon in her jade carriage and grant people's wishes.
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 2 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Whoa! When did that happen? She sounds different from the other adepti in Liyue...
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 2 yaoyao 22.ogg}} '''Yaoyao:''' It must have been a super long time ago, 'cause even Master barely knows anything about this adeptus.
:{{DIcon}} So [[Madame Ping]] has never met the White Horse Adeptus either?
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 2 yaoyao 23.ogg}} '''Yaoyao:''' Nope! Kinda unbelievable, right? [[Yanfei]] said the White Horse Adeptus might even be a made-up legend, just like Zhanzhu the Moon-Devourer.
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 2 qiqi 12.ogg}} '''Qiqi:''' Yeah, a made-up horse and a made-up toad...
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 2 luweng 01.ogg}} '''???:''' You're mistaken, children. The White Horse Adeptus really does exist.
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 2 yaoyao 24.ogg}} '''Yaoyao:''' Oh, Mr. [[Lu Weng|Lu]] from the [[Baiju Guesthouse]]! But... How do you know that for sure?
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 2 luweng 02.ogg}} '''Lu Weng:''' Have you ever wondered how the guesthouse got its name, Yaoyao?
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 2 yaoyao 25.ogg}} '''Yaoyao:''' Huh, "bai, ju"... White... colt... So it's named after the White Horse Adeptus?
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 2 luweng 03.ogg}} '''Lu Weng:''' That's right! And that's because one of my ancestors was once blessed by the White Horse Adeptus.
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 2 paimon 12.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wait, really? Tell us more, tell us more!
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 2 luweng 04.ogg}} '''Lu Weng:''' It was a long, long time ago, when this ancestor of mine was still a young girl. She was out gathering herbs and accidentally fell off a cliff, but the White Horse Adeptus rescued her.
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 2 paimon 13.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh... That's it? Paimon was expecting something a bit more... special? We've heard a whole bunch of stories like that before...
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 2 luweng 05.ogg}} '''Lu Weng:''' Patience, young one. Let me finish... After the White Horse Adeptus saved my ancestor, she told her a story about the moon and the ancient kingdom of [[Lang-Gan]]...
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 2 luweng 06.ogg}} '''Lu Weng:''' My ancestor was so captivated that she completely lost track of time... So much so, in fact, that when she returned to her village, she found nothing but a desolate ruin in its place...
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 2 luweng 07.ogg}} '''Lu Weng:''' It was as if, without her knowledge, countless years had passed in the mortal world...
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 2 yaoyao 26.ogg}} '''Yaoyao:''' Eh!?
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 2 luweng 08.ogg}} '''Lu Weng:''' The most extraordinary part of all is that... it turned out to be a dream. When she woke up, she found herself at the bottom of the cliff, right where she had fallen!
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 2 luweng 09.ogg}} '''Lu Weng:''' Other than her medicine basket, now filled to the brim with rare herbs, it was as if nothing had happened, until out of nowhere...
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 2 luweng 10.ogg}} '''Lu Weng:''' A horse's whinny echoed through the air, and when she looked up, she saw a pristine white horse leaping over the cliff.
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 2 qiqi 13.ogg}} '''Qiqi:''' A white horse... leaping over the cliff...
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 2 paimon 14.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wow, that sure is a crazy story. But now it's starting to sound a bit too far-fetched...
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 2 luweng 11.ogg}} '''Lu Weng:''' Hmph, another skeptic. You sound just like my son. But I know it's true... Ancestral records don't lie.
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 2 yaoyao 27.ogg}} '''Yaoyao:''' Wait, so... Your son doesn't believe it happened?
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 2 luweng 12.ogg}} '''Lu Weng:''' *sigh* Don't get me started. Not believing is one thing, but he even wants to change the name of our guesthouse! It's a disgrace, I tell you... a disgrace!
:{{DIcon}} Why does he want to change the name?
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 2 luweng 13.ogg}} '''Lu Weng:''' Well, it was getting about time for him to take over the guesthouse, and what's the first thing he does? Starts going on about how the name doesn't attract enough customers, and how we're losing business to [[Wangshu Inn]].
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 2 luweng 14.ogg}} '''Lu Weng:''' Can you believe that? As if Baiju Guesthouse and Wangshu Inn aren't miles apart from each other!
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 2 paimon 15.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oooh, what about something like... the "Geo Lord's Rest"? Paimon bets that would get people through the doors!
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 2 qiqi 14.ogg}} '''Qiqi:''' "Geo Lord's Rest"... I like that one...
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 2 luweng 15.ogg}} '''Lu Weng:''' This isn't about getting people through the doors! This is about disrespecting our ancestors!
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 2 luweng 16.ogg}} '''Lu Weng:''' *sigh* O White Horse Adeptus, my wish is this... Let your divine power be known. Teach my foolish son the error of his ways.
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 2 paimon 16.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Paimon wants to learn more about this adeptus... Hey, maybe we should ask [[Zhongli]]!
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 2 yaoyao 28.ogg}} '''Yaoyao:''' Good idea! Mr. Zhongli is super knowledgeable. He can answer questions even Master has no clue about!
:{{DIcon}} Any idea where we can find him?
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 2 yaoyao 29.ogg}} '''Yaoyao:''' Yeah! We just saw him having tea at [[Third-Round Knockout]]!
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 2 paimon 17.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Alright, then that's our next stop!
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 2 yaoyao 30.ogg}} '''Yaoyao:''' Qiqi and I are gonna keep making Xiao Lanterns. Careful on the road!
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 2 qiqi 15.ogg}} '''Qiqi:''' Goodbye, Paimon. Goodbye, {{Traveler}}.

;(Approach [[Lan Yan]], [[Keqing]], and [[Ningguang]] at [[Yujing Terrace]])
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 5 ningguang 01.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' Your grandfather is of the same opinion, Miss Lan Yan?
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 5 lanyan 01.ogg}} '''Lan Yan:''' Yes. "On Lantern Rite, the moon shall go dark." That's what the signs are indicating.
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 5 lanyan 02.ogg}} '''Lan Yan:''' Celestial observation isn't Grandpa's strong suit, but he discussed it with several other elders from our clan, and their conclusion was the same.
:{{Introductory Note|Lan Yan}}
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 5 keqing 01.ogg}} '''Keqing:''' It's consistent with the information we've received from other sources as well.
:{{Introductory Note|Keqing}}
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 5 lanyan 03.ogg}} '''Lan Yan:''' You mean the whole thing about the legend of "Zhanzhu the Moon-Devourer" happening in real life?
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 5 keqing 02.ogg}} '''Keqing:''' Yes, that's one of them...
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 5 lanyan 04.ogg}} '''Lan Yan:''' So it's true... I thought it was just a rumor.
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 5 keqing 03.ogg}} '''Keqing:''' It's true. But right now, the bigger issue is that all our sources indicate the phenomenon's gonna happen again. I'm not sure this bodes well...
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 5 ningguang 02.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' Let's remain optimistic for now. We're making progress interpreting the artifacts, and [[Ganyu]] is consulting with the adepti as we speak.
:{{Introductory Note|Ningguang}}
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 5 ningguang 03.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' Besides, apart from the incident at Wanmin Restaurant, there haven't been any other moon-related disturbances.
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 5 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ningguang, Keqing, and Lan Yan! You're all here!
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 5 lanyan 05.ogg}} '''Lan Yan:''' Oh, {{Traveler}} and Paimon! It's been a while! Happy Lantern Rite!
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 5 keqing 04.ogg}} '''Keqing:''' Yes, happy Lantern Rite! What brings you here, though? I thought you'd be in the harbor enjoying the Xiao Lanterns.
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 5 ningguang 04.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' Hmm, you're certainly not the type to visit Yujing Terrace for no reason. Is there something I can help you with?
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 5 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What, we're not allowed to just drop in on our friends during the festive season?
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 5 ningguang 05.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' I was only teasing. You're welcome to visit us anytime you wish. Happy Lantern Rite.
:{{DIcon}} Happy Lantern Rite!
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 5 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, and about all the moon business you were just talking about... We have something to show you. Here, take a look.
:<gallery widths="350">
The Realm of Clouds Quest Still 1.png
</gallery>
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 5 lanyan 06.ogg}} '''Lan Yan:''' Whoa, something really did take a chunk out of the moon!
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 5 ningguang 06.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' Someone managed to capture a picture of it? Is this... Zhanzhu the Moon-Devourer, then?
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 5 keqing 05.ogg}} '''Keqing:''' Even though we confirmed this event took place, I still can't quite believe what I'm seeing... Where did you get this picture?
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 5 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' From Xiangling! She found it when she was cleaning up after that customer caused a scene. She thinks they must've dropped it.
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 5 lanyan 07.ogg}} '''Lan Yan:''' Wait, is this... [[Chiwang Terrace]]?
:{{DIcon}} Yeah, is something wrong?
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 5 lanyan 08.ogg}} '''Lan Yan:''' No, no, it's just... Where I'm from, it's said that Chiwang Terrace was where the ancient people of Chenyu Vale communicated with the heavens.
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 5 lanyan 09.ogg}} '''Lan Yan:''' And in this picture, the moon happens to be right above Chiwang Terrace. I was just surprised, that's all... It's probably just a coincidence.
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 5 ningguang 07.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' That's interesting because... the ancient people of Chenyu Vale migrated there from the Chasm area.
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 5 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' [[The Chasm (Subregion)|The Chasm]]? So that place is involved too?
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 5 keqing 06.ogg}} '''Keqing:''' According to our investigation, that customer you just mentioned, Lu Xiangxiang... Her father and grandfather are merchants in Liyue Harbor, and her mother and grandmother grow tea in [[Qiaoying Village]].
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 5 keqing 07.ogg}} '''Keqing:''' A few days ago, she left her home in Qiaoying Village to join a civilian archaeological team funded by [[Huishan Hall]], and ended up excavating some artifacts in the Chasm area.
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 5 keqing 08.ogg}} '''Keqing:''' These artifacts were then entrusted to Xigu Antiques, and are set to be featured in an upcoming exhibition. Then, of course, the incident at Wanmin Restaurant occurred.
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 5 keqing 09.ogg}} '''Keqing:''' We suspect something happened during the excavation that left her with quite the shock.
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 5 ningguang 08.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' And now, it seems like she also went to Chiwang Terrace and took that picture of the moon disappearing.
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 5 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' The Chasm... Chiwang Terrace... Things are getting pretty complicated!
:{{DIcon}} How's Lu Xiangxiang doing now?
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 5 keqing 10.ogg}} '''Keqing:''' She's not in a good mental state, so we took her to Bubu Pharmacy to get some help.
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 5 keqing 11.ogg}} '''Keqing:''' Why don't you come with me to check up on her? At this point, you seem invested in this case too.
:{{DIcon}} Gladly.
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 5 keqing 12.ogg}} '''Keqing:''' Then let's head there now.

;(Talk to Lan Yan or Ningguang, optional)
:{{A|vo dialog eqhdj501 ningguang 01.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' Hmm... Now that I see this picture, it looks less like a piece of the moon was eaten, and more like something is obscuring it...
:{{A|vo dialog eqhdj501 lanyan 01.ogg}} '''Lan Yan:''' But what sort of thing could block out the moon?

;(Approach [[Baizhu]] at Bubu Pharmacy)
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 6 baizhu 01.ogg}} '''Baizhu:''' Ah, Lady Yuheng. Oh, and {{Traveler}} and Paimon are here as well.
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 6 changsheng 01.ogg}} '''Changsheng:''' What a pleasant surprise. Happy Lantern Rite.
:{{DIcon}} Happy Lantern Rite.
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 6 keqing 01.ogg}} '''Keqing:''' I hope we're not interrupting, Dr. Baizhu.
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 6 baizhu 02.ogg}} '''Baizhu:''' Not at all. I assume you're here to see the patient? Unless it's urgent, however, it would be best not to disturb her rest.
:{{DIcon}} Is her condition that bad?
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 6 baizhu 03.ogg}} '''Baizhu:''' It's quite unstable. She's even more agitated than when she first arrived, and she refused to cooperate when we tried to check her over.
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 6 baizhu 04.ogg}} '''Baizhu:''' I had no choice but to prescribe a calming draught and have her rest for two days.
:{{Introductory Note|Baizhu}}
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 6 keqing 02.ogg}} '''Keqing:''' So she's getting worse? That isn't the news I was hoping for...
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 6 baizhu 05.ogg}} '''Baizhu:''' It's just a precaution. Based on an earlier conversation with her, it seemed more like a fixation than anything else. She hasn't lost her mind.
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 6 changsheng 02.ogg}} '''Changsheng:''' That's right. When we asked about it, she kept insisting she was going to be famous far and wide.
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 6 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Well, it might not be "far and wide," but she's certainly made a name for herself around Yujing Terrace... Even some of the [[Qixing]] know who she is!
:{{DIcon}} Have you ever seen something like this, Baizhu?
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 6 baizhu 06.ogg}} '''Baizhu:''' Not often, that's for certain. From my initial assessment, the patient appears to have experienced some sort of shock, and whatever it was seems to still be haunting her.
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 6 keqing 03.ogg}} '''Keqing:''' But, what could have caused such a thing...? The relics from The Chasm? Or the moon above Chiwang Terrace that night?
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 6 baizhu 07.ogg}} '''Baizhu:''' Come back in two days, and you might just have your answer.
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 6 keqing 04.ogg}} '''Keqing:''' I suppose that's all we can do for now. We'll take our leave then, Dr. Baizhu.
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 6 baizhu 08.ogg}} '''Baizhu:''' Of course. If you need anything else, don't hesitate to stop by.
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 6 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Speaking of those relics from The Chasm, aren't they being featured in an exhibition tonight?
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 6 keqing 05.ogg}} '''Keqing:''' That's right. Are you planning to attend?
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 6 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yeah! We wanted to have a talk with Zhongli anyway, and now Paimon's even more curious about these relics!
:{{DIcon}} Would you like to tag along?
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 6 keqing 06.ogg}} '''Keqing:''' Haha, I would, except every item in the exhibition had to be registered with the Ministry of Civil Affairs, so I'm afraid it's been spoiled for me. I reviewed them all myself.
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 6 keqing 07.ogg}} '''Keqing:''' There are some rather peculiar artifacts, that's for certain. We're still working on decoding the ancient text that appears on them.
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 6 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yeah, the word "jade" appears a whole bunch, doesn't it?
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 6 keqing 08.ogg}} '''Keqing:''' Huh? How did you know?
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 6 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Xingqiu told us! He said there were some ancient poems on them too.
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 6 keqing 09.ogg}} '''Keqing:''' He's quite well-informed, isn't he? Well, he's right. We believe they're direct references to the ancient nation of Lang-Gan.
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 6 keqing 10.ogg}} '''Keqing:''' As for the other text... Instead of regular poetry, it seems to be more like ceremonial language used to worship the moon and the gods.
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 6 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' The moon and the gods...
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 6 keqing 11.ogg}} '''Keqing:''' Well, looks like it's almost time for the exhibition. You two should head over.
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 6 keqing 12.ogg}} '''Keqing:''' There's an usher at the harbor who will lead you to the venue.
:{{DIcon}} Do we need an invitation?
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 6 keqing 13.ogg}} '''Keqing:''' Not at all. The exhibition is free to the public. The people of Liyue have a great respect for our history and are eager to learn from it.
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 6 keqing 14.ogg}} '''Keqing:''' Plus, the exhibition is being organized by Linlang, the owner of Xigu Antiques.
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 6 keqing 15.ogg}} '''Keqing:''' As far as I know, it's been a long-time goal of hers to hold a cultural exhibition of this scale, where people can learn all sorts of information about the past.
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 6 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Guess we're in for a real treat tonight, then!
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 6 keqing 16.ogg}} '''Keqing:''' Yes, have a great time. There's still more artifact-decoding work I need to finish, so we'll have to part ways here.
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 6 keqing 17.ogg}} '''Keqing:''' After seeing the picture you brought, there's a few ideas I'd like to follow up on.
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 6 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You're hard at work even during festival season, huh... You haven't changed one bit, Keqing.
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 6 keqing 18.ogg}} '''Keqing:''' I'm simply fulfilling the responsibilities of my position, that's all.
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 6 keqing 19.ogg}} '''Keqing:''' Alright, I should get going. See you later!
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 6 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Well, guess we should head over to the harbor and find that usher!

;(Talk to Baizhu, optional)
:{{A|vo dialog eqhdj501 baizhu 01.ogg}} '''Baizhu:''' If you're looking to talk to Lu Xiangxiang, you should come back in two days.

;(Try to enter the patient's room at Bubu Pharmacy)<!-- Are these available earlier? -->
:{{A|vo dialog eqhdj501 qianyana 01.ogg}} '''Lin Xing:''' The patient is resting. No disturbances, please.

::{{A|vo eqhdj501 7 manmu 02a 1.ogg}} '''Manmu:''' After you.

;(Enter the exhibition)
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 8 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Whoa, look at all the antiques on this ship! It's almost too much to take in!
:{{DIcon}} Keep an eye out for Zhongli.
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 8 zhongli 01.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Greetings. I trust you've been well since last we met.
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 8 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Aha, speak of the devil! You're right where Hu Tao said you'd be!
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 8 zhongli 02.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Ah, so Director Hu gave me away, did she...
:{{Introductory Note|Zhongli}}
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 8 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Don't act like you're up to some super secret business. We know you just do whatever you feel like...
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 8 beidou 01.ogg}} '''Beidou:''' Yo, {{Traveler}}, Paimon! What's up!
:{{Introductory Note|Beidou}}
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 8 yunjin 01.ogg}} '''Yun Jin:''' It's been a while, you two! Happy Lantern Rite!
:{{Introductory Note|Yun Jin}}
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 8 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' [[Beidou]]! [[Yun Jin]]! It's great to see you! You're here for the exhibition too?
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 8 yunjin 02.ogg}} '''Yun Jin:''' Yes! When I heard these artifacts were from ancient times, I just knew I had to come learn more about them. I mean, what a discovery, right?
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 8 beidou 02.ogg}} '''Beidou:''' Yeah, Ningguang pretty much said the same thing. She thought coming here might help "culture" me up, or something.
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 8 beidou 03.ogg}} '''Beidou:''' But as you know, I'm more of a fists and punches type of person. I doubt one exhibition is gonna change that, haha...
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 8 yunjin 03.ogg}} '''Yun Jin:''' You're too modest, Captain. You're the leader of the [[Crux Fleet]]. That takes far more skill than just fists and punches.
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 8 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Plus, at the end of the day, you still decided to come, even though you didn't have to listen to Ningguang.
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 8 beidou 04.ogg}} '''Beidou:''' Heh, well she's the Tianquan. If she can't even get an average ship captain like me to do her bidding, how's that gonna look?
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 8 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You sure know how to think from her perspective, huh...
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 8 beidou 05.ogg}} '''Beidou:''' Haha, I guess I do. Anyway, how's everyone enjoying the exhibition?
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 8 beidou 06.ogg}} '''Beidou:''' I heard that if you see something you like, you can negotiate the price with the owner and take it home.
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 8 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wait, so we can buy this stuff?
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 8 zhongli 03.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Indeed. Although Xigu Antiques is hosting this exhibition, many of the items come from private collectors. As long as both parties reach an agreement, you can make an offer of [[Mora]] or an equivalent trade.
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 8 zhongli 04.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Well, shall we continue our conversation as we look around?
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 8 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Let's go! Paimon's super curious about all this stuff!

;(Follow Paimon to the stand with the painting)<!-- approach marked location -->
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 9 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Whoa, look at this painting! There's a huge toad on it! Could it be...
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 9 yunjin 01.ogg}} '''Yun Jin:''' Huh, this material is quite unusual — it doesn't look like paper. More like silk or some other kind of fabric.
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 9 beidou 01.ogg}} '''Beidou:''' Yeah, I was thinking the same thing.
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 9 zhongli 01.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Heh, well-spotted. This is a painting of Zhanzhu the Moon-Devourer, made primarily with mulberry silk. Such craftsmanship is rarely seen in modern-day Liyue.
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 9 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hah, Zhanzhu the Moon-Devourer! Paimon knew it! That toad made it super obvious.
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 9 beidou 02.ogg}} '''Beidou:''' What's that? A new dish at Wanmin Restaurant?
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 9 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' No, hehehe... It's a kind of lunar eclipse! You heard about how the moon disappeared recently, right?
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 9 beidou 03.ogg}} '''Beidou:''' Oh, yeah... You're saying a toad did that?
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 9 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' That's what the legend says!
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 9 beidou 04.ogg}} '''Beidou:''' Hah, so nothing to do with food, then. Noted.
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 9 yunjin 02.ogg}} '''Yun Jin:''' And the figure next to the toad... Is that the White Horse Adeptus? From the stories I've heard, her palace lies on the moon.
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 9 zhongli 02.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' That would seem to be a logical assumption.
:{{DIcon}} Was this excavated from The Chasm?
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 9 zhongli 03.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' No. In fact, this item was discovered in Chenyu Vale, and many years ago at that.
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 9 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, so it's from Chenyu Vale?
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 9 zhongli 04.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Actually, that's not quite right. You see, this painting is primarily comprised of mineral-based pigments such as cinnabar and azurite, which are usually found within stratified rock.
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 9 zhongli 05.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' This suggests its place of origin may very well have been The Chasm.
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 9 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You could have just started with that!
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 9 yunjin 03.ogg}} '''Yun Jin:''' You're as knowledgeable as ever, Mr. Zhongli. I had only ever heard the legend of Zhanzhu the Moon-Devourer, but now seeing it depicted in this painting, I wonder...
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 9 yunjin 04.ogg}} '''Yun Jin:''' If I purchased it, perhaps it could serve as inspiration for a new opera. Though I'm not quite sure who the painting belongs to right now...
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 9 zhongli 06.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' A splendid idea, Ms. Yun. Perhaps, in lieu of Mora, you could offer the lyrics to said opera as recompense?
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 9 yunjin 05.ogg}} '''Yun Jin:''' The lyrics? But, to whom...?
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 9 zhongli 07.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Why, to me of course. I am the owner of this painting, after all.
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 9 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wait, so you're one of the private collectors at the exhibition? No wonder you knew so much about the painting...
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 9 yunjin 06.ogg}} '''Yun Jin:''' But... lyrics in exchange for a precious antique? My work could never possibly be of equal value.
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 9 beidou 05.ogg}} '''Beidou:''' Mm, I don't know about that. I'm not much of a scholar, but even I know your operas are in a league of their own.
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 9 zhongli 08.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' An astute observation, Captain Beidou. In my possession, this painting is nothing but a lifeless artifact.
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 9 zhongli 09.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' In your hands, however, it could be transformed into a new piece of art entirely. Quite the worthy exchange, no?
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 9 yunjin 07.ogg}} '''Yun Jin:''' But I'm not sure when I'll be able to finish writing it. It certainly won't be ready this year...
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 9 zhongli 10.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Allow me to be equally forthright, Ms. Yun — this silk painting is merely a copy I made of the original work. There is no need for such concern over its value.
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 9 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh? So it's a fake!?
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 9 yunjin 08.ogg}} '''Yun Jin:''' I had no idea you were such a skilled artist, Mr. Zhongli. I pride myself on having some knowledge of antiques, but I didn't notice anything that would point to it being a replica.
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 9 beidou 06.ogg}} '''Beidou:''' Hahaha! You never cease to amaze me, Mr. Zhongli.
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 9 zhongli 11.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' You flatter me. All that said, Ms. Yun, you must accept. Truly, I insist.
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 9 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hmph... He's gone from handing out fake Mora to fake paintings now, huh...
:{{DIcon}} Shh...
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 9 yunjin 09.ogg}} '''Yun Jin:''' Your kindness is impossible to refuse, Mr. Zhongli. Rest assured, I'll be sure to return the favor.
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 9 zhongli 12.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' I shall look forward to it.
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 9 beidou 07.ogg}} '''Beidou:''' Man, that was quite the find. Heh, I should buy something too, if only so I can show it off to Ningguang.
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 9 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hehe, let's keep going and see what we can find!
<!-- black screen transition -->
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 10 beidou 01.ogg}} '''Beidou:''' Wow, this bronze war chariot is really something.
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 10 yunjin 01.ogg}} '''Yun Jin:''' Hmm, it must have quite the story behind it. I've never seen anything like it before.
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 10 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Do you know what this is, Zhongli?
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 10 zhongli 01.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Ah, I heard from Miss Linlang that a carriage made of celadon jade was unearthed in The Chasm.
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 10 zhongli 02.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' A copper canopy, a body adorned with flowing clouds and geometric patterns... Yes, this must be the one. A precious piece indeed.
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 10 beidou 02.ogg}} '''Beidou:''' This thing's gotta be thousands of years old, right? Crazy to think people back then were capable of such intricate metalwork.
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 10 zhongli 03.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Too often, we view the past and future through the lens of the present. Objects that fascinated us as children seem crude later in life, and that's only after a few decades or so of separation.
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 10 zhongli 04.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' If one were to stretch time across hundreds or thousands of years... one might discover that time is not always a force that pushes things forward.
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 10 yunjin 02.ogg}} '''Yun Jin:''' It would seem the people of that era managed to create a remarkable civilization in their own right.
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 10 beidou 03.ogg}} '''Beidou:''' Heh, makes me wanna get my hands on this even more. Ningguang's gonna be so jealous, don't you think?
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 10 linglang 01.ogg}} '''Linlang:''' Ah, has this war chariot caught your eye, Captain Beidou?
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 10 beidou 04.ogg}} '''Beidou:''' Oh, you must be Linlang from Xigu Antiques. Nice to meet you! This exhibition has been amazing so far.
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 10 linglang 02.ogg}} '''Linlang:''' Well, that's all thanks to supportive patrons like you, and Mr. Zhongli of course.
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 10 linglang 03.ogg}} '''Linlang:''' As for this war chariot, it was discovered by an archaeological team sponsored by Huishan Hall. The price comes in at 90 million Mora.
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 10 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' H—How much!?
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 10 beidou 05.ogg}} '''Beidou:''' Ninety million? Ha! Looks like my eyes were a bit too big for my wallet...
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 10 zhongli 05.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Hmm... Quite a bargain.
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 10 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' A bargain!? 90 million Mora could feed Paimon for like... a thousand years!
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 10 yunjin 03.ogg}} '''Yun Jin:''' Heh, and if you actually went on an eating spree that long, perhaps you'd be considered an antique worth that kind of Mora too.
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 10 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What, 90 million? Nuh-uh, Paimon's worth way more than that!
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 10 beidou 06.ogg}} '''Beidou:''' Hahaha, well if Mr. Zhongli thinks it's a good deal, I'm sure it's worth it.
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 10 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Beidou's putting way too much faith in Zhongli. What if he's only here to drive up sales!?
:{{DIcon}} Shh.
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 10 beidou 07.ogg}} '''Beidou:''' I'll take the chariot, Miss Linlang. Someone will come by with the payment.

:{{A|vo eqhdj501 11 zhongli 02.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Well, you may not know, Paimon, but before the "Rainjade Rite" came into practice, Chenyu Vale was known for a different ceremonial tradition that also involved jade.
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 11 zhongli 03.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' The Bi is used to honor Heaven, the Cong to honor Earth, the Gui to honor the East, the Zhang to honor the South, the Hu to honor the West, and the Huang to honor the North. These form the Six Ritual Jades.
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 11 zhongli 04.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' It's unfortunate, however, that Miss Linlang's set is missing both the Gui and Hu pieces.
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 11 linglang 02.ogg}} '''Linlang:''' I know. These jade artifacts are from such an ancient time, it's proved difficult to track them down, even for our establishment.
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 11 zhongli 05.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' No matter. You happen to have precisely the piece I was looking for.
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 11 linglang 03.ogg}} '''Linlang:''' Huh? This broken jade token? I didn't expect this to catch your eye, Mr. Zhongli. It isn't one of the Six Ritual Jades.
:{{DIcon}} What is it?
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 11 zhongli 06.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' An effect belonging to an old acquaintance of mine...

:{{A|vo eqhdj501 11 zhongli 07.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Heh, you could say that. {{Traveler}}, take a closer look.

:{{A|vo eqhdj501 11 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh, it doesn't look all that special to Paimon. Just seems like a broken artifact.
:{{DIcon}} There's a crescent moon.
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 11 zhongli 08.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Indeed. It's been thousands of years since the moon has appeared in such a form.
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 11 linglang 05.ogg}} '''Linlang:''' So, in the past, the moon wasn't always full? Then... Could this missing chunk be from when Zhanzhu devoured part of the moon?
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 11 zhongli 09.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Mmm... It's worth looking into.
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 11 linglang 06.ogg}} '''Linlang:''' Your insight is invaluable, Mr. Zhongli. I had no idea how special this piece was.
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 11 linglang 07.ogg}} '''Linlang:''' Since it has caught your interest, allow Xigu Antiques to cover the cost.
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 11 zhongli 10.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' That is far too generous, Miss Linlang.
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 11 linglang 08.ogg}} '''Linlang:''' Not at all. I've always wanted to give people a chance to appreciate these snapshots of history, so holding an exhibition like this has been a lifetime wish of mine.
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 11 linglang 09.ogg}} '''Linlang:''' And it never would have been possible without your help, Mr. Zhongli.
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 11 zhongli 11.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' I merely put in a good word with a few acquaintances of mine.
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 11 linglang 10.ogg}} '''Linlang:''' And it had a profound impact. Without your recommendation, I doubt half of these collectors would have come to the exhibition. So, on both a personal and professional level, I owe you my thanks, Mr. Zhongli.

:{{A|vo eqhdj501 16 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wait, weren't we going to rest? Why did you bring us here?
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 16 zhongli 01a.ogg}} {{A|vo eqhdj501 16 zhongli 01b.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Because I imagine {{Traveler}} would like to know what just happened to {{MC|m=him|f=her}}.
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 16 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh right. Ugh, Paimon's confused though. She could've sworn you were there the whole time!
:{{Black Screen|You explain your mysterious encounter in that strange space.}}
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 16 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' H—How is that possible?
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 16 zhongli 02a.ogg}} {{A|vo eqhdj501 16 zhongli 02b.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' It sounds like {{MC|m=his|f=her}} spirit formed an inexplicable connection with the being in that space.
:{{DIcon}} Was it the White Horse Adeptus?
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 16 zhongli 03.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Ah, you suspected from the beginning, didn't you? Indeed, the being you met is the fabled White Horse Adeptus, and the original owner of this jade token. Her name is [[Zibai]].
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 16 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wait, does that mean... she's inside this token!?
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 16 zhongli 04.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' No, she does not reside within this token, but rather... within the moon's shadow. This token is merely a medium.
:{{DIcon}} The moon's shadow? What do you mean?
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 16 zhongli 05.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Word has it, you accomplished quite the feat in Nod-Krai. You and your friend... brought the [[Frost Moon]] back to Teyvat.
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 16 zhongli 06.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Tell me, did you ever wonder about the other moon, the one that hung in its place for thousands of years?
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 16 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' We never really thought about it, but... it must have been a fake, right? A fake moon!
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 16 zhongli 07.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Indeed, it was false — its true nature nothing but a projection of the moon. It also happens to be the prison that confines Zibai to this day.
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 16 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wait, the White Horse Adeptus is trapped inside that projection!? Then, we need to rescue her!
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 16 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' But... the moon in the sky right now is the real one, right? Where did the fake moon go, and why can't Paimon see it?
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 16 zhongli 08.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' With the return of the true moon, the shadow naturally lost its place in the heavens. Now, it is disintegrating bit by bit. It's a process that comes and goes.
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 16 zhongli 09.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' When it occurs, it looks like the moon is being obscured by a black shadow. But when it stops, the shadow disappears and becomes invisible to the eye.
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 16 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' ...So you're saying there's an invisible fake moon blocking the real moon, right now?
:{{DIcon}} So, the recent lunar eclipse... It was the fake moon, wasn't it?
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 16 zhongli 10.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Indeed.
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 16 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Okay, this is not what Paimon was expecting!
:{{DIcon}} You said it's disintegrating. When will there be nothing left?
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 16 zhongli 11.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' My hypothesis is that people's wishes could be what trigger the periods of disintegration. After all, when you experienced that episode just now, it was precisely when Miss Linlang spoke of her own wish.
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 16 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wait, is that because the White Horse Adeptus answers people's wishes? The legend must be true, then.
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 16 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So, that means the more wishes we make, the faster the fake moon will disintegrate, right? Then it won't be long before the White Horse Adeptus is free!
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 16 zhongli 12.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Quite the contrary. After countless years trapped inside, the two have merged into one. When the moon's shadow is gone, Zibai will cease to exist in this world.
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 16 paimon 12.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh no... So, by bringing the moon back, we actually... hurt the White Horse Adeptus!?
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 16 zhongli 13.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Do not burden yourself with such thoughts. Because of your actions, a promising opportunity has presented itself to us — let us not forget, what is crumbling is also precisely that which imprisons her.
:{{DIcon}} So there's still a way to fix this?
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 16 zhongli 14.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Yes, and that is why I invited you here tonight. Your connection to that broken jade token confirms that you can do what I envision.
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 16 zhongli 15.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' However, while I had hoped to receive your assistance, this matter could have significant ramifications...
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 16 zhongli 16.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' I must admit a certain... reluctance to implicate you in more of Teyvat's secrets. Often, the deeper one's knowledge of such matters, the harder it becomes to extricate oneself from them.
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 16 zhongli 17.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' You are someone who once traveled through the boundless [[sea of stars]]. I cannot help but wonder... Perhaps it is wrong for your fate to become too entangled with the fate of any one world...
:{{DIcon}} I already know a bunch of secrets.
:{{DIcon}} I'm already deeply connected to Teyvat.
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 16 zhongli 18.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Hmm... Such is your conviction, then. Since journeying beyond Liyue, you have had ample time to reflect on these matters, it would seem.
:{{DIcon}} Yes. So, tell me what I need to do.
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 16 zhongli 19.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Very well. The first secret I must reveal is that Zibai has long since passed away. The being within the shadowmoon is merely one of the Three Deadly Selves she severed before her death.
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 16 paimon 13.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wait, the White Horse Adeptus is dead!? Weren't you supposed to tell us how to fix this? Now, it just seems even more impossible...
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 16 zhongli 20.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Please remain calm, Paimon, and allow me to explain.
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 16 zhongli 21.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' The Three Deadly Selves is a practice used by those engaged in spiritual cultivation. The intent is to sever the three vice-laden mortal selves to reveal one's true, pure self beneath. However, Zibai's Three Selves are more complicated in nature.
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 16 zhongli 22.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Because in the moment before her death, someone preserved the shattered essence of her soul, and placed the fragments within her Three Deadly Selves.
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 16 zhongli 23.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' If we retrieve the three fragments of her soul, there is a chance we can restore her presence in the mortal realm.
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 16 paimon 14.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So that means... we can bring her back to life!?
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 16 zhongli 24.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Yes, provided we retrieve the fragments of her soul's essence from the Three Deadly Selves.
:{{DIcon}} I'm guessing I just met one of them.
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 16 zhongli 25.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Indeed. The being you encountered was Zibai's First Deadly Self, Ziju. After Zibai's death, she ascended to the heavens and became one with the shadowmoon.
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 16 zhongli 26.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' The essence that resides within her is a Heavenly Soul, also known as Taiguang. Thus, this Self is the closest to Zibai's true nature.
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 16 zhongli 27.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' That said, because she is trapped within the shadowmoon, we have no choice but to seek out the other two soul essences first. Then, we can unite them as one.
:{{DIcon}} Okay, so... where are the other two?
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 16 zhongli 28.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Her Second Deadly Self is called Zizhi. After Zibai's death, she fell into a slumber deep beneath the earth in what is now known as The Chasm.
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 16 zhongli 29.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' The essence within her is the Earth Soul, also known as Shuangling. She is the Self that inherited most of Zibai's memories and wisdom.
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 16 paimon 15.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' The Chasm... So, do we have to go there to find her?
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 16 zhongli 30.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' That won't be necessary. I sensed her presence on the jade carriage from earlier, the one at the exhibition.
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 16 zhongli 31.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' It's possible the return of the Frost Moon awakened her, and she emerged from the Chasm alongside that batch of ancient artifacts.
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 16 paimon 16.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wait, that must be why you agreed to help with the exhibition... To investigate the artifacts!
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 16 zhongli 32.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Indeed. So in truth, Miss Linlang was the one who helped me.
:{{DIcon}} What about the last Deadly Self?
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 16 zhongli 33.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' The Third Deadly Self is Ziqiao. The essence within her is the Human Soul — also known as Youjing, Zibai's shade. Thus, she is the most free-spirited among the three.
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 16 zhongli 34.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' She lent me her aid during the Archon War a thousand years ago. But later, as her powers waned, she retreated into the mountains.
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 16 zhongli 35.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' I imagine finding Ziqiao should prove the most troublesome, so I shall take it upon myself to track her down.
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 16 paimon 17.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So we need to find the Second Deadly Self, right? But where do we even start?
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 16 zhongli 36.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Locating her should not prove difficult. In life, Zibai was fond of mortals, and as the Self who inherited most of her memories and wisdom, {{Sic|Ziju|expected=Zizhi}} should be the same.<!--add note?-->
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 16 zhongli 37.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' It's possible she has possessed someone and is meandering the bustling streets of Liyue Harbor as we speak.
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 16 paimon 18.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Possessed someone? Wait... Are you thinking what Paimon's thinking, {{Traveler}}?
:{{DIcon}} The customer who caused a scene at Wanmin Restaurant.
:;(The Traveler recalls Hu Tao's words)
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 16 hutao 01.ogg}} '''Hu Tao:''' What if she raided a tomb and dug up some super special relic, then got herself haunted by an ancient ghost!
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 16 paimon 19.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Exactly! Lu Xiangxiang!
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 16 zhongli 38.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' It seems you have a lead in mind already.
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 16 paimon 20.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' She'd still be at Bubu Pharmacy! She was super agitated when she first got there, so Baizhu gave her some calming medicine and told us to come back in two days.
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 16 paimon 21.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Do you think it could be her, Zhongli?
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 16 zhongli 39.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' It's quite possible. The Deadly Selves are impure beings that can easily influence mortal minds...
:{{DIcon}} Let's start our investigation there in two days.
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 16 zhongli 40.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' A sound plan. Well, I should get started on my own investigation, then.
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 16 paimon 22.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wha— You're leaving already?
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 16 zhongli 41.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' I must. Ziqiao went into hiding after the Archon War. If I am to have any success tracking her down — and there is no guarantee — I should start sooner rather than later.
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 16 paimon 23.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' But there's still so much you haven't told us... Like who the White Horse Adeptus actually is, and how she died in the first place...
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 16 paimon 24.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Not to mention who it was that preserved the fragments of her soul...
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 16 zhongli 42.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Should our endeavor prove successful, then naturally, those answers will follow. If not, speaking of them would be rather meaningless.
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 16 paimon 25.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' ...
:{{DIcon}} The one who preserved her soul's essence... Was it you?
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 16 zhongli 43.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' ...It would seem that this is a question you are unwilling to set aside. Very well, I shall tell you.
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 16 zhongli 44.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' ...It was the avatar of Time.
:{{DIcon}} [[Istaroth]]!?
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 16 zhongli 45.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Ah, so you know of her existence.
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 16 paimon 26.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' The Ruler of Time saved her soul...
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 16 zhongli 46.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Indeed. Preserving what remained of Zibai's soul in the moment before her death... Only the power of time could be capable of such a thing.
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 16 zhongli 47.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' However, there is no telling what effect it has had on the Three Deadly Selves. In other words, you must exercise caution when seeking out Zizhi.
:{{DIcon}} How much time do we have?
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 16 zhongli 48.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' On the night of Lantern Rite, countless Xiao Lanterns — and the wishes written upon them — will be released into the sky. I estimate that this event will trigger the shadowmoon's collapse.
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 16 zhongli 49.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' When that happens, the cage that confines the First Deadly Self will open. That is our moment to act, but also the moment where all could be lost.
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 16 zhongli 50.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' For if we fail to retrieve the other two soul fragments in time, Zibai's resurrection is hopeless.
:{{DIcon}} Understood.
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 16 zhongli 51.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' As I mentioned before, the answers to your remaining question should come in time, providing our efforts bear fruit.
:{{A|vo eqhdj501 16 zhongli 52.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Let us hope that all proceeds smoothly in the days to come.

;(Pass over the bridge in the domain)
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 3 ziqiao 01.ogg}} '''???:''' Who could have imagined that the once mighty [[Geo]] [[Archon]] might end up so? Sitting on a humble stool in the woods, quietly weaving Moon Lanterns...
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 3 ziqiao 02.ogg}} '''???:''' You really do look like an old man now.
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 3 zhongli 01.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' This is a Xiao Lantern, not a Moon Lantern.
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 3 ziqiao 03.ogg}} '''???:''' Hmm?
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 3 zhongli 02.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' In ages past, when the gods waged war and the world was in turmoil, these lanterns were lit to guide fallen warriors back to their homes.
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 3 zhongli 03.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Had you tarried in the mortal realm for but a little while longer, you might have become quite accustomed to them.
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 3 ziqiao 04.ogg}} '''???:''' Even so, it bears such a striking resemblance to the Moon Lanterns they used to offer up to the heavens. Could this truly be mere coincidence?
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 3 zhongli 04.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Perhaps in some sense it is, yet in another, it isn't.
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 3 zhongli 05.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' For instance, who is to say that some of [[Lang-Gan]]'s magnificent jade did not become part of the very foundations upon which Liyue Harbor now stands?
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 3 zhongli 06.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' It is conceivable that this ritual was transmitted in such a manner, too.
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 3 ziqiao 05.ogg}} '''???:''' Now, now... Let's not let ourselves get carried away. For all its splendor, do not forget that in the end, even Lang-Gan could not escape its heaven-sent fate.
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 3 ziqiao 06.ogg}} '''???:''' Alas, it is just a pity that the little creatures of this world may never again lift their eyes to the moon, even should misfortune befall them...
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 3 ziqiao 07.ogg}} '''???:''' But you, Geo Lord, now that you rule this realm — why take the trouble, not to mention the risk, to visit one who bears such profound guilt as I?
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 3 ziqiao 08.ogg}} '''???:''' Are you not afraid that you might be sullied by the curse of time that was laid upon me?
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 3 zhongli 07.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' There is no risk to speak of — at least, not in comparison to that which you took when you defied [[Heavenly Principles|the heavens]] all that time ago.
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 3 ziqiao 09.ogg}} '''???:''' Tch. As I have stated, time and again, it was not I who defied the heavens.
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 3 ziqiao 10.ogg}} '''Ziqiao:''' Geo Lord, the ancient affairs of Lang-Gan have nothing to do with me, for I am but one of her Deadly Selves, severed before her demise. My name is not [[Zibai]], but Ziqiao.
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 3 ziqiao 11.ogg}} '''Ziqiao:''' Surely you did not take us for one and the same solely on the basis that we may all assume the form of white horses?
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 3 ziqiao 12.ogg}} '''Ziqiao:''' Sorry to break it to you, but you seem to have found yourself the wrong white horse.
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 3 ziqiao 13.ogg}} '''Ziqiao:''' Anyway, do tell me — what urgent matter brings you here?
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 3 zhongli 08.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Very well, then... I have come to ask for Zibai's shade.
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 3 ziqiao 14.ogg}} '''Ziqiao:''' Oh? So the Geo Lord has set his sights upon Zibai's human soul... And what is it that you intend to do with it?
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 3 zhongli 09.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' The world outside is changing. With the [[Columbina|new moon]]'s birth, the confines of the shadowmoon are gradually disintegrating. In other words, the Heavenly Soul is set to return.
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 3 zhongli 10.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Consequently, strange phenomena have manifested within Lang-Gan's former domain, leading to the Earthly Soul's reappearance as well. The last of the trio, the Human Soul, is in your possession.
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 3 ziqiao 15.ogg}} '''Ziqiao:''' Most intriguing...
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 3 zhongli 11.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' My intention is to gather all three together so that an old friend may finally make her return.
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 3 ziqiao 16.ogg}} '''Ziqiao:''' I must admit, it seems that some remarkable affairs are coming to pass in the outside world. Yet there is one thing you seem to have overlooked, Lord of Geo.
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 3 ziqiao 17.ogg}} '''Ziqiao:''' Back in the day, it was you that freed me from that painting — and afterwards, I took up arms in your name. Together, we first subdued [[Chenyu Vale]], then brought peace to Mt. Qingce. It was for this cause that the contract between us was made.
:;(Zibai gazes at an old painting on a nearby desk)
:<gallery>Painting Zijiao Zhanzhu.png</gallery>
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 3 ziqiao 18.ogg}} '''Ziqiao:''' But now that the debt has been repaid, what cause have you to expect my aid?
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 3 zhongli 12.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Zibai and I have long been friends. Given not only that you were manifested from a corrupt desire within her divine form, but that you also possess a fragment of her soul, how can you purport to be "the wrong" white horse?
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 3 ziqiao 19.ogg}} '''Ziqiao:''' Ha... I think you'll find that we are now as separate and distinct as any two beings ever were. What once shone with radiant purity has long become dust... what you see is no longer what it was.
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 3 ziqiao 20.ogg}} '''Ziqiao:''' O great Lord of Geo, should this still be unclear to you, I bid you take your leave.
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 3 zhongli 13.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Mm... It seems that the fault lies in my own lack of consideration. As you wish, I shall let this matter rest.
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 3 ziqiao 21.ogg}} '''Ziqiao:''' Wait... One moment, if you will. Should this not be your opportunity to propose a new contract? The part where you make me an offer I simply couldn't refuse?
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 3 ziqiao 22.ogg}} '''Ziqiao:''' Even those puny mortals know how to haggle when striking their bargains. Should you, the famed God of Contracts, not likewise strive for success through negotiation?
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 3 ziqiao 23.ogg}} '''Ziqiao:''' Come now, enough with the posturing. It's time to name your price.
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 3 zhongli 14.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Very well. I had, in truth, prepared a new contract for your consideration.
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 3 ziqiao 24.ogg}} '''Ziqiao:''' Hah! I knew you would not come before me unprepared.
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 3 ziqiao 25.ogg}} '''Ziqiao:''' Yet you should know that I want for nothing, for I live in the mountains carefree and untroubled. Occasionally, I even find sport in teasing the mortals who stumble into my presence.
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 3 zhongli 15.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Then why persist in telling them those ancient stories? I speak of what transpired before the sky collapsed and the earth sank into itself.
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 3 ziqiao 26.ogg}} '''Ziqiao:''' That is merely my way of passing the time. And what of it? Would any believe, much less remember, the ramblings of a mountain hermit?
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 3 zhongli 16.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Those tales have long since spread throughout the mortal realm.
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 3 ziqiao 27.ogg}} '''Ziqiao:''' ...
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 3 zhongli 17a.ogg}}<!--{{A|vo eqhdj503 3 zhongli 17b.ogg}}--> '''Zhongli:''' Should my words prove insufficient, I invite you to see the world for yourself. To this end, I have found you a pair of trusty guides.
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 3 zhongli 18.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' The Lantern Rite is presently underway in Liyue, and should prove quite intriguing for you.
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 3 ziqiao 28.ogg}} '''Ziqiao:''' So this, then, is the "contract" you have prepared for me?
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 3 zhongli 19.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Indeed it is. Think of it as... a contract for a one-day festive excursion.
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 3 ziqiao 29.ogg}} '''Ziqiao:''' Surely you do not hope to offer this in exchange for Zibai's shade? The foundation of my very existence for a little excursion seems a little steep, wouldn't you say?
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 3 zhongli 20.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Why not see for yourself? You can always decide afterwards. The final determination, of course, shall rest with you.
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 3 ziqiao 30.ogg}} '''Ziqiao:''' Is that so? Then perhaps this deal might not be entirely off the table, after all. Hmm... Where, then, are these "guides" of which you speak?
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 3 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hey, it's Zhongli! We've been looking for you everywhere... We thought you might've gone missing!
:{{DIcon}} And this is...?
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 3 zhongli 21.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' You're here.

:{{A|vo eqhdj503 5 xiangling 09.ogg}} '''Xiangling:''' Anyway... Even if it is just a costume, is it alright if I still call you "White Horse Adeptus"?
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 5 ziqiao 03.ogg}} '''Ziqiao:''' Of course it's "alright," because that's exactly who I am.
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 5 xiangling 10.ogg}} '''Xiangling:''' Hehe, okay, okay... I can see you're really committed to the role! How about I call you "The Real White Horse Adeptus" instead?
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 5 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hah... In that case, you can call Paimon "The Real {{Traveler}}"!
:{{DIcon}} Guess that makes me "The Real Paimon."
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 5 xiangling 11.ogg}} '''Xiangling:''' Haha, yeah right. You could've at least switched outfits!
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 5 ziqiao 04.ogg}} '''Ziqiao:''' Hmph, puny mortals. Nevertheless, I suppose it might be amusing to indulge in your little charade, for a while at least...
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 5 xiangling 12.ogg}} '''Xiangling:''' Alright, go grab yourselves a table! I'll come take your order in a bit.
