:{{A|vo eqhdj503 6 luxiangxiang 01.ogg}} '''Lu Xiangxiang:''' Hello... May I ask if Miss Xiangling and Chef Mao are here?
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 6 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yeah, they're just over there! Wait a sec, aren't you...?
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 6 xiangling 01.ogg}} '''Xiangling:''' So, what would you like to— Huh? You're...
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 6 luxiangxiang 02.ogg}} '''Lu Xiangxiang:''' Hello, Miss Xiangling... It's me, Lu Xiangxiang. The one who broke some stuff here at your restaurant a few days ago.
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 6 luxiangxiang 03.ogg}} '''Lu Xiangxiang:''' I just wanted you to know how sorry I am... I honestly don't know what came over me. Please, please forgive me...
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 6 chefmao 01.ogg}} '''Chef Mao:''' Oh, it's you! You really gave me a fright that day, young lady! You didn't actually get food poisoning from our [[Black-Back Perch Stew]], right...?
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 6 xiangling 02.ogg}} '''Xiangling:''' C'mon Dad, she's come to say sorry...
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 6 xiangling 03.ogg}} '''Xiangling:''' It's alright, Miss Lu. You must've been feeling a bit off that day. You're looking so much better now, though!
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 6 xiangling 04.ogg}} '''Xiangling:''' Why don't you grab a table too? This one's on the house!
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 6 luxiangxiang 04.ogg}} '''Lu Xiangxiang:''' No, I couldn't possibly...
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 6 xiangling 05.ogg}} '''Xiangling:''' Hey, it's totally okay! We all feel under the weather sometimes, especially when we're away from home. Go on, find yourself a—
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 6 xiangling 06.ogg}} '''Xiangling:''' ...Uh, yikes, looks like all the tables are taken...
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 6 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wanna come sit with us? We've got an extra seat over here!
:{{DIcon}} Must be fate, huh?
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 6 xiangling 07.ogg}} '''Xiangling:''' Thanks guys! So, what would you like to eat today? Feel free to order anything you like!
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 6 ziqiao 01.ogg}} '''Ziqiao:''' Hmm... I should very much like to sample your renowned Poisonous Black-Back Perch Stew.
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 6 luxiangxiang 05.ogg}} '''Lu Xiangxiang:''' I—It wasn't poisoned... That was all on me...
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 6 xiangling 08.ogg}} '''Xiangling:''' Ahaha... So that's one portion of Black-Back Perch Stew. How about you guys?
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 6 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Paimon wants... Uh...
:{{DIcon}} Since it's on the house, why don't you choose for us?
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 6 xiangling 09.ogg}} '''Xiangling:''' Sure thing! Looks like Paimon's having trouble making up her mind, hehe... Anyway, I guarantee you'll love it!
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 6 xiangling 10.ogg}} '''Xiangling:''' Let me think... Well, since the Black-Back Perch Stew is on the spicier side, I guess it makes sense to balance it out with a serving of [[Stir-Fried Shrimp]].
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 6 xiangling 11.ogg}} '''Xiangling:''' And since it's Lantern Rite season, you'd better try out the [[Triple-Layered Consommé]] and [[Come and Get It]] too. Those are our seasonal specialties!
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 6 xiangling 12.ogg}} '''Xiangling:''' As for the carbs... since we've got a full table, how about some [[Right at Home]] along with our special [[Chili-Mince Cornbread Buns]]? Trust me, you won't be disappointed!
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 6 xiangling 13.ogg}} '''Xiangling:''' Then, for dessert, I'll whip you up some [[Lucky Snow Delight]]. I just came up with it a few days ago... and I can't wait for you to try it!
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 6 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wow, sounds like quite the feast! Looks like Paimon's in luck today!
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 6 luxiangxiang 06.ogg}} '''Lu Xiangxiang:''' Am I the only one who thinks that's... way too much?
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 6 xiangling 14.ogg}} '''Xiangling:''' Not at all! Don't worry, I know what I'm doing. And to top it all off, our star dish, [[Adeptus' Temptation]]! Hehe, you should know that we don't often serve this here at Wanmin Restaurant...
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 6 xiangling 15.ogg}} '''Xiangling:''' But since this is my first time cooking for the "White Horse Adeptus," I'm pulling out all the stops!
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 6 xiangling 16.ogg}} '''Xiangling:''' Okie-dokie, just sit back and relax. I'll have your dishes out in no time!
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 6 luxiangxiang 07.ogg}} '''Lu Xiangxiang:''' Hold on... Did I just hear Miss Xiangling mention the White Horse Adeptus?
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 6 ziqiao 02.ogg}} '''Ziqiao:''' You did indeed, and you're looking right at her.
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 6 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ahem... That's a joke by the way... She's cosplaying!
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 6 luxiangxiang 08.ogg}} '''Lu Xiangxiang:''' Oh, I see... Phew, almost believed you there for a moment!
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 6 ziqiao 03.ogg}} '''Ziqiao:''' Tell me, little one — what business might you have with the White Horse Adeptus?
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 6 luxiangxiang 09.ogg}} '''Lu Xiangxiang:''' Mm... It's a long story. Basically, a while back, I took part in an archaeological dig over at [[The Chasm]]. While we were there, we discovered a number of relics.
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 6 luxiangxiang 10.ogg}} '''Lu Xiangxiang:''' Our findings show that they date back to the era of Lang-Gan, an ancient nation whose people are said to have been the ancestors of some of the modern-day inhabitants of Chenyu Vale.
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 6 ziqiao 04.ogg}} '''Ziqiao:''' And why might such matters concern the White Horse Adeptus?
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 6 luxiangxiang 11.ogg}} '''Lu Xiangxiang:''' Because some of those relics not only seem to contain textual references to her, but even depictions of what she looked like.
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 6 luxiangxiang 12.ogg}} '''Lu Xiangxiang:''' There have long been legends claiming that the White Horse Adeptus was a deity of that era, but there are plenty of other theories out there too.
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 6 luxiangxiang 13.ogg}} '''Lu Xiangxiang:''' If I could just locate some more detailed records, I'm sure we'd be able to find out so much more...
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 6 ziqiao 05.ogg}} '''Ziqiao:''' So, you're into history?
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 6 luxiangxiang 14.ogg}} '''Lu Xiangxiang:''' I... Well, to tell you the truth, I actually joined the archaeological team by sheer accident. But once I'd started down this path, I knew that I wanted to make something of myself.
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 6 luxiangxiang 15.ogg}} '''Lu Xiangxiang:''' Recently, though, things seem to have taken a turn for the worse... *sigh* Still can't believe I caused such a mess, and even ended up hurting someone...
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 6 ziqiao 06.ogg}} '''Ziqiao:''' Oh? So you're considering becoming a martial artist now instead?
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 6 luxiangxiang 16.ogg}} '''Lu Xiangxiang:''' No, no, I mean, they weren't seriously hurt! It was just a few scratches, and they let it go after my mother compensated them...
:{{DIcon}} You know, that really wasn't your fault...
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 6 luxiangxiang 17.ogg}} '''Lu Xiangxiang:''' *sigh* Either way, my career's pretty much over. And even though both the victim and the [[Ministry of Civil Affairs]] say they won't be pursuing the matter any further, my father says he's going to punish me according to our family rules.
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 6 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' F—Family rules!?
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 6 luxiangxiang 18.ogg}} '''Lu Xiangxiang:''' Yeah, he's decided to ground me. I'll have to return to [[Qiaoying Village]] after Lantern Rite, and goodness knows when I'll be allowed to leave again...
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 6 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wow, that's harsh! Sounds like the kind of thing only rich, super traditional parents would do...
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 6 luxiangxiang 19.ogg}} '''Lu Xiangxiang:''' We're not exactly "rich," though! All we own are a few tea fields in Qiaoying Village and a guesthouse in Liyue Harbor...
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 6 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' A guesthouse? It isn't... [[Baiju Guesthouse]], by any chance?
:{{DIcon}} Ahh, so [[Lu Weng|Boss Lu]] must be your...
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 6 luxiangxiang 20.ogg}} '''Lu Xiangxiang:''' Yep, he's my grandfather! So you've heard of the guesthouse before?
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 6 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Small world, huh?
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 6 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Come to think of it, didn't Boss Lu mention something about... hoping that the White Horse Adeptus would show up and "let her divine power be known"?
:{{DIcon}} (Well, she showed up alright...)
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 6 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Sure, but... Paimon's guessing this wasn't exactly what he had in mind...
:{{DIcon}} (Shh, keep it down...)
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 6 ziqiao 07.ogg}} '''Ziqiao:''' Little one, it sounds to me that your family is rather well-off, after all. What, then, drew you to archaeology? Why subject yourself to such unnecessary hardships?
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 6 luxiangxiang 21.ogg}} '''Lu Xiangxiang:''' Even if I stayed at home, there's no guarantee I'd lead a nice, easy life. Just look at my father.
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 6 luxiangxiang 22.ogg}} '''Lu Xiangxiang:''' Recently, my grandfather put him in charge of the guesthouse, and he came up with a bunch of ideas right away, starting with changing its name.
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 6 luxiangxiang 23.ogg}} '''Lu Xiangxiang:''' That didn't turn out well, though. My grandfather yelled at him for days, even calling him a bad son, and they still haven't let it go...
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 6 paimon 12.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ohhh... Paimon thinks we might've heard about that, too...
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 6 luxiangxiang 24.ogg}} '''Lu Xiangxiang:''' Long story short... Being dependent on others is never fun. You just end up being completely under their thumb.
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 6 luxiangxiang 25.ogg}} '''Lu Xiangxiang:''' That's why I want to make it on my own out here, no matter how hard it is. After all, as the saying goes, "to rise above others, one must endure the hardest of hardships."
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 6 ziqiao 08.ogg}} '''Ziqiao:''' Hahaha...
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 6 luxiangxiang 26.ogg}} '''Lu Xiangxiang:''' What's... so funny about that?
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 6 ziqiao 09.ogg}} '''Ziqiao:''' You poor, innocent little creatures never fail to amuse me. To think you would endure all manner of hardships in your brief time on this mortal plane, and all that merely to "rise above others"!
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 6 ziqiao 10.ogg}} '''Ziqiao:''' I would have thought that the wiser path would be to simply roam this world as I do.
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 6 luxiangxiang 27.ogg}} '''Lu Xiangxiang:''' Huh?
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 6 ziqiao 11.ogg}} '''Ziqiao:''' Tell me, what is it that you truly delight in? Archaeology? Martial arts? Tea-planting? Or perhaps the keeping of a guesthouse?
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 6 luxiangxiang 28.ogg}} '''Lu Xiangxiang:''' What I... delight in?
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 6 ziqiao 12.ogg}} '''Ziqiao:''' Yes. Surely there must be something you don't find quite so exhausting? Whatever delights you should not feel like a burden.
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 6 luxiangxiang 29.ogg}} '''Lu Xiangxiang:''' But... do things like that really exist?
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 6 ziqiao 13.ogg}} '''Ziqiao:''' Of course! Take Miss Xiangling, for instance — I defy you to detect even a hint of hardship on her face when she wields her wok and spatula.
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 6 ziqiao 14.ogg}} '''Ziqiao:''' So, since it seems you are resolved to tread the rocky path, you should strive with all your might to pursue that which brings you delight.
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 6 luxiangxiang 30.ogg}} '''Lu Xiangxiang:''' You mean... like cosplay?
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 6 ziqiao 15.ogg}} '''Ziqiao:''' *cough* I suppose... you might say that...
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 6 paimon 13.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh... Looks like the White Horse Adeptus is really getting into her "role"...
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 6 luxiangxiang 31.ogg}} '''Lu Xiangxiang:''' Hmm... I think I get what you mean, then. Maybe I should have a chat with Miss Xiangling before I head home...
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 6 xiangling 17.ogg}} '''Xiangling:''' Okay everyone, sorry to keep you waiting! Here's your food!
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 6 paimon 14.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wow! It all smells so good!
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 6 ziqiao 16.ogg}} '''Ziqiao:''' Finally, I get to try that famous poisonous stew...
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 6 paimon 15.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hey, didn't you hear what Xiangxiang said? It wasn't the stew! If anyone's to blame, it's that other you!
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 6 ziqiao 17.ogg}} '''Ziqiao:''' Whew...
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 6 paimon 16.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What's... up?
:;(Tears begin running down Ziqiao's face)
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 6 ziqiao 18.ogg}} '''Ziqiao:''' How fiercely this mortal fare burns upon the tongue!
:{{Black Screen|You and the others devour the food set before you...}}
:{{Black Screen|Once you've all finished, Lu Xiangxiang stays behind to ask Xiangling how she might discover a vocation she truly loves.}}
:{{Black Screen|The rest of you make your way onto the streets as you discuss the next stop on your one-day tour of Liyue.}}
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 7 ziqiao 01.ogg}} '''Ziqiao:''' Mmm... Most satisfying, as poisonous stews go. So, where to now? Time, I think, to seek out some diversion.
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 7 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, there's plenty of entertainment options in Liyue, Paimon'll tell ya that! The locals like to drink tea, walk their pets, play chess, watch operas, attend storytelling performances—
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 7 ziqiao 02.ogg}} '''Ziqiao:''' Storytelling performances...?
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 7 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Y'know, like... listening to people telling stories! They're usually based on old Liyue legends, just like their operas.
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 7 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Stuff like "The Divine Damsel of Devastation," "Through the Eyes of a Dragon," or "The Sanctification of [[Tao Dou]]"...
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 7 ziqiao 03.ogg}} '''Ziqiao:''' What about the story of the bright moon that sits in the sky above us?
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 7 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hmm, Paimon doesn't think she's heard that one... Still, the moon does come up quite a lot! It's even in the name itself — the "yue" in "Liyue" actually means "moon"!
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 7 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Since we're on the subject... You like telling stories yourself, right? Why don't we go check it out?
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 7 ziqiao 04.ogg}} '''Ziqiao:''' In that case, I'll have to trouble the two of you to lead the way.
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 7 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Awesome, let's go! [[Third-Round Knockout]], here we come!
:;(Obtain {{Item|Recipe: Lucky Snow Delight}})

;(Approach [[Yun Jin]] and [[Iron Tongue Tian]] at Third-Round Knockout)
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 8 irontonguetian 01.ogg}} '''Iron Tongue Tian:''' What a tongue twister... Phew, I'd have made a complete fool of myself if I'd tried to say it on stage without practicing it first.
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 8 irontonguetian 02.ogg}} '''Iron Tongue Tian:''' "Ha! Call yourself 'Iron Tongue Tian'? 'Wobbly Tongue Tian,' more like!"
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 8 yunjin 01.ogg}} '''Yun Jin:''' Heh, I used to have that problem a lot...
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 8 yunjin 02.ogg}} '''Yun Jin:''' But if you just take your time to grasp the meaning and commit it to memory, you'll be able to say it smoothly in no time.
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 8 irontonguetian 03.ogg}} '''Iron Tongue Tian:''' You're right, Ms. Yun. I'll give it another try...
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 8 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hey, Yun Jin! Fancy seeing you here! What are you two talking about?
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 8 yunjin 03.ogg}} '''Yun Jin:''' Ah, {{Traveler}} and Paimon, we meet again. And who, may I ask, is this...?
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 8 ziqiao 01.ogg}} '''Ziqiao:''' You may call me the White Horse Adeptus.
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 8 irontonguetian 04.ogg}} '''Iron Tongue Tian:''' The White Horse Adeptus!?
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 8 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' *cough* She's not... really an adeptus...
:{{DIcon}} ...She's just cosplaying as one.
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 8 yunjin 04.ogg}} '''Yun Jin:''' I see... Well, it certainly looks like a lot of fun!
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 8 irontonguetian 05.ogg}} '''Iron Tongue Tian:''' Oh! Funny you mention it, this type of thing is actually something I'm quite familiar with.
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 8 irontonguetian 06.ogg}} '''Iron Tongue Tian:''' Once, to perform "Through the Eyes of a Dragon," I decided to imagine that I was Rex Lapis himself, hahaha. It was the only way to truly inhabit his mindset and understand his resolve to quell those demons...
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 8 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Sounds like you just wanted an excuse to feel all big and powerful...
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 8 irontonguetian 07.ogg}} '''Iron Tongue Tian:''' Hey, that's... You just don't understand how inspiration works!
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 8 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hmph, you're one to talk! Paimon's traveled all over with {{Traveler}}, and she's seen things that would make your jaw drop!
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 8 irontonguetian 08.ogg}} '''Iron Tongue Tian:''' Alright then, since you claim to be so knowledgeable, why don't you prove it by reciting "An Ancient Poem"?
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 8 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' An ancient poem? Which one?
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 8 irontonguetian 09.ogg}} '''Iron Tongue Tian:''' Hah, see! You mean to tell me you've never even heard of the ancient poem called "An Ancient Poem"?
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 8 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What kind of a title is that!?
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 8 yunjin 05.ogg}} '''Yun Jin:''' Ha, quit teasing Paimon. We only just found out about that ourselves. He's talking about the writing on those ancient relics.
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 8 yunjin 06.ogg}} '''Yun Jin:''' When we first saw it, we couldn't figure out what it all meant, so in the meantime, we decided to just refer to it as "An Ancient Poem."
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 8 yunjin 07.ogg}} '''Yun Jin:''' However, thanks to the painstaking work of the scholars who were tasked with decoding it, it seems like that's exactly what it was — or rather, an ode offered in veneration of the moon and the White Horse Adeptus.
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 8 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ohhh yeah, didn't [[Keqing]] mention that before? It's got something to do with Lang-Gan, right?
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 8 yunjin 08.ogg}} '''Yun Jin:''' That is correct. The Ministry of Civil Affairs has issued a notice stating that, although it is true that the moon may disappear tonight, we should be in no danger. In other words, there's nothing to fear.
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 8 yunjin 09.ogg}} '''Yun Jin:''' But if you're worried, we can always take a leaf from the book of the ancients — by reciting this poem, I mean, and calling for the White Horse Adeptus' aid. If we do that, I'm certain she'll protect our moon and keep us safe.
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 8 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Whoa, seriously? Paimon has to get a look at this...
::{{Readable|title=An Ancient Poem
|text=<!--
--><center><br><!--
-->Under moon eternal, in radiant night, a maiden grants silk soft and light.<br><!--
-->Under moon iridescent, in night divine, a maiden grants fiber for cloth so fine.<br><!--
-->Under moon of frost, in night so great, a maiden grants tools to divine our fate.<br><!--
-->The fields are plowed, the seeds are sown, and from the earth, life is grown.<br><!--
-->The seedlings stretch, the crops do rise, and all unfolds before our eyes.<br><!--
-->Fruits are gathered, sweet wine is poured, these gifts we offer to our lord.<br><!--
-->Pure as heaven, so fair and bright, she shines as light in this dark night.<br><!--
-->And with her does this wish take flight.<br><!--
--></center>}}
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 8 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' "Under moon eternal, in radiant night, a maiden grants silk... soft and light?" What in Teyvat's that supposed to mean...
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 8 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' "Under moon iridescent, in night divine... Blablabla something cloth so fine."
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 8 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' "Something about fields being plowed, something else about seeds being sown... from the earth..." Seriously, what is this?
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 8 ziqiao 02.ogg}} '''Ziqiao:''' "The fields are plowed, the seeds are sown, and from the earth, life is grown."
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 8 paimon 12.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' ...Whoa, you did that without even looking!
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 8 irontonguetian 10.ogg}} '''Iron Tongue Tian:''' Bravo, bravo! We have an expert in our midst!
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 8 irontonguetian 11.ogg}} '''Iron Tongue Tian:''' Looks like this young lady really does know her role inside out, haha! If I didn't know any better, I'd have taken her for the real deal!
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 8 ziqiao 03.ogg}} '''Ziqiao:''' That's because I am "the real deal."
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 8 irontonguetian 12.ogg}} '''Iron Tongue Tian:''' That's the spirit! This is exactly the kind of mindset I was talking about! "Behold, mortals, I am none other than the indomitable Rex Lapis himself! Kneel before my godly splendor!"
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 8 irontonguetian 13.ogg}} '''Iron Tongue Tian:''' Believe me, young lady, I know exactly why you do it. Back in the day, I was just like you...
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 8 ziqiao 04.ogg}} '''Ziqiao:''' I must say, you are rather amusing, as mortals go.
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 8 yunjin 10.ogg}} '''Yun Jin:''' Miss "White Horse Adeptus," it is a great pleasure to make your acquaintance today. I have some questions regarding the poem, and I was wondering, perhaps, if you might be able to shed some light on it?
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 8 ziqiao 05.ogg}} '''Ziqiao:''' Hmm, you want me to... explain the full meaning of its verses?
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 8 yunjin 11.ogg}} '''Yun Jin:''' Your guidance would be much appreciated.
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 8 ziqiao 06.ogg}} '''Ziqiao:''' Fascinating... Tell me, do all the people of Liyue still express such reverence for the ancient ways?
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 8 yunjin 12.ogg}} '''Yun Jin:''' Well, it's true that we hold a deep fondness for our history — but it is hardly our only pursuit. [[Xinyan|One of my good friends]], for instance, is even more devoted to the modern [[Fontainian]] art of rock 'n' roll.
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 8 irontonguetian 14.ogg}} '''Iron Tongue Tian:''' Exactly! And don't forget, great practitioners of the roleplaying arts walk among us too — people like me and you, young lady!
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 8 yunjin 13.ogg}} '''Yun Jin:''' Haha, yes... So rather than placing too much emphasis on our reverence for the ancient ways, it might be better to say that here in Liyue, a hundred passions bloom, each with a voice of its own.
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 8 ziqiao 07.ogg}} '''Ziqiao:''' I see... Then I suppose it wouldn't do any harm for me to enlighten you. In truth, it is but a simple poem of blessings. Its meaning is this:
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 8 ziqiao 08.ogg}} '''Ziqiao:''' "As the [[Eternal Moon]] rises in the night sky, a maiden adorned with lustrous jade descends upon the earth. She blesses the kudzu vines and mulberry leaves, so that they may be used to make coarse cloth that is nevertheless soft, light, and comfortable to wear."
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 8 ziqiao 09.ogg}} '''Ziqiao:''' "As the [[Iridescent Moon]] rises in the night sky, a maiden adorned with lustrous jade descends upon the earth. She blesses the kudzu vines and hemp, so that they may be used to make fine, luxurious cloth."
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 8 ziqiao 10.ogg}} '''Ziqiao:''' "As the [[Frost Moon]] rises in the night sky, a maiden adorned with lustrous jade descends upon the earth. She blesses the mugwort and artemisia, so that they may be perfect for divination."
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 8 yunjin 14.ogg}} '''Yun Jin:''' So she really did come down from the moon...?
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 8 ziqiao 11.ogg}} '''Ziqiao:''' "She shows the people how to use the plow and spade to purge the land of weeds, till the soil, and heap up the earth to make it fertile; then with the hoe, she teaches them to sow their grain, bestowing the promise of life upon every seed."
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 8 ziqiao 12.ogg}} '''Ziqiao:''' "She blesses the millet and the beans, ensuring that their stalks and vines stretch forth without end. She graces the wheat and the rice, so that their heavy heads are filled with plump, glistening grain."
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 8 paimon 13.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Sounds like she's a real pro at all this farming stuff!
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 8 ziqiao 13.ogg}} '''Ziqiao:''' "The fruits of the field are harvested and brewed into sacred wine for honored guests. This we reverently present to the divine maiden, with every ceremonial step flawlessly observed, so that she may witness the depth of our piety and respect."
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 8 ziqiao 14.ogg}} '''Ziqiao:''' "O, divine maiden, how can your graceful presence in the sky not seem like that of a fairy descending from the heavens?"
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 8 ziqiao 15.ogg}} '''Ziqiao:''' "O, divine maiden, how does your pure and radiant form not resemble the guardian spirit of our land?"
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 8 ziqiao 16.ogg}} '''Ziqiao:''' "I send my heart's desire ascending to the heavens, beseeching you to grant us good fortune and blessings in the coming year."
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 8 paimon 14.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh, so that's what it's supposed to mean...?
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 8 irontonguetian 15.ogg}} '''Iron Tongue Tian:''' I find myself speechless... moved beyond the power of words to convey. Oh young lady, haha, you have shown me the heights to which a true role-player might aspire!
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 8 yunjin 15.ogg}} '''Yun Jin:''' A truly remarkable performance! I did not anticipate that anyone could unravel this poem with such depth and clarity, and so soon after the Ministry of Civil Affairs' notice too.
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 8 yunjin 16.ogg}} '''Yun Jin:''' I'd even begun to consider myself somewhat versed in the matter, but as they say, there's always someone more knowledgeable out there. Allow me to extend my thanks to you, Miss "White Horse Adeptus."
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 8 ziqiao 17.ogg}} '''Ziqiao:''' You are far too humble, young one. I must confess, it is I who have been surprised — not only by you, but also by this "Liyue Harbor" of the present day...
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 8 yunjin 17.ogg}} '''Yun Jin:''' Ah, so you're not from Liyue? And what, may I ask, has surprised you about it?
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 8 ziqiao 18.ogg}} '''Ziqiao:''' Oh, it's nothing, really. Just some old memories scattered here and there.
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 8 ziqiao 19.ogg}} '''Ziqiao:''' Very well, my guides. I suppose it is time we set forth on the next part of our excursion. I'd like to go see that wharf now. What say the two of you?
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 8 paimon 15.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' N—No problem! We'll take you wherever you want!
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 8 yunjin 18.ogg}} '''Yun Jin:''' Oh, leaving so soon? Before you go, allow me to introduce myself... I am Yun Jin, director of the [[Yun-Han Opera Troupe]]. May I ask your name in return?
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 8 ziqiao 20.ogg}} '''Ziqiao:''' Heh, my own "name" is scarcely worth mentioning. But since you asked, hmm... perhaps I'll tell you the title of that poem instead.
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 8 paimon 16.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh? So it isn't actually called "An Ancient Poem"?
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 8 ziqiao 21.ogg}} '''Ziqiao:''' Ha, of course not! Its real title is "Odes of Lang: Zibai."
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 8 yunjin 19.ogg}} '''Yun Jin:''' "Odes of Lang"... "Zibai"...
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 8 ziqiao 22.ogg}} '''Ziqiao:''' Mhm... Alright then. Until we meet again.

;(Approach [[Ganyu]] and [[Yanfei]] in front of the Mingxiao Lantern)
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 9 yanfei 01.ogg}} '''Yanfei:''' Hey, Ganyu! I almost forgot to mention — on my [[Yanfei: Oh, horns...|recent trip]] to [[Nod-Krai]], I came across something really fascinating in the [[Frostmoon Scions]]' library.
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 9 yanfei 02.ogg}} '''Yanfei:''' I found records in their collection of another divine envoy living on the moon!
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 9 ganyu 01.ogg}} '''Ganyu:''' A divine envoy on the moon? You don't think it could have been referring to the White Horse Adeptus too, do you?
:{{Introductory Note|Ganyu}}
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 9 yanfei 03.ogg}} '''Yanfei:''' No way to say for sure. Still, the similarities between our legends are intriguing, to say the least.
:{{Introductory Note|Yanfei}}
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 9 yanfei 04.ogg}} '''Yanfei:''' Isn't it amazing? Especially when you consider how far apart we are...
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 9 ganyu 02.ogg}} '''Ganyu:''' It truly is. We might live in different lands, but when we look up at the night sky, we all see the same moon and stars.
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 9 yanfei 05.ogg}} '''Yanfei:''' Right? It's like we're all bound together, no matter where we are. When you think of it like that, it's almost as if our friends from other nations will be right here, celebrating with us! Isn't that a wonderful thought?
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 9 ganyu 03.ogg}} '''Ganyu:''' No wonder you were so excited to go see the giant lantern when you first got back. Sounds like you're a real fan of the White Horse Adeptus, huh?
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 9 yanfei 06.ogg}} '''Yanfei:''' I guess you could say that, haha! Just a pity she's so elusive... Even Granny's never met her, y'know. Maybe she really is just a legend, after all.
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 9 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hey, Yanfei and Ganyu! Trust Paimon — the White Horse Adeptus is as real as real can be!
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 9 yanfei 07.ogg}} '''Yanfei:''' Huh? Oh look, it's {{Traveler}} and Paimon! Feels like I haven't seen you two in, like... forever. Happy Lantern Rite! It's so good to see you again.
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 9 ganyu 04.ogg}} '''Ganyu:''' Hey, you two! Happy Lantern Rite!
:{{DIcon}} Happy Lantern Rite!
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 9 yanfei 08.ogg}} '''Yanfei:''' Did I... hear you right just now, Paimon? Does that mean you've actually seen the White Horse Adeptus!?
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 9 ziqiao 01.ogg}} '''Ziqiao:''' She has indeed. And now, so have you.
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 9 ganyu 05.ogg}} '''Ganyu:''' Huh? And you are...?
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 9 ziqiao 02.ogg}} '''Ziqiao:''' Why, who else? The White Horse Adeptus, of course.
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 9 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Could you maybe... start with something else next time?
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 9 yanfei 09.ogg}} '''Yanfei:''' *gasp* Y—You're the White Horse Adeptus!?
:{{DIcon}} *cough* She's cosplaying as the White Horse Adeptus.
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 9 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' ...That's right! Allow Paimon to introduce you to our new friend, Ziqiao! She's been lowkey obsessed with cosplaying the White Horse Adeptus, ever since we met her...
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 9 yanfei 10.ogg}} '''Yanfei:''' Haha, I see! Well then... Greetings, Miss Ziqiao. My name is Yanfei, and recently, I've been "lowkey obsessed" with learning everything I can about the White Horse Adeptus.
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 9 ganyu 06.ogg}} '''Ganyu:''' I'm sure the two of you will get along like a house on fire... Oh, and by the way, I'm Ganyu.
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 9 yanfei 11.ogg}} '''Yanfei:''' So, Miss Ziqiao! You must be here to see the giant lantern too, right?
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 9 ziqiao 03.ogg}} '''Ziqiao:''' Hmm? A horse-shaped Xiao Lantern... Is that... what I think it is?
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 9 yanfei 12.ogg}} '''Yanfei:''' That's right! A lantern made to honor the White Horse Adeptus herself! Isn't it gorgeous?
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 9 ziqiao 04.ogg}} '''Ziqiao:''' *chuckle*
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 9 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh? What are you laughing at?
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 9 ziqiao 05.ogg}} '''Ziqiao:''' Both the lantern... and myself.
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 9 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What do you mean?
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 9 ziqiao 06.ogg}} '''Ziqiao:''' This lantern truly is an artistic masterpiece, but tell me this — have any of you ever seen a horse before?
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 9 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Uh... Come to think of it, Paimon can't remember ever actually seeing one herself. What about you, {{Traveler}}?
:{{DIcon}} Me neither.
:{{DIcon}} I have, but not here.
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 9 ziqiao 07.ogg}} '''Ziqiao:''' This horse appears to be mid-trot, but it has adopted what is called a "lateral gait" — where the legs on one side of the body move together in unison. A rather rare sight, indeed...
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 9 ziqiao 08.ogg}} '''Ziqiao:''' Just now, I suddenly pictured myself... I mean, the White Horse Adeptus running the same way. The image was so absurd, I could barely contain my mirth...
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 9 yanfei 13.ogg}} '''Yanfei:''' Oh, really? I never knew that... You learn something every day, huh!
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 9 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' ...Oh c'mon, it's basically a giant piece of fan art! Who cares if it's different than the original!
:{{DIcon}} So... Why laugh at yourself?
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 9 ziqiao 09.ogg}} '''Ziqiao:''' Heh... I was merely laughing at my own ignorance. I came here thinking that the White Horse Adeptus' tale had been long forgotten — yet here I am, gazing upon a lantern made in her honor.
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 9 yanfei 14.ogg}} '''Yanfei:''' Hehe, well, you couldn't have been more mistaken! There are so many tales about the White Horse Adeptus, I'm starting to lose count. Just off the top of my head—
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 9 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Just so you know, Yanfei, we've heard it all like... a million times before!
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 9 yanfei 15.ogg}} '''Yanfei:''' ...Aha, but there's one thing I can guarantee that you haven't!
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 9 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh? You mean like, a new chapter of her story's come to light?
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 9 yanfei 16.ogg}} '''Yanfei:''' Mm-hmm, and I heard it from Ganyu just yesterday! Hey, why don't you share it with the others?
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 9 ganyu 07.ogg}} '''Ganyu:''' Sure, no problem. Hmm, where to begin... Do you guys [[One for the Foodies, Two for the Show|still remember]] what Liyue's [[Moonchase Festival]] is about?
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 9 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Of course! It's a festival held in honor of [[Guoba|Guo]]— Uhh, the Stove God!
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 9 ganyu 08.ogg}} '''Ganyu:''' That's right. But it took a really long time for the Stove God Festival to become what it is today.
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 9 ganyu 09.ogg}} '''Ganyu:''' In its earliest form, it was actually an adeptal ritual known as the "Moonchase Rite."
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 9 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hmm... Paimon remembers Madame Ping mentioning that before, but she never explained exactly what it was.
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 9 ganyu 10.ogg}} '''Ganyu:''' According to Cloud Retainer, the Moonchase Rite was originally a ritual meant for communicating with the moon.
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 9 ziqiao 10.ogg}} '''Ziqiao:''' Communicating with the moon...? But for what purpose?
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 9 ganyu 11.ogg}} '''Ganyu:''' At first, Cloud Retainer wasn't entirely sure either, as it was always Rex Lapis who performed the ritual.
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 9 paimon 12.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Whoa, Zhong— Uhh, Rex Lapis did it himself!? Must've been a really important ritual...
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 9 ganyu 12.ogg}} '''Ganyu:''' That's right. Unfortunately, despite numerous attempts, they never actually received any response from the moon... which is why they eventually stopped performing it.
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 9 ganyu 13.ogg}} '''Ganyu:''' But then, just yesterday, Keqing took a picture of the moon being obscured by a dark hole to Cloud Retainer, and asked if it had anything to do with the Moonchase Rite...
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 9 ganyu 14.ogg}} '''Ganyu:''' The moment Cloud Retainer saw it, it suddenly dawned on her that the Rite might have been an attempt to reach the White Horse Adeptus all along...
:;(Paimon leans over to whisper to the Traveler)
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 9 paimon 13.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Does that mean... Zhongli's been trying to bring back the White Horse Adeptus all this time?
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 9 yanfei 17.ogg}} '''Yanfei:''' So, how about that? Bet you never thought there might even be a link between the White Horse Adeptus and the Moonchase Festival...
:{{DIcon}} It is quite the revelation, yes.
:{{DIcon}} Not exactly. It's an idea I've considered before.
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 9 ganyu 15.ogg}} '''Ganyu:''' If Keqing hadn't taken that picture to Cloud Retainer, we would never have known any of this...
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 9 paimon 14.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' This is probably what Keqing was referring to that day when she mentioned there were some ideas she wanted to follow up on...
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 9 ziqiao 11.ogg}} '''Ziqiao:''' So, Geo Archon... All this time, you've been striving to awaken her...
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 9 yanfei 18.ogg}} '''Yanfei:''' Huh? What do you mean, "awaken"?
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 9 ziqiao 12.ogg}} '''Ziqiao:''' ...Nothing. What I truly meant to say was, this new insight you've provided has been truly... eye-opening.
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 9 ziqiao 13.ogg}} '''Ziqiao:''' Oh, by the way, my trusty guides, I've been meaning to ask — where in Liyue Harbor might one enjoy an expansive scenic view?
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 9 paimon 15.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh? We're off to the next stop already? But Paimon's barely done digesting that lore bomb just now!
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 9 ziqiao 14.ogg}} '''Ziqiao:''' All the more reason to find the right spot to let it sink in.
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 9 ganyu 16.ogg}} '''Ganyu:''' Oh, so that's what you're up to, a tour of Liyue Harbor? In that case, if you're looking for a spot with a panoramic view, I'd recommend [[Yujing Terrace]].
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 9 yanfei 19.ogg}} '''Yanfei:''' That's a great idea! Since the terrace is on higher ground, the sea view from up there's sooo much better.
:{{DIcon}} I agree.
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 9 yanfei 20.ogg}} '''Yanfei:''' Great! Well, the Lantern Rite's about to start, so we should get back to Granny's now.
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 9 ganyu 17.ogg}} '''Ganyu:''' Hope to see you all at the festival tonight!
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 9 paimon 16.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, you're off too? Alright then... See you both soon!
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 9 yanfei 21.ogg}} '''Yanfei:''' See you soon!
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 9 ziqiao 15.ogg}} '''Ziqiao:''' Very well, my guides — what are we waiting for?
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 9 paimon 17.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' O—Okay, you're the boss! Yujing Terrace it is — after all, the customer's always right!
:{{DIcon}} Hold on a second.
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 9 ziqiao 16.ogg}} '''Ziqiao:''' Something else you needed to do?
:{{DIcon}} Let's take a photo here in front of the giant lantern.
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 9 paimon 18.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Woohoo! Paimon likes that idea!
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 9 ziqiao 17.ogg}} '''Ziqiao:''' And what, may I ask, is a "photo"?
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 9 paimon 19.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' It's this awesome invention that lets you record moments in the blink of an eye! Except, you've gotta try not to actually blink...
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 9 ziqiao 18.ogg}} '''Ziqiao:''' Oh? What must I do in preparation, then?
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 9 paimon 20.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Nothing! All you gotta do is choose a pose — {{Traveler}} will handle everything else.
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 9 paimon 21.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Come on, let's give it a try!
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 9 paimon 22.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Look, we got a great picture! Paimon's gonna call it... "The White Horse Adeptus Meets the White Horse Adeptus in Liyue Harbor"!

:{{A|vo eqhdj503 9 ziqiao 19.ogg}} '''Ziqiao:''' Hah, they've even discovered a way to preserve moments in time... Now I truly am curious to witness what else these mortals might accomplish.
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 9 ziqiao 20.ogg}} '''Ziqiao:''' Very well, let us proceed. Yujing Terrace lies in that direction, does it not?
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 9 paimon 23.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hey, wait for us!

;(The Traveler, Paimon, and Ziqiao stand atop Yujing Terrace, gazing at the city below)
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 10 ziqiao 01.ogg}} '''Ziqiao:''' Truly, a marvelous view if ever there was one... It seems the charm of this "Liyue Harbor" is only heightened by the sun's dying light.
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 10 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Mm-hmm! And soon, people will start releasing their Xiao Lanterns to mark the most important day of the year.
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 10 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Practically everyone will be with their friends and family, eating a big meal, chatting, and even setting off fireworks. Trust Paimon, it'll look even more amazing then! Whaddaya say, wanna stay to see that?
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 10 ziqiao 02.ogg}} '''Ziqiao:''' Ha, no need. Let us bring this weary day to a close.
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 10 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' "Weary day"...? You mean... you didn't enjoy your tour?
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 10 ziqiao 03.ogg}} '''Ziqiao:''' I had imagined you would arrange for me to witness some grand spectacle — perhaps the descent of divine beings, the manifestation of the sacred before mortal eyes, or the appearance of a selfless hero come to aid the helpless and downtrodden.
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 10 ziqiao 04.ogg}} '''Ziqiao:''' Or, should that not come to pass, then at the very least, spend a little more coin. For that, it seems, is how one finds true enjoyment.
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 10 ziqiao 05.ogg}} '''Ziqiao:''' Alas, but there was none of these. Instead, we merely filled our bellies, listened to tales, and gazed upon a crude imitation of my likeness. And now, the sun begins its descent.
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 10 ziqiao 06.ogg}} '''Ziqiao:''' What a day of quiet tedium.
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 10 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' W—We're... so sorry! If we'd known that was what you wanted, we'd have done it all differently!
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 10 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' It's all that Zhongli's fault for not making the customer's requirements clear!
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 10 ziqiao 07.ogg}} '''Ziqiao:''' Well, it's too late now. Do you still believe I would part with that soul fragment, now so intertwined with my very being?
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 10 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' B—But...
:{{DIcon}} Quit scaring Paimon already.
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 10 ziqiao 08.ogg}} '''Ziqiao:''' Hm! I knew you were the more astute of the pair.
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 10 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Eh!? You were just trying to scare Paimon?
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 10 ziqiao 09.ogg}} '''Ziqiao:''' It seems the realm of the Geo Archon has a way of making one more... "stony-faced."
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 10 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So... Y—You were just pulling Paimon's leg?
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 10 ziqiao 10.ogg}} '''Ziqiao:''' Of course. I was merely engaging in a little banter with the two of you.
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 10 ziqiao 11.ogg}} '''Ziqiao:''' Long ago, I shared tales with various mortals who chanced upon my mountain abode. Never did I imagine that those stories would endure... It seems I greatly underestimated them.
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 10 ziqiao 12.ogg}} '''Ziqiao:''' Perhaps, as your Geo Lord said, a few pieces of ancient Lang-Gan's magnificent jade have truly become part of the very foundation of this land.
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 10 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So... You've decided to help us?
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 10 ziqiao 13.ogg}} '''Ziqiao:''' Again, that goes without saying. I made up my mind some time ago now.
:{{DIcon}} And when was that, exactly?
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 10 ziqiao 14.ogg}} '''Ziqiao:''' When I beheld a rather intriguing scene as I set foot in this city.
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 10 ziqiao 15.ogg}} '''Ziqiao:''' I saw porters passing through the alleys, setting down heavy wooden crates from their weary shoulders; peddlers pushing carts, as the kites and lanterns upon them rustled gently in the breeze...
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 10 ziqiao 16.ogg}} '''Ziqiao:''' I saw cooks cooking, actors acting, scholars reading, soldiers marching, children playing, elders resting, officials officiating, and the common folk absorbed in this or that, reveling in the simple joys of life.
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 10 ziqiao 17.ogg}} '''Ziqiao:''' Some, it seems, have already found that which stirs their hearts; while others continue to fret, troubled by uncertain futures.
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 10 ziqiao 18.ogg}} '''Ziqiao:''' Yet in this gentle and serene order, each holds fast to their anticipation — not only for the celebrations to come, but also, for the first light of the morrow.
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 10 ziqiao 19.ogg}} '''Ziqiao:''' Scenes I once yearned to behold now unfold before me — no longer in Lang-Gan, but in Liyue Harbor, thousands of years on.
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 10 ziqiao 20.ogg}} '''Ziqiao:''' Ah... How wondrous is this mortal realm.
:{{DIcon}} Thank you.
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 10 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Thank you, White Horse Adeptus... Thank you so much!
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 10 ziqiao 21.ogg}} '''Ziqiao:''' Adeptus, adepti... Perhaps the singular art in which we are truly proficient is that of sequestering ourselves within the high mountains.
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 10 ziqiao 22.ogg}} '''Ziqiao:''' But once we leave our mountain refuge, we find ourselves drawn back to mortal ways all the same.
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 10 ziqiao 23.ogg}} '''Ziqiao:''' So, it is I who should offer my thanks to the two of you. {{Traveler}}, Paimon, you have made this day more delightful than any I've known in a long, long time.
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 10 ziqiao 24.ogg}} '''Ziqiao:''' Come now and take what it is you need.
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 10 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You mean... like, right now? B—But... Don't you think we should wait for Zhongli?
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 10 ziqiao 25.ogg}} '''Ziqiao:''' That won't be necessary.
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 10 ziqiao 26.ogg}} '''Ziqiao:''' All things shall meet again in their time — for the waters know no rest, and the flowers their appointed season.
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 10 ziqiao 27.ogg}} '''Ziqiao:''' One need not fear that life is but a journey of goodbyes.
:;(Ziqiao's form dissolves, leaving behind a golden sphere of energy)
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 10 paimon 12.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Is she... gone?
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 10 zhongli 01.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Yes, she's gone. A Deadly Self is formed from the body's impure vapors — so naturally, it cannot survive long in this world. Had it not been sustained by the remnant of Zibai's soul, it would have faded away a long time past.
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 10 zhongli 02.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Now that the remnant is gone, it has severed its ties to the mortal world.
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 10 paimon 13.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Zhongli! When did you get here?
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 10 zhongli 03.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' A while ago.
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 10 paimon 14.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Paimon would've thought you'd at least wanna say goodbye...
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 10 zhongli 04.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Though mountains endure, the ceaseless waters will, at last, wear away their sharp edges. Thus must I meet the marks wrought upon her by the [[Istaroth|Ruler of Time]] with great caution.
:{{DIcon}} Actually, you're just terrible at saying goodbye.
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 10 zhongli 05.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' ...
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 10 zhongli 06.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' It may be goodbye for now, but someday, we will meet again.
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 10 paimon 15.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Really? And when might that be?
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 10 zhongli 07.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Who can say for sure? Years and years from now, perhaps...
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 10 zhongli 08.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' ...Or maybe tonight, at the Lantern Rite.
:{{A|vo eqhdj503 10 paimon 16.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Are you saying... that if the White Horse Adeptus were to be resurrected, she'd still have the memories of the Three Deadly Selves? That she'd still remember us?

'''''The Realm of Rocks''''' is the second part of the [[A Lanternlit Ode to the Silver Moon]] Event.

==Steps==
# Wait until 08:00 two days from now
# Go to [[Bubu Pharmacy]]
# Go to the [[Xiao Lantern]] crafting stalls
# Catch up with [[Gaming]]
# Find the [[adepti]] in [[Liyue Harbor]]
# Go to [[Mt. Aocang]]
# Escape the onrushing torrent of time
# Go to the end of this place
# Return to Mt. Aocang

* During steps 7-8, the player enters a [[Special Story Mode]], and the active party is limited to the [[Traveler]].

:{{A|vo eqhdj502 4 houzhang 01.ogg}} '''Houzhang:''' Hmph... By the order of [[Rex Lapis]], we were supposed to make haste to the Harbor to stand watch. Yet, we arrived late — for you, in your inscrutable wisdom, chose that very moment to tend the [[mint]].
:{{A|vo eqhdj502 4 houzhang 02.ogg}} '''Houzhang:''' It is no wonder Cloud Retainer banished us to the wilderness in anger. A pity only that I — blameless as I am — was made to share in the punishment.

:{{A|vo eqhdj502 4 jiehu 05.ogg}} '''Jiehu:''' If ever Cloud Retainer is away, we should steal into her abode and plant a veritable field of mint. A tempting little ruse, is it not?

:{{A|vo eqhdj502 4 daobaoa 01.ogg}} '''Panicked Treasure Hoarder:''' Please stop chasing us! Just let us go!

:{{A|vo eqhdj502 4 daobaob 01.ogg}} '''Panicked Treasure Hoarder:''' Please! We don't know anything about Wushou Dancing! Just leave us alone!
:{{A|vo eqhdj502 4 gaming 02.ogg}} '''Gaming:''' What, you think I'm not good enough to teach you? Just agree to be my apprentices and then we can talk!

:{{A|vo eqhdj502 4 jiehu 06.ogg}} '''Jiehu:''' Ah, it appears to be the Wushou Dancer from Liyue Harbor. I have seen him perform on occasion.

:{{A|vo eqhdj502 4 jiehu 08.ogg}} '''Jiehu:''' Oh? So, it is you who require aid, not the other way around...
:{{A|vo eqhdj502 4 gaming 03.ogg}} '''Gaming:''' Get out of the way, old men! This is between us!
:{{A|vo eqhdj502 4 houzhang 08.ogg}} '''Houzhang:''' Preposterous! You dare to presume we are of a... mature age?
:{{A|vo eqhdj502 4 jiehu 09.ogg}} '''Jiehu:''' Listen here, brazen youth. Skilled you may be in the art of dance, yet your off-stage demeanor leaves much to be desired!
:{{A|vo eqhdj502 4 houzhang 09.ogg}} '''Houzhang:''' Hold on, Mountain Shaper... Something is amiss. Look closer.

:{{A|vo eqhdj502 4 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Whoa! You okay, Gaming?

;(Approach [[Madame Ping]], Xianyun, and Xiao)
:{{A|vo eqhdj502 5 xianyun 01.ogg}} '''Xianyun:''' The White Horse Adeptus? You mean, the mysterious white mare that aided Rex Lapis during the [[Archon War]]?
:{{A|vo eqhdj502 5 madameping 01.ogg}} '''Madame Ping:''' Even if it's not her, there must be some connection. She always avoided us back then, and I never knew why.
:{{A|vo eqhdj502 5 xiao 01.ogg}} '''Xiao:''' Rex Lapis' recent trip seems to be related to this person as well.
:{{A|vo eqhdj502 5 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Xianyun! Madame Ping! Xiao! Great, you're all here!
:{{Introductory Note|Xianyun}}
:{{A|vo eqhdj502 5 xiao 02.ogg}} '''Xiao:''' Ah, {{Traveler}}. It has been quite some time.
:{{DIcon}} Yeah! Great to see you again, Xiao.
:{{Introductory Note|Xiao}}
:{{A|vo eqhdj502 5 madameping 02.ogg}} '''Madame Ping:''' Happy Lantern Rite, Paimon! You're as lively as I remember. I trust things have been well?
:{{A|vo eqhdj502 5 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Sorry Madame Ping, no time to catch up — something terrible has happened!
:{{A|vo eqhdj502 5 xianyun 02.ogg}} '''Xianyun:''' What is it? Has Mountain Shaper gotten himself into trouble? Moon Carver is here with you, but he is not...
:{{A|vo eqhdj502 5 houzhang 01.ogg}} '''Houzhang:''' Ahem...
:{{A|vo eqhdj502 5 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Um...
:{{Black Screen|You explain the situation to the adepti.}}
:{{A|vo eqhdj502 5 xianyun 03.ogg}} '''Xianyun:''' "The wrath of mint"? Hmph, that old fool dares to utter such nonsense behind one's back?
:{{A|vo eqhdj502 5 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Uh... Yeah, that's not really our biggest concern here!
:{{A|vo eqhdj502 5 madameping 03.ogg}} '''Madame Ping:''' So, even a mere Deadly Self of the White Horse Adeptus was able to possess Mountain Shaper and affect his mind? No wonder Rex Lapis told us to gather here and await his orders...
:{{A|vo eqhdj502 5 houzhang 02.ogg}} '''Houzhang:''' Mountain Shaper's cultivation is inadequate. He was caught unprepared. Were it one of us, Zizhi would hardly have found a vessel quite so... ready for the taking.
:{{A|vo eqhdj502 5 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hey, that's not what you said earlier!
:{{A|vo eqhdj502 5 xiao 03.ogg}} '''Xiao:''' Where is Mountain Shaper now?
:{{A|vo eqhdj502 5 xianyun 04.ogg}} '''Xianyun:''' Hmph, a question that hardly bears pondering. Obviously, he intends to plant mint in the vicinity of one's abode.
:{{A|vo eqhdj502 5 houzhang 03.ogg}} '''Houzhang:''' Ah, then he poses no great threat... We might as well let him be. Once he fulfills his wish, it's possible that Zizhi will relinquish him of her own volition.
:{{A|vo eqhdj502 5 xianyun 05.ogg}} '''Xianyun:''' Your ulterior motive is most obvious, Mountain Shaper. You, too, hope for Mt. Aocang to be covered in mint — one can see it clear as day.
:{{A|vo eqhdj502 5 xianyun 06.ogg}} '''Xianyun:''' Not to mention, Deadly Selves are born of malevolent human desires, and naturally, pose a great risk to the form and mind of all living beings. We cannot let this go unchecked.
:{{A|vo eqhdj502 5 xiao 04.ogg}} '''Xiao:''' Let me handle it. I have relevant experience and know how to deal with such situations.
:{{A|vo eqhdj502 5 xianyun 07.ogg}} '''Xianyun:''' One has no doubt of that, yet your involvement would likely end in armed confrontation. In one's own estimation, the time for such measures has not yet come.
:{{A|vo eqhdj502 5 xianyun 08.ogg}} '''Xianyun:''' Before his departure, Rex Lapis knew that Zizhi was active in Liyue Harbor, yet told us only to wait.
:{{A|vo eqhdj502 5 xianyun 09.ogg}} '''Xianyun:''' It would seem, then, that Rex Lapis did not believe extreme measures were warranted here.
:{{A|vo eqhdj502 5 madameping 04.ogg}} '''Madame Ping:''' Yes, this is quite a peculiar case. After all, Zizhi's possession does not seem to come with ill-intent. It's more like... she's guiding those she possesses to fulfill their own wishes.
:{{A|vo eqhdj502 5 houzhang 04.ogg}} '''Houzhang:''' Hm, there is another matter of import, however...
:{{A|vo eqhdj502 5 houzhang 05.ogg}} '''Houzhang:''' I sensed tremendous resentment emanating from her... What could be its source, to render her so unable to find peace?
:{{DIcon}} "The curse of time... The memories this body holds..."
:{{A|vo eqhdj502 5 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' She was talking about the White Horse Adeptus' memories, right? From what {{Traveler}} said, it seemed like she was about to explode with rage, but... why?
:{{A|vo eqhdj502 5 xianyun 10.ogg}} '''Xianyun:''' With Rex Lapis away, if we wish to understand that which occurred in the past, we shall have to ask her directly.
:{{A|vo eqhdj502 5 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' She also mentioned "the curse of time"... What could that be about?
:{{A|vo eqhdj502 5 xiao 05.ogg}} '''Xiao:''' Perhaps... [[erosion]].
:{{A|vo eqhdj502 5 houzhang 06.ogg}} '''Houzhang:''' Hm, indeed. We are of the same mind.
:{{A|vo eqhdj502 5 madameping 05.ogg}} '''Madame Ping:''' Hmm... I heard that ancient clans in the mountains once regarded the White Horse Adeptus as the daughter of Time... It seems there was some truth to that, after all.
:{{A|vo eqhdj502 5 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' The daughter of Time... cursed by Time?
:{{A|vo eqhdj502 5 madameping 06.ogg}} '''Madame Ping:''' Time does not treat everyone equally. The longer you dwell in this world, the more it takes from you...
:{{A|vo eqhdj502 5 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Then, what do we do?
:{{A|vo eqhdj502 5 xianyun 11.ogg}} '''Xianyun:''' One has devised a solution.
:{{DIcon}} What is it?
:{{A|vo eqhdj502 5 xianyun 12.ogg}} '''Xianyun:''' Based on what you have told us, it seems that Zizhi is in the habit of leaping to a different host when provoked.
:{{A|vo eqhdj502 5 xianyun 13.ogg}} '''Xianyun:''' One's plan is for us to block all escape routes while you confront Mountain Shaper, forcing Zizhi to reveal herself.
:{{A|vo eqhdj502 5 xianyun 14.ogg}} '''Xianyun:''' Then, if prior experience stands, she will have no choice but to possess you. However, not only are you able to sense it, you are also unaffected by the peculiar state of stasis.
:{{A|vo eqhdj502 5 xianyun 15.ogg}} '''Xianyun:''' In other words, in that moment, you would have the chance to either subdue or persuade her.
:{{A|vo eqhdj502 5 xiao 06.ogg}} '''Xiao:''' That is akin to walking straight into the lion's den. Allow me to go instead.
:{{A|vo eqhdj502 5 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yeah, isn't this plan a bit too risky?
:{{A|vo eqhdj502 5 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Why doesn't Paimon try first? After all, even if she got possessed, it's not like she would pose a danger to anyone.
:{{DIcon}} Yeah, but you might eat so much you become a literal ball.
:{{A|vo eqhdj502 5 paimon 12.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Paimon's wishes aren't all food-related, y'know!
:{{A|vo eqhdj502 5 xianyun 16.ogg}} '''Xianyun:''' One would not suggest this course of action if one had any such reservation.
:{{A|vo eqhdj502 5 xianyun 17.ogg}} '''Xianyun:''' Time and again, {{Traveler}} has proved immune to Zizhi's influence. Consider, for a moment, why that might be.
:{{DIcon}} Because... I bear the moonlight's guidance?
:{{A|vo eqhdj502 5 paimon 13.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, yeah! That's what the First Deadly Self told you, right?
:{{A|vo eqhdj502 5 xianyun 18.ogg}} '''Xianyun:''' Perhaps your time in [[Nod-Krai]] left you with the blessing of the [[Columbina|newborn Moon Goddess]], {{Traveler}}.
:{{A|vo eqhdj502 5 xianyun 19.ogg}} '''Xianyun:''' And this White Horse Adeptus clearly has a profound connection to the moon.
:{{A|vo eqhdj502 5 houzhang 07.ogg}} '''Houzhang:''' Indeed... Indeed!
:{{A|vo eqhdj502 5 xiao 07.ogg}} '''Xiao:''' I see...
:{{A|vo eqhdj502 5 xianyun 20.ogg}} '''Xianyun:''' Have you other concerns, Conqueror of Demons?
:{{A|vo eqhdj502 5 xiao 08.ogg}} '''Xiao:''' I was just trying to fathom why Rex Lapis left without explaining the situation in detail. But now, I think I understand.
:{{A|vo eqhdj502 5 xiao 09.ogg}} '''Xiao:''' Rex Lapis entrusted this matter to {{Traveler}}, which means in his estimation, {{Traveler}} must be the key to its resolution.
:{{A|vo eqhdj502 5 xiao 10.ogg}} '''Xiao:''' So, I have no other concern. I trust Rex Lapis, and I trust you.
:{{DIcon}} Leave it to me.
:{{A|vo eqhdj502 5 xianyun 21.ogg}} '''Xianyun:''' Then, we are all in agreement on proceeding with this plan?
:{{A|vo eqhdj502 5 xianyun 22.ogg}} '''Xianyun:''' Very well. We should depart at once, lest we lose our chance.
:{{A|vo eqhdj502 5 xianyun 23.ogg}} '''Xianyun:''' Let us see whether that old fool truly dares deface one's abode with mint!

:{{A|vo nllq003 4 nilou 12.ogg}} '''Nilou:''' "It is a beautiful thing born from our life experiences. Whenever there is joy or something to be celebrated, people will dance."
:{{A|vo nllq003 4 nilou 13.ogg}} '''Nilou:''' "In other words, any place where people can effortlessly begin a dance will for sure be filled with the blessings of everyone's happiness."
:{{A|vo nllq003 4 nilou 14.ogg}} '''Nilou:''' She wasn't looking for flowers and applause — all she wanted was to see her audience smile.
:{{DIcon}} So that is...
:{{DIcon}} What art means to people.
:{{A|vo nllq003 4 nilou 15.ogg}} '''Nilou:''' Right, the same as what Mr. Khasani believes.
:{{A|vo nllq003 4 nilou 16.ogg}} '''Nilou:''' I was completely moved by what she had said, so I started taking dance lessons from her. And later on, I began to dance here in her stead.
:{{A|vo nllq003 4 nilou 17.ogg}} '''Nilou:''' Before she retired, she told me, "For as long as you live, never forget what dance means to others."
:{{A|vo nllq003 4 nilou 18.ogg}} '''Nilou:''' This is why Mr. Zubayr and I never intended to listen to the Akademiya.
:{{A|vo nllq003 4 nilou 19.ogg}} '''Nilou:''' Even though it ended up causing everyone a whole lot of trouble, thankfully, everything worked out in the end.
:{{DIcon}} I see.
:{{DIcon}} Looks like you won't have to worry anymore.
:{{A|vo nllq003 4 nilou 20.ogg}} '''Nilou:''' Mhm, although I do have a small regret.
:{{DIcon}} Inayah?
:{{A|vo nllq003 4 nilou 21.ogg}} '''Nilou:''' Yeah. Even though she has already decided to stop fighting with her father, they never managed to have a real conversation with each other.
:{{A|vo nllq003 4 nilou 22.ogg}} '''Nilou:''' Before he left, Mr. Sharif looked like he had a lot on his mind.
:{{A|vo nllq003 4 nilou 23.ogg}} '''Nilou:''' He probably has a lot of things he wants to say, but will now perhaps never get a chance to.
:{{DIcon}} That really is a shame.
:{{DIcon}} That might be for the best.
:{{A|vo nllq003 4 nilou 24.ogg}} '''Nilou:''' Yeah, but I still hope that things can change. It never hurts to have hope.
:{{A|vo nllq003 4 nilou 25.ogg}} '''Nilou:''' You and Paimon are more than welcome to keep attending our shows.
:{{A|vo nllq003 4 nilou 26.ogg}} '''Nilou:''' Hehe, who knows, next time, you might see Inayah on the stage.

;(After talking to Nilou)
:{{A|vo nllq003 6 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Are you still worried about Inayah?
:{{A|vo nllq003 6 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Let's be sure to come back often. Who knows, maybe things will have worked out for her!

;(Talk to Nilou again, optional)
:{{A|vo dialog nllq003 nilou 01.ogg}} '''Nilou:''' You two are welcome here anytime! Seeing you safe and sound in between adventures will keep me from worrying too much about you.
:{{A|vo dialog nllq003 nilou 02.ogg}} '''Nilou:''' I think I already see you two as people of the Grand Bazaar. Yep, without a doubt.
{{Dialogue End}}
{{Quest Description|update|Sharif quit the debate, and the theater finally avoided the fate of being demolished. However, the seemingly perfect ending has left a little regret...}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(After passing time)
;(Approach the theater)
:;(Nilou finishes a dance)
:{{A|vo nllq003 7 nilou 01.ogg}} '''Nilou:''' Everyone, I'd like to introduce you to our newest member: Inayah!
:{{A|vo nllq003 7 inayah 01.ogg}} '''Inayah:''' H—Hello, everyone...
:{{A|vo nllq003 7 nilou 02.ogg}} '''Nilou:''' She'll be dancing for us from now on, so please give her your support.
:{{A|vo nllq003 7 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Inayah's taken her place on the stage! Paimon wonders how she'll look once she starts dancing.
:{{A|vo nllq003 7 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' When you stop and think about it, happy endings like this sure aren't easy to come by!
:{{DIcon}} A lot of things came together to make it happen.
:{{A|vo nllq003 7 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Nilou's efforts, everyone's wisdom, Inayah's determination...
:{{DIcon}} And Sharif's mercy.
:{{A|vo nllq003 7 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh? What do you mean by that?
:{{DIcon}} I think he intentionally gave us a chance.
:{{DIcon}} He didn't have to agree to the debate.
:{{A|vo nllq003 7 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You do have a point there...
:{{A|vo nllq003 7 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' The whole demolition thing was going overboard, but he really could've banned Nilou and the others from dancing.
:{{A|vo nllq003 7 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' If he really wanted to be ruthless, he could've done some real damage, even without winning the debate.
:{{A|vo nllq003 7 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh well, it's not like we can understand how people like him think. Let's focus on watching the performance!
:{{DIcon}} Agreed.
:{{DIcon}} Enough of him for now.
:{{A|vo nllq003 7 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh!? Wait, look who the cat dragged in!
:{{A|vo nllq003 7 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Isn't that Inayah's father!?
:{{DIcon}} Let's go greet him.
:{{A|vo nllq003 7 sharif 01.ogg}} '''Sharif:''' Oh, it's you two.
:{{A|vo nllq003 7 sharif 02.ogg}} '''Sharif:''' I don't have much to do today, so I just came to look around this place.
:{{A|vo nllq003 7 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hmph, are you looking for Inayah?
:{{A|vo nllq003 7 sharif 03.ogg}} '''Sharif:''' No, I am simply here to watch a performance. There is no need to trouble her.
:{{DIcon}} Shouldn't you be busy?
:{{A|vo nllq003 7 sharif 04.ogg}} '''Sharif:''' Well, I was, for a time.
:{{A|vo nllq003 7 sharif 05.ogg}} '''Sharif:''' My loss at the debate caused quite the loss of face for the Akademiya, so there was a period of unrest.
:{{A|vo nllq003 7 sharif 06.ogg}} '''Sharif:''' I used this opportunity to suggest that my superiors temporarily suspend me from duty. Otherwise, the rumors would probably persist for even longer.
:{{A|vo nllq003 7 paimon 12.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Suspended from duty...
:{{A|vo nllq003 7 sharif 07.ogg}} '''Sharif:''' Yes, I am temporarily unemployed. However, I now have an abundance of time, so I can afford to come here and watch a show.
:{{A|vo nllq003 7 sharif 08.ogg}} '''Sharif:''' I admit that I do not understand the magic that this theater possesses, but my curiosity has been piqued.
:{{A|vo nllq003 7 sharif 09.ogg}} '''Sharif:''' I still cannot forget that young lady's perseverance. Inayah would almost certainly mature in the presence of such a person.
:{{DIcon}} So you're still concerned about your daughter.
:{{A|vo nllq003 7 sharif 10.ogg}} '''Sharif:''' There are no parents who do not worry about their children. I suppose she managed to hit a weak spot of mine.
:{{A|vo nllq003 7 sharif 11.ogg}} '''Sharif:''' Never mind. I do not have the right to say that.
:{{A|vo nllq003 7 paimon 13.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You're already here, so you might as well go see her.
:{{A|vo nllq003 7 sharif 12.ogg}} '''Sharif:''' No, that is not necessary. I will take my leave after the show concludes.
:;(Nilou, who is talking to Inayah on the stage, notices Sharif)
:{{A|vo nllq003 7 sharif 13.ogg}} '''Sharif:''' ...Do not tell her that I was here.
;(A cinematic plays)
{{Cutscene Description|While you are having a conversation, Nilou pushes the reluctant Inayah to your side. She beckons you to step aside and leave some private space for the estranged father and daughter.<p>After seeing his daughter again, Sharif takes out a work of embroidery from his bag — his attempt to make up for the hurt his daughter has received. ::{{A|vo nllq003 cs nilou 01.ogg}} '''Nilou:''' C'mon, who knows if you'll get a chance like this again!
:;(Nilou pushes Inayah towards the Traveler and Sharif)
::{{A|vo nllq003 cs inayah 01.ogg}} '''Inayah:''' But, but...
::{{A|vo nllq003 cs nilou 02.ogg}} '''Nilou:''' You said you were going to make peace with your past. Show your father how much you've grown
::{{A|vo nllq003 cs nilou 03.ogg}} '''Nilou:''' Don't be nervous. Everyone at Zubayr Theater has your back!
::{{A|vo nllq003 cs nilou 04.ogg}} '''Nilou:''' Hey, let's go somewhere else. We should give them some space
::{{A|vo nllq003 cs paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You sure they'll be okay?
::{{A|vo nllq003 cs nilou 05.ogg}} '''Nilou:''' I dunno
::{{A|vo nllq003 cs nilou 06.ogg}} '''Nilou:''' But... I think we should have faith in them
:;(Nilou, the Traveler, and Paimon give them some space)
:;(After some awkwardness from both of them, Sharif starts to talk)
::{{A|vo nllq003 cs sharif 01.ogg}} '''Sharif:''' Ah, yes, Inayah...
::{{A|vo nllq003 cs sharif 02.ogg}} '''Sharif:''' I have something for you
:;(He pulls out an embroidery piece and offers it to Inayah)
::{{A|vo nllq003 cs sharif 03.ogg}} '''Sharif:''' I'm still learning. It's hardly a masterpiece...
::{{A|vo nllq003 cs sharif 04.ogg}} '''Sharif:''' But it's yours, if you'll take it
:;(Seeing Inayah's hesitation, he begins to take it back)
::{{A|vo nllq003 cs sharif 05.ogg}} '''Sharif:''' ...You don't have to take it
::{{A|vo nllq003 cs sharif 06.ogg}} '''Sharif:''' It's fine. Er... never mind
:;(Inayah reaches out and takes the embroidery piece from him, holds it to her chest, and turns around)
::{{A|vo nllq003 cs inayah 02.ogg}} '''Inayah:''' Let's have a heart-to-heart, Father
:;(Cinematic ends)
:{{A|vo nllq003 7 paimon 14.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Like father, like daughter. They're both so awkward with their feelings!
:{{A|vo nllq003 7 nilou 03.ogg}} '''Nilou:''' Yeah, she probably would've snuck away as well if I didn't drag her back.
:{{A|vo nllq003 7 paimon 15.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Do you think they'll be able to reconcile?
:{{A|vo nllq003 7 nilou 04.ogg}} '''Nilou:''' I'm not sure. A complete reconciliation may also not be the best thing for them right now.
:{{A|vo nllq003 7 nilou 05.ogg}} '''Nilou:''' All those years of arguments and misunderstandings can't be settled overnight. It might be best if they continue to keep some distance for now.
:{{A|vo nllq003 7 nilou 06.ogg}} '''Nilou:''' But no matter where their hearts and bodies may be, they will always be family.
:{{A|vo nllq003 7 nilou 07.ogg}} '''Nilou:''' All I wish for them is to be able to one day tap into the warmth of that bond.
:{{A|vo nllq003 7 nilou 08.ogg}} '''Nilou:''' Oh, by the way, everyone's really thankful to you for helping out with the debate.
:{{A|vo nllq003 7 nilou 09.ogg}} '''Nilou:''' So we made you a little something. Hope you'll like it!
::[[File:Item Miniature Zubayr Theater.png|150px]]
:{{A|vo nllq003 7 paimon 16.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' I—Isn't this Zubayr Theater?
:{{A|vo nllq003 7 paimon 17.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Whoa, this is amazing... It's so detailed and polished...
:{{A|vo nllq003 7 nilou 10.ogg}} '''Nilou:''' Hee-hee, we've also never made anything this complicated before.
:{{A|vo nllq003 7 nilou 11.ogg}} '''Nilou:''' Mr. Zubayr and Mr. Khasani took charge of the design, while Inayah and I made all the little pieces with the help of others.
:{{A|vo nllq003 7 nilou 12.ogg}} '''Nilou:''' Ms. Rekhar and Miss Najia made and assembled the centerpiece.
:{{A|vo nllq003 7 nilou 13.ogg}} '''Nilou:''' As adventurers, you two will doubtlessly travel to many more lands and see many more things.
:{{A|vo nllq003 7 nilou 14.ogg}} '''Nilou:''' That's why we hope that your time at Zubayr Theater will become a fond memory of your journey. You two are welcome back anytime!
:{{A|vo nllq003 7 paimon 18.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Mhm, we'll come back and watch you dance whenever we get the chance!
:{{DIcon}} Thank you all for being so considerate.
:{{DIcon}} According to custom, I should drop the formalities and just accept it, right?
:{{A|vo nllq003 7 nilou 15.ogg}} '''Nilou:''' You're welcome, and there's no need to be so polite. You learned fast!
:{{A|vo nllq003 7 nilou 16.ogg}} '''Nilou:''' Come on, take it. This is the story of you and me. It's a tale that I'll never, ever forget.
:;(Obtain [[Miniature Zubayr Theater]])
{{Dialogue End}}

{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Upon arriving to House of Daena)
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1916002 layla 01.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Okay, I should get started on those notes. If there's anything you're curious about, you may go ahead and ask now. I can answer you as I write! I'm used to multi-tasking.
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1916002 layla 02.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Oh, and I have to ask a favor. When you give the notes to her later, please don't tell her about my existence.
:{{DIcon}} Why's that?
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1916002 layla 03.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Hmm, well, she's always been in a fragile state. If she knew that there was another "Layla" who's always taking care of everything...
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1916002 layla 04.ogg}} '''Layla:''' She might feel like everything she's ever worked for is pointless, and that could lead to some demoralizing thoughts.
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1916002 layla 05.ogg}} '''Layla:''' She's a resilient girl, but no matter how resilient she may be, no one can hold up to criticism and torment from themselves.
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1916002 layla 06.ogg}} '''Layla:''' If her condition grows any worse, it's possible that I might cease to exist as well. Then there wouldn't be anyone to help her.
:{{DIcon}} But she's not doing very well now, either.
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1916002 layla 07.ogg}} '''Layla:''' She's getting better, though, isn't she? It's apparent how hard she's working now.
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1916002 layla 08.ogg}} '''Layla:''' She's my source of knowledge. I'm merely the representation of how she would be if she were rested and healthy.
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1916002 layla 09.ogg}} '''Layla:''' I believe that she's one of the best, even in a place like the Akademiya, where geniuses come by the handful.
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1916002 layla 10.ogg}} '''Layla:''' But growth is a process and shouldn't be rushed. I will always believe in and support her.
:{{DIcon}} It's good that she has you, or she might've already hit rock bottom.
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1916002 layla 11.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Hahaha, believe me, even if she were to end up at rock bottom, she'd find a way to somehow laugh it off as one of her silly mistakes and climb her way out.
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1916002 layla 12.ogg}} '''Layla:''' That's the kind of person she is.
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1916002 layla 13.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Alright, I've written down all the possible questions that I think the advisers might ask. Next, I'll put together a few words of encouragement for her.
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1916002 layla 14.ogg}} '''Layla:''' I'm not going to sign it, obviously. Oh, and don't forget about our agreement.
;(Obtain {{Item|"The Arrayed Stars Mirrored"}})
;(Proceed to [[#Ending: The Stars' Expectations|Ending: The Stars' Expectations]])
{{Dialogue End}}

{{Quest Description|Mualani successfully figures out the next destination based on the clues found in the valley, but it seems that new challenges await you there...}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Approach the marked location)
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 1 mualani 01.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' Okay, this is the place.
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 1 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So, where do we go next?
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 1 mualani 02.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' I'm not completely sure yet. The map seems to indicate there's a mechanism here that crosses the water, but I still need to think about what these lines might be referring to...
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 1 viramdra 01.ogg}} '''Viramdra:''' I knew it! My theory was correct!
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 1 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Sounds like he's got something to say again.
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 1 mualani 03.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' If you have any suggestions, then please feel free to share.
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 1 viramdra 02.ogg}} '''Viramdra:''' I believe the mechanism that the lines are indicating is a Spiritway.
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 1 mualani 04.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' Hmm, that is a possibility, but I don't remember anyone from the tribe setting up a Spiritdoor around here.
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 1 viramdra 03.ogg}} '''Viramdra:''' According to my theory, it might not have been set up by humans. The [[dragon]]s living in [[Natlan]] also used a similar device, long before the humans.
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 1 viramdra 04.ogg}} '''Viramdra:''' Speaking of which, the Spiritdoors your tribe uses may have been built imitating the dragon ones.
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 1 mualani 05.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' I remember now! Uncle [[Nuu]] did mention this possibility to me before...
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 1 viramdra 05.ogg}} '''Viramdra:''' After learning about the legend, I realized that it was connected to my research, and so, I looked up a lot of related information.
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 1 viramdra 06.ogg}} '''Viramdra:''' Even though I haven't found an exact route to the mysterious island, I'm fairly certain I've deduced the geographical features of the island's surrounding areas.
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 1 viramdra 07.ogg}} '''Viramdra:''' Firstly, it's at an intersection between water and land, and secondly, there should be a high concentration of Phlogiston. My research indicates that the Spiritway was originally a natural phenomenon caused by the flow of Phlogiston.
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 1 viramdra 08.ogg}} '''Viramdra:''' Therefore, the area must contain many potential Spiritways, and the dragons who lived here in ancient times may have left behind some devices to control them.
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 1 mualani 06.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' Ah... amazing! Now it all makes sense!
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 1 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Now everyone's contributing to the team!
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 1 viramdra 09.ogg}} '''Viramdra:''' Ahem... You flatter me. If my theory is correct, we should already be very close to the mysterious island. Once you've unlocked the mechanism, we'll be able to derive the island's location.
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 1 mualani 07.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' Alright, then let's start searching for the dragons' Spiritdoor!
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 1 viramdra 10.ogg}} '''Viramdra:''' That's just a quick and easy name... I won't be able to include it in my thesis. Given the dragons used the device long before the humans, we should stick with a name that references no human concepts. Calling it a "Phlogiston Node" would be much more appropriate.
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 1 mualani 08.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' ...Uh, then let's start searching for the Phlogiston Node! Speaking of which, what is it, exactly?<ref group="Note">Actual spoken voice line: "Speaking of which, what does it look like exactly?"</ref>
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 1 viramdra 11.ogg}} '''Viramdra:''' If I'm not mistaken... look that way!
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 1 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Whoa, it started glowing! This should be it, right?
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 1 mualani 09.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' Looks like we can activate it once we get close enough. The light does remind me of a Spiritway.
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 1 mualani 10.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' But according to the map, there should be two more Phlogiston Nodes. Let's keep searching, everyone.

;(Talk to [[Karya]], optional)
