:{{A|vo mlnlq005 2 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Whew... We finally found all of them!
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 2 mualani 01.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' Great work, everyone! Okay, now, first, we need to figure out how to control this thing. Hmm... Its qualities are very similar to that of a man-made device, but it doesn't seem as intuitive to me...
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 2 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Is there something wrong?
:{{Color|menu|When Mualani tries to operate the Phlogiston Node, a Spiritway appears in mid-air, then disappears again.}}
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 2 mualani 02.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' See, look at this... After activating a normal Spiritdoor, we could just go ahead and use it. But this one requires someone to stay and keep operating it here.
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 2 mualani 03.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' Also, according to the map, we need to activate the mechanism and switch between different Phlogiston Nodes to change the path of the Spiritway.
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 2 mualani 04.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' If we don't operate the nodes properly, then the people on the Spiritway will come tumbling from the sky.
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 2 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Isn't that super dangerous?
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 2 viramdra 01.ogg}} '''Viramdra:''' In theory, the process should be very safe, but only if the three Phlogiston Nodes are each being operated by someone.
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 2 mualani 05.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' Do you think you'd be able to operate it? I just tried, and it clearly requires more skill than a typical Spiritdoor.
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 2 viramdra 02.ogg}} '''Viramdra:''' Though I've never tried before, I've read a lot of information and theoretically should be able to properly control it. Let me give it a try...
:{{Color|menu|Viramdra tries to operate the Phlogiston Node, but ultimately fails.}}
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 2 viramdra 03.ogg}} '''Viramdra:''' ...Huh? But in theory, this shouldn't happen.
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 2 karya 01.ogg}} '''Karya:''' If Viramdra can't control it, then that also rules out me...
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 2 mualani 06.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' Okay... Well, how about you?
:{{Color|menu|You try to operate the Phlogiston Node too, and manage to successfully activate the Spiritway.}}
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 2 paimon 04a.ogg}} {{A|vo mlnlq005 2 paimon 04b.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' After all the adventures {{Traveler}}'s been on, handling something like this should be easy-peasy!
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 2 mualani 07.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' Alright, then it'll be up to the {{Traveler}} to stay here and operate the Phlogiston Node. I'll go activate the mechanism.
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 2 mualani 08.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' I'll let you know when we need to switch nodes. Just make sure you quickly head to the corresponding node and we should make it safely!
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 2 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wait! But handling it this way sounds even more dangerous, Mualani.
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 2 mualani 09.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' Don't worry, it looks like the Spiritways are all above the water. I'm pretty good at swimming, so I'm not afraid if I end up falling in!
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 2 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' But it's so high, and you'll be falling so fast... If we don't manage to reach a node in time, or if we make a mistake, there's a lot that can happen...
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 2 mualani 10.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' Do you still remember the promise we made before we left, Paimon?

:{{DIcon}} Just leave it to us!

:{{A|vo mlnlq005 3 mualani 01.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' Whew... That was perfect!
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 3 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You're amazing, Mualani! There were a couple moments Paimon thought it was over...
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 3 mualani 02.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' Hehe, I'm confident I could do it all over again! Wait, why are the Phlogiston Nodes no longer lit?
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 3 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh no, you're right...
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 3 viramdra 01.ogg}} '''Viramdra:''' It appears the Phlogiston Nodes here need to automatically recharge. Once they're activated, they'll be unusable for some time.
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 3 mualani 03.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' In that case, no matter what happens next, we have to seize our chance. Otherwise, who knows how long we'll have to wait for another shot.
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 3 viramdra 02.ogg}} '''Viramdra:''' Do you hear that...?
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 3 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' The weather's getting gloomy... And a bunch of whirlpools just appeared in the water!
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 3 mualani 04.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' Yes, we need to get to higher ground and take a look.
:{{Black Screen|You make your way up the hill nearby.}}
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 3 mualani 05.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' Hey, look over there!
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 3 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Whoa, there's a giant whirlpool over there!
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 3 mualani 06.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' Yep, and that's our next stop...
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 3 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh? What do you mean?
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 3 mualani 07.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' ...The info I deciphered from the map points to only one possibility... To reach the mysterious island, we must enter that massive whirlpool.
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 3 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' No way...
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 3 viramdra 03.ogg}} '''Viramdra:''' Forgive me for being frank, but as a guide of the [[People of the Springs]], I'm sure you understand of the danger of such a vortex even better than we do.
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 3 mualani 08.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' Yes, I know. But whether it's the information deciphered from the map, or the direction of the Spiritway that I observed in the air...
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 3 mualani 09.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' Everything points to the path ahead being hidden in that whirlpool!
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 3 viramdra 04.ogg}} '''Viramdra:''' And what if you're wrong?
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 3 karya 01.ogg}} '''Karya:''' Viramdra...
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 3 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' ...
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 3 viramdra 05.ogg}} '''Viramdra:''' I'm not trying to be unreasonable. Unfortunately, I'm very knowledgeable in this area...
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 3 viramdra 06.ogg}} '''Viramdra:''' The Spiritways must have affected the nearby bodies of water, and lowered the water level... That's why the whirlpools appeared.
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 3 viramdra 07.ogg}} '''Viramdra:''' At this rate, some of the land that was once underwater will soon reappear at the surface and see the light of day again... Don't you think that sounds more like the definition of a mysterious island?
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 3 viramdra 08.ogg}} '''Viramdra:''' So our goal should be the shallow waters. If we enter that vortex, the undercurrents will drag us to the bottomless abyss!
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 3 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Uh... He does seem to have a point.
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 3 mualani 10.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' I can't find any evidence to refute your claim for the moment, but I still trust my judgment.
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 3 viramdra 09.ogg}} '''Viramdra:''' Then it seems like it's time for our collaboration to come to an end.
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 3 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' But didn't we all agree to trust each other!?
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 3 viramdra 10.ogg}} '''Viramdra:''' I have reached this conclusion based on my field of expertise, and I cannot deny it, even if you try to convince me otherwise. From now on, let us each choose our own way.
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 3 mualani 11.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' ...No, I refuse!
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 3 viramdra 11.ogg}} '''Viramdra:''' Y—You...
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 3 mualani 12.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' Letting your clients separate themselves from the group in the middle of a journey will result in the worst luck possible! I will not agree to that.
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 3 viramdra 12.ogg}} '''Viramdra:''' Then we can implement the plan I proposed at the very beginning. You're not my guide, and as such, you don't have to take responsibility for me!
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 3 mualani 13.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' Ugh, but you can't do that once you've traveled together as a group! If you were to leave now, we'll all be hit with bad luck. It's now beyond both of our control.
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 3 mualani 14.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' How about this... You and Karya wait here. We'll go first and investigate the whirlpool.
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 3 mualani 15.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' I know you like to explain everything with theories and logic, so let me build my case first, and then I'll come back to convince you!
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 3 viramdra 13.ogg}} '''Viramdra:''' Well, uh...
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 3 mualani 16.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' {{Traveler}}, Paimon, let's get going!

;(Talk to Karya or Viramdra, optional)
:{{A|vo dialog mlnlq005 viramdra 02.ogg}} '''Viramdra:''' You're better acquainted with her than I, so you should tell her to carefully reconsider her decision.
:{{A|vo dialog mlnlq005 karya 02.ogg}} '''Karya:''' Viramdra is quite knowledgeable about Natlan's geography, so his ideas might also be worth considering. Perhaps you can give it some thought...

:{{A|vo mlnlq005 4 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Whoa, the massive whirlpool is up ahead. Just the thought of going in there is making Paimon dizzy...
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 4 mualani 01.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' Do you also think that this is a reckless decision?
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 4 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Um, well...
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 4 mualani 02.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' It's okay, that's completely normal. Actually, I completely understand how Viramdra feels.
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 4 mualani 03.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' This is just how it is to be a guide. The tribe's experiences that has been passed down from generation to generation is what gives us the ability to guide our guests through hardships.
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 4 mualani 04.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' This gives us the power to decide which way we should go, but it also means that we must bear the consequences of our mistakes in judgment. Which could be quite dire this time...
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 4 mualani 05.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' Although I'm pretty convinced that all the leads we have collected are pointing us to the whirlpool, I still don't know what awaits us inside.
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 4 mualani 06.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' If the scholars still choose to reject my plan, I won't have the confidence to ask them to only do as I say.
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 4 mualani 07.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' The same goes for the two of you. You are the commissioners, so if you think this is too risky, then it's perfectly reasonable if you want to end the trip here...
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 4 mualani 08.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' The good news is that I know the way back to the tribe very well!
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 4 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Mualani...
:{{DIcon}} We've already made a promise to each other.
:{{DIcon}} We'll reach the island together.
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 4 mualani 09.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' {{Traveler}}...
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 4 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' That's right! You've trusted us before, Mualani. Now it's our turn to trust you.
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 4 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Besides, it's gonna take more than a whirlpool to scare the two of us! We all managed to make it back from the Night Kingdom. After an experience like that, what's so scary about being sucked into a whirlpool?
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 4 mualani 10.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' Aw, Paimon... C'mon, bring it in again!
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 4 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Alright, alright... Let's investigate this whirlpool and see if we can gather any info to convince that scholar.
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 4 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Matters of luck aside, he definitely knows a lot about geography. We'll need him on the team.
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 4 mualani 11.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' I know, it's just that we can't see much from here... I'll get closer to the water and have another look.
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 4 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wait a sec... Is it just Paimon, or does the whirlpool seem to be getting smaller?
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 4 mualani 12.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' You're right... Maybe it's just like the Phlogiston Nodes and can only be active for a certain amount of time?
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 4 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' That means we need to hurry!
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 4 karya 01.ogg}} '''Karya:''' Miss Guide, we have a problem!
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 4 mualani 13.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' Karya? What are you doing here?
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 4 karya 02.ogg}} '''Karya:''' I tried to persuade him, but Viramdra insisted on verifying his theory first.
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 4 karya 03.ogg}} '''Karya:''' He said that the water to the south was about to be shallow enough to wade through. But after he took a few steps, the water suddenly began to surge, and he was swept away.
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 4 karya 04.ogg}} '''Karya:''' I'm not much of a swimmer, so I came to call for help.
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 4 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Why did this have to happen now... Can we still make it into the whirlpool?
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 4 mualani 14.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' No need to hesitate.<ref group="Note">Actual spoken voice line: "No time to hesitate."</ref> I'll get in the water and rescue him, just tell me which way he went, Karya!

;(While rescuing Viramdra)<!-- Timed challenge, 90s. Unsure what happens if you fail -->
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 4 viramdra 01.ogg}} '''Viramdra:''' Help! *coughing*
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 4 mualani 15.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' That way? He's been pulled away by the current!

:{{A|vo mlnlq005 4 mualani 16.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' Not here either... The current is too fast!

:{{A|vo mlnlq005 4 mualani 17.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' We found him!

;(After reaching Viramdra)
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 5 viramdra 01.ogg}} '''Viramdra:''' *coughing* *spluttering*
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 5 mualani 01.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' Whew... Karya came and found us just in time.
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 5 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, there they are!
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 5 karya 01.ogg}} '''Karya:''' Viramdra... thank goodness you're alright. Thank you so much, Miss Guide.
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 5 mualani 02.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' Ugh, didn't I tell you to wait for me?
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 5 viramdra 02.ogg}} '''Viramdra:''' *cough* Judging by the changes in the water's surface, the path to the mysterious island wouldn't be around for long! I didn't want to miss this opportunity!
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 5 viramdra 03.ogg}} '''Viramdra:''' It's just... I didn't expect my calculations to be wrong. It seems you were right...
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 5 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Right, who knows if we can make it back in time now... Huh? The whirlpools have disappeared!
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 5 mualani 03.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' Seems we missed our chance...
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 5 viramdra 04.ogg}} '''Viramdra:''' Why would you give up on such an opportunity to come rescue me?
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 5 mualani 04.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' How can you say that? It's already bad enough that you had to be left behind. Do you think I'd let anyone in my group drown?
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 5 viramdra 05.ogg}} '''Viramdra:''' ...
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 5 karya 02.ogg}} '''Karya:''' I'm really sorry...
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 5 mualani 05.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' Don't feel guilty, Karya. I think if I reactivate the nodes, that will cause the whirlpools to reappear.
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 5 mualani 06.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' The only problem is that we still don't know exactly when we'll be able to do that...
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 5 mualani 07.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' It's already getting late now, and we've been on the move for the whole day. As your guide, I suggest we make camp first and have a good meal. We can talk about the other stuff tomorrow.
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 5 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Now that you mention it, Paimon is feeling a little hungry...
:{{DIcon}} It's a miracle she hasn't mentioned food for so long...
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 5 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hey, Paimon's stomach can be very sensible. It won't interrupt while everyone's busy solving puzzles.
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 5 mualani 08.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' We have plenty of tasty things to eat, let's just find a suitable spot to make camp. Hmm... I like that place right over there.
:{{Black Screen|Mualani guides everyone to the best place to make camp.}}
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 5 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Is this the spot? Let Paimon and {{Traveler}} help set up the tent!
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 5 mualani 09.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' Go ahead! I'll take care of the fire. And here's a little camping tip, it's best to set the tent upwind from the campfire!

:{{A|vo mlnlq005 6 mualani 02.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' Karya helped out quite a bit, so she deserves some credit, too!
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 6 karya 01.ogg}} '''Karya:''' No no, I'm just happy I was able to help out.
:{{Color|menu|You hear an unsettling scream in the distance...}}
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 6 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh? What was that sound? Some kind of wild beast? Oh, it's scary to camp out at night...<ref group="Note">The voice line omits the words "Some kind of wild beast?"</ref>
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 6 mualani 03.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' Don't worry. Remember the record player I bought? Let me go turn it on.
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 6 mualani 04.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' Listen. It really works, huh?<ref group="Note">Actual spoken voice line: "Listen. Not bad, right?"</ref>
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 6 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wow, so it really works? Paimon thought you were just playing it for good luck.
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 6 mualani 05.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' My parents told me that most of the valuable experience from our ancestors is hidden in various customs. It's always better to trust our traditions.
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 6 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh, guess that makes sense...
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 6 mualani 06.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' In a sense, this trip to the mysterious island is also a custom left behind by the first chief of the tribe. I wonder what kind of experience he's trying to share with us.
:{{DIcon}} What kind of person was he like?
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 6 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yeah, Paimon would like to know, too!
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 6 mualani 07.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' Even though I've heard my parents tell stories since I was little... I actually don't know too much about him.
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 6 mualani 08.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' It's said that he was the first person to make a map of Natlan, and even the first person to become friends with the [[Koholasaur]]s.
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 6 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' That sounds pretty amazing!
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 6 mualani 09.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' Yeah, there isn't a place in Natlan that he didn't visit... even the most remote parts bear his footprints.
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 6 mualani 10.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' Even now, no one has even come close to his reputation and status as a guide. His trip to the mysterious island is the most legendary of all his accomplishments.
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 6 mualani 11.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' But oddly enough, after returning from the mysterious island, he laid aside his yearning for adventure and chose to settle down. That's how the tribe was founded.
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 6 mualani 12.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' It really makes me wonder what the journey meant to him.
:{{Color|menu|Mualani notices that Viramdra has already gone silent...}}
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 6 mualani 13.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' Hmm? Ahem... A camping trip shouldn't be this stuffy and quiet! Everyone needs to help make it more lively!
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 6 mualani 14.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' How about this... before we rest for the night, let's have a bonfire party!
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 6 viramdra 01.ogg}} '''Viramdra:''' If we're going to go plunging into that whirlpool tomorrow, then wouldn't it be best to try to rest and conserve energy now?
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 6 mualani 15.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' Now's not the time to be a party pooper! You ought to agree to ideas from the one who rescued you today!
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 6 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yeah, she's right!
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 6 viramdra 02.ogg}} '''Viramdra:''' Alright... So what do the rules stipulate for a bonfire party?
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 6 mualani 16.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' Rules? A bonfire doesn't have any rules! Everyone just needs to have a good time. How about this, I'll ask everyone a question, and then we'll take turns saying what's on our mind.
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 6 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Okay, sounds fun enough!
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 6 mualani 17.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' So, for the first question... what's the purpose of a journey?
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 6 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, we were just talking about this!
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 6 mualani 18.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' Let's hear everyone's ideas, and maybe we can figure out what the first chief was thinking back when he made the trip.
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 6 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Paimon can go first! If you ask Paimon what the purpose of a journey is... it'd definitely be about treasure and all kinds of delicious food! And...
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 6 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Most importantly, it's about making the trip together with your companions!
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 6 mualani 19.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' Yes, I can't agree more! Okay, next person... How about you, {{Traveler}}?
:{{DIcon}} The purpose of a journey...
:{{Black Screen|You close your eyes and recall the moment you were separated from [[Traveler's Sibling|{{MC|m=her|f=him}}]]...}}
:{{Black Screen|You remember the purpose of your journey has been to find {{MC|m=her|f=him}} all along... but you have yet to achieve this goal. You don't seem to see any other meaning to this long journey...}}
:{{Black Screen|However, you suddenly begin to recall the sound of the windmills creaking in [[Mondstadt]], and the sight of the colorful night sky in [[Liyue Harbor]]...}}
:{{Black Screen|You remember the moment you stepped onto the islands of [[Inazuma]] with the falling Sakura petals.}}
:{{Black Screen|You remember following the smell of coffee in [[Sumeru]].}}
:{{Black Screen|You hear the sound of the tide, and return to the waters of [[Fontaine]], swimming alongside schools of colorful fish...}}
:{{Black Screen|These things seem to be the real meaning of your journey.}}
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 6 mualani 20.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' You sure are taking your time thinking about it!
:{{DIcon}} Hmm, where should I even start?
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 6 mualani 21.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' Ah, I get it. You must have passed through many nations before making it to Natlan, right?
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 6 mualani 22.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' It's quite possible that your experience traveling is more than what I have as a guide. It's understandable that you can't explain it off the top of your head.
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 6 mualani 23.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' Why don't I circle back to you later? You can tell me once you have a clear answer.
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 6 mualani 24.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' Next... Let's hear what Karya has to say.
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 6 karya 02.ogg}} '''Karya:''' Me? If you ask about my travels... Well, this is actually my first time traveling, so I don't have anything useful to contribute.
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 6 mualani 25.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' That doesn't matter! This is a party around the bonfire, not some research seminar.
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 6 karya 03.ogg}} '''Karya:''' Alright... If I had to say what the meaning of a journey is, I'd say... it provides an opportunity for true companionship.
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 6 karya 04.ogg}} '''Karya:''' Before you reach the destination, you don't need to think about anything outside the trip itself. As long as you stick together with your companions, you won't have any trouble to worry about.
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 6 mualani 26.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' I think I understand.<ref group="Note">Actual spoken voice line: "Yeah, I get it."</ref>
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 6 paimon 12.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Paimon, too!
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 6 karya 05.ogg}} '''Karya:''' Huh? I hope that didn't sound too silly...
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 6 mualani 27.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' Ahem! Alright, now it's Viramdra's turn!
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 6 viramdra 03.ogg}} '''Viramdra:''' Alright, if you insist...
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 6 viramdra 04.ogg}} '''Viramdra:''' In my opinion, our goals and dreams in life are all in pursuit of what we call "results." The so-called "journey" is but a path that leads to these results.
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 6 viramdra 05.ogg}} '''Viramdra:''' So, the greatest meaning of a journey lies in managing to find the right result.
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 6 mualani 28.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' Not sure I completely get what you mean...
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 6 viramdra 06.ogg}} '''Viramdra:''' There's nothing difficult to understand. It's the same as the decision of your first chief.
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 6 viramdra 07.ogg}} '''Viramdra:''' He must have discovered enough valuable results after visiting the mysterious island to decide that he should end his journey. Once you've achieved the results you want, any additional journeys would become all but meaningless.
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 6 mualani 29.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' Um...
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 6 viramdra 08.ogg}} '''Viramdra:''' Before coming here, someone had stolen the "results" of one of my research projects.
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 6 viramdra 09.ogg}} '''Viramdra:''' All that person had to do was sign his name on my achievements, and he was able to take all of the honors. All my effort vanished into the air as though it never existed.
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 6 viramdra 10.ogg}} '''Viramdra:''' Do you understand now, Miss Guide? Without results, the journey is meaningless.
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 6 mualani 30.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' I sympathize with your situation, but I'm afraid I can't agree with your take.
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 6 viramdra 11.ogg}} '''Viramdra:''' I don't need your sympathy. As long as I can reach the mysterious island and find the correct results, my pain and struggles will become just another insignificant part of the process.
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 6 viramdra 12.ogg}} '''Viramdra:''' What happened during the day already proved that my theories were wrong, so I'm willing to trust your judgment. I apologize for our previous argument.
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 6 viramdra 13.ogg}} '''Viramdra:''' I must make it to the mysterious island, and if I have to entrust my life to someone else to achieve that goal, then so be it!
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 6 paimon 13.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Was that actually supposed to be an apology, 'cause It sounded kinda awkward...
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 6 mualani 31.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' Actually, there's a saying among the guides of the People of the Springs... If the goal of the journey was to reach the destination, then you should have never left the house to begin with.
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 6 mualani 32.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' Because the final destination of every journey is your home.
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 6 mualani 33.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' It would be disrespectful of my duties as a guide if I were just taking tourists straight to where they wanted to go. It's my hope to also make everyone feel happy along the way to their destination!
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 6 mualani 34.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' That is what I would truly call a journey, and that is my answer.
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 6 viramdra 14.ogg}} '''Viramdra:''' Just as you don't agree with me, I can't agree with your point of view, either.
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 6 mualani 35.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' I'm not too worried about that. After all, another purpose of traveling is to help people understand each other better.
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 6 viramdra 15.ogg}} '''Viramdra:''' What sort of logic is that...?
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 6 mualani 36.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' Alright, that's it for this round. Since it's still early, how about we tell some horror stories next?
:{{A|vo mlnlq005 6 paimon 14.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh!? Oh, now Paimon's scared...
{{Dialogue End}}

==Steps==

# Speak to the young lady at the store
# Head to the entrance of [[Dragonspine]]

:{{A|vo bzlq001 6 hutao 08.ogg}} '''Hu Tao:''' According to my grandpa, he and my great-uncle once went traveling together when they were young. They ended up at [[Chenyu Vale]], where they met a pharmacist.
:{{A|vo bzlq001 6 hutao 09.ogg}} '''Hu Tao:''' That pharmacist must've cast some sort of spell on my great-uncle, because after that encounter, he suddenly announced he wanted to leave the family business and go practice medicine instead.
:{{A|vo bzlq001 6 hutao 10.ogg}} '''Hu Tao:''' My grandpa had a huge argument with him, but he couldn't convince him to stay.
:{{A|vo bzlq001 6 hutao 11.ogg}} '''Hu Tao:''' So my grandpa inherited the Funeral Parlor, while my great-uncle stayed in Chenyu Vale to practice medicine... They never spoke to each other again.
:{{A|vo bzlq001 6 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Funeral director to doctor is a pretty big career change. Kinda hard to imagine... But why did it drive a wedge between them for the rest of their lives? That seems a bit extreme.
:{{A|vo bzlq001 6 hutao 12.ogg}} '''Hu Tao:''' If he had just become a regular doctor, there would have been no issue. After all, the Wangsheng Funeral Parlor wasn't unlike a regular doctor's clinic in the early days.
:{{A|vo bzlq001 6 hutao 13.ogg}} '''Hu Tao:''' But according to my grandpa, the pharmacist they met had a very ominous aura about him...
:{{A|vo bzlq001 6 hutao 14.ogg}} '''Hu Tao:''' ...And on top of that, the kind of medicine practiced in the Chenyu Vale tradition goes against the natural order of things.
:{{A|vo bzlq001 6 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' ...In what way?
:{{A|vo bzlq001 6 hutao 15.ogg}} '''Hu Tao:''' Don't know. My grandpa didn't know the specifics, and you've seen how wary Baizhu is around me. He'd never tell me anything...
:{{A|vo bzlq001 6 hutao 16.ogg}} '''Hu Tao:''' But even that says to me that he definitely has something to hide.
:{{A|vo bzlq001 6 hutao 17.ogg}} '''Hu Tao:''' One thing I do know about Baizhu is that he's obsessed with the idea of immortality... But whether that has anything to do with what he's hiding is hard to say.
:{{DIcon}} (Immortality...?)
:{{A|vo bzlq001 6 hutao 18.ogg}} '''Hu Tao:''' Anyway, so I will be sticking around here for now to keep a close eye on the situation. Maybe tomorrow, I'll finally figure out what he's up to...

;(After the cutscene)
:{{A|vo bzlq001 6 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Whew... After all that, it seems like we have more questions than answers!
:{{A|vo bzlq001 6 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Never mind. We'll just have to ask Baizhu himself about all of this tomorrow!

;(Talk to Hu Tao again, optional)
:{{A|vo dialog bzlq001 hutao 01.ogg}} '''Hu Tao:''' Oh, while you're here — have either of you seen Qiqi around?
:{{A|vo dialog bzlq001 hutao 02.ogg}} '''Hu Tao:''' It's not every day I get to infiltrate Baizhu's lair. But alas, I didn't catch a single glimpse of her anywhere...
:{{A|vo dialog bzlq001 hutao 03.ogg}} '''Hu Tao:''' Aha! What if... Baizhu knew I'd be on the lookout for her, and hid her away in advance?
----
;(Wait until the next day)
:{{A|vo bzlq001 6 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' It's a new day! Let's go back to Bubu Pharmacy and check out how Jialiang is doing!

;(Approach Bubu Pharmacy)
:{{A|vo bzlq001 7 ayu 01.ogg}} '''Ayu:''' Dad!
:{{A|vo bzlq001 7 jialiang 01.ogg}} '''Jialiang:''' Huh... Ayu!
:{{A|vo bzlq001 7 ayu 02.ogg}} '''Ayu:''' Dad! You remember me!
:{{A|vo bzlq001 7 jialiang 02.ogg}} '''Jialiang:''' Yes, I remember now! Oh, Ayu, I'm so sorry, you must have been worried sick... Has your mom shown up yet? She's... been gone for a while, hasn't she?
:{{A|vo bzlq001 7 ayu 03.ogg}} '''Ayu:''' Don't worry, Dad! I got the Adventurers' Guild to help us look for her. And Dr. Baizhu's gonna help too! Right now, all you need to do is concentrate on getting better!
:{{A|vo bzlq001 7 jialiang 03.ogg}} '''Jialiang:''' Great, that's wonderful... I can't thank you enough, Dr. Baizhu.
:{{A|vo bzlq001 7 baizhu 01.ogg}} '''Baizhu:''' My pleasure, really. It's the least I can do to honor my late master's dying wish. If anything, I should be apologizing to you for not making the time to visit in all these years.
:{{A|vo bzlq001 7 jialiang 04.ogg}} '''Jialiang:''' Hah, not at all, Dr. Baizhu. It's only because Jiangli... hmm... What was her reason again...
:{{A|vo bzlq001 7 baizhu 02.ogg}} '''Baizhu:''' ...You're still in the early stages of recovery, so you'll need to take it easy for a while. Take it slowly, and try not to over-exert yourself.
:{{A|vo bzlq001 7 changsheng 01.ogg}} '''Changsheng:''' I suggest you stay at Bubu Pharmacy and rest for at least the next few days.
:{{A|vo bzlq001 7 baizhu 03.ogg}} '''Baizhu:''' Director Hu, do you have any further reservations about Jialiang's condition?
:{{A|vo bzlq001 7 hutao 01.ogg}} '''Hu Tao:''' ...Hmm, it seems like the evil presence is gone after all. You really did manage to suppress it, huh...
:{{A|vo bzlq001 7 hutao 02.ogg}} '''Hu Tao:''' ...But how did you accomplish this in a single night?
:{{A|vo bzlq001 7 baizhu 04.ogg}} '''Baizhu:''' Hahaha, that would be a trade secret, I'm afraid. If that gives you any cause for concern, you may continue to monitor Jialiang for as long as you wish.
:{{A|vo bzlq001 7 baizhu 05.ogg}} '''Baizhu:''' Though I regret to say that Bubu Pharmacy cannot offer to reimburse Wangsheng Funeral Parlor for any revenue lost in the meantime.
:{{A|vo bzlq001 7 hutao 03.ogg}} '''Hu Tao:''' ...Oh, come on, Baizhu. I'm not THAT unreasonable.
:{{A|vo bzlq001 7 baizhu 06.ogg}} '''Baizhu:''' ...
:{{DIcon}} (Baizhu looks a little worse for wear...)
::{{DIcon}} (Something's wrong.)
:{{A|vo bzlq001 7 changsheng 02.ogg}} '''Changsheng:''' Ahhhhh — I've been stuck indoors for too long. Baizhu, take me outside for some air, or I'm going to suffocate!
:{{A|vo bzlq001 7 baizhu 07.ogg}} '''Baizhu:''' Ah yes, of course... Everyone, please excuse Changsheng and myself for a moment.
:;(Baizhu leaves Bubu Pharmacy)
:{{A|vo bzlq001 7 baizhu 08.ogg}} '''Baizhu:''' ... *cough* *cough*
:{{A|vo bzlq001 7 changsheng 03.ogg}} '''Changsheng:''' Suffering now, are we? Did you seriously expect to cover it up just by putting on a brave face and ignoring it? If it weren't for my quick thinking, they'd all have seen the sorry state you're in by now.
:{{A|vo bzlq001 7 changsheng 04.ogg}} '''Changsheng:''' But in any case, why must you keep this a secret from everybody? You should at least share your secret with one person you trust...
:{{A|vo bzlq001 7 baizhu 09.ogg}} '''Baizhu:''' Who's there?
:{{A|vo bzlq001 7 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Aaaah!!!!
:{{DIcon}} It's me.
:{{DIcon}} {{Traveler}}.
:{{A|vo bzlq001 7 baizhu 10.ogg}} '''Baizhu:''' ...Why did you follow us here?
:{{DIcon}} I thought you were looking a little unwell...
:{{A|vo bzlq001 7 baizhu 11.ogg}} '''Baizhu:''' Oh, hehe, it's nothing. I just needed to get some air... *cough*
:{{A|vo bzlq001 7 changsheng 05.ogg}} '''Changsheng:''' What did I JUST say about putting on a brave face? Tsk...
:{{A|vo bzlq001 7 changsheng 06.ogg}} '''Changsheng:''' {{Traveler}}, Paimon, the truth is... Baizhu did not cure Jialiang's illness.
:{{A|vo bzlq001 7 changsheng 07.ogg}} '''Changsheng:''' Instead, he transferred some of his own life force to his patient to temporarily subdue the poison in his system.
:{{DIcon}} ...Life force?
:{{DIcon}} ...Poison?
:{{A|vo bzlq001 7 baizhu 12.ogg}} '''Baizhu:''' *sigh*
:{{A|vo bzlq001 7 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Baizhu... Can you please explain all of this?
:{{A|vo bzlq001 7 baizhu 13.ogg}} '''Baizhu:''' ...My predecessors in medicine forged a contract with Changsheng. Every successor to this contract is able to use Changsheng's secret art to treat patients.
:{{A|vo bzlq001 7 baizhu 14.ogg}} '''Baizhu:''' I believe the irregularities with Jialiang's heart meridian were likely caused by a poison concocted using god remains as a key ingredient.
:{{A|vo bzlq001 7 baizhu 15.ogg}} '''Baizhu:''' The poison has not been purged from Jialiang's system. Rather, I infused him with some of my own life force using Changsheng as the delivery medium. This will suppress the poison's effects for a limited time.
:{{A|vo bzlq001 7 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Changsheng... You can do that? Paimon always thought you were just Baizhu's strange choice of a necklace...
:{{A|vo bzlq001 7 changsheng 08.ogg}} '''Changsheng:''' Hey! I'll have you know that I commanded the respect of even the adepti back in Chenyu Vale. If anything, he is my mannequin!
:{{A|vo bzlq001 7 changsheng 09.ogg}} '''Changsheng:''' I was treating patients with Baizhu's master's master long before he ever set eyes on his first medical text!
:{{A|vo bzlq001 7 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Whoa... Guess you shouldn't judge a snake by its skin.
:{{A|vo bzlq001 7 baizhu 16.ogg}} '''Baizhu:''' Please, that's enough... *cough* *cough*
:{{DIcon}} You're looking even worse now than before...
:{{DIcon}} ...Are you sure you're okay?
:{{A|vo bzlq001 7 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wait a sec... Hu Tao was saying that the branch of medicine you studied uses some pretty dubious methods... So when you transfer your life force, does that mean you're actually damaging your own body?
:{{A|vo bzlq001 7 baizhu 17.ogg}} '''Baizhu:''' Hardly. Changsheng helps to keep my qi in balance, so there is no great harm done...
:{{A|vo bzlq001 7 changsheng 10.ogg}} '''Changsheng:''' ...Still, Baizhu's life force is not unlimited. We must find a way to neutralize the poison in Jialiang's body, and soon.
:{{A|vo bzlq001 7 changsheng 11.ogg}} '''Changsheng:''' {{Traveler}}, Paimon, would you lend this dummy a hand? He needs someone checking up on him, or he'll exhaust himself trying to accomplish everything on his own...
:{{A|vo bzlq001 7 baizhu 18.ogg}} '''Baizhu:''' ...
:{{DIcon}} Go on, Baizhu. Let us help you.
:{{A|vo bzlq001 7 changsheng 12.ogg}} '''Changsheng:''' ...Baizhu, don't you think you should seize this opportunity? You cannot expect to hide this from everyone for your entire life. Time will see that all secrets surface eventually.
:{{A|vo bzlq001 7 baizhu 19.ogg}} '''Baizhu:''' *sigh*... "Entire life"...
:{{A|vo bzlq001 7 baizhu 20.ogg}} '''Baizhu:''' ...Thank you, {{Traveler}} and Paimon.
:{{A|vo bzlq001 7 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh, Paimon doesn't think we've seen this side of you. But there's no need to thank us! You've helped us out before.
:{{DIcon}} So. What are the next steps?
:{{A|vo bzlq001 7 baizhu 21.ogg}} '''Baizhu:''' The poison in Jialiang's system must have accumulated over a prolonged period. I think I should pay a visit to their family home, and look for clues as to how he might have been exposed to it.
:{{DIcon}} Do you know where his house is?
:{{A|vo bzlq001 7 baizhu 22.ogg}} '''Baizhu:''' Yes. I asked Ayu this morning before you arrived. He told me that his family lives in a secluded spot to the west of Qingce Village.
:{{A|vo bzlq001 7 baizhu 23.ogg}} '''Baizhu:''' Let's head there together once I've asked Gui and Qiqi to look after the pharmacy.
:{{A|vo bzlq001 7 baizhu 24.ogg}} '''Baizhu:''' ...As well as investigating Jialiang's exposure to the poison, we should also keep an eye out for Ayu's missing mother... my fellow disciple, Jiangli.

;(Talk to Qiqi outside Bubu Pharmacy, optional)
:{{A|vo dialog bzlq002 qiqi 01.ogg}} '''Qiqi:''' Phew... she's finally gone. She's gone for good now, right? ...Right?

;(Talk to Herbalist Gui inside Bubu Pharmacy, optional)
:{{A|vo dialog bzlq002 herbalistgui 01.ogg}} '''Herbalist Gui:''' Are you heading out now, Dr. Baizhu?
:{{A|vo dialog bzlq002 baizhu 01.ogg}} '''Baizhu:''' Yes. While I'm gone, I leave Bubu Pharmacy in your and Qiqi's capable hands.
:{{A|vo dialog bzlq002 herbalistgui 02.ogg}} '''Herbalist Gui:''' Rest assured, the moment anything comes up that you should know about, I'll inform you immediately.

;(Talk to Jialiang or Ayu by the steps leading to Bubu Pharmacy, optional)
:{{A|vo dialog bzlq002 jialiang 01.ogg}} '''Jialiang:''' *sigh* Your mother's been missing for days now, but here I am, sitting here and doing nothing...
:{{A|vo dialog bzlq002 ayu 01.ogg}} '''Ayu:''' Don't think about that, Dad! Just concentrate on getting better. ...It's been years since we were last able to talk to each other like this.
:{{A|vo dialog bzlq002 jialiang 02.ogg}} '''Jialiang:''' So it has... In the blink of an eye, you're already so grown up...

;(Talk to Hu Tao by the southwest corner of the platform outside Bubu Pharmacy, optional)
:{{A|vo dialog bzlq002 hutao 01.ogg}} '''Hu Tao:''' Huh... Fancy running into you guys at a place like this. What are the chances!
:{{DIcon}} What are you doing here?

Mm... mm, yep, i—it's working... "Stealthy as a snake, she can hear them coming, plants a little bait, and they all come running"...
:{{DIcon}} Won't your continued absence affect Wangsheng Funeral Parlor's business?
::{{A|vo dialog bzlq002 hutao 03a 1.ogg}} '''Hu Tao:''' It's fine, I have someone taking care of the books while I'm gone... Hold up, now that you mention it, I probably shouldn't stick around here too long...
:{{DIcon}} Still worried about what Baizhu's up to?
::{{A|vo dialog bzlq002 hutao 03b 1.ogg}} '''Hu Tao:''' ...You'd better not snitch on me, okay?
{{Dialogue End}}

'''''The Second Chilibrew Ingredient''''' is the second quest of the [[The Church's Affairs]] branch of {{Quest|Wellspring of Healing}}.

==Steps==
# Look for High-quality Sweet Flowers
# Defeat all opponents
# Talk to Barbara

==Dialogue==
{{Quest Description|To make some Chilibrew, you prepare to go with [[Barbara]] to the [[Whispering Woods]] to look for some [[Sweet Flower]]s.}}
===The Second Chilibrew Ingredient===
{{Dialogue Start}}

:{{A|vo bblcop001 1900601 uwe 13.ogg}} '''Uwe:''' Sister Deaconess, you believe me right? Heal me, I beg of you...

::{{A|vo bblcop001 1900601 uwe 15.ogg}} '''Uwe:''' Hmph... fine. Heartless adventurer...
::{{A|vo bblcop001 1900601 uwe 16.ogg}} '''Uwe:''' I'll stay hidden, Sister Deaconess, but please be back soon, I beg of you!
::{{A|vo bblcop001 1900601 barbara 17.ogg}} '''Barbara:''' We'll be back soon, don't worry.
:;(Continue to [[Healing Is My Job]])

::{{A|vo bblcop001 1900601 uwe 17.ogg}} '''Uwe:''' Wait a minute... Y'know, I'm suddenly feeling a lot better. Where was I...

::{{A|vo bblcop001 1900601 uwe 21.ogg}} '''Uwe:''' You think I'm afraid of you? If you wanna catch me, you better be up to the task!
:;(Continue to [[Ulterior Motive...?]])

'''''The Second Experiment: The World''''' is the fourth part of {{Quest|Traveler Observation Report}}.

==Steps==
# Observe the installations in the camp
# Talk to the returning Albedo
# Cook some [[Sunshine Sprat]] and give it to Albedo
# Use [[Elemental Sight]] to look for the lost items
# Talk to Albedo and hear his conclusions

==Gameplay Notes==
* Suspicious quality Sunshine Sprat cannot be submitted in Step 3.

==Dialogue==
{{Quest Description|After the experiment begins. Albedo first checks your elemental flow. The result is that both your internal and external elemental flow runs smoothly and that there is nothing unusual about them. These results seem very normal indeed, but according to Albedo, this is something to be happy about.}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Observe the installations in the camp)

;(Observe the installations in the camp)
:'''Observe Table:''' (Looks like an alchemy work table. Some potions and other apparatus are laid out here. Are these what Albedo uses to investigate the world?)
:'''Observe Table:''' (It wouldn't hurt to touch it... would it?)
;(Observe the installations in the camp)
:'''Observe Record Board:''' (A board with some incomprehensible experimental reports stuck onto it.)

:{{A|vo abdlq004 1 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Here comes Albedo, let's go see him.

;(Talk to [[Timaeus]], optional)
:{{A|vo dialog abdlq003 timaeus 02.ogg}} '''Timaeus:''' An elemental life form from another world! As soon as we have strong evidence, this may end up subverting a lot of alchemical theories.
:{{A|vo dialog abdlq003 timaeus 03.ogg}} '''Timaeus:''' Albedo's research will see huge progress!
----
;(Talk to the returning Albedo)
:{{A|vo abdlq004 1 albedo 01.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' I'm back. Did you see anything interesting?
:{{DIcon}} Couldn't make heads or tails of anything.
::{{A|vo abdlq004 1 albedo 02a.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Not to worry, they're all for alchemical purposes, you'd be hard pressed to find an everyday use for them.
:{{DIcon}} Your things aren't very organized.
::{{A|vo abdlq004 1 albedo 02b.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Hmm, agreed. I'd love to find a moment to put them all in order. Still, experiments come first...
:{{A|vo abdlq004 1 albedo 03.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Well, on with the research.
:{{A|vo abdlq004 1 albedo 04.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' There may be significant differences between different worlds.
:{{A|vo abdlq004 1 albedo 05.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Take [[Teyvat]], for example. Here, those with [[Vision]]s can manipulate the [[element]]s.
:{{A|vo abdlq004 1 albedo 06.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' But worlds may well exist where only one person is able to do so, or even everyone.
:{{A|vo abdlq004 1 albedo 07.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' So, leaving elements to one side... Do you possess any... unique abilities, {{Traveler}}? Ones that don't exist in this world?
:{{A|vo abdlq004 1 albedo 08.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' I think answering this question calls for the same methodology as last time. In other words, time for the next experiment.
:{{DIcon}} Am I battling [[slime]]s again?
:{{DIcon}} I drank my fill, thanks...
:{{A|vo abdlq004 1 albedo 09.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' No, no! You shan't be required to exert quite so much effort this time around.
:{{A|vo abdlq004 1 albedo 10.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Now, see this pillar here. Use your willpower to try and break it.
:{{DIcon}} Sorry, I just can't do it.
::{{A|vo abdlq004 1 albedo 11a.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' That was your best effort? Hmm... Well, can't be helped, I suppose.
::{{A|vo abdlq004 1 paimon 02a.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What's with the disappointment!? Isn't that, like, impossible?
:{{DIcon}} Paimon, you give it a shot.
::{{A|vo abdlq004 1 paimon 02b.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You think Paimon knows how to do that stuff?
::{{A|vo abdlq004 1 albedo 11b.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' That was your best effort? Hmm... Well, can't be helped, I suppose.
:{{A|vo abdlq004 1 albedo 12.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Ah! Have you tried using your elemental power with food? I don't mean for cooking as such — rather, channeling your power into the ingredients themselves.
:{{A|vo abdlq004 1 albedo 13.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' I'm curious to see how the taste and texture respond. It may even help with... proliferation...
:{{DIcon}} Alchemists certainly have active imaginations.
:{{DIcon}} Sure you're not just peckish?
:{{A|vo abdlq004 1 albedo 14.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Haha, I suppose I have a curiosity for things that others find surprising.
:{{A|vo abdlq004 1 albedo 15.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Anyway, why don't you cook us up a Sunshine Sprat? I've just finished preparing the recipe.
:{{A|vo abdlq004 1 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Cooking? Paimon was looking forward to more mad scientist stuff!
:{{A|vo abdlq004 1 albedo 16.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Not only is this recipe a staple for me, it's also worth experimenting with and highly nutritious!
:{{A|vo abdlq004 1 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hmph, Paimon bets you're just hungry!
:{{A|vo abdlq004 1 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' It does sound yummy though... Okay, Paimon approves!
:{{DIcon}} I know what you're getting at.
:{{DIcon}} I'll save you a fin or two.
:{{A|vo abdlq004 1 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Mm-hmm, good buddies are always on the same page!
:{{A|vo abdlq004 1 albedo 17.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' I'll leave you to it, then. Looking forward to the results.
:{{A|vo abdlq004 1 albedo 18.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' If there's anything left over, maybe Timaeus can finish the last morsels.
:{{A|vo abdlq004 1 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Uhh... Paimon doesn't think we'll have that problem.
:{{A|vo abdlq004 1 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' How are we gonna channel elemental power into the food? Maybe try the willpower thing again?
:{{A|vo abdlq004 1 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Where does he get these ideas from anyway?
:{{A|vo abdlq004 1 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ah, let's just do it the old-fashioned way.
----
;(Cook some Sunshine Sprat and talk to Albedo)
:{{A|vo abdlq004 2 albedo 01.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' That was fast! Looking forward to tasting — I mean, testing — the results...
:;(Give Albedo the Sunshine Sprat)
;(If normal Sunshine Sprat)
::{{A|vo abdlq004 2 albedo 02a.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Hmm, an average outcome for a fine dish.
;(If Delicious Sunshine Sprat)
::{{A|vo abdlq004 2 albedo 02b.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Mm! An average outcome experimentally, but you've really brought out the flavor. You seem well-versed in the science of gastronomy.
:{{A|vo abdlq004 2 albedo 03.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' As far as the proliferation hypothesis is concerned, we've come up short. Seems like food presents the same headaches in your world as it does ours.
:{{A|vo abdlq004 2 albedo 04.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Unless... Could it be that the natural laws of this world are limiting your unique abilities?
:{{A|vo abdlq004 2 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' We just didn't know how to channel elemental power into the food. It's a little more complicated than adding herbs and spices, y'know!
:{{A|vo abdlq004 2 albedo 05.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Not to worry, at least we put some food to good use, no need to feel disheartened.
:{{A|vo abdlq004 2 albedo 06.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' And here's your portion, enjoy! I can box it up if you like.
:{{A|vo abdlq004 2 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Woohoo, thanks! Glad you were paying attention.
:{{DIcon}} You're Paimon's new favorite.
:{{DIcon}} Not often that Paimon gets this much attention.
:{{A|vo abdlq004 2 albedo 07.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' I can tell that you're good friends. Paimon was keeping an eye on you and your safety during the whole experiment.
:{{A|vo abdlq004 2 albedo 08.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Not that Paimon would have been able to do much if things had gone wrong, but anyway...
:{{A|vo abdlq004 2 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hey! You were being nice a second ago!
:{{A|vo abdlq004 2 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' But you do have tasty recipes, so Paimon forgives you.
:{{A|vo abdlq004 2 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' And you're right, we are good friends. You have good friends too, right? Good students?
:{{A|vo abdlq004 2 albedo 09.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' ...Uh, yes! I'm fortunate too, I suppose. Anyway, moving on to the next experiment.
:{{A|vo abdlq004 2 albedo 10.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' There are all manner of alchemical items here, keeping them in their proper place is a challenge at the best of times. A while ago, I had the misfortune of misplacing a batch.
:{{A|vo abdlq004 2 albedo 11.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' I managed to retrieve the majority, but two vials have been evading me: [[Anemo Crystalfly]] elemental extract and [[Electro Hypostasis]] powder.
:{{A|vo abdlq004 2 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Paimon's barely finished eating and you want us to go gathering again?
:{{A|vo abdlq004 2 albedo 12.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Don't worry if you can't locate them. I was planning to replace them anyway, though finding them would save me the hassle.
:{{A|vo abdlq004 2 albedo 13.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' If you had, say, a "superpower," like night vision, or vibratory sensing, lost property would be a thing of the past.
:{{A|vo abdlq004 2 albedo 14.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' I must have dropped them somewhere in the area where you were looking just now.
:{{A|vo abdlq004 2 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So... guess we'd better take a look?
:{{DIcon}} There should be some elemental traces on the lost items.
:{{A|vo abdlq004 2 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh yeah! You could use Elemental Sight!

;(Talk to Albedo again, optional)
:{{A|vo dialog abdlq004 albedo 01.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Hmm, an interesting term... Compelling.
:{{A|vo dialog abdlq004 albedo 02.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' See what you can find, I'll be over here.
----
;(Upon finding the Anemo Crystalfly extract)
:{{A|vo abdlq004 3 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' The extract of an Anemo Crystalfly can only be [[Anemo]] elemental energy, right? This has gotta be it.
:{{A|vo abdlq004 3 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Still in one piece! Good thing the vial's so strong.

;(Upon finding the Electro Hypostasis powder)
:{{A|vo abdlq004 3 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' This must be Electro Hypostasis powder!

;(Talk to Albedo and hear his conclusions)
:{{A|vo abdlq004 4 albedo 01.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Goodness, you managed to find them? Incredible, a thousand thanks.
:{{A|vo abdlq004 4 albedo 02.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' I'm wondering, this Elemental Sight... This is what allowed you to locate the items, and find me here in the mountains, correct?
:{{A|vo abdlq004 4 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yup! Guess it does sorta count as a superpower, huh...
:{{A|vo abdlq004 4 albedo 03.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Unfortunately, though Elemental Sight is seldom seen, it is not unheard of in Teyvat.
:{{A|vo abdlq004 4 albedo 04.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Only a never-before-seen, otherworldly power would be of benefit to my research.
:{{A|vo abdlq004 4 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You mean... We failed again...?
:{{A|vo abdlq004 4 albedo 05.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Don't be disheartened, this falls entirely within my expectations. Besides, getting these items back? I'd call this a very worthwhile experiment.
:{{A|vo abdlq004 4 albedo 06.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' I have to commend your deduction that the items would contain elemental traces.
:{{A|vo abdlq004 4 albedo 07.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Right then. Up until now, our research has focused on your otherworldly identity. Our research on your identity as one of us is just beginning.
:{{DIcon}} With you to the end.
:{{DIcon}} ...How do I get off this train?
:{{A|vo abdlq004 4 albedo 08.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' In essence, the differences between humans are reflected in our intellectual and physical capabilities. Let's start with physical.
:{{A|vo abdlq004 4 albedo 09.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Looking out from where we're standing, can you see what [[Sucrose]] is doing?
:{{DIcon}} Nope.
:{{A|vo abdlq004 4 albedo 10.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' And if you jumped from here and landed on that cliff — the one over there — could you see her then?
:{{DIcon}} Nope.
:{{A|vo abdlq004 4 albedo 11.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' So what about if you planted a single blow on the mountain face here and it burst into a million fragments? Then could you see her?
:{{DIcon}} Nope.
:{{DIcon}} Sounds like we're still on the superpower test.
:{{A|vo abdlq004 4 albedo 12.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Hmm, then I shouldn't get too excited. Still, we'll gain a more thorough understanding with an experiment.
:{{A|vo abdlq004 4 albedo 13.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' I know of a location that will be perfect for a physical test. Please, follow me.
{{Dialogue End}}

'''''The Seeker of a Meteor Shower''''' is the first part of {{Quest|Star-Pickers' Passage}}.

==Steps==
# Go to [[Naganohara Fireworks]]
# Head to the dock in [[Ritou]]
# Walk around in [[Port Ormos]]
# Go to [[Sumeru City]]
# Go to the [[Sumeru Akademiya|Akademiya]]
# Return to [[Treasures Street]] and look for [[Yoimiya]]

==Dialogue==
{{Quest Description|Back in Inazuma, Yoimiya is preparing for a romantic journey...}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Approach Naganohara Fireworks)
:{{A|vo xglq201 1 naganohararyuunosuke 01.ogg}} '''Naganohara Ryuunosuke:''' Have you packed all your things? Make sure you've brought the onigiri and rice cakes your mother prepared.
:{{A|vo xglq201 1 yoimiya 01.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' Don't worry, I have them all! They're going to last me days!
:{{A|vo xglq201 1 yoimiya 02.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' Take care of yourselves while I'm out, and make sure you remind Mom to take her medicine on time.
:{{A|vo xglq201 1 yoimiya 03.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' If running the store gets a bit too much, take some time off and wait for me to return.
:{{A|vo xglq201 1 naganohararyuunosuke 02.ogg}} '''Naganohara Ryuunosuke:''' Oh, Yoimiya, your mother and I got so worried when we heard that you were going so far abroad.
:{{A|vo xglq201 1 naganohararyuunosuke 03.ogg}} '''Naganohara Ryuunosuke:''' We've never left the country, so we don't know how outlanders might view us Inazumans, or if they'd even be willing to speak to us...
:{{A|vo xglq201 1 yoimiya 04.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' Oh, relax! Outlanders are friendly and warm!
:{{A|vo xglq201 1 yoimiya 05.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' Look at Thoma from the Yashiro Commission. He's originally from Mondstadt, but everyone thinks he's a top-tier guy!
:{{A|vo xglq201 1 naganohararyuunosuke 04.ogg}} '''Naganohara Ryuunosuke:''' A mop-tier? What mop? Oh, do you mean the broken one at home? I just fixed it today, actually.
:{{A|vo xglq201 1 yoimiya 06.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' No, I said "top," not "mop"! You know, Thoma even sent us some wine from his homeland not too long ago.
:{{A|vo xglq201 1 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' We haven't heard this kind of friendly banter in a while, huh?
:{{A|vo xglq201 1 yoimiya 07.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' Oh, hey you two! It's been a long time, hasn't it?
:{{DIcon}} You're as peppy as ever.
:{{A|vo xglq201 1 yoimiya 08.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' Hehe, I'm excited because I'm going on a trip soon!
:{{A|vo xglq201 1 yoimiya 09.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' Many things have changed. Lots of outlanders have come to Inazuma, and lots of Inazumans have gone out as well.
:{{A|vo xglq201 1 yoimiya 10.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' You two have been adventuring all over Teyvat, so you might not be able to understand, but for us, this is a long-awaited chance to go out and fulfill our dreams!
:{{A|vo xglq201 1 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' That's right, the [[Sakoku Decree]] is gone.
:{{A|vo xglq201 1 naganohararyuunosuke 05.ogg}} '''Naganohara Ryuunosuke:''' Ah, I remember you two. You're Yoimiya's friends, yes?
:{{A|vo xglq201 1 naganohararyuunosuke 06.ogg}} '''Naganohara Ryuunosuke:''' Word of your incredible accomplishments has spread throughout Inazuma. My daughter's a big fan of yours — she said she'd love to be like you two.
:{{A|vo xglq201 1 yoimiya 11.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' Hehe, c'mon, Dad... Who's never dreamed of becoming a hero?
:{{DIcon}} You've done some heroic feats yourself.
:{{A|vo xglq201 1 yoimiya 12.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' Aw, thanks, but I'm just your average artisan. The quiet life suits me better.
:{{A|vo xglq201 1 yoimiya 13.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' But if an opportunity presents itself, why not try to show your stuff, right?
:{{A|vo xglq201 1 naganohararyuunosuke 07.ogg}} '''Naganohara Ryuunosuke:''' Alright, did you two come over today to order some fireworks?
:{{A|vo xglq201 1 yoimiya 14.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' Oh! Sorry, sorry, I got carried away.
:{{A|vo xglq201 1 yoimiya 15.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' While I'm gone, Dad's in charge of making fireworks. You've seen how skilled he is, so there's nothing to worry about.
:{{A|vo xglq201 1 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, no, we aren't here to do business or anything. We just happened to be passing by!
:{{A|vo xglq201 1 yoimiya 16.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' Oh, so we're all here with time to spare. What a treat!
:{{A|vo xglq201 1 yoimiya 17.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' In that case, let's chat some more! I'm not in a rush, anyway.
:{{A|vo xglq201 1 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Sure! So, where are you planning to go?
:{{A|vo xglq201 1 yoimiya 18.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' No clue!
:{{A|vo xglq201 1 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh?
:{{A|vo xglq201 1 yoimiya 19.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' Hahaha! I say that, but I do have a travel goal: to see Teyvat's grandest meteor shower.
:{{A|vo xglq201 1 yoimiya 20.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' But I don't know when or where it'll happen, so I figured I can search while I travel.
:{{A|vo xglq201 1 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' ...That's it? No details? Nothing?
:{{A|vo xglq201 1 yoimiya 21.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' Not right now, since this meteor shower was originally something like a family legend.
:{{A|vo xglq201 1 yoimiya 22.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' A long time ago, the Naganoharas were inspired to create new fireworks after watching such a meteor shower.
:{{A|vo xglq201 1 yoimiya 23.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' Dad says that inspiration is a combination of what you see and what you know. Different people can see the same thing but have different thoughts.
:{{A|vo xglq201 1 yoimiya 24.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' Inazuma today is completely different from how it was in the past. If I can see this meteor shower, I'm sure I'll be able to come up with a new kind of firework.
:{{DIcon}} Meteors and fireworks...
:{{DIcon}} They do have some similarities.
:{{A|vo xglq201 1 yoimiya 25.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' I know, right? Of course, my main reason is that I want to go and look outside Inazuma, hehe.
:{{A|vo xglq201 1 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' No need to be shy about it! You gotta play hard when you get the chance!
:{{A|vo xglq201 1 yoimiya 26.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' You know, you're right, Paimon! Is it just me, or have you gotten wiser since we first met?
:{{A|vo xglq201 1 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hehe, Paimon loves being friends with you since you say such nice things!
:{{DIcon}} Since you're going out to play regardless...
:{{DIcon}} Why not make Sumeru your first stop?
:{{A|vo xglq201 1 yoimiya 27.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' Sumeru... I've heard of it. It has a ton of trees, a super impressive school, and a massive desert!
:{{DIcon}} There's also a division of the school that specializes in studying the stars.
:{{A|vo xglq201 1 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yep, and everyone there is really smart, so Paimon's sure you'll get some answers from them about the meteor shower!
:{{A|vo xglq201 1 yoimiya 28.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' Really? But, won't research people make fun of me or something if I ask them about a legend?
:{{A|vo xglq201 1 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' We won't know if something's real or not unless we ask! Don't worry, we've got solid connections in there!
:{{A|vo xglq201 1 paimon 11a.ogg}} {{A|vo xglq201 1 paimon 11b.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Well, {{MC|m=he|f=she}} does, anyway...
:{{A|vo xglq201 1 yoimiya 29.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' Wouldn't I be taking up your time, though? I doubt this was in your schedule...
:{{DIcon}} It's fine. This way, your parents can be at ease.
:{{DIcon}} I'll be your guide.

:{{A|vo xglq201 1 yoimiya 30.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' Haha, alright! Then I accept your offer! Let's have some fun in Sumeru!
:{{A|vo xglq201 1 yoimiya 31a.ogg}} <!--{{A|vo xglq201 1 yoimiya 31b.ogg}}-->'''Yoimiya:''' Dad, you can have more peace of mind now that I'm traveling with them, right?
:{{A|vo xglq201 1 naganohararyuunosuke 08.ogg}} '''Naganohara Ryuunosuke:''' Hm? Ah, yes, your mother and I will be much more at ease.

:{{A|vo xglq201 7 yoimiya 17.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' Whenever we passed by busy crowds, she kept turning her head and taking in all the things around her. At first, I thought she was afraid that someone might bump into us...
:{{A|vo xglq201 7 yoimiya 18.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' But when I caught a glimpse in her eyes, I only saw yearning, and a deep sense of loss.
:{{A|vo xglq201 7 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' It's hard to not be down when something like that happens to you.
:{{A|vo xglq201 7 yoimiya 19.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' At first, she didn't really want to say anything to me at all — she just gave me yes and no answers.
:{{A|vo xglq201 7 yoimiya 20.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' But what I really saw was just another child, and asked all the same things everyone else did, about rugs, spices, cooking, and the differences between here and home.
:{{A|vo xglq201 7 yoimiya 21.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' Eventually, I think I earned her trust. Hehe, there were many things that she liked in the city after all.
:{{A|vo xglq201 7 yoimiya 22.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' I say that, but honestly, you two probably caught the majority of what she said.
:{{DIcon}} She had already relaxed her guard around you.
:{{A|vo xglq201 7 yoimiya 23.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' Gotta start somewhere. Oh, by the way, did you guys learn anything about the meteor shower?
:{{A|vo xglq201 7 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You bet we did, big time! You're in luck, Yoimiya — you'll be able to see the meteor shower from Sumeru!
:{{A|vo xglq201 7 yoimiya 24.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' Really!? Haha, that's great! If I had gone looking for it myself, I'm sure I would've missed it.
:{{DIcon}} Well, not necessarily.
:{{A|vo xglq201 7 yoimiya 25.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' Huh? What do you mean?
:{{DIcon}} Meteor showers appear in response to people's wishes.
:{{A|vo xglq201 7 yoimiya 26.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' They respond to wishes? Huh. I've never heard that one before...
:{{A|vo xglq201 7 yoimiya 27.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' So it's not that you wish upon shooting stars, but that wishes summon them?
:{{A|vo xglq201 7 yoimiya 28.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' Hehe, in that case, I was born ready! Don't you worry!
:{{A|vo xglq201 7 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Are you talking about how you want to use the meteor shower as inspiration for fireworks?
:{{A|vo xglq201 7 yoimiya 29.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' That's why I'm here, but I wouldn't call that my wish. I don't think that alone will call the stars down for us, right?
:{{A|vo xglq201 7 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Uh, yeah, that makes sense.
:{{A|vo xglq201 7 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' (Wow, she's adding her own spin onto this...)
:{{A|vo xglq201 7 yoimiya 30.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' If that's the case, then we'll have to "practice" wishing a little.
:{{A|vo xglq201 7 yoimiya 31.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' Can you two come with me? Let me put my thoughts together, and tell me if you understand.
:{{A|vo xglq201 7 yoimiya 32.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' As for what my wish is... Hehe, it's a secret for now.
:{{DIcon}} How about a change of scenery?
:{{DIcon}} Let's go someplace that better fits the mood.
:{{A|vo xglq201 7 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yeah, and we'll take the opportunity to show you some views you've definitely never seen before!
:{{A|vo xglq201 7 yoimiya 33.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' More places to see? Alright, let's go!
{{Dialogue End}}

:{{A|vo eqxs104 11 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' It wanted to replace you and infiltrate our group?

:{{A|vo eqxs104 11 albedo 19.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' It was watching us the whole time, and when it saw that I had disappeared, its instinct was to take my place. At that point, its disguise was complete and its next move was to hunt its prey.

:{{A|vo eqxs104 13 albedo 08.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Have you ever seen an intricate glass ornament and wondered how it was made? Well, one method for crafting with glass is a technique known as "glassblowing."

:{{A|vo eqxs104 13 albedo 11.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' This type of glassware is known for having a "pontil mark" at the point where the blowpipe was inserted, where the hole was sealed at the very end. This mark is a sign that the item was crafted by a human hand.

When the hole where the life force was infused is sealed at the end, it leaves a mark not dissimilar to the pontil mark in blown glass wares.

==Steps==
# Wait until the appointed time (08:00 – 12:00 the next day)
# Meet With [[Keqing]]
# Go to the place that Keqing spoke of
# Defeat the [[Treasure Hoarders]]
#* Keqing joins you for this battle

# Return to [[Qingce Village]]
# Follow the voice to its source
# Head to [[Third-Round Knockout]]
# Go to the [[Ministry of Civil Affairs]] and find Keqing

;(Day 1 - Talk to Zhongli at [[Third-Round Knockout]])
:{{A|vo eqhdj talk 13 zhongli 01.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' We meet again, Traveler.
:{{A|vo eqhdj talk 13 zhongli 02.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' What a rare opportunity to meet with you here in Liyue during this finest of festivals, as busy as you are on your travels.
:{{DIcon}} Happy Lantern Rite! How are you celebrating?
:{{A|vo eqhdj talk 13 zhongli 03.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' As you can see, I'm ambling the streets at my leisure, enjoying the sound of people chattering and birds chirping.
:{{A|vo eqhdj talk 13 zhongli 04.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Wangsheng Funeral Parlor has been somewhat idle as of late, so I am presently unoccupied.
:{{A|vo eqhdj talk 13 zhongli 05.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' When the director is out visiting friends, I take the opportunities to head out myself. Habit dictates that my first port of call is here, where I order myself a pot of tea, and listen to the storyteller.
:{{A|vo eqhdj talk 13 zhongli 06.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' As festival times, the storyteller will always select a few new passages that complement the spirit of the season.
:{{A|vo eqhdj talk 13 zhongli 07.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Most are variations on existing legends or accounts from folk history. Their historicity is questionable at times, but it is their entertainment value that makes them an excellent choice for the festive period.
:{{DIcon}} I know exactly what you mean.
:{{A|vo eqhdj talk 13 zhongli 08.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Hahaha, then it seems you are becoming rather familiar with the [[Iron Tongue Tian|storyteller]] at this establishment.
:{{A|vo eqhdj talk 13 zhongli 09.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Time marches forward relentlessly... People change, traditions change...
:{{A|vo eqhdj talk 13 zhongli 10.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Lantern Rite is no exception.
:{{A|vo eqhdj talk 13 zhongli 11.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' In times of old, Liyue was constantly at war. People lit lanterns and sent them into the sky to help guide the warriors on the distant front back to their home.
:{{A|vo eqhdj talk 13 zhongli 12.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Today, we live in a time of peace, and the custom of releasing lanterns has become ceremonial in nature. For the people of Liyue, the ritual of lighting lanterns every year symbolizes the undying spirit of heroism.
:{{A|vo eqhdj talk 13 zhongli 13.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' The things that refuse to be shaken by the passage of time... those are Liyue's roots.
:{{A|vo eqhdj talk 13 zhongli 14.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Traveler, I hope that you are able to celebrate the Lantern Rite together with the people of Liyue.
:{{DIcon}} What about you? Do you have any plans?
:{{A|vo eqhdj talk 13 zhongli 15.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Plans... not a notion that can be easily applied to me anymore. I am a man of leisure. I simply go wherever I am inclined, wherever that may be.
:{{A|vo eqhdj talk 13 zhongli 16.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Although, now that you mention... Yes, I should make the most of this festive period by venturing to parts of Liyue that lie beyond the harbor.
:{{A|vo eqhdj talk 13 zhongli 17.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' I began with tea at Third-Round Knockout today... perhaps tomorrow I shall try somewhere else in the near vicinity.
:{{A|vo eqhdj talk 13 zhongli 18.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' It is quite a joy to be idle and explore this bustling city at my leisure.
{{Dialogue End}}
