NPC 2.4 Event Location Zhongli 1 Context.png|Additional Context
</gallery>
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Day 2 - Talk to Zhongli on the street in front of [[Hanfeng's Ironmongers]])
:{{A|vo eqhdj talk 14 zhongli 01.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Oh? You're here.
:{{A|vo eqhdj talk 14 zhongli 02.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' I do apologize, another matter was occupying my mind just now.
:{{DIcon}} What are you looking at?
:{{A|vo eqhdj talk 14 zhongli 03.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Hanfeng's Ironmongers has a long history. Ownership has been passed down from generation to generation, and today it is known as the most reputable blacksmith in the land.
:{{A|vo eqhdj talk 14 zhongli 04.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' The art of forging prizes precision and diligence. The tasks of forging weapons and processing ore require a great deal of time and patience.
:{{A|vo eqhdj talk 14 zhongli 05.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' To most, the sound of iron being struck with a hammer is loud and intrusive. But to those who appreciate this art form, it is like the toll of a bell. Breathtaking, and transfixing.
:{{A|vo eqhdj talk 14 zhongli 06.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' The sound of metal clashing with metal causes one to fall quiet, calms one's spirit, focuses one's attention, and then, with a mind emptied of unwanted thoughts, devote oneself fully to the work at hand.
:{{DIcon}} It sounds like you are talented in forging, too.
:{{A|vo eqhdj talk 14 zhongli 07.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Any talent I possess comes not from natural inclination, but out of necessity. In times of war, weapons are indispensable equipment, and highly sought after.
:{{A|vo eqhdj talk 14 zhongli 08.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' The wondrous ley lines of Liyue produce all manner of exquisite ore. It follows naturally that distinguished artisans and prized wares arise in response.
:{{A|vo eqhdj talk 14 zhongli 09.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' But I have always thought that a craftsman's ingenuity is far more valuable than any precious stone. The most accomplished in their craft do not limit themselves to working exclusively with rare ores.
:{{DIcon}} Tell me more about famous Liyue craftspeople.
:{{A|vo eqhdj talk 14 zhongli 10.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Well, Traveler... After your long sojourn in Liyue, I trust you will have heard of the houses of Kun and Yun?
:{{A|vo eqhdj talk 14 zhongli 11.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' The [[Kun Family|house of Kun]] is a long-established name in the art of forging. To this day, their descendants continue their craft.
:{{A|vo eqhdj talk 14 zhongli 12.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' The [[Yun Family|house of Yun]] did not limit themselves to this craft. They branched out into many different disciplines and districts. Their descendants today still uphold the work ethic taught within their family for generations: "Even ostensible perfection can oft be improved upon through diligence." This has contributed towards their excellence in numerous fields.
:{{DIcon}} Wait... Is this the same "Yun" as in "Yun Jin"?
:{{A|vo eqhdj talk 14 zhongli 13.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Ah, so you are acquainted with Miss Yun. Yes, the talented Yun Jin of Liyue operatic fame is indeed a descendant of the historic house of Yun.
:{{A|vo eqhdj talk 14 zhongli 14.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Her ancestors changed professions long ago. It was her father's generation that dedicated themselves to the performing arts. In this day and age, the Yun family's history has been forgotten, and nobody knows of the connection they once had to the art of forging.
:{{A|vo eqhdj talk 14 zhongli 15.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' The evolution of families over the ages has been a profound force in shaping Liyue's history. While you're here, if you have the time, you may find learning about the human history of Liyue to be illuminating.
:{{DIcon}} It seems I still have a lot to learn.
:{{A|vo eqhdj talk 14 zhongli 16.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Much that you might want to know can be found in books.
:{{A|vo eqhdj talk 14 zhongli 17.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Even books change over the generations, causing discrepancies between their contents and the historical facts. But books can function as a mirror for humanity. Reading is the noblest of pastimes — there is always some benefit to be derived.
{{Dialogue End}}
<gallery>
NPC 2.4 Event Location Zhongli 2.png|Zhongli's Day 2 Location
NPC 2.4 Event Location Zhongli 2 Context.png|Additional Context
</gallery>
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Day 3 - Talk to Zhongli at [[Wanwen Bookhouse]])
:{{A|vo eqhdj talk 15 zhongli 01.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Ah, I wondered if I might run into you again. This makes the third day in a row... perhaps it is fate rather than coincidence.
:{{DIcon}} Are you doing some reading?
:{{A|vo eqhdj talk 15 zhongli 02.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Yes. After our conversation yesterday, I thought I might visit the bookhouse and see what constitutes popular literature these days.
:{{DIcon}} There's a lot of books in Liyue.
:{{A|vo eqhdj talk 15 zhongli 03.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Indeed. Traveler, do you know anything of the origins of books in Liyue?
:{{A|vo eqhdj talk 15 zhongli 04.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' First, people ground wood into pulp to make paper. For ease of reading, they began binding sheets together to make what we now call "books."
:{{A|vo eqhdj talk 15 zhongli 05.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Later, they developed movable-type printing to improve the speed and quality of production. Eventually, the technology developed to the point where books like those we see here can easily be produced in great quantities.
:{{A|vo eqhdj talk 15 zhongli 06.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' There has been a proliferation of literary genres and works since that time.
:{{A|vo eqhdj talk 15 zhongli 07.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Traveler, is there any book from Liyue that has made a particularly strong impression on you?
:{{DIcon}} There's a series called "[[Rex Incognito]]."
:{{A|vo eqhdj talk 15 zhongli 08.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Oh? So, you've read it too.
:{{A|vo eqhdj talk 15 zhongli 09.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' The author does not lack for ideas. Sometimes, they move in strange directions, and even I cannot claim to fully understand their meaning. But it makes for fresh and interesting reading material, a lot like reading somebody else's biography.
:{{A|vo eqhdj talk 15 zhongli 10.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Gods and adepti are far removed from the mortal experience. That they are difficult to portray in writing is no surprise.
:{{A|vo eqhdj talk 15 zhongli 11.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' It is true that the Geo Archon, [[Morax]] would journey in the mortal realm from time to time. But there was not quite so much ostentatious shapeshifting as the books would have you believe.
:{{A|vo eqhdj talk 15 zhongli 12.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' When the goal is to wander the streets undetected, donning an overly elaborate disguise is somewhat self-defeating.
:{{A|vo eqhdj talk 15 zhongli 13.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Such discrepancies illustrate the difference between history as it happened and folk accounts based on hearsay. The value of reading accounts penned by others is in the chance to view the world through their eyes. It is very often an unfamiliar sight, though never an uninteresting one.
:{{DIcon}} I've also read one called "[[Yakshas: The Guardian Adepti]]."
:{{A|vo eqhdj talk 15 zhongli 14.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Ah, yes. A memorable work indeed.
:{{A|vo eqhdj talk 15 zhongli 15.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' I have heard that this is an unpopular book due to its often impenetrable prose. And yet, the [[yaksha]]s described in it are real historical figures.
:{{A|vo eqhdj talk 15 zhongli 16.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' They were loyal servants of Liyue. They lived through a bitter war and sacrificed much. All of Liyue, from harbor to chasm, is indebted to the yakshas for their protection over the years.
:{{A|vo eqhdj talk 15 zhongli 17.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' I believe you have seen one of these yakshas in the flesh.
:{{DIcon}} Xiao.
:{{A|vo eqhdj talk 15 zhongli 18.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Yes... These days, he often appears at [[Dihua Marsh]].
:{{A|vo eqhdj talk 15 zhongli 19.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' He is given to solitude. But I suspect that he would not turn away a reliable companion such as yourself.
:{{A|vo eqhdj talk 15 zhongli 20.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Should you happen to see him, please pass on my season's greetings.
{{Dialogue End}}
<gallery>
NPC 2.4 Event Location Zhongli 3.png|Zhongli's Day 3 Location
NPC 2.4 Event Location Zhongli 3 Context.png|Additional Context
</gallery>
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Day 4 - Talk to Zhongli at the viewing deck of [[Wangshu Inn]])
:{{A|vo eqhdj talk 16 zhongli 01.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' "Where the clear blue water runs into the sky, and an ocean of silvergrass stretches out before the eye." That was written about Dihua Marsh.
:{{DIcon}} Are you enjoying the view?
:{{A|vo eqhdj talk 16 zhongli 02.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' From an altitude, the sight of reeds on the water, rustling gently in the breeze, is indeed a sight beautiful beyond compare.
:{{A|vo eqhdj talk 16 zhongli 03.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Wangshu Inn is located in the heart of Dihua Marsh, and provides the finest in both food and scenery. It is no wonder that travelers are fond of staying here.
:{{A|vo eqhdj talk 16 zhongli 04.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' But Wangshu Inn is no mere guesthouse.
:{{A|vo eqhdj talk 16 zhongli 05.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' It was built tall to provide superior visibility for surveying the surrounding terrain. And it was built here, on this road, because it is one of the main routes for traffic into the region.
:{{A|vo eqhdj talk 16 zhongli 06.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' This is a strategic location that must be defended at all costs.
:{{DIcon}} No wonder Xiao is here so often.
:{{A|vo eqhdj talk 16 zhongli 07.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Yes. That is one of the primary reasons that he frequents the inn.
:{{A|vo eqhdj talk 16 zhongli 08.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Looking southeast from here, one can see all the way to [[Guyun Stone Forest]].
:{{A|vo eqhdj talk 16 zhongli 09.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' With gods lying sealed beneath those rocks, the area is frequently afflicted with monster activity. Xiao often goes back and forth between here and Guyun.
:{{A|vo eqhdj talk 16 zhongli 10.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Being constantly on the move must be tiring for him. My purpose in coming here was to give him a few words of comfort, but to my surprise, I did not find him on the roof...
:{{DIcon}}  He must be busy with his duties.
:{{A|vo eqhdj talk 16 zhongli 11.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Perhaps so. Nevertheless, this trip was by no means a waste. Besides, there shall be no shortage of opportunities to meet in the future.
:{{A|vo eqhdj talk 16 zhongli 12.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' On the subject of Wangshu Inn, the chef here is highly talented.
:{{A|vo eqhdj talk 16 zhongli 13.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' If I recall correctly, there was a cooking competition hosted in Liyue Harbor during the [[Moonchase Festival]]. This chef was selected to represent the Dihua Marsh region, entered the finals, and took second prize.
:{{A|vo eqhdj talk 16 zhongli 14.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Culinary excellence should always be shared far and wide.
:{{A|vo eqhdj talk 16 zhongli 15.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Hmm... Being up so high reminds me of another lofty location.
:{{A|vo eqhdj talk 16 zhongli 16.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Yes... one that the adepti once took control of, long ago. It then fell into disuse. Whether anyone tends to it these days, I do not know...
:{{A|vo eqhdj talk 16 zhongli 17.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Alright then. That is where I shall go tomorrow.
{{Dialogue End}}
<gallery>
NPC 2.4 Event Location Zhongli 4.png|Zhongli's Day 4 Location
NPC 2.4 Event Location Zhongli 4 Context.png|Additional Context
</gallery>
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Day 5 - Talk to Zhongli at [[Three Cranes Puzzle|Dwelling in the Clouds]], above the teleport waypoint at Qingyun Peak)
:{{A|vo eqhdj talk 17 zhongli 01.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Here above the clouds, where the moon sets and the sun rises before your eyes, one's sense of time becomes indistinct.
:{{DIcon}} This is Cloud Retainer's place, right?
:{{A|vo eqhdj talk 17 zhongli 02.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Indeed.
:{{A|vo eqhdj talk 17 zhongli 03.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' You have encountered her several times, correct?
:{{DIcon}} She is quite wondrous, even for an adeptus.
:{{A|vo eqhdj talk 17 zhongli 04.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' You possess a wealth of knowledge and experience, and you have goodness in your heart. Naturally, you are able to have friendly interactions with her.
:{{A|vo eqhdj talk 17 zhongli 05.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Cloud Retainer is an expert in the mechanical arts, and an avid inventor.
:{{A|vo eqhdj talk 17 zhongli 06.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Generous and kind, honest and forthright... I treasure her as both a friend and teacher, the likes of whom are hard to come by.
:{{A|vo eqhdj talk 17 zhongli 07.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' An old friend once said to me that if you ever have a question on the most trivial of affairs, two hours conversing with Cloud Retainer will leave you better informed than three days and nights talking to every soul in the harbor.
:{{A|vo eqhdj talk 17 zhongli 08.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Traveler, would you say you agree?
:{{DIcon}} Hit the nail on the head.
:{{DIcon}} There's some truth to it.
:{{A|vo eqhdj talk 17 zhongli 09.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Hahaha. Yes, Cloud Retainer does not waste words, but this is no bad thing. She may say that she prefers to keep her distance from the mortal realm, but in fact she cares deeply for humanity.
:{{A|vo eqhdj talk 17 zhongli 10.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Ahh... I believe I have gazed at the mountains long enough. Time for a change of scenery.
:{{A|vo eqhdj talk 17 zhongli 11.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Tomorrow... yes, perhaps I will head further north.
:{{A|vo eqhdj talk 17 zhongli 12.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Qingce Village is one of the more populated places outside of the harbor. I think I shall go there.
{{Dialogue End}}
<gallery>
NPC 2.4 Event Location Zhongli 5.png|Zhongli's Day 5 Location
NPC 2.4 Event Location Zhongli 5 Context.png|Additional Context
</gallery>
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Day 6 - Talk to Zhongli beside the teleport waypoint West of Qingce Village)
:{{A|vo eqhdj talk 18 zhongli 01.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Compared to the constant hubbub of Liyue Harbor, it is far more serene here.
:{{DIcon}} Yep, it's so quiet here.
:{{A|vo eqhdj talk 18 zhongli 02.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' It is a pleasant and leisurely atmosphere, not unfit for a festival.
:{{A|vo eqhdj talk 18 zhongli 03.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' On the way over, I saw grandparents preparing meals, children learning to make Xiao Lanterns... It was quite nostalgic for me. It took me back to the very earliest days of Liyue's history.
:{{A|vo eqhdj talk 18 zhongli 04.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Back then, most able-bodied adults were busy supporting the war effort or helping to build the city. Like now, the oldest and youngest supported each other, living humble lives.
:{{DIcon}} It sounds like they had it rough...
:{{A|vo eqhdj talk 18 zhongli 05.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Indeed, their lives were not easy. But the people of Liyue have tenacity and optimism in their bones.
:{{A|vo eqhdj talk 18 zhongli 06.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' They will never stop striving for progress, no matter how much destitution they face.
:{{A|vo eqhdj talk 18 zhongli 07.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' In ancient times, Qingce Village was once ravaged by the [[Chi]]. It is now several thousand years since it was put to rest.
:{{A|vo eqhdj talk 18 zhongli 08.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Over the millennia, people built dwellings and worked the fertile land, creating the spectacular view we now see today.
:{{DIcon}} I heard a story about the Chi's corpse...
:{{A|vo eqhdj talk 18 zhongli 09.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' ...That after it died, its body became the rocky mountains and flowing waters of Qingce. I, too, have heard this story.
:{{A|vo eqhdj talk 18 zhongli 10.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' The idea is captivating. Though, I'm afraid, it is pure fantasy.
:{{A|vo eqhdj talk 18 zhongli 11.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Lofty mountains have stood and spring water has flowed here since time immemorial. That people now inhabit this place is solely because they have toiled to make it so.
:{{A|vo eqhdj talk 18 zhongli 12.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Qingce's verdant hills and stunning waters paired with the tranquil atmosphere here make it a place of extraordinary beauty. A rare blessing indeed.
:{{A|vo eqhdj talk 18 zhongli 13.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Oh, one of the villagers generously gifted me with some fresh [[Bamboo Shoot]]s. They will add some seasonal flavor to a meal on my return to Liyue Harbor.
:{{A|vo eqhdj talk 18 zhongli 14.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Seasonal bamboo shoots are yet another rare blessing offered by Qingce Village.
{{Dialogue End}}
<gallery>
NPC 2.4 Event Location Zhongli 6.png|Zhongli's Day 6 Location
NPC 2.4 Event Location Zhongli 6 Context.png|Additional Context
</gallery>
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Day 7 - Talk to Zhongli at the walkway above [[Liuli Pavilion]])
:{{A|vo eqhdj talk 19 zhongli 01.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' This year's Xiao Lanterns and fireworks seem more exquisite than ever.
:{{DIcon}} Ah, you're back in the city.
:{{A|vo eqhdj talk 19 zhongli 02.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Yes, after a most worthwhile journey.
:{{A|vo eqhdj talk 19 zhongli 03.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Had I not heeded your advice, I fear I may have missed out on the scenes I saw. Thank you, Traveler.
:{{DIcon}} You're welcome.
:{{A|vo eqhdj talk 19 zhongli 04.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Liyue's beauty always gladdens my heart. There is everything from the graceful to the grandiose, from serenity to splendor. And the ways in which the sights of Liyue stir the heart... They must be seen to be experienced.
:{{A|vo eqhdj talk 19 zhongli 05.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' The people of Liyue today are busier than ever before. Yet still they head home when the festival season comes, no matter how long the journey takes, just for the chance to sit around the stove and share a joyful time with their loved ones.
:{{A|vo eqhdj talk 19 zhongli 06.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Even a glimpse of Liyue's scenery on their homeward journey can serve to comfort their spirits.
:{{A|vo eqhdj talk 19 zhongli 07.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Traveler, this view belongs to you as much as to anyone else. Though your journey ahead may be long and much awaits for you to accomplish, I hope that each time you return to Liyue, sights such as these will put your mind at ease.
:{{A|vo eqhdj talk 19 zhongli 08.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' A safe haven between the mountains, a warm glow that guides you out from a dense forest. Like the stars in the sky, may the lights of this city always shine for you, Traveler, even from beyond the clouds.
{{Dialogue End}}

==Dialogue==
{{Quest Description|You haven't gone to see Katheryne in a while. Why don't you go have a look?}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Talk to Katheryne)
:{{A|vo tnllq001 1 katheryne 01.ogg}} '''Katheryne:''' Traveler, you've come at a good time.
:{{A|vo tnllq001 1 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wait, this sounds like... another commission?
:{{A|vo tnllq001 1 katheryne 02.ogg}} '''Katheryne:''' Hehe, it is as you say. The commission this time around is of high importance. It pertains to the safety of the Avidya Forest's inhabitants.
:{{A|vo tnllq001 1 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh? What happened?
:{{A|vo tnllq001 1 katheryne 03.ogg}} '''Katheryne:''' Not long ago, we received word that a section of the Avidya Forest seems to have become "contaminated."
:{{A|vo tnllq001 1 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Contaminated? You mean... a new Withering Zone?
:{{A|vo tnllq001 1 katheryne 04.ogg}} '''Katheryne:''' I don't know about the specifics, but I hear that strange things are happening to people who cross through that region.
:{{A|vo tnllq001 1 katheryne 05.ogg}} '''Katheryne:''' The Avidya Forest's inhabitants won't leave their home so easily. If we allow this contaminated region to expand, the consequences could be unimaginable.
:{{A|vo tnllq001 1 katheryne 06.ogg}} '''Katheryne:''' That's why I want to ask you to investigate the situation. Even if all you can do is stop the contamination from spreading, that will still save many people.
:{{A|vo tnllq001 1 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' This is forest business... Hmm, maybe Tighnari will know something. Let's go find him!
{{Dialogue End}}
{{Quest Description|update|You hear about the contaminated region of sorts from Katheryne. Time to ask Tighnari about the matter.}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Approach Tighnari)
:{{A|vo tnllq001 2 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' This is where you've been, Tighnari! Hm? That's—
:{{A|vo tnllq001 2 tighnari 01.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Shh... Keep your voice down.
:{{A|vo tnllq001 2 yara 01.ogg}} '''Yara:''' Tighnari... Everything's spinning...
:{{A|vo tnllq001 2 yara 02.ogg}} '''Yara:''' Am I going to die? *sniff* Tell Mom that I should've listened to her...
:{{A|vo tnllq001 2 yara 03.ogg}} '''Yara:''' And tell [[Suna]] that I'm sorry for breaking her toy. I didn't tell her because I was scared that she wouldn't play with me anymore...
:{{A|vo tnllq001 2 yara 04.ogg}} '''Yara:''' Tighnari, I heard that people turn into birds after they die. Is that true? I feel like I'm getting lighter...
:{{A|vo tnllq001 2 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What happened...? Tighnari, is he...
:{{A|vo tnllq001 2 tighnari 02.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Okay, okay, enough nonsense.
:{{A|vo tnllq001 2 tighnari 03.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' You just have a small fever. Take your medication and rest. You'll be bouncing off the walls in no time.
:{{A|vo tnllq001 2 yara 05.ogg}} '''Yara:''' Really? Then... Can you keep the thing about the toy a secret for now?
:{{A|vo tnllq001 2 tighnari 04.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' No can do. You're a big kid now. Once you've recovered, go and apologize. Keeping secrets to yourself won't solve anything.
:{{A|vo tnllq001 2 yara 06.ogg}} '''Yara:''' Aw...
:{{A|vo tnllq001 2 tighnari 05.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Hey, let me ask you something... I recall that you're usually pretty healthy. How did you get this sick all of a sudden?
:{{A|vo tnllq001 2 yara 07.ogg}} '''Yara:''' I don't know, either... Mom's been telling me not to play in the forest. I just wanted to look inside...
:{{A|vo tnllq001 2 yara 08.ogg}} '''Yara:''' It's different from before... I got lost and went around in a huge circle.
:{{A|vo tnllq001 2 yara 09.ogg}} '''Yara:''' After I got out, I started feeling dizzy...
:{{A|vo tnllq001 2 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Could it be...
:{{DIcon}} The contaminated region?
:{{A|vo tnllq001 2 tighnari 06.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' ...
:{{A|vo tnllq001 2 tighnari 07.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' So that's how this whole mess happened. Anyway, go rest. No running around until I say so, got it?
:{{A|vo tnllq001 2 tighnari 08.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' {{Traveler}}, Paimon, let's step out for now.
:{{Black Screen|You leave the room with Tighnari...}}
:{{A|vo tnllq001 2 asha 01.ogg}} '''Asha:''' Mr. Forest Watcher, how is my son?
:{{A|vo tnllq001 2 tighnari 09.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' I gave him some antipyretics. Let him rest here for a while.
:{{A|vo tnllq001 2 tighnari 10.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' I told him that he would feel better after some medicine and rest, but I only said that to comfort him.
:{{A|vo tnllq001 2 tighnari 11.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' His symptoms resemble a fever, but something else is causing them. They seem more akin to a disruption in his psyche. Antipyretics won't be of much use.
:{{A|vo tnllq001 2 asha 02.ogg}} '''Asha:''' What do we do? Mr. Forest Watcher, you have to help him!
:{{A|vo tnllq001 2 tighnari 12.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' If memory serves, a plant called [[Vasanti Grass]] can help soothe the mind.
:{{A|vo tnllq001 2 tighnari 13.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' A small number grow in arid deserts. They usually look like shriveled weeds, but can be revitalized with a splash of water.
:{{A|vo tnllq001 2 tighnari 14.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' They're expensive and unable to grow in the Avidya Forest's climate, so I don't have any on hand.
:{{A|vo tnllq001 2 tighnari 15.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' I'll ask the caravans. Go find Collei, have her prepare medicinal tools, and a set of traveling gear for me.
:{{A|vo tnllq001 2 asha 03.ogg}} '''Asha:''' Alright! Thank you!
:{{A|vo tnllq001 2 tighnari 16.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Contaminated region, huh... Is that why you two are also here?
:{{A|vo tnllq001 2 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yep. Is it a new Withering Zone?
:{{A|vo tnllq001 2 tighnari 17.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Doesn't seem like one. Whether you look at scale, internal conditions, or resultant effects, they're completely different.
:{{A|vo tnllq001 2 tighnari 18.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' The only thing they have in common is that they aren't welcome. This nuisance made itself home in the Avidya Forest, so I can't turn a blind eye.
:{{A|vo tnllq001 2 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' We feel the same way!
:{{A|vo tnllq001 2 tighnari 19.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Alright, let's contact the caravans first and purchase some Vasanti Grass. We can also ask about the contaminated region.
:{{A|vo tnllq001 2 tighnari 20.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' There's no time to waste. We have to move quickly. Let's go.

;(Talk to Yara again)
:{{A|vo dialog tnllq001 yara 01.ogg}} '''Yara:''' *sob* My head's still spinning...
{{Dialogue End}}
{{Quest Description|update|Tighnari would like to heal Yara, who has been to a contaminated region, but is missing a key herb known as Vasanti Grass. Go to a traveling merchant to see if you can get some.}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Talk to Mahir)
:{{A|vo tnllq001 4 tighnari 01.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Excuse me, I'd like to purchase some Vasanti Grass. Do you have any?
:{{A|vo tnllq001 4 mahir 01.ogg}} '''Mahir:''' I'm sorry, Mr. Forest Watcher, but we've been closed for the past few days.
:{{A|vo tnllq001 4 tighnari 02.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Closed? Now that's odd. It's my first time hearing you say something like that.
:{{A|vo tnllq001 4 mahir 02.ogg}} '''Mahir:''' *sigh* It's a long story... Some of our goods were stolen recently.
:{{A|vo tnllq001 4 mahir 03.ogg}} '''Mahir:''' They were mechanical parts that we got from the Akademiya. Although they're old models, they still fetch a good price on the market.
:{{A|vo tnllq001 4 mahir 04.ogg}} '''Mahir:''' Our caravans had to pool together Mora to afford those parts. Now that they've been lost, we'll likely come up short this trip.
:{{A|vo tnllq001 4 mahir 05.ogg}} '''Mahir:''' All the merchants talked it over, and we decided to raise the prices of our remaining inventory. Until this plan takes effect, none of us can privately sell anything.
:{{A|vo tnllq001 4 tighnari 03.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' I don't get it. If these goods are so important, then why not think of a way to get them back?
:{{A|vo tnllq001 4 tighnari 04.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Raising prices won't solve anything. At best, you're shoving the consequences of the robbery onto your customers.
:{{A|vo tnllq001 4 mahir 06.ogg}} '''Mahir:''' Mr. Forest Watcher, it's not that we don't want to, it's just the thief disappeared into the deepest parts of the forest.
:{{A|vo tnllq001 4 mahir 07.ogg}} '''Mahir:''' We asked around, and apparently the forest has been very unusual as of late. Anyone who goes in experiences mental anomalies.
:{{A|vo tnllq001 4 mahir 08.ogg}} '''Mahir:''' We can't keep waiting out here for the thief to come out. All we could do is come up with another solution.
:{{A|vo tnllq001 4 tighnari 05.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' So the bandit hid in the contaminated region after stealing those mechanical parts?
:{{A|vo tnllq001 4 tighnari 06.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' How many people were there in total? Were they not affected by the contaminated region?
:{{A|vo tnllq001 4 mahir 09.ogg}} '''Mahir:''' That crook CAME from the contaminated region! As for how many... Er... There weren't any "people."
:{{A|vo tnllq001 4 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' No people?
:{{A|vo tnllq001 4 mahir 10.ogg}} '''Mahir:''' *sigh* Even if I tell you, you might not believe me. *sigh* Fine, the thief that stole our parts was a huge, mechanical crab!
:{{A|vo tnllq001 4 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What the heck!? The Avidya Forest has creatures like that?
:{{DIcon}} Is it that "crab"?
:{{DIcon}} Didn't see any in the Avidya Forest Field Guide...
:{{A|vo tnllq001 4 mahir 11.ogg}} '''Mahir:''' To be honest, I'd rather not think about it... It moved too skillfully to be new at this.
:{{A|vo tnllq001 4 mahir 12.ogg}} '''Mahir:''' It came out of nowhere. Before we could react, it swiped our goods and ran away.
:{{A|vo tnllq001 4 mahir 13.ogg}} '''Mahir:''' We were all shocked. By the time we came to our senses, the thief was already long gone.
:{{A|vo tnllq001 4 tighnari 07.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' I see. If we help you retrieve your stolen goods, then business will return to normal?
:{{A|vo tnllq001 4 mahir 14.ogg}} '''Mahir:''' Oh, but of course.
:{{A|vo tnllq001 4 mahir 15.ogg}} '''Mahir:''' Not only that, but you'll become one of our caravan's VIPs. On all future purchases of any—
:{{A|vo tnllq001 4 tighnari 08.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Enough. Tell me something that's actually useful. Any leads on that mechanical crab?
:{{A|vo tnllq001 4 mahir 16.ogg}} '''Mahir:''' Maybe one? After our goods were stolen, we specifically got someone to assess the situation.
:{{A|vo tnllq001 4 mahir 17.ogg}} '''Mahir:''' If you're interested, you can go and talk to them.
:{{A|vo tnllq001 4 tighnari 09.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Alright, we'll go and have a word.

;(Talk to Mahir again)
:{{A|vo dialog tnllq001 mahir 01.ogg}} '''Mahir:''' How's it going? Figured out a solution?

;(Talk to Akarsh)
:{{A|vo tnllq001 5 akarsh 01.ogg}} '''Akarsh:''' After the goods were stolen, I made multiple inquiries with nearby caravans and residents.
:{{A|vo tnllq001 5 akarsh 02.ogg}} '''Akarsh:''' Turns out that many others have also been robbed by that crooked crab.
:{{A|vo tnllq001 5 akarsh 03.ogg}} '''Akarsh:''' However, the crab only seems to be interested in machinery. It doesn't even bat an eye at other valuables.
:{{A|vo tnllq001 5 akarsh 04.ogg}} '''Akarsh:''' A caravan carrying a large amount of Mora had an uneventful trip, but another caravan had a child whose metal toy was taken.
:{{A|vo tnllq001 5 akarsh 05.ogg}} '''Akarsh:''' Whatever the case, that thing is a scourge! We'll eventually think of a way to get rid of it!

;(Talk to Akarsh again)
:{{A|vo dialog tnllq001 akarsh 01.ogg}} '''Akarsh:''' We can't let it get away...

;(Talk to Abdo)
:{{A|vo tnllq001 6 abdo 01.ogg}} '''Abdo:''' That mechanical crab is fast, strong, and a pain to deal with.
:{{A|vo tnllq001 6 abdo 02.ogg}} '''Abdo:''' Ten of us might not even be able to take that thing head-on.
:{{A|vo tnllq001 6 abdo 03.ogg}} '''Abdo:''' Didn't the Akademiya ban research on mechanical life forms years ago? Where did that thing come from?
:{{A|vo tnllq001 6 abdo 04.ogg}} '''Abdo:''' Our salaries even got slashed because of it... *sigh* Who would've thought that the robber wasn't a human, but a mechanical crab? This is rough...

;(Talk to Abdo again)
:{{A|vo dialog tnllq001 abdo 01.ogg}} '''Abdo:''' *sigh* What a disaster...

;(Talk to Kadin)
:{{A|vo tnllq001 7 kadin 01.ogg}} '''Kadin:''' I heard from the caravaners that there have been a lot of robberies lately, but we haven't been affected.
:{{A|vo tnllq001 7 kadin 02.ogg}} '''Kadin:''' We don't normally see the mechanical crab, and it doesn't disturb our daily lives.
:{{A|vo tnllq001 7 kadin 03.ogg}} '''Kadin:''' It only shows up when the caravans are here, and it runs back to the contaminated region after it's done making a mess.
:{{A|vo tnllq001 7 tighnari 01.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' You haven't tried capturing it?
:{{A|vo tnllq001 7 kadin 04.ogg}} '''Kadin:''' We have, but it's too agile and fast.
:{{A|vo tnllq001 7 kadin 05.ogg}} '''Kadin:''' However, we did unexpectedly learn something the last time we tried to capture it.
:{{A|vo tnllq001 7 kadin 06.ogg}} '''Kadin:''' It apparently lives in the deepest part of the forest, so instead of immediately moving its spoils, it first hides them nearby.
:{{A|vo tnllq001 7 kadin 07.ogg}} '''Kadin:''' Once its stash grows large enough, it moves everything in one go. You'll have to move fast if you want those goods back.

;(Talk to Kadin again)
:{{A|vo dialog tnllq001 kadin 01.ogg}} '''Kadin:''' You know, I always thought it looked kinda familiar...
----
{{Dialogue End}}
{{Quest Description|update|The traveling merchant seems to have encountered some trouble. Does this strange mechanical crab have something to do with the contaminated region?}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Talk to Mahir)
:{{A|vo tnllq001 9 mahir 01.ogg}} '''Mahir:''' How are things? Did you make any progress?
:{{A|vo tnllq001 9 tighnari 01.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' We learned of its behaviors, but much still remains unclear.
:{{A|vo tnllq001 9 tighnari 02.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Assuming normal operational status, mechanical constructs generally act according to their given commands.
:{{A|vo tnllq001 9 tighnari 03.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' If I were its owner, I'd command it to steal more valuable things... or the Mora you made. That would be the most efficient method.
:{{A|vo tnllq001 9 tighnari 04.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' But it only goes after mechanical components. This doesn't make any sense.
:{{A|vo tnllq001 9 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Right! It's really weird!
:{{A|vo tnllq001 9 mahir 02.ogg}} '''Mahir:''' So you all found a way to retrieve our goods?
:{{A|vo tnllq001 9 tighnari 05.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Do you have any more mechanical parts with you?
:{{A|vo tnllq001 9 mahir 03.ogg}} '''Mahir:''' Yes, I still have a small bag of samples. They weren't taken since I keep them on me at all times.
:{{A|vo tnllq001 9 mahir 04.ogg}} '''Mahir:''' Oh, are you planning to—
:{{A|vo tnllq001 9 tighnari 06.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Under constant external conditions, organisms rarely initiate changes in their habits.
:{{A|vo tnllq001 9 tighnari 07.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Here's what we know so far: It has a mechanical composition; it lives in the contaminated region; and it comes out to steal mechanical components.
:{{A|vo tnllq001 9 tighnari 08.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' If we have said components, we can lure it out, capture it, and then make observations for further conclusions.
:{{A|vo tnllq001 9 tighnari 09.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Well... Chatting like this won't get us anywhere. We're only wasting time.
:{{A|vo tnllq001 9 mahir 05.ogg}} '''Mahir:''' You're right. We don't have any other options right now... This bag of samples is all yours, Mr. Forest Watcher. If you can get our goods back, the caravans will reward you generously.
:{{A|vo tnllq001 9 tighnari 10.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' We don't need anything in return, but I'll be keeping this bag. I may have other uses for it later.
:{{A|vo tnllq001 9 tighnari 11.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' We'll also need to borrow a Sumpter Beast. Our act has to be convincing if we want the crab to fall for it.
:{{A|vo tnllq001 9 mahir 06.ogg}} '''Mahir:''' Oh yeah, no problem at all! If it means getting our things back, you can even borrow me to do whatever you need!
:{{A|vo tnllq001 9 tighnari 12.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' I'll have to decline that offer. Anyway, we'll use the mechanical components and Sumpter Beast to pose as a transiting caravan and lure out the crab.
:{{A|vo tnllq001 9 tighnari 13.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Once it appears, capture it. I leave the timing to you.
:{{A|vo tnllq001 9 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Don't worry! We're professionals!

;(Talk to Mahir again)
:{{A|vo dialog tnllq001 mahir 02.ogg}} '''Mahir:''' *sigh* Trading sure is dangerous. Not only do you have to contend with the wits of others, but you have to be ready to deal with anything and everything...
{{Dialogue End}}
{{Quest Description|update|You and Tighnari decide to disguise yourselves as passing merchants to try to lure the Mechanical Crab out. Here goes nothing...}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Approach the marked area)
:{{A|vo tnllq001 10 tighnari 01.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Looking at the trade routes and the contaminated region's current perimeter, the goods were likely stolen somewhere around here.
:{{A|vo tnllq001 10 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Then let's get to it! We'll definitely capture that criminal crab!
:{{A|vo tnllq001 10 tighnari 02.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Okay. We'll start from here and have the Sumpter Beast, with the components on-board, lead the way.
:{{A|vo tnllq001 10 tighnari 03.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' This Sumpter Beast isn't familiar with us yet, so be calm and take your time with it.

:{{A|vo tnllq001 11 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' The Sumpter Beast went ahead. Let's keep up with it!

;(Approach the marked area)
:{{A|vo tnllq001 11 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh? Why'd it stop?
:{{A|vo tnllq001 11 tighnari 01.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Hmm... Looks like it's loafing around. Or maybe it's hungry.
:{{A|vo tnllq001 11 tighnari 02.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' The caravaners grew disheartened after their goods were stolen, so they probably didn't feed their animals as scheduled. Let's give it something to eat.

;(After feeding the Sumpter Beast)
:{{A|vo tnllq001 11 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Alright, it's moving again!

;(Approach the marked area)
:{{A|vo tnllq001 karkata doubt 01.ogg}} '''???:''' Kulilu?
:{{A|vo tnllq001 12 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Did you hear something—
:{{A|vo tnllq001 karkata happy 01.ogg}} '''???:''' Kolu!
:{{A|vo tnllq001 12 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Waaah! Is that the mechanical crab the caravan was talking about? It's charging straight at us!
:{{A|vo tnllq001 12 tighnari 01.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' It looks strong. Be careful!

{{Dialogue End}}
{{Quest Description|update|The mechanical crab has emerged! Subdue it now!}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(During the fight, when it is at low health)
:{{A|vo tnllq001 karkata upset 01.ogg}} '''Mechanical Crab (Sans Will to Fight):''' *rumbling*

;(After defeating the mechanical crab)
:{{A|vo tnllq001 karkata upset 01.ogg}} '''Mechanical Crab:''' Kuli...
:{{A|vo tnllq001 14 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hmph, just try to escape this time, you naughty, caravan-robbing crab!
:{{A|vo tnllq001 karkata doubt 01.ogg}} '''Mechanical Crab:''' Kulilu?
:{{A|vo tnllq001 14 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hey, playing dumb won't save you! Spill it! Why are you stealing so many mechanical parts?
:{{DIcon}} It doesn't seem to understand us...
:{{A|vo tnllq001 14 tighnari 01.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Hmm, it doesn't seem capable of comprehending complex questions. Keep an eye on it. I'll search around the area for the caravans' goods.
:{{Black Screen|After some searching, Tighnari finds the goods that the mechanical crab stole...}}
:{{A|vo tnllq001 14 tighnari 02.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' I don't know why you're stealing mechanical parts, but they don't belong to you.
:{{A|vo tnllq001 14 tighnari 03.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Stolen items must be returned to their rightful owners. Any objections?
:{{A|vo tnllq001 karkata upset 01.ogg}} '''Mechanical Crab:''' Kuli...
:{{DIcon}} It looks sad...
:{{A|vo tnllq001 14 tighnari 04.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' You came from the depths of the contaminated region, right? How about you help us with something?
:{{A|vo tnllq001 14 tighnari 05.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' If you take us there, I'll give you some mechanical parts as a reward.
:{{A|vo tnllq001 karkata happy 01.ogg}} '''Mechanical Crab:''' Kolu!
:{{A|vo tnllq001 14 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' It reacted!
:{{DIcon}} Does it understand us?
:{{A|vo tnllq001 14 tighnari 06.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' We can't be certain yet. Its excitement may be a simple, programmed response upon seeing mechanical components.
:{{A|vo tnllq001 14 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Okay, so you want the crab to lead us into the contaminated region?
:{{A|vo tnllq001 14 tighnari 07.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' That's right. The contaminated region has a large and currently expanding perimeter, so it would be difficult to conduct a thorough search.
:{{A|vo tnllq001 14 tighnari 08.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' If we charge straight in, we'll get lost like headless pigeons. Also, our new friend here seems to be full of secrets.
:{{A|vo tnllq001 14 tighnari 09.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' I've been studying this contaminated region recently, and I have a hypothesis of my own. So to be absolutely safe, it would be best to have a "guide" lead the way.
:{{A|vo tnllq001 14 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Paimon gets it now! Does this scuttler understand what you're saying?
:{{A|vo tnllq001 14 tighnari 10.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' It doesn't have to, as long as it isn't hostile towards us.
:{{A|vo tnllq001 14 tighnari 11.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' I gave it some components that it will definitely take back to the contaminated region. So long as it doesn't attack us, we can simply follow along.
:{{A|vo tnllq001 karkata happy 01.ogg}} '''Mechanical Crab:''' Kalu!
:{{A|vo tnllq001 14 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' It seems to be really happy...
:{{A|vo tnllq001 14 tighnari 12.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Listen to me. Wait for us here. No running off.
:{{A|vo tnllq001 14 tighnari 13.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' We'll be back soon. If you're still here when we return, I'll give you another mechanical part as a reward. Understood?
:;(The Mechanical Crab nods its head)
:{{A|vo tnllq001 karkata happy 01.ogg}} '''Mechanical Crab:''' Kolu!
:{{DIcon}} Does that count as understanding us?
:{{A|vo tnllq001 14 tighnari 14.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' I'm not sure, but our priorities are to retrieve the mechanical components, and to purchase Vasanti Grass to make medicine with.
:{{A|vo tnllq001 14 tighnari 15.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' We should return, but before we do, we need to set up a few "traps." Can't have that crab escaping.

;(Talk to the Mechanical Crab)
:'''Observe Mechanical Crab:''' (The mechanical crab looks quite well-behaved and does not intend to run away.)
{{Dialogue End}}
{{Quest Description|update|Although the mechanical crab doesn't seem to know much of anything in general, it accepts Tighnari's simple trade. But before you let it lead you to the contaminated region, there are some things you need to settle first...}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Talk to Mahir)
:{{A|vo tnllq001 15 mahir 01.ogg}} '''Mahir:''' Oh, oh!
:{{A|vo tnllq001 15 mahir 02.ogg}} '''Mahir:''' These are the mechanical parts that were stolen! You really got them back for us!
:{{A|vo tnllq001 15 mahir 03.ogg}} '''Mahir:''' Thank you all so very much! I don't know how I can repay you... Wait, didn't you want to purchase Vasanti Grass?
:{{A|vo tnllq001 15 mahir 04.ogg}} '''Mahir:''' Don't worry about the price — they're on the house! How many do you need?
:{{A|vo tnllq001 15 tighnari 01.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Two is enough.
:{{A|vo tnllq001 15 mahir 05.ogg}} '''Mahir:''' No, that won't do. Here, I'll throw in some Mora—
:{{A|vo tnllq001 15 tighnari 02.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' No need. I've already received a reward from you.
:{{A|vo tnllq001 15 mahir 06.ogg}} '''Mahir:''' Reward...? You mean that bag of mechanical parts? Ah, they aren't worth much compared to this merchandise.
:{{A|vo tnllq001 15 tighnari 03.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' But those parts are very useful to me, just like the Vasanti Grass.
:{{A|vo tnllq001 15 tighnari 04.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' I retrieved the things you needed, and you gave me what I needed in return. We're even.
:{{A|vo tnllq001 15 tighnari 05.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Oh, and before we go, just a reminder, the forest has an intricate and biodiverse ecosystem. Even if there were no mechanical crabs, other dangers are still present. Take caution on this route.
:{{A|vo tnllq001 15 mahir 07.ogg}} '''Mahir:''' Noted! Thank you all ever so much!
:{{A|vo tnllq001 15 tighnari 06.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Let's return to the village. The earlier we can give the child medicine, the sooner he'll start feeling better.

;(Talk to Mahir again)
:{{A|vo dialog tnllq001 mahir 03.ogg}} '''Mahir:''' Thank you all for your help. If it weren't for you, we would've lost a fortune.

;(Talk to Abdo, Akarsh, or Kadin, optional)
:{{A|vo dialog tnllq001 akarsh 02.ogg}} '''Akarsh:''' In the end, the goods got stolen because you all didn't guard them properly.

==Steps==
# Open the strange book
# Examine the surrounding area
# Continue exploring along the path
# Follow the Paper Frogs
# Continue forward along the path
# Go to the [[Hut of Blessings]]

# Return to the Hut of Blessings
# Collect the materials used to make [[Magic Tonic]] (0/3)

{{Quest Description|update|Albedo's editor, Editorial Director Hirayama, has not shown up. Perhaps he might be found near the Outlander Affairs Agency.}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Approach the Outlander Affairs Agency)
:{{A|vo rcjeq002 4 aratani 01.ogg}} '''Aratani:''' This can't be happening! The moment we need to contact Onodera is when he's on special leave.
:{{A|vo rcjeq002 4 aratani 02.ogg}} '''Aratani:''' Kuroda and I will go back to Inazuma City for an emergency printing run. The demand for this book is so high though, even with the emergency prints it still might not be enough.
:{{A|vo rcjeq002 4 murata 01.ogg}} '''Murata:''' Despite everything, we're still lucky that we found out today. If this had happened a few days later, then we'd really be in boiling water.
:{{A|vo rcjeq002 4 murata 02.ogg}} '''Murata:''' *sigh* Hey, do you think that the suspicious guy they found in the warehouse has anything to do with this?
:{{A|vo rcjeq002 4 kuroda 01.ogg}} '''Kuroda:''' Well, the editorial director is on his way over there to investigate the situation as we speak.
:{{A|vo rcjeq002 4 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Uh, sorry to interrupt, but what's going on here?
:{{A|vo rcjeq002 4 murata 03.ogg}} '''Murata:''' Oh, hey Traveler. Don't worry, it's nothing. Just an internal issue, that's all. How can I help you?
:{{A|vo rcjeq002 4 albedo 01.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' I'm looking for the editorial director, Mr. Hirayama. Does anyone know where he is now?
:{{A|vo rcjeq002 4 murata 04.ogg}} '''Murata:''' Mr. Hirayama is currently at the warehouse down by the harbor...
:{{A|vo rcjeq002 4 kuroda 02.ogg}} '''Kuroda:''' Hold on a second, Murata.
:{{A|vo rcjeq002 4 kuroda 03.ogg}} '''Kuroda:''' Uh, excuse me, but you must be Calx, the one who was invited to paint The Five Kasen for the festival?
:{{A|vo rcjeq002 4 albedo 02.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Yes, that's me.
:{{A|vo rcjeq002 4 kuroda 04.ogg}} '''Kuroda:''' My name is Kuroda. You must be inquiring about information regarding The Five Kasen.
:{{A|vo rcjeq002 4 kuroda 05.ogg}} '''Kuroda:''' I do apologize, but please make yourself comfortable at the International Trade Association, and I will let Mr. Hirayama know to send you the materials right away.
:{{A|vo rcjeq002 4 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, no need! You guys look super busy, so we can go find him ourselves.
:{{A|vo rcjeq002 4 kuroda 06.ogg}} '''Kuroda:''' Ah well, a—about that...
:{{A|vo rcjeq002 4 albedo 03.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Excuse me, but is there something wrong with the latest volume of A Legend of Sword?
:{{A|vo rcjeq002 4 kuroda 07.ogg}} '''Kuroda:''' Huh! How did you know?
:{{A|vo rcjeq002 4 albedo 04.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Since you were all aware that Mr. Hirayama needed to send me some supporting materials, that means the editorial director didn't forget about it. Instead, something urgent must've cropped up.
:{{A|vo rcjeq002 4 albedo 05.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' To add to that, despite being aware that I am Calx, you are still unwilling to let me go to Mr. Hirayama directly.
:{{A|vo rcjeq002 4 albedo 06.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' After considering these factors, the only reason you would try to stall me is if something happened to A Legend of Sword, which I did the illustrations for.
:{{A|vo rcjeq002 4 kuroda 08.ogg}} '''Kuroda:''' Well, uh... *sigh* I'm very sorry. The situation is just as you said, Calx. I suppose it doesn't hurt to tell you now...
:{{A|vo rcjeq002 4 kuroda 09.ogg}} '''Kuroda:''' Earlier today, someone spotted a suspicious outlander sneaking around inside the Irodori Festival warehouse down by the docks, so they promptly alerted the Tenryou Commission.
:{{A|vo rcjeq002 4 kuroda 10.ogg}} '''Kuroda:''' The Tenryou Commission was concerned about potential cargo theft, so they contacted everyone who was renting space in the warehouse. It was then that we realized that the latest copies of A Legend of Sword had suddenly gone missing!
:{{A|vo rcjeq002 4 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What? The books are missing!?
:{{A|vo rcjeq002 4 kuroda 11.ogg}} '''Kuroda:''' Shh... Not so loud!
:{{A|vo rcjeq002 4 kuroda 12.ogg}} '''Kuroda:''' Not only is this book an eagerly anticipated release in the last phase of the Irodori Festival, but the author, Zhenyu, will be personally attending the release party as well.
:{{A|vo rcjeq002 4 murata 05.ogg}} '''Murata:''' Because of the dire situation, Mr. Hirayama immediately hurried to the warehouse to determine whether the theft was related to that suspicious outlander.
:{{A|vo rcjeq002 4 albedo 07.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' I see. It would be a great misfortune if A Legend of Sword would not be released on schedule, and quite the disappointment for Zhenyu as well.
:{{A|vo rcjeq002 4 albedo 08.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' If Mr. Hirayama has gone to the warehouse at the docks, then I'll go down to see if I can be of any help.
;(If player has completed [[Yae Publishing House's Invitation]])
::{{A|vo rcjeq002 4 paimon 04a 1.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So the author of A Legend of Sword is Zhenyu, sounds familiar... Hey, isn't that Xingqiu's pen name?
::{{A|vo rcjeq002 4 albedo 09a.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Oh? Do you know him?
::{{DIcon}} We've met on a couple of occasions.
::{{A|vo rcjeq002 4 paimon 04a 2.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Xingqiu would definitely be upset if he discovers that his books are missing... Let's accompany Albedo to the warehouse, too.
;(If player has not completed [[Yae Publishing House's Invitation]])
::{{A|vo rcjeq002 4 paimon 04b 1.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Zhenyu... Hmm, sounds like a name from Liyue. Albedo, what kind of person is the author of this book?
::{{A|vo rcjeq002 4 albedo 09b 1.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' I have not met him personally, but the editors said that he is actually the second son of the Feiyun Commerce Guild family in Liyue.
::{{DIcon}} The second son of the Feiyun Commerce Guild?
::{{DIcon}} Isn't that Xingqiu?
::{{A|vo rcjeq002 4 albedo 09b 2.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Oh? Do you know him?
::{{DIcon}} We've met on a couple of occasions.
::{{A|vo rcjeq002 4 paimon 04b 2.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Whoa, that's a real twist! Paimon never would have guessed that Xingqiu would be publishing a light novel together with Albedo!
::{{A|vo rcjeq002 4 paimon 04b 3.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' But enough about that, Xingqiu would definitely be upset if he discovers that his books are missing.
::{{A|vo rcjeq002 4 paimon 04b 4.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Let's accompany Albedo to the warehouse, too.

;(Talk to Murata again)
:{{A|vo dialog rcjeq002 murata 01.ogg}} '''Murata:''' Aratani and Kuroda are going back to Inazuma City to start printing extra copies of A Legend of Sword. I'll stay here and hold down the fort.
:{{A|vo dialog rcjeq002 murata 02.ogg}} '''Murata:''' Of course, I still hope those novels can be found soon and that things won't take a turn for the worse.
{{Dialogue End}}
{{Quest Description|update|The copies of "A Legend of Sword"'s latest volume have gone missing. Hirayama has also gone to the warehouse where the incident took place. Head over there quickly and investigate.}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
:{{A|vo rcjeq002 5 kujousara 01.ogg}} '''Kujou Sara:''' ...
:{{Introductory Note|Kujou Sara}}
:{{A|vo rcjeq002 5 venti 01.ogg}} '''Venti:''' ...
:{{A|vo rcjeq002 5 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh? It's you!... Why are you here!?
:{{A|vo rcjeq002 5 kujousara 02.ogg}} '''Kujou Sara:''' I'm here on behalf of the Tenryou Commission, of course. Is that surprising?
:{{A|vo rcjeq002 5 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' No, Sara, Paimon wasn't talking about you...
:{{A|vo rcjeq002 5 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So, Tone-Deaf Bard... The suspicious outlander in the warehouse wouldn't happen to be you, would it?
:{{A|vo rcjeq002 5 venti 02.ogg}} '''Venti:''' Ehe... Considering the evidence, it appears that the suspicious outlander is... indeed me.
:{{A|vo rcjeq002 5 kujousara 03.ogg}} '''Kujou Sara:''' As I have told you, you are a suspect. Before your allegations of theft and illegal entry as a stowaway are cleared, you are to remain silent. Don't make me say it again.
:{{A|vo rcjeq002 5 kujousara 04.ogg}} '''Kujou Sara:''' Traveler, Paimon, do you know this self-proclaimed bard from Mondstadt?
:{{DIcon}} Well, I can't say he's a complete stranger...
:{{DIcon}} You could say we're quite familiar...
:{{A|vo rcjeq002 5 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Uh, listen Sara... Knowing him, it's safe to say that he wasn't behind the theft. But, what's this about being a stowaway?
:{{A|vo rcjeq002 5 kujousara 05.ogg}} '''Kujou Sara:''' Although he claims to be a special guest for the Irodori Festival, he's failed to present his Invitation Letter. Therefore, we can only suspect that he might've entered the country illegally.
:{{A|vo rcjeq002 5 kujousara 06.ogg}} '''Kujou Sara:''' And just a moment ago, we caught him in a [[Dandelion Wine]] crate near the Sailing Breeze.
:{{DIcon}} Could we ask him a few questions?
:{{A|vo rcjeq002 5 kujousara 07.ogg}} '''Kujou Sara:''' If it would help shed any light on the situation, then please, be my guest.
:{{A|vo rcjeq002 5 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Uh, Venti... You didn't really come here illegally, did you?
:{{A|vo rcjeq002 5 venti 03.ogg}} '''Venti:''' Ouch, your words wound me... We've been apart for so long, and the moment we meet again, all I'm greeted with is grilling questions and suspicious glares.
:{{A|vo rcjeq002 5 venti 04.ogg}} '''Venti:''' *sigh* You arrived in Inazuma via similar means, or, so I heard... You of all people should be more understanding, don't you think?
:{{A|vo rcjeq002 5 kujousara 08.ogg}} '''Kujou Sara:''' "Similar means"?
:{{DIcon}} Let's not bring up past now!
:{{DIcon}} We had no choice!
:{{A|vo rcjeq002 5 venti 05.ogg}} '''Venti:''' Haha, I merely jest. Fear not, for the person who sent me the invitation is none other than Kamisato Ayato of Yashiro Commission. It's unlikely that someone acquainted with the likes of him would ever be here illegally, right?
:{{A|vo rcjeq002 5 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' But why weren't you on the same ship as the other bards?
:{{A|vo rcjeq002 5 venti 06.ogg}} '''Venti:''' Well, once I received the Invitation Letter, I couldn't help but want to come to Inazuma a little early. It was then that I happened upon a cargo ship bound for Inazuma transporting Dandelion Wine, so, naturally, I decided to set sail with them.
:{{A|vo rcjeq002 5 venti 07.ogg}} '''Venti:''' Once aboard, I found the captain to be a kindred spirit, and I was treated to an abundance of fine liquor along the way. Uh, I must have fallen asleep in the cargo crate while carefully comparing the tastes of Dandelion Wine and Inazuman sake.
:{{A|vo rcjeq002 5 venti 08.ogg}} '''Venti:''' And when I woke up, I found myself in this warehouse with a Tenryou Commission general glaring at me from atop the crate.
:{{A|vo rcjeq002 5 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Coming from Venti, this story is quite believable. But, it still feels a bit...
:{{DIcon}} Childish...
:{{DIcon}} Shameless...
:{{A|vo rcjeq002 5 hirayama 01.ogg}} '''Hirayama:''' Excuse me, I'm the owner of the stolen goods from the Yae Publishing House, and there are some questions I would like to ask you.
:{{A|vo rcjeq002 5 hirayama 02.ogg}} '''Hirayama:''' Based on what you just said, it seems you've been in the warehouse for some time now. If that's the case, did you happen to hear anything unusual?
:{{A|vo rcjeq002 5 venti 09.ogg}} '''Venti:''' Actually, I did hear some faint footsteps around me a couple of times. But I didn't consider the sound anything out of the ordinary.
:{{A|vo rcjeq002 5 hirayama 03.ogg}} '''Hirayama:''' Hmm? But if you clearly heard something, why didn't you feel it was unusual?
:{{A|vo rcjeq002 5 albedo 01.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Oh, I seem to understand now.
:{{A|vo rcjeq002 5 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh? What did you notice, Albedo?
:{{A|vo rcjeq002 5 albedo 02.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' When it comes to burglars, they are generally associated with prying or rummaging through things. What Venti means is that he did not hear anything unusual like that.
:{{A|vo rcjeq002 5 albedo 03.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' As for the sound of footsteps, because this is a warehouse where many goods are coming in and out each day, it is quite normal for people to be walking around.
:{{A|vo rcjeq002 5 hirayama 04.ogg}} '''Hirayama:''' I see, but if that's the case, then we're back to square one regarding the stolen books.
:{{A|vo rcjeq002 5 albedo 04.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' No, not quite. From the facts that have been presented to us, we can draw at least three conclusions now.
:{{A|vo rcjeq002 5 albedo 05.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' First, whoever took the novels is not a spur-of-the-moment burglar, they had their sights on the books from the very beginning. Second, the culprit was very familiar with the warehouse and might even have a key. And third...
:{{DIcon}} There must be more than one criminal involved.
:{{A|vo rcjeq002 5 albedo 06.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' I knew you'd catch on, {{Traveler}}. One person couldn't possibly transport so many heavy books in such a short window of time, it must have been a team effort.
:{{A|vo rcjeq002 5 albedo 07.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' It goes without saying that Venti clearly does not match up with our culprits.
:{{A|vo rcjeq002 5 kujousara 09.ogg}} '''Kujou Sara:''' Yes, I agree with your reasoning.
:{{A|vo rcjeq002 5 kujousara 10.ogg}} '''Kujou Sara:''' Mr. Hirayama, the Tenryou Commission will continue by investigating the warehouse staff. If you come across any further clues, please notify us immediately.
:{{A|vo rcjeq002 5 hirayama 05.ogg}} '''Hirayama:''' Yes, understood. I'll leave it to you, then.
:{{A|vo rcjeq002 5 venti 10.ogg}} '''Venti:''' Hee hee, I suppose I'm free as a bird then...
:{{A|vo rcjeq002 5 kujousara 11.ogg}} '''Kujou Sara:''' Not so fast. Even though we've cleared the theft allegations, we still haven't ascertained whether your arrival in Inazuma was legal or not.
:{{A|vo rcjeq002 5 venti 11.ogg}} '''Venti:''' Aw, 'tis a shame! I thought surely after my honest account you might let me off the hook.
:{{A|vo rcjeq002 5 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Sara's quite the meticulous one. So where's your Invitation Letter, Venti?
:{{A|vo rcjeq002 5 venti 12.ogg}} '''Venti:''' Yes, the Invitation Letter. Eh-he, I'm truly sorry. I can't seem to remember where I may have put it.
:{{A|vo rcjeq002 5 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ugh... How could you lose something so important!?
:{{A|vo rcjeq002 5 venti 13.ogg}} '''Venti:''' Don't be mistaken, I was well aware of how important it was. But I didn't bring any luggage with me, and the letter was too big to fit in my pocket, so I kept it in my hand the whole trip.
:{{A|vo rcjeq002 5 venti 14.ogg}} '''Venti:''' Strange... Though I had a little too much to drink, I know that I kept it in a secure place. I even recall being most pleased at coming up with a good idea at the time.
:{{A|vo rcjeq002 5 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' If you were holding the invitation in your hand the whole time, then why did you put it down?
:{{A|vo rcjeq002 5 venti 15.ogg}} '''Venti:''' Well, to properly compare the taste of Mondstadt wine and Inazuman sake, I had to hold a glass in each hand.
:{{A|vo rcjeq002 5 venti 16.ogg}} '''Venti:''' I couldn't both hold the invitation and a glass at the same time. But surely I wouldn't put it in just any random place, it could easily be misplaced.
:{{A|vo rcjeq002 5 albedo 08.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' In which case, I believe there's only one place it could be. Have you figured it out, {{Traveler}}?
:{{A|vo rcjeq002 5 paimon 12.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh? You're way ahead of Paimon! Do you two already know where the Invitation Letter is?
:{{DIcon}} In his shoe?
::{{A|vo rcjeq002 5 paimon 13a.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh, that doesn't sound right. The invitation is pretty big, isn't it? And, if it's in his shoe, he would feel it when he's walking!
::{{A|vo rcjeq002 5 venti 17a.ogg}} '''Venti:''' Haha, drinking too much may occasionally render the tongue a little numb, but it's true, it certainly wouldn't affect the feet.
:;(Option removed, dialogue returns to option selection)
:{{DIcon}} In his cape?
::{{A|vo rcjeq002 5 paimon 13b.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh? Are you sure? His cape doesn't even have any pockets to put stuff. But hey, a cape with pockets isn't a bad idea, you should try and get it tailored sometime, Venti.
::{{A|vo rcjeq002 5 venti 17b.ogg}} '''Venti:''' Well, people do often claim that capes and the like serve no real purpose other than aesthetics, I suppose a cape with pockets would really turn the tables on that crowd.
:;(Option removed, dialogue returns to option selection)
:{{DIcon}} In his hat?
:{{A|vo rcjeq002 5 venti 17c.ogg}} '''Venti:''' Ah yes, I remember now. I knew you'd help me find it, {{Traveler}}.
:{{Black Screen|Venti finds the Invitation Letter stuffed under his hat...}}
:{{A|vo rcjeq002 5 kujousara 12.ogg}} '''Kujou Sara:''' Hmm. This is indeed an Invitation Letter issued by the Yashiro Commission. Now that we've confirmed this guest's identity, I have no further questions.
:{{A|vo rcjeq002 5 kujousara 13.ogg}} '''Kujou Sara:''' However, starting tonight, I would advise you to stay at the International Trade Association.
:{{A|vo rcjeq002 5 kujousara 14.ogg}} '''Kujou Sara:''' Now, if you'll excuse me, I'll be leaving now.
:{{A|vo rcjeq002 6 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' There goes Sara. Alright, let's go talk to Mr. Hirayama about Albedo's reference materials.
:{{A|vo rcjeq002 6 albedo 01.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Mr. Hirayama, I'm Calx. We had originally arranged to meet today.
:{{A|vo rcjeq002 6 hirayama 01.ogg}} '''Hirayama:''' Ah, yes, so you are Calx! I'm very sorry that you've arrived in Inazuma only to find such a mess.
:{{A|vo rcjeq002 6 hirayama 02.ogg}} '''Hirayama:''' These are the materials regarding The Five Kasen. All the information that we could find is compiled here.
;(Opens [[Five Kasen Summary]])
:{{A|vo rcjeq002 6 albedo 02.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Let's see here... Yes, it's just as I had suspected. Monikers such as "Suikou" and "Aoi no Okina" aren't the real names of The Five Kasen.
:{{A|vo rcjeq002 6 albedo 03.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' "Though there were once many stories regarding each of The Five Kasen, the validity of their contents can no longer be verified in present times." ...Alas, what a shame.
:{{A|vo rcjeq002 6 albedo 04.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' But at the very least we know that most of the stories were written according to a similar style, so there is still something we may glean from this.
:{{A|vo rcjeq002 6 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So is the info useful for your paintings, Albedo?
:{{A|vo rcjeq002 6 albedo 05.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' To some extent, yes. However, I must admit that it is still lacking, and fails to fulfill the most crucial element... inspiration.
:{{A|vo rcjeq002 6 hirayama 03.ogg}} '''Hirayama:''' I am sorry that this information is not as exhaustive as you'd hoped. However, it is not possible to gather anything more at the moment.
:{{A|vo rcjeq002 6 hirayama 04.ogg}} '''Hirayama:''' Though, Lady Yae did say that there are many variations of the stories about The Five Kasen, and everyone has a different story in their heart.
:{{A|vo rcjeq002 6 hirayama 05.ogg}} '''Hirayama:''' So all you need to do is to follow through with what's in your own heart and create something that you yourself find interesting.
:{{A|vo rcjeq002 6 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' That does sound like something Miko would say.
:{{A|vo rcjeq002 6 albedo 06.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Thank you, Mr. Hirayama. No need to worry, I'll find inspiration for the portraits.
:{{A|vo rcjeq002 6 hirayama 06.ogg}} '''Hirayama:''' Great. I'll leave it to you then, Calx. Oh, and there's one more thing I need to ask of everyone.
:{{A|vo rcjeq002 6 hirayama 07.ogg}} '''Hirayama:''' Tomorrow morning Mr. Zhenyu, the author of A Legend of Sword, will be arriving in Inazuma by boat. If you see him, please do not mention the stolen novels for the time being.
:{{A|vo rcjeq002 6 hirayama 08.ogg}} '''Hirayama:''' Whether the stolen books are eventually recovered or not, the Yae Publishing House will do its best to ensure that the novel's release is a success!
:{{DIcon}} I get it now.
:{{A|vo rcjeq002 6 hirayama 09.ogg}} '''Hirayama:''' You have my gratitude. I'll be going, then.
:{{A|vo rcjeq002 6 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Well, seems there's nothing more we can do here. Let's go.
:{{A|vo rcjeq002 6 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh? Venti? What are you doing over there? You don't want us to leave you behind, do you?
:{{A|vo rcjeq002 6 venti 01.ogg}} '''Venti:''' {{Traveler}}, Albedo, would you mind coming over here for a moment? There's something peculiar that I think you should see.
;(Obtain [[Five Kasen Summary]] ×1)
{{Dialogue End}}
{{Quest Description|update|Venti seems to have found some clues. Go over and see what he's found.}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Talk to Venti)
:{{A|vo rcjeq002 7 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What is it, Venti? A piece of paper?
:{{A|vo rcjeq002 7 venti 01.ogg}} '''Venti:''' Indeed. When I awakened to find myself in the warehouse this morning, I discovered this paper in the cargo crate where I was sleeping.
:{{A|vo rcjeq002 7 venti 02.ogg}} '''Venti:''' I didn't think much of it then, I thought it was merely a scrap piece of paper that had fallen into the cargo. After a quick glance, I stuffed it into a place nearby.
:{{A|vo rcjeq002 7 venti 03.ogg}} '''Venti:''' But on second thought, I think it's worth having you take a look at what's written on it.
;(Opens [[The Five Kasen's Splendor: Suikou]])
:{{A|vo rcjeq002 7 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Let me see... "Suikou Chapter"? Wait a minute, isn't Suikou the name of one of The Five Kasen?
:{{A|vo rcjeq002 7 venti 04.ogg}} '''Venti:''' The story told in this poem roughly boils down to Suikou getting tipsy and letting some poems that were meant for the Shogun get stolen.
:{{A|vo rcjeq002 7 venti 05.ogg}} '''Venti:''' Huh, this story sounds familiar to my ear, where have I heard it...
:{{A|vo rcjeq002 7 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Seriously!? It's literally the same story you just experienced yesterday!
:{{A|vo rcjeq002 7 venti 06.ogg}} '''Venti:''' Ahahaha. Indeed, it is. Interesting, isn't it?
:{{DIcon}} It almost seems related to the stolen novels.
:{{A|vo rcjeq002 7 albedo 01.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Yes, I concur. The person who left this paper could quite possibly be the criminal or even a witness to the theft.
:{{A|vo rcjeq002 7 albedo 02.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' But why leave the paper here in such a fashion? And if the one who left it here was a witness, why didn't they attempt to stop the burglary?
:{{A|vo rcjeq002 7 venti 07.ogg}} '''Venti:''' All right, let's not get ahead of ourselves.
:{{A|vo rcjeq002 7 venti 08.ogg}} '''Venti:''' Meeting together in Inazuma like this is a most rare occasion. Since we've been busy from the start of the day, let us find an inn with good drink to keep our thirst at bay!
:{{A|vo rcjeq002 7 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hey! You just sobered up and you're already thinking about more drinks?
:{{A|vo rcjeq002 7 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' And let's not forget that Albedo still has a portrait to complete. We don't have time to be slacking off!
:{{A|vo rcjeq002 7 albedo 03.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' No, it's fine. Let's all go for a drink together. It'll be my treat.
:{{A|vo rcjeq002 7 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wait a minute, what about your portrait?
:{{A|vo rcjeq002 7 albedo 04.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' As I mentioned before, I'm the kind of artist who can work quickly once I'm inspired. And now, it seems I've found my source of inspiration.
:{{A|vo rcjeq002 7 albedo 05.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' If I use a model as reference for the piece, we must pay him back with the appropriate recompense.
:{{A|vo rcjeq002 7 venti 09.ogg}} '''Venti:''' Haha, in that case, we'll need to order more dishes!
:;(Obtain [[The Five Kasen's Splendor: Suikou]])

;(A cinematic plays)

:{{A|vo rcjeq002 8 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wow, you really came through, Albedo. You were able to complete the first portrait before the opening ceremony.
:{{A|vo rcjeq002 8 venti 01.ogg}} '''Venti:''' Yes, it really is a sight to behold. Not only does it hearken to the traditional style of Inazuma, but it also makes use of modern aesthetics. My figure is particularly striking, even though I'm sound asleep in the portrait, I still appear as glorious as always.
:{{A|vo rcjeq002 8 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hey, don't get too full of yourself, Tone-Deaf Bard! You were just a model, the person in the artwork isn't actually you.

'''''The Strongest Opponent! The Biggest Crisis!''''' is the fifth [[Event Quest]] during the [[Fabulous Fungus Frenzy]] Event.

==Steps==
# Wait till the next morning (8:00 – 10:00)

# Participate in the final
# Defeat [[Haniyyah]]

'''''The Surprise That Awaits Us All!''''' is the third part of the {{Quest|Sunspray Summer Resort}}.

==Steps==
# Wait until morning the next day (08:00 – 12:00)
# Head to the reception to redeem your rewards
# Go to the place indicated in the photograph
# Enter the Domain
# Talk to everyone
# Go against the wind
# Continue on against the wind
# Continue onward
# Leave the Domain
# Talk to everyone
# Head to the [[Dance-Off Stage]]
# Operate the Dance-Off Stage and complete the performance
# Talk to everyone

==Gameplay Notes==
* During steps 6–10, the active party is limited to the Traveler.
* During step 8, there is no penalty for failing the quick-time events; the quest simply does not proceed until the player succeeds.

After completing this quest, Bennett, Venti, Chasca, [[Iansan]], [[Kachina]], Kinich, Ajaw, Mavuika, Mualani, [[Varesa]], and Xilonen can be found in the open world. 

Ifa and Ororon also appear if ''[[All Good Reunions Follow a Search]]'' has been completed.

'''''The Third Experiment: Life''''' is the fifth part of {{Quest|Traveler Observation Report}}.

==Steps==
# Head to the location of the next experiment
# Reach the location that [[Albedo]] designated
# Talk to Albedo and hear his conclusions

==Gameplay Notes==
* During this quest the player cannot enter [[Co-Op Mode]], even if the quest is not the player's current navigating quest.

==Dialogue==
{{Quest Description|After the elemental flow tests, Albedo asks you to display any special, otherworldly abilities you may have, though nothing comes of this. Still, Albedo's interest in you has not waned in the least...}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Head to the location of the next experiment)
:{{A|vo abdlq005 2 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You... You want us to jump!? From up here!?
:{{A|vo abdlq005 2 albedo 01.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Not necessarily — not if you know of a better method, that is.
:{{DIcon}} We'd better have a better method.
:{{DIcon}} That's not very reassuring.
:{{A|vo abdlq005 2 albedo 02.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Whichever method you choose, the experiment will end when you reach the opposite shore of the lake.
:{{A|vo abdlq005 2 albedo 03.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' I will factor the time expended and your top speed into my comparative analysis.
:{{A|vo abdlq005 2 paimon 02a.ogg}}<!--{{A|vo abdlq005 2 paimon 02b.ogg}}--> '''Paimon:''' The opposite side of the lake... So... We're gonna be swimming?
:{{A|vo abdlq005 2 albedo 04.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Without limitations, we complete tasks intuitively using the method that seems most rational to us.
:{{A|vo abdlq005 2 albedo 05.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Some of us would be unable to stand the icy waters... Others might find the whole thing rather refreshing.
:{{A|vo abdlq005 2 albedo 06.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' No matter what choice you make, it's all a part of the experiment. For me, every detail is invaluable to the research.
:{{DIcon}} My kind of experiment.
:{{DIcon}} This is actually less stressful than the superpower part.
:{{A|vo abdlq005 2 albedo 07.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Then if you would, please. I eagerly await the results.

;(While heading towards the designated location)
:{{A|vo abdlq005 2 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wait a minute... While we're busy testing, what exactly are you gonna be doing?
:{{A|vo abdlq005 2 albedo 08.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Me? Recording data, responding to risks, providing... emotional support...
:{{A|vo abdlq005 2 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So if we do decide to go swimming, you gonna dive in with us?
:{{A|vo abdlq005 2 albedo 09.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' No, unless you're thinking of conducting competitive research?
:{{A|vo abdlq005 2 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, uhh... Forget Paimon said anything.

;(Talk to Albedo and hear his conclusions)
:{{A|vo abdlq005 3 albedo 01.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Great work, I've never seen a performance quite like it.
:{{A|vo abdlq005 3 albedo 02.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Your reputation precedes you, Traveler. The data shows that you're easily outperforming the average citizen in Mondstadt.
:{{A|vo abdlq005 3 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' But you followed us the whole way without breaking a sweat!
:{{A|vo abdlq005 3 albedo 03.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Me? Actually, I used alchemy to cheat a little, but anyway.
:{{A|vo abdlq005 3 albedo 04.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' If it turns out that the natural laws of [[Teyvat]] do not affect you, I should be able to make various inferences about the otherworldly civilization you belong to.
:{{A|vo abdlq005 3 albedo 05.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' If the natural laws of Teyvat do affect you, then I shall be able to make inferences into the kind of evolution that would occur under the absence of such effects.
:{{A|vo abdlq005 3 albedo 06.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' The innumerable possibilities that this could present, the captivating insights... It will be something to savor again and agai—
:{{A|vo abdlq005 3 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Buuuut how does this help your RESEARCH?
:{{A|vo abdlq005 3 albedo 07.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' You've helped me to unravel many of the problems that were holding it back. When we return to the campsite, I should be able to show you something interesting.
:{{DIcon}} What else have you researched this thoroughly?
:{{A|vo abdlq005 3 albedo 08.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' I may be about to make some analogies between you and a few... unusual specimens. I hope you won't be offended.
:{{A|vo abdlq005 3 albedo 09.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Gold, Petrified Trees, a sun eight times the size of our own...
:{{A|vo abdlq005 3 albedo 10.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' The essence of the investigative process is enthralling, but such feelings are inevitably fleeting in nature.
:{{A|vo abdlq005 3 albedo 11.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' I'm willing to pour all my energy into research, and yet specimens are finite. As the unknown transitions into the realm of scientific understanding, the feeling of enlightenment is lost.
:{{A|vo abdlq005 3 albedo 12.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' All these things that start out as objects of fascination end up possessing the prosaic mundanity of a [[Sunsettia]] or a [[Sweet Flower]]. They cease to be noteworthy.
:{{A|vo abdlq005 3 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh... So that's why you wanted to paint those [[hilichurl]]s? Because you got to see something new and interesting in the differences between them?
:{{A|vo abdlq005 3 albedo 13.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Precisely. To quote my exact words from earlier, these creatures are, for the most part, "quite boring... not worth closer inspection." There is precious little about them that serves to pique my curiosity now.
:{{A|vo abdlq005 3 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So after all these experiments, are we gonna be, like, boring to you? Like some basic draft of a sketch?
:{{A|vo abdlq005 3 albedo 14.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Of course not. You have been of great assistance to me, and I will remember this friendship for a lifetime.
:{{A|vo abdlq005 3 albedo 15.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Now, before we head back to the campsite, there's one more experiment: intelligence.
:{{A|vo abdlq005 3 albedo 16.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Follow me, there are some other ruins nearby.
{{Dialogue End}}
