==Dialogue==
{{Quest Description|[[Jahoda]] warns you that the individual staying at [[The Flagship]] is a top dog of the criminal underworld. You'd do well to stay on their good side...}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Enter The Flagship)
:{{A|vo nkeq101 5 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' The Flagship... Guess this participant decided to figure out lodging first.
:;(In the background, Navia immediately spots the Traveler and Paimon and stands up to greet them)
:{{A|vo nkeq101 5 navia 01.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Partner! Paimon!
:{{Introductory Note|Navia}}
:{{A|vo nkeq101 5 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' [[Navia]]! It's been forever!
:{{DIcon}} I'm guessing...
:{{DIcon}} ...You're here for [[Nod-Krai Trade Expo|the expo]]?
:{{A|vo nkeq101 5 navia 02.ogg}} '''Navia:''' You got that right. Representing the [[Spina di Rosula]], of course.
:{{A|vo nkeq101 5 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Top dog of the criminal underworld... Yep, that checks out.
:{{A|vo nkeq101 5 navia 03.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Haha, is that my new nickname? I'm not opposed — it's kinda snazzy.
:{{A|vo nkeq101 5 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' It's great that we found you! We're working a [[commission]] to help with participant registration right now. Y'know, goods verification, stuff like that...
:{{A|vo nkeq101 5 navia 04.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Oh, I see. Well, in that case, take a seat. I ordered a whole bunch of food. [[Clorinde]] and [[Chevreuse]] went to unpack some things, but should be back in a sec... Ohh, speak of the devil!
:;(Chevreuse and Clorinde arrive and join the rest at the table)
:{{A|vo nkeq101 5 clorinde 01.ogg}} '''Clorinde:''' Talking about us?
:{{A|vo nkeq101 5 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Clorinde! Chevreuse! You're here too!
:{{A|vo nkeq101 5 clorinde 02.ogg}} '''Clorinde:''' [[Nod-Krai]] is a chaotic and dangerous place. Considering the Spina's importance to [[Fontaine]], the last thing we need is for something to happen to its president.
:{{Introductory Note|Clorinde}}
:{{A|vo nkeq101 5 navia 05.ogg}} '''Navia:''' I do find it nice to travel with friends, but c'mon... Look who you're talking to! What's the worst that could happen?
:{{A|vo nkeq101 5 clorinde 03.ogg}} '''Clorinde:''' With that nonchalant attitude, it's anybody's guess...
:{{A|vo nkeq101 5 navia 06.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Fair enough. Guess you can mark down our [[Champion Duelist]] here as my... bodyguard.
:{{A|vo nkeq101 5 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Gang boss and her bodyguard... Got it. Should we mark you down for the expo too, Chevreuse?
:{{A|vo nkeq101 5 chevreuse 01.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' No need. I'm here on official business. A lot of our recent cases have had ties to Nod-Krai.
:{{Introductory Note|Chevreuse}}
:{{A|vo nkeq101 5 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Aaand that's Paimon's cue to butt out, hehe.
:{{A|vo nkeq101 5 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, one more thing! What's the Spina planning to trade at the expo?
:;(Navia displays a mechanism on the table)
:{{A|vo nkeq101 5 navia 07.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Ah, this right here! It's one of the [[Fontaine Research Institute]]'s newest inventions. It's a kind of relay system that allows the user to unleash [[pneuma]] and [[ousia]] energy in battle!
:{{A|vo nkeq101 5 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So, it's... a weapon?
:{{A|vo nkeq101 5 navia 08.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Of course! At a market with no legal oversight like this one, weapons are gonna be the first to go!
:{{A|vo nkeq101 5 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Guess so... Still, bragging about not having to follow the law in front of Chevreuse feels wrong.
:{{A|vo nkeq101 5 chevreuse 02.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' I don't mind. I've read quite a bit about "lawless territories" in crime novels before.
:{{A|vo nkeq101 5 chevreuse 03.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' As a detective, I know that I'll need to put the rules aside for now if I want to get things done here.
:{{A|vo nkeq101 5 chevreuse 04.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' And, on that note, I should get to work. I've got [[Special Security and Surveillance Patrol|Patrol]] members waiting on me.
:;(Chevreuse leaves)
:{{A|vo nkeq101 5 paimon 12.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Well, ready to head over to the venue? Just follow us!
:{{A|vo nkeq101 5 navia 09.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Alright, let's get this show on the road! I wanna get a bit of shopping in as well.
:{{Black Screen|You lead Navia and Clorinde to the venue.}}
:{{A|vo nkeq101 6 navia 01.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Wow, it's even bigger than I expected. I'm hoping more people will show up, though...
:{{A|vo nkeq101 6 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' It'll get busier once things kick off. Still, looks like Jahoda needs a lot of help.
:{{A|vo nkeq101 6 navia 02.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Well, Clorinde and I are all set up for now. Be sure to stop by our booth when you get a chance!
{{Dialogue End}}

{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Upon obtaining quest)
:{{A|vo lnlq002 30 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wait... Paimon feels like we're forgetting something...
:{{A|vo lnlq002 30 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh yeah, Cesar's diary! We never found out if the two kids Cesar taught magic to were Lyney and Lynette or not.
:{{A|vo lnlq002 30 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Lyney changed the topic back in the workshop, so we didn't get a chance to bring it up. Oh well, guess we'll just have to ask Lyney tomorrow evening.

;(Talk to Charlotte in the Opera Epiclese, optional)
:{{A|vo dialog lnlq003 charlotte 01.ogg}} '''Charlotte:''' Here I am, as we agreed!
:{{A|vo dialog lnlq003 charlotte 02.ogg}} '''Charlotte:''' I wonder what kind of show Lyney has prepared for us this time? Oh, the anticipation, it's killing me!
:{{A|vo dialog lnlq003 charlotte 03.ogg}} '''Charlotte:''' Oh, and how could I forget — thank you both for capturing Lorenzo. Now that this decade-long case of The Phantom Weasel has finally been put to rest, I'm gonna go through my notes and put it all together into the most spectacular special column piece to ever grace the pages of The Steambird!

;(Approach Jemma and Lynette in the Opera Epiclese)
:{{A|vo lnlq003 1 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hehe, Paimon's excited to see another of Lyney's magic shows. Wait... Lynette, shouldn't you be on stage by now?
:{{A|vo lnlq003 1 lynette 01.ogg}} '''Lynette:''' Not this time. My brother's going solo today.
:{{A|vo lnlq003 1 lynette 02.ogg}} '''Lynette:''' So I'll be watching with you.
:{{A|vo lnlq003 1 roberthoudin 01.ogg}} '''Robert Houdin:''' Good evening, ladies and gentlemen! I hope everybody's ready, because the show is about to begin!
:{{A|vo lnlq003 1 roberthoudin 02.ogg}} '''Robert Houdin:''' The great magician Lyney has prepared a spectacular show for us all tonight, concluding with an all-new grand finale that no audience has ever seen before!
:{{A|vo lnlq003 1 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wow! A new trick!
:{{A|vo lnlq003 1 lyney 01.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Thank you all so much for coming. Now, prepare to join me on a journey through the mystical and miraculous.
:{{Black Screen|Lyney wows the audience with his skill...}}
:{{A|vo lnlq003 1 gemma 01.ogg}} '''Jemma:''' ...
:{{A|vo lnlq003 1 lynette 03.ogg}} '''Lynette:''' Exciting stuff, isn't it?
:{{A|vo lnlq003 1 gemma 02.ogg}} '''Jemma:''' Yes, it's just... It reminds me of him.
:{{A|vo lnlq003 1 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' No wonder. Cesar was a famous magician, too.
:{{A|vo lnlq003 1 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So how did you two first meet, Jemma?
:{{A|vo lnlq003 1 gemma 03.ogg}} '''Jemma:''' Hmm? Well, I was out on the street once, and I saw him performing for little children.
:{{A|vo lnlq003 1 gemma 04.ogg}} '''Jemma:''' Children love magic, because they're willing to believe in things that can't be rationally explained. Cesar had this amazing way of bringing them into a dream-like world.
:{{A|vo lnlq003 1 gemma 05.ogg}} '''Jemma:''' And somehow... I felt drawn to him, too. So I went up and asked him to do a trick for me.
:{{A|vo lnlq003 1 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Aw, that sounds so romantic... What trick did he do?
:{{A|vo lnlq003 1 gemma 06.ogg}} '''Jemma:''' It was... with a flower. He took it in his hand, snapped his fingers, and it magically appeared on my head.
:{{A|vo lnlq003 1 gemma 07.ogg}} '''Jemma:''' I was so happy that day. No one had ever given me a flower before that.
:{{A|vo lnlq003 1 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Aw, that's so cute... Actually, now that you mention it, Lyney's done that one before.
:{{A|vo lnlq003 1 gemma 08.ogg}} '''Jemma:''' Is that right? Then I suppose he's a romantic at heart, just like Cesar. So let's treasure the time we have with him.
:{{A|vo lnlq003 1 gemma 09.ogg}} '''Jemma:''' After all... You never know when the people dearest to you might... be gone.
:{{DIcon}} Don't be sad.
:{{DIcon}} The killer has been caught.
:{{A|vo lnlq003 1 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' That's right. It's all over now.
:{{A|vo lnlq003 1 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Um... Paimon doesn't really know how to comfort you, but at the very least, no one's gonna be intimidating you from now on. You can breathe easy at least, right?
:{{A|vo lnlq003 1 lynette 04.ogg}} '''Lynette:''' ...Right.
:{{A|vo lnlq003 1 lynette 05.ogg}} '''Lynette:''' Yes, you can breathe easy now, Phantom Weasel.
:{{A|vo lnlq003 1 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' See, even Lynette says— Wait, what!?
:{{A|vo lnlq003 1 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' The Phantom Weasel? Lorenzo escape? Where is he?
:{{A|vo lnlq003 1 gemma 10.ogg}} '''Jemma:''' Wh—What do you mean, "Phantom Weasel"?
:{{A|vo lnlq003 1 lynette 06.ogg}} '''Lynette:''' As Lyney once said... A performer's job is to commit fully to their role, and put on a flawless performance for their audience.
:{{A|vo lnlq003 1 lynette 07.ogg}} '''Lynette:''' But once the bag of tricks is empty, and the curtain falls, it's time to end the show. The spotlight is no place for someone with no more cards up their sleeve.
:{{A|vo lnlq003 1 lynette 08.ogg}} '''Lynette:''' It's been ten years, Jemma. Aren't you tired of the grieving widow act? I think it's time to put an end to it.
:{{A|vo lnlq003 1 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What are you talking about? Paimon doesn't like this riddle...
:{{A|vo lnlq003 1 paimon 12.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' {{Traveler}}, Paimon doesn't like where this is going... C'mon, say something!
:{{A|vo lnlq003 1 gemma 11.ogg}} '''Jemma:''' ...
:{{A|vo lnlq003 1 roberthoudin 03.ogg}} '''Robert Houdin:''' Ladies and Gentlemen! I hope you're all enjoying the performance so far!
:{{A|vo lnlq003 1 roberthoudin 04.ogg}} '''Robert Houdin:''' There will now be a brief intermission, after which Lyney will perform the most electrifying act of tonight's show — the one we've all been waiting for!
:{{A|vo lnlq003 1 roberthoudin 05.ogg}} '''Robert Houdin:''' The final performance will take place outside of the opera house, so please make your way outside in a calm and orderly fashion.
:{{A|vo lnlq003 1 lynette 09.ogg}} '''Lynette:''' The Phantom Weasel never did like public places, did they?
:{{A|vo lnlq003 1 lynette 10.ogg}} '''Lynette:''' Don't worry, this place will be quiet soon. Let's talk somewhere else for now.
----
{{Dialogue End}}
{{Quest Description|update|While you're watching the show, Lynette suddenly reveals that Jemma is the real Phantom Weasel. What's going on?}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Approach Jemma and Lynette)
:;(After a period of awkward silence between the four, Lyney approaches)
:{{A|vo lnlq003 2 lyney 01.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Dear me, this is awkward, isn't it? And unfortunately, I'm all out of gadgets, so I'm afraid I can't do any tricks to liven up the mood.
:{{A|vo lnlq003 2 lyney 02.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' This is a big mistake for a magician to make. But thankfully, I do have a backup plan... Now, who wants to hear a story?
:{{A|vo lnlq003 2 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Uh, Lyney, don't we have more important things to address right now?
:{{A|vo lnlq003 2 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Lynette accused Jemma of being the real Phantom Weasel a moment ago. What the heck's going on?
:{{A|vo lnlq003 2 lyney 03.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' All in good time. Magicians are good at guessing what people are thinking. I know the questions you want to ask... and as it happens, the story I'm about to tell might answer a few of them.
:{{A|vo lnlq003 2 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Really? Well then, let's hear it! Paimon's dying of curiosity here!
:{{A|vo lnlq003 2 lyney 04.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Let's go back to the very beginning. A decade ago, when The Phantom Weasel was terrorizing the Court of Fontaine. She never missed a target, never left a trace, and no treasure was safe from her thieving hands.
:[[File:The Truest Thing Graphic 1.png|200px]]
:{{A|vo lnlq003 2 lyney 05.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' But as her infamy grew, so did the readiness of the police, and her opportunities to act became ever fewer. Every day, she ran the risk of being exposed for who she was.
:{{A|vo lnlq003 2 lyney 06.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Of course, she could not simply take this lying down, and before long she found her ticket to freedom: She would create a scapegoat, a false Weasel to close the chapter on her behalf.
:{{A|vo lnlq003 2 lyney 07.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' After weighing her options, she set her sights on a renowned magician — Cesar. After all, magic and theft shared enough similarities for people to buy the story when the "truth" came out.
:{{A|vo lnlq003 2 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So... So then what?
:[[File:The Truest Thing Graphic 2.png|200px]]
:{{A|vo lnlq003 2 lynette 01.ogg}} '''Lynette:''' Being the master deceiver she was, The Weasel easily earned Cesar's trust. Now all that remained was to frame him for her countless crimes.
:{{A|vo lnlq003 2 lynette 02.ogg}} '''Lynette:''' But as she was considering how to make her move, she noticed Cesar's aggrieved pupil, and a new thought entered her mind: "Maybe I don't need to get my hands dirty after all"...
:[[File:The Truest Thing Graphic 3.png|200px]]
:{{A|vo lnlq003 2 lynette 03.ogg}} '''Lynette:''' At her encouragement, Lorenzo tampered with Cesar's magic box, causing him to fall to his death.
:{{A|vo lnlq003 2 lynette 04.ogg}} '''Lynette:''' Afterwards, Lorenzo seized his master's property, and The Weasel set about tarnishing Cesar's reputation. Two co-conspirators committed the perfect crime.
:{{A|vo lnlq003 2 gemma 01.ogg}} '''Jemma:''' I've gotta hand it to you, you're both exceptional storytellers. It's enough to make even me wonder whether there was really another mastermind behind all this, pulling the strings.
:{{A|vo lnlq003 2 gemma 02.ogg}} '''Jemma:''' But I just have one question. You seem to think that I am the villain in this tale. What's brought this on, Lyney? Is it something that Lorenzo said?
:{{A|vo lnlq003 2 lyney 08.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Don't worry, Lorenzo said nothing at all.
:{{A|vo lnlq003 2 lyney 09.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' But I never believed that he was The Weasel, and in fact my investigation only made me more certain of that. He was too forthcoming with his confession — as if there was something else he was trying to hide.
:{{A|vo lnlq003 2 gemma 03.ogg}} '''Jemma:''' How disappointing. So you'd sooner trust Lorenzo than me, even without a shred of evidence?
:{{A|vo lnlq003 2 lyney 10.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' A magician is an expert at playing the audience to get the result they want. And I have no doubt that you, Jemma, are equally talented in this regard.
:{{A|vo lnlq003 2 lyney 11.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' With a little help from Lorenzo, you put on a very convincing performance. The lovesick fiancée, whose devotion to her betrothed is unshakable even under threats of violence...
:{{A|vo lnlq003 2 lyney 12.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Cesar was maligned and hated by all for ten years, but you? Everyone sympathized with your plight.
:{{A|vo lnlq003 2 lyney 13.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Who would suspect for one second that the lovely young lady always seen weeping in front of Cesar's grave was actually the mastermind behind his demise? No, not that poor lady. Perish the thought!
:{{A|vo lnlq003 2 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wait, so you mean... The whole intimidation thing was just a hoax? Jemma and Lorenzo were both in on it?
:{{A|vo lnlq003 2 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' But why would Lorenzo agree to that? And why didn't he sell her out, even at the end? Instead of admitting to being The Weasel himself...
:{{A|vo lnlq003 2 lyney 14.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Yes, why indeed? Maybe Jemma herself could enlighten us on that question.
:{{A|vo lnlq003 2 gemma 04.ogg}} '''Jemma:''' Well, Lyney, if you're so confident in your version of events, then I think the answer should be obvious.
:{{A|vo lnlq003 2 gemma 05.ogg}} '''Jemma:''' Having killed Cesar with his own hands, Lorenzo was plagued by overwhelming guilt.
:{{A|vo lnlq003 2 gemma 06.ogg}} '''Jemma:''' Revealing The Phantom Weasel's true identity would serve no purpose. But if the Weasel remained free, then she could take care of Lorenzo's loved ones.
:{{A|vo lnlq003 2 lyney 15.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' An excellent answer... Though sadly, a little dull.
:{{A|vo lnlq003 2 gemma 07.ogg}} '''Jemma:''' Is that right? Well don't let me bore you. If you'd care to change the topic to something more interesting, I'd be much obliged.
:{{A|vo lnlq003 2 lyney 16.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' As a matter of fact, there's one thing I'd really like to understand.
:{{A|vo lnlq003 2 lyney 17.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Why would the real Weasel have targeted things that only have value to other people? Could you shed any light on that?
:{{A|vo lnlq003 2 gemma 08.ogg}} '''Jemma:''' Of course. After all, we're just telling stories here, aren't we?
:{{A|vo lnlq003 2 gemma 09.ogg}} '''Jemma:''' If I had to guess, I would say that the real Weasel must have had a terrible childhood.
:[[File:The Truest Thing Graphic 4.png|200px]]
:{{A|vo lnlq003 2 gemma 10.ogg}} '''Jemma:''' Left to fend for herself after her parents died young. Betrayed. Scorned. Beaten...
:{{A|vo lnlq003 2 gemma 11.ogg}} '''Jemma:''' She'd scrounge waste paper from garbage bins to draw on, using twigs and dirt for lack of ink and pen. She'd sew ugly ragdolls from whatever scrap material she could get her hands on.
:{{A|vo lnlq003 2 gemma 12.ogg}} '''Jemma:''' This was her only source of happiness in life. But it was all she needed, and she was content... until the world decided that even this was too good for her.
:{{A|vo lnlq003 2 gemma 13.ogg}} '''Jemma:''' Once again, she was betrayed, and this time everything was taken from her. She felt like life was a miry pit that dragged her further down the more she struggled to escape. At that tender age, she should have been happy... Instead, she stood in the shadows and watched with envy as all good things in the world passed her by.
:{{A|vo lnlq003 2 gemma 14.ogg}} '''Jemma:''' This was a fate too cruel for anyone to bear. Her pain became a breeding ground for dark thoughts, thoughts which festered and grew into a twisted solution to her troubles:
:{{A|vo lnlq003 2 gemma 15.ogg}} '''Jemma:''' "I detest the happiness of others in all its forms alike."
:{{A|vo lnlq003 2 gemma 16.ogg}} '''Jemma:''' "I will rob them of everything they hold to be good and true, and it will fill the void in my soul."
:{{A|vo lnlq003 2 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' That's some pretty heavy stuff...
:{{A|vo lnlq003 2 lynette 05.ogg}} '''Lynette:''' ...Now it all makes sense.
:{{A|vo lnlq003 2 gemma 17.ogg}} '''Jemma:''' Does this story satisfy you, Lyney?
:{{A|vo lnlq003 2 lyney 18.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Yes, it is quite to my tastes. Thank you for helping to clear up my confusion.
:{{DIcon}} So what was with the warning letter?
:{{A|vo lnlq003 2 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh, that's right. What drove you to write that letter, Jemma? What were you trying to achieve there?
:{{A|vo lnlq003 2 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Cause without that, none of this ever would have come to light...
:{{A|vo lnlq003 2 lyney 19.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' She didn't write the letter.
:{{A|vo lnlq003 2 gemma 18.ogg}} '''Jemma:''' After ten long years, I'd hoped that The Phantom Weasel would be consigned to the history books by now. But it seems like someone still wasn't ready to let her finally be at peace.
:{{A|vo lnlq003 2 gemma 19.ogg}} '''Jemma:''' Lyney... Or should I call you The Phantom Copycat now? You were the one who posted that letter outside the opera house. But why?
:{{A|vo lnlq003 2 lyney 20.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Very sharp, Phantom Weasel. Still as shrewd as ever.
:{{A|vo lnlq003 2 lyney 21.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Well, no need for me to be coy about it. Our goal was to clear Cesar's name.
:{{A|vo lnlq003 2 lyney 22.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' The most straightforward way to change the public's impression of Cesar was to force The Weasel to show themselves.
:{{A|vo lnlq003 2 gemma 20.ogg}} '''Jemma:''' That's it? You had no other agenda?
:{{A|vo lnlq003 2 lyney 23.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Of course we did. We made it quite clear in the letter, I believe? "I shall take from you that which you hold most dear, just as you did to me ten years ago."
:{{A|vo lnlq003 2 gemma 21.ogg}} '''Jemma:''' Ten years ago...? You mean Cesar's death? You... met him?
:{{A|vo lnlq003 2 gemma 22.ogg}} '''Jemma:''' Wait... Oh, I get it! You were those two obnoxious kids! It's been so long, and you're all grown up now... I didn't recognize you.
:{{A|vo lnlq003 2 gemma 23.ogg}} '''Jemma:''' He taught you magic back then, didn't he? For what, ten days or something? ...And you went to all this trouble... why, because you feel like you still owe him something?
:{{A|vo lnlq003 2 lyney 24.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' We remember all our debts, however great or small.
:{{A|vo lnlq003 2 lyney 25.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Ten years ago, Cesar's reputation was torn to shreds and his legacy was thrown out. Ten years on, and no one cares what the truth is anymore.
:{{A|vo lnlq003 2 lyney 26.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' But we did not forget, and so we came to find you.
:{{A|vo lnlq003 2 gemma 24.ogg}} '''Jemma:''' And? What exactly did you take from me? I'm still standing, as you can see. Lorenzo has admitted to everything — I'm free.
:{{A|vo lnlq003 2 lyney 27.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' "Free"? ...Do you really think so?
:{{A|vo lnlq003 2 lyney 28.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Cesar once told me that even though the world is filled with lies and falsehoods, we must find our own truth.
:{{A|vo lnlq003 2 lyney 29.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' I think that applies to you, too. Truth can take many forms — prized possessions with nostalgic value, fervent hopes and dreams... and irreplaceable people.
:{{A|vo lnlq003 2 lyney 30.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Life took many things from you, and those wounds never healed. When they ached unbearably in the dead of night, stealing became your way of numbing the pain.
:{{A|vo lnlq003 2 gemma 25.ogg}} '''Jemma:''' What are you trying to say?
:{{A|vo lnlq003 2 lyney 31.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' I'm saying that for the last ten years, you've been living a rather uneventful life. Perhaps that's because you've found something other than a life of crime to fill the hole?
:{{A|vo lnlq003 2 lyney 32.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Back to Lorenzo for a second: He murdered his own master, played along with your act, and took pains to make sure any suspicion would be directed towards him. But what did he have to gain from all that?
:{{A|vo lnlq003 2 lyney 33.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' He knew who you were and the things you'd done, and despite that, he was willing to give everything up for your sake. He's the reason that you haven't felt the compulsion to steal in all these years.
:{{A|vo lnlq003 2 lyney 34.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' You're more than just accomplices in murder — you're the only real friends each other has. So I think you know, deep down, that he is the only "truth" you have in your life.
:{{A|vo lnlq003 2 lyney 35.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' But that truth is gone now. And I guarantee you, you'll never see it again.
:{{A|vo lnlq003 2 gemma 26.ogg}} '''Jemma:''' ...
:{{A|vo lnlq003 2 lynette 06.ogg}} '''Lynette:''' Congratulations on your freedom, Jemma.
:{{A|vo lnlq003 2 lyney 36.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Your freedom will cost you dearly. From now on, you'll be all alone in a world full of lies and falsehoods. I do hope you'll be able to bear it — you've still got a long life ahead of you, after all.
:{{A|vo lnlq003 2 roberthoudin 01.ogg}} '''Robert Houdin:''' Gather 'round, one and all, the time has now come for the amazing Lyney to perform his final act in tonight's show!
:{{A|vo lnlq003 2 roberthoudin 02.ogg}} '''Robert Houdin:''' I'm sure you're all wondering what he has planned for the grand finale? Well, wonder no more, for the answer is... A death-defying high-altitude escape!
:{{A|vo lnlq003 2 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' A high-altitude escape!?
:{{DIcon}} Ten years ago...
:{{DIcon}} The trick that Cesar died attempting...
:{{A|vo lnlq003 2 roberthoudin 03.ogg}} '''Robert Houdin:''' I'm sure you all remember the magician Cesar. This was the very trick that led to his fatal fall, after which he was dubbed The Phantom Weasel.
:{{A|vo lnlq003 2 roberthoudin 04.ogg}} '''Robert Houdin:''' But we have now learned that Cesar was wrongly accused, and that the real Weasel has now confessed to their crimes...
:{{A|vo lnlq003 2 lyney 37.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Guess that's my cue to leave. Whew... I've been practicing this one for ages now, but I'm still a little nervous.
:{{A|vo lnlq003 2 lyney 38.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' {{Traveler}}, Paimon, I hope you enjoy the rest of the show. There may be a lot of people watching tonight, but you alone are my true witnesses.
:{{A|vo lnlq003 2 gemma 27.ogg}} '''Jemma:''' Lyney, wait.
:{{A|vo lnlq003 2 gemma 28.ogg}} '''Jemma:''' You two hid a lot from Cesar — he went to his grave without ever knowing your secrets. So what about now? Are you an open book — or are you still the same as ever?
:{{A|vo lnlq003 2 gemma 29.ogg}} '''Jemma:''' You don't have to tell lies to end up isolated and alone. One day, you'll end up exactly where I am today — maybe then you'll finally understand.
:{{A|vo lnlq003 2 lyney 39.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' You're wrong. I'm nothing like you.
:{{A|vo lnlq003 2 gemma 30.ogg}} '''Jemma:''' ...
:{{A|vo lnlq003 2 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So, uh... What are we, uh... doing now?
:{{A|vo lnlq003 2 lynette 07.ogg}} '''Lynette:''' Like Lyney said — when you're ready, let's head outside and watch the show.
:{{A|vo lnlq003 2 paimon 12.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' But what about Jemma...?
:{{A|vo lnlq003 2 lynette 08.ogg}} '''Lynette:''' She'll figure out what's best for her soon enough. Oh — and if you'd like to see Lyney after the show... You know where he'll be. The usual haunt.
:{{A|vo lnlq003 2 paimon 13.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Alright, well let's go and watch Lyney's finale then! This trick's a pretty dangerous one... but he should be able to pull it off, right?

;(Talk to Jemma, optional)
:{{A|vo dialog lnlq003 gemma 01.ogg}} '''Jemma:''' What is my truth...?
:{{A|vo dialog lnlq003 gemma 02.ogg}} '''Jemma:''' Sometimes, I think I'm like a gambling addict... All I care about is winning, and it doesn't matter what's at stake.
:{{A|vo dialog lnlq003 gemma 03.ogg}} '''Jemma:''' By the time I come to my senses, I'm left with nothing. Oh, if I had my time again...

;(Talk to Lynette, optional)
:{{A|vo dialog lnlq003 lynette 01.ogg}} '''Lynette:''' Magicians are not like thieves.
:{{A|vo dialog lnlq003 lynette 02.ogg}} '''Lynette:''' Thieves only tear things apart. But good-hearted magicians... They put things back together.

:{{A|vo lnlq003 3 janet 01.ogg}} '''Janet:''' Did you see that? One minute he was falling... And the next, he turned into flowers!
:{{A|vo lnlq003 3 randolf 01.ogg}} '''Randolf:''' How could he possibly have done that?
:{{A|vo lnlq003 3 olivia 01.ogg}} '''Olivia:''' How mysterious! I didn't blink once, he just... vanished, right in front of my eyes!
:{{A|vo lnlq003 3 charlotte 01.ogg}} '''Charlotte:''' What a heart-stopping magic show! This was really worth the trip.
:{{A|vo lnlq003 3 charlotte 02.ogg}} '''Charlotte:''' Cesar's name has finally been cleared, and Fontaine's new star magician, Lyney, has fulfilled a wish on his behalf... Ah, I couldn't ask for a better grand finale. It will make a great headline for The Steambird tomorrow, even if I do say so myself!
:{{A|vo lnlq003 3 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Whew... Looks like everyone really loved Lyney's grand finale!
:{{DIcon}} Even though they don't know the full story...
:{{A|vo lnlq003 3 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Paimon doesn't see Lyney anywhere. Where'd he go?
:{{A|vo lnlq003 3 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, Lynette said he'd be waiting for us at the "usual haunt"... But, um... Where is that?
:{{DIcon}} The cemetery...?
:{{A|vo lnlq003 3 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, you mean the one where Cesar's buried?
:{{A|vo lnlq003 3 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yeah, that's probably it. This whole magic show kinda seemed like Lyney's way of saying goodbye to Cesar. So it makes sense that that's where he'd be afterward.
:{{A|vo lnlq003 3 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Alright, let's go look for him there!
{{Dialogue End}}

{{Quest Description|update|At the place where Cesar fell to his death, Lyney performed the same trick that the deceased magician failed to complete ten years ago. You wonder what's on Lyney mind right now...}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Approach Lyney at Cesar's grave)
:{{A|vo lnlq003 4 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Lyney, there you are!
:{{A|vo lnlq003 4 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Are you alright? Paimon was scared to death when the chain broke... Paimon was sure something had gone horribly wrong.
:{{A|vo lnlq003 4 lyney 01.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Magic is a performance art. A magician has to get creative to keep the audience on tenterhooks — that's our job. So I tweaked Cesar's original setup a little to keep it fresh.
:{{A|vo lnlq003 4 lyney 02.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' I was honestly a little nervous during the live performance. The thought of falling, suddenly feeling weightless, seeing the sky and the ground spinning and spinning...
:{{A|vo lnlq003 4 lyney 03.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Sometimes, I can't help but wonder what Cesar thought in those final moments.
:{{A|vo lnlq003 4 lyney 04.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Did he regret taking Jemma and Lorenzo on? Or... Did he believe that it was his own slip-up right until the end?
:{{A|vo lnlq003 4 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Y'know... Paimon's been wanting to ask you about something ever since we were in Cesar's workshop. You learned magic from Cesar once, didn't you? When was that?
:{{A|vo lnlq003 4 lyney 05.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' After I joined the House of the Hearth. To be honest, Lynette and I had an agenda when we approached him.
:{{DIcon}} An agenda?
:{{A|vo lnlq003 4 lyney 06.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' I told you about my past before, remember? As a young boy, I survived by secretly learning magic from street performers. I'd watch their tricks and try to figure out how they were done.
:{{A|vo lnlq003 4 lyney 07.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' But I quickly realized that observation alone could only get me so far. What I saw was the polished final performance, but the rigorous training they put in behind the scenes remained invisible to me.
:{{A|vo lnlq003 4 lyney 08.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' I needed to learn how to improve my sleight of hand, hone my misdirection skills, and make niftier props...
:{{A|vo lnlq003 4 lyney 09.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' We were gifted enough that we'd made some progress by ourselves. But without proper guidance from a professional magician, we quickly plateaued.
:{{A|vo lnlq003 4 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So that's why you sought Cesar out?
:{{A|vo lnlq003 4 lyney 10.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Yes. We figured there was no harm in asking — but it took us by surprise that he was so willing to teach us.
:{{A|vo lnlq003 4 lyney 11.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' In all, we only spent ten short days together, but he was very good to us. By contrast, we hid so many things from him...
:{{A|vo lnlq003 4 lyney 12.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' For instance, when he asked why I wanted to learn magic... I answered "It's my passion."
:{{A|vo lnlq003 4 lyney 13.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' But in truth, there was already a lot more to the story by then. After being taken in by an aristocrat for our magic talent, then betrayed soon after... This was no longer about me doing what I loved.
:{{A|vo lnlq003 4 lyney 14.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' What amazed me was how the lie escaped my lips even as I was hesitating over whether to tell him the truth.
:{{A|vo lnlq003 4 lyney 15.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Trust is a beautiful thing. Sadly, I'd forgotten how to trust by then.
:{{A|vo lnlq003 4 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Lyney...
:{{DIcon}} I don't blame you.
:{{DIcon}} That wasn't your fault.
:{{A|vo lnlq003 4 lyney 16.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Still worried about the way I feel? You really are a gentle soul, aren't you?
:{{A|vo lnlq003 4 lyney 17.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' But don't worry, I'm used to it now. From the mansions of the elite to the House of the Hearth, lies and selfishness have followed me and Lynette everywhere we go.
:{{A|vo lnlq003 4 lyney 18.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' After Cesar went on tour, we became busy with our missions. The next we heard of him was that he'd fallen to his death and was now declared to be The Phantom Weasel...
:{{A|vo lnlq003 4 lyney 19.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' That night, I remembered his smile... But as I lay there, I didn't know what to say to him.
:{{A|vo lnlq003 4 lyney 20.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' To keep secrets is to put up walls. The longer you keep them up, the less you let people in. Then one day, you look around and realize your life is like an empty auditorium after a show — full of seats once occupied by all the people who left... But I guess that's the price we have to pay.
:{{A|vo lnlq003 4 lyney 21.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' You only realize how much someone really meant to you when you lose them completely. That's why I was so confident this would hurt Jemma... because I've felt it for myself.
:{{DIcon}} Don't be sad.
:{{DIcon}} We're in your "auditorium," and we're not going anywhere.
:{{A|vo lnlq003 4 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yeah. Cheer up, Lyney.
:{{A|vo lnlq003 4 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' We've had to say our fair share of goodbyes during our journey, too... But whatever happens, Paimon always believes in what tomorrow brings.
:{{A|vo lnlq003 4 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Delicious food, fun toys, and {{Traveler}} by my side... Paimon just needs to focus on things like this, and all the unhappy stuff goes right out the window.
:{{A|vo lnlq003 4 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Y'know, {{Traveler}}... Doesn't that kinda make you Paimon's "truth"?
:{{A|vo lnlq003 4 lyney 22.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Exactly. It's the same for me and Lynette — we are the truest thing each other has in the world, and nothing can replace that.
:{{A|vo lnlq003 4 lyney 23.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Life has taken plenty from us, like it did from Jemma. But at least it left us with each other. That's what gave us the strength to get through the darkest days.
:{{A|vo lnlq003 4 lyney 24.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' That's why the darkness never consumed me, and why it never will. Maybe we live in the shadows too, but we remember every precious ray of light that shines through.
:{{A|vo lnlq003 4 lyney 25.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Alright, time to lighten this conversation up a little! What did you think of the show tonight? Were you happy with it?
:{{A|vo lnlq003 4 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' It was amazing! Paimon just wishes we hadn't been so distracted with the Jemma situation... We spent most of our time in the opera house just talking, and pretty much missed the entire first half of the show.
:{{A|vo lnlq003 4 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Um, Lyney... Could you do just one more trick for us?
:{{A|vo lnlq003 4 lyney 26.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Whoa, that's a bit of a tall order I'm afraid. The show's just finished, so my sleeves are decidedly card-free right now...
:{{A|vo lnlq003 4 paimon 12.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Aw, c'mon... Surely you can think of something! The Lyney Paimon knows can do anything if he puts his mind to it!
:{{A|vo lnlq003 4 lyney 27.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Oh, alright then. I'll give it a go — but only because it's you.
:{{A|vo lnlq003 4 lyney 28.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Watch closely. I have a flower in my hand...
:{{A|vo lnlq003 4 paimon 13.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You liar! There's nothing in your hand! We ain't going along with this!
:{{A|vo lnlq003 4 lyney 29.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Huh? My goodness, you're right! But I could've sworn I brought one here with me... Okay, try this. Count down with me: Three, two, one...
:{{A|vo lnlq003 4 paimon 14.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Three, two, one!
:{{A|vo lnlq003 4 lyney 30.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Now have another look around — maybe the flower's appeared somewhere else.
:;(A Rainbow Rose has appeared on the Traveler's chest)
:{{A|vo lnlq003 4 paimon 15.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Really? Let's see...
:{{DIcon}} ...
:{{A|vo lnlq003 4 paimon 16.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wow, there it is! This is a different flower from the one last time, right? This one's called... oh yeah, a Rainbow Rose!
:{{A|vo lnlq003 4 paimon 17.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' But more importantly — Paimon has to know how the trick is done! Please, Lyney, pretty please?
:{{A|vo lnlq003 4 lyney 31.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Well, if you want to learn magic, you'll have to start by addressing me as "Teacher"...
:{{A|vo lnlq003 4 paimon 18.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Uhh... Fine, pleeease, Teacher, please!
:{{A|vo lnlq003 4 lyney 32.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' *sigh* Since you asked so nicely... I'll share one little tip with you. Namely, the student of magic cannot solely rely on others being prepared to reveal their secrets. You have to observe, think, and find the answers for yourself.
:{{A|vo lnlq003 4 paimon 19.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' ...Is that it!?
:{{A|vo lnlq003 4 lyney 33.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Ah, look at the time — we shouldn't linger here too long. Thanks again for coming to see my show. I bid you both good night!
:{{A|vo lnlq003 4 lyney 34.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' ...I look forward to seeing you again.
:{{A|vo lnlq003 4 paimon 20.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Alright, fine... See ya!
:{{A|vo lnlq003 4 paimon 21.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Shall we head back now too?
:{{A|vo lnlq003 4 paimon 22.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hehe, Paimon can't wait to read The Steambird tomorrow. Paimon bets Lyney and Cesar will be plastered all over it!
:{{A|vo lnlq003 4 paimon 23.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Let's head to The Steambird's offices tomorrow morning and see what we can find out!
:;(Obtain {{Item|"Delightful Encounter"}})
{{Dialogue End}}

{{Quest Description|As you go off to send your well-wishes, Ayato gradually realizes that there is some plot at play behind this wedding. According to his reasoning, you are rapidly approaching the truth...}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Investigate the situation inside the cave)
:{{A|vo lrlq002 1 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What are you doing? Release Shinnojou this instant!
:{{A|vo lrlq002 1 ayato 01.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' Stop this at once.
:{{A|vo lrlq002 1 kubo 01.ogg}} '''[[Kubo]]:''' It's the [[Yashiro Commission]]er...
:{{A|vo lrlq002 1 kubo 02.ogg}} '''Kubo:''' Hmph! Well, we take orders from our Master, no one else.
:{{A|vo lrlq002 1 ayato 02.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' Really... Then, please excuse me!

;(After defeating the guards)
:{{A|vo lrlq002 2 kubo 01.ogg}} '''Kubo:''' Blast! Let's go!
:{{A|vo lrlq002 2 kubo 02.ogg}} '''Kubo:''' We must report to Master right away!
:{{A|vo lrlq002 2 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hey! Get back here!
:{{A|vo lrlq002 2 ayato 01.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' No need to follow them.
:{{A|vo lrlq002 2 ayato 02.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' We need bait to catch the fish anyway. Leave them be.
:{{A|vo lrlq002 2 ayato 03.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' I think I saw a key fall to the ground during the fight. Let's free Shinnojou first.
:{{A|vo lrlq002 2 ayato 04.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' But... in all the chaos, it must have been kicked to one side. Hmm, where did it end up?
;(A tanuki runs past)
:{{A|vo lrlq002 2 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What the...? It's a tanuki! ...Oh, don't tell Paimon that the tanuki took it!
:{{A|vo lrlq002 2 ayato 05.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' Let's follow it and see.

;(Talk to Shinnojou)
:{{A|vo dialog lrlq002 shinnojou 01.ogg}} '''Shinnojou:''' Oh, thank the gods! You're here! Please, help me!

----
;(Look for the key that the bake-danuki made off with)

;(Use the key to free Shinnojou)
:{{A|vo lrlq002 4 shinnojou 01.ogg}} '''Shinnojou:''' Thank you, thank you...
:{{A|vo lrlq002 4 shinnojou 02.ogg}} '''Shinnojou:''' It was terrifying... They said they were gonna throw the cage into the sea with me still inside...
:{{A|vo lrlq002 4 shinnojou 03.ogg}} '''Shinnojou:''' Oh... Wait, you have to listen to me! [[Hiiragi Chisato|Lady Chisato]]'s wedding, they... It's all part of a scheme! Someone's trying to use the wedding for their own ends!
:{{A|vo lrlq002 4 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Calm down, Shinnojou. It's okay. We know about all that.
:{{A|vo lrlq002 4 shinnojou 04.ogg}} '''Shinnojou:''' ...Huh?
:{{A|vo lrlq002 4 ayato 01.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' Our suspicions were roused to this possibility, and so far, everything is unfolding rather as we expected.
:{{A|vo lrlq002 4 ayato 02.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' Those behind this plan are not going to give up easily. Their next move is imminent. We must devise sufficient countermeasures.
:{{A|vo lrlq002 4 shinnojou 05.ogg}} '''Shinnojou:''' Yashiro Commissioner, you're personally going to take action?
:{{A|vo lrlq002 4 ayato 03.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' This situation has consequences for the whole [[Tri-Commission]], and the stability of all of Inazuma is at stake. My hitherto-neutral stance ends now.
:{{A|vo lrlq002 4 ayato 04.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' The [[Raiden Shogun|Almighty Shogun]] has always despised these pathetic power games. As a Commissioner, I am a servant of the Shogun, and it is therefore my duty to handle these tiresome matters on her behalf.
:{{A|vo lrlq002 4 shinnojou 06.ogg}} '''Shinnojou:''' Hmm... That's true...
:{{A|vo lrlq002 4 ayato 05.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' Shinnojou, don't return to your post yet. Find somewhere safe and stay hidden.
:{{A|vo lrlq002 4 ayato 06.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' Traveler, Paimon. Let's get out of here.
:{{Black Screen|A short while after leaving...}}
:{{A|vo lrlq002 4 matsuura 01.ogg}} '''[[Matsuura]]:''' Well, if it isn't the Yashiro Commissioner.
:{{A|vo lrlq002 4 matsuura 02.ogg}} '''Matsuura:''' I hear you showed up here with no explanation and attacked my men.
:{{A|vo lrlq002 4 matsuura 03.ogg}} '''Matsuura:''' You wouldn't happen to be carrying out some sort of secret mission, now, would you?
:{{A|vo lrlq002 4 ayato 07.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' I heard that someone was taking the law into their own hands. As a responsible official of Inazuma, I could not in good conscience stand idly by.
:{{A|vo lrlq002 4 ayato 08.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' Shinnojou may be your retainer, but the law does not grant you the right to abuse him.
:{{A|vo lrlq002 4 matsuura 04.ogg}} '''Matsuura:''' Abuse? Nonsense! I was just teaching him a lesson.
:{{A|vo lrlq002 4 matsuura 05.ogg}} '''Matsuura:''' Out of nowhere, a low-ranking officer decides to barge in on Lady Hiiragi and start spurting out the most absurd and insulting nonsense one can imagine... A truly egregious loss of decorum!
:{{A|vo lrlq002 4 matsuura 06.ogg}} '''Matsuura:''' I daresay, the poor Lady was terrified.
:{{A|vo lrlq002 4 ayato 09.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' So you're saying that you know absolutely nothing of the reasons for his actions? Because otherwise, why would you describe it as "out of nowhere"?
:{{A|vo lrlq002 4 matsuura 07.ogg}} '''Matsuura:''' Two people from two different clans are getting married, that's all there is to it, and yet this young gentleman took it upon himself to fabricate a nonsensical disaster story around it. How should I know what he was thinking?
:{{A|vo lrlq002 4 matsuura 08.ogg}} '''Matsuura:''' Even if she marries into the [[Kujou Clan]], Lady Hiiragi will always be the daughter of the [[Hiiragi Clan]] and the most distinguished member of the Kanjou Commission.
:{{A|vo lrlq002 4 matsuura 09.ogg}} '''Matsuura:''' We are, and always will be, her loyal assistants. It's our duty to see that she never has to worry about anything.
:{{A|vo lrlq002 4 matsuura 10.ogg}} '''Matsuura:''' Loyalty and duty are our guiding principles. Not only did this guard show no regard for either, he went out of his way to upset our Lady. How could one do such a thing?
:{{A|vo lrlq002 4 matsuura 11.ogg}} '''Matsuura:''' Even if we put it down to a rare moment of impulsivity, I have to say I'm surprised to see one of such noble standing as yourself rushing to his defense.
:{{A|vo lrlq002 4 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Darn it! This guy is good... Annoyingly good!
:{{DIcon}} (He's a slimeball.)
:{{DIcon}} (But he's also difficult to argue against...)
:{{A|vo lrlq002 4 ayato 10.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' Funny, I'm suddenly reminded of an anecdote I'd like to share with you. There's not been a dull moment since I took up my post in the Yashiro Commission. Every day, I've been exposed to new and fascinating things.
:{{A|vo lrlq002 4 ayato 11.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' For instance, a merchant from abroad once told me about a curious kind of bird with the most extraordinarily long tongue. So long, in fact, that you can tie two knots in the portion of it that extends out of its beak.
:{{A|vo lrlq002 4 ayato 12.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' I'm sure someone as erudite as yourself should be able to guess what people do with these unusual avians?
:{{A|vo lrlq002 4 matsuura 12.ogg}} '''Matsuura:''' Uh... keep them as pets?
:{{A|vo lrlq002 4 ayato 13.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' Haha, you'd think, wouldn't you? But there's a catch. You see, this bird is of no use to humans whatsoever, and certainly doesn't make a suitable pet. If you catch one, the best thing you can do is actually cut its tongue off and throw it out of the window.
:{{A|vo lrlq002 4 ayato 14.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' The reason they give is this: "The longest tongue has the most to say, but don't be deceived as it chirps away... lest the song it sings lead you astray."
:{{A|vo lrlq002 4 matsuura 13.ogg}} '''Matsuura:''' You...! I say, Yashiro Commissioner, are you here simply to mock the Kanjou Commission?
:{{A|vo lrlq002 4 ayato 15.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' Far from it. In my mind, the Kanjou Commission is made up of honorable individuals, upright and forthright, conscientious and loyal.
:{{A|vo lrlq002 4 ayato 16.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' It is unbecoming of such people to resort to lies, deception, and filibustering all as part of a plan to remove Lady Hiiragi from her position in the Kanjou Commission.
:{{A|vo lrlq002 4 matsuura 14.ogg}} '''Matsuura:''' Yashiro Commissioner, please don't make accusations without any evidence.
:{{A|vo lrlq002 4 ayato 17.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' The evidence is standing right in front of me, is it not? I have a credible witness who can confirm you were quick to try and make him disappear as soon as he said something that you did not like.
:{{A|vo lrlq002 4 ayato 18.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' Dear me, I can't believe the grand Matsuura Clan is now represented by someone with less of a sense of loyalty than even an ordinary servant.
:{{A|vo lrlq002 4 ayato 19.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' You studied hard and took a government position, only to make it to where you are now just to play these petty power games behind the scenes... I'm not sure whether it's because you're smart enough to play the system, or too foolish to know any better?
:{{A|vo lrlq002 4 ayato 20.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' In your years of service to the Shogun, not only have you managed to glean nothing good from the people around you, you have also let yourself be blinded by self-interest... And now you have ruined your once-bright future.
:{{A|vo lrlq002 4 ayato 21.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' I'm not angry, Mr Matsuura... I just feel sorry for you.
:{{A|vo lrlq002 4 matsuura 15.ogg}} '''Matsuura:''' ...Hahaha! Is that right? Then tell me, if you're so bright, what exactly do you think you can do to me!?
:{{A|vo lrlq002 4 matsuura 16.ogg}} '''Matsuura:''' This is at most a Kanjou Commission issue. We'll handle this amongst ourselves.
:{{A|vo lrlq002 4 matsuura 17.ogg}} '''Matsuura:''' You are reaching rather outside of your bounds, Yashiro Commissioner, if you seek to involve yourself in other clans' affairs... Might I be so bold, then, as to question your motives in doing so?
:{{A|vo lrlq002 4 matsuura 18.ogg}} '''Matsuura:''' I think you are simply opposed to an alliance between the Kanjou Commission and [[Tenryou Commission]], because the new balance of power in the Tri-Commission would be a threat to you personally.
:{{A|vo lrlq002 4 matsuura 19.ogg}} '''Matsuura:''' So you come here with an elaborate excuse to try and break up this marriage!
:{{A|vo lrlq002 4 ayato 22.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' Hm. So, that's how you view it. Well, I have to admit, you clearly are far more talented than I at monitoring the power balance within the Tri-Commission.
:{{A|vo lrlq002 4 matsuura 20.ogg}} '''Matsuura:''' Let me be crystal clear. This wedding is going to happen, and nothing is going to change that.
:{{A|vo lrlq002 4 matsuura 21.ogg}} '''Matsuura:''' The notices have already been sent out. All of [[Inazuma City]] knows about it now!
:{{A|vo lrlq002 4 matsuura 22.ogg}} '''Matsuura:''' Most of the public weren't aware that Kujou Kamaji and Hiiragi Chisato were courting, but you can bet it's all anybody's talking about now.
:{{A|vo lrlq002 4 matsuura 23.ogg}} '''Matsuura:''' Once the notices go out, that's it! The wedding is a sure thing, even if it hasn't happened just yet!
:{{A|vo lrlq002 4 ayato 23.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' Hm. I see. It seems like I was wrong.
:{{A|vo lrlq002 4 matsuura 24.ogg}} '''Matsuura:''' Hah! So suddenly we see eye to eye?
:{{A|vo lrlq002 4 ayato 24.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' I had expected you to at least be smarter than most. But it seems that I was gravely mistaken.
:{{A|vo lrlq002 4 matsuura 25.ogg}} '''Matsuura:''' Kamisato Ayato! You...! How dare you!
:{{A|vo lrlq002 4 ayato 25.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' You've made your move. Now, I suppose it's time I made mine.
:{{A|vo lrlq002 4 matsuura 26.ogg}} '''Matsuura:''' ...What do you mean?
:{{A|vo lrlq002 4 ayato 26.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' Do you seriously think this marriage will bring the Kanjou Commission and the Tenryou Commission together?
:{{A|vo lrlq002 4 ayato 27.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' Isn't it at all possible that the Kanjou Commission becomes marginalized as a consequence of this union?
:{{A|vo lrlq002 4 matsuura 27.ogg}} '''Matsuura:''' ...Hmm?
:{{A|vo lrlq002 4 ayato 28.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' Goodness me. Well, I've learned a great deal from talking to you. That will be all for now. If you would excuse me, I shall take my leave.

;(After leaving)
:{{A|vo lrlq002 4 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hey, hey! What was all that? Paimon didn't follow at all!
:{{A|vo lrlq002 4 ayato 29.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' They had their scheme, but fortunately I was prepared. As I said, they ended up coming out from the shadows and revealing themselves.
:{{A|vo lrlq002 4 ayato 30.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' Let's see how things are in Inazuma City. Then I'll take you through the details of my plan.
{{Dialogue End}}

;(Talk to Kujou Kamaji)
:{{A|vo lrlq002 10 kujoukamaji 01.ogg}} '''Kujou Kamaji:''' Welcome. I just heard that the news of my wedding has been officially announced.
:{{A|vo lrlq002 10 kujoukamaji 02.ogg}} '''Kujou Kamaji:''' It seems so sudden... I wasn't ready yet.
:{{A|vo lrlq002 10 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yeah, about that... It's kinda complicated...
:{{Black Screen|You briefly explain the situation to Kujou Kamaji...}}
:{{A|vo lrlq002 10 kujoukamaji 03.ogg}} '''Kujou Kamaji:''' I see... So someone's trying to take advantage of our marriage...
:{{A|vo lrlq002 10 ayato 01.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' If you proceed with the wedding, the repercussions for you are likely to be minimal. But we must take Lady Hiiragi's situation into consideration.
:{{A|vo lrlq002 10 kujoukamaji 04.ogg}} '''Kujou Kamaji:''' I've previously considered this possibility. But in the end, we are getting married for true love, and I've promised to her that I'll do everything in my power to protect her.
:{{A|vo lrlq002 10 ayato 02.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' I understand where you're coming from, but to be frank, she should not need your protection.
:{{A|vo lrlq002 10 ayato 03.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' Or to put it another way, you have tacitly admitted that Lady Hiiragi will need your help to get through the hard times ahead, which perhaps suggests that, deep down, you realize all she stands to lose.
:{{A|vo lrlq002 10 kujoukamaji 05.ogg}} '''Kujou Kamaji:''' I...
:{{A|vo lrlq002 10 ayato 04.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' I don't mean to criticize you. It is natural to want to protect our loved ones. You're an intelligent and gentle person, and I'm sure you would have been able to think about this more objectively were you not so emotionally involved in the situation.
:{{A|vo lrlq002 10 ayato 05.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' I'm sure you admire Lady Hiiragi for being the independent, gentle, resilient, and strong-willed person she is.
:{{A|vo lrlq002 10 ayato 06.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' For the sake of marrying you, this wonderful woman will become someone who has to depend on you for the rest of her life.
:{{A|vo lrlq002 10 ayato 07.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' Are you really okay with that?
:{{A|vo lrlq002 10 kujoukamaji 06.ogg}} '''Kujou Kamaji:''' ...
:{{A|vo lrlq002 10 kujoukamaji 07.ogg}} '''Kujou Kamaji:''' I love her with all my heart and would do anything to make her happy...
:{{A|vo lrlq002 10 kujoukamaji 08.ogg}} '''Kujou Kamaji:''' ...That's why I cannot abide to see her suffer or be manipulated by other people.
:{{A|vo lrlq002 10 kujoukamaji 09.ogg}} '''Kujou Kamaji:''' Yashiro Commissioner, you're right... It was naive and selfish of me to take things this far.
:{{A|vo lrlq002 10 kujoukamaji 10.ogg}} '''Kujou Kamaji:''' But it's too late now, isn't it? There are notices everywhere...
:{{A|vo lrlq002 10 ayato 08.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' I have a plan. But... it needs a villain.
:{{A|vo lrlq002 10 ayato 09.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' Sir Kujou, in order for my plan to work, you and I must both play the role of antagonists. But it is not without its risks.
:{{A|vo lrlq002 10 ayato 10.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' Are you willing to help?
:{{A|vo lrlq002 10 kujoukamaji 11.ogg}} '''Kujou Kamaji:''' If there's a way to salvage this, then let's hear it.
:{{A|vo lrlq002 10 ayato 11.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' I've told the people at the Kanjou Commission that the marriage isn't going to unify the Kanjou Commission and the Tenryou Commission. On the contrary, it's a terrible idea that will marginalize the Kanjou Commission.
:{{A|vo lrlq002 10 ayato 12.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' The context for this is that they are planning to use this marriage to bring down the Hiiragi Clan, and the key to their success is coming up against no resistance to the marriage from the Tenryou Commission.
:{{A|vo lrlq002 10 ayato 13.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' But what if we were to imagine for a moment that since the affairs of the [[Vision Hunt Decree]], the Tenryou Commission has been planning to make a move against the weakened Kanjou Commission...
:{{A|vo lrlq002 10 ayato 14.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' The only reason you have been hesitant to act since taking over the Tenryou Commission is because you care about Lady Hiiragi's feelings.
:{{A|vo lrlq002 10 ayato 15.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' And so, your plan is to liaise with the Yashiro Commission to marry her and bring her out of the Kanjou Commission as soon as possible.
:{{A|vo lrlq002 10 ayato 16.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' Once that is achieved, as the person in charge of the Tenryou Commission, you no longer have any reason to hesitate.
:{{A|vo lrlq002 10 kujoukamaji 12.ogg}} '''Kujou Kamaji:''' I see! This is an ingenious plan, and takes advantage of the situation perfectly...
:{{DIcon}} This will make Hiiragi Chisato indispensable.
:{{A|vo lrlq002 10 ayato 17.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' Exactly. Our purpose is to change Lady Hiiragi's position from an unnecessary burden to an indispensable asset.
:{{A|vo lrlq002 10 ayato 18.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' By doing so, we can even strengthen her position in the Kanjou Commission.
:{{A|vo lrlq002 10 ayato 19.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' Once our adversaries realize how the network of connections behind the scenes really looks, they'll do their utmost to stop this wedding from happening.
:{{A|vo lrlq002 10 ayato 20.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' Then, we simply leave them to clear up the mess they've created.
:{{A|vo lrlq002 10 kujoukamaji 13.ogg}} '''Kujou Kamaji:''' Got it.
:{{A|vo lrlq002 10 paimon 02a.ogg}} {{A|vo lrlq002 10 paimon 02b.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ugh... So the network of connections... Ah, this is all way too complicated for Paimon! Can you just tell us what you need us to do?
:{{A|vo lrlq002 10 ayato 21.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' We have to make sure that the behind-the-scenes story comes to the attention of our dear friends in the Kanjou Commission.
:{{A|vo lrlq002 10 ayato 22.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' Matsuura, with whom I spoke earlier, will now be fearing the worst. No doubt he'll be on the lookout for the first sign of a crisis.
:{{A|vo lrlq002 10 ayato 23.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' In that case, he will almost certainly have placed informants throughout Inazuma City. What we need to do is to use these informants as a breeding ground for our fake intel.
:{{A|vo lrlq002 10 ayato 24.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' Sir Kujou, there are certain things that I need you to attend to personally.
:{{Black Screen|Kamisato Ayato explains the details of his plan to Kujou Kamaji. A while later...}}
:{{A|vo lrlq002 10 ayato 25.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' It's almost time. My ninja has located one of the informants. Let's go and see if he'll take the bait.

'''The Truth of What Was''' is the fourth part of {{Quest|The Warmth of Lies}}.

==Steps==
# Take a look around the Court of Fontaine
# Go to the place you agreed upon with Sigewinne
# Talk to Sigewinne

==Dialogue==
{{Quest Description|The many-layered mysterious case caused by cosmetics has now been fully solved, and after Sigewinne finishes helping the [[Marechaussee Phantom]] wind up the case, she prepares to tell you a story about the past...}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Approach the group)
:{{A|vo sgwlq004 1 calcagni 01.ogg}} '''Calcagni:''' The wait is over, everyone! The sale of our new skincare product, Romaritime Essence, will now begin!
:{{A|vo sgwlq004 1 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Another skincare promotion? And it's selling as fast as last time! Wonder what people would think if they knew what was in that last batch...
:{{A|vo sgwlq004 1 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, Sigewinne's here too!
:{{A|vo sgwlq004 1 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hey, Sigewinne!
:{{A|vo sgwlq004 1 sigewinne 01.ogg}} '''Sigewinne:''' Oh, {{Traveler}}, Paimon, hello! I hope you two got a good rest yesterday after all your hard work?
:{{A|vo sgwlq004 1 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Of course! Nurse's orders, right? ...Anyway, are you here to take notes for your next article?
:{{A|vo sgwlq004 1 sigewinne 02.ogg}} '''Sigewinne:''' Actually, I'm mostly here to help [[Morgane|Officer Morgane]] wrap up yesterday's case.
:{{A|vo sgwlq004 1 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ah, that reminds Paimon... That stuff sold like crazy, didn't it! Is it gonna cause huge problems?
:{{A|vo sgwlq004 1 sigewinne 03.ogg}} '''Sigewinne:''' Nope, there's nothing to worry about. Unless modified, Butterfly Dew is an excellent skincare product that's completely safe to use.
:{{A|vo sgwlq004 1 sigewinne 04.ogg}} '''Sigewinne:''' Besides, officers have already retrieved all Butterfly Dew purchased on the market. Now, it's just a matter of disposal.
:{{A|vo sgwlq004 1 sigewinne 05.ogg}} '''Sigewinne:''' After consulting Monsieur Neuvillette, I came up with a way to neutralize any harmful effects, so it'll evaporate naturally without polluting the water or soil.
:{{A|vo sgwlq004 1 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wow! It's Sigewinne to the rescue again!
:{{A|vo sgwlq004 1 morgane 01.ogg}} '''Morgane:''' Thank you for serving as our consultant, Head Nurse. All the Butterfly Dew we recovered has been disposed of according to your instructions.
:{{A|vo sgwlq004 1 sigewinne 06.ogg}} '''Sigewinne:''' Great. Good job, everyone.
:{{A|vo sgwlq004 1 morgane 02.ogg}} '''Morgane:''' Also, you mentioned you wanted a copy of [[Rawat]]'s interrogation records... Well, technically Potton's records... Anyway, I have them with me. Here.
:{{A|vo sgwlq004 1 morgane 03.ogg}} '''Morgane:''' After he saw his mother for the last time, it was like all his mental defenses came crashing down. He put up no resistance during the interrogation, and answered all our questions. We learned a lot.
:{{A|vo sgwlq004 1 morgane 04.ogg}} '''Morgane:''' Apparently, the formula was something he discovered by chance while helping the criminal gang produce [[Sinthe]]. Later, he came up with the idea to dilute it and use the resulting substance as a skincare product.
:{{A|vo sgwlq004 1 morgane 05.ogg}} '''Morgane:''' Their supplier was [[Vacher]] — but you could also argue that they were the ones doing him a favor. His operation helped Vacher's gang dispose of an enormous amount of evidence.
:{{A|vo sgwlq004 1 morgane 06.ogg}} '''Morgane:''' It made for a seamless collaboration. One man's trash was another man's treasure, and there were no loose ends. It's no wonder we never noticed what Potton's gang was up to.
:{{A|vo sgwlq004 1 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Vacher again, huh... Is there still no end to the harm he caused?
:{{A|vo sgwlq004 1 morgane 07.ogg}} '''Morgane:''' Make no mistake, the crimes of Vacher and his accomplices will come to an end. It's only a matter of time.
:{{A|vo sgwlq004 1 morgane 08.ogg}} '''Morgane:''' Since the flood cut off their supply of [[Primordial Seawater]], they've been forced to resort to riskier methods — like using their private reserve to attack people on the street. Naturally, those attempts all ended in failure.
:{{A|vo sgwlq004 1 morgane 09.ogg}} '''Morgane:''' After receiving numerous reports, we were able to zero in on the gang and eventually round them up.
:{{A|vo sgwlq004 1 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' That sounds more like it!
:{{A|vo sgwlq004 1 morgane 10.ogg}} '''Morgane:''' Based on what he told us in his confession, we pretty much had him backed into a corner, even though he made a point of distancing himself from the gang while disguised as Rawat.
:{{A|vo sgwlq004 1 morgane 11.ogg}} '''Morgane:''' He tried to throw us off his tail by reporting his accomplices, giving him enough time to transform back into Potton and see his mother one last time.
:{{A|vo sgwlq004 1 morgane 12.ogg}} '''Morgane:''' But, there was one thing he hadn't anticipated... Even though "Potton" had been missing for a long time, we were very much still on the lookout for him. So the moment he appeared in public after changing back to his original appearance, we caught him.
:{{A|vo sgwlq004 1 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So he tried this once before, huh? Guess he really did want his mother to see him again. But in the end...
:{{A|vo sgwlq004 1 sigewinne 07.ogg}} '''Sigewinne:''' ...Looking at the interrogation records, it seems like he spent the first sum of money he earned as Rawat on his mother's treatment.
:{{A|vo sgwlq004 1 morgane 13.ogg}} '''Morgane:''' Yes, which is why I suspect that his initial motive for using the potion was not personal greed, but a desire to become somebody who had the power to save her.
:{{A|vo sgwlq004 1 morgane 14.ogg}} '''Morgane:''' Even so, he went too far. In the end, he got what he deserved.
:{{A|vo sgwlq004 1 sigewinne 08.ogg}} '''Sigewinne:''' I understand. Thank you for bringing me these records.
:{{A|vo sgwlq004 1 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Why did you want them, anyway?
:{{A|vo sgwlq004 1 sigewinne 09.ogg}} '''Sigewinne:''' Potton was one of my patients, so I need to put together a medical file for him. My teacher always stressed that a person's life experiences are just as important to their file as their medical history.
:{{A|vo sgwlq004 1 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Why are you still treating him like your patient? Isn't he kinda beyond redemption now?
:{{A|vo sgwlq004 1 sigewinne 10.ogg}} '''Sigewinne:''' That may be true, but a patient is a patient, regardless of the choices that bring them to my care.
:{{A|vo sgwlq004 1 morgane 15.ogg}} '''Morgane:''' Ah, one last thing, Head Nurse. Please keep everything you know about this potion a secret.
:{{A|vo sgwlq004 1 morgane 16.ogg}} '''Morgane:''' It would be for the best if most of Fontaine knows nothing of its existence. I know my fellow officers and I will be able to sleep easier if that's the case.
:{{A|vo sgwlq004 1 sigewinne 11.ogg}} '''Sigewinne:''' Of course. Not to worry.
:{{A|vo sgwlq004 1 morgane 17.ogg}} '''Morgane:''' Thank you for understanding. I'll take my leave, then.
:{{A|vo sgwlq004 1 paimon 12.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So Sigewinne, did you really use that potion yourself?
:{{A|vo sgwlq004 1 sigewinne 12.ogg}} '''Sigewinne:''' Why do you sound so surprised, Paimon? I told you all about it. It was quite a while ago now.
:{{A|vo sgwlq004 1 paimon 13.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Uhh... You mean that story about the witch and the potion? So it was really, actually, genuinely a true story?
:{{A|vo sgwlq004 1 sigewinne 13.ogg}} '''Sigewinne:''' Yes. It really, actually, genuinely was.
:{{A|vo sgwlq004 1 paimon 14.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' But...
:{{DIcon}} The process of making that potion...
:{{A|vo sgwlq004 1 sigewinne 14.ogg}} '''Sigewinne:''' I know. There are some secrets I can't tell anyone about. But considering everything we've been through together, I know I can trust you with them.
:{{A|vo sgwlq004 1 sigewinne 15.ogg}} '''Sigewinne:''' Before I tell you, though, could you follow me somewhere? I want to pay my respects to an old friend.
:{{A|vo sgwlq004 1 paimon 15.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Of course!

;(Talk to Calcagni, optional)
:{{A|vo dialog sgwlq001 calcagni 01.ogg}} '''Calcagni:''' Stocks are running low, so purchase soon to avoid disappointment!
