;(Approach Neuvillette and Wriothesley)
:{{A|vo sgwlq004 2 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh... Neuvillette and Wriothesley! They're here too!
:{{A|vo sgwlq004 2 neuvillette 01.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' Good to see you, {{Traveler}}, Paimon. I trust all has been going well for you.
:{{A|vo sgwlq004 2 wriothesley 01.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' Big news, everyone: The Iudex is out of his office on important business.
:{{A|vo sgwlq004 2 neuvillette 02.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' Hmm? Is that genuinely something people would consider "big news"?
:{{A|vo sgwlq004 2 wriothesley 02.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' Why wouldn't they? Important business is a big deal.
:{{A|vo sgwlq004 2 neuvillette 03.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' Ah... Yes, you're quite right. When someone you care about requires emotional support, being there for them at the right time and place is of the utmost importance.
:{{A|vo sgwlq004 2 neuvillette 18.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' After reading the Marechaussee Phantom's reports, I had a feeling a trip here might be in order.
:{{A|vo sgwlq004 2 wriothesley 03.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' Take note — that, my friends, is how Monsieur Neuvillette shows that he cares. We're both here for the same purpose, actually — to accompany Sigewinne as she pays her respects to her late teacher.
:{{A|vo sgwlq004 2 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So the old friend she mentioned was her teacher then? The "witch"?
:{{A|vo sgwlq004 2 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Uh, sorry, sorry, Paimon didn't mean to be rude! It's only 'cause Sigewinne calls her that all the time, so...
:{{A|vo sgwlq004 2 wriothesley 04.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' I doubt she considers that title to be offensive, Paimon. Don't worry.
:{{A|vo sgwlq004 2 neuvillette 04.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' Indeed. In fact, I believe Sigewinne would take it as a sign of affection. She has spoken of this doctor on many occasions, and it sounds like she was a truly generous individual.
:{{A|vo sgwlq004 2 neuvillette 05.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' In those days, many people harbored prejudices against Melusines. She was the only teacher willing to take Sigewinne on as a student.
:{{A|vo sgwlq004 2 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wow, it's really nice of you two to be here for Sigewinne! Guess you guys really look out for your younger colleagues, huh...
:{{A|vo sgwlq004 2 wriothesley 05.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' Younger colleague? That might be true for the Iudex, but I'm not sure I can say the same.
:{{A|vo sgwlq004 2 wriothesley 06.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' Sigewinne served a sentence in the [[Fortress of Meropide]] hundreds of years ago, and after she did her time, she decided to stick around. She's been an integral part of our administration ever since.
:{{A|vo sgwlq004 2 wriothesley 07.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' Strictly speaking, the head nurse has been around longer than most people in the Fortress, myself included. Pretty sure that makes me the younger colleague.
:{{A|vo sgwlq004 2 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' She served a sentence?
:{{DIcon}} She committed a crime?
:{{A|vo sgwlq004 2 neuvillette 06.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' Yes. Long before I became Iudex, there was an ancient law in Fontaine that prohibited any attempt to transform another species into a human.
:{{A|vo sgwlq004 2 neuvillette 07.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' Initially, I and most researchers believed this law to have been imposed due to ethical concerns.
:{{A|vo sgwlq004 2 neuvillette 08.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' But now, it seems more likely that the law was nothing more than an insurance policy — a way for [[Egeria]] to ensure that her people would remain insulated from the truth, thus enabling them to lead more straightforward, happier lives.
:{{A|vo sgwlq004 2 wriothesley 08.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' Ignorance is bliss, as they say.
:{{A|vo sgwlq004 2 neuvillette 09.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' Sigewinne had her reasons for choosing to obtain a human form, but the act was nonetheless in clear violation of the law.
:{{A|vo sgwlq004 2 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Could you tell us a bit more about what happened back then?
:{{A|vo sgwlq004 2 neuvillette 10.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' Certainly. Sigewinne does not object to her close friends learning about her history. In fact, I first learned of it myself because she confessed the truth to me of her own volition...
<!-- Flashback begins -->
:{{A|vo sgwlq004 2 thewitch 01.ogg}} '''"The Witch":''' Even with their daughter so ill, they kicked you out? Stubborn as always... and prejudice isn't a disease I can cure, either.
:{{A|vo sgwlq004 2 thewitch 02.ogg}} '''"The Witch":''' *sigh* Shame that I don't have the energy to get over there. You're laughable, you old witch. You want to save everyone in Fontaine, but you can't even save the patient before you.
:{{A|vo sgwlq004 2 sigewinne 01.ogg}} '''Sigewinne:''' Master, what are you...
:{{A|vo sgwlq004 2 thewitch 03.ogg}} '''"The Witch":''' I discovered a strange disease, one I suspect that every Fontainian suffers from. But without witnesses or proof, no one will believe me.
:{{A|vo sgwlq004 2 thewitch 04.ogg}} '''"The Witch":''' I had no choice but to experiment on myself to find a cure, but I hit a wall — and as you can see, it took a wretched toll on me.
:{{A|vo sgwlq004 2 sigewinne 02.ogg}} '''Sigewinne:''' Then... I'll find a cure for you, and then you can go cure her!
:{{A|vo sgwlq004 2 thewitch 05.ogg}} '''"The Witch":''' There's no need... I'm beyond saving now. There's nothing you can do.
:{{A|vo sgwlq004 2 sigewinne 03.ogg}} '''Sigewinne:''' But Master...
:{{A|vo sgwlq004 2 thewitch 06.ogg}} '''"The Witch":''' As I said before, a doctor's duty is to treat whatever ailments they can.
:{{A|vo sgwlq004 2 sigewinne 04.ogg}} '''Sigewinne:''' I know... But, they don't trust me at all.
:{{A|vo sgwlq004 2 thewitch 07.ogg}} '''"The Witch":''' *cough* That girl... She's your first ever patient, isn't she? ...Tell me, what cost are you willing to bear to see her cured?
:{{A|vo sgwlq004 2 sigewinne 05.ogg}} '''Sigewinne:''' I'll do whatever it takes.
:{{A|vo sgwlq004 2 thewitch 08.ogg}} '''"The Witch":''' Even if it means breaking the law and being punished for it?
:{{A|vo sgwlq004 2 sigewinne 06.ogg}} '''Sigewinne:''' ...As long as I don't hurt anyone, yes.
:{{A|vo sgwlq004 2 thewitch 09.ogg}} '''"The Witch":''' Haha. Spoken like a true student of mine.
:{{A|vo sgwlq004 2 thewitch 10.ogg}} '''"The Witch":''' Then I shall make one more final gamble... and see my experiment through to its end. Leave me for now, and come back in two hours.
:{{A|vo sgwlq004 2 thewitch 11.ogg}} '''"The Witch":''' If I am able to work this miracle, then I will have found a way to save all Fontainians, and I shall be able to help you treat that girl.
:{{A|vo sgwlq004 2 thewitch 12.ogg}} '''"The Witch":''' If not... Then it means there is one more disease in this world that I cannot treat. In that case, do not come looking for me.
:{{A|vo sgwlq004 2 thewitch 13.ogg}} '''"The Witch":''' I will leave you a parting gift — an accidental discovery, happened upon through my study of this strange disease. It has little use, but it will at least help you cure this one patient you can reach.
<!-- Flashback ends -->
:{{A|vo sgwlq004 2 neuvillette 11.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' When Sigewinne returned, the miracle had not occurred.
:{{A|vo sgwlq004 2 neuvillette 12.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' She found a potion bottle and a note on the table. After using the potion as instructed, she gained her current form, breaking Fontaine's law in the process.
:{{A|vo sgwlq004 2 neuvillette 13.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' And after I had confirmed the veracity of the events, I gave my verdict.
:{{A|vo sgwlq004 2 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So that's what happened...
:{{DIcon}} Her teacher sacrificed herself.
:{{DIcon}} And left that potion behind.
:{{A|vo sgwlq004 2 neuvillette 14.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' I fear Sigewinne only understood the full story after the truth about the dissolution of Fontainians was uncovered.
:{{A|vo sgwlq004 2 neuvillette 15.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' When I reflected on all this with that knowledge in hand, I felt a deep sense of regret... As I use the law to uphold justice, there are times when I cannot help but acknowledge its ruthlessness.
:{{A|vo sgwlq004 2 neuvillette 16.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' After the final details of the events surrounding Sigewinne's transformation came to light, I checked several sources and, thankfully, the legal code does not require Sigewinne to shoulder any additional punishment.
:{{A|vo sgwlq004 2 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hmm, wonder how she feels about all this...
:{{A|vo sgwlq004 2 neuvillette 17.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' Since she invited you here, I imagine she intends to speak of these matters with you, no?

;(Talk to Neuvillette and Wriothesley, optional)
:{{A|vo dialog sgwlq004 neuvillette 01.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' On behalf of the Marechaussee Phantom, I would like to once again thank the Fortress of Meropide for your assistance in the response to yesterday's prisonbreak.
:{{A|vo dialog sgwlq004 wriothesley 01.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' Our Head Nurse and {{Traveler}} and Paimon did most of the heavy lifting, I would say.
:{{A|vo dialog sgwlq004 neuvillette 02.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' Sigewinne seems to be in good spirits. I trust work hasn't been too hard on her lately?
:{{A|vo dialog sgwlq004 wriothesley 02.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' Well, she might be the only permanent medical staff in the Fortress, but there's plenty of people with medical knowledge willing to help her out.
:{{A|vo dialog sgwlq004 neuvillette 03.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' I am most relieved to hear it.
:{{A|vo dialog sgwlq004 wriothesley 03.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' Haha, the way you're asking after her wellbeing makes you sound like a concerned parent.
:{{A|vo dialog sgwlq004 neuvillette 04.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' Ah, well, I won't lie... I've always seen myself that way.
:{{A|vo dialog sgwlq004 wriothesley 04.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' Showing your age a bit there, don't you think...
:{{A|vo dialog sgwlq004 neuvillette 05.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' Indeed. Actually, I often forget just how much older I am than you...
:{{A|vo dialog sgwlq004 wriothesley 05.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' Well, while we're on the topic... What did you do before getting this job, anyway? Spend all day swimming in the sea, from east to west, then south to north?
:{{A|vo dialog sgwlq004 neuvillette 06.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' Yes, and uh... from the surface to the ocean floor, on occasion.
:{{A|vo dialog sgwlq004 wriothesley 06.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' Wow. Impressive.
:{{A|vo dialog sgwlq004 neuvillette 07.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' ...Apologies, that was merely an attempt at humor. You can disregard what I said.
:{{A|vo dialog sgwlq004 wriothesley 07.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' Hah, that's impossible, I'm afraid. My imagination's already running wild.

;(Talk to Sigewinne)
:{{A|vo sgwlq004 4 sigewinne 01.ogg}} '''Sigewinne:''' You're here.
:{{A|vo sgwlq004 4 sigewinne 02.ogg}} '''Sigewinne:''' The old friend I mentioned was my teacher. When she passed, her body was nowhere to be found. All that's left of her is an empty tomb, and even that's deep underwater now.
:{{A|vo sgwlq004 4 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Sigewinne... The witch who gave you the magic potion, she was your teacher, wasn't she?
:{{A|vo sgwlq004 4 sigewinne 03.ogg}} '''Sigewinne:''' Ah, sounds like Monsieur Neuvillette filled you in.
:{{A|vo sgwlq004 4 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' After learning the truth... it must've been hard to process, huh?
:{{A|vo sgwlq004 4 sigewinne 04.ogg}} '''Sigewinne:''' Well... To be honest, after I realized what really happened that night, my first thought was that it kind of made sense. It seemed exactly like the sort of thing she would do.
:{{A|vo sgwlq004 4 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' But, she was planning to sacrifice herself, and never told you!
:{{A|vo sgwlq004 4 sigewinne 05.ogg}} '''Sigewinne:''' That's just who she was. If lying is what it took to get a kid to take their medicine, then that's what she'd do.
:{{DIcon}} A truly great doctor.
:{{DIcon}} A truly odd doctor.
:{{A|vo sgwlq004 4 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Alright... But, why did you turn yourself in?
:{{A|vo sgwlq004 4 sigewinne 06.ogg}} '''Sigewinne:''' I broke the law, simple as that. My teacher made her choice, and I made mine.
:{{A|vo sgwlq004 4 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' True, it's just... The way Potton framed it when he was asking you all those questions, it made Paimon really mad!
:{{A|vo sgwlq004 4 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You're not like him at all, and everything Neuvillette said confirms that...
:{{A|vo sgwlq004 4 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' And yet you were still convicted and thrown in prison... It just feels so unfair.
:{{A|vo sgwlq004 4 sigewinne 07.ogg}} '''Sigewinne:''' Unfair? I happen to think just the opposite. If I hadn't served that time, I'm not sure I would've been able to stay strong when he was questioning me.
:{{A|vo sgwlq004 4 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What makes you say that?
:{{A|vo sgwlq004 4 sigewinne 08.ogg}} '''Sigewinne:''' I knew you'd be curious. Let me tell you a story...
;(A cinematic plays)
:{{Cutscene Description|Sigewinne was convicted, and thus the Fortress of Meropide gained a tiny new doctor. The more patients she treated, the more her sentence was shortened, and she stayed within the Fortress until she had finally served her time. One day, she received an invitation from an elderly lady. It turns out that she was the young girl that Sigewinne had treated all those years ago. The woman told Sigewinne that she still remembers that it was Sigewinne who saved her back then, and that regardless of whether Sigewinne looked more human or Melusine, the warmth of her palms was ever the same.}}
::'''Sigewinne:''' The verdict came down: This Melusine is guilty
::'''Sigewinne:''' The Iudex defended the authority of Fontaine law
::'''Sigewinne:''' But he did not confiscate the Melusine's medical kit
::'''Sigewinne:''' And so, the Fortress of Meropide gained a new little doctor
::'''Sigewinne:''' She still wore her hood and raincoat
::'''Sigewinne:''' Even though it never rained in the Fortress
::'''Sigewinne:''' Perhaps thanks to her human appearance, no one refused her treatment
::'''Sigewinne:''' She treated more and more patients, and her sentence grew ever shorter
::'''Sigewinne:''' Finally, the people of the Fortress could not live without her
::'''Sigewinne:''' And though her sentence ended, she did not leave them either
::'''Sigewinne:''' Then one day, she received an invitation from the outside world
::'''Sigewinne:''' The location seemed familiar, and when she arrived, an old lady was waiting for her
::'''Sigewinne:''' She saw right through the Melusine's disguise, but didn't reveal it
::'''Sigewinne:''' Instead, she asked a question
::'''Old Woman:''' Tell me, why do you think you gained the respect of so many people
::'''Old Woman:''' Despite being a Melusine?
::'''Sigewinne:''' Because...I look like a human?
::'''Old Woman:''' It's been 50 years, Sigewinne
::'''Old Woman:''' And you haven't aged a day...
::'''Old Woman:''' I think everyone knows you are not human
::'''Old Woman:''' I've finally found you, after all these years
::'''Old Woman:''' I still remember, you know. It was you who saved me that night
::'''Sigewinne:''' But how? I was no longer a Melusine by then
::'''Old Woman:''' Does it really matter if you're human or Melusine?
::'''Old Woman:''' I remembered the warmth of your palm
::'''Old Woman:''' It's quite unmistakable
::'''Old Woman:''' And you know what? It hasn't changed one bit
::'''Old Woman:''' You don't have to hide anymore, Sigewinne
::'''Old Woman:''' These days, everyone wants to make friends with Melusines
::'''Old Woman:''' And I think it's all because of you
::'''Old Woman:''' I'm sorry I couldn't say this until now, but...
::'''Old Woman:''' Thank you, Doctor Melusine
:;(Cinematic ends)
:{{A|vo sgwlq004 4 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Now that's an ending Paimon can get behind!
:{{A|vo sgwlq004 4 sigewinne 09.ogg}} '''Sigewinne:''' After hearing everything Potton said, I wanted to tell him that it didn't matter who he looked like on the outside... But it was too late — the warmth in his palm had already disappeared.
:{{A|vo sgwlq004 4 sigewinne 10.ogg}} '''Sigewinne:''' I tried to treat him, but... The roots of his problem had nothing to do with his face.
:{{DIcon}} No need to feel too bad for him.
:{{DIcon}} It does feel like wasted potential.
:{{A|vo sgwlq004 4 sigewinne 11.ogg}} '''Sigewinne:''' I understand... Thanks, you two. I appreciate you being here for me while I talk this through.
:{{A|vo sgwlq004 4 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, it's nothing! Our pleasure.
:{{A|vo sgwlq004 4 sigewinne 12.ogg}} '''Sigewinne:''' Oh, there's one more reason I invited you here. It's about time I finally give you what I promised.
:{{A|vo sgwlq004 4 sigewinne 13.ogg}} '''Sigewinne:''' In order to restore the appearances of the face-swapping victims, the Marechaussee Phantom gave me special permission to make a few bottles of that potion. And... I made one extra, just for you two.
:{{A|vo sgwlq004 4 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh? We don't need it, though... Shouldn't we destroy it?
:{{A|vo sgwlq004 4 sigewinne 14.ogg}} '''Sigewinne:''' Well, even if you chose to destroy it, I still thought I should give it to you first. You two did so much for me — how could I break my promise?
:{{A|vo sgwlq004 4 paimon 12.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Well, fair enough. But anyway, Paimon's definitely not interested in this stuff anymore.

:{{A|vo sgwlq004 4 paimon 14.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Melusine physiology wasn't affected by the great flood, right? So that means the potion should have a permanent effect on you. In that case... Whaddaya say, Sigewinne? Ever thought about transforming back to the way you used to look?

:{{A|vo sgwlq004 4 paimon 17.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Heh, what was Paimon thinking? You made up your mind a long time ago. Yeah, let's just destroy this thing.
:{{A|vo sgwlq004 4 sigewinne 16.ogg}} '''Sigewinne:''' Leave it to me.

{{Quest Description|This is the day that the winner of the Furina Award shall be revealed at the Fontinalia Film Festival. This is no time for delay. Time to head down to the venue!}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Approach Xavier on the day of the festival)
:{{Black Screen|Some more time passes after that...}}
:{{Black Screen|The film has a successful premiere and the musket murder case also successfully comes to an end.}}
:{{A|vo dyjeq005 1 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Xavier! It's been a while!
:{{A|vo dyjeq005 1 xavier 01.ogg}} '''Xavier:''' Hey there, you two. Sorry I've been scarce, I've been buried in marketing and preparing the film for release ever since we wrapped post-production...
:{{A|vo dyjeq005 1 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' The award ceremony is today, right? Paimon wonders if we'll win the Furina Award!
:{{A|vo dyjeq005 1 furina 01.ogg}} '''Furina:''' I'd give it a ninety percent chance.
:{{A|vo dyjeq005 1 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Furina! Paimon didn't know you were already here. You're earlier than everyone else!
:{{A|vo dyjeq005 1 furina 02.ogg}} '''Furina:''' I'm sure the others will also be here in no time. Hmm... Xavier, if we end up getting called on stage, shouldn't you come up with a name for our crew?
:{{A|vo dyjeq005 1 xavier 02.ogg}} '''Xavier:''' Huh!? But we don't even know if we're going to win. I wouldn't want to jinx our chances by celebrating early...
:{{A|vo dyjeq005 1 furina 03.ogg}} '''Furina:''' Just open your eyes! Surely you've seen the audience's reactions to our film? We've had nothing but critical acclaim!
:{{A|vo dyjeq005 1 furina 04.ogg}} '''Furina:''' You've also had conversations with the opera house's operating staff, right? Didn't they want to increase the number of showings?
:{{A|vo dyjeq005 1 furina 05.ogg}} '''Furina:''' With the Mora you've made from the box office, you can now open your very own film company!
:{{A|vo dyjeq005 1 xavier 03.ogg}} '''Xavier:''' B—But that's all credit to my amazing crew! You've all helped to make this a reality, so I can't be the only one asked to come up with a name!
:{{A|vo dyjeq005 1 furina 06.ogg}} '''Furina:''' Well, give it some thought. I'm sure the crew will respect your choice.
:{{A|vo dyjeq005 1 xavier 04.ogg}} '''Xavier:''' Alright... But before that, {{Traveler}} and Paimon, could I trouble you to quickly pay a visit to the [[Fortress of Meropide]]?
:{{A|vo dyjeq005 1 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh? But shouldn't we stay for the award ceremony?
:{{A|vo dyjeq005 1 xavier 05.ogg}} '''Xavier:''' I wanted to ask you two to invite Chevreuse to join us at the ceremony. She's one of the lead roles, after all.
:{{A|vo dyjeq005 1 xavier 06.ogg}} '''Xavier:''' I haven't been able to find her recently, so I haven't had the chance to invite her personally.
:{{A|vo dyjeq005 1 xavier 07.ogg}} '''Xavier:''' According to the papers, the culprits of the musket murder case will be personally escorted today by the Captain of the Special Patrol to the Fortress of Meropide...
:{{A|vo dyjeq005 1 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, Paimon gets it now.
:{{DIcon}} It'll be a piece of cake for us.
:{{A|vo dyjeq005 1 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yep! Just wait here, Xavier, and maybe try to come up with a few snappy sounding names.
:{{A|vo dyjeq005 1 xavier 08.ogg}} '''Xavier:''' Alright, then I'll leave you to it.

;(Talk to Furina or Xavier, optional)
:{{A|vo dialog dyjeq005 xavier 01.ogg}} '''Xavier:''' Will we really win an award...
:{{A|vo dialog dyjeq005 furina 01.ogg}} '''Furina:''' Trust me. When have I ever been wrong about something like this?
----
;(Enter the [[Duke's Office]])
:{{A|vo dyjeq005 2 chevreuse 01.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' This is as far as I'll be taking them. I'll leave the three of them to you now.
:{{A|vo dyjeq005 2 wriothesley 01.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' Got another errand to run?
:{{Introductory Note|Wriothesley}}
:{{A|vo dyjeq005 2 chevreuse 02.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' Something like that. I'm expected at a party.
:{{A|vo dyjeq005 2 wriothesley 02.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' Now that's something you don't hear every day. Found a new pastime?
:{{A|vo dyjeq005 2 chevreuse 03.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' No, it's just a special occasion.
:{{A|vo dyjeq005 2 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Chevreuse, Wriothesley!
:{{A|vo dyjeq005 2 wriothesley 03.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' Festivals really do bring people together. It's been a while since I last had so many visitors at the Fortress of Meropide.
:{{A|vo dyjeq005 2 chevreuse 04.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' Call it the festival spirit, I guess.
:{{A|vo dyjeq005 2 wriothesley 04.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' Yeah, you could say that. Even our [[Sigewinne|head nurse]] has gotten herself all worked up preparing super deluxe nutritious shakes... Just one gulp, and you'll have met all of your nutrition needs.
:{{A|vo dyjeq005 2 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Were you talking about work just now?
:{{A|vo dyjeq005 2 chevreuse 05.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' We've already finished discussing everything. So, what do you think about my "heads-up," Mr. Wriothesley?
:{{A|vo dyjeq005 2 wriothesley 05.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' Hmm. I believe I haven't yet made any promises or guarantees.
:{{A|vo dyjeq005 2 chevreuse 06.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' But you also didn't shoot me down.
:{{A|vo dyjeq005 2 chevreuse 07.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' Here, how about this? You could give everyone a copy of the newspaper. Perhaps on the day when the cover story happens to, oh, I dunno, expose a certain someone's misdeeds from 20 years ago.
:{{A|vo dyjeq005 2 wriothesley 06.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' Hmm. I suppose then, a certain someone may soon find himself the most unlucky person in the Fortress of Meropide.
:{{A|vo dyjeq005 2 chevreuse 08.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' While another two people will soon be hailed as heroes.
:{{A|vo dyjeq005 2 wriothesley 07.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' Speaking of heroes, did you two need something from me?
:{{A|vo dyjeq005 2 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, uh, actually we're here for...
:{{A|vo dyjeq005 2 chevreuse 09.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' You're here to invite me to the party, right? Don't worry, I didn't forget.
:{{A|vo dyjeq005 2 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ooh, then let's head back right away!
:{{A|vo dyjeq005 2 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' See ya, Wriothesley! Happy Fontinalia Festival!
:{{A|vo dyjeq005 2 wriothesley 08.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' And the same to you.

;(Talk to Wriothesley, optional)
:{{A|vo dialog dyjeq005 wriothesley 01.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' Please go and enjoy the festival.
----
;(Approach the venue)
:{{A|vo dyjeq005 3 filmfeshost 01.ogg}} '''Film Festival Host:''' And the winner of the Furina Award for the first Fontinalia Film Festival is—
:{{A|vo dyjeq005 3 filmfeshost 02.ogg}} '''Film Festival Host:''' "The Two Musketeers"!
:{{A|vo dyjeq005 3 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' We won! We really won!
:{{A|vo dyjeq005 3 ayaka 01.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' Congratulations, Mr. Xavier.
:{{A|vo dyjeq005 3 xavier 01.ogg}} '''Xavier:''' We won... I can't believe it, I... I... I really can't thank all of you enough!
:{{A|vo dyjeq005 3 furina 01.ogg}} '''Furina:''' See? My takes on Fontaine's entertainment industry have never been wrong.
:{{A|vo dyjeq005 3 filmfeshost 03.ogg}} '''Film Festival Host:''' Now, please welcome to the stage the producer of "The Two Musketeers," Mr. Xavier!
:{{A|vo dyjeq005 3 xavier 02.ogg}} '''Xavier:''' Thank you... Thank you all so much for your recognition and support. While I'm up here, I would like to give special thanks to—
:{{A|vo dyjeq005 3 chevreuse 01.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' Time really flies, huh?
:{{A|vo dyjeq005 3 ayaka 02.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' It certainly feels that way. It feels like it was only yesterday when you were teaching me to hold a musket.
:{{A|vo dyjeq005 3 chevreuse 02.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' Will you come back to Fontaine again?
:{{A|vo dyjeq005 3 ayaka 03.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' Of course! I'm very fond of this city. There are so many novel and interesting things that it's been hard to keep track of them all.
:{{A|vo dyjeq005 3 ayaka 04.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' But how about you? Would you be interested in visiting Inazuma?
:{{A|vo dyjeq005 3 chevreuse 03.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' I can't say the thought has crossed my mind before... but I'd be willing to consider it now.
:{{A|vo dyjeq005 3 ayaka 05.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' I will be eagerly awaiting your visit. It would be wonderful if you could visit my home and enjoy a taste of our tea and desserts.
:{{A|vo dyjeq005 3 chevreuse 04.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' Yes, let's keep in touch.
:{{A|vo dyjeq005 3 chiori 01.ogg}} '''Chiori:''' Did you accomplish all you came here for?
:{{A|vo dyjeq005 3 ayato 01.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' Yes. And you should visit Inazuma again sometime.
:{{A|vo dyjeq005 3 chiori 02.ogg}} '''Chiori:''' How has [[Ogura Mio|Ogura]] and her business been?
:{{A|vo dyjeq005 3 ayato 02.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' To my knowledge, she's been doing quite well.
:{{A|vo dyjeq005 3 chiori 03.ogg}} '''Chiori:''' Tell her I said hi.
:{{A|vo dyjeq005 3 ayato 03.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' I certainly will.
:{{A|vo dyjeq005 3 chiori 04.ogg}} '''Chiori:''' I heard the thunderstorm has stopped.
:{{A|vo dyjeq005 3 ayato 04.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' Yes, and the war has also been brought to an end. Peace and prosperity has returned to the islands.
:{{A|vo dyjeq005 3 chiori 05.ogg}} '''Chiori:''' I quite like the sound of that, perfect for hanging textiles out to dry.
:{{A|vo dyjeq005 3 xavier 03.ogg}} '''Xavier:''' —I'd like to offer my thanks again to the entire cast and crew. Without you, I would have never completed this film, much less had the opportunity to be standing on this stage.
:{{A|vo dyjeq005 3 xavier 04.ogg}} '''Xavier:''' With the support of my entire crew, I would like to officially announce our film company, "Musketeer Pictures"!
:{{A|vo dyjeq005 3 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ooh, that has a really nice ring to it!
:{{A|vo dyjeq005 3 filmfeshost 04.ogg}} '''Film Festival Host:''' Then, in that case, let's please welcome all the members of Musketeer Pictures onto the stage for a commemorative photo!
:{{A|vo dyjeq005 3 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh! Paimon didn't know we'd also be taking pictures!
:{{A|vo dyjeq005 3 xavier 05.ogg}} '''Xavier:''' Director Furina, I believe you are the most deserving person to raise this trophy.
:{{A|vo dyjeq005 3 furina 02.ogg}} '''Furina:''' Huh? No, no no no, there's no need... It's so embarrassing...
:{{A|vo dyjeq005 3 chevreuse 05.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' It's an honor the director deserves.
:{{A|vo dyjeq005 3 ayaka 06.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' Yes, I agree.
:{{DIcon}} I can't think of anyone better for the honor.
:{{A|vo dyjeq005 3 chiori 06.ogg}} '''Chiori:''' Just accept that you're not getting out of this.
:{{A|vo dyjeq005 3 filmfeshost 05.ogg}} '''Film Festival Host:''' Ready, everyone? Three, two, one—
:{{A|vo dyjeq005 3 together 01a.ogg}} {{A|vo dyjeq005 3 together 01b.ogg}} '''Crowd:''' Musketeer Pictures!!!

:{{DIcon}} Your acting was brilliant.
::{{A|vo dialog dyjeq005 ayaka 02a 1.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' Really? Thank you...
::{{A|vo dialog dyjeq005 ayaka 02a 2.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' At first, I simply tried to work hard out of a desire to not become a burden to the crew. It would have been so embarrassing if the filming had to stop to accommodate my lack of skills.
::{{A|vo dialog dyjeq005 ayaka 02a 3.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' But Director Furina was both patient and knowledgeable, and Chevreuse and [[Elain]] taught me a lot about the scenes and details. It was all thanks to their help that I was able to grow comfortable with the role.
::{{A|vo dialog dyjeq005 ayaka 02a 4.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' And even with all of that said, I still... got a little flustered with praise, especially since everyone, including you, were complimenting me at the end...
::;(Dialogue returns to option selection)
:{{DIcon}} Did you have a good time?
::{{A|vo dialog dyjeq005 ayaka 02b 1.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' Yes, I visited many places with Yoimiya in between the filming sessions.
::{{A|vo dialog dyjeq005 ayaka 02b 2.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' The elegant streets, the beautiful flowers and greenery, and the dreamlike underwater world... Everything I saw will shine like stars in my memories.
::{{A|vo dialog dyjeq005 ayaka 02b 3.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' It also brings me joy to think that perhaps you've marveled at those exact wonders as well.
::;(Dialogue returns to option selection)
:{{DIcon}} Thank you for your hard work, Ayaka.
::{{A|vo dialog dyjeq005 ayaka 02c 1.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' Ah, it's nothing at all. I... don't often have the opportunity to wander out into the world like this.
::{{A|vo dialog dyjeq005 ayaka 02c 2.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' Not only did I make many new friends during this trip, I also picked up many new skills from everyone around me. I will cherish this experience greatly.
::{{A|vo dialog dyjeq005 ayaka 02c 3.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' Oh, and I'm also going to bring some [[Conch Madeleine]]s back to the Yashiro Commission as a gift.
::{{A|vo dialog dyjeq005 ayaka 02c 4.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' If we could enjoy them with some coffee... Hehe, perhaps it'll feel as if I'd never left Fontaine at all.
::;(Dialogue returns to option selection)
:{{DIcon}} Have a safe and relaxing trip home.
::{{A|vo dialog dyjeq005 ayaka 02d 1.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' Mhm, thank you for looking out for me. Please do take care of yourself during your adventures as well.
::{{A|vo dialog dyjeq005 ayaka 02d 2.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' If the stars align, we'll see each other in Inazuma again.
{{Dialogue End}}

{{Quest Description|To prepare supplies for your adventure, you and Paimon come to the Grand Bazaar...}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Approach Nilou in the grand bazaar)
:{{A|vo nllq001 1 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Nilou, it's nice to see you again!

:{{A|vo nllq001 1 nilou 02.ogg}} '''Nilou:''' That's right. Although there were a few hiccups here and there, the [[Sabzeruz Festival]] turned out to be a grand success!
:{{A|vo nllq001 1 nilou 03.ogg}} '''Nilou:''' And so, the theater wants to host a celebration event.

:{{A|vo nllq001 1 nilou 07.ogg}} '''Nilou:''' Mr. Zubayr, our manager, always says that celebrations aren't just for fun, but that they should also be occasions for reflection and review...

:{{A|vo nllq001 1 paimon 03a.ogg}}<!--{{A|vo nllq001 1 paimon 03b.ogg}}--> '''Paimon:''' We've been to a lot of festivals during our adventures!
:{{A|vo nllq001 1 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Will your celebration also have lots of yummy food and drinks?
:{{A|vo nllq001 1 nilou 09.ogg}} '''Nilou:''' Of course! We always do lots of eating, toasting, and gift-exchanging. We try really hard to show our appreciation for everyone.
:{{A|vo nllq001 1 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ahh, so we'll need to bring a present...
:{{DIcon}} Don't tell me you were planning to freeload?

::{{A|vo nllq001 1 paimon 06a 2.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' ...But maybe you could lend Paimon some Mora first...?
:{{DIcon}} Into a gift box you go, Paimon.

:{{A|vo nllq001 1 nilou 11.ogg}} '''Nilou:''' You can come, present or not. The gift exchange is just to make the celebration more entertaining.
:{{A|vo nllq001 1 nilou 12.ogg}} '''Nilou:''' You two being there would be the best gift of all! It'll also be a good time to introduce you to the rest of the theater.
:{{DIcon}} (Speaking of, since we last met her in her dream...)
:{{DIcon}} (Many more things have happened...)
:{{A|vo nllq001 1 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Is something up?
;(If the player has not completed ''[[Where the Boat of Consciousness Lies]]'')
::{{DIcon}} A pity Dunyarzad can't also be here...
::{{A|vo nllq001 2 nilou 01.ogg}} '''Nilou:''' Yeah... but for now, it's more important for her to rest and recover.
::{{A|vo nllq001 2 nilou 02.ogg}} '''Nilou:''' I tried to visit her, but I got turned away at the door... The people there wouldn't listen to a single word I said.
::{{A|vo nllq001 2 nilou 03.ogg}} '''Nilou:''' All I could do was to leave a letter encouraging her to get some rest and keep her spirits up.
::{{A|vo nllq001 2 nilou 04.ogg}} '''Nilou:''' She'll be better soon, and then we can celebrate together at the theater!
::{{A|vo nllq001 2 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' It's all thanks to you and Nilou that we managed to save Dunyarzad!
::{{DIcon}} I just didn't want her to have any regrets.
::{{DIcon}} She also helped us out a lot.
::{{A|vo nllq001 2 nilou 05.ogg}} '''Nilou:''' You're way too modest! Just now, I actually felt really self-conscious when Paimon talked about us in the same breath.
::{{A|vo nllq001 2 nilou 06.ogg}} '''Nilou:''' Compared to you, I really didn't do much at all.
;(If the player has completed ''Where the Boat of Consciousness Lies'')
::{{DIcon}} Did you run into any trouble after your dance?
::{{A|vo nllq001 3 nilou 01.ogg}} '''Nilou:''' You mean when I danced at the square right in front of the Akademiya? Hehe, not a single person came after me. I left really easily.
::{{A|vo nllq001 3 nilou 02.ogg}} '''Nilou:''' After that, no one came to the theater to scold me, either. We actually gained many new customers... And, they were all Akademiya students.
::{{A|vo nllq001 3 nilou 03.ogg}} '''Nilou:''' From what I can tell, in the past, if a student were to put off their studies to watch a show or dance, they'd be called foolish and irresponsible.

::{{A|vo nllq001 3 nilou 05.ogg}} '''Nilou:''' Anyway, it seems like people have to personally experience something to gain a good understanding of it.
::{{A|vo nllq001 3 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' They should thank us for opening their eyes!
::{{DIcon}} Hopefully, they'll appreciate the arts more.
::{{A|vo nllq001 3 nilou 06.ogg}} '''Nilou:''' That'll probably take some time... They're still droning on and on about "experimentation" and "proof." Will they really gain more appreciation for the arts if they continue to think of everything like that?
:{{A|vo nllq001 4 nilou 01.ogg}} '''Nilou:''' Hehe, anyway, all that aside, are you thinking about coming to our event?
:{{A|vo nllq001 4 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Paimon thinks it'll be a great time... What do you think, Traveler?
:{{DIcon}} Yeah, it sounds like fun.
:{{DIcon}} Sure, we have some time right now anyway.
:{{A|vo nllq001 4 nilou 02.ogg}} '''Nilou:''' Alright, then let's head to the theater...
:{{A|vo nllq001 4 nilou 03.ogg}} '''Nilou:''' —Wait, I completely forgot about this pile of stuff!
:{{A|vo nllq001 4 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Whoa! Did you buy all of this, Nilou!?
:{{A|vo nllq001 4 nilou 04.ogg}} '''Nilou:''' Just one box. The rest were given to me. I really don't know how it came to this much...
:{{A|vo nllq001 4 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' That's way too many freebies! Many vendors give out samples for free, but Paimon's never seen this much...
:{{A|vo nllq001 4 nilou 05.ogg}} '''Nilou:''' All I know is that whenever I start chatting with people, my hands would get more and more full until I can't hold everything anymore. This seems to happen every time...
:{{A|vo nllq001 4 nilou 06.ogg}} '''Nilou:''' I was planning on making a few trips to bring everything back, before continuing on with my shopping... but I don't think I'll have the time.
:{{A|vo nllq001 4 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So this isn't even all of it!?

:{{A|vo nllq001 8 afshin 04.ogg}} '''Afshin:''' Hahaha, come now. You know, Sumpter Beasts sometimes eat not because they're hungry, but because they like gnawing on things.

:{{A|vo nllq001 8 afshin 08.ogg}} '''Afshin:''' I wouldn't dare experiment with such a precious product.
:{{A|vo nllq001 8 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' True, it does sound like some good fabric...

:{{A|vo nllq001 8 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ooh, that's a pretty good discount. What do you think, {{Traveler}}?
:{{A|vo nllq001 8 nilou 03.ogg}} '''Nilou:''' No thanks, Mr. Afshin. You can't use that kind of tactic on her. Look, you've already sucked her in.
:{{A|vo nllq001 8 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Uh... Tactic? So you mean, everything he just said to Paimon was a lie?
:{{A|vo nllq001 8 nilou 04.ogg}} '''Nilou:''' Ah, I wouldn't go that far... It's just that Mr. Afshin is really good at spinning stories. A word from him, and you'll find yourself buying things you don't actually need.

:{{A|vo nllq001 8 afshin 10.ogg}} '''Afshin:''' C'mon, don't look at me like that... All she got was a talking-to from Zubayr, while I was nearly fed head-first to the Sumpter Beasts.
:{{A|vo nllq001 8 afshin 11.ogg}} '''Afshin:''' My philosophy is that stories give value to merchandise. That's why my business started with such a boom.
:{{A|vo nllq001 8 afshin 12.ogg}} '''Afshin:''' Our Nilou here is an extraordinarily good listener. Back then, she believed anything I said.
:{{A|vo nllq001 8 afshin 13.ogg}} '''Afshin:''' After a while, I began to feel guilty selling things to her because of how happy she looked... Though she enjoyed the stories and I the Mora, I knew she didn't need to buy that much...
:{{A|vo nllq001 8 afshin 14.ogg}} '''Afshin:''' Anyway, since then, I've come to realize two things: One, that stories should just be a means instead of an end, and two, that there's more to business than just selling goods.

:{{A|vo nllq001 8 afshin 16.ogg}} '''Afshin:''' They're fine for general use, but my customers have high standards, and I don't have the time or resources to find new buyers right now.
:{{A|vo nllq001 8 afshin 17.ogg}} '''Afshin:''' Nilou, why don't you take them?
:{{A|vo nllq001 8 nilou 07.ogg}} '''Nilou:''' Huh? No no no no, I can't do that...

:{{A|vo nllq001 8 afshin 19.ogg}} '''Afshin:''' It costs me Mora to store or ship, so I'm just losing money every day continuing to hold on to them.
:{{A|vo nllq001 8 nilou 08.ogg}} '''Nilou:''' Even so, let me buy them at market value.
:{{A|vo nllq001 8 afshin 20.ogg}} '''Afshin:''' Nah, these goods are hard movers. Besides, if I let you pay, wouldn't it mean that I'm just using stories to sell my goods again?
:{{A|vo nllq001 8 afshin 21.ogg}} '''Afshin:''' Just take them. If you really feel that bad about it, give me some theater tickets later.
:{{A|vo nllq001 8 afshin 22.ogg}} '''Afshin:''' Oh yeah, you should also take some while you're at it. Adventurers are always in need of materials, right?
:{{A|vo nllq001 8 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wow, even we get a share of this...?
:{{A|vo nllq001 8 afshin 23.ogg}} '''Afshin:''' Hurry and take it. Just looking at it all is giving me a headache. Haha, thanks for the huge favor.

:{{A|vo nllq001 26 sharif 13.ogg}} '''Sharif:''' Wrap everything up and make preparations to shut down at once.
:{{A|vo nllq001 26 inayah 14.ogg}} '''Inayah:''' ...
:{{A|vo nllq001 26 inayah 15.ogg}} '''Inayah:''' Why is he always like that!?
:{{A|vo nllq001 26 sheikhzubayr 06.ogg}} '''Sheikh Zubayr:''' This is quite the misfortune, but there's nothing we can do.
:{{A|vo nllq001 26 sheikhzubayr 07.ogg}} '''Sheikh Zubayr:''' That's it for today, everyone. Let's clean up.
:{{A|vo nllq001 26 sheikhzubayr 08.ogg}} '''Sheikh Zubayr:''' I'll go talk to them again tomorrow. *sigh* The storms that come out of the blue are always the hardest to deal with.
{{Dialogue End}}
{{Quest Description|update|The celebration was interrupted by a scholar from the Akademiya. In the face of this emergency, you'd better discuss it with Nilou first.}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Talk to Sohrin, Ahbi, and Rekhar, optional)
:{{A|vo dialog nllq001 sorin 03.ogg}} '''Sohrin:''' Is this place gonna get torn down?
:{{A|vo dialog nllq001 abe 02.ogg}} '''Abhi:''' Nooo, I don't want that to happen...
:{{A|vo dialog nllq001 rikard 02.ogg}} '''Rekhar:''' Shh, don't cry... That man was just trying to scare us.

;(Talk to Sheikh Zubayr, optional)
:{{A|vo dialog nllq001 sheikhzubayr 01.ogg}} '''Sheikh Zubayr:''' Hmph, they get more and more unreasonable with each passing day.
:{{A|vo dialog nllq001 sheikhzubayr 02.ogg}} '''Sheikh Zubayr:''' I have to think of something...

;(Talk to Inayah, optional)
:{{A|vo dialog nllq001 inayah 02.ogg}} '''Inayah:''' Sorry, my father is always like that.
:{{A|vo dialog nllq001 inayah 03.ogg}} '''Inayah:''' Ugh...

;(Talk to Khasani, optional)
:{{A|vo dialog nllq001 qasani 03.ogg}} '''Khasani:''' The carefree warmth of summer will always give way to the bleak futility of winter.
:{{A|vo dialog nllq001 qasani 04.ogg}} '''Khasani:''' Man is even more fickle than the seasons.

;(Talk to Kourosh and Najia, optional)
:{{A|vo dialog nllq001 kourosh 03.ogg}} '''Kourosh:''' Why couldn't he just have a good faith discussion with us? There's always room for compromise.
:{{A|vo dialog nllq001 negar 03.ogg}} '''Najia:''' Well, if there really was, then we wouldn't be in this predicament.

;(Talk to Farhad and Hushang, optional)
:{{A|vo dialog nllq001 farhad 01.ogg}} '''Farhad:''' This just came out of nowhere. What'll happen next?
:{{A|vo dialog nllq001 hushang 02.ogg}} '''Hushang:''' Beats me. Everyone else must also be at a loss.

;(Talk to Nilou)
:{{A|vo nllq001 33 nilou 01.ogg}} '''Nilou:''' Sorry, I invited you thinking this was going to be a happy occasion. I didn't know that things would turn out like this...
:{{A|vo nllq001 33 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' There's no need to apologize, Nilou! No one could've seen this coming. *sigh* Paimon just wishes she could've at least gotten to the food...
:{{A|vo nllq001 33 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Is what that guy said true? The Akademiya has already given you many warnings?
:{{A|vo nllq001 33 nilou 02.ogg}} '''Nilou:''' Yeah, I guess you could say that. They've always seen us as being meaningless.
:{{A|vo nllq001 33 nilou 03.ogg}} '''Nilou:''' Knowledge is king in Sumeru, and their pursuit of it leaves no room for the arts.
:{{A|vo nllq001 33 nilou 04.ogg}} '''Nilou:''' But if that's all it is, there's also no reason to go so far as to demolish the theater.
:{{DIcon}} So it really has something to do with Inayah.
:{{A|vo nllq001 33 nilou 05.ogg}} '''Nilou:''' After Inayah ran away from home, I brought her here, to Zubayr Theater.
:{{A|vo nllq001 33 nilou 06.ogg}} '''Nilou:''' She rarely talks about her family. All I know is that she didn't get along with them.
:{{A|vo nllq001 33 nilou 07.ogg}} '''Nilou:''' I never expected it to blow up like this...
:{{A|vo nllq001 33 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' If you did nothing wrong, then there's no reason to listen to the Akademiya, right?
;(If the player has completed ''Where the Boat of Consciousness Lies'')
::{{DIcon}} I can ask Nahida to lend a hand.
::{{A|vo nllq001 34 nilou 01.ogg}} '''Nilou:''' Nahida... Ah!? You mean, Lesser Lord Kusanali!?
::{{A|vo nllq001 34 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' She'd probably help if she knew what was going on. No matter how nasty the Akademiya could get, surely they can't win against Lesser Lord Kusanali!
::{{A|vo nllq001 34 nilou 02.ogg}} '''Nilou:''' Nononono, I wasn't doubting her ability... I just feel like we shouldn't bother her with such a trivial problem.
::{{A|vo nllq001 34 nilou 03.ogg}} '''Nilou:''' Plus, if the Dendro Archon were to intervene... Then, it wouldn't feel like our victory was earned.
::{{A|vo nllq001 34 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' That's true...
:{{A|vo nllq001 35 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Who cares, let's just take them in a fight!
:{{DIcon}} That won't solve the underlying problem.
:{{DIcon}} We won't always be here.
:{{A|vo nllq001 35 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' That's true...
:{{A|vo nllq001 35 nilou 01.ogg}} '''Nilou:''' I'll try to think of something. We can't just let everyone suffer in a perpetual state of fear and uncertainty.
:{{A|vo nllq001 35 nilou 02.ogg}} '''Nilou:''' What to do, what to do...
:{{A|vo nllq001 35 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Can you pretend to shut down, but secretly continue to hold your shows somewhere else?
:{{A|vo nllq001 35 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Or we could go through a list of customers, and try to see if anyone in there might be willing to help out... Ugh, that also doesn't sound like it'll work.
:{{DIcon}} I think a scholar once told me that...
:{{DIcon}} Differences can be settled through a debate.
:{{A|vo nllq001 35 nilou 03.ogg}} '''Nilou:''' A debate? Hmm... Well, scholars do love to use them to solve their problems, but... how would that work in this case?
:{{DIcon}} We just need to prove...
:{{DIcon}} That the theater's existence has value.
:{{A|vo nllq001 35 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, if we can prove to Inayah's father that the Akademiya's position doesn't hold water, then they won't have a reason to demolish the theater!
:{{A|vo nllq001 35 nilou 04.ogg}} '''Nilou:''' I see. Defeating him in a debate...
:{{A|vo nllq001 35 nilou 05.ogg}} '''Nilou:''' It's a good idea, but which one of us could hope to win against a researcher...?
:;(The Traveler and Paimon look at Nilou expectantly)
:{{A|vo nllq001 35 nilou 06.ogg}} '''Nilou:''' Huh? Me?
:{{A|vo nllq001 35 nilou 07.ogg}} '''Nilou:''' Nonono, I'm the literal worst at arguments.
:{{A|vo nllq001 35 nilou 08.ogg}} '''Nilou:''' I can't debate...
:{{DIcon}} Debates aren't arguments.
:{{DIcon}} You debate to prove that you are right.
:{{A|vo nllq001 35 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Nilou, you are only so stressed out right now because you care so much about protecting the theater!
:{{A|vo nllq001 35 nilou 09.ogg}} '''Nilou:''' I...
:{{A|vo nllq001 35 nilou 10.ogg}} '''Nilou:''' This theater holds a special meaning in all of our hearts — it's irreplaceable.
:{{A|vo nllq001 35 nilou 11.ogg}} '''Nilou:''' But I just don't know... Can I really take on such a huge responsibility?
:{{DIcon}} You'll be fine as long as you prepare.
:{{DIcon}} I'll do my best to help.
:{{A|vo nllq001 35 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Paimon will help, too! You'll feel a lot more confident after doing some prep work. Believe in yourself!
:{{A|vo nllq001 35 nilou 12.ogg}} '''Nilou:''' Thanks, you two.
:{{A|vo nllq001 35 nilou 13.ogg}} '''Nilou:''' Alright, I've decided!
:{{A|vo nllq001 35 nilou 14.ogg}} '''Nilou:''' Even though I may fail, I'll do my very best for everyone's sake!
:{{A|vo nllq001 35 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' That's our Nilou! We're rooting for you!
:{{A|vo nllq001 35 nilou 15.ogg}} '''Nilou:''' Okay, let's head back and tell everyone what we came up with.
{{Dialogue End}}

==Dialogue==
{{Quest Description|Ayato claims that your job is done and that all that remains is to wait for the [[Kanjou Commission]]'s internal reaction. Will things really proceed as he thinks they will?}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Go to Ritou to check on the situation)

;(Talk to Hatanaka)
:{{A|vo lrlq003 5 hatanaka 01.ogg}} '''Hatanaka:''' Hello, how may I help?
:{{DIcon}} What are you doing?
:{{DIcon}} Why is there such a strong [[Tenryou Commission]] presence here?
:{{A|vo lrlq003 5 hatanaka 02.ogg}} '''Hatanaka:''' We arrived here two days ago to escort Lady Hiiragi to [[Inazuma City]].
:{{A|vo lrlq003 5 hatanaka 03.ogg}} '''Hatanaka:''' Sir [[Kujou Kamaji]] gave us very strict orders, so we have to obey. But every time we attempt to receive the bride, the [[Hiiragi Clan]] always finds an excuse to delay things.
:{{A|vo lrlq003 5 hatanaka 04.ogg}} '''Hatanaka:''' Since we haven't fulfilled our duties yet... we decided to stay in Ritou until Lady Hiiragi is ready to come with us.
:{{DIcon}} Everyone is scared.
:{{DIcon}} People suspect something is wrong.
:{{A|vo lrlq003 5 hatanaka 05.ogg}} '''Hatanaka:''' We apologize, it was not our intention to stay here so long.
:{{A|vo lrlq003 5 hatanaka 06.ogg}} '''Hatanaka:''' We promise our presence here will not impact ordinary people's lives. We can only hope that the leaders of the Hiiragi Clan will start to cooperate soon.
:{{A|vo lrlq003 5 hatanaka 07.ogg}} '''Hatanaka:''' If this stalemate continues, who knows... Sir Kujou might give us orders to be less accommodating...

;(Talk to Hatanaka again)
:{{A|vo dialog lrlq003 hatanaka 01.ogg}} '''Hatanaka:''' Whatever happens, please don't worry. We know where to draw the line.

----

;(Talk to Sasano or Kaede)
:{{A|vo lrlq003 1 sasano 01.ogg}} '''Sasano:''' These people from the Tenryou Commission have been here for days now.
:{{A|vo lrlq003 1 kaede 01.ogg}} '''Kaede:''' I guess they're here to pick up Lady Hiiragi... but why would it be taking so long?
:{{A|vo lrlq003 1 sasano 02.ogg}} '''Sasano:''' I heard that the Kanjou Commission suddenly said they don't want Lady Hiiragi to leave.
:{{A|vo lrlq003 1 sasano 03.ogg}} '''Sasano:''' To be honest, I'd be hesitant if I were her. A crowd this size comes to Ritou? Who knows what they could be planning.
:{{A|vo lrlq003 1 kaede 02.ogg}} '''Kaede:''' Shh! Stay quiet. Someone might hear you.
:{{A|vo lrlq003 1 sasano 04.ogg}} '''Sasano:''' Oh, right, sorry. Ugh, how did things get to this point...

;(Talk to Sasano or Kaede again)
:{{A|vo dialog lrlq003 kaede 01.ogg}} '''Kaede:''' I hope this is all resolved soon.
:{{A|vo dialog lrlq003 sasano 01.ogg}} '''Sasano:''' I know, right? What the heck is the Kanjou Commission doing...

----

;(Talk to Yasuaki or Hideo)
:{{A|vo lrlq003 3 yasuaki 01.ogg}} '''Yasuaki:''' How much longer does your Master plan to hold them off...
:{{A|vo lrlq003 3 hideo 01.ogg}} '''Hideo:''' I have no idea. We're stuck in limbo here.
:{{A|vo lrlq003 3 hideo 02.ogg}} '''Hideo:''' Master's been very on edge these past few days. He gets irate over the smallest things and is suspicious of everything... He's been yelling at me a lot...
:{{A|vo lrlq003 3 hideo 03.ogg}} '''Hideo:''' I understand that he's anxious, but I mean... what can we do? I've told him before — never cross the [[Yashiro Commission]]er.
:{{A|vo lrlq003 3 yasuaki 02.ogg}} '''Yasuaki:''' Yeah, good advice... With him, you just know that whatever he's doing, a lot of preparation has gone into it.
:{{A|vo lrlq003 3 yasuaki 03.ogg}} '''Yasuaki:''' If Lady Hiiragi is really taken away, then what will the Tenryou Commission do? And what will the Yashiro Commission do...
:{{A|vo lrlq003 3 hideo 04.ogg}} '''Hideo:''' Maybe we should tell Master to discuss things with Lady Hiiragi.

;(Talk to Yasuaki or Hideo again)
:{{A|vo dialog lrlq003 yasuaki 01.ogg}} '''Yasuaki:''' What's your Master thinking?
:{{A|vo dialog lrlq003 hideo 01.ogg}} '''Hideo:''' Ugh, with his temper, it's hard to say...
----
;(After talking to the people of Ritou)
:{{A|vo lrlq003 10 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hiiragi Chisato is now at the center of every conversation in Ritou.
:{{A|vo lrlq003 10 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' By now, the Kanjou Commission probably knows how important she is... but what about what she thinks?
:{{A|vo lrlq003 10 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Let's go and see.

;(Optional — Talk to [[Ide]] at the stairs near Kaeda and Sasano)
:{{A|vo dialog lrlq003 ide 01.ogg}} '''Ide:''' Sorry for the disruption. We're still waiting for further orders.
;(Ide walks towards Ritou entrance afterwards)

;(Optional — Talk to [[Okabayashi]] near Yasuaki and Hideo)
:{{A|vo dialog lrlq003 okabayashi 01.ogg}} '''Okabayashi:''' Don't worry, the negotiations with the Kanjou Commission should be coming to an end very soon.
;(Okabayashi walks towards Ritou entrance afterwards)

;(Optional — Talk to [[Yokoyama]] at the Hiiragi Estate gate)
:{{A|vo dialog lrlq003 yokoyama 01.ogg}} '''Yokoyama:''' Please leave. Due to an ongoing emergency, we are receiving no guests at present except where a special invitation is given.

----
;(Meet and talk to Hiiragi Chisato)
:{{A|vo lrlq003 11 hiiragichisato 01.ogg}} '''Hiiragi Chisato:''' Oh, Traveler!
:{{A|vo lrlq003 11 hiiragichisato 02.ogg}} '''Hiiragi Chisato:''' I assume you've heard about everything that's been going on out there? What on earth is happening?
:{{A|vo lrlq003 11 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Don't worry, we can explain everything. So, what happened was—
:{{DIcon}} Hold on, someone might be eavesdropping.
:{{DIcon}} Let me check it out.
:{{Black Screen|You make sure that no one is eavesdropping before explaining the whole situation to Hiiragi Chisato.}}
:{{A|vo lrlq003 11 hiiragichisato 03.ogg}} '''Hiiragi Chisato:''' After the Tenryou Commission arrived, they suddenly became alarmed. They keep having secretive discussions and won't allow me to have any direct contact with the Tenryou Commission.
:{{A|vo lrlq003 11 hiiragichisato 04.ogg}} '''Hiiragi Chisato:''' I never would have thought that... this was Sir Kamisato's plan... Now it all makes sense.
:{{DIcon}} Since we last met...
:{{DIcon}} ...have you made your mind up?
:{{A|vo lrlq003 11 hiiragichisato 05.ogg}} '''Hiiragi Chisato:''' ...I'm sorry, I haven't.
:{{A|vo lrlq003 11 hiiragichisato 06.ogg}} '''Hiiragi Chisato:''' "Maybe there's no right or wrong decision... maybe everything would be easier if I simply didn't have a choice"...
:{{A|vo lrlq003 11 hiiragichisato 07.ogg}} '''Hiiragi Chisato:''' I used to tell myself things like this to avoid having to think about it. But once I saw the notices appearing out of nowhere on the streets, signaling that the wedding was confirmed...
:{{A|vo lrlq003 11 hiiragichisato 08.ogg}} '''Hiiragi Chisato:''' I didn't feel reassured at all. Instead, I felt a great sense of regret.
:{{A|vo lrlq003 11 hiiragichisato 09.ogg}} '''Hiiragi Chisato:''' I keep thinking back to what Sir Kamisato said. This is supposed to be my bright and beautiful future... but what if it's not?
:{{DIcon}} This is exactly what he is worried about.
:{{DIcon}} You can't rush into important things.
:{{A|vo lrlq003 11 hiiragichisato 10.ogg}} '''Hiiragi Chisato:''' I can happily accept that if someone was trying to take advantage of my marriage, I should absolutely refuse to go through with it...
:{{A|vo lrlq003 11 hiiragichisato 11.ogg}} '''Hiiragi Chisato:''' But that's not the answer I'm looking for. And also... now that things have escalated to this point, it will be tricky to resolve...
:{{A|vo lrlq003 11 matsuura 01.ogg}} '''[[Matsuura]]:''' Ah, Lady Hiiragi, here you are. You scared me for a second. I thought you'd gone missing...
:{{A|vo lrlq003 11 matsuura 02.ogg}} '''Matsuura:''' You... Wait, you're the ones who were with the Yashiro Commissioner that day!
:{{A|vo lrlq003 11 matsuura 03.ogg}} '''Matsuura:''' What do you think you're doing here? Are you trying to convince Lady Hiiragi to leave!?
:{{A|vo lrlq003 11 hiiragichisato 12a.ogg}} '''Hiiragi Chisato:''' Calm down. They're my friends. They're just here to visit me.
:{{A|vo lrlq003 11 matsuura 04.ogg}} '''Matsuura:''' Friends? Are you sure? Just friends?
:{{A|vo lrlq003 11 matsuura 05.ogg}} '''Matsuura:''' Lady Hiiragi, I told you already, these are exceptional circumstances. You need to be more vigilant in everything you do.
:{{A|vo lrlq003 11 matsuura 06.ogg}} '''Matsuura:''' You are extremely important to us and to the entire Kanjou Commission...
:{{A|vo lrlq003 11 matsuura 07a.ogg}} '''Matsuura:''' Who's to say... they don't have a hidden agenda?
:{{A|vo lrlq003 11 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' If you wanna accuse us of trying to abduct her, just come out and say it!
:{{DIcon}} You're acting far less dignified than when we last met.
:{{A|vo lrlq003 11 hiiragichisato 13.ogg}} '''Hiiragi Chisato:''' Don't be rude. You've been very highly strung lately, seeing everything as a threat.
:{{A|vo lrlq003 11 matsuura 08.ogg}} '''Matsuura:''' I... Ugh...
:{{DIcon}} You won't even follow Lady Hiiragi's orders now?
:{{A|vo lrlq003 11 hiiragichisato 14a.ogg}} {{A|vo lrlq003 11 hiiragichisato 14b.ogg}} '''Hiiragi Chisato:''' Listen to me. I know all the ins and outs of everything that's happened so far. {{MC|His|Her|mc=1}} arrival might well be your very last chance to fix this.
:{{A|vo lrlq003 11 hiiragichisato 15.ogg}} '''Hiiragi Chisato:''' The present state of affairs in Ritou shows me that the situation has escalated well past the point where you could hope to control it. If this deadlock continues any longer, we will have nothing to gain and much to lose.
:{{A|vo lrlq003 11 hiiragichisato 16.ogg}} '''Hiiragi Chisato:''' This is not an order. All I need you to do is give me an explanation and take responsibility for the situation.
:{{A|vo lrlq003 11 matsuura 09.ogg}} '''Matsuura:''' ...
:{{A|vo lrlq003 11 matsuura 10.ogg}} '''Matsuura:''' Understood, my lady. I shall discuss with the others right away.
:{{A|vo lrlq003 11 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Good job, Chisato! You handled that well!
:{{A|vo lrlq003 11 hiiragichisato 17.ogg}} '''Hiiragi Chisato:''' I was so nervous. But I thought, things are now so critical that I should at least give it a try... and it worked remarkably well.
:{{DIcon}} That's what I call a voice of authority.
:{{A|vo lrlq003 11 hiiragichisato 18.ogg}} '''Hiiragi Chisato:''' Yes, well, let's wait and see what happens. I hope they provide a satisfactory response.
:{{Black Screen|A while later, Matsuura comes back with his tail between his legs.}}
:{{A|vo lrlq003 11 matsuura 11.ogg}} '''Matsuura:''' We had a serious discussion and reflected on our mistakes.
:{{A|vo lrlq003 11 matsuura 12.ogg}} '''Matsuura:''' In all honesty... no one can handle the weight of the situation here. Everyone is besides themselves with worry. It'll drive us mad if it continues any longer.
:{{A|vo lrlq003 11 matsuura 13.ogg}} '''Matsuura:''' Ah! I'm so sorry, my actions were radical and duplicitous, I was selfish and ignored the greater good, and then I left the situation to fester...
:{{A|vo lrlq003 11 matsuura 14.ogg}} '''Matsuura:''' Would you... would you please give us a second chance? For my lady's sake, please, give the Kanjou Commission another chance...
:{{DIcon}} It's no use talking to me.
:{{DIcon}} You'll have to talk to Kamisato Ayato.
:{{A|vo lrlq003 11 matsuura 15.ogg}} '''Matsuura:''' I suppose you're right...
:{{A|vo lrlq003 11 matsuura 16.ogg}} '''Matsuura:''' The only person who can change the Tenryou Commission's mind will be the Yashiro Commissioner.
:{{A|vo lrlq003 11 matsuura 17.ogg}} '''Matsuura:''' We'll head off to the Kamisato Estate shortly, and beseech him to help us with the utmost sincerity.
:{{A|vo lrlq003 11 matsuura 18.ogg}} '''Matsuura:''' Lady Hiiragi, might I ask you to join us? You are the most important person... Without you, we have no other way...

;(On the way to the Kamisato Estate)
:{{A|vo lrlq003 12 matsuura 01.ogg}} '''Matsuura:''' By the way, aren't you a good friend of the Yashiro Commissioner?
:{{A|vo lrlq003 12 matsuura 02.ogg}} '''Matsuura:''' Please put in some good words for me.

----
;(Go to the Kamisato Estate to meet Ayato)
:{{A|vo lrlq003 13 matsuura 01.ogg}} '''Matsuura:''' Yashiro Commissioner, I'm sure you've heard the news... The Tenryou Commission has now occupied Ritou, refusing to leave until we hand Lady Hiiragi over to them.
:{{A|vo lrlq003 13 matsuura 02.ogg}} '''Matsuura:''' I realize I've greatly offended you with my atrocious actions, and I realize also that this must sound like the very height of absurdity, but please... have mercy, good sir...
:{{A|vo lrlq003 13 ayato 01.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' I'm sorry, Mr. Matsuura, I'm exceptionally busy, and have but a moment to spare before my next engagement. I fear this leaves no time for small talk.
:{{A|vo lrlq003 13 ayato 02.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' So please, if you would be so kind, get straight to the point.
:{{A|vo lrlq003 13 matsuura 03.ogg}} '''Matsuura:''' Ugh...
:{{A|vo lrlq003 13 matsuura 04.ogg}} '''Matsuura:''' I know our apology means nothing to you, but we really have nothing else left to offer by this point. I'm terribly sorry... Everyone in the entire Kanjou Commission now realizes the gravity of this situation.
:{{A|vo lrlq003 13 matsuura 05.ogg}} '''Matsuura:''' Lady Hiiragi is indispensable to us. We promise to always support her.
:{{A|vo lrlq003 13 matsuura 06.ogg}} '''Matsuura:''' So, would it be at all possible for you to talk to Sir Kujou once more, on our behalf?
:{{A|vo lrlq003 13 ayato 03.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' You make it sound so easy. The [[Tri-Commission]] will be ridiculed by the public if we choose to withdraw the notices now and eat our words. What do you plan to do about this?
:{{A|vo lrlq003 13 ayato 04.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' To lose face for the Tri-Commission is to bring shame to [[Raiden Shogun|Her Excellency]]. Are you and your associates ready to face the thunderous wrath of the Almighty Shogun?
:{{A|vo lrlq003 13 matsuura 07.ogg}} '''Matsuura:''' We... We'll take full responsibility. We'll publish a new notice and hold a conference to explain the situation. We will make sure that the public knows this was all a huge misunderstanding.
:{{A|vo lrlq003 13 matsuura 08.ogg}} '''Matsuura:''' We'll do everything we can to minimize the impact, everything we can...
:{{A|vo lrlq003 13 ayato 05.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' ...Master Matsuura, you should have known it would come to this. Whatever were you thinking?
:{{A|vo lrlq003 13 ayato 06.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' But the Tri-Commission must always put the interests of Inazuma first, regardless of what Sir Kujou and I may feel at this present moment.
:{{A|vo lrlq003 13 ayato 07.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' If the situation in Ritou is left to fester any further, things may get out of control. But Lady Hiiragi and the inhabitants of Ritou are innocent.
:{{A|vo lrlq003 13 ayato 08.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' If we fail to contain the situation promptly, the rumor mill will wreak havoc on the Tri-Commission's reputation.
:{{A|vo lrlq003 13 ayato 09.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' Try keeping a pet bird, you'll see what I mean. Songbirds who know how to hold a tune can be very pleasant to listen to, but they can also become irritating if they don't know when to stop.
:{{A|vo lrlq003 13 ayato 10.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' And as for the ones with excessively long tongues, well they're so insufferable that they can't be kept as pets at all... But it doesn't take a moment to cut out their tongues and silence them for good.
:{{A|vo lrlq003 13 matsuura 09.ogg}} '''Matsuura:''' ...Y—Yes... I understand!
:{{A|vo lrlq003 13 ayato 11.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' I've listened to your concerns, and I'll talk to Sir Kujou for you. But I can't guarantee that he will change his mind.
:{{A|vo lrlq003 13 matsuura 10.ogg}} '''Matsuura:''' I understand. Thank you for your help, Yashiro Commissioner!
:{{A|vo lrlq003 13 ayato 12.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' Alright, you ought to return now. I'm sure you have a sizable mess to deal with back in the Kanjou Commission?
:{{A|vo lrlq003 13 matsuura 11.ogg}} '''Matsuura:''' Okay, then please excuse me... Thank you once again, Commissioner!
;(Matsuura leaves)
:{{A|vo lrlq003 13 ayato 13.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' Ah yes, Lady Hiiragi, I have something to tell you. Would you mind?
:{{A|vo lrlq003 13 hiiragichisato 01.ogg}} '''Hiiragi Chisato:''' Oh? Why, of course...
:{{A|vo lrlq003 13 hiiragichisato 02.ogg}} '''Hiiragi Chisato:''' Sir Kamisato, you became a completely different person just now. It felt so intense.
:{{A|vo lrlq003 13 ayato 14.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' Unruly servants like him need to be severely reprimanded. As a commissioner, the Almighty Shogun trusts me to do her will. I did as I should.
:{{A|vo lrlq003 13 ayato 15.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' But now I'd like to take off my commissioner hat and share a personal story with you.
:{{A|vo lrlq003 13 hiiragichisato 03.ogg}} '''Hiiragi Chisato:''' Oh, please. I'd love to hear it.
:{{A|vo lrlq003 13 ayato 16.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' You must've heard that the [[Kamisato Clan]] once went through an extremely difficult period.
:{{A|vo lrlq003 13 ayato 17.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' My father worked incredibly hard to compensate for the grave errors made by the Kamisato Clan long ago and restore our reputation. The work took a toll on his health, and ultimately led to his untimely demise.
:{{A|vo lrlq003 13 ayato 18.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' My [[Kamisato Kayo|mother]] loved him dearly. She passed soon after.
:{{A|vo lrlq003 13 ayato 19.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' This sudden turn of events dealt a heavy blow to the Yashiro Commission. Behind the scenes, things became very unstable.
:{{A|vo lrlq003 13 ayato 20.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' Everyone thought that the Kamisato Clan had lost power. That made my sister and me nothing but burdens hindering the ambitions of others.
:{{A|vo lrlq003 13 ayato 21.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' It may sound preposterous now, but I assure you that is the truth of what the Yashiro Commission has been through.
:{{A|vo lrlq003 13 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh, pretty similar to how the Kanjou Commission is now...
:{{A|vo lrlq003 13 ayato 22.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' Back then, I had no choice but to accept the position I was in. While I desperately looked around for powerful supporters, I endured smear campaigns and attempts to exploit me.
:{{A|vo lrlq003 13 ayato 23.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' I had no other choice. I had to honor my parents' dying wishes, and I also had a [[Kamisato Ayaka|young sister]] to take care of.
:{{A|vo lrlq003 13 ayato 24.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' I didn't mind what became of me, but my family... No one can ever be allowed to trample over my precious family.
:{{A|vo lrlq003 13 ayato 25.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' Fortunately, I persisted, and the Kamisato Clan was able to survive this storm.
:{{A|vo lrlq003 13 hiiragichisato 04.ogg}} '''Hiiragi Chisato:''' ...I think I now know where my sense of loss and confusion was coming from.
:{{A|vo lrlq003 13 hiiragichisato 05.ogg}} '''Hiiragi Chisato:''' [[Shinnojou]] once told me that he saw what was in me, in a way that no one else did... That's why he couldn't bear to see me live the rest of my life depending on someone else...
:{{A|vo lrlq003 13 hiiragichisato 06.ogg}} '''Hiiragi Chisato:''' I thought the reason I felt unsettled was because of uncertainty over getting married. But the fact is, it's because I felt too young and inexperienced to handle the situation facing me.
:{{A|vo lrlq003 13 ayato 26.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' The reason why Sir Kujou was able to face the prospect of marriage so confidently is because he's prepared for anything.
:{{A|vo lrlq003 13 hiiragichisato 07.ogg}} '''Hiiragi Chisato:''' ...That's it. The situation I'm facing now is the same one he faced back then.
:{{A|vo lrlq003 13 hiiragichisato 08.ogg}} '''Hiiragi Chisato:''' When his clan was in crisis, he bravely drew his blade and challenged the Almighty Shogun. And now...
:{{A|vo lrlq003 13 hiiragichisato 09.ogg}} '''Hiiragi Chisato:''' It is time for me to make a stand, and become my own person.
:{{A|vo lrlq003 13 ayato 27.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' Well said. I'm sure once you have grown and gained confidence, your father will be able to let go and allow you to decide how you want to live the rest of your life.
:{{A|vo lrlq003 13 ayato 28.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' It might not sound exciting, but this kind of personal growth is a necessary step in the pursuit of true happiness.
:{{A|vo lrlq003 13 hiiragichisato 10.ogg}} '''Hiiragi Chisato:''' ...And I'm sure I can get there.
:{{A|vo lrlq003 13 hiiragichisato 11.ogg}} '''Hiiragi Chisato:''' I will use this as an opportunity to take over the responsibilities of the Hiiragi Clan. I'll think about marriage again after everything is more settled.
:{{A|vo lrlq003 13 hiiragichisato 12.ogg}} '''Hiiragi Chisato:''' This puts less pressure on Kamaji, and means I can support and protect myself without having to worry about becoming a burden or dependent on someone else.
:{{A|vo lrlq003 13 ayato 29.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' My best wishes to both of you were and remain heartfelt. When the time comes for the wedding to go ahead, I will come to congratulate you once more.
:{{A|vo lrlq003 13 hiiragichisato 13.ogg}} '''Hiiragi Chisato:''' Thank you, Sir Kamisato. I am grateful for everything you have shared with me.
:{{A|vo lrlq003 13 hiiragichisato 14.ogg}} '''Hiiragi Chisato:''' Now, if you'll excuse me, I have a lot to deal with back home.
:{{A|vo lrlq003 13 ayato 30.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' Take care, Lady Hiiragi. I'm confident that on your return, you will find your Kanjou Commission associates most receptive to your instruction.
:{{A|vo lrlq003 13 hiiragichisato 15.ogg}} '''Hiiragi Chisato:''' Yes, in fact my recent experience suggests the same. Thank you once again.
;(Hiiragi Chisato leaves)
:{{A|vo lrlq003 13 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' She really has the air of a leader now.
:{{DIcon}} She has a lot in common with Kamaji.
:{{DIcon}} They really are a good match for each other.
:{{A|vo lrlq003 13 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hats off to you too, sir! Everyone thought there was no way out until you pulled that super smart strategy out of nowhere!
:{{A|vo lrlq003 13 ayato 31.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' In fact, counter checking is a perfectly common maneuver in the game of chess.
:{{A|vo lrlq003 13 ayato 32.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' Our rival this time was easy to deal with. He was smart, but short-sighted, and sloppy in his execution. This outcome is entirely within my expectation.
:{{A|vo lrlq003 13 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Even so... Paimon could never come up with a plan that cunning in a whole lifetime!
:{{A|vo lrlq003 13 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Anyway, it's kind of a relief to see that Chisato has decided to set the Hiiragi Clan straight.
:{{A|vo lrlq003 13 ayato 33.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' I agree. Stability in Inazuma benefits me, as well. I wasn't about to pass up an opportunity to make less trouble for myself.
:{{DIcon}} Speaking about your stance...
:{{DIcon}} You weren't in this just to help Chisato, were you?
:{{A|vo lrlq003 13 ayato 34.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' Hahaha, well, the fact is that I am first and foremost the Yashiro Commissioner.
:{{A|vo lrlq003 13 ayato 35.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' Perhaps for Master Matsuura, power is his life's pursuit. But for me, nothing matters more than the stability of Inazuma.
:{{A|vo lrlq003 13 ayato 36.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' A stable nation is the prerequisite for a stable Yashiro Commission. Only then can the Kamisato Clan and the other Yashiro Commission clans have a peaceful existence.
:{{A|vo lrlq003 13 ayato 37.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' But human desire will always be a factor in the equation. This is not the first situation of its kind, nor will it be the last.
:{{A|vo lrlq003 13 ayato 38.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' All I have tried to do is make sure the three parties to the Tri-Commission serve to restrain each other. Stasis is not the only form of stability. A balance of power leaving no room for maneuver achieves the same end.
:{{DIcon}} Balance of power...
:{{DIcon}} Mutual restraint...
:{{A|vo lrlq003 13 ayato 39.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' Another positive outcome is that everyone recognizes how important Lady Hiiragi is now. I think I did her a sizable favor in that regard.
:{{A|vo lrlq003 13 ayato 40.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' Dealing with the Hiiragi Clan will be much easier for her than navigating a new and unfamiliar one.
:{{A|vo lrlq003 13 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Whew, there were so many things at play over this one wedding...
:{{A|vo lrlq003 13 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' ...Wait a second, you weren't trying to stop the wedding from the very beginning, were you!?
:{{A|vo lrlq003 13 ayato 41.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' Hmm? I thought straight away it was bad timing. Nevertheless, everything I said to Hiiragi Chisato was entirely sincere.
:{{A|vo lrlq003 13 ayato 42.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' If you choose to give up your stance on something once, you'll be having to compromise for the rest of your life.
:{{A|vo lrlq003 13 ayato 43.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' I didn't want to see her suffer because she didn't realize what she was getting into.
:{{A|vo lrlq003 13 ayato 44.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' Now, she has the chance to become her own person. Let's see who she becomes.
:{{A|vo lrlq003 13 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Okay then, guess we'll have to wait and see...
:{{DIcon}} See you next time.
:{{A|vo lrlq003 13 ayato 45.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' Alright, farewell and profuse thanks to you both. I shall have to host you at the Kamisato Estate when my sister is next available.
;(The Traveler and Paimon leave)
:{{A|vo lrlq003 13 thoma 01.ogg}} '''[[Thoma]]:''' Looks like everything's resolved.
:{{A|vo lrlq003 13 thoma 02.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' Masterfully done, everything was perfect. Well, except for one minor detail... I somehow ended up with a glass of very peculiar-tasting milk.
:{{A|vo lrlq003 13 ayato 46.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' Hmm? Didn't you like it? I distinctly remember you saying you are quite partial to exotic flavors.
:{{A|vo lrlq003 13 thoma 03.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' Oh, my lord...
:{{A|vo lrlq003 13 ayato 47.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' The Traveler had one of those as well.
:{{A|vo lrlq003 13 thoma 04a.ogg}} {{A|vo lrlq003 13 thoma 04b.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' I'm sure {{MC|he|she|mc=1}}'s made a great impression on you.
:{{A|vo lrlq003 13 ayato 48a.ogg}} {{A|vo lrlq003 13 ayato 48b.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' The Traveler did indeed play a critical role in this case. I'm sure both families would have been more guarded against me had {{MC|he|she|mc=1}} and {{MC|his|her|mc=1}} companion not been present.
:{{A|vo lrlq003 13 ayato 49.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' It wouldn't have been so easy to get to the heart of the matter.
:{{A|vo lrlq003 13 thoma 05.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' There you go again, my lord. Placing the focus on other people while discreetly performing your job to perfection.
:{{A|vo lrlq003 13 ayato 50.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' Naturally. Ah yes, now that we're both free, let's finish off that game of chess we started a few days ago.
;(Quest ends)

;(Talk to Thoma or Ayato again after the quest ends — if the player re-enters the Kamisato Estate)
:{{A|vo dialog lrlq003 thoma 01.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' Actually, I don't think there's much point continuing that game... I'm pretty sure I don't have a chance of winning.
:{{A|vo dialog lrlq003 ayato 01.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' Hehe, well, I've forgotten where we left off amidst the activity of the past few days. Don't you want to take this opportunity to try and best me for once?
:{{A|vo dialog lrlq003 thoma 02.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' If you say so... alright, I'll give it my best shot!

;(Read the bulletin board)
:'''Shogunate Announcement:''' Please take note that the announcement concerning the marriage between Sir Kujou Kamaji and Lady Hiiragi Chisato has been found to have been released in error due to a miscommunication within the Kanjou Commission.
:'''Shogunate Announcement:''' We sincerely apologize for any subsequent confusion or misunderstandings.
:'''Shogunate Announcement:''' The staff involved have been held to severe account, and the [[Shogunate]] wishes again to emphasize the importance of communication and discipline.
:'''Shogunate Announcement:''' Let it be known that the matrimonial ceremonies have been delayed, and that further details will become available at a later date.
{{Dialogue End}}

'''''The Wingless One of Tlalocan''''' is the first act of {{Quest|Of Fading Flowers and Falling Feathers}}.

==Start Location==
Start the quest by talking to [[Coyllur]] west of the [[Quahuacan Cliff]] Statue of the Seven.
<gallery>
The Wingless One of Tlalocan Start Location.png|The Wingless One of Tlalocan's start location
Story Quest The Wingless One of Tlalocan Start Location Context.png|Additional context
</gallery>

==Steps==
# Head to the area near the [[Flower-Feather Clan]]
# [[Saurian Indwelling|Indwell]] a [[Qucusaurus]] to get close to Coyllur
# Perform an indwelling and then talk to Coyllur
# Go to check on Coyllur
# Head to the Flower-Feather Clan
# Talk to [[Chasca]]
# Coordinate with Chasca by splitting up
# Talk to [[Cusco]]
# Go to the Obsidian Totem Pole
# Talk to [[Allpa]]
# Talk to the Wingless (0/3)

* If {{Quest|For the Same Land}} is active, this quest may be blocked until the former is completed.
