;(Approach Coyllur)
:{{A|vo qsklq001 1 coyllur 01.ogg}} '''???:''' ...♪
:{{A|vo qsklq001 1 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh? What's that sound? Seems like it's coming from that bridge.

;(Talk to Coyllur)
:'''???:''' ...♪
:{{A|vo qsklq001 2 coyllur 01.ogg}} '''???:''' *sob*... *sob*...
:{{A|vo qsklq001 2 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh no, why's she crying? Should we go check on her? Y'know, just in case she's... thinking of doing something stupid...
:{{A|vo qsklq001 2 chasca 01.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' I'd leave her be.
:{{A|vo qsklq001 2 chasca 02.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' The warriors of the Flower-Feather Clan are a proud bunch, who never show their vulnerability in public... Even if they've gone wingless.
;(Before completing [[The Rainbow Destined to Burn]]){{Verify}}
::{{A|Vo qsklq001 2 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, you're that fan favorite from the [[Stadium of the Sacred Flame]]! Ch... Ch...
::{{A|Vo qsklq001 2 chasca 03.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' I'm flattered that you remember my name. Your reputations precede you too, Travelers.
::{{A|Vo qsklq001 2 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So what are you doing here? Paimon figured you'd all be off fighting in the [[Night Warden Wars]] by now.
::{{A|Vo qsklq001 2 chasca 04.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' I'll be heading there shortly. But there are some things I want to get taken care of before I go.
;(After completing [[The Rainbow Destined to Burn]])
::{{A|vo qsklq001 2 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh! ...Chasca?
::{{A|vo qsklq001 2 chasca 05.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' Good to see you again, {{Traveler}} and Paimon.
:{{A|vo qsklq001 2 chasca 06.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' Before we carry on — let's get a little further away before Coyllur notices us.
:{{A|vo qsklq001 2 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So that girl on the bridge — Coyllur, you said? Should she really be on her own right now? With the mental state she's in, it just seems risky...
:{{A|vo qsklq001 2 chasca 07.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' Don't worry, that's exactly why I'm here. Elder Allpa sent me to keep an eye on her. If she does attempt the unthinkable, I'll swoop in and catch her.
:{{A|vo qsklq001 2 chasca 08.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' I doubt it'll come to that, though. She's a fighter — a warrior, in fact. One who aimed for the sky. However despondent she might feel now, I'm confident she'll get through it.
:{{DIcon}} What do you mean, "aimed for the sky"?
:{{A|vo qsklq001 2 chasca 09.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' Well, in the Flower-Feather Clan there's an elite flying squad made up of qucusaur riders.
:{{A|vo qsklq001 2 chasca 10.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' But it's an extremely selective squad. To become a rider, you need to undergo a trial where you not only demonstrate mastery of the relevant skills, but also win the approval of the qucusaurs. Very few candidates make it through the process.
:{{A|vo qsklq001 2 chasca 11.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' Coyllur has spent years training for her most recent attempt, but unfortunately she didn't pass... So it's not hard to see why she's so upset.
:{{DIcon}} And when you mentioned "going wingless," what does that mean?
:{{A|vo qsklq001 2 chasca 12.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' Sometimes, after multiple failed attempts to pass the flying test and win the qucusaurs' approval, people get so disheartened that they give up on their dream to soar the skies.
:{{A|vo qsklq001 2 chasca 13.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' They resolve to quit trying for good. We call those people the "Wingless."
:{{A|vo qsklq001 2 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' *gasp* Do they get expelled from the tribe!?
:{{A|vo qsklq001 2 chasca 14.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' What? No, of course not. They're still prized warriors.
:{{A|vo qsklq001 2 chasca 15.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' We have a saying: "Just as the qucusaur treasures every feather on its body, so the tribe treasures each one of its children."
;(If the player has completed [[The Rainbow Destined to Burn]]){{Verify}}
::{{A|vo qsklq001 2 chasca 16.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' This hits even harder in the wake of the war... All of our young warriors carry the future of our tribe on their shoulders.
:{{A|vo qsklq001 2 chasca 17.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' Besides, every qucusaur falls from its nest before it learns to fly. It's practically a rite of passage. Likewise, for the Wingless, we always hold out hope that one day when they're ready, they'll rekindle their dreams and keep trying.
:{{A|vo qsklq001 2 chasca 18.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' Until then, all we can do is quietly watch over them from a distance... just like I'm doing now.
:{{A|vo qsklq001 2 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Aw, okay... Paimon hopes she'll get back on her feet soon!
:{{A|vo qsklq001 2 chasca 19.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' ...Well, from the sound of her whistling, her confidence has been seriously shaken. No qucusaur is gonna respond to a call that sounds like that.
:{{DIcon}} Whistling?
:{{DIcon}} Call?
:{{A|vo qsklq001 2 chasca 20.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' Yeah, people from my tribe call to their saurian companions by whistling or blowing a horn. So it sounds like Coyllur was trying to summon a qucusaur to practice her flying.
:{{A|vo qsklq001 2 chasca 21.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' But the qucusaurs are an even prouder bunch than our warriors... They would never respond to a lackluster whistle like that.
:{{A|vo qsklq001 2 chasca 22.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' First she failed the trial, and now she's struggling to even summon a qucusaur. That's only gonna hurt her confidence further... And getting trapped in that vicious circle is the kind of thing that'll make people go wingless.
:{{A|vo qsklq001 2 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Surely, there must be something we can do to help?
:{{A|vo qsklq001 2 chasca 23.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' That's very kind of you. Coyllur's flying skills are up to par, but mentally, she's stuck in a rut. If she wants to return to the sky, she has to overcome that for herself.
:{{A|vo qsklq001 2 chasca 24.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' I'm going to lay low nearby, just in case she takes a turn for the worse. Let me give you a tour around the tribe once this is all over.
:'''Coyllur:''' ...♪
:{{A|vo qsklq001 2 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Coyllur still isn't giving up! Even though Chasca said that she has to do this by herself, Paimon can't help feeling like maybe we can nudge her in the right direction...
:{{A|vo qsklq001 2 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hmm... What if we could get a qucusaur to fly up to her? That might give her the confidence boost she needs.
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (Actually, that sounds like a plan...)

;(Approach Coyllur while indwelling a Qucusaur)
:{{A|vo qsklq001 3 coyllur 01.ogg}} '''Coyllur:''' It's... It's a qu-qucusaur! Oh my gosh, is this really happening? I did it, I summoned one!
:{{A|vo qsklq001 3 coyllur 02.ogg}} '''Coyllur:''' I was beginning to think you'd all given up on me completely... Thank you! Oh, thank you...
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (Looks like her mood's lifted. Now to wait till she's not looking, and fly outta here...)
:{{A|vo qsklq001 3 coyllur 03.ogg}} '''Coyllur:''' Excuse me... would you mind if we did some flying practice together right now?
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (...!)
:{{A|vo qsklq001 3 coyllur 04.ogg}} '''Coyllur:''' I think I know where I went wrong in the test now — I need to maintain a higher speed on my turns! So I just gotta practice my Bell Tailslides and Split S maneuvers...
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (Yikes, those sound complicated... I'm out of my depth. This is too dangerous.)
:{{A|vo qsklq001 3 coyllur 05.ogg}} '''Coyllur:''' ...Also, I really wanna try some stall turns and cobra maneuvers...
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (Crikey. I've never even carried a passenger, let alone while doing all that... I need to get out of here!)
:'''???:''' ...♪
:{{A|vo qsklq001 3 coyllur 06.ogg}} '''Coyllur:''' Huh? That sounded like a whistle... Is someone else trying to summon a qucusaur?
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (Now's my chance!)
:{{A|vo qsklq001 3 coyllur 07.ogg}} '''Coyllur:''' Hey! Wait! Wait...
:{{Black Screen|With the whistle providing the perfect cover, you make your escape...}}

;(After the cutscene)
:{{A|vo qsklq001 4 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Do you think Coyllur's feeling better now? Let's go back to that bridge and check!

;(Approach Chasca and Coyllur)
:{{A|vo qsklq001 5 coyllur 01.ogg}} '''Coyllur:''' Chasca! I summoned a qucusaur! They do still respond to me after all!
:{{A|vo qsklq001 5 coyllur 02.ogg}} '''Coyllur:''' ...Although unfortunately, someone else summoned it away again before I had a chance to go for a flight...
:{{A|vo qsklq001 5 chasca 01.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' Oh really? That is unfortunate... But if you can do it once, you can it again. Keep at it, and you'll pass the trial eventually.
:{{A|vo qsklq001 5 coyllur 03.ogg}} '''Coyllur:''' You're right! You know, I almost thought about giving up, but I'm glad I didn't.
:{{A|vo qsklq001 5 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hey, Chasca! How's Coyllur doing?
:{{A|vo qsklq001 5 coyllur 04.ogg}} '''Coyllur:''' Huh? Who are you? And how do you know my name...?
:{{A|vo qsklq001 5 chasca 02.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' Ahem, these are, uh... my friends. {{Traveler}} and Paimon.
:{{A|vo qsklq001 5 chasca 03a.ogg}}<!--{{A|vo qsklq001 5 chasca 03b.ogg}}--> '''Chasca:''' You came up in conversation the other day, because... I was telling them about up-and-coming warriors in our tribe.
:{{A|vo qsklq001 5 coyllur 05.ogg}} '''Coyllur:''' Oh, {{Traveler}}, huh? So that's you? ...Uh, what do you mean up-and-coming? *sigh* I'm closer to being wingless than I am to passing the trial...
:{{A|vo qsklq001 5 coyllur 06.ogg}} '''Coyllur:''' Anyway... We haven't met before, have we? You look so familiar somehow...
:{{A|vo qsklq001 5 chasca 04a.ogg}} {{A|vo qsklq001 5 chasca 04b.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' Hmm... Maybe you saw {{MC|m=him|f=her}} in the stadium? Or anywhere, really. {{MC|m=He|f=She}}'s been all over Natlan lately, so it's not surprising that you've seen {{MC|m=him|f=her}} around.
:{{A|vo qsklq001 5 coyllur 07.ogg}} '''Coyllur:''' ...If you say so...
:{{DIcon}} ...Yeah, that must be it.
:{{A|vo qsklq001 5 allpa 01.ogg}} '''Allpa:''' Coyllur! Chasca!
:{{A|vo qsklq001 5 allpa 02.ogg}} '''Allpa:''' Here you are. I've been looking everywhere for you two.
:{{A|vo qsklq001 5 coyllur 08.ogg}} '''Coyllur:''' Oh, Elder Allpa! What's the matter?
:{{A|vo qsklq001 5 allpa 03.ogg}} '''Allpa:''' I thought I should tell you myself... We're going to redo the flying trials.
:{{A|vo qsklq001 5 coyllur 09.ogg}} '''Coyllur:''' Redo them? How come? This is so unexpected... and I can't believe you came out here just to tell us that in person...
:{{A|vo qsklq001 5 allpa 04.ogg}} '''Allpa:''' It's embarrassing to admit, but... due to time constraints, we didn't do a proper inspection of the arena before the last round of trials began. Then we started to notice many candidates performing worse than expected...
:{{A|vo qsklq001 5 allpa 05.ogg}} '''Allpa:''' So we redid the inspection afterwards, and found a number of issues which likely impacted candidate performance.
:{{A|vo qsklq001 5 allpa 06.ogg}} '''Allpa:''' This was entirely our mistake, and I apologize unreservedly. I know it doesn't make up for it, but I thought bringing you this message in person was the least I could do.
:{{A|vo qsklq001 5 coyllur 10.ogg}} '''Coyllur:''' Oh, okay...
:{{A|vo qsklq001 5 allpa 07.ogg}} '''Allpa:''' Chasca, these people you're with... Are they {{Traveler}} and Paimon?
:{{A|vo qsklq001 5 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh? You've heard of us?
:{{A|vo qsklq001 5 allpa 08.ogg}} '''Allpa:''' I have indeed. Gathering intel is an essential part of being a warrior — plus, you've already made quite a name for yourself in Natlan. Actually, I've been meaning to invite you to enjoy our tribe's hospitality for some time.
:{{A|vo qsklq001 5 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hospitality? Ooh! That includes food, right?
:{{A|vo qsklq001 5 allpa 09.ogg}} '''Allpa:''' Of course it does. If you'll let us host you, you'll be treated quite lavishly. Mighty warriors are highly revered in our tribe.
;(If the player has completed [[The Rainbow Destined to Burn]]){{Verify}}
::{{A|vo qsklq001 5 allpa 10.ogg}} '''Allpa:''' Besides, we still owe you for your help during the war. Without you, we would have suffered far worse at the hands of the [[Abyss]]... So I'd like the chance to show you our gratitude, on behalf of the whole tribe.
:{{A|vo qsklq001 5 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Mighty warriors, plural? So Paimon counts, too...? Hehe, Paimon's starting to like you a lot!
:{{A|vo qsklq001 5 allpa 11.ogg}} '''Allpa:''' That should go without saying. Your flying skills are the envy of our tribe.
:{{DIcon}} That's a good point...
:{{A|vo qsklq001 5 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' The Flower-Feather Clan seems like a really nice bunch of people! We definitely need to take her up on this offer!
;(If the player has completed [[All Fires Fuel the Flame]])
::{{DIcon}} Last time was just a... flying visit...
::{{DIcon}} We never got to check the place out properly.
:{{A|vo qsklq001 5 allpa 12.ogg}} '''Allpa:''' Well, I'd love to stay, but I'm afraid I still have to inform the other candidates about the retrials. With our younger generation's future on the line, there's no time to lose.
:{{A|vo qsklq001 5 coyllur 11.ogg}} '''Coyllur:''' Wait, Elder Allpa! ...Lemme help. The sooner everyone gets the news, the better.
:{{A|vo qsklq001 5 allpa 13.ogg}} '''Allpa:''' Very well... In that case, Chasca, could I leave you to entertain our guests?
:{{A|vo qsklq001 5 chasca 05.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' Sure thing.
:{{A|vo qsklq001 5 allpa 14.ogg}} '''Allpa:''' Okay, let's meet by the obsidian totem pole later. Coyllur, let's get going.
:{{A|vo qsklq001 5 coyllur 12.ogg}} '''Coyllur:''' Okay!
:{{Black Screen|Allpa and Coyllur fly away, riding a qucusaur....}}
:{{A|vo qsklq001 5 chasca 06.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' ...Alright, they're out of earshot. I'm just gonna come out and ask:
:{{A|vo qsklq001 5 chasca 07.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' ...That qucusaur who responded to Coyllur's call — that was your doing, wasn't it?
:{{DIcon}} ...!
:{{A|vo qsklq001 5 chasca 08.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' I grew up with these creatures. I could tell something was off the second I saw it.
:{{A|vo qsklq001 5 chasca 09a.ogg}} {{A|vo qsklq001 5 chasca 09b.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' {{MC|m=His|f=Her}} whole demeanor seemed less like a qucusaur and more like... well, you. So I figure you must have been pulling the strings somehow.
:{{DIcon}} I can't believe you saw through it...
:{{A|vo qsklq001 5 chasca 10a.ogg}} {{A|vo qsklq001 5 chasca 10b.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' {{MC|m=He|f=She}} looked very flustered when Coyllur asked for a ride. So I whistled to give {{MC|m=him|f=her}} a chance to escape.
:{{A|vo qsklq001 5 chasca 11.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' ...And judging by the look on your face, that was a welcome intervention, huh?
:{{A|vo qsklq001 5 chasca 12.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' It's alright, if you'd rather your hidden talents remain hidden, I respect that. I won't press you for answers, and I'll keep my speculations to myself.
:{{A|vo qsklq001 5 chasca 13.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' You're the kind of person I'd still trust even if you had superpowers. I know you'd use them for good.
:{{DIcon}} Technically, I deceived Coyllur... Does that count as "for good"?
:{{A|vo qsklq001 5 chasca 14.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' I think the ends justify the means in this case. She just lacked confidence, and you helped her resolve her internal conflict.
:{{A|vo qsklq001 5 chasca 15.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' If you hadn't intervened, I likely would have gotten my [[Chimpu|"mom"]] to help out instead... Although, having said that, there's a small chance she might've recognized her and seen through the whole thing... that would've done more harm than good...
:{{DIcon}} Well, luckily no harm was done in the end.
:{{A|vo qsklq001 5 chasca 16.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' Yeah. Anyway, if you're free now, how about I give you that tour I promised?
{{Dialogue End}}

;(Approach the Flower-Feather Clan)
:{{A|vo qsklq001 6 kotimy 01.ogg}} '''Kotimy:''' Hmph! Hah!
:{{A|vo qsklq001 6 yatlan 01.ogg}} '''Yatlan:''' Hyah!
:{{A|vo qsklq001 6 capac 01.ogg}} '''Capac:''' Ready? I'm gonna get you!
:{{A|vo qsklq001 6 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Uh-oh... are they fighting? Should we try and break them up?
:{{A|vo qsklq001 6 chasca 01.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' They're fine, just doing their daily combat training.
:{{A|vo qsklq001 6 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Combat training? A little young for that, aren't they?
:{{A|vo qsklq001 6 chasca 02.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' Not to us, we're a tribe of warriors. In ancient times, we were the most elite troops in the nation, responsible for patrolling and defending all of Natlan.
:{{A|vo qsklq001 6 chasca 03.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' And even though times have changed, we've kept our martial spirit alive.
:{{A|vo qsklq001 6 kotimy 02.ogg}} '''Kotimy:''' Hey, is that Chasca?
:{{A|vo qsklq001 6 yatlan 02.ogg}} '''Yatlan:''' Chasca, you're back!
:{{A|vo qsklq001 6 capac 02.ogg}} '''Capac:''' Can you come train with us?
:{{A|vo qsklq001 6 chasca 04.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' Now's not a good time, I'm afraid. I'm showing {{Traveler}} and Paimon around. Maybe next time.
:{{A|vo qsklq001 6 kotimy 03.ogg}} '''Kotimy:''' {{Traveler}} and Paimon...? Wait! You mean that legendary warrior, and legendary flying expert?
:{{A|vo qsklq001 6 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Legendary? Uh, yep! That's us, alright!
:{{A|vo qsklq001 6 kotimy 04.ogg}} '''Kotimy:''' Awesome... It's so cool that you can fly without having to ride a qucusaur. Even Chasca can only do that for short distances!
:{{A|vo qsklq001 6 capac 03a.ogg}} {{A|vo qsklq001 6 capac 03b.ogg}} '''Capac:''' Um, {{MC|m=Mr.|f=Miss}} {{Traveler}}! Can you teach me some cool sword tricks?
:{{A|vo qsklq001 6 yatlan 03a.ogg}} {{A|vo qsklq001 6 yatlan 03b.ogg}} '''Yatlan:''' {{MC|m=Mr.|f=Miss}} {{Traveler}}! My family's shop makes the best [[Volcano Cake]], you gotta try it!
:{{A|vo qsklq001 6 chasca 05.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' Ahem! Let's behave ourselves, everyone. These people are here as our guests. They're going to meet Elder Allpa in a few minutes, anyway.
:{{A|vo qsklq001 6 chasca 06.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' [[Kotimy]], instead of being jealous of other people's talents, why not work on developing your own?
:{{A|vo qsklq001 6 chasca 07.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' [[Capac]], there's no point trying any "cool sword tricks" until you've mastered the basics. Have you done all your sword drills today?
:{{A|vo qsklq001 6 chasca 08.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' And [[Yatlan]]... Easy does it, okay? Not every conversation has to turn into you plugging the family business.
:{{A|vo qsklq001 6 together 01.ogg}} '''Kotimy & Yatlan & Capac:''' Okay...
:{{Black Screen|Chasca's mini-lecture calms the children down, and they stop crowding you.}}
:{{A|vo qsklq001 6 chasca 09.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' Sorry about those kids, they just got overexcited when they heard your name. Hope it didn't bother you too much.
:{{A|vo qsklq001 6 chasca 10.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' This is a Volcano Cake that Yatlan forced into my hands. She said to think of it as an apology gift.
:{{A|vo qsklq001 6 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Whoa... it smells amazing! {{Traveler}}, you want some?
:{{DIcon}} It does smell pretty good.
:{{DIcon}} Tastes nice, too.
:{{A|vo qsklq001 6 chasca 11.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' That's good. Yatlan will be thrilled.
:{{A|vo qsklq001 6 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' By the way, Chasca, those kids really adore you! You're way better with them than Paimon expected. Paimon figured you'd be more... um... aloof, maybe?
:{{A|vo qsklq001 6 chasca 12.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' Aloof, huh? Well, to be fair, there was a period when I was like that. Around the time when I first joined the tribe.
:{{A|vo qsklq001 6 chasca 13.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' ...But it's a terrible attitude to have as a peacemaker. It tends to turn situations that could've had a peaceful resolution into a stalemate that can only be resolved by force...
:{{DIcon}} "Resolved by force" meaning, beating both parties into submission?
:{{A|vo qsklq001 6 chasca 14.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' Yep, exactly. As long as other options are available, I try to avoid that at all costs.
:{{A|vo qsklq001 6 chasca 15.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' Someone once told me that peace imposed by force will crumble in a matter of days, but peace achieved through genuine dialogue actually benefits both sides.
:{{A|vo qsklq001 6 chasca 16.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' Even if sometimes, the parties are only willing to negotiate because they're both armed to the teeth.
:{{A|vo qsklq001 6 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' That's true...
:{{A|vo qsklq001 6 yatlan 05.ogg}} '''Yatlan:''' Hey, Chasca!
:{{A|vo qsklq001 6 kotimy 06.ogg}} '''Kotimy:''' Uncle Cusco knows you're back, and he's coming to get you!
:{{A|vo qsklq001 6 chasca 17.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' Hmm? Oh... Thanks.
:{{A|vo qsklq001 6 chasca 18.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' {{Traveler}}, Paimon, gotta dash. I'll meet you at the totem pole up ahead. You can't miss it, it sticks out like a sore thumb.

:{{A|vo qsklq001 6 chasca 19.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' First rule of conflict resolution: Grab the fan and run before the you-know-what hits.
:{{A|vo qsklq001 6 capac 05.ogg}} '''Capac:''' Hehe, trust Chasca to make even running away sound cool!
:{{A|vo qsklq001 6 chasca 20.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' Sorry about this... Just stall him for me, okay? I'll explain everything later.

;(Approach the marked location)
:{{A|vo qsklq001 7 cusco 01.ogg}} '''Cusco:''' Hmm... A golden-haired outlander, and a white flying object... You must be {{Traveler}} and Paimon?
:{{A|vo qsklq001 7 cusco 02.ogg}} '''Cusco:''' I heard Chasca was with you, but I suppose she's run away again, has she...

:{{A|vo qsklq001 7 cusco 03.ogg}} '''Cusco:''' Who am I? Tsk, only her father!
:{{A|vo qsklq001 7 cusco 04.ogg}} '''Cusco:''' She's supposed to go for a checkup every three months to see how her Abyss condition is doing. We both agreed on it... But she's already missed three checkups this year! That's three out of four!
:{{DIcon}} Abyss condition?
:{{A|vo qsklq001 7 cusco 05.ogg}} '''Cusco:''' *sigh* Yes, she got exposed to Abyssal energy as a young child... Then her birth parents abandoned her. It's lucky those wild qucusaurs found her when they did, or she wouldn't have made it. They took her under their wing and raised her as one of their one.
:{{A|vo qsklq001 7 cusco 06.ogg}} '''Cusco:''' Eventually, some riders out on patrol spotted her, and brought her back to the tribe... But she was practically feral at that point!
:{{A|vo qsklq001 7 cusco 07.ogg}} '''Cusco:''' The moment you took your eyes off her, she'd be getting herself into a fight. Or she'd run away to be with the [[saurian]]s. She seemed to prefer them to her own kind... She might as well have been a saurian in human form!
:{{A|vo qsklq001 7 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' ...That must be the aloof period she mentioned, right?
:{{DIcon}} Sounds like there was more going on than just being aloof...
:{{A|vo qsklq001 7 cusco 08.ogg}} '''Cusco:''' We later discovered that her exposure to the Abyss had planted seeds of conflict in her heart. So, we started trying to bring it under control...
:{{A|vo qsklq001 7 cusco 09.ogg}} '''Cusco:''' But ultimately, she's the only one who can control it. Anyway, she's much more human these days.
:{{A|vo qsklq001 7 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yeah, uh... Don't worry about her, she seems pretty stable to Paimon. Uh, she's probably only avoiding the checkups because she thinks it'll stop you guys from worrying about her.
:{{A|vo qsklq001 7 cusco 10.ogg}} '''Cusco:''' ...Yes, I'm well aware of that. She knows she needs to be careful. If her condition ever took a turn for the worse, she wouldn't be brushing it aside like this.
:{{DIcon}} Then what's there to worry about?
:{{A|vo qsklq001 7 cusco 11.ogg}} '''Cusco:''' It's just, every checkup she's been to, they find new cuts and bruises. Nothing to do with the Abyss, of course, oh no — that's all fine. The problem with her is, she's her own worst enemy!
:{{A|vo qsklq001 7 cusco 12.ogg}} '''Cusco:''' She's been living dangerously again, I'm sure of it! That's why she's avoiding the checkups, she wants to hide it from us!
:{{A|vo qsklq001 7 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ah... Yeah... Paimon can see her doing that....

:{{A|vo qsklq001 7 cusco 18.ogg}} '''Cusco:''' If she doesn't want to do these checkups anymore, that's fine. I just want her to stop putting herself in harm's way.

:{{A|vo qsklq001 10 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hey, Chasca! Hey, Allpa!
:{{DIcon}} Sorry to keep you waiting.
:{{A|vo qsklq001 10 chasca 01.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' It's alright. I bet my dad talked your heads off, huh? What did he say?
:{{DIcon}} That you used to run away from home nearly every other day...
:{{DIcon}} And that nearly half of your peers got beaten up by you as a kid...
:{{A|vo qsklq001 10 chasca 02.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' Heh... I was sometimes a little impulsive back then.
:{{A|vo qsklq001 10 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hah! That's putting it mildly!
:{{A|vo qsklq001 10 allpa 01.ogg}} '''Allpa:''' Haha, the memories... It feels like it was only yesterday when we brought you back and had Cusco and his family take you in.
:{{A|vo qsklq001 10 allpa 02.ogg}} '''Allpa:''' ...Back then, no one imagined this feral child would grow up to be the strongest warrior of the Flower-Feather Clan.
:{{A|vo qsklq001 10 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh? You were the one that brought Chasca back to the tribe?
:{{A|vo qsklq001 10 chasca 03.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' That's right. Elder Allpa was already a veteran rider by then. She spotted me while patrolling from the skies, and tracked down my qucusaur "mom."
:{{A|vo qsklq001 10 chasca 04.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' "Mom" agreed that it was time I tried to re-enter human society... But I didn't know the first thing about being civilized. I clashed with everyone who had to deal with me.
:{{A|vo qsklq001 10 allpa 03.ogg}} '''Allpa:''' And look at you now, renowned throughout the land as a peacemaker... How time flies.
:{{A|vo qsklq001 10 allpa 04.ogg}} '''Allpa:''' When the day comes that I can't fly anymore, it'll be up to you to look after our tribe and our flying squad.
:{{A|vo qsklq001 10 chasca 05.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' Mm... You know me, though. I'm not a natural commander, I'm better off as a lone wolf on the front line.
:{{A|vo qsklq001 10 chasca 06.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' ...So stick it out for at least a few more years, okay? Give Coyllur and the others time to come into their own.
:{{A|vo qsklq001 10 allpa 05.ogg}} '''Allpa:''' Oh, stop...
:{{A|vo qsklq001 10 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wait so...Isn't the leader just the strongest warrior in the tribe? At least, Paimon figured that's how your tribe would work.
:{{A|vo qsklq001 10 chasca 07.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' Strength is certainly a core tenet in the Flower-Feather Clan. But strength means far more than martial prowess alone.
:{{A|vo qsklq001 10 allpa 06.ogg}} '''Allpa:''' Heh, if it all came down to individual strength, I'd struggle to call myself a warrior, let alone a member of the flying squad. Any fighter in the tribe could take me down.

:{{A|vo qsklq001 10 chasca 08.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' And yet, you still managed to become the leader of the flying squad, thanks to your experience and determination. All while battling those old injuries. Don't you think that's a display of strength in its own right?

:{{A|vo qsklq001 10 chasca 10.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' Let me handle the other errands while you meet with the merchants. You shouldn't be trying to do everything at your age.
:{{A|vo qsklq001 10 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' We should help too! Seems only fair after all that food we ate...
:{{DIcon}} It'll help the digestion process.
:{{DIcon}} We're not here for a free lunch.
:{{A|vo qsklq001 10 allpa 14.ogg}} '''Allpa:''' Huh... Well, much obliged. Chasca, the remaining Wingless are all people you know. Let's see... [[Pixica]] now manages the [["Floating Target Balloon" Challenge|Floating Target Balloons]]...
:{{A|vo qsklq001 10 allpa 15.ogg}} '''Allpa:''' [[Huascar]]'s probably still addicted to [["Eyes on the Feathered Prize" Challenge|"Eyes on the Feathered Prize,"]] and [[Zhunan]] spends her days up on the flying platform, staring at the Cinder City... I'll leave you to tell them the news.

:{{A|vo qsklq001 17 chasca 03.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' They're making some big changes to the arena this time, so the flying experience should be smoother than before. Coyllur's gonna try again.
:{{A|vo qsklq001 17 zhunan 05.ogg}} '''Zhunan:''' ...!
:{{A|vo qsklq001 17 zhunan 06.ogg}} '''Zhunan:''' Ehh... No, forget it. If I was genuinely good enough to make the squad, the location shouldn't affect my chances.

:{{A|vo qsklq001 17 coyllur 02.ogg}} '''Coyllur:''' Guess they already told you then, huh? Come on, let's go train together!

:{{A|vo qsklq001 17 coyllur 03.ogg}} '''Coyllur:''' What? Why? But you've always looked up to Elder Allpa...
:{{A|vo qsklq001 17 coyllur 04.ogg}} '''Coyllur:''' She went wingless after her injury, and spent years drifting... but even she came back and made it in the end. If she can do it, why can't you?
:{{A|vo qsklq001 17 zhunan 09.ogg}} '''Zhunan:''' I mean... I don't have that kind of perseverance. And besides, the last thing I wanna do is fail in front of her yet again...

:{{A|vo qsklq001 17 zhunan 11.ogg}} '''Zhunan:''' Wait... Hold on! Slow down! I can't keep up!

:{{A|vo qsklq001 17 chasca 05.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' You helped Coyllur deal with her internal conflict, and now, she's done the same for someone else... You know, people often talk about how one conflict leads to another, and so on.

===The Wisdom Seelie===
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Use [[Nahida]]'s [[All Schemes to Know]] on Rabah, optional)
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915101 rabah 09.ogg}} '''Rabah:''' (She probably won't hear back in time.)

;(Ask Rabah about the legend)
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915101 layla 01.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Excuse me, have you ever heard of the Wisdom Seelie?
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915101 rabah 01.ogg}} '''Rabah:''' Heh, you've come to the right person.
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915101 rabah 02.ogg}} '''Rabah:''' I came across this legend not too long ago myself. After hearing about it, I decided to test it out and asked it a question about the brightness of the stars.
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915101 rabah 03.ogg}} '''Rabah:''' Two days later, I got a response. It included two pages of detailed and accurate information. It saved me from having to look up a ton of resources.
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915101 layla 02.ogg}} '''Layla:''' R—Really?
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915101 rabah 04.ogg}} '''Rabah:''' Yeah, so I submitted another question a few days ago. I still haven't received a reply, though.
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915101 layla 03.ogg}} '''Layla:''' That sounds like what others have said. But I don't have the time to wait for a reply if the Seelie doesn't answer right away...
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915101 layla 04.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Ahh, whatever. Can you please tell me how to submit a question to the Wisdom Seelie?
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915101 rabah 05.ogg}} '''Rabah:''' It's quite simple. Go to the bookshelf over there and find either "Theoretical Astrology" or "A Quick Reference Guide to Astrology Cases."
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915101 layla 05.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Oh, I know where those are... My Darshan has us use those two books quite often.
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915101 rabah 06.ogg}} '''Rabah:''' Okay, so write your question in a letter addressed to the Wisdom Seelie, and then insert the letter into one of the books.
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915101 rabah 07.ogg}} '''Rabah:''' Come back in a day or two, and if you see a red stamp on your letter, that means the Wisdom Seelie has replied.
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915101 rabah 08.ogg}} '''Rabah:''' However, if the stamp never appears, then that means the Seelie doesn't want to answer your question.
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915101 layla 06.ogg}} '''Layla:''' I see. Thank you so much.
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915101 layla 07.ogg}} '''Layla:''' I'm gonna go write down my question. Hopefully the Seelie replies...

;(Talk to Rabah again)
:{{A|vo lylcop001 1915101 rabah 10.ogg}} '''Rabah:''' There's no harm in trying. Now let's see if it's in the mood to answer your question.

;(Continue to [[#Dislocated Dialogue|Dislocated Dialogue]])
{{Dialogue End}}

'''''Thesis Defense Practice''''' is a quest in {{Quest|Ever Silent Stars}}.

==Steps==
# Go to the House of Daena to practice

==Gameplay Notes==
* The player will proceed to [[#Ending: A Matter of Course|Ending: A Matter of Course]] under the certain circumstances:
**Ask Layla regarding to the triple-orbit shift calculation. Additionally, the player will grant an {{Achievement|She's Already Tense}}
** Ask her about the quadruple-orbit shift calculation if Layla's Stress Value is reached to 3. However, the player will proceed to that ending even without granting the achievement.
*The player will proceed to [[#Ending: The Stars' Expectation|Ending: The Stars' Expectation]] after Layla's consciousness is fully-awakened (which her Stress Value is on maximum level). This ending is caused by the following scenarios:
**If the player asks her relating to the quadruple-orbit shift, regardless of her Stress Value is on 4.
**If the player asks her far from the topic.

:{{A|vo lylcop001 1916002 layla 05.ogg}} '''Layla:''' She's a resilient girl, but no matter how resilient she may be, no one can hold up to criticism and torment from themselves.

:{{A|vo lylcop001 1916002 layla 09.ogg}} '''Layla:''' I believe that she's one of the best, even in a place like the Akademiya, where geniuses come by the handful.

:{{A|vo lylcop001 1916002 layla 11.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Hahaha, believe me, even if she were to end up at rock bottom, she'd find a way to somehow laugh it off as one of her silly mistakes and climb her way out.

;(Reaching the rendezvous point)
:{{A|vo ablq004 2 ambor 01.ogg}} '''Amber:''' This is [[Springvale]]. There must be some clues about Raptor 'round here.
:{{A|vo ablq004 2 ambor 02.ogg}} '''Amber:''' The Sister from the [[Favonius Cathedral|Cathedral]] put some secret [[Anemo]] markings on the artifact he took.

:{{A|vo ablq004 3 ambor 03c.ogg}} '''Amber:''' It looks like a broken tree branch.
:{{A|vo ablq004 3 paimon 01c 1.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, Paimon knows! It's from a frame of a [[wind glider]]! Therefore—
:{{A|vo ablq004 3 ambor 03c 1.ogg}} '''Amber:''' There are no elemental traces on it.
:{{A|vo ablq004 3 ambor 03c 2.ogg}} '''Amber:''' ...It looks like it's just a plain old tree branch.

:{{A|vo ablq004 3 ambor 03b 1.ogg}} '''Amber:''' Looking at the design and the way it's woven, there's a good chance it came from a wind glider.
:{{A|vo ablq004 3 paimon 01b.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wow, Outriders have to be textile experts now!? It's a harder job than Paimon thought.
:{{A|vo ablq004 3 ambor 03b 2.ogg}} '''Amber:''' If this really belongs to Raptor, it must mean his wind glider is broken.

;(Interacting with Elemental Mark)

:{{A|vo ablq004 3 ambor 03a.ogg}} '''Amber:''' Anemo Slimes are airborne creatures. They don't leave marks on the ground, unless someone stomped on one to take-off.
:{{A|vo ablq004 3 paimon 01a 1.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wait... Are you telling me people actually do that?
:{{A|vo ablq004 3 ambor 03a 1.ogg}} '''Amber:''' Either way, let's make a mental note of these markings. They're very clear.

;(After investigating all three clues)
:{{A|vo ablq004 4 ambor 01.ogg}} '''Amber:''' It appears that the elemental markings point this way.
:{{A|vo ablq004 4 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh. Well... D'you think he ran off ahead?
:{{A|vo ablq004 4 ambor 02.ogg}} '''Amber:''' There's only one way to find out!
:{{A|vo ablq004 4 ambor 03.ogg}} '''Amber:''' C'mon {{Traveler}}, we should keep following the markings.
:{{A|vo ablq004 5 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ooh, what's that? Looks like something's going on up ahead...
:{{A|vo ablq004 4 ambor 04.ogg}} '''Amber:''' It sounds like there's a battle going on — could that be Raptor?
:{{A|vo ablq004 4 ambor 05.ogg}} '''Amber:''' Quick, let's keep going!

----

;(After defeating the hilichurls)
:{{A|vo ablq004 5 farrah 01.ogg}} '''Farrah:''' Thank goodness, the Knights of Favonius have arrived! The hilichurls won't dare pursue me any longer...
:{{A|vo ablq004 5 ambor 01.ogg}} '''Amber:''' What happened?
:{{A|vo ablq004 5 farrah 02.ogg}} '''Farrah:''' I can't believe it but... the hilichurls attacked our carts. Luckily I outran them.
:{{A|vo ablq004 5 ambor 02.ogg}} '''Amber:''' Hilichurls? But I thought the Knights of Favonius had cleared out most of the hilichurl camps around these parts?
:{{A|vo ablq004 5 farrah 03.ogg}} '''Farrah:''' It's a small camp not too far from the village. The route I take on my delivery runs ensures I steer clear of it.
:{{A|vo ablq004 5 farrah 04.ogg}} '''Farrah:''' But today... some crazy fellow suddenly fell out of the sky and landed right in the camp!
:{{A|vo ablq004 5 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hmm... Now who does that remind me of...
:{{A|vo ablq004 5 farrah 05.ogg}} '''Farrah:''' It really riled them up. They chased the funny-looking fellow as he fled, which brought them out into the open.
:{{A|vo ablq004 5 farrah 06.ogg}} '''Farrah:''' I managed to get away, but they smashed my fruit carts to smithereens. I don't know what I'm gonna do when the merchant caravan gets here tomorrow—
:{{A|vo ablq004 5 ambor 03.ogg}} '''Amber:''' ...Funny-looking? In what way?
:{{A|vo ablq004 5 farrah 07.ogg}} '''Farrah:''' He was holding onto something. Must've been heavy, because he couldn't glide in a straight line to save his life... Maybe that's why he fell.
:{{A|vo ablq004 5 farrah 08.ogg}} '''Farrah:''' Honestly, people like that shouldn't be allowed in the skies. It doesn't take a genius to know you're not supposed to carry heavy objects while gliding! I'm gonna report that idiot and make sure he gets his license revoked!
:{{A|vo ablq004 5 ambor 04.ogg}} '''Amber:''' Heavy object... The artifact? This could well be our guy.
:{{A|vo ablq004 5 ambor 05.ogg}} '''Amber:''' Tell me, did you see which way he went?
:{{A|vo ablq004 5 farrah 09.ogg}} '''Farrah:''' I managed to catch a glimpse as I ran from the hilichurls. I think he went... that way.
:{{A|vo ablq004 5 ambor 06.ogg}} '''Amber:''' Seems like a strong lead. {{Traveler}}, on with the chase!
:{{A|vo ablq004 5 ambor 07.ogg}} '''Amber:''' Oh, and don't worry — as soon as I get back I'll tell the Knights to mop up the rest of the hilichurls as soon as possible.

----

;(After defeating the Treasure Hoarders)
:{{A|vo ablq004 6 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Apart from the hilichurls, there's a bunch of funny-looking people too!
:{{A|vo ablq004 6 ambor 01.ogg}} '''Amber:''' Judging from the type of wind gliders they've got, I'd say this lot is with Raptor.
:{{A|vo ablq004 6 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' But if that's the case, what are they hanging around here for?
:{{A|vo ablq004 6 ambor 02.ogg}} '''Amber:''' I wonder... Well, this measly bunch can't slow us down, that's for sure.
:{{A|vo ablq004 6 ambor 03.ogg}} '''Amber:''' But we also haven't found the artifact — which means, Raptor still has it on him.
:{{A|vo ablq004 6 ambor 04.ogg}} '''Amber:''' ...Forget these guys. C'mon {{Traveler}}, let's keep following the elemental markings.

----

;(After following the marks left by Raptor)
:{{A|vo ablq004 7 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh, look where we are...
:{{DIcon}} There are no more elemental markings ahead.
:{{A|vo ablq004 7 ambor 01.ogg}} '''Amber:''' The elemental power on the artifact must have worn off.
:{{A|vo ablq004 7 ambor 02.ogg}} '''Amber:''' Raptor must have realized the markings would give away his position, and sent his minions to slow us down.
:{{A|vo ablq004 7 ambor 03.ogg}} '''Amber:''' That way, when the effect wears off, he can make his escape.
:{{A|vo ablq004 7 ambor 04.ogg}} '''Amber:''' He won't get away with this! After him!

==Dialogue==
{{Quest Description|After the wargames, the members of the [[Special Security and Surveillance Patrol]] seem to have gained new tactical insights...}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Talk to [[Turenna]] or [[Enghiene]])
:'''Turenna:''' Hmm... the route taken by the attacking force, and their coordination with their supporting flank teams when targeting an enemy stronghold... These aspects must be studied further.
:'''Enghiene:''' But what about {{Traveler}}'s unorthodox tactics? They don't seem to make sense at a glance, and yet...
:{{DIcon}} See something you like?
:{{DIcon}} Any textbook examples for your recruits?
:'''Turenna:''' Indeed! As you can see, once the main force has been deployed, it is difficult for them to disengage for a short period of time. This window is when covering the enemy's flanks and cutting off their reinforcements becomes crucial.
:'''Turenna:''' But with limited troops, it becomes difficult to decide how many to allocate to the support unit.
:'''Enghiene:''' Ugh... If we had the numbers, we could downsize the main force. But if we couldn't spare many, we might not even be able to cut the enemy off... Nobody knows for sure how much manpower we'd have each time.
:'''Enghiene:''' It's customary for the Special Patrol to form a support unit of about one quarter the strength of the main attacking force, and deploy them to patrol areas where we might expect enemy reinforcements to show up...
:'''Enghiene:''' Normally, this arrangement would suffice, although there have been exceptions... One time, while the support unit was leisurely patrolling their target area with no enemies in sight, the main force was running thin and had to fight for their lives...
:'''Turenna:''' But as for you, Proto-Boss — you planned your attack routes for the main force exceptionally well, coordinating their movements with those of the support unit.
:'''Turenna:''' That way, both units could rely on each other for support when it mattered, making the most of our manpower.
:'''Turenna:''' When the main assault met heavy resistance, the support unit could act like reinforcements. Likewise, when enemy reinforcements suddenly arrived in force, both teams could move in tandem to intercept. Like an offensive-defensive unit!
:{{DIcon}} That's just how I roll.
:{{DIcon}} Really? I just did whatever...
:'''Turenna:''' Anyway, thanks to your unorthodox strategy, you've demolished the same third Assault Scenario that had Drillmaster Enghiene stumped...
:'''Enghiene:''' ...
:'''Enghiene:''' Fine, I admit defeat! You'll be getting your limited-edition ammunition once we get back!
:'''Turenna:''' Hehe! The pleasure's all mine, Drillmaster!
:'''Turenna:''' The very same limited-edition bullets used by Captain [[Chevreuse]], renowned for their precision and velocity over long distances... Hehehe...
:'''Turenna:''' Ahem! Back to the topic at hand, I've always known you had an interest in firearms, Proto-Boss! I talked through some of the necessary application requirements with my colleagues, and you're a perfect fit!
:'''Turenna:''' When you're free, we'll find an opportunity to get the relevant paperwork done, check up on your key data, and get you a custom-made musket of your own!
{{Dialogue End}}

==Steps==
* Start the quest by approaching the quest marker.
# Defeat the [[Koholasaur]]s
#* {{Enemy|Koholasaurus|x=3}}
# Talk to the freed tourists

==Dialogue==
{{Quest Description|While wandering in the wilderness, you hear two tourists crying for help, and you and Paimon decide to aid them...}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Approach the quest marker)
:{{A|vo mlnlq001 1 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wow, what an amazing view! And we can even see some Koholasaurs here and there! Hey, why don't we try to get a picture with one or two of them in the wild?
:{{DIcon}} But what if they try to bite us?
:{{A|vo mlnlq001 1 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Well... they're so cute, they probably won't do that, right...?
:{{A|vo mlnlq001 1 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh? What's happening over there?
:{{A|vo mlnlq001 1 karya 01.ogg}} '''Karya:''' Help! Somebody help us!
:{{A|vo mlnlq001 1 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ah! Wild Koholasaurs are actually biting people!
:{{DIcon}} It's time for us to save the day again!
::{{A|vo mlnlq001 1 paimon 05a 1a.ogg}} {{A|vo mlnlq001 1 paimon 05a 1b.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yeah, those two are in trouble! The legendary {{Traveler}} and {{MC|m=his|f=her}} trusty sidekick Paimon will not stand by idly!
:{{DIcon}} Seems those pictures we wanted will have to wait.
::{{A|vo mlnlq001 1 paimon 05b 1.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yeah, we can save those for later! We can't just stand around when someone's calling for help!

;(Approach [[Karya]] and [[Viramdra]])
:{{A|vo mlnlq001 1 karya 02.ogg}} '''Karya:''' G—Get back!
:{{A|vo mlnlq001 1 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Don't panic, just hang in there!
:{{A|vo mlnlq001 1 karya 03.ogg}} '''Karya:''' Ah, finally, someone's coming... Please, help us!

;(After defeating the enemies)
:{{Black Screen|The defeated Koholasaurs scatter and run away.}}
:{{A|vo mlnlq001 2 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Judging from your clothes, you must be scholars from [[Sumeru]], right?
:{{A|vo mlnlq001 2 karya 01.ogg}} '''Karya:''' Yes, I'm Karya, and this is my senior, Viramdra. Thank you so much for saving us. That was a little too close...
:{{A|vo mlnlq001 2 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Don't mention it! Handling these sort of things is practically second nature to us by now. Paimon is Paimon, and this is {{Traveler}}!
:{{A|vo mlnlq001 2 viramdra 01.ogg}} '''Viramdra:''' *sigh* Still, it seems that all the Koholasaurs just ran off... We need to capture at least one alive.
:{{A|vo mlnlq001 2 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh? Capture one alive?
:{{A|vo mlnlq001 2 viramdra 02.ogg}} '''Viramdra:''' Correct. Say, I can see you are very skilled at dealing with them. Do you think you could use me as live bait to help us capture one? I will pay you for the effort!
:{{A|vo mlnlq001 2 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Um, well...
:{{A|vo mlnlq001 2 karya 02.ogg}} '''Karya:''' Apologies. Viramdra has been hyper-focused on his research, so please, don't be too hard on him...
:{{A|vo mlnlq001 2 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, no worries! But why did you approach a whole group of wild Koholasaurs? And what's this talk about "capturing them"?
:{{DIcon}} Don't tell me you want to get a picture with them, too.
:{{A|vo mlnlq001 2 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Paimon's pretty sure that's not what they're trying to do!
:{{A|vo mlnlq001 2 karya 03.ogg}} '''Karya:''' I'm sure we must look very silly... The fact of the matter is that we're searching for a mysterious island from a certain legend. It's said that a very important clue about the island can be found on Koholasaurs, so...
:{{A|vo mlnlq001 2 karya 04.ogg}} '''Karya:''' Approaching them without the help of a guide from the [[People of the Springs]] was certainly an unwise choice on our part.
:{{A|vo mlnlq001 2 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' A mysterious island?
:{{A|vo mlnlq001 2 karya 05.ogg}} '''Karya:''' Yes. There's a legend from the People of the Springs that mentions a mysterious island, and Viramdra believes the key to his research can be found there.
:{{A|vo mlnlq001 2 viramdra 03.ogg}} '''Viramdra:''' Ahem... Are you certain you two won't consider my proposal to capture one?
:{{A|vo mlnlq001 2 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Some proposal... There's no way we'd be willing to use a person as live bait!
:{{A|vo mlnlq001 2 viramdra 04.ogg}} '''Viramdra:''' Then I suppose discussing it any further will just be a waste of time. I must come up with another solution...
:{{A|vo mlnlq001 2 karya 06.ogg}} '''Karya:''' Ahem... Viramdra!
:{{A|vo mlnlq001 2 viramdra 05.ogg}} '''Viramdra:''' Oh, alright... You did rescue Karya and I just now, and I suppose I should express some gratitude. Thank you very much.
:{{A|vo mlnlq001 2 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' A little awkward, but Paimon'll take it...
:{{A|vo mlnlq001 2 viramdra 06.ogg}} '''Viramdra:''' We should move on, Karya.
:;(Viramdra leaves)
:{{A|vo mlnlq001 2 karya 07.ogg}} '''Karya:''' Yes, thank you again. My apologies... Viramdra really doesn't have the best people skills.
:{{A|vo mlnlq001 2 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' That's alright, bye now!
:;(Karya runs after Viramdra)
:{{A|vo mlnlq001 2 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You really don't see a pair of adventurers like those two every day!
:{{A|vo mlnlq001 2 paimon 12.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' But anyway, Paimon's really curious about that mysterious island that lady just mentioned!
:{{DIcon}} Do you wanna find the island too, Paimon?
:{{A|vo mlnlq001 2 paimon 13.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yeah! Who knows, there might be treasure!
:{{A|vo mlnlq001 2 paimon 14.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' After all the amazing places we've explored during our adventures, finding some mysterious island should be a walk in the park for us!
:{{DIcon}} But we don't have any info about this island.
:{{A|vo mlnlq001 2 paimon 15.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ah, you're right... The lady mentioned that the mysterious island is related to a legend of the People of the Springs... So maybe we can start by asking some of them about it?
:{{A|vo mlnlq001 2 paimon 16.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Time's ticking. Let's get started on our next adventure!
:{{A|vo mlnlq001 1 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' But the real question is... who should we ask?
:{{DIcon}} Can we just talk to the chief?
:{{A|vo mlnlq001 1 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hmm... that's an idea. If anyone, the [[Amina|chief]] of the tribe should know the details!
{{Dialogue End}}

:{{A|vo sdnlq004 10 xavier 02.ogg}} '''Xavier:''' Haha... True...
:{{A|vo sdnlq004 10 charlotte 01.ogg}} '''Charlotte:''' Ooo-ooo-ooh? Did I hear someone mention the Furina Award?
:{{A|vo sdnlq004 10 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' C'mon. Don't gloat.
:{{A|vo sdnlq004 10 charlotte 02.ogg}} '''Charlotte:''' Hehe, I won't. Our crew winning the Furina Award was a team effort, after all.
:{{A|vo sdnlq004 10 charlotte 03.ogg}} '''Charlotte:''' Costume design, script adaptation... Ooh! And the practical effects were so realistic! The flames and explosions even made me jump while we were filming!
:{{A|vo sdnlq004 10 chevreuse 01.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' A lot of the effects were based on actual items the Special Patrol confiscated from criminals. Who knew they'd serve another purpose, right?
:{{A|vo sdnlq004 10 citlali 01.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' But it turned out amazing! Really brought the thrilling scenes from the novel to life. Fontaine's film industry is seriously impressive.
:{{A|vo sdnlq004 10 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Which film did you vote for, Citlali?
:{{A|vo sdnlq004 10 citlali 02.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' Uh, isn't it obvious? "Great Detective Hurlock," of course! That's the whole reason I'm here!
:{{A|vo sdnlq004 10 charlotte 04.ogg}} '''Charlotte:''' You all should be proud, though! A lot of critics are saying really good things about your film too!
:{{A|vo sdnlq004 10 charlotte 05.ogg}} '''Charlotte:''' Longing and loss, searching for something even after it's gone... It's a film that makes you think about life, and how important it is to explore those themes!
:{{A|vo sdnlq004 10 furina 03.ogg}} '''Furina:''' Well, that is what the art of storytelling is for.
:{{A|vo sdnlq004 10 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hehe, watching a film with friends is so much fun! There's so much to talk about!
:{{A|vo sdnlq004 10 charlotte 06.ogg}} '''Charlotte:''' Let's throw a celebration later then! We're all old friends. We can find a place and chat to our hearts' content!
:{{A|vo sdnlq004 10 marionette 03.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' How about the Wingalet?
:{{A|vo sdnlq004 10 furina 04.ogg}} '''Furina:''' That's perfect! Friends and family are more than welcome too! So, if you want to bring people, don't be shy!
:{{A|vo sdnlq004 10 marionette 04.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' You all can head over first and make yourselves at home. I'll bring over some refreshments in a bit.
:{{A|vo sdnlq004 10 marionette 05.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' I just have one more stop to make first...
:{{A|vo sdnlq004 10 columbina 04.ogg}} '''Columbina:''' Can I come?
:{{DIcon}} Us too?
:{{A|vo sdnlq004 10 marionette 06.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' Hmph, fine. Not like you'd listen if I tried to stop you.

;(Approach the marked location in [[Alain Guillotin's Resting Place]])
:{{A|vo sdnlq004 11 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wait... Is this...?
:{{A|vo sdnlq004 11 marionette 01.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' Yes. Here lies "Lord-Artificer," Alain Guillotin. This is his grave.
:{{A|vo sdnlq004 11 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' ...
:{{A|vo sdnlq004 11 marionette 02.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' I'm sorry... Alain. I'm sorry this is the first time I've been back since leaving Fontaine. I should have come to see you more often.
:{{A|vo sdnlq004 11 marionette 03.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' I got your "gift." Heh... I even cleaned up one of the Narzissenkreuz Ordo's messes along the way.
:{{A|vo sdnlq004 11 marionette 04.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' [[Hidden Dwelling|Our home]] is just as quiet and warm as it always was. The flowers in the garden are still thriving. I'll make sure to tend to them more often from now on.
:{{A|vo sdnlq004 11 marionette 05.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' [[Pulonia]]... received irreparable damage in battle. I should have taken better care of your invention. I'm sorry.
:{{A|vo sdnlq004 11 marionette 06.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' Pulonia was family to me... just like you.
:{{A|vo sdnlq004 11 marionette 07.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' You always said I was a fast learner... but I'm not so sure. It took me far too long to learn the things that truly matter...
:{{A|vo sdnlq004 11 marionette 08.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' I never said this to you back then, but... thank you for creating me, for giving me the chance to experience life.
:;(When Sandrone looks up, her eyes are filled with tears)
:{{A|vo sdnlq004 11 marionette 09.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' Being your family meant everything to me. Absolutely everything...
:{{A|vo sdnlq004 11 columbina 01.ogg}} '''Columbina:''' ...
:{{A|vo sdnlq004 11 columbina 02.ogg}} '''Columbina:''' Can I say a few words as well, Sandrone?
:{{A|vo sdnlq004 11 marionette 10.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' Hmph... don't need my permission...
:{{A|vo sdnlq004 11 columbina 03.ogg}} '''Columbina:''' Hello, Mr. Guillotin. I'm Sandrone's friend.
:{{A|vo sdnlq004 11 columbina 04.ogg}} '''Columbina:''' You don't need to worry. Sandrone is doing great.
:{{A|vo sdnlq004 11 columbina 05.ogg}} '''Columbina:''' Not only is she a brilliant scholar, she's made a whole bunch of friends too. And she takes great care of them.
:{{A|vo sdnlq004 11 marionette 11.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' As if...
:{{A|vo sdnlq004 11 columbina 06.ogg}} '''Columbina:''' She'll never admit it, but she's always there when her friends need it the most. I wouldn't even be here without her.
:{{A|vo sdnlq004 11 columbina 07.ogg}} '''Columbina:''' So, if she ever needs help, her friends will be there in a heartbeat, including me. That's what best friends are for.
:{{A|vo sdnlq004 11 marionette 12.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' Columbina...
:{{A|vo sdnlq004 11 columbina 08.ogg}} '''Columbina:''' What else... Oh! She likes drinking bitter coffee, listening to piano music when she can't sleep... Turns out she even likes giving hugs...
:{{A|vo sdnlq004 11 marionette 13.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' No, wait! Don't tell him all that!
:{{A|vo sdnlq004 11 columbina 09.ogg}} '''Columbina:''' Huh? I don't understand. I didn't think you'd want to hide things from him.
:{{A|vo sdnlq004 11 marionette 14.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' Well, yeah. But there are still things I don't want to say!
:{{A|vo sdnlq004 11 columbina 10.ogg}} '''Columbina:''' Okay. I'll come by myself and tell him for you then.
:{{A|vo sdnlq004 11 marionette 15.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' That's not what I meant!
:{{A|vo sdnlq004 11 marionette 16.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' Tch, alright. Enough with the speeches. If no one has anything else to add, let's just leave it there!
:{{A|vo sdnlq004 11 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hm, should we say a few words too? Kinda seems like Columbina said it all...
:{{DIcon}} Let's leave a flower.
:{{A|vo sdnlq004 11 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ooh! Great idea!
:;(The Traveler and Sandrone each leave a bouquet of wildflowers, while Columbina leaves a ring of [[Moon-Prayer Blossom From Columbina|Moon-Prayer Blossoms]])
:;(As the group departs, Sandrone turns back one last time)
:{{A|vo sdnlq004 11 marionette 17.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' *sigh*... Goodbye, Alain.

;(Interact with Alain Guillotin's Epitaph, optional)

-->May the waters protect his soul<br><!--
-->May he be troubled by suffering no more<br><!--

;(Enter the Wingalet)
:{{A|vo sdnlq004 12 furina 01.ogg}} '''Furina:''' Ah, you made it! The party's already started.
:{{A|vo sdnlq004 12 furina 02.ogg}} '''Furina:''' Oh, but, uh, you didn't bring anyone else along? I thought you headed out to invite some friends?
:{{A|vo sdnlq004 12 marionette 01.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' We did invite a friend, actually. She'll be here soon. She's even bringing some desserts to have over tea. You should join us later, Miss Furina.
:{{A|vo sdnlq004 12 furina 03.ogg}} '''Furina:''' I do love a tea party... Then, don't mind if I do!
:{{A|vo sdnlq004 12 columbina 01.ogg}} '''Columbina:''' This seems like a fun occasion. Let's go talk with everyone!
:{{A|vo sdnlq004 12 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Good idea! We'll introduce you to all our old friends!

<!-- After talking to each of the following groups, the NPCS will all remain in the open-world, though none have talk-again lines. Some of them will move positions (see [[#Trivia]]). -->
;(Approach [[Emilie]], [[Chevreuse]], [[Chiori]], [[Clorinde]], and [[Navia]])
:{{A|vo sdnlq004 13 chevreuse 01.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' You made it! Sorry for starting the celebrations without you.
:{{A|vo sdnlq004 13 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' No worries at all! We're just glad everyone's having such a great time!
:{{A|vo sdnlq004 13 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, right! You've probably seen them around already, but let us introduce you for real. This is—
:{{A|vo sdnlq004 13 navia 01.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Miss Columbina and Miss Guillotin, right? Haha, we saw the film you were in! It was so touching!
:{{A|vo sdnlq004 13 clorinde 01.ogg}} '''Clorinde:''' Yep. This one started bawling her eyes out right next to me in the theatre.
:{{Introductory Note|Clorinde}}
:{{A|vo sdnlq004 13 navia 02.ogg}} '''Navia:''' I know! I didn't bring nearly enough tissues!
:{{A|vo sdnlq004 13 marionette 01.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' Thanks. We saw your film too. I memorized all your names.
:{{A|vo sdnlq004 13 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, guess we can skip the introductions then...
:{{A|vo sdnlq004 13 navia 03.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Hehe! Our effects were pretty over-the-top, right? Some of the extras in the big scenes were actual members of the [[Spina di Rosula]]!
:{{A|vo sdnlq004 13 chiori 01.ogg}} '''Chiori:''' So basically, your contribution was creating realistic-looking chaos.
:{{A|vo sdnlq004 13 clorinde 02.ogg}} '''Clorinde:''' Heh, that wasn't the only realistic aspect... Miss Chevreuse and Miss Emilie were also kind enough to lend their expertise on criminal investigations and forensics.
:{{A|vo sdnlq004 13 emilie 01.ogg}} '''Emilie:''' Oh, it was nothing. I was just honored to take part and help out.
:{{A|vo sdnlq004 13 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wow, no wonder your film turned out so good... You basically had an expert in every field! Talk about a stacked crew...
:{{A|vo sdnlq004 13 navia 04.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Oh, speaking of... Want to join in on a round of Tabletop Troupe later, Miss Columbina and Miss Guillotin? I mean, what better place for a party... than a party, hehehe!
:{{A|vo sdnlq004 13 clorinde 03.ogg}} '''Clorinde:''' Here we go again...
:{{A|vo sdnlq004 13 columbina 01.ogg}} '''Columbina:''' That sounds interesting.
:{{A|vo sdnlq004 13 navia 05.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Yes! Persuasion successful! What about you, Miss Guillotin?
:{{A|vo sdnlq004 13 marionette 02.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' Uh... I guess one round couldn't hurt...
:{{A|vo sdnlq004 13 navia 06.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Haha, critical success!

;(Approach [[Charlotte]], [[Escoffier]], and [[Lepine-Pauline]])
:{{A|vo sdnlq004 13 lepinepauline 01.ogg}} '''Lepine-Pauline:''' *sob*... What a dream come true... For once, it all worked out... I can die without regrets...
:{{A|vo sdnlq004 13 charlotte 01.ogg}} '''Charlotte:''' Uh, haha... Let's not get too ahead of ourselves, Director Lepine-Pauline!
:{{A|vo sdnlq004 13 charlotte 02.ogg}} '''Charlotte:''' What was in that piece of cake you just handed her, Escoffier?
:{{A|vo sdnlq004 13 escoffier 01.ogg}} '''Escoffier:''' [[Romaritime Flower|Romaritime flower]]s, eggs, flour... same as all the other pieces. What, you think I tampered with it? Playing a detective in real life now too, are we?
:{{Introductory Note|Escoffier}}
:{{A|vo sdnlq004 13 lepinepauline 02.ogg}} '''Lepine-Pauline:''' It's so delicious... I'm so happy... My life has peaked... *sob*...
:{{A|vo sdnlq004 13 xavier 01.ogg}} '''Xavier:''' Miss Lepine-Pauline, look who I brought!
:{{A|vo sdnlq004 13 ninette 01.ogg}} '''Ninette:''' Master!
:{{A|vo sdnlq004 13 ninette 02.ogg}} '''Ninette:''' Wait... What happened to your face? Why are you crying?
:{{A|vo sdnlq004 13 lepinepauline 03.ogg}} '''Lepine-Pauline:''' Never mind my face! Here, let me introduce you. This is Miss Charlotte and Miss Escoffier...
:;(The Traveler, Paimon, Sandrone, and Columbina approach the group)
:{{A|vo sdnlq004 13 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Things are sounding lively over here!
:{{A|vo sdnlq004 13 lepinepauline 04.ogg}} '''Lepine-Pauline:''' Oh, look who it is! Perfect timing! I was so busy with the shoot, I feel like we barely got to talk!
:{{A|vo sdnlq004 13 lepinepauline 05.ogg}} '''Lepine-Pauline:''' Ah! And the elusive Miss Guillotin! It's great to see you! Thank you so much for letting us use the boat free of charge. That was so generous of you!
:{{A|vo sdnlq004 13 lepinepauline 06.ogg}} '''Lepine-Pauline:''' Oh, right! Introductions! This is Miss Charlotte and Miss Escoffier...
:{{A|vo sdnlq004 13 marionette 08.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' That's kind of you, but I didn't really do anything. If you want to thank someone, it should be [[Wriothesley|the Duke]] or the people who keep the boat in such good shape.
:{{A|vo sdnlq004 13 lepinepauline 07.ogg}} '''Lepine-Pauline:''' Right, right... I'll head over in a bit and do just that!
:{{A|vo sdnlq004 13 charlotte 03.ogg}} '''Charlotte:''' Miss Columbina...?
:{{A|vo sdnlq004 13 columbina 03.ogg}} '''Columbina:''' Yes?
:{{A|vo sdnlq004 13 charlotte 04.ogg}} '''Charlotte:''' Could I... interview you sometime? I'll treat you to some [[Gateau Debord: Magnifique|Gateau Debord]] for the trouble! There's only a limited amount available each day, but it's an absolute must-try when you're in Fontaine!
:{{A|vo sdnlq004 13 columbina 04.ogg}} '''Columbina:''' Oh... Sure.
:{{A|vo sdnlq004 13 escoffier 02.ogg}} '''Escoffier:''' Bold of you to use my own cake as a bribe right in front of me...
:{{A|vo sdnlq004 13 lepinepauline 08.ogg}} '''Lepine-Pauline:''' You know what? When else are we all going to be together like this? C'mon, everyone. Grab your drinks!
:;(Everyone raises their glasses)
:{{A|vo sdnlq004 13 columbina 05.ogg}} '''Columbina:''' Are we going to toast?
:{{A|vo sdnlq004 13 lepinepauline 09.ogg}} '''Lepine-Pauline:''' Yep! C'mon, c'mon, c'mon! Sante!
:;(Lepine-Pauline rapidly clinks her own glass against everyone else's, before lifting it in the air)

;(Approach [[Citlali]], [[Freminet]], [[Lynette]], and [[Lyney]])
:{{A|vo sdnlq004 13 lyney 01.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Granny Itztli, you're really not going to let us borrow these cute little stuffed toys for our magic show?
:{{Introductory Note|Lyney}}
:{{A|vo sdnlq004 13 citlali 01.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' First of all, Citlalin and Itzpapa are Tzitzimitl! They have inauspicious stars sealed within them, and they're my helpers, not toys!
:{{A|vo sdnlq004 13 freminet 01.ogg}} '''Freminet:''' But... the [[Wondrous Trick: Miracle Parade|Grin-Malkin Cat]] and [[Magic Trick: Astonishing Shift|Bogglecat Box]] are Lyney and Lynette's helpers, and they still make good partners on stage.
:{{Introductory Note|Freminet}}
:{{A|vo sdnlq004 13 lynette 01.ogg}} '''Lynette:''' Agreed. We've never had a Tzitzimitl pop out of our hats before. It would be quite the surprise. I think the audience would love it.
:{{Introductory Note|Lynette}}
:{{A|vo sdnlq004 13 citlali 02.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' (Ugh... If this was the [[Masters of the Night-Wind]], these kids wouldn't have even had the guts to say my name, let alone pester me like this...)
:{{A|vo sdnlq004 13 citlali 03.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' (I'm terrible at dealing with requests like this... Oh! {{Traveler}}! Quick, save me!)
:;(The Traveler and Paimon approach the group)
:{{DIcon}} Looks like Granny Itztli's made some new friends!
:{{A|vo sdnlq004 13 citlali 04.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' You think you're so funny!
:{{A|vo sdnlq004 13 freminet 02.ogg}} '''Freminet:''' Lady Sandrone, Lady Columbina.
:{{A|vo sdnlq004 13 columbina 06.ogg}} '''Columbina:''' Hello.
:{{A|vo sdnlq004 13 marionette 09.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' Don't look at me like that. I don't have any mechanisms for you to break!
:{{A|vo sdnlq004 13 lynette 02.ogg}} '''Lynette:''' ...Hmph.
:{{A|vo sdnlq004 13 lyney 02.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Hehe... Don't be fooled by my sister's demeanor, Lady Sandrone. She's just as delighted as the rest of us to have you back.
:{{A|vo sdnlq004 13 marionette 10.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' Hmph, well... I suppose when I'm not so busy, I could find some time when [[Arlecchino]] is around, and bring over a few gifts to the [[House of the Hearth]].
:{{A|vo sdnlq004 13 lyney 03.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' You're too kind, Lady Sandrone. I'm sure just your visit alone would make "[[Arlecchino|Father]]" more than happy.
:{{A|vo sdnlq004 13 lynette 03.ogg}} '''Lynette:''' I just need to borrow them for a bit. I'll pull them out of my hat, give them a quick hug, then give them straight back.
:{{A|vo sdnlq004 13 citlali 05.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' When did hugging become a part of it!?
:{{A|vo sdnlq004 13 freminet 03.ogg}} '''Freminet:''' Oh! I could lend you [[Pers]], so you have something to hug in the meantime. He gives really good hugs...
:{{A|vo sdnlq004 13 citlali 06.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' I don't need something to hug in the meantime! The issue was never the hugs!
:{{A|vo sdnlq004 13 lynette 04.ogg}} '''Lynette:''' Mm, how about this... You can have two VIP tickets right next to each other. Excellent view!
:{{A|vo sdnlq004 13 citlali 07.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' Right next to each other?
:;(Lynette eyes both the Traveler and Citlali)
:{{A|vo sdnlq004 13 lynette 05.ogg}} '''Lynette:''' Yep. Super quiet. No one will bother you.
:{{A|vo sdnlq004 13 citlali 08.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' Ugh...
:;(Citlali glances at the Traveler)
:{{A|vo sdnlq004 13 lynette 06.ogg}} '''Lynette:''' I'm sure you'll have a great time.
:{{A|vo sdnlq004 13 citlali 09.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' Fine.

;(Approach [[Neuvillette]])
:{{A|vo sdnlq004 13 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Neuvillette! You came to the celebration too!
:{{A|vo sdnlq004 13 neuvillette 01.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' Yes. I can only hope my presence does not make anyone ill at ease.
:{{Introductory Note|Neuvillette}}
:{{A|vo sdnlq004 13 columbina 07.ogg}} '''Columbina:''' Who's this...?
:{{A|vo sdnlq004 13 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, right! This is Neuvillette, the Iudex of Fontaine. And this is Columbina and Sandrone.
:{{A|vo sdnlq004 13 neuvillette 02.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' Greetings.
:{{A|vo sdnlq004 13 marionette 11.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' Hello.
:{{A|vo sdnlq004 13 neuvillette 03.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' (These two must be the Fatuus and former Fatuus related to the recent incident in Nod-Krai. I read about them in the diplomatic report...)
:{{A|vo sdnlq004 13 columbina 08.ogg}} '''Columbina:''' The Iudex? Oh, the [[dragon]] that cries a lot.
:{{A|vo sdnlq004 13 neuvillette 04.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' Oh, well...
:{{A|vo sdnlq004 13 marionette 12.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' (Geez, Columbina... That's your takeaway from all those Fatui meetings. Seriously...?)
:{{A|vo sdnlq004 13 neuvillette 05.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' (Is that truly how I'm portrayed in the Fatui's intelligence?)
:{{A|vo sdnlq004 13 columbina 09.ogg}} '''Columbina:''' You must put a lot of people in prison, then...
:{{A|vo sdnlq004 13 neuvillette 06.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' Well, it would be more accurate to say I pass judgment on their crimes. All trials in Fontaine strive for fairness and justice, so as to avoid imprisoning the innocent.
:{{A|vo sdnlq004 13 columbina 10.ogg}} '''Columbina:''' So... only the people who deserve it get sent to prison.
:{{A|vo sdnlq004 13 neuvillette 07.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' Well, "deserve" is quite a subjective metric, is it not? At the very least, I can promise that, in every trial over which I preside, I make every effort to deliver a fair verdict.
:{{A|vo sdnlq004 13 columbina 11.ogg}} '''Columbina:''' Hm...
:;(Columbina punches Neuvillette lightly)
:{{A|vo sdnlq004 13 columbina 12.ogg}} '''Columbina:''' ...Hya!
:{{A|vo sdnlq004 13 marionette 13.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' (Oh, for the love of— What is she doing now!?)
:{{A|vo sdnlq004 13 neuvillette 08.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' Uhm...
:{{A|vo sdnlq004 13 columbina 13.ogg}} '''Columbina:''' You seem like a good per— uhm, dragon. Not the kind that throws people in prison for no reason.
:{{A|vo sdnlq004 13 columbina 14.ogg}} '''Columbina:''' I think we can get along just fine.
:{{A|vo sdnlq004 13 neuvillette 09.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' Ah, well... Thank you...?
:{{A|vo sdnlq004 13 neuvillette 10.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' (Then, she punched me because...?)
:{{A|vo sdnlq004 13 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Sorry, Neuvillette! She thinks that's a sign of friendship...
:{{A|vo sdnlq004 13 marionette 14.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' (Where does she even pick up weird habits like that...?)
:{{A|vo sdnlq004 13 neuvillette 11.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' Ah... I see. I believe I have observed people on the streets of Fontaine expressing affection in a similar manner.
:{{A|vo sdnlq004 13 neuvillette 12.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' I suppose I now know what it feels like. Hm, yes. Quite... abrupt.
:{{A|vo sdnlq004 13 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Y'know, these two are surprisingly alike...

;(Approach [[Baptiste]], [[Sigewinne]], [[Veronique]], and [[Wriothesley]])
:{{A|vo sdnlq004 13 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wait a second... Mr. Baptiste and Veronique! You're here!
:{{A|vo sdnlq004 13 marionette 03.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' Friends of yours?
:{{A|vo sdnlq004 13 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Veronique is the prop manager for Musketeer Pictures! And Mr. Baptiste is the author of "[[The Two Musketeers]]"!
:{{A|vo sdnlq004 13 veronique 01.ogg}} '''Veronique:''' Aha... Yeah, "former" prop manager. Now we're just two criminals serving our time.
:{{DIcon}} How've you been?
:{{A|vo sdnlq004 13 veronique 02.ogg}} '''Veronique:''' Thanks to Duke Wriothesley and Nurse Sigewinne looking out for us, not too bad actually.
:{{A|vo sdnlq004 13 wriothesley 01.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' You make it sound like I'm giving you special treatment. I just think the method of "justice" you chose to pursue is one people can respect.
:{{A|vo sdnlq004 13 baptiste 01.ogg}} '''Baptiste:''' You're far too modest, Your Grace. The only reason we were even able to come to the surface for the festival is because you fought for it.
:{{A|vo sdnlq004 13 sigewinne 01.ogg}} '''Sigewinne:''' It's also just good for the physical and mental health of the prisoners in general.
:{{Introductory Note|Sigewinne}}
:{{A|vo sdnlq004 13 wriothesley 02.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' Anyway, I suppose I have you to thank for keeping the Wingalet in such good shape! I never knew she could look so striking.
:{{A|vo sdnlq004 13 marionette 04a.ogg}}<!--{{A|vo sdnlq004 13 marionette 04b.ogg}}--> '''Marionette:''' I didn't do anything special. It was mostly {{Traveler}} and the others.
:{{A|vo sdnlq004 13 wriothesley 03.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' Don't sell yourself short, Miss Guillotin. You are the current captain, after all. In light of that, I have to ask...
:{{A|vo sdnlq004 13 wriothesley 04.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' Do you mind if I leave up some of the installations so the people back at the [[Fortress of Meropide|Fortress]] can also enjoy the aquarium?
:{{A|vo sdnlq004 13 marionette 05.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' ...Huh?
:{{A|vo sdnlq004 13 wriothesley 05.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' Like I said before, I just think it would be good for the inmates who clean and maintain the Wingalet to see their work put to good use.
:{{A|vo sdnlq004 13 wriothesley 06.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' Besides, maintaining an aquarium is sure to be a lot more interesting than scrubbing rust off the walls and deck.
:{{A|vo sdnlq004 13 marionette 06.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' Oh... Of course I don't mind. I'm grateful you even want to keep it.

==Gameplay Notes==
* During step 12, the Pagoda Stack puzzle can be skipped by selecting "Support" or by exiting the challenge. This will progress the quest.
** The "rule set" for the Pagoda Stack (based on the {{w|Tower of Hanoi}} mathematical puzzle) is actually the less intuitive/common ''"technically correct"'' application, only requiring moving the stacks to ''"one other-than-the-starting-position pin"'', being considered as solved when placed on ''either'' the middle ''or'' the right pin. The more commonly seen version of this problem usually expects to move the stacks from one end to the other side's pin ''only'', instead.
* After completing (or skipping) the Pagoda Stack game for the first time, it can be replayed freely. For subsequent games, the following changes are made:
** Adds an Easy Mode (3 layers) and a Hard Mode (7 layers).
** Adds a Challenge Timer, which counts up from zero. After finishing the puzzle, the Challenge Complete screen will display both the total move count and completion time taken.
* During steps 13-23, the player is in a [[Special Story Mode]]
** During steps 13-15, the active party is limited to the [[Traveler]].
** During steps 16-23, the active party is limited to a trial [[Sandrone]].<!-- no combat; walking only -->

:{{A|vo sdnlq002 8 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wow, this house is filled with so many memories! It's so cozy and charming!
:{{A|vo sdnlq002 8 marionette 01.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' Hmph, you should've seen it in its prime, when people actually lived here. A lit fireplace, a steaming cup of coffee... that's the real deal.

:{{A|vo sdnlq002 8 marionette 03.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' Alain never played it much. He probably wasn't able to at that point.
:{{A|vo sdnlq002 8 marionette 04.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' But I managed to teach myself. Music theory is essentially math, after all. Once you learn the patterns, it's not really that difficult.
:{{A|vo sdnlq002 8 marionette 05.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' I loved perusing Alain's collection of classical music. The chords and harmonies felt like individual mathematical puzzles. It was fascinating, so I did some composing as well.
:{{A|vo sdnlq002 8 marionette 06.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' But as Alain continued to deteriorate, even the sound of music began to grate on his nerves. So I got rid of the piano.
:{{A|vo sdnlq002 8 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh...
:{{A|vo sdnlq002 8 marionette 07.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' Back then, I assumed a piano was like an ordinary clothing rack, commonplace in every home and easily replaceable. It was only after I left that I realized how hard a good piano is to find...
:{{A|vo sdnlq002 8 marionette 08.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' Ahem, enough about that. Alain's gift should be just in here. The only things undisturbed before I left were a few of his personal belongings.

:{{A|vo sdnlq002 9 alainguillotinold 04.ogg}} '''Alain Guillotin:''' "I once asked if there was something you wished for. Do you remember that? I wonder if time has changed your answer..."
:{{A|vo sdnlq002 9 alainguillotinold 05.ogg}} '''Alain Guillotin:''' "Regardless, I have another gift — a formula that will allow you to come face to face with the 'anomaly' inside of you. Haha... if you even still call her that."
:{{A|vo sdnlq002 9 alainguillotinold 06.ogg}} '''Alain Guillotin:''' "Why this gift? To understand that, allow me to wax poetic on the soul once again. I would ask you to stick with me until the end, but I know you will. You always have."
:{{A|vo sdnlq002 9 alainguillotinold 07.ogg}} '''Alain Guillotin:''' "I believe a person should be born twice over in their lifetime. First, there's the birth that grants us life, then the birth of the soul."
:{{A|vo sdnlq002 9 alainguillotinold 08.ogg}} '''Alain Guillotin:''' "It's a matter of transforming the life bestowed upon us into the life we choose for ourselves. And to do that, we must look inward.
:{{A|vo sdnlq002 9 alainguillotinold 09.ogg}} '''Alain Guillotin:''' "We must make a conscious choice to define the meaning of our life, instead of allowing the happenstance of our existence to pass us by..."

:{{A|vo sdnlq002 9 alainguillotinold 11.ogg}} '''Alain Guillotin:''' "You are my proudest masterpiece. I told you that long ago. But to me, you have never been a creation or a machine."

:{{A|vo sdnlq002 9 alainguillotinold 13.ogg}} '''Alain Guillotin:''' "In fact, some theories think of the human brain as nothing more than a machine, and thought the product of its computations."
:{{A|vo sdnlq002 9 alainguillotinold 14.ogg}} '''Alain Guillotin:''' "So, you see? Perhaps we're not so different, after all. Your inner machinery is just far more advanced than most."
:{{A|vo sdnlq002 9 alainguillotinold 15.ogg}} '''Alain Guillotin:''' "No matter how one looks at it, the heart is a complex thing... a place where logic and reason collide with our emotions.

:{{A|vo sdnlq002 9 alainguillotinold 19.ogg}} '''Alain Guillotin:''' "Similar to how a blind person can feel when a part of their {{Rubi|body|soul}} is in pain, without being able to fully visualize its form. Such is your relationship with your soul."
:{{A|vo sdnlq002 9 alainguillotinold 20.ogg}} '''Alain Guillotin:''' "So, what I leave you now is this... a formula that will allow you to see the shape of your soul. For if you want to protect your 'heart,' you must first be able to recognize it within yourself."

:{{A|vo sdnlq002 9 marionette 24.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' "Regardless, whether by my formula or some other means, I trust you will know your heart one day. You always were a fast learner... and the smartest person I've ever known."
