:{{A|vo sdnlq002 17 marionette 13.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' I may have accepted my emoti{{Rubi|onal self|anomalies}}, but I'm not about to go all soft and mushy on the inside and pour my heart out.
:;(The Traveler smiles to themselves)
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (...Yep, still the same old Sandrone.)
:{{A|vo sdnlq002 17 marionette 14.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' That said... taking a step in the right direction couldn't hurt... starting with cleaning some old aquarium tanks of my own.
:{{A|vo sdnlq002 17 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh?
:{{A|vo sdnlq002 17 marionette 15.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' Metaphorically speaking, I mean. C'mon, let's head back to the ship. I need to talk to that Shaman.
----
;(Enter the Wingalet)
:{{A|vo sdnlq002 18 citlali 01.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' ...Huh? Resentful lost souls?
:{{A|vo sdnlq002 18 marionette 01.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' You couldn't get comfortable sleeping near the [[Opera Epiclese]], right? Well, I bet that's why. The [[Fountain of Lucine]] is where all the water in Fontaine gathers, so that's where the emotions within the water converge as well.
:{{A|vo sdnlq002 18 citlali 02.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' Hold on... If it's souls we're dealing with, feeling uncomfortable should have been just the beginning. I should have been able to hear their voices or something.
:{{A|vo sdnlq002 18 marionette 02.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' And under normal circumstances, I'm sure someone of your talents would have. The problem is, these souls are no longer complete.
:{{A|vo sdnlq002 18 citlali 03.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' Remind me how they ended up like that again? You mentioned something about them being split apart?
:{{A|vo sdnlq002 18 marionette 03.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' Yes. It's called soul-severing. Rene of the [[Narzissenkreuz Ordo]] came up with it.
:{{A|vo sdnlq002 18 marionette 04.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' After learning of Fontaine's impending doom, Rene thought if he could find a means for the soul to live on in perpetuity, it might ensure the world's salvation. Soul-severing was the first step of his research.
:{{A|vo sdnlq002 18 marionette 05.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' Unfortunately, his theory of the Four Orthants was imperfect at the time, and a failure along the way caused his physical form to dissipate.
:{{A|vo sdnlq002 18 marionette 06.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' [[Jakob]], another member of the Narzissenkreuz Ordo, sought to carry on Rene's legacy and restore his physical form. He even used some of the people who stood in his way as test subjects for his research.
:{{A|vo sdnlq002 18 citlali 04.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' By severing their souls?
:{{A|vo sdnlq002 18 marionette 07.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' Yes. After Rene successfully awakened, the two continued their research, and all the severed souls ended up merging into Rene's consciousness.
:{{A|vo sdnlq002 18 marionette 08.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' After you saved Fontaine by turning Fontainians into true "humans," these souls returned to the [[Ley Line]]s.
:{{A|vo sdnlq002 18 marionette 09.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' But the souls severed before Rene awakened had nowhere to go, doomed to forever wander the waters of Fontaine as listless spirits.
:{{A|vo sdnlq002 18 citlali 05.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' Almost as if they exist outside the bounds of this world... unrecognized by the Ley Lines or fate. No wonder I couldn't sense them.
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (Breaking free from fate... was also one of Rene's goals back then.)
:{{A|vo sdnlq002 18 marionette 10.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' Not only that, but over time, they began to fuse with other entities. Their inner resentment lured in all sorts of evil beings, which corrupted and defiled them into nothing more than accumulations of filth.
:{{A|vo sdnlq002 18 marionette 11.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' But the full transformation must have been recent. Otherwise, the [[Neuvillette|Iudex]] surely would have noticed.
:{{A|vo sdnlq002 18 marionette 12.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' Wait, no, he must know already! That would explain the underwater [[Melusine]] patrols. No wonder I kept running into officers from the [[Marechaussee Phantom]] earlier!
:{{A|vo sdnlq002 18 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' In that case, let's go find [[Neuvillette]], and we can sort it out together!
:{{A|vo sdnlq002 18 marionette 13.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' No, not just yet.
:{{A|vo sdnlq002 18 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Why not?
:{{A|vo sdnlq002 18 marionette 14.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' For one, the diplomatic hassle alone would be a nightmare. Even though I haven't reported back to [[Snezhnaya]] yet, I'm not planning to leave the Fatui anytime soon.
:{{A|vo sdnlq002 18 marionette 15.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' Heh, besides, with me here, success is a done deal. Involving other people would just complicate things.
:{{A|vo sdnlq002 18 marionette 16.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' All I need is for Miss Citlali to help pinpoint the location of this monstrosity. Think you can do it?
:{{A|vo sdnlq002 18 citlali 06.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' Pfft, with my eyes closed. This is what I do. I'm a lot better at it than manning a desk, at least.
:{{A|vo sdnlq002 18 citlali 07.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' But, uh, how exactly do you plan on resolving this soul stuff? Even to me, there's no obvious answer. Seems pretty complicated, all things considered.
:{{A|vo sdnlq002 18 marionette 17.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' Just trust me. I have the perfect solution.
:{{A|vo sdnlq002 18 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Uh, alright. If you're that confident, we'll follow your lead.
:{{A|vo sdnlq002 18 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh, why the sudden interest in helping Fontaine with this, Sandrone? You never knew Rene and the others, right?
:{{A|vo sdnlq002 18 marionette 18.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' No, I didn't. And you're right, this problem has nothing to do with me. I wouldn't get within ten feet of the Narzissenkreuz Ordo or its members.
:{{A|vo sdnlq002 18 marionette 19.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' But... In his later years, Alain told me he regretted not helping his best friend when he needed it the most.
:{{A|vo sdnlq002 18 marionette 20.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' He also felt sorry towards [[Mary-Ann Guillotin|Mary-Ann]], for being too lost in his mechanical research to look after her properly.
:{{A|vo sdnlq002 18 marionette 21.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' If he were still with us, I think he'd do the same. He might have a few choice words to say about it, but even after everything, he wouldn't leave his friend's mess for someone else to clean up.
:{{A|vo sdnlq002 18 marionette 22.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' Friends shouldn't hold grudges or leave behind regrets. Fixing what happened between him and Rene was one of his greatest wishes. All I'm doing is fulfilling it in his stead.
:{{A|vo sdnlq002 18 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hehe, y'know, you really do seem a little different now.
:{{A|vo sdnlq002 18 marionette 23.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' Tch, you mean everything that just happened wasn't for nothing? Why, thank you for pointing out the obvious, Paimon.
:{{DIcon}} Giving those aquarium tanks a good cleaning, huh...
:{{A|vo sdnlq002 18 marionette 24.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' Hmph, just washing off the grime of the past. Turns out, a lot can build up after being ignored for so long.
:{{A|vo sdnlq002 18 citlali 08a.ogg}}<!--{{A|vo sdnlq002 18 citlali 08b.ogg}}--> '''Citlali:''' (What's this about aquarium tanks all of a sudden? They go off on some grand adventure, and what? Now they have their own private code? Hmph, stupid.)
:;(Having heard her thoughts, the Traveler looks over at Citlali in confusion)
:{{A|vo sdnlq002 18 marionette 25.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' Alright then, Citlali. Tracking this thing down is up to you.
:{{A|vo sdnlq002 18 citlali 09.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' Huh? Oh... Right. No problem.
:{{A|vo sdnlq002 18 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You've got this, Granny Itztli!
:{{DIcon}} You've got this, Granny Itztli!
:{{A|vo sdnlq002 18 citlali 10.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' Tch...! You! Come with me to [[Hotel Debord]] for a drink. Right now!
:{{DIcon}} Wh—Why?
:{{A|vo sdnlq002 18 citlali 11.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' Why? Because I said so!
:{{A|vo sdnlq002 18 citlali 12.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' Miss Guillotin, I'll report back on the location tomorrow morning. Just need a drink or two first to bolster me up.
:{{A|vo sdnlq002 18 marionette 26.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' Well... Don't let me keep you.
:{{A|vo sdnlq002 18 citlali 13.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' Alright, you. Time to go! I've got scores that need settling...
:{{A|vo sdnlq002 18 marionette 27.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' ...Huh?

This tale comes from the desolate, distant past. In those days, the mountains' teeth were still bared like blades against man and beast, thirsting for the souls of the feeble-minded, human and nonhuman alike.
People knew that the god of the mountains loved them not, and was to be given a wide berth. Yet they were forced to seek shelter in caverns from the storms screaming through the wilds, all to pass one long night after the next. But these caverns, like the mountains, extracted payment from these vagrants. Countless were the tribes who lost kin to the wastes through which they stumbled blind.

Valiant Tequil and his kindhearted brother Rimac were born to one such tribe.

At the hour of their birth, a long, troubling night reigned inside and outside the caves, and though the campfires around which the tribespeople sat flickered, none were comforted by their light.
The people thought:
"This fire shall soon go out, and once it does, we too shall be finished!"
"How long will this night last? I'm cold... and hungry too..."
"Let's hurry things up then! Quickly, let me walk into the night! Better that than this torment."
"Oh, you poor children... You poor, poor children..."

Yet Tequil and Rimac did not announce themselves with sorrowful cries as other children did.
Instead, Tequil stared into the cavern depths. The minions of the cavern did their best to frighten him, but his gaze swept over them, keen as a sharp stone spur.
"He has seen us, our sharp claws and long teeth, but he is not afraid!"
The wicked creatures whispered amongst themselves anxiously, and involuntarily retracted said appendages.


Rimac for his part waved his hands and laughed, and his laughter was like pebbles tumbling in a stream, drawing the eyes of all the distressed tribespeople to his face. Only then did they notice that though the flame wavered, it had never ceased to burn, and with another wave of his hands, Rimac patted the firewood next to him.

"Feed the flame! Feed the flame!"
The elderly chief, thus reminded by the newborn boy, shouted his words aloud, repelling the fear that had been about to swallow the tribe whole.

People stood and fueled the fire, and they drew their obsidian blades, casting their eyes into the cavern depths just as Tequil had.

The beasts of the cavern were filled with rage and hate, but they knew that these people would not loosen their grip on their weapons, nor would their eyes be shut. Terror had already fled, and so death was forced to retreat.

Only when the sun rose again did the brothers close their eyes, falling asleep in their mother's bosom.

Thus did the tribespeople depart the cave, having lived another day. These people, who had rejected fear, would live countless days more.

Yet the defeat of her evil underlings caught the eye of their master, Coatlicue.
For this lord of demons, who claimed to be the mother of the underworld and mistress of ten thousand times ten thousand caves, whose fangs were the rocky stalactites, whose tongue was every blast of wet, frigid wind, and who upon awakening could only be satiated by devouring ten thousand living souls — Tequil and Rimac were the first humans to slip her grasp.
Shamefaced, this earth mother waved her hand, lashing the evil beasts cowering to the side with rock.
"Go! Go! Redeem your humiliating failure! Capture those dimwitted mortals and fill my stomach!"

But having seen their fears vanquished, the people remembered well the methods of scattering those terrors time after time.

They settled at the foot of the mountains, sharpened wooden stakes, lit fires, and gave the sharpest blades to their best warriors, with which they would stand guard behind the stakes. Their bright eyes pierced the wilderness beyond the firelight, and did not shift their gazes away for even a moment.

By blade and fire did Coatlicue's minions taste defeat time after time, until they could do nothing but huddle in the dark, daring not to draw near the flame.

The fires in the hearts of the people ignited, and they began to speak of victory, of light, and of the end of the viper — they believed in Tequil and Rimac. These two brothers could surely keep the heat and light alive.

Tequil and Rimac thought the same, and so they sharpened their spears and blades, preparing to drive the demon lord of that evil serpent to her doom.

But the earth mother, who hated this tribe, did not relent.
She took sludge from the deepest parts of the cave and pinched it into a snake. Then, she plucked out her eye, setting it into the serpent's eye socket.
"It was that child who caused you to witness the fire, and so, let me go and swallow his eyes."

One evening, when the sun had just set, night's veil was slowly covering the sky, and the stars had yet to begin granting their light, the serpent bit and slew a rabbit beyond the tribe's bounds, and burrowed into its skin, lying flat on the ground.

Rimac, returning from gathering herbs, came upon this rabbit, and seeing its wound, the kind child put his torch down without hesitation, and reaching for his herbs, he chewed on them, preparing to apply them to the rabbit. But the snake, speaking for the earth mother, leaped from the wound, hissing laughter:

"Hahaha, ignorant, foolish human! Sacrificing yourself for a lowly rabbit!"

Before Rimac could retrieve his torch, the earth mother's serpent latched its fangs first onto his neck, then, burrowing into his body, captured his heart and soul both.

The defenseless sentries were the next to be murdered by the earth mother, for they greeted Rimac just as they always did when he returned from gathering herbs, only to be pierced through the heart by the serpent, dying on the spot. The entire tribe's fires were put out, and amidst the shroud of darkness, death and terror were resurgent.

The earth mother spat the snake out, and through poisoned fangs she cried out:
"Behold! Behold, you arrogant fools, and kneel as you should in the dust!"

But the sound of a rock being struck cut her off, for Tequil, who had been sharpening his obsidian blade, used it to create sparks that set his tent alight.

He raised his blade and charged forward, letting fly his blade at the earth mother's messenger. The blazing edge cleaved the poisoned serpent molded from soil with ease, but as Tequil was about to follow through, he saw his brother's eyes and the blood staining his brother's hands.

That instant was all the time the wounded viper needed to escape. Yet nigh fully charred it was still, and the earth mother's eye reduced almost to ashes.

This tribe was destroyed, and never again was there a chance it would dare defy her.

Thus did the earth mother comfort herself as she retreated into the darkness.
How Tequil wished to call out Rimac's name! But the burning dust caught in his throat, and so he could only watch as his brother vanished into the night.

When the night at last passed, Tequil, who stood amidst the ruins, knew that the surviving tribespeople could no longer stay. Burying his confusion and pain deep in his heart, he led them on a new journey.

They crossed mountains and canyons, dodging fearsome beasts and poisonous insects. Tequil did not close his eyes for so long as they journeyed, nor did he dare to loosen his grip on blade or torch.

Finally, by a silent volcano, they found a tribe willing to take them in.

Only after he saw the last of his tribe peacefully fall into slumber under the old shaman's care did he relax and collapse to the earth.

When he awoke, he found himself in a blazing cave. The lava that surrounded him undulated with an erratic pulse, as if the very mountain was slowly breathing. When he stood up, the lava boiled and bubbled, and a rumbling came from all directions:

"Do not search for your brother. His eyes have been devoured by a cunning serpent."
"But I must save him, and pursue that venomous snake also!"

His words echoed through the cave, but the Goddess of Mountains and Fire was silent.
Tequil thus prayed unto her:
"Let my brother's name live on. I am willing to sacrifice my heart and blood in return."
The goddess answered him in the echoing cave.
Thus said she:
"Your prayer have I heard, but your brother is no longer your kin. His name has sunken into the deepest of depths."
Tequil raised his head and lifted up his wish to the goddess:
"Turn my blood to fire, so my heart may illuminate the depths. I will bring my brother back before my blood runs dry."
"Turn my blood to fire, until my soul may sear and slay that serpent. I will take its head before my blood runs dry."

When Tequil awoke once again, the old shaman of the tribe gave him a brand-new sword, food, and water.
Finally, the shaman clasped his shoulders and blessed him:
"May your fire dry the venomous snake's venom."

Thus did Tequil embark on another journey. His strength was endless, his body tireless, and his blood burned like lava. He crossed grassy fields and snowy peaks, deep valleys and high mountains, and the Goddess of Mountains and Fire showed him the way with falling rocks and the cracks in cliffs. Thus did Tequil stride forward without hesitation.

When he met his brother again, the earth mother mocked him once more using Rimac's body and voice, but when her claws pierced Tequil's chest, he moved not, and instead her bones were melted by his burning blood.
Tequil stared the vicious demon lord down, and said in a loud voice:
"My brother is gentle of heart. He would surely have made this land a better place."
"Yet you have affronted him with your poison, smothered his virtue, slaughtered those who had faith in his virtue!"
"Die, you despicable, venomous insect! Die here!"
As he roared, Tequil's blood stained his obsidian blade, turning it red-hot in an instant. The earth mother watched in terror as her shell, bones, and soul were sundered. She wished to scream, to buy but a moment in which she could unleash her claws and tear Tequil to ribbons.
But she could make no sound, for in the fire's light, the silent soul to whom this body once belonged awakened. And that soul cried out to his brother:
"I do not wish to see your blood be reduced to ash, but I have seen the light of your heart and spirit. Remember my name, brother. As long as you remember me, I will never have left."

The blazing flames swept over every corner in that gloomy, frigid cavern, and every last poisonous insect within was slain, burned to ash alongside every plot and scheme, so heinous and vile.
As the last drop of his blood was about to burn away, the roof of the cave above Tequil's head trembled. A fissure opened, and a gem fell down and stopped up his wound.
The Goddess of Mountains and Fire spoke once more, and her voice echoed across the walls:
"You yet have one drop of blood. Return to your tribe, for this is your brother's wish, and I will see it fulfilled."

One night, the old shaman who had waited day after day beyond the tribe's bounds stood to welcome the returning Tequil.
But Tequil refused the water, the food, and the cheers. Instead, he simply said:
"The venomous snake is slain, and I am victorious. But I shall soon depart along with my brother."

He took the gem from his chest, placed it upon a torch, and walked up to the silent volcano.
"I have but one drop of blood left, but it was not left for me, but rather, for justice and fairness, for the good and the brave."
"Use it, and light a fire — a flame that shall never be extinguished."

Having said that, valiant Tequil leaped into the dead volcano. The earth was shaken by his heart and blood, and the volcano's own heart resumed beating, the blazing lava once more beginning to flow.
The volcano lives — as does the bravery of all the tribes.}} :{{A|vo xnnlq003 1 xilonen 36.ogg}} '''Xilonen:''' I remember there was one line that was super popular at the time. '''Three Realms Gateway Offering: Aftermath''' is an Event Quest during the [[Three Realms Gateway Offering]] event.

==Steps==
# Return to the [[Dainichi Mikoshi]] to look for [[Tsumi]]
# Go to the Dainichi Mikoshi's entrance
# Go and search for the [[Enjou|Abyss Lector]]
# Defeat the Abyss Lector
# Return to the Dainichi Mikoshi to look for Tsumi
# Use the mechanism to guide the light (0/3)
#* At each of the locations, there are 2 Common Chests on the way up
# Go beneath the Dainichi Mikoshi and investigate
# Head beneath the Dainichi Mikoshi
# Defeat the [[Bathysmal Vishaps]]
# Head beneath the Dainichi Mikoshi to look for Tsumi
# Leave Enkanomiya and speak to [[Sangonomiya Kokomi|Kokomi]]

:{{A|vo eqyx005 5 fuchikamialter 05.ogg}} '''The Thing Calling Itself "Enjou":''' Makes sense, doesn't it? The Bathysmal Vishaps are a highly intelligent and fast-evolving kind. There have been legends about this for over a thousand years now.

But today, only the common folk have flourished, while the other two bloodlines have declined. So the pendant is of little use anymore.
:{{A|vo eqyx005 19 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Funny you should say vassals... One of the soldiers seemed to think that Tsumi was one of those. But actually, her vertical pupils meant that she was a reptile... She fooled us all.

:{{A|vo eqyx005 19 kokomi 08.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' But Vishap-people and Reptilians... they're pure fiction. There is no evidence for their existence anywhere among Sangonomiya's classified documents.
:{{A|vo eqyx005 19 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, so Tsumi isn't actually a vishap?
:{{A|vo eqyx005 19 kokomi 09.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' The Watatsumi Omikami exhausted its power to create Watatsumi Island, and after that, it grew weaker and weaker. No more Vassals of Watatsumi were born after that. But the records do mention the very last of the vassals...
:{{A|vo eqyx005 19 kokomi 10.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' All our hopes were placed onto her. She was going to be the one who could communicate between the vishaps and the humans. But when she was just an infant girl, she and her guardian shrine maiden were attacked by vishaps at the border of Enkanomiya. Her whereabouts have been unknown ever since.
:{{A|vo eqyx005 19 kokomi 11.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' Most believe she died that day. But some believe she was raised by the vishaps.
:{{A|vo eqyx005 19 kokomi 12.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' The people of Watatsumi owe a great debt of gratitude to the Vassals of Watatsumi. Now that the vishaps and Watatsumi Islanders no longer have a territorial dispute, I sincerely hope that she will find her way to where she belongs... wherever that is for her.
:{{A|vo eqyx005 19 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What a story...
:{{A|vo eqyx005 19 kokomi 13.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' Still, now that we know how Bloodbranch Coral works, I, as Divine Priestess of Sangonomiya, may need to think of a new way to counteract the Holy Soil phenomenon.
:{{A|vo eqyx005 19 kokomi 14.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' For the time being, however, the issue is resolved, and all thanks to you. Watatsumi Island will be at peace for many decades to come.
:{{A|vo eqyx005 19 kokomi 15.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' I can't thank you enough.

'''Three Realms Gateway Offering: The Eve''' is an Event Quest during the [[Three Realms Gateway Offering]] event.

==Steps==
# Go to [[Sangonomiya Shrine]] and look for [[Kokomi]]
# Talk to [[Tsuyuko]]
# Venture into the darkness of Enkanomiya with [[Ueno]]
# Go to the makeshift camp
# Investigate the makeshift camp
# Talk to the injured soldiers (0/3)
# Go to the perimeter of the camp
# Talk to [[Tsumi]]
#* Obtain [[Bokuso Box]]
# Use the Bokuso Box to defeat the monsters
#* {{Enemy|Electro Abyss Mage|x=1}}
#* {{Enemy|Hilichurl|x=3}}
# Talk to Tsumi
# Use the Bokosu Box and complete the challenge
#* Defeat 3 opponents in 120 second(s)
#* {{Enemy|Large Geo Slime|x=1}}
#* {{Enemy|Large Pyro Slime|x=1}}
#* {{Enemy|Large Electro Slime|x=1}}
#* A Common Chest containing 5 Light Realm Sigil appears after this
# Talk to Tsumi

==Dialogue==
{{Quest Description|Learning that the Watatsumi Goryou Matsuri was successfully conducted, you prepare to go pay Kokomi a visit...}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Upon login or completing requisite quest)
:{{A|vo eqyx001 1 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Apparently, they held the [[Watatsumi Goryou Matsuri]] in Sangonomiya recently. Paimon bets Kokomi was the host.
:{{A|vo eqyx001 1 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Let's go pay her a visit.

;(Approach Kokomi)
:{{A|vo eqyx001 1 ueno 01.ogg}} '''Ueno:''' ...This is the correspondence from Stingray III. Your Excellency, the situation looks extremely serious.
:{{A|vo eqyx001 1 kokomi 01.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' Thank you, Ueno. Inform Swordfish I to stand by. I'll see to the wounded shortly.
:{{A|vo eqyx001 1 ueno 02.ogg}} '''Ueno:''' Yes, Ma'am.
:{{A|vo eqyx001 1 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hey, Kokomi! How've you been?
;(If the player has not finished the quest [[Sword, Fish, Resistance]])
::{{A|vo eqyx001 1 kokomi 02.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' Ah, {{Traveler}}, it's you. Glad to have you back on Watatsumi Island. I would have liked to have given you a grand reception, but as you can see...
;(If the player has finished the quest [[Sword, Fish, Resistance]])
::{{A|vo eqyx001 1 kokomi 20.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' Ah, Captain of Swordfish II. Glad to have you back on Watatsumi Island. I would have liked to have given you a grand reception, but as you can see...
:{{A|vo eqyx001 1 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What's going on?
:{{A|vo eqyx001 1 kokomi 03.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' Not long ago, I hosted the Watatsumi Goryou Matsuri. It's the most important ceremony on Watatsumi Island. I'm guessing you'll have heard about it from Tsuyuko—
:{{A|vo eqyx001 1 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What? How did you know we were the ones helping out Tsuyuko this whole time?
:{{DIcon}} I'd be more surprised if she didn't know...
:{{DIcon}} How could you not tell, Paimon?
:{{A|vo eqyx001 1 kokomi 04.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' Ahem. Tsuyuko is one of the more conscientious shrine maidens of Sangonomiya. I knew that handing off the planning of the ceremony to her would play to her strengths.
:{{A|vo eqyx001 1 kokomi 05.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' Based on her description of the person who took the commission, it was quite obviously you.
:{{A|vo eqyx001 1 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' This is all starting to sound pretty suspicious...
:{{DIcon}} It's a bit late for that now, Paimon.
:{{A|vo eqyx001 1 kokomi 06.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' Anyway. I'm sure Tsuyuko will have told you that the Watatsumi Goryou Matsuri is a ceremony to reverse the [[Holy Soil]] phenomenon on Watatsumi Island.
:{{A|vo eqyx001 1 kokomi 07.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' It's a bleaching process that slowly turns the earth to "Holy Soil," leaving the land infertile and devastating agricultural production.
:{{A|vo eqyx001 1 kokomi 08.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' Granted, crops aren't our staple food on Watatsumi Island, but I can't allow external forces to drastically alter the people's diet — and we certainly shouldn't be overly reliant on imports...
:{{A|vo eqyx001 1 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Paimon doesn't quite follow...
:{{A|vo eqyx001 1 kokomi 09.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' Imagine all you had to eat from now on was radishes, no more fish or meat. Clearer now?
:{{DIcon}} (Opposite day. There's something Paimon can follow.)
:{{A|vo eqyx001 1 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' That would be terrible!
:{{A|vo eqyx001 1 kokomi 10.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' The issue began with the Watatsumi Goryou Matsuri. I did not miss a single step during the ritual and there's no question that the [[Bloodbranch Coral]] you retrieved was infused with the [[Omikami]]'s power...
:{{A|vo eqyx001 1 kokomi 11.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' But it didn't reverse the Holy Soil phenomenon as expected. Instead, it just... paused. This has never happened before in history.
:{{A|vo eqyx001 1 kokomi 12.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' This is ultimately a matter of Watatsumi Island's survival, so I sent as many people as I could spare to Enkanomiya to investigate the situation.
:{{A|vo eqyx001 1 kokomi 13.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' The news from Stingray III was that "All of Enkanomiya is engulfed in a darkness that cannot be dispelled." Additionally, there have also been reports of monsters the likes of which no one has ever seen before.
:{{A|vo eqyx001 1 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Strange monsters and... an all-engulfing darkness?
:{{A|vo eqyx001 1 kokomi 14.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' That's all that Stingray III has reported. Their investigation otherwise has yielded no useful information, and the unforgiving environment has caused many casualties so far...
:{{A|vo eqyx001 1 kokomi 15.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' I have sent several rescue teams already, but so far... the situation does not look promising.
:{{A|vo eqyx001 1 kokomi 16.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' It brings me no pleasure to have to ask, but on behalf of all of Watatsumi Island... I beseech you. Please lend us your assistance one more time, {{Traveler}}.
:{{DIcon}} Anything for you, Ma'am.
::{{A|vo eqyx001 1 kokomi 17a.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' Heh... please don't joke around.
::{{A|vo eqyx001 1 kokomi 17a 1.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' But thank you for once again agreeing to put your life on the line for the sake of our island.
:{{DIcon}} For the sake of everyone on Watatsumi Island, I'll do it.
::{{A|vo eqyx001 1 kokomi 17b.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' Thank you, {{Traveler}}.
:{{A|vo eqyx001 1 kokomi 18.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' Now, please come with me to meet Tsuyuko.

;(Approach Tsuyuko)
:{{A|vo eqyx001 2 tsuyuko 01.ogg}} '''Tsuyuko:''' Your Excellency, {{Traveler}}...
:{{A|vo eqyx001 2 tsuyuko 02.ogg}} '''Tsuyuko:''' I did wonder. Hope you're both having a wonderful date so far.
:{{A|vo eqyx001 2 kokomi 01.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' Ahem... Cut the comedy, Tsuyuko. Or I may have to have you and Naki switch posts next year — in which case, you'd be in charge of Specter Eco-Management on Watatsumi Island.
:{{A|vo eqyx001 2 tsuyuko 03.ogg}} '''Tsuyuko:''' No need, no need! I'll stop. So since the two of you are here together, I assume it's about Enkanomiya?
:{{A|vo eqyx001 2 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Kokomi filled us in on what's been going on.
:{{A|vo eqyx001 2 tsuyuko 04.ogg}} '''Tsuyuko:''' Oooh, "Kokomi." Hehe... ahem.
:{{A|vo eqyx001 2 tsuyuko 05.ogg}} '''Tsuyuko:''' Right, well, as I'm sure Her Excellency has told you, an ominous darkness has completely engulfed Enkanomiya. At the same time, strange humanoid monsters have appeared when the place should be completely deserted.
:{{A|vo eqyx001 2 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Humanoid... monsters?
:{{A|vo eqyx001 2 tsuyuko 06.ogg}} '''Tsuyuko:''' Armor that can move on its own. I know it sounds ridiculous, but we're not talking about one spooked soldier hallucinating in the darkness. All the wounded who return to Sangonomiya have described seeing the same thing.
:{{A|vo eqyx001 2 tsuyuko 07.ogg}} '''Tsuyuko:''' On top of this, even ordinary enemies seem to grow much stronger in the darkness. That's why Stingray III has sustained so many casualties.
:{{A|vo eqyx001 2 tsuyuko 08.ogg}} '''Tsuyuko:''' There's one other thing that the returning soldiers have mentioned. They say a shrine maiden who calls herself Tsumi has been helping to treat the wounded.
:{{A|vo eqyx001 2 kokomi 02.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' Tsumi? I don't recall there being any record of a shrine maiden by that name in Sangonomiya.
:{{A|vo eqyx001 2 tsuyuko 09.ogg}} '''Tsuyuko:''' That's the thing, there isn't one. But she held something called a Sentou ceremony, which managed to keep a small area in the very center of Enkanomiya brightly lit.
:{{A|vo eqyx001 2 tsuyuko 10.ogg}} '''Tsuyuko:''' Thanks to her, the wounded soldiers have a safe zone where they can recuperate.
:{{A|vo eqyx001 2 kokomi 03.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' Sentou... I've seen this term in the Deep-Sea Healing Arts Compendium. But it's a ceremony that only works in Enkanomiya, so it was never brought to Watatsumi Island.
:{{A|vo eqyx001 2 kokomi 04.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' I'd love to meet this Tsumi... But right now, helping the wounded has to be my top priority.
:{{A|vo eqyx001 2 tsuyuko 11.ogg}} '''Tsuyuko:''' Your Excellency... even if you had no duties at all right now, there's still no way we'd let you go down there.
:{{A|vo eqyx001 2 tsuyuko 12.ogg}} '''Tsuyuko:''' Enkanomiya is exceedingly dangerous right now. Only pre-eminent warriors like {{Traveler}} and Paimon should venture there.
:{{A|vo eqyx001 2 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yup, absolutely, a hundred percent. This is a job only we can handle!
:{{DIcon}} ...Tsuyuko, you really get Paimon.
:{{A|vo eqyx001 2 tsuyuko 13.ogg}} '''Tsuyuko:''' Hehe. We've worked together plenty of times in the past, after all.
:{{A|vo eqyx001 2 kokomi 05.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' Do you have any other information about Tsumi?
:{{A|vo eqyx001 2 tsuyuko 14.ogg}} '''Tsuyuko:''' It was mentioned that she wears a strange mask that covers the upper half of her face.
:{{DIcon}} A masked shrine maiden...
:{{DIcon}} Half of her face...
:{{A|vo eqyx001 2 kokomi 06.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' How interesting. What is she trying to hide? Mmm...
:{{A|vo eqyx001 2 tsuyuko 15.ogg}} '''Tsuyuko:''' Your Excellency, in my humblest of opinions, Tsumi has shown nothing but goodwill so far. Since the situation is so critical, we don't have the resources to make other defense arrangements and cast suspicion on our allies.
:{{A|vo eqyx001 2 kokomi 07.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' Mmm, I see what you mean.
:{{A|vo eqyx001 2 kokomi 08.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' I have instructed Swordfish I to proceed to Enkanomiya and continue evacuating the wounded. {{Traveler}}, you can go with them.
:{{A|vo eqyx001 2 kokomi 09.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' Swordfish I will escort you to the camp at the center of Enkanomiya.
:{{A|vo eqyx001 2 kokomi 10.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' Also — please take this with you.
;(Obtain [[Fragmented Accessory (Three Realms Gateway Offering: The Eve)|Fragmented Accessory]])
:{{A|vo eqyx001 2 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What's this? Looks like... a missing piece of something.
:{{A|vo eqyx001 2 kokomi 11.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' It's just a little trinket. When you are faced with a difficult choice, it might be able to help you.
:{{A|vo eqyx001 2 tsuyuko 16.ogg}} '''Tsuyuko:''' Your Excellency... but... isn't that...?
:{{A|vo eqyx001 2 kokomi 12.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' Watatsumi Island doesn't need it anymore. Besides, both of the other two pieces are in Enkanomiya. If we're lucky enough, this could be our chance to reunite them.
:{{A|vo eqyx001 2 tsuyuko 17.ogg}} '''Tsuyuko:''' Understood, Your Excellency. Okay... emergency measures to hold the Three Realms Gateway Offering now underway.
:{{A|vo eqyx001 2 kokomi 13.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' Mm. I apologize for the trouble. Now, {{Traveler}}, please excuse me, I need to tend to the wounded. Please see Ueno once you're ready.

;(Talk to Tsuyuko again)
:{{A|vo dialog eqyx001 tsuyuko 01.ogg}} '''Tsuyuko:''' Specter Eco-Management... I hear Liyue has a program to get rid of rats, cockroaches, flies, and barnacles.
:{{A|vo eqyx001 3 tsuyuko 01.ogg}} '''Tsuyuko:''' Specter Eco-Management must be the same kind of thing.
{{Dialogue End}}

{{Quest Description|update|Enkanomiya has been wrapped in darkness. To save Watatsumi Island, you must find some way to solve this problem...}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Talk to Ueno)
:{{A|vo eqyx001 3 ueno 01.ogg}} '''Ueno:''' Are you ready to venture into the dark shroud of Enkanomiya?
:{{DIcon}} Let's go.
::{{A|vo eqyx001 3 ueno 03.ogg}} '''Ueno:''' Alright. Follow me.
:{{DIcon}} Not yet.
::{{A|vo eqyx001 3 ueno 02.ogg}} '''Ueno:''' Please make sure you are fully prepared.

:'''You break through the darkness with Swordfish I and arrive at the [[Dainichi Mikoshi]].'''

:{{A|vo eqyx001 5 ueno 01.ogg}} '''Ueno:''' Here's hoping I have the chance...
:{{DIcon}} The chance to do what?
:{{A|vo eqyx001 5 ueno 02.ogg}} '''Ueno:''' Next year, I'm going to apply for Swordfish I to be redeployed into Specter management. 'Cause if it's that or spend more time in Enkanomiya, I'll take my chance with the Specters.
:{{A|vo eqyx001 5 ueno 03.ogg}} '''Ueno:''' Those armor monsters... closing in on you, "ker-chunk, ker-chunk"... It's the stuff nightmares are made of.
:{{A|vo eqyx001 5 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Totally understand.
:{{A|vo eqyx001 5 ueno 04.ogg}} '''Ueno:''' Anyway. We should be safe for now. There shouldn't be any more danger from here on out.
:{{A|vo eqyx001 5 yabe 01.ogg}} '''Yabe:''' Hey! Whassup!
:{{A|vo eqyx001 5 ueno 05.ogg}} '''Ueno:''' It's Yabe... The odd guy from Stingray III.
:{{A|vo eqyx001 5 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You seem kinda chipper compared to all the other soldiers.
:{{A|vo eqyx001 5 yabe 02.ogg}} '''Yabe:''' Do I? Hehehe. I've pretty much always loved horror stories and ghost stories and stuff. Ever since I was a kid. This trip to Enkanomiya is something else, though — totally mind-blowing.
:{{A|vo eqyx001 5 yabe 03.ogg}} '''Yabe:''' Super fun, 10/10 would come again.
:{{A|vo eqyx001 5 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Totally do not understand...
:{{A|vo eqyx001 5 yabe 04.ogg}} '''Yabe:''' Well, I mean, it's pretty sweet to have the chance to come to Enkanomiya. I actually kinda wanted to look into the Bunkoku Puzzle while I'm here. It's the first of the four great puzzles of Enkanomiya.
:{{A|vo eqyx001 5 ueno 06.ogg}} '''Ueno:''' Yeah, please don't do that. We're the ones that'll have to come rescue you.
:{{A|vo eqyx001 5 yabe 05.ogg}} '''Yabe:''' Alright, well never mind that. There's a makeshift camp at the top of those steps over there. Yeah, you should head up and catch some rest if you haven't been there yet.

;(Talk to Yabe again)
:{{A|vo dialog eqyx001 yabe 01.ogg}} '''Yabe:''' Have you been to the camp yet? Tsumi's the one that set it up. It's over there at the {{Color|buzz|top of the steps.}}
:{{A|vo dialog eqyx001 yabe 02.ogg}} '''Yabe:''' Gotta get yourselves familiar with the base of operations before you go venturing into the darkness.

;(Approach the camp)
:{{A|vo eqyx001 6 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hey look, a shrine maiden taking care of the wounded. That must be Tsumi, right?
:{{A|vo eqyx001 6 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Let's go ask her about what's been going on.

;(Approach Tsumi)
:{{A|vo eqyx001 7 tsumi 01.ogg}} '''Tsumi:''' You are... different from all the others. Are you human?
:{{A|vo eqyx001 7 paimon 01a.ogg}} {{A|vo eqyx001 7 paimon 01b.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Well {{Traveler}} is, obviously! Just not a native of Watatsumi Island, that's all.
:{{A|vo eqyx001 7 tsumi 02.ogg}} '''Tsumi:''' And you? A human hatchling?
:{{DIcon}} I doubt it.
:{{A|vo eqyx001 7 tsumi 03.ogg}} '''Tsumi:''' Oh, really? Because I thought that humans lose the ability to fly when they reach adulthood, just like [[Bathysmal Vishaps]] lose the ability to see in color when they reach maturity.
:{{A|vo eqyx001 7 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Tsumi, you seem to know a lot about [[vishaps]].
:{{A|vo eqyx001 7 tsumi 04.ogg}} '''Tsumi:''' Wait, how do you know my name?
:{{A|vo eqyx001 7 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, the wounded soldiers mentioned you.
:{{A|vo eqyx001 7 tsumi 05.ogg}} '''Tsumi:''' Oh.
:{{DIcon}} We came to investigate the darkness.
:{{A|vo eqyx001 7 ueno 01.ogg}} '''Ueno:''' Greetings, my name is Ueno, acting captain of Swordfish I. We're here to evacuate the wounded and support the Traveler's investigation.
:{{A|vo eqyx001 7 ueno 02.ogg}} '''Ueno:''' Swordfish I needs to rest and reorganize before commencing the evacuation. I'll see you later.
;(Ueno leaves)
:{{A|vo eqyx001 7 tsumi 06.ogg}} '''Tsumi:''' So you're here to help resolve this, hmm?
:{{A|vo eqyx001 7 tsumi 07.ogg}} '''Tsumi:''' Very well. It's taking all the energy I have to keep this light shining. I don't have the strength to try and combat the spreading darkness, too.
:{{A|vo eqyx001 7 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Do you understand what's going on?
:{{A|vo eqyx001 7 tsumi 08.ogg}} '''Tsumi:''' The [[Void Realm]] is invading. The people of Byakuyakoku believe that there are three realms: the [[Vishap Realm]], the [[Human Realm]], and the Void Realm.
:{{A|vo eqyx001 7 tsumi 09.ogg}} '''Tsumi:''' The darkness spreading in Enkanomiya comes from the Void Abyss. Neither vishaps nor humans can endure it.
:{{A|vo eqyx001 7 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' But don't Bathysmal Vishaps like the dark?
:{{A|vo eqyx001 7 tsumi 10.ogg}} '''Tsumi:''' No. They hate the light, but only because down here in the depths, the presence of light signifies human activity.
:{{A|vo eqyx001 7 tsumi 11.ogg}} '''Tsumi:''' In fact, the Vishap Realm is the realm of pure, primordial elemental beings. It's actually referred to as the [[Light Realm]] in most books.
:{{A|vo eqyx001 7 tsumi 12.ogg}} '''Tsumi:''' The [[Seven Sovereigns]] of the Light Realm are the seven foremost elemental dragons at the pinnacle of the raw and primitive elemental forces.
:{{A|vo eqyx001 7 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So that's why Tsuyuko called this the "Three Realms Gateway Offering."
:{{A|vo eqyx001 7 tsumi 13.ogg}} '''Tsumi:''' "Three Realms Gateway Offering"... Not far off the mark, actually. But technically, I think it should be called the "Triangle Gateway Offering."
:{{A|vo eqyx001 7 tsumi 14.ogg}} '''Tsumi:''' Because the source of the darkness from the void is the three towers at the corners of Enkanomiya's triangular borders.
:{{A|vo eqyx001 7 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, the three towers! The ones where we did those trials.
:{{A|vo eqyx001 7 tsumi 15.ogg}} '''Tsumi:''' You've been there before?
:{{A|vo eqyx001 7 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' It's a long story.
:{{A|vo eqyx001 7 tsumi 16.ogg}} '''Tsumi:''' Oh.
:{{A|vo eqyx001 7 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' By the way, Tsumi, what's up with the weird mask?
:{{A|vo eqyx001 7 tsumi 17.ogg}} '''Tsumi:''' To hide my face. It has to do with some things that happened as I was growing up. I just don't want to scare anyone, that's all.
:{{A|vo eqyx001 7 tsumi 18.ogg}} '''Tsumi:''' Does that make me untrustworthy in your eyes?
:{{A|vo eqyx001 7 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' No, not at all. You've been helping the wounded all this time, everyone must be super grateful to you. It's just that...
;(Player receives the dialogue option below only if they have completed [[Yougou Cleansing]])
:{{DIcon}} I don't want to see another [[Hanachirusato|masked shrine maiden]] disappear...
::{{A|vo eqyx001 7 tsumi 19a.ogg}} '''Tsumi:''' Can't say I really understand what you're talking about.
:{{DIcon}} I don't want to be betrayed again.
::{{A|vo eqyx001 7 tsumi 19b.ogg}} '''Tsumi:''' Me neither. I hate betrayal too.
:{{A|vo eqyx001 7 tsumi 20.ogg}} '''Tsumi:''' Anyway, if you want to rid this darkness from Enkanomiya, you can come to me for guidance. Of course... if you can trust me.
:{{A|vo eqyx001 7 tsumi 21.ogg}} '''Tsumi:''' I'm going inside to tend to the wounded and check in with the new arrivals. Please excuse me.

:'''After she finishes speaking, Tsumi heads to an inner room...'''

:{{A|vo eqyx001 7 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What're we gonna do, {{Traveler}}? Paimon really wants to trust Tsumi, but...
:{{A|vo eqyx001 7 paimon 12.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' How about we go ask the wounded?

:{{A|vo eqyx001 10 imaizumi 01.ogg}} '''Imaizumi:''' Greetings.
:{{A|vo eqyx001 10 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hello. We'd like to ask you about the masked shrine maiden, Tsumi.

:{{A|vo eqyx001 10 imaizumi 03.ogg}} '''Imaizumi:''' Well, you've come to the right person.

:{{A|vo eqyx001 10 imaizumi 04.ogg}} '''Imaizumi:''' I was one of the first people that she rescued. Straight away, I thought there was something very weird going on... Who is this shrine maiden who knows the lost ceremonies of Enkanomiya, and why is she covering her face with a mask?
:{{A|vo eqyx001 10 imaizumi 05.ogg}} '''Imaizumi:''' So I started pestering her about it. I wasn't going to let up until I got an answer.
:{{A|vo eqyx001 10 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' And?
:{{A|vo eqyx001 10 imaizumi 06.ogg}} '''Imaizumi:''' There weren't so many people around at that time, so eventually, she let me look behind the mask. It was actually pretty normal for the most part. There's just one thing she's trying to hide.
:{{A|vo eqyx001 10 imaizumi 07.ogg}} '''Imaizumi:''' Her eyes have snake-like pupils. Thin vertical lines.
:{{A|vo eqyx001 10 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Whoa! Weren't you scared?
:{{A|vo eqyx001 10 imaizumi 08.ogg}} '''Imaizumi:''' I probably would have been, if every Watatsumi Islander wasn't so familiar with our legends... or I should say, our history.
:{{A|vo eqyx001 10 imaizumi 09.ogg}} '''Imaizumi:''' The first familiars of the Watatsumi Omikami were the Vassals of Watatsumi. Legend has it that they are a half-human, half-snake kind who helped our ancestors fight back the Bathysmal Vishaps.
:{{A|vo eqyx001 10 imaizumi 10.ogg}} '''Imaizumi:''' They were said to have disappeared long ago. But then Tsumi showed up, and as soon as I saw her snake eyes, I instinctively trusted her. It's like the vassals have returned to help us in our moment of need.
:{{A|vo eqyx001 10 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh...
:{{A|vo eqyx001 10 imaizumi 11.ogg}} '''Imaizumi:''' I'm no expert, by any means. But I think Tsumi can be trusted.

;(Talk to Imaizumi again)
:{{A|vo dialog eqyx001 imaizumi 01.ogg}} '''Imaizumi:''' As long as Tsumi stays around, we shouldn't have any problems.

;(Talk to Enomoto)
:{{A|vo eqyx001 9 enomoto 01.ogg}} '''Enomoto:''' Hello, what can I help you with?
:{{A|vo eqyx001 9 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hi there. We wanted to ask you what you know about the masked shrine maiden, Tsumi.
:{{A|vo eqyx001 9 enomoto 02.ogg}} '''Enomoto:''' I see, I see. What're you looking to know, exactly? I've tried asking if she's seeing anyone, y'know, or whether she's looking right now... but she seems pretty tight-lipped about her love life.
:{{A|vo eqyx001 9 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' That's... not what we meant at all. We were more wondering... do you think there's anything suspicious about her?
:{{A|vo eqyx001 9 enomoto 03.ogg}} '''Enomoto:''' "Suspicious," huh... suspicion, the unknowable, the unpredictable... unexplored territory... Mysterious? Enigmatic? Enchanting. Bewitching. Compelling, addicting. Yeah. Know what I'm saying?
:{{DIcon}} Be serious.
:{{A|vo eqyx001 9 enomoto 04.ogg}} '''Enomoto:''' I am being serious!
:{{A|vo eqyx001 9 enomoto 05.ogg}} '''Enomoto:''' Okay, look — if I had to pick one thing about her that's suspicious, I'd say... okay, two things. Number one, her mask. It's pretty scary, I don't know why she chose it.
:{{A|vo eqyx001 9 enomoto 06.ogg}} '''Enomoto:''' Number two, some kind of pendant fell out of her sleeve when she was bandaging me up. It looked like it was a broken-off piece of something. So maybe when you put them together, it makes a whole.
:{{A|vo eqyx001 9 enomoto 07.ogg}} '''Enomoto:''' Huh, maybe the other half is held by Tsumi's lifelong sweetheart...
:{{A|vo eqyx001 9 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Sounds like you hit the nail on the head. So you know, maybe ease off a little, bro?

;(Talk to Enomoto again)
:{{A|vo dialog eqyx001 enomoto 01.ogg}} '''Enomoto:''' I can feel a beard coming on. Oh! Do you guys think shaving it with a weapon would work?

;(Talk to the sleeping soldiers)
:{{A|vo eqyx001 8 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' It looks like they're resting. Let's not disturb them.

;(After talking to the soldiers)
:{{A|vo eqyx001 14 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Paimon thinks we've got enough answers now. Let's find somewhere to recap what we know so far.
:{{A|vo eqyx001 14 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Tsumi's just inside the room. It'd be a bit awkward if she hears us talking about her behind her back.

;(Approach the marker outside the camp)
:{{A|vo eqyx001 14 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So here's what we learned from the soldiers.
:{{A|vo eqyx001 14 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Tsumi's mask hides her snake-eyes, which the people of Watatsumi Island believe to be a distinguishing feature of [[Orobaxi]]'s vassals.
:{{A|vo eqyx001 14 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Based on her actions, it seems like all she wants to do is protect the people of Watatsumi Island. And from what she said, she's doing everything she can to combat the darkness spreading in Enkanomiya.
:{{A|vo eqyx001 14 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So she seems pretty trustworthy.
:{{DIcon}} I agree.
::{{A|vo eqyx001 14 paimon 07a.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Then let's go talk to her about working together.
:{{DIcon}} I still have some reservations...
::{{A|vo eqyx001 14 paimon 07b.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Paimon gets it. Like, why is she covering her pupils when they're obviously an easy way to win everyone over?
::{{A|vo eqyx001 14 paimon 07b 1.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Guess we'll just have to see what she has to say for now. But let's keep our guard up, just in case.

:{{A|vo eqyx001 15 tsumi 01.ogg}} '''Tsumi:''' So, how's it going? Have you made a decision?
:{{A|vo eqyx001 15 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yep. Let's team up to tackle the darkness.
:{{A|vo eqyx001 15 tsumi 02.ogg}} '''Tsumi:''' Okay. Then, take this.
:{{A|vo eqyx001 15 tsumi 03.ogg}} '''Tsumi:''' It's called the Bokuso Box. I found it in the Dainichi Mikoshi when I was looking for a solution.
:{{A|vo eqyx001 15 tsumi 04.ogg}} '''Tsumi:''' Actually, the Dainichi Mikoshi was where I found the method and tools for the Sentou Ceremony. Lucky I can read human writing.

;(After defeating the monsters)

To have mastered the craft at her age lends credence to the old aphorism that heroes are made young. {{Dialogue End}} ==Trivia== *Towards the end of the ''Flavors of the World'' cutscene, [[Madame Ping]], [[Ganyu]], [[Ningguang]], and [[Keqing]] together recite the following {{w|Antithetical couplet|couplet}}; each line makes reference to another famous Chinese work: **{{Lang|mini=1|zh={{Rubi|风|fēng|雨|yǔ|犹|yóu|祝|zhù}}，{{Rubi|山|shān|海|hǎi|同|tóng|欢|huān}}，{{Rubi|是|shì|承|chéng|天|tiān|地|dì|之|zhī|佑|yòu}}。|zh_tl=Nature provides, the mountains rejoice, we are blessed by heaven's good grace.}} ***This line is narrated by Madame Ping, that after thousands of years, Liyue is still peaceful and prosperous, this should be credited to the joint work of the heroic Liyue people. ***"{{Rubi|承|chéng|天|tiān|之|zhī|佑|yòu}}" is an idiom that means "be blessed by heaven's good grace." It is derived from the fourteenth hexagram ({{wt|䷍}}) in the {{Lang|''{{w|I Ching}}''|zh=周易}}, {{Lang|mini=1|zh={{Rubi|大|dà|有|yǒu}}|zh_tl=Great Possessing}}: {{Lang|mini=1|zh={{Rubi|上|shàng|九|jiǔ}}：{{Rubi|自|zì|天|tiān|佑|yòu|之|zhī}}，{{Rubi|吉|jí|无|wú|不|bú|利|lì}}。|zh_tl=Nine at the top means: / He is blessed by heaven. / Good fortune. / Nothing that does not further.}}Chinese Wikisource: [https://zh.wikisource.org/zh/%E5%91%A8%E6%98%93/%E5%A4%A7%E6%9C%89 {{Zh|周易/大有}}]I Ching: [http://www2.unipr.it/~deyoung/I_Ching_Wilhelm_Translation.html#14 Ta Yu / Possession in Great Measure] **{{Lang|mini=1|zh={{Rubi|星|xīng|移|yí|斗|dǒu|转|zhuǎn}}，{{Rubi|沧|cāng|海|hǎi|桑|sāng|田|tián}}，{{Rubi|烟|yān|火|huǒ|人|rén|间|jiān|依|yī|旧|jiù}}。|zh_tl=Years have gone by, the world has transformed, but our way of life survives.}} ***This line is narrated by Ganyu, a half-adeptus who lived through the fall of the Guili Assembly, helped build Liyue Harbor, and has served as the Qixing secretary ever since. She is most keenly aware of Liyue's steadfastness in the face of changing times. ***{{Lang|mini=1|zh={{Rubi|沧|cāng|海|hǎi|桑|sāng|田|tián}}|zh_tl=The blue sea turned into mulberry fields}} is an oft-used idiom derived from {{Lang|''{{w|Shenxian Zhuan}}''|zh=神仙传|zh_tl=Biographies of the Deities and Immortals}}. It is a metaphor for the constant (and significant) change in life or in the world. It can be translated as the "vicissitudes of life" or "ups and downs of time."Wikipedia: {{w|Mulberry fields (idiom)}} **{{Lang|mini=1|zh={{Rubi|功|gōng|名|míng|在|zài|我|wǒ}}，{{Rubi|百|bǎi|岁|suì|千|qiān|秋|qiū}}，{{Rubi|毋|wú|忘|wàng|秉|bǐng|烛|zhú|夜|yè|游|yóu}}。|zh_tl=Fame and fortune is only a season, it is the moment that we should embrace.}} ***This line is narrated by Ningguang; while she amassed an enormous fortune through her own wits and skills and became the Tianquan of the Qixing, she is also keenly aware that her both her title and her wealth are impermanent. It is instead her actions in the present moment that hold lasting meaning. ***{{Lang|mini=1|zh=秉烛夜游|zh_lit=Hold a candle and wander at night}} is derived from {{w|Li Bai}}'s famous poem, {{Lang|''Preface for a Spring Evening Banquet with Cousins in a Peach Plum Garden''|zh=春夜宴从弟桃花园序}}, which gives a rationale for ''carpe diem'' and living in the moment: {{Lang|mini=1|zh={{Rubi|而|ér|浮|fú|生|shēng|若|ruò|梦|mèng}}，{{Rubi|为|wèi|欢|huān|几|jǐ|何|hé}}？{{Rubi|古|gǔ|人|rén|秉|bǐng|烛|zhú|夜|yè|游|yóu}}，{{Rubi|良|liáng|有|yǒu|以|yǐ|也|yě}}。|zh_tl=In addition, the floating life is but a dream, so how much joy can we have at all? The ancients had good reason to hold candles and entertain themselves at night.}}Google Books: [https://www.google.com/books/edition/A_Concise_History_of_Chinese_Literature/FOJ5DwAAQBAJ?hl=en&gbpv=1&dq=Preface%20for%20a%20Spring%20Evening%20Banquet%20with%20Cousins%20in%20a%20Peach%20Plum%20Garden&pg=PA307&printsec=frontcover&bsq=Preface%20for%20a%20Spring%20Evening%20Banquet%20with%20Cousins%20in%20a%20Peach%20Plum%20Garden A Concise History of Chinese Literature] This idiom itself was derived from the fifteenth of the {{Lang|''{{w|Nineteen Old Poems}}''|zh=古诗十九首}}: {{Lang|mini=1|zh={{Rubi|昼|zhòu|短|duǎn|苦|kǔ|夜|yè|长|cháng}}，{{Rubi|何|hé|不|bù|秉|bǐng|烛|zhú|游|yóu}}|zh_tl=When days are short and the dull nights long, Why not take a lamp and wander forth?}}Wikisource: [https://en.wikisource.org/wiki/A_Hundred_and_Seventy_Chinese_Poems/Seventeen_Old_Poems A Hundred and Seventy Chinese Poems] (the poem in question is listed as No. 14 instead of No. 15.) **{{Lang|mini=1|zh={{Rubi|今|jīn|古|gǔ|诸|zhū|事|shì}}，{{Rubi|激|jī|荡|dàng|中|zhōng|流|liú}}，{{Rubi|宏|hóng|图|tú|待|dài|看|kàn|新|xīn|秀|xiù}}。|zh_tl=Past meets present, heritage becomes legacy, long into the future may we thrive.}} ***This line is narrated by Keqing, who is considered the most forward-thinking and innovative of the Qixing. [[Zhongli]] admits that it is because of people like her, who take the initiative to do what they think is right, that he was willing to step down from his role as Archon.{{Ref/VO|Zhongli|About Keqing}} ***{{Lang|mini=1|zh={{Rubi|激|jī|荡|dàng|中|zhōng|流|liú}}|zh_lit=surging midstream}} is from {{w|Mao Zedong}}'s famous poem {{Lang|''Changsha''|zh=沁园春·长沙}}, extracted from {{Lang|mini=1|zh={{Rubi|曾|céng|记|jì|否|fǒu}}，{{Rubi|到|dào|中|zhōng|流|liú|击|jī|水|shuǐ}}，{{Rubi|浪|làng|遏|è|飞|fēi|舟|zhōu}}。|zh_tl=Remember still / How, venturing midstream, we struck the waters, / And waves stayed the speeding boats?}}Blogger: [https://poetmao.blogspot.com/2009/11/english-translation.html Qinyuan Chun: Changsha] The poem refers to the mood of youths going on an adventure and doing great deeds, changing the world through their actions and words. * Marchosius' quote recited by Madame Ping to Guoba is also a couplet in the Chinese version:
{{Lang|mini=1|zh={{Rubi|说|shuō|小|xiǎo}}，{{Rubi|可|kě|取|qǔ|一|yì|捧|pěng|粟|sù|米|mǐ|尝|cháng}}，{{Rubi|汲|jí|石|shí|上|shàng|甘|gān|泉|quán|水|shuǐ}}；{{Rubi|说|shuō|大|dà}}，{{Rubi|可|kě|取|qǔ|一|yì|壶|hú|星|xīng|月|yuè|饮|yǐn}}，{{Rubi|行|xíng|千|qiān|年|nián|人|rén|间|jiān|路|lù}}。|zh_tl=A humble meal of maize and spring water is also profound in that, by ensuring one's survival, it paves the way for millennia of human history and culture to come.}} ==Cinematic== Story Teaser- Flavors of the World - Genshin Impact ==Soundtracks== {{Soundtracks by Category Table|type=quest}} ==Other Languages== {{Other Languages |en = Three to Get Ready, and Here We Go |zhs = 六情通七仙贺八方飘香九霄得闻十分完满 |zhs_rm = Liù qíng tōng qī xiān hè bāfāng piāoxiāng jiǔxiāo dé wén shífēn wánmǎn |zht = 六情通七仙賀八方飄香九霄得聞十分完滿 |zht_rm = Liù qíng tōng qī xiān hè bāfāng piāoxiāng jiǔxiāo dé wén shífēn wánmǎn |zh_tl = Six Moods Are Heard by Seven Adepti, Tasty Aura Flood the Eight Corners to Let the Nine Sky Know, Ten out of Ten Perfection |ja = 六情・七仙・八方飄香・九霄到達・十分無欠 |ja_rm = Rokujou - Shichisen - Happou Hyoukou - Juubun Muketsu{{Assumed}} |ja_tl = Six Moods Are Heard by Seven Adepti, Tasty Aura Flood the Eight Corners to Let the Nine Sky Know, Ten out of Ten Perfection |ko = 사방팔방 음식 향기, 구천까지 만족 |ko_tl = Everywhere Food Smell, Inner Palace also Satisfied |es = Preparados, listos... ¡vamos! |es_tl = Ready, Set... :{{A|vo wylq102 1 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hey there, we'd like to ask you a quick question.
:{{A|vo wylq102 1 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Do you know if anyone around here has been looking for him? For Kaedehara Kazuha, we mean!
:{{A|vo wylq102 1 ryuji 01.ogg}} '''Ryuuji:''' Aha, so this is the renowned Mr. Kaedehara! I've heard a lot about you. It is an honor to finally meet you today.
:{{A|vo wylq102 1 kazuha 01.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' You are too kind. We are currently investigating an assault, and would appreciate any help you can offer.
:{{A|vo wylq102 1 ryuji 02.ogg}} '''Ryuuji:''' Oh? You were targeted in an assault? Let me think... I can't seem to recall anything of immediate interest.
:{{A|vo wylq102 1 ryuji 03.ogg}} '''Ryuuji:''' Mr. Kaedehara is currently the talk of the town, so there are always a lot of people looking for him.
:{{A|vo wylq102 1 ryuji 04.ogg}} '''Ryuuji:''' To be honest with you, our [[Bantan Sango Detective Agency|Detective Agency]] has recently been receiving many inquiries from people wishing to obtain Mr. Kaedehara's personal information.
:{{A|vo wylq102 1 ryuji 05.ogg}} '''Ryuuji:''' Some of them were offering us millions of Mora just to gather the information they want. If these were more legitimate commissions, Sango would have snapped them up in an instant.
:{{A|vo wylq102 1 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' M—Millions of Mora!? Whoa... wait, even at that price, you probably still shouldn't...
:{{A|vo wylq102 1 kazuha 02.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' Please accept my thanks for looking out for my privacy.
:{{A|vo wylq102 1 ryuji 06.ogg}} '''Ryuuji:''' Of course. No matter what, we only take on legitimate cases. We don't make our money by revealing details of other people's day-to-day life just for the sake of it.
:{{A|vo wylq102 1 ryuji 07.ogg}} '''Ryuuji:''' Sorry, I got a little off topic. What I'm really trying to say is, it doesn't surprise me that a complete stranger is looking for Mr. Kaedehara.
:{{A|vo wylq102 1 ryuji 08.ogg}} '''Ryuuji:''' But I wouldn't know where to begin if we want to connect this with an assault...
:{{A|vo wylq102 1 kazuha 03.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' Then let's put that connection aside for now. Have there been any other attacks or similar incidents recently that stand out as particularly unusual?
:{{A|vo wylq102 1 kazuha 04.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' The [[Tenryou Commission]] had very few leads. I thought you might have some information from different sources.
:{{A|vo wylq102 1 ryuji 09.ogg}} '''Ryuuji:''' It's true that the Commissioners aren't clued up about every little thing that goes on out in the streets. But typically, it's only the most trivial events that manage to escape their attention...
:{{A|vo wylq102 1 ryuji 10.ogg}} '''Ryuuji:''' If anyone had been out there attacking people, that would be assault, in which case the Tenryou Commission would absolutely get involved.
:{{A|vo wylq102 1 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Th—That does make sense...
:{{A|vo wylq102 1 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Uh-oh, looks like the trail's already run cold.
:{{A|vo wylq102 1 kazuha 05.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' I still find it difficult to believe that whoever attacked you hasn't been causing any trouble elsewhere...
:{{A|vo wylq102 1 kazuha 06.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' Few people possess your prowess in battle. So unless you were the first person he targeted, someone is certain to have been hurt by now.
:{{DIcon}} Is this your way of giving praise?
:{{DIcon}} It was also not easy for me to fight him off.
:{{A|vo wylq102 1 kazuha 07.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' I am well aware of your talents, there is no need to be humble around me. In fact, I'm quite relieved that you were the one he targeted.
:{{A|vo wylq102 1 kazuha 08.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' It would cause me great grief to see someone become critically injured or lose their life because of me.
:{{A|vo wylq102 1 kazuha 09.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' For the poor victim, this would be a completely senseless crime.
:{{A|vo wylq102 1 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Don't worry, we'll find him!
:{{A|vo wylq102 1 ryuji 11.ogg}} '''Ryuuji:''' It seems you are every bit the selfless hero they make you out to be, Mr. Kaedehara. Surely, this same concern for your fellow man is what drove you to fearlessly raise your blade against the [[The Shogun|Almighty Shogun]].
:{{A|vo wylq102 1 kazuha 10.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' You flatter me. Truth be told, I don't know quite what came over me in that moment...
:{{A|vo wylq102 1 ryuji 12.ogg}} '''Ryuuji:''' Haha, you are much too humble. Don't worry, I completely understand your concerns. I will try my best to gather whatever leads I can for you.
:{{A|vo wylq102 1 ryuji 13.ogg}} '''Ryuuji:''' Oh, actually, there was one strange incident over the last few days. It doesn't involve an attack, though.
:{{A|vo wylq102 1 ryuji 14.ogg}} '''Ryuuji:''' Let me tell you about it just in case.
:{{A|vo wylq102 1 kazuha 11.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' Sure. During times like this, the more information we have, the better.
:{{A|vo wylq102 1 ryuji 15.ogg}} '''Ryuuji:''' Alright then. Recently, two people went missing from the city at around the same time.
:{{A|vo wylq102 1 ryuji 16.ogg}} '''Ryuuji:''' One of them is a pretty well-known collector, surname Nagato. The other, [[Amenoma Yuuya]], is a samurai from the [[Amenoma Clan]].
:{{A|vo wylq102 1 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Amenoma... now there's a familiar name.
:{{A|vo wylq102 1 ryuji 17.ogg}} '''Ryuuji:''' Right. Yuuya is the nephew of [[Amenoma Tougo]], the owner of [[Amenoma Smithy]].
:{{A|vo wylq102 1 ryuji 18.ogg}} '''Ryuuji:''' Two grown men going missing at the same time... their cases are likely connected, but I don't know much in the way of details.
:{{A|vo wylq102 1 ryuji 19.ogg}} '''Ryuuji:''' I recalled this because Amenoma Yuuya is also an accomplished martial artist who is skilled with the blade. Perhaps he is the one you are looking for.
:{{A|vo wylq102 1 kazuha 12.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' Understood, though it seems highly unlikely to me... I neither know this man, nor do I have any idea why he may wish to attack me.
:{{DIcon}} Let's consider this a favor for Ryuuji.
:{{DIcon}} We'll investigate both incidents at the same time.
:{{A|vo wylq102 1 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Sure, can't hurt! We never know what we might find out along the way.
:{{A|vo wylq102 1 kazuha 13.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' Thank you, Ryuuji. We'll start by making some inquiries at the Amenoma Smithy.
:{{A|vo wylq102 1 ryuji 20.ogg}} '''Ryuuji:''' Sounds good. All the best with your investigation. I'll get moving shortly myself.
{{Dialogue End}}
{{Quest Description|update|To prevent the attacker from causing more harm, you and Kazuha decide to investigate his identity. With few leads to follow, you start from the missing person case that Ryuuji metioned.}}

;(Talk to Amenoma Tougo)
:{{A|vo wylq102 2 amenomatoogo 01.ogg}} '''Amenoma Tougo:''' Ah, if it isn't Kaedehara Kazuha! What brings you here today?
:{{A|vo wylq102 2 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh? You two know each other?
:{{A|vo wylq102 2 kazuha 01.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' Yes. The Kaedehara and Amenoma Clans were both members of the [[Raiden Gokaden]]. Historically, there have always been deep links between the two clans.
:{{A|vo wylq102 2 kazuha 02.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' After I returned to Inazuma, I visited Mr. Amenoma to pay my respects.
;(If the player did not take part in [[Hues of the Violet Garden]])
::{{DIcon}} "Raiden Gokaden"?
::{{A|vo wylq102 2 kazuha 03.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' Ah, let me quickly explain. The Raiden Gokaden was the collective term for the five most acclaimed bladesmithing arts in Inazuma.
::{{A|vo wylq102 2 kazuha 04.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' The techniques of blade-making were personally bequeathed to the Raiden Gokaden by the Almighty Shogun, and over time, further honed and enhanced by the most talented craftsmen.
::{{A|vo wylq102 2 kazuha 05.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' Unfortunately, a series of events led to the gradual decline of many clans in the bladesmithing trade. Today, only the Amenoma Clan has kept its art alive.
::{{A|vo wylq102 2 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So sad...
::{{A|vo wylq102 2 amenomatoogo 02.ogg}} '''Amenoma Tougo:''' *sigh* It is a great pity indeed. In the old days, we each had our specialties, and just as iron sharpens iron, so too did we learn much from each other.
;(If the player took part in [[Hues of the Violet Garden]])
::{{DIcon}} Ah. I see.
::{{A|vo wylq102 2 kazuha 06.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' Yes. You may recall the story of the Raiden Gokaden from the [[Irodori Festival]].
::{{A|vo wylq102 2 amenomatoogo 03.ogg}} '''Amenoma Tougo:''' Though all bladesmiths trace their craft back to the same source, over time, each of us has arrived at a different blade-making philosophy, spawning the development of different branches of the same art.
:{{A|vo wylq102 2 amenomatoogo 04.ogg}} '''Amenoma Tougo:''' As an example, the Amenoma Art strives to emulate the abiding patience and determination of water as it turns stone to sand.
:{{A|vo wylq102 2 amenomatoogo 05.ogg}} '''Amenoma Tougo:''' There is nothing mystical to our work. There is only practice, day in and day out, until both body and mind have memorized the craft, turning each motion of every technique into an intrinsic part of the bladesmith's life.
:{{A|vo wylq102 2 amenomatoogo 06.ogg}} '''Amenoma Tougo:''' As for the art of the [[Kaedehara Clan]]... I believe it's called the "[[Isshin Art]]."
:{{A|vo wylq102 2 kazuha 07.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' That's right. Isshin Art strives for complete harmony between blade and mind from the moment that forging begins.
:{{A|vo wylq102 2 kazuha 08.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' For only a blade thus forged can capture and convey its maker's thoughts and feelings, and eventually become an extension of its wielder's will.
:{{A|vo wylq102 2 amenomatoogo 07.ogg}} '''Amenoma Tougo:''' Indeed. Most samurai choose their blades, but an Isshin blade chooses its owner.
:{{A|vo wylq102 2 amenomatoogo 08.ogg}} '''Amenoma Tougo:''' You are, without a doubt, the most worthy wielder of an Isshin blade... It gladdens my heart to see that although the Kaedehara Clan has fallen on hard times, its ideals and virtues are alive and well.
:{{A|vo wylq102 2 kazuha 09.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' You overestimate me. My actions are guided by my own personal sentiments, not by any noble aspirations on behalf of my clan.
:{{A|vo wylq102 2 kazuha 10.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' But let's get back on topic. The purpose of our visit today is to gather some information on your missing nephew.
:{{A|vo wylq102 2 kazuha 11.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' We hope to assist with the investigation. It may turn out that this case is connected to another we are pursuing.
:{{A|vo wylq102 2 amenomatoogo 09.ogg}} '''Amenoma Tougo:''' Ah yes, my nephew... *sigh* I reported the case to the Tenryou Commission, but I haven't heard anything back so far.
:{{A|vo wylq102 2 amenomatoogo 10.ogg}} '''Amenoma Tougo:''' He didn't say a word before he left, which is very unlike him. I'm still completely at a loss on what to make of it.
:{{A|vo wylq102 2 amenomatoogo 11.ogg}} '''Amenoma Tougo:''' But I've done what I can so far. Worrying is futile, all I can do now is wait for the news from the Tenryou Commission.
:{{A|vo wylq102 2 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' We heard that there was a collector involved in the disappearance too. Know anything about that?
:{{A|vo wylq102 2 amenomatoogo 12.ogg}} '''Amenoma Tougo:''' Yes. On the morning that Yuuya went missing, he gave me a very cryptic look and said that he was going to give me a great gift.
:{{A|vo wylq102 2 amenomatoogo 13.ogg}} '''Amenoma Tougo:''' I believe he went to collect the item from Mr. Nagato after that. The next thing I heard was that a fire had broken out at the warehouse, and neither of them came back...
:{{DIcon}} A fire!?
:{{A|vo wylq102 2 amenomatoogo 14.ogg}} '''Amenoma Tougo:''' Yes. Strange, isn't it? I wonder what could have caused it? Unfortunately, there was very little evidence left behind, so nobody knows what really happened...
:{{A|vo wylq102 2 kazuha 12.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' Hmm... Do you have any thoughts on what Yuuya may have wanted to give you?
:{{A|vo wylq102 2 amenomatoogo 15.ogg}} '''Amenoma Tougo:''' If I had to guess... it must have been some kind of rare weapon. Otherwise, there would have been no reason for him to get my hopes up.
:{{A|vo wylq102 2 amenomatoogo 16.ogg}} '''Amenoma Tougo:''' He's never been particularly interested in blade-forging, but has always had a fondness for blade-testing, and can sense even the most minute differences in blade quality.
:{{A|vo wylq102 2 amenomatoogo 17.ogg}} '''Amenoma Tougo:''' He is extraordinarily talented in martial arts, particularly when it comes to the art of the sword.
:{{A|vo wylq102 2 kazuha 13.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' Truth be told, we have some information that you may find to be objectionable. The person we are looking for... he attacked this friend of mine.
:{{A|vo wylq102 2 kazuha 14.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' Based on the evidence we have gathered so far, only Yuuya seems to match the suspect's profile.
:{{A|vo wylq102 2 amenomatoogo 18.ogg}} '''Amenoma Tougo:''' What? No, absolutely impossible. Yuuya is not that kind of person.
:{{A|vo wylq102 2 amenomatoogo 19.ogg}} '''Amenoma Tougo:''' He is humble and kind. Even his training is done with the goal of calming his mind. He has never gotten into a fight before.
:{{A|vo wylq102 2 kazuha 15.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' Huh, is that so...
:{{A|vo wylq102 2 amenomatoogo 20.ogg}} '''Amenoma Tougo:''' Yes. If there's one thing I can say for certain, it's that Yuuya would never draw his blade without a very good reason.
:{{A|vo wylq102 2 amenomatoogo 21.ogg}} '''Amenoma Tougo:''' But with that said, it's equally out of character for him to just disappear with neither farewell nor fair warning.
:{{A|vo wylq102 2 amenomatoogo 22.ogg}} '''Amenoma Tougo:''' I also cannot know what course of action he might be capable of if coerced, or otherwise compelled by circumstances unbeknownst to me...
:{{A|vo wylq102 2 amenomatoogo 23.ogg}} '''Amenoma Tougo:''' Anyway, should you find him, please let me know as soon as possible.
:{{A|vo wylq102 2 kazuha 16.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' Don't worry. You have our word.
:{{A|vo wylq102 2 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hmm... from the sound of that, Paimon doesn't think Yuuya was the one who attacked us as well.
:{{DIcon}} We still need to get the info from the Nagato family.
:{{A|vo wylq102 2 kazuha 17.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' Yes. It sounds as if something happened when the two men met each other.
:{{A|vo wylq102 2 kazuha 18.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' Let's pay a visit to the Nagato household.

;(Talk to Amenoma Tougo again)
:{{A|vo dialog wylq102 amenomatoogo 01.ogg}} '''Amenoma Tougo:''' Growing up, Yuuya never caused anyone any trouble.
:{{A|vo dialog wylq102 amenomatoogo 02.ogg}} '''Amenoma Tougo:''' *sigh* What could have happened to him...
