;(Talk to Nagato Sachiko)
:{{A|vo wylq102 4 nagatosachiko 01.ogg}} '''Nagato Sachiko:''' I'm very sorry, but we cannot afford to pay what we owe right now...
:{{A|vo wylq102 4 nagatosachiko 02.ogg}} '''Nagato Sachiko:''' My husband has gone missing, and I'm still trying to find him.
:{{A|vo wylq102 4 kazuha 01.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' No, no, you misunderstand us. We are here to help with the investigation. We'd like to ask you some questions about Mr. Nagato's disappearance, if we may.
:{{A|vo wylq102 4 nagatosachiko 03.ogg}} '''Nagato Sachiko:''' Ah, I see... I thought the debt collectors had come to visit again.
:{{A|vo wylq102 4 nagatosachiko 04.ogg}} '''Nagato Sachiko:''' I'm sorry you have to see me in this dreadful state... Has some new information come out? Do you know where he's gone?
:{{A|vo wylq102 4 kazuha 02.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' I'm afraid we don't have any new information at the moment. We're still trying to find out as much as we can to inform our search.
:{{A|vo wylq102 4 kazuha 03.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' With this in mind, can we perhaps ask some questions about your family's current situation?
:{{A|vo wylq102 4 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' For example, Paimon's struggling to understand why a collector would be strapped for Mora...
:{{A|vo wylq102 4 nagatosachiko 05.ogg}} '''Nagato Sachiko:''' *sigh* That's a long story. Ever since I've known him, he's been an avid collector of all sorts of things...
:{{A|vo wylq102 4 nagatosachiko 06.ogg}} '''Nagato Sachiko:''' He'd always get so animated when he was showing them to me... I knew nothing about the items myself, but seeing how enthusiastic and excited they made him, I was happy to believe that they were just extremely important to him.
:{{A|vo wylq102 4 nagatosachiko 07.ogg}} '''Nagato Sachiko:''' Everything was fine when we first got married. But as time went by, things changed for the worse...
:{{A|vo wylq102 4 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Uh-oh, what happened?
:{{A|vo wylq102 4 nagatosachiko 08.ogg}} '''Nagato Sachiko:''' He lost his sense of restraint. He started buying more and more things, and even resorted to borrowing money just so he could pay for them.
:{{A|vo wylq102 4 nagatosachiko 09.ogg}} '''Nagato Sachiko:''' Our expenses really spiraled out of control when he started getting interested in weapons. It was awful. There were days when he'd spend hours down at the warehouse admiring his weapons even as debt collectors were descending upon our house.
:{{A|vo wylq102 4 nagatosachiko 10.ogg}} '''Nagato Sachiko:''' He wouldn't sell them, wouldn't even touch them. Just sat there staring at them, like he was in a trance.
:{{A|vo wylq102 4 nagatosachiko 11.ogg}} '''Nagato Sachiko:''' I'm happy he has a hobby and I'm willing to support him, but making ends meet has to come first. I've tried talking to him about it so many times, but he never listens...
:{{A|vo wylq102 4 nagatosachiko 12.ogg}} '''Nagato Sachiko:''' On the last day that I saw him, I gave him an ultimatum... I said, if he refused to sell his collectibles and pay off his debts, I would divorce him and take the children with me.
:{{A|vo wylq102 4 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Whoa...!
:{{A|vo wylq102 4 kazuha 04.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' And that led to an argument...
:{{A|vo wylq102 4 nagatosachiko 13.ogg}} '''Nagato Sachiko:''' Actually, it didn't. Generally, he's a quiet man who likes to go with the flow. On most things, he leaves the decision-making to me.
:{{A|vo wylq102 4 nagatosachiko 14.ogg}} '''Nagato Sachiko:''' You must understand, I never would have dreamed of threatening him with divorce if the debts hadn't pushed our family to the brink...
:{{A|vo wylq102 4 nagatosachiko 15.ogg}} '''Nagato Sachiko:''' After I said those words, he froze, and was silent for a long time. When he finally spoke, he awkwardly mumbled that he would pick out a few items to sell.
:{{A|vo wylq102 4 nagatosachiko 16.ogg}} '''Nagato Sachiko:''' His voice was so meek and pitiful that I felt an urge to take everything back. But then what? If I didn't draw the line, what would happen to our family?
:{{DIcon}} You did the right thing.
:{{DIcon}} It's important to set boundaries.
:{{A|vo wylq102 4 nagatosachiko 17.ogg}} '''Nagato Sachiko:''' Had I not indulged his bad habits, we would not have found ourselves in such a predicament.
:{{A|vo wylq102 4 nagatosachiko 18.ogg}} '''Nagato Sachiko:''' And I also don't know if he had actually come to his senses, or if he was simply angry with me...
:{{A|vo wylq102 4 nagatosachiko 19.ogg}} '''Nagato Sachiko:''' The next thing I heard was that our warehouse had caught fire, and both he and the buyer had gone missing.
:{{A|vo wylq102 4 kazuha 05.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' I see. I understand.
:{{A|vo wylq102 4 kazuha 06.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' Amenoma Yuuya came to purchase a weapon from Mr. Nagato. During the sale, a fire broke out at the warehouse, and both men disappeared.
:{{A|vo wylq102 4 nagatosachiko 20.ogg}} '''Nagato Sachiko:''' At first, I assumed they must have gotten into an argument over the price...
:{{A|vo wylq102 4 nagatosachiko 21.ogg}} '''Nagato Sachiko:''' But my husband has never been one to negotiate. He never even haggles when he's out buying groceries, so it's hard to imagine him getting into a fierce argument.
:{{A|vo wylq102 4 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hmm... maybe he was feeling the pressure from the debts?
:{{A|vo wylq102 4 nagatosachiko 22.ogg}} '''Nagato Sachiko:''' I don't know. He just disappeared after the warehouse burned down.
:{{A|vo wylq102 4 nagatosachiko 23.ogg}} '''Nagato Sachiko:''' Perhaps he's too afraid to come home now that all his collectibles have been lost in the fire, and he's got no way to pay off our debts.
:{{A|vo wylq102 4 nagatosachiko 24.ogg}} '''Nagato Sachiko:''' *sigh* Even though I'm still a little mad at him, we're a family, and I want us to face our family's crisis together.
:{{A|vo wylq102 4 nagatosachiko 25.ogg}} '''Nagato Sachiko:''' As long as he's willing to turn over a new leaf, I know we can work things out...
:{{A|vo wylq102 4 kazuha 07.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' Please don't get upset. There could be more to this situation than meets the eye.
:{{A|vo wylq102 4 kazuha 08.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' If collecting things is a habit that Mr. Nagato has had his whole life, it is quite unusual for this habit to change so drastically over a short period.
:{{A|vo wylq102 4 kazuha 09.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' But the information we gathered from the other side suggests Amenoma Yuuya is also a mild-mannered man who would not be likely to start an argument.
:{{A|vo wylq102 4 kazuha 10.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' Hmm... this situation is getting a little confusing.
:{{A|vo wylq102 4 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' "A little confusing"? More like completely mystifying.
:{{A|vo wylq102 4 kazuha 11.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' Let's try a change of scenery, and see if we can piece together what we've learned.
:{{A|vo wylq102 4 kazuha 12.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' Rest assured, we'll notify you if we find anything.
:{{A|vo wylq102 4 nagatosachiko 26.ogg}} '''Nagato Sachiko:''' Ah, thank you so much. I just want him to come home...
:;(Kazuha, the Traveler, and Paimon move to a nearby location)
:{{A|vo wylq102 6 kazuha 01.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' Based on the information we've gathered so far, I can only surmise that the sales meeting between the two men was somehow the catalyst for their disappearance.
:{{A|vo wylq102 6 kazuha 02.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' The fire at the warehouse likely played a part in how the situation unfolded, though its exact role is a mystery.
:{{A|vo wylq102 6 kazuha 03.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' ...Do you have any thoughts?
:{{A|vo wylq102 6 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Eh? Um, well... Paimon was thinking that maybe someone accidentally knocked over an oil lamp, and um...
:{{A|vo wylq102 6 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Nope, never mind, Paimon's brain needs to rest for a while. Over to you!
:{{DIcon}} They must have had an argument during the sale.
::{{A|vo wylq102 6 kazuha 04a.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' That is the most likely conclusion based on everything we know. What started as a disagreement over the price escalated and ultimately turned into a tragedy.
::{{A|vo wylq102 6 kazuha 04a 1.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' However, in this case, only one of the parties would have started the fire. That would make the other party innocent, and they would have no reason to hide themselves from the public.
::{{A|vo wylq102 6 kazuha 04a 2.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' If this is indeed what happened, and the innocent man hasn't come forward yet, then it suggests they may have already lost their life.
:{{DIcon}} Perhaps the fire was deliberately used to hide the truth.
::{{A|vo wylq102 6 kazuha 04b.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' An interesting explanation. I was also considering this possibility.
::{{A|vo wylq102 6 kazuha 04b 1.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' Amenoma Yuuya is an expert on swords. He could have noticed some problematic details about Mr. Nagato's collectibles.
::{{A|vo wylq102 6 kazuha 04b 2.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' Maybe he recognized a blade as a fake, or a well-known stolen item. Either way, after arguing about it, the two men agreed to hide the truth of this matter.
::{{A|vo wylq102 6 kazuha 04b 3.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' They thought a fire would destroy everything, but then the Tenryou Commission began investigating and uncovered some incriminating details, so they fled to protect their secrets...
::{{A|vo wylq102 6 kazuha 04b 4.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' But it's a far-fetched theory... I can't imagine how they would have been able to reach an agreement.
:{{DIcon}} We are still missing crucial information.
::{{A|vo wylq102 6 kazuha 04c.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' Right, I very much agree with you. It seems highly likely that we're missing a piece of the puzzle...
::{{A|vo wylq102 6 kazuha 04c 1.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' Working off what we know so far, there are too many things that don't add up.
::{{A|vo wylq102 6 kazuha 04c 2.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' The chances are that there are still some clues left for us to discover.
:{{A|vo wylq102 6 kazuha 05.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' One fact that I keep coming back to is that Amenoma Yuuya is polite and well-mannered, while Mr. Nagato is introverted and passive. Neither seems like the type of person who is inclined towards initiating conflict.
:{{A|vo wylq102 6 kazuha 06.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' Mr. Nagato, being heavily in debt, is also the only one of them with a potential motive to disappear after the fire.
:{{A|vo wylq102 6 kazuha 07.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' The more I ponder it, the more puzzling it becomes... just what could have happened there?
:{{DIcon}} This also doesn't seem connected to the case of the attacker.
:{{A|vo wylq102 6 kazuha 08.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' Right. Although the time frame seems to broadly match, no other details that we've learned seem to link the two events together.
:{{A|vo wylq102 6 kazuha 09.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' Amenoma Yuuya lacks a key distinguishing feature of the attacker — namely, that he is principally a practitioner of the blade-testing techniques of Amenoma Art, not those of the combat-oriented Isshin Art.
:{{A|vo wylq102 6 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Darn, we thought we could get two birds with one stone here, but at this rate it's starting to look like a wild goose chase...
:{{A|vo wylq102 6 kazuha 10.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' Hmm...
:{{A|vo wylq102 6 kazuha 11.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' Let's keep going, since we've come this far.
:{{A|vo wylq102 6 kazuha 12.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' If we can solve the case, both Mr. Amenoma and Mrs. Nagato will be able to get some closure.
:{{A|vo wylq102 6 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Okay, but where should we go now?
:{{A|vo wylq102 6 kazuha 13.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' Let's head out of the city and check out the warehouse. There's still a chance we may be able to find some shreds of evidence.

:{{A|vo dialog wylq102 nagatosachiko 01.ogg}} '''Nagato Sachiko:''' Thank you for your help. The longer this drags on, the worse things at home will get...

;(Approach the warehouse)
:{{A|vo wylq102 7 kazuha 01.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' Wait.
:{{A|vo wylq102 7 kazuha 02.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' I hear something ominous in the wind.
:{{A|vo wylq102 7 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ohh, this must be another one of those sounds that only you can hear.
:{{A|vo wylq102 7 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' As sketchy as that whole thing seems, you did put it to good use when we were chasing down that Vision thief at [[Autumn Winds, Scarlet Leaves|Beidou's tournament]], so...
:{{DIcon}} I knew we could count on you.
:{{A|vo wylq102 7 kazuha 03.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' Hmm, now I'm picking up a strong scent in addition to the sound. It's right around here somewhere...
:{{A|vo wylq102 7 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' But there's nothing here.
:{{A|vo wylq102 7 kazuha 04.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' It's gone now. But I can still sense the direction it left in.
:{{A|vo wylq102 7 kazuha 05.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' It felt very much like that ancient presence in Inazuma... the remnants of the [[Tatarigami]].
:{{DIcon}} Tatarigami...
:{{DIcon}} That's one thing I didn't expect to encounter here.
:{{A|vo wylq102 7 kazuha 06.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' Indeed. But this unexpected spring of inauspicious energy may prove to be of benefit to our investigation.
:{{A|vo wylq102 7 kazuha 07.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' We should remain vigilant, and approach slowly.
:;(Kazuha, the Traveler, and Paimon approach a trapdoor)
:{{A|vo wylq102 7 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh, so it's an underground warehouse...
:{{A|vo wylq102 7 kazuha 08.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' The force is definitely coming from down below.
:{{A|vo wylq102 7 kazuha 09.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' The source of the Tatarigami energy has long since left this place, but the residue it left behind still hasn't dissipated completely.
:{{A|vo wylq102 7 kazuha 10.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' Judging from the concentration... I would have to conclude that the Tatarigami source resided here for a very long time.
:{{A|vo wylq102 7 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Mrs. Nagato said her husband used to hang around the warehouse by himself a lot.
:{{A|vo wylq102 7 kazuha 11.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' It could well be that he was already under the influence of Tatarigami energy at that time.
:{{DIcon}} Surely someone would have noticed?
:{{A|vo wylq102 7 kazuha 12.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' From what I've been told... Tatarigami does not turn all upon whom it preys into violent monsters.
:{{A|vo wylq102 7 kazuha 13.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' But most will develop a stubborn streak upon being exposed to the Tatarigami's unfulfilled will. Their interests become fanatical obsessions.
:{{A|vo wylq102 7 kazuha 14.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' Mr. Nagato had an interest in collecting to begin with. The influence of Tatarigami could explain why he became an obsessive hoarder, amassing more and more possessions even as he put himself in grave debt.
:{{A|vo wylq102 7 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Um... so what should we do now? Go down and take a look?
:{{A|vo wylq102 7 kazuha 15.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' Step back. I'll open the door and take a look inside.
:{{DIcon}} That's dangerous.
:{{A|vo wylq102 7 kazuha 16.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' If we don't open this door, we can move no closer to the truth.
:{{A|vo wylq102 7 kazuha 17.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' You needn't worry. Both of us have faced far greater dangers than this. Relatively speaking, the risk here is trivial.
:;(Kazuha opens the door)
:{{A|vo wylq102 7 kazuha 18.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' Ah... hmm...
:{{A|vo wylq102 7 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What's down there?
:{{A|vo wylq102 7 kazuha 19.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' Everything's buried in debris. I can't see anything.
:{{A|vo wylq102 7 kazuha 20.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' It looks like the fire caused a cave-in, reducing the entire warehouse to rubble.
:{{DIcon}} So in the end, it was just a scare.
:{{DIcon}} I'm not sure if that's a good or bad thing...
:{{A|vo wylq102 7 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' That was too scary! Paimon was so sure that the warehouse bogeyman was about to jump out at us...
:{{A|vo wylq102 7 kazuha 21.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' All we can do now is keep searching in the direction that the Tatarigami energy's source left this place.
:{{A|vo wylq102 7 kazuha 22.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' Two ordinary humans, entangled with the Tatarigami... I fear much misfortune has already befallen them.
:{{DIcon}} Let's hurry.
:{{DIcon}} We cannot afford to delay any longer.
:{{A|vo wylq102 7 kazuha 23.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' Yes, let's go. If nothing else, it's vital that we find out where this Tatarigami energy is coming from.
:{{A|vo wylq102 7 kazuha 24.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' Quiet your mind and focus on what you sense around you... perhaps you, too, will perceive its ominous presence in the wind.

;(After defeating the hilichurls)
:{{A|vo wylq102 10 kazuha 01.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' I—It's...
:{{A|vo wylq102 10 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Agh! Look at this red stuff... Wh—What is it?
:{{A|vo wylq102 10 kazuha 02.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' By the looks of it, a letter, written on a piece of torn clothing. The ink is bone-dry... it must have been written quite some time ago.
:{{A|vo wylq102 10 kazuha 03.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' Well, let's take a look.
:{{color|menu|You reveal the strip of clothing and begin to read. The words seem to have been penned by Nagato, and according to him, Amenoma Yuuya was thet one who took his blade. But Nagato himself seems to have disappeared as well...}}
:{{Black Screen|Red-Dyed Fabric}}
::I am Nagato. I was wounded by Amenoma Yuuya. He took my most precious blade. I chased him, but could not catch him. I lay down here to rest on account of my exhaustion. I thought that I might croak right here — my stomach kept on bleeding! But it seems that some strange power has sustained me...
::Why did he steal that blade? I was going to sell it to him! He even burned my warehouse down!
::Agh, it hurts. It hurts! But for some reason, I can't fall unconscious, so all I can do to distract from the pain is write.
::What will happen to Sachiko, Yuuichi and Yuuji...
::I'm sorry to them. I really am. Only now do I realize how stuck in my ways I was, and how blind to my obsession! I must have been cursed...
::I collected all those strange and bizarre things, but they won me not one iota of happiness or warmth. Put all of it together, and it still wouldn't have been worth a single word from her mouth.
::Thank you... and sorry for letting you down, Sachiko.
:{{A|vo wylq102 10 kazuha 04.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' Mm-hmm...
:{{A|vo wylq102 10 kazuha 05.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' According to this letter, a conflict arose because Amenoma Yuuya wanted to seize a blade belonging to Mr. Nagato.
:{{A|vo wylq102 10 kazuha 06.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' Yuuya started the fire that destroyed the warehouse, and wounded Mr. Nagato in the fight. Mr. Nagato kept chase as long as he could, eventually stopping here to write this letter when his strength gave out.
:{{A|vo wylq102 10 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So... where is he...?
:{{A|vo wylq102 10 kazuha 07.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' He was not only mortally wounded, but also under the heavy influence of Tatarigami. Add to that the fact that its aura seems to have attracted a horde of monsters, and... I'm afraid he may no longer be with us.
:{{A|vo wylq102 10 kazuha 08.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' Whatever traces there may have been of his fate beyond after this point, they've since been disturbed by the hilichurls. There's nothing more for us to find here.
:{{DIcon}} Let's ask the Tenryou Commission to do a thorough search later.
:{{DIcon}} There are more important things right now.
:{{A|vo wylq102 10 kazuha 09.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' Yes, right now, we need to uncover some more important truths.
:{{A|vo wylq102 10 kazuha 10.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' If Amenoma Yuuya is attacking other people indiscriminately, then the longer we take to find him, the more people risk meeting the same tragic end.
:{{A|vo wylq102 10 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Right, so let's get moving!
:{{DIcon}} How did it come to this...
:{{DIcon}} It's not in his nature.
:{{A|vo wylq102 10 kazuha 11.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' I wouldn't be surprised if he, too, fell prey to the influence of the Tatarigami.
:{{A|vo wylq102 10 kazuha 12.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' For a practitioner of the martial arts, the easiest desire to inflame would be their pursuit of further power and skill.
:{{A|vo wylq102 10 kazuha 13.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' All the clues that at first seemed disparate and disconnected... it seems that now we know the thread that runs between them.
:{{A|vo wylq102 10 kazuha 14.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' I have a hypothesis that, if it's correct, not only explains the series of events leading to the two men's disappearance, but also zeroes in on the attacker's identity.
:{{A|vo wylq102 10 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' ...Wait, you've figured it out? So these two cases are connected after all?
:{{A|vo wylq102 10 kazuha 15.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' I believe so... but it's something of an outlandish idea. I will only be able to confirm my suspicions once we've met him in person.
:{{A|vo wylq102 10 kazuha 16.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' On with the search. We must stay vigilant. At any point now, we may find ourselves in danger.

;(Approach the island)
:{{A|vo wylq102 11 kazuha 01.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' He seems to have stayed here for a long time.
:{{A|vo wylq102 11 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Why here? Is there anything special about this place?
:{{A|vo wylq102 11 kazuha 02.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' I'm not sure... but on closer examination, I sense that the aura may have lingered here at several different points in time...
:{{A|vo wylq102 11 kazuha 03.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' ...
:{{A|vo wylq102 11 kazuha 04.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' Show yourself! It's no use hiding anymore!
:{{A|vo wylq102 11 kagotsurubeisshin 01.ogg}} '''???:''' Hmph.
:{{A|vo wylq102 11 kagotsurubeisshin 02.ogg}} '''???:''' Kaedehara Kazuha... it's you, at last.
:{{A|vo wylq102 11 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Aha! So it {{Not a Typo|IS}} the same guy from before!
:{{A|vo wylq102 11 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What's your problem, huh? What could you possibly have against Kazuha!?
:{{A|vo wylq102 11 kazuha 05.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' Indeed, there should be no enmity between us... if it is Amenoma Yuuya that stands before us.
:{{A|vo wylq102 11 kazuha 06.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' But what if instead of facing Amenoma Yuuya... we are in fact facing the blade in his hand?
:{{DIcon}} ...The blade?
:{{A|vo wylq102 11 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Now that you mention it, it is giving off a strange light...
:{{A|vo wylq102 11 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Whoa, whoa, surely you don't mean... Are you serious!?
:{{A|vo wylq102 11 kazuha 07.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' Tatarigami energy often lodges itself within physical objects, then works to subtly affect any living organisms in its vicinity.
:{{A|vo wylq102 11 kazuha 08.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' The blade has resided in Mr. Nagato's warehouse for many years, affecting his state of mind, and more recently using the sale as a means to affect...
:{{A|vo wylq102 11 kazuha 09.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' Or rather, as a means to occupy Amenoma Yuuya's body.
:{{A|vo wylq102 11 kagotsurubeisshin 03.ogg}} '''???:''' Hmph. You're sharper than I thought. You've already deduced the truth of the matter.
:{{A|vo wylq102 11 kagotsurubeisshin 04.ogg}} '''Prized Isshin Blade:''' Many, many years ago, I was forged by a famed bladesmith of the Isshin tradition. I was his pride and joy, in me, he placed all his hopes and dreams.
:{{A|vo wylq102 11 kagotsurubeisshin 05.ogg}} '''Prized Isshin Blade:''' As a descendant of the Kaedehara Clan, you should be able to guess our greatest regret.
:{{A|vo wylq102 11 kazuha 10.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' I presume it has something to do with the Raiden Gokaden.
:{{A|vo wylq102 11 kagotsurubeisshin 06.ogg}} '''Prized Isshin Blade:''' Indeed. At that point in time, he failed to live up to the Raiden Shogun's expectations. In the end, all he could do was to flee the nation by sea, on a ship bound for [[Snezhnaya]].
:{{A|vo wylq102 11 kagotsurubeisshin 07.ogg}} '''Prized Isshin Blade:''' He was a bladesmith of great renown, a master of his craft! There was nothing that he could not accomplish! All he needed was more time, and a little faith.
:{{A|vo wylq102 11 kagotsurubeisshin 08.ogg}} '''Prized Isshin Blade:''' And sure enough, in the end, he achieved what he had set out to do. All of his life's work — his wisdom, his skill — it culminated in his creation of me.
:{{A|vo wylq102 11 kagotsurubeisshin 09.ogg}} '''Prized Isshin Blade:''' He not only bestowed upon me the greatest of strength, but also endowed me with a consciousness of my own...
:{{A|vo wylq102 11 kagotsurubeisshin 10.ogg}} '''Prized Isshin Blade:''' In her conceit, the Raiden Shogun lost not only the single most perfect blade in the entire world, but also an irreplaceable achievement in the art of blade-forging!
:{{A|vo wylq102 11 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So... swords can become conscious? And... control people!?
:{{A|vo wylq102 11 kagotsurubeisshin 11.ogg}} '''Prized Isshin Blade:''' The people of the time in which I was born never believed I had that kind of power. They saw me as a mere blade — a sharp and well-crafted one, but in all other respects an ordinary weapon. Hmph, but that gave me the opportunity to take action.
:{{A|vo wylq102 11 kagotsurubeisshin 12.ogg}} '''Prized Isshin Blade:''' After the death of my creator, I decided to leave Snezhnaya, and began my long quest to return to the distant land of Inazuma. Moving from one person to the next, I controlled the minds of countless hosts along the way, each bringing me one step closer to my ancestral home.
:{{A|vo wylq102 11 kagotsurubeisshin 13.ogg}} '''Prized Isshin Blade:''' I seek but one thing: to face the full force of the Raiden Shogun's blade, and prove my power, the might of Isshin Art!
:{{A|vo wylq102 11 kazuha 11.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' So Amenoma Yuuya was not your first victim.
:{{A|vo wylq102 11 kazuha 12.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' Tell me, what happens to those you've possessed when you've finished using them?
:{{A|vo wylq102 11 kagotsurubeisshin 14.ogg}} '''Prized Isshin Blade:''' My hosts? Who cares what happens to them. They are but tools that serve my mission.
:{{A|vo wylq102 11 kagotsurubeisshin 15.ogg}} '''Prized Isshin Blade:''' When they got tired, or injured, or unusable, I hopped to the next one in line. All I needed them for was to take me back to Inazuma.
:{{A|vo wylq102 11 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You're awful!
:{{A|vo wylq102 11 kagotsurubeisshin 16.ogg}} '''Prized Isshin Blade:''' After I returned to Inazuma, I decided to bide my time in Nagato's warehouse, until Amenoma Yuuya handed himself over to me on a silver platter.
:{{A|vo wylq102 11 kagotsurubeisshin 17.ogg}} '''Prized Isshin Blade:''' At long last, I am approaching my journey's destination. By Amenoma Yuuya's body I have found you, and by your hand I shall defeat the Raiden Shogun!
:{{A|vo wylq102 11 kagotsurubeisshin 18.ogg}} '''Prized Isshin Blade:''' Kaedehara Kazuha, you stood against the Raiden Shogun's Musou no Hitotachi. There can be no other to serve as my host for what is to come.
:{{A|vo wylq102 11 kagotsurubeisshin 19.ogg}} '''Prized Isshin Blade:''' Now, give your body over to me!

;(After defeating the opponent)
:{{A|vo wylq102 15 kagotsurubeisshin 01.ogg}} '''Prized Isshin Blade:''' Do not stand in my way, or I will strike you down too!
:{{A|vo wylq102 15 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Your bluff's fooling no one. You've lost!
:{{A|vo wylq102 15 kagotsurubeisshin 02.ogg}} '''Prized Isshin Blade:''' Lost? I can never lose. It is this body that has reached its limit, nothing more.
:{{A|vo wylq102 15 kagotsurubeisshin 03.ogg}} '''Prized Isshin Blade:''' Even if you defeat me here, the one who falls will not be me, but this man.
:{{A|vo wylq102 15 kagotsurubeisshin 04.ogg}} '''Prized Isshin Blade:''' He is but a puppet that can be replaced. I can take a new vessel at will.
:{{DIcon}} Then we will smash you into pieces.
:{{A|vo wylq102 15 kagotsurubeisshin 05.ogg}} '''Prized Isshin Blade:''' The end result is the same! I will end this wretch's life before you can lift a finger.
:{{A|vo wylq102 15 kagotsurubeisshin 06.ogg}} '''Prized Isshin Blade:''' And even if I were to lose my physical form, it is but a small setback. My consciousness shall endure.
:{{A|vo wylq102 15 kagotsurubeisshin 07.ogg}} '''Prized Isshin Blade:''' By any means necessary and any medium available, I shall return and fulfill my destiny!
:{{A|vo wylq102 15 kazuha 01.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' Your fighting style... it is indeed the forms of Isshin Art.
:{{A|vo wylq102 15 kazuha 02.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' But from your movements, I sense only hatred and arrogance, as well as a thinly veiled mania and despair.
:{{A|vo wylq102 15 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Really? You can tell all that just from his moves?
:{{A|vo wylq102 15 kazuha 03.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' As I've mentioned before, the forms of Isshin Art convey the user's thoughts and feelings.
:{{A|vo wylq102 15 kazuha 04.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' Since the blade is currently possessing Amenoma Yuuya's body, its movements express the innermost thoughts of the blade.
:{{A|vo wylq102 15 kazuha 05.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' If you ask me, the mania is probably due to your desperate, single-minded ambition. You believe I am your only hope.
:{{A|vo wylq102 15 kagotsurubeisshin 08.ogg}} '''Prized Isshin Blade:''' Are you trying to claim that I am helpless without you?
:{{A|vo wylq102 15 kagotsurubeisshin 09.ogg}} '''Prized Isshin Blade:''' On his deathbed, he passed to me all of Isshin Art's secrets. The little that you know barely scratches the surface.
:{{A|vo wylq102 15 kagotsurubeisshin 10.ogg}} '''Prized Isshin Blade:''' In that regard, why would I ever need your help?
:{{A|vo wylq102 15 kazuha 06.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' Because all of that is in the past.
:{{A|vo wylq102 15 kazuha 07.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' I've been wondering why you've not caused more trouble in all the years that you've been in Inazuma, if you are indeed a cursed blade that can possess its owner.
:{{A|vo wylq102 15 kazuha 08.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' Now that I've seen inside your mind, everything finally makes sense. You weren't biding your time... you were trapped.
:{{A|vo wylq102 15 kagotsurubeisshin 11.ogg}} '''Prized Isshin Blade:''' Hmph...
:{{A|vo wylq102 15 kazuha 09.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' After all the time that's passed, you have grown weak, to the point that you are now unable to acquire a new host without making physical contact.
:{{A|vo wylq102 15 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ooh, that's right, Paimon remembers now! Mr. Nagato had a habit of never touching his collectibles!
:{{A|vo wylq102 15 kazuha 10.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' Only when Mr. Nagato witnessed his wife's distress and decided to sell his collectibles did you finally have an opportunity to reach out to Amenoma Yuuya and make your escape.
:{{A|vo wylq102 15 kagotsurubeisshin 12.ogg}} '''Prized Isshin Blade:''' Hmph, what of it!
:{{A|vo wylq102 15 kazuha 11.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' Well, that brings me to my second point. There's a despair in you that is so strong, it threatens to overwhelm you.
:{{A|vo wylq102 15 kazuha 12.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' You were determined to fulfill your maker's ambition, whatever the cost. But this ambition is too grand, and too heavy for you to bear. Each step you have taken has come at a great cost.
:{{A|vo wylq102 15 kazuha 13.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' I think you realized your limitations long ago. The more you clenched your teeth and pressed forward, the greater your fear of losing everything you had achieved grew, and the more you wished to run from the truth.
:{{A|vo wylq102 15 kazuha 14.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' But the way I see it... what began as an ambition has long since become a delusional fantasy.
:{{A|vo wylq102 15 kagotsurubeisshin 13.ogg}} '''Prized Isshin Blade:''' What would you know about any of this? I'm just one step away from achieving my goal!
:{{A|vo wylq102 15 kazuha 15.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' You returned to Inazuma to prove the unparalleled brilliance of Isshin Art. But to make this arduous journey, you committed countless atrocities, and showed a blatant disregard for human life.
:{{A|vo wylq102 15 kazuha 16.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' Even if you were to sever that divine light... is this truly the outcome that your maker would have desired?
:{{A|vo wylq102 15 kagotsurubeisshin 14.ogg}} '''Prized Isshin Blade:''' You...
:{{A|vo wylq102 15 kazuha 17.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' Sure, you inherited the secrets of Isshin Art, but even as you made your journey to honor this legacy, you treated the ones who wielded you as mere tools to do your bidding.
:{{A|vo wylq102 15 kazuha 18.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' How could you possibly unleash the full potential of Isshin Art, when you act in perfect discordance with the principle of harmony between a blade and its bearer?
:{{A|vo wylq102 15 kagotsurubeisshin 15.ogg}} '''Prized Isshin Blade:''' Silence, you blabbering fool...
:{{A|vo wylq102 15 kagotsurubeisshin 16.ogg}} '''Prized Isshin Blade:''' I must achieve my goal. This was his life's dream, and the very purpose for which I was brought into being.
:{{A|vo wylq102 15 kagotsurubeisshin 17.ogg}} '''Prized Isshin Blade:''' I will concede that you are most perceptive. You see my predicament clearly... but you also underestimate my resolve.
:{{A|vo wylq102 15 kazuha 19.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' And you should face reality.
:{{A|vo wylq102 15 kagotsurubeisshin 18.ogg}} '''Prized Isshin Blade:''' Easy for you to say! Facing reality offers me nothing!
:{{A|vo wylq102 15 kagotsurubeisshin 19.ogg}} '''Prized Isshin Blade:''' I have no need of anything that would stand in my way. Not hesitation, not self-reflection, and certainly not your so-called reality!
:{{A|vo wylq102 15 kagotsurubeisshin 20.ogg}} '''Prized Isshin Blade:''' ...
:{{A|vo wylq102 15 kagotsurubeisshin 21.ogg}} '''Prized Isshin Blade:''' It is pointless to argue further, descendant of the Kaedehara Clan. If you wish to save this man, then offer me your body in exchange.
:{{A|vo wylq102 15 kazuha 20.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' How stubbornly you stick to your wayward path...
:{{A|vo wylq102 15 kazuha 21.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' I do not believe for a second that you can challenge the Almighty Shogun in your current state. So let us make a bet, and I will put your strength to the test.
:{{A|vo wylq102 15 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What? Surely you're not planning to agree to his demands...

==Steps==
# Head towards [[Springvale]] and look for [[Schubert]]
# Go with [[Schubert]] to meet his "friends"
#* Enter the Quest Domain: [[Behind Enemy Lines]]
# Talk to [[Schubert]]
# Follow [[Schubert]]
# Talk to the [[Fatui|Fatuus]] guarding the entrance
# Keep following [[Schubert]]
# Talk to the [[Fatui]] ahead of you
# Defeat the [[Fatui]]
# Chase [[Schubert]]
# Talk to [[Eula]]
# Go deeper within and retrieve the diagram of the city's defenses
# Defeat the attacking [[Fatui]]
# Talk to [[Eula]] and say goodbye

:{{A|vo qsklq005 12 allpa 10.ogg}} '''Allpa:''' I trust you've learned of Tepal's wish on your way here: "a world where the skies are for all of humanity to share"

:{{A|vo qsklq005 12 allpa 13.ogg}} '''Allpa:''' So tell me, Chasca... Do you really wish to see the Phlogiston Wings forever grounded and gathering dust?

:{{A|vo qsklq005 16 cusco 07.ogg}} '''Cusco:''' *sigh*... What are we gonna do with her, hmm? Even after everything that's happened, she still hasn't figured out how to start the conversation with you...
:{{A|vo qsklq005 16 cusco 08.ogg}} '''Cusco:''' She keeps saying, "I don't think Coya has forgiven me yet"... But if you ask me, she's the one who's scared to open up and have an honest conversation!
:{{A|vo qsklq005 16 cusco 09.ogg}} '''Cusco:''' For all her confidence, she's a very sensitive soul underneath... You'd think as a peacemaker, she of all people would know how to reconcile with her family after a falling out...
:{{A|vo qsklq005 16 cusco 10.ogg}} '''Cusco:''' ...She must have been a handful growing up. Thank you for being there for her.
:'''Coya:''' ...
:{{A|vo qsklq005 16 cusco 11.ogg}} '''Cusco:''' And, of course... Thank you for keeping her safe when you were up there in the sky.
:{{A|vo qsklq005 16 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Coya, Uncle [[Cusco]]! We're here!
:{{DIcon}} What were you talking about just now?
:{{A|vo qsklq005 16 cusco 12.ogg}} '''Cusco:''' ...Hmph! I was just telling her that she's not to go chasing danger with Chasca ever again!
:{{A|vo qsklq005 16 mutota 01.ogg}} '''Mutota:''' Cusco, I understand how you must feel... But it's all thanks to Coya and Chasca's efforts that the airborne workshop didn't come crashing down on our heads.
:{{A|vo qsklq005 16 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, Paimon almost forgot to ask... They didn't hurt you while we were gone, did they?
:{{A|vo qsklq005 16 mutota 02.ogg}} '''Mutota:''' Thankfully, when her co-conspirators tried to arrest me, I was out coaching [[Coyllur]] and [[Zhunan]].
:{{A|vo qsklq005 16 mutota 03.ogg}} '''Mutota:''' The two of them were a huge help. They took care of things while I went around rallying the resistance... So in the end, Allpa's would-be revolt didn't really get off the ground.
:{{A|vo qsklq005 16 mutota 04.ogg}} '''Mutota:''' And as it turns out... not all of the Wingless want to see our dear saurian friends replaced with Phlogiston-powered gizmos.
:{{A|vo qsklq005 16 mutota 05.ogg}} '''Mutota:''' I'm so sorry you got mixed up in this, by the way. We should have caught on to Allpa's scheme sooner... We could have saved so many qucusaurs from getting hurt...
:'''Coya:''' ...
:{{A|vo qsklq005 16 mutota 06.ogg}} '''Mutota:''' Most of the airborne workshop has now been dismantled. We've just left one small, harmless part intact... and repurposed it as a jail for Allpa and her cronies.
:{{A|vo qsklq005 16 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Let's see how THEY like being locked up in a sky prison!
:{{DIcon}} How the tables have turned.
:{{DIcon}} Time they got a taste of their own medicine.
:{{A|vo qsklq005 16 cusco 13.ogg}} '''Cusco:''' ...So, it looks like there's just one last conflict left to resolve. Peacemaker, you're up.
:{{A|vo qsklq005 16 chasca 05.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' ...*sigh*
:{{A|vo qsklq005 16 chasca 06.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' I said it had to wait until things had blown over, didn't I... And now they have... But I still have no idea what to say.
:{{A|vo qsklq005 16 chasca 07.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' ...Coya, I just want to say... I'm sorry for how things went down back then.
:'''Coya:''' ...
:{{A|vo qsklq005 16 coya 04.ogg}} '''Coya:''' (There's nothing to be sorry about. Human or saurian, we all grow up, and form new bonds with new family and friends.)
:{{A|vo qsklq005 16 coya 05.ogg}} '''Coya:''' (And now, I've come to understand why you chose to stay among the humans.)
:{{A|vo qsklq005 16 chasca 08.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' Huh? Does this mean, you're... you're not mad at me anymore?
:{{A|vo qsklq005 16 coya 06.ogg}} '''Coya:''' (...That's right.)
:{{A|vo qsklq005 16 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' There's that family likeness coming through again...
:{{DIcon}} Paimon... Zip it.
:{{A|vo qsklq005 16 chasca 09.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' But... that day, when we ran into each other...
:{{A|vo qsklq005 16 coya 07.ogg}} '''Coya:''' (Alright... I admit, I was angry in that moment. I thought you were their accomplice...)
:{{A|vo qsklq005 16 chasca 10.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' Huh... So then... when did you finally make your peace with it?
:{{A|vo qsklq005 16 chime 01.ogg}} '''Chime:''' (Moooooom!)
:{{A|vo qsklq005 16 chimpu 01.ogg}} '''Chimpu:''' (Hey! Slow down!)
:{{A|vo qsklq005 16 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Aw! It's Chime and [[Chimpu]], they're here too!
:{{A|vo qsklq005 16 chime 02.ogg}} '''Chime:''' (Mom, are you okay?)
:{{A|vo qsklq005 16 coya 08.ogg}} '''Coya:''' (Mom is fine, love... We're all doing well.)
:{{A|vo qsklq005 16 chasca 11.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' ...
:{{A|vo qsklq005 16 coya 09.ogg}} '''Coya:''' (...I guess it was when... it was my turn to embrace a new family of my own.)
{{Dialogue End}}

==Dialogue==
{{Quest Description|Ningguang has been working pretty hard all day. You'd like to help her take a day off. She seems to have some idea of what she'd like to do during this down-time...}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Wait until the following day <nowiki>(07:00–08:00)</nowiki>)

;(Wake Ningguang up)
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913801 ningguang 01.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' Yes, I'm already awake.
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913801 ningguang 02.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' I'll be out in a moment. I'm just changing.

;(Talk to Ningguang)
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913801 ningguang 03.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' Good morning. Did you sleep well?
:{{DIcon}} The same as usual.
::{{A|vo ngcop001 1913801 ningguang 04.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' That's good. I was worried you'd be a little uncomfortable.
:{{DIcon}} I was a little nervous.
::{{A|vo ngcop001 1913801 ningguang 05.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' There's nothing to worry about. We just need to go through the schedule you made and tick the items off one by one.
:{{DIcon}} I was so excited I couldn't sleep.
::{{A|vo ngcop001 1913801 ningguang 06.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' Oh, how strange — me too! ...I'm joking, of course — I slept like a baby. Sorry to disappoint you.
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913801 ningguang 07.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' So. What's item one on today's schedule?
:{{DIcon}} Here. Take a look for yourself.
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913801 ningguang 08.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' Hmm...
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913801 ningguang 09.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' I imagine this must have taken Baishi completely by surprise.
:{{DIcon}} Yes, but she said she'd leave it up to me.
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913801 ningguang 10.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' Sure. There's no harm in changing my schedule around once in a while.
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913801 ningguang 11.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' My schedule is usually very tightly packed, and any extra time I can squeeze out is spent on preparing for the future.
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913801 ningguang 12.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' So it'll be quite nice to take a break.
:{{DIcon}} You don't take many breaks, huh?
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913801 ningguang 13.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' I don't often feel tired. Seeing the Mora come in has a way of making me feel quite invigorated.
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913801 ningguang 14.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' Still, your idea is very sensible. Mora can only lift a weary spirit. It cannot alleviate physical fatigue.
:{{A|vo ngcop001 1913801 ningguang 15.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' So then. The day's ahead of us. Any ideas on how to spend it?
:{{Hangout Branch|Let's do something you never normally have time for.|Liyue Millennial}}
::{{A|vo ngcop001 1913801 ningguang 16.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' Something I never have time for...
::{{A|vo ngcop001 1913801 ningguang 17.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' Ah, have you played the chess game I made? Or heard of it, perhaps?
::{{DIcon}} Never heard of it...
:::{{A|vo ngcop001 1913801 ningguang 18.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' It's called Liyue Millennial. Based on classic chess, but with different rules.
::{{DIcon}} Is it called Liyue Millennial?
:::{{A|vo ngcop001 1913801 ningguang 19.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' Yes. It's based on classic chess, but with different rules.
::{{A|vo ngcop001 1913801 ningguang 20.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' When I was designing it, I wanted it not only to be a fun game, but also capture Liyue's culture in a unique way.
::{{A|vo ngcop001 1913801 ningguang 21.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' So I introduced a lot of concepts that aren't part of traditional chess, as well as different chess pieces and even boards.
::{{A|vo ngcop001 1913801 ningguang 22.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' I'm constantly revising and expanding it. So far, there are over 30 editions.
::{{DIcon}} What an ambitious project...
::{{DIcon}} It sounds quite complicated...
::{{A|vo ngcop001 1913801 ningguang 23.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' True. That's one reason why it's been difficult to catch on.
::{{A|vo ngcop001 1913801 ningguang 24.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' But I don't feel that making it easier to learn is necessarily a good thing.
::{{A|vo ngcop001 1913801 ningguang 25.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' Isn't one of the joys of playing chess to continually learn and progress through a complex set of rules?
::{{DIcon}} So how do we get people interested in it?
::{{A|vo ngcop001 1913801 ningguang 26.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' I think the key will be to make something that easily catches the attention of people who haven't played much chess before.
::{{A|vo ngcop001 1913801 ningguang 27.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' I'm planning to make a new set with the board and pieces based on the battle for Liyue.
::{{A|vo ngcop001 1913801 ningguang 28.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' One side will play the guardians of Liyue Harbor. The other side will play the Fatui and Osial.
::{{DIcon}} Sounds fun.
::{{DIcon}} I'd play that.
::{{A|vo ngcop001 1913801 ningguang 29.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' No problem. I will let you try it out as soon as I finish the prototype.
::{{A|vo ngcop001 1913801 ningguang 30.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' I want to make each of the chess pieces of Liyue Millennial as true-to-life as possible.
::{{A|vo ngcop001 1913801 ningguang 31.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' And no Guardians of Liyue chess set would be complete without you, would it?
::{{DIcon}} You're going to make a chess piece based on me?
::{{A|vo ngcop001 1913801 ningguang 32.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' I am indeed. Many of them, in fact.
::{{A|vo ngcop001 1913801 ningguang 33.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' My thinking was that only people who pre-order the chess set at full price will be eligible to receive the limited-edition Traveler chess piece.
::{{A|vo ngcop001 1913801 ningguang 34.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' It seems only fitting for someone of your status.
::{{DIcon}} So I'm part of the marketing plan...
::{{A|vo ngcop001 1913801 ningguang 35.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' Naturally, since you are the face of that historic event. I intend to make chess pieces for everyone who was involved that day, including myself.
::{{A|vo ngcop001 1913801 ningguang 36.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' Everyone who owns this chess set will preserve this moment in history in a vivid and compelling form.
::{{DIcon}} It sounds great.
::{{A|vo ngcop001 1913801 ningguang 37.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' Then it's decided.
::{{A|vo ngcop001 1913801 ningguang 38.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' Come with me. To make this chess piece, I need to take some measurements.
::;(Proceed to [[Liyue Millennial]])
:{{Hangout Branch|Let's do something you never normally have the opportunity to do.|customlinks=[[Starting From Zero]] or [[Endless Smoke]]}}
::{{A|vo ngcop001 1913801 ningguang 39.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' Something I never have the opportunity to do...
::{{A|vo ngcop001 1913801 ningguang 40.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' Interesting. Before I decide, I'd like to know... what gave you this idea?
::{{A|vo ngcop001 1913801 ningguang 41.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' Because as far as most people are concerned, Mora is the key to any and all opportunities.
::{{DIcon}} But being a member of the Liyue Qixing is a limitation.
::{{DIcon}} But Mora can also be a limitation.
::{{A|vo ngcop001 1913801 ningguang 44.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' Yes, you're absolutely right. This is what I appreciate about you, you see things the way they are rather than how they appear.
::{{A|vo ngcop001 1913801 ningguang 45.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' I want to do something a little self-indulgent. Is that okay by you?
::{{DIcon}} Sure. Whatever you feel like doing.
::{{DIcon}} The day is yours. Do with it as you please.
::{{A|vo ngcop001 1913801 ningguang 48.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' Thank you. Alright here it is — I've always thought it would be fun to recapture what life was like before I joined the Liyue Qixing.
::{{A|vo ngcop001 1913801 ningguang 49.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' I was born into a humble family, and all the wealth you see now began with a single haul of fish.
::{{DIcon}} You... know how to fish?
::{{A|vo ngcop001 1913801 ningguang 51.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' Hehe. I had to. I wasn't born with a silver spoon in my mouth.
::{{A|vo ngcop001 1913801 ningguang 52.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' Fishing isn't the half of it. You'd be amazed at some of the odd jobs I've worked in my time.
::{{A|vo ngcop001 1913801 ningguang 53.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' A lot of the old folks like to brag about how I used to be their errand-runner back in the day... hehe.
::{{DIcon}} It's hard to imagine...
::{{DIcon}} But it makes sense.
::{{A|vo ngcop001 1913801 ningguang 56.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' They were tough times. But I had a clear goal and plenty of motivation.
::{{A|vo ngcop001 1913801 ningguang 57.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' If I didn't make any money in the morning, I'd have no food for lunch. I guess that's why I came to be so obsessed with Mora.
::{{A|vo ngcop001 1913801 ningguang 58.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' I want to re-live that time from my life, feel some of that drive again. Take a trip down memory lane.
::{{A|vo ngcop001 1913801 ningguang 59.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' So how about it? Will you join me?
::{{DIcon}} Sure.
::{{DIcon}} It's not what I was expecting but it sounds like a lot of fun.
::{{A|vo ngcop001 1913801 ningguang 62.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' Great. Then let me lay down the ground rules.
::{{A|vo ngcop001 1913801 ningguang 63.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' We're not to use our status or reputation in Liyue Harbor to our advantage, and we have no starting capital.
::{{A|vo ngcop001 1913801 ningguang 64.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' The goal is to see how much Mora we can make under these conditions.
::{{Hangout Branch|Let's start at the bottom of the ladder.|Starting From Zero}}
:::{{A|vo ngcop001 1913801 ningguang 67.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' Okay, but working as a day laborer could be quite dull...
:::{{A|vo ngcop001 1913801 ningguang 68.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' Why don't we go down to the docks?
:::{{A|vo ngcop001 1913801 ningguang 69.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' They periodically throw out a lot of unclaimed or abandoned goods. We might find something that we can exchange for Mora.
:::{{DIcon}} That's not the most dignified way to make money...
:::{{A|vo ngcop001 1913801 ningguang 70.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' What does it matter? Don't worry about it, it's all part of the fun.
:::{{A|vo ngcop001 1913801 ningguang 71.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' Come on. Let's go down to the docks.
::;(Proceed to [[Starting From Zero]])
::{{Hangout Branch|Let's go and find some work at Northland Bank.|Endless Smoke}}
:::{{A|vo ngcop001 1913801 ningguang 72.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' I can see why you'd suggest that. You're thinking I could use my knowledge of how Mora works to my advantage and make a lot of money there.
:::{{A|vo ngcop001 1913801 ningguang 73.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' But Northland Bank is a special case. I rather suspect I would not be welcome there.
:::{{DIcon}}Because you've clashed in the past?
:::{{A|vo ngcop001 1913801 ningguang 74.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' Yes, and also... Never mind, I'll just show you. It won't eat up too much time.
:::{{A|vo ngcop001 1913801 ningguang 75.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' I expect they still hold a grudge against me to this day.
::;(Proceed to [[Endless Smoke]])
{{Dialogue End}}

{{Quest Description|The flagship attraction, "Asha Speedrun," is waiting for professional testers...}}

;(Approach Gaun, Bennett, and his Asha companion)
:{{A|vo yqeq407 9 gaun 01.ogg}} '''Gaun:''' ...I'm sorry, but we can't let you take that risk.
:{{A|vo yqeq407 9 bennett 01.ogg}} '''Bennett:''' But that's not what you said earlier...
:{{A|vo yqeq407 9 gaun 02.ogg}} '''Gaun:''' Our sincerest apologies. We may be pressed for time, but the safety of our visitors has to come first. We hope you understand.

'''''Time to Test the Twilight Cruise!''''' is a subquest in the quest ''[[To Wavey Bay!]]''

==Steps==
# Experience the Twilight Cruise
# Meet up with [[Mualani]]
# Use the ability of an [[Iktomisaur]] to complete construction
#* Amusement Facilities constructed: 0/2
#* When construction is complete, give the cruise ship the signal to set off
# Experience the Twilight Cruise again
# Meet up with Mualani

==Gameplay Notes==
* If the player stops indwelling the Iktomisaur during step 3, quest progress will go back to step 2. Talking to Mualani will resume the quest from "You return, having indwelt an Iktomisaurus..."

'''''To Catch a Kitten''''' is a quest in the first branch of {{Quest|The Cat and the Cocktail}}.

==Steps==
# Talk to [[Diona]]
# Look for the kitty on Mondstadt's rooftops
# Try to make conversation with [[Roger]]
# Look for the kitty near the Blacksmith
# Try to make conversation with [[Nelson (Cat)|Nelson]]
# Look for the kitty near the Cathedral
# Try to make conversation with [[Paisley]]
# Return to The Cat's Tail

==Gameplay Notes==
* Roger is located on top of the building behind and to the right of [[Blanche]]'s shop. It is possible to climb the building to reach the rooftop.

* Majoritively picking the options that favour the cats over Diona will lead to Branch 1. Proceed to [[#Ending: The Unfathomable Felines|Ending: Unfathomable Felines]]
* Majoritively picking the options that favour Diona over the cats will lead to Branch 2. Proceed to [[#When the Cats Come Home|When the Cats Come Home]].

:{{A|vo dancop001 1910202 diona 08.ogg}} '''Diona:''' He's the one that always eats the most. And even though he's always eating, he somehow weighs the lightest. I really have no idea what he's up to all the time...

:{{A|vo dancop001 1910203 diona 05.ogg}} '''Diona:''' But the amount of cat food isn't too much this time, so it'll be fine if he finishes it all.
:{{A|vo dancop001 1910203 diona 06.ogg}} '''Diona:''' Alright, we have all we need for now, let's go find Roger and Nelson. We'll deal with Paisley later.

===When the Cats Come Home===
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Upon returning to The Cat's Tail)
:{{A|vo dancop001 1910207 margaret 01.ogg}} '''Margaret:''' Oh, it looks like the kitties are back, as well as our customer.

:{{A|vo dancop001 1910207 diona 04.ogg}} '''Diona:''' No matter how well-dressed or honest of a person they actually are, once they start drinking, they become terrible people.
:{{A|vo dancop001 1910207 diona 05.ogg}} '''Diona:''' Nothing good comes of alcohol, it makes people foolish, lazy, and ugly. That's why I plan on making the most disgusting drink there ever was. Everyone will realize how terrible alcohol really is!
:{{A|vo dancop001 1910207 diona 06.ogg}} '''Diona:''' That way, Mondstadt will finally be rid of alcohol and freed from its snarling teeth.
:{{DIcon}} Quite the grand plan you have there...
:{{A|vo dancop001 1910207 diona 07.ogg}} '''Diona:''' Of course, and that's why I became a bartender in the first place, I must understand anything and everything there is to know about alcohol. This is the first step in my plan.

:{{A|vo dancop001 1910207 diona 11.ogg}} '''Diona:''' Although, I haven't discovered how yet, but I will!
:{{A|vo dancop001 1910207 diona 12.ogg}} '''Diona:''' Anyway, didn't you come all this way to just see the cats? Now that all three of them are back in the tavern, why don't you go inside and play with them?
:{{A|vo dancop001 1910207 diona 13.ogg}} '''Diona:''' Oh, and in return for all your help, I'll make a special drink just for you... non-alcoholic, of course.
{{Dialogue End}}

'''''To Claim the Crown''''' is the first part of [[A Parade of Providence]]: Act III - ''[[Gatherings and Partings]]'' during the Event.

==Steps==
# Wait until the following day (07:00)
# Learn about the situation from Aarav
# Go to the kidnappers' camp
# Investigate the truth behind the kidnapping
# Go to the main venue and find the staff member
# Retrieve the Diadem of Knowledge
# Return to the finish line and observe the situation

:{{A|vo xyjeq004 5 saqqain 01.ogg}} '''???:''' At long last... Someone to inherit my estate... and with it, my research.

:{{A|vo xyjeq004 5 kaveh 01.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' ...How do you know my name? Who are you?
:{{A|vo xyjeq004 5 saqqain 03.ogg}} '''Sachin:''' I am Sachin. Well, to be precise, I am but a fragment of Sachin's mind.
:{{A|vo xyjeq004 5 saqqain 04.ogg}} '''Sachin:''' Fate is a curious thing... Seeing you reminds me of another I once met. But you are made of sterner stuff than he, more cognizant of the trials and tribulations of this world. It is you who are worthy to inherit all that I once owned.
:{{A|vo xyjeq004 5 saqqain 05.ogg}} '''Sachin:''' We meet for the first time, children. But what I mean to say now is of utmost importance. So please, pay attention and bear witness.
:{{A|vo xyjeq004 5 saqqain 06.ogg}} '''Sachin:''' You have all performed outstandingly in this Interdarshan Championship. The Akademiya has many rare talents among its ranks, and you are the creme of the creme.
:{{A|vo xyjeq004 5 saqqain 07.ogg}} '''Sachin:''' But if I were to choose a successor, I would choose you, Kaveh. Not only because you were victorious, but also due to our similarities in character.
:{{A|vo xyjeq004 5 kaveh 02.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' ...Me? Similar to you?
:{{A|vo xyjeq004 5 saqqain 08.ogg}} '''Sachin:''' Why, yes. Both of us have the misfortune to be idealists — and that is the source of our misery.
:{{A|vo xyjeq004 5 saqqain 09.ogg}} '''Sachin:''' Twenty-eight years ago, I came to the desert and lived there for eight full years. What do you think I saw there? Alas, endless strife and slaughter...
:{{A|vo xyjeq004 5 saqqain 10.ogg}} '''Sachin:''' Conflict over water sources, robbing of merchant caravans, exploitation of the people... relentlessly, day after day. Beyond the Wall of Samiel lay a completely different world from the one I knew.
:{{A|vo xyjeq004 5 saqqain 11.ogg}} '''Sachin:''' The things I witnessed there tormented me greatly. I wished desperately to find a way to save them.
:{{A|vo xyjeq004 5 kaveh 03.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' ...So? Did you find a way?
:{{A|vo xyjeq004 5 saqqain 12.ogg}} '''Sachin:''' As a [[Vahumana]] scholar, I tried to use Vahumana knowledge to find the answer.
:{{A|vo xyjeq004 5 saqqain 13.ogg}} '''Sachin:''' I researched history and anthropology, performed countless experiments on human nature, and even sought out the scholars living deep in the desert who call themselves the "[[Order of Skeptics|Lost Darshan]]"...
:{{A|vo xyjeq004 5 saqqain 14.ogg}} '''Sachin:''' But in the end, I found that the answer I sought simply did not exist.
:{{A|vo xyjeq004 5 saqqain 15.ogg}} '''Sachin:''' It was not possible to simply assign blame for these transgressions to any one party, for the sins are carved into humanity's very nature. Our nature begets conflict, and conflict begets destruction. This is the inexorable truth.
:{{A|vo xyjeq004 5 saqqain 16.ogg}} '''Sachin:''' The aim of my research was to draw lessons from history, but what I discovered was that history offers no such guidance... Things can only ever go from bad to worse!
:{{A|vo xyjeq004 5 saqqain 17.ogg}} '''Sachin:''' After this realization, I could no longer see the meaning in anything that I had ever learned. Consumed by an overwhelming sense of emptiness, I could no longer bear to face life... and so I decided to bring my life to an end.
:{{A|vo xyjeq004 5 saqqain 18.ogg}} '''Sachin:''' But before I went through with it, a strange twist of fate led me to come into the possession of this diadem, which has the ability to preserve part of one's consciousness. Into it, I placed my experiences, before requesting that the Akademiya manage my estate.
:{{A|vo xyjeq004 5 alhaitham 01.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' As I thought, the contract you signed with the Akademiya was, in essence, your will.
:{{A|vo xyjeq004 5 alhaitham 02.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' But if you'd given up hope on this world, why did you feel the need to do this?
:{{A|vo xyjeq004 5 saqqain 19.ogg}} '''Sachin:''' I mentioned that I had performed a great many experiments concerning human nature... You may regard this as the very last experiment of them all.
:{{A|vo xyjeq004 5 saqqain 20.ogg}} '''Sachin:''' The Akademiya has no shortage of genius talents, nurturing the brightest minds of every generation. And so, with a handsome reward to draw out the worthiest of individuals, my hope was that one day, I would find one who could untangle the mystery of human nature once and for all, and help to move the world onto a better path.
:{{A|vo xyjeq004 5 alhaitham 03.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' I see, so you desired a successor who was not only a genius, but who also understood the suffering of ordinary people. Such a person would have a clearer understanding of humanity, society, and the world.
:{{A|vo xyjeq004 5 kaveh 04.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' ...
:{{A|vo xyjeq004 5 alhaitham 04.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' But did you ever consider that wealth numbs the human heart to the pain in the world? Even an idealist may be incapable of following through on your wishes after inheriting your wealth.
:{{A|vo xyjeq004 5 saqqain 21.ogg}} '''Sachin:''' You are highly intelligent... Yet you are not the sort of person who would understand my line of thinking. To me, this is also part of the experiment — part of my investigation into human nature.
:{{A|vo xyjeq004 5 saqqain 22.ogg}} '''Sachin:''' Whether my successor suffers as a consequence of my research or succumbs to an indulgence in pleasure-seeking, my research will have progressed.
:{{A|vo xyjeq004 5 saqqain 23.ogg}} '''Sachin:''' I grieve the fundamental sickness of the world, I regret the unbearable weight of its history, and I lament the research that I failed to complete.
:{{A|vo xyjeq004 5 saqqain 24.ogg}} '''Sachin:''' And this, Kaveh, my dear child... is why you will be of great utility to me.
:{{A|vo xyjeq004 5 kaveh 05.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' You're... you're absolutely certain that you want to give me everything you owned, for me to do with as I please?
:{{A|vo xyjeq004 5 saqqain 25.ogg}} '''Sachin:''' I have faith in what I see in you. Now, wear the diadem, Kaveh, and complete the journey that I could not.

==Gameplay Notes==
* [[Co-Op Mode]] is locked during several steps in this quest involving the quest's gameplay mechanics. Quitting the game, leaving the area (may require teleportation), or failing the challenge (if applicable) will usually reset the quest to a reset point and allow access to Co-Op Mode.
** The quest cannot be reset during step 12<!-- Investigate the inside of the cavern -->.<!-- teleportation disabled, physically leaving the area is allowed but does not affect the quest at all -->
** Co-Op Mode may still be available even if the icon shows otherwise. The icon will correctly display that Co-Op Mode is available after restarting the game.
* Step 3<!-- Follow the sheriff to the bar --> unlocks access to the eastern part of the Guitzli Ridge Inner Cavern: Northern Zone map layer. This is lost if the quest is reset to step 1.<!-- "Saved" upon reaching the next reset point at step 5: Talk to the sheriff -->
* Step 12<!-- Investigate the inside of the cavern --> unlocks access to the rest of the Guitzli Ridge Inner Cavern: Northern Zone map layer and the Guitzli Ridge Inner Cavern: Western Zone map layer.
* During step 4<!-- Defeat the bandits -->, the Soothing Salve that is initially presented as a drink can be shot to recover while it is still on the bartop, before the Alpaca Boss says "Use the Soothing Salve, *meh*!" and moves the Soothing Salve to the floor. If it is shot while it is still on the bartop, a second Soothing Salve will spawn and move to the floor when the Alpaca Boss says "Use the Soothing Salve, *meh*!"

::{{Readable|title=Beautifully-Written Notes
|text=<!--
-->[[Aroni|I]] noticed [[Macani]]'s gone another night without sleeping... I'm afraid he's still trying to figure out how to break the truth to his friends. Naturally, I know where he's coming from. It's troubled me for many days as well. As his wife, and as one of the first members of the team...<br><br><!--
-->I can still see the past when I close my eyes, like it happened yesterday.<br><br><!--
-->Rumors spoke of a young man traveling from place to place, seeking kindred spirits to form an adventure team. Out of curiosity, I found a vantage point from which I could catch a glimpse of him. But nobody cared for some brash upstart from the [[Collective of Plenty]], so there were few people around him... leaving me as his most conspicuous spectator.<br><br><!--
-->His speech wasn't bad. He wasn't the sort who loved to flatter others, and his words were simple and sincere. He believed in himself and his goal. Like a wildfire, brave and fearless... I can't recall all the details by now, but I know that his excitement infected me.<br><br><!--
-->Still, nobody applauded him, and no one spoke to him. Watching the noisy crowd leave him behind, the man merely smiled and sighed, then he bent down to pick up his backpack. It looked like he didn't plan on staying.<br><br><!--
-->"Maybe I should try my luck with the Flower-Feather Clan," he said.<br><br><!--
-->I was worried that he'd be disappointed. After all, we of the [[Masters of the Night-Wind]] are not exactly avid adventure-seekers.<br><br><!--
-->He looked over his shoulder at me, and I saw no trace of dejection in his eyes. He thanked me with a smile, his resolve unshaken — as if the cold shoulders were mere brambles by the roadside, and every hardship just an interlude on his grand adventure.<br><br><!--
-->How can someone live life with a spirit so fiery and clear? I've always been curious about lifestyles that differ from mine.<br><br><!--
-->Later, [[Chaco]] joined us, and then [[Anja]] from the [[People of the Springs]].<br><br><!--
-->I still remember that extraordinarily hot summer. Anja suggested holding a bonfire party at her house, and we practically leapt into getting it ready. The joy of meeting new companions and the anticipation of setting out for our future adventures combined had us drinking more than our fair share. When it was time to name our adventure team... the suggestions were about as coherent as you could expect.<br><br><!--
-->After someone tossed out the "Victorious Scorching Halberds," Macani raised the suggestion of calling us "[[Tecpatl's Flintblades]]."<br><br><!--
-->Anja asked why he didn't want a grander name, and Macani responded by saying that his dream was not to become a hero, and so he needed no such ceremony. That shocked us enough that we all sobered up slightly.<br><br><!--
-->Macani went on to explain that this land had no shortage of heroes, and so what he wanted to do was forge a path for future generations to take, allowing embers of the future to grow and shine...<br><br><!--
-->Tecpatl's Flintblades, the inheritance of embers... It was a beautiful name, and full of meaning.<br><br><!--
-->Nowadays, it seems to describe us perhaps too well.<br><br><br><!--
-->We were the ones who wanted to spread the name of the Flintblades throughout [[Teyvat]], but that dream's yet to come true. Once we had our child, we were the first to turn back...<br><br><!--
-->For the friends who trusted us and accompanied us on all our adventures thus far, our decision is undoubtedly a selfish one.<br><br><!--
-->But as parents, what could be more important than protecting our child as he grows up?<br><br><!--
-->After all this time together, we already sense what our friends' answers will be — yet it does nothing to dull the guilt within. Saying farewell has never been an easy choice, least of all for our leader.<br><br><!--
-->Or perhaps this is just another sort of adventure for us. Right now, it's my turn to give Macani courage, after he did the same to me in the past.<br><br><!--
-->...<br><br><!--
-->Our friends said they knew this day would come... They teased us for a while, but my heart doesn't feel as heavy anymore. Macani looks to be in better spirits, too.<br><br><!--
-->Anja suggested organizing a final farewell trip so we can enjoy one last holiday together... That's just like her. She knows how to keep everyone happy and doesn't want us to leave with any regrets.<br><br><!--
-->It's time to get busy again. Aside from all the packing, I'd like to prepare some special gifts for my friends.<br><br><!--
-->Oh, right, I should also find a new album so I can store more pictures from our travels.}}

:{{A|vo sglq004 6 yaemiko 05.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' So. From what you were saying, it seems that she has finally begun to comprehend what form eternity should take?
:{{A|vo sglq004 6 yaemiko 06.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' That's the most important outcome of this trip. To be honest, I wasn't expecting you'd make such great progress when I lent you the Pass Permit.
:{{A|vo sglq004 6 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yeah. It seems like she's not gonna force everything to stay the same way anymore.
:{{A|vo sglq004 6 yaemiko 07.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' To put it nicely, even deities indulge in wishful thinking. To put it more bluntly, there are things that even [[The Seven]] can't do when faced with something even more powerful than themselves.
:{{DIcon}} The human heart?
:{{DIcon}} The [[Heavenly Principles]]?
:{{A|vo sglq004 6 yaemiko 08.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' Hehe. Take a guess.
:{{A|vo sglq004 6 yaemiko 09.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' Anyway. It sounds like you had a very pleasant trip and even had the chance to see Ei's less formal side.
:{{A|vo sglq004 6 yaemiko 10.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' Next time you wish to see her, you can come and take the Pass Permit from me again. She would never admit to it, but she does, in fact, get quite lonely.
:{{A|vo sglq004 6 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What? But she said she doesn't need company...
:{{A|vo sglq004 6 yaemiko 11.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' Because she is a god. It's not that gods don't need the company of others, just that the idea of a god having company seems indulgent to her.
:{{A|vo sglq004 6 yaemiko 12.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' But you don't belong to this world. Perhaps you are just the company she needs.
;(Quest ends)

;(Talk to Yae Miko again after the quest ends)
:{{Color|menu|The matter came to a close some time ago, but you'd still like to share the interesting things you experienced with Miko...}}
:{{A|vo dialog sglq004 yaemiko 01.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' Hmm? Was there something else you wanted to talk about?
:{{DIcon}} About Dango Milk...
::{{A|vo dialog sglq004 yaemiko 02.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' I have no doubt that she immensely enjoyed that drink. I'm sure she was as happy as can be.
::{{A|vo dialog sglq004 yaemiko 03.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' What she really wanted to say was this: "How soon do you think you could open a branch in the Plane of Euthymia?"
:{{DIcon}} About the Raiden Shogun...
::{{A|vo dialog sglq004 yaemiko 04.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' The puppet, yes. I've also heard that changing a puppet's operating rules is extremely difficult.
::{{A|vo dialog sglq004 yaemiko 05.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' It's most likely the first time in history anyone has faced this issue. You can imagine how hard it must be, given that it has successfully flummoxed the wise and powerful Ei...
::{{A|vo dialog sglq004 yaemiko 06.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' This is one problem that even the [[Musou no Hitotachi]] will not be able to solve.
:{{DIcon}} About light novels...
::{{A|vo dialog sglq004 yaemiko 07.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' Don't you think it's a fun idea, someone being reborn as the Raiden Shogun? That's all that light novels are supposed to be — a bit of fun.
::{{A|vo dialog sglq004 yaemiko 08.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' For her, though... yes, probably a little too avant-garde.
::{{A|vo dialog sglq004 yaemiko 09.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' Ooh, maybe I should commission a sequel: Reborn as Guuji Yae. What do you think?
:{{DIcon}} I've got nothing else to say.
:;(Dialogue ends)
{{Dialogue End}}

==Steps==
# Go to the [[Wangshu Inn]]
# Sit next to the table and accept [[Mona]]'s invitation
# Talk to Mona and enjoy a good meal
# Look for the innkeeper and ask to borrow the kitchen to make Mona a dish
# Cook Golden Crab
# Give the [[Golden Crab]] (Normal or Delicious) to Mona
# Continue your journey, head for the [[Stone Gate]]
# Talk to Mona as she rests
# Fend the bandits off
