==Dialogue==
{{Quest Description|The astrologist Mona, who you met by chance outside [[Liyue Harbor]], has promised that if you go with her to [[Mondstadt]] to fulfill her appointment, she will help you read the truth behind the gods and your sibling. Leaving Liyue Harbor, you head towards Mondstadt.}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(At Wangshu Inn)
:{{A|vo mnlq002 3 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Since it's Mona's treat, we can order whatever we want, right?
:{{A|vo mnlq002 3 mona 01.ogg}} '''Mona:''' Of course. I am a most generous master, after all. But only if you can finish it all. Wasting food simply will not do.
:{{A|vo mnlq002 3 yuhua 01.ogg}} '''Yuhua:''' Excuse me, what would you like to order?
:{{DIcon}} These [[Golden Shrimp Balls]]...
::{{A|vo mnlq002 3 yuhua 02a.ogg}} '''[[Yuhua]]:''' These are made using large, succulent shrimp wrapped in crispy-fried potatoes. They have an amazing texture.
:{{DIcon}} As for the [[Vegetarian Abalone]]...
::{{A|vo mnlq002 3 yuhua 02b.ogg}} '''Yuhua:''' It's exactly what it says on the label — abalone made from vegetarian ingredients. It's just as good as the real thing!
:{{DIcon}} How about this [[Crab Roe Tofu]]...
::{{A|vo mnlq002 3 yuhua 02c.ogg}} '''Yuhua:''' Though tofu could not be a more ordinary ingredient, it and crab roe are truly a match made in heaven. It's one of our specialties.
:{{DIcon}} And this [[Bamboo Shoot Soup|Salted Pork Soup]]...
::{{A|vo mnlq002 3 yuhua 02d 1.ogg}} '''Yuhua:''' This is a favorite among our regulars. Bamboo shoots, meat and ham are cooked together, creating a richly-flavored soup.
::{{A|vo mnlq002 3 yuhua 02d 2.ogg}} '''Yuhua:''' Pour a few spoonfuls into each bowl of rice you eat — you'll never get enough of it!
;(After hearing the waitress describe each dish)
:{{DIcon}} I'll order them all.
:{{A|vo mnlq002 3 mona 02.ogg}} '''Mona:''' A—All of them? We only have three... No, two and a half people? Isn't that too much food?
:{{A|vo mnlq002 3 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' That's not how you count it! Besides, Paimon hasn't even ordered yet!
:{{A|vo mnlq002 3 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' [[Squirrel Fish]], [[Jueyun Chili Chicken]], and [[Jewelry Soup]], please!
:{{A|vo mnlq002 3 yuhua 03.ogg}} '''Yuhua:''' Sure. And is there anything else that you would like to order, ma'am?
:{{A|vo mnlq002 3 mona 03.ogg}} '''Mona:''' I—I'd just like to ask, how much do the current dishes cost in total?
:{{A|vo mnlq002 3 yuhua 04.ogg}} '''Yuhua:''' Um, around twenty thousand [[Mora]].
:{{A|vo mnlq002 3 mona 04.ogg}} '''Mona:''' Then I—I'll just have some vegetarian noodles, please.
:{{A|vo mnlq002 3 yuhua 05.ogg}} '''Yuhua:''' Alright. A bowl of vegetarian noodles, was it? Please wait a moment, we will serve you shortly.
:{{Black Screen|''The food arrives. You and Paimon gorge yourselves on a feast fit for a king, while Mona dines on vegetarian noodles.''}}
:{{A|vo mnlq002 3 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Paimon's been thinking about something since we started eating...
:{{DIcon}} Why did she only order one dish?
:{{A|vo mnlq002 3 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Is it... because she actually doesn't have money?
:{{A|vo mnlq002 3 mona 05.ogg}} '''Mona:''' I heard that! I said I was treating. How could I be rattled by something as mundane as Mora!?
:{{A|vo mnlq002 3 mona 06.ogg}} '''Mona:''' An astrologist's mind is set on studying the stars. Being so easily disturbed by such banal matters would hamper my judgment.
:{{A|vo mnlq002 3 mona 07.ogg}} '''Mona:''' Especially the act of overly gratifying oneself using Mora. It is both vulgar...
:'''???:''' *stomach grumble*
:{{A|vo mnlq002 3 mona 08.ogg}} '''Mona:''' ...and dangerous.
:{{A|vo mnlq002 3 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So not eating the dishes we ordered is also part of an astrologist's pride? Paimon doesn't get it.
:{{A|vo mnlq002 3 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' But it feels kinda bad that only we got to feast...
:{{DIcon}} Let me whip something up for you.
:{{A|vo mnlq002 3 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, yes! We can do that! Just give us a minute!
;(After cutscene ends)
:{{A|vo mnlq002 3 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You don't use Mora to fulfill your desires. So, it's fine as long as you're not buying anything, right?
:{{A|vo mnlq002 3 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Let's go borrow the kitchen from the {{Color|buzzword|innkeeper}}!

;(Talk to Mona again, optional)
:{{A|vo dialog mnlq002 mona 01.ogg}} '''Mona:''' There's no need to spend all that effort on me, I'm not in dire need of food.
:{{A|vo dialog mnlq002 mona 02.ogg}} '''Mona:''' I am a little hungry... but it's not a big deal.
----
:{{A|vo mnlq002 4 huaian 01.ogg}} '''[[Huai'an]]:''' Hello, how may I help you?
:{{A|vo mnlq002 4 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' We'd like to borrow the kitchen here.
:{{DIcon}} A friend of mine would like to eat a special dish.
:{{DIcon}} My friend would like to eat something made by me.
:{{A|vo mnlq002 4 huaian 02.ogg}} '''Huai'an:''' Ah, I see. In that case, sure. As long as you've prepared your own ingredients, feel free to use the kitchen.
:{{A|vo mnlq002 4 huaian 03.ogg}} '''Huai'an:''' If I may... You must be well-versed in the art of cooking, yes?
:{{DIcon}} Of course. If I make it, it's delicious!
::{{A|vo mnlq002 4 huaian 04a.ogg}} '''Huai'an:''' Haha, talented indeed. Actually, I have a small suggestion to make...
:{{DIcon}} Not really...
::{{A|vo mnlq002 4 huaian 04b.ogg}} '''Huai'an:''' Haha, how humble of you. Actually, I have a little suggestion...
:{{A|vo mnlq002 4 huaian 05.ogg}} '''Huai'an:''' From your clothes, you're most likely not from around these parts. But since you've come to Liyue, would you like to try making Liyue-style cuisine?
:{{A|vo mnlq002 4 huaian 06.ogg}} '''Huai'an:''' I have a recipe for Golden Crab with me. It's a Yue cuisine classic.
:{{A|vo mnlq002 4 huaian 07.ogg}} '''Huai'an:''' It's crab meat that's been rolled in flour, deep-fried, and then pan-fried together with ginger and garlic. When you finally plate it up, the crab seems to be lying on gold.
:{{A|vo mnlq002 4 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Golden... Crab!
:{{DIcon}} That sounds a little complicated.
:{{DIcon}} Learning a whole new dish for Mona's sake is a bit...
:{{A|vo mnlq002 4 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Golden Crab, {{Traveler}}! Golden Crab!
:{{DIcon}} I got it, I got it. Golden Crab.
:{{DIcon}} ...I guess I'm learning it for your sake, too.
:{{A|vo mnlq002 4 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Heh-heh. Then let's get to it!
:{{A|vo mnlq002 4 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' With your skills in the kitchen, this'll be a cinch!
:;(Obtain [[Golden Crab|Recipe: Golden Crab]] ×1)
----
;(Returning to Mona)
:{{A|vo mnlq002 6 mona 01.ogg}} '''Mona:''' There's no need to spend all that effort on me, I'm not in dire need of food...
:{{A|vo mnlq002 6 mona 02.ogg}} '''Mona:''' I am a little hungry... but it's not a big deal.
;(Give Golden Crab or Delicious Golden Crab to Mona)
:{{A|vo mnlq002 6 mona 03.ogg}} '''Mona:''' T—This aroma is...
:{{DIcon}} Something to go with your noodles.
::{{A|vo mnlq002 6 mona 04a.ogg}} '''Mona:''' I never thought it'd be so luxurious...
:{{DIcon}} Your special order, ma'am.
::{{A|vo mnlq002 6 mona 04b.ogg}} '''Mona:''' W-Wow, it's incredible...!
:{{A|vo mnlq002 6 mona 05.ogg}} '''Mona:''' Fine. Since my disciple has put in so much time and effort, I must — with great difficulty — accept.
;(If Normal Golden Crab)
::{{A|vo mnlq002 6 mona 06.ogg}} '''Mona:''' ...Aah! It's delicious! It's the most delicious thing I've eaten recently!
;(If Delicious Golden Crab)
::{{A|vo mnlq002 6 mona 07.ogg}} '''Mona:''' ...Ooh! This Golden Crab is too delicious! I have never eaten anything this good in my life!
:{{A|vo mnlq002 6 mona 08.ogg}} '''Mona:''' Ah, uh, I mean... *cough* I never knew that my disciple was this skilled. As your master, I am most comforted.
:{{DIcon}} As long as you're eating a full meal.
:{{DIcon}} You say that, but you're clearly relishing the meal.
:{{A|vo mnlq002 6 mona 09.ogg}} '''Mona:''' I see that it's no boast to call them Liyue's delicacies.
:{{A|vo mnlq002 6 mona 10.ogg}} '''Mona:''' I suppose it wasn't too much to spend all this Mora on...
:{{A|vo mnlq002 6 mona 11.ogg}} '''Mona:''' Ah, it's nothing. Nothing at all. Now that we've eaten and drank our fill, we should be off.
:{{A|vo mnlq002 6 mona 12.ogg}} '''Mona:''' If we travel north from here, we should reach the {{Color|buzzword|Stone Gate}}, and from there, we will be within the boundaries of Mondstadt.
:{{A|vo mnlq002 6 mona 13.ogg}} '''Mona:''' What deep mysteries shall we acquire knowledge of? *chuckles* I'm looking forward to it.
----
;(After reaching the destination at the Stone Gate)
:{{A|vo mnlq002 8 mona 01.ogg}} '''Mona:''' Phew. That was tiring, but we're finally in Mondstadt.
:{{A|vo mnlq002 8 mona 02.ogg}} '''Mona:''' The quest to plumb the wondrous depths of knowledge is indeed arduous...
:{{A|vo mnlq002 8 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Paimon's not tired.
:{{A|vo mnlq002 8 mona 03.ogg}} '''Mona:''' Ugh, that's because you float.
:{{A|vo mnlq002 8 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Well, it doesn't look like an astrologist is all that amazing either.
:{{A|vo mnlq002 8 mona 04.ogg}} '''Mona:''' That's because you have too many unrealistic fantasies about astrology.
:{{A|vo mnlq002 8 taylor 01.ogg}} '''[[Tyler]]:''' Are you also resting your feet here?
:{{A|vo mnlq002 8 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Who are you?
:{{A|vo mnlq002 8 taylor 02.ogg}} '''Tyler:''' Oh, my brothers and I are all merchants. We just finished doing business in Liyue, and we're preparing to head back to Mondstadt.
:{{A|vo mnlq002 8 taylor 03.ogg}} '''Tyler:''' You look rather tired. The cart we hired will be coming in a while — what say you to coming along for the ride?
:{{DIcon}} Well, I am a little tired...
::{{A|vo mnlq002 8 taylor 04a.ogg}} '''Tyler:''' Haha, let's go, then. We can make conversation along the way, the more the merrier.
:{{DIcon}} Do I need to pay?
::{{A|vo mnlq002 8 taylor 04b.ogg}} '''Tyler:''' No need, no need, we're already heading that way anyway.
:{{A|vo mnlq002 8 mona 05.ogg}} '''Mona:''' There's no need. Now shoo. Get out of our way.
:{{A|vo mnlq002 8 taylor 05.ogg}} '''Tyler:''' Eh? Miss... Is there something wrong?
:{{A|vo mnlq002 8 mona 06.ogg}} '''Mona:''' Cease your pretensions, bandit.
:{{A|vo mnlq002 8 mona 07.ogg}} '''Mona:''' Picking up people on the road who appear vulnerable robbing them blind once they've gotten on the cart, and then taking them to some [[archon]]-forsaken place — is that your deal?
:{{A|vo mnlq002 8 taylor 06.ogg}} '''Tyler:''' W—What are you saying? We came over here to make conversation, and this is how we're rewarded? With insults?
:{{A|vo mnlq002 8 taylor 07.ogg}} '''Tyler:''' If you don't want to get on, don't! Crazy girl...
:{{A|vo mnlq002 8 mona 08.ogg}} '''Mona:''' Well then, shall I tell you now which objects you have on you that are stolen?
:{{A|vo mnlq002 8 mona 09.ogg}} '''Mona:''' If you have any quibbles, we can bring people to corroborate what I've said, and all will come to light.
:{{A|vo mnlq002 8 mona 10.ogg}} '''Mona:''' If I lose, I'll pay you twenty thousand Mora. But if I win, then you'll be eating prison rations in Liyue Harbor tonight.
:{{A|vo mnlq002 8 mona 11.ogg}} '''Mona:''' How about it? If you're real legitimate businessmen, there's nothing to fear, is there?
:{{A|vo mnlq002 8 taylor 08.ogg}} '''Tyler:''' You... You!
:{{A|vo mnlq002 8 taylor 09.ogg}} '''Tyler:''' You've pushed it too far, brat!
:{{A|vo mnlq002 8 taylor 10.ogg}} '''Tyler:''' I don't know how you found out, but as long as we get rid of you, no one will have to know!
:{{DIcon}} Careful, Mona!
:{{DIcon}} You will not touch her!
:{{A|vo mnlq002 8 mona 12.ogg}} '''Mona:''' Don't fret, it's just a few bandits.
:{{A|vo mnlq002 8 mona 13.ogg}} '''Mona:''' You said earlier that there was nothing amazing about astrologists... Well then, this is a good time to show you what your master can do.
----
;(After defeating the bandits)
:{{A|vo mnlq002 10 mona 01.ogg}} '''Mona:''' Hmph, what did you think? Did that satisfy your expectations?
:{{DIcon}} Your combat abilities were amazing.
:{{DIcon}} It's impressive that you saw through those bandits.
:{{A|vo mnlq002 10 mona 02.ogg}} '''Mona:''' Such things are elementary for an astrologist.
:{{A|vo mnlq002 10 mona 03.ogg}} '''Mona:''' Lies are worthless before astrology. Destiny and truth are written in the stars.
:{{A|vo mnlq002 10 mona 04.ogg}} '''Mona:''' Though it may take more time to garner the specifics, I can read the gist of a situation at a glance.
:{{A|vo mnlq002 10 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' But you did hit some bumps in the road...
:{{A|vo mnlq002 10 mona 05.ogg}} '''Mona:''' That's because [[Teyvat]]'s stars can only display the fates and truths of "this world."
:{{A|vo mnlq002 10 mona 06.ogg}} '''Mona:''' Anything related to you becomes like a fog that even I cannot penetrate.
:{{A|vo mnlq002 10 mona 07.ogg}} '''Mona:''' That is why I must meet that successor. With our knowledge combined, I might be able to gain new insight into your fate.
:{{DIcon}} I'm a little excited.
:{{DIcon}} I'm not getting my hopes up...
:{{A|vo mnlq002 10 mona 08.ogg}} '''Mona:''' Ha. Whatever the case, you've got everything to gain from this trip.
:{{A|vo mnlq002 10 mona 09.ogg}} '''Mona:''' Alright, I'm rested. Let's get this journey to {{Color|buzzword|Mondstadt}} over with!
:{{A|vo mnlq002 10 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' *sigh* If only we had a cart...
:{{A|vo mnlq002 10 mona 10.ogg}} '''Mona:''' I thought you weren't tired!
{{Dialogue End}}

'''''To the Shrine''''' is a quest in {{Quest|The Gang's Daily Deeds}}.

==Steps==
* Go to the [[Grand Narukami Shrine (Subarea)|Grand Narukami Shrine]] and apologize to [[Yae Miko]]

==Dialogue==

'''To Traverse the Mortal Plane''' is the second part of {{Quest|Reflections of Mortality}}.

==Steps==
# Go out for a walk with [[Ei]]
#* [[Co-Op Mode]] is locked from this step until Ei and the Traveler finish trying Dango Milk at Tomoki's stall.
# Talk to Ei
# Accompany Ei on her tour of the streets
# Go with Ei to [[Tomoki]]'s stall
# Talk to Tomoki
# Go with Ei to [[Yae Publishing House]]
# Talk to [[Kuroda]]
# Browse the light novels on the shelf
# Talk to Ei
# Pick a suitable light novel (0/3)
# Recommend and explain the contents of the book to Ei

==Gameplay Notes==
* While walking with Ei in the marketplace, the player's character is restricted to just the [[Traveler]]. The walk must be restarted from the beginning if the player leaves the area before Ei arrives at Tomoki's stall.

;(Approach the Adventurers' Guild in Fontaine)
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 1 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hey, Katheryne, it's us! Got any new commissions? Specifically, one with a huge Mora tag, perhaps...?

::{{A|vo fnnlq001 1 paimon 02a 1.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Eh, Paimon's just being enthusiastic. We're old friends now, she gets it!

::{{A|vo fnnlq001 1 paimon 02b 1.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You know we're worth it! For quality work and speedy results, choose the Paimon and the Traveler!
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 1 katheryne 01.ogg}} '''Katheryne:''' Hehe, it's always a pleasure to see our two most avid adventurers again. Looking for the next challenge, I see.
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 1 katheryne 02.ogg}} '''Katheryne:''' Actually, we do in fact have a rather urgent commission that is still open. Having read the details, however, I don't believe you'd consider it to be "lucrative"...
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 1 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Um, don't worry about that. We were just kidding. So what's the situation?
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 1 katheryne 03.ogg}} '''Katheryne:''' To put it simply, the requester is looking for a temporary replacement actress for their musical. The original cast member ran into some issues, and is currently unable to perform the role.
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 1 katheryne 04.ogg}} '''Katheryne:''' But the troupe has also been experiencing some financial difficulties, so unfortunately they cannot afford to pay the replacement actress...
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 1 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hmm... That does sound like a tricky situation. So basically, they're looking for a volunteer?
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 1 katheryne 05.ogg}} '''Katheryne:''' That's right. Our adventurers reached out to many actresses, but none of them were willing to take the job.
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 1 katheryne 06.ogg}} '''Katheryne:''' There are only a few days left until the performance. If they can't find someone in time, they'll probably have to postpone the show. And delays tend to create all sorts of new problems...
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 1 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Got it... Oh... This one's a doozy. What do you think, {{Traveler}}? Any ideas?
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 1 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Even if we took the commission, neither of us have any experience starring in musicals...
:{{DIcon}} Very true...
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 1 katheryne 07.ogg}} '''Katheryne:''' Hmm... If you're interested in helping, why not start by having a chat with the requester? He's right over there.
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 1 katheryne 08.ogg}} '''Katheryne:''' Maybe you can't fill the role yourselves, but you might be able to help him figure out another solution. Maybe there's something he hasn't thought of.
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 1 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ohh, it's that guy, huh? No wonder he looks like he just ate a sour lemon.
:{{DIcon}} Got it.
:{{DIcon}} We'll go talk to him.
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 1 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Paimon approves. Let's go!
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 1 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hello there! Are you the guy looking for a new actress?
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 1 lauwick 01.ogg}} '''Lauwick:''' Wait... I know you two! Are you really willing to act in my musical!?
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 1 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wow, sounds like we're pretty famous in Fontaine already! Heehee.
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 1 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Uh... But to answer your question, neither of us have any experience in musicals... But we heard that you're in a bit of a bind, so we figured we could at least try to help you think of a solution.
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 1 lauwick 02.ogg}} '''Lauwick:''' Ah, I see... It's okay, I knew that asking for a volunteer was a long shot.
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 1 lauwick 03.ogg}} '''Lauwick:''' If we can't find someone to step in, we'll have no choice but to cancel the show... It would be such a shame.
:{{DIcon}} Can't you cover the budget for a new actress with ticket fees?
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 1 lauwick 04.ogg}} '''Lauwick:''' *sigh* That's the thing... We're not some high-profile theater troupe. Just a group of amateur enthusiasts.
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 1 lauwick 05.ogg}} '''Lauwick:''' All our sets and props are very crude. We're grateful enough just to get an audience, never mind ticket fees.
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 1 lauwick 06.ogg}} '''Lauwick:''' If we had a way to make this profitable, things might've turned out differently... But now it looks inevitable that we'll disband.
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 1 paimon 12.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Disband? You're splitting up the troupe?
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 1 lauwick 07.ogg}} '''Lauwick:''' Oh, I guess the lady at the Adventurers' Guild didn't tell you? Yeah... This is supposed to be our final show together as a troupe.
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 1 lauwick 08.ogg}} '''Lauwick:''' One last show, and after that, we go our separate ways. So we were really hoping to end on a high note.
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 1 lauwick 09.ogg}} '''Lauwick:''' Nobody wants things to just... fizzle out. Not after all the time and effort we've invested into it.
:{{DIcon}} Katheryne mentioned that one of your actresses can't make it?
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 1 lauwick 10.ogg}} '''Lauwick:''' Yeah... the leading lady, in fact. She's been dealing with a chronic illness ever since childhood, and unfortunately it flared up again recently. It really drains all her energy, so she's in no state to perform.
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 1 lauwick 11.ogg}} '''Lauwick:''' The show just won't be the same without her... But for everyone else's sake, I still hope we can find a way to hold the performance on schedule.
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 1 paimon 13.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Got it. We have a clearer picture now... Um... Let's see if we can come up with any ideas.
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 1 paimon 14.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Uh... What if we sponsored the show? Um... Traveler, how much Mora are you carrying?
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 1 lauwick 12.ogg}} '''Lauwick:''' Ah, please, there's no need to go that far. I wouldn't feel right asking such a huge favor, and I can't promise that we'd ever be able to pay you back.
:{{DIcon}} Mora isn't the biggest problem...
:{{DIcon}} How do we find someone who's a good fit for the role?
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 1 paimon 15.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hmm, good point. If the actress just goes through the motions for the Mora, that's not exactly rescuing the show.
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 1 paimon 16.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' We should find someone who'll put on the best performance possible. Hmm... Ooh, wait! What about you-know-who...?
:{{DIcon}} Great minds think alike. I was just thinking that.
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 1 paimon 17.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Haha, that's how you know we're the best of partners! Anyway, she should have all the free time in the world right now.
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 1 paimon 18.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' She's really good at performing, and she was once super popular with the crowd... performing in a musical should be a piece of cake for her!
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 1 lauwick 13.ogg}} '''Lauwick:''' Who are you thinking of? Sounds like someone famous...?
:{{DIcon}} Furina.
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 1 lauwick 14.ogg}} '''Lauwick:''' Her!? You're... That was a joke, right?
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 1 paimon 19.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Um... Nope. Paimon doesn't actually know if she's performed on stage before, but Paimon's pretty confident that she'd be really good at it.
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 1 lauwick 15.ogg}} '''Lauwick:''' You're not wrong there... She has actually performed in a number of big-name shows before. They were one of the reasons she was so popular...
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 1 lauwick 16.ogg}} '''Lauwick:''' But even if she's no longer the Hydro Archon, it's not like she's suddenly a commoner.
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 1 lauwick 17.ogg}} '''Lauwick:''' She's still an idol to many people in Fontaine, including myself... I just think Lady Furina might feel a bit out of place in an amateur troupe like ours.
:{{DIcon}} You want the show to go ahead, don't you?
:{{DIcon}} Are you prepared to do whatever it takes?
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 1 lauwick 18.ogg}} '''Lauwick:''' Well yes, but... but...
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 1 lauwick 19.ogg}} '''Lauwick:''' Huh... Fair enough, I mean, if she was actually willing to, then of course I'd be honored to have Lady Furina star in our show. I'm sure the rest of the troupe would be delighted too.
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 1 lauwick 20.ogg}} '''Lauwick:''' I'm sure everyone in our troupe has probably dreamt of performing on stage with her one day.
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 1 lauwick 21.ogg}} '''Lauwick:''' Of course, it all depends on whether she's interested... She might consider this opportunity beneath her...
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 1 paimon 20.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' No point stressing about that. We'll only know if we ask her.
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 1 paimon 21.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' And besides, things are different now. There's no reason for her to be all high and mighty anymore.
:{{DIcon}} Let's go. It'll be good to check in on her anyway.
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 1 lauwick 22.ogg}} '''Lauwick:''' Thank you for your help... I guess I'll just stay here and wait for the good news. Good luck!
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 1 paimon 22.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' ...Wait, where does Furina actually live nowadays? She used to live in luxury at the Palais Mermonia, but she's, uh... moved out, right?
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 1 katheryne 09.ogg}} '''Katheryne:''' As it happens, I have her current address here. I can provide it to you.
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 1 paimon 23.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Whoa, when did you get here!?
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 1 katheryne 10.ogg}} '''Katheryne:''' Hehe, I came over when things were starting to sound more promising. I thought I should be at the ready in case my assistance is needed.
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 1 katheryne 11.ogg}} '''Katheryne:''' It is my duty to support commissioners in any way I can.
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 1 lauwick 23.ogg}} '''Lauwick:''' Thank you, Ma'am... Thank you so much.
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 1 paimon 24.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Well, now that we've got the address, we'll go find Furina. Back in a jiffy!

:{{A|vo dialog fnnlq001 katheryne 01.ogg}} '''Katheryne:''' Try not to worry. May I pour you a glass of water?

:{{A|vo fnnlq001 2 furina 08.ogg}} '''Furina:''' Pff, not yet, maybe, but... Anyway! What are you even doing here? I do hope you didn't come here just to ogle at my fall from grace?
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 2 furina 09.ogg}} '''Furina:''' Let me first be clear that I'm not taking guests at this time. So if you're just here to clown around, then please be on your way! Shoo!
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 2 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Sorry, we're sorry! Please don't be mad!
:{{DIcon}} Paimon was just showing concern for your wellbeing.
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 2 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yeah, exactly. What {{Traveler}} said! Paimon wasn't trying to make fun of you.
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 2 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' ...Hang on a sec, you weren't exactly holding back either!
:{{DIcon}} That's not important.
:{{DIcon}} We actually came here to ask you for your help...
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 2 furina 10.ogg}} '''Furina:''' My help, hmm? Well, maybe you're forgetting that I'm no longer the mighty Hydro Archon. I don't even have a Vision, you know.
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 2 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Don't worry, it's nothing that serious! It's just very specific, and you're the one with the power to help.
:{{DIcon}} If not you, then no one.
:{{DIcon}} You're the only person for the job.
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 2 furina 11.ogg}} '''Furina:''' Oh? Well, if that's the case, then... fine, I'll spare you the lecture about your attitude just now.
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 2 furina 12.ogg}} '''Furina:''' So tell me. What, specifically, makes this matter so... specific?
:{{Black Screen|You tell Furina about the troupe's plans for its final performance.}}
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 2 furina 13.ogg}} '''Furina:''' Ah, I see... I knew you couldn't have come all this way just to amuse yourselves at my expense.
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 2 furina 14.ogg}} '''Furina:''' After all, I was once the brightest star in all of Fontaine, well-versed in all the various performing arts. A mere musical is well within my capabilities...
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 2 furina 15.ogg}} '''Furina:''' ...But given the present circumstances, I'm afraid I must regretfully decline your casting request.
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 2 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' How come? It sounds like this'd be a breeze for you.
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 2 furina 16.ogg}} '''Furina:''' True, but I have made a decision to retire from the stage.
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 2 furina 17.ogg}} '''Furina:''' Although I am no longer required to play the role of the Hydro Archon, the time I spent inhabiting that character has left an indelible mark on me.
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 2 furina 18.ogg}} '''Furina:''' Centuries of pretending to be a different person changes you completely. I'm not the same person I once was.
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 2 furina 19.ogg}} '''Furina:''' Of course, that can't be undone now. It's too late, and I have no intention of reinventing myself all over again.
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 2 furina 20.ogg}} '''Furina:''' But at least I can say that I no longer desire to play any new roles.
:{{DIcon}} So that's how you really feel...
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 2 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Paimon can understand...
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 2 paimon 12.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' But this is just a one-off part to fill in for someone who's sick. Surely that's okay?
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 2 furina 21.ogg}} '''Furina:''' Whether it's a one-off or not, it's a boundary that I've committed to no longer cross.
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 2 furina 22.ogg}} '''Furina:''' If I make an exception to the rule now, I'm just leaving a backdoor for myself. Which would be the same as not having a boundary in the first place.
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 2 furina 23.ogg}} '''Furina:''' So I'm not going to perform, and that is that.
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 2 paimon 13.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Okay, guess there's no convincing you... Well, is there anything else we can do to help out the troupe? Otherwise, they'll just have to disband without any fanfare...
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 2 paimon 14.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Do you know any other actors who might be interested in the role?
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 2 furina 24.ogg}} '''Furina:''' Nope.
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 2 paimon 15.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Short and to the point, okay...
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 2 furina 25.ogg}} '''Furina:''' I've never been great at maintaining relationships. Besides, anyone I've ever worked with probably couldn't wait to get rid of me...
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 2 furina 26.ogg}} '''Furina:''' Since I'm just an ordinary person now. They'll probably just laugh in my face if I go asking them for help...
:{{DIcon}} You shouldn't assume the worst of people.
::{{A|vo fnnlq001 2 furina 27a 1.ogg}} '''Furina:''' True, but.. I mean, could you even blame them? I show up out of the blue, begging and groveling for their help with a show they won't even get paid for? ...*shudders* No way, I'm dying from embarassment just thinking about it. Nope, not happening!
:{{DIcon}} What's wrong with making one exception?
::{{A|vo fnnlq001 2 furina 27b 1.ogg}} '''Furina:''' Look, I'm sorry, okay!? I'm sorry I drew a line in the sand without thinking about every possible grain on the other side!
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 2 paimon 16.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Well... Is there anything else we can do? This performance really means a lot to the guy we're working for...
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 2 furina 28.ogg}} '''Furina:''' Have I not made myself clear? You're barking up the wrong tree. I don't want this job, nor do I know of anyone else who would.
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 2 furina 29.ogg}} '''Furina:''' ...Sorry, I didn't mean for that to sound so harsh. I wish I could help, really. But if I thought I had the answer to this problem, I would've said so by now.
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 2 paimon 17.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' It's alright, Furina. Paimon just wanted to make sure we tried everything. *sigh* Everyone in the troupe will be so disappointed...
:{{DIcon}} Let's try to come up with a plan B.
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 2 paimon 18.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yeah, guess that's all we can do now. Alright then, we'll see you around, Furina...
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 2 furina 30.ogg}} '''Furina:''' Toodle-oo to you too. I'm going home to take a rest now.
----
{{Dialogue End}}
{{Quest Description|update|Furina was unexpectedly unyielding in her opposition to performing, so all you can do is return to the Adventurers' Guild and tell them the truth.}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(While walking back to the Adventurers' Guild)
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 3 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' It's too bad, but we have to respect Furina's decision.
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 3 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Maybe the thought of performing brings up too many painful memories now...

;(Approach the Adventurers' Guild)
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 3 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh? What's going on? Are they arguing?
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 3 dulphy 01.ogg}} '''Dulphy:''' ...That's besides the point. I'll ask you again. Why did you start looking for a replacement without my consent? When did I tell you I'm going to take a step back?
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 3 lauwick 01.ogg}} '''Lauwick:''' You didn't need to say it... We've known each other for how long now? We know the signs. But you never tell us about your illness even when it's clearly flaring up.
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 3 dulphy 02.ogg}} '''Dulphy:''' And that gives you the right to make a decision on my behalf?
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 3 katheryne 01.ogg}} '''Katheryne:''' Shortly after you left, the troupe's lead actress came to the Adventurers' Guild. She believes that she's healthy enough to perform.
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 3 katheryne 02.ogg}} '''Katheryne:''' Excuse me, but can you both take a moment to discuss something else for now? The adventurer assigned to your commission has returned.
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 3 lauwick 02.ogg}} '''Lauwick:''' Sorry, I was just dealing with a little misunderstanding. So, how did your conversation with Furina go?
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 3 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Sadly, it's a no from her. We tried to persuade her, but she wasn't having it. She doesn't want to play the role, for personal reasons.
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 3 lauwick 03.ogg}} '''Lauwick:''' I see... Well, circumstances have changed a little, so maybe that's not such bad news after all.
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 3 lauwick 04.ogg}} '''Lauwick:''' You see, our leading lady has just informed me that she's well enough to make it to the show after all. Staging the musical with the full original cast was always the dream, of course.
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 3 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, right... Sounds like everything worked itself out then.
:{{DIcon}} Imagine if we had managed to convince Furina to join...
:{{DIcon}} ...Only for her to find out she's no longer needed.
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 3 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yeah, she'd be livid! We'd get the scolding of a lifetime!
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 3 dulphy 03.ogg}} '''Dulphy:''' Geez... Is Lady Furina really so harsh with people?
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 3 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Only joking, calm down! ...So, uh, guess we can consider this case closed now, huh?
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 3 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Despite the fact that we failed to complete the commission... We were still racking our brains for ideas on the way back here, hehe.
:{{DIcon}} ...
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 3 lauwick 05.ogg}} '''Lauwick:''' *sigh* Look, there's no point arguing with you about this any more. You've made yourself very clear, so I'll stop looking for a replacement.
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 3 lauwick 06.ogg}} '''Lauwick:''' This is the last chance we have, though. If your illness flares up again, there won't be time to find anyone to replace you.
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 3 lauwick 07.ogg}} '''Lauwick:''' So, are you absolutely sure you'll be able to handle it? The whole team is putting everything they have into this final performance. We have to make sure it goes ahead.
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 3 dulphy 04.ogg}} '''Dulphy:''' Yes, I'm completely confident. I've been taking a new medication from the doctor, and it's working brilliantly. I'll definitely be able to tough it out until the performance day.
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 3 dulphy 05.ogg}} '''Dulphy:''' I share everyone's desire to commemorate all our years as a troupe with a proper farewell show. So the last thing I want is to be left out.
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 3 dulphy 06.ogg}} '''Dulphy:''' Every one of us thinks of this troupe as their home. Myself included.
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 3 lauwick 08.ogg}} '''Lauwick:''' You're right. I'm sorry — I let myself get too worried about the show. I should have asked for your permission first.
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 3 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hehe, all's well that ends well! Sounds like the show will go on.
:{{DIcon}} Paimon, wait here a second.
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 3 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Uh... Sure.
:;(The Traveler sees Furina hiding nearby and grabs her hand)
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 3 furina 01.ogg}} '''Furina:''' Hey, how did you... I—I was just passing by because... I realized I forgot a couple of items on my shopping list!
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 3 furina 02.ogg}} '''Furina:''' ...Alright, alright, I'm coming. No need to drag me!
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 3 furina 03.ogg}} '''Furina:''' Uh... Ahem, hello one and all. I couldn't help but overhear your conversation just now...
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 3 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Furina!? Didn't you say you were gonna take a rest at home? What are you doing here?
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 3 furina 04.ogg}} '''Furina:''' I... I was just ever so slightly concerned about the situation you mentioned. Yes. A teensy bit concerned, that's all.
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 3 furina 05.ogg}} '''Furina:''' When you came to talk with me earlier, I jumped right to explaining my position, and said some strongly worded things.
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 3 furina 06.ogg}} '''Furina:''' And all before I even had a full grasp of the situation... Anyway, I just feel a bit bad about how it went down.
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 3 furina 07.ogg}} '''Furina:''' I'm sorry, Paimon.
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 3 paimon 12.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, it's totally fine! Paimon didn't take any of that personally!
:{{DIcon}} Then why didn't you just show yourself?
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 3 furina 08.ogg}} '''Furina:''' ...You really have a knack for asking the most uncomfortable questions, don't you...
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 3 furina 09.ogg}} '''Furina:''' I felt very sheepish, having had a change of heart after flatly refusing you. And then, to make matters worse, you caught me...
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 3 furina 10.ogg}} '''Furina:''' But in any case, it sounds like the issue has already been resolved?
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 3 lauwick 09.ogg}} '''Lauwick:''' Yeah... When they said they were gonna ask for your help, I almost had a heart attack. I mean, how could we be worthy of having Lady Furina star in our show?
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 3 furina 11.ogg}} '''Furina:''' There's no need to think like that, and no need to keep addressing me as "Lady." Just "Furina" is fine.
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 3 furina 12.ogg}} '''Furina:''' I was wondering... if this troupe is so important to all of you, why does it have to disband?
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 3 furina 13.ogg}} '''Furina:''' If the difficulties are purely financial, then there must be a solution. You could put the shows on pause while you look for a sponsor, for instance.
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 3 furina 14.ogg}} '''Furina:''' Everyone seems so devoted to the troupe. I'm sure if you keep chipping away, you'll find a way through.
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 3 dulphy 07.ogg}} '''Dulphy:''' *sigh* We all want to believe that, but... Some things are just beyond our control.
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 3 dulphy 08.ogg}} '''Dulphy:''' ...Everything's been going downhill ever since we lost our director. She was the heart and soul of our troupe. She kept us going.
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 3 lauwick 10.ogg}} '''Lauwick:''' Her name was [[Aurelie]], and she was the founder as well as artistic director of our troupe. And tragically, she... was a victim in the serial disappearances case.
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 3 furina 15.ogg}} '''Furina:''' What?
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 3 lauwick 11.ogg}} '''Lauwick:''' That's actually how I recognized these two. It was all thanks to their efforts that the true culprit was brought to justice.
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 3 lauwick 12.ogg}} '''Lauwick:''' *sigh* But still... No sentence can bring our director back to us.
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 3 dulphy 09.ogg}} '''Dulphy:''' She was a loyal fan of your performances, Lady— Uh, Miss Furina. They were what first inspired her to get into musical theater.
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 3 dulphy 10.ogg}} '''Dulphy:''' She rallied many people around her who were destitute or had lost their sense of purpose in life, and convinced them to join her troupe. She wrote her own scripts, acted on stage, and mentored each and every one of us.
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 3 dulphy 11.ogg}} '''Dulphy:''' People loved our performances back then... We seemed to be going from strength to strength. Things were really looking up for us...
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 3 furina 16.ogg}} '''Furina:''' And then, disaster struck...
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 3 lauwick 13.ogg}} '''Lauwick:''' Yeah. After that, the entire troupe fell into disarray.
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 3 lauwick 14.ogg}} '''Lauwick:''' None of us know anything about scriptwriting, let alone how to handle the business side of things. We've been doing the best we can, but despite our efforts, things are slowly but surely falling apart.
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 3 lauwick 15.ogg}} '''Lauwick:''' It's agonizing, but ultimately, we'd rather end things now on our own terms than stick it out to the bitter end and watch all our dreams turn to dust.
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 3 paimon 13.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh...
:{{DIcon}} That's so sad...
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 3 furina 17.ogg}} '''Furina:''' What a terrible waste... A gifted artist from humble beginnings, who achieved so much and no doubt had much more to give... and then her life was so cruelly taken.
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 3 furina 18.ogg}} '''Furina:''' I suppose it's fair to say, then, that this final show, besides being your farewell to the stage, is also your final gift for her?
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 3 dulphy 12.ogg}} '''Dulphy:''' Yes, exactly. We all miss her terribly.
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 3 furina 19.ogg}} '''Furina:''' Well, good thing I followed the Traveler here. After hearing this tragic tale, I can no longer stand by and do nothing.
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 3 paimon 14.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Uh... Furina?
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 3 furina 20.ogg}} '''Furina:''' I know what you're thinking, but I by no means plan to cross the boundary I've set for myself. Besides, they're no longer looking for a replacement anyway.
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 3 furina 21.ogg}} '''Furina:''' I can, however, provide some artistic guidance from the vantage point of a highly experienced audience member.
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 3 furina 22.ogg}} '''Furina:''' But only if you feel this is something that would help, of course.
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 3 dulphy 13.ogg}} '''Dulphy:''' Oh, most definitely! We'll take any guidance that you can give!
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 3 lauwick 16.ogg}} '''Lauwick:''' We unfortunately don't have any budget for a consultant, though... Will that be a problem?
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 3 furina 23.ogg}} '''Furina:''' I don't need any compensation. All I'd ask in return, if you're willing, is that you tell me some more about the life and work of your late director.
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 3 furina 24.ogg}} '''Furina:''' Something I've begun to realize since my departure from the Opera Epiclese is that there's a lot you don't see when you observe everything from on high.
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 3 furina 25.ogg}} '''Furina:''' The law only judges criminal behavior, and does not weigh human emotion. The court's verdict can settle the question of criminal liability, but...
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 3 furina 26.ogg}} '''Furina:''' What about all the unresolved emotions of the parties involved? What happens to them?
:{{DIcon}} A verdict can bring emotional catharsis.
:{{DIcon}} They come pouring out, and flow away into infinity.
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 3 furina 27.ogg}} '''Furina:''' An interesting answer. But if you ask me, I think all emotion shall ultimately return home to the heart, and slowly settle with the passage of time.
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 3 furina 28.ogg}} '''Furina:''' Take, par exemple, how this troupe pines for their late director... Things such as this I have never witnessed before. And so, I should like to observe, perchance to understand.
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 3 paimon 15.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Uhh... Still a fan of your old dramatic monologues then, huh?
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 3 paimon 16.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You just wanna get back in on the action, don't you?
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 3 furina 29.ogg}} '''Furina:''' No, no, no, this is a completely different situation! Hmph, pearls before swine...
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 3 paimon 17.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' The name's not "Swine," it's Paimon!
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 3 furina 30.ogg}} '''Furina:''' Would you be willing to join me? C'mon, take a break from adventuring to listen to a story.
:{{DIcon}} Since it's you, I'll do it.
:{{DIcon}} Especially since it's related to the serial disappearances case.
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 3 lauwick 17.ogg}} '''Lauwick:''' Thank you all so much. Our director was a huge fan of Miss Furina's performances... as, of course, we all are.
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 3 lauwick 18.ogg}} '''Lauwick:''' Alright, follow me. We'll go to our usual practice space. Please excuse the size — it's a little on the smaller side.
----
{{Dialogue End}}
{{Quest Description|update|Furina was unexpectedly unyielding in her opposition to performing, so all you could do was return to the Adventurers' Guild and tell them the truth. However, she actually followed you back, and chooses to participate in the performance as a consultant...}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Enter the rehearsal location)
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 4 buraud 01.ogg}} '''Buraud:''' Huh? L—Lady Furina!?
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 4 elain 01.ogg}} '''Elain:''' What's Lady Furina doing here?
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 4 lauwick 01.ogg}} '''Lauwick:''' Hello, all. Allow me to explain. As of today, La— Uh, Miss Furina will be supporting our production of "The Little Oceanid" in the role of artistic consultant.
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 4 lauwick 02.ogg}} '''Lauwick:''' These two over here are the ones that made it possible — they kindly reached out to Miss Furina on our behalf. I'm sure they need no introduction.
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 4 buraud 02.ogg}} '''Buraud:''' You bet! That was the trial of the century!
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 4 elain 02.ogg}} '''Elain:''' You helped bring our director's murderer to justice. We can't thank you enough.
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 4 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, please don't mention it. We're just here to join in on the fun.
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 4 furina 01.ogg}} '''Furina:''' So, you were saying — "The Little Oceanid"...?
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 4 dulphy 01.ogg}} '''Dulphy:''' Yeah, that's the name of our final show. It's an unfinished script left behind by our director.
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 4 dulphy 02.ogg}} '''Dulphy:''' One of our greatest regrets is that she never got to complete it. So if we can bring it to the stage and make it a successful show, we can all take some solace in that.
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 4 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wait, but if it's not finished, then...
:{{DIcon}} Finding an actress was the least of your problems...
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 4 lauwick 03.ogg}} '''Lauwick:''' Yeah, we've been battling issues on every front trying to realize this dream... Anyway, let me give you a quick summary of what the story's all about.
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 4 lauwick 04.ogg}} '''Lauwick:''' The protagonist of the story is a young Oceanid who transforms herself into human form, despite the protests of her family.
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 4 lauwick 05.ogg}} '''Lauwick:''' She longed to live just like any other human. And sure enough, she found friendship and even love. Everything seemed perfect.
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 4 lauwick 06.ogg}} '''Lauwick:''' But one day, her true identity was exposed, and her world came crashing down around her...
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 4 furina 02.ogg}} '''Furina:''' So far, so good. A classic tale. What happened after that?
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 4 dulphy 03.ogg}} '''Dulphy:''' That's one of the issues we've been trying to deal with... Unfortunately, this was as far as the director got with her script.
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 4 dulphy 04.ogg}} '''Dulphy:''' We need a proper ending so we can bring this musical to the stage, but people have different opinions on which direction to take it in.
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 4 lauwick 07.ogg}} '''Lauwick:''' We still haven't decided between a happy ending or a true-to-life tragedy.
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 4 furina 03.ogg}} '''Furina:''' By true-to-life, you mean... the director's sudden disappearance?
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 4 dulphy 05.ogg}} '''Dulphy:''' Yeah. Like they say, truth is stranger than fiction.
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 4 dulphy 06.ogg}} '''Dulphy:''' But then there's the question of whether we really want to use the stage to pass our raw pain onto the audience.
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 4 lauwick 08.ogg}} '''Lauwick:''' Exactly. A lot of the time, people come to watch a show just hoping for some light entertainment. We have to consider their emotional stake in this, not just our own.
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 4 lauwick 09.ogg}} '''Lauwick:''' And one last thing — we're still waiting on confirmation from two of our main actors.
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 4 lauwick 10.ogg}} '''Lauwick:''' The first is [[Pauleau]], who plays the protagonist's lover. He's locked himself away to focus on writing and ending for the script. But the deadline's past and we still haven't heard from him.
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 4 lauwick 11.ogg}} '''Lauwick:''' The other is [[Vilmant]], who plays the main antagonist. He took the director's death pretty hard. Hasn't set foot in the city since.
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 4 lauwick 12.ogg}} '''Lauwick:''' He did write to us, promising that he'll be there for the final performance, but we haven't seen or heard from him since. So we're not really sure what to make of that.
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 4 dulphy 07.ogg}} '''Dulphy:''' Although... Now that we have Miss Furina helping us, maybe we should take the opportunity to get everyone back together?
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 4 furina 04.ogg}} '''Furina:''' What opportunity? What do you mean?
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 4 dulphy 08.ogg}} '''Dulphy:''' Hehe, maybe you're unaware, but your name has always been like a rallying cry for us.
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 4 lauwick 13.ogg}} '''Lauwick:''' Our director was constantly singing your praises. All of us look up to you as a role model.
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 4 furina 05.ogg}} '''Furina:''' Oh stop, you're making me all flustered. Although... hehe, not in a bad way.
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 4 furina 06.ogg}} '''Furina:''' I suspect the reason they're dragging their feet is that they have their doubts about whether the show will really go ahead, considering all the issues you've been facing.
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 4 furina 07.ogg}} '''Furina:''' But one by one, all the obstacles are being removed. Now is the time to rally the troops.
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 4 dulphy 09.ogg}} '''Dulphy:''' Makes sense... Okay, priority number one — let's check in with Pauleau and see where he's at with the ending.
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 4 dulphy 10.ogg}} '''Dulphy:''' He went back to Poisson a few days ago. Said that staying in a friend's home might help him to relax, and escape the feeling of isolation.
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 4 lauwick 14.ogg}} '''Lauwick:''' I thought the last thing his friend would want right now would be to take visitors, given that Poisson was flooded not too long ago. But I guess it's the opposite — a friend in need, and all that.
:{{A|vo fnnlq001 4 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yeah, maybe he could use some company.

==Dialogue==
{{Quest Description|Unexpectedly, this old couple's child is the [[Tenryou Commission]]'s [[Imatani Keisuke]], an old acquaintance of [[Sakujirou]]'s. However, the two of them once had a sharp disagreement, and so [[Yoimiya]] is unable to use this prior relationship to help Sakujirou out of his bind. As the Tenryou Commission closes in on [[Naganohara Fireworks]], Yoimiya fears that Sakujirou will forever forfeit his chance to fulfill his wish...}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Talk to [[Naganohara Ryuunosuke]])
:{{A|vo dialog xglq004 naganohararyuunosuke 01.ogg}} '''Naganohara Ryuunosuke:''' Things aren't boding well for Sakujirou.
:{{A|vo dialog xglq004 naganohararyuunosuke 02.ogg}} '''Naganohara Ryuunosuke:''' If only there was something we could do...

;(Talk to [[Morihiko]])
:{{A|vo dialog xglq004 morihiko 01.ogg}} '''Morihiko:''' ... Be careful.
:{{A|vo dialog xglq004 morihiko 02.ogg}} '''Morihiko:''' This is the Tenryou Commission we're talking about. Please, don't do anything you might live to regret.

----
;(Upon spotting the children)
:{{A|vo xglq004 1 yoimiya 01.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' It's [[Matsuzaka]] and his friends! Let's ask them!

;(Approach the children)
:{{A|vo xglq004 1 matsuzaka 01.ogg}} '''Matsuzaka:''' Hi, Yoimiya! Are the weapons to scare away the Great Mujina Youkai ready yet?
:{{A|vo xglq004 1 yoimiya 02.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' Oh, Mr. Ryuunosuke is making them right now. You can go collect them from my house later.
:{{A|vo xglq004 1 saika 01.ogg}} '''Saika:''' Uh... Aren't you gonna play with us, Yoimiya?
:{{A|vo xglq004 1 yoimiya 03.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' I'm sorry, I have something important to do right now. I'll be back later on.
:{{A|vo xglq004 1 yoimiya 04.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' ...But I'll bring you guys some candy next time! The extra-sweet candy, the one you guys love.
:{{A|vo xglq004 1 iwao 01.ogg}} '''Iwao:''' Yay-ay! We're gonna get candy, woohoo.
:{{A|vo xglq004 1 yoimiya 05.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' Also, I wanted to ask you guys something. Did you see a bunch of scary-looking men come by here, at all?
:{{A|vo xglq004 1 saika 02.ogg}} '''Saika:''' Yep, we did! It looked like they were chasing someone!
:{{A|vo xglq004 1 iwao 02.ogg}} '''Iwao:''' Are they trying to catch a monster, too?
:{{A|vo xglq004 1 yoimiya 06.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' No, don't worry. It's all just a big misunderstanding.
:{{A|vo xglq004 1 yoimiya 07.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' Be good kids and stay out of trouble, alright? Stay in the city for now, and I'll come play with you after the fireworks start.
:{{A|vo xglq004 1 matsuzaka 02.ogg}} '''Matsuzaka:''' We will! We'll be on our best behavior, especially for you, Yoimiya!

;(After talking with the children)
:{{A|vo xglq004 1 yoimiya 08.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' It looks like this is the right way. Let's keep going!
:{{A|vo xglq004 1 yoimiya 09.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' If Sakujirou still hasn't made up his mind, I guess I'll have to step in...
----
;(Upon spotting the Tenryou Commission officers)
:{{A|vo xglq004 1 yoimiya 10.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' Look, there are people from the Tenryou Commission over there! That must be them.

;(Approach the officers)
:{{A|vo xglq004 2 yoshitaka 01.ogg}} '''Yoshitaka:''' Sorry, official business. I can't let you pass.
:{{A|vo xglq004 2 yoimiya 01.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' Sakujirou and Keisuke are up ahead, right? We need to talk to them about something.
:{{A|vo xglq004 2 yoshitaka 02.ogg}} '''Yoshitaka:''' Didn't you hear me? You're not getting past.
:{{A|vo xglq004 2 yoimiya 02.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' Ugh, what a nuisance! Well, you've only got yourself to blame!
----
;(After defeating the officers)
:{{A|vo xglq004 4 yoshitaka 01.ogg}} '''Yoshitaka:''' How dare you impede the work of the Tenryou Commission!
:{{A|vo xglq004 4 yoshitaka 02.ogg}} '''Yoshitaka:''' You will be punished for your actions!
:{{A|vo xglq004 4 yoshitaka 03.ogg}} '''Yoshitaka:''' There is nowhere you can escape justice, not even at the edges of the world!
:{{A|vo xglq004 4 yoimiya 01.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' Look at that — the one with the loudest mouth had the fastest feet.
:{{A|vo xglq004 4 yoimiya 02.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' We can't waste any more time on these guys. Let's push on, they should be just ahead.
----
;(Approach Sakujirou and Keisuke)
:{{A|vo xglq004 5 sakujirou 01.ogg}} '''Sakujirou:''' *panting*... *panting*...
:{{A|vo xglq004 5 imatanikeisuke 01.ogg}} '''Imatani Keisuke:''' Your skills with the sword have stagnated, Sakujirou...
:{{A|vo xglq004 5 imatanikeisuke 02.ogg}} '''Imatani Keisuke:''' You should have known that you stood no choice against me in a duel.
:{{A|vo xglq004 5 sakujirou 02.ogg}} '''Sakujirou:''' I never imagined I'd fall into your hands.
:{{A|vo xglq004 5 sakujirou 03.ogg}} '''Sakujirou:''' ...
:{{A|vo xglq004 5 sakujirou 04.ogg}} '''Sakujirou:''' If this is to be my fate, I accept it. I have nothing else to say.
:{{A|vo xglq004 5 imatanikeisuke 03.ogg}} '''Imatani Keisuke:''' But your return says that you finally came around to my point of view.
:{{A|vo xglq004 5 sakujirou 05.ogg}} '''Sakujirou:''' Whatever you say.
:{{A|vo xglq004 5 imatanikeisuke 04.ogg}} '''Imatani Keisuke:''' You will return with me to the Tenryou Commission to await your sentencing.
:{{A|vo xglq004 5 imatanikeisuke 05.ogg}} '''Imatani Keisuke:''' The one who made this boat will also be punished.
:{{A|vo xglq004 5 yoimiya 01.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' Wait!
:{{A|vo xglq004 5 yoimiya 02.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' It doesn't have to end like this! Don't you have anything else to say to one another!?
:{{A|vo xglq004 5 imatanikeisuke 06.ogg}} '''Imatani Keisuke:''' Hey, I know you. You're Naganohara's girl, who makes the fireworks... Huh. I know you like to get involved in other people's business, but stay out of this. It does not concern you.
:{{A|vo xglq004 5 sakujirou 06.ogg}} '''Sakujirou:''' It's okay, Yoimiya. The past is the past.
:{{A|vo xglq004 5 yoimiya 03.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' Then why did you risk life and limb to get yourself back into Inazuma!? And why were you so reluctant to leave after you got here!?
:{{A|vo xglq004 5 yoimiya 04.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' I'll tell you why, this is why! This is the chance you've been waiting for, to talk everything through!
:{{A|vo xglq004 5 imatanikeisuke 07.ogg}} '''Imatani Keisuke:''' I have nothing to say to him.
:{{A|vo xglq004 5 imatanikeisuke 08.ogg}} '''Imatani Keisuke:''' He's a criminal, I work for the Tenryou Commission. There was never any room for discussion.
:{{A|vo xglq004 5 imatanikeisuke 09.ogg}} '''Imatani Keisuke:''' Out of respect for the friendship we once had, I gave him a chance to fight for his freedom. But his skills with the sword are as disappointing now as they ever were.
:{{A|vo xglq004 5 yoimiya 05.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' What are you talking about? And just who do you think you're kidding!?
:{{A|vo xglq004 5 yoimiya 06.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' You left all your subordinates back there to guard the road, making sure no one else followed you here. Seems to me like you were hoping for a chance to talk.
:{{A|vo xglq004 5 yoimiya 07.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' I can see it in your faces. You both have so much to say... and you're just gonna choose to keep it all inside?
:{{A|vo xglq004 5 imatanikeisuke 10.ogg}} '''Imatani Keisuke:''' ...
:{{A|vo xglq004 5 imatanikeisuke 11.ogg}} '''Imatani Keisuke:''' Don't flatter yourself. What would you know?
:{{A|vo xglq004 5 sakujirou 07.ogg}} '''Sakujirou:''' Yoimiya, leave it. It was just my wishful thinking.
:{{A|vo xglq004 5 yoimiya 08.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' No, I won't leave it! I will not stand by and watch when you haven't even done anything!
:{{A|vo xglq004 5 yoimiya 09.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' Keisuke, you seem to like settling things with a duel. So let's do it your way! I challenge you to a duel!
:{{A|vo xglq004 5 yoimiya 10.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' If I win, then you need to say everything that's in your heart. No more running from your feelings!
:{{A|vo xglq004 5 yoimiya 11.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' And the same goes for you, Sakujirou! If I win, you will tell Keisuke exactly why you came back. No matter what the consequences are. You have to tell him everything!
:{{A|vo xglq004 5 yoimiya 12.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' If you don't say anything now, you may never have another chance!
:{{A|vo xglq004 5 imatanikeisuke 12.ogg}} '''Imatani Keisuke:''' And if you lose?
:{{A|vo xglq004 5 yoimiya 13.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' Then I'll admit to collaborating with Sakujirou and accept the Tenryou Commission's punishment!
:{{A|vo xglq004 5 sakujirou 08.ogg}} '''Sakujirou:''' Yoimiya...
:{{A|vo xglq004 5 imatanikeisuke 13.ogg}} '''Imatani Keisuke:''' I accept. Let's settle this with a duel.
----
;(At the start of the duel)
:{{A|vo xglq004 5 yoshitaka 01.ogg}} '''Yoshitaka:''' Sir, we're here to back you up!
:{{A|vo xglq004 5 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Backup!? Duels are supposed to be one on one!
:{{A|vo xglq004 5 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Alright, that's it, let's help Yoimiya! We can't let her fight them all alone!
----
;(After defeating Keisuke)
:{{A|vo xglq004 7 yoshitaka 01a.ogg}} '''Yoshitaka:''' Sir, they are too strong. We need more men...
:{{A|vo xglq004 7 imatanikeisuke 01.ogg}} '''Imatani Keisuke:''' Stand down.
:{{A|vo xglq004 7 yoshitaka 02.ogg}} '''Yoshitaka:''' Wh—What?
:{{A|vo xglq004 7 imatanikeisuke 02.ogg}} '''Imatani Keisuke:''' I thought I told you to stay away! Now, stand down!
:{{A|vo xglq004 7 yoshitaka 03.ogg}} '''Yoshitaka:''' Y—Yes, Sir... Sorry!
:{{Black Screen|''Yoshitaka leaves in a panic.''}}
:{{A|vo xglq004 7 imatanikeisuke 03.ogg}} '''Imatani Keisuke:''' Young lady, you are just as obstinate as Sakujirou was back then.
:{{A|vo xglq004 7 imatanikeisuke 04.ogg}} '''Imatani Keisuke:''' Why were you so convinced that we had things to say to each other?
:{{A|vo xglq004 7 yoimiya 01.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' Because... Sakujirou may not have told me about you when he came back, but he did order a firework from me.
:{{A|vo xglq004 7 yoimiya 02.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' Then, your parents told me what happened between you when you were younger. Once I'd heard the story, I realized that the firework meant something special to you both.
:{{A|vo xglq004 7 yoimiya 03.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' And that's why I simply refuse to believe that you have nothing to say to each other!
:{{A|vo xglq004 7 yoimiya 04.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' Nobody sets off a firework to feel lonely, do they...
:{{A|vo xglq004 7 imatanikeisuke 05.ogg}} '''Imatani Keisuke:''' ...
:{{A|vo xglq004 7 sakujirou 01.ogg}} '''Sakujirou:''' The reason I came back is that... I felt lost.
:{{A|vo xglq004 7 sakujirou 02.ogg}} '''Sakujirou:''' It wasn't that I'd changed my mind, I just felt that what I'd done in the past was to try to escape from reality.
:{{A|vo xglq004 7 sakujirou 03.ogg}} '''Sakujirou:''' I saw the freedom of [[Mondstadt]], the contracts of [[Liyue]], the wisdom of [[Sumeru]], and the justice of [[Fontaine]]... It all left a deep impression on me.
:{{A|vo xglq004 7 sakujirou 04.ogg}} '''Sakujirou:''' I was glad that I'd left Inazuma. But then I happened to hear about the [[Sakoku Decree]].
:{{A|vo xglq004 7 sakujirou 05.ogg}} '''Sakujirou:''' I was an escapee, and I was proud of that. But really, what I should have tried to do is take the good things from the outside world and bring them back home.
:{{A|vo xglq004 7 imatanikeisuke 06.ogg}} '''Imatani Keisuke:''' So that's why you came back? Out of your naive hope of changing the way things are here?
:{{A|vo xglq004 7 sakujirou 06.ogg}} '''Sakujirou:''' No, I let go of those delusions of grandeur. I just felt that... I never should have run away like that...
:{{A|vo xglq004 7 sakujirou 07.ogg}} '''Sakujirou:''' After all, you never ran away.
:{{A|vo xglq004 7 imatanikeisuke 07.ogg}} '''Imatani Keisuke:''' ...!
:{{A|vo xglq004 7 sakujirou 08.ogg}} '''Sakujirou:''' I don't know about you, but life hasn't been easy for me.
:{{A|vo xglq004 7 sakujirou 09.ogg}} '''Sakujirou:''' But I just had to come back and visit. It was like fate was calling me, and I couldn't ignore it any longer.
:{{A|vo xglq004 7 imatanikeisuke 08.ogg}} '''Imatani Keisuke:''' ...Life isn't easy for anyone.
:{{A|vo xglq004 7 imatanikeisuke 09.ogg}} '''Imatani Keisuke:''' I truly worship the [[Raiden Shogun]]. Her ideas are my personal creed, and I desire nothing more than to see her will done.
:{{A|vo xglq004 7 imatanikeisuke 10.ogg}} '''Imatani Keisuke:''' But now, my role is to punish violators of the Sakoku Decree and confiscate people's Visions. It's not what I signed up for when I joined the Tenryou Commission...
:{{A|vo xglq004 7 imatanikeisuke 11.ogg}} '''Imatani Keisuke:''' I do wonder... Am I really doing the right thing?
:<!--{{A|vo xglq004 7 imatanikeisuke 12.ogg}} <!--no sound here -->'''Imatani Keisuke:''' ...
:<!--no sound-->'''Sakujirou:''' ...
:{{A|vo xglq004 7 imatanikeisuke 13.ogg}} '''Imatani Keisuke:''' The boat is yours.
:{{A|vo xglq004 7 sakujirou 11.ogg}} '''Sakujirou:''' Huh?
:{{A|vo xglq004 7 imatanikeisuke 14.ogg}} '''Imatani Keisuke:''' I couldn't make you stay in Inazuma, but that doesn't mean I want to keep you here by force.
:{{A|vo xglq004 7 sakujirou 12.ogg}} '''Sakujirou:''' What will you say to the higher-ups?
:{{A|vo xglq004 7 imatanikeisuke 15.ogg}} '''Imatani Keisuke:''' Don't worry about that. I'll handle it.
:{{A|vo xglq004 7 imatanikeisuke 16.ogg}} '''Imatani Keisuke:''' If you wanna come back, I hear that the process of returning to Inazuma from the outside world is long and complicated. But it can be done.
:{{A|vo xglq004 7 imatanikeisuke 17.ogg}} '''Imatani Keisuke:''' I will lend you my help. But until then, wait for me out there.
:{{A|vo xglq004 7 imatanikeisuke 18.ogg}} '''Imatani Keisuke:''' ...And don't kick the bucket on the way out.
:{{A|vo xglq004 7 sakujirou 13.ogg}} '''Sakujirou:''' Don't worry, Keisuke.
:{{A|vo xglq004 7 sakujirou 14.ogg}} '''Sakujirou:''' Any chance we could watch the fireworks together?
:{{A|vo xglq004 7 imatanikeisuke 19.ogg}} '''Imatani Keisuke:''' Mm. Maybe next time.
:{{Black Screen|''Sakujirou's boat departs in inscrutable silence...''}}
:{{A|vo xglq004 7 imatanikeisuke 20.ogg}} '''Imatani Keisuke:''' *sigh* I'll be demoted for sure...
:{{A|vo xglq004 7 imatanikeisuke 21.ogg}} '''Imatani Keisuke:''' It's not like me to give in to childish sentiment like this. I can't explain why I went through with it.
:{{DIcon}} That boat...
:{{A|vo xglq004 7 imatanikeisuke 22.ogg}} '''Imatani Keisuke:''' It's the one that Sakujirou planned on using for his escape. I asked Yoshitaka and the others to transport it here, citing the Temporary Contraband Storage clause.
:{{A|vo xglq004 7 imatanikeisuke 23.ogg}} '''Imatani Keisuke:''' Forcing Sakujirou to this spot was also something I had planned all along.
:{{A|vo xglq004 7 imatanikeisuke 24.ogg}} '''Imatani Keisuke:''' It's just like you said, Yoimiya. Even thought I hadn't fully made up my mind, my actions betrayed my intent...
:{{A|vo xglq004 7 yoimiya 05.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' But I think you did the right thing. And look, now you've managed to resolve the grievance in your heart by talking about it.
:{{A|vo xglq004 7 imatanikeisuke 25.ogg}} '''Imatani Keisuke:''' I understand now, thank you. I didn't know you were quite so perceptive — you saw right into what I was thinking.
:{{A|vo xglq004 7 yoimiya 06.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' Hehe, that's only because I know your parents so well. They're both really nice people, so I didn't think the apple would fall too far from the tree.
:{{A|vo xglq004 7 imatanikeisuke 26.ogg}} '''Imatani Keisuke:''' I had heard that there was a new Naganohara running things these days. A little loud and reckless, maybe but... You live up to the family name.
:{{A|vo xglq004 7 imatanikeisuke 27.ogg}} '''Imatani Keisuke:''' By the way, Naganohara Fireworks can reproduce the firework that the two of us set off back then, right Would you be able to make one for me?
:{{A|vo xglq004 7 yoimiya 07.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' Sorry, no can do. Without the slip for reference, I can't make the same one again, and I'm afraid Sakujirou is the one with the slip.
:{{A|vo xglq004 7 imatanikeisuke 28.ogg}} '''Imatani Keisuke:''' Ah, I see...
:{{A|vo xglq004 7 imatanikeisuke 29.ogg}} '''Imatani Keisuke:''' Never mind, then.
:{{A|vo xglq004 7 yoimiya 08.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' Hehe, don't get too down just yet, though — I mentioned that Sakujirou ordered a firework from me, didn't I?
:{{A|vo xglq004 7 yoimiya 09.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' I can't make another one, but I'm guessing Sakujirou probably won't be needing his anymore... It'd be a shame for it to go to waste, so I'll make an exception and let you set it off instead.
:{{A|vo xglq004 7 imatanikeisuke 30.ogg}} '''Imatani Keisuke:''' ...Thank you very much.
:{{A|vo xglq004 7 yoimiya 10.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' No worries. And don't miss out on the start of the fireworks show.
:{{Black Screen|''Imatani Keisuke also leaves.''}}
:{{A|vo xglq004 7 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yoimiya, the way you took command of that whole situation was amazing!
:{{A|vo xglq004 7 yoimiya 11.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' What can I say — I like to talk. I'm a strong believer in the power of words.
:{{A|vo xglq004 7 yoimiya 12.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' If you're not willing to communicate, then the problem just sits there. If you just keep staring at it without doing anything, eventually you'll watch every last opportunity to resolve it slip away before your eyes.
:{{A|vo xglq004 7 yoimiya 13.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' Sakujirou and Keisuke can't turn back the clock in their relationship, but... that's no reason to live with remorse.
:{{A|vo xglq004 7 yoimiya 14.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' Anyway, follow me. I'll bring you to the perfect place to watch the fireworks.
:{{A|vo xglq004 7 yoimiya 15.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' My pops will set off the firework that I wanted to give to you.
{{Cutscene Description|The fireworks blossom profusely in the skies over Inazuma City. Sakujirou, rowing his small boat alone, cannot help but weep as his gaze chances upon a familiar fire-flower. The instigator of this affair, Yoimiya, ever the chatterbox on the road here, is uncharacteristically silent, observing the fleeting panorama of beauty thoughtfully.}}
;(A cutscene plays)
:;(Sakujirou paddles away in his small boat)
:;(There is a flash of light and he turns around to see a firework display)
::{{A|vo xglq004 cs sakujirou 01.ogg}} '''Sakujirou:''' It's...!
:;(A familiar firework sets off)
::{{A|vo xglq004 cs sakujirou 02.ogg}} '''Sakujirou:''' Keisuke...
:;(He begins to weep)
:;(Yoimiya, the Traveler and Paimon watch the fireworks from Amakane Island)
::{{A|vo xglq004 cs paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So, Yoimiya. These fireworks, what do they mean to you?
:;(Yoimiya is captivated by the show and does not respond)
::{{A|vo xglq004 cs paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yoimiya?
:;(The Traveler shushes Paimon)
:;(Paimon nods)
:;(Cutscene ends)
:{{A|vo xglq004 9 yoimiya 01.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' Ahh, that was amazing. It was so beautiful I could weep.
:{{A|vo xglq004 9 yoimiya 02.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' Uh, I didn't actually cry, though, right? I just feel a bit misty-eyed.
:{{DIcon}} It was very pretty.
:{{DIcon}} Once again, the Naganoharas live up to their name.
:{{A|vo xglq004 9 yoimiya 03.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' Oh, remember that big one that went up first? The gold one?
:{{A|vo xglq004 9 yoimiya 04.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' That's the one I had pops make for you.
:{{A|vo xglq004 9 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, Paimon saw it! It was one of the best ones, they won't forget that any time soon!
:{{A|vo xglq004 9 yoimiya 05.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' Haha, that's what I wanted to hear. I was hoping it would leave a deep impression on you guys.
:{{A|vo xglq004 9 yoimiya 06.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' No matter where your journey takes you, and no matter what hardships might lie ahead, I hope you'll always be able to look back fondly on the fireworks you saw tonight.
:{{A|vo xglq004 9 yoimiya 07.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' I believe that as time goes by, this firework will only grow brighter and more beautiful in your heart.
:{{A|vo xglq004 9 yoimiya 08.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' Oh, and also, you're technically my customers now. Here, this is your paper slip. If you ever wanna see that golden firework again, just come and see me.
:{{DIcon}} Thank you for the firework.
:{{DIcon}} Thank you for your kindness.
:{{A|vo xglq004 9 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You know, Yoimiya, you seemed to turn into a completely different person during the fireworks. You were so quiet, and it was like you couldn't hear anything it all.
:{{A|vo xglq004 9 yoimiya 09.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' Oh, I could hear you. I just have a habit of being silent while I'm watching fireworks.
:{{A|vo xglq004 9 yoimiya 10.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' Quietly watching something you made with your own hands rise into the sky, it feels like a sacred ceremony to me.
:{{A|vo xglq004 9 yoimiya 11.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' You asked me what fireworks mean to me, right?
:{{A|vo xglq004 9 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yup!
:{{A|vo xglq004 9 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Well, for Kouichi, who built that boat for us, and his friend, [[Third Sis]], fireworks commemorate friendship.
:{{A|vo xglq004 9 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' For Keisuke's parents, they commemorate marriage.
:{{A|vo xglq004 9 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' And for Keisuke and Sakujirou, they were commemorating... hmm.
:{{DIcon}} Unwavering beliefs, right?
:{{A|vo xglq004 9 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh yeah, right! Beliefs!
:{{A|vo xglq004 9 yoimiya 12.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' As for me...
:{{A|vo xglq004 9 yoimiya 13.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' Hehe, to be honest, even though I've thought about it countless times before, I still haven't found an answer.
:{{A|vo xglq004 9 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Seriously? Huh... Paimon was expecting something deep and philosophical.
:{{A|vo xglq004 9 yoimiya 14.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' Well, no one has ever asked me this before, so I've never really settled on an answer.
:{{A|vo xglq004 9 yoimiya 15.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' It was by chance that I happened to be born into the Naganohara family, so it was by chance that I ended up learning this craft from my pops.
:{{A|vo xglq004 9 yoimiya 16.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' It's also by chance that I've met so many people, learned so many things, and discovered that people associate watching fireworks with the things that are most precious to them.
:{{A|vo xglq004 9 yoimiya 17.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' Fireworks that disappear in a flash of light are probably the furthest thing away from the eternity that our Shogun desires.
:{{A|vo xglq004 9 yoimiya 18.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' But people's feelings don't just disappear, and it's those feelings that give fireworks their purpose. If nobody wanted to watch fireworks, then they wouldn't exist.
:{{DIcon}} That's another kind of eternity.
:{{A|vo xglq004 9 yoimiya 19.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' Also, consider this: You have to have the Naganoharas, because so many people are emotionally invested in the existence of fireworks.
:{{A|vo xglq004 9 yoimiya 20.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' If we didn't exist, their wishes would go unfulfilled, wouldn't they?
:{{A|vo xglq004 9 yoimiya 21.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' You know, {{Traveler}}, I don't really think about complicated things like this very often...
:{{A|vo xglq004 9 yoimiya 22.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' But I'm proud that I was born into the [[Naganohara family]], and have the chance to make so many pretty fireworks.
;(Obtain {{Item|Naganohara Fireworks Note}})
----
;(Talk to Yoimiya after the end of the quest)
:{{A|vo dialog xglq004 yoimiya 01.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' I think I'll stay here for a bit longer. The show is still not quite over in my heart.
:{{A|vo dialog xglq004 yoimiya 02.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' Oh, but if you wanted to chat, I'll happily oblige.
:{{DIcon}} What do you want to do afterward?
::{{A|vo xglq004 9 yoimiya 23a.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' Matsuzaka and the others are still waiting for me so we can go hunt down the [[Great Mujina Youkai]]. I'm like a big sister to them, so I can't go back on my word.
::{{A|vo xglq004 9 yoimiya 23a 1.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' Also, I want to go and ask everyone what they thought of the fireworks.
::{{A|vo xglq004 9 yoimiya 23a 2.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' And over the next few days, I'd also like to thank everyone for their support.
::{{A|vo xglq004 9 yoimiya 23a 3.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' That includes you and Paimon, too, of course.
:{{DIcon}} Are fireworks expensive?
::{{A|vo xglq004 9 yoimiya 23b.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' For you guys...
::{{A|vo xglq004 9 yoimiya 23b 1.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' I'll do it for free!
::{{A|vo xglq004 9 yoimiya 23b 2.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' I did kind of force it on you, after all. Not to mention that I dragged you along with me and gave you all sorts of trouble along the way. Hehe, I'd feel bad if I charged you any Mora.
::{{DIcon}} Are you sure? I feel bad...
::{{A|vo xglq004 9 yoimiya 23b 3a.ogg}} {{A|vo xglq004 9 yoimiya 23b 3b.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' It's fine. ...Look, how about we make a deal: After you find your {{MC|m=sister|f=brother}}, tell {{MC|m=her|f=him}} to come to Naganohara Fireworks for all {{MC|m=her|f=his}} fireworks needs. That way, I'll get another customer. Sound fair?
::{{A|vo xglq004 9 yoimiya 23b 4a.ogg}} {{A|vo xglq004 9 yoimiya 23b 4b.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' Also, it'd be nice to meet {{MC|m=her|f=him}}.
:{{DIcon}} What if the Tenryou Commission causes you more trouble...
::{{A|vo xglq004 9 yoimiya 23c.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' I'll kick their butts again!
::{{A|vo xglq004 9 yoimiya 23c 1.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' Hahaha, I'm joking. Didn't I tell you that my family deal with the Commissions quite a bit?
::{{A|vo xglq004 9 yoimiya 23c 2.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' We have an easy enough time of it. At the worst, we'd have to apologize, smile, and pay a fine. It wouldn't be the end of the world.
::{{A|vo xglq004 9 yoimiya 23c 3.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' You two should be careful, though. Without the same connections, you can't afford to be as reckless as me, hee-hee.
{{Dialogue End}}
