:{{A|vo txslq001 2 emilie 18.ogg}} '''Emilie:''' It's a kind of flower that was once popular in Fontaine. The perfume made from it also bears the same name... "Auguste."
:{{A|vo txslq001 2 paimon 20.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' "Auguste," huh... That's not a name you hear often nowadays!
:{{A|vo txslq001 2 emilie 19.ogg}} '''Emilie:''' In an ancient language, the word is said to mean "sacred" or "noble." It's sometimes used as a name for people as well.
:{{A|vo txslq001 2 emilie 20.ogg}} '''Emilie:''' ...Ah, that reminds me, are you familiar with the historical event in Fontaine known as the "Perfume Mania"?
:{{DIcon}} Not really...
:{{A|vo txslq001 2 emilie 21.ogg}} '''Emilie:''' The "Perfume Mania" was an event that occurred in Fontaine nearly twenty years ago...
:<gallery widths="350">
Top Note Floral Debt Quest Still 2.png
</gallery>
:{{A|vo txslq001 3 emilie 01.ogg}} '''Emilie:''' It all started when several merchants released their own lines of high-end, expensive perfumes, marketing them as must-have, luxury products, the very symbol of elegance itself..
:{{A|vo txslq001 3 emilie 02.ogg}} '''Emilie:''' No one anticipated the absolute frenzy this would create on the market, causing the price of the perfumes to skyrocket.
:{{A|vo txslq001 3 emilie 03.ogg}} '''Emilie:''' The demand was two-fold... What some saw as a status symbol, most saw as a money-making opportunity. You could take advantage of the soaring price by hoarding them and reselling at even higher margins.
:{{A|vo txslq001 3 emilie 04.ogg}} '''Emilie:''' The value of these products became so inflated, regular bottles of perfume were even going for hundreds of thousands of Mora. This resulted in countless disputes and scams.
:{{A|vo txslq001 3 emilie 05.ogg}} '''Emilie:''' But, at the end of the day, perfume is just perfume. The market value greatly exceeded the intrinsic worth of the product, creating an economic bubble that was never going to last.
:{{A|vo txslq001 3 emilie 06.ogg}} '''Emilie:''' Luckily, the Palais Mermonia recognized the danger and intervened before the craze could truly spread. Many profiteers and scammers were thrown in jail as a result.
:{{A|vo txslq001 3 emilie 07.ogg}} '''Emilie:''' In the end, only a few wealthy families were affected when the bubble popped.
:{{DIcon}} That's good... It really could have been a lot worse.
:{{A|vo txslq001 3 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What does all this have to do with that "Auguste" you mentioned earlier?
:{{A|vo txslq001 3 emilie 08.ogg}} '''Emilie:''' Well, during the craze, the most popular perfume was none other than "Auguste." The demand far exceeded the supply, to the point where it once sold for ten million Mora a bottle.
:{{A|vo txslq001 3 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' T—Ten million!? Then what about now?
:{{DIcon}} Calm down, Paimon.
:{{A|vo txslq001 3 emilie 09.ogg}} '''Emilie:''' After the mania ended, most perfumes returned to a normal price. "Auguste" was the only exception...
:{{A|vo txslq001 3 emilie 10.ogg}} '''Emilie:''' ...Its namesake, the flower used to create it, went extinct. As a result, no new bottles of "Auguste" have been made, and the value of the perfume remains exceedingly high.
:{{DIcon}} The flower... went extinct?
:{{A|vo txslq001 3 emilie 11.ogg}} '''Emilie:''' Indeed. The Auguste flower was not a natural variety, you see. It was specially cultivated for use in perfume-making.
:{{A|vo txslq001 3 emilie 12.ogg}} '''Emilie:''' When the bubble popped, all the flowerbeds used for its cultivation were destroyed in a fire. The variety has never been seen since...
:{{A|vo txslq001 3 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' But... didn't you say you came to the exhibition to look for it?
:{{A|vo txslq001 3 emilie 13.ogg}} '''Emilie:''' Ah, yes. I came to investigate a certain rumor that the Auguste flower has reappeared in Sumeru... It's causing quite the stir in the Fontaine perfume market.
:{{A|vo txslq001 3 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' {{Traveler}}! We should help Emilie look for it!
:{{DIcon}} It's just a rumor, Paimon...
:{{DIcon}} There's no way it's that easy to find...
:{{A|vo txslq001 3 tighnari 01.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' I have to agree. Emilie wrote me to ask if I could look into the rumor, but the Forest Rangers haven't received any reports of new plant species recently.
:{{A|vo txslq001 3 emilie 14.ogg}} '''Emilie:''' Even if I can locate the flower, I'm afraid you'll be disappointed, Paimon. I don't have any grand Mora-making endeavors planned.
:{{A|vo txslq001 3 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ehhhh!?
:{{A|vo txslq001 3 emilie 15.ogg}} '''Emilie:''' "Divine," "noble," "one of a kind"... All beautiful sentiments, to be sure... But, to me, they overshadow the very essence of the product.
:{{A|vo txslq001 3 emilie 16.ogg}} '''Emilie:''' When it comes to perfume, I want people to forget the price and the prestige... and focus on the beauty of the fragrance itself.
:{{A|vo txslq001 3 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wow... So noble...
:{{A|vo txslq001 3 emilie 17.ogg}} '''Emilie:''' Of course, there's also a more practical reason... In recent years, low-grade, counterfeit versions of "Auguste" have been popping up on the Fontaine perfume market.
:{{A|vo txslq001 3 emilie 18.ogg}} '''Emilie:''' ...Every so often, someone will claim to have recreated the unique scent of "Auguste," and the rumor mill will start comparing the counterfeits to my own work.
:{{A|vo txslq001 3 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Okay, that's more like the reason Paimon had in mind.
:{{A|vo txslq001 3 emilie 19.ogg}} '''Emilie:''' Ever since that rumor started, three new perfumes claiming to be made from the Auguste flower have appeared on the market.
:{{A|vo txslq001 3 emilie 20.ogg}} '''Emilie:''' If I can dispel the fanaticism surrounding "Auguste" — even just by proving the rumor to be false — Fontaine's perfume market can finally start to get back to normal.
:{{A|vo txslq001 3 emilie 21.ogg}} '''Emilie:''' Then, I'll be free from all the "stories" and "added meaning," and can focus on making what I like.
:{{A|vo txslq001 3 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' That makes sense...
:{{DIcon}} Either way, even if it's not for Mora...
:{{DIcon}} We could still help you out.
:{{A|vo txslq001 3 emilie 22.ogg}} '''Emilie:''' Oh... I would, of course, be grateful for your help, but I wouldn't want to trouble you.
:{{A|vo txslq001 3 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Well, you said it yourself! We're both travelers from abroad, so "it's only right that we help each other out!"
:{{A|vo txslq001 3 emilie 23.ogg}} '''Emilie:''' Hah... I suppose you're right. Then, you have my thanks.
:{{A|vo txslq001 3 tighnari 02.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Based on the information I have so far, it's unclear if the rumor is true.
:{{A|vo txslq001 3 tighnari 03.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Mr. Edgar also thinks it's too early to say... But you could always go talk to him? He was there all those years ago, after all... Maybe he'll know something.
:{{A|vo txslq001 3 emilie 24.ogg}} '''Emilie:''' Ah, I was just about to pay him a visit at the hotel.
:{{A|vo txslq001 3 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Edgar...? Who's that?
:{{A|vo txslq001 3 tighnari 04.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' The person you've been trying to guess this whole time — the "Flower Expert" in charge of the exhibition. He's also the most respected and experienced perfumer in the area.
:{{A|vo txslq001 3 tighnari 05.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Back when he was still working in Fontaine, "Auguste"... was his creation.
:{{A|vo txslq001 3 emilie 25.ogg}} '''Emilie:''' I should also mention... He was my teacher, the one who taught me the basics of perfumery when I apprenticed in Sumeru.
:{{A|vo txslq001 4 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So, this guy was a famous perfumer in Fontaine... But then, he came to Sumeru to... teach people from Fontaine? Sounds confusing...
:{{A|vo txslq001 4 emilie 01.ogg}} '''Emilie:''' It's a long story. If you're interested, we can talk more about it when we see him. He should be staying near the hotel.

:{{A|vo txslq001 6 sylvain 04.ogg}} '''Eude:''' ...Haha, well, what respectable perfume merchant hasn't heard of "Auguste"? Anyone in the business would be interested in the rumors.
:{{A|vo txslq001 6 edgar 09.ogg}} '''Edgar:''' I'm guessing you're here for the same reason, Emilie? We were just about to get into it, so you three might as well join in.
:{{A|vo txslq001 6 edgar 10.ogg}} '''Edgar:''' I commissioned a few Eremites to do some scouting for me. They searched all over Sumeru, but there were no sightings of the Auguste flower.
:{{A|vo txslq001 6 edgar 11.ogg}} '''Edgar:''' That being said, there are people in Port Ormos who claim to have smelled a unique fragrance on the streets... definitely floral, but still distinct...
:{{A|vo txslq001 6 edgar 12.ogg}} '''Edgar:''' Some of them were merchants who lived in Fontaine twenty years ago. According to them, the fragrance smelled exactly like the "Auguste" they remember from back then...

:{{A|vo txslq001 6 emilie 07.ogg}} '''Emilie:''' No, I don't think so. I doubt that's the case. Even if someone had a bottle that was never opened, the fragrance of the perfume would have changed over time. Very few perfumes can go decades without a change in scent...
:{{A|vo txslq001 6 emilie 08.ogg}} '''Emilie:''' "Auguste" is even more prone to that kind of shift. Only a few bottles still exist in Fontaine, and their scent would have completely degraded by now.

:{{A|vo txslq001 6 lucien 05.ogg}} '''Blaise:''' Impossible! If "Auguste" were that easy to replicate, it would never have sold for such a high price all those years ago! The Auguste flower is back! It has to be!

:{{A|vo txslq001 6 edgar 14.ogg}} '''Edgar:''' ...No. By the time they realized they had smelled something, the scent was already gone. If I hadn't asked about it, they probably wouldn't have given the experience a second thought.
:{{A|vo txslq001 6 edgar 15.ogg}} '''Edgar:''' Compared to things we see and hear, smells can be much easier to overlook...

:{{A|vo txslq001 15 lucien 01.ogg}} '''Blaise:''' Wait, you—!
:{{A|vo txslq001 15 sylvain 01.ogg}} '''Eude:''' Hey...!
:{{A|vo txslq001 15 sylvain 02.ogg}} '''Eude:''' ...Were you talking to us, Mademoiselle? I'm afraid we've never heard of those names before...
:{{A|vo txslq001 15 emilie 06.ogg}} '''Emilie:''' Hmm... Before arriving in Sumeru, I asked a friend from the Special Patrol to look into the creators of "Auguste"...
:{{A|vo txslq001 15 emilie 07.ogg}} '''Emilie:''' There were four people in total... The perfumer, Edgar — the one thrust into the limelight — and three others...
:{{A|vo txslq001 15 emilie 08.ogg}} '''Emilie:''' A researcher from Sumeru responsible for cultivating the Auguste flower... and two merchant brothers responsible for promoting the product on the market...
:{{A|vo txslq001 15 emilie 09.ogg}} '''Emilie:''' The two brothers capitalized on the mythos surrounding "Auguste." Their actions lured in numerous speculators and profiteers, inflating the price of "Auguste" even further.
:{{A|vo txslq001 15 emilie 10.ogg}} '''Emilie:''' In the end, they were sent to the Fortress of Meropide for falsifying their accounts and destabilizing the market... If you do the math, they should be out of prison by now.
:{{A|vo txslq001 15 lucien 02.ogg}} '''Blaise:''' Hmph! And what does that have to do with us? There are countless merchant families in Fontaine... You gonna accuse them of being criminals too?
:{{A|vo txslq001 15 emilie 11.ogg}} '''Emilie:''' Every time your brother called you "Blaise," it took you several seconds to respond... But, when I called you "Lucien" just now, the name registered immediately.
:{{A|vo txslq001 15 lucien 03.ogg}} '''Blaise:''' I...!
:{{A|vo txslq001 15 sylvain 03.ogg}} '''Eude:''' Ah, Miss Emilie... Out of respect for your position as a famous perfumer in Fontaine, I'm inclined to believe that was simply a poor attempt at humor.
:{{A|vo txslq001 15 sylvain 04.ogg}} '''Eude:''' You have a bright future ahead of you. You wouldn't want to develop a reputation as someone who throws around false accusations... especially among merchant circles.
:{{A|vo txslq001 15 emilie 12.ogg}} '''Emilie:''' Hmm... You claim to be regular perfume merchants, and yet... When I brought up "Amber Wine," you took it to be alcohol...
:{{A|vo txslq001 15 sylvain 05.ogg}} '''Eude:''' What!?
:{{DIcon}} (Just as I thought...)
:{{A|vo txslq001 15 emilie 13.ogg}} '''Emilie:''' "Amber Wine" is a perfume I created several years ago. It wasn't particularly renowned, but I'm certain any respectable perfume merchant in Fontaine would know of it.
:{{A|vo txslq001 15 emilie 14.ogg}} '''Emilie:''' Unless, until recently, they were living somewhere completely cut off from the perfume world... Hmm, somewhere like... the Fortress of Meropide perhaps...?
:{{A|vo txslq001 15 lucien 04.ogg}} '''Blaise:''' Emilie, you little...!
:{{DIcon}} Don't even think about it.
:;(The Traveler brandishes their [[Silver Sword]] in between the two, blocking Blaise off from going after Emilie.)
:{{A|vo txslq001 15 lucien 05.ogg}} '''Blaise:''' Oof...!
:{{A|vo txslq001 15 emilie 15.ogg}} '''Emilie:''' Don't misunderstand, Mr. Sylvain. I don't bring this up to criticize you. No matter what happened all those years ago, the court has already passed its judgment.
:{{A|vo txslq001 15 emilie 16.ogg}} '''Emilie:''' But Master's life is in danger. We need to learn whatever we can about the person who has done this.
:{{A|vo txslq001 15 emilie 17.ogg}} '''Emilie:''' If Master's attack had something to do with "Auguste," I would imagine the two of you might also be in danger.
:{{A|vo txslq001 15 emilie 18.ogg}} '''Emilie:''' So, I'd like to trouble you for some information, if I may... Tell me about "Kirya."
:{{A|vo txslq001 15 sylvain 06.ogg}} '''Eude:''' ...
:{{A|vo txslq001 15 sylvain 07.ogg}} '''Sylvain:''' ...Fine. As you wish.
:{{A|vo txslq001 15 lucien 06.ogg}} '''Lucien:''' ...Sylvain!
:{{A|vo txslq001 15 sylvain 08.ogg}} '''Sylvain:''' Lucien, if this will help us find Kirya, then it will be all worth it. Besides, we've already told most of this stuff to the Maison Ordalie, anyway.
:{{A|vo txslq001 15 sylvain 09.ogg}} '''Sylvain:''' ...You were right, Miss Emilie, there were four of us at the beginning: Myself, Lucien, Edgar... and a researcher from Sumeru in charge of flower cultivation... Vijava.
:{{A|vo txslq001 15 sylvain 10.ogg}} '''Sylvain:''' Some time down the road, the Marechaussee Phantom came knocking, saddled us with a list of accusations, and started looking into our books... They did their meddling, and my brother, Edgar, and I were forced to serve time in the Fortress as a result...
:{{A|vo txslq001 15 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Sounds like he's still upset about that... Wait, then how did Edgar end up in Sumeru?
:{{A|vo txslq001 15 emilie 19.ogg}} '''Emilie:''' Master was convicted as an accomplice, so he only had to serve a few years. He decided to move to Sumeru so that he could put those events behind him.
:{{A|vo txslq001 15 emilie 20.ogg}} '''Emilie:''' ...Still, Master was depressed for a long time after that... He stopped making new perfumes and focused on introducing students to the craft instead.
:{{A|vo txslq001 15 emilie 21.ogg}} '''Emilie:''' That's how I met him. My parents had to relocate to Sumeru for work when I was a child, so I had the chance to study under him for a little while.
:{{A|vo txslq001 15 emilie 22.ogg}} '''Emilie:''' ...But, we can talk about that some other time. I want to hear more about this researcher... Vijava.
:{{A|vo txslq001 15 sylvain 11.ogg}} '''Sylvain:''' ...Like us, Vijava was also staring down an investigation from the Marechaussee Phantom.
:{{A|vo txslq001 15 sylvain 12.ogg}} '''Sylvain:''' But, before the Phantom showed up at her door, she set all the flowerbeds on fire, along with much of the Mora we managed to earn. All the Auguste flowers, everything we worked to create... was reduced to nothing but a pile of ash.
:{{A|vo txslq001 15 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' But... destroying all that evidence... Wouldn't that make things worse for her?
:{{A|vo txslq001 15 emilie 23.ogg}} '''Emilie:''' It didn't matter at that point... Because she died in the fire as well.
:{{A|vo txslq001 15 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What!?
:{{A|vo txslq001 15 lucien 07.ogg}} '''Lucien:''' Hmph, sounds like you did an investigation of your own. Why even ask us if you knew all of this already?
:{{DIcon}} So far...
:{{DIcon}} Kirya's name still hasn't come up.
:{{A|vo txslq001 15 emilie 24.ogg}} '''Emilie:''' The name wasn't mentioned in any of the files I reviewed, either. But... you two seem quite familiar with him.
:{{A|vo txslq001 15 sylvain 13.ogg}} '''Sylvain:''' ...Kirya was Vijava's younger brother.
:{{A|vo txslq001 15 sylvain 14.ogg}} '''Sylvain:''' He was just a clueless kid back then... somewhere in his teens, I think. He helped his sister with her work sometimes, but that was pretty much it... He didn't have any idea what we were doing.
:{{A|vo txslq001 15 sylvain 15.ogg}} '''Sylvain:''' Vijava kept him close most of the time. The three of us were probably the only ones who even knew she had a brother.
:{{A|vo txslq001 15 sylvain 16.ogg}} '''Sylvain:''' After our operation was compromised, he disappeared... There were no signs of him until recently, when people started saying the Auguste flower had reappeared in Sumeru.
:{{A|vo txslq001 15 emilie 25.ogg}} '''Emilie:''' ...So, you think Kirya took something with him back then... something that allowed him to reproduce the Auguste flower?
:{{A|vo txslq001 15 lucien 08.ogg}} '''Lucien:''' Hmph, Vijava doted on the kid like you wouldn't believe! She even told us to give her cut to her brother if anything happened to her.
:{{A|vo txslq001 15 lucien 09.ogg}} '''Lucien:''' If she left something behind before she died, believe me — Kirya's the one that has it!
:{{A|vo txslq001 15 sylvain 17.ogg}} '''Sylvain:''' And judging by the liquid in that bottle... the Auguste flower wasn't the only thing he reproduced... He managed to replicate the perfume itself...
:{{A|vo txslq001 15 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So the liquid Edgar was forced to ingest really was "Auguste"! Wait, does that mean "Auguste" is poison?
:{{A|vo txslq001 15 sylvain 18.ogg}} '''Sylvain:''' Ahem! Poison? No, no... of course not! No perfume is meant to be ingested. Even small amounts can be dangerous, let alone ingesting a whole bottle at once.
:{{A|vo txslq001 15 sylvain 19.ogg}} '''Sylvain:''' If "Auguste" could be considered a poison, we wouldn't have even sold half a bottle back then. Edgar fell unconscious because Kirya forced him to drink perfume... it just happened to be "Auguste"!
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (Strange... Sylvain seems nervous all of a sudden...)
:{{DIcon}} Why did Kirya attack Edgar?
:{{A|vo txslq001 15 sylvain 20.ogg}} '''Sylvain:''' Hah... He probably thought we had something to do with his sister's death. But, to tell you the truth, I have no idea why she did all that.
:{{A|vo txslq001 15 sylvain 21.ogg}} '''Sylvain:''' We're not looking for Kirya because we have it out for him... We just wanted to see how he was doing... and, if possible, work together to bring back "Auguste."
:{{A|vo txslq001 15 sylvain 22.ogg}} '''Sylvain:''' We only went to prison for a bit of fraud and market manipulation... It had nothing to do with the product itself.
:{{A|vo txslq001 15 sylvain 23.ogg}} '''Sylvain:''' As long as we keep things honest this time around... bringing the product back to market would almost be like honoring his sister's memory!
:{{A|vo txslq001 15 emilie 26.ogg}} '''Emilie:''' ...So, that's why you never mentioned Kirya during your interrogation?
:{{A|vo txslq001 15 lucien 10.ogg}} '''Lucien:''' ...Yes, exactly! We were just looking out for the kid!
:{{A|vo txslq001 15 sylvain 24.ogg}} '''Sylvain:''' Anyway, that's all we know... If you're looking for information on what's in "Auguste" or what to do if you ingest it... there are only two people to ask — Edgar... or Kirya himself.
:{{A|vo txslq001 15 emilie 27.ogg}} '''Emilie:''' ...Well, at least we're able to say for certain that the substance Edgar ingested was, in fact, "Auguste." That gives us a direction for further testing... Well, then, I'd say that was a very enlightening discussion.
:{{A|vo txslq001 15 sylvain 25.ogg}} '''Sylvain:''' Ah, well, glad to hear it.
:{{A|vo txslq001 15 sylvain 26.ogg}} '''Sylvain:''' Lucien, let's head back to the room and rest for a bit. With everything that's happened... There are things that need reconsidering...
:{{A|vo txslq001 15 lucien 11.ogg}} '''Lucien:''' Yes, of course.
:{{A|vo txslq001 15 emilie 28.ogg}} '''Emilie:''' ...
:{{DIcon}} ...They're still hiding something.
:{{A|vo txslq001 15 emilie 29.ogg}} '''Emilie:''' Ah, you think so too? Hmm, that does seem to be the case... Pity we don't have more evidence.
:{{A|vo txslq001 15 emilie 30.ogg}} '''Emilie:''' But, based on Sylvain's tone of voice just now, I suspect further questioning will only result in more made-up answers.
:{{A|vo txslq001 15 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' The way you exposed them like that, just based on a hunch... That was genius!
:{{DIcon}} Are you really just a perfumer who looks after people in your spare time?
:{{A|vo txslq001 15 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, right! Earlier you said you were only sort of a doctor... and that your patients were "unusual"...
:{{A|vo txslq001 15 emilie 31.ogg}} '''Emilie:''' Oh, yes. That's because most of the "patients" I encounter... are already dead.
:{{A|vo txslq001 15 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So, you're a... forensic doctor?
:{{A|vo txslq001 15 emilie 32.ogg}} '''Emilie:''' Close... I'm actually a "forensic cleaner." Once the forensic team and the Marechaussee Phantom are done collecting evidence from the scene, I'm in charge of clearing away the final traces my "patients" leave on the world.
:{{A|vo txslq001 15 emilie 33.ogg}} '''Emilie:''' In fact, with just a small alteration to the formula, the same tincture used as the base of perfume can also be made into a cleaning agent.
:{{A|vo txslq001 15 emilie 34.ogg}} '''Emilie:''' Basically, there are two sides to forensics — those who collect evidence to expose the truth, and those who clean up the smells, bloodstains, and other substances left behind at the scene.
:{{A|vo txslq001 15 emilie 35.ogg}} '''Emilie:''' I've learned a lot in my line of work, and I've witnessed a lot of death... But this time, we may still save the patient.
:{{A|vo txslq001 15 emilie 36.ogg}} '''Emilie:''' Actually, {{Traveler}}, could I trouble you to report back to Tighnari and the officers at Port Ormos? We should update them on the situation...
:{{DIcon}} Will do.
:{{A|vo txslq001 15 emilie 37.ogg}} '''Emilie:''' I'll stay here and continue to look after Master. Now that we have a sample of "Auguste"... I'm hoping further analysis won't be too difficult.

;(Talk to Emilie again, optional)<!-- same ASTK as before entering the hotel -->
:{{A|vo dialog txslq001 emilie 03.ogg}} '''Emilie:''' Master looks a lot older than when I last saw him... I just hope he can hold on...

;(Interact with the flower stand, optional)
:'''Flower Stand:''' (The stand displays flowers from various nations. Looking at the flower pot in the middle, the soil seems to have been disturbed recently.)

;(Interact with the perfume bottles, optional)

;(Interact with the door of the main hotel building for the merchant brothers' rooms, optional)

;(Interact with the door of the secondary hotel building for Edgar's room, optional)
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (Emilie is doing her best to treat her Master... We shouldn't interrupt her.)

;(Talk to Tighnari)<!-- same ASTK as the start -->
:;(It is sunset by the time the Traveler runs up to Tighnari and Shyam.)
:{{A|vo txslq001 20 tighnari 01.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Woah, why the rush? Did something happen?
:{{Black Screen|You explain everything...}}
:{{A|vo txslq001 20 shyam 01.ogg}} '''Shyam:''' What!? Edgar was attacked?
:{{A|vo txslq001 20 shyam 02.ogg}} '''Shyam:''' He's the most famous perfumer in the region, someone who's helped countless people around Port Ormos... How could this happen...
:{{A|vo txslq001 20 tighnari 02.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Sheriff, have you received any reports of a suspicious individual fleeing through the bazaar?
:{{A|vo txslq001 20 shyam 03.ogg}} '''Shyam:''' No... But we've got eyes all over the area. I'm sure someone's seen Kirya.
:{{A|vo txslq001 20 shyam 04.ogg}} '''Shyam:''' I'll start gathering my forces. We won't let him get away!
:{{A|vo txslq001 20 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What about you, Tighnari? Do you have a plan?
:{{A|vo txslq001 20 tighnari 03.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Hmm... I'm sure the sheriff can handle things over at the scene, and I doubt Emilie needs my help looking after Mr. Edgar.
:{{A|vo txslq001 20 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Uh... But, she said she's not a real doctor...
:{{A|vo txslq001 20 tighnari 04.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Then, she was far too modest. She may not be a doctor by trade, but she has a deeper understanding of human anatomy and pharmacology than most scholars from the Amurta Darshan.
:{{A|vo txslq001 20 tighnari 05.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Not to mention the fact that Mr. Edgar's condition is related to perfume... Emilie is certainly in the best position to help him.
:{{A|vo txslq001 20 tighnari 06.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' As for me... I'll head to the Akademiya and see what I can learn about Vijava and Kirya.
:{{A|vo txslq001 20 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, that's right! Vijava was supposed to be a scholar from Sumeru... Do you recognize the name?
:{{A|vo txslq001 20 tighnari 07.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' From Emilie's letter, certainly, but that was the first time I'd heard of it. The Akademiya produces a lot of scholars, and there are plenty of graduates who choose to pursue a career outside their Darshan.
:{{A|vo txslq001 20 tighnari 08.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' I didn't have time to look into it earlier... But, now, it seems like Vijava's past could be critical to getting to the bottom of what happened to Mr. Edgar.
:{{A|vo txslq001 20 tighnari 09.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' I have friends in Sumeru City that can help me investigate. With any luck, we'll have news to share by tomorrow.
:{{A|vo txslq001 20 tighnari 10.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' ...I'll leave you and Emilie to watch over things here in Port Ormos.
{{Dialogue End}}

==Steps==
# Wait until 07:00 – 10:00 two days from now
# Go to the event venue to meet up with [[Yelan]] and the rest
# Go to [[Ashvapati]]'s hideout
# Investigate Ashvapati's hideout (0/3)
# Read the letter Ashvapati left behind
# Discuss what to do next
# Head to the meetup location

==Dialogue==
{{Quest Description|With Yelan's help, you locate Ashvapati's hideout. There lies a past buried beneath the yellow sands, and with it, the truth behind the entire case...}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Pass time)
:{{A|vo nkeq103 99 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' We just got word from Yelan. Looks like she managed to track down Ashvapati. C'mon, let's go meet up with the others.

;(Approach the event venue entrance)

:{{A|vo nkeq103 1 yelan 02.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' Absolutely. You just need to trust us, just like we trusted you earlier.
:{{A|vo nkeq103 1 beidou 01.ogg}} '''Beidou:''' Yeah, we've got this. My crew's already locked and loaded.
:{{A|vo nkeq103 1 chevreuse 02.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' I'll take you at your word.
:{{A|vo nkeq103 1 navia 01.ogg}} '''Navia:''' I know you said you wanted to keep this operation small. But, I still thought you could use some backup.
:{{A|vo nkeq103 1 navia 02.ogg}} '''Navia:''' So, I chose a few promising young [[Spina di Rosula|Spina]] members to help out. [[Clorinde]] and I have got things covered at the expo.
:;(The Traveler and Paimon arrive)
:{{A|vo nkeq103 1 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Guess we're ready to roll then.
:{{A|vo nkeq103 1 yelan 03.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' Now that you're here, I guess we can get this show on the road.
:;(The Traveler, Paimon, Chevreuse, and Yelan begin to leave)
:{{DIcon}} Let's go.
:;([[Ati]], [[Neb]], and [[Raya]] approach)

:{{A|vo nkeq103 1 chevreuse 03.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' I'm sorry, you can't come with us. You need to stay at the expo like we agreed. It's for your own safety.
:{{A|vo nkeq103 1 neb 01.ogg}} '''Neb:''' We know. It's just... Do you really think Uncle Ashvapati is working for the bad guys?
:{{A|vo nkeq103 1 chevreuse 04.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' I wish I could answer that question, but it would just be speculation, and I work based off evidence.
:{{A|vo nkeq103 1 neb 02.ogg}} '''Neb:''' He's been gone for two days now, and he just left us here... He's never done that before. Maybe he really is working for those people and was afraid of getting caught...
:{{A|vo nkeq103 1 neb 03.ogg}} '''Neb:''' But, if that's true, then... That means he must've been involved in making and selling weapons in the past, too. Wouldn't that make him a bad person...?
:{{A|vo nkeq103 1 navia 03.ogg}} '''Navia:''' That's not for us to say. Take a look around the expo — there are plenty of other people making and selling weapons. Doesn't mean they're necessarily all bad people.
:{{A|vo nkeq103 1 neb 04.ogg}} '''Neb:''' Really?
:{{A|vo nkeq103 1 navia 04.ogg}} '''Navia:''' The same is true for your uncle. Whatever he may have done in the past, the real question we need to ask is "why." There's a lot we need to know before we can judge a person.
:{{A|vo nkeq103 1 navia 05.ogg}} '''Navia:''' In [[Fontaine]], we have a long and complicated process in place just to make sure we get the right answer to that question.
:{{A|vo nkeq103 1 neb 05.ogg}} '''Neb:''' Yeah... Why would Uncle Ashvapati do something like that?
:{{A|vo nkeq103 1 navia 06.ogg}} '''Navia:''' How about this? I'll make sure that Miss [[Chevreuse]] and Miss Yelan promise to bring your uncle back safe and sound.
:{{A|vo nkeq103 1 navia 07.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Then, you can ask him yourselves.
:{{A|vo nkeq103 1 ati 01.ogg}} '''Ati:''' Thanks, Miss!
:;(Ati, Neb, and Raya leave)

:{{A|vo nkeq103 1 beidou 02.ogg}} '''Beidou:''' Hahaha, it's alright. We're prepared for whatever we might face.
:{{A|vo nkeq103 1 chevreuse 05.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' Regardless, it's a promise we have to keep. After all, when the children get their answer, it will shape their understanding of what justice means.
:{{A|vo nkeq103 1 yelan 04.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' Then let's all do our part to make sure this ends as well as it possibly can.

:{{A|vo nkeq103 5 chevreuse 01.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' These records look suspiciously familiar...
:{{A|vo nkeq103 5 yelan 01.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' Yeah... doesn't seem very coincidental to me, either.
:{{A|vo nkeq103 5 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What is it?
:{{A|vo nkeq103 5 chevreuse 02.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' Remember when I said this group's cover was ironclad? They were always careful never to leave a trail leading back to them...
:{{A|vo nkeq103 5 chevreuse 03.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' The one time they slipped up, it broke the case wide open. We found a cargo manifest left behind at the scene — that's the clue that led us to [[Nod-Krai]].
:{{A|vo nkeq103 5 yelan 02.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' It was a similar story on our end.
:{{A|vo nkeq103 5 chevreuse 04.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' And now, that same manifest shows up here, among the records left behind by Ashvapati.
:{{A|vo nkeq103 5 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So... he's the guy that slipped up back then?
:{{A|vo nkeq103 5 yelan 03.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' Unless it wasn't a slip-up at all... How does the same clue get left behind at two separate scenes, and picked up by two separate law-enforcement agencies? Thinking back on it now, it doesn't seem quite so accidental after all.
:{{A|vo nkeq103 5 chevreuse 05.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' No. Almost like he led us here on purpose... But, for what reason?

;(Investigate the letter on the bench)
:{{A|vo nkeq103 6 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hey, there's a letter here.
:{{A|vo nkeq103 6 yelan 01.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' Look at how it's positioned... it was begging to be found. I think it might be for us.
:{{A|vo nkeq103 6 chevreuse 01.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' You think he knew we would come here?
:{{A|vo nkeq103 6 yelan 02.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' If he did, he's a more impressive opponent than I anticipated.
:{{A|vo nkeq103 6 chevreuse 02.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' Let's keep going. We can read it together when we debrief.

;(Investigate the ballista)
:{{A|vo nkeq103 4 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wait, is this what Paimon thinks it is?
:{{A|vo nkeq103 4 chevreuse 01.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' It's the display model that goes with the prototype... Guess that does make him our thief.
:{{A|vo nkeq103 4 yelan 01.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' What's worse is that, with his technical background, I bet he managed to bypass the security features on the prototype.
:{{A|vo nkeq103 4 chevreuse 02.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' You're saying, our guy has a battle-ready ballista in his possession, just waiting to be unleashed?
:{{A|vo nkeq103 4 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' This isn't looking good...
:{{A|vo nkeq103 4 yelan 02.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' Something isn't adding up... All the evidence suggests that he was here alone. Which begs the question: Why would he unlock the ballista's features before even meeting up with his boss?
:{{A|vo nkeq103 4 chevreuse 03.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' That's a question for another time. We need to focus on where he's going next.

;(After investigating all three clues)
:{{A|vo nkeq103 7 yelan 01.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' This situation seems more complicated than we imagined. It looks like Ashvapati does have a connection to our criminal gang... But, it might not be what we thought at first.
:{{A|vo nkeq103 7 chevreuse 01.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' You don't think he's working for them?
:{{A|vo nkeq103 7 yelan 02.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' Unlikely. He lured us to Nod-Krai, prepared those weapons on his own, deliberately put us on his trail... This is looking more and more like the work of an independent actor.
:{{A|vo nkeq103 7 chevreuse 02.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' Well, if we wanna get to the bottom of this, he's still our best lead.
:{{DIcon}} Let's read the letter.
:{{A|vo nkeq103 7 chevreuse 03.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' That would seem to be our last remaining clue. Let's do it.
:{{A|vo nkeq103 7 ashvapati 01.ogg}} '''Ashvapati:''' To the officers of the [[Special Security and Surveillance Patrol]] and the [[Liyue Qixing]]. You certainly live up to your reputation. Within a single day, you were able to eliminate over half of the gang's forces. I appreciate the effort.
:{{A|vo nkeq103 7 ashvapati 02.ogg}} '''Ashvapati:''' I doubt my secret hiding spot will be a secret much longer, so I suppose it's my turn to throw my hat in the ring.
:{{A|vo nkeq103 7 ashvapati 03.ogg}} '''Ashvapati:''' I'm just glad I no longer have to run. So, before my day in court is upon me, allow me to confess to my crimes.
:;(A flashback begins — Ashvapati is walking through the Sumeru desert)<!-- black screen transition -->
:{{A|vo nkeq103 8 ashvapati 01.ogg}} '''Ashvapati:''' It all started with a [[Kshahrewar]] researcher, expelled from the [[Akademiya]] for violating a taboo.
:{{A|vo nkeq103 8 ashvapati 02.ogg}} '''Ashvapati:''' He had dedicated his life to the pursuit of knowledge, but when he found himself in the desert, it wasn't even worth a pail of water to quench his thirst.
:;(Ashvapati collapses and awakens to a group of Eremites approaching)
:{{A|vo nkeq103 8 ashvapati 03.ogg}} '''Ashvapati:''' *coughing*... Could you spare some water? I... I'm a Kshahrewar researcher. If you need something, I could—
:{{A|vo nkeq103 8 khaemwaset 01.ogg}} '''Khaemwaset:''' Researchers like you are a dime a dozen. Smart as a whip until you find yourself in the desert... Then, you're lucky to survive the night.
:{{A|vo nkeq103 8 ashvapati 04.ogg}} '''Ashvapati:''' Are... Are you mocking me?
:{{A|vo nkeq103 8 khaemwaset 02.ogg}} '''Khaemwaset:''' No, son. Just still trying to figure out why I've got such a soft spot for strays like you... Here, give me your canteen.
:{{A|vo nkeq103 8 ashvapati 05.ogg}} '''Ashvapati:''' *gulp*...
:{{A|vo nkeq103 8 khaemwaset 03.ogg}} '''Khaemwaset:''' You got somewhere to go?
:{{A|vo nkeq103 8 ashvapati 06.ogg}} '''Ashvapati:''' *coughing*... Not really. Thanks to this water, though, at least I can rule out the bottom of a vulture's stomach.
:{{A|vo nkeq103 8 khaemwaset 04.ogg}} '''Khaemwaset:''' Haha... Now you're talking like desert folk. You could always join my band of misfits.
:{{A|vo nkeq103 8 ashvapati 07.ogg}} '''Ashvapati:''' What would I do?
:{{A|vo nkeq103 8 khaemwaset 05.ogg}} '''Khaemwaset:''' Gather foods, guard our water source... just like everyone else I've taken in.
:{{A|vo nkeq103 8 khaemwaset 06.ogg}} '''Khaemwaset:''' Of course, if you have something you're good at, you're welcome to show it off. Every little bit helps.
:{{A|vo nkeq103 8 ashvapati 08.ogg}} '''Ashvapati:''' All I know is... weapons.
:{{A|vo nkeq103 8 khaemwaset 07.ogg}} '''Khaemwaset:''' Weapons?
:{{A|vo nkeq103 8 ashvapati 09.ogg}} '''Ashvapati:''' Yeah! I love studying them! Big and powerful ones, small and deadly ones, old ones, new ones...
:;(Visualizations of a Ruin Drake, a [[Primal Construct]], and the [[Algorithm of Semi-Intransient Matrix of Overseer Network]] are shown)
:{{A|vo nkeq103 8 ashvapati 10.ogg}} '''Ashvapati:''' I believe the essence of Kshahrewar research is embodied in weaponry, and the pursuit of this kind of technology is what pushes the world forward.
:{{A|vo nkeq103 8 ashvapati 11.ogg}} '''Ashvapati:''' My lifelong goal has always been to become a foremost expert on all kinds of weapons so I can invent even more advanced ones!
:{{A|vo nkeq103 8 ashvapati 12.ogg}} '''Ashvapati:''' So, I might have "borrowed" a few sensitive texts without permission, but you see the vision, right? The higher-ups in the Akademiya just didn't understand...
:{{A|vo nkeq103 8 khaemwaset 08.ogg}} '''Khaemwaset:''' Pfft. The Akademiya could have a thousand and one reasons for exiling you out here, and it still wouldn't matter to me, son. All I care about is what this "specialty" of yours can do for us.
:{{A|vo nkeq103 8 ashvapati 13.ogg}} '''Ashvapati:''' I... I can help upgrade your weaponry! That should come in handy in a dangerous place like the desert, surely?
:{{A|vo nkeq103 8 khaemwaset 09.ogg}} '''Khaemwaset:''' True, weapons are essential to life here in the desert. Most folks get them when merchants happen to pass through.
:{{A|vo nkeq103 8 khaemwaset 10.ogg}} '''Khaemwaset:''' But when it comes to protecting the people here, this scimitar in my hand is more than enough. The kind of weapons you're talking about are overkill for a place like this.
:{{A|vo nkeq103 8 ashvapati 14.ogg}} '''Ashvapati:''' Overkill? Really?
:{{A|vo nkeq103 8 khaemwaset 11.ogg}} '''Khaemwaset:''' Our group is lucky. Our ancestors learned how to protect the oasis from the sandstorms to prevent it from drying up.
:{{A|vo nkeq103 8 khaemwaset 12.ogg}} '''Khaemwaset:''' Plus, we're pretty far off the beaten path. Helps us avoid conflict with other bands of [[Eremites]].
:{{A|vo nkeq103 8 khaemwaset 13.ogg}} '''Khaemwaset:''' All in all, we don't have to travel to find water, we don't have to fight off other desert folk.... It's a real place to call home.
:{{A|vo nkeq103 8 khaemwaset 14.ogg}} '''Khaemwaset:''' There are plenty of ways to die in the desert, but behind a lot of them lies too much ambition. So, having somewhere to settle down... is more than enough for me.
:{{A|vo nkeq103 8 ashvapati 15.ogg}} '''Ashvapati:''' I see... Guess I could do some odd jobs, then.
:{{A|vo nkeq103 8 khaemwaset 15.ogg}} '''Khaemwaset:''' I've heard you Kshahrewar scholars are handy with all kinds of gadgets. You could always make something for the kids...
:{{A|vo nkeq103 8 ashvapati 16.ogg}} '''Ashvapati:''' You mean like... toys?
:{{A|vo nkeq103 8 khaemwaset 16.ogg}} '''Khaemwaset:''' Yes, if you wouldn't mind. It'll give 'em something to do. Life can get boring out here.
:{{A|vo nkeq103 8 ashvapati 17.ogg}} '''Ashvapati:''' Alright then...
:{{A|vo nkeq103 8 ashvapati 18.ogg}} '''Ashvapati:''' And just like that, a Kshahrewar scholar at the cutting edge of his field ended up in the desert... making toys for children.
:{{A|vo nkeq103 8 ashvapati 19.ogg}} '''Ashvapati:''' It got boring from time to time, but all in all, those days were quite pleasant. The Eremites accepted me as one of their own, and all the children loved me.
:{{A|vo nkeq103 8 ashvapati 20.ogg}} '''Ashvapati:''' Looking back now, I wish I could have lived like that until the end of my days. But then those despicable people showed up, and it changed everything...
:;(Ashvapati in the flashback addresses a group of children)
:{{A|vo nkeq103 8 ashvapati 21.ogg}} '''Ashvapati:''' Don't rush me. These materials are in short supply.
:;(A short distance from the oasis, Khaemwaset and two of his Eremites face [[Sennedjem]] and his men, who are on the ground)
:{{A|vo nkeq103 8 sumerushouwei 01.ogg}} '''Eremite Guard:''' They've got a lot of nerve, showing their faces back here.
:{{A|vo nkeq103 8 khaemwaset 17.ogg}} '''Khaemwaset:''' Sennedjem... It has been a while.
:{{A|vo nkeq103 8 sennedjem 01.ogg}} '''Sennedjem:''' Well, we have a right to this oasis too. Our ancestors were part of the group that discovered it!
:{{A|vo nkeq103 8 sumerushouwei 02.ogg}} '''Eremite Guard:''' You hated this place! After that giant sandstorm, when everyone else was trying to figure out how to help, you got out of dodge the first chance you could get!
:{{A|vo nkeq103 8 sennedjem 02.ogg}} '''Sennedjem:''' Because I knew better than to be stubborn. Stay in one place too long around here, and it might just be your grave.
:{{A|vo nkeq103 8 sumerushouwei 03.ogg}} '''Eremite Guard:''' You abandoned this place. If we'd done the same, the oasis wouldn't even exist anymore. You gave up your right to be here a long time ago!
:{{A|vo nkeq103 8 sumeruchengyuan 01.ogg}} '''Eremite:''' I heard they joined another band of Eremites after leaving us, but got kicked out. I bet they're only crawling back to us now because they've got nowhere else to go...
:{{A|vo nkeq103 8 sumerushouwei 04.ogg}} '''Eremite Guard:''' Chief, should we drive them off?
:{{A|vo nkeq103 8 sennedjem 03.ogg}} '''Sennedjem:''' I'd like to see you try! I'm warning you... You won't get rid of us that easily!
:{{A|vo nkeq103 8 khaemwaset 18.ogg}} '''Khaemwaset:''' ...Leave them be. This oasis has always been big enough to sustain more than one group of people. It's not worth spilling blood over.
:{{A|vo nkeq103 8 khaemwaset 19.ogg}} '''Khaemwaset:''' All that matters is keeping the people here safe.
:{{A|vo nkeq103 8 ashvapati 22.ogg}} '''Ashvapati:''' At the time, I didn't think much of it. Just [[Khaemwaset]] being the kind-hearted man he always had been.
:{{A|vo nkeq103 8 ashvapati 23.ogg}} '''Ashvapati:''' And so, normal life continued, much unchanged. Well, mostly. You can take the scholar out of the Akademiya, but... Putting your life's work behind you is easier said than done.
:{{A|vo nkeq103 8 ashvapati 24.ogg}} '''Ashvapati:''' I often found myself flipping through my collection of blueprints and sketches. The [[Ruin Drake]]s scattered around [[Sumeru]] were of particular interest to me.
:{{A|vo nkeq103 8 ashvapati 25.ogg}} '''Ashvapati:''' As far as I knew, no one had been able to analyze or reproduce the technology within those mechanisms.
:{{A|vo nkeq103 8 ashvapati 26.ogg}} '''Ashvapati:''' But I was able to design a kind of "lure" to bait them into attacking a specific target — in effect, turning them into a weapon.
:{{A|vo nkeq103 8 ashvapati 27.ogg}} '''Ashvapati:''' Somehow, the new arrivals at the oasis must've caught wind of it, because they soon started taking an interest in me.
:{{A|vo nkeq103 8 sennedjem 04.ogg}} '''Sennedjem:''' Hope you don't mind me asking, but is that a weapon you're researching?
:{{A|vo nkeq103 8 ashvapati 28.ogg}} '''Ashvapati:''' ...I do mind, actually. It's none of your business.
:{{A|vo nkeq103 8 sennedjem 05.ogg}} '''Sennedjem:''' Rumor is, you used to be a researcher at the Akademiya. All that knowledge going to waste out here in the sticks ... what a shame.
:{{A|vo nkeq103 8 ashvapati 29.ogg}} '''Ashvapati:''' What do you want?
:{{A|vo nkeq103 8 sennedjem 06.ogg}} '''Sennedjem:''' I want to team up.
:{{A|vo nkeq103 8 sennedjem 07.ogg}} '''Sennedjem:''' The rules and red tape that got you kicked out of the Akademiya... They don't exist in the desert. You could take this research to the next level. As things stand, all you've got is a blueprint and a pipe dream.
:{{A|vo nkeq103 8 sennedjem 08.ogg}} '''Sennedjem:''' But what if... you had access to the right funds and materials?
:{{A|vo nkeq103 8 ashvapati 30.ogg}} '''Ashvapati:''' What are you suggesting?
:{{A|vo nkeq103 8 sennedjem 09.ogg}} '''Sennedjem:''' Me and my men can get you what you need. In return, all you gotta do is bring this sketch to life.
:{{A|vo nkeq103 8 sennedjem 10.ogg}} '''Sennedjem:''' We've always had a good eye for business, just never the right product. But this thing right here... the different bands of Eremites are gonna shell out [[Mora]] left and right to get their hands on it.
:{{A|vo nkeq103 8 ashvapati 31.ogg}} '''Ashvapati:''' You want to sell it?
:{{A|vo nkeq103 8 sennedjem 11.ogg}} '''Sennedjem:''' It's a win-win. You provide the goods, and I earn enough Mora from these people to fund the research of your dreams!
:{{A|vo nkeq103 8 ashvapati 32.ogg}} '''Ashvapati:''' I don't know...
:{{A|vo nkeq103 8 sennedjem 12.ogg}} '''Sennedjem:''' I understand what you're worried about. But listen, it won't come back to bite the people here.
:{{A|vo nkeq103 8 sennedjem 13.ogg}} '''Sennedjem:''' These people don't think bigger than this place. They don't get involved in conflict. I mean, c'mon, their biggest enemy is the weather.
:{{A|vo nkeq103 8 ashvapati 33.ogg}} '''Ashvapati:''' ...You've made a bad name for yourself around here. I don't want any part in this.
:;(Ashvapati begins to leave)
:{{A|vo nkeq103 8 sennedjem 14.ogg}} '''Sennedjem:''' Well, it's your choice. But it could be the last meaningful choice you ever get in life.
:;(Ashvapati stops)
:{{A|vo nkeq103 8 sennedjem 15.ogg}} '''Sennedjem:''' So I'll ask you again. Do you want to finally develop the weapons you've been dreaming of, and realize your academic ambitions? Or do you want to stay here building toys for kids?
:{{A|vo nkeq103 8 ashvapati 34.ogg}} '''Ashvapati:''' How I wish I'd made the right choice back then...
:;(Some time later)
:{{A|vo nkeq103 8 sennedjem 16.ogg}} '''Sennedjem:''' Yeah, we increased our prices. What about it? You gonna back out?
:{{A|vo nkeq103 8 sumerumaijia 01.ogg}} '''Buyer:''' So, you're really as money hungry as they all say, huh.
:{{A|vo nkeq103 8 sennedjem 17.ogg}} '''Sennedjem:''' Cash is king. That's just business.
:{{A|vo nkeq103 8 sumerumaijia 02.ogg}} '''Buyer:''' Hmph, fine.
:;(The buyer tosses over a bag as payment and leaves)
:{{A|vo nkeq103 8 ashvapati 35.ogg}} '''Ashvapati:''' ...I'm done. I want out.
:{{A|vo nkeq103 8 sennedjem 18.ogg}} '''Sennedjem:''' What are you talking about? We're making bank here.
:{{A|vo nkeq103 8 ashvapati 36.ogg}} '''Ashvapati:''' I know what the weapons have been used for, and I refuse to be an accomplice to all this any longer.
:{{A|vo nkeq103 8 sennedjem 19.ogg}} '''Sennedjem:''' An accomplice? Listen, that's got nothing to do with us. People would be at each other's throats with or without our weapons. So they die to a machine instead of a scimitar? What difference does it make?
:{{A|vo nkeq103 8 ashvapati 37.ogg}} '''Ashvapati:''' Can't you sell more than just weapons? Surely this can't be all the Eremites are interested in buying?
:{{A|vo nkeq103 8 sennedjem 20.ogg}} '''Sennedjem:''' If you wanna make the big Mora, you gotta push what sells. That's just how it is.
:{{A|vo nkeq103 8 ashvapati 38.ogg}} '''Ashvapati:''' *sigh*... And that right there is why I want out.
:{{A|vo nkeq103 8 sennedjem 21.ogg}} '''Sennedjem:''' Fine. I've made more than enough to leave this dump in the dust anyway. If you want out so bad, have it your way.
:;(A ruckus erupts nearby)
:{{A|vo nkeq103 8 ashvapati 39.ogg}} '''Ashvapati:''' What was that!?
:;(Ashvapati runs back to the oasis to find that Ruin Drakes have set the camp ablaze)
:{{A|vo nkeq103 8 ashvapati 40.ogg}} '''Ashvapati:''' No...
:{{A|vo nkeq103 8 ashvapati 41.ogg}} '''Ashvapati:''' Khaemwaset!
:{{A|vo nkeq103 8 khaemwaset 20.ogg}} '''Khaemwaset:''' ...
:;(Ashvapati looks around to see the bodies of the tribe members scattered across the area)
:{{A|vo nkeq103 8 ashvapati 42.ogg}} '''Ashvapati:''' How did this happen?
:{{A|vo nkeq103 8 sennedjem 22.ogg}} '''Sennedjem:''' You won't find a tribe in this desert without enemies. People have tried to steal water from this oasis in the past, but Khaemwaset drove them off. Guess his enemies have been holding a grudge this whole time...
:{{A|vo nkeq103 8 ashvapati 43.ogg}} '''Ashvapati:''' You sold weapons to his enemies? But, he took you in when you had nowhere to turn! You owe him your life! Why would you do this!?
:{{A|vo nkeq103 8 sennedjem 23.ogg}} '''Sennedjem:''' It was the perfect excuse to drive up the price, that's why.
:;(Sennedjem and his men leave)
:{{A|vo nkeq103 8 ashvapati 44.ogg}} '''Ashvapati:''' It was only later that I found out, this wasn't the first time [[Sennedjem]] and his men had turned around and stabbed their allies in the back. Let's just say... there was a good reason they had nowhere else to turn back then.
:{{A|vo nkeq103 8 ashvapati 45.ogg}} '''Ashvapati:''' I didn't chase after them or try to hold them accountable. In that moment, all I could think about was saving as many people as I could in a desperate attempt to atone for my sins.
:{{A|vo nkeq103 8 ashvapati 46.ogg}} '''Ashvapati:''' But once the weapons I designed were turned against us, the fate of this place was sealed... even I could do nothing to prevent it.
:{{A|vo nkeq103 8 ashvapati 47.ogg}} '''Ashvapati:''' In the end, despite all the burning tents I rushed into, I was only able to save three children.
:{{A|vo nkeq103 8 ashvapati 48.ogg}} '''Ashvapati:''' And now you know the full account of my crimes.
:;(Flashback ends)<!-- black screen transition -->

:{{A|vo nkeq103 9 ashvapati 01.ogg}} '''Ashvapati:''' I've been raising them ever since, while attempting to hunt down the men who made them orphans in the first place.
:{{A|vo nkeq103 9 ashvapati 02.ogg}} '''Ashvapati:''' This confession is for the kids to read too, so I hope you'll pass it along to them. They deserve to know the full truth of what happened.
:{{A|vo nkeq103 9 ashvapati 03.ogg}} '''Ashvapati:''' I know I'm in no position to make requests, but... please help them find loving parents to take them in. Above all else, they deserve a true family.
:{{A|vo nkeq103 9 ashvapati 04.ogg}} '''Ashvapati:''' Back then, I failed to see this through to the end. But I won't make that mistake again.
:{{A|vo nkeq103 9 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Geez, if this is true...
:{{A|vo nkeq103 9 yelan 01.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' He's after the same target as us... and he's out for revenge.
:{{A|vo nkeq103 9 chevreuse 01.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' He even lured us to Nod-Krai to help him get it.
:{{A|vo nkeq103 9 yelan 02.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' I think I know what he's planning to do with those ballistas now. If I'm right, this doesn't bode well.
:{{A|vo nkeq103 9 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Then we need to find him ASAP! It sounds like he's about to do something super dangerous, but we promised the kids we'd bring him back safe.
:{{A|vo nkeq103 9 chevreuse 02.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' I can't just let him get rid of our target either. This crime ring runs deep. There are still many other conspirators we need to track down.
:{{DIcon}} So where do we go to find him?
:{{A|vo nkeq103 9 yelan 03.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' Hmm...
:{{A|vo nkeq103 9 chevreuse 03.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' Oh?
:{{A|vo nkeq103 9 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You got something?
:{{A|vo nkeq103 9 yelan 04.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' He knew we'd be out of the picture investigating this place... I think he decided to spring the trap that we set up.
:{{DIcon}} He's gonna ambush the target when he comes to pick up the goods...
:{{A|vo nkeq103 9 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, snap! He's not working for them, so our original plan could've worked all along!
:{{A|vo nkeq103 9 chevreuse 04.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' The meeting will be happening any time now. Quick, we need to head to the rendezvous point.
----
;(Approach the marked location)
:{{A|vo nkeq103 10 sennedjem 01.ogg}} '''Sennedjem:''' Ashvapati?
:{{A|vo nkeq103 10 ashvapati 01.ogg}} '''Ashvapati:''' It's been a while, Sennedjem. Over a decade at least...
:{{A|vo nkeq103 10 sennedjem 02.ogg}} '''Sennedjem:''' How did you find this place?
:{{A|vo nkeq103 10 ashvapati 02.ogg}} '''Ashvapati:''' All these years, and the signal you use for the meet-up point still hasn't changed. All I had to do was pose as your point of contact, and fish a time and date out of that scout you sent.
:{{A|vo nkeq103 10 sennedjem 03.ogg}} '''Sennedjem:''' Useless bunch of idiots... Just wait until my backup gets here.
:{{A|vo nkeq103 10 ashvapati 03.ogg}} '''Ashvapati:''' Oh, I think that might take a while. The Fontaine and Liyue authorities have your men locked down tight... Every last one.
:{{A|vo nkeq103 10 sennedjem 04.ogg}} '''Sennedjem:''' No... There's no way the cops could have known we'd be here.
:{{A|vo nkeq103 10 ashvapati 04.ogg}} '''Ashvapati:''' Unless, of course, someone deliberately left a trail of clues leading them straight to the expo. That would be a different story, now wouldn't it?
:{{A|vo nkeq103 10 ashvapati 05.ogg}} '''Ashvapati:''' If they hadn't taken your agents out of the equation, I doubt I would've been able to lure you here.
:{{A|vo nkeq103 10 sennedjem 05.ogg}} '''Sennedjem:''' Hmph, so now what? You gonna turn me in too?
:{{A|vo nkeq103 10 ashvapati 06.ogg}} '''Ashvapati:''' No. The authorities can have your men. But you're mine.
:;(A barrier appears around Ashvapati, Sennedjem, and his men)
:{{A|vo nkeq103 10 sennedjem 06.ogg}} '''Sennedjem:''' Is that Fatui tech? Looks like your skills are as good as ever.
:{{A|vo nkeq103 10 sennedjem 07.ogg}} '''Sennedjem:''' Listen, I know you're mad that I've been racking up Mora without you all these years. But it looks like you still got it. If you want back in, we can work something out.
:{{A|vo nkeq103 10 ashvapati 07.ogg}} '''Ashvapati:''' After everything that happened, what makes you think I would want back in?
:{{A|vo nkeq103 10 sennedjem 08.ogg}} '''Sennedjem:''' Because what's the alternative? ...You're not here for revenge, are you?
:{{A|vo nkeq103 10 sennedjem 09.ogg}} '''Sennedjem:''' After Khaemwaset took you in, you really convinced yourself you were one of them, huh...
:{{A|vo nkeq103 10 sennedjem 10.ogg}} '''Sennedjem:''' What you should have learned is that banking on "loyalty" and "belonging" is a losing hand. Better to cash out before you're in the hole.
:{{A|vo nkeq103 10 sennedjem 11.ogg}} '''Sennedjem:''' In the desert, my people live by one rule and one rule alone — the last laugh doesn't go to the righteous... it belongs to the one who knows how to cut their losses.
:{{A|vo nkeq103 10 sennedjem 12.ogg}} '''Sennedjem:''' Just look at me. When there's Mora to be earned in the desert, I'm a desert folk. When the opportunities in Fontaine are sweeter, I'm a Fontainian.
:{{A|vo nkeq103 10 ashvapati 08.ogg}} '''Ashvapati:''' You think everyone is as much of a lowlife as you?
:{{A|vo nkeq103 10 sennedjem 13.ogg}} '''Sennedjem:''' A lowlife? Heh, there's nothing Mora can't buy, Ashvapati... that includes prestige.
:{{A|vo nkeq103 10 sennedjem 14.ogg}} '''Sennedjem:''' You're talking to a renowned Fontainian philanthropist who lives in the Vasari Passage and spends his days going from one grand banquet to the next. Nobody who counts would dare call me a lowlife!
:{{A|vo nkeq103 10 ashvapati 09.ogg}} '''Ashvapati:''' Are you done?
:{{A|vo nkeq103 10 sennedjem 15.ogg}} '''Sennedjem:''' Tch... Clearly, there's no reasoning with you. Fine. Have it your way.
:{{A|vo nkeq103 10 sennedjem 16.ogg}} '''Sennedjem:''' But if you want me dead so bad, why'd you come to face me alone? That wasn't the wisest decision, now, was it?
:{{A|vo nkeq103 10 ashvapati 10.ogg}} '''Ashvapati:''' Oh, don't you worry — I brought plenty of firepower with me. You could've brought a whole army for all I care. These weapons will bury every last one of you!
:;(Projectiles begin to fly up into the sky from afar)
:{{A|vo nkeq103 10 sennedjem 17.ogg}} '''Sennedjem:''' What the... Are you crazy!? If that thing fires, you're not getting out of here alive either!
:{{A|vo nkeq103 10 ashvapati 11.ogg}} '''Ashvapati:''' Yes, that's the plan. It's high time both of us paid the price for our sins!
:{{A|vo nkeq103 10 sennedjem 18.ogg}} '''Sennedjem:''' He's lost his mind... Get him! Start breaking his bones until he removes this barrier!
:{{A|vo nkeq103 10 chevreuse 01.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' Hold it right there, all of you! Otherwise, I've got enough firepower to go around too!
:{{A|vo nkeq103 10 sennedjem 19.ogg}} '''Sennedjem:''' The Maison Gardiennage...
:{{A|vo nkeq103 10 ashvapati 12.ogg}} '''Ashvapati:''' You got here sooner than I expected...
:{{A|vo nkeq103 10 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hey, what's that in the sky? Looks like bad news...
:{{A|vo nkeq103 10 chevreuse 02.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' Ashvapati, you have my word that these people will face the judgment of the Fontaine courts. Remove the barrier and come with us at once!
:{{A|vo nkeq103 10 ashvapati 13.ogg}} '''Ashvapati:''' Fontainian justice is too merciful for them... You should leave us.
:{{A|vo nkeq103 10 chevreuse 03.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' Stubborn fool...
:{{DIcon}} Ati, Neb, and Raya are waiting for you!
:{{A|vo nkeq103 10 ashvapati 14.ogg}} '''Ashvapati:''' I don't deserve them... I have to atone for the things I've done.
:{{A|vo nkeq103 10 yelan 01.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' What is it you feel you need to atone for? Weapons research?
:{{A|vo nkeq103 10 ashvapati 15.ogg}} '''Ashvapati:''' ...You're from Liyue, right? Your ancestors were the first people to master the recipe for gunpowder. And yet, they turned it into fireworks and firecrackers that even children could play with.
:{{A|vo nkeq103 10 ashvapati 16.ogg}} '''Ashvapati:''' Surely, it's choices like that which make Liyue what it is today... I hear that it's a very peaceful place to live for the most part.
:{{A|vo nkeq103 10 ashvapati 17.ogg}} '''Ashvapati:''' But me? I chose to use my research skills to create weapons of war that brought death to countless people and destroyed the only home those kids had... That's why I have to atone. Because I have blood on my hands.
:{{A|vo nkeq103 10 yelan 02.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' Sounds like you don't know as much as you think about fireworks. They might be harmless fun in this day and age, but they started out as weapons too, y'know.
:{{A|vo nkeq103 10 ashvapati 18.ogg}} '''Ashvapati:''' ...What?
:{{A|vo nkeq103 10 yelan 03.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' That's right. Fireworks and firecrackers were originally developed for use as weapons. They needed something a little more powerful than usual for purging evil forces and scaring off wild beasts.
:{{A|vo nkeq103 10 yelan 04.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' Over time, evil spirits learned to fear the sight of flames, and the beasts retreated into the mountains. That's when people started repurposing fireworks for entertainment purposes.
:{{A|vo nkeq103 10 yelan 05.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' The peace we enjoy today isn't because we chose to make toys instead of weapons.
:{{A|vo nkeq103 10 yelan 06.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' The weapons are what secured us the peace in the first place. Only then did we have the luxury of choosing to turn them into toys instead.
:{{A|vo nkeq103 10 yelan 07.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' It's people, not weapons, that commit acts of evil. And when people are as bent on destruction as the evil forces and beasts faced by our forebears, whatever tools they have at their disposal end up as weapons.
:{{A|vo nkeq103 10 ashvapati 19.ogg}} '''Ashvapati:''' ...Time is running out. Please, leave while you still can.
:{{A|vo nkeq103 10 yelan 08.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' Relax. Now that we have these guys in custody, I think we can find a way of repurposing these ballistas for the children's amusement.

:{{A|vo nkeq103 11 ashvapati 01.ogg}} '''Ashvapati:''' I never imagined the Guizhong Ballista could be used for something so beautiful...
:{{DIcon}} I saw this coming.
:{{DIcon}} I didn't see this coming, either.
:{{A|vo nkeq103 11 chevreuse 01.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' If you'll agree to come with us and answer some questions, it would be a big help to our investigation.
:{{A|vo nkeq103 11 ashvapati 02.ogg}} '''Ashvapati:''' Of course. You'll have my full cooperation. I know I'm guilty, just... not sure of the precise crime at this point.
:{{A|vo nkeq103 11 chevreuse 02.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' Honestly, me neither. I'm sure a case like yours would have Fontaine's top legal experts scratching their heads.
:{{A|vo nkeq103 11 chevreuse 03.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' As for these arms dealers, though... I can confidently say that none of them will be getting away with this. So at least you can take some solace in that.
:{{A|vo nkeq103 11 chevreuse 04.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' I know, there's no sentence the court can give them that will satisfy you. But at least the trial will be a public declaration of their crimes and the punishment they will receive. The victims deserve that much.
:{{A|vo nkeq103 11 chevreuse 05.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' Considering the alternative was them dying in obscurity to a revenge-killing, with no one left behind to tell the story... This looks more like real justice to me.
:{{A|vo nkeq103 11 ashvapati 03.ogg}} '''Ashvapati:''' ...I guess you're right.

{{Quest Description|The Flower-Feather Clan's flying trials have officially started, but a shocking sight greets those at the site...}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Approach the quest area)
:{{A|vo qsklq003 1 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' The Flower-Feather Clan should be about ready to hold the new flying trials by now. Let's go check it out!

:{{A|vo qsklq003 2 chasca 02.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' Yeah... You'll see why soon enough.

Tracks Through the Wilderness Quest Still 1.png

:{{A|vo qsklq003 2 zhunan 01.ogg}} '''Zhunan:''' I feel light as a feather... Haha, I'm flying without a qucusaur!
:{{A|vo qsklq003 2 pachacuti 01.ogg}} '''Mukki:''' These Phlogiston Wings are awesome!
:{{A|vo qsklq003 2 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What the... What's going on!?
:{{A|vo qsklq003 2 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Paimon can barely believe her eyes... How did they fly all on their own?
:{{DIcon}} What happened while we were gone?
:{{A|vo qsklq003 2 chasca 03.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' The merchants we ran into that day were selling a product called "Phlogiston Wings."
:{{A|vo qsklq003 2 chasca 04.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' It's a flying machine worn on the back. To operate it, you just use a hand-held trackball that controls the flow of [[Gaseous Phlogiston|gaseous phlogiston]].
:{{A|vo qsklq003 2 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' That's incredible...
:{{A|vo qsklq003 2 chasca 05.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' Yeah. If our tribe — well, if Natlan mass-adopted this technology, it would revolutionize our mobility and responsiveness in times of crisis...
:{{A|vo qsklq003 2 chasca 06.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' ...Just think of the countless tragedies that could be averted.
:{{DIcon}} ...
:{{A|vo qsklq003 2 zhunan 02.ogg}} '''Zhunan:''' I... I feel like I'm dreaming... Did I really just... fly on my own? Without the help of a qucusaur?
:{{A|vo qsklq003 2 coyllur 02.ogg}} '''Coyllur:''' You'd better believe it! Plus, you just passed the flying trial! Right, Elder [[Allpa]]?
:{{A|vo qsklq003 2 allpa 02.ogg}} '''Allpa:''' ...
:{{A|vo qsklq003 2 zhunan 03.ogg}} '''Zhunan:''' ...Elder Allpa?
:{{A|vo qsklq003 2 pachacuti 02.ogg}} '''Mukki:''' Um... Should this really count as a pass, if we did the trial using Phlogiston Wings?
:{{A|vo qsklq003 2 coyllur 03.ogg}} '''Coyllur:''' Why not? The scoring rubric is about flying performance. It doesn't specifically say you have to ride a qucusaur, does it?
:{{A|vo qsklq003 2 pachacuti 03.ogg}} '''Mukki:''' Maybe, but... I mean, even Chasca had to ride a qucusaur in her trial, right? And the whole point of the trial is to test both your flying technique, and your ability to work with a saurian companion.
:{{A|vo qsklq003 2 coyllur 04.ogg}} '''Coyllur:''' Well, if we can fly by ourselves... maybe we don't to test the latter anymore.
:{{A|vo qsklq003 2 allpa 03.ogg}} '''Allpa:''' Chasca, {{Traveler}}, what are your thoughts on this new invention?
:{{DIcon}} It's a good innovation. The sooner it's widely adopted, the better.
::{{A|vo qsklq003 2 coyllur 05a 1.ogg}} '''Coyllur:''' You see! Even {{Traveler}} agrees!
:{{DIcon}} It's an unknown quantity. You should use it with caution.
::{{A|vo qsklq003 2 pachacuti 04b 1.ogg}} '''Mukki:''' Right? That's what I think, too...
:{{A|vo qsklq003 2 chasca 07.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' Hmm... I agree that they have strategic value. But I don't think it makes any sense to evaluate candidates by the current testing standards if they're using Phlogiston Wings.
:{{A|vo qsklq003 2 zhunan 04.ogg}} '''Zhunan:''' ...!
:{{A|vo qsklq003 2 coyllur 06.ogg}} '''Coyllur:''' Whyyy? [[Zhunan]] finally mustered the courage to go through with this, and now you're saying it doesn't count!?
:{{A|vo qsklq003 2 chasca 08.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' We don't have any experience using these wings in battle, nor is it immediately obvious how to incorporate them into the existing systems in our tribe.
:{{A|vo qsklq003 2 chasca 09.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' Taking a longer-term perspective, I think we need to start by getting thoroughly acquainted with how these things work. Then we can develop a new trial format with new assessment criteria, tailored to candidates using the Phlogiston Wings.
:{{A|vo qsklq003 2 allpa 04.ogg}} '''Allpa:''' Mmm... You all raise valid points. But Chasca, while your proposal sounds perfectly reasonable, it would probably take years to put it into practice.
:{{A|vo qsklq003 2 allpa 05.ogg}} '''Allpa:''' We lost so many people in that war... These Phlogiston Wings could be exactly what we need to strengthen our forces and boost morale in this trying time.
:{{A|vo qsklq003 2 allpa 06.ogg}} '''Allpa:''' And as for real-world battle experience... There will be plenty of opportunities to gain that. I have high hopes for you, Zhunan.
:{{A|vo qsklq003 2 zhunan 05.ogg}} '''Zhunan:''' Huh...
:{{A|vo qsklq003 2 coyllur 07.ogg}} '''Coyllur:''' Hey... Stop staring into space! Say "thank you"!
:{{A|vo qsklq003 2 zhunan 06.ogg}} '''Zhunan:''' Oh, uh — thank you! Thank you, Elder Allpa!
:{{A|vo qsklq003 2 allpa 07.ogg}} '''Allpa:''' You have nothing to thank me for. Remember... the way you got your wings back was by relying on yourself.
:{{A|vo qsklq003 2 warmi 01.ogg}} '''Warmi:''' ...Elder Allpa! Bad news — qucusaurs are attacking the merchants again!
:{{A|vo qsklq003 2 allpa 08.ogg}} '''Allpa:''' Again? Okay, everyone stay put while I— Hmm?
:{{Color|menu|Chasca runs out without saying a word.}}
:{{A|vo qsklq003 2 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh? Chasca...

;(After the cutscene)

:{{A|vo qsklq003 8 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Chasca... A—Are you okay?
:{{A|vo qsklq003 8 chasca 01.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' Phew... I'm fine, sorry for making you worry.
:{{DIcon}} You're not going to keep following her?
:{{A|vo qsklq003 8 chasca 02.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' No point. She's an expert at hiding her tracks. Once she's shaken you off, you'll never catch up to her.
:{{A|vo qsklq003 8 chasca 03.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' ...At least, I always used to lose to her at hide-and-seek when we were kids.
:{{DIcon}} When you were kids?
:{{A|vo qsklq003 8 chasca 04.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' Well, yeah. You know I was raised by qucusaurs. Anyway, she and I grew up in the nest together... her name's Coya, and she's my "big sister."
:{{A|vo qsklq003 8 chasca 05.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' We played together all the time, chasing each other through treetops, or mountaintops. It felt like it would go on that way forever... Until the day I was sent back to live with the humans.
:{{A|vo qsklq003 8 chasca 06.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' Not all qucusaurs are friendly towards people. Coya, for instance — she's fine with me, because we grew up around each other, but she's not fond of other humans.
:{{A|vo qsklq003 8 chasca 07.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' When "Mom" decided to send me away, Coya strongly protested, and after I left, she became more and more reluctant to interact with humans...
:{{A|vo qsklq003 8 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Maybe she thinks that... humans stole you away from her?
:{{A|vo qsklq003 8 chasca 08.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' ...It's a possibility. But in any case, we still stayed best friends at first.
:{{A|vo qsklq003 8 chasca 09.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' I had a hard time adjusting to life in the tribe, so whenever something went wrong, I'd run off into the wild and vent to Coya.
:{{A|vo qsklq003 8 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ah, so that's what Uncle [[Cusco]] was talking about. He said you seemed to prefer hanging out with [[saurian]]s to your own kind back then.
:{{A|vo qsklq003 8 chasca 10.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' Yeah, I did... but then gradually, everything changed. With a new mom and dad, a new tribe, and [[Chuychu]]...
:{{A|vo qsklq003 8 chasca 11.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' I started getting curious about these humans, and made an effort to understand their behavior. The more time I spent with them, the less I spent with Coya...
:{{A|vo qsklq003 8 chasca 12.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' And then, one day... it was Coya's turn to leave the nest. She sought me out and asked if I was willing to leave the tribe and go live in the wilderness with her.
:{{A|vo qsklq003 8 chasca 13.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' As far as I can remember... That was the first time she ever approached a human settlement on purpose.
:{{A|vo qsklq003 8 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So... how did you answer her?
:{{A|vo qsklq003 8 chasca 14.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' Well, I wouldn't be standing here talking to you if I'd said yes.
:{{DIcon}} In other words, you turned her down?
:{{A|vo qsklq003 8 chasca 15.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' No, I... I was torn. On the one hand, I'd already made up my mind to embrace my new family, and accept my human identity.
:{{A|vo qsklq003 8 chasca 16.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' But I also knew that Coya wasn't a fan of humans, and I didn't want to disappoint her... *sigh* She took my hesitation as an answer.
:{{A|vo qsklq003 8 chasca 17.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' She saw it as a personal betrayal, threw a huge fit, and then flew off. We hadn't seen each other since... until today.
:{{A|vo qsklq003 8 chasca 18.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' Not for lack of trying, though. I tried asking Mom where Coya's new nest was so I could talk things out with her. But Coya had already asked Mom not to tell me where she'd moved to.
:{{A|vo qsklq003 8 chasca 19.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' It must be hard for Mom, being stuck between her two daughters, so I didn't press the issue, and I didn't go looking for her.
:{{DIcon}} But after today's events...
:{{A|vo qsklq003 8 chasca 20.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' Mm, if things carry on like this, I need to make sure I find her before anyone else... Even if she doesn't want to see me.
:{{A|vo qsklq003 8 chasca 21.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' For now, let's bring the wounded back to the tribe, and see what [[Mutota]] and Elder Allpa have in mind.

:{{A|vo qsklq003 9 mutota 04.ogg}} '''Mutota:''' Chasca, to prevent things from deteriorating further, I'd like to task you with restoring peace to the tribe.

:{{A|vo qsklq003 9 mutota 05.ogg}} '''Mutota:''' {{Traveler}}, you've already done so much for Natlan, and the Flower-Feather Clan has no right to ask more of you, but...

:{{A|vo qsklq003 13 isidore 18.ogg}} '''Isidore:''' But the qucusaurs are have a natural ability to process gaseous phlogiston, so... if you use them as an intermediary, then...

:{{A|vo qsklq003 13 allpa 03.ogg}} '''Allpa:''' I don't believe it...
:{{A|vo qsklq003 13 chasca 16.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' Elder Allpa, does the name "Tepal" ring a bell to you? I feel like I've seen it written down before... maybe in a list of candidates for the flying trials.
:{{A|vo qsklq003 13 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh? So he's a member of your tribe, then?
:{{A|vo qsklq003 13 chasca 17.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' No... If he was a member of the Flower-Feather Clan, I'd definitely know him.

:{{A|vo qsklq003 13 allpa 05.ogg}} '''Allpa:''' ...Now that you mention it, I do remember a young man from outside our tribe who came to participate in our flying trials once.
:{{A|vo qsklq003 13 allpa 06.ogg}} '''Allpa:''' You were away on a mission at the time, which is probably why you don't remember him.
:{{A|vo qsklq003 13 allpa 07.ogg}} '''Allpa:''' He was a craftsman from the [[Children of Echoes]], but he'd always dreamed of soaring the skies. So he wanted to join our flying squad.

:{{A|vo qsklq003 13 allpa 08.ogg}} '''Allpa:''' But despite his best efforts, he unfortunately failed to pass the trial and gain the qucusaurs' approval.
:{{A|vo qsklq003 13 allpa 09.ogg}} '''Allpa:''' In the end, he went wingless, and returned dejected to the Children of Echoes.
:{{A|vo qsklq003 13 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wingless, huh... Maybe he invented the Phlogiston Wings to get revenge on the qucusaurs?
:{{A|vo qsklq003 13 allpa 10.ogg}} '''Allpa:''' Perhaps... or maybe it's simply his way of dealing with his regrets over his past flying endeavors.
:{{A|vo qsklq003 13 chasca 19.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' ...Either way, it doesn't excuse his abuse of the qucusaurs. I'm gonna take these guys back and expose the truth to the tribe. It's time for this conflict to end.
:{{A|vo qsklq003 13 isidore 21.ogg}} '''Isidore:''' Aah...!
:{{A|vo qsklq003 13 allpa 11.ogg}} '''Allpa:''' Easy, Chasca. Remember what I said about keeping a low profile?
:{{A|vo qsklq003 13 allpa 12.ogg}} '''Allpa:''' The ringleader still hasn't shown himself, and this man's allegation about powering the Phlogiston Wings with qucusaurs is only speculation.
:{{A|vo qsklq003 13 allpa 13.ogg}} '''Allpa:''' Bringing these men to the tribe now won't win over any current supporters of the Phlogiston Wings. In fact, it may even escalate the conflict further.
:{{A|vo qsklq003 13 allpa 14.ogg}} '''Allpa:''' ...After all, many are mistrustful of the qucusaurs after recent events.
:{{A|vo qsklq003 13 chasca 20.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' ...Is that why Tepal waited until now to try to capture my sister?
:{{A|vo qsklq003 13 isidore 22.ogg}} '''Isidore:''' I—I don't know! I mean, he did tell us to spread negative rumors about the qucusaurs, and slip some Mora to anyone opposed to them, but...
:{{A|vo qsklq003 13 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' But Coya only attacked humans because they stole her child!
:{{A|vo qsklq003 13 allpa 15.ogg}} '''Allpa:''' Nevertheless, we will be hard-pressed to change people's minds while emotions are running high — unless we have irrefutable evidence...

'''''Tread the Right Path''''' is the third part of {{Quest|Up! Toward Homecoming Wings}}.

==Steps==
# Awaken from the dream
# Follow [[Aguara]] to find [[Celaeno]]
# Continue following Aguara
# Talk to Celaeno
# Return to your room in [[The Flagship]] to rest
# Check out the training grounds
# Wait until the following day (08:00 – 12:00)
# Complete the fated duel
# Go to [[Natlan]] to complete the training
# Wait until the evening of the day after tomorrow (i.e. 20:00 in 2 days)
# Talk to Linnea
# Return to the [[Frostmoon Enclave]] to complete the finals
# Participate in the finals
# Complete the finals
# Give the post-match interview
# Say goodbye to Celaeno

==Gameplay Notes==
* After completing the quest, [[Viliana]] can be found at [[Mimisbrunnr Books]] in Nasha Town as a permanent open-world [[NPC]].
