:{{A|vo skklq005 3 skofnungr 01.ogg}} '''???:''' *coughing*...
:{{A|vo skklq005 3 skirk 01.ogg}} '''Skirk:''' Well, have you come to your senses?
:{{A|vo skklq005 3 skofnungr 02.ogg}} '''???:''' You saw that my body was at its limit. So, you deliberately channeled your power into me, knowing that it would destroy my shell from within...
:{{A|vo skklq005 3 skofnungr 03.ogg}} '''???:''' Such power, such keen battle instincts... So, you must be...
:{{A|vo skklq005 3 skirk 02.ogg}} '''Skirk:''' Skirk, Surtalogi's disciple.
:{{A|vo skklq005 3 skofnungr 04.ogg}} '''???:''' How long has it been? How long has he been away from Teyvat?
:{{A|vo skklq005 3 skirk 03.ogg}} '''Skirk:''' Hundreds of years.
:{{A|vo skklq005 3 skofnungr 05.ogg}} '''???:''' Hundreds...!? Hahaha...
:{{A|vo skklq005 3 skofnungr 06.ogg}} '''Skofnungr:''' Sorry, it's a lot to take in. I should introduce myself. I am Skofnungr, a friend of your master and one of his followers.
:{{A|vo skklq005 3 skofnungr 07.ogg}} '''Skofnungr:''' This is the first time I've heard your name, Skirk. But, hundreds of years ago, I knew you existed, and I knew you would come here.
:{{A|vo skklq005 3 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hundreds of years ago?
:{{A|vo skklq005 3 skirk 04.ogg}} '''Skirk:''' Sounds like you and Master have quite the history. Care to tell us about it?
:{{A|vo skklq005 3 skofnungr 08.ogg}} '''Skofnungr:''' Of course. Might as well take advantage of a clear head while I can. The story starts a long... long time ago.
:{{A|vo skklq005 3 skofnungr 09.ogg}} '''Skofnungr:''' I was born into a noble family in [[Khaenri'ah]]. As the eldest son, I was set to inherit our title. But, I contracted an incurable illness as a child, and everyone gave up on me.
:{{A|vo skklq005 3 skofnungr 10.ogg}} '''Skofnungr:''' I trained the sword harder than anyone else, defeated all of my peers, but it was all in vain. When other people looked at me, all I saw in their eyes was pity or a strange glee in my misfortune. Even my parents were just waiting for me to die.
:{{A|vo skklq005 3 skofnungr 11.ogg}} '''Skofnungr:''' Over time, my heart hardened, and I became aimless. That was the point where I met your master, Surtalogi.
:{{A|vo skklq005 3 skofnungr 12.ogg}} '''Skofnungr:''' We were similar in age, but different in background. He was born in prison, the son of criminals who had been sentenced to death. He spent his childhood wandering the streets facing more criticism than the literary works in the [[Universitas Magistrorum]].
:{{A|vo skklq005 3 skofnungr 13.ogg}} '''Skofnungr:''' Yet, he always wore a smile on his face, as if kindness and malice were one and the same, and he could not see the difference.
:{{A|vo skklq005 3 skofnungr 14.ogg}} '''Skofnungr:''' I still remember what he said to me when we first met: "You need to fight to survive. Even if it's a losing battle, it should light a fire under you. How can you sit back like this and go down without a fight?"
:{{A|vo skklq005 3 skirk 05.ogg}} '''Skirk:''' ...That does sound like something he would say.
:{{A|vo skklq005 3 skofnungr 15.ogg}} '''Skofnungr:''' He was the first to acknowledge that I was worth something, and he inspired me to keep going. When we sparred together, it was the first time I actually felt the thrill of combat.
:{{A|vo skklq005 3 skofnungr 16.ogg}} '''Skofnungr:''' When I was ten, he stole forbidden research materials and managed to cure my illness. It was like there was nothing in this world he couldn't accomplish... When it came to the human form, he was always intent on pushing the boundaries of possibility.
:{{A|vo skklq005 3 skofnungr 17.ogg}} '''Skofnungr:''' But, somewhere along the way, I fell behind. My talents were nothing compared to his, and at some point, I realized he had pulled so far ahead, I was too embarrassed to even ask him to spar.
:{{A|vo skklq005 3 skofnungr 18.ogg}} '''Skofnungr:''' After his "grand endeavor" was successful, he sought me out and said to me...
:{{A|vo skklq005 3 surtalogi 01.ogg}} '''Surtalogi:''' This planet no longer holds anything of interest to me, so I'm leaving. But first, I have an offer. I can use a power I have just refined to break the curse of immortality for you.
:{{A|vo skklq005 3 surtalogi 02.ogg}} '''Surtalogi:''' Your death was once what we worked so hard to prevent. But the "immortality" you now face is a different kind of pain altogether.
:{{A|vo skklq005 3 skofnungr 19.ogg}} '''Skofnungr:''' Hahaha... I'll pass. Immortality doesn't sound so bad to me. Since I can't die, it means I have an infinite amount of time to get stronger. Maybe I'll finally catch up to you one day, and we can spar like we used to.
:{{A|vo skklq005 3 surtalogi 03.ogg}} '''Surtalogi:''' Are you sure? I cannot say when I will return. Your body... Or rather, your soul might not be able to withstand this curse.
:{{A|vo skklq005 3 skofnungr 20.ogg}} '''Skofnungr:''' Haha... All I can do is try. After all, a wise man once told me, people need to fight for their own survival.
:{{A|vo skklq005 3 surtalogi 04.ogg}} '''Surtalogi:''' Wise indeed. Nevertheless, if you grow weary of the pain of immortality, and wish to experience a good sparring match before you wither away, seek out my disciple.
:{{A|vo skklq005 3 skofnungr 21.ogg}} '''Skofnungr:''' Disciple? Never thought I'd hear that word coming from you...
:{{A|vo skklq005 3 surtalogi 05.ogg}} '''Surtalogi:''' Nor I. But, [[Vedrfolnir]] said I was destined to find a disciple out there in the universe and bring her to Teyvat.
:{{A|vo skklq005 3 surtalogi 06.ogg}} '''Surtalogi:''' You know as well as I, Vedrfolnir's prophecies are never wrong.
:{{A|vo skklq005 3 skofnungr 22.ogg}} '''Skofnungr:''' Huh. Well, now I'm curious about who this disciple of yours will be...
:{{A|vo skklq005 3 surtalogi 07.ogg}} '''Surtalogi:''' All Vedrfolnir said was that, one day, "the stars shall bow in her honor."
:{{A|vo skklq005 3 skofnungr 23.ogg}} '''Skofnungr:''' Sounds pretty impressive.
:{{A|vo skklq005 3 surtalogi 08.ogg}} '''Surtalogi:''' Of course. Only the most outstanding people would have the right to become my disciple.
:{{A|vo skklq005 3 skofnungr 24.ogg}} '''Skofnungr:''' Hahaha... Still as self-assured as ever, I see. But, you're not wrong.
:{{A|vo skklq005 3 surtalogi 09.ogg}} '''Surtalogi:''' I'll be leaving, then. Oh, and if you're serious about getting stronger, I left you a little gift in the [[Primordial Sea]]. As I've said before — walk whatever path you want. Freedom means even the wicked get to make their own choices.
:{{A|vo skklq005 3 skofnungr 25.ogg}} '''Skofnungr:''' Waiting for me in the Primordial Sea was the All-Devouring Narwhal, already beaten into submission by Surtalogi. In its weakened state, I was able to cut off part of its flesh and sew it into my own heart.
:{{A|vo skklq005 3 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Y—Your heart? That sounds like torture... How did you even survive that?
:{{A|vo skklq005 3 skofnungr 26.ogg}} '''Skofnungr:''' Because, of course, I bear the curse of immortality.
:{{A|vo skklq005 3 skirk 06.ogg}} '''Skirk:''' So, you used the curse to turn yourself into a vessel for power.
:{{A|vo skklq005 3 skirk 07.ogg}} '''Skirk:''' Even with that whale's ability, devouring power like that is not something the human body can withstand. With your body and soul constantly at the breaking point, it was the curse of immortality that sustained you...
:{{A|vo skklq005 3 skirk 08.ogg}} '''Skirk:''' But, that is not the path to strength. You have to pour your heart into it, work for it, dream of it. Instead, you stole something that didn't belong to you — and it backfired.
:{{A|vo skklq005 3 skofnungr 27.ogg}} '''Skofnungr:''' You're right. I should have known better, but... I had already pushed myself to my limits, and he was still miles ahead of me. So, I had to take a leap of faith.
:{{A|vo skklq005 3 skofnungr 28.ogg}} '''Skofnungr:''' I miss your master. I miss the days when we were all together, troublemakers without a home. Argh... I don't regret the choice I made, but if you'll allow it, I do want to apologize... to both of you.
:{{A|vo skklq005 3 skirk 09.ogg}} '''Skirk:''' After the beating we just gave you, I think we can call it even.
:{{A|vo skklq005 3 skofnungr 29.ogg}} '''Skofnungr:''' Hahaha... You're an interesting one as well.
:{{A|vo skklq005 3 skofnungr 30.ogg}} '''Skofnungr:''' Surtalogi's disciple... That's a lot to live up to. It can't have been an easy experience.
:{{A|vo skklq005 3 skofnungr 31.ogg}} '''Skofnungr:''' I know what he's like. He rules with an iron fist, using despair and fear to force you to catch up to him, all the while standing ever out of reach.
:{{A|vo skklq005 3 skofnungr 32.ogg}} '''Skofnungr:''' We're like mountain climbers in the dark — never knowing how much higher we have to climb, or when we will see the sun again.
:{{A|vo skklq005 3 skirk 10.ogg}} '''Skirk:''' True. But, I made up my mind long ago — no matter how dark it gets, I will not give in to despair. I will overcome it.
:{{A|vo skklq005 3 skirk 11.ogg}} '''Skirk:''' Besides, after hearing your story, I suspect what Master really wants is not a battle that demands his full strength, but rather... a defeat without regrets.
:{{A|vo skklq005 3 skofnungr 33.ogg}} '''Skofnungr:''' Oh?
:{{A|vo skklq005 3 skirk 12.ogg}} '''Skirk:''' Since you're his friend, you must have some things in common.
:{{A|vo skklq005 3 skirk 13.ogg}} '''Skirk:''' The first time we came here, when you stabbed me through the fog and stole my power, I felt no emotion coming from that spike.
:{{A|vo skklq005 3 skirk 14.ogg}} '''Skirk:''' But, when you had to devote all your strength fighting me just now, I could feel joy and passion emanating from your blade.
:{{A|vo skklq005 3 skirk 15.ogg}} '''Skirk:''' It was the joy of a researcher discovering the truth of the world, the joy of an artist uncovering a temple of wonders...
:{{A|vo skklq005 3 skofnungr 34.ogg}} '''Skofnungr:''' Interesting... I'm certain I didn't express those emotions outright, yet you were able to read them from my blade... like a glimpse into my inner world.
:{{A|vo skklq005 3 skofnungr 35.ogg}} '''Skofnungr:''' You're right. That battle brought me an unbridled sense of joy. And my defeat brings me no regret whatsoever.
:{{A|vo skklq005 3 skirk 16.ogg}} '''Skirk:''' Exactly. I think Master also craves a battle like that.
:{{A|vo skklq005 3 skirk 17.ogg}} '''Skirk:''' One where his opponent forces him to use all his strength, unlock the extent of his potential, and transcend his own limits — a battle to end all battles.
:{{A|vo skklq005 3 skirk 18.ogg}} '''Skirk:''' After which, all can come to an end... including, perhaps, his life.
:{{A|vo skklq005 3 skirk 19.ogg}} '''Skirk:''' For that very reason, good and evil are meaningless to him. He has one purpose, one goal — to complete himself. It's one of the secrets to his strength.
:{{A|vo skklq005 3 skofnungr 36.ogg}} '''Skofnungr:''' Perhaps you're right. Perhaps that is his goal.
:{{A|vo skklq005 3 skofnungr 37.ogg}} '''Skofnungr:''' What a battle that would be! Oh, to witness such a—
:{{A|vo skklq005 3 skofnungr 38.ogg}} '''Skofnungr:''' *cough*
:{{A|vo skklq005 3 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Are you okay!?
:{{A|vo skklq005 3 skofnungr 39.ogg}} '''Skofnungr:''' Too many different kinds of power are surging through my body. The curse of immortality allows it all to coexist, but it does not remove the pain.
:{{A|vo skklq005 3 skofnungr 40.ogg}} '''Skofnungr:''' I won't be able to hold onto my sanity for much longer... What a shame. I would have loved to witness that battle.
:{{A|vo skklq005 3 skofnungr 41.ogg}} '''Skofnungr:''' Surtalogi once offered to free me from this curse. Now, I must ask that of you, Skirk. Can you release me from the pain?
:{{A|vo skklq005 3 skirk 20.ogg}} '''Skirk:''' I can. But, not through death, if that's what you are hoping for.
:{{A|vo skklq005 3 skirk 21.ogg}} '''Skirk:''' It's not a suitable punishment for your crime. As an alternative, I can take your consciousness, along with all the power you've consumed, and smash it to pieces.
:{{A|vo skklq005 3 skirk 22.ogg}} '''Skirk:''' The impurities will dissipate, and under the curse of immortality, your mind and body will regenerate. When that process is complete, you will be back to who you were before, no longer tortured by powers you can't control.
:{{A|vo skklq005 3 skirk 23.ogg}} '''Skirk:''' But, it will be a time-consuming and painful process. The decision is yours to make.
:{{A|vo skklq005 3 skofnungr 42.ogg}} '''Skofnungr:''' I accept. And who knows? Perhaps I'll wake up in time to witness your great battle with Surtalogi.
:{{A|vo skklq005 3 skofnungr 43.ogg}} '''Skofnungr:''' I have faith that you will be able to stand against him one day. Though I know it will be a long and arduous road.
:{{A|vo skklq005 3 skofnungr 44.ogg}} '''Skofnungr:''' If we are climbers in the dark, it appears the dawn has finally broken for me, but your ascent continues.
:{{A|vo skklq005 3 skofnungr 45.ogg}} '''Skofnungr:''' (Haha. At least, it looks like you... are not alone on your journey.)
:{{A|vo skklq005 3 skirk 24.ogg}} '''Skirk:''' I will reach the top of this mountain, no matter what it takes.
:{{A|vo skklq005 3 skirk 25.ogg}} '''Skirk:''' And you, Skofnungr, will be my witness... at the end of all things.

;(After leaving together)
:{{A|vo skklq005 5 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' We did it! Whew... It's only been a few days, but it feels like forever.
:{{A|vo skklq005 5 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Once again, we've proved there's nothing we can't overcome! We're just that awesome.
:{{DIcon}} I didn't even break a sweat.
:{{A|vo skklq005 5 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wow, you sound even more confident than usual. Guess you really have become stronger!
:{{A|vo skklq005 5 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Today sure went by fast. It's night already! Oh, wait! That reminds Paimon... The stars you mentioned, the ones that died out, are they back now?
:{{A|vo skklq005 5 skirk 01.ogg}} '''Skirk:''' Yes, the power Skofnungr stole has been returned. So, the stars have regained their light.
:{{A|vo skklq005 5 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Great!
:{{A|vo skklq005 5 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh, it's crazy that you even noticed their light was gone! There are so many stars in the sky, if a few disappeared, Paimon definitely wouldn't be able to tell.
:{{A|vo skklq005 5 skirk 02.ogg}} '''Skirk:''' I suppose it's because... I have gazed upon this sky for centuries.
:{{A|vo skklq005 5 skirk 03.ogg}} '''Skirk:''' The false stars hanging in the meticulously planned sky, glittering with rotten light...
:{{A|vo skklq005 5 skirk 04.ogg}} '''Skirk:''' It's not real, and yet... it is for that very reason that I can look upon it and enjoy the momentary peace it brings.
:{{DIcon}} It's beautiful. I agree.
:{{DIcon}} I'd like to see what it's like up there.
:{{A|vo skklq005 5 skirk 05.ogg}} '''Skirk:''' Even the most beautiful of bubbles has to burst. We will return to the real universe one day, whether of our own volition or not.
:{{A|vo skklq005 5 skirk 06.ogg}} '''Skirk:''' Time marches ever forward. Even the innocent and naive will taste life's bitterness. Yet, through hardship, we grow, until we learn to seize the sands of time for ourselves, and uncover our true strength.
:{{A|vo skklq005 5 skirk 07.ogg}} '''Skirk:''' Though we gaze upon a [[False Sky|false sky]], its vastness and majesty is palpable. One can only wonder... what is it going to take for kindness to reign supreme in the vast expanse of the universe?
:{{A|vo skklq005 5 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Um, this is all going over Paimon's head, but if she knows one thing, it's that {{Traveler}} always finds a way.
:{{A|vo skklq005 5 paimon 08a.ogg}} {{A|vo skklq005 5 paimon 08b.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ever since we met, {{MC|m=he|f=she}} has filled Paimon's days with happiness. No matter how tough things get, {{MC|m=he|f=she}} always finds a way to make it better.
:{{A|vo skklq005 5 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' If it's too big a job for one person, then we'll do it with two. And if two's still not enough, then three!
:{{A|vo skklq005 5 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' We've met so many amazing friends, and accomplished so many amazing things! As long as we don't give up, we can make any wish come true!
:{{A|vo skklq005 5 skirk 08.ogg}} '''Skirk:''' I suppose, when it comes to you, anything is possible.
:{{A|vo skklq005 5 skirk 09.ogg}} '''Skirk:''' ...Well, I should be going. Now that my power is no longer isolated from my emotions, I need more practice to get used to it.
:{{DIcon}} When will we meet again?
:{{A|vo skklq005 5 skirk 10.ogg}} '''Skirk:''' I suppose fate will decide. Maybe we'll bump into each other on the street... or maybe we'll reunite on a different planet entirely.
:{{A|vo skklq005 5 skirk 11.ogg}} '''Skirk:''' Regardless, reunions and partings are but passing moments. More than anything, I hope that, at the end of this journey — wherever it takes us — we stand in a world reborn.
:{{A|vo skklq005 5 skirk 12.ogg}} '''Skirk:''' One without war, pain, or forced partings... One where new life can bloom, even where there was once nothing but scorched earth.
:{{A|vo skklq005 5 skirk 13.ogg}} '''Skirk:''' For this, we must all work to become stronger.
:{{DIcon}} Of course.
::{{A|vo skklq005 5 skirk 14a 1.ogg}} '''Skirk:''' Goodbye, {{Traveler}}. Remember your training. Make sure to put it to use.
:{{DIcon}} Of course... Master.
::{{A|vo skklq005 5 skirk 14b 1.ogg}} '''Skirk:''' ...If that's what you wanna call me, I won't object. Goodbye.
:{{A|vo skklq005 5 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Bye!
:{{A|vo skklq005 5 paimon 12.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Is it just Paimon, or is she being... nicer than before? We definitely count as friends after all that, don't you think?
:{{A|vo skklq005 5 paimon 13.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hey, what do you think about camping here tonight? There's nothing quite like sleeping under the stars!
:{{A|vo skklq005 5 paimon 14.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Come tomorrow, we can continue our journey! Oh, and since Paimon treated you to that super nice meal at Wanmin Restaurant, it's about time you returned the favor!
{{Dialogue End}}

;(Approach the marked location)
:{{A|vo sgwlq003 1 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' It's Officer Morgane, they're already here!

:{{A|vo sgwlq003 1 morgane 02.ogg}} '''Morgane:''' It's open. Let's go in.

:{{A|vo sgwlq003 1 dupont 01.ogg}} '''Dupont:''' Captain, up ahead! Those look like our fugitives!
:{{A|vo sgwlq003 1 morgane 03.ogg}} '''Morgane:''' So they found this place too... Don't let any of them escape!

:{{A|vo sgwlq003 2 sigewinne 01.ogg}} '''Sigewinne:''' Mr. Odilon, didn't I tell you a few days ago that you need to stop all field work until you've recovered?
:{{A|vo sgwlq003 2 lazare 03.ogg}} '''"Odilon":''' Ah, well, y'know... Gotta help His Grace out, share the load! *coughing*

:{{A|vo sgwlq003 5 morgane 01.ogg}} '''Morgane:''' Freeze! Marechaussee Phantom!
:{{A|vo sgwlq003 5 potton 10.ogg}} '''Potton:''' What? Who let them in?
:{{A|vo sgwlq003 5 sigewinne 01.ogg}} '''Sigewinne:''' Officer Morgane, before anything else, please find out Rawat's status.
:{{A|vo sgwlq003 5 potton 11.ogg}} '''Potton:''' Rawat...
:{{A|vo sgwlq003 5 morgane 02.ogg}} '''Morgane:''' I don't see him... Hand over the hostage now, if you want any chance of avoiding an extension to your sentences.
:{{A|vo sgwlq003 5 potton 12.ogg}} '''Potton:''' Hahaha... Spare us your condescending attempts to coax us back to our cells! You think we're looking to negotiate? Rawat is dead!
:{{A|vo sgwlq003 5 sigewinne 02.ogg}} '''Sigewinne:''' Potton...
:{{A|vo sgwlq003 5 morgane 03.ogg}} '''Morgane:''' Arrest them all! Don't let anyone get away!

;(After defeating the enemies)
:{{A|vo sgwlq003 6 morgane 01.ogg}} '''Morgane:''' Gotta say, I never expected to see the head nurse in combat...
:{{A|vo sgwlq003 6 sigewinne 01.ogg}} '''Sigewinne:''' Some patients respond better to a more aggressive treatment plan. Did we get everyone?
:{{A|vo sgwlq003 6 dupond 01.ogg}} '''Dupond:''' Captain, we've finished the headcount — Potton's missing...
:{{A|vo sgwlq003 6 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Over there! The door's closing!
:{{Color|menu|As the exit gate locks into place, you realize that Potton escaped to the control room in the chaos.}}
:{{A|vo sgwlq003 6 potton 01.ogg}} '''Potton:''' Hah, one group trying to arrest me, another trying to hunt me down... Good, I get to kill two birds with one stone.
:{{A|vo sgwlq003 6 morgane 02.ogg}} '''Morgane:''' How did he get up there? There must be a secret passage somewhere. Find it!
:{{A|vo sgwlq003 6 potton 02.ogg}} '''Potton:''' Don't waste your energy. I already sealed it off.
:{{A|vo sgwlq003 6 morgane 03.ogg}} '''Morgane:''' How naive. We have more people outside. If we're not back out by the agreed time, they'll come to our rescue.
:{{A|vo sgwlq003 6 potton 03.ogg}} '''Potton:''' Well then, you'd better hope they get here in time!
:{{A|vo sgwlq003 6 sigewinne 02.ogg}} '''Sigewinne:''' There's some kind of gas leaking from the pipes... Be careful, it's poisonous.
:{{A|vo sgwlq003 6 potton 04.ogg}} '''Potton:''' This is our distribution center, where we store the product derived from our source solution. We had to use special fire prevention methods to prevent contamination.
:{{A|vo sgwlq003 6 potton 05.ogg}} '''Potton:''' The pipe network here was designed to emit a gas for firefighting. One little modification later, and it makes an efficient death trap.
:{{A|vo sgwlq003 6 sigewinne 03.ogg}} '''Sigewinne:''' Why would you do this? Your partners are here too.
:{{A|vo sgwlq003 6 potton 06.ogg}} '''Potton:''' Oh, please. If they can't supply what I need, they're of no further use to me. Besides, I can't have them exposing my potential whereabouts.
:{{A|vo sgwlq003 6 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' He's a maniac... C'mon, we've gotta find a way to open that door!
:{{A|vo sgwlq003 6 potton 07.ogg}} '''Potton:''' Go ahead, struggle in vain. Once the last of you croaks, no one will ever find me again. So long!
:{{A|vo sgwlq003 6 sigewinne 04.ogg}} '''Sigewinne:''' Are you sure you're ready to leave, Potton? You haven't changed your dressing today.
:{{A|vo sgwlq003 6 potton 08.ogg}} '''Potton:''' ...You can't cure my face. Just give up.
:{{A|vo sgwlq003 6 sigewinne 05.ogg}} '''Sigewinne:''' And what if I could?
:{{A|vo sgwlq003 6 potton 09.ogg}} '''Potton:''' Hmph... Nice try, you're just trying to stall me. Don't you worry about me, I'll find a way to cure my face once I get out of here.
:{{A|vo sgwlq003 6 sigewinne 06.ogg}} '''Sigewinne:''' Oh, I doubt it. After all, Fontainians can no longer dissolve in [[Primordial Seawater]].
:{{A|vo sgwlq003 6 potton 10.ogg}} '''Potton:''' What the... How did you...!?
:{{A|vo sgwlq003 6 sigewinne 07.ogg}} '''Sigewinne:''' The key component of the face-changing potion is the fluid left behind by dissolved Fontainians. It might look like ordinary water, but it has some unique elements in it.
:{{A|vo sgwlq003 6 sigewinne 08.ogg}} '''Sigewinne:''' Before the flood, all Fontainians were [[Oceanid]]s, physiologically speaking.
:{{A|vo sgwlq003 6 sigewinne 09.ogg}} '''Sigewinne:''' A potion made from that fluid could dissolve and reconstruct the face of a Fontainian, in much the same way as [[Hydro Eidolon]]s change form.
:{{A|vo sgwlq003 6 sigewinne 10.ogg}} '''Sigewinne:''' Theoretically, it could give someone any appearance they wished.
:{{A|vo sgwlq003 6 sigewinne 11.ogg}} '''Sigewinne:''' But since the flood, Fontainians have become true humans. They can no longer provide the source material for this potion, nor reap its benefits.
:{{A|vo sgwlq003 6 morgane 04.ogg}} '''Morgane:''' Are you saying... this potion is made from Fontainians dissolved with Primordial Seawater? Then their crimes are far worse than I thought...
:{{A|vo sgwlq003 6 potton 11.ogg}} '''Potton:''' How could you know all of this? No, wait... Hahaha, of course! Well, well. So that's why you have a human appearance.
:{{A|vo sgwlq003 6 sigewinne 12.ogg}} '''Sigewinne:''' It also means that I have a formula you're unaware of. *cough* ...The air's getting thicker... It's getting hard to breathe.
:{{Color|menu|Hearing the conversation, Potton temporarily closes the pipe valve.}}
:{{A|vo sgwlq003 6 potton 12.ogg}} '''Potton:''' Heh, I might get to make a deal today after all. Alright, keep talking. How do you intend to give me the formula?
:{{A|vo sgwlq003 6 sigewinne 13.ogg}} '''Sigewinne:''' Oh, it's not a formula, but a finished product. I have a bottle of it right here.
:{{A|vo sgwlq003 6 potton 13.ogg}} '''Potton:''' What?
:{{A|vo sgwlq003 6 sigewinne 14.ogg}} '''Sigewinne:''' When I tried Rawat's skincare product, I noticed it had a certain special component in it. So I had my friends gather some other ingredients for me, and sure enough, a little experimenting later, I'd produced the potion.
:{{A|vo sgwlq003 6 sigewinne 15.ogg}} '''Sigewinne:''' I'm guessing his skincare lotion contains the fruits of your joint research?
:{{A|vo sgwlq003 6 potton 14.ogg}} '''Potton:''' Huh. Impressive guesswork. Yeah, we were his supplier for some of the raw ingredients.
:{{A|vo sgwlq003 6 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' *gasp*
:{{A|vo sgwlq003 6 potton 15.ogg}} '''Potton:''' But it only contains a tiny amount of the active ingredient. The effect is miniscule compared to the undiluted fluid.
:{{A|vo sgwlq003 6 sigewinne 16.ogg}} '''Sigewinne:''' Well, I found a way to reverse the dilution process, giving the skincare lotion a similar effect to the fluid it is derived from.
:{{A|vo sgwlq003 6 potton 16.ogg}} '''Potton:''' That's impossible...
:{{A|vo sgwlq003 6 sigewinne 17.ogg}} '''Sigewinne:''' If I tell you some of the ingredients, I think you can figure it out. First, you need to combine [[Tainted Hydro Phantasm]] tissue with [[Transoceanic Pearl]]s at a ratio of around three to seven.
:{{A|vo sgwlq003 6 potton 17.ogg}} '''Potton:''' Tainted Hydro Phantasms and Transoceanic Pearls? Ah, I see... Can't believe I never thought of that...
:{{A|vo sgwlq003 6 sigewinne 18.ogg}} '''Sigewinne:''' So. Can we make a deal?
:{{A|vo sgwlq003 6 potton 18.ogg}} '''Potton:''' Sounds good to me. There's a delivery pipeline beneath this window. Drop the potion in, and I'll release you all.
:{{A|vo sgwlq003 6 sigewinne 19.ogg}} '''Sigewinne:''' Nope, not trusting you that easily. You're like those naughty kids who try to hide their illness. Open the sluice gate first, then I'll hand you the potion.
:{{A|vo sgwlq003 6 potton 19.ogg}} '''Potton:''' Hmph. Even if you're not bluffing, your potion won't cure my face permanently... You really think you have any leverage here?
:{{Color|menu|Potton restarts the valve, and the poison gas begins leaking once more...}}
:{{A|vo sgwlq003 6 potton 20.ogg}} '''Potton:''' I'm not closing the valve this time. Clock's ticking.
:{{A|vo sgwlq003 6 sigewinne 20.ogg}} '''Sigewinne:''' Fine, then I'll just stand here with the potion in my hand. And when I faint from the poison, I'll drop it and it'll be destroyed.
:{{A|vo sgwlq003 6 potton 21.ogg}} '''Potton:''' No...
:{{Color|menu|Potton hesitates for a moment, but finally chooses to raise the gate.}}
:{{A|vo sgwlq003 6 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' It's open!
:{{A|vo sgwlq003 6 morgane 05.ogg}} '''Morgane:''' Disable that sluice gate! Jam it! Don't let it close again!
:{{A|vo sgwlq003 6 sigewinne 21.ogg}} '''Sigewinne:''' That's more like it. In that case, a promise is a promise.
:{{Color|menu|Sigewinne places the potion she is holding into the delivery pipeline.}}
:{{A|vo sgwlq003 6 morgane 06.ogg}} '''Morgane:''' Head Nurse, there's too much poison gas in here. We have to leave, now!

;(After leaving the domain)
:{{A|vo sgwlq003 7 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Phew... That was too close! That Potton is a real nasty piece of work...
:{{A|vo sgwlq003 7 sigewinne 01.ogg}} '''Sigewinne:''' Don't be too quick to sit down. Moving around a little will help relieve the soreness.
:{{A|vo sgwlq003 7 sigewinne 02.ogg}} '''Sigewinne:''' Same goes for you, {{Traveler}}. But Paimon, you should be fine, right?
:{{A|vo sgwlq003 7 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Flying fast is pretty tiring too, actually! Anyway, that's not important right now. Paimon's still shocked to learn that there was a whole criminal operation going on behind that skincare lotion.
:{{A|vo sgwlq003 7 sigewinne 03.ogg}} '''Sigewinne:''' Shame I ended up giving the improved version to Potton after finally making it for you... I'll make you some more, I promise.
:{{A|vo sgwlq003 7 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' No no no, please don't... Paimon doesn't wanna use that stuff anymore. Still, it was a pretty good job that Paimon wanted to buy some in the first place, huh? It ended up saving everyone's lives! That's gotta count for something.
:{{DIcon}} Sigewinne was the one doing the saving.
:{{A|vo sgwlq003 7 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yeah, yeah, Paimon was just kidding...
:{{A|vo sgwlq003 7 morgane 01.ogg}} '''Morgane:''' Head Nurse, I've done a final headcount of our team and the criminals. Everyone's here and doing fine. We're ready to escort the fugitives back to the Fortress of Meropide.
:{{A|vo sgwlq003 7 morgane 02.ogg}} '''Morgane:''' It's a shame that we didn't find Rawat. At this point, I'm afraid he's probably deceased.
:{{A|vo sgwlq003 7 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' *sigh* What a horrible bunch. Especially that Potton guy. If he hadn't made good on that deal, we'd all be dead because of him.
:{{A|vo sgwlq003 7 sigewinne 04.ogg}} '''Sigewinne:''' No we wouldn't. I always keep a {{sic|whole of bunch|expected=whole bunch of}} antidotes on me for emergencies, and one of them neutralizes that poison gas. We'd have been fine, even if he hadn't opened the gate.
:{{A|vo sgwlq003 7 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What? Then why did you give him the potion?
:{{A|vo sgwlq003 7 morgane 03.ogg}} '''Morgane:''' ...If this is true, I must concur. Sorry to be blunt, but I think you made a bad decision by handing him that bottle.
:{{A|vo sgwlq003 7 morgane 04.ogg}} '''Morgane:''' If he changes his appearance and flees Fontaine, it's unlikely that we'll ever find him, no matter how cooperative his accomplices are when we question them.
:{{A|vo sgwlq003 7 sigewinne 05.ogg}} '''Sigewinne:''' No, you don't understand. I gave him the potion precisely so we could be sure where he'll go next.
:{{A|vo sgwlq003 7 morgane 05.ogg}} '''Morgane:''' What do you mean?
:{{A|vo sgwlq003 7 sigewinne 06.ogg}} '''Sigewinne:''' We gotta hurry. She won't last much longer.
{{Dialogue End}}
{{Quest Description|update|As all the other fugitives are rounded up, only Potton escapes the net. However, Sigewinne seems to have a good idea of where he's heading...}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Approach the house)
:{{A|vo sgwlq003 8 ceasth 01.ogg}} '''Ceasth:''' Don't move a muscle! I might be short, but I pack a mean punch!
:{{A|vo sgwlq003 8 ceasth 02.ogg}} '''Ceasth:''' Captain? You're just in time. While I was lying in wait, I spotted this crook snooping around, trying to find a way in. So I detained him.
:{{A|vo sgwlq003 8 potton 01.ogg}} '''Intruder:''' Hmph...
:{{A|vo sgwlq003 8 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Whoa, his face...
:{{A|vo sgwlq003 8 morgane 01.ogg}} '''Morgane:''' Are you... Potton? So this is where you were heading, huh?
:{{A|vo sgwlq003 8 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What?
:{{A|vo sgwlq003 8 morgane 02.ogg}} '''Morgane:''' This is how Potton looked before his face was marred. His current appearance matches the mugshot on his arrest warrant.
:{{A|vo sgwlq003 8 sigewinne 01.ogg}} '''Sigewinne:''' Hmm... I see.
:{{A|vo sgwlq003 8 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wait, so what's going on? Wasn't the whole point of the potion to disguise himself and escape Fontaine? Why {{sic|would|expected=would he}} change back to his original face and run right into our trap!?
:{{A|vo sgwlq003 8 potton 02.ogg}} '''Potton:''' Enough of this nonsense! Let me in!
:{{A|vo sgwlq003 8 ceasth 03.ogg}} '''Ceasth:''' You better pipe down! There's an old lady in there who's very sick. No way are we letting a crook like you inside!
:{{A|vo sgwlq003 8 potton 03.ogg}} '''Potton:''' Ugh, to heck with it... Listen to me! I'm Rawat! That's my mother in there!
:{{A|vo sgwlq003 8 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' He's gotta be lying, right? Rawat was a victim in all this, he was forced into it against his will... How could he and this monster be the same person?
:{{A|vo sgwlq003 8 potton 04.ogg}} '''Potton:''' Forced again his will? Hahahaha... That's the funniest thing I've heard all day.
:{{A|vo sgwlq003 8 potton 05.ogg}} '''Potton:''' Back when I was being coerced, everyone thought I was colluding of my own free will. And then when I actually became a criminal in my own right, you all suddenly thought I must be under duress!
:{{A|vo sgwlq003 8 potton 06.ogg}} '''Potton:''' Amazing what a difference a handsome face makes!
:{{A|vo sgwlq003 8 morgane 03.ogg}} '''Morgane:''' Save us the speech. Explain yourself!
:{{A|vo sgwlq003 8 potton 07.ogg}} '''Potton:''' You want an explanation? Fine, I'll tell it how it is.
<!-- Flashback begins -->
:{{A|vo sgwlq003 8 potton 08.ogg}} '''Potton:''' When I was just Potton, the whole world treated me with contempt.
:{{A|vo sgwlq003 8 audree 01.ogg}} '''Audree:''' Ew. What do you want? Get away from me...
:{{A|vo sgwlq003 8 potton 09.ogg}} '''Potton:''' Women despised me.
:{{A|vo sgwlq003 8 antibes 01.ogg}} '''Antibes:''' Collaborate? Pff, you don't look like much of a researcher to me...
:{{A|vo sgwlq003 8 potton 10.ogg}} '''Potton:''' My peers scorned me.
:{{A|vo sgwlq003 8 enri 01.ogg}} '''Enri:''' Mr. Potton, was it? I'm most interested in your research. Consider my offer carefully — I doubt you'll find other investment opportunities.
:{{A|vo sgwlq003 8 potton 11.ogg}} '''Potton:''' Only villains would work with me.
:{{A|vo sgwlq003 8 gaston 01.ogg}} '''Gascon:''' You want out of the game? Forget about it. Turns out I slipped up a little — left your picture with some Marechaussee Phantom officers... Easy mistake to make. Now they've listed you as an accomplice and drawn up an arrest warrant.
:{{A|vo sgwlq003 8 gaston 02.ogg}} '''Gascon:''' So I suggest you put any thoughts of running away to rest.... If you get caught by the [[Garde]]s for being in the [[Sinthe]] business, you ain't ever seeing the light of day again! Hahahaha...
:{{A|vo sgwlq003 8 potton 12.ogg}} '''Potton:''' There was no way out for me...
:{{A|vo sgwlq003 8 potton 13.ogg}} '''Potton:''' Until... I could stop being Potton.
:{{A|vo sgwlq003 8 audree 02.ogg}} '''Audree:''' Mr. Rawat, I, um... I have something I'd like to tell you.
:{{A|vo sgwlq003 8 rawat 01.ogg}} '''Rawat:''' I became popular with women.
:{{A|vo sgwlq003 8 antibes 02.ogg}} '''Antibes:''' This new potion you've developed is fascinating — genius, in fact! Would you consider working with me? I'd be happy to sign a licensing agreement...
:{{A|vo sgwlq003 8 rawat 02.ogg}} '''Rawat:''' My peers looked up to me.
:{{A|vo sgwlq003 8 enri 02.ogg}} '''Enri:''' I'm very interested in your research, Sir. You must no doubt have offers from countless investors, so far be it from me to ask for a full collaboration, per se — I merely wanted to express my interest... No pressure at all, naturally.
:{{A|vo sgwlq003 8 rawat 03.ogg}} '''Rawat:''' And the villains even began to fear me.
:{{A|vo sgwlq003 8 rawat 04.ogg}} '''Rawat:''' Becoming Rawat showed me what a superficial world we live in.
:{{A|vo sgwlq003 8 rawat 05.ogg}} '''Rawat:''' But I did not hold a grudge. After all, this superficiality could be made to work in my favor.
:{{A|vo sgwlq003 8 rawat 06.ogg}} '''Rawat:''' Or so I thought... But alas, the world seemed bent on finding a reason to make me despise it.
:{{A|vo sgwlq003 8 rawat 07.ogg}} '''Rawat:''' Mother, I'm back! How are you doing?
:{{A|vo sgwlq003 8 sickoldlady 01.ogg}} '''Sick Old Lady:''' ...Hmm... Who are you?
:{{A|vo sgwlq003 8 rawat 08.ogg}} '''Rawat:''' I bought the best medicine Mora could buy, but nothing would cure her illness... In the end, I hoped at least that she could see her son one last time before she passed, but...
:{{A|vo sgwlq003 8 rawat 09.ogg}} '''Rawat:''' ...When everyone else rejected me, the only person who cared about me was my mother. Then, when I became a rising star in the Fontaine Research Institute, I was unrecognizable to her.
<!-- Flashback ends -->
:{{A|vo sgwlq003 8 potton 14.ogg}} '''Potton:''' I have to let her see me again, even if it means donning my own wretched, ugly face...
:{{A|vo sgwlq003 8 potton 15.ogg}} '''Potton:''' ...Well? Is that enough explaining for you? Now do you understand? Let me inside already!
:{{A|vo sgwlq003 8 morgane 04.ogg}} '''Morgane:''' Have you ever considered if you'll even be able to look your mother in the eyes, after what you've done?
:{{A|vo sgwlq003 8 morgane 05.ogg}} '''Morgane:''' You found a way to completely change your identity. You could easily have escaped from them... But no, you chose to keep working with them!
:{{A|vo sgwlq003 8 potton 16.ogg}} '''Potton:''' Hmph, why would I want to give up on such a lucrative business? The profits were dozens of times that of the Sinthe business, and it was all above board!
:{{A|vo sgwlq003 8 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So you kept being a villain just for the money!
:{{A|vo sgwlq003 8 potton 17.ogg}} '''Potton:''' Villain? By what standard? Is doing evil deeds really what makes someone a villain in your eyes, or does it all come down to the way they look? None of you saw a villain when I was wearing my other face, did you?
:{{A|vo sgwlq003 8 potton 18.ogg}} '''Potton:''' You have no right to judge me! You're all just fake people living in a hypocritical world. I regret nothing! My mother would understand!
:{{A|vo sgwlq003 8 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You... You're a villain to the core! But especially that tongue!
:{{A|vo sgwlq003 8 sigewinne 02.ogg}} '''Sigewinne:''' Honestly, I don't see a villain when I look at your current face, either.
:{{A|vo sgwlq003 8 potton 19.ogg}} '''Potton:''' Don't humor me. You don't seem surprised by my confession in the least. How long have you known the truth?
:{{A|vo sgwlq003 8 sigewinne 03.ogg}} '''Sigewinne:''' I didn't know anything for sure until you chose to take that potion bottle and spare our lives. But if you're asking when I started suspecting you, it was the first time you came to see me at the infirmary.
:{{A|vo sgwlq003 8 sigewinne 04.ogg}} '''Sigewinne:''' I had to confirm my suspicions. That's why I chose to join this investigation.
:{{A|vo sgwlq003 8 potton 20.ogg}} '''Potton:''' Are you kidding me? A young, promising researcher and a wretched criminal? What on earth gave you the idea that they could be one and the same person?
:{{A|vo sgwlq003 8 sigewinne 05.ogg}} '''Sigewinne:''' Well, there were no visual clues — this potion's face-changing effects are very powerful. Even as a Melusine, I couldn't see through the disguise.
:{{A|vo sgwlq003 8 sigewinne 06.ogg}} '''Sigewinne:''' But I believe I understand humanity a little better than most of my kind. Humans have certain fundamental qualities that do not change with their appearance.
:{{A|vo sgwlq003 8 potton 21.ogg}} '''Potton:''' Fundamental qualities, huh? So, you think you're the one who's seen through me, do you?
:{{A|vo sgwlq003 8 potton 22.ogg}} '''Potton:''' Most people probably don't know this, but I think I can guess what your deal is. Melusine constitutions are very close to that of water, so it stands to reason that the potion should work on them, too.
:{{A|vo sgwlq003 8 potton 23.ogg}} '''Potton:''' You used it yourself, didn't you? That's why you have a human appearance.
:{{A|vo sgwlq003 8 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Sigewinne?
:{{A|vo sgwlq003 8 sigewinne 07.ogg}} '''Sigewinne:''' Yes, you're right.
:{{A|vo sgwlq003 8 potton 24.ogg}} '''Potton:''' Haha... I'll bet it was back in the days when Melusines were discriminated against because of their appearance.
:{{A|vo sgwlq003 8 potton 25.ogg}} '''Potton:''' It was either carry on living in the gutters as part of an alien race cast out by humanity, or become the Head Nurse of the Fortress of Meropide, revered by all. Not a hard choice to make. It's a no-brainer.
:{{A|vo sgwlq003 8 potton 26.ogg}} '''Potton:''' So you see? You and I, we're the same! And I'm the one who saw through you!
:{{A|vo sgwlq003 8 sigewinne 08.ogg}} '''Sigewinne:''' That's not important right now. You came here to see your mother, didn't you? Well, I can grant you your wish.
:{{A|vo sgwlq003 8 potton 27.ogg}} '''Potton:''' Huh...?
:{{A|vo sgwlq003 8 morgane 06.ogg}} '''Morgane:''' Head Nurse, I'm not sure that's a good idea in his current state.
:{{A|vo sgwlq003 8 sigewinne 09.ogg}} '''Sigewinne:''' Don't worry. Back in the warehouse when I traded the potion for our lives, I was doing it to test him.
:{{A|vo sgwlq003 8 sigewinne 10.ogg}} '''Sigewinne:''' He was willing to risk sacrificing his only chance of escaping capture by opening the gate in exchange for the potion, all so he could see his mother again. If nothing else, his concern for his mother is genuine.
:{{A|vo sgwlq003 8 morgane 07.ogg}} '''Morgane:''' I see...
:{{A|vo sgwlq003 8 sigewinne 11.ogg}} '''Sigewinne:''' So before you arrest him, please allow him to see his mother one last time. {{Traveler}} and I will accompany him — you have nothing to worry about.
:{{A|vo sgwlq003 8 morgane 08.ogg}} '''Morgane:''' Alright. I understand.

;(Talk to Ceasth, optional)
:{{A|vo dialog sgwlq003 ceasth 01.ogg}} '''Ceasth:''' I don't trust this guy much. Be careful.

;(Talk to Morgane, optional)
:{{A|vo dialog sgwlq003 morgane 01.ogg}} '''Morgane:''' Join the Head Nurse inside. If he tries anything, anything at all, shout.

;(Enter the house)
:{{A|vo sgwlq003 9 potton 01.ogg}} '''Potton:''' Mom? It's me, Potton, your son! You recognize me now... don't you?
:{{A|vo sgwlq003 9 sickoldlady 01.ogg}} '''Sick Old Lady:''' *cough*
:{{A|vo sgwlq003 9 potton 02.ogg}} '''Potton:''' Mom...! What's wrong?
:{{A|vo sgwlq003 9 sigewinne 01.ogg}} '''Sigewinne:''' I'm sorry, but I have some bad news. I examined your mother last time we were here, and it appears that due to her prolonged fever, she's... lost her eyesight.
:{{A|vo sgwlq003 9 potton 03.ogg}} '''Potton:''' What?
:{{A|vo sgwlq003 9 sigewinne 02.ogg}} '''Sigewinne:''' Your appearance no longer has any bearing on her ability to recognize you. But... there are always other ways to remind our loved ones who we are... wouldn't you say?
:{{A|vo sgwlq003 9 potton 04.ogg}} '''Potton:''' No no, it can't be... Please, Mom, open your eyes! It's me, your son, Potton! If... If you really can't see my face, then... here, take my hand... Tell me you feel your son's hand!
:{{A|vo sgwlq003 9 sickoldlady 02.ogg}} '''Sick Old Lady:''' Hmm...
:{{A|vo sgwlq003 9 potton 05.ogg}} '''Potton:''' I've done so much to get to this point... Please, you have to recognize me...
:{{A|vo sgwlq003 9 sickoldlady 03.ogg}} '''Sick Old Lady:''' *cough*
:{{A|vo sgwlq003 9 potton 06.ogg}} '''Potton:''' No, no, no... No!
:{{Color|menu|Sigewinne grasps the old woman's hands...}}
:{{A|vo sgwlq003 9 sigewinne 03.ogg}} '''Sigewinne:''' Hm, the temperature of his palm must have changed. ...I'm sorry. It seems I couldn't bring him back to you after all.
:{{A|vo sgwlq003 9 sickoldlady 04.ogg}} '''Sick Old Lady:''' ...Ahh, it's you... Thank you.

'''''Uninvited Guests''''' is the fourth [[Story Quest]] of [[The Chalk Prince and the Dragon]] event. Finishing this quest unlocks the Act IV objectives in the event's menu and allows the player to participate in the Frostborn Miracle challenge.

==Steps==
# Look for [[Albedo]]
# Head to the monster habitat to test the sword
# Defeat the surrounding opponents {{Enemy List|Large Cryo Slime*2;Cryo Slime*2}}
# Speak to [[Sucrose]]
# Follow Sucrose to the adventurer camp
# Speak to Albedo
# Defeat the [[Fatui]] who have come to take the sword

:{{A|vo wylq101 12 kujoukamaji 01.ogg}} '''Kujou Kamaji:''' Greetings. We were just discussing the repealing of the [[Vision Hunt Decree]]. Since you're here, you're very welcome to listen in on the conversation.
:{{A|vo wylq101 12 kujoukamaji 02.ogg}} '''Kujou Kamaji:''' We invited Mr. Kaedehara here to extend a gesture of goodwill on behalf of the Shogunate.
:{{A|vo wylq101 12 kujoukamaji 03.ogg}} '''Kujou Kamaji:''' Your hard work has secured for us the agreeable state of affairs that we now enjoy. Also, I have been granted the chance to correct my clan's past mistakes, and for that, I am deeply grateful.
:{{A|vo wylq101 12 kujoukamaji 04.ogg}} '''Kujou Kamaji:''' The Almighty Shogun has issued a large array of directives aimed at resolving, or at least easing, the tensions that have built up over the years.
:{{A|vo wylq101 12 kujoukamaji 05.ogg}} '''Kujou Kamaji:''' The Tri-Commission has made the recommendation to use this opportunity to restore the honor of the Kaedehara name.
:{{A|vo wylq101 12 kujoukamaji 06.ogg}} '''Kujou Kamaji:''' Regarding the history of the Kaedehara Clan... I trust that you are already somewhat informed?
:{{DIcon}} I've heard a thing or two.
:{{DIcon}} I forget.
:{{A|vo wylq101 12 kujoukamaji 07.ogg}} '''Kujou Kamaji:''' In short, there once was a group of select bladesmiths who served the Shogun directly, responsible for upholding and further developing the traditional blade-forging arts of the Almighty Shogun. The Kaedehara Clan belonged to this class.
:{{A|vo wylq101 12 kujoukamaji 08.ogg}} '''Kujou Kamaji:''' But there came a time when some of these bladesmiths revolted and fled to Snezhnaya. Both the Kaedehara and Kamisato Clans were held accountable for lax oversight, and entered a period of great turmoil.
:{{A|vo wylq101 12 kujoukamaji 09.ogg}} '''Kujou Kamaji:''' We later learned that the whole misadventure had been secretly orchestrated by the Fatui. Attributing all of the blame to the Kamisato and Kaedehara Clans was neither proper, nor just.
:{{A|vo wylq101 12 kujoukamaji 10.ogg}} '''Kujou Kamaji:''' Considering Mr. Kaedehara has once more made an outstanding contribution to Inazuma, the Almighty Shogun believes he should not only be rewarded for his achievements, but also receive recompense for the excessive punishment borne by his clan in the past.
:{{A|vo wylq101 12 kujoukamaji 11.ogg}} '''Kujou Kamaji:''' In the interest of preventing further harassment of the bladesmith clans by the Fatui, we chose not to publicly release the findings of our investigations into these matters. We trust you can understand why this was necessary.
:{{A|vo wylq101 12 kazuha 02.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' This is a true honor. I am delighted to be in a position to receive the goodwill of the Almighty Shogun and the Shogunate at large.
:{{A|vo wylq101 12 kazuha 03.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' However... would I be correct to assume that this magnanimous gesture does not come without some strings attached?
:{{A|vo wylq101 12 kujoukamaji 12.ogg}} '''Kujou Kamaji:''' I can assure you that nothing could be further from the truth. We seek only to correct a past injustice.
:{{A|vo wylq101 12 kujoukamaji 13.ogg}} '''Kujou Kamaji:''' With the Kaedehara Clan's reputation and occupation restored, the Kaedeharas will be bladesmiths once more, and your wanderings will finally come to an end.
:{{A|vo wylq101 12 kujoukamaji 14.ogg}} '''Kujou Kamaji:''' You will be able to lead a safe and prosperous life in Inazuma City with the Almighty Shogun's blessing and the full support of the Shogunate.
:{{A|vo wylq101 12 kazuha 04.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' I have grown accustomed to life among the elements, I fear I would no longer feel at home behind the tall walls of a stately abode.
:{{A|vo wylq101 12 kazuha 05.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' Yet my ancestors did indeed take great pride in the name of Kaedehara and the art of blademaking for which it stood. I do have a responsibility to restore their honor.
:{{A|vo wylq101 12 kujoukamaji 15.ogg}} '''Kujou Kamaji:''' I sense some hesitation in your words.

:{{A|vo wylq101 12 kujoukamaji 18.ogg}} '''Kujou Kamaji:''' Also, eye-witnesses saw him using the power of Electro in addition to that of Anemo. As a result, the falsehood that "Kaedehara Kazuha was using a [[Delusion]]" began to spread...
:{{A|vo wylq101 12 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What? But that doesn't make sense. Using a Delusion turns you old and frail, and Kazuha still looks fine...
:{{A|vo wylq101 12 kujoukamaji 19.ogg}} '''Kujou Kamaji:''' That is correct. However, to some people, the idea of a single person wielding two elements at once is a more inconceivable notion still.
:{{A|vo wylq101 12 kazuha 06.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' This is just one of many similar rumors. I am very uncomfortable with being the subject of public discussion, no matter whether it brings suspicion or stardom my way.
:{{A|vo wylq101 12 kazuha 07.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' But perhaps, if the Shogunate is willing to publicly support me, this situation will blow over more quickly...
:{{A|vo wylq101 12 kujoukamaji 20.ogg}} '''Kujou Kamaji:''' This is precisely why I'd encourage you to give our offer some serious thought. It stands to benefit all of us.
:{{A|vo wylq101 12 kazuha 08.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' Hmm. Please allow me some time to consider.
:{{A|vo wylq101 12 kazuha 09.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' In fact, let us put this discussion on hold for the moment. Well then, what brings the two of you here?
:{{A|vo wylq101 12 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yikes, we nearly forgot about the most important thing!
:{{Black Screen|You and Paimon recount the attack on the outskirts of town to Kazuha.}}
:{{A|vo wylq101 12 kazuha 10.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' Why would such a dangerous individual be looking for me...?
:{{DIcon}} Do you have any siblings?
:{{DIcon}} Could it be someone you trained with under the same master?
:{{A|vo wylq101 12 kazuha 11.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' No. This puzzles me as much as it does you.
:{{A|vo wylq101 12 kazuha 12.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' My fighting forms were taught to me by my family, based on techniques originally developed for blade-testing. We undergo rigorous training to standardize every motion the blade is put through, so that each can be fairly assessed for quality.
:{{A|vo wylq101 12 kazuha 13.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' Over time, these techniques came to form something of a Kaedehara sword art, focused on blade-testing but with a full repertoire of combat forms.
:{{A|vo wylq101 12 kazuha 14.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' Those forms are quite different from the more practical ones typically used by samurai in battle, so it's hard to imagine that the similarity you speak of was coincidence alone...
:{{A|vo wylq101 12 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' All the more reason to watch your back! This guy was a serious nutcase.
:{{A|vo wylq101 12 kazuha 15.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' Indeed. He sounds highly aggressive. Anyone he targets is at risk of serious injury, or worse.
:{{A|vo wylq101 12 kujoukamaji 21.ogg}} '''Kujou Kamaji:''' In that case, I will send some men out immediately to search for him.
:{{A|vo wylq101 12 kazuha 16.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' Thank you. I must say, I am now very curious about this matter, and I will also need some time to consider your offer.
:{{A|vo wylq101 12 kazuha 17a.ogg}} {{A|vo wylq101 12 kazuha 17b.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' I will first join the Traveler in investigating the one who attacked {{MC|him|her}}, then give you a conclusive answer upon my return.
:{{A|vo wylq101 12 kujoukamaji 22.ogg}} '''Kujou Kamaji:''' Very well. Please stay safe.
:{{A|vo wylq101 12 kazuha 18.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' Come on. Let's go and track down your aggressor.

:{{A|vo cllq004 3 navia 04.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Uhh... Anyway, let's not talk about that anymore! I'm going to go on ahead. Don't fall too far behind, now!
:{{A|vo cllq004 3 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ah... She ran off.
:{{A|vo cllq004 3 lyney 04.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' I should probably head back as well. This story was truly incredible. I might have to spend the whole night telling my siblings all about it!
:{{DIcon}} See you later.
:{{A|vo cllq004 3 lyney 05.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Mhm, Goodbye!
:{{A|vo cllq004 3 clorinde 11.ogg}} '''Clorinde:''' ...
:{{A|vo cllq004 3 clorinde 12.ogg}} '''Clorinde:''' {{Traveler}}... Should your name and deeds be forgotten, what do you think the significance of your journey will be?
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (...)
:{{A|vo cllq004 3 hero 01.ogg}} {{A|vo cllq004 3 heroine 01.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' I suppose the significance would be the journey itself and the world we helped create. There's still value in the time I shared with everyone here, in the things we were able to accomplish, even if no one remembers them.
:{{A|vo cllq004 3 clorinde 13.ogg}} '''Clorinde:''' A great answer. I'll remember it.
:{{DIcon}} What would your answer be, Clorinde?
:{{A|vo cllq004 3 clorinde 14.ogg}} '''Clorinde:''' Me? Hah...
:{{A|vo cllq004 3 clorinde 15.ogg}} '''Clorinde:''' "The Marechaussee Hunter says nothing in response to that question."
:{{A|vo cllq004 3 clorinde 16.ogg}} '''Clorinde:''' "Perhaps her answer lies in her silence, an unspoken vow left to echo through the night. The path she walks needs no explanation."
;(Obtain {{Item|"Marechaussee Hunter: Judgment Day" Character Album}})

#* Wave 2: {{Enemy List|Rockfond Rifthound;Rockfond Rifthound Whelp*2}}

#** Help Jean near [[Mona's Laboratory]] and collect the nearby tear: {{Enemy List|Hilichurl*2;Wooden Shieldwall Mitachurl//Hydro Hilichurl Rogue}}

==Gameplay Notes==
* During steps 2<!-- Go to the Knights of Favonius Headquarters and participate in the test -->-10<!-- Defeat Dvalin, who has been corrupted by the Abyss -->, the [[Homeward, He Who Caught the Wind/Echoes of Memory|Echoes of Memory]] subevent cannot be accessed.
* During steps 4<!-- Defeat the monsters -->-10<!-- Defeat Dvalin, who has been corrupted by the Abyss -->, the player will enter a [[Special Story Mode]].
** Barriers will prevent players from leaving or advancing past the areas of the fights involving the group of Rifthounds initially faced by Venti, Jean's fight when she is located, and Diluc's fight when he is located.
** During steps 4<!-- Defeat the monsters -->-6<!-- Collect the tears and find your companions -->, Nicole will help the player by placing healing buffs and elemental devices all over Mondstadt City. The devices that have the witches' bubble over them and the healing buffs can be activated via interaction and are infinitely re-usable with a cooldown of 5 seconds. Hydro Elemental Ambers do not respawn.<!-- well, they do respawn if you leave the Special Story Mode -->
** [[Lightning]] triggered by activating mechanisms behave as follows:
*** The lightning ignores the player even if it hits them.<!-- no damage, no Electro applied, no stagger -->
*** There is no visual indicator of where the lightning will strike.
*** No [[energy particle]]s are created.
*** The lightning will strike as long as there is a target<!-- including but not requiring the player --> in the nearby area and the mechanism is not deactivated.
** During steps 4<!-- Defeat the monsters -->-10<!-- Defeat Dvalin, who has been corrupted by the Abyss -->, the active party will be limited to a trial [[Venti]] and [[Traveler (Pyro)]].
*** In step 6<!-- Collect the tears and find your companions -->, after locating [[Diluc]], he joins the party as a trial character.
*** In step 6<!-- Collect the tears and find your companions -->, after locating [[Jean]], she joins the party as a trial character.
*** In step 7<!-- Go to the plaza in front of the Cathedral -->, after finding [[Varka]], he joins the party as a trial character.
** Optional enemies in the city:
*** Next to [[Good Hunter]]: {{Enemy List|Rockfond Rifthound Whelp*2;Rockfond Rifthound}}
*** At the top of the stairs leading to the side gate: {{Enemy List|Blazing Axe Mitachurl;Wooden Shield Hilichurl Guard;Hilichurl Fighter}}
*** Next to the side gate near a Hydro [[Elemental Amber]]: {{Enemy List|Rockfond Rifthound}}
*** Next to the side gate near a Hydro [[Elemental Amber]]: {{Enemy List|Rockfond Rifthound}}
*** Next to the large Adventurers' Guild building: {{Enemy List|Frostarm Lawachurl}}
*** At the bottom of the stairs next to the [[Goth Grand Hotel]] leading downward: {{Enemy List|Rockfond Rifthound}}
*** In the stairwell south of the Goth Grand Hotel: {{Enemy List|Thundercraven Rifthound}}
*** At the top of the stairs leading up and northward from the Goth Grand Hotel, near a Hydro Elemental Amber: {{Enemy List|Thundercraven Rifthound}}
*** In front of the [[Knights of Favonius Headquarters]]: {{Enemy List|Blazing Axe Mitachurl;Cryo Hilichurl Shooter;Pyro Hilichurl Shooter}}

==Dialogue==
{{Stub Dialogue|Check for Nicole help bubbles. Most should be documented by now, but not sure if all are. It may help to get to a high vantage point.|sort=1}}
{{Quest Description|The second day's tests have come to a successful close. After a joyful banquet, the third day finally arrives. It's time to test the story's ending...}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Approach [[Alice]] in the Grand Master's Office)
:{{A|vo mdeq003 1 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Alright, we made it. Time for round tw— Huh?
:{{A|vo mdeq003 1 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Was this bubble this color before? Is something wrong?
:{{A|vo mdeq003 1 nicole 01.ogg}} '''Nicole:''' I'm not sure. It was like this when I came to check on things this morning.
:{{DIcon}} It's the [[Abyss]]...
:{{A|vo mdeq003 1 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wh—What? That... That can't be! How would the power of the Abyss even get in there?
:{{A|vo mdeq003 1 varka 01.ogg}} '''Varka:''' You sure know your stuff, {{Traveler}}. That's where my head went too. But, I don't know... something is different about this power.
:{{DIcon}} Yeah, it's hard to describe...
:{{DIcon}} It's Abyssal in nature, but also... not a threat?
:{{A|vo mdeq003 1 diluc 01.ogg}} '''Diluc:''' What does that mean?
:{{A|vo mdeq003 1 venti 01.ogg}} '''Venti:''' It seems to be in an "embryonic state." Like an egg that hasn't hatched, the dark clouds before a storm, or... an omen before disaster strikes.
:{{A|vo mdeq003 1 nicole 02.ogg}} '''Nicole:''' Of course, the world within the magic bubble is imaginary, so the same should be true of this Abyssal power... at least for now.
:{{A|vo mdeq003 1 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You created this magic, right, Alice? Do you have any idea what's going on here?
:{{A|vo mdeq003 1 alice 01.ogg}} '''Alice:''' New magic does often come with its issues. So, I can't say I'm entirely surprised something like this would crop up.
:{{A|vo mdeq003 1 alice 02.ogg}} '''Alice:''' As for a solution, however, I'm afraid I need more information first.
:{{A|vo mdeq003 1 qin 01.ogg}} '''Jean:''' One thing is for certain, at least... Given the current threat, we'll have to close off the bubble to event participants.
:{{A|vo mdeq003 1 qin 02.ogg}} '''Jean:''' My apologies, Miss Alice. I know you've made a promise to [[Klee]], but I'm not sure you'll be able to keep it.
:{{A|vo mdeq003 1 alice 03.ogg}} '''Alice:''' ...
:{{A|vo mdeq003 1 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Uh, have we ever seen Alice look this serious...?
:{{DIcon}} Breaking a promise to Klee...
:{{DIcon}} ...Might make her angrier than all of [[Dottore]]'s scheming combined.
:{{A|vo mdeq003 1 alice 04.ogg}} '''Alice:''' Unprecedented crisis notwithstanding, it's too soon to just throw in the towel. What we should be focusing on is how we're going to fix this.
:{{A|vo mdeq003 1 varka 02.ogg}} '''Varka:''' Are we talking about the Klee situation or the Abyss situation...?
:{{A|vo mdeq003 1 alice 05.ogg}} '''Alice:''' Both! Now, I have my suspicions, but I'll need someone to head into the bubble and confirm a few things.
:{{A|vo mdeq003 1 alice 06.ogg}} '''Alice:''' It's not like we can avoid going in there, right? We have to nip this crisis in the bud, after all.
:{{A|vo mdeq003 1 qin 03.ogg}} '''Jean:''' I agree. We have to take action.
:{{A|vo mdeq003 1 alice 07.ogg}} '''Alice:''' Alright. I'll go convince Klee to play somewhere else for now and then head right back.
:{{A|vo mdeq003 1 alice 08.ogg}} '''Alice:''' In the meantime, [[Nicole]], be a dear and keep observing the bubble from out here. Oh, and provide any fixes you can while the rest are inside.
:{{A|vo mdeq003 1 nicole 03.ogg}} '''Nicole:''' I don't know, Alice. There are quite a few unknowns here. It's not like I can force people to head in there and take that risk. We angels aren't miracle workers...
:{{A|vo mdeq003 1 alice 09.ogg}} '''Alice:''' ...You sure about that?
:{{A|vo mdeq003 1 nicole 04.ogg}} '''Nicole:''' ...Fine, I'll do what I can. Just be quick, okay? This is your magic, after all.
:{{A|vo mdeq003 1 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Well, guess this is our best option. We're definitely not gonna sit back and watch!
:{{DIcon}} What was today's story meant to be again?
:{{A|vo mdeq003 1 nicole 05.ogg}} '''Nicole:''' The part where [[Barbatos]] uses the Lyre to summon Abyss-corrupted [[Dvalin]].
:{{A|vo mdeq003 1 nicole 06.ogg}} '''Nicole:''' Then, everyone joins forces to fight him inside [[Stormterror's Lair]], purges him of Abyssal influence, and there you have it... happy ending.
:{{A|vo mdeq003 1 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yep, that sounds like how it happened...
:{{A|vo mdeq003 1 diluc 02.ogg}} '''Diluc:''' Well, we've got the gang from back then all here. Let's go in and find out what's happening.
:{{A|vo mdeq003 1 varka 03.ogg}} '''Varka:''' Count me in too. Potential threat or not, if there's even the slightest chance Mondstadt is in danger, I need to get to the bottom of it.
:{{A|vo mdeq003 1 qin 04.ogg}} '''Jean:''' ...
:{{A|vo mdeq003 1 venti 02.ogg}} '''Venti:''' [[Jean]]?
:{{A|vo mdeq003 1 qin 05.ogg}} '''Jean:''' It's nothing. I was just feeling a bit... nostalgic, getting to work together like this again.

:{{A|vo mdeq003 12 alice 01.ogg}} '''Alice:''' Looking for me?
:{{A|vo mdeq003 12 alice 02.ogg}} '''Alice:''' I'm glad. I wanted to thank you for helping me keep my promise to Klee. She had a splendid time in the bubble.
:{{A|vo mdeq003 12 alice 03.ogg}} '''Alice:''' Nicole came with us to make sure all was in order and prevent any similar incidents from happening in the future.
:{{A|vo mdeq003 12 alice 04.ogg}} '''Alice:''' *sigh* You live and you learn. It's rare, but even the Dodo-King isn't immune to a small slip-up here and there, I suppose.
:{{A|vo mdeq003 12 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So, it's all fixed?
:{{A|vo mdeq003 12 alice 05.ogg}} '''Alice:''' Yes, quite. The recording work is done as well, so now all we have to do is play it on loop.
:{{A|vo mdeq003 12 alice 06.ogg}} '''Alice:''' It should be smooth sailing from here on out. Anyone and everyone can now enjoy the bubble at their leisure.
:{{A|vo mdeq003 12 alice 07.ogg}} '''Alice:''' Nicole will keep an eye on them, of course.
:{{DIcon}} The disaster we experienced...
:{{DIcon}} That was "fate" before we changed it, right?
:{{A|vo mdeq003 12 alice 08.ogg}} '''Alice:''' Hmm... I wouldn't put it quite like that. It was more like... a "fate that will not come to pass."
:{{A|vo mdeq003 12 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh? What's the difference between the two?
:{{A|vo mdeq003 12 alice 09.ogg}} '''Alice:''' Let us not forget, the courageous dragon slayer in the story? Well, in real life, he had already left on an expedition to [[Nod-Krai]] at that time.
:{{A|vo mdeq003 12 alice 10.ogg}} '''Alice:''' Of course, that doesn't mean Dvalin would have escaped his destined death, for another hero would have come along and paid a painful price for victory.
:{{A|vo mdeq003 12 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' But, what we saw in the bubble was what happened after Dvalin broke free from the seal. So, couldn't Varka have been back by then?
:{{A|vo mdeq003 12 alice 11.ogg}} '''Alice:''' Hehe... Dear Paimon, you're free to ponder such questions yourself, of course, but it's of little use to ask them aloud.
:{{A|vo mdeq003 12 alice 12.ogg}} '''Alice:''' Word to the wise — do not lose sleep over all those "what ifs," over the "fates that will not come to pass." It's an exercise in futility.
:{{A|vo mdeq003 12 alice 13.ogg}} '''Alice:''' Those who can observe fate see both the good and the bad of what could have happened.
:{{A|vo mdeq003 12 alice 14.ogg}} '''Alice:''' But, all that matters is what did happen. Those alternate fates are nowhere near as important as the world that exists in the here and now.
:{{A|vo mdeq003 12 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Uh... Alright...
:{{DIcon}} There's something else...
:{{DIcon}} The Abyssal power inside the bubble was far too real...
:{{A|vo mdeq003 12 alice 15.ogg}} '''Alice:''' Ah, you're saying it was as if the bubble itself had become contaminated?
:;(The Traveler nods)
:{{A|vo mdeq003 12 alice 16.ogg}} '''Alice:''' I suppose some "gunk" could have stuck to my luggage while I was wandering the "border," and got mixed into my magic without me noticing...
:{{A|vo mdeq003 12 alice 17.ogg}} '''Alice:''' Haha, just kidding. I would never be so careless.
:{{A|vo mdeq003 12 alice 18.ogg}} '''Alice:''' Your intuition is spot-on, {{Traveler}}. What developed in the bubble was a nascent form of Abyssal power that, if left unchecked, would evolve into the real thing.
:{{A|vo mdeq003 12 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What, so it didn't come from outside? It just... appeared out of thin air?
:{{A|vo mdeq003 12 alice 19.ogg}} '''Alice:''' The Abyss is perilous, cunning, dangerous, obsessive, and most infuriating of all, a complete and utter mystery. I'm sure you've seen for yourself how complex it can be.
:{{A|vo mdeq003 12 alice 20.ogg}} '''Alice:''' The [[Hexenzirkel]] has been observing its energies for a long time, and I think [[Barbeloth]]'s interpretation is the most accurate.
:{{A|vo mdeq003 12 alice 21.ogg}} '''Alice:''' The essence of the Abyss lies in the hatred carried by all the fates that will not come to pass.
:{{DIcon}} The hatred carried by fate...
:{{A|vo mdeq003 12 alice 22.ogg}} '''Alice:''' This world is filled with conflicting elements. That one thing should happen signifies that a different possibility has been eliminated.
:{{A|vo mdeq003 12 alice 23.ogg}} '''Alice:''' These events can be small, almost trivial. I had [[Sweet Madame]] for lunch today, for instance. That means the "Alice who chose [[Tea Break Pancake]]s instead" is no more.
:{{A|vo mdeq003 12 alice 24.ogg}} '''Alice:''' Of course, they can also be events that threaten the world, such as my friend [[Rhinedottir]]'s decision to tap into the Abyss. In that instant, the tale of a future in which she remained pure was gone forever.
:{{A|vo mdeq003 12 alice 25.ogg}} '''Alice:''' So then, the question at the heart of it all is this... Why must these fates be the ones to disappear?
:{{A|vo mdeq003 12 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ahh, Paimon gets it. It's hatred that stems from not being chosen.
:{{A|vo mdeq003 12 alice 26.ogg}} '''Alice:''' Precisely. The magic we wove this time involved recreating the past. However, some of the variables we added allowed a certain amount of these "unchosen fates" to come very, very close to reality.
:{{A|vo mdeq003 12 alice 27.ogg}} '''Alice:''' And, thus, the Abyss showed its teeth. Of course, much like always, it is not existence that it seeks... but the destruction of all.
:{{A|vo mdeq003 12 alice 28.ogg}} '''Alice:''' In the end, though, it wasn't a huge issue. Things like this happen on the "border" all the time.
:{{DIcon}} I see.
:{{DIcon}} No wonder the Abyss is so full of hatred.
:{{A|vo mdeq003 12 alice 29.ogg}} '''Alice:''' It has quite the victim complex, that's for sure.
:{{A|vo mdeq003 12 alice 30.ogg}} '''Alice:''' It's obsessed with entering this world at all costs. And that is precisely why we must protect our lives and those of our loved ones.
:{{A|vo mdeq003 12 alice 31.ogg}} '''Alice:''' Because, when you think about it, to exist in this world is to be a spark of luck amidst countless possibilities. How precious is that?
:{{DIcon}} Having crossed swords with the Abyss many times...
:{{DIcon}} I'm beginning to think along the same lines too.
:{{A|vo mdeq003 12 qin 01.ogg}} '''Jean:''' Ah, Alice. You're here.
:{{A|vo mdeq003 12 qin 02.ogg}} '''Jean:''' I'm truly sorry about this, but per the regulations of the Knights of Favonius, I'm afraid I must send you to confinement.
:{{A|vo mdeq003 12 alice 32.ogg}} '''Alice:''' Whatever for? Things turned out just fine with the magic bubble.
:{{A|vo mdeq003 12 alice 33.ogg}} '''Alice:''' Besides, if that's what this is about... Shouldn't Nicole come along, too?
:{{A|vo mdeq003 12 qin 03.ogg}} '''Jean:''' It's not about the bubble. We received word that a number of fish have been injured as a result of explosions near [[Starfell Lake]]...
:;([[Amber]] is shown observing dead [[Black-Back Bass]] floating in the water)
:{{A|vo mdeq003 12 qin 04.ogg}} '''Jean:''' As I'm sure you're well aware, fish blasting is strictly prohibited.
:{{A|vo mdeq003 12 alice 34.ogg}} '''Alice:''' Oh dear...
:{{A|vo mdeq003 12 alice 35.ogg}} '''Alice:''' Run, Klee! Save yourself!
:{{A|vo mdeq003 12 qin 05.ogg}} '''Jean:''' She's already inside.
:;(Alice gasps)
:{{A|vo mdeq003 12 alice 36.ogg}} '''Alice:''' ...
:{{A|vo mdeq003 12 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Guess it's a day of firsts for the Dodo-King, huh...
:{{A|vo mdeq003 12 alice 37.ogg}} '''Alice:''' ...*sob* Farewell forever, {{Traveler}}. You shall never see me again!

'''''Victory Banquet''''' is the fourth part of {{Quest|Warriors' Dreams Like Spring Grass Renewing}}.

==Steps==
# Go to the site of the Victory Feast
# Wait until nighttime (18:00 – 6:00)
# Listen to [[Kokomi]]'s speech
# Talk to the nearby crowd
#* Talk to [[Hirai]] and [[Kabasawa]].
# Investigate the suspicious soldier
# Time for debate
#* Fight {{Enemy|Watatsumi Soldier: Kouzen|text=Watatsumi Soldier: Kouzen - Aggressive Radical}} with [[Traveler]]
# Talk to the soldier
# Report the truth back to Kokomi

==Gameplay Notes==
* During the fight with Kouzen, the Traveler will retain their character level, weapon, and artifacts during the fight.
** Their stats will increase by 12,000 [[HP]], 5,000 [[ATK]], and 800 [[DEF]]. These stat increases are exactly the same as in [[The Crux Clash (Quest)|The Crux Clash]].

:{{A|vo xhlq004 5 kouzen 01.ogg}} '''Kouzen:''' You're a strong fighter... No wonder Her Excellency chose you.
:{{A|vo xhlq004 5 kouzen 02.ogg}} '''Kouzen:''' You really do have a warrior's will... Then, maybe you can understand us.
:{{A|vo xhlq004 5 kouzen 03.ogg}} '''Kouzen:''' Captain, comrade... will you join us?
:{{DIcon}} First you need to tell me what's going on.
:{{A|vo xhlq004 5 kouzen 04.ogg}} '''Kouzen:''' ...
:{{A|vo xhlq004 5 kouzen 05.ogg}} '''Kouzen:''' We made it up. The story about the Tenryou Commission colluding with the Fatui... It didn't happen.
:{{A|vo xhlq004 5 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' WHAT!? Poor Kokomi's been worried sick! You're telling us you made the whole thing up?
:{{A|vo xhlq004 5 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What the heck were you thinking? This could send you right back into war with the Tenryou Commission!
:{{A|vo xhlq004 5 kouzen 06.ogg}} '''Kouzen:''' Yes. That's exactly what we're hoping to achieve.
:{{A|vo xhlq004 5 kouzen 07.ogg}} '''Kouzen:''' Peace talks? Pfft... Everyone's been drawn in by the idea. That's why the future of Watatsumi Island is at stake.
:{{A|vo xhlq004 5 kouzen 08.ogg}} '''Kouzen:''' What's to stop the Tenryou Commission from stabbing us in the back? And what's to stop the [[Raiden Shogun]] from issuing another Vision Hunt Decree?
:{{A|vo xhlq004 5 kouzen 09.ogg}} '''Kouzen:''' We are the resistance! Everything hinges on our warrior's will!
:{{A|vo xhlq004 5 kouzen 10.ogg}} '''Kouzen:''' We can't trust the Tenryou Commission or the Raiden Shogun. But we can put faith in ourselves!
:{{A|vo xhlq004 5 kouzen 11.ogg}} '''Kouzen:''' Surely you agree with that?
:{{A|vo xhlq004 5 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' His point does kinda make sense, but something about it doesn't feel right to Paimon...
:{{DIcon}} What it boils down to is... you just want to fight.
:{{A|vo xhlq004 5 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yeah! Everything you said just now was pure speculation, wasn't it?
:{{A|vo xhlq004 5 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Are you seriously willing to make up a wild rumor and ruin the peace everyone's worked so hard for, all because of some imaginary situation that may not even happen?
:{{A|vo xhlq004 5 kouzen 12.ogg}} '''Kouzen:''' Don't take that tone with me, acting like you're above all of this! What would you understand?
:{{A|vo xhlq004 5 kouzen 13.ogg}} '''Kouzen:''' For the sake of victory, we embodied the warrior's will to the fullest. You understand? We were all in. Now they're suddenly trying to tell us that none of it matters anymore...
:{{A|vo xhlq004 5 kouzen 14.ogg}} '''Kouzen:''' You'd have me just put down my weapon and start living like an ordinary person, but how can I? How can I, when... when every time I close my eyes, I see the faces of the friends we lost in battle.
:{{A|vo xhlq004 5 kouzen 15.ogg}} '''Kouzen:''' Every time I see them there, in my mind's eye, it reminds me that I can never forgive the Tenryou Commission, and never forgive the Vision Hunt Decree!
:{{A|vo xhlq004 5 kouzen 16.ogg}} '''Kouzen:''' I guess you're not one of us... Well, whatever. Go ahead and tell Sangonomiya if you want. But you're too late to stop us now...
:{{A|vo xhlq004 5 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Too late? What do you mean?
:{{A|vo xhlq004 5 kouzen 17.ogg}} '''Kouzen:''' ...
:{{A|vo xhlq004 5 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Darn, doesn't seem like he's gonna answer that one.
:{{A|vo xhlq004 5 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What are we gonna do, {{Traveler}}? This is really serious! We need to give Kokomi the full story right away!
{{Dialogue End}}
----
{{Quest Description|update|The truth behind the rumors proves unexpected indeed. Kokomi must be informed.}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Report the truth back to Kokomi)
:{{A|vo xhlq004 6 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' ...So we found out a few things.
:{{A|vo xhlq004 6 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' The whole thing about the Tenryou Commission colluding with the Fatui is baloney! They made it all up.
:{{A|vo xhlq004 6 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' They wanted the peace talks to break down so that they could carry on fighting the war. And they said that it's too late to try and stop them, no matter what we do.
:{{A|vo xhlq004 6 kokomi 01.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' Mm. I see.
:{{DIcon}} What's the matter, Kokomi?
:{{DIcon}} Are you feeling alright?
:{{A|vo xhlq004 6 kokomi 02.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' I'm fine, don't worry.
:{{A|vo xhlq004 6 kokomi 03.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' This is my fault. If only I'd perceived what they were feeling earlier, it never would have come to this.
:{{A|vo xhlq004 6 kokomi 04.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' I think I understand what Kouzen means when he says it's too late.
:{{A|vo xhlq004 6 kokomi 05.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' The talks don't begin until tomorrow, but both sides have already sent their guards to the location. They are responsible for making sure the area is safe and secure.
:{{A|vo xhlq004 6 kokomi 06.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' I highly suspect that one of Kouzen's pro-war co-conspirators will have infiltrated the guards with an intent to reignite hostilities tomorrow during the negotiations.
:{{A|vo xhlq004 6 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Well that's no good. Do you want us to head over there now and switch out the guards?
:{{A|vo xhlq004 6 kokomi 07.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' That won't work. Firstly, the act of bringing a new team of guards to a neutral negotiation site will put both sides on high alert.
:{{A|vo xhlq004 6 kokomi 08.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' It would almost certainly push the pro-war faction into taking action. They would attack the Tenryou Commission's guards, and we'd be in danger of war breaking out once again.
:{{A|vo xhlq004 6 kokomi 09.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' Not to mention that we have no idea how many of Watatsumi Island's soldiers are involved in this plot. If we change the guard in haste, we face the issue of not knowing who to trust.
:{{A|vo xhlq004 6 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Sounds like a really tricky situation... so, is there really nothing we can do about it?
:{{A|vo xhlq004 6 kokomi 10.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' Don't let it worry you, what's done is done. Mm... Now it falls to me to devise a counter plan.
:{{A|vo xhlq004 6 kokomi 11.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' These soldiers crossed a line, but the blame is not theirs alone. Whatever happens, I will find a way to ensure they do not come to harm...
:{{A|vo xhlq004 6 kokomi 12.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' Let's meet here again tomorrow.
:{{Black Screen|Kokomi rushes back to [[Sangonomiya Shrine]], and the Victory Feast continues joyfully until all have had their fill.}}
{{Dialogue End}}
