==Dialogue==
===The Arataki Support Group...?===
{{Quest Description|The Police Station's Uesugi is fretting about the Arataki Gang...}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Go to the Police Station and talk to Uesugi)
:{{A|vo jqrcop001 1914101 shinobu 01.ogg}} '''Kuki Shinobu:''' I do apologize. As I've explained before, it's a constant battle for [[Arataki Itto|Mr. Arataki]] with his mental instabilities. I know it's caused no end of problems for you, and I can assure you that he regularly feels very remorseful about that, too.
:{{A|vo jqrcop001 1914101 shinobu 02.ogg}} '''Kuki Shinobu:''' ...Exactly, yes, and that's why he has such a big heart for other people struggling with similar issues. Uh, the [[Arataki Gang|Arataki Support Group]] was actually founded precisely to try and bring something positive out of that...
:{{A|vo jqrcop001 1914101 shinobu 03.ogg}} '''Kuki Shinobu:''' Yes, all of them are good, honest people underneath. It's just a shame that they still haven't found a cure, after all this time...
:{{A|vo jqrcop001 1914101 shinobu 04.ogg}} '''Kuki Shinobu:''' ...Oh but — no no no, not me. I'm not a sufferer.
:{{DIcon}} What are you doing?
:{{A|vo jqrcop001 1914101 shinobu 05.ogg}} '''Kuki Shinobu:''' Hmm? Ah, {{Traveler}}, just the person I need.
:{{A|vo jqrcop001 1914101 shinobu 06.ogg}} '''Kuki Shinobu:''' Mr. Uesugi, my friend here can confirm everything I've told you about Mr. Arataki. To put it simply, he experiences strong emotion more acutely than most, and easily becomes highly excitable.
:{{DIcon}} I guess that's true...
:{{A|vo jqrcop001 1914101 shinobu 07.ogg}} '''Kuki Shinobu:''' And, deep down inside, all the members of the Arataki Support Group are some of the most down-to-earth, kindhearted people you could ever meet.
:{{DIcon}} Yeah, I guess so...
::{{DIcon}} (But that seems besides the point...)
::{{DIcon}} (But that's not the full story...)
:{{A|vo jqrcop001 1914101 uesugi 01.ogg}} '''Uesugi:''' Huh, even the Traveler is here to vouch for the [[Arataki Gang]]. So you're saying we've had them wrong all this time?
:{{A|vo jqrcop001 1914101 shinobu 08.ogg}} '''Kuki Shinobu:''' ...
:{{DIcon}} (Shinobu is giving us the look which means "play along"...)
:{{DIcon}} Otherwise, why would Shinobu have stayed in the gang?
:{{DIcon}} Otherwise, how would the Arataki Gang have been able to keep Shinobu?
:{{A|vo jqrcop001 1914101 uesugi 02.ogg}} '''Uesugi:''' You make a good point. You know, I heard [[Yoriki]] [[Owada]] saying how the Arataki Gang's deputy has studied abroad and is well-versed in the law... I was wondering why someone with that much talent would choose to stay with the Arataki Gang...
:{{A|vo jqrcop001 1914101 uesugi 03.ogg}} '''Uesugi:''' Here's the thing, though: We have solid evidence that those three were illegally posting flyers everywhere, and we've received a lot of complaints from members of the local community. I appreciate what you're saying and everything, I'm just not sure I can let them off so easily...
:{{A|vo jqrcop001 1914101 shinobu 09.ogg}} '''Kuki Shinobu:''' Please accept my sincere apologies once again for all of that.
:{{A|vo jqrcop001 1914101 shinobu 10.ogg}} '''Kuki Shinobu:''' Mamoru and the others probably believed that they would be able to reach more people in need this way. Unfortunately, they were so eager to help that they ended up causing more problems than they solved.
:{{A|vo jqrcop001 1914101 shinobu 11.ogg}} '''Kuki Shinobu:''' The Arataki Support Group assumes full responsibility. We will work quickly to restore the clean and tidy living environment that the community quite rightly expects.
:{{A|vo jqrcop001 1914101 shinobu 12.ogg}} '''Kuki Shinobu:''' ...But with only myself available, I'm afraid that it could take a very long time to remove all the flyers. Having their help would've made things much quicker...
:{{A|vo jqrcop001 1914101 shinobu 13.ogg}} '''Kuki Shinobu:''' I'm just a little concerned that if progress is too slow, the complaints will only keep coming, which ultimately only makes more work for you and your colleagues.
:{{A|vo jqrcop001 1914101 uesugi 04.ogg}} '''Uesugi:''' I... Ugh, alright, fine. I'll go fetch them... but don't think I'm gonna make a habit of this!
:{{Black Screen|''Uesugi escorts the Arataki Gang out of the Police Station...''}}
:{{A|vo jqrcop001 1914101 mamoru 01.ogg}} '''Mamoru:''' Finally, we're saved...
:{{A|vo jqrcop001 1914101 akira 01.ogg}} '''Akira:''' Hey, hey! I knew Shinobu wouldn't abandon us!
:{{A|vo jqrcop001 1914101 genta 01.ogg}} '''Genta:''' What uuuup! The Arataki Gang is back in town!
:{{A|vo jqrcop001 1914101 shinobu 14.ogg}} '''Kuki Shinobu:''' Ahem! Sorry, they're getting a little over-excited at the prospect of being able to serve the community.
:{{A|vo jqrcop001 1914101 uesugi 05.ogg}} '''Uesugi:''' Alright, guys... make sure you get every last one of those flyers back, okay?
:{{A|vo jqrcop001 1914101 uesugi 06.ogg}} '''Uesugi:''' And don't forget to apologize to the residents and ask for forgiveness!
:{{A|vo jqrcop001 1914101 shinobu 15.ogg}} '''Kuki Shinobu:''' I assure you, there won't be any problems — will there, guys?
:{{A|vo jqrcop001 1914101 akira 02.ogg}} '''Akira:''' Uhh... Y—Yes! No problems!
:{{A|vo jqrcop001 1914101 genta 02.ogg}} '''Genta:''' W—We'll be sure to get the job done!
:{{A|vo jqrcop001 1914101 uesugi 07.ogg}} '''Uesugi:''' *sigh* ...I really hope letting them go was the right decision... They'd better not cause any more trouble...

;(Talk to Uesugi again)
:{{A|vo jqrcop001 1914101 uesugi 08.ogg}} '''Uesugi:''' I really hope letting them go was the right decision...
{{Dialogue End}}

===Attempted Persuasion===
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Use [[Nahida]]'s [[All Schemes to Know]] on Dori, optional)
:{{A|vo kvcop001 19072 dori 01.ogg}} '''Dori:''' (That's another deal in the bag. Hehe. Mora, my beautiful Mora...)

;(Approach Dori)
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907201 dori 01.ogg}} '''Dori:''' Ohoho, now here are some unexpected guests. What brings you to the Palace of Alcazarzaray?
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907201 dori 02.ogg}} '''Dori:''' When I saw Kaveh, I almost thought it must be that time of month again. Sadly for me, I must wait a few more days before I can collect my shiny Mora...
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907201 kaveh 01.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Hey, can't you think of something else for a change? You are literally living in an objet d'art, and yet your mind is still fixated on nothing but Mora?
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907201 kaveh 02.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' What is the point of wealth, anyway? Is your happiness entirely dependent on your hoard of cold, emotionless Mora?
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907201 dori 03.ogg}} '''Dori:''' That's exactly right! Mora is extremely valuable, you see. If you don't keep your mind on it, your Mora may just find its way to somebody else's pockets!
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907201 dori 04.ogg}} '''Dori:''' If you ask me, this place is still way too empty. Just give me some time, and I'll fill it to the brim with lots and lots of Mora!
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907201 kaveh 03.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' You're hopeless...
:{{DIcon}} Let's get back to why we're here.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907201 dori 05.ogg}} '''Dori:''' Ooh? So you have an actual reason to visit me? Alright, let's hear it.
:{{DIcon}} We would like to ask for your help in introducing us to some merchants.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907201 dori 06.ogg}} '''Dori:''' Merchants? Why? Is there some kind of business opportunity?
:{{Black Screen|You describe the library construction project to Dori...}}
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907201 dori 07.ogg}} '''Dori:''' Oh, I see. So you're just looking for someone to help you foot the bill...
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907201 kaveh 04.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Ugh, I knew you wouldn't be interested in something like this. Still, you wouldn't refuse just making some introductions for us, would you?
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907201 dori 08.ogg}} '''Dori:''' Sure, I can connect you with some folks. But with every service comes a fee, you know!

:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907201 dori 09.ogg}} '''Dori:''' Of course! Making introductions means using my connections and putting my reputation on the line. Why wouldn't I charge a fee for something so important!
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907201 dori 10.ogg}} '''Dori:''' Since we've known each other for so long, though, I'll give you a huge returning customer discount. Hmm... how about five hundred thousand Mora?
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907201 kaveh 06.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Five hundred thousand... *sigh* I guess that's okay. But why are you charging a fee before we've even secured any funding? That just doesn't seem right.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907201 kaveh 07.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Besides, by helping us out, you'd be doing a great service to the public! Can't you take your mind off your Mora even for just one second, and focus on something far more important?
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907201 dori 11.ogg}} '''Dori:''' ...
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907201 dori 12.ogg}} '''Dori:''' *sigh* Very well. Since you're so passionate about this project, I'll help you out and waive the introduction fees.

:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907202 kaveh 01.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Alright, here's the situation. I've been commissioned to build a library in the desert, with the intended goal of allowing the desert-dwellers to have more access to reading materials.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907202 rubab 01.ogg}} '''Rubab:''' So it's a public welfare project?
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907202 kaveh 02.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Correct.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907202 qasimi 01.ogg}} '''Qasimi:''' Hmm, then the commission fees will likely be very low. You should be careful.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907202 kaveh 03.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' I'm not too concerned about how much I'll get for the commission fees, actually. I'm fine with doing it for free. I just want to get this project rolling as soon as possible... we're just a little short on funding.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907202 tippu 03.ogg}} '''Tippu:''' So what? You can't possibly expect that we'd just cover the shortfall for you?
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907202 tippu 04.ogg}} '''Tippu:''' Besides, what does a library in the desert have to do with us? If you want to build it, build it yourself with your own Mora. Seems simple enough to me...
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907202 rubab 02.ogg}} '''Rubab:''' Hey, there's no need to be so harsh. They are Dori's associates, after all. Here, can you tell us a bit more about what we can gain from sponsoring this project?
:{{DIcon}} You can get the naming rights to the library.
:{{DIcon}} You can get Kaveh's client to advertise your businesses in the desert.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907202 rubab 03.ogg}} '''Rubab:''' Hmm... So we'd mostly be doing it for reputation and exposure? There is some value to that — it could make doing business in the desert a bit easier.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907202 tippu 05.ogg}} '''Tippu:''' Well, just speaking for myself, I've got nothing in the desert.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907202 qasimi 02.ogg}} '''Qasimi:''' I also have a concern... It feels like there's not much to profit from in the short term, but in the long term, the reputation gain also doesn't sound like it'd offset the cost of the sponsorship.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907202 kaveh 04.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Then how about this: what if instead of building a single library, we commit to an entire complex of buildings dedicated to culture and education?
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907202 tippu 06.ogg}} '''Tippu:''' Wouldn't that just cost more?
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907202 rubab 04.ogg}} '''Rubab:''' Yes, but in that case... Mr. Kaveh, please tell us what you have in mind.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907202 kaveh 05.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' I'll just give an example. If we were to build a library and a school near Aaru Village, then the desert dwellers would gradually begin to migrate towards the area.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907202 kaveh 06.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' A whole suite of buildings will be able to host more traffic, and thus drive the economic development of the entire area. In turn, that would lead to direct business opportunities.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907202 kaveh 07.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' I've been to the desert several times. Although there are still many lingering tensions between the two regions, the amount of interaction has been steadily increasing, and in the long term, the desert will only become more and more important to Sumeru.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907202 rubab 05.ogg}} '''Rubab:''' Hmm, you do have a point.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907202 qasimi 03.ogg}} '''Qasimi:''' Education in the desert is indeed an industry that has not been tapped into. If we can be the first to place stakes in the area...
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907202 tippu 07.ogg}} '''Tippu:''' Hmph, and you'd just believe anything he tells you?
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907202 kaveh 08.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Even the greenest amateurs know that urban planning will affect population flow. If you don't believe me, you can ask anyone on the street to confirm it to you.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907202 tippu 08.ogg}} '''Tippu:''' You...
:{{DIcon}} You don't seem to think about your questions very thoroughly before speaking.
::{{A|vo kvcop001 1907202 kaveh 09.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Hey, why are you starting to sound like Alhaitham?
:{{DIcon}} Please only ask questions that are relevant to the discussion.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907202 rubab 06.ogg}} '''Rubab:''' Wait, something just occurred to me. If we're going to build a library in the desert, Aaru Village would obviously be the best place for it...
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907202 rubab 07.ogg}} '''Rubab:''' But it seems we're not the only ones with our eyes on the village. I heard a rumor a while back saying a lot of land and buildings in Aaru Village have already been secretly purchased by a big name merchant.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907202 qasimi 04.ogg}} '''Qasimi:''' What?
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907202 kaveh 10.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' What?
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907202 rubab 08.ogg}} '''Rubab:''' In other words... if we try to join the fray now, there won't be much left for us.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907202 rubab 09.ogg}} '''Rubab:''' If we want to build a suite of buildings focused on education and culture, Aaru Village is the prime location. If we want to build it anywhere else, we'll have to deal with a far larger list of problems. It's not impossible, I suppose, but...
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907202 qasimi 05.ogg}} '''Qasimi:''' Then there's no hurry. We can wait for Aaru Village to develop more first, and get into the market for expansion to other areas.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907202 kaveh 11.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Uh... But if you were to do that...
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907202 tippu 09.ogg}} '''Tippu:''' Is there nothing else to discuss? Great timing — I've pretty much heard all I want to hear. If there are no other urgent matters, I'll be on my way.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907202 qasimi 06.ogg}} '''Qasimi:''' I'll be off as well. If you have any new ideas, please feel free to reach out.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907202 rubab 10.ogg}} '''Rubab:''' It seems like the others are not interested in funding this, so no point in me doing this on my own. Let's revisit this another time.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907202 kaveh 12.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Hey, guys—wait! ...Ugh.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907202 kaveh 13.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Well, what can I say... I guess it went somewhat as expected. They are Dori's friends, after all. As soon as they heard that there's not much Mora in this for them, they lost all interest.
:{{DIcon}} That's just business, I guess.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907202 kaveh 14.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Yeah, it's just another day doing business with people, but I can never get used to that... Those people never think of anyone other than themselves.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907202 kaveh 15.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Looks like we'll have to figure out some other way to get the funding... let's go.

:{{A|vo bntcop001 1904304 bennett 06.ogg}} '''Bennett:''' They were the ones who rescued me from a perilous place when I was just a baby, and together they raised me.

:{{A|vo bntcop001 1904304 bennett 16.ogg}} '''Bennett:''' Well, it seems we'd better give up on that idea. Let's go do something else...

:{{A|vo bntcop001 1904304 jack 02.ogg}} '''Jack:''' Some of the older adventurers in the guild are really hurting from their arthritis again... it could be because of the humidity today...
:{{A|vo bntcop001 1904304 bennett 18.ogg}} '''Bennett:''' You mean my dads? That's too bad. They'll need someone to take care of them.

:{{A|vo bntcop001 1904304 bennett 19.ogg}} '''Bennett:''' Okay, I'll be right over!
:{{A|vo bntcop001 1904304 bennett 20.ogg}} '''Bennett:''' O—Oh, wait...

==Dialogue==
===Asking Around===
{{Quest Description|You decide to help Gorou find a way to defeat Yae Miko so that he may exorcise his fears.}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Seek solutions on Watatsumi Island)
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1901901 gorou 01.ogg}} '''Gorou:''' Phew, I feel more at ease on Watatsumi Island.
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1901901 gorou 02.ogg}} '''Gorou:''' I had an idea on the way here.
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1901901 gorou 03.ogg}} '''Gorou:''' Many of my army comrades are older than me, and I'm sure that handling this kind of situation must be second nature to them by now. So I thought we could go ask them for advice.
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1901901 gorou 04.ogg}} '''Gorou:''' But I can't just go to them and say "Hey, I'm no good at this". So instead, I'm going to go with a cover story: that "I'm asking for a friend."
:{{Black Screen|''You tell Shuuhei about how this all happened...''}}
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1901901 shuuhei 01.ogg}} '''Shuuhei:''' I see, so you're saying that you're... your friend, sorry, is having some trouble with a certain someone who has an intense personality?
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1901901 gorou 05.ogg}} '''Gorou:''' Yes. So I'm here on my friend's behalf to ask you for advice on a coping strategy.
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1901901 shuuhei 02.ogg}} '''Shuuhei:''' Hmm... Based on my experience, the easiest way to deal with people like that is just go through the motions.
:{{DIcon}} What's the logic behind that?
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1901901 shuuhei 03.ogg}} '''Shuuhei:''' Well you see, General Gorou— General Gorou's friend, I mean, always listens intently when other people are talking, and takes them very seriously.
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1901901 shuuhei 04.ogg}} '''Shuuhei:''' No matter who the other person is, General Gorou's friend treats them all equally — which, don't get me wrong, is something I admire very much.
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1901901 shuuhei 05.ogg}} '''Shuuhei:''' But the other side of the coin is that it makes General Gorou's friend very susceptible to falling for the other party's verbal traps and being led by the nose.
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1901901 shuuhei 06.ogg}} '''Shuuhei:''' If something like that is bothering you, your best bet is simply to not give the other party your full, undivided attention. Don't hang on their every word, and when they ask a difficult question, just gloss over it.
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1901901 gorou 06.ogg}} '''Gorou:''' That makes a lot of sense, actually... so that's how it's done.
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1901901 shuuhei 07.ogg}} '''Shuuhei:''' Haha, well, it's something to try. Whether it'll actually work in this case is a different question.
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1901901 shuuhei 08.ogg}} '''Shuuhei:''' Going through the motions is a skill that everyone has to get the hang of as they get older. I'm guessing General Gorou's friend is on the younger side.
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1901901 gorou 07.ogg}} '''Gorou:''' Well, on my friend's behalf, thank you for your advice.
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1901901 shuuhei 09.ogg}} '''Shuuhei:''' Don't mention it. Oh yes, I heard that Miwa from Sangonomiya Shrine is also in the area. Why don't you ask her for advice, too?
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1901901 shuuhei 10.ogg}} '''Shuuhei:''' She's supposed to be good with interpersonal stuff. It can't hurt to get another perspective.
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1901901 gorou 08.ogg}} '''Gorou:''' Makes sense... Alright {{Traveler}}, let's see what Miwa has to say.

;(Talk to Shuuhei again)
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1901901 shuuhei 11.ogg}} '''Shuuhei:''' Glad I could be of help.
----
;(Run with Gorou)
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1901901 gorou 09.ogg}} '''Gorou:''' Most people who wish to have an audience with Her Excellency usually start by presenting their name cards and official documents to Miwa, who then passes them along.
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1901901 gorou 10.ogg}} '''Gorou:''' So I'm sure Miwa has lots of experience dealing with all kinds of people. Hopefully, she'll have some good ideas.

;(Ask Miwa)
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1901902 miwa 01.ogg}} '''Miwa:''' General Gorou, and the Captain of Swordfish II... What are you doing here?
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1901902 gorou 01.ogg}} '''Gorou:''' We wanted to ask you about something.
:{{Black Screen|''You tell Miwa about the jam you're in...''}}
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1901902 miwa 02.ogg}} '''Miwa:''' I see, so General Gorou's... friend wants to overcome his weakness, right?
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1901902 gorou 02.ogg}} '''Gorou:''' That's right, do you have any advice?
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1901902 miwa 03.ogg}} '''Miwa:''' Hmmm... let me think...
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1901902 miwa 04.ogg}} '''Miwa:''' My advice would be to hide what you are really thinking.
:{{DIcon}} Hide your thoughts...
:{{DIcon}} Interesting...
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1901902 miwa 05.ogg}} '''Miwa:''' Cast your minds back. Why do you think Yae Miko was able to tease General Gorou's friend, and not the other way around?
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1901902 miwa 06.ogg}} '''Miwa:''' It's because she always has that same smile on her face, so no one ever knows what she's really thinking. She's already won the battle right from the start.
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1901902 miwa 07.ogg}} '''Miwa:''' If General Gorou's friend wants to go head-on with her, he must at least learn to do as she does — to conceal the workings of his mind.
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1901902 gorou 03.ogg}} '''Gorou:''' You make so much sense. So what you're saying is, my friend just needs to keep his cool, and she won't have the chance to take advantage of him.
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1901902 miwa 08.ogg}} '''Miwa:''' Exactly.
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1901902 miwa 09.ogg}} '''Miwa:''' Many things look complicated on the surface, but often all it comes down to is who loses their cool first.
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1901902 gorou 04.ogg}} '''Gorou:''' Wonderful! You have my gratitude.
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1901902 gorou 05.ogg}} '''Gorou:''' I'm sure with your approach, that friend of mine will be able to overcome his weakness, haha.
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1901902 miwa 10.ogg}} '''Miwa:''' Then I wish General Gorou's friend a great victory.
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1901902 gorou 06.ogg}} '''Gorou:''' Well, I'm slowly starting to gain confidence!
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1901902 gorou 07.ogg}} '''Gorou:''' Oh {{Traveler}}, I've suddenly remembered — Her Excellency updated her General Operational Directives recently.
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1901902 gorou 08.ogg}} '''Gorou:''' Who knows, there may be some useful suggestions in there, too. Let's go take a look, just to be thorough.

;(Talk to Miwa, optional)
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1901902 miwa 11.ogg}} '''Miwa:''' You can't be too careful when you're going up against Yae Miko.
----
;(Run with Gorou)
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1901902 gorou 09.ogg}} '''Gorou:''' Her Excellency handed me the General Operational Directives in three parts, and I think this is where I placed them...

;(Talk to Gorou)
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1901903 gorou 01.ogg}} '''Gorou:''' Let's see...
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1901903 gorou 02.ogg}} '''Gorou:''' Deployment and mobilization... logistics... conflict resolution... dealing with outlander merchants...
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1901903 gorou 03.ogg}} '''Gorou:''' Aha! I've got it!
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1901903 gorou 04.ogg}} '''Gorou:''' How to avoid awkward social situations. That's Her Excellency for you... she thinks of everything, doesn't she?
:{{DIcon}} What does it say?
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1901903 gorou 05.ogg}} '''Gorou:''' Socializing is as important as a decisive battle. Know yourself and your enemy to succeed.
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1901903 gorou 06.ogg}} '''Gorou:''' Boy, if even Her Excellency treats this so seriously, then we'd really better be careful.
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1901903 gorou 07.ogg}} '''Gorou:''' What I take from this is, it's not enough just to learn some general countermeasures. We need specific knowledge of Yae Miko's individual weaknesses to achieve ultimate victory.
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1901903 gorou 08.ogg}} '''Gorou:''' But how do we figure her out?
:{{DIcon}} I think we can visit Yae Publishing House.
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1901903 gorou 09.ogg}} '''Gorou:''' Yae Publishing House... makes sense.
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1901903 gorou 10.ogg}} '''Gorou:''' Since she goes there often, perhaps we can find some telling details about her there.
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1901903 gorou 11.ogg}} '''Gorou:''' Let's go and investigate.
----
;(Go to Yae Publishing House)
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1901904 kuroda 01.ogg}} '''Kuroda:''' Greetings. Here to buy some books? We just got a new batch of light novels in — these ones are all the rage at the moment.
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1901904 kuroda 02.ogg}} '''Kuroda:''' I must say that Lady Guuji has a keen eye for a good book. Almost every one she picks is a bestseller...
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1901904 kuroda 03.ogg}} '''Kuroda:''' Apparently, the rumor goes that if you can impress Lady Guuji with your writing, you're just one small step away from becoming the next big author.
:{{DIcon}} Are these books personally selected by Yae Miko?
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1901904 kuroda 04.ogg}} '''Kuroda:''' Yes. Well, first, we screen all manuscripts, filter out the bad ones, and write synopses for the rest. Then, we send those to Lady Guuji for final approval.
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1901904 gorou 01.ogg}} '''Gorou:''' So, you have close dealings with Guuji Yae? What sort of person is she?
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1901904 kuroda 05.ogg}} '''Kuroda:''' Hmm, well for starters, she's a very busy person. Whenever she visits the Yae Publishing House, she never stays for long... so actually, we don't know a whole lot about her...
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1901904 kuroda 06.ogg}} '''Kuroda:''' Still, she seems very invested in Yae Publishing House, and on occasion she'll share some of her promotional strategies with us.
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1901904 kuroda 07.ogg}} '''Kuroda:''' Take "That's Life" magazine, for example. When we first started running it, sales were very poor — the return was barely covering costs, and for a while it was on the verge of being axed.
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1901904 kuroda 08.ogg}} '''Kuroda:''' But the fans weren't happy about the prospect of their favorite magazine being discontinued. They kept writing in, begging us to keep it going. So in the end, Lady Guuji stepped in and drew up a new marketing plan.
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1901904 kuroda 09.ogg}} '''Kuroda:''' Next thing you know, sales are through the roof!
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1901904 gorou 02.ogg}} '''Gorou:''' "That's Life"? Wait, isn't that...
:{{DIcon}} What's up?
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1901904 gorou 03.ogg}} '''Gorou:''' Nothing... it just reminded me of something unrelated.
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1901904 gorou 04.ogg}} '''Gorou:''' I didn't realize Yae Miko personally handled the marketing for Yae Publishing House. Yet more proof of her unparalleled skill in reading people's minds...
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1901904 gorou 05.ogg}} '''Gorou:''' Anyway, thank you very much. Is there anything more you can tell me about Guuji Yae?
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1901904 kuroda 10.ogg}} '''Kuroda:''' Uh, no. That's all...
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1901904 kuroda 11.ogg}} '''Kuroda:''' Look, I'm not sure what your plan is here, but I caution you against trying to second-guess Lady Guuji.
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1901904 kuroda 12.ogg}} '''Kuroda:''' Just my opinion, but she's the most mysterious person I've ever met!
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1901904 gorou 06.ogg}} '''Gorou:''' You think she's mysterious, too? ...I guess we can forget about getting any insights this way, then.
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1901904 gorou 07.ogg}} '''Gorou:''' Actually, you said that this batch of light novels was handpicked by her, right?
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1901904 gorou 08.ogg}} '''Gorou:''' Maybe we could take a brief look? Perhaps we can get some inspiration from them.
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1901904 kuroda 13.ogg}} '''Kuroda:''' Sure. If you are interested, I recommend this book: "I've Been to Other Worlds But I've Never Tasted Defeat."
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1901904 kuroda 14.ogg}} '''Kuroda:''' The protagonist doesn't have any particularly exciting abilities, but never fails to defeat strong opponents. It's all thanks to their wealth of experience and cunning strategies.
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1901904 gorou 09.ogg}} '''Gorou:''' Cunning strategies... In that sense, it sounds similar to Her Excellency, Sangonomiya.
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1901904 kuroda 15.ogg}} '''Kuroda:''' Oh, there's an iconic line in this book that people quite like: "One who relinquishes nothing also gains nothing." If you want to win when you're at a disadvantage, a little sacrifice is probably going to be necessary.
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1901904 gorou 10.ogg}} '''Gorou:''' Thank you for the valuable advice.
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1901904 gorou 11.ogg}} '''Gorou:''' Well, one more string to our strategic bow. Although I didn't learn much about my enemy, I've still learned a lot from everyone.
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1901904 gorou 12.ogg}} '''Gorou:''' It's time to put these theories to the test. Let's go to Yae Miko's lair... the Grand Narukami Shrine!
{{Dialogue End}}

===Shrine Showdown===
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Challenge Yae Miko again)
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1901906 gorou 01.ogg}} '''Gorou:''' Any second now, we'll be face to face with her...
:{{DIcon}} We're in this together.
:{{DIcon}} Let's show her who's boss!
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1901906 gorou 02.ogg}} '''Gorou:''' Don't worry, all our hard work is definitely going to pay off.
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1901906 gorou 03.ogg}} '''Gorou:''' She can forget about teasing me this time!
:{{Black Screen|''You look for Yae Miko together with Gorou.''}}
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1901906 yaemiko 01.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' Oh? You arrived a little later than expected. Did you run into some trouble along the way?
:{{DIcon}} You knew we were coming?
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1901906 yaemiko 02.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' But of course. That's why I'm here waiting for you.
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1901906 gorou 04.ogg}} '''Gorou:''' Hmph, so what if you knew we were coming? This time, we won't get caught off guard. We're here to...
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1901906 yaemiko 03.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' Hehe... Slow down, no need to rush. Let me guess.
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1901906 yaemiko 04.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' In the past, I used to have many believers coming to see me at the shrine every day, and most of them came for the same reason.
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1901906 yaemiko 05.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' Especially those who came in pairs. Nine times out of ten, they were here seeking to know their future fate, hoping that it would be a lifetime together.
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1901906 yaemiko 06.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' If you're interested, I'd be quite happy to do a reading for you two.
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1901906 gorou 05.ogg}} '''Gorou:''' Together... for a lifetime?
:{{DIcon}} Whoa there, calm down, Gorou!
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1901906 gorou 06.ogg}} '''Gorou:''' {{Traveler}}, remember what Shuuhei said? We mustn't pay too much attention to what she says.
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1901906 gorou 07.ogg}} '''Gorou:''' Otherwise, we may be fooled by her cunning words...
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1901906 yaemiko 07.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' Now that I think about it, perhaps I never needed to recommend that store to you in the first place.
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1901906 yaemiko 08a.ogg}} {{A|vo wlcop001 1901906 yaemiko 08b.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' You can just leave all your fur grooming to your little friend here. Imagine {{MC|m=him|f=her}} holding your tail in one hand, combing it gently with the other...
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1901906 gorou 08.ogg}} '''Gorou:''' Uh-oh, not good. My mind is already full of mental images...
:{{DIcon}} Yeah, me too...
:{{DIcon}} Can't unthink it now...
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1901906 gorou 09.ogg}} '''Gorou:''' I'll have to resort to the method Miwa taught us...
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1901906 yaemiko 09.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' By the way, there's really no point in trying to hide the way you feel.
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1901906 yaemiko 10.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' You might be able to remain stony-faced if you really try, but with your tail swishing behind you... Hehe, it tells everything.
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1901906 gorou 10.ogg}} '''Gorou:''' What!
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1901906 yaemiko 11.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' Then again {{Traveler}}, you know what?
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1901906 yaemiko 12.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' Most people only pay attention to your tail, but those soft, pointy ears are really just as fascinating.
:{{DIcon}} Please, no more.
:{{DIcon}} I can't take it anymore.
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1901906 gorou 11.ogg}} '''Gorou:''' There's only one method left... a cunning strategy that no one saw coming...
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1901906 gorou 12.ogg}} '''Gorou:''' This is going to hurt me almost as much as it hurts my opponent... but there's no other way.
:{{DIcon}} Gorou...
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1901906 gorou 13.ogg}} '''Gorou:''' I think the real reason you know me so well... is that you're just like me!
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1901906 gorou 14.ogg}} '''Gorou:''' Just like me, you hug your tail when you go to sleep... and just like me, you daydream about someone else grooming your tail for you!
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1901906 yaemiko 13.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' I see. You decided to admit to your feelings in an effort to bring me down with you...
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1901906 yaemiko 14.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' Not bad. I suppose this is a step forward for you. But I'm afraid...
:;(Yae Miko shows her back)
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1901906 yaemiko 15.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' I don't have a tail at all.
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1901906 gorou 15.ogg}} '''Gorou:''' ...
:{{DIcon}} Gorou...
:{{DIcon}} K.O...
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1901906 gorou 16.ogg}} '''Gorou:''' Retreat... Retreat!
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1901906 gorou 17.ogg}} '''Gorou:''' Fighting on is futile, better to conserve resources for the next confrontation... we're out of here, {{Traveler}}!
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1901906 gorou 18.ogg}} '''Gorou:''' When I get back, I'm going to train harder than I've ever trained before. I won't lose to her again!
:{{A|vo wlcop001 1901906 yaemiko 16.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' Bye-bye now. Come again soon.
{{Dialogue End}}

:{{A|vo nhdlq102 2 nahida 03.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' But this is our only chance.
:{{DIcon}} I said no, and I mean it.
::{{DIcon}} We can't go through that again.
:{{A|vo nhdlq102 2 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' {{Traveler}}...
:{{DIcon}} I'm sorry, I got a little anxious.
:{{A|vo nhdlq102 2 nahida 04.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' It's okay... I trust your judgment. I was being a little hasty myself. Let's see if we can think of another way.
:{{DIcon}} What about the crystal...?
:{{A|vo nhdlq102 2 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, yeah! You said that the elemental power in the crystal was identical to theirs.
:{{A|vo nhdlq102 2 nahida 05.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' You want to use its power? But...
:{{A|vo nhdlq102 2 hydrofunguslifeform 05.ogg}} '''Elemental Being: Floating Hydro Fungus:''' The Lord of Dendro seems hesitant. I too, would advise caution.
:{{A|vo nhdlq102 2 hydrofunguslifeform 06.ogg}} '''Elemental Being: Floating Hydro Fungus:''' It's risky to use its power without fully understanding its intended use.
:{{A|vo nhdlq102 2 anemofunguslifeform 01.ogg}} '''Elemental Being: Floating Anemo Fungus:''' Don't understand. This no good... That no good... Save life... important.
:{{A|vo nhdlq102 2 hydrofunguslifeform 07.ogg}} '''Elemental Being: Floating Hydro Fungus:''' Yes, I understand, but this is our only chance to return home. We cannot afford to be careless.
:{{A|vo nhdlq102 2 nahida 06.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' It's okay, there's no need to argue. I'll think of something to do about the elemental power that will be used.
:{{A|vo nhdlq102 2 nahida 07.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' Hmm, how about this... {{Traveler}}, you could try using it.
:{{A|vo nhdlq102 2 nahida 08.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' I understand that you have an amazing resistance to forbidden knowledge.
:{{DIcon}} Sure thing.
:{{A|vo nhdlq102 2 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Don't overdo it, {{Traveler}}. Paimon will be worried!
:{{color|menu|You walk forward and use the power of the crystal to heal the anomalous elemental creature...}}
:{{A|vo nhdlq102 2 geoshroomfunguslifeform 02.ogg}} '''Elemental Being: Grounded Geoshroom:''' ...
:{{A|vo nhdlq102 2 geoshroomfunguslifeform 03.ogg}} '''Elemental Being: Grounded Geoshroom:''' Ugh...
:{{A|vo nhdlq102 2 geoshroomfunguslifeform 04.ogg}} '''Elemental Being: Grounded Geoshroom:''' Lord of Dendro... and you others... How long... How long have I been waiting here?
:{{A|vo nhdlq102 2 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yay! Looks like it worked!
:{{A|vo nhdlq102 2 geoshroomfunguslifeform 05.ogg}} '''Elemental Being: Grounded Geoshroom:''' The Lord of Dendro, here in person... Does that mean... the apocalypse has come to an end?
:{{A|vo nhdlq102 2 geoshroomfunguslifeform 06.ogg}} '''Elemental Being: Grounded Geoshroom:''' Wait, did you... get smaller again?
:{{A|vo nhdlq102 2 nahida 09.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' I'm sorry, that portion of my memory is highly unreliable at the moment... I can't seem to remember who you are...
:{{A|vo nhdlq102 2 geoshroomfunguslifeform 07.ogg}} '''Elemental Being: Grounded Geoshroom:''' Hmm, that sounds about right. After all, the purpose of my existence is precisely for those "unreliable" memories you speak of.
:{{A|vo nhdlq102 2 geoshroomfunguslifeform 08.ogg}} '''Elemental Being: Grounded Geoshroom:''' You once said that the apocalypse will be completely eradicated and that relevant memories will become unstable.
:{{A|vo nhdlq102 2 geoshroomfunguslifeform 09.ogg}} '''Elemental Being: Grounded Geoshroom:''' Even you couldn't promise that you'd remember our agreement after those events take place.
:{{A|vo nhdlq102 2 geoshroomfunguslifeform 10.ogg}} '''Elemental Being: Grounded Geoshroom:''' However, you are definitely someone who stays true to your word. My sacrifice is nothing compared to your resolve.
:{{A|vo nhdlq102 2 nahida 10.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' You and I made the agreement?
:[[File:What Shape Does the Self Hold Graphic 1.png|200px]]
:{{A|vo nhdlq102 2 geoshroomfunguslifeform 11.ogg}} '''Elemental Being: Grounded Geoshroom:''' Yes. You used your power to protect me. That is the reason why I was able to survive here.{{clr}}
:{{A|vo nhdlq102 2 geoshroomfunguslifeform 12.ogg}} '''Elemental Being: Grounded Geoshroom:''' To be honest, I'm nearing my end... I had thought I'd be stronger than this.
:{{A|vo nhdlq102 2 hydrofunguslifeform 08.ogg}} '''Elemental Being: Floating Hydro Fungus:''' No one can withstand the power of the apocalypse.
:[[File:What Shape Does the Self Hold Graphic 2.png|200px]]
:{{A|vo nhdlq102 2 geoshroomfunguslifeform 13.ogg}} '''Elemental Being: Grounded Geoshroom:''' In order to preserve a somewhat stable memory, I had to change the power of the apocalypse into a different form.
:{{A|vo nhdlq102 2 geoshroomfunguslifeform 14.ogg}} '''Elemental Being: Grounded Geoshroom:''' Only the giant spike that fell from the sky was capable of doing something like that. But the moment I chose to go through with it...
:{{A|vo nhdlq102 2 geoshroomfunguslifeform 15.ogg}} '''Elemental Being: Grounded Geoshroom:''' Is the moment I lost my chance of being rescued by the Lord of Dendro...
:{{A|vo nhdlq102 2 geoshroomfunguslifeform 16.ogg}} '''Elemental Being: Grounded Geoshroom:''' But enough about me. Lord of Dendro, let's get to the important matter at hand. As you can see... I won't last much longer...
:{{A|vo nhdlq102 2 nahida 11.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' I understand, and I'm sorry. But...
:{{A|vo nhdlq102 2 nahida 12.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' Can you please tell me what this is?
:{{A|vo nhdlq102 2 geoshroomfunguslifeform 17.ogg}} '''Elemental Being: Grounded Geoshroom:''' This... is a Fire Seed. It's an essential item for saving the Dendro Dragon. Thankfully, it appears to be in good condition.
:{{A|vo nhdlq102 2 geoshroomfunguslifeform 18.ogg}} '''Elemental Being: Grounded Geoshroom:''' The Lord of Dendro and our people created this item together. It mimics how the Dendro Dragon's "Heart of Oasis" operates.
:{{A|vo nhdlq102 2 geoshroomfunguslifeform 19.ogg}} '''Elemental Being: Grounded Geoshroom:''' The Dendro Dragon has been tormented by the apocalypse for far too long. It too is nearing the end of its power.
:{{A|vo nhdlq102 2 geoshroomfunguslifeform 20.ogg}} '''Elemental Being: Grounded Geoshroom:''' However, if you are able to reactivate its Heart of Oasis using the Fire Seed, then the Dendro Dragon will begin to recover.
:{{A|vo nhdlq102 2 geoshroomfunguslifeform 21.ogg}} '''Elemental Being: Grounded Geoshroom:''' And as a result, our homeland will return to the way it once was.
:{{A|vo nhdlq102 2 nahida 13.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' So the Heart of Oasis is Apep's source of power...
:{{A|vo nhdlq102 2 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' No wonder the crystal was able to heal this Fungus just now. That's what it's used for.
:{{A|vo nhdlq102 2 geoshroomfunguslifeform 22.ogg}} '''Elemental Being: Grounded Geoshroom:''' What?
:{{A|vo nhdlq102 2 geoshroomfunguslifeform 23.ogg}} '''Elemental Being: Grounded Geoshroom:''' You used... the Fire Seed to save me?
:{{A|vo nhdlq102 2 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Mm-hmm. Why? What's wrong?
:{{A|vo nhdlq102 2 geoshroomfunguslifeform 24.ogg}} '''Elemental Being: Grounded Geoshroom:''' That's... Uh, never mind, it's not your fault. You didn't know.
:{{A|vo nhdlq102 2 geoshroomfunguslifeform 25.ogg}} '''Elemental Being: Grounded Geoshroom:''' The Fire Seed contains a high concentration of elemental power inside of it. It's very powerful yet fragile at the same time.
:{{A|vo nhdlq102 2 geoshroomfunguslifeform 26.ogg}} '''Elemental Being: Grounded Geoshroom:''' It is not stable in its current form. To prevent any accidents, please don't use it again.
:{{A|vo nhdlq102 2 nahida 14.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' Since I am its creator, I will take responsibility for it. I assure you there's no need to worry.
:{{A|vo nhdlq102 2 geoshroomfunguslifeform 27.ogg}} '''Elemental Being: Grounded Geoshroom:''' Alright. Aside from being able to heal the Dendro Dragon, the Fire Seed can also resonate with the Heart of Oasis.
:{{A|vo nhdlq102 2 geoshroomfunguslifeform 28.ogg}} '''Elemental Being: Grounded Geoshroom:''' In other words, you'll be able to find the Dendro Dragon by following the guidance of the Fire Seed.
:{{A|vo nhdlq102 2 geoshroomfunguslifeform 29.ogg}} '''Elemental Being: Grounded Geoshroom:''' But you should hurry, there is little time to waste.
:{{A|vo nhdlq102 2 anemofunguslifeform 02.ogg}} '''Elemental Being: Floating Anemo Fungus:''' What... about you?
:{{A|vo nhdlq102 2 geoshroomfunguslifeform 30.ogg}} '''Elemental Being: Grounded Geoshroom:''' Forget about me. You should hurry home now.
:{{A|vo nhdlq102 2 hydrofunguslifeform 09.ogg}} '''Elemental Being: Floating Hydro Fungus:''' Everyone is returning home, including you.
:{{A|vo nhdlq102 2 geoshroomfunguslifeform 31.ogg}} '''Elemental Being: Grounded Geoshroom:''' As I told you, I've already lost my chance to be saved by the Lord of Dendro.
:{{A|vo nhdlq102 2 geoshroomfunguslifeform 32.ogg}} '''Elemental Being: Grounded Geoshroom:''' Lord of Dendro, I thank you for coming to find me and for being willing to save the Dendro Dragon.
:{{A|vo nhdlq102 2 geoshroomfunguslifeform 33.ogg}} '''Elemental Being: Grounded Geoshroom:''' Our past has been saved, and our future has been ensured.
:{{A|vo nhdlq102 2 geoshroomfunguslifeform 34.ogg}} '''Elemental Being: Grounded Geoshroom:''' It's enough for me just knowing that they will return home.
:{{color|menu|With its mission accomplished, its life also reaches its end...}}
:{{A|vo nhdlq102 2 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hey... wait!
:{{A|vo nhdlq102 2 paimon 12.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' It turned into... Oozing Filth.
:{{A|vo nhdlq102 2 hydrofunguslifeform 10.ogg}} '''Elemental Being: Floating Hydro Fungus:''' Can you use the Lumenstone once more? I can still feel its elemental power.
:{{A|vo nhdlq102 2 hydrofunguslifeform 11.ogg}} '''Elemental Being: Floating Hydro Fungus:''' Please... Of all of us, it deserves the chance to return home the most.
:{{DIcon}} Okay.
:{{color|menu|You use the Lumenstone once again...}}
:{{A|vo nhdlq102 2 nahida 15.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' This is a small ball of light that it left behind...
:{{A|vo nhdlq102 2 hydrofunguslifeform 12.ogg}} '''Elemental Being: Floating Hydro Fungus:''' I can feel it... I can feel its knowledge and emotions... It has all returned to its original elemental form and is becoming one with the other family members.
:{{A|vo nhdlq102 2 hydrofunguslifeform 13.ogg}} '''Elemental Being: Floating Hydro Fungus:''' Do not be sad, my friends. Its wish has come true and it's very happy right now.
:{{A|vo nhdlq102 2 nahida 16.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' Because its external form doesn't matter, right?
:{{A|vo nhdlq102 2 hydrofunguslifeform 14.ogg}} '''Elemental Being: Floating Hydro Fungus:''' Yes, because our external form does not matter, and our home has been saved. There is nothing more important than being together with family.
:{{A|vo nhdlq102 2 anemofunguslifeform 03.ogg}} '''Elemental Being: Floating Anemo Fungus:''' Let's go. Home.
:{{A|vo nhdlq102 2 nahida 17.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' Home...
----

{{Quest Description|update|The elemental life-form spoke of past events and used Nahida's crystal to discover the truth. Next, you must use the crystal's directions to find Apep.}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Approach the marked area near the outdoor [[Bayt Al-Sukr]] Teleport Waypoint)
:{{color|menu|You come to the desert depths to seek out Apep the Dendro Dragon...}}
:{{A|vo nhdlq102 3 nahida 01.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' It's not much further. Follow me, we're close now.

;(Approach the marked area)
:{{A|vo nhdlq102 3 nahida 02.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' I can feel its power lingering and shifting around us. Sometimes it feels distant, but other times it seems close. This is its way of warning us.
:{{A|vo nhdlq102 3 nahida 03.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' It has already noticed our presence.

;(Approach the smaller marked area)
:;(A cinematic begins)
::{{A|vo nhdlq102 3 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' We won't be able to see anything if we keep going that way.
::{{color|menu|The sky-enveloping sandstorms obscure your sight. You can only sometimes see a gigantic form that blots out the sun in the distance...}}
::{{A|vo nhdlq102 3 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hey, look! Something's over there!
:;(Cinematic ends)
:{{A|vo nhdlq102 3 nahida 04.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' We've found it... Apep, the Dendro Dragon.
:{{A|vo nhdlq102 3 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Paimon knew it would be big, but... not THAT big!
:{{A|vo nhdlq102 3 apep 01.ogg}} '''Apep:''' Puny god, puny human... Leave my domain.
:{{A|vo nhdlq102 3 apep 02.ogg}} '''Apep:''' Frail life-forms like you cannot survive in the endless sands of the desert.
:{{A|vo nhdlq102 3 nahida 05.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' Apep, we're here to save you.
:{{A|vo nhdlq102 3 apep 03.ogg}} '''Apep:''' I do not need saving. Especially not by you, Buer.
:{{A|vo nhdlq102 3 apep 04.ogg}} '''Apep:''' You are no different from [[Amun]]. Both of you have only existed for a fraction of what you know as time, yet you call yourselves lords of this land by leaning on the heavens' glow.
:{{A|vo nhdlq102 3 apep 05.ogg}} '''Apep:''' You're better off paying attention to your path ahead, as you will fall where you've fallen before.
:{{A|vo nhdlq102 3 nahida 06.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' I know that you hate both gods and humans, but you've grown too weak now. Can't you let go of your hatred, even for only a moment?
:{{A|vo nhdlq102 3 apep 06.ogg}} '''Apep:''' Let go... for only a moment?
:{{A|vo nhdlq102 3 apep 07.ogg}} '''Apep:''' Foolish Buer. You will find no gratefulness from me, even if you heal me.
:{{A|vo nhdlq102 3 apep 08.ogg}} '''Apep:''' You will only be reviving the dragon that will destroy Sumeru and the seven nations!
:{{A|vo nhdlq102 3 nahida 07.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' No. You're ill, that's all.
:{{A|vo nhdlq102 3 apep 09.ogg}} '''Apep:''' That I am. Time will bring death to all, it's unavoidable. Although I am gravely ill, my mind remains clear.
:{{A|vo nhdlq102 3 apep 10.ogg}} '''Apep:''' I am different from the ancient dragons that came to terms with you!
:{{A|vo nhdlq102 3 nahida 08.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' There's no need for this. There is no point in fighting, what we need is the truth.
:{{A|vo nhdlq102 3 apep 11.ogg}} '''Apep:''' Hmph. "The truth"... the shackles that the God of Wisdom cannot escape from.
:{{A|vo nhdlq102 3 apep 12.ogg}} '''Apep:''' I have paid dearly for the truth, and you shall do the same soon enough.
:{{A|vo nhdlq102 3 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hey, don't leave!
:{{A|vo nhdlq102 3 nahida 09.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' Careful! Something's coming!
:{{A|vo nhdlq102 3 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wahh! What is that? Paimon's never seen that before!
:{{A|vo nhdlq102 3 hydrofunguslifeform 01.ogg}} '''Elemental Being: Floating Hydro Fungus:''' It's our family.
:{{A|vo nhdlq102 3 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh? They're your family too!? But they don't look anything like Fungi!
:{{A|vo nhdlq102 3 anemofunguslifeform 01.ogg}} '''Elemental Being: Floating Anemo Fungus:''' External form... not important. Inner nature... same.
:{{A|vo nhdlq102 3 hydrofunguslifeform 02.ogg}} '''Elemental Being: Floating Hydro Fungus:''' The composition of their elemental power is identical to ours. In other words, they're residents of our homeland.
:{{A|vo nhdlq102 3 nahida 10.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' Is this what they've become after experiencing the apocalypse?
:{{A|vo nhdlq102 3 hydrofunguslifeform 03.ogg}} '''Elemental Being: Floating Hydro Fungus:''' This is also a form of adaptation, although a most gruesome and pitiful one. Many of our family members never made it out of the Dendro Dragon...
:{{A|vo nhdlq102 3 hydrofunguslifeform 04.ogg}} '''Elemental Being: Floating Hydro Fungus:''' They've gradually taken this form in order to survive the apocalypse.
:{{A|vo nhdlq102 3 nahida 11.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' Is there any way to avoid fighting them?
:{{A|vo nhdlq102 3 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hey, can you guys talk? We're here to rescue you!
:'''Strange Elemental Life-forms:''' ...
:{{DIcon}} They're not responding.
:{{A|vo nhdlq102 3 nahida 12.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' They've given it their all just to survive.
:{{A|vo nhdlq102 3 hydrofunguslifeform 05.ogg}} '''Elemental Being: Floating Hydro Fungus:''' They're being drawn by the Fire Seed. Only its power can temporarily free them from their pain.
:{{A|vo nhdlq102 3 hydrofunguslifeform 06.ogg}} '''Elemental Being: Floating Hydro Fungus:''' All that remains are the instincts to survive and search for energy needed to do so. Everything else has been discarded in the process of adaptation.
:{{A|vo nhdlq102 3 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So this is the result of forbidden knowledge...
:{{A|vo nhdlq102 3 nahida 13.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' Would our world become the same if the forbidden knowledge was allowed to rampage across Teyvat...?
:{{A|vo nhdlq102 3 nahida 14.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' Like fish struggling on land... unable to find a single puddle of fresh water in the entire world...
:{{DIcon}} We can talk about this later.
:{{DIcon}} Let's deal with them first.
:{{A|vo nhdlq102 3 hydrofunguslifeform 07.ogg}} '''Elemental Being: Floating Hydro Fungus:''' Yes. But please, try to be gentle with them. They are not evil in nature... All they want to do is survive.

;(After defeating the enemies)
:{{A|vo nhdlq102 4 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Paimon thinks they've used up all their strength! They don't seem aggressive anymore...
:{{A|vo nhdlq102 4 anemofunguslifeform 01.ogg}} '''Elemental Being: Floating Anemo Fungus:''' They... want to... go home.
:{{A|vo nhdlq102 4 hydrofunguslifeform 01.ogg}} '''Elemental Being: Floating Hydro Fungus:''' Yes, it was never their intention to leave the Dendro Dragon.
:{{A|vo nhdlq102 4 nahida 01.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' Is there a way to make them revert to their elemental form?
:{{A|vo nhdlq102 4 nahida 02.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' Years of torment is what turned them into their current state. Their external form has become their shackles...
:{{A|vo nhdlq102 4 nahida 03.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' It seems only the Fire Seed or Apep's Heart of Oasis can save them.
:{{A|vo nhdlq102 4 nahida 04.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' But it'll be risky if we use the Fire Seed again.
:{{A|vo nhdlq102 4 hydrofunguslifeform 02.ogg}} '''Elemental Being: Floating Hydro Fungus:''' Correct, we cannot use the Fire Seed again.
:{{A|vo nhdlq102 4 anemofunguslifeform 02.ogg}} '''Elemental Being: Floating Anemo Fungus:''' Everyone... goes... home. Not just... us.
:{{A|vo nhdlq102 4 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Aw, this is becoming quite the dilemma...
:{{A|vo nhdlq102 4 nahida 05.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' Let me think for a second.
:{{A|vo nhdlq102 4 nahida 06.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' It's fine, let's use the power of the Fire Seed. I can't bear leaving them in the desert like this.
:{{DIcon}} But...
:{{A|vo nhdlq102 4 nahida 07.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' Don't worry. The decision is on me, I'll take responsibility for whatever happens.
:{{A|vo nhdlq102 4 nahida 08.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' It won't require much elemental power. I'm just worried that it'll become unstable.
:{{A|vo nhdlq102 4 nahida 09.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' But as long as I use my elemental power to stabilize it a little, it shouldn't be a problem.
:{{A|vo nhdlq102 4 anemofunguslifeform 03.ogg}} '''Elemental Being: Floating Anemo Fungus:''' Thank you... Sorry... stubborn.
:{{A|vo nhdlq102 4 hydrofunguslifeform 03.ogg}} '''Elemental Being: Floating Hydro Fungus:''' Thank you, Lord of Dendro.
:{{A|vo nhdlq102 4 nahida 10.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' Returning home is the most important thing to you. I've come to understand that during our travels.
:{{A|vo nhdlq102 4 nahida 11.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' I'm not doing this just to protect you, but also because I hope to use you and your experience and try speaking to Apep again.
:{{A|vo nhdlq102 4 nahida 12.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' After all, that giant Dendro Dragon is also your family. Maybe it would listen.
:{{A|vo nhdlq102 4 hydrofunguslifeform 04.ogg}} '''Elemental Being: Floating Hydro Fungus:''' I will stand with you, Lord of Dendro. I will never forget your kindness.
:{{A|vo nhdlq102 4 anemofunguslifeform 04.ogg}} '''Elemental Being: Floating Anemo Fungus:''' Yes... yes...
:{{A|vo nhdlq102 4 nahida 13.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' Thank you. Alright, here it goes.
:{{A|vo nhdlq102 4 hydrofunguslifeform 05.ogg}} '''Elemental Being: Floating Hydro Fungus:''' Family... We will all be able to go home soon.
:{{color|menu|As all the remaining elemental energy enters its body, its form begins to "grow" with a radiant light...}}
:{{A|vo nhdlq102 4 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Woah! It's shining now!
:{{DIcon}} It's getting bigger...
:{{A|vo nhdlq102 4 hydrofunguslifeform 06.ogg}} '''Elemental Being: Grounded Hydroshroom:''' Endless amounts of knowledge and emotions are moving inside of me. They're all very excited.
:{{A|vo nhdlq102 4 hydrofunguslifeform 07.ogg}} '''Elemental Being: Grounded Hydroshroom:''' To imagine such growth could be achieved in such a short period of time...
:{{A|vo nhdlq102 4 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' It's because you're carrying everyone's hopes and dreams.
:{{A|vo nhdlq102 4 hydrofunguslifeform 08.ogg}} '''Elemental Being: Grounded Hydroshroom:''' Yes, finally... we can go home.
:{{A|vo nhdlq102 4 nahida 14.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' This is the last part. Let's go.

;(Approach the marked location)
:{{color|menu|You come to a gigantic void...}}
:{{A|vo nhdlq102 5 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' This cave is huge! Could this be where the Dendro Dragon lives?
:{{DIcon}} We can't go any further.
:{{A|vo nhdlq102 5 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yeah... Who knows what's inside that cave...
:{{A|vo nhdlq102 5 nahida 01.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' Our goal is not only to find the dragon, but to also enter the world inside of it.
:{{A|vo nhdlq102 5 nahida 02.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' That will be impossible if we can't get it to cooperate with us.
:{{A|vo nhdlq102 5 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' But how are we gonna do that? It doesn't seem to want to help at all.
:{{A|vo nhdlq102 5 nahida 03.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' I'll see what I can do.
:{{color|menu|Nahida calls out into the void...}}
:{{A|vo nhdlq102 5 nahida 04.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' Apep, I know we don't see eye to eye, and that we have a very different understanding of the world and its orders.
:{{A|vo nhdlq102 5 nahida 05.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' However, we are both born of elemental power and both suffered the torment of forbidden knowledge.
:{{A|vo nhdlq102 5 nahida 06.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' We are not that different. And right now, we share a common enemy. We should not let our differences get in the way.
:{{A|vo nhdlq102 5 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hmm, wonder if the Dendro Dragon's even willing to listen...
:{{A|vo nhdlq102 5 nahida 07.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' I don't care about what you believe in, who you hate, or what you've done in the name of hatred... Nor do I expect you to be grateful.
:{{A|vo nhdlq102 5 nahida 08.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' I'm here to save both you and your people. My people.
:{{A|vo nhdlq102 5 nahida 09.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' They've been searching for a way to save you ever since they left their homeland. They yearn for a chance to return home.
:{{A|vo nhdlq102 5 nahida 10.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' And now that everything is over, all the hatred that you harbor has lost its meaning. Rather than continuing to fight, you should consider the life you've produced.
:'''Void:''' ...
:{{A|vo nhdlq102 5 hydrofunguslifeform 01.ogg}} '''Elemental Being: Grounded Hydroshroom:''' No response...
:{{A|vo nhdlq102 5 nahida 12.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' Your eagerness to survive means that you haven't given up on that world yet!
:{{A|vo nhdlq102 5 nahida 13.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' If you claim to know so much more than I, then why don't you truly think about why you want to survive... and why you're so vengeful!
:'''Void:''' ...
:{{DIcon}} Still no good...
:{{color|menu|A great force bursts from within the void, pulling everyone in...}}
:{{color|menu|At this critical juncture, Nahida uses the power of the Fire Seed...}}
:{{A|vo nhdlq102 5 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wh—Whaaaa! Paimon is getting sucked in!
:{{DIcon}} Hurry, grab on to me!
:{{A|vo nhdlq102 5 nahida 15.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' Please, keep everyone safe...
:{{A|vo nhdlq102 5 nahida 16.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' And send us to the "homeland"!

;(Paimon and Nahida find themselves alone in a large, murky-green dome)<!-- screen transition -->

* While fighting the Warden of the Last Oasis, different voices are heard that are referred to as the "Voice in the Memories." The voice heard in Phase 2 sounds the same as that of the [[Elemental Being: Grounded Geoshroom]]. Based on the story shared earlier in the quest, it was likely saying "[[Rukkhadevata]]," whose name would be blotted out due to her removal from [[Irminsul]].

'''What the Blue Flowers Left Behind''' is the only part in the [[True Tales of the Violet Garden]]: Act II - [[What the Blue Flowers Left Behind]] during the [[Hues of the Violet Garden]] event.

==Steps==
# Wait until the following day (08:00 – 10:00)
# Go to the Ritou docks
# Meet [[Albedo]] at The Five Kasen Plaza
# Go to [[Uyuu Restaurant]]
# Enter Uyuu Restaurant
# Ask around in the store (0/3)
# Go to the editorial house
# Go to the [[Outlander Affairs Agency]]

==Gameplay Notes==
* The quest cannot be progressed in [[Co-Op Mode]]

{{Quest Description|update|It is time for the ships to arrive. Head for the Ritou docks.}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(After waiting until the next day)
:{{A|vo rcjeq003 1 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' The passenger ship from Liyue that we're supposed to meet should be arriving soon. Let's go to the docks.
:{{A|vo rcjeq003 1 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You know that Xingqiu will be on board, right? So we should be careful not to say anything about the stolen novels.

;(Approach the docks)
:{{A|vo rcjeq003 2 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hi there! You must be visiting from Liyue to participate in the Irodori Festival. We'll be your guides and will take you onto the island.
:{{A|vo rcjeq003 2 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh, is it Paimon or have we met somewhere before?
:{{A|vo rcjeq003 2 xu 01.ogg}} '''Xu:''' Haha. Yes, in fact, we have. I am Xu from [[Feiyun Commerce Guild]]. Aboard this ship, we have calligraphers, painters, and even players of [[Theater Mechanicus]].
:{{A|vo rcjeq003 2 xu 02.ogg}} '''Xu:''' The inventor of Theater Mechanicus previously came to the Feiyun Commerce Guild seeking investment. Although the guild manager was not interested, Master still wanted to support them.
:{{A|vo rcjeq003 2 xu 03.ogg}} '''Xu:''' We heard that they'd be demonstrating the game and letting people try Theater Mechanicus at the Irodori Festival. So the guild manager instructed Master and I to take the opportunity to come to Inazuma and investigate the product's potential.
:{{A|vo rcjeq003 2 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, speaking of which, where's the young master?
:{{A|vo rcjeq003 2 xu 04.ogg}} '''Xu:''' Ah, well... Master, he's uh...
:{{A|vo rcjeq003 2 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Whoa, Xingqiu's just sitting there... sound asleep!
:{{A|vo rcjeq003 2 xingqiu 01.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' ...Huh, wha—
:{{A|vo rcjeq003 2 xingqiu 02.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' Oh... *yawn* It's {{Traveler}} and Paimon. I presume you are guests in Inazuma as well? It seems fate has destined our paths to cross once again.
:{{A|vo rcjeq003 2 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' We aren't actually guests, we're actually guides for the Irodori Festival.
:{{DIcon}} Xingqiu, how are you doing?
:{{DIcon}} You seem a little down.
:{{A|vo rcjeq003 2 xingqiu 03.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' Please, no need to worry. I was a little too caught up in a novel on the voyage here. When I finally realized what time it was, the first rays of dawn were already peeking over the horizon.
:{{A|vo rcjeq003 2 xingqiu 04.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' Ah yes, now that we've arrived, the [[Kanjou Commission]] will likely wish to inspect our invitation letter. Let's keep it in hand, shall we?
:{{A|vo rcjeq003 2 xingqiu 05.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' Huh, that's odd...
:{{DIcon}} What's wrong?
:{{A|vo rcjeq003 2 xingqiu 06.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' There was a piece of paper underneath my bag... Strange, I don't recall seeing it there before.
:{{A|vo rcjeq003 2 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Let Paimon have a look!
;(Opens [[The Five Kasen's Splendor: Aoi no Okina]])
:{{A|vo rcjeq003 2 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' *gasp* There's no doubt about it! It's from the same series as the story we found before. Even the handwriting looks exactly the same!
:{{A|vo rcjeq003 2 xingqiu 07.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' The story you found before?
:{{A|vo rcjeq003 2 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh yeah, in the warehouse down by the—
:{{DIcon}} Ahem!
:{{A|vo rcjeq003 2 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Uh, by the... the Poem Hunt competition!
:{{A|vo rcjeq003 2 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yeah, that's it! A friend of ours is on Ritou to paint portraits of The Five Kasen... You know, as part of the Irodori Festival. Poetic stories about The Five Kasen have been hidden in various places nearby!
:{{A|vo rcjeq003 2 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' If you can find one of the stories and give it to this friend of ours, then there's a chance you'll become the model for the next portrait!
:{{A|vo rcjeq003 2 xingqiu 08.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' Wait a moment, so you mean that...
:{{DIcon}} Uh oh, he's on to us!
:{{DIcon}} Paimon, you're so terrible at making up stories!
:{{A|vo rcjeq003 2 paimon 12.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' H—Hey, it's hard coming up with stuff on the spot like that!
:{{A|vo rcjeq003 2 xingqiu 09.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' ...There is a chance of meeting [[Calx]] in person!?
:{{A|vo rcjeq003 2 paimon 13.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh? Oh, uh, yeah... you could say that.
:{{A|vo rcjeq003 2 xingqiu 10.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' Really? That's wonderful! I knew that Calx would attend the Irodori Festival, but convincing my father to let me come to Inazuma was proving to be quite the high hurdle. I had to really rack my mind to come up with the excuse of evaluating the investment value of Theater Mechanicus.
:{{A|vo rcjeq003 2 xingqiu 11.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' Just a few days later, word then came that Calx would be busy painting portraits of The Five Kasen during the festival.
:{{A|vo rcjeq003 2 xingqiu 12.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' It is a most rare opportunity for both Calx and I to be in Inazuma together, but it seemed he would be too busy with the portraits to meet with me... So, I've felt quite disappointed for some time now.
:{{A|vo rcjeq003 2 paimon 14.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Don't worry, Xingqiu. Even though Calx has work to do, he still has time to see friends. We can take you to see him right now.
:{{A|vo rcjeq003 2 paimon 15.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Also, we heard that Calx did illustrations for your [[A Legend of Sword]] novel.
:{{A|vo rcjeq003 2 xingqiu 13.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' Ah, so you've already heard.
:{{A|vo rcjeq003 2 xingqiu 14.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' To be honest, my works have drawn little interest in Liyue. However, the novels are selling quite well in Inazuma with the help of Calx's beautiful illustrations.
:{{A|vo rcjeq003 2 xingqiu 15.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' Calx is not only a skilled artist, but he also carries out his craft with great alacrity. I heard that it took him merely a few hours to finish the illustrations for the latest chapter.
:{{A|vo rcjeq003 2 xingqiu 16.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' But when I looked at the art, the brushwork did not even look the slightest bit rushed. His work is truly exquisite...
:{{A|vo rcjeq003 2 xingqiu 17.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' Oh my, I was beginning to get carried away there. Let us depart, quickly now.
:{{A|vo rcjeq003 2 paimon 16.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Phew... Luckily, the idea of meeting Albedo managed to draw Xingqiu's attention and keep the situation under wraps. Let's just hope we don't let anything slip while meeting Albedo.
;(Obtain [[The Five Kasen's Splendor: Aoi no Okina]])
{{Dialogue End}}
{{Quest Description|update|You found another tale of The Five Kasen in Xingqiu's luggage. Discuss this matter with Albedo at The Five Kasen Plaza.}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Approach Albedo at the plaza)
:{{A|vo rcjeq003 3 albedo 01.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Traveler, Paimon, how are you? And who is this accompanying you?
:{{A|vo rcjeq003 3 xingqiu 01.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' You must be Calx, it's a great pleasure to finally meet you. I am the author of A Legend of Sword, Zhen...
:{{A|vo rcjeq003 3 xingqiu 02.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' Ah, forgive me... It's rude of me to introduce myself by my pen name when meeting in person. Please, call me Xingqiu.
:{{A|vo rcjeq003 3 albedo 02.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' And you may call me Albedo, then.
:{{A|vo rcjeq003 3 xingqiu 03.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' No, no, that would be most improper...
:{{A|vo rcjeq003 3 albedo 03.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Why not? Seeing as we are both friends of {{Traveler}}, it'd be more convenient for us to use our real names.
:{{A|vo rcjeq003 3 albedo 04.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Besides, we've already corresponded with each other many times before. In fact, I feel a bit self-conscious seeing you act so politely.
:{{A|vo rcjeq003 3 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hehe, it's not just you, Albedo. We haven't seen Xingqiu act this awkward before either.
:{{DIcon}} It's a real eye-opener, that's for sure.
:{{DIcon}} I learned some new tips on manners today.
:{{A|vo rcjeq003 3 xingqiu 04.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' Ahem... you guys... It's certainly not good taste for you two to be teasing me like that.
:{{A|vo rcjeq003 3 xingqiu 05.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' Oh, by the way, we happened to find a story from the Poem Hunt competition at the docks. I heard that you are collecting them.
:{{A|vo rcjeq003 3 albedo 05.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Hmm? Poem Hunt?
:{{A|vo rcjeq003 3 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Y—You know... The thing where we have to find pieces of paper with stories of The Five Kasen! Uh, Venti found one and then he was allowed to be a model for one of your portraits, hehe.
:{{A|vo rcjeq003 3 albedo 06.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Huh?... Oh, yes. That's right.
:{{Black Screen|You show Albedo the piece of paper found by Xingqiu...}}
:{{A|vo rcjeq003 3 albedo 07.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' I understand the story now. Thank you, it's very helpful.
:{{A|vo rcjeq003 3 xingqiu 06.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' Splendid. Though, I'm still piecing together the story myself. Would you kindly explain it to me in more detail?
:{{A|vo rcjeq003 3 albedo 08.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' If all of you are free, why don't we discuss this over a meal?
:{{A|vo rcjeq003 3 xingqiu 07.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' Ah, well, about that...
:{{A|vo rcjeq003 3 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Do you have other plans, Xingqiu?
:{{A|vo rcjeq003 3 xingqiu 08.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' No no, not at all! Speaking of dining, [[Shimura's]] [[Unagi Chazuke]] is quite delicious, would you like to go there?
:{{A|vo rcjeq003 3 albedo 09.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Shimura's? Unfortunately, today is a bit windy, how about Uyuu Restaurant instead?
:{{A|vo rcjeq003 3 xingqiu 09.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' That's perfectly fine with me. But, I must first unpack my luggage. Let's meet later at Uyuu Restaurant.
;(Xingqiu and Xu leave)
:{{A|vo rcjeq003 3 albedo 10.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Hmm, something didn't quite add up just now...
:{{A|vo rcjeq003 3 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh, no way! Paimon thinks we acted well together. Did we say something we weren't supposed to?
:{{A|vo rcjeq003 3 albedo 11.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' No, Paimon, I'm not referring to us. {{Traveler}}, what are your thoughts?
:{{DIcon}} Xingqiu was a little suspicious.
:{{A|vo rcjeq003 3 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh? Xingqiu's suspicious? Hey, what are you two talking about?
:{{A|vo rcjeq003 3 albedo 12.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Paimon, you read the poem, right? Although it may seem confusing to Xingqiu on its own, what if we read it together with the previous poem we found?
:{{A|vo rcjeq003 3 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Read them together? Hmm, let's see...
:{{A|vo rcjeq003 3 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Suikou lost Aoi no Okina's poem in a drunken stupor, so Aoi no Okina recovered the poem and gave it to some mysterious person...
:{{A|vo rcjeq003 3 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh? Wait a minute... Could today's story be hinting that the one who stole the latest copies of A Legend of Sword... Is Xingqiu himself!?
:{{A|vo rcjeq003 3 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' No way, that can't be right! Xingqiu only arrived at Inazuma this morning.
:{{A|vo rcjeq003 3 albedo 13.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' And that is precisely the point of suspicion. If Xingqiu had only just arrived in Inazuma, how could he recommend Shimura's Chazuke?
:{{A|vo rcjeq003 3 albedo 14.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Moreover, he didn't raise any questions when I suggested another place because of the windy weather. This means he knows that Shimura's is an open-air restaurant.
:{{A|vo rcjeq003 3 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hmm... Are you saying that Xingqiu has already been in Inazuma for some time and that he's only pretending he just arrived?
:{{A|vo rcjeq003 3 albedo 15.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Yes, that is indeed my conclusion.
:{{A|vo rcjeq003 3 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' But, how could Xingqiu be the book thief!? His mission is to fight for justice, isn't it? There's no way he'd do something against his own ideals!
:{{A|vo rcjeq003 3 albedo 16.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Calm down, Paimon. Even though this is the first time I've met Xingqiu in person, we've communicated via letters for some time now. I do have some understanding of his character.
:{{A|vo rcjeq003 3 albedo 17.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' I think there must be some deeper motive at play here. The story also tells us that Aoi no Okina flees with the poem because of a threat.
:{{A|vo rcjeq003 3 paimon 12.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh? Could Xingqiu be in danger?
:{{A|vo rcjeq003 3 albedo 18.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' It's difficult to say at this point. But given that Uyuu Restaurant is indoors, it will be easy for us to detect anyone following or eavesdropping on us. I think it should be safe for us to talk there.
:{{A|vo rcjeq003 3 albedo 19.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' I'll be relying on your assistance to get to the bottom of this matter.
:{{DIcon}} Got it.
:{{A|vo rcjeq003 3 albedo 20.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Good. Then let's head to Uyuu Restaurant.
{{Dialogue End}}

;(Talk to Youta or Akito)
:{{A|vo rcjeq003 6 youta 01.ogg}} '''Youta:''' The last phase of the Irodori Festival is when they release all the new publications. The one I'm really looking forward to is A Legend of Sword!
:{{A|vo rcjeq003 6 akito 01.ogg}} '''Akito:''' That's right! A signed first edition is gonna become quite the collectible. I've gotta get my hands on a copy!
:{{A|vo rcjeq003 6 youta 02.ogg}} '''Youta:''' I've seen Zhenyu's signature before. His handwriting is super neat, he must be really diligent about his style.
:{{A|vo rcjeq003 6 akito 02.ogg}} '''Akito:''' He'll be there in person on the day of the release, so we'll get a good look at him then. I hear that he's actually pretty young.
:{{A|vo rcjeq003 6 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wait a minute, did you just hear that? Not only will Xingqiu be signing novels at the release... but his handwriting is "super neat"!?

;(Talk to Okazaki Rikuto)
:{{A|vo rcjeq003 5 okazakirikuto 01.ogg}} '''Okazaki Rikuto:''' Hello there, what can I get for you?
:{{A|vo rcjeq003 5 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hi, do you have any special recommendations today?
:{{A|vo rcjeq003 5 okazakirikuto 02.ogg}} '''Okazaki Rikuto:''' Why of course, I'd personally recommend our freshly caught seafood! It's been pouring these past few days, so the fishing boats haven't been able to sail at all. But the weather finally cleared up today, so we have some fresh catch.
:{{A|vo rcjeq003 5 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So the weather at sea has been bad these past few days...
:{{A|vo rcjeq003 5 okazakirikuto 03.ogg}} '''Okazaki Rikuto:''' It sure has, a few guests from Liyue were just telling me that their boat was heaving and rolling all the way here. They couldn't do anything but sleep the entire trip.
:{{A|vo rcjeq003 5 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, this might be some useful information.

;(Talk to Albedo)
:{{A|vo rcjeq003 7 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Albedo, what should we talk about when Xingqiu gets here? Any ideas?
:{{A|vo rcjeq003 7 albedo 01.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Hmm, I will try to break the ice by talking about our work on novels and illustrations.
:{{A|vo rcjeq003 7 albedo 02.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' If he really is hiding something, then he might feel even more nervous than we do. If we start by talking about our work creating novels, perhaps he will lower his guard.
:{{A|vo rcjeq003 7 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, come to think of it, Xingqiu mentioned that he'd like to thank you for finishing the illustrations on time. He said they looked amazing despite the time you had.
:{{A|vo rcjeq003 7 albedo 03.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Is that so? Hmm, that is also a very valuable clue.

;(After talking to all 3 characters)

:{{A|vo rcjeq003 8 xingqiu 01.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' That was delicious. Inazuman cuisine largely consists of fresh seafood, which is certainly to my liking.
:{{A|vo rcjeq003 8 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hehe, that's good, we were worried you might not have an appetite because you didn't sleep well.
:{{A|vo rcjeq003 8 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Now's our chance, {{Traveler}}. Let's talk to Xingqiu and see if he says anything useful!
:{{A|vo rcjeq003 8 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Maybe we could start by asking him about the journey.
:{{DIcon}} Talk about his thoughts regarding the journey.
::{{A|vo rcjeq003 8 xingqiu 02a.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' Well, I've never embarked on such a long journey before. Though I was quite excited when we set off, the long days at sea quickly became most monotonous.
::{{A|vo rcjeq003 8 paimon 04a.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, speaking of the journey, did anything noteworthy happen along the way?
::{{A|vo rcjeq003 8 xingqiu 02a 1.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' Well, to be honest, I spent most of the trip with my nose in a novel, haha.
::{{A|vo rcjeq003 8 paimon 04a 1.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Well, that didn't tell us much...
:;(Option removed, dialogue returns to option selection)
:{{DIcon}} Talk about the book he read during the voyage.
::{{A|vo rcjeq003 8 paimon 04b.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' By the way, Xingqiu, what book were you reading on the way here?
::{{A|vo rcjeq003 8 xingqiu 02b.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' Oh, I was reading a novel called, "[[Pretty Please, Kitsune Guuji?]]". It was sent to me by my editor.
::{{A|vo rcjeq003 8 paimon 04b 1.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Didn't you feel dizzy while reading on the ship?
::{{A|vo rcjeq003 8 xingqiu 02b 1.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' Haha, it was nothing I couldn't handle. Don't forget, I'm proficient in the arts of the [[Guhua Clan]]. That being said, there were quite a few people aboard who felt seasick.
::{{A|vo rcjeq003 8 paimon 04b 2.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Well, there doesn't seem to be anything suspicious about what he's said so far...
:;(Option removed, dialogue returns to option selection)
:{{DIcon}} Talk about the scenery on the journey.
:{{A|vo rcjeq003 8 xingqiu 02c.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' To be honest, there wasn't much to see, just water all around, morning to night. The sheer monotony of the trip caused everyone to grow a little impatient.
:{{A|vo rcjeq003 8 xingqiu 02c 1.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' So, when the peak of [[Mt. Yougou]] finally appeared in the distance as we approached the islands of Inazuma, everyone crowded the deck to have a look.
:{{A|vo rcjeq003 8 xingqiu 02c 2.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' However, the ship sailed along at a crawling pace, it took a whole day from the time we saw the mountain peak to the time we docked.
:{{A|vo rcjeq003 8 paimon 04c.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Paimon didn't catch anything suspicious so far...
:{{DIcon}} No, there was something really suspicious.
:{{A|vo rcjeq003 8 paimon 04c 1.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, right... If it took an entire day to reach the docks, then it would have been pouring rain at the time they saw the top of the mountain!
:{{A|vo rcjeq003 8 albedo 01.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' We learned a couple of things from his account, but we still require more evidence. Let's discuss creating novels with Xingqiu.
:{{DIcon}} Talk about Xingqiu's own novel.
::{{A|vo rcjeq003 8 xingqiu 03a.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' While it is entertaining to read novels, writing one is an endeavor of its own.
::{{A|vo rcjeq003 8 xingqiu 03a 1.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' You must give great thought to every detail, from the layout of the plot to the rhythm of the lines.
::{{A|vo rcjeq003 8 xingqiu 03a 2.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' And even when you have come up with interesting content, there's still no guarantee that it will be to your liking.
::{{A|vo rcjeq003 8 albedo 02a.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' I couldn't agree more.
::{{A|vo rcjeq003 8 albedo 02a 1.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Whether it's writing a book, creating art, or studying alchemy, seldom can you really feel joy after seriously delving into the work.
::{{A|vo rcjeq003 8 paimon 05a.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Xingqiu and Albedo are getting into some deep topics now, but nothing suspicious has come up...
