:{{A|vo dyjeq004 11 chevreuse 08.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' So, what do you think, Morris? Care to talk about what happened twenty years ago?
:{{A|vo dyjeq004 11 morris 02.ogg}} '''Morris:''' ...
:{{A|vo dyjeq004 11 chevreuse 09.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' My patience is limited, you know. Don't force me to take you back to the interrogation room... I'd wager that you wouldn't last for more than a minute in there.
:{{A|vo dyjeq004 11 chevreuse 10.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' With the recording we made, you have no chance of winning in court. Cooperating with us now is the most practical move.
:{{A|vo dyjeq004 11 morris 03.ogg}} '''Morris:''' ...Alright, I'll talk.
:{{A|vo dyjeq004 11 morris 04.ogg}} '''Morris:''' I hired an assassin to murder Elisa.
:{{A|vo dyjeq004 11 morris 05.ogg}} '''Morris:''' She once worked as a maid on my family's estate. She was very beautiful, and after some time I fell for her.
:{{A|vo dyjeq004 11 morris 06.ogg}} '''Morris:''' We kept our relationship a secret, and carried out an affair for some time. But it wasn't long before she became pregnant.
:{{A|vo dyjeq004 11 morris 07.ogg}} '''Morris:''' If my parents ever found out, they would have stripped me of my inheritance and status, and driven me out of my home...
:{{A|vo dyjeq004 11 morris 08.ogg}} '''Morris:''' I also didn't expect Elisa to insist on bringing the pregnancy to term. She even asked me to leave my family, and travel far, far away with her.
:{{A|vo dyjeq004 11 chevreuse 11.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' She believed that you were truly in love with her.
:{{A|vo dyjeq004 11 morris 09.ogg}} '''Morris:''' ...I didn't have a choice.
:{{A|vo dyjeq004 11 morris 10.ogg}} '''Morris:''' I gave her a large sum of Mora, told her to leave the family, and get rid of the baby.
:{{A|vo dyjeq004 11 morris 11.ogg}} '''Morris:''' But then years later, she sent me a letter. There were photos of two children, and she even asked if I could find some time to visit them...
:{{A|vo dyjeq004 11 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh? Two children? Paimon thought Baptiste was the only... Ah! You mean...
:{{A|vo dyjeq004 11 chevreuse 12.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' Even if she had the children against your will, you could have just ignored her letter entirely. Why kill her?
:{{A|vo dyjeq004 11 morris 12.ogg}} '''Morris:''' I had just gotten engaged to be married to an heiress from another wealthy family, so if anyone were to find out about Elisa, my life would be completely ruined! I didn't have a choice!
:{{A|vo dyjeq004 11 chevreuse 13.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' No... you always had a choice. You just made the wrong choice, again.
:{{A|vo dyjeq004 11 morris 13.ogg}} '''Morris:''' ...
:{{A|vo dyjeq004 11 veronique 04.ogg}} '''Veronique:''' ...Do you know how it feels to watch your mother be killed right in front of you?
:{{A|vo dyjeq004 11 veronique 05.ogg}} '''Veronique:''' My brother and I were hardly even school-age yet! We were hidden beneath the floorboards, grasping each other's hands like a lifeline. We were so terrified that we didn't even know when we could ever take a breath!
:{{A|vo dyjeq004 11 veronique 06.ogg}} '''Veronique:''' All we could do was to watch mother try to fight back, and then... collapse to the floor...
:{{A|vo dyjeq004 11 veronique 07.ogg}} '''Veronique:''' Even after the assassin left, we were still too terrified to leave our hiding spot. We thought that he might come back... It was only until the next evening when we finally climbed out and gathered around our mother.
:{{A|vo dyjeq004 11 veronique 08.ogg}} '''Veronique:''' But she... had already become cold and stiff to the touch.
:{{A|vo dyjeq004 11 chevreuse 14.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' You made up your mind right then and there to bring this case to light.
:{{A|vo dyjeq004 11 veronique 09.ogg}} '''Veronique:''' Not only that... we resolved to get our revenge.
:{{A|vo dyjeq004 11 chevreuse 15.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' And that's why you became the musketeers.
:{{A|vo dyjeq004 11 veronique 10.ogg}} '''Veronique:''' No, that's why I became a musketeer. The man from before was also killed by me. My brother had nothing to do with it.
:{{A|vo dyjeq004 11 chevreuse 16.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' I figured as much.
:{{A|vo dyjeq004 11 veronique 11.ogg}} '''Veronique:''' ...You did?
:{{A|vo dyjeq004 11 chevreuse 17.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' I once told these two that he didn't look like a killer to me. His confession from that night also rubbed me the wrong way.
:{{A|vo dyjeq004 11 chevreuse 18.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' I think what really tipped me off was... how could I not feel a sense of "regret" in him?
:{{A|vo dyjeq004 11 veronique 12.ogg}} '''Veronique:''' ...
:{{A|vo dyjeq004 11 chevreuse 19.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' He confessed faster than any criminal I've ever met, but he didn't say a single word about you. He insisted that he was the sole perpetrator in the case...
:{{A|vo dyjeq004 11 chevreuse 20.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' But after the questioning ended, I disassembled the musket we dug up from his backyard, put it in front of him, and told him to reassemble it. Wanna guess how far he got?
:{{A|vo dyjeq004 11 veronique 13.ogg}} '''Veronique:''' ...
:{{A|vo dyjeq004 11 chevreuse 21.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' He had no idea where to even start. He's never touched a gun in his life.
:{{A|vo dyjeq004 11 chevreuse 22.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' Based on that, I determined that he was not acting alone. He only surrendered himself to draw our attention and create a moment of opportunity for his partner. So, I decided to play along.
:{{A|vo dyjeq004 11 chevreuse 23.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' And as expected, the second musketeer followed us without hesitation once she saw Morris get separated from the rest of the cast.
:{{A|vo dyjeq004 11 chevreuse 24.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' Besides, why else would he call the novel "The TWO Musketeers"?
:{{A|vo dyjeq004 11 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' But... How did you know it was Veronique?
:{{A|vo dyjeq004 11 chevreuse 25.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' I figured it out the moment Baptiste told me his father's name.
:{{A|vo dyjeq004 11 chevreuse 26.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' That so-called "financial crisis" was all just a ruse. He just wanted to sign up as the investor, and then leave the film without any source of funding.
:{{A|vo dyjeq004 11 chevreuse 27.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' After all, he has a vested interest in minimizing the reach of this story. It's really just the same thing as what he did to Elisa all those years ago.
:{{A|vo dyjeq004 11 veronique 14.ogg}} '''Veronique:''' ...Human scum.
:{{A|vo dyjeq004 11 chevreuse 28.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' But then Xavier pulled out all the stops and got the film made, against all odds. Morris couldn't have that.
:{{A|vo dyjeq004 11 chevreuse 29.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' With the killer in custody, he figured it was safe to act. And so he came to visit the set today, just as I expected.
:{{A|vo dyjeq004 11 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wait... so you were behind all those mishaps today!?
:{{A|vo dyjeq004 11 morris 14.ogg}} '''Morris:''' ...
:{{A|vo dyjeq004 11 chevreuse 30.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' As for the identity of the second musketeer... I assumed they'd probably stay close to Morris, and look for an opening.
:{{A|vo dyjeq004 11 chevreuse 31.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' And if they already knew that Morris was the film's investor, then that narrowed the list of potential suspects as well.
:{{A|vo dyjeq004 11 chevreuse 32.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' Furthermore, being the props manager would allow the culprit to avoid scrutiny by purchasing mechanical parts in the name of the crew.
:{{A|vo dyjeq004 11 chevreuse 33.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' With that hypothesis in mind, I went back to check Baptiste's orphanage adoption records. Guess whose name I saw on the same page, just a few lines from his?
:{{A|vo dyjeq004 11 veronique 15.ogg}} '''Veronique:''' ...
:{{A|vo dyjeq004 11 veronique 16.ogg}} '''Veronique:''' My brother... He trusted you...
:{{A|vo dyjeq004 11 chevreuse 34.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' ...
:{{A|vo dyjeq004 11 chevreuse 35.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' As in, he trusted me to perform the deed on his behalf?
:{{A|vo dyjeq004 11 veronique 17.ogg}} '''Veronique:''' He trusted you to stand on the side of justice!
:{{A|vo dyjeq004 11 chevreuse 36.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' I am.
:{{A|vo dyjeq004 11 veronique 18.ogg}} '''Veronique:''' I thought you could do it as well! The look on your face when you told him to go to hell... I really thought you'd put a bullet in his brain!
:{{A|vo dyjeq004 11 chevreuse 37.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' ...
:{{A|vo dyjeq004 11 veronique 19.ogg}} '''Veronique:''' You know what he has done. Are you telling me that you'd rather see him spend the rest of his life living like a king in the [[Fortress of Meropide]]!?
:{{A|vo dyjeq004 11 veronique 20.ogg}} '''Veronique:''' I will never be able to forget the feeling of my mother's cold, lifeless hands... And you would call this ending fair? Is this what you call justice!?
:{{A|vo dyjeq004 11 chevreuse 38.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' ...
:{{A|vo dyjeq004 11 chevreuse 39.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' I won't lie, Veronique. I did hesitate when your brother first told me about the truth...
:{{A|vo dyjeq004 11 chevreuse 40.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' I wondered... I agonized over whether I should really put a bullet in his head.
:{{A|vo dyjeq004 11 veronique 21.ogg}} '''Veronique:''' So why don't you...
:{{A|vo dyjeq004 11 chevreuse 41.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' Because that should never be how justice is carried out in this world!
:{{A|vo dyjeq004 11 chevreuse 42.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' Perhaps, to you justice is simply reciprocated: an eye for an eye, and a life for a life.
:{{A|vo dyjeq004 11 chevreuse 43.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' But everyone has their own understanding of justice. If everyone were to pursue their own definition of it, there would be no more order in this world.
:{{A|vo dyjeq004 11 chevreuse 44.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' Today, you'll kill Morris. And tomorrow? His children may come for you.
:{{A|vo dyjeq004 11 chevreuse 45.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' The world cannot render judgments based on a desire for revenge. That will only lead to a cycle of revenge, as well as the destruction of order and civilized society.
:{{A|vo dyjeq004 11 chevreuse 46.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' Fontaine is founded on a set of laws and a standardized code of justice. That is why we are the Nation of Justice.
:{{A|vo dyjeq004 11 chevreuse 47.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' But with all that said, I will promise you this: Morris will not lead a cushy life in the Fortress of Meropide.
:{{A|vo dyjeq004 11 yoimiya 03.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' Chevreuse, the rest of the Special Patrol is here.
:{{A|vo dyjeq004 11 chevreuse 48.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' Thank you so much, Yoimiya. [[Letellier]], [[Turenna]], please take them away.
:{{A|vo dyjeq004 11 morris 15.ogg}} '''Morris:''' ...
:{{A|vo dyjeq004 11 veronique 22.ogg}} '''Veronique:''' ...I still can't agree with your reasoning.
:{{A|vo dyjeq004 11 chevreuse 49.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' ...I know.
:{{A|vo dyjeq004 11 veronique 23.ogg}} '''Veronique:''' Justice has not been delivered. At least... not today.
:{{A|vo dyjeq004 11 chevreuse 50.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' ...
:{{A|vo dyjeq004 11 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Chevreuse...
:{{A|vo dyjeq004 11 chevreuse 51.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' Let's go. We should give an explanation to the crew.
:{{DIcon}} Are you okay?
:{{DIcon}} I think you made the right call.
:{{A|vo dyjeq004 11 chevreuse 52.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' Thank you for your concern. I'm fine.
:{{A|vo dyjeq004 11 chevreuse 53.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' I'm just thinking... About the things in life that have driven people to take justice into their own hands.
:{{Black Screen|You explain everything that happened to the rest of the crew...}}
:{{A|vo dyjeq004 13 xavier 01.ogg}} '''Xavier:''' Who would have thought Morris would turn out to be... Ugh, I'm at a loss for words. How could he have done something like this!?
:{{A|vo dyjeq004 13 ayaka 01.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' I'm just glad that you are all safe and sound. Who knew that such a labyrinth of cases would be behind this story...
:{{A|vo dyjeq004 13 xavier 02.ogg}} '''Xavier:''' Well... what should we do now? We have a finished film, of course, but... Should we still go ahead with the premiere?
:{{A|vo dyjeq004 13 chiori 01.ogg}} '''Chiori:''' What do you mean!? Shouldn't you be even more motivated to spread the word now that you've learned the truth?
:{{A|vo dyjeq004 13 chevreuse 01.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' Chiori is right. I'd also like more people to see this story for themselves.
:{{A|vo dyjeq004 13 ayato 01.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayato:''' But the real ending of the story seems to have deviated somewhat from the one in the script. Is that still acceptable to you, Miss Chevreuse?
:{{A|vo dyjeq004 13 chevreuse 02.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' ...
:{{A|vo dyjeq004 13 furina 01.ogg}} '''Furina:''' The call is yours. We still have time to re-shoot an ending if that's what you'd like.
:{{A|vo dyjeq004 13 chevreuse 03.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' ...No, it's fine as-is. I like what we have for the catharsis.
:{{A|vo dyjeq004 13 chevreuse 04.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' Romanticism is what gives works of art their appeal. Fiction is able to explore means of restitution that could never work in real life.
:{{A|vo dyjeq004 13 chevreuse 05.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' Just like the real world, the world of stories also has its own set of "rules" and "justice." These different possibilities are what initially drew me to reading in the first place.
:{{A|vo dyjeq004 13 furina 02.ogg}} '''Furina:''' Sounds good to me! I support your decision.
:{{A|vo dyjeq004 13 yoimiya 01.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' What about Veronique... will she be okay?
:{{A|vo dyjeq004 13 chevreuse 06.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' She will soon face her judgment alongside her brother and Morris.
:{{A|vo dyjeq004 13 chevreuse 07.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' If I had to guess, they'll probably all be sent to the Fortress of Meropide. I'll make sure to give [[Wriothesley]] a heads-up about it.
:{{A|vo dyjeq004 13 chiori 02.ogg}} '''Chiori:''' Oh, you mean, "that" kind of heads-up?
:{{A|vo dyjeq004 13 chevreuse 08.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' Exactly.
:{{A|vo dyjeq004 13 furina 03.ogg}} '''Furina:''' Ahem, alright! Then the matter's settled! Now that everything's been taken care of, there's no reason for us to keep looking all gloomy and grumpy.
:{{A|vo dyjeq004 13 furina 04.ogg}} '''Furina:''' Let's get back to the feast and enjoy each other's company. We'll be starting the post-production process tomorrow.
:{{A|vo dyjeq004 13 furina 05.ogg}} '''Furina:''' You should join us, Chevreuse. You missed the first few hours of the party, didn't you?
:{{A|vo dyjeq004 13 chevreuse 09.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' Alright, count me in.
:{{A|vo dyjeq004 13 ayaka 02.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' Then I'll wait for you over there. There's still some good news that I'd like share with Chevreuse.
:{{A|vo dyjeq004 13 chevreuse 10.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' {{Traveler}}, Paimon? Could you wait for me by the sea after the party ends? I'd like to go on a brief walk with the two of you.
:{{DIcon}} Absolutely.
:{{DIcon}} See you then.
:{{A|vo dyjeq004 13 chevreuse 11.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' Thank you very much.
:;(The party continues)
:{{A|vo dyjeq004 13 chevreuse 12.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' Sorry for the wait.
:{{A|vo dyjeq004 13 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, we weren't waiting long at all! Is there something else you wanted to tell us?
:{{A|vo dyjeq004 13 chevreuse 13.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' No, I don't have anything new to share. I just felt that... since you were my investigation partners, I should have another conversation with the two of you.
:{{A|vo dyjeq004 13 chevreuse 14.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' ...
:{{A|vo dyjeq004 13 chevreuse 15.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' {{Traveler}}... how would you have responded to Baptiste's request if you were in my shoes?
:{{DIcon}} I would have done the same as you.
::{{A|vo dyjeq004 13 chevreuse 16a 1.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' Is that so... Thanks for sharing.
:{{DIcon}} I would have helped him get his revenge.
::{{A|vo dyjeq004 13 chevreuse 16b 1.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' Hah... Just like the protagonist of the story, huh. Can't say it doesn't suit you.
:{{DIcon}} I don't know...
:{{A|vo dyjeq004 13 chevreuse 17.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' ...When I was young, my father often took me here to swim. We'd come, rain or shine, even when it was freezing cold.
:{{A|vo dyjeq004 13 chevreuse 18.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' He told me that swimming was the best activity to train one's strength of will. You could never give up before reaching the shore... especially when the water was cold.
:{{A|vo dyjeq004 13 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh? Why's that?
:{{A|vo dyjeq004 13 chevreuse 19.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' Because the moment you give up would be the moment you die. At that point, I still hadn't received my Vision.
:{{A|vo dyjeq004 13 chevreuse 20.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' One winter, the chilly wind felt almost like knives on my skin, and the seawater was so frigid that it numbed my toes the moment I stepped in.
:{{A|vo dyjeq004 13 chevreuse 21.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' I cried and begged my father to spare me from having to swim across, but he wouldn't listen. He used to be a member of the Special Patrol as well... You could say it was his way of educating his children.
:{{A|vo dyjeq004 13 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' That sounds awful...
:{{A|vo dyjeq004 13 chevreuse 22.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' When he saw that I wouldn't stop crying, he just picked me up, and tossed me into the icy water.
:{{A|vo dyjeq004 13 chevreuse 23.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' The bone-chilling cold took away my senses. I couldn't feel anything but fear and rage...
:{{A|vo dyjeq004 13 chevreuse 24.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' I waited for my father to save me, but one look and I knew he'd already started swimming for the opposite shore. I realized that if I were to give up, I really would die right then and there.
:{{A|vo dyjeq004 13 chevreuse 25.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' I used all of my strength to try and catch up to my father. Those few minutes felt longer than my whole life up until that point. I did, however, make it to the other side.
:{{A|vo dyjeq004 13 chevreuse 26.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' I've never felt afraid about anything in my life after that, nor have I ever cried again.
:{{A|vo dyjeq004 13 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' That way of teaching would have never worked on Paimon...
:{{A|vo dyjeq004 13 chevreuse 27.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' Yeah, I don't think that was the right method for anyone...
:{{A|vo dyjeq004 13 chevreuse 28.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' It's just that... working now as I am in the pursuit of justice, I still sometimes feel like I've been tossed into that winter sea all over again. The anger and the helplessness...
:{{A|vo dyjeq004 13 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Chevreuse...
:{{A|vo dyjeq004 13 chevreuse 29.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' But the worse I feel, the more I know to never give up. The alternative would be to forever lose myself among the waves.
:{{A|vo dyjeq004 13 chevreuse 30.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' Anyway, how about a race? Neither of us will drown, but we can still see who swims faster?
:{{DIcon}} I'm game.
:{{A|vo dyjeq004 13 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Er... You guys go ahead! Paimon will grab the clapperboard to mark the start of the race...

;(Approach the other shore)
:{{A|vo dyjeq004 14 chevreuse 01.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' Whoa, that felt good!
:{{A|vo dyjeq004 14 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You were so fast in the water, Chevreuse... You were swimming even faster than Paimon could fly!
:{{A|vo dyjeq004 14 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So, about the Special Patrol... Did you join because of your dad?
:{{A|vo dyjeq004 14 chevreuse 02.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' Partly, but I'd say I was more inspired the heroes I read about in stories growing up.
:{{A|vo dyjeq004 14 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, so it's due to your love of stories...
:{{A|vo dyjeq004 14 chevreuse 03.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' Of course, it was only after I joined the Special Patrol that I learned that truth is often stranger than fiction.
:{{A|vo dyjeq004 14 chevreuse 04.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' ...Come on, let's walk a bit more.

;(After the cutscene)
:{{A|vo dyjeq004 15 chevreuse 01.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' To be honest, I do sometimes question whether the decisions I make are the right ones.
:{{A|vo dyjeq004 15 chevreuse 02.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' But I know that no matter what, I must keep swimming.
:{{A|vo dyjeq004 15 chevreuse 03.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' Because the only thing I've got my eyes on is the shore in the distance.

;(Approach Chevreuse after she finishes her walk)
:{{A|vo dyjeq004 16 chevreuse 01.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' Thank you for coming on this walk with me. I feel a lot better after getting all that off my chest.
:{{DIcon}} You're welcome.
:{{DIcon}} Anytime.
:{{A|vo dyjeq004 16 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh!? We're nearly back at Baptiste's house!
:{{A|vo dyjeq004 16 chevreuse 02.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' Huh, you're right. I didn't realize we were so close.
:{{A|vo dyjeq004 16 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' He really did plant a lot of flowers. It's just like how he described it in the story.
:{{A|vo dyjeq004 16 chevreuse 03.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' *gasp* Wait. Paimon, {{Traveler}}, look!
:{{A|vo dyjeq004 16 chevreuse 04.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' The Rainbow Roses in the garden... They're in full bloom now.

==Post-Quest Dialogue==
After completing this quest, Chevreuse can be found in the open world.

{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Talk to Chevreuse near [[Baptiste]]'s house)
:{{A|vo dialog dyjeq004 chevreuse 01.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' Even though it's a bit late, I must thank you for investigating this case with me.
:{{A|vo dialog dyjeq004 chevreuse 02.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' Not on behalf of the Special Patrol this time — it's a personal expression of gratitude from yours truly.
:{{DIcon}} About your family...
::{{A|vo dialog dyjeq004 chevreuse 03a 1.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' Ah, you want to hear more about my father?
::{{A|vo dialog dyjeq004 chevreuse 03a 2.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' To be honest, I didn't spend that much time with him. He was always busy with the Special Patrol, so he would often return home really late at night. Some nights, he didn't come home at all.
::{{A|vo dialog dyjeq004 chevreuse 03a 3.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' Once, he didn't come home for a long time. Maybe a whole week or so.
::{{A|vo dialog dyjeq004 chevreuse 03a 4.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' When I went out to buy food, I learned that he had become a criminal, and by extension, that made me a criminal's daughter.
::{{A|vo dialog dyjeq004 chevreuse 03a 5.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' But we can talk about that another day.
::;(Dialogue returns to option selection)
:{{DIcon}} About the case...
::{{A|vo dialog dyjeq004 chevreuse 03b 1.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' I actually have a lot of sympathy for Veronique and Baptiste. I can understand the hatred they feel for their father...
::{{A|vo dialog dyjeq004 chevreuse 03b 2.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' But that doesn't mean I'll allow them to walk the path of evil, even if it might lead to another sense of justice.
::;(Dialogue returns to option selection)
:{{DIcon}} About the film...
::{{A|vo dialog dyjeq004 chevreuse 03c 1.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' Films are different from the real world. They are a form of art and represent the wishes in people's hearts.
::{{A|vo dialog dyjeq004 chevreuse 03c 2.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' I adore "The Two Musketeers," and I'm very happy to have had the opportunity to act the role as one.
::{{A|vo dialog dyjeq004 chevreuse 03c 3.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' I can't wait to catch the film when it premieres in the opera house. I'm looking forward to seeing the audience's reaction to the climactic ending.
::;(Dialogue returns to option selection)
:{{DIcon}} Please take care...
::{{A|vo dialog dyjeq004 chevreuse 03d 1.ogg}} '''Chevreuse:''' Thank you for looking out for me. I'll see you at the award ceremony — I'd be very surprised if we don't win.
{{Dialogue End}}

'''''White Horse's Leisurely Journey''''' is the fourth part of the [[A Lanternlit Ode to the Silver Moon]] Event.

==Steps==
# Wait until the morning of the day after tomorrow
# Go to [[Third-Round Knockout]] and look for [[Zhongli]]
# Go to [[Wanmin Restaurant]]
# Go to [[Yilong Wharf]]
# Get in the chariot
# Ride in the chariot...
# Go to where the tea merchant is
# Go to [[Qiaoying Village]]
# Get in the chariot
# Ride in the chariot...
# Talk to [[Lu Xiangxiang]]
# Go to [[Qingce Village]]
# Get in the chariot
# Ride in the chariot...
# Follow the voice to its source
# Go to [[Wangshu Inn]]
# Get in the chariot
# Ride in the chariot...
# Enter Wangshu Inn
# Return to [[Liyue Harbor]]

==Gameplay Notes==
* During steps 5-6, 9-10, 13-14, and 17-18, the active party is limited to the [[Traveler]].
** If the player escapes from the chariot, quest progress will be reverted to the step before the party is limited.

:{{A|vo zblq001 3 zibai 11.ogg}} '''Zibai:''' Someone requested my help in purchasing some tea leaves. I was informed they have discounted prices during the festival and that I shall get a good deal there.
:{{A|vo zblq001 3 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Tea leaves...? This sounds like Zhongli's doing... He sure knows how to get people running errands for him!
:{{DIcon}} Has Zhongli started buying discounted tea?
:{{A|vo zblq001 3 zibai 12.ogg}} '''Zibai:''' Your friend, Rex— Zhongli, initially requested the most expensive tea.
:{{A|vo zblq001 3 zibai 13.ogg}} '''Zibai:''' But then a young lady in a hexagram hat mentioned he'd burned through the [[Wangsheng Funeral Parlor]]'s yearly expenses at an exhibition a few days ago.
:{{A|vo zblq001 3 zibai 14.ogg}} '''Zibai:''' As such, he is only permitted to buy items that are discounted this month.
:{{A|vo zblq001 3 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh! That's his boss, [[Hu Tao]]! It's about time she realized the problem and put a stop to his spending sprees.
:{{A|vo zblq001 3 shenhe 09.ogg}} '''Shenhe:''' Oh, I see. So that's why you're here. Unfortunately, Wanmin Restaurant doesn't sell tea leaves... If you're truly in need, I could gather some wild tea from the mountain slopes.
:{{A|vo zblq001 3 zibai 15.ogg}} '''Zibai:''' You don't sell tea leaves? But I remember your boss, [[Lu Xiangxiang|Miss Lu]], saying that she owns tea fields.
:{{A|vo zblq001 3 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You really should get some rest... The person you're talking about isn't the boss of Wanmin Restaurant! She's just like you — she came here to eat!
:{{A|vo zblq001 3 zibai 16.ogg}} '''Zibai:''' Is that so? Life really is full of surprises.
:{{A|vo zblq001 3 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What surprises!? Your brain really is as gooey as a pack of [[Slime]]s... Paimon can't believe Zhongli entrusted you with going all the way to Yilong Wharf and buying tea...
:{{DIcon}} Why don't we show you the way to Yilong Wharf?
:{{A|vo zblq001 3 zibai 17.ogg}} '''Zibai:''' That would be excellent, my dutiful guides.
:{{A|vo zblq001 3 zibai 18.ogg}} '''Zibai:''' Ah, yes, Miss Crane, I apologize profusely for my improper behavior just now. Please forgive me.
:{{A|vo zblq001 3 shenhe 10.ogg}} '''Shenhe:''' I completely understand. Master often says that the human body is like a mechanism in need of regular maintenance. When a person cannot rest at night, they are sure to become irritable and on edge.
:{{A|vo zblq001 3 zibai 19.ogg}} '''Zibai:''' Miss Crane... You appear reasoned and compassionate on the surface, yet I sense dark forces churning within your spiritual core... Those red ropes you wear are what bind them, am I correct?
:{{A|vo zblq001 3 shenhe 11.ogg}} '''Shenhe:''' ...You can sense that?
:{{A|vo zblq001 3 zibai 20.ogg}} '''Zibai:''' Indeed. I also sense that with your strength, you might try undoing one or two of those bonds when training.
:{{A|vo zblq001 3 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Untie Shenhe's ropes? Wouldn't that be risky...?
:{{A|vo zblq001 3 zibai 21.ogg}} '''Zibai:''' Though the use of red ropes to bind the soul is a wondrous technique, practitioners must eventually learn to break free from external aids and look within themselves for restraint.
:{{A|vo zblq001 3 shenhe 12.ogg}} '''Shenhe:''' [[Cloud Retainer|Master]] has told me similar things, but I... I am not ready yet.
:{{A|vo zblq001 3 zibai 22.ogg}} '''Zibai:''' Your self-cultivation has progressed far enough.
:{{A|vo zblq001 3 shenhe 13.ogg}} '''Shenhe:''' Then I will seek further guidance from my master.
:{{A|vo zblq001 3 zibai 23.ogg}} '''Zibai:''' If you still have doubts, you can find me at the [[Baiju Guesthouse]]. I'll be taking up residence there for a while.
:{{A|vo zblq001 3 zibai 24.ogg}} '''Zibai:''' For now, my dutiful guides, let us be off.

;(Approach the marked location)
:{{A|vo zblq001 4 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Weren't we going to Yilong Wharf? How did we end up on this mountain?
:{{A|vo zblq001 4 zibai 01.ogg}} '''Zibai:''' Is that small town over there not Yilong Wharf? I sense a familiar scent wafting through the air.
:{{A|vo zblq001 4 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You're right... Except for the smell part. Paimon doesn't smell anything.
:{{A|vo zblq001 4 zibai 02.ogg}} '''Zibai:''' That is because... this scent is the essence of jade, which can nourish the spirit.
:{{A|vo zblq001 4 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh! Yeah, Chenyu Vale does have a lot of jade... but Paimon didn't think jade smelled like, y'know, anything...
:{{A|vo zblq001 4 zibai 03.ogg}} '''Zibai:''' Naturally, this has reminded me of something.
:{{A|vo zblq001 4 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hmm? And what's that?
:{{A|vo zblq001 4 zibai 04.ogg}} '''Zibai:''' A few simple tricks for mastering one's power.
:;(Zibai concentrates for a moment before summoning a jade chariot)
:{{A|vo zblq001 4 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What is that thing!?
:{{A|vo zblq001 4 zibai 05.ogg}} '''Zibai:''' I'm sure you've been to Yilong Wharf many times before. But I wonder if you've done so while cruising through the air?
:{{A|vo zblq001 4 zibai 06.ogg}} '''Zibai:''' You've been such dutiful, dedicated guides, so allow me to offer this fresh experience as recompense.
:{{A|vo zblq001 4 zibai 07.ogg}} '''Zibai:''' Please, step in.

;(While riding the chariot)
:{{A|vo zblq001 5 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' This... is... amazing! Paimon feels just like an [[adeptus]] flying through the sky... What is this thing?
:{{A|vo zblq001 5 zibai 01.ogg}} '''Zibai:''' Hehe, I created it from my memories of the chariot of the lunar palace.
:{{A|vo zblq001 5 zibai 02.ogg}} '''Zibai:''' Many years have passed since I last laid eyes upon it, so there may be some discrepancies. Nonetheless, it is functionally much the same.
:{{A|vo zblq001 5 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' A lunar chariot!? Wow... Paimon never imagined she'd get to ride in one...
:{{A|vo zblq001 5 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So Zibai, does that mean you used to work on the moon?
:{{A|vo zblq001 5 zibai 03.ogg}} '''Zibai:''' Work...? That's an interesting way to phrase it. Though I suppose you are correct.
:{{A|vo zblq001 5 zibai 04.ogg}} '''Zibai:''' I was once an [[angel]] — a member of a race tasked with guiding humanity. Then, graced by serendipity, I became a [[Moon Envoy|moon envoy]].
:{{A|vo zblq001 5 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh? What's a moon envoy? Some kinda super-important angel?
:{{A|vo zblq001 5 zibai 05.ogg}} '''Zibai:''' As you would understand it, a moon envoy is a job title. Any angel — or non-angel — can become a moon envoy.
:{{A|vo zblq001 5 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Does that mean you're not the only one?
:{{A|vo zblq001 5 zibai 06.ogg}} '''Zibai:''' Of course not. Though my memories are still hazy, I vaguely remember some of my colleagues — there was one who liked to take on the form of an ibis...
:{{A|vo zblq001 5 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' An ibis... [[Thoth|Could it be]]...?
:{{A|vo zblq001 5 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Can all moon envoys turn into animals?
:{{A|vo zblq001 5 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Does that mean [[Lauma]] could take that job? She can turn into a deer, and [[Frostmoon Scions|Moonchanters]] are some sorta lunar envoy anyway, right?
:{{A|vo zblq001 5 zibai 07.ogg}} '''Zibai:''' A Moon... chanter? I have no idea what those are...
:{{A|vo zblq001 5 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, okay then...
:{{A|vo zblq001 5 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Look! Paimon thinks she saw a tea vendor over there!
:{{A|vo zblq001 5 zibai 08.ogg}} '''Zibai:''' Very well, let's take a look.

;(Approach [[Fenglian]])
:{{A|vo zblq001 6 fenglian 01.ogg}} '''Fenglian:''' Welcome! Please have a look around. We only sell teas of the finest quality, sourced directly from [[Qiaoying Village]]. Right now, we're offering a special discount for Lantern Rite!
:{{A|vo zblq001 6 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Look over there! Discounted tea!
:{{A|vo zblq001 6 fenglian 02.ogg}} '''Fenglian:''' Dear customers, are you looking to purchase some tea leaves?
:{{A|vo zblq001 6 fenglian 03.ogg}} '''Fenglian:''' I can see from your bearing that you are no ordinary customers — my humble shop has some exquisite teas that should satisfy your more refined tastes.
:{{A|vo zblq001 6 zibai 01.ogg}} '''Zibai:''' We're not here for quality — we're looking for a discount.
:{{A|vo zblq001 6 fenglian 04.ogg}} '''Fenglian:''' Discount? Well, that's a coincidence! Our Sunglo Tea is on sale right now. A special festive offer!
:{{A|vo zblq001 6 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Something about the name of that tea sounds familiar to Paimon...
:{{A|vo zblq001 6 fenglian 05.ogg}} '''Fenglian:''' Buy three boxes of Sunglo Tea during the festival to get ten percent off. Buy four, get twenty percent off. Buy ten b—
:{{DIcon}} ...Buy ten boxes, get fifty percent off?
:{{A|vo zblq001 6 fenglian 06.ogg}} '''Fenglian:''' That's right, ten boxes at half price! Have you been to our shop before, by any chance?
:{{A|vo zblq001 6 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, Paimon's definitely heard this spiel before!
:;(Zibai's eyes turn from gold to blue)
:{{A|vo zblq001 6 zibai 02.ogg}} '''Zibai:''' Three, four, ten...
:{{A|vo zblq001 6 zibai 03.ogg}} '''Zibai:''' Ten, twenty, fifty...
:{{A|vo zblq001 6 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Zibai, what are you muttering about...?
:{{A|vo zblq001 6 zibai 04.ogg}} '''Zibai:''' When purchasing three, four, or ten boxes... the corresponding discounts are ten, twenty, and fifty percent...
:{{A|vo zblq001 6 zibai 05.ogg}} '''Zibai:''' The intervals between the two sets of numbers are 1 and 6, and 10 and 30...
:{{A|vo zblq001 6 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Look! Her eyes turned blue! That's gotta be a first...
:{{A|vo zblq001 6 zibai 06.ogg}} '''Zibai:''' If the differences between intervals remain equal, the interval after six should be six plus the difference between six and one, which is eleven. Similarly, after thirty, the next interval should be fifty...
:{{A|vo zblq001 6 zibai 07.ogg}} '''Zibai:''' Therefore, extrapolating upward, the next two numbers in each set should be twenty-one and one hundred.
:{{A|vo zblq001 6 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ugh... you're making Paimon's head spin... Those numbers... What do they mean?
:{{A|vo zblq001 6 zibai 08.ogg}} '''Zibai:''' They mean that if we buy twenty-one boxes of Sunglo Tea, we should get a 100% discount.
:{{A|vo zblq001 6 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' A 100% discount!? You mean we'll get 'em for free!?
:{{DIcon}} That is what she means.
:{{A|vo zblq001 6 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ohh, there was a pattern to the discounts... Is... is that right?
:{{A|vo zblq001 6 zibai 09.ogg}} '''Zibai:''' The pattern we speak of is mathematics, little one. A pattern that is always right.
:{{A|vo zblq001 6 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' That's amazing! You're a shopping genius, Zibai! But wait... something feels off here...
:{{A|vo zblq001 6 fenglian 07.ogg}} '''Fenglian:''' *cough*... I had no idea our shop's discounts were tied to the laws of nature... I've learned so much from you, dear customer...
:{{A|vo zblq001 6 zibai 10.ogg}} '''Zibai:''' No need to thank me. Now, please give us our twenty-one boxes of free tea.
:{{A|vo zblq001 6 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' W—Wait!
:{{A|vo zblq001 6 zibai 11.ogg}} '''Zibai:''' What's the matter?
:{{A|vo zblq001 6 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Paimon just realized what it is that's not right...
:{{A|vo zblq001 6 fenglian 08.ogg}} '''Fenglian:''' It took you long enough...
:{{A|vo zblq001 6 paimon 12.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' We got the short end of the stick!
:{{A|vo zblq001 6 paimon 13.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Think about it — if we don't have to pay when buying twenty-one boxes, then if we buy even more, the vendor should be paying us money instead, right?
:{{A|vo zblq001 6 fenglian 09.ogg}} '''Fenglian:''' Huh...?
:{{A|vo zblq001 6 paimon 14.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hey, Zibai, work this one out! If we buy a hundred boxes, we'd make loads of money, wouldn't we?
:{{A|vo zblq001 6 zibai 12.ogg}} '''Zibai:''' It stands to reason.
:{{A|vo zblq001 6 fenglian 10.ogg}} '''Fenglian:''' Wait a moment, dear customers... don't you think you're haggling a little too hard?
:{{A|vo zblq001 6 zibai 13.ogg}} '''Zibai:''' You are the one dictating the discounts. We're simply extrapolating the numerical patterns within. As such, we are hardly haggling.
:{{A|vo zblq001 6 fenglian 11.ogg}} '''Fenglian:''' Uhm... You have a point... However... Ah, aha! That's right!
:{{A|vo zblq001 6 fenglian 12.ogg}} '''Fenglian:''' I'm so sorry, I just remembered... My supplier didn't come today, so we don't have any tea after all...
:{{A|vo zblq001 6 fenglian 13.ogg}} '''Fenglian:''' Such a shame... Terribly sorry about this... awful, awful luck... Ahahem...
:{{A|vo zblq001 6 zibai 14.ogg}} '''Zibai:''' Where can we find your supplier?
:{{A|vo zblq001 6 fenglian 14.ogg}} '''Fenglian:''' Uhm... Well...
:{{A|vo zblq001 6 zibai 15.ogg}} '''Zibai:''' Not to fret. We'll save you the effort and go straight to the source ourselves.
:{{A|vo zblq001 6 fenglian 15.ogg}} '''Fenglian:''' Uhm... W—Well you see, dear client, the supplier's discount isn't as generous as ours. You won't be able to get the same price from them.
:{{A|vo zblq001 6 paimon 15.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh? Does that mean they won't pay us for taking their tea?
:{{A|vo zblq001 6 fenglian 16.ogg}} '''Fenglian:''' Ahahem... They might not even offer you a 100% discount...
:{{A|vo zblq001 6 zibai 16.ogg}} '''Zibai:''' How very unfortunate. Nevertheless, as the original supplier, they must offer some sort of discount.
:{{A|vo zblq001 6 zibai 17.ogg}} '''Zibai:''' Besides, we're not looking to make money — we just want a good deal.
:{{A|vo zblq001 6 fenglian 17.ogg}} '''Fenglian:''' W—Well... that's great. My suppliers are all tea farmers from Qiaoying Village... You can go ask around the village — but please don't say I sent you...
:{{A|vo zblq001 6 zibai 18.ogg}} '''Zibai:''' Do not worry, we appreciate your generosity.
:{{A|vo zblq001 6 zibai 19.ogg}} '''Zibai:''' Referring customers to your business partners, even choosing to remain anonymous — the demeanor of a true gentleman, indeed. Your business will surely prosper.
:{{A|vo zblq001 6 fenglian 18.ogg}} '''Fenglian:''' I hope you're right, haha...
:{{A|vo zblq001 6 zibai 20.ogg}} '''Zibai:''' Then let us head to Qiaoying Village. Do you know the way, my guides?
:{{A|vo zblq001 6 paimon 16.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Of course. Just follow us!
:{{A|vo zblq001 6 fenglian 19a.ogg}}<!--{{A|vo zblq001 6 fenglian 19b.ogg}}--> '''Fenglian:''' *sigh*... What otherworldly beings were those? Thank the heavens I managed to send them on their way...
:{{A|vo zblq001 6 fenglian 20.ogg}} '''Fenglian:''' I should hurry home and pray to the White Horse Adeptus. May she bless me, such that I never encounter such customers again.

;(Talk to Fenglian, optional)
:{{A|vo dialog zblq001 fenglian 01.ogg}} '''Fenglian:''' I should hurry home and pray to the White Horse Adeptus. May she bless me, such that I never encounter such customers again.

;(Approach the marked location)
:{{A|vo zblq001 8 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Here we are — Qiaoying Village!
:{{A|vo zblq001 8 zibai 01.ogg}} '''Zibai:''' The mountains and waters are pristine — they embody the beauty of heaven and earth.
:{{A|vo zblq001 8 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' It's a good-looking place, alright, but it's hard to enjoy the scenery when Paimon can't stop thinking about all that tea-buying [[Mora]] we're missing out on.
:{{A|vo zblq001 8 zibai 02.ogg}} '''Zibai:''' Should fate dictate, Mora will find its way to you sooner or later.
:{{A|vo zblq001 8 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Well, Morax certainly finds us often enough. He even sought us out in person this Lantern Rite...
:;(Zibai smiles, her eyes having turned gold once more)
:{{A|vo zblq001 8 zibai 03.ogg}} '''Zibai:''' Hehe. For now, let's look around and see if any tea farmers are selling their crop.
:{{A|vo zblq001 8 zibai 04.ogg}} '''Zibai:''' We'll be able to see more clearly from up high. Let's take to the sky and enjoy the beautiful scenery while we're at it.

;(While riding the chariot)
:{{A|vo zblq001 9 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wow... Qiaoying Village looks beautiful from up here.
:{{A|vo zblq001 9 zibai 01.ogg}} '''Zibai:''' Indeed, the houses here are quite different from those in Liyue Harbor. They follow the natural contours of the mountains, forming unique, elegant structures.
:{{A|vo zblq001 9 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yeah, it's super beautiful!
:{{A|vo zblq001 9 zibai 02.ogg}} '''Zibai:''' The white walls and dark tiles frame the emerald waves of the terraced fields, while the curved eaves and tall gateways juxtapose each other with grace.
:{{A|vo zblq001 9 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' It's almost too beautiful to be true!
:{{A|vo zblq001 9 zibai 03.ogg}} '''Zibai:''' The crowing of roosters and barking of dogs, the calls of farmers working the fields — a vibrant pastoral chorus overflowing with earthly vitality.
:{{A|vo zblq001 9 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yeah! It's incredibly beautiful, huh?
:{{A|vo zblq001 9 zibai 04.ogg}} '''Zibai:''' Have you... studied the linguistic arts, by some chance?
:{{A|vo zblq001 9 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh?
:{{A|vo zblq001 9 zibai 05.ogg}} '''Zibai:''' Your vocabulary for beauty seems... rather constrained.
:{{A|vo zblq001 9 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Paimon knows how to say "pretty" as well!
:{{A|vo zblq001 9 zibai 06.ogg}} '''Zibai:''' I see... Now then, let's take a look around and see if we can find any farmers selling tea...
:{{A|vo zblq001 9 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Look! There's someone in that tea field, and they look kinda familiar... Wait, is that [[Lu Xiangxiang]]?
:{{A|vo zblq001 9 zibai 07.ogg}} '''Zibai:''' And who is that?
:{{A|vo zblq001 9 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh! You'll remember her once you see her up close.
:;(The chariot lands, and they approach Lu Xiangxiang)
:{{A|vo zblq001 9 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hey there, Lu Xiangxiang! It really is you!
:{{A|vo zblq001 9 luxiangxiang 01.ogg}} '''Lu Xiangxiang:''' Huh? Paimon, {{Traveler}}, and the "White Horse Adeptus"! Fancy seeing you here!
:{{A|vo zblq001 9 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hehehe, the White Horse Adeptus has a name now! You can call her Zibai!
:{{A|vo zblq001 9 zibai 08.ogg}} '''Zibai:''' And you are...?
:{{A|vo zblq001 9 zibai 09.ogg}} '''Zibai:''' Wait... I remember now, you're...
:{{A|vo zblq001 9 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Don't say anything about food poisoning or fish!
:{{A|vo zblq001 9 zibai 10.ogg}} '''Zibai:''' You're... the young lady who wanted to rise above the rest, are you not?
:{{A|vo zblq001 9 luxiangxiang 02.ogg}} '''Lu Xiangxiang:''' Haha... Yes, that's me, but I'm in a bit of a state right now — at best, I can say I've... fallen below them.
:{{A|vo zblq001 9 paimon 12.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Fallen below them? What happened?
:{{A|vo zblq001 9 luxiangxiang 03.ogg}} '''Lu Xiangxiang:''' Like I said the last time we met, I'm being punished according to family rules.
:{{A|vo zblq001 9 luxiangxiang 04.ogg}} '''Lu Xiangxiang:''' My father, mother, grandfather, grandmother, other grandfather, other grandmother...
:{{A|vo zblq001 9 paimon 13.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Whoa! That's a lot of family members...
:{{A|vo zblq001 9 luxiangxiang 05.ogg}} '''Lu Xiangxiang:''' Yeah, and on the night of Lantern Rite, they held a family meeting to discuss my situation.
:{{A|vo zblq001 9 paimon 14.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So they do care about you!
:{{A|vo zblq001 9 luxiangxiang 06.ogg}} '''Lu Xiangxiang:''' There's no doubt they care, but they think that since I caused all that trouble in Liyue Harbor, it shows I can't be trusted on my own. They decided to ground me.
:{{A|vo zblq001 9 paimon 15.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ground you?
:{{A|vo zblq001 9 luxiangxiang 07.ogg}} '''Lu Xiangxiang:''' Yeah, though they're not confining me to my room. Instead, I have to personally nurture a tea seedling until it grows big enough to be sold at market.
:{{A|vo zblq001 9 paimon 16.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Aw, a tiny little tea baby! Do they want you to experience what it's like to be a parent?
:{{A|vo zblq001 9 luxiangxiang 08.ogg}} '''Lu Xiangxiang:''' It's supposed to cultivate my character and temperament. They say this will help me calm down and reflect on my issues.
:{{A|vo zblq001 9 paimon 17.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What happened in Liyue Harbor really wasn't your fault... Oh well, at least this punishment doesn't sound too harsh.
:{{A|vo zblq001 9 paimon 18.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So... how long will it take for the little tea baby to grow?
:{{A|vo zblq001 9 luxiangxiang 09.ogg}} '''Lu Xiangxiang:''' Actually, I don't know. I've never grown a tea tree before...
:{{A|vo zblq001 9 zibai 11.ogg}} '''Zibai:''' It usually takes two or three years.
:{{A|vo zblq001 9 luxiangxiang 10.ogg}} '''Lu Xiangxiang:''' Two or three years!?
:{{A|vo zblq001 9 zibai 12.ogg}} '''Zibai:''' Yes, the tea in this garden requires two or three years to mature.
:{{A|vo zblq001 9 paimon 19.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' That long!? Zibai, you're not making this up, are you? How do you know so much about growing tea?
:{{A|vo zblq001 9 zibai 13.ogg}} '''Zibai:''' When the plants thrive and grow — that is the meaning of my name. I can tell at a glance when their season of ripening will come.
:{{A|vo zblq001 9 luxiangxiang 11.ogg}} '''Lu Xiangxiang:''' Do I really have to waste two or three years here... Why is this happening to me? I'd only just found my direction in life...
:{{DIcon}} Did you figure out what you could do to make it on your own?
:{{A|vo zblq001 9 luxiangxiang 12.ogg}} '''Lu Xiangxiang:''' Yes! During the night of Lantern Rite, I heard many people reciting poems from Lang-Gan in praise of the moon. In that moment, I suddenly felt a great sense of pride...
:{{A|vo zblq001 9 luxiangxiang 13.ogg}} '''Lu Xiangxiang:''' I mean, I helped excavate cultural artifacts from Lang-Gan, so I contributed to the revival of these poems, too, right?
:{{A|vo zblq001 9 luxiangxiang 14.ogg}} '''Lu Xiangxiang:''' So I decided to stay with the archaeological team. I want to unearth even more history.
:{{A|vo zblq001 9 zibai 14.ogg}} '''Zibai:''' I see... And are you sure that's what you want to do? If you don't achieve anything significant in the years to come, will you still enjoy it?
:{{A|vo zblq001 9 luxiangxiang 15.ogg}} '''Lu Xiangxiang:''' Yes! Because archaeology gives me that "boom shaka-laka" feeling!
:{{A|vo zblq001 9 paimon 20.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wait... Did Xiangling teach you that?
:{{A|vo zblq001 9 luxiangxiang 16.ogg}} '''Lu Xiangxiang:''' Hehe, that's right, I was asking her for advice. She said that if something gives you that boom shaka-laka feeling, then it has to be worth pursuing.
:{{A|vo zblq001 9 luxiangxiang 17.ogg}} '''Lu Xiangxiang:''' I immediately thought about how, when I'm excavating in the ruins, I always feel like there's a ghost standing beside me — and not in a spooky way!
:{{A|vo zblq001 9 luxiangxiang 18.ogg}} '''Lu Xiangxiang:''' It feels like my great-great-great-great... great-grandmother, patting me on the shoulder and saying, "Keep going! You're about to rediscover some grand ancestral knowledge!"
:{{DIcon}} That certainly sounds like a boom shaka-laka sort of feeling...
:{{A|vo zblq001 9 luxiangxiang 19.ogg}} '''Lu Xiangxiang:''' Right? It feels like I've made some kind of connection with my ancestors... Isn't that amazing?
:{{A|vo zblq001 9 zibai 15.ogg}} '''Zibai:''' Since you've made up your mind, you should give it your all.
:{{A|vo zblq001 9 luxiangxiang 20.ogg}} '''Lu Xiangxiang:''' And I'd love to... but I'm still grounded.
:{{A|vo zblq001 9 zibai 16.ogg}} '''Zibai:''' Run away. Summon up a little boom shaka-laka and leave the tea garden behind — flee this village.

:{{A|vo zblq001 13 hutao 22.ogg}} '''Hu Tao:''' Alright, we'll take our leave now. See you later!
:{{A|vo zblq001 13 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hu Tao's so thoughtful! Why don't we follow her advice and stay at the Wangshu Inn tonight?
:{{A|vo zblq001 13 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Zibai, you can see the whole of [[Dihua Marsh]] from up there — the view's amazing! Plus, you can sample [[Smiley Yanxiao]]'s cooking!
:{{A|vo zblq001 13 zibai 05.ogg}} '''Zibai:''' Wangshu... An intriguing name. It couldn't hurt to check it out.
:{{A|vo zblq001 13 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Awesome! Let's go!
----
;(Approach the marked location in Dihua Marsh)
:{{A|vo zblq001 14 zibai 01.ogg}} '''Zibai:''' Is that towering structure Wangshu Inn?
:{{A|vo zblq001 14 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Sure is! We can take the lift up from over there!
:{{A|vo zblq001 14 zibai 02.ogg}} '''Zibai:''' Hehe, always walking the path long-trodden — does retracing others' footsteps not tire you?
:{{A|vo zblq001 14 zibai 03.ogg}} '''Zibai:''' Come on, get in, we'll fly to the top.

;(While riding the chariot)
:{{A|vo zblq001 15 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Are we really gonna fly up to Wangshu Inn? Isn't that a bit showy? All the guests are gonna see us.
:{{A|vo zblq001 15 zibai 01.ogg}} '''Zibai:''' Is that a bad thing? To be able to witness an adeptus — this will surely add to the inn's appeal, not to mention the room prices. The owner will thank us.
:{{A|vo zblq001 15 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You seem to really like showing off your powers...
:{{A|vo zblq001 15 zibai 02.ogg}} '''Zibai:''' Hehe, this inn's architecture is incredible, and the surrounding countryside radiates a picturesque charm. No wonder the new proprietor of the Baiju Guesthouse thinks he can't compete and has decided to change his own establishment's name.
:{{A|vo zblq001 15 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' The new proprietor? Ah, you mean [[Lu Weng|Lu Xiangxiang's dad]]! So you know about that, too!
:{{A|vo zblq001 15 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Personally, Paimon thinks he should go with something like "Rex's Rest." That's a contender's name if Paimon's ever heard one!
:{{A|vo zblq001 15 zibai 03.ogg}} '''Zibai:''' A fitting name indeed.
:{{A|vo zblq001 15 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So you think the guesthouse should change its name, too? Paimon kinda thought you'd say something like, "Such sacrosanct traditions must never change."
:{{A|vo zblq001 15 zibai 04.ogg}} '''Zibai:''' Time flows ever onward. Why should the rules of yesterday be carried forward into the world of tomorrow? The people of today should determine what is to be kept.
:{{A|vo zblq001 15 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh. You're not as old-fashioned and stuffy as Paimon thought!
:{{A|vo zblq001 15 zibai 05.ogg}} '''Zibai:''' The years ebb and flow, seas recede to reveal fields... In the vastness of time, I am but a wild horse in a boundless sea of dust.
:{{A|vo zblq001 15 zibai 06.ogg}} '''Zibai:''' Even Rex Lapis, having waded through the waters of the river of time, is not quite the same as before.
:{{A|vo zblq001 15 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' ...Zhongli? What was he like before...?
:{{A|vo zblq001 15 zibai 07.ogg}} '''Zibai:''' That is another story for another time.
:{{A|vo zblq001 15 zibai 08.ogg}} '''Zibai:''' We have arrived.

;(After riding the chariot)
:{{A|vo zblq001 16 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Whew! This is the first time Paimon's ever flown up to Wangshu Inn on a chariot! Everything's so different when you're up high...
:{{A|vo zblq001 16 zibai 01.ogg}} '''Zibai:''' Wangshu... Wangshu... Like Moon Lanterns and Xiao Lanterns... Might it all be a coincidence...?
:{{A|vo zblq001 16 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hmm? What's a coincidence?
:{{A|vo zblq001 16 zibai 02.ogg}} '''Zibai:''' Do you not know what "Wangshu" means?
:{{DIcon}} I have no idea.
:{{DIcon}} Does it mean "the moon"?
::{{A|vo zblq001 16 zibai 03b 1.ogg}} '''Zibai:''' Not bad. You're clearly much sharper than your diminutive companion.
:{{A|vo zblq001 16 zibai 04.ogg}} '''Zibai:''' Wangshu can refer to the moon, but its original meaning is actually...
:{{A|vo zblq001 16 xiao 01.ogg}} '''Xiao:''' The goddess who rides the bright moon's chariot.
:{{A|vo zblq001 16 zibai 05.ogg}} '''Zibai:''' And you must be... the Conqueror of Demons?
:{{A|vo zblq001 16 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Xiao! Paimon was wondering if we'd disturbed you by flying down from the sky.
:{{A|vo zblq001 16 xiao 02.ogg}} '''Xiao:''' Not at all — I sensed an unusual presence long before you arrived, though I didn't expect it to be you in a flying chariot.
:{{A|vo zblq001 16 zibai 06.ogg}} '''Zibai:''' Ah, a witness at last.
:{{A|vo zblq001 16 zibai 07.ogg}} '''Zibai:''' I was starting to think we should fly a bit lower — t'would be awfully dull if no one ends up marveling at my lofty bearing.
:{{A|vo zblq001 16 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' No need, no need! This is already showy enough!
:{{A|vo zblq001 16 zibai 08.ogg}} '''Zibai:''' Hehe, I'm not one to do good from the shadows, as Rex Lapis is wont to do.
:{{A|vo zblq001 16 xiao 03.ogg}} '''Xiao:''' Then you must be...
:{{DIcon}} She's the White Horse Adeptus.
:{{A|vo zblq001 16 zibai 09.ogg}} '''Zibai:''' Nay. I'm only cosplaying as the White Horse Adeptus, in truth.
:{{A|vo zblq001 16 xiao 04.ogg}} '''Xiao:''' Cosplaying? What's that?
:{{A|vo zblq001 16 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' *sigh* Ignore her nonsense, she's the genuine article, the one-and-only, completely authentic White Horse Adeptus. It's just...
:{{A|vo zblq001 16 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Xiao, did Zhongli say anything about her being a teensy bit... not quite right...
:{{A|vo zblq001 16 xiao 05.ogg}} '''Xiao:''' ...Mental instability, perhaps?
:{{A|vo zblq001 16 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Did Zhongli tell you that!?
:{{A|vo zblq001 16 xiao 06.ogg}} '''Xiao:''' No, this is my own speculation.
:{{A|vo zblq001 16 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Well, you've pretty much hit the nail on the head! It's like her brain's filled with a bunch of Slimes right now, all gloopy and messy!
:{{A|vo zblq001 16 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' There's a hot-tempered [[Pyro Slime]]... a math-obsessed [[Hydro Slime]]... and a mischievous little [[Anemo Slime]]...
:{{A|vo zblq001 16 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' But don't tell her Paimon said that, or she'll come and tell us all off.
:;(Zibai's eyes turn red again, and she looms over Paimon)
:{{A|vo zblq001 16 zibai 10.ogg}} '''Zibai:''' You white-haired rascal! Do you think I can't hear you!?
:;(The Traveler smiles knowingly as Paimon rushes to hide behind them)
:{{A|vo zblq001 16 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Uh-oh, we're in for it now!
:{{A|vo zblq001 16 xiao 07.ogg}} '''Xiao:''' Hmm... White Horse Adeptus... You must be weary from your journey. Why not take a rest?
:{{A|vo zblq001 16 paimon 12.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ooh, yes, yes, yes! You must be hungry, right, Zibai? How about we get some food... Haha... The chef here is incredible... Hehe...
:;(The group sits down for a meal, Zibai's eyes having returned to gold)
:{{A|vo zblq001 16 zibai 11.ogg}} '''Zibai:''' Mm! It's so hot... So spicy...
:;(Zibai starts tearing up again)
:{{A|vo zblq001 16 paimon 13.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Are you okay? Do you want Paimon to get you some water?
:{{A|vo zblq001 16 zibai 12.ogg}} '''Zibai:''' Ahem... Don't worry about me... I just need to pace myself.
:{{A|vo zblq001 16 xiao 08.ogg}} '''Xiao:''' So... regarding your friend and her... condition, does even the Lord of Geo have no solution?
:{{A|vo zblq001 16 paimon 14.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Zhongli said we should wait, and she'll get better on her own. But who knows how long that's gonna take...
:{{DIcon}} He says her three spirits have only just merged and have yet to settle.
:{{A|vo zblq001 16 xiao 09.ogg}} '''Xiao:''' Is that why her personalities change so easily?
:{{A|vo zblq001 16 paimon 15.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Paimon thinks that has something to do with her Three Deadly Selves. Zhongli told us that the Deadly Selves are impure, affecting living things that get too close...
:{{A|vo zblq001 16 xiao 10.ogg}} '''Xiao:''' Hmm, the White Horse Adeptus's remnant spirit was attached to the Deadly Selves for a long time... It makes sense that her temperament and memories would have been influenced by them...
:{{A|vo zblq001 16 paimon 16.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' But... Paimon still doesn't really understand what the Three Deadly Selves actually are...
:{{A|vo zblq001 16 xiao 11.ogg}} '''Xiao:''' Paimon, as you do not practice self-cultivation, I cannot help you fully understand, but you can think of them simply as emotions and desires.
:{{A|vo zblq001 16 xiao 12.ogg}} '''Xiao:''' The act of "Severing the Three Deadly Selves" is a means of exorcising wicked desires and cultivating one's true self. I believe other nations have similar practices — in [[Sumeru]], it is known as Shattering Atmagraha.
:{{A|vo zblq001 16 paimon 17.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh! So it's about emotions, desires, and attachments, that sort of thing!
:{{A|vo zblq001 16 xiao 13.ogg}} '''Xiao:''' It includes those... I wonder, does she still remember what happened in the past?
:{{A|vo zblq001 16 paimon 18.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Some of it, but right now, it's like she was suddenly awakened — like she's still half dreaming.
:{{A|vo zblq001 16 paimon 19.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' The half that's still dreaming might remember things, but the half that's awake doesn't quite get it.
:{{A|vo zblq001 16 zibai 13.ogg}} '''Zibai:''' Conqueror of Demons... Are you looking to learn about Rex Lapis's past from me?
:{{A|vo zblq001 16 xiao 14.ogg}} '''Xiao:''' You are an old friend of his, so please, call me by my name.
:{{A|vo zblq001 16 zibai 14.ogg}} '''Zibai:''' Hehe, but "Conqueror of Demons" sounds so much more imposing.
:{{DIcon}} I'd like to know about Zhongli's past too.
:{{A|vo zblq001 16 zibai 15.ogg}} '''Zibai:''' In days of yore, he was... the Lord of Geo, Heaven's Star.
:{{A|vo zblq001 16 paimon 20.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh!? You said the same thing the day you came back! B—But, what does it mean?
:{{A|vo zblq001 16 zibai 16.ogg}} '''Zibai:''' Mmm... I'm afraid I can't remember.
:{{A|vo zblq001 16 paimon 21.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hey! Did you really forget, or are you just pretending so you don't have to tell?
:{{A|vo zblq001 16 zibai 17.ogg}} '''Zibai:''' Why not ask Rex Lapis himself? Whether I've forgotten might be up for debate, but I am certain he remembers.
:{{A|vo zblq001 16 xiao 15.ogg}} '''Xiao:''' Hmm... He must have his reasons for not raising the past, and you likely have similar concerns. I shouldn't have asked.
:{{A|vo zblq001 16 zibai 18.ogg}} '''Zibai:''' An answer that suits your style, General Alatus. Now that we're on the subject, though, I suddenly remembered something...
:{{A|vo zblq001 16 xiao 16.ogg}} '''Xiao:''' Which is?
:{{A|vo zblq001 16 zibai 19.ogg}} '''Zibai:''' In the distant past, there was a feast, which I attended. I faintly recall the Lord of Geo also being present that day...
:{{A|vo zblq001 16 paimon 22.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh! And then? What happened?
:{{A|vo zblq001 16 zibai 20.ogg}} '''Zibai:''' Among the dishes served, there was one that could be found in every household throughout Lang-Gan at the start of spring — a dish called "[[Flavor of Spring]]."
:{{A|vo zblq001 16 zibai 21.ogg}} '''Zibai:''' I suddenly remembered the recipe for this dish.
:{{A|vo zblq001 16 paimon 23.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' ...Is that it!?
:{{A|vo zblq001 16 zibai 22.ogg}} '''Zibai:''' Yes. Since it's Lantern Rite here in Liyue, why don't I make some for you to try?
:{{A|vo zblq001 16 xiao 17.ogg}} '''Xiao:''' ...That sounds... good.
:{{A|vo zblq001 16 paimon 24.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wow! It might not have been the story Paimon was hoping for... but this looks deeelicious!
:{{A|vo zblq001 16 zibai 23.ogg}} '''Zibai:''' The spring breeze stirs — now is the perfect time to savor this dish.
:{{A|vo zblq001 16 zibai 24.ogg}} '''Zibai:''' My dutiful guides have gone to great trouble to show me around Liyue, and even the Conqueror of Demons has graced us with his presence. I feel deeply honored — this Flavor of Spring is my way of expressing my gratitude.
:{{A|vo zblq001 16 xiao 18.ogg}} '''Xiao:''' There's no need for such grand words...
:{{DIcon}} I have a gift for you, too.
:{{A|vo zblq001 16 zibai 25.ogg}} '''Zibai:''' ...What's this?
:{{A|vo zblq001 16 paimon 25.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hey! It's that broken jade token from the antiques exhibition!
:{{DIcon}} I believe this belongs to you, yes?
:{{A|vo zblq001 16 zibai 26.ogg}} '''Zibai:''' Hehe, indeed, this was once an adeptal treasure of mine. I'm amazed it ended up in your hands. Alas, it serves little purpose now in its fractured state. Please, keep it as a memento.
:{{A|vo zblq001 16 paimon 26.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, that's a shame... Can't we fix it?
:{{A|vo zblq001 16 zibai 27.ogg}} '''Zibai:''' This is the way of the world — once jade is broken, it can never be made whole.
:{{A|vo zblq001 16 xiao 19.ogg}} '''Xiao:''' Then... what about forging a new one?
:{{A|vo zblq001 16 zibai 28.ogg}} '''Zibai:''' Hehe... That is a good point — that it has ended up in your hands must be a message from fate.
:{{A|vo zblq001 16 zibai 29.ogg}} '''Zibai:''' I could try to craft it into a little trinket for you. One that might prove useful on your journey.
:{{A|vo zblq001 16 paimon 27.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ooh? What sorta trinket?
:{{A|vo zblq001 16 zibai 30.ogg}} '''Zibai:''' Hehe, it's just a passing thought, one that will require the right opportunity. I'll think about it more when the time comes.
:{{A|vo zblq001 16 zibai 31.ogg}} '''Zibai:''' Now that we've had our fill, we should get some rest. Tomorrow we return to Liyue Harbor, where I'll have need of your guidance once more.
:;(After a night's rest, the Traveler and Zibai emerge from Wangshu Inn refreshed)
<!-- time changes from night to day -->

;(Approach [[Qiqi]] and [[Yaoyao]] in Liyue Harbor)
:{{A|vo zblq001 17 yaoyao 01.ogg}} '''Yaoyao:''' Qiqi, the Lantern Rite is almost over. Do you remember how to make a Xiao Lantern?
:{{A|vo zblq001 17 qiqi 01.ogg}} '''Qiqi:''' Morning, split bamboo, {{Traveler}}...
:{{A|vo zblq001 17 qiqi 02.ogg}} '''Qiqi:''' Then get silk, make Paimon...
:{{A|vo zblq001 17 yaoyao 02.ogg}} '''Yaoyao:''' You've got it all mixed up again!
:{{A|vo zblq001 17 qiqi 03a.ogg}}<!--{{A|vo zblq001 17 qiqi 03b.ogg}}--> '''Qiqi:''' ...They're here again.
:{{A|vo zblq001 17 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yaoyao! Looking good in that [[Rainlit Bamboo Reverie|new outfit]], huh?
:{{A|vo zblq001 17 yaoyao 03.ogg}} '''Yaoyao:''' Hey, it's Paimon! Hehe, Dr. [[Baizhu]] gave this to me as a gift. How does it suit me?
:{{DIcon}} It suits you very well — you look adorable.
:{{A|vo zblq001 17 yaoyao 04.ogg}} '''Yaoyao:''' Thank you!
:{{A|vo zblq001 17 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wow! What happened for Baizhu to suddenly give you a brand-new outfit, Yaoyao?
:{{A|vo zblq001 17 qiqi 04.ogg}} '''Qiqi:''' Dr. Baizhu is thanking Yaoyao... for teaching me to make Xiao Lanterns...
:{{A|vo zblq001 17 yaoyao 05.ogg}} '''Yaoyao:''' Qiqi and I were just playing together! Dr. Baizhu's too kind.
:{{A|vo zblq001 17 yaoyao 06.ogg}} '''Yaoyao:''' Oh, yeah, take a look at this! Dr. Baizhu gave me these clothes, but it was Qiqi who wove this little basket!
:{{A|vo zblq001 17 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wow, that's beautiful! When did you become so good with your hands, Qiqi?
:{{A|vo zblq001 17 qiqi 05.ogg}} '''Qiqi:''' I learned to make Xiao Lanterns... thanks to Yaoyao...
:{{A|vo zblq001 17 qiqi 06.ogg}} '''Qiqi:''' I also made a wish...
:{{A|vo zblq001 17 luweng 01.ogg}} '''Lu Weng:''' What do I always say? The White Horse Adeptus answers prayers! Come, help this old man make an offering in thanks.
:{{A|vo zblq001 17 yaoyao 07.ogg}} '''Yaoyao:''' Huh? [[Lu Weng|Mr. Lu]]? What did you pray for?
:{{A|vo zblq001 17 luweng 02.ogg}} '''Lu Weng:''' For my idiot son to finally come to his senses and not change Baiju Guesthouse's name — which he has!
:{{A|vo zblq001 17 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh!? He's keeping the old name?
:{{A|vo zblq001 17 luweng 03.ogg}} '''Lu Weng:''' Listen to this — my granddaughter planted a tea seedling in our village just a few days ago...
:{{A|vo zblq001 17 luweng 04.ogg}} '''Lu Weng:''' She made a prayer to the White Horse Adeptus to help it grow. Overnight, her seedling flourished into a mature tea tree!
:{{A|vo zblq001 17 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh... haha... That sure does sound like a miracle...
:{{A|vo zblq001 17 yaoyao 08.ogg}} '''Yaoyao:''' Could the White Horse Adeptus really have helped it grow?
:{{A|vo zblq001 17 luweng 05.ogg}} '''Lu Weng:''' Of course she did! O, White Horse Adeptus... How blessed is our family, over whom you keep watch!
:{{A|vo zblq001 17 zibai 01.ogg}} '''Zibai:''' Truly, this is an extraordinary miracle. You must record it in your family history without delay!
:{{A|vo zblq001 17 luweng 06.ogg}} '''Lu Weng:''' Of course... Huh? Is that you, Miss... Zibai?
:{{A|vo zblq001 17 zibai 02.ogg}} '''Zibai:''' Indeed. I have a long-term booking at your guesthouse.
:{{A|vo zblq001 17 luweng 07.ogg}} '''Lu Weng:''' Yes, yes, yes, I recall. Mr. Zhongli said to charge your expenses to the Wangsheng Funeral Parlor, if I remember correctly.
:{{A|vo zblq001 17 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' That Zhongli... Always making trouble for poor Hu Tao.
:{{A|vo zblq001 17 luweng 08.ogg}} '''Lu Weng:''' Hmm... I noticed when you were here last that you bear a striking resemblance to the pictures of the White Horse Adeptus in my family history — you both have golden eyes...
:{{A|vo zblq001 17 zibai 03.ogg}} '''Zibai:''' Perhaps fate has had a hand in our meeting.
:{{A|vo zblq001 17 luweng 09.ogg}} '''Lu Weng:''' And a glad meeting it is, Miss Zibai! Now, why don't I gift you some tea from my garden to celebrate this encounter?
:{{A|vo zblq001 17 luweng 10.ogg}} '''Lu Weng:''' We grow Sunglo Tea there, and it has quite a reputation throughout Yilong Wharf. I hope you will accept it.
:{{A|vo zblq001 17 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh! Sunglo "Buy-Ten-Boxes-Get-Half-Off" Tea's back on the menu!
:{{A|vo zblq001 17 luweng 11.ogg}} '''Lu Weng:''' Buy ten boxes, get half off? Don't be silly, this is a gift. It's free!
:{{A|vo zblq001 17 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Woohoo... Nice!
:{{A|vo zblq001 17 zibai 04.ogg}} '''Zibai:''' Hehe, thank you so much, Boss Lu.
:{{A|vo zblq001 17 luweng 12.ogg}} '''Lu Weng:''' There's no need to thank me. You're a visitor from out of town, which makes you an honored guest — make yourself at home.
:{{A|vo zblq001 17 luweng 13.ogg}} '''Lu Weng:''' Lantern Rite may have ended, but the streets are still bustling with activity.
:{{A|vo zblq001 17 luweng 14.ogg}} '''Lu Weng:''' Make sure to take everything in, meet some new friends, and enjoy your time here!
:{{A|vo zblq001 17 luweng 15.ogg}} '''Lu Weng:''' And that goes for you kids, as well. Happy Lantern Rite!
:{{A|vo zblq001 17 yaoyao 09.ogg}} '''Yaoyao:''' Got it, Mr. Lu!
:{{A|vo zblq001 17 qiqi 07.ogg}} '''Qiqi:''' Happy... Lantern Rite.
:{{A|vo zblq001 17 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yeah! Happy Lantern Rite, everyone!
:{{A|vo zblq001 17 zibai 05.ogg}} '''Zibai:''' Happy Lantern Rite indeed.
{{Dialogue End}}
