:{{A|vo fnnlq002 1 lauwick 01.ogg}} '''Lauwick:''' If I remember correctly, this is where he's staying.
:{{A|vo fnnlq002 1 pauleau 01.ogg}} '''Pauleau:''' Who is it?
:{{A|vo fnnlq002 1 lauwick 02.ogg}} '''Lauwick:''' It's me. Is the script ready?
:{{A|vo fnnlq002 1 pauleau 02.ogg}} '''Pauleau:''' ...You came all the way here for that?
:{{A|vo fnnlq002 1 lauwick 03.ogg}} '''Lauwick:''' Ugh, alright, forget that for now. Just come on out, we've got some great news.
:{{A|vo fnnlq002 1 pauleau 03.ogg}} '''Pauleau:''' Hmph, nice try... Look, just gimme some time, okay? I'm just wrapping up this last part of the script. I'll be out once I'm done.
:{{A|vo fnnlq002 1 lauwick 04.ogg}} '''Lauwick:''' Okay then. Looking forward to your masterpiece.
:{{A|vo fnnlq002 1 furina 01.ogg}} '''Furina:''' So... as expected, he's missed the deadline.
:{{A|vo fnnlq002 1 dulphy 01.ogg}} '''Dulphy:''' The ending is one of the most important parts of the show...
:{{A|vo fnnlq002 1 dulphy 02.ogg}} '''Dulphy:''' Even once he's done, it isn't final until we've all had the chance to read through and make sure we agree on it.
:{{A|vo fnnlq002 1 navia 01.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Someone told me they'd just seen you in Poisson. I assumed it was a case of mistaken identity, but sure enough, here you are... and Furina, too.
:{{A|vo fnnlq002 1 furina 02.ogg}} '''Furina:''' Ah... I was wondering if we might run into her...
:{{A|vo fnnlq002 1 navia 02.ogg}} '''Navia:''' So, you're here for Pauleau? Looks like he could be a while, so feel free to take a stroll around town in the meantime. I've made all the arrangements already.
:{{A|vo fnnlq002 1 lauwick 05.ogg}} '''Lauwick:''' Oh, it's okay, we can just wait h—
:;([[Dulphy]] walks behind [[Lauwick]] and walks away with him)
:{{A|vo fnnlq002 1 dulphy 03.ogg}} '''Dulphy:''' Thank you for being so considerate, Miss [[Navia]]! That sounds wonderful. We'll take that stroll!
:{{A|vo fnnlq002 1 dulphy 04.ogg}} '''Dulphy:''' Get over here, you! How oblivious are you!?
:{{A|vo fnnlq002 1 furina 03.ogg}} '''Furina:''' How are things in Poisson now? Any better?
:{{A|vo fnnlq002 1 navia 03.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Things are on the mend, but it's a slow process. Some people may never recover from the trauma they experienced.
:{{A|vo fnnlq002 1 furina 04.ogg}} '''Furina:''' I'm... sorry to hear that. I wish there was something I could do...
:{{A|vo fnnlq002 1 navia 04.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Please... Must our conversations take such a depressing turn every time we meet?
:{{A|vo fnnlq002 1 navia 05.ogg}} '''Navia:''' We all have painful memories, but we don't have to let them cloud everything we do.
:{{A|vo fnnlq002 1 navia 06.ogg}} '''Navia:''' And if you're trying to make a new start, perhaps it's best if you don't bring up the past all the time.
:{{A|vo fnnlq002 1 furina 05.ogg}} '''Furina:''' Thank you for your words of comfort. You make a very good point.
:{{A|vo fnnlq002 1 furina 06.ogg}} '''Furina:''' But for now, at least... I think I should stay with the way I'm feeling for a while longer.
:{{A|vo fnnlq002 1 navia 07.ogg}} '''Navia:''' It's okay. These things take time. Moving on from a painful experience is easier said than done.
:{{A|vo fnnlq002 1 navia 08.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Which brings me to why I'm here... I thought you should probably know that not everyone here is ready to forgive and forget after the Hydro Archon's inaction in the face of catastrophe.
:{{A|vo fnnlq002 1 navia 09.ogg}} '''Navia:''' To avoid upsetting the peace, I told the townspeople that everyone here is a member of the theater troupe... and that you are just an actress playing the role of Furina.
:{{A|vo fnnlq002 1 navia 10.ogg}} '''Navia:''' It's not a perfect solution, but hopefully it means you won't have to lie low while you're here.
:{{A|vo fnnlq002 1 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' That's so thoughtful of you, Navia!
:{{A|vo fnnlq002 1 navia 11.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Well, what do you expect? I am the courageous and considerate president of [[Spina di Rosula]], after all, like [[Callas|my father]] before me.
:{{A|vo fnnlq002 1 navia 12.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Anyway, that was all. Look after her, now.
:{{DIcon}} Got it, Navia.
:{{DIcon}} Thank you.
:{{A|vo fnnlq002 1 furina 07.ogg}} '''Furina:''' Off we go then... Let's take a look up there.
:{{A|vo fnnlq002 1 furina 08.ogg}} '''Furina:''' I don't have any friends that I can be frank and honest with, so maybe she's right. You're the closest thing to friends that I have.
----
;(Approach the marked location)
:{{A|vo fnnlq002 2 furina 01.ogg}} '''Furina:''' I'm so grateful that Miss Navia was so understanding. To be perfectly honest, I didn't know if I was ready to meet her.
:{{A|vo fnnlq002 2 furina 02.ogg}} '''Furina:''' It's always easiest to just run away from your problems. But that never fixes anything. You can't get around the obstacles without facing them.
:{{A|vo fnnlq002 2 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So that's why you were nervous when they brought up Poisson...
:{{A|vo fnnlq002 2 furina 03.ogg}} '''Furina:''' Yeah. I'd be lying if I said I wasn't scared of coming back here.
:{{A|vo fnnlq002 2 furina 04.ogg}} '''Furina:''' Still, I felt it was something I had to do. As I was saying before, I want to see for myself the things that I never could in the past.
:{{A|vo fnnlq002 2 furina 05.ogg}} '''Furina:''' I'd be overjoyed if the people here could find it in their hearts to forgive me. But they're more likely to unleash a tirade of vitriol against me, which of course I completely understand and accept.
:;(Nearby citizens of Poisson glare at Furina disapprovingly)
:{{DIcon}} I'm sure some people didn't buy Navia's lie.
:{{A|vo fnnlq002 2 furina 06.ogg}} '''Furina:''' Yeah... I can tell people are watching me.
:{{A|vo fnnlq002 2 furina 07.ogg}} '''Furina:''' I'm sure some people here see the idea of someone coming to Poisson dressed as the Hydro Archon as extremely disrespectful.
:{{A|vo fnnlq002 2 furina 08.ogg}} '''Furina:''' I used to be terrified of the gaze of other people, especially when they had suspicion or resentment in their eyes.
:{{A|vo fnnlq002 2 furina 09.ogg}} '''Furina:''' ...*sigh* I guess I wasn't quite ready for this after all.
:{{A|vo fnnlq002 2 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Paimon's surprised you're making yourself go through all this.
:{{DIcon}} Maybe you've taken on a bit too much in one go?
::{{A|vo fnnlq002 2 furina 10a 1.ogg}} '''Furina:''' I can't let myself see only the things I want to see. How would that make me any different from before?
:{{DIcon}} Me too. It's not like you.
::{{A|vo fnnlq002 2 furina 10b 1.ogg}} '''Furina:''' What do you mean by that? You expected me to just keep running and hiding from my responsibility forever?
:{{A|vo fnnlq002 2 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Look... There seems to be a crowd gathering over there.
:{{DIcon}} They're not staying quiet, either.
:{{A|vo fnnlq002 2 furina 11.ogg}} '''Furina:''' Probably time we made a move.
:{{A|vo fnnlq002 2 furina 12.ogg}} '''Furina:''' How about we check out Spina di Rosula's ship? We should have a view of the whole of Poisson from there.

;(Talk to Dulphy or Lauwick on the middle level of Poisson near [[Kosel]], optional)
:{{A|vo dialog fnnlq002 lauwick 01.ogg}} '''Lauwick:''' Ah, there you are. We were just buying some fish. There's a clearance sale right now, and the prices are much better than in the city.
:{{A|vo dialog fnnlq002 dulphy 01.ogg}} '''Dulphy:''' Who said anything about buying them? You're really gonna carry a huge fish around all day while we're out visiting Pauleau and Vilmant?
:{{A|vo dialog fnnlq002 lauwick 02.ogg}} '''Dulphy:''' Ah... You're right. We don't have anywhere to put it...
<!-- Spoken by Lauwick, but mislabelled as "Dulphy" -->
----
;(Approach the marked spot on the ship)
:{{A|vo fnnlq002 3 furina 01.ogg}} '''Furina:''' I'm sorry, you probably just wanted a relaxing stroll, and here I am dumping all this heavy stuff on you.
:{{A|vo fnnlq002 3 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' We don't mind! It's actually refreshing to see a different side of you.
:{{A|vo fnnlq002 3 furina 02.ogg}} '''Furina:''' Great. Well, I appreciate your company, so please don't disappear just yet.
:{{A|vo fnnlq002 3 furina 03.ogg}} '''Furina:''' I don't know whether you can tell, but... the years of suffering and loneliness aren't the only reason I have a hard time facing up to who I used to be.
:{{A|vo fnnlq002 3 furina 04.ogg}} '''Furina:''' As I stand here by the ship, I can't get the images of the rising water out of my mind...
:{{A|vo fnnlq002 3 furina 05.ogg}} '''Furina:''' One after another, people were taken by the water... All those treasured lives and memories, washed out of existence in an instant.
:{{A|vo fnnlq002 3 furina 06.ogg}} '''Furina:''' They thought their god would protect them. They had absolute faith that when disaster struck, a divine power would save them from harm.
:{{A|vo fnnlq002 3 furina 07.ogg}} '''Furina:''' And all the while, I played my part to perfection to convince them that was true...
:{{A|vo fnnlq002 3 furina 08.ogg}} '''Furina:''' But then the flood waters finally came. And the "Hydro Archon" did nothing.
:{{A|vo fnnlq002 3 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You shouldn't look at it like that. You were only doing your duty.
:{{DIcon}} Don't be so harsh on yourself.
:{{A|vo fnnlq002 3 furina 09.ogg}} '''Furina:''' I've had to go through so many moments like that for the sake of protecting the truth. As time went on, it got harder and harder to bear, and I became more lonely and isolated.
:{{A|vo fnnlq002 3 furina 10.ogg}} '''Furina:''' Eventually, I realized I had nothing left except the truth. I became terrified of completely failing in my task, and was haunted by the thought of being left all alone, weeping on my throne.
:{{A|vo fnnlq002 3 furina 11.ogg}} '''Furina:''' Fortunately, we were able to avoid the worst-case scenario thanks to the help of heroic individuals such as yourselves.
:{{A|vo fnnlq002 3 furina 12.ogg}} '''Furina:''' Everyone rose to their responsibilities. And I finally regained my freedom...
:{{A|vo fnnlq002 3 furina 13.ogg}} '''Furina:''' But on some level, freedom also means no longer being needed. I have no further use to people.
:{{A|vo fnnlq002 3 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh. Paimon would've never imagined you'd see it that way.
:{{DIcon}} Think of your freedom as your reward.
:{{A|vo fnnlq002 3 furina 14.ogg}} '''Furina:''' Reward?
:{{DIcon}} Because now, you can finally speak your heart.
:{{DIcon}} You don't have to be anguished and alone anymore.
:{{A|vo fnnlq002 3 furina 15.ogg}} '''Furina:''' ...I guess so.
:{{A|vo fnnlq002 3 furina 16.ogg}} '''Furina:''' Back then, I didn't even dare to dream about having someone to confide in.
:{{A|vo fnnlq002 3 furina 17.ogg}} '''Furina:''' I was scared of someone recognizing me for who I truly was, and exposing the secret I swore to protect.
:{{A|vo fnnlq002 3 furina 18.ogg}} '''Furina:''' "Believe in the Furina you see on stage. She is the one you can trust."
:{{A|vo fnnlq002 3 furina 19.ogg}} '''Furina:''' I had to keep all my feelings, all my curiosity about life to myself. No-one could be allowed to know...
:{{A|vo fnnlq002 3 furina 20.ogg}} '''Furina:''' That's what I really meant when I said I'm no good at maintaining relationships.
:{{A|vo fnnlq002 3 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So that's where you were coming from... Paimon totally thought you were just a bit of a diva at heart.
:{{A|vo fnnlq002 3 furina 21.ogg}} '''Furina:''' Could you please get off my case!? I don't know what's gotten into you today. I'm making an effort here, you could at least try to do the same.
:{{DIcon}} What Paimon meant to say was, she doesn't like to see you so down.
:{{DIcon}} Do you feel better, having gotten all this off your chest?
:{{A|vo fnnlq002 3 furina 22.ogg}} '''Furina:''' I do. I once had nothing but the truth, and now, I'm finally free to live my own life again. And even though I have no idea where I'm going right now...
:{{A|vo fnnlq002 3 furina 23.ogg}} '''Furina:''' At least the choice is in my hands.
:{{A|vo fnnlq002 3 furina 24.ogg}} '''Furina:''' Alright, it's about time to head back. Pauleau should have finished the ending by now.
:{{A|vo fnnlq002 3 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Sure. Okay, let's head back and check it out.
----
;(Approach Dulphy and Lauwick)
:{{A|vo fnnlq002 4 dulphy 01.ogg}} '''Dulphy:''' Didn't you say you needed to watch what you eat? You're supposed to be cutting down on fried foods, not wolfing down copious quantities of fish and chips, y'know?
:{{A|vo fnnlq002 4 lauwick 01.ogg}} '''Lauwick:''' Ah, c'mon, it's not every day we get to dine at Spina di Rosula's expense... Can you believe how generous she is? I'm not about to pass on free food...
:{{A|vo fnnlq002 4 lauwick 02.ogg}} '''Lauwick:''' Anyway, my character doesn't need to be slim and good-looking. That's your job.
:{{A|vo fnnlq002 4 dulphy 02.ogg}} '''Dulphy:''' Are you kidding me right now? It's not your character's health I'm worried about! It's yours!
:{{A|vo fnnlq002 4 dulphy 03.ogg}} '''Dulphy:''' I've spent my whole life battling the effects of ill health, and it kills me to watch you willingly ruin yours by filling yourself up with junk all the time.
:{{A|vo fnnlq002 4 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh no, looks like they're arguing again.
:{{A|vo fnnlq002 4 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' We're back! Could you maybe put your differences aside for a moment?
:{{A|vo fnnlq002 4 lauwick 03.ogg}} '''Lauwick:''' Ah, you're back. We've been enjoying Spina di Rosula's VIP treatment in your stead, hehe.
:{{A|vo fnnlq002 4 lauwick 04.ogg}} '''Lauwick:''' Pauleau's nearly done. We shouldn't have to wait too much longer.
:{{A|vo fnnlq002 4 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Great. So, you were discussing your characters, right? We heard she's playing the oceanid who turns into a human girl — what about you?
:{{A|vo fnnlq002 4 lauwick 05.ogg}} '''Lauwick:''' Me? I'm an oceanid, too.
:{{A|vo fnnlq002 4 dulphy 04.ogg}} '''Dulphy:''' He was originally supposed to take the form of a crane, but he... ahem, outgrew that role. Well, the costume, at least. So now he's playing the boar instead.
:{{A|vo fnnlq002 4 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Pff... Sorry, sorry...
:{{A|vo fnnlq002 4 furina 01.ogg}} '''Furina:''' The boar's not a bad character, actually. He's the one who raises the little oceanid, yes?
:{{A|vo fnnlq002 4 lauwick 06.ogg}} '''Lauwick:''' That's right. He has some pretty memorable lines, too, like when he imparts some solemn words of wisdom to the little oceanid:
:{{A|vo fnnlq002 4 lauwick 07.ogg}} '''Lauwick:''' "If you become human, you can reveal your secret to no one. You will face suffering and loneliness... Is this truly what you want?"
:{{A|vo fnnlq002 4 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wait, that sounds kinda familiar...
:;(Paimon and the Traveler turn to look at Furina)
:{{A|vo fnnlq002 4 dulphy 05.ogg}} '''Dulphy:''' It's the most important line in the whole script. I think it's a symbolic statement about our director's life and legacy.
:{{A|vo fnnlq002 4 dulphy 06.ogg}} '''Dulphy:''' She kept quiet about all the trials and tribulations she faced in running our troupe, allowing us to devote ourselves fully to performing.
:{{A|vo fnnlq002 4 dulphy 07.ogg}} '''Dulphy:''' It was only after she was gone that we realized how tough her job really was.
:{{A|vo fnnlq002 4 furina 02.ogg}} '''Furina:''' You mentioned earlier that the troupe was like your "home"...
:{{A|vo fnnlq002 4 dulphy 08.ogg}} '''Dulphy:''' Yeah. I was born with an incurable illness, and once my family found out it couldn't be treated, they decided they didn't want me anymore.
:{{A|vo fnnlq002 4 dulphy 09.ogg}} '''Dulphy:''' I spent some years taking whatever work I could find and trying to manage my illness with various medicines. But whenever I had a bad flare-up, I'd be lying in an alleyway for days at a time.
:{{A|vo fnnlq002 4 dulphy 10.ogg}} '''Dulphy:''' It was like that until the director found me one day. She told me I had a great voice, and asked if I was interested in studying singing from her. I said yes.
:{{A|vo fnnlq002 4 dulphy 11.ogg}} '''Dulphy:''' She took me under her wing. Taught me to both sing and act, helped me find Mora for my meds, took care of me when my condition decided to flare up... I know it was all a huge burden on her.
:{{A|vo fnnlq002 4 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' She sounds like a really incredible person.
:{{A|vo fnnlq002 4 lauwick 08.ogg}} '''Lauwick:''' She really was. She gave everything she had to her troupe and the people in it. All of us were so proud to call her our director.
:{{A|vo fnnlq002 4 lauwick 09.ogg}} '''Lauwick:''' I was a lost child, too, when she found me. As the child of a murderer, my parents weren't around when I was little, so I got sent to an orphanage.
:{{A|vo fnnlq002 4 lauwick 10.ogg}} '''Lauwick:''' The other kids were always picking fights with me... They'd say things like, "C'mon, you must be pretty tough if you're the son of a murderer!" It was just to taunt me, though. I was an easy target, and they knew it.
:{{A|vo fnnlq002 4 lauwick 11.ogg}} '''Lauwick:''' One day, I got beaten up so bad that I just couldn't take it anymore, so I ran away. I'd lost all faith in humanity by that point. Thought the whole world was out to get me.
:{{A|vo fnnlq002 4 furina 03.ogg}} '''Furina:''' Hm, let me guess... Fortunately, the next person you ran into was the director.
:{{A|vo fnnlq002 4 lauwick 12.ogg}} '''Lauwick:''' Yeah. For the first time in my life, I was somewhere I felt safe, and I promised myself I'd stay here until the day the group parted ways.
:{{A|vo fnnlq002 4 pauleau 01.ogg}} '''Pauleau:''' The day you hoped would never come... *sigh* How times change.
:{{A|vo fnnlq002 4 lauwick 13.ogg}} '''Lauwick:''' Oh, you're finally done? Get your butt over here, there's someone I need to introduce you to. This is our new artistic consultant, Miss Furina.
:{{A|vo fnnlq002 4 pauleau 02.ogg}} '''Pauleau:''' ...Furina? THE Furina? Oh my god! How did you manage to wrangle that!?
:{{A|vo fnnlq002 4 furina 04.ogg}} '''Furina:''' Please, the honor is all mine. I was profoundly moved to hear about your troupe and your wonderful director. I just wanted to do something to help.
:{{A|vo fnnlq002 4 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Same here!
:{{A|vo fnnlq002 4 pauleau 03.ogg}} '''Pauleau:''' Even so, this is just... wow... I'm sorry. I'll try to calm down. Now, where was I...
:{{A|vo fnnlq002 4 pauleau 04.ogg}} '''Pauleau:''' Ah yes, the script, of course! Let me give you a rundown of how the story unfolds in my version of the script.
:{{A|vo fnnlq002 4 pauleau 05.ogg}} '''Pauleau:''' I'm sure you're already familiar with the beginning of the story: A little Oceanid decides she wants to become a human, against the wishes of her family.
:<gallery widths=370>
Whither Should the Water Flow Quest Still 1.png
</gallery>
:{{A|vo fnnlq002 4 pauleau 06.ogg}} '''Pauleau:''' She finds love and friendship in the bustling city. But then, disaster strikes...
:<gallery widths=370>
Whither Should the Water Flow Quest Still 2.png
</gallery>
:{{A|vo fnnlq002 4 pauleau 07.ogg}} '''Pauleau:''' The people start to notice that all the fresh water in the surrounding area is slowly disappearing. The soil is becoming arid, plants and flowers are withering, and the people begin to panic.
:<gallery widths=370>
Whither Should the Water Flow Quest Still 3.png
</gallery>
:{{A|vo fnnlq002 4 pauleau 08.ogg}} '''Pauleau:''' The little Oceanid, Clio, and her lover decide to do something about it, and investigate the truth of the matter together.
:{{A|vo fnnlq002 4 pauleau 09.ogg}} '''Pauleau:''' In the end, they discover that all the waste and pollution created by humans over the years has caused the fresh water to flee the land, as if driven by a consciousness of its own.
:{{A|vo fnnlq002 4 dulphy 12.ogg}} '''Dulphy:''' Consciousness? You mean... the water is sentient?
:{{A|vo fnnlq002 4 furina 05.ogg}} '''Furina:''' Water as a conscious entity... There's actually quite a few stories that explore this theme.
:{{A|vo fnnlq002 4 pauleau 10.ogg}} '''Pauleau:''' Since the little Oceanid is a water spirit, she immediately understands how the water is feeling. She then tells her lover about her true identity, as well as the truth behind the crisis.
:<gallery widths=370>
Whither Should the Water Flow Quest Still 4.png
</gallery>
:{{A|vo fnnlq002 4 pauleau 11.ogg}} '''Pauleau:''' Her lover accepts her for who she is, and works with her to find a way to bring the water back. However, unbeknownst to them, there were some people eavesdropping when she revealed her secret...
:<gallery widths=370>
Whither Should the Water Flow Quest Still 5.png
</gallery>
:{{A|vo fnnlq002 4 pauleau 12.ogg}} '''Pauleau:''' The little Oceanid is accused of being directly responsible for driving the water away, and faces the greatest dilemma of her life...
:{{A|vo fnnlq002 4 furina 06.ogg}} '''Furina:''' And then...?
:{{A|vo fnnlq002 4 pauleau 13.ogg}} '''Pauleau:''' In the end, she makes the brave decision to sacrifice herself to save her lover and the rest of humanity...
:{{A|vo fnnlq002 4 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh? But didn't they all treat Clio like a villain? Why would she want to save them after that?
:{{A|vo fnnlq002 4 pauleau 14.ogg}} '''Pauleau:''' Well, she mainly wanted to save her lover, plus everyone who'd stood up for her.
:{{A|vo fnnlq002 4 furina 07.ogg}} '''Furina:''' Through her love for her human partner, she was able to find an even greater love — one that extended to all of humanity. Surely the biggest strength of Clio's character.
:{{A|vo fnnlq002 4 dulphy 13.ogg}} '''Dulphy:''' There's actually something else that bothers me...
:{{A|vo fnnlq002 4 dulphy 14.ogg}} '''Dulphy:''' You know the protagonist is supposed to represent the director, right? And she never had the chance to become a hero in our world.
:{{A|vo fnnlq002 4 dulphy 15.ogg}} '''Dulphy:''' If we're serious about dedicating this show to her memory, we should make the ending as true-to-life as possible.
:{{A|vo fnnlq002 4 dulphy 16.ogg}} '''Dulphy:''' What about if... the little Oceanid is hounded to death by people who hate her, her lover makes sure her secret never gets out, and humanity continues down the path to extinction?
:{{A|vo fnnlq002 4 furina 08.ogg}} '''Furina:''' ...That sounds like too cruel of an ending to me. And perhaps a little irresponsible to present to the audience.
:{{A|vo fnnlq002 4 pauleau 15.ogg}} '''Pauleau:''' That ending would be a perfect mirror to Director [[Aurelie]]'s death. Both arbitrary and meaningless.
:{{A|vo fnnlq002 4 pauleau 16.ogg}} '''Pauleau:''' On the day when she went missing, Director Aurelie had instructed us all — somewhat out the blue — to leave the Court of Fontaine and wait for her outside the city.
:{{A|vo fnnlq002 4 pauleau 17.ogg}} '''Pauleau:''' We waited and waited at the rendezvous point, but she never came. By the time we returned to the city, she'd disappeared without a trace.
:{{A|vo fnnlq002 4 pauleau 18.ogg}} '''Pauleau:''' We looked for her, the [[Gardemek]]s looked for her, but she was nowhere to be found. Increasingly, all the signs seemed to point to her being the latest victim in the [[Marcel (Fontaine)|serial disappearances case]].
:{{A|vo fnnlq002 4 dulphy 17.ogg}} '''Dulphy:''' The Director was the kindest soul in the world... Yet she was senslessly sacrificed for the sake of a so-called experiment, by someone who had nothing to do with her at all...
:{{A|vo fnnlq002 4 furina 09.ogg}} '''Furina:''' Hmm... But doesn't the way she suddenly told you to leave the city suggest that maybe she had some sense of what was about to happen? It almost seems as if she was moving you to safety.
:{{A|vo fnnlq002 4 pauleau 19.ogg}} '''Pauleau:''' I've been trying to follow up on that ever since, but all my efforts so far have turned up nothing... [[Vilmant]] might know something, but he won't open up to me.
:{{A|vo fnnlq002 4 furina 10.ogg}} '''Furina:''' Vilmant? The one who's playing the role of the villain?
:{{A|vo fnnlq002 4 lauwick 14.ogg}} '''Lauwick:''' Yeah. He's been overwhelmed by grief — I think the director's death hit him hardest of all.
:{{A|vo fnnlq002 4 pauleau 20.ogg}} '''Pauleau:''' Grief? Hmph, guilt, more like. Also, I... have a hard time imagining that anyone took it harder than me.
:{{A|vo fnnlq002 4 pauleau 21.ogg}} '''Pauleau:''' Because... Well, speaking of the play being true-to-life, I... I was deeply, madly in love with Aurelie.
:{{A|vo fnnlq002 4 dulphy 18.ogg}} '''Dulphy:''' What? You... You kept that one quiet...
:{{A|vo fnnlq002 4 pauleau 22.ogg}} '''Pauleau:''' It's time to be upfront with you all. No more keeping secrets from each other, we'll never be able to agree on the ending if we can't be honest about how we feel.
:{{A|vo fnnlq002 4 pauleau 23.ogg}} '''Pauleau:''' I did tell her how I felt once, but she turned me down pretty much straight away.
:{{A|vo fnnlq002 4 pauleau 24.ogg}} '''Pauleau:''' She said that we were all like brothers and sisters to her, and she'd never considered us as potential romantic partners.
:{{A|vo fnnlq002 4 pauleau 25.ogg}} '''Pauleau:''' Not that it came as a shock or anything — it was what I was expecting to hear. So I told her I'd always be there for the troupe, and I'd always be there for her.
:{{A|vo fnnlq002 4 pauleau 26.ogg}} '''Pauleau:''' I said, maybe one day in the future, when everyone's settled in to their own lives and on the up and up, and managing the troupe no longer required her constant attention...
:{{A|vo fnnlq002 4 pauleau 27.ogg}} '''Pauleau:''' Well, maybe then she could... reconsider what she really wanted in her life.
:{{A|vo fnnlq002 4 pauleau 28.ogg}} '''Pauleau:''' ...And now, that day will never come.
:{{A|vo fnnlq002 4 lauwick 15.ogg}} '''Lauwick:''' Oh, Pauleau...
:{{A|vo fnnlq002 4 pauleau 29.ogg}} '''Pauleau:''' So if I'm the one writing this ending, then I'm gonna make sure it does right by Aurelie. I won't let anyone get in the way of that.
:{{A|vo fnnlq002 4 dulphy 19.ogg}} '''Dulphy:''' *sigh* In that case, you have to straighten things out with Vilmant once and for all. Face to face.
:{{A|vo fnnlq002 4 dulphy 20.ogg}} '''Dulphy:''' We've all had our differences of opinion over the ending, but those two have never seen eye to eye on anything. One of them has to compromise if we're ever going to reach a final decision.
:{{A|vo fnnlq002 4 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Well, if that's where we're at, looks like it's time to go visit Vilmant.
:{{A|vo fnnlq002 4 furina 11.ogg}} '''Furina:''' Are you ready to face the truth?
:{{A|vo fnnlq002 4 pauleau 30.ogg}} '''Pauleau:''' Honestly? I'm slightly terrified. But for the sake of our final performance, I'll do whatever it takes...
:{{A|vo fnnlq002 4 pauleau 31.ogg}} '''Pauleau:''' Funny you should ask, though... You really do get what I'm going through right now...
:{{A|vo fnnlq002 4 furina 12.ogg}} '''Furina:''' I certainly do.
:{{A|vo fnnlq002 4 furina 13.ogg}} '''Furina:''' Come on, everyone. Allons-y.

==Steps==
# Wait until night (if applicable)
# Go to [[Patton]] in [[Mondstadt]], and talk to him about recent conversation topics
# Enter the tavern and talk to the tavern patrons about the strongest fighter in Mondstadt

==Dialogue==
{{Quest Description|Customers at the [[Angel's Share]] have started debating the hottest topic on Mondstadt's streets: "Who is the strongest fighter in Mondstadt?" The curious promoter of the tavern, Patton, is eager to weigh in on the discussion.}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Talk to Patton about recent conversation topics)
:{{A|vo kllq001 3 patton 01.ogg}} '''Patton:''' *sigh* Shame I only get to listen in from the other side of the window and don't get to join in the debate. I'd love to give my two cents...
:{{A|vo kllq001 3 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Say what? What's up, what's up? Paimon wants in!
:{{A|vo kllq001 3 patton 02.ogg}} '''Patton:''' Recently, all the customers at the tavern have been debating the exact same topic: "Who is the strongest fighter in Mondstadt?"
:{{A|vo kllq001 3 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' The strongest fighter?
:{{A|vo kllq001 3 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Must be someone who can floor a whole gang of [[hilichurl]]s with just one punch!
:{{DIcon}} There must be far more to it than that.
::{{A|vo kllq001 3 paimon 04a.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wow... then it really must be tough to become the strongest of all.
:{{DIcon}} Pff! I do that for fun.
::{{A|vo kllq001 3 paimon 04b.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Then Paimon nominates you!
:{{A|vo kllq001 3 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' But anyway... Is there, like, a general agreement in the city on who it is, or...?
:{{A|vo kllq001 3 patton 03.ogg}} '''Patton:''' Hah. Expecting people to come to a swift and straightforward consensus in the City of Freedom is like expecting [[Fisherman's Toast]] to drop out of the sky.
:{{A|vo kllq001 3 patton 04.ogg}} '''Patton:''' Everyone's got their own opinion, backed up by a unique set of cherry-picked information... But let's be honest, that's what makes the discussion so impassioned and entertaining.
:{{A|vo kllq001 3 patton 05.ogg}} '''Patton:''' Mainstream opinion is polarized, with most people supporting one of two candidates.
:{{A|vo kllq001 3 patton 06.ogg}} '''Patton:''' One is the [[Jean|Dandelion Knight]], the other is the [[Diluc|Darknight Hero]].
:{{DIcon}} Paimon, who are you voting for?
:{{DIcon}} Anyone vote for me?
:{{A|vo kllq001 3 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Paimon votes for you!
:{{A|vo kllq001 3 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' But let's go into the {{Color|buzzword|tavern}} and talk to the patrons. Maybe we'll pick up some juicy gossip.
:{{A|vo kllq001 3 patton 07.ogg}} '''Patton:''' Oh, I do envy your life of leisure...
:{{A|vo kllq001 3 patton 08.ogg}} '''Patton:''' But don't mind me, of course. *sigh* I guess I'll just... get back to work.
----

:{{A|vo kllq001 5 jack 04.ogg}} '''Jack:''' Guild Master [[Cyrus (Mondstadt)|Cyrus]] is up there with the toughest, too, but only Stanley can take on the bloodthirsty beasts of the [[Mare Jivari]]!

:{{A|vo kllq001 8 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Did you say treasure!?

:{{A|vo kllq001 8 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So, this girl. What's her name?

:{{A|vo kllq001 8 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' But thanks for your intel!

'''With You''' is the fifth and final part of {{Quest|The Whispers of the Crane and the White Rabbit}}.

==Steps==
#Go to [[Amakane Island]]
#Go to the festival with [[Kamisato Ayaka]]
#Follow Kamisato Ayaka
#Talk to Kamisato Ayaka
#Follow Kamisato Ayaka
#Talk to Kamisato Ayaka
#Follow Kamisato Ayaka
#Talk to Kamisato Ayaka
#*Get recipe [[Sakura Mochi]]

#Talk to Kamisato Ayaka

==Gameplay Notes==
* After step 2, the party will be limited to the [[Traveler]], [[Co-Op Mode]] will be disabled, and if you leave the island the quest will restart from step 2.

==Dialogue==
{{Quest Description|Kaveh suggests that you pay a visit to [[Faranak|his mother]]'s former professor. Maybe Professor Zaha Hadi will have the clues you seek...}}
===The Missive Locked Away===
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Approach the marked location)
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907701 tighnari 01.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Hmm, what am I supposed to do now... Forget it, I'll just head back.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907701 kaveh 01.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Tighnari? What are you doing here?
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907701 tighnari 02.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Oh, it's you! Good to finally see you again.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907701 tighnari 03.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' I came into the city to buy some experiment reagents, hoping to bring them back with me to Gandharva Ville.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907701 tighnari 04.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' But as soon as I got here, I noticed someone banging on Cyrus' door. You've all heard of Cyrus, right? He's an ex-sage and Cyno's adoptive father.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907701 tighnari 05.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' I was thinking about going over to ask what's happening. That granny over there may appear old and frail, but her vocal cords certainly sound loud and healthy as ever.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907701 kaveh 02.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' ...Granny?
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907701 tighnari 06.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Yeah, she's just over there. You can go check out the situation yourselves in a moment.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907701 tighnari 07.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' *sniff* Kaveh, were you at the tavern?
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907701 kaveh 03.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' I had a quick drink or two. Can you still smell the alcohol?
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907701 tighnari 08.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Drinking in broad daylight... Really? You want to pass out by the road and get run over by a Sumpter Beast like some mindless Fungus? Huh?
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907701 tighnari 09.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' And you, {{Traveler}}. You didn't try to stop him?
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907701 kaveh 04.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Uh... I...
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907701 tighnari 10.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' You look like a wreck, Kaveh. What happened? Are you feeling down again?
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907701 tighnari 11.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' You know what, I'm hosting a meal at Pardis Dhyai tomorrow evening. Do you want to come?
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907701 kaveh 05.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Huh? Oh, I had no idea... Let me think for a moment. Uh, I'll come if I can find some time.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907701 tighnari 12.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Alright, then I'll plan on reserving two seats for you.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907701 tighnari 13.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' I'll be heading back to Gandharva Ville for now. I have a feeling that argument over there is gonna continue for quite some time. It might be best if we don't get involved.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907701 kaveh 06.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' A granny who lives nearby... Let's go take a look.

;(Use [[Nahida]]'s [[All Schemes to Know]] on Zaha Hadi, optional)
:{{A|vo kvcop001 19077 zahahadi 01.ogg}} '''Zaha Hadi:''' (My tomato! I know Cyrus is the one who picked it!)

;(Approach Zaha Hadi)
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907702 zahahadi 01.ogg}} '''Zaha Hadi:''' Hah, so plan on keeping yourself locked in there, huh? Fine by me, if you're not going to come out, then I'm not going to leave!
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907702 zahahadi 02.ogg}} '''Zaha Hadi:''' My tomato was growing so well — it had all the potential to become the best tomato this year... And you cut it straight from the vine!?
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907702 spantamadcyrus 02.ogg}} '''Cyrus:''' I already told you, I had nothing to do with it! Why would I take a tomato that's still weeks from ripening?
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907702 spantamadcyrus 03.ogg}} '''Cyrus:''' You'd have to be awfully "green" as an investigator to think it was me.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907702 zahahadi 03.ogg}} '''Zaha Hadi:''' ...
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907702 spantamadcyrus 04.ogg}} '''Cyrus:''' You see, the word "green" here could refer both to the color of the tomato, and the fact that your skills could use some—
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907702 zahahadi 04.ogg}} '''Zaha Hadi:''' Enough nonsense. Just come out and face me, you coward!
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907702 spantamadcyrus 05.ogg}} '''Cyrus:''' You're out of your mind. If I've actually done something wrong, then get a matra and pull me out by force, why don't ya!
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907702 zahahadi 05.ogg}} '''Zaha Hadi:''' Why you—
:{{DIcon}} Don't tell me this is...
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907702 kaveh 01.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Professor Zaha Hadi?
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907702 zahahadi 06.ogg}} '''Zaha Hadi:''' And who are you— Oh, Kaveh! Fancy seeing you here!
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907702 zahahadi 07.ogg}} '''Zaha Hadi:''' How long has it been? C'mon, get over here and let the Professor take a good look at you... Not bad, not bad. You've grown taller again!
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907702 kaveh 02.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Um... Professor, what's going on here?
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907702 zahahadi 08.ogg}} '''Zaha Hadi:''' Ah, it's no big deal, really. A few of us old scholars got bored in our retirement, and decided to put together a vegetable growing competition. At the end, whoever loses will have to go up on stage and do a performance for the winners.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907702 zahahadi 09.ogg}} '''Zaha Hadi:''' Which brings us to our current predicament... Hehe, my tomato was sure to win until a certain someone decided they couldn't bear to lose.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907702 spantamadcyrus 06.ogg}} '''Cyrus:''' Hey, don't try to defame me in front of the kids! If we're airing each other's dirty laundry now, then why don't we talk about you sneaking into Jannat's garden the other night—
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907702 zahahadi 10.ogg}} '''Zaha Hadi:''' Ahem! Lucky for you, seeing these youngsters come to pay their respects today has put me in a better mood. I'll let you off the hook for now.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907702 zahahadi 11.ogg}} '''Zaha Hadi:''' C'mon, let's go. We'll take our conversation elsewhere. He doesn't need to be a part of it.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907702 kaveh 03.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' A—Ah yes, of course.

;(Knock on Cyrus' door, optional)
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907702 spantamadcyrus 01.ogg}} '''Cyrus:''' Stop trying to break down my door, Zaha Hadi! You know I'm not going to come out!

;(Approach the marked location)
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907704 zahahadi 01.ogg}} '''Zaha Hadi:''' Is [[Faranak]] still doing well?
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907704 kaveh 01.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Yes, as far as I know. She left for Fontaine some time ago, and started a new life for herself. She's still doing work related to architecture, though.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907704 zahahadi 02.ogg}} '''Zaha Hadi:''' Ah yes, I did hear about that. Did that upset you at all?
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907704 kaveh 02.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' No, not at all. She's already sacrificed a lot raising me as a single mother.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907704 zahahadi 03.ogg}} '''Zaha Hadi:''' That's good to hear. Your mother did struggle quite a bit those few years... It's probably a good thing that she found a new place to call home.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907704 zahahadi 04.ogg}} '''Zaha Hadi:''' Sometimes I wonder if things were harder for her because she was so beautiful. People were always drawn to her beauty first, only to realize she had a sensitive and vulnerable heart underneath.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907704 zahahadi 05.ogg}} '''Zaha Hadi:''' She was still quite young when she first joined my class as a student. Beautiful and radiant with her golden hair, yet quiet and single-minded, she seemed like a lass from some aristocratic house who was seeing the outside world for the first time.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907704 zahahadi 06.ogg}} '''Zaha Hadi:''' She had to make a lot of drastic changes in her life to raise you on her own.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907704 zahahadi 07.ogg}} '''Zaha Hadi:''' Even during her time in the Akademiya, she was a thorough perfectionist. If she was unsatisfied with something she had made, she'd insist on redoing it even if I was perfectly happy with it.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907704 zahahadi 08.ogg}} '''Zaha Hadi:''' She had many admirers, and they'd always fill up the first few rows of seats, hoping they could get closer to her sitting in the first row. If it were any of my other classes, you'd have found nobody sitting in the front.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907704 zahahadi 09.ogg}} '''Zaha Hadi:''' But every time I saw her, she was always in that same rigid pose. She'd have one hand on her forehead, with the other clutching her pencil. Her eyebrows would be knitted in a frown as she concentrated on the blueprint in front of her.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907704 kaveh 03.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' I'm sure she had many difficult moments in her life, how did she cope with the stress?
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907704 zahahadi 10.ogg}} '''Zaha Hadi:''' I'm not too sure, she never talked about such things with me. She rarely opened up to other people, you know.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907704 zahahadi 11.ogg}} '''Zaha Hadi:''' I do remember one time though when she got into a heated argument with a friend. She said something that I found very memorable.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907704 zahahadi 12.ogg}} '''Zaha Hadi:''' She said: "True art cannot be understood, but as an artist, I wish some people could understand its meaning and value."
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907704 zahahadi 13.ogg}} '''Zaha Hadi:''' If you ask me, that's probably the greatest source of pain for geniuses of their craft. It's extremely hard for them to find someone who can truly understand their ideas.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907704 kaveh 04.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' So that's how it is, hmm... I wonder if the password could be...
:{{DIcon}} "Understanding"?
:{{DIcon}} "Acknowledgment"?
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907704 kaveh 05.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Hmm... I tried both just now. Seems those aren't it, either.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907704 zahahadi 14.ogg}} '''Zaha Hadi:''' What are you trying to do?
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907704 kaveh 06.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' My mother left her notebook to me, but it has a password and I haven't figured out what it is yet. I'm trying to learn more about her so I'd have a better chance at cracking the code... Thank you for all that you told us.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907704 zahahadi 15.ogg}} '''Zaha Hadi:''' Haha, it's the least I can do. Talking to youngsters like yourself makes me feel younger, too. Honestly, looking at you now, I can see how much you resemble her... It's almost as if she's standing right in front of me again.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907704 zahahadi 16.ogg}} '''Zaha Hadi:''' Your personalities are quite alike, too. You're both stubborn, and both a little awkward. Of course, I'm sure the similarities are mostly superficial... but so long as you continue to harbor those traits, you'll find a lot of difficulties in your work.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907704 zahahadi 17.ogg}} '''Zaha Hadi:''' I've taught a lot of students over my career, and in my experience, very few genius architects of Kshahrewar ever found happiness for themselves.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907704 zahahadi 18.ogg}} '''Zaha Hadi:''' They would know exactly what they want to express, and fight for it tooth and nail, which inevitably led to arguments with their clients.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907704 zahahadi 19.ogg}} '''Zaha Hadi:''' Some clients would choose to respect the architects' vision, or just let the argument go because of the architects' reputation, but those are the rare ones.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907704 zahahadi 20.ogg}} '''Zaha Hadi:''' When Faranak first graduated, she was getting into arguments with her clients nearly every single day. I think it only got a little better when she met your father.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907704 kaveh 07.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' I see... But could he understand the designs my mother made?
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907704 zahahadi 21.ogg}} '''Zaha Hadi:''' No, I think they were probably beyond him, too. But despite that, he still stayed next to her, listening to her joys and sharing in her sorrows.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907704 zahahadi 22.ogg}} '''Zaha Hadi:''' Faranak had many admirers, but she ended up choosing your father. His support probably played a part in that decision.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907704 kaveh 08.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Hmm... So instead of "understanding," perhaps all we need is just "companionship"...
:{{DIcon}} Maybe that's what she was trying to tell you?
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907704 kaveh 09.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' ...Huh, it worked!
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907704 zahahadi 23.ogg}} '''Zaha Hadi:''' Oh, was that the right password?
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907704 kaveh 10.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Yes!
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907704 zahahadi 24.ogg}} '''Zaha Hadi:''' Then you should be on your way, child. Find a quiet place and see what she wanted to say to you.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907704 zahahadi 25.ogg}} '''Zaha Hadi:''' Being the awkward person that she is, I suppose there were many things that Faranak could never say out loud. Instead, she probably left them in her diary hoping that they would make their way to you one day.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907704 zahahadi 26.ogg}} '''Zaha Hadi:''' If you're ever in a mood to chat again, just come and find me here. You're always welcome to discuss architecture topics with me as well.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907704 kaveh 11.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Thank you so much, Professor.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907704 zahahadi 27.ogg}} '''Zaha Hadi:''' Haha, there's no need to be so formal. I'll let you kids go. It's time for me to take another stroll around the vegetable garden.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907704 kaveh 12.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' I wonder what my mother could have written about...
:{{Black Screen|Kaveh starts quickly flipping through the notebook, revealing lines upon lines of elegant handwriting.}}
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907704 faranak 01.ogg}} '''Faranak:''' "They all say Zaha Hadi's class is the toughest, but I think it's actually not too bad. On the other hand, though, structural mechanics is definitely a pain no matter how you try to approach it... I doubled down and managed to get through it in the end."
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907704 faranak 02.ogg}} '''Faranak:''' "I met someone special. At first, I didn't think much of him, but now I feel very happy whenever I get to spend time with him."
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907704 faranak 03.ogg}} '''Faranak:''' "We decided to name our son Kaveh. I don't think a younger me would have ever imagined forming such an intimate bond with another person... Back then, I lived only in the shadow of myself, as well as that of the dream in my heart."
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907704 faranak 04.ogg}} '''Faranak:''' "The bad news came, and even though it's been several days now, I still can't bring myself to come to terms with what happened. My eyes are so swollen that it's hard to see. What if they are all lying to me, and this is just a long, cruel dream?"
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907704 faranak 05.ogg}} '''Faranak:''' "But I have to face reality. I still have someone to take care of. No matter what happens, I'll do my best to raise my son on my own."
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907704 kaveh 13.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' ...
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907704 kaveh 14.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Huh? Is this... a drawing? Seems like it was done by my mother.
;(A drawing appears)
:[[File:Faranak's Drawing.png|200px]]
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907704 kaveh 15.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' This blonde man was probably my father... But who are the other people in the picture? Huh? Why do a few of them look somewhat familiar...
:{{DIcon}} Yeah, they do seem familiar...
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907704 kaveh 16.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' From the dates in the notebook, she probably drew this more than thirty years ago. I hadn't even been born yet.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907704 kaveh 17.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' ...Maybe we were thinking too much. Oh! There are a few lines written in the diary about this as well.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907704 faranak 06.ogg}} '''Faranak:''' "The one who invited us to the gathering is a talkative woman. Including us, three couples showed up... There was also a person who came alone."
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907704 faranak 07.ogg}} '''Faranak:''' "The talkative woman introduced everyone to each other. She spoke really quickly, so I couldn't quite catch everything she said, but I also didn't feel like asking her to repeat herself."
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907704 faranak 08.ogg}} '''Faranak:''' "My husband seems to be friends with the man with long ears. I couldn't really join their conversation, so I've resigned myself to sitting in a corner and drawing in my notebook."
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907704 faranak 09.ogg}} '''Faranak:''' "I don't think I'd be able to become friends with any of these people... especially that stiff-looking couple."
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907704 faranak 10.ogg}} '''Faranak:''' "That man is certainly very handsome, but he would constantly alternate between disjointed and serious ways of talking... His wife is a bit more bearable."
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907704 faranak 11.ogg}} '''Faranak:''' "We were not acquainted with each other to begin with, and I doubt we'll see each other again after this gathering. The ambiance of this gathering is surprisingly pleasant, however. Talking to people can allow us to find some peace after a long day."
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907704 faranak 12.ogg}} '''Faranak:''' "Maybe my son will also partake in these gatherings in the future. I hope he'll be able to make many friends."
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907704 kaveh 18.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Who would have thought my mother used to attend that kind of thing... It seemed she was only good at talking about her own work, and found it difficult to join into other conversations. As a result, she often kept to herself and would be off to the side drawing.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907704 kaveh 19.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' There's more written on the back... Oh, it seems like it was written to me.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907704 faranak 13.ogg}} '''Faranak:''' "Kaveh, I was both overjoyed and distressed when I learned of your decision to continue your studies in Kshahrewar."
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907704 faranak 14.ogg}} '''Faranak:''' "You are very talented, and I am confident that you will become an architect of much acclaim. However, the more talented you are as an artist, the more misery and anguish you may encounter."
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907704 faranak 15.ogg}} '''Faranak:''' "No one will be able to help you during your journey as an artist. But outside of your life as a creator, you can learn to form connections with other people, and enjoy many other things in life. It's the only way to alleviate your suffering."
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907704 faranak 16.ogg}} '''Faranak:''' "Whenever you feel down, seek out a friend to sit and have a chat. You can accumulate joy and fulfillment by spending time with them. The positive feelings you gain will get you through the long and difficult years. Never forget that companionship is the most important thing of all."
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907704 kaveh 20.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' So that's the answer she prepared for me... She really thought long and hard about me and my future.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907704 kaveh 21.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Well, now that I've read her words... Do you think I should accept Tighnari's invite, and attend that dinner at Pardis Dhyai?

:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907704 kaveh 23.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Although it'd be nice to get together with friends and chat the night away... I don't want to bring down other people's moods because I'm sad.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907704 kaveh 24.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Besides, don't most people hate the feeling of seeing their friends troubled and being unable to help? And what's worse, nearly all of my problems can't be easily resolved with some encouraging words or gesture.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907704 kaveh 25.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' And don't forget, I'm also older than all of them... As their senior, I should appear to be a bit more responsible.
:{{DIcon}} But Tighnari saw right through you.
::{{A|vo kvcop001 1907704 kaveh 26.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Ah, you're right... *sigh* I really didn't expect to run into him here. I swear, his nose must be just as sensitive as his ears...
::{{A|vo kvcop001 1907704 kaveh 27.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Well then, I guess... it's best that we go and join him for dinner. *sigh* That means I'll owe him yet another meal now...
::{{A|vo kvcop001 1907704 kaveh 31.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' You know what, I'm not going to overthink it. I'll see you tomorrow at Pardis Dhyai!
:{{DIcon}} It's normal for friends to take care of each other.
::{{A|vo kvcop001 1907704 kaveh 28.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' You're not wrong, but I keep feeling like I haven't really helped them much in return...
::{{DIcon}} It's always fun to have you around, Kaveh.
:;(+1 Heart)
::{{A|vo kvcop001 1907704 kaveh 29.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Wait, do you mean it? You're not... making fun of me, are you?
::{{A|vo kvcop001 1907704 kaveh 30.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' I've gotten so used to sarcasm that I can't tell what's genuinely a compliment anymore. Wait! By "fun," did you mean...
::{{A|vo kvcop001 1907704 kaveh 31.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' You know what, I'm not going to overthink it. I'll see you tomorrow at Pardis Dhyai!

:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907703 kaveh 04.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' I knew this wouldn't be just a simple free dinner... Is that why you also invited Alhaitham?
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907703 tighnari 08.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Yes, I thought it would be good if we could all put our heads together about this.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907703 tighnari 09.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Anyway, let's take a quick trip down memory lane. What did you guys do when you ran into a problem that you didn't know how to solve, or got assigned a project that you knew you weren't going to finish on time?
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907703 cyno 02.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Never happened to me.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907703 kaveh 05.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' I'd just pull another all-nighter.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907703 tighnari 10.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' You two are hopeless... Does anyone have a more useful answer to the question?
:{{DIcon}} Perhaps you could adjust the pace of the curriculum?
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907703 kaveh 06.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Ooh! That's a good point! Confidence is the most important thing. Once you lose your sense of confidence, it'll become all but impossible to find the motivation to study.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907703 tighnari 11.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Hmm, this could be a potential direction. I have already redesigned the literacy curriculum, and I was originally hoping to ask Alhaitham for his opinion, but...
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907703 alhaitham 01.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' It's very simple. Instead of focusing on the amount of material you would like to teach, focus on the amount the student would be able to remember.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907703 kaveh 07.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Wow, you actually showed up! I could probably count the number of times you've actually come to gatherings like this on just one hand.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907703 alhaitham 02.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' It's still more than the number of times you've managed to get a proposal approved on the first try.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907703 kaveh 08.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Hmph, as long as you're still aware. So, what made the difference this time? Are you looking to drink your sorrows away with some friends?
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907703 alhaitham 03.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' That's your purpose for being here, not mine. Don't project your ways of thinking onto me.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907703 kaveh 09.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' So you're saying the only reason you came is to help Tighnari with his brainstorming?
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907703 alhaitham 04.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' Precisely. Collei will have a long road in front of her.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907703 kaveh 10.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Hey, just to get one thing clear, even if Collei manages to make her way to the Akademiya, we cannot let her enroll in Haravatat! Kshahrewar is obviously the best choice for her. She's been a trainee forest ranger for so long, she'll definitely be good with her hands.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907703 cyno 03.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' What are you saying? Spantamad is the better choice. It's where I graduated from, after all.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907703 kaveh 11.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Then what about Amurta? That's the Darshan her master actually graduated from.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907703 alhaitham 05.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' There are only two other Darshans left. We might as well select all of them on her enrollment application.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907703 kaveh 12.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' You...! I'm trying to have a serious discussion here!
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907703 kaveh 13.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' {{Traveler}}, you aren't associated with any of the six Darshans. In your opinion, which Darshan would be the best choice for Collei?

:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907703 cyno 04.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Well said.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907703 tighnari 12.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Agreed. And my goal in inviting you here was to gather some thoughts on the execution of this second phase.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907703 alhaitham 06.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' Phase two far exceeds phase one in both curriculum complexity and the speed of instruction. I hope Collei has prepared herself for what is coming.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907703 kaveh 14.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Hey, what are you thinking now? Please don't tell me you're planning on lending her those abstruse books from your home library.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907703 alhaitham 07.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' Actually, I was thinking about lending her a professions guide.
:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907703 kaveh 15.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' I'll make sure to write "DON'T BECOME AN ARCHITECT" on the front page of that.

:{{A|vo kvcop001 1907703 kaveh 20.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' I... Whatever! I'm not going to use my brain anymore! Let's drink tonight to our hearts' content!

;(Go to Ogura Textiles & Kimonos)
:{{A|vo aylq002 2 ayaka 01.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' Hm? This must be...
:{{A|vo aylq002 2 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' It's a festival promotion.
:{{A|vo aylq002 2 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hey, speaking of — we haven't been anywhere fun since we arrived in Inazuma!
:{{DIcon}} Did you want to go, Ayaka?
:{{A|vo aylq002 2 ayaka 02.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' N—No, what made you think that? Ahem... Festivals are a common occurrence here in Inazuma. We in the Yashiro Commission are very well acquainted with these sorts of customs.
:{{A|vo aylq002 2 ayaka 03.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' Each season brings its own festival... and each festival, in turn, brings a fresh challenge to the task of maintaining public order...
:{{A|vo aylq002 2 ayaka 04.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' So, while festivals are undoubtedly joyous and lively occasions, for us they are also a cause for concern...
:{{A|vo aylq002 2 ayaka 05.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' Oh! My apologies, I should stop thinking about work, this is hardly relevant to the matter at hand. This store here is the place I wanted to visit.
:{{A|vo aylq002 2 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, so you weren't checking out the promotion... Well, let's take a look inside then.
:{{A|vo aylq002 2 oguramio 01.ogg}} '''Ogura Mio:''' Welcome, I have all the latest styles. Please take a look!
:{{A|vo aylq002 2 oguramio 02.ogg}} '''Ogura Mio:''' Oh! It's Miss Kamisato — with guests from overseas! Welcome to Ogura Textiles & Kimonos. Are you here to purchase fabric, or for tailored garments?
:{{A|vo aylq002 2 ayaka 06.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' Oh! Greetings to you too. I have a design here for a garment, would you be so kind as to take a look?
:{{A|vo aylq002 2 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ohh, Ayaka came prepared!
:{{A|vo aylq002 2 oguramio 03.ogg}} '''Ogura Mio:''' Let me see... Hmm? Hmm, this could be...
:{{A|vo aylq002 2 ayaka 07.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' Mm-hmm? Could be...?
:{{A|vo aylq002 2 oguramio 04.ogg}} '''Ogura Mio:''' —Oh, it's a very fine design!
:{{A|vo aylq002 2 oguramio 05.ogg}} '''Ogura Mio:''' ...Miss Kamisato — you'd like us to make a kimono following this design, yes?
:{{A|vo aylq002 2 ayaka 08.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' Please, if you could.
:{{A|vo aylq002 2 oguramio 06.ogg}} '''Ogura Mio:''' I'm honored that you'd choose Ogura Textiles & Kimonos for your tailoring needs! However... there is one rather difficult problem...
:{{A|vo aylq002 2 oguramio 07.ogg}} '''Ogura Mio:''' Based on the design, this kind of kimono would require silk made from the Silk Flower. The majority of Inazuma's silk is imported from Liyue Harbor, but given the current climate...
:{{A|vo aylq002 2 oguramio 08.ogg}} '''Ogura Mio:''' *sigh* As you well know, Inazuma is currently under a strict lockdown.
:{{A|vo aylq002 2 oguramio 09.ogg}} '''Ogura Mio:''' In all honesty, the impact on the textiles industry has been quite significant. We're struggling to import high-grade fabrics, so much of our tailoring business has been put on hold indefinitely.
:{{A|vo aylq002 2 oguramio 10.ogg}} '''Ogura Mio:''' But of course, where our customers are able to provide the fabric themselves, we can still be of service.
:{{A|vo aylq002 2 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' *sigh* So you're saying, we need to go and buy some silk first?
:{{A|vo aylq002 2 ayaka 09.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' If even Ogura Textiles & Kimonos can't get ahold of high-grade fabric... where would we buy it from?
:{{A|vo aylq002 2 oguramio 11.ogg}} '''Ogura Mio:''' You could try the International Trade Association. They are a little better connected than we are — after all, the association brings together merchants from all over the world.
:{{A|vo aylq002 2 oguramio 12.ogg}} '''Ogura Mio:''' The only thing is their prices... they're not the cheapest. In times like these, though, we're lucky to even have an option of getting hold of the things we want in the first place.
:{{A|vo aylq002 2 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh, so even just getting clothes made is an ordeal in Inazuma...
:{{A|vo aylq002 2 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wait, the International Trade Association? That's Kurisu's thing, right? We haven't been to Ritou in a while.
:{{A|vo aylq002 2 ayaka 10.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' Hmm... It looks like that will be our next stop.
:{{A|vo aylq002 2 ayaka 11.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' Thank you ever so much. We will be back once we've acquired the fabric.
:{{A|vo aylq002 2 ayaka 12.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' In the meantime, I have one other very small request. Could you...
:{{A|vo aylq002 2 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Why's she being so secretive all of a sudden?
:{{A|vo aylq002 2 oguramio 13.ogg}} '''Ogura Mio:''' Mm-hmm... Absolutely.
:{{A|vo aylq002 2 ayaka 13.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' Much obliged.
:{{A|vo aylq002 2 oguramio 14.ogg}} '''Ogura Mio:''' My pleasure, Miss Kamisato.
:{{A|vo aylq002 2 oguramio 15.ogg}} '''Ogura Mio:''' Honestly, I'm just as excited as you to see the end product! We haven't made a silk kimono for the longest time now, and this is a beautiful design...
:{{A|vo aylq002 2 ayaka 14.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' That's very kind of you, thank you. Goodbye for now.
:{{A|vo aylq002 2 ayaka 15.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' Traveler, Paimon — let's try our luck at the International Trade Association.

;(Talk to Ogura Mio again)
:{{A|vo dialog aylq002 oguramio 01.ogg}} '''Ogura Mio:''' I do hope you manage to get hold of your silk.
----

;(Upon reaching the next location)
:{{A|vo aylq002 3 ayaka 01.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' This is it, the International Trade Association.
:{{A|vo aylq002 3 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Okay, then... we need to talk to Kurisu, right?
:{{A|vo aylq002 3 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Doesn't look like he's here. Let's look around!

;(Upon finding Kurisu)
:{{A|vo aylq002 6 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Look, look! There he is!
:{{A|vo aylq002 6 ayaka 01.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' Ah, looks like we found him.
:{{A|vo aylq002 6 kurisu 01.ogg}} '''Kurisu:''' *whimpering* What am I going to do...
:{{A|vo aylq002 6 ayaka 02.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' Mr. Kurisu, are you alright?
:{{A|vo aylq002 6 kurisu 02.ogg}} '''Kurisu:''' Oh! You're M—Miss Ayaka from the K—[[Kamisato Clan]]. How do you do?
:{{A|vo aylq002 6 ayaka 03.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' Better than you, it appears.
:{{A|vo aylq002 6 kurisu 03.ogg}} '''Kurisu:''' And if it isn't the Traveler... I haven't seen you in a while — I take it you've been out of Ritou?
:{{DIcon}} It sure has been a bit.
:{{A|vo aylq002 6 kurisu 04.ogg}} '''Kurisu:''' Thanks again for your help last time. The Association is back in business, and it's all thanks to you.
:{{A|vo aylq002 6 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' That's great, but uh... Why were you staring into space just now? Did something bad happen?
:{{A|vo aylq002 6 kurisu 05.ogg}} '''Kurisu:''' Well... You see... *sigh*
:{{A|vo aylq002 6 kurisu 06.ogg}} '''Kurisu:''' It's embarrassing to admit, but some of the Association's goods have been... stolen. By vagrants.
:{{A|vo aylq002 6 ayaka 04.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' Which goods were stolen?
:{{A|vo aylq002 6 kurisu 07.ogg}} '''Kurisu:''' It was a batch of high-grade silk.
:{{A|vo aylq002 6 ayaka 05.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' ...!
:{{A|vo aylq002 6 kurisu 08.ogg}} '''Kurisu:''' We imported a big batch of silk from Liyue several years ago. It's been sitting in storage ever since.
:{{A|vo aylq002 6 kurisu 09.ogg}} '''Kurisu:''' Recently, we heard that clothing stores in the city have more or less sold off all their silk stocks. So we figured now would be a good time to bring our batch out of storage, thinking it'd probably fetch a good price. But then...
:{{A|vo aylq002 6 kurisu 10.ogg}} '''Kurisu:''' The vagrants swiped the whole batch then disappeared into the woods. I'd report it to the authorities, but...
:{{A|vo aylq002 6 kurisu 11.ogg}} '''Kurisu:''' Well, as you know, they don't think much of foreign merchants like us. The Kanjou Commission don't want to give us the time of day — honestly, you can just tell that our suffering amuses them...
:{{A|vo aylq002 6 ayaka 06.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' While I also take issue with aspects of the Kanjou Commission's operational methods, please remember, Mr. Kurisu, that while you are here in Inazuma, you should be careful with your words.
:{{A|vo aylq002 6 kurisu 12.ogg}} '''Kurisu:''' Oh! M—My apologies... I had to let off some steam...
:{{A|vo aylq002 6 kurisu 13.ogg}} '''Kurisu:''' Anyway, there doesn't seem to be much we can do ourselves to get our goods back.
:{{A|vo aylq002 6 kurisu 14.ogg}} '''Kurisu:''' *sigh* Perhaps I'm doomed to go bankrupt after all...
:{{A|vo aylq002 6 ayaka 07.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' I'm afraid I can't intervene in an official capacity... but I can still help you get your lost goods back.
:{{A|vo aylq002 6 kurisu 15.ogg}} '''Kurisu:''' Of course, I would never— Wait, what!?
:{{A|vo aylq002 6 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What!?
:{{DIcon}} Seriously?
:{{A|vo aylq002 6 ayaka 08.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' Yes. Acting in my own capacity, mind you. Even then, there is no escaping the fact that my every action and word will be seen to reflect on the Yashiro Commission and the Kamisato Clan.
:{{A|vo aylq002 6 ayaka 09.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' I do so not without reservations, so... I hope that you will treat this matter as confidential.
:{{A|vo aylq002 6 ayaka 10.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' That aside — as I'm sure you're aware, I'm afraid that I won't always be able to help you in such circumstances.
:{{A|vo aylq002 6 ayaka 11.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' Given your position and that of the International Trade Association... please try to exercise more caution in the future. You do not want to incur further unnecessary losses.
:{{A|vo aylq002 6 kurisu 16.ogg}} '''Kurisu:''' We will, we certainly will!
:{{A|vo aylq002 6 kurisu 17.ogg}} '''Kurisu:''' But, um... are you sure this isn't going to cause any issues... for you?
:{{A|vo aylq002 6 kurisu 18.ogg}} '''Kurisu:''' What if someone high up in the Kanjou Commission sees what you're doing and doesn't like it? You're a highly respected member of society... Surely, putting your neck on the line for small-timers like me can't be worth the risk!?
:{{A|vo aylq002 6 ayaka 12.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' Very humorous.
:{{A|vo aylq002 6 ayaka 13.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' Let's not forget that I am the eldest daughter of the Kamisato Clan. I would be very surprised indeed if anybody in the Kanjou Commission felt that I was accountable to them for my actions.
:{{A|vo aylq002 6 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Whoa, that sent shivers down Paimon's spine! Does everyone from a powerful clan talk like that?
:{{A|vo aylq002 6 ayaka 14.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' Mr. Kurisu, I need to know the exact time and location of the theft, and anything that stood out about the perpetrators' appearance.
:{{A|vo aylq002 6 kurisu 19.ogg}} '''Kurisu:''' Thank you so much! Let's see, it was two hours ago now, over at the...
:{{Black Screen|''Kurisu explains whys and wherefores of the serial theft cases...''}}
:{{A|vo aylq002 6 ayaka 15.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' Everyone, please follow me to the scene of the crime. The investigation starts there...
:{{A|vo aylq002 6 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Alright, off we go!
----
;(Upon reaching the scene)
:{{A|vo aylq002 7 kurisu 01.ogg}} '''Kurisu:''' Here we are. This is where we were robbed.
:{{A|vo aylq002 7 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hey, look on the ground! What're those?
:{{A|vo aylq002 7 kurisu 02.ogg}} '''Kurisu:''' Huh...? Footprints! Very deep ones at that... leading towards the forest.
:{{A|vo aylq002 7 ayaka 01.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' Hmm, presumably the depth suggests that they were carrying something heavy.
:{{A|vo aylq002 7 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Let's see were they lead!

;(At the end of footprints trail)
:{{A|vo aylq002 10 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Stop, thief!
:{{A|vo aylq002 10 rounin 01.ogg}} '''Ronin:''' Hah! You think you can get your stuff back with this bunch? You must be dreaming.
:{{A|vo aylq002 10 kurisu 01.ogg}} '''Kurisu:''' Why you... You better hope you have the courage of your convictions...
:{{A|vo aylq002 10 rounin 02.ogg}} '''Ronin:''' Why wouldn't I, old man? Answer me this — you're one of those outlander merchants, right?
:{{A|vo aylq002 10 rounin 03.ogg}} '''Ronin:''' You trade association types are worms, coming over to our land, leeching off our people... Who's gonna leap to your defense, huh? Tell me, who's gonna stick their neck out for the likes of you?
:{{A|vo aylq002 10 ayaka 01.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' ...
:{{A|vo aylq002 10 rounin 04.ogg}} '''Ronin:''' Hahaha! Look at that, no response. You know I'm right.
:{{A|vo aylq002 10 rounin 05.ogg}} '''Ronin:''' Face it. This is Inazuma, you've got no ties here, you're at the bottom of the pile... Can you really blame us for walking all over you?
:{{A|vo aylq002 10 kurisu 02.ogg}} '''Kurisu:''' ...You are despicable...
:{{A|vo aylq002 10 rounin 06.ogg}} '''Ronin:''' Hey! I just had an idea. Since you came all this way — how about we do some business?
:{{A|vo aylq002 10 kurisu 03.ogg}} '''Kurisu:''' Business?
:{{A|vo aylq002 10 rounin 07.ogg}} '''Ronin:''' Pay up, and you can take your fabric back. Sound good? If you ask me, it beats walking out of here with black eyes and a broken nose.
:{{A|vo aylq002 10 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' *gasp* You're just a big bully!
:{{A|vo aylq002 10 kurisu 04.ogg}} '''Kurisu:''' I... Ugh! What choice do I have...
:{{A|vo aylq002 10 ayaka 02.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' Wait.
:{{A|vo aylq002 10 ayaka 03.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' Mr. Kurisu, please do not pay any money to this man.
:{{A|vo aylq002 10 kurisu 05.ogg}} '''Kurisu:''' But, but...
:{{A|vo aylq002 10 ayaka 04.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' I trust you remember our agreement? If you keep your lips firmly sealed, I, too, shall uphold my end of the deal.
:{{A|vo aylq002 10 kurisu 06.ogg}} '''Kurisu:''' Oh, yes, of course!
:{{A|vo aylq002 10 ayaka 05.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' Then please stand well back, where it is safe. Now... it is time for me to honor my word.
----
;(After the battle)
:{{A|vo aylq002 12 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Well, that's that resolved then!
:{{A|vo aylq002 12 ayaka 01.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' ...Phew.
:{{DIcon}} That was amazing, Ayaka.
:{{DIcon}} You made that look so easy!
:{{A|vo aylq002 12 ayaka 02.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' No, please, I... It was nothing, I was simply doing my duty.
:{{A|vo aylq002 12 kurisu 01.ogg}} '''Kurisu:''' Miss Kamisato, Traveler, a—are you hurt!?
:{{A|vo aylq002 12 ayaka 03.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' Don't worry. We're fine.
:{{A|vo aylq002 12 ayaka 04.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' The vagrants left in quite a hurry — it would seem they didn't have time to take anything with them. I believe your stolen goods should all be here.
:{{A|vo aylq002 12 kurisu 02.ogg}} '''Kurisu:''' Th—Thank you, thank you so much...
:{{A|vo aylq002 12 ayaka 05.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' You'd best do a count.
:{{A|vo aylq002 12 kurisu 03.ogg}} '''Kurisu:''' 6, 8, 10... Yep, it's all here!
:{{A|vo aylq002 12 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Great! Now we can finally buy some silk!
:{{A|vo aylq002 12 kurisu 04.ogg}} '''Kurisu:''' Buy silk? ...You mean, you need some of this silk, here?
:{{A|vo aylq002 12 ayaka 06.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' This was indeed our intent.
:{{A|vo aylq002 12 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Don't get us wrong though, that's not the reason we helped you out! Even if it were just a few Carrots or Cabbages, chances are we still would've helped you get them back.
:{{A|vo aylq002 12 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Paimon thinks we were pretty lucky! If we'd arrived any later, our chances of getting silk in Inazuma would have been zero...
:{{A|vo aylq002 12 kurisu 05.ogg}} '''Kurisu:''' I honestly can't thank you all enough...
:{{A|vo aylq002 12 kurisu 06.ogg}} '''Kurisu:''' Please, say no more! You need silk? I'll pick out a piece for you right away!
:{{A|vo aylq002 12 ayaka 07.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' Thank you, good sir. How much do I owe you?
:{{A|vo aylq002 12 kurisu 07.ogg}} '''Kurisu:''' Oh, it's free of charge! I could never ask you to pay after everything you've done for me!
:{{A|vo aylq002 12 ayaka 08.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' No, no, that will never do. Things cost what they cost, and what they cost is what I shall pay.
:{{A|vo aylq002 12 ayaka 09.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' Merchants already have enough challenges to deal with, and as Paimon explained, my help was unconditional. Please, sell your wares to me at the price you would sell them to any other customer.
:{{A|vo aylq002 12 ayaka 10.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' There is nothing to feel distressed about, because nothing, I repeat, nothing, happened here in these woods today. Did it?
:{{DIcon}} Nope, just an uneventful stroll in the woods.
:{{A|vo aylq002 12 kurisu 08.ogg}} '''Kurisu:''' Thank you, I... I don't think I could ever repay you. You have helped me greatly, and I will never forget it.
:{{A|vo aylq002 12 kurisu 09.ogg}} '''Kurisu:''' I'm afraid we must part ways — I must get these goods back to the Association. If you ever need anything at all, just come to the International Trade Association and ask for Kurisu!
:{{A|vo aylq002 12 ayaka 11.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' Very well, and thank you for the silk, Mr. Kurisu.
:{{A|vo aylq002 12 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' See ya then, bye! Safe journey home, don't go getting robbed again!
:{{Black Screen|''Ayaka buys the fabric, and Kurisu thanks and bids you all goodbye...''}}
:{{A|vo aylq002 12 ayaka 12.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' Traveler, thank you for stepping in to help out.
:{{DIcon}} No worries, it's what I signed up for.
:{{DIcon}} It was no trouble.
:{{A|vo aylq002 12 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' But... how come those vagrants didn't seem to know who you were? They must move in completely different circles, maybe they've never seen anyone from the Kamisato Clan before?
:{{A|vo aylq002 12 ayaka 13.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' Perhaps. Either way, I'm glad they didn't recognize me. The fewer people who know what happened today, the better.
:{{A|vo aylq002 12 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hee-hee, it's not every day an important person like you helps out someone like Kurisu. It really shows what a great person you are.
:{{A|vo aylq002 12 ayaka 14.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' Oh, uh... Your praise is quite unwarranted. I merely did what anyone in my position would have done...
:{{A|vo aylq002 12 ayaka 15.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' I admit that it did feel strange for me to come to his aid... But this should have nothing to do with identity, or social class... As far as I'm concerned, it was one individual helping another in need.
:{{A|vo aylq002 12 ayaka 16.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' I guess that deep down... I don't see how a society can be considered just when people encounter such obstacles in their livelihoods...
:{{A|vo aylq002 12 ayaka 17.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' Ah! Sorry, I'm getting off topic.
:{{DIcon}} No problem.
:{{A|vo aylq002 12 ayaka 18.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' Right. Let's head back to Ogura Textiles & Kimonos and give our hard-won silk to the shopkeeper.
:{{A|vo aylq002 12 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Okay!
----
;(Return to Ogura's Textiles & Kimonos)
:{{A|vo aylq002 14 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hey there, we're back!
:{{A|vo aylq002 14 oguramio 01.ogg}} '''Ogura Mio:''' Welcome back!
:{{A|vo aylq002 14 oguramio 02.ogg}} '''Ogura Mio:''' So, any luck at the International Trade Association? Did they have any silk in stock?
:{{A|vo aylq002 14 ayaka 01.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' Yes, they did.
:{{A|vo aylq002 14 ayaka 02.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' Here.
:{{A|vo aylq002 15 oguramio 01.ogg}} '''Ogura Mio:''' Excellent news! So, apart from the silk, I think everything else I need, I've got in store already...
:{{A|vo aylq002 15 oguramio 02.ogg}} '''Ogura Mio:''' I just need to go and take stock of our materials — it won't take me a moment. I'll be right back.
:{{A|vo aylq002 15 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' They'd better be all there!
:{{A|vo aylq002 15 ayaka 01.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' I do hope nothing else is missing.
:{{A|vo aylq002 15 ayaka 02.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' Traveler, on the subject of garments, I've been meaning to acquire a new outfit for you, too.
:{{A|vo aylq002 15 ayaka 03.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' It's just... I wasn't sure how you'd feel about the idea of dressing in Inazuman attire...
:{{DIcon}} It's a kind thought, but I'm fine with my current outfit.
:{{A|vo aylq002 15 ayaka 04.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' Oh? Are you sure?
:{{DIcon}} These clothes are special to me.
:{{DIcon}} If I'm too concerned about my appearance, I'll lose my edge in battle.
:{{A|vo aylq002 15 ayaka 05.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' Is that so...
:{{A|vo aylq002 15 ayaka 06.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' Impressive... So, travelers of your stature hold themselves to a dress code, as well as a code of conduct.
:{{A|vo aylq002 15 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hmm... More like, when you're away from home, you've gotta live by certain rules to survive, whether you like it or not.
:{{A|vo aylq002 15 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' But Paimon would still love to check out some Inazuman outfits!
:{{DIcon}} Do they do Paimon sizes here?
:{{A|vo aylq002 15 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Just what is that supposed to mean? They make them in whatever size the customer asks for!
:{{A|vo aylq002 15 ayaka 07.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' Hahaha, ah, your interactions are so adorable to watch... Ahem! I mean, um... I can certainly find someone to tailor a Paimon-sized outfit, if Paimon so wishes.
:{{DIcon}} Ayaka, you're too kind.
:{{DIcon}} Thanks, but Paimon and I are fine as we are.
:{{A|vo aylq002 15 ayaka 08.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' Hm, well if you're sure... As you wish.

'''''Zip Along (According to Safe Cart Operating Procedures)''''' is an [[Event Quest]] during [[Secret Summer Paradise]]: Part I - [[An Invitation From Afar!]].

==Steps==
# Go to the canyon Klee told you about
# Ride ahead on the rail tracks
# Save the Hydro Eidolon from the preprint
# Ride ahead on the Choo-Choo Cart
# Keep riding ahead on the Choo-Choo Cart
# Head to the rail junction
# Ride the cart ahead to look for the Jeroney
# Switch tracks using the Junction
# Ride the Choo-Choo Cart towards the Torrential Twister
# Talk to Haddo
# Ride the Choo-Choo Cart and go activate the tracks
# Activate the Torrential Twister
# Return to the Torrential Twister's Cart Platform
# Ride the Choo-Choo Cart
# Ride the Torrential Twister
# Talk to everyone
# Return to the Silver Bottle Courtyard
